An employee was run over and suffered a fractured pelvis, collapsed lung, and collapsed bladder.

An employee climbed a tree and tied off during tree trimming activities. The employee cut a limb, which fell and broke the limb he was tied off onto. He fell approximately 40 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured skull, a blood spot on the brain, and fractured bones around his right ear. He was hospitalized.
An employee's left ring finger was amputated while running wood through a table saw.
An employee was cleaning up debris on a riverbank when a splinter entered his left hand. The hand became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a bulldozer to unload it off a trailer onto a dirt shoulder. The bulldozer rolled onto its side and struck the employee. The employee suffered a skull fracture.

Employees working on a roof took an extension ladder apart. The piece with the feet was being used on the roof to access another portion of the building while the other piece of the ladder was being used on the ground. The piece of the ladder being used on the ground was not tied off and fell when an employee used it. The employee broke his leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized with broken ribs after falling approximately 18 feet off an unguarded area of the cat walk. The employee was on the walkway to unjam equipment.

An employee was brushing plastic shavings to one end inside the CNC machine so that the shavings could be removed. The auger inside the machine started, and the employee's hand came into contact with the auger, breaking bones.
An employee was operating a drill press with a gloved hand, which got entangled in the drill bit. His left little finger was amputated.
An employee was lifting metal pallets when a metal pallet slipped out of his hand and crushed his right hand middle finger, breaking it.
An employee fell 35 feet while installing metal decking.
An employee performing inspections suffered heat stress and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was acting as a spotter for a trenching site. The trenching machine grabbed a piece of form board, which hit and crushed the employee's ankle.
An employee's leg fell asleep while riding in a passenger van.  When he stood up, he fell down and broke his right fibula.
An employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.
An employee was walking near the CNC router when his leg got caught between a moving table and the base of the router. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning an electrical component in a de-energized substation. Another crew was providing power to an electrical pump motor. The alternate power was from another substation and energy source. A closed switched allowed the electricity to flow back to where the injured employee was working.

An employee was outside behind the store removing toy freight from a storage container. The storage container door was open at the time. A gust of wind blew the door shut on the employee's ankle, giving him a large gash. His Achilles tendon was severed, requiring surgery.
An employee's hand got caught and severed in a shear machine while cutting fence posts.
After completing a round of deliveries, an employee experienced heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee working in the Unicor Prison Industry furniture factory walked backwards and tripped over a pallet, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was transferring packages from a pallet to a trailer using a pallet jack. While loading the packages, he stated he "felt something wrong."  He required surgery for a hernia.

Rice was not coming down to the bran remover from the auger/conveyor above. An employee removed the round plate from the square round pipe and stuck his arm inside, feeling for the cause of the choke. His hand contacted the rotating screw auger/conveyor above. He suffered an amputation of his right hand up to and including the mid-point of his ulna and the radius of his right forearm. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee driving a forklift was thrown from it. The employee's foot was crushed by the forklift.
An employee was adding oil to the extruder. The auger, which was still turning, caught and amputated the employee's thumb tip. The extruder was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was putting foam beneath a die cutter machine when the machine came down, crushing and amputating his left index finger.

The injured employee was working as part of a three-person crew. The crew was removing and disassembling a bin-whip used to unclog a bin. As the bin-whip is raised, a 4-foot section is removed and the remaining part is reattached to the hydraulics used to raise it. 

Another crew member struggled to insert a pin to attach the hydraulics to the bin-whip. The injured employee reached over to help insert the pin and bumped the hydraulic controls with his knee. This caused the pin to rotate and pinch the injured employee's right index finger between the pin and the bin-whip housing. His finger was amputated.

An employee was training a coworker in the processing division when he noticed something caught in an overhead conveyor. When he went to remove it, his glove got caught in the conveyor, twisting his right wrist and injuring his extensor tendon.

On August 13, 2015, at about 5:30 p.m., an employee was operating a center rider (forklift) to pick up a pallet with his left hand outside of the forklift. He smashed his left-hand little finger against a bollard pole at the warehouse. His fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee's finger was lacerated while working with a saw. He was hospitalized.

An employee had connected a flux car for unloading. The previous car that unloaded into this line had oil with some residual water. When the flux (a tar-like substance) made contact with the water, it expanded and contacted the employee as he exited the railcar, causing first and second degree thermal burns.
While working on Rollstock equipment, three of an employee's right-hand fingers were amputated in the machine.
An employee was cutting a piece of flat bar stock using an ironworker machine. The machine's hold down jaws caught and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was disconnecting an attachment from the boom of an excavator for a transmission crew. When the connecting pin was removed, the 100-pound auger motor he was working on fell and crushed the end of his left pinky finger. He suffered an amputation of the distal end/joint of that finger.
On 08/14/15, at 06:15 a.m., an employee tried to unjam a press. The machine was still running at the time and it cycled, partially amputating the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was using an impact tool to tighten lug nuts on a truck wheel when the truck fell, pinning his hand between the truck frame and the impact tool. His left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was loading empty water bottles onto a truck using a dolly. A bus hit the dolly, which then struck the employee and fractured his collarbone.
An employee's finger was partially amputated after getting caught between a wood part and work table while feeding parts into a gusset machine.

An employee was fishing coax wiring through a drop ceiling from a 4-foot, A-frame step ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and struck his head, causing a laceration to the back of his head, bleeding on the brain, and a concussion. He required staples to close the laceration.
An employee was creating a new chemical inside a fume hood when the beaker exploded. The employee received multiple lacerations to the face from the beaker glass.
An employee driving a walkie ran into a stock picker in an aisle. The employee's left leg and ankle were injured, requiring surgery.

An employee was connecting a concrete form that was 29 inches high x 30 feet long. The form was being stored on the ground horizontally. Before the employee could get the form connected to the overhead gantry crane, the form fell 
over and injured the employee's right leg, causing a distal fracture to the right femur.

An employee inserted an Allen key into the soft step adjuster of a lip groover to adjust the machine's tension. His left pinky finger was positioned near the machine shaft and shaft housing. The work cell was not de-energized at the time. As he was making the adjustment, the machine cycled, pulling the shaft into the housing and amputating approximately half of his left pinky finger.
On August 14, 2015, an employee's left index finger got caught in the point of operation of a mechanical power press. The distal tip of his finger was surgically amputated (above the first joint).

An employee was doing a roll-up on the belt slitter machine when the belt buckled after he cut it. He turned away from the machine to get a stick to flatten the belt and slipped off the wooden box that he was standing on. While trying to catch his balance, he put his right hand down on the belt going under the roller. He turned the machine off, which caused the roller to drop and crush his right forearm.

On Friday, August 14, 2015, an employee was bracing a dump truck tailgate. When he removed the pins, he lost his balance and the tailgate fell over and crushed his big toe on the right foot. The toe was surgically amputated.
An employee fell backwards (5 to 6 feet) off a ladder on 8/14/15, breaking the tibia to the right knee.

An employee was tearing down an office wall while standing on a rafter using a pry bar and hammer. The employee lost his footing and fell approximately 9 feet to the lower ground level, breaking his right arm and wrist and injuring his right elbow. He was hospitalized.

An employee was running a compound liner machine when she saw a cover that she thought she had to align. She placed her hand on the machine, which was running, and her right hand/glove was pinched between the stacker plate. She pulled her hand out of the glove and her middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a forklift up a ramp to the truck scale when he drove off the ramp, fell off the forklift, and broke his leg.
An employee working at the service desk tripped over an object and fell to the ground, hitting their upper left arm and sustaining a possible fracture.

On Saturday, August 15, 2015, at approximately 2:00 p.m., an employee was operating a forklift at a roofing project jobsite. He was reversing the forklift when he made a sharp 90-degree turn with the boom extended, causing the forklift to overturn. He sustained injuries to his toes on the right foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to loosen the pin so that he could adjust the tandem wheels under the back of his 53-foot semi-trailer for loading/unloading. An air line failed or an air spring (ballast) burst, suddenly dropping the trailer down and pinning the employee's arm between the top of the tire and bottom of the trailer frame. His arm was crushed and lacerated.

Two employees were working on the well head to bleed pressure off a tank so that ethylene glycol could be added. The sight glass on the tank exploded and struck one of the employees in the face, causing a severe facial laceration and requiring surgery.
An employee's finger was amputated while removing the sample port from a blender during cleaning activities. The blender was running at the time.
An employee was struck by an object that swung while it was rigged to a forklift, suffering a possible spinal fracture.
An employee was trying to unjam a staple gun when the staple gun activated and shot a staple into his hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was changing the teeth on a saw when the chain used in the lockout/tagout procedure broke, allowing the saw blade to fall and strike the employee's head and knocking him out.  He fell about 2 feet and broke his right leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was raising the flag outside of the post office. Two dogs attacked him, causing lacerations on both forearms, knees, and calves. He was hospitalized.

On 8-15-15, at 1330, an employee working in the seafood department received a puncture wound in her right index finger from a yellow tail snapper fin bone while scaling the fish. She was hospitalized.

An employee fell 18 feet through an open hole on a 1/4 x 12 pitch roof while monitoring employees installing a standing seam metal roof. The employee sustained head lacerations and fractures to the skull and face.

Two employees were delivering furniture to a private residence. One of the employees was inside the residence while the other stayed in the truck. The employee inside the truck slipped on a piece of plastic while moving a dresser, and the dresser fell on and fractured his right ankle.
An employee suffered a hernia when lifting a bag of linen from a bin.
An employee was pinned against the fuselage of an MD-80 when the jack that he was using to change a tire failed.

An employee was operating a plate forming press when his right hand got caught between the plate press. Three right-hand fingers (index, middle, and ring fingers) were lacerated, and the employee was hospitalized.

On 08/16/2015, an employee was installing highway drainage pipes inside an excavation. A slab of asphalt that was next to the pipe trench broke loose and slid into the excavation, catching his fingers between the slab and the trench bottom. His left index finger at the knuckle and left thumb at the first joint were fully amputated at the hospital.

On 8-16-2015, at about 1750 p.m., an employee was working at the special services return desk when a can of red mahogany Minwax spilled. The vapors caused the employee to have difficulty breathing and triggered an asthma attack. She was hospitalized.
Molten lead from recycled batteries erupted from a kettle, causing second degree burns to an employee's right arm. An aluminized suit was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped and fell while getting coffee from the cafeteria, resulting in a fractured shoulder and pelvis.

When an employee made a turn while operating a forklift, the forklift got too close to the wall and caught the employee's finger between the forklift and a hydraulic pipe along the wall. The employee's finger was amputated.

An employee was installing a pump during the fracking process when he felt lightheaded and began vomiting. He started having heat cramps and was hospitalized after suffering severe dehydration while operating equipment outside with temperatures of 105F.
An employee had been working outside moving baggage and was found passed out in the break room. The employee was hospitalized for extreme dehydration that caused kidney failure.
An employee tripped and fell down the stairs in the dock area. The employee was found unconscious at the bottom of the stairs.
An employee was hospitalized with a lower back strain/groin strain after welding small parts.
An employee's left thumb got pinched in the stamping die of a punch press. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was installing the wood truss of a roof when the truss moved, causing the employee to lose balance and fall approximately 10 feet to the floor. The employee broke both wrists and ribs on the left side. A fall protection system was not used at the time.
An employee demolishing a kiosk sustained a cut on the right forearm while removing a plank that had a veneer/laminated cover.

An employee was packing bags of baked snacks into shipping boxes. While moving from the packing area to another section of the plant, the employee went under a portable conveyor and pulled it down while trying to support their weight. The conveyor belt fell onto the employee, lacerating the head and arm and requiring arterial cauterization.

On August 17, 2015, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was injured while assisting a customer with a riding lawnmower positioned on a display. The employee was lowering the display to retrieve the lawnmower.  The display did not operate properly, so the employee lifted up on it to break it loose. The display and lawnmower fell and pinned the employee's left hand between the equipment and the ground, amputating one fingertip and fracturing three fingers.
An employee was walking on the property. When the employer opened the metal gate, it came off its roller and struck the employee, breaking several vertebrae in his back.

An employee was injured while working from a scissor lift installing a metal corrugated steel panel on a wall. The employee was removing an angle iron on an overhead door that was connected to the overhead door spring. As the final bolt was removed, the spring's tension was released, causing the angle iron to repeatedly strike the employee's left hand. The employee sustained fractured bones and severed tendons in the left hand.
An employee was cleaning gutters at a client's home when he fell approximately 10 feet off a ladder to the ground. He was hospitalized with a broken right wrist.

An employee was painting a traffic light pole at an intersection when a semi truck struck the bucket truck he was working in. He was ejected from the bucket onto the pavement and was hospitalized with multiple skull fractures.

An employee was preparing to operate a motorized roof tear off machine. The machine got stuck in reverse. The employee held on to the machine as it continued reversing. Both the employee and the machine fell off of the roof. The employee sustained bruised ribs and shoulders.

An employee on a ladder was drilling holes in the wall to run fiber optic wire for a breakroom television monitor. As he tried to pull the wire through the hole, the ladder slipped out from under him and slid down the wall it was leaning on. He landed on the ladder and the floor, fracturing his right femur.
An employee drove a golf cart into the pond and dislocated their shoulder.

An employee was delivering milk.  While he was unloading the milk case with a coworker, the case slipped out of his hand and landed on his leg, crushing his tibia. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee had finished repairing the scraper and was pulling in the outriggers on his work truck. As he pulled up the outriggers, the truck rolled backwards and pinned him between the scraper and truck, breaking his back.

An employee was helping to prepare an electrical transformer for shipment to a customer's location. The transformer was moved to a pallet. When a forklift approached the pallet to pick it up, the transformer began to lean and then fall toward the ground. The employee, in an attempt to stop the 1,200-pound transformer from falling, reached out his left arm, which was then crushed between the transformer and the work table. He fractured his left forearm (ulnar and radius) and all five digits on his left hand.

An employee was releasing cargo chains tied around an excavator in a cargo hold on level 1 of the vessel. During that time, some of the latch hooks on the chains became wedged and would not budge. A coworker used a pry bar to help release the chains. The coworker pulled on the pry bar, which slipped from the coworker's grasp and flew towards the injured employee. The pry bar struck the injured employee in the head, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the ground, lining up a load for a flatbed truck. The employee had placed dunnage on the tire and moved it right as the load was put in place. This caused the trailer to level out and catch his finger between the dunnage and the trailer frame. He sustained a partial fingertip amputation, no bone, to the fourth left-hand digit.
An employee was putting auto parts in the grinding machine when his index fingertip was amputated.
On 08/17/15, an employee experienced cramping while tagging equipment. He later experienced dizziness and vomiting. He was hospitalized for dehydration leading to heat stress.
An employee was making adjustments to a vise on a cold saw machine when the vise clamped down on the employee's left hand, fracturing two fingers and partially amputating the index finger.
An employee was building a pallet and was bent over putting in the last nail. As he stood up, the nail gun trigger was still depressed and shot a nail into his ankle.
An employee was walking from the bathroom in an area where a bucket loader was operating. The loader struck and broke the employee's right leg while it was backing up.
An employee stepped from a semi-truck onto a curb that was 7" high. His ankle gave out and he fell to the ground on his right hip. He sustained a compression fracture of the L2 vertebra.

An employee was sanding a pipe on a training lathe while wearing gloves. The employee's right glove got caught on the pipe and was drawn into the turning pipe, amputating part of his right thumb tip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to receive trim from an upper shelf. The unbalanced load caused the forklift to tip over. The employee's right leg was fractured by the lift's mast when the employee tried to exit the forklift as it was tipping.
An employee was lowering a crane wheel using a crane when his finger got caught between the crane wheel and the steel rope. His right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was carrying heavy metal pans when he dropped them on his foot, damaging his pinky toe. The toe was surgically amputated at the hospital.

An employee masking an aircraft using a boom lift fell approximately 10 feet to the ground when he exited the lift. He was hospitalized for a broken back and bleeding in the brain. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
A maintenance employee fell through the roof of a paint booth he was disassembling when the roof bowed.
While performing maintenance on a punch press machine, an employee's right-hand middle finger got caught in a rotating wheel and was amputated.
An employee was spreading decking when he fell approximately 16 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized overnight with a possible broken arm and fractured jaw, requiring surgery.

On 8-18-2015, at about 8:40 a.m., three employees were de-energizing and locking out a 480 VAC circuit breaker. The breaker did not open properly. When the cubicle door was opened, an arc flash occurred, injuring the first employee with 2nd and 3rd degree burns to his face, arm, and chest. Another employee had no injuries, and the last suffered minor burns to the face and arms. The first employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling overhead jacks for an upper forming system when he fell approximately 20 feet off of the pier of the bridge. He broke his leg and ankle, requiring surgery.

On 8/18/2015, a garbage truck's front tire ran over and broke an employee's foot and leg. The employee had exited the front cab of the truck while it was still moving to pick up trash. The employee required surgery.
An employee was using a pressure washer when he lacerated his left middle finger. He was hospitalized overnight.

On 8/18/2015, in the Disney Magic Kingdom's cast member parking lot, an employee was struck by a pick-up truck driven by another Disney employee. The injured employee suffered a broken ankle and required surgery.

On 8-18-2015, at about 10:00 a.m., an employee was operating a Bobcat machine to remove soil. With soil in the bucket, the employee travelled forward down an incline. The elevated bucket tilted forward and the bucket got stuck. The employee could not get the machine to tilt back and the rear wheels were 1 foot off the ground. The employee's right foot got caught between the back of the bucket and the machine. The top of the employee's right foot bones were crushed, requiring surgery.
An employee was loading cream on a milk truck using a flexible hose when the employee's finger got caught between the handle and body of a plunger valve, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was installing insulation plates on a flat roof. While walking backwards, he tripped and fell 20 feet through a skylight, injuring his right wrist and left heel.
An employee was drilling holes in steel pipes when his glove got caught in the drill, pulling his right hand into the rotating part. His right middle finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was closing the office safe (4 feet by 3 feet) when her left thumb got caught between the safe door (3 inches thick) and the safe door jam. Her left thumb tip and nail were severed.  She was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was attempting to relocate a pallet of car batteries while operating a forklift with the forks elevated. As he attempted to turn, the forklift flipped over and pinned him beneath the roll-over protector and the ground. He suffered blunt force trauma to the upper torso and ruptured his spleen, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was traveling by ATV on a forest road. While turning a corner, he was thrown from the ATV and hit the ground. He broke his rib and collarbone and bruised his lungs.
An employee slipped and lacerated nerves in the right-hand middle finger.

The employee was conducting a residential building inspection and was chased by a dog in the back yard of the residence. While running away from the dog on an uneven surface, the employee fractured the left foot requiring surgery to repair the injury.
An employee was standing beside a truck watching the septic tank get pumped out. The employee bent to pick up the hose and was bitten by a coral snake on the right index finger.
An employee was dumping a plastic trash cart into a compactor. Her right ring fingertip got stuck between the plastic receptacle and the metal frame around it. She sustained a fingertip amputation.
Am employee was adjusting the grinding plate of a machine when the plate fell on the employee's hand, amputating a finger.

An employee was carrying a carton of eggs downstairs at the cafeteria. She missed the bottom stair and fell to the ground, fracturing her left ankle/foot and spraining her right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was performing service work on paving equipment outdoors. The employee experienced stomach pain, possibly due to heat stress, and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell when walking toward room 3536 while doing rounds in the facility hallway. The employee's left thigh bone was fractured.
An employee was standing near a hose/pipe connection. The pressurized water hose came loose and struck an employee while moving at a great speed and force, breaking his leg.

An employee was exiting the chip box of a bucket truck. When he moved his left foot off of the tailgate, his right foot slipped due to the weight shifting and he lost control of his footing. He fell and suffered internal bleeding near the kidney.

An employee was doing a service check on a tilt bed trailer. The employee went to the front of the trailer to lock it in place so it wouldn't tilt. There was a small gap in the neck of trailer. A coworker stepped onto the back of the trailer and the trailer went upward, crushing and amputating the employee's finger.

An employee was moving pallets in the warehouse with a forklift. As the employee exited the forklift, it rolled and pinned the employee between the wall and forklift. The forks broke the employee's leg.

An employee was helping a forklift operator load two pallets of solar panels into a flatbed truck. The employee was holding a piece of dunnage and his finger got pinched when the forklift operator pushed the second pallet farther into the box truck. The employee's right ring fingertip and nail were amputated.
An employee was kicked in the chest by a horse while attempting to saddle it. The employee broke multiple bones and suffered a laceration.
An employee was distributing mail from a pallet to mail routes.  He tripped over plastic wrapping and struck his head on a desk, suffering a laceration and head trauma and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was being lifted by an aerial lift to repair a wellhead. The employee's left thumb got crushed and fractured between the aerial lift and the wellhead.

On August 18, 2015, at approximately 7:00 p.m., two employees were performing die setting operations. The first employee used a forklift to place a die in a press. The second employee approached the backside of the press and began to install bolts in the die. The first employee had not finished aligning the die. When the first employee repositioned the die for bolting, it caused the washer and bolt that the second employee was holding to move and pinch the second employee's finger against the die. The second employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

On August 18, 2015, an employee was hospitalized after tripping and falling onto a box of granulator blades that were awaiting sharpening. The employee sustained lacerations to the hands and arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the shower line (high pressure water line) in the liner head box on the wet end of a paper machine. He stood up to get out of the box as someone from maintenance began to move the crane and got caught between the crane bridge and the liner head box lid. He broke his ribs and left forearm and dislocated his sternum.

An employee was removing parts from a rack while standing on a portable platform. He lost his balance and fell approximately 50 inches to the walkway below, breaking two fingers and fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was operating a forklift.  When the employee made a hard right turn, the forklift turned over on its side and trapped the employee's left foot underneath the roll cage.  The employee was hospitalized and his foot was amputated.

An employee was climbing a 20-foot extension ladder to adjust boxes he had flung to the top of the wall when the ladder slipped. Both the ladder and employee fell down. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis.
An employee was performing maintenance on a Cellunator when their left glove got entangled in one of the disks, amputating the left ring fingertip to the first knuckle.
An employee was rigging the painter's boom when the rigging rope got cut on a sharp edge and broke. The rigging came down and hit the employee in the left knee, causing a laceration.

An employee was hospitalized after suffering breathing difficulties related to a compressed air spray operation to spray paint fire extinguishers conducted on August 19, 2015. A respirator wasn't worn and no monitoring was conducted to determine employee exposure during spray operations.

An employee was grinding a chisel. When he placed the chisel on the work blade, the grinding wheel caught the chisel through the work rest and pulled his left thumb into the grinding wheel. His left thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was parking a stand-up forklift in the equipment room for powered industrial trucks. He struck another parked lift while his foot was hanging outside the platform. His foot was crushed, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a load using a power jack when, due to wet floors, he lost control and crashed the power jack into a stack of pallets. The pallets fell on him, injuring his right ankle.
An employee was standing between an RCD pipe and a loader with forks on it when the pipe rolled and pinned the employee to the loader, crushing and fracturing his leg.
An employee pouring concrete was struck by a car that drove into the employee's work zone. The employee sustained a broken leg, as well as cuts and bruises to the hip.
During welding operations, an employee's right pant leg caught on fire, resulting in 1st and 2nd degree burns. FR-rated pants were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a winch to rehang beef that had fallen off the hook when his finger got caught between the trolley and the rail, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was climbing a ladder after a rain storm to set a 2 X 6 on the roof.  The employee slipped and fell about 15 feet to the ground, fracturing his vertebrae and injuring his head.

On 8/19/2015, an employee was working out in the morning as part of the unit's training exercise. The employee experienced nausea and vomiting, almost fainted, and was hospitalized with a muscle injury.
An employee fell from a ladder and injured his right leg.
An employee lost control of a stand-up forklift and their foot got crushed between a racking system and a forklift.
A maintenance employee fell approximately 4 feet and fractured his arm when the airline (pipe) he stepped on broke.
An employee was walking down the hallway. While turning to the elevator, she slipped and fell, fracturing her right hip on the wet floor. She was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was performing daily inspections on the Dominator Ride. He attached a fall protection device to the carriage of the ride and rode the carriage to the top, then stepped off of the carriage and onto an inspection catwalk. He contacted personnel on the ground to lower the carriage so he could inspect the ride cables. He did not disconnect his harness and lanyard and was pulled off the catwalk by the harness and lanyard as the carriage was lowered. He was left suspended in the air from the lanyard and harness, suffering seven broken ribs, as well as neck and shoulder edema and contusions.
An employee was delivering mail on their route when they began to feel unwell and vomited. The employee was diagnosed with dehydration.

An employee was installing light posts when the derrick truck swung the light post and contacted the power line behind them. The trailer holding the post became energized, and the employee received severe electrical burns.
An employee was trying to unhook lumber at the sawmill gang when the hook flopped. He lost his balance and fell, and his left hand went between a roller and a plate, crushing his left thumb.
While closing a gate to an animal pen, an employee's right ring finger got caught in the gate and was amputated.
After performing mail carrier tasks, an employee suffered from heat stress/exhaustion.
On 8/19/2015, an employee stepped and fell between the trailer and the dock. His injuries included a lacerated knee. He was hospitalized for stitches and/or staples to close the laceration.

An employee at the warehouse placed a 35-pound box of degreaser on the forks of a motorized stand-on powered industrial vehicle and hit the wrong button, causing the PIV to move backwards and pin the employee against the rack system. The employee suffered a crushing fracture to the left leg.
An employee fell from the roof while looking for anchor points, breaking a leg.

An employee was cutting and grinding metal on a building column to prepare it for painting. A backhoe nearby lurched and pinned the employee between the backhoe bucket and the building column, injuring (hematoma) the employee's left thigh requiring surgery.
An employee was walking down the hall toward the nurse's station when she fell and broke her right hip.

An employee was piloting a boat to bring crew members back to shore. The boat navigation systems indicated that they were farther out in the channel than they actually were. The boat hit a tree and threw two employees onto dry land. One of the two employees was hospitalized.
On 8-19-15, an employee had a reaction while cleaning. The employee experienced difficulty breathing and anaphylactic shock and was hospitalized.
On August 19, an employee was feeding sod into a jammed plug machine. While trying to clear the jam, her finger got cut on the blades, which were still spinning. She later had the tip amputated.

An employee was hospitalized when she stepped into a floor opening and fell. She was cleaning the deli area with coworkers. The floor drain was removed for cleaning purposes. She required surgery for her injured right ankle.
An employee bent over to unplug an electronic pencil sharpener and was unable to straighten their back, suffering a lumbar injury.
An employee was directing traffic at the main parking lot along Lancaster Avenue. The employee experienced heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
While slicing meat on a meat band saw, an employee's hand slipped and her right middle and index fingertips were amputated.

An employee was standing on the ground and tripped on a fallen tree. The employee was trying to cut a vine when the chain tip hit the wooden fence, causing the chainsaw to kick back. The chain hit and lacerated the employee on the top of the left shoulder.

An employee was trying to sort out a stray cow that had come into the pen. The employee's horse stumbled. He tried to dismount the horse, but his foot got caught in the stirrups. He fractured his lower right leg.

Two employees were at Blackpoint Marina to repair a fuel leak on a customer's boat. The employees identified a corroded fuel valve (pickup) and replaced it. They were checking for additional leaks when a small explosion occurred in the bilge area. The ignition source may have been static electricity from a cell phone. Both employees received burns to their hands and faces and were hospitalized.
An employee's right ring finger was partially amputated when it got pinched between a reel of veneer and the reel track.

An employee was unloading pipes by cutting the metal band that held them all together. One of the metal pipes came loose and rolled over, falling on the employee's foot. The employee's right big toe was amputated.

An employee was attempting to change out an adhesive pot on a machine. During the draining process, some of the adhesive spilled out. The employee slipped and fell on the liquid adhesive, breaking his tibia and fibula in the right leg.
An employee fell and broke her leg while walking in the lobby area.
An employee was closing the lid that covers the tire shoot when the lid fell on his left hand, partially amputating at least one finger.
On 8-20-2015, at about 10:00 a.m., an employee descending a ladder lost his balance and fell to the concrete ground, sustaining injuries.
An employee stepped from a ladder to the roof, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. A coworker operating a forklift with the forks up ran into the pallet jack. One of the forks struck and cut the employee's upper right thigh.

An employee was guiding a forklift driver to a specific area. The forklift hit a chuck hole in the ground, causing the load to shift and fall onto the employee's leg. The employee sustained a broken fibula and tibia, several broken metatarsals, and a fractured foot.

On August 20, 2015, an employee was rethreading the extruded tube product into the belted puller. The rollers caught his glove and pulled his left thumb into the nip point, crushing it. He was hospitalized for a left thumb contusion.

An employee was using a forklift to line up the shaft and bearing on a yarder. His finger was inside a bolt hole on a cable drum when the weight was shifted to line up the equipment. His finger got caught between the drum and the forklift fork, necessitating the amputation of his right index fingertip.
An employee was running an obstacle course when he ran into a support beam and injured his knee.

An employee was driving a forklift at the Walmart Distribution Center in Smyrna, Delaware.  He dismounted the moving forklift, which drove toward a vertical I-beam. His left foot got caught between the I-beam and the forklift and his toes were crushed. All of his left-foot toes were surgically amputated.
An employee tripped on the smock of another employee and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur.

An employee was training a coworker on how to operate a CNC machine when she tried to adjust the clamp that holds the part being processed. The clamp is operated by a foot pedal on the floor. While adjusting the clamp, she inadvertently stepped on the foot pedal, activating the clamp and severing her right index and middle fingertips.  She required surgery.

An employee was running parts through a punch press. The part jammed, so he attempted to retrieve the part from the machine. His foot hit the foot pedal and activated the punch, which amputated his left thumb down to the first bone and required surgery. The guard was not in place at the time of the incident.

An employee was on the fourth rung of a ladder that was leaned up against a modular home.  A tractor moved the modular home while the ladder was still leaned against it. The employee fell from the ladder, breaking a foot and hurting his/her back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in the mold maintenance area unloading an approximately 4 ft. by 4 ft. steel mold from the transport trailer with a crane. He stepped up on the trailer (approximately 29 inches high) and as he was stepping down from the trailer, he slipped and fell to the floor fracturing his left elbow in multiple places. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery to repair the fractures.

An employee was standing on a 5' X 10' board, which was laying on jersey barriers so that the employee could screw other pieces of wood  to the board at a downward angle. The employee stepped off the edge and fell 4 feet, injuring the left knee and requiring hospitalization.

On or about August 20, 2015 at approximately 4:40 p.m., an employee received a hand injury while working on the pepper production line. The employee was feeling dizzy and went to sit on a small roller conveyor. As he sat down, he put his hand on a moving chain conveyor, which pulled his finger into the sprocket and partially amputated it.

An excavator was dislodged from a flatbed trailer after hitting an overpass on Northbound I-15. An employee attempted to reload the excavator onto the trailer.  The excavator encountered fluid on the flatbed and slipped off the trailer. The employee was injured, sustaining a hairline fracture to the neck vertebrae.

An employee was operating a slitter machine and grabbed the latch. The latch is stopped at 90 degrees by a safety pin, however the safety pin was worn out and it did not stop the latch. The latch continued past the 90 degree angle with the employee still holding it with his left hand and made contact with the metal box that houses the slitter's major bearings. Once the latch made contact with the metal box it crushed employee's left little, ring, and middle fingers. The little finger was amputated at the hospital.

An employee was measuring a pallet of paper on an automated conveyor line. The conveyor cycled and the employee's finger got caught between the paper and an I-beam. The employee's left-hand middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was visually inspecting a steel pipe while standing between the pipe he was inspecting and another pipe. One of the pipes started to roll towards him, and he got caught between the two steel pipes, sustaining soft-tissue damage to both legs.

An employee entered the blast booth service room to investigate why media was not flowing. His leg was amputated when he stepped into a floor auger. The cover guarding the auger was removed at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing MIBS (solar panel supports) outdoors when the employee started to feel lightheaded. Coworkers took the employee into the general contractor's trailer where the employee began to vomit due to heat stress.
An employee was exposed to bacteria, became ill, and was hospitalized.

An employee was assembling rings into plastic tubes. The employee ran out of large plastic tubes and went to the crib area storage to retrieve more. The employee climbed onto a rolling ladder and fell off, sustaining fractures.

An employee was forming parts on a hydraulic press brake. The material being formed rotated and crushed the employee's thumb between the material and the press brake frame. The employee's right thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was helping a flow hand from another company change rubber between two pieces of high-pressure pipe. As the employee was checking to make sure the rubber was seated properly, the clamp slipped, amputating his right-hand middle fingertip.
An employee was adjusting the track control on a conveyor when his hand got caught by the chain, partially amputating his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was repairing an axle hub when a bolt from the hub came out of the air gun and struck the employee's left index finger. The finger was fractured.

On August 21, 2015, at 8:30 p.m., an employee was starting a pump when an expansion joint failed, releasing sulfuric acid into the atmosphere. The employee inhaled sulfuric acid fumes as he was evacuating the area. He was hospitalized.

On August 21, 2015, an employee was scanning products on the dock when she was struck by an unstable load (boxed flat screen TVs) being transported by a forklift truck. Approximately 500 pounds fell on the employee, who sustained crushing injuries to her left ankle, ligament damage to her right ankle, and contusions to her lower body and both legs. She was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting the vacuum channel of a machine when his hot gloves got pulled into the blocks. Half of his right ring finger was amputated. The guard was not in place at the time.

An employee was loading cars and moving a lever to adjust platform heights. The wrong lever was moved while the employee's hand was resting on a long pole. His left index finger got caught on the hydraulic platform and was partially amputated.
An employee was walking in the green lumber storage area and slipped on a wet surface and fell, suffering a broken hip.

An employee pulled Printing Section # 1 out of the Martin Machine and opened the interlocked cover on the ink rollers. He then took a pair of vise-grips, depressed the jog button, and clamped the button to the housing in the depressed position causing the rollers to rotate slowly. The employee then used a hose to spray water on the partially submerged  ink rollers to clean them. The inside of the container in which the rollers were partially submerged was painted black. The color of the ink was also black. The employee reached his  right hand into the liquid to see if it was clear, and his hand was pulled into the nip points of the rollers resulting in the amputation of the middle and ring fingers and one half of the index finger on his right hand.
An employee suffered burns to his face and head while repairing an air conditioner compressor with a torch at a customer's job site.
An employee's finger was bitten by a venomous snake while attempting to search for a welding pipe. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove a paper jam in a folding machine when the machine indexed and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.

An employee was working from a roof approximately three stories high when he fell about 15 feet. He was wearing his harness at the time. During the fall, his right arm was struck and lacerated by a radial arm saw that fell with him. He sustained deep cuts in his tendons and loss of feeling in his fingers.

An employee was in a ditch (approximately 7 feet deep) unhooking a pipe from a backhoe when the ditch caved in from behind. The employee hit his head against the pipe and suffered a fractured skull, head injuries, a broken jaw, a broken left eye socket, possible blindness in the left eye, damage to teeth, and a swollen ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hooking up a backyard machine to a digger derrick when the employee's finger got caught between the hook and the backyard machine. The employee's pinky finger broke.

An employee was helping a coworker assemble a vehicle seat.  The seat was moving down the assembly line on a jig, which allows the seat to tilt forward and backward.  The employee tilted the jig with one hand while his other hand was in a pinch point. The employee's right-hand pinky fingertip got degloved between the first knuckle and the start of the fingernail. The employee was hospitalized.
A worker suffered heat stroke while forming and grouting a pressure relief valve.

On 8/21/2015, two employees were traveling toward each other in the same aisle on separate stand-up forklifts. They collided, and one employee suffered a right foot injury, including a laceration and possible broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stringing new power line using pools of wire that are carried on a reel mounted on a trailer.  His finger got pinched in the reel, and his left ring finder was crushed and amputated.
An employee was operating a punch press and was using pull-backs to protect his hands.  His left hand got caught in the press, and three fingers were amputated.

An employee was inspecting freight he had just placed in the aisle using a forklift when a forklift driver backed up and pinned the employee between the two forklifts. The employee sustained a broken hip.
On August 21, 2015, an employee's left-hand middle and index fingertips were amputated by a saw when the employee attempted to adjust the blade. The saw was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was unloading product from a box trailer. The driver pulled away from the dock and the employee fell out of the back of the truck to the ground, suffering a concussion and fractured skull.

An employee tried to prevent a turkey neck from going through the peeler. The employee's glove got caught in the peeler rollers, which crushed the left middle fingertip. The fingertip was amputated below the fingernail.

Two forklifts collided in the processing area causing one of them to tip over.  The employee in the forklift that tipped over sustained a broken arm and a broken ankle requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee pulled the start cord on a generator, and the generator fell on the employee. The employee suffered a strained knee.
An employee was cutting cabbage using a produce knife when she cut her right index fingertip.
Employee tripped on a metal skid 8' X 20' X 5" and fractured an ankle.
A demolition saw kicked back on an employee who was cutting railroad tie. The saw hit his opposite shoulder and caused soft tissue damage (blood and nerve damage).

An employee was dispensing propane from a main propane tank into a smaller tank. As he unscrewed the nozzle from the smaller tank, a burst of propane came out from the main tank and burned his hands and forearms.
On August 22, 2015, at approximately 0100, an employee turned a stand-up forklift and hit a crate. The employee's left foot, which was outside of the cockpit, broke.

An employee was cleaning out a mud pond when his right leg, up to his shin, became stuck in the mud. He was unable to free himself. A coworker used a high-pressure washing wand to try to loosen the area around the employee's leg.  The pressure wand got too close and cut through the employee's boot, lacerating the side of his right foot from the small toe to the middle.  He was hospitalized and received stitches.
An employee experienced an amputation to the right middle finger while clearing a jam from an energized and functional fruit feeder.
An employee amputated the fourth and fifth fingertips of the right hand while working on a milling machine.
An employee riding a railcar in order to move it around a switch yard lost his balance and lacerated his foot.
The employee was walking and tripped on a curb dislocating both elbows.

An employee was found unconscious lying next to the stock picker he had been operating. It is suspected that he fell from the machine. The machine's work platform was approximately 15 feet above the warehouse floor when the employee was discovered.

Four employees were burned by hot plastic while working in the vicinity of a plastic extruding machine. One employee required hospitalization. The employees were purging an extruder machine and cleaning the die when they were sprayed with hot, melted PVC material. The hospitalized employee suffered first and second degree burns to the face and neck.
Employee climbed nine feet to the top of a machine to troubleshoot a jam.  The employee lost footing and fell nine feet to the ground below resulting in a right hip fracture and a facial fracture.
An employee fell as he was stepping up onto the sidewalk and fractured his right hip.
An employee amputated the fingertips of the right thumb, index and middle fingers while cleaning the rollers on a printing press. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee received an electrical shock while repairing 7200 KV power lines resulting in hospitalization and the amputation of three fingers on his left hand.
An employee fell off the back of a pickup truck and broke his left arm.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger while performing patty-machine maintenance.
An employee suffered a severe dislocation injury to his left foot while operating a sit down forklift when he was struck by a second forklift operated by another employee.
An employee was hospitalized due to a crushing injury to a finger on the left hand while operating a fork truck.

A maintenance technician was working on the #2 GB Dust Collector/Grinder to change the belt on the motor. The employee's right pinky finger got caught between the belt and the fly wheel, amputating part of his finger.
An employee walking under a scaffold was struck in the head by a wooden pallet that was thrown down from above resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was descending a portable ladder while carrying a box of materials, missed the bottom step, and fell approximately three feet to the concrete floor. The employee was admitted to the hospital with a fractured hip.

An employee suffered third and fourth degree burns to the arm while installing a rubber gasket in the wrap weal #8 machine when the machine closed on the employee's arm that then contacted the 250 degree heated surface.
An employee providing home health care at a residential setting ran after a disabled child that had run into the street and was struck by a motor vehicle.  The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was standing on a secured mat. When she turned to walk away, she tripped and fell breaking her pelvis.

An employee was entering Unit 2 (north stairwell) through a door.  The employee reached back to stop the door from slamming and his right index finger got caught between the door and its frame crushing the tip of his finger.  The right index fingertip was amputated at, or just above, the distal (1st) knuckle.

An employee was working on the soy bean preparation line when he caught his hand near a clam-shell-like device that stops the flow of soy beans to the scale resulting in the amputation of his left middle fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a pressure cooker with a water hose. His left hand got caught in the rotating blade inside the machine and was amputated above the wrist.
A letter carrier became sick to his stomach. He was given water and told to sit down. The employee was transported and admitted to the hospital for dehydration.
An employee was pulling a tarp off wood and a staple struck him in the eye. He was admitted to the hospital for eye surgery.

Employee was fabricating sound proof enclosures and began not feeling well. He was given water and told to sit down and rest. The employee became sick to his stomach and complained of chest pain. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was stripping wires using a knife and cut his finger. When they tried to wrap his finger, he passed out and hit his head on the floor causing head injury.

An employee was standing on a step stool while applying a surgical dressing in the operating room. While stepping down, she stepped into a table-side bucket and fell, fracturing her left ankle. She was admitted and had surgery to repair her ankle.

An employee's leg got entangled in the tag line of the bucket used to haul debris. The bucket went up along with the employee and then the rope broke and the employee fell approximately 10 feet breaking a leg.
An employee slipped and fell while unloaded a food truck suffering a head injury.
While loading a truck, an employee experienced heat illness. The employee was admitted to the hospital and given treatment.
An employee received a finger injury while working with a sawing machine.

An employee was unloading a truck at a customer location when the ramp on the back of the truck fell. The employee fell approximately three feet to the ground resulting in three broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was in a trench box inside of a 30 foot deep trench signaling a backhoe operator who was lowering a pipe into the trench. The employee's left arm was caught between the bucket (6 feet wide and 9 feet deep) and the trench box. The employee suffered contusions and swelling of the employee's left arm was evident. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a disc section on a tractor implement when his hand was caught between the pry bar and the implement frame. The employee received deep lacerations to his fourth and fifth fingers. The employee had surgery and was admitted overnight for observation.
An employee fell backwards off of an eight foot step ladder striking his head on the ground.
An employee fell approximately 25 feet from a ballast tank.
An employee was walking up the attic stairs in a house to install an AC unit. One of the steps gave way and he slipped and fell resulting in a concussion and 2 cracked ribs.

An maintenance employee opened a closed panel of an energized motor which activated unexpectedly catching the employee's index, ring and middle fingers in the pulley system and causing an amputation injury.
An employee was walking around a vehicle and banged an elbow on it. The employee was hospitalized for a contusion and infection to his left elbow.
An employee was injured when his arm was caught in a smooth idler pulley on the stuffer output belt conveyor resulting in multiple fractures.

An employee performing quality checks on filters leaving the assembly line amputated the left pinky finger from the first knuckle when it was caught between the vertical guide rail and the horizontal dead plate. The force of the backed up filters contributed to the injury.

An employee was installing a new fertilizer pump and hoisting it up with a chain when a link on the chain broke. The pump fell and struck the employee in the left leg causing a severe laceration and breaking the lower leg.
A parking attendant used a fire extinguisher to fight a car fire. The employee felt shortness of breath after the incident. The employee was hospitalized for smoke inhalation.
An employee operating a reach truck was struck on the head and shoulders by two boxed toilets that fell 35-40 feet from the storage rack.  The employee was subsequently hospitalized.
An employee was walking by an unguarded conveyor belt and amputated the right thumb tip.
An employee was operating a horizontal band saw and amputated three fingers on the left hand.
An employee caught a finger in a jammed bagging machine resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee amputated the tip of the left pinky finger in a roller conveyor.

An employee was welding inside of a wing tank for about 30 - 40 minutes.  He came out of the void at about 1500 hours feeling lethargic and weak and was assisted to the cool down area.  The employee left the cool down area and went to the office where the decision was made to take him to the hospital.  He was diagnosed with heat illness and treated with fluids.  He was officially admitted to the hospital at about 2000 hours.  The injured employee was wearing leathers, a welding shield, and gloves during welding.
An employee was on a short step ladder removing a synthetic strap used in binding steel tubing/pipes when he fell off the step ladder fracturing the top left tibia plateau, close to the knee.
An employee fell off an 8 foot step ladder and fractured an elbow.

On August 24, 2015, an employee of Russell Standard was struck-by a tri-axle asphalt truck.  The employee suffered multiple injuries including lacerations to his liver and lungs, crushed ribcage, and vertebrae.
An employee was caught in between a moving machine and a sprocket guard while building trusses resulting in a hip injury.

An employee opened a trailer door to install a sticker. He grabbed the strap at the bottom of the roll down door with his right hand, stepped down onto the ICC bar and slipped or lost balance. With his right hand still on or in the strap, the employee's body spun around and the door slammed down on his left hand breaking bones.
At approximately noon on Tuesday, August 25, 2015, an employee tripped down a flight of stairs and sustained a head injury requiring five to seven stitches.
A worker was standing beside a milling machine. His right foot got too close to the milling head and the machine ran over it causing severe lacerations.
An employee was struck in the head by a slab of concrete debris that fell from the backhoe. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae in the neck and back.
An employee was erecting a fence when he tripped over some rebar on the ground and fell. He fell on top of his tool belt and punctured the stomach on his tools (pliers) in his tool belt.
An employee was hospitalized when he fell from a front end loader sustaining a head laceration and a broken sternum.
An employee exited the hospital to retrieve something from her vehicle. The heel of her shoe got caught in the doorway and she fell fracturing her ankle.

An employee was backing a forklift off a scale. He backed over a wooden pedestrian walkway that gave way under the weight of the machine, tipping the forklift onto a column. The employee's left hand was trapped between the column and the forklift crushing three fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
On 8/25/2015, an employee was washing a gut buggy and a tray fell onto employee's finger fracturing it.

A crane operator in the stacking bay was attempting to lift a trailer using a 7.5 ton crane.  The employee had his hand on the chain to keep the trailer hooked up in the correct location.  When the slack on the chain came up, the employee pinched his left fingers between the chain and the trailer breaking the left index and middle fingers.

An employee climbed on top of a 55 gallon barrel to retrieve some equipment from a rack, lost his balance, and fell four feet into an empty stainless steel vat below causing him to fracture five ribs.

An employee was walking across the turbine deck (on the third floor) and tripped on a piece of uneven concrete.  As he was falling forward, he put both of his arms out to catch himself and broke both of his arms.
An employee fell down the stairs injuring a leg and cutting an ear.
Employee was operating a semi-trailer lift gate to lift a load onto the truck.  While the gate was lifting he tried to open the latch and his fingertip got caught between the lift gate and the latch.
An employee was walking out of a salt shed, slipped on gravel and fell striking his knee on rebar. The severe laceration required surgery to repair.
An employee was performing maintenance on a metal stamping furnace and was struck by the metal furnace door, breaking ribs on both sides of the torso.

An employee was setting up signage at a traffic control zone.  A private vehicle swerved onto the closed lane, missed the attenuator truck barrier, and struck the employee. The employee sustained broken ribs and a head laceration.
An employee was unloading wood from a truck onto a conveyor belt system when his left hand got caught between the rollers and the wood, crushing his index and middle fingers.
A mail carrier was hospitalized due to a heat related illness.
On or about August 25, 2015, an employee suffered the amputation of two fingers, when his right hand got caught between the wire and spool while running wire.

An employee sustained an injury to his left ring finger which resulted in an amputation of a digit on his left ring finger at the hospital. The employee's gloved hand was caught by the wire rope on the crane while he was conducting crane inspection activities.

An employee was installing a chicken wire catch all to a sidewalk shed. The employee was standing on the sidewalk shed wall and fell approximately 16 feet onto an iron fence and the concrete ground below.  He sustained broken ribs, a broken jaw and lacerated the liver.

A worker was wearing leather work gloves and cutting aluminum bar stock on a horizontal band saw.  His hand contacted the moving saw blade and was pulled in causing an amputation of the left index fingertip.
A electrical lead on the drive motor on a powered industrial truck began to melt and fume.  A worker nearby inhaled the fume/smoke and was taken to the hospital.
An employee was stuck by plastic containers that fell off a forklift that was operated by another employee when the forklift struck a washing machine. The employee suffered a leg injury.
An employee was cleaning the rubber plates on the printing press and crushed three fingers between the printing cylinders. The machine was running at the time and was not locked out.

An employee was operating a button making machine when she reached around the guard to pull out the stems before it jammed up. Her foot was still on the foot peddle and it was pressed when her finger was in the point of operation. The machine smashed her right index finger resulting in the amputation of the finger.

A truck driver fell ill while standing in the parking lot talking with other employees.  Management took the employee to an urgent care clinic where he was diagnosed with dehydration. He was then  admitted to the hospital and given fluid treatment.
Two employees were overcome by fumes that were emitted into their work area from epoxy being applied to the floor in the garage.
An employee severed his right middle fingertip when it got caught in a slot conveyor.
An employee broke his leg when a piece of equipment shifted on a jack and kicked the jack out causing the piece of equipment to fall on him.
An employee was loading a paver onto a truck. A foot was run over by the paver and may be amputated.
One employee received a partial thumb amputation when it was caught in a pinch point while raising a dock plate.

On August 25, 2015 at approximately 11:25am, an employee was attaching slings to a spreader. When the vessel moved, the sling hit his right middle finger and tore the nail bed off. The employee was treated and released from the hospital on the same day.
An employee was standing in the lay down yard when a 12 inch pipe shifted and pinned his left leg between two pipes. The employee was admitted to the hospital with a broken tibia.
On 08/25/15 at 10:15pm, an employee's hand was caught in the point of operation of a hydraulic press and he lost three fingers.
On August 25, 2015 an employee was admitted to the hospital due to heat stroke.

A temporary employee was helping to load a 3' X 3 ' bag of cement onto a forklift while standing on two stacked bags of cement, 6 feet tall. The employee lost his balance and fell to the cement floor causing a skull fracture requiring admittance to a hospital.
An employee amputated a fingertip working with a tubing machine.
A temporary  worker suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger when it was caught by a blade inside a pump.
An employee was struck by falling concrete cinder blocks while walking underneath a bridge and sustained a skull fracture.
On 8/26/15, an employee received laceration injuries to the fingers on the left hand while cutting wood on a table saw.
An employee suffered heat stress while doing landscaping work.

An employee sustained a serious injury when wiping wood dust residue from the notching machine.  The machine caught his glove and pulled the employee's hand into the point of operation. The right hand was amputated.

An employee was operating a roller compacting the dirt around a bridge when the roller tipped over on its side and pinned the employee from the waist down under the roller. The employee was transported to a hospital and treated for a broken pelvis.
An employee was using a machine to clean meat and lacerated a finger on the right hand.
An employee tripped and fell while descending stairs breaking the femur.
An employee was hospitalized after getting his right arm caught between the arm of a skid steer and the frame, fracturing his wrist.
An employee cut his right index finger on a piece of aluminum he had just cut on a table saw.

An employee was working on a power line from a bucket truck moving wire lines from an old pole to set a new pole when the old cross arm braces broke and live electric wires fell on his right shoulder/arm. As a result of the two phased electrical contact flash, the employee suffered a second degree burn on the right shoulder and right side of his body and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out excess meat from a meat grinder and amputated two fingers on the right hand.
An employee was lifting a battery when he heard a "pop."  The employee had cellulitis of the arm and the wound began oozing.  The employee was sent to the hospital for treatment.

Two employees were loading rice sacks onto a pallet for shipment.  The employees were horse-playing while doing this.  One employee pushed another employee causing him to step in between the slats of the pallet and fracturing the ankle.
On August 26, 2015 at approximately 10:00am an employee was climbing a pallet racking system and fell approximately 10 to 15 feet breaking the L8 and L9 vertebrae.
An employee was hospitalized when he fell approximately four feet off the wing of a Challenger 300 aircraft while cleaning it. The employee broke the left leg and sprained the right ankle.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet from the roof while delivering roofing shingles and broke a leg.
An employee was adjusting a ratchet strap on a flat bed truck when his hand slipped off of the adjusting bar severely cutting his finger that required surgery and hospitalization.

On August 26, 2015, an employee working on a metal tank was struck by a falling pipe assembly weighting approximately 700 lbs. after removing bolts from the top flanges. The employee suffered broken ribs and a possible fractured vertebrae.
On or about August 26, 2015, an employee was exposed to an ammonia leak and sustained burns to the forehead, face and wrist.
An employee was moving a cart with steel on it when the wheel of the cart got caught in a crack in the floor and the cart toppled over onto the employee's right ankle fracturing it.
An employee came in from the stairwell, tripped over the door seal, fell and broke her elbow.  The employee had surgery and was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was slicing thin like steak, and towards the end, he turned off the slicer, lifted the carriage and reached to retrieve the remaining product. As he reached, the blade had not come to a complete stop and the tip of the blade hit his right middle finger amputating the fingertip (soft tissue).
An employee was walking down a hallway while making rounds and miss-stepped and fell to the floor.

A paramedic participating in a training drill that required crawling through a fogged area looking for potential victims while wearing a SCBA experienced breathing difficulties and was taken to the hospital.
An employee was walking from the south end of the mill to the north end of the mill when he tripped and fell, causing a fracture to his elbow. The employee was hospitalized for his injuries.
A scientist was bitten by a rat. The employee experienced an allergic reaction and was transported to a hospital.

An employee was removing the exit guard on the bar peeler machine.  The top hinge of the guard fell and caught the tip of the employee's finger between the guard and the machine.  The tip of the employee's right index finger was amputated.  The employee was not hospitalized.

An employee was replacing a missing shingle on the cedar shake roof of a 2-story residence. He  stepped on a loose shingle, slipped, and fell 20 feet to a cobblestoned area of ground below. He sustained three cracked vertebrae and a bruised lung.
An employee suffered the amputation of his right foot when it was caught under a rail car.

An employee was moving a tie rod part from a cart to assemble into a larger part.  The part slipped from his hands and when he tried to catch the 18 pound part his middle finger was crushed between the part and the table resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using a nail gun to nail 2x4s for the purpose of making pallets.  The nail gun double shot during use causing the second nail to become lodged in the employee's stomach area.  The employee was hospitalized for treatment.

Two employees had just completed transferring a patient to a bed using a Hoyer Lift.  The employees were then going to wash the patient.  One of the employees stepped away from the bed and tripped on the Hoyer Lift.  The employee fell and struck her head on the wall.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was building a bunker wall using an air nail gun.  As the worker was nailing, he fired the gun twice and a nail went into the employee's left thumb.

An employee bumped into equipment forks and sustained a bruise to the lower leg on 8/21/15.  The incident was reported to the employer on 8/25/15 when the employee sought treatment.  The employee was hospitalized on or about 8/26/15 for the treatment of a hematoma.
An employee working the cash register tripped over the fatigue mat and fell fracturing the femur.
An employee fell and hit the left arm on the counter fracturing it.
An employee was holding a pin while another employee was driving the pin in with a hammer.  The employee's finger was struck by the hammer resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was positioning dunnage under a load when the load fell on the left hand resulting in the amputation of the left hand.

An employee, a char-house operator, was washing sugar off the floor around filter-top #15.  He tripped over a hose and fell to the floor.  Hot water (180 degrees F) from the hose got into his elbow-length gloves.  His back was burned when he fell backwards.
On or about August 26, 2015, an employee was struck-by an aerial lift while guiding it from the ground. The employee sustained a laceration and avulsion injury to the left leg.
An employee was operating a forklift and crushed his right pinky finger between the forklift and a warehouse rack. The fingertip including the nail was amputated.

On August 27, 2015, an employee's pinky finger was severed while closing a gate inside a cattle trailer at a feed lot in La Salle, CO.  The employee was admitted to a hospital and underwent surgery to re-attached the finger.

An employee was pushing a dolly and slipped. The employee's thumb was caught between the handle and a piece of equipment. The employee was sent to the hospital and some tissue was removed by the doctor.
An employee tripped and fell, while walking to her car on a public street. Employee was on work time at the time of the accident. The employee was hospitalized with a broken shoulder.

An employee was hospitalized after being struck by a piece of debris (8 inch pipe) during a building demolition. The employee suffered nine broken ribs, a punctured lung, a broken finger and bruises on the face.
On or about August 27, 2015, an employee suffered an amputation to the right index fingertip while cutting fabric with a straight knife cutter.
An employee fell approximately three feet from a ladder and fractured a wrist, finger and ankle.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.

An employee fell in the parking lot as she was attempting to go up a step and both legs went out. The employee injured both legs and sustained a right elbow abrasion. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was walking up a hillside to plan line clearing work.  He stepped on a branch, which rolled under his foot, and fell breaking his ankle.  He was admitted to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was putting a bolt into a five foot steel I-beam and suffered the loss of the right thumb tip when it was caught between the end of the beam and the wrench.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while lifting a vehicle hood from one pallet to another pallet. The employee's finger was caught under the hood when the hood was set down on the pallet.
An employee was cleaning a trim blender while it was running and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee fell in the copy room and broke her ankle.

Two maintenance mechanics were adjusting a sensor on a shrink wrapper. The sensor was located under the wrapper table. After adjusting the sensor, the mechanics were moving the table back into position when the table shifted, catching the finger of one of the maintenance mechanics. The employee suffered the partial amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee was entering or exiting the cab or a front end loader and amputated the tip of his left thumb (without bone loss) while closing the cab door.

An employee was dumping a 90 gallon cart at a customer's building.  The cart got wedged in the truck.  The employee climbed onto the truck to dislodge the cart, lost his balance, and fell from the vehicle striking his head resulting in a laceration and a concussion.
An employee was tack welding the steel walls on a manufactured storm shelter.  The tacks failed and one of the steel walls fell on him fracturing his L2 vertebrae.

An employee was trimming carcasses on the final rail trimming line with a straight knife. The carcass shifted, changing the position of the employee's knife, which resulted in a laceration to his left bicep.

On or about August 27, 2015, an employee suffered the amputation all four fingertips of the on the left hand.  The employee was using a concrete molding machine and in the process of inflating the interior core pinched his/her fingers between the core and the mold.
On or about August 27, 2015, an employee suffered an amputation of the right index fingertip while helping to load a crane onto a flatbed for transport.
On or about August 27, 2015, an employee suffered an amputation to the right middle finger and ring finger while working at a sheer press.

While jacking up a pallet of fixtures and using 2x4s for bracing, an employee had his right index finger and thumb amputated when the pallet came down and smashed the employee's right hand between the pallet and the 2x4s.
An employee was struck by a forklift resulting in a broken hip requiring hospitalization.

An employee operating a walk behind floor scrubber suffered a right middle fingertip amputation when he reached under the floor scrubber to unclog it and his finger was caught in the rotating fan. The floor scrubber was running at the time.
An employee was working on a machine when the coupler fell off the jack stand striking the employee in the left leg causing a severe laceration.

An employee left the casino floor and was walking down the "employee only" hallway towards The Dish (casino restaurant) when she fell and injured her knee.  She was admitted to the hospital where she underwent knee surgery.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet while setting straps on a storage tank and landed on his feet. He suffered injuries to both feet and a broken right ankle.

An employee was repairing the chipper with the guard off and the machine locked out and tagged out. The guard was replaced and the machine was started.  He heard a noise and again powered down the machine and took the guard off.
