An employee was walking a dog. The dog lunged forward to chase a lizard and the employee lost balance and fell breaking her left femur.
A security officer was on patrol at the country club when he lost his footing and fell into a ditch breaking his leg.

An employee was cleaning with a water jet. He lost his balance and was sprayed with high pressure water. 
He suffered a cut on his mouth and skin abrasions on his neck.
An employee was removing shoring when a piece of plywood fell on him, breaking his finger and collarbone and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered first and second degree on the face as result of an arc flash while relocating overhead power lines.

On or about 9/11/2015 a Department of Veterans Affairs employee was folding letters and putting them into envelopes and sustained a paper cut on his left thumb.  The cut became infected and the employee was admitted to the hospital for treatment.
An employee reached into a bowl chopper while the machine was running and amputated three fingers on his right hand.
The employee was cutting a 1/4 inch piece of plastic liner with a hand held grinder. The grinder jumped, lacerating the employee's left middle and index fingers.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an ATV when he lost control of his vehicle and ran six feet off the road and hit a tree. The employee suffered several injuries including a broken right femur, a possible broken hip or pelvis and a cracked rib.
An employee was replacing a telecom connection. The employee fell from an extension ladder and fractured vertebrae.

An employee performing custodial work (sweeping in stairwell) misjudged his step and fell striking his head on September 12, 2015 at 2:30 am. The employee was admitted to the hospital. The employee sustained contusions and lacerations to the head.

With the assistance of other employees, the injured employee was relocating a tufting machine. The employees were in the process of leveling the machine by inserting metal leveling plates under the machine. The machine was being lifted by a 10-ton capacity pneumatic floor jack. The jack slipped and the tufting machine dropped trapping the employee's hand underneath. The employee suffered two fractured fingers.
An employee was stacking batteries on a pallet in the fleet garage. He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor resulting in 2 hip fractures.

A material handler on the motorized sheet lifter picked up a pack of material with the lifter and was moving the pack around when the pack struck a fixed object. The stack then shifted and caught the worker's fingers between the object and the stack injuring three fingers. The pinky finger was partially amputated from the tip to between the first and second joint.
An employee was preparing to fabricate a clamp for a pipe. As he was rotating the pipe, it pinched his left finger to the knuckle resulting in amputation.
An employee tripped and fell while pushing a bin with merchandise.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was coupling two 28 feet long trailers when his middle finger was pinched between the pintle hook.
An employee was injured while transporting equipment with a wagon. The wagon tilted over and the seat tracks fell onto the employee's leg resulting in bruising and crushing injuries.

At approximately 1030 hrs. on 12 September 2015 an employee suffered a broken hip when a bovine he was processing pushed the employee into a cattle gate. The employee was admitted to the hospital for his injuries.
An employee suffered the amputation of the right index fingertip when his finger was caught between the bumper of a truck and a jack.

An employee was descending a caged ladder. Due to earlier rain, the ladder rungs were slippery. The employee's foot slipped off a ladder rung and the employee fell an estimated 20 feet breaking the right ankle.
While attempting to rope a calf, an employee got his finger caught in the rope and amputated.
An employee was scraping loose paint on a railcar door. The employee's hand was caught in the door when it closed unexpectedly. The employee sustained a fractured right wrist.
An employee was assisting the doctor with a blood draw on a cat and was bitten on the thumb.
A steel beam tipped over and fell onto an employee's right ring and middle finger causing an amputation above the knuckle.
An employee was working in the meat department and broke bones in the right foot.

An employee was being lifted on a pallet with a forklift when the pallet broke and the employee fell approximately 8-10 feet to the concrete below. The employee suffered a brain bleed, fractured eye socket, broken wrist and broken ribs.
An employee was walking around a machine and tripped over an electrical cord of a glue pot splashing hot glue onto the employee's leg and foot.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder and lost his grip. He fell 10 feet to the ground below and fractured the left heel and L5 and L7 vertebrae.
An employee tripped over the curb while carrying items and injured the face and neck requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access the roof. The employee fell approximately 16 feet suffering a concussion.
The employee was lowering some rebar into a 24" hole/cage. His left ring finger got caught between the cage and rebar amputating the fingertip.
An employee was climbing off a baker's scaffold when his foot slipped and he fell breaking his femur.

An employee was crossing the street and was struck by a taxi. The employee sustained a broken nose, a dislocated left shoulder, a broken femur, a sprained right ankle and needed 18 stitches on his head.

Two employees had just finished installing a replacement spindle motor for a CNC machine. The employees started the motor up. As it was coming up to speed, the bottom flange that holds the motor failed and fragments flew through the air striking both employees on their right legs.
An employee was knocked off of a ladder when a Genie aerial lift lifted a waste bin. The employee suffered a head contusion and chest injury.

An employee was trying to clear a jam in the shaker screen machine. His shirt sleeve got caught in the equipment resulting in a fracture of his arm in three places.  The employee will need surgery to repair the fractures.

An employee was going up a ladder to do a pre job assessment of the air conditioning system.  When he was about 4 feet from the ground, the employee's foot slipped and he lost his balance.  He fell, hitting a movable conveyor on the way to the ground. He hurt his back, head and spine.

An employee was assisting a co-worker to lift a handicap passenger into their seat on board a 737 aircraft.  After bending over and lifting the passenger's feet, the employee indicated her back was hurting.
An employee was operating a pallet lift device in reverse. The employee jammed the left foot between the fork truck housing and the loaded pallet behind.
On or about September 14, 2015 between 3:30 pm-4:00 pm, an employee operating a chop saw in the Cut Shop had their right hand amputated (four fingers and half of palm).

An employee was pulling electrical wire onboard a marine vessel. A large hole was cut into the main deck to place the engine into the vessel. The employee fell into the hole breaking ribs and the right wrist.
An employee slipped on oil and fell. The employee received minor burns on hands and was hospitalized.
The employee was collecting recyclable materials from the curbside. When the employee exited the vehicle, his foot was run over by the front passenger tire of the truck breaking it.
An employee was burned when a kettle of boiling water tipped over and spilled onto his feet.
An employee was standing on a three-step step ladder attempting to remove a radiator from the shelf and lost his balance falling to the floor fracturing a lower lumbar disc.
An employee was test driving a scooter and had an accident resulting in two fractured ribs and hospitalization.

An employee received a severe compression fracture to his back (L1) while buffing a floor. The employee had been polishing the floors near the end of the shift and felt the sudden onset of severe back pain causing him to fall backwards.
An employee was operating a punch press when the die pulled the part in causing her left index finger to be amputated.

An employee was putting trays of chicks into the tray washer. The employee reached into the tray washer machine to remove a chick when his glove got caught on the chain and sprocket. He suffered lacerations to his right hand between the index and middle finger.
An employee was impaled by copper tubing while walking between two machines on the copper tubing line.

A worker was attempting to install a safety pin in the self climbing form work system. The platform came down on his hand before any safety pins were put in. The worker's hand was crushed resulting in finger amputations.

On September 14, 2015, an employee was working from a ground level scaffold. The employee stepped on a section of plywood that was covering a steam pipe. Upon contact, the pipe sprayed hot water (198 degrees) onto the employee's left foot. The employee was treated for second and third degree burns to his foot and released. The employee returned to work with restrictions. On September 22, 2015, at a follow-up appointment, the physician noted the foot was not healing.  At approximately 8:00am, the employee was admitted to the hospital to have a skin graft done to his left foot.

An employee was at the shop warehouse using a come-a-long to pull a tube bundle inside a condenser shell. The come-a-long hook was attached to a metal lifting lug welded onto a shell. As the employee was pulling the tube bundle back into the condenser shell, the weld holding the lug onto the shell broke. The lug struck the employee in the throat.
While cutting aluminum material with a band saw, the blade of the saw jammed and slipped causing the employee's right thumb to be cut by the blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On 9/14/15 an employee was operating a ham skinner machine when his right hand came in contact with the blade. The employee suffered a complex laceration of three fingers.

A carpenter employee received multiple fractures to his leg when he was struck by and pinned by a section of concrete form.  The employee was climbing down from the top of a stack of concrete forms when he stepped on an L bracket on one of the forms causing the form to move and strike the employee.
An employee was exiting a freight elevator when an upright vacuum cleaner operated by another employee struck him in the right shin. The resulting contusion became infected.

Employees were erecting a sidewalk shed  and lost control of an upright as it was lifted.  The upright fell onto the hand of an employee who was standing nearby.  One finger was amputated and another was crushed.
An employee was working with a pin press machine and placed his hand inside the machine to remove the pin. The pin press cycled and his right index finger was amputated at the first joint.

An employee was being lifted on a pallet by a forklift to fix a boom. The forklift got too close to the boom and the employee was crushed between the forklift and boom resulting in contusions to the abdomen and legs.
An employee working on the roof fell and was hospitalized for vertebrae fractures.
An employee was injured driving when he swerved to miss a deer and impacted a telephone pole. The employee's injuries consisted of a torn pancreas, fractured ribs, chest pains and a head laceration.
An employee slipped on a puddle of water and fell when moving trash containers to mop the floor of the utility room.  The employee's right knee cap was fractured.
The employee was performing framing operations when a piece of steel angle struck the employee's head/neck.
An employee was walking, tripped on an electrical cord and fell injuring the left hip and leg.

On September 14, 2015, at approximately 10:30am, a worker suffered an amputation of the left pinky finger just above the palm while unloading pipe from a pipe trailer.  The employee was standing towards the tractor side of the trailer and a side boom with sling was unloading the pipe.  The load was lowered near the tractor in an effort to raise the pipe above the back stanchion on the trailer.  As the pipe slowly moved, the load struck a stanchion or DOT fender and the employee's hand was crushed in the load of pipe. No tag line was used.
An employee was walking through the hallway of the hotel, tripped and fell suffering a collapsed lung.
An operator leaned into the loom to adjust a pin.  The beater bar came back on the operator and broke his ribs. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking between a barrier (parapet) wall and a rubber track excavator when the excavator struck his right lower leg and ankle, nearly severing his right foot. His right foot was surgically amputated, and his left foot was fractured.
An employee was going down the stairs when he fell on his right knee. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery on his right quadriceps.
An employee got his fingers pinched between cable and a drum on an excavator resulting in the amputation of the right pinky and index fingers to the first knuckle.

An employee was driving south on a stand-up crown reach truck towards a four-way intersection in the warehouse when he collided with another employee operating a stand-up crown reach truck that was stopped at the intersection heading west. The employee's left leg and ankle were crushed. The injury required surgery.

Employees were working at a remote well site in Kingfisher, Oklahoma making a connection with two pipes when the pumping host attachment at one end came loose and struck the employee's left arm, breaking both bones of the forearm.

An employee was installing a fence. He had the leveler on top of the fence. He moved a board and the leveler fell hitting the nail gun and at the same time the employee had a finger on the trigger. The gun fired a nail into his thigh.
An employee was standing on a nine foot step ladder stocking merchandise. She lost her balance and fell backwards hitting her head on the concrete floor.
An employee suffered cramps and was taken to hospital for heat stress symptoms.
An employee was crushed-by a concrete structure when it was being placed along the southeast section of the lake's shores/bank. The employee's pelvis was broken.

Employees were descending a water tower in suspended scaffolding. About 30 to 40 feet above the ground, one of the motors locked up and the scaffold stopped. One of the employees detached his rope lanyard from his harness and attempted to slide down another rope lanyard. The employee fell off the rope hitting the ground and fracturing both legs and suffering severe rope burns on this hands.
An employee was descending a ladder, lost balance and fell injuring his left leg and knee.

On or about 9/15/15 at approximately 2:30 pm, an employee was removing a rear tire of a dual wide trailer when one of the tires blew and the employee's left hand was knocked into the wheel well causing a fracture. The employees was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was checking lumber sizes in a "safe zone" about 18-20 ft from the board edger when a board broke while being processed. The wooden pieces were ejected, striking and injuring the employee 20 ft away. The employee sustained a broken nose, injuries to the face and loss of consciousness.
An employee was working on a metal detector that was not locked out or tagged out. The machine started unexpectedly and caught his left hand middle finger resulting in amputation.

At approximately 11:30 on 15 September 2015, an employee was hospitalized when he was struck in the chest by a cap on a pressure vessel that he and another employee were removing. Remaining pressure in the pipe leading to the pressure vessel caused the cap to violently dislodge during the procedure and strike the employee in the chest, breaking one rib and causing the employee to suffer a broken left elbow, a laceration that required sutures on his right elbow and a hemorrhage on the artery leading to his adrenal gland.
An employee was operating a tractor mowing a field, fell off and was run over by the tractor fracturing the pelvis, right arm and causing internal bleeding.
On September 14, 2015, an employee was pulling a large roll of carpet when the roller grabbed the employee's hand and amputated his left ring finger to the end of his nail.
An employee fell 20 feet from a bucket truck and fractured his ribs, collarbone and neck.
An employee fell 20 feet from a ladder and fractured his upper right arm in two places.
An employee fell from a ladder while restocking shelves injuring the elbow.

An employee was hit from behind by a lifting attachment as he was in the process of rigging a rebar cage. The lifting attachment was not secured properly to the forklift. As it was being raised, the forks were tilted forward and the lifting attachment slid forward falling onto the backside of the employee who suffered ligament damage in the right knee and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee received a right foreman fracture as a result of entanglement injuries from contact with a moving conveyor line and tail pulley.
An employee operating a jointer amputated the right hand middle and ring fingers.
An employee was repairing the weather stripping around a door and amputated the top of the left middle finger.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut brush along a utility right of way when the chainsaw kicked back and injured the palm of his left hand.
A refrigeration technician slipped and fell from the third rung of an interior roof access ladder resulting in a broken leg and possible head and hand injuries.
An employee was loading advertisements into the tie machine and got his left hand caught in the machine resulting in amputation of the pinky and right fingertips.
An employee fell when her heel was caught on the carpet.  The fall resulted in an ankle fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was helping a pallet jack operator to free the forks on the pallet jack from a pallet when the employee's leg was caught between a wall and the pallet jack causing a lower leg fracture.

The heat treat/batch furnace operator had latched the batch furnace carriage with a bar and was moving the carriage to the furnace. The carriage jumped on the track and the latch came loose pushing the bar towards the operator pinning the left hand pinky finger between the bar and the nearby handrail.

The employee was working with another coworker in the process of charging a furnace (place scrap metal into the furnace). The injured worker's coworker was on a PIV that had a hopper on the lifts. In the hopper were briquetted radiators (compressed radiators in bales). As the hopper was being moved on the PIV, the hopper latching mechanism malfunctioned causing the hopper to tip and the  briquetted radiators to fall out and roll into the injured employee's leg.
An employee was attempting to pull a vehicle onto a flatbed tow truck when it broke free from the tow chain and rolled over the employee's right leg.
The boom of the Jerraff Side Trimmer fell on top of an employee fracturing his ribs and lower back.
AN employee was loading potatoes into the trailer hopper and fell approximately 4 to 10 feet from a platform fracturing the pelvis.
An employee was walking in the attic to install HVAC equipment and fell between the studs to the concrete floor below resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was observing other employees install a forming machine and began to complain of leg cramps.

Employee was moving a pallet of materials off a shelf with a forklift. He hit the support for the shelf above while moving the pallet. The pallet of compact disks on that shelf fell, striking the employee. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae and ankle injuries.
An employee was using a gas powered saw to cut a 30 inch pipe. The saw guard kicked back and struck him in the face causing a laceration.
An employee was cleaning an asphalt paving machine when the roller struck him in the leg.
An employee fractured a knee after slipping and sliding down the lint slide on a cotton gin.

On or about 9/16/15 at 11:20 am, a temporary employee at Osceola Farms was performing water blasting operations inside a tank when was shocked.  The employee was hospitalized after complaining of chest pain.
An employee was standing on the bed of a flatbed truck untying the rigging used to secure a utility pole.  When he finished, the employee jumped off the bed of the truck and fractured his tibia.
An employee pinched his left index finger while operating the strap machine.
An employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee was walking across the job site gathering tools when a six inch metal flange fell from above onto the employee and striking his hard hat. The employee sustained a broken collarbone and broken vertebrae.
An employee went into the palletizer machine to troubleshoot a jam and tripped on the rake. He fell and was pinned on the rail. He broke 2 ribs and lacerated a lung.

An employee's right foot received a compound fracture after it was squeezed by the tire of a garbage collection truck while he was collecting trash.  The employee underwent surgery and was hospitalized.

The employee was installing a shaker box on a plow when he inadvertently bumped the shaker box causing it to move on the jacks and pinch his right ring finger between the shaker box and the mounting arm of the plow. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation with loss of a finger nail.
The employee was running a card machine.  When the employee tried to remove build up, string wrapped around his left hand middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was setting a die in the brake press. The employee was attempting to line up the upper holes when he depressed the foot pedal and the brake press lowered onto the employee's left hand thumb causing a fingertip amputation.
While hanging a sign at a customer's work site, the employee lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet from a ladder fracturing an ankle.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw and lacerated his left thumb.

An employee was standing in a lift bucket changing out a still energized transformer on a power pole. He received electrical burns to the left forearm and right arm. Rubber gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was on a stepladder installing a sprinkler pipe in a stairwell. He was on the fourth rung of an 8 foot step ladder tightening a fitting when the wrench slipped causing him to fall over the railing to the lower level, then roll down the stairs, ending up two levels below his starting point. He was hospitalized with a concussion, five broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was riding a golf cart at the dealership and fell out striking his head on the ground. The employee suffered a brain hemorrhage requiring surgery.
An employee was lifting a grader with an air tugger and got her left hand index finger caught in the metal wiring resulting in amputation.
An employee fell down stairs in an office building resulting in a shoulder injury.

An employee was operating a Barrett double jack and making a "U" turn when he lost balance and inadvertently pressed on the brake causing him to fall off the equipment. The front plate under the carriage struck his foot as he fell. The employee sustained lacerations to his toes and two hairline fractures.

An employee was cleaning the AMC (automated cutting machine) and sustained the amputation of their right little finger due to contact with a rotating chain and sprocket. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was working from a ladder to seal a grain bin door.  The employee fell from the ladder and fractured his right foot.
On September 16, 2015, an employee was troubleshooting a nail gun when the gun went off and the employee was struck by a nail in the left hand. The employee was hospitalized for hand surgery.

An employee reached across a conveyor to straighten a 14 lb. bag of dog food that was coming down the conveyor when he slipped and his hand went through the rollers on the transition conveyor. The rollers continued turning and rubbing against the employee's arm causing severe skin burns to his left forearm.  Employee was hospitalized overnight for skin graft purposes.
An employee was crushed between a rolling transfer car and a parked forklift resulting in a fractured pelvic bone.

The employee was operating a shear to fabricate a part for a crane.  The employee placed an aluminum sheet into the machine opening and accidently hit the foot control which activated the press.  The employee's left middle finger was amputated above the first knuckle.  The employee was treated at a local hospital and released the same day.
An employee walking though a grassy area between parking lots, stepped in a rut, and fractured an ankle.
On 9/16/2015 at 8:45 am, an employee was walking between a dump truck and a pick-up truck and broke his left femur. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was removing a metal product from a storage rack and lost his grip on the product causing the product to fall and lacerate his right arm.
An employee was trying to retrieve a twist lock with a pole. The twist lock fell. As he tried to get away he tripped and fell. He was taken to the hospital with pain in the chest and abdomen.

A worker had shut down a machine and removed the guard to make an adjustment.  The worker restarted the machine and reached into the machine to remove a paper chip. His right hand index finger got caught in a roller and amputated down to the second knuckle.
An employee was delivering mail and fell hitting their head on the concrete sidewalk.
An employee using a table saw amputated the tip of the right index finger from the first and second knuckle.
An employee operating a forklift caught their right ring finger between lift truck cage support and a stack of pallets causing an amputation.

An employee received rib and shoulder injuries after falling off of a picking cart.  The cart tipped over while the employee was standing on it while picking orders and/or putting merchandise in a bin.
An employee strained her arm while moving a patient.

An employee was standing on the DOT bumper observing a concrete chute. He slipped and in his attempt to restrain his fall, inserted two fingers into the roller on the concrete ready mix truck. Two fingers were crushed requiring amputation.
An employee was operating a front end loader on a pile of raw material (wood chips and saw dust). The front end loader rolled down the pile. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was injured and hospitalized while assisting a resident from a wheelchair to the bed. The employee fell and fractured the left shoulder.
An employee working in an aerial lift maneuvered the bucket and the tip of his pinky finger was severed in the bi-fold door.
An employee was struck by motor vehicle while doing road clean-up work on the shoulder of the road.
An employee was setting up scrapers to clean the floor. The scrapers were in a cart and when one of them was falling off the cart, the employee tried to catch it and lacerated his right thumb.

Two employees were replacing a high voltage single power line between two poles. One employee, was electrocuted at approximately at 08:15 AM and received third degree electrical burns on the right arm and back side.
The inured employee was holding and lowering a shaft from machine number GK24 onto a jack stand. The shaft slipped and fell on the worker's finger causing an amputation of the right middle fingertip.
While at the Pultrusion Machine, an employee was stepping down from a resin cart, twisted his back, and could not get back up.

An employee was grinding meat. As the meat was grinding in the mixer, the employee opened the lid and stuck his hand into the mixer before the blades came to a complete stop. His right hand/arm got stuck between the mixer and the housing resulting in a right arm fracture and removal of skin.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut pipe when the saw kicked back and severely lacerated the employee's neck.

An employee opened the gate to inspect a part of the Tangent deep draw hydraulic press. Lock out/tag out wasn't used. A co-worker provided additional light and crossed the light curtain in front of the press activating it. The injured employee suffered cuts to both arms, burns to the left hand and a compression injury to both arms.
An employee was picking up surgical instruments and twisted her chest and side.
An employee was splitting wood with a hydraulic splitter and got his right pinky finger caught between two pieces of wood amputating the fingertip.
An employee closed the door on her left pinky finger resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was assisting with moving equipment. The employee jumped from the moving equipment onto the ground to place chock-blocks and broke his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the #2 water softener. The sight glass blew, spraying the employee with hot water and causing an eye injury.

An employee was standing on a movable machine bed. The employee reached up to grab a rail and caught her hand in a shear point between a bearing block and the machine frame. Her right hand pinky and ring fingers were amputated to approximately the second joint.
An employee was hospitalized after scrapping his arm on a metal stud wall at a job site.  The cut/scrape became infected.
An employee was bitten by a rattle snake on the right index finger.

The forklift operator got his hand caught between the top roll bar of the forklift and a piece of framing that was protecting a hydraulic fluid line resulting in a laceration to the top of the left hand, a broken ring finger, a crushed little finger and hospitalization.
An employee feel off an eight foot step ladder and landed on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee working in the maintenance shop dressing a 6-8 foot roller at ~ 64 RPMs. He was injured after being pulled into the roll resulting in the avulsion of the underarm of the right forearm.
An employee was struck by a car in a work zone and suffered multiple severe injuries.

An employee was threading a new roll of bags into the midstream bagger machine. The jaws of the machine include a heat seal and cutters. The machine activated and the jaws caught his finger resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell over a walker.  She was transported to the hospital where she was admitted overnight and had surgery for a left wrist fracture the following morning.
An employee was working a 100 ft. below the North gridiron floor when a piece of steel fell through the gridiron floor and struck the employee's ring finger on the right hand lacerating it.
An employee was shocked while changing wire on a welder.
An employee was walking behind other workers carrying a leaking bag of trash. The employee slipped and fell forward landing on the edge of a platform lift and fracturing four ribs.
The employee was operating a saw and reached in to remove a jammed aluminum part and amputated the tip of his right ring finger.
The employee was cutting a piece of ductile 8" iron pipe with a hot saw or quickie saw. The weight caused the pipe to pinch the blade and the pipe kicked up and struck the employee in the face.
An employee sustained a broken leg and knee after falling approximately 10 feet from a plank.

On September 17, 2015, at approximately 6:30pm, a worker was injured when the tip of his right index finger was pinched while changing the blade on a horizontal band saw.  Lockout was used to de-energize the machine.  As the employee manually turned the wheel to engage the blade, his finger was pinched between the wheel and the blade, resulting in amputation.
An employee caught a hand in a pulley system while trying to untangle the cable resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was injured on September 17, 2015, while retrieving a mold for setup of a plastic injection molding machine. The employee was retrieving a mold from a rack system approximately 8 feet tall.  He climbed to the second shelf of the rack system (approximately 4-5 feet) off the floor.  When attempting to descend the rack system he slipped and fell to the floor below.  He landed on his buttocks and back.
An employee amputated the tips of the long finger and ring finger while operating a shaper saw.
An employee was preparing to change the line over to a different product on the breader elevator and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee fell off a step stool and injured her hip and pelvic bone.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on the conveyor motor and amputated the tips of the right thumb and index fingers.
An employee fractured his left foot when it was caught between a concrete curb and the forklift he was operating.

An employee was walking down the ramp of a delivery trunk using a hand dolly to carry five cases. He slipped and the metal part of the dolly landed on his two right middle fingers lacerating them both down to the bone.
An employee was injured while guiding a street lamp post into position. The cast iron base of the post slipped and crushed his finger.

The employee was circulating mud and water and sucking fluid from a steel container with a running vacuum truck. H2S vapor accumulated under the truck. When it reached his hot pump, it caused a flash fire.  The employee suffered burns to his face and hands.
An employee was removing shank bone from a ham with a five inch de-boning knife. The knife slipped and struck his left forearm resulting in a 2 to 3cm laceration just below the elbow.

An employee was assisting a resident back from the bathroom. The resident was pushing a walker and began to fall. The employee went to keep the resident from falling and felt pain in her stomach. The result was a hernia that required surgery.

On 9/18/2015 two employees were performing preventative maintenance on the friction washer.  They were attempting to remove a 2-part screen that needed to be replaced due to wear.  The screen has two parts.  An employee removed the first part of the screen and placed it away from the machine.  While this was going on, the second piece of the screen slipped and fell on the back of his right wrist.  When the employee jerked his arm back, he cut a tendon on the back of his right wrist.  He was taken to the hospital where the tendon was re-attached.
An employee was outside on a break and was walking back to her work station when her ankle gave out, causing her to fall to the concrete floor. She broke her elbow in the fall.
An employee received a partial amputation to the right middle finger while clearing a jam on the Skive Machine (leather trimmer).

Two tower climbers were running a heavy duty coax cable up to an antenna tower.  One employee was on the ground running the cable up to another employee who was approximately 100 feet from the ground.  The cable was on a reel and the front end of the cable was cut and live.  One of the employees touched it and was shocked. The injured employee received second degree burns on his right arm, third degree burns on his right thumb and minor burns to his knees.

An employee was cleaning a trailer with a steam cleaner. The vent was not working correctly and the steam turned to water splashing onto the employee. The employee received first and second degree burns on the arms and chest.

An employee was installing metal framing in a scissor lift approximately 25 feet above the ground. A piece of metal that was being installed started to fall out of the lift and the employee went to grab it and severely cut his forearm.

An employee stepped onto an electric pallet jack and lost footing.  He reached for a handhold and accidently grabbed the throttle. The jack lurched forward, crushing his foot between the jack and a pallet.
An employee was cooking food and suffered burns to the face due to a grease fire.

An employee was working on an enclosed balcony putting up flashing between the balcony and the porch. The employee went on the outside of the balcony. He was holding on to the railing when it became loose and he fell approximately nine feet to the ground below injuring the hip, shoulder, ribs and lung.
An employee felt dull pain as he was going down the stairs at a customer's home. A week later he was hospitalized with a possible herniated disc.

An employee was loading gas cylinders from a loading dock onto a pallet on a forklift truck positioned next to the loading dock. The employee stepped back and fell approximately four feet breaking two ribs, the pelvis and a wrist.
An employee was cutting a branch and the branch struck the employee fracturing the C3 and C7 vertebrae.
An employee was on top of the clean room ceiling changing air filters. He lost his balance and fell to the floor, fracturing his left arm.
An employee was leaving the prep area, tripped over a mat, and fell on her side fracturing the hip joint of the left leg.
An employee was servicing a box sealer that was not de-energized and suffered a broken arm.

An employee suffered the amputation of their right index and middle fingers at the first joint when the employee opened the door of a machine to clean the interior with a cloth and the cloth and the employee's hand were pulled into the machine.
An employee was struck by a car within the garage. The vehicle operator moved the car off of the hoist platform and hit the employee injuring his abdominal area.
An employee was laying decking, tripped over the decking, and fell 14 feet to the ground injuring his head and back. Fall protection was not worn correctly at the time of the incident.
An employee amputated his right second and third fingertips with a rope.
An employee was taking measurements for a project estimate and fell off a second story roof breaking ribs and vertebrae and puncturing a lung. The employee was not wearing fall protection.
On or about September 18, 2015, an employee fell while working on an eight foot step ladder. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm and a head injury.
An employee was walking a jobsite, twisted an ankle and fell. The employee received 16 stiches on his chin.
An employee sustained severe lacerations to the pinky and ring fingers of his left hand while cutting bone in pork on a band saw.
An employee was hospitalized with a head injury, broken ribs, a cracked sternum and a chipped tooth after falling 20 feet from a forklift basket.

An employee was cleaning the fryer machine located in a Tyson Food poultry plant and partially amputated his left ring finger. The machine was not locked or tagged out when the employee removed the guard and was cleaning the machine.
An employee was hospitalized with a concussion after falling while dodging a guest that had run out in front of the employee.

On September 19, 2015, at approximately 11:00am, a millwright was injured while spot welding a hard hydraulic line on a forklift.  The line was under pressure and hydraulic fluid was not removed from the line. The line ruptured and the millwright received 2nd degree burns to the top of his head and was hospitalized.

On September 19, 2015, at approximately 3:45pm, an equipment operator was hospitalized after suffering fractured vertebrae in his neck and back, a broken left arm, and broken ribs.  The employee was operating a Morooca tracked dump truck on an access road hauling water when the track slipped off the road and the vehicle rolled over an embankment.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut boards to size and amputated the tips of three fingers on the right hand.
An employee was operating the blow molding machine and bypassed the guard to clear a jam and amputated a finger.
An employee amputated the left index finger on a bag machine producing plastic film.

On Saturday, 9/19/15, at approximately 1:00 PM, a journeyman ironworker fell from the second deck of a structure to the first floor deck sustaining a broken wrist, several cracked ribs, and a head laceration. At the location where the incident occurred, two vertical stud members set on 16" centers had been removed to allow room for an access ladder. As the ironworker placed his weight upon the top plate (in the area where the studs had been removed) to secure the decking, the top plate bent causing the ironworker to fall onto the first floor deck.

On September 19, 2015 at approximately 2:30 p.m., two employees were working together to empty a trash container into a dumpster. One of the employee's fingers was smashed between the trash container and the dumpster resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was injured and hospitalized with a bruised or fractured tail bone after falling off a step ladder.
On September 19, 2015, an employee was riding a clothing cart down a hill. The cart tipped over and ejected the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation on a band saw.
An employee was checking an electric fan motor and amputated the left ring finger in the belt and pulley.
An employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion after working 8-9 hours in the heat treatment area.
An employee was operating a bag machine and amputated four fingers.
A temporary employee sustained an amputation injury to the tip of the left middle finger while unjamming Machine #22 Mail Inserter.

On Sunday, September 20, 2015 at approximately 11:15 AM, an employee was walking down the cooking galley carrying a 10 pound bag of bacon.  He slipped and fell, landing on his buttocks. During his fall he reached out and grabbed a hot fryer full of hot grease to try and break/prevent his fall.  The hot grease caused second degree burns to his left hand and arm.

A cashier was walking through the kitchen area with papers from the front.  The cooks were cleaning the fryer.  They drained the oil from the fryer into a stock pot and set it on the floor in the aisle.  The cashier tripped over the pot and the oil splashed onto her feet.  She was taken to the hospital.
An employee was working in the MXBU Trucks department. The employee suffered a partial finger amputation when it was caught between a cylinder and the jig.
An employee was providing home care and was bitten on the right inner thigh by the client's dog.

An employee was installing six inch sprinkler pipes while on a scissor lift. A hanger came lose and the pipe swung down pinning the employee's left arm between the pipe and scissor lift and fracturing it.

On September 20, 2015 an employee was working in spice room #1 adjusting the flow of seasoning and amputated his left middle finger when it came in contact with a rotating auger at the end of the feeder tube.
An employee was cleaning a polisher when the machine pulled in her cleaning cloth and caught and amputated her left index fingertip. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was standing next to an excavator.  The excavator turned and the employee was struck by the excavator's counterweight.  The employee fell over into a sump hole and struck his body against a steel plate.  The employee suffered a broken jaw, broken ribs, punctured lung, and broken left elbow.  The employee was hospitalized.
While he was searching for a missing knife on a gut slide in the casing department, an employee's finger got caught in the moving gut conveyor belt. His right middle finger was amputated.
An employee fell 30-40 ft from a tree while cutting limbs resulting in a head injury.

The employee was in the process of erecting a barrier wall on the side of the road (highway construction).  The employee got his right index finger caught between the panel of the wall and the bolt, pinching/crushing his finger and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was driving a narrow aisle lift in the receiving department to get a pallet to bring to the floor. He ran into an upright and, out of reflex, put his hand up. He broke arm bones when his arm got caught between the upright and the lift.

An employee took off a magnet tray and his arm reached inside the pipe. His arm came into contact with a rotatory feeder blade that was aligned with the magnet tray, amputating his right index fingertip.

The lift gate chain broke on an employee's delivery truck while he was unloading a cage full of garments. He struck his head on one of the brackets that holds the lift gate when it is in the up position, lacerating his ear.
An employee was conducting a quality audit of livestock gates when the gates came down on him. He was pinned and sustained a pelvis injury, requiring hospitalization.
On or about September 21, 2015, an employee was hospitalized after suffering a second degree chemical burn from a concentrated degreaser that had spilled onto the employee's left foot and ankle.
A temporary employee was operating a stand-up forklift with a foot hanging off the edge. He backed into a rack and broke bones.
An employee was feeling sick and dizzy and was hospitalized after contracting a bacterial infection.
An employee was lifting a 5-gallon water bottle to change out an empty bottle when he sustained a lower back injury and lost feeling in his legs.

An employee was moving a mold cart into a thermoformer for a different product. The employee was pushing the cart from the side when the cart rolled and caught the employee's fingertip between the thermoformer framing and the cart, amputating the right index fingertip (full nail removed).
An employee utilizing the pace roll groover received a crushing injury to the right index finger that resulted in a partial amputation.

An employee was measuring metal and lost his grip on the measuring tool. When he reached for it, his gloves were caught in the guide rollers resulting in the amputation of two fingers at the first joint.
An employee fell from a catwalk, suffering a bone fracture and head injury.
An employee was exposed to a tripping hazard.

An employee was spraying a colony of bees using an aerosol spray when he was stung by two bees on the face and arm. He suffered a heart attack after being stung. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

On September 21, 2015, an employee fell from a screed machine while attempting to refuel it. He had ascended the machine with the fuel hose when he felt dizzy, passed out, and fell to the ground below. He fractured his skull and cracked his lip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was testing A/C equipment, reading the voltage of the compositor by placing the alligator clamps on the A/C. The employee was shocked by the A/C unit, which was not locked out at the time, and he passed out on top of the bus bar. He received a third degree burn on his left cheek and left hands.

An employee was transporting a full box of product from the packaging line when she tripped over a piece of equipment, landing on both knees and fracturing her femur. She was hospitalized for surgery.
After giving a presentation, an employee tripped over the steps and fell from the 18-inch stage. The employee fractured the left humerus and sustained a head injury.
An employee's wrist was cut by a metal stamped automobile part during a physical altercation with another employee.
An employee fell from a one-story scaffold/balcony when the railing broke as the employee leaned against it. The employee broke both wrists and injured their back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder onto the pavement below and injured the left elbow requiring hospitalization.

An employee bled a water heater gas line after replacing it and then attempted to start the gas water heater. This provided an ignition source, resulting in a flash fire with flame front. The employee received first and second degree burns on exposed facial and hand skin.
An employee amputated the right middle finger while operating the brake press.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a cylinder when the weld broke on an attachment plate used to lift a steel beam. The beam came down on and broke the employee's left forearm.
An employee was stocking a five foot box containing spiral duct. While placing the box on the shelf, the employee sustained a right elbow laceration requiring surgery.

An employee was holding onto the dryer's control panel that was on the fork of a pallet jack operated by his co-worker. As the pallet jack was coming down the aisle, the control panel (weighing about 400 pounds) hit a box and the control panel fell onto the employee's leg fracturing the tibia.

An employee was adjusting a steel pipe from a 6-foot ladder. The anchor came off, causing him to fall 6 feet down to the floor and to land on the right side of his face. The area near his right eye was bruised, requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped off a front-rider type forklift and the equipment continued to move, pinning his left foot between the forklift and guard rail (angle iron). He broke his left heel bone.
An employee was adjusting the wire in a bobbin winder with the guard open. The tip of his left index finger was amputated when the wire tightened.
While pushing boards through the sanding shaper machine, an employee's hand got caught between a board and the machine. The tip of her right ring finger was amputated.
An employee was removing a hydraulic tool and crushed a thumb between steel plates.
An employee was cutting wings with a wing saw and partially amputated the right thumb.
An employee fell from a 3.5 ft. high scaffold and broke his right wrist and left elbow.

A flooring employee was cleaning an area on the fourth floor of a new construction project. The  employee lifted a piece of plywood that was covering a floor opening and then fell through the hole to the third floor. The employee fell approximately 16 feet, fracturing his lower back and tail bone areas.

On September 22, 2015, an employee made a delivery to a customer location. A forklift driver for the customer struck part of the delivery trailer causing damage. When the trailer was unloaded the semi truck operator climbed up onto the trailer to inspect for damage. As the operator was inspecting the trailer he slipped and fell five feet to the ground below.  The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was standing on a pallet holding an accumulator (equipment) in place while waiting for another employee to pick it up with a forklift. The employee standing on the pallet stepped in between the gaps of the pallet and fell down causing the equipment to fall on his right leg and fracture the femur.

An employee was unloading merchandise and cutting open a pallet of boxes stacked 7 boxes high. Some of the boxes fell on top of the employee and knocked him 20 feet to the concrete floor. The employee had surgery to repair a broken ankle and lower knee fracture.
An employee was setting up the plastic injection molding machine and lacerated the left pinky finger.
An employee was operating a manlift and struck their abdomen against the roof joist causing a contusion.
An employee was pulling out a food tray from a rack and lacerated his finger.  The employee also suffered damage to a tendon.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a stand up pallet jack and injured his left ankle when it was caught between a wall and the pallet jack.
An employee fell ten feet off a ladder and onto a trailer hitch while attempting to secure the ladder with a rope. The employee suffered two broken bones in his wrist and three broken ribs.
Employee was trimming a piece of pipe with a skill saw and amputated the index fingertip.

An employee was using a hand operated push hammer to unclog the fly ash silo. A dislodged piece of fly ash pinned the employee's finger and when the employee jerked their hand out the finger was lacerated.
An employee removed the guard on a conveyor to perform maintenance. His hand was caught in the chain and sprocket and the left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was rigging a piece of steel. The metal was already on the ground. The employee was removing the tag line when the metal shifted and struck the employee breaking his leg.
An employee fell in the workplace and suffered a laceration injury to the elbow.  The elbow became infected and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee received a severe foot injury when two fork lifts collided. The employee taken to the hospital for treatment.
The cook was unwrapping meat when a hornet attacked him.  He turned to run and fell, breaking his hip.
On 09/22/2015, two employees working on a propane gas line to a grain dryer were burned on the face, back, torso and arms when leaking propane gas ignited.
An employee was pumping hot (310 degrees F) liquid asphalt into a tar kettle and was burned on his face.

A truck driver was standing on the side of the truck while it was being unloaded by a forklift driver. A 12 inch piece of PVC pipe (8 ft. 7 in.) became stuck in the window lip of the truck. It broke free and sprung off the forklift striking the truck driver and causing head and neck injuries.
On September 22, 2015 at approximately 5:12pm, an employee was exiting through the front entrance of the building and slipped off the top step. The left ankle was fractured due to the fall.
A Journeyman electrician was making an electrical connection on top of an above ground storage tank and fell twelve feet to the ground below injuring his back.
An employee was working in the giblet department loading paper into the wrapping machine and suffered a partial amputation of the right hand middle fingertip.
An employee's finger was caught between the roll housing and the sled while in the process of changing the felt. He subsequently lost the tip of his right index finger.
An employee was torching a piece of steel that was to be cut down to size. The piece of steel rolled over onto the employee's lower left leg and broke bones.
An employee was unloading a truck of windows and window materials when various window panels fell over onto the employee. The employee sustained a broken shoulder and an elbow laceration.
An employee was chasing a robber and suffered a head injury.
An employee amputated the tip of his left ring finger between the feed roller of Shaper #3 and a piece of wood board.
An employee amputated the tip of his right ring finger while operating a machine to close boxes.
A worker was hospitalized for a fire ant bite.

An employee was moving a pasta cooker when a wheel on the pasta cooker hit a floor drain grate resulting in hot water spilling onto the employee.  The employee suffered second degree burns to the head, neck, back and face and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking and tripped and fell breaking the femur bone.
An employee was climbing over a railing and fell breaking his femur.
An employee was working on a conveyor and suffered a partial finger amputation and fracture when the finger was caught in a the chain and sprocket.
An employee was walking on a platform and jumped two feet to the ground.  He lost his balance and fell fracturing the left hip and shoulder.
On September 22, 2015, a delivery driver amputated a portion of his right hand ring finger while stowing the Tommy Gate on his vehicle after usage.

An employee was picking up cut brush and placing it into the chipper during power line right of way clearance. The branch brushed his abdomen and lodged a thorn into his abdomen. The event occurred on Sept. 22, 2015. Several days and two doctor visits later, the employee was admitted to the hospital on Sept. 29, 2015 with a severe infection. The thorn was found during exploratory surgery.
An employee walking in the laundry area passed out from heat stress and hit his head on the concrete floor.

An employee was performing maintenance when he found a broken solenoid valve on the dust collector machine. He reassembled  the valve of the unit, which performed an automatic blow-down of the dust collector unit. A static charge occurred, causing an explosion that severely burned the employee's body.

The employee was loading parts onto a rotating conveyor system when the machine malfunctioned and the parts got wedged in the machine. When the employee reached into the running machine to remove the parts, his finger was pinched resulting in the amputation of the left index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a steel die with an overhead crane. The employee was caught between the upper and lower dies and received a crushing injury to his chest and back and punctured a lung.

An employee was approximately 16 feet aboveground sitting on a steel horizontal beam. He was installing bolts to replace the studs that he connected to the holders. As another beam was being drifted in by the crane, the beam that he was sitting on became dislodged and fell to the ground along with the employee.
An employee was helping to line up two walls that would be nailed together. A nail from the nail gun hit a knot in the wood. The nail ricocheted, hitting and puncturing the employee's chest.
An employee was trying to reach a box of product from a shelf in the produce cooler. When he felt the full weight of the box, he lost his balance and fell.  His left ankle shattered during the fall.
An employee was pulling a come-along when the pad eye broke free and struck his right leg breaking it.
While walking, an employee tripped and fell over the forks on a parked pallet jack, injuring the right leg/knee.
The injured employee was assisting another employee by holding metal wire. The second employee caught the injured employee's left thumb in the clamp gun resulting in amputation of the left thumb.

An employee was flagging traffic with a stop sign. A motor vehicle failed to stop, left the roadway, and struck the employee. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula, as well as facial lacerations.

Two employees were moving a concrete pipe. They were on either side of the pipe. The first employee was moving the jeeper. The injured employee saw the first employee move the jeeper and went to roll the pipe onto the jeeper as well. He then ended up on the ground and received an electrical shock to his entire body.

An automatic stacker machine became jammed with wood boards. An employee hit the boards with a hammer from underneath to loosen them up and unjam the machine. The boards became unjammed and spilled out of the machine onto the employee's leg.  The employee suffered a broken left leg that required hospitalization for surgery.
An employee was cleaning a stencil machine when his finger got caught in the flow valve. The valve closed on his finger and amputated his left fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell while walking down steps, breaking his femur.
An employee slipped from a 10-foot roof while installing flashing. The employee suffered lower back pain and a potential fracture due to the harness and lanyard restraint impact.
Three employees were replacing a gasket on a liquid fertilizer tank.  While attempting to install the gasket, the injured employee's finger got caught in a pipe, amputating his right index fingertip.
On September 23, 2015, an employee was shocked while connecting cable to a pole, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was pushing a crate of sweet potatoes down a ramp to a roller table. His hand got caught and made contact with the drive chain sprocket, severing his right index finger and fracturing his ring and little finger.
An employee was installing laminate on the roof when he stepped into a hole and fell approximately 20 feet. He fractured his left elbow, dislocated his pelvis, and required left arm surgery.
On September 23, 2015,an employee suffered a left hand finger amputation when a right angle air drill with a double sided hole saw slipped and caught his Kevlar glove.
An employee broke the upper right arm while raking leaves.
An employee slipped on a substance on the floor and fell breaking a leg.
The employee was welding the support hood of a railcar. The employee got his left ring finger pinched between the porta power and the break rod support resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading cattle from a pen into a truck for transport. Two cows tackled the gate. The gate deformed and its spring-lock mechanism released. The gate struck and knocked down the employee. She struck her head on the concrete ground and was hospitalized for a small brain bleed.

An employee was holding onto a braided chocker line (wire) that was wrapped around pipes being installed in a manhole by a backhoe. The backhoe came in contact with a live electrical line, and the employee received burns to his right hand and shoulder.
An employee sustained a right index fingertip laceration while clearing a misfeed part in a strapper machine.
While an employee was exiting the excavator, he missed a step and fell about 35 to 40 inches, fracturing his left femur.
Two employees on a lift fell 15 feet when the cable snapped. The first employee broke an ankle and toes. The second employee sustained a back injury and bruised lungs.

On Tuesday, 9/22/15 at approximately 6:30 PM, an employee suffered a laceration to his right thigh when he backed into a motor's fan that was being repaired. The fan's protective shroud had been removed for the repairs. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee was guiding a 1500-pound weight that was being carried by a forklift to the wheel on a tractor. The weight slipped off and fell on the employee's left lower leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee performing maintenance on the board edger was struck and injured by a tool left on the equipment after the equipment was re-energized. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured wrist.
An employee caught the middle finger of her left hand in the door of the mail truck severing it at the fingertip.

An employee was monitoring the process of balancing two cooling fans. The fan guard had been removed for this process. The employee grabbed the belt of the fan, which was not turned on at the time, and the force coming from the adjacent fan caused it to rotate. The employee's hand got caught between the belt and pulley, amputating his right pinky, ring, and middle fingers.
A temporary worker was sweeping the warehouse floor and was bitten by a rattle snake on the right index finger.

The employee was loading film/packaging materials at the start of his shift when the material jammed in the machine.  When he manually removed the jam, the machine restarted and the blade amputated his left index fingertip.
Two employees were moving a shelving unit. The unit slipped and fell onto the employee's right big toe fracturing it.
While tying an extension ladder to a building's permanent ladder, an employee lost his balance and fell 4 feet, breaking his tibia and injuring his ankle.
An employee was cutting and deboning shoulders when the knife lacerated his abdomen. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing loose concrete to install a pipe when another employee struck his hand with a sledge hammer resulting in the amputation of the right index fingertip.
While closing the side door of an ambulance, an employee's fingers got shut in the door. The right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee's heel got caught in the carpet while she was moving dresses. She fell to the floor and broke her hip.
While using a table saw, an employee's right index finger and right middle finger contacted the blade. The employee's right index finger was amputated.
An employee scratched her right leg at work on September 23, 2015.  The scratch became infected and the leg was later amputated.

An employee was replacing a motor on a chiller. While he was loosening a lug, his wrench made contact with the starter cabinet, which shorted to the ground and caused an arc flash. He sustained second degree burns to his face and left arm. LOTO was not used and proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a scraping pole to scrape spray foam from studs while standing on the floor. He moved to work on a lift and when he finished the work from the lift, he came down and made contact with the pole scraper blade, lacerating his right arm.
An employee was sliding a 55-gallon drum onto another rack when the rack on the forklift slid, striking and lacerating the employee's forehead. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing the drive belts on a fan unit. His left ring finger got caught between one of the drive belts and the motor pulley/sheath as the belt turned on the pulley. His left ring finger was amputated below the first joint and he required surgery.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet when a series of unbraced roof trusses he was working on collapsed. The employee's legs were pinned in the debris pile of the collapsed trusses.

On or about September 24, 2015, at 11:40 a.m., an employee was filling the gift card rack in the electronics department when she tripped over one of the rack's protruding legs and fell onto her left side.  She broke her left hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading trees from a truck while riding on the forks of a forklift. The forklift driver moved the forks, and the employee's left hand got caught in the chains of the fork, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell while unloading goods with a hand cart. The hand cart came down on the employee's hand, pinching it between the cart and ground.

An employee entered the room that reduces noise from the line saw to look at a vent. Her hand contacted the saw blade, cutting her right index, middle, and ring fingers. She was hospitalized and had surgery resulting in a partial amputation to the first knuckle of the right index finger.

An employee was cleaning out the air actuator. The employee called out to a second employee who did not hear him correctly and the second employee closed a valve amputating the employee's right middle finger above the finger nail.

An employee was sorting scrap metal by hand. The employee's finger got caught between a piece of metal and the handrail that it was being tossed over into a bin. The piece landed on the fingertip and pinched it between the rail, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cutting material with a double miter saw. While attempting to clear a piece of material from under the machine's housing, her left hand contacted the saw blade, amputating her finger at the second knuckle.

On September 24, 2015, at approximately 11:15 a.m., an employee's middle fingertip became caught inside the pin hole of a crane that was being used to set up temporary lighting. The employee was coming off the ladder and used the pin hole for leverage. The crane operator thought he was clear to actuate the boom, and while doing so the employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was checking a compartment beneath the undercarriage of an aircraft. While the employee was closing the access panel door, the door closed on and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was pressure-washing a propane truck in a garage when a fire explosion occurred, burning the employee's hand and arms.
An employee was operating the leveler machine when his glove got caught by a part going into the machine. He suffered an avulsion.

An employee had just finished setting up a printer press and was wiping excess ink off of the cylinder when the rag got caught in the roller. While the employee attempted to remove the rag, the machine amputated his right middle finger and injured his index and ring fingers.
An employee's powered buggy spun out of control after being accelerated, and the employee fell and injured his left hip. He required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was investigating a slitter malfunction when the employee's arm was caught in the scrap removal conveyor below the slitter. The left arm was amputated above the elbow.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while walking down the aisle, breaking an ankle.

An employee at an oil field site was snubbing pipe while standing on a catwalk. As a second pipe was being loaded into the V-door, it caught the end of the first pipe, sending the second pipe into the air. The employee saw the pipe and jumped from the catwalk to avoid being struck. The pipe fell on and broke his left leg.

An employee was moving a pole containing a security camera downward to adjust the camera. The top portion of his right middle finger got caught and was amputated between the top and lower portion of the pole's hinge.

An employee was trimming trees from a scissor lift at a height of approximately 10 to 12 feet. The employee fell from the scissor lift, sustaining a head injury, punctured lung, torn liver, and broken bones.
An employee was working on a heater when the fuel gas system detonated and caused a flash fire. The employee was burned on the right side of the face and ear.

On 9/24/15, at approximately 5:15 p.m., an employee was positioning a jack to a block bailer. He put his left hand on the side of the jack and his left middle finger got caught between the cradle and jack set. His left finger was crushed and had to be surgically amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee's right calf was bitten by a dog while delivering mail to a residence.

On or about September 24, 2015, an employee was unloading a piece of glass from the conveyor to place it on a cart. The employee's right-hand middle finger struck the edge of the glass and was lacerated. The wound became infected and required overnight hospitalization.
An employee's index finger was cut by a conveyor belt. The belt was unguarded at the time.
An employee tripped and fell, hitting his head on the cabinet of the air conditioning unit he was working on.

On 9/24/15, an employee was doing electrical service work to the motor of a vertical cardboard baler. The power to the motor was not turned off at the time. He received an electric shock when he grabbed the live 208 power cord and sustained burns to his hands, requiring hospitalization.
On 9/24/15, at 8:10 a.m., an employee's left middle and ring fingertips (including a portion of the nailbed) were amputated while the employee was setting up a bagger machine.
An employee tried to move a bench in the production shop. The bench fell on her right foot, causing fractures.
An employee slipped and fell from a delivery truck while cleaning the window glass, hitting his head on the ground below and suffering a concussion.

On 9/24/15, at 7:15 a.m., an employee was operating a brake press. The light curtain on the press break was inoperative at the time. The employee sustained an amputation of the right index finger's first knuckle.
An employee was unloading a Telehandler off a truck trailer. The equipment became unstable and tipped over striking the employee.  The employee suffered a skull fracture.

An employee was monitoring the flow of flour bags along a conveyor on a packaging machine.  He noticed a bag that had gotten caught at the top and attempted to reach in to pull it through. His gloved hand got pinched in the machine, lacerating the right middle fingertip.
An employee dropped a large metal rim on his finger tearing flesh from the fingertip. The hospital amputated the finger to the first knuckle due to nerve damage.

An employee was repairing a cooling fan and replacing the fan belt. The employee was using a screw driver to put the belt on when it slipped, catching the employee's finger between the pulley and fan belt. The employee's left fingertip was amputated.
On or about September 25, 2015, while using a partner saw to cut a 4x4 piece of wood, an employee cut their left leg across the thigh and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 10-foot A-Frame ladder grinding a 3-inch carbon steel pipe with a 4.5-inch grinder. The employee fell off the ladder, breaking the left arm in three places (surgery required) and suffering a mild concussion.
An employee was adjusting machinery to resize envelopes when his thumb got caught and amputated between the collator and the collator wheel. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was carrying a catalytic convertor cutter with his hand in the shearer. The employee accidently stepped on the activation switch closing the shearer and amputating two fingers on the left hand.
An employee amputated the tip of his right thumb just below the fingernail while cutting meat with a meat saw.

An employee was dismantling transformers when one of the transformers fell on him and injured both legs. His left leg and foot had to be surgically amputated below the knee, and his lower left arm was fractured.

An employee placing material on a cut-off (plate) saw was injured when the material caught his left pinky finger and pinched it between the housing of the saw and the material. The finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was cutting scrap material with a table saw and severely lacerated the left hand index and middle fingers.
An employee was cleaning the okra cutter and amputated the tip of the left thumb.
An employee exposed to fall hazards sustained head injuries.
An employee was applying wax to a double-sided planer when his glove got caught by the blades. His right index finger and thumb were amputated.

An employee was unloading a mail shipment off a delivery truck at the processing center loading dock. A general purpose mail container fell off a scissor lift and struck her, fracturing her left forearm.

An employee was troubleshooting the fourth filling spout on an assembly line machine. While attempting to fix it, the employee made contact with the machine and his finger got pinched. He sustained a left-hand fingertip amputation.

An employee was working at the former machine. As the employee attempted to pull out a full stack of trays from inside the machine, the stack pusher engaged upwards to push the trays. The stack pusher caught and partially amputated the employee's right-hand middle finger.

On 09/25/2015, at approximately 4:28 p.m., a maintenance employee was injured while working on a drive chain and sprocket. The employee's right hand became caught in the equipment, fracturing the right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was moving a patient on a rolling bed and injured her back.

An employee was operating the deburring machine. While removing a part, the plunger cycled forward and smashed his index finger, which was caught in the part window. The employee's left index finger was amputated, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fractured and amputated the his left thumb tip when it was caught between the blade of an excavator and a steel chain while attempting to secure the excavator to a trailer.
An employee was hospitalized with a broken right arm after his hose became entangled with a conveyor belt and pulled him into the device.

An employee was taping drywall while standing on a baker scaffold approximately 5 feet above ground level when he fell to the floor below. He fell on his head, suffering a fractured skull and several broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up the roll thread machine when the brake out snagged, catching and amputating his right-hand pinky finger.
An employee fell approximately 80 feet to the ground and was injured.
An employee fell from a 4-foot stepladder while performing preventive maintenance, breaking their right hip and foot.

An employee was moving a 15-gallon stock pot full of boiling water when he stumbled. The water splashed him on his arm, chest, and back, causing second degree burns that required overnight hospitalization.
An employee was using the paper cutting board when he amputated the end of his left-hand middle finger.
An employee was operating a stack loader forklift to move product when his left foot got pinned between a light pole and the lift truck. He experienced left foot swelling.
An employee's left foot was crushed while driving a forklift, requiring overnight hospitalization.

On September 25, 2015, at approximately 11:00 to 11:30 a.m., an employee was working from a ladder and reached for a nail gun. The ladder slid down the wall approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee broke his left arm and left leg.

An employee was inside the block plant maintenance shop waiting for a coworker to finish cutting pieces of angle iron with an electric-powered reciprocating saw. While the saw was operating, the employee's finger contacted the belt running between the saw's electric motor and the flywheel.  The employee's left index fingertip was caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on liquid spilled on the floor and subsequently fell down a flight of stairs (10 to 12 risers). She suffered contusions and potential fractures to her back and torso.

An employee in the molding department was attempting to remove material that clogged the auger of an injection molding machine. His hand got caught in the auger, which was not shut down at the time of the incident. He sustained left-hand and wrist lacerations, as well as torn tendons, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing a cracked clamp used to join two panels together during bracing when the MSE wall panel fell over on and hit him. He sustained hand, arm, and torso injuries.

An employee was helping to roll out roofing material. The employee fell approximately 16 feet through pallets and plywood that were covering a skylight to the concrete floor below. The employee was knocked unconscious.
An employee injured their stomach and suffered a hernia while lifting a patient, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down while walking, fracturing his left tibia and fibula.

While attempting to retrieve a piece of plastic from a conveyor, a machine that was dumping  a mushroom bin onto the conveyor hit the employee. The employee got caught between the guardrails and the dumper, puncturing the employee's lungs and breaking an arm and two ribs.
An employee tried to correct a stacked pallet that was leaning over. The pallet fell on the employee, breaking the employee's hip.
An employee was loading asbestos bags onto the scaffold and walking. The scaffold collapsed, struck him in the head, and knocked him down. He sustained a back injury.

An employee was cleaning wood fiber debris from an airlock when his finger got caught between the metal tip of the vane and the airlock, amputating his left middle finger above the bone. The airlock was not turned off at the time of the incident.
An employee was helping to lower a pipe for a trench. The employee's finger got caught and lacerated between a pipe.

An employee lifted, carried, and placed 6-inch frames, which weighed approximately 28 pounds, 3 feet to a nearby table. While separating the material, he felt a pop in his stomach and instantly experienced pain. He was hospitalized for rupturing a pre-existing hernia, requiring surgery.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder attached to a vessel. She slipped around the fifth rung from the bottom, breaking her ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee was fumigating a ship's hold when he placed his hand near the edge of a hatch opening. A coworker closed the hatch cover, which amputated the employee's right thumb. He was hospitalized for hand surgery.
An employee slipped on grating, which resulted in leg fracture.
