An employee was hospitalized due to leg injuries from being caught in a conveyor belt.

At approximately 3:45 a.m., on 9/27/2015, an employee working on a bottling line was preparing to do some cleaning. The employee filled a hand sprayer with cleaning product and pumped the sprayer up. The sprayer exploded, causing a severe injury to his hand, as well as minor lacerations to his face and legs. The hand injury required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a case of beer when he suffered a hernia.
An employee was sorting papers on the floor of her cubicle.  She went to the copier and when she returned, she stepped on a pile of the papers and slipped and fell, fracturing her left ankle.
An employee was riding a horse from the stalls to the pen when the horse bucked, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken lower leg and knee dislocation.
An employee was installing asphalt shingles when he accidently shot himself in the foot with his nail gun.

On September 28, 2015, an employee pulled his truck and trailer off the road and exited to the side of the road. He picked up a large cone and placed it in the trailer while standing on the driver's side. He saw headlights coming towards him and immediately tried to avoid being struck by the third-party vehicle. The vehicle struck the parked trailer at full speed. Something, likely the trailer, struck his head and knocked him to the ground unconscious. He sustained injuries to the back of his body and elbow, as well as a head laceration and concussion.

An employee was servicing a client's forklift when the forklift sped up unexpectedly and went off the side of the loading dock ramp. The employee was pinned by the forklift and, as a result, half of his foot was amputated.

A worker poured isopropyl alcohol into an acid waste container, causing a reaction that produced acid gas. An employee working in an adjacent room was overcome by the vapors and suffered restricted breathing, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was preparing to travel to onsite work locations. He disengaged the foot-operated emergency brake with his hand while the truck was in the drive gear. The truck rolled into a structure, at which time the employee attempted to place the truck in the park gear. He inadvertently placed the truck in reverse, causing it to reverse and strike him in the chest and knee.

While telescoping plastic through the winder on an extrusion machine, an employee's left arm was caught in the equipment. The employee was hospitalized overnight with a broken ulna and radius, which required surgery.
An employee was helping to unload cable reels when his finger got pinched between a forklift fork and a trailer. His right ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

On September 28, 2015, at approximately 9:10 a.m., a crane was being used to move a rebar mat into position when one of the lifting straps failed, causing the mat to fall.  An employee was beneath the mat as it fell; he became pinned, sustaining broken legs, a punctured lung, and facial lacerations.
An employee was flash burned on one side of his face and chest when the three-phase meter shorted out. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a saw table to trim and cut lumber boards. While attempting to grab the cut lumber under the table, the employee hit the foot pedal. The saw blade activated and amputated his fingertip.
On September 28, 2015, an employee was hospitalized after receiving a 2%, second degree burn on his right forearm while cleaning nozzles with a bucket of hypochlorite and foaming alkaline.
An employee received an electrical shock when their drill bit contacted an energized wire while drilling a hole into a wall.

An employee was manually pushing a center steel partition to align it in a railcar when his foot slipped. He reached up to the edge of the railcar to catch himself while the ram of the hydraulic radar pusher was coming down. The employee's middle and ring fingers on his right hand were caught in a pinch point, resulting in the amputation of his fingertips.

An employee was working on a pitched roof, clearing off materials, when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. He was wearing fall protection at the time, but the shock pack did not deploy, and all of the fall protection fell with him. He fractured his lower back.
An employee was training a coworker on how to operate an electric pallet jack. The employee was struck by the pallet jack and sustained injuries to the left leg.

An employee was resetting a machine center to the home position when his left-hand ring finger got pinched between the spindle and the ball part of the press. This 
de-gloved the finger, which had to be surgically amputated.

On September 28, 2015, at 7:00 p.m., an employee was adjusting the stroke length on a pneumatically powered cylinder. The cylinder actuated when the employee reattached the air source (100 psi) to the pneumatic cylinder, amputating the employee's right-hand pinky fingertip in the pinch point between the end of the cylinder body and the cylinder rod cap.
On or about September 28, 2015, an employee felt a pop in their back while driving a forklift. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.

On September 28, 2015, at approximately 10:15 a.m., an employee fell from a ladder while climbing on the roof of a house to inspect it for damage as part of a claim. After striking the ground, the employee received a head injury involving the face, teeth, and facial bones.

An employee was servicing and troubleshooting an oven loader when the employee's right index finger got caught and amputated in the chain and sprocket. The chain and sprocket was not covered at the time.
An employee fell while using crutches for a previous non-work related incident, fracturing the left side of his hip.
An employee was cleaning a print roller when the rag that he was using got caught and pulled his hand into the rollers. His fingers were crushed.

On 09/24/2015 the injured employee lifted a 50 pound of dog food in the Claims Department (returns area) and felt pain in the right shoulder. The employee was hospitalized on 09/28/2015 with strain in the right shoulder resulting in blood clot(s) in the right shoulder.

An employee was delivering metal product to a customer's facility by semi-truck. He hooked a load of material to the customer's overhead crane. In the process of moving the material from the truck, his finger got caught between the metal load, amputating his left fingertip up to the first knuckle.

An employee was performing maintenance on a compressor, tightening the belt, when the motor froze. While attempting to turn on the compressor, his hand made contact with the belt and his right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was walking in the parking lot during a rain storm and slipped and fell injuring the back and shoulder.

On September 28, 2015, at approximately 2:45 p.m., an employee was climbing a 28-foot extension ladder that had been leaned against a mid-span, which is the line between two poles. The ladder began twisting and moving, and the employee fell 15 feet to the rocky ground below. He fractured his left wrist and required surgery.

An employee was operating a chop saw to cut lumber. He went to stop the saw by hitting the stop switch and then went to the exhaust pipe to clean out sawdust. The saw blade was still spinning at the time, and the employee's hand came in contact with the spinning blade. He sustained a laceration to the back of his left hand.

An employee was inside a vinegar vat for maintenance purposes. He was standing on a ladder, entering the space, and wearing a respirator when he was overcome and fell from the ladder into the vat. He was hospitalized for chemical burns to his lungs.
An employee was in an aerial lift approximately 8 feet high in an energized zone. The employee made contact with a station transformer, causing an arc flash, and was hospitalized.
An employee was mounting a specialty tire using a tire machine when the machine's roller amputated his right-hand pinky fingertip.
While making copies, an employee turned, caught the left foot on the copy machine, and fell fracturing the left femur.

An employee was riding on the back of a trash truck vehicle when the truck struck a vehicle while reversing. The truck jerked as it shifted gears to move forward, causing the employee to fall from the back of the truck to the pavement. The employee sustained a broken shoulder.
An employee was helping to lower pipe into a shored trench when the employee's finger got caught between the pipe and one of the trench's shoring jacks.
An employee was welding angle edge onto steel beams. The employee placed a scaffold plank across two beams to provide a surface on which to sit while welding. He slipped and fell fracturing a hip.
On 09/28/2015, about 4:30pm, a temporary worker fell from a trash pile/landfill and broke her ankle.
An employee sustained a broken foot after it was ran over by a forklift resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was filling wall forms with concrete from a pump truck. He fell off of the 4-foot concrete form he was working on and his leg struck the concrete footer at the bottom of the concrete wall, fracturing his femur.
An installer was working at a residence laying hardwood flooring and kneeled on a tack. The wound became infected and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving the elevator, tripped and fell breaking the left femur.
An employee fell backwards off the first or second step of a ladder while stocking grass seed on the shelf. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

An employee dropped the plate that he was carrying with a crane. He was pushing the plate with his right foot when he dropped it. He reacted by turning his body quickly, twisting his ankle and fracturing his left foot. The plate did not strike the employee.
An employee in the packing department was adjusting the box taper when his left index finger was pinched in the unguarded chain and drive sprocket resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was pushing a loaded cart when the cart hit a doorway and the load began to shift. The employee then attempted to catch the load and amputated portions of the index and middle fingers on the left hand.
An employee was walking around the site, observing the installation of a new sewer line, when he slipped in the mud and fell to the ground. He sustained a left ankle injury.
An employee was slicing potatoes and cut off the tip of his pinky finger.
While an employee was holding an air conditioner blower shaft to change the belt, his left hand slipped. His left index finger got caught by the air conditioner blade, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was struck by a forklift truck while walking in the warehouse and sustained a leg injury.
An employee was admitted to the hospital due to dehydration.
An employee was delivering groceries. He fell and broke his left ankle while pushing a dolly down a ramp, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped when her foot got entangled in a computer cable, fracturing her right elbow.
An employee was adjusting guides on a machine when another operator jogged the machine.  The employee's finger got crushed between the rollers, amputating his left ring fingertip.

An employee was holding a metal diaphragm ring with a nylon stick (tool). The roller used to make the lip on a metal ring (diaphragm) came off of the die inside of the machine, causing the piece to be pulled into the rollers as the machine cycled. The employee's right-hand ring finger was amputated by the rollers.
An employee received electrical burns to the right thumb and middle fingers when his wrench contacted the control module of an AC unit on a boat.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder while carrying boxes and fell striking his head on the concrete floor.
The employee had a medical reaction to a chicken pox vaccine on 9-24-15. The vaccine was a job requirement.
A nurse was checking a patient's room and fell breaking her hip.
The employee was cleaning pieces of metal off a magnet. The magnets drew together and pinched the employee's right ring finger resulting in amputation.

On or around 9/29/15, while taking measurements for installation of a lightening protection system, a worker on the second floor of Building 148 fell approximately 10 feet through a ladder access hole and fractured their skull.  At the time of the incident, a guardrail was in place on 3 sides of the access hole.
An employee was retrieving supplies and/or documents from a storage room and tripped over a step stool. She fractured her right femur.
An employee cut their left thumb on September 29, 2015.  On October 1, 2015 the employee was hospitalized for a severe infection in the thumb.
An employee's hands came in contact with a chainsaw operated by another employee while swamping brush for a sawyer. The employee damaged two fingertips on left hand and was hospitalized.

An employee was lowering a load of glass panels onto a manual pallet jack and amputated the tip of his right index finger when his finger was pinched between the load and the handle of the pallet jack.
While operating a food slicer to cut cucumbers in the grocery store, an employee amputated the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee was operating a manual tabletop paper cutter and amputated a fingertip. The paper cutter was unguarded at the time of the incident.
On 09/29/2015, about 10:30 am, an employee rolled a heavy piece of equipment onto his right foot. On 10/09/2015, the employee was hospitalized and had surgery to amputate two toes on the right foot.

While a travel crane operator was in the process of climbing up to the cab of the crane, he slipped off a rung that was approximately 28 inches from the ground and hit his head on the ground. He suffered a laceration to the skull along with swelling at the base of his spine near the neck.

A temporary employee was cleaning out hoses using a gas powered pressure washer with a wand attachment inserted into the hose.  As the employee pulled the trigger to begin washing, the force of the water caused the hose to pull back from the wand which allowed the pressurized water to strike his left thumb and index finger causing laceration/injection wounds.
An employee suffered the amputation of four fingers on his right hand while operating a miter saw.
An employee's right middle fingertip was amputated when it came into contact with a band saw that was being used to cut up meat.
An employee of Simplot Foods was severely burned on his neck and back when an industrial fryer he was cleaning overflowed with boiling water.

An employee operating a lathe attempted to remove a shim located between the jaws of a chuck and pipe. While the employee was removing the shim, the kicker actuated, causing the pipe to move. The employee's finger became stuck between the pipe and the chuck jaws, amputating the right index fingertip.
While an employee was clearing the area, a copperhead snake jumped out of the brush and bit his left pinky finger.
On or about September 30, 2015, an employee was removing excess aluminum trim from a press. A coworker activated the press, which crushed the employee's left forearm.

An employee was loading pipe into a fusion machine when the pipe became crooked. The employee tried to remove the pipe by lifting it with a coworker. His right pinky and ring fingers got caught between the pipe, amputating his fingertips.

An employee was operating an overhead crane to move a 1100-pound steel structure from saw horses onto the floor. While moving the structure, the load shifted and hit the employee on the head. He fell backward and hit his head on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture.

An employee was operating a lapper machine when its vacuum hose clogged. He turned the machine off, opened the doors, and attempted to unclog it. His hand got caught in the machine and was crushed, resulting in a hand amputation.
An additional 480V service for a step-up transformer was being installed. When the circuit was tested, an arc flash occurred, resulting in lacerations to the employee's hand.

At approximately 10:30pm on Wednesday, September 30, 2015, a janitorial employee was walking to a dumpster when he slipped and fell on asphalt next to the dumpster, hurting his leg.  The employee was transported to the hospital where he was admitted.
An employee was loading and unloading a truck when he began to feel ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee wearing a harness and lanyard was accessing the third-story roof. He stepped from the ladder to go to his tie-off anchor point, but slipped in the process. He fell approximately 30 feet to the second story and then to the ground and was hospitalized with a compressed disc.
An employee felt sick and passed out after spray painting residential doors by hand at a paint booth. The employee possibly overheated.
On 9/30/15, at 9:19 PM, an employee was changing a propane tank when the tank ignited, burning his hands. Safety gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was hospitalized with a leg fracture after falling on a staircase.
An employee was injured from a four foot fall off of an unguarded loading dock at a satellite location and was hospitalized with fractured ribs.
An employee who suffered a burn on the leg from hot water during a sanitation process was hospitalized due to an infection of the injury.
An employee was hooking his lanyard to his harness while standing on a ladder.  His foot slipped and he fell 20 feet. His left ankle was shattered.
An employee was on a ladder removing electrical wire from a warehouse. He touched a live wire, was shocked and fell off the ladder. He suffered internal burns and a fractured skull.

While breaking down a hydraulic crane, an employee was in the process of removing the outrigger pad while the outrigger was retracting and got his left hand caught in a pinch point fracturing the middle and ring finger in two places.
An employee was climbing into his dump truck and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.

While an employee was moving lumber in row one using a diesel-powered forklift, the top two packs of lumber in row two fell onto the forklift, causing the forklift cage to fail. The cage then struck the employee, fracturing his scapula and dislocating his collarbone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using elevators to latch pipe. While pulling the elevators back to latch another joint of pipe from the trailer, his fingertip got caught between the horn and bale. He sustained a right index fingertip avulsion.
An employee fell while walking in the parking lot, breaking her left femur.
An employee was cleaning machinery and fell from an elevated work area to the floor, fracturing the right hip.
An employee's backup hammer slipped over the end stud nut, smashing the employee's left index finger between the stud and wrench. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to remove a piece of rubber from the cutter of a machine. His finger contacted the blade, amputating his fingertip.

The injured employee, a semi truck driver, left the company in Woodward to deliver a load at various locations in Oklahoma.  He left Woodward around 3:00 AM to go to the site in Laverne, OK.  When he got to the site, he opened the door and got a forklift truck out to unload the truck by himself. Someone came to the site later and found him on the ground.  He may have fallen from the back of the truck.  He had 3 broken ribs, a fractured skull and bleeding in the brain.
An employee operating a forklift struck the back of another forklift, breaking his left leg and injuring both feet.
An employee was straightening wood near a saw when he was struck by a wood board, fracturing his left femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee amputated his left middle finger at the first knuckle after it was pinched between a C clamp and an access panel while working on an elevator belt.
An employee was loading insulation into an insulation blower machine. The employee's left arm was injured when it got caught in the equipment's metal bars.
On September 30, 2015, a temporary worker was applying tar to the roof and fell through the roof. The employee sustained head injuries.
While trying to clear a jam in a screw conveyor, an employee's gloved right hand was pulled into the conveyor. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated right hand.

An employee was adjusting a core chuck on a paper machine winder when the core inserter raised and caught the employee's right little finger between the core insert and the core chuck. The employee's finger broke and was lacerated.
An employee was walking across the parking lot, fell, and broke their hip.
At the time of the incident, an employee was operating a core stripper and got his hand caught in a running nip point.

An employee was fixing a leaf spring beneath a truck when the car jack slipped off the truck's axel. The leaf spring struck the employee and fractured the employee's head behind the ear and orbital region.

An employee was cutting a hickory board with a table saw. A piece of the board broke off and impaled the employee on the right wrist/forearm. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to remove the wood.
An employee was plugging in a forklift battery (36 volts) into a charger and was shocked. He was  admitted to the hospital.

An employee was nailing trusses to the side wall and stepped off of the all on to the adjacent patio ceiling. He then fell through the braces to the ground eight feet below resulting in crushing injuries to the lumbar region of the back.

An employee was using a staple gun for siding or roofing activities. The staple gun engaged while the employee was changing positions, lodging a 3-inch staple into the bone of the employee's right leg.
An employee was moving a paper roll with an overhead crane. Her right pinky finger got caught and was amputated between the paper roll shaft and the bracket.
On or about 9/30/2015, an employee slipped and fell after stepping into spilled/leaking water on a sloped walkway next to a fountain/garden. The employee fractured a kneecap.

Two employees were loading a trailer with packages. The trailer was coupled with the yard dog. They were told to get out of the trailer so that the driver could move it. The injured employee took a package off the extendo, stepped backwards, and fell off the dock fracturing her femur.  She had her back to the dock.
An employee broke his left foot while operating a forklift.
An employee was walking in the warehouse and was hit by a pallet jack breaking their femur bone.
An employee was performing maintenance on a press when the press door closed on his finger, amputating the fingertip between the nailbed and first knuckle.
An employee fell four feet from his delivery truck, suffering head/back pain.

An employee was replacing an underground drain line with a coworker. The employee was bent over when a light pole that was sitting on the ground with the arm section leaned against the wall fell over and hit the employee on the back, breaking two lower back bones.

An employee and a coworker were installing a drive pin on a filler machine. The employee was holding the equipment while the coworker manually turned the filler. The employee's finger got pinched between the motor casing and the filler drum, amputating the left middle fingertip.

On Thursday October 1, 2015, at the Suncast Distribution Center in Montgomery, Illinois, an employee was bent over working. Coworkers nearby were manually breaking down double-stacked pallets with boxed products. The last box (weighing 208 pounds) on the top of a double-stacked pallet shifted and fell onto the employee from overhead. The employee suffered a closed fracture to the pelvis, femoral vein damage, a pelvic hematoma, and a lower body injury.

An employee was attempting to clear a pizza pan jam on the conveyor. The line was not shut down at the time. As the pans continued down the line, they jammed and pinned her left hand against the metal bar that guides the pans. She could not remove her hand and sustained a laceration, fracture, and burns to the palm.
An employee was cutting sheet metal when the sheet metal curled up and bounced back, striking and lacerating his left eye.

On or around October 1, 2015, an employee was attempting to pry up a refractory plate into a bobcat bucket when his right pinky finger became pinned between the pry bar and the furnace wall. His pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was unloading freight from a truck when the load fell on and broke his ankle.
An employee was unloading materials in a UPS trailer while standing on a step stool. The employee fell off the third rung of the step stool to the ground below, fracturing the left leg.

An employee was reaching into the cab of the truck to obtain a flashlight. The truck began to move and hit a parked trailer causing the truck door to close on the employee's legs fracturing the left leg.
An employee's golf cart drove 5 feet off the golf course's retaining wall into a pond. The golf cart landed on top of the employee, who suffered ankle, wrist, eye socket, and rib fractures.

An employee fell approximately 25 feet from the second-story roof of a residence where he was installing solar panels. He fractured his feet, ankles, legs, and wrist and suffered a spinal injury when he hit the ground. He required surgery.

An employee was performing maintenance, removing manifold gauges from a residential air conditioning unit. The employee unscrewed the gauges and the liquid refrigerant sprayed onto the employee's hands. The employee suffered chemical burns to the left palm, four left fingers, and the right index finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hit in the head by pipe while pulling it up. The employee's skull was fractured.
An employee slipped and fell while delivering mail. The employee's right ankle broke and required surgery.
An employee was removing a horse from the exercise walker and hooking the lead to the horse. The horse reared and kicked the employee, causing loss of consciousness and a head injury.

An employee was washing down sodium hydroxide that was leaking off a pump. During the washing process, caustic material soaked into the employee's steel toe boots through the laces, causing second and third degree burns to the tops of the employee's feet.

An employee was working on the timing belt under a vehicle when a coworker came and turned on the vehicle. Once the vehicle was turned on, the belt system trapped the employee's left index finger and amputated the distal knuckle.
An employee's right pinky finger was amputated up to the first knuckle while operating a hydraulic press.
While an employee was pressure testing a pipe, the test ball shot out of the pipe and severely lacerated the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a boom lift during painting operations when it tipped over and fell to the ground while the employee was still inside. He was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

The employees use the Caterpillar tractor bucket to transfer tools and equipment from the storage conex to the work site.  The operator lowered the bucket from the caterpillar onto the left foot of the injured employee injuring the big toe.

An employee was machining a bolt when his jacket got caught in the chuck of a horizontal lathe, which in turn pulled him into the rotating parts of the lathe. He injured his left hand and lacerated his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a semi-automatic vertical winder to make a gasket. When he activated the foot pedal to the machine, the machine pinched and amputated his fingertip.
An employee was picking up auto parts and was struck by a tugger resulting in contusions to the legs and knees.

An employee was standing above a concrete pump when he fell inside the hopper.  His left leg got caught inside the pump auger, and the lower part of the leg was fractured and lacerated. The pump was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was selecting cases in the warehouse using a triple jack PIV. He was coasting the triple jack PIV toward the racks to select product when the PIV pinned him against the rack, fracturing two ribs.
An employee was assembling an aluminum tailgate when the torque gun he was using to tighten bolts slipped and caught his finger. His left middle finger was amputated.

An employee was winding the end of a roll. He was jogging the end of the material onto the roll when his right hand went between the hold-down device and the take-up reel. When he pulled his hand out, his fingertip was amputated.

A maintenance employee was trying to reset the limit switch on an overhead crane after the operator tripped it. The employee was working near moving gears that caught his pant leg and pulled his leg in. His leg was partially amputated.
An employee was using a 6 ft. A-frame ladder to fix the air conditioning drain pipe on top of the awning outside the building. He fell on the pavement and injured his head.
An employee was cutting wood material with a table saw and contacted the saw blade amputating the middle and ring fingers of the right hand.

An employee working on a vertical polisher machine was installing a saw blade. He was hoisting a blade onto an arbor with a spacer.  While aligning the blade to the bushing and arbor, he pushed the blade and bushing with one hand and operated the hoist with the other.  The blade slipped off the hoist and fell on his left thumb, amputating the tip.

An employee was on the back of an end-load sanitation truck while it was backing up.  The truck backed into a utility pole and the employee's hand was caught between the truck and the utility pole. Five fingers and half of his right hand were amputated.
Two employees were in a feed mill man lift. Some component in the lifting mechanism failed, causing the car to fall to the ground. Both employees sustained fractures to both legs.
An employee was using a load device to move a metal ring for a manhole cover when he turned and fell backwards. The metal ring fell onto his ankle, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee carrying a bucket of paint up a portable ladder fell approximately 10 to 12 feet when the ladder became displaced. He was hospitalized with head/neck lacerations and possible fractures.

An employee lost approximately 1/3 of the finger while performing routine daily maintenance on a piece of equipment known as a topsoil screen. Two employees were cleaning debris from the radiator. In order to gain access to the radiator, the motor was moved. While placing the motor back into its proper alignment by placing a pin into a mount, the mount moved catching the employees finger and causing injury.
An SSA Gulf employee was unloading cargo when his finger became caught between the cargo, amputating a portion of his left index finger.
An employee was installing tape to hold the paper protector on a metal roller. The employee's right finger got caught and crushed in the drive gear located next to the roller.
An employee tripped over her feet and fell to the ground, fracturing her right shoulder in two places.

An employee climbed a ladder and attempted to adjust the blow pin assembly of a blow mold machine. The machine was operating at the time. While the employee tried to move a bracket and tighten screws, the machine cycled and the assembly moved up, amputating the employee's right index finger below the first knuckle.

Two employees were cleaning on the ground floor outside when an explosion occurred in the boiler room. Both employees were struck by falling debris. One of the employees fractured his right wrist. The other employee suffered a contusion to his right shoulder and right knee.

An employee was in the SkyTrak personnel basket cutting tree limbs. The operator was repositioning the machine when it hit a mound of dirt and caused the SkyTrak to tip over. The employee jumped out of the basket and suffered a concussion and a broken right ankle.
While using a high-pressure power washer, an employee's right foot was impaled by the power washer.
While getting off of a forklift, an employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing both wrists.
An employee was struck in the head by materials being lifted by an overhead hoist.
An employee went to pull out the dock plate but fell while doing so. As he fell, his right pinky finger got caught under the dock plate, amputating the fingertip.
While an employee was attempting to unhook an air line, a water line broke and sprayed hot water/steam on his torso and arms, burning them.

An employee was performing maintenance work on a malfunctioning impregnation tank lid. When the employee attached an air hose to the lid, it opened automatically and pinned his head, causing head and neck damage.
An employee was rolling a movable, wheeled pedestal grinder. The grinder fell on his foot, crushing three toes.
While attempting to clear a jam on the pre-curl machine, an employee's right finger was amputated to the knuckle by the machine's teeth.

An employee was putting a combo inside the trash compactor. Once the combo was inside, he turned on the trash compactor, but the equipment failed to operate normally. He attempted to adjust the combo, and as soon as the combo was adjusted, the compactor reacted quickly and crushed/amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was unhooking power cables from a barge when the metal handle of a cable came in contact with the plug, causing an arc flash. The employee was burned on the arm and torso.

An employee had just applied tape to a roller, sticky side up. The next step in this operation was to apply tape, sticky side down, on top of the tape that he just applied to the roller.  His right arm got caught between two rollers that were separated by approximately 2 to 3 inches. He suffered a severe abrasion to his right arm.
An employee was bitten by a spider on the left leg and hospitalized.
An employee was operating a robot-roller compacter when a coworker ran over the employee's leg with a Bobcat. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg, pelvis, and hip.
An employee was clamping rope clamps when her hand got caught in the machine. She suffered a partial amputation to her left index finger.
An employee was performing electrical work on an automatic transfer switch when an arc flash occurred. He was burned on his left ear and face.
An employee working on a scaffold took a phone call, stepped back, and fell 7 to 8 feet to the cement floor. He fractured his skull, neck, and ribs.

An employee had just finished picking up a donation and at 1260 Waterville Monclova Road in Waterville, Ohio. As the employee was closing the back sliding door of the box truck they were driving, the door came down on the top of the employee's right foot/toe. The employee lost balance, fell off the back of the box truck (approximately 3 to 4 feet), and struck their head against the concrete ground. The employee suffered a laceration to the right big toe and a possible skull fracture.
An employee was shoveling out a garbage truck at a landfill. The wind blew the side-hinged access door shut on the employee's right thumb, amputating it between the thumbnail and the first knuckle.
A maintenance employee was unclogging a sewer line when the auger cable twisted and wrapped around his left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the chuck machine with a green pad when his right index fingertip slipped into the chuck and was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting a 2x8 board with a power saw when his left ring fingertip was amputated by the saw blade.
An employee was backing a stand-up forklift off a vender-owned trailer. His left foot got caught between the forklift and the dock plate, breaking the foot.

An employee was driving a truck, jockeying trailers around in the yard of a beverage manufacturer. The employee later experienced shortness of breath and chest pain, requiring hospitalization for a collapsed lung.
An employee's hand got caught in an auger while cleaning a machine. The employee suffered broken wrist bones. The machine was still running at the time of the incident.
An employee drove a forklift to the maintenance area and parked in front of the maintenance door. As he was descending out of the cab, he slipped and fell fracturing the left femur.
While walking, an employee slipped on a mat, falling on and fracturing his right hip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a dehydration unit when the employee received a fluid burn to the left hand.

An employee was operating a jointer to make parts for two window sills just prior to glue up. The employee's glove came into contact with the jointer spindle, pulling his left hand in. Three left-hand fingers were amputated.

An employee was attempting to remove debris from the scanner on the veneer grading table. The rag he was using got pulled into an idler pulley, causing his hand to also be pulled in. He suffered a right thumb laceration and fracture.

On 10/03/2015, an employee was mopping the floor behind the counters with a mop and bucket when the mop handle struck the menu board sign, causing a piece to fall off and strike the employee's head. The employee later experienced a seizure and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a pipe rack that was approximately 7-feet high. As he attempted to roll a single piece of 20"-pipe, he lost his footing and fell backward off the top of the stacked pipe, landing on his left side. He fractured his left wrist, busted his lip, and suffered a left hip contusion.

On 10/03/2015, an employee was sorting packages when a jam occurred. While attempting to clear the jam, the employee's right hand got caught by a moving conveyor belt, which drug the hand into a transition plate. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee had greased a chain drive on a label machine. He was cleaning excess lubricant with a paper towel when the towel got caught in the sprocket and pulled his finger in, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was lifting the roll-up door of a trailer when it buckled back, pinching/catching the employee's finger in the gap of the roll-up panels. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated at the first joint.
An employee tripped and fell over a rubber mat on the floor while walking, breaking their left hip.
While unwrapping a shrink-wrapped produce pallet, an employee became tangled in plastic wrap. He lost his footing, fell, and broke his left hip.

An employee's gloved hand made contact with and was pulled in between two rollers of a mill machine while he was loading small, hardened chips of pre-mix onto the rollers for further processing. He sustained four right-hand finger amputations and third degree burns to his right forearm.

Two shop employees were in the process of tearing down a 1250 Ton Slip Type Elevator (STE) and were pulling the carriers and slips out of the STE.  While removing one of the carriers from the slip, utilizing the overhead crane, the entire slip assembly (carrier, slip, and slip hanger) began to rise out of the tool.  As the slip hanger rose the IP reached in to remove it when the slip suddenly released from the carrier pushing the slip hanger back into position.  The IP's finger was caught between the slip hanger and the timing ring of the STE amputating the tip of his left index finger midway up the fingernail.

An employee was about to replace a primary conductor in a power pole. He made contact with the live power source in the power pole, resulting in third degree burns on both hands. PPE was not worn at the time.
While preparing to inspect parts, an employee was walking and tripped on a part that was on the floor. He twisted/rolled his ankle and fell on his hip, breaking it.
An employee was welding when his welding wire failed to fire and shot through his glove and into the joint between his hand and index finger. He sustained a cut on his left hand.
An employee was operating a soup packaging machine when the die roller amputated his right index finger.

Two employees were moving an electrical panel board, sliding it across the floor. The first employee was holding the panel from the front and the second employee was holding the panel from the back. The floor was slick, and the panel slipped out from under them. The panel struck the first employee on the top of his left foot, right behind the steel toe of his boot. The big toe and second toe on his left foot were amputated.
An employee was pushing a food tray cart when it fell on top of her. She was hospitalized overnight with an injured pelvis.

An employee was working from a 6-foot, A-frame ladder with two associates to remove approximately 16 sheets of melamine (thin particle board) from where they were secured to a permanent fixture in the back room. The employee cut the strap, releasing the boards. The associates were unable to prevent the boards from hitting the ladder, causing it to buck and the employee to fall. The employee suffered a double fracture to the left leg bones just above the ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee operating a gator vehicle drove it into a block out. The approximate 8-inch sudden drop resulted in nose, knee, and wrist injuries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while washing dishes and injured her back, neck, and head, requiring hospitalization.

Three employees were in a helicopter that crashed at the company parking lot at or near 214 East Highway 44 in Parkston, South Dakota. The employees suffered head and leg injuries.

3 hospitalized.

An employee was trying to remove metal from the slides of a die cast machine. The machine was powered on at the time. The employee's right hand got caught in the machine, amputating the right middle fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized after falling from the roof of a one-story building while inspecting for hail damage. He hit his head on the pavement below and suffered bleeding on the brain.

An employee was weighing off ingredients that went into the plastic homogenization for electrical wire jacket/insulation manufacturing. While he was attempting to remove excess material, a roll mill caught and partially amputated his right index finger.
An employee was working at the loading dock checking a pallet when she tripped over a load bar and fell, breaking her right hip (femur). She was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was flagging traffic to stop. When the first car stopped, a second car came around the first car, hit the employee, and kept going. Both of the employee's legs broke.
An employee was discovered at the docking bay with a laceration to his head.

Two employees were preparing to perform glazing work on the 16th and lower levels of a new construction project. The adjustable suspended scaffold failed for unknown reasons. Employee 2 was able to jump out of the basket, grab one of the supporting ropes and climb to the roof. Employee 1 fell approximately 100 ft. to the ground with the scaffold. Employee 1 sustained severe head and body trauma along with a fractured right leg.

An employee was chaining a seal on a piece of equipment. He was using a pry bar to lift the shaft so he could use his right index finger to put the seal in. The bar slipped and pinched/amputated his right index finger.

An employee was using a hoist to transfer a heat treat basket which was approximately 3 ft. by 4 ft. long from a staging rack to a conveyor. The basket was loaded with castings that go into the heat treat operation.  The employee detached the hoist and noticed the basket wasn't sitting flat on the cart.  As she manipulated the basket her right middle finger was pinched between the basket and the conveyor resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip with loss of fingernail and subsequent revision of the tip of the finger. Stitches were used to close the wound. No surgery was required.
An employee slipped and fell after losing his footing when climbing out of a crane cab. He fell into the handrail and broke his hip.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, installing wood boards at the eave of the building. The employee fell 15 feet while attempting to exit the scissor lift onto the roof surface, breaking ribs and suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee was loading patio doors into a tractor trailer when three patio doors shifted and struck/crushed the employee. The employee was hospitalized and exhibited paralysis below the chest line.
An employee was nailing siding to the wall when he fell 12 feet between the pump jack scaffold and the wall. He broke his femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a dolly of studs when he stepped between an exterior wall and the concrete floor. His leg dropped down to his knee and was bruised.
While removing gutters, and employee fell 4 to 5 feet from a ladder and hit his head on the concrete.
An employee was walking around to stretch his legs between shuttle runs. His left leg gave out and he fell to the ground, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was doing maintenance on a dough sheeter in the bakery department. The machine's housing was off at the time of the incident. His finger got caught between the chains and the housing, amputating the fingertip below the fingernail.
An employee was feeding bags into a pulley. When he hit the feed button, his finger was pulled up into the pulley, amputating his right index fingertip.
During general clean-up activities, the edger machine malfunctioned and cut boards began ejecting from it. An employee was struck in the back by one of the boards and sustained five broken ribs.

An employee was pulling merchandise and placing it on a cart. She stepped on a pallet to stack more merchandise on the cart and twisted her right ankle as she turned around and was coming off the pallet.

An employee was using a log splitter to split fire wood.  He placed a log in the holder and activated the hydraulic lever that operates the blade. His left hand was still holding the log at the time, and his left pinky fingertip was smashed.

On 10/06/2015, at approximately 5:40 p.m., an employee was looking for a box in the UPS truck. While exiting the vehicle, he fell inside, landed on his side, hit his head, and could not stand. He required surgery for a broken leg.

On October 6, 2015, at approximately 3:30 PM, an employee was helping a coworker roll a full linen rack into his truck. The employee was pushing the rack while the coworker was pulling, and the linen rack began to sway to the right. The employee reached over the right side of the rack and attempted to control it with his left hand. He was not able to stop the rack from swaying to the right. His left hand was on the outside right of the rack, and his right hand was placed on the middle bars of the rack. His left-hand finger got caught between the linen rack and a stationary rack that was to his right, amputating the left middle fingertip.
An employee was caring for a patient when the patient became irate. The patient scratched and bit the employee, resulting in an infection.
An employee was working at a facility that made precast concrete on machinery that pulled wire and his finger was pulled into the machine after it was started up amputating the tip of his finger.
An employee was walking downstairs at the workplace when he fell and hit his head on the concrete.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet through the roof to the ground while performing roofing work.
An employee was burned on the face and arm from a flash fire that occurred while changing the oil in a vehicle.

A delivery driver from another company delivered a tanker load of hot oil emulsion for asphalt to the facility.  The driver arrived onsite and hooked up a hose up from the tanker to the facility's pump.  The pump feeds the emulsion to a storage tank. The driver opened the valve on the tanker and turned on the pump. The driver did not open the valve leading to the storage tank. The pump started making loud noises.  The driver closed valve from the tanker.  A Midland Asphalt Materials, Inc. site employee came out of an office to hit the emergency stop switch for the pump.  At that time, the hose ruptured, spraying the two employees with the hot oil emulsion material.  The temperature of the hot oil emulsion material is approximately 320 degrees Fahrenheit. The Midland Asphalt Materials, Inc. employee sustained second degree burns to the face and hand.

An employee was cleaning equipment using the central vacuum hose. The hose was not working properly.  The employee tried to troubleshoot the issue and reached underneath the rotary feeder catching his finger on the blade and amputating the tip of his right index finger.
An employee attempted to push back the column in a brick cutter. The cutter swung around and cut his right hand, sustaining a possible amputation.

An employee was cutting a steel plate when a scrap piece fell and was lodged on the cutting table.  The employee attempted to remove the scrap plate with an overhead crane when the two hooks came loose and struck him in the chest and face. He sustained three fractured ribs, a collapsed right lung, and a nose laceration.
An employee fractured his hip when he fell down on the asphalt in the parking lot.
An employee climbing a fixed industrial roof ladder lost his balance on the upper landing and fell to the level below, injuring his ankle.
An employee was driving an electric cart with one leg outside of the cart and struck a pole breaking his left hip.
An employee fell off of a ladder and injured her back while attempting to fix a banner in the store window.

An employee was troubleshooting a lube pump on a press. He used his hand to determine the issue inside the lube tank, and the pump shaft come down on his finger.  His hand was trapped between the lower shaft that was broken, amputating his right middle fingertip.
An employee's right hand was amputated while rigging new hoisting cables on a crane.
An employee was picking up scraps between two CNC saw tables. One table was in operation and the two tables moved together pinching the employee's left thumb resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped when the ice cream machine he was moving became tangled in his shoe lace. The machine fell over and landed on his left hand, fracturing four fingers.
An employee fell from a makeshift scaffolding breaking the left ankle.
An employee was working on the rooftop, using a material hoist, when he was struck by the hoist. He fell onto and injured his back.
An employee was cutting 2x4's when his left hand came in contact with the blade of the chop saw, amputating two left fingers.

An employee was removing products from a conveyor belt when her hand got pulled into the conveyor. Her right middle fingertip was amputated above the first joint. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee caught his left arm in the puller as he was feeding parts into the machine. The employee's fingers were dislocated.
An employee was loading a pallet onto a jack when the jack moved backwards, pinning the employee's right leg against a rack. The employee sustained a leg laceration.

An employee was using an hydraulic pipe bender and was setting the pipe in place to bend when a coworker started the machine. The employee's finger got caught between the metal conduit and the yoke of the machine. His right-hand middle finger was amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee received a fingertip amputation when his right hand thumb got caught between the closing rod and latch of a dumpster.
An employee was pressure washing the roof of a three story building and fell off the roof breaking an arm and pelvis.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet from a roof.

Five employees were leaving the jobsite on an ATV designed for four passengers.  The ATV was traveling down a steep hill on a gravel road when it fishtailed and began to roll due to the steepness of the grade. Two employees who were not wearing seatbelts were ejected. One employee suffered two broken ribs and was hospitalized. The other employees were treated and released.
An employee was loading a forklift onto a skid when it rolled forward pinning him between the forklift and van causing severe bruising.
An employee was using a wrench to tighten a bolt on a baler. When the bolt broke loose, his right forearm struck the edge of his tool cart and fractured.
An employee tripped over a rubber mat in the produce section and fell fracturing the right hip and pelvis.
An employee fell 7-10 feet from a flatbed trailer while removing a tarp from a load of lumber and was hospitalized with a small fracture to the pelvis.
An employee was struck by the lever of a waste container while unloading it. The lever sprung out and struck the employee's face, fracturing the cheek bones and jaw bone.
An employee was unloading frozen fish from a vessel and got his hand caught in the cable of the vessel's winch and pulley. Two fingers were amputated as a result.
An employee suffered a broken right arm while trying to move a metal cabinet.

An employee in the fabrication shop was operating a tube saw and amputated her right thumb from the base of the nail bed to the tip when the guard crushed her thumb before she could get her hand out of the way.

On 10/07/2015 at approximately 3:30 PM, an employee was helping a Bobcat operator load a two piece steel barrier wall form onto the bed area of the knuckle boom truck. As the forms were being lowered into place, the tip of his right middle finger was smashed between the two forms pieces.
An employee was stepping over a barricade, tripped on his lanyard and fell approximately 2-3 feet to the floor. He suffered a broken right tibia that required surgery to repair.
An employee was working in the production area cutting pineapples with a knife and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured right wrist and skull fracture after falling off a 10-foot ladder.
An employee was pulling a pan out of the steamer and was burned on her head, face, chest, stomach, and upper arms by hot water.

An employee was mixing grout in a cement mixer. The machine was turned off. The employee reached into the mixer tub with his left hand to clean the grout off the mixer paddles and his right shoulder accidently struck the mixer's start lever. His left arm was caught in the machine and broken.
An employee had his left ring and small finger amputated when he placed his hand in the Horizontal Compression Machine (HCM) to clean the sensor that was located approximately 18" inside the machine.

Maintenance employees were using a forklift to lift a pallet jack to check the wheels. While the pallet jack was being lifted, the battery fell out and struck one of the employee's in the right leg fracturing it.

An employee was acting as a spotter while moving a freight of glass to keep the freight balanced.  The freight fell striking the employee on his right leg and breaking it in two places below the knee.
An employee tripped going up the steps and struck his head and knees on the concrete steps.

On 10/07/15 at approximately 10:10 pm, a Goodman employee was returning from break when he slipped on some oil on the floor in the coil department and fell. The employee has been admitted to the hospital for evaluation.

An employee was operating a portable grinder with a cup tool attachment to bevel the edge of a piece of pipe. The cup tool disintegrated and debris from the cup tool struck the left side of the employee's face. The employee was transported to hospital.
An employee became ill while at work and required hospitalization.
An employee was using air to blow out the line of a pump in the rending room when the air caused a pump plate to come loose and strike the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

An employee was setting up the site to begin work on a scaffold. When the employee got on the scaffold, the scaffold began to roll. It hit a hole in the floor and fell over. The employee also fell and the scaffold landed on top of him breaking the left leg.
An employee was in a bucket truck installing a lightning arrestor and was shocked.
An employee performing cutting operations with a torch suffered second degree burns to 6-7 percent of his leg after the slag and torch flame came into contact with his leg.
An employee suffered second degree burns to the left hand and side when hot chicken broth he was carrying spilled on him.

A bag machine operator was retrieving a bag that jammed the machine and severed the left index fingertip.  The bypass switch on the machine was activated. Once the switch is activated, the machine cycles one more time before it hits the home position and stops. The door was opened before the cycle completed and the star wheel pinched the tip of her left index finger, severing it just above the first knuckle. The incident occurred October 7, 2015 at approximately 9:35hrs.

On 10/7/15 at about 1:30a.m., an employee fell from a ladder attached to a tanker truck and broke his left hip and pelvis. The employee was transferring residue from Tanker 11 to Tanker 15 in the tanker pit. The employee was using the ladder attached to Tanker 11 to climb onto the tanker when he fell to the concrete floor.

On or about October 5, 2015, an employee was trying to free the door of a grain dump truck when the locking mechanism got stuck. Once the door was freed, it slammed on the employee's right middle finger. The right middle fingertip was amputated.
A rural letter carrier injured his knee while descending the steps at a residence. He was admitted to the hospital for surgery.

On or about October 7, 2015, an employee of Alpha Controls & Services, LLC was performing a service call at a client location and stepped on an unsecured sewage injection pit access panel that gave way. His right leg fell through the 16" x 18" x 24" floor opening, resulting in a groin injury requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was repositioning a gift shop display from inside the door to outside the door when the employee fell and broke the left hip.

An employee was picking frozen product from a freezer and placing it on a pallet. The employee was stuck by a coworker operating a lift truck, and his leg got pinned between the lift truck and the pallet. He suffered a lower left leg fracture, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of OSB with a circular saw and amputated his index finger.
An employee received burns to his hands from electrical shock while stripping off a neutral wire on a 277 volt system.  The employee was hospitalized as a result of his injuries.
An employee received crushing injuries to his left ankle when a 600 pound coil of steel fell while positioning the coil onto a forklift.
On October 7, 2015, an employee operating a floor buffer machine suffered a fingertip amputation when the pinky finger became caught between the machine handle and a door handle.
An employee was repairing a boiler unit and received electrical burns to the face and arms from an arc flash.

Employee 1 was working the night shift building trusses. Employee 2 was operating the roof press.  One end of the press table has gaps so that the truss can be pulled out.  Employee 1 went into the gap at the end of the table to pull a truss out and the employee's right thigh was caught between the gap in the table and the edge of the press when the press was activated.
An employee tripped and fell getting out of a transportation van, breaking both ankles.
An employee injured his leg when setting a floor tile.
An employee experienced a partial amputation of the left ring finger while working with another employee to knock out a pin with a sledgehammer.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move a piece of equipment into place when the piece fell and struck the employee's lower leg. The injury required surgery to repair.

A temporary worker employed as a material handler was standing in an aisle way at the distribution warehouse when a PIV came around the corner and ran into this employee, pinning him against the rack system.  The employee sustained severe compound fractures to the right foot.
A deli associate was doing evening clean up and moved a deli cart from its place next to the fryer to the triple sink with a hose.  The employee tripped over hose and fell breaking the left hip.
The employee was making a batch of metal powder in the reactor. He added acid and it foamed over burning his feet and shins.

An employee was cleaning out a knife gate. The equipment was turned off. While using an airline and nozzle to blow out material the airline hit the on/off switch and the gate was activated. The employee's thumb was crushed under the gate and amputated by the machine.

An employee was trying to change the spacer on a bar cut off saw. He reached back to the controls meaning to hit the "spacer toggle button" to adjust the spacer, but hit the "vice close button" instead which made the vice close onto the employee's left hand resulting in a partial amputation of the index and middle fingers.
An employee was removing plywood forms for concrete from beneath a highway overpass.  The lift bucket was side swiped by the trailer of a semi truck.  The employee suffered broken bones.
An employee was throwing trash into a dumpster when a guardrail gave way and he fell onto the trailer injuring his back.
An employee sliced the top of the pointer finger while using a power saw to cut wood. The employee was treated in the emergency room, but was not admitted.
An employee was hospitalized after his right index finger was cut to the bone while operating a table saw to cut a particle board.
An employee amputated his right pinky finger while troubleshooting the air handling units in the mechanical room.
An employee was organizing the stock room and bumped his elbow on a stack of wooden pallets. The elbow later became infected and the employee was hospitalized.

On October 8, 2015, at approximately 12:00 noon, a Georgia Pacific Wood Products employee was performing maintenance on the Number 1 Lathe. The employee was welding with a Lincoln welding machine when his shirt caught on fire. The employee was wearing FR clothing.  The fire watch immediately started spraying water on the employee as the employee laid down in an attempt to smother the flames. The employee suffered second degree burns under his left arm and his left torso area.
An employee was manually setting a post driver on the ground and caught their right index finger between the post driver and the hammer resulting in amputation.
An employee was working from a scaffold next to and surrounding a semi trailer. The employee fell about 13-15 feet to the floor between the scaffold and the trailer sustaining head and back injuries.

An employee was spotting for another employee who was loading a tile installation plow onto a trailer. The spotter was struck by the back filler brace when it broke off and fell from the plow. The spotter suffered a skull fracture and upper back injury.

An employee was painting on the roof of a building and fell approximately 20 feet through a skylight.  The employee was hospitalized.  The incident happened at approximately 1:45pm on October 8, 2015.
An employee received a partial amputation to the left pinky finger just below the nail bed after the finger was crushed by a closing door.
An employee was clearing a jam on the bucket condenser when the wheel crushed his fingers in between two metal pieces resulting in the amputation of the index and middle fingers on the right hand.

Employee 1 was helping Employee 2 weld a flange to a pipe. Employee 1 was holding a 20" diameter, 2" thick flange in place for Employee 2. The flange was held up by a pipe jack.  The flange slipped and Employee 1's fingers were caught between the flange and the pipe jack.  His right middle finger was amputated between the first and second joint and his ring finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was walking across the kitchen floor, slipped, and stepped into a hot oil filter sustaining second and third degree burns to the foot.
A city postal carrier was chased by a dog while delivering mail. The employee ran into the street and fell, striking his head on the ground. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

On October 8, 2015, at approximately 12:45pm, an employee was operating an ATV when it began to slide on gravel. The ATV went over an embankment and rolled approximately 100 feet. The employee fell out of the ATV and suffered a fracture to his right ankle.

An employee was operating a "roto claw" meat processing machine when a meat hook fell into the machine. The employee reached into the machine to retrieve the hook which resulted in the amputation of the employee's right hand pinky finger and injuries to the employee's right hand ring finger.
While straightening a piece of metal using the piranha press, an employee amputated part of a finger.
An employee was erecting a scaffold and fell 10 feet lacerating their spleen.
An employee was descending a 16 foot extension ladder and fell six feet to the ground resulting in a lower back injury.

An employee was assisting his co-worker to brace the products (35 inches high by 29 inches wide by 120 inches long) on the forklift. The forklift driver set the double pallet of reinforcement material on to the floor and the forklift backed out. Part of the bottom pallet on the left side broke and the materials started to wobble. The injured employee tried to stabilize it, but part of the top pallet fell on his chest causing him to fall down. As he was bracing his fall, he fractured his left wrist.
The employee was putting sticks onto a conveyor belt when his right hand and arm got caught in the conveyor resulting in three broken fingers, a fractured wrist and abrasions on the arm.

An employee was operating a tie down machine in shock packaging. The employee was adjusting a tie strap while the tie down machine was cycling. The employee's finger was caught between the pusher head of the pneumatic tie down machine and the splatter washer resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee fell 6-11 feet.
An employee was attacked by a dog while delivering a package and fell off the steps. The employee fractured the left arm and was hospitalized.

An employee had been working for the company for a couple of weeks on a commercial construction site as an apprentice carpenter. The employee was experiencing elbow soreness and went to the local hospital. The employee was admitted to the hospital due to a staph infection in the left elbow.
On October 9, 2015, an employee amputated his left index finger to the first knuckle when he was working with an auto-threader machine in the shop.
An employee was working on a tin roof. The employee stepped off the roof onto an overhang. The overhand collapsed and the employee fell breaking the right hip, arm, tail bone and ribs.
An employee stepped on a sample hole causing him to fall and injure the left ankle. The injury required surgery.

The company was having a United Way rally which was done once per year. They were performing a treasure hunt and the employee was going from one station to another. As the employee crossed the gravel parking lot, the employee slipped and fell breaking the right wrist.
An employee was struck by a portable electromagnetic drill press and suffered a severe laceration.  This injury later required a partial amputation of the finger.
An employee amputated a fingertip while shutting the safety gate to the cardboard compactor.
An employee was making deliveries and was found in the back of the delivery truck with a head wound. The employee was admitted to the hospital and received stitches.
An employee walking through the salad production area tripped over product on the floor and fell fracturing the right leg.
An employee was servicing a mold when a piece of mold fell onto the employee's arm. The employee received an abrasion to the right forearm.
Two employees were lowering a gun safe weighing 805 lbs. onto a cart on the customer's trailer. An employee caught their left index finger between the cart and the safe resulting in amputation.
An employee was closing a 480 volt disconnect switch when it arc flashed and caused third degree burns to the right hand and first degree burns to the face.
An employee was struck by a light pole during an excavation operation resulting in a back injury.
An employee fell approximately 8-10 feet from a ladder.
An employee was counting bags on a conveyor and caught the left ring finger in the conveyor system resulting in the removal of the fingertip including the nail with no bone damage.
An employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation when the finger was caught inside a material bin/hopper.
Employee suffered a fractured neck after falling from the back of truck and landing on the head.

On October 9, 2015, a shuttle driver fell out of a moving vehicle while attempting to rid the vehicle of a bug.  No seat belt was worn at the time.  The employee suffered a contusion to the right leg that required a medical procedure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting fillers with a radial arm saw and amputated the tip of the right index finger.

An employee slipped on the plastic backing/laminate of a peel and stick underlayment near the roof edge and fell 23 feet off the roof resulting in broken ribs. The employees were evacuating the roof due to a storm.

On Saturday 10/10/15 at approximately 5:00 AM, an employee's hand slid underneath a fixed guard at the Department 5540 Pleater. The employee's left index finger made contact with a belt and was pulled into a roller resulting in injury.  Medical provider's diagnosis is that of a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was working by a sheeter roll and was using a wedge so it wouldn't move.  When he placed the wedge, the roll moved and it pinched his fingers.  The roll weighs 2,000 lbs.  The hand specialist had to amputate the right middle fingertip.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a battery operated circular saw. The blade got stuck in the wood and kicked back lacerating three fingers on the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing a Toyota trailer for transportation by placing placards on the trailer.  A coworker was in the tractor cab waiting for the employee to finish preparing the trailer for transport.  The parking brake on the tractor truck was not set.  The tractor truck rolled back and pinned the employee between the trailer and tractor truck.  The injured employee was facing away from the tractor truck at the time of the incident.  The injured employee suffered crushing injuries to the midsection, ribs, and kidneys.

Employee was driving a combat ASV vehicle form a dock area to a staging area.  The vehicle has a hatch.  When the employee was exiting the vehicle, he hit the button to close the hatch.  He pinched his finger in the locking mechanism resulting in the loss of the right ring fingertip.
An employee got his left ring finger caught between a belt and pulley while conducting maintenance on the vacuum fan.  When he jerk his hand out, the skin and nail pulled off the finger to the bone.
An employee was working on an electric motor to get it going. When the motor started, his left thumb tip was amputated by the belt of the motor.
An employee fell through a hole in the 3rd floor to the 2nd floor and landed onto a set of chicken cages.  The employee broke two ribs and sustained a fracture in the upper neck.
One employee was hospitalized after falling 25 feet inside a boiler at a power plant.  The incident occurred on October 10th at approximately 7:45 am.
An employee was rigging a load to be elevated by a crane. He tripped and fell when his feet were pulled out from under him by the tag line. He suffered a fractured left hip.

An employee was rushing through the automatic doors while they were closing causing her to trip and fall. The fall resulted in a fracture of the right humerus. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee got both hands caught into a series of rotating chains and sprockets resulting into the amputation of four fingers on his left hand and the tips of three fingers on his right hand.

A sanitation employee was working on a steel ladder cleaning the outside of a conveyor frame.
