The injured employee was transported to the hospital for treatment.
An employee suffered a head and back injury when kicked by a patient.
An employee was operating a tug and taking baggage to an aircraft. The employee swerved to avoid another employee in the area and crushed their left foot between a post and the tug.
An employee fell off the peanut trailer ladder while a taking moisture reading and broke his left foot/ankle.
An employee was lining up two dies and caught their right index finger in the upper die resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting potatoes and pumpkins during the day.
An employee was trying to line up a symmetrical pump in a pit. The pump dropped on both hands causing severe lacerations to both hands and a partial left finger amputation.
An employee was running wood through the gang saw and amputated the pinky and ring fingers on the right hand to the knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor suffering a head injury.
Employees were passing sheet rock from the first floor to the second floor. The injured employee stepped off of the stack of sheet rock and fell breaking the right leg.
An employee was operating a mag drill when his sleeve got caught in the drill causing injury to his left forearm.  He was working in the maintenance department.
An employee was walking in the warehouse and fell breaking the lower left leg.
An employee was changing the filter on a hot water system. The employee loosened the water filter cover and was burned on the chest, back and arms by hot water.

On 10/12/2015 at approximately 2:30pm, an employee was working on a table saw with an attachment called the magic molder. The piece of wood kicked back and his left hand got caught by the table saw blade cutting his ring and middle fingers (no amputation). The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An Ironworker was tying rebar 8 feet above ground. He hooked the rebar onto a wall with a hook and then leaned back and the wall hook slid off the rebar and the ironworker fell backwards approximately 8 feet to the crushed gravel ground injuring the right leg.
An employee was working in the OCA department attempting to light the OCA furnace with a butane lighter. There was a suspected gas leak that ignited and burned the employee's right arm.
An employee tripped on a hand tool electrical cord and fell to the ground causing  a right hip fracture.
An employee amputated the right ring finger when clearing a jam on the bottling machine.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell while providing rehab therapy to a patient. The employee fractured their right wrist.

An employee was moving a toolbox on wheels to set up for his shift. It struck a stationary toolbox and the two handles were close enough in height that the employee's left middle finger was pinched off between the two handles. As part of the surgical repair the distal phalange was removed in order to accommodate the formation of a dermal flap.
An employee fell while walking on racking on 10/12/2015 at approximately 9:00 am.
An employee was hospitalized for a fractured C2 vertebrae when he fell from the bottom step of a front-end loader.
An employee received electrical burns to his forehead when he leaned into a live electrical box and contacted the 480V electrical panel.

An employee was operating a crimper machine. While the employee was putting a metal holder piece in place, the machine somehow activated, causing the ram to engage.  The employee's right hand was caught between the ram and the machine deck. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of broken bones in the right hand.
An employee was performing roof repair work and fell off the roof. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones due to the fall.

A maintenance employee was performing work on the Slingshot ride when the carriage unexpectedly ascended and carried the employee into the air approximately 15 feet.  The employee fell to the ground and suffered two broken ankles requiring hospitalization.

An employee was scooping ice pellets from the APC machine while it was running and the press came down and caught his right ring finger amputating it above the 1st joint near the base of the fingernail bed.
An employee fell 36 inches off a pallet of shingles resulting in a fractured ankle that required hospitalization.

An employee of the McKinney Drilling Company, LLC, got his right foot caught under the bucket of the Bobcat loading machine. The employee was hospitalized with laceration to the soft tissues and damage to his ligaments.
An employee was moving a motorized pallet to a charging station and slipped crushing his foot between two pallets.
An employee was opening the wing gate on an asphalt laydown machine and his right leg was caught in the elevator amputating it above the knee.

On October 12, 2015, at approximately 1:30am, an employee suffered the amputation of his left arm (up to the shoulder) after it became caught in the bridle roller, a power unit that moves the strip of metal at 300 feet per minute, while the employee was troubleshooting it.  A guard was removed and the line lock procedure was not used.
An employee got his right hand caught in the brush that was feeding into the chipper. His right hand went into the feed wheel and was amputated above the wrist.
An employee fell 16-18 feet from an extension ladder and broke both wrists. The employee suffered head lacerations and two torn ligaments in the neck as well.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of plywood and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized after falling backwards off a 3-foot platform fracturing the L2, L3, and L4 vertebrae.
An employee fell from an drilling derrick while in the process of disassembling the unit.  The employee suffered injuries to the head, face and right leg as a result of the fall.
An employee had the flesh removed from the bottom of his right middle finger while using an unguarded table router.
An employee was cleaning metal tooling. The tooling slipped and fell onto the employee's fingers amputating the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was removing a sticky matt in front of an elevator when he was stung by a wasp inside the building.
An employee's hand was caught under the grinding wheel of a surface grinder resulting in a left middle finger avulsion. The fingertip was later amputated.
A maintenance employee fell from the top of a school bus while attempting to remove a strobe light fixture from the top of the bus. The employee fractured the right hip.
An employee was operating a chain saw cutting an 8x8 timber when the saw kicked back and hit him in the left side of his chest. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a gas power chop saw cutting concrete. When the gas cap came off, the chop saw caught on fire. Gas splashed onto the employee and the employee suffered second and third degree burns to his legs, back, stomach, and arms.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet as he stepped from a ladder to a platform breaking his ankle that required surgery and hospitalization to repair.
An employee tripped on a fatigue mat, fell, and struck her forehead causing a concussion and hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized with a severe hand injury involving nerve damage after slipping and falling from a branch while attempting to cut down a tree.

An employee was cleaning the powder filler machine. In the process, a conveyor belt pulled in the cloth she was using to wipe down the machine and the tip of her middle right hand finger was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was troubleshooting a form fill and seal machine. When the machine inadvertently cycled, the employee's right index finger was amputated above the first joint.
An employee was stocking merchandise and fell from a six foot step ladder sustaining head injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was wire brushing the interior of the #1 recovery boiler's forced draft fan duct. He lost his footing, the fan blades moved, and he fell into the duct. He fell approximately 25 feet to the 10th level of the boiler. He suffered a compound fracture of the right leg and dislocated the right shoulder and elbow.
An employee was pulling telecommunication wiring and suffered a hernia.
An employee working on the taxi way lights in the air field at O'Hare Airport was hospitalized overnight when incurring electric shock through his hands while working on cables.
An employee was loading mattresses on the roller pack machine and got caught in the machine resulting in head and back injuries.
The crew was erecting a scaffold. On his way up the scaffolding, an employee slipped and fell landing on the concrete floor below and inuring a leg.

An employee was working on a 32" hydroform. The piston had been removed from the equipment. The collar on the center piston slide down and caught the employee's right hand injuring the index finger. It was later amputated at the hospital.
An employee fell or jumped off a truck at the loading dock and broke the left leg.

An employee was adjusting a wood molder machine. The employee opened the hood and climbed onto the molding machine partially supporting his body on his right knee and arm. His hand slipped and contacted the machine's "knife" amputating the right hand's middle finger distal phalange.
An employee sustained a laceration to the hand while cleaning the drywall finisher sprayer.
An employee was performing maintenance on a horizontal press. The employee tripped and struck his head on a metal die causing a fracture to the 5th vertebrae.

On 10/13/15 at approximately 10:00 AM a technician was performing maintenance on a customer's oil burner which is powered by 10,000 volts. The furnace was powered up again by mistake and resulted in the technician receiving an electric shock. The technician was admitted to the hospital with burn injuries.

An employee was on the bow of a tug boat on the Mississippi River cleaning the cutter head. A large boat passed by causing a wave. The employee put his hand on the bit to catch his balance. The boat rocked up and his right pinky finger was smashed between the bit and the cutter head resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking across the drive and was struck by a truck resulting in neck and back trauma.
An employee was using a hoist to move a 200 lb. bar. The bar dropped from the hoist and landed on the employee's left large toe resulting in the removal of a small portion of the toe.
An employee was hospitalized for inhalation hazards.
The employee was driving a company vehicle and making a left-hand turn when he was rear-ended by another vehicle. The employee was transported to the hospital with neck and back injuries.

An employee noticed that a plastic bottle of shampoo had fallen over on the conveyor belt because it was missing the cap. The employee thought he had hit the stop button to shutdown the conveyor belt in order to grab the fallen shampoo bottle, but he didn't thereby his right index finger got caught between the chain and the sprocket. This resulted in the amputation of the fleshy tip of his right index finger.
A conex was being loaded onto a rollback truck. At that time, the rollback bed struck the employee and fractured his femur requiring surgery.
An employee amputated three fingers on the right hand while operating the mixer.
An employee fractured her finger while unjamming the quarter machine.
An employee pinched his right ring finger between a chunk of refractory and a conveyor resulting in the amputation of the right ring fingertip.
A client threw a fire extinguisher at an employee. A second employee attempted to block it and got hit by the fire extinguisher, sustaining a back injury. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the basement when he tripped over a sewer grate and fell resulting in five fractured ribs and shoulder tissue damage.

An employee was working on an inspection table when he got his left hand caught in the moving parts of a chain and sprocket assembly. The employee's left middle finger was broken and required stitches. He was admitted for treatment at a local hospital.

An employee was checking for gasket pieces in the production line with a metal detector. The machine did not have LOTO and the safety guard had been removed at the time of the incident. The employee's fingers got caught in the machine. The third finger on the right hand was amputated at the middle of the distal phalanx and the fourth finger was avulsed at the distal tip.
An employee suffered the amputation of the large and second toe on the left foot when the trailer separated from the tracker and fell onto the employee's left foot.
An employee suffered an inguinal hernia requiring surgical repair after tightening a bolt with a small wrench.

An employee was operating a plasma cutting CNC machine in auto cut mode. The employee attempted to remove cut pieces of metal from the cutting table. The table struck the employee causing their foot to get caught on a floor grate resulting in a fractured right ankle.

The employee was pulling a safety pin out of an outrigger on the telebelt and had his finger pinched in the outrigger. The employee sustained a flesh amputation to the fingertip of the right hand middle finger.
On October 14, 2015, an employee was shoveling asphalt from a dump truck when the employee slipped and their left hand contacted the hot asphalt resulting in burns to the middle and pinky fingers.
An employee was on his horse moving 12 head of cattle. A cow charged him and struck the employee's leg. The employee fell off his horse and fractured the right hip and femur.
An employee was delivering mail and caught their right pinky finger in the vehicle door resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was kneeling down and felt pain in his knee. His knee was infected, possibly due to a previous kneeling incident where a foreign body was injected into his left knee.
On 10/14/2015, about 8:30pm, an employee was injured on his abdomen by pressurized fluids from an oil well when the coil tubing burst. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a 3 foot ladder in a retail store when she missed a step and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized overnight with a possible knee fracture.
An employee was removing the side quarter glass on a customer's SUV. The glass fell onto the employee's leg and the hard plastic molding on the glass lacerated the employee's leg.

An employee was selecting cases in the freezer area while driving a long jack. As he stepped off the long jack, he was still holding the accelerator and pinned himself between a rack and the long jack resulting in fractured ribs and a laceration to the lungs.
An employee was under a house checking the propane line for leaks. While he was under the house he was bitten by a snake.
An employee was operating a reach truck. When he stepped off the truck to pick up a fallen box, an order selector (cherry picker) ran over his right foot.
A crane operator caught his right middle finger between two "I" beams while repositioning the beans using a gantry crane. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a ladder to paint the side of a townhouse. The ladder slipped out and the employee fell to the pavement below fracturing both wrists.

An employee was removing a 14 foot jack in a parking garage by releasing clamps on the top and the bottom.  While the employee was releasing the bottom clamp, the top clamp that was previously loosened fell and caught his finger between the top clamp and the back. The left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was returning from break and fell, fracturing the right knee.
An employee was admitted into the hospital for severe dehydration.
An employee suffered leg injuries when a backhoe ran over his leg.
An employee fell five feet from the edge of the scalder.  Fall protection was not used at the time of the incident.
An employee was setting up a lathe. A part fell and his hand was caught between the part and the chuck lathe severely lacerating the middle and ring fingers on the right hand.
An employee was in training to use a metal stamp machine when his left hand got caught in the machine crushing the left ring finger.
An employee was working with a pipe rolling machine and got their left hand caught in a roller resulting in the amputation of the ring finger.

An employee was cleaning sludge from the storm water/spill collection sump at the tanker unload area. He was attempting to return a section of heavy metal grate back into the operational position when he amputated his fingertip.
An employee was standing on the bottom rung of a four foot ladder using a pneumatic sander on the bottom of a fiberglass swimming pool and fell, striking his left hip on a five gallon bucket.

On or about October 14, 2015, at 5:15 am the employee opened the back of the truck and mis-stepped into the six-inch gap between the loading dock and the back of the truck. His left leg plunged into the gap up to his thigh. He was hospitalized for observation and care of a deep left thigh contusion.

An employee was operating a saw to cut pieces of wood. The employee reached in to get a piece of wood out and stepped on the peddle, activating the saw and amputating the tip of the second finger on the left hand.
An employee was pushing a heavy flatbed cart and pinched their fingers between the cart and the door bracket severing the tip of a finger at the first knuckle.
While descending the scaffold ladder, an employee lost his footing and fell 12 to 15 feet to the ground breaking his left leg, right heel and left wrist.

An employee was working on the caser line in the packaging area adjusting the caser machine. In the process of moving away from the caser machine, the employee was knocked down by an oncoming forklift delivering a load of materials in the packaging area. The employee hit his head on the concrete floor and was hospitalized for a fractured skull and bleeding in the brain.
A roofing employee slipped and fell from a 12 foot ladder resulting in internal injuries and possible fractures.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet sustaining unknown injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming tree branches from a ladder, lost his balance, and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, fracturing his right-side ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a desk picking recycled contaminants off a block of bale, when she bent down and was struck by a block of bale. She sustained a fractured left leg and pelvis.
An employee was using a manual crimping tool to bend scrap coils. While using an upward pulling motion to crimp the clip, he felt pain in his abdomen and suffered a right-side abdominal hernia.
An employee's arm got tangled in tarp as he tried to keep it tightly rolled in the tarp equipment's roller. Both bones in his left forearm were fractured.
An employee was clearing a jam on the tack machine and fractured the right thumb.

On 10/15/2015 at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was performing maintenance work on a milk-filling machine when his right index finger got caught on the machine belt. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to re-attach his right index fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell while getting out of the powered industrial truck.
A maintenance employee amputated his right fingertip while operating a bagging machine.
While an employee was getting out of a car, the car door slammed on and partially amputated the employee's pinky.

A trackhoe operator was cleaning out the bed of a Kenworth Tri-axle dump truck.  The dump bed was raised and the trackhoe was scraping material out of the bed.  The injured employee approached the dump truck while this was occurring and proceeded to stick his head in between the dump bed and the swing gate to see inside. The excavator made contact with the bed and caused the swing gate to move, catching the injured employee's head between the truck bed and the swing gate.  He was admitted to the hospital with a fractured skull.

An employee was situating a ladder to dust the window ledge and wash the windows. While attempting to center his feet on the ladder rung, he lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet, fracturing his right pelvis.
An employee was accessing a safe in the cash office to get deposits. While closing the door to the safe, his finger got caught, amputating his left index fingertip near the first knuckle.
An employee was descending a staircase. When he reached the landing, he blacked out and fell 10 feet to the concrete floor below, breaking his hip and fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was inside a box truck unloading plants. He missed his step and fell 4 feet off of the truck to the dirt ground. He broke his cheek bone, clavicle bone, and several ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lowering the gate on a baler when the fifth digit on her left hand got crushed, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was sprayed by baby food product and metal while checking for clogs in the system line, sustaining burns on the right hand, right forearm, chest, and upper lip. The baby food product was approximately 200 degrees.

An employee was cleaning a transfer belt when his hand got caught between the belt and the drive roller. He was hospitalized with severe injuries to the second, third, and fourth digits on his right hand.
An employee was welding with a cutting torch when a piece of hot slag landed on his shirt, which caught on fire. He suffered third degree burns to his left arm, hand, shoulder, and torso.

An employee was putting air into a tire and having trouble getting the tire bead to seal. The employee put a rag in between the rim and tire to assist the seal. When the employee went to remove the rag, the tire sealed and caught his right index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was covering a manhole with a manhole cover. The manhole cover flipped up on top of the employee's right foot, breaking four bones.

An employee was working on the dry grocery side of the warehouse. The employee came around the corner while riding a stand up forklift and ran into the forks of another forklift. A fork from the forklift punctured his foot.
An employee was performing maintenance on a mobile belt system when his fingers were pulled into the conveyor belt, cutting and tearing the tendon on his middle right middle finger.

An employee was performing maintenance on a slit line using an Allen wrench. The slit line suddenly energized and a clamp came down, pinching and bruising both of the employee's forearms. LOTO was not performed at the time of the incident.
An employee walking on a vinyl floor in the office tripped and fell, breaking the right tibia and fibula bones. The employee required surgery and overnight hospitalization.

On 10/15/2015, at about 12:00 p.m., an employee was climbing a 12-foot fiberglass ladder. When he reached approximately 10 feet, he fell to the ground. He injured his knee and the right side of his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting meat when his right-hand thumb tip contacted the blade of the band saw and was amputated.
An employee was welding a beam during steel erection activities for a commercial building. The employee's knee got caught between the boom net and a beam.
An employee was struck by an automobile while gathering carts in the parking lot. The employee suffered severe leg injuries and bleeding on the brain.
An employee was performing a walk around visual inspection of the crusher recycler when he tripped on a piece of rebar and fell hard on his left hip and forearm. His hip broke and required surgery.
An employee was cleaning equipment with a water hose and got a hand caught in the potato line auger. The right hand was amputated.
An employee raised a platform scale out of the framework.  The scale fell on the employee's hand and amputated the left thumb.
A machine stopped feeding. The employee reached into the machine and amputated three fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.

The elevator lifting a 30 foot long pipe at an oil well shifted causing the bottom of the pipe to strike an employee in the back. This employee then fell against a second employee pushing the tongs into his face and causing employee 2 to fall and strike his head against the guardrail. Employee 2 was knocked unconscious for several seconds and was hospitalized with a fracture of the bottom orbital bone below the left eye.
The employee was trying to clear a paper jam in the machine and caught his finger in the chain and sprocket resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hospitalized with an broken wrist after slipping on some water on the floor and falling in the produce department.
An employee was operating a loaded pallet jack and caught their leg between the pallet jack and the railing at the loading dock, fracturing it.

An employee was reassembling and calibrating  the Cherry Burrell Machine and leaned under the machine while it was running.  The employee's hand slipped into the point of operation amputating the right hand index fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized for injuries sustained while fighting a vehicle fire in a commercial parking garage. The employee suffered smoke inhalation.

An employee was clearing a pipe line using nitrogen to pressure the line. The employee disconnected the nitrogen line, which was not clear or de-pressured at the time. Product sprayed out on the employee, causing first and second degree burns to the left side of the employee's head, the left arm, and both legs from the knees down.
While changing a machine die, an employee's left index finger got caught between the hydraulic clamp and cylinder, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee's right index and second finger were caught under the ram of a mechanical power press.
The employee slipped on the job while wearing shoe coverings and fell breaking her wrist.
An employee was welding on a heater. While exiting the heater, he stepped on a beam and his foot got stuck in his safety harness. He fell on his right knee and fractured his tibia.
Two employees were engaged in horseplay and one employee was knocked to the ground, suffering a left femur fracture.
An employee securing a piece of trim from a ladder in an automated car wash missed a rung and fell off the ladder resulting in admission to a hospital for a broken hip and surgery.
An employee fell 6' from a concrete pumping boom to the ground fracturing his left wrist and suffering a head laceration and bruising.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground while climbing a stepladder, breaking his clavicle and sustaining bruises and lacerations.

On 10/16/15 an employee removed the guarding from the chain on a fan fold machine while the machine was running. The employee was attempting to replace the chain after the chain had come off the machine. The employee got his fingers caught in the machine. On 10/19/15 the employee had surgery for a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was hospitalized for chemical burn to the eyes.
An employee injured the T10 and T11 discs after tripping on a trash bucket and fatigue mat and falling against a table.

On October 16, 2015, around 11:00 AM, an employee was trying to untie a knot in a mule line when he was electric shocked and suffered electrical burns to the left ring and pinky fingers and the left knee. He was hospitalized.

On Friday, October 16, an employee was preparing to lower the drill bar from the rest of the drilling machine. The bar separated from the tool that was holding it and fell on the employee. He sustained four fractured ribs and a blow to the right side of his face and left shoulder.
The company was logging a forest track (land) of nearly 100 acres when an employee was run over by an empty tractor trailer. The employee suffered eleven broken ribs and a fractured hip and pelvis.
An employee was lifting equipment (flat top for grill) during cleaning activities. The equipment was placed down on his finger, cutting his fingertip.
On or about October 16, 2016, while operating the feather press machine, the employee's foot was smashed.
A temporary employee was hospitalized after shooting himself in the left foot/ankle with a nail gun.

A mold operator was hospitalized when he fractured his pelvis during a fall. The injured employee along with another employee was emptying a bin (30 gallon waste container) into a Gaylord box (1 yard cardboard box), which rests on top of a 6 inch riser. It is believed that the employee's toe became trapped underneath the riser and when the employee turned around after placing the bin on the riser he fell and landed on his hip causing the left side pelvic fracture.
A temporary employee was working on a scaffold approximately three feet above the ground when he fell off the side and broke his the radius and ulna on the right arm and the radius on the left arm.

On or about October 17, 2015, an employee walking the plant was struck on the hard hat by a hose that was dropped by another subcontractor. The injured employee was admitted to the hospital for back pain.

An employee was installing a 24V DC transformer inside a control panel with 480V wires.  During this process,  an arc flash occurred that caused second degree burns to the employee's hands and face.  The employee was hospitalized.
On October 17, 2015, an employee was operating a table saw to cut decorative strips of metal and cut his right thumb. He was admitted to the hospital and had surgery the next day.
An employee was inside an M-1 Tank. He pulled himself up through the turret and pinched his fingertip in a metal joint on the headrest.
An employee was removing a sheet of veneer from the top deck of the dry out-feed conveyor when a second sheet of veneer fell and lodged in the employee's right forearm.
An employee was pushing down on a table and injured their back.  While attempting to stretch it out the employee felt a pop.
An employee fell from a ladder and broke a hip.
A machine operator tripped over the floor-mounted automated palletizer sensor and fell striking his head on the palletizer machine.
An employee was using a saw to cut lumber and amputated a finger.

An employee was working to undo forms around a casting area using a gantry crane. The employee was holding on to the cables at the main block as the crane was raised and caught his fingers between the cables and the pulley causing an amputation of his pinky fingertip and a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was walking, caught her shoe in the carpet and fell suffering a back injury. She was admitted to the hospital.
A temporary employee had his left hand middle finger amputated while using a cut-off saw to cut up scrap OSB on or about October 17, 2015.
An employee was walking to the cash register and fell breaking the right leg and hip.

On October 18, 2015, an employee was mopping the stairs of a double landing staircase to the second floor. The employee was found laying on the first landing. The employee is hospitalized with a severe head injury and possible broken neck.
An employee twisted and broke his ankle while investigating the odor of smoke coming from the facility's basement.

An employee was moving a pallet with a forklift. The pallet was attached to the forklift with a chain. The employee tried to manually move the chain when the forklift rolled and pinched his fingers between the chain the vertical upright. His pinky finger was amputated.

On or about 10/18/2015 an employee was attempting to clear a jam in a parcel bundling machine and climbed on top of a rolling wire cage container approximately 41" high x 48" long x 40" wide.  The employee slipped from the cage and fell to the floor fracturing their ribs and collarbone.

On or about 10/18/2015, an employee was running an electrical conduit in the attic. When the employee went to get a level, the employee fell through the attic access to the ground and injured their lower back.
An employee was operating a commercial dishwasher.  While inserting a dish rack her gloved finger was caught or pinched and the tip of the left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee amputated two fingertips, pinched a third finger, and fractured a finger on the right hand while cleaning ink off print rollers on a machine that had not been shut off and isolated.

On October 19, 2015, at about 11:00 a.m., an employee was on a step ladder installing drywall with a drill driver. He fell off the ladder to the concrete floor and broke his right arm. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was operating a dump truck in the orange grove. The truck was loaded with shell rock to be dumped to grade a road. Upon lifting the bed, contact was made with an overhead power line. Upon exiting the truck the employee was shocked and received electrical burns to the left arm and foot.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was aligning and storing rack vertical components by hand. His left middle fingertip got caught between two rack foot plates; it was crushed and amputated (distal phalanx, part of nail).

An employee was looking into a hopper containing molten plastic to determine why the hopper was not running smoothly. Molten plastic backed up onto the employee's hands, burning them and requiring surgery.
An employee was involved in a motor vehicle accident while on the job and driving a company vehicle.

An employee observed two individuals behind a building that appeared to be fighting. The employee approached the individuals and questioned what was going on; he then told them that he was going to call SAPD.  One of the individuals knocked the phone out of his hand, and then both individuals attacked him. He was hospitalized.

An employee was passing instruments to the surgeon during a surgical procedure. The employee was turning around to the operating table to retrieve an instrument for the doctor when she tripped on the doctor's foot.  She fell to the floor on her left side, fracturing her left shoulder and left hip.
An employee fell from a ladder and broke a leg.

An employee was attempting to align the hydraulic mast tilt cylinder on a forklift so he could insert the locking pin. His finger was in the pin hole while he instructed the forklift operator to lower the hydraulic mast so the pin hole would line up and the pin could be inserted. He suffered a partial amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was clearing a jam in a plastic grinder while the machine was running and three fingers were amputated.  The machine was not locked out.

An employee was cleaning ride-on trowel equipment. As he was taking the clip-on pan out of the ride-on trowel, the round pan (48 inches in diameter; 25 pounds) fell on his right leg and broke his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee's hand got caught in a bottle molding machine during cleaning activities.
An employee was cutting meat in the meat department when his right hand ring fingertip contacted the band-saw blade and was amputated.

An employee was cleaning a 2-gallon tea urn. He picked it up and attempted to pour it out. Some hot liquid made contact with his left forearm, resulting in second degree burns. 

He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a 22-foot wall using a 30-foot ladder. The ladder hooks were not latched at the time, causing the ladder to slide. The employee fell approximately 16 feet and landed on a sand pile.  The employee's lower right leg broke, requiring surgery.
An employee was felling a tree when the cut tree fell, rebounded, and struck the employee in the left leg, causing a leg contusion.

An employee was pushing a dumpster into an enclosure. A gust of wind caught the enclosure door and slammed the door into the dumpster catching the employee's left hand middle finger resulting in amputation.

On 10/19/2015 at or around 11:15 a.m. a temporary employee was struck by a garbage truck and pinned between a utility pole and the rear bumper of the truck. The employee then fell off the rear of the truck. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
An employee working from a swing stage scaffold was struck in the head by the counterweights of a winch that was being used to hoist mud/stucco inside 5 gallon buckets.
An employee working on the shipping line conveyor got his right hand caught in the conveyor belt pulley amputating the tip of his fifth digit.

The freight elevator door was left open, which causes a buzzing sound (alarm). The employee walked over and attempted to close the door to stop the alarm. As she pulled the metal door down, the door caught and amputated her left index fingertip.

An employee operating a standup powered industrial vehicle (PIV) was backing out of an aisle into the main aisle. He struck a pole at the end of the storage rack, and his left leg got crushed between the lift truck and the pole.
An employee's leg was caught in a conveyor.
On or about October 19, 2015, an employee's left-hand index finger was amputated by the chain of a red iron chain conveyor. The employee was hospitalized.

In the planner area, an employee was piling lumber that was being transported by a lumber chain.  One of the chains became jammed.  The employee reached between the chain way because the chains were doubled over. Energy was stored in the gear box due to the jam. The employee manually tugged the belt associated with the belt/pulley mechanism for the 2 hp motor and gear box.  The motor/gear box drives the chains.  When the employee tugged on the belt, it released the stored energy from the jammed gear box.  The employee's fingers went into the nip point created by the belt/pulley and three fingers on the right hand were severely fractured. The ring finger also had skin removed.
An employee fell from the roof of a building while removing cable.
An employee was weed-eating when a rock was thrown into the employee's face.  Safety glasses were worn. The employee was unstable and disoriented and may have suffered a head injury.
An employee was operating a machine that packages frozen pizzas into cartons when her hand was pulled into an in-running nip point, amputating her left-hand middle fingertip.

An employee was acting as a signal person for a driver backing the truck. The employee's left hand was caught between the corner of a building and the truck. The employee underwent surgery to repair a fractured thumb and the surrounding soft tissue.
While conducting wind turbine maintenance operations, an employee slipped, striking and bruising his upper right leg on a turbine support structure.

An employee was using nitrogen air to purge particles from a vessel. The chemical spray used to purge the vessel got on the employee's wrist and face. The employee sustained a chemical burn to the left wrist.
An employee was pulling a portion of a tunnel section out of a shaft when he fell from an elevation onto a piece of broken slab and broke his jaw.
An employee was rigging pilings for hoisting and pinched a finger between the sling and piling. The tip of the index finger was amputated and reattached.
An employee was mowing the grass when the lawn mower rolled over and crushed his pelvis.
An employee's hand got caught between the conveyor belt and roller on a sanding machine.
On or about October 20, 2015, an employee's hand got caught in an auger while servicing it.
An employee involved in an automobile accident suffered a broken wrist and leg.
An employee was prepping for concrete pouring work when his finger got caught in a concrete drill.  He was hospitalized for a potential finger amputation.

An employee was struck in the face by a nail from a second employee's nail gun and admitted to the emergency room. The second employee shot himself in the stomach with the nail gun and was hospitalized.
An employee was in bike training. While trying to navigate some stairs, he lost his balance and fell. He injured his arm and was hospitalized for surgery.

On October 20, 2015, an employee's left index finger got caught in a flywheel while setting up a mechanical power press. Her finger was amputated to the first knuckle. The flywheel was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk inside the construction perimeter. He tripped over a discharge hose and fell onto his side, breaking two ribs and puncturing a lung.

An employee was attempting to make a delivery and was operating the dock gate that goes in the trailer. The employee was pulling up the dock plate and moving it forward when the employee's left middle finger got caught between the dock plate and trailer. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

While reducing the height of a load on an I-Beam/Rail Trailer and re-positioning it on the blocks, the employee checked under it before it was lowered via hydraulics. The rock truck shifted and rolled forward trapping him between the neck of the trailer and the front bumper of the truck. Another driver jumped into the rock truck and backed it off the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a crushed pelvis and other internal injuries.

Employees were using a Hydrovac to find an underground line.  The Hydrovac has a nozzle to shoot high pressure water and suck up water and mud.  One employee works the vacuum hose and another works the water nozzle. The employee working the vacuum hose saw a rock that he didn't think would go up the vacuum hose. When he reached down to pick it up, he stepped in front of the water nozzle.  The pressurized water punctured his knee on the inside of his right leg.

An employee was starting up an extrusion machine when the machine "kicked out" or faulted. The employee's gloved hand was caught in the auger. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index finger between the first and second digit.
An employee was delivering a pallet to a local business using a manual pallet jack. During the delivery, the employee moved and pulled or strained a muscle in his side and lower back.
While moving a stack of doors, an employee's finger was caught between doors resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping to put valves in place on a flatbed truck. A valve shifted and his hand got pinched between two valves, amputating (de-gloving) his right index finger.

On 10/20/2015 at about 11:45 AM, the injured employee was in the process of repositioning forks on a rough terrain forklift with his bare hands (no gloves). His right hand was near the tip end and his left hand at the heel end. He lifted with his right hand so that he could slide the fork along the fork bar. His right hand slipped and his left little finger got caught between the heel and the carriage. The distal end was crushed and severely lacerated (partial amputation).

On 10/19/15, at approximately 5:20 AM, an employee was driving a truck when she hit a washout and lost control of the vehicle. Her right wrist got caught between the steering wheel and something else (unknown) and broke. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the parking lot and passed a large/long concrete barrier. She tripped over the foot of the barrier and fell to the ground, breaking her right wrist.
On or about October 20, 2015, an employee was cutting a piece of wood with a circular saw when the saw kicked back and cut his upper right leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring fertilizer from a tinder truck to a field applicator when he fell off of the field applicator. He was hospitalized with a broken collarbone and broken vertebrae in his neck.

The employee was preparing to operate the water stripper gun to perform a quick test prior to beginning work. During the test, a particle lodged in one of the newly installed jewel tip nozzles of the whip hose causing a sudden surge in pressure. This resulted in a failure of the whip hose (the pressure surged to 18,000 PSI and was rated for 22,000 PSI). High pressure water exited the hose from the break and struck the employee's wrist.
On 10/20/15, an employee fell backwards into an open pit 8-10 feet deep and fractured ribs.

An employee was clipping paper on a white board. When she turned away from the board, she tripped on the leg of the white board and fell striking her left knee on the floor and her right knee popped.  She felt pain in the right knee and had difficulty lifting herself from the floor.  She was hospitalized overnight with a sprain, strain injury.
A reversing forklift struck an employee and ran over his right foot.
On October 20, 2015, an employee was attempting to remove an air tank valve with a wrench when he lost his footing, fell, and broke his right femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an ATV on a gravel road that was recently graded, when the vehicle tipped over and pinned the employee's arm to the ground.  The employee sustained a fracture to his upper left arm and wrist and a dislocated shoulder.
While operating a stretch wrapping machine, an employee's finger got caught between two rollers. Approximately two-thirds of the employee's right little finger were amputated.
While an employee was repairing/moving an electric powered pallet jack, the jack backed over his foot, lacerating and breaking bones in his right foot.

Three employees were performing leak testing on a 54-inch sanitary pipe when the testing device (80 lbs. air pressure) exploded and struck an employee, causing life-threatening head injuries and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing mold using a rollover machine when a box pattern fell on his left hand, amputating two fingers.
An employee was using a power tool to install a support bracket. The screw went through the bracket and cut his finger. The cut became infected and the employee was hospitalized.

On 10/21/2015, a roofing employee was performing a roofing tear off of dead wood. During the replacement of dead wood the worker ran out of replacement wood. The worker covered an opening in the roof with felt paper. The employee lost his balance and jumped from the roof of a single story mobile home instead of falling through the felt covering. Both heels were injured.
An employee was pulling and laying down pipe and amputated the third digit on the right hand from the tip to the knuckle.

On 10/21/15 at approximately 3:30 PM, an employee was cutting banding material off a stack of steel beams. The steel beams were 3 feet high and 20 feet long and came in stacks of two. They had wood blocking that held the two beams and steel banding material together. The employee was on the ground between two stacks of beams and was using a circular grinder to grind off the banding material. When he cut the last beam, the beams fell on him resulting in his hospitalization for a broken pelvis, right femur, and right tibia.

An employee was inserting a piece of metal inside a piece of vinyl window profile when she got a splinter. She and a co-worker removed the splinter.  Later she went to the doctor to receive further treatment and was hospitalized for an infection.
On 10/21/2015, an employee was removing shrink wrap from a pallet and got her feet tangled in the shrink wrap resulting in a fall.  She fractured her left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was mowing a lawn using a riding mover. He struck a wire and fell off the mower. The mower ran over his right hand severing it.
An employee suffered an amputation injury with a pipe threader.
An employee was assisting with surgery and struck his head on overhead light in the operating room when he stood up. He had a headache and tingling in both hands afterwards.

An employee was purging the ambient air on the compressor displacing it with natural gas. The night before, an electrical storm had shorted the motor. While purging the line, a spark ignited the natural gas causing a flash fire. The employee received burns on his face and hands and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting straps from boxes at the loading dock with a knife. The employee's hand slipped and he cut himself in the lower, right abdomen.  The employee was hospitalized for treatment of small perforations in the small intestine.

The employee was welding from a spider lift. While moving the spider lift from one location to another, the employee got his hand caught between the handrail and a steel plate resulting in the loss of the left ring fingertip (bone exposed).

An employee was nailing shingles at the edge of the roof of a new one story house when he lost his footing, fell 8 feet to the ground, and landed on a pile of wood. The employee was not wearing fall protective equipment. He was hospitalized with six broken ribs.

An employee was injured when the ladder he was using slipped, came loose from a rope connection, and fell. The employee fell approximately 9 feet to the next level. He was hospitalized with three broken ribs and a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was delivering vehicles to a car dealer. The employee climbed up the transport and was opening the back door of a vehicle when he lost his balance and fell 12 feet to the ground breaking both legs.

An employee had his back towards the machine when his gloves were caught in the metal slitter machine. This caused his arm to twist and pull resulting in a fracture to his upper right arm above the elbow. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was bitten on the right index finger by a copperhead snake, resulting in hospitalization and treatment.

The employee was watching a vacuum truck.  For shade the employee sat underneath a gangway.  A tanker vessel traveled by where the barge was stationed.  The waves rocked the barge allowing the gangway to fall on the employee.  The employee's entire right side, upper torso, back and pelvis sustained injuries.
On 10/21/2015, an employee was sanding a piece of stock on a lathe when he was pulled into the rolling stock fracturing his left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
The employee was walking, tripped over a wooden pallet, and fell breaking his hip.

An employee was clearing a jam on the Standun Bodymaker #34.  The machine was running at the time. The safety interlock malfunctioned and the horizontal press made a full revolution crushing the employees left pinky finger that was later removed at the hospital.

The injured employee was cleaning at the end of the shift. She proceeded to put paper in a recycling bin and turned around to return to the Mega-cutter.  As she passed by the weight scale she stepped diagonally across the ramp and caught the back portion of her foot on the ramp causing her to trip.  The employee fell forward onto the floor landing on her right hip and fracturing it.

An employee was moving a 220 pound cutting edge (blade) onto a pallet using a forklift. The blade was unstable and the employee exited the forklift to steady the blade. The blade shifted and fell onto her left ring finger resulting in the amputation of the finger up to the first digit.
An employee tripped over a pipe and fell to the floor resulting in a knee contusion that became infected requiring hospitalization.

On 10/21/2015, an employee was operating a folding machine when her left pinky fingertip was caught in the folding bar. An emergency stop was employed by a coworker. As the employee removed her finger from the machine, her fingertip was severed.
An employee carrying a nail gun tripped with his finger on the trigger and the nail gun shot a nail into his knee.
An employee preparing to perform concrete work on a building climbed up an extension ladder, lost his footing, and fell from the fourth rung fracturing his left knee cap.

An employee attempted to hurdle a cart return stall in the parking lot and fell fracturing the lower left arm and sustaining facial lacerations. The employee was admitted to the hospital to set the fracture and is scheduled to have rods placed in the arm.
An employee was walking down the hallway when he tripped and fell fracturing the hip and thigh.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a pocket stream feeder cart sideways across the floor. The cart tipped over and fell onto the employee's foot crushing two toes that were later amputated.
An employee was playing tag with children and turned his ankle.
An employee was starting a 300 gallon fertilizer pump and amputated the right ring finger when his finger was caught in the flywheel.

An employee was lifting a 70 lb. section of metal duct that needed to be welded to a ship bulkhead that was under construction. The metal duct slipped from the employee's hands and his left index finger was pinched between the metal duct and an I-beam flange. The employee's left index finger was amputated by the emergency room doctor.

An employee was on the ground performing a safety check on his fork truck when another fork truck driver backed into the aisle and pinned the injured employee between the two fork trucks. Both lower legs were crushed.

The employee is a truck driver. The employee drove to another employer's location to deliver a tractor. While unloading the equipment off the trailer, the employee fell from the trailer and fractured a hip.

A forklift operator was in the process of moving a load when the load fell off of the forks and struck a nearby worker on the foot resulting in broken and lacerated toes. The injured worker was hospitalized and requires surgery.

An employee was making an adjustment to a pneumatic strapper head that was energized. Pneumatic pressure kicked back pinching the employee's right ring finger between the adjustment tool and the metal plating causing a loss of soft tissue (no bone) requiring surgical repair.

During the process, he fell approximately 12 feet, fracturing his ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee conducting work on a flat roof fell approximately 17 feet through a skylight, suffering a fractured jaw, fractured hand, concussion, and bruised lungs. The employee required facial and hand stitches.
Two forklifts collided at a corner. The fork from one forklift went into the cage of the other forklift, fracturing an employee's left foot.

An employee was leaning over the CNC machine to see how the part was cutting. The door to the machine was open and the spin spindles were spraying oil onto the floor. The employee slipped on the oil and his knee hit the rail of the door. When he put his hands in front of his face, the pick-off tool on the CNC machine lacerated the right middle finger.
An employee on the ground level was struck by a temporary wooden barrier that fell from four stories above. The employee suffered fractures and internal bleeding.

An employee was running a brake press and had a piece of rectangular metal. The employee set the dies and pressed (bent) the short end. The employee then turned the piece to bend the long side, adjusted the dies, and leaned forward. The employee's left-hand fingers got caught in the equipment. The employee's left index fingertip and middle finger to the knuckle were surgically amputated; there was also some damage to the ring finger.

On November 11, 2015 at approximately 12:15 pm smoke from an electrical fire in the building activated the fire alarm.  An announcement was made over the PA system that it was a false alarm, so employee(s) remained at their work stations. Moments later the employee(s) were told to exit the building.  The fire department was called and arrived on scene (for approximately 30 minutes).  The employee coughed for the remainder of the day and the rest of the night.  Due to difficulty breathing and excessive coughing the employee sought care at the emergency room.  She was admitted.
An employee was exposed to an amputation of a fingertip while placing a rear bar onto a cart on November 19, 2015.  The bar fell and pinched the finger, severing the tip.
An employee torching a steal beam from a ladder got caught between the beam and a wall when the beam moved unexpectedly. He fractured his pelvis.
An employee tripped and fell on a rug, breaking her hip

An employee was on the ground floor securing the containment with flexible tarp when the wind started to move it around.  A gust of wind blew against the flexible tarp, knocking him backwards and causing him to land on the ground on his right wrist. His wrist fractured and required hospitalization.
On or about November 12, 2015, an employee's arm was pulled into the spindle on a printing press when her glove got caught. She broke two bones in her right arm.

An employee was picking up a lasher turnbuckle while a container was being loaded onto the ship by an overhead crane. When the crane operator was lowering the container onto the ship, the crane operator placed the container in the wrong position and struck one of the twist locks. That twist lock came off and struck the employee in the lower back, causing spasms and finger numbness
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell, hitting his head and fracturing his foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading tools into a truck when a golf car struck and pressed him between the two vehicles. He suffered body fractures.

The employee was pressure washing a ditch with a 10,000 psi pressure washer. The worker lost balance and the pressurized water blast lacerated the area between his big toe and the first toe on his right foot.
An employee's left ring fingertip was amputated while he was cutting flooring material using a retractable knife.
An employee was using a hoist to move a cast iron curb box from a pallet to a conveyor. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated between the casting and the side panel of the conveyor.

On 11/12/15, and employee was repairing a mold while working under a suspended load. The employee removed bolts to replace O rings. The runner plate separated from the cavity plate, and the 1500-pound mold fell on the employee's legs. The employee's left leg fractured.

At approximately 6:20 AM on November 12, 2015, an employee was opening the third ball valve in a system of six to operate the plasma cutting machine.  There was a failure at the pipe or the valve, and a spark ignited the gas. The employee was positioned at the compressed gas cage when this occurred, sustaining second-degree burns to his upper right chest, right arm, and left wrist.
An employee was operating a cope and drag machine when the employee's hand slipped, causing the employee's thumb to get crushed beneath a plate.
An employee was moving between two pallets when she tripped and fell to the ground, breaking her femur.
While turning a powered pallet jack, an employee ran into a forklift that was occupied and parked. His left leg got pinched between both vehicles, fracturing his lower leg area.

An employee was climbing up the ladder in an attempt to secure it when the ladder retracted and slipped off the wall.  Both the ladder and employee fell to the ground. The employee fell approximately 8 feet, breaking ribs and suffering a swollen spleen.
An employee fell and broke the left ankle.

While a rig was being dismantled, the flow line was being moved with the boom line. The flow line pipe got caught on the stairs and pulled them loose from the rig. The stairs fell and struck an employee, who suffered a broken leg, knee fracture, and spine fracture.
An employee hit a power line while operating an aerial lift and received an electrical shock.
An employee was operating a milling machine when the feed bar slipped through the rotation and hit his hand, de-gloving his right thumb and fracturing his index finger.

An employee was helping to lift concrete panels when the metal brace slipped out of his hand and cut his right pinky finger. He was wearing gloves at the time. He was hospitalized for surgery, and his right pinky had to eventually be surgically amputated.

An employee removed a flexible hose with a coworker. The bleeder valve was inadvertently opened, and hot non-toxic process fluid came out and sprayed the employee's shoulder. He suffered a second degree burn.

An employee was working in the rod basket of a well-servicing rig when the operator raised the block into the rig derrick. The block bumped the basket, and the employee grabbed the side. His left middle finger got caught between the basket and the derrick, pinching off the end of his finger. The end of his left middle finger was surgically amputated (including bone).
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on an extendable conveyor line when his left index finger got caught and amputated between the line and the dock door.
An employee was showing a supervisor something on a punch press die when his foot hit the foot pedal. The press cycled and caught the employees' left index finger, which was amputated.

A crew was removing worn slats from a burn table, which was hoisted approximately 3 feet. When an employee cut one of the slats, the table came down to its home position and cut the employee's right thigh, requiring hospitalization and stitches.
An employee was hooking a trailer when he felt something pop in his back. He experienced numbness and paralysis from the chest down, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee got his hand caught in a scalper device and suffered contusions and a laceration. The employee was admitted for observation and wound care.

A wire became jammed in the wire brush manufacturing machine. The employee unjammed the wire and used his left middle finger to check if the feed tube was free of debris. The machine toggled and amputated his left middle fingertip.  The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was tightening a bolt with a wrench, slipped, and fell to the floor landing on the left side and arm. The employee sustained bruised lungs and a blood clot.

An employee was performing prep work on metal for a highway construction project. An equipment operator was extracting a metal sheet from the ground nearby when the shackle for the sling broke and sent metal shards flying. The shards struck and lacerated the employee, requiring stitches.
An employee was operating a machine when his finger was amputated.
An employee was between a bolster and a press frame when the bolster rolled on and crushed his right foot and ankle.
An employee was filling a container with a chemical when his coworker accidentally splashed him with sulfuric acid. The splash caused chemical burns to the employee's face, arms, thigh, and shin.
An employee was walking by an applicator when the coupling blew off, spraying anhydrous ammonia that burned the employee's chest and eyes.
An employee was ripping wood on a table saw when the blade amputated two of the employee's fingertips. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was preparing to cut some metal material with a chop saw (miter saw) with his right hand holding the material.  The saw blade got caught on the material, causing it to raise and catch two of his fingers. His right index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee was pushing a dolly into the store when she slipped and fell on ice. She fell on her right side, fracturing her hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a load of wood logs with a crane. After disconnecting the metal sling clip attached to the load, the logs shifted, causing the employee's finger to get caught between them. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a forklift and moving pallets. The employee's foot got pinched between the forklift and warehouse racking, breaking bones that required surgery.
On 11/12/15 at 1:30 p.m., an employee missed the final step of the exterior stairs. The employee fell onto both knees and fractured the right knee.
On 11/12/15 an employee tripped over a pallet and fell striking the right side of the forehead. The employee was later hospitalized.
An employee was loading a mold onto a forklift when the forklift moved forward and caught his finger between the mold and forks sustaining a 1st digit amputation to the right middle finger.
An employee fell while walking in the corridor and suffered multiple fractures.

On November 13, 2015, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee was working from an aerial lift and signaling a crane lifting a pipe. The crane was overloaded, tipped, and struck the aerial basket the employee was riding in.  The employee was bounced out of the aerial lift. When the crane sat back down, the employee was bounced back in the aerial lift and back out again. The employee suffered a spinal fracture, broken ribs, and multiple facial fractures, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized with injuries sustained during a helicopter crash.
On 11/10/2015, an employee was hospitalized with a rash that developed on her bilateral forearms after transferring a patient.
An employee was unloading pipe racks when a rack fell on and broke the employee's leg.
An employee was performing maintenance on an engine when some of the fluid got on his hands and burned them.

An employee was moving metal tubes onto a forklift when a tube began to slip out of his hand.  He attempted to pull his hand out of the way, and his finger got caught between two tubes. His left index fingertip was amputated.

On November 13, 2015, an employee was feeding a large-format print into the laminator.  The employee's fingers got caught between the two large rubber rollers.  The employee's left-hand ring fingertip was amputated, while the middle finger was lacerated and required stitches.
An employee fell from a scaffold located in a stairway, fracturing their vertebrae.
An employee got on his truck to check the slump at the ready-mix plant. He slipped and fell approximately 4 feet, breaking some ribs and suffering a hairline fracture to his pelvis.
While driving a powered industrial truck, an employee's foot slipped off the side and his calf was pinned between the truck and the wall. He suffered tissue damage in his calf.
An employee bent over to pick up his tool bag and felt his back pop. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
On 11-13-2015, at 6:30 p.m., an employee was riding the forks of a forklift when the forklift ran into a cement post, breaking his left femur.
On Friday, November 13, 2015, an employee was moving a wooden pallet when he got a splinter in the palm of his right hand. He was later hospitalized when the splinter became infected.
An employee's left hand received an electrical shock when it grabbed an electrical conduit wiring as he climbed down a ladder.
Two of an employee's fingers were amputated.
A Bobcat employee was loading steel into a punch press when multiple fingers got crushed and amputated in a pinch point.
An employee was standing on a ladder placing boxes on a storage shelf. The employee fell off the ladder and broke the left wrist.

On Friday, November 13, 2015, at approximately 6:04 PM, an employee tripped on the curb when exiting the office. She was hospitalized with fractures to her left wrist, left eye socket, and left femur.
An employee was changing a roller on a coding machine. His left hand made contact with the roller and the left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee fell from a 10-foot fiberglass A-frame ladder while setting up to drill a hole in the wall. The employee suffered a concussion, thoracic sprain, lumbar sprain, laceration to the face and forehead, nasal bone fracture, and two broken wrists.

An employee was cleaning a bridge along the embankment of canal.  An operator was using a crane and clam bucket. The employee was guiding the bucket when it came down on and fractured the employee's right foot.
On 11/13/15, at 10:45 p.m., an employee was struck by a semi-truck in the parking lot. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was pulling tarp over the bed of a flatbed truck. As the employee dismounted the truck, the employee's wedding ring got caught on a truck bolt. The ring finger had to be surgically amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was moving a board inside a trash truck hopper. The blade was moving at the time. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated between the compactor blade and the side wall of the hopper.
An employee was adjusting a conveyor belt when his fingers got caught between the conveyor belt and a metal roller. The third and fourth fingertips on his left hand were amputated (no bone loss).
An employee servicing a security camera slipped down an extension ladder, breaking an arm, nose, and ribs.

An employee was spotting the loading of a skip hoist onto a semi trailer. The employee attempted to adjust one of four legs that support the motor pack for the skip hoist, which is a separate piece from the skip hoist. The motor pack weighed 1,850 pounds. The employee was loosening a clamp on one of the motor pack legs when the leg collapsed, causing the motor pack to fall on the employee, who suffered broken vertebrae.
While pushing wood through a table-mounted, hand-held router, an employee's left-hand middle finger was cut by the router blade; the ring finger was also  amputated at the first knuckle.

On February 13, 2015, a temporary employee was doing pipe fitting work at the job site and lifted a compressor.  The compressor fell down and injured his left index finger. The finger was later amputated.
An employee was restocking hops in the cooler when he fell approximately 8 feet. He landed on a box and fractured his right ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a hose apart when lime got on and burned the employee's chest, face, and neck.
An employee fell to the ground below while traversing between roofs, injuring his back.

An employee was rolling aluminum. The employee's gloved hand was drawn into the in-turning rollers of the rolling machine. The employee required pinky and ring finger surgery. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee fell approximately 20 feet from the top of a barge to the dry dock while using a come along to pull a plate into position. The employee shattered the left ankle and damaged two to three vertebrae.
An employee was delivering mail to a private residence and stepped up one step to put mail in a mailbox. As he was turning around to step down, he lost his balance and fell, breaking his right hip.

An employee was counting deer while conducting a wildlife survey from a helicopter. The helicopter crashed into the side of a mountain. The employee broke their right femur and ankle, and possibly fractured three vertebrae.
An employee lost his balance while using a table router on wood trim. His hand came in contact with the cutter head, partially amputating his right middle finger.
An employee was assessing ground water when her right hand and knuckle got scraped. Her knuckle became infected and required hospitalization.

On 11/14/15,at 1:30 p.m., an employee was driving a forklift while wearing a body harness and lanyard. The lanyard was run over, strangling the employee and breaking his right shoulder blade.  He was hospitalized overnight.
On 11/14/2015, at 7:40 AM, an employee fell from the dock and was pinned between the dock and a truck that was backing up at the same time. He was hospitalized with a broken back and knee.

An employee lifted a rare earth magnet from a materials hopper. He handed the magnet to a second employee.  The second employee took the magnet and began to set the magnet down on an adjacent piece of equipment.  As the second employee set the magnet down, the magnet pulled itself to the piece of equipment that he was going to place it on. His left-hand ring finger was crushed between the magnet and the equipment and had to be surgically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a blow molding machine that makes plastic bottles. The employee's right ring finger got caught in the machine and required medical amputation.

On November 14, 2015, an employee was loading tools and was folding a triangle tool that has steel cables attached to it. The cables had slack in them and when the employee folded them, the cable tightened up and amputated the employee's right pinky fingertip.
An employee was operating a folder tender when he attempted to adjust a box of napkins on the conveyor. His hand got pinched between a roller and the conveyor belt.

Employees were dismantling a scaffold and were handing down a piece of plywood, which was 4-feet by 6-feet, when it slipped from a coworker's hands and fell 50 feet. The plywood struck the injured employee in the left foot behind the steel-toe shoe. His left toes were amputated.

An employee was getting out of his semi-truck after parking in the terminal yard. The ground location where the employee parked was an uneven surface. As he stepped out of the truck, he heard a snap in his leg. He was hospitalized for knee surgery.

An employee climbed onto his dump truck to retrieve some information. While descending the ladder, he lost his footing and fell to the ground level below, striking his head. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture.

An employee was making a turn while driving a motorized pallet jack in the Textiles area of the store and their left foot was pinned between the pallet jack and a steel column causing an ankle laceration.
An employee suffered several broken vertebrae after being struck by a "cuber" machine while repositioning brick pavers on a board.
An employee was pulling wire on the slip line of a truck when the wire loop caught and amputated his thumb tip.

On November 15, 2015, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee was helping a coworker remove a 6.5-feet tall, 2.5-feet wide, 1.5-feet deep electrical panel. The panel was strapped to a two-wheel hand truck/dolly. The 450-pound cabinet became unstable and fell on top of him, pinning him beneath it. The dolly stayed strapped to the cabinet, and the cross bar on the dolly made contact with the employee's lower leg, fracturing it.
A worker was struck by a mini excavator moving in reverse. It rolled over his right foot and fractured the tibia and fibula.

An employee was picking merchandise from a storage rack using a stock picker. She was 2 to 3 feet above the floor at the second shelf of the racking system. She opened the gate and walked out, falling to the floor and breaking her tibia in two places.

An employee was outside grinding metal for duct work when a spark or piece of metal blew inside his jacket and ignited it. He suffered 3rd degree burns on his torso and arms and was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee was using a pry bar to pry a chain. The chain freed up, and the pry bar hit the employee on the side of the face. The employee sustained a cheek laceration, broken nose, and fractured sinus bone.

An employee was moving a 4-inch-diameter hose to an industrial vacuum cleaner when his clothing and hand were sucked into the hose. The high pressure suction caused the capillaries in his hand to swell. He was hospitalized and required surgery to reduce the swelling.

An employee was installing sheet metal and was preparing to weld. He leaned against the sheet metal, which kicked out and fell. He attempted to catch the sheet metal and it struck him, breaking his right femur.

On 11/15/2015, at approximately 1:30 p.m., an employee was working inside a ground stewards tank, which holds the potable water for the city.  As he went up  some rigging on the inside of the tank, the rigging came loose and he fell down with it. He hit the floor of the tank, breaking his leg and fracturing his face. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a roof deck and broke bones.
An employee was using an excavator to load concrete slabs into a dump truck. The employee's right leg got caught between the concrete slab and truck tailgate, causing soft tissue damage.
The employee was positioning the shoot on the hopper rail car when the shoot broke and the employee fell onto the hopper rail car fracturing three ribs on the left side.

An employee was in the freezer getting a 50 lb. case of turkey. While standing on a pallet, he lost his balance and let go of the case. The case fell on his right leg, fracturing his tibia. He was hospitalized.
While being lifted on a crate of material, an employee fell approximately 20 feet, suffering a fractured pelvis and right heel.
An employee working from a scaffold fell 10 feet to the ground while painting the exterior of a street bridge. He suffered three broken ribs and a fractured disc.

An employee was cleaning a machine using a rag. The rag got caught in a nip point, and the employee's right hand was pulled into the machine. He was hospitalized with injuries to his palm and three middle fingers. The machine was running and unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee's foot was fractured after being struck by a forklift on 11/16/15.
An employee was struck by a rolling forklift in the warehouse. The employee suffered fractured ribs.

An employee was using a tractor with a front-end load bucket to remove bark from under a log deck. The tractor unexpectedly started to move forward and the employee's head got caught between the log deck and a bar on the tractor. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing the force draft fan belt. He turned off the fan. Due to the inertia, the belt did not come to a complete stop and began to rotate. The employee's right index finger got caught between the belt and the pulley, and was amputated between the last joint and base of the nail. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

He was making an adjustment to an extrusion machine puller, which allows the belt to go up and down, when his right middle finger got caught in the belt. His right middle fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was troubleshooting a malfunctioning machine that is used to wash metal parts. The metal door of the machine fell down on the employee's right forearm, causing a deep laceration that required surgery.

An employee was cleaning out her desk in preparation for her department's relocation.  She kneeled on the corner of her desk to reach the bookshelf located above.  The corner where she was kneeling broke, and she hit her head on the corner of the desk. She was hospitalized with a head laceration and back injury.
While attempting to clean a conveyor belt, an employee's finger was smashed in a gear box. The employee's fingertip was amputated. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.

On 11/16/15, at about 6:00 p.m., an employee was using a transferrable cart to load a piece of steel into the grit blaster machine. The transferrable cart rolled over the employee's right foot, fracturing it.
An employee was torching (cutting) railroad rails with an oxygen/propane torch when a spark struck his lower left pant leg, causing burn injuries to his shin area. He was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing the overhead bracket, which holds the overhead guard, on a customer-owned forklift.  The overhead guard fell and caught the employee's finger between it and the frame of the forklift. The employee's middle left-hand finger was amputated approximately 1/4" to 1/2" from the tip (middle of the fingernail).
An employee fell approximately 5 feet from a ladder while installing a ceiling tile grid. He broke his knee and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking toward his truck. When he stepped down to the ground from the sidewalk with his right leg, he felt a pop. He fell to his knees and could not stand up, experiencing tingling and loss of feeling in both legs. He suffered a serious muscle strain to both quadriceps.
