An employee had swelling of the knee after kneeling down to perform work on the fluting machine.  An infection ensued causing the employee to be hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was moving heavy doors on a drywall cart when a door shifted, fell off the cart, and crushed the employee's left big toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished working on top of a trailer. As he began stepping on the 20-foot aluminum ladder to get down, his foot slipped and kicked the ladder from underneath him. He fell 10.5 feet to the ground below, injuring his head and vertebrae. The employee's body harness was disconnected at the time of the incident.

An employee was working in front of the side boom when the employee tripped and fell. The side boom moved forward several feet, and the boom track ran over the employee, fracturing their right leg and foot.
An employee was walking through a work aisle when she tripped on a co-worker's foot, causing her to fall to the ground and break her left hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was felling a cedar tree with a chain saw.  A branch of the cedar tree hit an 8-inch maple tree.  When the tension was released,  the maple tree whipped back, knocking the employee to the ground.  The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle, ribs, and shoulder, as well as a back injury. The employee was wearing PPE at the time of the incident.
An employee's left index finger was crushed between two 21-feet-long steel pipes.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was backing up, suffering compound fractures to his left leg.

An employee was cleaning bread crumbs from the end of the conveyor and the flight (guide that keeps the bread separated). The employee's left ring finger got caught in the conveyor, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle. The machine was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting wood tack strips with a band saw and suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee slipped on water on the tile floor and fell fracturing the right leg.
An employee was changing out a die in a brake press and pinched a finger between the die and the bed of the machine amputating the fifth fingertip on the right hand.
An employee was walking out the door when a gust of wind caught the door. She tried to grab the door and fell striking her head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee ran into a guardrail and fractured vertebrae while trying to avoid being struck by a pipe that had fallen from the elevator.
An employee's hand was caught between two belt rollers on a conveyor system while trying to pick up heavy luggage. The employee's hand and fingers were lacerated.
An employee was using a food processor to slice cucumbers. The employee's nail was removed when it was caught on the blade while unjamming it.

On November 17, 2015, at approximately 10:40 am, an employee operating a stand up forklift to transport tires from the back of the building to the Tire/Battery Center hit a bump and fell off the forklift. The forklift rolled over his foot. He was hospitalized with two broken toes and some damage to the skin.
An employee tripped over wires and fell, fracturing the left leg.

The employee was trying to dislodge a stone that was stuck on the dump truck.  His right middle finger was stuck between the pin and the locking mechanism on the gate, amputating the tip of his finger.
An employee was pulling a cart full of patio door frames and the cart turned over striking the employee.  The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left hip.
An employee was using a knife to cut a band from a stack of trusses and cut his left wrist.
An employee sustained a fractured ankle when she was struck by an oncoming vehicle that entered the work zone.
On November 17, 2015, an employee mistakenly drank cleaning fluid that had been placed in an unlabeled water bottle.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and slipped off the pallet jack severely lacerating the right ankle and shin area.

As the employee was cleaning the cheese conveyor, his glove got caught on the conveyor pulling his hand and arm into a rotating circular shaft.  The employee suffered a compound fracture of the right forearm requiring surgery.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to his left index finger while attempting to navigate the auto lift tailgate on the company vehicle.
An employee was emptying the hopper into a dumpster. The hopper shifted and the employee's left index finger was caught in the hopper's dump door amputating the fingertip.
On November 17, 2015, an employee was hospitalized after falling off a standard curb and breaking both ankles during a routine pre-trip inspection of their truck.
A plate machine operator had his foot on/under the plate machine and the moving gantry on the machine caught his foot and drug it causing a chip fracture and lacerations.
On November 17, 2015, an employee suffered a de-gloving of their right hand while using the base fiber feeder on the 9214 mat line.
An employee was participating in a team building event and fell breaking his hip.

An employee was exiting the rear door of the hospital. A gust of wind caused the door to smash his hand between two arms of the closer creating a pinch point. The employee lost the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee was putting her coat away in a closet that was a fire door. The employee started closing the door and caught her hand in the door. Her right pinky finger was amputated to the first joint.
The employee was walking into the building from the parking lot and fell onto the landscaping rock injuring both ankles.  The right ankle was fractured and dislocated.  The left ankle was sprained.
An employee was painting a balcony when the rail/fence on the balcony broke causing the employee to fall approximately 30 feet and break the right wrist/hand. The employee also had internal injuries.
A driver was positioning himself to lift a fiberglass door and dislocated his knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was injured at a delivery stop when his hand and wrist were caught between the lift gate and the truck as the lift gate was being lowered. The employee sustained broken bones and tendon damage to his left wrist.
An employee operating a hydraulic power press had his right middle and index fingers caught in the point of operation. The employee had the tip of his right index finger amputated as a result.
An employee was loading and guiding tubing into the #1 forming head on the corrugator. As the tubing was loading his right hand got caught in the machine and crushed the middle finger.
An employee had the tip of the left index finger amputated by a 3" peek tube mold.
The wind caught a containment pan the employee was handling and the employee suffered a hernia when he tried to hold onto it.
An employee was stacking pallets and used his left hand to prevent the stack of pallets from falling over.  The employee suffered a thumb tip amputation and compound fracture of the left hand.
An employee was entering the training room when she tripped on a raised landing, fell and broke her wrist.

An employee was checking the printer on Machine # 0735-16 while the line was down and not running. He stepped over the wire (approximately 7 inches from the ground) with his left foot and as he attempted to bring his right foot over, his toe caught the wire and he fell forward fracturing the right ankle.
An employee was repairing a tire and lacerated his thumb on a protruding nail in the tire.
An employee was measuring the inside of a trench box and was struck by a piece of concrete fracturing a finger.
An employee stepped into an uncovered hole and sprained their back.
An employee stepped on a piece of fruit, slipped and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee fell approximately seven feet off a ladder and broke both wrists.
The employee was weed trimming and another employee was mowing on a tractor. The tractor ran over a metal pipe. The metal pipe struck the employee who was trimming on the right leg.
An employee suffered an avulsion of his left thumb that was later amputated in the hospital.
An employee was walking across the first floor of the building under construction and fell through a hole in the floor breaking the left wrist.
A temporary worker doing carpentry work for a client company suffered a back injury resulting in hospitalization.
A mail carrier fell and struck his head on the ground while delivering mail on his route. He was later diagnosed with bleeding in the brain.

On 11/18/2015, an employee was doing paperwork at his desk when he felt a sting on his left arm.  When he looked at his arm, he noticed a bite mark from an insect. He ignored the bite initially, but the pain became worse and he decided to go to the hospital on 11/22/2015 at which time he was admitted for treatment.  Medical staff determined that he had been bitten by a brown recluse spider.
An employee was working on the packaging line. While he was manipulating pallets, his foot was caught between two conveyer belts injuring the lower leg.
An employee was cleaning a portable packing machine when it was inadvertently powered-on, resulting in the amputation of four fingertips on the left hand.

A piece of wood got stuck in the feed conveyor.  The employee tried to free the board and when he did it went into the rip saw and a piece was ejected striking the employee and rupturing the intestine.
An employee was responding to an emergency alarm, got up from the desk and tripped over computer cords falling to the floor and breaking her left hip.
An employee slipped and fell down stairs injuring both knees.
An employee was operating a stamping machine and got his right hand caught in the stamper. The employee was hospitalized on 11/18/2015 and underwent surgery to repair fractures on two fingers.
An employee climbed on top of a front load garbage truck to remove debris from the canopy area.  The employee then fell approximately 10 feet off the truck fracturing the left hip and arm.
An employee made contact with an energized line and received flash burns to his left hand.
An employee was walking down a ramp towards the customer's car in the parking area when he slipped and fell on his right arm and broke his wrist.  The ramp was wet from rain.
On November 18, 2015, an employee suffered a fingertip amputation while working on a part revolution punch press.

The employee was operating a coiler when he noticed a pin/shaft was coming out of the machine. The employee stopped the machine and knocked the pin/shaft back into place with a hammer.  The metal pin/shaft shattered and a piece of metal lodged in the employee's stomach.

Two employees were installing the top wall plate and caulking the seams of a previously erected pre-manufactured wall.  One employee was in a man lift and the second employee was working from the ground.  The wall fell over as a result of a sudden wind gust.  The temporary supports holding the wall in place failed and the wall fell onto the man lift and struck both employees. One of the employees sustained two broken ankles and the other employee dislocated the right hip.  The pre-manufactured framed wall (structural insulated pane) measured approximately 18 feet in height by 120 feet in length.
An employee working the paunch table amputated part of his right thumb.

An employee was loading a washer onto a company truck outside of a residential customer's address. The employee slipped on the lift gate and fell. When he fell, the washer fell on top of him causing an unspecified back injury and hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a forklift attachment and smashed this thumb between the swivel hook and the forklift attachment resulting in the amputation of his right thumb tip.
An employee was repairing a barrel threading machine and amputated the left index fingertip when it became caught between the gun barrel and a clamp.

On November 19, 2015, an employee was mixing a batch of chemicals and spilled resin near his face, and on his hands and arms. At the time of the spill, he took a shower and returned to work. Days later he began to feel very ill and was hospitalized.
An employee was working at the facility when the employee felt ill. The employee was hospitalized due to an allergic reaction to indirect contact with latex gloves at the facility.
While removing a discharge hose from a water pump, an employee was exposed to hot water and suffered burns to the arms, neck and abdomen.
An employee was caught in the feeder portion of a structural steel vertical band saw (17 inches),  resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee ingested Tilex cleaning solution.
The tip of a bicycle mechanic's thumb was amputated while servicing the drive chain of a stationary cycle.

An employee finished connecting the drop fitting to start the fuel delivery. When he turned around, he tripped over one of the safety cones and fell onto the pavement breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell, breaking an ankle.
An employee was installing fire taping on a drywall from a 16 ft. extension ladder. He fell 9 feet to the ground resulting in contusions to his left ankle, lower back, upper back, shoulder and neck.
An employee received chemical burns to the right forearm while transferring 98% pure sulfuric acid from a tank truck.

On November 19, 2015, an employee was using a hand held air blower to clean wood chips off a shaper table while the cutter head was running. The employee's hand made contact with the cutting head, amputating the right index finger and severely lacerating the right thumb.
An employee was using a stamping machine and suffered the amputation of the left frontal oblique, fourth digit.
A temporary employee was pulling plastic from behind a stack of boards. The boards fell and broke his leg.

An employee was securing a steel plate under a barge on a dry dock. The 24" X 14' steel plate weighing approximately 285 lbs. came undone from the lifting mechanism and struck the employee in the back.
An employee was splashed in the face with a cleaning chemical (extreme degreaser) while cleaning a kitchen at a client site. The employee was hospitalized for chemical burns.
An employee was cleaning wet materials from a dust auger and his left hand got caught inside the auger while in operation resulting in the amputation of the thumb tip.
A worker was cutting 8" steel pipe with a pipe cutting machine and got caught in the point of operation amputating the right index and middle fingertips.

An employee was walking her mail delivery route in a residential neighborhood. While stepping down from a step or curb, she lost her footing and fell. She suffered a broken bone in her lower left leg and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee got her finger pinched in the conveyor on the packaging line resulting in the amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee suffered a finger amputation after their gloved hand was entangled in a rotating drill bit.
An employee was moving buckets of liquid potassium hydroxide and some of the liquid spilled onto his foot causing severe chemical burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee injured their knee and ribs as a result of a fall from a ladder while removing a fuel filter on a crane.
An employee slipped and fell on the wet marble floor near the entrance to the facility resulting in a hamstring tear and lower back pain due to bruising and contusions.

An employee was operating an angle line fabricator. The angle iron rolls in and it's measured and cut to length by the machine. The employee was adjusting the punch that cuts the angle iron with a wrench between cycles. The punch came down. The angle iron got stuck on the punch and retracted with the punch crushing the tip of the employee's left middle finger between the angle iron and the machine.

An employee suffered a puncture wound on his left hand when attempting to retrieve uprights from an elevator shaft that had taken on water. The wound became infected and the employee was admitted to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was injured while repairing a powered industrial vehicle at the customer location.
An employee amputated the left pinky finger when the die blocks on the micro weld machine came down it.
An employee was polishing a four inch bar in a lathe. The soft emery paper got caught around the rotating bar and crushed the employee's fingers.

An employee was operating a dump truck and another employee was outside the truck attempting to shut the tailgate. The tailgate was stuck open and the employee was pulling on the tailgate trying to get it unstuck. As the employee pulled on the tailgate, the truck moved forward and the tailgate shut on the employee's hand resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee fell while descending the stairs at the health clinic, suffering multiple contusions and fractures to the left numerus and right elbow requiring hospitalization.
An employee was winding up a 42 inch wide belt and got his foot caught between the belt guide on the conveyor and the belt. The employee's right leg was broken just above the ankle.

An employee was operating a rail king (equipment that moves rail cars) to couple two rail cars.  The rail cars would not couple, so the employee bumped the rail cars and the front rail car started moving.  The employee got off the rail king and attempted to get onto the moving rail car to set the brake.  The employee slipped as he was getting onto the rail car and a wheel ran over his left foot amputating at least two toes. The employee was transported to the hospital where he underwent surgery and the left foot was amputated.

On November 19, 2015, at about 8:00am two employees received electrical burns when they removed a grounding strap from 220Kv lines.  They were working from a personnel platform suspended by a crane on a barge in the San Francisco Bay.
An employee slipped and fell and hit his head.
An employee lost balance and fell off a ladder breaking a leg.
A roll-off truck driver was trying to untangle the automatic load tarp and fell approximately 8-10 feet to the ground. The driver suffered trauma to the head, back and shoulder.

Two maintenance employees were troubleshooting a switch gear at an unmanned pipeline compressor station when an arc flash occurred.  One employee was hospitalized after receiving burns on his hands and face.  Another employee was treated, but was not hospitalized.
A drain pipe that was being lowered into place crushed a worker's left index finger resulting in amputation.
The employee was working with a bench mounted drill press and amputated the right middle finger at the second knuckle.
An employee who had been performing decking operations suffered spinal injuries after he fell 12 feet through a guardrail to the plywood below.
An employee, who was providing patient care, was exposed to peanut products, which aggravated the employee's allergies resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting a flat glass panel when the panel shifted and pinched the employee's left wrist and pinky finger between the glass panel and the machine's railing. The employee fell and amputated the left pinky finger and broke the left wrist and ankle.

An employee used the ladder to go down into the 8 feet deep trench. He stepped onto the floor of the trench and started to sink. His co-worker dropped down an emergency retrieval sling and as he was pulling himself up with it, he hurt both legs resulting in torn ligaments.
While standing in an aisle, an employee picking cases and loading them onto an electric pallet jack was struck by another electric pallet jack operated by another employee resulting in a broken leg.

Two employees were preparing to weld a 6 inch pipe. The anchor bolts that were holding the pipe came out of the concrete. The pipe fell and struck the ladder on which the employee was working. The employee was thrown 4 feet off the ladder to the concrete below striking his head. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a fractured eye socket, and minor bleeding to the brain.

An employee was assisting with the unloading of granite curbing from a flatbed trailer. The bucket of the excavator being used to unload the curbing struck a length of curbing causing it to fall onto the employee's leg and causing injury.
An employee amputated a thumb.
On or about November 20, 2015, a clipper machine operator amputated the right middle fingertip while cutting bundles of veneer.

On Friday, November 20, 2015, two concrete truck drivers were washing their respective concrete trucks at the same time in the wash down area at the concrete mixing plant. Driver #1 finished washing his truck and started driving out of the wash down area. After pulling out some distance from the wash down area, Driver #1 looked in both mirrors and noticed Driver #2 laying on the ground. Driver #1 stopped to assist Driver #2 who stated that he was run over when Driver #1 pulled away. Driver #2 sustained foot, leg and shoulder injuries requiring surgery.
An employee tripped over the drainage system and fell breaking the left leg.
An employee carrying large boxes tripped over a pallet and suffered a dislocated ankle and broken right foot.
An employee tripped and fell in the art department resulting in a hip and shoulder injury.
An employee was removing bolts from concrete forms while the forms were laying on the ground. The form shifted and broke the employee's tibia and fibula.

An employee was sitting at an egress booth and fell off a chair striking his head. The employee lacerated his head requiring four staples and suffered a mild concussion and minor bleeding on the brain.

An employee was attempting to place a tarp over the load of gypsum he was going to transport. The employee fell from the top of the load and sustained three broken ribs, a mild concussion and a fractured right orbital. A personal fall arrest system was not used at the time.
An employee fell 15 feet from a 20 foot straight portable ladder breaking his left leg.
An employee was at the airport resetting a modem for the Doppler radars when he was assaulted and stabbed by a robber. He was hospitalized with severe injuries.

An employee was helping to move a portable hydraulic lifting device onto the bed of a pickup truck. One of the folding legs of the portable hydraulic lifting device opened up.  The injured employee reached for the leg of the unit and caught his finger in a pinch point caused by the movement of the leg. His right little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working from a ladder stocking retail products on shelves on 11/21/15 @ 3:15pm.  The employee fell from the ladder and fractured the right ankle.
An employee was involved in a putting product into carts and taking product out of carts and suffered a hernia.
An employee performing plumbing work was hospitalized after the hole hawg drill he was using caught his glove and amputated his right pinky finger.
An employee was removing snow and ice from the employee's vehicle in the company parking lot after completion of the work shift. The employee slipped and fell due to icy and snowy conditions.
An employee fell into the trench while trying to cross over it and suffered a moderate to severe spinal injury.
A rural carrier delivering a parcel slipped and fell on the ice injuring his hip.
An employee was operating equipment identified as a paster and amputated the right thumb tip when it was caught in the machine while trying to remove a scrap of paper.

While working in Bay 3 of the facility, an employee was moving metal plates that weighed approximately 4000 pounds with a pendant control crane.  The plate swung and struck the employee pinning him against another plate and injuring his stomach.
An employee suffered a left hand fingertip amputation when cleaning the hopper of a straw machine.

A maintenance mechanic was using a powered hand drill with a 4 foot long ready rod (attachment) to clean out a pipe that was clogged with powder. When he inserted the rod into the pipe, the rod caught his gloved left hand lacerating his fingers. Because of personal medical reasons, the employee opted to have the tip of his index finger surgically amputated.
An employee fell to the ground while putting a cover over a greenhouse roof striking their head and breaking their wrist.
An employee slipped, fell, and broke his wrist in an attempt to adjust boxes on a pallet that was on the palletizer.
A temp employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture after being struck in the head by the bucket of a mini-excavator.
An employee was manually splitting two trolleys apart, lost his footing and fell. One of the trolley's fell on his leg, breaking it.
An employee suffered a broken wrist after tripping over a water transfer hose and falling to the ground.
An employee operating a pallet jack got his left foot caught between the pallet jack and a rack.
An employee injured his foot operating a powered industrial pallet jack.
An employee was hospitalized after slipping and falling on ice on November 22, 2015. The employee suffered a skull fracture and internal bleeding.

On or about November 22, 2015, an employee was seriously injured and hospitalized with a crushed pelvis and a lower left arm amputation, after being ejected from a front end loader that went over an embankment at the facility.
A janitorial employee was walking out a women's bathroom and collided with a customer. As a result, the employee fell to the ground and fractured the right femur.
An employee was cleaning the fryer and set a hot pan of oil behind him.  Then he stepped back into the hot oil and burned his back.

Two employees were repairing a hub bearing.  The machine was locked/tagged out and secured.  The first employee attempted to line up the internal keyway slot by reaching in to feel the alignment. The second employee was manually tightening bolts to the hub adapter and when the external housing turned it amputated the tip of the first employee's right index finger.
An employee was climbing down the rail car ladder and fell sustaining head and back trauma.
An employee was pulled into a running winder crushing the employee's left hand and lower left arm.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor while standing on an I-beam approximately 8 feet high. The employee's foot was caught in the conveyor and his big toe was later medically amputated.
An employee was repairing the roof's exhaust and got an index finger caught in the motor's belt resulting in amputation.

An employee was driving an excavator up a mountain road. The excavator hit a patch of ice, slid off the side of the road and rolled over. A tree stump came through the cab and pinned the operator's leg between the stump and the controls.
An employee was responding to a sensor alert in Grid 4A and injured the left ankle. The employee was later hospitalized for a fractured ankle and infection.

On 11/22/2015 at 11:50 a.m. an employee was isolating the gas line to identify the point of a suspected ice plug. He walked over to the meter when the hammer union on a two inch gas line disconnected and the pipe struck his leg injuring the tibia and fibula.

An employee was unhooking the initial hook on a cattle's hind leg. While re-hooking it to another shackle, the cattle's leg dropped down. The slack was not removed from the shackle due to mud and manure. The hook went up, and the employee's right thumb got caught in the shackle, causing an initial avulsion that later required surgical amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was cleaning loose cotton from around a banding machine when he was knocked into the machine. He sprained his ankle and suffered leg abrasions, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was tripping production pipe in a well using a rig and traveling block. A pipe slipped in the well, causing a pressure change and blowout. The employee went down an escape line and fell at about 10 feet above the ground, fracturing and lacerating his face.

An employee was performing mechanical work on a scissor lift. The employee inadvertently touched the controls, causing the scissor portion of the machine to cycle down on the employee's left index finger, fracturing and lacerating it.
An employee was helping a customer load merchandise into their vehicle. A forklift was backing up and crushed the employee's right foot. The employee suffered two fractured toes and required surgery.

An employee was erecting steel. He was straddling a steel beam suspended by a crane when the end of the beam seesawed up under him and pinned him against a column. He was hospitalized with a leg laceration.

An employee was walking downhill to the parking lot when he fell and rolled into the back of a parked car. He broke the bone under his right eye, cracked a rib, and broke a bone in his neck (C2). He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a band saw when something became caught in the blade. He attempted to push the item through when his left little finger got caught and was lacerated/amputated by the blade. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was painting a door and pinched a finger in the door hinge amputating the fingertip.

An employee was finishing a concrete double v-beam with a trowel when a coworker entered the building with a forklift. As the coworker passed the injured employee, his tire caught the employee and pinned him against the form and forklift. The injured employee suffered scrapes to his back, right arm, and right torso.

An employee was measuring plywood with a coworker when the coworker stepped on the plywood. The injured employee's finger got caught between two sheets of plywood and the left ring fingertip was snipped off. The employee required surgical amputation down to the first joint.
An employee walking in the cafeteria slipped on a puddle of milk, fell, and broke his right femur bone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying a tray of dishes from the dining room to the kitchen when the employee stepped in water on the floor near the facility's ice machine. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, breaking the hip bone on the left side and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was squatting down between the axel and the bumper of a truck. The truck started to lean and then fell from the jack stand, striking the employee in his lower back area. He was hospitalized with a lower back injury.

An employee was installing casing joints in a well using tongs when the bite of the tongs malfunctioned and the tongs bucked unexpectedly. The employee's hand got crushed between the tongs and the derrick, causing hand fractures.
An employee was cleaning/unclogging the cyclone when his middle finger got caught in the machine. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was helping a coworker demolish a fin fan part that was recently replaced on a cooling unit at the chemical plant. The employee's coworker was tasked with torch cutting a 15 feet x 25 feet, 3/16-inch steel fin fan part into smaller pieces for demolition and removal from the site. The employee was standing 6 to 8 feet away from the torch cutting operation. While the coworker was torch cutting the tail-end area on the fin fan, a side panel that measured 19 feet x 4.5 feet and weighed approximately 650 lbs. came off and fell, striking the employee in the right leg. The employee's right tibia and fibula were fractured.

A maintenance employee was investigating a suspected defective roller on a conveyor belt. The machine must be running to hear defective rollers. His hand was pulled into the machine, and the rollers rolled up onto his forearm. He suffered compound fractures to his radius and ulna and required surgery.

An employee entered the shipping area to turn off an air compressor.  When she turned to leave the area, she tripped over a platform scale on the floor and fell, breaking her arm. She was hospitalized overnight.

On November 23, 2015, at approximately 8:45 a.m., an employee was troubleshooting a 110-volt ultraviolet lamp on a press.  The employee turned the light off, removed a cover, manually adjusted the bulb, and then received an electrical shock. The employee suffered tightness of the chest and elevated blood enzymes and was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee and coworkers were removing a roller from a veneer dryer by hand. The roller slipped out of a coworker's hands, and the employee's finger was  trapped between the roller and the dryer. His left index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was positioning a 3-yard container to attach to a truck when his hand got pinched between the container and truck. He lacerated/fractured two fingers on his right hand and required hospitalization.
An employee lost their footing and fell in the jet way while boarding the aircraft. The employee scraped both elbows and knees and broke their right kneecap, requiring surgery.

An employee was replacing purlins on the roof when he fell approximately 30 feet to the ground through a hole, breaking his right arm and leg. He was wearing an unsecured harness at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning a propane dryer and blowing dust with compressed air when an explosion occurred. The employee suffered a shoulder injury and hand burns.
An employee had finished installing drywall and began to disassemble the scaffold with coworkers. Part of the scaffold pinched and cut his right thumb. He was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee suffered a fracture to his left hand while moving a hydraulic catwalk.
An employee was taking out the trash when the wind blew the fence into her head, fracturing her skull.
An employee tripped and fell down some stairs, striking her head on the handrail. She cut her forehead and required stitches.

An employee was welding two sections of pipe on top of a skid platform. The skid platform (2 feet high) collapsed, and the pipe rolled onto the employee's lower leg, fracturing the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
An employee walked into the Surgical Intensive Care Unit (SICU) room and began wheezing, causing an emergency response to be initiated. Bleach is suspected to have caused the wheezing.

An employee was repairing a slicer and was pushing on the pulley when the motor started. His finger got caught between the belt and pulley, amputating his right middle fingertip and requiring surgery.
An employee was thrown from his horse while rounding up cattle.  He hit his head and blacked out. He also fractured ribs and injured his right knee and shoulder.
An employee was conducting site preparation using a mini excavator when the vehicle flipped over, causing him to break his hip.

On November 23, 2015, an employee was reversing a powered industrial vehicle. The employee got on the walk behind the lift, began to back up, and became pinned between a railing and the lift, suffering a crushing injury to the right lower extremities.
An employee was spotting a front end loader. A traffic vehicle did not yield on the worksite and struck the front end loader, which in turn struck the employee. He broke bones in his right leg.
On or about 11/23/15, at approximately 10 p.m., an employee walking on the jobsite was struck in the chest by the arm and bucket of an excavator. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised heart.
An employee was using a robotic welder to lift a heavy pan of metal parts when he experienced a hernia that required surgery and overnight hospitalization.

An employee operating a truck was making a delivery on November 23, 2015. While exiting the vehicle, the employee stepped into a pothole, lost their balance, and struck their head against the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a severe concussion and nausea.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while reaching into a machine that was actuated by another operator. The employee required reattachment surgery.
An employee was fitting a 40-foot steel plate onto the bow rake of a barge. The plate came loose and fell on the employee's leg, breaking the employee's femur.

An employee in a roadway work zone was struck by a vehicle that left the roadway.  The employee had dismounted the equipment in a coned area when he was struck.  His leg broke, and he was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was attempting to dump scrap metal from a dumpster into his truck using a robotic arm. He was found disoriented in the cab of his delivery truck with a broken collar bone and concussion.
After performing electrical work, an employee was stepping down from an aerial lift when he slipped and injured his back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a piece of equipment when his left index finger was caught and amputated between a chain and sprocket. He was hospitalized.

On 11/23/15, at about 2:30 a.m., an employee was operating a forklift to empty a hopper of garbage into a dumpster. He placed his hand on top of the fork while pushing up on the hopper tilt release lever. When the hopper tilted forward, the employee's finger was pinched between the top of the fork and the bottom of the dumpster. His left index fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee slipped on ice and fell. The employee was hospitalized for head trauma.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder into an elevator pit to repair a sump pump. The employee fell 4 to 5 feet into the pit and suffered head trauma.
An employee was cutting billets using a band saw and amputated his right thumb up to 1/3 of the finger nail.

On Nov. 23, 2014, at approximately 9:00 PM, an employee sustained an animal bite (cat) to her right finger.  She was treated and released at the ER. Later, due to swelling, she was admitted to the hospital and underwent surgery on the tendon in her right finger.

An employee was watching an excavator operator dig a hole and he decided to get some measurements in the hole. As he was walking, a large rock rolled down and struck him in the pelvis, breaking his pelvic bones.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while the employee attempted to straighten a box in a vertical box conveyer system.
An employee was starting a new run of fiber. As she went to pull the fiber from the oven, her right hand and arm got caught in an adjustable conveyor. Her hand and arm were severely burned.
An employee was working on a roof and fell through a skylight. He hit his head and body and was hospitalized with head and back injuries. He was wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was counting inventory while riding a lift when the vehicle struck the forks of an upright forklift working in the same area. He fell approximately 19 feet with the lift basket and struck the concrete below, breaking his upper right arm, pelvis, and left leg. He was wearing fall protection at the time.
An unknown vehicle struck and dragged an employee 60 feet in the work-site parking lot. He was hospitalized with injuries to his entire body.
An employee fell through the guard rails of a 10-foot platform and broke his tail bone and vertebrae.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot, fracturing her left distal radius.
An employee tripped and fell over a floor mat that was rolled up on the floor near the locker room entrance. The employee struck the wall and fractured their right-eye orbital bone.

An employee was driving a golf cart. When he attempted to turn right, the golf cart left the paved path and his right knee hit a trash can. He attempted to hit the brake, but instead stepped on the accelerator. The golf cart flipped on top of him and injured his back, requiring surgery.
An employee was hit by a car in the parking lot while walking into work.

An employee was responsible for loading rail cars with peanuts. The employee climbed to the top of the rail car to position the shoot for the loading process. The employee was wearing a retractable harness at the time of the incident. The train began moving forward at a slow rate of speed, causing the retractable lanyard to become fully extended. The employee was pulled from the top of the rail car and impacted the ground resulting in serious injury (bleeding on the brain and a shoulder injury) requiring hospitalization.

While stepping off an electric pallet jack, an employee's foot got caught between a loading dock platform and a metal barricade. The bone(s) above his big toe shattered. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery. The jack was in motion at the time of the incident.

On 11/24/15, at 1900 hours, an employee was operating a rough terrain forklift on a steep grade. The forklift toppled over and pinned his left arm underneath. He was hospitalized with a broken arm and had surgery.
An employee was pulling on a light chain to get an alignment for a pavement edge. The chain broke, causing the employee to stumble, misstep, and fall. He broke his left tibia above the ankle.
While attempting to clean a jet foam airlock, an employee's fingertips were struck and amputated by the spinning part ("squirrel cage") of the airlock.
An employee was operating a gunning machine to shotcrete a cupola. He contacted the flywheel and amputated his right-hand middle fingertip.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to store products. He fell off the pallet jack and injured his hip.

An employee was threading paper into the padded bag line machine. When the paper passed through the notcher section, the employee attempted to support the paper with his hand. The notcher fired and amputated his right ring fingertip. The notcher was not turned off at the time of the incident.
An employee was carving a carcass with a knife when he suffered a laceration to his right knee.
An employee's toes were fractured while the employee was driving a pallet jack. The employee's foot was outside the jack at the time of the incident.

An employee was transferring wire cable from a spool to a cradle. His right-hand middle finger got caught between a washer and a bolt, amputating the distal third of his fingertip. He required reattachment surgery.
An employee fractured his left tibia when he was pinned by a an electric walking jack while putting a hopper under a shoot.

An employee was working the winder machine when the slitter blade failed to complete a cut on the paper. He attempted to complete the cut using a box knife when his right index finger got caught under the turning core. His fingertip was ultimately amputated.

On November 24, 2015, an employee was picking orders and climbed a racking system to reach for a part. While coming down from the racking system, he missed a step and fell backwards to the ground, hitting his head. His coworkers found him unconscious, and he was hospitalized for observation with head trauma.
An employee missed a step while exiting his truck, injuring his leg and pelvis.
An employee was climbing up the ladder when he fell resulting in a back injury.
An employee was changing a tool inside of a forging press and pinched a finger between the tool and the mold flange. The right index fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was driving a Vermeer flex track loader onto a flat bed trailer when the load shifted forward. This caused the Vermeer flex track loader to fall off of the trailer and strike the employee's foot resulting in crushing injuries that required surgery.
An employee was walking from the parking lot to the building caring a casserole dish. The employee tripped on the curb and fell onto the dish. The employee was later hospitalized for broken ribs.

An employee was assisting in moving a monorail frame steel structure by rigging the frame to a winch and roust about. The steel cable carrying a 1,800 pound steel beam snapped and the steel beam fell to the floor, bounced, and struck the employee on the upper left leg and breaking the femur bone.
An employee slipped on the ice while walking from their vehicle to the production buildings, fracturing the right ankle.

Two employees were walking on facility grounds, in the street, by the 1590 Building. They were walking with traffic and one employee was struck by an automobile and was hospitalized with a skull fracture, torn ear that had to be reattached, fractured ribs and lacerations and contusions.
An employee was delivering a carpet with a cart. The carpet fell off the cart, and the employee injured his shoulder when he tried to grab it.
An employee fell four to six feet from the top of the tanker truck breaking ribs and the left elbow.
An employee was using a "PV stick" to separate wood on a conveyer belt, when it became stuck on a piece of wood and kicked back hitting the employee in the head.
The employee was driving a forklift and pinched their right hand on the warehouse rack resulting in an amputation injury to the right middle finger.

An employee was unloading equipment at a storage facility. A 2" x 6" x 20' steel bar rolled onto the employee's left-hand pinky finger, crushing it between the bar and trailer. The first digit of the finger was surgically amputated.
An employee suffered a partial amputation while performing maintenance operations on an HVAC system. The system for the pressure door was not shut off at the time of the incident.
The employee was walking from her desk to the copy room, tripped over another employee's foot, and fell fracturing her hip.
An employee slipped while climbing down a ladder, hit his face, and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a strapper machine after making boxes. The machine amputated his left pinky fingertip when he moved it back into position.
An employee was unloading a truck at the dock area at the end of the day. He fell in between the truck and the dock breaking his right leg. He was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
While on duty, an employee approached a shoplifter to request he return stolen items and was stabbed in the chest and left arm with a knife by the shoplifter.
An employee was walking to the restroom when a forklift operator ran over the employee's right foot, resulting in an inpatient hospitalization.

An employee received a distal amputation of his left middle finger while transporting a cart loaded with scaffolding. The rolling cart shifted and the employee's hand was pinched between the cart handle and an I-beam.

On November 25, 2015, at approximately 11:45am, a BORSTAR Agent fell while climbing on top of a mountain.  The agent fell approximately 15-20 feet, bounced on his back, and fell another 5 to 10 feet before landing. He suffered a concussion, a laceration to the back of his head requiring staples, several possible broken ribs, and multiple cuts and bruises.

On November 25, 2015, an employee was removing floor tiles with a razor scraper hand tool. While he attempted to replace a blade on the razor scraper, the blade contacted and deeply lacerated his wrist, possibly damaging tendons.

The employee was sliding 1/4 inch by 14 feet long angle iron from the forks of a forklift onto the storage racks.  The employee pinched his right ring finger between the angle iron and the fork of the forklift.  The incident resulted in the amputation of the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was offloading a metal container (auto part dolly) onto a mobile cart when her left-hand ring finger got pinched between the two metal pieces. Her fingertip was amputated below the nail.
An employee was handling line on a barge when he stepped into an open hatch and fell onto the steel deck, cracking his rib and bruising his liver. The hatch was unguarded at the time.

An employee was removing boxes from an automatic conveyor because they were not sealed properly. Her movement in her working space adjacent to the conveyor line became hindered by the multiple boxes she removed from the conveyor, so she went to push the conveyor stop. As she was doing this, she tripped and fell, breaking her knee cap (patella).
An employee's left ring finger was partially amputated while she was removing a valve from a manual valve tester.
An employee amputated her left pinky fingertip while cutting tomatoes during lunch preparation.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of the right middle finger.
The employee was using a step jack to position a patch under a rail car when the jack slipped and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.

On November 25, 2015, an employee was delivering freight to a customer site. While unloading products from his truck, he walked down an icy metal ramp behind the store. He slipped and fell on the icy surface, suffering an L2 compression fracture in his back that required hospitalization. He was wearing his safety boots at the time of the incident.

On November 25, 2015, an employee was loading a 1300 lb. roll of plastic onto a roll stand using an overhead hoist. The roll struck the frame of the press, bounced out of the sling, and struck the employee breaking three ankle bones.
While conducting an inventory check in preparation for an inspection, an employee was climbing a fixed ladder and fell approximately 12 feet. He was hospitalized.
The employee was working in maintenance utility area when he stepped through a door and fell a little over three feet to the bottom of an air channel. He fractured his right fibula and tibia.
An employee stepped backward into a stairwell on the second floor mezzanine that had no stairs and fell 24 feet to the ground.
An employee attempted to fault a pin motor machine near the point of operation. His finger made contact with a machine part, and his left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was assaulted by a patient on 11/25/15 at 10:20am. During the assault, the patient knelt on the employee's chest. The employee was later hospitalized for a heart attack.
An employee was threading paper into a slitter machine and contacted the slitter blade amputating the left index fingertip.
An employee was pulling shopping carts from a cart corral, tripped, and fell in the parking lot. The employee fractured the right hip.
An employee climbing a fixed ladder at a cotton gin slipped and fell approximately 8-10 ft. breaking a hip.

An employee was installing holiday decorations from the bucket of a bucket truck when the piston broke on the lower arm of the bucket truck causing the bucket to fall with the employee harnessed inside. The employee suffered broken ribs and a lacerated spleen.

An employee working on a oil and gas drilling rig fell from a height of 85 feet due to icy conditions on the derrick board.  The ladder safety device did not engage properly resulting in the employee's fall. The employee was hospitalized with multiple broken bones, internal injuries, and lacerations.
An employee was cutting beef and lacerating his left arm requiring stiches and surgery.
An employee slipped on the wet pavement and fell resulting in a broken hip.
An employee tripped after catching their foot in a skid and fell.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee bent down to check an in-ground water meter when something punctured his knee. He kept working and washed it off later. Over the ensuing weekend it became swollen with a red line down his leg. He was later admitted for an infection.

An employee sustained second degree burns on the left side of their face, neck, arm, hand and both legs from hot oil. The employee was cleaning a slurry screen for a pump and opened the flange to check for product flow. A coke plug was present and let loose during the pulling of the screen which allowed hot oil to release and spray the employee.
An employee was picking up a bag of laundry weighting 10-15 lbs. and strained her back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a saw and contacted the saw blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An operator was in the process of unclogging a machine when his left ring finger was caught and amputated by the equipment.
An employee was walking to his vehicle in the company's parking lot and slipped on ice or snow fracturing the left leg and ankle.

While attempting to clean out over flow candy from an unsecured tall display shelving unit, an employee stood on a 4 inch ledge to reach the area and the display tipped over and fell on top of her. Her right ankle was fractured.
On 11/28/2015 at 5:00 pm, an employee was walking up to the door to deliver the pizza when he slipped and fell on the ice near the garage. During the fall, he hit his head and fractured his ankle.
An employee crushed their left middle and index fingertips in a patty machine.

An operator was injured while preparing equipment for maintenance by flushing the equipment with condensate (warm water) and flushing it into an oily water sewer system.  While performing the flush, it went to the hydrocarbon sewer where it flashed and ignited. The employee suffered second degree burns to the lower face and neck region and lesser burns to his right hand.

An employee was in the process of isolating voltage to the live front transformer in an ice storm.  He was attempting to install a load break device to dump the load and the insulated stick he was using arced from the switch attachment to the fiberglass stick.  The employee was shocked and admitted to the hospital.
A mail carrier slipped and fell on ice, fracturing his leg. This resulted in an inpatient hospitalization for surgery.

An employee was unloading boxes inside a trailer. A 35 lb. box of batteries fell and struck the employee in the head. The employee suffered a muscle strain in the neck and possible cracked or broken vertebrae.

An employee was greasing a bearing on the air handler. The employee wiped off excess grease from the moving belt and the employee's finger was caught in the belt resulting in the amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee suffered a broken leg and ankle after slipping and falling on a wet, slick floor.
On November 29, 2015, an employee was hospitalized when exposed to high levels of carbon monoxide.
An employee was servicing an HVAC unit when his hand came in contact with live electrical voltage.
An employee was attempting to lift a part when the chain/hoist slipped off the part and the chain struck the employee in the face fracturing facial bones on the left side just below the eye.
An delivery driver slipped on snow or ice when getting out of his delivery vehicle and fell on his hip, aggravating an existing condition. The employee was hospitalized for further treatment/surgery.

The employer was delivering trusses to a deck with an all terrain forklift. As the forklift pulled out, the trusses fell onto the deck, the deck gave way, and the employee fell. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was working on roof installing an exhaust fan. The employee stepped back and fell through a skylight to the floor 12 to 15 feet below. The employee was admitted to the hospital for a head injury and surgery.

On November 30, 2015, an employee was adjusting the throttle cable on his work golf cart. The employee was pulling on the throttle cable and the cart started and moved backwards. He fell to the ground and abraded his left knee. He was seen by the company physician who dressed the wound and the employee returned to work. He was later admitted to the local hospital for treatment of an infection.
An employee was backing up the milling machine and struck another employee that was sweeping the road. The employee suffered a fractured tail bone.
On November 30, 2015, a machine operator had his right index finger amputated when he attempted to clean a dough ball making machine.
An employee was using a roller cart to move stock paper rolls. The employee caught his left leg between the roller cart and a fixed ladder breaking it.
An employee stepped out onto the damp porch, slipped, and fell injuring her left knee.

An employee was using a Sumner roust-a-bout to lift an I Beam.  The roust-a-bout lost balance and tipped over.  The employee tried to stop the I-Beam from falling.  The I-beam fell and landed on the employee's left pinky finger crushing it. The finger was amputated.

A welder was operating a horizontal band saw.  There was a hydraulic clamp for the material being cut.  The employee pushed the button for the clamp and his left thumb was caught in the clamp, cutting it open. The employee was admitted to the hospital for hand surgery.
An employee was cleaning a guest room and got a splinter in her left thumb. She was later hospitalized for an infection.

An employee was performing maintenance on the Niagara Punch Press machine. He was looking at the die setting. When the machine cycled, the employee's hand was caught between the pin and bussing resulting in the right forearm amputation.
An employee's finger was caught in a rotating part. A finger on the right hand was amputated at the second digit by a physician.
A temporary employee was clearing a jam on a cotton swab machine and sustained a fingertip amputation to the left hand.
An employee amputated the tips of the right middle and ring fingers when a metal plate fell onto his fingers.
The employee was removing a strap from a crate on a rack. The pallet and crate fell off the rack hitting the employee in the chest area.
An employee was soldering a water pipe while standing on a 6 foot self supporting ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and was hospitalized for bleeding in the brain.

An employee had his right foot on rollers to walk around a pallet that was in the walkway. When the employee placed his right foot in the rollers, the rollers turned.  This caused the employee to fall backwards. His left foot struck the pallet resulting in a dislocated ankle and a broken tibia.

An employee was servicing an internal hangar door when it traveled beyond its limit point. His hand got trapped between the hangar door and a hose reel assembly on the adjacent wall and was crushed. His left ring finger was amputated.
An employee was setting beams using a crane and lifting hoist when a beam tipped over and broke his leg.
An employee fell on the wet sidewalk and fractured her hip.

After loading a truck, an employee tried to close the door on the trailer. The trailer was moving away, and his finger got caught between the door and the condenser stand that straddles the dock, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, breaking her right wrist.
An employee lost her footing and fell in the parking lot, breaking her hip.
An employee fell over and bumped his head as he was trying to remove weed stickers from his pant leg and shoes. He suffered abrasions to the head and arm.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger while servicing/cleaning the sensing device on a paper sheeter machine.
A bathroom stall door swung back and struck an employee in the face, fracturing her nose.
An employee fell from an A-frame ladder onto his back and experienced extreme pain.

An employee was using an extension ladder to check the liquid level in a tank when the ladder lost its footing, causing him to fall about 10 feet to the ground below. He fractured his right wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while exiting her vehicle, injuring her right shoulder.

An employee was moving building material on a construction site using a "piggy-back" type forklift. The load shifted and tipped the forklift. The employee hit his head and was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was painting while standing on a 4.5-foot baker scaffold. He fell off the scaffold, injuring his head, ribs, and back on the concrete floor below.

An employee was struck in the face while blowing down a reinjection line at an oilfield production location, resulting in facial bone fractures, a hole in the roof of his mouth, tooth loss, and a big gash on his right cheek near/under the lower edge of his safety glasses. He required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a restaurant cooking flue when he fell from the roof to the ground, requiring hospitalization.
While an employee was moving a loader, the loader door came back and closed on his thumb.

An employee was calibrating a machine. As he turned around, he lost his balance and fell. He tried to catch himself by grabbing the machine, which had an exposed mixture arm on it.  The mixture arm was turning and caught the fingers on his right hand, amputating his index and ring fingertips.

An employee was welding on some carbon steel with a MIG welder when his right hand caught on fire. As he tried to put out the fire, his other hand caught on fire. He suffered second and third degree burns.
An employee slipped and fell while climbing a fixed ladder to the lashing platform on a ship. He fell 8 feet to the ship deck and fractured his right ankle.

An employee was picking up trash and polishing bollards at the loading dock.  A coworker was also using the same dock to load groceries into a freight trailer. The coworker was using a standup forklift and did not see the employee. When the employee stepped out of the bollard area, the coworker's forklift ran over and crushed his left foot.

An employee was setting up a machine for boxes. While he was cleaning the feed wheels, his left hand was pulled into the feed rolls. He received cuts on his palm and a bone fracture, requiring surgery.
While delivering mail/packages to a residence that had no sidewalk, an employee slipped in the mud, fell, and broke her right ankle.
An employee was cleaning a wheel feed guide. As he exited the area, his hand got caught in the feed channel wheels, crushing and amputating his left thumb.
An employee's right index finger was amputated while operating a press machine.

While climbing a fixed metal ladder (ship's ladder) to the high roof of a high school building, an employee slipped and fell approximately 12 feet to the ground, landing on his back and fracturing two vertebrae.

An employee fell 6 feet from a ladder to the cement floor while installing a piece of pipe duct work for an HVAC system. The pipe got hung up on a wire and hit the ladder, knocking him down. He fractured his right forearm.

An employee attached a chain sling to an engine and was removing engine parts with a pneumatic tool. The vibration from the pneumatic tools caused the chain sling to slip, and the engine fell about 6 inches onto the drain table. The employee's left hand was crushed between the engine and drain table, requiring surgery.
An employee was standing on the dock plate, helping to unload a truck, when the truck pulled away. He fell from the load dock to the concrete ground, injuring his head and shoulder.

An employee was on an outdoor sign, installing a vinyl.  He was wearing a safety harness, and the lanyard was attached to a wooden part of the sign, which gave way.  He fell 15 to 18 feet to the ground below, injuring his head and torso.
An employee was kneeling down to hand grate or hand shovel when a bobcat operator struck the employee, injuring his right tibia.
An employee was installing a part in a press machine when her leg hit the switch. Her left pinky fingertip got caught in the machine and was partially amputated.
On or about December 1, 2015, an employee's right middle finger was crushed and fractured while setting up the "straight draw" press.

While an employee was operating an automatic welding machine, the foot pedal of the machine was activated. His left thumb got crushed between the pedal of the welding machine, requiring amputation. He was wearing welding gloves at the time of the incident.

An employee stepped into a storage tote to retrieve fishing line. The tote tipped over, causing the employee to fall into the hold of the ship. The employee suffered a broken right wrist and right leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee attempted to remove a jammed piece of wood from a running saw. When the jam was relieved, the 12" diameter saw started rotating and deeply lacerated the palm of his right hand.

On December 1, 2015, an employee and a coworker had cut down three trees.  While they were cutting up the trees that lay on the ground, the employee's chain saw blade got pinched in a tree.  The coworker, who was located upslope from the tree, made a cut in it to relieve the pinch pressure on the saw blade. When the cut was completed, the tree rolled down the slope and over the employee. He suffered bruises and abrasions to his face and head, as well as broken ribs.
On or about December 03, 2015, an employee was lining up paper on the die cutter machine. The machine cycled, and the employee's finger got caught and was amputated between the machine rollers.

On 12/2/2015, at approximately 12 p.m., an employee was climbing a ladder to the roof to install fall protection anchor points. The decking under the ladder was frosted over.  As the employee climbed the ladder, the ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to the decking.  The employee was hospitalized with contusions to the left shoulder, left leg, and ribs.
An employee attempted to remove a metal object from the dough on a dough conveyor. The employee's right hand got caught and smashed between the conveyor and roller.
An employee was holding a shaft that was being knocked out when his finger got pinched between the shaft and the repair box. His right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was holding down product in a weld fixture with their right hand. The employee's right pinky fingertip was pinched in one of two pivot points and the tip was amputated.
An employee was operating a bulldozer to conduct site preparation work. Coworkers found him unconscious on the ground near the bulldozer with neck and arm injuries. He was hospitalized.

On December 2, 2015, at approximately 8:45 AM, an employee was changing out propane tanks on a forklift when another forklift operator backed into him, pinning him between the two lifts and fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was evaluating a jam around the back of the cutter machine. His glove came into contact with a guarded belt and pulley, which caught his glove and pulled his right hand in. A section of his right index finger was amputated.
On 12/2/2015, at 12:00 to 12:30 pm, an employee was hand washing the inside of a drinking glass using a rag. The glass broke and cut her hand.
An employee saw a build up of rice on the rice polisher feed hopper. He shut off the equipment to clean it. His right fingertip got caught in the feed hopper and was amputated.
While dismounting a material handler, an employee lost his balance and fell approximately 3 feet.  He struck his rib cage on the machine stabilizer, suffering a contusion/bruise.
While delivering a package to a residential home, an employee slipped and fell on wet blacktop pavement. She twisted her ankle and suffered a compound fracture to her tibia.

An employee was demonstrating the function of a sliding axle trailer to a coworker when the trailer drifted unexpectedly and caught the employee's finger in one of the adjustment holes. The employee's right index finger was amputated.
On December 2, 2015, an employee was giving a bath to a patient. The tub door closed on the employee's hand, which became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was securing his cargo on a flatbed trailer. After securing his load, he tripped on the cargo securing strap and fell to the ground, fracturing his left knee and left wrist.
While attempting to clear a jam in a heat seal bag machine, an employee's pinky finger was amputated.
On 12/2/15, at about 3:30 p.m., two employees got into an altercation. One employee was pushed to the ground and was hospitalized with a shoulder and back sprain/strain.

An employee was reaching for boxes while on top of a pallet. When she turned to step off of the pallet, her foot got caught in shrink wrap, causing her to trip and fall. She landed on her left wrist and broke it, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized for work-related leg pain.

An employee was dumping cardboard boxes into a recycling container using a forklift. When he tilted the forks to allow the boxes to slide off into the container, the pallet also slid into the container.  While attempting to remove the pallet, the employee slipped and fell, hitting his face on the ledge of the container.  He continued to fall to the floor, hitting his face again on the pavement. He broke two eye sockets, his nose, and a bone behind his upper lip.
An employee was repairing a hot water boiler when a bolt snapped and the employee was sprayed with hot water. The employee was hospitalized with burns.
An employee slipped on an infant toy on the floor and broke her hip.
An employee attempted to move a lawnmower that became stationary. His right foot slipped and fell into the blades, amputating his toes.
An employee was using a jib crane to pick up a return pig. When using the pendant to lift the pig, his finger got stuck between two chain links, amputating his fourth left-hand finger's first pad.

An employee exited a room on the third floor of the building being cleaned. The exit door was unmarked, unlocked, and led to the flat roof, which had a parapet wall. The employee fell three stories and broke a leg.
An employee was wearing gloves and sorting I beams with his hands.  One beam slid and rolled and caught his finger. The employee had half of his middle finger surgically removed.

An employee was manually feeding a plastic sheet through a hydraulic/pneumatic press set on manual mode. The press then cycled and caught his left thumb in the point of operation area, amputating his thumb tip.
While cutting vegetables with a knife, an employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was assembling a mobile set of stairs while standing on a ladder. The employee was trying to get a strap off a platform and fell from the ladder to the lower level. The employee suffered a broken jaw and right shoulder fracture.
An employee was walking on top of the load on the flat bed trailer, unfolding a tarp.  He lost his footing and fell to the ground fracturing his skull in the left temple area and his right wrist.

An employee was attempting to connect two dollies. The rear dolly gained momentum, causing the employee to lose control. The dolly tongue crushed and amputated the employee's right-hand ring fingertip.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when he slipped and fell, breaking his right shoulder.

An employee was helping to remove a belt from a pulley attached to a fan used in the ginning process. While moving the belt manually, his finger got pinched between the belt and pulley, partially amputating his right pinky fingertip.

An employee was operating a can densifying machine that crushes aluminum cans. The employee's right foot got caught in the hydraulically controlled door to the machine, crushing and possibly amputating the toes.
An employee traveling on a forklift stopped quickly when a scrubber cut in front of his machine. The machine's load shifted, so the employee exited the vehicle. He slipped and broke his right leg.
An employee's left thumb tip was amputated while she was cutting pork loin with a band saw.

An employee entered an oven from a side access door located 12 feet aboveground to clean and clear the rollers of the coating machine. When the employee was in the oven, she stepped onto a pressure release trap door, causing the door to open. She fell 12 feet to the ground below, sustaining multiple fractures to her right ankle and possibly lower back fractures.
An employee's left hand was crushed while operating the sheet metal roller machine.
An employee was dumping garbage into the waste dump when an automobile slammed into the back of the truck, pinning the employee between the car and truck. Both of the employee's legs were amputated.
An employee suffered burns to 45% of his lower body when a plastic bottle of diesel fuel blew up near him while he was trimming logs.

On December 03, 2015, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was using the brisket saw when the circular blade of the brisket saw lacerated his abdomen. The laceration required stitches and overnight hospitalization.

An employee was operating a spindle machine. The process required 14 bolts, but the employee noticed that there was only 13 bolts. When she tried to put in the 14th bolt, moving parts came down and caught her left-hand pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

Workers were using bottle jacks to move a heat treatment oven laterally. One of the bottle jacks moved out of position, causing the footing of the oven to come down and crush the injured employee's left hand.
While walking from one patient's duplex to another, an employee slipped and fell on a grassy area that was covered in ice. The employee fractured their tibia.
An employee was walking down the stairs and fell forward approximately 3 feet. She dislodged several teeth and fractured her gum line and upper jaw.

An employee was working on a sample table, loading weights into the benefits inserts of a punch machine. She missed a weight in one of the inserts and shut the machine off to add the weight. The machine restarted and caught the employee's finger between the punch and the insert. Her left index finger was amputated.
An employee had just serviced a portable toilet and stepped on the passenger side of the truck. While the truck was moving, he fell off and injured his head.

An employee attempted to retrieve a small strip of scrap metal behind the shears. The employee's foot actuated the machine via the treadle while the employee's fingers were in the point of operation, amputating the right middle fingertip.
An employee was working on a motor house belt system when her arm got caught between the belt and the metal beam of the conveyor system.

An employee was carrying an 8-feet-long, 7-feet-wide, reinforced wire mesh on the flat roof of a new building. As he was approaching the area where the wire mesh was to be installed, the wire mesh snagged with the handle of the power pack, causing him to trip. He fell on a 2" by 6" foam board, fracturing his lower left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee placed material on stacks with a standup forklift. He reversed into a second forklift and was thrown to the ground, injuring his lower back and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was getting ready to load two intermediate bulk containers. The two containers slammed against each other and caught the employee's finger between them. The left pinky fingernail tip was amputated.
An employee was assaulted by a shoplifter and was knocked unconscious, suffering a head injury.
An employee slipped on the wet floor in the break room and sustained right wrist, knee, and neck injuries.
An employee slipped on a wet floor while cleaning the bathroom and fractured a hip.

An employee was on a ladder repairing a minor water leak on a pipe above the ceiling.  The pipe/coupling failed, and the employee was sprayed with hot water and knocked off the ladder. The employee suffered a back injury and arm burn.
An employee was unstrapping office tables from the inside of a truck when the tables fell on top of him. He sustained 10 broken ribs and a gash to the head.

An employee was assisting a pit fitter. When a track hoe operator adjusted a pipe approximately 300 feet away, it caused the pipe to fall off the pipe stand and strike the employee just above the left ankle. The employee's ankle fractured.
An employee was moving a metal coil from one part of a metal slitting machine to another. The metal coil sliced through the sling being used and lacerated the employee's right shin and foot.
An employee's right middle fingertip was amputated while he was cutting meat on a chuck saw.

Employees were performing new building construction. An angle iron slipped and became caught between other objects at a height of approximately 10 to 15 feet aboveground. An employee accessed a ladder to inspect what the angle iron was caught on and determine how it would be removed when the angle iron fell to the ground and struck the ladder, knocking the employee off. The employee fell approximately 8 feet to the ground and struck their head. The employee suffered wrist and skull fractures and required stitches.
An employee was operating a hydraulic impulse system when materials hit him in the face. He was hospitalized overnight with broken facial bones.

An employee was loading railcars with petroleum coke. As he was coupling up the railcars, his left foot got caught under the railcar. He called out to the locomotive operator to back the railcar in the other direction to relieve the pressure off his foot, which was crushed in the process and required hospitalization.
An employee's right-hand little fingertip was amputated when a 2x4 piece of lumber dropped suddenly and smashed the employee's finger.

An employee was applying a dry-film lubricant with a spray can and nozzle extender onto a conveyor to eliminate/reduce package slippage. The employee's coat got caught in the rollers and pulled his right hand/forearm in. He sustained ligament and tendon damage.
An employee's right foot was run over by a construction vehicle, fracturing the right ankle.
An employee was performing maintenance on a molding machine when his right arm got caught and injured. He was hospitalized.

An employee was struck by the door handle of a roll-off garbage container when it snapped open while he was manually opening it.  He was hospitalized with bruises and lacerations to the right cheek and a possible nose fracture.
An employee was using a wrench to remove pipe while standing on a stairway platform. The wrench slipped, and the employee fell off the stairway, suffering a lower back injury.
An employee was struck by a car while crossing the street. The employee's right arm broke, and their bowel was punctured.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while servicing an air unit on the roof of a fast food restaurant.

On December 3, 2015, at approximately 1:45 pm, an employee fell from an 8-foot fiberglass stepladder. The employee was installing an exterior light on the side of a building using a hammer drill while standing on the stepladder. The employee fell from the ladder and struck the concrete driveway, fracturing both wrists.  The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
Employee experienced a heart attack while shoveling snow.

Two employees were driving a company golf cart across an intersection when an automobile ran the stop sign and struck the cart. One of the employees sustained five broken ribs and a broken collarbone, while the second employee suffered knee bruises and a strained neck.
An employee slipped and fell while coming out of the laundry room in an inventory home, breaking the right hip.
An employee was trying to pop a load bearing out. He put both fingers into the area of the locking pin and then it came down and amputated the distal aspect of the right index and little fingers.
On Friday, December 4, 2015, around 8:30 a.m., an employee got out of his vehicle and slipped and fell on ice while walking in the parking lot. He had surgery for a dislocated/fractured left ankle.
An employee was checking a collection box and lost his balance as he stood up. As he attempted to jump the front of the collection box ditch, the impact of the landing fractured his lower left leg.

An employee was tightening the nipple onto a choke manifold with a 36 inch pipe wrench. As the employee was tightening the nipple, the wrench slipped causing the employee to shift his weight to his right leg and fracture it above the ankle.
