An employee was disconnecting a piece of flow iron from a pump. He was supporting the piece of pipe with his left hand and hitting it with his right hand when it suddenly disconnected. Due to the weight of the pipe, it dropped about 1 foot, catching his left ring finger between the iron and rear bumper of the pump and amputating the fingertip. He required surgery.

An employee went into her office, retrieved something, and was leaving to go to a meeting. She tripped on the carpet, fell over her carrying case, and hurt her right side, back and leg. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery on her leg.
An employee was cleaning the pipes on the ice cream machine when his right index finger was amputated by the pipe's metal paddle. The machine was not locked out at the time.
While retrieving an item from a trailer, an employee fell through a gap between the dock plate and trailer. One leg fell through first, and she broke her pelvis.

An employee was using the "button machine" to crimp pieces of fabric around buttons. One of the pieces of fabric was off center and the employee reached under the guard to slide the fabric back into place.  The employee pressed the foot pedal that operates the machine while her hand was still in the machine and amputated the right index fingertip and fractured the right middle finger.
While walking into the bathroom, an employee tripped on rubber matting and fell on her hip, breaking it in two places. She was hospitalized.

On Friday 12/4/2015, at 6 pm, an employee was scooping flux from a galvanized zinc kettle. As he was putting the excess flux into a 55-gallon drum, the hot flux boiled up and popped. The splash from the flux went down into his leather glove, resulting in second degree burns on the left hand and wrist.

An employee was loading a scrap wheel into a scrap bin while wearing double cotton gloves. The glove got caught on the edge of the wheel as he set it on the edge of the bin to be thrown in. As he let the wheel go into the bin, his right pinky got caught between the edge of the wheel and the edge of the bin, amputating his right pinky fingertip (without bone loss).
An employee was bending a piece of metal on a brake press when the metal came up and pinched his finger against the die. His left index fingertip was amputated right below the fingernail.
An employee fell 6 feet from a ladder that was leading up to a trailer. The employee was hospitalized overnight with a back injury.
An employee was preparing to apply ice melt to the sidewalks around the post office when she slipped on ice and broke several bones. She was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting a rated test on a coil assembly. After completing the test, she received an electrical shock while removing the test leads. She fell to the floor and was hospitalized.

A stucco crew set up two A-frame scaffold frames inside a 10x10 enclosed porch area and placed some planks between the frames. The ground that the scaffold was on was not level or solid.  A worker climbed on the planks between the frames and began applying stucco to the walls.  One of the frames slipped and fell over causing the worker to fall to the ground breaking his right arm in a manner that requires surgery. He also suffered scrapes and bruises.

An employee was gluing magnet assemblies at a table with caster wheels. She unlocked the caster wheels and started rolling the table to another location. The table splintered and fell, along with all its contents, onto the employee's right ankle. She was hospitalized and required surgery for a compound fracture to her ankle.
An employee was working on an agitator when one of the pieces of equipment shifted and crushed the employee's pinky finger. The finger had to be partially medically amputated.
An employee's left thumb tip was amputated while cutting lamb chops with a band saw.
An employee was power washing a van when the employee was overcome by carbon monoxide poisoning from the power washer.

An employee reached into a horizontal band saw as it was running to either insert or remove a block. The pipe clamp on the saw closed and pinched her finger between the clamp and the block, partially amputating her left index fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell off the curb, breaking her ankle.

On or about December 04, 2015, a worker was working on a tie machine when a jam occurred. The worker called the injured employee for assistance. The injured employee disconnected the energy source, a pneumatic airline, and proceeded to clear the jam manually. As the employee tried to clear the jam, the machine's cutting knife was actuated, amputating the employee's right fingertip.

An employee was cleaning a transfer roller on a lamination machine with a rag. While using a "job" pedal with his foot in slow speed, he began cleaning the roller. The rag got caught and his hands were pulled into a nip point. He was hospitalized and received stitches.

On Saturday, December 5, 2015, at about 9:25 AM, an employee processing fruit on a conveyor belt attempted to remove a grapefruit. His finger got stuck in the roller spreader and the end joint of his right-hand middle finger was amputated.

Employees were attempting to insert a section of U-adjuster shackle into a chain link using a sledge hammer. The injured employee was holding the shackle. As a coworker swung on the hammer, the injured employee's hand slipped and got struck by the hammer. His left index finger was partially amputated.

On 12/5/15, an employee was switching out 55-gallon drums of wall waterproofing material in a waterproofing truck when an explosion occurred. The employee suffered second and third degree burns to the abdomen, back, and face and was hospitalized.

An employee suffered a serious injury to his right hand while positioning a 1700 pound could blade onto a table.  The injured employee suffered a broken index finger and cuts to three other fingers on his right hand when the part shifted as it was being moved with an overhead crane.  The injury occurred in the weld shop.
An employee was operating a rigid cable machine when his left hand got caught between a wire and a capstan sheave. While attempting to free his hand, he amputated his left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was picking up debris in the main work area. He walked up to an excavator as the bucket was turning. The bucket struck his shoulder, causing him to fall down and hit his head.

An employee was cleaning a running conveyor machine. The employee lost balance and put a hand up to catch themselves. The employee's hand and arm were pulled into the machine by a pulley, resulting in multiple hand fractures that required surgery. The pulley was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to secure an anti-tip chain with one hand while a crane pendant was in the other hand. He lost his balance and fell approximately 18 inches off the platform he was on, lacerating his left kidney.

On December 5, 2015, an employee operating a forklift collided, head-on, with a second forklift operator. The employee was thrown from the vehicle and was struck by his own forklift. He suffered a concussion and a de-gloving injury on his left foot and ankle.  He also fractured his left-foot big toe and was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting a roof for pesticide application on the building. The employee slipped and slid off the roof to the ground floor, breaking two legs and shattering the right ankle.
An employee fell backwards while adjusting wood with a pick-pole and suffered a broken back.
An employee was pulling a wire using needle nose pliers. The pliers slipped, and the wire struck and severely injured the employee's right eye.
An employee was taking merchandise from the backroom to the sales floor. As he was lifting a car jack off a pallet, he heard a pop. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was about to start moving a train and decided to close the door. When he shut the door, his left thumb was crushed. He was hospitalized with a fractured left thumb.
An employee was cleaning tables when she touched fish juice on a dish. She could not breathe and was hospitalized for a food allergy.
An employee was installing a curtain wall when his finger was pinched.
On or about 12/06/2015, an employee was standing on a ladder adjacent to a rotating apple grinder shaft when his sleeve got entangled in the shaft. He suffered two fractures to his right arm.

An employee was untangling a wire tangle at the capstan.  The employee tried to cut the tangle when his left hand got caught in the ball of wire, amputating two fingers. The machine was still in operation at the time.

While troubleshooting a jam on a crystallizer machine, an employee's left-hand middle and ring fingertips were amputated by the rotary airlock. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee's hand got caught between an unguarded conveyor chain and sprocket. The employee's thumb was amputated.
An employee was hospitalized on December 6, 2015, to have work-related hernia surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting a 200KVA welder. The equipment inadvertently cycled and amputated two fingers to the first joint on the employee's right hand.
An employee tripped and fell while walking injuring the left femur.

An employee was helping another employee clear out a 2 x 4 piece of board on a conveyor belt.  The employee's left hand struck the metal frame of the conveyor belt resulting in the amputation of his left index fingertip.
An employee was operating a power press when his left pinky got pinched and amputated by a steel coil.
An employee's left index finger was partially amputated while operating a punch press.
An employee doing fiber optic installation was climbing a communication pole and fell from an unknown height.  The employee suffered a couple of cracked ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was moving 55 gallon drums and smashed a finger between a drum and the barrel picker. The fingertip was amputated below the thumb nail.
While drilling aluminum, an employee's right middle finger was amputated when it got caught in a stationary drill.
An employee at the receiving department was hit in the head when palletized TV's felt over. The palletized TV's were being pulled down using a walkie stacker.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he fell for an unknown reason.  The employee was found on the floor unconscious and was hospitalized.
An employee's right ring fingertip was amputated while using a band saw to repair a tractor.

An employee was walking along the top of a trench that was 4 feet deep, and was carrying a 13 foot long, 8 inch diameter PVC pipe.  The victim slipped, fell into the trench, and sustained a broken neck.
An employee was drilling a metal bracket onto a machine and was struck by the bracket, suffering an eye injury.
An employee was hospitalized when a forklift ran over his foot.
An employee fell approximately five feet from a shelf while retrieving a motor.  The employee fractured his right wrist and his right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a printing plate and got his hand caught in a pinch point between two rollers when another employee jogged the machine using the registration button. The employee suffered three broken fingers and a degloving injury to the right palm.
An employee was removing a coupling from a rotating pipe when his glove was caught in the rotating pipe. The employee's wrist was wrenched and later surgically repaired.
A worker fell approximately seven feet from a mobile scaffold resulting in hospitalization for severe head trauma.
An employee working on a milling machine cut his hand between the thumb and first finger.  The cut went to the wrist.
An employee tripped and fell over a bucket containing a sodium hydroxide (10-15%) solution. The employee suffered chemical burns to the arms, back and legs.
An employee was walking toward a stainless steel table in the room when she tripped and fell over a hose containing product, breaking her hip.

An employee was moving a pallet with a manual pallet jack when a forklift operator struck the employee while making a U-turn. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a possible hip fracture, requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a pressurized tank trailer when a bolt broke on a lid. The lid flew off and struck the employee in the head, fracturing their skull.
An employee amputated four fingers on the right hand while servicing a rotary air valve.
An employee was writing a valet parking ticket for a customer when the employee was struck by a vehicle operated by a public driver. The employee suffered a lower torso injury.

A contract employee at a host employer worksite was changing a light bulb while positioned on a stepladder when his clothing got caught on a piece of metal on a rotating shaft, pulling the worker into the machine and fracturing both forearms.

On December 7, 2015 an employee was opening a construction gate for a dump truck to enter when a passenger vehicle tried to pass the dump truck and struck the dump truck.  When the passenger vehicle struck the dump truck it hit the employee resulting in fractured ribs and a fractured pelvis and a head laceration.
An employee's ring fingertip was amputated when the hinge on a used electrical panel failed, allowing the lid to slam down on his finger.

To clear a jam, a temporary employee climbed on top of the in-feed conveyor for residential recyclable materials and struck the operating steel paddle wheel with his foot and broke his big toe.  He was admitted to the hospital as an in-patient for his injury.
An employee was operating a PLC saw and amputated part of four fingers when his left hand came in contact with the saw blade.
On or about December 8, 2015, an employee stepped off a step stool and fell to the floor, breaking her femur.

An employee locked out the rip saw to remove a jam when his glove got caught on the blade. The blade, which was still moving under its own momentum, pulled the employee's right hand into a pinch point and crushed three fingers, which were then amputated.

An employee was standing on the ground, pulling overhead cable using fish tape. The fish tape broke or detached from the cable, causing the employee to fall to his knees. He tore quadriceps tendons in both knees.

An employee was operating a Milwaukee drill press when his glove was caught in the drill bit resulting in the amputation of the right index finger. The drill bit was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was building a part when his finger got caught and crushed between an angle iron and sheet steel. The end of the finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was repairing a trailing arm bushing and pinched his finger between the trailing arm and a tool. The medical report later classified it as an oblique amputation.
On 12/09/2015 an employee was spraying insulation and stepped on a drywall screw. The employee was hospitalized when the laceration became infected.
An employee fell and rolled her hip on a curb outside the building. Her hip broke and required hospitalization.
An employee was coordinating and participating in a film shoot. The employee performed a jump on a ski hill and landed wrong, breaking the right femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering materials with an electric pallet jack and ran over his foot, breaking it.

An employee was attempting to dislodge a small piece of stock that remained in an automated horizontal band saw's cutting area after the initial cut was made. He contacted the cutting portion of the blade during the upward stroke, lacerating his left hand.

An employee was performing maintenance on a chain drive, lubricating it with a rag. The rag became entangled in the chain, drawing the employee's hand into the sprocket. The employee injured four right-hand fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a bale of trash to place it in the dumpster when he dislocated his left shoulder.
While crimping decking sheets, an employee stepped backwards and fell 14 feet from the first level deck to the concrete below.  The employee fractured the right fibula/tibia.
An employee was struck by a passing vehicle while he was unloading merchandise. Both of the employee's lower legs were fractured.
An employee operating a steel bending machine received a laceration that resulted in the partial amputation of his right pinky finger
An employee's left middle fingertip was amputated while clearing a jam on the clip rail machine.
An employee tripped, fell, and fractured her hip, requiring surgery.
An employee was assembling calendar pages using a commercial paper cutter when the machine cut the employee's left-hand middle and ring fingers. The fingers were amputated.
A line cook amputated the tip of his left thumb while chopping broccolini.
A forklift operator clipped a refrigerator while backing up. The refrigerator fell onto an employee who was driving a golf cart in the warehouse resulting in head injuries.
An employee lost his footing and fell off the back of a semi trailer onto a paved road. The employee suffered four broken ribs, a broken scapula and internal bleeding in the lungs.
A warehouse employee fell while climbing over a forklift guardrail and broke her knee.
A local driver was hospitalized with crushing injuries.
While descending from the back of a flatbed truck, an employee fell to the ground and hit his head.
An employee was struck by a bar on the Elliot Packaging Machine while cleaning it. The employee suffered a broken arm.
An employee was operating a corrugator when a piece of metal lacerated the employee's arm as it moved forward during the manufacturing process. The employee required surgery.

An employee was moving walkboards. The employee slammed a walkboard to clean off excess mortar which caused an outlooker to break. This caused the scaffold to tilt and the employee fell sustaining a neck injury.
An employee was moving a tray to a container when the interlocked gate came down unexpectedly and partially amputated the employee's right middle finger.
On or about December 8, 2015, an employee was hospitalized after suffering a back injury while test driving a vehicle on a rough road track.
An employee tripped on a plastic pallet and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip. She required surgery.

An employee was assisting another employee in moving a large plastic spool. As the employee was pushing the spool, a trackhoe that was compacting the dirt backed over the employee's left foot resulting in injury to the left knee.

An employee was inspecting a forklift. During the inspection the hydraulic line ruptured. The employee placed his left hand on the end of the hydraulic line. As the forklift operator engaged the hydraulic line, fluid shot into the employee's middle finger creating an embolism. The employee was transported to the hospital for surgery to remove the hydraulic fluid from his finger.
An employee lost balance while walking up the stairs and fell backwards down the stairs. The employee sustained bruises and lacerations and slight bleeding on the brain.
An employee was operating a table saw and severed his left thumb, index and middle fingers.
An employee was cleaning the end of an auger when his left middle fingertip was amputated. The auger was not shut off at the time of the incident.
After glazing wood doors, an employee became lightheaded and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell approximately 12 feet down a metal ladder on the side of the building. The employee received severe injuries, including broken ribs, and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out bottles that were jammed in the filling machine. Another employee cycled the machine amputating the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee was bringing shopping carts to the store when he tripped on the curb and fell resulting in a head injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering a shipment of freight when a gust of wind blew papers out of his hand. As he went to reach for them, he walked into the edge of the lift gate, injuring his head and right shoulder. He was hospitalized.
An employee was tarring a roof when he slipped and fell approximately 7 feet, suffering a cervical injury.
When an employee opened a trailer door, the freight (a metal excavating bucket) fell out of the trailer onto his right foot, breaking several bones.
Two employees were fusing two sections of polyline. When the fusing device was activated, the area became engulfed in flames. Both employees were hospitalized with burns to the face and hands.

An employee was operating a reach truck while moving a pallet with product form one location to another. He lost control of the forklift and struck a stack of pallets with product, causing him to lose his balance and fall. His foot got caught, severely lacerating and crushing his left big toe and second toe. He was hospitalized, and the second toe was amputated.
An employee was shampooing the carpet when he stepped on a security tag sensor which penetrated his shoe and punctured his right foot.

On December 7, 2015, an employee received an electrical shock when the steel cables attached to the spider basket in which the employee was working contacted an overhead power line. The employee suffered electrical burns to the right hand and stomach and the amputation of his right arm just below the elbow.

On December 8, 2015, at the back of the store, an employee got stuck between the handle of an electric powered pallet jack and a metal storage rack. He bruised his back, lower chest area, and spleen and was hospitalized.

While descending a 10 ft. A-frame ladder an employee's foot got caught between the rungs and the employee fell approximately 8 feet hitting some shelves before hitting the ground and fracturing the left arm.

An employee was making adjustments to a belt conveyor and had removed the guard from the chain and sprockets. The conveyor was turned off and the adjustment was made. The employee turned the conveyor on to ensure the adjustment was effective. The employee was demonstrating to another employee what adjustments had been made by pointing to the parts with his left hand when the employee's hand became caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in multiple fractures requiring hospitalization for medical treatment.
An employee was cutting pieces of cardboard with a band saw and amputated the right middle finger above the first knuckle.

A maintenance worker was using a pneumatic die grinder with a carbide cutting wheel to cut a piece of metal. The cutting wheel got in a bind and broke sending pieces of metal into the right side of the employee's neck and causing a laceration.

On December 8, 2015, an employee working in the First building on line 6 at the fixed extrusion machine smashed his finger between a flange and a pneumatic plunger resulting in the partial amputation of the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell from a 4-foot aluminum step ladder while washing an outside window, fracturing the right ankle.

An employee attempted to clean rice bran from the trunk of a whitening machine. His right hand contacted a rotating blade, amputating 1 inch of his middle finger. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a customer U-Boat and sustained blunt trauma to the back of his head and pain to his right shoulder.

An employee was installing a ballistic windshield on an armed security vehicle. The employee was working from a ladder, which fell out from under him. The windshield, weighing approximately 60 pounds, fell on top of him and injured his spine.
An employee was inserting oranges into a squeezer machine when his right hand got caught inside and was crushed.

On December 9, 2015, at about 8:00 a.m., an employee was struck by a door assembly fixture while installing a wind tower door. He was hospitalized with fractures to the sternum and lumbar area and a shoulder laceration.

An employee was helping a patient in the hyperbaric chamber. The patient started seizing and the employee had to rapidly decompress the chamber, which resulted in the employee suffering an air embolism and decompression illness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to open the top hatch on a sand blasting pot that was pressurized. The pressure from the tank shot the hatch into his face, fracturing it and knocking his teeth out.
A maintenance employee put his gloved hand on a conveyor belt to see if the belt was hot. His hand and arm were pulled into a belt roller, fracturing his forearm. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee stepping from an extension ladder onto a wet metal roof slipped and fell to the concrete below. He suffered a compound fracture to his right wrist.

Two employees operating stand-up reach trucks were rounding a corner at the same time and collided. One employee was traveling with the forks behind him and the other employee was traveling with the forks in front him. The truck traveling with the forks in front struck the other employee in the lower leg, causing a compound fracture to the tibia and crushing the left ankle.
On December 9, 2015, at about 10:28 a.m., an employee was cutting pig's feet on a meat saw when the blade amputated his left index finger above the first knuckle. He had surgery.

An employee was disconnecting the rear trailer of a double-trailer tractor trailer when the trailer moved, pinning  the employee between the trailer and another tractor trailer parked behind it. The employee suffered multiple leg fractures, a knee fracture, multiple rib fractures, and numerous contusions and bruises.

An employee was fielding (visual inspection of telecommunications components) a pole in the rear casement of a home when she tripped over and fell on a vine.  She felt pain in her right arm, right shoulder, and chest.  She was hospitalized overnight with broken ribs.
An employee suffered amputation and crushing injuries to his thumbs while operating a metal bending unit.

An employee was working from a 10-foot step ladder when a bar that holds clothes came loose. She lost her footing and fell 10 feet from the ladder to the concrete floor, breaking vertebrae in her neck and back.
An employee was removing a plant from a box truck when he lost his balance and fell, striking his head on the floor of the truck.
While operating a miter saw, an employee's left palm and thumb was cut, resulting in hospitalization.

On December 9, 2015, an employee was using a table saw to cut lumber. As he was making the cut, the board started to rise and kick back. He attempted to control the kickback by pushing down and forward into the saw. His hand was on the trailing end of the board as he pushed, and his right ring finger's first digit was amputated by the saw blade.
An employee was operating a hopper when his right index fingertip was pinched  between the hopper and the frame and amputated.
An employee installing Christmas lights fell while climbing off the lower level of the roof onto a portable ladder. He was hospitalized with a fractured back vertebra and a dislocated right thumb.
A rattlesnake bit an employee's left index finger while the employee was loading pallets.
While pulling equipment, an employee fell to the ground from a gearbox that was approximately 7-feet high, injuring the pelvic area. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee's hand was smashed between a dressing wheel and the edge of a table during grinding work. His left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was reloading pallets onto a truck and was returning the powered pallet jack to the truck. The employee walked the jack back onto the trailer in the space available on the lift gate. The jack moved to the right, running over the employee's foot and pinning his leg. He lost his balance and fell approximately 3 to 4 feet off the lift gate platform, twisting his right ankle and breaking his right leg below the knee.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down stairs, breaking their hip.
An employee was holding forklift forks in the upright position when a fork fell and crushed the employee's finger. One-third of the employee's finger was amputated at the hospital.
On 12/9/2015, at 12:15 a.m., an employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when his left hand got caught under the belt. His left ring finger was amputated just above the lowest/first knuckle.
An employee was using a wood joiner to finish the edge on a piece of wood. When the employee attempted to brush away dust with his gloved hand, the blade amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was pulling wiring using a 10-foot step ladder. He lost his footing and fell to the ground, losing consciousness for 15 minutes. He was hospitalized with a concussion and minor spinal fractures.

An employee was watching maintenance being performed on injection molding machine number seven. The employee fell backwards three feet off the steps on the side of injection molding machine number six and broke ribs and vertebrae.

An employee was helping a second employee remove bolts from a steel plate attached to an axel fixture. One employee was using an air wrench to loosen bolts while the second employee was using a wrench to hold onto the bolt. The first employee loosened the bolt, and the plate slid down and struck the second employee's right index finger, amputating the tip.
While attempting to install a hand line, an employee made contact with an energized power line, receiving second and third degree burns to the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
Three employees were working in a scissor lift. An overhead door opened and knocked the scissor lift over.  One employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee pulled into the yard to pick up some rebar. He thought he placed the pickup truck in park and exited the vehicle, however the truck was in reverse. The door knocked him over and the left front tire ran over his right ankle. He was admitted to the hospital for a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was picking up debris from the roof of a building. She lifted one of the skylight covers, which was not labeled "hole," and fell through 10 feet. She fractured her right arm and was hospitalized.
An employee amputated the their left index fingertip while loading a weld fixture into a weld robot cell.

An employee operating a boom lift truck was getting ready to change a light bulb on a pole. The truck tipped over, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the ground. He suffered broken bones and internal injuries.
An employee was cutting brick using an automated saw when his finger went under the saw blade. His right index finger was amputated below the fingernail.

An employee was troubleshooting an encapsulation machine and bypassed the safety interlock. The employee's hand was caught in moving parts while troubleshooting resulting in the partial amputation of the left middle finger from the tip to the second joint.

An employee was installing a new security gate with rollers with two other co-workers. As they were moving the gate, the gate fell on the employee resulting in back injuries. He was taken to the hospital where he had surgery.
On December 10, 2015, an employee fell to the floor in the hallway leading to the activity room, sustaining a broken right wrist and broken left hip.
An employee fell from a low boy trailer while loading a bulldozer onto the trailer. The employee suffered a head laceration and fractured vertebrae in the neck and upper back.

An employee was replacing rusted screws on crypt plates using a hand held screwdriver. The employee was struck in the head by a crypt plate that came loose and fell. The employee suffered head and pinky finger lacerations requiring stitches.
An employee was hanging drywall from a scaffold and fell resulting in a head injury.
A forklift driver hit an employee, crushing him between the forklift and a baggage cart.
On December 10, 2015, an employee amputated the right index finger between the second and third knuckle while clearing a jam at the bacon bellies paper cutter.

On December 10, 2015, at approximately 12:05 PM, an employee attempted to clear scrap material from the operating envelope of a die cutting machine.  The machine, which was still energized at the time, cycled and crushed his hand. He required surgery for multiple hand fractures.
An employee was getting out of the refuse truck and was struck by a car that ran over his foot.
An employee amputated three left-hand fingers while operating a chop saw.
An employee injured her wrist when she encountered a group of children participating in physical altercations.

An employee was standing on the back of a highway van trailer, pulling on a pallet with a hook. The hook disconnected from the pallet, causing the employee to fall off the trailer and hit the ground.  He was hospitalized with broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a displaced ribcage.
An employee's hand got caught in a machine press, amputating the right index finger.

On December 10, 2015, at approximately 3:00 PM, an employee was processing/cutting meat in the production room with a meat saw. The employee's hand slipped off and his right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was applying membrane material to the foundation of a house. Her coworkers were transporting hot waterproofing material product in buckets to the foundation and were throwing the hot product on walls and spreading it with brooms. The product splashed and burned the employee's hands, fingers, face, and neck. She was hospitalized.

On December 10, 2015, at approximately 1:50 AM, a Southern Foods Group, LLC, employee was hospitalized with 2nd degree burns to his left arm, upper chest, and right shoulder after being splashed by hot water from a disconnected hot water line that he thought was empty while he was checking lines and switching circuits.
An employee was moving a fluid pump into the maintenance bay when a work platform fell and struck the employee's right arm, fracturing it.
An employee slipped and fell, striking her right knee on the parking lot surface and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell to the ground and dislocated a hip after accidental contact with another coworker.

An employee was hanging dry wall from a 5-ft high scaffold and was found unconscious on the floor with multiple skull fractures by his co-worker who heard the noise from the other side of the wall and came to his aid. The employer assumes the employee was climbing down when the scaffold tipped over and he fell head first onto the concrete floor.
An employee fell from a ladder and injured their back. The employee was hospitalized overnight.

On December 10, 2015, at approximately 10:00 p.m., a pizza delivery driver had given pizza to the customer and was standing at the doorway asking for payment. The customer refused payment. An unknown person(s) approached the deliverer from behind and struck his head with a baseball bat. The delivery driver was able to get away and call for assistance. The driver was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee suffered a finger amputation (first digit on her left hand index finger) while operating a drill press/reamer. The employee was wearing cotton gloves at the time of the incident.
An employee using a small three-step ladder fell and fractured her right ankle. She was hospitalized.
A cow carcass fell from the shackle striking the employee on the right leg and fracturing it.

An employee climbed a fixed ladder on a conex to install weather instrumentation. The support rung at the top gave way and the employee fell approximately eight feet resulting in a broken left ankle that required surgery and hospitalization.

On December 10, 2015, around 3:15 pm, an employee walked from his work station to a work area where a co-worker was using hot water to wash a tooth roller while it was running. To warm up his hands, the injured employee put his hands under the hot water poured by his co-worker and the moving roller caught his glove, pinching a finger. He was admitted to the hospital for an avulsion injury on the right index finger.

An employee was moving a suspended heat exchanger unit during the manufacturing process. The part that was to be placed under the heat exchanger unit (roll of steel mesh) fell on top of the employee's hands resulting in a partial amputation of the right index fingertip above the knuckle.

An employee was moving a two-door storage cabinet. As the cabinet was being lowered on its side, the door closest to the employee swung open and caught his index fingertip in the hinge, partially amputating his fingertip.

An employee in the Planing Area was working at the middle wood profiler. The employee received lacerations to her right forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee experienced an electrical shock while walking in the reformer section of the paper mill.
An employee was standing on an eight foot ladder and fell resulting in a skull fracture above the left eye, a broken left wrist, and a broken nose.
Two employees got into a verbal altercation.  One employee packed up his gear and was leaving the vessel. The employee punched a steel I-beam on his way out, fracturing his right hand.
An employee was rigging down a conductor pipe. A pipe swung and struck the employee in the back as it was being hoisted. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was walking on strap-on stilts spreading joint compound on newly installed bathroom drywall when he tripped on an exposed pipe on the floor and fell. He was hospitalized with a broken right femur.
An employee operating a powered pallet jack injured his left foot/ankle when he struck a parked powered pallet jack.
A laborer was cutting down a piece of metal ductwork and cut his forearm. He was admitted to the hospital for stitches and treatment of a 6 inch laceration.

On December 10, 2015, around 7:15 pm, an employee slipped and fell on the floor while performing her duties cleaning the kitchen and washing dishes. The employee broke an ankle and was admitted to the hospital.
A temporary employee was operating an electric pallet jack and struck a rack system support. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a machine and smashed three fingers inside the machine resulting in the amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee was at the edge of the vault observing work inside the vault when he passed out and fell 8 feet down into the vault. He landed on a water pipe resulting in a broken mid-back.

A maintenance technician was preparing to work on a maturation tank valve. When he opened the valve a caustic chemical splashed him in the face.  The employee suffered burns to his eyes and the left side of his face and neck.
An employee was welding a trailer fender.  The tire burst and debris struck the welding mask causing a facial laceration and temporary vision impairment. The injured employee was hospitalized.
On December 11, 2015, at approximately 6:20pm, an employee amputated the left middle fingertip while operating the trimmer.
The employee was removing panels from a roof during building demolition. He stepped on a weak section of the fiberglass roof and fell through breaking his femur.
An employee was dismantling a vehicle on a lift. The vehicle fell and crushed the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a broken ankle and hip contusion.
The injured employee was walking toward the restroom and hit his shoulder on the door frame causing him to lose balance and fall to the floor.  He was hospitalized for a left hip fracture.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while operating a pallet jack.
An employee fell from an A frame ladder and injured the left leg and hip.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet from a scaffold while climbing down resulting in a lower extremities fracture and hospitalization for medical treatment.
A driver was walking around his truck to look at the scales and get the weight when he slipped and fell.  A slimy product with moisture was on the floor.  The employee broke his lower right tibia.

On December 11, 2015 at approximately 11:00 AM, a staffing worker was asked by the host company to get on the roof to help take off fiberglass panels. The employee stepped on a weak spot and fell through twelve feet breaking his right femur and sustaining other injuries to his spine and ribs.
An employee was making a bed in the guest room. The sheet ripped and the employee fell breaking the right hip.

An employee was guiding an eight foot piece of aluminum railing through the 3-axis angle machine when his glove got caught on the rollers that pulls in the aluminum piece crushing his hand. His left ring finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee operating the KM16 5 head saw suffered a partial amputation of his right foot.
While moving a cart off the line, the rack swung back and pinched the tip of the employee's right hand middle finger between the rack and the rolling cart resulting in amputation.

On December 12, 2015, at approximately 12:45 am, an employee was washing a paving machine with a water hose. The employee moved in close to wash behind the auger that was slowly spinning. The auger caught the employee's vest pulling him into the machine and turning him onto his back. At that time, another employee was able to shut off the machine. The employee suffered a dislocated left hip, a left knee strain and a left arm abrasion.
An employee walking to their car was startled by another employee, lost their balance and fell fracturing their hip.
A ski patrol employee was checking a run prior to opening. He hit a rock, and tumbled into other rocks, breaking his tibia and fibula.
An employee was on ski patrol on a run and struck a rock under the snow fracturing the right leg.
An employee was drawing blood from a patient when she felt a pop in her back as she stood up.
An employee was uncoiling chain and got their fingers caught between the sprocket and chain resulting in the amputation of the right index and middle fingers.
An employee was bitten on the right hand by a dog while delivering mail.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor fracturing the left hip.
An employee suffered the amputation of the left index fingertip while troubleshooting a packaging machine.

An employee was working in the graphite mixing department. The mixing process creates one pound graphite mix balls. Once the mixing process was completed, the employee dumped the contents of the mixer into a stainless steel box. One of the mix balls landed on the edge of the stainless steel box. The employee reached for the mix ball to throw it into the box. As the employee reached for the mix ball, he lost his balance and pinched his finger between the mix ball and the edge of the stainless steel box.  The employee suffered the amputation of the left middle fingertip as a result of the incident.
An employee amputated her right middle fingertip while operating the card spinning machine.
An employee was cutting a block of cheese and the knife slipped and punctured the employee's abdomen.
An employee stocking product fell to the floor while coming down an A-frame ladder and broke the right leg requiring surgery.
An employee was seriously burned while working at a fracking fluid recycling facility, requiring hospitalization.
An employee amputated the left ring fingertip when it was caught in a roller inside the unguarded housing of a pump.
While moving packages on a load chute, an employee's finger got caught between the metal release mechanism, amputating the right middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing a wrap-up when her hand got caught between two rollers as she was re-threading the web. She partially amputated three left-hand fingers.
On December 13, 2015, a portable rack fell on an employee's left-hand little finger as the employee attempted to move it, amputating the fingertip.
An employee amputated three fingers on his left hand while working with a plate roller machine in the Sheet Metal Department.

An employee was working independently underneath a trailer in the yard to repair a lift axle that was jammed. While the axle was rising slowly, he held onto the safety chain. When the arm had enough pressure to release itself from under the axle where it was jammed, the axle shot up, tightening the chain to the axle and amputating three of his right-hand fingers.
While walking in the crosswalk from the parking lot to the building, an employee was struck by a feeder shifter (powered industrial vehicle), fracturing his leg.
An employee was operating a grommet machine when her right index finger went into the path of the punch press and was smashed.
On December 14, 2015, an employee was delivering mail. While moving the mail around in her vehicle, a package fell out and she tripped over it. She fell to the ground and broke her left wrist.
An employee was slicing a tomato near a 90-degree belt on a conveyor line when her hand got caught underneath the belt. Her left pinky finger was amputated below the nailbed.

After cleaning a process kettle with methanol and water, an employee emptied the tank and filled it with phenol.  The employee then began to remove the plug and was splashed with phenol, suffering chemical burns to the right thigh, stomach, and face.
An employee was unloading a palette or shipping crate with a coworker. The coworker dropped the crate and it struck the injured employee's finger. His middle finger was medically amputated.
While attempting to straighten the paper he was feeding into the stacker hopper of a machine, an employee's right hand got caught in the rollers, crushing his fingers.
An employee's finger was amputated while operating a cookie wrapping machine.
An employee was operating a vertical milling machine when his glove got caught between a part and a drill bit. His left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was moving a breader into position for a production run when the breader fell off the tracks and the hopper created a pinch point that amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.

An employee was making sand cores on a core machine when the gas plate cracked. While he was adjusting the ram to align the gas plate, the ram moved downward and contacted his foot, amputating his fourth toe.
While an employee was climbing into a fork truck, he reached for the grab handle and it broke off.  He fell 4 feet, landed on his tailbone, and suffered a vertebral compression fracture.
While stepping off a 6-inch step in the shop, an employee slipped and broke his left hip, requiring surgery.
An employee was loading a plane on the ramp with carry-on luggage from the jet bridge when he felt a pop and pain in his stomach area. He was hospitalized for a possible hernia.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a 6-inch OD piece of round stock weighing approximately 617 pounds. He reached underneath the load to place a 1-foot block of wood when the load shifted and released from the rigging, landing on his hand. His left index finger was partially amputated to the knuckle.
An employee amputated his right hand while feeding lumber into a notcher machine. The machine was unguarded at the time.
While driving a yard truck, an employee became ill from the vehicle's carbon monoxide exhaust and was hospitalized.
An employee was in the dock area speaking with a Towmotor operator when he got pinched between two Towmotors, injuring his right lower leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was stabilizing a mortar tub that weighed approximately 75 to 100 pounds on a forklift. The load began to swing in a circular motion and pushed the employee toward the front right-side wheel. The forklift then rolled onto the employee's right leg, breaking the right femur.
An employee was operating a table saw when his right middle finger was amputated. The saw was unguarded at the time.
While operating a fork truck, an employee was struck by a forklift, suffering a pelvic injury and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's hand got caught between a rotating table and a stationary table. Her right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was moving product using a two-wheeled hand truck when the hand truck and the boxes of material fell back and struck the employee. The cart handle fell on the employee's right thigh, causing a contusion.

An employee was moving product from the back of one trailer to another trailer when the vehicle began to move. The employee attempted to move from the stationary trailer to the moving trailer but fell off, fracturing his right tibia/fibula.
An employee was training on a new piece of equipment (stretcher). When she lifted one end of it, she hurt her back falling to the ground and passing out. She was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee fell through a skylight while roofing.
An employee was doing maintenance on an electrical transformer when he contacted energized equipment, suffering third degree burns on his left hand.
An employee was helping a sign hanger unbuckle a sign from a crane truck when the sign fell off and hit the employee on the head, causing head trauma.

An employee was sanding the rollers on a 3-axis rail bender. The rollers caught the employee's left hand and pulled it into the machine while a piece of aluminum was going through it, crushing his fingertips.
An employee's finger was crushed by machinery when it was inserted into an unguarded hole. The employee was admitted with a broken finger.

An employee and a coworker were guiding an electrical cabinet carried by a forklift into a storage unit. They noticed the electrical cabinet was too tall for the storage unit, so they repositioned the electrical cabinet to its side. While moving the repositioned electrical cabinet, a backboard on the pallet broke, allowing the cabinet to fall. The injured employee tried to catch the electrical cabinet, fracturing his right leg.
An employee was using a pry bar to unjam a cage when a nearby forklift operator dumped a full chicken cage. The full cage slid and struck the employee, causing a pelvic injury.
An employee's finger was scraped on a cart that was being moved and became infected.
An employee cut their right little finger with a circular saw.

An employee was loosening a bolt from a cylinder in the plastic injection molding machine. When he attempted to grab a hand jack, the plate came down because the bolt was loosened, and the employee's right hand was pinched between two metal plates. When he pulled his hand out, his pinky finger got lacerated and required surgery.

An employee was changing a link in a chain on a set of rollers when a pallet of finished product was pushed onto the roller set being worked on. This caused the sprocket to move on the chain, pulling the employee's left index finger in and amputating it to the middle knuckle.
An employee was delivering food on his bicycle when he was assaulted at approximately 11 a.m. He sustained multiple injuries, including a collapsed lung and concussion.
An employee was operating a Towmotor and backed into a wall. His foot got stuck between the Towmotor and the wall and required surgery.
An employee got out of his truck to chain up when he slipped and fell on the icy road surface. He struck his head and back on the road surface and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading cars and looking for packages left behind. As he reached into the running equipment his right arm was caught in the pulley and belt, fracturing it. The equipment was not guarded at the time.
An employee amputated the left ring finger while setting up a machine.
An employee was operating a break machine and got his left index finger caught in the machine resulting in laceration and fracture.
An employee was climbing the fixed ladder on the back of a ready mix truck when they slipped and fell off, landing on their chest.

An employee received a compound fracture injury to the middle three fingers of his left hand when the forklift he was changing a tire on slipped from the jack. The employee's hand was caught between the bumper and the tire.

Four employees were taken to the hospital for burns on their face and hands when a machine blew out hot polyphenylene sulfide (chemical). The chemical is used to manufacturer insulator pipes.   The employees were trouble shooting the extruder when they were burned.  Two employees were hospitalized.
An employee suffered a head injury when he slipped on a customer's porch and fell.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on piece of conveyor. He reached across and lifted up on the belt.  His back elbow crossed the photo eye, activating the belt.  His finger was caught between the end of the conveyor and the end guard.  When he pulled his hand back, he degloved the right ring finger resulting in medical amputation.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to pull orders. The employee backed into a parked forklift that was behind a divider curtain and broke their right leg.
An employee was working on the flap gates of a crate. A flap came down and amputated the right ring fingertip.
An employee's right index fingertip was amputated when a load of 2x4s was placed onto a trailer with a forklift and the load crushed the employee's finger.
An employee was injured while conducting snow surveys. He was ejected from a snowmobile and sustained a back and neck injury.
An employee slipped and fell on snow and ice resulting in a broken left ankle and hospitalization.
A forklift operator ran into a parked forklift. The employee's left hand was caught between the two forklifts resulting in a broken hand. He was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee fell down the stairs from a walkway to the parking lot en route to their personal vehicle at the end of the work shift.
An employee slipped on a piece of tape and fell approximately 11 feet from the roof resulting in two broken ribs and a fractured scapula.
An employee was descending from a ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground injuring his forehead, elbow, right hand and knee.

On December 14, 2015, at approximately 4:00 PM EST, an employee was in the meat cooler retrieving chicken product to put out in the display case when he slipped, falling to the floor and hitting his head. He was admitted to the hospital for swelling and bleeding in the brain.

An employee fell approximately 20 feet from the roof of a two story building. The employee's fall arrest system was not hooked to the safety line at the time. As a result of the fall, the employee suffered three broken ribs and a broken right hand.
An employee was sandblasting pipe at the Rice Energy Compressor Station. The sandblaster slipped out of employee's hands, hit the pipe and struck the employee's upper right arm.
An employee crushed a finger between two scrap iron parts on a tray resulting in amputation at the hospital.

On 12/15/15 at approximately 1:00 PM, an employee operating Rounder Machine #150 was in the process of feeding a 2" x 1/2" piece of copper stock material and inadvertently actuated the mechanism resulting in a partial amputation to the right index finger.
On or about December 15, 2015 at 3:10p.m., a mail handler got her right foot caught in some unsecured netting on a parcel container and twisted her foot resulting in a fracture.
An employee was hospitalized with a concussion after falling down a flight of stairs.
An employee was cleaning debris and moving ladders when the employee tripped and fell breaking a wrist and a hip or pelvis.
Two workers were lifting an 80 lbs. shear ram block onto the shear.  The block shifted and pinched a worker's right thumb fracturing it.
On or about December 15, 2015 an employee was injured when his hand became caught in the binding machine while unjamming it.

Two employees were working from an extension ladder that was placed on the 2nd tier of a scaffold. The scaffold and ladder collapsed resulting in both employees falling approximately 30 feet.  Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was plowing snow. As he exited the pickup truck, he slipped and fell hitting his head on the ground resulting in a concussion.
An employee fell and broke her hip resulting in a hospitalization.
An employee was walking in a patient's house and struck her right toe on an uneven threshold resulting in a laceration.
While removing rotten decking from a roof, an employee fell about 30 feet through the decking. The injured employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

A bus person was carrying a big box of cereal after restocking the counter and started to walk away. She hit the corner to the salad bar and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized for an injury to her left hip.
An employee's hand was caught in a metal pipe bending machine resulting in a broken and dislocated left little finger.  The left ring finger was crushed.

An employee lifted a hatch door by hand and was attempting place the door over the hatch opening when it slipped from his hands and his right ring finger was pinched between the hatch door and the hatch opening.  The right ring finger was amputated.
An employee lost control of a forklift and hit a rack resulting in a punctured kidney and head trauma.
An employee was stacking parts on the turn table. While the table was rotating, the parts fell off the table and struck the employee's left leg fracturing it.

On December 16, 2015, at approximately 2:52p.m., an employee was hospitalized after receiving burns to his neck, ears, head, and hands.  The employee was preparing to unload a coal tar pitch railcar.  The line on the railcar was opened without relieving pressure and material sprayed onto the worker.
An employee was unloading a cart from a plane and fell less than six feet striking his head on the ground. The cart also fell onto the employee injuring his ankle.

An employee was cleaning the battery condenser between catwalks while standing on one of the machine's discharge side, between a catwalk and a 45 degree slide. The employee slid down the battery condenser slide (45 degree angle) and fell into the cotton press. The press was not running at the time of the incident. The employee sustained lacerations to the back of the head, fracture lumbar vertebrae and a collapsed lung.
An employee's right index finger and knuckle were fractured after his glove got caught in a conveyor.
An employee fell out of a rolling office chair onto a cement floor breaking his hip and lacerating his head.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam at the lumber mill and caught his finger between a board and a roller resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.
Two employees working from a man-lift received an electrical shock.
An employee was hospitalized after getting his hand caught in a printer.
A letter carrier was delivering mail to a residence when she fell down the front steps and fractured the left ankle.
An employee was cutting a carrot with a knife and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee bent down to pick an item up and felt a pop in her lower back. She was not able to stand back up.
An employee amputated his left finger while using a table saw. The saw blade guard was removed at the time.
An employee's ring finger was amputated on or about 12/16/15 at approximately 3:45pm.

An employee was setting up the table saw to perform dado cuts on a door. The material kicked back and the employee's right hand was pulled into the blade. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on his index finger, middle finger, and thumb.
An employee fell from a deck through a gap in the railing.
An employee was troubleshooting an upper and lower flask of a mold trying to get the upper flask to seat on the lower flask properly. The flasks came together and crushed the employee's hands.
An employee was making patties using a Patty-O-Matic patty forming machine and amputated the tips of the left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was operating a cut-off saw and the wheel of the cut-off saw exploded and kicked back injuring the worker.  The worker was hospitalized with a deep laceration to the chest and a chipped collarbone.
An employee cleaning the x-ray conveyor in the Bakery Department got her arm caught between the roller and the belt breaking her arm in two places.

On or about 12/16/15, an employee was opening the gate for a semi truck to leave the area.  The semi trailer's rear bumper with the hazmat sign got hooked on the gate.  The gate broke loose from the hinges and went flying 10 feet in the air landing on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs, a potential hole in the lung, and a facial laceration.

An employee was cleaning glue rails on a packaging machine. Another worker was troubleshooting the packaging machine where suction cups grab the paperboard boxes. This worker jogged the machine to see if the suction cups were grabbing the paperboard sheets and the employee who was cleaning glue off of the rails suffered an arm injury requiring surgery.

On 12/16/15, an employee's hand was caught-in the roller of a dough rolling machine while the employee was attempting to clean the machine with a rag. The rag was caught-in the moving roller and pulled the employee's hand into the machine.  The employee was  admitted to the hospital with a severe hand injury and is awaiting surgery.
An employee was jogging the bolt header machine and amputated the right index finger to the second joint.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to work from the parking lot and broke her left ankle. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was operating a manual hydraulic pallet jack to elevate and relocate a storage cabinet. A plastic storage bin fell from the cabinet and struck the employee breaking the left leg.

An employee was walking in between aisles and caught her foot on the corner of a table. She fell on her right arm and the right side of her face. She experienced bruising and abrasions to the right side of her face. She was hospitalized for a fractured right arm above the elbow that required surgery.
An employee suffered a head injury after tripping and falling and hitting their head on a work surface.

A stack of 6"x 6" x 20' timbers were banded together and sitting on the ground. The stack was about three to four feet high. An employee cut the bands off of the stack and four of the timbers fell striking the employee in the left leg and fracturing it just above the ankle.
An employee was operating a stacker. While trying to clear a jam, their right thumb was crushed in the stacker.
An employee was operating the bone cannon machine and amputated part of the right index finger.
On December 17, 2015, an employee was operating the table saw and amputated the top segment of the left thumb.
An employee was cleaning hot rollers on a running machine. The rollers caught and pulled his hand into the machine.  The employee was hospitalized with burns to the top part of his left hand.
An employee was painting poinsettias and slipped on plastic sheets on the floor. He fell and hit his head on a metal table. He was unconscious for an hour and hospitalized.
An employee was installing low voltage wires and received a shock. He fell from a six foot step ladder resulting in broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee slipped on a sloped hill at the worksite and fell onto a protruding sapling suffering a puncture wound to his right backside. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the rollers of the tri-laminator machine from the intake side.  Both of the employee's forearms were pulled into the machine. The employee was hospitalized for injuries to both arms.
On or about December 17, 2015, an employee amputated the left middle finger at the first joint when the finger was caught between the 14" X 36" log and the conveyor belt.
A lineman in a bucket truck was removing a dead insulator. Something hanging down from the basket contacted a live line below. The employee suffered electrical burns to the hands and thighs.
An employee was hospitalized after suffering injuries to both arms while operating a milling machine.
An employee got his left hand caught in the winder and suffered a compound fracture to the left hand.
While stepping onto a trailer, an employee lost his balance, fell, and hit his head on the ground resulting in hospitalization for head and rib injuries.
A Line Mechanic was adjusting the film on a machine that makes plastic bags. The fingers of his left hand were pulled into the rollers resulting in the amputation of the left middle finger.

On December 17, 2015, at approximately 9:00 AM, an employee was empting a bag of recyclable material into a grinding machine when the bag became lodged into the equipment. The employee tried to free the bag from the equipment and he was pulled into the equipment. The employee suffered broken bones and damage to his skin on the right wrist and left arm.
An employee climbed up onto a storage rack to retrieve an item and fell approximately eight feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was hospitalized for a serious hand injury requiring surgery while operating a five axis CNC machine.
An employee broke a leg during athletic training when they impacted another person.
An employee suffered a broken leg that will require surgery after being struck by another skier on the Springmeier ski run.
An employee was moving a desk with a co-worker and aggravated a preexisting hernia. The employee was admitted to the hospital on 12/18/15.
An employee was cutting meat and sliced their left thumb on the saw blade. A partial amputation was required to treat the wound.
An employee was using a hand-held blower to clean when his thumb was partially amputated by the impeller on the bottom of the equipment. The impeller was unguarded at the time.
A rural carrier operating a POV to delivery mail suffered a partial amputation to the right hand middle finger after slamming the car door on the right hand.

An employee was cleaning a plastic mold with alcohol. He pulled a lighter from his pocket to melt some of the plastic from the mold.  When he struck the lighter, his hand caught on fire.  The employee tried to put out the flames on his pants and caught them on fire. The employee was hospitalized with first and second degree burns to his stomach, leg, left hand and nose.
An employee was loading a flatbed trailer with a forklift. The employee climbed on top of the trailer and fell approximately six feet and fractured his hip.

The employee was working with another employee to set up a new operator valve system. While observing the operation of the valve system, one of the employees placed his hand into the opening of the plates and the plates closed onto his fingers.  The employee's index and middle fingers were amputated. There was no guard on the machine at the time.
An employee's right ring finger was amputated while working on a machine.

The employee was unloading a pallet to make a box using the mechanical rollback storage rack. The pallet got stuck and the employee attempted to dislodge the pallet with a rod/pole.  The employee lost his footing and fell. The employee's left pinky finger was smashed by the falling pallet.
An employee accidentally shot himself in the right thigh with a pneumatic nail gun and was hospitalized.
A ski instructor fell while skiing and broke her tibia.
An employee was cleaning the injector lid. The lid came down on top of the employee's hand amputating the left index finger.
An employee was opening the garage door to the warehouse to pick up materials.  The employee tripped over the rope to the garage door and fell.  He was hospitalized with a concussion.

On 12/18/15 at approximately 9:30am, two employees were offloading pre-cast concrete stairs off of a truck with a link belt crane at a new commercial construction project. As they unloaded the third piece, one of the employees was using both hands to guide the piece to the ground. The suspended stair came into contact with a stair on the ground. As the pieces came together, the employee's left middle finger was pinched between the concrete stairs. A partial fingertip amputation may have occurred.

An employee was operating a MAC-MR6 truck with a 1997 Putzmeister BSF32.16H 32 Meter Concrete Pump. The pump clogged. The employee was fixing the clog, when suddenly the pump shot concrete out striking the employee in the face and chest.  The employee was thrown a distance of approximately 16 meters. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of his injuries.

An employee was attempting to place a large dog into a kennel when she lost her balance and fell to the floor. The employee fractured her right ankle in two locations resulting in admission to the hospital for surgery.

An employee was checking the wire on strander machine #265. The wire was stranding onto a bobbin and somehow his finger got under the wire. The tip of his left middle finger was amputated to the first joint.
An employee had an asthmatic reaction caused by another person's strong cologne.
An employee was changing an air filter in the cabin of an aircraft.  The employee cleaned dust off the fan blades and amputated the left hand ring and middle fingertips on the fan blades.
An employee was cutting a vehicle's windshield at the customer's home when the cold knife slipped and punctured his right forearm. The employee was admitted to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was washing a process line that had a phosphate blockage. The chemical splattered and burned the employee's legs.

An employee suffered second and third degree burns to the chest, right arm, torso, and right foot when struck by hot water from the Jensen Vat Dryer machine.  A short in the conduit caused the dryer door to open and spray the hot water.

Employees were dismantling a system scaffold 20 feet in the air. When one of the employees removed a gravity pin that was holding a coupling pin for a scaffold leg, the leg released and fell 20 feet below striking another employee on the right arm above the elbow and on his right middle finger. The employee was hospitalized with a puncture wound above the elbow and a broken right finger.
An employee was inspecting welds on a scaffold and fell 6.5 feet resulting in a broken leg. Fall protection was worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was mopping a stairwell when she missed a step and fell down the stairs resulting in a fractured left arm, bruised eye, bruised face, and a concussion.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken hip when he was struck by a passing forklift that was carrying pallets.
An employee sustained a back injury while lifting materials. He was hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of his delivery truck and slipped resulting in injuries to both knees that required surgery.
An employee operating a 20 inch masonry saw to cut cinder block amputated his left thumb when the saw kicked back.
An employee was helping another employee adjust the perforator machine. As the employee ran product through the machine, their left pinky finger was amputated. The guard was not in place at the time.
An employee was getting up from a chair. Her legs got tangled up with a sweater and she fell on the floor fracturing the right hip.
An employee was driving a fork truck and struck a section of the concrete floor that was raised about 1/4 inch. The sudden stop caused a neck injury.
An employee was pushing a food cart and caught her right pinky finger between the corner of the car and the wall resulting in a fingertip amputation.
Workers were moving Jersey barriers. An employee suffered a broken lower left leg and a broken right foot when the backhoe ran over his leg.
An employee delivering mail tripped and fell, breaking his hip.
An employee was packing donuts when a break in the line occurred. The employee tried to correct the problem and amputated the right middle fingertip.
An employee lacerated the right hand while cleaning a manual cutter.

Employees were prepping a vessel for painting. The employees were using a pressure washer and working from a scissor lift.  Another employee who was moving in a scissor lift became entangled in the pressure washer line. The line was tied off to the lift with the employees who were pressure washing. That lift tipped over and fell onto a third scissor lift.  The employee suffered a dislocated tibia.
An employee was working from a scaffold. The employee fell seven feet. The employee's harness was unhooked at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking on the tarmac to pick up an orange cone when he slipped on ice and fell injuring his head.

An employee was attempting to connect alligator clips to a battery inside of a welding machine. The machine was running and the fan severely lacerated his right index and middle fingers. The index finger was also dislocated.

A worker was cleaning the chain of a tenter frame machine. A second worker was jogging the machine for the first worker. The first worker's right hand was caught in the machine resulting in the amputation of the index fingertip.

The employee was walking in front of the CIP discharge when it discharged hot, caustic water. The flow knocked her to the ground. She sustained burns to the left side of her thigh, foot, and lower leg.
An employee was walking from the sales department to the bakery department when she tripped and fell resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee climbed a ladder to perform cleaning duties and fell. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

On December 20, 2015 at approximately 12:54, while an employee oiled the chain that drives the power turn conveyor to the SSM, part of her right hand index and middle fingers were severed when they were caught between the chain and sprocket.
A temporary employee was working at a knock-out station lifting castings.  He complained of chest pains and was hospitalized.  He was diagnosed with muscle strain.
A employee was stabbed in the back, neck, head and leg by another employee.
An employee was carrying rivet bars, dropped one, tripped over it, and then fell face-first into wooden shelves.  The employee sustained a fractured nose, teeth, and possible fractured neck.
There was a fire inside a patient's room.  An employee suffered smoke inhalation while removing another employee from the room.

The employee reached over a safeguard to push a coil towards the wrapping machine.  While pushing, he triggered the proximity switch for the seal bar to come down.  The seal bar came down on top of his hand, which was between the seal bar and the coil.  The safety device, which makes the seal bar retract when it makes contact with an object, failed.  The seal bar remained in the lowered position.  The employee tried to pull his left hand out of the equipment resulting in the amputation of the middle fingertip.
On December 20, 2015, at approximately 3:30 pm, an employee was performing operation duties inside the CFB unit when Boiler #2 failed, releasing hot steam and burning the employee.
An employee was carrying a small folding table and tripped and fell on her hip.
An employee was installing u-verse equipment in a customer's home. When he stood up he felt a pop in his back. He was hospitalized for a pinched nerve.
An employee was operating an unguarded table saw and amputated three fingertips on the left hand.
An employee fell approximately 30 feet through an elevator shaft after unhooking his self-retracting lifeline to readjust a laser resulting in fractured ribs, pelvis and a punctured lung.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine and amputated three fingers.
On or about December 22, 2015, an employee amputated a fingertip while fixing a conveyor.
An employee caught a finger on a sling and fractured it resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to free up some stuck boxes along the conveyor line.  The employee was pulling on some stuck boxes when his hands slipped off the box he was lifting. He fell to the side and stopped his fall with his right hand. During that process, his right hand was caught between two rollers. In freeing his hand, he pulled the skin off the top of his hand.  He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking on a loading dock and fell off the dock to the concrete floor below resulting in a broken right femur and a laceration to the left side of his of head.  The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was gassing up his company vehicle at the private fueling station on company property when the company owner drove by and struck the employee causing a broken leg.

One employee fell three feet from a ladder while installing sheetrock and suffered a compound fracture to his right ankle.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a cylinder from a platform approximately six feet in height using a ladder. The employee fell and broke his left leg.

An employee was in the process of tightening belts on an electric motor on a pump jack and was caught between the arm and the base of the motor experiencing a fractured pelvis, abrasions to left side of the abdomen, and abrasions to the buttocks.
An employee amputated a ring finger and crushed two other fingers while operating a brake press.

On or about 12/22/2015, an employee's fingertip was amputated when the lift cart he was operating caught his finger between a shelf and the cart.
An employee fell off the back of a delivery truck and broke his hip.

An employee tripped and fell. His leg was then run over by a forklift breaking it.

An employee's leg was injured from slipping in the mud. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and caught his right foot between the pallet jack and a storage rack.
On or about December 22, 2015, an employee received a right hand and finger injury while trying to unjam a Doughboy tray maker machine.
An employee was working at a coil winder, winding reactor coil and got their left hand caught in the machine between the plate and feed wire.
An employee was looking for parts while walking and talking on the radio.  The employee tripped on a safety barrier and broke the left leg above the ankle.

An employee tripped and fell and was hospitalized for a shoulder injury.
An employee was smoothing round stock using emery paper on a lathe. The employee's gloves were caught in the machine resulting in the amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was sanding a metal part on a lathe. The employee's arm got caught in the lathe and fractured.
An employee was moving steel product on a metal table when the table tipped over and the product fell off and struck the employee's right foot.

An employee fell from a ladder resulting in injury to the right side of his head.
An employee fell six feet from a ladder being used to perform electrical installation work and fractured vertebrae.

An employee was operating a CNC machine. An aluminum piece from the CNC machine became a projectile and struck the employee's chest resulting in a laceration.
Employee was stepping onto the roof from the ladder and slipped off the roof onto the ground fracturing his right heel.

An employee was flipping on the circuit breaker to the AC unit and received a flash burn to the left hand.
An employee working on a blow mold machine suffered a fingertip amputation.
A USPS employee was struck by a car while crossing a street on foot. The employee suffered a fractured wrist and knee.

An employee was attempting to replace a belt on a conveyor system and suffered a partial amputation to the left thumb.
