An employee in the Grooming Department received a hair splinter in the hand that became infected and required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was pulling a V-belt. The motor engaged and his right ring and pinky fingers were amputated.

When an employee arrived at the feed yard, the cattle rushed on the gate and ran over the employee, fracturing the employee's right elbow and left thumb.
An employee doing maintenance on a machine suffered a contusion on the top of his left foot when an outrigger was set on it.

An employee was compacting rock on a roller when the roller suddenly caught fire. The employee's shirt got stuck with the shifter and she suffered burns to her right arm, cheek, forehead, and the tip of her nose. She was hospitalized.
While installing cable at a residence, an employee slipped on ice while walking on the concrete sidewalk to his work truck. He broke his right ankle and had surgery.
An assailant robbed and struck an employee in the head with a wooden stick while the employee was taking trash to the dumpster outside of the church being cleaned.
An employee was kneeling on a stool and fell forward, resulting in a broken femur and hospitalization.

As an employee was dismounting a forklift, a coworker approached with a motorized pallet jack. The coworker did not stop in time and struck the employee on the right leg. The employee was hospitalized for a broken bone above the right ankle.
An employee suffered a chemical exposure to his face and was hospitalized.

On January 3, 2016, an employee was using a manual pallet jack. The forks were not completely under the pallet being towed. When the employee tugged on the pallet jack, the brakes went on and the employee fell to the ground. She suffered a contusion to her right hip and was hospitalized.
While trying to prevent a patient from falling off the operating table, an employee strained/sprained their lower back.
An employee backed into a customer in the check-out line, causing her to trip and fall to the floor. She broke her hip and required surgery.

An employee was standing on a forklift-mounted platform to move sheets of drywall into a second-story window. The forklift tipped forward, causing the employee to fall approximately 16 feet and suffer a broken coccyx.
A large portion of an employee's hand was amputated in a grain auger when a coworker bumped or jogged the auger while the employee was cleaning it out.

A maintenance employee was performing maintenance on a cutter machine, replacing the drive gear and motor belt. As the employee was adjusting the belt, the machine cycled and rotated the flywheel.  Two bolts on the side of the flywheel caught the employee's right hand, crushing and lacerating the index fingertip and damaging the middle fingernail. The right index fingertip was surgically amputated just below the fingernail.
An employee working on the roof of a three-story building fell and fractured his humerus and hips.
An employee was repairing the hydraulic line on a bucket truck when the line ruptured. His face was splashed with hydraulic fluid, resulting in facial burns and hospitalization.
An employee was repositioning a saw used for cutting strips when he suffered a flap laceration to his left little finger, requiring hospitalization. The saw was still running at the time.
An employee tripped over her shoe lace and fell while walking away from her desk, breaking her leg.
An employee was working on a mechanical power press when the machine cycled and closed on his left hand, crushing his third, fourth, and fifth fingers.
An employee was working on the rooftop exhaust unit. When the employee removed the top case of the unit, the belt began spinning and partially amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was servicing a cross-cut box when he began to feel pain in his head and shoulders.  He fell to the ground and became disoriented, requiring hospitalization.
A maintenance employee was working on a transfer auger when the auger crushed his right leg, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fractured his ankle.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he ran into a guard railing. He struck and injured his knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a hot stamp brander when a coworker accidentally moved toward the activation paddles, bringing the clamp down. The employee's second, right-hand fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell while carrying a cake, fracturing her left femur.

An employee delivered plywood to a project site and was walking away on the opposite side of panels boards being installed when he fell to the ground unresponsive. He was hospitalized with external and internal head trauma from a bullet-nail, which pierced his skull and was embedded in his head. A ricochet may have occurred through the panel boards being installed, causing the nail to strike the employee.

Employees were loading chickens onto a trailer when the wooden platform they were working from collapsed, causing them to approximately 10 feet to the floor below. One employee was hospitalized with six fractured ribs and a head laceration, which required sutures.
On or about January 4, 2016, an employee was working from a cherry picker when he lost his balance and fell 17 feet. He fractured his wrist and face and lacerated his left eyebrow.
On January 4, 2016, an employee slipped on a piece of ice in the parking lot and broke the right tibia. The employee had surgery.

An employee was flicking chicken material off of his hands when his right index finger got caught between a gap in a cone and a chain link on a track. When he pulled his hand back, his right index fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was rolling a pipe when his glove got caught underneath it, smashing his right index finger. The finger was eventually amputated down to the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of wood that got stuck in the conveyor when her right hand got caught in the belt, amputating her right index finger.

An employee was snowboarding down the mountain when the edge of his snowboard caught the snow and he fell on his right side. He fractured his collarbone and wrist on the right side and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was climbing a ladder on the front side of a house when the ladder fell over. The employee suffered spine and neck injuries.
While using a screw gun, an employee tweaked his back and had to be hospitalized.

An employee was repositioning a stop on the leg of an egg washer and was lifting the washer with straps around it. The straps dropped a little, and his finger went through the gusset and leg.  His finger was forced through this small opening, crushing it and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee ran into a counter and fell to the floor on her right side, fracturing her hip.
An employee was hospitalized with leg injuries after slipping on liquid on the floor of the children's restroom.
An employee was moving a bar (a hitch) attached to a cart when the employee's right index fingertip was crushed between the bar and cart.

An employee was moving a large air compressor that was in front of the metal recycle bin behind the store. The air compressor moved faster than anticipated and smashed the employee's left ring finger between the compressor and recycle bin. The finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was loading chickens from a chicken farm onto transportation trucks. The employee was pulling a full cart of chickens down the aisle inside the chicken house. As the cart rolled over a section of the steel grating floor, the section became dislodged and fell. The employee and cart fell approximately 10 feet through the hole to the ground.  The employee suffered a broken left hand and required surgery.
An employee was descending a ladder after inspecting roof damage at a residence when he fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, breaking his elbow and foot.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the forklift stopped suddenly and flung the employee off backwards. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee was carrying product down a flight of stairs when he tripped and fell, hurting his knees and elbows.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she slipped on ice and fell, striking her head on the pavement. She suffered a skull contusion.
An employee's left-hand index fingertip was amputated while running machines.

An employee was cutting the blower section of an air unit out. As he was cutting the blower, a section that he was cutting fell off of the frame, which caused the blower wheel to fall to the floor. It landed on his right boot and cut through the steel reinforcement, damaging two of his middle toe tips.
An employee walking down a waxed hallway floor had a severe asthma attack triggered by the wax odor and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a press welder when two of his fingers got caught in the press. His right-hand index and middle fingers were amputated at the first joint.

An employee slipped and fell while cleaning the batter conveyor with a green scrubbing pad. His right index finger got caught in and was partially amputated by a sprocket on the conveyor belt drive train.

On 1/5/2016, at approximately 7:30 p.m., an employee was rinsing out a pump as part of the changeover process. The pump is left on while this is being done. The pump got jammed with sprinkles, so the employee attempted to clear it. His right index fingertip was amputated down to the first knuckle.
An employee was struck in the forehead by a ratchet chain binder handle.
An employee was working in a house and fell off a ladder, suffering shoulder and ankle pain.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access and repair a piece of air compressor equipment when the ladder kicked off and came in contact with the structural surface. The employee suffered three non-displaced rib fractures and contusions.

Four employees were setting up a suspended scaffold. Three employees were on a level above. The injured employee was standing on a lower level, receiving materials from the employees working above. The employee stepped backwards and fell approximately 8 to 10 feet, breaking multiple back bones.
An employee was working on a building rooftop when he fell, breaking his neck and partially paralyzing his legs and left arm.
An employee was unloading a slab of granite from a truck bed when wind caught the slab and pushed it into the employee. He fell off the truck bed and injured his left heel.

An employee was walking in a tank farm area when he slipped into an open hole in soft ground, which contained water that was heated by an exposed steam pipe. He was exposed to the heated water on both of his legs, burning one leg up to the knee and the other leg up to the mid-thigh.

An employee was observing the testing of a locomotive intercooler when he was struck by a 10-inch steel plate in the abdominal area. The steel cap broke loose from the coupling at 35 psi and shot out 9 feet striking employee in the abdominal area.
An employee was installing a floor joist on the deck when he fell 10 feet through the joist to the ground below. He hit and injured his backside and was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding clients on an ice climb when he was hit by falling ice, which caused him to fall. His fall was arrested by his climbing equipment, but he struck against the ice and sustained broken ribs, which punctured a lung.
An employee was walking into the building when he slipped and fell on ice, fracturing his right upper leg and hip.
An employee was stepping away from his tool box, tripped on a wire cable, and fell to the floor breaking his right hip.
An employee was walking from the kitchen to the dining area when he missed a 6-inch high unmarked step. He sustained torn knee ligaments and a head injury.
An employee connecting structural steel fell approximately 17 feet, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was coming down an 8-foot extension ladder when he misplaced his descending foot and it entered the space between the rungs.  As his leg went through the empty space, it came into contact with the ground, twisting him around and down the ladder. He dislocated his knee joint and broke his tibia.
An employee was operating the wire-forming machine when the wire got hung up on the end of the machine. The employee pushed the wire to the machine's form, which amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was de-rimming a tire using a tire-mounting machine. While he was pushing the bead breaker bar, his hand slipped and got caught between the rim and the breaker bar, amputating his right ring fingertip.

An employee was preparing to conduct preventative maintenance activities on an HVAC unit on the roof of the building. He took the front panel off the unit. He slipped/lost his footing, causing his hand to enter the unit and get caught in the desiccant belt wheel.  His left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was hospitalized with burns to his legs, arms, face, and body after the propane line he was connecting in a residential home exploded.
An employee was bitten by a recluse spider on January 6, 2016, while at a conference. She was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a dough sheeter when the employee's hand got caught between the in-running nip point of two rolling drums on the machine. The employee's hand was crushed and a fingertip was amputated.

On January 6, 2016, an employee was operating a cold header machine when a mobile welding cart became entangled with the coil wire being fed into the machine. The employee accidentally grabbed the wire, which began to advance in speed, and the employee's hand was pulled into the draw box. The employee's right ring finger was amputated.

An employee was attempting to lift a metal grate off of a burn table for cleaning purposes. Using a two-hook chain sling, the employee used one of the hooks with the other being left to dangle. The other hook got caught under the frame of the burn table. When the employee went to lift the grate, the hook that was unknowingly caught came free, flying across and striking the employee in the face. The employee suffered contusions to the face, nose, left cheek, and right forehead.
An employee was observing a supervisor during training on the production floor when the employee's left arm got entangled in the conveyer drive shaft.
An employee was trying to open a glass crate. The weight of the glass gave in and fell on top of him, fracturing his right leg.

An employee was grabbing 2-inch by 20-foot lengths of copper pipe from the back of a tractor trailer. The employee put the pipe on their shoulder while standing on the lift gate at ground level, then tripped on the lift gate handle and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a head laceration and broken leg.

An employee was driving a forklift to take excess liquid concrete to an area where it is poured into 2x2x6 forms for retaining wall blocks. The liquid concrete was being poured into a bucket, which the forklift was lifting above the forms, when the employee exited the forklift to either move or manipulate the bucket. The bucket slipped off the forklift onto his person, pinning him to the ground and causing body trauma.

An employee was closing the tops on grain transport railcars. As he was closing the cover, a broken part of the walkway began to "flex," causing the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately 12 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a concussion.

An employee was operating the can draw press when he noticed that the transfer had malfunctioned. While he was adjusting the trigger eye, his hand was on the equipment. The machine cycled after he made the adjustment, pinching his hand between the machine and the moving press transfer. His right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was struck by HDPE piping, breaking his back and 10 ribs. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee suffered damage to the right index finger and shoulder after being shot during a bank robbery.
An employee was hydrostatic pressure-testing a section of pipeline when a pipe coupling separated and struck him in the face, lacerating his upper lip and causing dental trauma.

An employee was moving soil and debris over a pile with a dozer. The equipment went nose down over an earthen embankment and slung the employee out. He struck the ground, and the equipment landed near/on top of him, lacerating his head and damaging his neck vertebrae. He was hospitalized. No seat belt was worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was riding a four-wheeler through very dense fog to get to another area of the feedlot when he struck a closed steel gate. He suffered a fracture and a contusion to the face. He was wearing a helmet at the time of the incident.

On 01/06/2015, an employee was manually feeding a work piece into a tabletop-mounted router to remove material/shape the edges of the triangular shaped work piece, which was 5-inches long by 2-inches tall. The work piece momentarily became stuck on debris that surrounded the router bit and then unexpectedly moved toward the bit, which caused the employee's right thumb/hand to go beneath the machine guard. The router bit partially amputated the employee's right thumb, removing the skin on the thumb tip.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a production line when the employee got caught between a welding parts machine and a robot while adjusting a sensor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken nose, fractured neck, fractured back, and two fractured ribs.

An employee was driving a pickup truck down a driveway to the employer's site across the street. The employee moved to the side to avoid an oncoming vehicle and collided with a trailer that was parked there. The employee suffered two broken neck bones.

On or about January 6, 2016, an employee was removing roller tables. The employee stacked one table on top of another other table. When the employee turned to retrieve straps to secure the tables for transportation, the top table slid and struck the employee's left leg, breaking the tibia and fibula and requiring surgery.

An employee was riding in a truck transporting a container that was to be crane-lifted onto a ship. As the container was being lifted from the truck, it stuck to the body of the vehicle, thus lifting both the container and the truck. The employee fell from the inside of the truck down to the ground, breaking his left leg.
An employee was walking in the parking lot and slipped on ice falling and fracturing an ankle.

An employee was working on the bed of a truck and was attempting to position a V-Board. The employee stepped over shingle skids to strap the load down and fell sideways off the truck, fracturing ribs.
An employee was reversing a powered industrial vehicle. While he was going to turn, his foot went outside of the truck and struck a rack. He suffered a lower left leg fracture.

An employee entered the slitter machine area to cut off a piece of material. The machine was running at the time.  The employee's left hand and forearm were crushed between two rollers on the machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating an arc welder on a pipe conveyor line when he attempted to perform maintenance/make adjustments to the unit. A pipe on the conveyor struck and broke his right leg.

A maintenance employee was using a pipe wrench to unstick a machine shaft when his hand or the wrench slipped off the shaft as he put his weight down. He then fell onto the wrench, which contacted his right orbital. He was hospitalized.

Employees were rolling flotation tires into the bed of a pickup to take them to a field where the contracted company could install them on trucks to remove modules from the wet fields. An employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee working on a demolition project fell from an elevated level to the concrete floor, cutting the back of his head.

An employee was retrieving lunch meat from a refrigerated cooler when their right foot became entangled in an electrical cord at the base of the cooler. The employee fell on the left knee and broke the left hip.

An employee was cleaning wheat out of a grain elevator leg, which had filled with wheat and prevented the belt/elevator from moving. The belt was not locked out at the time. A coworker on the floor above was instructed to start the belt to see if it would move while the employee was still clearing wheat. The belt started, and his hand got caught between a bucket and the metal housing of the leg, amputating his hand a few inches above the wrist.
After hanging pipe, an employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground while descending a ladder.  The employee lost consciousness and suffered head and face contusions.
An employee fell in the parking lot while getting out of a car. The employee's head hit the pavement, requiring hospitalization.
While participating in a workplace violence hands-on training class, an employee fell to the floor on landed on her bottom and hip. She broke her hip and was hospitalized.
An employee's pinky finger was amputated below the fingernail while the employee attempted to remove a defective spool on the creel wire machine. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was lifting a tub containing mail and phone books to place it into a hamper when she felt a sharp pain in her upper left torso. She suffered a muscle strain.
An employee was cutting concrete when a piece of concrete chipped off and struck the employee's left eye. The employee required surgery.
An employee stepped on a loose bolt sitting on the floor, slipped, and fell, breaking his hip.  He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was injured in a fight and suffered bleeding in the brain.

Employee was walking towards the corner of the line kill to add oil to the equipment. He started walking through what appeared to be sawdust on the ground, but slipped and fell in what turned out to be an 11" to 12" deep mix of sawdust and lime mud. He suffered from chemical irritation and small chemical burns to his right leg.

An employee was cleaning the concrete mixer with a stick when he lost his balance.  He dropped the stick and tried to grab hold of something. His hand went into the open lid of the mixer, lacerating the first three fingers on his right hand.
While exiting the breakroom an employee collided with a co-worker and suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was preparing to offload materials at a laydown yard. He was reaching for a cable attached to a load when his leg gave out, causing him to fall from the truck and fracture his left leg.
An employee was washing her hands before preparing her dinner when she was burned by the instant hot water spigot.

An employee went to tighten a load on the back of a step deck trailer by pulling on a load strap and ratchet. While pulling on the load strap, he lost his balance and fell backwards, striking his head on the road's surface and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's left thumb was smashed between a hospital bed frame and a radiant heater, resulting in the bone being exposed. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was walking down dock steps when he slipped and fell, striking his head. He was knocked unconscious and was hospitalized with neck, back, and head aches. He also had bleeding in the brain and was kept overnight.
An employee was working behind pipe coating line equipment. He dismounted approximately 4.5 feet from his work platform and lost his footing. He lacerated and injured his shoulder, head, and arm.
An employee was struck by a motor vehicle and was hospitalized.
An employee mopped the floor of the dish room and then slipped and fell on the wet floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was loading the kiln. A hook fell off of the rail car that enters the kiln. The employee attempted to reconnect the hook and caught his ankle in the rail car path resulting in a broken leg.
An employee fell from a 2-foot ladder while screwing a metal piece on an air-conditioning unit, sustaining five broken ribs and a fractured lower back.
An employee's glove got caught in a metal lathe, amputating the index, middle, ring, and pinky fingers of the right hand.

While working on a sorting line, an employee was sprayed by a flammable chemical when the bottle that it was in got stuck on the conveyor. The ignition source was a portable heater that was being used to keep the employee warm. The employee received 1st and 2nd degree burns to the right hand and right leg.

While attempting to clean a caser machine at Nissin Foods, an employee's thumb got caught in the conveyor drive chain and sprocket. The employee's left thumb was partially amputated. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was loading a pneumatic roller onto a flat bed trailer.  Once the roller was centered, the employee attempted to place the roller in park, but hit the wrong lever.  The roller started to move in reverse, so the employee tried to put it back into forward.  The rear wheels started to spin and the roller fell off the flat bed trailer.  The employee held on as the roller was turning over and hit a mailbox.  The impact with the mailbox broke the employee's left femur.
An employee was one member of a crew applying road asphalt. The 10-wheel truck dumping the asphalt backed over the employee's feet, breaking two bones in his right foot and requiring stitches.
An employee was helping a forklift lift a metal brace that was frozen to the ground when the brace became free and popped up, hitting and breaking the employee's ankle.

An employee exited a vehicle to instruct the vehicles behind hers to back out because her vehicle was stuck. When she exited the vehicle, she slipped and fell on the wet ramp floor, hitting her head on the ground and fracturing her right ankle.
An employee operating a pallet jack collided with an employee operating a high-lift fork truck. One employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee fell/tripped on the bottom step as he exited a bus, falling to the asphalt pavement and landing on his knees. He tore his left and right quadriceps and required surgery.
An employee's left-hand pinky, ring, and middle fingers were amputated while he was cutting product on a band saw. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
Two employees using a propane torch to loosen hardened asphalt were hospitalized when a flash flame caused severe burns to their arms and faces.
A technician was discussing the job with a customer and was bitten by the customer's dog causing lacerations to the right forearm and muscle damage.
An employee's left pinky finger was amputated.

An employee had to walk around the end of a conveyor at the front of the line to retrieve a hose for cleaning. While walking by the conveyor, his hand was pulled under the fabricated guide. He suffered a fracture.
An employee was lifting a section of metal roller conveyor when it fell on his left pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.
Finger amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a grease line when he contacted an energized electrical line that ran parallel to the grease line. He was shocked and suffered electrical burns to his hand.
While shoveling sand from a sand silo, two employees were burned when a flash fire/explosion occurred. They were hospitalized with face and hand burns.

An employee 
was doing maintenance on a piece of equipment that was shut down. He grabbed the motor's damper/pulley belt and pulled the belt toward himself. This caused the damper/pulley to rotate, pinning his right-hand thumb between the damper/pulley and the belt. As a result, the top part of his right-hand thumb (approximately 1/8" to 3/16") was amputated.
An employee was using a 4x4 to move a steel beam onto a truck when the board snapped, causing him to lose his balance and fall from the truck. He fractured his ankle.
An employee was struck in the head by a mooring line that broke while the employee was getting off the vessel. The employee suffered broken face and back bones that required surgery.

While attempting to unclog a dust collection bin's rotary valve, an employee's fingers got caught in the flap wheel of the valve. His three left-hand middle fingers were severed above the second knuckle.
An employee was bench-testing a rebuild on a CO2 pump when it unexpectedly cycled and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was maneuvering a fifth wheel plate onto the bucket of a front-end loader.  The employee and a coworker lost control of the plate, which fell flat.  As it fell, the employee's right middle finger got pinned between the top of the front-end loader bucket and the fifth wheel plate, amputating the tip.
An employee was cutting neck bones in the pack room with a band saw when the saw amputated his left index finger.
As an employee was carrying boxes from one line to another line, she tripped and fell over a pallet, breaking her left tibia and fibula.

Two employees working from a scissor lift were removing overhead air conditioning duct work at approximately 19 feet in height. When the employees cut the straps that were holding the duct work in place, it swung down and hit the scissor lift, causing it to turn over. The first employee sustained a fractured vertebra and shattered right knee. The second employee suffered a fractured left femur.
Two employees were repairing the Bambury machine and were exposed to carbon dust.
An employee was crushed between a forklift and a battery changing machine, injuring his torso area, chest, and back.

An employee was moving a conveyor with a crane and sling when the sling snapped, striking the employee in the face and knocking him backward. He was then struck in the face by the conveyor. He suffered facial cuts/lacerations and was hospitalized with a possible concussion.
An employee was checking the shaker on the slurry unit when the unit caught on fire, causing 12% burns to his head, face, and neck.
An employee was crushed by boxes that fell off a forklift when the shrink wrap tore.
An employee was riding an elevator from the 2nd to the 3rd floor when the elevator fell back to the 2nd floor. The employee fell, breaking his pinky finger and fracturing his back.
On January 8, 2016, an employee amputated two fingers while operating a table saw to rip lumber.

An employee was conducting food prep work in the deli when a loop from her right shoelace got caught on the wheel of the deli slicer table. She tripped and fell on her right wrist and right knee, resulting in a right wrist strain, fractured knee, and possible head injury. She was hospitalized.
An employee was coring through a sewer while working in a 15-foot deep excavation. The employee's leg got trapped by debris outside of a trench shield, resulting in a lower limb injury.

On or about January 9, 2016, an employee was descending a cross-over ladder with a bucket in hand. The employee slipped off the ladder and fell to the ground, fracturing both his left and right wrist.
An employee's left foot was fractured when he was run over by a tow motor pulling cart.
An employee pushed another employee down the stairs during a verbal altercation. The pushed employee suffered a broken ankle due to the fall, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a valve body with a hoist from a CNC Machine to the side of the machine.  The valve body slipped from the clamps that were holding it and hit the employee in the right leg between the knee and ankle. His leg broke.
An employee fractured his ribs, sternum, back, and shoulder when a tree fell on him while he was clearing it off a power line.
While cutting metal baseplates on a band saw, an employee attempted to sweep shavings from the cut. His left index finger came into contact with the band saw blade, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was pulling trays (unknown how heavy) over rollers in the fodder barn. The employee lost their footing and fell, suffering a broken sacrum/pelvis, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he suffered a hernia, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
On or about January 10, 2016, an employee's left hand was lacerated by a belt while troubleshooting a towel folder machine.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was injured while operating a plastic bottle palletizer. The employee was caught in the moving components of the machine and suffered skull, neck, and jaw fractures.
While unloading items from a pallet, an employee tripped over the pallet and fell to the floor, breaking the right hip. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was de-catering an aircraft at when he fell approximately 10 feet from the platform of his high-lift catering truck. He suffered a contusion to his cervical cord, sternum, and right leg.

An employee was organizing his work truck when a large tank of R-22 refrigerant fell out of the truck, causing the valve to open and spray the employee. He received chemical burns to his face, neck, shoulders, and chest area.

On January 10, 2016, at approximately 4:35pm, an employee was hospitalized after falling on wet, icy grass, while walking to her car after work.  The employee suffered a fracture and dislocation of her upper left arm resulting in surgery.
An employee's fingertips got caught while he was trying to put a chain on a sprocket on a belt conveyor. His right ring and pinky fingertips were amputated.

An employee was walking up the staircase at the worksite, ran into a coworker and fell. The employee reached out to brace for impact and suffered a triceps tendon avulsion in the left arm that required surgery.
A maintenance employee was pulling antenna cables while standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground below, sustaining a head injury.
On January 11, 2016, at about 2:00 p.m., an employee was struck by support pieces from a racking system that was being disassembled. The employee suffered cracked vertebrae.
An employee dismounting a powered industrial truck stumbled and struck a safety rail, resulting in lower leg fractures and hospitalization.

On or about January 11, 2016, at 10:30 a.m., an employee was operating a CNC saw and made a trim cut. When he tried to remove the scrap piece, the front-side pressure device activated and trapped his left pinky finger, avulsing part of the skin. He was hospitalized with a partial finger amputation.
An employee was trying to remove a metal piece from the punch/iron-work machine when the machine cycled and amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was walking around his truck in the parking lot of a customer's facility during a freight pickup when he slipped on ice and struck his head on the concrete, suffering bleeding in the brain.

On 1-11-16, at around 11:47 a.m. CST, an employee was investigating a robotic system that had shut down in a safety cell due to an error.  An explosive device fell from the machine to the floor and detonated while he was exiting the cell. He was thrown against a door frame, breaking his arm and suffering whole-body blunt force trauma.
An employee received first degree burns to the forearms and face from steam that was created when water being used to wash the catalyst media touched a hot spot in the media.

An employee was riding on the mast of a forklift while a coworker operated the forklift. They were in the process of fixing a leaning pallet when the employee's foot got caught between the mast, amputating his left toe.
An employee was feeding potatoes into the robot coupe and contacted the blades resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.
While bagging product on the packing line, an employee attempted to remove debris from the bagger. The employee's thumb got caught in a roller, amputating the tip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while delivering mail, breaking two ankle bones.
An employee was preparing to change out the equalizer block on a crane when the block fell over and struck the employee, who suffered broken bones in both legs.
On January 11, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after slipping on ice and falling, breaking a leg, while inspecting a truck trailer.

An employee was preparing to change the tire on an electric pallet jack. A hydraulic jack was used to lift the pallet jack while a jack stand was placed into position. The jack slipped, causing it to fall and injure the employee's left pinky finger. His finger had be surgically treated and partially amputated due to tissue damage.
