An employee fell approximately 47 inches while changing an upper ram on a BOP, fracturing ribs.
An employee was removing a positive displacement diaphragm pump in the wastewater treating unit when potassium hydroxide splashed the employee's eyes and face.
An employee suffered a broken arm after tripping over a patient's walker while distributing medication.
An employee was cutting shrink wrap on a pallet when he tripped over an outrigger and fractured his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground from the top of trailer while closing hatches, fracturing the left arm and leg.
On or about 1/24/16, an employee's arm was pulled into the auger of a salt spreader while cleaning it. The employee's lower left arm broke.
An employee slipped on ice in front of the building, injuring the back of his head and right shoulder and requiring hospitalization.
An employee mistakenly grabbed a bottle of methanol, believing it to be a water bottle, and took a drink. The employee suffered from methanol poisoning.
An employee was accessing supplies in the tool crib using a three-step rolling ladder when she fell and struck her head on the floor. She was hospitalized on 1/25/2016.
An employee slipped on the sidewalk and struck her head on the concrete surface, resulting in a concussion and hospitalization.
An employee climbed over a screen gable over a pool in order to pull a tarp down. He slipped because the aluminum was icy and fell on top of a deck chair resulting in a lower back injury.
On 1/25/2016, an employee fell while using an 8-foot step ladder to install a light outside of a commercial building. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
On 1/25/2016, an employee was struck by a door under negative pressure while attempting to enter it. The door slammed on and fractured her hip, requiring hospitalization.
While walking a route, an employee slipped on snow-covered ice and fractured the right ankle.

On January 25, at approximately 9:00 AM, an employee was descending the steps at a residence after delivering mail. The employee slipped on ice on the middle step and suffered a possible fractured ankle, requiring surgery.

An employee had removed a cover for the drive belt and the exit roller so the timing could be adjusted for the inserter. His left index finger was caught between the drive belt and the rotating exit roller, and his index fingertip and approximately two-thirds of the bone were amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was feeding a compound into an injection mold press when his hand got caught in the feeder, partially amputating his left-hand middle finger.
An employee was using an overhead crane to position pipe into a steel holding area. The employee's left hand was caught between the pipe and steel structure, amputating the left thumb tip.
An employee was shoveling snow on the loading dock when he slipped and fell on slippery concrete. He fractured his right femur in three places.
On January 25, 2016, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was performing physical training when he became lightheaded and dizzy. He was hospitalized.
The employee went to the restroom to wash her hands and caught a finger in the door resulting in a fracture and laceration.
An employee was spotting for a waste management truck while it was backing up when the truck ran over and broke the employee's left foot.

An employee was tightening bolts while standing on a 10-foot step ladder when the ladder tipped over. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering skull, rib, and vertebra fractures.
An employee had just performed a pre-trip inspection on his truck. While climbing down from the tractor, he fell approximately 4 feet and hit his head on the ground.
An employee fell while stepping off of a de-limber machine after servicing the oil level.  He landed on the side of his foot, breaking his ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee was reviewing blueprints at a work table in the assembly hall when a coworker bumped a piece of angle iron weighing approximately 24 pounds off the table. The angle iron fell on the employee's steel-toe boot, fracturing his left pinky toe. The injury became infected and the toe had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was preparing the floor slab of a parking garage for abrasive, sand-injected water blasting. During this process, an electrical conduit was uncovered. Not wanting the water associated with the blasting process to accidentally enter the PVC conduit, the employee attempted to seal the conduit with tape. The employee then contacted a live, energized electrical conduit and was electric shocked, suffering nerve damage and leg pain.
An employee's right-hand ring fingertip/first knuckle was amputated by an excavator bucket while the employee was taking measurements under a tank.
While an employee was climbing a scaffold, his foot slipped and he fell to the ground, breaking his foot and lacerating his head.

An employee was attempting to retrieve part numbers from a compressor's fan belts to do maintenance on the machine. When the employee manually advanced the belts to better see the numbers, the compressor started up unexpectedly and caught his fingers in the pulley and belt. His left index, middle, and ring fingers were partially amputated. The compressor was not locked out at the time of the incident.

On January 25, 2016, at approximately 4:30 p.m., an employee was completing rig service on the top drive. The service door was open and lowered with a winch.  The employee was positioned on the service door, approximately 8 to 10 feet above the ground, and wore fall protection. The remote for the winch developed an electrical short, causing the winch to re-spoil. This caused the door to raise back up. The employee was pinned between the service door and the top drive, resulting in two hairline hip fractures.

At approximately 2:30 p.m., on 1/25/16, an employee operating a metal polishing machine lifted a curtain to wipe down the feed rollers on the machine. The employee's left-hand little finger was caught between the feed roller and the metal plate and had to be surgically amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee was using a gas-powered cutoff saw to cut a 2-foot section out of a 42-inch diameter storm drain pipe when the saw kicked back. The saw blade struck and lacerated the employee's right facial cheek, requiring hospitalization.

While taking measurements in the heat treatment furnace, an employee stepped onto a non-load bearing support and fell into a vat of 220-degree quench oil.  The employee suffered second and third degree burns.
An employee tripped over a wire while getting up from a desk and suffered a hip injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's fingers were crushed while fabricating metal (e.g., bending metal flashing) on a brake press machine. The employee was hospitalized overnight for surgery.
While cutting lettuce in the cafeteria kitchen with a knife, an employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a cutting torch on a diesel trailer when the oil holding tank exploded. The employee was hospitalized with severe burns to his face, right hand, and back.
An employee was grinding a point on a steel wedge when the grinder pulled the employee's left thumb in and amputated the tip.
An employee slipped and fell in the parking lot while going to work, fracturing the neck of the right femur.
An employee was moving a container in a truck when his pinky finger was caught and partially amputated between the container and truck.
An employee was descending from a stationary ladder when he missed a rung and fell about 6 feet, fracturing his left tibia. He required surgery.
An employee was attempting to put a part on a shelf when the part hit an end cap and bounced back. He put up his arms to protect his face and the part lacerated his left arm.
An employee was installing solar panels using a ladder. The ladder slid on the icy floor and the employee fell 10 feet and suffered multiple fractures.
At approximately 8:50 a.m. on Monday, January 25, 2016, an employee slipped on ice on the parking lot and fell. He struck his head on the pavement and was hospitalized with a concussion.

An employee was removing a red oak tree (60-feet tall, 18" in diameter) from an aerial lift unit. When the employee cut a piece of wood 8-feet long and 16" in diameter, the piece of wood broke free, fell back, and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured scapula and elbow.
An employee was operating a milling machine while wearing gloves when the machine bit lacerated the employee's fingertip. The tip was surgically amputated.
On January 26, 2016, at approximately 10:09 a.m., an employee was performing physical training when his hand began to shake. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking on the production floor when he was struck by a forklift, injuring his left ankle and foot.
An employee was inspecting a trail when his snowboard became stuck in the snow. He fell forward and injured his spleen.
An employee was using a hook in his left hand to rotate a hog while holding a trim knife in his right hand. The knife punctured his left forearm between his wrist and elbow.
On 01/26/16, an employee's right middle fingertip was amputated when the employee attempted to clear a jam in the cold bead machine.
An employee was performing carpentry work from a 10-foot A-frame ladder. As he reached for something above him, the ladder wobbled and he fell off. He was hospitalized with a broken shoulder bone.
An employee was setting up a conference room (tables and chairs). He tripped over the tablecloth on a table and fell hitting his head against the table and the floor.
An employee was using a wrench to loosen bolts when his right index finger was pinched between the wrench and a fixed pipe support, amputating soft tissue.

An employee was operating the slitting machine while wearing gloves. While actuating the rollers on the slitter, the employee attempted to remove a piece of scrap. The roller pulled his glove into the point of operation, causing an open avulsion to his left thumb and an open wound to his left pointer finger.
An employee was preparing a vehicle and opened the generator door. She tripped and slammed her left index finger in the door, requiring surgery.
While an employee was operating a machine to cut a circular test sample, a pin in the machine broke and made contact with the employee's right index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee walking in a locker area tripped on an elevated locker platform. The employee was hospitalized with head, neck, back, knee, and elbow injuries.

An employee was nailing decking on a first floor deck. The plywood was icy, and the employee slipped and fell with his nail gun in hand.  As he fell, the nail gun discharged a long nail that punctured his right knee.

An employee was performing set up on a wire drawing machine when his hand was pinched between the wire and the block on the machine. His left-hand ring finger was partially amputated and his middle finger was fractured.

A crane was lifting a 40-foot load with a magnet when the load struck an object. When an employee tried to stabilize the load, it fell from the magnet and struck the employee's right leg, fracturing it.

An employee was walking to her desk when she stumbled on a rug, lost her balance, and fell face forward to the floor. She injured her head, left shoulder, right wrist, and right knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trimming brisket on the boneless meat saw when his hand slipped into the blade, partially amputating his right index finger and lacerating his right middle finger.

An employee was pulling a cart (with caster wheels) that was carrying a 500-pound magnet.  The caster wheel became caught on the concrete expansion gap, causing the cart and magnet to tip and fall on the employee. His trachea was torn in half, the internal walls of his chest were injured, and his scalp was lacerated. He was hospitalized.
While a backhoe was pulling dirt into a hole, it caught the wire on a nearby barbed wired fence. The backhoe pulled the wire out, causing it to strike and break the leg of a nearby employee.
A employee slipped and fell on ice, fracturing his right femur and requiring surgery.
While demolishing a precipitator, an employee fell approximately 33 feet to the ground below, suffering wrist and leg fractures and tissue injuries.
An employee's finger was pinched between a cart and table in the kitchen. The right pinky fingertip was partially amputated and reattached.
An employee tripped and fell in the dining room, fracturing his leg and requiring surgery.
An employee placed a carbon steel tube into a hydraulic tube bender and was activating the bar clamps to hold the tube in place when the second clamp crushed and amputated three left-hand fingers.

On or about January 26, 2016, at 2:45 a.m., an employee was practicing cutting a 3/4-inch steel plate on a cutting table with an oxygen propane torch when his 100-percent cotton work shirt caught on fire, causing second degree burns over 12 percent of his chest and stomach.  He was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on a jar assembly machine when the machine lacerated the employee's left index finger, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a tug to the carousel for charging. The employee's foot became stuck, and the tug increased speed and ran into a concrete barrier. The employee's kneecap was injured by the impact, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over metal banding on the floor and fell, breaking his hip.
On 1/26/2016, an employee became dehydrated while shoveling snow for work. He was hospitalized overnight for treatment.

An employee was operating a pipe coating machine, ensuring that the product (steel pipe) was being carried through the machine as close together as possible. When he attempted to adjust a pipe, his shirt sleeve was caught between the pipe and a passive tire, pulling his right arm into the machine. His right forearm was fractured and had internal bleeding, requiring surgery. The machine was not guarded or locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped on snow and ice and fell on concrete, breaking the left ankle.

An employee and a coworker were working on a machine's tool changer because it would not drop a tool. The coworker pushed the machine buttons while the employee's hand was in the tool changer, partially amputating his left thumb and pinky.
An employee was preparing to clear snow by an entry doorway when the employee slipped on ice, spraining the back, neck, and knee.
An employee pulled a pallet from a stack and got a severe splinter in his right hand. The wound eventually became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was removing traffic cones from the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell hitting their head and neck. The employee was hospitalized with head, neck and back pain.
While operating a pallet jack, an employee lost control and struck a parked vehicle.  The employee's left leg was caught between the pallet jack and the vehicle.

An employee saw a pallet fall off a forklift into a bin where it did not belong. He left his forklift and went over to the other forklift.  He rode the forks of the forklift to a 6- to 8-foot high elevation and retrieved the pallet. As he was riding the forks down, his right-hand ring fingertip became trapped and was amputated between the mast and the rack of the forklift.

A masonry contractor was helping to move a mattress in a home owner's 2nd floor condo.  The masonry contractor did not observe that a glassed area had the glass wall removed and he fell through the open area.  The employee was taken to hospital for a broken collarbone, three broken ribs and a head injury.
An employee's finger was pinned between a machine part and the frame of the machine. The employee was hospitalized and received treatment for crushing injuries.
While an employee was operating a drill collar clamp on a workover rig, his right pinky finger was caught between the clamp and the tubing tongs, amputating the fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot, fell, and broke the left ankle.
A temporary worker operating the bacon slicer caught his right pinky in the bacon slicer. This resulted in a medical amputation of the employee's right pinky fingertip.

An employee was shoveling snow from a low-slope roof when he fell through a skylight approximately 15 feet to the floor below. He was hospitalized with a severe concussion, head laceration, fractured skull, broken ribs, broken pelvic bone, broken left femur, and broken left eye socket.

An employee was loading pallets into a trailer using a pallet jack . Some of the pallets started to fall. His hand got caught in the pallet jack's handle when he tried to catch the falling pallets and his left index finger was amputated.

An employee was being observed while performing their practical exam operating an electrically powered, stand up, 3000 lb. capacity fork lift. The employee went down an aisle as instructed and was turning the fork lift around. During the turn, the employee lost control of the fork lift and attempted to exit the fork lift.  The employee stepped onto the dock with his left foot and the forward momentum of the fork lift caused the equipment to strike his left foot resulting in crushing injuries requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing maintenance, replacing lights in ceiling fixtures that are 27 feet off of the floor. He was using a scissor lift as a working platform. A coworker operating a gantry crane struck the scissor lift, causing it to topple over and land on conveyor systems that were being built. The employee suffered right heel injuries, a head laceration (requiring stitches), a concussion, and minor contusions and bruising.
An employee was cleaning dishes and slipped on water on the floor and fell.
An employee tripped and fell in the school parking lot while walking backwards resulting in a broken hip.
An employee lost his balance while putting a roll on the mandrel and his fingers were pinched between a roller and threading belt. His left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 to size for framing. The employee was standing in approximately 1" of water on a concrete slab. The employee was shocked.
An employee was installing an electrical fixture when he fell from a 16-foot fiberglass A-frame ladder to the concrete floor below. He hit his head on the floor and was hospitalized.

An employee arrived at the bus yard and parked his vehicle. He started walking through an automatic gate and tripped over the track that the gate wheel rolls on. He fell and fractured his nose, broke some teeth, and displaced two vertebrae.
An employee was holding a chicken that was to be vaccinated when he was stuck in the right hand  by the needle gun that administers the vaccination. He was hospitalized with an infection.
At approximately 08:30, an employee slipped on ice, fell, and broke his ankle while walking from a building to a truck to gather tools needed for the job. He was hospitalized.

An employee reached for a box that was jammed in the ground beef burger tray former machine. When he removed the box, the machine started and pulled his hand into a chain resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.

On or about January 27, 2016, at 3:25 p.m., an employee was pushing a chair cart when his hand was crushed between the wall and the cart due to the cart's momentum.  His right-hand middle finger was amputated.

An employee was working to replace a lightning arrester( electrical distribution work). When the tool he was using came in proximity to an energized jumper coming from the top of the lightning arrester, an arc flash occurred.
An employee was adjusting the chute on the T-Belt going to the FB4K hopper resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing snap ties on the outside of a three-story house's masonry wall when his coworker on an aerial lift was coming down and knocked the employee off the scaffold platform. The employee fell 6 feet to the ground, dislocating his shoulder and fracturing his proximal humerus. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a pole.  The employee was 10 feet up from ground level when the wooden pole broke.  The pole fell on the employee's leg, fracturing it between the ankle and knee.
An employee amputated a finger while cleaning ginning equipment.

An employee was attempting to close the spray booth door when the suction of the spray booth ventilation caused the door to close suddenly and pinch the employee's left middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
While exiting his delivery truck, an employee slipped on ice on a private driveway and broke his right fibula and tibia.
An employee was assisting a patient from his bed to a wheelchair. The employee bent over to adjust the bed when the patient accidentally hit and injured her face with his boot.
An employee was skiing downhill when he fell and hit the hard-packed snow, suffering spinal injuries.
An employee was installing a metal roof on a carport when the metal trim came into contact with a power line.  The owner was electric shocked and fell off the roof breaking the right leg.
An employee was mopping the floor using a wooden-handle mop when a splinter entered his left finger. He was hospitalized and the finger was amputated.
On January 27, 2016, an employee was injured when a small shiv of wood kicked back through a straight-line saw and punctured his upper thigh. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a hip injury while breaking up an altercation between two inmates.
An employee cut his right middle finger with a knife while slicing a turkey roast.
An employee was working on a shore power plug on the dock next to a ship to shore power crane. An arc flash occurred. The employee was burned in the face.
An employee was hospitalized after his shirt caught fire while welding. The employee suffered burns to the torso, left axilla, right forearm and right hand.
An employee was moving construction material on the third story balcony of building 9 when the guardrail came loose and the employee fell 3 stories to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized.
Employee was moving cars in a back parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell, fracturing a hip.
An employee was dropping muffins onto a muffin depositor tray and used her finger to wipe excess batter by hand.  The employee's middle fingertip got caught in the tray and was amputated.
An employee fell from an extension ladder and fractured their knee cap and dislocated their shoulder.  The employee was hospitalized.

The employee was transferring hot water into bath tank #11 using a hose. The employee lost control of the hot hose and hot water splashed on to the employee causing first and second degree burns to the face, arms and thigh.

The employee was helping to load a truck.  He was walking and looking at a scanner at the same time a forklift truck was backing up. The back-up alarm and light were working.  Because he was looking at the scanner, he did not see the forklift truck backing up. The right rear tire of the forklift truck ran over his left foot.  The employee was wearing steel toe shoes.
An employee slipped on a metal grating and broke her wrist.

An employee was standing outside on a wooden walkway next to an entrance door. It had been raining and the wooden walkway was wet.  The employee opened the door for a student. The student walked into the building. The door was about to slam shut so the employee twisted to grab the door and slipped on the wet walkway falling to the ground and breaking his tibia.
On or about January 28, 2016 at 8:15 am, an employee performing stripping operations fell approximately 10 feet.  The employee sustained a fracture to a thoracic vertebra.
An employee was knocking the steel wedge out of the rigging. As he struck the steel wedge (10lb. 6 in. long), it shot out, struck the employee in the face, and  fractured it.
An employee was loading a pavement roller onto a lowboy trailer. The roller got too close to the edge of the trailer and rolled over. The employee suffered head trauma.
An employee was installing cable from the utility pole to a house and fell off of an extension ladder fracturing vertebrae as a result of the fall.
An employee slipped on ice and broke his right tibia and fibula.

An employee cut the truck seal with a bolt cutter and opened the trailer door. When the door was opened, three hot water heaters fell out and one of the heaters struck the employee on the head causing a neck fracture.
An employee tripped over plastic banding and shrink wrap, falling to the floor and breaking the hip/pelvis.

An employee was operating a spin welding machine. She placed material into the welder, pushed both start buttons, and the machine cycled. The employee reached into the machine to remove the material and the machine cycled again, smashing the employee's fingers on her right hand (middle, ring and pinky fingers).
An employee amputated the left index fingertip while working with a battery powered circular saw.

An employee was wiping grease off a roll on the temper mill with a polish pad when the roll housing unexpectedly closed, pinning the employee's right hand between the roll and roll housing. The employee sustained a crushing injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was coming into work, walking from the parking lot with a co-worker, and tripped on a 4 inch curb.  She tried to catch herself, and suffered a laceration on her forehead and a spiral break in her left arm.

An employee was attempting to center a winch drum spacer on a lathe. The winch drum spacer flipped off the lathe and fell onto his right foot resulting in injury. The employee sustained a contusion on upper part of right leg and had four toes amputated.
An employee's left thumb tip was amputated while he was guiding pallets through the process at the bucket tipper machine.
An employee was operating a frozen meat grinder when a piece of meat got stuck in the shoot. When he attempted to dislodge the meat, his right index finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a pasta press and amputated three fingers.

A mail carrier was walking on grass that was spongy and wet when both of his feet sank in. He fell forward and then fell back with both his feet still stuck in the mud. The employee was unable to bend both knees and was taken to the hospital and admitted for evaluation and treatment. Ligaments and tendons in both knees were detached. At the time the incident was reported, it was not clear whether this caused the fall or this was caused by the fall.
An employee was prepping a rail car for a load of peanuts when he fell approximately 10 ft. and landed outside of the rail car breaking both of his legs.
One employee was hospitalized after falling off a ramp at the loading dock.

An employee was removing an old pole to replace it with a new one. The chain that was holding the old pole was out of center. The employee grabbed the pole and he was lifted. Then he fell from the pole and landed on the outrigger of the truck. The employee was hospitalized for chipped vertebrae in his back.
An employee had an asthma attack as a result of paint fumes.

An employee clocked out and was leaving the plant for the day.  The employee got into a physical altercation with another employee who struck him in the face resulting in a broken jaw requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on ice and fell, hitting his head.
Employees were coming down from a roof along with equipment and tools using an articulating boom lift.  The lift wells gave out, and the employees fell suffering broken bones.

An employee was showing the cleaning contractor where they would be cleaning at the facility.  He opened the hatch to a chute. He pulled on the hatch with his left hand and placed his right hand on the lip of the chute to get more leverage.  His left hand slipped from the handle and he tried to pull  his right hand out of the way, but the fleshy part of his thumb was caught between the hatch lid and the chute lip resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was placing auto bumpers into a bin when a forklift with a cage struck the employee's right leg.

An employee was using sulfuric acid drain cleaner to unclog a bath tub drain.  He felt burning in his eyes and throat.  He left the apartment and was transported to the hospital with breathing problems.

Employees were removing equipment and debris from a roof. The Skytrak was raised for equipment and debris to be placed on the forks. The injured employee grabbed the forks. The forks came down while the employee was holding on to them and smashed his left hand fingers between the forks and the catwalk.
An employee was injured on 1/29/16 when the crane gave away underneath soft ground and pinned the employee's right leg underneath the outrigger. The wooden mat was broken.

An employee was lubricating equipment.  He was using a rag to clean lubricant from the PT4 conveyor.  The rag was caught in the chain and sprocket, which pulled in the employee's left hand crushing the middle finger in the chain and sprocket. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle at the hospital.
An employee was using a drill when his glove contacted the drill and/or drill bit and amputated his right second digit.
An employee was working from a rolling step ladder when he lost his balance and fell, striking his head on the concrete floor.

On January 29, 2016, an employee was closing the door to a 30-yard industrial roll-off container when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the door and the latching mechanism. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee attempted to correct log material (cants). As he lifted a 6" cant, it slipped and smashed his fingertip between the cant and the chain. His fingertip was amputated.
An employee was preforming drywall taping and working from a baker scaffold when he fell off, breaking three ribs and potentially puncturing a lung.

On January 29, 2016, an employee was attempting to unjam the nailing machine when a coworker started the machine. The employee's hand was dragged through a chain and sprocket, amputating the right  middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee went into a 15-feet-deep trench to test if the cables were energized when the trench collapsed. The employee was crushed by the dirt and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the company parking lot, fracturing his right tibia and fibula.

An employee was troubleshooting a piece of machinery that was not working properly. When the employee tried to check the tension in the chain with his left index finger, the chain pulled his finger into the chain and sprocket, amputating his left index fingertip. The machine was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.
An employee fell in a ditch while walking his rounds, suffering a rib fracture and contusion.
Employee was walking down the stairway after cleaning her work area when she lost her footing and fell down the stairs, severely injuring her backside. She was hospitalized.

An employee was participating in annual emergency egress aircraft training. The toe of the employee's left boot caught the top portion of the inflated slide, causing the employee's leg to bend slightly at the knee. As the employee landed on the emergency egress slide, the left leg became wedged under the body and twisted. The employee's left leg and foot were fractured, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was getting up from a chair when the chair broke, causing the employee to fall and injure his right ankle.
On 1/29/2016, an employee was attempting to dislodge a rolling bay door when he fell approximately 12 feet, fracturing his left leg.
Employee was hospitalized after burning his legs while welding structural steel. Hot slag caught the acetylene tank on fire.

An employee was troubleshooting an overhead crane from an approximately 30-feet-high scissor lift. The crane hit the scissor lift and knocked it over, causing the employee to fall and fracture his shoulder and hip.
At approximately 9:50 a.m., an employee slipped on icy steps and fractured the right ankle while delivering mail.

An employee went into the cotton compress pit and climbed a ladder up to two press boxes.  The press boxes are 24 in. wide x 48 in. long and held together by a bar between them.  The press box rotates before it compresses the cotton.  There is an 8 inch opening and the employee's arm got caught in that opening.  As the press box began to rotate it tore part of his arm. The employee was able to pull his arm out and was transported and admitted to the hospital. His arm was amputated at hospital.

The employee had completed the work operation and was shutting down the crane.  The employee was asked to check the control switch located on the crane's turn table. The employee's finger got caught in a slot where the switch was located and the crane engaged and started to turn. The employee's left middle finger was crushed. It was later amputated at the first knuckle at the hospital.

The Zamboni driver was shoveling shaved ice off of the ice rink.  While shoveling the shaved ice, the driver slipped, fell, and fractured his hip.  The driver was hospitalized and will undergo surgery.

Three workers were setting a cast iron tree grate in place. Two lifted the grate while a third placed wooden block underneath to prop it up. When the grate lowered, a worker's finger was caught between the grate and the block, resulting in the amputation of the right little finger from the fingertip to the second knuckle.

An employee was descending an air enclosure roof when his foot slipped and he fell off the roof. He hit structural steel as he fell, fracturing his upper left arm and left shoulder and suffering brain bleeding.

An employee was attempting to pump water into a natural gas line. After he was given the "all clear" sign by the pipeline supervisor, he opened a water valve and was instantly struck and injured by pressurized water. The gas line was not de-energized at the time.
An employee was pushing a pallet off of a truck when his right foot was caught between the truck and dock. His foot broke and required surgery.
An employee was working on the electrical circuit on pole lights when the equipment arced, burning his hands and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing chuck from a lathe machine. When he operated the machine hydraulics by stepping on the foot pedal, the chuck did not dislodge completely. As he was troubleshooting the problem on the chuck, the machine was activated by the foot pedal. This caused the chuck to move back inside the machine, amputating is right-hand middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was struck by a vehicle that was being driven off the car wash production line. She was hospitalized overnight with injuries to her legs.

An employee was using a pry bar to guide the base of a jib crane over the bolts in the floor. The base was suspended by straps attached to a forklift. The base slipped in the straps and pinned the employee's right hand between the pry bar and the floor, breaking his right index finger and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the second or third rung of a ladder, attempting to fix and roll up an overhead door.  He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering broken ribs, a broken wrist, and head and eye injuries.
An employee was working from a ladder to put a box on top of a fixture. He fell off of the ladder to the ground, where a customer found him laying unconscious. He injured his head.
An employee's left pinky finger was amputated at the last joint while he was using a horizontal press/trimming machine.
After checking a package, an employee turned around and started walking. A forklift stopped short near her, and she tripped over the forks or lost her balance and fell, injuring her knee.

On January 31, 2016, at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was using a fryer to fry chips when the glass from the thermometer exploded and went into the employee's right eye. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was setting the gap on the granulator blade. When the employee rotated the rotor, the employee's left-hand middle finger was partially amputated (approximately 1/8 inch) by the rotor blade.
While raising up in a lift to repair loose pipe insulation, a maintenance employee was struck in the head by a ceiling fan blade, suffering a skull fracture.
An employee's right middle and ring fingers were amputated when his hand became trapped between cooling rolls while checking for defects in the web.
On January 31, 2016, an employee was hospitalized due to static shock that occurred while loading clean plastic flake into a silo from the overflow bag.
On January 31, 2016, an employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibia after falling into a pit in the foundry.
While lifting a patient, an employee sustained a back injury.

An employee was getting ready to reposition portable source lights using a material lift cart.  He picked up the front of the lift. As he twisted around, he turned/rolled his ankle and it gave out. He suffered torn ankle ligaments.
An employee was holding a concrete form stake when a coworker struck and crushed the employee's right thumb with a sledgehammer.
On February 1, 2016, an employee was performing maintenance on a crushing machine when the rotary blow bars spun and pinched the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with broken foot bones.

An employee was walking on a catwalk to inspect the current job progress. While inspecting bolts, the employee fell 20 to 25 feet through the grating into a 2-feet-deep pool of water. The employee sustained rib and vertebrae fractures, a heel fracture, and a punctured buttock.
An employee injured the left hand with a spray gun.

An employee was delivering a pizza to a private home.  After he delivered the pizza and collected the cash, he walked back to his vehicle.  Prior to entering his vehicle, the employee was shot in the bladder and was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the weaving machine, which was de-energized, when his right pinky finger was caught in the sector gear. His fingertip was amputated (no bone loss).

An employee was walking to an enclosure to collect the trash that was in it. While walking, he slipped and fell on the ice and snow. When he landed on the paved parking lot surface, he fractured his patella and severed some tendons, requiring surgery.
An employee was attempting to connect the cables for an LED light fixture when he received an electrical shock, suffering burns to his hands. He was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee's gloved left hand became entangled in a rotating metal drill bit/chuck while he was trying to sweep off metal shavings from around the drill bit. His left ring finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was working at the front desk when she tripped and fell, breaking her arm under the shoulder socket. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working from the fifth floor, installing a 28'/2300-pound window with a hoist. The employee's finger got caught underneath the window and was partially amputated, requiring surgery.
An employee was on a lift installing sheet metal at a job site when he fell off the lift and landed between two pieces of equipment, breaking his ribs.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet while dismantling scaffolding at a jobsite and was hospitalized with a fractured right foot and lower back injury that required surgery.

An employee was helping to install ground pipe in a deep trench. He was outside of the trench box on top of the 60-inch, pre-cast pipe form and bracing pipe. A back hoe operator was attempting to move the trench box when a portion of it made contact with the employee's left foot, crushing and breaking it.

On February 1, 2016, an employee was unloading parts from a conveyor when the conveyor stopped because a part was stuck upstream. The employee attempted to retrieve the part when a piece of steel began to index, got caught, and pinched her finger. Her right thumb was amputated.

An employee was climbing a ladder to mount ductwork into the ceiling tile. When he shifted his body on the ladder, he twisted his knee. He experienced knee and lower leg swelling, and was hospitalized with an infection.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot, breaking an ankle.
An employee attempted to walk around a downspout in the parking lot. When she stepped down from the sidewalk, she slipped on ice and fell, fracturing her right ankle.
An employee was descending a 12-foot attic ladder hen he slipped and fell approximately 4 feet, breaking his left leg below the knee.
An employee was stepping from a ladder to the metal roof when he slipped and fell 11 feet, fracturing his left femur. He was not connected to a fall protection system at the time.
An employee's right index finger was partially amputated after becoming caught on a trailer door handle.

An employee was placing plastic on an inclined feed conveyor when the metal detector identified metal contaminants and automatically stopped the conveyor. The employee walked up the conveyor belt to extract the metal material from the plastic and then began to descend. While walking down the conveyor, the employee slipped and fell, striking his rib cage against the metal conveyor wall. He was hospitalized with fractured ribs.

A worker cut a 4-foot x 6-foot x 5-inch piece of concrete slab from the operating floor, which fell toward the barricaded area in the basement. As the concrete slab fell, it struck a piece of equipment and was deflected to an area outside of the barricade. The slab then struck an employee standing nearby, lacerating the employee's leg.
An employee slipped on black ice while walking in the company parking lot, suffering a broken lower left leg.

An employee was attempting to unload goods from his delivery truck when he fell approximately 3 feet off the back platform onto the concrete parking lot (ground). He was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the skull, ribs, shoulder, and hand.
On 2/1/2016, at 8 a.m., an employee was holding the end of a beam being lowered by a crane. The beam bumped into a column and pinned the employee's hand, amputating the pinky finger.
An employee was changing an air filter from an A-frame ladder.  The employee was on her way down from the ladder when she missed the last step and fell to the ground, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was trying to unjam the dumpster on a forklift when the forklift struck the employee's hip. The employee required hip surgery.

An employee was loading materials while standing on a flatbed trailer. The employee stepped backwards off the flatbed trailer and fell 4 feet to the ground, sustaining bruising and possible spine damage.
An employee was moving a roll of paper with a pallet jack when his left foot was pinned between a piece of angle iron and the pallet jack, fracturing four bones.

In February 2016, an employee was injured while repairing a loader.  The loader was turned on and the employee tripped and fell into the moving parts. The employee sustained two broken bones and skin lacerations on the left arm.
An employee fell 10 feet off an unprotected edge and fractured his left ankle.
A maintenance employee was cutting 36-inch pipe with a cutting torch when his right hand was crushed between the pipe flange and the cutting table. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

On or about February 2, 2016, at 3:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to initiate an in-person survey at a private home when the employee slipped on ice located on the home's porch, fell on a knee, and fractured the left fibula.

An employee was loading a tractor trailer when the tractor trailer unexpectedly pulled off while he was still inside. He fell approximately 5 feet from the rear of the trailer to the asphalt ground below and landed on his face. His face and chin were lacerated and/or abraded, requiring stitches.

On or about 2/2/16, an employee was cleaning a laminator machine with a brillo pad in his gloved hand when the laminating roll, which is hot and sticky, caught his glove and pulled his hand into the rollers. He was hospitalized with burns and a fracture.
While using an oxy-acetylene torch, an employee tripped over the hose and fell, breaking the thigh bone.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking to her car in the parking lot, fracturing her right tibia.
An employee sustained burns to the side of the face and neck after coming in contact with heavy oil while unplugging a bleeder valve.
An employee tripped on a curb while walking in the parking lot. The employee's left hand was lacerated.

On February 2, 2016, a maintenance employee was checking the photo eye on the panel saw. As he checked the eye, the program fence released and crushed his right ankle between the fence and a pressure beam. He was hospitalized.
While walking to the building, an employee slipped on a patch of ice in the parking lot and broke her left leg. She was hospitalized.

An employee was helping with ground work when a strap holding an auger to a truck broke and the auger swung free, hitting the employee in the head. He was knocked unconscious and was hospitalized with a head laceration. The employee was wearing a hardhat at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping an aerial access driver load multiple mobile light plants that were off-rent onto an aerial access trailer. The employee was bent down in a squat position, attempting to adjust the tongue of a mobile light tower, when the aerial access driver put his back against the rear light plant and shoved it forward. The employee's index finger was caught between the transport trailer deck and tongue of the mobile light tower, amputating the left index fingertip.
A fire extinguisher fell while it was being serviced, striking an employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving a part from an order when her foot got caught in a plastic strap, causing her to trip and fall. She fractured her femur (right leg) and was hospitalized.
An employee's left ring finger was partially amputated after being struck by a sledge hammer while the employee was repairing a 34-inch pipeline.

An employee was moving a finished part (a pipe) that was coming down the conveyor of the roll former machine. The pipe became jammed, flew up, and hit the employee in the neck. The employee was hospitalized with a neck laceration.

An employee was laying a metal deck with another employee when he lost his footing and fell approximately 20 feet over the leading edge. He suffered several fractures to the back and neck bones and a gash on the side of his head.
An employee was climbing up or down a scaffold ladder when he fell approximately 14 feet and broke his leg.
An employee was working on an adhesive machine when the adhesive paper stuck to the employee and pulled him into the machine roller. He suffered a potential collarbone fracture and other injuries.

An employee was cleaning a plastic recycling line when the fan blades inside the machine hit and partially amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee and client were horse playing by doing flips when the employee fell to the ground and broke her left arm.

An employee was gathering parts from a conveyor, placing them in a hamper on an adjustable work table. The employee moved the knee-high work table and then tripped over the cord, which was stretched and above the floor. She fell to the floor, fracturing her left femur below the hip joint.  She was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee used lacquer thinner to clean the lid of a glue pot over a barrel.  He then used a heated putty knife to clean the remaining glue from the lid. When the knife touched the lid, the fumes and thinner caused the lid and barrel to flash and catch on fire. The employee suffered first degree burns on his face and left hand.

An employee was operating a shear to cut metal when the shear's control activated while the employee's hand was in the point of contact. The employee's right middle finger was amputated (half an inch) by the blade.

An employee was vacuum filtering a 49-percent hydrofluoric acid solution in a lab hood when the hydrofluoric acid was pulled through a vacuum pump during filtration. The employee inhaled the fumes, and her right ear and head were contacted by the solution.

On 2/2/16, at 9:45 a.m., an employee was pouring hot water from a bucket into the sink when hot water contacted the employee's right leg. The employee suffered 3rd degree burns from the knee to the ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing bolts from the bottom of a cylinder bottom core when the core fell and struck the employee. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the upper right arm and a fractured right thumb.

While walking from a vehicle to the office, an employee slipped on wet snow and fell to the ground on the driveway incline. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the right ankle, requiring surgery.

Two employees were removing sheets of plywood from old shelving when a piece about 3' by 6' slipped. The injured employee's right pinky fingertip was caught against the plywood and the skin tore off (no bone damage) within the employee's glove. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was talking with a powered industrial truck (PIV) operator who was unloading a vehicle. As he walked back to his office, the PIV operator reversed the PIV and hit him, knocking him to the ground and running over and fracturing his left foot/ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when he lost control and was pinned between the jack and a metal storage rack. He suffered lacerations and a muscle injury to his lower left leg.
An employee was handling glass panes when the glass shifted and fell on the employee resulting in injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a 10-foot A-frame ladder, changing a motor inside a dropped ceiling's air handler. He fell off the ladder, fracturing his right upper arm and his right wrist.
A 2,200-pound, 6-inch-wide steel coil fell over onto an employee's leg.
While working on a painting assembly line, an employee was injured when an automated door closed as the employee was trying to pull out a part. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was doing a machine die rotation on a brake press when the die slipped out of place and fell onto the employee's left middle finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was helping to install a marine loading arm.  As he stood near the base of the loading arm, the weight shifted and struck him, causing his right-hand index finger to be caught and amputated between the base of the loading arm and a piece of pipe.
An employee was leaving work, slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot breaking the right hip.

On Wednesday, February 3, 2016, an employee was getting into the passenger's side of an aerial lift truck when he slipped on ice. He attempted to grab the side of the truck, and a ring on his left ring finger got caught on a bolt on the side of the aerial lift. His left ring finger was amputated.

An employee was just finishing up loading a barge. The employee was on the barge to unhook the back cable attached to the tug at the back of the barge. The employee was walking toward the front of the barge and the cable line sprang up to chest height. He continued to walk to the front of the barge to get out of the cable's way. When he was toward the front corner, he swung his leg around and over the timberhead.  Just as his leg was going over the cable, the cable pinned his leg between the cable and the timberhead breaking the lower leg.
An employee choked on a piece of chicken while testing food for a new menu.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs to the basement while carrying equipment in his hands. He tripped and fell fracturing five ribs and chipping vertebrae.
An employee was troubleshooting equipment and suffered an amputation.

On February 3, 2016, at approximately 4:30pm, an employee was injured while attempting to restrain a patient who became irate and physically aggressive.  The security officer was hospitalized for a concussion.
On February 3, 2016, an employee was hospitalized with a fractured right leg after being pinned between a walkie lift and a stack of pallets.

An employee was performing maintenance functions on board an aircraft.  The employee manually reclined a passenger seat back and raised the foot rest to inspect under the seat.  Using his right hand, the employee pulled on the manual release mechanism to lower the foot rest, not realizing that his left thumb was between the foot rest support structure.  As the foot rest was released, it automatically dropped to the folded position, severing off the employee's left thumb at the first knuckle (approximately 1").
On February 3rd, 2016, an employee was adding chlorine to the water and received chemical burns to the gastrointestinal tract from breathing in the chlorine gas.

An employee was transporting a swivel from one side of the shop to the other. As he was getting ready to lower the swivel to connect it to another machine, the bottom part dropped onto his right pinky finger. The employee was transported to the hospital where his finger was amputated.

An employee was operating the T-80 Kauffman Tapper machine. When he reached into the machine to clear a shaving, he bumped his hand on the spinning tap and suffered a partial amputation on the right index finger involving skin and flesh with no bone loss.
An employee was fabricating a bracket and sharping a piece of metal on a belt sander. The metal bracket slipped out of his hand, rotated and sliced the top of his left thumb.
Employee was descending a six foot self supporting ladder and slipped and fell to the ground resulting in a strained knee and wrist.
Employee was walking on a sidewalk outside the office when he slipped on black ice and fell to the ground, breaking his right femur and suffering head trauma.

A worker was pressure washing concrete slab. The hose became kinked. During the process of un-kinking the hose the spray wand slipped and made contact with the worker's hand just enough to actuate the water spray. The nozzle which was very close to the worker's right leg sprayed high-pressure water into the worker's calf. The action caused a pin-prick sized hole that was quickly filled with water and air. The laborer was admitted to the local hospital.
An employee was spraying water on the floor to clean up in the prepared food department when she tripped over the hose and fell to the ground.  The employee sustained a right hip fracture.
Employees were removing the panel cover on a vacuum pump when there was an arc flash. An employee was hospitalized for burns to the face, head, arms, eyes, and hands.

An employee was performing maintenance on the trough machine.  The guard was removed to ensure the machine was operating properly. One of the troughs fell out of the machine and activated the micro-switch, which activated the machine cycle.  The employee's left forearm was caught and injured in the machine.
An employee slipped and fell while entering the cafeteria suffering a broken knee cap requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered electrical burns to the right hand while making adjustments inside a generator when it was turned on by another employee.

The employee was working on an elevated platform (scaffolding) removing form boards from a new concrete structure.  The employee was tied off to a form board that had been taken apart by mistake.  The form board fell 15'-20' to the ground pulling the employee to the ground with it. The employee suffered a fractured leg.

An employee was operating the Pierce and Prime Line. A primer got jammed in the line and the employee used a tool to try and unjam the line. The tool set off the primer and the adjacent primers causing a minor explosion. The employee was hospitalized with abrasions and lacerations to their face and body.
An employee was hospitalized after being pushed to the ground by a customer resulting in a broken hip, clavicle and ribs.

An employee was struck in the head while removing a concrete form used to manufacture burial vaults. The form was being removed when a bar swung and hit the employee in the head, knocking him to the ground. The employee was standing on the floor at the time and was wearing a protective helmet. He was hospitalized after being knocked unconscious with a cut to the head.
An employee was opening the top hatches on railcars when he slipped and fell to the ground, striking his head.
An employee fell off a ladder and hit his head.
An employee was using compressed air to remove sawdust from resaw and amputated the right thumb, index and middle fingers.
The employee was cutting shank meat using a band saw and amputated the fleshy tip of the right ring finger. The fingertip was reattached by outpatient surgical procedure.
An employee was loading a semi trailer with product using a pallet rider. She got pinned between the pallet rider and the wall of the semi resulting in a fractured pelvis.

A temporary employee was operating an automatic welder and attempted to clean the weld heads while the machine was still in operation.  The left ring finger was amputated to the first knuckle and the left pinky fingertip was also amputated.
An employee engaged in painting operations for large tractors became entangled in the equipment and suffered a distal forearm amputation.
A temporary employee was removing reject logs from the line 5 conveyor belt when he got his finger caught-in the drive chain sprocket and suffered an amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee suffered a left ring finger amputation when loading a damaged vehicle onto a tow truck.
An employee unloading shingles from a truck suffered a fall that lacerated the spleen and required hospitalization.
An employee was finishing up concrete when concrete got into the top of the employee's boots and burned both feet.
An employee was walking across the street to terminal B at KCI and fell, striking his face. The employee was hospitalized with contusions to the face and arms.
An employee was cutting metal on the shear machine and amputated the left ring fingertip.

An employee was delivering sheet rock to a new residential home. While unstrapping a metal cart from the truck, it rolled off and struck the employee on the head and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the 5 inch pizza dough press. She reached her hand into the machine to clear some debris on the belt and the die cycled amputating the tip of her right ring finger.

An employee was operating the winding machine and knelt down to get a better view. His knee gave out and he fell forward extending his hand to brace himself. His hand contacted the machine blade and amputated the right middle finger.
An employee suffered a broken right leg resulting in in-patient hospitalization after falling from a 12 inch platform.
An employee was working with the basket mill in the production area and severely lacerated his left thumb. The employee was hospitalized and received surgery on his finger.
An employee was picking up steel and dropped a 70lb. piece onto his left foot. The employee was hospitalized with a contusion on the left foot requiring surgery.
An forklift operator struck another employee in the aisle way and injured the employee's right leg. The injury resulted in a mid-calf amputation of the right foot.

An employee was attempting to remove a pressure washer tip on the pressure washer while it was running. High pressure water was injected into the employee's palm and left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.

On or about February 4, 2016, an employee was operating a crane and lifting a bundle of wire mesh.  The employee was underneath the raised load when the load fell, fracturing the employee's femur, pelvis and face.
An employee was operating a burden carrier in reverse and caught their left foot between the carrier and a steel beam resulting in a fractured lower left leg.
An employee was pinned between a semi-trailer and a dock door resulting in a crushed pelvis, fractured vertebrae and internal bleeding that required hospitalization.

An employee was rolling an oil drum off of the back of the truck when he slipped and fell to the pavement below.  The driver was found unconscious. The employee was hospitalized with traumatic injuries to the C-5 and C-6 vertebrae that will require surgery in the future.
On February 4, 2016, an employee was hospitalized due to an injury to the left hand requiring surgery. The employee was changing the tip of a spray gun and paint was injected into his palm.
An employee was loading laundry and a large load of laundry fell onto his leg, fracturing it.
On 2/4/2016 at approximately 3:15 AM, an employee fell approximately four feet while climbing down a ladder and fractured a hip.

An employee was washing trucks inside a wash bay and began to feel light headed. The employee was hospitalized due to CO exposure. It was determined that the cause of the CO was an improperly installed vent pipe on the newly installed pressure washer system.

On February 4th at approximately 2:00 PM, a maintenance mechanic was repairing a broken chain on a debarking/log cutter machine.  A compression roller (log holder) came down and pinned the employee.  The employee was hospitalized with two broken vertebrae requiring surgery. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was trying to put a bit in a lifting rig for transport via a trolley crane. As he was extending his right arm it made contact with a sharp edge of the bit causing a laceration to the right forearm. The bit weighs approximately 50 pounds is 12 inches in length and 18-24 inches in width.
A temporary employee suffered a broken lower leg when a large steel coil tipped over and fell onto his right leg.
An employee was cutting turkey with a knife and severed the tip of her left thumb.

A crane operator was stacking concrete slabs. A slab on the stack slid and struck another employee on the ground in the left thigh area. The employee was hospitalized due to deep laceration to the thigh requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a rail car opener when the employee's safety vest became entangled on the rotating shaft pulling the employee in and breaking bones. The employee also lost consciousness.
An employee was positioning a loading dock leveler. The dock leveler's hinge sprung open and severed the employee's left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee suffered an amputation injury when a skid kicked back on a band saw causing two boards to fold together pinching his finger.

An employee suffered a fracture to their left arm when it was struck by a falling draft gear weighing approximately 250-300 lbs.  The employee was using wooden blocks to stabilized the piece in preparation for welding operations when the piece fell off the wooden blocks and struck the employee.

While performing pump repairs, an employee got his right middle finger pinched between the coupling extender on the pump and the discharge piping flange resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee had just completed ripping a piece of wood stock when he changed the process and began to shave it.  While in the process of shaving the wood block it kicked forward causing the employee's hand to move forward into the rotating blade. The employee sustained an amputation injury to the tip of his right thumb.
A pizza delivery driver was robbed, shot and beaten at approximately 7:50 pm February 4, 2016.  He was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the saddle pack department taking product off the test line when the actuator activated and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was working on a Ferris wheel because a sweep was not lining up properly.  As the crew was working to line it up, it let go, crushing the employee's fingers on the right hand.

On February 4, 2016, at approximately 4:00pm, an employee was operating a Ryder pallet jack in a 9'10" wide aisle way.  He passed a second employee operating another pallet jack in the opposite direction.  The load of pallets on the second employee's pallet jack struck a guardrail causing a pallet to fall onto the employee and lacerate his right calf.

In the afternoon of February 4, 2016, two employees were 
lifting a concrete pole onto a truck using a crane when another concrete pole on the ground rolled away from the stack and struck one of the employee's lower left leg and foot. The employee was hospitalized for medical treatment.
An employee delivering mail was bitten by a dog on the right thumb and forearm. The injuries required hospitalization.

An employee working from a ladder at an elevation of approximately 8' fell from the ladder onto a carpeted floor and struck his head and back.  He was admitted to the hospital with a skull fracture and cranial bleeding.

An employee had completed performing maintenance work on a piece of equipment and was in the process of lowering the JLG with a crane. The thumb of his right hand was caught in the line that was being used to lower the JLG removing muscle and tissue. The employee was transported to the hospital where his thumb was removed above the knuckle.
The employee was getting out of his truck, slipped on snow-covered ice on the ground and fell breaking his pelvis.

A maintenance employee removed the fuel tank from truck, set it on the ground and then began pressurizing the tank to located an air leak.  A portion of the tank exploded from being over-pressurized. The employee sustained facial injuries and damage to the left arm.

The employee was working from the 6th rung of an 8' ladder.  He removed a strap from a pipe containing conduit which had tension on it.  When he removed the strap, the force slung him off of the ladder and onto the concrete below. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was working on a board stacker. One of the boards went in crooked and when the employee tried to straighten it, his right forearm was caught in the machine.
An employee was cleaning the blender auger and slipped and fell, hitting the framework of the equipment and fracturing ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was part of a crew that was off loading a barge of 10' scrap pipe encased in concrete.  One of the joints was not lying straight, so the injured employee stood on top of the pile of pipe kicking it in order to roll it into place.  It rolled into place, and when it moved, he fell and another piece of pipe rolled up onto the back of his leg fracturing it.
An employee was admitted to the hospital with a fractured femur after being struck by a piece of metal.
An employee was hospitalized after their right arm was injured while reaching into an agitating hoper.

An employee was lifting a bundle of bars with an overhead crane.  The employee was steadying the load with his ungloved left hand.  The load of bars shifted and pinched his finger.  The employee suffered a partial amputation of his left ring finger.
An employee suffered an amputation when he reached into the running dry tip machine.

On February 5, 2016, an employee was using a table saw with a circular saw blade for cutting wood. The employee sustained a severe cut to his left hand thumb that was surgically amputated at the hospital.
The employee was working off an 8 foot step ladder to replace a light bulb in an outside fixture. The employee fell off of the ladder and was hospitalized with a concussion and head/face trauma.
An employee walking down the stairs lost her balance and fell down the stairs, breaking her leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trouble shooting the bar sealer. The employee's hand triggered the optics resulting in a partial amputation of the right middle finger.

On 02/05/2015 at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was operating a plate punch ironworker machine.  A piece of steel jammed, and he tried to dislodge or unjam it from the machine.  The tip of his left index finger was pinched by the machine resulting in the loss of the fingertip and some of the finger nail.

On February 5, 2016, at approximately 12:30pm, an employee was injured while operating a full revolution mechanical power press.  The employee was transferring can parts into a redraw die. Two fingers on his right hand became trapped between the can part and the working die as he removed the can part from the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle and ring fingers.
An employee working with a table saw attempted to move material away from the blade and contacted the saw blade resulting in the amputation of one finger and laceration of three fingers.

An employee was operating an order picker and was struck by furniture when it fell from the order picker and pushed the employee into a mesh guard. The employee was hospitalized with a traumatic brain injury with loss of consciousness and a laceration above the right eye.
An employee was working at a computer desk at the nurses station.  The employee stood up and walk two or three steps and fell fracturing the left femur.

The injured employee was working with other employees to rig and lift a bridge beam for transport. The bridge beam was frozen in the ice/ground.  When the beam was dislodged it struck the employee resulting in a crushing injury to his shoulder.

An employee received an injury to the right middle finger that required surgery and hospitalization. The employee's finger was caught between a pump plunger and the catwalk when the pump plunger fell to the catwalk.
An employee lost the tip of his right ring finger when it was caught in the trailer door.

On February 05, 2016, at approximately 10:10 p.m., an employee removed a fixed safety guard to clear jammed material from the cutting machine. The cutting blade activated and amputated a finger and a thumb tip.
The employee was delivering food to a customer in the parking lot. The employee slipped on ice and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was cutting metal with a saw and a piece of metal lodged in the employee's eye.
A route driver was unloading a truck, lost his footing, and fell out of the rear of the truck resulting in an elbow fracture/dislocation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking outside the warehouse when the employee slipped on a thin layer of black ice and fell to the ground breaking an ankle.
An employee was exiting a tractor when his prosthetic leg caught the side of the door and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a bone chip to the upper right portion of his leg.
An employee crushed his right pinky finger when it was smashed between the door and the door jam, resulting in an amputation from the nail bed up.

Three employees were moving the frame of a trailer to be placed on the bed of the trailer. The employees were guiding the frame, which was suspended from a crane. The injured employee had his finger caught between the frame and the bed of the trailer when the trailer frame was lowered into position, causing an amputation.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle and collided with another employee operating a powered industrial vehicle resulting in two fractures to the tibia and multiple soft tissue injuries to the foot.
An employee was attempting to dismount a tall storage rack and fell breaking the right leg.
A pipe crushed an employee's finger between a pipe and the bucket of a frontend loader resulting in amputation of the left pinky finger at the hospital.
An employee suffered the amputation of the left hand middle finger to the first knuckle while testing the U1 cell heat sealer.
An employee was walking to their vehicle in the parking lot at the end of a shift, slipped on ice, and fell resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was putting a ramp back into a trailer and the ramp slipped and smashed his finger.
A worker fell off a manlift and was hospitalized for broken ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.

On 2/5/16 at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was loading four-inch black pipe onto a truck rack. The employee was securing the pipe into straps and a pipe rolled back onto his hands. The employee was wearing leather work gloves. The pipe crushed his right middle finger on his right hand resulting in a hairline fracture and laceration requiring sutures. The employee was later hospitalized for treatment of an infection.
An employee fell in an aisle way and suffered a broken left hip.

On February 6, 2016, at approximately 12:30 PM, an employee sustained an amputation of the left middle finger to the first joint. The employee was preparing to dump a dumpster elevated by a forklift when the dumpster rolled back onto the employee's hand.

An employee was helping the driver of a winch truck back up and hook up to a tank.  When the driver was close enough to the tank to hook up, the employee told him to stop and set the brakes. An employee responded to a road service call where he was going to replace two tires on an 18 wheeler. The employee was inflating the tire and when the bead set on the tire. The rim flew off and struck the employee resulting in a broken leg.
While rolling the belt onto or off a pulley, the employee's glove was caught in between the pulley cutting the right pinky.
An employee was working on a skinner machine and amputated the whole middle finger on the left hand.
An employee was hammering a lifting rod and hit a finger while swinging the hammer causing a laceration and fracture of the left index finger.

An employee was attempting to put a cat into a temporary holding cage, so that she could clean the cat's main holding cage. As she reached her left hand in to handle the cat, it bit her. The employee received 27 puncture wounds as a result. The employee was hospitalized for further treatment.
An employee was walking from the plant to his car and slipped on ice falling to the ground and breaking his shoulder.
On or about February 6, 2016, an employee amputated the right ring fingertip while operating a grinder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a pump from a piece of equipment.  The air supply to the pump was knocked loose, closing a valve and amputating the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee working in the melt department was injured while moving materials by hoist. The employee pinched his 4th and 5th distal ends between the wire rope and the sheave of the load block, resulting in an amputation of the 5th distal digit.
An employee slipped on ice and grabbed the door to prevent a fall injuring the employee's hip. The employee did not fall to the ground, but was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was operating surveying equipment. A dirt clod rolled down a hill and struck the employee in the back knocking him to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a back laceration.
On 2/6/16, an employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow after losing control of an ATV and rolling it over.
An employee was retracting the legs of the drilling platform when the jack pinned his right thumb.  The employee was taken to the hospital where the doctor was able to reattached his thumb.
Whiles walking across a wet floor behind the horizontal mixers, an employee slipped and fell hitting his head and right hip on the floor.
An employee sustained a hernia while lifting a vanity for installation.

A glass shelf was leaning against the employee's leg. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor and some of the glass shelves fell on top of her. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and a bruised right leg.
After caring for a patient, an employee tripped on a chair and broke her hip.
An employee suffered a head injury as a result of a fall from a 10-12 foot ladder.
An employee was operating a forklift. While turning into an aisle, the employee lost control of the forklift and put his left hand out catching his left thumb between the forklift and the racking.
An employee was walking out of the guard shack and slipped on some rock salt on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a torn femoral tendon in the right leg.
An employee was repairing a leaking site glass containing caustic acid when the glass ruptured. The employee suffered thermal burns from the wrist to the shoulder.

An employee was loading his trailer when he heard a hissing sound. He climbed the ladder to check the dome of the trailer, tightened the bolts and began to climb down the ladder. On February 7, 2016, an employee cleaning the beef patty machine unit amputated the tip of the left ring finger.
While lifting a case of drinks, an employee felt pain in the lower back. The employee was hospitalized with a lower back strain.
An employee slipped on ice on the ramp outside of the jetway breaking an ankle that required surgical repair.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. As the employee was exiting the freezer section of the warehouse, she noticed that her forklift began to slide. She lacerated her foot and possibly fractured her ankle.

While an employee was driving a baggage tug across a wet ramp, she collided with a second tug being driven by a coworker. She was ejected from the vehicle, breaking her pelvic bone.  A seat belt was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was descending a ladder from a roof when the ladder collapsed. The employee fell to the ground and broke his left arm.
An employee was operating a drill press while using gloves. The gloves were caught in the drill, lacerating part of the employee's thumb.

On or about February 8, 2016, at 7:00 a.m., an employee was stepping out of her car when she slipped and fell on ice on the top level of the parking garage. She fractured her left ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee's right-hand index fingertip was amputated by a mixer-grinder machine head. The grinder was still spinning at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell 3 to 4 feet off the back of a straight truck while filling up the water tank, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was operating a cut-off saw when his glove was stuck in a chain, pulling his hand into the saw blades. He amputated his pinky finger and part of his right-hand ring finger.
An employee was working on a drilling operation. An excavator was lowering a pipe casing onto a stack of casings when the casing shifted, contacting and bruising the employee's right leg.

An employee was unloading a tractor trailer using a reach powered industrial truck (PIT).
