The employee suffered a broken left clavicle and facial fractures.
An employee attempted to stop a moving belt and sheave when his fingers were caught in the rotating parts, amputating the second, third, and fourth digit fingertips on his left hand.
An employee was spotting for a driver backing up a truck when the employee's arm was pinched between the truck and a dumpster at the site. He suffered a broken arm.
While counting product on a storage shelf, an employee lost their balance and fell. The employee's foot was caught under a wood pallet, and the employee's right ankle fractured, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the forklift struck a shelf support, chipping the employee's vertebrae and other bones.
An employee was picking up plywood that was covering a floor opening when the employee fell 10 to 15 feet through the opening.
An employee slipped on snow in the driveway of a client's home, fracturing his right ankle. He was hospitalized for surgery.
On or about February 8, 2016, an employee suffered a pelvic injury after being caught in/crushed between form work and a precast panel.
An employee's left thumb was slammed in the door of a work vehicle, causing an open fracture to the thumb and an amputation of the distal tip. The employee required reattachment surgery.
On or about February 8, 2016, an employee was hand-feeding a gluer machine when the employee's right hand was caught in the machine. The employee was hospitalized with a right hand injury.
While attempting to remove trash wood that fell behind a machine, an employee's glove was caught in the machine's rotating bit, puncturing the right hand and wrist.
An employee received a laceration on his left hand and a skin avulsion on his right arm after being pulled into a conveyor in the coating department while performing maintenance.
An employee was running production on a spot welder when the employee's hand was caught in the machine's point of operation, amputating the thumb.

An employee was servicing a forklift at a customer's site when the employee's hand was struck by the forklift motor cooling fan blade. The employee suffered hand and wrist lacerations and a broken middle finger. The forklift was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell while delivering mail.

On February 8, 2016, at approximately 1:00 PM, an employee working on an HVAC unit fell approximately 8 feet into the return case of an air handler unit on the roof of the structure. The employee suffered vertebrae, rib, and scapula fractures, as well as a collapsed lung.
While operating a bagging machine, an employee's hand was crushed, amputating his left index finger.

On Monday, February 8, 2016, at approximately 12:15 PM, an employee was operating a double rider (powered industrial truck). An employee had just poured concrete on the bridge deck and was using a paving machine to move the concrete when the employee slipped back and fell approximately 10 to 11 feet to the lower roadway from the upper bridge level. The employee hit a metal corrugated pipe and fractured the left knee.
On or about February 8, 2016, a marble slab fell on an employee while the employee was unstrapping it. The employee suffered a severe pelvic injury and broken thigh.
While an employee was attempting to slice a meat product using a knife, the blade lacerated the employee's abdomen just above the belly guard.
While removing furniture, an employee was struck by the furniture and fell backward into a metal rack, causing a neck fracture, cerebral concussion, and scalp laceration.
A trash can fell and hit an employee's leg, breaking it.
On or about February 8, 2016, an employee was delivering a water heater to a homeowner when he slipped on snow-covered ice and broke his leg, requiring surgery.
An employee was mopping a floor on February 8, 2016, when she slipped and fell injuring her right side and ribs.

An employee was injured and required hospitalization after she fell in the dining area of the facility.  Mats had been stacked in an area and the employee tripped over the mats while carrying a tray of food.
While troubleshooting a dock board, a maintenance employee became pinned under the unit.

Workers were performing tree trimming activities at a residential jobsite. While moving traffic cones that were stored on a wood chipper, an employee's right hand contacted the chipper's fan assembly, amputating his fingertips.
On February 9, 2016, an employee's left thumb was amputated to the first joint while the employee was operating a brake press to bend steel.
On February 9, 2016, at approximately 10:30 PM, an employee was pressure-washing the inside of a scrubber unit and felt a pain in his back. He was hospitalized overnight with a strained back.
An employee was unloading a new chiller from a truck using the lift gate. While trying to get a dolly off of the truck, the chiller fell on and pinned the employee, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee had just worked on an aircraft while standing on a movable platform. As he was going down the platform's fixed ladder, he slipped between the second- and third-from-the-top rungs (a total of three rungs) and fell 2 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
While trying to stop three patients from escaping an area of the facility, an employee was kicked in the leg by one of the patients. The employee suffered a broken tibia.

An employee was snowmobiling while participating in a winter training exercise. The employee was dislodged from the snowmobile and struck a rocky surface, fracturing the left ankle and dislocating a shoulder.
On February 9, 2016, an employee was attempting to trip the proximity sensor on the finishing line when the clamp activated, amputating the employee's left thumb distal to the first joint.
While transporting bags to a terminal, an employee walked between the bag carts and a motorized tug. While turning left, the employee suffered a broken left leg, requiring hospitalization.
While delivering mail at a private residence, an employee slipped on black ice and fell on the stairs.  The employee injured the left ankle and was hospitalized overnight, requiring surgery.
While moving a wooden pallet, an employee received a wooden splinter to the left palm.

An employee was working on top of a steel girder when he stepped down to a concrete bend that was approximately 30 inches beneath the girder and diagram. While attempting to unjam a reefed system, an employee's right hand was caught between the rotary valve and a rotating part in the system's discharge shoot. His hand was amputated.
An employee was hit by a vehicle in the parking lot as she was on her way to work. She suffered broken bones in her ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a truck trailer when the truck shifted, causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture his shoulder. He was hospitalized overnight for surgery.
An employee getting out of a truck fell to the ground and fractured his right hip.

On Tuesday, 02/09/16, an employee was operating a skid steer to push a hot slab when he got stuck. When a coworker tried to push him out, the employee's right arm was burned by the hot slab, eventually requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a miter saw to cut aluminum while building a sign. The saw blade grabbed the aluminum material, and the material lacerated the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was hospitalized for knee pain after performing shoring activities.
An employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder while carrying a piece of lumber when he fell, injuring his ribs and lung.

On February 9, 2016, an employee was performing maintenance on a front-wheel drive prismatic machine. While the employee was working on the coolant tank, the high-level arm was activated, causing the tank pump to start. The employee's right pinky finger was amputated by the pump impeller.
An employee was on a scissor lift when it tipped over onto him and pinned him, breaking bones in his back.

An employee was working with a client as part of the day program when the client experienced a behavioral outburst and pushed the employee to the floor. The employee suffered a broken hip and had to be hospitalized.
An employee was working on the reactor when a chemical reaction in a tank caused a metal pump housing to burst. The employee's right leg was fractured below the knee.
On or about February 9, 2016, an employee received an amputation while operating a lathe.

While riding on a waste collection truck, an employee fell backward and struck his head on the ground. He later fell again, this time on his face, injuring his right arm and sustaining a possible concussion. He was hospitalized.

While an employee was laying pipe, a piece of 36" concrete pipe became disconnected from an excavator. The pipe rolled down the slope of the excavation and up against the employee, striking and breaking his lower left leg bones.
An employee was preparing to clean a machine and asked a coworker for assistance. The two were then involved in a physical altercation, and the employee sustained neck and throat injuries.
An employee was pulling a piece of material from a table top when the employee slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing the hip.
An employee was grading veneer wood when his hand was caught in a drive chain sprocket. His right index and long fingers were amputated.

While attempting a motorcycle jump during rehearsal, an employee hit the front of the landing ramp on stage at the waist and fell down to the stage via air bag. He suffered a laceration at the waist and a fractured pelvic bone, requiring surgery.

He suffered a large laceration to the palm of his right hand below the middle and ring finger, as well as a broken finger.

An employee was operating a boring mill machine while his right hand rested on top of a metal beam on the shuttle. The beam moved during the operation of the machine and pinched his right middle fingertip between it and another metal beam. His fingertip was amputated.
An employee stepped on a spray nozzle and fell onto a concrete floor, fracturing and dislocating her ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing repair activities on a dock leveler when support blocks failed, allowing the dock plate to come down on top of the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured vertebrae and ruptured discs.
An employee was loading trailers on a semi-trailer for shipment. While climbing off the trailer, the employee's wedding ring got caught, de-gloving the finger.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor when her left-hand glove was caught in a roller. Her left middle finger was partially amputated, and her left index finger was fractured.
An employee was cleaning a paper machine when the employee's hand contacted the machine, resulting in a left-hand palm laceration that required hospitalization and stitches.

While pop riveting awning trim from a single buck scaffold platform, an employee fell approximately 6 feet from the platform onto the concrete below, suffering a head injury. The platform was unguarded at the time.

An employee was operating a rotary card sealer when a package became mis-positioned. While he attempted to reposition the package, the machine cycled and caught his left hand, burning and crushing three fingers.
On or about February 10, 2016, an employee was hospitalized with a left rib/lung area injury after falling from the tailgate of a delivery truck to the ground.
An employee slipped and fell on the cement while taking trash to the compactor, sustaining a fractured right wrist that required surgery.
An employee amputated her left pinky finger after contacting a moving part (chain and gear) on a machine.
After installing a light fixture, an employee fell off the ladder, suffering a compression fracture to the lower back and dislocating an elbow.

An employee was using a jib crane to flip a cantilever. He guided the hook with his right hand and used the crane controller with his left hand. The employee hit the "up" button on the controller and his finger was caught between the hook and the cantilever, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee's right middle fingertip was amputated while the employee attempted to unjam a blanker die and block machine.

An employee was taking straps off a loaded flatbed. A load of metal cattle panels shifted when the tie-down straps were removed, causing metal panels to fall on the employee. The employee suffered scratches and bruises.

An employee was unloading the last window from a container when the previously unloaded windows that were stacked against the container fell against his lower leg. He was hospitalized with a broken tibia and required surgery.

On or about 2/10/2016, an employee was at the back of his mail delivery truck gathering the mail to be delivered when he was shot twice. He suffered gunshot wounds to the right side of his face and body.
On 2/10/16, an employee's hand was caught in the exit roller of an assembly table. The employee was hospitalized and his left index finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was trying to hook a set of trailers together when he slipped and fell, breaking his right leg.
An employee was cutting plywood on a table saw when the sawblade amputated his left thumb at the knuckle.

An employee was in the bucket of an aerial lift while it was being repaired. A stabilizing cable broke, the bucket tipped, and the employee fell to the ground. An employee was using a grinder on a vehicle when the sparks created by the grinder ignited brake cleaner on the vehicle. The resulting flames burned the employee's face.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a conveyor, checking to see if material or debris had fallen down under the conveyor. The employee was caught between the conveyor and a cross bar under the conveyor, crushing his abdomen. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was working on a residential cable connection outside while standing on an extension ladder. While the employee was descending, the base of the ladder slipped on ice, causing the ladder and employee to fall. The employee suffered lumbar and hip injuries.

An employee was reaching down to pick up a box to clear a jam when his jacket was caught in a roller. As he tried to pull it out, his hand got pulled in as well. His hand and lower arm were crushed. The roller is part of a recirculation belt-driven conveyor.
An employee was walking from one deck to the deck feeder. As he crossed the gap between the two, his foot became caught in the chainway, breaking his right ankle.
An employee was working with a chop saw when his hand was exposed to the blade, partially amputating his right index finger.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking from a vehicle in the parking lot to the building entrance. The employee tore ligaments in the left knee and sprained both ankles.

An employee was cutting a narrow strip of flexi glass using a table saw. He was pushing the flexi glass with a 'push stick' using his right hand and was holding the material with his left hand. As the material was going through the blade, his left index finger was caught by the table saw blade, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was hooking a winch cable from a truck to a crane while standing between them. The truck was positioned up hill from the crane. As the employee was connecting the winch line, the truck slid down the icy hill and pinned the employee against the crane. The employee suffered soft tissue damage in the left shoulder.
An employee was holding a chain attached to a gopher machine being lifted by a forklift. The employee's hand was caught in the chain as it was being lifted, fracturing the right ring fingertip.
An employee's left finger fractured after getting caught in a door that was being closed.

An employee was changing the jaws on a CNC lathe when the jaw hydraulic clamps were actuated by the foot control. His right index fingertip was amputated above the first joint between the jaws and the new part.
An employee's hand was caught in the chain at the end of a stinger trailer, amputating two fingertips.
While walking by truck pallets, an employee tripped over plastic wrap and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken hip from impact with the floor.
An employee mistakenly grabbed a bottle of methanol, believing it to be a water bottle, and took a drink. The employee suffered from methanol poisoning.
An employee was unloading coils from a truck using an overhead crane and was injured when his finger was crushed between the rigging coil tongs and the coils that were being picked up by the rigging.
An employee was walking a small dog and slipped on the ice. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice and suffered a broken leg.
A forklift backed into and struck an employee who was walking on a ramp, crushing both of the employee's legs.

An employee was unhooking chain slings on a crane moving via remote control. Hooks from the overhead crane, which was being operated remotely by a coworker, caught a 6-foot-tall bundle of steel stacked behind the employee and pulled it over onto the employee's leg. The employee's leg broke.

He was hospitalized with upper and lower body injuries, including strains, sprains, and severe bruising to the leg and torso.
An employee was using an end milling machine while wearing gloves. The machine caught the employee's glove and amputated the left-hand index finger.
An employee was walking into work from the parking lot when she slipped and fell on icy pavement and fractured her left ankle, requiring hospitalization.

A worker was backing a log out of the mill when the log became jammed. When a maintenance employee attempted to push the log out with a block of wood, a chain amputated the maintenance employee's right index finger.

An employee had just completed performing preventative maintenance on a blower unit. A maintenance crew was fabricating and terminating an "EYE" splice on a tether. The injured employee was pulling a serving line trough a termination when the serving line wrapped around his right-hand middle fingertip. An employee was trying to remove cylinders that open/shut the grappler on a boom loader. The employee removed bolts and pins holding the cylinder in place, but the cylinder was stuck. The employee's left-hand middle and ring fingers were crushed. The middle finger was surgically amputated and the ring finger also required surgery.

An employee was cutting castings off of trees with a saw when the sawblade caught or broke and pulled his hand into the blade.  His right-hand ring finger was amputated, and the back of his hand was lacerated.
While stepping down to a work space to take pipe measurements, an employee's right knee gave out, causing him to fall onto piping below. He suffered a spiral fracture of his upper right tibia.

An employee was coming down a ladder. The wind pushed him to the ground, where he tripped on a wire, breaking his left leg.
An employee was running a conduit when a byproduct of the plant fell off a conveyor belt into a hot water tank. The water splattered onto the employee, causing skin burns.

An employee went on the roof to clean plastic debris. He noticed a piece of plastic by the leading edge of the roof. An employee was opening a door. The door handle broke and the employee fell to the ground fracturing the right arm.

An employee was stepping off of the tailgate of a truck when he slipped and fell, breaking his lower tibia.

An employee responded to a call about issues in the silo. The blower motor amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers, and fractured the employee's ring finger. The employee underwent surgery.
While removing plastic from an injection blow molding machine, an employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a handheld angle grinder on a light pole base when the grinder rebounded and contacted his unprotected face. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the left side of the face. The grinder was unguarded at the time of the incident.

While bending parts on a brake press, and employee's right index fingertip was amputated between the part and the press.
An employee was operating an auger to drill holes for electrical poles when an auger fell on the employee's right foot, amputating a toe.
While operating an electric powered pallet jack, an employee suffered crushing injuries when pinned between the handle of the pallet jack and a wall inside the building.

On February 12, 2016, an employee cutting wood was brushing sawdust away from the chop saw's cutting surface when the chop saw blade caught the employee's glove and pulled the employee's hand toward it. The employee's right thumb was amputated.

An employee was walking/working along the casting line as steel was being cast. He was wearing a PAPR unit around his waist line when his PAPR cartridge overheated and started to burn, filling his PAPR mask with smoke. The employee suffered from flu-like symptoms caused by smoke inhalation.

An employee was struck by a forklift.
An employee was using a hydraulic pop rivet gun to repair a railcar. The employee's finger was amputated when they pulled the trigger.

An employee was testing the jumps and features of the terrain park, lost control of the snowboard, and fell sustaining severe head trauma.
An employee was walking in the parking lot, slipped on ice, and fell fracturing the left ankle.

An employee was trying to clear a jam in the body shop when his foot slipped and the employee landed awkwardly. The employee suffered a fracture to his left ankle resulting in a hospitalization.

An employee was heating and circulating a chemical batch in a process tank. The employee opened the automatic valve in the control room to begin the transfer of hot molten chemical material. Two bottom drain valves were left open on the transfer line spilling the hot molten chemical material onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized for second and third degree burns to the lower extremities and both hands and arms.
An employee was fixing a boomerang machine caster. A support fell and pinched the employee's right index finger between the floor and the machine resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee slipped on pieces of laminated paper and fell breaking an ankle.
An employee was walking from the store to his truck, slipped on ice in the parking lot, and fell resulting in a broken right ankle.
An employee was reaching overhead to remove a metal spacer when an aluminum log fell on the employee's leg, breaking it.

On February 14, 2016, an employee was scrapping down the sides of a 56 gallon mixing tank with a wooden paint stick. His shirt got tangled with the rotating mixer shaft and the employee was pulled against the tank. The employee suffered a punctured lung, cracked ribs and lacerations to his right side, forearm and forehead.
On or about February 14, 2016, an employee was scrubbing equipment by hand and was hospitalized for a chemical irritation to the back of the hands from the diluted acid cleaner.
An employee amputated three fingers while working on an auger.

An employee was inspecting the location of a future concrete pour. A gust of wind lifted him and the material he was standing on into the air. When he landed on the ground, bones in the neck, arm, and back were broken.
An employee was cleaning equipment, slipped in the mud, and fractured the right fibula.
A worker lacerated his right finger while using a table saw. He was hospitalized as a result of the injury.
An employee fell about 20 feet from a ladder resulting in broken ribs, a broken wrist, bruises and a split liver.
An employee was using a sledge hammer to knock a piece of wood from in between pipes. The pipe struck the employee's right hand and lacerated it.
An employee was removing meat from a bone and punctured their wrist with the knife.
An employee amputated fingertips while operating a shearing machine.

An employee hurt his back while placing a roll of plastic onto an uncoiler.  The roll of plastic weighs approximately 40 pounds.  While placing the roll onto the uncoiler, the roll slipped and fell.  The employee attempted to catch the falling roll of plastic resulting in a lower back injury.
An employee cut her middle finger on a cake-sponge cutting machine resulting in a partial amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee slipped on the icy covered sidewalk leading to her car and broke her hip.
A employee was cleaning the sensing eye on the baler when the baler cycled and caught the employee's right middle fingertip resulting a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a pepperoni slicer and amputated his finger and severely lacerated several other fingers while attempting to remove food from the machine.

An employee was working after the store closed. He was using a reach truck to remove a vanity from a pallet that was stored in an overhead rack. He stepped backwards off the operator platform and fell approximately three feet to the ground level fracturing his collarbone. The safety belt and lanyard were not worn at the time.
An employee fell off a ladder.
An employee was lifting a 50 lb. pipe fitting elbow with another employee and suffered an abdominal hernia rupture on his right side.
An employee was trimming a palm with a polecat bucket lift. The polecat flipped over with the employee inside and the employee fell about 15 feet.
An employee was clearing debris from a sloped roof. The employee slipped on a piece of plywood and fell 18 feet to the ground resulting in a broken back.
On February 15, 2016, an employee was pushing a cart and tripped over pallet wrapping resulting in a fall to the floor and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was struck by a forklift when he was trying to warn the driver that a box was about to fall off the forklift. The forklift ran over the employee's right ankle resulting in the amputation of the foot.
An employee stepped off the bottom step of a fixed ladder at the crossover to a four-foot high conveyor and onto a piece of wood scrap. The employee suffered a twisted right ankle.

On February 5, 2016, at approximately 11:30am, an employee was delimbing a felled tree on sloped ground using a chainsaw. As the last limb was being cut, the tree began sliding on the snow and the employee's right leg was pinned by the limb resulting in fractures to the tibia and fibula and hospitalization.
On or about February 15, 2016, an employee suffered the amputation of their right index fingertip when it was caught between a conveyor that was being moved on a forklift and a press.

While operating the mill line in the main shop, the employee's right ring finger was caught in the hydraulic press when he tried to free a stuck part. The employee's finger was fractured and lacerated.

An employee was operating a table saw cutting lumber. A piece of the wood that he was cutting kicked back causing the employee to lose his balance.  His right middle finger struck the saw blade resulting in the loss of bone to the right middle finger.

An employee entered the cat walk approximately 13' above the grade. As he was walking to borrow a tool from another employee, he fell through an opening that was not secured from pedestrian foot traffic. The employee suffered a compound fracture of the right leg.
An employee was climbing on the back of an 18-wheeler tractor trailer stacking tires and fell breaking the left wrist and hip.

An employee was drying  the star valve with a paper towel when the machine turned on.  The valve rotated and sucked the towel and the employee's finger into the rotating equipment resulting in the amputation of the middle finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was cutting an angle on a small (5") piece of aluminum using a chop-saw. The material kicked upward and the employee's left thumb contacted the saw blade resulting in amputation of the thumb.
A third party truck driver was loading natural gas condensate into his tank truck when an explosion occurred and injured the driver. He was hospitalized for burns to both hands and his back.
An employee was tying off a vessel in dry-dock. The employee fell 20-25 feet through a make shift cover onto the safety deck below resulting in broken ribs and vertebrae.

Two ladders were leaning against the wall.  An employee was going up one of the ladders when the wind blew the other ladder into him knocking him down approximately 3 feet.  The employee was hospitalized.
The employee was installing a fence when he slipped and fell. He grabbed the fence and cut his right middle finger on the fence.
An employee was walking from their car to the plant, slipped on the ice, and fell resulting in a broken knee cap.
An employee got off a ladder to move the ladder and while pulling the ladder towards himself, the ladder struck his right shin resulting in a contusion.
An employee was lining up a piece of steel under a punch press. The employee pulled the lever to activate the press and smashed the tip of the left index finger resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking up a conveyor belt and fell resulting in a head injury.
An employee was engaged in sanitation of the meat blender in the blend room and amputated the right thumb.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was stepping down from the crane operator's cab and fell to the ground, fracturing the right hip.
An employee stepped on a tack while walking in the work area. The employee was later hospitalized for an infection in his foot.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, suffering a fractured clavicle.

The employee was operating a chemical transfer bleeding process. The chemical transfer line ruptured during the transfer and the employee was exposed to sulfuric acid. As a result the employee suffered burns on various part of his body.

An employee was jacking up a floating roof in an above ground storage tank. The extension on the bottle jack slipped and struck the employee resulting in stitches to the ear and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee amputated 3/4 of the right index finger while operating a plastic film winder.

Employee was relighting an industrial furnace that went out.  Gas had built-up in the furnace and when the employee attempted the relight, an explosion/flash fire knocking the employee backwards and causing burns to the face.
An employee was kicked in the back by a mare, resulting in four broken ribs and a lacerated liver, spleen and kidney.
An employee slipped on an icy surface, fell to the ground, and struck his head.
An employee was unloading windows at a delivery site and tripped over a strap  in the trailer, falling and breaking an ankle.
An employee tripped over a rolled up rug and fell suffering a dislocated shoulder and a broken humerus.
An employee was struck several times by a patient with a knife. The employee suffered puncture/laceration wounds to the neck, face and abdomen.
An employee slipped on ice and fell while walking to their work truck in the company lot. They sustained injuries to their left knee that required surgery.
An employee walking down the hall tripped and fell resulting in shoulder and knee injuries.
An employee fell while installing roof sheathing. The employee suffered a concussion and broken ribs.

An employee climbed up a 35' X 5' X 5' rebar column to attach the forms.  He cut loose two supports.  The column began to slowly roll and fell catching the employee's foot. The employee was admitted to the hospital for a contusion on the right foot.
An employee suffered the amputation of the right middle fingertip when it was caught in the door as two employees attempted to close misaligned flammable locker doors.
An employee was rolling sheet metal into a HYD double pinch plate roller machine when his hand got caught between the rollers resulting in the amputation of his left index finger.
An employee suffered a finger amputation after his finger was injured from a drill bit attached to a roto hammer.  The drill had accidently been actuated as employees were attempting to move it.
An employee was moving a display rack. When he stepped back, he tripped and fell fracturing his left hand.
An employee was calibrating a temperature instrument and was sprayed with hot water resulting in burns.
An employee was putting rebar in a down cell in a block wall. The employee was electric shocked when the rebar he was working with arced with a power line.
The employee was unloading appliances from a truck. As he was walking backwards, he slipped and the oven that he was carrying fell on his left leg fracturing it.
An employee reached under a conveyor belt and injured the pinky finger.

On Tuesday, February 16, 2016, at approximately 4:00PM, an employee was walking across a wet 6"x6" piece of lumber, while carrying a 4"x4" piece of lumber, when he slipped and fell. The employee sustained a fracture to his left ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was engaged in rigging down activities. The top drive cradle fell from the rig and struck an employee on the leg resulting in amputation of the leg.
On February 16, 2016, an employee suffered a fractured left forearm when their arm was pulled into a hose puller at the reeler end of line 8 in the extrusion department.
An employee was driving a forklift and struck a rack.  She pinned her hand between the rack and the forklift resulting in the amputation of two fingers on her right hand.
An employee was operating an Ace strap cutting machine and the blade of the machine severed her left hand pointer finger at the knuckle.

An employee was adjusting the valve of a condensate line and attempting to "sewer" the hot water through a hose. The hose failed and hot water (200 degrees) caused second and third degree burns to the employee's arms, abdomen and legs (35% of the body).
An employee was getting out of a vehicle and slipped on ice injuring his left hip.

An employee was operating a stand up counterbalance in the case pick area when she collided with pallets in the racking. The corner of the upper Chep pallet penetrated the operator compartment, striking the employee in the upper hip area and fracturing the pelvis.
An employee was operating a trimmer.  As the employee cleared a jam on the in-feed conveyor, his right middle finger was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing a mold from the injection molding machine and pinched a finger resulting in amputation.
While ripping a piece of 2x4 on a table saw, an employee amputated the tip of the right thumb.
An employee was filling out paperwork while standing next to a standup pallet truck. Another standup pallet truck struck the employee resulting in a right ankle injury.
An employee was working on a roof.  The employee was in the process of moving roof trusses when he fell 9 feet to a lower level and broke his left leg.
As an employee walked to his truck in the parking lot of building 5, the employee slipped on snow and ice.  The employee suffered a fractured left ankle requiring surgery.

On Tuesday, February 16, 2017, at approximately 12:30PM, an employee was in the process of washing out the salt spreader on the rear of a truck. The employee sustained fractures to his right arm and was hospitalized when his hand was caught in the moving spreader mechanism.

An employee was trying to prevent multiple rollers from coming out of the conveyor. Another employee went to point at the area of concern when a roller came out and pinched a finger resulting in the amputation of the right hand index fingertip.
An employee was lowering a scissor lift with the remote control. His left thumb got pinched in the lift resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a live electrical panel. An explosion occurred. The employee was hospitalized for burns.
An employee fell off a podium platform and was admitted to the hospital for a broken arm.
An employee was pushing a 4-wheel cart to the exit door. Her foot got caught under the wheel resulting in a cut on the lower right leg.
An employee was cleaning a bathroom shower, slipped on water on the floor, and fell resulting in injury to the left wrist.
An employee was working on a ladder and felt it wobble. He jumped off the ladder resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was cutting material on a radial arm saw. As the employee attempted to grab material with the right hand, the saw was activated with the pneumatic foot pedal. The saw contacted the employee's wrist and amputated the right hand.
An employee was pouring floor stripper in a bucket to dilute with water. While pouring, the chemical splashed into his left eye.
While checking to see if a room was ready to be rented, an employee tripped on the leg of a chair, fell to the floor, and fractured her hip. She was hospitalized for treatment.

A cart had been loaded with 2"x4"s.  The cart has two wheels in the middle, front, and back on both sides.  The day shift had used half of the lumber, pulling the lumber from one side.  Approximately 40 2"x4"s remained stacked on the other side of the cart.  The second shift employee started to move the cart to his saw, where he cuts the lumber to specified lengths.  As the employee was moving the cart, the cart fell over onto the employee's legs breaking both legs below the knee.

Two employees were removing a reach rod.  One of the employee was on the top deck lifting the reach rod while the other employee was trying to remove a pin. The reach rod slipped smashing the employee's finger. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
While using a core drilling machine, an employee's hand was caught in the core drilling cylinder, amputating the right index finger.
An employee was shot two times by a robber while closing the store.

On February 17, 2016, an employee was installing a fascia and fog lamp on a car. As he was pulling on the wire to connect the fog lamp, he struck the car and punctured his right hand between the index finger and thumb. The injury became infected and required hospitalization.
Two workers were passing windows from an elevated trash box on a forklift to a balcony and fell approximately 3 stories, suffering back and head injuries.
An employee was using a lathe while wearing cut resistant gloves.  A glove became entangled in the lathe and the employee's hand was degloved when he tried to remove it.
An employee's arm was severely cut while he was removing a piece of sheet metal from the upper shelf, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was checking the fluid levels on a tug and amputated the left index fingertip when the hood of the tug slammed down on his left hand.
An employee was exiting a parked vehicle on the jobsite, slipped on ice, and fell onto concrete. The employee suffered a concussion and a compression fracture to the back.

An employee was on break and eating lunch in the store deli. She was seated in a chair that had a loose seat bottom.  While scooting her chair closer to the table, she got her right ring finger caught between the loose seat bottom and the chair's frame. When she sat back down she tore the flesh off the distal joint of her right ring finger. She was transported to the local hospital where doctors had to amputate the distal joint.
An employee was cutting plastic tubing using an arbor press and suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee's middle finger was caught in-between the hydraulic cylinder and the platen while trying to move the die that was hooked up to the overhead gantry crane hoist. The employee's middle left finger was partially amputated.

On February 17, 2016, an employee was exiting a scissor lift when his finger became caught in a cable attached to a locking pin.  The locking pin is used to hold a top rail into place at the end of the scissor lift.  The employee's right ring finger was amputated down to the second knuckle.

An employee was traveling from the second floor to the first floor and was about halfway down the first run of stairs toward the platform when he fell and landed with his face hitting the platform wall.  The employee suffered two fractured ribs, a punctured lung, a shoulder injury and a dislodged lower tooth.

An employee was struck by a straight body international truck in the rear parking lot resulting in a collapsed lung, fractured lower back, left collarbone and fractured ribs.  He also sustained damage to the spleen.
An employee was putting cardboard into the baler.  His hand was caught in the baler door while closing it. The employee's left hand was dislocated, fractured, and lacerated.

An employee was pushing a stack of cardboard across the ground in front of her.  The cardboard struck a fixed object on the ground and "jarred" the employee.  The employee fell on her knee and cracked her patella.  The employee was hospitalized.
On February 17, 2017, an employee slipped on the bathroom floor that was just mopped and suffered a knee injury.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee slipped and fell on black ice while walking in the parking lot on the way into work around 7:45 AM on February 17, 2016.  The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and stiches to the back of the head.
An employee was placing printing cylinders into storage and got caught between the hand cart and guard railing resulting in broken ribs.
An employee was training soldiers on the new paladin military vehicle. The hatch for the driver's seat closed on his right hand, damaging his middle and index fingers requiring surgery.
An employee suffered a head contusion and a crushed right arm after a hand lift tipped over off of a lift gate.  The employee was knocked over and was struck by the hand lift.

An employee was replacing the automatic arm for a tarp on a disposal truck. As he reached for a pin, the automatic arm moved and pinched his finger between the top and bottom arms, amputating his left index fingertip.
On February 17, 2016, an employee was struck by the rear wheel of a powered industrial vehicle (Bobcat) resulting in a severe laceration requiring surgery.
A worker was off loading a truck and fell through the empty bay door resulting in a left hip fracture.
A door closed on an employee's right pinky tip, severing it.
An employee was moving a 2' base plate with a fork truck and 1/2 inch chain. He caught his finger between the fork and the chain amputating the right index fingertip.
A worker slipped on oatmeal in the staff lounge and fell breaking an arm.
An employee's left-hand middle finger was amputated when a safe door shut on it. He required surgery.
An employee was repairing a piece of equipment when his thumb was crushed between the equipment.

An employee was manually adjusting a stack of empty boxes at the unloading dock.  Ice was present on the floor due to a leaking water sprinkler line.  The unloading dock is not heated.  The employee slipped on the ice on the floor and the empty stacked cardboard boxes fell onto him as he fell onto the floor. The employee suffered a broken right hip as a result of the slip and fall.  The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was cleaning out trash from the bed of a truck at the PSO yard.  He stepped back and turned to throw out some trash and stepped on a plastic bottle. As he slipped and fell, his foot was caught between a fiberglass pole and the bed of the truck, breaking his leg.
An employee was injured during a snowmobile accident.
An employee was working from a 10 foot ladder and fell to the ground cracking two vertebrae in the neck.
An employee was cutting laminate flooring on a table saw when his left-hand fingers were cut by the saw.

An employee was pulling a welder up to the catwalk with a rope when the left side of the catwalk railing broke, causing him to fall 25 feet to the ground below. His head hit a toolbox, and his back hit the platform railing. He was hospitalized with an L1 lumbar fracture and required staples for his head injury.

An employee was attempting to free a frozen burial vault from the frozen ground. A coworker was using a backhoe to free the vault. The burial vault dislodged from the ground rapidly and struck the employee, crushing him between the vault and a wall. He fractured his pelvis and hip.
An employee was unloading pallets from his forklift when a coworker ran over his left foot and ankle with another forklift.
While walking on stairs, an employee was electric shocked on his left side by the handrail. The stairs were located near where the ingots come off the line.

An employee was replacing the backing core of a tufting machine with a new primary backing when her right finger was caught between the backing jack and the backing core of the machine. Her right-hand middle fingertip was amputated.

On or about February 18, 2016, an employee was settling trusses while standing on the top plate of the building being constructed. Due to high winds, a 100-foot section of approximately 50 trusses fell and knocked the employee off the top plate.  The employee fell 16 feet to the frozen dirt ground, suffering a broken wrist, shattered elbow, and head injury requiring stitches. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
While an employee was cutting a tomato with a knife, the employee's fourth left-hand fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing gas pipes when his arm was caught between two pipes, resulting in vascular injuries.
An employee was heating a 40-foot steel beam to adjust its camber when the beam fell over and struck the employee's right leg, breaking the tibia and fibula.

An employee was removing a door from an upper shelf and carrying it down using a step ladder when he missed the last two steps and fell on his left leg/knee, possibly fracturing his kneecap and tearing ligaments. He was hospitalized.

On February 18, 2016, an employee attempted to clean the air filters on a plugged up industrial vacuum loader. He raised the motor section from the collection bin with the four built-in air bladders. The air bladders lost their pressure and the motor section dropped onto the employee's arm, pinching it between the motor section and the bin. His lower right arm broke.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when he lost control and his left ankle was pinned between the jack and a filing cabinet. His ankle broke and required surgery.

A maintenance mechanic was adjusting the safety switch on a bread cooler when a shaft became loose and struck an employee in the abdomen/chest area, breaking three ribs. The shaft came out approximately 12 inches.

On February 18, 2016, an employee was checking freight material that had been loaded into trailers when a coworker hit him with a powered industrial vehicle. He sustained broken bones in his foot, as well as bruises and lacerations to both legs.

After stopping a press line, an employee walked between the press brake light curtain. The press then cycled and the dye post came down, hitting the employee's right arm. His right forearm and hand were amputated, and he was hospitalized.
An employee went into the silo to make adjustments on the grain sweep. A coworker did not know that the employee was in the silo and turned on the grain sweep, which lacerated the employee's leg.

An employee had just loaded a new car onto a railcar. As he exited the car and started to descend the railcar's fixed ladder, he lost his grip and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. He fractured his back and left wrist and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting the lacquer recycling machine. When the employee opened the machine to fix the bag, hot liquid sprayed out, causing second degree burns to the right side of the employee's trunk and head.

An employee was working on a 12-foot A-frame ladder, attempting to thread a piece of pipe. While pushing the pipe to align it, he was thrown off balance and fell forward approximately 4 feet (from the 4th or 5th rung) to the concrete floor, suffering a head laceration, two broken wrists, dental trauma, and a bruised knee.

An employee was unloading a flatbed truck that was carrying a PMC, which is a cookie-sheet type of pallet that carries cargo for airlines. He was pulling the PMC manually because the bed of the truck has a roller bed that allows the PMC to move the length of the bed without using a powered industrial vehicle once it is unhooked and all the hooks are removed. The employee's left foot became lodged between the vehicle and the bypass system. The PMC hit the employee's leg while it was stuck and broke it in two places. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was handling material (metal skin) on top of a table when the table tilted. The material fell on his left leg, causing multiple fractures.

On or about February 18, 2016, an employee was processing a part down the chemical film line when the employee was exposed to hydrofluoric and nitric-mixed acid solutions, which chemically burned the employee's right thumb.

A maintenance employee was making repairs on the production line, using a handheld grinder to grind metal, when sparks flew back and hit him. His shirt was oily and caught on fire, causing burns to his torso.

An employee was working on an electrical box while standing on a ladder. He heard an explosion from a transformer and was startled. While attempting to dismount the ladder, he fell 12 feet to the level below, breaking his left leg.

On February 18, 2016, at approximately 9:30 a.m., an employee was exiting a van at a conference meeting when she missed a step, fell, and struck her back on the step. She fractured her L1 vertebra and was hospitalized.
While making a delivery, an employee slipped on ice at the customer location. The employee fell to the ground and broke a leg in two places, requiring hospitalization.

Employees were welding a wall plate to connect a structural steel member. The base of the member became unstable, and the structural steel started to fall, causing an employee sitting on a cross member to fall 15 feet to the ground below. A second employee was welding while standing in an aerial lift basket when the structural steel member fell and crashed down on the lift, slamming it to the ground. The employee suffered multiple blunt force trauma injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was getting down from a truck and fell backwards off the truck.
An employee was closing the main cabin door and caught his left hand index finger between the door and aircraft resulting in a fingertip amputation.
The end of an employee's finger was pinched off while working. The employee was hospitalized and the fingertip was surgically amputated.

A crane was lowering an arbor into the bell of a flute machine while an employee guided the arbor into position. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the arbor and the bell  housing, and his fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a drill press to drill holes in aluminum stock. When he adjusted the material, his finger contacted the rotating drill bit. His right index finger was amputated above the distal joint.

An employee was unloading a transformer from a flatbed truck and was hooking up straps so the transformer could be moved by an overhead crane. The truck driver moved the truck, causing the employee to fall from the flatbed to the ground. The employee may have fractured both elbows.
While an employee was trying to clear a jam on the brake press, the press activated, injuring both of the employee's hands and amputating a right-hand finger.

On February 19, 2016, at approximately 8:15 a.m., an employee was cutting 6-foot lengths of fiberboard down to 43 inches using a miter saw. While holding the material with her left hand, she used her right hand to lower the blade of the saw. The blade made contact with and amputated her left thumb tip.
An employee slipped and fell on a pile of rebar laying on the ground, injuring the hip.

An employee was performing maintenance on a grinder machine, which was lifted up with a pin placed underneath. The machine fell and pinched the employee's fingers, amputating the right-hand middle and ring fingers at the distal joint.
While slicing ham with a bone saw, an employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was installing a metal HVAC duct. As the duct was being lifted, the rigging failed, causing the duct to drop. The employee attempted to catch the duct as it fell, and his right hand was lacerated. He was hospitalized.
While attempting to unjam a milk carton from the blow mold machine, an employee's right index finger was amputated.
An employee's left pinky fingertip was amputated by a digger truck's rope drum, which was being used to pull a truck that was stuck.
An employee was exiting a crane when he slipped, fell, and broke his right arm and right leg.
While an employee was stacking lumber, the lumber fell on and amputated his right-hand middle fingertip.

A maintenance employee was repairing a tapping machine. He was working underneath the machine. To access the conveyor belt, he was moving a product tray out of the way by pushing it. The tray came off the guides and tilted, and his finger was caught between the tray and the machine, amputating his left middle fingertip.
While performing wood framing, an employee fell from a 10-foot ladder to the concrete floor, breaking ribs.
While moving a table, an employee slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing his right hip.
While accessing an area near a sprinkler system, an employee stepped on an exposed, protruding 1/4" x 2" concrete anchor, which punctured the employee's left foot and required surgery.

An employee was standing on top of a masonry wall, removing the wall forms, when a wall form fell. The employee's personal protective equipment was attached to the form. As the form fell, it also brought the employee down 10 feet to the ground below, crushing the employee's left hand, fracturing the spine, and causing lacerations.

An employee was pressing bacon when the press malfunctioned. While the employee was attempting to diagnose the problem, the machine cycled and crushed the employee's left hand in the point of operation, fracturing the pinky, ring, and thumb fingers and causing severe lacerations. The press was not locked out at the time of the incident.

On February 19, 2016, an employee was cutting a steel beam with a grinder when the grinder jumped out of the cut and contacted the employee above the knee. He was hospitalized overnight with a right leg laceration.

An employee was attempting to stop his assigned vehicle from rolling when he was hit by the door, knocked to the ground, and dragged. He suffered right hip and ankle injuries, as well as left knee abrasions.
While exiting a van, an employee stepped and slipped on a patch of ice in the parking lot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

On 2/19/2016t, at 1:55 AM, an employee was working on a production line when she tripped on an airline, fell, and rolled her right foot/ankle. She was hospitalized and required surgery for a fractured right tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting pieces of wood using a table saw. A piece of wood slipped and his right hand contacted the blade, cutting three fingers.
An employee was bitten by a dog while delivering mail, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee slipped on ice while walking outside, fracturing a leg and requiring overnight hospitalization.
A temporary worker crushed a finger resulting in the amputation of the digit up to the first knuckle.
An employee was stabbed by a patron after the bar had closed. There had been an earlier altercation in the bar between the employee and the attacker.
An employee stocking fiberglass was trying to extend a table leaf. The employee's left fifth finger was caught between the table frame and the table top, resulting in a distal amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw when the blade lacerated his right index finger, requiring stitches.
An employee fell while getting out of the dump bed of a truck he was washing. He struck his head on the concrete ground and fractured his skull.

An employee was using a wrench to remove snow that was blocking the magic carpet conveyor belt machine. As soon as the snow was released, the conveyor started going again and grabbed the wrench. When the employee tried to grab the tool, she was trapped under the conveyor belt bar, breaking her right humerus.

An employee was taking out the trash on February 20, 2016. When she opened the gate to the dumpster area, the wind blew the gate back at her and knocked her down, breaking her left hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was painting from the second step of a 4-foot step ladder when he fell backwards and hit the concrete floor. He suffered a bruise and was hospitalized.

On 2/20/2016, at around 4:00 p.m., an employee was using a machine called a planner to prep the poly pipe for welding repairs when a short burst of flame occurred. The employee received second degree burns to the side of the face and neck and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was taking pictures at the finish line of a track event. One of the participants finished the race and turned toward the employee. The runner struck the employee, knocking her to the ground and fracturing her right ankle.
An employee's left middle fingertip was amputated while reaching for a part on a press.
An employee was driving a golf cart to a service call when a valet ran a stop sign and struck the cart. The employee suffered three broken ribs.
A steel coil tipped over on an employee, who was hospitalized with contusions.
An employee sustained an amputation of the right middle fingertip while using a meat saw.
Two employees were installing a protective goal post for overhead power lines when the post made contact with the energized line, causing the employees to receive an electrical shock.
A maintenance employee was repairing and troubleshooting a high-speed overhead door. The employee's left middle and ring fingers were pinched in the overhead roller, amputating the fingertips.
An employee was sitting on a skid of 2x4's being transported on a forklift driven by a coworker. The employee fell off of the skid and was run over by the forklift, fracturing/crushing his arm.
An employee made contact with a conveyor roller, which pulled him into the conveyor. He sustained a possible left shoulder fracture.
An employee contacted a wall with his hand while engaged in horseplay and caught his finger on a screw. His finger split open to the bone and required surgery.
An employee was pushing a BiPAP machine into the store room of the respiratory department and cut their thumb on the edge of the machine. The employee was later hospitalized for an infection.
An employee was walking into her work space to begin her shift when her shoe got caught on the carpet and she fell breaking her left shoulder and left knee.
An employee was removing some debris from a conveyor belt when another worker cycled the machine, causing the employee's right index finger to be crushed and partially amputated between two pallets.

An employee was moving a sterile processing tray, which contained surgery instruments and weighed approximately 28 pounds, when the tray started to tip. While trying to prevent the tray from tipping, the employee suffered a back strain and required hospitalization.

An employee entered a freshwater, 3000-gallon tank to replace spray nozzles and was exposed to steam mist and residual chemicals that were left in the tank from the clean-out process. He experienced nausea from inhalation exposure and was hospitalized.
On or about February 21, 2016, an employee fell approximately 2 feet from a feed trough and sustained head and back injuries.
While descending a ladder, an employee missed the second to the bottom step and fell to the concrete floor. The employee fractured the left side of the hip.

An employee was starting work on a precipitator and was using a sleever bar to remove the door, which was 18" x 18". He removed the bolts and some of the silicone from the door, but the door would not open.  He went to the front of the equipment, removed the inspection window, and used the sleever bar to reach inside, at which point he was electric shocked. The electrical current went in his left ring finger and out through his right foot.

An employee was standing on top of water pumps to reach a power disconnect. The frame bolts on one of the water pumps were corroded, and the employee's weight caused the pump to break loose and release hot water. The hot water contacted the employee, causing second degree burns to the legs and the lower back.
An employee was grinding the joint of a pipe when another joint of pipe rolled and struck the employee on the right side of the head, fracturing the skull.
An employee attempted to walk an angry customer out of the store and was assaulted and stabbed by the customer. The employee was hospitalized with a stab wound to the chest and a lacerated heart.

On or about February 21, 2016, at approximately 9:40 a.m., an employee operating a wool separator machine was attempting to clear a jam when his hand was caught in the machine. He suffered an avulsion that required hospitalization for stitches.
An employee was fastening a tug boat to a barge when his fingers were crushed between the boat knee and the barge. His left index and middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was handling a conveyor belt that was soaking in a tank of chlorine and water. The chlorine liquid splashed on the employee's legs, soaking his pants. He suffered chemical burns on both legs and was hospitalized.
While walking 63 feet away in the equipment yard, an employee was struck on the left thigh by a piece of metal debris that broke off from the jack hammer bit on an excavator.

While exiting a bathroom, an employee turned a corner and tripped over a student's rolling back pack. The employee fell to the ground and fractured her left shoulder, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Employees were standing in front of an extrusion machine studying a test run of material while other employees were grinding on the mold. A sudden release of pressure forced material and components out of the mold. As a result, an employee suffered multiple face fractures, a laceration above the right eye, broken fingers, and broken ribs.
An employee was using a shovel to perform foundation work when a skid steer backed up and ran over the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was involved in a physical altercation with a co-worker, suffering broken teeth, facial fractures, a swollen eye, and back injuries.
While an employee was adjusting a press die, the embossment press cycled and crushed his forearm in the point of operation.

An employee standing on an 8-foot ladder was using a hammer to remove wooden blocks wedged between the door and the wall. When the last block was knocked out, the door shifted and caused the ladder to fall. The injured employee was approximately 5 feet high when his foot slipped off the rung and went through the ladder. He fell to the ground and fractured his lower leg.
While slicing deli meat, an employee slipped on a piece of meat on the floor and fell, breaking her right hip and right wrist.

A two-man crew was retrieving trash/debris from a dumpster in the alley behind a bakery. The process involves a truck, which is specially outfitted with a hoisting mechanism and an automatic tipping device. The device lifts the dumpster off the ground and dumps the debris into a hopper attached to the rear of the truck. While the device was lifting the dumpster, the injured employee's left-hand fingers were caught between the lifting mechanism and the trunnion bar. His middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee attached a tagline on some pipe casing. When the pipe was picked up, his foot was tangled in the tagline, ultimately breaking his ankle.
An employee's right thumb became caught in a mixer he was operating and was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was training a coworker on an automated press. The press wasn't cycling properly, so the employee attempted to adjust a part. At this time, the coworker inadvertently cycled the press using the two-hand controls. The press ripped the skin off of the back of the employee's hand (partial de-gloving).

The employee was troubleshooting a case alignment problem on the can line palletizer and noticed that the can case was misaligned. While he was examining the layer formation section of the palletizer, the machine cycled. The layer formation bar hit and fractured his right forearm.

On February 22, 2016, two employees turned off a jammed candle-making machine to service it. As the first employee was attempting to pull something out of the machine, the second employee turned it on, crushing the first employee's right-hand middle finger. His finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was doing a pre-trip inspection on a tractor trailer unit before driving it back to the facility for preventative maintenance. While doing this, the employee slipped on the rainy and muddy surface, fracturing the radius and ulna.

An employee installing gutters on a house fell off an extension ladder that was sitting on a porch roof. He then rolled off the porch roof to the ground and was hospitalized with a compression fracture of the lower back.
An employee was trying to clear a jam on a machine when part of the machine struck and fractured his right femur.

An employee was blowing chips off parts and fixtures with compressed air in preparation for the next machine set up when he tripped and fell over a tooling post, injuring his hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was struck by a coworker operating a double rider vehicle, suffering lower leg lacerations.
An employee stumbled and fell while standing up from a chair. The employee fell to the concrete ground and fractured the left hip, requiring surgery.

On February 22, 2016, at approximately 6:05 p.m., an employee was covering overhead lines with blankets and hoses to replace damaged lightning arrestors when an electrical arc occurred. The arc caused first degree burns to the employee's face and neck, requiring hospitalization.

While working on nearby equipment, an employee drew an arc of approximately 12 inches from an unpowered electrical line. The power in the line was induced into the circuit from a nearby power source. The employee suffered an electrical shock/burns to the pointer finger and thumb.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet from a ladder while installing a sign, suffering a fractured hip that required surgery.

An employee was preparing stock for the morning shift when his left foot was caught between two forklifts he was operating. The employee was using a stand-up and sit down forklift at the same time.  His foot was mangled between the forklift forks.

An employee was unloading steel poles from a trailer. The employee was on the trailer during the rigging, trying to locate the center gravity of the poles. Once he located the center gravity, he went to the other side of the trailer to get off. He lost his balance, slipped, and grabbed one of the rebar supports on the trailer. At that time, the operator began lifting the pole upward. As the pole was lifted, it swung toward the injured employee and caught his right hand between the rebar support and the steel pole. His right middle fingertip was amputated and his right index finger was lacerated.
An employee fell 20 feet from a roof while delivering shingles to a customer site, suffering blunt trauma.

An employee was standing at the rear of their vehicle, sorting mail to be delivered. An approaching truck struck a nearby car, causing the car to veer and strike the employee's vehicle and right leg. The force of the impact caused the vehicle to be pushed up on the sidewalk. When it rolled back towards the street, it ended up on top of the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a right leg injury and possible left leg injury.

A maintenance employee was stepping down from a scissor lift when his wedding ring was caught on the safety chain from the lift gate. His left ring finger was amputated above the second knuckle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was loading a refrigerator into the back of a truck when the blade that pushes debris into the truck caught his gloved left hand and partially amputated his middle and ring fingers.
An employee was restocking janitorial supplies in the ladies restroom when a wooden cabinet fell off the wall and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right femur.
An employee was lifting an object with a crane when the object fell onto the employee's left foot, amputating all of his left toes.

On February 22, 2016, at about 10:39 a.m., an employee was delivering a propane gas tank when he fell from the gangway to a barge and into the water, injuring his eye. He was hospitalized and had surgery for a possible eye socket fracture.
An employee was loading a filter into a casing while a coworker pushed the other end. The employee's fingers were pinched and his right-hand index and middle fingertips were amputated.
On or about February 22, 2016, while using the table saw to cut card board, the cardboard slipped and the employee's finger contacted the rotating saw blade resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was pulling hose to connect to a pump when his hand slipped and his left middle finger struck the moving impeller of the pump. His finger went down the intake pipe and his left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was sandblasting metal parts when he lost control of the sandblasting gun. The gun dropped and spun around, blasting him in the stomach. His stomach was lacerated and required surgery.
An employee was loading work equipment into her car when she slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell, breaking her arm, shoulder, and humerus.
An employee's hand became caught in a moving conveyor chain as a conveyor was being tested on February 23, 2016. His second and third fingers were amputated.
While cleaning, an employee fell approximately 8 feet through an open hole in the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was returning to her work area carrying a case of water bottles on her right shoulder.  She was walking down a catwalk and came to a 4-step elevation change. As she walked down the steps, her left foot became entangled in some air hose, causing her to lose her balance.  As she stepped down with her right foot to regain her balance, she stepped on more air hose, which caused her ankle to roll. When she brought her left foot back up, all of her weight went onto her right ankle. She dislocated her ankle and fractured her tibia and fibula.
An employee was performing maintenance on a customer propane dispenser when he suffered liquid propane burns to his hands.
An employee was examining the underside of a bus when he tripped over the vehicle jack and fell, suffering internal bleeding.
An employee using a pneumatic nail gun was shot in the right forearm when the nail came out the back of the gun.
An employee was parking a truck on the dock. As he lifted the electronic dock with his right hand, the lift gate came down and fractured his right ring finger, causing a partial amputation.
On February 23, 2016, at 3:00 p.m., an employee was using a floor waxing machine when he tripped over the cord and fell to the ground, striking his head.  He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking in the parking lot to the facility when he was struck by a yard truck that was moving trailers to different docks. The employee fell to the ground and suffered blunt force trauma to his head. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee twisted and fractured his ankle while stepping off of a step on his mail delivery route.

On February 23, 2016, at approximately 10:40 am, an employee and his crew were clearing a powerline right-of-way. A 1/2-inch rope was placed in the tree and held by the foreman. The employee notched and back cut the 26-inch diameter poplar tree, 107 feet in height. Using the 1/2-inch rope, 120 to 150 feet in length, the foreman began tugging on the rope to assist the tree to the ground. Once the tree was safely on the ground, the foreman yelled "clear" and no one answered. The foreman found the employee on the retreat path, face down on the ground, in the opposite direction of the felled tree. The employee was rolled over and his face was covered with blood. He suffered face and head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was in the bathroom when she slipped and fell. She was hospitalized with bone damage.
An employee was loading a stack of steel beams when they fell on top of him, fracturing his pelvis and collapsing his lung.
While mopping the floor of the kitchen, an employee slipped and fell, striking the back, shoulder, and head on the tile floor. The employee was hospitalized overnight with bumps and bruises.
An employee stepped backward onto the wheel of an office chair and fell, fracturing the left wrist.

An employee had just delivered a load of steel to the galvanizing plant to be coated, and a load of galvanized steel had been loaded onto his trailer for the return trip. He climbed onto the flatbed trailer, positioned the tie down straps used to secure the load, and was climbing down the rear step/bumper to get off the trailer when he slipped and fell, breaking his right leg.

While operating a stacker machine, an employee attempted to remove a fallen product container that was blocking a sensor that controlled the conveyor. When the fallen container was removed, the conveyor began to move. The employee was wearing cut resistant gloves, and the glove on her right hand was caught by the chain and sprocket of the chain conveyor. She right-hand middle finger was partially amputated and required surgery.
On February 23, 2016, an employee was trying to access the roof when he fell approximately 11 feet from an extension ladder to the lower roof level. He dislocated his kneecap and required surgery.

An employee climbed an 8- to 10-foot ladder to open the door to a confined space. The door was under pressure, and as the employee opened the final latch, it came open and knocked the employee from the ladder. He fell approximately 8 feet, fracturing his skull, breaking several ribs, and puncturing a lung.
An employee fell from a screen plant and suffered neck and back fractures, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee bent down to pick up a post while installing a silt fence when a snake bit his finger.

An employee was reaching for a 2x4 board while working with the planer in-feed table. The employee's right thumb went through a 1.5-inch gap in the guarding and was caught between the tipple chain and sprocket, amputating the first digit of the right thumb.
An employee was working on overhead powerlines when an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to his face, neck, and arm.
An employee slipped and fell on a wide marble stairway at a client's facility, suffering head, back, and leg injuries that required overnight hospitalization.
An employee was using a pneumatic cut-off saw to cut a nail when the blade broke and amputated his left ring finger at the second knuckle. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was ripping panels when a build-up of sawdust and wood waste on the table saw caused the guard to be pushed up. When the employee attempted to clear the buildup, the blade amputated 1 inch of his right ring finger.
An employee was working on building trusses when he fell 12 to 14 feet from the truss. He suffered a brain injury and broke his neck and ribs.
An employee installing a metal roof on a pole barn fell through a plastic skylight approximately 15 feet to the ground and was hospitalized.

On 2/23/16, an employee sustained an amputation of the ring and middle fingers on his right hand while operating a cutting shear.  The employee was holding a piece of metal in place while another employee operated the pedal for the shear.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while clearing a jammed production part from an assembly machine.
An employee was replacing a pyrite gate on a pulverizer when the gate slipped and struck the end of the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was struck by a suspended load (2x4) that was being hoisted by a crane. The material fell approximately six stories onto the employee's back, breaking ribs and a shoulder blade and puncturing the employee's lung.
While an employee was inflating the air pressure on the tire of a truck, a fault rim ejected from the tire and hit his chest. He then fell backward onto the ground and suffered a mild head injury.

On February 24, 2016, at approximately 4:00 p.m., an employee placed a 64-inch post in the saw. The blade hit a knot in the post and pulled the employee's hand into the blade, amputating the left thumb tip.

An employee was attempting to move a log. He was riding on a box (5' long x 3' high x 4' wide) and the box changed directions, causing him to fall. His right foot slipped and was caught between the railing and the guide roller. His foot was crushed and lacerated between the fourth toe and pinky toes, and his big toe was dislocated.
An employee was pushing tubing into a draw bench when a trolley caught the employee's fingertip, causing an avulsion.

An employee was pumping fuel from his truck to an aboveground tank when the system malfunctioned and the fuel leaked, causing the truck to catch on fire. To avoid the fire, the employee quickly exited the truck and hit the ground, breaking his leg.
An employee was burned by an arc flash that occurred while the employee was performing routine maintenance readings on a distribution pump.
On or about February 24, 2016, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was unjamming a plastics grinder when his right middle fingertip was amputated by the grinder's spinning blades.
An employee was dusting off his work station when his thumb was caught in a chain and sprocket, amputating his right thumb tip.
While walking between conveyor belts, an employee's right forearm was caught and mangled by a conveyor belt.
An employee was cutting plywood on a band saw when the blade partially amputated his left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee went into a food preparation room when she tripped on a rug, causing her to fall and fracture her right femur.
An employee was diagnosing an issue with the pallet stacker when the load backrest fell and struck the employee, breaking the right big toe and injuring the second toe.
While exiting the break room, an employee tripped over a person in a wheelchair. He fell and broke his hip bone.
An employee was unloading a metal table from a trailer with coworkers when the table flipped and landed on top of the employee. The employee was crushed and required hospitalization.
An employee's left thumb was fractured after it was caught in a closing door, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering parts to an assembly plant when he became caught in a conveyor. His left leg fractured and he suffered muscle damage.
An employee was taking the tarps off his trailer when he fell approximately 5 feet, fracturing his skull and rib and suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee's sweater was caught in a large ironing machine, which pulled her arm into it.  She suffered a possible broken arm and shoulder injuries.
