An employee was operating a power stock lift when he fell off and was run over. His left leg was injured and required surgery.

An employee was standing on the edge of a metal tub approximately 1 foot from floor level when his foot slipped off the tub, causing an abrasion to his lower left leg. His injury became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was putting down plywood to cover a hole when he fell through the hole and fractured his skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee was descending an extension ladder at a construction site when he fell approximately 15 feet to the ground below, suffering fractures and lacerations.
An employee using a warehouse lift to stock televisions fell approximately 15 feet from the lift to the floor. The employee suffered a head injury.
An employee was working on a ladder installing lights and fell resulting in a broken wrist and sternum and a collapsed lung.

On or about February 24, 2016, at 11:20 am an employee stumbled and fell to the floor. She hit her forehead and incurred a deep muscular bruise to the right hip. She was kept by the hospital overnight for observation and physical therapy treatment.

An employee was attempting to move the test set power cable from a disconnect/receptacle to the service on the wall. After turning off the power supply, the employee unplugged the cable to plug it into the wall outlet. The employee inadvertently touched the cable capacitor, which still contained some residual voltage after it was unplugged from the test set, and was shocked on his left hand.
An employee lacerated and broke bones in the left forearm while changing tools on a machine.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical ground fault. As he went to tighten the lug, an arc flash occurred and burned both hands and both arms.
An employee's right forefinger was smashed between a sheet of glass and the lifting arm.

An employee was performing maintenance on a log-bucking saw and locked it out to replace a hydraulic valve. He then had to re-energize the valve to bleed out air from the hydraulic cylinder. When moving the cylinder in and out, his finger was pinched between the saw guard and saw structure. His left-hand middle finger was amputated at the first joint.

On 2/25/16, a powered industrial truck was moving a punch press (steel stamping machine) when the press fell on top of an employee working in the area. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm.
On February 25, 2016, an employee was inspecting parts on the transfer table when the rotating shaft grabbed the employee's glove and amputated his left thumb.
An employee's right index finger was amputated while attempting to remove a plastic bottle from a drive chain.

An employee was trying to unclog an asphalt distribution (spreading) machine. When he opened up a porthole, the pressurized pump caused hot liquid asphalt to shoot out and burn the palm of his right hand.
An employee was unloading equipment from a cart. The base of the cart dropped while he was still holding the handle, and his right fifth finger was amputated in a pinch point.
An employee was lifting an overhead truck door when his left foot slipped off, causing him to fall 12 inches and strike his knee on the truck bumper.
A maintenance employee was changing out a control transfer in a motor control cabinet when an electric arc occurred, causing burns to his face and arms.
While standing next to a chute, an employee was hit on the head by a piece of metal coming down the chute. The employee suffered a laceration that required stitches.
An employee was tightening a safety stand to a pole when the pole shifted, causing the safety stand to move and catch the employee's fingertip between the stand and pole. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was removing the existing membrane from the roof deck when he fell approximately 25 feet through metal decking to the ground below. He suffered a broken arm and broken facial bones.
An employee was adjusting a beam inside the nacelle when his finger was pinched between the beam and the beam bracket. His left ring fingertip was amputated.
As he was tightening a bolt on a piece of equipment, an employee's left hand was caught and fractured between a piece of metal slat and a sprocket.
An employee fell 20 feet from a scaffold and broke the right foot.
An employee was reversing an electric stand-up forklift when their foot was pinched between the forklift and a concrete wall.
An employee was taking trash out through the loading dock to the dumpster. The employee fell over a dock chain to the ground and suffered facial fractures.
A forklift was lifting three employees inside a trash box to the third floor. As they were stepping off, the box tilted and the employees fell to the ground. Two of the employees were hospitalized.

On 02/25/2016, an employee inhaled a vapor cloud containing sulfuric and hydrofluoric acid due to a process leak at the facility. The employee was hospitalized with a sore throat and difficulty swallowing.

An employee was trying to latch the hinged walkway on the in-board side of a turn press. His supervisor pushed the platform to latch it while the employee's hand was in a pinch point. His right ring finger was partially amputated between the latch and platform.
An employee was assaulted by a coworker and suffered a brain injury.

An employee was moving a crane at a customer's site to inspect it. Steel coil weighing approximately 40,000 pounds was still in the lifting device attached to the overhead crane. The employee attempted to remove the coil and it moved towards him, pinning him at the right shoulder. He broke his collarbone, arm, and right ribs, and also potentially suffered internal bleeding.
An employee received an electrical shock while performing maintenance on a room HVAC unit.
An employee amputated the left middle fingertip while operating a hand held router.
An employee was delivering packages, slipped on ice and fell scraping and cutting his elbow. The employee was later hospitalized for an infection.
An employee was lifting up a tea kettle and spilled hot water. The employee's chest, arms and stomach were burned.
An employee was attempting to prevent a patient from falling.  Both the patient and the employee fell to the ground. The employee's left knee cap was fractured as a result.
An employee was leaving a patient's home and tripped and fell injuring her left knee.
An employee was cutting hose from a spool and stepped on a piece of wire from the hose. The employee suffered a puncture wound to the left foot and twisted his left ankle.

An employee was cleaning mud from a roadway while a trackhoe was being operated nearby. A car came over the hill in the same lane as the employee. When the employee stepped out of the way, he moved in the direction of the turning trackhoe. His overalls were caught by the track, which pulled his left leg underneath. His left leg below the knee had to be surgically amputated.
On or about February 26, 2016, an employee was feeding material into a shear when the employee's fingers entered the shear point. The employee's finger was amputated.

An employee was attempting to lift a large heavy die using a crow bar when the die fell on the employee's fingers. The employee's right index finger was partially amputated and the thumb was seriously injured.

An employee was transferring formic acid from a leaking tote to a new tote. The new tote's valve was open, which allowed the formic acid to run out onto the ground. The employee walked toward the tote, slipped, and fell onto the formic acid, suffering third degree burns (right leg, backside, right ear, and hands) that required hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting windows at a customer's home while standing on the third step of the interior stairway. As he was turning to come down the stairs, he fell and landed on the hallway floor, fracturing his ankle.

While an employee was checking for an air leak on the die-cutting machine, the machine was activated by the foot pedal. The employee's left index finger was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was trying to put plastic up on a building to protect it against the elements. The wind caught the plastic and knocked the employee off the 12-foot ladder. The employee suffered a hairline fracture of the lower back.

An employee was showing a coworker a problem with a handgun that would not eject its cartridge. The employee was able to pull the slide back when the cartridge went off. A portion of the bullet went through the employee's hand. A bullet fragment also struck a second employee in the left ankle and heel.

An employee was repairing loose, serrated, expanded metal grating. When he lifted a piece of grating, his middle fingertip was caught between the top piece of grating he was moving and another portion of grating. His fingertip was amputated (no bone loss).
An employee was in a bucket running wire from a transformer when they received burns across the upper torso and hands due to an arcing power line.
While walking in the parking lot, an employee was struck by a customer's vehicle that was backing out of a parking space.

An employee was beveling a pipe with a grinder. The employee put down the grinder after beveling the pipe, placed his hand on the elevated skid, and looked into the pipe. The pipe started to roll and crushed his right index finger, which was partially amputated.
An employee fell 18 feet from a ladder to the ground while working on a roof.
An employee was cleaning out the bed of his dump truck while holding the tailgate with his right hand when the tailgate came down on his right middle finger, amputating the fingertip (no bone loss).

On February 26, 2016, an employee had unloaded a load of salt water from the trailer before bringing it to the shop to help a mechanic remove bolts from the lid on the first hatch to replace the scrubber ball. They tried using vice grips and wrenches, but were unsuccessful. The employee proceeded to use a metal die grinder to attempt to remove the bolts while the mechanic walked to the tool room. Both the employee and the mechanic reported that they heard a whistling sound. At some point the vapors left behind after unloading the salt water ignited causing a flash fire. The employee's left forearm was burned.
An employee suffered an amputation injury while cutting particle board on a table saw.
An employee was walking next to a forklift. A railroad rail fell from the forklift and struck the employee's right leg resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee was removing wiring and sensors from the top of a Tainter gate retaining wall. The employee fell 10-16 feet from the retaining wall and fractured vertebrae in the back.

An employee experienced an amputation of the left pinky finger while guiding a rod out of a well. The rod was sticky and grabbed the employee's gloved left hand and spun it counterclockwise resulting in the amputation of the pinky finger and dislocation of the ring and middle fingers.
An employee experienced lower back pain from lifting a heavy pail.
An employee was riding a tug. The extinguisher in the tug went off causing a respiratory irritation that led the employee to have an asthma attack.
An employee was working at the pipe threading machine. As the employee walked away from the machine, he tripped over a tripod leg of the machine and fell breaking the left hip.

The injured employee was on the deck of a ship, lashing containers and locking them down to the ship. The injured employee's right hand was resting on a container on the deck. A crane operator was bringing another container onto the deck. The employee's right thumb tip was smashed between the container that was already on deck and the container that was being set in place by the crane.

An employee was operating a CNC machine that had a chip conveyor extending from it. The employee turned the CNC machine off to retrieve a chip ball piece of scrap from the conveyor. As he was retrieving the scrap, the machine was unintentionally activated. The employee's glove became caught in the moving parts and his fingers were caught where the conveyor meets the CNC machine. His left-hand index and middle fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was operating a plasma cutter to cut parts from a sheet of steel. When he attempted to adjust a part, his right index fingertip was amputated between the machine and the steel plate.
An employee was struck on the back by a large metal pole, cracking two ribs.
An employee was putting metal bands into a trash can when his left index finger was caught between the steel cans, partially amputating the finger at the nail.
An employee stepping down from his truck cab missed the steps and fell approximately 2 feet to the ground, fracturing his ankle.
While placing a hide in clamps, an employee's thumb was caught and crushed in the clamp.

On February 27, 2016, at approximately 6:20 a.m., an employee fell off a load of drywall on the back of a truck while preparing to unload it. The employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, fracturing vertebrae and suffering a concussion. The employee required head staples.
An employee was struck by a field truck while preparing to harvest tomatoes, injuring his left leg and lower back.
An employee broke his middle finger while attempting to recoil a garage door cable.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet through the floor of an enclosed scaffold structure while working on a bridge. The employee suffered a broken leg, wrist, and arm and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a ladder and broke two ribs.
While attempting to remove buildup from a concrete ledge, an employee fell from a 10-foot portable A-frame ladder to the ground. The employee's left elbow broke and required surgery.
An employee's left thumb was amputated to the first knuckle while the employee was inspecting the drain plug on the bottom of a chemical mixer.
An employee was struck by a large 4  ft. X 2 ft. piston while cleaning a dough machine resulting in trauma to the forearm.

An employee loading freight from a truck to a railcar got his hand crushed when the rail car sliding door closed and pinched his hand between the door and the door jamb. The employee sustained crushing injuries and lacerations to the right hand.
An employee was using a drilling machine when a 6-inch collar fell and struck the machine, causing it to rotate and strike the employee's left leg. The employee's left femur fractured.
An employee slipped and fell against the wall and floor while trying to assist a falling patient, breaking her left arm.
An employee's left hand was cut on a chiller guard on 2/26/16 at approximately 10:00 p.m. He was hospitalized when the wound became infected.
An employee was assaulted by a patient during discharge, suffering back and right hip injuries and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an amputation injury while closing a door.
An employee's fingertip was amputated after contacting the belt of a running air compressor while  attempting to repair the machine.
An employee's right hand was amputated while cleaning out material from a knife gate.
An employee was loading material into the slitter machine when his hand and arm were pulled into the machine.
An employee completed his shift on 02/27/2016 when he began coughing uncontrollably. The employee was later admitted to the hospital and diagnosed with chemical induced pneumonia.

An employee was holding a 2 x 4 stake while a coworker hit it with a sledgehammer. The coworker struck the employee's right index finger with the sledgehammer, breaking bones in the employee's right hand.

An employee was on the first floor when he was called down to the basement level to assist with a repair. Coworkers had drained water from a boiler into a sump pit, which was approximately 3 feet deep and 2 feet in diameter. There was no cover on the pit, and the sump pump had trouble keeping up with the volume of water being added and quickly filled up. When the employee came down from the first floor to help, he fell into the sump pit and suffered second and third degree burns on his lower torso, legs, and hands. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering a trailer door when his foot slipped off the trailer bumper, causing him to fall forward. The trailer door came down on his left arm and broke it.
An employee missed a rung while climbing a fixed ladder and fell 15 feet. He suffered multiple right leg fractures and shattered his right ankle.
An employee was loading materials into a storage room. His finger was caught on the hinge side of a door resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's hand was caught between the air conditioner belt and pulley on a tree cutter machine.  The employee's left hand was crushed and the employee was hospitalized due to the injury.

On 02/29/2016 an employee was grinding a steel plate when the work stock got wedged. The work stock flipped up pinching his thumb tip between the work stock and the grinding disc. The employee was taken to the hospital for medical treatment. The employee's right thumb tip was later amputated.
An employee was setting up a production machine. While adjusting parts, a hand was caught in the running machine resulting in injuries to the right hand.
An employee slipped and fell striking the back of his head.

An employee was working on a pole using climbers. After the employee completed his work on the pole, he began to descend the pole. As he was descending, he "cut out" and slid down three to four feet while hugging the pole. He then let go and fell approximately 12 feet causing injury to his back.

On February 29, 2016, at approximately 3:05pm, an employee suffered injuries after falling to the floor.  The employee was walking out of the Director's office, caught a shoe on a chair, and fell to the tile floor resulting in a loss of consciousness, nasal fracture, laceration to the lip, and bruising.

An employee performing a road call was struck in the face by a bottle jack that kicked out while he was servicing a truck alongside a public road. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of an orbital fracture and observation.
An employee was getting into the truck and scraped his leg on the step rail. The leg swelled and the employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was removing dust around the area of the blade on a band saw. The employee lost his balance and stumbled into the band saw breaking his left arm and lacerating his left hand and ring fingers.

While descending a ladder with a nail gun, an employee tripped over the nail gun hose and started to fall. As he tried to prevent the fall, his finger activated the trigger and he was shot in the right leg.

The employee was standing on a desk to measure the plastic cover on an overhead fluorescent light fixture. He stepped on the corner of the desk and the leg of the desk penetrated the 5/8" plywood flooring. The employee fell three feet and fractured the right leg.
On or about February 29, 2016, one employee was injured when he disconnected his PFAS to untangle the line and fell from the roof area breaking a leg.

An employee was troubleshooting a furnace when hot condensate that had built up in the vertical muffler of a steam vent line splashed onto the employee and caused first and second degree burns to the employee's back, shoulders, arms, posterior and legs.
An employee broke a leg while driving a forklift between piles of pallets.

An employee was loading a pallet into a pick up truck using a forklift. The employee placed the pallet onto the tailgate of the pick up truck, then got off the forklift and proceeded to push the pallet into the pick up. The forklift moved forward slowly and a fork struck the employee in the arm and pinned his arm. The employee suffered two cracked ribs and a fractured forearm.
On or about February 29, 2016, an employee's arm was crushed between the mold and plate while attempting to move the mold off the rollers.
On or about February 29, 2016, an employee received a partial index finger amputation while working on the Magic Box A conveyor belt on the 500 Line in the Bindery Department.

An employee was performing maintenance on a truck. The truck brakes were on fire and employees used a fire extinguisher to suppress the flames. The employee then began adjusting the brakes and sustained a hand injury.

An employee was putting wire on a U-shaped, steel channel frame, balanced on forklift tines, in order to attach the frame to an overhead crane.  The steel frame began to fall backwards, and the employee tried to maintain its balance causing the employee's right pinky finger to get caught between the forklift frame and the fork tines.  The employee's right pinky finger was removed from above the second knuckle.
The employee was conducting preventive maintenance on a sit down lift truck. As he was removing a side panel, the battery rolled out and struck his left knee cap fracturing it.
An employee amputated the right ring fingertip in a pulley assembly.

An employee was putting away a cart of headlight extensions in the store.  The employee turned to exit the store and walked out into a moving forklift.  The employee's right foot was injured.  The second, fourth and fifth digits (toes) were fractured and the big toe was dislocated.  The employee was hospitalized.

On February 29, 2016, 2nd shift (2:30 p.m. - 11:00 p.m.) the injured employee was performing his regular job duties to assemble wooden crates with a pneumatic staple gun, nail gun, and other hand tools. At approximately at 6:40 p.m., the injured employee was adjusting his position to assemble the bottom of the crate that was enclosing a part placed on the pallet on the floor. The injured employee moved around the crate to position his body and inadvertently pressed or had something else press the staple gun's trigger to initiate the stapling cycle. Subsequently it came sideways in contact with his right leg area above the kneecap and resulted in a puncture wound.

An employee was lifting 40' of material from a trailer using slings and a crane. While backing up to the edge of the trailer, the employee lost their footing, slipped and fell to the bottom of cement stairs landing on a tape measure causing a hip and knee injury.

An employee was riding a Polaris Ranger vehicle gathering cattle on a ranch when it hit a bump. The rifle that he was carrying felt off the vehicle, hit the ground, and accidently discharged striking the employee in the leg.

An employee was rolling up lines and a piece of material fell and struck the employee on the shoulder. The employee sustained bruising/hematoma to the left upper back area and compression fractures of three thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was inflating a tire on an RV when a piece of molding flew off and struck another employee in the head causing a laceration.
The employee jump started a farm tractor with a screw driver.  The tractor was in gear and the throttle advanced.  The tractor started and ran over the employee resulting in multiple fractures.

An employee was pouring used cooking oil into a disposal receptacle.  The oil was not sufficiently cool and as it was being transferred, it splashed on the employee's face and shoulder resulting in burns that required overnight hospitalization.
An employee was setting up the CNC machine when the cycle button was hit, causing the spindle to turn and throw parts out. The parts hit, shattered, and broke bones in the employee's upper arm.

An employee was walking across the roof of a barn carrying a piece of guttering when he stepped backwards onto a skylight. He fell through the skylight into the barn from a height of about 15 feet and landed on metal cattle pens and the concrete floor. The employee suffered broken ribs, a liver laceration, a fractured eye-socket bone, and an arm laceration.
An employee was operating a locomotive crane when the crane tipped, bruising the employee's ribs.

On 3/1/2016, an employee was performing maintenance on a pin-setting machine when his hand slipped and was caught in the pin-setting equipment while it was in operation. The machine caught the ring on the employee's left finger and amputated it.

On 3/1/2016, an employee was guiding a large piece of steel as it was being moved by an overhead crane. The sling that was holding the piece broke during the move, and the piece of steel fell on the left side of the employee's body, amputating his left arm and crushing his left leg.

On March 1, 2016, an employee was using an air hose to clean off a piece of machinery when he was caught in the spindle cutter. The spindle caught his gloved hand and pulled his left hand and arm into the moving parts of the cutter. His arm was amputated from the elbow down.
While cutting material using a table saw, an employee's fingers contacted the blade, resulting in a finger amputation on 3/1/16.
An employee was pushing a die cart when a wheel got stuck in a hole. As he went to push it out, he felt a pop in his left calf muscle. He was later hospitalized when his left calf became infected.
An employee working on a residential roof slipped and fell to the ground, injuring his knee and back.
An employee was overcome by smoke when he responded to a smoke alert.  He went into an apartment and helped evacuate the tenants.  He was hospitalized for smoke inhalation.
An employee struck the back of the right foot while dismounting a double pallet jack, suffering a laceration and slight Achilles tendon tear, which required overnight hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell in the packaging department and fractured the left femur.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while cutting onions with a knife.
An employee was pushing a food cart when wind caught the door of the cart, causing it to swing back and hit the employee's fingers. The employee's left-hand third digit was amputated.

An employee was sitting on the back of a pick-up truck throwing salt. When he dismounted the truck to retrieve something that had fallen, he lost his footing and fell, hitting the back of his head and requiring hospitalization.

On or about March 1, 2016, an employee was re-installing a pump that was approximately 5 feet long and weighed approximately 300 pounds. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated when it was caught between the pinch point of the housing and the casting.

An employee was operating a laundry press when the press fell on her hand from the up position. She suffered fourth degree burns on the left hand and a possible broken bone, requiring hospitalization.
On or about March 1, 2016, an employee was cleaning the metal detector air valve when it actuated. The employee's hand was in the pinch point, and the middle fingertip was amputated.
On 3/1/16, an employee was lifting a patient using a mechanical lift when the lift malfunctioned and struck the employee's back.

An employee was pulling a cart filled with beverages onto the lift gate of a truck when his foot got tangled in the lift gate safety chains. He fell off the lift gate onto the concrete ground, suffering head trauma.
An employee fell from a grocery stock cart to the floor while stocking a grocery aisle, injuring his head.
An employee was surveying an area for future work while standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder. He fell from the ladder, breaking his ribs and puncturing his lung.
An employee was walking towards the truck yard when he tripped on an uneven surface (1/4-inch rise). He broke several ribs and hit his chin.
An employee had an allergic reaction to air freshener in a patient's room.
An employee was slicing meat in the deli for a customer when the employee's hand slipped off the guard and struck the rotating blade, amputating the right thumb tip.

A maintenance employee received multiple fractures and lacerations when a high-tension cable associated with a roll-up door wrapped around his right hand during attempts to troubleshoot a malfunction. He required surgery.
An employee was working on a crane, fixing a hydraulic line. The employee fell from the crane to the concrete ground, suffering head injuries and a fractured clavicle.
An employee was running the profile in a door panel shaper machine. When he attempted to clean out the sawdust, his left-hand pinky finger contacted and was amputated by the cutter on the machine.

On Tuesday, March 1, 2016, at approximately 6:15 AM, employees were attempting to unjam the end-matcher machine. The load chain was placed in reverse, and a lug on the chain pulled an employee's right thumb into a guarded area, amputating the tip.
An employee was using his pass key to open the door when he hit his head on the mailbox and passed out.

An employee was working in the stock area and was coming down the top-stock cart ladder when she missed the bottom step, falling backwards onto the floor and injuring her left wrist and lower back area. She was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was reaching for a part to be welded with his right hand while his left hand was on an oil table that contained a conveyor. The conveyor cycled by itself, amputating his left middle and index fingertips.
On 3/1/16, an employee was hospitalized after two fingers were crushed in the rollers of a machine.
An employee was hospitalized with a concussion after a lamp pole fixture hit him in the head during snow removal operations.
An employee stepped onto an approximately 18-inch-tall retaining wall. The top cap block of the wall slid, causing the employee to fall and fracture his hip. He required surgery.

An employee was working with a sewer jetter to clean a sewer line and the jetter became stuck. The employee attempted to remove it from the sewer line when the high-pressure dirty water shot into his right index finger, causing an infection.
While an employee was performing electrical work underneath a refrigerated case, he noticed severe swelling in his left hand. He was hospitalized with an infection.

An employee was repairing a leaking water pump. The employee went to change into rubber boots when he stepped on a wheel wire brush. The wires from the brush punctured and broke off in his right heel, requiring surgical removal.

An employee was working early in the morning at a residential construction site, using a ladder to reach a gable to install corners finishing work. He stepped onto the icy roof, slipped, and fell approximately 10 to 12 feet to the ground, crushing/fracturing his vertebrae.

An employee fell approximately 7 feet from an elevated picker while picking an order from the second level up. He landed between the mast and forks of a forklift, suffering bruising on his left side, a collapsed lung, brain bleeding, and facial injuries.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to his truck, injuring his head.
An employee was picking orders from ground level when a pallet fell from a shelf above and struck his leg, breaking his right fibula.

An employee was stenciling a piece of 4" 30' drill pipe inside a racking system. A second pipe was kicked over onto the racking system and rolled down the table, striking the employee from behind. This caused the employee's face to impact the stationary pipe in front of him that he was stenciling. He sustained a fractured jaw.
An employee was cleaning a machine when the machine cycled while his arm was inside. He suffered two fractures to his right arm.
An employee fell to the ground while exiting a rental truck after missing the second step. During the fall, he struck his head on the truck and/or parking lot, suffering lacerations.

While an employee was conducting a tree felling operation, the holding wood snapped and the tree came off the stump in the direction of the employee. The employee was following a designated escape route when the bole of the tree impacted his left side, breaking his rib, scapula, and clavicle; cutting his lip; and causing a chest contusion.
An employee was working on a feed system and attempting to reline the feed line to the machine when her right middle finger was pinched by the homing plate, amputating her fingertip.
An employee was assembling 5-pack boxes, cutting the plastic strapping from a bundle of cartons using a retractable snap blade utility knife, when his left wrist was lacerated.

An employee was wearing a full harness, shock absorbing lanyard, rope, and anchor while working on the second floor roof. The employee slipped on a peel-and-stick felt pad and fell. He landed on his feet and fractured his right hip. He had 38 feet of rope laid out and the roof height was 23 feet.

On Wednesday, March 2, 2016, at approximately 3:30 PM, an employee was operating a CNC machine. The employee opened the protective door of the machine to clean the chips from the fixture with an air hose. When his hand was close to the spindle area, the cutting tool struck his finger, amputating his fingertip.
An employee sustained electrical burns while performing wiring work.
An employee was attempting to remove a frozen chicken breast from a belt. The employee's fingertip was amputated when it was caught in the belt.
An employee fell while walking down stairs. His finger was caught in a grate, ripping skin from his finger. His fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was pushing a cart of plywood when a strong wind blew the plywood over, causing the cart to strike and fracture the employee's left ankle.

An employee was working on an underground residential distribution junction box, attempting to ground a live elbow in a box, when an arc flash occurred. He received electrical flash burns to both legs.

An employee was part of a crew performing work during the temporary shutdown of a boiler. He was raising a wash beam from inside the boiler by using an electric powered winch.  He was operating the pendant controls of the winch and raising the beam.  While raising the beam, his right hand was on the cable of the winch. The spool of the winch caught his glove, causing his hand to became caught in the winch.  He pulled his hand back, amputating his right ring fingertip just below the nailbed.
An employee installing an ice and water shield slipped and fell 30 feet, breaking two ribs.
An employee delivering mail to a residence misstepped from a step to the curb and fell, suffering head and back trauma.
An employee fell through an opening on a permanent structure, a compressor, suffering a pelvic fracture.
An employee was struck on the head by a piece of concrete that fell from the ceiling. He suffered a concussion.
An employee was using a portable grinder on site when the grinder wheel shattered. The employee's right hand was lacerated by the wheel particles.
On or about 3/2/16, an employee slipped and fell on concrete while exiting a car in the parking lot. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

On or about 3/2/16, an employee was kneeling, writing an address on a shipping container, when a forklift ran over the employee's foot with the right front tire. The employee was hospitalized and the foot was amputated.
An employee slipped inside the walk-in freezer, breaking the right hip.
An employee was on a step ladder removing decorations when she landed and felt pain in her right leg and knee.
An employee was exiting a patient's room when her shoe was caught in the carpeting. She fell, striking her head twice on the floor. She suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was injured after tripping over a fence.
An employee fell to the ground and injured his left wrist after being startled by a snake.
An employee was cleaning his boot with a high-power pressure washer when the washer lacerated the area above the right ankle.

An employee was adjusting a surveillance camera. Afterwards, the employee began stepping down from the ladder he was using. He missed the last step of the ladder and fell to the floor, fracturing his left hip.
An employee removed a tire from a company trailer and was airing the tire when the tire exploded. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the left forearm and required surgery.
An employee was loading I-beams when one of the I-beams fell off the rack and hit the employee in the back of the leg, breaking an ankle.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while stretching a cable.

An employee was walking and talking to another employee when she slipped and fell on the concrete ramp leading to her office building. She was hospitalized with a head injury and compound fracture to her right wrist area.
An employee was cleaning a coater (coats sheets of metal) with a rag when his right hand was caught and crushed between the rollers. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was checking on a mini-excavator being worked on by a subcontractor. As he walked around the mini excavator, a hydraulic failure caused the extended boom to drop and strike the employee in the upper back area, cracking vertebrae.

An employee was on security patrol and helped a driver enter the establishment. He then observed a trash can with a portion of a pallet sticking out of it. The employee attempted to push it farther down into the can. The piece was too long to move, and the employee had several wood splinters enter his hand. He was hospitalized when his injury became infected.

An employee was preparing to help clean deli equipment using a chemical degreaser. The container  of concentrated degreasing chemical fell, causing the chemical to spill out and contact the employee's leg.  The employee suffered severe skin irritation.
An employee fell 12.5 feet from a stair landing to the ground and was hospitalized with multiple fractures.
An employee was trying to line up two pin holes when the pipes came together and amputated the first two left-hand fingertips.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when he tripped and fell down three stairs. He struck the handrail and suffered a contusion to the lower chest/upper abdomen on his right side.

An employee was helping unravel hose when his hand was placed in the buffer zone between the trailer and hose. His right middle finger was caught between the hose and the trailer, resulting in the traumatic amputation of his fingertip.
An employee's right hand was caught in the rollers while feeding dough into the dough machine, amputating the ring and middle fingertips.
Employees were preparing to remove a gear box from a wind turbine when an employee's lower left leg was struck and lacerated by high-pressure hydraulic fluid, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell in the parking lot and was hospitalized with a fractured femur.
An employee was cutting plastic pedestals using an electric miter saw when his left-hand thumb was amputated.
An employee hyperextended their back while picking up a 38-pound box and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to replace a fiberglass grate when the grate slipped from his hands and fell on his right leg.
While mixing concrete with a mixer drill, and employee's left index finger was caught in the blades, partially amputating the fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jam on a powder-actuated tool when the tool discharged. The actuating piston struck the employee's right palm, requiring surgery.

While two employees were walking and carrying a recliner, the employee who was walking backward tripped over a hand truck, became unstable, and fell, striking his head on the truck's lift gate. He suffered a head laceration that required surgery, as well as brain bleeding.

An employee went to check wires on a pull box using a ladder. The employee contacted live wires, was shocked, and fell approximately 4 feet off the ladder. He landed on his back and hit his head on the ground, suffering bleeding on his brain.

An employee was waiting for maintenance to clear a jam on a tissue interfolder machine. The employee attempted to grab a scrap of paper as maintenance was jogging and stopping the machine. Her right pinky and ring fingers were pulled into a pinch point and had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was operating a tree-trimming machine to cut tree limbs along a powerline when the machine rolled off a hill and struck a group of trees. He suffered a concussion, fractured arm, and broken ribs.
At 5:45 AM on 3/3/16, an employee was walking into work from her car when she slipped on ice in the driveway and fell, fracturing her right ankle and knee.
On March 3, 2016, at approximately 3:15 p.m., an employee fell 32 feet from a roof while installing metal panels. The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken pelvis, as well as a hand laceration.

An employee placed a 500-1,000 lb. mold onto the sandblasting sled table using a crane. The employee then began moving the table to the sandblast cabinet when the tabletop fell from the base and landed on employee's left leg causing severe damage to his leg.
An employee was operating an auger and amputated the three middle fingers on the left hand.
An employee was hospitalized after tripping and falling, resulting in a broken hip.

A front end loader was pulling a truck out of the sand. The loader operator asked an employee to hold the chain used to pull the truck. The chain became tight and caught the employee's middle ring finger, fracturing it. The employee required surgery.
An employee was admitted to the hospital following a fire during the transfer of diesel fuel at a facility.
An employee was hit/crushed by a motor grader's rear differential while the operator was backing up. The employee suffered a fractured back, three broken ribs, and a broken shoulder/collarbone.
An employee was entering the building and was reaching for the closing door when his finger was caught between the door and door jam, causing a soft tissue amputation of his left-hand ring finger.
An employee was running pipe in a hole when his right pinky finger was caught and fractured between the wrench line and the rod.

An employee was moving storage racks with a forklift when the forklift became stuck in the mud. The employee was putting boards under the tires with help from a coworker. The storage rack fell from the forklift and struck the employee. He sustained a crushed pelvis, broken ankle, broken ribs, and a head injury.

During the cleaning and sanitation of a dough divider, an employee was checking to see if any food particles were left on the machine. He spotted a small piece of bread dough and tried to flick it off with his finger. The tip of his glove was pinched in the machine, which amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was feeding stock into an alligator shear when the shear amputated the employee's middle finger.
An employee was checking one of the label-making machines in the cooler. When she bent down, she lost her balance and grabbed a step ladder. The ladder folded and crushed her left pinky finger.
An employee cleaning a conveyor line came into contact with a chain and sprocket, amputating a fingertip.
An employee's knee was pinned and injured between two carts.

An employee was trying to clear a blocked floor drain using an air hose. He attempted to pressurize the drain and hot water splashed onto his face, arms, and chest, causing second degree burns to 10 percent of his body.
An employee's left little fingertip was pinched by a carry aid that opened as it was being unloaded from a truck. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was shuttling vehicles at the distribution center.  The employee fell and struck their head while entering or exiting a vehicle, suffering a traumatic brain injury.
An employee was moving furniture when a leg broke on a china cabinet. The cabinet hit her in the head, back, and leg, causing contusions.
Three workers were raising the structural wall frame of a single family house when the wall fell onto an employee, fracturing his upper leg.
Two employees were operating forklifts when they collided with each other. One of the employees suffered a fractured left tibia.

An employee was trying to unjam a jammed pipe connection when the cast-iron T section of the boiler pipe shattered, causing steam and hot water to release and burn the employee's thighs. The employee suffered second degree burns.

An employee was using a dismantler to pull the boards of a pallet apart. His hand became caught in the pallet, and he was unable to remove his hand before the pallet went through the blade of the dismantler. His pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to dismount a railcar by the side ladder when the railcar began to move along the tracks. The railcar collided with a pipe layer on an A-frame, crushing the employee's right hand between the pipe layer and the ladder of the railcar. The employee was hospitalized and required hand surgery.

An employee was climbing up a fixed ladder to clear a material jam on a conveyor when his hand slipped, causing him to lose balance and fall from the third rung up from the floor. He fell standing up, but fractured his lower left leg.

When an employee stepped onto bleachers, the bleachers broke, and the employee fell through and hit the ground. The employee suffered 13 fractured ribs, a punctured/collapsed lung, a dislocated shoulder, and multiple contusions and abrasions.

An employee was replacing a bearing in a space heater when his leather glove was caught at the edge of the separator bar (the rotating mechanism inside of the heater) as it turned. His right thumb was caught between the separator bar and the outer shroud (the heater's fan with a filtration system) and was amputated from the first joint.

An employee was inspecting metal stripes in the attic of a dormitory construction. The employee stepped on a soffit and fell through a hole approximately 9 ft. off the ground breaking the tibia and vertebrae.
An employee was punched in the face by a shoplifter and suffered facial fractures that required surgery.
An employee was adjusting the location of a barrier on a work site when the barrier fell on his foot, fracturing some bones.
An employee was tapping a part on a milling machine when his glove became caught on the rotating tap. His left thumb was partially amputated under his fingernail.
An employee fell from a ladder and fractured three vertebrae while installing home TV cable.
An employee was taping metal coil when coil came off a C-hook and hit the employee's right side. The employee suffered a hairline fracture to the pelvis and vertebrae.

An employee was hanging 8x8 tubes from the ground level. The first tube was set in place and the second tube was being placed. The column leaned out and separated from the wall, causing the tube to slip off the column. The steel tube hit the employee's forehead and knocked the employee against a wall.
An employee was finishing drywall seams on the fourth floor corridor ceiling when he fell to the concrete below. He suffered a right-side facial laceration and broken right arm.

An employee was feeding a piece of 1/4"-thick by 2"-wide by 2'-long steel flat bar into an electric plate rolling machine. The employee noticed that the material was feeding crooked. When he tried to straighten it, his right hand was pulled into the rolling mechanism, crushing the index and middle fingers between the rollers. He used his left hand to push the roll-release lever, which freed his right hand from the machine.
An employee was walking to her automobile to travel to her next assignment when she fell off a curb at the site and fractured her arm in four locations. She was hospitalized.
An employee's finger became caught between two metal doors while he was trying to close them. His left index finger was amputated at the second digit.
An employee was cutting in wall blocking and amputated a finger with the saw.
While coaching and training a cart associate, an employee tripped over a speed bump outside the store and fell on her left arm, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was bending flat steel into machine parts on a brake press. On the third bend, the steel curled around, catching and crushing the employee's right thumb between the steel and the brake press.

On March 5, 2016, at approximately 1600, an employee was placing rope between stacked pipe to protect the finish on the product when the line ejected another pipe. The ejected pipe came over the stop and struck the employee, pinning him between the pipes and causing crushing injuries to his legs. He was hospitalized.
An employee's left hand was caught between a pontoon and a rigging chain, amputating the left-hand index finger at the first digit.
An employee was working off an extension ladder when the bottom of the ladder slipped and the employee fell off, landing on his feet and injuring his back.
While an employee was unloading a trailer of media cabinets, product fell on him and broke his lower right leg.

An employee and coworkers were setting up the small mortar mixer on a concrete masonry unit to allow the mortar to be poured into a wheelbarrow. As he was lifting the mixer, it moved forward, causing him to lose his grip. It slipped out of his hand and pinched his fingers between the top of the concrete masonry unit and the bottom of the back of the mixer, amputating his right index fingertip.
While skiing down hill, an employee was hit on the head and knocked unconscious by a bar/cross bar of the ski lift, sustaining a head injury.
Two forklifts collided in a warehousing operation. One employee was injured by the fork of the other forklift truck.
An employee's left middle finger was pinched between decking support, requiring hospitalization for surgery.
An employee was loading metal stock into a CNC machine when his right thumb struck against the machine and was lacerated. He was hospitalized when the laceration became infected.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while working on the printing press. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to reach and adjust a chain that was holding up one of the very large bags in the baghouse. The employee crawled on top of the bags, which are held in place by angle irons 11 inches apart. While crawling toward the bag, the employee lost his grip and fell through the 11-inch gap. He fell 37 feet to the ground, breaking a foot and fracturing a vertebra.
An employee was taking a box from a shelf in the bakery cooler when she lost her balance, fell, and hit her head on the floor. She was hospitalized.
A crane operator was moving a load, which was secured by choker slings. An employee on the ground was struck in the head by the pole/rod while the lift was taking place, fracturing his skull.

An employee was operating a boring mill and measuring a hole that was to be drilled in a cross beam when their sleeve was caught in the drill bit. The force from the boring machine caused the employee to flip over and land on the ground, suffering cracked right ribs, a collapsed right lung, right kidney bleeding, and a rash burn to the arms and neck.
A forklift driver was re-positioning a pallet when the pallet fell off the forks, striking and breaking a nearby employee's right leg.

An employee was changing grease fittings and lines on a stand in the plant. The employee was picking up the hoses as he was walking away (there is a channel that the profile gauge moves back and forth over). The profile gauge had been moved away at the time, uncovering the channel. The employee stepped in the open channel, which is 26" deep, and broke his left leg.
An employee was taking out the garbage when wind caught the door and closed it on the employee's finger. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

On March 6, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee climbed up a ladder to inspect a roof. The ladder slid sideways, and the employee fell 10 feet to the driveway. The employee sustained a fractured left elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a steel plate with a gantry crane when his thumb became pinned between the plate and the frame of the crane, amputating his thumb tip.

An employee was helping to stack barge covers when the top cover's clamp became caught in the D-ring on the cover below it, preventing proper stacking. The employee went to assist another employee in removing the catch and asked the crane operator to lift the top cover again. During this action, his left index finger was caught in the clamp, lacerating it. He required surgery.
An employee fell from a stepladder to the ground while trying to grab an item off a shelf, injuring his elbow, back, and head.
An employee was playing basketball with clients as part of a health and wellness activity when he ruptured his left knee.
An employee was framing a residence when he fell off a scaffold to the ground, breaking his ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee backed into a shelf while driving a stand-up forklift and suffered a back injury.
An employee sustained a partial amputation of the small finger while operating a drill press.

An employee was diagnosing an issue with malfunctioning ejector plates and was attempting to remove a plastic particle from behind a back plate when a second employee cycled the machine. The plates closed and pinched the first employee's hand, amputating the right middle fingertip.
On 3/7/16, an employee using the mobile vet clinic was hospitalized with an infection after being bitten by a cat.

An employee was using a 6-foot step platform ladder to change a filter for a pump when the platform ladder became unstable and tipped over to the ground. The employee fell and suffered fractures to the right wrist, right ankle, and right hip.

At approximately 10:20 p.m., an employee was operating one of the moving lifts. When he exited the lift, the vehicle did not stop, and his foot was smashed between the machine and the protective railing, severing his toe.
An employee was exposed to carbon monoxide from two forklifts while working at the grading table.
An employee tripped and fell while carrying material. The employee fractured the right wrist and injured the right knee, requiring wrist surgery.
An employee was moving a part with a forklift when he struck a storage rack. A brake drum fell from the storage rack and struck his right ankle, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a mixer when the bowl fell from the guard. The employee's finger was caught in the mixer, amputating his left middle fingertip.

An employee was making an inside delivery and was cutting a strap with a box cutter. The strap was resistant to the box cutter, so he pulled with more force. The blade came past the box and cut his inside wrist and forearm area, severing a blood vessel. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a router to cut a groove in a panel when his index finger went into the opening on the router. The bit pulled his glove in and his right index finger was amputated.
An employee was installing an LV box overhead while standing 4 feet up on a 6-foot ladder when she fell off the ladder and fractured her ribs.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to move material when the employee's foot was caught between two pallet jacks. The employee sustained crushing injuries and broken bones to the foot and ankle.
An employee fell approximately 4 feet from a trailer to the ground while pulling a skid with a drum on it when the skid broke. The employee suffered a broken right wrist.
An employee was installing lift straps when he slipped and his hand entered the bearing point of a mill and bearing roll. His left thumb broke.
An employee was repairing a roof when he fell approximately 30 feet to the ground, puncturing his lung.
An employee was installing a light fixture from a ladder when he made contact with a live electrical wire. He fell from the ladder and fractured his clavicle.
An employee was performing maintenance on a blowout preventer when his finger was crushed by a hydraulic valve. He was hospitalized and had surgery for fractured bones in the left ring phalanges.
An employee was helping to move a pane of glass when it fell on him and shattered, causing lacerations and fracturing bones.
An employee was walking out of the guard shack when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his left leg in two places.
An employee was changing out a hydraulic line from a piston-holding, hoist-on roll-off when it fell, injuring the employee who required hospitalization.
An employee was pushing a cart of chrome bundles, which were 2" x 12' long. The bundles shifted and pinched two fingers on his right hand. When he pulled his hand out, his fingertips were amputated.
An employee descending a 28-foot extension ladder misstepped and fell approximately 9 feet to the ground, breaking an ankle.

An employee was working from a 4-foot A-frame ladder when the soffit on which he was working de-stabilized and fell, knocking the ladder and employee to the ground. He broke four ribs and suffered a partially collapsed left lung.
An employee amputated his left-hand ring and middle fingertips when his hand contacted a running fan belt.

Two employees were operating a manual, foot-operated shear to cut aluminum sheet metal. The injured employee was helping to hold down the sheet metal when the second employee operated the shear, amputating the injured employee's right index and middle fingertips.
While cutting wood with a table saw, an employee contacted the moving saw blade, amputating half of the left middle finger.
An employee was changing a light bulb when the bulb burst in his hand. The broken glass lacerated this palm.
While replacing roof sheet metal, an employee fell approximately 26 feet from the roof, to the top of a forklift, and then to the concrete ground, suffering a broken leg.
An employee's right-hand pinky fingertip was amputated when an equipment facer fell.

An employee was attempting to move a box of labels, which weighed approximately 42 pounds.  The box was located on a pallet on a lower shelf of a warehouse rack system. The employee lifted one box and placed it on an adjacent pallet. When he stood up and turned to get another box, he lost strength in his legs and fell to his knees. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
Two employees were hospitalized with facial injuries when a shipping case exploded as it was opened.
An employee was operating a cold press and amputated the right index finger from the second knuckle.

An employee was cleaning up the area when he noticed a piece of meat on the frame of an overhead saw (tail cutter). The employee reached up to get the meat but contacted the blade instead, amputating his left index fingertip.

The injured employee and a coworker were picking up supplies from a local supplier in a truck. The dock plate at the local supplier did not engage properly. Both workers got out and were trying to fix the dock plate when it came down on and amputated the injured employee's right index fingertip.

On March 7, 2016, an employee was moving a motor weighing approximately 350 pounds when the motor broke the floor, creating a hole. The employee fell approximately 25 feet through the hole, dislocating the left shoulder, fracturing an elbow, breaking a hip, and possibly rupturing the kidney and spleen.

An employee was cutting pieces of copper using a shear when one of the pieces dropped. He reached down to get the piece with his right hand and at the same time his left foot pressed the down pedal of the shear (which has an up pedal and a down pedal). His left-hand index and middle fingertips were amputated above the top knuckles.
An employee was injured after they climbed on top of a forklift and inadvertently kicked it into gear. The employee became pinned between the roll bar and the mast, suffering a cracked sternum.
On 3/8/2016, an employee was folding a box when she sustained a paper cut on her left wrist. The cut later became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to split a chicken with a saw. As the employee was pushing the chicken onto the saw blade, the employee's left index finger touched the saw blade, amputating the tip.
An employee's left thumb was amputated while the employee was fixing the railing of a flatbed truck.

An employee was unloading tote pallets from his delivery truck with a ride on electric pallet jack. The pallet jack struck a fixed light pole and the employee fell off the pallet jack onto the floor resulting in a right hip fracture.
An employee's hand was caught in a chain drive while the employee attempted to clear a jam, amputating the pinky finger.

On 3/8/2016, at approximately 2:00 PM, an employee was cutting up boxes. As the employee was attempting to step over the boxes, she tripped, fell, and hit her head. She lost consciousness and suffered a concussion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was holding a railroad crossing gate for a vehicle to get on the railroad. The vehicle struck the gate and the gate fell on his finger. His left ring finger was lacerated and the fingertip was eventually amputated.

Two employees got on a jet ski to rescue a guest that had capsized. During the rescue operation, a wave capsized the jet ski and caused it to break down. One of the employees suffered hypothermia after being immersed in the 55-degree water for several hours.
An employee was clearing a jam from the snap ring press when he received a cut on his right forearm.

An employee was carrying multiple containers of baby formula with both hands. She was going behind the service desk when she tripped over a box that was on the floor behind the desk. She fell and fractured her left knee, requiring hospitalization.

At approximately 09:00 a.m., an employee entered the attic area of the building to look for extra ceiling panels. He was making his way through the attic when he came across a surface that appeared to be concrete (this was actually the backside of the sheetrock that served as a ceiling to the area below). When he placed his foot on the surface, the sheetrock collapsed, and he fell from the 18-foot ceiling to the concrete below. He struck an automotive training aid tire with his left wrist as he fell on his back. He fractured his back, requiring surgery, and bruised his wrist.
An employee was cleaning wet sand from the sand bin gate when the gate closed on his left hand, causing multiple fractures and lacerations. He required sutures.

An employee was operating a winch on a barge when the rigging came free and hit the protective cage, breaking the cage loose. The cage hit the employee, lacerating his forehead and causing multiple facial fractures. The was hospitalized.
An employee's hand came into contact with an engine fan blade, amputating his right index finger and lacerating other fingers.

An employee was removing a contaminated piece of meat from a hanging bovine carcass using a trimming knife. The employee was stabbed with their own trimming knife when a piece of fat fell on their cutting arm, pushing the arm into the stomach/abdomen.
An employee was dismounting a 6-foot step ladder when he slipped and fell. As he fell, his right arm struck a nearby machine and fractured.

The employee was picking up hand tools and materials from around a drilling rig when he was struck in the head by a falling drilling rod and knocked unconscious. He suffered a head and neck vertebra injury.

On Tuesday, March 8, 2016, at approximately 7:15 AM, an employee was wrapping the walls of a modular home for shipping. The wall fell and injured the employee when he tried to grab it to stop it from falling. He was hospitalized overnight for treatment of back injuries.

An employee was using an aerial lift to trim trees. The foundation under the outriggers was soft/wet and could not support the weight of the lift in the extended position, causing the lift to tip over. The employee fell 30 to 45 feet from the lift and fractured the hip.
An employee was working on a pole while standing on a ladder when he fell to the ground, injuring his ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee's finger was smashed in a car door in the parking lot. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was in a free-swivel utility bucket installing the primary and neutral lines on a pole. The bucket moved, and the employee's left-hand middle finger was crushed and punctured by the parking bracket.

Workers were removing a load of rebar from the jobsite with a rough terrain forklift when the load of rebar shifted. An employee on the ground was struck by the falling load and ended up falling onto cribbing, fracturing the right ring finger, left pelvis, and tailbone. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 8, 2016, at 10:00 AM, two employees were working on the first level of the chemical vaporation area when a crane operator on the second level lowered the ring to lift a load. A 50-pound safety ring  dislodged from the lifting ring from about 7 feet, striking one employee in the hard hat and another one in the back. The employee who was hit in the back was hospitalized with three broken ribs and a hematoma.
An employee was doing a wheel alignment. He stepped out of the vehicle, fell to the ground, and lost consciousness.
A vehicle battery on a drill press became unsecured while an employee was drilling into it. A battery cable wrapped around the employee's left ring finger, amputating it at the first knuckle.

An employee was using a pressure washer to clean a forklift. The pressure washer lost pressure, so the employee walked around the pressure washer to try and see what was wrong. At that time, the "caps" blew off of the heater element on the pressure washer, striking the employee in the jaw and fracturing it.
An employee was moving a spreader bar into position when it slipped and caught his thumb between the bar and the wall. He was hospitalized to have his thumb reattached.

An employee was moving carts out of the way to connect a bag cart to a tug. One of the carts hit a seam in the concrete, and the cart's tong arm swung around and hit the employee's arm, fracturing it.

An employee was raising a roll of paper up with a hoist so that they could turn the roll of paper to the right position on the ramp. While working on the raised roll of paper, two or three other rolls of paper were prevented from coming down the ramp by an air activated cushion and a rubber chock.  Somehow, the rolls of paper became free and started rolling down the ramp. One of the rolls of paper struck the employee and pushed him against the roll of paper he was working on fracturing his pelvis.

On or about March 9, 2016, an employee was working with an internal combustion machine in the basement of a new construction residential house when he collapsed. The employee was overexposed to carbon monoxide and hospitalized.

An employee was descending the fold down access ladder on the concrete mixer truck after spraying down the hopper. The employee's wedding ring, worn on left ring finger, was caught on a bolt associated with the ladder safety latch, located on the left side of ladder. The injured finger required medical amputation.

An employee was loading paper into a printing press when the press did not move the paper along as designed. The employee jogged the machine and turned it off and then on, attempting to get the paper to move along. The employee's left index finger was caught in the machine, amputating the first digit of the finger.
An employee was installing roofing materials when he lost his footing, tripped, and fell onto an asphalt buggy. He was hospitalized with burns to his arm.
An employee was removing a tree limb with a chainsaw when the chainsaw kicked up and cut his left arm, requiring surgery
An employee's left foot was caught between the forklift he was operating and a pole, requiring surgery.
On March 9, 2016, around 2:00 p.m., an employee slipped and fell on grease in the kitchen, breaking her left wrist. She was hospitalized.

An employee was using a riveting machine to rivet a part. As she was removing the part, it became caught on the riveting detail for the pneumatic device. Her finger was then caught in the point of operation when the machine was activated by the foot pedal, partially amputating her right thumb.
On 3/9/16, at approximately 5:15 PM, an employee in the back of the shop was injured after falling from an unknown height. He was hospitalized overnight for treatment of his injuries.
While grinding on a disc sander, an employee's finger became lodged between the platform and the sander, amputating the distal tip of his right thumb.
An employee engaged in wood-framing activities fell 13 feet to the ground, suffering multiple fractures. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time.
While driving to a patient's house during a storm, an employee exited their car and was swept away by rushing creek water. The employee suffered hypothermia from the cold water.
An employee was operating a riding pallet jack when she fell and hit her head on the concrete warehouse floor, suffering a concussion.

Employees were unplugging a slurry strainer that was plugged with corn mash. They shut the slurry strainer down and took it offline to be cleaned and unplugged. When the machine was cleaned and put back online, a drain valve was not closed. Pressure forced the hose/pipes into the air, spraying hot liquid onto the employees. One of the employees suffered second degree burns on his neck, ears, and back, requiring hospitalization. The second employee suffered first degree burns on his cheek and ears, but was not hospitalized.

Employees were putting a new tire on a loader/forklift. Two employees were using pry bars to manipulate the split rim in order to get the tire to seal correctly around the rim. The injured employee was manipulating the spare tire. One of the pry bars slipped while the injured employee was positioning the tire, amputating his right ring fingertip.

An employee was on the production floor moving a hot glue cart when the cart began to fall. The employee tried to stop the cart and glue pot from falling, but he fell with it and his hand contacted the melted glue. He suffered third degree burns to his hand.

An employee was removing a spacer from the curing press when a bolt that was holding up the support leg for another piece of equipment (platen) broke. The support leg fell on the employee's right middle finger, smashing it.

While restarting a compressor, an employee noticed the alternator belt was loose. The employee was tightening a bolt when an arc occurred, igniting natural gas vapors in the area and burning the employee's hands and face.

An employee was guiding a metal grating, which was being lifted by an excavator bucket to its final location, when the rigging slipped from the excavator hook. The metal grating then fell, striking the employee in the left leg just below the knee. The impact fractured the employee's tibia and fibula, requiring surgery.
An employee was pulling a pallet of water when she stopped on a ramp with the pallet. The pallet continued to move and rolled onto her leg, fracturing her left foot.
An employee was shot in the ankle while bagging groceries.

On 3/9/16 at 9:30am an employee had serviced the planer, removed his lock, and started the machine.  He observed a piece of wood near the point of operation and reached towards the planer blades to remove the wood and his fingers contacted the rotating planer blades resulting in amputation of part of the right-hand index and middle fingers.
An employee's thumb was partially amputated while performing maintenance on  a primary machine. Four of the employee's fingers were caught in a belt and pulley.
An employee was headed to the lab extruder to run a sample. She was found laying on her back and bleeding. She was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee went into the shed to get a pitching machine when he severely cut his left calf on the sharp edge of a motorized cart. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground from an extension ladder that was 5-feet high when the ladder kicked out from under him. He broke his right foot.

An employee was installing an LED light fixture in the light circuit when he was shocked. He suffered burns to his left and right hands, broken ribs, a head laceration, and a possible fractured rib. The light circuit was not locked out and personal protection equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was working from a mid-stand ladder that was hooked to a cable when the cable broke. The employee fell to the ground and suffered lower vertebrae fractures, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fueling a truck tripped and fell while walking over the elevated fuel hose. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left foot.
An employee was removing rigging grabbers/biters for a wall panel when his finger was grabbed by the equipment, causing a finger injury.
While delivering mail, an employee was chased by two dogs. The employee fell on concrete and received a severe arm fracture.
An employee was placing a piece of waste wood in the compactor and caught a wrist between the wood and the side of the compactor breaking it.
On 3/9/16, at 8:06 p.m., an employee injured his right hand while breaking up a fight between inmates. The employee's hand became caught in an inmate's mouth during the altercation.

An employee was reassembling a bagger head when a metal piece came too close to a metal detector and caused the machine to deactivate. The deactivation caused a valve to close on the employee's left thumb, partially amputating it.
An employee was driving a golf cart that was struck by another vehicle. The employee was thrown from the golf cart over the other vehicle, suffering a head contusion.

Two employees were removing a 4' x 3' part from the welding jig with an overhead hoist.  The part got stuck, then broke loose, and dropped on the employee's right pinky finger. The finger was amputated at first knuckle.
On March 10, 2016, an employee was walking behind a lift truck when the vehicle rolled backward and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured hip.

An employee and coworkers were removing rigging from a steel I-beam. As they were freeing the straps from under the load, one of the straps became caught under the beam. The upward force of the strap caused the beam to tip over, pinning the injured employee's foot underneath it. He was hospitalized with a broken right ankle.

An employee was helping his foreman crank an electrical generator. The generator's pull starter started whipping around and broke off from the motor's plastic cover. As he tried to turn off the kill switch, the pull starter wrapped around his left thumb and amputated it. He was wearing leather gloves at the time of the incident.
On March 10, 2016, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was injured after dropping a wooden board, weighing up to 50 pounds, on his left foot. He was hospitalized when his injury became infected.
An employee was unloading a truck/trailer when the employee fell to the pavement, fracturing the lower left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down a ladder inside a home when his right ear hit a shelf on the wall and started bleeding. He was hospitalized.

An employee was herding cattle from the pens to the kill floor. On the way to the kill floor, the employee tripped and struck his head on the concrete of the pens. As the cattle passed him, one of their hoofs struck him in the ribs. He was hospitalized with broken ribs, a concussion, a broken nose, and a head laceration.

An employee was gathering tree limbs from the ground and feeding them into a chipper. While he was feeding the chipper, a piece of rope was caught in the feeder wheels and wrapped around his right hand, amputating his fingers.

The employee was attempting to push a lawn mower housing into the press area, while pushing a newly pressed lawn mower housing out onto a conveyor. A lift rack that is on a timer rises up to catch the lawn mower housing that has just been pressed.  The employee's left thumb was caught in the rack as it retracted resulting in a crushing injury/amputation to the thumb tip.

An employee climbed a ladder leaning against an energized distribution breaker when a phase-to-phase or phase-to-ground flash occurred while the employee was holding two testing clamps. The employee experienced an electrical burn and was hospitalized.

An employee was working with hot aluminum sulfate. During the reaction portion of the aluminum sulfate process, the agitator was turned on, causing the aluminum to boil too fast and crack the lid over the sulfate. The hot aluminum sulfate spilled onto the employee, causing second degree burns to the foot and the back of the right arm.

An employee dropped an Allen wrench into a molder machine. When he attempted to retrieve the tool, his hand was caught on one of the gears. His right hand was pulled between the gear and the machine, damaging his right thumb and his middle and index fingers. The machine was still running at the time of the incident.
An employee was training a horse with a long line. The horse became spooked, and one of the lines pulled forward and caught the employee's foot, throwing her up in the air and breaking her right hip.

On 3/10/16, at 6:15 a.m., an employee went up a ladder to unlock a hatch and access the roof for work. He unlocked and opened the hatch, saw that the ladder was not extended 3 feet above, and went back down to readjust it. He lost his footing and fell 8 to 10 feet, breaking his left leg and right heel. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a coworker move a catwalk away from a piece of equipment for cleaning purposes. The employee's hands were beneath the catwalk to guide the forks of the forklift under the catwalk when the fork caught his right index finger, partially amputating the tip. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was pinched between a trailer truck and a 40-yard dumpster after the trailer rolled from where it was parked.  He suffered a right thigh laceration and a right shoulder strain.
An employee was walking down stairs and fell down several risers after reaching the second step. The employee suffered a sprained ankle.

The employee was transferring a cardiac patient from his bed onto his wheelchair. As she was transferring him, he made sudden moves, which caused her to do the same. She suffered a hernia in her abdomen and required surgery.
An employee's thumb was pinched when a crimp tool actuated. The accident resulted in the amputation of the employee's thumb tip.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) to move product through the shipping area. The employee's PIT collided with another PIT, and the employee suffered a lacerated and fractured left foot, requiring hospitalization.

A work van and trailer pulled off of the road shoulder to begin working. As workers were removing safety gear and equipment, a northbound vehicle came off the road, beyond the shoulder, and struck the trailer, pushing it into the rear of the van. An employee retrieving equipment at the back of the van was pinned between the trailer and van, suffering a broken right leg and left hand.

An employee was using a straight ladder to clean a horizontal coater. The employee slipped while descending the ladder, falling 6 to 8 feet to the cement floor and fracturing a leg. The employee was hospitalized.
