An employee was operating a straddle carrier when a crane's spreader bar struck the carrier during ship loading operations. The employee was ejected and fell approximately 25 feet, landing on top of a container. The employee suffered a broken right femur that had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was removing sweet potatoes from the oven and received a burn on the right upper arm from spattering grease. The burn became infected and the employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was placing mechanical insulation on a storm drain pipe when the employee fell from a 10-foot fiberglass step ladder to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured left hip socket, concussion, and head laceration.
An employee was hospitalized after sustaining back injuries while lifting a 10-foot ladder.

On March 11, 2016, an employee was changing a lighting ballast on an overhead light when the employee made contact with a fuse holder joining the open electrical circuit. The employee was shocked and fell from the ladder, injuring the right side of the body, the thumb, and a finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell 12 to 15 feet after his scissor lift was knocked over by falling duct work. He suffered a back injury from hitting the ground.
On or about March 11, 2016, an employee was working on a robot gripper when the gripper activated, pinching and partially amputating his left index finger.
On March 11, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after being attacked and bitten on the face by a dog while delivering and/or picking up packages at a residential home.

An employee was operating a reach forklift truck when he struck a steel column while turning. His left foot was pinned between the reach truck and the steel column, and he fractured his lower left leg.
On Friday, March 12, 2016, at midnight, an employee slipped and fell on the wet processing floor by the washing area, suffering a fractured hip.

While performing a troubleshooting task on a folding ladder, an employee braced one foot on the kettle lid. The lid slipped off and fell inside the kettle, which was full of 250-degree melted flakes, causing the employee's leg to fall inside the hot solution. The employee suffered second degree burns to the left foot and lower leg.

On 3/11/2016, at 09:30, an employee was performing a property claim adjustment on a one-story residential home roof. As the employee was exiting the roof, she fell from a ladder to the deck below. She was hospitalized with three broken ribs on the right side.

An employee was standing on the lift gate of a truck, unloading a junk pool heater into a dumpster, when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete below. He suffered head trauma due to head contact with the asphalt.

An employee was working with a brake press, pushing a 1-foot by 5-foot piece of metal up under the hold-down dogs, when the machine cycled. The employee's left index finger was crushed and amputated by the hold-down dogs.
An employee was on top of a running machine, cleaning it with a hose, when his left arm became caught between the wall of the machine and the machine's auger. He suffered bruising to his left arm.
An employee was jogging a packaging machine and feeding film through it when his hand contacted the cutter, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was mounting a tire onto a rim. While setting the tire bead, the bead broke, and the tire and rim were ejected from the machine. The employee was struck by the tire and rim, suffering blunt force trauma to the head.
An employee was carrying a tray of dirty dishes when she slipped and fell backward, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was repairing an overhead light in the emergency room when the cover collapsed on his right thumb. The cover cut through the employee's glove and amputated his right thumb tip.
On March 12, 2016, an employee fell from the third step of a 6-foot fiberglass step ladder when his boot became hung up. He broke his left hip and required surgery.

An employee was attempting to align the conveyor belt when his right thumb was caught between the rollers, amputating the thumb below the fingernail. The belt was in motion at the time of the incident.
An employee was running a crimper on the 40 mm line when her right thumb and index finger were crushed by the machine. Her thumb and index finger were surgically amputated.

An employee was slicing meat using a band saw when the movable platform on which the meat was placed stalled.  With his right hand on top of the meat, the employee used his right side hip to apply more force on the moving platform to push the meat toward the operating band saw. He was wearing cotton gloves at the time of the incident. The right-hand cotton glove became caught between the meat and the band saw, which consequently dragged his right ring finger toward the point of operation. His finger was amputated.
An employee was moving a pallet with a pallet jack when he fell from the platform of the semi-trailer he was unloading. He fell head-first to the ground, suffering a head injury.

On or about March 12, 2016, at approximately 2:00 AM, an employee was working on the assembly line, attempting to stow a steering hose, when her hand was caught between machine components. Her ring finger was amputated at the distal tip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing cable when a piece of the metal strains went into his finger. His finger became swollen, and he was hospitalized with an infection.
An employee was closing the tailgate to a pickup truck when his left pinky finger was caught and crushed between the tailgate and the bed of the truck.
While performing a maintenance task on a mold tilting device, an employee's hand was caught in the device, causing muscle damage that required surgery.

An employee was changing a battery and removed the battery plate. As the employee was replacing the plate, it became stuck. The employee tried to unjam the plate; in the process, the plate fell on the left middle finger, amputating the tip.
An employee fractured her hip after tripping over a pedestal fan cord.
An employee fell and broke her hip while walking to her car in the parking lot.
An employee was loading baggage into a tractor's passenger side when the tractor operator began to drive and ran over the employee's foot, injuring her right ankle.

On March 13, 2016, an employee was putting a belt (48" wide by 17' long) on the screener.  The employee was on a ladder three rungs up. When he attempted to pull on the belt, the ladder went out from underneath him and he fell to the floor. He suffered a compression fracture to his lumbar vertebra.

An employee was attempting to fix a registration issue on a machine's fill and seal line. As he went to remove a cover off the stretch cylinder, the machine cycled. His left middle finger was crushed between the machine's collar and the stretching cylinder, amputating his left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a reach truck to move freight through the aisles when his foot became pinned between a rack and the truck. He was hospitalized with a foot injury.
An employee was cutting meat with a vertical band saw when he cut his middle finger.
On or about March 13, 2016, an employee's leg was crushed between a tugger unit and a stationary transformer unit, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was preparing a dog for a bath and nail trimming. As the dog was attached to the groomer's helper, it became violent. The dog did a barrel roll and proceeded to bite the employee's hand as it tried to escape from the groomer's helper.

An employee was operating a CNC machine when his sleeve was caught in either the tool or the part, pulling him into the rotating spindle of the machine. He suffered left arm damage that required surgery.
An employee was removing boxes from the stack-off conveyer when his glove became caught in a knuckle chain. His right finger was partially amputated.

An employee was using an oxygen and acetylene torch set to heat up the rollers on the excavator in order to change the tracks out on the equipment. While heating the rollers with the torch, the oil inside the rollers was heated. The pressure from the rollers and heat caused the heated oil to splash on the employee's face, causing second degree burns.

An employee amputated the fleshy part of a finger when an automatic feeder malfunctioned.
An employee was cleaning gutters on a residential roof. The employee fell 20 feet off the roof while pulling on a hose that was stuck, dislocating a shoulder and requiring stitches.
An employee was working in an excavation when he was hit by a front loader on both ankles. Both ankles fractured and required hospitalization.
An employee was running to help a coworker when he tripped and fell to the cement on his knees, fracturing both kneecaps.
An employee was moving a 20lb. bucket of scaffolding parts off of a dolly and strained his back.
While driving a forklift in the parking lot, an employee hit a pothole and suffered a concussion that required hospitalization.
While aligning a bag on the sample machine, an employee suffered three right-hand fingertip amputations.

An employee was working from a ladder, installing cable lines to the eave of a roof over a driveway, when he fell off the ladder. He injured his head, pelvis, rib, and arm on his left side and was hospitalized.

An employee was hanging an oil drip pan on one of the gear boxes next to the conveyor when his glove became caught on the conveyor roller. His right hand was pulled under the belt toward the drive motor, resulting in a deep laceration.

The employee's right hand broke while trying to brace for the fall.

Workers were testing the rotation on a motor when a shaft cover on the machine became dislodged and hit a nearby employee in the left lower leg. The resulting impact fractured the employee's tibia and fibula, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was trimming a tree on the property of the company when a tree limb fell on him. He then fell 10 feet and fractured his right shoulder and foot.
An employee was walking across a freshly mopped floor when she slipped and fell, fracturing her ankle.
While an employee was completing the batch drop process, a fire flash occurred, burning his right hand and face.
An employee slipped and fell on a curb, fracturing his kneecap.

An employee was up on the deck of the plasma cutter to operate the panel control box when he tripped falling forward onto the surface of the plasma table. He tried to break his fall with his right hand and broke his right wrist.
An employee was washing the inside hood of a transformer. As he was closing the hood, his hand slipped off and the hood came down and smashed his left middle finger. His fingertip was amputated.
On March 14, 2016, an employee fell approximately 5 to 6 feet from a baker's scaffold while working on crown molding, breaking his right wrist, fracturing his hip, and fracturing his vertebrae.

An employee was operating a golf cart. The cart flipped on its side when the rear wheel made contact with a parking lot's raised curb. The employee's right ankle was pinned between the cart and the pavement, causing the ankle to break.
An employee tripped over a small lip in the floor and fractured his humerus after striking the ground.

An employee was removing the nails securing two scaffolding planks together. A coworker had removed the support beam beneath the scaffold platform. The employee suffered a broken right upper arm, broken cheek bones, and a broken nose.

Two employees were cleaning a 30-foot tube with a chemical mixture of hydrochloric and nitric acids inside. The tubing became over-pressurized and the end cap dislodged, spraying the mixture onto the employees. They were both hospitalized with chemical burns.
An employee stepped on a sensor pin which resulted in the amputation of her 5 right toes.
An employee was attempting to push down on the anvil in a T-nut machine when his right index finger became trapped in the machine. His finger was partially amputated.
An employee was hospitalized with an infection after a piece of metal became stuck in his right hand while he was moving a metal table.
An employee was cleaning around a machine when his cleaning rag and finger were pulled into the machine. His finger was amputated. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
While climbing down a ladder, an employee was struck by a fan blade, suffering facial and forehead lacerations.
An employee tripped and fell while walking down an internal staircase resulting in a broken leg and in-patient hospitalization.

An employee was connecting steam lines to an icing bowl when her right forearm was caught and crushed between the lifting arm and the icing bowl. After delivering material to a site, an employee stood on top of the DOT bar to close his tractor-trailer's rear door. He slipped, and the door hit his left arm, causing a fracture and 1-inch laceration.
An employee was removing debris from an air compressor when his hand contacted the compressor's rotating fan, fracturing and lacerating three fingers and amputating one finger.

On 3/15/16, at 8:18 AM, an employee was operating a dock stacker when his thumb became pinched between the stacker and a bollard while leaving the staging area for automation. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for crushing injuries to his thumb.
An employee was placing a core into the core chuck machine when the cylinder actuated while his finger was in the hazard area. His right ring finger was pinched and partially amputated.

An employee was moving a mobile piece of equipment when the caster wheel rolled over his left foot, crushing/amputating half of his little toe.
An employee dislocated her pelvis while opening a wooden office door on March 15, 2016, at 9:00 AM.

On or about March 15, 2016, an employee was climbing a ladder attached to a trailer to disconnect a hose when he fell to the ground, suffering cuts, bruises, and injuries to his head, as well as a concussion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hand tool (4- to 5-feet-long stainless steel rod with a two-pronged end) to pull meat out of a dump hoist vat and into a hopper. An employee was bitten by a snake while working on an open box to operate the valve.

An employee was operating a 75-ton die cutter and was having problems with the sensor position device. While he was attempting to adjust the sensor, his left index finger was crushed by the machine. The die cutter was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was loading hogs onto a trailer when two hogs darted out and pushed a gate into the employee. He fell and struck his head, suffering a 2- to 3-inch head laceration and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a steel beam and pinned between the beam and a wall. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised abdomen.

An employee was removing a snake from the spa pool area while standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder. The snake lunged at the employee and startled him. He attempted to step down on the ladder and missed a rung. He fell to the ground and suffered a compound fracture to the left ankle.

An employee was cutting egg crates using a band saw. While attempting to remove a small scrap from the cutting area, she swept her hand backward into the saw blade, partially amputating her left middle finger at the second knuckle.

An employee was setting floor trusses using a ladder when he fell from the ladder and broke his ribs.

During a sales blitz activity, an employee participated in one of the 'minute to win it' games. An employee suffered a finger amputation.
An employee was using a band saw to cut down sirloin steaks when his hands came in contact with the saw blade, amputating his left thumb tip.

An employee was walking through the store to hand out food samples and had turned around to talk to a coworker. When she turned back around to continue on her way, she ran into a pole. She fell down and struck the back of her head, requiring hospitalization for concussion symptoms.
While looking for a tool, an employee tripped and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was removing a lineup clamp from a piece of pipe when his finger was caught between the turtle clamp and a metal ring. The tip of his right middle finger was amputated.

An employee was exiting the trailer of his 18-wheeler when he tripped and fell approximately 4 feet to the paved ground below, breaking his left hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to adjust equipment. She tripped as she was walking around the equipment. When she reached out to catch her fall, her right hand entered the point of operation. An employee was standing next to the bandsaw operator when he contacted the moving bandsaw blade, amputating four right-hand fingers down to the knuckle.
An employee fell off a roof that was 10 feet high and fractured both wrists.

An employee was struck by a passenger automobile while performing road construction activities. The employee suffered leg and face injuries, including lacerations, crushing injuries, and bruised bones.

An employee was climbing back into his truck when he lost his footing and fell backward, rupturing his eardrum and severely injuring his left ribs, shoulder blade, clavicle, and hand. The area was experiencing a snowstorm at the time.

An employee was laying brick from a scaffold. The employee stepped off the end of the scaffold and fell to the ground, breaking a wrist and requiring  surgery.

An employee was changing hose reels at the Cover Extruder machine when his right thumb was caught in the Kevlar string used to splice two sections of rubber hose, amputating it above the first knuckle. He required surgery.
An employee was opening and closing the doors of vehicles when her right index finger was smashed by a door. Her fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee lost grip of the grab bar while entering the cab of a truck and fell to the asphalt pavement. The employee suffered a hairline fracture in the right hip and multiple left wrist fractures.
An employee slipped and fell while getting out of a vehicle, suffering a bruised spleen.

A dozer backed over an employee while he was setting up survey points, breaking his left leg.
An employee sitting at a desk was hospitalized after being bitten by a spider.

An employee was inspecting demolition work that was completed at the end of the day when he was struck by a piece of structural steel, lacerating and crushing a toe on his right foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was going to the break room, caught her foot on the door jamb, and fell breaking a hip.
Employees were in a fist fight when one employee fell and hit his head on the ground, suffering a minor concussion.

An employee was hospitalized with a head laceration after falling to the floor in the workplace.

An employee fell from a ladder while working on some pipes in the ceiling and bumped his head. He was hospitalized overnight with lacerations and a contusion.
On March 17, 2016, an employee suffered a compound fracture of the right arm while cleaning a conveyor belt.

An employee was riding on the side of a forklift when he was struck by a second forklift, crushing his left foot.
An employee was emptying trash into the dumpster when their finger got caught between the dumpster and the hand rail resulting in amputation of the left ring finger.

An employee was driving a forklift, traveling to his next pick-up, when the road embankment gave way beneath his tires and caused the forklift to turn over. He broke nine ribs, punctured a lung, and lacerated his forehead and right elbow.

An employee was connecting the air hose to the saw. The saw was on and amputated fingers on the employee's left hand.

An employee was working on a machine with a pry bar when the bar slipped, causing him to lose his balance and step backward into a sub-pump hole filled with hot water. The employee sustained 2nd degree burns to his left leg and was hospitalized on March 18, 2016.

An employee skiing downhill fell and broke a forearm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had replaced a clutch in a drive belt when he tripped on the concrete base and struck his left hand on the unit frame. His fingertip and a small amount of bone were amputated.
An employee was working on a roof and fell on the same level striking his back on the standing seam roof deck resulting in a back fracture.

At 7:50 a.m., on 3/18/16, an employee was skiing to his lift assignment for the day. As he was approaching the bottom of the chairlift, he hit a rock underneath the snow, which caused him to fall. He was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
An employee was walking around a coworker in the kitchen area when she tripped and fell, injuring her right groin area.

On March 18, 2016, at approximately 6:15 a.m., an employee was operating a stand-up forklift and traveling toward the battery changing area when his left hand made contact with the overhead racking system, amputating his left pinky finger near the knuckle.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when the right front tire hit a pot hole, causing the truck to tilt over. The protective cage fell on and injured the employee, who required hospitalization.
An employee was working at a conveyor belt when his left hand became stuck between the conveyor belt and the guard, lacerating four fingers and amputating the ring fingertip.

An employee was draining a chiller while standing on a platform to push back poultry. The paddle of the chiller struck the employee's elbow and pushed it into a guard, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee walked outside to get the client's newspaper and slipped in the client's garage. She fell and hit her face on the tracks of the garage door, suffering a nasal septal fracture and upper lip lacerations.

While loading an electric pallet jack onto the back of a trailer, an employee slipped and fell approximately 4 feet off the lift gate and onto the parking lot asphalt, fracturing a bone in the elbow area.

An employee was retrieving merchandise from an elevation using an order picker when a second order picker struck his and caused him to fall to the ground below. He suffered a broken pelvis/hip.

An employee was performing sanitation work when he entered the picking room.  There was fog in the room. An employee walking beside an excavator slipped or stumbled on the dirt track from the excavator, lacerating the left leg.

An employee was bringing product to the back of a truck trailer when a book case began falling. He fell as he tried to catch the falling case. His foot was caught in the truck ramp and he twisted his ankle, breaking it.
An employee was moving boxes when he started having chest pain. He was hospitalized with a musculoskeletal chest injury sustained while moving the boxes.
An employee's hand was resting on a part that then moved into machine rollers. His right index finger was amputated.

An employee descending a staircase tripped and fell approximately 5 steps, landing on her left side and suffering a head injury and fractures.
An employee was power washing exterior windows when the end of the washer tip went across his left hand, lacerating it and requiring surgery to repair a damaged tendon.

An employee was operating an up-cut saw. As he was putting a piece of wood in the saw, his left foot stepped on the foot pedal and cycled the machine. The saw blade amputated his right ring fingertip.

An employee and his coworker were holding a 3-feet-long pipe that was 4 inches in diameter and approximately 30 pounds to move it inside a ship. As they set the pipe inside the boat, the employee felt a pull in his groin. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was feeding material into the moulder during the setup process. The employee fed a thin piece of material into the moulder and then thought it was jammed in the machine. An employee fell off the ladder while cleaning the ceiling vent.
An employee was operating the carbon fiber spinning machine and cleaning out the valve. A finger got pinched when the valve closed resulting in the amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was lifting the end section of pipe to help clear an I-beam of a pipe rack. As the crew moved the pipe forward, the employee's left thumb was caught and amputated between the pipe and an I-beam support member.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam at the rotary airlock discharge when the airlock rotated and amputated his fingertip.

An employee conducting maintenance work was caught in the sprocket of a moving conveyor and fractured bones in his left wrist.
An employee injured his left-hand finger while changing the tire on a rim.
An employee fell off a 12-foot ladder and was hospitalized with multiple fractured ribs.

An employee was cutting an overhead steel member with a cutting torch when molten slag fell onto his clothing and ignited it. He suffered 1st and 2nd degree burns to his back and additional burns on his hand.
An employee was checking an air blower to determine if it was operational when the force of the intake pulled his hand into the fan blade, amputating approximately half of his left pinky finger.

An employee was installing metal decking when he fell while trying to grab a piece of sheet metal that was elevated by a forklift. He fell approximately 15 feet to a dirt surface and was hospitalized with head and neck trauma.
An employee was trimming tree limbs when he was struck by a truck driven by a patron. He suffered right leg and head/brain trauma, requiring surgery.
An employee was unloading students from a chair lift when one of the students skied over the employee's skis, causing him to fall and fracture his hip.
An employee was inspecting a customer's vehicle in the parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell, breaking his leg.
While standing in a squatting position, an employee stepped backwards, tripped over a pallet, and landed on his left backside, fracturing his left hip and requiring surgery.
An employee walking between buildings slipped on the damp floors and fell. She broke a bone in her elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting up a metal floor plate to access the switch to reset the escalator. The metal plate fell on his hand, amputating the top third of his finger.
While cutting chicken wings into segments using a back saw, an employee amputated the distal segment of the left-hand thumb.

An employee and a coworker were trying to introduce air into a condensate line to empty it. When the employee went to remove a plug from a valve on the condensate line, hot water splashed onto his left shoulder, arm, and back, causing second degree burns.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when her finger became pinned between the handle of the pallet jack and a pallet that was behind her. Her right little finger was amputated at the top joint.

An employee was loading the zinc tank from the vacuum truck. The truck hose recoiled, struck the employee's respirator, and splashed chemical onto the employee's face.

An employee was attempting to pull a mattress off a third-tier rack shelf when he fell to the concrete floor, suffering head trauma and loss of feeling. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a crowbar to straighten a part when the crowbar slipped and the employee lost her balance. She fell backwards and hit her head on the base of a heat treat rack that was positioned behind her. The employee fractured her skull and injured her neck.
An employee cutting trees was struck by a nearby tree. The employee sustained a broken left arm between the wrist and the elbow and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee who had been repairing equipment was found convulsing on the floor while holding an electrical cord. The employee suffered electrical burns.
An employee injured his foot and leg while inspecting a semi-truck in an icy parking lot.

An employee was using a slitter to cut corrugated cardboard. When he tried to make an adjustment, the input wheel grabbed his glove and pulled his finger in, causing the slitter to crush his finger. His right ring finger was amputated.
An employee snowboarding down an intermediate run caught an edge and struck a tree, suffering a lung contusion.
An employee was installing an eave on a manufactured home using a pneumatic staple gun when the gun discharged a staple into his left kneecap.
An employee in a bucket truck was dismantling powerlines when he was electric shocked, suffering burns to both hands. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was hospitalized for breathing problems potentially associated with dust from construction activities.

An employee was sitting in a chair near the baggage conveyor belt. At the same time, a tug that was towing three baggage carts was making a turn around the baggage belt. During this turn, the last cart struck a concrete bollard and overturned. The overturned cart struck the employee, who suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was standing to the side of a load of wood being put in the kiln. The load shifted and fell on his right leg and foot, fracturing them.
An employee was operating a lathe when his arm became stuck in the machine. He was hospitalized with a possible amputation.

An employee was lifting an 8" pipe to place it on a pickup truck when the pipe slipped out of his hand and fell on his right index finger. The pipe severed his index fingertip, which had to be surgically amputated.
On 3/22/16, at 5:15 PM, an employee was walking down the indoor employee entrance stairs when she fell and broke her left arm and leg.
A load of steel in a 3x16 foot crate shifted while it was being strapped/secured to a truck, landing on and breaking an employee's ankle.

An employee was neutralizing an empty railcar that had carried sodium hydroxide. While the employee was cleaning the tank, sodium hydroxide splashed on his face and arm, causing 2nd degree chemical burns.

An employee was pouring cement from a truck when he noticed a hard piece of cement on the conveyor belt. When he attempted to remove the cement, the belt lacerated and broke several of his right-hand fingers.
An employee fell to the floor while passing out medications and suffered a right arm fracture.
While walking down a driveway, an employee slipped on loose gravel, fell to the ground, and fractured a hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a step and fell forward. When he fell, his left hand entered tar and received burns.

An employee was ascending a 32-foot ladder to deliver roofing supplies at a two-story home. Once he stepped off of the ladder onto the leading edge of the roof, his foot gave out, and he fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a left tibia fracture.

An employee was troubleshooting the CNC line glue spreader and was attempting to push and pull a board through the spreader. When the employee pulled the wood through, the wood came down and crushed his finger, which was on a guide, between the guide and wood. His right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee had just checked an air compressor that was mounted to the back of a pick-up truck. He slipped while exiting the back of the truck bed and fell approximately 3 feet, injuring his right hip.

An employee had been working on a 12- to 14-feet-high roof and was descending an extension ladder. The ladder was tied off and extended 3 feet above the roof at the time. The ladder slipped out from underneath the employee when he was at the top, and he fell 12 to 14 feet, suffering a hairline fracture of the pelvis and a broken pinky finger.

An employee was struck by a privately operated vehicle while standing to the side of a waste management truck. The employee was collecting trash from curbsides at the time. He suffered a broken leg, kidney bruising, and internal bleeding/bruising.

An employee was showing a second employee how to install a drive shaft onto a rotor plate. The drive shaft had to be aligned and seated onto the rotor plate by using a leather mallet and striking the drive shaft repeatedly. While attempting to stabilize the drive shaft, the second employee placed his index finger on the end of the shaft. The first employee struck the second employee's finger against the drive shaft with the leather mallet, crushing his left index finger, which had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was performing maintenance on a horizontal grinder and had the guard in an upright position to access the work area. A strong gust of wind displaced the guard and it fell on the employee's head, resulting in torn neck ligaments. The employee was wearing a hard hat at the time of the incident.
An employee sustained left chest trauma when a sand blaster he was operating shot steel pellets under his left armpit.

An employee was injured while walking through a non-tempered, automatic glass entrance door. The employee suffered cuts to the left leg, face, and right hand and required surgery to repair a leg muscle.
An employee was keeping boxes from falling in front of the Bobcat truck. The Bobcat truck ran over the employee's left foot crushing it.
An employee's right ring fingertip was amputated when a delivery truck's sliding door closed on it.

An employee exited the building to go to the back patio and the door locked behind him. To re-enter the building, he attempted to climb a security fence. The employee became caught up in the fence's barbed wire and fell to the ground, landing on his back and right side. He was hospitalized with three broken ribs, a bruised lung, and lacerations and scratches.

An employee was operating a pallet jack when another forklift operator hit the forks of a third lift, which was holding a stack of empty pallets. A plastic pallet came loose, fell, and struck the employee in the face, fracturing his nose and causing a possible concussion.
An employee suffered a left leg injury while exiting a stand-up reach truck, requiring hospitalization.
The employee was getting product from the machine and contacted the machine blade resulting in lacerations.
An employee was conducting an occupational therapy activity with a patient when the patient's dog bit the employee, lacerating her lip and cheek.

An employee was attempting to remove a cardboard corner post on a pallet. He was using his right leg as leverage on the pallet. As he was bending the corner post, it released, and the pallet slipped out from under his foot. He fell back onto the concrete floor, breaking his left hip bone.
An employee was working on the roof. He lifted up a wooden hole cover and stepped forward into a roof hole, falling 15 feet to the concrete floor below. He fractured his elbow, vertebra, and pelvis.

On or about 3/23/2016, at approximately 9:30, an employee was working from a 15-foot fiberglass extension ladder to install satellite TV cable at a residential home. The employee was drilling holes to install clips that hold the cable to the side of the building. While working from the ladder, the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the concrete below, suffering injuries to both legs/feet that required hospitalization.
On March 23, 2016, around 6:30 a.m., an employee slipped and fell while entering a building, breaking her ankle.

While installing vinyl siding on a roof, an employee fell approximately 8 feet to the lower ground level, sustaining compound fractures to the right leg, tibia, and fibula. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee amputated two fingers while a cleaning a mixer.

An employee was using a motorized pallet jack to move cardboard recycling bins. While the employee was steering, the jack became stuck and pinned the employee's ankle to the storage racks. The employee suffered a broken tibia/fibula.
An employee was feeding lumber into a planer when a piece jammed. When he attempted to clear the jam, his right little finger was lacerated. The finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was attacked while on duty. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

On or about 3/23/2016, an employee was unloading a truck when a coworker operating a PIV backed into him, pinning him between the PIV and another PIV. He suffered a crushing injury to the left knee and leg.
While operating a brake press, an employee amputated four right-hand fingers when the foot pedal activated during a change over.

An employee was opening/unfolding a wheelchair by pressing down on the sides of the seat when her finger went between the base and bracket of the wheelchair. When she pulled her finger out, her fingertip was amputated.
An employee was putting snow chains on his tires. While he was tightening the chain cam, his right middle finger became stuck under the tire chain and his fingertip was amputated.

An employee was conducting a fire wall inspection while working from a ladder. While descending the ladder, the employee lost their footing and fell against an adjacent countertop and then to the floor, breaking ribs.

On March 23, 2016, at approximately 1:30 a.m., an employee was cleaning out a vertical blender. When she opened a 10-inch x 10-inch door on the side of the blender, her right hand was caught between the side of the blender and the moving auger, amputating four fingers. The machine was energized at the time of the incident.

An employee was hooking chains between a yard dog and a transport truck that was stuck in the parking lot. The yard dog driver exited the vehicle without parking it to help the injured employee unhook the vehicle. The yard dog rolled back and pinned the injured employee between the truck and yard dog, fracturing the employee's ankle and heel bone.
While loading friction paper into a laminator, an employee's left hand became caught between platens, lacerating the third and fourth fingers. The fourth finger had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was taking batteries from a conveyor belt and placing them on the lift table for shipping. The employee stepped backward, tripped on the anti-fatigue mat, and fell to the floor, suffering a right hip injury.

On or about 03/23/2016, at 9:00 AM, an employee fell from the cargo area of a pickup truck when the truck starting moving forward. The employee had been setting up signs to prepare a road lane closure. During the fall, he hit his head and lacerated his left arm.
On or about 3/24/2016, an employee's finger was amputated while feeding a thermal former machine.

An employee was unloading a pallet of pavers from a semi-truck with a tractor. The pallet of pavers shifted forward and fell off the tractor, causing it to jerk backward. The jerking of the tractor caused the neck of the employee to whip back, fracturing his C5 vertebrae. He experienced numbness in both arms and was hospitalized.

An employee on a ladder was caulking underneath eaves when the ladder slipped and the employee fell. The employee was approximately 12 to 14 feet from the lower level at the time.  The employee was hospitalized with a partially collapsed lung and fractured wrist.
On or about 3/24/16, an employee slipped/tripped while stepping over a 2-foot-high masonry wall.  He was hospitalized with three fractured ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was changing the air line on a three-station pneumatic press. Her finger was in a porthole on the equipment when she connected the air line to the machine. The air caused a piston in the machine to be actuated while her finger was in the hole, amputating her right pinky finger between the first and second knuckle.
An employee was wrapping some windows on a stretch wrapper machine when the windows fell over onto his right arm/shoulder. He was hospitalized.

A front-end loader bucket on an articulated wheel loader was transferring tools to another part of the work site. The operator of the wheel loader inadvertently released the end loader, which fell on top of and broke an employee's left foot. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee operating a reach truck collided with a stand-up fork truck, suffering a left foot injury.

An employee was pressure washing the pool when he ran out of gasoline. While he was adding gasoline to the pressure washer, it ignited, causing first and second degree burns to 50 percent of the employee's body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a tractor that was connected to a feed wagon. He went over a bump that caused the drawbar mechanism to break. In turn, the cables connected to the hydraulics became dislodged, and the lever hit him on the top of the nose/center forehead. He suffered a small laceration that required stitches.
On 3/24/16, at around 2:00 PM, an employee amputated an index fingertip while operating a punch press with pull-back devices.
An employee was working inside a meat freezer when he struck his head. He was hospitalized with internal bleeding.

An employee was working on a brake assembly by installing a pin into the manual brake lever, from the bottom side underneath the railcar, when a fellow employee performed a brake test. The employee's finger was caught in the manual brake assembly resulting in injury and possible amputation.
While retrieving something from a toolbox in the bed of a pickup, an employee slipped and broke a leg.
On March 24, 2016, an employee was helping a warehouse worker pull an order when a stack of insulation products fell and struck the employee, fracturing the left fibula.
An employee slipped in the icy parking lot while walking into work. She was hospitalized with an ankle tendon tear.
An employee's foot hit the down button on a scissor lift table, causing the lift to break the employee's left femur.
An employee was repairing a leak on a roof when he fell 45 feet to the ground, injuring his torso and pelvis and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was pulling a crate of produce out of a truck using a manual pallet jack when he lost his grip and fell backward, striking the floor of the truck and injuring the back of his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning up an area by sweeping and removing sand from the summit when the machine cycled, pinning his left hand between the summit and the transfer car he was using to put the sand in. He suffered multiple fractures and lacerations to his left-hand thumb, ring, and pinky fingers. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking to the grossing station in the laboratory when she slipped and fell, fracturing her left leg. She required surgery.

An employee was changing the light bulb beneath the diving board in a drained swimming pool. The employee then slipped along the sloping wall and fell onto a cinder block located on the bottom of the pool, suffering a possible broken hip.
While cutting aluminum on a saw, an employee sustained a right middle finger amputation.

An employee was trying to cage a brake chamber with a caging bolt. The caging bolt was too short, so the employee applied shop air to the chamber to connect the bolt. As the employee was installing a fitting on the chamber to connect it to the air hose coupling, the employee's left middle finger was caught and crushed between the chamber and bolt washer.
The employee was over head structure welding from a scissor lift at the height of approximately 18 feet. His head became caught between the scissor lift railing and the structure.
An employee was flung from a man lift and suffered a concussion. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were moving a welding positioner into place using an overhead crane. One was handling the base of the positioner as the other was operating the crane. The employee with his hands near the base moved his hand under the positioner as it was lowered, and his left index finger was smashed and partially amputated between the base and the ground.
An employee was putting parts on the trolley conveyor in the sequencing area when his fingers were caught in a chain and sprocket, amputating his right ring and pinky fingers at the second knuckle.

An employee was stepping off an A-frame type ladder. As he placed his weight on his back foot, he slipped and lost his balance. He fell backward and landed on top of an elevated welded pipe gas line, breaking three ribs and suffering a slightly collapsed lung on his right side.
An employee was working on a skid steer with the unsecured cab tilted back. While he was working, the cab fell onto the employee resulting in broken ribs and vertebrae.

The injured employee was lifting an oversized package that weighed approximately 98 lbs. with another employee. When the employee lowered the package his finger was severed by a piece of metal on the package.

An employee was webbing the paper through the printing press perf and anvil cylinder.  The employee indexed the cylinders while holding the lead edge of the paper in the gap which drew the finger in, pinching it between two cylinders.  The employee's right index finger was amputated.

An employee was manually feeding 2x4 wood members into a saw when wood cutoffs began interfering with the machine's operation. While attempting to rearrange the wood cutoff debris, his left hand contacted the rotating 10-inch sawblade, amputating one finger and injuring two others.

An employee was helping to move a generator with fold-out handles off the back of a truck. His index finger was caught in the pinch point between the handle and frame of the generator, amputating the distal end of his finger. He was wearing gloves at the time.

An employee was clearing the inside of a vacuum hose of accumulated debris that was interfering with the suction force. Once the employee cleared the vacuum hose, the suction force grasped the employee's right arm. The employee's right arm and hand were injured.
An employee was opening small packages with scissors when her left index fingertip was amputated (no bone loss).
An employee fell and was injured while performing work.

An employee was performing maintenance on a CNC waterjet cutting machine by replacing the high pressure line. When he was testing the pressurized line, the fitting failed or broke causing the water to be released at a very high rate. It struck the employee in the chest and exited his back. The employee was standing approximately 15 ft. away from the machine.

An employee was riding a pallet jack from a chill area to a dry area and was waiting for others to pass through the doorway area. 
The automatic door cycled and came down on the employee, breaking his arm.
An employee was attempting to remove material out of a saw when the sawblade cut the employee's pinky and ring fingers.
A piece of metal framing fell off a cart and struck an employee in the face.

An employee got out of an elevated bucket to perform work (he was wearing a fall protection arrest system). When the employee got back into the bucket, he put his hand on the top railing of the bucket. When all of his weight transferred into the bucket, the bucket bounced a bit and his left ring finger was pinched between the railing and the wire tray of the bucket, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was hooking up a trailer to a customer vehicle. The employee tried to step over the tongue of the trailer and tripped, landing on his left side and fracturing his left hip.
An employee had just finished loading his trailer. While closing the rear trailer door, his finger was caught between the door panels, amputating his right index fingertip.
While core drilling on a second floor balcony, an employee was struck by the drill and fell 12 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering broken arms.
An employee stepped out the passenger side of a garbage truck and slipped and fell on the wet brick road. He fractured his right foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a fiberglass ring on a 70'' (5ft 8.33in) platform ladder with a coworker on a fixed ladder. The platform ladder tipped over, and the employee fell and broke his right femur.
An employee was operating an asphalt machine when the machine caught fire. He attempted to turn it off and received burns on his face and arms.

On March 25, 2016, an employee was moving a casting with a magnet when the magnet was turned off and the casting fell onto the employee's right foot resulting in amputation of the toes on the right foot.

An employee was making her rounds and slipped and fell on the floor. The employee was admitted to the hospital for treatment. The employee sustained multiple injuries including a bruised left knee, a hairline fracture to the right knee, a displaced fracture to the left rib, a fracture to the left wrist and an impact fracture to the neck and left shoulder.

On 03/26/2016, at 6:00 p.m., an employee exited a semi-truck and trailer and was providing backing directions to a driver who was reversing a second semi-truck and trailer. The driver did not see the stop signal and continued backing the truck into the injured employee's truck and trailer. The employee's right arm was caught between the two trailers. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right arm.

An employee was installing siding on a house and stepped from one side of a scaffold to the edge of a 2 x 12 platform on another scaffold. He lost his balance and fell on his back, and the platform then landed on his face. He suffered a laceration above his left eyebrow and a back injury.
An employee was changing sandpaper on a buffer machine when his hand slipped and was cut by the machine. He was hospitalized and received stitches.
An employee was stepping over APC units when she tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing her right hip.
While climbing down a ladder, an employee fell, hit his head against the bottom of a shelf, and had a seizure. He suffered a laceration to the back of his head.
An employee was opening a valve to obtain a sample of hot rosin for testing when the rosin splashed toward the right side of his face and ear, causing second degree burns. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on wet grass while delivering a package, breaking her ankle in two places and requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to replace the permeate port on the end-cap of a reverse osmosis vessel. The equipment retained pressure, which caused the end-cap to be forcibly removed. The pressurized end cap struck the employee's right hand against a support member, amputating two fingers.

An aircraft mechanic was working with other mechanics on an MD88 aircraft bin.  The injured employee attempted to use the golf cart to step up into the bin, when his foot slipped and hit the pedal of the electric golf cart causing the golf cart to move forward pinning the employee between the golf cart and the aircraft. The employee suffered two fractured ribs, a fractured T9 vertebrae and had blood in the lungs.

An employee was unloading a trailer. When he reached the dock plate, the wheels of his pallet jack hit the dock plate and became stuck, causing him to fall off the jack to the concrete floor. He suffered a brain injury.
An employee was walking through the parking lot and tripped over a curb at the crosswalk. The employee broke their left arm.
An employee's left index finger was cut when handling a bungee cord. The finger became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee fell out of a tree onto a lower level.

While diagnosing a vacuum system, an employee removed an exhaust filter to access a vacuum port with his right thumb. The ball valve actuated while his thumb was in the port, amputating his thumb tip.
An employee was troubleshooting a broken valve when the valve opened, causing a wrist fracture. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee stepped into an improperly covered hole and fell (approximately 3 feet), breaking his right arm.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a pocket feeder and was manually lifting a section of the machine when it shifted, pinching and partially amputating his right pinky finger between two sections.
An employee was repairing a debarker machine. The arm of the machine was loosened and fell on the employee's hand fracturing a finger and injuring a tendon that required surgery to repair.
An employee partially amputated her middle and ring fingers while operating the CVP bagging machine.
While closing a lift gate on a trailer, an employee's gloved finger was caught between the gate and the trailer doorframe, partially amputating the left middle finger.
An employee's hand was on the edge of a gang box when a coworker closed the box on the employee's finger, partially amputating it.
As an employee climbed a client's rodeo gate inside an arena, the gate collapsed. The employee fell  to the ground, and the gate fell on top of him, breaking his back.

An employee was assembling a fire-rated door. When the employee removed the shipping clamp on the unit, the door opened and hit him in the chin. He fell backward and when he got up, a large amount of blood was oozing out of his mouth. He was hospitalized with a laceration to the chin/mouth.
An employee was changing out the cutter head when the cutter head activated, partially amputating the employee's index finger.
An employee was working in a scissor lift with a grinder. While grinding on the conveyor, the employee lost control of the grinder, which lacerated the employee's right forearm.
An employee's right middle finger was caught by a door that was being repaired. The employee lost part of his fingertip.
An employee was connecting a fifth wheel trailer hitch when the trailer came down and crushed his right thumb. His thumb was partially amputated and required surgery.

On March 28, 2016, an employee felt faint and dizzy and blacked out. When the employee came to, the right ring finger was caught between the conveyor and the guide bar. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

On March 28, 2016, at approximately 11:20 p.m., an employee exited his excavator and peered into the bin where he was placing additives. Wearing metatarsal gloves, the employee placed his left hand on the side of the bin. A piece of metal, used as a trough, was not secure and slid against his hand, amputating his left pinky finger down to the knuckle.
An employee fell 20 feet to the floor while installing audiovisual equipment to structural steel, breaking an arm and elbow.
An employee fell from the roof to the ground while installing rubber membrane roofing, breaking the right hand and fracturing the right hip.
An employee was struck by a passing lift truck while sweeping and cleaning the material handling area, sustaining a fractured right leg.
An employee was hospitalized after falling into a stairwell while installing insulation in a new residential building.
An employee was securing a lift hook to a table on a jib crane when the employee's right thumb tip was crushed/amputated between the hook and lift table.
An employee was dumping product onto the auger that takes meat to the slicing machine. When he reached down, his right index fingertip was amputated by the auger.

An employee was climbing a ladder to gain access to the top of a railcar for inspection. The employee lost their grip and fell to the ground, injuring their back and right hand and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a drill rig and stepped on the flight of an auger to pull the swing radius barricade tape into position. The auger tilted over and hit the employee's hand, which was positioned on the counterweight of the drill rig. The employee's left index finger was lacerated and fractured.

An employee was clearing out residual materials on a screw auger when his finger contacted the screw component that was turning inside the auger, amputating one-third to one-half of his right middle finger and severely cutting his right index fingertip.

An employee was operating a power platform stake bed truck to unload production equipment. The employee's left index finger became caught on the equipment, amputating the fingertip at the first knuckle.

An employee was delivering a caustic truckload at a client's site. The hose was disconnected under residual pressure, and it hit the employee's helmet, displacing the face shield and spilling caustic solution on the face, mouth, and neck areas. The employee suffered chemical burns.
An employee was loading a truck at the dock when an empty metal plant cart fell onto the employee's right leg, breaking the right ankle.
An employee left work and was admitted to the hospital for asthma issues.
An employee was loading the wooden scaffold system into the truck and got a splinter. The employee removed the splinter. The wound became infected and the employee was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was attempting to remove the lock actuating pin and the lock bar shifted severing his left index fingertip.
An employee working on a concrete form slipped and fell on top of a bolt. The employee reinjured a stomach hernia and was hospitalized.
Employees were taking down a scaffold and the scaffold collapsed. An employee suffered a broken left ankle and wrist and a fractured right knee.

Employees were about to take samples of hot sugar cane juice as the machine was processing the sugar cane. An air bubble inside the line caused the line to burp, and 200-degree hot sugar cane juice inside the line splattered onto the employees. 
Two employees sustained first and second degree burns.
An employee fell and hit the left side of his head and face on the concrete floor.

An employee was transporting a sample container containing phenol from a microwave to a lab fume hood. The septum on the cap of the container unexpectedly burst, spraying a mist of the content into the employee's face and causing first degree facial burns. The employee's eyes were protected at the time of the incident.
On or about March 29, 2016, an employee was cutting paper tags with a manual paper/cardboard cutter when the blade came down and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a machine when a finger contacted the belt and pulley resulting in a fingertip amputation with bone loss.

While cleaning a buildup of dough from the conveyor roller, an employee's left hand was caught between the roller and the conveyor belt. The employee sustained left-hand injuries and a left forearm laceration that required surgery.
An employee lost balance and fell sideways to the concrete floor, breaking the left leg.
While scraping out the hopper inside a mixer/dough divider, an employee's left-hand fingertip was caught and amputated by a shear point. The divider was operating at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell while taking inventory.
An employee was diving for 63 minutes at a depth of 37 feet when he felt ill. He surfaced and showed signs of carbon monoxide poisoning from a breathing air compressor.
An employee was pushing one cart and pulling another. The first cart stopped, but the second continued rolling, pinning and breaking the employee's arm.
An employee was walking down a hallway when 1,200 pounds of stacked drywall fell on him and broke his ankle.

An employee was torch cutting anchor bolts from the anchor plate of a stand-alone jib crane. As the employee cut the last of the anchor bolts, the approximately 10-foot-high round column with a 10-foot-long jib fell over onto a second employee standing nearby. The second employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower leg and lacerations to the back, neck, forehead, and leg.
While walking through the parking lot, an employee was struck by a coworker's vehicle, fracturing the employee's right leg.

An employee was building a window, finished her portion of the assembly, and pushed the window down the production line to the next employee. When the next employee pulled the window toward them, it caused the window to close, catching and cutting the first employee's right ring finger in the window.

An employee was packing equipment to move to another jobsite when a pendant, weighing approximately 40 pounds, fell on his hand and crushed his right index fingertip. The finger was medically amputated just below the fingernail.
An employee was helping to work on an electrical panel when the panel arc flashed. The employee suffered burns over 65% of his body and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a knife to make a cut on a chicken when the knife slipped out of his hand. He was stabbed in the stomach while trying to grab the knife, requiring surgery.
An employee was lifting a part with her left hand when the part slipped and struck her right hand, amputating the first right-hand fingertip.
An employee cleaning out roof gutters in an aerial lift contacted the overhead powerlines, receiving second and third degree burns to his hands.
An employee fell 5 to 6 feet from a stepladder while working on a light fixture, suffering a fractured pelvis and head bleeding.

Employees were measuring the receiving dock bay door area for a replacement dock plate. The dock plate springs opened quickly and the dock plate caught the injured employee's fingers in a pinch point between the dock plate and the dock bay door surface resulting in the amputation of the right middle and index fingertips.

An employee was operating the end boring machine, drilling holes for dials. The employee's finger got caught under the clamp when the clamps came down resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee assigned to load trucks and operate stand forklifts suffered a shattered and broken left tibia when he struck a structural beam.
An employee's right hand was amputated while cleaning a meat grinder. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.

At approximately 2:00 p.m., on 3/30/16, an employee was climbing down from a one-story roof using a metal extension ladder. The ladder collapsed, and the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with two cracked right-side ribs and four cracked vertebrae.
An employee was checking the quality of a roll of product with his hand when his hand became caught and his arm was dragged into the roll. His left arm broke and required hospitalization.

An employee heard the cap fall off of a chemical system flow line to a holding tank containing ammonia. The employee went to the area to close the valve and was overcome by ammonia fumes, suffering a respiratory injury.

An employee was looking under a cooling silo when his backside hit a switch that activated the knife gate. The knife gate amputated his left fore fingertip and middle fingertip. The knife gate was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was attempting to set down an excavator attachment that was being lifted with an overhead crane when the attachment came loose and rolled onto the employee's foot, crushing it. The foot had to be amputated.

An employee was walking across a resident's driveway while delivering mail when the resident backed up a vehicle and struck the employee. The employee was knocked unconscious and hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was using a screwdriver to clean the dirt from the nose of the fuse. This caused the fuse to detonate and the back end of the fuse punctured his hand.
An employee slipped and fell from a ladder while handling cattle feed. He broke his arm while attempting to break his fall.

An employee was changing out a mold on a machine when the safety device processor card failed, dropping the mold on the employee's finger. The employee was hospitalized with a broken index finger and hairline fracture to the middle finger, requiring surgery.
An employee was picking up blocks on the ground behind a forklift. The forklift operator struck the employee while backing up. The employee sustained an ankle bone fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a lift with a beam clamp on a beam with a chain attached. The clamp had a hammerlock that connected the chain and beam lock. The employee's left index finger was between the chain and hammerlock when he hoisted the load. His left index finger was pinched and amputated between the hammerlock and chain when the chain tightened.
An employee was using a homogenizer to make emulsified sulfur when the employee's finger was caught between the plunger and cooling line, lacerating the fingertip and requiring sutures.

An employee was setting up a deep hole drilling machine (honing machine) when the oil pressure head disengaged. The head struck the employee's right hand, amputating his right thumb and right index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a steel diamond plate cover off a lagoon pit when the cover slipped out of his hand and fell on his foot. He slipped and fell, breaking his right hip. He was hospitalized.

On March 30, 2016, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was working from a 12-foot fiberglass step ladder, preparing to relocate a 2-inch vent line from a receiver tank. Steam and hot water came out of the vent, causing the employee to lean back, lose balance, and fall to the concrete floor below. The employee suffered a right hip fracture, multiple right rib fractures, and a right forearm laceration, requiring hospitalization. An energy control procedure was not used at the time of the incident.
An employee fractured two fingers on the right hand when his hand was caught between two molds while operating a mold press.

On 3/30/16, at approximately 10:00pm, an employee crushed his left hand index and middle fingers between the dies of a hydraulic brake press while forming a metal part.  The tip of his index finger was medically amputated.

An employee was in the process of loading a gang bar onto a paint rack in the shop using an overhead crane rigged with a magnet. The gang bar was placed on the rack out of position. The employee released the lifting device and attempted to reposition the gang bar without the lifting device. In the process of repositioning the gang bar, one end came out of the rack and fell pinching the employee's fingertip between the gang bar and the rack resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
Two employees were performing maintenance on the Schlatter machine (high speed machine that produces wire shelving). One of the employees suffered the amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee felt severe pain in his left knee while detailing a car.

An employee was releasing a pallet that had become jammed on the infeed.  He lost his balance and fell approximately four feet between the infeed and the outfeed onto a metal support injuring his back.
An employee was repairing equipment. The equipment was not locked out. The reciprocator arm contacted the employee's right arm resulting in a laceration that severed an artery requiring surgery.
An employee tripped over a board left on the floor to cover newly installed tile flooring.  The employee fell and injured their back resulting in hospitalization.

On 03/30/2016, at approximately 9:30am, an employee was standing in a hallway. Another employee was driving a forklift that was carrying a large metal coil weighing 3,265 lbs. The coil slipped off the forklift and fell onto the employee's right foot, crushing it.
An employee was using a drill when the glove was caught in the machine resulting in a pinky finger amputation.
On 3/31/16, an employee walking in the hall stepped in a water puddle and slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her left arm.
An employee was hospitalized after sustaining a shoulder injury.
An employee tripped on a carpet in the hallway and fell, breaking her leg.
An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder installing fire caulking. The employee tried to re-position, lost his balance, and fell. He was hospitalized overnight with a possible broken pelvis.

Two employees had an altercation and one employee struck the other employee with his respirator knocking him out.  The injured employee fell to the ground and was hospitalized with fractures to the forehead, nose, and left wrist.
On March 31, 2016, at 12:00PM, an employee tripped on an electrical extension cord and fell.
On March 31, 2016, an employee experienced the amputation of the left middle fingertip when it was caught between a conveyor belt and a pallet. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
On or about March 31, 2016, at 9:00 a.m., an employee in the meat department suffered a fingertip amputation while cutting meat on a band saw.
An employee was mowing grass. He was startled by lightening and when he dismounted the riding mowing his leg was struck by the mower attachment.

An employee drove a forklift with a bundle of wire (4500 lbs.) on the forks to the door of an intermodal container and parked it. The employee got off the forklift and went inside the intermodal container to adjust dunnage. As the employee was adjusting dunnage the bundle of wire stationed on the forks of the forklift fell and pinned the employee between a wire bundle inside the container and the wire bundle that fell from the forklift. The employee sustained a fractured sternum, a fractured rib, and a fractured right forearm.

Two employees were using a pressure washer (8500 PSI) to remove paint lines from concrete.  One of the employees accidently swept the discharging water across the other employee's foot. The injured employee suffered lacerations, tendon damage, and a chipped bone on the foot.
The employee was placing a concrete blanket over the newly poured concrete. The wind picked up the blanket causing the employee to fall and break his left leg.
An employee was walking and struck a stationary piece of equipment causing her to stumble and twist resulting in a spiral fracture to the left hip.
An employee fell 12 feet off a ladder resulting in a head injury.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from an A frame aluminum ladder while removing gas line pipe or tubing in the middle warehouse. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was standing between the inner core and outer jacket of a precast concrete form. The employee was struck by the outer jacket resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was cleaning oil off the pneumatic stapler gun and a staple penetrated the employee's right hand.
An employee fell from a rack and fractured his hip and ankle. He also received a concussion and a shoulder strain resulting in a hospitalization.

An employee was removing a pump from a truck using a forklift. Another employee was removing the last bolt from the pump on the back of the truck, when the forks of the forklift struck that employee in the back of the right leg resulting in a laceration.
An employee was hand grinding a flat piece of metal that was held in place by a vice. The piece of metal slipped out of the vice striking the employee and cutting the right side of his neck.

An employee was lifting steel bar stocks 12 feet long and weighing approximately 20lbs to place into a CNC mill machine when he felt a pull across his stomach. The employee was later admitted to the hospital for pain in the stomach.

On 3/31/16, at 1:45pm an employee was making large cans on a roll bender machine when the rollers pulled his left hand into the machine causing a crushing injury to the employee's hand that required hospitalization.
The employee was riding on a paint striping machine. The machine was struck by a vehicle causing the hot thermo plastic paint to splash onto the employee burning both arms and the employee's face.

Two employees were managing two 500 lb. steel plates with an overhead crane. One of the steel plates fell crushing an employee's right hand between the two pieces of steel.  The injured employee was hospitalized and three fingers were amputated.
On 03/31/2016, at approximately 4:00 pm, an employee tripped on a tarp and fell while loading/unloading material. The employee suffered a fracture of the right femur.
An employee was traveling eastbound on Dock #1 when the reach truck he was operating lost power, causing the reach truck to strike a parked pallet jack fracturing the employee's left foot.
An employee was changing out a tire on a tractor trailer when the tire blew up and knocked the employee to the ground causing a head injury and thigh contusions.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground hitting his head. The employee required in patient hospitalization for treatment.
On March 31, 2016, an employee injured both hands while hand-feeding a printer/slotter for corrugated cardboard.  The employee was hospitalized with fractures and lacerations on both hands.
An employee was disassembling a crane boom and slipped off the boom falling three feet ten inches and fracturing the lower left leg.
The employee was walking down the incline of a bayou on uneven terrain at the jobsite. The employee slipped, tripped, and fell to the ground fracturing his right leg.

An employee was working with a crew to remove a tree branch from a cable wire on a pole that fell down during a storm. A crew member was cutting a branch to free it from the communications line when it hit an adjacent branch, which then fell onto the employee's back and pinned him to the ground. He fractured his rib and punctured his lung.

An employee was removing whalers of gang form. While positioned on the form, he removed one nut, and the form slid backwards. He was still connected to the form when the form detached from the concrete wall and fell. He fell 8 feet 6 inches with the form to the ground, dislocating his hip and breaking his pelvis. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting and emptying trash cans when he experienced stomach pains. He was hospitalized with a hernia and required surgery.
While clearing a chemical hose line, an employee was sprayed/splashed with concentrated sulfuric acid. He suffered chemical burns on his left thigh.

On or about April 1, 2016, at approximately 10:10 p.m., an employee was walking from the receiving desk at the shipping dock when a forklift driver struck him. His left leg was amputated below the knee.

An employee was unloading logs from a log trailer. The employee stepped on a ladder to climb down when the ladder disconnected, causing the employee to fall and suffer contusions to the back and right shoulder.
An employee was hand stacking product on a skid. The employee walked around the skid and tripped on the shrink wrap, falling to the floor and fracturing the right hip.
An employee was operating a machine when a coworker tipped over a cart. A mold fell from the cart and struck the employee, breaking the employee's lower leg and foot.

An employee welding material on a welding table hung his lead line in a hole in the table. When he turned to walk away, he tripped over the lead line and fell to the floor, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.

While climbing a 17-foot fixed ladder, an employee lost grip of the ladder and fell approximately 10 feet to the surface below. The employee suffered a fractured left ankle and elbow, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was guiding a car into the tire and lube bay while a coworker drove it. The coworker's foot slipped off of the brake and engaged the accelerator. The vehicle struck the injured employee and pushed him into a tire machine and the wall. He sustained a puncture wound above his knee and fractured his leg.
An employee was working under the hood of a truck when the hood fell and dislocated a shelf on the wall. The shelf struck and punctured the employee's lower back.
An employee was placing a piece of lumber under a bundle of steel that was being moved by an overhead crane. The bundle slipped off the chain and fell on his right hand, amputating his middle finger.

An employee was checking the operation of the concrete mixer after the belts were replaced and the pulleys were realigned. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the mixer's belt and pulley, partially amputating the right middle fingertip.
An employee's finger was amputated.

An employee was attempting to refuel a tack buggy when a flame from a nearby rosebud torch ignited the fuel or vapors. The employee was exposed to the flame, burning him on his left arm, hand, and abdomen.

An employee was inside an intermodal container positioned to the right of granite slabs that were stacked in an A-frame manner. As a forklift was unloading the slabs from the left side of the A-frame, the slabs on the right side fell and struck the employee. The employee was pinned between 7 to 8 slabs and the side of the container. The slabs weigh approximately 700 pounds each. The employee sustained bruised ribs and lungs.

An employee was cleaning wet lap from a machine when his right hand came in contact with the machine's blade, amputating four of his fingers. His index finger was reattached. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was adjusting plug tints/caps on an automatic installer machine when the machine's installing head cycled and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

On 04/01/2016, an employee was hospitalized due to lacerating his left forearm. The employee was using a pocket knife to cut a hard plastic banding off of stacks of boxes when the banding sprung and caused the knife to lacerate his left radial artery. The employee required surgery.

While operating the strander machine in normal operating mode, an employee's clothes became entangled in the rotating parts of the machine. The employee was dragged into the machine, suffering head lacerations and breaking the right and left femur, right tibia and fibula, and four ribs.
While using a water hose to wash down a piece of equipment, an employee contacted the equipment and amputated the left thumb.

An employee was working from a 6-foot step ladder while using a screw gun to install a panel cover. He lost his footing, knocked the ladder from beneath himself, and fell to the ground, landing on top of the ladder. He suffered a head laceration and wrist injury, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was laying on her back while installing a chain on the sprocket of an egg packer. While she was jogging the machine, her towel became caught. When she attempted to grab the towel, her right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee attempted to move an electric pallet jack from the battery room. As he turned the pallet jack, his left thumb was caught between the pallet jack handle and a metal concrete pillar. He suffered a compound fracture his left hand, requiring surgery.
An employee was stacking weights when a weight fell on and partially amputated his finger.

An employee was working on a modular unit approximately 4 feet from the ground. While walking to retrieve a tool, the employee stepped into an unguarded opening and fell 3 feet, suffering a fractured rib and pelvis.

A truck jockey operator was pulling in near the office ramp where another employee was sitting to deliver papers to the office. The operator hit the brakes on the truck, but the truck did not stop. The truck pinned the employee between the truck and the wall, causing right arm, upper and lower back, and stomach injuries.

An employee was blowing down a bagger product feed conveyor with an air hose when his right hand became entangled in the chain drive. His right index finger was amputated with fractures to the remaining three fingers.
As an employee was exiting his vehicle, he stepped on a bottle that was hidden inside a bag. He tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing his right wrist and suffering back pain.
