An employee was coming down from a shoring scaffold that he was erecting when he lost his footing and fell 10.5 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured back.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack down an incline when his left leg was pinned into a guardrail, fracturing his left femur.
An employee was cutting out bricks as part of demolition activities when several courses of brick slid down a steel beam and struck his hand, lacerating and fracturing it.

An employee was packing product into boxes. She grabbed a piece of packing tape hanging from the conveyor for the box line printer. Her arm was fractured when it was pulled between the roller and the belt.
An employee was backing a stand-behind forklift into the charging station when his left foot was caught between a guide post and the forklift. He was hospitalized with a crushed foot.
On or about 4/2/16, an employee was unloading a utility pole from a truck when the pole rolled and struck his right leg below the knee, causing a compound fracture. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee had an allergic reaction to a patient's anti-fungal foot cream. The employee developed a rash and experienced breathing problems, requiring hospitalization.

An employee walked out to the parking lot to retrieve an unstable patient. The patient decided to leave the hospital and walked out to get in their car. The employee followed the patient. The patient started the car with the door open. The employee attempted to talk the patient into coming back into the hospital for care. The patient became agitated and reversed the car. The employee was caught by the open door and slammed into the ground. The patient then put the car in drive and ran over the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken nose and chest injuries and required stitches to the face.
An employee slipped and fell while walking to a restroom at the exterior of the store. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee fell approximately 18 feet to a concrete driveway from a ladder while installing cable television line from a pole to a home, suffering fractures and soft tissue damage to the feet and ankles.

An employee entered a bag holder to access a bag placer carriage and monorail where a bag had fallen. While the employee was kneeling below the monorail to pick up the bag, the bag placer carriage engaged, pinching the employee's head between the carriage and monorail. The employee suffered head lacerations that required sutures, as well as contusions on both sides of the head and nose.
An employee was climbing down an A frame ladder when the ladder collapsed. The employee suffered two broken ribs.
An employee delivering food fell from the lift gate of the delivery truck to the ground, breaking a leg.
While operating a divider, an employee's hand entered the guillotine, amputating the right-hand fingertip.

An employee was cleaning a food cart in the back storage part of the store. A forklift operator on the other side of the storage rack was pushing a skid with a cooler but pushed it too far, causing a pallet (weighing approximately 100 pounds) on the other side of the rack to fall on the employee cleaning her cart. She was hospitalized with injuries to her mouth, chest, legs, and feet.
An employee was using a snowmobile to take an empty patient sled up the mountain when the employee crashed into a permanent snow fence, breaking bones and puncturing the aorta.
An employee was detailing a boat. While trying to remove plastic, she fell approximately 6 feet from the boat to the ground, breaking her collarbone, cracking her rib, and injuring her head.
An employee was working near mail transporting equipment when the web on the machine became caught on the employee's right leg, causing a bone fracture.
An employee was using a pneumatic torque wrench when the locking mechanism pinched his right ring finger. Part of his finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was clearing a line vessel when a hose came loose and struck the employee's left arm. The employee was hospitalized with a left bicep tear requiring surgery.
On or about April 3, 2016, an employee was operating a water lance to clean a fixed pipe when he made contact with pressurized water, lacerating his left thumb.

While an employee was operating the clothes sorting machine, a garment was inserted incorrectly. When the employee tried to pull the garment back out of the machine, the employee received a static electricity shock and experienced chest and right arm pain.
An employee fell while delivering clean linen at a customer's location, suffering a concussion and back, shoulder, and hand pain.

An employee had been working on stripping and waxing the floor when the floor buffer machine made a loud noise. The employee bent over to make an adjustment to the machine and fell on the floor, fracturing the left leg.

While servicing a hydraulic press, an employee entered the space between the light curtain and the machine. The machine cycled, trapping the employee between the mandrill and casting. He suffered a broken femur, broken hip, and punctured bladder.
An employee was helping to lower an aircraft hose hoist when he tripped on a cart tongue that connects two engine cowling carts. He fractured his right elbow in two places.
An employee fell 5 feet off scaffolding and fractured the left wrist. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee sustained a broken arm after slipping and falling on a wet surface on the floor.

An employee was unjamming candy on the forming line when his glove was caught by the rollers and his right hand was pulled into the machine. He was hospitalized after receiving a deep laceration on the webbing of his right hand between his index and middle fingers.

An employee climbed a ladder to install a buss over an energized circuit. The buss slipped from the employee's hand and made contact with an energized circuit. An arc flash occurred and the employee's hands, face and chest were burned.
An employee was working in the GI Lab cleaning equipment with Cidex-OPA Solution.  The employee had an asthma attack triggered by the cleansing solution and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee fell while walking along a corridor, suffering a broken kneecap.
On Monday, April 4, 2016, an employee was hospitalized with a crushing injury to his right leg.
An employee was walking out of the office when a coworker punched him repeatedly, knocking him down. He suffered a fractured jaw requiring surgery.
An employee slipped and fell from a flatbed trailer, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was installing bridging from a scissor lift. He stepped out of the scissor lift and onto the bar joist and fell approximately 16 feet to the concrete below, suffering head trauma.
An employee was testing a machine spindle when the spindle dropped, striking and fracturing the employee's leg. The spindle was not secure at the time of the incident.

An employee was repairing a conveyor that was jammed with product. The employee's fingers were caught in the conveyor pulley when it started back up, amputating the pinky finger and fracturing the right ring finger.
An employee was working on a car's coil spring when the spring came loose and a tool struck him in the face. The employee suffered a cut hand, a broken nose, and eye damage.

An employee was using a vertical disc grinder to grind a small piece of metal while wearing gloves. His glove was caught on the disc, resulting in the amputation of his left index fingertip just above the tip of his nail.

An employee was walking at floor level next to a machine. The employee tripped over a 3-inch piece of round stock sticking out of the machine and fell to the floor. She fell on her right arm and broke several bones.
An employee was cutting a piece of PVC piping with a chop saw. The blade kicked back and struck him in the chest, lacerating it.
An employee was walking down the hallway when she slipped and fell, suffering a compound fracture to her arm.

While working the boom lift, an employee was struck by a vehicle, suffering a broken knee and nose, bruised head, and injured foot. The employee was wearing a harness, but was not tied off at the time of the incident.

A rig crew was attempting to pull a drill rig through the mud using a company-owned winch truck.  While doing so, the winch line separated, striking the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated arm and injured spleen.
An employee was walking along the roof, conducting an inspection for roof replacement. The employee fell through the roof to the concrete floor, breaking ribs and a wrist.

While spray painting a building, an employee went over a gate and walked off the ledge. The wind had blown a tarp over the area and covered the edge, which could not be seen. The employee fell approximately 50 feet, suffering broken ribs on the right side and a collapsed lung.
An employee stepped off a forklift and was struck by the driver, causing a severe leg injury.
An employee was performing maintenance on a D/C line when the line ruptured, creating a flash fire. The employee suffered first degree burns to the hands and face.

An employee suffered a partial amputation of the left middle finger while connecting a tow bar to a forklift's attachment. The employee's finger got pinched between the tow bar and the pintle hook on the attachment.

An employee was attempting to drive a forklift off of a trailer bed when the forklift went off the side of the trailer bed and crushed the employee. The employee suffered six fractured ribs, a partially collapsed lung and a lacerated spleen.
Two employees were overcome by carbon monoxide fumes while troubleshooting a hot water heater. One of the employees was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was using a shearer to cut a metal plate during prep work. A piece of the metal shear blade broke and hit him in the neck, causing a neck laceration.

Employees were moving a stack of wear bands with an overhead crane. The wear bands fell over and struck an employee. He suffered a left shin laceration and left ankle fracture, as well as right leg laceration and right ankle injury.
An employee was climbing up the ladder on the catwalk when he slipped and lost his grip, falling 5 feet to the concrete floor below. He broke his right lower leg and suffered an ankle injury.

An employee was cleaning the oven. She sprayed degreaser and then put the oven in the self-cleaning cycle. When she opened the oven, she was exposed to the fumes inside and experienced lung irritation, requiring hospitalization.
On or about April 5, 2016, an employee was guiding a die in a press when he attempted to remove a scrap. His right middle finger was caught between the die and die stop, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was attempting to remove viscera (guts) with a tool from the machine. The tool he was using was caught in the evisceration machine, and his right ring finger was smashed between the tool and the machine, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was working near a boring tunneling pit when he experienced dizziness and fell through railing, breaking his pelvis and two ribs.

On or about April 5, 2016, at 4:00 p.m., an employee was  attempting to insert a plate into a shell core machine when his hand became caught in the machine, severely burning his left thumb and first and second fingers. He was hospitalized for treatment.
While attempting to retrieve scrap steel from a horizontal band saw, an employee's third, fourth, and fifth left-hand digits were amputated.

On or about April 5, 2016, at 1:00 p.m., an employee slipped and fell 6 to 8 feet from the fixed industrial ladder to the boiler's eighth elevation platform, suffering compound fractures to the tibia and fibula, as well as metatarsal fractures in both feet. He was hospitalized overnight for surgery.
An employee's right ring finger was smashed while he was attempting to unjam a 6x6x18 timber from a machine roller bed, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was performing flagging duties for traffic control while a company truck performed pole work. The employee was on the step of the truck when the truck moved. The employee fell onto the road, suffering a skull fracture and road rash.
An employee was mopping the break room when he stepped into the water on the break room floor, slipped, and struck his head on the floor.

An employee was using a band saw to cut scrap steel when the sawblade became stuck. As the employee attempted to release pressure in the blade area, the blade pulled his left-hand glove and index finger into the saw. His left index finger was amputated.

An employee standing on a skid lifted on the forks of a forklift, fell 10-12 feet to the ground. The employee fractured the right shoulder and wrist and sustained a head laceration requiring stitches.

An employee was pushing a wheelchair to place it in the front lobby when he tripped and the wheel chair was pushed away from him. He fell on his left side and fractured his left shoulder and left hip.

An employee was working in an elevated platform (cherry picker) that stopped working. A coworker came to rescue him, and as he stepped off one platform onto the other, he slipped and struck his head. He was working 10 feet above the lower level and was wearing a body harness and retractable lanyard at the time.
An employee suffered a shin burn when a fire occurred while he was re-fueling equipment in the horse barn.
Two employees were hospitalized after being buried in dirt when a trench collapsed.
An employee's index finger was jammed between a door frame and the door as he was closing it, amputating his distal phalange.
An employee opened the trap door of a rotating floor on a restaurant to reach a guest's credit card when his leg was caught in the rotating floor mechanism. He suffered a leg fracture.
An employee slipped on ice and fell on the sidewalk while walking into work, fracturing his leg.

An employee exited the cab of a garbage truck. The truck was not in park at the time. When the employee attempted to re-enter the truck cab, the truck crashed into two cars and a building. The employee suffered bruises/contusions to the arms and legs, as well as a pelvic injury.

While performing construction work on an apartment building, an employee's lanyard became tangled. While the employee was attempting to untangle the lanyard, a cantilevered portion of one truss contacted and pushed down another roof truss, causing the employee to lose his footing and fall to the ground. He suffered a broken pelvis, lacerated kidney, lacerated spleen, punctured lung, and broken rib.
An employee tripped and fell in the deli and landed on a knee, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a drill press to drill a hole in a piece of metal when a metal bur contacted his glove and pulled his finger into the drill press. His finger was amputated.
An employee was lowering a dock plate when it became stuck. As he used a pole to lift the dock plate, the plate became dislodged and fell on his foot, severely cutting one toe.

An employee was unloading dirt from a dump truck onto a dirt service road when the load shifted and the dump truck rolled onto its side. The employee sustained nerve damage to his left shoulder and left arm.
An employee was pushing a rolling cart of dishes into a wall-mounted dishwasher when his foot entered a pool of water heated to 180 degrees Fahrenheit. He suffered a second degree burn to his ankle.

An employee stood up in a forklift to reach through the mast and retrieve paperwork on the freight load. The employee had his arm extended through the mast of the forklift when the lever was hit and lowered the fork onto his arm. He suffered a severe right arm contusion with a large hematoma.

An employee was trying to remove pepperoni that was jammed in the guard of a slicer. As he pulled out the pepperoni, his hand was caught in the slicer blade. His right hand index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was installing a small motor when the motor slipped out of his hands. The motor fell onto his hands and onto the ground. His left index finger was caught and amputated between the motor and the ground.

An employee was setting up and performing maintenance on a drilling machine with a panel removed. When the machine cycled, its table moved a plastic bin, which smashed the employee's finger between the bin and the ledge of the machine. The employee's left middle fingertip was partially amputated.
While cleaning the area, an employee's left thumb was caught and amputated between a leveling plate and a tank.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun to assemble walls when the gun came in contact with his knee and discharged the nail into it. He required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee entered a robotic palletizing area to adjust tape that was sticking to boxes. The employee was struck by a robotic arm, suffering pain and contusions on the right side of the ribs and neck area. The system was not de-energized at the time of the incident.
While cleaning the bagel machine, an employee suffered an amputation after being caught in the point of operation. The machine was not turned off at the time of the incident.
An employee attempted to tap into an airline to operate a nail gun. When he operated the nail gun, it exploded. The employee lost an eye and suffered multiple lacerations to the hands and face.
An employee was pushing push rods through the ceiling to pull wire when he fell off of a 6-foot stepladder and broke his right leg.
An employee was reaching for a liver on a conveyor-type table when his right wrist was lacerated by the knife he was holding. The laceration became infected and required hospitalization.
A maintenance employee was shot in the abdomen while trying to break up an argument between a tenant and the apartment manager. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on the ground, holding onto an aerial lift. The coworker in the aerial lift did not realize the other employee was holding onto the basket, and he lifted the lift. The employee let go and fell to the ground, fracturing the left ankle and requiring hospitalization.
On or about April 6, 2016, an employee fell one story down detached stairs to a lower level. The stairs then fell on top of him, breaking his vertebrae.
An employee was climbing down a fixed metal ladder when he lost his footing and/or grip and fell from a height of approximately 5 feet. He fractured his left leg bone beneath the knee.

An employee was helping the operator mount the concrete mold to the side of a slip form paver. He took the transport strands off the mold before the operator had secured the mold to keep it from overturning. The concrete form fell onto the employee fracturing his right ring finger and right leg.

An employee was walking by a 260 J raw cooker containing oil, grease, and solid food for chicken feed when the cooker built up pressure, causing the door to pop open. Hot food splashed out and contacted the employee's chest, resulting in chest burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a soil stabilizer when the equipment struck a high-pressure natural gas pipeline. The pipeline burst into flames and exploded, causing burns to the employee.
On 4/6/16, an employee suffered an asthmatic reaction to a degreasing chemical that was sprayed on the floor and required hospitalization.
While descending a rolling ladder and carrying a product, an employee tripped on the last few steps and fell onto the ladder, suffering multiple fractures and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a shipping container onto a flatbed truck when his right hand became pinched between the container and the truck. His right pinky fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
While investigating a noise, an employee opened a lid for a pool jet pump and was splashed with hot water and steam. The employee suffered burns to the face, eyes, neck, and arms.

An employee was participating in powered industrial vehicle training. As the employee was attempting to pick up a table, the wheels on the lift turned sharply. The lift accelerated quickly, causing it to veer to the right. His right pinky finger was pinned and amputated under an adjacent table next to a wall.

An employee was winding in steel cable using a reel. The steel cable came off the drum and the employee placed it back with his right hand. The steel cable pinched and amputated his right index fingertip between the steel cable and the reel drum.

An employee was attempting to unjam a 50-pound steel bar from a machine platform. As the bar became unjammed, it slid down through the opening, hit the platform, and struck the employee in the back, breaking three ribs and causing a puncture injury.

An employee was standing on a three-step stool to stock cigarettes in overhead bins. While coming down the steps , the employee missed the last step, lost balance, fell, and struck the countertop, breaking four ribs.
On or about April 6, 2016, an employee was installing an anchor point on the roof when he fell to the ground and broke his right wrist.

An employee was running the casting machine when he noticed that the charge bucketful of ingots had come off of the elevator. When he attempted to pick up the ingots that had fallen onto the floor, the carrier arms (part of the chain lift elevator device) that held the charge bucket in place came down and struck his right hand, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
While an employee was removing two rolls of paper from a winder, the stops came up and twisted one of the rolls. The employee's left forearm was caught and fractured between the rolls.
An employee was on a ladder trimming branches when he was hit by a falling branch. He then fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a damaged spleen.
An employee was elevating an order picker when three of his fingers were caught between the top of the cage and a steel beam in the ceiling, fracturing and crushing the fingers.
On April 6, 2016, an employee was hospitalized with a broken leg after slipping and falling from a step on a box truck.

An employee was attempting to push a 400- to 500-pound upright plastic floater when his left ring fingertip was caught between the plastic tank and a forklift tine. He suffered a possible fingertip amputation.
An employee was breaking a horse when the horse ran into the metal railing of the pen, fracturing the employee's knee.
While riding an ATV, an employee hit a rut and was thrown from the vehicle. He struck the dirt road and sustained broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and broken neck vertebrae.
An employee was placing a tiger in a cage when his right hand struck the cage housing. He experienced bruising and discomfort and was hospitalized.
While stepping off a ladder, an employee missed the last step and fell to the ground, injuring his left knee and requiring surgery.

On or about April 6, 2016, an employee was cleaning a food slicer when her right ring fingertip contacted the spinning blade and was amputated. The slicer was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.
While delivering mail to a residence, an employee was startled by a dog and fell backwards, injuring her hip.
An employee was cleaning the kitchen. A cutting board fell onto the employee's hand breaking a finger.
An employee's middle fingertip was amputated when a pool table fell on top of the employee's finger.

An employee was replacing a blow valve on a digester. The line was broken and was open for 15 minutes. When the employee returned to remove the two remaining bolts on the right side of the valve, the employee was exposed to black liquor from the paper processing line. The liquor came down and burned the employee's abdomen, left thigh, and both arms.
An employee was moving bricks on the roof of a one-story house when he lost his balance and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, suffering left leg trauma.
An employee was on a 4-foot stepladder, cleaning caulking off of a window frame to install a new window. He fell from the second step to the concrete below and broke his left ankle.
An employee was fine grading a stone with a shovel when an excavator backed up and pinned the employee's legs. One of his legs was amputated and the other suffered broken bones.
On April 7, 2016, an employee was pulling a large bag full of plastic while walking backwards when he tripped on a bag of flour and fell, striking his head on the floor.
While sweeping the front store area next to the tower baskets, an employee began to experience respiratory/breathing problems. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading metal plates into the bucket of a Bobcat when the equipment tipped over and struck the employee's foot. The employee suffered a contusion that became infected and required hospitalization.
On 04-07-16, an employee was adjusting/operating a coil machine when two looping blocks came together and pinched the employee's finger, amputating the left index fingertip.
While descending a step ladder, an employee fell from the lower rungs, injuring his head and torso and breaking two ribs.

An employee was operating a right angle grinder cutting a door jamb when the frame pinched the grinding wheel causing it to kick back and strike the employee in the left bicep.  The employee required surgery to repair the injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a new auger bag for the CNC machine when his right index finger was partially amputated by the auger blade. The safety tube covering the blades was not in place properly at the time of the incident.

On April 7, 2016, an employee was using a walk-behind skid steer machine to pick up steel debris in the basement of the mill.  While picking up a piece of steel with the bucket, the bucket became stuck due to the weight of the steel. The back end of the skid steer raised up and moved the employee's hand to a flange, where the employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee working on the Phosphate Line was transferring parts from one bin to another bin when his left thumb was caught on the side of the bin and amputated.

An employee was inspecting a rotary valve airlock system. He opened a hatch to see if it was plugged and attempted to move some plugged material. He contacted the internal rotating parts, partially amputating three left-hand fingers.
While exiting the back of a delivery truck, an employee's ring became caught on part of the door. His left-hand ring finger was severely injured.
An employee slipped and fell while walking through the bottom of a cyclone (large tube) interior, breaking her ankle.

An employee was operating a press machine when a part fell into the scrap conveyor. He went to retrieve the part and his glove was caught in the moving conveyor, amputating the end of his left middle finger.
On 4/7/16, an employee was ripping a 2'x10' board on the floor with a circular saw when the blade amputated a quarter-inch of his left finger.
An employee was repositioning a platform on a construction site when it collapsed to the level below. The employee fell 18 feet and was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee's left middle fingertip was amputated in the chute of an electric grinder while he was grinding beef.

An employee was cleaning a chiller when a coworker turned on the equipment. The paddle in the chiller struck the employee's right hand, breaking and lacerating the middle and ring fingers. The equipment was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking up the stairway while carrying a sheet of sheet rock. A gust of wind came and caught the sheet rock like a kite, knocking the injured employee backwards. He lost his balance and fell 5 to 6 feet to the ground, suffering a concussion.
An employee walked behind a counter and slipped and fell, breaking the left kneecap.
An employee was attempting to lift/tilt a scissor lift with coworkers when he pulled his right arm bicep.
An employee was struck by a front-end loader while he was removing a chain from a dumpster. He was crushed from the waist down.

A maintenance employee attempting to repair a machine's gate asked a coworker to trip the mechanism to start the machine. The coworker accidentally started the machine a second time, amputating the employee's right-hand middle and ring fingers between the platen and gate.

An employee was clearing brush near a chain link fence at a right-of-way when the employee's saw became caught in with the fencing, causing it to kick back. The employee sustained a horizontal 6-inch to 8-inch laceration across his upper chest, below the neck. He was hospitalized and received stitches.
An employee was tracing a wire under the hood of a powered industrial vehicle when his right hand contacted the cooling fan, lacerating the thumb, index, and middle fingers.
An employee had exited a forklift when a coworker traveling in the same direction in a motorized pallet jack forklift struck his left ankle.
An employee twisted and fractured his ankle while carrying a 4x4 piece of wood on his shoulder.
An employee was cleaning fiber off a moving part/sprocket and suffered a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee fell approximately 47 feet off the grating in the air recovery area, breaking her right arm and injuring her hip.
An employee was working on a transformer when another worker hooked up a generator to the power shop and a back feed caused the employee to receive an electrical shock to his hands and side.

A maintenance employee completed a repair on dough sheeting equipment. After the repair, he attempted to wipe a metal shaving off the running machine. His rag was caught by the equipment and his left index finger was crushed, requiring hospitalization.

An employee climbed up a ladder to enter a trailer and fix flaps on the trailer belt that were laying the wrong direction. When he climbed over the side of the trailer and turned his body, he aggravated a previous hernia and required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning while a coworker was pushing a cart of hot coffee nearby. A carafe of hot coffee fell off the cart and spilled onto the employee's ankles, causing severe burns that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was raising the slide gate on his truck with one hand on the controls and the other hand free. He slipped and his left hand was caught between the truck and rising gate, amputating his left middle fingertip.

A maintenance employee was greasing a bearing and could not get the grease to flow. When he put his finger on the fitting to get the grease to flow, other workers moved the motor, which amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee turned a piece of metal machinery over using a crane. A part of it came loose and landed on his hand, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was driving a dump truck on an oil lease when the truck rolled over. The employee suffered head lacerations, a brain hemorrhage, and a bruised shoulder and thigh.
A maintenance employee was using a sledge hammer to remove an end cap on an axle to a ride. The sledge hammer struck the employee's right pinky finger, crushing it.
An employee was cutting a board with a metric (powered hand saw) saw that is secured to a table when his hand contacted the saw blade, amputating his left index finger.
An employee was installing shingles on a two-story house when the employee lost their footing and fell, suffering a broken back and two broken hands.
While cutting lumber using a miter saw, an employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee's finger was amputated in the point of operation of a brake press.
A piece of mulch perforated the sole of an employee's boot and punctured his foot while he was edging along some bricks. The wound became infected and the employee had to be hospitalized.

On April 8, 2016, at approximately 12:30 p.m., a maintenance employee was standing on a stepladder, working above the ceiling. The employee was using PVC cutters to cut into a clogged pipe. When the pipe was cut, a corrosive liquid showered onto the employee's head, face, and arms. The employee received chemical burns and was hospitalized
An employee tripped while exiting a towing car, suffering a broken hip.
On or about April 8, 2016, an employee suffered a fingertip amputation when the left middle finger was caught between steel coils on a conveyor.
An employee was operating a walker stacker when the stacker reversed over the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with a foot injury.

An employee was conducting inventory on stove sets. As he climbed onto returnable crates that were more than 12 feet high, he grabbed onto one of the crate's fold-out doors. The door came unlatched, causing the employee to fall onto the concrete floor. He suffered lacerations, fractured ribs, and a partially collapsed lung.
An employee's right thumb was caught in a safe door she was closing, crushing/amputating her thumb tip above the nail.

An employee was delivering goods to a client, unloading a truck through the side door. The employee slipped and fell from the truck, striking their ankle on the ground and head against another parked vehicle.
An employee was cleaning a mixer using acetone when a flash fire occurred. The employee received burns to both hands.

An employee was inspecting a load of incoming scrap material. While trying to close the grain chute door of truck, the employee's fingertip was caught by the door. The employee suffered a right index finger amputation.
While lifting a pallet, an employee bent down, felt a crack, and slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a lumbar injury.
An employee was lifting a dryer off of another appliance with a coworker when she tore her bicep, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was adding hydrogen peroxide to a chemical pot that exploded. The employee suffered two fractured left-hand fingers and chemical burns.
An employee was cleaning inside a grain bin when the sweep auger hit him on the leg, injuring his right leg calf muscle.
An employee was picking up a garbage dumpster when his left middle finger was caught between the cable and dumpster, crushing his fingertip.

An employee was walking through an orange grove with a ladder when the ladder made contact with overhead power lines. An electrical current entered the employee's body through his hands and exited through his feet. He was hospitalized.
When an employee stepped off a platform to descend a zip line, the non-weight bearing loop failed and the employee fell. The employee suffered back injuries and broken ribs.
On or about April 9, 2016, an employee's hand was caught in an air handler between the belt and pulley. The employee's fourth left-hand finger was amputated.

An employee was attempting to move a pumping system out of a paint booth. A coworker assisted by lifting the pumping system with a forklift while the injured employee was observing/spotting. The pumping system slid off the forklift forks and pinned the employee between it and the wall of the paint booth. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg, broken right forearm, and a cracked sternum.
An employee was cleaning a framework near a conveyor when he fell and broke his upper right arm between the conveyor and the framework.
An employee was putting a filter system back into service after changing product filters when he was sprayed with sulfolane product, suffering second and third degree burns.
While dismounting a forklift, an employee misstepped and fell on his left hip, breaking it.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a water heater in the ceiling when he lost his balance. He grabbed onto a wire that supports the ceiling, and the sharp wire cut his left-hand middle finger and tore a tendon.
While driving a transfer car, an employee's foot contacted an in-feed conveyor, partially amputating his big toe and index toe. His foot was hanging outside of the car at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a crane to load grain onto an ocean-going ship when a hydraulic hose failed and caused a fire after contacting a muffler. The employee exited the cab of the crane and landed on a catwalk, breaking the right leg.

On April 9, 2016, an employee was sanding a metal part using a stand-alone upright disc sander when the rotating sander part grabbed the metal part and the employee's gloved left thumb. The employee's thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was admitting a patient to the hospital when the employee had a severe reaction to cat dander on the patient's clothing.
On or about Saturday, April 9, 2016, at 8:00 a.m., an employee fell from a yard spotter to the concrete, suffering head trauma.

While operating a conveyor, an employee's glove became entangled between the conveyor belt and the belt tensioning roll, causing a finger amputation. The equipment was unguarded at the time of the incident.
While walking into work, an employee turned to wave at someone and tripped. She fell onto her right side, breaking her hip.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor while passing through the kitchen wash area, breaking his left ribs and injuring his lungs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attaching hydraulic clamps to cattle hide when the employee's left hand was caught in the clamps, fracturing all of the fingers.
An employee was standing on a step stool, organizing products in the cooler, when she fell off the stool and fractured her left leg.
An employee was struck by a door as he entered the facility, injuring his eye socket and cheek.
A maintenance employee was unjamming a part in a new piece of equipment. The part unjammed and the slide went forward, amputating his right index fingertip.

An employee was showing a maintenance man an issue with a machine. As the employee was pointing to the problem, his finger was pulled into the rotating belt and pulley, amputating his right index fingertip.

An employee was attempting to close a valve while standing on a platform. One of his feet slipped off the platform, causing him to fall. He was burned on his left lower leg when it came into contact with the condensate that had been heated with steam.
While attempting to thread tape on a machine, an employee's hand was caught in a roller, breaking the employee's left wrist.
An employee was removing a piece of plastic product from a mold when the employee's fingers were smashed between the mold and the machine, partially amputating the right-hand ring and middle fingers.

An employee was lowering an irrigation pipe into a trench when the pipe slipped from its rigging. The employee's knee was caught between the falling pipe and a coupler screw, requiring surgery to remove shattered bones from the knee.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder troubleshooting the sawmill conveyor system. He fell from the ladder and his left pinky finger was crushed by an unguarded chain and sprocket gear, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was carrying items from her car in the parking lot towards the office when she lost her footing and fell fracturing the left hip.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground and was hospitalized with a broken right shoulder.

On or about April 11, 2016, an employee was operating a spiral winder when the bobbin ran out of wire. While he worked on the bobbin, the machine activated and pinched the employee's right index finger, partially amputating the fingertip.
An employee pushing a cart felt a snap and pain in the hip. The employee's prosthetic hip broke, and the employee required hospitalization.
An employee suffered a left wrist cut while cutting trim with a miter saw when the employee's coat sleeve was caught in the guard.
While using a magnetic drill, an employee's gloved hand was drawn into the drill, amputating the right thumb above the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to remove a clog beneath a trim press when the die amputated the employee's left-hand middle fingertip.
While cutting boards of wood on an up-cut saw, an employee's right thumb and part of his index finger were amputated by the saw blade.
An employee fell approximately 2 to 3 feet down a set of stairs at the loading dock and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was cutting a hole in a wall while standing on a 7-foot ladder. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder, breaking his right foot, suffering an internal injury, cutting his forehead, and injuring both hands.
An employee drove a van off of an automotive lift, striking a wall and suffering a back injury.
On or about April 11, 2016, an employee amputated her right fifth finger after it contacted the blade of a spindle saw.
An employee was working from a portable ladder when the employee slipped and fell. The employee's hand became caught on the metal garage door and was lacerated.

An employee was directing a forklift that was moving a transformer and its stand. After the forklift lifted the transformer and stand, the transformer began to shift and fall, causing the stand to fall on its side. The stand bounced and one of its metal legs hit the employee, cracking two of the employee's ribs.

On an access road, a front-end loader operator lost control of his vehicle and slid into the path of the injured employee, who was driving a garbage truck. The front-end loader crushed the garbage truck cab, trapping the injured employee and crushing the employee's left leg.

On 4/11/16, an employee was replacing an air valve beneath an RV motor coach when the coach pinned him beneath it for several minutes until he was freed by other employees using jacks and a forklift. He was hospitalized with cracked rib(s) and a superficial laceration of the liver.
On or about 4/11/2016, an employee was helping to guide and signal a backing truck when he was struck by the truck, eventually requiring hospitalization for a back injury.
On or about April 11, 2016. an employee was working in an electrical cabinet when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with burns on the face and forearms.

The injured employee was operating a Crown 4500 Pallet Jack (stand up type) and was in the process of navigating it into the designated parking area, when his left foot became caught between the parking space concrete curb and the left side of the pallet jack. The employee sustained a fractured left foot.
While operating an electrical powered industrial truck, an employee backed into a metal table edge that lacerated his left leg.
An employee was riding an ATV to set fire markers. While making a left turn, the employee lost control of the ATV and fell on the road, suffering an injury.
An employee that was operating a stand up power industrial truck at the warehouse of the distribution facility collided with a material rack system and suffered fractured ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished giving a class to new drivers and was strapping his equipment into the rear of a semi trailer. The end of the strap came loose on one end, and the momentum of the tightening strap pulled the employee out the rear of the truck to the ground. The employee suffered an elbow contusion and broken pelvis.
An employee was cutting croutons with a serrated bread knife and amputated a portion of his thumb.
An employee was ascending the container attached to a dump truck when he fell and broke his left forearm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking out of the parking lot through a man door when he was struck by a yard truck. He was hospitalized.
An employee's right middle finger was amputated while installing a safety guard.
While adjusting the fill levels on a machine with a wrench, an employee amputated the right-hand middle fingertip.
On 4/12/16, an employee's hair was pulled into the roll straightener machine's rollers. The employee sustained a scalping injury.

An employee was pushing a cart with a spindle on top of it when the cart wheel hit a bump and the cart tipped over. The spindle fell on the employee's foot, flattening the employee's steel toe and breaking a foot bone. The employee required surgery and overnight hospitalization.
While operating a table saw to cut lumber, an employee amputated two fingers and lacerated another.

An employee was parked in a residential incline driveway. The customer asked if the employee could move his truck. While backing up the vehicle, the right side of the vehicle was off the driveway in the grass. The employee exited the vehicle to look. The vehicle was still in reverse at the time. As the employee exited, the vehicle continued to reverse, and the driver's door struck and knocked him to the ground. The left front tire then ran over the employee, injuring his ribs and chest and possibly collapsing his lung.
An employee was riding in an elevator that ascended at a rapid pace when her head hit the ceiling. She was hospitalized with head injuries.
An employee opened a manhole for fiber optic installation and immediately began hyperventilating.
A machine loader collided with a company truck, causing the truck to move and hit an employee's head. The employee was knocked unconscious and required hospitalization.
An employee and two coworkers were working from a one-frame-high scaffold to remove masonry when the scaffold tipped over to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tailbone.
While driving a stand-up counterbalance forklift, an employee struck a rack. The employee fell off the forklift and was pinned between the forklift and the rack, fracturing the pelvis.
An employee had provided care to residents when she experienced flu-like symptoms. She was hospitalized with the flu and pneumonia.

On or about 4/12/2016, at 8:45 a.m., an employee was picking up a 40-pound box of apples while stepping on the pallet that held the box. The board of the pallet broke and the employee lost his footing, falling to the floor and hitting his back and head.
An employee was using a horizontal milling machine to cut a cap for an engine when the employee's right hand was amputated.
Employee may have been exposed to methanol and experienced symptoms consistent with methanol poisoning.
An employee was using a sander to clean steel when the sanding disc caught and flipped onto his arm, cutting his wrist requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was performing physical training when he became ill and required hospitalization.

An employee was helping to stabilize an optical comparator on the forks of a forklift when the machine shifted slightly. One corner of the machine slipped off the edge of the fork and hit the employee's leg above the ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was unloading a steel plate from a trailer at the dock when the steel plate fell from the forklift forks onto his right foot, breaking three bones.

An employee fell while stepping up onto a sidewalk and then fell a second time while stepping down stairs. The employee suffered right knee, hip, and bilateral hand contusions, as well as an abrasion and strain.
An employee walking through the company parking garage stumbled while passing between two parked cars. She suffered multiple fractures in her right ankle.

An employee was operating a hand saw while cutting concrete blocks when the blade pinched up and kicked back. The employee lost control of his upper hand, and the machine spun around and came down on his left bicep, lacerating the muscle. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was loading a pile of limbs from the curb side into the back of a garbage truck. The employee's glove was caught in the hydraulic packing blade of the truck, injuring three fingers and requiring surgery.

An employee and a backhoe operator were leveling the waler on a slide rail system. The backhoe operator flipped the bucket, pushed up the waler, and lost sight contact with the employee. The operator then lost his grip on the bucket, causing the waler to fall.  The waler hit a 8' 2"x4" piece of wood, which jumped up and hit the employee in the face. The injured employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized with a fractured jaw.

On April 12, 2016, at about 7:05 p.m., an employee was trying to clean out pieces of fish from the 4-pound feed conveyor when the employee's fingers were caught by the machine's knife, amputating the right third and fourth fingertips.
An employee was walking through the employee dining room, tripped and fell fracturing his right hip.
An employee was nailing with a nail gun. When a nail hit another nail, it bounced off and struck the employee in the left eye. The employee required surgery for the eye injury.
An employee in a scissor lift was helping to repair a heater approximately 17 feet above ground level when the lift platform collapsed. The employee sustained injuries upon impact with the platform.
An employee was cutting 2" by 4" pieces of lumber with a saw when the saw kicked back and partially amputated his left index finger at the second joint.
An employee fell from a pole while connecting wires, suffering a broken right arm.

An employee was setting up a tillage tool. While he was placing the tillage frame on jack stands with an overhead crane, the lifting straps fell off the crane hook, causing the frame to drop on the employee's foot, lacerating it.
An employee was unclogging a hose used to spray roofing products when the chemicals in the hose sprayed into the employee's face and eye.
An employee's left index finger was partially amputated to the first knuckle while he was using a panel saw to cut the edge off of a board.

An employee was performing a clean-in-place process using pressurized 2% caustic solution when the hose connection broke, spraying the employee and causing a 2nd degree burn to the employee's left forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
On 4/13/16, an employee slipped on metal decking and fell approximately 10 feet, suffering fractured ribs and a fractured skull.
An employee was inspecting a roof when it collapsed. He fell 16 feet through the roof to the stairwell below, breaking his leg and dislocating a shoulder.
An employee was removing gauges from a compressor when refrigerant came out and caused first and second degree burns to his right hand. He was hospitalized.
The employee was riding a pallet jack while loading trailers. The handle of the pallet jack jerked and the pallet jack moved quickly pinning the employee against the trailer wall.
While climbing a ladder into a barge to offload the remaining grain, an employee fell 15 to 20 feet from the ladder, suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was egressing from a 12 foot A-frame ladder and slipped and fell. The employee suffered a concussion, a thoracic sprain and minor lacerations.

While an employee was transferring his issued duty weapon from one holster to another, the weapon engaged some keys on his duty belt. The keys entered the trigger guard, and as he pushed the weapon into the holster, it discharged. The bullet struck and wounded his left-hand middle finger.

An employee was working on a lift truck. While putting the chain back on the lift truck's forks, the employee accidentally knocked it in gear and the boom fell. The forklift chains on the boom amputated the two middle fingers on his right hand. One finger was cut below the nailbed and the other was cut in the middle of the nailbed.
An employee fell as he was walking down the aisle to his work station, injuring his ankle and requiring hospitalization.

On 4/13/15, at approximately 5:00 p.m., an employee was setting up a metal grinding machine. During the setup process, he attempted to remove the part that was to be worked on. The manual control was in the reverse position at the time. As he pushed the job button with his right hand, his left ring finger was caught between the part and a machine guide, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was clearing a small pine tree from the road using an axe. The axe went all the way through the tree and struck his right shin, causing lacerations and a small fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to take a cable winch system down. The system had been used to pull a heat exchange bundle. The employee's hand was on a poly snatch block when the operator moved the cable. The employee's fingertip was caught between the cable and poly snatch block, resulting in a distal finger amputation.

An employee was unstrapping steel cross beams so material handlers could deliver the material into the facility. While unstrapping the cross beams, the load shifted and dropped onto the employee. The employee suffered facial, skull, and lumbar fractures, requiring hospitalization.

On or about April 13, 2016, an employee was cleaning off a machine with a compressed air hose when she lost control of the hose's coupler end. The air hose end whipped up and struck her in the eye, requiring hospitalization.

While connecting beams and attempting to torque the bolts, an employee was pinned between the beam and the lift controls. He fractured his back and two ribs and suffered a collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on the ground, backfilling a sidewalk with hand tools. When a nearby excavator operator reached to close a window, the operator's knee struck the bucket control lever. This caused the bucket that was resting on the ground to extend and strike the left foot of the employee who was working on the ground.
An employee was installing a scissor assembly on a high reach forklift. A finger was pinched while aligning two holes when the assembly moved resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.

On 4/13/16, an employee was working on a road/street/underpass project, installing "mini piles" that consisted of digging holes and inserting rebar, casing, and grout/lye. Grout/lye entered the employee's rubber boot, burning his right foot and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a ladder and fell off approximately 20 feet when the feet of the ladder slipped. The employee suffered a fractured right elbow.

An employee was removing spouts on a decommissioned grain elevator. While the employee was removing the last spout, the grain elevator collapsed and the employee fell approximately 50 feet, suffering a fractured femur, shattered left heel, and facial lacerations.

An employee was tightening a bolt on the mixer so it would not move. She started to fall and tried to catch herself with her hands, fracturing her right wrist on the concrete floor. She was hospitalized.
An employee was using an electric pulley to raise materials up a scaffold when the employee's finger became stuck in the pulley casing, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was replacing an aerial drop wire from a ladder. The employee missed a rung while descending the ladder, falling approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a bruised left lung, shoulder, and knee, as well as a bruised and abraded back.

An employee was using a flight simulator and was attempting to slide the right seat (passenger).  The vertical seat adjustment lever was activated instead of the horizontal adjustment, and the seat went down while his right hand was searching underneath for the horizontal seat adjustment mechanism, amputating a fingertip.

An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift lost traction and hit a racking system. When the employee attempted to brace himself, his right hand was caught between the mast and the rack, pinning his right wrist.
An employee moving a part with a crane was struck by the part, suffering a head injury.

An employee was inspecting bridge-cleaning activities and was walking on the 5' 6"-high wood bridge with 14" rails. The employee took a step back, tripped on the rail, and lost balance. The employee fell back off the bridge and suffered neck fractures.

An employee was cutting a branch with a hand saw. The hand saw cut through the branch faster than expected and struck his left hand, lacerating the tendon between his ring and pinky fingers. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee tried to open a gate while on a forklift truck when his finger was pinched between the gate and a concrete wall. The distal phalange on his right ring finger was amputated.
An employee was removing panels from the building while working on top of a connex trailer. The employee fell from the trailer and suffered fractured vertebrae.
An employee was repairing a flow pipe when he tripped and fell backward with the flow pipe on his body. He fractured his left ankle.

On or about April 14, 2016, at approximately 7 AM, a crane operator and an employee were setting up to carry a load to the mill. The crane operator was setting riggers for the crane while the employee was in the area when the crane's outrigger crushed the employee's left foot, fracturing it and possibly amputating toes.
An employee was operating a crane when a piece of steel tubing fell on and crushed his left foot. He was hospitalized.
While cleaning up liquid that leaked from frozen meat onto the floor, an employee slipped and fell, suffering a tendon injury to the shoulder and a muscle injury to the buttocks.

An employee was working with a piece of metal on a shear machine while wearing gloves when his hand became caught on the machine guard. The guard pulled the glove and his left middle finger into the machine, amputating the fingertip almost to the first knuckle.
An employee was leading horses to the stable at night when a horse was spooked. The horse turned and kicked the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was entering the hospital facility when she tripped on the floor mat and fell, breaking her wrists and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping coworkers move a canoe rack when it dropped on his right ring finger, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee was using a ladder to enter the office through the window above the office door. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a fractured right elbow.
An employee selecting product from the racks fell to the floor after a pallet jack went by, breaking his left wrist.

An employee was tossed from an aerial lift/bucket when the silo/pole being lifted broke away and struck the arm of the aerial lift. The employee sustained a broken left ankle and pelvis, a punctured lung, and a concussion.

An employee was installing internet on a mid span cable using a 28-foot extension ladder. While the employee was descending, the ladder shifted and the employee fell to the ground, suffering contusions.

While crossing a passageway, an employee was struck by a forklift being operated by another worker, suffering a broken tibia and fibula. At the time of the incident, the forklift driver's view was blocked by the lift's jib.
An employee operating a stand-up forklift had just put a pile of empty pallets under a rack at floor level. While backing away, he hit the rack behind him, injuring his left hip.
An employee was loading a dolly when the dolly slipped, amputating the employee's left index finger before the first knuckle.

An employee was using a saw to cut the window meeting rail when the saw guard activated and came down on the employee's right thumb, trapping it between the guard and the work table. A coworker came over and tried to help him unpin his thumb. When his coworker grabbed the saw, the sawblade activated and amputated the tip of the employee's trapped right thumb.

On 4-14-2016, at 12:15 p.m., two employees were dispatched to trench, lay cable, and connect service to an underground pedestal. During the installation, the first employee fell on the second employee, who was preparing the wire to be installed in the pedestal's energized bar. The first employee's left arm made contact with the energized 120-volt bar and was electrocuted. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a wood beam as part of the framing for the garage of a new home construction. He was carrying the beam up an A-frame ladder when he lost his balance and fell. The beam fell on top of him. He sustained an eye injury and head laceration.

An employee was transferring wax from a storage tank into a tanker truck. The employee opened a valve that was under pressure and a fire occurred. The employee sustained second and third degree burns to the face and neck.
An employee was replacing heat tape on the head of a plastic film bagger when the machine head cycled and pinched his left hand, partially amputating his third and fourth fingertips.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting an ink press when his jacket was caught in the antilock and cylinder gear of the flexographic press. His right arm was pulled into the machine and was amputated from the elbow down. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee and coworker were installing a cable lifeline while standing on a scaffold platform. The wall plate of the middle scaffold support broke at the connection point, causing the employee and coworker to fall approximately 12 feet. The employee was hospitalized with a ruptured spleen, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle when she lost balance and grabbed onto the throttle. When she grabbed the throttle, she drove into a wall, smashing her leg between a rack and the vehicle. She suffered a large laceration that required surgery.

An employee was canting a pole (moving a power pole from the ground to a standing position) when the rope and cant hook slipped because they were wet. The employee fell backwards and put his hands behind him to catch himself. He landed on his right hand and broke it near the wrist.

An employee was using a cutting torch to disassemble a steel processing tank. The employee was working on the top of the tank, approximately 7 feet above a lower level. The employee walked over a section of the tank that had previously been cut but was still attached to the structure. The section gave way and the employee fell approximately 7 feet to the ground, fracturing the pelvis and left elbow. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was installing a machine gear on an elevator using rigging and chain falls when the employee's left pinky was pinched in the rigging, removing the fingernail and some flesh.
An employee was moving flippers for the lumber to go up to the rack. The employee's gloved hand was caught in a 12-foot long shaft, resulting in a left thumb amputation.
An employee was bending rebar when part of his little finger was amputated.

An employee had just completed nailing a pallet with a nail gun. The employee's finger was on the trigger as the nail gun was set down. The nail gun brushed the employee's upper leg and went off. The nail punctured the employee's right kneecap.

An employee was filling a natural gas powered vehicle. A noise startled the employee, who then fell backward and made contact with the lip of the fueling island, breaking his right leg in the process. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee putting thread protectors on drill pipe was resting his hand on a TM-80 iron rough neck. The rough neck operator did not see his hand and started retracting the equipment, which caught the employee's right hand in a pinch point and broke a bone.

While operating an erosion blanket machine, the employee attempted to clean hay out of the machine. His left hand was caught on the belt and his arm was pulled in, causing a broken left ring finger, laceration, and crushing injuries to the left arm.

The employee was going to address a mechanical or electrical problem that occurred and caused some shingles to fall onto the floor.  The employee went to pick up the shingles on the floor and when he stood up, he struck his head on the conveyor resulting in neck and back injuries.

An employee was changing the cassette in a large commercial kitchen dishwasher when the solution inside the dishwasher spilled out onto the employee's feet. The employee suffered a chemical burn and was hospitalized with an infection.
An employee was using a table saw to cut flooring when the saw partially amputated his right-hand ring and middle fingers.

An employee was inspecting a newly delivered military tank. The wind caught the hatch as it was being opened and caused the employee to fall approximately 11 feet from the top of the tank to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken rib and head lacerations.

An employee was performing product quality checks on an AccuShear press machine. As she was lining up the product, the press cycled and the cylinder came down, crushing and amputating her third left-hand fingertip.

An employee was unhooking a crane hook from a conveyor that was loaded on the flatbed of a truck. The hook or chain from the crane caught on the conveyor, causing it to tip and knock the employee off the trailer. The employee suffered severe right leg injuries.

An employee was cleaning a piece of equipment while standing on a 6-foot fold-out ladder. The employee placed his second foot back on the ladder and felt as if the ladder was going to tip over.  To avoid falling on his back, he dismounted the ladder, landing on the ground and fracturing his right knee.

On or about April 15, 2016, an employee was setting trusses on a post frame agriculture building. While coming down from the trusses, the employee fell approximately 11 feet to the ground, sustaining upper and lower back contusions and requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee had just completed her break and was in the process of returning to work. The employee was walking towards the door when another employee walked through the door startling the injured employee.  The injured employee fell backwards and fractured her pelvis.
An employee stepped onto a pallet on the floor to reach a box overhead. He fell backward to the concrete floor and broke his hip, requiring overnight hospitalization.

Employees were offloading pipe onto a pipe stand. An employee's hand was resting on the pipe stand and when the pipe came down, his hand was pinched between the pipe and the pipe stand, breaking his left index finger.

An employee and coworker were working 10 feet off the ground in an aerial lift. They climbed onto a 4-foot by 5-foot wall landing and were trying to bend a piece of rebar when the injured employee lost his balance and tripped into his coworker. Both employees fell from the wall landing. The injured employee landed on his back, breaking it.
An employee's finger was partially amputated when it was caught in a strap being used to rig pipe.
On or about April 15, 2016, at 2 a.m., an employee was exposed to chemicals used to strip/wax floors and suffered an asthma attack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to clear a jam from a degater machine when his right middle fingertip and nail were amputated. He lost approximately one-eighth of an inch of his fingertip.

An employee was adjusting the chains on a piece of equipment, preparing it to be lifted by an overhead crane. The coworker operating the crane let go of the control button for lowering the chains. The injured employee thought the crane had already come to a complete stop, so he attempted to adjust the chains. His left hand was on one of the chains and while adjusting the other chain with his right hand, the chain tightened and slapped against his left hand, amputating his left middle fingertip.
An employee was splicing two wires using the terminal press when her left index finger entered the point of operation and was amputated.
On 4/15/16, an employee was operating a cutter machine when his right index finger was amputated to about the second knuckle.

An employee in an aerial lift was pulling on a come-along to align a piece of steel. The chain broke and struck the employee's leg, knocking him to the floor of the lift. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
On April 15, 2016, a cable dropped and hit a concrete surface. A piece of metal from the cable struck an employee and injured the employee's liver.
An employee was adjusting a resin band with a bamboo knife when his hand was pulled into the fabric area. The lamination equipment pulled off part of his fingers (no bone loss).

An employee was operating a heat sealer machine. The employee was holding a die in place that was used to seal yellow vinyl fabric. When the under plate came down, the employee's finger was crushed, amputating one-third of the right index finger (including the first knuckle).
An employee was using a tire jack to change a tire on a postal vehicle when the jack handle struck him in the head.
An employee fell and fractured her left femur while walking toward the elevator bank. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell 17 feet, 6 inches, and was hospitalized with injuries.
An employee tripped and fell while using a two-wheel dolly, breaking ribs.

At approximately 11:00 AM on April 15, 2016, an employee was cutting cow bones using a band saw.  The employee's right hand came into contact with the band saw, amputating the right pinky finger just below the first joint (distal phalanx).
While moving equipment in a surgical suite, an employee's left elbow was cut by a suction machine. The employee was hospitalized when the cut became infected.

An employee was attempting to reinstall a concrete pouring conveyor cable on a pulley. The employee operated the conveyor controls to cycle the pulley and re-engage the cable. The employee's thumb tip was pinched and partially amputated between the pulley and cable.
While vacuuming paint chips from a curb, an employee was struck by a bus and pinned against the curb, suffering a left calf injury.
While walking and conducting a border perimeter check, an employee slipped and fell 15 feet, breaking an arm.

While walking in the front lobby, an employee tripped over a piece of the floor that was damaged and had a mat over it while awaiting repair. The employee fell to the ground, sustaining facial and shoulder fractures.
While an employee was wiping debris from a plastic compression mold press, the vertical injector plate came down and partially amputated the employee's left middle and index fingertips.
While attempting to clean out clogged material from the fat sucker machine, an employee suffered a partial amputation of the right hand distal middle finger. The machine was running at the time.
An employee amputated two right-hand fingers while cutting meat with a band saw.
While carrying a box of parts, an employee tripped over a pallet and fell, injuring the left knee and fracturing a femur.

An employee shut off the screw conveyor to readjust the machine's lid and prevent ground meat from leaking onto the floor. As the employee was closing the cover of the screw conveyor, the passing fulcrum lever amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was handing out food samples when she tripped over a customer's foot, fracturing her left femur and hip.

An employee was attempting to disconnect a hose from a 4-inch centrifugal pump on a rig that was under pressure. When the employee released the fittings, the hoses blew apart, spraying hot mud that burned the right side of the employee's face, neck, shoulder, and head, as well as his right arm and back.
On 4/16/16, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift. He suffered serious leg/ankle injuries and was hospitalized.

On April 16, 2016, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was playing a softball game as part of a leadership retreat. While attempting to catch a fly ball, the employee ran into a foul pole and struck it head on. The employee was hospitalized with a facial injury.
While an employee was cutting product in the deli, the employee's knife came into contact with a hole in the employee's glove, amputating the left middle fingertip and fingernail.

An employee and his coworker were loading a kayak onto the forks of a forklift. The forks were on the ground when the employee walked backward and tripped over the forks. He fractured his left wrist and required surgery.
An employee's left index finger was amputated while attempting to clear a piece of meat from a meat mixing machine.
A maintenance employee was replacing a double backer belt on a corrugator when he fell approximately 41.5 inches off of the machine, fracturing his hip.

An employee's work vehicle became stuck in the snow at a customer location. The customer offered to tow the truck with his vehicle, and when the employee was attaching the tow rope, the customer's vehicle slid down the hill and pinned the employee between the two vehicles. The employee suffered 10 broken ribs, two collapsed lungs, and a broken clavicle.
An employee's right middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle when the employee attempted to grab a part in the conveyor belt.

An employee was performing maintenance, replacing a ribbon in an ironer. He tried to pull the ribbon by placing the slack end around his finger. The ironer then turned on and lacerated his right middle finger, which was still wrapped around the ribbon.
An employee's left-hand middle and ring fingers were partially amputated.
A pot of hot water fell on an employee, causing second degree burns to her chest, underarms, and face.
An employee was assisting workers on a machine when his thumb was caught and cut between the machine and a crowbar. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches.
On or about April 17, 2016, an employee stumbled while descending the steps from a turn table, landed on a track rail, and turned the left foot. The employee suffered a broken bone above the ankle.
An employee was heating a mold with a natural gas burner when the hose came loose and caught on fire, burning the employee's face and neck.
An employee fell on stairs and fractured her knee while delivering mail to a private residence after being startled by a dog in the yard.

On 4/17/16, an employee was delivering tiles to a customer's residence in a truck. After unloading the tiles, the employee fractured his right tibia and fibula while exiting the truck. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting bone-in meat with a band saw when the saw blade severely cut two of the employee's fingers, requiring surgery.

On 4/17/16, an employee was cutting down trees to clear an oil field well pad site. A previously cut tree became caught up in the tree he was currently cutting. The tree then fell down and struck his right leg, breaking it.
While cleaning a sifter and rotary valve, an employee's left-hand index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee and crew were attempting to install an I-beam support upright between two horizontal running I-beam supports in an existing structure. The crew carried the support and fit it in place. The injured employee tapped the bottom of the support with a hammer to make it fit. The bottom of the beam fell off and landed on the employee's right foot, breaking the fifth toe.
An employee suffered four left-hand finger amputations while performing maintenance on the rotating drum of the Opener #1 machine.
An employee was operating a chop saw to cut wood studs when the chop saw activated via the foot pedal, amputating the employee's left mid-forearm.
While pulling a tool cart, an employee fell to the concrete floor while trying to grab a part. She fractured her L2 vertebra.
An employee was conducting pre-operational adjustments on a DSI machine. While closing a panel, his left pinky finger was caught and amputated between the panel and the machine.
An employee was using the freight elevator when his hand was caught between the gate door and the landing door. One finger was crushed, and another was nearly amputated.
An employee was dismounting a ladder when he missed the last rung and fell on his side, fracturing his upper leg area.
An employee crushed his thumb between a door jamb and the railing on a scissor lift while lowering the lift from inside the basket.
At approximately 8:00 a.m., on 04/18/16, an employee was reaching for an anchor point to secure his lanyard when he slipped and fell off of the roof . He was hospitalized with broken bones.
An employee was attempting to unjam a label in the Automatan machine when his left hand became caught between two rollers and was de-gloved. The equipment was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was working from an order picker and fell approximately 12 feet. The employee suffered a broken hip, pelvis, and leg. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
On April 18, 2016, an employee separating trash cans on the receiving docks began to experience shoulder pain. The employee was hospitalized with a collapsed lung.

An employee was removing debris from a piece of equipment. He hit the stop button. While reaching for the debris, he activated a proximity sensor. 
The sensor in turn activated a solenoid, which activated the cylinder. This caused the die set to come down and crush/amputate his right index finger.

While walking to the HR desk, an employee tripped over the lower part of a vertical stanchion at the same level and fell to the ground. The employee suffered head and back injuries, as well as a fractured femur that required surgery and hospitalization.

Two employees were manually lifting a power cooling fan (approximately 60 pounds) off a stack of units on a pallet. While lowering a unit on a cart, the injured employee lost grip, or the unit shifted, and the employee suffered a left wrist laceration requiring surgery.
Employees were adjusting an 8-feet-wide rollup door. The clamp holding the door up slipped, causing the door to come forward and strike/lacerate an employee's left ear.

On or about April 18, 2016, an employee was helping a coworker lift the top combo from a stack of four combos. The combo slid off and cut employee's middle finger. The finger was surgically amputated above the first joint.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot and broke several ribs. The employee was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was observing a pipe liner as it was being extended to the stationary steel pipe in the ground. The pipe liner was slightly offline, and the employee tried to manually guide it in place right as it was making contact with the pipe. The liner jerked up as he was leaning over it and it hit him in the chin with force. He suffered a chin laceration requiring 5 stitches and was knocked unconscious. Employee was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was fabricating metal. He drew it over and was grinding off the weld when a tacked piece of metal used to clamp the weld shield came free and hit the grinder. The grinder fell over and cut his right forearm.

An employee was measuring the inside of a metal cone area while on a ladder 30 inches above the floor. The employee was on the top step of the ladder when he and the ladder fell to the side. He fractured his wrist and two ribs.
An employee was hospitalized after falling off a truck and hitting their head.
While exiting a vehicle, an employee slipped off the vehicle step, hit her forehead on the step, and fell to the ground, hitting her head.
An employee's right thumb was crushed while he was trying to prevent an excavator from falling.
An employee was trying to adjust his truck's trailer brakes when the truck and loaded trailer rolled backward onto his right arm.
An employee was on a 5-foot fixed ladder, descending a work platform, when he missed a ladder rung and slid down the ladder to the floor. He fractured his right foot and required surgery.
