An employee was installing metal roofing on a porch roof when the supporting pole collapsed.  The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, fracturing his elbow, pelvis, and two ribs.

An employee was taking plastic bottles from a conveyor and placing them on a pallet. While walking between the stretch wrapping machine and the conveyor, the employee tripped over the stretch wrapping machine and fell to the ground, fracturing the lower back.
An employee was operating a maintenance cart, clearing off areas of the golf course, when the cart rolled. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and internal injuries.

An employee was stacking a unit of corrugated sheets when his foot entered the path of an automated material transfer cart. His left leg was pinned between the cart and a conveyor when a coworker stopped the machine. He fractured his left ankle and lacerated both legs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working at her computer when she experienced respiratory distress due to a coworker's perfume, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving hot oil in the kitchen when some of it spilled on her and burned both of her hands. She was hospitalized.
On April 19, 2016, an employee fell off a mobile scaffold and was hospitalized for a broken leg.
An employee was cleaning a window frame with alcohol when sparks from a nearby grinder ignited the alcohol, burning the employee.

An employee was working from a pallet raised on the forks of a powered industrial truck when he fell approximately 6.5 feet while emptying a tray of spoiled tomatoes into a dumpster. He fractured his head and pelvis.

An employee was scanning for overhead hazards after falling a tree. Everything looked okay.  He walked towards the tree and was struck by a falling limb that was in a different tree. The employee sustained a neck injury.

After responding to an out-of-gas call, an employee was attempting to light a gas-fired log set (fireplace) for the customer when a propane flash fire occurred. He suffered burns to his hands and face, with possible respiratory burns.
An employee was standing on the second step of a step ladder stocking cigarettes when she fell off the ladder, injuring her ribs.
An employee was cutting metal bands containing paper bales when a 500-pound bale fell from the stack and onto the employee. She sustained crushing and struck-by injuries, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had completed his lockout/tag-out procedure after cleaning the central cement batch mixer. He closed the central cement batch mixer, removed all locks and tags, and re-energized the central power source of the central cement batch mixer. He heard a strange noise coming from inside the mixer, so he shut down the mixer's power source, followed lockout/tag-out procedures, opened one of the hatches at the top of the batch mixer, and noticed a hammer inside of the central cement batch mixer. When he reached into the mixer to retrieve the hammer, the paddle struck the right side of his head, fracturing his face and partially amputating his right ear lobe. He was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to work on a paper machine when his left hand was pulled into the machine, removing flesh on two fingers.
An employee tripped and fell while walking down a hall, fracturing her hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was pushing a rack when the rack fell over on his left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was lowering a porcelain post from an electrical transmission line in the "right of way" when the post fell onto the employee. The employee suffered shoulder and spleen injuries.
An employee was operating a shear machine when the machine actuated. The hydraulic drop came down and amputated the employee's right index finger.
On April 19, 2016, an employee was rounding up cattle when a bull spooked the employee's horse. The horse threw the employee to the ground, breaking four of the employee's ribs.
An employee's hand was caught in a pinch point while raising one of the legs of a cable form, partially amputating the left-hand index finger.

An employee was guiding an 8" PVC water pipe that was attached by a synthetic sling to the bucket of an excavator. The pipe was being set in place when the sling slipped from the pipe. The pipe rolled on the ground and struck the employee in the leg, fracturing the employee's upper thigh bone.

Employees were removing a loading arm from the loading platform and were using a rope to hold the loading arm in place. The rope snapped, which caused the arm to swing down and hit an employee in the chest. The blow knocked him off of the platform and onto the concrete below, a distance of approximately 11.5'. He fractured his neck vertebra and skull.
An employee was struck by a closing overhead door. He bounced off the door and fell backwards, hitting and fracturing the back of his head on the ground.

While selecting an order, an employee was struck by falling material from a broken pallet that was being moved by a forklift approximately 30' above. The employee suffered a broken leg and head injuries.
An employee on a PT run with the Hotshot Firefighters (elite crew) collapsed on 4/19/2016 at 5:00PM and was hospitalized for heat stroke.

An employee was helping to set up a trellis from a man basket being lifted by forklift. The basket sat directly on top of the forks, approximately 14-to 16-feet-high. When the employee moved to the end of the basket, the basket tipped and he fell out. The basket then landed on top of him. He broke teeth, fractured multiple ribs, broke his back, and suffered internal stomach bleeding. The basket was not secured at the time of the incident.
An employee was placing a part into a brake press machine to form it when the machine activated before he removed his finger. The top die pinched off the end of his left index finger.

On 04/19/2016, at about 5:00 p.m., an employee was installing new lights on wires when a coworker turned on the breaker. The employee received an electric shock and fell 4 feet off the ladder. He was hospitalized overnight with second-degree electrical burns to one of his hands.
An employee was walking on unpaved terrain. While attempting to get back on the paved path, she tripped on the 4-inch step up to the path and fell forward, breaking her hip.

An employee lost his grip on a dolly and file cabinet he was moving up a flight of stairs. The cabinet fell down the stairs, hitting the employee below and breaking his leg. The injured employee was hospitalized.
While operating a forklift in a sequence cell, an employee struck a column and lacerated the left foot.
An employee was using a ratchet wrench to tighten a bolt when the wrench slipped, catching his finger between it and a piece of steel. His left-hand third fingertip was amputated.
An employee was standing in the gymnasium bouncing a basketball. When the employee turned to walk away, he dislocated his hip and fell to the floor fracturing his hip.
An employee was working in Aisle 13 on a walkie rider. While backing out of the aisle he ran into another employee's cherry picker in Aisle 14. The employee broke his ankle.
The employee was unloading empty racks from a trailer. One rack tipped over and struck the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a laceration.
The employee cut his hand. He was later hospitalized when the cut became infected.

On 4-19-16, an employee suffered the amputation of the distal tip of the left index finger. The tip was reattached and there was no bone separation. The injured worker placed his hand inside of a valve port to move metal shavings out of the way so that he would not damage the finish cut of a compressor. The injured worker is not sure if the shavings cut his finger or if it was the rotation of the bore mill machine that cut his finger.
An employee fell off a rear ladder while trying to climb into a box truck. He broke his right leg and shoulder and required hospitalization.
An employee was walking when he was struck by rubber gaskets that fell from a height of approximately 10 feet. He was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle.

An employee was cutting wood using a table saw. The employee's right hand contacted the saw blade resulting in multiple lacerations to the right hand index, ring and pinky fingers. Two digits were amputated.
An employee tripped over the cord of the ham slicer, fell to the ground, and fractured his right shoulder.
An employee was cleaning the metal detector with a hose when a ball valve actuator amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was preparing to pour bridge deck when his pants and subsequently right leg were caught and pulled into the deck finishing machine. He was hospitalized with a fractured right leg.

An employee was replacing a belt on a bagging machine when it activated. The machine jaws amputated a portion of the employee's left middle finger. Lockout/tag-out procedures were not followed at the time of the incident.
An employee was at the bottom of a ramp painting a container when a forklift driver backing down the ramp ran over the employee's right leg.

An employee was replacing the spring and U-bolt behind a tire. He was replacing the tire when the jack collapsed, catching and amputating the distal phalanges on his right-hand middle and ring fingers.

An employee was working on a workover rig. While the crew was running pipe in the bore hole, the employee's hand was caught between two strands of pipe. The distal phalanges of the employee's right-hand middle finger was crushed and partially amputated.
An employee entering an interview room in the hospital slipped on the floor and struck their head on the door frame. The employee suffered a neck strain/sprain and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee fell and sustained a hip injury.

On April 20, 2016, at approximately 6:15 p.m., an employee was helping to move a precast concrete panel on a dry wall cart. The 12' x 60" concrete panel, weighing 1200 pounds, was loaded by forklift onto the cart, which had a load capacity of 3200 pounds. The cart was being navigated through a doorway by two employees. While making a turn, the wheels swiveled. The injured employee reached behind the panel and grabbed the cart to pull it forward.  The panel lost its center of balance and fell forward and onto the employee, fracturing his shoulder, ribs, pelvis, and three vertebrae. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing coping while working from an extension ladder when the ladder kicked out at the bottom, causing him to fall approximately 10 feet. He hit the ground and broke his left arm and left leg.
An employee had just finished loading a truck and was stepping out of the vehicle when he fell and struck his head on concrete. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
On 04/20/16, at approximately 12:24 a.m., an employee was cleaning a table with a rag when he tripped on the table leg and fell backwards. He was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

An employee was repairing a storage rack in the warehouse using a drill machine. The employee turned off the drill, and the still-rotating drill bit grabbed his right-hand glove and index finger.  The drill was then activated, amputating his right-hand index finger at the midpoint.

An employee brought a straddle truck into the shop to change the right rear shoe assembly lifting cylinder. He used a floor jack to support the weight of the lifting shoe so the locking clamp that holds the lifting shoe onto the hydraulic lifting cylinder shaft could be removed. The employee had a crescent wrench in his right hand at the time and taped on the clamp but found that the clamp was already free of the shaft. He attempted to push the back half of the clamp out to remove it from around the cylinder shaft and put the clamp on the floor. As he was doing this with his left hand, he put his right hand down on the floor to support himself while kneeling. The jack came out from under the shoe, and the shoe dropped a few inches to the floor. The wrench the employee had in his right hand was partially under the shoe when it dropped. The shoe fell onto the end of the wrench, and the employee's fingers were caught between the wrench handle and the floor, amputating the right-hand index and middle fingers at the first joint.
An employee was exiting the building when a gust of air grabbed the door. He lost control of the door and it slammed on his left middle finger, amputating the tip on the palm side.
An employee was removing a piece of jammed wood from the chop saw when his right-hand pinky finger was amputated by the blade.

An employee was on a telescoping ladder pulling cable. The ladder did not lock properly and collapsed, causing the employee to fall 5 to 6 feet.  The employee was hospitalized with a broken wrist requiring surgery.
An employee fell down the concrete stairs, fracturing her ribs and puncturing her lung.

After unloading a rail car of feed pellets, an employee was helping to move the rail car. He went to slow the rail car with the turn brake and his left foot was run over by the rail car. His fractured foot required surgery.

An employee was climbing up an extension ladder to caulk a wood soffit which was 10 feet above the ground when he slipped and fell about five feet onto the concrete sidewalk resulting in a left wrist fracture and possible bruising to the left leg.

An employee was cutting a 3/4-inch plywood using a table saw when the riving knife broke, struck the saw blade, and was thrown forward, striking and lacerating the employee's right bicep. The employee was hospitalized and required wrist surgery.

An employee was strapping supply wood. The employee saw that the panel saw was not working properly and tried to fix the problem. The accumulator arm came in to catch the plywood panels while the X-lift was discharging the full load of plywood. The panels on the other side of the machine did not catch the accumulator arm, and the panels fell through and hit the X-lift. As the X-lift was coming back up, the employee saw the panels sticking up. He tried to push the panels on top of the X-lift. By that time, the X-lift had gone up, and his right hand was caught between the X-lift and the accumulator arm, resulting in a compound fracture to his right arm. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was transferring a piece of plate metal from one pallet to another. A forklift stood the metal plate up on the edge of the pallet. The plate metal fell over and struck the employee's leg, fracturing the femur.

An employee was attempting to load a piece of medical equipment on the bed of a truck when the equipment shifted, crushing and amputating the employee's finger between the truck's lift gate and the equipment.
An employee was walking toward the front door of the bank when she stepped on a rock and slipped, falling on and breaking her right hip.
An employee was delivering mail to home addresses when a dog startled her. As she ran away from the dog, she fell and fractured her left forearm.
While operating a chop saw to cut a piece of PVC plastic on 4/20/16, an employee amputated the left thumb.
An employee fell approximately 5 feet off a crane while checking fluid levels and fractured his leg.

An employee dropped a piece of ice on the ground while removing a cap from a combo.  He tried to move the piece of ice out of the walkway with his foot, lost his balance and fell to the ground. He fractured the tibia and dislocated the ankle.
An employee was installing a 10" piece of duct over a doorway when his belt was caught on the ladder, causing him to fall and break his wrist and elbow. He was hospitalized.

On 4/20/2016, a piece of plywood sheeting, used in poured concrete construction, fell from a floor above and struck the head of an employee standing on the ground, cracking his hardhat. He was hospitalized with a concussion and lacerations.

An employee was replacing a residential septic system using an excavator.  He placed his left hand on the bucket of the excavator to gain leverage as he moved an object with his foot.  His force against the bucket caused the bucket to move.  The movement of the bucket created a pinch point between the bucket and "thumb" of the bucket. His left ring finger was caught and crushed in the pinch point.

An employee was preparing to change a table saw's blade. Before doing so, he cut another piece of wood. As he finished cutting the board, the lumber shifted and his left hand was caught in the blade, amputating the last three fingertips on his left hand. The saw's automatic feed guard was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee's left index finger was caught in the concrete delivery chute during installation. The wound would not heal therefore, the finger was medically amputated.
An employee fell and broke his upper right leg when stepping down from a 24-inch-high A-frame cart used to transport glass.

An employee and his coworker were about to change a V-belt on an exhaust fan. They disconnected the power of the fan, but the momentum of the air handler caused the fan to spin in reverse. When the employee attempted to stop the fan blades from moving, his pinky fingertip was amputated.  His middle and ring fingers were also injured.
An employee was loading rebar onto the forks of a forklift when the rebar rolled off the forks and struck the employee, breaking the right leg.
An employee's right hand was caught between a beam and a pressure roller and amputated.

An employee took the cover off a chain and tried to grease a bearing. The PTO was engaged and the chain was moving at the time. When the employee put one pump in, the chain caught his glove, sending his fingers in through the sprocket and chain. His left thumb was partially amputated, and his index, middle, and ring fingers were lacerated and crushed.
An employee was performing maintenance on a piece of machinery when the machine became energized and amputated his right index finger.

An employee was in the back of a pickup truck with a lift. The employee was standing on the lift as it was being raised. His foot was hanging over the edge and his right big toe was caught. The injury requires surgery and the toe may be amputated.

An employee was threading some 3-inch conduit when he identified burrs that needed removal.  He was using his channel locks to get rid of the burrs when the channel locks grabbed and pulled his left hand into the machine. The fingertip of his left pinky finger was surgically amputated above the fingernail.

An employee was troubleshooting a cable drum when the drum was activated. The employee's harness was caught by the cable, which flipped him over the drum. He landed on his head, suffering a 3-inch head laceration.
On 4/21/16, at approximately 9:20 AM, an employee accidentally drank cleaning solution while mixing an iced tea.
An employee was clearing a jam on a machine using a hammer.  As he used the hammer to hit the material, his hand struck a metal bar, amputating his right ring finger at the third knuckle.

An employee had finished walking a dog and was about to re-enter the building when the dog tried to run and pulled the employee. She hit the building and fell to the ground, fracturing her right humerus.
An employee was getting ready to run a board through the punch press. The punch press cycled while her left hand was inside it, amputating four fingers.
An employee opened an electrical cabinet door while conducting an infrared survey. An arc flash occurred, burning the employee.

An employee was operating the laminator machine and was trying to move material through the winding bar, but the material would not roll through. When he attempted to pull the material through, his arm was caught in the winding bar. He required surgery on his right forearm.

On 04/21/16, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was cutting a concrete pipe with a cut-off saw. The blade became stuck, and the guard that covers the blade struck the left side of the employee's face, fracturing the orbital bone and causing lacerations.
Employees were removing the last tracks from a rider plate. When they hit the last track, the metal plate popped up and struck the injured employee, fracturing the employee's right tibial plateau.

An employee was working with a screwdriver to remove a screw from a 480-volt circuit breaker when he hit an energized switchboard. An arc flash occurred, burning the employee's face and arm and requiring hospitalization.
While cutting down wooden beams, an employee suffered a small knee puncture. The employee was hospitalized when the wound became infected.
While adjusting a patient in bed, an employee experienced abdominal pain due to a hernia, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

As an employee was collecting garbage and throwing two bags in the back of the garbage truck, the driver pulled forward and then backed up and hit the employee. He was hospitalized with two fractured legs.
An employee fell from a platform roof, injuring his pelvis and breaking a wrist and arm.
An employee was sitting at her desk. When she tried standing up, her shoe became tangled in the chair roller and she fell down. She was hospitalized with a vertebra fracture.
An employee was hospitalized due to dehydration after picking pickles in the field.
An employee tripped on the wheel of a medication cart and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury.
An employee stepped off a forklift and rolled his left ankle, breaking it.
An employee tripped and fell while moving a sign in the reception area, dislocating the left shoulder.

An employee was putting parts into the back of his pick-up truck using material handling equipment.  Once the part was in place it shifted/rolled over and smashed his pinky finger.  The bone was fractured in three different places.
While replacing a light fixture, an employee suffered a shock injury and fell from a ladder to the ground. The employee suffered contusions and minor burns.

An employee was operating the pallet machine, which prepares pallets of rice for transport. A bag of rice fell off the pallet while being transported via rollers to where the pallets are wrapped in plastic. The employee went to grab the bag and his right glove was caught between the rollers, amputating his right index finger pad.
An employee fell from a ladder on the roof while troubleshooting a solar system installation project, breaking right-side ribs and fracturing an ankle.

Two employees were working at a food preparation and heating cart when a flash fire occurred as they opened the door to the heating compartment, shooting flames out at the employees. One employee received second degree burns to the hands and face; the other employee received third degree burns to the hands and face.
An employee fell from the mezzanine while installing a permanent guardrail, suffering a pelvis fracture and elbow injury.

An employee was hydro blasting on top of a vertical exchanger with a 20,000-psi cleaning lance when he lost his balance and control of the lance. The water stream from the lance cut through his metatarsal boot, lacerating the top of his right foot.

An employee was repairing a forklift used in the facility. While the employee's hands were inside the forklift making repairs, the forklift shifted, amputating the employee's left index finger and lacerating his other fingers.
An employee was holding a part in a machine when the machine cycled and amputated the employee's finger.

On April 22, 2016, an employee was backing up in the trench while directing an excavator operator to come back with the bucket when he was crushed between the excavator bucket and a water main behind him. He suffered cracked ribs and contusions to the left side of his chest.
An employee was cleaning when a valve failure caused hot water and steam to release in the area where he was working. He suffered second degree burns on both hands and was hospitalized.

On April 22, 2016, at approximately 7:15 a.m., an employee was operating a notch saw. While the employee was placing a 4-foot piece of vinyl in the saw, the saw was activated by the foot pedal. The saw amputated the employee's left index finger below the nail bed.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet out the back of a truck while loading food carts on a plane, impacting the ground and suffering an injury.
An employee received an electrical shock while pushing a cart.
While exiting a vehicle, an employee slipped off a step, landed on the ground, and broke his femur.
An employee was performing carpentry work with a table saw when his left index finger was lacerated by the saw. His finger had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was feeding metal parts into a rolling machine when her glove became caught in the rollers and her hand was pulled into the machine. She suffered a pinky fracture and index fingertip amputation. Her ring finger required stitches.

An employee was standing on a ladder and using a manual pole saw to cut a tree limb. The manual pole saw extended about 8 to 10 feet. The saw became caught in the limb, and the employee was trying to free the saw from the limb. When the saw was freed from the limb, it fell, and the blade struck the employee's left arm above the elbow. He suffered a severe arm laceration.
On 4/20/16, an employee was grabbing screws out of a container to hang a frame when a metal shard went into the palm of his left hand. He required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee laid the dock plate down on a trailer bed to unload a trailer. A piece of wood was sticking out from the trailer wall, preventing the dock plate from laying all the way down.  The employee used his foot to kick the wood out of the way, which caused his foot to become stuck under the dock plate. His ankle broke and started bleeding.

An employee was standing on the floor plate of a drilling rig when the method of attaching the floor plate to the structure failed. The employee fell 17 feet to the ground, suffering a head laceration that required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell, injuring his leg/knee.
An intruder assaulted an employee and struck her head. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee retrieving refrigerated meat from the cooler tripped on a box/pallet corner and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a concussion and back pain and requiring hospitalization.

While an employee was unloading drums onto the cut porch, he bumped a drum behind him, which had his cell phone on top of it, causing the cell phone to fall into the cutter.  When he attempted to retrieve the cell phone from the cutter area, his right thumb and index finger were amputated right before the knuckle at palm level.

After making a batch of meat the employee opened up a hatch, which automatically shut off the machine. The employee's other hand entered into where the meat comes out of the grinder. The machine did not completely shut off, causing a fingertip amputation.
On April 22, 2016, an employee was cutting sheets of acrylic plastic with an unguarded table saw when his right pinky and ring fingertips were amputated.

On April 22, 2016, an employee was removing a grill from a trailer that was on a powered industrial vehicle (PIV). The employee's head/neck became caught between the PIV and the trailer, causing head/neck injuries that required hospitalization.

Three employees were investigating an H2S odor at a cooling tower. One of the employees removed the lid from the cooling tower and stuck a measuring rod in to measure the level. The employee put the lid back on and started walking away. The employee became lightheaded and fell onto the concrete walkway, requiring hospitalization for a concussion and skull fracture.
An employee was bending parts on a brake press when their finger entered the point of operation while the machine cycled.  The employee sustained a right index finger amputation.

An employee was setting up a powdered metal press for production. While he was attempting to check if the inner punch was firing, his left-hand middle finger was struck by the tooling, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on an automatic door switch when the door closed on the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was placing a bottom bar between forms on a module when his right index finger was caught and amputated in a pinch point between the leg of a material cart and the bottom bar.
An employee was cleaning out the straight-line rip saw when four left-hand digits were amputated.

Two employees were transporting hot oil when one of the employee's legs hit the pot of oil, causing it to spill on the employee's hand. The employee released the pot and the hot oil spilled onto and burned the employee's feet. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was climbing a caged, fixed ladder that was approximately 23 to 25 feet high. While he was standing on the top rung and attaching his fall protection lanyard, he slipped and fell approximately 8 to 10 feet inside the cage, breaking his ankle.
An employee suffered frostbite to the hands and fingers while cleaning racks in the freezer, requiring a finger amputation.

On April 22, 2016, at approximately 7:05am, an employee was hospitalized after being injured while moving a plastic water line on I-beams.  The employee and a coworker were rolling a 14 inch diameter PVC pipe weighing approximately 300 lbs. and 15 feet in length across I-beam stands.  During the roll, the pipe slipped off the I-beam and the employee's thumb was pinched between the I-beam and the pipe resulting in cuts and crushing injuries to the left thumb.
The employee was cleaning a bag sealing machine cutting blade and the machine cycled resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip.
While moving baseboards to the scrap pile, an employee was bitten on the hand by a rattlesnake.
On April 23, 2016, at approximately 4:30am, an employee was troubleshooting a press guard that was shaking when the employee's fingertip was amputated by the machine's moving conveyor.

An employee was acting as a spotter for a crane being moved. While standing between the crane and another stationary crane, the employee attempted to warn the crane operator that he was about to hit the other crane when he was crushed between the crane that was moving and the stationary crane. He suffered lung, hip, and head injuries and required surgery.

On April 23, 2016, at 1:00 a.m., an employee was setting a dock board to the back of a trailer. The trailer was not aligned properly with the loading dock bay. As the employee set the dock board, it began to slip. The employee descended from the sliding dock board to the pavement below the loading dock, suffering a compound fracture to his right leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was vertically lowering tubes (16-inch-diameter x 12-feet-long, with a flange on top; approximate weight= 1500 pounds) into an exchanger with an overhead crane. Due to slack in the lifting attachment, the employee grabbed the flange to try to turn the tube and align it with the lower tube sheet. His fingers were pinched between that tube and the adjacent tube, amputating the top joint of his right middle finger.

On 4-23-16, at 11:45 a.m., an employee was attempting to move materials out of the way on the bag line machine when his right index finger was caught between the chain and pulley, amputating the fingertip.

On April 23, 2016, at approximately 9:30 a.m., a maintenance employee was on a scissor lift with a coworker, preparing for an entombment. Working from the lift, the two employees removed the granite face from the mausoleum. As the granite was being lowered to the lift, the maintenance employee fell 12 feet from the lift and landed on the concrete surface below. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the face, both wrists, and jaw.
An employee was shot in the left forearm while serving a warrant, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking form the fuel kiosk to the store when she tripped and fell over a curb, dislocating her right elbow and breaking her left kneecap.

An employee was cleaning the equipment and floors in an area when an ammonia release occurred. The employee was exposed to the ammonia and suffered second degree burns to her right leg, requiring hospitalization.
Hot water splashed and burned an employee who was engaged in manufacturing operations.
An employee's right middle finger was cut while she was using an automatic slicer to slice cucumbers.
An employee was shot and wounded in the arm while serving an arrest warrant as part of an arrest team.
An employee was troubleshooting a metal door when a gust of wind hit the door, causing it to strike the employee's head. The employee suffered head trauma.

On April 23, 2016, at approximately 4:00 PM an employee experienced a crushing injury and fractures when he got his left forearm and wrist caught between rollers while troubleshooting calendar rolls on the extrusion line.  The injury required surgery.
An employee in the laboratory was stuck by a needle contaminated with a virus.
An employee was performing maintenance on a skinner machine when his right hand came in contact with the skinner blade, amputating the third fingertip above the joint and below the nail cuticle.
A client at a group home became violent and charged an employee. The employee was knocked to the ground and suffered a fractured knee.
While exiting a crane on a vessel, an employee slipped on the ladder and hit his head on the railing, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a sheet metal bender when a part became lodged in the machine. When the employee attempted to remove the part, the trolley that moved it through the machine hit the employee in the leg, breaking the left tibia.
An employee was changing a projector bulb when the bulb shattered, the glass caused a facial injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was unloading a metal rafter with an overhead traveling joist crane when the crane's clamp caught the edge of the rafter, causing the crane to tip over onto the employee. The employee suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access a storage area above an office unit. The ladder slipped from under the employee, and the employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground below, suffering a fractured rib and clavicle.
An employee suffered a broken right ankle and twisted right hip after tripping and falling over a power cord.
On 4-25-16, an employee fell through a floor opening between two joists on the second floor while attempting to glue the subfloor down.
While pushing a piece of track on a ride, an employee's left pinky finger was caught between two pieces of the track, amputating the fingertip.
An employee's hand was caught in a machine.
On April 25, 2016, an employee was attempting to straighten a crooked board on the trimmer machine when his right ring fingertip was pinched and amputated between two boards.
An employee was cutting a hole for an exhaust fan when the saw kicked back and lacerated his left big toe.
An employee was pulling a piece of duct work when the piece of duct fell onto his arm, severely cutting his wrist and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was taking a bumper off of a spotter tractor and the employee's finger got caught between the bumper and the vehicle body causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell through the roof to the concrete floor, requiring wrist surgery.

Employees were setting up pipe slips and the well-head ring needed to be centered. The injured employee was attempting to center the ring on the bottom of the flange. When the well flange came down, it caught his right pinky finger and smashed it at the joint. The finger was surgically amputated.
An employee fell about 10 feet while descending a ladder, suffering fractures.
An employee was pinned against a steel pen by a driver backing up her vehicle. The employee suffered crushing injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to clean the glue eye on a paper-covered wire machine when his left ring finger was pulled into the machine, amputating it. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
While an employee was cleaning a facility, a high-pressure water lance was accidentally activated. The lance shot forward and pierced through the flesh of his right forearm.

An employee was cutting down trees for the sawmill.  When he cut down a larger tree, it fell onto a smaller tree that then bowed over. The employee went to cut the smaller tree and it sprung back, hitting his left leg and breaking it below the knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was using the pop-up saw to cut scrap lumber into smaller pieces when the saw blade amputated her right thumb at the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a saw when a reel of product fell off the stand and crushed the employee's finger, breaking a bone and cutting it.
While lifting a patient in the bathroom, an employee fractured her back.

At about 5:00 a.m., on April 25, 2016, an employee fell approximately 15 feet into the pipe shop basement while removing spill iron from the back of a casting machine. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip and right wrist.
While he was operating a forklift, an employee's left leg was caught between a guardrail and the forklift, fracturing his left foot.
While operating a carding machine, an employee attempted to clean the card. The machine caught his finger, amputating it just below the fingernail.
An employee was setting up seine equipment to harvest fish from a pond when his hand was pulled into the chain and sprockets, injuring two fingers on his left hand.
The employee was operating the plastic compounding extruder and completing a screen change. When the plastic built up pressure, it came out of the screen change burning the employee's left forearm.
An employee was walking down the hall to lunch, tripped and fell fracturing the right hip.
On April 25, 2016, an employee's right hand was seriously injured when pulled into the smooth mill machine rollers, requiring hospitalization.
When an employee turned around while inspecting parts at the foam conveyor line, she suffered sharp pain in her lower back.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when she tripped and fell into a band saw blade, cutting her hand and breaking her thumb. She was hospitalized.

As an employee was removing a tube from a box while standing on a stair ladder, the box came off the shelf, causing the stair ladder and employee to fall 9.5 feet to the lower level. The employee landed on a box and broke his left hip, left wrist, and several left-side ribs; cut his spleen; and fractured his back vertebrae.

An employee was trying to pull down a section of drilling pipe from the back of a truck when one of the pipes fell down and pinched his right ring finger, amputating it between the first and second knuckles.

On April 25, 2016, at about 6:15 am, an employee fell against a parking lot curb while coming down some stairs. The employee suffered a broken arm and possibly a broken leg. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was a cutting a form board with a circular saw. The saw jammed and kicked back cutting the employee across the chest.

An employee attached a counter-weight to a chain that was being adjusted. The employee's glove was then caught on the chain and pulled into the sprocket, amputating the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell over an extension cord in the office, suffering a fractured hip.
While an employee was trying to lift a dock plate, the dock leveler fell on his right foot, injuring two toes.
An employee was using a power wash to clean a rebuilt gas compression unit when a flash fire occurred. The employee sustained 2nd degree burns on the hands, face, neck, and ears.

On 4/26/16, at approximately 5:15 AM, an employee was using a pneumatic chipping gun to break up hardened mortar inside the mortar mixer. When he connected his chipping gun's quick-connect hose to the airline, he accidentally hooked it to an oxygen line, which was not properly labeled.  While he was operating the chipping gun with oxygen instead of compressed air, a fire broke out inside the tool and enveloped his right arm, face, and neck. He suffered second and third degree burns to his arm, and first and second degree burns to his face and neck, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had just completed residential roof tile work. While throwing debris to the ground close to the edge, the employee fell 20 feet to ground level. The employee suffered left shin, left ankle, and right ankle injuries, requiring surgery.

An employee was helping to lower metal sheets into place for ground stability when the wind caught one of the sheets, causing it to strike the employee's leg. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee suffered finger amputations while operating a bender machine.
An employee stumbled and fell while descending a flight of stairs, fracturing the lower leg.
An employee fell approximately 13 to 15 feet while descending a ladder from the roof where workers were painting. The employee suffered multiple fractures in the left wrist.
An employee was cutting metal when the outer steel fell, amputating the third finger on his right hand.

An employee was making deliveries from a flatbed trailer. As he was climbing down the attached ladder, a weld broke and he fell backward onto the hard surface of the lot, lacerating his head and left ear and fracturing his spine. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was lifting a tire onto another tire when he felt pain in his neck. He was hospitalized with a neck injury.
While checking a car, an employee was struck by another vehicle being driven by a coworker. The employee was pinned between the car and the building, suffering a fractured pelvis.
An employee was working near the slit coil packaging line when his left index finger was caught between the powered conveyor belt and a 4,000- to 6,000-pound roll of steel, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was coming down a fixed ladder when the right and left grab rails broke. He lost his balance and fell 11 or 12 feet to the lower roof level, breaking his left arm above the elbow and requiring hospitalization.
While disconnecting a steam fitting from a railcar, an employee suffered thermal burns to the hands/arms from hot water that released from the fitting.
After greasing equipment, an employee fell while descending metal stairs, breaking a shoulder and wrist.

On April 26, 2016, at approximately 9:30 PM, an employee was spinning a non-energized rotary press by hand to clean excess oil with a rag. The rag was caught in the spinning press, pulling the employee's hand toward the punches. His right middle fingertip was amputated by the downward punch.

An employee was installing cable and telephone wire from a ladder. While descending the ladder, the employee stepped on a drill bit attached to an electric power drill. The drill bit impaled the employee's calf muscle.
An employee was ascending a ladder, supporting himself with a grounding L-bracket, when he fell. He struck the concrete floor and suffered cuts and abrasions, requiring hospitalization.

On April 26, 2016, at approximately 4:00 p.m., an employee was adjusting the brush table, which is part of the equipment that loads buns into bags. To adjust the brush table, the employee loosens a lock bolt, slides the brush table forward or backward, and retightens the lock bolt. While adjusting the brush table with his right hand, the employee's right index finger was pinched between the pusher on the bagger and the brush table, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while setting up a work zone on a state highway. The employee suffered rib fractures and a punctured lung.
A maintenance employee was changing out a roll of plastic film on the overwrap machine when his right forearm was caught and crushed between the rollers.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground of the shop, cutting his head and left ear.

On Tuesday 4/26/16, at about 1 PM, an employee was installing a control panel on a cooling tower. The employee dropped his screw driver and it rolled under the cooling tower. When the employee knelt down to retrieve the screw driver, his knee landed on some wire debris. He required surgery to remove the wire debris.
An employee was collecting debris at a construction site when a large piece of clay came off the debris and hit the employee's left shoulder, lacerating it.

On April 26, 2016, an employee was standing on a rolling ladder/stairway to retrieve merchandise from overhead storage. The employee fell approximately 8 feet off the ladder to the floor, suffering a broken shoulder, elbow, and hip.
An employee was using a hammer to clean accumulated material from rollers on a conveyor. The hammer slipped and his arm was caught between the rollers. His arm broke and required surgery.
An employee was hit by a falling skid.
An employee was mowing the grass using a hover mover. The employee slipped and struck his foot with the mower resulting in a severe laceration to his foot.
An employee was operating a machine. The employee contacted the machine blade and lacerated the right hand/wrist.
An employee fell five feet from the loading dock to the ground and fractured two ribs.

An employee working in the maintenance shop was adjusting the bolster of a hydraulic press. While the employee was attempting to align the bolster pinhole with a pinhole in the press frame, the bolster came down and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was walking between the parking garage and the entrance when the employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken kneecap and elbow injuries.

On April 26, 2016, at approximately 6:00 p.m., an employee was changing a filter basket that removes fines from the alkaline cleaner. The employee unscrewed the lid and was struck by hot water and detergent (sodium hydroxide mix) under 26 psi, causing second and third degree burns to his upper torso, arms, and back. He was wearing a hard hat, eye protection, hearing protection, boots, and nitro gloves at the time. Chemical resistant clothing was not worn, and lockout/tag-out was not performed, while the filter was being changed.

On or about 4/27/16, an employee was being trained to operate a powered pallet jack. The employee lost control of the pallet jack and exited the platform. His leg was pinned under the platform of the pallet jack between a racking system, and he was hospitalized with a broken foot.
An employee's right-hand middle finger was caught in a shackle in the live hang area and had to be surgically amputated.
While braking parts on a press brake, an employee's right index finger was caught between a part and the upper die. The fingertip was amputated at the nail.

An employee was attempting to enter the attic area of a home to conduct an inspection. The employee's ladder slipped from position, causing him to fall 10 to 12 feet to the ground, injuring his vertebra and left heel.

An employee removed state bolts from one of two supporting flanges while working on railing. Both flanges, as well as the equipment they supported, then collapsed on the employee. The employee suffered four broken ribs and a broken tailbone and pelvis.
An employee was run over by a tractor while filling a nurse tank, suffering a pelvic injury.

An employee was attempting to turn off the conveyor using the control sequence lights when his left glove was caught and pulled into the chain and sprocket, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee's ankle was crushed by a forklift.
An employee's mail satchel became caught on a railing, causing him to miss the bottom step of a staircase and herniate a disc in his back.
An employee was walking in the facility lot when a driver backed up and pinned the employee between a tractor and trailer. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture, requiring surgery.
An employee was helping a coworker lift a 200-pound oven onto a table when his right index finger was pinched and amputated to the first knuckle between the table and the oven.
An employee ran to retrieve an at-risk patient as he was leaving the premises. She fell down on the floor, bled from her mouth, and broke her right hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a sign while on a 6-foot fiberglass ladder. He stepped off the ladder and onto a stack of water cases. The stack caved in, and the employee fell down, head first, to the concrete ground, suffering a head injury.
An employee was walking in a hallway, slipped, and fell, breaking the left hip at approximately 5:00 PM on April 27, 2016. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was walking down the hall when her foot caught the floor causing the employee to fall on her left knee and right arm. She broke her knee and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee closing a sliding door on a sausage production process pinched their finger between the door and another component causing an amputation of the left ring finger at the first joint.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. Their left foot was crushed after becoming caught between the forklift and a column.

On April 28, 2016, at 1:20 PM, an employee was using a router table to notch several small pieces of wood. The employee was moving the pieces of wood from left to right. The wood kicked back, allowing the employee's fingers to enter the bit.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while he was using a press brake.
An employee was wiping a roller with a rag when the roller pulled the rag and the employee's right hand in, breaking skin and causing lacerations.

An employee was removing a jam under the pusher bar when the bar came down on the employee's arm, pinching and severely bruising it. The employee required surgery. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee had just parked and exited his forklift to look for parts. When he stepped out from behind his forklift, an oncoming forklift ran over and crushed his right foot.

An employee was inspecting products being removed from a truck. The truck started to roll away while he was standing with one foot on the truck and the other on the loading dock. He fell and fractured both legs.
A crew was setting a steel plate on the ground using a backhoe. The plate became loose and fell on an employee's lower left leg, causing three fractures.

On April 28, 2016, at approximately 8:22 a.m., an employee was using a butchering knife to remove the inner and outer shank from a ham. While she was manually turning the meat, the knife came in contact with her left arm above her personal protective equipment, causing a deep laceration and puncture injury.

An employee was servicing and troubleshooting a generator when a moving part became energized. The employee's hand was caught by the moving part, causing injuries that required surgery and hospitalization.
On April 28, 2016, at 12:00 p.m., an employee slipped on a wet tile floor and broke a femur bone, requiring hospitalization.

On April 28, 2016, at approximately 1:10 p.m., a maintenance employee was repairing a thin film evaporator machine. While he was removing the rotor assembly, his left middle finger was pinched between a nut and metal belt sheave, amputating his fingertip.
