An employee was flagging traffic in a work zone behind a line of cones when a driver drove straight into the employee, bruising the employee's right leg and causing a concussion.
An employee was using a portable hand grinder and cut their bicep.
An employee was loading baggage when a spider bit his left leg, causing swelling.
An employee fell approximately 5 feet through an open ground-floor elevator shaft, suffering a fractured eye socket and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a chain saw to cut sections of a felled tree. When the saw cut completely through a section, the tree, which was under tension, swung 7 feet and hit him in the hip area, knocking him to the ground. He broke his femur, sacrum, pelvis, and ribs and suffered internal injuries, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a wind tower when the wind picked up and caused the motor to start turning. The employee's glove was caught in the motor, and his middle finger was pulled in and lacerated. The finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was disconnecting a vapor line and a cargo hose that contained trichlor ethylene when his knees buckled and he stumbled. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee opened the dishwasher door to load dishes into the washer when the switch malfunctioned, causing hot water to splash out and burn his face, arm, and chest. He was hospitalized.

An employee was grinding a hole in an empty 300 gallon gasoline tank. Sparks from the grinder ignited gasoline vapors resulting in a fire/explosion. The employee received flash burns to the face and first degree burns to the forearms and fingers.

An employee was running the vinyl machine, which rewinds and cuts big rolls of vinyl into smaller rolls, when his right hand was caught between two rolls. The skin was peeled off his right hand, requiring hospitalization.
A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a machine when his right middle and ring fingertips were amputated by the machine's unguarded chains and sprockets.
An employee had cleaned a room and was exiting when the room door slammed on her right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was checking the electric output on a fan when the alternator fan blade caused an amputation injury to his right hand.
An employee was flagging traffic at a road construction when an excavator backed over and crushed his lower left leg. He suffered severe lower leg fractures, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's finger was caught in a truck's lift gate, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was cutting a tree with a chainsaw when the tree split and struck his left arm. The impact severely lacerated his left arm, which had to be amputated above the elbow. The employee was wearing required PPE at the time of the incident.

The injured employee was training another employee on how to operate the side puller machine. The injured employee noticed that a hide was not clamped properly and went to adjust it on the clamp. At the same time, other employees pressed the buttons to start the machine. The clamp caught the injured employee's right middle finger, which had to be surgically amputated from the tip to the first knuckle.
An employee was delivering pressure cylinders when a cylinder slipped and fractured his right lower arm.
An employee was cutting plywood using a circular saw when the saw got away from him, cutting his left index finger. The finger was amputated at the hospital.

An employee was strapping down a load of lumber onto a flatbed truck. While attempting to get down from the back of the flatbed, he fell 3.5 to 4 feet and hit the ground. He was hospitalized with a collapsed lung.
On May 13, 2016, an employee suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger, to the first knuckle, while greasing a belt and pulley on the dust collector.
An employee's left pinky finger contacted an unguarded fan in equipment resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was delivering mail into a door slot when a dog bit his right hand, amputating the right index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was moving a glass rack with a pallet jack. While lowering the rack of glass, the employee had the handle of the pallet jack in a vertical position. When the rack was lowered, the employee's thumb was caught and partially amputated between the rack and the handle of the pallet jack.

An employee was using a diluted corrosive chemical solution with a 24" long brush to clean drains. The employee sustained a second degree chemical burn to the forearm and wrist when the chemical solution splashed under the employee's protective gloves and sleeves.

An employee was pulling containers of mail from a tractor-trailer onto an elevated scissor lift. The employee fell through the opening, and a container also fell through the opening on top of him. He suffered a laceration to the back of his head and a neck fracture, requiring hospitalization.
While attempting to repair a lawnmower, and employee turned off the mower and tried to flip it over before the blades stopped spinning. His right middle fingertip was amputated by the blades.
An employee operating a boom lift struck a door and broke a leg, requiring hospitalization.
As an employee stepped onto a scaffold to install an electrical box, the scaffold moved, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the lower level. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 14, 2016, at approximately 2:45 p.m., an employee fell while getting up from a clerical chair. Her foot became trapped under the chair, causing her to fall to the floor on her right side. She fractured her hip and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was putting parts away while standing on a ladder when the ladder slipped. The employee dismounted the ladder and landed on their feet, breaking both heels.
While stepping onto an assembly, an employee tripped on the edge and fell forward. The employee's jaw struck an angle iron and broke in three places.

An employee was walking down the aisle when she slipped on the wet floor and twisted her ankle. Her ankle began to swell immediately and was broken in two places. She also fell and hit her head on the floor.

On 5/14/2016, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was stripping concrete forms. A wooden block was removed from between the two forms, which then came together and crushed the employee's right thumb. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee lost footing and fell down stairs to the ground level, breaking ribs and puncturing a lung. The employee required hospitalization.
The employee was dicing red peppers when he cut his left thumb resulting in the amputation without bone loss of the tip of his left thumb.

Two maintenance employees were working to replace carriage arms on a stacker machine. After they dislodged the pins that held the two carriage arms in place, the arms did not swing free. An employee standing on a support beam struck the right-side carriage arm with a hammer to free it. The arms struck an employee, fracturing the employee's left-foot metatarsal bone.
An employee was cleaning out a drop-out chamber with a Grant machine. Material fell onto the wet ground creating steam that caused second degree burns to the employee's face, ears, neck and knees.
An ironworker was handling an S-4 beam when he lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee was caught between the beam and the floor and a section of the employee's pinky was amputated.
An employee was stomping/crushing boxes on top of a dumpster when he slipped and fell off the dumpster, breaking his right tibia.
An employee was retrieving supplies from the storeroom when she tripped and fell over a plastic rack, breaking her left femur.
An employee in a crane suffered electrical burns when the boom came into contact with a powerline.
An employee was connecting the hitch of a wood chipper to a customer's truck when the hitch ball fell on top of his left foot. He had surgery and was hospitalized.
On or about May 16, 2016, an employee was riding a mountain bike on a bike trail when he hit a jump and fell onto his bike. He was hospitalized and required surgery for possible internal injuries.
On 05/15/2016, at 5:00 p.m., an employee was administering medication to a patient when he slipped and fell, fracturing his kneecap and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was feeding boards into a door jamb machine when his left hand was caught and crushed in the machine's chain and sprocket. He was hospitalized.
While washing a skid steer with a pressure washer, an employee's left wrist was cut by the water pressure. The employee began to feel sick later that day and was hospitalized.

An employee was strapping down cargo on a ship and helping to guide a forklift driver when the forklift bumped the employee and knocked him down. The load then fell onto the employee's ankle, breaking it.
An employee was removing a fence from a ditch near an excavator when the excavator backed over the employee's leg, breaking it.

An employee was working on an adjacent thermoforming line when he saw a pile of regrind collecting on the top of the regrind system hopper. He climbed up to the platform to access the area where the regrind was collecting. As he brushed away the pile of regrind to try to determine how it was leaking out of the system, his right middle finger entered an access hole in the side of the airlock. The blade inside the airlock amputated his fingertip.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a molding machine when he was caught between the machine and the railing. He suffered a back laceration with possible lung damage, requiring surgery.

While an employee was working on a punch press a piece of metal became stuck. The employee removed the guard to remove the metal piece. While his fingers were in the die area, the employee hit the foot pedal and stroked the machine. The employee sustained the amputation of the left index finger and fractures to the left middle finger.
An employee was replacing a concrete grinder wheel when the grinding wheel exploded, lacerating his left index finger and fracturing his left shin bone. He was hospitalized.

On May 16, 2016, at 11:05 a.m., an employee was replacing a light fixture while standing on a ladder that was approximately 4 feet off the ground. He came in contact with a live electrical wire and was shocked. He then fell from the ladder to the ground below.
During the cleaning process, an employee's hand came in contact with a moving piston located near the bottom of the bakery depositor machine, amputating her left middle fingertip.
An employee making a delivery fell off the lift gate on the back of his truck, struck the ground below, and broke his lower right arm.
An employee entered through a cooler door and slipped on ice that had accumulated on the freezer floor, breaking the right femur.

An employee was handling a freight container on a chassis. When he hit a pin with a hammer, the container dropped and crushed his hand, pulling off his glove and skin. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was attempting to tighten bolts on a sprinkler system used for fire suppression when a gasket ruptured, causing water under pressure to flow out and strike him. He then fell 16.5 feet from his ladder to the concrete floor below. He suffered facial scrapes, an orbital bone fracture above the left eye, a left shoulder fracture, a left rib fracture, a sacrum bone fracture on the left side, a collapsed lung on the left side, and a loss of consciousness.
While placing beef into a meat tenderizer, an employee's right hand was caught in the machine, amputating the pinky finger and ring fingertip.

An employee fell through a rotted section of a commercial flat roof while stripping material from the center of the structure. The employee fell approximately 16 feet to the floor, breaking bones in the right arm and elbow, cracking the tailbone, and fracturing the pelvis.

An employee attempted to drive in a sheet-metal screw with a Phillips-head bit attachment on a power hand drill. The drill slipped and punctured the middle finger on his right hand. His hand then became infected and required hospitalization.
While walking, an employee stepped up and over a curb instead of using a ramp.  The employee's knees gave way, resulting in injuries to both knees and quadriceps. The employee required surgery.
An employee was caulking the exterior of a boat while standing on a ladder or scaffold. The employee fell 6 feet from the scaffold or ladder, breaking a vertebra.
An employee was on an 8-foot tripod ladder, painting a wall with a hand brush. The employee slipped and fell, fracturing the left-side scapula and one rib.

On Monday, May 16, 2016, at 2:35 p.m., an employee was helping two coworkers and a forklift driver stack wood beams.  The driver was holding the forks (which carried 20-foot planks) level. The planks were banded together, and the employee and his coworkers were removing the bands. As they were helping to move the last banded bundle, the load shifted and the final band broke. The planks fell on top of the employee's right leg/foot area, breaking his ankle in two places.

An employee was preparing to install a TV monitor. He was working from an 8-foot ladder and using a voltage tester to evaluate wiring to power the monitor when he made contact with a live electrical wire and fell off the ladder. He hit his head, cracked his vertebra and rib, and suffered a laceration that required stitches.
An employee was removing a C-hook from the inside diameter of a steel coil. The employee's left index finger was caught between the C-hook and the steel coil, partially amputating the fingertip.
On May 17, 2016, an employee was burned by hydrofluoric acid.

An employee was dismantling an overhead conveyor when the connection point for the rigging gave way and the conveyor fell, amputating the employee's left pinky finger at the first joint (just below the nailbed).
An employee dropped a bottle and attempted to catch the bottle. The bottle struck another bottle, breaking and cutting both of the employee's pinky fingers.
An employee was taking a pipe off of a rack when the pipe fell and pushed his right thumb up against a saw blade that was not in operation. His right thumb was partially amputated.
While dismounting a roller, an employee's left foot became caught in the bottom step. The employee could not hold on and fell backwards onto stone and dirt, fracturing the left ankle and elbow.
An employee tripped and fell off the back of a flatbed truck trailer, fracturing the L1 vertebra.

An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift when a fork popped off the frame and pinched the employee's left middle and ring fingers. The employee's middle finger was partially amputated, and the ring finger required sutures.
An employee was observing maintenance being performed on the head of a planer when his left hand contacted the planer head, amputating his left ring finger at the first joint.
An employee slipped and fell on the workplace parking lot, suffering a right knee injury that required surgery.

An employee was moving a 750-pound slab of concrete when the slab tilted off the base. The employee tried to catch it and suffered a broken and lacerated left-hand finger, as well as bruising to the left thigh, knee, and foot.
An employee's left hand was caught in a table router/notcher while the employee was pushing lumber into the machine, requiring surgery.
An employee was moving remnant pieces of stone countertops. As he pulled them toward him, the pieces tipped and fell on his right leg, breaking it.
An employee was standing on a step stool to refresh a kitchen display. After stepping off the step stool, he began walking, felt a pop in his right leg, and experienced leg pain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting flash off of one of the pallets with a knife when he missed the pallet and cut his left arm, damaging his arteries.
An employee was staging material on a roof that was wet from rain when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was shocked while MIG welding and was hospitalized.

On May 17, 2016, an employee operating a forklift drove off the dock between the dock and a truck trailer, suffering a broken ankle. At the time of the incident, chocks were not placed behind the trailer wheels and the truck was in neutral.

An employee was helping to load 40-foot steel angles onto a truck. The crane moved, and the chain dropped due to the load. The load then struck the employee in the back of the head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury and three fractured vertebrae.
An employee was moving a round table that was leaning against the wall when the table tipped over and hit the employee in the leg.  The employee was hospitalized.
As an employee closed the bathroom door, his left hand was on the door's hinge. His middle fingertip was caught and amputated (no bone loss) between the hinge and the jam.
Employees are exposed to a caught by hazard from an unguarded ammunition loading machine, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cleaning adhesive buildup from the surface of a driven rubber nip roll on an adhesive applicator unit. The employee's hand and forearm were pulled forward and upward by the machine, subsequently pressing and holding the back of the employee's left hand against the heated surface of the adhesive die tip. The employee suffered a burn across the back of the hand between the wrist and the knuckles.

An employee was using an overhead hoist with a small J-hook to lift a raw part up from a work table in order to change the orientation from face-down to face-up. He had lifted the part approximately 3 inches from the table surface when the part became unsecured from the hook and dropped on his left hand. The fifth digit was smashed and required stitches, and the fourth digit was partially amputated at the first distal.
An employee fell from a wet ladder while installing awning, requiring stitches.
An employee was cleaning out the dishwasher when he suddenly fell to the ground and hit his head, becoming unconscious due to dehydration.

An employee was cutting a shim on the quarter-inch flat stock of the table saw when the saw became jammed. While he was attempting to unjam the saw, his right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle, his middle finger was amputated at the second knuckle, and his ring finger was lacerated.
Employees were going to lift a 40' x 30" x 16.5" launch with a crane. Prior to hooking, the stack tipped over and caught an employee's lower leg, injuring the employee's left ankle and foot.
An employee slipped and fell off a free-standing ladder approximately 2 to 3 feet high, landing on his hands, and suffering a compound fracture of his right arm.
While setting metal forms, an employee's right index and middle fingers were caught and amputated between the forms.
An employee tripped and fell while walking down a flight of stairs, injuring the right knee.
An employee was trying to unattach the hook from a lifting "eye" on the top of a compressor after it was moved when his pinky fingertip was caught and amputated between the hook and the "eye."
An employee slipped on a powder and fell on the tile floor while walking in a corridor and fractured their hip, shoulder and pelvis.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood. While he was guiding it with his left hand and using a push stick in his right hand, the piece of wood kicked back causing his left hand to come in contact with the saw blade resulting in a severe laceration to the left thumb. Part of the employee's left thumb was later amputated.
An employee was flagging and tripped, flipped, and fell hitting the curve. The employee suffered intracranial bleeding.
An employee fell while walking down the hallway, fracturing the left elbow.
A floor stripping cleaning chemical was spilled onto an employee and the employee received a chemical burn on the left hand and leg and the right foot.
While cleaning up in the saw area, an employee attempted to remove scrap from a scrap conveyor. His hand was caught by the belt and pulley, and his radius and ulna were fractured.
An employee fell from a loading dock and fractured a foot and dislocated a shoulder.
A worker fell six feet off the back of a bucket truck while securing the boom to its cradle. The employee fractured a rib and an elbow and sustained a cut over the right eye.
An employee was using a saw to cut an 8-inch PVC fire-waster line pipe when the pipe moved, causing the saw to kick back and lacerate the left side of the employee's chest.
An employee suffered the amputation of two fingers and two fingertips on the right hand after attempting to clear a clogged grinder that is used to grind waste Dacron.
An employee was using a saw to install water lines when the saw kicked back and lacerated his chest.
An employee amputated three fingers with a table saw.
An employee was operating a forklift and struck a pole. The employee was hospitalized because of the injuries sustained.
An employee reached to adjust a part on the press die and suffered a partial amputation of a fingertip on the right hand.
An employee stepped on a nail while pulling aluminum and was later hospitalized when the foot became infected.
At 7:30 a.m., an employee was possibly stocking inventory on the second floor when he fell 12 feet to the ground below, severely fracturing his ankle.
While climbing a fixed ladder, an employee fell backward and fractured his wrist.
An employee was preparing to change piping on a propane tank when liquid propane leaked out and burned the employee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift in the produce warehouse. The employee started feeling dizzy and having blurred vision. The employee then sat down to rest and noticed loss of feeling in the hands and face. The employee was hospitalized with high levels of carbon monoxide in their system.
An employee was injecting a vaccine into chickens on a poultry farm along a conveying system and stuck the back of his left index finger with the injection apparatus.
The employee was operating a Hydro T machine that produces copper plumbing fittings. The employee was clearing a jam and amputated the left middle finger and lacerated the left ring finger.
An employee was adjusting the forks of a fork truck while they were lifted approximately 2 feet in the air when the forks failed and fell, partially amputating his left big toe. He had surgery.

Two employees were closing the garden gates. When the gate closed, one of the employee's left index finger was pinched and lacerated. The employee then had surgery for a partial amputation of the top joint of the left index finger.
An employee was training on an ATV and was thrown from the ATV. The ATV fell onto the employee who suffered broken ribs and a possible shoulder injury.

An employee was trimming a tree limb with a chainsaw while working off of an extension ladder. The ladder fell and the employee fell approximately 10-12 feet with the ladder landing on the ground in a standing position. He broke his right leg in three places and suffered an open fracture to his lower right leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cutting a load of bundled timber pieces. One of the timber pieces fell from the load and struck the employee's right index finger and foot resulting in amputation of the fingertip and a fractured foot.
An employee's finger was caught in the premelter conveyor while clearing pizzas off the conveyor. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing the storage racks to retrieve product and fell, landing on his feet and breaking both heels.

An employee was greasing the dock door when the door dropped, causing the chain to catch the employee's glove. The employee's right-hand index and middle fingers were amputated just below the nail line.
An employee was helping to drag brush from a work site when a tree branch fell and struck him on the hardhat. He suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.

At 1705, on 05/18/2016, an employee and a coworker were cutting over on a roll of material when the cut edge flap fell over. When the employee grabbed the material, the nip roll caught his hand and arm. He suffered a double fracture to the left ulna and radius, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down basement stairs and was hospitalized for a broken shoulder and/or scapula.
An employee was disconnecting a trailer and a jack when the trailer moved, pinching and amputating his left-hand index and middle fingers between the trailer and jack.

An employee was unbolting pipe and installing a plug on valves. A crane was lifting a B-Tex condensing unit. The unit tipped over, striking the employee in the back. The employee suffered a broken right shoulder blade, three broken ribs, and a collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was sanding on a disc sander when his right ring finger was caught in the sander and sanded down to the bone.
An employee injured an arm while cleaning a machine.
While driving a stand-up forklift in the warehouse, an employee was crushed between the forklift and a pole, fracturing the left leg.
An employee was caught between the drilling rig and the mud pit and was injured.
An employee walking towards an aerial lift, fell, and struck his head. The employee was hospitalized for a brain injury and lacerations.
An employee had four fingers on the left hand amputated when his left hand was caught in the rollers of the paper converting machine.
On May 19, 2016, an articulating off road truck turned over and an employee sustained a broken ankle.

While turning a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) around, an employee lost control of the PIV, which then flipped on its side. He dismounted the vehicle and hit his head, suffering a laceration above the left eye and a nose fracture.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a cat from a cage to give it a shot when the cat turned and bit her.
On 5/19/16, at 7:56 PM, an employee amputated his fingernail and thumb tip (no bone loss) with a meat slicer. The employee was wearing one set of cut-resistant gloves at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing plastic from the sprocket of a machine when his right thumb was pulled in and amputated above the knuckle. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a table saw with a dado blade. While he was leaning down in a crouching position, he pulled back and his finger contacted the blade, amputating his fourth fingertip with bone loss and a fracture.

On May 19, 2016, at approximately 3:30 pm, an employee was working as a flagger assigned to handling traffic control in a street renovation/construction work zone and was struck by a vehicle. The employee suffered a fractured ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee fell 8-10 feet from an extension ladder breaking ribs on the left side and sustaining a small puncture to the lung.
An employee was installing a frame angle using a powder-actuated tool when a pin ricocheted off a steel beam and punctured his chest. He was hospitalized.
An employee was injured while cleaning a blending machine.

An employee was helping a coworker unload a portable generator from a box trailer. The generator was equipped with a fold-away handle. The generator had to be lowered approximately 18 inches to the ground outside of the trailer. The employee's right hand was placed between the generator frame and the handle. When his coworker pulled the generator out of the trailer, the generator fell 18 inches to the ground. The handle struck the floor of the trailer, pinching the employee's finger between the frame and the handle with approximately 200 pounds of force. The employee's middle finger was fractured, and the distal tip was amputated. His ring finger was also partially amputated.

An employee was descending a ladder and lost his footing falling 12-15 feet.  The employee sustained a broken left wrist, dislocated the right shoulder and fractured the right side of his face and jaw.

An employee was packaging and weighing bundles of stainless steel shapes. The employee was adjusting the lifting strap to balance a load. The employee's finger was caught under the load (steel beam) when it was lowered onto the saw horses resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was installing solar screens on windows and fell from a ladder, striking his head, breaking an arm, and cracking ribs as a result of the fall.

An employee was performing an inspection on a bearing housing that was attached to a forklift by a strap.  The housing came loose and fell onto the employee shattering his left knee and breaking his ankle.
An employee fell 15 feet out of a tree while clearing branches. He was hospitalized with a fractured spine.
An employee was moving a vehicle into a bay when the employee's hand was caught between the tire and the wheel well crushing one finger and breaking another finger.
An employee was replacing the motor and bearing on a cooler unit/fan when his left thumb was caught between a belt and pulley on the unit. He suffered a left thumb distal tip amputation.
While sorting food product, an employee stepped off a stand, lost balance, and fell to the floor, breaking a wrist.

An employee was climbing a telecommunications tower without incident.  A co-worker looked over and the employee appeared to be in pain while holding on to the tower at a height of approximately 250 feet.  No fall or other event occurred.  The employee just climbed the tower and started feeling pain in his lower back.  Tower rescue was initiated and the employee was lowered to the ground.  The employee was using a personal fall arrest system and was fully tied-off when he experienced the pain.  Upon reaching the ground, an emergency response crew began administering pain medication.  The employee experienced an adverse reaction to the medication and was rushed to the hospital where he was admitted primarily due to his reaction to the medication administered by the first responders, but the employee may have some lower back disorder(s) as well.
An employee suffered severe cuts to the left arm while cleaning a saw. The saw was not locked out at the time of the incident.
While bending to lift a product out of a box, an employee suffered a back injury.
An employee was attempting to enter the garage. As he went over a chain that was across the bay door, his foot became tangled in the chain. He fractured both elbows.
An employee's right index finger was amputated while operating a press machine.
While performing a final inspection of a bus, an employee fell on the bus steps, fracturing ribs.
An employee was eating lunch and fell from a stool resulting in a broken femur.

An employee was helping an operator clean glue off a machine roller. As he was wiping down the roller with a damp cloth, his hand was pulled into a pinch point, amputating his right middle fingertip.  The machine was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.
An employee was de-winterizing a boat to prepare it for launching when his foot was lacerated by the engine propeller, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing up a bundle of compressed cardboard to twist the metal wiring closed when his nose was struck and lacerated by the metal tie. He then lost his balance, fell backward, and struck his head on the concrete floor. He required hospitalization.

An employee attempted to catch a bundle of shingles that was about to fall off the truck's conveyor. When he did this, he lost his balance placing his hand in a pinch point and amputating a portion of his right thumb.
An employee was walking into the packing cooler when a pallet jack ran over the employee's toe.

An employee was using a sledge hammer to install a master pin into the track of a track hoe. When the employee struck the pin with the sledge hammer, a small piece of metal splintered off the pin and struck the employee in the right leg below the knee, puncturing the leg and lacerating an artery.

While attempting to investigate the cause of a hot wood pulp stock overflow, an employee stepped into pulp stock that was higher than his rubber boots. The stock was approximately 135 degrees and caused second degree burns to the employee's right leg and foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a tractor to mow grass when a high-tensile wire became caught in the machinery. When the employee stepped off the tractor, the wire swung around and hit the employee's left foot, breaking two bones and lacerating the heel.

An employee was inspecting a conveyer before starting production. The conveyer was in the off position at the time. The employee slipped while kneeling down to inspect the clean-out and then grabbed the side of the conveyor, which caused the clean-out cover to shut on the employee's finger, amputating the fingertip.
On or about Friday, May 20, 2016, an employee was climbing into his cab when he fell back out onto the pavement, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On or about May 20, 2016, at 8:10 a.m., an employee was operating a walkie rider pallet jack in walkie mode when the pallet jack backed over him. His left leg was pinned between the jack and a large metal tank, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cleaning racks inside a warehouse at ground level when a pallet on the third level of a nearby rack failed, allowing a large load of wrapped cookies to fall on him and fracture his left femur.
On Friday, May 20, 2016, an employee was testing personal protective equipment when he strained/sprained his back. He was hospitalized.
While running tubing into a well, an employee was struck on the head and face by the tubing, requiring hospitalization.

On May 20, 2016, at about 4:00 p.m., an employee was popping out reflective items in a construction zone when a driver entered the zone and ran over the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones.
An employee's right index and middle fingers were amputated while working with a sprue grinder vacuum system.
An employee was helping to hook up propane and preparing kitchen equipment by lighting the pilot lights when a propane flash occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's left hand.
An employee was cutting cores with a saw. While she was attempting to retrieve a marking crayon, the saw cut her right hand and broke her right index finger. She was hospitalized.

An employee was moving an energized pump when the equipment suddenly actuated and caught the employee's finger in a vent port. The employee's finger broke and sustained lacerations that required surgery.
An employee was getting ready to perform maintenance on a furnace transformer when he contacted a 12.5-kilovolt line, suffering second and third degree burns.
An employee was driving a boat in the open ocean when he was hit by a plasma fireball, suffering an electrical shock.
An employee was working on a ship and dropped a lashing jack (lasher/header) on his foot and suffered an amputation to his first toe (big toe).
An employee was using a platform ladder to put parts in storage. She lost her balance and fell to the ground injuring her ribs and left leg.
While operating a paper cushioning machine, an employee's right hand contacted the cutting blade, amputating three fingertips.

An employee was breaking up wooden furniture on a raised loading dock and then throwing pieces into a 30-yard dumpster positioned along the dock. While attempting to throw a wooden drawer into the dumpster, the employee's right foot entered the gap between the loading dock and dumpster. He then tripped over the dumpster lip, fell forward into the dumpster, and struck his chest on the debris inside. He broke two ribs and suffered internal bleeding, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell and sustained a laceration while loading freight.

On May 21, 2016, at approximately 5:30 a.m., an employee was scanning bins on the shelves from a ladder. As she was descending the 6-foot ladder, she fell from the third step to the floor, breaking her left leg just below the knee.
While operating a standup forklift, an employee struck a concrete wall, crushing her left foot.
An employee raised the hoist arm on a conveyor to pull a pallet that had stopped. The hoist arm then fell down and struck the employee, causing contusions and abrasions.
On 5/21/2016, an employee tripped and impacted the ground while exiting the back door of the building, breaking an arm in three places.

After clearing debris from the chain of a machine, an employee noticed the bolts that held in the sealing die were loose. As he was attempting to tighten the bolts, the die came up and crushed two of his fingertips.
An employee was hospitalized after sustaining burn injuries during a house fire.
An employee was riding a horse when the horse stopped abruptly. The employee was thrown over the front of the horse, sustaining a broken back.
A piece of metal from a crusher machine splintered off during routine maintenance and hit an employee's right eye.
While working at the cash register, an employee tripped on a guest, fell to the floor, and suffered a laceration above his left eyebrow.
An employee suffered a reaction from a brown recluse spider bite.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a sterilization machine. As the employee was removing the housing/base of the machine's filter assembly, white mist came out of the inside of the filter. The employee inhaled hydrogen peroxide vapors, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was airing up a steer tire for a tractor trailer truck. He put it in a cage and was walking back to check for leaks when a zipper rupture occurred. The force pushed him back and he fell onto the ground. He was hospitalized.
On or about May 22, 2016, an employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated when a supply closet door shut on it.
An employee's right hand was suctioned while unloading a tanker resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.

An employee attached a strap from the excavator bucket to the jack hammer and then signaled for the operator to move the bucket back. The employee saw the strap start to get tighter when the jack hammer popped up and crushed his right hand between the hammer and the pipe. His right pinky finger was amputated.
While attempting to clear plastic from the die of a plastic molding machine, an employee's hand was caught in the die. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the hand and thumb.
An employee was operating a power shear when his right-hand middle fingertip was caught in the shear's part holder. His fingertip was partially amputated and required stitches.
An employee was feeding wood-fiber insulation boards into a rip saw when the saw blade amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
While operating a forklift, an employee struck a rack, causing her left foot to fall off of the forklift platform. The forklift continued to travel forward, running over and fracturing her left leg.
On or about 5/23/16, an employee sustained serious injuries while cleaning inside a tank. He was hospitalized with a laceration on/near his abdomen, a left-side puncture, and bruising.
An employee was mowing a side hill when the mower tipped and rolled over, striking and fracturing the employee's right ankle.

An employee was taking two drums of trash to the dumpster with a forklift (55 gallon and 20 gallon).  The employee lifted the drums and tried to tilt the drums so they would fall into the dumpster. His left middle finger was caught between the dumpster and the 20-gallon drum, amputating the first digit.

Two employees were loading explosive pyrotechnics into a drying tumbler when the material exploded, burning the face and hands of both employees. One of the employees also fractured her elbow and lacerated her leg.
The passenger door of an automobile shut on an employee's left hand, amputating his ring finger at the nailbed.
An employee was packing and moving plasma cases when a stack of cases began to fall. To avoid being struck, the employee turned suddenly and pulled a back muscle.

An employee was pouring hot tar from a tote bucket to a mop cart when the person mopping went to dip the mop. The hot tar then splashed up and inside of the employee's glove, burning his right forefinger, thumb, and hand.

An employee was helping to inspect an electrical line and repairing a jumper that came off the transformer switch. The employee pulled two of the three switches to de-energize the pole line and then repositioned his bucket truck to get to the next switch. When he grabbed the wire to reinstall it onto the third switch, the switch was energized and caused third degree burns to his index, middle, and ring fingers on both hands.

An employee was setting up a vessel to be cleaned. When the employee opened up a sample port on the vessel, he was sprayed with yeast extract, suffering first and second degree burns to his torso and upper legs.

After exiting the parking shuttle and walking into the building, an employee's foot stuck to the floor, causing the employee to fall face-forward onto the floor. The employee suffered a fractured right humerus, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating the Greer #3 machine and caught his right hand between the rake arm and the machine frame. The employee's right hand was crushed resulting in the amputation of the index finger.
An employee was attempting to repair a gantry crane when stored energy caused the crane's hydraulic motor wheel to release and strike the employee, breaking the left arm and middle finger.

An employee was washing down the drum of a mixer truck and was attempting to remove concrete that was stuck on a sprayer. His left arm was caught and crushed in a pinch point, requiring hospitalization.
On May 23, 2016, an employee was operating a pallet jack when the employee's right foot was caught between a wall and the pallet jack platform. The employee suffered a right foot fracture.

An employee was holding on to the basket of the aerial lift. The employee's left middle finger was crushed between the lift rail and a piece of steel resulting in the amputation of the fingertip below the first knuckle.

An employee was wrapping a finished pallet on a stretch wrap machine. While attempting to cut the excess stretch film from the pallet, the employee's left index fingertip was amputated between the pallet and the guarding around the turntable. The machine was still running at the time of the incident.

An employee was cleaning the rollers on the printer machine while a coworker was moving the rollers forward inch by inch by tapping the jotting button. The employee's right pointer and middle fingers were pinched between the rollers, amputating the fingertips without bone loss.

On or about May 23, 2016, an employee was handling a piece of steel with a magnet lifting-device.  The steel shifted and fell on the employee's left hand, amputating the first joint of the ring finger.
On or about May 23, 2016, an employee was moving a mail rack when her hand was smashed between the rack and a concrete column. Her right pinky fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was carrying a set of chains while walking on the outside of the Jersey wall. He slipped under the top rail and fell about 12 feet to the ground below, breaking his right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee strained their lower back while pulling a power cable up a cell tower.
A safe door closed on an employee's right thumb, severing the tip.
An employee was hospitalized for possible carbon monoxide poisoning while batching garbanzo beans.

Two employees were driving an all-terrain vehicle to check on rain gauges when they entered a muddy area. As the first employee attempted to correct the wheels, the vehicle turned over. The first employee suffered a crushed left leg, while the second suffered fractured ribs and a broken pelvis.

An employee was stacking cases on a pallet when he was struck by a pallet jack being operated by a coworker. The employee's ankle was pinned between the pallet and the pallet jack, fracturing his right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell in the parking lot while walking to work and fractured the right tibia and fibula.

While waiting for reject materials to be generated, an employee's right-hand middle, ring, and pinky fingers became wedged in a pinch point of the conveyor. The fingers broke and suffered skin removal.
An employee was conducting a compression test on a part when the rig holding the part failed, allowing it to strike the employee's chest.
After climbing over a 3-foot joist, an employee stepped on a loose angle iron and fell on his right side, suffering internal injuries.
An employee was delivering mail to residence and was bitten by a dog resulting in the amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee climbed a ladder to remove a ceiling tile and gain access to a locked office. The employee went over the wall, stepped on a ceiling tile, and fell through the ceiling to the floor, breaking both heels and requiring surgery.
An employee was clearing a jam from a piece of equipment while working from a ladder. As he descended the ladder, his pant leg was caught on the machine and he fell to the floor, breaking his leg.
An employee fell to the ground while walking on a loading dock, suffering a contusion.
A steel gate came off its tracks and fell on an employee. The employee suffered a broken left hip, a cut to the back of the head, and a broken jaw.
While stabilizing and leveling a rig, an employee's hand was caught between the stabilizing jack and the jack stand, amputating his right ring fingertip.
An employee was helping a forklift operator unload blanks onto a metal pallet when his hand entered a pinch point, amputating his middle fingertip.

An employee was bending rebar and turned the switch to the program position so he could check the angle of the bar. The bending pin went to the left side of the bar. As he turned the equipment back on in the manual mode, the bending pin returned to the home position. The employee had already loaded a second bar.  When the bending pin was returning to the home position, it picked up the second bar. As the employee reached for the bar, his left index finger was caught between the pin and rebar, amputating the first digit.
An employee was operating a fiber optic rewinder when his right index finger was caught and pulled by the machine. His finger was amputated above the knuckle.

On May 24, 2016, at 6:30 a.m., an employee was helping to guide a platform into position while a coworker used a crane to lift it. While guiding the platform, the employee's fingers entered the open walking surface grating. He suffered hand and finger injuries, including possible broken bones and/or finger amputations.

An employee bumped a running pedestal fan while reversing a forklift, and the fan fell toward him. When he reached out to stop the fan, his right fingers went through the guard, amputating his right middle fingertip and lacerating/contusing his pointer and ring fingers.

An employee was changing over the assembly station. After she changed out the pop-up plate, she restarted the machine. The machine failed to cycle properly and a piece became stuck. The employee's hand then became caught in the cycling device. She sustained several right-hand fractures and a severe laceration by her right thumb.

An employee was helping to troubleshoot hydro-blast equipment. The hydro-blast operator lost control of the equipment and hit the employee with high-pressure water. He sustained lacerations to his hand and abdomen, as well as an abdomen injury that required surgery.
An employee was checking the fluids on a forklift when he lost his footing. His right arm was impaled by the forklift's muffler guard, tearing an artery, tendons, and muscles. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a ladder to clean the fascia at a residential home when he fell to the surface below, suffering a broken right arm and a head injury. He was hospitalized.
While walking, an employee tripped over a rolled up mat. She was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling cable from a 4160-volt switch gear when the cable made contact with an energized spark arrestor, causing an arc flash. The employee suffered burns to the face and both hands.

An employee was removing the last bolt from the joint bar that holds the rail line in place when the rail abruptly shifted, hitting the employee and fracturing his left foot. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was driving a forklift to move materials when a piece of material rolled off the stack, causing the forklift to pitch forward and then return to the ground. The employee struck the windshield, rupturing his discs.
An employee fell through a roof skylight to the floor, breaking his arm.
An employee was working on a ladder when another employee pushed the trash cart filled with drywall into the ladder thereby causing the employee on the ladder to fall and shatter his knee.

An employee was working at a tank in the fryer room when cooking oil and water mixed, causing a reaction that created pressure and made the lid come off the tank. The employee's right-side body was burned by the oil and water overflow.

An employee was watching the contractor crane up materials that had been taken from a truck when he noticed a tag line near the materials. He grabbed the tag line to move it to the side. As he grabbed it, the crane began the lift and the line became tangled in his hand, amputating his right index finger between the first and second digits.
An employee was adjusting the rollers of the rip saw to unjam a piece of wood. The piece of wood kicked back and hit him on the stomach causing a laceration.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet off of a ladder while hanging a banner, injuring the left ankle.
While sweeping his work area, an employee struck his head on the lid of a metal storage container. He suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a table saw to cut some weed wacker cord when the cord became tangled and pulled the employee's left-hand fingers into the blade. Two of the employee's fingers were completely amputated, and one was partially amputated.
While moving a lower power train brake assembly with an overhead crane/lifting device, an employee's left thumb was pinched and amputated in a pinch point.

An employee was backfilling sugar from a sugar silo into a tanker truck when a lock on one of the trailer hatches gave way and released significant air pressure, throwing the employee to the ground. The employee broke the lower left arm and right wrist, requiring surgery.
On May 24, 2016, an employee was helping to place sections of concrete barrier with a track hoe. One piece shifted and fell on the employee's leg, fracturing it and requiring surgery.

An employee was inside an open-top trailer using a pendant-operated crane to load packages of extrusions. A load weighing approximately 700 pounds, and measuring approximately 24-feet-long by 2.5-feet-wide, was being moved with straps and loaded onto an existing stack of materials. The employee was positioned between the load and another stack of materials. The employee was unhooking the load when the extrusions inside the package shifted and caused the newly set load to slide and trap the employee between the bundles. The employee suffered spinal fractures, two broken ribs, and a left pneumothorax injury.
An employee on a man lift was repairing the rudder of an aircraft when someone else powered the aircraft. His right hand became caught in the rudder, which then broke his arm.

On May 24, at approximately 2:40 p.m., an employee was loading a delivery truck with panels. The employee went to load a top-level panel on the stack when the panel slid down, catching and amputating the employee's right pointer fingertip.
An employee climbed a ladder to the top of a railcar. As he was transitioning to a handhold, he lost his balance and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, separating his hip.
Three employees were using a pry bar to free a bridge that occurred on a furnace when the furnace exploded. One of the employees was hospitalized with severe burns.

An employee was working from an aerial lift to install purlins on a steel shed when the shed shifted and collapsed. The collapsing building struck the aerial lift, causing it to turn over. The employee hit the ground, breaking his hip.
An employee was cutting wood with a hand-held electric saw when the saw slipped and severely lacerated the employee's upper left leg. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a box and fell while sweeping the floor, fracturing her left femur.
While pulling a drilling pipe, the pipe broke and the jack fell onto the employee's foot crushing the steel toe portion into his foot.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift, backing away from a dock door, and pulled into the path of another stand-up forklift resulting in three fractured toes on the left foot.

The employee was on the second step from the floor of an A-frame ladder when she lost her balance while hanging decorations in the racetrack area. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery on her broken right ankle.

An employee was delivering parts when the employee's vehicle became stuck. As the employee attempted to dislodge the vehicle, the grass caught on fire and the employee fell approximately 6 to 8 feet into a ravine. The employee suffered a second degree burn to the left forearm, a broken rib, a punctured lung, and a broken collarbone.
While exiting a bin truck, an employee fell backwards to the pavement, suffering back and head injuries, as well as a small laceration to the back of the head.
An employee fell from an A-frame ladder to the concrete floor while pulling/installing 277-volt wires for new indoor lighting. The employee sustained a skull fracture and brain hemorrhage.

An employee was plumbing in a separator on a natural gas line that had pressure in it. The line blew up and knocked the employee to the ground, spraying him with dirt and rocks. He fractured his skull and suffered cuts to his arms.
An employee was standing on an extension ladder when the ladder began to slip. The employee jumped approximately 5 to 6 feet off the ladder and fractured the left ankle.
An employee was removing tong dies from hydraulic tongs when the tongs engaged and broke the employee's left forearm.

An employee was operating a fork truck to transport a box to a stage in front of a box dumper. When he dismounted the fork truck and walked in front of the load, the truck moved forward and pinned him between the box dumper and fork truck forks, fracturing his lower left leg.

An employee was operating a pallet dismantler when he dropped a pull bar onto the dismantler table. As he attempted to retrieve the bar, his left hand contacted the blade, amputating his middle finger. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee's left thumb tip was amputated while he was cutting a bearing with a chop saw.
An employee was feeding rolls of plastic material into a shear when his left index fingertip was amputated.
While sweeping a work area, an employee vomited and became disoriented from heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting some steaks on a band saw for a customer. He had finished cutting the steaks when the customer called out and startled him. The employee jumped and his finger went into the blade, suffering a partial amputation.
On 5/25/2016, at 1:15 p.m., an employee was cutting a stair rail with a saw when the safety guard malfunctioned. The saw then jumped and cut the employee's left forearm.
An employee was trimming trees when his left index finger was pinched and amputated between a fallen branch and the bucket of the bucket truck.

An employee was placing a wooden block under a steel coil that was being held by a forklift. The coil then slipped off the forklift and smashed the employee's left index finger against the wooden block.

An employee was helping to set two risers for a new underground utility vault when the operator lowered the riser onto his hand, fracturing his left index finger. He was hospitalized with hand swelling.
An employee slipped while walking up the stairs on a train car. He fell approximately 24 inches and landed on his right elbow, requiring elbow surgery.
An employee was using a pry bar to align a flange when the bar slipped, causing him to fall backward and fracture his left ankle. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was struck by an automobile while working on a roadway in a work zone.
While delivering packages, an employee began to feel ill and experienced cramping throughout his body. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking between a cooker and a pot when a water hose began to whip around and sprayed him with hot water and steam. He suffered a second degree burn to his upper back.
An employee was loading a barge when he became ill due to dehydration.
An employee was working off a 24' ladder on a bundled secondary and fell approximately 9' off the ladder resulting in a broken shoulder, wrist and ribs.
An employee was clearing a jam when his finger was smashed by two rollers. His ring fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee fell from a 6-foot ladder, fracturing her arm and requiring hospitalization.

While an employee was operating an order picker to move a stack of empty pallets, some of the pallets got caught on the rack and pushed into the employee's ribs. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of three fractured ribs and a bruised spleen.
An employee was cleaning the engine of an excavator with starting fluid when an arc sparked and triggered a fire on his sleeve. He was hospitalized with burn injuries.

An employee was helping to perform maintenance on an elevator and was handing a mechanic a wire cable when the cable became caught on the elevator, amputating the employee's right arm and lacerating the leg.

An employee was returning to her vehicle after delivering a parcel to the front porch of a house when she rolled her left ankle on the sidewalk. She then lost her balance and fell to the sidewalk, fracturing her right patella.

A work crew was wrapping the steep tank with poly to protect it against the weather. To do so, the crew was moving the grating away from the tank so that they could slide the poly down and tie it to the tank. While setting down the end of the grating, the injured employee's left fifth finger became caught between the grating and the I-beam.  When he went to pull his finger out, he partially severed the fingertip, which had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was using a portable grinder to cut a metal stand when the grinder wheel shattered and caught his glove, pulling his hand into the grinder blade. He required surgery and hospitalization for a hand laceration.
After loading hides onto a pallet, an employee stepped backwards and tripped on a lower guardrail. He fell backwards and struck his head on concrete, suffering a concussion.

An employee had just climbed down a lighting tower. While moving from the tower to the stage, the employee fell 6 feet off the stage to the ground level below, suffering a cranial injury, nose fracture, and facial fractures.
An employee was cutting a wood board when his left-hand middle finger was cut by the circular saw.

An employee was cutting a 45-degree angle on a piece of 2x4 wood when the circular saw kicked back. The saw blade severed multiple tendons in the employee's forearm and penetrated the bone just above the wrist.

An employee climbed a ladder to assess the next level of a metal roof. He stepped on a shingle and fell 8 feet through the roof to the ground, breaking his right index finger, left middle finger, right hip, and back.

An employee was cutting a pipe when a water solution with ammonia came through the pipe and contacted the employee. The employee suffered a first degree burn to the right forearm, as well as trachea and esophageal irritation.
An employee was pulling a walkie pallet jack from under a pallet when his right-hand thumb was caught and crushed between the handle and the unit.

An employee was operating a stand-up high reach truck.  As the employee was traveling, the lift struck a pallet that was on the floor.  When the lift struck the pallet, the employee was ejected from the lift and struck a nearby rack where he injured his lower back and fractured his pelvis.

While assisting in material handling operations, an employee's finger was crushed between a skid steer fork and a concrete slab. The employee suffered a fingertip laceration resulting in amputation and fingernail loss.

An employee was attempting to make an adjustment on the press. As the employee was releasing the tension on the "signature," the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the level and another part of the press, amputating soft tissue and the nail.
An employee was pushing a cart into an elevator when she fell to the elevator floor, breaking her left kneecap (patella) and requiring surgery.

Two employees were taking a gutter up a ladder to install it on the roof when they hit the 7200-kilovolt (KV) line with the gutter. The employee closest to the 7200 KV line fell approximately 18 to 35 feet to the ground, while the second fell approximately 16 to 30 feet into a dumpster
An employee was climbing a ladder at a construction site when he suffered cramps and started feeling dizzy and lightheaded. He was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a finished mobile home. She was using a two-step stool to get off the home when the stool moved, resulting in a broken left ankle. She was hospitalized.

An employee was standing near the area where an auger crew was preparing to drill a hole to install a light pole. A pin holding the auger broke, causing it to fall. When the auger fell, it hit a security fencing and then landed on the employee's right foot, smashing the fourth and fifth toes.
An employee was drilling a hole in the foundation when a cinder block fell from the third floor and struck him, causing contusions to his lower back and kidney. He was hospitalized.

An employee was draining fluid from a cut pipe.  He took the magnet, which was raised by a crane, and raised one end of the two pieces of pipe. One of the pieces rolled loose of the magnet and the material fell onto the employee's left index finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was attempting to lift a concrete slab/rock into the bucket of a front-end loader. The slab slipped, and the employee's right index fingertip was crushed and amputated between the slab and another slab.
An employee was struck by an empty cargo cart, which fractured his left leg.
An employee slipped off a ladder while descending and broke the tibia and fibula at the knee. The employee was wearing a fall protection harness while working on the ladder.
While doing plumbing work at a resident's home, the worker was bitten by the home owner's cat. The worker was admitted into the hospital for treatment when the wound became infected.

The injured employee along with his co-worker were lining a farm implement onto the farm tractor's hitch. As the farm implement was being aligned with the ball of the hitch, the employee's right pointer finger got caught between the implement and the ball of the hitch resulting in the amputation of his finger from the nail up. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was exposed to electrical current while setting up a supplemental lighting/camera resulting in blisters and electrical burns on a hand.

An employee was cleaning stairs using a handheld electric grinder with a fine wire brush. The wire brush became caught up in the employee's pant leg, causing the grinder to make contact with his right ankle. His ankle was lacerated to the bone, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was checking a component under a conveyor when a section of the conveyor system came down and struck him.
An employee tripped on the wheel of a resident's wheelchair and fell to the ground, breaking the hip.
An employee was pinned under the bumper of an 18-wheeler when the truck came off the jack while the employee was changing the front tire. The employee suffered broken ribs and internal injuries.

An employee was feeding lumber into a roller system. While he was trying to free a piece, his hand was pulled into the roller, pinching his finger between the board and the roller. His left ring finger broke and was amputated.
An employee was injured when condensate spontaneously released while the employee was starting up a coker.

On May 27, 2016, at approximately 5:00 p.m., an employee was escorting a discharged patient to their vehicle in the driveway when another vehicle struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured skull and possible fractured pelvis.
An employee was placing a plastic sleeve on a filler tube when the ladder he was using moved, causing him to fall to the facility floor and fracture his skull and wrist.

An employee drove up in his truck to access a standpipe by the road. He got out of the truck and began lowering an electronic probe down on a reel and cable to measure the depth to water. The truck then moved and pinned/crushed his leg between the bumper and the standpipe. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting/turning stainless steel on a summit lathe. As the shavings came off the stainless steel, they lacerated the base of his left thumb, requiring stitches and hospitalization.
An employee fell off the back lift of a delivery truck onto the road, breaking a leg.
An employee was cleaning around the dough machine when the employee's gloved hand became caught in the auger, amputating the left and ring fingertips.

An employee was a passenger in a golf cart used to transport people around the site. The driver was traveling to a building directly in front of them to get needed parts, but realized he might find the parts in another building to the left. As the driver turned to the left, the employee fell off the cart and struck her head on the pavement, fracturing her skull.
An employee was pushing a lift onto an elevator when the employee's hand was caught between the lift and the elevator, amputating a finger.

An employee was riding on the passenger side of a baggage tug being driven by a coworker. The driver made a sharp left turn, and the employee fell off. The baggage cart, which was being pulled by the tug, ran over the employee and fractured his left ankle.
As she was entering the building, an employee's left hand was caught in the door.
An employee slipped on wet pavement and broke the right fibula and ankle requiring surgery.
An employee was working on the case packer line and amputated a fingertip.
An employee walking down the hallway with non-skid shoes. The shoes stuck to the tile floor and  the employee fell fracturing the left hip.

An employee was injured on or about May 27, 2016, when an employee was getting ready to remove a base ring from a tank. The employee was standing on a ladder on the truck. A second employee was operating a crane to the west end. When the operator moved the west crane, he bumped into the east crane holding the base ring. The tank on the truck was moved 3 feet knocking the employee on the ladder in the truck off the ladder. The injured employee suffered fractured ribs and damage to the left kidney.

An employee was using a hand held circular saw to cut a strip (1/2" - 1") off a large, fat piece of plastic (4' X 8'). At the end of the cut the piece (strip of plastic) flipped up and removed the very tip of his right index finger.
An employee was hospitalized with a severe laceration to his arm when a saw blade kicked back while cutting pipe.

An employee was installing broadband services at a private residence. While descending the wooden stairs of a walking path at the residence, the employee slipped on the wet surface and heavy vegetative growth, fracturing a vertebra.

An employee was closing a gate. A forklift driver came to help the employee. The unattended forklift then went backwards and pinned the employee against a wire fence, fracturing the employee's pelvis.

An employee was attempting to adjust the arm on an active machine, which was between a set of rollers set 12 to 15 inches apart. The employee's hand was caught between the arm and a roller, burning his skin and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a machine when his right-hand middle finger came in contact with the chain drive, amputating the fingertip. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.

While driving a straddle carrier, an employee collided with a second straddle carrier being driven by a coworker. The employee's carrier tipped over, amputating the employee's left leg above the knee.
While operating a mail-processing machine, an employee's head became trapped between the equipment and a guard, fracturing the skull, breaking ribs, severing ears, and damaging vertebrae.
An employee was cleaning gummed up bread crumbs out from under the conveyor with a compressed air wand resulting in the amputation of the right arm just below the elbow.

An employee hoisted the lubricator up off a well head using a winch and was inspecting the tool stream. The winch malfunctioned and continued to raise the lubricator up which was 8 feet long. It was raised approximately 15 feet off the ground. The cable snapped and the lubricator fell striking the employee and causing a laceration to his chest approximately 6-8 inches long and 1 1/2 inches deep.
An employee was emptying a pot of boiling water in to a colander and the water spilled, burning the employee on the chest.
An employee's arm was pulled into nip rollers while working at a drying rack, requiring hospitalization for tissue damage.

On May 30, 2016, at approximately 6:50 p.m., an employee was walking on the workroom floor in the automation area when her shoelace became caught on a float tire. She fell to the floor, hitting her right elbow and the joint between her right hip and thigh. She required hospitalization and surgery for a broken hip.
An employee was placing items on a shelf from a ladder. On the way down, the employee fell off the ladder and hit their head on the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized when his right hand was caught in a dryer belt.

On 5/31/2016, an employee was servicing an MRI machine when the machine magnetically energized and the employee's metal knife was drawn into his eye socket resulting in retinal detachment causing blindness.
An employee stepped off a curb and fell, breaking his left hip.
An employee was removing a forklift's brakes as part of periodic maintenance when the brake's drum (weighing 150 pounds) fell down, amputating the employee's right index finger without bone loss.

An employee was blowing shot dust from a shot blast machine. When the employee tilted the machine, it became unhooked and hit the employee in the back and shoulder. He fractured his back and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a power cord in a patient's room and fell, fracturing her right humerus.

A stack of pipes were placed on a rack on top of rollers on the floor. The employee needed to blow the pipes out, so he went to get the air line. He was walking backwards toward the rack, pulling the hose, when his leg made contact with the rack.  His pant leg was caught in the rollers, and his calf was pinched between the rollers and the rack. He tore his Achilles tendon and punctured his leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while picking up trash.
A worker was operating wood machinery and suffered an amputation of the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was injured while operating a handheld drill. The drill bit slipped and struck the employee's left hand while she was holding a piece of plastic and drilling.

An employee was standing in front of racking that held bundles of steel. The racking tipped forward and the top bundle of steel slid forward off the rack striking the employee and crushing their legs.
An employee was struck by 12 sheetrock panels that tipped over and fell onto and broke his left leg.
An employee was struck by the outriggers of a backhoe resulting in a severe leg laceration and a broken pelvis.
An employee operating the pneumatic E-Unit press suffered an amputation to his left thumb from the nail bed up.
An employee was running the steam flaking machine and amputated four fingers on the right hand.
On or about May 31, 2016, an employee was hospitalized due to a heat-related illness while engaging in physical fitness training.

On June 8, 2016, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was opening the door on the back of a delivery truck when another truck rolled backwards and pinned him between the two vehicles. He suffered broken vertebrae.
