An employee was moving a door panel when the door panel fell off the horse, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right patella.
An employee was cutting vegetables with a knife when his left index fingertip was amputated at the fingernail.

An employee was changing weld tips on a machine when the used weld tip fell. As the employee was trying to retrieve the used weld tip, the machine cycled and placed a door frame on the tip stand. The door cut the employee's left hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee was attempting to straighten a bent blade on a splitting saw when the saw was actuated, amputating the employee's right pinky and index fingertips.

An employee was loading crates with household goods onto a truck when he felt light headed, numbness in his arm, sweating, panting, chest pain and then passed out. He was admitted to the hospital where he was diagnosed with heat stress.

On or about June 8, 2016, an employee was chipping concrete inside a mixing drum using a pneumatic air chisel. The chisel malfunctioned, and the locking collar exploded, sending a piece of shrapnel into the employee's left bicep. The employee was hospitalized with a penetrative wound.
An employee was installing concrete blocks onto a modular home's concrete piers to level a double-wide trailer. A block fell onto his left middle finger and fractured it.
An employee's right-hand finger was crushed while he was loading cargo onto a loader.
An employee fell from a ladder and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift and sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was moving a platform when his thumb was pinched between the rolling platform and a stationary machine. His left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee performing an accountability check was attacked and assaulted by a patient, suffering eye injuries and requiring surgery.
An employee was pushing a board through a shaper when the employee's hand slipped and went into the blade. The employee suffered an amputation of the right-hand middle finger to the first knuckle.
An employee injured his left thumb while he was sliding a reshore jack post into the closed position.
On or about June 8, 2016, an employee was pulling a transmission part with a hoist when the employee's left index and middle fingers were crushed between the plate and the transmission.
An employee felt light-headed, fainted, and fell to the ground while walking to the office, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was dismantling a mobile tugger. As he was pulling back on the motor, the pulley was caught on the bottom track of the wall and came out of the extension arms, causing the weight to shift toward the motor side. The motor began to counterbalance toward the employee. He then tried to prevent the equipment from flipping up by catching the weight of the motor. At that time, he injured his back and fell to the floor. He was hospitalized.
On or about June 08, 2016, an employee was backing up a standup forklift when he collided with a parked standup forklift. He lacerated his foot/ankle and fractured an ankle bone.

On June 8, 2016, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee sustained an electric shock while he was repairing an overhead garage door operator.  He then fell from the third rung of an 8-foot ladder, fracturing his vertebra and requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder while attempting to open a cover plate from a tea line. The tea product poured onto the employee, causing him to slip and fall off the ladder. He struck his head on the concrete floor, suffering contusions and an edema.
An employee was power-washing the airfield surface when the water spray or the sharp edge of the spray nozzle lacerated his upper left arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was dumping a container when his hand/finger was struck by a cable from a truck winch.

An employee turned on a core drilling machine. The machine was stuck, resulting in him being knocked to the ground. The drill base kept spinning and went over his hand, amputating his left ring fingertip.
An employee was sweeping up leftover chips when a nearby distributor truck began to back up and hit the employee. The employee was dragged under the truck, cracking three vertebrae and two ribs.
An employee burned the left hand on a pressing machine.
A firework unexpectedly went off in an employee's hand, amputating the first two fingers to the first digit and lacerating the thumb and ring fingers.
An employee was handing a coworker pieces of wood after cutting them with a chop saw when the saw activated and partially amputated his right thumb.
An employee was struck by an order picker and was caught between rack shelving and the picker, breaking ribs and suffering internal injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to unravel a bound chain. When the slack released, his left middle finger was caught between two pieces of steel, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was adjusting a chute on the back of a cement truck when the employee's right-hand finger was pinched by the chute, scraping off finger skin.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut aluminum. He stopped cutting the metal and turned the chop saw off. The chop saw had some revolutions left. The employee tripped and fell, and the back of his left knee struck the blade, lacerating it. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was attempting to boost a patient up in bed when she suffered severe back pain.

An employee was preparing material to add to a batch on a mixer. A plastic bag became tangled in a mixer shaft, and the employee's arm also became wrapped around the shaft. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the left arm.
An employee was positioning a pallet load on the forks of a reach truck when a coworker backed his reach truck into the employee's reach truck. The reach truck's outrigger ran over his left foot.
An employee was using pipe wrench to install a pump in a liquid storage tank when the wrench broke free and caught the employee's right pinky finger, partially amputating it.
While stepping off a ladder, an employee missed the last rung and lost his balance. He fell to the ground and landed on the left side of his body. He was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
On 6/9/16, a maintenance employee was troubleshooting an overhead door when his right index finger was caught in a sprocket, partially amputating the right index finger tip.
An employee was installing a light fixture from a ladder when he received an electrical shock and fell to the ground, suffering broken teeth and a fractured right patella.
An employee was performing walking cuts on the kill floor. As he attempted to make a cut, he missed and contacted the knife of a coworker, lacerating his right forearm.

An employee was using hand tools to unload a spring that was incorporated into the structure of the building. Upon compressing the spring, it released and the bracket that housed it struck the employee, fracturing his right wrist.
An employee was moving a beam with an overhead crane when the beam fell on his right leg, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift truck that was traveling in reverse, fracturing his left foot.
An employee was replacing some bolts in the "truck dump" machine when his right hand was caught between a chain and sprocket, amputating his index and middle fingers and fracturing his thumb.
An employee was inside of his car in the parking lot when he started cramping all over his body. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was repositioning a piece of cardboard over the vacuum holes of a printing press when the piece was drawn into the machine. His left hand was also pulled in, de-gloving the top of the hand and amputating the index finger.
An employee was mowing a retention area when the mower rolled over on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was shoveling gravel into a 1-foot trench by a partition wall. The site supervisor was operating a mini excavator near the partition wall while the employee was working on the opposite side. The mini excavator bumped into the wall, causing it to fall to pieces. Some of the pieces fell on and broke the employee's hip.

On June 9, 2016, an employee was directed to connect a hose to a fire hydrant. The hydrant was charged. When the employee opened it, the employee was struck by high-pressure water and/or tools. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and broken rib(s).
While an employee was attempting to stick or unstick something in the dough press machine, the press operator started the machine, amputating the end of the employee's right thumb.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when he tripped over a pallet and fell. The pallet jack traveled up his left leg, lacerating and possibly fracturing it near the ankle.
An employee was loading a truck's flatbed trailer when he stepped on a piece of flat bar that flexed and fell 6 feet to the ground below. He fractured his left elbow.

While operating a sorter, an employee attempted to clear a board that was hung up on the back side of the sorter. The board slipped and pinched the employee's right index finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was delivering a 265-liter (70-gallon) compressed air tank when the delivery cart caster wheels struck the skid plate, turned sideways, and caused the tank to topple over and strike the employee. The employee suffered a fractured back and was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a ladder with a work light to access the roof when he fell off and struck the ground, suffering head, nose, and ear injuries, as well as loss of consciousness.
A stack of insulation rolls fell on top of an employee while he was walking in the warehouse, fracturing his right leg and requiring surgery.
On or about June 09, 2016, an employee was jacking a truck up when the jack slipped and hit the employee in the torso. The employee was hospitalized with a ribcage injury.
An employee was opening a box of office supplies when she tripped and fractured her lower back.

An employee was entering a laboratory at a customer's location to deliver drinking water when a gust of wind and the pressurization of the laboratory caused the door to close on the employee's right pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was in a boom lift, replacing an emergency light at a warehouse. As he was lowering himself, the bucket swung into an industrial ceiling fan, which lacerated his left forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while picking up a traffic control flag from the middle of the street, suffering multiple bodily injuries.
An employee was loading a trailer when he fell off the back and hit the concrete below, suffering a concussion and broken ribs.
An employee was delivering mail on his walking route when he became lightheaded and dizzy. The temperature at the time was 91 degrees with a humidity of 41%. He was hospitalized with heat stress.
While replacing switch components on a high-voltage contactor, an employee was shocked and required hospitalization.
An employee was removing tin from a beam that was located on the roof when he fell and injured his back.
An employee was sprayed in the face with general purpose cleaner as he was mixing the chemicals. He suffered an allergic reaction to the medication he was given.

An employee was setting up the dies on a punch press when it released energy unexpectedly. The press caught and severely lacerated his left hand, with a possible amputation. The press was not powered off at the time of the incident.
An employee was observing a third party who had a device with a spool line. The employee's left hand was caught by the line, amputating the ring finger.
While moving a gondola, an employee's fingertip was pinched and amputated in the gondola grate.
While loading luggage into a can and dolly, an employee's hand became caught in a pinch point, partially amputating the middle finger.
An employee was cutting decking with a handheld saw when the saw cut his leg.

An employee was picking up a stack of boards behind the chamfer machine when the machine malfunctioned, causing the sawblades to throw the boards. The boards slammed onto the employee's left middle finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was reinstalling a cutting shoe on a direct push tube soil sampling rod. The dual tube rod slid out of the tensioner that was being used to hold it up and fell back down the bore hole, amputating the employee's right index finger below the first knuckle.
On or about June 10, 2016, an employee sustained finger injuries when the employee's hand was caught in the shear hold-down.
An employee was attempting to do maintenance on a wood chipper when his hand was trapped in the conveyor. All five fingers on his right hand were lacerated, and he was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor while discarding trash in an outside dumpster, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was hot wrapping a pipe using flammable glue and a flame torch. The mixture ignited and the employee suffered second degree burns.
An employee was climbing into the cab of a tractor-trailer when the muscle in his calf detached from the bone.
An employee took packages off a conveyor, stepped back, and fell, severely fracturing the ankle.
An employee was opening a refrigerator when it fell on her, injuring her ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was working on the side of a wall, positioning ties. As he was climbing the wall form, he fell from a height of approximately 4 to 5 feet, breaking his left ankle.

An employee's right hand was on the mezzanine near the catwalk when a coworker adjusted the catwalk, causing it to move and set down on the employee's right middle fingertip. When the employee attempted to remove his hand, his middle fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was bending metal when their right hand pinky finger was caught between metal rollers and amputated.
An employee was working on a presorting machine. She was pushing a stack of mail trays across the floor when the trays fell over. She fell over with the trays and fractured her leg.

The injured worker was driving a golf cart toward the body shop. Another employee was driving a customer's vehicle and they collided. The injured employee suffered a broken right arm, a fractured shoulder and a fractured to the mid foot.

An employee was replacing an old lightning arrester with a new one. The new arrestor began to move, so the employee reached over to stop it. The employee's left elbow then came into contact with an energized line, causing an electrical shock.
On 6/10/16, an employee fell onto a wooden stake in the ground and punctured his lungs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was operating a walk-behind lift jack in a back stockroom. The employee's gloves became caught in the controls, causing the lift jack to become stuck in the on position. The employee was pinned between two lift jacks and suffered a leg injury.

The employee was pushing boxes down the conveyor line when a box got stuck on the line. As the employee tried to release it from where it was caught, her finger became caught in the chain on the conveyor line resulting in a partial amputation of the fourth finger on her left hand.

On June 11, 2016, an employee was assisting the crew as it rigged out a crane. The crane operator was retracting the outrigger when the injured employee used his left hand to brace himself as he bent down to pick up the outrigger pad. He placed his left hand on the outrigger, and his finger entered the eyelets on the outrigger. As the outer section of the outrigger retracted into the inner section, the eyelet on the outer section amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was involved in a physical altercation with a coworker, suffering a fractured vertebra.
An employee's foot became stuck on a floor tile, and she fell and broke her hip.
While climbing up a ladder to hook into a beam strap and yo-yo, an employee fell approximately 4 feet from the ladder and broke 8 or 9 ribs.
An employee was tightening a loose tarp over the load of a dump truck when he fell and suffered head trauma.

An employee was taking electric breakers and wires out of a live electrical panel. One of the stingers from a bus bar dropped down after breaking a set screw, causing a cross phase and starting an arc flash. The employee fell to the ground and suffered burns to the eyes, face, and left forearm.
An employee had been installing electrical wiring and was descending a ladder when the ladder collapsed. The employee fell and contacted the floor, suffering a contusion and bruised tailbone.
An employee was helping a patient walk from the bed to the bathroom when the patient's leg gave way and both fell to the floor. The employee suffered a fracture.
An employee was unloading a trailer when freight fell on the employee, who suffered a broken hip.
An employee was performing maintenance on an electric breaker panel when an arc flash occurred, burning his face, arms, and hands.
Two employees fell from scaffolding after it collapsed inside a water tower, striking the concrete floor. One was hospitalized with a broken arm.

An employee was dismantling a crate that was housing a small boiler unit. While his right hand was between the boiler and a board of the crate, the board kicked another part of the crate. The force of the kick caused the board to move and amputate his left ring finger between the board and the boiler.

An employee diagnosed that a serpentine belt was defective on a car. After replacing the belt, the employee attempted to locate the source of a noise. His glove was caught between the shroud and the crank, and his left-hand fingers were crushed.
An employee was working at the drive through window collapsed due to heat stroke.
An employee was exiting the patient compartment of an ambulance when her ring caught on a thumbscrew on the railing. Skin was torn from her ring finger, requiring surgery.
An employee was stocking shelves in the back room when she tripped over a box and injured her right knee. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a hallway when she tripped, injuring her right knee. She was hospitalized.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a drive motor that operates a conveyor belt when his right hand was caught by the belt. He broke his hand and lost several fingertips. The belt was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was moving a free rolling blanket cart when he stopped and grabbed his chest. He sat down on the blanket cart and complained about chest pain. Temperature in the area ranged from 90 to 100 degrees. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee and a coworker were carrying part of a rack. While the two were putting down the  part, it fell on the employee's right big toe, lacerating and fracturing it.

An employee was removing burrs on a set of custom-made aluminum jaws with a 10-inch hand file, when the file struck the jaws while they were still spinning in the chuck of the lathe. The file then pushed back into the employee's left-hand palm, causing a deep puncture wound.

The employee removed the safety gate of the inserter machine and got in front of the machine to clean the paper out. The machine started to move and the employee was pinned between the pockets of the machine and the crossbar resulting in multiple fractures.

On 6/13/2016, at 1:30 a.m., an employee was cleaning a ventilation hood when his foot was caught in the lower rung of a ladder he was descending. He fell approximately 6 to 8 feet, fracturing the 2nd and 3rd metatarsals in his foot and requiring surgery.
An employee was outside collecting trash on his route and suffered heat exhaustion.

An employee was un-belting and descending a 15-foot ladder. The ladder slipped and started falling, so the employee jumped from the ladder and landed on his feet. He fractured both heels and broke his left ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee working in the laundry department inhaled laundry cleaner vapors while transferring residual chemicals from one container to another. The employee was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was working under an overhead crane that had just placed two-500 lb. steel poles on a table. The employee moved in to begin cleaning the poles when the rigging fell from the crane hook and struck his left hand, amputating all four fingers.

An employee was performing maintenance repair on a machine when the operator started it. The employee's left arm sustained a compound fracture and elbow dislocation. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
While throwing brush off a truck and down an embankment, an employee lost his balance and fell 75 feet down the embankment. He broke ribs, lacerated his spleen, and fractured his spine.
An employee was descending a ladder when he fell from the second rung closest to the ground, suffering a head injury.
At approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was lashing and unlashing cargo when he became overheated and disoriented. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was attempting to straighten a piece of metal in a press brake when his right hand was caught in the machine, amputating his index and middle fingertips.

An employee was installing a large lift cylinder on a bulldozer. While he was trying to align the cylinder, it slipped, crushing his left ring finger under the pry bar he was using to position the cylinder. He was hospitalized overnight and required surgery.
On 6/13/16, an employee was packing ceramic parts onto a pallet when he tripped over another pallet on the floor. He sustained lacerations on the back of both arms and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a band saw to cut angle iron. One of the five pieces of angle iron that was being cut was shorter than the others and was not secured by the clamp. When the band saw was lowered to make the cut, the unsecured angle iron was pulled into the backstop, or guide, and the employee's left thumb was caught between the angle iron and the backstop resulting in amputation.

An employee was working from a 19-foot electronic scissor lift (set at 11-feet high) to cut a large structural brace using a torch. As the brace was cut loose, it struck the top of the scissor lift and fell onto plastic storage containers. The back of the employee's head hit the scissor lift guardrails and was lacerated, requiring hospitalization.

On June 13, 2016, an employee was working on a barge (on land), performing paint spraying operations. The employee attempted to clean out a paint gun when a small foreign object embedded into the fourth digit of his right hand. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was unloading a delivery truck when the load shifted. Some of the product fell down, landed on him, and broke his left leg.
An employee was adjusting the position of a paper-roll stand when a nearby hoist came close to the roll stand and caught the employee's right hand, fracturing/lacerating a finger.
An employee was operating a punch press when the die came down on his left thumb and amputated the tip.
An employee began vomiting after performing die-casting on a machine. He was hospitalized with severe dehydration.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat stroke that occurred while he was working in the field harvesting watermelons.

An employee was loading a truck of cement when the loading process clogged. When the employee attempted to clear the clog, a large amount of cement dumped onto him, causing respiratory distress. He was hospitalized.
On June 13, 2016, an employee was attempting to remove meat from the discharge door of a blender when the blender paddles caught and amputated the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was clearing out a dryer due to a buildup of pasta between the press and dryer when a coworker turned on the machine to blow the line free of pasta. The employee suffered amputations of the second, third, and fourth fingers below the knuckle, as well as a pinky finger amputation above the knuckle.
An employee was threading up a paper machine when his hand was caught and pinched by a hydraulic cylinder, lacerating his third, fourth, and fifth fingers and fracturing his fourth and fifth fingers.

An employee was helping a driver deliver produce. As he placed the dock leveler while standing on the back of the door, he injured his left foot with the leveler.  The employee then attempted to remove the dock leveler with his right hand when it fell on his right index finger and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was checking the drive bracket on a conveyor when the conveyor activated. His left thumb tip was caught and amputated in the conveyor chain. The conveyor was unguarded and not locked out at the time of the incident.

A crew was pulling tubing out of a hole. As elevators were coming down, an employee grabbed the tubing elevators by the handles and was unable to push them back far enough to latch them onto tubing. The elevators hit the top of the tubing collar, causing it to shift and pinch his right index finger between the elevators and tubing bail. His finger was lacerated and fractured.
An employee was dismounting off the back of a truck when his wedding ring was caught, causing the ring to embed into his finger.
An employee went outside to fill a bailer with trash and became locked out of the building. As he was climbing over a gate to access another door, he fell to the ground and broke his right kneecap.

An employee was helping to load a food truck on the dock when the driver drove off while the employee was still in the truck, causing the employee to fall and break a leg bone.  The employee was hospitalized overnight and required surgery.
An employee experienced heat stress while picking up the trash.

An employee was stepping off a pallet jack to pick a product from the shelf when his right foot was caught between the pallet jack and the upright rack, breaking his right ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was descending some stairs from a platform when he lost his footing, put his arms out to break his fall, and caught his pinky fingers on both hands in the "V" formed by the railing. Both pinky fingers were amputated.
An employee was assembling an amusement park ride when the component that was being installed fell and crushed his arm. He was hospitalized overnight with a fractured left forearm.

An employee was moving drywall from the forks of a fork truck when the drywall slid off the forks and pinned him between the drywall and a wall, causing back and neck injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was delivering auto parts. When he exited his vehicle, it rolled and ran him over. He was caught under the vehicle's wheel well and broke his collarbone.
An employee tripped and fell over a basket on the floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee's right index finger was amputated in the pinch point on a drive tire while the employee was performing maintenance on a lift truck.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood when the saw jumped and amputated two of the employee's fingers.
An employee was stung by a wasp while inspecting scaffolding and had an allergic reaction, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was powering up a compressor and noticed a leaky hose. When he turned around, the hose popped off and sprayed him in the back, causing second and third degree burns.
While getting out of his truck, an employee misstepped and re-injured a previous hernia in his left lower abdomen.
An employee was delivering packages on his route when he began to feel nauseous and experienced cramping due to heat stress.
An employee was clearing an area when a large metal rack used to store aluminum dropped on his foot, fracturing it.
While installing underground utilities, an employee began to feel sick. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee had finished repairing a strobe light on the back of a forklift and began to climb down when he fell to the concrete. He fractured his right hip socket and required surgery.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (double pallet front rider) when the truck struck a section of storage racking, fracturing the right lower tibia and mid shin.

An employee and a coworker were applying stucco from a scaffold to the exterior of a building. When the employee and his coworker stepped off the scaffold onto a canopy awning, the canopy came off, causing them to fall. The employee suffered a broken left ankle and tailbone, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's right thumb was bitten by a snake while the employee was removing shrink wrap from a skid inside the building.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk when she tripped on the raised lip of the concrete. She fell on her gun belt and felt back pain, suffering a back contusion.
An employee was waiting in the parking lot to swap packages with another driver when he became ill. He was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.
An employee was holding a piece of foam in place to cut using a band saw when the saw blade amputated the employee's right ring finger.
An employee was using a ladder on a tile floor with plastic sheeting when the ladder slipped out, causing the employee to fall and break their pelvis.

An employee was hitting a refractory block that had wedged between a wall and a floor with a sledge hammer when another refractory block fell and struck him. Each block weighs over 200 pounds. The employee's right shoulder was injured. The employee also suffered second degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after completing a delivery route due to dehydration.
An employee was operating an automatic panel saw when his right thumb pad was avulsed between the gate/guard and the equipment. He required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was injured when boxes fell on him.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut plywood when the blade lacerated the employee's left-hand fingers.
An employee was installing a new blade on a lathe when he stumbled and his right wrist made contact with the blade edge, resulting in a severe laceration.

An employee was operating a CNC mill that was equipped with a 1" drill bit and checking the large bore depth of the hole when the left index finger was crushed by the drill bit that came down automatically.

An employee was helping a crew to remove some malfunctioning valves from a ballast tank on a ship for repairs. While rigging gear was lifting the valve to the next level in the ladder way, the employee was helping to guide the valve up the ladder and was keeping the valve from striking the steps. When the valve reached the top step, the employee helped lift it over the lip of the ladder way. He then lost his balance and fell forward a little, inadvertently shifting his hold on the valve, which placed his fingers along the surface of the valve opening. At this same moment ,the valve came in contact with the deck, causing the spring to dislodge from the stuck position and to close on two of his left-hand fingers. He was wearing leather work gloves that lodged in the pinch point along with his two fingers. As his coworkers tried to open the valve, he pulled his hand out of the glove, which was still lodged in the pinch point. He amputated his left middle and ring fingertips at the knuckle closest to the fingernail.
While transporting mail, an employee was struck by a hamper and fell over, breaking her arm and dislocating her elbow.
An employee's leg was punctured by the nail from a nail gun the employee was using to hang fascia.

On June 14, 2016, an employee was felling trees and brush around an overhead power transmission line with a chainsaw. The oak tree being felled slit up the middle and toppled to the ground, striking the employee's shoulder and knocking the employee to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured collarbones and ribs.

An employee was servicing a customer's compactor that was inside a large cinder block enclosure with two access gates. As he was closing the left gate, a gust of wind quickly blew the gate closed, pinching his thumb where the gates meet in the middle. He suffered a partial finger amputation.
An employee was repairing a hot condensate steam-line joint when the steam pipe broke and hot condensate steam splashed onto and burned his left thigh, right thigh, and right forearm.
An employee was emptying a box of scrap plastic onto a sorting table and suffered a broken little finger when trying to prevent plastic from sliding off the table.
An employee was hospitalized after falling down the stairs.
On June 14, 2016, an employee was bitten by a tick while performing remediation work in the field. The employee became ill and required hospitalization.
An employee got a splinter in his finger that later became infected. The finger was amputated as a result.
An employee was carrying either a box of chicken wings or a keg that dropped onto their foot. Part of the foot/toes were amputated.
An employee was pouring molten iron back into the furnace when the molten iron splashed onto the employee's foot resulting in burns to the foot.
An employee fell from a three-step ladder while performing a maintenance function at an aircraft. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was closing the overhead door on a trailer while standing on a dock. The door started going back up and the employee reached out with his right hand to stop and pull it back down. His right index finger was caught between two panels, amputating his fingertip.

On June 15, 2016, an employee was troubleshooting the chain on a forklift mast. With one hand on the lever and the other hand near the chain, the employee operated the lever. His left hand was caught in the chain, amputating his second and third digits.

An employee was unhooking a cart from a tug that contained three carts. The tug operator put the tug in reverse, pinning the employee between two carts. The employee suffered a collapsed lung, broken clavicle, and broken rib.

An employee had been doing landscaping outside and was walking when his right foot slipped forward, causing his left leg to buckle under him. He fell to the ground and landed on his left leg, breaking the fibula and tibia and requiring surgery.
An employee tripped over an electrical cord and fell, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had lifted a vehicle 4 inches off the ground to make sure it was sitting on the pinch rail. The vehicle slipped off the cleat and pinched his right middle finger between the vehicle and the lift. He suffered a phalangeal amputation of his right middle finger.
An employee was notch-cutting a tree when a tree limb fell on him. The tree limb struck his hardhat, lacerated his forehead, and knocked out his teeth. He was hospitalized.
An employee experienced heat cramps and dehydration while stacking materials.

An employee was running a string of pipe from a derrick basket when his shirt was caught by the rotating torque rod. It pulled his shirt tight, compressing his chest against the derrick basket. He suffered chest bruising and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking from the bakery to the sales floor. There was a transition in the floor that went from slip-resistant flooring to concrete. When the employee stepped from the slip-resistant floor to the concrete, she slipped and fell, breaking her arm and hip.
An employee who had been using a weed wacker suffered heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was observing the pallet machine and attempted to access the platform to adjust the limit switch sensor. The employee then fell and suffered an avulsion fracture to the left leg.
An employee was removing tables from a truck when the pile of tables collapsed on the employee, breaking the left femur and requiring hospitalization.
On 6/15/16, an employee was removing chicken feet from a shackle machine when his left thumb tip was amputated.
On June 15, 2016, an employee was inspecting a refrigeration compressor outside and began to feel unwell. He was hospitalized with heat stress.
An employee tripped over a hose and fell on top of a cart full of industrial supplies, puncturing his left lung and requiring hospitalization.

An employee had delivered a parcel to a house and stepped off the step onto a walkway when she twisted her left ankle. She then tried to catch herself with her right leg and heard a pop. She fractured her right leg in three places and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was troweling concrete and fell 8 feet off the edge of the foundation wall resulting in back and head injuries.

An employee was standing to the side of a recycling bin. When a forklift moved the bin, a large roll of steel (approximately 800 pounds) that was beside the recycling bin rolled across the aisle from the coil rack and struck the employee. The employee suffered broken toes and leg injuries.

An employee was moving 2x4's into a single-family home under construction when he fell into a floor hole in the middle of the floor, breaking ribs, puncturing a lung, and fracturing neck vertebrae. The floor hole was unguarded at the time of the incident.

On or about June 27, 2016, an employee incurred a fingertip amputation of the little finger and laceration of the ring finger on her right hand. The employee was operating a laminating machine when the machine stopped.  The employee tried to get the machine started by adjusting the belt.  When she touched the belt, the machine started up, catching her fingers.
An employee was installing filters on a paint booth and fell seven feet off the ladder, breaking ribs and a collar bone.
An employee bent over to pull up a fence post when he suffered a slipped disc in his lower back.
An employee was using a step stool to scan products with a hand-held scanner unit. The employee then fell from the stool, injuring a leg and fracturing the left hip.

On June 28, 2016, at approximately 1:00 AM, an employee went to sit on a high rolling chair when the chair moved and she fell to the floor, landing on her left hip. She suffered a compression fracture to the back and was hospitalized.
An employee fell 10 feet when the scaffold he was on collapsed. He was hospitalized with five cracked ribs.

An employee was on a man-lift when it was struck by an 18-wheeler. He fell approximately 15 to 19 feet to the ground below, injuring both legs and lacerating his head. His lower leg was surgically amputated.
An employee was detailing an RV while standing on a ladder. As the employee was climbing down the ladder, he slipped off and fell, fracturing his right leg.
On or about June 28, 2016, an employee was operating a dolly to move a hydraulic brake weighing several hundred pounds. The hydraulic brake fell over and injured the employee's knee.

An employee was riding on the side of a chassis racker (a specialized industrial truck) while being trained. The trainer was in the driver's seat operating the industrial truck. The trainer drove the truck too close to a nearby chassis, and the injured employee's leg was caught between the moving truck and the nearby chassis. He sustained a severe laceration/cut to his left calf/leg that required stitches and overnight hospitalization.
An employee was organizing empty boxes after merchandising a store when she fell to the floor and fractured her left fibula.
An employee was using vise grips to repair an overhead door when his left ring finger was caught in the hinge of the tool, amputating the fingertip.

An employee had parked a vehicle. As he was getting out, he felt lightheaded, fainted, and fell to the floor. He did not have a chance to station the vehicle and his body was dragged on the road, injuring his right shoulder and left leg.
An employee was removing dirty iron from a bull ladle when he was spattered by the hot iron and suffered second and third degree burns on his face, neck, shoulders, and arms.
An employee tripped on cardboard and fell while walking, injuring the left leg.
An employee was rotating (spinning) a luggage dolly when his left index finger was caught in the dolly, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was using a lead shot plastic face hammer when the hammer struck his left index finger, breaking it.
An employee was bitten on the leg by a rattlesnake and hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking up the stairs, injuring her face and right eye.
An employee was engaged in bird control operations while standing on a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder while descending and suffered back pain, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading signs onto a flatbed truck parked on the shoulder of the road when an automobile veered onto the shoulder and struck the employee. The employee suffered broken bones, an internal injury, and a leg amputation.
An employee was unloading a box truck while it was raining. He slipped on the wet floor of the truck bed and fell, breaking his right femur.
On or about June 28, 2016, an employee was using a trim saw to cut down bronze castings when the employee's left hand contacted the cutting blade, amputating the third, fourth, and fifth digits.
An employee was trying to remove material that was stuck in the trimming machine when the blade came down and partially amputated his left index finger without bone loss.
An employee was distributing milk bottles to calves when his right foot was caught between a walking deck and the suspension wheel of a trailer.

An employee was cutting foam with a disc saw when he contacted the blade, injuring his left middle fingertip. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was starting up a compressor with a fitting on the hard pipe airline. The airline was loose and allowed air pressure to release and hit the employee in the face. His face became swollen and his lungs got air in them.

An employee was helping to remove sand from holding tanks during hydraulic fracturing treatment rigging  breakdown. A pipe containing an auger was being used to remove sand from a tank.  There was an opening at the end to allow the sand to drop from the pipe, and the employee thought the pipe was stopped up. While inspecting the opening, the employee's left-hand index finger was amputated to the distal joint and the middle finger was severely lacerated by the rotating auger inside the pipe.

An employee was moving a 1,300-pound steel skeleton off the plasma table with an overhead crane. The employee set the work piece down on the ground and was trying to manually push it toward the scrap pile. The material shifted and tipped over, striking and pinning the employee between the work piece and a stationary toolbox. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a fractured sternum, requiring hospitalization.
On June 28, 2016, at approximately 8:45 PM, an employee was operating a machine when his arm contacted the shackle wheel guide bar on the equipment, puncturing his right forearm.

An employee was working on the roof taking photographs and measurements when he stepped through a skylight and fell approximately 20 feet, striking metal shelving before landing on the concrete flooring. He suffered fractured ribs (all), a fractured sternum, a fractured back in three locations, and a fractured skull.

An employee was walking through an atrium to go from one building to another when she lost her balance and fell into the approximately 1-inch-deep water. She suffered a shoulder injury and required surgery.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and was driving through the curtains to the freezer. As he used his right hand to open the curtain, his left hand was caught between the pallet jack handle and a post, smashing his left thumb. He was hospitalized and required thumb surgery.
An employee started removing fiber and cleaning a carding machine while it was being repaired and his right-hand ring and pinky fingers were amputated.
An employee was overcome with heat stress symptoms while unloading a trailer.
While adjusting material on the fence of a band saw, an employee's hand contacted the saw blade, amputating the right thumb tip.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a pump to a commercial washing machine. After using water to prime the pump, the employee ran the cleaning fluid to the pump. Residual water with cleaning product was caught in a hand-held container. The employee inhaled the cleaning product odor and experienced respiratory tract irritation and distress.
An employee was attempting to straighten a pin with a sledge hammer when the sledge hammer struck his right hand, fracturing his middle and ring fingers.
An employee suffered a seizure and fell off the scaffold striking his head and causing a laceration. The employee was also diagnosed with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was working with yarn when her finger was caught in the yarn cutter guide during a string-up operation, causing an amputation.

An employee was pulling a rope connected to tubing when the tubing bent and the attached clamp struck him in the face and collarbone. He suffered a facial laceration and fractured collarbone, requiring hospitalization.

At 11:34 a.m., an employee was working with an electric pallet jack while another receiving associate had a forklift. When the employee went to move the electric pallet jack, the handle was turned in such a way that when it moved, it moved backwards and smashed her left-hand pinky into the forklift battery. Her pinky fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
On or about June 28, 2016, an employee was performing environmental cleaning work when a nearby coworker's brush saw kicked back and deeply cut the employee's left thigh.

An employee was operating an aircraft pushback vehicle. The vehicle began to "buck" and the employee struck her head on the windshield, suffering facial cuts and bruises and a spinal compression fracture. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift to transport wooden skids/pallets when the forklift struck a concrete post in the warehouse. The employee was hospitalized with possible back and leg injuries.

An employee was standing on a 5-gallon bucket to unjam a board on the chain deck when he fell off the bucket onto his right side, fracturing a rib, puncturing a lung, and suffering a laceration behind his right ear.
An employee was moving 50 gallon oil drums at the site shop when he pinched his finger between two barrels, causing a partial amputation of his fingertip.
An employee was fire-taping above the ceiling when his arm brushed against a pipe, scratching his right elbow. His elbow experienced pain and swelling, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a truck. When he pulled on a tote, he fell onto a metal step and broke his hip.
An employee was installing pipes. The rigging slipped and a pipe struck his leg fracturing it.
The employee was working on the HVAC system at the restaurant and was bitten by an insect. The employee had a reaction to the insect bite.
An employee wasn't feeling well while delivering packages and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was changing a belt on an air conditioner motor when his right hand was caught between the belt and pulley, amputating his ring finger and fracturing his middle finger.
An employee was re-assembling a valve and caught his finger between the valve shaft and a cover plate resulting in a severe laceration of the left middle finger through the bone.

On June 29, 2016, an employee was hospitalized due to a fall on the same level. The employee stepped on a pallet and the pallet moved, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor resulting in a fracture of the L1 vertebrae.
The employee was directing a mini-excavator onto a trailer when the excavator shifted and struck his hand, amputating a fingertip.
An employee's right index fingertip was amputated when the finger was caught between a piece of over-pour and the door to the shaker-shack.
An employee was redrawing a steel wire to reduce the diameter using a redrawing machine. When he attempted to untangle the wire, it amputated his left pinky, ring, and middle fingers.
An employee was hospitalized after falling off the platform of a boom truck.

Two employees were working on the super unleaded tank when an explosion occurred. One employee suffered burns to the arms and smoke inhalation. The second employee suffered burns to his lower extremities. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was climbing stairs and slipped backwards and struck his head on the steps.
An employee's leg was impaled by protruding rebar.
An employee was under a running truck tightening a packing gland and was injured by the PTO shaft.
An employee leaving the facility around 6:30p.m. was shot in the upper chest and face by an assailant.

Two employees were manually handling two pieces of 3" x 3" x 3/8" angle iron that were 20-feet long, attempting to get the pieces on a band saw. As the employees moved the angle iron onto the saw, the injured employee's right pinky finger was caught between the angle iron and the saw table, amputating the fingertip.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from a double gang job ladder to the lower level and suffered injuries including two fractured ribs, a punctured lung and a laceration to the back of the head.

Employees were loading regulators onto a truck for delivery when the lifting cable on their digger truck broke causing the regulator to fall. When the regulator fell, it hit a crate and rolled striking an employee's head. The employee suffered three lacerations to the head that required 35 staples and seven stiches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell 10 feet to the ground from a ceiling beam during a remediation project.
An employee operating a saw on a wing line suffered a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee fell while in the back of the truck and injured his right hip.
An employee was hospitalized when she became ill, lost her balance, and contacted the floor resulting in a small linear fracture to the head.
An employee was performing bagging operations. The employee reached into the machine to retrieve a melting bag and was caught by the heating bar resulting in the amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was on a scaffold using a chain fall to remove the manway cover to a vessel. As the employee removed the manway cover, the chain fall had too much slack and slipped, catching and amputating the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was rinsing empty trailers and was bumped on the left hip and pushed into the trailer tire stomach first by a forklift.
An employee was feeding a notcher machine and amputated his left ring and little finger.
An employee plugged the blood pressure machine into the wall outlet and received an electrical shock.
An employee was injured on June 29, 2016, while driving the camp golf cart.  The cart tipped over and fell onto the employee breaking the left arm.
An employee was attempting to unjam the Manchester machine (shapes copper tubing) and amputated the third finger on the right hand at the first joint.
The employee attempted to throw a urinal up and into the dumpster. The urinal struck the top, broke, and fell back striking and lacerating the employee's right forearm.
An employee had the right middle fingertip amputated while making adjustments on a moulder that was in operation.
An employee collapsed after telling his co-workers he was not feeling well.

An employee was directing the use of a tow strap to move a vehicle when the employee's left pinky finger was crushed by a quick coupler that was on a rubber tire loader. The employee's finger was amputated up to the knuckle.

An employee was working from an extension ladder to paint the side of a single-story residential home when he lost his footing, fell to the ground, struck his head on the concrete surface below, and sustained a head injury to the point of unconsciousness. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a box container when the boxes began to fall. The employee tripped and fell while trying to avoid the falling boxes, striking the bottom of the container and fracturing the right clavicle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was opening a lower clam door on a jet when he felt a burning sensation in his groin. He was hospitalized for a hematoma and infection.

An employee was setting up a part on a lathe. As the machine was spinning, the employee's gloved hand became caught between the spinning part and the tailstock, amputating the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was preparing to hook up a tank trailer to his truck and suffered heat exhaustion.
A temporary employee was hospitalized for dehydration while he was working as a CNC machine operator.
An employee was rolling up a door on a truck and amputated his right index finger when it was caught in the folding door.
An employee was hospitalized for possible infection of lacerations on the left arm that the employee received while attempting to remove debris from an insulation blower.
On June 30, 2016, an employee was working between the cab and trailer of a truck, standing on a six foot ladder. The employee fell backwards and broke his wrist and heel.
An employee suffered a finger amputation.
An employee released the park brake on a forklift and went to get something from a van. The forklift rolled forward, striking the employee and breaking the employee's leg.
An employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.
The employee was working on the conveyor system from the catwalk and fell 12-15 feet resulting in fractured vertebrae and ribs.
An employee was using a powered walk-behind forklift to move raw material when he was pinned between the forklift and a roll of metal, injuring his hip and liver.
An employee mowing lawns was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was performing a hot splice, hooking up temporary power to residential construction from a main distribution using a crimping tool when an arc flash occurred. He sustained second degree burns on his left arm and first and second degree burns on his face.
An employee was on a back country patrol when his horse bolted. The employee's hand/finger was caught in the bridal reins.

An employee was performing maintenance on skid steer equipment. The employee was changing the bucket and putting pins on. The lock pins were stuck so the employee used a pry bar to pop it loose, but it did not come apart. The employee asked another worker to tilt the skid while the pry bar was in the front of the equipment. The employee's left ring finger got caught between the pry bar and the skid steer carriage resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee fell approximately 6 to 8 feet from a 12-foot ladder while hanging up a flag outside the maintenance shop, suffering a broken femur.

An employee drove a float in the parade. She parked the float and as she was climbing out of the driver's compartment, the hatch came down onto her left hand which was resting on the edge of the opening. A finger was fractured and dislocated.
While descending from the roof on an extended ladder, an employee slipped and fell approximately 4 feet from the ladder, spraining the left wrist.
An employee was unloading a truck at the loading dock when a nearby dock plate leaning on the wall fell onto his leg, fracturing it.

An employee was closing a side door of a trailer when another employee was starting up another truck. The truck rolled back and struck the employee in the mid-section pinning him between the truck and the trailer, causing internal injuries.
While treating water in an aboveground tank, an employee became ill from heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was ratcheting a load on top of a pallet and slipped and fell backwards off the pallet fracturing lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was cutting beets with a knife and amputated the tip of the left pinky finger.

At 7:15 pm, on June 30, 2016, an employee was operating a sit-down forklift truck to put product into a dumpster when his left index finger was caught between the fork and the dumpster. His fingertip was amputated above the knuckle, requiring surgery.
An employee was anodizing parts on a polishing machine when the part jerked, breaking the employee's left thumb and pinky finger.
An employee fell while walking up an incline to the building in the parking lot, fracturing ribs and puncturing a lung.
An employee was cutting an onion with a knife when the blade amputated his left thumb. Cutting gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a commercial grass mower on an incline when the mower began to roll over. To prevent a rollover, he placed his hand onto the mower deck. During the machine's movement, his hand entered the rotating mower blades under the deck, severely lacerating and injuring his right hand. He was hospitalized.
On or about June 30, 2016, an employee fell down the steps in the maintenance building, suffering a back injury.

An employee was working in the electric panel of a rotor machine when an arc flash occurred. The employee received burns on both arms and the face. The electric power was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was doing concrete formwork when he turned into a coworker who was using a sledgehammer on a stake. The employee's left middle finger was caught and fractured between the sledgehammer and stake.

An employee had to manually place a trash container onto a hydraulic lift to empty the container. After the container was emptied, the employee was placing the lift back into position. As the arm of the lift was being raised, his left hand entered the path of the lift's arm, crushing his left pinky finger. His finger was partially amputated via surgery.

On June 30, 2016, a work crew was preparing to offload an electric utility pole from a trailer to install it into the ground. As they attempted to roll the pole off the trailer, a hook-shaped copper ground on the pole caught and wrapped up the safety vest of the injured employee, causing him to be pulled toward the rolling pole. He tried to free himself, but the pole landed on his lower right leg, breaking his fibula and dislocating his ankle.
An employee was installing a fiberglass grating when he fell off a platform, injuring his head. His harness was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was changing out the retainer on a shear machine when he was struck in the chest by the retainer ring, breaking his sternum.

An employee was delivering products from a trailer when he became pinned between a pallet jack and product rack while moving the rack inside the trailer. He suffered a concussion and injured his lower hip and leg.
An employee was setting a piece of casing in a trench when the line-up tab broke, swung off the pipe, struck the employee in the head and chest, and pinned him between the pipe and wall.

An employee was in the dressing room area pulling carts together to take to the front of the store. As she was backing up with the carts, one of the carts got caught on a stool in the shoe department. She got caught in the shopping cart and fell. She was hospitalized for a fractured right hip that required surgery.
An employee was operating an ATV near railroad tracks, looking for signs of foot traffic, when the ATV hit a rock and threw the employee. He was hospitalized with a suspected fractured clavicle.

An employee operating a powered industrial truck drove over an oil spill and lost control. The employee slid and rested against an iron column. The employee's left leg was pinned and fractured between the powered industrial truck and the iron column, requiring hospitalization.
On 7/1/16, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee experienced shortness of breath while delivering mail, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.

An employee was transferring diesel fuel from the middle tank of a fuel truck to the forward tank using a barrel pump when a fire/explosion occurred. The fire/explosion threw the employee off the tanker to the ground and ignited his clothing, causing second and third degree burns to his body and arms.
An employee was sharpening mower blades when his shirt was caught by the blade-sharpening grinder. His right forearm was cut to the bone, requiring hospitalization.

As an employee was trying to close a gate on a cattle pen, a cow charged the gate, crushing the employee's left middle finger between the cow's head and the gate.  The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated as a result of the injury.
On or about July 01, 2016, an employee tripped over a railing while walking from the warehouse to his work station, breaking seven ribs.
An employee was unloading pallets and tripped on a pallet resulting in a broken foot/ankle.

An employee was troubleshooting a pelletizer machine that cuts crystal polystyrene using a knife blade. He made contact with the pelletizer machine blade, amputating his right-hand index fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee collapsed while making deliveries at a residence due to environmental heat temperatures and hit her head on the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was hooking wire rope slings to a cargo container when one of the slings came loose and struck the employee on the chest. The employee suffered broken ribs, a cracked sternum, and a fractured left ring finger.

An employee was unloading a truck when the dock plate did not extend completely. As the employee pulled it out to extend it, his finger was caught between the plate and the trailer, amputating his fingertip. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee's right hand was crushed and his fingertip was amputated by a rotating fan blade. The fan was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee had cleaned up the wood room with a walk-behind track loader and was returning the loader to storage. As he was glancing over his shoulder to make sure the way was clear, his right foot was caught in the left track of the loader, causing him to fall and break his right leg.

On 7/1/16, at approximately 6:30 PM, an employee was helping to pull tubing from a derrick rig. The employee climbed the derrick structure to attach the necessary rigging. As he descended to the working level, his climb assist became caught/wrapped in the gooseneck assembly. He was then pulled into the derrick board, breaking his tibia and dislocating his ankle.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor when his hand was caught in a roller and his arm was pulled into the conveyor, breaking it.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to a wasp sting and was hospitalized.

A packaging machine vacuum stopped working. The employee thought the vacuum line was clogged and reached inside the machine with his right hand to unclog it. The fan blade was still rotating and struck his right middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet from a welded, tubular steel frame scaffold into the bottom of an empty pool, suffering a leg/foot injury.
An employee was cleaning a pasta processing machine when her hand contacted the lower blade, amputating her left ring and middle fingers just above the middle knuckle.
An employee was adjusting racking. The grate slipped and smashed a finger resulting in the amputation of a fingertip on the left hand.

On Friday, July 1, 2016, an employee was performing maintenance work when the equipment he was working on suddenly energized and caught his hand inside the machine. His fingertips were medically amputated.
An employee was descending a portable extension ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground below, breaking bones. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

On or about 7/1/16, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was climbing into an articulating boom lift from the horizontal section of a structural steel tube that was 12 feet above the ground when he began to slip. A coworker who was in the lift went to grab the employee and was pulled out of the lift, causing both employees to fall 12 feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized overnight for a fractured vertebra. The coworker was not hospitalized.

An employee was helping a customer when she tripped on a floor mat behind the cosmetic counter, striking her head on the counter and lacerating her arm on the cabinet before falling to the floor. She suffered a concussion.
An employee was operating a forklift and struck a fixed object resulting in the amputation of part of his foot.

An employee was inside a security guard shack when a generator from a construction company that was performing work at the facility emitted exhaust fumes into the shack. The employee became dizzy and lightheaded, requiring hospitalization for carbon monoxide exposure.
An employee was adjusting a conveyor belt when it caught his hand, amputating the right ring and middle fingertips. The conveyor was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking up a 4' platform, missed the second from the last step and fell, fracturing his hip.
While carrying a load of pallets on a forklift, an employee struck a column pole, suffering severe head injuries.

An employee had stopped at a rest area and was walking around the front of his vehicle when he was struck by the front/passenger area of his vehicle as it rolled forward and turned to the right. He was pinned between his truck and an adjacent trailer, breaking his pelvis, rupturing his spleen, and injuring his knee.

An employee was repairing a garage-type door that was stuck in the open position. The door malfunctioned and a cable had made a loop. His hand was on a railing when the door fell and caught his hand in the loop of the cable. Three of his right-hand fingers were damaged.

On Saturday, July 2, 2016, at approximately 10:35 a.m., an employee was working alone on the inside of an aircraft engine to repair its blades. The employee was attempting to leave the engine compartment when the work mat beneath him slipped, causing him to slide out of the engine compartment. As he slid out of the engine compartment, his foot became tangled in the nearby portable A-frame step-ladder that he used to access that compartment. He then fell about 3 to 4 feet to the adjacent ground level and broke his right hip, requiring hospitalization.
On July 1, 2016, an employee was cleaning up a work area outside in reported temperatures of 97 degrees with a heat index of 105. He began to feel unwell and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was remotely controlling a crane to move concrete barricades in the coil yard. The rebar handle on a concrete barricade failed, causing the crane's chain rigging to whip up, hitting the employee in the hand. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was pulling mail out of the dock when the gate from an APC cart fell and struck her on the head. She was hospitalized with a head contusion.
An employee was operating a tractor to push a pile when the tractor flipped over. The employee was hospitalized and had stitches.
An employee walked out carrying a till when she tripped on a cardboard box on the floor.  She fell and broke her left hip.
An employee was cleaning equipment when two of the employee's fingers were amputated.
An employee was measuring wind turbine blades on a scaffold when the scaffold hoist malfunctioned, causing the employee to fall approximately 140 feet to the ground and suffer severe body injuries.

An employee was riding a horse on patrol when the horse became spooked and threw the employee, who fell 35 feet down the hillside. The employee suffered head lacerations and broke eight ribs and the sternum.

An employee stopped his truck on the highway to go to the restroom. The employee stepped over the guard rail of the highway and the ground gave way under his feet. He tumbled about 60 yards down the side of the mountain, cracking seven ribs and puncturing a lung.

An employee was attempting to adjust a row of televisions on a metal rack while on a power lift. When he stepped off the lift onto the steel rack, he fell 20 feet to the concrete below, fracturing both arms, contusing his right eye, and lacerating/fracturing his skull/forehead.
An employee slipped in the freezer and fell, breaking her hip.
An employee was cleaning floors with a hot-water hose when the hose burst and sprayed the employee, causing third-degree burns to the employee's left foot and ankle.

An employee was operating a chop saw on an extrusion line when the saw became jammed. As he attempted to clear the jam, the saw amputated his left-hand ring finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On July 4, 2016, at 08:35 AM, an employee was struck by a vehicle operating in reverse. The employee suffered two fractured legs.
An employee was struck by a forklift, requiring hospitalization for a left knee laceration.
On July 4, 2016, at 12:00 PM, an employee fell from a 5-foot ladder while she was stocking shelves and hit her head on the floor.
An employee was making metal parts on a spin unit when the employee's right hand was caught between a part and the machine, fracturing it.
An employee was replacing a 40-foot pole and was installing a lightning arrester when the arrester failed, resulting in second degree flash burns to the left side of his face. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were lowering a part from a mast of a ship. As the employees were lowering the part with a pulley and a tagline, the part got caught in something. The injured employee pulled hard on the tagline, cutting the line and the part fell on his right index finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was performing duct work demolition from an extension ladder approximately 15 feet off the ground. The ladder feet slipped and the employee fell from the ladder, which then fell onto the employee. The employee suffered a dislocated shoulder and head/arm lacerations, requiring hospitalization.

An employee and his co-worker were removing a sheet metal air duct fitting from a scissor lift. After removing two of the four bolts, they brought the lift down to the floor to get additional tools. While the co-worker left to get the tools, the employee raised the lift back up to remove the remaining two bolts. The employee then lowered the lift back to the floor to wait on the co-worker. While standing in the lift at the floor level, the employee was struck by the fitting when it came loose and fell, injuring the employee's back and nose and fracturing a vertebra.
An employee fell down a utility pole to the ground, breaking his heel and lacerating his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an 8-foot ladder to remove a recessed "can" for lighting when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a head injury.
An employee was working on a survey crew and reached to the ground for his bag when a rattlesnake bit him on his left middle finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to lower a concrete piece of manhole onto another section when it fell and landed on the employee. He suffered a broken left clavicle, broken left ribs, and a broken hip.
An employee was pushing a cart to collect mail from the collection box when he fainted and hit the left side of his face and his left leg. He suffered a leg cut and eye bleeding.
An employee was walking alongside a forklift when the forklift turned and pinned the employee between it and the wall. He suffered abdominal pain and difficulty breathing, requiring hospitalization.
An employee climbed onto a truck catwalk, tripped over air lines, and fell to the ground. The employee stood up and fell again, and a trailer then ran over the employee, fracturing both of his legs.
An employee passed out while preparing trays in the kitchen due to the heat.

An employee was setting up for a new print run and was feeling the roller to see if it had enough ink when his right hand was pulled in between the rollers. His right hand and fingers were crushed and fractured.
An employee was trying to rig up a well. The employee enabled the clutch and accidently struck the emergency stop button resulting in a kick back and a broken left arm.
An employee was installing a tray on a press when his left finger was caught and amputated in the machine's roller.
