An employee was climbing down the scaffold ladder and fell. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a spinal cord injury.
An employee fell backwards from a truck and struck his head on the concrete, suffering a possible concussion.

On or about 7/11/16, an employee was moving four pieces of metal weighing about 84 pounds. He hand-carried the metal to a truck bed and set it down on his pinky finger. When he attempted to pull his finger out, he suffered a deep avulsion. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
While working on a truck, an employee was struck in the face by a pry bar, suffering a laceration to the left cheek and eye.
An employee was helping to adjust a row boat line when the employee's left ring finger was caught/amputated at the second digit between the rope and a cleat of the float dock.

An employee was helping to position a 'cage' form into a caisson for concrete. A 2x4 that was part of the rigging came loose and hit the employee in the face, causing multiple facial fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking around a customer's establishment looking for a floor mat that was to be cleaned when the employee tripped over a duffel bag and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee was carrying a box when she tripped on her own feet and fell to the floor, breaking her left wrist.
An employee was approaching an injection molding machine when she tripped and fell from the floor level onto a conveyor, suffering a large hematoma to her upper left leg.

Employee 1 was disconnecting a pressurized hose used to offload sulfuric acid from a rail tank car into a storage tank when he was sprayed with sulfuric acid.  Employee 2 tried to help Employee 1 and was also sprayed with sulfuric acid.  Employee 1 was hospitalized for treatment of burns to the arms, face, and chest.  Employee 2 was hospitalized for treatment of burns to the arms.
An employee was loading metal into a pot and sustained a hernia requiring surgery and hospitalization.

On July 12, 2016, at approximately 1:45 p.m., an employee was attempting to remove a stairway from a 100-barrel tank that was also being prepped for removal. The stairway was held to a platform by two bolts. Standing on the ground, the employee removed one bolt, which allowed the stairway to swing towards the tank. The employee was pinned between the tank and the stairway, suffering a collapsed left lung, contusion to the back and right shoulder, and friction burn to the trunk and right ear. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a belt conveyor. The employee's right-hand middle finger was amputated while the employee disassembled the baggage tug.

An employee was spotting for a forklift driver who was attempting to lift a steel I-beam. The employee was standing on the opposite side of the I-beam pile from the forklift. When the driver began to lift the I-beam, the pile shifted. 
One of the-I beams rolled down and landed on the employee's ankle, breaking it in several places.
The injured employee and a second employee were laying a walkway on its side when the employee's foot slipped on some rock and the walkway fell onto the employee's leg, breaking his tibia.
An employee received an electric shock when she went to turn off the air conditioner in the day room, suffering a burning feeling in her chest and pain in her right arm and leg.
An employee fell through a safety rail at a height of 18-20 feet injuring their back and feet.
An employee went to the hospital with a potential heat related illness.
An employee was hospitalized with two broken legs after the ram of a press brake he was cleaning fell on top of him.
While lifting milk products in the back of a vehicle, an employee felt a pop and was hospitalized with a sprain.

An employee removed a tap from a brine tank containing cold water (8-10 degrees). The brine liquid burned the employee's right hand, palm, and forearm. The employee was admitted to the hospital burn unit.

An employee was helping a forging hammer operator and was attempting to release a part lodged inside the hammer. The employee's hand tool became caught inside the point of operation and broke when the machine cycled. A piece of the hand tool ejected and struck the employee, breaking bones and lacerating the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

After working on the ground and gathering materials for the lineman, an employee became ill and started vomiting due to dehydration and heat cramps. The employee was hospitalized with heat-related illness.

An employee operating a forklift retrieved a pallet from the metal rack in the meat department. There were two pallets on the rack; one pallet was leaning on the other. When the employee placed one pallet on the floor, he exited his forklift to check the load. Fifteen to 20 small boxes from the pallet on the rack then fell and struck the employee, fracturing his left leg below the knee and three toes on his left foot.
An employee was throwing glass into the rework hopper when the glass slipped out of his hand and contacted his neck, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was admitted for in-patient hospitalization on July 12, 2016, due to heat exhaustion.
An employee went to adjust the load on a forklift when the load fell on the employee's foot, causing a contusion.
An employee was performing framework in high temperatures and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was removing a tire from a forklift. While removing the tire from the split rim, the employee removed all of the split rim bolts. When the tire was inflated, the split rim separated and struck the employee in the left side of his head, face, and jaw. He suffered lacerations that required surgery.

An employee was hauling metal roof panels on a flat roof when he fell 20 feet through the roof to the building's floor, shattering his pelvis and fracturing his jaw, right elbow, right wrist, and left femur. He was hospitalized.

Employees were loading a skid steer when the operator of the machine lost control and jumped clear from the operator's station. The injured employee attempted to get to the controls to stop the machine when he suffered lacerations and a fracture to his right foot.

An employee was heating up a track frame pin with a torch. While the employee was removing the track frame pin, a hot bolt or part of the frame pin punctured an adjacent aerosol can of brake cleaner and the contents ignited into a ball of fame, causing thermal burns to the employee's lower left and right arms and face.
An employee connected a compressed air connection to fill the compressed air tank when the tank burst. The employee was struck by flying debris, suffering facial injuries and abdominal pain.
Employees were working on a wheel loader when the bucket fell off and struck an employee's left ankle, breaking it and requiring surgery.
On July 12, 2016, an employee was offloading a 2-yard dumpster when the employee's finger became caught between the truck and the container lock. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was injured when he lost control of the ATV he was driving and crashed into a tree while transporting trash to its disposal. The employee sustained a fractured left rib and punctured left lung.
A dump truck driver was preparing to dump a load of dirt. The bed of the truck struck an overhead power line. The driver received an electrical shock when he exited the truck.

On or about July 12, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after receiving a severe laceration to the left armpit from a dragon saw. As the employee went to set the dragon saw onto the ground with one hand, the saw was activated and jumped striking the employee under  the arm.
An employee was moving a transformer that was on a hand dolly. The employee  tilted the dolly back so that he could move it and it fell over and struck the employee in the right ankle, breaking it.

An employee picked up carpet from a carpet cutting machine. The machine was still running and his ring finger got caught on the tip of the blade. The employee was wearing gloves when his finger was struck by the blade resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee fainted at work and hit his head on the floor.
While traveling on a forklift in the warehouse, an employee scraped against a concrete and metal pillar. The employee's foot was pinched between the forklift and metal pillar.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck by a transfer beam that kicked out and struck him in the abdomen resulting in a broken rib and punctured lung on the right side.
On or about July 12, 2016, an employee was using a nail gun to install wood blocking. The nail gun discharged and the nail struck the employee in the stomach area.

An employee was working from a 10 foot step ladder on an overhead register vent. As the employee went to pull down the register, he fell backwards about 5 feet to the floor below and fractured his right ankle. The employee required surgery to his ankle and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was operating a road shouldering grader while doing road work and experienced dizziness and numbness in his arms. He was later hospitalized.
An employee's fingertip was amputated when a drill rig bucket fell on his finger.
On or about July 12, 2016, an employee was attaching two trailers together and crushed their left pinky finger between a dolly and a truck trailer resulting in amputation of the left pinky finger.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a granite curb. When he set the saw down, the blade was still rotating and made contact with the curb. The saw then kicked back and struck the employee in the right shoulder and forearm, slicing his skin.
An employee fell from a 6-foot ladder and suffered a fractured leg.
An employee fell out of their chair and damaged their artificial hip.
While in the yard, an employee climbed on top of a truck to level off a load of coal, lost his balance and fell off. The employee was hospitalized for a contusion and hematoma on the right hip.
An employee was fixing a link on a track. The track pads shifted and pinched the employee's left pinky finger. The finger was later amputated.
An employee was riding a walking stacker. His right foot slipped off the walking stacker and was caught between it and a pallet resulting in a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs, breaking her ankle.
An employee was inside a grain bin sweeping down rice when his leg was caught in the operating sweep auger. He sustained severe leg wound injuries that required surgery.
An employee was departing through the front entryway when the automatic door struck the employee. The employee fell and injured their left hip requiring surgery.

The employee was attempting to remove a pin from a tube that is part of a dump truck's lifting mechanism with an air chisel. The pin shot out at him, striking him in the stomach area. The pin is approximately 2 inches in diameter. It did not pierce the skin, but caused bruising/internal injury.
An employee was installing sod and began to feel unwell. He was admitted to the hospital and treated for dehydration.

An employee was installing wood bracing on the trusses. A gust of wind knocked over the trusses which caused the employee to fall approximately 16' to the ground resulting in a sprained left ankle and a fractured L6 vertebrae.
An employee on his mail delivery route was showing signs of dehydration and was taken to the hospital. The employee was admitted for further evaluation.

An employee was digging up the irrigation piping system because it was not working and was planning on troubleshooting the system. While he was digging, he felt dizzy, got cold chills, and then sat down and drank water to cool down. When he stood up, he began to vomit and required hospitalization for dehydration. The temperature and percent relative humidity at the time of the incident was 89 degrees and 59%, respectively.
An employee was hospitalized after exhibiting symptoms of heat stress during a pipeline certification course.
The employee was inspecting a parked mobile excavator. Dirt in the bucket of the boom arm fell out and struck the employee's left leg dislocating the knee.
An employee was participating in a team building event and fractured their right leg.

An employee was working a trouble call for a low wire. He was working off a 25 foot pole when it broke and fell over. The employee fell to the ground while tied off to the pole and suffered a fracture in the upper left arm above the elbow and a hip fracture.
On or about July 13, 2016, an employee was hospitalized with a heat illness.
An employee was hospitalized for a possible concussion after falling from a two story roof while stocking shingles.
An employee was walking to a meeting when she slipped on a dry erase marker that was on the floor and broke her leg.
An employee was struck by a forklift truck that was moving a tote of fertilizer on a wooden pallet resulting in a left leg fracture.
An employee was bitten while grooming a dog, resulting in a puncture wound on the hand.
An employee was adjusting the belt and pulley on a lawn mower when his middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped on a puddle of water in the main lobby and suffered a knee injury.
An employee amputated the tip of their right index finger and their middle finger when they were caught between a casting and a machine apron while trying to remove the casting from the machine.
An employee was walking, tripped on a shoe lace, and fell fracturing the right hip.
An employee was hospitalized after a horse kicked him in the chest.

An employee was working on the 102-2 envelope machine while it was running. The employee was loosening a bolt with a wrench when the wrench slipped and the employee's right hand entered the machine's scoring section that includes a shaft and two blades. The blades amputated the employee's right index finger to the middle phalanx.
An employee amputated a hand while operating a cement delivery vehicle.

An employee was operating a trackhoe where acid waste was undergoing treatment in a stabilization tank. The operator became unconscious after being exposed to hydrogen sulfide generated from the stabilization tank.

An employee was changing the end tape in a bundler machine and the employee's hand was in the path of the product. The product pushed his hand into the wall resulting in a partial amputation of his right middle finger.
An employee felt light headed and fainted.

An employee was assembling/testing an automated two-inch ball valve actuator. He put his finger in for alignment and released the air and his left middle finger was partially amputated (partial bone, on the tip of the finger).
The employee was cutting a tree limb with a chain saw when the tree limb contacted the saw and the saw contacted the employee's arm causing injury to the left arm.
An employee fell backwards while mopping the floor, hitting her head and blacking out. She was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was squatting down adjusting inventories on lower shelves while a coworker was stocking yeti ice chests approximately 16 feet above the injured employee. The yeti ice chests were in cardboard boxes and  weighed about 45lbs. The coworker lost their grip on one of the yeti boxes and it fell onto the injured employee knocking her into the shelving and then onto the floor. The injured employee passed out, and sustained a laceration on her left temple. She also suffered a broken right ankle and sustained injuries to her back. The injured employee was hospitalized.

An employee fell a distance of approximately twenty feet while performing concrete work on a pour form wall. One of the engineered ties used to hold the form in place snapped allowing for concrete to pour out of the form, striking the scissor lift from which the employee was working, and causing the scissor lift to topple over. The employee fell to the ground where he sustained serious injury to his arm and pelvic region.

An employee was on a 6/12 pitch roof tearing off shingles from a single story residence. The employee was wearing a harness and attached to a lanyard that was anchored on the roof. At the time of the incident, the employee was preparing to get off the roof and disconnected his lanyard from the harness. He was transitioning to the ladder and lost his footing falling 6 to 8 feet to the ground below. The employee fractured a bone in his back and was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was operating an angle cutting machine. When the employee tried to remove a piece of metal, the machine began another cycle and the metal plate on the machine struck the employee's wrist causing a severe laceration, severed tendons, and broken bones.

The employee was placing material from the back of the truck onto a door that was lying across the forks of a forklift. When he stepped backwards, he stepped onto the edge of the door, lost his balance and fell to the concrete 4 to 5 feet below. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the leg and injured his foot and ankle.

On July 12, 2016, an employee was admitted to the hospital as a result of crushing injuries that resulted in a laceration across the palm of the hand. The employee was cleaning the rollers on a roll coater machine with a cotton shop rag when a hand was pulled into an in-running nip-point between rollers.
An employee slipped off the bottom rung of a truck mounted ladder and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was slicing meat using a meat slicer when his left pinky fingertip contacted the cutting blade and was lacerated.

An employee was attempting to stabilize the concrete barrier that was being lifted by a rubber tire loader. The operator of the rubber tire loader lowered the barrier and caught the tip of the employee's right foot resulting in amputation of the tip of the right foot to the first joint.

An employee was working under a conveyor belt. When he reached for a non-moving part, his shirt sleeve was caught in the conveyor belt. His hand was then pulled into the belt, causing a strain and sprain to the wrist, minor burns from the belt's friction, and ligament tears on the first and second fingers.
An employee was turning around and caught a foot on a scale in the hallway causing her to fall on her side. The employee sustained a break to the tip of the femur.
Cutting a piece of plexiglass with a table saw when the employee's right hand was pulled into the blade, amputating the ring and middle fingers at the first knuckle.

The employee was selecting product on the third floor of a warehouse when he felt "weird."  He went to an air conditioned room and sat down. He started to feel dizzy, sweat profusely, have tunnel vision, muscle spasms, and numbness in his legs.  The employee was hospitalized for heat related stress and dehydration.
An employee was attempting to adjust the bars on a drill rig but the drill rig rotated and hit the employee. The employee was caught between the drill rig and the casing, suffering abdominal trauma.
An employee was picking up a bag in an aisle when a passing forklift ran over his foot, crushing his toe.

On July 14, 2016, at approximately 1:40 a.m., an employee was located at the end of the line where aluminum was being rolled onto a coil. Wearing cotton gloves, the employee was checking for edge cracks and used sand paper when he observed a spot. The roll was moving at approximately 900 feet/minute when the operator of the machine saw the coil buckle and hit the E-stop to prevent damage. While using the sand paper, the employee's left hand/fingers were severely crushed between the moving coil and the roller, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on an air cylinder when it activated and crushed his left index finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was climbing up a scaffold when the scaffold fell over. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was hospitalized for a bruised arm and hand after he fell from a ladder.
An employee was operating a cutoff wheel on a grinder when the wheel separated and struck the employee on the left arm and severed a vein.

While checking lines, an employee inhaled a chemical and experienced respiratory distress and tightening of the chest. The employee was hospitalized overnight for possible exposure to a gaseous substance.
An employee was pouring concrete when he became disoriented due to heat stress, requiring hospitalization.
On or about July 14, 2016, an employee was restraining a cat while waiting for euthanasia. The cat began thrashing out of control and bit the employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a security camera when the ladder he was standing on slipped out from underneath him and he fell approximately 7 to 8 feet. He fractured his fibula, scapula, and L1 vertebra.

Two company employees were in charge of traffic control/flagging operations on both ends of a street paving operation. One of the employees stopped vehicle #1 in the oncoming lane. Vehicle #2 then rear-ended vehicle #1, which in turn struck the employee. The employee was thrown approximately 30 feet and was hospitalized to receive head and elbow stitches.

An employee was in the process of setting up an RMC machine that takes mozzarella cheese and forms it into a block. The employee was installing a plastic wedge (approx. 2 ft. x 2 ft. x 1 in. thick, weighing approx. 25 lbs.) into the machine and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee dismounted from a crane boom he was reconfiguring and fractured his ankle.
An employee was attempting to unjam a paper wrap-up in a machine when a coworker jogged the machine. The employee's right hand was drawn into the rollers, de-gloving the index and middle fingers.
An employee filled a mop bucket with hot water. When the employee moved the bucket, hot water splashed onto and burned his right shin, ankle, and foot.
An employee was placing a sticker on a pallet when he was hit by the arm of the pallet wrapping machine. His arm was broken.

Two employees were performing compression checks on cylinders. One employee opened the gas valve and another employee was bending over to light the starter. The gas flashed, engulfing an employee and causing second degree burns to his face, neck, wrist, and back.

An employee went to retrieve a tool from another section of the cooling tower. En route, his pinky finger (left) was caught in the belt/pulley system of a maintenance fan as he passed by, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was greasing a conveyor when his foot slipped from the framework he was standing on and ended up on the chain drive and sprocket. The drive and sprocket crushed the toe box of his boot, partially amputating his right big toe.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when the saw amputated his left thumb at the knuckle.
On July 14, 2016, an employee sustained a broken foot when the outrigger on the truck landed on his right foot.
An employee amputated the tip of his thumb while attempting to help dock a motor boat.
An employee climbed a pole to raise conductors off of the ground. The pole broke at the ground level while the employee was on it. The employee hit the ground and suffered a fractured right hip.
On or about July 14, 2016, an employee was performing a vertical cut in a concrete wall using a gas-powered masonry cut-off saw when the saw kicked back, lacerating the employee's chest.
An employee was struck by the fork of an oncoming forklift, lacerating his left foot and breaking three toes.
An employee was coming down a ladder to leave the roof when he slipped off and fell approximately 6 feet, suffering ankle and back sprains.
An employee was testing a 240v line that had a fault and received an arc flash burn to their left arm.

On 07/14/2016, at approximately 11:15 a.m., an employee was using a saw to cut 4'x8' panels. As the employee was retracting the table back to its starting position, the blade cut the employee's right-hand middle, ring, and pinky fingers, amputating the pinky and ring fingertips.
An employee was trouble shooting line equipment. The stack un-loader rotated and struck the employee fracturing the left jaw.

On 07/18/2016, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was operating a flour mill, a machine that consists of a hopper that goes into an airlock. The airlock moves air with a squirrel cage type system. The hopper became clogged, so the employee unbolted and removed a plate to try and clear the clog. The employee's right hand then hit the squirrel cage's assembly, amputating the middle finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was bitten on the hand by a cat and required hospitalization.
An employee was filling a lawn mower tire with air when the tire popped and struck the employee's hand, fracturing it.
An employee was cutting grass and started complaining of chest pain and shortness of breath. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was putting parts into a CNC machine and amputated the right middle finger at the middle joint when the hydraulic clamp closed on the finger.
An employee was trying to de-escalate a situation with a patient when the patient attacked the employee, fracturing the employee's jaw.
An employee fell off a ladder, fracturing a wrist and the pelvic bone.
An employee was coming down the truck's fixed ladder when his right foot slipped inside of the ladder resulting in a broken right tibia. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee tripped and fell, hitting the concrete floor and breaking his hip.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor and amputated the right ring fingertip while replacing the guard.

On Friday, July 15, 2016, an employee was operating a packing machine and suffered the amputation of two fingers and one partial finger after their left hand was caught in the drawer of the packing machine while attempting to clear a jam.

An employee was injured while performing a routine wheel inspection diagnostics checklist. During this inspection and as the wheel assembly was spinning, the employee's right hand entered into the wheel assembly and his index finger extended beyond the spoke of the wheel as it passed the brake caliper assembly. A pinch point occurred between the caliper and the spoke and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was driving south on the highway when a tree branch fell on top of the car breaking the windshield. The employee suffered head, neck and shoulder trauma and facial lacerations.

An employee was installing insulation in a control panel. When he grounded two wires together an arc flash occurred and the employee's face and hands were burned. Another employee who was standing nearby observing the first employee's work on the control panel was also burned on his face and arms. They were both admitted to the hospital.
An employee was cutting a beam with a torch. When the beam was cut, it rolled and fell on and crushed both of the employee's feet.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat exposure.
An employee was troubleshooting a filler machine. While replacing the guard on the track chain, the employee's left thumb was amputated at the knuckle.
An employee was stamping metal using a press and amputated the pad of the right thumb.
An employee was flagging traffic for a construction site and was struck from behind by a truck exiting the road. The employee suffered two fractured ribs and two fractured vertebrae.
An employee fell from the second floor landing to first floor landing while delivering sheetrock and suffered lacerations on the chin.

While conducting well servicing operations, a rig crew was changing out swab cups and preparing to go back into the hole (oil well), when an employee had his hand pinched between a bar and the tubing resulting in the amputation of the employee's pinky finger.
An employee was operating a straight cut machine and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was lifting panels from one place to another place, finished the job and then went home. While at home the employee felt pain in his chest. The employee went to the hospital and was admitted with a collapsed lung.
An employee was working from a scissor lift at a jobsite and fell out of the scissor lift onto the concrete below fracturing ribs, a leg and vertebrae.

On July, 15, 2016, an employee suffered an amputation of three fingers on their left hand when their hand was crushed between the die and steel rail while operating the rail pierce machine to punch holes in a steel rail.
An employee was repairing a diesel fuel tank. He was burning off extra metal after the repair and the vapors ignited. The employee received second degree burns to the face.
An employee fell off an elevated bed onto a railroad track and was hospitalized with a fractured elbow.

The employee was working at the stacker end of the cut to length line. The table in the stacker was being raised to be at the same elevation as the conveyor on the cut to length line so product could begin to be stacked. The employee went to remove a board from the table and his right middle finger was caught between the board on the table and the stacker resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was driving a tri-axle dump truck, delivering a load of stone to a customer at a camp ground. The employee raised the bed of the dump truck 2-3 feet and then went to observe the load. He noticed the load was unbalanced and was causing the truck to lean to the driver's side. The employee got back in the truck and started to lower the bed. At that point, the telescoping rod that raises and lowers the truck bed broke. This caused the truck to tip over onto the driver's side. The employee climbed out of the passenger side and down a ladder. The employee was  hospitalized for a fractured T-12 vertebrae.
An employee was mowing the lawn on the side of a hill. He lost his footing and his foot went under the mower amputating two toes.
An employee was operating an electric walking jack. While making a turn his right foot was pinned against a shelving unit resulting in multiple fractures.

On July 15, 2016, an employee was skimming slag off the top of a pot of molten bronze when some of the slag and molten bronze dropped onto his coveralls. The molten bronze and slag, with a temperature over 2000 degrees Fahrenheit burned through his coveralls, seriously burning his shin, ankle, and foot before his boot could be removed.

An employee was swabbing the inside of the pipes for testing before sauces ran through. A pipe slipped off the employee's shoulder. His right index finger was caught between the end of the pipe and the pump's housing amputating the fingertip.
Two employees received electrical burns when an anchor cable was touched by a live electrical cable near the trench where the employees were working.

Four employees were dumping fixtures from the platform on a forklift into the dumpster. An employee climbed up the side steps of the dumpster to pull fixtures from the platform and fell to the ground fracturing both shoulders, a knee and the nose.
An employee was erecting a wall and became disorientated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized on Friday, July 15, 2016, after having an allergic reaction to epoxy flooring adhesives. The employee presented with swelling and a rash.

An employee was installing a replacement garage door at a commercial business.  During the installation, the crew released the tension off the last of three overhead springs. The spring caught the employee in the shoulder and upper right arm causing a severe laceration and pulling the employee into the side of the structure.

Two employees were working in the roll finishing area of the paper machine building. A 2,000-5,000 lb. roll of paper smashed an employee's feet and toes causing fractures and contusions requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a ladder to retrieve a package in the storage area. She miss-stepped coming down the ladder, fell, and tried to catching herself using her leg. Her leg broke beneath the knee.

An employee lost control of a forklift and tried to manually stop it with their left foot. The foot was caught between the forklift and the base of a warehouse rack and fractured. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was covering up equipment to keep it from getting wet in the rain. As the employee tried to tie up the cover his right hand was caught between a moving sprocket and chain resulting in a right pinky finger fracture and a laceration to the right ring finger.

With the assistance of a sling swing the employee was loading a big gas valve into a truck with his bare hands. During the loading, the sling rotated thus rotating the valve, which caused the employee to pinch his finger between the sling and the valve resulting in the amputation of his thumb just below the fingernail.
An employee fell from the back of a flat bed truck as he was unloading beams and ruptured his spleen.
An employee was guiding the forklift operator while unloading steel bars from the delivery truck. The strap holding the steel bars together snapped and the steel bars fell on his foot.
An employee was operating a rubber tire roller. The roller went off the road and as the employee returned the roller to the road the roller tipped over resulting in injury to the employee's face.
An employee tripped and fell while trying to stop a rolling dolly resulting in a fractured left arm.
An employee was organizing pallets in a warehouse. A wooden pallet fell onto the employee and fractured an ankle.

An employee was preparing to dismantle formwork. With the wedge pins of the formwork removed, the employee attempted to step out onto an outrigger. The employee fell and his harness, tied off to the formwork, brought the form work down on his ankle, breaking the ankle.

An employee was cleaning up for the day and was setting a metal shelving unit onto the bucket of a backhoe machine. The employee lost control of the shelf and it dropped, pinching his index finger between the bucket and shelf. The finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was hospitalized with left shoulder and wrist fractures due to tripping over a cord and falling in the deli department.

On 7/16/16, an employee had just finished filling one of the rollers with water and was walking around the roller. A second roller came by and the operator put his roller in neutral. The injured employee walked between the two rollers and was caught between the rollers resulting in a broken shoulder and arm.

An employee was returning a patient that was trying to flee the hospital back to the ER. The patient kicked and the employee was knocked off balance and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken collar bone.

An employee was sitting in a chair under the grandstand. The chair was on an incline and she fell. When she went to brace herself she injured her left arm. The left humerus was fractured in three places and required surgery.
An employee was using a drill press and amputated a portion of the left middle finger.

An employee was trying to release a work float that had become wedged under a waterside rescue ladder. The employee was standing on a walkway and used his left hand to try and release the work float. As the float released, the walkway came down and caught the employee's left hand between an angle and the walkway, which partially amputated the pinky finger. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.

An employee was dismantling scaffold when a large exhaust fan turned on. The fan blades amputated the employee's right middle fingertip below the nail bed, fractured the right ring finger and lacerated to the right index finger.

An employee was walking on the north side of the H-602 hot oil heater unit when he tripped over a scaffold pole and landed on both elbows. The employee was admitted to the hospital with two fractured elbows. The right elbow fracture required surgery.
An employee was cutting material for RV trailer manufacturing using a foot controlled chop saw. When he hit the control with his foot the upcut saw amputated three fingers on the right hand.
An employee was working on a 6' ladder installing a light fixture. The employee received an electrical shock and fell from the ladder fracturing his foot.
An employee was cutting grass along a hill with a self-propelled push mower. He slipped and the mower ran over his feet. The blades struck his right big toe. Half of the toe was surgically amputated.
An employee was stocking beer bottles. He dropped a bottle which shattered and a piece of glass went into his left eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to get a wrap up out of the slitter by turning the nip roller by hand resulting in a left thumb fracture and laceration.
An employee was moving a beam with a crane and sustained a foot injury.
An employee tripped on an all purpose container (APC) netting and fell to the ground fracturing his elbow.
An employee was struck by a forklift resulting in a fractured femur and wrist.
An employee was delivering a linen cart and got the first two toes on his right foot caught in the dock leveler and crushed when the linen cart was placed on it.

An employee was finishing the drywall on a mobile rolling scaffold when he stumbled off of the scaffold while attempting to climb on top of the scaffold's platform. He fell against the wall and pinched a nerve in his back. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee suffered back and pelvic fractures when a piece of machinery fell on him.
An employee pinched a nerve in his back while pulling pallets and moving boxes. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a billboard while standing on a step ladder. The ladder kicked out and the employee fell about five feet, then rolled down an embankment about ten feet. He suffered a broken wrist.
An employee tripped over plastic produce crates and fell fracturing their right hip.

An employee was making routine rounds at the plant when a power outage occurred causing a fan to fail. The employee was overcome by sulfur dioxide. The employee did not have a respirator at the time of the incident.

At approximately 10:45PM on 7/17/16, an employee was cleaning glue from the rollers on the off-line laminator when his left hand was caught in between the rollers. The employee suffered crushing injuries and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was re-setting the car wash and slipped and fell fracturing a knee.
An employee was troubleshooting a malfunction on the walking floor near the baler and amputated the left thumb when the door closed on his hand.
An employee was struck by a trackhoe while working in an excavation resulting in a chest contusion and chin laceration.

An employee was performing maintenance on the B Extruder when he sustained a left pinky finger first digit amputation and fracture. The employee was removing an upper roll for the flat belt. While supporting the roll with one hand and removing bolts with the other hand, the employee lost control of the roll pinching/smashing the left pinky finger between two rollers.
An employee was sweeping the floor of the tunnel and struck his head on a structural member of the building causing a concussion.
An employee was conducting stucco work while on the third buck of a scaffold when he fell 18 feet to the ground resulting in facial and skull fractures. He was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was working in the ingot cooling and stacking area when he became overheated. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a laminator machine. While feeding product into the laminator his glove was caught in the rollers pinning his left hand in the machine.
An employee was packing plastic bags when a bag became stuck in the winder. The employee attempted to remove the bag from the winder and his right arm was caught in the winder and fractured.
An employee on a construction site was standing while talking and suddenly passed out possibly due to heat, hitting their head on the wall and falling to the floor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee left work not feeling well and was later admitted into the hospital for a heat related illness.
An employee was delivering mail and began cramping. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to latex balloons that had been placed on the work floor as decoration for an event. The employee was later hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift when their foot became caught between the forklift and an I-beam. The operator's foot was broken.

An employee was preparing to cleanout a planer. He removed the exhaust chute and reached into the machine while the planer blades were still coasting resulting in the amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee fell from a vehicle trailer.

On July 14, 2016, at approximately 9:45 a.m., a cutter operator placed paper in a skid to be cut. When the skid moved, the employee's left pinky finger became caught between the cutter and the lift. The employee's left pinky finger was surgically amputated the following day.
An employee reported feeling dehydrated and vomiting due to heat. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were working in a lift bucket truck cleaning a cross arm when the boom failed and the bucket hit the truck. One employee remained in the bucket and the other was thrown out of the bucket. Both employees were attached to the bucket with harnesses and lanyards. One employee received a broken rib and bruising.

Employees were stripping a tile floor in preparation to wax it. One of the employees slipped and fell on the wet floor striking his head and sustaining a small laceration. The employee was hospitalized due to a possible head injury.
An employee was on a platform. When he stepped over a ladder he lost his balance and fell to the ground fracturing the right foot.

An employee was hospitalized after he fell from a ladder while painting a building. The employee fell backwards off the ladder, which was up against a parking bumper for stability, and onto the bumper. The employee received bruises to his head and back, a broken pelvis, and two broken heels.

At the end of shift, an employee turned off the grinder and used his right hand to clean meat off the grinder plate. The employee's right index finger went into a hole in the grinder plate and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was partially pinned underneath the front three sheets of bundled steel plates that slid off of the front of a flatbed trailer while the crane was attempting to set them down on the trailer. The employee suffered a fractured cheek bone and ocular socket, a large laceration on his back, and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee fell while walking into the cooler and fractured their right hip.

An employee had been outside in hot temperatures for approximately three hours standing on the ground watching bags of feed being loaded into a hopper bottom truck. The employee began feeling ill so he went and sat down for a while. When he stood up he seemed to be confused. He was admitted overnight for heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a drill press when the employee's glove was caught in the drill bit. The employee's fingers were injured requiring surgery.

Employees were picking up a mud pump using a winch and two trucks. The winch line slipped and broke causing the truck holding the pump to be raised approximately five feet off the ground and then slammed back down. The employee in the truck suffered a compression fracture in their back.
An employee was struck by a vehicle operated by another employee in the parking lot. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee slipped and fell on a sidewalk breaking a hip.
A powered industrial truck operator was transported to the hospital after becoming lethargic and unresponsive during a work break. The employee was admitted to the hospital due to dehydration.
On or about July 18, 2016, an employee was trying to prime a chemical metering pump. Chemical splashed out of the drum and onto his lips and mouth. The employee was hospitalized for chemical burns.

An employee was hauling a concrete post with a forklift. The employee got off the forklift and became pinned between the forklift and a dumpster. The employee suffered a fractured right fibula and big toe.

An employee was untying a 32-foot extension ladder from the building. As the employee descended the ladder it began to slide sideways. The employee kicked free from the ladder and fell approximately 15 feet, resulting in fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.

On Monday, July 18, 2016, an employee was not feeling well while on his lunch break. Approximately an hour later he returned to his duties and completed his shift. He was off the following day, July 19th, and was still not feeling well. He went to his doctor and was diagnosed with dehydration and heat exhaustion. He was then admitted to the hospital.

An employee was assisting an air conditioning contractor position an air conditioner for the crane lift. The employee's right hand was caught between the air conditioner unit and the curb/asphalt causing the amputation of the right middle fingertip and a fractured finger.
An employee tripped and fell while walking in the carpeted aisle inside the building, sustaining a right shoulder injury.

One of the wheels of a semi-truck was trapped in a hole. The truck's driver asked an on-site employee to hook the truck to a yard dog so they could pull the truck's wheel out of the hole. The on-site employee hooked the truck to the yard dog and then boarded and operated the yard dog. As the yard dog began pulling, the brakes on the yard dog malfunctioned, causing it to move backwards. The driver of the semi-truck was standing between the semi-truck and the yard dog, and was crushed between the vehicles, sustaining two broken hips and a crushed pelvis.
An employee fractured her left ankle when she slipped coming out of a dunk tank during an employee appreciation event.
An employee was working on a flat roof and using a pump sprayer to spray material onto the roof. He tripped over the power cord and fell and breaking his right wrist.

An employee was attempting to remove a stainless steel window sill segment from the drive-thru window system using a cordless drill. The screw he was removing reversed quickly, causing his left thumb tip to become pinched between the stainless steel section and the drill he was operating, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was on the roof to repair a leak when he stepped on and fell 24 feet through the sky light to the ground resulting in a broken hip. He was admitted to the hospital.
A driver became light headed and nauseated at approximately 3:19p.m. on 7/19/16, at one of his truck stops. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.
An employee was clearing brush and experienced heat stress.
An employee was re-stacking corrugated sheets on a conveyor storage line when their left foot was caught between two sections of the conveyor resulting in a laceration/de-gloving injury.

At 4:15 p.m. on 7/18, an employee was cleaning a hot polymer glue press-pot using a scraper. The scraper broke, which caused both hands and her left forearm to come into contact with the hot glue. She sustained second degree burns to the palms and fingers of both hands and to the left forearm.

An employee was assisting during the installation of a new washer/dryer in a private residence. After plugging in the appliance to an outlet, he touched the dryer and received an electric shock. He was hospitalized.
An employee became ill while riding on the back of a trash truck. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was unboxing furniture and stepped on a nail on the furniture frame.
An employee was rigging steel and started to experience symptoms of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employees' finger was amputated when it was caught in a roller of a print roll machine.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs from the fourth floor to the third floor. She twisted an ankle and fell, resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

On July 19, 2016, at approximately 7:10 p.m., an employee was loading a tube in the tube bender when a clamp closed on the employee's right fourth and fifth fingers. A portion of the fourth finger was surgically removed the following day.
An employee was on an oil rig handling the tubing and suffered a heat-related illness resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was leaving the evisceration break room when the door started to close and her right middle finger was pinched in the door jam resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was standing on the flatbed trailer while securing the freight when he lost his footing and fell off of the trailer. His legs were tangled in the airline causing him to turn on the descent and strike his head on the ground. He was hospitalized for treatment of contusions to his head, right arm and wrist.
An employee was climbing a ladder, slipped due to a faulty grab bar, and fell approximately 12 feet. He was admitted to the hospital for a broken wrist and a bruise to the head.

While delivering product to a customer location, the employee's foot slipped off of a second level of concrete on which the ramp was set up. He attempted to regain his balance by using the hand truck (dolly) to stabilize himself, but the hand truck fell and his thumb was pinched between the ground and the hand truck. This caused a portion of his left thumb to be amputated just above the knuckle (just behind fingernail).

An employee was standing between a pickup truck and a wagon attempting to connect the two together, when the truck rolled back pinning the employee between the truck and wagon. The employee suffered a broken shoulder, left arm, left clavicle and four ribs on the left side.

An employee was servicing a chilled water line by cleaning the line with hydrogen peroxide. There was a combustible reaction and the pressure blew the lid off the stream filter housing unit. The lid struck the employee on the right hand that was being used to protect his face, causing multiple hand fractures requiring surgery. Minor burns were also incurred on the right hand/arm.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to the roof and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle and leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell off a porch roof approximately 10' above the ground and was hospitalized for a broken ankle and shoulder.

An employee and his supervisor were carrying a boiler part (weighing approximately 110 to 120 pounds) in tandem and placing it atop a pile. The employee was wearing Kevlar Gloves covered with rubber gloves (i.e.; two layers of gloves). The employee was helping to stabilize the boiler part on top of another part already stacked in the pile. The part the employee was adjusting shifted and the employee's left index finger was pinched between two parts. The employee tried to pull his finger out of the pinch point, and suffered a fingertip amputation with the loss of some bone.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured elbow after he fell 12 feet through a floor hole.
An employee was painting from a boom lift and fell 8 feet out of the lift and landed on an iron fence. She suffered an impalement injury to the right leg and a broken rib.
An employee experienced severe leg cramps and abdominal pains while working in the heat.
On July 19, 2016, an employee suffered a partial little finger amputation while guiding the well casing into a bore hole.
An employee was working in the receiving area of the store. A pallet with metal shelving on it fell approximately 12' striking the employee on the head and causing a head laceration.
An employee working on a barge tripped and fell 4.5' to a lower deck.

On 7/19/2016, an employee was operating a walk-behind commercial lawnmower on a terraced hillside. He went to mow a strip located between two 8 foot retaining walls. He fell over one of the 8 foot retaining walls and suffered a broken left femur and skull fractures.
An employee was struck by a material moving machine and suffered a fractured right ankle.

The injured worker was on a scaffold measuring chilling water piping. The electrician turned on the water circulating pump that was hooked onto the chilling water piping. The junction box that the wiring was inside of shorted and the injured worker received an electrical shock.
An employee was using a cutting torch to cut a strip of steel from a master coil cylinder. The strip of steel that was under tension struck the employee in the stomach.

On 7/19/2016, an employee was performing maintenance on a palletizer lift elevator. The lift platform was elevated about 3 inches with a chain fall in order to adjust the lower jack bolts. The elevator dropped, crushing the employee's left index finger between the jack bolt and palletizer elevator resulting in an amputation close to the second knuckle on the left index finger.

A 4'x11' concrete form wall was being lifted with a crane. During the lift, an employee walked near the lift area to retrieve some tools. As the employee walked into the lift area, the form wall got caught on another piece of the construction project. The form wall came out of it's rigging and fell to the ground, tipped over, and struck the employee on the head and back. The employee was hospitalized and suffered 2 fractured vertebrae.
An employee overfilled a tank and corrosive liquid splashed onto the employee causing chemical burns.

An employee stepped on a metal grate that had a weak corner from where a pipe was penetrating through the grate, lost his balance, and fell 10-16 feet into a sloped pit. The employee sustained a soft tissue injury to his left leg and ankle and a mild concussion.
An employee began to suffer from heat exhaustion while working outside to complete an installation for satellite television.
While operating a divider machine, an employee attempted to clear a dough jam and suffered a left index finger amputation above the first knuckle.

An employee was filling candle forms with hot wax. Hot wax leaked onto the floor. The employee slipped on the hot wax and fell on the wax suffering third degree burns to the right calf and first degree burns to other parts of the body.
An employee was admitted to the hospital for heat exhaustion.
While starting a pumping unit at a well site, an employee felt ill and asked for assistance. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
On July 20, 2016, at 2:15 p.m., an employee was attempting to climb out of a 55-gallon drum when he slipped and fell on the top ridge of the drum resulting in a kidney injury.
While sorting packages inside of his truck, an employee got dehydrated and passed out. He was hospitalized.
The employee was supervising the expansion of a high school and suffered heat exhaustion/dehydration.

An employee was welding a trailer sub-frame that weighed approximately 850 - 900 lbs. The sub-frame tipped over and struck the employee before hitting the floor. The employee suffered four fractured vertebrae, a right foot fracture and a fractured left shoulder.

An employee placed their left hand on the line conveyor, which moves doors down the line. When the conveyor started up, the employee's left middle finger was caught between the steel frame of the conveyor and a gap in the steel conveyor belt, resulting in a partial amputation and an open fracture to the left middle finger.
An employee slipped and fell on stairs injuring their back.

An employee was setting up to repair a heat transfer leak on a mill and was exposed to organic vapors through a chemical reaction. The employee was using brake clean and a water miscible degreaser detergent when a chemical reaction occurred.
An employee suffered a back injury while moving a patient in bed.
An employee was cleaning up and hot water (estimated at 150-200 degrees F) got inside the top of his boot burning the employee's right foot.
On July 20, 2016, an employee experienced a fingertip amputation when the ram of a hydraulic press crushed the employee's finger on a trunnion part.
An employee was hospitalized for a heat related injury.
An employee was operating a circular saw when their vest got caught up in the saw. The employee's right quadricep was lacerated.

On July 20, 2016, at around 6:40 PM, an employee was walking at the jobsite beside the dirt mound and was struck by the skid steer that was backing up at the moment. The employee suffered a broken ankle and lower body injuries and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee's foot was pinned under the motor of a gantry crane he was operating. He was pulled along for 38 inches and was hospitalized with two broken toes and a broken metatarsal.
An employee amputated his right index finger when he was fixing the polarizer machine.

An employee was installing an air bag. While inflating the air bag after installation, the air bag base gave way and was ejected striking the employee in the face (cheek and nose area). The employee suffered lacerations to the face/head and facial fractures.
An employee tripped over a lobby cart and fell breaking her right arm. She was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to remove jammed material from a corrugated roll former machine. His glove was drawn into the rollers, causing a degloving injury to his right thumb between the fingernail and the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a table saw and amputated the left index finger while moving material away from the blade.

An employee was painting a room with a paint sprayer (approximately 2000 psi). The equipment malfunctioned and the employee's left thumb was lacerated. In addition, paint was injected into the laceration.
An employee fell backwards off the outside cab step of a truck to the ground and fractured ribs.
An employee was transported to the hospital after suffering stomach cramping and was hospitalized for dehydration.

Rigging employees were setting a pipe that was 20 feet long, 24 inches in diameter, and weighed 5 tons. As the load was being transferred from the crane to the rack, the riggers were adjusting the chain fall hoists. Slack was taken up in one of the hoists, which caused the pipe to lift. When the pipe lifted the injured employee was straddling the beam, and the shoe plate of the pipe contacted the injured employee's left lower leg, causing a compound fracture. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
The employee observed a broken rubber conveyor band and attempted to remove it. He reached into the conveyor power roller and amputated the right index finger and lacerated the middle finger.
An employee was hauling wood chips in an open trailer with a tractor when the tractor flipped going down a hill.

An employee operating an electric pallet jack was rounding an aisle and became pinned between the pallet jack handle and a fixed storage rack, sustaining five broken ribs. The injured employee was hospitalized.

While conducting maintenance on the battery charger of an order picker, an employee's right index fingertip was caught between the chain and cog of the order picker and amputated when the order picker was activated.
An employee was clearing a jam in the forming die and amputated the left index and ring fingertips, and the middle finger to the first knuckle.

Employees were unloading a flatbed truck in the laydown area of the job site. An operator picked up a piece of pipe with a telehandler to unload it. Another employee signaled the operator to lower the pipe down onto the truck to readjust the straps. When the tie down strap released, the pipe rolled and struck an employee's lower right leg fracturing it. The load also struck another employee in the lower back. Both employees were knocked off the truck by the rolling pipe.

An employee was unloading a shipping container that contained bundled lumber products. The bundles of lumber were stacked both horizontally and vertically. As the employee worked inside of the shipping container, a vertically stacked lumber bundle fell and struck the employee on the right leg, fracturing the employee's right femur.

An employee had been tying rebar under a covered shed and reported having cramps at 10 AM. He was taken to the air-conditioned office and given fluids, but the cramps continued. He was then hospitalized.

An employee was repairing cable lines at the top of a telephone pole. As he was climbing down the pole using the preinstalled pegs on the pole, he missed a step and fell 10-12 feet breaking both legs and an ankle.
An employee suffered burns to their forearms and dizziness from exposure to a chemotherapy drug (Sevoflurane/Ultane) that had spilled. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered heat related injuries and was hospitalized on July 20, 2016.
An employee was setting metal posts when he slipped off the curb and broke his right ankle.
On 07/20/16, an employee fractured his right ankle after falling off the back of a trailer.
An employee fell onto a safety rail and suffered broken ribs. He was wearing fall protection.

An employee was mowing grass using a riding lawn mower near a drop-off on the grounds. The mower got stuck. The employee dismounted the mower to push it and the mower flipped onto the employee fracturing ribs.
An employee was running rods into the well when the elevator/block began to lower. Something caught the elevator/block and pulled the elevator/block into the rod basket striking the employee.
An employee was delivering merchandise to a customer and while on the lift gate he slipped and fell to the ground injuring his spleen.
An employee was not feeling well and was sweating heavily. The employee was admitted to the hospital for treatment of heat related illness.
An employee was kneeling down on the ground shooting grade at an active construction jobsite when he was struck by a backing bulldozer, fracturing his ankle.
An employee sustained severe burns on his whole body when heated wax spilled out of a wax tank.

An employee was trying to flip a metal stair stringer over when it fell onto his hand and crushed his index finger between the stair stringer and the concrete resulting in the amputation of the index fingertip.

On July 20, 2016, at approximately 12:30 pm, an employee was in the process of moving a loaded barge with a cable that travels through a sheave. The employee's hand became caught in the sheave amputating the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers at the first knuckle.
Employee fell approximately six feet from scaffolding while dismantling it and was hospitalized for cuts and a fractured arm.
An employee was burned on both hands and arms when hot plastic shot out of the throat of the plastic injection molding machine.
On July 20, 2016 an employee was admitted to the hospital for kidney failure from heat stress.
An employee felt ill at work after using MEK solvent (Butanone) and was hospitalized.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake on a finger on his right hand while moving boards on location.
An employee was cleaning the vertical mixing shaft on Mixer #3 and got his hair caught in the mixer shaft. The employee was scalped.

An employee was cleaning the material feeder into a mechanical punch press. The employee's glove got caught in a gear of the feeding machine. The finger was pulled into the gear crushing it. This resulted in the amputation of the right  index finger at the first joint
An employee felt dizzy and ill and began vomiting while working in the truck paint area. The employee was admitted to the hospital with heat related illnesses/dehydration.
An employee was walking on the docks and tripped over freight resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was transferring a rubber pad from the railroad flatcar deck to a table to be cut when he lost his balance and fell from the rail car. The employee received facial lacerations requiring stiches, a fractured nose and a fractured vertebrae.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while working on the side of the road.
An employee was welding and was hospitalized for dehydration/heat stress.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it turned sharply into a concrete door frame, pinning the employee against the wall. The employee suffered a pelvic injury.

An employee was installing expansion joints on a bridge attachment while working from a man lift. The employee grabbed hold of a pipe on the bridge and sustained electrical burns to his arms and legs.
On July 21, 2016, around 2:30 p.m., an employee was driving from one corn field to another when she felt ill due to heat stress and pulled over to call for assistance. She was hospitalized.
An employee degloved his thumb and amputated a finger on the left hand while operating a clamper machine.
An employee was using a drill press when their glove was caught in the drill bit drawing the left index finger into the bit and tearing tendons in the finger.
An employee was outside mowing when he became overheated and passed out.  He was taken to the hospital where he was treated for dehydration and was admitted overnight.
An employee helping with solar panel equipment experienced legs cramps, requiring hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee became disoriented while out on his route. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
The employee was positioning metal into a hydraulic press brake and amputated the tip of the second digit on his left hand.

On July 21, 2016, around 4:45 p.m., an employee was processing hardened steel parts in metal baskets from the heat treat furnace when one of the baskets hit and lacerated his right middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a box to put on a hand truck and suffered an abdominal hernia.
An employee was unjamming the vertical bandsaw and got wedged in a section of the machine resulting in a pelvic fracture.
An employee passed out and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee exited the rear of a flatbed semi-trailer onto an unpaved county road, and fractured his left tibia and was hospitalized.

An employee was hospitalized with a severe injury after falling approximately seven feet from a catwalk to the ground below. The employee was walking from a stationary catwalk to a mobile catwalk at the time of the incident.
An employee working in the deli department was slicing meat when his finger slipped and struck the blade of the deli slicer, resulting in a fingertip amputation to the left pinky finger.
An employee stepped out of a trailer truck and fell to the ground resulting in a head contusion.
An employee was chasing a suspect, jumped a fence, and landed on both heels fracturing them.

An employee was drilling holes in a part using a Bridgeport mill.  The part moved in the vice and the employee reached in to re-secure the part while the machine was running.  A burr or the drill bit snagged his glove pulling his thumb into the drill bit and causing a partial amputation of the left thumb.
An employee was counting inventory and lacerated his forehead on an aluminum wheel.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in the parking lot resulting in a broken elbow and ankle.
After completing his wing-walking task an employee was walking back to the airport terminal and started to feel fatigued. The employee was admitted to the hospital for dehydration.
An employee was operating a chop saw and amputated the right thumb and index fingers.
An employee fell from a ladder and fractured their femur.
An employee was pushing a plastic pallet with his foot and fell backwards hitting his head on the floor.
An employee was pressure washing a roof. The pressure hose ruptured and the employee's upper left arm was lacerated.
An employee fell from a height of 46' and was hospitalized with a hip injury.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet and suffered broken vertebrae.

Two employees were working on a motor to prepare it to ship to a customer. One employee was lubricating and greasing the bearings while the other employee was manually turning the shaft. The employee turning the shaft got his finger pinched between the v-belt and pulley amputating his right index finger just below the cuticle.

An employee was cleaning and adjusting the chain on the stationary fixed gear bike (35 pound flywheel) when the towel in his right hand got caught in the chain pulling his right hand in between the cog and chain and amputating the right index fingertip.

An employee was inspecting an air conditioning unit and its surrounding area for mosquito infestation. An air conditioner drain pipe about 2 inches in diameter and about 2 inches off the ground was on the walkway. As the employee went to step over the pipe, the toe of his right foot caught on the pipe. He fell over and hit the ground, fracturing his left shoulder and suffering a minor forehead contusion.

An employee was using a digging bar to loosen sand located over a cable buried in a shunt box when he impacted the primary cable. An electric flash occurred, causing first degree burns on his left forearm and a piece of sand to become lodged under his eyelid.
As the employee was standing with both hands on the JLG lift rail, a lighting strike hit the JLG. The employee was stunned, fell to the ground, and was hospitalized.

An employee was struck in the head by a plastic hose that became wrapped around a rotating CNC machine spindle. The hose struck the employee in the head causing a severe laceration. The employee's right pinky finger was also broken and lacerated. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of the head injury.
An employee was kicked by horse resulting in fractures to the jaw requiring surgery.
While using a band saw to cut pork chops, an employee amputated the right thumb tip, including portions of the finger nail.
An employee was walking in the parking lot and slipped on a puddle of water rolling his ankle resulting in a right ankle injury.
An employee was unjamming the cement cylinder gate and amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee tripped on a pipe while walking and fell, hitting their head on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

While trying to access a room where inmates were located, an employee attempted to open a facility door that had been jammed by the inmates to prevent his entry. When he tried to force the jammed door open, his left pinky finger became stuck between the door and a bar, amputating 1 inch of his finger.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down stairs, fracturing their wrist.
An employee received injuries to his head and eyes when a board struck him due to a kickback from a woodworking machine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee collapsed due to heat exposure while delivering mail, requiring overnight hospitalization.
After delivering mail on a walking route in extreme heat, an employee became ill and began throwing up. He was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was rinsing down the floors and started to transfer milk into the tanks. The conduit for the milk transfer pump was pulled away from the transfer pump j-box and the employee was shocked, causing him to fall to the ground and hit his head. He suffered a head and backside contusion.

On July 22, 2016, at approximately 4:57 a.m., an employee was attempting to clean a jammed chute when a gate closed and pinched his finger(s) resulting in an amputation to his right index finger just past the first knuckle.
An employee was driving a work vehicle when it caught on fire, burning the employee.

While attempting to retrieve garbage from a machine, an employee's forearm was caught and crushed between a pallet lift and the machine frame. The machine was still operating at the time of the incident.
An employee lost consciousness while operating light construction equipment due to heat illness and was hospitalized.

An employee had finished rolling and wrapping a deck sheet and was using a hoist with hooks to lift it when he noticed a problem and grabbed the hook. At the same time, the deck sheet came out of the hook on his side. His finger became wedged between the air bar with the rolled deck sheet and the bracket that holds the air bar on the power roller, partially amputating his left ring fingertip.
An employee suffered a seizure and fell over a parapet wall that had a 15 foot drop. The employee fractured both heels.
An employee was attempting to unplug a sausage grinding machine when the grinder amputated four of his left-hand fingers.
An employee was driving a delivery truck and started to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was opening a box with a box cutter when she poked her eye with the cutter, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was walking and working in the repack area of the facility when he slipped and fell, hitting his head. He suffered a head laceration and skull fracture, requiring surgery.

At 12:00 p.m., on 7/28/2016, an employee was loading trash into the back of a truck when a piece of glass from the trash can cut his left arm, causing blood loss. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
On 7/28/16, an employee was climbing a ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his wrist and hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a pipe threader to thread a pipe. When the employee released the chuck on the pipe threader, the pipe dropped. The cut end then came up and amputated the employee's left ring finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was getting into a car when the driver pulled away before the employee was inside. The employee's ankle was run over and fractured in three places.
An employee amputated the right index fingertip when his finger was caught in a moveable platform hinge.
An employee was bitten on the hand by a patient. The right index fingertip (soft tissue only) was amputated.
On July 28, 2016, an employee experienced a finger amputation when using a wrench and hammer to clear a jammed rock from a running conveyor.
An employee was struck on the right ankle and toes by a passing forklift and hospitalized.
At about 8:45am on July 28, 2016, an employee fell backwards and struck his head against a stationary sheet metal storage rack. The employee was hospitalized with a traumatic head injury.
An employee was dumping renderings from a vat when his arm was caught in the machinery.
While installing a refrigerator and pushing it into place, an employee's finger became stuck between the wall and the refrigerator. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was helping to place chocks under a rail loaded on a truck. The rail fell off the truck and fractured his left leg.
An employee was installing an attachment on a forklift when the attachment fell striking the employee on the head and causing a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
The employee was making delivery rounds and started to feel nauseous and began vomiting. The employee was admitted to the hospital for dehydration.
An employee was climbing a 24-foot ladder to install an area line. The employee was attacked by bees and fell to the ground, which resulted in a broken left ankle and a compound fracture.
An employee was overcome by heat and suffered dehydration.
An employee was using a jack hammer that collapsed and fell on his left hand, breaking his middle finger and causing an open wound.
An employee lost his balance while tying his shoe and fell, fracturing a hip.
An employee was moving two refrigerators with a pallet jack when the top refrigerator tipped over and landed on the employee. The employee suffered bruises and broken vertebrae.
An employee was standing on the fourth rung of an extension ladder painting an interior wall when he slipped and fell off the ladder to the concrete floor, breaking a vertebra in his back.

An employee was climbing up on the roof with a 10-foot extension ladder while carrying a box of air conditioner filters when the ladder shifted, causing him to fall about 6 feet to the ground. He suffered a muscle strain and bruising in his right shoulder and was hospitalized.
Three employees suffered burn injuries in a flash fire on a boat. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a lifting hook in order to pick up some rebars and was struck in the head by the hook resulting in hospitalization for a concussion.
An employee was struck by lightening while taking shelter inside a canopy building and was hospitalized for burns.

An employee was preparing a bundle of rebar for transport when a banding wire broke and pinned the employee's arm between the bundle and a stack of rebar, causing a right arm fracture that required surgery.
An employee was carrying boxes and when he set them down he felt pain. He was hospitalized for a collapsed lung.
An employee was standing on the top of a ladder hanging a banner on the side of the truck. He fell several feet from the ladder and broke a hip.

An employee was working in the bucket of an aerial lift to change out a two phase 13.2 KV straight line pole with a two phase pull off. The employee boomed down to get bottled water. The employee was booming back up to finish working on a pole when he made contact with the power line (tap primary) resulting in electrical burns to his left hand, right shoulder, and the right side of his face. The employee was admitted to the hospital and due to the severity of the burns on his left hand it was amputated.

An employee was responding to an emergency call regarding an accident on the bike trail. The employee lost control of his bike and struck a tree. The employee was hospitalized for six broken ribs and fluid in his lungs.
An employee was moving a 1,180 lb. steel plate into position to grind the welds using an overhead crane. The crane released the load catching the employee's left foot and crushing it under the load.
An employee was walking across the floor when she tripped on her shoe and fell. She suffered a contusion and fracture to her forearm.
An employee was pushing a drywall cart. The cart tipped over onto the employee fracturing the right femur.
An employee was struck and knocked to the ground by a forklift. The employee's right side was injured.
An employee attempted to remove a jam from the exit area of a dye-cutter machine. The machine turned on and the press crushed his right hand resulting in three broken fingers.

An employee was working on the rig floor and tripped over an object that he just placed on the rig floor falling to the ground. The employee landed on his shoulder fracturing an arm and dislocating his elbow.

The employee was on a forklift and had lowered the pallet of parts to the ground and shut off the forklift. When the employee got off of the forklift and walked around to the front of the forklift she tripped over the fork and fell to the ground resulting in fractures to both her elbows. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was pulling a pallet truck and felt discomfort. The employee was later hospitalized with a collapsed lung.
An employee was walking around a corner, tripped over a box and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was hospitalized for heat related illness.
An employee amputated the left middle fingertip while cleaning a mixer.
The employee was stocking merchandise and fell off the ladder breaking the left shoulder and knee.
