The employee was topping a log on the ground. The log moved and struck his leg above the ankle fracturing the lower leg.
The employee was lifting a long box that weighed more than 50 lbs. onto a storage shelf. The employee felt a pop in his right abdomen. The employee was hospitalized for a possible hernia.

An employee and his co-worker had completed maintenance work on the green chip bin machine when they noticed that a guard was not properly installed. When the employee tried to properly re-adjust it, the guard made contact with a moving part thereby shifting the guard. The employee's right thumb was caught between the guard and a handrail. He was admitted to the hospital where he was treated for his broken right thumb.

An employee was assigned to install a small hydraulic cylinder at 6 Clean #1 Payoff hold down roll. The employee had the cylinder in place on the blank end clevis with the pin inserted. While the employee was lining up the rod end clevis, their right hand pinky finger was partially inserted in the pin hole. When the cylinder dropped, it struck the tip of the employee's gloved finger resulting in amputation of an eighth of an inch of the finger. The amputation did not include bone.
An employee was admitted to a hospital with a broken clavicle after falling from a ladder while exiting the top of an aircraft.

Employees were removing sections of side panels from an open ended cooler that was approximately eight feet above the lower surface. As employees carried a disconnected side panel across an unbolted belly panel, the belly panel collapsed. The employees fell through the opening and the side panel they had been carrying fell with them. Employee 1 suffered a fractured left tibia and fibula and a fractured right femur. Employee 2 suffered a fractured left ankle, a dislocated left patella, and a back injury. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was loading a bulk flour trailer. A loading cap came off the trailer under pressure and struck the employee in the face resulting in facial lacerations, a nose fracture, and broken teeth.
An employee was gauging tack welds when the strong back plate fell on the employee's left leg. The strong back plate holds 2 base plates together while they weld.
On July 30, 2016, an employee suffered an arm amputation while working on the 550 ton press.
An employee was pinned between a railcar and the handrail of a transfer cable while switching railcars resulting in internal injuries.

An employee was setting up the machine in the converting department when his hand got caught in the nip roller crushing his hand. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery to repair the injured hand.
An employee was bitten by dog.

The worker was performing a demonstration event. She walked over to the produce section to get grapes for her demonstration. She was in front of the grapes, reached for an item, turned to go back to her demo cart and fell onto her right side, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut cardboard strips out of a full sheet of cardboard and amputated the left ring fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized with multiple arm fractures when his hand was caught between two rollers.
An employee was troubleshooting a CD 4.2 muffler pack machine when it was cycled resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip between the frame and machine arm.
An employee slipped on ice in the freezer and fell, sustaining an injury to his ankle.
An employee's foot was caught in a hydraulic steering component on board a docked vessel, crushing it.
An employee's hand was crushed while engaging the locking clamp device on the baler door.
An employee was putting on a metal elbow and fell, fracturing the right leg.
An employee was feeding tube into a straightener machine and their hand was caught in the machine. The right ring and pinky fingers were amputated above the knuckle.
An 8-inch pipe weighing approximately 500 lbs. rolled and landed on an employee's right leg resulting in a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was backing up the stacker truck with his left hand on the control lever when he pinched his left pinky finger between a rack and the stacker truck control lever resulting in the amputation of two-thirds of the pinky finger.
While resetting the pressure switch on an HVAC unit, an employee lacerated their finger.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor belt. The conveyor restarted and amputated three fingers.
An employee was bitten by a copperhead snake while moving a dolly to a storage room. The employee was treated with antivenom and admitted to the hospital.
An employee was on a pitched roof. The employee slipped and fell sliding several feet off the roof resulting in back injuries and lacerations.
An employee was inspecting a crane from a scissor lift when the crane moved and the load block struck the lift. The lift tipped over and the employee fell to the ground sustaining a head injury.
An employee was hospitalized with chemical burns during a concrete cutting operation.
An employee was replacing wall panels in the maintenance shop. While the employee was removing one of the wall panels, a panel fell on the employee's left hand.
An employee became ill and was hospitalized due to dehydration from possible heat exposure after working with patients to get them connected to their dialysis units.

Two employees were performing maintenance on a lift by a tower and were being transported in a basket up the lift line. When the basket arm contacted the sheaves of the tower, the basket jettisoned from the cable. The two employees fell with the basket 25 feet to the ground. Both suffered broken bones and concussions.
An employee was walking toward the back of the store when the employee tripped over an empty rack and fell, fracturing the left shoulder.
An employee fell to the floor and suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was using a sliding table saw to cut wood when the wood kicked back, causing the saw blade to amputate the employee's left index finger.

An employee was laying down sheathing and securing it to the trusses when he fell through an opening, landing on the pavement below. He fell approximately 14 feet, suffering head and back trauma and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking to the shop when his right knee gave out and he fell to the concrete floor, fracturing his right hip. He required surgery.
An employee was screwing fasteners into duct work while standing on a ladder. He lost his balance and fell approximately 11 feet, cracking a rib and breaking his right heel.
An employee was getting a sample brick from the brick stack when bees came out of the stack. The employee then dismounted the stack and broke his ankle and lower leg.
An employee tripped on a concrete block display and broke her right femur.

An employee was removing freight in the back of a trailer when the freight slipped from the back of the trailer. The employee fell out of the trailer and landed on the ground, and the freight landed on top of him. He suffered back and rib injuries.
While decking on the roof, an employee became overheated and required hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee suffered a possible heat related injury.
An employee was walking in the employee parking lot when she tripped over a clothes hanger on the ground and fell to the concrete, breaking her left arm.
An employee was preparing to sterilize several hock cutter parts. While the employee was placing the parts into the sterilization container, the employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was checking the hoses in the steam rack area. When he began to climb the ladder, he fell approximately 1 foot to the concrete floor, fracturing his skull and back.

An employee was tack welding with an automatic MIG welder. The employee was holding the steel part with one hand and engaged the pneumatic clamp with the other hand. The clamp smashed and amputated his left middle finger.
An employee was attempting to make a delivery to a store when he was struck by a third-party truck. He suffered multiple fractured ribs, a torn diaphragm, bleeding, and abdomen injuries.
An employee was cleaning underneath a band saw when his left-hand pointer and middle fingers were partially amputated by the saw blade. The saw was running at the time of the incident.

An employee and a coworker were trying to hitch a cube wagon to feed cattle. The hitch would not latch onto the ball of the vehicle, so the employee used his finger to check what was causing the problem. The hitch latched onto the ball while his finger was caught in between, amputating his left index fingertip.
An employee collapsed at the end of a shift and was admitted to the hospital and treated for heat stroke.
An employee was using a 12-foot step ladder when the pin on the ladders bracing broke causing him to fall to the ground. The employee suffered cracked ribs and a fractured coccyx.

On 08/01/2016, an employee was working on a 12-foot ladder gluing PVC pipe onto the ceiling when a brace on the ladder broke, causing the employee to fall 12 feet to the floor. The employee suffered broken ribs and a fractured pelvis.

A winding shaft on the slitter machine was cutting larger rolls into smaller rolls when an employee noticed there was a wrinkle in the material. When he tried to correct the wrinkle, his left arm was caught between the winder and the material, breaking it. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was turning on the switch to a scrubber fan pump when the fan pump's pipe burst, causing the chemical inside the pipe to splash on and burn the employee's right arm.
While clearing a buildup of rolls on a conveyor, an employee's right-hand ring finger was caught between the conveyor and a stationary object, amputating the first distal phalange.
On or about August 1, 2016, an employee was helping to remove a piece of equipment from the wellhead using a crane. The piece of equipment fell and struck the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

An employee lost control of her power equipment/double jack, and her right leg/thigh was pinned between a rack and the double jack. The impact and pressure severely cut her right leg just above the knee to her inner thigh.

An employee was bending rebar when the rebar-bending table he was working at activated while his finger was in the danger area. His left pinky finger was pinched between the machine and the metal rebar, amputating it at the first knuckle.
On August 1, 2016, at approximately 8:40 p.m., an employee was cutting material with a utility knife.  His hand slipped while holding the knife and he cut his wrist, lacerating an artery.
On or about August 1, 2016, an employee's left hand was smashed while setting a die into a tilt pour machine, crushing four fingers.

An employee was installing a ductwork hanger while working about 14 feet from the ground level on the metal trusses. He fell 14 feet from the trusses, injuring his head and breaking his ribs, shoulders, and back.

An employee was operating a forklift. When he went to pull the cord to activate the door opener, his right hand became caught in the cord. As he moved forward, his ring fingertip was caught and amputated between the cord and the roll cage on the forklift.
An employee was retrieving items from a car when the door closed on his left index finger, amputating it below the nail.

An employee was operating a press to remove a cylinder rod from a piston when a spring released its tension, causing the employee's finger to be caught between the piston and the press. The employee's right index finger was amputated up to the first knuckle.

On August 1, 2016, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was driving a stand-up rider forklift at a cold storage facility. As he was turning to exit the freezer, his glove became caught in the steering wheel and he lost control of the forklift. He was thrown from the operators' platform and became pinned between the forklift and a bollard post located at the freezer door opening, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet down an extension ladder. He landed on a rock and broke bones in his foot.

An employee collected a sample cylinder of gas and was placing the cylinder into a weather guard job box that is used to organize the sample cylinders. The job box drawer closed on his left hand, amputating his left ring finger at the first joint, right below the nail.

An employee tripped and fell. As she was getting up from the fall by grabbing onto a tire rack, another tire rack shifted and crushed her left hand. Her middle, ring, and pointer fingertips had to be medically amputated.
An employee's thumb tip was amputated while feeding wire into a crimping machine.
An employee was bending pipe when his thumb became pinched between the pipe and the bender shoe, amputating his thumb tip.
An employee in an aerial lift was installing sandwiches between precast panels when the panels collapsed and fell on top of the lift. He suffered a broken leg and wrist.
An employee was securing a stand of drilling pipe with a chain wrench when the wrench broke and hit his hand, breaking his wrist and finger.
An employee was standing on a portable stand rehanging beef in the cooler when the stand was bumped, causing the employee to fall to the floor below and suffer a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of the right pinky finger and injury to the right ring finger while attempting to clear a paper jam in a machine.
An employee was walking back to his truck in the yard while carrying some material when he was struck by a coworker operating a powered industrial truck. He suffered pelvic and ankle injuries.
An employee slipped on wet wood and fell about 4 feet to the ground while inspecting a wooden bridge. The employee suffered a broken little toe on the left foot and broken left pinky finger.
On August 1, 2016, an employee was cleaning the outside of a tanker truck when he became overheated. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was stung in the lip twice by a bee while removing brush at a site.  He was hospitalized after suffering an allergic reaction.
An employee was working along the exterior east side of the building when an unknown assailant stabbed the employee with a knife. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
Stacked bales of cardboard fell on an employee, injuring him. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was helping a coworker change out a plug catcher. After re-inserting the screen, the employees attempted to attach the connection. As the connection cap was pushed forward to prepare it for threading, the loose bolts on the cap allowed for significant play and crushed the employee's left thumb between the cap and flange bolts. The employee's left thumb was partially amputated below the fingernail.
An employee was pinning fence material together when he began experiencing cramps. He was hospitalized with a heat injury.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat stroke and dehydration.
An employee was carrying a concrete cap when the cap slipped and struck the employee's left forearm, resulting in an open fracture.
An employee was investigating a blockage in the hopper system. While closing the hopper's dryer door, the employee suffered amputations to the left-hand ring, middle, and index fingertips.
An employee fell 35 feet while snapping bolts, suffering broken ribs and bruised lungs.
An employee was dumping a load of waste when he fell into the solidification pit, suffering burns.

On or about August 2, 2016, at approximately 3:30 p.m., an employee was helping to install roofing underlayment when he stepped on wet membrane material and slid off the roof, falling more than 12 feet to the ground below and lacerating his head and tongue.
An employee was descending a ladder when his right foot slipped. He fell approximately 2 to 3 feet from the third step from the bottom to the concrete floor, breaking his right hip.
An employee was standing by a concrete pump when a hose connected to the pump broke loose and struck the employee in the face, causing a laceration and nose fracture.
An employee had delivered mail to a mailbox at the front door of a home. As she turned away, two dogs appeared and attacked her, biting her head, right and left arms, and right and left legs.
An employee was cutting a tree into smaller pieces when he began to feel ill. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
On 08/02/2016, at about 5 p.m., an employee began to feel ill and was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

On August 2, 2016, at approximately 5:15 p.m., an employee who had been welding pile splices and performing pile-driving work began to feel ill and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a baler when the baler's plunger struck his back. He was hospitalized.
While delivering mail to a residence, an employee was startled by a dog and tripped while retreating. The employee fell to the ground and suffered back trauma.
An employee was removing a twisted belt from a motor. A finger got caught between the belt and pulley amputating the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee was doing maintenance work when a corrosive dip tank solution soaked into the employee's glove and caused burns to the hand.
On August 2, 2016, an employee was manually molding with a 20-pound ladle of aluminum when he began to experience muscle spasms. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was removing 3 feet of cut-up log from the sawmill floor when two fingers on his left hand were pinched and broken by the logs.
An employee was adjusting a washer machine when the heavy metal door fell off and hit his leg, causing a leg injury.
An employee tripped over a newspaper rack and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing maintenance on a plastic grinding machine. As he was attempting to dislodge a plastic piece in the machine, his left ring finger was caught between a belt and pulley, amputating the fingertip.
An employee working at a powerhouse was splashed with a caustic solution made up of water and drain cleaner, suffering chemical burns.

An employee was operating a foam-cutting machine. After completing the cuts on the foam material, the employee was moving away from the machine and was electrically shocked by it, suffering right hand and arm injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was scanning boxes when an unload device roller rolled over her hand, amputating her left index fingertip.
An employee fell approximately 10 inches from a pallet jack, suffering a sacral spine injury.
An employee drove off the road while delivering shingles with a forklift. The forklift overturned and crushed the employee.
An employee was grinding on a machine. When he attempted to grab the metal part being worked on, his left ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was supervising the loading of a coil onto a truck from the designated safe zone when the 500-foot, 4-inch coil weighing approximately 1,250 pounds began to slip off the spool that was being lifted by a forklift. The employee tried to push the coil back onto the spool when the coil struck him, knocking him to the ground and cracking his vertebrae.

An employee was at a client's jobsite sweeping up debris in a new room addition to a home. He stepped onto an area that was covered with sheetrock and fell 14 feet to the lower level onto a staircase below, hitting his head and breaking his ankle.
An employee was teaching tennis class when his knees gave out and he fell. He ruptured both patella tendons in both knees.

On 8/2/2016, an employee and a coworker were moving a piece of equipment onto a wooden block. The employee's left index finger was pinched between the equipment and the wooden block, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee was standing to the back, left side of a forklift that was moving totes. The forklift operator backed up and ran over the employee's right foot, breaking his fibula.
An employee was performing a task involving electrical connections when an electrical arc flash occurred, causing second and third degree burns to his upper body. He was hospitalized.
While opening a dock door, an employee slipped on a wet dock plate and suffered a severe laceration from the heel to the calf, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a belt sander to remove burrs on a piece of sheet metal when his thumb became caught and partially amputated between the sander and sheet metal.
On or about August 2, 2016, an employee was sawing pieces of plastic with a band saw when the blade lacerated his left-hand index finger, requiring hospitalization.

An employee who had been installing pipe was descending a ladder when he blacked out due to heat exhaustion and dehydration. He fell to the ground (approximately 8 feet), breaking his shoulder and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was ejecting a bale from a baler. He was standing in front of the bale while pushing the button to eject it. The bale began to come out and his right ankle was caught underneath it, breaking his right lower leg.

An employee was completing a rig down and had finished cementing. He was attempting to remove the cement plug of the plug container by lowering the plug to the ground using a wench. The plug shifted and the employee's left wrist was caught between the drill pipe and the manifold on the plug container. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated left wrist.
While cleaning out a grain silo, an employee contacted a running auger in the floor, tearing four leg ligaments.
After initially cutting their left index finger with a knife in the deli department, the employee's finger was amputated due to infection.
On 8/3/2016, at 1:00 p.m., an employee was holding a boat board with her left hand and using a utility knife to cut it. She slipped and partially amputated her left thumb, requiring stitches.
On August 3, 2016, at 1:15 AM, an employee was operating a part revolution stamping press when her right middle and ring fingertips were amputated at the nailbed.

An employee was using a pneumatic grease gun to grease a trailer chassis when the gun began to malfunction. As he lifted the unit attached to the grease drum to troubleshoot the problem, his left hand slid. The moving piston then amputated his pinky fingertip between the first and second knuckle.

An employee was positioning an air tank for installation using an overhead crane when his thumb was pinned between the frame and the tank's mounting leg. The distal tip of his left thumb was amputated.
An employee was using a meat saw to cut meat when his hand slipped and his right index fingertip was amputated by the saw.
An employee was working on a barge when he became ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee on a ladder was shocked while installing circuits in an electrical junction box. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking to the building when he tripped on the uneven surface and fell to the ground, injuring his back.

An employee was ground handling a helicopter on the aircraft flight line. He was walking beside the helicopter when the helicopter wheel rolled over his left foot, ankle, and lower leg, causing compound fractures to his tibia and breaking bones in his foot. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell 22 feet to the ground while placing decking, suffering a broken pelvis, elbow, wrist, and nose.
An employee was carrying a door frame and door when it slipped and fell, bending the employee's right index finger backward and dislocating it. The employee required surgery.
An employee suffered from heat exhaustion while performing metal framing on a new construction prior to installing drywall, requiring hospitalization.
An employee on a ladder was applying flashing to a roof that was 17 feet high when the flashing ignited. The employee dismounted from the ladder and fell to the ground, fracturing the tailbone.
A car drove into a store and struck an employee, who suffered a broken leg.
After stocking a shelf, an employee fell while descending a 4-foot step ladder, fracturing the left leg/knee.
An employee was clearing out refractory outside of a hopper when ash from above poured out and caused first and second degree burns to the employee's neck and legs.

An employee smelled chlorine when he entered the chemical room. He flushed the floor drain to eliminate the smell. He notified his supervisor about the smell, and the two of them flushed the drain with multiple barrels of water. After they had flushed the drain, the employee started to experience wheezing and had a slight headache. He was hospitalized due to lung/respiratory irritation.

On August 3, 2016, at approximately 5:30 p.m., while moving from one site on the vessel to another, an employee crawled to the edge of a hatch opening, crawled over the pipe railing, and fell 8 feet into the cargo hold. The employee injured four ribs and suffered a shoulder contusion and a possible bruised lung.
After spending all day installing a fence, an employee became ill and was hospitalized due to dehydration/heat exhaustion.

On 8/3/16, an employee was leaning glass sheets on a truck rack toward himself to identify/inventory loaded sheets when he lost control of the stack, which fell over and pinned him between the glass load and a hard object. The glass broke and lacerated his head and knee.
An employee was caught between the load bar of a trailer truck and a stack of plastic dairy cases, losing consciousness and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a table saw using an 8-inch blade to cut a piece of wood. The wood piece became caught in the blade and was pulled in along with the employee's left index and middle fingers. His left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee became stuck in the hot tar and was struck by paving machinery while working on the highway.

An employee was helping to discharge fuel from a barge by positioning a C-hook on a coil. After he slid the C-hook into the coil, his hand rested on the bottom of the C-hook. When a crane began to lift the hook, the coil and his fingers became caught, crushing his left-hand pinky, ring, and middle fingers.

An employee was installing wind-ties between trusses on a new construction building when he started noticing cramping in his right arm. He was moved to a shady area to rest when he started vomiting. He was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee finished up on a rig cap on a new roof he helped install. He unhooked from the crane lift and reached over to hook his D-ring to the beam when he slipped and fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below. He dislocated his shoulder, fractured a rib, and suffered facial abrasions.

While on patrol, an employee noticed two males fighting and observed that one of the males needed medical attention. The employee approached the male, who became agitated and entangled with the employee. The male fell on the employee's ankle and broke it.

An employee was operating a machine to load wood slabs for processing into doors. As the employee was attempting to remove cardboard from the bottom of the slab being handled, the machine clamped onto the slab. The employee's left middle and ring fingertips were crushed and amputated between the slab and the clamp. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground as he was transitioning from a ladder to the roof, breaking ribs, fracturing vertebrae, and lacerating his head.
While taking the trash out, an employee slipped and fell on the concrete and received abrasions on her arm. She later started coughing up blood and was hospitalized.
On or about August 3, 2016, the wire rope on a rigging system broke, allowing a hinge pin to fall about 20 to 30 feet and strike an employee's left arm.
While roping cattle at a team roping event, an employee's right thumb became caught in the rope and was amputated.

An employee was closing a bin door when a chain attached to the bin became caught on a 4-feet x 8-feet x 3/4-inch sheet of steel plate that was leaning against the wall behind him. When he pushed to close the bin door, the chain pulled the steel plate onto his left lower leg, causing a compound fracture.
An employee fell backwards while using a dolly to go through a doorway with a stack of boxes, suffering a fractured hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting a light fixture when he came into contact with an energized circuit. He was working from a scissor lift at a height of approximately 19 feet. After the shock, he fell out of the scissor lift and landed on the concrete surface below, suffering multiple fractures and requiring hospitalization.
While working on a piece of equipment, an employee fell through a second-story hole in the floor to the concrete below, suffering a skull/facial fracture.
An employee was flushing a process line with pressurized steam when the sight glass shattered. The glass cut his abdomen and was embedded in his right forearm.
An employee was up in a tree trying to install a meat-hanging pole. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a fractured arm and spine.
An employee was cleaning the air tank of a semi truck with steam when hot water released and sprayed him, burning his left arm, chest, and back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a machine and jogging it to perform maintenance. The jog button was activated and the machine engaged, pinching and amputating the employee's left ring fingertip in the point of operation.

An employee had a steel beam suspended from an overhead crane and was attempting to lower it onto the ground. He had one hand on the end of the beam while his other hand held the remote control for the crane. While moving it to the saw area, he stepped on a stack of beams. The top beam tipped over and landed on his right foot, fracturing three bones.
An employee was installing an A/C duct panel when the component fell and lacerated his left forearm.
An employee was using a high-pressure water line (6,000 psi) lance to clean out a tar line when the lance kicked back and lacerated his neck and upper chest. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
Two employees were pressure washing the inside of a stairwell when they were overcome by carbon monoxide fumes. They were both hospitalized.
An employee was leaving a mobile tool trailer when the door broke and caught his right index and middle fingers, amputating his fingertips.

An employee was performing maintenance on a trimmer saw. When the employee removed the chock block, the saw blade rotated, amputating a centimeter of his index finger (no nail or bone loss) and avulsing his middle finger.
An employee fell on equipment while doing mill work and punctured a lung.
After securing a load to truck, an employee became disoriented and experienced full-body cramps. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was bending and cutting rebar on a rebar bending machine when the machine cycled twice, causing the rebar to bend twice. The rebar punctured the employee's right foot, fracturing the fourth metatarsal.
An employee was climbing up the third or fourth rung of a ladder when he fell to the ground and hit his head. He was hospitalized with a fractured vertebra.
An employee's finger was caught and amputated in a hydraulic gate lift.

An employee operating a forklift stopped because he thought the forklift was overheating. When he removed the radiator cap to check the water level, the hot water caused first and second degree burns to his chest and right arm.
While cleaning asphalt stuck to the bottom of a truck bed with a shovel, an employee suffered heat stress and was hospitalized.
An employee was looking for a vacuum when he slipped and fell on some water on the floor from a leaking ice cooler. He was hospitalized with a left leg injury.
An employee slipped from and fell 11 feet from the top of a railroad tank car to the ground. The employee fractured both heels and the left wrist.

While using an electric pallet jack to move a pallet between racks in the back warehouse, an employee's right thumb was smashed and partially amputated between the pallet jack handle and a warehouse rack.
An employee was handling baggage containers when his right-hand middle finger was crushed by two aluminum baggage containers.
An employee tripped and stepped into an open manhole. He fell across the manhole, fracturing two ribs and puncturing a lung.
An employee was emptying the trash and cleaning off the compactor when the compactor activated and caused two fractures to the employee's left hand/finger.
While attempting to put the chain back on a cartoner machine, an employee's fingertip became caught in the chain and sprocket and was amputated.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress symptoms while conducting rig down operations.
An employee was placing a tube in a clamp for a drill press when the clamp closed on and crushed her lefty pinky finger.
An employee tripped on an electrical cord and fell, fracturing her left hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee and coworkers placed a metal bed frame on a wall. The metal bed frame slid and landed on the employee's head and upper back. She was hospitalized with a contusion on the back of her head and upper back.
An employee was trapped under a coil of steel that fell on the employee's foot resulting in the amputation of his foot.
After working in the heat, an employee was riding with his coworkers back to the company yard when he began to feel sick. He was hospitalized with stomach pains and possible heat-related injuries.
An employee was cutting tree limbs from a 6 foot A-frame ladder when a limb hit the ladder. He dismounted the ladder 2 feet off the ground, breaking his right leg and requiring hospitalization.
After performing environmental duties outside, an employee was hospitalized due to dehydration and heat exhaustion.
On 8/4/2016, an employee was using a sand blaster when a chain broke and fell on his toe, amputating it.
An employee fell off a roof and was hospitalized.
An employee's left hand slipped while grinding a water meter casting, and the grinder cut the employee's little finger.
An employee fell 4 to 5 feet off a scaffold to the ground while preforming masonry work, suffering a hip/rib injury.
An employee was walking from one location to another and needed to step over a small foundation wall. His foot became caught on a wire and he tripped and fell 1.5 feet, fracturing his tibia.

An employee was driving a tractor pulling a stainless steel trailer containing a chemical solution when he felt an explosion from the trailer. He exited the tractor and was engulfed in fumes, causing loss of eyesight, difficulty speaking, and chest and throat irritation. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a drum with a torch. After he made the cut, the drum panel fell on and injured him. He was hospitalized.

On or about August 4, 2016, an employee was transferring a tray of mail to the mail truck when the carrier stepped off a curb, felt a snap in the left ankle, dropped the tray of mail, and fell to the ground. The employee's ankle fractured in three places.
While removing a flex hose from a machine, an employee's hand slipped and contacted a moving part. The employee's left-hand index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee was cleaning a piece of metal on a belt sander when the metal piece slipped out of the employee's control and came back to amputate his fingertip.
An employee was repairing a backhoe using a pry bar to adjust the cylinder. The pry bar slipped and the cylinder landed on his left pinky finger, smashing and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was applying pesticide outside a warehouse. A PIV exited the warehouse and ran over the employee's foot.

An employee was on a ladder inside of a trailer, attempting to correct the tension on the door. When he released the tension, the door knocked him off the ladder. He suffered fractured ribs and air outside of his lung.
An employee slipped on a spill on the floor while walking behind the donut counter. The employee hit their head and suffered a brain contusion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was preparing to load a truck of emulsion. While he was lowering the stairs, the truck's loading arm drifted, catching his hand between the loading arm and spring mechanism. His ring finger was partially amputated.

An employee was helping a coworker unload drums using a drum dolly. The coworker had secured the 800 lb. drum to the 1000 lb. capacity drum dolly. As the coworker attempted to tilt the drum dolly back, the employee placed his hand on the back side of the drum. The drum then slipped off the dolly, which in turn fell back into place and caught the employee's hand between the drum being lifted and another drum that was still on the truck. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was standing/kneeling on top of a flatbed trailer when a forklift operator sat a 500-pound A-frame onto the trailer. The A-frame fell onto the employee, pinning him underneath and breaking five vertebrae.

On Thursday, August 4, 2016, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was working outside, marking a new engineered path with flags for an underground service drop from the electrical pole to a relocated electric meter at a new residential construction site. As the employee was walking toward the electrical pole, the adjacent ground grading changed; it was partially graded and partially undisturbed natural landscape, creating an uneven walking surface. Subsequently, the employee's right ankle rolled and she fell to the ground, fracturing her ankle. She was hospitalized overnight for surgery.
A stack of acrylic plastic sheets fell on an employee, fracturing both of the employee's ankles.
An employee was trying to remove a mold by hitting it with a mold leg. His hand slipped and his left ring finger was caught between the mold and the mold leg, fracturing it.
An employee was cleaning a short weight tumbler machine when her hand was caught between the machine, amputating part of her thumb and breaking several bones in her hand.
An employee was making copies when he tripped and fell against another copier, breaking his hip.
An employee was injured by a moving forklift while picking up goods at a site, suffering broken ankle bones.
An employee was moving a ladder out of the path of a lift truck operator when the lift truck ran over the employee's left foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was flagging for traffic control when a tandem dump truck struck her and ran over both of her feet. Her left foot was fractured and bruised.

An employee was changing the rolls on the slitter and had the slitter roll hoisted with a crane. The roll was crooked/off balance on one side, which caused the sling strap to loosen. As the employee straightened the sling strap, the roll dropped down and struck his fingers between the sling strap and the roll. His left-hand ring and middle fingertips were surgically amputated.
An employee was descending a steel ladder when he slipped and hit his knee on the hand rail of the ladder.
On August 4, 2016, an employee tripped over a projector's flexible cord, fell into a door, and struck their head, requiring hospitalization for head trauma.
An employee was talking with a coworker when he suddenly fainted and experienced seizures. He was hospitalized with heat-related illness.

An employee had just cleared a jam in a conveyor when he turned left to walk away from the conveyor while his right hand was still resting on the guard. His right hand slipped and made contact with the conveyor, and his right pinky and ring fingers became caught between the roller and the fixed roll. His right ring fingertip was amputated, and his right pinky finger was fractured.
An employee was leaving the cooler in the meat department and slipped on the wet floor breaking an ankle. The employee was admitted to a hospital for his broken ankle.
On August 5, 2016, at 1:15 PM, an employee's finger was caught in the pinch point of a press brake, amputating his left ring fingertip.

An employee was pressure washing the floor in the cleaning room area when the pressure washer wand moved toward his left foot, resulting in a small cut. The cut became infected and required hospitalization.
A maintenance employee was hospitalized due to exposure to outdoor heat.
While delivering parcels to an office building, and employee fell down stairs and suffered a broken neck and sprained legs and arms.

An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift tipped over. The employee's leg was crushed under the rollover protection cage. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg and other bodily injuries.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.
An employee hurt his finger while using a screwdriver to perform electrical work.
While loading heavy brake parts into a machine, an employee suffered a herniated back disc and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on the gravel in the parking lot and fell, suffering an elbow injury.
An employee was stacking plastic tubs and had a seizure. The employee fell to the floor striking his head and elbow causing contusions to both. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was operating a reach truck when the truck started heading straight toward a pedestrian guardrail. When the employee attempted to dismount the truck, the employee's foot became pinned between the reach truck and the guardrail, resulting in a left foot amputation.
An employee was greasing a gear inside a machine when his left little finger was caught and amputated in the machine.

An employee was offloading boxes from a wooden pallet that was sitting on the floor while working at the receiving section of the warehouse. She tripped on the edge of the pallet and fell, fracturing her left tibia.
An employee was folding back a lift gate attached to a moving truck when his hand was caught in the gate, crushing all four fingers and requiring surgery.

An employee was feeding edge trim onto a conveyor when his hand became caught between the roller and the conveyor belt. He was pulled into the conveyor up to his elbow, suffering a right arm laceration and abrasion.
An employee was pulling a wheeled metal cart when a wheel became stuck. As she was trying to dislodge it, the cart fell on top of her. She was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell after he stepped on acrylic material, suffering a fractured left arm, torn ligament in his left knee, and a broken left ankle.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when he fell, rupturing the patellar tendons in both knees.

An employee was in the process of removing an overhead roll-up door. While the employee was removing bolts from the door, the "D-Ring" swung out of place and struck the employee's ladder, causing the employee to fall and break an arm.
An employee was in the process of attaching handles to a 30-quart cooler when her hand was caught on a piston, amputating her right middle fingertip.
An employee stepped into a pit containing hot water while performing cleanup duties, suffering burns to the lower legs and arms.
An employee was walking through a metal door when it closed on the employee's right pinky fingertip, amputating it.

An employee was tipping over (breaking open) a mold that contained liquid molten iron. The molten iron came in contact with the cuff of his leather glove and traveled down the inside of his glove to the palm and fingers, burning his hand.

An employee was holding a piece of metal in his hand and sanding the metal on a belt sander. The belt sander grabbed the piece of metal and pulled the employee's right hand in. His right thumb contacted the belt sander and was amputated.
A customer was trying out a golf club and an employee was hit in the head by the golf ball.

An employee was attempting to manually unjam the pleating machine. The stripper bar broke free of the pusher bar and cycled down to the table before returning to and resting in the up position. The employee's left hand was caught between the stripper bar and table during the down cycling of the bar. His left hand was sliced between the index and middle fingers to the wrist, and half of his hand was amputated.
An employee operating a table saw amputated his right index, thumb, and pinky fingertips while cutting material.
An employee fell down a stairwell, suffering facial fractures, broken and loosened teeth, shoulder pain, back pain, and buttock pain. She was hospitalized.
An employee was gathering roofing debris in a wheel barrow when he tripped and fell on roofing material, breaking his right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's left index finger was amputated while attempting to release product on a mixer.

An employee was working on the lower leg of a standing tower, installing steel members and bolts, when he fell approximately 30 feet from the tower to the concrete ground. He fractured his sternum, pelvis, leg, and arm.
An employee was operating a door press when the press closed on the employee's left little finger, crushing and amputating it.
A decoiler slipped off of forklift straps and crushed an employee's right-hand pinky and middle fingers, amputating them.
An employee was performing tank gauging on a produced water tank. After opening the tank's thief hatch, the employee was exposed to hydrogen sulfide, suffering headaches and nausea.
An employee was mounting plates on a printing press when his left ring fingertip was caught between the plates, partially amputating the soft tissue.

An employee was holding meat in front of a vertical saw blade to cut it when the employee's foot slipped on the floor. The employee's right index finger then impacted the saw blade and was partially amputated with bone loss.
An employee was raising the safety rail on the conveyor and holding onto the vertical support rail. His left middle finger was caught in the hinge amputating the fingertip.
An employee was attempting to secure a nasogastric tube to the bridge of a patient's nose when the patient bit the employee, amputating the employee's right pinky fingertip.
An employee was taking orders at the drive-thru window when she tripped and fell to the tile floor, fracturing her right ankle.
An employee struck a double stack pallet of product while operating a pallet jack, breaking the left femur.
An employee was attempting to fix air conditioning vents on a trolley when the fan blades inside the air conditioning unit amputated his fingertip.
While cleaning a machine, an employee's finger became caught in the sprocket and chain of the moving equipment. The employee's middle and ring fingers were partially amputated.

On or about August 6, 2016, an employee was using a vehicle-mounted winch when the holding mechanism malfunctioned and the wire cable kept unwinding. The employee could not pull their right hand back in time and it was pulled into the first "sheave" that was about 6 feet away from the winch, amputating three fingers.
An employee fell through a skylight while installing a new roof. He injured his wrist and spleen and broke his eye socket.

An employee was holding the top of a small manway cover and abrasive blasting the handle. The force of the blast media hitting the cover caused the cover to twist in the employee's hand, which caused his left hand to move into the blasting media stream. The blast media penetrated the back of his glove and abraded the back of his hand.
An employee pinched and crushed her left hand while cleaning a disassembled airlock machine with a water hose.
An employee rolled and fractured her ankle while picking up bread trays.

An employee was carrying a ladder on his hip when he tripped and fell, landing on top of the ladder. He later experienced irregular breathing and was hospitalized with nine fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, a broken collar bone, and shoulder and hip sprains.

An employee was helping a coworker move a guide cart. The employee was pulling the cart while the coworker was pushing it. After the cart came over a hump, it had to be pulled and pushed through four metal beams. The cart struck one of the beams, causing it to come to an abrupt stop. The guide shifted, pinching and fracturing the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was rolling product on a dolly when his foot caught on something. He twisted his left leg, fracturing both lower left leg bones.
An employee received burns from hot cream.

After using the meat cutting band saw, an employee turned off the machine and was pushing down the blade guard. The blade, which was still slowing down, amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee was stepping down out of a commercial truck cab when he missed the bottom step with his foot. He lost his grip on the handholds and fell backward to the ground, hitting his head on the gravel surface and suffering a head abrasion.
On 8/7/16, at about 3:30 p.m., an employee injured his back  while re-arranging office furniture, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading an LD8 (large cage for baggage) onto a cargo bed dolly. The LD8 shifted and his hand was pinned between the LD8 and the flat bed dolly, possibly amputating his left middle finger.
An employee was working on the cam lock for a heat treating table when he suffered an electrical shock.
An employee opened one of the two doors on the rail cars. The door swung around and made contact with the plate and the employee's finger resulting in a distal amputation.

An employee was using a hand chisel and hammer to remove the blade from the lower pocket of the shear head. While he was driving the chisel with the hammer, a small piece of metal came off and punctured his arm 3 inches above the elbow.
An employee slipped and fell 6 to 8 feet while cleaning a conveyor, fracturing the left clavicle and humerus.
An employee was cleaning the inside front glass of a chameleon cage when the glass fell and cut muscle and tendons in his left leg. He required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was unloading baggage tubs from a cart when he lost his balance and fell over, striking his leg on the baggage conveyor and fracturing his right femur.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he fell off and broke his right arm.
On August 07, 2016, at approximately 10:00 PM, an employee was hospitalized due to dehydration and heat exhaustion.
While delivering mail, an employee was bitten by a dog on the upper and lower left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches.
An employee was working in an aeration basin and attempted to retrieve a grappling hook when he slipped and fell breaking his lower left leg.
While operating a wire press, an employee's left thumb was amputated by the press clamp.
An employee was bitten on the hand by a rattlesnake while turning a valve to change the flow direction. The snake was coiled underneath the tank hatch. The employee was hospitalized.
While delivering mail on her route, an employee began feeling faint and experienced pains in her chest. She was hospitalized due to possible heat stress.

An employee was working on a faulty water cannon and was standing in front of it. The cannon motor did not stop running and hot water (being hot from the sun) escaped, burning the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell 8 feet off a ladder onto a generator that was located approximately 5 feet away from the ladder.
An employee felt dizzy and lightheaded while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress and kidney failure.

On 8/8/16, an employee was cutting metal on a shear. The employee's gloved hands became caught in the metal hold-down pads that push the metal into the shear. The employee suffered a right-hand middle fingertip amputation, as well as left-hand middle and index fingertip amputations.
An employee was testing electrical voltage when an electrical arc flash occurred. The employee suffered electrical burns to the arms and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading packages from a trailer. A package fell and struck the employee pushing her into a trailer flap. The employee was hospitalized with two rib fractures and a laceration to the left kidney.
An employee was walking out of the cold storage area when a forklift backed up over his left foot, bruising it.
An employee opened a door for another person. The door then shut on his right-hand middle finger, partially amputating it.
An employee was tubing when she hit her head and suffered a concussion.
An employee was crimping tube on a block machine when his left-hand ring finger was caught, crushed, and amputated in the clamps.
An employee fell 3' 11'' and dislocated the right shoulder.
An employee suffered a fractured ankle during a scaffolding collapse and simultaneous fall, requiring hospitalization.
A temporary employee became involved in a physical altercation with another temporary employee, suffering a fractured right fibula/dislocated right ankle.
On or about August 8, 2016, an employee was exposed to excessive heat while tearing off a flat roof and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was retrieving material from a drying rack and descending a 4-foot ladder when he fell and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in the process of maintaining the swimming pool. A PVC pipe burst and the employee received chemical burns to the left side of the face, chest and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming shrubs with gas-powered shears when the shears amputated his right-hand index fingertip.
An employee was operating a large farm tractor outdoors when he experienced blurred vision, slurred speech, a queasy stomach, and unsteadiness. He was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
An employee was walking around an order picker when he tripped over the wheel, fell to the ground, and broke his femur and hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the bolster of a chassis, hooking up a chain to the chassis to lift up a pedestal. The yard jockey driver backed up to the chassis, left the yard jockey in neutral, and got out without setting the brake. The yard jockey then rolled back and pinned the injured employee's left leg between the yard jockey and the chassis, causing a severe contusion and swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee was in the hatch of a maritime vessel attempting to hook up to a bundle of pipe to lift it out of the hatch. The employee began to experience severe body cramps and was hospitalized with severe dehydration.
After working in the heat, an employee passed out due to heat stress and was hospitalized.
An employee become dehydrated, nauseated, ill, and experienced muscle spasms due to the heat. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking from one area to another when she slipped and fell onto her left hip. She was hospitalized with a wrist injury and a fractured left hip.
At approximately 8:00 AM, on 8/8/2016, an employee was attempting to adjust the forks on a forklift when his fingertip was crushed between the fork and the frame of the forklift. He required surgery.
An employee was trying to readjust a trailer hitch when the employee's finger was caught and partially amputated between the trailer hitch and the ball of the truck.
An employee was operating a reamer drill when the main frame of the reamer drill struck the employee in the abdomen/stomach area. The employee was hospitalized with internal bleeding.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while working on a CNC machine.
An employee partially amputated the left middle fingertip while loading a machine with bar stock.
An employee fell to the floor while climbing a ladder to inspect a spray booth, breaking the L1 vertebra.
An employee was using a skill saw to cut plywood for concrete forms and cut his left index finger to the middle of the nailbed (no bone loss).
An employee was using a drift pin to align form holes for assembly. When the employee struck the pin, a shard flew up into his interior nostril, lacerating it.

An employee seated at an inspection station attempted to move a power strip with their right foot. As the employee extended the right leg, the chair tipped and ejected the employee to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.

Workers were offloading jersey barriers from a trailer when they lost control of one of the jersey barriers, causing it to strike an employee in the back. The employee rolled off the trailer and laid down on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with L2 and L3 vertebrae fractures.

An employee was stripping/unloading a trailer. There was a deck bar in the trailer towards the top of the vertical tracks. The employee was trying to remove the bar, but it was not coming loose. He then walked under the deck bar towards the front of the trailer and it released striking him on the top of his head, causing a laceration to the top left side of his head.

An employee offloaded tertiary butyl catechol (corrosive) from a cargo tank to a facility tank. Upon completion of the transfer, the employee began disconnecting hoses. He had difficulty with one of the connections and when the hose disconnected, hot product contacted the employee's left arm and leg, causing a third degree burn.
An employee was removing a strap from a column that was being adjusted using a forklift. The strap released from the load and struck the employee in the face, causing head trauma.
An employee suffered an asthma attack while using a powered floor sweeper to clean the floor.
An employee's left-hand middle fingertip was crushed and amputated while the employee was attempting to repair forming equipment.
An employee was opening the door of his truck when a roll of material weighing more than 400 pounds knocked him down. He fractured his lower back.
An employee was changing the shock absorber on a military truck when the replacement shock absorber shifted during installation and amputated 1/2 an inch of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was working behind a piece of equipment when he tripped and fell into a belt and pulley, amputating his left index and middle fingers up to the first joint.
On or about August 8, 2016, an employee attempted to wipe away dust near the pinch point on a press machine. The press came down and amputated the employee's right thumb tip.
An employee was standing on a column guiding a forklift operator when the forklift struck the column, causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered bruises and possible internal damage.
While painting an awning, an employee fell about 15 to 16 feet and fractured his femur.
An employee was carrying boxes to the freezer when he tripped and fell over trash bags on the floor. The employee suffered lower back and left leg injuries.

An employee entered a trench that was properly shored with a steel trench box and access ladder. The employee was using a cut off saw to cut through an abandoned water main. The section of main was isolated/shut off and restrained from the live portion of the main the prior day. The employee successfully cut through the main and turned around to place the cut off saw on 
the ground. As he did, the water main valve from the live portion of the 
main failed and separated from the pipe striking his knee. Water from the main began to fill the trench. As the employee began to exit the trench box his hard hat fell off. The employee fell and his head hit the spreader bar. The employee suffered a left knee fracture and a head contusion.
An employee fell 4 feet off a ladder, fracturing the lower left leg.
An employee was shoveling asphalt when he began to feel unwell. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion/dehydration.
On August 9, 2016, an employee fell from a straight truck's lift gate while making a delivery, suffering a fractured hip/right upper leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving heavy products upstairs and felt pain in the back. The employee was hospitalized for a bulged disc.
An employee was holding onto a scaffold when a metal flashing on top of the scaffold fell and struck the employee's left forearm, lacerating it.
An employee stepped on a piece of bridge decking and fell through to the ground, suffering a cut on the head and one broken rib.

An employee was moving pallets with an electric pallet jack. While backing up the pallet jack, his leg got caught in the wheel well of a forklift. The forklift operator began to move the forklift forward, causing the employee's leg to be pulled farther into the wheel well. He suffered broken bones in his right foot and a fractured right elbow, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had some cramping in his right shoulder and passed out for approximately 2 to 3 minutes possibly due to heat stress.
An employee was laying down a power swivel when the swivel fell and fractured the employee's tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when a piece of wood shot back and struck him in the eye.

On Tuesday, August 9, 2016, at approximately 3:00 PM, an employee was walking near the receiving entrance to the facility. He turned around and tripped over bags of grout that were on the floor and fell. He was hospitalized for a fractured hip.
On or about 8/09/2016, an employee was guiding an operator who was lowering a concrete mat. The spreader bar came loose and hit the employee in the lower back, fracturing his right femur.
An employee was installing a security camera at a commercial building while on top of a 6-foot ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking bones.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to place a clamp when he fell 8 feet to the ground, bruising his forehead and lacerating his nose, lip, and back.
An employee working from a ladder suffered an electrical shock. The employee fell from the ladder and suffered fractures to the face and back/neck, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing a mirror when a piece of it broke off and impaled the employee in the chest, causing a laceration to the chest/abdomen.
An employee experienced heat stress and was hospitalized.

An employee was responding to a trouble call work order at the home of a customer. He was standing on and working from an extension ladder at an estimated working surface height of 15 ft. in order to remove and replace the drop (aerial cable) that was serving the customer's home. He cut the drop at the point where it was attached to the mid-span. The release of tension on the drop caused the mid-span to recoil, thereby throwing the employee from the ladder to the ground onto his right hip. He sustained a fracture to the lower portion of his back (spine) and was hospitalized.

An employee was offloading a termite mini excavator from a trailer when the excavator missed the ramp and began to tip over. The employee dismounted the excavator and broke the left femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While spreading pine straw, an employee was bitten by a spider and had an allergic reaction (swelling and inflammation), requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bitten by a copperhead snake while picking up loose material.

An employee on a scaffold had been welding on a pipe structure for 8 to 8.5 hours. When he came down off of the scaffold, he exhibited signs and symptoms of dehydration, hyperglycemia, and heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee and a coworker were working on the glass front entryway door. The employee was adjusting the door-closing mechanism with the door closed. The coworker opened the door while the employee had his finger in the closing mechanism. It closed like a scissor and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was finishing up concrete padding operations in 90- to 91-degree temperatures with a 105 to 106 heat index when he felt dizzy and experienced cramping. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was in a resident's room to draw blood for a blood sugar test. When she turned to leave the room, she tripped over an electrical cord for the bed's alarm mat. She fell on her right side and fractured her right femur.
An employee experienced heat-related illness and dehydration while delivering his route.
An employee descending a step-stool missed the last step, losing balance and falling to the floor. The employee suffered a possible broken hip.
On or about August 9, 2016, an employee driving an electric pallet jack was struck by a coworker driving an electric sit-down forklift, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee injured his hand when it was caught in a ribbon blender.
An employee was trying to identify where a noise was coming from on a conveyor belt when his watch and then left hand were caught in the conveyor, de-gloving some skin. He was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling scaffolding, took a step back, and fell down the stairwell dislocating the right wrist.
An employee was manually turning a drive belt when their thumb was caught between the roller and the belt resulting in a partial amputation of the right thumb.

An employee was staging a part on a coordinate measuring machine. The employee put the part onto the fixture. A hole in the casting into which the fixture pin is placed was not big enough. The employee placed the part on its side to deburr the hole out. The employee was repositioning the part onto the fixture when it slipped and crushed his finger between the part and the fixture, amputating his fingertip. The part weighed about 56 pounds.
An employee was adjusting air conditioner vents when the malfunctioning unit caught on fire, causing second degree burns.
After repairing sprinklers outdoors at a customer's site in the sun, an employee experienced kidney problems likely due to severe dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on the bottling machine when the bottle filler tube punctured his left hand between the first and second digits, requiring sutures and possible hand surgery.
An employee was working on a 22.5 MVA transformer when an electrical explosion occurred. The employee received first, second, and third degree burns on the left arm, neck, shoulder, and back.

An employee was changing a viber plate on a mini-excavator and aligning the shim when the driver in the cab accidentally bumped the lever, causing the arm of the machine to pinch the employee's thumb. The employee's thumb tip was amputated and thumb bone was smashed, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a mold cart. The cart tipped and the employee fell onto the concrete floor injuring his back.

An employee was pouring a dry powder chemical compound (DMPA) into an empty 25-lb plastic bag for shipment when he began to experience a running nose, shortness of breath, and a sore throat. He was hospitalized and treated for a possible allergic reaction.
An employee was servicing an aircraft engine when he fell off a ladder and injured his wrists, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading an ATV onto a trailer when one of the ATV's wheels came off the trailer and the ATV tipped over, fracturing the employee's vertebra.
An employee was on a ladder and fell 4 to 5 feet fracturing a disc in the lower back.
An employee was standing/stepping on the tracks of a bulldozer when the tracks moved, crushing the employee's heel bone and tearing the surrounding tissue.
An employee was getting ready to step from the roof onto a ladder when it started to rain. He fell to the ground and suffered back and sprain injuries.

An employee was cutting a flat piece of cork stock (1/8" thick from a 12"X12" section) to be used as trimming on furniture. He was having difficulty cutting the cork material because it would not slide on the table saw surface due to the cork material adhering to the table. He proceeded to apply more force, and as he attempted to push the stock into the blade, the material inadvertently folded, causing his left hand to move into the rotating blade. His left-hand pinky finger was amputated, and his ring finger was lacerated.
While repositioning a 148-pound part on a pallet, an employee suffered a back strain and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a customer to move feed sacks on the back of the customer's flat bed truck. The employee stumbled and fell approximately four feet to the ground fracturing the left hip.
A temporary employee was washing/detailing a car when he slipped on some water and fell, fracturing his left femur.

An employee was unloading 10- to 15-pound packages from a trailer and stacking them. The employee finished unloading the packages and stepped onto the roller system (8 to 9 inches long in the middle of the trailer deck). The employee then lost their footing and hit the floor, striking the left hip and breaking the left femur.
While operating a pallet truck, an employee's foot became wedged between the pallet and product, fracturing the employee's ankle.

An employee was climbing a ladder to cut tree limbs that were blocking the customer's view of the satellite dish. The employee fell off the ladder and struck a galvanized pole. The employee was hospitalized with kidney and abdominal trauma.

An employee had attached braces to a tank using a ladder. He started to climb down and fell approximately 7 to 8 feet to the ground striking his head. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured skull and ribs.
An employee walked across the parking lot and felt ill. He was hospitalized with heat-related illness.

An employee in a rigger box that was on a forklift was connecting cables to a flat rack storage container that was high up in the air. The employee fell 15 feet out of the rigger box to the ground, fracturing bones and requiring hospitalization.
While an employee was moving a fan and floor mat, the fan was knocked over and the screen and blade came off and struck her left hand, cutting her fingers and breaking her ring finger.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet from the roof during painting activities.
An employee was feeding rebar into the rebar bending machine when his hand was pulled into the point of operation, crushing his right pinky finger. The finger had to be medically amputated.
The injured worker was installing a pet drinking fountain when he became dizzy and disoriented which resulted in hospitalization for heat stroke.
An employee was removing a clump of fertilizer from a screw conveyor when two fingers on his left hand became caught and partially amputated in the conveyor.

An employee was unjamming a log stuck in the slab deck. His hand was caught under the log when his coworker restarted the machine. This caused the log to smash his right ring and pinky fingers, leading to a medical amputation of his fingertips.
While helping to install a metal hand railing, an employee suffered cramping due to working in the heat. The employee was hospitalized overnight for heat exhaustion.
An employee was preparing for a system demonstration of the NitroJet when the employee's left hand came close to the system's nozzle and was cut.
An employee suffered injuries to the left leg and shoulder after falling to the ground while picking up a piece of wood.
An employee's left-hand pinky finger was crushed between press dies, requiring a partial amputation.
An employee was attempting to pull a long piece of material through a rotary cutter when two of his fingers were caught in the machine. His right index and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was using a choker chain and hoist to lift material and relocate it. The hook slipped and pinched his left ring fingertip, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was taking laser measurements at a client facility in the freezer area. There was a roof leak and patches of black ice on the floor. The employee slipped on the ice and fell to the floor, sustaining a hairline fracture to his right hip and injuring his right arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee's hand was caught in rollers while flaking corn, amputating fingers.
An employee was struck in the legs by a motorized wheelchair and subsequently hospitalized.

When the employee placed a piece of metal into the shear, the weight difference between the heavy end and lighter end caused the piece of metal to be raised above the shear table. The shear cycle then activated via the foot pedal, and the hold-downs and guard lowered and forced the piece of metal down toward the shear table. The employee's right index fingertip was pinched and amputated between the metal and the shear table.

An employee was retrieving work equipment from the roof when he fell through a hole cut by another employee. He suffered broken ribs, cracked vertebrae, and a dislocated shoulder, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a laminate glue machine when his right thumb became stuck in the machine rollers, amputating his thumb tip.
An employee was carrying breadsticks out of the walk-in freezer when a piece of metal on the freezer door sliced his foot open.
An employee was cleaning a roller with a rag when the rag became caught in the roller. The employee's right index finger was pulled into the roller, causing an abrasion and requiring hospitalization.

A belt on an auger became jammed with wheat. An employee turned off the power to the auger and attempted to loosen the belt. The belt temporarily released and pulled the employee's finger between the belt and a pulley, amputating the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was removing a tire from a split rim wheel on a heavy truck when the lock ring was blown off of the assembly. The force amputated the employee's 3rd, 4th, and 5th digits on the left hand.

An employee was putting in a steel post approximately 6 feet tall and 6 inches in diameter when he was struck by the bucket of a mini excavator. His hand was caught between the top of the post and the bucket of the excavator, amputating his left-hand pinky and ring fingertips.
An employee had just finished using a shear press when he began to feel ill. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

A maintenance employee was changing the ballast above the tile in the ceiling space. He stripped a wire and cut it. While still holding the wire, his body came into contact with the metal grate that holds the ceiling tiles, and he suffered an electrical shock.
An employee was walking in the yard when a loader truck struck him, breaking his right leg.

An employee was using a side boom along a pipeline when the wooden mat broke apart and the lift began to rock. The employee exited the side boom and landed on some rocks, injuring his left elbow, ribs, abdominal area, lungs, and the right side of his face. He was hospitalized.
On August 10, 2016, at approximately 11:45 PM, an employee was operating an ATV when he ran into a dry canal. He hurt his wrist, ankle, ribs, and hips.
An temporary employee was moving a bag of chemicals when the bag opened.  The employee was covered in the chemical and later suffered burns to a large portion of his body.

On 8/10/16, at 12:15 p.m., an employee was riding a lawn mower on an incline when it rolled and fell 10 feet from a wall to the grass below. He fractured his left tibia and lacerated his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped into an open pit and fell 4.5 feet to the concrete floor, breaking the right femur and requiring surgery.
An employee had trouble breathing and was hospitalized for possible heat stress.

An employee was operating a table saw to cut a piece of wood when the wood became bound in the saw blade and kicked back, causing the employee's left thumb to contact the blade. The thumb tip was amputated with some bone loss.
While driving a work bicycle, an employee was struck by a moving vehicle, suffering bruises and scrapes on the legs, shoulders, and arms.
An employee was performing furnace maintenance when he began feeling overheated. He was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.

An employee was trimming an ornamental pear tree with a pole saw when the pole saw came in contact with an electrical line. The employee suffered an electrical shock and received a burn on his right hand and on each foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized for a heat-related injury.
An employee was descending a staircase when his knee buckled, causing him to fall down the stairs. He fractured his left femur.
While cutting metal studs with a chop saw in hot weather, an employee did not feel well and was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee's right hand was bitten by a dog while delivering mail to a resident's door, requiring hospitalization.

On 8/11/2016, at approximately 3:05 PM, an employee was cutting a stair stringer with a circular saw when the board moved. As he attempted to grab the board, the saw kicked back and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was installing insulation on a roof cavity between two purlins when he fell 30 feet through an opening to the ground, crushing his head.
An employee was hospitalized for a heat related illness.
An employee was cleaning a roll of steel when the roll cycled and amputated his right index finger.
An employee was connecting pipes on the drilling rig from the derrick position. The employee fell from the derrick to the rig floor, suffering torso injuries.

An employee was using a 2-inch screw pipe to remove a coupler. He used a pipe threading machine and pipe wrench to force the coupler to screw off. His right ring finger was pinched between the pipe wrench and the pipe threading machine, amputating his distal fingertip.
After delivering packages for 7.5 hours, an employee suffered a heat-stress-related event and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking down a marked walkway when he slipped on a tiny piece of plastic, causing him to fall and break his right ankle.
An employee  was installing cable system at an apartment complex and was overcome by heat.
On or about August 11, 2016, an employee was hit by a forklift, suffering a severe laceration to the left big toe. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches.

An employee pulled up to a tractor trailer with a fork truck. He got off the fork truck and went to open the tractor trailer door. The fork truck rolled into him and pinned him between the pallet and the tractor trailer causing internal injuries.
An employee was disassembling equipment when his hand contacted a running belt and was drawn into a pinch point, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was moving a vat on a vat lift. When he attempted to correct the alignment of the vat, his finger was pinched between the vat and the vat lift, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was working on the roof of a commercial building when the deck gave way and he fell approximately 15 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell into a 145-degree hot water pit, suffering second and third degree burns to the lower body.
An employee was waiting on the side of the road for assistance with his disabled vehicle when an oncoming vehicle lost control and struck him, fracturing his leg, pelvis, and/or hip.
An employee was working from a ladder when it slid from under the employee. The employee fell, fracturing the left ankle and a bone under the right knee.
