An employee was operating a zero-turn lawn mower when he approached a steel cable approximately 3 feet off the ground. He became caught in the cable, and both of his legs were lacerated and crushed between the cable and the mower's mowing deck.
An employee was filling a lead mold when the mold dropped on his right hand, fracturing his right forefinger and bruising his right thumb.
An employee was attempting to rig a solid web rafter beam when the beam leaned toward the employee and fractured the employee's right foot.

After loading yard waste onto a waste disposal collection truck for 2  hours, an employee became dizzy and lightheaded. The employee was hospitalized with severe dehydration and acute kidney failure due to the heat.
An employee was cleaning the debris off of a pitched roof when he fell from the eave onto the lower flat roof (fell about 5 feet), breaking his pelvis and requiring hospitalization.
On August 11, 2016, at approximately 8:30 AM, a forklift ran over an employee's right foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a baker scaffold. A plank shifted and the employee fell 4.5 feet. The employee suffered a fracture to the sternum.
While working from the roof of a house, an employee fell approximately 20 feet from the roof eave to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right heel and was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet from the roof while attempting to install an anchor, suffering a fractured pelvis.
An employee was carrying a pipe to a dumpster when the pipe dropped and landed on his leg. He was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee passed out while filling napkins into a dispenser, fracturing her left leg.

On or about August 11, 2016, an employee was cutting steel bar stock on a band saw when the employee's left index finger was caught between the band saw stop and the bar stock as a vertical vice closed to secure the bar stock. The distal phalange on the finger had to be surgically amputated.
While delivering mail an employee felt ill possibly due to heat and was hospitalized.
While repairing a grill exhaust fan, an employee suffered an amputation of the right index finger at the first joint and a fractured right middle finger at the first joint.
An employee became weak and dizzy while making a delivery. He was hospitalized due to dehydration.

On or about August 11, 2016, an employee was adding ink to the decorator can printing machine when the ink fell. When the employee attempted to grab it, the employee's hand became caught between the plate cylinder and the blanket segment, amputating the left ring finger.
As an employee was walking on site, he felt lightheaded and headed over to the gang box, where he blacked out. He was hospitalized for possible heat-related illness.
While changing/replacing lighting from an extension ladder, an employee received an electrical shock and fell 20 feet, breaking a tibia.
An employee was operating a bread molder/slicer machine. His right index finger was caught in the machine, amputating his right fingertip above the fingernail.

An employee was attempting to transfer product from a partially filled drum to an empty drum. He placed a valve in the bung of the partially filled drum to complete the task. When he opened the valve to initiate the pour, the valve came off, and hexamethylenediamine splashed on him, causing first and second degree chemical burns to his face/upper body.
An employee amputated a fingertip (no bone) while slicing onions with a knife.
An employee fell while walking down the stairs and was hospitalized with an ankle fracture.
An employee suffered from heat exhaustion and dehydration while stacking 50 lb. bags of carbon black, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was conducting maintenance on the nacelle of the wind turbine when he slipped and fell onto a stair, landing on his right-side ribcage and suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee was working in the rolling mill when he began to feel nauseous, light-headed and started cramping. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was performing maintenance work on the cotton gin when a piece of the equipment shifted and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee fell off the shipping dock and broke several ribs.

An employee was signaling a backhoe while doing excavation. His hand was holding onto a chain that was attached to a trench box and the backhoe. He signaled the backhoe, which moved the trench box. When the weight shifted, the employee's hand was pinched by the chain, avulsing and fracturing his left ring finger.

An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum off a tommy-lift to a pickup truck. The employee tilted the drum back to roll it off the lift and released the drum. The drum pinched the employee's left pinky finger between the other drum, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was holding a piece of plywood in his right hand by the steel structure of a conveyor. A forklift was returning a dumpster to that area and the forklift struck the plywood pressing the employee's finger between the plywood and the steel structure of a conveyor. The tip of the employee's right ring finger was amputated.
An employee working in the drumming area started walking slowly and breathing hard. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was using a water hose to spray a conveyor. He observed a piece of meat in the conveyor and was attempting to remove it when his left arm was caught in the sprocket. He was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.
An employee suffered chest pain with tachycardia and was hospitalized after exposure to dry vinyl sealer and stain used on doors.

On August 12, 2016, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee fell to the cement floor while trying to stabilize a stack of air conditioners. Some of the A/C units then fell on top of him, causing brain bleeding and a black eye, fracturing a rib, and puncturing his lung.

An employee was working on the extrusion line. During the process of removing the shaft from the roll, the employee used his right index finger to release the air from the shaft. He pushed the button to move the shaft carriage system upward with the left hand. The shaft carriage system crushed his right finger between the shaft carriage system and the shaft, amputating his index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning and sharpening the food slicer's blade when her left hand contacted the blade, amputating her pointer and middle fingertips.
On August 12, 2016, an employee attaching toters to a truck began to feel lightheaded and dizzy due to a heat-related illness in the late afternoon.

An employee was walking in an aisle while a forklift operator was approaching with a cart on the front of a forklift. He saw the employee at the last moment and pressed the brakes all the way to the floor. The load shifted, rolled forward, and hit the employee, injuring her right hip and left hand. She was hospitalized.
An employee's foot was injured when it was run over by a forklift.

An employee was helping other workers dispose of a small engine that was attached to a pulley and a shaft. The workers were turning the small engine to load it on a pallet jack, and the employee reached between them to help load the engine onto the jack. The pulley then slid down the shaft and smashed his pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working on a sheet metal cutting machine when two fingers on his right hand were caught in a chain and sprocket, amputating his pointer and middle fingertips.
An employee was working on the picking station when a piece of metal flew through a metal cage and hit him, breaking his arm.

An employee was driving a forklift into the freezer to retrieve product. As the employee traveled over an uneven portion of the floor, it caused the forklift to swerve. The employee's left elbow was caught between the forklift and a post, breaking bones and dislocating the left elbow.

An employee was pressure flushing a clogged drain pipe that contained a caustic chemical with a pressure washer. The caustic substance in the drain pipe was pushed back out by the water pressure and splashed into the employee's face. His safety glasses were knocked off by the pressure and the caustic chemical got into his eyes. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing electrical conduit when he fell 3 feet, 7 inches through an expansion joint opening in the floor, landing on top of an I-beam and injuring his vertebrae.
An employee was cleaning the top of a manhole with a brush when a truck drove over him. He suffered broken bones and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a wood processor to process logs. The logs, which were being held down by a clamp, tipped, so the employee opened the processor screen. The clamp then came down and smashed his left-hand little finger. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was running products and laying parts down for sensors to operate. The employee stood a part up, which bypassed the sensors. Four parts were in the catcher and one was being crushed in the machine. The employee attempted to pull the part out and his ring finger was amputated by the stamping machine's lock seamer.

An employee was reorganizing a janitorial closet. The employee moved a 5-gallon container of floor stripper from a shelf. The cap was loose and the floor stripper spilled on the employee's chest, left arm, and left foot, causing chemical burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing cheese product from a mixer exit when the rotating auger caught the employee's right arm, fracturing the right wrist and forearm and causing a laceration.

At approximately 2:30 PM on August 6, 2016, an employee fell off the roof of a commercial building into a keg of hot tar and suffered burns to approximately 70 percent of his body. He was hospitalized.
As an employee was verifying that the air pressure on a die-cast machine was at the correct level, the valve actuated and amputated the employee's third right-hand distal phalange.
Around 10:00 AM on 8/12/2016, an employee was sweeping when he began having cramps. He was hospitalized for heat-related symptoms and dehydration.

An employee was helping attach a jib to a mobile crane by pushing on the jib. The jib was laying on the tip of the fork. The jib fell and hit the employee on the head and shoulder, and then landed on his foot, breaking three toes and two metatarsals in his left foot.

An employee was rolling fiberglass and was not feeling well. When other workers helped her sit down, she suffered an altered level of consciousness. She became severely lethargic and was cold and clammy to the touch. She was hospitalized overnight for heat exhaustion.
An employee suffered a smashed right index finger while operating a tube-bending machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was connecting a pipe to a wellhead. The pipe separated under pressure and struck the employee, fracturing the employee's ribs and leg.
An employee was emptying trash from a 55-gallon drum into a larger trash bin when his left middle finger was caught between the trash drum and the large trash bin, clipping his finger.
An employee slipped off a conveyor railing while leveling cheese and his hand entered the tumbler resulting in a partial amputation without bone loss to the right pinky fingertip.

While troubleshooting a machine, an employee leaned against an adjacent hopper machine and propped himself up with his left hand. The hopper housing moved under his weight and pinched this thumb, fracturing bone and amputating his thumb tip.
An employee fell approximately 12-13 feet off of a roof and suffered a broken hip that required surgery and four broken ribs.  Fall protection was not used at the time of the incident.
An employee fell off of a roof while cleaning a window and landed on a concrete wall. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.

An employee was lowering a 300-pound refrigeration compressor from the tailgate of a pickup truck to a steel dolly with a helper when the employee's finger was caught between the compressor and the dolly. The employee suffered a bone fracture of the right pinky finger and an open wound on the top and bottom of the pinky.

An employee was working at the baler/hogger shredding up corrugated boxes when a jam occurred. The employee used a metal pipe to try and clear/unjam the hogger when his right hand was pinned between the pipe and hogger's door frame, fracturing his third, fourth, and fifth fingers.

On Saturday, August 13, 2016, around 4:15 p.m., an employee was attempting to clean the push arm of a conveyor when a positioning device activated and caught the employee's right middle finger, amputating approximately 1 centimeter.

An employee had just finished making a delivery and was sitting in his truck getting ready to drive to another store when an assailant shot the employee in the left cheek and shoulder. He was hospitalized.
On August 13, 2016, at 4:30 p.m., an employee became ill while delivering mail in a company vehicle. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee fell while ascending a ladder to replace a service drop, breaking the right arm and left hand.
An employee received electrical burns to both hands and the left forearm while pulling wires from an energized breaker panel.
A maintenance employee was hospitalized after cutting into a live 480 VAC circuit and suffering an electrical shock.
An employee fell and hit her head while assisting a resident who had fallen.
An employee tripped over a parked lift truck fork and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was testing the spark plug on a mower during repairs when the mower leaked gas and ignited, causing first through third degree burns below the knees on both legs.
An employee was performing well test operations and experienced heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee operating a forklift was lifting a small dumpster on a 1- to 2-degree slope when the forklift tipped over. The employee jumped out of the forklift during the descent and was struck on the right calf by the overhead bars, suffering tissue and ligament damage.
An employee moving a patient felt throbbing pains in her lower back and was hospitalized with a back sprain.
An employee slipped in a pool of water approximately 3 inches in diameter and fell to the floor, breaking her right femur and requiring surgery.
An employee became ill due to heat-related illness while delivering mail, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was repairing a motorized tarp on a side-dumper semi-trailer when his fingers became caught in the drive chain and sprocket, amputating his left ring finger to the first knuckle.
An employee climbed up onto the workover rig to secure the mast and lost his balance. He slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his left orbital bone.
An employee struck a yellow post while attempting to make a U-turn in the parking lot, dislocating and fracturing the right wrist.
An employee walking on a sidewalk lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his lower left leg and dislocating an ankle.
On August 13, 2016, an employee fell while descending an A-frame ladder leaning against the wall of an overhead platform, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was closing the bank vault door and got their finger caught in the door resulting in amputation of the left ring fingertip.

An employee was checking the oil on the reefer unit of a trailer. A third-party tractor did not see the employee and pinned the employee between the tractor and the trailer. The employee suffered broken ribs, a broken sternum, and a collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee working behind the fragrance counter turned around and tripped over a box, falling to the floor and fracturing an arm.
An employee experienced heat stress symptoms after engaging in production work, requiring hospitalization.
While standing on a step stool to stock shampoo on a shelf, an employee fell and struck the right arm on the concrete floor, fracturing the upper arm.
An employee's left pinky finger was partially amputated.
On 8/14/16, at 0800 hours, an employee was climbing stairs when he felt a sharp pain in his lower back shooting down his leg. The pain worsened and he was hospitalized.
While stacking a produce cart in the produce cooler, an employee slipped on a strawberry on the floor and was injured requiring hospitalization.
An employee was retrieving a piece of meat from under a deli slicer when her right ring fingertip made contact with the blade and was amputated.
An employee was using a hardwood pole to clean a furnace's tap channel when molten metal slag suddenly released from the furnace, burning the employee's hands, head, face, left ear, lips, and mouth.

While hooking up cargo (wood pulp) in a vessel, an employee walked into one of the landing gear legs of the spreader bar, knocking his hard hat off and causing his head to go backwards. His neck and right arm became numb and he could not move his right-hand fingers.

An employee was grinding salmon in a meat grinder when a piece of salmon became stuck to the side. When she attempted to dislodge it, her right middle finger was caught in the grinder blades, amputating her fingertip and requiring reattachment surgery.
After working all morning, an employee began to have cramping and feel ill. The employee later collapsed and was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee broke the bone and lacerated his right thumb in the locking mechanism on a trailer tongue.
An employee fell off a ladder while installing lightning protection on the roof, fracturing a left rib, the left tibia, and an ankle.
An employee was repairing a metal roof. The employee stepped on a glass skylight. The glass broke and the employee fell 12 feet to the floor below fracturing his left hand.
An employee was putting up wall boards while working from a ladder when he fell and landed on a screw gun, injuring his right arm and triceps.
An employee fell onto gravel and lacerated his head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling out a vacuum when she fell over a box of paper, hitting her head on the concrete flooring.
Am employee was walking by a steam cooking kettle and slipped on the water that was on the floor, breaking the hip and bruising the wrist.
An employee's right index fingertip was smashed and amputated before the first joint while cleaning chicken parts out of a machine conveyor area.

An employee was trimming excess yarn off of the package. The excess yarn became entangled in his hand and fell back through the guide slot in the guard as the employee was cutting it. After falling through the guide slot, the yarn began to wrap around the over feed, pulling his hand against the guard causing the amputation of the left thumb, a laceration on the left pinky finger, and crushing the left ring finger.
An employee was using an 8-foot ladder when he slipped. As he reached to catch himself, his little finger was caught on a shackle, amputating it.
While trying to manually rotate a forms shaft, an employee slipped and fell, breaking a finger and requiring stitches.
An employee began experiencing heat-related illness and cramping due to high temperatures, humidity, and dehydration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sitting in a vacuum truck that was next to a tanker trailer containing hot water. The trailer's legs sank into the ground and the tank rolled, allowing water to splash through the driver side of the employee's truck. He suffered second degree burns to his left arm and left leg.
An employee slipped and fell from an extension ladder while installing gutters, breaking the pelvis/hip.
While moving an aerial lift, an employee came in close proximity to a powerline. The power line arc-flashed and the employee sustained an electrical shock, requiring hospitalization.

While delivering letters and packages, an employee went up a set of stairs to a customer's house and rang the bell. Suddenly, the employee passed out due to dehydration and fell down the stairs, puncturing his left lung and fracturing a rib. He was hospitalized.
An employee was kneeling and nailing shingles on a roof when a nail struck his right knee. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee experienced heat stress while performing bridge work in 86-degree weather, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was riding a horse on the trail when the horse disturbed a bee's nest. The bees stung the horse, causing the horse to buck and throw off the employee. The employee landed on a jagged stump and sustained lacerations to the left forearm, and possibly sustained rib and spleen damage.
An employee was troubleshooting the baler machine. When he opened the electrical controller for the baler, he received an electrical shock to his right hand.

On August 15, 2016, an employee was trying to unjam the reel stop on a paper machine when the machine suddenly activated. The employee was caught between the piece of equipment, injuring his shoulder and neck. He was hospitalized.
An employee was observing equipment being offloaded when a piece of wood bounced out and hit his thumb, amputating the tip.
An employee was attempting to cut a zip tie from a fence post with a knife. The knife slipped and struck the employee's left forearm, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating an overhead hoist using "J" hooks when his left middle fingertip was pinched between a shaft and a "J" hook. He suffered a partial amputation of his left middle fingertip and a possible fracture of his left ring finger.

An employee was oiling the production line conveyor during routine preventative maintenance when a rag he was using was pulled into the conveyor along with his left middle finger, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee was putting product away in the warehouse using a pallet jack when he lost control of the pallet jack and dismounted. His right leg collided with the pallet jack, fracturing his fibula.
An employee was coming out of a mushroom barn when a small fan's (used for circulation) cover fell off and landed on his head, cutting it open. He was hospitalized and required staples.
An employee was loading an asphalt kettle when the asphalt splashed on and burned his hands, face, and chest.

An employee was talking to a coworker on the west side of the drive aisle. After finishing the conversation, the employee crossed back over to the east side of the drive aisle and was struck by a fork truck driving forward with a single material container. The employee was knocked to the ground and was struck a second time when the material container slid off the forks. The employee suffered a right thumb fracture, right tibia fracture, and lower leg scratch.
An employee was changing a tire when his finger was caught between the tire and the wheel brake, breaking it.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack and was backing up when his foot contacted a rail. His foot was crushed between the pallet jack and the rail, breaking a bone in his foot and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee fell 5 feet from a ladder while removing plastic from a locomotive engine.

An employee was moving products around for scanning when he slipped and fell off the back of the trailer fracturing the right shoulder.
Sparks from a grinding operation made contact with an open container of flammable liquid, causing it to ignite. Two employees were burned as they attempted to move the container outside.

An employee was adjusting the legs of a floor scale while a coworker lifted the corner of the scale with a pry bar. The pry bar slipped and the floor scale fell and pinched the employee's left index finger, amputating his fingertip.
An employee's left Index finger was caught in a man door, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was removing a beam cross framing when the existing welds connecting the end dam steel to the bridge beams broke free and struck the employee, fracturing his leg, knee, and foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee visually determined that a metal flange on a transfer had become disconnected from a metal plate, allowing a transfer roller to fall. When he touched the flange, the metal plate became loose and smashed his right ring finger between the metal plate and flange. The transfer was locked out at the time.
An employee was cutting insulation with a knife when his hand slipped, cutting and puncturing his upper right forearm. He required surgery.

An employee was operating machinery that re-rolls tire liners. She was observing a liner being wound at the machine and was adjusting the liner when her gloved hand was caught in the winding liner, fracturing her right forearm.
An employee slipped off the second step of a ladder while descending and fell to the ground, fracturing his left hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was holding the corner of a piece of 3/8" steel plate as it was being cut by a shear. The blade failed to cut but caused the plate to tip, applying pressure to the plate corner, which amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was stripping a concrete form in a building basement when he lost his balance and fell approximately 4 feet onto a concrete slab. He was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was walking to the rear of a truck when a piece of equipment slid and struck the employee, breaking the right leg.

An employee was servicing and performing maintenance on a package boiler when energized thermal energy (high temperature water) breached the employee's boots and caused second-degree burns to the right and left feet.

An employee was helping a coworker place a forklift battery into a forklift when the battery fell over on its side and smashed two of the employee's left-hand fingers (3rd and 4th finger) between the battery and the concrete floor.
An employee was standing on a step ladder torqueing a bolt. When the bolt broke loose, he lost his balance and fell to the deck, bruising his side and possibly breaking ribs.
An employee was helping to move a stretch roller with the motor jack. The stretch roller fell over and landed on his right foot/lower leg, breaking three bones.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet while attempting to descend from the top of an office (mezzanine) that is located inside an aircraft hangar. He was hospitalized with two broken wrists.
Two employees were cutting a jumper wire with cutters when their tool made contact with a live line. They were severely electric shocked, suffering second- and third-degree burns.
An employee was using a band saw to cut material when the material kicked back and struck the employee in the chin-jaw area, causing a laceration.
An employee was stepping down from a 12-inch-tall foot stool when he fell and struck the ground, landing on and fracturing his left hip.
On or about September 12, 2016, an employee was loading a trailer. When she stepped down onto the belly on the trailer, she twisted her knee and was hospitalized with extreme pain.
An employee was adjusting a bag of salt while it was held up by a forklift when his left ring finger was pinched between the load and the forks, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was working with a take-up spool on a winch when the employee's fingers were caught in the spool, amputating the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was conducting a basic horsemanship training course when he fell off his horse during a warmup drill, injuring his head and chest.
An employee was unclogging the mixer machine and amputated the right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was on a work platform clearing a product line when he slipped and got his hand caught in a metering valve resulting in the amputation of a finger and thumb.
An employee was repairing a vehicle body by hammering out dents when he smashed his index finger with a manual hammer. The finger was lacerated and infected.
An employee was in training learning to drive a standing reach truck. The employee's left hand was caught against a wall and fractured.

An employee was checking the belt tension and adjusting the motor bracket on a conveyor when his glove was caught in the belt. The pulley then pinched and amputated his left-hand index finger. The belt guard was removed at the time.
An employee was connecting the top half of a meter to a pole when a tool he was using contacted the neutral wire, causing an arc flash that burned his face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a machine when it was activated via the foot pedal and amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was using a date stamper on boxes when her left index finger was caught in the date stamper mechanism, amputating her fingertip.

An employee was clearing the large coffee bean hopper at a height of approximately 35 feet. He lost his balance and fell through the opening for the permanent ladder access. He fell 12 feet to a lower level and broke his right leg, requiring hospitalization. A full guardrail system was in place at the time.
An employee was operating a hydraulic side-mounted lift on a trash truck when his right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was dumping sacks of rice back into the cutback system when stepped into a floor-mounted hopper and made contact with the auger system, amputating his left lower leg.

An employee was descending a stairway while carrying two cardboard boxes in her left hand. She missed the last step above a middle landing and fell onto the landing. Both of her feet were bent backwards, fracturing both ankles and requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a skill saw when the saw kicked back and amputated two fingers.

An employee was cleaning the filling machine and emptying it of liquid. She then attempted to see if there was any remaining liquid. Her left index finger was inside a quarter-sized hole where a piston was when the machine activated, causing the piston to move and amputate approximately 1/8" of her left index fingertip. The machine's air source was connected at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing a steel plate on an inner-bottom using an overhead crane. As the employee lifted the steel plate with the crane, it became wedged between two steel frames. He continued applying lifting force with the crane and the plate sprang loose, striking him the face. He suffered multiple facial injuries, including trauma, a broken nose, an eye socket fracture, and a skull fracture.
On September 13, 2016, an employee was placing concrete when he became ill due to dehydration and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to de-escalate a resident having a mental breakdown. The resident sprayed the entire contents of a fire extinguisher in the basement of the building. The employee inhaled the fire extinguisher contents and experienced breathing distress, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking to the package car to determine how many packages were in the car when she slipped on a walking surface and fell. She tried to catch her fall and her hand went between the tire and the bottom of the car frame, breaking her right arm.

An employee was in an aerial bucket, trimming trees to get to a communication cable. As he moved the bucket, it touched the powerline, resulting in an electrical shock. He suffered severe burns to both arms and was hospitalized.

On or about September 13, 2016, an employee was driving a side-by-side vehicle when the back swerved out and overturned landing on the employee's legs. He suffered a compound fracture and required surgery.

An employee was standing on a 3-foot scaffold platform, screwing sheetrock into the metal studs when he lost his footing and fell off the scaffold. He fell through the open door onto sheetrock that was on the other side. He caught the sheetrock corner on his right side, breaking two ribs.

An employee hopped approximately 4 feet from a loading dock down to the lower level. He stumbled and fell, lacerating his right wrist with a sharp metal object (no-hub coupling) he was holding. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
While troubleshooting electrical problems in the main control panels, an employee made contact with a phase from the bus and was shocked, suffering arm burns.

An employee was pushing a heavy trash bin with a pallet jack when it struck a concrete column, causing the load to shift and crush the employee's finger between 3/4" plywood and the edge of the metal trash bin. His right middle fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee fell while moving boxes and injured his left hip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor when his hand was caught between the conveyor and the sprocket, amputating his left thumb.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when he stepped on an extension cord and lost his balance, falling to the ground and fracturing his right hip.
An employee was standing on a step stool reaching up for equipment when she fell, sustaining head injuries including brain bleeding and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was leaning over to place his cell phone in his pocket. As he tried to steady himself with his right elbow against the hallway wall, he missed the wall and fell backwards onto the floor, breaking his upper thigh/hip area.

An employee cut a hole in the roof to install a vent curb and then fell 15 feet through the hole to the concrete floor below, sustaining leg and pelvic fractures. The hole was uncovered at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating an overhead crane. He was moving the overhead trolley into position over the load by trolleying toward his position. The hook of a rigging chain caught on the flange of an I-beam girder to be moved, knocking the 4,600 lb. girder over onto him. The flange of the girder struck his lower left leg, causing a compound fracture just above the ankle.

An employee was pulling MC cable on a catwalk and had to step over some ductwork when his heel caught some of the ductwork, causing him to trip off the catwalk and fall 15 feet through a ceiling. He broke the femur, scapula, and patella on the left side of his body. There was no railing on the catwalk at the time of the incident.

An employee was being lifted by his co-workers in order to pass tools to the other side of a 10-foot fence. He fell from their hands onto the concrete below, suffering an elbow injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
On or about September 13, 2016, an employee's right hand became caught in a tag line that was attached to the butt of a 40-foot pole. The employee suffered a broken right arm and femur.
An employee unplugged the carding machine and then opened the door to clean out debris. The machine then amputated his right index fingertip. The machine was still in motion at the time.
An employee was walking up the stairs in the stockroom when she lost her balance and fell, suffering a pinched nerve in her foot.
While unloading a trailer by hand an employee suffered a possible heart attack. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee suffered a partial left finger amputation while changing the de-hacking brick machine settings for the next product size that was to be packaged.

On or about September 13, 2016, an employee was operating the small milling machine when his glove snagged on the millings and his hand was caught in the rotating tool at the point of operation. He suffered right-hand fractures and lacerations that required hospitalization.
On 09/13/2016, at 10:30 a.m., an employee was laying brick while standing on a 5-foot scaffold when he stepped back and fell off the scaffold, fracturing his left knee.

An employee was operating the panel roll forming machine and was measuring a piece of panel that had to be cut. As he was running the piece through the machine, his left ring and middle fingers were amputated.

An employee was installing a roller jig section with a chain jack. The employee's hand was on the jig while his other hand reached for the chain jack. The jig shifted and caught his fingers between two pieces of steel.

An employee was cleaning the chain on a motorcycle with a rag when the rag was caught in the chain. The employee's fingers were then pulled into the chain, amputating the right middle and pointer fingertips. The motorcycle wheel was spinning at the time.
An employee was adjusting the extruder machine when the roller caught his glove and hand. The machine was in operation at the time.
An employee slipped from the 3rd rung of a fixed ladder and broke his ankle.
An employee was picking up a pallet behind a swing reach truck when the truck operator backed up and ran over the employee's left foot, fracturing the second, fourth, and fifth metatarsals.
An employee was sliding an industrial ladder off a truck when his left pinky finger was caught between the end of the ladder and his steel-tip boot, amputating his fingertip.
On or about 9/13/2016 at 12:00 pm, an employee was reaching for a sheet pan with cooked bacon when the pan tipped over and grease fell on her, causing first-degree burns to her face and neck.
While retagging furniture in an elevated lift, an employee fell from the lift and hit the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was directing traffic standing next to a slacked cable when a vehicle passing by caught the cable, which hit and threw the employee to the ground. The employee suffered right knee and left hip injuries.

An employee was helping to install a guide wire for a high voltage 7620 volt line. He was holding onto the guide wire at ground level while a coworker in an elevated aerial lift was tightening the guide wire bolt. The coworker came into contact with a live wire bolt, which energized the guide wire that the employee had in his hand. Both of his toes suffered electrical burns, requiring hospitalization. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down a hallway when her sandal caught, causing her to fall. She broke her left kneecap and required surgery.

An employee was finishing her morning medication administration cycle when she was called into an apartment by another worker to help move a resident from her bed to a wheelchair. The resident began to lose her balance, so the employee tried to help her to the ground, suffering acute severe lower back pain with disc protrusion in the process.
An employee was operating a discharge spout with a rotary valve and amputated three fingertips.

On 9/14/16, an employee was transferring cleaning chemical from a 55-gallon drum into a larger tote when the chemical transfer pump blew a hose off the hose bar and sprayed chemicals on the employee's face, arms, and torso. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns.
While stepping down from a 4-foot ladder, an employee missed the last rung and fell, impacting the elbow and requiring surgery.

An employee was removing built-up rubber from the inside of a baling machine. As he was standing on a ladder to reach the top side of the machine, his hand was caught in the cover ram, amputating parts of his left index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was removing a steam connection. The employee removed the fitting and was exposed to steam, suffering burns to the torso, right forearm, and right side of the face. The pressure in the line was not relieved at the time of the incident.
An employee's left ring fingertip was amputated while operating a panel saw.
While carrying a machine with a cutting edge guard, an employee tripped and the guard of the machine crushed the employee's four fingers.

An employee was changing a hydraulic hose on a front end loader when the pressure on the cylinder released, causing it to come down and strike him, pinning and breaking his arm between the frame and the bucket.

An employee was feeding a chipper machine while tied around a rope for fall protection. The rope was pulled by a piece of machinery and gave way, allowing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee fractured both legs and dislocated a thumb.

An employee was cleaning a clogged airlock system that had rotating blades in the airlock. The employee's left index finger made contact with the rotating blade, amputating his fingertip between the top of the finger and the first knuckle/joint.
On or about September 15, 2016, an employee performing flagging duties in a construction zone was struck by a privately owned vehicle, suffering leg fractures.

On or about September 14, 2016, an employee was a passenger in the company shuttle bus, commuting from the employee parking lot to the building. The company shuttle bus quickly braked to avoid another vehicle and the employee slid forward, striking her left abdomen on the seat in front of her.
While descending a top stock cart/ladder, an employee missed the second step from the bottom and fell, suffering a hip fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the mezzanine level while cleaning the dryer hopper. He was using a hose and spraying water into a cleaning port at the top of the hopper. There are moving parts inside the hopper, and it has to be cleaned while the parts are moving. The employee climbed down to ground level at the base of the hopper. There was another port at the base of the hopper, which contained a vane valve on a rotating shaft. The employee's left index finger entered this port, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was standing under an overhead crane performing rigging activities when a guard came loose from the overhead crane and struck the employee in the face and head. The employee was hospitalized with face and skull fractures, as well as a concussion.
An employee was unloading a truck when she slipped and fell into the truck, fracturing her left ankle. She was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a router. When he bent over to look at the router, his hair was caught in the router. The router pulled him in, and his face slammed into an angle iron frame. He suffered head trauma and face lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee working in the kitchen suffered an amputation.

An employee was feeling for a hole that needed to be patched on the outside of a corn leg's steel housing, which was leaking grain. The employee's left index finger entered the leg and was amputated above the first knuckle. The corn leg was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was loading a cow into a chute when the cow raised her head and smashed the employee's right hand next to the chute, amputating her pinky finger to the first joint.
While using a pallet jack to move stock, an employee blacked out and hit their head on concrete, suffering a concussion.
An employee was using the band saw when his left hand slipped into the blade, cutting a finger. His finger had to be partially amputated.

An employee was going to install concrete forms on the range in the air force base. While he was putting a piece of plastic into the concrete form, his right-hand middle finger was bitten by a snake. He was hospitalized overnight.
On 09/14/2016, an employee was lifting one side of a sheet pile when he lost his footing and the sheet pile fell on his right leg above the ankle, breaking his lower leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a compound fracture to the lower right leg while training on a powered pallet jack.
An employee was working from an 8-foot ladder when he lost his balance and fell onto an arcade machine, breaking multiple ribs.
On or about September 14, 2016, an employee was bitten on the left bicep by a K-9 while conducting training.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal on an ironworker machine when his right index finger contacted the underside of the metal piece, amputating the skin from the bottom of his finger.
While walking to a home to provide services to a patient, an employee tripped on an uneven surface and fell to the ground, breaking the left patella.
An employee tripped and fell down four steps to the ground, lacerating her head.

An employee was picking product from the dock and moving it to the storage area using a forklift. The employee's lower left leg was then caught between a support column and the forklift, crushing and fracturing it and causing blood loss.
An employee tripped on a rug and fell, suffering a possible knee fracture.
An employee was sizing a 15" piece of reinforced concrete pipe with a cut off saw when the saw kicked back, striking and lacerating the employee's upper left arm. The employee was hospitalized.

On or about September 14, 2016, an employee shut down his drop ball crane and exited the cab when he heard a noise from the engine compartment. As he inspected the engine, the coolant line broke/displaced, spraying hot fluid on him. He suffered burns, requiring hospitalization.
After returning to the warehouse, an employee felt overheated and began cramping due to dehydration. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was descending an escape trunk when he stepped onto a wood platform. The platform shifted, causing it and the employee to fall 36 feet. He suffered an arm laceration, fractured hip, and fractured foot.

On or about September 14, 2016, an employee was working at the base of a shaft. At the same time, an overhead crane had hoisted a filled concrete bucket over the shaft. As the bucket crossed over the shaft, the bucket opened and spilled concrete onto the employee below. The employee suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was struck by a forklift while returning to his forklift, breaking his right lower leg and ankle. He required surgery.
An employee was accidently shot by a resident cleaning their gun.

On 9/15/16, an employee was injured and hospitalized when the employee fell off a joist and a steel beam fell on him as he landed one floor below. The employee sustained a torn kidney and liver and fractured ribs and a knee.

The employee was operating a hydraulic torqueing machine, completing a torque sequence on a 16" discharge valve. He was using both hands to pick up and position the hydraulic torqueing machine wrench head onto the bolt. The employee had been working with a coworker who was operating the remote controller of the hydraulic torque wrench head. The coworker then activated the wrench head, which was set at 2800 psi and amputated the right index fingertip of the injured employee.
An employee was walking alongside a skid steer that was in operation when he tripped and his left leg was caught in the skid steer track. He sustained a fractured left femur.
An employee was operating a string trimmer during landscaping duties when he became dizzy. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was unjamming a machine when the scrap knives struck the employee's right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.

A worker opened a valve that allowed monoisopropylamine to enter an empty tank. Vapors from the monoisopropylamine entered the shop environment and migrated to a neighboring area where an employee had a serious reaction and experienced respiratory distress. She was hospitalized.
An employee was webbing up a press when his finger was caught in the press, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was attempting to disconnect electrical service at a residence when a dog attacked the employee. The employee suffered puncture wounds on the left forearm, a crushed right index fingertip (bone), and tissue and nail bed damage (pulled off bone but not completely torn).
An employee was hooking a dumpster up to a truck when his thumb was caught in a pinch point, breaking his distal phalange joint.
An employee was removing a ball from the throat on a machine when his right index fingertip was amputated in a pinch point.
An employee was re-threading a portion of the re-winder machine when his left middle finger became caught in the machine, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was operating a walkie rider machine. When he hit the throttle (accelerator), the machine jumped back and pinched him against a concrete wall, fracturing and lacerating his right foot, right ankle, and chin. He was hospitalized.
An employee was calibrating equipment when his fingers were caught in the rollers. He sustained broken left-hand fingers and was hospitalized.

An employee was beginning to install a thermocouple. He pulled out a plug and discovered it was not connected to a thermowell, but was plugged directly into the asphalt storage tank. When the plug was removed, 295  F asphalt splashed out of the tank and onto his hands, upper chest, and neck. He received second degree, partial thickness burns.

An employee was charging a rack through a produce case on the sales floor. He had the Schrader core removed from the access fitting where his hose was hooked up. Upon completion, the case went into a time-off defrost, which fills the evaporator with liquid Freon. 

When he disconnected his hose liquid Freon started to spray out of the fitting. As he tried to reconnect his hose, the Freon burned his right hand and forearm and his left hand and part of his left forearm.
An employee's finger was caught in a pinch point, amputating his right middle fingertip.

An employee was putting rivets on the nose of a trailer while working from a platform. The work platform is approximately 36 inches wide, 6 feet long, 36 inches off the ground, with two steps to access. He was stepping down from the platform when he lost his balance and fell backwards, breaking his legs between the ankle and knee.
An employee was injured when a fork truck backed into him, pinning him against a stand-up desk and crushing his abdomen. He was hospitalized.

An employee and coworkers were using machetes to cut overgrown brush and grass to create a clear path to use surveying equipment. A coworker's machete struck the left hand of the employee, amputating the employee's left index finger.
An employee's right index fingertip was pinched by a hydraulic cylinder and amputated while performing maintenance work on a press.
Employees were erecting an I-beam 10 to 12 feet overhead when the I-beam  fell on the back of an employee below, injuring his shoulder and knee. He required surgery.
An employee sustained an amputation to his index finger while using a metal lathe.
An employee was trying to remove a cord from a hatch when it closed on his right pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was working from a cable tray 15 feet above the ground. The employee was utilizing a fall protection harness in conjunction with a PFAS. As he tried to move from one location to another, he fell to the floor, shattering his right heel and fracturing his left ankle. His lanyard was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was setting aluminum shoring for excavation using a hydraulic shoring machine when his finger was pinched inside the shoring. His right-hand middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to remove a molded 27.5-inch rubber part from the mold using an overhead crane and a push-out barrel. When he raised the part and the core mold with the crane, he reached up under the part to apply more 4x4 wooden blocks. The part then slipped off the core, pinning his right arm between the part and the push-out barrel. He suffered a broken arm and hand, as well as a forearm burn, and required surgery.

An employee was setting up the electronic fuse on a non-lethal sting ball grenade. An electronic fuse is placed in the grenade and electrical wires are set up on the electronic fuse. The grenade went off as it was being set up for the test. The employee suffered multiple broken bones in his left hand, a laceration to the left hand, and multiple contusions to his stomach and chest.

While walking through a wooded area to retrieve Frisbees for disc golf, an employee stepped on some uneven ground and rolled an ankle.  The employee sustained a broken and dislocated left ankle, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving an aerial articulating boom lift when his head brushed against high-power electrical lines. He was shocked several times before falling unconscious to the basket of the lift, suffering second and third degree burns and internal injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an air hose to blow off debris around the forklift radiator. He removed a forklift radiator cap and hot anti-freeze spewed out of the radiator, burning his arms and face.
An employee was removing left bottom roll belts from a pin at the DR machine. The end of the employee's finger was then caught between the pin and a horizontal brace on a hoist.
An employee was staging pallets on an electric power jack when he lost control and ran into a rack, fracturing his foot.
While loading shingles on a mobile conveyor, an employee became overheated and experienced heat stress.

An employee was using an air nozzle inside a machine to blow dust off internal parts when his right hand was caught in the rotating spindle inside the machine, smashing the index, middle, and ring fingers on his right hand. The machine's guard door was removed at the time of the incident.

An employee was setting up tire force testing machines and changing out rims to fit the size of the tire being tested. He was mounting the bottom portion of a rim. During the mounting, the cylinder is lifted up to ensure the machine lines up properly. The rim he was mounting was off center. When he lowered the cylinder, the rim fell on his index and middle fingers. His index finger was fractured and his middle finger sustained a deep laceration between the hand and first knuckle. His finger had to be surgically amputated.

On or about September 15, 2016, an employee was driving a stand-up forklift in reverse from the back of a semi-trailer after setting down a load. A second stand-up forklift was also backing up and the two forklifts collided. The elevated forks of the second forklift struck the left foot of the employee controlling the first forklift. The employee suffered three broken toes, requiring surgical removal of the fourth toe, as well as a cut (left foot).
An employee fell off a ladder and fractured the T-12 vertebrae.
A temporary employee was cleaning out a running saw and amputated the right pinky finger.
An employee was using a table saw and cut the tip of his finger.
An employee was walking back to his truck when he tripped and fell to the ground, suffering chest contusions and an internal injury.
An employee was attempting to install a belt on a pulley system on a PVC mixer machine when his finger was caught between the pulley and the belt, amputating his pinky finger above the fingernail.

On or about September 16, 2016, at 1:45 AM, an employee walked outside to speak with a driver at the gate. The employee tripped over a cinder block and fell to the ground, suffering a shattered bone between the left shoulder and elbow.

An employee was attaching base timber to a green house structure. The employee was drilling holes in the lumber with a power drill when the drill bit caught the aligning string. The string subsequently wrapped around the end of the employee's left middle finger and amputated the fingertip.

A temporary employee was working from a 10-foot ladder and cutting ductwork from the ceiling when the ductwork fell and undercut the ladder. The employee fell and struck their head on the concrete floor, suffering severe cranial/brain injuries.
An employee suffered an avulsion trauma injury to the left ring finger while testing/repairing an avionics cooling fan. The fan guard was removed at the time of the incident.

On September 16, 2016, an employee was attempting to remove a rock from a running conveyor belt. When the employee attempted to retrieve the rock, the conveyor grabbed his glove and pulled his arm into the drive pulley assembly. His right arm was crushed and had to be surgically amputated.
On or about September 16, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after tripping over a pallet and suffering a broken hip.

An employee was installing fiber cable optic in an apartment complex building. The employee stepped out to the hallway on the second floor and leaned against an unsecured railing, falling approximately 9 feet to the ground below and fracturing the pelvic bone.
An employee was loading concrete forms when they collapsed and partially crushed the employee, who suffered a broken hip and leg.
An employee was setting up the bagged milk production line when a clamp activated and caught his fingertip, amputating the finger tissue.
An employee was on a ladder cleaning out a compactor chute when he fell from the ladder and broke his leg.
An employee was caught between a utility pole and a truck, fracturing a leg.

On or about 9/16/2016, an employee was performing demolition work by cutting away metal ducts when suddenly the duct fell to where the employee was on a 12-foot ladder, knocking the employee to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a tailbone.

On September 16, 2016, around 6:00 p.m., an employee was moving away from an area where she had been adjusting a rail to align boxes to the box stop air cylinder when the actuating cylinder of the conveyor belt pinched her left middle finger. Her fingertip was amputated.
An employee was bitten by a dog while delivering a pizza. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.

An employee was sorting cauliflower on a machine when it became jammed. While trying to remove the jam, the employee's glove became caught in the feed belt and the employee's left index finger came in contact with the blades, partially amputating it.
An employee suffered a left middle finger amputation while clearing a jam at the seed wheel of the packet filling station. The machine was not shut off and locked out at the time.

An employee was attempting to set up a dryer system to dry peanuts before shipment to a processing facility. The employee's right hand went through the grating of the face of the dryer and the fan blades amputated three fingers. The dryer was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking on a wet cement sidewalk from the hall gate to the clinic about 50 yards away when he lost footing, fell in front of the maintenance building, and fractured his right femur.

An employee was ordering food at a drive-through when a client that accompanied the employee in the car became violent and attacked the employee. The incident resulted in an automobile accident in which the employee sustained an injury.
An employee was replacing a motor when an asphalt plant component fell and hit the lift platform, knocking the employee to the ground. He suffered a back vertebrae injury.

An employee was tightening the bolts on a billboard when the weld of the catwalk arm broke, swung down with him on it, and hit his ankle on the billboard column, fracturing his right ankle. He fell 20 feet from the catwalk and was hanging by his fall protection lanyard about 9 feet above the ground when he was rescued by his foreman. He was hospitalized.

An employee was getting equipment ready to head out to the field while a second employee brought a gun to the office to have a third employee look at it.  While the two employees were looking at the gun to correct a malfunction, it went off and shot the employee preparing equipment. The employee was struck in the lower back, hitting the pelvic bone, stomach and large intestine.
An employee was unloading poles and was pinned to the ground when a pole rolled off of the fork truck, suffering a right leg injury.
An employee was clearing a jam on an energized packaging machine and amputated the end of the right thumb.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. While backing up, his left foot was caught between a wall and the lift, breaking his left leg.
An employee was exiting a truck when he missed a step and fell to the ground. His elbow hit the ground and broke, requiring hospitalization.
On September 17, 2016, while operating a chamfering machine, an employee's third left finger was amputated in the machine's point of operation. The machine's safety buttons were bypassed at the time.
An employee was walking toward the prep sink in the deli area when she turned around and slipped and fell. She landed on her right leg and fractured her upper femur, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a bender machine to bend 4x45x36 conduit elbows. As he went to remove an elbow from the bender, the bender's rear clamp closed, pinching and amputated fingers on his right hand.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor motor chain with a rag and oil when the towel he was using to wipe off excess oil was caught in the chain, along with his hand. Two of his fingers were smashed, and his right thumb tip was partially amputated. The chain was moving and the guard was removed at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a vertical belt sander to deburr a piece of metal. The metal became caught between the sanding belt and a tool rest, which pulled his thumb into the belt behind the tool rest and amputated his left thumb tip. The sander was guarded at the time.

An employee was walking a dog from the back kennel area to the bathing area when the dog suddenly started to run causing the employee to trip on a mat and fall. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip and injuries to the knee and neck.
An employee was bitten by a dog while delivering mail, suffering a puncture wound to the left calf that required surgery.
An employee was walking through the warehouse when he tripped on the tine of a cart dumper, falling to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.

An employee exited the poultry building to take a water break. The employee mistakenly ingested diluted Virocid thinking it was water, suffering stomach pain and vomiting that required hospitalization.
While replacing some broken parts on top of an auger, an employee slipped and fell approximately 59 inches to the concrete below, breaking four vertebrae and two ribs.
An employee was removing the cutting wheel from the impact buffer when the impact buffer engaged, cutting his left index finger's tendon below the knuckle. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was moving a forklift mounting plate from a shelf onto a pallet. The pallet was lifted on a forklift and the mounting plates were slid from a 3.5-feet-tall shelf to the pallet. The plates have a notch in them, and while the employee was guiding the second plate onto the pallet, his right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee had an allergic/asthmatic reaction to cologne/body spray and a flower on a desk. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was guiding a vehicle into the bay. The coworker driving the vehicle was unfamiliar with it and accidentally hit the gas instead of the brake, pinning the employee between vehicles. The employee suffered a right leg injury.
An employee was flipping the mold tool on a press to strip parts when the press ram came down and crushed his left thumb.

On or about September 17, 2016, an employee was stepping on the tongue of a trailer to gain access to a parade float on the trailer when the tow vehicle accelerated and the employee fell to the pavement, striking their head, left hip, and right side of the back. After the employee fell to the ground, the tow vehicle continued to move forward and the trailer's tires grazed the employee's left leg.
An employee was digging an excavation when the excavation collapsed on the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was moving items from one vehicle to another and stepped into a hole and fractured their lower leg.
An employee fell to the floor while helping an inpatient get into a bed, injuring a knee and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing a pipe, which was about 1 foot above the ground, when the pipe fell on the employee's right foot and broke toes.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, suffering a back injury.
While installing a press mold, an employee's wrench slipped, causing the employee to fall backward to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was working around a chain lift hoist that held a propeller when a link in the chain failed. The employee was then pinned between the propeller and nozzle, suffering internal injuries and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to reach a product further back on a shelf when she slipped and fell, fracturing her hip.

An employee had a small grease fire on his equipment. As he grabbed the fire extinguisher and handed it down to a coworker, he lost his footing and fell down, fracturing his right leg beneath the knee.

An employee was using a forklift to lift and empty a dumpster when he attempted to push the dumpster at the same time that the forklift tines were activated/lifted. His left pinky finger was pinched between the forklift tine and dumpster, amputating his fingertip and requiring hospitalization.
While operating a hydraulic torque wrench, an employee dropped the remote, which activated the torque wrench. The wrench then struck the employee's right hand, fracturing the index finger.

An employee was hanging a new drop to the mock house. She had already cut the old drop and was addressing the tap to connect the new drop to it. She shifted her weight and leaned to the left. When her weight shifted, the safety hook on the right side of her safety strap shifted and came off the D-ring. She fell approximately 18 feet from the ladder and landed on her right side, fracturing both arms.

An employee was removing clevises from under a blowout preventer (BOP). The employee retrieved the first clevis, but the second clevis was trapped underneath one of the BOPs. He lifted the BOP up and stuck the first clevis underneath to support the BOP's weight (this allowed him to retrieve the second clevis). When he attempted to lift the BOP back up to remove the first clevis, the BOP slipped and fell. His right index fingertip was caught/pinched between the two BOPs, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while sliding trailer tandems on the side of the road, requiring hospitalization.
Workers were installing a heat exchanger when it fell, striking and fracturing an employee's ankle.
An employee was injured while trying to clear a jam on an injection molding machine.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut a zip tie that was securing a reel of flexible hose when the knife lacerated his left leg.
An employee was changing a light bulb on a rig unit when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below, breaking four ribs on his right side and suffering a lung contusion.
An employee slipped while throwing debris into a dumpster, causing the employee to collide with the dumpster and suffer broken ribs upon impact.
An employee finished work at the end of the day  and as he was walking to his truck he began vomiting and feeling light headed possibly due to heat stress.
An employee was on the back of the paver operating the screed when he started to feel unwell and experienced muscle cramps. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee fell from a stepladder after losing his balance while performing needle gun operations, suffering a contusion and a possible fracture to the right hip.
An employee was changing bags in a bag house with three coworkers when his left hand entered a rotary air mover, partially amputating three fingers.

On September 19, 2016, an employee was sliding a ductwork transition across the ground and tripped over a 4-inch step. The employee fell to the ground and the flange on the ductwork amputated the employee's fingertip.

A crane operator was lowering material and an employee went to remove the hook from the material when the crane moved, causing the chain to tighten and pinch the employee's right index finger between the hook and material. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was feeding the prefeeder when he stepped in a hole that was created by a missing roller. He suffered a swollen knee and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was running a punch press when the punch press tripped, amputating his left-hand at the wrist.

An employee was driving back to the rig from the water well and ran over a rattlesnake. He got out of his vehicle and walked to the rattlesnake, which bit his right middle finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting a forklift operator with loading beams when the operator drove over the employee's left foot, fracturing it.
An employee was inspecting a high-pressure hydraulic hose that had a pinhole leak when it injected hydraulic fluid into the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was loading wood onto a stack when lumber fell off the stack and struck his right leg, fracturing his femur.

On Monday, September 19, 2016, at approximately 7:25 AM, an employee was setting up a core box at the beginning of work when he passed out and fell backwards striking his head on some metal saw horses. He sustained a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was stacking wrapped chicken tender packages when he noticed chicken tenders that had become lodged in the edge sealer of the packaging machine and attempted to remove them. At that point, the machine activated and the blade of the edge sealer impacted and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was attempting to adjust the spacers in a machine when a coworker started it. The machine cycled, causing the employee's arm to become caught in the die boxes. The employee sustained a left arm fracture.
An employee was getting ready to start the kettle motor on the tar kettle. The pipe was not hooked up yet, causing hot tar to burn his face, neck, and arms.
An employee experienced an acute kidney injury due to severe dehydration while servicing and testing steam valves.
An employee experienced heat stress while sorting packages, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was engaged in a physical emergency safety intervention with a student while leaning against a free-standing table in the classroom. The student was struggling, causing the table to slide. The employee fell backwards on the floor, suffering a cervical spine sprain.

An employee was operating a drill machine and cleaning the debris around it. As the drill bit was automatically pulling out of the drilled hole, the bit caught the employee's sleeve and pulled in the employee's right forearm, lacerating it.

After repairing a diesel truck, an employee climbed off the truck and stepped on the battery box. The lid on the battery box was unsecured, causing the employee to fall 2 to 3 feet onto the concrete floor below. He also struck the battery box during the fall. He fractured several vertebrae and a left rib.

An employee was standing on a transloader conveyor belt. He was in a crouched position attempting to remove a vibrator from the rail car. A coworker was with him, and as he was pushing the lever to turn off the vibrator, his hand hit the lever to engage the conveyor belt. The employee was spun around and caught under the guard and belt, breaking his left leg.
An employee was conducting repairs on the bender machine when his right hand was caught in the machine, amputating his index, middle, and ring fingertips.

An employee was leaving a work station in a processing area and was backing up when her heel was caught on the edge of a wood pallet. She lost her balance, tripped, and fell.  While trying to catch herself with her left hand, she broke her left forearm in five places, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee lost his footing while descending a fixed cage ladder and fell 10 feet, fracturing both ankles.
An employee was on a jammed conveyor line, attempting to clear a carton jam. His foot slipped on the rollers and he rolled his right ankle, fracturing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when the saw amputated two fingers and damaged two others on his left hand.
An employee was outside of a grain elevator watching the auger operation. When he entered the grain elevator, his left leg was caught and amputated in a running auger.

An employee was repairing wooden pallets and placing the chain back on the sprocket when his left hand became stuck between the moving chain and sprocket, crushing and severely lacerating multiple fingers on his left hand.
On or about September 19, 2016, an employee was installing rack systems. As he was loosening a rack from a bundle, it fell on him, dislocating his ankle and breaking his tibia.
An employee was bending a piece of rebar when the employee's glove was caught between the rebar and the table, causing an amputation without bone loss.
While walking down a steep slope in the woods and crossing a gully on a log, an employee fell and landed on their back, suffering a ruptured spinal column and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell from a step stool while stocking merchandise, fracturing the right knee.
The employee was replacing a bag on the airlock system when the motor started running. The machine's moving parts amputated the employee's right middle finger.
An employee felt overheated while cutting rebar with a saw from approximately 1235 to 1250 hours. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee slipped off a ladder while removing fryer hood vents from housing and the employee's foot/ankle went into the fryer. The employee was hospitalized for burn injuries.
An employee was performing maintenance and changing the belt on a chip transport pump when his left index finger was caught between the belt and pulley, amputating his fingertip below the fingernail.

On September 20, 2016, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee was coring concrete using a drill. His hair somehow became caught in the drill and he suffered damage to his scalp and broke his neck. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee lost his balance and fell from the loading dock, landing on and injuring a second employee standing below. The second employee suffered a broken left tibia, lower back contusions, and a concussion.
An employee experienced heat stress while edging a concrete sidewalk. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee at a utility power pole was moving an insulator cover that was draped over a power wire. He was working from a bucket truck about 30 feet up. When the employee removed the insulator, the insulator cover failed and an arc flash occurred, causing flash burns to the employee's hands. He was hospitalized.

An employee was riding on the forks of a forklift. The forklift tipped over and the employee fell. The employee was then pinned under the forklift and suffered two broken legs. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees installed a new mud press belt. The employees were in the process of installing the mud wash box. In the process of removing the bolts from the bearing pillow block on the redirect roller, the remaining tension on the new belt and residual in air bag belt tensioning system pulled and twisted the redirect roller forward into the water flush line union. The force and motion of the redirect roller bearing pillow block pushed the employee's hand between the adjustable wrench (crescent wrench) and the water flush line union. The employee immediately removed his hand from the leather glove and noticed the pinky finger was smashed and suffered a partial skin amputation.
While attempting to pull a tray out of an egg wash machine, an employee's fingertip was amputated by the machine's conveyor belt.
An employee was at the labeler station located in the conveyor system. His hand was caught between the moving pallet and the reflector of the photo eye sensor, amputating his right index fingertip.
Two employees received second degree burns to the arms, face, and neck while installing a switch on a pole.
An employee suffered heat stress while welding on a roof, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from a baker's scaffold to the floor while blowing in insulation, suffering a broken clavicle and contusions.

An employee was scanning a bundle of steel for inventory on a flatbed railcar. He was turning to step down from the railcar when he lost his footing and fell approximately 3.5 feet to the ground, injuring his shoulder.
An employee was squeegeeing mud when he fainted after experiencing dizziness and leg cramps due to possible dehydration.

An employee was climbing a ladder for pest control inspection when the ladder kicked out at the bottom and the employee fell to the driveway, landing on the wrists and face and suffering multiple fractures.
An employee was trying to troubleshoot a case sealer when his left finger was caught in the belt and pulley drive, amputating his left ring finger.
Two employees who were operating pallet jacks collided with each other. One employee was hospitalized overnight with back pain.
While tripping pipe on a derrick, an employee's left index finger was pinched between a metal beam and a driller collar, amputating the fingertip.
On or about September 20, 2016, an employee was walking behind a forklift when it backed over the employee's right foot, breaking bones and causing lacerations.

An employee banged her knee on a table in a classroom. The employee received a steroid shot due to an inflamed bursa. The employee had a reaction to the steroid shot. The employee was hospitalized to treat her reaction to the steroid shot.

A lead person was adjusting the edge grinder. An employee walked to the back of the machine and placed his hand on the end of an adjustment rod sticking out of a pneumatic cylinder. The lead did not realize the employee's hand was on the rod, so he actuated the machine to test his adjustments. The employee's left index finger was then  pinched and amputated between the cylinder housing and the rod end stop.
An employee fell down 10 stairs sustaining a head injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell six feet from a ladder on a wooden deck and broke his left ankle.
An employee was walking off a ship when he slipped on the accommodation ladder and twisted his left leg. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was stung by bees while servicing a controller panel, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was under the kitchen sink connecting a water line to install a dishwasher when his arm contacted a live 220-volt line, causing an electrical shock and burns to his arms.
An employee went to disconnect a hose for a Q10 pump when a coworker opened a discharge valve, causing the pressurized hose to strike and fracture the employee's ankle.
An employee's finger was smashed between a winch line and the tailboard of the winch truck.
An employee was working in a field environment and stepped near a hole where a rattlesnake contacted the employee on the lower leg.
An employee was attempting to cut a piece of trim (wood) with a battery-powered circular saw when his index fingertip was amputated.
An employee broke a hand while working with a ladder.

An employee was trimming a bush with a hedge trimmer when the trimmer became caught up on a bush and kicked back onto the employee. He covered his face with his right hand and his index finger was fractured.

An employee on a second-level platform was opening a slide gate at a height of approximately 14 feet to place a pallet on the deck. The slide gate was 4 ft H x 12 ft W on the exterior wall, attached by a sliding mechanism.
