The employee fell to the ground along with the gate, suffering multiple fractures to the femur, pelvis, ribs, right leg, and arm.

An employee was climbing onto a roof from the ladder. His foot slipped on the granules from the roof shingles and he fell 10 feet. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured L4 vertebrae and a torn ACL.
An employee was working on the floor of a rig when a hinge pin became unlatched on the tubing that held the rig elevator. The tubing struck the employee, breaking the collarbone on the right side.

An employee was walking away from the tank that feeds the cleaning lines with a water and caustic solution. The vent from the tank blew off and splashed the employee with the solution. The employee suffered burns on the face, back, legs, arms, and stomach.

An employee was drawing and smelting a pot for casting lead when he became dehydrated and experienced nausea, weakness, and lightheadedness. He was hospitalized for heat stress/exhaustion and dehydration.

While walking to the trash hopper, an employee stepped over a permanent pipe running along the ground. The employee's foot became caught on the pipe, and the employee stumbled and contacted the trash hopper support frame, breaking the left arm and requiring surgery.
An employee was working inside the upper level of the storage warehouse and began experiencing muscle cramps due to heat stress while changing rollers on a conveyor belt.
An employee was kicked in the face by a cow while milking.

On September 21, 2016, around 3:30 a.m., an employee was changing out a 1,400-pound seal-in roller with a hoist when the roller rolled on to his left thumb tip. The thumb tip had to be surgically amputated.

After filling up the milk tanker truck, the employee was closing the plunger valve by hand. The employee's finger was over the edge of the flange, and when the valve was sucked in it amputated the right middle fingertip.
An employee began experiencing dizziness, nausea, and cramping after returning to the office from a roofing jobsite. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee lost his grip and fell 6 feet off a fixed ladder, breaking his right ankle.
On September 21, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after receiving burn injuries while operating a tempering/polishing machine.
An employee was carrying a bucket of hot asphalt when he tripped. The hot asphalt splashed on and burned his face, requiring hospitalization.

On September 21, 2016, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee and two coworkers were conducting routine checks on the plating line when a piece of debris was noted riding on top of the running strip line/plating solution. The employee attempted to remove the debris from the running strip line with a 12-inch spud wrench when his right hand was pulled into the rotating plating rolls, amputating his index finger, breaking his ring finger, and causing an abrasion to his hand.

An employee was bending over to pick up a 10-foot stick of 3/4" electrical metallic tube (EMT) when he felt and heard a pop in his back and experienced a sharp lower back pain. He was hospitalized with a compressed back disc.
A driver was attempting to access the dock door on a loading dock, fell off the dock, and fractured their right leg.
On or about September 21, 2016, at 8:30 a.m., an employee fell while manually mopping a bathroom floor, fracturing the right leg or ankle.

On September 21, 2016, an employee was on a vertical ladder checking the level of waste in a dumpster when a delivery truck struck and pinned the employee between the truck and the dumpster. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg, a collapsed lung and liver damage.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and walked to the front of the equipment to select product for an order when he stumbled and pressed the controls. The jack moved forward and caught his right ankle between the pallet jack and another one directly in front of him. He suffered multiple fractures to his ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was drilling a hole through an overhead bar joist. The bit broke suddenly and the employee lost control of the hand-held drill. The unused portion of the drill bit went around his safety glasses and penetrated the eye.
An employee's right thumb was caught in a chain and sprocket while removing fiber from an idler, amputating the thumb tip at the nail. The idler was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was standing on a ladder when he lost his balance and fell, fracturing his leg.

An employee was helping to install an 8-inch water line, working approximately 4-feet, 8-inches deep, when the dirt underneath the concrete of the street gave way and hit the employee on the right-side hip/pelvis.
An employee fell from a roof at a jobsite and was hospitalized.
An employee was securing a large box to his assigned fork truck when a delivery truck driver backed his truck into the employee.
While installing and uninstalling metal racks, an employee was injured by a metal band that snapped and struck him in the eye, puncturing his right pupil. Eye protection was not worn at the time.
An employee slipped while inspecting the pre-chiller rocker drive. When he tried to catch himself, his right index finger was caught and amputated in a moving belt.
An employee was walking between jobs when his right leg was caught between a conveyor and a paint skid, lacerating it.
An employee was pushing a piece of wood through a saw blade when the wood kicked back and the employee's hand slipped forward into the blade, lacerating the right pinky finger.

On September 21, 2016, around 12:45 p.m., an employee was helping to adjust the tracking of a conveyor belt when a moving part caught his glove and pulled his right hand and forearm into the belt/roller, resulting in a right arm fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing old power lines with another employee. The power line tilted and struck the employee's left leg.
An employee was changing a belt on equipment using a bar and got a finger caught between the belt and pulley amputating the fingertip.
An employee was operating a truck wash rack and was pinned between a parked truck and the machine resulting in broken bones.

Employees were loading I-beams onto a flatbed truck with an excavator. The last beam of the load was just set and secured in place when the crew removed the rigging from the I-beam. The excavator then turned away from the truck. A piece of the rigging was unintentionally caught on a piece of the I-beam, causing the beam to slide off the truck. The I-beam hit an employee's arm and leg.

An employee was operating a backhoe, shoveling milling material off the road, when the shovel became caught on a manhole road protrusion. This contact jarred the backhoe and the employee with great force, causing a liver injury where the seat belt connection contacted the employee near the right abdominal area.

An employee was attempting to hook a trailer to the hitch of a customer's vehicle. The customer was backing up and hit the gas pedal while in reverse, pinning the employee between the vehicle and the trailer. The employee suffered severe leg contusions and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was performing aircraft support operations and was walking toward an air pad when he tripped on a mooring chain and fell on the concrete air pad, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was standing on the floor next to a pallet jack. When the employee engaged the pallet jack throttle, the jack moved and the employee was caught between the pallet jack and the rack, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was performing pre-fabrication operations for a jointing wood process when his right middle finger was crushed and partially amputated between two beams he was aligning.

An employee was helping to load a barrier rail clamp onto a lowboy trailer. When the clamp was over the correct stop on the trailer, he directed the operator to lower the clamp. His left hand was resting on the clamp. As the clamp settled on the trailer, it closed enough to catch and amputate his left ring fingertip.

On or about September 22, 2016, an employee was performing maintenance on a converting machine that makes corrugated boxes when the hinged door swung shut, partially amputating his right ring finger to the distal knuckle.

An employee was helping a coworker empty trash carts into a dumpster. They were lifting the trash cart manually from a loading dock. The trash cart slipped and caught the employee's left middle finger between the trash cart metal frame and the trash cart, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was pressure washing pipes with a steam cleaner when the steam hose became disconnected from the cleaner and whipped around, striking the employee in the leg and fracturing the tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

On or about on September 22, 2016, an employee was installing compensation rope to elevator counter weights when a cinderblock brick fell down the 180' elevator hoist way and hit the employee in the head. The employee suffered a broken neck, concussion, and lacerations.

An employee was standing by his service vehicle in the parking lot area when a tow truck backed up and struck him. He was pinned between his service vehicle and the vehicle being towed, breaking his pelvis and requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a pultrusion flat sheet press. When the employee tried to retrieve an item in the press, his left arm was caught by the traveling puller as it attempted to return to the home position causing a crushing injury to the arm.
Am employee was climbing a ladder on a tanker truck when he fell to the ground and injured his back, neck, shoulder, and head.

An employee was assisting a rigger and a crane operator with guiding a furnace tube through the opening of a furnace when the employee's finger was caught between the 90-degree point of the furnace opening and a furnace tube. The right-hand index finger was partially amputated, requiring surgery.

An employee was helping unload a semi truck from behind the semi. As he opened the doors of the semi, the semi backed up which startled the employee. He started feeling chest pains and went to his manager's office to explain he wasn't feeling well. The employee was hospitalized where it was determined that the employee had a minor stroke.
An employee was using a rubber tub to pour water out of a double hung window when the top section of the window slipped and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
A temporary employee was lining up a concrete form during a changeover. His left middle finger was in a bolt hole when the concrete form slid into position and amputated his fingertip.
While working on the enrobe line, an employee's left pointer finger was amputated up to the first knuckle by an agitator arm.

On 9/22/2016, an employee was pulling a skid (hand jack) with product on it from a side aisle to the main aisle when he was struck by a passing forklift, injuring his right leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped off a forklift onto a 4x4 wood block used for spacing trusses, which rolled his ankle and cracked the base of the tibia on his right foot. He was hospitalized for surgery.
While at the truck washing station, an employee was pinned between a mobile truck and a parked vehicle, breaking pelvic bones.
An employee collapsed, hit their head on the ground, and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

The employee was in the process of changing a tire on a trailer on a highway. One of the jacks slipped off from under the trailer, causing the tire assembly to drop and strike the employee's right leg.

An employee in an aerial lift was installing overhead solar panels on a new steel structure when he was crushed between the rail of the aerial lift basket and the steel I-beam he was working on. He suffered a crushed sternum and broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing a vapor barrier to the outside of a new home while working from an extension ladder when he lost his balance and fell 6 to 8 feet to the ground, breaking his pelvis.

An employee was performing a vacuum procedure on a bulk 30,000-gallon propane tank. He was using an air compressor to blow air into the base of the container to create a tornado effect that subsequently vacuums the propane from the tank. 
A tool ignition source ignited the flammable gas, burning legs and face of the employee, who was 18 to 36 feet away from the opening.

An employee walked to the rear of a trailer that was loaded with steel purlins. He began removing straps from the stored purlins and turned around, making contact with the edge of a purlin, which lacerated his right eye.

An employee entered a basket/cage that was on a forklift to secure a load to a trailer. The forklift operator lifted the employee in the basket to the top of the load. The basket became hung up on the load, so the forklift operator backed up the forklift, which caused the employee and the basket to drop to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured face, requiring stitches, and a fractured right wrist.
An employee was disconnecting a dolly from a trailer when the dolly kicked up and smashed the employee's right thumb.

An employee was unloading utility poles from a trailer using a self-unloading boom. As the employee swung the pole to the left, the pole slipped out of the grapple and struck the employee's right hip area, fracturing it.
An employee slipped and fell while walking in the call center. The employee landed on her right knee, fracturing it.
An employee on stilts slipped on plastic while installing insulation in a building and fell, tearing a knee tendon and requiring hospitalization.

Employees were cleaning a tank of Green Liquor with a fire hose. They started from outside the tank and were washing the chemicals toward the drain with a high volume of water. The Green Liquor was around the drain when two of the employees entered the tank. They were wearing chemical protective suits with knee high boots that were taped around the top. As the employees moved toward the drain, the Green Liquor flowed around behind them and rose above their boots. The Green Liquor seeped through the tape and burned the employees' legs. One employee did not require medical treatment. The second employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while walking to the building, breaking her right arm.

An employee was hauling sand in a dump truck. He dumped the truck load of sand and was attempting to close the tailgate on the back of the truck. The tailgate failed to close completely. The employee attempted to pull the tailgate away from the vehicle to create momentum from the swing to close it. His hand was positioned on the bottom of the tailgate and as it swung toward the truck, it created a pinch point. His left hand was pinched between the tailgate and the vehicle frame, causing fractures, cuts, and bruising to the fingers.

An employee was pumping oil into a production line via a hot oil truck. Oil began to spray out of the pipe and ignited the burner. The ensuing fire engulfed the employee's upper body and he received third degree burns, requiring hospitalization and surgery. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping a coworker transport a box sofa to a customer's car with a four-wheel dolly when he tripped on the dolly wheel and fell to the parking lot surface. He injured the left side of his body and suffered a bulging lumbar disc, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was picking plastic parts off a machine. When he attempted to dislodge a part that was caught in the machine, the machine blade amputated his left middle finger and lacerated his left index and ring fingers. The guard was in place at the time.

On September 22, 2016, an employee was standing on the stairs next to a forklift that was prying solidified metal off a metal casting. The forklift freed the metal and it struck the employee in the chest and face, causing the employee to fall 4 or 5 feet backwards over a guardrail. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was diagnosing equipment that was malfunctioning. He opened an access panel as part of the diagnostic procedure. When he opened the compartment, chemical was released and sprayed into his face, upper body, chest, shoulder area, and back, causing second and third degree chemical burns.

On September 22, 2016, around 12:45 p.m., an employee had an angle grinder under his arm. The grinder was already switched to the "on" setting when he plugged it in, and it severely lacerated his arm. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was climbing down a ladder from a stage and fell fracturing the tibia.
On September 23, 2016, while walking to the restroom, an employee tripped on a guardrail bolt and fell to the ground, fracturing the hip.
On September 23, 2016, an employee slipped and landed on the ground while climbing out of the bed of a service pickup truck, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was struck in the head and feet by a wooden box that fell from a stack that was being lifted by a powered industrial truck. The employee suffered fractures to the left heel and right ankle, as well as being partially scalped.
An employee was using a coin press when it crushed and amputated her middle fingertip. The press guard was in place at the time.
An employee was maintaining an irrigation system and fainted due to heat-related illness.

An employee at a poppet machine had just finished putting a box together, but the box was not spinning correctly. When she opened the interlocked door to balance the box, the chuck pulled in her right glove and then twisted her right index finger, partially amputating it.
An employee was attempting to reach a box of bagels standing on the top of a 2-foot step ladder. The employee fell and fractured the left tibia.

On September 23, 2016, an employee was installing a fire sprinkling system in the attic of an office building when a 110-volt wire hanging down touched his shoulder and shocked him. He was hospitalized.
While an employee was exiting a trailer, the dock plate unexpectedly dropped, hitting and breaking the employee's right leg.
An employee fell 20 to 25 feet while installing decking on the third level of a building, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning off a container when he tripped over an air hose in the dust containment room. He fell and hit his head on a rail, requiring hospitalization for two broken ribs, a back injury, and a cut above his left eye.
An employee bent over to lift up a handle to raise a dolly. When he came back up, he felt a pop in his back. He was hospitalized for a herniated disc in his back.
While moving material out of the way of a boom lift, an employee's left foot was caught between the boom lift tire and the floor, breaking four bones.

On September 23, 2016, an employee was shocked when the boom of a concrete pump truck he was operating came in contact with energized electrical lines. He suffered first and second degree burns to his arms.

An employee was greasing the rollers of the concrete mixing truck when his glove was caught in the pinch point of the moving drum and his fingers were crushed. His right fifth digit was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a food packaging machine when his left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading tools into the trailer when he was bitten by an insect. He was later hospitalized when he had an adverse reaction to the bite.
As an employee exited the heat treat building, his right foot slipped on the edge of the curb/step and he fell. He fractured his tibia and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing material in the bed of a dump truck. While using the access ladder to descend from the dump truck, the employee fell approximately 5 feet, fracturing both wrists and one vertebra. The employee required surgery.
An employee fell from a ladder and struck the ground while painting/staining a log cabin, requiring hospitalization.

An employee's coworker was sawing 1-inch hind shanks, while the employee pulled the product and bagged it after it was cut. A piece of fat was pulled into the saw. When the employee attempted to remove it, her left index finger was amputated just above the second knuckle.
An employee was pushing a wood block along a wood shaper when the blade cut his left forefinger.

An employee grinded a steel pipe that was approximately 24" in diameter x 40' long. An excavator machine with a nylon strap then raised the pipe. One end of the strap was connected to the excavator machine and the other end of the strap was around the pipe. During the pipe raising, one end of the pipe came free and struck the employee's left leg, breaking it below the knee.

An employee was core drilling holes into a set of concrete exterior steps to make sleeves for the handrail. The drill bit became hung up, making the core drill twist and throwing the employee off balance. He fell off the side of the steps and landed on a concrete sidewalk, breaking his left wrist and landing on the side of his head.
On or about September 23, 2016, an employee received an electrical shock from a light circuit while working on an elevator car top box.
An employee was trying to unjam the slide gate on a conveyor when the slide gate contacted and amputated his left middle fingertip. The device was not locked out at the time.
An employee slipped on water that was spilled on the floor and fell, shattering her kneecap.

An employee was operating the T-nut machine. She put a piece of stock in the machine and was going to install a T-nut into the end of the stock. She activated the machine for the T-nut installation, but the T-nut did not go into the stock properly. As she attempted to remove the T-nut from between the stock and the ram, her hand hit the limit switch. The ram then plunged forward, pinching her right middle finger between the ram and stock. Her fingertip was amputated. The guard was in place at the time.

An employee was working with a coworker to clear some scrap paper that was blocking a sensor on the baler and preventing the baler door from closing. The door could only be raised or lowered using the manual controls. While the employee was clearing the scrap paper from the sensor, his coworker activated the controls to lower the door. The door closed on his left hand, causing multiple metacarpal fractures and lacerations.
An employee was stepping off of a shuttle bus and onto the curb. The employee tripped and fell breaking his arm.
An employee was unloading a manual lift from a truck when the lift tilted and fell on top of the employee, breaking the left leg.
While performing regular maintenance, an employee was bitten by a brown recluse spider.
An employee was cutting a whole piece of loin into steaks when the bone of the loin caught the saw blade and drew the employee's left index finger into the blade, amputating it.

An employee was operating the lights for the work area when a drunk driver drove into the work zone, causing an object to strike the employee and ricochet him into a nearby box truck. He was hospitalized with two broken legs, a broken hip, broken ribs, and a concussion.
An employee was entering a restroom when someone came out and hit her with the door. She fell and fractured her shoulder and cheekbone.
An employee slipped and fell down the stairs, fracturing the right arm.
An employee's arm was caught in a construction hoist's counterweight, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was washing windows on a hospital overpass when he was struck by a pick-up truck travelling approximately 55 mph.
An employee tripped over a speed bump in the parking lot and hit her face on the pavement, seriously injuring her face, nose, and arms.
An employee was decontaminating or sanitizing the chiller area with a hose when a sprocket hit his hand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to straighten up a board on the conveyor. As he was attempting to pull the board, his left-hand index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket. He was hospitalized overnight, and his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a golf cart through a gate and used her left arm to push the gate open. Her arm became caught between the golf cart bar and the gate, breaking it.

An employee was underneath the trailer tongue frame of a portable abrasive blasting unit, attempting to straighten a bent pin in the jack stand with a crowbar. As he pried on the pin with the crow bar, the jack fell, pinning him beneath the trailer tongue frame. He punctured his lung and broke five ribs, his sternum, and his left shoulder blade, requiring hospitalization.
On Saturday, September 24, 2016, an employee was using a demo saw (wood saw) to cut wood when the saw kick backed and cut his left arm. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was operating a loader to backfill a trench with sand when the loader turned over and slid into the open trench. The employee's leg contacted the control console of the loader, breaking the fibula and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading refrigerated trailers and pulled down on a refrigerator door. The employee felt chest pains and initially believed he was having a heart attack. The employee was admitted to the hospital where it was later diagnosed to be a strain on his sternum.
An employee was walking with a paint booth blasting gun in his hand and tripped over the hose. The blasting gun caused a deep laceration to the employee's left thigh.
While descending a step ladder, an employee missed a step and fell, suffering a left ankle injury.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when he lost control of the vehicle and jumped from it. The truck severed his lower left leg, which had to be surgically amputated.
On or about September 24, 2016, an employee slipped on a grease spill between the grill line and drink station and suffered a possible broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting an operational problem with a bander when she tripped on a box on the floor and fell. Her hand then entered a moving timing chain and sprocket assembly, partially amputating her right middle fingertip. The machine was energized and the guard was removed at the time.
On or about 9/25/2016, an employee was cutting a squash with a manual vegetable slicer when the slicer amputated part of his nail and his right middle fingertip.
An employee was assisting a coworker with carts. While stepping away, the employee tripped over the coworker's foot and fell on the left side, breaking the left arm and hip.
On September 25, 2016, at 5:00 p.m., an employee was unpacking printer equipment when the corner of the box scraped his right leg just below the knee. He was hospitalized for a possible infection.
An employee bent over to pick up a tourniquet and felt a pop in her back and sharp pain down her left leg.
An employee was going down the stairs when he fell and was found at the bottom floor. He was hospitalized with a hip injury.

While trying to release a jammed piece of tin from a conveyor belt, the employee's foot slipped off the paddle of the conveyor belt and his foot became stuck. When the employee attempted to jerk his foot out, the result was a de-gloving injury to the right foot.
An employee fell off a ladder while running network cable for computers, breaking a tibia and requiring surgery.
An employee was installing a cover for a wastewater treatment pond. When the employee initiated the welder, a fire occurred, burning the employee's arms and face.
An employee was mudding sheetrock from a scaffold when it collapsed, causing the employee to fall 10 to 12 feet. He injured his foot and broke his ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing a metal cage in parts storage. The cage had a sliding door, which closed on and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
While taking a sample, an employee suffered a heat burn to the back and shoulder.

An employee was cleaning a moving printer roller with a paint scraper while holding a rag in his left hand. The rag became caught inside the printer roller and anilox roller gears, pulling his left hand in and causing an amputation.
An employee was struck by the fork of a forklift, fracturing and lacerating his right leg (calf).

The employee was assigned to perform housekeeping of the shielding/work platform and clean the deck panels and grinders. At the start of the shift, the employee was walking and stepped on a conduit pipe causing him to roll his ankle.
On September 26, 2016, at approximately 5:30 AM, an employee fell while walking onto the patio, suffering a fractured hip and wrist.

An employee was standing in front of a pallet of product to place it in the bin when a coworker on a turret truck ran into the pallet, jolting the employee's foot between the pallet slats. He suffered a broken right ankle.

An employee was operating a riding mower on the golf course to mow the lawn. He was on a hillside when he lost traction on wet grass, causing the mower to slide down the hill towards a tree. He put his right hand up to protect his head and kept his left hand on the steering wheel. At impact, the steering wheel turned quickly, injuring his left hand. He suffered a thumb amputation and four broken fingers.
An employee was loosening bolts on an axle when it swung down and pinched the employee's finger between the axle and fixture, amputating the right pinky fingertip to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting wood with a notching machine when the machine's saw blade amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was attempting to stuff cardboard back into the chamber of a horizontal baler when it crushed her right hand.
An employee was removing grass from jammed mower blades when the blades partially amputated the left pointer finger.
While cutting a truss, an employee fell from a second-story roof and sustained a hip fracture.
While installing metal ducting, an employee's finger made contact with fan blades, amputating the fingertip.
While attempting to change the railroad track direction, an employee's left thumb was caught and amputated between tracks.
An employee was cleaning the starch feeder hopper when his right index fingertip was amputated by the 2-inch auger at the bottom.

An employee was operating a pendant crane to move a bundle of 20 sinker bars onto a stack that was eight levels high. As he was unstrapping the hook from the bundle, a banding from another bundle beneath had become undone, causing the bundle of rods to collapse. He was caught in the fallen bundle of rods, causing multiple fractures to both legs. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
Two employees were struck by amine and suffered burns, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet from a steel rack to the ground below, fracturing a wrist and arm.
An employee was removing items such as boxes from a shelving rack. While attempting to retrieve an item, he fell 7 feet to the floor, breaking both wrists and fracturing his skull.
An employee tripped over an extension cord and struck her head on a stretcher, suffering a concussion.
An employee was stepping off a side loader when the machine struck him, fracturing his sternum and ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was performing telecommunications work from a ladder and fell breaking ribs and suffering a collapsed lung.

An employee was using a donation cart to transport donated goods. When he made a turn with the cart, his left foot was caught between the cart and a parking lot block. He fell on his left side, breaking his hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was performing a manual adjustment to the shaft of the tufting machine when the belt pulled his right hand into the machine, amputating three fingers.
An employee was walking with a tagline for a forklift carrying an 8' by 13' steel sheet when he tripped and the forklift operator rolled over his right foot. He was hospitalized with tissue damage.
An employee was cutting a masonry block when the saw bounced off the block, kicked back, and cut his collarbone.

An employee was installing a dryer felt when the pipe slid off the end of the forks and struck the employee, knocking her to the floor. She suffered injuries to her right fingers and the left side of her body.
An employee was putting a metal piece into the die area of the stamping machine when the machine cycled and crushed her left hand. The press guard was in place at the time.

On September 27, 2016, an employee was unhooking the safety chain from the hauling trailer when the truck driver started to pull ahead. The employee's right-hand middle finger was pinched and amputated between the safety chain and the trailer's hitch.
An employee was helping to unload a 200-pound flare stack from a gooseneck trailer when the stack shifted and fell, striking the employee in the right shoulder and lower back area.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut picture frames. While the employee was making a cut, the saw came down and lacerated the employee's right-hand index and middle fingers.
An employee was dressing a wash pipe when the chain came loose and broke the employee's leg.
An employee was cleaning a pipe and removing debris that blocked the air hole. The release of pressure lacerated and broke the employee's right index finger.
On September 27, 2016, an employee was using a forklift to load products on a truck. He either fell off the forklift or the truck and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
On 9/27/2016, at approximately 3:44 p.m., an employee was performing foundation concrete forming work when he was struck by lightning and suffered burns, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading drywall from a forklift. The weight of the drywall caused the forklift to tilt as the drywall was being moved off the forks. As soon as the drywall was fully removed from the forks, the truck tilted back in place and injured the employee, who suffered major swelling of the neck/spine and required hospitalization.

An employee was in the cooler taking boxes of chicken off a conveyor when his glove and right ring fingertip were caught in a knuckle chain on the conveyor. The first distal segment of the employee's ring finger was damaged and had to be amputated.

While performing dozer operations in a skid loader/grader, the employee was placing top soil dirt into a beach bulkhead. The skid loader/grader backed off the bulkhead and fell 3 feet to the ground. Broken glass from the rear window lacerated the back of his head and the safety (lap) bar caused bruising to his chest.
An employee slipped and fell approximately 10 feet while climbing down a ladder installed on a fixed light pole.
An employee was climbing a ladder on a roll-off box that was loaded on the back of a truck. The employee missed a step and fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, fracturing the left elbow.

An employee entered a robot cell through an opening used to remove sand. As the employee attempted to adjust the casting, the saw caught and cut the employee's finger. An interlocked gate was in place at the time.

An employee was using a lathe and sandpaper to sand a piece of metal pipe. As he was sanding the pipe, the sandpaper wrapped around the lathe and then wrapped itself around the second and third fingers of his right hand, partially amputating them.
An employee was stripping concrete forms when a form fell towards him. As he attempted to move out of the way, his back impacted a metal toolbox, fracturing his lower ribs.
An employee was hoisting an elevator rail using an electric winch when it gave way, dropping the 230-pound rail onto the employee's left foot and big toe.
An employee was clamping pipes on the 15th floor. A pipe that was being loaded on the 23rd floor fell from a basket and struck the employee.

An employee was pulling metal pipes from a bundle of six. He was breaking the metal bands that were holding the bundle together to retrieve two of the six. As he was cutting the final band, two of the metal pipes fell from the bundle and struck his right leg, breaking it.
An employee had just finished cleaning up a resident's room and was exiting when she tripped and struck her head, suffering head injuries and a concussion.
An employee was cleaning a mixing machine when the mixer cycled, breaking the employee's hand. The mixer was not locked out at the time.

Employees building a lake deck were using a mechanical pile driver to drive piling into a lake bed. The rope broke as the hammer was being raised, and the hammer fell and struck one of the employees. The employee suffered facial trauma, a broken left shoulder, and a left arm laceration.
An employee installing water piping was injured after attempting to close/clamp a cracked pipeline. The employee suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a 2x3-inch piece of wood and cutting it with a circular saw when the blade amputated his right index finger just below the fingernail. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was bitten by a dog on the left elbow as he was delivering mail.
An employee's right foot was struck by an outrigger, injuring the big toe and second toe and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a tree log with a remote mechanical grapple when the log came loose and rolled onto his left lower leg. He was hospitalized for a leg fracture.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood on a table saw when the saw cut his right thumb above the knuckle.
After climbing a ladder and stepping onto the roof, an employee fell approximately 10 feet from the roof to a concrete slab.
An employee's glove was caught in a conveyor belt pulley, injuring the employee's right forearm.
An employee was using a lathe to machine a part, which was approximately 6" wide, 5" long, and 16 pounds, when the part came out of the lathe and impacted his abdomen.

On September 27, 2016, at approximately 4:45 a.m., an employee was helping to clear a dryer jam. While stepping over a steel latch support, he fell (on same level) against another steel latch support and fractured his right femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a utility knife to scrape sealing seams on a tractor when the part he was holding slipped and the knife cut his right thumb tip. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from a truck bed to the pavement where the truck was parked, fracturing a femur.

On the R2 Hoods machine in the warehouse, an employee caught her right index finger in the machine when trying to place a piece of cloth between the pieces of metal. The injury resulted in surgical amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was walking through the lobby of the building when she fell on the left side of her hip and broke it. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped on water droplets on the floor and fell, breaking her left hip and right ankle.
While performing routine food preparation inside a kiosk, an employee fainted due to heat stress, then suffered right forearm pain after falling.

An employee was performing maintenance on the underside of an airplane wing and was standing on a pump stand. When finished, he turned and fell from the stand onto the chain guards. The chain guard broke at the attachment to the stand and the employee fell approximately 7 feet to a concrete floor. He sustained an open gash head injury, fractured ribs, and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was walking to the front of the chicken house when he was hit from behind by a forklift. He suffered four fractured ribs, a fractured pelvis, a punctured lung, and a lacerated liver.
An employee was riding on a trailer when it hit a bump and he fell off, breaking his ribs, sternum, and leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a traumatic amputation of the right distal thumb.
An employee was walking around the trailer to slide trailer tandems when he tripped and fell on his right hip, fracturing the femur.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck while walking to the shipping office, suffering a broken ankle that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was descending a customer's folding attic entrance ladder located in the garage. When he stepped down onto the bottom section, it broke, causing him to fall to the ground. He fractured his left arm and left foot.
While clearing leaves in the back parking lot, an employee tripped on a telephone line that was close to the ground, breaking her right ankle. She was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was operating a punch press, punching holes in nail plates. As she was doing this, the machine malfunctioned and a double stroke resulted. The employee attempted to free the nail plate from the machine and the ram plate came down and crushed her left hand. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery.

An employee was preparing a tanker truck to be loaded with caustic. While the tanker was being filled, it was discovered that a valve near the end of the tanker was not closed and was leaking caustic. The employee was attempting to close the valve on the tanker when the soles of his shoes began disintegrating from contact with caustic. He suffered chemical burns to his feet and was hospitalized.
An employee was hit from behind by a vehicle while using a stand-on street blower to blow a curb area. The employee's right leg was amputated up to the knee.

An employee was using a crane to lift and move steel tubing onto a roller bed. The chain sling slipped from the crane hook as the tubing was being lowered and the employee's left thumb was pinched between the tubing and a steel beam that was in the roller bed. The employee's thumb was amputated just below the fingernail.
An employee slipped on a liquid that was present on the floor and injured his back and leg, requiring hospitalization.

While working in a ditch, an employee cut a test header off a piece of steel pipe.  The test header was being lifted out of the ditch when it tipped to the side and some methanol, which had been used to clean the pipe, leaked out and onto the employee's legs. The methanol ignited and caught the employee's legs on fire. The employee was hospitalized with leg burns.

An employee was operating the swing stage lift to raise it to the top of the suspension cable. As soon as the motor hit the swage, the swage split into two pieces. One end of the swing stage then dropped approximately 5 feet and the air motor struck and cut the employee's lower left leg.

An employee was operating an aerial lift to torque the bolts on a connection point of the steel girder to a bridge. His head was pinched between the aerial lift control panel cover and the bottom of the steel girder above him. He suffered a laceration to his right ear and a skull fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell 30 feet from the edge of an apartment complex roof while engaged in roofing work. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur, wrist, and ribs.

An employee was monitoring the production conveyor to remove defective products from production. While he was pulling a large piece of plastic off the conveyor, the piece of plastic fell into the equipment. The plastic started making a loud noise, so the employee attempted to remove it. His hand was then pulled into the equipment's wheel area. His right thumb and index finger had to be partially amputated. The guard was in place at the time.

An employee was tipping a pouring cup into a mold (to mark it as bad) while his right hand was on the conveyor belt. The conveyor belt automatically moves when it's ready for the next mold. When it moved forward, his hand became caught between the mold and conveyor belt, amputating his right pinky fingertip.
An employee was experiencing chest pains while running electrical conduit and was taken to the hospital 09/28/2016.

On September 28, 2016, an employee was hooking up large pipes in the hull of a ship when he fell in an 18-inch void between the pipes on the deck. He suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a concussion.
While building a tent, an employee's right index finger was caught and lacerated between a crown and a brace.
An employee fainted and fell to the ground while walking down stairs from the second to the first floor, suffering an ankle sprain and multiple contusions requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were standing side by side attempting to make repairs when the kick-out bar engaged. The kick-out bar ran over the first employee's left foot and caught the second employee's leg between the bar and a bale. The first employee suffered two broken bones between the left knee and ankle. The second employee suffered a laceration and two broken bones in the left foot. They were both hospitalized.
An employee was caulking holes on a wall while standing on a 6-foot ladder when the employee fell to the ground, breaking ribs and puncturing a lung.

An employee was in the attic of a residential home setting up equipment to blow insulation into the attic. He was walking on the ceiling joist while pulling an insulation hose when he lost his balance and his foot slipped off the joist. One of his feet went through the ceiling and caused his upper torso to fall onto the joist, fracturing four ribs and bruising his chest.
An employee was shoveling dirt onto a paved surface when a nearby skid steer made an abrupt backward turn and struck the employee's left leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

On September 28, 2016, at 12:30 a.m., an employee had gone to his car during his break when two men approached him, pointed their guns at the employee and shot him in the face and chest. He was hospitalized.
While doing preventative maintenance on a stamping press, an employee's right index finger was caught and partially amputated in the door's chain and sprocket.
An employee was cleaning a pump when the pump actuated and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
While performing powerline maintenance, an employee received first, second, and third degree burns to his back and arms due to an electric arc flash.
An employee was taping a pipe and using a utility knife when the knife lacerated his left ring finger.
An employee's foot became caught on the stairwell and she fell, suffering a bone fracture.
An employee opened a hand hole on a boiler in preparation for an annual inspection. After the employee opened the hole, hot water came out and burned the employees' hands, arms, and legs.
An employee was digging out a trench when the trench collapsed and broke the employee's femur.
An employee broke one of his legs while moving furniture from a house into the moving truck.
An employee was installing an auger on a digger derrick. As he slid the kelly bar down into the sleeve, the bar/sleeve amputated his fingertip.

An employee was operating a band saw when her glove became trapped in the conveyor belt, which pulled her right hand under the saw blade. Her right index finger was amputated between the first and second knuckle.
An employee was working on a table saw when a piece of 3x3x24" wood kicked back, hitting his left cheekbone and cutting him above his right eye.
An employee was helping a coworker change the forks on a forklift when the fork dropped on his finger. The fork crushed his right-hand middle finger, amputating the tip just above the first knuckle.
An employee was cleaning up after painting with a paint gun when the paint gun went off and punctured his hand with high-pressure liquid.

An employee was about to make coffee on an automatic coffee machine. The water reservoir that contained hot water was not closed properly. When she tried to open it, she was splashed with hot water and suffered second degree burns.

An employee was maneuvering a lid for a hole in a platform in a building. The employee lost control of the lid and both the lid and the employee fell into the basement area. The employee suffered three broken ribs.
An employee was struck in the face by a tool and a spreader bar while trying to open "ears" on a machined part.
On or about September 29, 2016, an employee suffered an injury when he fell outside the office building while walking toward his truck.

An employee was moving a board that was double-stacked on a chain conveyor. When he moved the top board, his right index finger was pinched by the boards or chain conveyor and his fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was venting a container with water and condensation at an oil site when a vacuum truck at the site caught fire in the engine compartment or cab. While retrieving a fire extinguisher from the truck, the employee received first and second degree burns and required overnight hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder about 8-10 feet up cutting tree branches when a tree branch fell and hit the ladder, causing it to tip. The employee fell to the ground and landed on his back fracturing five ribs, the pelvis and bruising a lung.

An employee was leveling a washer machine that washes bottling equipment. He placed his hands underneath the machine to remove a shim inside of it when a 6-inch by 6-inch block support cracked, causing the machine to crush and amputate the upper part of his left index finger.

On or about September 29, 2016, an employee was operating a brush chipper. The employee began to dismount the chipper by grabbing the winch rope. An employee was moving a conveyor into place when the wheel became caught on a gutter cover, which caused the cover to lift up. His right foot was then caught in the gutter, fracturing and dislocating it.

An employee was attempting to close the door of a shipping trailer when the spring from the trailer came loose and was hanging free. As the employee attempted to replace the spring, it recoiled and caught his right thumb, amputating the tip to the first knuckle.
An employee severed a finger while using a stationary horizontal bandsaw to cut material. The finger had to be amputated.
During rig down procedures, an employee was moving a mud tank with a tandem truck when an overhead walkway slid, hit the ground, and then struck the employee on the left knee.

An employee was walking inside a trailer containing appliances for new homes when he tripped and fell onto an oven canopy hood that was stored on the floor, cutting his right wrist and severing an artery on the metal edge of the oven hood. He was hospitalized overnight and required surgery.

On September 29, 2016, an employee was helping to install a torque (transmission) on a large bulldozer using chain hoists when one of the hoists gave way, allowing the transmission to come down and strike the employee's head and face. The employee suffered forehead lacerations, facial trauma, and a skull fracture.

An employee was working near the edge of a loading dock when he fell to the next lower level, hitting his head and ribs upon contact with the ground. He was hospitalized for fractured ribs and a concussion.
While removing a clog in a coffee bean vacuum, an employee's right index finger came into contact with rotating parts, partially amputating it.
An employee was delivering mail to an industrial company site when he was struck by the swinging forks of a mini loader, breaking his left leg in two places and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was driving a forklift and lost control while making a turn. The forklift tipped over and the employee suffered a fractured pelvis.

An employee was teaching a class when she turned to walk away from the podium and tripped. When she started to fall, she placed her right arm out to brace herself. Her arm hit the wall, fracturing her humerus and requiring surgery.
On September 29, 2016, an employee was playing baseball with clients when he suffered a torn patellar tendon avulsion in his right knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's boot became stuck between the carpet and a plastic mat under his chair, causing him to fall and fracture his hip.

A worker was riding a bicycle traveling between locations on a paved roadway and fell off the bicycle landing on his arms and upper body. The employee incurred a fracture with laceration to his left forearm.

On September 29, 2016, at approximately 10:15 AM, an employee walking through the facility was struck by a powered industrial vehicle. The employee then fell and suffered a broken left elbow, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

Workers were drilling a water well. They were removing the drill pipes from the well with a block when the block went past the block stop at the top of the rig and broke free. The block fell to the drill deck and the bails on the block struck an employee, causing him to fall 8 feet to the ground. He was also struck by slips that were dislodged by the impact of the block. He suffered four fractured vertebrae and lacerations to the head and ear.

An employee was setting up a grinding machine when he heard an unusual noise coming from the machine. He turned the machine off and looked inside. Something then flew out of the belt drive area and struck him in the face. He fell backwards and struck his head on the concrete floor, lacerating his lip and head and sustaining a concussion.

An employee was cleaning a hydraulic tank with a brake parts cleaning solution. The employee sprayed the cleaner on the parts to be cleaned and then dropped a mechanic's droplight to the ground. The bulb then sparked and caused the cleaning solution vapors to ignite, resulting in burns to the employee's face and neck.

An employee was cleaning bag machine plates with a rag when the rag and his left hand were pulled into the machine, amputating his fingertip between a plate cylinder and impression roller. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was removing debris from the rotating tables of a grinder when his right hand came in contact with the abrasive wheel, amputating three fingers.

An employee and two coworkers were reverse-rolling a 110-foot roll of carpet for a scheduled carpet installation. After reverse-rolling the carpet, the team proceeded to operate the carpet machine in order to shrink-wrap it. During this process, the carpet fell off the machine and struck the injured employee in the left leg, breaking the kneecap and requiring surgery.
An employee was struck by a passing forklift, fracturing the skull, ribs, and ear. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding sheet metal into a hydraulic shear when four fingers were partially amputated, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading scissor lifts from a truck trailer ramp. As the employee was bringing a lift down the ramp, the wheel started turning sideways, which caused the lift to tip over with the employee on it. The employee suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was in a pallet trailer behind the store when he fell about 4 feet from the pallet trailer to the ground. He sustained severe head injuries, fractured ribs, a fractured eye socket, and a fractured sternum, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling on a strap that was around a box when the strap broke, causing him to fall to the ground and fracture his right ankle.
An employee was pressure testing oil and gas equipment. As the employee was removing the tube/pipe, high-pressure air and water released and amputated the employee's left-hand digits.
An employee placed a bundle of steel bar stock into a horizontal band saw when he suffered a severe laceration to the right index finger, requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was loading/unloading a punch press machine when she suffered a left thumb amputation. The safety guard was in place at the time.

On 09/30/2016, at 7:00 PM, a shipping/receiving employee was preparing to shrink wrap a switchboard when she stepped over the shrink wrap placed between the film roll and the switchboard structure to start the turntable wrapper. While stepping over it, her right foot was caught on the film and she fell to the ground on her left side, fracturing her left hip.
An employee felt light-headed and suffered asthma exacerbation while walking down a recently waxed hallway. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting loins with a saw when he made contact with the blade, suffering a laceration and fracture to his left thumb. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while walking in the hallway, suffering bruising and abrasions to the face and body.
While clearing out a cutting machine's path, an employee's fingertip was cut by the machine. The machine was in operation at the time.

An employee was emptying trash from a trash hopper into a dumpster. As he was trying to clear cement debris inside the trash hopper (which was lifted up by a forklift), he lost his footing and fell about 6 feet from the dumpster to the concrete floor, injuring his head, clavicle, and ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was drilling holes in a half-inch steel plate using an electromagnetic drill. As he was removing the drill bit from the last hole, a stinger caught his glove and pulled his hand toward the drill bit, amputating his left index fingertip.

On September 30, 2016, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was attempting to help fellow crew members fuel up machinery when he lost his balance and fell. He received minor scrapes to his face and injured his right eye. He was hospitalized for surgery.

On 09/30/16, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was grinding stock on a pedestal belt sander when the stock became caught, pulling the employee's hand against the sander. The employee's left thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was teaching other employees how to inventory equipment. As the employee was taking an inventory of tires, he stepped off a catwalk and fell approximately 7 feet to a concrete surface. He was hospitalized with a head contusion and laceration.
An employee was replacing a light bulb, lost their balance and fell from the ladder sustaining a head injury.
An employee was moving a cabinet when he lost his balance and pinched his left pinky between the cabinet and the door frame. The finger had to be amputated at the first joint.
On 10/01/2016, at approximately 2:30 a.m., an employee's hand was caught between a slide conveyor and the frame. He fractured his left ring finger and received lacerations to several fingers.

On October 1, 2016, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was going up the front porch steps of a private residence to make a sales call when he fell on the concrete porch and landed on his right elbow, fracturing his right ulna. He required surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a pie crust mixer with water when a rotating mixer blade caught his finger against the mixer housing. His left pinky and ring fingers were lacerated.
An employee was installing insulation when he grabbed a truss that had a nail, puncturing his hand through his gloves. He required surgery when the wound became infected.
While exiting the television trailer to take paperwork to another location, an employee slipped on wet stairs and fell to the ground, suffering pain in the left shoulder, left hip, and lower back.
An employee was helping a coworker position a patient when the patient lost consciousness and fell on the employee. She sustained a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a chef's knife to cut steak when the knife cut her thumb, amputating the tip.

An employee was fixing a freezer door from a ladder when the door opened and struck the ladder, causing the employee to fall 12 feet onto the concrete floor. The employee suffered a concussion and fractured legs, ribs, shoulders, and nose.
An employee was cutting a 24-inch cast iron pipe with a saw when the saw kicked back and severely lacerated the left side of his neck.

An employee tried to prevent a client from leaving a residential unit. The client went through a door leading into a stairwell.  Staff continued to try to de-escalate and stop the client from leaving the unit. The client pushed the employee, who fell down the stairs and suffered a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a ladder, installing a communications drop. The ladder slipped laterally, and the employee fell and impacted the ground, suffering a fractured right wrist that required hospitalization.
The employee was a passenger in a golf cart performing ranger duties when he fell off the cart and hit his head on the parking lot.
An employee was making an adjustment to the stretch-wrap machine when his finger was caught between the drive wheel and the machine frame, severely lacerating his left first fingertip.
An employee was delivering mail to a resident's home when a dog attacked him, causing an amputation injury to his left index finger.
An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder performing maintenance tasks when he fell off the ladder to the platform below and rolled down 21 feet into an unguarded pit. He broke his left arm and leg.

An employee was positioned over the cab of a catering truck, trying to loosen a service platform that was stuck over the cab. When he pried the platform loose, it fell on his head and fractured his face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck in the face and suffered a broken jaw during an altercation with a coworker.
The employee was opening a valve. The free end of a connected hose struck the employee when he opened the valve injuring his lower left leg.
An employee was working on a unit with piping when he became overheated. He was later hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee ruptured his right patellar tendon while he was playing basketball for a scene.

An employee was taking inventory inside a 48-foot tractor trailer. She had one foot inside the trailer and one foot on the power dock plate when a truck jockey hooked up to the trailer in error and pulled away.  This action caused the employee to fall 4 feet off the back of the trailer. She landed on her feet and sustained bi-lateral heel fractures.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder installing electrical materials overhead. The employee missed a step while descending the ladder and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground below, resulting in hospitalization for a right ankle fracture.

Employees were using an overhead crane to lift steel plates from the bed of a truck.  An employee attempted to attach chains to offload the steel plates from the truck. As he was lowering the steel plate onto the floor, the plate began to move. His right hand was on the plate and his middle finger was caught between the lip of the plate and the hook, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was trying to free a planet car from a temporary guardrail. When the car became free, the employee's right thumb was amputated below the nailbed.
An employee was removing a scaffold runner when it came loose and struck him. He fell backwards and struck his head, suffering a contusion/laceration.
An employee was moving a table with a glass top. When she picked up the table, she leaned it toward her and the glass fell off the top of the table and onto her big toe, amputating the tip.
An employee was struck by a truck while flagging in a work zone, breaking an arm and leg.
An employee stood up and fell to the floor, suffering a severed femoral artery.

An employee was standing on a step stool (22 inches) and arranging boxes in a supply closet. As she finished up, she lost her balance and fell to the ground. She landed hard on the ground on her right side with her right arm extended, breaking it in three places.
An employee fell to the ground while coming down a ladder, fracturing his right wrist.

An employee was working on a highway, pouring concrete on a part of the road, when a car sped into the construction zone. The car hit a wood plank, which ejected toward the employee, striking him in the face and causing major swelling and bruising. He was hospitalized.
A worker was moving a piece of material with an excavator when it struck an employee's calf, causing a lateral laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cutting pork on a band saw when the pork bone caught the blade and began to spin, causing the employee's left ring finger to strike the saw. He suffered a tendon laceration and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell approximately 9 feet through a working surface to the concrete below, sustaining fractures to the skull, ribs, and wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was recording the serial numbers located on the side of wooden crates containing parts. One or more of the wooden crates fell on the employee, breaking the employee's ankle and hip.
An employee was relocating a light switch on a wall when he was shocked by a hot wire on the light switch, suffering burns on his right hand.
While unpacking boxes of newly received fabric, an employee tripped and fell on a packaging strap, fracturing the left hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was lifting a 12' x 8" diameter steel vent pipe with three coworkers. They were using a come-along/chain fall to lift the pipe in place while the other employees were guiding. The pipe was shifted to maneuver around a guard rail, causing the rigging beam to slide off the I-beams it was placed on. The entire rigging assembly and load fell. As the rigging fell, the chain whipped around and struck the employee in the right arm, fracturing the ulna and radius.
An employee was near the roll-bending machine while the machine operator was feeding metal into the roller. The employee's index and middle fingers were then caught and amputated in the roller.

An employee was operating a power saw from his knees and was cutting a pallet to discard. The power saw kicked back and part of the blade cut the employee's right leg above the knee, causing a deep laceration. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was loading a dye header (a piece of carpet) into a sample beck. When she tried to pull the head end of the dye header from underneath the reel, the carpet pulled her arm between the reel and the carpet, breaking two bones in her left forearm.

While loading items into the cab of a delivery truck, an employee came in contact with liquid disinfectant cleaner, suffering chemical burns to both hands and the nose, as well as whitening of the fingertips.
On October 1, 2016, a forklift operator ran over and crushed an employee's right foot.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while operating a milling machine.
An employee jumped off the 2nd floor balcony to avoid being bitten by a dog and was injured. The employee jammed the left thumb and sprained their lower back upon impact with the ground.
An employee was bringing a boat to the dock when the boat tower used for water skiing came down and pinched the employee's finger, partially amputating it.

An employee noticed that there was lint built up on a mounted fan. He then got a paper towel and began to wipe the lint off. His finger went between the guard, and the fan blades amputated his left index fingertip. The fan was on at the time.
An employee's fingers became stuck in a construction equipment mast during inspections, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sitting in her chair at her work desk and rolled backwards to talk to a fellow co-worker when her chair tipped over, causing her to fall to the ground and strike her head. She hospitalized with a concussion.

An employee was attempting to fix the gusset of a bag on a bagging machine when the machine closed on his fingers, amputating his right middle fingertip and lacerating his right index fingertip. The guard was in place at the time.
An employee fell down the stairs while pulling a pallet jack, suffering fractured ribs and a lacerated spleen.

An employee was pushing a materials cart with scaffolding material on it when the cart became stuck. The material dislodged and fell on the employee, striking him in the head and causing a potential concussion.

An employee was trying to unjam two steel bars on a conveyor when the photo sensor sensed movement and began to cycle, causing the employee's right hand to be dragged into the conveyor. The employee suffered a fractured right hand and was hospitalized overnight. The machine was not locked out at the time.

Two employees were installing a 25-foot, 1000-watt halide light onto anchor brackets using a forklift when the metal fixture broke at the knuckle, striking one employee in the head and the other in the back. The first employee was hospitalized with a head injury, and the second was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.
An employee fell into a hole that was 18 feet deep and was hospitalized with a broken nose and cheek and jaw injuries.

An employee was operating a loader to load dry fertilizer into a truck when a wall of dry (hard) fertilizer broke loose, broke the windshield of the loader, and engulfed the loader and the employee up to the middle of his chest. He suffered breathing difficulties and leg contusions, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating an ATV when it rolled and injured his left wrist.

Two employees were offloading asphalt flux when one of the employee's unhooked the hose from the trailer, which caused a release of product. The asphalt flux contacted the injured employee's arms, chest, and chin.  He was hospitalized with second and third degree burns.
An employee fell to a lower level while securing cargo containers on a 14-wheel flatbed truck, dislocating a shoulder.
An employee was stung by a wasp on his right torso and had an allergic reaction while cleaning tree limbs.
An employee was trying to correct loose taping on boxes that were on a moving machine when his right middle finger became caught in the machine's moving chain and was amputated.
An employee was driving a Segway when it hit a curb. The employee fell to the ground and broke the right ankle.

An employee was inspecting a core machine because it was not operating. He attempted to clear some sand inside the point of operation. As his hand passed through a light curtain's sensing field, a core table lowered and crushed his right hand, causing lacerations and fractures.
An employee was hit by a mini-excavator bucket while walking, suffering a right shoulder injury.
While walking, an employee tripped on a plastic strap, fell to the ground, and fractured her right shoulder.
An employee tripped over a box of coins while closing a safe door. As she fell, her right index finger was caught in the closing door, amputating her fingertip.

An employee was working on a dog-eared board machine when his leg was severely lacerated by a moving part at the edge of the machine near the bottom that catches the boards. He was hospitalized with a cut ligament in his right leg just below the knee and required surgery.
An employee was working on a shredder. He was pulling a pin with a pin puller when his finger was smashed between two pieces of metal. His finger had to be amputated.

On October 4, 2016, at approximately 10:00 AM, an employee was operating a small full-revolution clutch mechanical power bench press, forming and punching recliner hardware.  The press was equipped with two palm buttons, light curtains, and two mechanical side guards. Unexpectedly, the top ram came down and pinned the employee's left hand against the bottom half of the die.  She suffered broken fingers and was hospitalized for surgery.

A maintenance employee was cleaning out a pump and attempted to flick out a piece of meat. His hand became stuck, and he sustained a partial amputation of his right index finger when he pulled out his hand. The pump was not locked out at the time.
A maintenance employee was manually rotating a pulley to oil the bearings on an air handler when the pulley caught and amputated his left small fingertip. The power was locked out at the time.

After loading a gun assembly onto the tines of a forklift, an employee tried to roll the gun assembly into a cart. The gun assembly fell off the cart and onto the employee's right foot, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was cutting pork loins with a meat-cutting bandsaw when his left middle fingertip contacted the rotating blade and was amputated.
An employee was attempting to park a pallet jack. The pallet jack struck him as he was stepping off of it, lacerating his lower left leg.
An employee was cutting rolls of metal on a machine. The employee was on the stairs checking on the rollers when his right leg became caught in the roller and amputated at the ankle.

On October 4, 2016, an employee was positioning a mold that was to be lifted by a gantry. The employee's hand was on one of the chains attached to the mold. When the chain was tightened, the employee's left thumb was caught and partially amputated by the chain (tissue and nail loss; no bone loss).
The employee was aligning the traffic control barrels when a vehicle struck the employee. The employee sustained a broken leg, arm and a dislocated ankle.
On October 4, 2016, an employee fell as he got up from his chair and fractured his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was bitten by a spider in his truck, requiring hospitalization.
On October 4, 2016, while performing maintenance on a fan, an employee's gloved hand was pulled into a belt and pulley, amputating a fingertip.
While attaching a drop wire to the side of a residential building, an employee fell approximately 14 feet from an extension ladder.

An employee was reclaiming a liquid lye mixture from the containment area using a shop vac. The employee removed the lid to the shop vac and was attempting to pour the reclaimed potassium hydroxide mix from the shop vac into the reclamation area when he lost his grip on the shop vac and spilled the mix onto his legs.  He was not wearing PPE. He suffered a chemical burn to the lower half of his left inner thigh and left inner ankle area.
An employee was welding structural steel. While descending a ladder, the employee fell to the ground and dislocated an ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting material on a flatbed when the material knocked the employee off the flat bed to the concrete ground. The employee suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and lacerations to the head and arm.

An employee exited a forklift on the loading dock. The forklift was then knocked into reverse and the started going backward toward the end of the dock. The employee tried to stop the forklift from falling off the dock, but instead fell 4 feet off the dock with the forklift, suffering internal bruising on the left side of the back. The forklift was not turned off at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing a hose connector from a conveyor when the hose became snagged on the conveyor. The connector came flying back, hitting and breaking the employee's hand and wrist.

The employee fell approximately eight feet from a pallet/crate elevated with a forklift, while installing plywood on the windows of the warehouse in preparation for hurricane Matthew.  The employee's ankle was fractured.
An employee was packaging meat products and attempted to dislodge a package caught in the conveyor. The chain-driven conveyor belt then amputated the employee's fingertip.
On October 5, 2016, an employee was using a 7-inch electric grinder when it kicked back and severely lacerated the back of his left hand.

An employee was operating a forklift. The forklift wheels struck a plate between the loading dock and the back of the trailer causing the plate to move and the employee to fall off the forklift. The employee suffered a concussion.
On 10/05/2016, an employee's right calf was struck by construction equipment that backed up unexpectedly. He suffered a compression injury to his calf, requiring surgery.
An employee was making cheesecake at a cheesecake press machine when the machine severely cut her thumb, requiring overnight hospitalization and surgery. The machine was guarded at the time.

On Thursday, October 5, 2016, at approximately 3:15 p.m., an employee was descending from the fourth deck of a scaffold (5x16x40) after installing blinds. At the 8-feet mark, he lost three-point contact and fell to ground level, dislocating and fracturing his left elbow. His PPE was not connected at the time.
On October 5, 2016, an employee suffered a left thumb tip amputation while removing a part from a bale cutter.

An employee was walking up a hill while a pickup truck was backing up the hill from the other side. The driver did not see the employee. The employee attempted to get out of the way but fell and was run over by the truck. The employee suffered broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a fractured ankle.
While unloading laundry bins from the back of a delivery truck, an employee's foot was caught under the hydraulic lift at the back of the truck, amputating his toes.

An employee was attempting to place a pin in the hydraulic cylinder of a backhoe when the front of the backhoe struck the employee. The employee sustained lacerations to the right forearm, three broken ribs, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was reassembling a trampoline when a bungee cord struck the employee in the eye, causing eye and vision damage that required overnight hospitalization.
Employees experienced dizziness, drowsiness, and headaches after being exposed to carbon monoxide. They were hospitalized.

Two employees were on a job site inspecting the area above the roof to see where the next storefront frame was going to be installed. They set up a ladder and the first employee began climbing while the second employee held the ladder for him. 

The ladder was sitting on a deck made of composite material that was damp from rain. The first employee was over 4 feet off the ground when the bottom of the ladder began to slip away from the building. He jumped as the ladder began to fall; when he landed, he suffered a compound fracture in his right lower leg and dislocated his right shoulder. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move a stick pipe. He was standing on the ground by the pipe wrangler and had his left hand on the pipe. The pipe skate was too close to the pipe so he motioned to the pipe wrangler operator to move the skate back. However, the skate moverd forward, pinching the employee's left index finger between the skate and the pipe. His left index finger was partially amputated.
While operating a pallet jack and driving down an aisle in the warehouse, an employee lost control of the lift and struck the left leg on adjacent metal racking, fracturing it.
An employee was attempting to lift a 300-pound stone to place a lifting strap underneath it when his left index finger was caught beneath the stone, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was positioning metal next to hydraulic clamps to prepare the metal for tack welding. The clamp actuated while the employee's finger was between the metal and the clamp, crushing the employee's fingertip. The fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was taking down cement forms when their pinky finger was smashed by rebar material.
While stocking pharmaceutical items, an employee came into contact with cinnamon residue on a pallet and suffered an allergic reaction.
