An employee was changing a knockout on a press die when a chain came loose. The employee's left ring finger was then pinched between the die stem and the die knockout, amputating the fingertip.
A maintenance employee was using a sledgehammer to drive a launder pin out when the sledgehammer struck his left pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was walking by an air handler when he heard a strange mechanical noise. He walked behind the air handler to investigate and attempted to stop the machine's moving rubber belt. His right middle finger contacted the belt and was amputated above the knuckle.
An employee as attempting to stop the fan belt on a fan motor pulley when the pulley lacerated his right middle finger.
An employee misstepped while sweeping a stairwell and fell down the stairs, fracturing the left tibia and fibula.

An employee was dumping trash from a gondola style trash bin into a dumpster. The trash bin began to tip over into the dumpster and the employee grabbed it. The employee's finger was smashed between the bin and dumpster, amputating a fingertip.
Two employees were collecting trash. When the first employee backed the truck up to a trash container, the second employee's right pinky finger was pinched between the truck and the container.

An employee was sweeping a roof after conducting roof repair activities when he fell 20 feet through the roof to the ground, suffering shoulder and spinal injuries, pelvic fractures, and a pelvic hemorrhage.

An employee was using a sanding cloth to smooth a long shaft in an engine lathe. As he got to the end of the shaft farthest away from the chuck end, his glove became caught between the sanding cloth and the shaft, wrapping his fingers on both hands within the shredding cut-resistant fibers of the gloves. He suffered one finger amputation, a broken left wrist, and right hand lacerations.
An employee was walking through the property doing an inspection when she stepped in a puddle of water in the parking lot and fell, fracturing her left ankle.

At about 11:00 p.m., an employee was rotating a pole to line up the strong back with the crane to hook. Two out of the six tacks were holding the strong back. The strong back came loose and dropped vertically to the floor; before it stopped moving, it struck the employee on the left side of his left leg. The strong back weighs approximately 600 lbs. The employee's leg, from the knee down to his ankle, received a glancing blow. He was taken hospitalized with several broken bones.

An employee was attempting to push a pipe down the trough of a grinding machine with his foot. His foot became caught between the wall and the pipe, smashing his leg. He suffered severe contusions to the lower leg that required surgery.
While installing underlayment on the roof, an employee fell to the ground and suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was coming down a ladder when he slipped and fell approximately 9 ft. injuring his left leg and arm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a ground power unit to attach it to a truck when a coworker pushed the unit, which caught and amputated the employee's left ring finger.
An employee was moving a mobile food tray rack from one area of the scullery to another. The employee lost balance and fell, suffering a broken hip.

On October 6, 2016, an employee was changing out cutter blades when he saw a piece of plastic. As he removed the plastic, his left hand contacted the blades, injuring his index, middle, and ring fingers and amputating his middle finger.
An employee was working on a 480-volt electrical panel when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee's stomach, chest, hand, and arm.

On 10/06/2016, at approximately 1:15 p.m., an employee was cleaning walls in the warehouse from a scissor lift when a material handling equipment (MHE) operator struck the scissor lift. The lift tipped over and landed on a second MHE. The employee fell to the ground and was hospitalized with acute pain due to trauma.

An employee was working from a ladder to remove an aerial drop from a line as part of a U-Verse installation job. The employee slipped and fell approximately 18 feet from the ladder, suffering rib and pelvic fractures and bruised lungs. The employee was hospitalized.

On 10/6/16, at approximately 2:00 p.m., an employee was operating a compound miter box saw to cut cardboard tubes. The saw kicked upward, pulling her right arm into the blade and lacerating the right bicep. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was adjusting the blade on a horizontal coating machine when the spring popped off. The employee and a coworker tried to fix the machine by holding up the blade and reattaching the spring. The spring then partially amputated the employee's finger in a pinch point.
An employee's foot became caught on a barrier guard. The employee fell, dislocating a shoulder and suffering a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a cart while loading packages from another loading cart, suffering fractured ribs.

The employee was stacking pallets of empty barrels with a forklift. One of the barrels was not seated properly. The employee moved the barrel by hand when the forks dropped and his finger was caught between the barrel and the pallet.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slid down. He fell down and broke his left leg and heel bone.
An employee was moving a pallet of bags using a hand pallet jack when someone called her name. As she turned around, the hand pallet jack ran over and fractured her left foot. She was hospitalized.

An employee observed a shoplifter with stolen merchandise and confronted the shoplifter as he entered his car. The shoplifter put the car in reverse with the door open and quickly backed out of the parking lot. The door struck the employee, injuring the employee's head and back.

An employee was pulling a mobile cart backwards from a packing station. The cart was located between a guard rail and the wall, which had a dry erase board mounted on it with an aluminum marker storage tray located along the bottom edge. While passing the tray, the back of the employee's hand came across the edge of the tray, pulling his glove down and lacerating the back of his left hand.

An employee was changing dies when a metal guard flipped down, causing the insulator on the energized 240V (die heating element) heater wires to break. The employee suffered an electrical shock to his shoulder, lost consciousness, and then collapsed forward, hitting his head on a metal track.
An employee was loading a lawnmower reel into a machine when the machine centered itself, causing the positioning device to strike his left hand.
An employee was trying to unjam a turret machine when his right ring finger was caught and partially amputated between the turret wheel and the side of the bowl.
An employee was greasing the rollers of a mixer using a rag. As he was greasing near the rollers, his right hand contacted the roller, crushing and amputating his right index finger.

An employee was replacing a gear on a strapping machine conveyor. Bundles (of aluminum) continued to be put on the strapping conveyor while the employee was installing the gear. When a bundle hit the photo eye, the conveyor belt engaged and amputated the employee's right index finger below the second knuckle. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was removing a fallen white pine tree limb with an 8-foot extendable chain saw when a limb fell onto a communication line and struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the scapula and ribs.
An employee was fabricating a piece of sheet metal on a press when the press brake came down on the employee's right hand.

An employee was looking into a truck trailer while standing on the ground with his hands on the dock. A forklift then ran over his right hand and crushed the three middle fingers, requiring hospitalization.
An employee collapsed and hit her head on the floor, suffering a laceration and a hemorrhage.
An employee sustained a right ring finger amputation.
An employee was attempting to cut a piece of plastic with a small utility knife when the knife slipped and lacerated the employee's left index fingertip.

On 10/6/16, an employee was helping to replace a high-pressure pump that failed. He was attempting to guide the belts back on the pulley when his right index finger wrapped around the belt and slipped onto the pulley. His fingertip was caught and amputated between the belt and pulley.
An employee was replacing a gear box and was bitten on his wrist and forearm by a black widow spider.

An employee was moving a piece of pipe on a cart when it shifted and crushed his right-hand middle and index fingers, fracturing both. The index finger above the first knuckle had to be surgically amputated.
An employee suffered an arm injury while operating a forklift.
While pushing a basket with steel frames, an employee came in close proximity to a pole with a cage around it.  The employee's finger was caught and amputated between the pole and the basket.

An employee was cutting wood wedges with a skill saw on a boom lift when the saw jumped and cut the three middle fingers on his left hand. His middle finger was amputated from the bottom of the fingernail up.
An employee slipped and fell down the stairs, hitting his head. He suffered a concussion, fractured left thumb, multiple facial fractures, skin tears, and a laceration to his right eye.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet through an unsecured hole on a parking garage roof and was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the wrists and pelvis.
A maintenance employee was driving a cart when it ran off the loading dock. The employee was hospitalized with head injuries.

An employee was dragging tree limbs to a chipper via a winch system when his legs were struck by either the tree limbs or the winch system, resulting in one broken leg and a possible break to his other leg.
On 10/6/16, an employee was performing roofing work on a bay window roof at an elevation of 18 feet when he fell to the ground, fracturing his feet and/or legs.

An employee was operating the bread line, where bread comes off the cooler line onto five different baggers. The bread goes onto a slide that pushes one loaf at a time into the guarded slicers.  After it is sliced, a metal guide pushes the bread forward to the next line for the bread to be bagged. Two loaves of bread, one behind the other, went into the slicer the wrong way. When the employee attempted to grab the bread, the metal guide pinched her right pinky finger, resulting in a distal amputation of her fingertip.

An employee was operating a front deck mower. As he was reversing, the mower slid. The employee grabbed the roll bar, and the right index finger was caught between the roll bar and a support beam. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was putting material into a metal leveler machine when his hand was crushed by the metal rollers, breaking bones and amputating three fingers.
An employee was applying a belt dressing to an aggregate conveyor when his arm was caught by the conveyor. He suffered arm and pinky finger fractures, requiring hospitalization.

On October 7, 2016, an employee was operating a press brake to bend metal material when the left index fingertip became caught between the material and the front of the machine. A small portion of the finger had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was walking by a pouch converting machine when she noticed a fold in the plastic and attempted to correct it. At the same time, the operator jogged the machine, which pulled her hand between two rollers and amputated her index finger and half of her pinky finger. The guard was not in place at the time.
As an employee was pulling material and backing up, the employee's left lower leg struck a support bracket and was lacerated.

An employee was on an upper platform of power-producing machinery checking the phase rotations on the fan motors. While descending a fixed ladder to come down from the upper platform, the employee fell off a lower rung approximately 4 feet to the floor below. The employee suffered a bruised left leg and back pain.

An employee was working at a drum dump station, dumping material into a tumbler.  He was putting a 55-pound steel drum onto the dump station when the drum fell. When he tried catching the drum, his right index finger was caught between the falling drum and the next drum in line to be dumped, amputating his fingertip.
An employee's pinky finger pad was amputated while bending pipe.
An employee's hands were pinched between two pieces of machinery while assembling equipment, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was checking for any obstructions in the dryer when the employee's right hand became caught in the anti-clumping tumbler wheel, amputating a fingertip.

On Friday, October 7, 2016, two employees were helping to decontaminate the blow down settling drum in the coker unit.  In order to remove the check valve, one employee had to hold the back up while the other loosened the check valve. As the employee began to loosen the check valve, it suddenly came off and product sprayed out of the line onto the two employees. As a result, one employee received burns to his face and hands, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to help a coworker free a jammed/stuck part on a mold press machine when his finger was caught in a defective clamp, which pinched/amputated his left ring fingertip.

An employee was attempting to change the bearings on a fertilizer tender truck's auger and was using a garden hose to loosen the product. The hose became tangled in the auger, which drug his hand into the auger. As a result, his right pinky and part of his ring finger were amputated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a die set on a metal roller form machine using a breaker bar. The breaker bar slipped off the bolt head and struck his right ring finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell from a flat roof.

On 10/07/2016, at approximately 8:45 a.m., two employees suffered electrical shock. An employee was shocked while using a concrete saw. Another employee attempted to move the first employee out of the water and was also injured. The employees were hospitalized.

While loading mail into a vehicle, an employee fell from the same level onto a concrete slab. The employee's foot twisted on the slab, which caused the employee to lose balance and fall. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and fractured left hip.
An employee was checking a gap in a pipe machine when his finger was pinched between two rollers, amputating his left middle fingertip.
An employee was standing on top of a stack of feed bunks, untying a bundle, when the bunks shifted and he fell off. The bunks then fell onto his leg, breaking his right femur.
While walking to the break area, an employee tripped on a mat, fell to the ground, and fractured the left knee.
A boom section fell and struck an employee who was disassembling an 80-ton crawler. The employee suffered a fractured right leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move equipment on the ground while a nearby payloader with forks was moving equipment and wooden dunnage. The forks made contact with the wood dunnage, which then struck and broke the employee's jaw.
While performing sawmill operations for the pallet mill, an employee went to unjam a wood board from a saw. His left thumb was then amputated in a chain and sprocket pinch point.
An employee was loading counter weights into a counter weight frame during an elevator installation when the counter weights crushed his middle and ring fingers.

An employee was watching bottles go down the trimmer line to make sure the blow molds were working correctly. When the employee attempted to remove a bottle, the trimmer engaged and hit the employee's hand, lacerating and crushing it. The guard was in place at the time.
An employee's hand was caught in a machine while working on it.
An employee contacted live wires and suffered burns to the hands and forearms when an electric arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to square a bundle of steel sheets using a 4X4 piece of wood up against an I-beam. The sheets caught the employee's left little finger, removing flesh from the knuckle to the fingertip. The fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was starting a pressure washer when a plug from the block valve blew out and struck the employee in the face, fracturing the left cheek and jaw.
An employee suffered an amputation.

An employee was lowering a folding trailer tongue with a coworker when they lost control of the towing arm. The arm caught the employee's hand, severing the right thumb and partially severing the right pinky finger.
While greasing the ring on a truck drum, an employee's index and middle fingertips were caught and amputated between the rollers and the ring.
An employee was pushing vats of chicken in the deboning area. The employee's left thumb was caught and partially amputated between two vats.
An employee was using a loader to unload an airplane when the loader caught fire and burned the employee.
An employee was repositioning an I-beam when his right middle and ring fingers were caught and partially amputated between the moving I-beam and an adjacent stationary I-beam.

An employee was emptying the grease reservoir of a deep fryer when the hot grease spilled over the edge and splashed onto her feet, causing second degree burns. She also slipped and fell, fracturing her ankle.

An employee on a ladder was operating a battery-powered screw gun while sliding jam pieces of a door when a gust of wind blew the door open, thus knocking down the ladder and employee to the ground. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and multiple contusions to his left side.

An employee was removing a wall behind a phosphate tank while working on a plank that bridged the 8-foot-tall tank. The employee fell into the phosphate tank and suffered second and third degree burns.

On October 9, 2016, an employee was loading scrap into a trailer that had an insulator sticking out of it. The trailer operator moved and the insulator struck the employee in the back near the kidney. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 9, 2016, an employee was mounting a tractor when it lurched and threw him to the ground in front of a rear wheel. The tractor then struck him, and he suffered bruises and a pelvic injury that required surgery.

At approximately 2:30 a.m., an employee was power washing the inside of a tanker. The employee got out of the tanker and said it smelled foul. Monitoring was done and no hazardous atmospheres were detected. The employee re-entered the tanker and approximately 10 minutes upon return he passed out. The employee was hospitalized and treated.
An employee was operating a forklift when he was caught between the forklift and a machine, suffering left foot fractures that required overnight hospitalization.
An employee was putting dough into the extruder machine when their right little finger was pinched, causing an avulsion.

On Sunday, October 9, 2016, at approximately 6:15 AM, an employee was exiting her vehicle in the parking lot when she lost her balance and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized for a fractured hip.

While getting off a salmon cage to board a barge, an employee grabbed the rope attached to a winch system.  The winch was in operation (lowering and raising a hose) and the employee's right hand was pulled into the winch, amputating the ring and middle fingers to the lower knuckles.

An employee went to open the door to the gin but it was stuck. When he pulled the door forcefully, it opened and pinned his right hand between the door and the metal wall. His hand suffered an abrasion.
An employee's foot was run over and broken by a forklift while traversing the job site.

An employee was performing maintenance work on top of a tumble blast machine. As he was either climbing or descending a fixed ladder on the machine, he fell backward and landed on the floor below. He hit his head on steel framing on his way down. He suffered a head laceration, a fractured jaw, abrasions, and a contusion.
An employee was installing a panel on the loading dock when he lost his balance and fell, hitting his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was pulling electric wire when an anchor bar broke and struck the employee's left leg, breaking it.
An employee was unloading a drill. The auger was still spinning. His clothing became caught on a bolt and he was caught up in the auger, suffering three fractured left ribs and bruises.
An employee was checking the water level in a fire system battery when an explosion occurred. The battery acid entered his eyes and pieces of the battery case lacerated his face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 with a mini circular saw when it became bound, jumped back, and ran over his left hand, amputating his thumb and severely lacerating his ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was unloading a truck using a pallet jack. The employee's foot was caught between the pallet he was moving and a stationary pallet resulting in a broken left ankle.
An employee was operating a time saver machine (which is similar to a wood planer but for metal) when he lost his balance and received a laceration from the thumb to the forearm.
An employee suffered a back injury after attempting to prevent a patient from falling.

An employee was helping to unload pipe from a trailer. When he attempted to roll the pipe, his left knee was pinned between a pipe stake and a trailer. He pushed the pipe back and dislodged himself. He suffered a deep knee laceration, tendon damage, and a kneecap fracture.
An employee was unhooking a flatbed trailer from a truck. The trailer dropped abruptly and pinned the employee's hand between the truck bed and the trailer.

On October 10, 2016, an employee installed an oil plug on a crowd gate lubricator. He was using a ladder to descend the crowd gate when the ladder moved. He lost his balance, started falling backward, and grabbed the machine's chain, which pulled his finger through the sprocket. The top portion of his left-hand index finger was amputated.
On 10/10/16, an employee was unjamming a hydraulic shear when his left thumb was amputated.
An employee fell off a scooter when he attempted to pick up a piece of paper that he dropped. He fractured his right hip and/or right leg and was hospitalized.

On 10/10/16, employees started a prescribed fire in a national forest to help the vegetation in the area. One employee was refueling a chainsaw to cut trees. When he uncapped the fuel tank, the hot oil boiled out of the tank and onto his right wrist, right arm, and belly, causing second and third degree burns.

On October 10, 2016, an employee was securing a load of trusses on top of a trailer with binder chains when the metal banding holding the trusses together broke, causing the load to shift and knock him off the trailer. He landed flat-footed on the ground with both feet but was knocked over and pinned beneath the trusses at ground level when they landed on his right foot and ankle. He was hospitalized with lower back and foot pain.

The crew was checking valves in the side curb pump. The injured employee was attempting to work on the suction valve while the engine was being energized. The drive line rolled the pump and the #4 plunger stroked forward and crushed his hand.
An employee's foot was caught in a transfer auger for a corn bin, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was stepping into a lime loader truck when his knee popped and he fell to the ground. He tore a ligament in his left knee.

An employee was loading equipment onto storage racks using a hoist. The hoist's up button was activated, causing the hoist hook to jump. The employee's left pinky finger was caught in the pinch point between the hook and the equipment, amputating her finger to the first knuckle.

An employee servicing a package boiler was on the forks of a forklift, attempting to move pipe. He fell approximately 8 feet off the forks and onto the concrete, suffering a head laceration (that required surgery), a broken left ring finger, three chipped vertebrae, and a potential concussion.
An employee slid off a roof and fell to the ground. A harness rope was not connected at the time.

An employee was using a 1-ton, 460V electric chain hoist to separate the inner lid of a die from the base (part of a mold die). After removing the material, the die would only partially separate or open about 6 inches. The employee lowered the hoist by a few inches and looked into the die to identify any causes as to why it was not separating. To support himself, he placed his hand on the hoist hook. When he was ready to lift the die again, he grasped the chain and his finger went between the electric hoist hook throat opening. The epoxy seal then gave way and caused an immediate tensioning of the chain, pinching his finger between the chain and throat opening. When he pulled back, his right index fingertip was amputated.

On October 10, 2016, at approximately 4:30 p.m., an employee was helping to remove a light plant generator from an excavation. A 9-foot chain was attached to telehandler forks and the light plant was lifted from the excavation and transported to a flatbed pickup truck located below a power line. While standing on the ground, the employee used his hand to guide the light plant onto the 4' high flatbed. The telehandler forks made contact with the overhead 7,200-volt line. The employee received second degree burns to his left hand, abdomen, and leg.
An employee was pushing a board though a saw blade when a splinter entered his hand. His left hand then jerked and hit the turning saw blade, amputating his left thumb above the knuckle.
An employee was lifting a 1,000-pound piece with a magnetic lifting device. The piece fell and struck the employee's right arm, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized after he was shot in the leg.  The employee was in the parking lot after getting off shift.  The gun was in his backpack that dropped on the floor, setting the gun off.
An employee was removing a net from underneath an airline metal pallet (PMC) when the cargo pallet broke and fell from a forklift onto the employee's thumb, amputating it.

An employee was transferring small boxes that were inside a large wooden crate that was stationed on a shelving unit about 18 feet up. The employee was using a mobile platform ladder to reach the boxes. A coworker was operating a forklift and had raised a pallet to where the employee was working. As the employee was transferring the small boxes onto the pallet, the wooden crate became dislodged from its current position on the shelving unit. When the employee attempted to straighten the wood crate, he lost his balance and fell, first hitting the pallet that was raised and then the ground below. He suffered a compression fracture and lacerations to his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was servicing a gas boiler system and was burned on the head/face due to a faulty gas valve.
An employee was stepping out of the elevator when her foot was caught on the 1/2-inch rise from the elevator floor to the work floor. She tripped and fractured her left wrist, requiring surgery.

On 10/11/2016 at 7:00 p.m., an employee was standing on the top level of an auto hauler trailer when he lost his balance and fell off.  There were no railings on that part of the trailer and he fell 10-11 ft. to the ground.  The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull, fractured collar bone, 2 fractured ribs, and bleeding in the brain.
An employee was standing on the floor while plumbing a line on a wall when a passing scissor lift struck the employee, breaking the employee's left fibula and left shoulder blade.

An employee was changing over the nozzles on an injection molding machine. When he went to unbolt the manifold, molten plastic sprayed in his face. He sustained second degree burns to the front and right side of his face.
An employee was struck by a piece of wood while operating the diagonal tooth machine, requiring arm surgery.
An employee fell from a 6-foot step ladder while replacing ceiling tiles and suffered a fractured wrist.
While unloading trash into a dumpster during roofing activities, an employee fell approximately 15 feet onto an I-beam, breaking ribs.

Employee #1 was operating a stand-up forklift with forks trailing, headed south on a dock area.
 Employee #2 was also operating a stand-up forklift with forks trailing in the direction of employee #1. Employee #1 stopped his forklift to activate a door's pull cord to enter a freezer when his forklift was struck by the forklift of employee #2. 
The back-to-back impact caused Employee #2's left foot to become caught between both forklifts, fracturing the big toe and partially amputating the fourth toe.
An employee was operating a pulling unit on a rig when he tripped on a pipe, fell,  and broke his leg.

An employee was hooking up airlines to his truck from the trailer. He was 3 feet off the ground when he fell from the truck to the concrete parking lot. He suffered rib injuries and a concussion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was clearing a jam on the pan washing station conveyor when the employee's left ring finger was caught between two pans, amputating the fingertip.

An employee parked outside on the side of the street. When he opened his van's back door, a box fell out of the van and went into the ditch. As he attempted to get the box, he fell several feet into the ditch and broke his left tibia in his lower left leg.
A slide gate closed on and severely cut an employee's left wrist, resulting in a left hand amputation.

On October 10, 2016, an employee was installing and positioning a regulator on a platform. His left hand was holding the base of the regulator about 1.5 inches above the tie down when his second fingertip was pinched between the regulator and the platform. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
While installing cable at a residential home, an employee fell approximately 16 feet off a step ladder and broke a leg.
An employee was using a hydro-blaster with water when the wand ran over his foot, causing an open wound that required surgery.
An employee was working on a vehicle at the hospital when his thumb was caught between the frame and the switch, amputating his thumb at the joint.
An employee was conducting maintenance when a restraint failed on an air driven system, allowing a door to close on and crush the employee's hand.

An employee was troubleshooting a machine. The hydraulic clamps were not functioning properly. When the employee placed his hand on the side of the heater, the clamp closed, pinching and amputating his left middle finger.
An employee was delivering mail when she tripped over a water hose. She fell and fractured her left and right wrist.
An employee suffered two fingertip amputations when they were caught in a machine's belt and pulley during an inspection. The machine was LOTO at the time.

An employee and a coworker strapped an industrial site plan printer onto a forklift's long skid to take it to the second floor. The employee was on the forklift's skids when he fell 10 feet to the first floor of the warehouse, suffering lower back injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was loading a truck when a dock plate became stuck. As a coworker lifted the dock plate with a forklift, the employee pulled a pin on the plate and it fell on him, breaking his pelvis.
While rigging wire, an employee slipped and fell off a truck, breaking a wrist and ribs.

An employee was pumping a pipe pump and unhooked the air hose when she noticed something was still in the pump. As she attempted to wipe it out, the pump amputated the distal part of her right middle finger.
An employee was installing components on an aircraft when he fell approximately 24 inches from his work platform to the ground, fracturing his right tibia.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction in the store. At the hospital, she was given medication. The employee reacted badly to the medication and was hospitalized.
Three agents were unloading a transporter when one agent's foot was caught between the transporter and container loader when the driver pulled ahead causing several fractures in his right foot.

While descending the stairs of fertilizer-applying equipment, an employee fell approximately 3 feet to the concrete surface below and struck the right side of the forehead, suffering a hematoma and brain bleed.

An employee was retrieving cleaning materials from a rolling cart to detail a car when a car drove into the area, crashed into another vehicle and that vehicle struck the rolling cart. The cart then struck the employee and pushed her into a wall. She was hospitalized with broken ribs and a broken pelvis.
An employee was injured in a natural gas explosion.

An employee was operating a tube winder when three of his right-hand fingers were caught in the main winding belt. His pointer finger was surgically amputated to the first knuckle, and his ring finger broke and required surgery.
An employee was changing a tire using a tire machine when it pinched/amputated his right middle fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was responding to an emergency gas leak when an explosion occurred nearby. The employee suffered multiple injuries, including bone fractures.
An employee was trying to remove a trash can from a certain spot. When he attempted to move a pallet jack out the way, it ran over his right foot.
An employee was closing a clamp that was under pressure when it slipped out of his hand and struck him below the eye on the cheek bone.

An employee was emptying trash into a compactor using a 1/2-ton tilt truck. He attempted to lift and dump the tilt truck up and over the compactor's gate bar when it fell. As he grabbed the bottom stabilizer bar, it caught and partially amputated his right middle finger.

While servicing a valve, an employee sent a solenoid to the valve to open it and see if the rubber seat was damaged. The solenoid coil disconnected, which interrupted the solenoid signal and caused the valve to close on the employee's thumb. The thumb had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when his foot was caught between the lift and a column, fracturing his left ankle and heel.
An employee was using a pressure washer to clean sludge in the bottom of a pit when the pressure washer's water stream penetrated the employee's boot and was injected into the top of the left foot.
An employee was straightening a hose when he tripped on the screening blower line and fell down, fracturing his right hip.
On October 11, at 11:00 a.m., an employee tripped while walking across the floor and suffered broken facial bones, a severe laceration to the hand, and a severe knee contusion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a bucket truck and cutting a branch. The bucket had a winch attached to a branch that was cut. The branch slipped and flung the employee from a height of 50 feet. The employee suffered broken bones, contusions, cuts, and scrapes.

An employee was removing cabinets from a second-story apartment, which was under construction. The employee was walking onto the plywood and 2X4 box, which was being lifted by a forklift, when the box, cabinet, and employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee suffered two broken wrists, facial fractures, and a dislocated/broken right elbow.
An employee was stung by a bee and had an allergic reaction.

An employee was moving a mobile marination powder mixing tank. As he tumbled the tumbler, his finger was smashed between the mixing tank and the door hinge on the tumbler. He sustained a right pinky tissue amputation.

An employee climbed a ladder after retrieving ice/water shield and was hooking up to fall protection when ice/water shield fell. The employee and the ice/water shield went over the edge (4/5 pitch). The employee fell about 30 feet and suffered a broken arm and leg.

An employee was finalizing a load for transport on a flatbed trailer. When finished, the employee used a chain to descend to the ground. The opposite end of the chain was not connected to anything and the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured pelvis.
A front end loader drove over a heavy steel plate (the panel/side of a trench box) that was lying on the ground. The contact caused the panel to strike and break an adjacent employee's leg.

On October 12, 2016, at 3:10 p.m., two employees were setting up to cut the main 8" gas pipe to install a new pipeline when the pipe coupling failed and the pipe exploded. Debris struck the employees, who suffered facial lacerations and fractures. Both employees were hospitalized.

On 10/12/2016, an employee was squaring up steel with a sledgehammer to cut it with a saw. While he was swinging the sledgehammer, the head of the hammer missed the steel and instead smashed his right index finger between the hammer handle and the steel, lacerating and fracturing his fingertip. His fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was preparing to pour concrete for a bridge tower/column. He was descending the tower when he fell approximately 16 feet to the ground, breaking his right-side hip and ribs.
An employee's left hand was caught in the outfeed roller while straightening lumber on the lumber deck with a metal pole.
An employee closed her finger in the door when leaving the office. As a result her left index finger was broken.
An employee missed a step and fell from a stationary semi-truck injuring their back.
An employee suffered a lower back strain while lifting and placing boxes of material onto a dry wall cart.

An employee was driving a yard spotting truck when the trailer containing empty bottles became unstable, leaned to the right and fell on the right side causing the truck to go up in the air. The employee fell about 8 feet from the truck's cabin to the ground resulting in a head fracture. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was in a bucket truck with a jib (rope and pulley system). The employee was using the pulley system to pull up an insulator. While trying to pull up the insulator, the employee's hand was caught between the rope and the pulley resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

Employees were installing an 8 inch pipeline and one employee was hospitalized as the result of a pipe failure. The employee's injuries included facial lacerations and fractures to the nose and forehead.
An employee was working on a loose bagasse feeder belt when his right finger come into contact with the belt resulting in amputation.

An employee was painting a pad transformer (6ft. x 5ft. x 6 ft.) inside the paint booth. The employee was standing on top of a roll around platform ladder when he fell approximately 6 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken arm and a hairline fracture to the pelvis.
On October 12, 2016, an employee was attempting to close the sidewall curtains on the north calf hutch and was hit in the neck with the crank.

The employee was traveling on his PIT to put it away and plug it into to a stationary charger stored on the second tier of racking. As he approached the area to park the PIT, he noticed the charging cord hanging down from the racking. He stopped and reached to move the cord and the truck moved forward catching his fingers between the truck and the racks.
An employee was cleaning magnets while standing on a step ladder. The employee slipped while stepping off the ladder and fractured the left ankle.

While separating bundles of steel joist, the joist became stuck and an employee used a pry bar to dislodge the joist. The employee attempted to separate the joist with his hands. The joist shifted and pinched the employee's right index finger resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was installing wood backers for a roof and he tripped over the backer. His left arm hit a sharp valley in the metal causing a laceration when he fell. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee cut a finger and was hospitalized while moving a piece of metal in a storage closet.
A temporary employee was operating a packaging machine and amputated the right index finger. The guard was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee received an electric shock with the wrench cable the employee was holding made contact with the power line.
An employee was working a roller line and was struck by a pipe when the roller line was started resulting in a lower leg amputation.

At 6:30AM on 10/12/16, a crane truck was being setup to load a sign and the truck's outriggers were being setup to stabilize the truck. The injured employee was on the passenger back-side of the truck holding the man basket in place so that the swivel of the basket would not come in contact with tubing on the crane. As he was holding the crane basket, the back outrigger came down and crushed his right foot. Four toes were amputated at the hospital.
An employee was working at the selection area and his hand contacted a moving conveyor belt resulting in a laceration to the left index finger.

An employee's left ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle on October 12, 2016. While the employee was loading a part on a CNC machine, his hand was caught between the casting and the clamp. The employee was not wearing gloves at the time.
An employee servicing a wood chipper suffered a partial am[utation of the right ring finger after going under the machine to engage the belt. The chipper was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
Employees were cutting a water main when a pressurized pipe burst and struck them, causing contusions and lacerations.
An employee suffered an amputation when a die press fell on his hand.
An employee was cleaning up granules that spilled onto the floor from a vent hole at the resin transfer system and amputated the left index fingertip.
While rotating a motor housing on an auxiliary oil pump, an employee's left ring finger was pinched in the bolt hole resulting in the loss of left ring fingertip.
An employee was descending from a tree when the rope came untied from the saddle and the employee fell approximately 25-30 feet fracturing the left hip and several ribs.
On October 12, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after a leg became pinned between a piece of powered equipment and a support beam.

An employee was attempting to remove a 1/2 inch drill bit from a battery operated drill equipped with a keyless chuck. The employee was wearing cotton rubber palm gloves and squeezing the keyless chuck to remove the bit. As he pushed the trigger increasing the torque to the keyless chuck his grip slipped and the bit caught the fingertip of his glove twisting it and his fingertip into the bit causing lacerations and a fracture to the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee conducted a pull test on deck tie downs. He then went to move the test unit to dislodge the hook and the swivel nut and all thread shaft shifted catching the employee's right middle fingertip between the test unit foundation and swivel nut. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was attempting to secure a material basket and was struck by the basket fracturing the left thumb.

A temporary employee was riding on the passenger side of a yard waste truck. When the employee got out of the truck as it approached waste cans, the right front truck tire drove over his left foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning up under the chipper. The machine was live and the belt caught his glove, pulling his arm into the belt and fracturing it.

An employee was in the process of installing steel shelving for a meat locker. The employee climbed up 8-10 feet on the side of the shelving unit, lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for face and mouth contusions.

An employee was pressing a small steel bracket against a rotating sanding wheel with his hands and fingers to smooth the edge. The bracket flew out of his hand and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was operating a backhoe to lift a pipe. He got off the backhoe to remove a plug from the pipe and the backhoe rolled and pinned the employee between the pipe and the backhoe causing a right femur fracture.
An employee was bitten by a pet rat that was being triaged for veterinary treatment. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery when the bite became infected.
An employee was moving metal material when their finger was caught between the metal and wooden cribbing. The left ring finger was amputated above the upper knuckle.

An employee was clearing a blockage in a pipeline and proceeded to blow the line with compressed air. There was a filter screen in the line. The lid on top of the filter screen blew off the filter striking the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured nose and other facial bones.

On October 13, 2016, an employee was troubleshooting a squealing roller on a conveyor. The guard was removed and the employee tapped on the roller with a hammer. The roller caught the hammer and pulled his finger into it. He was transferred to the hospital where the left index finger was amputated at the first joint.

Prior to a welding job, an employee was unscrewing the cap on the acetylene tank and turning on the valve to check if any fuel was left when it ignited resulting in burns to his right hand and forearm. He was admitted to the hospital.
Employees were cutting metal. A piece of cut metal fell and struck an employee on the back causing a laceration.
An employee was working behind the counter and was shot in the back.

An employee who had just climbed onto a roof approximately 9 feet 2 inches in height after his lunch break was in the process of securing his fall protection when he slipped and fell off the roof fracturing the left ankle.
An employee was resizing parts in a press machine and amputated the finger print portion of his left middle finger. Lockout/tagout controls were not in place at the time of the incident.

An employee was on an extension ladder working on a cable TV system. The cable broke while he was climbing and the ladder shifted. The employee fell 12 feet landing on his right leg sustaining a compression fracture just above the ankle.

An employee was rigging supersized bags of etibor material. After rigging the bag, one of the top bags rolled off the stack and struck the employee who sustained a broken shoulder blade, broken right pelvic bone, and detached right ankle.

An employee was cleaning a moving conveyor with a spray hose. The employee stopped the conveyor to access a particular area that needed cleaning. The conveyor started back up and the employee's arm was caught in the conveyor causing a fracture and laceration.

Employees were picking up a piece of pipe that was about 5 inches wide and 42 inches in diameter to load it on a trailer when the pipe shifted and struck an employee on the left thigh pinning his leg between the pipe and the trailer. The employee was admitted to the hospital for surgery on his broken left tibia.
An employee was cleaning a jam in the cryo-vac machine and caught the left index fingertip on the propeller resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was adjusting a fixture in a hydraulic press and amputated the right index finger behind the nail bed.

An employee was leaning against the truck frame in the back of the truck with his hand resting on the edge of the frame close to the truck's mud flap spring release. A student unknowingly pushed down on the spring amputating the employee's left pinky fingertip.

On 10/13/2016 at approximately 5:30 am, an employee was cleaning a film tear out of a film line MDO roll section when his right hand got caught in the film line MDO roll section and was crushed.  The employee was hospitalized and the right hand was amputated the next day.

An employee standing at the end of a production line reached inside a bin that contained 30-75 lbs. of rubber. A bin shifted, pinching the employee's finger between a bin and the roller. A piece of the skin on the employee's middle finger was pulled off.
An employee suffered the amputation of four right hand fingers after their hand was caught in the smooth mill.
An employee was removing debris from the panel saw and amputated the right index fingertip.
On October 13, 2016, an employee received a hip and leg injury when the employee entered a 10' trenching (cave protected) to repair a main water line and a cap located on a 12' water line blew.
An employee was attempting to clear a clogged fryer line. Chemical had been left in the drain line and when the hot oil hit the chemical and water, the employee was burned on the upper body.

An employee was unloading dirt for a bridge construction site. The raised dump bed made contact with an overhead power line. The employee exited the dump truck, placing his feet on the ground, and was shocked resulting in electrical burns to his left hand, left hamstring, all toes and feet.
An employee was picking up a part from the floor, lost balance and fell cracking his hip.
An employee was unjamming the tapper machine and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee suffered electrical burns to both hands and fingers while removing the alpha-phase tap from the bushing of a recloser.
An employee was using an air powered nail gun and shot a nail into their left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was recalibrating the fryer and adjusting the vent above the fryer from a table. The employee fell and injured the right wrist.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck by a load that slid off while attempting to secure it onto a trailer and crushed his legs.

An employee was working on the roof structure of a stadium to install structural steel. The employee was using a wire rope to pull a 600 pound steel beam when the beam fell from the roof structure. The employee's hand was caught in the wire rope causing the tip and left side of the employee's left pinky finger to be separated from the bone, but still attached.
An operator slipped and fell off his excavator landing on a drainage pipe. The employee was hospitalized for a lower back fracture.

An employee was attaching a connection to the wellhead for treatment when a stream of high pressured natural gas caused the following injuries to the employee: facial Injuries, right punctured lung, and a torn esophagus. The employee was hospitalized.
On October 13, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after an arm was pulled into a machine during a cleaning activity.

An employee was checking the alignment on a blasting machine while it was locked out. The injured employee reached into the machine to check clearance when another employee rotated the wheel by hand. The injured employee suffered the amputation of 3/16 of the index finger.
An employee pinched a nerve in his back while lifting luggage.

An employee was using a PIT to carry a plastic 55 gallon drum. The drum became wedged between the forks. When the employee tried to maneuver the drum, his pinky finger was caught resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was performing electrical work on a 15-20 foot fiberglass extension ladder. Upon completion of work, the employee was descending the ladder when the ladder's legs kicked out causing the employee to fall. The employee sustained a broken jaw and injured an arm.
An employee was servicing an HVAC unit when their left forefinger was caught between a pulley and belt when the return air fan was activated. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was repairing a car using a ball joint press and a hammer. The hammer broke and a part of it lodged in his stomach. The employee suffered a puncture wound resulting in a blood clot.

The employee was working as a shackle chuck. He places a shackle on the beef quarter so that it can be moved to a different department. He noticed some gloves on top of a rotating sprocket above his work area. He reached his right arm to grab the gloves and his sleeve was caught in the chain, drawing his right arm into the sprocket and fracturing the radius and ulna.
An employee was cleaning a running pump and amputated the left middle fingertip.

An employee was working on the press and switching a roll of paper on the machine. The roll shaft was stuck in a roll of paper and as he was pushing it out his left hand was caught, crushing four fingers between the roll and the shaft.
An employee became ill and was subsequently hospitalized that same afternoon due to a noxious odor in the building.

An employee was climbing up the crane's fixed ladder to access the deck of the crane in order to work on the jib bracket. As he climbed onto the deck, he lost balance and fell about 4 feet to the ground resulting in a broken left fibula. He was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was unjamming a piece of equipment and two fingers were caught resulting in a deep laceration to one finger and a fingertip amputation on the other.
An employee was cleaning out a gin stand and slipped. Two fingertips on the right hand were amputated when they contacted a sharp edge inside the cotton gin.
A temporary employee operating a "Set Out Press" amputated half an inch of a finger while retrieving a metal part from the press.

An employee was adjusting a 30" diameter PVC vertical stand pipe. There were some bricks holding up the casting, acting as adjustment shims. The employee stepped on one of the bricks as he was going to take the casting off of the vertical stand pipe. The brick, which was now underneath his foot, was on a gravel base and rolled out from under his foot as he lifted the casting off of the pipe causing the employee to lose his balance. As he was falling, his right arm and shoulder area landed in the center of the vertical stand pipe and his right upper chest area landed on the sidewall of the pipe. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was operating the rubber mill. His left hand was on the controls when his right hand reached under the rubber mill and was caught between the two rollers resulting in multiple finger amputations.
The worker was rotating the "setting tool" and placed their left middle finger inside the tool. The finger was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee just completed repairing the sewer line and was backfilling the trench. As the employee was removing the wheeler, it impacted the employee's left foot and fractured it.

An employee was waiting for a guardrail to be set in place by a fork lift so it could be anchored. After the guardrail was in place, the employee attempted to line up the guardrail with the anchor spots with her foot. The guardrail fell away from her into a post and came back toward her striking her left leg and fracturing the tibia.

On October 14, 2016, an employee had her finger in a pivot point on a backhoe assembly to determine if the two holes were aligned. The employee operated a hydraulic control that moved the pivot point and amputated her right index finger. The pivot point on the backhoe assembly was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee loading materials onto the roof fell through a skylight approximately 25 feet resulting in broken ribs and back.
An employee was operating the hydraulic press brake. The pull back safety device malfunctioned and the employee's right thumb was caught in the machinery resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

The employee had just completed a drywall delivery and was walking down the entrance ramp to clean the area when his feet got caught in the green strapping material. The employee fell onto a piece of metal pipe and broke his lower right leg.

An employee was preparing to pick up a dumpster and empty it. As the employee was unhooking the winch line from the rear of the truck, the employee's hand was on the hook/line and he inadvertently activated the winch reel in control instead of the reel out.  The line tightened and caught his left middle fingertip between it and the truck body resulting in amputation at the first joint.
A worker was performing maintenance work on an air handling unit when his hand was caught between the belt and sheave, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was positioning a rock and smashed his fingertips resulting in an amputation.
An employee suffered an amputation injury to the left thumb while using a chop saw.
A piece of rebar was lifted with a front end loader. The rebar slid off and struck an employee causing neck and shoulder injuries.

The employee was leading a group of clients on a bike ride when she came to a temporary construction walkway. The employee swerved to avoid a shoe in the middle of the walkway at which point a 2 x 4 wooden plank that was sticking out into the walkway got caught in her front wheel. The employee fell off her bike onto her left side and was hospitalized with broken ribs and a fractured back.
An employee was hospitalized on 10/15/16 when diagnosed with advanced cellulitis on his right leg resulting from puncture wounds from thorny vegetation indigenous to the patrol area.
An employee was conducting regular maintenance of a motor on the pumping equipment. The motor was running and the employee's hand was crushed.
An employee fell and hit his head while trying to run away from a dog. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting rollers that were not lined up to move boxes of plastic pellets when his finger was caught between the rollers resulting in an amputation.
An employee felt stressed and light headed and had a cardiac event. She was hospitalized.

The employee was cleaning the plate heat exchangers when a mechanical system failure resulted in the release of pressurized steam (30-35 psi). The employee was hospitalized for burns to the stomach, groin, and both arms.
An employee was drying the exterior of a car and amputated the left index finger when she closed the door on her finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was pushing a wheeled cart loaded with rectangular weights. The cart struck a wall causing the weights to shift and strike his fingers. The employee's left ring finger was cut and broken.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of wood. The saw got stuck in a knot in the wood. The employee tried to free the saw from the knot and the blade amputated the left middle and index fingers.
An employee was hospitalized with a broken left arm after being struck by a forklift.

An employee was watching for oncoming traffic while a fellow worker was installing wiring on a light pole. The employee was struck by a motor vehicle that was driving illegally in reverse down a one way street in the wrong direction. The employee sustained a sprained right ankle, contusions to the left hip, thigh and forearm and lacerations to the left side of the face.
An employee was exiting the postal vehicle, stepped on a rock and fell to the ground breaking the left hip.

An employee was working on the ground aligning the bottom of a 13 3/8" casing joint into the drilling rig v-door by hand. A winch on the rig floor was lifting the joint top through the v-door. The winch line was lowered causing the bottom of the pipe to slide into the injured employee's left foot resulting in a compound ankle fracture.

While an employee was pulling out secondary backing to make a waste collection bag at the scales for warp waste, the employee's feet became tangled in waste on the floor. The employee fell to the ground and fractured the right femur and right hip.
An employee was picking product while standing on a hoisted pallet. The employee then fell from the pallet to a concrete slab, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking through the dining room when she slipped and fell on the recently mopped floor. She landed on her left knee and then rolled on to her right side. She was hospitalized with a fractured left tibia and fractured left patella.

An employee was operating a standup forklift to unload a trailer and set up a line. Her left foot became pinned between the vehicle and a wall. She was hospitalized with a fractured left foot and contusions/bruising, requiring surgery.

An employee was observing a packer/hopper assembly that he had just finished when the hydraulic fitting failed and he was struck by the hydraulic hose and sprayed with hydraulic fluid. He then fell backward and struck the back and top of his head on a solid square object located approximately 5 feet behind his observation point. He suffered a small cut to the skin on the right side of his neck, bruising from the cut down across his right clavicle, bruises to the back of his neck, and a scrape to the top of his head.

An employee was measuring duct for insulation while standing on a sheet of plywood that had been laid across the beams of the ceiling. The end of the platform was extending over a beam, so when the employee stepped on the end of the plywood he fell approximately 8 feet. He fractured seven ribs and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was using a rag to clean a bagger machine on the gear side when the rag became tangled in a gear and pulled his hand into the machine, amputating his right middle finger and crushing other bones in his hand.
An employee was operating a utility task vehicle and going uphill when the vehicle rolled over backwards and rolled down the hill. The employee suffered a lacerated head and four fractures.
An employee's hand slipped while he was sanding the metal part on a 12-inch sanding machine, catching and partially amputating his right thumb between the part and the sanding disk.

An employee was standing under a crane's boom while a coworker released the stow pin to disconnect a jib from the crane's boom. Once the coworker pulled the stow pin, the heavy side of the jib drifted down and made contact with the employee, dislocating his hip.
An employee was leaning against a wooden handrail when it broke, causing him to fall to the ground. He broke his upper right arm and required surgery.
On October 17, 2016, an employee was walking across a furnace top when he slipped and his foot entered a furnace. He suffered a third degree burn to his foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing spoils from the tailgate of a dump truck using a scraper (flat shovel). While maneuvering near the tailgate, he tripped over a dirt clod roughly the size of a basketball and fell on the ground. He got up and fell again, breaking his left ankle, tibia, and fibula and requiring surgery.
An employee tripped over a door threshold and fell on his face, breaking his neck and lacerating his face.
While walking between registers, an employee slipped and fell to the floor, breaking a leg.
An employee walked outside to talk with a supervisor. While walking past a trailer hitch on the back of a pickup truck, she tripped and fell onto the pavement, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking, suffering a fractured fibula and superficial abrasions.

An employee was rebuilding an intensifier on a high-pressure pump when the machine became energized by a remote operator. The piston on the pump extended on a hydraulic cylinder while the employee's hands were in the machine, pinching and amputating a finger between the cylinder and machine.
An employee was fastening cargo nets to a pallet when his right index fingertip was pinched and amputated between the pallet and the pallet net lock.
An employee was walking towards the printer in the front office when she hit her right foot on her co-worker's desk. She fell forward onto her right side and dislocated her hip requiring surgery.

On or about October 24, 2016, an employee and his coworker attempted to jumpstart a car. As one car was pulled up to the other, the employee's knee was pinched between the two cars. He was hospitalized and required surgery for a broken knee.
An employee was entering the plant through the door when it hit and pushed him. He lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his right hip.
An employee was working at the cash register when she passed out, fell, and hit her head on the floor. She was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading acrylonitrile from a railcar. He pressure checked the setup, found a leak, and attempted to relieve pressure from the system by removing a bull plug from the bleed location in the piping. The bleed valve was not closed at the time. Material then released from the piping system through the open valve and sprayed the employee's upper abdomen. He was hospitalized.

At approximately 8:04 a.m., on October 17, 2016, an employee was counting stacked sheet metal when she was struck by a pallet being carried by an oncoming forklift. She fell and struck her right side on the concrete working surface, fracturing her hip.
On 10/17/16, an employee was hospitalized due to heat-stress-related exhaustion.
On October 17, 2016, an employee was attempting to clean scale out of a pipe when hot water back-flowed from the pipe and injured the employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a trim cell unit where engine blocks are trimmed out. As he was picking up the block, he was wearing a hot mill style glove. His pinky went into the chain belt and was caught between the backside of the chain belt and the guard. His left pinky finger was amputated.
A steel beam fell onto an employee's left foot, crushing four toes.
An employee was walking when she twisted her ankle, lost her balance, and fell, fracturing her right wrist as she braced her fall.
While walking to a truck to get materials, an employee slipped on an empty bag and fell backwards onto a concrete block, injuring the lower back vertebrae.
An employee fell while walking during rounds as a security guard and suffered a broken left shoulder and right arm, as well as a facial injury.

On Monday, October 17, 2016, an employee was at her carrier case on the workroom floor and bent down to pick up a mail tub to load into a hamper. When she lifted the tub, she felt a pop in her back and experienced a lot of pain. She was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was using scissors to cut a piece of plastic when the scissors cut and amputated her left index fingertip.

An employee was repairing a gas leak when a dead tree fell and struck a nearby excavator. A piece of the tree then struck the employee in the head. The employee suffered fractures to the neck vertebrae, back vertebrae, and ribs.
An employee was standing to the side of the road flagging traffic when a vehicle veered off the road and struck him, fracturing his tibia and ribs.
An employee was struck in the ankle when an 11-pound metal part fell off a rack.

Employees were installing grating that consisted of 4 sheets (approximately 4 feet by 5 feet), cumulatively weighing approximately 800 pounds. When the employees disconnected the load from the crane, they realized the corner of the grating rested on the edge of an existing guard rail toe plate. The injured employee attempted to lift the grating upwards while his coworker used a spud wrench to shift the grating off the toe plate. The grating shifted and caught the injured employee's left index finger between the grating and structural steel. He suffered an avulsion to his left index finger flesh beneath his fingertip, which was crushed and cut. He required surgery and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was refilling a gas powered pressure washer when some gasoline spilled onto the hot muffler and ignited, burning his hands.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet while securing a ladder to a building. She landed on her back and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning in the facility when hot water entered their boot and burned their right calf.

An employee was unjamming a pipe in a grinder machine. As the pipe loosened, the door to the grinder slammed shut on his right ring fingertip, amputating it from the tip to the middle of the fingernail.
An employee had an adverse response to a flu shot, suffering a headache and shortness of breath.

An employee was performing crane/hoist operations and was directed to shutdown operations and move the crane to another location. The employee was preparing to lock the boom for storage when the crane operator energized and activated the carriage boom, causing the boom pinhole to slide and pinch/amputate the employee's right thumb and right index finger.
While delivering mail, an employee was stung by an insect and experienced an adverse reaction.

An employee was at a client worksite cleaning some rust off a 3 ft. x 4 ft. metal part with an electric drill and a drill bit brush. The drill bit broke and the drill bit/brush lacerated the back of his left hand.

The employee was sitting on a static (not operational) skid steer bucket when he stood up and began walking to the compressor work truck. As he walked away from the skid steer bucket, he attempted to step over the angled right side of the bucket. At this point the employee tripped on the right side of the bucket and fell, putting his right arm down in an attempt to break his fall. There was a steel pothole cover nearby that was inverted, with a 12-16 in. appendage that extends out. The employee struck this pothole appendage with his right elbow as he fell, resulting in a shattered right elbow. Employee was admitted to the hospital where he received surgery for the injury.
An employee collided with a cart of empty plastic bottles that was being pushed by a coworker, suffering a head injury.

An employee was digging a ditch underneath a digger derrick that was lifting a transformer onto a pole. The rope holding the transformer broke and the transformer fell, hitting and fracturing the employee's arm, leg, and heel.
An employee lacerated the index and middle fingers while cutting ham with a band saw.

On October 18, 2016, at 4:15 p.m. a temporary employee was caught between the metal building insulation (MBI) machine and the push off bar on the machine while reaching over the machine to pull insulation. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting sections of a vertical pipe (shaft for a valve). When he pushed the last cut section out of the way, the pipe fell straight down and pinned his fingers between the pipe welds, breaking his right-hand middle and index fingers.
An employee fell approximately 10 to 12 feet off a mixing tank platform while adding polymer from bags into the tank, fracturing his ribs.

An employee was speaking to a coworker in a truck when he was struck by another coworker's reversing pickup truck. He was caught between the two vehicles and suffered soft tissue damage that required overnight hospitalization.

The employee was attempting to couple a pipe trailer to a hitch on a backhoe and got a finger caught between the coupler on the trailer and the receiver on the backhoe after lifting it to connect the two. The right index finger was amputated.

An employee was testing a prototype hydro-pad cylinder in a confined area at the maintenance shop. As the employee was putting a spacer (cone) into the cylinder, it twisted very fast via air power. When he went to stop it, his left index finger became wedged between the cone and the pipe. His left index finger was amputated above the knuckle and required surgery.

An employee was performing electrical work from a 6-foot ladder. He was coming down the ladder when it slipped and he fell with it. He suffered a broken right tibia and fractured two other bones in his foot/ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing metal roofing panels when he lost his balance, slipped, and fell 14 feet to the concrete floor below. He suffered a head injury, fractured skull, broken ribs, and minor internal injuries.
An employee partially amputated the left index finger while using a 9-inch chef's knife to chop food.
An employee was operating a 60-ton press to cut steel and amputated the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee broke his left leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering mail from her vehicle. She pulled over to reload mail from the back of the vehicle to the front of the vehicle. As she dismounted her vehicle, she fell on uneven gravel and twisted her ankle. Her left ankle broke and required surgery.
An employee was pinned between a pickup truck that rolled forward and a skid steer resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was making a delivery when he was pushed to the ground by an unknown assailant, suffering two pelvic fractures.
An employee was using a table saw when his hand slipped and contacted the saw, breaking one finger and cutting off the knuckle on another finger.
While driving a forklift with a bale of scrap on its load, an employee descended to cut metal wires on the bale and was caught between the forklift and a table, bruising his chest.
An employee was making a delivery at a restaurant when he fell out of his truck to the ground, fracturing both wrists and an elbow.

An employee was evaluating a defaulted/de-energized trolley kart when the trolley kart self-energized and rapidly moved toward the employee. The employee was struck by the trolley kart and pinned between a conveyor and the bumper of the kart causing a laceration to the left inner thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to open a gas cover/cap when a flash fire occurred and burned the employee's face.
An employee tripped and fell over a step while going through a doorway, breaking his right arm.
An employee was preparing a pipe flange for paint when the pipe ruptured causing a release of trichlorosilane. The employee sustained chemical burns to the left hand, forearm and hip.
An employee was on his security rounds at a customer's site when he stubbed his toe on a metal plate. His toe broke and required overnight hospitalization.

An employee was raking parts off the top of a slow moving conveyor (4.5"/minute) when a loud noise startled him and his finger entered a gap between the conveyor and the exit chute. The chute then shifted and dropped pinching his finger and removing his nail and fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress related illness following training exercises.
An employee amputated their right ring finger while in the process of washing wooden pallets. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was hospitalized for respiratory issues after working in the building throughout the day while the elevator was painted from the roof of the building. The paint fumes were pulled into the building via the ventilation system.

An employee was stacking rods to space out a pump. His finger was caught between the polishing rod and load cell resulting in the traumatic amputation of the distal and middle phalanx at the proximal interphalangeal joint of the right index finger.

An employee was injured in a motor vehicle accident in a construction zone when another driver crossed over the center line and struck their vehicle head on. The employee was transported to a hospital for a broken jaw and other physical injuries.
An employee was a passenger in a UTV that a customer was driving. The UTV overturned and the employee's right arm was fractured.
An employee was coming down from a six foot ladder, lost his footing, and fell landing on a concrete walkway and breaking both fibulas.

An employee was driving a golf cart when he lost control and flipped the vehicle. The employee sustained a broken collar bone, five broken ribs, and pulmonary contusions. A safety belt was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was working the strip line and reported the smell of fumes suspected to be hydrogen chloride (HCl). The employee was hospitalized for headache, nausea and a sore throat.

An employee made contact with a live electrical utility wire during construction of a 3 phase line. The energy entered the right hand and exited the left big toe, leaving a 1/2 inch exit wound and causing cardiac arrest.
An employee was cleaning a carcass wash cabinet when the cabinet lid came down and lacerated his right pinky finger.  During treatment, the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was hospitalized for a cat bit on the finger.
An employee fell approximately 18 feet  through an open roof hole and was hospitalized for a back injury and head laceration.
An employee was on a ladder changing a light bulb and fell striking his head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a combiner box when his wrench crossed the D.C. cable and shorted out. His right hand was burned.
An employee was relieving residual nitrogen pressure on returned empty product cylinders and was exposed to methyl bromide vapors. The employee suffered second degree chemical burns.

An employee was injured when the brakes on a flatbed truck did not work. As a result, the flatbed collided with an A/C unit on the ground. The employee hit his right knee on the dash. As the employee walked upstairs to report the incident, the employee fell and injured his other knee.

An employee was working in the electrical box changing out an fuse block and replacing it with a motor circuit breaker. The employee made contact with a live component and an arc flash occurred causing burns to the employee's face, both hands, and forearms.

An employee was freeing a jammed wood product (veneer panel plywood) from a saw line workstation.  While freeing the jammed plywood from the grader bin, the operator pinned/pinched his arm between a piece of metal angle iron (under a load) and the metal cross member causing a puncture wound on his right arm below the bicep.
On October 19, 2016, approximately 7:30 AM, an employee fell approximately 5 feet while dismounting a front-end loader. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.
An employee closed their right thumb in the safe door resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was feeding wire to a wire stripping machine when he noticed that the wire had a loop in it. He reached to get the loop out and while his left thumb was in the loop the machine tightened the loop resulting in the amputation of the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was unchocking a piece of equipment when his right hand was caught by the machine belt amputating the fourth finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a 500 pound box. The box slipped and bent her right hand backwards shattering the wrist.
On October 19, 2016 at 9:40 p.m. an employee entered a compactor to get his glove and the compactor broke both legs.  The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were installing helical piers at a residential location when an employee was struck by the torque arm of the hydraulic power head. The employee sustained three broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was stacking lumber and amputated three fingers on the right hand in a chain and sprocket.
An employee's right big toe was amputated when the loading dock platform was lowered onto his toe.
An employee was removing dough from the mixer and amputated a finger on his right hand.
An employee was walking though the pallets in the packing area and was struck by an electric powered forklift. The employee sustained a foot injury requiring stitches and hospitalization.
