While cleaning a sensor, an employee's right thumb was caught in a drive chain and amputated.
An employee was making a packaging sample and amputated the right thumb tip.
An employee was using a 24" chainsaw to trim oversized logs. During use, the chainsaw dropped and cut the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on his foot.
On or about October 19, 2016, an electrician was setting up a 480-VAC line and received an electrical shock. The employee was hospitalized.
During repositioning of a load of angle bars, an employee caught his fingers in the bundle of iron resulting in a fingertip amputation and lacerations/fractures to two other fingers.
An employee was vaccinating a chicken with a wing web inoculator. The bird kicked and the employee poked their left middle finger and side of the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
The employee was adjusting limit switches on an energized woodworking machine (tenoner) and amputated the right ring finger.

An employee was operating a paper spool crane. The employee stepped off the operating platform and was pinched between the stair rail and the moving spool resulting in abrasions, contusions, and muscle strains.
An employee was hospitalized after sustaining an electrical shock while unscrewing a light bulb on a training rig.
On October 20, 2016, an employee was using a tool to poke holes in a freeze cloth when he slipped and the tool lacerated his left foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a sugar mill and partially amputated the right index finger.
An employee was operating a hand held pallet jack when their foot got caught between the pallet jack and a steel storage rack upright.
An employee was on the roof surveying HVAC needs and fell through the metal roof breaking an arm and a leg.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee was standing on or about the third rung of a ladder working on a light fixture and experienced electrical shock. The employee fell off the ladder landing on his head and shoulder.
An employee was inspecting the seal of a container on a truck when the truck pulled away/forward. The employee was struck by the truck chassis and run over by the wheels, fracturing his pelvis.
A temporary employee was struck by a forklift resulting in a broken left femur.
An employee suffered a broken foot after a 200 lbs. piece of machinery fell from a manual pulley system.

An employee was in an aerial lift washing down plant equipment with a fire hose. The fire hose became tangled in the aerial lift causing it to tip over and the employee fell 16 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury, a collapsed lung and a laceration on the throat.
A employee working on and near a 230 Kv transmission line was shocked resulting in third degree burns to both hands.
As an employee lifted a case of flour, he felt a "pop" in his back followed by pain in the same area. He was hospitalized with a herniated disc.

A serpentine gate was closed.  The employee pulled the pin in order to open the gate when a cow rammed the gate and his left ring finger was pinched between the gate and the cement wall.  The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated and the middle finger was fractured.
An employee was climbing a 32' fiberglass ladder to access a two-story new construction roof and fell fracturing the right heel and left foot (forefoot).

An employee finished delivering a package to a customer and was walking back to his truck when he started feeling cramps in his arms and legs. The employee was admitted to the hospital for dehydration.
An employee was getting a drink at a customer's deli when she fell through an open hatch in the floor and fractured her femur.
An employee was repairing a belt on the core/tenoner machine. A glove got caught in the moving chain and a fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working in a tank on a drilling rig when he tripped on a beam and fell, resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was working on the side of a column that was supported by a wood planked scaffold forming concrete foundation on a wall. The employee lost his footing and fell three and a half feet to the ground fracturing his right lower back.
While walking, an employee slipped off a curb and injured his right calf muscle. He was admitted to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was landscaping and was run over by the tractor when their pant leg was caught under the wheel.

An employee was on the tubing platform of a production rig placing tubes in the elevators when his safety line became snagged by the tubing being elevated. The employee was lifted off of the platform until his line separated, then he fell onto the platform. The employee sustained back and neck injuries and five broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An aerial artist fell 40 feet while rehearsing an aerial act.  She was hospitalized with head/neck/shoulder injuries.

An employee was connecting a temporary 480 Volt AC electrical pigtail cord into an electrical box. This pigtail would supply the plug connection for the 480 Volt AC cord for the floor shot blasting machine.  An arc flash occurred burning the employees hands and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tasted what he thought was a sauce reduction on the stove that turned out to be a pot of chemical from the grease trap and burned his throat.

An employee was attempting to raise a load with an air hoist when the air hoist came loose from its anchor point and swung down, striking the employee's torso and breaking ribs. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was cleaning rollers with a rag. The rag got lodged in the roller, pulling in and degloving his right thumb.

An employee was starting to wind a plastic liner onto a spool (bobbin) with a foot switch energized on the "FE Complexor" machine that combines layers of rubber used to make tires. The liner was slipping. The employee reached in to secure it from slipping and his hand was caught between the liner and the rotating spool (bobbin). This resulted in a fracture of both bones in the lower left arm which required surgery.
As the employee was getting off the conveyor, he braced himself on the forks of the carriage system, the forks came down striking him and fracturing the left ankle.
An employee was adjusting a limit switch on a molding machine. The machine cycled and the employee was struck by a cylinder in the machine causing head and foot injuries.
An employee's right ring fingertip was amputated while operating a vertical milling machine.
An employee was  getting out of the shuttle van, slipped and fell fracturing the L1 vertebrae.
An employee was hospitalized due to a work related back injury turning a card or moving a roll.
An employee was setting up the dry curd press to package a product when the machine cycled causing an amputation to the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was working from a scaffold driving metal studs into the wall. A metal stud kick-back struck the employee causing a laceration over the right eye.
An employee painting roof tiles fell off a one-story residential roof.
An employee suffered right index, middle, and ring finger amputations while cleaning a dust collector.
While performing form work, an employee fell 14 feet down with the form. The form fell on top of the employee, causing a broken sacrum and pubic bone.
An employee suffered left index and middle fingertip amputations.

An employee was helping to set a concrete lid weighing a couple hundred pounds for an electrical box in place. One end of a length of steel chain was attached to a steel loop (hasp) embedded in the concrete lid.  The employee attempted to attach the other end of this chain to a steel loop (hasp) on the back (underside) of an excavator bucket when the excavator boom unexpectedly dropped, pinning the employee's right thumb between the bottom of the excavator bucket and the concrete lid. His right thumb was amputated at a point between the first and second knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell off a roof while attaching an anchor, suffering cracked vertebrae.
An employee and a coworker were carrying a box outside the store when the employee tripped on the handicap ramp, suffering a fractured elbow and pelvis.
An employee was using a safety cutter to cut a 1/4-inch nylon rope when the cutter broke, exposing the razor. The employee's hand slipped, and the blade severely lacerated his left bicep area.
An employee was stacking pallets at the end of a production line when she tripped over stretch wrap and fell, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was flipping the top half of a tank when the tank fell out of its frame and partially amputated his left big toe.
An employee was placing a hatch cover on a barge when it landed on and amputated the end of the employee's right pinky finger.
An employee was spotting equipment being moved by a rough terrain forklift when the forklift ran over the employee's foot, breaking it.

An employee was troubleshooting a seized motor when the motor started and pulled the employee's thumb through the pulley. The employee suffered an amputation of the left thumb above the knuckle and bruising to the left middle and ring fingers.
While modifying scaffolding, an employee fell to the ground, suffering head and facial trauma, an internal injury, a broken wrist, and a leg laceration.

An employee was working on a roof when a piece a material started sliding down the roof.  The employee chased the material but was unable to stop and fell off the roof, suffering a broken wrist, facial laceration, and other injuries.
An employee was working on a piece of exercise equipment when a portion of the machine slipped off of the track and amputated his thumb tip.
An employee was opening the cover to an exhaust fan when the motor pulley wheel and sheave caught and severely pinched the employee's left index finger, partially amputating the fingertip.

An employee was flagging to help a tractor-trailer driver park when a gust of wind sent a temporary job fence in the air. The fence struck the employee who sustained neck and back compressions and a fractured sternum.
An employee was transporting soiled laundry when she tripped and fell over a plastic banding strap that had fallen onto the floor. She broke her left arm in the fall.
An employee slipped on a wet step while exiting a work vehicle, suffering a fractured left-side rib and requiring hospitalization.

On October 21, 2016, an employee was packing finished goods onto trays. The trays were on a flexible conveyor system. One of the trays turned sideways and as the employee attempted to straighten the tray out , her right ring fingertip was caught and amputated between two links of the conveyor.
An employee was standing on the rig floor of a water well drilling rig when a block came down, hitting and breaking the employee's left foot.
An employee suffered an electrical shock while cleaning the top of a blast chiller cabinet.
A maintenance employee was entering a forklift when he slipped on a damp metal surface, causing him to fall and fracture his left tibia.
An employee suffered a left index finger amputation while feeding pig bellies into the chain and sprocket.

On Friday 10/21/2016, at 0900, an employee was on the second story of a building replacing a seal on a window. The employee went to take another step up when the ladder gave out beneath him and he fell to the ground, fracturing his right and left femurs and injuring his ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move game animals when one of them charged the employee, collided with him, and knocked him to the ground. He sustained a fractured cervical vertebrae, sprained left hand, and a cut to the head that required stitches.

An employee was on the roof of a two-story house checking the felt to make sure it was smooth when he slipped on the wet felt and fell two stories, breaking his elbow and suffering a possible concussion.
An employee was unloading a skid of freight from his trailer when he slipped and fell onto the floor. He pulled his left hamstring muscle and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to remove a belt from a conveyor. He used a bar for leverage to remove the belt from the pulley. The motor was on at the time. As the motor caught the bar, it jerked him back and his hand made contact with the other belt, potentially amputating his left middle finger.
An employee fell off a roof when a gust of wind knocked him off balance. His harness was disconnected at the time.
An employee was pushing lumber through a table saw when his hand slipped and made contact with the blade, amputating his left middle finger.
An employee was on the trailer when he was struck by the tarp on the truck and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a right hip ball joint injury.
An employee fell one level through an unmarked hole in a roof while he was removing debris and plywood. He was hospitalized for spinal and rib fractures, abrasions, and a cut to the head.

An employee was replacing the filter of a duct cooling fan when the filter moved, causing the employee's hand to strike the fan. The employee suffered lacerations and fractures to the left ring, pinky, and index fingers.
An employee was emptying a trash bin and their finger got caught and amputated on the inside of the bin.
On October 22, 2016, an employee fell to the ground while sliding tandems into place on a trailer, suffering a head contusion/possible concussion that required hospitalization.

On or about October 22, 2016, at 1:10 p.m., while walking to the door of a private residence to deliver a certified mail piece, an employee tripped on the edge of the concrete driveway where it meets the grass forming a 2-inch difference in surface level.  The employee suffered two fractured bones in the right lower arm, requiring hospitalization.

On October 22, 2016, an employee was pushing a stick cart. The employee had his left hand on top of the stick cart when he hit another stick cart. The wooden sticks came towards his hand amputating the distal part of his left middle finger.

An employee had just unjammed a roll former and was running another flat piece through the rollers to try and determine what had caused the jam. The flat metal piece became caught in the rollers. The employee was trying to pull it through with his hands when his gloves were caught and both of his hands were pulled between the rollers. Two of his right-hand fingertips were amputated, and four left fingers were smashed. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee fell to the ground and suffered a hip fracture.
A forklift ran over an employee's foot and broke his ankle.

An employee was climbing a steel fixed ladder that led to a steel-framed basket attached to a crane. As he was trying to grasp the top rung of the ladder, he lost his grip and fell backward approximately 12.5 feet to the ground below, landing on his right side and fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was walking along the edge of the lube "PIT" in one of the mechanic bays.  He was cleaning the steel grates for the lube "PIT" when he stepped into the "PIT" and fell approximately 7 to 8 feet, dislocating and breaking his shoulder.

An employee was monitoring a potato conveyor line when the rollers began sticking due to mud and dirt. He was using a crowbar to remove the mud and dirt when it was drawn into the conveyor.  His gloves were also drawn in, crushing and amputating his left thumb.

On a three head saw machine, an employee was using a hand tool/bar to lift a chain that had a jammed buckle. The employee pressed the foot pedal to move the chain and free the buckle. When the pedal was pressed, the chain moved and caused the hand tool/bar to jerk, which pinched and amputated the employee's right-hand index finger between the chain guard and tool.
While he was descending outdoor concrete stairs at a customer's premises, and the employee's knee gave out. He fell to the ground and tore his left and right quadriceps.
An employee was working inside of a boiler on the 13th floor of Unit 3. A piece of slag fell from above and struck the employee on the head. The employee sustained a concussion and minor lacerations.
An employee suffered multiple fractures and tissue damage to his arm when he opened the guard of a scrap baler. The baler was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was standing on a conveyor approximately 18 feet high. He was greasing the bearings when he fell to the ground below, breaking multiple bones.

On October 10, 2016, at approximately 11:15 a.m., an employee was attempting to remove a load bar that had fallen off the ranks into the STC tank. While exiting the STC tank, the employee slipped and fell into the STC up to the waist, suffering heat and chemical burns to the lower body.

An employee was lifting the back door of a trailer filled with cranberries. He was inserting an S hook so the door would not come down before filling the trailer with water to float the cranberries out when the rear door came down and broke his thumb.
An employee was cutting cucumbers on a slicer and amputated the tip of her right thumb.

While performing warehouse stocking operations, an employee stacked merchandise on a heavy load pallet onto a light load pallet with a forklift when the stack tipped over. When he got off the forklift to try and stabilize the heavy pallet, the stacked pallets fell on him and fractured his left ankle.
An employee was blowing down a mist eliminator when the side glass broke and sprayed sulfuric acid onto the employee's face and right ear, causing acid burns that required hospitalization.
On 10/23/2016, an employee slipped and fell while climbing stairs, requiring hospitalization for a lower back injury.

A maintenance employee was attempting to realign an overhead conveyor belt while on a scissor lift. While attempting to reach up and pull a lever, he started to lose his balance. To steady himself, he reached his left hand up into the conveyor belt and his glove was caught in the belt, leading to a deep abrasion on the top of his left hand that required surgery.
While riding and backing up a forklift, an employee's right hand was pinned between the forklift and a loading table, partially amputating a finger.
An employee was pushing a rolling table when his right index finger was caught between the table and a wheel, amputating the fingertip.

Two temporary employees were working to stand up paperboard tubes 18 inches in diameter, 240 inches in length, and 105 pounds in weight.  As one employee turned to walk away, one of the tubes fell and struck the first employee in the head, knocking him to the floor.  This employee sustained a fracture to the second vertebra in his neck, which required surgery and hospitalization.
While demolishing an HVAC unit on a roof, an employee fell through a skylight to the floor below.
An employee was unloading a garage door section from a trailer when the band that he was pulling to move the section broke, causing him to fall to the ground and dislocate his elbow.
An employee was removing a satellite dish when his foot became tangled in his tool belt and he fell 4 to 5 feet to the ground below, suffering a possible concussion.
An employee cut the tip of his left index and middle fingers while using the Verticut overseeding machine.

An employee was leak testing a 500-cc accumulator part when built-up air pressure suddenly released, creating a load noise. The noise startled the employee, causing her to lose her balance and fall backward. She hit her back, hip, and head.
While operating a truck, an employee struck a parking lot light post resulting in hospitalization for a cut to the forehead and neck trauma.

An employee was removing totes from the top rack of a warehouse with an industrial lift when he fell from the lift platform to the concrete floor below, fracturing his skull. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a high pressure hose to wash a vacuum box at the landfill and slipped into the concrete lined pit, breaking his ankles.

An employee was using a driveline tube over a wrench to gain leverage to remove a tie rod end. The driveline tube over the wrench slipped off and hit the employee in the head. The employee sustained a 3" cut requiring stitches.
An employee was removing trash out of the building. As he was dumping the trash from a rubber container into a steel dumpster, his left ring fingertip was smashed and amputated.
An employee was struck in the back by a piece of rebar resulting in hospitalization.
An employee injured his ring finger after his ring got caught on the edge of the Kustner machine while descending a step ladder. The finger was later amputated.

Employees were standing at the company truck about to break for lunch when a log truck came down the road and a tire blew. The weight of the logs broke an axle on the log truck and the tire and wheel broke off striking two of the employees standing at the company truck.
An employee was presorting mail when his right index fingertip was caught and amputated on the underside of the mail tray conveyor.
An employee was installing two segments of a concrete chute when it closed on his right hand, crushing his fingers and requiring surgery.
An employee was shot by an active shooter at a truck stop.

An employee was installing foam pieces into bridge deck panels on a beam when he lost his footing and attempted to jump toward the opposite beam. His body struck the beam, fracturing his nose, face, rib, and sternum.

On October 24, 2016, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was standing behind the demonstration stable serving customers sample candy when the employee fainted, injuring their right elbow and back.

On October 24, 2016, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to move a shutter head assemble from the shutter head machine on Line 16. The equipment was stuck. The employee went to get help and the two employees jogged the piece and the 40 pound shutter head fell approximately 18 inches. While the equipment was falling, the employee tried to catch it and his left middle fingertip was caught between the equipment and wood board resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

A special needs child got agitated and attacked an employee as they were driving.  An aid was on the bus and attempted to restrain the child, but was unable to prevent the attack. The employee suffered whiplash, a partially collapsed lung, right shoulder sprain, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were going to remove an aeration pipe (18 inch in diameter and 10 feet long) that had potatoes on it with a 3/8" chain & a skid steer with forks.  The chain was secured around the pipe and around both forks on the skid steer.  After the pipe was free of the potatoes, the skid steer driver began to back up, while another employee guided the pipe.  While backing up, one of the skid steer forks hit one of the bulkhead tubes (75-80#) that was sitting in its slot. The tube came out of its slot and fell roughly 7'8" striking the employee on the head.  He fell backwards into the potato pile and suffered a head laceration.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor near the cafeteria resulting in a fracture to the right intertrochanteric femur.
An employee restarted the binder machine and amputated a fingertip. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped on a mat outside his guard post and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck while working in the finished goods warehouse. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of a broken left hip.
An employee was repairing a water main when he slipped on a clump of dirt and broke his tibia, requiring overnight hospitalization.
On or about 10/24/16, at 4:00 p.m., an employee was cutting a tie on a group of wires with a box cutter knife when he suffered a laceration, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was unloading a truck of pipe pile when his finger was pinched causing a right thumb amputation above the first knuckle. The employee was hooking up rigging from a crane at the end of the pipe pile which was beveled and significantly sharp. His right thumb was inside the throat of the hook as the crane operator was signaled to take the slack off of the rigging. When the hook was pulled into the pile edge the employee's thumb tip was pinched.

An employee was cutting a tree stump.  A strong gust of wind caused a large branch from a nearby tree to break off and fly toward the injured employee.  The branch struck the employee in the back of the head causing a severe head contusion.

An employee was exiting the property's roadway while driving an Isuzu NPR Spray rig when he hit the two concrete walls and came to rest on an oak tree. This resulted in two broken legs, a broken left arm and wrist, a broken jaw and multiple cuts to the head and face. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee fell 10' through a stairwell opening from the mezzanine to the floor below fracturing a rib and the clavicle.

An employee was reaching into a 6-inch opening under a machine conveyor to retrieve a part when the employee's right hand contacted the rotating sprocket, amputating the ring fingertip and avulsing the middle finger.
An employee was riding an ATV when he came to a terrain that induced a sudden stop. He was thrown over the handle bars and landed on the ground, dislocating his wrists and requiring surgery.
An employee slipped/tripped on an uneven surface while descending the front steps of a residence and fell breaking her hip.
An employee was operating a router when his hand slipped and contacted the machine, amputating his middle finger and lacerating his index finger.
An employee was replacing a plow on a tractor when it slipped and fell on him, lacerating and breaking his leg.

An employee was walking with a client along a public sidewalk. While she was trying to support the client, she tripped over an uneven surface and sustained injuries to her abdomen, ankle and lower back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cycling the bending machine after an electrical repair. The injured employee was resting his hand on the machine and his right thumb tip was amputated when the machine cycled.
An employee suffered a fractured ankle while loading trash into the back of the rear load garbage truck.

An employee climbed a 12-foot step ladder. He stepped off the ladder with his left foot to position it on a large round valve handle to reach an anchor point he intended to tie off to. As he reached with his left hand, to attach his lanyard to this anchor point, the large round valve turned, and the employee lost his balance and fell approximately 6 feet onto a pipe below the ladder. The employee sustained a fractured left arm, fractured thumb and two fractured ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pinned between two vehicles they were offloading from a low boy trailer and was hospitalized for his injuries.
During excavation work, an employee stepped on loose soil and rolled his right ankle while spotting for the excavator. The employee's right ankle was dislocated.
Two workers were carrying a bundle of struts into a truck. The struts shifted and a strut struck a worker's ear causing a laceration that required stitches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending the ladder on the side of a scaffold and fell.  The employee broke his right leg.
On October 25, 2016, an employee sustained an amputation injury after the employee's shirt was caught in a belt and pulley pulling the hand in.

Two employees were installing siding on the third floor of a stair landing from a makeshift scaffold. Both employee's fell approximately 30 feet to the ground when the scaffold failed. Employee 1 suffered a broken back and neck. Employee 2 suffered fractures to the pelvis, tailbone and lower back. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was closing the trailer door when he inadvertently pinched his right middle finger in the door latch causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell while stepping off of an ergonomic mat twisting an ankle and hitting their head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assisting in stocking concrete pieces and crushed his right thumb between two pieces of concrete.
While climbing down an attached, caged ladder from a boiler unit, the employee slipped and fell roughly 15-20 feet breaking his right femur and dislocating the left knee.

An employee was working on equipment that was not in operation. A chain on the equipment was bound up and had tension on it. The employee took a bar to pry and loosen the chain because the chain had some energy in it. When the chain became free, the chain moved slightly, energized. His finger was above the chain and it slipped between the sprocket and the chain. His right index fingertip was caught between the chain and the sprocket and amputated.

An employee was drilling a hole in a piece of aluminum about 12-inches by 3-inches wide using a pedestal drill press and amputated his left index finger at the first knuckle. The employee was wearing tight fitted grip gloves. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
On October 25, 2016, an employee's distal right index finger was amputated when a metal door closed on the finger.

On October 25, 2016, at 7:10 a.m., an employee was disassembling a load of precast concrete hollow core planks and tried to remove the stacking block before the plank had cleared the stack. The plank broke and amputated the tip and fingernail of his left index finger. He was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was lowering a trailer on a wooden block. When the block fell over, he reached down to set the block up and smashed his left thumb between the wooden block and the trailer.
An employee was operating a machine and amputated the right index fingertip. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee rolled her ankle while walking in the parking lot. She was hospitalized for surgery the next day.
An employee was cleaning the area around a shaft at the end of a conveyor. An arm was caught by the shaft and fractured. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee removed a guard from a conveyor belt motor to check the chain and sprockets for tension. The employee reached toward the running chain and sprocket and his left thumb was caught between the chain and sprocket resulting in an amputation of 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch of the thumb. The machine was energized at the time of the incident.
A driver slipped and fell off a flatbed truck. He suffered two small brain bleeds.

A temporary employee was inspecting paper bales as they left the baler. He was hand picking plastic "fuzz" from the finished bales. Bales were stacked 2 high in the building. A row near the employee fell. The employee was found under a fallen paper bale and hospitalized.

An employee was using a mag drill when the glove on his supporting (right) hand was pulled into the drill.  The employee sustained a mangling injury to the right ring finger that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a skid steer while it was backing up causing broken ribs and a broken leg. The equipment has a functioning back up alarm.

An employee broke both wrists after falling off a ladder. The employee was working on a billboard when the hook ladder he was using slipped off the billboard. The employee fell approximately 14 feet to the ground below.
An employee's finger was amputated by transfer pump impellors.

Employees were re-positioning a boiler's mill liner on a pallet. There were three boiler mill liners laying side by side on the pallet. As the employees were re-positioning the liner to the pallet, the mill liner shifted and the employee' right ring finger got caught between two boiler mill liners, resulting in the amputation of his right ring fingertip and a laceration to his right index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was servicing a restaurant machine and amputated the right index finger.

On 10/25/2016, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was injured as the press crew began webbing the paper through the press rollers at the beginning of a press run. During the "web up," an excessive amount of paper built up in the area. The employee attempted to push the paper through the energized machine with her right hand resulting in the laceration and fracture of the middle finger.
An employee was trimming countertops using a miter saw. The employee suffered a laceration on the left small and ring fingers that required surgery when they contacted the saw blade.
An employee was driving a forklift and scraped a hand on a cement post while backing up.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut plastic wrap from a bundle of boxes and lacerated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was troubleshooting the basket return system on the pasteurizer machine. His left forearm got caught between the shaft and the chain and the employee suffered a possible fracture.
An employee was washing windows and fell approximately 8 feet out of a window landing on the concrete sidewalk. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

On October 26, 2016, at approximately 2:15 p.m., an employee was injured while felling a tree. The tree had been topped and skinned. Using a chainsaw, the employee felled the tree which caught on something as it fell. The bottom of the tree kicked back and struck the front of the employee on the leg and foot. The employee was admitted to the hospital and treated for multiple fractures to the left leg, below the knee.
An employee was operating a press machine and injured three fingers on the right hand (middle, ring, and little).
An employee was cleaning an area of the conveyor belt when a tip of his glove got caught in the belt resulting in the amputation of the right ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was working aloft in the bucket truck. While moving the bucket into position, the truck tipped over. The employee sustained broken ribs and internal injuries.
An employee pulled the generator string and his left hand got caught in the string as it returned into the generator amputating the middle fingertip and thumb tip.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to a bee sting on the right hip.
An employee was pulling wires from a pipe while standing on an 8 ft. A-frame ladder. The employee lost balance and fell from the fourth step of the ladder breaking his left ankle.
An employee fell through a hole on the third floor and landed on the second floor resulting in a head injury.
An employee was clearing a jam in the palletizer machine and cut a finger when it was caught in a gear.
An employee was walking from lunch break and was struck by a tractor trailer that was backing up. The employee received multiple fractures and head trauma.

A truck driver was tarping the load while on the live shed. As he was coming down, he braced himself and his left index and middle fingers were caught in a moving fan resulting in the amputation of the fingers above the knuckle.
An employee fell from approximately 12 feet to the lower level while descending on a fixed ladder attached to the ship. The employee suffered a broken right leg and elbow.

An employee was extending a scaffold being used by employees to lay bricks for a school wall. As the employee was bolting down the scaffold towers, his wrench slipped off the bolt. This caused the employee to fall over the front of the scaffold and over the brick wall being built. The employee suffered a possible hip fracture and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was operating a jointer machine and his left hand contacted the blade amputating the left index fingertip.
While walking an employee's knee gave out. The employee fell and twisted her leg.
An employee was tightening a bracket onto a form with a pneumatic wrench and caught his right middle finger between the bracket and the form resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was going down the simulator slide during an evacuation drill and broke his ankle.
An employee was cleaning the food composter discharge chute while it was running and amputated two fingertips and damaged a third.

An employee placed a torpedo level on a post to straighten and level the post. Another employee was operating a hydraulic ram. When that employee activated the machine the first employee's left index finger was crushed. The finger was amputated at the hospital.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when he hit a rack, sustaining an injury to his left leg.
On October 26, 2016, an employee was struck in the head when a section of chain link fence blew over due to high wind. The employee suffered a concussion and was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was walking down the aisle in the fab/sewing area, turned a corner, and tripped over the corner of a pallet. She fell and suffered a non-displaced compression fracture at L4 and L3 and microfractures of the pelvic bone.
Two employees were leaning over the safety handrails to grab a 4'x8' piece of sheathing and the Perry Scaffold fell over injuring three employees. Two employees were hospitalized.
While cutting a soup bone, an employee's hand slipped into the path of the saw blade resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was on a ladder repairing the door closer device when it snapped and the arm of the door closer device struck the employee on the head causing an eye injury and possible concussion.
On October 26, 2016, an employee was operating a punch press and suffered the  amputation of the left 4th and 5th fingers.
An employee was struck by a forklift resulting in a broken hip and lower leg and hospitalization.

On October 26, 2016, at 12:00 p.m., an employee was using a pry-bar to raise the manholes to the level of the new pavement. The manhole cover slipped off of the pry-bar as he was reaching under the manhole cover and crushed the tip of his left middle finger. The tip of his left middle finger with some bone was amputated at the hospital.
An employee suffered a potential amputation of the left middle fingertip while aligning a bolt hole on the bucket of the track excavator.

A driver backed his waste truck up to a dumpster. Another employee got out of the truck and went to the rear of the loader to hook cables to the dumpster. The driver had the truck in neutral with the parking brake set. He accelerated the motor to pick up the dumpster and when doing so the truck rolled backwards and pinned the employee between a wall and the dumpster. The employee was hospitalized with a hairline fracture in his hip and internal injuries.
While crawling under a home to run coaxial cable, an employee was bitten by an unidentified/unknown insect and was hospitalized.
On October 26, 2016, an employee was hospitalized for smoke inhalation from a fire that ignited in the dust collection system.
On October 26, 2016, an employee was standing at a computer station and as the employee turned to leave their foot got caught in a scanner cable causing the employee to fall fracturing the left hip.

An employee was doing work on a drop ceiling while standing on a ten foot ladder. The employee contacted 277 volts resulting in a burn on the back of his hand and causing him to fall off the ladder. Employee fell backwards onto the concrete and was knocked unconscious.
An employee was removing a fuel tank with a screwdriver when the hatch fell on his left ring finger amputating the fingertip and nail.

Two employees were entering a sewer manhole. One of the employee's hands slipped and the second employee's middle finger was caught and amputated at the first joint as the manhole cover fell back into place.
An employee suffered a fractured lower right leg, when a stair rail rigged to a chain fall became unbalanced and fell, striking the employee in the right leg.

The injured employee was standing on a ladder to install a sign structure located at the jobsite. A manlift operator was moving the manlift for painting projects. The injured employee was struck by a board that came out of the manlift bucket and fell to the ground. He was admitted to the hospital for treatment of a laceration to his head and a contusion to his mouth.

The employee attempted to manually align boxes by pulling the bottom box forward, causing the top box to slide back and pinch the employee's right middle finger between the two boxes. A chunk of tissue was removed from the finger.
An employee was preparing a mobile crane for transport and amputated a portion of the left index finger when the jib moved into place.
An employee was stacking bundles of steel rods when two bundles fell onto the employee's legs fracturing them.
An employee fell from an extension ladder while climbing into the attic to change furnace filters. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a fractured right eye socket.

An employee operating a Bobcat suffered a broken arm and severe lacerations after a metal chain being used to lift a 450 lb. bollard pipe released unexpectedly and the pipe whipped around striking the operator.
An employee was walking onsite, tripped and fell breaking a leg.
An employee was struck by a sit-down forklift resulting in multiple fractures to the left foot.
An employee was de-rigging the suspended scaffolding on the bridge. He did not see a cable and ran into the cable clips resulting in an abdominal hematoma.
An employee cut his wrist with a box cutter.

The employee was unloading CO2 into a tank for a customer. The hoses were not connected when the product (CO2) valve was opened and CO2 struck him in the abdomen knocking the employee down. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a spleen injury.

On October 27, 2016, an employee was descending a ladder from a primary catwalk. She slipped while stepping down onto the last rung. The employee fell backwards resulting in a laceration and a broken elbow.

On October 27, 2016, at 4:40 p.m., an employee was engaged in a flip operation and was using a hammer to tap the fixture holding the part. The hammer glanced the fixture and struck/severed the machinist's left index fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell in the parking lot, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was walking down the stairs and fell 13 stair treads to the bottom landing. He was hospitalized for a neck injury and a laminectomy.
An employee's foot was run over by a pickup truck resulting in a broken foot and hospitalization.

An employee fell 11 feet from an elevated order picker platform. The employee was wearing a body harness, but was not tied off prior to the fall. He was hospitalized and treated for two broken ribs, bruised lungs and facial lacerations.
An employee was assisting a patient in the restroom when they both fell on the floor resulting in injury to her back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning food processing equipment and amputated the right hand.
An employee started the pressure washer in order to wash a concrete wall when he lost control of the pressure washer wand resulting in a laceration to his neck. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping unload a wooden crate full of glass (about 1,000 lbs.) from a flat bed truck with a forklift and jib. The crate slipped loose, slid, and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left leg.
An employee was picking up a box from the floor of the trailer when he saw another box falling toward him and stepped back to avoid it. The employee felt a pop in the lower back and a sharp pain.
An employee was unjamming a piece of fabric from the rotary fabric cutter and amputated the left pinky fingertip. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was hospitalized with rib fractures and facial lacerations when a freeze dryer door fell onto the employee.

An employee was spotting the PIT operator, lost his footing due to some loose ground near the unloading area, and fell. While on the ground, his leg was crushed by the bridging material when it was unloaded onto the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg and ankle.
An employee was cleaning with a stainless steel cleaner and felt dizzy. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was transferring a package onto the conveyor of the metal detector when her finger was caught in an exposed belt and pulley. A portion of the employee's finger was amputated.
The employee was measuring the thickness of the granite and got caught between the granite and the roller on the conveyor. The employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee was unclogging the pump truck piping during a concrete pour. When he removed the flange, the pressure plate struck his lower left leg breaking it.
Employee was operating a brake press when she placed her fingers in the press brake die opening during the downward stroke of the ram and amputated three fingertips on her left hand.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell dislocating an ankle bone.
An employee was repairing a pallet jack. He lifted the pallet jack by hand. When he went to lower the pallet jack, the wheel mechanism severed his right index finger at the first joint.

An employee was running film on a production line. While trying to remove excess plastic film from a rubber roller, the employee suffered an avulsion injury to the left palm. The machine was running at the time of the incident. The employee was hospitalized for a skin graft.
An employee was mopping a patient room, backed into a wheelchair and fell, resulting in a pelvic fracture.
An employee was walking into the building when the employee fell forward striking their right knee on the ground and fracturing the right knee cap.

A bundle of stacking sticks in the stick staging area busted open. An employee was rebinding the bundle and sustained a puncture wound between the ring and middle fingers from a splinter that punctured the seam of his right glove.
An employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized when his foot got caught in a pallet and he fell.
An employee was refueling her vehicle, tripped over the fuel hose and fell breaking her right shoulder.

An employee fell off the fire escape approximately 15 feet to the concrete ground below. The employee was knocked unconscious and sustained seven broken ribs on the right side, a punctured right lung and a fractured scapula.

An employee climbed onto a flatbed truck to unhook equipment. As the employee unhooked the load, the chain binder's lever suddenly released, allowing the chain to fall and hit the employee's right leg, fracturing two bones.
An employee's right pinky finger was caught in a closing door and amputated.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell fracturing the left ankle.
An employee was cut by glass due to an over pressurization event.

An employee was sweeping floors using a floor scrubber machine. He pushed open a door which then came back and struck his right ring finger. His finger was caught between the door and the floor scrubber machine amputating part of it.

An employee was capping an 8 inch PVC water line. Backpressure built up in the line from a leaking valve and blew the cap off resulting in amputation of the employee's left pinky finger and a partial amputation of the left ring finger.

Employees were setting up a piece of concrete block manufacturing equipment using a telehandler to raise a section of fabricated steel. A piece of shipping pallet that was still attached to the steel fell from overhead and struck an employee in the head knocking him to the ground. The employee was admitted to the hospital for a concussion.
The employee was raising a steel coil from a pallet with a hoist when the steel coil struck the employee, breaking his shoulder blade.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of lumber and lacerated their hand.
An employee was performing maintenance/cleaning along the company's property line and fell striking his head on rocks and sustaining a head and spine injury.
An employee was operating the flex-nip machine. His shirt got caught in the machine and the employee suffered lacerations to the hip and chest.

Employees were near a hydraulic power unit that was slipping off a forklift. As the employees attempted to get out of the way, they tripped over other equipment and fell. One employee sustained a knee injury. The second employee sustained a head laceration.
An employee was driving a reach truck and struck an upright beam on a rack installed in the warehouse injuring their chest.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a gas processing unit when a flash fire occurred. The employee was burned and was hospitalized. See also 1151988.
Two employees were conducting maintenance on a gas processing unit when a flash fire occurred. Both employees received burns and were hospitalized. See also 1151826.

On October 28, 2016, at approximately 6:00 AM, a PVC pipe got clogged causing mud to overflow from the shakers. An employee went down to unclog it and when he did, the PVC pipe struck another employee, who was standing at the end of the pipe, on the neck. He was admitted to the hospital and was diagnosed with a fracture to the C6 vertebrae.

On October 28, 2016, at 6:30 a.m., an employee was removing a piece of stuck steel from the shear. The machine was activated and a 1 inch diameter piece of angle steel was propelled into the employee's left forearm. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
The employee was putting paper products on a storage shelf and fell 2-3 feet from the step ladder fracturing a hip.
An employee was feeding wood into the chop saw. The employee's left thumb was amputated when the saw was activated. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a packaging/sealing machine and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee was spreading hot asphalt and fell sustaining second degree burns on the lower legs.
While assisting with the sewer line inside the trench box, a section of trench wall fell into the box and pinned the employee against the box wall. The employee was hospitalized with a spinal injury.

Employees were moving a vehicle on to steel rims in the salvage yard when an employee's hand was caught between the car and the bumper. The employee suffered an amputation to the soft tissue pulp of the left pinky finger.

An employee was on the roof unloading the asphalt shingle bundles from the conveyor. He stepped backwards and fell from the second-story section of the roof to the one-story section of the roof fracturing his shoulder and ribs.
A temporary worker was operating equipment when his right arm was caught between the rollers. The employee suffered a compound fracture of the right arm and partially amputated the thumb.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and suffered an amputation to the right thumb.

At approximately 2:40 a.m. on October 27, 2016, the injured employee and other employees were removing an 80 lb. bolt from a stamping press. The bolt had to be moved approximately 2 ft. over the edge of the press. The bolt was attached to a chain fall and sitting on the lip or edge of the press. An employee pulled the bolt with the tag line, but could not move the bolt over the edge. The injured employee then pushed the bolt with his hands. The bolt moved, and his right hand or finger was caught between the bolt and the edge. The employee suffered a crush/dislocation injury and his right pinky fingertip was medically amputated below the fingernail.

After cutting 2 x 4s with the saw, the employee was breaking wood using his foot in a stomping motion to break the remaining halves. The half with nails sticking out swung upwards and struck the employee in the leg, lodging two nails into the employee's knee.
An employee was run over by a backing backhoe resulting in fractures and internal injuries.
While cutting wood with a portable saw to make shelving, an employee suffered an amputation of the left index finger below the nail.
As an employee dismounted from a fork truck, he could not stop the fork truck from moving. The wheel ran over his left foot, breaking bones.
An employee fell approximately 24 feet off a roof and sustained back injuries.
An employee was troubleshooting the extruder machine when hot polymer splashed and burned his face.
An employee was in the infeed area of a sort machine, attempting to straighten a stack of pallets, when the stacker side arms engaged and crushed his right lower leg.
On 10/28/2016, an employee was shot in the parking lot, suffering 11 gunshot wounds.

On 10/28/16, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was walking to the laundry room to drop off her apron when her leg gave out. She fell to the floor and was transported to the hospital for treatment.
An employee fell off a flatbed trailer while loading material onto it.  The employee fractured his clavicle and ribs and displaced his scapula.
On 10/29/2016, an employee was performing maintenance on the reefer engine on top of a box truck, lost balance and fell approximately 12-13 feet fracturing 6 ribs and 3 vertebrae.

A temporary employee was operating a planer to cut a bevel on a 40 foot steel plate. The employee stepped off the planer to remove a metal chip on the plate as it was being automatically moved into the planer, which resulted in his left foot getting caught under the plate clamp. The employee was admitted to the hospital for treatment of his broken foot and leg above the ankle.
An employee was going into the office and her left pinky finger was caught and amputated in the door when it closed due to high winds.
An employee was hospitalized after they were struck by a 12" discharge hose while vacuuming sediment from the river floor.
An employee was operating the sealer machine when the seal arm came down and caught his right hand, burning both sides of the hand.

An employee was positioning a stand-up lift truck to pick up parts. When the operator turned the steering wheel, a tire on the lift grabbed the floor. The lift swung around, causing the operator to fall out of the lift. The operator fell up against racking and the lift pinned him between the rack and the lift fracturing ribs.
An employee was cleaning the conveyor when his right hand was pulled into the machine fracturing the right forearm.

An employee was using a spike maul to set a steel spike in a wooden tie. The spike maul struck the steel joint bar and the impact broke a small piece of steel off the joint bar. The small piece of steel struck the employee in the right eye.

On October 29, 2016, an employee went to the top of the bin and opened the manhole hatch to repair the sweep auger. The employee was later discovered at the bottom of the bin approximately 80 feet below the opening. The employee suffered a broken left leg and fractured vertebrae.
An employee fell off a ladder into a manhole and fractured a leg and vertebrae.
An employee was building a riser for electrical power lines and received burns to the arm and neck.

An employee was backing up to load some product into condemn barrels, but did not see the open drain and fell into it. The pallet jack ran over his right leg causing a compound fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was rolling pipes on a metal forming machine and smashed his left index finger in the machine resulting in amputation.
An employee was setting a type and inlet cover. One object was put down on top of other material and struck the top of the employee's foot breaking two toes.
A hydraulic dock plate was not lowering to floor completely and an employee used his hands to push it down causing the dock plate to release and amputate the tip of his right hand ring finger.

An employee was changing the oil in a car while down in the oil changing pit when a jug of brake cleaner ignited, causing second degree burns to both of the employee's legs and the right forearm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking from the back prep area to the line when he slipped and fell. He attempted to brace himself on the side of the fryer, but he missed and his arm went into the hot fryer. He suffered partial thickness burns to approximately 3/4 of the arm.
An employee was working from the scale platform and fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete below suffering fractured ribs and vertebrae and internal bleeding.
An employee was measuring a bundle on a moving conveyor belt. His index left finger got caught between a roller and the bundle and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped over a long reach product grabber and fell sustaining multiple fractures to her arm.
An employee suffered the partial amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee was demolishing a piping assembly. When the weight shifted, the pipe rolled and struck the employee, fracturing and severely lacerating his left index finger.
An employee was bitten on the right index finger by a poisonous snake and hospitalized.
An employee suffered second degree burns on her left leg and foot when hot water overflowed from a cooker.
An employee was insulating ductwork over an air handler when he slipped and fell approximately 6-9 ft. to the ground below. The employee sustained head trauma and fractured facial bones.

An employee was driving a stand-up counterbalance forklift and making a U-turn in the warehouse. The lift struck a rack crushing his left foot. He was taken to the hospital and had a partial amputation of one toe.
An employee was checking the cotton for moisture and the bagger ram caught his left arm and broke it.
An employee fell out of his truck and fractured the left elbow.
An employee was installing a conveyor system using a pry bar to separate parts and amputated a fingertip when the tool slipped and pinched his finger between the two parts.
When handling a 4 foot waler and loosening bolts, an employee's finger was caught between metal bolts and the waler, amputating the left middle distal fingertip.

An employee was unloading pressure treated lumber with a forklift. The employee tried to pick up three loads of lumber, but realized that the load was too heavy for the forklift. As he placed the load onto the ground, the forklift extended forward, causing the employee to fall forward out of the forklift. The employee sustained a head laceration.
An employee was operating a loader. A bus drove by the loader causing the door to slam closed on the employee's thumb and amputate 1/4 inch of the thumb.
An employee was conducting maintenance operations in the area and saw feed coming off the conveyor. His right middle finger was partially amputated when it was caught by the auger.
Two employees were hospitalized for injuries sustained during a roof truss collapse.
An employee fell from a ladder, suffering broken ribs, a broken shoulder, and a punctured lung.

An employee was walking across the cafeteria when she tripped on the edge of a fixed metal floor ramp used to move salad carts into the cooler. She fell on the floor, breaking her left hip. She was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on wet leaves on stairs outside a client's house, suffering a head injury and requiring overnight hospitalization.
While clearing a jam, an employee lost balance and fell off a three-step ladder, fracturing the right wrist.
While stepping off a rack shelf onto a ladder, an employee missed the ladder rung and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and a back contusion.

On 10/31/2016, an employee was delivering furniture to a client's house. He attempted to cross the road while holding a mattress and a speeding car hit him, injuring his nose and causing contusions to multiple body parts.
On October 31, 2016, an employee's fingertip was amputated when he was attempting to use tongs on the screw casings.
An employee was operating a full revolution power press when the press cycled while the employee's hand was inside the die, crushing/amputating three fingers.

An employee was standing on a small work platform to reach an adjustment on the rear of a milling machine when he slipped off the platform. His left arm came down rapidly, striking the running milling blade. The blade severely cut the third and fourth fingers on the last joint, as well as his index finger.

An employee was attempting to fuel his truck with diesel. He removed the fuel cap from his truck, picked up the fuel nozzle, placed the fuel nozzle in the tank, and squeezed the handle. 

It was at that point that a flash fire and/or small explosion occurred, burning his face, hands, and chest area. He was hospitalized for third degree burns.
An employee was attempting to stop a pipe from rolling when his left hand was caught between the pipe and guardrail of a table in the pressure washer area. His left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was leading a driver and directing him on how to park the sweeper truck in the bay for service. The driver hit the gas, and the injured employee's legs were wedged between the moving vehicle and a parked vehicle. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis, a partial left pneumothorax, fractured ribs, a left knee injury, and a wrist injury.
An employee was using a ladder to access a single-story residential roof when he fell off, landed on the ground, and broke his femur.
An employee was standing on the floor surface when steel erectors struck an adjacent building, causing a piece of steel to break off and strike/deeply lacerate the back of the employee's head.
An employee was walking across a concrete deck and fell through an unguarded floor hole breaking the right tibia.
An employee was moving a pack of sheetrock that was placed against the wall when the pack fell over and struck his knee, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking around a vehicle in the back of the shop when he tripped over a safety rail and fell on the concrete floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was cutting tree limbs with a 20-inch chain saw when a falling limb possibly struck him. He lost consciousness and fell to the ground, suffering a small bump on his head.
On October 31, 2016, at approximately 9:15 a.m., two employees were exposed to elevated levels of carbon monoxide from a boiler with a cracked heat exchanger.
An employee was stepping off the truck, missed the step, and fell breaking the right hip.

An employee was using a meat grinder when some meat became stuck to the side of the hopper. When the employee went to dislodge the meat, the employee's left hand was caught in the auger, amputating the pinky fingertip and ring finger.
An employee was repairing/installing a sliding door in a door track using an allen wrench when the door arm sprung open and flung the allen wrench into the employee's neck, impaling it.

An employee was refueling a job site crew boat on 10/31/16. He removed the boat  battery to plug in the portable fuel pump. During fueling, some fuel ran over and spilled inside the boat. He turned off the fuel pump, cleaned up the area, and reinstalled the boat battery. A fire occurred. He put the fire out with a fire extinguisher and suffered hand and arm pain.

An employee was standing on the fender of a side-dump trailer using a torque wrench to loosen a pipe when the torque wrench broke and he fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. He hit his head, lost consciousness, and suffered facial cuts and broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee amputated his fingertip when it became caught under the clamp on the cutting machine.
An employee was on the back side of a box (where cotton is pressed) when the ram that compresses the cotton into bales came down and broke his right arm.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell resulting in a brain bleed and a fractured right elbow.
An employee was removing cable from the cable rack when the cable rack collapsed. The reinforcing steel holding the cables fell and struck the employee in the lower right back.

An employee was using a crowbar to lift a powered industrial truck outrigger to dislodge debris from the metal outrigger wheel. While he was using his left hand to brush the debris away from the wheel, the crowbar slipped and allowed the wheel to fall on his left hand, amputating his middle fingertip and breaking his pointer finger.

An employee was driving a forklift toward a conveyor when he noticed an error light at the tote scanner. He traveled on the lift toward the tote scanning area to manually scan the tote in and clear the error. He attempted but was unable to slow the machine using the plugging method or the dead-man switch. He then attempted to exit the machine. In that process, he struck the racking and his left foot became wedged between the rack and the forklift. He suffered a broken left foot and deep abrasions.
An employee's left index finger was amputated between the first and second knuckle by the cutting head on the DCM sleeve cut machine.
An employee was conducting cleaning/unjamming operations on a dust collector machine when his hand entered the point of operation, amputating his index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was installing a new shear in the shop. He had removed the fuses from the bottom of the disconnect and began wiring the new shear into the box when an arc flash occurred, causing an electrical burn to his left forearm. The box was not locked out from its energy source at the time of the incident.

An employee was conducting landscaping activities (e.g., mowing grass and cleaning up the grounds). As he closed the gate to his box truck, his left ring finger was caught in its pinch point, causing a compound fracture that resulted in a finger amputation near the knuckle.
An employee was troubleshooting a motor control bucket when an arc flash occurred, causing electrical first and second degree burns to the employee's left hand and arm, right arm, neck, and face.
On November 1, 2016, an employee was reaching for a bolt in a lint cleaner when his right arm became caught and wedged, cutting his arm off.
An employee was moving a box of fabric when she lost her balance and fell, fracturing her left femur.

An employee was bent over checking the layout for a window opening with a tape measurer when the wind caused a nearby metal stud (weighing 60 pounds) to fall over on him. He was struck on the back and suffered a contusion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee drove a truck toward the wharf crane. The crane lifted the truck while the employee was still inside. The truck and trailer became unattached, fell to the ground, and bounced onto the concrete surface, jostling the employee around inside the truck. He suffered two bruised vertebrae and required surgery.
On 11/01/2016, an employee was operating a pallet jack in the warehouse when he hit a forklift and fell off the pallet jack, landing on his back. He was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was standing near a base cover while it was being lowered by crane. The employee noticed damage on the cover and started to spin it to access the part that needed repairs. The crane operator was not aware of the employee and continued to lower the cover. The employee's fingers were caught between the cover and the crane, amputating the left fourth finger mid-nailbed and the third fingertip.
An employee was unloading boxes (weighing 5 to 25 pounds) from a truck when the boxes fell on her, causing her to fall off the two-step stool. She broke her right ankle and required surgery.
On November 1, 2016, at 5:50 p.m., an employee fell from a pallet mover to the concrete floor, landing on and fracturing the left hip.

An employee was starting to clean the cabin of an off-road haul truck used for rough terrain when his left middle finger was caught between the truck frame and the truck door, amputating the fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell over a 2-inch form, fracturing his left elbow.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on the extruder unit when the machine caught and fractured three of the employee's fingers, requiring pins and surgery.
An employee's right hand was crushed by a press brake when the material he was holding slipped out of place and caused his hand to enter the machine.
An employee was obtaining supplies from a closet and slipped and fell.
While setting reinforcing 10 gauge wire for a concrete form, the wire slipped and poked an employee in the left eye resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped and fell down a ramp rupturing a tendon in the left knee. The employee was hospitalized.

The bucket on a backhoe froze up and an employee tried to free it up. When the bucket moved, the employee's right hand  was pinched between the moving pin and the hole that it was inserted into resulting in a right thumb amputation.
An employee was moving a standup forklift and returning it to the parking area when his foot was pinned between the forklift and a rack, breaking it.

An employee was climbing over the side of a 10-story residential high rise's parapet wall when he fell. His safety equipment engaged and he hit the side of the building. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle and minor rope burns.

An employee was dislodging a 2-foot-long pole-top cutoff when the pole became lodged on a belt. His right hand was caught between the pole-top cutoff and the belt, which resulted in the degloving of the back of his right hand and the amputation of his right pinky down to the first knuckle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a centerfire machine and smashed a fingertip in the machine. The tip was re-attached. There was no bone loss.

An employee was using a table grinder to grind the end of a pipe. The wheel of the grinder grabbed the pipe, causing it to shift. The employee's hand was caught between the pipe and the disconnect on the grinder, amputating the pinky finger between the first and second knuckles and damaging the ring finger tendon.

An employee was on the ground setting up some steel parts when an 8-inch C-channel post that had been previously set became loose and hit the employee on the back of his head, causing head trauma. He was hospitalized and required stitches.
An employee was troubleshooting an air compressor. The plastic line coupling blew off and struck the employee in the face lacerating and breaking the employee's nose and breaking their cheekbone.
An employee was performing maintenance on a forklift when the forks came down and struck the employee. The employee suffered a shoulder fracture and was hospitalized.
While walking to his car, the employee fell to the ground and suffered a laceration to the eye.
While installing blocking between trusses, an employee fell through the trusses to the concrete floor, suffering a broken leg and hip.
An employee was installing bolts using an extension ladder and fell approximately 13 feet resulting in two broken ribs.

An employee was moving a block of logs from the yokes of a machine. The operator stopped the machine and the employee stepped between the yokes to remove the log. While his foot was between the yokes, the operator restarted the machine, fracturing the employee's right foot. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was going up on a fixed ladder attached to a convenience store exterior wall. When he reached the top, he fell approximately 10 feet. During his fall, he hit the back side of his body on the metal toolbox of the company utility track, fracturing his spine.

An employee was operating a feed mill grinder when a belt started slipping. As he was checking the belt, the machine energized and pulled his right middle finger in, pinching it between the belt and pulley and amputating his fingertip. The machine was not locked out or guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was unloading the truck, tripped in a rut and fell onto their right side rupturing the L4 vertebrae.

On November 1, 2016, an employee entered a robot workspace to clear a jam in the handles machine. The robot became energized and pinned the employee against the machine, lacerating the employee's liver and causing other internal injuries.

An employee was working at the loading dock to retrieve new merchandise clothing from the truck. While utilizing a Z-cart, the employee's foot was caught under the Z-cart wheel. She tripped and fell to the concrete surface, fracturing her right shoulder.
While dumping refuse, an employee slipped and fell, breaking a femur.
An employee was attempting to replace a chain on an energized machine when his left hand became engaged in a live sprocket wheel, amputating the third, fourth, and fifth digits.

An employee was pulling on a pry bar to loosen a track on a skid steer piece of equipment. The pry bar slipped, causing the employee to fall backwards and strike the loader bucket. The employee suffered three broken ribs on the right side.
On November 1, 2016, an employee suffered a stroke after assessing a patient in a room where air deodorizer had been used.
On November 1, 2016, an employee was operating a machine and amputated his left index and middle fingertips.
An employee fell off his horse while moving cattle. The horse then stepped on his lower left leg, breaking it.

An employee was lifting a piece of machinery with a crane when the load slipped and his left index finger was pinched between the beam on the crane and the load. He was hospitalized and his left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading parcels from a truck when was struck in the groin with a box. The employee was hospitalized for swelling and blood in the urine.

An employee was troubleshooting a chain and sprocket inside a welder machine conveyor when a coworker started the machine from the other end while the employee's hand was still inside. His left fourth fingertip was amputated.
An employee was securing a flatbed semi-trailer on top of another semi-trailer using cargo chains and load binders when he rolled his ankle, breaking it.

An employee was operating a forklift and unloading materials from a tractor trailer when he noticed dunnage under the pallet and got off the forklift to remove it. The forks then crushed his left middle finger, requiring surgical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was conducting construction activities when a wooden structural beam fell and struck the employee's head, causing an internal head injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
A worker suffered chest pain and increased blood pressure due to physical exertion from training exercises, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was disembarking from a tram when she tripped due to the slight decline in elevation, breaking her upper arm, tearing her rotator cuff, and dislocating her right shoulder. She was hospitalized.
While stepping out of a construction vehicle, an employee suffered a foot laceration and two fractured toes.

On November 2, 2016, an employee was pushing a rolling stack of 1" trusses toward center stage from upstage when one of the stage boards (which was on ice) shifted, creating a spot for a wheel to become stuck. The trusses began to fall over and the employee tried to stop them. When he did, the trusses struck him in the face and broke his jaw.
An employee was using a pipe wrench to unstop the motor of the bagger when the pipe wrench slipped and hit him, breaking his left jaw and lacerating his neck. He was hospitalized for surgery.
While coming out of a tank retaining area, an employee tripped over a retaining wall and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured left hip that required surgery.
An employee was picking up a metal extension for a forklift when the equipment fell on his hand and partially amputated his right middle finger.

An employee was disassembling the Y-axis ball on a CNC machine when the ball came loose. He moved the ball screw and it became dislodged and struck his left index finger, amputating it just behind the fingernail.
An employee was walking to his work trailer when he was struck by a work truck, breaking his left tibia and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing outside a tank that was being cleaned. The cleaning head came out of the tank through the manway and struck the employee causing a laceration to the abdomen and shoulder.
An employee was operating a friction welding unit when the clamp for hold-down caught and fractured the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was descending a ladder and stepped down on a hose, breaking the right ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to place a new shear bolt in the auger when the power take-off was engaged to line up the shaft and insert the bolt. His right arm was then caught and amputated in the auger.

An employee's left foot became caught underneath a shelf in the auto parts store. When the employee attempted to walk, his foot remained caught, causing him to fall and fracture his left foot. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was preparing to rig up a laydown truck using a rake. He was standing on top of the rake when it was activated. The rake then came back up and smashed his left foot between it and the laydown truck.

An employee was using a forklift to unload a pallet from the top rack (approximately 15 feet) of an industrial storage rack. The employee stepped off of the forklift to inspect the contents of the pallet he had just moved. At this time, three separate cardboard boxes of rubber hoses fell from the top rack. While backing away, the employee suffered a scalp laceration (from being struck by the boxes or from tripping and falling).

An employee was on a step ladder on an elevated deck. He was attempting to secure a piece of metal on a roof overhang when he fell 12-15 feet. The employee was hospitalized for three fractured ribs and three fractured vertebrae. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to dislodge a piece of veneer that was caught in a machine when her glove was pulled into the drive gears in the lower in-feed belt. Her right index finger was pinched and smashed by the drive gears. The machine was running and guarded at the time of the incident.
While leaning on a paver pallet, an employee fell approximately 2.5 feet. The employee's right arm was caught between the pallet and a steel plate, breaking it.

While attempting to remove a piece of yarn from a stretcher machine roller, an employee's right arm was caught and severely fractured in the roller. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

On November 2, 2016, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was walking on a flat concrete surface when he tripped over a support beam's protruding base metal flange, which was 1 inch off the ground, fracturing his right elbow.

An employee was attempting to make an adjustment on a golf course hole when he was run over by a deep tine machine that was being towed by a tractor. He suffered fractures to both legs below the knees.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured left cheekbone, a laceration near his left eye from his eyeglasses, and a left shoulder contusion.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut wooden pieces for window frames when the saw amputated two of his fingers.
An employee was cutting paper with a large paper cutter when her left thumb entered the cutting area. The paper cutter then amputated the tip of her left thumb.
