An employee was working in a box truck and loading equipment. When she pulled a strap on boxes, the strap broke. She then hit her head on the box truck wall and suffered a head injury that required hospitalization.
On 11/2/2016, an employee fell 10 feet to the concrete pad below while performing a tie beam inspection on a second-story deck, breaking both ankles. The deck was unguarded at the time.
An employee was cutting granite to trim the edge and the saw kicked back, lacerating their chin and jaw.
Two employees were engaged in horseplay and one employee fell and hit his head on the shop floor. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
The cap on a pressurized water tank blew off and the pressure knocked an employee over. The employee suffered a concussion, a broken jaw and a cut on his right arm.

An employee was struck by a 10' x 10' section of wood framing while he was descending from a ladder. He fell 6 feet to the ground. While he was on the ground, the section of framing fell on top of him, breaking his collarbone, two left-side ribs, and two right-side ribs.

On November 3, 2016, at approximately 1:40 p.m., a temporary employee was cleaning production equipment with sodium hydroxide material in a 5-gallon bucket. The employee wore rain suit pants, gloves, goggles, and a long-sleeve shirt. The caustic material made contact with the employee's right forearm, resulting in a burn that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was standing in a doorway directing a forklift operator. The front-end assembly on the forklift was being lowered down to retrieve a concrete troweling machine. The boom went sideways and struck the employee, breaking three ribs.
An employee tripped over a halogen light stand and suffered a knee injury, requiring hospitalization.
While cleaning the windshield of a backhoe, an employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering internal injuries.

An employee was trying to bring cement into a silo. When he stuck his hand into a butterfly valve, the valve closed, smashing multiple fingers on his right hand. His middle fingertip was surgically removed.
An employee was standing on a trailer inside of a tank spraying foam insulation when he slipped and fell 2 feet. He landed awkwardly and fractured his right femur.
A temporary employee was shot in the right knee while operating a nail gun to manufacture crates, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing lids from a yogurt cup filler while standing on a platform that was approximately 19 inches off the floor. After unloading the lids, she walked down the step leading up to the platform from floor level, lost her footing, and fell into a 24" high stand, breaking two right-side ribs and puncturing her right lung.
Employee slipped off a side boom and hit the side boom stick, breaking his ribs and lacerating his kidneys. He was hospitalized.
On November 3, 2016, an employee's hand and finger were pinched while lowering a piano plate onto a table, amputating part of the middle finger.

On 11/03/2016, at approximately 5:15 PM, an employee was troubleshooting a gizzard machine that was not running properly. He was attempting to identify the problem and got assistance from a coworker. He closed the cover and shut down the machine. The machine was turned back on while the employee's right hand was in the moving/rotating parts of the chain drive and sprocket, amputating 3/4 of his index finger and 1/2 of his middle finger.
Two employees were arguing in the parking lot when one employee struck the other employee in the jaw. He fell to the ground and hit his head on the concrete surface.
An employee was checking a truck when he saw a wire in the engine compartment. When he attempted to grab the wire, his right index finger was amputated by the fan belt.
An employee was walking with a piece of pipe in his hand when he tripped over a cord that was laying on the ground. He fell to the ground and landed on his left hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing work in a residential house to turn on the gas when the customer's dogs broke though the rear door and bit the employee's left forearm, fracturing it and requiring surgery.
On November 3, 2016, at 8:30 a.m., an employee fell onto the floor and fractured her left hip.

An employee was inspecting a facility's piping and fitting systems when a 3/4-inch pipe broke. He fell approximately 4 feet and fractured one of his shoulders. The hot steam from that broken pipe caused first and second degree burns to the front and back side of his legs.
An employee was cutting metal with an electric saw. The saw blade jammed with material and cut the employee's right index finger.

At approximately 10:25 AM, an employee was walking up a stairway where the railing had been removed for a tank installation. When the employee walked up the stairway and reached for the missing railing, he lost his balance and fell off the side of the stairs, fracturing his spine and pelvis.
An employee was using an emery cloth on a bar stock that was turning on a lathe when his glove was caught on the cutting mount, pulling his left hand into the machine and cutting it.
An employee was  hospitalized after a blade cut four right-hand fingers.
An employee was helping to dismantle a scaffold when he fell into an ankle-deep "trench," causing him to lose his balance and fall. He fractured his ankle.

While stepping out of a trailer, an employee grabbed the hinge of the rear trailer door. The employee's hands were pinched in the hinge, breaking the right middle finger and pinching the left index finger.
An employee slipped on wet grass while delivering mail. He fell and broke his ankle.

An employee was attempting to check the valve position on top of a small bulk tank. He placed a ladder against the tank to get a better view of the valve and was climbing up. As he reached the half
way point, the ladder slipped on the smooth concrete surface and he fell 4 to 6 feet and landed on his right 
knee, breaking his kneecap.

An employee was backing into an aisle with a motorized power jack when he lost balance and stepped off the jack. His right foot was then pinched between the power jack and a rack, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was driving a stand-up lift when it struck a yellow rail. He suffered a laceration and three left foot fractures.

An employee was walking on an aluminum roof to patch it when he tripped and fell 13 feet through a skylight. The area was not marked or protected by guardrail systems or covers. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

An employee was standing on the back of his truck on a toolbox while grinding a pipe down. He missed a step, lost his footing, and fell on the toolbox, breaking two ribs and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee suffered a right middle finger amputation while using a wood working machine.
An employee's walker caught on a loose rug as she was exiting the restroom. She fell, hitting her head and twisting her left knee.

An employee was using a 6-foot pry bar to move a bent piece of pipe (4.5" .290 wall) that would not roll down the starwheel discharge ramp. As the employee pulled on the pry bar, which was partially inserted into the pipe, the bar slipped and caught the his right ring fingertip and part of his pinky finger between the pry bar and a post supporting a pass-line chain. He was hospitalized.

On Friday November 4, 2016, at approximately 5:30 a.m., a temporary employee was working with a coworker to hand feed fabric into a fabric cutter machine. At some point during the operation, fabric entangled the employee's hand and pulled it into the point of operation. The employee suffered a partial right ring fingertip amputation and lacerations to the right middle and pinky fingers.
An employee was cleaning a truck with a pressure washer when the employee's left hand was lacerated by the pressure washer's stream of high-pressure water.
An employee slipped on leaves in the parking lot and fell, fracturing an ankle.
While shelving pallets on a second layer bay, an employee fell approximately 6 feet from the layer bay to the floor, fracturing both wrists and suffering a head injury.

On Friday November 4, 2016, at approximately 8:00 a.m., an employee was loading corn onto a running conveyor while a trailer was dumping corn nearby. The employee's right arm was caught on and amputated by the rotating power-take-off shaft of the auger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee and a coworker were arguing over a personal issue when the coworker bit and stabbed (with a metal thermometer) the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized with a punctured lung.

On November 4, 2016, an employee was moving laminated beams when one fell, hit the ground, bounced back up, and pinched the employee's right middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cutting metal pipe with a cutting torch that used acetylene and oxygen gas during interior metal removal when the torch caused second and third degree burns to the employee's face and hands. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.

An employee was attaching hooks to an upright storage tank when the tank moved, causing the employee to fall approximately 7 feet from the ladder to the concrete below. The employee suffered a fractured wrist and damaged heel.

An employee was guiding a hydraulic cylinder ram into its storage rack while it was supported by a small jib crane. As he was guiding the cylinder, the ram slowly retracted. The head of the ram then pinched the employee's finger against the bolt and the frame, crushing and partially amputating his right index finger.

An employee was standing on top of a first floor wall and was setting floor joists for the second floor when he lost his footing and fell 10 to 12 feet to the concrete ground below, suffering a head injury.

An employee was walking back to her van after an outing with a client when she fell off a curb and onto the parking lot pavement. She fractured her left wrist and right shoulder, requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was going to install bolts onto plates on furnaces located on the third level when he stepped on a piece of metal stair grating that had not been welded down. The grating flipped and the employee fell through the opening to the stair landing 7 feet below, suffering a fractured L1 vertebra.
An employee was working inside of a tank that was roped off when he fell approximately 10 to 12 feet, lacerating his right ear, fracturing his right facial bone, and puncturing his upper right leg.

An employee was performing a test on a device when the Teflon wires of the unit became charged. The device exploded in the employee's hands, causing small cuts and puncture wounds to both hands from small metal pieces.
An employee pressed a button to raise an overhead door and ducked under the door as it was rising. The door broke loose from the its cable and fell, striking his head.
An employee was framing the external shell of the building when a block of wood fell off a wall and struck the employee's head. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee's right hand was pulled into machine rollers, amputating the right index fingertip (above the knuckle).
On November 5, 2016, an employee fell approximately 4 feet from a ladder, suffering head and rib injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was reversing a powered industrial truck when it collided with another parked powered industrial truck. The employee suffered a lacerated artery in the right leg and required surgery.

An employee was waiting for pipe to come out to the accumulator station where he would lower it down to build a unit. A pipe came down the line from the preheater and was moving to the next station when it went sideways on the line. When the employee attempted to straighten out the pipe, the machine's sensor activated the pipe pusher, which pinned him between the pipe pusher and the table. He suffered a fractured pelvis.

On November 5, 2016, at approximately 6:15 AM, an employee was unhooking his trailer from the truck when he slipped and fell, striking the truck frame and fuel tank. The employee sustained a fractured rib, bruised ribs, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was loading product onto an elevated pallet that was on a forklift. The lift operator lowered the load while the employee had his hand in the lift mast area, pinching/crushing his hand/fingers.

An employee was using an air hose to blow off the router bit on a router machine. The employee's sleeve was caught in the rotating router bit, pulling his arm into the rotating equipment. He suffered a laceration on his right elbow up to his armpit. The router machine was in operation at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing a circuit breaker on an existing panel. As the breaker made contact with the bus bar, an arc flash occurred, causing first degree burns on the employee's face and second degree burns on both arms.

An employee was moving a cart in a warehouse when a nearby pallet that was being moved pushed the cart and smashed the employee's finger between the cart and a pole, amputating the left ring fingertip.

An employee was standing on a dock plate between a semi-trailer and the loading dock when the truck driver moved the trailer away from the dock. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was driving downhill to return a UTV (utility terrain vehicle) to a truck when he lost control and capsized, breaking 11 ribs.
An employee was lifting a gear box off of a motor when a plate clamp failed, allowing a metal plate to fall on his left hand and crush four fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to feed foam through a jammed slitter when his left thumb was caught on a roller and pulled into the blade compartment. He suffered a left thumb amputation.
While working on a derrick, an employee's right thumb was caught between a rotator and a stuffing box during a drilling process. The first digit of the employee's right thumb was amputated.

An employee was picking up trash and putting it on the back of a truck. The employee rode on the back of the truck holding the trash while a coworker drove the truck to a dumpster a block away. The employee fell from the back of the truck to the road, suffering a head laceration and four broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a car to be loaded on a cargo ship when he hit a light pole in the yard. He suffered body pain and a cut to the top of his left eye and possibly required back surgery.
An employee was rolling up a tarp when his glove and arm became caught in the automatic roller. He suffered a right arm fracture.

An employee was selecting cases in an aisle when he could not get his jack to respond. He then became pinned between a rack bar and the backrest on his equipment while still inside the cab, suffering a lacerated liver.

An employee was troubleshooting the circuit of a photo eye. When he touched the photo eye, the material next to him moved forward and caught him between two pieces of aluminum material, breaking his ribs. He fell to the ground and suffered a contusion.

An employee was performing a service trouble call at a private residence. He went into the attic and put his hand down on a truss that had a live wire, suffering an electrical shock that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the surface of a grinding plate when the plate amputated a right-hand fingertip.

An employee was on the shoulder of the road and as he was retrieving parts from his work truck to repair an irrigation line a vehicle ran off the road and struck him. The employee received a contusion to his right leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a press machine. The machine completed its cycle while the employee's hand was next to an air cylinder, partially amputating the employee's left middle finger and fracturing the left ring finger.
An employee fell from a height and broke his left leg.
An employee was stowing a jib crane when his right ring finger was caught and partially amputated between the crane's frame and the bump stop, requiring surgery.
An employee was assessing a customer's roof when the employee's ladder slid away, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet. The employee suffered four broken ribs and a scalp laceration.

On November 7, 2016, an employee tripped and fell while picking up scrap buckets and stuck out the left hand to catch him/herself from falling. The employee's left hand entered a cut-out on a turning machine mechanism, amputating the middle fingertip.
On November 07, 2016, an employee who had been servicing a circulating water pump began to feel ill. The employee sought treatment at a local hospital and was diagnosed with legionellosis.
An employee was sand blasting parts when the sand blaster fell. As he tried to catch the sand blaster, it discharged into his left armpit, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were changing out a belt on a piece of equipment. They locked out the machine and were pulling belts on a pulley. The first employee was aligning the belt around the next groove when the second employee manually gave the shaft another turn, trapping the first employee's finger under the belt and above the pulley. His left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a circular saw when it cut the employee's hand.
An employee was driving a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when it struck a column. The employee's left leg was pinched and crushed between the column and the PIV.
An employee was working on a new recycler, when a piece of the recycler fell on and partially amputated the employee's middle finger.

The employee went to a 5-drawer office cabinet and pulled the top drawer open. The two drawers on the bottom came out at the same time the top drawer was open and the entire cabinet fell over and landed on the employee. The employee injured her hip and sustained lacerations to her legs and upper body.

An employee was performing maintenance work on an injection molding machine, attempting to unclog a valve, when pressure that built up behind the valve caused it to release hot nylon. The nylon burned the employee's right hand, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a truck in the parking lot, suffering possible back and neck injuries.
An employee was loading a dolly of product inside a truck when he tripped or fell and the loaded dolly fell onto his right leg, breaking it.

An employee was removing a door wedge to close a door when the employee's left pinky finger was pinched in the closing door. The employee's left pinky was amputated to the first knuckle just above the nail.

An employee was replacing roller bearing adapters on a railcar when the jack moved, causing the side frame to move. When the jack moved, the employee's right hand was partially between the adapter and the side frame, compressing his right middle and ring fingers and amputating the first joint of his index finger.
An employee was operating a centrifugal furnace to manufacture silicon when the furnace blew out, burning the employee's lower body extremities.
An employee was preparing to re-thread ropes on a sheave pulley when his right middle fingertip was amputated.
A horse kicked an employee in the torso with both back legs.
An employee fell through a tray ceiling while working in the attic of a residential home, suffering a bruised knee and cut hand.

An employee was working on a vehicle on the lift with the engine running. The employee attempted to stop the spinning front wheel and caught their left index finger in the wheel spokes resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning the funnel on a die cast machine while standing on an inverted pail. He slipped off the pail and tried to catch himself with his right hand. The die cast's shot rod retracted, catching and crushing his right pinky and thumb, resulting in fractures.
An employee stepped off a curb and fell while walking in the parking lot, suffering a shoulder strain.
An employee was pushing a food cart to an outside garbage container when he fell. He suffered two hematomas and an elbow contusion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had an allergic reaction to cleaning chemicals used in her area of operations. She was admitted to the hospital for breathing difficulties.
An employee fell from the loading dock and injured their back and ribs.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 and the handheld powered saw jammed and jerked back amputating the end of his left thumb.
While installing a light fixture, an employee was shocked and fell from a ladder, hitting the ground and suffering a lower back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam on the printing press and sustained a partial amputation of the left ring finger and a laceration to the left middle finger.

On November 7, 2016, at approximately 8:15 a.m., an employee on a ladder was installing an overhead gas line approximately 12 feet above the ground. A coworker climbed the backside of the employee's 10-foot fiberglass ladder, causing the support rungs to bend and the ladder to collapse. The employee fell to the concrete below and was hospitalized for a fractured collarbone and punctured lung.
On 11/07/2016, an employee was standing on a tire when he slipped and fell 3 feet to the ground, suffering a hip fracture. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was removing a loose board from the floor of a trailer when he lost his grip and stepped on a nail sticking out of the floor, puncturing his left foot.
A temporary employee was sawing wood with a table saw when the saw amputated his right thumb tip.
An employee was installing acoustic panels while standing on a Perry scaffold system. The system became unstable and the employee fell breaking the left leg.

On 11/07/2016, an employee was working in the waste area of two mills where a waste block was hung between a shaker and conveyor belt. The employee was going to pull the waste block out when the sleeve of his jacket was caught and pulled his hand between the waste block and the conveyor belt. The flesh of his hand was pulled back, requiring surgery.

An employee was installing a grain bin while standing on a ladder when a nearby coworker's ladder fell on him, causing him to fall 13 to 15 feet to the ground below. He suffered a broken left arm and facial cuts.

An employee was walking down a staircase when he overstepped from the second-to-last-step to the bottom of the staircase and fell forward onto his knees. The patella tendons were torn in both of his knees, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was exiting the driver side of a line truck when he slipped off the top step and fell to the pavement, fracturing his vertebrae.

While operating a forklift, an employee struck a truck that was being repaired. The employee then attempted to reverse the forklift while a hand was on the outside of the roll bar, but went forward instead. The employee's right pinky finger was caught and amputated between the forklift's roll bar and the truck.
An employee was cleaning electrical contacts when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee's arm.
An employee was cleaning an auger when he dropped a tool in the machine. The moving auger amputated his finger as he attempted to retrieve the tool.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor when a roller caught and amputated the employee's left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was polishing a metal shaft on a lathe when their hand was pulled into the lathe tearing skin and muscle.

An employee was replacing a sprinkler pipe while standing on a trestle ladder. As he was tightening the sprinkler pipe with a pipe wrench, he lost his grip and fell from the ladder, injuring his head, back, and left shoulder. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a metal shear when the shear guard came down and crushed his left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working in the fitting room area when she felt dizzy, experienced a racing heart, and passed out due to dehydration. She was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a car in a work zone, suffering a head laceration, leg and torso bruising, and internal injuries.

An employee was operating wire pulling equipment when the glove on his left hand was caught in a rope, which pulled his arms and body into the equipment. His left thumb was amputated and he required surgery for right wrist and arm injuries.
An employee received an electrical shock of 277 volts while installing commercial light fixtures.
An employee slipped off a rung while descending a fixed ladder. The employee used a hand to cover the face to avoid a direct strike and suffered a left wrist injury that required surgery.
An employee was struck by a counterweight while adjusting lines during workover rigging activities. The employee suffered facial injuries and a fractured eye socket.
An employee was transferring water from one pot to another when the hot water spilled onto both feet, causing third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee struck a pole while driving a forklift and was ejected. The employee lost consciousness, suffered a neck injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to close the safety clasp on a lifting hook when his right middle finger became stuck in the clasp and was partially amputated.
An employee was being trained on an electric pallet jack when he swerved into a parked semi truck. His left leg was caught between the truck and the pallet jack, breaking it.

An employee had just finished a maintenance function on the de-burring machine and was in the process of starting it back up. The employee was then caught between the hopper and de-burring table, suffering a crushing injury to the upper left chest, including a fractured scapula and extensive bruising. The employee was hospitalized overnight. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to pry a bar away from a lint cleaner drum when the pry bar slipped, catching the employee's left little finger and amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee's left foot was crushed and lacerated between a forklift and a shelving guardrail as he stepped off the lift. The forklift was moving at the time.
A truck rolled over both of an employee's legs after the employee exited the vehicle, fracturing both of the employee's ankles.

An employee was using a pickaxe to poke and break up clumps of material inside a hopper when the spike end of the pickaxe was caught by a rotating auger in the hopper, causing the other end of the axe to strike and scrape the employee's face. He sustained a severe injury to the right side of his face. His lip was severely traumatized and lacerated, his facial skin was ripped and peeled, and his cheekbone broke.
An employee was cutting a steel I-beam using an oxygen/acetylene torch. When he cut all the way through the beam, it fell on and broke his right leg.
On November 8, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after tripping over a pallet jack and suffering a leg injury.

On November 8, 2016, at approximately 12:45 p.m., an employee was clearing a jam on a conveyor that carries scrap to the chipper when he made contact with the rotating band saw blade. The blade cut through his hard hat and made contact with his skull, resulting in stitches and hospitalization.
On November 8, 2016, an employee was cutting and removing bandings from bundles of tubing when two pieces of tubing fell and fractured the employee's right foot.

An employee was standing on a step platform and tried to pull product from a conveyor belt using a hook. The hook pulled his right hand into the conveyor, partially amputating his middle finger. The conveyor was not locked out at the time.
An employee was cleaning an auger when it was activated. The auger blades partially amputated the employee's left index finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was taking materials from a shelf when he fell backwards from a step stool and hit the back of his head, requiring hospitalization.
On November 8, 2016, an employee slipped and fell while walking in the parking lot, suffering a fractured neck.
On November 9, 2016, an employee suffered a pinky finger amputation while using a press brake to bend sheet metal.

An employee was working in the warehouse and loading stacks of panels (3 feet wide, 48 feet long, stacked 7 feet high). One of the stacks fell over and landed on the employee, who suffered internal injuries, broken ribs, and a broken collarbone.

An employee was retrieving a tire from a storage container. As he was moving it out the doorway, his grip on the tire and assembly slipped. When he tried to grab the assembly, his left finger was crushed between the tire/wheel assembly and the door frame, requiring hospitalization for a finger laceration.

An employee was on a ladder approximately 8 feet up. The employee attempted to move the ladder away from a tree branch, lost his balance and/or footing, and fell onto the concrete sidewalk. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and a fractured rib.
An employee was attacked while assisting with a violent patient, requiring hospitalization for a concussion.
An employee was locking truck compartment doors in the parking lot when a coworker lowered an outrigger on his right foot, crushing it.
On November 9, 2016, at 3:45 p.m., an employee was using a cutting torch to cut through an I-beam that rested on a forklift when the I-beam fell and crushed the employee's foot, amputating two toes.

As an employee was reversing the forklift, he placed his right hand on the forklift cage. His thumb struck against a cylinder protruding from one of the plastics machines, amputating three-quarters of the thumb.

An employee was helping to remove and install new steel roofing on a barn when he fell approximately 20 feet through the roof insulation to the concrete floor below, injuring his bottom lip, right eye, and elbow. He required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam from a tapper machine when his right index finger was pinched between the shuttle piece and the metal frame, partially amputating his fingertip.

An employee was driving a scissor lift down a loading ramp when the lift suddenly jack knifed and started to slide. The lift tipped over and the employee attempted to jump out but was tied off to the lift, causing the employee to break a femur.
An employee was operating a power press and attempting to place a part when four left-hand fingers were amputated in the pinch point between the press die and the part.
An employee's left ring finger was pinched and partially amputated between two parts while stacking parts on a rack.
An employee was using a jackhammer to cut a hole in a concrete road when the jack hammer bounced onto his right foot, severely cutting his big toe.
An employee was operating a forklift when the lift slid down an embankment. As the forklift was tipping over, the employee was ejected and broke his pelvic bone.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access a single-story roof when he slipped at the roof edge and fell 8 to 9 feet, sustaining a broken leg and facial trauma.
An employee's lower leg was caught in a grain transfer auger as the employee was running beans from one bin to another. The leg was amputated above the knee.

An employee was packaging lunch meat containers on a conveyor line when one of the container lids became dislodged. When she tried to retrieve the lid, her fingers were caught in the middle of the two adjoining conveyer lines. Her right ring and middle fingers were severely lacerated, and her ring finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was manually operating a filler machine with a coworker. While he was moving the filler, one of his fingertips was amputated before the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when she ran into a metal barrier. Her legs were pinned between the metal barrier and the jack, fracturing both ankles.

An employee was sitting on the floor and organizing items under a desk. When he tried to lift himself up onto a rolling chair, the chair rolled out from under him. He then fell, hit his head on the wall, and rolled onto his right shoulder.
An employee sustained a fingertip amputation when it was caught in a door slammed by another person.
An employee was unloading a hopper when the hopper door closed on his left thumb, amputating the tip.
A temporary employee was operating a filler machine when the machine's roller bearings caught his glove and pulled his hand in, amputating his right index finger just before the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to reinstall a chain on a drive sprocket when his right thumb was pinched as the chain rolled the chain sprocket, amputating his thumb below the knuckle.
An employee suffered an amputation while working on a trim press.
After delivering mail to a house, an employee turned and started to descend the steps, which were wet. He slipped on the steps and broke his left ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee's fingertip was amputated in a machine.
An employee was reassembling the funnel component on a machine when he slipped and fell approximately 3 feet from the crossbar in front of the machine to the floor, fracturing his left wrist.
An employee was cleaning print ink on a roll with a cloth when an uncovered gear at the end of the roll amputated his pinky finger. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped and fell, breaking her hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using an overhead crane to load a raft onto a pre-former. As the raft went down into place on the pre-former, the employee's left middle finger was between the raft and the pre-former. This resulted in a pinch point that amputated his left middle fingertip/pad and fingernail.
An employee leaving the kitchen slipped on tartar sauce and fell, fracturing a hip.
An employee's sleeve became caught and tangled in a 3-inch magnet drill's bit, breaking the left arm in two places.
An employee was cutting laminate on a table saw when he became dizzy and put his hand down on the table to catch his balance. The sawblade then amputated his left index fingertip.
On November 10, 2016, an employee tripped and fell over a pallet while assisting a vocational rehab member. The employee suffered a broken right elbow.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while crossing the street, suffering a concussion, a cut over the left eyebrow, and a broken left leg.

After checking sulfur levels in a fertilizer building, an employee fell while descending a fixed wooden ladder and sustained a broken pelvis, broken ribs, broken C-3 vertebra, and internal bleeding as a result of the fall.
An employee's fingertip was caught and amputated in a paper coating machine. The machine was not locked and/or tagged out at the time.
An employee was descending a 12-foot column form and came down on a section of rebar that was in his path. The piece of rebar impaled his left upper leg.
While cleaning the blade on a waste truck, an employee's hand was caught and injured in the blade area, requiring hospitalization. The truck was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was dumping lime from a flatbed dump truck onto a customer's field when the truck tipped over. The employee was inside the cab at the time of the incident and suffered a cervical fracture, a leg hematoma, and several contusions.
Two employees were installing wood trusses on the balcony of an apartment when they fell approximately 30 feet, suffering bumps and bruises and a fractured hand.

An employee was attempting to unhook an aircraft tow bar from an aircraft tug when a coworker put the tug in neutral. The tug lurched slightly and the mechanism that secured the tow bar closed onto the employee's right thumb, requiring hospitalization.
When an employee opened a trailer door, a mini refrigerator fell out and struck the employee on the head, causing a simple spinal fracture.
On November 10, 2016, an employee was cleaning glue machine rollers when his hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket area, partially amputating his ring and pinky fingers.
On November 10, 2016, an employee's right ring finger was caught and avulsed between a guard and a band saw, requiring amputation.

An employee was "locating" cotton bales (scanning bar codes) weighing 480 pounds when the bale(s) fell and struck him. He lost consciousness and sustained a broken leg, back injury, and laceration on top of his head from ear to ear. He required surgery.
An employee was moving an A-frame across a loading dock when a drain tipped over and fell. The employee was trapped between the wall and the falling material, breaking his leg.
An employee's left middle finger was caught and amputated between a refrigerator door and a room door.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she fell and hit the ground, breaking her nose. She was hospitalized.

An employee fell through a drop ceiling while servicing the condenser on a cooling unit. The employee struck a 3'x4'x5' cart and then fell to the concrete floor below, fracturing the L1 and L2 vertebrae.
An employee's finger was struck by a locking mechanism resulting in amputation.
The employee was climbing the asphalt distributor tank to take measurements when a fire occurred. The employee was burned on the hand, face and upper torso.
An employee finished loading a vehicle, turned to walk away, and stepped/slipped on a rotten banana peel. He fell forward onto his left knee and broke his kneecap.
An employee's finger was pinched in a printing machine.
An employee was loading a box when it fell back, causing the employee to lose balance and fall. The employee suffered a broken rib and punctured lung.
An employee slipped on a condiment spill and hit her head on the floor. She was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading sulfuric acid 98% from a truck. When he disconnected the truck's black transfer hose from the host's receiving cam lock, he was sprayed with the chemical and suffered severe chemical burns to his neck, abdomen, left thigh, and left calf.

An employee was walking out of the showroom to greet a customer when she stepped off a walkway ramp, twisted her ankle, and fell on her left side. She suffered abrasions to the left knee and forehead and a fractured left elbow.
While attempting to unclog a jammed leaf blower, an employee's left index fingertip was amputated by rotating parts.
An employee fainted while walking from one building to another. The fainting was considered to be work-related and stress induced.
An employee was walking with crutches. As she turned around, she tripped and fell, breaking her right hip.
An employee was compacting an embankment (fill material) using a single drum vibratory roller when the machine overturned. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.

An employee was changing steel form panels to create a box culvert. The corner panel (located on a forklift) had a loose screw that broke, causing the load to disengage and drop 6 inches. A panel fell on the employee's foot, causing an injury that required that hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's left leg was fractured when he tried to prevent his reach truck from striking a fixed guardrail.
An employee was inside a packaging machine. The operator did not see him and activated the machine. He was crushed and suffered spinal injuries. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee lost his balance and fell while stepping up on a walkway, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee had delivered a package to the front door of a resident's home. On the way back to the truck, the employee tripped on an uneven surface and fell forward, hitting her face on the cement driveway. She suffered a scratched nose, left eyelid cut, and swelling around her left eye.

An employee was extinguishing a fire beneath a combine. The combine driver did not know the employee was beneath the combine and ran over the employee, who suffered internal bleeding in the right leg and a spinal injury.
An employee was training in the gym. After completing a workout he felt ill and his left bicep later became swollen due to a muscle injury.

On November 11, 2016, at approximately 1:30 p.m., two employees were hospitalized after receiving second degree burns to the face and third degree burns to both arms from a flash fire that occurred during a natural gas leak at a wellhead.
An employee was hooking up acid hoses to pump acid in a batch when he slipped and fell in a puddle of acid. He suffered severe chemical burns on his arms and legs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was shimming a rotor assembly in a lathe to correct a run-out condition before turning the part in a CNC turning lathe. The tail stock foot pedal was actuated, closing the tail stock on and amputating her left index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee suffered a left index fingertip amputation when attempting to open a package of salmon using a chef's knife.
An employee suffered index and middle finger amputations while cleaning the sealing machine. The machine was running at the time.

On November 11, 2016, an employee was attempting to reset an alarm on a corrugator stacker and was standing on a conveyor approximately 1 foot above the ground. The employee stepped on a piece of corrugated material and slipped between the conveyor and a metal support column, fracturing the right lower leg.

An employee was attempting to walk down a wooden bleacher/seating area that was adjacent to the main stairs. When he was on the fourth seating level, he fell down the remaining levels to the concrete floor below, requiring hospitalization.

An employee bent over to pick up cans that had fallen from an accumulation table. When the employee stood up, the employee was struck by the stacker arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right radius bone that required surgery.

An employee was preparing to install pipe into a bore hole when the pipe began bouncing on cribbing. He put his right hand underneath the pipe, and his right pinky fingertip was pinched and amputated between the pipe and the cribbing.

An employee went to the top of an asphalt silo to check on a drag conveyor. His left hand became caught in a drive pulley, amputating his middle finger, lacerating his index finger, and fracturing his wrist. The drive pulley was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was adjusting the position of the cow hide between two metal jaws when his left thumb was caught between the jaws of the skinning machine resulting in a fractured left thumb.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder when his foot slipped. He fell from the caged area of the ladder and broke his left leg.

An employee leaving the facility at the end of a shift was physically assaulted by a former employee in the parking lot. The employee suffered serious head and neck injuries including brain swelling and skull fractures.
An employee was attempting to spray lubricant on a press machine when the machine came down on and burned the employee's right arm. Press blocks were not used at the time of the incident.
An employee was loading equipment and tripped on the lip of the loading ramp and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was standing on a piece of wood while cleaning out a furnace when the wood slipped, causing him to fall.
An employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder when he fell off and hit a water pipe, breaking three ribs and puncturing a lung.
An employee was hooking a sack of animal feed up to a forklift when the sack of feed fell on the employee's left leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was slicing four sirloin tip roasts on a bandsaw when the roast jerked and pulled his right ring finger into the sawblade, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee's head struck a piece of angle iron, fracturing vertebrae.
An employee was driving a shuttle bus. At a stop, he stood up, felt severe lower back pain, and passed out. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a crowbar to apply leverage to a part. His left hand then became caught between the crowbar and a piece of steel, amputating the ring and middle fingers of his left hand.
An employee was performing daily functions when his foot or leg became caught in a car wash tunnel conveyor.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while aligning an 8-inch PVC drain pipe.

An employee was using a baler to make bales when a piece of wrap was sticking out of the machine. While attempting to push the wrapping, the employee's foot became caught between the baler and the wrapping, causing a left toe injury.
While helping a client stand up, an employee tripped on the client's foot and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee fell from a tricycle (used to cover large distances and transport tools) to the ground, injuring his hip and requiring surgery.
On 11/11/2016, an employee tripped over a cable tray that was sticking out of a doorway and fell to the floor, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.

On November 11, 2016, an employee was installing a crusher on a test stand when he fell approximately 4 feet from the operator platform to the floor below. He struck and lacerated his head on the side of the stand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was stepping down from a 6-foot baker scaffold when he fell 3 feet, injuring his shoulder.
An employee was using a pie press to press crusts onto pies when her finger was crushed and amputated between two parts of the press.
An employee tripped over some wires under her desk and fell, fracturing her right hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was climbing on the forks of a forklift to enter a freezer trailer when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his ankle.

An employee was using a two-step step stool to reach a high shelf when she fell and struck her knee on the stool. She broke her left knee and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee had locked/tagged out equipment and was pulling the belt manually to clean it when the employee's left pinky was pinched and amputated above the knuckle between the belt and the pulley.
While cutting meat for a customer, an employee's thumb became caught in the guard/bandsaw, amputating it to the knuckle.
An employee's finger was pinned between a trailer's interior wall and a drum of material while loading a 450 lb. drum on a pallet skid. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
While installing fascia and soffit, an employee slipped on a roof tile and fell from the roof, fracturing a leg and requiring hospitalization.
On 11/13/2016, an employee was conducting preventative maintenance when his upper back was struck by a falling wooden pallet near the pallet return module.
An employee's pinky fingertip was amputated in a door jamb when the door shut.
An employee was struck by a rolling mill and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was troubleshooting and resetting a vulcanizer machine when the equipment crushed his forearm and lacerated his hand. The equipment was not locked out at the time of the incident.
On November 13, 2016, an employee dropped a cleaning pad while cleaning a hopper. When reaching down to retrieve it, the employee contacted a moving part and suffered a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were attempting to clear a clog from a cellar with a water hose. As they moved the hose into the cellar, an obstruction came out and pushed the hose out.  The hose whipped around, striking both employees in the face, causing lacerations and facial bone fractures.

An employee was giving hand signals to a powered industrial truck (PIT) operator who was pushing pipe around the yard. When he motioned the operator to lower a bundle, his hand was caught between the fork of the PIT and the pipe bundle, lacerating and fracturing his right thumb.

An employee instructed a coworker to reverse a forklift so he could use the back portion as a work platform. He attempted to tighten the rope, but when he cinched down, the 1/4" manila rope broke, causing him to fall face first into gravel. He suffered two fractured left eye bones and three fractured ribs.
A clamp came off of a piece of sanitary piping that was holding a check valve in place, allowing hot water to release and spray an employee. The employee suffered burns.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the blade amputated his right thumb tip. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning a slab drag when a coworker stepped on the foot pedal. The remaining air then activated the machine, which lacerated the employee's right arm.
An employee was trying to fix a belt on the corrugated paper cutting machine when the belt engaged and pulled his hand through the belt and pulley, amputating his right middle finger.
An employee was disconnecting a chute from the top of a hopper when he scratched the lens of his eye with a fingernail. He was wearing safety glasses at the time.
An employee received an electric shock and burns to the right hand and lower part of the arm and face while tightening a screw inside a cubicle.
An employee was attempting to sharpen a tool with a grinding wheel when the employee's finger entered the wheel and was amputated.
An employee was holding a metal piece in place in a milling machine when the clamp came down and struck his hand, amputating his right pinky finger.
A beam sitting on a skid rolled onto an employee and fractured his leg.
An employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

On a trash route, an employee's right foot slipped out of the truck and was caught by the tire pulling the employee out of the truck. The employee's left side of body was run over resulting in broken bones.
An employee was pulling product from a conveyor line when his finger became caught in a space where there was a missing rollerball, severely lacerating his right index finger.
An employee was stacking covers on the outside deck of a barge when a cover-stacking spreader bar slid down the barge cover and struck him on the right forearm, fracturing it.
An employee fell 3 feet off a stage while setting it up for a show, sustaining a broken right arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a rag to clean oil from a hot foil stamping machine. The machine's sensor was not working, and it fractured the employee's arm and lacerated a hand. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was attempting to turn down the speed of production on a production line using the speed control, which was located on the bottom of the line. The guard had to be removed to run the shaft. The employee's right hand then came in contact with the bevel gear, completely amputating the right index finger.
An employee fell while entering the building, fracturing both of her legs.

A temporary employee was using a torqueing tool to torque a brake disc when his left index finger was caught between the tool's reaction arm and the bolt pack. His finger broke and was lacerated, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was making mechanical repairs on a machine and struck their face with a bar while removing a pin. The jaw was broken.
An employee experienced an asthma attack possibly related to an unknown odor in the workplace.
An employee was using a wire rope cutter and hammer to cut wire rope when a sliver of metal became lodged in the employee's eye. PPE was not worn at the time.
An employee was using a push broom to sweep corn into a cleanout hole inside a grain dryer when his left leg fell into the cleanout hole, breaking two bones in his left ankle.
An employee was sawing laminate on a table saw and amputated three fingers on the left hand.
An employee was struck by a steel angle while performing maintenance on a piece of machinery, suffering a torso injury and neck laceration.

An employee was attempting to install a harness on a roof that was approximately 12 feet high when he fell through a skylight to the ground, injuring his neck and body. He was hospitalized for surgery.

The injured employee and his coworker were lifting a lid off an installation barrel. When the coworker dropped his side, the injured employee tried to grab the falling lid. The falling metal lid lacerated and fractured his right hand exposing tendons and ligaments.
An employee suffered a finger laceration while pulling a tire from a rack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell off a chair while changing the time on a wall clock. During the fall, the employee's head struck a door jamb and was lacerated, requiring stitches and overnight hospitalization.
On November 14, 2016, an employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation while operating a pneumatic crimper machine in the assembly area.
The injured employee was eating lunch with another employee that was eating seafood for lunch. The injured employee was hospitalized for an allergic reaction to the seafood vapors.

An employee was using an overhead crane to unload wooden floor boards onto the sub-assembly of a tractor-trailer frame when his left middle fingertip was caught between a load spreader bar and a sub-assembly cross member, requiring medical amputation.

An employee stopped at a truck stop and climbed to the top of the trailer that he was hauling. He was transporting a load of approximately 6,500 gallons of fuel oil. The dome lid at the top of the trailer forcibly blew off the tank, causing him to fall to the ground and suffer a neck laceration.
An employee was checking a seam on an RV when he fell off his ladder to the ground, contusing his nose.
While operating a packaging machine, an employee's hand was caught between the ceiling head and the die, amputating the right middle fingertip. The guard was removed at the time.
An employee was loading a flatbed truck and repositioning a package when he fell off the back of the truck to the ground below, fracturing his ankle and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while clearing a jam in a conveyor.

An employee was assisting with the extraction of a 4-foot by 24-foot steel plate from an excavation. As the steel plate cleared the top opening of the excavation, it rotated and struck the employee in the right side, causing a serious contusion and small tear in the kidney that required hospitalization.
On November 15, 2016, an employee was cleaning excess pasta off a pasta cutter when the blade partially amputated his finger.

An employee was dispatched to an oil and gas weld site to pick up produced water. When he made it to the worksite, he set his truck in position, connected the hose, and engaged the vacuum pump. A fire then occurred, causing second and third degree burns to both of his arms and part of his torso, as well as minor burns to his neck, face, and ear.

An employee was climbing into the cab of a farm tractor. When the employee reached the top step of the tractor, the employee's hand slipped off the handle. The employee fell and hit the bottom step, suffering a head contusion and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was drilling out old electrical boxes in the pharmacy with a core drill. The core drill spun out of control with the employee on it, resulting in two broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was attempting to clear a cardboard jam in a powered conveyor when his right thumb was caught in an in-running nip point.
An employee was cleaning up her work station when she tripped over the end of a pallet and fell to the concrete floor, breaking her hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a triple saw to cut a frozen fish block. When the employee attempted to move the fish block, the saw blade amputated two right-hand fingers.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell resulting in a fractured leg.
While preparing an empty apartment for lease, an employee was shot in the face by an unknown male.
An employee was removing a filter stack from a plating line area when he tripped over the plumbing of the filter/plating line. He landed on a protruding bolt, which lacerated his left forearm.
An employee fell approximately 7 feet through an open hole while dismantling old stadium bleachers, suffering a broken arm.

An employee was to trying to make sure the bottom outlet port of a mixer was clear when the mixer blades partially amputated the employee's fourth and fifth fingers. The mixer was operating at the time of the incident.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack and struck another pallet jack resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was walking behind an operating forklift when the forklift driver backed up and ran over the employee's foot.

An employee was removing lashing turn-buckles on the bottom level of a container when a turn-buckle fell. The turn-buckle swivel crushed the employee's left middle finger between deck plating, and his fingertip had to be medically amputated.

An employee was patrolling the McKelligon Canyon area in EL Paso, TX while riding a bike and fell from it. The employee was transported to a hospital where he was diagnosed as having had a heart attack.
An employee was in a lift and descending when he fell out of the lift, landing on his feet. His right ankle and right heel bone were fractured.
While descending from a roof, an employee slipped and fell over the ladder to the ground below, suffering a broken pelvis, fractured rib, and injured ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was opening a steam oven and slipped while she was holding the tray, fracturing her right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a grinding wheel when it broke and pieces struck his left bicep. He required surgery and overnight hospitalization.
An employee's left ring fingertip was amputated while using a fabric saw to cut a stack of fabric.

An employee was unloading precast concrete from a truck trailer when he slipped on a metal frame, lost his footing, and fell from the truck to the ground. He suffered a broken rib and lacerated spleen.
An employee was lining up a garment on the track of the garment cutter when the cutting wheel activated and amputated her right thumb tip.
An employee was separating two stacks of bridge railing when one slipped and smashed his right little finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was backing a powered industrial truck (PIT) out of a trailer. When he stepped off the PIT, he was struck by another PIT, which lacerated and contused his right lower leg.

An employee was using an automatic tape machine when the machine jammed.  As she attempted to free the machine with her left hand, the ribbon cutting shear amputated her index finger from the tip to the first knuckle.
A worker reached into a running palletizer machine to adjust a sensor.  A compression bar came down, breaking his arm. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was attempting to fix a belt drive in a casing machine when a coworker plugged the machine back in, causing the belt drive to engage. The employee's right index finger was then caught in a sprocket and de-gloved, resulting in a medical amputation to the first joint. The equipment was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was in a trench preparing to set up a laser lever when an excavator bucket detached from an excavator and struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs and arm lacerations.

An employee was replacing the bearing of a poultry elevator and separator using a hammer and wrench. When he hit the sprocket to gain access to the bearing, the sprocket came loose and caused the elevator to fall. The employee jumped back and the force from landing broke his right foot and lower right leg.

An employee was installing a pin in a boom point that had been chilled in liquid oxygen. When the employee removed the pin with a slide hammer, an ignition occurred and caused the pin to shoot out of the hole and to strike the employee. The employee suffered burns to both hands and a broken thumb.

An employee was transforming hot resin from a 55-gallon drum that was elevated by a forklift over an open vat. The employee opened a gate valve on the drum and the valve popped off, creating an uncontrolled release of the hot liquid that caused serious burns to his right forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a machine and amputated a fingertip.

An employee was servicing a strapping machine that applies multiple polyester straps to compressed bales of cotton. The employee was checking the point were a friction weld fuses the two ends of the strapping together when the employee's right arm/wrist became strapped and trapped to the expanding bale of cotton. The right arm was caught and compressed under considerable pressure, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a back injury and required hospitalization after the employee's chair broke.
An employee suffered a left index fingertip amputation when his hand was pinched by the wheel of the Bid-Well workbridge.
An employee was pouring hydraulic oil into a skid steer when a trackhoe reversed into the door where the employee was standing. The door swung shut, crushing and breaking the employee's right arm.
On 11/16/2016, at 3:30 PM, an employee was struck by an aircraft ground support vehicle and suffered severe head injuries.
An employee fell off a ladder and fractured a hip.
An employee's left little fingertip was amputated between a cart and a machine.
While installing plywood decking to a rooftop, an employee lost his balance and fell 11 feet 8 inches to the lower level, breaking his spinal cord/back. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was sweeping the floor when a bale of cotton fell on him, injuring his lower back.

On November 16, 2016, an employee was retrieving parts from a new washer when his glove was caught in the chain conveyor and subsequently caught between the chain and a rotating shaft. His right middle fingertip was amputated. The chain and shaft were unguarded at the time of the incident.
On November 16, 2016, at approximately 7:15 PM, an employee's left hand entered a piece of moving equipment as it was coming to a stop and was injured. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to adjust the handle on a case packer when he lost balance and leaned his left index finger into a pinch point, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut fittings when a fitting jumped and the bandsaw partially amputated his left thumb tip.

An employee entered a trash cart as part of a process where a forklift operator would raise the cart off the ground so the employee could shovel trash out of the cart and into a compactor. An employee was grinding on an auxiliary diesel fuel tank to fix a clog when a spark from the grinding wheel ignited diesel fumes inside the tank and it exploded. A piece of the exploding tank hit and broke his right leg below the knee, requiring surgery.
An employee fell approximately 21 feet when a guardrail failed, suffering a broken right arm.
An employee was climbing up the outer portion of a water station when he slipped and fell, breaking his ankle and hurting his back.

An employee was connecting a load bar to the roof of a manufactured home. The employee turned to get off of the roof and missed the truss he was attempting to step on. He fell and caught himself by his arms in the trusses. He sustained rib contusions.

On November 16, 2016, at approximately 8:51 p.m., an employee was disposing of pieces of trim in the vacuum system of a single phase machine. The employee's left hand slipped and the ring finger made contact with the score bar. The finger was lacerated and had to be amputated.
While walking down an incline in an auditorium, an employee tripped, fell, and hit their neck on the arm of a chair. The employee suffered an injury from the ear to the larynx area.

An employee was washing a refrigerated container with a hose and signaled the driver to drive away. The water hose became stuck on the container as the driver pulled away. It wrapped around the employee's foot and pulled him off the dock to the ground, fracturing his back vertebra.

On November 16, 2016, an employee was performing a pre-delivery check of a boom lift near electrical lines. A loud noise was heard, and the employee was found lying in the basket with electrical burns to the head, chest, and hands. The employee was hospitalized.

On 11/16/2016, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was checking a printing press when his left hand was caught in the roller of the press damping system. He suffered lacerations and required surgery.
An employee suffered a hand burn while cleaning a deep fryer, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was engaged in HVAC demolition activities on the roof. As he was attempting to push parts of the demolished HVAC unit off of the roof, his glove became stuck to the unit. He was pulled off the roof with the unit to the ground, suffering artery damage that required surgery and a cracked skull.
An employee was delivering a pizza in a resident's driveway when an assailant sprayed her in the face with pepper spray. She experienced difficulty breathing and an upper respiratory issue.
An employee was arranging mail in the back of his parked vehicle when he was struck by a passenger vehicle, suffering a crushed left leg and fractured right leg.

On November 16, 2016, employees were changing a press mold, which was being lifted by a boom attached to a forklift. The boom failed and the mold struck the injured employee, who suffered lacerations, a possible fracture, and a head injury.
An employee was jointing a piece of wood when his hand slipped. His pinky finger went into the blade and was amputated.
While crawling through and greasing a loader, an employee's head struck the edge of the loader's bucket, fracturing the skull.
An employee was cleaning the chute on a ready-mix truck. As he extended the chute, two of his right-hand fingers were caught/pinched between two chute sections.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when his foot contacted a column, amputating four toes.
An employee was walking through a truck stop parking lot and was run over by a car. The employee was hospitalized for bleeding on the brain.
An employee was pushing an oxygen bottle on a cart when his leg gave out and he fell to the ground, suffering an acute right hip fracture.
An employee was struck by metal shelving, which knocked him to the floor. He sustained multiple head and shoulder lacerations.

An employee went to his vehicle in the parking lot to retrieve some items. While walking back to the building, he rolled his right ankle and then stepped forward with his left foot to catch himself. He felt a pop in his ankle and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized for a fractured fibula.
On November 17, 2016, an employee fell off a single-story roof damaging their pelvis and breaking the left arm.
An employee was using a riding lawn mower to cut grass when the mower turned over on a hill and broke the employee's arm.
A diver was removing sediment from the floor of the tank in 47 feet of water. The diver lost his weight belt and made an uncontrolled ascent to the surface resulting in an air embolism and coma.
While installing a gate, an employee's left middle finger was amputated above the knuckle when the gate pinched the finger as it was being hung.
An employee was struck by a paving machine and suffered broken bones in his foot and leg.

An employee was standing on the roof top of a truck supplying hot asphalt (400 degrees). The hot pipe became loose and had a slight leak. The employee was trying to tighten it when the pipe burst and splashed him with the hot asphalt, causing first degree burns to the face and arms.
An employee was on top of a rail car loading meat bone meal. When he tried to move the auger chute, he lost his footing and fell to the ground fracturing the right leg.
An employee was hospitalized after breaking a hip while walking in a sewer.

An employee was changing the tire on a loader. He placed blocking under the loader after jacking it up. The jack shifted, causing the loader to fall down onto the blocking. The impact of the loader broke the employee's hip, requiring hospitalization.

On November 17, 2016, an employee was operating a napkin printing press and noticed a defect.  The employee turned the machine off and felt the printing plate to see if it was lifting off the cylinder. The jog button was pressed while his right hand was feeling the plate and his hand was caught between the plate and the impression roll. He suffered an amputation of his right thumb pad and laceration to his right index finger.
On November 17, 2016, an employee was lifting a glass window when it broke and sliced his left hand. He suffered a deep laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing oil on a tractor trailer unit when it rolled off the blocks and struck the employee, breaking 12 ribs and a shoulder and collapsing the left lung.

On November 17, 2016, an employee was working on ladder approximately 10 feet high when the feet of the ladder slipped out. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken arm and head injury.

An employee was attempting to light a handheld propane torch when an explosion occurred. The employee received second degree burns to the face, hand, and other body parts. A second employee also suffered injuries.
A temporary employee using a table saw to cut wood. The saw blade amputated his right pinky fingertip as he was adjusting the saw guide with a hammer. The blade was not guarded at the time.
An employee was feeding nonferrous cable material into the cable stripping machine when their right hand was caught inside the machine amputating four fingers.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor belt on the hamburger patty line in a meat processing plant. His gloved right hand got caught in the gear resulting in amputation of the index finger.
On November 17, 2016, an employee who works in plastic recovery sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell to the ground while repairing shingles on the roof of a private residence, requiring hospitalization for facial injuries and a torn aorta.
An employee was cleaning a 4,000-pound mixer when his glove was caught in the machine, which then pulled in his hand and amputated his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was cleaning a blender when his glove was caught and pulled into the spinning auger, amputating his right ring and middle fingers. The blender was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was moving a manufactured steel part that weighed approximately 70 lbs. from a pair of saw horses to the ground. He then tripped over one of the sawhorses, and three of his right-hand fingers were pinched between the steel part and the ground, amputating his middle fingertip and injuring the other two.
An employee was cutting 2x4" lumber on a radial arm saw when the saw blade lowered on and amputated his right middle finger. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was reversing a stand-up forklift when she extended her left arm to keep from hitting another stand-up forklift. Her left hand struck the second lift, breaking her left wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing cross beams on a racking system when the right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on a 5-foot ladder cutting a pipe used to carry nitrogen. As the employee was cutting the pipeline, the pipe (which was filled with carbon dioxide) ruptured. The employee suffered a concussion, fractured orbital bones, a skull fracture, and neck injury.
An employee's hand was pulled into a spindle shaper machine, injuring fingertips and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was replacing a furnace in a customer's home and was installing a PVC exhaust pipe.  The PVC pipe was to run directly over the water heater out the side of the home.  He set his PVC cleaner and glue on top of the water heater (chest height) as he put the exhaust together.  While installing the final piece, he cleaned the connection with the PVC cleaner and put the dabber back into the can. When he reached for the glue, he bumped the can of cleaner and it spilled on his chest.  He caught the can with his hand but the contents spilled on the floor. The water heater ignited vapors from the cleaner and a fire started, causing first and second degree burns to his chest, right lower arm, right neck, earlobe, left armpit, and both lips.

An employee was operating a press brake and attempting to remove a piece when the clamp came down and amputated his left middle fingertip and avulsed his left ring finger. The machine was cycling at the time of the incident.
An employee was helping to add alloy to steel when a splash of alloy came through the door and hit his pant leg. He was kneeling at the time, so the splash ran down into his boot, causing burns.

On November 17, 2016, an employee's fingers were caught in the in-running nip point of a printing press while he was attempting to thread new paper through the press. One of his fingertips was amputated and another was badly injured.
An employee was standing on top of a 5-foot, 1-inch tall dock block while installing a grounding strap to a vessel shaft in a dry dock when he slipped and fell to the floor, rupturing his spleen.

An employee was attempting to change the buffing blades on an automatic tire buffing machine. While he was using a wrench to remove the blade head, the machine turned on. The wrench became entangled in his clothing and pulled him into the machine, breaking his right wrist and lacerating his right forearm, bicep, and leg. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

Around 1:00 p.m. on 11/18/16, an employee was leaving the repackaging station when she tripped over a metal piece of the rolling warehouse steel. She fell on her right hip and was unable to get up and walk, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing a splicer case on a telephone strand while working  from a ladder. The employee then fell approximately 15 feet while descending, breaking the left ankle.
An employee was working from a ladder when it slipped and he fell to the ground, breaking his pelvis, elbow, and wrist.

An employee was delivering a scissor lift to a location. As the employee was unloading the scissor lift, the scissor lift's wheel went off the edge of the ramp, causing it to start to fall. The employee jumped from the cab of the scissor lift to avoid the fall and broke his right leg.
An employee suffered a right thumb amputation while working on a horizontal lathe.
An employee contacted a capped wire while installing radiation panels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee on a center rider was about to start filling an order when a box of mangoes fell off a rack and struck him. He suffered a fractured right shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a 9 foot ladder to the concrete floor breaking the right hip and shattering the left knee.
On November 18, 2016, an employee was delivering a package to a residential home when she stepped into a hole and fell to the ground, fracturing her hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was part of a rigging crew tasked with using an overhead 8-ton crane to move a heat exchanger through two columns. The employee pushed the exchanger through by hand and it swung back and struck the employee's left index finger and thumb. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was cleaning an exhaust flue and was exposed to sodium hydroxide. He received a chemical burn on his right arm.
An employee was injured when he tripped over tin studs.
An employee sprained her right ankle while chasing after a student.

An employee was adjusting a C5 slide core on his work table and was resting it on a 2x4. The 2x4 rolled up, pinching and crushing his right middle fingertip between the table and core. His fingertip had to be medically amputated.

An employee was standing inside a 2-foot high box. When she stepped back, the back of her feet hit the inside of the box, causing her to fall backwards and hit her head and back. She suffered eight fractured ribs and a vertebra fracture.
An employee on an electric pallet jack collided with a coworker on an order picker, suffering a fractured forearm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was building a scaffold and while bending over he fell from the scaffold.
On November 18, 2016, an employee was hospitalized after falling from a step ladder and breaking their back.

An employee was opening the doors of a semi tractor trailer when a stack of wooden pallets fell and struck her head, left shoulder, and left leg. She suffered a gash on the left side of her head and was hospitalized.

Two employees were resurfacing part of an interstate when a car entered the construction area and struck a nearby work trailer. The trailer then struck the employees. The first employee suffered a broken left leg, and the second employee suffered left leg lacerations.
While working in a straight boom lift that was 5 feet off the ground, an employee bounced out of the bucket. The employee's harness stopped the fall, but the employee suffered torso and rib injuries.

An employee was installing a rotor lock pin in a bearing housing when the magnets in the lifting system failed. The rotor lock pin then dropped into the bearing housing, pinching the employee's fingers between the flange of the pin and the housing. Two of his fingers were amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell on water that had dripped onto the floor from a wet shower bed, breaking his left knee and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping a three-man crew with a backhoe to lift a walk-behind saw approximately 6 inches and move it forward approximately 3 feet. The employee attached rigging from the walk-behind saw to the backhoe and stood to the side of the forks approximately 4 feet away. As the backhoe operator lifted the saw, the backhoe forks disengaged and struck the employee's hard hat. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was operating a sit-down forklift to stack large bundles of flat corrugated boxes in rows. A row of bundles started to fall in a domino fashion, striking and then tipping the forklift over from the employee's right to left side. His left foot was pinned under the forklift and several bundles of boxes fell on top of him. He was hospitalized with a fractured left foot.
An employee was welding burner tubes when his shirt caught on fire, causing second degree burns to his torso that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking on a catwalk while sanitizing a de-stoner machine when he tripped and fell, landing on the edge of the de-stoner guard on the platform below. He lacerated his left forearm.
An employee was cutting cardboard to make a work mat for his desk when his pocket knife slipped and lacerated his right arm.
An employee slipped while descending the steps, reached outward, and caught their left ring finger on one of the traction rings amputating the tip of the fourth left digit.

An employee was helping to assemble a standard duty wrecker and was in the process of guiding a part into position when a component inside of the part shifted and pinched/partially amputated the employee's finger between two sections.
