An employee was offsite and inhaled fire extinguisher powder while extinguishing a fire resulting in inflammation of the lungs.

An employee was trimming a tree limb that was touching a powerline. When he grabbed the tree limb, he made indirect contact with the powerline, suffering third degree burns to both hands and his right leg.

An employee was operating a radial arm saw when a piece of wood became caught in the travel slot behind the saw blade. When the employee attempted to remove it, the blade lacerated his right index finger. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
A brace holding up a tilt wall sheered off and swung out of place, striking an employee in the legs.

An employee was climbing a wooden ladder with a string of lights over his shoulder. When he reached the top of the ladder, he attempted to grab the rail but missed and fell approximately 20 feet, lacerating the side of his face and head and breaking his wrist.
An employee was pulling debris out of the cutter machine when the blade crushed and broke his right hand. The machine was activated at the time of the incident.

An employee was unbanding a load of steel that had a wooden 4x4 block in between it. The steel band snapped and the steel hit the extra length of wood, causing it to fly up and hit the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's hand entered the entrance section of a jammed conveyor that was being fixed, partially amputating her left middle finger.
An employee was picking kohlrabi and using a knife to cut tips and amputated the tip of their thumb.

An employee was in the process of preparing a coal fired boiler section to be dumped. The employee stopped the coal feed to the section in preparation and as he approached the front of the boiler, the boiler went positive. In this instance, the door to the section that was being prepared to dump, blew open and the employee was blasted with a fire discharge. The employee received multiple first, second, and third degree burns to the arms, legs, torso, and face.
An employee was walking between a patient's stretcher and computer when she tripped on a rolling stool. She fell and fractured her right arm.

An employee was operating the board edge unscrambler when he noticed a stick had become jammed beneath the floor chains. When he attempted to remove it, his shirt was caught on a chain lug that then pulled his left arm into the machine, amputating his left ring fingertip, crushing his left hand, and injuring his left arm. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was positioning a wind brace and connecting a mast to a work platform. He fell back on his lanyard and his upper arm was caught in a pinch point between the mast and the wind brace.
An employee was operating a forklift when the fork extension of a second forklift struck and fractured the employee's ankle.
An employee's left index fingertip was amputated by a closing freezing door.
An employee suffered a right index finger amputation while operating a table saw.

An employee was visually checking a rope that was pulling a conductor from an underground application through a block. As he turned to walk away, he put his arms down to his side. The rope caught the tip of his left-hand glove and pulled his fingers into the block. His left ring and pinky fingers were amputated.

An employee pulled his semi and trailer off to the side of a service road close to a ditch.  The tractor and trailer began to lean over. When the employee exited the cab, he fell to the ground and injured his head, neck, and shoulder.
An employee was bending over picking up debris in the dock area and was struck by forklift. His head hit a metal guard rail. The employee was hospitalized for head, neck and back injuries.

An employee was working from an aerial lift and cutting a tree limb. The tree limb fell towards him and pinched his arm between the end of the limb and the aerial lift bucket. His right upper arm was lacerated and required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell over a curb rupturing their spleen.
An employee was attempting to free wire that was hung up in a dolly. When the wire was freed, it pulled his left hand into the dolly, partially amputating his left pinky finger.
On November 20, 2016, at 2:30 p.m., an employee suffered a partial amputation to the left middle finger while attempting to retrieve bread that was stuck in a bagel machine.
While attempting to remove a steel piece from a forklift, a temporary employee's left finger was caught and amputated between the fork and another piece of metal.
An employee was cleaning a bathtub when she slipped and fell, fracturing her hip. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was using a toxic vapor analyzer to monitor a carbon canister for fugitive emissions. The employee lost consciousness due to potential exposure to dimethyl disulfide, requiring hospitalization. Respiratory protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking to his truck when he slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, breaking his right fibula in two places and dislocating his ankle.
An employee was removing tangled film from a roller in a laminator machine when he stepped back into a roller that was still running, fracturing his skull and breaking an arm.
An employee was lubricating a drive chain on a conveyer when his rag and hand were drawn into the chain and sprocket, partially amputating his finger.
An employee was climbing a ladder to a roof when his foot became tangled in the ladder and he fell 8 feet, breaking his ankle.

An employee was using a portable hydraulic tool to separate flanges on a hollow flight auger. During separation, the tool slipped off the shim, causing the shim to hit the employee in the face. The employee suffered fractured facial bones.
An employee was performing maintenance on a material handling conveyor system when his right index finger was amputated above the first joint.
An employee was cutting a concrete foundation to install an egress window when a piece of concrete broke off and landed on the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee tripped on the forks of a forklift while attempting to remove a plastic cover from a pallet of merchandise, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee was attempting to remove the shaft stock in a machine when the stock slipped and crushed his index finger, requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was carrying materials to his car when he missed a step, tripped, and fell, fracturing his wrist.
An employee was removing a scaffold around a chimney when wind caught the scaffold plank, causing the employee to fall 16 to 18 feet to the ground below.
An employee was driving when he struck a disabled motor vehicle and sustained several cuts and fractures that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell, hitting her head on the side of a produce rack and suffering a brain hemorrhage.

An employee was removing excess tuna from the rear of a filler machine when her right hand became caught in the star wheel (carries empty cans to the filler machine). Her middle and index fingers were amputated, and her right hand suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was trying to move a piece of wood that was stuck in the chain when the wood jammed his hand into the steel railing, amputating his right middle finger and breaking a bone.
An employee fell to the ground while walking down the stairs from a loading dock to a snowy/icy parking area, suffering a broken back (in two areas) and a neck injury.
On 11/21/16 at 15:30, an employee was struck by a piece of machinery that transports bars, suffering right hip and right side injuries.
While accessing the roof, an employee slipped and fell approximately 10 feet, bruising his back and knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee's thumb was caught and partially amputated in a closing bagger machine door.
An employee was operating the forklift in the yard. When he made a turn to return to the building, the forklift tipped over and rolled onto his foot.
An employee suffered burns to the face when an arc flash occurred while he was working on electrical lines. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from an unknown height to the ground, breaking both ankles.
An employee was operating a high-reach forklift to move product when the employee's left thumb was caught and partially amputated between a section of racking and the forklift's support beam.
During polishing activities, an employee's left index finger was caught by a shaft and had to be amputated.

An employee was moving a part (about 12"x18"x1" thick) by hand from a pallet to a work table. His right thumb was inside a hole in the part. As he pulled the part, the hole closed, amputating his right thumb tip.
An employee was performing maintenance on the wing of an aircraft and fell to the floor fracturing the right side of their body. The employee was not attached to the SRL at the time.

An employee was directing a powered industrial truck (PIT) operator on how to load onto a tractor trailer when the PIT operator reversed and pinned the employee between the PIT and the tractor trailer. The employee suffered a right lower leg injury.
An employee tripped over a chair in the automotive store while attempting to put the delivery vehicle keys away. The employee fell to the cement floor and suffered a broken left hip.
While walking through the lumber yard, an employee's foot was run over by a forklift, breaking it.
An employee was refueling a passenger bus that was not properly parked. The employee slipped on ice and fell in front of the rolling rear wheels resulting in crushing injuries to the lower abdomen.
An employee was rebuilding shafts and bearings on a slicer and amputated his left pinky finger when it was caught in the machine.
An employee was using an electric torque gun to tighten bolts when his right thumb was caught and partially amputated between the gun and the steel.
On November 21, 2016, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee slipped and fell on ice on the concrete walking surface, suffering a concussion and neck/back pain. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to clear a piece of poly from a running machine when his fingers were caught in the machine. His fingers were cut and his left thumb was badly damaged, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was sliding T-beams from a staging area to a forklift when a beam pinched and amputated his left fingertip.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to the right index finger while cleaning a drive chain on a band saw while the machine was in operation.
An employee and a coworker were handling knives in the kitchen when the coworker accidently lacerated the employee's leg.
An employee was using a sliding hammer to remove injectors from a farm implement when the employee's left thumb was crushed between the handle and the top of the tool, amputating the tip.
An employee fell from a work platform to the ground, fracturing his right tibia.
An employee fell out of a truck trailer, breaking three ribs and puncturing a lung.

An employee was working at a pipe beller machine when the beller ring clip came loose. The employee was attempting to put the ring back on when the machine cycled, catching the employee's palm and thumb between the ring holder and the beller frame, requiring stitches. The employee was  hospitalized and had surgery the following day. The machine was guarded, but not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee drove a van to transport a group of consumers from the care facility to a store parking lot. The employee was sitting in the van when an agitated consumer bit and hit the employee's head. The employee suffered a concussion, bite, and pain in the right shoulder, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell approximately 5 feet off the back of a delivery truck to the ground, suffering a broken tailbone and concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 21, 2016, an employee was walking in the cabin of a plane in the aircraft interior repair shop when he stubbed his toe on a first class seat. His toe became infected with a suspected hairline fracture and required hospitalization on November 22, 2016.
An employee's right hand was caught in the printer rollers resulting in amputation of the middle finger at the first digit.
An employee was cleaning their hands with a shop rag and got a steel splinter in their hand. The splinter required surgery.
An employee fell off a ladder and suffered fractures.

On November 21, 2016, an employee was observing a new utility pole that was being moved when the pole suddenly jerked left and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured left leg and contused right leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to clean molten sulfur from the inside of a rail tank car with a pressure washer when he was exposed to an off-gassing of the molten sulfur. He was hospitalized with burns to his lungs.
An employee's gloved hand was caught in the rotation fan of a welder unit during repairs, amputating the thumb.
An employee was pulling wire when his pinky finger was pinched between equipment and wood, tearing a ligament.
An employee suffered a left index fingertip amputation while using a ribbon cutting machine.

On November 21, 2016, at 12:00 p.m., an employee was walking between a vehicle and the building when the employee slipped on an icy parking lot surface and fell onto the vehicle's trailer hitch, suffering three fractured ribs, a bruised abdomen, and pain in the neck and shoulder.
An employee fell on concrete pavement while walking from one building to another, requiring hospitalization for injuries to the hand/arm and leg.
An employee was struck by falling countertops that fell from an unevenly stacked pile that became unstable. The employee suffered a broken lower leg.
While walking through the upper level of a facility, an employee fell approximately 10 feet through a vent hole in the floor, suffering a broken left knee and broken left wrist.

On 11/21/2016, an employee and his supervisor were washing a vehicle together on a track. When the supervisor turned on the track to begin moving the vehicle, the employee was still washing the rim. As soon as the rollers popped up, the moving wheel of the car lacerated the employee's right-hand finger and amputated it at the first joint. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was working on a boat and fell while descending the ladder breaking the left radius.
An employee was standing on a 6-foot ladder troubleshooting a light fixture when he lost his balance and fell off the ladder, suffering a subdural hematoma.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated his right thumb at the first knuckle.

An employee was dressing a grinding wheel with a rag when the rag became caught in the wheel. The employee's left hand was then pulled into the grinding wheel, amputating the index finger and lacerating the third, fourth, and fifth fingers.
An employee fell while installing solar panels on a residential roof and required hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a trailer to pull down the roll-up door. It was raining and the employee slipped and fell which caused the door to come down on his left hand amputating the left middle and ring fingers at the first joint.
An employee was blowing off a router bit with an air gun and lacerated the left hand and pinky finger. The brush guard was in place at the time.
An employee was repairing a chain hoist when his right index finger was caught between the chain and sprocket, amputating his fingertip.

An employee stood up quickly, hit his head on a cross beam, lost consciousness, fell to the floor and had a seizure. 

He was hospitalized.
An employee was bolting up a 10 inch pipe. He put his hand under the valve and the valve and pipe rolled over his right hand and crushed it.
An employee was administering medication when a patient kicked her. She fell backwards against the wall, breaking her hip.

A pallet was jammed at a pallet magazine discharge area. An employee attempted to unjam the pallet using a hook attached to a rod about 36 inches long. When the hook did not work, the employee grabbed the pallet with her hands. At the same time, the machine cycled the next pallet in place, causing the pallet that she was grabbing to raise. Her left thumb became caught between the pallet and the metal frame of the machine, amputating her thumb tip.

An employee was cleaning a rib cage when his arm became stuck in two rollers that are designed to crush chicken bones. His left arm broke in multiple places and had to be surgically amputated above the elbow. The crusher was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was feeding wire from one roll to another. While guiding the wire his gloved hand got caught and amputated two digits.
An employee slipped on the ice and fell down stairs breaking two ribs and injuring their back.
An employee was riding a tug as a passenger. When the driver turned a corner, the employee fell off the tug to the ground, breaking his forearm.

On November 22, 2016, at approximately 8:00 a.m., an employee was using a floor-operated overhead crane to lift a gear unit. The fine thread eye bolts that secured the load to the chain sling became stripped and allowed the load to fall onto the employee, causing a fracture and nerve/artery damage.

An employee working at a conveyor line was trying to remove a can from underneath a pallet. A forklift driver did not see her and delivered the next pallet, which pushed the pallet that was staged on the conveyor. The employee's ankle was pinned between the pallets and a support beam on the conveyor, and she suffered compound fractures to her tibia and fibula.

An employee was tightening a ratchet strap on a flat bed. The handle got away from him while under pressure and swung up, hitting him in the face. He was hospitalized with a broken jaw, nose, and tooth and a possible concussion.
An employee was carrying pot of hot grease when he slipped and fell. The hot grease spilled on him, causing third degree burns to his arms, chest, neck, leg, and back.

An employee was making sure that packages did not fall off the unload belt when a flat package slipped between the unload belt and a transfer plate. When he attempted to retrieve the package, his glove became caught on one of the belt rollers, pulling his hand between the roller and a piece of angle-iron located near the belt. His right hand was crushed, especially his right ring finger.
An employee was operating a sandblaster when the hose dropped on his legs. The blast media came out of the nozzle and deeply lacerated his left calf, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor and amputated the right thumb.
An employee was loading out components of a stacked drilling rig when a beam flipped over and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg and fractured ribs.
An employee was removing gas lines from chlorine gas tanks when a small quantity of chlorine gas escaped from one of the lines, causing the employee to experience respiratory irritation.
An employee was checking emergency lights when he fell from an extension ladder and fractured his ankle.
An employee suffered a left thumb amputation while cutting wood on a table saw.
An employee was re-entering the facility from the parking lot when the wind forced the door closed, slamming it on and amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee partially amputated the left index and middle fingers while using a 24-inch hook to reach the drum de-boner auger.

An employee was entering the cab of a bulldozer. Upon opening the door, his hand slipped off the handle, causing him to lose his balance and fall off the bulldozer. He suffered minor lacerations to the head, a dislocated right finger, and a fractured or cracked sternum, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working with replacement belts when the belts tightened around his right-hand middle finger, partially amputating his fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee fell approximately 11 feet off the roof and was hospitalized with broken legs.
An employee was investigating an unknown noise in a laboratory jar roller machine when his right index fingertip was caught in the machine's drive chain.

An employee was packaging components as they came off the press when his glove was snagged on the hexagon-shaped component of the conveyor, amputating the tip of his left index finger from the fingernail to the first knuckle.
The employee was feeding trays on a conveyor system when her right hand got caught in the rollers, causing a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee fell from the fourth rung of a step ladder to the floor, fracturing her elbow.
On 11/23/2016, at approximately 1445, an employee was cleaning a straightener machine when his hand became caught in a portion of the machine, partially amputating his left ring fingertip.
On November 23, 2016, at 3:10 AM, an employee was troubleshooting a bagger machine when the employee's arm became caught in the door, breaking a forearm bone.
An employee tripped and fell while climbing over a conveyor, striking the wall and suffering a shoulder injury.
An employee was performing maintenance on an overhead conveyor roller when a shaft dropped out of a roller and pinched his finger between two plates, amputating his left index fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder putting tape on a wall for a painting when he fell, breaking his tibia and fibula.
An employee suffered a hand crushing injury requiring surgery and hospitalization while cleaning the filter press.
While standing on a 4-foot ladder to pull a box from a shelf, an employee lost his balance and fell onto a cement door stop pile-on, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee had finished loading baggage onto an aircraft when he tripped and fell, hitting the pavement.  He suffered broken bones near his eye socket and sinuses, knee abrasions, and swollen hands.
On 11/22/16, an employee was cleaning a glue roller with a scraper when the employee's right-hand middle finger was caught between glue rollers. The fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
While cleaning dust off equipment, an employee fell off a 6 foot ladder and fractured left side ribs.
An employee suffered a broken left arm when a large tool being unloaded from a forklift rolled onto his arm.
An employee was using a 10-inch chef's knife to slice salmon. The slicing motion pulled the knife through the salmon and amputated the employee's fingertip.

On November 23, 2016, at approximately 7:30 p.m., an employee began feeling sick and experienced breathing difficulty, headaches, and migraines due to carbon monoxide exposure, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was inching the ram down on a press when the plastic die spacer shot out and broke the employee's right arm.
An employee fell to the floor as she was walking toward the elevator, fracturing her spine.

An employee was helping to move a large rack of blades out of a spray booth when a part fell and struck the employee's hand between the thumb and index finger. The employee was hospitalized with a hand fracture.

An employee was working from a 14-foot boom lift, setting up a wire pool and trying to place it in a sheave, when he lost control and his right arm was caught between the wire and the railing of the lift, breaking it.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder from the sorter to the main floor when her foot slipped and she fell approximately 5 feet to the floor, fracturing her right leg.
An employee was attempting to step over a tow bar between mail carts when her foot was caught on the bar. She fell to the floor and fractured her knee.
An employee crossed the street to retrieve shopping carts. While crossing back with the carts, the employee was struck by a moving vehicle, suffering a broken arm and leg.
An employee was retrieving a small LCD TV from the top of a shelving unit. While descending the ladder, he missed the last step and fell to the floor, breaking his left leg.
An employee fell 20 feet from a scaffold while helping to build a wall for an elevator shaft. The employee landed on concrete and suffered five broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee had been removing ceiling ductwork from an 8-foot step ladder. When he stepped off the ladder, he rolled his ankle and fell. He tried to brace himself while falling and extended his hands. He suffered a compound fracture of the ankle and a broken wrist.
An employee was using an angle iron when it moved downward toward the vise and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee and a coworker were closing the perimeter gate at the end of the day when he stopped to remove some cardboard that was blocking the gate. His coworker kept pushing the gate and the employee's second finger became stuck in the gate rollers, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was heating an asphalt product with a propane torch to close a lid on a tank when a flash fire occurred. The employee suffered second degree burns to the hand and first degree burns to the face.
On 11/23/16, at about 12:30 p.m., an employee was working on a trash compactor and caught his right leg fracturing the shin. He was taken to hospital where he received surgery.
An employee's right hand was crushed, breaking several bones.
An employee tripped over debris on the floor, fell, and fractured her knee.
A forklift with a nylon sling was loading counterweights when the sling failed, allowing a counterweight to fall and strike an employee's left leg, breaking it.

An employee was inserting a blank piece of pipe into the chucks of a CNC machine when the blank fell and his right finger was caught between the blank and the metal bar inside the machine. His right ring fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
A temporary employee attempted to remove dunnage from on top of a bundle of rebar when a bundle shifted and struck his left shoulder/arm area, fracturing his left hand and left leg.
An employee was unloading an oil drum and fell off the back of the truck resulting in a serious head injury and hospitalization.
On November 23, 2016, at 12:30 a.m., an employee was repairing a conveyor belt when he needed to use oil on the chain. When he turned on the power, his left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was sitting on a forklift when another forklift struck his left foot.
An employee was entering the bathroom when a malfunctioning hinge caused the door to slam shut on her left-hand ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was emptying a hopper at 6:40 AM when the hopper flipped back and hit the employee's wrist and forearm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating an irrigation machine when he was struck in the head/face by a rotating boom, breaking his jaw and losing consciousness.
An employee suffered a hand laceration while using a saw to cut material.
An employee was washing a personal transportation vehicle when she slipped on a soapy patch, struck the ground, and broke her right wrist.
On November 25, 2016, an employee fell in the locker room and broke a femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was struck by a motor vehicle driving approximately 35 miles per hour. He hit the car's windshield and was then thrown approximately 30 feet, suffering a broken leg, three broken ribs, and multiple facial lacerations.
An employee was delivering a package to a customer when the customer's dog attacked and partially amputated the employee's left ring finger.
An employee slipped or fell on stairs while going to a tank yard, suffering a twisted knee.
An employee was pulling cardboard on a pallet when the cardboard tore, causing her to fall to the floor. She suffered a wrist and possible hip injury, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was making an adjustment to a blow mold machine when a tool slipped from his hand and caused him to lose his balance. His left hand then came in contact with a mold part, amputating his index and middle fingers at the knuckle and his ring fingertip.
An employee was working in an aisle when a forklift operator driving down the aisle pushed a pallet into her, striking her left ankle.
An employee lost control of a pallet jack while backing up and was pinned between the pallet jack and a racking system. The employee suffered a muscle injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was running a piece of wood through a wood edger machine when an excess piece (called a stick) was created. The employee turned off the machine to retrieve the stick. As he reached for it, the machine's saw blade lacerated his left hand and forearm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking back to a vessel to verify the lashing when he slipped and fell, breaking a rib.
While working on a ship's radar, an employee fell after a rusty safety ring gave way. The employee suffered a hematoma to the head.

While installing plywood covers over the stairwell opening of a new two-story residence, an employee fell approximately 9 feet through the opening from the second level of the home to the concrete floor, fracturing the neck, hip, and two ribs.
While working on the 1st floor mezzanine installing structural steel, an employee was struck in the head by a steel beam and required hospitalization.

An employee was leaving a patient's home. As she stepped onto the outside step, it broke and she fell 4 feet onto a cement slab, suffering internal injuries. She was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was standing on top of a plywood sheet to reach for something when he slipped and fell. The plywood sheet then fell onto his fingers, fracturing and lacerating them. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated. The plywood was not secure at the time of the incident.

On November 25, 2016, at 2:30 PM, an employee was watching a coworker set up a die in a full revolution mechanical power press when the employee's left hand entered the top ejection post that was attached to the platen. The coworker then jogged the machine and the top rod crushed four fingers on the employee's left hand. The middle and ring fingers had to be medically amputated below the first joint.

An employee was being lifted in a powered industrial truck cage to conduct inventory. The cage fell to the ground when it reached the third tier of the racking system, which was about 25 feet high. The employee hit the ground, sustaining facial fractures and bruised ribs and lungs.
An employee was walking in a hallway when she fell forward and struck her face, nose, lips, and the side of her body on the floor.
An employee was repacking a pump when his right-hand pointer and middle fingers were amputated. The pump was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was inflating an inboard tire mounted on the rear of an RV when the tire exploded. The employee lost consciousness and suffered right shoulder pain, hearing loss, and blurred vision.

An employee was cleaning the glass above a steam table while standing on a stainless steel table. The employee then slipped and the left foot fell into a hot water well. The employee suffered first, second, and third degree burns to the left foot up to the ankle.

An employee was working from a ladder on a roof, installing a heating and air conditioning unit, when he fell 20 to 25 feet to the concrete driveway below, cracking his pelvis and ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning an uncut noodle off the blade of a noodle-cutting machine when the blade cut the back of the employee's left hand, requiring surgery. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was working at a sausage stuffing machine. She had placed an empty sausage casing on the horn of the machine and was feeding it to the chuck when the machine was activated. Her right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the chuck and horn.
An employee was dismounting a ladder and missed the last step. The employee fell to the floor breaking their knee cap.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift down the main travel aisle in the warehouse when he struck some racks. His left foot became caught between the racks and the forklift, sustaining a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting the alignment on a case erector head. He activated the emergency stop and raised the head to the horizontal position, creating a pinch point that amputated his right pinky fingertip.
An employee was walking to his car when he fell in the parking lot. He suffered a head laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle in a freezer area to fill orders. When he dismounted the vehicle, it continued to move (coasted) and ran over his right foot, lacerating the bottom of his foot and tearing tendons and ligaments in his big and middle toes.
An employee was unloading caustic from a truck using a hose. When he disconnected the hose, he was chemically burned by the caustic solution.
An employee fell to the floor while getting into the cab of a truck, suffering a fractured hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was held at gunpoint while taking the store's trash out at 12:02 a.m. The armed robber forced the employee back into the store and shot the employee in the abdomen.
An employee was using a pole pounder to pound stakes in when the employee's right glove became snagged and the pole pounder fell onto the right index finger, amputating it.

An employee was calibrating the temperature for steam on a kettle. His coworker did not know he was calibrating the kettle and poured the hot water out of the kettle, splashing the employee's leg and causing second degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was trying to close the back door, which was not closing properly. When she forced it closed, it slammed on her left little finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was unhooking a tractor trailer from a dolly when his finger was caught between the dolly and the tractor trailer, amputating his left pinky fingertip.

On or about November 28, 2016, at approximately 1:40 a.m., an employee was loading a new roll of plastic film on a winder machine when his left hand was pulled into a nip point. His lower left arm was fractured and required hospitalization.

An employee was picking recyclable waste from a conveyor belt and placing it in the appropriate bins when the employee's left pinky finger became caught and amputated between the belt and the metal portion of the shoot.

An employee was operating a table saw to cut backing material when the material became snagged and pulled his right hand into the saw blade, lacerating his middle and ring fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was connecting wires to a switchgear when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee's head and shoulders.
An employee fell off a scissor lift that was approximately 12 feet high, breaking both heels and a vertebra.

On 11/29/2016, at 4:00 p.m., an employee was in the machine room when he saw debris on the sheave where the elevator cables wrap around. He started to clean the sheave using a screw driver. When the elevator started to move, the cable caught his left hand and pulled him, causing him to tip over and fall to the ground. He sustained three finger amputations on his left hand, broken teeth, and lacerations to his face, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The elevator was not locked out at the time of the incident.
While giving vaccinations to a cow, the cow kicked, causing the syringe to enter the employee's right forearm.
An employee was reaching for a box while standing on the second step of a three-step ladder when she lost her balance and fell, fracturing her left hip.
An employee's finger became stuck in a door jamb after the door closed on it. When he pulled away, his right pinky finger was de-gloved and had to be amputated to the first joint.
An employee suffered left ring and middle fingertip amputations while cutting sheet metal with a mechanical shear.

Two employees were switching circuits in a circuit breaker when an arc flash/blast occurred. They were running from the blast when an oil-filled transformer exploded burning the employees. One of the employees was hospitalized due to the burns.
An employee was driving a powered pallet jack down an aisle and maneuvering between pallets when he ran into a rack, pinning and breaking his leg.
An employee was operating an order picker. The order picker tipped over and the employee suffered a head injury.
An employee was descending an extension ladder after measuring a sign when it kicked out from under him. He fell and injured his head and knees.
A box slid off a fork truck and knocked another container into an employee, pinning him against a scissor lift. He suffered internal injuries.
An employee suffered hand lacerations and fractures while cleaning cheese-making equipment.
An employee on a ladder was attempting to adjust a hydraulic press when the press opened and caught/crushed the employee's right thumb in a pinch point.
An employee was walking through the yard when concrete slurry leaked into his boot and caused cement burns (corrosive) to his right foot.

An employee placed a pallet of material on a platform with a forklift and then backed the forklift up to the platform gate. When the employee reached out of the lift to shut the gate, the index and middle fingers were crushed between the gate and the forklift cage. The employee's middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was helping a coworker who was using a sledgehammer when the sledgehammer ricocheted and hit the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized with head trauma.
An employee was preparing to clean the ink tray of a printing machine when he stumbled and put his left hand out to catch himself. His hand entered the machine's unguarded rollers and was de-gloved.
An employee was drilling a bushing out of a part when his glove was caught on the rotating drill, pulling his hand into the drill and amputating the right index finger and middle fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder removing a bolt with a wrench when it slipped off the bolt, causing the employee to fall and suffer a compound fracture of the ankle.
An employee lost their balance and fell off a ladder while cutting branches, landing on the right side.
An employee was setting up bottling equipment when hot water from a leaking line clamp splashed his stomach, causing second degree burns that required overnight hospitalization.
An employee was shot while on the job.

On 11/28/16, an employee on a ladder fell to a cement patio floor while handing a pipe boot to a coworker on the roof. The employee suffered a brain hemorrhage and several broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.

On or about November 28, 2016, at 12:25 AM, an employee was trying to dislodge a metal I-beam from a skid of wall boards. When he pulled to dislodge the I-beam, it separated from the wall boards and came down on his right hand, amputating his middle fingertip.
An employee was unloading his trailer when it tipped over and amputated his lower left leg.

On 11/28/2016, an employee was unloading a 53-foot trailer using a forklift. As he was attempting to enter the trailer, the tractor and trailer rolled forward, causing the forklift to fall to the ground.  As the forklift was falling, the employee jumped out of it and hit the ground, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing snow from a tarp covering a trailer when the spring loaded tarp arm shut and caught the employee's finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating the shrink wrap machine. As he was lowering the stretch wrap to the bottom of a pallet, his left ring finger was caught by the spinning plate that the pallet was sitting on. His finger then became caught in the machine and was amputated.
An employee was using a backhoe to lay down a steel beam when the beam broke through the backhoe's glass window and struck his left kneecap. He was hospitalized with a broken left kneecap.
An employee was removing a goose neck from a die casting machine when the chain sling hook crushed his index fingertip. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee fell to the ground while working from a ladder, injuring his back and requiring surgery.

An employee was greasing the chain on an edge banding machine when her rag and gloves were pulled into the machine, which then amputated her left middle and index fingers. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was driving a golf cart on muddy pavement. As he was turning left, the golf cart slid and he fell out. The cart's back tire then ran over his right shin and broke it, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was laying on an inclined catwalk 30 feet above the ground to observe repair work on a beltline conveyor system below. As he positioned himself to stand up, he fell through the mid-rail and toe board of the catwalk, hitting the belt and the ground. He suffered three fractures to the right arm, multiple fractures to the right ribs, bruised lungs, and a bruised right kidney.

An employee was attempting to climb from one scaffold ladder to another. As he reached to tie his lanyard off to the ladder, he fell to the ground and fractured his right leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in the parking garage walking towards the building when he was hit by a car entering the garage. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured leg.
An employee was breaking down a pallet of freight in the warehouse when a 7.5-pound box fell approximately 2 feet onto the employee's face, rupturing a blood vessel.
While inspecting a residential roof for damage, an employee fell from a ladder and suffered an arm fracture.

An employee was de-burring a piece of sheet metal with a belt sander when either the belt sander pulled the sheet metal or the sheet metal slipped and amputated the top of the employee's right thumb from the knuckle to the nail.

While placing springs into a grinding machine, an employee contacted the guide edge of the grinding machine, amputating the right index fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a planter machine to plant broccoli. As he was pulling a plant from the planter machine's cup, the cup turned and amputated his right index fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An electrical current traveled through a crane to a nearby tractor, where two employees were electrocuted.
An employee was running a test procedure on an explosive device when it detonated, sending shrapnel into the employee's right hand and arm.

An employee was using a handheld, air-powered wire bender tool (used to straighten wire coil so it can be welded to the end of another wire coil). He was holding the wire bender handle with his right hand while his left hand was holding the end of the wire bender. The tool was actuated, and his left middle finger was caught between the wire and the tool, partially amputating his left middle finger.
On 11/29/2016 at 12:30 p.m., an employee was attempting to reset the tooling in a turret punch press when the tooling came off and pinched the employee's right middle fingertip, amputating it.

The employee was unloading a car from a car hauler. He was standing between the car and a fence strapping down the car. He lost his balance and his arm was caught on a piece of metal protruding form the fence resulting in a four-inch laceration on his right forearm.
An employee was working on a die cut machine that manufactures metal caps when the machine amputated his right pointer finger.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor suffering a strained groin muscle and  lumbar disc herniation.

An employee kneeled down in a narrow, guarded area to clean around a tank that contained zinc. His right leg slipped and became partially submerged in the tank, causing second degree burns to the employee's right leg (from the upper thigh to the ankle), right arm, and right abdomen.

On November 29, 2016, an employee was entering a cooler when she tripped over a coworker's foot. She fell, striking her right elbow and knee on the floor. She was hospitalized with a fractured kneecap.

An employee was moving sows from gestation to the farrowing room. He was trying to move an animal out of a stall when he lost his balance and fell, hitting the metal side of a pen on his way down. He was hospitalized with a dislocated left shoulder and a concussion.
An employee was walking from the parking lot to the building when her foot clipped a concrete parking barrier, causing her to fall and break an arm and leg.
An employee was injured when a wall collapsed on him during work operations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was converting a cupper machine by removing the die set when the die set slid back and amputated his left ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was walking across some wet railroad tracks to deliver auto parts when he slipped on the tracks and fractured his left hip, requiring surgery.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while getting out of the cab of his truck, breaking his hip.

A maintenance employee was working on a rotoformer machine when a moving cylinder caught his glove. He pulled his arm back and struck a hot piece of the machine, suffering a severe forearm burn that required hospitalization.

A crew was using a hand-chain hoist to move a large filter basket back into its housing when the basket moved unexpectedly and smashed the injured employee's right index finger against the housing. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration.
An employee was using a band saw to manufacture pallets for an engine when the saw amputated his middle and index fingers and fractured his ring finger.
An employee was working on the engine of a compressor when a flash fire occurred, burning the employee's hands and face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was fighting wild fires and was bitten by an insect. The employee suffered a reaction requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cleaning the marker machine puck and press assembly when his hand was caught between the press and the puck, amputating his left index finger to the first knuckle.
An injured employee was removing a wedge from the Newman Shaving Box. The machine operator hit a button and a log advanced striking the injured employee and causing a fracture.
An employee tripped over a computer wire and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a possible broken hip and was hospitalized for surgery.

On 11/30/16, an employee was pulling pipe from a well when the pipe was released from the elevator before the arm that held it was in place. The pipe fell and struck the employee's right hand, crushing his ring finger above the knuckle and fracturing his middle finger.  His ring finger had to be amputated.
An employee was driving a forklift and collided with a stationary forklift breaking a metatarsal on the left foot.

An employee was troubleshooting a sheave (the mechanism that lowers and raises an elevator) when the sheave rotated. His right middle finger was then caught and amputated between the sheave and the elevator cable.

An employee was at a customer's house, walking up to the front door when the wooden stairs broke. The employee's foot went through the broken stairs to the ground and he felt a pinch in his lower back. The employee tried to get up and walk, but he could not and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized overnight for a lower back injury.

An employee was plastering a wall approximately 14 feet above the ground while working from a hydro lift when he fell to the ground, breaking his left wrist, fracturing his hip, and rupturing his spleen. He was hospitalized. The lift was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was opening a tablet of Metamucil to give to a resident and suffered a severe allergic reaction resulting in anaphylaxis and hospitalization.

A forklift operator was driving in reverse and making a right-hand turn when he collided with a 4,000-pound steel parts basket. The basket was pushed into a nearby employee who was operating a press, pinching him between the basket and the power press. He suffered a right buttock laceration and right leg contusion.
An employee was walking down a hallway when she lost her footing and fell, injuring her hip and pelvis.
An employee's hand was crushed while operating a dough machine.
An employee was using a pole to straighten a pallet of papers traveling on a track when he fell between the floor and the track. He fell approximately 20 feet to the floor below, breaking his pelvis.
After turning on an air compressor, an employee was descending a ladder when it slipped out and the employee fell approximately 5 feet, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was struck in the face by a metal cap while leak testing a water line. The employee's cheekbone was fractured.

An employee was repairing the stacker portion of a door machine that had been elevated and supported with a forklift. When he removed the forklift and then removed a bolt, the stacker fell on him, crushing his pelvis and breaking ribs.
An employee was feeding dough onto a conveyor when their smock got caught in the conveyor belt. The employee suffered a hand injury and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was unloading snacks from the rear of a truck when the truck door came down and severed the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee stood on a plastic table to hang Christmas decorations, lost her balance, fell to the floor, and broke her left arm. She was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was descending the ladder of a flat bed truck and fell to the ground breaking a hip.
An employee was collecting saliva from a hippo when the hippo's mouth closed and caught the employee's left pinky fingertip, amputating it.
An employee was installing insulation and  stepped on a board with a nail in it. The nail punctured his boot and foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on the wet floor in the kitchen and injured the right elbow.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder that was leaning against a generator. The top of the ladder shifted and the employee fell approximately six feet off the ladder onto a concrete curb breaking the lower right leg.

An employee was unjamming the core baler machine when the right hand was pulled into the core cutting nip. The employee suffered open fractures to the second, third and fourth digits on the right hand. Two days later the employee's middle fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was placing a stack of plates on the counter when her foot became tangled in an electrical cord, causing her to fall on her right hip. She suffered a right leg/hip contusion.
The employee was walking around the building inspecting for termite damage when he felt light headed and dizzy and passed out. He was taken to the hospital where he was diagnosed with a heart attack.
An employee was changing the die on a press. The wrench slipped off a bolt and the employee fell breaking a hip.
An employee was cleaning the slicer and amputated the tip of the third finger on the right hand.

An employee was conducting an inspection onboard a moored vessel. While exiting a space, the employee stepped onto an unmarked, unsecured deck plate covering a void. This caused the plate to shift and the employee fell into the space below.
An employee was hospitalized on 12/1/16 after she tripped over a student's backpack and fell into a bookcase. She received a laceration to her chin and a concussion.

An employee was guiding a palm tree that a front-end loader was loading onto a work vehicle when the strap holding the tree slipped, causing the tree to shift and strike the employee. The employee suffered a head contusion.
An employee was working on a metal plate when the machine was activated and caught the employee's right hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee threw an engine rigging chain and it struck his head resulting in a contusion and laceration to the left side of his head.
While working inside an articulating boom lift, an employee came in contact with a live, 34,500-volt knife switch. The employee suffered an electrical shock and burns, requiring hospitalization.
On December 1, 2016, at about 2:00 PM, an employee slipped and fell on a damp floor while walking inside the store, fracturing her knee and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was prepping a storm drain in the middle of the road when a city inspector drove up past the site barricade and struck a ladder, which then struck the employee. The employee lost three front teeth and suffered a fractured nose. The employee was wearing a safety vest and hard hat at the time.
An employee suffered a back injury while helping to move a patient from a chair to a bed.

An employee was checking for coolant leaks on a generator when his left hand contacted the fan blades, amputating a few fingers. He was hospitalized and had surgery. The generator was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was running the table saw and lacerated fingers on his left hand.

An employee was punching cases on an assembly line when he noticed a pair of pliers near the chain and sprocket. As he attempted to retrieve the pliers, the chain snagged his glove, pulling his middle finger between the chain and sprocket and amputating his fingertip. The machine was active and unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was preparing to euthanize a heifer using a captive bolt gun. He armed the captive bolt gun and repositioned himself for better footing. When he fired the stunner, the gun shot into his right hand and wrist, causing tendon and nerve damage that required hospitalization.
An employee suffered chemical burns to the throat and pneumonia to the left lung when they entered a restroom that had recently been cleaned with a Clorox mixture.
While moving a 125-pound wooden door to a table, an employee's finger was caught between the table edge and the door frame. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated and fractured.
An employee was confronting a shoplifter when the shoplifter pushed the employee into a concrete pillar. The employee fell to the floor and suffered an internal injury that required hospitalization.
While walking in a corridor of the hospital, an employee slipped and fell, fracturing her femur. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

Employees were installing a fiber optic cable along a rural roadway and were cleaning up the site at the end of the day when a vehicle approached the work site, left the road, and traveled through the ditch, striking two employees. The first employee suffered lacerations and contusions, while the other suffered a fractured leg. Both were hospitalized.
An employee was walking from the printer to a desk when her right foot became caught on the corner leg of a desk. She lost her balance and fell to the floor, injuring her left hip.
While installing a manure pond garage door, an employee fell off a ladder and broke four ribs, requiring hospitalization.

While replacing a conveyor roller, an employee's right middle fingertip became caught on the chain/sprocket and was partially amputated. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was existing the tractor trailer, missed a step and fell breaking a hip.

Employees were unloading a pallet from a rack. When they released the pallet, the injured employee's left middle finger was not clear and became caught and amputated between the pallet and the ground.

An employee was working on a plastic film extrusion line when her clothing became caught in the machinery. Her left arm was then pulled in between two rollers in the extrusion line, causing skin and tissue trauma. She was hospitalized overnight.
On December 1, 2016, an employee was using a ladder to turn off a valve when the ladder slipped out. The employee fell and suffered a broken left arm, requiring surgery.
On 12/1/16, at approximately 8 p.m., an employee's finger was caught in a closing door, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was exiting a ladder to a rooftop when he slipped and fell 10 feet to the ground, breaking his ankle.

An employee was using compressed air to blow dust off the photo eye at the stacker machine when his glove was caught in the chain tensioner, severing his left ring fingertip. The machine was unguarded and operating at the time of the incident.

On 12/1/16, an employee was standing next to a 40-liter glass carboy that was being tested for integrity when the carboy shattered. Flying glass hit the employee, who suffered minor cuts on the leg and serious lacerations to the hand, requiring surgery.
An employee was greasing the back of a milling machine when the operator reversed the machine and crushed the employee's ankle that may result in a medical amputation.

An employee was working on the roof of a building when he noticed a crack in a concrete deck panel. As he attempted to remove the deck panel to patch it with wood, the panels he was standing on also broke. He fell almost 20 feet to the concrete floor below, cracking his L2 and L3 lumbar vertebrae. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was removing a temporary barrier wall. A loader with forks was used to lift the wall to relieve pressure so the employee could pull pins from it. The pin shifted as he was pulling it and his right index finger was caught between the bolt and the barrier wall, amputating it at the first knuckle.
On December 1, 2016, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee slipped on the grass slope outside of the building and fell, dislocating and fracturing her left ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a molding machine and amputated the left index finger.

An employee was working with a helper to change the belt and sheave on an air intake fan. He was manually moving the fan belt while a coworker was pushing it when his gloved left-hand ring finger became caught between the sheave and belt. When he pulled his hand out, the skin came off the first digit of his left ring finger. The first digit had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was abrasive blasting inside a small mockup tank. The employee lost control of the blast hose and suffered lacerations to the left thigh and left leg from blast grit.
An employee was working on a sprinkler pipe while standing on a 6-foot ladder when he fell off the ladder and broke his ankle.

An employee attempted to unload an irregular package from a trailer. The other packages in the trailer shifted and caused the employee to fall. The irregular package then fell onto the employee, who suffered a fractured left leg.

An employee was checking the sensor of a valve. As he was closing the lid, he lost control of it. When he attempted to grab the lid so it did not slam, it crushed and partially amputated his right third fingernail.

An employee was drilling bolt holes to fit the scrape blade on a snow plow. As the employee attempted to clear a metal shaving out from behind the bit, the employee's sleeve was caught and was pulled into the drill chuck, suffering a broken forearm. The drill chuck was guarded at the time.

An employee was installing a gas fryer. After restoring propane flow to the fryer, he attempted to light the pilot light. An explosion then occurred, causing second degree burns to his hands, arms, and face.
An employee was hospitalized after tripping over a toy and landing on her right wrist.
On 12/2/16, a temporary employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a laceration to the back of the head and a compression fracture to the spine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a 12-inch miter saw to chop scrap wood from 4-foot to 2-foot pieces when the saw amputated his left index finger between the first and second digit.

On December 2, 2016, at 2315, an employee was blanching green beans when they became lodged in a stand-alone chute that is used to transfer product from one location to another. The employee was using a scraper to dislodge the beans when there was an uncontrolled release of water that was approximately 200 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee was hit by the water and suffered second degree burns to the upper back, arms, forehead, and ear.
An employee was fixing a fan belt on the roof when his thumb was caught and amputated in the fan belt/wheel.
An employee slipped and fell on steps while walking into the building from the parking lot, suffering a possible broken hip.
An employee was cleaning a machine when his sweatshirt was caught and wrapped around the roller bar, causing him to lose circulation in his right arm and wrist.
An employee was working at a construction site and his foot was run over by a forklift that was transporting metal sheets. The employee suffered a broken ankle, foot and toes.

An employee was applying trowel finish to double tees. As the employee started the trowel, he discovered it was set to full throttle. He struggled to get the trowel machine under control. The trowel blade contacted a portion of the double tee side rail. The blade stopped, but the trowel continued to rotate, throwing the employee off of the form and onto the ground on his right side. The employee was then struck by the trowel machine control bar.

On December 2, 2016, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee was walking down a stairwell to the basement when he missed the first step and fell down approximately 12 stairs. He was hospitalized with a head laceration and a fractured left wrist. At the time of the incident, the backup generator was being tested and a delay in the emergency lighting caused the stairwell to be poorly lit.

An employee was removing and replacing the hydraulic cylinder from the powered industrial truck. The truck's forklift mechanism became unsecure and struck the employee on the left hand amputating the pinky finger.
An employee had just picked up a saut  pan that contained scalding cooking oil and meat juices when hot grease splashed the back of his hand and wrist, causing severe burns.
An employee was cleaning an automatic roll-up door while working from a ladder. The employee's rag and gloves became caught between the roll-up door, which subsequently broke the employee's left arm.
An employee suffered a ruptured neck disc while using a 3-pound metal scraper to clean the coating roller on a printing unit.

An employee was removing service wires from an electrical panel when his pliers slipped and struck the electrical cabinet. An arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to his right hand and minor burns to his face.
An employee was releasing the hook and chain rigging on an engine when the swinging chain and hook struck the employee's forehead, causing a concussion that required overnight hospitalization.
An employee was hanging sheet metal from a ladder when he fell from the ladder and broke some ribs.
On December 2, 2016, an employee was using a hoist to move a 945-pound casting into a paint booth when the casting fell from the hoist and onto the employee's left foot, amputating all toes.
An employee was working from a step ladder when one of the ladder legs failed and the employee fell approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a bump on his head and was hospitalized.

An employee was disconnecting a bolt from an I-bolt attached to the top frame rail of the side wall of a trailer. The bolt goes through the threaded portion of the I-bolt to hold it in place, and a crane hook goes through the I-bolt.  The crane hook was still attached to the I-bolt.  As the employee was removing the tension bolt, the crane trolley was moved, and the employee's finger was pinched/amputated between the bolt head and the trailer frame rail.
An employee was shafting a corrugated roll of paper when the roll crushed his right hand up against the frame of a splicer bar. His right thumb and index fingers required surgery.
An employee was opening a crate of safety glass when the glass fell on top of him, fracturing both legs and requiring hospitalization.
On December 2, 2016, at 11:30 AM, an employee was walking in the back of the parking lot when he was robbed at gunpoint and shot in the head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stringing up an accumulator machine when his right middle finger was caught between the wire, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was skiing down a road slope and instructing students when he hit an edge. He then fell to the ground on his side, breaking ribs and suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee's right index fingertip was caught in the pinch point of moving equipment, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was picking up the wheel end of a hand dolly. When he sat it down, his left pinky finger was pinched between the wheel and the housing, causing a distal amputation.
An employee went out to the parking lot to retrieve a shopping cart when she was startled by running children and fell to the ground, fracturing her left femur and left hip. She had surgery.
While elevated in a personnel lift and performing maintenance on a refrigeration system, an employee was exposed to refrigerant ammonia, suffering inhalation injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on the rig floor when a traveling block fell and struck him, fracturing his clavicle and ribs.
An employee was working in an aisle and picking product when cases of salad fell on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with ankle and wrist pain.

An employee was attempting to place roof sheathing material on a new residential structure when the wind picked the employee up and sent him off the edge of the structure to the ground below. He suffered a cracked rib.
While sorting donations in a trailer, an employee tripped and fell on the trailer/truck netting system, suffering a fractured femur that required hospitalization.

An employee was ground spotting while coworkers moved a transformer on a pull and push truck near a railroad crossing when he tripped and fell over a road marker and was pulled under the trailer tires, fracturing his right leg.

An employee was walking from the dock area into a trailer across the dock plate/bumper when he misstepped and lost his footing. His right foot and leg went off the dock plate/bumper, leading his left leg to bend abnormally and his left femur to break above the knee.

An employee was cleaning water in the nail salon from a busted pump/pipe when he was bitten by a spider on his left hand. He experienced swelling and pain in his left hand and required hospitalization.

An employee was using a 4'x8' 3/4" MDO plywood to construct an 8' trash bin. The employee was using the plywood as a saw horse to put another side on the bin. He went to cut the wood using an electric circular saw and the vibration caused the wood to fall which caused the saw to kick back and amputate his left index finger below the second knuckle and cut his left thumb.
On 12/3/16, an employee fell off a residential roof and suffered head trauma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee misstepped while climbing an extension ladder and fell approximately 10 feet, suffering facial fractures to the eye socket area.

A team of four employees were replacing a chemical pump. When the pump was replaced, the team began to dismantle the setup. Team member 1 was taking down a come-along when he slipped and grabbed onto a nearby strap to regain his balance. This caused a bar to fall directly onto the hand of the injured employee who was replacing a pump eyelet below the bar and come-along assembly. The injured employee received a right thumb laceration, fracture and tendon separation. As a result, the right thumb was partially amputated.
An employee was cleaning the hopper on a combine with an air hose when the employee's right leg was caught in the combine auger, amputating it mid-calf.
An employee fell down the stairs and suffered a shoulder sprain.

An employee was standing on a conveyor (approximately 2 feet to 3 feet above the ground) to cut and dismantle it when the conveyor collapsed. The employee fell and hit the ground/steel conveyor frame, suffering a fractured hip and wrist.
On December 3, 2016, an employee was removing metal brackets from a semi truck trailer when a bracket struck the employee in the eye, requiring hospitalization.

An employee picked up a case of jelly from one pallet and walked over to another pallet to place the case of product. Once the employee got to the second pallet, he tripped and fell in a lunge position, striking his right knee on the ground and fracturing his right femur.

On December 4, 2016, an employee fell from a portable 4-foot, fiberglass A-frame ladder that had been set up on the finished floor and was covered with paper. The floor vents had not been installed and one of the ladder legs was on the paper that covered a vent floor opening. The injured employee had climbed the ladder to approximately the second or third step when the ladder tipped as the leg dropped into the floor hole. He fell and his lower body struck the floor while his upper torso struck against the wall corner. He suffered two fractured right ribs and a punctured right lung, requiring hospitalization.
The employee slipped on the snow on the sidewalk while leaving work. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was unclogging the Stick Machine while it was running. His left hand contacted the saw blades resulting in amputation of the middle, index and ring fingers.
An employee was setting a pipe at a well site and was guiding the pipe with his hands. As he was lowering the pipe into a hole, his right index fingertip was caught and amputated by the pipe.
An employee was installing a cross arm in a pole with 7620 KV when he received flash burns on the left side of his body (arm to waist). He was hospitalized.

An employee on a ladder was reaching to remove some clothes from the back of a rack while holding on to a horizontal pipe (used to hang clothes) near the front of the rack. The horizontal pipe disengaged from the rack uprights and fell, causing the employee to lose her balance and fall to the ground. She fractured her left ankle.
As an employee was walking away from the rig floor, he tripped and fell, hitting his shoulder on the drill line that was on the rig floor. His right shoulder blade suffered a hairline fracture.
On December 5, 2016, an employee fell 7 feet 10 inches from a ladder resulting in multiple fractured ribs, a torn rotator cuff and a fractured rotator cuff socket.
On December 5, 2016, an employee fell to a lower level while exiting the roof, suffering cuts, scrapes, and possible fractures to the wrist and ankle.
An employee was cutting a dock plate when it came loose and landed on the employee's left foot, injuring several toes. Two toes had to later be surgically amputated.

On December 5, 2016, an employee fell down a flight of stairs at a patient's home, striking her head and losing consciousness. She suffered a head injury, detached retina, and fractured right arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on the chain and sprocket to a tape machine. As he used a tool to tighten the chain, his hand slipped and his right index finger contacted the moving chain. His right index finger was partially amputated (approximately 2-2.5 cm). The machine was running and was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was putting away furniture using a cherry picker and was 30 feet high when he fell to the concrete floor, breaking his left leg and arm. A fall protection line was not connected at the time of the incident.

An employee was investigating the discharge of a rotary airlock.  He removed the inspection door, visually inspected the spout, and thought he saw a suspicious buildup.  When he attempted to remove the buildup inside the spout with his left hand, his glove was caught by the running airlock, which then pulled his hand in and amputated three fingertips.
An employee was wrapping a roll on a packaging crater when his right middle finger and ring finger were caught between a chain guard and a wind-up roller switch. His middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing rubber protection (hoses and blankets) on a 13.2-KV powerline when an arc flash occurred, causing second and third degree burns to his upper right back and left upper leg.

An employee was using a scaffold to clean a marquee sign. The locking collar on the scaffold did not hold and the scaffold tilted, causing the employee to fall and suffer a compound fracture to his right lower leg.
An employee's fingertip was caught and amputated in a conveyor belt.
An employee pulled the cord on a small water pump motor and their hand was pulled into the flywheel amputating a fingertip (without bone loss).

An employee was removing a link arm part from a crane sling to set it down on top of other stacked link arms. One side of the link arm was down on top of the stack and the other side was elevated.  When the employee removed a piece of wood to lower the elevated side of the link arm, it came down and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was pushing boards into a chipper when the ends of two boards closed together and caught the employee's right middle fingertip, amputating approximately one-third of the fingernail.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, suffering a broken femur.

An employee was assembling a tool when he noticed water coming out of the tool's drain hole. He tipped the tool upwards to drain the water. When he was setting the tool down, it pinched and amputated his right middle fingertip between the seal support frame and the tray lifter.
An employee was scraping a hickey off a printing press roller when his hand was pulled into the cylinder-roller gap. He sustained a compression injury and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was attempting to push product packaging into the cellophane film wrapper when the crimper shaft that cuts, heats, and seals the cellophane film amputated her left middle fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee and his supervisor were having a conversation while standing between two pieces of equipment when a coworker operating an upright pallet jack struck the employee's left leg, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into the facility through the employee entrance when her left middle finger became caught in the door. Her fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was training a horse when the horse had a heart attack and fell on the employee. The employee suffered a bruised leg.
An employee slipped on some ice and fell to the ground fracturing a hip.

An employee was picking up and loading material onto a truck with a forklift when his left foot was caught between the forklift and a post that protects the door opening. His foot broke and required surgery.
A temporary employee was turning a corner while operating an electric pallet jack when the employee's ankle was caught and fractured between the wall or a racking system.
An employee was helping to move a transformer when his left index finger was pinched and fractured between the transformer and metal strapping on the wall.
An employee was building a set using a guarded Skil Saw. When he was cutting the wood, the wood jolted causing his hand to move and resulting in amputation of the left pinkie fingertip.
An employee fell from a ladder or the top of a truck to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a punctured lung, and head lacerations.

On December 5, around 9:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., an employee was using an aerial boom lift in a road center median. As he was coming down with the basket, the basket became positioned in live traffic and was hit by a box truck. He was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was attempting to remove a paper jam in a machine when the machine blade amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a corrugated plastic pipe when the saw kicked back, cutting the employee's face and right armpit.

An employee was operating a tugger to pull racks to the warehouse while a coworker on a forklift was stacking finished product in the warehouse. The coworker sounded his horn upon backing up and attempted to take a right turn around a stack of knockdowns. The employee was heading into the warehouse area at the same time and came around the stack of knockdowns. The coworker's forks hit the front left side of the employee's tugger. The left fork hit the front left side, spinning the back of the tugger towards the lift and allowing the right fork to strike the top of the employee's foot. The employee suffered a fractured left foot.

An employee pulled onto a metal-surface truck scale and stepped out of his truck while carrying a pint-size sample bottle of the materials he had just picked up. It was raining and he slipped. The sample bottle fell to the ground and broke. He then fell onto the bottle, which severed the ulnar nerve in his right wrist.
An employee was standing on a ladder and disconnecting a hose from a silo when he fell off the ladder and hit the ground, suffering a radial fracture.
An employee was hit in the head by a piece of steel.
An employee's retractable lifeline became caught and the employee fell approximately 28 feet from a metal roof to the concrete below, suffering arm, shoulder, rib, and hip injuries.

An employee was assisting an outside driver with an extendable chassis when his right arm was caught or struck by the chassis as the truck driver pulled forward. He was hospitalized with a right forearm injury.
While using a dolly to deliver a package to a home owner, an employee fell out of the back of the delivery truck and onto the roadway, breaking three ribs and an elbow.
On 12/5/2016, an employee suffered an amputation of the right index fingertip while cleaning the caramel depositor machine when his finger got caught in the air actuated slide that opens and closes.
An employee received an electrical shock while unplugging a power strip, suffering sweating, tingling, and nausea.

An employee was attempting to empty a sweeper into an open-top dumpster sitting on the dock apron below him. Suddenly, the dumpster began to move and the employee and the sweeper fell off the dock. He injured his lower back and was hospitalized.

On December 6, 2016, around 1:25 p.m., an employee was cleaning the gutters of the second level of a residence from a ladder placed on the roof of the first level. When he was on his way down the ladder, he slipped and fell on the roof, and then rolled off to the ground. He broke his neck and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee and a coworker were attempting to lift a 500-pound grinder bag full of polyvinyl chloride powder when the bag slipped and struck the employee, knocking him to the floor. He suffered head and lower back injuries.

On December 6, 2016, at approximately 2:10 a.m., an employee was pressure washing the floors in the shop when the heated, high-pressure water from the wand made contact and penetrated his leather work boot. He was hospitalized for a laceration and second degree burn to the left middle toe.
An employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
