An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. While making a left turn, he struck a steel beam. His left ankle/foot were caught and fractured between the steel beam and the pallet jack.

An employee was carrying a metal pole to install filler between tables. He was walking by a table truss when he bumped the truss, which was being supported by a cross brace. The truss then fell over and landed on the employee's lower back and leg, pinning him down. He suffered a dislocated left hip and broken left femur.
While walking to a customer's location, an employee slipped on ice under a snow-covered walk and fell, breaking the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was watching a contract employee change out a tire on a vehicle. The tire separated and a portion of the wheel and tire assembly struck the employee that was watching. He suffered a fractured femur and injuries to his mid section, leg, and the middle of his body. He was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a tray when she slipped on sauce and fell on her right knee, breaking her kneecap on the tile floor.

An employee was unscrewing lock pins from a wellhead to remove a tubing hanger when an L-80 joint of tubing and hanger was ejected from the frac valve due to the pressure-to-weight differential. The tubing and hanger struck the employee's back, fracturing the L1 vertebra.
An employee suffered a right finger amputation while attempting to remove food products from the jammed motor blades of a vacuum tortilla oven.

An employee was unloading packages from a trailer with a coworker when the coworker accidentally dislodged a package that made contact with the employee's head. He suffered a head contusion and required hospitalization.

An employee was emptying the skid bin underneath a rotary lock at the bag house, which allows bags to empty polymer wax, when the unit became plugged. As the employee attempted to clear the plugged chute, his right index, middle, and ring fingers were caught and amputated by the rotary valve (rotating drum with fingers).
An employee was connecting a trailer to the ball of a truck. His finger was in the coupling when the trailer came down and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was rigging up forms and installing a lifting hook when the crane operator inadvertently lifted the form. The employee's finger was then caught between the form and the lifting hook, amputating the first left-hand digit.

A temporary employee on a catwalk was cleaning the incandescent lighting covers above fertilizer blenders when he fell 7 to 8 feet off the catwalk and onto the concrete floor, injuring his back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was checking the oil on a utility vehicle when the safety latch on the hoist supporting the bed slipped, causing the hoist to fall on the employee. The employee suffered a leg fracture and was hospitalized.

Two employees were replacing the decking on a roof. They were lifting up the concrete panel using a pry bar when the deck to the right of them gave way and they fell through the roof. One of the employees fell to the concrete floor below and was hospitalized with six broken ribs and a broken pelvis. The employee was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was manually pushing a load of lumber when the truck moved and pushed him to the floor, injuring his left ankle.
While servicing an HVAC unit on the roof of a commercial building, an employee's finger was caught and amputated or avulsed in the fan belt of the HVAC unit.
An employee was cutting a beef rib on a band saw when the blade amputated his right thumb tip and fractured his right index finger.
An employee was trying to lift a granite countertop out of a pick-up truck bed when he twisted and injured his lower back.

An employee was using a bulldozer when it became stuck. He attached the lifting slings to the brackets and was lifting the bulldozer and placing it on top of cargo. After hooking up the shackles/sling to the bulldozer, he held onto the cable with his left hand and flagged the crane operator to lift with his right hand. When the slack was taken up, the employee's left pinky was pinched between the cable and the cab of the bulldozer, partially amputating his pinky fingertip.
An employee was feeding parts into a machine at her workstation when she experienced shortness of breath and collapsed, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to unclog a transfer auger and had removed three to four bolts from the housing. The employee was scraping the product with the left hand when the left middle finger was caught in a pinch point between the auger and casing, amputating half of the finger. The auger was turning at the time of the incident.

An employee was on top of a mobile tank trailer, removing the loading arm apparatus that was used to load the trailer with molten sulfur. The bucket he used to dispense the sulfur then began to fall into the open hatch of the trailer. When he tried to catch it, his hand became submerged in the top surface of the molten sulfur, suffering second degree burns.

An employee was attempting to cut wood flooring to size with a chop saw. He mashed down on the steel plate on top of the saw blade guard with his left hand while his right hand was near the blade. The blade then severely lacerated his right hand and amputated his right pinky fingertip. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was pushing meat totes on a dolly from the meat cooler to the meat room. As he was going through the doorway, the totes fell off. He tripped over them and landed on his head, suffering a concussion.

An employee was doing maintenance on an automated label laminator. After replacing a roll, the employee had to place stripping bands back into the grooves/ridges of the glue applicator roll. He began to guide the stripping band into place on the groove with his left hand to keep the bands from sliding out. At the same time, he was straightening the stripping band with his right hand to keep it from twisting. His left hand then got close to a nip point. As he was attempting to pull his hand out, the rolls smashed his left hand, amputating his middle fingertip (no bone loss) and avulsing the fingernails of his third, fourth, and fifth digits.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she slipped on a small patch of ice and fell, breaking her elbow. She required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was training a new coworker on cutting PVC pipe when the saw blade amputated the employee's left index finger just below the first knuckle. The saw was guarded at the time.

On December 7, 2016, an employee was cutting metal tubing on a band saw. The employee was attempting to retrieve a part in the saw housing when the blade amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was attempting to switch power from one circuit to another when an arc flash occurred, burning his face and arms.

An employee was cleaning a bolt on a piece of equipment when a coworker who was tightening a bolt on the same piece of equipment dropped a bracket. The bracket struck and amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.
An employee was cutting half-inch wooden boards on a table saw. When he reached out to move the fallen wood out of the way, the end of his thumb contacted the blade and was partially amputated.
An employee was moving a refrigerator when it fell onto the employee's forearm, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was readjusting an edge guard and a strap smashed their left thumb tip.
An employee fell off a loading dock and injured his knee.

An employee and a coworker were adjusting the stops on the second plate of an 825-ton press. They needed to bring the second plate up for adjustment. The coworker was operating the controls to adjust the height of the second plate and proceeded to turn off the exhaust. The second plate raised while the employee working inside the press had his arm resting on the trip rod. When the second plate raised, it pinned the employee's right forearm between the trip rod and main ejection nut, causing a compound fracture.

An employee had collected recycling cans from the left side of the street and was crossing back to the front of his truck when a car struck him. He suffered a bilateral broken wrist, laceration near the eye, and a bruised groin area, requiring hospitalization and wrist surgery.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she stepped onto black ice and fell. Her left leg twisted during the fall, breaking her tibia and fibula.

An employee walked up the plywood decking on a new construction residential home to install an anchor point. The employee then slipped on roof sheathing and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured right leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a table saw when it amputated his left-hand fingers.
An employee was installing dunnage on a trailer float when his left thumb tip was crushed just below the nail.
On December 7, 2016, an employee fell to the floor while handling mail and suffered a fractured hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was performing pipe-fitting operations at the top of a 6-foot rolling staircase (rollers locked in place). When she reached out and grabbed a fitted pipe, it came loose and caused her to lose her balance and fall down the stairs. She broke her right wrist, left hand, and sacrum.
An employee was operating a press machine when his left index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was unhooking a trailer from a tractor when his left hand was caught between the trailer and tractor, amputating his left index fingertip at the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a 6-foot ladder, repairing stucco at a commercial building, when he fell and broke his arm and ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting wood using a chop saw when the guard became stuck in the up position. As the saw was powering down, the employee's jacket was caught on the blade, which then pulled the employee's left forearm into the machine, lacerating it.
An employee and a client leaned against the iron railing on a balcony at a local restaurant and the railing gave way causing the employee and the client to fall one story to the ground below.
An employee broke her ankle after tripping over an airline.
An employee fell into a ditch along the side of the road while walking outside a company vehicle. The employee suffered a right shoulder fracture and required hospitalization.
An employee was driving a stand-up vehicle when he grazed the side of a stored rod. Stored material then fell on and injured his hand.

An employee in a drilling rig had drilled a shaft for a new sewer tunnel. The employee was changing the bit on the drilling rig when the seat broke on the operator's station, causing the employee to fall off and into the drilled hole (14 feet). The employee suffered a head laceration and concussion.

An employee was attempting to move a jammed machinery part. He moved the controls, but the part did not move. While troubleshooting, he leaned on the part, which then moved and pushed him backwards. He tripped and fell, landing on and fracturing his right hip.

An employee was loading bags of ice when the ice machine became jammed. The employee was using a metal pole to unload the auger when the auger grabbed the pole and pinned the employee's left index finger to the machine, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was feed-loading a board into the loading port or opening of a sap edger when the board kicked back out of the port, causing four of his left-hand fingers to be pinched between the ejected board and another stationary or slowly moving board on the conveyor.
While installing metal decking, an employee slipped and fell 15 feet to ground level, suffering broken ribs.
On 12/08/2016, an employee fell off the back end of his tractor-trailer at a customer's loading dock and suffered a severe concussion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was struck by a forklift and knocked to the floor. The forklift's right front tire then ran over the employee's right foot. He suffered a head contusion, sore left ribs, a laceration to his left hand between the thumb and index finger, and two broken toes on his right foot.
An employee was putting plates on a tie under a rail when the tamper head fell off the rail, causing the rail to fall on and amputate the employee's fingertip.

An employee was attempting to clear a clump of starch from an overhead duster when the plate that controls the flow of the starch closed and amputated the employee's right-hand index, middle, and ring fingertips. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to separate two paper rolls (4-inch roll and 34-inch roll) with a knife when the knife was caught between the rolls and the employee's right index fingertip was pinched off. The paper roll machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to free bridged material in a regrind feeder when an auger struck and amputated his right pointer, middle, and ring fingertips.
An employee was ski-cutting to compact snow so that customers would not clip any ice and get hurt when he clipped ice on the ground and fell forward onto the snow, fracturing his leg.
An employee was tending to a machine when his right-hand index fingertip was amputated. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was troubleshooting a treater machine when he received an electric discharge through his arm, with an entry burn at his fingers and exit burn at his elbow.

An employee was installing a robotic welder and finishing the cement grouting around the workstation when his right foot entered the service pit of an adjunct active robotic welder. The active robotic welder began its cycle and crushed/pinned the employee's right foot against the barrier guard and the welder. He suffered lacerations and fractures to the big toe and two adjacent toes. The active welder was guarded at the time of the incident.

On 12/08/2016, at 4:08 AM, an employee was washing a processing line. The employee removed the cover plate from an auger, reached in, and suffered a left index fingertip amputation at the top knuckle.
An employee was sorting boards on a roll case conveyor when two boards came together and partially amputated his right little finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was manually shaking out a PTO auger. His jacket got caught in the PTO resulting in a torn right bicep.
An employee was operating a forklift when his foot was caught between the two pedals. While trying to get his foot out from between the pedals, he drove into a guardrail and broke his left femur.

On 12/8/16, an employee was operating a packaging line when her arm entered the discharge opening of a case sealer and contacted rotating parts. Her left forearm broke and required hospitalization. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell while getting out of a dumpster and struck his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped onto a powered pallet jack and the jack moved suddenly striking and pinning another employee. The injured employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was operating a reach truck when he collided with a support column. He suffered a laceration above the eye and chin, fractured jaw, possible concussion, and dental damage.

An employee was replacing a valve on a vacuum tank and was attempting to remove two bolts using an air grinder. As he started grinding the first bolt, a flash explosion occurred. He suffered a cut on his head; received third degree burns to his hands, forearms, and stomach; and fractured his left leg. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was walking on stilts to his working area. He was working in a computer room (raised floor) that was covered in tile squares. Someone had removed a carpeted tile and he fell between the false floor and carpeted sections of the floor, dislocating his left elbow and breaking his right wrist.
An employee's leg gave out while conducting pre-track inspection training. The employee fell backwards and struck the ground, suffering a left shoulder injury that required hospitalization.
While reaching for a package, an employee's hand was caught in a conveyor, de-gloving two fingers.
An employee was stepping out of a box truck while carrying a squeegee tool when he slipped, fell to the ground, and was impaled in the abdomen by the tool. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a saw to cut notches on a slab when the saw kicked up and lacerated the front of his throat.
An employee was changing the  wheels on a cart when it fell off the shims, crushing and amputating his right ring finger.
An employee was descending a 6-foot A-frame ladder when he lost his balance on the second rung and fell to the ground, breaking his hip.
An employee was preparing a winder machine to start a new spool of twine. When she started the machine, it caught and damaged her right index fingertip, requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was walking on a dock and was struck by a forklift that was backing up. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was turning the landing gear on a tractor trailer when he lost his grip on the gear handle. The handle then spun around and hit his mouth, breaking his jaw and teeth.

An employee was working on a tractor trailer and loading equipment for a customer. As he was trying to shut the back trailer door, the driver of the trailer pulled forward and the door closed on his left middle finger, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee was attempting to thread a machine and position the zipper when the machine's roller amputated her fingertip.
An employee was working on the radiator of a car. As he leaned over the front of the car, he injured his back and required hospitalization.

An employee had just checked the status of rolls at a computer station in the roll stock warehouse and started walking away when a clamp truck in the warehouse struck the employee. The employee suffered a right leg amputation (mid-shin) and five broken metatarsals on the left foot.
An employee fell 5 feet to the ground while erecting a scaffold, suffering broken ribs and possible broken vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 9, 2016, an employee was processing clean dishes and putting them on a cart when she tripped and fell over a four-wheel dolly that was stored beneath a counter and protruded slightly beyond the edge of the counter. She fractured her right hip and right shoulder.
An employee was caulking while standing on a ladder when he fell, injuring his neck and ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking beside a 26 ft. electric scissor lift when his right foot slipped and was run over by the left wheel of the scissor lift. The employee was hospitalized for fractured bones in his foot.

An employee was removing a 700 lb. flange from the side of a winder coil of wire when the flange released and fell on the employee. The employee suffered a mild concussion, broken arm, and fractured L2 vertebra, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was tripping out rods on a servicing rig when his hand was caught above the rod transfer case near the swivel. His right arm was then caught and fractured on the rod transfer.
An employee was operating a power washer when the high-pressure water lacerated the employee's foot.

An employee was using propane to heat up a solenoid on a diesel pump when the underground pump turned on, resulting in diesel making contact with the propane heater. The diesel and propane ignited, burning the employee's arms.
An employee was struck by a water line that was being unloaded from a truck, suffering a fractured skull, broken ribs, and a cracked pelvis.

An employee was closing an overhead door when the rope he was using to pull the door closed broke, causing him to fall to the concrete ground and strike his head. He suffered a head laceration and concussion.
An employee was lowering a cable tray into the basement at the worksite when his left hand was caught in the rope, amputating his long and ring fingertips.
An employee was walking through the parking lot to report to work when he slipped on ice and fell on the sidewalk, breaking his right elbow and requiring hospitalization.

An employee had just come out of the restroom and was waiting by a stack of pallets. A coworker turned on his pallet jack and moved the handle, causing it to move in the wrong direction. The jack then hit the employee's left leg, breaking it above the ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee's hands were caught and lacerated in an ice milling machine.
An employee was using a 6-foot step ladder to retrieve a box from an upper shelf when he lost his balance and fell to the floor, breaking his left ankle and requiring surgery.

On 12/9/2016, at 7:50 p.m., an employee was pushing out a bar that fits into a metal core on a line winder. When he pushed the bar, his left index fingernail was caught on the core. As he pulled his finger back, his left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee went to sit down on her office chair and only caught the front edge falling and fracturing her left femur.
An employee was pushing a money cart when the employee began feeling unwell. The employee sat down and had chest pains, tingling in his arms, and shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized.

On 12/9/2016, at approximately 9:10 a.m., an employee was walking to a conference room for a meeting. As she exited the elevator, she slipped and fell on the wet tile floor, which was being mopped at the time. She suffered a fractured tailbone and a hematoma, requiring hospitalization.
While exiting the back of a truck trailer, an employee slipped on ice. The employee's index finger was then caught and fractured under the truck door.
An employee was observing the separation of a gear box when a hydraulic ram struck the left side of the employee's face, injuring it above and below the eye.
An employee was operating a horizontal boring mill when he stepped backwards and tripped over the tracks of the mill. He fell onto the concrete floor and fractured his hip, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting steak meat on a band saw when the saw cut his left thumb and index finger.

An employee was clearing compound material (resin) from the hopper above a jammed extruder machine when his fingers became pinched between the hopper and the extruder. His left index and middle fingers were amputated.

While unloading a trailer that contained donated goods, an employee made contact with the blade of a food processor that was inside a black garbage bag, requiring hospitalization for an arm laceration.

An employee was going to turn off an escalator after a cable was cut when the zipper on his pants caught on the lever. The lever swung around and bumped the employee who then fell onto a drainage culvert. He suffered a rib fracture and a bruised lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to restart a reject conveyor when his arm was caught in the conveyor and pulled between the conveyor and its frame. He suffered a fractured right arm and shoulder.
An employee was cutting a flat bar with an iron worker when the employee's finger was crushed and cut, suffering artery damage.

An employee was clearing a fault in the pallet picker when the push bar activated due to a solenoid valve failure and crushed his hand, causing a compound fracture to his left thumb that required hospitalization and surgery.
On Friday, December 9, 2016, an employee was helping a lift truck driver unload the truck when the truck driver backed up and drove over the employee's left foot, fracturing his big toe.
An employee on a second-floor balcony was pulling plastic over a scaffold when a guardrail gave way, allowing him to fall from the balcony.
An employee was moving rockers on the sales floor when her foot became stuck underneath a rocker, causing her to fall to the ground and fracture her hip. She required surgery.
An employee was inspecting for leaks on a small 5-foot roof that extended above the main roof. The employee bent over, became dizzy, and slipped off onto the main roof, fracturing a wrist and ribs.
An employee was servicing a heating system (boiler) when it pre-ignited during purging. A fire ball came out of the inspection door and burned the employee's right and left arms.

An employee was adjusting the rolls on a pellet mill and had to jog it when he noticed a burning smell in the firebox. He was attempting to remove a buildup in the pellet mill when his hand was crushed, injuring his left middle and ring fingers. His left ring finger was partially amputated up to the second knuckle.

An employee was working on the compressed air line for a vessel and connecting a 2-inch hose to a valve in a bilge in order to flush a new pipe. He then stepped on the valve, which opened and released air that knocked off his safety glasses and blew metal debris into his eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a customer at the counter when she tripped and fell, breaking her hip.

An employee was walking near two chillers and attempted to step over some standing water on the ground when he lost his balance. He went to reach for a pole or bar, but instead his left hand fell into a chain and sprocket assembly, amputating his left middle and index fingers. He was hospitalized and had surgery. The chillers were guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, suffering a fractured hip.
While riding in a utility all terrain vehicle (UTV), an employee's right arm was caught and fractured between the UTV and a tree.
An employee fell while carrying boxes down a flight of stairs, suffering contusions.
An employee was cleaning around her work station when she tripped on a cable cover and fell, fracturing her right knee and shin.

An employee was removing rust from a steel beam when the beam fell from a transfer table onto the employee's right foot, fracturing multiple toes. The employee was wearing steel-toed boots at the time.
On December 10, 2016, an employee's hand was pulled into a conveyor belt while attempting to remove stuck rubber, amputating three fingertips.
On December 10, 2016, at 9:30 a.m., an employee was removing shoring equipment when his right thumb tip was pinched and amputated between shoring and an I-beam.

An employee was standing near a frame assembly while a crane was bringing in steel. The crane bumped the frame assembly clamp, which then failed and allowed the frame to fall over and strike the employee. The employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee fell from a ladder while splicing lines between poles and was hospitalized due to a fractured lower right leg.
An employee was working on a water trailer pump that was under pressure. A part of the pump released and struck the employee in the lower leg causing a fracture.

An employee was working on a cable line from a ladder when a neighbor's cable line came loose, causing slack in the line that the employee was working on. The employee lost balance and fell from the ladder, suffering a concussion, vertebral fractures, and facial fractures.
An employee was troubleshooting a leak in an air blast muffler when the muffler sheared loose from the flange and struck the employee in the back.

An employee was operating a walkie rider outside the warehouse in the canopy area when the walkie slid into a canopy pole. The employee's right leg was caught between the pole and the walkie, causing a laceration and nerve/tissue damage to the employee's lower right calf. The employee was hospitalized.
The employee was using a chainsaw. When he set the chainsaw down he cut his knee with the chainsaw.
An employee was stocking freight when he felt faint and stopped to rest. He then collapsed and required hospitalization.
An employee was walking through aisles to restock the shelves of a department store when she slipped and fell, injuring her back and hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was carrying a backpack that had a handgun holstered inside it. The backpack was dropped from where it was perched. The handgun then went off and shot the employee in the stomach. He was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a wire metal container full of packages from the building out to the postal vehicle to load it for delivery. Her hands were placed on the outside corners of the wire container and as she pushed the equipment toward the parking lot, her left hand was caught between a metal support beam and the equipment. Her left pinky suffered a compound fracture that required surgery.
An employee was walking into work, slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot fracturing the left hip.
An employee tried to intervene during a fight in the parking lot and was stabbed in the rib cage.

An employee was emptying trash from a small collection unit (hopper) into a much larger collection unit (roll-off dumpster). This required the employee to stage the hopper up and over the roll-off dumpster with a forklift and then dismount the forklift to manually pull a mechanical lever that releases the hopper vault and dumps the hopper contents into the roll-off. The employee grabbed the releasing handle with his right hand and placed his left-hand fingers on the bottom cross-section of the hopper between the bottom of the forklift fork and the hopper frame. When he released the hopper vault, the hopper frame sprang suddenly and violently upwards until it stopped by the bottom of the fork and created a pinch point. The employee's left-hand ring, middle, and index fingertips were caught and amputated in the pinch point.
While inspecting a construction activity, an employee fell approximately 20 feet to a lower level and suffered a broken leg.
On December 12, 2016, an employee was using an oxygen/acetylene torch while working on a semi tractor when a piece of metal flew off and struck the employee's right upper leg.
An employee was trying to clean an overhead vent/filter with a broom when the 4-pound filter fell out and hit her head. She suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to unload a coil rolling machine from a trailer. As the main body of the machine was lifted by crane, it struck the machine consul. The consul then fell off the trailer and struck the employee's back and thighs. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was entering a submarine when he slipped on the deck and strained his knee, requiring hospitalization.
On 12/12/16, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was working on an assembly line and filling bags at the airlock bottom of a dust collector when four of her fingers were amputated.
An employee was walking between machines when his left foot was caught on a slip roll pedestal. He fell to the ground and fractured his right tibia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While cutting meat on a band saw, an employee's thumb tip was amputated by the blade.

A crew was putting together a slide rail-style protective system. In the process, the injured employee was positioned on the right-hand side of the retaining wall. While the crew was positioning the wall into the positioning slots, the wall jolted to the right-hand side and pinched the employee's hand between the retaining wall and the slide rail. His right pinky and middle fingers were lacerated.
An employee experienced a coughing fit and subsequently fell out of a chair, breaking two ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he struck a handrail, fracturing his left leg.
An employee suffered an asthma attack after being exposed to paint fumes.
An employee was closing the bulk-head door of a package car when his finger was caught in the door, amputating his right middle fingertip.

An employee was trying to strip an electrical cord but the strippers would not work on the cord, so he used a lighter to melt the insulation. The lighter ignited a gas leak and triggered an explosion, burning the employee's hands and face.
Two employees were injured when a flash fire occurred on a rig. One employee was hospitalized with second degree burns, while the second employee was hospitalized for observation.
An employee was taking garbage out to the trash dumpster when his right pinky finger was pinched in the hinged portion of the trash lid amputating his fingertip.
An employee was euthanizing pigs with a bolt gun when the gun shot the employee's left index finger, requiring surgical amputation at the middle phalanx.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor in the kitchen area of a fast food restaurant, hitting his head and dislocating his left knee.

An employee was attempting to restart a cooker's infeed screw. After locking out the equipment, he tried to pull the belts backward to get the screw motor to turn over. He then attempted to start the equipment. When the equipment started, the motor turned over and the belt caught his glove, causing his left index finger to contact the belt/pulley. His fingertip was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee and a coworker were rolling tubes with flanges on the ends when the employee's pinky finger was crushed and amputated under the flange.
While standing on a 6- to 8-foot ladder and pulling electrical wires through a conduit, an employee fell to the ground.

An employee was assisting a customer to unload a pickup truck. A pallet got stuck. The employee pulled to break the pallet free and fell backwards onto the ground. The employee suffered an L1 compression fracture.
An employee was walking down the stairwell and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee replaced a hydraulic cylinder in a packer press. Then the machine was cycled to test it. While observing the cylinder cycle to ensure there were no leaks, the employee's hand entered the machine and his right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was setting up concrete cylinder targets on a gun range. A forklift was pressing a metal plate against the cylinders to help position them tightly as the employee was using his hands to position them. His thumb was then caught between the metal plate and concrete cylinder, tearing some skin off his thumb tip and requiring surgical amputation.

An employee was setting/welding a door onto a truck. The door was being supported by a crane. After the door was welded and the support was removed, the door slid off from the truck and pinched the employee's right index fingertip, amputating it.

On December 12, 2016, at approximately 11:10 a.m., an employee was using a hand-operated pallet mover to retrieve a pallet from the bulk storage area. As she moved the machine backwards, her hand was caught between a steel upright and the handle of the machine, fracturing her right hand and right ring finger.

An employee was connecting a cable that had been looped around a pipe to hook the pipe onto an excavator bucket and lay it across the highway. As the excavator operator raised the boom, the employee's hand became caught between the cable and the hook, amputating his left index fingertip.

An employee was using a hose to wash crankcases with a cleaning solution when the hose nozzle came loose. The solution then pumped out and entered the employee's eyes and mouth. The employee was hospitalized with internal injuries.

An employee was unloading food from a tractor-trailer. He exited the trailer and proceeded down a ramp with a two-wheel dolly that was loaded with food product. He then lost his footing, fell forward on his knees, and rolled approximately 3 feet off the side of the ramp onto the ground. He ruptured the bilateral tendon in both knees.

An employee had been working on a telecommunication cable from a 28-foot extension ladder when a passing motorist found him unconscious on the ground. He was hospitalized for broken ribs, a concussion, and bleeding on the brain.
While cutting a 2 x 4 piece of wood with a miter saw, an employee suffered amputations of the index to ring fingers.
An employee was polishing the rotating shaft of a lathe with an emery cloth when his hair was caught in the lathe. He suffered scalping and a possible scapula fracture.
An employee was walking on a ramp and slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was putting bags on a 16-inch by 20-foot ductile iron pipe that was resting on the forks of a skid steer. The employee was standing in front of the open forks when the pipe rolled off and landed on and broke the employee's left leg and foot.

An employee was taking a tire off a tire balancing machine when his finger was pinched between the shaft of the tire balancing machine and the rim of the tire. His left index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was installing wires on an electrical box when a worker at the jobsite energized the box, which then burned the employee's right palm. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was removing rope from a pipe on a blast booth machine when the machine indexed to move the pipe. The employee's gloved hand became tangled in the rope, and the index fingertip was amputated between the pipe and the machine's roller.

On December 13, 2016, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was climbing an extension ladder to access the roof of a residence when he fell approximately 12 to 15 feet to the ground, fracturing his back. The top and bottom of the ladder were secure at the time of the incident.
While walking to a house to deliver the mail, an employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken left ankle.
On December 13, 2016, an employee was replacing some underground piping and removed a section of existing pipe. The existing pipe then shifted and pinned the employee's left forearm, injuring it.
An employee was trying to move product in a hopper when the blades amputated two fingers.
As an employee was rolling a 200-pound paper roll, another roll behind him became unstable and rolled onto his left leg, breaking it.
An employee was performing a demolition operation from an aerial lift when a suspended load struck the employee. The employee was knocked out of the lift and fell 14 feet, suffering a serious injury.
An employee suffered pneumonia, requiring hospitalization, after sealing tiles with a chemical sealer. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was trying to remove packages from a chute and was unable to remove one due to a closed dock door. The employee then opened a loading bay door believing a trailer was in the bay to be entered. The employee stepped off the dock bay surface and fell 46 inches, suffering a punctured lung and pelvic and rib fractures.

An employee was driving her forklift away from the battery charging area. She jogged the direction of the forklift slightly and was attempting to correct the direction when she lost control and her left foot went outside the forklift. Her foot then became pinned between a rack and the forklift.

While operating ground support equipment, an employee attempted to activate the door control button of a hanger door. The equipment then collided with the hanger door, which caused the employee's left forearm to be caught between the two objects. The employee's left forearm was swollen and severely bruised, requiring surgery.

An employee was walking around the back of a vehicle to use his ID to raise the employee entry gate when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground. He broke his right tibia and fibula as a result of the fall.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while exiting a car in the parking lot, breaking the left ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy walking surface in the parking lot, suffering a fractured left leg.

An employee was trying to free a piece of material that was stuck in a conveyor when his right hand was pulled into the conveyor, resulting in a broken radius and ulna. He was hospitalized. The conveyor was moving at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping to operate a scrap saw and was ensuring plastic would feed through it when a coworker activated the saw, severely cutting the employee's right arm. He required surgery. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.

Employees were moving steers from one pen to new pens. The steers were being moved through a gate opposite of the feed bunker into an alley to another pen. A group of steers was facing the employees and away from the gate. All of a sudden, one of the steers in that group put its head down and rammed an employee who was standing next to the water trough. The employee was driven backwards and into the bar of the feed bunker. The steer pushed the employee against the feed bunker with its head several times and then flipped him over into the feed bunker. The injured employee sustained multiple closed pelvic fractures with disruption of the pelvic ring. His left side/leg was also significantly affected.
An employee was cleaning a three-roll mill when his right hand was caught between the skirt and the rolls, cutting two tendons and requiring surgery.
An employee was stepping off the platform floor of a print shack when she tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing her left femur.

An employee was standing just outside the jobsite fence to direct a truck driver to the truck wash-out area inside the construction site when a driver struck the employee with a public vehicle, fracturing his left tibia.
At approximately 10:01, an employee entered a break room to obtain a locator badge when she slipped and fell near the sink. She injured her left knee and required surgery.
On 12/13/16, an employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw when the wood jumped and the employee's thumb was pulled into the blade. His left thumb was severely lacerated.
An employee was attacked by a resident, suffering head injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was building a bridge girder when his left middle finger was caught between the flange and a splice plate, amputating his left middle fingertip without bone loss.
An employee tripped on shoelaces and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee slid off a damp roof and fell approximately 9 feet to the ground, sustaining a broken ankle that required hospitalization.

An employee climbed up a column and tied his positioning hook onto a rubber cage. The hook did not fully engage on the plywood form and when he leaned back, the hook slid off. He fell backwards approximately 4 feet to the ground below, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a plate using a shim. The side planer was activated and the employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were lighting LP gas fryers in preparation for a catering event when a fire occurred and both employees were hospitalized with burns. The first employee suffered first degree burns to the face. The second employee suffered second degree burns to both forearms.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell fracturing their back.
An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot when he slipped on ice and tore his patellar tendon.
An employee ingested methanol and required hospitalization.

An employee was performing forklift/rigging operations (material handling) with a telescopic handler (telescoping forklift). While adjusting the forks on the handler, the employee's right index finger was caught in a pinch point between the adjustment box and the forks, lacerating and fracturing it. The finger was amputated down to the first knuckle.

An employee was helping to move a large heating/cooling piece of equipment when one of the panel doors fell off and struck his leg, contusing his thigh. His leg became swollen and required hospitalization.
An employee was crushed between an excavator and another piece of equipment, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was vacuuming mud at the bottom of a hill when the mud vacuum trailer rolled down the hill and hit him, pinning him next to a drilling unit. He suffered ankle, arm, and jaw injuries that required surgery.
On December 14, 2016, an employee was operating the vertical mill and removing shavings from the bit when the employee's right index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was nailing wooden boards against the rafters in an attic with an air-actuated framing nail gun when the recoil caused the gun to kick back. The gun hit the rafter behind him and then struck and penetrated the top of his left hand. The gun was in contact actuation mode at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a scissor lift to mount a machine that shoots clay pigeons from 20 feet in the air. The scissor lift would not lower all the way to the ground, so the he attempted to troubleshoot the problem. When he tried to grab a wire underneath the fold of the lift that may have been the problem, the lift came down on top of his left arm. He was hospitalized with nerve damage.
An employee was unloading small packages from a conveyor belt when his right thumb was caught and amputated between the belt and the roller.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fractured his left leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a cement mixer that was covered with a tarp due to extreme cold temperatures. The tarp covered the mixer's exhaust and trapped carbon monoxide vapors, which the employee inhaled.
An employee sustained severe burns from a temporary heater while working inside a mason's enclosure.

An employee was operating a horizontal bender machine to bend rebar. While he was adjusting the rebar for the second bend, his foot contacted the footswitch and activated the machine, which then crushed/amputated his right index finger.

An employee was using a hand grinder with a wire wheel to buff the side rail of a panel form when the wheel grabbed a piece of tie wire and whipped it around. The wheel hit and amputated his left middle fingertip.
While adjusting a dock plate, an employee lost balance and fell off the dock, suffering a left elbow fracture.

An employee was drilling and installing a pipe into a large concrete digester when the flare went out, creating additional pressure in the digester. The pressurized digester gas shot through the short section of 6-inch pipe, knocking the employee 5 feet off a scaffold to the concrete floor. The employee was exposed to hydrogen sulfide, stopped breathing, required CPR, and suffered a shoulder injury.
An employee was exiting a room and closing the door when the sliding door handle amputated the employee's right little fingertip.
While securing cages to a trailer, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift, suffering fractured ribs.

An employee used a foot step to climb on top of a 6-foot-tall mud tank to de-sand cones, which needed to be repositioned. When he attempted to reposition the cones using his hands, he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his collarbone and six ribs.
An employee was drilling a piece of metal with a magnetic drill when the bit bound, causing the drill base to spin and amputate the employee's left index fingertip.

While operating a stand-up forklift in a warehouse aisle, an employee was struck by a second forklift traveling in the same direction. The employee's left leg above the ankle was caught between the first forklift frame and the clamp of the second forklift.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when he collided with a coworker who was also operating a powered industrial truck. His left hand was caught between the two trucks as they collided, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from storage racks to the concrete floor, suffering broken ribs and a head injury.

An employee was operating a cartridge seal machine when the machine jogged, pinching her finger between the seal transfer and seal cutting die. Her left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An overhead garage door was stuck in the open position. An employee was standing on a bus to reach the overhead door and fell off the top of the bus to the ground. The employee fell approximately 10-12 feet and injured their wrist and hip.

An employee was using a water hose to help cool down a tank of molten zinc solution during the pumping transfer process when the water came into contact with acid/residue and a violent chemical reaction and explosion occurred. The water with molten acid solution blew into the employee's face and back as he turned to run, causing second degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was unloading his trailer on a snowy dock surface. When he went to lift the dock plate, he lost his balance and fell onto his right hip, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
On 12/14/16, an employee was operating a horizontal band saw when the blade moved unexpectedly, amputating the left ring fingertip and lacerating the left middle finger.
A dock plate fell on an employee's hand and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was using a 4-foot step ladder to re-install a small overhead door contact when he fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a concussion and serious head trauma.

On December 15, 2016, at approximately 1:00 PM, an employee was pulling boxes when she lost her balance and fell. As she was falling, she attempted to break her fall with her hand and suffered a broken wrist. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was setting up a die-cutter when it cycled and severely lacerated his right hand and amputated the index finger.
On December 15, 2016, an employee was operating a book binder cutter when the machine jammed. As he attempted to clear the jam, the blade came down and amputated his left ring finger's first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to hook up a ground heater to a truck, but the trailer wasn't hooking up properly. His finger was between the ball hitch and receiver when the trailer dropped onto the hitch, pinching his left ring finger. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was preparing to offload a compressor from a delivery truck and slipped on snow that had accumulated on the lift gate.  The employee fell into the bed of the truck and the compressor landed on and fractured his ankle.
An employee was moving a conveyor belt when it slipped and fell on his lower leg, breaking his right ankle.
On December 15, 2016, an employee's right thumb was pinched between metal and a jig as the employee was placing a steel part in the jig. The employee suffered a right thumb fracture.
An employee's pinky fingertip was amputated by a pulley.
An employee was walking into work in the parking lot between some cars when she slipped on the icy surface and fell, fracturing her leg/ankle.
While unloading supplies from a truck, an employee slipped on ice and broke an ankle.
On December 14, 2016, an employee fell in the snowy parking lot while on the sidewalk and was hospitalized for a broken hip.

An employee and a coworker were placing a cold case (refrigerator) into a counter when the coworker lost his grip, causing the employee to also lose his grip. The employee's right-hand pinky finger was caught between the cold case and the counter, amputating it at the first knuckle.

While walking during rounds, an employee stepped on a section of ground floor trench cover. The trench cover shifted, causing the employee to fall into the 2.5 feet deep trench and suffer a broken right leg.

An employee was terminating underground cables in a three-phase switching cabinet when an arc flash occurred, causing first and second degree burns to the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.

While driving a scissor lift to install a sprinkler system, an employee drove over a hole that had been covered by plywood. The wheel fell into the hole, causing the scissor lift to fall over. The employee fell with the lift and suffered an injury.
An employee was lifting a board from a pallet when his fingers were smashed between the board and pallet, amputating his right thumb tip and index fingertip.
An employee was delivering parcels when he slipped on black ice, breaking his lower right leg and right ankle in two places.
A temporary employee fell while descending a 6-foot ladder, fracturing the left hip.
An employee was dumping trash from a can into a hopper when a piece of debris struck and cut him above the eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move jersey barriers from a corner to clean up for a storm water inspection. A coworker was lifting the barrier with a skid steer that had forklift forks installed. One corner of the barrier was elevated on the forks approximately 10 inches high when the employee went over the barrier to move a tool that was in the way of where they were moving the barrier. When he was on the other side of the barrier, the concrete corner that was elevated broke off of the barrier. The barrier then fell sideways onto the employee, pinning him between the fallen barrier and the street curb and breaking his left leg.
An employee's left index finger was caught between a chain and a 1,500-pound part that was being lifted by an overhead crane, partially amputating the fingertip.

An employee was tracing a water pipe through a large warehouse with coworkers and climbed on top of an indoor office area to trace the line. The employee then fell through the roof/ceiling of the office, breaking an arm and suffering possible internal injuries.
An employee was unloading a coil from a forklift when the forklift pinched the employee's hand, crushing the right ring finger. The finger had to be amputated.
An employee stepped off the edge of a roof while dragging a roof sheet, falling to the next lower level and breaking ribs.
An employee was cleaning a cat run and was in the process of placing the cat back in the run when it bit the employee's right hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering an auto part when he slipped and fell on ice in the customer's parking lot, shattering a bone in his left lower leg.

An employee was operating a punch press when the employee's right hand got through the safety light curtain and activated the press. The press then amputated the employee's right index fingernail and half of the distal phalanx bone.
An employee was attempting to unjam a mixer when the machine amputated two of his fingers.
While walking into the post office, an employee slipped and fell on ice, fracturing her tibia.
An employee was clearing a jam on an assembly machine when the machine cycled and amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was trying to catch a feral cat in the store when the cat bit the employee's hand.
An employee was cleaning up debris and creating a drywall barrier. When he shifted the drywall, it fell on him, breaking his right tibia and fibula.
An employee's index finger was caught in the chain of a conveyor belt, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a stepladder and fell fracturing the right hip.
An employee was climbing a ladder while holding a garden hose nozzle when he slipped and fell onto nearby truck equipment, breaking two left-side ribs.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, suffering a broken ankle.
While installing purlins on a roof system, an employee fell 14 feet from the roof to the ground, cracking two vertebrae and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a rag to find the source of a leak on a tractor transmission when the rag became stuck in a flywheel and subsequently pulled the employee's hand into the flywheel. The employee suffered a right-hand laceration that required stitches.
An employee was participating in concrete stress testing operations. A stress cable retention chuck slipped causing the cable end to flip and puncture the employee's right hand and abdomen.
An employee was hit by a car while walking, breaking an ankle and requiring hospitalization.
While inserting stacking cones into the bottom of suspended shipping containers, an employee was struck by the rear wheels of a forward-moving empty hustler truck, suffering pelvic injuries.
An employee was discharging water from a truck drum when he slipped while standing at the exterior control. He fell and struck his jaw on a truck fender, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was sawing wood with a table saw when the blade amputated two fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee suffered a finger amputation.

An employee was feeding metal through a pneumatic metal saw when his glove was caught in the saw blade. His left hand was then pulled down and his left index finger and hand was severely lacerated by the saw blade, requiring surgery.
An employee fell on icy residential stairs while delivering mail, breaking the left ankle.
An employee was standing on an air line when a coworker yanked on the line, causing the employee to fall and land on a stack of metal bars. The employee fractured some ribs and was hospitalized.
While loading a mail truck, an employee slipped on a slick, icy parking lot, breaking an ankle.
An employee was removing wall flashing when he fell approximately 30 feet from the roof to the ground below, bruising his right-side ribs.
An employee was walking to her vehicle, slipped on ice and fell. She sustained an elbow injury that required surgery.

On December 16, 2016, an employee was inspecting a ball valve for correct assembly and testing it using air. When the air was applied, it caused the valve to close on and amputate his left index fingertip.
On December 16, 2016, an employee was mopping the floor when she twisted her torso and injured her back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting meat with a saw and amputated his right thumb tip.
An employee was attempting to remove poly film lid debris from a filling machine when the employee's right thumb was caught and amputated in the machine.

An employee had just installed a windshield in a vehicle and was putting his tool away. He attempted to use the handle of a scraper to push a plastic clip into the cowl when the handle of the scraper, which had a razor blade attached to it, slipped off and cut his left thumb tendon, requiring surgery.

An employee was lying on a floor dolly on his back underneath a newly fabricated bin weighing approximately 1,000 lbs. The bin was supported on all four corners by 6-foot-long metal saw horses. The employee was painting the underside of the bin using a spray gun. When he attempted to scoot the dolly along the floor, his foot pushed against one of the saw horses, causing it to move. The saw horse pivoted out from under the bin, which then tipped and fell on the employee, breaking his arm.
On 12/17/16, an employee was adjusting a frozen mirror when the mirror snapped and lacerated the employee's right hand, requiring surgery.
An employee was getting out of her vehicle to pick up a piece of mail that had fallen when she slipped on ice, breaking her left ankle and left leg. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

On December 17, 2016, an employee was attempting to clear a jam during a plastic grinding process when the airlock's rotating mechanical paddle wheel caught the employee's hand. The employee's left middle and ring fingers were amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee volunteered to help a duty crew repair a downed power pole. The powerline was grounded and open during pole erection and rehanging of the wire. The employee went to energize the transformer and measure the stinger when he contacted the energized wire, sustaining burns to both hands and a dislocated shoulder. He was hospitalized and required surgery. Gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was working outside around a stationary pipe when his lower left leg contacted the pipe, breaking his shin bone.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk and slipped on ice and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a head contusion.
While exiting a security vehicle, an employee slipped on ice and hit the right knee and arm on the pavement. The employee suffered abdominal pain, vomiting, and a headache.
On December 17, 2016, an employee was walking to deliver a parcel to a residential home when he slipped on an icy driveway and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor well when the cuff of the employee's coat became caught on the conveyor and pulled the employee's right arm into the sprocket, fracturing it. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was driving a loader during a concrete mixing process. While he was dumping the loader bucket on top of a bin, some frozen pieces would not go through the bin's grate. He climbed a ladder to retrieve the pieces. He then slipped off the bin and fell 10 feet to the ground, injuring his ankle.
An employee was operating a boring bar when the drawstring on his hooded sweatshirt became caught on the spindle. The boring bar then fractured his arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking from the parking lot to the facility when she slipped and fell on ice, breaking her hip.
On December 17, 2016, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was jogging a machine while attempting to adjust a poly wrapper when a plate came down and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, suffering a concussion and a fractured shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to set up a trench box when the box shifted and his knee was caught on a spreader bar. His foot was then compressed to his heel in the storm culvert.
An employee was manually turning the gears to a slitter machine that had just been cleaned when his right middle and ring fingers were caught in the gears, pinching and amputating the fingertips.
An employee was changing the motor on a machine when the motor slipped and amputated his left index finger.
An employee was inspecting a hotel room when her right-hand pinky finger was caught in a closing door, lacerating her finger and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while bringing dirty dishes to the dish tank area, injuring the left leg and hip.
An employee was working in the laundry area when the industrial ironer caught on fire due to a faulty belt. The employee was hospitalized for smoke inhalation.

An employee was cleaning a card machine's rollers. When the employee removed the roller belt, the rollers moved and pulled the employee's left arm between two rollers. The employee suffered a left forearm avulsion and partial amputation of the left pinky and forefinger.
An employee was working on the press. When he knelt down to check the scrap conveyor belt, his right index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket. The fingertip was later amputated.
An employee was placing trash in a trash compactor outside the back of the store when the sharp metal edge of the compactor avulsed his right middle finger. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
While exiting a car, an employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, fracturing the left hip.

On 12/18/16, an employee was walking up the basement steps while carrying a few packages of frozen meat when she missed the top step, lost her balance, and fell. When she attempted to brace herself from the fall, her right hand went though the lower tier window of the back door, severely lacerating her right wrist.

On December 18, 2016, an employee fell off a bolted 30-foot ladder while trying to cover a hole on top of the burr house cyclone. He hit his head on the ladder rail and injured his spine during the fall to the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was monitoring the production line when he saw that a board on the line was not straight. As he attempted to straighten the board, his left ring finger was caught between the board and a flapper, amputating it just below the fingernail.

An employee was preparing to mix batter in a commercial mixer. When the machine started, the bowl started to move out of the frame. The employee attempted to catch the bowl and his hand was caught between the frame and the bowl, pinching and amputating a finger.
An employee was throwing bales of hay over a fence when he slipped and fell on the frozen ground, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped on small pieces of candy and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with head and wrist injuries.

An employee was driving a tractor trailer on the highway when she encountered icy road conditions. The tractor trailer made contact with a pole on the side of the road. The employee pulled off of the highway and into a parking lot. She stepped out of the vehicle to check for damage. While outside of the vehicle, she slipped and fell on the ice, breaking two bones in her back.

An employee had been outside shoveling ice and snow from the walkway. When he entered the restaurant, he slipped and fell on the floor of the lobby, fracturing his right hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working with students to complete their models in the fabrication laboratory when the CNC router room caught fire. The employee suffered smoke inhalation injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving from a ladder onto a pile of slag when he fell into the slag and broke his left leg.
A spark from an unknown source caught an employee's shirt on fire. The employee suffered burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was lashing and securing military cargo. A nearby Bradley Fighting Vehicle (BFV) operator was backing up a Bradley when she pulled the throttle instead of the fuel shut-off. The Bradley then hit a second Bradley and pinned the employee between the Bradley and the wall. The employee suffered two broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee became dizzy and slipped on ice in the terminal lot, suffering a hip injury and requiring hospitalization.
On December 19, 2016, an employee was delivering a parcel when he slipped on ice and fell, striking his head on the ground. He suffered a brain hemorrhage and was hospitalized.

An employee was demolishing old railroad tracks and moving rails from the track. He was attempting to hook the rail dog machine up on to the old rails that were lying on top of some old cross ties when the rail slid off the top of the cross ties and fell on and fractured his right foot.

An employee was moving from one steel girder to another when his foot became caught on a beam. He lost his footing and fell 14 feet, 10 inches to the ground below, breaking his right knee and lacerating his chin.
An employee was pushing a dryer rack cart when his left hand was caught between two carts, amputating the tip of the third digit on his left hand.

On December 19, 2016, at approximately 2:55 p.m., an employee opened the 600 amp of an electrical air switch using the handle on the outside of the switch cabinet. He raised the bottom of this barrier to slide it into a slot designated to hold it in place between the two electrical contacts on the air switch. As the barrier was being slid into place, an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to his face that required hospitalization.

An employee was stepping down a ladder while restocking shelves when he missed a step. He reached out to catch himself by grabbing the shelving and his left ring finger was caught and amputated in the grid of the shelf.

An employee was standing next to his vehicle when a runaway truck rolled down a hill and pinned him between the two vehicles. He suffered fractures.
An employee fell 20 feet from a roof resulting in broken ribs, a bruised kidney, and fluid in the lungs.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk while delivering mail, suffering a compound ankle fracture.

A temporary employee was operating the protein mixer when the extruder stopped extruding. The mixer was running at the time of the incident.

A trailer sub-frame assembly was sitting on three jack stands and an employee was using two bottle jacks to raise the axles so he could install the wheels. The trailer became unstable and shifted, causing the assembly to fall on and break the employee's femur.

An employee was walking out to the parking lot when he stepped off a curb onto the asphalt, slipped on black ice, fell backwards, and struck the back of his head on the curb. He suffered a head laceration and brain hemorrhage.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he lost control while going down a sloped area. The forklift tipped over and his left foot was caught between the forklift and the curb, smashing his second toe, which had to be surgically amputated.
An employee exited her vehicle, walked across the parking lot, slipped on ice, and fell onto the ground. She struck her head on the pavement and lost consciousness.

On December 19, 2016, at 7:45 p.m., an employee was operating an electric forklift in the freezer to go pick an order when the employee struck a storage rack upright. The employee's right foot was caught between the forklift and the rack, resulting in lacerations that required stitches and two broken toes. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell 4 feet off the loading dock while bending over to pick up a box, suffering left wrist and right ankle pain.

An employee was troubleshooting a product non-conformance. While doing so, the employee suspected that the machine (tapering mill) had been set up or repaired incorrectly. After turning off the work cell, which this machine is a part of, the employee entered the work cell to verify the machine was set up correctly. The employee was attempting to adjust the machine's tapering rollers when four left-hand fingers were caught and fractured in between the rollers.
An employee was mooring a vessel when the employee's right ring finger was caught between the mooring line and a metal cleat, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was felling a declining ash tree. When the tree came over, it became hung up on a smaller oak tree, lifting the butt of the ash tree in the air. The butt of the tree then came down on the employee who sustained a broken right fibula.
An employee was feeding paper through various rollers on a paper converting machine when his left index fingertip was caught and amputated in an ingoing roller nip.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when the saw amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was loading produce into the trailer. As the employee was closing the trailer door his finger got caught on the latch used to lock the door in place.  The employee's right index fingertip was amputated to the base of the nail. The employee was wearing gloves at the time.
An employee was plugging in a grinder to remove a metal piece from the floor. When he placed the plug into the socket, he was shocked and thrown back about 3 feet.
An employee was rigging a load that was on a forklift when the forks lowered and struck his left foot, fracturing it.
An employee was taking trash out of a construction trailer when he tripped and fell to the ground, spraining his left shoulder.

An employee was attempting to repair a small portable pneumatic barrel pump that appeared to be frozen. The employee had his left ring finger inside the pump plunger when it activated, amputating his left ring finger.
An employee was injured after slipping and falling in a room.
An employee fell while walking into an office.

Employees were cleaning up the warehouse area when a bundle of boards fell onto an employee striking their head. Two hours later the injured employee suffered stroke-like symptoms and was hospitalized.
An employee started the truck while standing on the side step. The truck was in gear. The employee fell and the truck ran over his leg fracturing the fibula.
An employee was removing dunnage from under a rig when the right index finger was caught between the dunnage and the stem of the jack resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee fell from a height of 31 inches while attempting to connect an unloading hose to the back of a truck. The employee tripped and attempted to catch himself by taking a step back resulting in the fall. The employee's right tibia and fibula were fractured.
An employee was loading a trailer with freight when an unsecured axle tipped over and landed on the employee's right foot, breaking the big toe and lacerating three other toes.

A forklift was lifting a double stack of trailer fenders when the top pallet of the stack fell onto the forklift. The pallet broke and trailer fenders fell onto the injured employee, who was standing nearby supervising the operation. The employee sustained a broken nose and two broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unbolting a storage tank when he stepped on a 3-foot segment of a grated platform that was not secured. He then fell 15 feet to the concrete floor below, breaking his left hip and requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was fabricating pipe and components on a jig at a client location when the components rolled off the jig and landed on his waist and right leg. He suffered internal injuries to the abdomen and trauma to the right leg.
An employee's forearm was caught in a mixer.
An employee was operating a jelly cup packing machine when it became energized. The employee's left index finger then contacted a moving part, amputating the distal tip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a grain bin auger and amputated the right thumb and index finger.
An employee was resting their right hand on a test stand when a piece of the test (shielding) equipment fell onto the employee's hand resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring fingertip.

An employee was cleaning steel by hand file and grinder and began experiencing shortness of breath and tightness in the chest. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack.

An employee was loading a hydraulic hammer into the back of a truck when he lost his footing and control of the hammer. It then rolled back and caught his hand between the hammer and the bucket of the tractor, amputating his left ring finger.

On December 20, 2016, at approximately 3:30 p.m., an employee was cubing meat in a tenderizer when the meat became stuck. While she attempted to remove the meat from the tenderizer, the rollers caught the glove of her left hand and pulled her index and middle fingers into the tenderizer, fracturing both.
An employee was responding to a patient's call, tripped over the call light cord, and fell fracturing the left hip.
On December 20, 2016, an employee was placing a pallet when his forklift ran out of fuel. He had dismounted the forklift when a coworker on a forklift backed over his left foot, breaking two toes.
An employee was struck by a forklift while unloading freight, injuring the right ankle.

An employee was attempting to hook the tongue of a baggage cart to the hook on a tug vehicle when the tug driver's foot slipped off the brake pedal and onto the gas pedal. The tug was in reverse and moved backwards, hitting the employee and pinning him between the vehicle and the baggage cart. He suffered a severe fracture to his left leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was working in the anodize department when an anodize color power supply unit transformer malfunctioned, causing a small amount of smoke to rise and settle in the rafters. The employee suffered respiratory illness and was hospitalized.
An employee was making adjustments to a chain conveyor with a come-along when the chain slipped and caught the employee's left hand, amputating the middle fingertip at the nailbed.
On 12/20/16, at approximately 8:15 p.m., an employee was processing wood into trusses on a final press machine when the machine smashed his finger. His finger was medically amputated.

On December 20, 2016, at approximately 8:30 PM, an employee was stopped for a routine inspection. As he was trying to get back in the truck, he fell backwards off the step of the truck and broke his ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was working on a boom cylinder to install a locking pin when the pin came out. The employee's left hand was then pinched between the boom and the support stand. The employee suffered a broken left-hand and laceration.

An employee was picking up spilled garbage on the ground when the garbage truck backed up and struck him. He fell to the ground and the truck ran over the tip of his left foot. He suffered bruises to the left leg and foot.

An employee was fixing a lock on a pallet in an airport trailer when he lost his balance and fell backward approximately 5 feet onto the concrete floor. He suffered a head injury and broken neck, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to set up a scaffold when a piece of clay tile/ceiling debris fell from the ceiling and struck the employee's lower back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking past a pallet when a 50-pound bag fell and struck the employee's shoulder and heel.
An employee was driving a forklift when his foot was pinched between two forklifts, amputating two left toes.

An employee was transferring small packages of material from a conveyor to a cart when his foot was caught on the corner of a nearby pallet. He tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing his right arm and elbow.

An employee was changing the dust collection drum on a CNC router when the dust collection system's airlock amputated his right index finger at the middle phalange. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a hand grinder to fabricate a piece of metal when the disk exploded and lacerated his face, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood for cabinets when the blade partially amputated the employee's right index finger. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was troubleshooting a UV chamber to see if there were bulbs installed when something in the chamber burst and contacted the employee's face. The employee lost the right eye.

An employee was using a crane to load steel for a furnace. When the employee unhooked the lifting device from the steel, the hook on the chain caught on the steel. Before the employee could stop the crane, the hook, under tension, came free and struck the employee's jaw, fracturing it.

An employee was rolling a driveway using a compact roller (equipped with a rollover protective system and canopy) when he drove into a tree limb. His right pinky finger was caught and amputated on the tree limb.
An employee was installing windows from a scaffold when the scaffolding collapsed. The employee then fell approximately 12 feet, suffering broken ribs and fingers.

An employee and a coworker were working at a machine press to bend metal parts. The employee was placing metal pieces while the coworker operated the machine. The coworker cycled the machine while the employee's fingers were still under it, smashing and fracturing them. The employee's fingers later had to be amputated.
An employee on a production line was installing a chassis bumper when the chassis from down the line pinned him between the two chassis, crushing his back.

On Wednesday, December 21, 2016, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee was operating tube-straightening process equipment when a tube stopped in the process. He placed his left hand on the tube.
