As he did, the tube began rotating again. The motion caught the employee's left forearm, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was tearing down a side boom. While pulling the slack out of the load line, the employee's right hand was pulled into the guidewheels of the equipment, amputating the ring finger and partially amputating the middle and pinky fingers.

An employee was on the flatbed of a tree transport truck moving hoses. He was grabbing a loose tree bar when he fell backwards off the truck. The tree bar also fell on top of him and struck his abdomen, causing serious internal injuries that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was using a hand held grinder with a 5-6 inch blade to grind a granite countertop. The grinder kicked back and the back end of the grinder struck the employee in the mouth. While trying to regain control of the grinder, the grinder blade lacerated his left bicep requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was helping to unload a truck and was moving out of the way of a pallet jack when he fell, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was delivering a package to a residence, slipped on ice in the driveway, and fell fracturing the left hip.
An employee was loading and unloading trucks on a loading dock when he was struck by a reversing forklift, suffering contusions and edema.

During rigging down of a drilling rig, two employees attempted to lift/move an I-beam by hand. The I-beam shifted and crushed one of the employee's right middle finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip/print pad.

A temporary employee was mixing dough when he noticed dough stuck on a rod at an adjacent machine. He was attempting to clear out the dough when a moving part pinched and amputated his right ring fingertip between the part and the rod.

An employee was placing cardboard into the empty corrugate conveyor. The pick knife the employee was using contacted an exposed area between the plug and the outlet. The employee was shocked and suffered an electrical burn on the wrist.

An employee was trying to manually fit a side panel for a livestock trailer when his finger was pinched between the side panel sheets causing a 1 cm amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee suffered a severe right hand and arm injury while using a woodworking machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing gutters and fell 12 feet through a skylight. The employee suffered a skull fracture, fractured vertebrae, a fractured wrist and a fractured pelvis and tailbone.

An employee was walking down an aisle in a warehouse. At the same time, a coworker was operating a forklift in the opposite aisle. The forklift pushed some items, causing them to fall from a shelf and strike the employee. He was hospitalized with a compound fracture to his right leg, six cracked right-side ribs, a fractured pelvis, and three broken vertebrae.
An employee was moving around the office on a rolling chair when she fell off the chair and fractured her right hip.
An employee was walking to his car to retrieve work equipment when he fell on ice in the parking lot, fracturing three bones in his back.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor, breaking her kneecap.
An employee was heating a paint spray can with a heat gun when the can blew up, burning his hands, wrists, neck, and face.
An employee was roofing when he stepped backwards and his heel struck a skylight cover. He then lost his balance and fell 25 to 30 feet through the acrylic cover to the concrete ground below.
An employee was burned while working with refrigerant.

On December 21, 2016, an employee was installing cable on a vehicle lift when an arm of the lift fell on his left hand causing crushing injuries and broken fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgeries to the hand.
An employee was operating a utility task vehicle (UTV) and drove off a bunker. The UTV fell five feet and rolled over. The employee suffered a broken right leg that required surgery.
An employee collapsed while loading the meat case and was hospitalized for a possible heart attack.
While rolling a tank, the tank fell from the platform and the employee fell with it resulting in a lower back strain and hand lacerations.
An employee was coming down a ladder, slipped, and fell fracturing an ankle.

An associate was at the register when another associate came to take something out of the drawer. He stepped back and hit the drawer that had been opened, causing a chain reaction. He stumbled and bumped into the associate who had opened the drawer and then she stumbled and fell into the injured employee, causing her to fall onto the floor fracturing the right hip.
An employee was hospitalized after falling from a roof on 12/22/2016.

An employee was retrieving a box of clothing from the mezzanine above the maintenance area when she stumbled and fell down the last 3-4 stairs of the wooden stairway. The employee's left ankle was broken in two places.
An employee was sweeping the floor with a broom, lost her balance, and fell fracturing the left hip.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell fracturing a knee cap.
An employee fell from a step ladder resulting in fractured ribs and an ear laceration.

On December 22, 2016, at approximately 6:25 a.m., an employee was making adjustments to the GN machine 3030-7 contact heater when his hand slipped down into the cutting knife resulting in the amputation of the right index finger at the first knuckle.
On December 22, 2016, at approximately 7:30 AM, the employee was lubricating a moving conveyor when her finger got caught in the conveyor resulting in a partial amputation.
While loading a ham cart onto a truck, the cart fell off the lift gate and struck the employee resulting in a broken leg.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk while delivering mail resulting in a knee fracture.
A temporary employee was operating a forklift while carrying a nylon sling outside of the cab. The sling got caught under the rear tire of the forklift resulting in a left arm amputation.
An employee was cutting a pipe using a clamshell pipe cutter and amputated the left index finger.
An employee was unloading paper products from a cargo ship. The employee's finger was crushed between two rolls of paper resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee slipped on loose cardboard and plastic and fell in the driveway of a customer's residence during delivery. The employee suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was operating a table saw and cut his right index finger resulting in amputation of the finger at the knuckle.
An employee was performing maintenance work using a grinder when their left thumb contacted the grinding wheel resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee's left arm was caught in the printing press resulting in tearing of the skin that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was standing on top of a mechanical power press. When the machine cycled, the employee's foot was caught in the press resulting in an injury that required 17 stitches.
An employee was loading/unloading steel I beams when a steel I beam slipped off the crane hook and amputated two of the employee's toes.
An employee was retrieving a knife that had fallen into a hopper. The machine was turned on while the employee's hand was in the screw auger area and two fingers were amputated.

An employee was cleaning out a gate valve while on a scissor lift about 15 feet in the air. As the employee opened the inspection door on the valve, hot ash dislodged and landed on the lift's control panel. The hot ash on the control panel made it impossible to lower the lift. The employee manually lowered himself from the lift and fell on his back.

An employee was standing on his flatbed trailer unstrapping an outrigger when it shifted and fell on him. The employee was knocked to the ground and the outrigger (600 lbs. of steel) fell on him resulting in a laceration to the right wrist and a puncture wound to the right leg.
An employee was onsite water-well drilling and was caught between the drill stem and the truck resulting in a fractured left arm requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was working on forms for a concrete pour and fell seven feet to the deck below fracturing their pelvis and shoulder. The employee was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was trimming a tree branch. While the tree branch was being re-positioned, the branch kicked back and struck the employee in the leg resulting in a leg fracture.

On December 22, 2016, at 11:00 a.m. an employee was manually moving a snow plow blade on a parked forklift and caught his finger under the blade and between a fork on the forklift resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot resulting in three fractures to the lower right leg and ankle.
A temporary employee was operating a stone splitter and amputated a finger at the first joint.

An employee was removing fasteners from an MDF board on a shelving display while standing on a four foot step ladder. A piece of MDF board struck the employee and the employee fell sustaining a broken pelvis and a right shoulder contusion.
On December 22, 2016, at 11:30 am, an employee was bagging product and suffered a left index finger amputation.
On December 22, 2016, an employee injured his right forearm when a piece of glass he was carrying broke. The employee was hospitalized and needed surgery to repair the laceration.
An employee was operating a mechanical hydraulic press and cut the tip of his left hand middle finger at the point of operation. The tip was surgically amputated the following day.
An employee was cleaning up a hazmat spill when some of the dust got under his mask burning his mouth and throat.
An employee suffered a ruptured/fractured vertebrae while assisting a patient.

Two employees were repairing a sofa. The injured employee's finger got caught between the springs and when the second employee pulled the springs the injured employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was manually bending sheet metal and suffered a heart attack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail and fell fracturing a hip that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was descending a stepladder, missed the last step, and fell resulting in a broken wrist.
An employee was walking in the aisle, turned a corner and was struck by an electronic shopping cart driven by a customer. The employee sustained a broken hip.
While working around a cardboard baler, an employee tripped over plastic that was wrapped around a pallet prepared for the baler and fell fracturing the pelvic bone.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack, turned a corner and lost control of the pallet jack. The employee sustained bruising after being pinned between the pallet jack and the warehouse rack.
An employee was on a horse and a cow/steer got under the horse causing the employee to fall onto and then over a fence.  The employee's left humerus was fractured.
On December 23, 2016, an employee slipped and fell in the parking lot fracturing a hip that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was carrying a case of product from a trailer into the store and stepped into a gap near a scissor lift causing the right foot to roll fracturing the ankle.
An employee's right arm was amputated while he was operating an edge grinder machine.
An employee slipped on black ice and fell while walking on the sidewalk fracturing her lower leg while performing parking attendant duties.
On December 23, 2016, an employee was walking from the break room to a material handler when he stepped on a nail that punctured his shoe. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee climbed boxes to retrieve orders and fell 5 to 6 feet resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was injured while advancing a pallet of hollow core doors on a conveyor to the door unit assembly machine. The employee's foot slipped between conveyor rollers causing an ankle injury.
An employee was operating a router and crushed three fingers in the machine. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

On November 30, 2016, an employee was working on the magna vc line and received a crushing injury when a finger was pinched between the slide and the part that was being repaired. On December 23, 2016, the right index finger was amputated.
An employee was making adjustments to a machine when the roller mechanism came down and struck his thumb fracturing it.
An employee was operating a forklift and collided with another forklift traveling in the same direction resulting in amputation of a toe on the right foot.
An employee was using a pallet jack to select product and pinned his hand between the jack handle and the rack. Surgery was performed on the employee's left pinky finger to repair a cut tendon.
An employee was drilling a water well when their left arm was caught between the truck and drill stem and fractured.
An employee was painting a house. The employee exited the scaffolding onto the roof and then fell approximately 12 feet. The employee sustained a fractured L1 vertebra and left arm.

An employee was setting culverts along a highway. After a culvert was in place, the employee slipped on the embankment. The employee grabbed the rim of the culvert to catch his fall and lacerated three fingers on the left hand.
An employee was troubleshooting a hydraulic power press and suffered the amputation of the right and left middle fingers above the first knuckle.
A temporary employee was operating a forklift and crushed their foot between a pole and the forklift.

The employee was walking into work from the parking lot when a customer was driving their vehicle away from pump #9 and the hood of their vehicle struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg and torso injuries.
An employee was performing maintenance on a pasteurizer when the CIP mechanism initiated causing first and second degree burns to the employee's arms and side.
An employee was walking to her car in the parking lot, tripped over a concrete parking block and fell breaking the right arm.

Shortly after midnight, two suspects attempted to gain access into the store. The suspects tried the front door and drive through, but those access points were locked. The suspects fired through the glass into the store striking an employee in the back under the arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking on an alarm, tripped on steps to the pharmacy door, and fell breaking his leg in two places.

An employee was making rounds when the employee walked into a sulfuric acid spray that was coming from a pin hole leak from a V-1038's sludge trap. The employee sustained second and third degree burns to the neck and face.
While performing avalanche hazard reduction, an employee fell and tumbled in steep terrain. The employee sustained a fractured right knee, left shoulder and a rib.
On 12/25/16 at approximately 11:30 AM, an employee sustained first degree burns to the forearms and right hand while troubleshooting an energized pneumatic document tube system's panelboard.
An employee was clearing a plug in a rotary feeder at the base of the bag filter and amputated four fingers on the left hand.

While rewiring equipment on top of a larger cooler, an employee walked from one cooler to another and tripped, falling forward, then off the cooler and onto the ground approximately 8 feet below. The employee sustained facial lacerations and three herniated discs in the neck.
On 12/26/16, an employee was bending rebar with a machine. The employee sustained a hand injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing a tree from a downed power line. The tree struck the employee in the head causing a skull fracture.
An employee was slicing a tomato using the meat/cheese slicer and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was moving a piece of iron on the bed of an iron truck, when he lost his balance, slipped, and caught his finger between the piece of iron he was handling and part of the iron flatbed truck. The left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a baker scaffold 5 to 6 feet high when he fell off of the scaffolding and broke a leg and cheek bone.
On December 26, 2016, an employee was hospitalized for surgery on his dislocated left foot when he was stuck by a customer vehicle in the parking lot.

On December 26, 2016, two employees were moving a 90 inch metal reel using a forklift and a 4 X 4 wooden block. The reel spun and pinned the injured employee between the reel and the support beam resulting in a fractured rib and vertebrae and a collapsed lung.
An employee was delivering food to a residence and was robbed at gun point by an unknown person. The employee suffered two gunshot wounds to the face and head.
An employee caught a falling diamond shape glass placard with her hand and suffered a deep laceration on her hand caused by the edges of the placard. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a PIT resulting in broken bones.

An employee was cleaning radishes. The employee slipped on the wet platform floor and fell three feet striking a pipe. The employee sustained an injury to the right side of the chest that may require surgery.
An employee was sweeping outside in front of the hotel when the rotating door struck the employee's shoulder causing the employee to fall and break the left wrist.
An employee was loading an empty coil tubing reel onto a trailer using a crane. The reel fell off the trailer and struck the employee breaking the tibia and fibula.
A patient became aggressive and physically struck an employee multiple times. The employee suffered multiple bruises, a bloody nose, and a bruised kidney.
Two employees received burns to their arms, hands and face while working in the shop area when the facility caught fire.

An employee was dumping scrap granite using a forklift. The employee placed his hand on the forks while pulling the lever to dump the bucket. The employee's left pinky finger was caught between the bucket and the fork resulting in amputation.
An employee was cleaning inside a manhole when he was hit by a car. He suffered a broken left shoulder.
An employee was feeding rebar into a radius machine when his glove became caught on the guard. His right hand was then pulled into the point of operation, crushing and breaking it.
An employee was disassembling a press machine. The gear under the press shifted and the screw driver the employee was using went through his right hand.
An employee was preparing to move a 55-gallon oil drum when he suffered an abdominal hernia.
An employee was moving a metal egg buggy when his right foot was caught between the buggy and another buggy. As he tried to remove his foot, the tendon in his right heel was cut and required surgery.
An employee was operating a gate cutter when his left middle and ring fingers became crushed/pinched between the gate and the gate cutter.
An employee was taking equipment out to a storage corral when she slipped on ice and broke her ankle.
An employee's left thumb was partially amputated when it got caught between a beam and the hook of the overhead crane used to lift the beam.

An employee was using a table saw to rip small pieces of 2x4 for a form when his left index finger contacted the running blade, amputating the first knuckle. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped on ice outside the front of the building while walking into work, fracturing a leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a tube winder and amputated three fingers on the left hand.
An employee was walking from the tractor to his truck to get a wrench when he slipped on ice and fell hitting his head on the ground.
An employee was shutting down an air handler and using a screwdriver to slow the belt down when his left fourth fingertip was caught and amputated in the belt.
An employee was walking down a set of stairs and fell, striking his face on a pipe on the landing. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones in the face and head.

An employee was walking alongside a forklift moving decking. He was wearing a harness because he would eventually have to go up to an elevated position. The lanyard from the harness became caught on a pipe, causing the employee to fall, which then caused the load to shift. Decking sheets then pinned the employee's left hand between a column and the sheets, injuring his ring finger.
An employee was removing a thermometer from a thermal well when hot liquid from the thermal well leaked out and sprayed the employee, causing thermal burns.

On December 27, 2016, at approximately 10:50 p.m., an employee was changing the shackles on an evisceration line when his right thumb was amputated by the line. The shackle line was not turned off at the time of the incident.

An employee was setting up tools on a CNC machine. He had commanded a tool change when he noticed the coolant line was in the path of the tool changer. When he attempted to move the coolant line, the tool changer went into motion. His right index fingertip was then amputated between the tool and the changer (no bone loss).
An employee was cleaning up water that had leaked from the dishwasher. She slipped and fell breaking her knee cap.
A temporary employee was cleaning the mixer with salt and fell into the mixer. The mixer actuated and the employee was injured.

An employee was loading soil into a truck when he noticed debris on top of the truck that was hindering the tarp from covering the load. He climbed a fixed ladder and was clearing the debris when he fell 10 feet to the ground below, fracturing his vertebrae.
An employee was hospitalized due to slip and fall conditions.
An employee was laying metal decking and fell approximately 15 feet. The employee suffered a fractured left hip and fractures to both arms, the jaw and cheekbones.

An employee had just finished lifting a shale bin using two loaders (one with a stinger, chain, and lifting equipment) in order to place matting underneath. Once the matting was in place, the employee directed the loader to lower the bin until there was enough slack in the lifting chain to remove it. As the employee grabbed the eye of the lifting chain to unhook it, the operator of the loader bumped the controls with his knee, causing the chain to tighten and pinch the employee's right middle finger between the bin and the chain. The employee's right middle finger was amputated between the middle and upper joint, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working at his station when his right foot was run over by a forklift in reverse. He was hospitalized with a broken right foot.

An employee locked a machine out, opened the panel door, and was reattaching a wire nut onto a conduit when his hand touched a live wire. He was shocked and suffered a burn on his hand, requiring hospitalization. Although the machine was de-energized at the time of the incident, power was still coming into it through a box at the top of the machine.
An employee was taking the trash out to the dumpster when he fell approximately 4 feet off the dock and broke both his legs.
An employee sustained an arc flash burn while performing electrical work on equipment, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a handheld skill saw when the employee's glove was caught in the blade. The employee's left ring finger was then amputated up to the first knuckle.

An employee was feeding film into a wrapping machine when her hand contacted the machine, amputating approximately three-quarters of three left-hand fingers. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a right-hand middle finger amputation while cleaning a lint filter.
An employee slipped and fell on a patch of ice in the parking lot.

An employee was moving a pressure washer from one section of scaffolding to another section when the weight of the pressure washer on the end of the scaffold caused it to tip over. The employee fell to the ground and fractured his vertebrae.
An employee on a ladder fell while reaching for his lanyard attachment.
After working with pre-cast concrete parts, an employee felt sick and then fell. The employee struck their head and required hospitalization.
An employee was standing up from a bench when something snapped in her right ankle.
An employee slipped while climbing down from equipment. The ring on his ring finger was then caught on the equipment, causing an avulsion.
An employee was testing de-energized conductors at a solar farm construction site when an arc flash/fire occurred, burning the employee's hands, face, and neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had installed a valve stem extension on a tractor trailer rig and was crossing the roadway when he was struck by a truck that was leaving the area, fracturing both legs/ankles and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's left ring fingertip was caught between the cylinder and motor as he was performing maintenance on a compressor.
An employee was getting ready to hook up to the dome while using the vault cart. The employee's left thumb was caught in the vault cart winch and the end of his thumb was amputated.

An employee was unloading a shipping container using a hand truck. The hand truck fell with the load on it and struck/crushed the employee's foot causing a fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was breaking down boxes and cut her upper leg with the box cutter tool.

An employee was wearing an N-95 dust mask and mopping the floor at the end of her work shift when she experienced shortness of breath due to breathing in tezacaftor (chemical compound). The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping another employee lower a walk-behind pallet jack that had been stood up on it's back end. The employee's right hand had a hold of the forks and his right index finger got stuck in the wheel well as it was lowered to the ground. The finger was smashed and the tip was amputated at the hospital.
An employee was cutting a block on a table saw when the blade cut his finger, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were sprayed with black liquor as they attempted to replace a refractometer. One employee was sprayed in the left eye, while the second employee was sprayed in the neck area. They suffered chemical burns.
An employee was performing duties as a derrick hand at an oil/gas production site when his right index fingertip was pinched and amputated between a pipe and a latch.
An employee was descending a 14-foot fixed ladder when she fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing her right femur.

An employee was installing decking and transferring from a static fall protection line. The employee disconnected from one anchor and was trying to reattach to another when the employee fell 15 feet to the ground, suffering a broken wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a press machine when the ram fell and crushed her right ring finger, amputating it at the knuckle.
An employee was walking alongside a Bobcat when he tried to mount the vehicle for a ride. The vehicle then ran over him, breaking his leg.

A rural mail carrier had an accident when she ran into a tree while driving down the driveway of a residence after delivering a package. The employee was reported as having a seizure that caused the accident. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured jaw with loss of teeth and a fractured right collar bone.

An employee was a passenger in an open cab, flatbed utility cart (golf cart type) that was transporting a load. She was ejected when the driver made a sharp turn, striking her head on the pavement. She suffered a fractured skull and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to give medication to a patient when the patient became agitated and bit the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 29, 2016, an employee was a clearing a jam on the in-feed conveyor of a double-end foiler machine when the employee's right ring finger was pinched and lacerated in a pinch point between the feedstock material and the framework of the conveyor's emergency stop paddle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking from a mushroom house when he slipped on a small patch of black ice and fell on his right leg, fracturing his right tibia/fibula.
An employee was climbing a wet built-in ladder on a vehicle that had been brought in from the rain when he slipped and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, breaking his right elbow.

An employee was operating a mule-type all terrain vehicle to travel from one area of the plant to another when he was struck by the forks of a forklift being operated by a coworker, fracturing his left tibia and fibula.
An employee was backing up from a cardboard baler when she tripped on the forks of a manual pallet jack and suffered multiple fractures.

While walking from the west parking lot into the building, an employee walked in front of a stationary truck that was waiting to proceed to a scale. When the employee was in front of the truck, it began to move and struck the employee with the front bumper. The employee was pulled under the truck and suffered numerous cuts and a laceration to the right thigh.
An employee slipped and fell while mopping, breaking her hip.
An employee was using a meat saw when his hand slipped and his right middle finger engaged with the blade, lacerating his fingernail and fingertip.
An employee was blending solvents (dichloroacetic acid and toluene) in a 100-liter glass vessel when it cracked, splashing solvent on the employee's left shoulder, chest, and back.

On December 29, 2016, at approximately 11:30 a.m., a crew was moving skids out of the bottom of a large excavation. The skids had been placed in an excavator's hoe bucket on the ground. An employee was unloading the skids from the bucket and handing them to the injured employee, who was positioned next to the track hoe bucket and a super sack of sandbags. At this time, another employee walked by the hoe operator and asked him to take over the track hoe. As he twisted around to speak, his safety vest caught the operating lever and caused the bucket of the track hoe to move and pinch the injured employee's left ankle between the hoe bucket and super sand bag. His lower left leg was fractured just above the ankle.

An employee was unloading a truck using an electric pallet jack. As he was exiting the truck, the dock plate malfunctioned and pinned the employee's foot against the electric pallet jack causing lacerations and fractures to several bones in his right foot.

An employee was operating an LPM machine to seal small mustard packages. A mustard package jammed up the LPN machine and when the employee tried to pull the mustard package out, part of her left index finger was removed. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was using the scanner, tripped over the scanner cord and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee's gloved hand was caught between the moving rollers while removing strings from the powered conveyor resulting in the amputation of his right finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was checking a cyclone machine when he opened the spy door and fire shot out, burning his forehead, cheek, and chin.

An employee was using a hand grinder when he saw something wrong with the guard.  When he attempted to adjust the guard, the grinder caught his gloved hand and amputated his left index finger. The grinder was still in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was obtaining a storm water sample when the storm water grate fell and pinched the employee's finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell over a large piece of concrete in the parking lot. The employee sustained a broken kneecap and required surgery.
Two employees were checking a dust collector when a flash fire occurred, seriously burning their faces, necks, shoulders, and hands. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was operating a bus when he crashed into an 8-foot fence, suffering lacerations and a fractured left shoulder.
An employee was grinding parts on a pedestal belt grinder and suffered a left thumb amputation.
An employee was moving a ladder and caught their right index finger in the hinge resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The employee was making parts at the Accupress machine and stacking them on a skid that was on a cart. The employee went to adjust the materials when the skid and parts fell on him, causing him to fall backwards with the material landing on his stomach and legs and his head striking machinery behind him. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left kneecap and leg, a fractured right ankle and multiple lacerations to his legs, stomach and head.

An employee was performing sanitation duties on a machine. The employee removed piping to clean a valve inside. The air source to the machine was not locked out. While cleaning the valve, it actuated and caught her finger. She was hospitalized and the finger may be amputated.

On December 30, 2016, at 5:45 am an employee slipped on black ice in the back parking lot and fell while using a flashlight on his way to the jockey truck to move a loaded trailer. The employee fractured the lower left leg that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was walking into the plant, slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell suffering an ankle injury that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was walking into work from the parking lot, slipped on black ice and fell fracturing the pelvis and a wrist.
An employee was adjusting the cable on the electric hoist when his left index finger got caught up in the hoist cable and the fingertip was amputated.
On December 30, 2016, an employee was burned on the face, arm and left hand while cleaning a jiffy mixer in a solvent tank when the solvent vapor ignited.

An employee was sprayed with hot product causing third degree burns to his neck, upper torso and legs. He also sustained a dislocated right shoulder in the incident.  The employee was admitted to the burn unit for treatment.

An employee was unhooking a trailer from the truck and was pulling the 5th wheel pin to drop the trailer. The trailer was on a slight incline and when he pulled the pin, the trailer slid and dropped catching his right hand and causing lacerations.
An employee was cutting top sirloin on a meat saw and amputated the right index finger.
An employee was lowering the frame of the bread rounder back into place on the conveyor and pinched their right thumb resulting in amputation of the thumb.
An employee was helping two other employees push a winder back into starting position. One employee's hand was caught in a nip point and the left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell down the stairs while carrying a box from the stock room.

Employees were using a rough terrain forklift truck to pivot a fork of another rough terrain forklift truck. The fork was tied to its carriage. When the fork was untied it came down and struck an employee standing near the truck and broke his leg near his ankle.

An employee was blasting angles inside the cargo tank on the upper level of a scaffold. A 6-inch pipe approximately 24 inches above the scaffold deck was running horizontally behind him. During the process, he stepped backwards, lost his balance and fell backwards over the pipe as pressure remained on the hose. His legs went in the air during the fall the blaster blasted his right leg below the knee. The employee suffered a deep laceration and injection injury to his lower right leg.
An employee was at the nurse's desk, turned, and fell to the tile floor fracturing the left hip.
An employee was dismounting a center riding pallet jack and fell breaking a leg.
An employee was delivering mail in a residential neighborhood. While walking down a driveway, she stepped on an unstable object and twisted her ankle.

An employee was using an air impact wrench to tighten lug nuts on the vehicle he was servicing. His glove got caught on the rotating spindle as he was tightening the lug nuts on the vehicle and the employee suffered an open fracture and amputation of his left little fingertip.
An employee suffered a back injury (slipped discs) while reaching into the back of the LLV to retrieve a parcel for delivery.
An employee's finger was amputated while closing the safe door.
An employee was working on a platform 2.5 feet above ground power washing equipment. He fell backwards off the platform breaking his radius and ulna.
An employee slipped on ice near the car washing area and fell. The employee suffered a broken hip requiring surgery.
An employee was re-attaching the dump arm to the main frame of a cane trailer. The employee's right index finger was crushed in a pinch point causing an open fracture.
An employee caught and injured their right middle finger inside a door jam.
An employee was using a table saw to cut shims at the jobsite when a board kicked back amputating his right index finger. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was cutting the aitch bone out of a hog carcass when the boning knife slipped and lacerated/punctured his top right rib area.
An employee struck a concrete bollard while following another employee on a stand up forklift resulting in amputation of the left leg.
An employee was collecting shopping carts in the parking lot when he was struck by a moving automobile, suffering multiple injuries and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on the edge of a containment wall while changing a pump when he slipped and fell 1.5 feet from the wall and fractured his left forearm.
Employees were pulling poly pipe when a piece of poly pipe struck an employee's lower left leg and fractured it.

An employee was performing set-up for production. When he picked up the pipe to a vacuum-type motor to connect to the fecal flush pump, he received an electrical shock on both hands. The fecal flush pump was not operating at the time of injury.
An employee was walking through the store parking lot and was struck by a car. The employee suffered a broken leg.
On January 03, 2017, an employee was closing a trailer door when their fingers were caught in the door and the left middle finger was amputated.

The plant was shut down for maintenance including the 440 V lines. The 110 V line was left energized. Three employees were moving the rectifier equipment back into place when one of the employees touched something and felt hot like he was shocked. It ran through both arms. An EKG showed changes in his heart rate and he was hospitalized.
An employee was loading skylight panels onto a trailer when the employee's right pinky fingertip was caught and amputated between the panels and the trailer.
An employee fell on icy ground outside and broke her left hip.
On January 3, 2017, an employee fell from an A-frame ladder while attempting to change the ballast in an overhead light fixture, suffering heel fractures to both feet.
An employee was walking, tripped over metal parts and fell breaking an ankle.

An employee was removing passenger bags from a conveyor belt while a string of four dollies was carrying empty LD3 containers from a flight. The last dolly clipped a curb and an LD3 bounced off the dolly and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured left tibia and a head contusion.

Two employees were moving sheets of plywood on the dock. At the same time, a poultry pan was being lowered onto the dock. The injured employee moved under the pan as it was being lowered and was struck by the pan. The employee suffered a broken hip and right metacarpal and a hematoma on the forehead.
An employee was hospitalized when he fell from a step ladder fracturing a shoulder and a rib.

An employee was using a powered pallet jack (ride on the back style) to pick up orders. The injured employee was walking in front of the PIT, looking backwards, and ran into a stationary stack of materials. The employee operating the PIT was unable to stop the PIT before it struck the injured employee pinning him between the PIT and the stationary materials and breaking the employee's left leg.
An employee was wearing stilts to place ceiling grid when he tripped on a metal stud and fell, breaking both wrists.
An employee was picking up cones and warning signs in a road construction area when he was struck by a runaway car, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a folding table and fell fracturing two vertebrae.
An employee was dismounting a boom truck when his leg was caught in the outrigger, breaking it.
An employee on a loading dock was walking away from a pallet truck he was handling when he fell 4 feet off the dock to the lower level, fracturing his T4 vertebra.
An employee was working on a core baker machine when his leg was caught between a moving part and a stationary part. He suffered a broken lower right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a circular saw to rip a plywood counter top brace when the saw bound up and kicked back, partially amputating the employee's thumb.
An employee was working on a wooden crate and using a pneumatic nail gun when a nail penetrated his right eye.

Two employees were performing preventive maintenance on an elevator table device used for stacking and palletizing totes. One employee was adjusting a braking mechanism/motor while the other was below the table. The braking mechanism was accidentally released, causing the table to fall on the second employee and pinning him below. He suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee's left index finger was pinched by a plow on a draw bench, requiring medical amputation.
An employee suffered a hernia while pulling a 50 pound piece of beef off of the conveyor table. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee attached a full drum to a drum hoist for transport. The full metal drum slipped from the drum hoist during transport and struck the employee's left shin, severely cutting it and requiring hospitalization.

While moving equipment (a concrete testing machine) from one building to another via forklift the load became unstable and began to tip off of the forks. An employee attempted to grab the equipment to keep it from falling and his hand was caught between the equipment and a doorframe. He suffered lacerations to his hand and a fracture resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was removing the safety barricade in front of a cap on a 24-inch PVC pipe after pressure testing when the cap became over-pressurized and blew off the pipe, striking him and knocking him against the wall and to the ground. He suffered a fracture to the left side of his skull near the ear and a sprained right knee.
An employee was salting an icy area when he slipped and fell forward, hitting his forehead on the asphalt. He fractured his skull and suffered a brain hemorrhage.
An employee was using a cheese cutter when the blade amputated his finger.
While operating a tow bar, an employee's right thumb was crushed between two metals.
An employee was arranging jewelry in an opened drawer when she bumped into it. She lost her balance and fell on the ground, breaking bones and injuring her leg. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was walking down a hallway when the rubber tip of her shoe was caught, causing her to fall forward on her left side. She suffered a compound fracture of the upper humerus and required surgery.
A guard was hit in the head, neck and chest by a combative patient in the emergency room.
An employee was getting out of his truck when he slipped on ice/snow, fell to the ground, and broke his left fibula.
An employee was replenishing the warehouse storage racks when he fell 8 feet off of a platform to the ground below, fracturing his wrists.

An employee was moving a catwalk (a long piece of equipment that helps move tube) against a rig to perform an inspection when his right ring finger was caught and fractured between the catwalk skate and a pin. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a cart of zinc bars/ingots to a reclaim furnace to be melted down. The cart wheels were caught in pit holes on the floor, causing the cart to tip over and the bars of ingots to fall on his left leg. He suffered a compound fracture and was hospitalized.
On January 4, 2017, an employee was replacing a paper roll on a mill polisher machine when his left thumb was caught in a pinch point on the machine. His left thumb tip was surgically amputated.
An employee lost her balance while in the office. She fell onto her left arm and suffered a fracture.
An employee was inspecting a roof when he fell to the ground and lost consciousness.

An employee was using a pallet machine and was trying to clear a nail that was jammed in a nail bowl when the nailer came down and amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut trees for maintenance purposes when the saw kicked back and landed on the employee's left foot, lacerating it and amputating a toe.

An employee was scanning vehicles on a rail car and was descending a ladder when he lost his balance and fell approximately 12 to 14 feet to the concrete surface below. He broke his left hand, left wrist, left hip, and two ribs.

An employee was processing scopes in endoscopy. The cycle on the Steris machine finished and all safety checks and indicators completed and passed. The employee opened the lid to remove the scope and noticed some fumes (peracetic acid) coming from the machine. The employee had a burning sensation in the throat and lungs. Other employees assisted the employee out of the room into fresh air. The employee took a break and returned to work, but was having difficulty breathing. She was admitted to the hospital for treatment.

An employee was MIG welding the dog house of a self-contained compactor when a spark ignited and his shirt caught on fire. He sustained first and second degree burns to his upper torso and third degree burns to his back.
An employee was checking a vehicle and had his left hand in the motor belt when a coworker started the vehicle. The motor belt then moved and amputated his left middle, ring, and pinky fingers.
An employee was on a roof and getting a new battery for his drill when he fell through a fiberglass skylight and injured his right elbow, requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning a piece of equipment when his hand contacted a knife that was behind the equipment, lacerating his right thumb. He had surgery and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was cutting cardboard that was on top of a pallet with a utility knife when the knife slipped and partially amputated his left thumb tip.
An employee was moving a spare engine when the engine was lowered onto the employee's foot, crushing it.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking to a truck, fracturing his right leg.

An employee was tracing piping when the employee's pant pocket became caught on a hot water valve clamp. The valve then released hot water onto the employee's right arm and torso, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was assisting in a dowel drilling operation and attempting to steady the drill when his glove was caught in the drill bit. His left fourth fingertip was then amputated by the drill bit.
An employee was threading bale wire through a paper scrap baler when the baler was activated. The employee's index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was stocking shelves and loading a baler with empty cardboard boxes. She was pulling a rope attached to the baler door to close it when her left pinky fingertip was caught and amputated in the door.
An employee was using hydraulic controls to lower an iron roughneck when his right pinky finger and knuckle were caught and fractured between the iron roughneck and the hydraulic cat head.

An employee was filing quality documentation records in file boxes stored on metal shelves, which are about 10 feet high. She was later found unconscious on the concrete floor to the side of the metal shelving unit, which had fallen on the floor. She was hospitalized with a head injury and fractured skull.
An employee was walking on steel shelving approximately one foot high. The employee slipped and fell resulting in a chest contusion.
An employee was changing an electrical pole when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and fractured his right wrist.

An employee was working on the rig floor of a workover rig. The crew was picking up pipe from the hole. The operator descended the block to the rig floor to connect to the pipe. The bails and elevators were connected to the blocks. When the elevators came down, the employee's finger was caught between the elevator and bail resulting in a left middle finger amputation at the first digit.

An employee was climbing a tree to cut off the limbs and underbrush when the tree roots came up and the tree fell into the lake. The employee also fell about 40 to 50 feet into the lake while still attached to the tree with safety equipment. He broke both legs and his pelvis.

An employee was handing down a sewer connection fitting to an employee below in a trench when a bolt on the fitting snagged on the employee's jacket, causing him to lose his balance and fall. He fell on the fitting, breaking two left ribs and bruising his left lung.
A crane was lowering a steel beam when the beam dropped unexpectedly and struck an employee. The employee suffered broken fingers, a hand laceration, and back pain.
An employee was using a pry bar to loosen debris on a machine when the pry bar slipped and broke his arm. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was moving a signal arm at a toll booth gate when a nylon sling failed, causing the arm to swing down and strike the employee's chest. He fell to the ground and struck his head.
An employee slid and fell on wet concrete while walking into the building from the company parking lot, breaking the left ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down the hall, lost her balance, and fell breaking her humerus.
An employee was herding cattle while on horseback when the horse slipped on ice and fell, landing on and breaking the employee's leg.
An employee was using a punch press to put holes in a 12-inch post. As he placed the post in the press, the press activated, crushing his right hand.
An employee was changing a battery in a company vehicle. When he lifted the battery, he injured his lower back and required hospitalization.

An employee was climbing on a baker's scaffold to reach a working platform when the scaffold turned over on top him. He fell approximately 6 to 8 feet to the ground, puncturing his lung and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to latex gloves.
On January 5, 2016, an employee was exiting his vehicle when he slipped and fell on the snow/ice, injuring his hip/back and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lifting an aluminum panel (a hutch compartment) when he suffered a herniated disc in his lower back. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground while walking in the parking lot, breaking a leg.
An employee was assisting a truck driver with a load when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his shoulder and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a standup forklift. When he exited the equipment, he was pinned between the dock door and the forklift, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was burning trash with gasoline when he was severely burned on the hands and face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling poly film off a roll when the poly film gave way and the employee fell backward to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee was trying to grab a small piece a wood that was being cut with a circular saw when his left hand contacted the blade, lacerating his index finger.

An employee was being trained on a forklift and traveling around a charging station when he hit a parked lift and became pinned between the two vehicles, breaking his leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while operating a saw. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a bandsaw to cut lumber from wood pallets when a piece of lumber became stuck. As he attempted to remove the piece of wood, the blade amputated his right thumb. The saw was activated at the time of the incident.

An employee was working at the shop running a 10-inch-long, 3-inch-wide piece of metal through a homemade roller machine. The employee was attempting to curve the piece of metal so that it would go on a wheel. While running the piece of metal through the roller, the employee's index finger was caught between the metal and the roller. The employee's right index fingertip was smashed and cut, resulting in a soft tissue amputation.
An employee was moving a 9-foot cart full of packages when his right pinky was caught and de-gloved between the cart and a pole. He was hospitalized for surgery.

On January 5, 2017, at approximately 10:20 AM, employees were moving a small safe in order to renovate the floor and wall behind the safe. They attempted to lift the safe one corner at a time to place a shim under each corner. While they were placing a shim under a corner, the safe slipped off the pry bar and caught the injured employee's left-hand index finger, crushing it to the middle knuckle. The finger had to be amputated.

An employee was cutting off a tree branch with a chainsaw while standing on a guard rail. The branch pushed back and struck him in the chest. He was pushed against another tree and fell off of the guard rail.
An employee slipped on the wet concrete floor and fell, fracturing two bones in her left foot/ankle.

An employee had trimmed tree branches and was descending from the tree. The employee's descending rope was tied to a branch that broke, causing the employee to fall approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis, a lacerated spleen, fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, fractured vertebrae, and a fractured left elbow.

An employee was using compressed air to blow out an extrusion unit before completing a resin change over when the mechanical hopper gate closed, pinching and amputating the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingertips.

A temporary employee was cleaning the mill grinder floor when he fell approximately 20 to 40 feet through a hole in the floor and struck the floor below, breaking his right arm, pelvis, and right cheekbone.

An employee was using a tugger machine to pull wire through a conduit when the machine mounts broke free, causing the employee to fall backward and strike the metal racking. The employee suffered a hand laceration and cracked ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a diesel generator onto a trailer when the load shifted and pinched the employee's left index fingertip, amputating it.
While approaching a set of stairs, an employee fell and struck the leading edge of the second step injuring his left knee.

An employee was cutting a 4' x 8' sheet of particle board with a table saw when the board kicked up, causing the saw's guard to flip up. He attempted to stop the board, but his right index and middle fingers were caught in the saw, amputating his right index fingertip.

An employee was being handed shelving units by a coworker when the coworker lost their grip and the shelving unit made contact with the top of the employee's head. The employee was hospitalized overnight with a head laceration and contusion.

On January 7, 2017, at approximately 2:40 p.m., an employee was attempting to lay out structural steel pieces with the assistance of a forklift truck. A steel truss fell over and struck the employee's legs resulting in fractures and crushing injuries to both lower legs.

An employee was on the dock helping to load/unload freight into/from trailers. At approximately 2:45 a.m., he attempted to move freight (boxes shrink-wrapped on a pallet) manually when a board became loose and broke away from the pallet, propelling him sideways into a nearby forklift. He broke three ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting 6" by 6" lumber when he slipped and fell after stepping on a steel plate, causing the lumber to fall on his right hand and amputate his middle and ring fingertips.

A crew was removing material (hot ash) from the outside of the loop seal on the power boiler. Once they finished removing the loose material, the crew was exiting the platform when the material inside the boiler gave way. The material came out of the boiler's manway door and contacted an employee burning his hands and the back of his legs.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell fracturing the left femur.
An employee slipped and fell on the sidewalk due to icy conditions, breaking the lower left leg in three places.

While checking the surface quality of steel at the automatic blanking line, an employee fell into the shear bed area of the platform. The shear bed hold-downs then clamped onto the employee's left middle and ring fingers, fracturing them.
An employee was performing maintenance on a scrap conveyor when his glove was caught and his finger was partially amputated.
An employee was working on a saw when his right index finger came in contact with the saw blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working outdoors on some equipment/machines when he suffered frostbite to eight fingers.
An employee was opening a valve he was repairing when he dropped the valve hand wheel. As he tried to catch it, the wheel crushed his middle fingertip, which had to be amputated.

On January 6, 2017, at approximately 6:00 p.m., an employee was injured while working at the cant deck in the resaw area. Standing near four motor driven chains, the employee noted two 6-8 inch cants that were not laying flat. Wearing leather gloves, the employee adjusted the cants when his left thumb became jammed between the chain and one cant, resulting in amputation of the tip of his thumb.
An employee was cleaning out a heat exchanger when hot material blew back and burned 50 percent of the employee's body.

An employee was working at the de-palletizer and reached with their right hand to retrieve a slip sheet from the top of the empty cans. The sweeper arm on the de-palletizer, which is located above the cans and pushes the cans off of the pallet and onto a conveyor belt, came down and caught her right hand resulting in a fractured right forearm.

An employee was transferring water at high pressure through a hose. The hose failed and a jet of water knocked the employee through the air approximately 150 feet. When the employee landed on the ground he suffered a shoulder injury.
An employee was driving a clamp truck when it caught on fire, causing first and second degree burns to his lower back, wrists, and right leg.
An employee was unstrapping lumber from a delivery truck when a beam fell from the top of the load and struck him, resulting in a T-12 compression fracture.
An employee was feeding materials into a machine when her glove was caught in the rollers, pulling her fingers in and amputating her left hand.
An employee was placing a tire on a tire changing machine when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The machine then caught and amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was performing quality assurance/control on a stacker unit when the unit jammed. As the employee attempted to clear the jam, the stacker unit energized and the employee's right leg was caught and fractured between the roller and the kick-out.

An employee was placing a zinc ingot into an induction melting electric furnace. When the zinc ingot contacted the molten metal, the furnace blew up, causing severe burns to the employee's upper body and minor burns to a coworker.
An employee fell approximately 2.5 feet from a tender frame after finishing repairs on a motor resulting in broken ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.

On Friday, January 6, 2017,at 9:30 a.m., an employee was helping a trailer being loaded with fertilizer. As he stepped forward to notify the driver that the trailer was full, he tripped and fell forward, hitting his nose on the step of the semi-trailer. He was hospitalized overnight with a broken nose.
An employee fell 10 feet through a hole while removing a carbonate roof fracturing a wrist, eye socket and temple.
On January 6, 2017, at around 10:00 AM, an employee was using a baker scaffold to patch concrete on interior walls when he fell about 4 feet to the hard floor below, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was operating the aluminum mandrel lathe when a shaft part that he was cleaning on the machine flew off and struck the employee in the chest resulting in a fractured rib and a lacerated liver.

An employee was cleaning a cotton bale press and was attempting to hit the stop button when his arm hit the ram-down button, causing the ram to come down and crush his right hand. His hand was amputated.

An employee was working on a blowout preventer. When he went to remove the valve removal plug, pressure (approximately 300 PSI) released and struck him, blowing him 20 to 30 feet away. He was hospitalized.

The injured employee was part of a two man team performing bird harassment at a landfill. The process required firing 12 gauge cracker shells to displace the birds. After a failed detonation, the injured employee proceeded to eject the miss-fired round. Immediately upon ejection, the miss-fired round denoted resulting in substantial injury to the employee's face and hand area. The employee was hospitalized and treated for the loss of his right eye plus a cheekbone fracture and a concussion.
An employee was retrieving a plastic part from inside a cooling tunnel when her finger became caught in a conveyor nip point, amputating her right middle fingertip.
On January 6, 2017, at approximately 11:45 a.m., an employee was operating a radial arm saw and amputated a ring finger.

An employee was on a ladder, visually checking and listening for possible air leaks on a line, when he slipped and grabbed a support structure next to the 180 gear. The forward motion of his weight caused his right hand to slide into the plastic gear, which amputated his right middle finger.
On January 7, 2017, an employee suffered a thumb tip amputation while using a band saw to cut meat.
An employee was delivering mail and climbing snow-covered stairs when she slipped and fell, fracturing her ankle.
An employee fell while walking to the restroom, suffering lower leg/knee pain and a hip fracture.
An employee suffered a right middle fingertip amputation while cleaning a roller.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor resulting in a left wrist injury.
An employee slipped on ice and fell on the sidewalk outside the building. He suffered possible broken ribs.
An employee felt a sharp pain in his back and neck while picking up stock. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was entering the store with a two-wheel hand truck when he slipped on the floor and fell, fracturing his left leg in two places. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a cement truck to the company's yard when he stopped the vehicle to inspect his load. While he was inspecting the load, the lid for the control panel closed unexpectedly and lacerated his left middle finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was attempting to use a pry bar to pry up on the bail of a lead pot when the pry bar slipped, causing the employee to fall 6 to 8 feet to the ground. He landed on his left side, cracking four ribs and fracturing two vertebrae.

On January 7, 2016, at approximately 6:30 a.m., an employee was operating a man lift when a cable failed on the lift's guarded platform, causing the lift basket to fall over 8 feet to the ground below. The employee fell with the basket, breaking his left foot and ankle.
An employee was getting in her car when she slipped and fell on ice, breaking her right femur.
An employee was attempting to remove meat from a meat grinder when it activated and fractured the employee's left arm, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was helping a forklift operator fill spill kits in the warehouse when the forklift ran over the employee's foot. His right foot was caught between the counterweight and the wheel of the forklift, breaking the second and third toes.

An employee was repairing a valve on a solid waste collection truck hydraulic lift. The hydraulic lift was raised while the employee was working underneath the arm. The lift came down and the arm fell on the employee, crushing the left side of his body and causing a concussion.

On January 7, 2017, an employee was operating an overhead crane to lower a section of tooling into a stationary stamping die. He leaned on the stationary stamping die to ensure that the tooling was lined up. As he lowered the tooling, his left fingertip was caught and partially amputated in the opening/pinch point.
An employee leaned over to pick up a utensil when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.

An employee was performing building maintenance. As he was climbing a fixed ladder on the outside of the building, he slipped off the ladder and fell 10 feet to the concrete below, fracturing his T12 vertebra.
A temporary employee was operating a drill press when their glove was caught and their left thumb was amputated to the first knuckle.

Employees were using an air hoist to lift/move a crossover sub (pipe) on the platform floor. The lifting cap on the air hoist failed and the load fell on an employee's hand, causing a burst wound in his palm and a fracture in the bottom bone of his hand.
On January 7, 2017, an employee slipped and fell while leaving the breakroom, fracturing her right femur.

An employee and a coworker were simultaneously pouring two 5-gallon buckets of 34% hydrogen peroxide and a catalyst down a floor drain when a violent chemical reaction occurred, exposing them to gases and corrosive liquid chemicals. The employee was hospitalized with first and second degree burns to the face, neck, and arms.
An employee was walking into work when she tripped over a chair and fell, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was ringing out a customer at the cash register when she walked around the shopping cart to scan a product. As she was returning to the register, she struck the corner of the cart and tripped and fell, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was removing a rigid metal flow line from a parts basket when the flow line shifted and fell on the employee's right leg, breaking the tibia and fibula.
An employee was stepping off a tanker trailer ladder to the ground when she twisted and fractured her left knee.

An extrusion machine became backed up. Employees dissipated the energy and were going to remove the machine's die plate when a pressure buildup caused the plate to blow off and strike an employee in the right arm. He fell onto his left side, fracturing three ribs and separating his right shoulder.
An employee was coming down a mobile staircase when he missed the last two steps and fell. He fractured his lower left leg and left wrist and dislocated his left elbow. He required surgery.
An employee was reaching for a box on a shelving unit when he slipped and his ring became caught on the shelf. His left ring finger was then partially amputated.
An employee fell while climbing truck steps to close the trailer door, suffering a broken left elbow. The steps were slick and icy at the time.

An employee was attempting to load a gearbox onto a container vessel. His hand was between the gantry crane spreader bar and the box when the crane lowered, catching and amputating the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was flattening out sheets of wire mesh when his right middle finger was caught between two wire bundle sheets, amputating his right middle fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was unclogging material from a flour hopper when a pneumatic gate fractured his right thumb. The gate was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was mounting the rear riding step of a refuse truck when his hand entered the refuse truck hopper where the sweep blade was running. The sweep blade caught and amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was walking towards the kitchen when she slipped on the wet floor and fell shattering her right kneecap, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was putting print plates onto the drums of an open machine on site when the drum moved and the employee's hand was caught in the machine. The employee's hand was crushed, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was unloading a truck when the employee's left middle fingertip was pinched and amputated between two steel beams.
An employee tripped on a rug and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured femur and arm and nose injuries.
An employee was stocking a bakers rack when her foot became stuck. When she reached around the rack, she fell to the concrete floor, fracturing her right femur and possibly her right kneecap.
An employee came in contact with a bus bar, suffering serious electric burns to his hands and face.
An employee was making a delivery at a customer's location when he slipped and fell on ice, injuring his left ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was exposed to meth lab chemicals while responding to a meth lab explosion.
An employee fell on an icy street while delivering mail, fracturing the right ankle and lower right leg and requiring surgery.

An employee was on the ground helping a front-end loader recover a disabled vehicle (semi/tractor). The operator of the front-end loader did not see the employee and dropped the bucket, which struck the employee and caused back and lung injuries.
An employee was assisting a press operator and attempting to remove a piece of scrap from the press when the machine cycled and amputated his right hand.

An employee was servicing a conveyor belt system to free a jammed shirt. He was using a knife to cut away the shirt and free the jammed system when his shirt was caught by the conveyor belt. The belt then pulled his left hand between the roller, the belt, and the frame, causing burns to the back of his left hand from his knuckles to his wrist and lacerations to the underside of his left thumb.
An employee was cleaning a pasta extruder. The employee's right arm was inside the extruder when it was activated and pulled the employee's arm inside. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was dispensing cleaning chemicals when the chemicals spilled on the floor and mixed together. While attempting to clean up the spill, the employee inhaled the fumes and experienced difficulty breathing.

An employee was helping a coworker with an irregular package when he lost his footing on metal grating and fell through the hole of the safeguards onto the concrete. He broke his right upper arm and was hospitalized.
An employee fell in the gravel parking lot and broke their right ankle.
A maintenance employee was searching for a jam on an auger when the auger lacerated/amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
On January 9, 2017, an employee slipped on the sidewalk/parking lot while picking up a car to go on an assignment. He lost consciousness, fractured his skull, and suffered a hemorrhagic contusion.
An employee was driving when his vehicle hit a fire hydrant. He injured his left knee.
An employee was dumping items from a lugger into a metal dumpster. When the employee lifted the lugger and released the handle, the handle hit and amputated his left third fingertip.
An employee fell to the ground while walking on an icy tarmac to refuel his tug, fracturing his hip.
An employee fell off a step ladder while changing air lines and suffered a head injury.
An employee was checking a tote that had a mix of sulfuric acid and chlorine when it exploded. Shrapnel from the tote amputated his right arm and partially severed his leg.

An employee was working in a high-pressure pump room when he slipped on the floor and his hand was caught on the pump equipment. Both of his hands were lacerated, and his right index and middle fingers were possibly broken.
A consumer used a 3-inch paring knife to stab an employee in the right shoulder, puncturing the employee's lung.

An employee was preparing to shoot a fluid level on a well. He screwed an echo gun onto the well casing and opened the casing valve. When the pressure hit the gun, the outside of the casing valve threads failed and the pressure popped, releasing H2S (hydrogen sulfide) gas into the employee's face.

An employee on a baker's scaffold reached over to tie a wire lath when the scaffold tipped and he fell 5 feet 6 inches to the ground, fracturing his left femur. The scaffold had guardrails and the wheels were locked at the time.

An employee was driving a forklift when the tie strap behind his seat began falling off. As he grabbed the strap, the end of it became caught in the tire, causing the strap to cinch and lacerate his right pinky, ring, and middle fingers.
An employee was working on a dock when she stepped out from between two pallets and was struck by a clamp truck. She was knocked to the ground and suffered a compound fracture to her left wrist.
An employee was operating a table saw when a piece of wood kicked back. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was treating a patient when the patient assaulted her. She was hospitalized with possible lower back and neck injuries.

An employee was operating a hydraulic lift on the back of a pickup truck to lift a washing machine when the employee's left index finger was pinched and partially amputated to the first knuckle. The lift was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee on a 12-step ladder fell 10 feet to the concrete floor while running new electrical wire overhead.
An employee was replacing a natural gas pipeline when he slipped on ice and fractured his left ankle.
An employee suffered a groin hernia while trying to lift a toppled 55-gallon drum, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder installing a recessed light when the ladder (which was nailed into the wall) came away from the wall. The employee fell with the ladder, breaking the right femur and left leg below the knee.
An employee fell while walking on an icy roadway to make a delivery, breaking the right ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee was called to repair a leaking lift cylinder on a forklift that was outdoors. The employee set the parking brake, tilted the mast to a vertical position and extended the mast to gain access to the secondary lift cylinder. The employee was standing on the dashboard cowling of the forklift between the mast and the overhead roof structure. Thee employee's foot engaged the tilt lever on the forklift, and the mast tilted backward and pinned the employee between the mast and roof structure. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and ruptured stomach, requiring surgery.
An employee was making a home delivery of propane when the gas released and ignited, causing a flash fire that burned his right hand, left leg, and face.

An employee was outside a parking booth, using an ice scraper/breaker to break up ice on the ground, when ice/snow slid off the roof/side of the parking garage and struck her in the neck and head. She suffered a neck sprain/strain and required surgery.

An employee was changing letters on a reader board while standing on an 18-foot extension ladder when he fell to the grassy ground below and landed on his back. He bruised his spinal cord and required hospitalization.

While operating a stand-up counterbalance lift truck, an employee lost control of the steering and dismounted from the moving lift. He was caught between a rack and the lift, breaking his right femur and lacerating his hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up to move chemical from a tank to a drum when a hose came loose and chemical splashed on the employee, burning the upper left arm and left side of the body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing a belt on an electric motor when his left hand was caught between the belt and pulley, cutting and fracturing his hand and ring finger.

An employee had rigged slings and shackles to a 419-pound fan silencer and communicated to the crane operator via radio to cable up. A coworker was helping stabilize the silencer because it was upside down in the shipping crate. While trying to stabilize it, an employee's fingers were caught between the silencer leg and the ground.  His left index fingertip was crushed and had to be amputated, and his left middle finger was lacerated.
An employee was setting up his equipment and caught his finger between the anti-lock roll and doctor roll crushing and severing the right middle finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was helping a carry deck crane operator deliver items to the field. He followed the crane in a golf cart to the fab tent to retrieve equipment. As he was walking out of the fab tent with a strap in his hand and looking down at the strap to perform a visual inspection, the crane operator was putting his outriggers down. They did not see each other and an outrigger caught the employee's big toe. The outrigger smashed the steel toe of his boot, splitting and breaking his big toe.
An employee tripped over a window opening and fell off a balcony, breaking ribs and an arm and suffering internal injuries.
An employee was carrying a piece of glass from the truck into the building, tripped on a curb or uneven part of the sidewalk, and fell breaking ribs and puncturing a lung.
An employee was performing general clean up duties with a fire hose and shovel when an explosion occurred. The employee suffered severe head trauma, contusions and a broken rib.

An employee was inside the sand hopper breaking up the frozen sand in preparation for concrete manufacturing. His legs were caught in the two hopper blades when it closed causing injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a grinder and lacerated the left inner thigh requiring hospitalization. The grinder was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was working in the restaurant and was shot in the chest during an attempted robbery.
An employee was stabbed in the abdomen by another employee with a sharp object.

Employees were laying a tarp over a section of a trench. Two employees slipped and fell approximately eight feet into the trench. Both employees were hospitalized. Employee 1 suffered broken ribs. Employee 2 suffered torn tendons/ligaments in his hands.
An employee was walking from one building to another, slipped on ice, and fell in the parking lot. The employee broke a rib and was hospitalized due to a possible punctured lung.

An employee was replacing the thermostat on a pole hauler truck. He was accessing the engine from the passenger side fender using a step ladder. As he was transitioning from the ladder to the fender, the ladder became unstable and the employee fell resulting in a fractured right femur.
An employee was changing a polished rod when the employee's hand was caught between a well head and a block, crushing the ring and pinky fingers.
