An employee was filling an oxygen cylinder from a large cylinder. Another employee pushed the booster pump and the cylinder exploded. Both employee were hospitalized for burns to the abdomen, arms, chest and face.
An employee fell and sustained a head injury while closing the pit door.

An employee was using a drill press to drill pilot holes in sheet metal and plastic components when the glove on the employee's left index finger was caught by the drill bit. The bit pulled the employee's index fingertip in and amputated it between the fingernail and first knuckle.
An employee was removing an EMS gurney with an injured patient on it and felt a "twinge" in his neck.
An employee was removing residual meat from the paddles of a grinding machine when the machine cycled and broke his right hand. The machine was on at the time of the incident.
An employee fell six feet from a ladder and fractured vertebrae.

Two employees were removing an air bladder shaft from a paper core inside a plastic roll.  The roll was on a pallet on the floor.  An employee was stationed at each side of the roll.  The injured employee (temporary employee) was pushing the air release valve signaling the other employee to remove the shaft.  When the shaft was removed, the injured employee's right index finger was caught between the core and the air release valve causing a fracture/laceration to his right index finger.  The injured employee was wearing cut resistant gloves.
An employee was operating a wrap saw to cut cardboard when the saw jammed. As he attempted to unjam it, the saw blade lacerated his arm. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was baling material and using a retractable box cutter to cut a box down to bale it when the blade went through the cardboard and lacerated his left wrist requiring hospitalization.

An employee was retrieving a hard hat that had blown off his head and onto the grass when he slipped on the wet grass, twisting his ankle and falling to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured left fibula with bone chips in the vicinity of his ankle and ligament damage. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee tripped and fell over a cord while walking to the rear of a deli slicer, fracturing the right tibia and fibula and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking into work, slipped on ice and fell resulting in a broken wrist that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was using a band saw to cut metal pipe. The pipe slipped and the employee's right thumb was amputated.
An employee slipped on ice at 7:45 a.m. while walking into work. The employee sustained a leg and knee injury requiring surgery and overnight hospitalization.

An employee was cutting frozen meat with a band saw. The meat moved and the employee's fingers contacted the saw blade resulting in a partial amputation of two fingers on the right hand. The saw was not guarded at the time.
An employee was working the first base media entrance and stepped between the magnetometer and the bag check table. She tripped over cable and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was servicing a heater when his right hand was caught in an inclined conveyor adjacent to the heater. The employee suffered a finger amputation on the right hand.

An employee was trying to remove a tool extender bit from a hand drill wearing slip-resistant gloves. The employee grasped the tool extender bit and when the drill was turned on, the glove became entangled and torqued. His finger was squeezed between the glove and drill bit, amputating the left pinky fingertip.
An employee blacked out and fell down the stairs, breaking the right arm.
An employee was operating a standup powered industrial truck (PIT) and struck another PIT. His left foot was caught between the two PITs and fractured requiring surgery.
An employee tripped and fell while delivering mail, fracturing the right ankle.

An employee was on a ladder tying off electrical wire on the ceiling when he suffered an electrical shock. He blacked out and fell off the ladder, hitting his head, twisting his ankle, and fracturing and contusing his back.
On January 17, 2017, an employee was operating a brake press and lacerated three fingers on the right hand.
An employee was pulling a truck out of a ditch with the winch from another truck and amputated the left pinky fingertip.
An employee fell down the stairs and broke the right ankle.
An employee was cutting shingles with a manual shingle cutter and amputated the left index fingertip.

An employee was operating an excavator machine approximately four feet from an above ground power line when the power line arced out and electrocuted the employee who suffered second degree burns on the right arm and a broken wrist.
An employee suffered a heart attack while engaged in strenuous truck unloading activities.

An employee was walking through the yard and stepped on a piece of plywood on which other materials were stacked. The plywood shifted and the stack of rebar fell and struck the employee's leg. The employee suffered a broken leg requiring surgery.
An employee was pulling out a core from the laminator machine when his left index finger and thumb were crushed between the core and spindle chuck.
An employee was moving a trailer when the tongue dropped and landed on his finger resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was picking up a socket from the floor when a box from the upper shelf of the overstock wall fell and struck the employee's lower back causing a fracture to the lower back.
An employee was inspecting a well at a customer's site when he slipped and fell on a patch of ice, breaking his rib and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on top of a provisioning truck replacing snacks on an aircraft when his truck was pushed over by another aircraft that was being repositioned. He fell 10 feet and suffered a bruised lung and back injury.
An employee was setting up a 32-foot extension ladder when the top part slid down on the employee's right thumb, fracturing it and tearing a ligament.
An employee was on a ramp near the planes when he climbed on a loader and his foot slipped. He lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet to ground, breaking his right ankle.
An employee reached for his backpack when the strap contacted his service weapon trigger. When he applied pressure to the strap, the weapon fired and shot his right calf.
An employee fell off a ladder and shattered an elbow.

An employee was walking across a roof purlin to attempt to connect to a retractable lifeline when the purlin broke and he fell 20 feet to the concrete below. He broke his neck and suffered brain swelling.
An employee was installing a door when his right thumb was caught between the door and the jam, severing it before the first joint.
An employee was running a machine when his hair became caught in it. His hair and scalp were then removed.

An employee was loading/unloading a truck when the vehicle rolled off the road and down a hill. The employee's legs were pinned underneath the truck. The parking brake and wheel chocks were not used at the time of the incident.

An employee was going to a residence to provide emergency medical treatment to a patient with shortness of breath. The employee began having breathing problems and suffered poisoning once inside the residence, where the patient had set off insect foggers.

An employee was working on an overhead garage door. He was in the bucket of a fork truck when he lost his balance and shifted his weight to the right side. The bucket's screws popped out and the bucket came apart. The employee fell 10 feet to the concrete floor, cracking his ribs and puncturing his lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell 18 feet from a flat roof, suffering a lacerated spleen and broken ribs.
An employee fell from the top of a railroad car sustaining arm and pelvic fractures.
An employee slipped and fell in the icy parking lot, breaking an ankle.

An employee was pulling freight to the rear of the trailer to offload. When the employee turned the freight around, his left leg was caught between the lift gate and the rear of the trailer resulting in a soft tissue laceration.
An employee's glove became caught in a shear machine, which crushed his index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized.
While getting off a forklift, an employee slipped and fell 2 feet to the asphalt, breaking a hip.
An employee fell from a job-made ladder while accessing the upper deck at a work site, suffering foot injuries.
An employee was caulking the inside of a railcar when the doors closed on his upper legs, compressing them.

An employee and a coworker were lifting a trash cart to empty its contents inside a dumpster when the employee's left middle finger was caught between the metal dumpster and the trash cart. The employee's fingertip was amputated up to the nail bed.
An employee slipped on a damp floor and fell backward, striking her head on the wall as she fell. She suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was breading a hopper machine when it fractured and de-gloved his right hand and forearm. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee struck a metal storage rack while operating a standup lift, fracturing and lacerating the left ankle.

An employee was dislodging a metal basket from a forklift using a chain. His finger was inside the end of the chain's hook when the forklift pulled the chain, catching and amputating his left index fingertip.
A temporary employee tripped over a bundle of metal studs and fell onto the concrete floor, fracturing the femoral head bone.

An employee was standing on the forks of the forklift 2 feet in the air. He was lifting a steel grate when it fell back and caught his hand between the steel. He suffered torn hand ligaments and broken middle and ring fingers.
An employee's left middle and ring fingers were partially amputated by the knives on a cutter machine.

Two employees were attempting to change the tire on an elevated trailer when a portion of the trailer broke apart and struck them. Both employees suffered head injuries. One was treated and released, while the other was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and broke his hip.
An employee was directing a PIV operator moving materials. The material shifted and fell onto the employee breaking both legs. The PIV operator was not moving the materials at the time.
An employee was moving boards when his finger was crushed between a board and a trailer frame, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell down stairs and broke his wrists and fractured his skull.
While on a ladder replacing a fiberglass boom in a mechanical tree trimmer, an employee was knocked off the ladder and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured hip.

An employee was moving pallets with a forklift when it became stuck in the mud. Two coworkers attempted to pull the forklift out of the mud by tying two straps of fastener together with a clevis and attaching it to a truck that was pulling the forklift. The clevis then broke and swung back, striking and lacerating the employee's head.
An employee was exposed to carbon monoxide, suffering sickness and light-headedness.
An employee lost his grip on a sandblasting hose. The abrasive then struck and became embedded in his arm. He was hospitalized for surgery.
Two employees were hospitalized after a motor vehicle accident inside a military installation.
An employee was using a nail gun to package batteries when a nail shot into the employee's left hand.

An employee was removing chicken wing totes from beneath a wing separator. The employee reached up under the wing separator to retrieve a hanging chicken piece and contacted the separator. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated above the nailbed.

An employee was delivering a forklift when part of it broke off at the weld and the forklift fell 3 feet. The employee then hit his head on the bar support for the roll-over protection and suffered a laceration that required hospitalization.

On 1/19/2017, at approximately 1830, an employee was attempting to remove a die key from a steam-powered forging hammer when his leg became caught and injured between the key knocker ram and the hammer.
An employee fell 10 feet from a fixed ladder while performing HVAC maintenance, suffering a lumbar fracture and head concussion.
An employee was performing a roof inspection. He was taking photos when he slipped on wet shingles and fell into an empty concrete pool below, breaking his left arm and left ankle.
An employee was bringing aerosol cans to room temperature when one of the cans ruptured and struck the employee's right cheek, causing a laceration.

An employee was preparing to unload a truck mounted shipping container by activating the dock plate which is manually operated with a handle. While lowering the dock plate onto the back of the truck, the dock plate recoiled upon striking the right side of the truck causing the plate not to clear the truck as required to lay flat for unloading operations. The employee's left ring finger was pinched between the steel dock plate and left side steel edge of the dock plate.
An employee was standing in an aisle, preparing to stock shelves, when he fainted, fell back, and hit his head.
An employee was operating a punch press to punch holes in an aluminum door frame when his left middle finger was caught in a ram, amputating his fingertip. The ram was unguarded at the time.
An employee was operating a drilling machine when the clamp amputated the employee's right pinky finger. The clamp was guarded at the time.
An employee bent down to lift a chest of drawers when he experienced lower back and leg pain.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, fracturing her left femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lifting the dock plate with a hook. When the hook slipped, the employee fell backwards onto the concrete dock floor, fracturing his left hip.

On January 19, 2017, an employee was operating an overhead crane to raise an 1,800-pound load. During the ascent, the load began to swing and pinched the employee's left thumb between a stationary object and the load. The employee's thumb was amputated.
An employee was shot in the leg during an attempted robbery.
An employee was running a milling machine when a software glitch allowed the machine's clamp to close on and amputate the employee's fingertip.

An employee was walking on a steel beam that was lying on the ground when it flipped over and pinned his leg between it and another beam. His right leg was fractured above the ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was guiding a tractor trailer into an unloading area. The employee realized some pipes were hanging over the side of the trailer and moved behind and to the side of the truck to warn the driver to stop. The employee got caught between the trailer and a wall resulting in a broken left arm and two broken ribs.
An employee was on the roof removing snow when a fiberglass portion of the roof gave way and the employee fell 10 to 12 feet to the concrete floor below.

An employee was setting up a chicken house to receive new chickens. She turned and slipped on a powdered pesticide coating the concrete floor. Her right leg folded under her as she fell resulting in a broken lower leg.
An employee's right thumb tip was caught and amputated in a chuck saw.
An employee was working on a tractor alternator belt when a coworker started the engine. The employee's right second and third fingertips were then amputated by the moving belt.
An employee was changing a pasteurizer system's probe, which was located on a pipe cap. When the cap was removed, the employee was sprayed with heated water.

An employee was attempting to clean the focus eye lens in a trough that wood passes through on the lay-up assembly line. The machine started while the employee's right ring finger was in the strike area and a piece of wood crushed the finger, breaking it and causing the fingertip to burst.

An employee turned off a gang rip saw to clear debris from it with his left hand. The saw blades were still in motion and amputated his left fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was pushing a container of hot asphalt on the roof when the asphalt splashed him, severely burning his face and neck.
An employee was cutting metal with a torch when slag entered the employee's boot and caused a burn. The burn became infected and required hospitalization.

On 01/19/2017, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was walking into the work site when she tripped and fell over the curb and into the doorframe. She caught the edge of the hinged door and then fell to the concrete floor, hitting her forehead and scalp, breaking her nose, and contusing her neck.
An employee was helping to move a slab of granite when a forklift ran over his right foot, breaking three toes.

An employee was helping unload a compressor from a pallet when the compressor tilted and pinned the employee between the compressor and the ground. The employee suffered a broken right arm and his right ankle was crushed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a flat bed truck while a transformer was being loaded onto it with a sky lift. Outriggers were not used at the time. The sky lift tipped over and struck the employee on the head causing a laceration to the ear and abrasions to an arm and leg. The employee was hospitalized.

While standing on a mezzanine platform, an employee opened a gate and was moving pallets for a powered industrial vehicle to retrieve when he fell out of the open gate to the ground, breaking his femur.
An employee slipped on black ice while opening the lid of a dumpster. The employee's leg was caught beneath the dumpster, breaking the ankle.
An employee was walking in the manufacturing yard when he tripped on a rock and twisted/fractured his right ankle. He required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a shop vacuum to remove a liquid nylon blockage from a machine in the production area. Pressure had built up on the opposite side of the blockage, and as it was removed, the pressurized liquid nylon sprayed out striking the employee. He sustained second degree burns to the face and other burns to both hands and arms.
An employee was carrying a bucket up a ladder to an 18-foot roof. The employee then stepped on plywood sheathing and slipped off the roof to the ground, suffering a broken tailbone.
An employee was leaning against the counter. When she turned around to walk towards the exit she lost her footing and fell backwards resulting in a contusion to the back of her head.

A temporary employee was standing on the forks of a forklift, helping to move and load tile-making equipment onto a semi-trailer, when he fell off the forks. The forklift then ran over his right leg, requiring surgery.

An employee was working with a high-pressure processing machine and was trying to put the push arm back when the machine reset and caught the employee's finger between the sheet metal and the push arm. The employee suffered a contusion and amputation to the left ring fingertip.
An employee fell to the same level while closing a door, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a manlift onto a flatbed trailer when the manlift and employee fell off the side of the trailer. The employee suffered a broken femur and gash to the head and eye area, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while exiting a tote loading cage, injuring the right hip.

An employee was using a jib crane to lower a mold onto a carrier that had a bolt laying on top of it. When the employee attempted to pull the bolt from beneath the mold, it dropped down and smashed his left middle finger between the mold and carrier. His left middle fingertip was partially amputated.
On 1/20/2017, an employee was climbing a ladder to disconnect a service line when the cable he hooked the ladder on snapped, causing him to fall and break six ribs.
An employee fell while running through the parking lot, injuring his right knee and right shoulder.
An employee was pumping a sewer truck into a below-ground holding tank when he fell into the tank, fracturing his hand and suffering a friction burn to his fingers.

An employee was loading a 700- to 800-pound steel billet into a furnace when the billet became misaligned on the loading platform. As he attempted to straighten the billet with a pry bar, it rolled off the loading platform and onto his left foot, breaking bones and crushing toes.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut aluminum metal when the guard became hung up. When he attempted to adjust the guard, his left hand contacted the blade, lacerating his thumb tip and fourth finger. The saw was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating the press. He sustained a de-gloving injury and a broken finger when his hand was caught between the clutch and the roll.

The wiring for an argon oxygen decarburization (AOD) motor caught fire and the AOD had to be operated manually. An employee attempted to insert a crank handle into the AOD crank. As the employee was manually tilting the AOD, it moved beyond the center of gravity and the crank handle started spinning rapidly. When the employee tried to grab the crank handle, his right middle finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, de-gloving the fingertip. The chain and sprocket was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing a window pane on the third floor of a building when the window broke and the glass fell into the fold of the employee's arm, lacerating it and severing two veins.
On 01/20/2017, and employee was descending a 10-foot step ladder when he tripped on the bottom rung and contacted the surface below, fracturing his tibia and fibula.
While delivering mail to a box, an employee fell on an icy street and fractured the left tibia.
An employee was loading or unloading a tote on the back of a truck and descending the ladder when he slipped and fell on his back. He suffered broken ribs and cracked vertebrae.

The employee was walking on two stacked railroad ties to take a picture of aerial construction. The railroad ties shifted causing the employee to fall. A railroad tie rolled into his right leg and fractured it in three places.
An employee was walking by a coworker when she tripped over his foot, fell on the floor, and landed on her side, fracturing her hip.
An employee was tying rebar. As he disconnected his positioning hook to come off the rebar, he fell to the ground, breaking his arm and ribs and displacing a disc in his back.
An employee was placing a safety collar on the cylinder when the machine cycled crushing his right middle finger between the safety collar and the cylinder and causing a partial amputation.
An assailant used a screwdriver to stab an employee's eye and back in the parking lot. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
On January 22, 2017, an employee fell and broke his hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to direct a trackhoe in placing 30-foot concrete barriers on a roadway when a barrier fell on his left foot, partially amputating his pinky toe.

An employee was changing the oil on a prentice machine. As the employee was descending the machine's steps, he slipped and hit his forehead and lacerated the back of his ear on the machine. The employee suffered a TIA (mini stroke) and was admitted to the hospital with slurred speech.
An employee was lifting an I-beam that weighted approximately 75 pounds using a rope. The employee's thumb was caught under the rope as the beam began to drop resulting in an avulsion injury.

On January 21, 2017, an employee was using a rag to clean grease off a printing press when the rag became caught in the machine. A moving part then pulled the employee's left index finger into the machine, amputating the fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
While stepping onto a joist on the second floor of a commercial construction site, an employee fell 13 feet to the ground below, fracturing the left pelvis and elbow.

An employee was working with a flat automated calling system machine and over-the-road container when the container shifted, catching her left hand between the container and a dumper restrain bar. She suffered a left ring finger amputation and fracture.

An employee was replacing sign panels on metal arches over a terminal access road overpass on a parkway. He was working from a boom lift parked at the median while the inside lanes were open to traffic in both directions and the outside lanes and shoulders were closed. An automobile truck carrier struck his boom lift, ejecting him from the basket. His harness/lanyard pulled him back, and he bounced off the basket and landed on the pavement below. He sustained a fractured femur, nine broken ribs, a broken collar bone, a punctured lung, and lacerations on the forehead and calf.
An employee fell from a ladder while installing new HVAC units. The employee sustained a fractured skull and brain swelling, two fractured vertebrae, a displaced sternum, and fractured ribs.
An employee was exiting an office when the right index fingertip was caught and amputated by the closing door.
An employee's right hand became caught in an electrical meat grinder, partially amputating the middle and ring fingers.
An employee tripped over a coworker's foot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was riding a three-wheeled bike when an axle broke and the employee fell, hitting a guardrail and fracturing his back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an extruding repalletizer. The line jammed and when he broke the line loose, his fingers were pulled into the machine resulting in the amputation of the left index and middle fingertips. The machine was energized at the time of the incident.
An employee was standing on a high lift while a coworker was driving a forklift. The forklift struck the high lift and crushed the employee's right foot, fracturing it and causing severe trauma.

On January 22, 2017, an employee was driving a skid steer in an outdoor yard area where bulk materials are staged. At approximately 8:40 p.m., he exited the skid steer cab as a coworker was backing up an agricultural tractor/trailer. The employee was then struck by the tractor/trailer unit, fracturing several bones in his right foot.

An employee confronted a shoplifter attempting to steal liquor.  The employee retrieved the liquor and the shoplifter left the store.  Approximately 1.5 hours later, the shoplifter returned to the store, grocery side, and shot the employee three times - on the side of the head, in the left shoulder and on the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting open a case of ketchup with a box-cutting knife when the knife cut his left wrist.
An employee suffered a partial index finger amputation while servicing a wiring harness machine.
An employee was walking up to the door of a patient's residence when she tripped and fell, breaking her tibia/fibula and dislocating her ankle.
An employee was operating a meat cutting band saw when the blade cut his left ring finger.
As an employee was attempting to put a screen back on a spin dryer, he stepped into an opening on an auger and his leg was crushed/fractured by the auger.

An employee was using a reciprocating saw to cut into a wall made of drywall. The screws came loose on the access panel above the employee's head. The panel swung open and struck the employee on the head resulting in a head contusion and a concussion.

An employee was installing form boards inside a confined space cell. While working inside the cell, a piece of pipe (bell reducer) approximately 7" long, 8" diameter, and weighing 55 pounds fell approximately 35 feet and landed on the employee. The employee suffered a neck fracture and a left hand metacarpal fracture with a complex laceration over the web space.
An employee was loading material onto the roof of a newly constructed home when he fell to the ground and fractured his elbow and hip. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was under a dock plate to change a spring when the dock plate slipped and pinned the employee beneath it. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.
While cleaning debris from a roof, an employee fell approximately 12 feet to the ground, breaking a rib.
An employee was leaving work on 1/23/2017, slipped on the wet sidewalk, and fell striking her left knee on the curb. She was hospitalized for a broken knee.

A crew of three employees had just repaired a heater/treater water leg 3" vitriolic coupling and had pressured it up with a pump. A leak appeared at a bolt on the unit and the two injured employees proceeded to tighten it. While the two were tightening the bolt, they heard a pop and something gave away. They were drenched with liquid and gas. The third employee saw this and shut the pump down and was going to isolate the unit when it caught fire near the coupling. The fire spread to the two drenched employees. One employee suffered third degree burns while the second employee suffered second degree burns.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell striking their head on the pavement.
An employee was entering the building when she slipped on wet tile and fell, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was helping passengers load luggage when he tripped and fell forward, landing on and fracturing his right hip. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was operating a packer machine when he attempted to grab a piece of flex duct that was hanging from the back. His right index finger was caught and amputated by the machine, and his middle finger was cut.

An employee on a scissor lift that had a manually extendible boom was replacing a furnace door. As he was maneuvering the door, he placed his left hand on the lift's top rail assembly, which consisted of a square tubing channel and a U-shaped channel. When he pushed the door against the lift, his left pinky was caught and amputated (above the knuckle) between the two channels.

Employees were using an air hoist to remove the cover from a rotary transmission when the cover became stuck on a 5-gallon bucket. As an employee attempted to push the cover free from the bucket, the cover fell on top of his right arm. His right arm was trapped between the bucket and cover, crushing tissue and muscles. He then fell and fractured a bone in his left hand.

An employee was at a residence to assemble some furniture. When he was walking to the house, he tripped on the concrete curb and hit his head/face. The employee lost some teeth and suffered contusions to face/head.
An employee went to sit down in a wheeled chair when the chair slipped out from under her. She fell and hit her head, requiring hospitalization.
A temporary employee was operating an electric pallet jack and suffered a foot injury when stepping off the pallet jack before it had come to a complete stop.

An employee was preparing a finished boat for shipment. He was placing a battery in the motor box when the lid of the box inadvertently closed and crushed his right big toe, amputating part of the bone.
On January 23, 2017, an employee was stuck on the palm of his hand by a dental hook while collecting instruments to be sanitized. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee working from an aerial lift removing Christmas decorations received an electric shock from a possible arc flash. The employee received second and third degree burns.
While helping to place mats on a basketball court, an employee tripped on a stack of mats and fell on a flashlight and the ground, breaking the right femur.

An employee was entering the plant through another building when a door closed on her right ring finger. The doctor diagnosed the injury as an amputation of the distal portion of her right ring finger.

An employee was using a pipe threading machine to attach a four-way coupling onto a threaded steel pipe. The employee used a pipe wrench to hold the coupling in place. When the pipe wrench was released from the coupling, the foot pedal was engaged and the pipe wrench came down and crushed the employee's fingertip, amputating it.
An employee was working on a chain and sprocket conveyor when the machine restarted and amputated the distal tip of his left ring finger up to the first knuckle.
An employee was reaching for some keys on the wall in the shop area when his foot got caught in a cord and he fell breaking a hip.
An employee was taking a water sample at the out cell. While holding a glass sample bottle, he slipped on the mud and fell. The bottle shattered and cut his left thumb including severed tendons.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and was pinned between the pallet jack and a pole when he stepped off the pallet jack and it continued to move forward. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
At a staging area, an employee shoveling and spreading gravel began experiencing chest pains and shortness of breath.  He was hospitalized.
While cleaning a track for a race, an employee lifted a bucket of snowmelt and suffered an abdominal hernia. He required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on ice or snow in the parking lot, fracturing his hip and one wrist and requiring hospitalization.
While walking and holding a box, an employee tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing his right hip.

An employee was dismantling an elevated platform after the completion of a production. The bolts were removed from a section. When the employee stepped on that section, the floor tipped and the employee fell 7.7 feet landing on his feet and rolling onto his back. The employee suffered bilateral fractures to the ankles and heels.

An employee was inspecting an aircraft engine while kneeling behind it. He put his hand on the rear part of a non-operating engine to pick himself up when the turbine spun and lacerated his gloved left hand between his ring and little finger.
An employee was standing and talking to a co-worker. As she turned to walk away her foot got caught on a chair causing her to fall onto her left side and break the left hip.

The employee was operating a mill machine to put flats on round bar stock. The employee reached behind the stock to check on a radius and was caught between the bit and the stock amputating the right index fingertip.

An employee was walking in the aisle when the drive motor of a press came apart while running at a high speed and a piece flew off and struck the passing employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a scaffold to access the building's roof. As the employee was crossing the walk boards to get to the roof, the employee fell 12-14 feet to the ground resulting in broken ribs and a neck injury.

On January 24, 2017, at approximately 2:13 p.m., an employee was injured while operating a chicken pressure fryer. The lid to the cooker was closed, but did not latch. Approximately 5 minutes into the cooking cycle, the pressure inside the cooker caused the lid to open and grease, heated to 350 degrees, splattered on two employees. The first employee was hospitalized for second degree burns to her back and neck. The second employee was treated for first degree burns to his back and was released.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation when the wind blew an exterior door closed onto the employee's hand.

The employee was driving a loaded garbage truck to the landfill for dumping. As the employee entered the landfill, he rounded a corner and the garbage truck rolled onto its side. The employee fell from the truck and fractured ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing near a truck while another employee was loading the truck using an electric pallet jack. As the employee was driving the electric pallet jack off of the truck and onto the dock, one of its wheels hit some moisture which caused it to skid and strike the other employee's lower right leg fracturing it in two places.
An employee suffered a heart attack after shoveling snow and salting the sidewalk and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a handrail to tighten a screw on a linen chute. The employee fell and was injured.
An employee was unloading material from a flatbed truck and fell from a ladder resulting in three broken ribs and a punctured lung.

A graduate assistant teacher was preparing to run a column chromatograph7 purification wearing a flame retardant lab coat and safety glasses, as well as gloves, long pants and closed toed shoes. A second graduate assistant teacher was sitting at his desk in the same lab at the time. The first teacher struck the bottom of a 4L glass bottle of hexanes on the edge of the bench, while attempting to put the bottle down. The bottom of the bottle sheared off on contact with the bench and the contents spilled onto the ground. Some of the hexane spilled onto the teacher's lab coat, long pants (left leg) and shoe (left foot).  After an initial assessment of the spill, the teacher collected absorbent towels and paper towels to begin to contain and clean up the spill. He was assisted by the second teacher who heard the breakage while sitting at his desk.  Shortly after the teachers began to contain the spill, it ignited explosively causing a flash fire. Both teachers were burned and admitted to the hospital.
An employee was unloading a bundle of flat bar iron from a truck using an overhead crane. The bundle became unstable and the material shifted and struck the employee on the head.
An employee fell approximately 15-20 feet off a bridge and was hospitalized.

On 1/24/2017, an employee was dismounting an excavator when his safety vest got caught on one of the levers. The lever engaged and caused the bucket to drop on a second employee who was standing close to the excavator and crushed both of his ankles.
An employee was trying to hang a part on the paint line while standing on a platform approximately 2 feet high. The employee got dizzy and fell on the concrete floor fracturing his left femur.
An employee was operating a slitter machine and caught his right arm in a pinch point causing a severe laceration.
An employee slipped on snow/ice and fell in the parking lot resulting in a fractured left ankle requiring in-patient hospitalization.
An employee was walking toward a washer with laundry, slipped on a broken tile, and fell breaking the right wrist.
An employee was checking the fried pie line when he felt dizzy and his hand got caught in the pie line rollers. The employee's fingers were degloved.

A driver was trying to tighten a washout cap on a cargo tank trailer when the washout cap blew off and startled him. He fell off the trailer and broke his right femur, separated his left shoulder and sustained a spleen injury.
An employee was pouring molten metal. The molten metal splashed onto and burned another employee that was standing nearby.

An employee reached into a 40-ton press to remove a part from the die. The press malfunctioned due to the "dogs" breaking and the press tripped and crushed the employee's left hand. Four fingers were amputated.
An employee fell 9 feet from a catwalk while helping to move a boat. The employee sustained a fractured leg and a bruised arm and nose.

An employee was picking up steel bars in the holding area to move to another area.  The bars were strapped on one end where his hand was and one of the bars moved pinching his right pinky finger resulting in a split of the fingernail to the bone.
An employee was stepping down from a four-step stand, missed the second step and fell to the hangar floor breaking his left femur.

An employee was transporting a scaffold section from the hall of a school under construction to a bathroom to begin masonry work. The employee had his hand against the wall as he was waiting to erect the scaffold. Another employee slid a section of the scaffold down to the injured employee. At that point the section slid down and amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.
An employee was plowing and shoveling snow and suffered shortness of breath and chest pain.

An employee was assisting another worker with transporting bricks to complete the job. The employee was climbing down from the scaffold when he slipped on one of the railings and fell approximately six feet striking another piece of the scaffold during the fall. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was walking in the front door, tripped, and fell resulting in injury to her left side and elbow.
An employee was lifting boxes and suffered a muscle strain/sprain/tear in his lower abdominal muscles.
An employee was struck by bullets from a drive-by shooting while conducting business at a residence.

The injured employee was driving a 4-wheeled ATV transporting materials and while passing another ATV, steered the ATV to the right. The ATV's right-side wheels rolled onto a parked Bobcat. The ATV tipped over and the employee grabbed on to the left rail bar. When the ATV fell, it crushed the employee's left hand.
An employee tripped and fell fracturing a hip.

Employees were replacing an estimated 250-pound lid on a pump using lifting equipment. The lid came loose and struck an employee on the right calf. The employee was hospitalized for a contusion and abrasion on the right calf.
An employee was installing protective corners on the load of a flatbed trailer and fell off the trailer breaking both ankles.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell approximately 4 feet fracturing an ankle that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking garage, slipped on the painted lines and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was working at the centerfire priming area removing or cleaning excess primers out of the primer bowl when the primers exploded and the employee suffered multiple injuries including first degree burns and abrasions to the forearms, chest, and face. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were working behind the counter and bumped into each other. One employee fell and fractured her pelvis.
An employee was demonstrating the metal bender to another employee when their glove was caught between two rollers resulting in the partial amputation of the left index finger.

On 1/25/2017 at 12:07 PM, an employee was stocking goods in a movie theater.  While moving cases of water bottles, two at a time, his back gave out and the employee fell to the floor. The employee was admitted to the hospital for a back injury.
An employee was coming down a straight ladder, missed a rung and fell less than two feet fracturing a knee cap.
An employee was installing a lining in a pipe that was operating when the inverter blew up and a piece of equipment struck the employee's face.

An employee was assisting in moving a portable truck scale when the load shifted, fell approximately 10 feet, and caught the employee's left-hand fingers between the cribbing and the asphalt resulting in three fingertip amputations and fractures.
An employee fell while replacing a service drop and suffered broken bones.
An employee was taking measurements of the sub-station when an arc flash occurred and burned the back of the employee's left hand to his wrist.
An employee was operating a table saw and amputated the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was relocating sprinklers above the ceiling and was shocked by live wires resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access the blower motor. The employee was standing on the fourth rung when their right hand came in contact with the running pulley belt resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
On January 25, 2017, an employee fell 16 feet off a metal ladder that was fixed to the side of the de-stat booth on a paint line. The employee broke both wrists and sustained a spinal injury.
An employee was walking through a door with a ladder when the wind caught the door and slammed it closed on the employee's left ring finger, resulting in amputation at the first joint.

Two employees were performing maintenance on an electrical generator. While one employee was making adjustments to the generator's fuel system, the other employee amputated his left index finger at the knuckle.
On January 25, 2017, at approximately 3:00 a.m., a driver was injured after falling three feet from a fixed ladder on a tank wagon fuel truck resulting in a back injury requiring surgery.
An employee was walking from the floral department to the produce department, slipped, and fell breaking the right knee.
An employee was conducting product inventory from an eight-foot step ladder and fell resulting in a fracture to the T11 vertebra and a rib. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a set of stairs when they missed a step and fell fracturing the right ankle.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot, slipped on ice and fell fracturing a hip.

On January 25, 2017, at around 9:30 a.m., employee 1 was operating a Skyjack Telehandler forklift with a telescopic boom and outriggers on the front. Employee 2 attached a nylon choker midway down a steel pipe that was 40 feet long and 10.75 inches in diameter. Employee 2 then attached the other end of the checker to a hook located under the boom of the forklift just behind the forks. Employee 1 lifted the steel pipe and carried it to an area where there were existing above ground steel supports. The designated area was muddy and wet. Employee 1 put the outriggers down and extended the boom approximately 40 feet and placed the steel pipe down onto the steel supports.  Employee 2 was removing one end of the checker from the hook on the bottom of the forklift boom that was about 10 inches above the steel pipe, when the telescopic boom came down on top of the employee's right hand that was on top of the steel pipe resulting in fractures and lacerations to his fingers.
An employee was getting up from her chair when her foot got caught in the wires under the desk and she fell, fracturing the left hip.
An employee engaged in bead building activities had their right ring fingertip amputated when it was caught in a pinch point on the bead wire spool.

An employee was threading paper into the hot plate section of the running corrugator. The employee's gloved left hand was pulled into the nip point, trapping his hand/arm between the corrugator belt and the hot plates resulting in burns to the employee's arm and hand.
An employee was walking out of the plastic press, tripped and fell on corrugated steel (part of the platform) lacerating the right elbow and forearm.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot at the end of shift, slipped on ice, and fell breaking their right leg or ankle.
An employee was shot in the right shoulder by two armed robbers.
An employee was stocking the back store room shelves using a mobile stair ladder. As she descended the ladder, the employee lost her footing and fell breaking her right knee.
An employee was walking down a hallway and fell striking her head on the tile floor. The employee suffered a head laceration, a fractured elbow and a fractured finger.
An employee was on a ladder to clean the top of a spray booth. The ladder slid out from under the employee and he fell 5-6 feet to the floor resulting in a broken left femur.
An employee was inspecting a water heater in the attic of a residence and fell 8 feet when the ladder gave way, landing on his back.

The injured employee was standing at the edge of an excavation when an excavator hit a natural gas line while digging resulting in a fire. The injured employee suffered first degree burns to the lower right arm and thigh.
An employee was cutting wood profile samples when his finger was caught under a pneumatic guiding/clamping tool resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was behind the dump truck trying to pull the dump gate up in order to drop it back against the truck and loosen gravel. The truck driver lowered the truck bed and the dump gate crushed the employee's right ring finger.
An employee was  adjusting the tension of a saw belt. The saw was locked out. The employee manually rotated the pulley and caught his right thumb in the belt amputating the tip.

An employee was driving a flatbed delivery truck loaded with construction materials (e.g. lumber) to a residential construction job site.  The employee drove into the respective subdivision and past his destination.  The employee stopped on the roadway, place the vehicle in reverse, and attempted to drive back to the destination. The vehicle stalled and the employee jumped from the cab of the moving vehicle resulting in a broken ankle.
The employee was closing the main cabin door of a twin-engine jet airliner and caught their fingers between the door and the handle fracturing the third and fourth digits on the left hand.
An employee was operating the pop up saw and amputated the right middle fingertip.
An employee was in a man basket spooling wire rope using a chain. The employee's hand was on the rope when the chain moved and caught his right thumb resulting in an amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was sitting a the desk when a co-worker applied lotion. The employee immediately started coughing and suffered a bronchial spasm.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a part into the press when it fell on the employee's leg and fractured the ankle.

On 1/26/17 at approximately 3:15 PM, an employee was working on a tractor supported by jacks when the tractor slipped off the jacks and pinned his hand between the impact wrench he was using and the floor, amputating four fingers on his right hand.
An employee was struck by a pallet on a forklift that was being operated in the area where he was working. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was hospitalized for electric shock when the ladder he was carrying touched the power line.
An employee was moving totes of sulfuric acid with a forklift when a tote was accidentally punctured, causing the acid to spray out and burn the employee's neck, face, and chest.
An employee was using a high pressure hose to wash a conveyor belt. His smock got caught in a sprocket on the machine resulting in an upper right arm fracture.
An employee was walking through the kitchen and fell dislocating his femur at the knee that required surgery.
An employee was working on the motor of the scrap out conveyor when his glove was caught in the chain amputating the right index finger.
An employee was dismantling a furnace scraper when a part of the scraper weighing approximately 40,000 lbs. fell on his right foot amputating multiple toes.
An employee was moving product with a forklift and collided with a pallet jack bruising an ankle.
An employee was riding a horse in the cattle pen. The horse slipped in the mud and fell on the rider. The employee suffered a fractured leg.
An employee was manually lifting a roll of fabric material with a metal pole. The employee placed the pole into its holder and pinched their left index finger resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was attaching a chain to the bucket of the backhoe to remove the shoring box from the bed of the supply truck when he fell backwards over the side of the truck. The employee sustained right shoulder, back, and left leg injuries.
An employee was unloading metal beams when their left hand was caught between two beams. The employee suffered a severe laceration that resulted in medical amputation.

An employee was pushing fish tape through a pipe. The fish tape fell from the employee's hands and onto an energized buss/switchgear creating an arc flash. The employee suffered burns to the face, arm and hand.

An employee was operating a press and encountered a problem with the machine. The machine was powered down to adjust the hardness wheel. When the machine was powered back up, the employee's left index and pinky fingers were amputated.
Two employees were installing a battery on the police boat when the fuel vapors ignited causing a flash fire. The employees suffered third degree burns to the face and arms.
An employee was welding on a stainless foundation and received first to second degree burns under the right arm pit and shoulder area when his shirt caught fire.

An employee unlatched a trailer ramp to let water drain from the trailer after washing it. When the employee attempted to put the ramp back into position to latch it back up, the ramp fell on the employee's arm and fractured it.
An employee was climbing the ladder on the trailer to install a tarp. The employee fell from the ladder and fractured the right hip.
An employee was taking trash to the dumpster and suffered a laceration to the right index finger resulting in hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was ascending a scaffold ladder when his foot got caught in a rung and he fell backwards. A co-worker came to his aid and freed him. While descending the remaining scaffold he slipped and fell approximately four feet to the pavement. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was riding an ATV and fell off the ATV while going around a curve in the road. The employee sustained a fractured arm.

An employee was on a forklift moving bales of carpet. As the employee was moving the bales, the carpet in the back row shifted, causing the bales in the front to fall. The employee jumped off the forklift and as he was running a bale hit him from behind. The employee sustained a fractured right leg, a fractured left fibula, a fractured L3 vertebra, and foreign bodies in left ankle.
An employee amputated the left pinky fingertip with a shaper machine.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to go from one roof section to an upper roof section and missed the top rung. The employee fell 14 feet to the lower roof and hit his head. The employee suffered cracked ribs and a lung contusion. The fixed ladder had a cage around it.
An employee was sitting in a chair in a patient's room. As she stood up, her foot caught the bed side table. She lost her balance and fell backwards resulting in a fractured right femur.

On January 26, 2017, an employee was operating the roll forming machine. The employee's shirt sleeve was caught in the machine pulling his right hand and wrist into the machine resulting in a crushing, bruising, internal bleeding, and swelling injury.  The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

On January 26, 2017, at approximately 12:45 PM, an employee was injured while pulling crates of milk from the energized floor track. A stack of product cases became hung up on the floor track. Using a metal hook, the employee attempted to unjam the cases. The track popped up and caught the employee's left ankle between the track and the metal side barrier on the track resulting in a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was delivering mail and slipped on a residential porch fracturing an ankle.

On January 26, 2017, at 3:00 PM, an employee was performing his rounds such as checking the hide conveyor for fats and paper towel build up to prevent a future problem. The conveyor was running and one of the hooks caught the employee's right arm tearing some of the muscle tissue from the arm. He was hospitalized where he had several surgeries due to E. Coli from the hide conveyor.
An employee was walking through the mechanical room and struck his head on a pipe. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was observing a switch operation during troubleshooting and got a finger caught in the motor belt resulting in two fingertip amputations.
An employee was walking in the work area, tripped and fell breaking the left hip.
An employee walked out the back door to the common area and while going down the three stairs he tripped on the third step and fell breaking his left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a horizontal milling machine when his right arm was caught by the spindle blade and severely lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on rope on the floor and fell, breaking his right femur.
An employee was working at a customer location and slipped while going down the rear, concrete steps and injured his right knee.
An employee was using ammonium hydroxide with water to test a product for lead when he was exposed to potassium cyanide. The employee was hospitalized for cyanide poisoning.
A worker was struck by a moving trailer in the receiving area resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was discharging pipe from the vessel located in the hatch of the vessel. He approached a bundle of steel pipe that had just been lifted by a crane. The crane lifts the load high enough for workers to put a strap under the pipe. When the employee approached to throw the strap he stepped on another loose bundle of pipe that rolled onto his left ankle and broke it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lining up pipes to be connected when the clamp that holds the pipes together broke and the employee's left index finger was caught in the lifting chains amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was installing a curtain wall and fell through a hole in the floor breaking the right femur and the right arm.
An employee was operating a punch press and amputated the left middle finger.

On January 27, 2017, at 9:45 a.m. an employee was attempting to reposition the upper of two loaded Ropak pallets in the Pack Area to gain visual access to the shipping label on the pallet for inventory purposes. The employee's left pinky finger became caught between the two pallets resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working from a ladder and fell approximately four feet injuring his back.
An employee was cleaning a H2S (hydrogen sulfide) tower using a H2O2 (hydrogen peroxide) chemical when a chemical explosion occurred. The employee suffered burns to an ear and leg.

An employee was moving a transport dolly loaded with approximately 200 pounds of sheet metal. As he was turning the dolly, his right pinky finger got caught between a stationary table and the dolly handle resulting in the amputation of his right pinky fingertip without bone loss.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet through a skylight and sustained broken legs, feet, and ankle. The employee was not connected to his lifeline at the time.

An employee was replacing a concrete discharge boot from atop a front end loader. While tightening a bolt, the wrench slipped and the employee lost his balance and fell approximately 10 feet.  The employee struck the hood of the loader and fractured ribs.
An employee was kicking garbage to clear an area and struck a solid object under the garbage resulting in the dislocation of the right knee requiring hospitalization.
An employee working inside a trench was struck by the bucket of an excavator fracturing his hip.
An employee sustained an amputation on his left hand while operating a metal servicing machine.
An employee was assisting a patient and suffered a strain injury to her leg. The employee was hospitalized with a blood clot.

An employee was driving an ATV spraying vegetation control around a pond on a golf course when the ATV flipped on its side and the employee fell off.  The employee sustained a back injury requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal on a hydraulic shear and crushed his right index finger in the shear's hold down.
An employee was installing a cooling tower over a pit when he fell approximately 12 feet into the pit, suffering bruising. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was cutting meat with a bone in a saw. The meat rolled and the employee's right middle finger contacted the saw blade and was amputated.

An employee was assisting with the assembly of an 800-ton hydraulic crane and was preparing to secure the cable bridle to the base section of the luffing jib. The employee was holding the cable with his left hand as it was being pulled through the sheave. The employee's glove and left hand got caught and pulled into the sheave.  As it caught his glove, he pulled his fingers out and suffered the amputation of the left index fingertip, a severe laceration and a minor fracture to the left middle fingertip and a contusion and minor fracture to the left ring fingertip.

An employee was performing decking work and fell approximately 30 feet while moving from one work area to another. The employee suffered broken facial bones. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was changing out a motor on a drag conveyor. Lock out/tag out was removed and power restored to check rotation. When the motor started, the employee's fingers were pulled into the chain and gear box amputating the left index and middle fingertips. The left ring finger sustained a laceration requiring stitches.
An employee was handing out food samples at the store, fainted and fell to the floor fracturing an ankle.
An employee moving meat on a conveyor amputated her left middle finger.
An employee was retrieving documents from a safe and closed their left pinky finger in the safe door resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was trying to stabilize a leaning stacked pallet. He climbed the nearby roof access stairs and was reaching to straighten the pallet when he fell over the stair railing about 10 feet and landed on his back on the floor below. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to repair fractures to his back.

A temporary employee was riding in a track mobile that moves rail cars. While dismounting the moving track mobile, the employee's leg became pinned between the track mobile and a stationary pole.  The employee was hospitalized for a broken leg that required surgery.
An employee was erecting the second tier of a masonry scaffold when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below breaking the L1, L4 and L5 vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the second step of a six-foot ladder in the backroom sorting through hardware bins. The employee began to come down the ladder and missed the last rung. The employee fell and broke the left hip.
An employee was assisting a forklift driver stacking freight. The lifting straps broke and the freight fell on the employee's foot.

An employee was about 13' up a cell tower in a spider basket taking steel off of the tower for new reinforcement. The employee fell and sustained lower back fractures. The employee was not tied off at the time.
An employee's hand was caught between a conveyor belt and a roller.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to transport pallets of food when the employee was caught between the pallet jack and a metal warehouse rack post. The employee sustained lacerations to his left leg near the knee.
An employee slipped on food and fell in a patient's room, fracturing their back.

An employee was walking on the beam portion of the pumping unit attempting to guide the "horse's head" into position when the "horses-head" moved unexpectedly and struck the employee's right foot resulting in a fracture and laceration to the foot.
An employee tapping in a set of electrical cables into the secondary side of a pad mounted transformer received second and third degree burns to the face when an arc flash occurred.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) and removing a stack of pallets from a trailer. While exiting the trailer, the rear of the trailer dipped increasing the distance between the dock plate and the trailer floor.  This caused the PIT to land in the dock pit and the employee was thrown from the PIT. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a bruised liver.
An employee was walking down the stairs in a building when the stairs collapsed and he fell from the third to the first floor landing on his left side and injuring his wrist and back.
An employee was slipping new drilling line when his right hand got caught in the sheave resulting in the amputation of four fingers. The thumb was not affected.
An employee was unloading fiberglass camper shells from a curtain sided semi trailer using a forklift when he fell and struck his head on the pavement.

An employee was waiting at the gate that leads to the press loader. His right foot was underneath the gate and his right toe was hanging over the edge of the pit. When the press loader step indexed down, his right foot got caught between the press loader step and the edge of the pit resulting in a crushing injury to his right toe. The tip of the toe was surgically amputated.

An employee was cleaning the inside of tank with a pressure washer and contacted his left foot with the pressurized water blast. It cut through the top of his safety shoe and caused a one inch cut to the left foot behind the big toe area.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was at a truck wash location and fell and hit his head.
An employee was using a wrench to loosen a nut. The wrench slipped resulting in the amputation of the left thumb tip.
An employee was approximately four rungs up on an 8-foot A-frame ladder when he slipped while trying to tighten bolts on a steel structure and fell breaking the right ankle.

An employee climbed onto the bed of the truck to retrieve a 2x4 off of the rack and fell approximately five feet to the ground.  The employee suffered multiple left wrist fractures and a head laceration.
An employee was struck by a fork truck as it backed up resulting in a head and foot injury.
An employee was sitting in her office when a recently terminated employee came into the office and attacked her. The employee received injuries to the head and face.

An employee was carrying a pan of hot water and walking through a doorway when another employee entered through the doorway, knocking the pan to the floor and spilling hot water onto the employee's feet.
An employee was performing maintenance on equipment when a spring broke and a piece struck the employee's face causing a laceration.

An employee was operating a drill station while wearing gloves. The glove got caught in the drill, drawing the employee's left hand into the equipment and causing an injury to the thumb that may require amputation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing wires going to the head switch and grabbed hold of a live wire resulting in electrical burns to both hands.
An employee was using a coping grinder to grind a piece of flat bar. The flat bar gave way and the employee's hand was caught in the machine amputating the left little finger to the second knuckle.
An employee was operating a vertical wrapper and amputated the left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a truck and fell while descending the ladder backwards (i.e., while facing away from the ladder) sustaining face and back injuries.
An employee was operating a lift and was pinned between the rail and the lift injuring his left toe.
While stocking product, an employee tripped over a pallet and fell injuring a hip.

An employee was standing beside his truck while a truck next to him was emptying a roll-off container. The door of the roll-off container opened and struck the employee on the lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking out of the building, slipped on ice and fell. The employee sustained a head/neck injury and a concussion.

An employee delivered a load to a customer and was unloading the cargo when he was struck in the head with the forks of a forklift. The employee was wearing a hard hat. The employee sustained multiple skull fractures, five staples in the face, and short-term memory loss.
An employee was checking the rice bagging machine when his hand was caught in the jaws of the machine severing the left index finger at the first joint.

An employee was pouring hot fryer oil into the fryer oil bin when he slipped on oil on the floor and spilled hot oil onto himself. He received second degree burns to his arms, legs, stomach and part of his face.
An employee was removing product from a shipping stack when her foot got tangled in the string that holds the stack together causing her to fall and fracture the right hip.
An employee was walking in the parking lot, slipped on ice and fell breaking the right tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking across the yard when he slipped on ice/snow and fell to the ground. The employee broke his left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was on top of the semi-truck unloading steel joists when the load shifted and struck the employee. The employee fell and hit his head on a concrete block.

An employee was conducting well maintenance when the flow line (two inch steel pipe) snapped and struck the employee in the head, back and pelvic areas. The employee then fell approximately three feet sustaining a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a steel cross brace from a steel I beam. The crane hook was not centered over the brace and when the brace came free, it struck the employee in the leg and head. The employee suffered a leg contusion and was hospitalized for blood clots that developed in his leg.

An employee was a passenger on a baggage tractor traveling from one gate to another. When the tractor made a left turn, the employee fell off. The employee sustained a left knee fracture and a right shoulder dislocation.
An employee slipped on ice while walking across the parking lot and fell fracturing their skull and ribs.
An employee was burned by hot water.
An employee was walking across the parking lot on her way to work when she slipped on snow/ice and fell breaking an ankle.
An employee was operating a gas powered saw and lacerated his left leg from the top of the left foot to just below the knee area. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee suffered a double finger amputation injury to his right hand when he contacted the table saw blade in an attempt to dislodge a jammed board.
An employee was attempting to clear a jammed component from a machine and amputated the left ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck by the stretcher.
An employee was operating the shaper that bevels the edges of small pieces angled to fit into a garage door and contacted the shaper blade amputating a fingertip.

An employee had been working on a lower-sloped porch roof and was preparing to get off the roof to have lunch when he noticed a four-foot level was getting close to the edge of the roof. The employee reached for the level and slipped on snow or ice or some other moisture and then fell off the roof approximately ten feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee fell approximately 15 feet from the roof while working. The employee suffered a broken collar bone, broken ribs, a collapsed lung and a concussion. The employee was not using fall protection at the time.
An employee was painting from a ladder when the ladder shifted and the employee fell breaking a femur.
An employee fell 10 feet to the ground while working from a ladder. The employee fractured his left wrist.

An employee was assisting in rigging up and rigging down when their left hand was caught between the blow out preventer (BOP) and elevators. The employee sustained lacerations, contusions and fractures to their hand.

An employee was standing on a small step while working on a vehicle that was up on a lift. He lost his balance and fell backwards hitting a transmission jack when he fell. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
While performing pump maintenance an employee's right hand was caught in the pump area and crushed.

On January 31, 2017, an employee was removing teeth from a core barrel that was used to drill a 30-inch diameter eight-foot deep hole. The employee was facing towards the hole when he was witnessed as experiencing seizure type symptoms. The employee turned around and looked upwards. The employee then backed up and fell into the hole. The employee suffered a broken neck.

An employee was working underneath a trailer trying to remove a wheel with an air gun. The air pressure released causing the gun to jolt and catch the employee's hand between the floor and the bottom of the gun. The employee's right pinky finger was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee amputated his index fingertip on a band saw.
An employee was changing a tire on an industrial floor sweeper when the tire jack he was utilizing collapsed. Three fingers on his left hand were crushed.
An employee was inspecting a crane and the load was set down on the employee's hand during the inspection resulting in amputation of three fingers.

An employee was cleaning a chain and sprocket assembly on a laundry folding machine when his glove was pulled in between the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was walking into work when she either tripped on a curb or walked into a hole in the grass and fell. The employee broke her humerus bone and was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was restraining a patient when the patient sat on his left leg and fractured the tibia and fibula.

A temporary employee was resting on top of the depucker machine guard housing while bottles passed by on the conveyor belt. She braced her left hand underneath the machine's conveyor belt guard to push herself back up to a standing position when her left hand made contact with the moving conveyor belt resulting in the amputation of the first joint of her left index and ring fingers. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking up a ramp to go inside a building and fell off the ramp shattering his elbow.
The employee was switching trailers. While climbing into the trailer, the employee tripped over something and fell backwards out of the truck injuring his right elbow.
An employee was operating a metal sheet roller when a glove got caught in a roller amputating the left index fingertip.
On 1/31/2017 an employee was cleaning out an auger. Tension on the auger was released when the debris was cleared and the blade lacerated the employee's hand.
An employee was walking on a railroad swing bridge platform carrying a wrench when he lost balance and stepped between bridge ties injuring his knee.

An employee was cutting carbon steel metal on a lathe machine. A metal shaving from the cut coiled up and fell into the tee, a fitting used to connect pipe. The material is on a rotating part. A portion of the metal shaving was pushed out of the tee and struck the employee's upper leg above the knee and lacerated it.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell fracturing a hip.

An employee was installing a life ring at the entrance of the floating dock. The dock had become misaligned and off level on the rocks after a recent Nor'easter. A 2x4x8 foot piece of lumber was used to pry up the anchored side of the dock. The lumber snapped and the employee's right thumb was pinched between the lumber and a rock resulting in a partial amputation of the right thumb tip including the nail.
An employee was climbing the ladder on a ready mix truck, slipped and fell to the ground fracturing the lower right leg.
An employee was carrying a pot of boiling water and splashed the boiling water on herself resulting in severe burns to the left forearm.
An employee fell into a tank that contained 180 degree Fahrenheit water while removing an aluminum extrusion from the tank.
On 2/1/17, an employee was operating the printing press when his left hand was pulled into a pinch point. The employee was hospitalized due to his injury.
