An employee was preparing a shell core machine to make shells. The employee installed the right half of the pattern and placed the left into position. The employee activated the machine to bring the two pattern frames together. The rotating cylinder became stuck and the employee hit it with a hammer. The frames then closed on his left ring finger amputating it below the first knuckle.

An employee was hand feeding a copper tube into a finning machine with her right hand. The employee rested her left hand on top of the slide gate guard with her fingertips behind the guard. The machine was in the automatic mode. The slide gate activated and amputated her left small fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a slitter machine's tension roll as part of setup operations when the machine was jogged. The roll pinched the employee's left hand, crushing/breaking fingers and amputating a finger.
An employee was climbing onto the catwalk area and fell injuring their abdomen.
An employee fell on icy stairs while exiting the building and fractured the left ankle.

An employee rode a shuttle bus from the parking lot to the building. When she stepped off the bus and onto the street, she tripped on a curb, fell forward, and struck a cement column. She suffered contusions to the head, face, and scalp.
An employee was terminating loading procedures on the top of a truck trailer when he fell from the trailer to the ground. He sustained a head laceration and broken sternum, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot while helping a customer bring groceries to their car, suffering a left leg injury.
An employee was walking from one building to another when she slipped and fell on ice, fracturing her pelvis.

An employee was on a man lift with a coworker erecting product racks. The employee had his hand on the rail of the basket of the man lift while it was being raised. His left middle finger was then caught between the racking and the rail of the man lift, partially amputating the fingertip.
An employee was stepping backward from a chair in the cafeteria when she bumped into a bench behind her and fell, suffering left hip/lower back pain.
On February 8, 2017, at about 9:30 AM, an employee was inspecting air handling units and amputated his right middle fingertip when it was caught between the moving belt and pulley of a fan blower.

An employee was working on a tractor with a blow gun when the gun's air pressure removed the bolt. The employee's left middle finger was then smashed between the brake chamber and tractor, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee was walking on the property when she slipped on an acorn and fell, fracturing her left leg.

An employee was in a feedlot pen helping a coworker with a steer that was having problems getting up. The coworker was behind the animal and the employee was at its head, attempting to move it. After he moved the steer's head, the animal tried to get up. As it was trying to stand, the steer swung its head and hit the employee's lower right leg, fracturing his tibia.

An employee was hooking up a strap to connect a small excavator to a concrete saw. While a coworker was picking up the saw with the excavator, he attempted to readjust the straps at the moment the two pieces of equipment came together. His left ring finger was caught and amputated from the nail between the excavator bucket and the concrete saw.
An employee was cleaning contaminants from stripper rings on a slitter head when the employee's left arm was pulled into the running slitter and crushed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a wire wheel to remove corrosion when a filament from the wire wheel flew off and embedded itself in his hand. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy brick walkway, tearing her right ACL.
An employee was retrieving a semi truck tire rim from an elevated storage rack using a ladder. The ladder moved and the employee fell and sustained a large gash on the head.
An employee was attempting to remove jammed wood from a band saw when the blade cut his index finger. The saw was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee fell while going from a ladder to the roof, breaking ribs and the collarbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a machine when his right hand was trapped and injured between two parts.
An employee was filling a mixing hopper when two fingers on his right hand were amputated by the mixing paddles.
An employee was making adjustments to a planer when his left hand contacted the fan motor, partially amputating his ring and middle fingers.

An employee was removing a steel pot that was in the upright position. The steel pot was supported by its own weight on the ground. In trying to do so, the steel pot shifted and leaned to one side. The steel pot landed on a piece of cement wall that was adjacent to the steel pot. The employee's finger was caught between the steel pot and the cement wall. The employee's right middle finger was amputated at the last knuckle.
An employee was bending a sheet metal part in a press brake when the employee's left middle fingertip was pinched and amputated between the tool bed of the press brake and the sheet metal part.
An employee was walking and talking to a cashier when she struck a column. She fell to the floor and suffered a fractured right wrist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift truck when he struck a yellow pole. His left foot was caught between the truck and the pole, crushing his left leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a pipe grooving machine when the employee's glove and hand were pulled into the point of operation, partially amputating the right index finger to the second knuckle and the middle fingertip to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting food with a knife when the blade amputated the employee's left thumb. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was de-burring a machine part when the employee's right fingertip contacted the machine and was amputated.

An employee and a coworker were welding on the inboard and outboard sides of a bulkhead. Welding slag became trapped between the sweatshirts of one employee and ignited. The employee suffered first, second, and potentially third degree burns to the right side of the back and right armpit.

An employee was operating a skid pusher to push freight into a trailer while he pulled the door down. The door came down fast and caught his hand between the door latch and the edge of the skid pusher, amputating a fingertip and causing a fracture.
An employee was walking down the sidewalk carrying a briefcase when she fell. She suffered a brush burn to her right hand and a head injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was standing in a box basket being lifted by a forklift, attempting to hang tarp, when the box basket tipped over. The employee fell from the forklift and fractured both knees, requiring hospitalization.
On 2-9-17, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was removing a film wrap from a metal chill roller when he was caught in the equipment, suffering lacerations, contusions, and abrasions.

An employee was shifting a material support stand with a coworker when the employee's left thumb was pinched between the tops of the support being moved and an adjacent support. The distal tip of the employee's left thumb was amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on ice, breaking six ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped in the icy parking lot and broke her ankle, requiring surgery.

On February 9, 2017, an employee was delivering mail to a customer's home. As she made the turn onto the home's front sidewalk, she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, fracturing her right fibula and dislocating her ankle.

An employee was beginning to do a pre-operational inspection on equipment. She was visually inspecting a running tail cutter when she noticed some debris in the wheel. She put on her glove and attempted to clear the machine of debris. When she did, her glove was caught by the equipment, which then amputated her right index fingertip.

An employee was trying to enter the cab of an 18-wheeler by reaching for the steering wheel to pull himself up when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his left fibula and tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee's hand became caught in a drill press and was seriously injured.
An employee was preparing an order by hand to load into a forklift truck. As the forklift transported the pallet, the pallet struck the employee, fracturing and deeply lacerating his lower leg.
An employee was removing lashing (securing) rods from containers when a rod fell and hit the employee on the hard hat, causing a concussion.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy/snowy ramp while exiting a ship, breaking an ankle and requiring hospitalization.
While walking in the parking garage of a jobsite, an employee fell from a step and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping a forklift operator load a non-working truck into a cargo shipping container. The truck was being placed into the shipping container facing outward when the tires slipped off of the lip of the container and the truck bounced. The employee's left ring finger was caught and pinched in the hood, amputating his fingertip.
An employee suffered a foot injury requiring surgery when his left foot was pinched between the forklift he was operating and a racking system.

An employee was driving a utility cart to a cafe to pick up garbage when she overcorrected her steering to miss a parking lot island pier and flipped over. She was pinned underneath the utility cart and sustained a head injury, a fractured clavicle and pelvis, broken ribs, and a punctured lung. She was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a flow meter after applying anhydrous ammonia as fertilizer for corn. When he finished taking the flow meter out of the system, the meter still had product in the line. The product came out of the line and leaked onto the back of his legs, burning his lower calves and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was loading a semi trailer when his right middle finger was caught on an E-track inside the trailer, amputating his distal phalanx.

An employee was performing maintenance on a belt. He placed a 36-inch pipe wrench on the belt while it was out of service. When he turned the belt back on, the wrench flew off and hit him, causing head trauma and multiple facial and nose fractures.
An employee slipped and fell down a flight of stairs inside his workplace, fracturing his right hip and requiring surgery.

While spraying a runaround conveyor machine with a pressure washer, an employee noticed something on the conveyor belt. The employee was attempting to remove the object when the employee's hand was caught between the belt and a moving sprocket. The employee suffered a right arm fracture and tissue damage.
An employee was on top of a shopping cart trying to reach a tote of lettuce on an upper shelf. The employee then fell and injured the left leg.
An employee slipped in the snowy/icy parking lot, fracturing his right ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was dumping a tray of water when her right hand struck the side of a machine. She suffered a contusion that required surgery. The machine was unguarded at the time.

Two employees were unloading equipment with a truck-mounted spooling crane cable. They attempted to untangle the cable by spooling it out. The first employee's hand was on the spool when the second employee engaged it. The cable then amputated the first employee's thumb.
While walking into work an employee slipped on ice and fell, breaking a bone in her leg.
An employee was removing shoring material when it slipped out of the employee's hand and amputated the right pinky fingertip.
An employee was walking in the lot, slipped on ice and fell fracturing the tibia.

An employee was standing on a 3-foot scaffold using a wrench to turn a tool on a machine when his wrench slipped. He slipped off the scaffold and hit the floor, breaking six ribs and suffering a contusion.
An employee slipped and fell on the left side of his back while shoveling snow from the loading dock. He fractured three ribs and suffered bruising.
An employee was climbing down from a pot carrier when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor. He landed on his feet, twisted his right foot, and fractured his heel bone.
On February 9, 2017, an employee slipped and fell on ice while walking from the maintenance shop to a delivery truck, fracturing the left hip.

On February 9, 2017, at about 9:45 p.m., an employee was standing on active hot fryers, containing 350 degree hot oil, to retrieve hood filters when he slipped and fell into the oil. He suffered burns to both legs from the knees down.
An employee was inside a trench box waiting on pipe to be lowered when a piece of PVC pipe fell from above and struck the employee's leg above the ankle.
An employee was placing a hold tag on a pallet in the shipping dock area when a forklift struck him, fracturing his left leg.

An employee was trying to run a sand line down a hole when the line stopped. The stopping motion threw a loop in the line. When the employee attempted to grab the line, it dropped down the hole and amputated three of his right-hand fingers.
An employee was preparing to sweep the floor with a push broom when he stepped on the broom, slipped, and fell, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was driving a truck to a farm to deliver feed. As he turned onto the farm's driveway, the left rear wheels of the truck trailer ran off the driveway's culvert, causing the truck to turn over on the driver's side. He suffered three broken ribs and a lacerated spleen.
An employee was stripping nails from formwork when the formwork shifted and lacerated the employee's left ring finger.
An employee was struck by a forklift, which lacerated his right lower leg and required hospitalization.

An employee was shutting off the valve of a truck tank hose when the pressure caused the lid to blow off. The oil inside the tank then struck the employee, fracturing his pelvis and right wrist and causing a road rash on his chest area. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam in a cutting machine when the machine started up and amputated the employee's fingers.

An employee was installing an arch pipe in a driveway. After the employee released the mechanism on the hoisting apparatus that held the pipe, the pipe fell on the employee's finger, pinching it between the pipe and the concrete driveway. The employee's right ring finger was amputated at the first joint.
Two employees were working on a scaffold when the scaffold's saddle hanger broke, causing them to fall approximately 24 feet to the concrete below. They were hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to close a dock door while sitting on a forklift. He had backed his forklift so that the rear right wheel was on a loading dock leveler that was still attached to a trailer approved for release. When the trailer was moved, the forklift fell over and the employee's hand was pinned between the ground and upper overhead carriage. He suffered broken bones in the thumb and palm area.
An employee was carrying a tub of burritos to be repackaged when he lost his balance and fell, suffering spinal injuries and a herniated disc.
An employee dropped an ink pen on the floor and bent under the desk to retrieve it. The employee's head struck the desk while coming back up, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from a ladder while cleaning snow from a vent. The employee sustained several injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a mail container from her vehicle. When she stepped back, her ankle buckled and she fell to the ground, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was getting paperwork out of a filing cabinet when she tripped and fell, breaking her left hip.
An employee was emptying the truck of salt. The employee tried to clear a jam in the auger when their glove got caught and their left hand was pulled into the auger resulting in a fractured hand.
An employee was reaching under a machine bed to fix a motor when a pin on the actuator broke and the bed fell on the employee's hand, fracturing it.
An employee was cleaning a channel on an anti-caking machine when his glove was caught in a rotating part, amputating his right index fingertip.

A pipefitting crew was installing wear pads on a 30-inch-diameter pipe. When they lifted the pipe with a chain fall, it fell approximately 1 to 2 feet and pinched an employee's right foot between the pipe and support, injuring his right small toe, fourth toe, and the distal portion of his foot. He was hospitalized.
On February 10, 2017, at approximately 5:10 p.m., an employee was attempting to move a nitrogen tank when his fingers were smashed.
An employee was preparing to lift two bundles of cut steel from a conveyor when the weight shifted, causing the bundles to fall onto the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

An employee was cleaning near a conveyor while the plant was in a state of shutdown because of repair activities. The conveyor then became energized and grabbed him, pulling him 75 feet in the air. He fell from the conveyor, injuring his neck and fracturing his hip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice, fracturing a knee and the right ankle.
An employee tripped and fell in the concrete parking lot, fracturing a hip.
On 2/10/17, an employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and suffered serious head injuries.

An employee was moving an oil pan with an overhead crane. The employee attempted to fit the oil pan between a second oil pan and a storage rack. The crane hook hit a support on the storage rack, causing the pan to break free from the crane hook and fall onto the employee's right foot. The employee's foot broke and required surgery.

A transportation driver was attempting to load mail cages onto a trailer and placed them on a lift platform without securing them. When he raised the lift, a cage rolled off and struck the injured employee, who suffered chipped vertebrae.

On February 10, 2017, an employee was using a compressor to spray concrete forms with Clean Strip J1A when the compressor hose became clogged. He attempted to unclog the hose by applying heat. The hose then ignited, burning the employee from his head to toes and requiring hospitalization.

On February 10, 2017, an employee was performing functional tests on a lawnmower. The engine was running, but the drive belts for the mower were not engaged or moving. At approximately 8:15 a.m., the employee was walking near the mower when he tripped and fell.  As he fell, his right hand contacted a sharp area where the belt met a pulley and his right index finger was de-gloved.
An employee was standing on a saw cab platform when the saw blade broke, flew in the air, and struck/lacerated the employee on the right side of the face, requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was operating the cardboard baler when it jammed. The employee's arm was caught in the machine while trying to unjam it. The employee was admitted to the hospital for his injuries.

An employee was using chains to tighten a forklift onto a truck when a chain broke and struck the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized with a tibia fracture, talus fracture, and lateral malleolus fracture.
An employee was setting windows on the first floor when he lost his balance, fell backward, and struck his head on a concrete parking block.

On February 10, 2017, an employee was un-jamming a box stuck between two conveyors when he fell forward and his left hand went between the conveyor belt and a gap roller. His left hand was de-gloved and fractured.
An employee was trying to move granite slabs that were leaning against each other when he lost control of the slabs, which fell on and broke his right leg.
An employee was on his way to service a customer's home, slipped on a patch of ice, and fell breaking several ribs.
An employee was balancing a granite countertop that was on the floor when it fell on and broke his left ankle.
An employee was decorating a cake when she thought a cake was falling. When she reached to save the cake, she fell to the floor and could not get up. She fractured her hip and required surgery.

On February 10, 2017, at about 2:00 PM, an employee was making a beverage delivery with a hand cart loaded with cases. While descending the ramp, the cases started to fall and as he attempted to catch them, his right hand contacted the ramp and his right middle fingertip was lacerated, causing the loss of his finger nail. 

He was admitted the hospital for surgery.
An employee was struck by a scaffold board that was being disassembled, breaking his left wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to install section pipe when the employee's right middle finger was caught and pinched between the flanges of pipe and the existing line.

An employee was standing on a ladder while trimming tree branches with a chain saw when a tree branch grabbed the saw. The employee removed a hand from the saw to try and catch the branch. The saw blade then lacerated the employee's left forearm, requiring overnight hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was emptying trash into an outside dumpster. He climbed a ladder to stomp down the trash. While he was getting back onto the ladder from the dumpster, he lost his footing and fell to the ground below, injuring his back and head.

On February 10, 2017, an employee was using a torch to cut an automotive die when a line ruptured, spraying the employee's legs with hot hydraulic fluid. The employee sustained serious burn injuries to both legs and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a manhole cover and dropped it on his foot. He suffered a left toe injury that required surgery.
An employee was removing concrete product from the molds and got a finger pinched between the pulling beam and the pulled concrete product. The employee's left little finger was medically amputated.

An employee was inspecting a bundle of steel when the overhead crane that carried the steel bundle actuated and pinched the employee between the steel bundle and a steel bundle carrier. He suffered pelvic fractures and crushing injuries to his left hand.
An employee was climbing air-stair door steps when he fell approximately 5 feet to the ground below, striking his head and shoulder.
An employee was pulling a cow head off a slide when another head slid down and amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was working with a palletizer to restock pallets of milk crates when his foot was caught and crushed between the pallet and a catwalk.
An employee was adjusting the position of a mud tank during a rig-up when the tank's hook released and struck him. He suffered a chipped tooth and facial fracture.
On February 11, 2017, at about 6:15 PM, an employee was descending stairs with trash bags in both hands when he slipped and fell. He struck the back of his head and neck and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to weld when his left index finger entered the path of the weld, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee suffered a thumb amputation while cutting meat on a band saw.
An employee was struck by a hydraulic hammer that fell off a front loader.
On February 11, 2017, at approximately 8:10 a.m., an employee was struck by a forklift truck as it was being backed out of a freezer, injuring his lower right leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a crane to lower a 3-inch plate onto support boards. He was down on one knee while positioning the plate and operating the crane when he lost his balance and slipped. As he put his hand out to brace the fall, it was caught between the motor plate and a pallet. His left middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was repairing a fixture to hold a shotgun stock when an air clamp actuated and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was delivering mail when she was shot in the leg by an unknown assailant.
An employee was trying to center a vehicle on a lift ramp by moving a tire rim when his left middle finger was caught and amputated between the tire rim and the caliper.
An employee was retrieving mailbox keys from a safe when the safe door closed on and partially amputated his right pinky finger.
An employee was walking along a pedestrian walkway when she tripped on a pallet and fell. She hit her head, lost consciousness, and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a bone-in pork chop with a band saw when the bone became snagged on the blade and pulled the employee's fingers into the blade. The employee's right middle finger was partially amputated.

On February 12, 2017, at approximately 1:30 p.m., an employee was standing on a metal electrical box, clearing material from a hopper and ductwork. The employee stepped backward and fell approximately 4 feet to the floor, breaking ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was supervising the parking garage at 3:00 AM when a customer attempting to exit the parking garage in their vehicle struck the employee. The employee suffered head injuries and a fractured leg.

The employee was moving a tall pallet load from a trailer with a powered pallet jack. As the pallet was exiting the trailer the top struck the bottom of the trailer's rollup door.  The door fell and the employee attempted to catch it with his right hand. The door dislocated the employee's right thumb that required two metal pins to be surgically inserted.
An employee tripped on a curb in the parking lot while walking to the store, fracturing an ankle.
An employee was attempting to adjust the machine pump in a high-pressure system used to wash cars when the employee's right ring finger was caught and fractured in the pump.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and suffered a fractured hip.
An employee was testing a hydraulic catwalk when a 1-inch hydraulic line burst, causing high-pressure hydraulic fluid to release and lacerate the employee's left palm.

An employee was performing service and maintenance on a machine when the pulley unit lacerated and fractured the employee's right hand, requiring surgery and hospitalization. The machine was unguarded and energized at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while clearing snow, fracturing his ankle and requiring surgery.
A volunteer was skiing and fell approximately 20 feet off the edge of the mountain suffering a head injury and several crushed bones.
An employee was coming down a trailer side ramp with a dolly when he fell to the ground, lacerating his legs and breaking ribs. He was hospitalized.

On 2/13/17, an employee was operating a crane and hook to load material onto a truck. When the employee lowered the crane hook to remove a sheet lifter, the employee's right index finger was pinched and amputated within the D-ring.
An employee was opening a security gate and attempting to release a bent locking mechanism when his right ring finger was caught in the mechanism, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was helping a coworker load a piece of equipment called a "walk-behind" onto a trailer. He was at the back end when they lost control of the equipment, which started to roll. His left middle fingertip was crushed and amputated by the equipment and the trailer.
An employee was changing a die on a press brake when the brake came down and caught his left middle finger. His finger broke and required surgery.
An employee was carrying pies in the kitchen when she lost her footing and fell, striking her head on a counter and the floor.

An employee was performing maintenance on a jammed turntable in an industrial parts washer. When he opened up the parts washer and stepped in, a section of screen collapsed and he fell into water that was approximately 180 degrees. He received second and third degree burns on his foot and shin.
An employee on a ladder was installing cable at a residential home when he fell 17 to 20 feet and suffered multiple head injuries.
An employee was performing maintenance activities on a rock crushing machine when the machine's bucket struck him. He suffered a chest contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a cookie divider when her arm was pulled into a roller, fracturing it. She was hospitalized. The cookie divider was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was cleaning trim extruders on the lower side of a locked out auger. During the cleaning process, the equipment was unlocked. At that time, the employee's right finger entered the auger's drain port and was amputated.
On February 13, 2017, at about 4:30PM, an employee was visiting a patient in their home and slipped and fell fracturing an ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left thumb was caught in a closing bank vault door, amputating the tip.

An employee was setting up at his workstation while a nearby coworker was moving a pallet of parts. The pallet struck an empty pallet, which in turn struck the employee as he tried to move out of the way. He fell and landed on the empty pallet, injuring his back.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while crossing the road, suffering knee contusions.
An employee bent down to remove extra trim off a paper product. When he stood up, he struck his head on machine railing. He was hospitalized with a brain hemorrhage.
An employee was searching for a tool under a maintenance work table. He suffered lower back pain when getting up off the lowered position with bent knees.

An employee was operating a skid steer to remove snow during a snowstorm when he felt something in the blades of the skid steer. He shut down the PTO switch, got out, and attempted to retrieve the object. During this process, his coat pulled the PTO switch back to the on position, and the equipment caught his glove and then hand, amputating his left index fingertip below the first joint.

An employee was standing on a ladder changing out a light fixture. As he reinstalled the light, he was shocked when he touched the wiring. He fell approximately 4 to 6 feet from the ladder and struck his head on the concrete, fracturing his skull. The fixture was energized at the time of the incident.
The employee was observing an overhead crane moving a load and was walking. As the employee walked his left foot became caught between two air line pipes. He fell and broke his lower left leg.

An employee was driving a reach truck when it malfunctioned, stopped suddenly, turned right, and collided into another reach truck. The employee's leg was amputated below the knee during the collision.
An employee was helping a coworker hoist a motor to change out an auger when his right pinky became caught between the motor and the railing, amputating his fingertip.

An employee on a scaffold was helping to install metal roofing material when a strong gust of wind blew and knocked the employee over the rail. The employee fell 10 feet to the floor, suffering skull and vertebrae fractures.
An employee was climbing down the end ladder of a railroad hopper car when he lost his footing and fell approximately 7 feet to the ground, sustaining bi-lateral heel fractures.

An employee and several coworkers were moving a storage rack that was on pallet jacks when the storage rack struck another unit and the employee's right pinky fingertip was pinched and amputated between the rack and a wood shelf.

An employee was forming metal on a press brake when he experienced a cramp in his leg and began to stretch his leg to get the cramp out. In the process of taking care of the cramp, the foot pedal was engaged which caused the machine to cycle and partially amputate his left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was attempting to remove steel plates from a case packing machine that was held in position by two bolts. After the employee removed the top bolt and loosened the bottom one, the plate swung down and struck the employee's left hand, partially amputating the left thumb.

The employee was standing on a catwalk and using a cord tied to his hands to remove an empty film roll from a machine. The cord got caught in a roller beneath the catwalk and amputated the employee's left ring and index fingers.
An employee was operating a snow blower when he slipped and tried to brace the fall with his left arm. He hit the ground and fractured his left arm, requiring surgery.
On February 13, 2017, an employee was trying to adjust a stack of pallets in a trailer when the pallets shifted, causing the employee to fall and fracture the right elbow and right hip.

An employee was performing prime-up operations when a discharge hose with a winged connection came loose from a manifold trailer. Boost pressure was being applied to the hose, causing it to whip around and spray water. As the hose was whipping around, it struck and fractured the employee's lower left leg.

An employee's left hand was caught by the rotating spindle of a lathe, partially de-gloving the hand and amputating the thumb, index, and middle fingers at the first joint. The lathe was unguarded at the time.
An employee suffered asthma exacerbation after using scented hand lotion, requiring hospitalization for respiratory distress.

On 2/13/2017, an employee was working on an airplane in flight from Arkansas to Virginia when the airplane experienced flight turbulence, causing the employee to slip/trip/fall and fracture her right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was manufacturing metal cylinders. A cylinder slipped and fell 12 inches. As the employee tried to catch it, two fingertips on the left hand were amputated.
An employee was walking along the side of a levy when he slipped and fell on damp grass, breaking his ankle in two places.
An employee was using a screw machine to make pipe fittings when some metal chips jammed the machine. As the employee attempted to clear the chips, the machine crushed the employee's hand.

An employee was performing a leak check on an engine cart by introducing air into the cart and spraying to check for leaks. He noticed leaking around the cap. He unlogged the cap, which had a latch on it. When he leaned in to get to the second latch, the pressure pushed the cap off. The cap hit him on the chin, fracturing his jaw and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was making a delivery when he slipped and fell on ice, fracturing his right lower leg.

Two employees were carrying a sheet of metal decking. When they went to put the sheet down, one employee's finger was caught between the cement wall and the sheet of metal decking, amputating the left index fingertip.

An employee was cleaning out the drain port underneath a mixer tank. He removed the drain port cap and was attempting to clear out the port when the mixer ribbon (metal agitator) struck his hand and partially amputated three fingers.
An employee was emptying trash around the job site into the main trash bin when a reversing skid steer ran over and fractured both of his feet and ankles.
An employee was pulling a cool lift when he lost his balance and fell, striking his head on a guardrail and the ground and fracturing his wrist.

An employee was spotting for a truck driver who was backing up to deliver a chemical barrel. When the vehicle stopped, the chemical barrel came loose and struck the employee, fracturing his scapula, both feet, and his tibia.

An employee was getting back into the passenger side of his truck. When he grabbed the handle of the door, his hand slipped and he fell about 3 feet to the ground, fracturing his right tibia and fibula.

An employee was observing the processing of pipe and noticed something had fallen off or was not correct during the process. He was walking across the hot pipe to retrieve the part when he slipped and fell onto the pipe, suffering third degree burns to his buttocks and the anterior side of his thighs and left hand.

An employee was using compressed air to clean out materials in a saw. The employee's left hand was on the frame of the machine when it cycled and a brass rail caught the employee's thumb and pinched it against the frame. The employee's left thumb tip had to be surgically amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was putting parts into boxes near the rolling mill when the mill needed to be loaded with a new coil. During the loading process, the employee's glove was caught and pulled into the mill, and the employee's left pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was changing tooling at the form molding machine when the tooling fell and struck the employee's left thumb, amputating the tip.
An employee stepped out of a manlift 5 feet above the ground and fell, striking his head on the cement floor.
An employee slipped while walking on a muddy ramp, fracturing her right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking across the jobsite when a reversing bulldozer struck him, breaking his right leg and dislocating his left hip.

An employee was threading a paper roll that was not moving. She went to the front of the roll to grab the tail. As she did so, her foot bumped the foot pedal and actuated the paper roll. An employee was inserting a locking pin into a bushing when the locking pin amputated the employee's right thumb.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut wood when his left hand went under the saw blade and was lacerated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a part onto a machine when his hand was caught between a boat sleeve and a cone. His hand suffered possible broken bones and a severe burn.
An employee was ground spotting during post pulling activities when his fingers were caught between the post pulling plate and a rigging strap. He suffered one broken finger and one lacerated finger.
An employee was transporting racks of water bottles on a cart when the cart became caught on a drain depression and tipped over, causing the bottles to fall on him. He suffered three broken ribs.
An employee's left thumb was caught between a hydraulic clamp and the copper tube that was in the clamp. The thumb was surgically amputated at the last knuckle.
An employee fell approximately 5 feet while climbing on a vertical metal formwork to install whalers. The employee was hospitalized with back bruising.

An employee was packing tubes in a box from a moving plastic cleated conveyor in the Packaging Department. The employee's work glove was caught on the moving conveyor pulling his hand into the static plate on the conveyor and amputating the right index finger.

An employee was laying metal decking when his foot slipped on a bar joist, causing him to lose his balance and fall 17 feet to the ground. He suffered a fractured rib, fractured vertebrae, and a lacerated liver, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was setting a trailer onto a hitch when he climbed underneath the tongue to try and position it. The tongue slipped off the ball and struck him in the head. He was hospitalized with forehead lacerations.

An employee was operating a flexography machine when the conveyor belt began to jam with boxes. As the employee attempted to adjust the belt, the rotating belt's stitching removed the skin and fingernail from the employee's left pinky finger.

An employee was helping a coworker lower and position a steel beam onto a rolling cart when his right middle finger was caught between the steel beam and the rolling cart, amputating his fingertip at the nailbed.
An employee was working on the roof of a weather shelter when he fell 6 feet to the ground, crushing three vertebrae.
An employee's right index finger was caught on a shackle on a rehang line, amputating it above the second joint.
On February 14, 2017, at 12:45 p.m., an employee's right foot became caught on his desk, causing him to fall to the floor. He broke his left hip and was hospitalized.

An employee entered a walkway that was near a portable dust collection system. The system created a blind spot, and a forklift struck the employee, who suffered a fractured right elbow and crushed right foot.
A temporary employee was using a sander and cut her left ring finger. Her fingertip was surgically amputated.

An employee was unhooking her seatbelt while exiting a mail vehicle on a rural route when the shoulder strap fell and hooked onto her shoelace, causing her to fall to the ground and fracture her left hip.

On February 15, 2017, an employee was performing a leak check on a stainless steel vessel. A nut had become stripped, allowing a bolt to fly off and hit the employee in the nose and forehead. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations, a broken nose, and a broken eye socket.
An employee was rigging up a railroad car for unloading when a coworker unbound the chains, causing the load and the employee to fall. The employee suffered a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
While closing two oven doors, an employee's fingers went through the door handles and were pinched between the doors, amputating two fingertips.
On February 15, 2017, an employee was working cables for dry dock spray curtains with a capstan. His left index finger was caught in the cable where it meets the drum, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was operating a floor buffer on the second floor when he stepped back and fell from the upper level, which had no guardrails in place. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a dumpster when his hand was pinched between the forks of a forklift and a dumpster attachment, partially amputating his left pinky finger.
An employee was catching a horse when it kicked her in the chest. She sustained a contusion and bruising to her chest and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a Lull operator offload crates of switch gear from a truck when one crate became caught on another. The Lull operator then tilted the forks down. The products slid down and pinched the employee's right fingertip, amputating it.
An employee slipped on black ice while checking on trailers in the yard, fracturing an ankle.
An employee was using a handheld portable grinder to grind a vehicle bracket when the grinder came apart and struck him in the face, causing facial lacerations and multiple avulsed teeth.

An employee and a coworker were exchanging a mold. The coworker raised the mold with a stand forklift while the employee used a hand to lift a part. The employee's fingertip was then caught and amputated between the upper part of the mold and the forklift structure.
An employee's right arm was caught in a "notcher" machine and amputated above the wrist.

An employee was dismantling an excavator when the excavator counterweight (6.2 tons) fell on and crushed the employee's leg. The lower right leg was amputated. The employee also sustained a fractured arm, hips and vertebrae.
An employee was unloading a truck when his hand was caught and smashed between a forklift tire and a piece of wood, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell to the frozen ground while getting on a steel frame to lay out decking.

An employee was watching an operator load materials with a forklift. The operator tilted the forks slightly, which caused the material to break its straps and roll off the forks. The employee jumped to get out of the way and fell on the cement floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was conducting rigging operations in a vessel's cargo bay when he stepped back on ulexite mineral and fractured his right tibia.

An employee was giving a hockey lesson on an ice rink when his hockey 
stick broke under pressure, causing him to lose his balance, twist his body, and fall on the ice. He fractured his right fibula and ankle.

An employee was walking to a sampling location when he tripped on a barge rib and fell, striking the steel beam with his face. He busted his teeth, fractured his nose, and punctured an artery, requiring surgery.

On February 15, 2017, at about 8:42 AM, an employee tripped on a pallet and fell, fracturing his right foot. 
He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was carrying two castings on top of one another when one of the castings fell and landed on his foot. His toe was medically amputated.

An employee was operating a winding machine when it became jammed, causing the stitching to break. As the employee attempted to remove the string, his left middle finger was caught and lacerated between the machine's sling and pulley. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
On February 15, 2017, at about 9:30 AM, an employee was using an excavator to push a concrete pipe together when his right forefinger was partially amputated above the fingernail, requiring surgery.

An employee was cutting stretch film for pallets when he was pinned between a stack of pallets and a forklift being operated near the stretch film cutting station. He suffered broken ribs and liver damage.
An employee was loading product from a cherry picker onto a rack when the lift malfunctioned and the platform fell to the ground. The employee fell with the platform and fractured an ankle.
An employee was operating a floor scrubber when she slipped, fell, and suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was pulling on a car carrier to hook it to the back of a truck. The car carrier handle broke and the employee fell and hit his head on the ground.

An employee was walking to a dock door to meet a delivery person. She opened the folding hand truck before opening the overhead dock door. The two sections of the hand truck pinched her left little fingertip, severely lacerating and amputating it.

On 02/15/2017, at approximately 1200, an employee was operating a stand-up lift truck when the employee's left foot became stuck between the lift and a rack system. The employee suffered foot lacerations and was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a check valve in a pipe and was burned by water that was 165-170 degrees Fahrenheit.
On 2/15/2017, an employee was trimming parts on a trimming press and had a finger on the right hand crushed, resulting in amputation.

An employee was taking a roll of paper off a skid to put on the paper machine when the roll fell over and pinned him between it and the floor. He suffered a fractured lower leg and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking to check the clearance between a truck and the dock when a passing vehicle struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee was cutting a piece of paneling on a table saw. When she tried to move some debris near the saw, the blade amputated her right index fingertip.

An employee was re-installing a roller assembly after working on a motor beneath it when the roller assembly slipped and pinched his fingers between it and a cross-member. His right middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

An employee was climbing a communications tower when his hand slipped while he was reaching for a cable grab. His fall arrest system failed to engage and he fell to the platform below, injuring his L1 vertebra, breaking his left ankle, and shattering his right heel.

As the injured employee was kneeling down and rolling rims to a coworker, a third employee engaged him in a verbal confrontation and kicked him in the face while wearing steel-toed shoes. The injured employee was hospitalized with blunt force trauma to the head.

An employee was attempting to re-thread a broken sheet through a roll on an extruder when he fell backward. His left hand hit the bottom pull roll, which pulled his left arm into the machine, crushing it and requiring surgery.
An employee was closing the bulk mail container's metal door when it fell on his right hand, amputating his middle fingertip.

On February 16, 2017, at approximately 3:05 p.m., an employee was walking through the shop when he stepped into a deep hole in the concrete floor, twisted his ankle, and fell, fracturing his left shoulder.
An employee was positioning equipment while getting ready to repair an over-the-road container when his left pinky finger was caught and amputated in the container door.

An employee was changing the boom cable on a drum. He was standing between the boom drum and the holding drum on the frame below. While feeding the dead end of the cable with his left hand, he was using his right hand to balance himself on the drum. In the process, his right hand slipped and was caught between the cable and the drum. He was then pulled down and flipped over. He landed on the floor between the drums, dislocating his right elbow and fracturing his right wrist.
An employee was standing in the warehouse removing freight from a trailer when merchandise fell on him, fracturing his L1 vertebra.
An employee was on the front bumper of a front loading dump truck assisting the driver who was having issues with the canopy when he fell onto the ground fracturing his right hip.
An employee was changing the tool in a CNC stamping machine when the tool fell and smashed the employee's left pinky fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was operating a pump and was moving it from one drum to another when the rotating blade on the pump amputated his right pinky finger.
An employee was carrying two 1-gallon bottles when his foot was caught on the leg of a power press and he fell, striking and breaking his lower leg on the foot of the machine.
An employee was injured when his lower leg was struck by a forklift.
An employee was attempting to re-spool electrical wire onto a drum when he tripped over the wire and hit the ground, fracturing his ribs, right index finger, and left elbow.
An employee tripped over a rolling apparel rack and struck the floor, breaking her femur.

On February 16, 2017, at approximately 8:30 AM, an employee and a coworker were walking along the right side of a trash truck, picking up trash bags and containers. His coworker picked up a large trash bag, swung it around, and accidentally struck him, causing him to lose his balance. The truck's rear tires then ran over both his ankles and feet. He suffered left foot fractures and bruises/cuts to his right foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell on snow/ice while picking up a client at her home, breaking her hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was burned and hospitalized after a fire occurred at a natural gas well.

An employee was standing on an extension ladder installing shingles on the roof. The employee was using a nail gun when the hose became tangled. The employee pulled on the hose and fell approximately 5 to 6 feet from the ladder to the ground, breaking vertebrae.
While descending from a roof, an employee fell 8 feet to the ground and injured his left lower leg.
An employee tripped over a threshold where the floor transitions from carpet to tile, suffering right arm, shoulder, and femur injuries.

On 02/16/2017, at approximately 10:50 a.m., an employee tripped on the door threshold while entering a parts stockroom through an outside entrance. The employee stumbled forward and landed awkwardly, breaking a bone in the left upper leg and requiring surgery.

An employee was inspecting a pump house frame when he discovered the back board box was installed upside down. He enlisted a coworker to help remove and reinstall the box. His left hand was inside the box and his right hand was underneath it as it moved a few inches. When it cleared the framework, the box fell and pinched the employee's finger between it and a piece of angle iron below. His right middle fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was unloading propane tanks from a truck using a hand cart when he lost his balance and fell backwards to the ground. The tank then fell on and injured his left ankle.

An employee was using an open-top tractor with a front-end loader to push a fallen tree when a limb (about 8 inches in diameter) fell on his face. He sustained a facial bone fracture and contusion on the back of the head, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking through the aisle of the store, interviewing a potential employee, when he tripped over a grill that a co-worker was assembling. He contacted the ground and broke several ribs, his pelvis, and vertebrae.

An employee was attempting to start a malfunctioning truck engine while standing between the wall and the front of the truck. The employee sprayed starter fluid into the air filter while a coworker was turning the ignition key. The engine started and the truck moved forward, pinning the employee between the truck and wall. The employee suffered a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a boomer on a trencher with a ratchet. When he stood up, his back seized up. He was hospitalized with a bulging disc and pinched nerve in his back.
An employee was prepping film on the production floor when he slipped and broke his femur.
An employee suffered a right middle fingertip amputation (no bone loss) while using a band saw to cut pork belly.
An employee was inserting a laminated panel into a pinch roller when the employee's left index finger was crushed and fractured between the panel and the roller.
An employee was repairing a door in the fitness room. When the employee bent over to pick up tools, the employee suffered a lower back strain.
An employee stood on the second rung of a platform ladder while cutting a door opening. When he stepped off the ladder, he rolled and fractured his left ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee approached a coworker who was trimming the lower part of a carcass with a knife from behind. His coworker then accidentally punctured his right chest wall with the knife, injuring his right lung and requiring hospitalization.

An employee fell while cleaning around a piece of equipment injuring his left hip and requiring hospitalization. The employee was walking next to a transformer that had an electrical conduit connector protruding out a couple of inches. The employee's pant leg was caught on it which caused him to fall.
An employee was sweeping on the furnace deck when he fell backward into a pit that was 12 feet deep, injuring his back and requiring hospitalization.
A patient struck an employee in the abdomen, causing blunt abdominal trauma.
An employee was pinned between a reversing truck and a wall, suffering a punctured left lung and eight broken ribs.
An employee was attempting to clear a chocolate outlet tube when a rotating agitator inside the chocolate tube amputated her right middle finger above the top joint.
An employee was fixing damage to a custom trailer door using a pry bar and block of wood when the door shifted at the top and amputated the employee's right finger.
An employee was called to provide assistance with controlling a patient. During the struggle, the employee suffered a heart attack.
An employee was using a machine when it caught his glove and pulled his finger in, amputating his fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he lost his grip on the rung and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below. He damaged his shoulder and fractured his pelvis, wrist, and elbow.
An employee fell after slipping on snow and ice in the parking lot, breaking his left femur.
An employee was handling sheet metal on a brake press when his left thumb was caught in the point of operation. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On February 17, 2017, at approximately 7:45 AM, an employee was uncoupling a 2-inch airline from an air compressor when the pressurized line became unhooked and whipped around, striking the employee in the lower right leg. The employee suffered right tibia/fibula fractures.

An employee was cutting a tree limb with a chain saw in the bunching area on top of the tree. He noticed the limb was under pressure and stopped cutting. He was stepping over the limb when it snapped and struck his left leg, breaking both bones above the ankle.

An employee was attempting to offload liquid, caustic soda from a trailer. The trailer was parked on a downward slope which allowed the chemical product to enter the dome area and contact/burn the employee's face and neck.
An employee was looking over the second-story balcony of a building when the guardrail gave way and the employee fell to the ground. He suffered pelvic and rib injuries.

An employee was moving a large rolling tote full of paper for shredding when the employee either tripped and fell or the tote fell on the employee. The employee suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was standing on the back of a lavatory service truck while he was servicing water into the system. As he was connecting a dump hose onto the aircraft, he stumbled, fell 61 inches, and hit his head on the concrete floor. He sustained a contusion on his head, fractured four ribs, and fractured his left thumb, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was grabbing a sheet of metal off a roof when the bolt that was holding it in place became stuck. When he pulled on the sheet, it slipped and fell on his left leg, cutting it so that it required hospitalization.
An employee was weighing out potassium cyanide and walking it to the lab hood. The employee suffered acute potassium cyanide poisoning. A proper respirator was not worn at the time of the incident.
While moving materials across planking, an employee fell 11 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured right wrist.

On February 17, 2017, at approximately 9:45 a.m., an employee was tightening a cylinder gland into the chuck of a lathe. The employee dropped the chuck wrench, which struck the lathe engagement lever, causing the lathe to actuate and eject the part. The part struck the employee, who was hospitalized with a back strain and contusions to the stomach and chest.

An employee was sitting down in front of a machine observing the operation. While attempting to stand, the employee lost his balance and put an arm out to catch himself. The fleshy portion of his right forearm pushed through a gap in the machine's guard, lacerating it between the wrist and elbow.
An employee suffered broken ribs when caught between the bottom part of the rig basket and the pump jack beam.
An employee was lifting stone material with a suction cup when the slab came loose and crushed the employee's right middle finger, amputating the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was removing a two inch plug and was thrown by the pressure build up (1100-1200 psi). The employee suffered a puncture wound to the leg, a broken left arm and fractures to the head and face.
An employee was pressing a stainless steel shaft into a wheel when the shaft shattered and became lodged in the employee's abdomen.
An employee's hand was on the inside of a doorframe while a coworker was holding the door. The coworker closed the door, which amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee fell and struck a scaffold while climbing a ladder to the roof, suffering a fractured cheek bone.
An employee was operating a construction roller machine when it tipped over. The employee fell off the equipment and received internal injuries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down the stairs and suffered head trauma, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working from a ladder to connect a light fixture. The circuit was live and shocked the employee, causing him to fall 8 to 10 feet off the ladder. He suffered a minor electrical burn on his left hand, a lower back fracture, and a fractured right heel.
An employee was walking down an aisle in the warehouse when he tripped over a shelving unit's end cap and fell to the floor, breaking his right elbow.
An employee was lowering a cover die with an overhead crane when his left index finger was pinched and amputated between the cover die and the machine sleeve.
An employee fell on the handles of a sled he was dragging and fractured his hip, requiring hospitalization.
While fabricating a metal bench, an employee placed a metal clamp on top of the bench. The clamp was not secured and fell on the employee's right thumb, amputating the tip.

An employee was seated behind the reception desk at which he works. Dust from ongoing construction activities in the facility reached the employee, who experienced respiratory distress. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a stack truck to move a pallet of materials from the racks. When he backed up the truck to reposition it, his arm became jammed between the truck and a pallet of materials on the racking behind him. His arm broke.
An employee was cleaning a piece of equipment when a piece fell and amputated his thumb tip.
An employee was struck by a loader while walking through the plant, suffering multiple fractures to the pelvis and legs. The employee was hospitalized.

On February 18, 2017, at approximately 5:30 p.m., an employee was replacing the chain on a breading machine conveyor that was turned off. The power was restored to the machine while the employee was checking the tension of the chain. The moving chain caught and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was walking around a stacker truck when the truck operator ran over the employee's left foot. The employee's left pinky toe had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was attempted to cross over a gap from one elevated work platform to another when he fell approximately 6 feet to the floor, fracturing his left tibia. The platform was unguarded and fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee suffered frostbite to his left ring and pinky fingertips after working in the freezer. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were manually lifting a forklift boom to position it for a forklift. As the employees lifted the boom the jib slid towards the ground and smashing two fingers on one of the employee's right hand.

An employee and a coworker opened the hood of a dump truck to diagnose why the fan of the radiator was not engaging. The injured employee was on the passenger side while the coworker was on the driver side. The coworker entered the cab and started the engine. The injured employee contacted the radiator's belt and pulley at that moment, which amputated the end joint of the employee's right index finger.
An employee was walking to a truck to turn on a pump when he slipped on ice dislocating and fracturing his ankle.

An employee sustained a right arm injury requiring hospitalization while cleaning a conveyor belt in the raw processing area. The employee was crouched and cleaning the bottom area of the conveyor when he lost his balance and attempted to stop falling forward. His glove was caught in the moving conveyor belt and pulled his arm in and under the belt.
An employee amputated the tip of his thumb while cleaning a food sealer.
An employee was carrying hot oil for disposal when he slipped on ice on the pavement splashing hot oil onto his face, neck, chest, arms and legs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was underneath a tanker trailer checking the 5th wheel hook up and struck the back of his head. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and skull fracture.
While trying to elude a large flying insect, an employee fell and fractured the right elbow, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw and amputated the tip of his pinky finger.
An employee was removing a piece of pipe when he lost his balance and fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. He bruised his lung and broke his wrist and ribs.
An employee was picking up a pallet when a nearby wheelbarrow tipped over and struck the employee's right ankle severing the Achilles tendon. The employee was hospitalized.

On 2/19/2017, an employee was about to start fueling an aircraft. He was walking between two baggage carts when one of the cart operators moved and he was caught between the two carts. He was hospitalized with head and right arm injuries.
An employee was attempting to dislodge a bottle from the bottling scrambler machine when the machine's belt amputated his ring fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

On February 19, 2017, an employee slid down a containment mat and struck a pressure gauge on the wellhead while attempting to pull slack in a wire line. He suffered a rib injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on the elevated surface of a scaffold. As he turned the corner from one scaffold to another, he fell approximately 15 feet to an elevated roof deck below, lacerating the back of his head and suffering other scrapes and bruises. He required hospitalization.
An employee was climbing into a truck when he slipped and fell, landing on his neck. He broke two neck bones.
As an employee was manually moving a part onto the forks of a forklift, the part slipped and pinched the employee's finger between it and the ground, amputating the right middle fingertip.
An employee slipped on wet leaves in the parking lot while getting out of her car and fell. Her ankle was broken in three places.
An employee was cleaning the blade of a power tool when it activated, partially amputating his right thumb. The blade was unguarded at the time.
An employee was operating a buffer machine when his right hand was caught between the die and the rollers resulting in a crushing injury to the ring and pinky fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving drywall on a motorized pallet jack when his leg was caught and fractured between the jack and a scissor lift.
An employee was ripping lengths of oak on a table saw when the employee's left hand contacted the unguarded saw blade, amputating a fingertip.
An employee was retrieving an order from the stock room when he tripped over some boxes and fell, breaking his lower left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell off a stepladder to the floor, suffering two lumbar compression fractures and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a load of pipes when it fell and broke his left index finger. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was leaving the dock area in the dark and walked into a steel park stop used as a bumper for trucks. Both shins were lacerate and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a scaler at the batter depositor. The depositor needed to be adjusted for the weight of the batter being deposited in the cake pan. The employee was fixing the adjustment handle and amputated their left pinky fingertip.

On February 20, 2017, an employee was getting materials from on top of an elevated mezzanine when the employee fell 8 to 10 feet to the lower level. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and hematoma on the right shin and a bruised left hip and eye.

An employee was using a portable band saw to create quality samples from steel tubing. He held the band saw with his right hand and attempted to catch the sample piece with his left. The saw blade bound up inside the tubing. He was attempting to steady the saw with his left hand when the blade cut and amputated his left index fingertip.
A temporary employee was operating a machine in the assembly department and amputated the right middle fingertip.

On the morning of February 20, 2017, at approximately 7:37 AM, an employee was using an emery cloth to polish a small copper electrode part on a lathe. His glove or the cloth became caught in the lathe's rotating chuck, which then avulsed his left ear and face, caused an abrasion on his left hand, and broke his left clavicle.
An employee loosening nuts using a hydraulic torque wrench pinched his left ring finger between the nut and wrench. The finger was amputated up to the first knuckle.
An employee lost his balance and fell from the third step of an A-frame ladder while attaching tie wraps to a lift cylinder. He was hospitalized with head and back injuries.
A temporary employee was attempting to lift a rack of steel weld parts using a hoist when the parts shifted and fell on his left forearm, lacerating and fracturing it.

On February 20, 2017, an employee was on a catwalk attempting to caulk the top of a wall. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a punctured lung and fractures to the ribs, collarbone, and a toe. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the second level of the roof with his harness on and was preparing anchors to start work. The employee fell 15-20 feet through a hole and suffered broken ribs, a torn right lung, a ruptured spleen, a broken pelvis and bleeding on the brain.
An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack in the warehouse and pinched his left foot between the wheel and a metal plate resulting in the amputation of his left big toe.
An employee was loading product onto pallets. The employee's leg was caught between two pallets after a pallet jack pushed a pallet into the employee's leg. The lower left leg was fractured.

An employee on a ladder was drilling a hole in concrete when the drill bit made contact with a rebar rod and kicked back, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the floor. He broke his left foot and right leg.

An employee was holding the rigging line while he was signaling the operator to lift the load. As the load was lifted up, it shifted and his left hand little finger was caught between the rigging strap and the lifting box and was amputated.
An employee tripped on a bump in the floor while walking lunch menus over to patients, fracturing her hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trimming bushes at a jobsite. As he was attempting to grab a hedge lopper, he grabbed the bottom of the tool and hit the trigger. The blade then amputated his left ring fingertip.

An employee was collecting willow branches and using pneumatic clippers to cut the material to length. As the employee was cutting a branch, he amputated the tip of his left thumb without bone loss. The hospital reattached the tip of the thumb.
An employee was trimming palm branches when a falling branch struck him in the back and punctured a lung.

An employee was using a crow bar to move steel beams for unloading while standing on the trailer bed of a truck. 

The crow bar came loose from the material, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall to the ground. He extended his arms to break his fall, resulting in broken bones in his right wrist and left elbow. He required surgery.
An employee was driving a tanker uphill when the truck started rolling back down the hill and jack-knifed. The tanker rolled over, and the employee suffered a concussion and internal injuries.
An employee was making a delivery at a residence and was bitten by a dog on both arms.
An employee fell 18 feet from an apartment complex roof while installing shingles, breaking two right-side ribs.
An employee suffered a broken right foot when a battery fell off a battery lift and onto his foot.

An employee was helping to load empty cargo containers onto dollies. He was caught between two of the dollies when a cargo tug driver pulled them. He suffered lacerations on his head, face, and torso, as well as a broken ankle and broken ribs.

An employee was installing bearings onto an axle hub with a handheld bearing press. The press malfunctioned and became stuck in the down position. When the employee reached into the bearing press to free the plunger, it shot up and partially amputated his left thumb tip.

The injured employee was about to inspect a docked vessel and was accessing the vessel through a gangplank. While on the gangplank, an employee of the docked vessel opened the hatch door which pushed the gangplank off the vessel. The injured employee fell 40 feet into the Mississippi River and suffered multiple injuries to her body.
An employee on a bakers scaffold fell while attempting to remove a light fixture. The employee's head struck the floor and suffered a contusion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing maintenance on a roll-on ball dispensing machine. He was wiping the machine with a towel when his finger was pulled into the machine and was crushed between the drive pulley and belt. His left index fingertip was amputated. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a left index finger amputation while actuating a pneumatic shaft device.
The cover of a splice box closed on an employee's hand, amputating the ring and middle finger down to the middle knuckle and a small portion of the pinky.
An employee was operating an axle die cutting machine when the die came down on his right hand, smashing his fifth digit.
