An employee was hospitalized for a hip fracture after breaking up an altercation between two hospital visitors.
The employee was using an air wand to spray off excess shot from the steel beam. The steel beam rolled over onto the tip of his right middle finger causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from the third scaffold level to the ground below resulting in a fractured and dislocated finger.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from a mezzanine to the concrete ground below resulting in a broken hip and elbow.
An employee was walking down a flight of three stairs from the client's home into their garage when she missed the last step and fell. She was hospitalized for a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning while working at a construction site.

An employee was cutting the strapping on a bundle of steel square tubing. The bundle was approximately waste high and stacked on top of other material cribbed by 4'x 4' lumber. The bundle fell onto the employee when the last retaining band was cut breaking the employee's right leg.
An employee was struck by a forklift injuring his hip and fracturing his leg and foot.
A worker was on the seventh or eighth rung of a 10-foot ladder and fell resulting in a broken rib and a bruise to the head.
An employee was moving a piece of steel plate with a hoist. The steel plate swung into the employee's lower left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was punching out a small piece of metal on a hydraulic ironworker when a piece of metal flew off and lodged in the employee's neck, requiring surgery for removal.

An employee received an electrical shock when he made contact with a 277V circuit. At the time of the incident, the employee was relocating a 2' x 4' ceiling grid light fixture using an 8-foot A-frame ladder.

The injured employee (Operator 1) was assisting another employee (Operator 2) in die stamping operations at the press. Operator 1 was standing at the press and to the inside of the light curtains installed at the press, but was not in an area that triggered the light curtains to work (i.e. the light curtains did not extend all the way to the die bed of the press). Operator 2 triggered the press to cycle and Operator 1's right hand was in the press and caught by the upper die. As he stepped back he triggered the light curtains which caused the press to rise back up. The employee's right fingers were fractured.

On March 1, 2017, at approximately 3:00 a.m., an employee was injured while visually checking a belt drive in the Thistle Area. A jam had occurred in the crusher. The machine was locked out, the jam was cleared, and the machine was started back up. The employee gained access to a catwalk and knelt down to check the tightness of the belt drive when his knee made contact with a piece of metal causing him to react by throwing his hand out. His gloved hand made contact with the unguarded, moving belt drive resulting in a fracture and amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a spray dryer, at or near the rotary valve, and amputated fingers on the right hand.
An employee tripped on a rug and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and left knee injury.
An employee was shot by an armed suspect while working his shift.
While performing auto body work on a pickup truck, an employee was standing on the bumper and fell off fracturing his ankle.
An employee cutting trees around a service line received multiple bee stings and was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering a 55 gallon drum. The drum was lying on its side in the trailer. As the employee was trying to steady the drum, it shifted and caught his right hand resulting in amputation of the right pinky fingertip.

An employee was performing maintenance on a leveler machine. He was aligning the machine lid to put it back on, holding the lid with his right hand and his left hand was on the machine in a pinch point. As he was aligning the lid, it fell onto his left hand. The employee sustained broken bones and damage to blood vessels and nerves to his left ring and pinky fingers. The employee was admitted to the hospital and had surgery to pin the bones in his fingers.
An employee fell off a ladder landing on his back. The employee was hospitalized for injury to the ribs.

On March 03, 2017, at approximately 5:10 PM, an employee was operating a truck vacuum. The employee exited the truck to see if he was positioned correctly. While at the back of the truck, the truck started to roll backwards pinning him against a pipe. The employee suffered bruising and trauma to both legs (no fractures).

An employee drove a high lift single operator cherry picker from the roadway onto the soft earth of a drainage ditch to avoid oncoming traffic. The uneven surface caused the employee to be thrown around the basket. The employee was wearing a safety harness and was not ejected, but received a severe laceration on his lower leg from contact with the basket guardrails.
An employee was operating a machine (similar to a wood lathe) when he noticed a sound suggesting a loose belt. While troubleshooting, his fingers were caught in the pulley and crushed.

On March 01, 2017, a forklift driver was trying to lift a base pallet so the injured employee could place a 4X4 wooden board under it. The forks slipped off the base pallet and struck the employee's jaw. The employee suffered a broken/dislocated jaw.
An employee was attempting to open a jammed door to the machine room with both hands. The employee fell backwards onto the concrete floor fracturing his right wrist.
An employee was operating a mechanical power press and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee was operating the trimming machine and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jam from the crystallizer machine when her hand was caught in the rotating throat resulting in amputation of her hand. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee slipped on the ice and broke her ankle.
An employee was checking the belt on an AC unit when the belt suddenly turned on and amputated part of his right middle finger.
An employee was training on the stand-up forklift and lost control. The forklift struck a building beam resulting in amputation of the employee's left foot.
An inmate suffered the amputation of two fingers when they contacted the running belts of an air handling unit.
On March 1, 2017, an employee fell from a rolling ladder and fractured her hip.

An employee was trimming tree branches on the ground with a chain saw. The employee tripped on a tree branch while operating chain saw, causing the chain saw to kick back and strike him in the face. He received a laceration to the right eye and cheek.
An employee was pressure washing the hull of a vessel, slipped on the wet surface and fell to the concrete deck below fracturing the left elbow.
An employee fell off a three-foot high stand during production. She hit her head and was hospitalized for a laceration on her skull and a sub-arachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a pipe. The pipe was wet and his hand slipped from the pipe up into the saw blade. The employee's left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle and the left middle finger was lacerated.

An employee was lifting a hatch to gain access to the underground area. As he was lifting the hatch, his right pinky finger was caught between the hatch and the ground amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee fell approximately 25 feet from a section of a roadway bridge during remodeling. The employee sustained fractures, contusions and a concussion.

An employee was under a conveyor to retrieve a bird in live hang and caught their right hand in an unguarded, moving chain and sprocket resulting in partial amputation of the right middle, ring, and pinky fingers.
An employee injured his right hand when it was caught in the moving parts of a router during flooring installation.
An employee was walking in the parking garage and fell down the stairs resulting in an elbow injury that required surgery.
An employee was cutting down a tree. When the tree fell, the base of the tree struck the employee resulting in a fractured pelvis, a collapsed lung and two broken vertebrae.
An employee was walking out the east entrance door, slipped on ice that had accumulated on the sidewalk and suffered a sprained groin.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration after spreading grass seed.
An employee was using a magnetic drill when the drill became de-magnetized and fell striking the employee's left foot.

An employee was making his weekly propane delivery. He connected a hose and refilled the first of two tanks. When he disconnected the hose, a fire occurred and the employee received second degree burns to both arms and the left side of his face.

An employee was unloading a shipment of totes from a delivery truck. While the employee was putting the last tote onto a cart, the cart's leg broke, causing the totes to fall off of the cart and land on top of the employee.

On March 02, 2017, an employee was at a customer site attempting to remove a tire from a forklift. While removing the lug nuts, the tire exploded severing the employee's left thumb, below the knuckle.
An employee tripped while stepping backwards and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee was using a knife to trim plastic. The knife slipped and punctured the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was clearing the pie chunker of loose debris. A blade energized while his left arm was in the machine resulting in amputation between the shoulder and elbow.
An employee was moving a truck tire out of the street after it had fallen off of his truck. The tire fell onto the employee breaking his hip.

An employee was attempting to remove paper from between rollers on the manufacturing line. The employee's glove got caught in the rollers pulling her left arm into the rollers resulting in tissue damage to the arm.
An employee was stacking pallets in a trailer and stepped on a broken pallet puncturing his right foot.

Employees were in the process of connecting gas to a fire pit. The gas accumulated underneath the access door where the injured employee was monitoring it. A flash fire occurred and the injured employee sustained first degree burns to the face and second degree burns to the left elbow. He was admitted to the hospital.

Employees were building the stairs to the loft area in a barn. The injured employee was carrying a piece of housewrap in front of him and fell 14 feet through the stairs that were under construction. The stairs did not have guardrails at the time. The employee suffered three broken ribs, a fractured hip and internal bleeding. His spleen had to be removed.
On March 02, 2017, an employee was struck by a forklift in the yard. The employee sustained fractured bones in the leg and ankle.
An employee was moving a table (on rollers) that was loaded with square tubing into his work area. The square tubing shifted and a piece rolled and smashed right thumb.

An employee was driving a tugger back to the loading area. When the employee turned a corner the train he was pulling jack-knifed. A forklift driver was straightening the tugger. As the employee was opening the pintle hitch, the forklift driver was lifting the cart and pinched the employee's left index finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was closing a guard over a machine when the guard slipped out of his hand and pinched his hand between the guard and the slicer resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip.

An employee was about to weld a piece of cable from the east side cable to the west side cable. The west side was already clamped off and the employee was putting the east side into the clamp on the cable welder. As he was lowering the guard, the clamp guard actuated catching his right middle finger in the clamp and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was helping another employee lift a furnace door weighing approximately 1,500 lbs. using a forklift. The door fell off the forks and onto the employee's foot.

On March 2, 2017, at approximately 6:15 a.m., an employee was walking to his assigned van in the parking lot at the beginning of his workday when he slipped on the ice and fell hitting his head on the van as he fell. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.
An employee sustained a laceration while operating a centrifugal machine.
An employee was working on a strapping head when his right middle finger was caught in the strapping head and amputated.

An employee was loading a cream truck. The employee was getting all of the liquid out of the line when his finger was sucked into the hose causing the valve to close and amputate the tip of the left index finger.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a 24-inch by 15-inch section of plywood to make a battery floor and amputated his left index finger just below the second knuckle. The employee also sustained a laceration to his left thumb and middle finger.
An employee was climbing down a 6-foot step ladder after cleaning the interior wall of a trailer when the employee's left knee gave out and he fell fracturing his right femur.

An employee was removing a finished part from a CNC lathe. With his hand on the part, he inadvertently stepped on a foot control that actuated a hold down ram. The ram came back in on the part and amputated the upper portion of the employee's right thumb.

An employee was walking past a waste trommel and lost his footing. He grabbed for the machine and the machine grabbed his glove and pulled his hand in resulting in amputation of the left index, middle and pinky fingers.
An employee was removing rubble from the tailgate of a dump truck when his hand was smashed in the tailgate resulting in amputation of the left ring finger.

The power had gone out in the community that morning and was expected to be out for several hours. The injured employee was collating materials for an upcoming class. The injured employee asked another employee to help her sort through boxes of materials in the storeroom. There was an emergency light on in the storeroom and the co-worker grabbed a large flashlight to add additional light. As they were sorting through the boxes, the injured employee stepped out of the lit area and fell over a piece of equipment suffering a strained back and fractured pelvis.
An employee was removing a wall form away from the scissor lift. The scissor lift dropped after it was freed pinching the employee's finger.
An employee was cleaning and sorting a toy bin. The employee tripped over the bin and fell breaking the right hip.
An employee was building a pallet when his foot got caught up in the nail gun hose while he was holding the nail gun with his finger on the trigger and a nail shot into his right heel.
An employee was walking in the parking lot, tripped over landscaping rocks, and fell breaking and dislocating the humerus.

The employee was moving a manifold via three portable pipe stands when one of the stand's casters got stuck in a divot in the cement floor. As the employee attempted to push the manifold from the first stand, the weight of the manifold became unevenly distributed causing the manifold to fall from the pipe stands. The employee's finger was caught between the pipe stand and the manifold resulting in the amputation of the employee's first digit of the right thumb.

An employee was throwing a 4-inch cast iron pipe into a garbage dumpster. The dumpster was full and the pipe came back and smashed his left hand ring finger. He was hospitalized for a severed tendon in the finger.

An employee was making neon signs. He was glass pulling, attained a vacuum in the tube, and pumped the tube with neon. The employee was charging the sign with electricity to check the level of illumination. The employee was trying to attain 300 milliamps in the tube. During bombarding, the milliamp meter malfunctioned and the employee tried to troubleshoot. An arc flash occurred and the employee was shocked and burned on his arms and hands. He also received a laceration to the right elbow and bruising on the right hand.

Employees were on lunch break and looking at a .22 caliber pistol. When the gun owner was putting it back in the truck that was in the company parking lot, the gun discharged injuring a fellow employee in the abdomen.

An employee was adjusting the hydraulic pressure setting on a 1200- ton die casting machine when a component of the machine broke free and struck the employee in the face resulting in injuries requiring hospitalization. The employee sustained a fractured eye socket and a fracture to the back of the head.

The employee stepped onto a portable staircase to retrieve a product from the second tier on a rack. The portable staircase's wheels were not locked down. As the employee stepped onto the first step, the staircase slid out from under her and she fell hitting her head on the floor.

An employee was standing under a net drum waiting to receive fishing nets to work on fishing lines when a basketball hoop that was previously attached to the net drum fell over and struck the employee's right jaw and neck area. The employee suffered a fractured jaw and was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a baker's scaffold from a height of approximately 4 feet 9 inches. The employee fell from the scaffold ladder to a concrete floor and suffered a head injury. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was unstrapping a load of wooden components at a job site. While removing a strap one of the components fell off the truck and landed on the employee's right leg resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was monitoring the laminating machine. The machine's electrodes were stuck in the up position. When the employee removed the guard from the running machine and used a metal broom stick to push the electrodes down, he received an electrical shock on the right arm.
An employee was using a blender and as he pushed cilantro into the blender he suffered the partial amputation of his right middle and index fingers.
While attempting to contact a potential customer, an employee was chased by a dog. While running away, he fell and broke a leg.
An employee suffered a toe amputation when his foot was caught between the roller and the sheet.

On 3/3/17, two employees were lighting the Stabilizer Reboiler Heater (21-H-205). An internal vapor ignition impacted the heater integrity and both employees that were in the process of lighting the heater were injured. One of the employees was admitted to the hospital for further treatment of burns to the face.

An employee was picking cartons of merchandise and placing them on a conveyor. The employee lost control of a box and several boxes fell over and struck another employee on the head resulting in a concussion.
An employee was unloading scaffold planking from a truck when the load shifted and a plank fell striking the employee's back. The employee suffered a spinal injury, broken jaw and bruises.
An employee was using a hydraulic press to cut bearing parts and crushed two fingers.
An employee was unjamming a bagger machine and lacerated the left index finger requiring overnight hospitalization. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.
An employee was sitting in her chair. When she stood up she tripped on computer cables and cords and fell fracturing the left femur.
An employee was climbing a portable extension ladder to work on a hatch in the ceiling. The ladder slipped out from underneath him and the employee fell 8-10 feet resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was performing a "rope shortening" operation on a freight elevator. One of the six suspension wire cables broke and a section of the wire cable fell onto the employee on top of the elevator car. The employee was hospitalized for a bone fracture.

On March 3, 2017, an employee sustained amputation injuries to the right hand after coming in contact with the shell auger. The shell auger moves eggs shells from production to a load out trucking area.

On March 3, 2017, at 11:00 a.m., an employee was completing a merchandise delivery when a male on a bicycle rode up to the delivery box truck and fired 8 rounds at the truck, three of which pierced the employee in the arm and pelvic area. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a table-top miter saw when his glove got caught in the saw blade, pulling his left fifth finger into the saw blade. A physician later amputated part of the employee's finger.
An employee fell from a 10-12-foot extension ladder and hit his head while performing maintenance work on malfunctioning equipment in the hospital.
An employee amputated fingers on his left hand while using the 12-ton pneumatic brake press to attach a blanket to a U-shaped bar.
An employee was repairing a wood pallet and struck his knee with a nail from a nail gun.
Three employees were lifting a steel plate onto a truck trailer. As the employees lifted, one employee fell to the ground. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was troubleshooting a paper jam on a machine and amputated two fingers.
An employee was touching up vehicles and as he was walking he tripped over one of the curbs outside in the ready lot and fell onto his left arm. The employee sustained a left elbow injury.

An employee was operating the ARP system when their shirt and arm got caught inside the moving system. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration and tendon damage to the arm. The equipment was not locked out at the time.
An employee was climbing a portable 12 foot ladder up to a one story residential garage roof when the ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall to the concrete driveway and break both heels.
An employee was helping load a compressor onto a forklift. The back tire of the forklift ran over his right foot resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was working in the concession stand when a small grease fire started. The employee had difficulty breathing due to the smoke from the fire.

At approximately 8:25 a.m. on 3/4/2017, an employee was working on top of the cooling conveyor while cleaning the oven conveyor. The cleaning hose became caught in a gap between the oven roller and the conveyer unit and wrapped around his foot pulling both feet and lower legs into the gap. The employee was caught in and struck by the oven roller. The employee was admitted to the hospital with multiple fractures.

An employee was performing fire watch duties and fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for brain contusion, broken ribs, a collapsed lung and broken vertebrae.

An employee was adjusting a belt on the machine and dropped a tool onto the moving belt. When the employee attempted to retrieve the tool his left arm and hand were caught between the belt and a weight roller resulting in burn injuries to his arm and hand.

An employee was pouring flour into a vat. The bucket slipped from the employee's hand and fell into the vat. The employee tried to pull the bucket out of the vat and suffered a left ring fingertip amputation when the finger was caught between the lip of the vat and the bucket.
An employee was teaching an advanced ski lesson and struck a tree injuring the left knee and breaking the left femur.

An employee was working at a pack station when they experienced itching hands. The employee was working with cardboard boxes and an unknown product that was being packed. The employee was admitted and diagnosed with acute anaphylaxis.
An employee sustained multiple stab wounds from a person who entered the store with a knife.

An employee was cutting the bolt heads off carrier flights of conveyor chain when the oxygen hose on the torch unit sprung a leak and the oxygen ignited. The employee's shirt caught on fire and the employee was burned on the left side of his chest.
An employee was walking, slipped on a plastic bag and fell. The employee dislocated the right shoulder and broke the left shoulder.

An employee was opening an oven door in the paint department to expedite cooling. The employee entered the door to Stage 1 and 2 and the vacuum system in the oven sealed the door making it difficult to open. The employee was burned on the hand when he tried to exit the oven. The oven reached a temperature between 300 to 400 degrees Fahrenheit when in operation. It had been turned off for approximately one and a half to two hours at the time of the incident.

An employee was transferring product from a top tote tank to the bottom tote tank when the leg of the top tote tank shifted causing the top tote tank to pinch the employee's right thumb between the top tote tank and the bottom tote tank spark arrestor. The employee suffered a partial amputation to his right thumb.
An employee was looking upward to find the source of an air leak when he stepped off the six inch platform and fell breaking the right tibia.
An employee was driving a golf cart and collided with a container trailer chassis. The employee was pinned beneath the chassis and was hospitalized for his injuries.

An employee was standing on a 12 foot portable step ladder to change a light bulb. While descending the ladder, the employee lost his footing and fell approximately eight feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the lower left leg.

An employee was operating a sheet folding machine and received a laceration and crushed three fingers on his right hand in the machine's chain. The employee was subsequently hospitalized as a result of his injuries.
An employee tripped over a floor mat at the cashier station and fell breaking a hip.
On Monday, March 6, 2017, at approximately 1:30PM, an employee was operating a tractor when the tractor rolled over trapping the employee underneath. The employee's lower left leg was fractured.

An employee was attempting to move a conveyor back into its original position after moving it to grease a bearing on an adjacent conveyor. The employee grabbed the bottom legs of the conveyor and tried to pull it back into place. As he pulled on the bottom leg of the conveyor, the top end of the conveyor tilted or rocked which allowed his right gloved hand to travel down the conveyor leg and was smashed between the base plate of the conveyor leg and the floor amputating the fingertip.

An employee was walking on the grating when he slipped and fell. The grating gave way, causing the employee to fall an additional five feet. The employee landed on his legs fracturing the right leg in three places.

An employee was cutting a section of a six foot I-beam and placed it on the material cart. The employee's left hand was caught between the I-beam and the cart resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was attacked by a customer while working in one of the aisles. The customer cold cocked, kicked and broke two wine bottles over the injured employee's head. The employee suffered a concussion, bleeding on the brain and head lacerations.
An employee was on the roof of an apartment building repairing a leak and fell off. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs and a cracked bone in the lower back.
An employee amputated the right index fingertip while cleaning a deli meat slicer.
An employee was operating a machine and amputated the right middle fingertip when it was caught in a screw while trying to remove a piece of plastic.
An employee was moving packages when their left foot was run over by a PIT and fractured.
An employee was moving an attachment member and got his left index finger caught between the attachment member and a dolly cart resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was measuring a piece of steel and amputated the right pinky fingertip.

An employee was installing a dust collector air seal. As the employee was hooking up the air lines, he touched the rubber seal to verify the seal was engaged and another employee working with the him activated the air (start button). The injured employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was inside an M-Starter cabinet mounting a bracket to the back panel using a cordless drill. Energized wires were located outside the cabinet along the back panel and an arc flash occurred. The employee received burns to both hands, wrists, and arms and the face.

An employee was riding a mill elevator when it got stuck between the third and fourth floor with the doors in the open position. The employee was found at the bottom of the elevator shaft with a skull fracture.

An employee (basketball player) sustained a fracture to his left tibia when his leg came into contact with the leg of a player from the opposing team while engaged in court play. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

Two employees were removing bolts from a flange. One employee was loosening the bolts by hand and another employee was using a pneumatic socket wrench. The wrench has a bar that travels with it and the bar pinched the first employee's finger resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was airing a tire inside a cage when the tire blew up amputating two of the employee's fingers.
A temporary employee's right hand was caught between two rollers while attempting to unjam a metal part on the roll sorter machine resulting in overnight hospitalization.
An employee was walking out of the facility to make a delivery, tripped and fell breaking three fingers on the right hand and injuring his right kidney.
An employee working in the retail sales room fell from a step ladder breaking the left femur and tibia.

An employee was loading a bin with catfish feed when the machine clogged. The employee tried to clear the clog and caught their left hand in the rollers resulting in amputation of four fingers. The guard was removed at the time.
An employee's left index finger was caught between the chain and the concrete while unloading a precast concrete box, resulting in amputation of his fingertip.

An employee was replacing shingles on a steep pitched roof. As he was walking across the roof, he slipped and fell approximately 12 feet. The employee's fall protection was not hooked to the anchor point at the time.
An employee was snowboarding and struck a tree resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was skiing and fell onto his back resulting in injury to the ribs and internal bleeding.
An employee was assisting a client off the bus and twisted her ankle, breaking it.

An employee was sweeping in the bun warehouse when they were struck by a forklift and fell to the ground. The forklift operator was carrying a load when the incident occurred. The injured employee sustained a right shoulder injury.
On March 6, 2017, an employee was setting up a press and amputated part of the left index finger.

The employee had just started the Clean In Place (CIP) process on an oven in the further processing area. After the CIP process had been started, the employee added additional caustic to the solution. This caused the CIP solution to splash onto the employee's face and chest. The employee was hospitalized for chemical burns to the face, throat, and upper chest.

On 3/5/17, an employee was walking on a walkway over a tank holding wash fluid (water + alkaline substance) to unclog/adjust spray nozzles. The employee fell through the walkway floor into a tank that was approximately four feet deep. The employee was treated for broken ribs and admitted to the hospital for additional treatment after reporting increased pain and difficulty breathing.
An employee inspected a shipment and was retreating from the cooler when a forklift ran over and fractured her foot.
An employee fell approximately five feet from a mobile scaffold work platform and was knocked unconscious.

An employee was conducting research and development activities. He was attempting a different recipe for cooking corn using a pressure cooker. He opened the pressure cooker after the gauge returned to zero. After he removed the lid, leftover pressure caused the hot water and corn to splash on him, burning 42% of his body.

The injured employee was moving a load of product with a pallet jack on the front loading dock of the building. Another employee was operating a sit down forklift and struck the pallet jack pinning the injured employee's left leg between the pallet jack and the forklift resulting in an ankle injury.

An employee was operating a lathe to polish a twenty pound pin. The pin came out of the lathe chuck and struck his left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on the fractured finger.
An employee was assembling a heat exchanger. He bent over to hand a co-worker a screw and strained his back.

An employee was removing a steel caisson tube and lacerated four left-hand fingers when he grabbed the rigging hook and his left hand was caught between the hook and the tube as the tube slid downward.

An employee suffered the partial amputation and open fracture of the distal phalanx of the left thumb when an outside door in the loading dock area was caught by the wind and shut on the employee's hand.

An employee was lifting packages off the ground and placing them in a chute. The employee was injured when the packages fell down causing him to lose his balance and fall against an exposed screw on the wall. The employee was hospitalized with an arm injury.
An employee was lightheaded and dizzy at work. The employee was hospitalized and treated for dehydration.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell fracturing the left ankle.
An employee was attempting to place a core plug into a core at the hard roll towel area and pinched his left middle finger between the core and the core plug resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
On March 08, 2017, an employee's left arm was caught between two molds resulting in a muscle injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing a 400 pound cable tray into a skid when his hand was caught between the cable tray and the skid when the cable tray was lowered. The employee suffered the amputation of the distal phalanx on his right pinky finger.
An employee's distal portion of the right thumb was amputated while operating the belt sander.
An employee was hospitalized when their hand and arm were pulled into a roller.
An employee climbed up onto a machine and reached to remove accumulated chicken parts. The right ring fingertip was amputated by the guarded saw blade.
An employee suffered an electrical shock while working on high power lines near a transformer.
An employee was struck by a backing forklift. His right leg went under the forklift resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was training on a stand up forklift/PIT when passing equipment caught his right leg resulting in a compound fracture.
An asphalt crew was lifting a piece of equipment when an employee strained his back and injured ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a drill press style mill. The employee's finger became caught between the clamps and the part being worked on resulting in a fracture and loss of the thumb tip.

An employee was performing inventory by placing oil on the shelves when a customer called out to him. The employee turned from his inventory activities and crossed the second bay pit that was partially covered by a wooden pit cover three feet long. When the employee stepped on the cover, it gave way and the employee fell four feet to the bottom of the pit breaking his right femur.
An employee suffered a diagonal amputation of the thumb tip while using a paper guillotine.
An employee turned the water on and the PVC pipe burst striking him in the face and fracturing his jaw.
An employee was walking when a forklift ran over the employee's toes crushing them.
An employee was walking backwards, tripped over a traffic cone in the parking lot, and fell fracturing the left wrist.
An employee was parking her forklift and suffered a crushing injury to the left foot resulting in amputation of two toes.
An employee was taping knives on the 60" metal slitter machine at the entry side of the machine. When the machine was jogged three fingers on the employee's left hand were amputated.
An employee was using a ladder to stock items. The employee fell while coming down the ladder breaking the left leg that included knee surgery.
While an employee was moving an 80 lb. grate, the employee fell 15 ft. through the hole in the floor. The employee suffered broken ribs and stitches to his face.
An employee fell while walking around a corner in an inside corridor resulting in a broken hip and in-patient hospitalization.
While the employee was walking to the cafeteria, the employee tripped and fell onto the terrazzo floor fracturing the left hip.
An employee was working on the roof when a gust of wind blew a loose piece of roofing insulation that struck the employee in the head knocking him down. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was critically injured during an altercation at the construction site on March 8, 2017.

At the differential axle line, an employee sustained the amputation of his right ring fingertip while he was training another employee. A push air gun that the injured employee was holding caused an atlas square fixture to spin which caused the amputation.

An employee was leaving the premises and walking out the door when a gust of wind caught the door. When the employee tried to grasp the door his left hand middle finger was caught between the door and the doorjamb amputating the fingertip.
An employee was lubricating a machine and amputated the right index fingertip.

The employee was sitting on a pumping unit walking beam trying to attach the horsehead. The horsehead struck the employee causing him to fall over 9 feet onto the lower portion of the pumping unit resulting in a fractured pelvis and fractured facial bones.
An employee was walking in the yard and was struck by a delivery truck resulting in a back injury.

An employee was working on a wall and using a positioning device when his anchor point failed causing the employee to fall approximately 11 feet six inches to the lower level. The employee suffered a fractured left wrist.
An employee was admitted to the hospital after an allergic reaction to the chemicals in joint cement.

The employee was removing a hose from a tank of water/oil mix that was approximately 226 degrees Fahrenheit to use in another location. The valve was open when the hose was removed resulting in the hot liquid spraying out under pressure onto the employee. The employee suffered second and third degree burns to the face, neck, stomach, and both arms.

An employee was changing the oil on a vehicle. When he started the engine to check the oil pressure, he heard a noise coming from the engine. As he investigated, his right hand contacted the radiator fan lacerating the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was gathering her things to leave when she turned and fell breaking her right hip.
The injured employee was acting as a spotter for the skid steer operator. The skid steer jumped forward and ran over the spotter's foot. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured foot.

The injured employee was helping the apprentice install 6 inch rigid conduit. The injured worker was installing the conduit while the apprentice held the pipe. The conduit slipped out of the apprentice's hands and struck the injured worker's left hand injuring his finger. The finger was not amputated, but required surgery to repair.

An employee was changing a tire on a fuel trailer using a floor jack. When the employee lowered the trailer, his left hand was caught between the chassis and the tire resulting in fractures that required hospitalization.
On March 8, 2017, a temporary employee was changing a roll of plastic on a machine when an arm was caught in a roller and fractured in two places.
An employee was removing fixtures at a location that was closing when the employee suffered severe coughing. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking up a flight of stairs while carrying linens when she missed a step and fell backwards resulting in a contusion to the back and head.

The injured employee was moving an anchor point to a different position to continue adding shingles when he fell 10 feet from the roof of a three-story building to the flat roof of the second floor resulting in a head injury and hospitalization. The employee's lanyard was detached from the anchor point at the time.
An employee was removing a guard on a belt and pulley while the pulley was spinning. His left arm was caught in the pulley resulting in a fractured arm and a crushed left index finger.

An employee was assisting others to move a partition wall. The employee stepped backwards, tripped and fell. As the employee was falling, the employee twisted their body and landed on their shoulder. The employee sustained a broken right shoulder and was hospitalized for surgery to repair the fracture.
An employee was pulling wire while working from an 8 foot A-frame ladder. The employee lost his balance and fell off the ladder breaking the right leg.
An employee was installing duct wrap from a 10 foot step ladder and fell. The employee struck his head and was hospitalized with a head laceration.
An employee was heating and bending metal rail road parts when his shirt caught on fire resulting in second degree burns.
A stairway fell onto an employee's ankle causing a fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cutting decking material with a circular saw. The employee miss-stepped and lost his balance. In doing so, the arm that was holding the saw raised and lacerated the opposite forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
The injured employee was working at his desk when a car was driven through the building and struck the injured employee.
An employee was disassembling a manifold and a counter weight fell and struck his hard hat. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture, lacerations and a fractured rib.
An employee was learning to operate a forklift and struck a bollard. His foot was caught between the bollard and the forklift resulting in a fractured foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was holding on to the valves of two cylinders of MIG welding gas on two adjacent welding machines and was shocked (110V) due to an internal short in one of the machines. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee returned a loaded trailer to the yard at the end of the day. The loaded trailer was supported by a jack. It fell off the jack and landed on the employee's right leg/foot causing multiple fractures that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a convoluted press machine and got their left forearm caught in the press. The arm was crushed from the hand to the elbow.
An employee was operating a table saw and cut his hand requiring hospitalization for surgery.

On March 08, 2017, an employee was hoisting a steel coil via an underhung crane for placement in the cradle of a coil feeding machine. As the operator began to hoist and position the coil over the cradle, the lower button on the crane's control pendant was pressed before the coil was appropriately aligned between the cradle walls. The coil landed on the top edge of the cradle creating slack on the load line, breaking the safety latch, and displacing the coil attachment from the hook. The coil struck a few machine components before ultimately landing on the operator's lower half of his body and fracturing his pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing a trailer for a semi-truck to hook up to it. When the semi-truck backed up to connect to the trailer, the employee was struck and pushed under the trailer. The employee was hospitalized for injuries to his upper torso and jaw.

While trying to close a metal gate, a gust of wind pinned the employee between two metal gates resulting in injuries requiring hospitalization. The employee suffered two broken ribs, a broken clavicle and a possible collapsed lung.

Two employees were removing a plywood cover over the vault for a pad mount transformer. One employee stepped forward while lifting and fell into the 3-foot deep hole. The employee sustained a fractured mandible, broken teeth and lacerations to his face.
An employee was grading gravel next to a backhoe when the control lever got stuck and struck him in the hip resulting in a fracture in the ball-and-socket joint area.

On March 9, 2017, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was injured while handling cants from the gang saw to the roof top chain. As a 5 1/2 inch x 7 1/4 inch cant came out of the saw, it fell short of the chain and fell towards the floor. The employee reached for the end of the cant and as the cant raised, the employee's right thumb was caught between the cant and the steel hood of the gang saw resulting in a severe cut behind the nail bed above the knuckle. The employee was transported to the hospital where the employee received stitches. The injury was classified as a partial amputation with the tip of the bone broken, but no nerve damage.
An employee was loading parts at the deburring machine, bumped their head, and fell backwards breaking their femur.

An employee was operating a shear while standing at the end to catch material as it came out. The employee saw a piece of plastic balling up and attempted to remove it when a quarter inch of his left finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a vegetable slicer and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee was servicing a corn planter and became pinned underneath a tractor hitch while kneeling on the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg, bruised ribs and a bruised lung.
An employee experienced spinal separation after stepping down an approximately 8-inch step.
An employee was unloading roofing materials on a flat roof when a gust of wind blew him off the roof. The employee fell 16-17 feet to the ground fracturing an arm in numerous places.
The employee was heating the core of the precast tank using a propane tank. The flame went out. The gas built up so when she relit it there was a flash fire causing second and third degree burns.
An employee was working in the photo lab helping a customer. When she turned to get some photos off of the photo printer she fell.

An employee was working on a single story roof repairing a skylight. The employee was vacuuming up nails when he lost balance and fell through the skylight resulting in broken ribs, a punctured lung and a head laceration.

An employee was attempting to open the door to a 30 yard cardboard container and lost control of the door handle after removing the locking pin. Due to the nature of the door closing mechanism (a locking fulcrum) the door handle to these types of containers can have some tension on it when opening. The container wall struck the employee resulting in blunt force trauma to his left cheek/eye socket and a broken nose.

The employee was holding the dock plate handles up so that the forklift operator could maneuver the forks into the handles. The employee's left index finger was crushed in the dock plate handle resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was walking to the locker room and was struck by a lift truck. The employee suffered a broken arm, hip and rib.

An employee was working on a turbine to connect a dehumidifier to a generator unit. A localized flash-fire occurred resulting in burns to both of the employee's arms and a contusion on the left side of his head.
An employee was working in the warehouse and was struck by a forklift resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was starting to fill a trailer with anhydrous ammonia. While grabbing the hose, he lost his footing and fell 46" off the platform and broke his left humerus.
An employee was walking down the steps from the Engine Test Cell when he slipped and fell on his right ankle resulting in a nondisplaced fracture of the right tibia.

An employee was jacking up a vehicle with a bottle jack when the vehicle slipped off the jack, striking the trolley which then struck the employee pushing him up against the wall of the service pit and breaking four ribs.

An employee working in sanitation was pulling the bucket out of the COP tank and spilled hot water onto herself. The employee suffered second degree burns on the chest, abdomen and legs. Water in the COP tank is circulated by a pump to clean the inside of buckets. The water temperature was approximately 180 degrees and the buckets hold approximately 5 pounds of water.
An employee tripped and fell down an unguarded stairway resulting in injury to the employee's head, back and shoulders.

An employee was changing an auger bit on a drilling rig when the employee noticed the pin hole was filled with dirt. The employee used his right middle finger to clear the hole when the Kelly bar moved and amputated his finger.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a powered industrial vehicle (PIV). The employee was cleaning the lifting cylinder from the inside of the PIV when the cylinder pinched his right thumb causing a severe laceration to the bone that resulted in an amputation injury.

An employee was attempting to replace a belt on the pulley system in the bagging area. The machine was stopped when the employee pulled on the pulley. Due to high tension on the belt, the employee's right hand was pulled between the belt and pulley resulting in amputation of the first two fingertips on the right hand.
A set up operator was struck by a portable conveyor between the first 1600-ton press and the second 1600-ton press.
An employee was standing on a bucket truck preparing for a job. The employee was not in the bucket, but standing on the truck frame when he fell 9.5 feet resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee was descending a ladder while carrying a bundle of wooden stakes and fell approximately four feet striking their chest against the bundle of stakes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying boxes, slipped and fell resulting in a back injury.
An employee was unloading bundles of steel pipes from a truck when a bundle broke loose and rolled onto the employee's foot resulting in a broken toe.
While releasing a turnbuckle for a poured concrete wall, an employee's right ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee stepped up onto a ledge to get supplies, miss-stepped and fell resulting in a fracture to the left hip. The employee was also knocked unconscious.

An employee was attempting to load a piece of 3" iron pipe onto a forklift to load it onto a trailer when the employee stepped backwards and tripped on containment, dropping the pipe, fracturing the left tibia.

An employee was releasing the tarp that rolls over the top of the load of the dump truck, when the employee fell to the ground causing a pelvic fracture. Strong winds were a factor in the employee's fall.

On March 9, 2017, an employee was maneuvering a steel frame close to the concrete floor when it slid off a block of wood that was supporting one end of the frame and struck the employee's right middle finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was attacked by a dog on his delivery route resulting in a wrist/hand injury.
An employee was performing maintenance on a motorized roll-up door and received an electrical shock and burns to the index finger and thumb.

The employee and a second employee were confirming measurements adjacent to an open stairwell that did not have the stairs installed yet. While looking at the blue prints and masonry wall to the north, the employee stepped to the east into the unprotected stairwell and fell approximately 11 fell to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken left scapula, fractured ribs on his left side and fractured vertebrae in his lower back.
An employee was inspecting the work being done when a metal scaffold board failed and the employee fell ten feet. The employee sustained a broken arm, three broken ribs and two broken vertebrae.

An employee was waiting for his trailer to be off loaded. He was leaning against the trailer with his left hand resting on the trailer when his left thumb was crushed between a board and the step deck platform of the trailer during the unloading process.
An employee was ascending an eight-foot step ladder to install a metal strut and fell five feet off the ladder fracturing the right ankle.

An employee was hospitalized after his left arm was caught inside the hose of a high pressure vacuum while the employee was collecting abrasive blasting debris on a bridge. The employee suffered from severe swelling and inflammation of his left arm, from the upper biceps to the hand while cleaning the hose of the high pressure vacuum.
An employee fell 35 feet to the ground while handing sheet metal up to the roof from a JLG. The employee suffered fractures to the lower extremities.
An employee was checking the banding in the strapper machine when the lid fell onto the employee's hand amputating the left ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was performing repair work on a vehicle that was elevated on a vehicle hoist. The employee stood up and hit his head on the car. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was lowering a gear onto a metal shop rack and caught his left ring finger between the gear and the rack resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was operating the laminating machine, stepped back, hit a stool and fell backwards hitting his head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using the table saw and pushing a piece of wood through with a push stick when his hand slipped into the saw blade cutting the two middle fingers.
An employee was leaving her desk and fell breaking an elbow.
An employee fell from a height of 9 feet 9 inches while building a staircase.

An employee was closing an electric overhead door when he heard a noise in the door. The employee hit the stop button and the door came off the tracks. The door fell and part of the door struck the employee's right leg fracturing the lower leg.
An employee fell down the stairs and broke a leg.

An employee was driving a stand up pallet jack along the shipping lane. When she stepped out of the pallet jack while it was in motion, her ankle was caught between the angle iron and the pallet jack's platform resulting in a compound fracture to her right ankle. The injured employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was unjamming the sawdust feeder and amputated the left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was operating a cutting machine and amputated two fingertips while unplugging a clog. The machine was running and unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was doing stucco work when a roll of roofing paper fell off the roof and struck the employee in the head.
An employee was working on the line and passed out hitting her head and lacerating the forehead.
An employee was taking an opossum out for exercise when the animal bit her on the hand. The employee was hospitalized for an infected animal bite.
An employee was making a spring and suffered a fractured left arm when the spring popped out while the employee was adjusting the feed wire.
An employee fell from a collapsing cantilever scaffold and suffered a compound fracture to the right leg.

On March 10, 2017, an employee was standing on stacked rebar bundles on a train car when he lost his balance and fell approximately four to five feet to the ground striking his head on a piece of rebar as he fell. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was found unconscious on the ground in the store and bleeding from his head.

The employee was refilling the abrasive media in the blast pot. After filling the blast pot, the injured employee was brushing the loose blast media on top of the blast pot into the material opening when the employee's left hand was pinched by the blast pot actuator injecting abrasive blast media and possibly air into the employee's hand and fingers.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and tore muscles in her hamstring.
An employee was cleaning a mixer when his hand made contact with the mixer blade, resulting in amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was boning plates on beef carcasses, pulled a piece of meat back, and lacerated his right forearm with his knife.
An employee was unloading material for delivery at a customer loading dock when the employee stepped on a nail puncturing the sole of the foot and chipping a bone.

An employee was injured while conducting vehicle inspections on a railcar. The injured employee was found on the ground next to the railcar by another employee. It is presumed that the employee fell from the railcar. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and a broken arm.
An employee was attempting to lower a patient's mechanical bed. It was not working so the employee was troubleshooting when the bed collapsed on her right arm crushing the forearm.

On March 10, 2017, an employee was operating a press machine with his hand resting on the machine's track. The automated mold platform pinched his left index finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a 6 foot ladder to install a membrane on the side of the building when he became unbalanced and fell backwards, striking his head on the ground.

Two employees towed a stuck forklift out of the dirt with another forklift. The injured employee got out of the stuck forklift and started removing the tow chain that connected the two forklifts. The other forklift jumped backwards, pinning the injured employee between the two forklifts and causing broken ribs and bruising to internal organs. The second forklift was running and was not in neutral at the time.
An employee was pushing carts and suffered a heart attack.

A drilling rig was tripping out of the well. The derrick employee was moving the top of a pipe stand to the racking fingers when the employee's retractable lanyard line was caught by the descending top drive and he was pulled to his knees on the derrick platform. The employee sustained a left knee fracture and vascular damage to the left thigh.
An employee was walking across the street to deliver mail when a vehicle struck the employee and ran over his left ankle and right leg, breaking both.

On March 11, 2017, an employee was operating a forklift moving a bundle of square tubing off the rack in the yard. The employee walked underneath the load on the forklift when the operator told him to move because there was a piece of metal sticking out. The employee attempted to move when the piece of metal fell to the ground, bounced up at an angle, and struck the employee on the back of his left leg, breaking it. His leg had to be surgically amputated.

An employee on a ladder was removing packages from an overhead conveyor when the employee slipped and fell approximately 8 feet to the floor, fracturing the left humerus and dislocating the left elbow.

An employee was installing steel grating on the mezzanine level of a newly constructed building when the steel grating panel unexpectedly shifted and fell. The employee fell 20 feet with the panel, suffering skull and vertebrae fractures.

An employee was cleaning a rotary valve machine when a coworker activated the machine, which then amputated the employee's index finger between the first knuckle and fingernail. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

While running vinyl through rollers, an employee noticed the vinyl was building up. The employee was wiping the roller with a rag when the employee's right hand was pulled and burned between the rollers.

On March 11, 2017, an employee was using a hopper when a pipe in the machine became blocked with hardened chocolate, preventing hot water from transferring from the pre-mix kettle to the hopper. The employee used an air line to blow the lines clear. The air made the kettle, which was filled with hot water, overflow and cause first and second degree burns on the employee's back.

An employee was performing maintenance, lubricating a drive train with a rag, when the rag became caught. When he attempted to pull out the rag, his right hand was caught in the chain sprocket, amputating half of his right pinky finger.
An employee's right index finger was caught and amputated in a rolling/crimping machine.
An employee was clamping a piece of granite to a forklift clamp when the clamp grabbed his left pinky finger along with the granite and fractured it.

An employee was cleaning a deep fryer and emptying it out when oil spilled over to the floor. The employee slipped on the oil and hit the hot fryer, suffering burns on the chest, right thigh, and leg.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and fractured her ankle.

On March 11, 2017, an employee was guiding a finished roof truss down exit rollers past the finish press using a pivot pole as a guide. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the finished roof truss and the pivot pole, partially amputating the distal fingertip.
An employee was breaking down the scaffold system when a bar slipped, knocking his safety helmet off and striking his forehead. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee suffered a stroke while pulling a pallet.

An employee was assembling a large gearbox using the lifting hoist. Each end has swivel hooks hooked onto the assembly on the shaft ends. When he went to hook the hoist to the customer end the hook swiveled with his gloved hand on the chain hoist. As the weight shifted, his left index finger was caught between the chain and the chain adjustment resulting in amputation up to the first distal joint.
An employee amputated two fingers when casing loosened from a retention nut, fell and struck the employee.

An employee stood on the first step of an 18-inch step stool while trying to clean the wall. The employee fell off the step stool onto the concrete floor, breaking a leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was handling a sedated cat when it bit the employee, requiring hospitalization for a possible infection.
An employee fractured his finger while placing a die onto a press. The machine was locked out when the die crushed his finger.

An employee was using a rig elevator to pull rods out of a hole. As he lowered blocks down the elevator, the block brakes failed, allowing the elevators to strike and fracture the upper phalange on his left thumb.

An employee was changing a plunger on the press-and-blow machine. The machine was shut down, but the safety device to keep the blanks open was not installed. When the employee activated the machine with his left hand in the machine, the hot blanks closed on his hand causing burns and bruising.

An employee was descending a fixed ladder after installing a thermocouple for a reheat furnace when he missed the bottom rung, lost his balance, and fell to the floor. He fractured his right femur and required hospitalization.
Employees were performing cutting operations near a 275 gallon container of used oil when sparks caused an explosion. An employee was hospitalized after suffering burns to their hands and lower body.

An employee was helping a coworker adjust the placement of a cellar cover when he slipped and his right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the cellar cover handle and the matting board.

An employee was taking samples of paper to check quality before it was sent to the final roll. He was standing on paper on the ground and had taken his samples when the final roll moved to uptake the slack and pulled the paper from under him. He fell flat on his back and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder while replacing an air filter, injuring the right shoulder and requiring hospitalization.

On March 13, 2017, an employee was operating a CNC machine and was loading a 2-foot pup joint into the chuck spindle. The pipe dropped in the back, resulting in the pipe coming up in the front. The employee's right hand was located inside the pipe and was smashed between the pipe and the chuck of the machine. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell off a loading dock while cleaning it and moving skids, sustaining skull and rib fractures.
On March 12, 2017, at approximately 2 p.m., an employee was participating in a ruck march when he suffered dehydration and diarrhea, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to move a steel cart when a pin came out and allowed the cart to fall onto the employee's left foot, breaking four toes.
An employee was loading insulation into a blow machine when he tripped. As he tried to catch himself, his left thumb tip hit a gear and was amputated.
An employee slipped on water and stepped into a boiler collection pit filled with hot water, suffering burns to the lower left leg and foot.
An employee was securing a spare tire to his trailer with straps when he tripped over the tire and fell 3-4 feet off the trailer, hitting the ground and fracturing his pelvis.
The employee was providing illumination to a welder that was welding inside a vessel by means of a miners light (hard hat attachment). An arc flash occurred and the employee was shocked.
An employee tripped on a chair leg and fell fracturing her femur.
On March 13, 2017, at approximately 3:40 p.m., an employee was coming down a ladder when he missed a step and fell face-first to the floor. He was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was changing an anhydrous ammonia pump when some of the chemical splashed on him, resulting in burns to his hand, arm, neck, and chin. The pump was not locked out and no personal protective equipment was worn at the time.
An employee was connecting a beam to a column when the beam struck and caught his forearm between the beam and column, causing internal bruising that required hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a truck. The truck door had some ice on it and when it docked, the ice splashed on the floor. The employee then slipped on the wet floor, suffering a head injury/concussion.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat when his hand came into contact with the saw blade, amputating his left thumb tip.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack and moved it onto the lift gate. The lift gate 
was wet and slippery from running a previous pallet that contained product packed in ice. The jack starting sliding 
toward the curbside of the platform. As the pallet was sliding to the edge, the associate tried to 
keep the pallet level by placing his arm on the pallet, to keep it from falling. The pallet jack continued to slide and as the employee attempted to get out of the way, his finger slid across the pallet jack and was amputated.

On 3/13/17, a ladder slipped while an employee accessed an elevator pit and the employee fell 14 feet to the elevator platform. The employee then rolled and fell an additional 6 feet to the elevator pit, suffering a hairline fracture to the head.
An employee was attempting to move pails on a conveyor line when his fingertip was caught and amputated.
An employee was using a meat blender when the blade amputated the employee's right ring finger.
An employee's left ring fingertip was amputated by the track runner gears of a clamping machine.
An employee was moving a grill component with a lift. When the lift released, the component fell onto his right index finger amputating the fingertip.
An employee was putting a trailer jack under a trailer when the yard dog rolled back and hit his left side. He suffered a broken leg and pelvis.
An employee was throwing trash from a hopper into a dumpster when he fell into the dumpster and suffered fractured ribs and a possible head injury.
Employee was bitten by a poisonous spider while cleaning a forklift.
An employee fell off a flatbed trailer while loading it, suffering a fractured skull.
An employee fell backwards off of a ladder from a height of 3.5 feet and hit the back of his head on the concrete below. He suffered a concussion/head injury.
An employee was cutting plywood with a powered hand saw when his left index finger touched the saw blade and was amputated.
An employee was stepping off a trailer with his left leg while his right foot remained on the trailer deck plate. He then overextended his right leg and fractured his right femur.
An employee was cutting chicken with a knife when he amputated approximately 1/4" of his left thumb tip.
An employee was erecting a scaffold and was on the second level when he slipped and fell 12 feet to the concrete floor, breaking his left ankle. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was working as a safety spotter on an overhead crane. While exiting the crane area he was caught between the crane and the walkway hand railing resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was working with sheet metal and studs. He did not realize that a piece of sheet metal was close behind him and when he moved his arm, the sharp edge of the sheet metal struck his left arm resulting in a laceration to his triceps. He was admitted to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was walking down the stairs when he missed the second from the bottom step and fell on to the ground, breaking his collarbone and leg.

An employee was acting as a flagger when he was struck by an automobile. He suffered severe head trauma and multiple internal injuries including abdominal, spleen, pelvic, liver, and knee injuries, requiring hospitalization.
On March 13, 2017, at approximately 10:30 PM, an employee was troubleshooting a vacuum pump when a belt lacerated his left middle finger down the bone. His finger was partially amputated.

An employee was loading metal into a machine to be painted when the entry tower lost air pressure, allowing the rollers to fall down on the employee. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the left arm and was hospitalized.
On March 13, 2017, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was unloading copper pipes from a forklift when he suffered an umbilical hernia and was hospitalized.

An employee slipped while walking on the catwalk located over the maintenance pit and fell into the maintenance pit resulting in shoulder and back injuries. It was raining and the catwalk had grease on it.

An employee was using a dolly to transport boxes. When she pulled back on the handle, she was unable to keep it upright and the dolly came down, trapping her finger between the handle and ground. When she attempted to pull her finger out, her skin was removed and her fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was walking in the shop area when he tripped over a device used to cover wires on the floor. He fell and suffered a head injury and brain hemorrhage.

An employee was operating a bucket truck to perform elevated repairs when it began raining. The employee lowered the bucket to the rest position and was exiting when the employee fell 7 feet to the ground, fracturing an elbow and vertebra.
An employee was installing a section of scaffolding and suffered a hernia.
An employee caught a finger in a sliding door and fractured it.
An employee was stacking scaffolding material in a rack and crushed his hands between boards. The employee's left middle finger was fractured and lacerated.
An employee was walking a plane from a gate to the aircraft operating area when the employee slipped on some ice and fell fracturing a hip.
Two employees were cleaning out a tank with a vacuum hose and an air lamp when a flash fire occurred burning both employees on the face.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack into the buck hoist and got his right foot caught between the pallet jack and hoist fracturing it.

An employee was conducting a pressure test inside a wellhead to check for leaks. When he removed his pressure detecting equipment, excess air pressure was released and struck the employee's hand and face. The employee suffered a facial laceration and a laceration and fracture to his hand. The employee was wearing PPE at the time.
An employee was on a ladder cutting a piece of wood that was inside an attic access. The ladder slipped out from under him and he fell breaking his right arm.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on the line 2 case erector, a machine that forms corrugated into a box. The employee was looking to see if a bearing was running smoothly in the machine and had a shop rag in his right hand. The rag got caught in the moving chain and sprocket assembly, pulling his right index finger into the assembly. The finger was severely lacerated and contorted such that it was amputated at the hospital.
An employee was on a 6 foot A-frame ladder cutting a 2x6 using a circular saw and amputated a finger.

The injured employee was part of a three man team replacing a rope in a high rise elevator. The employee was feeding part of the rope through the rigging when excess rope on top of the car created a loop. The employee's right leg was caught in the loop and when it tightened the employee suffered a compound fracture to the lower leg.

An employee was walking on the wing of a B-1B bomber preparing it for painting. The employee slipped and fell off the aircraft wing tip to the floor 14 feet below. The employee was wearing a body harness, but it was not attached to the overhead lanyards. The employee suffered a left knee fracture and compressed disc.
An employee was helping to build a turf roller when the employee's glove got caught between the shaft on the roller and the sand paper resulting in amputation of the left thumb.
Employees were servicing a well. When the injured employee lifted tubing, his finger was caught between the slip segments and the well head resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was assisting another employee with shoveling snow and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was lifting packages and suffered a strangulated hernia.

An employee was attempting to manually manipulate the leading edge of the rail into a lead out stacker. The stacker was displaced by the leading edge of the rail. The employee slipped and his foot went underneath the lead out stacker. The stacker was then freed of the rail that was displacing it and the stacker fell onto the employee's foot resulting in multiple fractures as well as an open wound on the bottom of the foot that extends from heel to toe.

An employee was hand clearing parts from a machine press. The manufactured part from the last cycle got stuck to the upper part of the die. An employee was pushing a snow blower and struck something that was under the snow causing the snow blower to flip and strike the employee resulting in a back injury.
An employee was struck in the shoulder by a board while operating a resaw resulting in a broken collar bone.

The employee was placing a rope by hand onto a 24 inch oilfield pipe. The pipe rolled over his right middle finger catching it between the pipe and the top of the pipe rack resulting in amputation of the finger.
While performing maintenance to a large piece of equipment, an employee burned their back with scalding water that was being used to flush the  equipment.

Employees were setting up utility poles using a boom truck. They were using choker chains to hold the pole and set it. The chain rolled and the pole caught the injured employee's left ring finger resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was delivering packages, slipped on ice and tore their quadriceps which required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a vertical mill and injured a finger. The injury required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor and amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was operating a shear and amputated the middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting pieces of wood with an under-mounted table top router and amputated the left index fingertip.
On March 15, 2017, an employee was on a freight elevator when the chain broke and the elevator collapsed. The employee sustained broken lumbar vertebrae requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting wood boards on a table saw and contacted the blade resulting in a deep laceration to the left index finger.

An employee was replacing a fluorescent light fixture when he was shocked and fell off a ladder approximately 5 feet high. The employee suffered an injury to his shoulder blade from the fall as well as the electrical shock from the light fixture. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was practicing with the mini excavator when he became trapped between the boom and the cage of the mini excavator. The employee sustained broken bones in the upper face.

An employee was assisting other employees to raise a tower. When he placed his hand on a cable to provide tension on it to aide in the operation, his right hand contacted a pulley and sustained a partial amputation of the pinky finger.
An employee was using the forks of a forklift to remove a post. When the post was pulled up, it struck the employee in the face fracturing the jaw.
An employee was loading a truck and lifting materials when he felt severe pain in his back and then the employee passed out. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was sorting packages and suffered shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized for a possible heart attack.

An employee picking up garbage at a stop along the route slipped on ice while pushing a small dumpster. The employee smashed his pinky finger between the dumpster and the back of the dump truck suffering an injury that required amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was clearing snow and moving trucks around the parking lot to permit snow removal. He slipped on the icy surface and fell fracturing the right tibia and fibula.

An employee was inside the boiler removing broken pieces of refractory from the hopper using a water hose when the wall directly in front of the employee released hot ash and refractory onto the employee.
