The worst of the burns were to his legs and ankles.

Two employees were positioning trucks. The injured employee was entering the warehouse and was struck by a moving vehicle resulting in a broken left collar bone, an elbow injury, a head abrasion and a right thumb injury.
An employee was walking in the parking garage, slipped on ice and fell striking the right knee on the ice and concrete. The employee was hospitalized for a torn right quadricep.
An employee was setting up an offline printer and got a finger caught between the roller and a guard resulting in an amputation injury.
On 3/15/17, an employee walking on a walkway towards the southwest entrance of the building slipped and fell on ice and broke their right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the bed of the semi-truck throwing bundles of rebar onto the ground. When the employee went to throw a bundle of rebar onto the ground, the end of the rebar caught his glove dislodging him from the semi-truck onto a concrete sidewalk resulting in a head injury.
An employee was putting cardboard away when the top shelf of a rocket cart, which was raised up, fell down and struck the employee's head. The employee sustained cuts and scrapes to the head.

An employee reporting to work in the morning parked his car in the parking lot. The employee slipped on snow and ice and fell, fracturing his ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to treat his fractured ankle.

On March 15, 2017, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee was injured while checking the function of a pump being used to transfer oil from a tank to a compressor station engine. The pump was being heated and a tarp had been placed over the pump in an effort to hold heat due to the outdoor freezing temperatures. The employee reached under the tarp and made contact with a moving piston inside an air exhaust port resulting in the amputation of the right index fingertip.
On 3/15/17, an employee slipped and fell on some black ice in the yard while cleaning off a tractor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken right ankle.
An employee was operating a shear to cut metal and crushed their fingers under the sheet metal hold downs resulting in injuries that required surgery.
An employee was hooking up two pop trailers between two trailers when the neutral gear fell on his right hand.

On March 15, 2017, the notching head saw jammed and the employee attempted to remove the jam with a steel bar. The saw caught the bar and hit the employee's left hand resulting in two broken fingers and an amputated thumb below the fingernail. The employee had surgery on the broken fingers requiring hospitalization. The saw was not locked out or turned off at the time.
An employee was struck by a strand of cable that broke during load testing. The employee was standing in the vicinity of the cable when it broke and it struck his right thigh.

The injured employee was walking along side the forklift in order to steady a piece of equipment being moved by the lift. The equipment was being carried in a sling that was suspended on the forks of the lift and the employee was walking in front of the lift with his hand on the equipment to prevent it from swinging. The employee tripped and the lift struck the employee. The injured employee sustained two broken hips and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was walking around his desk and stepped into a 12 inch hole fracturing his leg.

The injured employee was descending an aircraft stairway when another employee carrying a heavy bag of headsets struck the injured employee on her way up the stairway. The injured employee fell approximately 5 feet to the lower level of the aircraft.
An employee was paving a highway road and was struck by a cement truck. The truck ran over the employee's left leg.

An employee was working on a microwave in the medical electronics department (no metal utensils were in use) and experienced electrical shock. An employee was exiting a vehicle on the ramp of the main post office, slipped on ice and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was working on the yogurt filling line and amputated one-half inch of her right middle finger.
An employee was walking in the parking lot from her car to report to work when she slipped and fell on ice fracturing her foot.
An employee was working on the ground close to an excavator when the excavator bucket lowered and struck the employee resulting in a dislocated right ankle and possible cracked ribs.
An employee was leaving the store for the evening and slipped and fell on the icy sidewalk sustaining multiple fractures. The employee fractured her left cheek, left wrist and pelvis.
An employee was operating a rewind machine when his glove got caught in the winding material, pulling his left arm in and breaking it.
An employee was delivering mail, slipped on some ice on the ground, and suffered a patellar tendon tear.
An employee was working on top of the roof installing drains and fell approximately 25-30 feet to the ground breaking both legs and ankles and displacing a hip.

An employee was removing Mylar coating from a stainless steel pipe. He was wearing cut resistant gloves at the time. He then placed the steel pipe on a lathe to sand the coating off the pipe. The rotating steel pipe caught his gloved right hand and pulled it in amputating the middle and ring fingers at the far distal joint.

An employee was on the roof of the repair garage attempting to repair a leak and fell 20 feet through a skylight. The employee suffered various injuries such as head and back injuries, a collapsed lung, and a skull fracture.

An employee was installing fascia onto the truss inside of a two-story house from an extension ladder 6 feet above the floor. His upper body was leaning over the wall when the ladder slipped. An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot, fell backwards and struck the back of his head on the ground resulting in a subdural hematoma.
An employee was making a delivery and lowering the lift gate on the back of the truck when he tripped and fell from the lift gate breaking the left tibia.
While operating a stand-up tram or PIT, an employee was hospitalized for a fractured hand after it was caught between the PIT steering wheel and an APU.
An employee was cutting wood with a saw and amputated a fingertip.

An employee was providing assistance to a customer while using a caustic tank. When the employee blew down the product hose, he was sprayed in the face by caustic sodium hydroxide solution, resulting in burns to his mouth, lips, and face.
The employee was walking to the clinic parking lot, tripped over a parking block and fell fracturing the left arm and nose.

Two employees were moving light poles in a parking lot. The injured employee slipped and fell in front of the other employee who was operating a Lull at the time. The Lull ran over the injured employee's foot. The injured employee was hospitalized for treatment of a broken left foot.
An employee was entering the cab of a 18-wheeler and fell backwards striking his head. He was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was hooking 2 trailers together using a dolly and suffered an abdominal hernia while picking up the dolly.
An employee slipped on ice on a walkway and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a traumatic head injury.

An employee was shutting down the stacker machine and amputated the right ring finger to the first joint when the machine caught his finger between the belt and the gear.
An employee fell from a ladder and fractured the right arm.

An employee suffered a pinky fingertip amputation while retracting the parcel chute that delivers packages into the trailers.
An employee suffered burns to his face and hands from a flash fire that occurred while lighting the pilot light to a propane water heater.
An employee slipped on the icy floor and suffered an ankle injury.
An employee stepped off of the back of a trailer and placed his foot on the bumper. His foot slipped and was caught between the bumper and the trailer resulting in a fracture.

An employee was getting lunch meat from the cooler box and walking back to the slicer when her foot got tangled in a box strap causing her to fall and injure her right hip.
An employee was clearing a jam on the slitter machine and amputated a fingertip.
An employee stepped out of a tractor, slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell breaking the left ankle.
An employee was performing PH analysis on water using sodium hydroxide. The employee ingested some of it and was hospitalized for a burned esophagus and stomach.
An employee slipped on a large patch of ice in the parking deck and fell striking his head. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and short term memory loss.

Employees placed tubing for a welding job on a jack stand to balance it. While discussing how to proceed with the job, the injured employee placed his hand on the tubing and it rolled over and struck his lower right leg fracturing it.
An employee was on patrol and slipped on ice on the walkway resulting in hospitalization for a back injury.
An employee was involved in an altercation with another employee and fell suffering a hip injury.
An employee slipped on ice and snow in the parking lot and fell fracturing the right hip and wrist.
An employee was putting a sheet of metal into a pyramid roller when his gloved left hand was pulled into the rollers resulting in amputation of the left right fingertip.
A worker was on a break below the dock and was struck by a trailer backing up. The employee sustained a crushed pelvis.
An employee was on a materials rack feeding wire into a wire making machine, lost his balance and fell backwards five feet landing on his back.

The employee was hospitalized for a left middle finger laceration and a busted upper lip.
An employee was troubleshooting a light circuit in a building and fell from a 12 foot ladder. The employee was hospitalized for head, neck and wrist injuries.

An employee was de-pressuring a vessel. After a pressure check with nitrogen, the employee was exposed to a small amount of chlorine released from the vent. The employee was admitted to the hospital for chlorine inhalation.

The employee suffered a broken right leg above the ankle and a shattered heel bone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the trucking yard, slipped on ice, and fell resulting in a leg injury between the knee and ankle.

On 3/14/17, an employee was trying to attach a transfer cart. While attaching the cart his leg was caught in a pinch point between the cart and the safety bar when the cart moved. The employee's lower leg was broken.

An employee was moving and reinstalling equipment. The employee was adjusting the spacer board underneath the piece of equipment when the forklift operator lowered the equipment onto the employee's right middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was shot blasting the inside of a turret. The employee lost their balance and sustained a laceration to the upper arm from the shot blast tool.
An employee was removing hot food from the stove/oven when the contents spilled on his ankle and feet, causing severe second and third degree burns.
An employee was inserting a thin film into an opening (approximately 1/2") of a pinch roller when his finger became caught pulling his fingers into the opening and causing burns and a fracture.
An employee was unloading trash when he fell off the dock and hit his head.

An employee was conducting touch-up work on precast concrete on a worksite and suffered a stroke.

An employee was walking in the facility when her left heel slipped out from under her and she fell fracturing the L2 vertebra.

An employee was walking into work when he slipped on the ice and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a head injury and a ruptured spleen.

An employee was cleaning a moving roller when the rag got caught in the roller pulling the employee's left hand into the roller and partially amputating the middle finger. The employee was wearing leather gloves at the time.
An employee was operating a roll former. His gloved hand was caught in the rollers and pulled in resulting in three broken fingers.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a conveyor and was wiping down the conveyor frame with a rag when the rag got caught between the conveyor belt and the roller. The employee's right hand was pulled into the machine and his right middle and index fingers were severely lacerated resulting in amputation. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.

The employee was operating the wrapper knife machine which cuts plastic wrap that is used to package ice pops. The plastic wrap jammed underneath the guard. When the employee attempted to clear the jam, his left thumb was severely lacerated requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while entering the workplace. She dislocated her elbow and broke her wrist.
An employee was hooking up a roll-off trash container, slipped on the ice and fell resulting in a broken right femur.
An employee amputated the right ring finger while operating the back pack vacuum machine.
On March 17, 2017, an employee was using a band saw to cut meat and suffered a pinky fingertip amputation and a laceration to the ring finger. Cut resistant gloves were worn at the time.
An employee was stocking the shelves using a rolling step ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and was admitted to the hospital for head trauma.
An employee was helping to unload the loader off of the trailer when their left ring finger was caught between the ramp and loader bucket resulting in amputation.

An employee was operating a tractor trailer and drove off the side of the access road causing the tractor trailer to topple over. The employee suffered a head laceration, neck pain and internal bleeding.
An employee was adjusting the rollers on the shear machine to loosen the carpet. The rollers moved and pinned the employee's hand resulting in two broken fingers.
An employee was using a radial arm saw to cut pieces of wood product when the saw cut his ring finger and into his hand requiring several sutures. The worker was hospitalized.

An employee was using a skid steer with a chain to pull on a piece of brass. The chain broke and snapped back striking the employee on the face. The employee was hospitalized with four broken teeth and a facial laceration.
An employee was standing on the riding step of the refuse truck. The truck started to roll and the employee fell off the step striking his head on the pavement. He was hospitalized for a concussion.

An employee was using a manual lathe to polish a small pin used in mold manufacturing. He was polishing the rotating pin using a piece of sandpaper. The glove on his middle right finger got caught by the rotating part pulling his hand in resulting in amputation of the right middle finger and a broken ring finger.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence and fell down three stairs resulting in a broken right tibia and fibula that required hospitalization.

An employee was bending to pick up a broom that was laying on the floor against the wall in the linen department when a fire extinguisher fell off the wall and landed on his right thumb. His thumb was amputated from just below the thumbnail up.
An employee was cutting up a tree when a part of the tree fell and hit the employee, breaking his leg.

An employee was conducting a safety inspection of the room and fell from a fixed access ladder after receiving an arc flash burn to his forearm. The employee suffered a broken ankle from the fall off the ladder.
An employee was descending a rolling ladder and missed the last step. He fell and sustained a head laceration.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a small metal scrap baler. The baler engaged while the employee's left foot was in the machine resulting in amputation of the foot at the ankle.
An employee was cleaning a cooler with a water hose. The employee stepped in a puddle of water, slipped, and fell backwards hitting his head on the floor.

An employee was placing rotors on a shelf using a step ladder and holding onto the shelf support bar. When the employee stepped off the ladder, the shelf collapsed on the employee's left hand resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was working on a piece of equipment and was adjusting the tube valve (approx. 30lbs) which has a manual handle and was not in the lock position. The employee put his hand inside the valve to check to see if it was flush. The lift handle released itself while the employee's finger was still in the tube resulting in the partial amputation of the third finger on the left hand.
An employee tripped over a rodent control box and fell fracturing the right hip.
An employee was assisting a customer and fell backwards striking their head on the concrete floor. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee placed a pry bar into a flywheel of the machine. The machine started and the pry bar struck his right forearm breaking it and his wrist.
An employee was hanging bridge plates and lost his balance in the rail car and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a laceration to the back of his head.

An employee was attempting to position a pipe on the swage unit using an F wrench style tool. When the employee was applying force to the tool, it slipped off of the pipe and the employee struck his hand on the metal table runner. The employee's hand was pinched between the tool and the table runner resulting in partial amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was in the parking lot after work and was stuck by a car resulting in a laceration to her arm.
An employee was walking down the dock stairs, slipped and fell breaking his arm. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack and struck a stationary pallet jack. Her finger was caught between the two pallet jacks resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on cardboard and hit the floor, fracturing the left hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was transferring a chemical (alkali) from a bulk tank to a smaller tank. The smaller tank overfilled and chemical spilled onto the floor. The employee slipped and fell on top of the chemicals resulting in chemical burns to the left side of his hip, the back of his leg and his face.
An employee was driving down the aisle and dismounted the scooter before it had come to a complete stop. The employee's right ankle was fractured.

An employee was operating a valve to reduce steam pressure in a boiler when hot water sprayed out of a vent line and hit him. He sustained second degree burns to his hands, right knee, and neck-facial area.

An employee was changing a die on a forge when the prop he had placed under the forge hammer to hold it in place was knocked out and struck him in the head. He suffered a fractured skull and had surgery.
An employee amputated their index fingertip while cutting a piece of pipe with a pipe cutter.
An employee was walking down a grocery aisle when she fell and broke her leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was moving to dewater a barge void when he fell 25 feet through an open barge hatch, breaking three ribs, his pelvis, and his wrist.
The employee had a heart attack while going up and down jet bridge stairs.

An employee was inserting a 5" pipe into a large section of duct work. He needed a come-a-long that was at the other end of the pipe. He climbed onto the pipe and started walking on the pipe to reach the come-a-long. When he reach a flange, he stepped over it and then fell approximately 6' to the floor. The employee sustained bruised ribs, a bulging disc and a grade two kidney tear.
An employee was cleaning a discharge chain on a conveyor when his thumb was caught in the chain, amputating his right thumb nail and bone. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was greasing bearings on a running machine and his left index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in amputation at the first knuckle. The guard was removed at the time.
An employee was walking the work site in preparation for land clearing. The employee tripped and landed face first onto a tree resulting in a cut lip and chipped teeth.
While climbing up a scaffold to measure a window, an employee fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete ground, breaking ribs and the pelvis.
An employee was lifting the edge of a steel roller conveyor section when the employee's left middle fingertip was pinched between the conveyor and a fork.

An employee was using a battery-powered plastic banding tool to wrap a coil of steel. As he tightened the band, his left index fingertip was caught between the band and the coil, resulting in a deep laceration. His left index fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was operating a cutoff saw to cut pipe when it bound and kicked back, lacerating his chest, neck and cheek.
An employee was mopping the floor when she fell and fractured her hip.
An office door closed on an employee's left thumb. She suffered a damaged tendon under her thumb nail, requiring overnight hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was deburring a piece of steel on a belt sander when the metal flipped up and caught/amputated his right thumb tip between it and the belt.
An employee lost his footing and fell in the path of an excavator bucket, which scraped his right leg, causing a hairline fracture and swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee was trying to pick up a piece of concrete with a walk-behind mini track loader when he was kicked back by the loader and struck a concrete wall behind him. He suffered a fractured hip and pelvis.
On March 20, 2017, an employee was walking in the dining room/kitchen, slipped, and fell resulting in a fractured right femur.
An employee was reversing a stand-up forklift when the forklift jerked. He fell backward and was pinned between the forklift and a shipping container, suffering a deep leg laceration.

On March 20, 2017, at approximately 6:30 p.m., an employee was guiding a sample leather sheet through the roller machine. The employee's hands were pulled into the machine and caught between the top and lower rollers resulting in a fractured right thumb and fractured metacarpals in both hands including lacerations, abrasions and contusions to both hands.

The injured employee was assisting another employee to remove a joint of drill pipe from the pipe rack/gull wings by utilizing an extended boom forklift. The injured employee used lifting slings to raise the load and was caught between the motor shed and the joint of drill pipe injuring his right leg.
An employee was using liquid dishwashing soap when the product splashed the employee, causing chemical burns to the eye and chest.

An employee was operating a printing press when he attempted to clean debris from the press wheel. His hand was pulled into the rollers, and he suffered damaged nerves and swelling in his left arm up to the elbow.

An employee was adjusting the jib lock at the side of the main boom on a 55-ton boom truck. He loosened the lower securement bolts. While loosening the upper bolts one of the lower bolts came out and the jib slipped off of the locking plate. It dropped a couple feet until resting on the cab and struck the employee on the face and left shoulder.

An employee was operating a slitter machine which unrolled steel coils. The coils develop slack as they are unrolled and to counter the slackness the operator manually inserts cardboard slats. As the employee inserted a slat, a gloved right hand was pulled into the coil. The middle, ring and little fingers were amputated. The thumb tip was also amputated.
An employee was replacing a piece of tin that had blown off a building when he lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet from his ladder to the ground, fracturing both ankles.
An employee was throwing a bag of trash into the dumpster when he tripped/slipped and fell to the ground, injuring his hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking the dock area to check for empty trailers when he was struck by a forklift, breaking his foot, heel, and toes.
An employee was operating a press break to bend sheet metal and amputated the middle two fingertips on the right hand when they were pinched between the upper and lower dies.

An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while working with conduit on a concrete floor. The injured employee was manually bracing a piece of metal conduit while another employee applied pressure to bend it. The conduit rolled and caught the injured employee's finger between the conduit and the concrete floor resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was unjamming a multi-aspirator system when the machine cycled, resulting in amputation of his left hand middle finger.
An employee was unloading a truck and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was working on a roof with a leaf blower and fell to the ground while climbing down the extension ladder resulting in a dislocated shoulder.
An employee suffered a right index finger laceration while working near a shrink wrap machine.
An employee was operating a shrink wrap machine and caught her right hand in the running machine resulting in a severe laceration to the right index finger.
An employee was working out of a bucket truck when an arc flash occurred and the employee was burned.
On 3/20/17, an employee was operating a brake press to bend a piece of metal. While he was feeding the press, his right hand entered the machine, amputating his right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee's hand slipped while cutting wood with a table saw. The saw blade then avulsed the employee's left third fingertip.

An employee was moving an empty hamper to a worksite. The employee was holding onto a bungee cord affixed to the hamper when the bungee cord came loose, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the floor. The employee suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was performing sanitation maintenance on a conveyor belt and climbing a ladder when he lost his balance and fell approximately 6 feet. He suffered fractured vertebrae and internal bleeding.
An employee was handling a damaged smoke grenade when it detonated in his hand. He lost his pinky finger and thumb tip.

An employee reached into a gang box to get some welding rods. He placed one can of welding rods to the side and set it on another can of rods. He was reaching to grab a 1/8" can of rods when an opened can tipped over and lacerated his ulnar artery with the metal lid.

An employee was guiding a part into the ring roller machine. As the part was forming, the employee's glove became caught in the rollers and pulled her left hand into the rollers amputating her little, ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was operating a forklift to unload trailers when he drove into a crosswalk safety gate arm, which punctured the inside of his left thigh.
An employee was on a ladder, putting a hanger on a gate valve, when the employee fell off the ladder and into a ditch, breaking a leg.
An employee was moving plywood with a cart and a tractor when a stack of plywood fell on him, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was cleaning out a super heater hopper and was burned by hot ash.
An employee was stocking a shelf with dog treats that were on a pallet. He tripped over the corner of the pallet, fell, and broke his hip, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to load material into a monorail cart. As the employee was pushing the material into the monorail material cups, the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the material shell bar and monorail cart cups. The fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was pulling a plastic pallet over a foot stopper on a conveyor when the pallet crushed her left middle finger, lacerating and fracturing it.

On March 21, 2017, an employee was using a baler to compress metal parts into a block. The employee's left foot was pushing some wire into the baler when the horizontal door caught the foot and amputated two toes. The baler was running at the time.
An employee was operating a press brake and amputated their left ring finger.

On March 21, 2017, an employee was cutting sheathing with a circular saw to make an opening for a staircase and fell 9 feet 3 inches from the first floor to the basement resulting in a fractured eye socket. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while placing pieces in a press brake.
An employee was blowing down a compressor when he fell down and suffered facial fractures, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to move a newborn calf when the mother cow rammed him on the side with her head, breaking about six ribs.
An employee was feeding wire into a wire-pulling unit when the employee's fingertip entered a pinch point on the machine and was partially amputated.
An employee was accessing the top of a baler when the ladder he was on kicked out. He then grabbed the structure next to him and injured his shoulder, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cutting aluminum stock on a table saw. A piece of metal kicked back and severed the tendon to the thumb on the right hand.
An employee was riding on the side of a forklift. When he exited the forklift while it slowed down, his right lower leg was struck and run over by the forklift resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was unloading a forklift from a trailer when the forklift moved and rolled over the employee's left leg, ankle, and foot, requiring hospitalization.
A temporary employee was on an A-frame ladder, applying sealant to a house window, when he fell 8 feet to the ground below. He lacerated his head and fractured his shoulder.
An employee was straightening out wire when he fell backwards and contacted the metal edge around the bottom of a tank, lacerating his right arm.

An employee was recovering a glass container from an autoclave when the hot phosphate buffer saline solution erupted from the autoclave and burned the employee's legs. Proper PPE was not worn at the time.
An employee in a cubicle tripped over a cord and fell against the cubicle wall before hitting the ground. The employee suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a drive motor on an embossing machine when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated in two of the motor gears.
An employee was admitted to the hospital after becoming dehydrated at work.
An employee tripped and punctured his left foot on a metal strand that had just been cut. He was hospitalized and had surgery. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was pulling a 50 lb. bag of powdered cheese across a pallet on the production floor when he felt a sharp pain in his lower abdomen.
An employee was walking and tripped over a vacuum cord and fell, fracturing his knee.
An employee was loading pre-fabricated racks of 4-inch conduits from a cart onto a trailer when his finger was caught between the cart and the conduit, amputating his right ring fingertip.
An employee fell down the stairs and broke an ankle.
An employee was delivering frozen food to a customer. He slipped on ice in the refrigerated trailer and fractured the lower right leg.

An employee was reattaching the gas line to an oven cook top. As he was soldering the line, the gas ignited, causing second and third degree burns on his arms and legs. The gas was not turned off at the time.

An employee was lifting a mold with a crane. He had rigged the mold using chain slings through eye bolts secured to the mold. He was operating the crane with his right hand and placed his left hand on the chain sling/top of the eye bolt. As the slings became tighter, the chains came together and pinched the end of his left thumb, causing an open fracture of his left thumb tip. His thumb tip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee had gone up the unguarded stairway to an office that was locked. When he turned to go back down the stairs, he reached out for the handrail that was not there and fell 10 feet off of the landing. He contacted the floor and fractured his skull.

An employee was moving a piece of sheet rock on an unguarded balcony on the second floor of a building when he fell two stories to the ground, suffering broken bones and contusions that required hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a trailer when his head hit a piece of metal on the trailer. He suffered a head laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a beam saw when he made contact with the moving blade, cutting his right hand.

An employee was operating a multiple spindle drilling machine to make stiles for wood products when the pneumatic hold-down came down on her right ring finger and amputated the fingertip to the first joint.

An employee was observing bridge construction when an excavator struck a telephone pole knocking it over. The telephone line struck the employee on the head. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury and an elevated heart rate.
An employee was cutting pipes located in the ceiling. The employee dismounted the ladder and broke both feet/ankles.
On March 21, 2017, an employee was checking an empty chemical hopper and amputated two fingers on the right hand when the slide gate struck the employee's right hand.
An employee was using a forklift to move building materials from a truck to a construction site when the forklift overturned while going up the driveway. The employee broke an arm and ribs.
An employee was cutting a threshold with a table saw when the blade amputated the employee's fingertips. The table saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was standing on a ladder to install an HVAC at a jobsite when he slipped and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. He cracked several ribs and felt sore on his right side, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was carrying trays back into the kitchen area when she slipped and fell on the wet floor, fracturing her left hip and requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was removing a part from a neck down machine when the machine was activated via the foot control. His left middle fingertip was then caught and amputated in the machine's nip point.
An employee tripped and fell on shrink wrap on a pallet, fracturing the left femur.
An employee was struck by a forklift while emptying a bag into a hopper. The employee suffered a fractured left wrist and L12 vertebra, requiring hospitalization.

On March 22, 2017, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was installing a poster on a billboard sign when he fell 16 feet from the catwalk to the ground below, breaking his right hip and suffering multiple bruises.
An employee was looking on top and under huge metal sorters for documents. When he lifted his head, it struck the metal frame of a sorter and was injured.

An employee was winding fiberglass onto a spinning mandrel when his gloved right hand was caught by the fiberglass/mandrel and pulled into the winder. When he pulled his hand out, his middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was flowing production water to his water trailer when he tripped over a pipe at the well site and fell on his face. He broke his nose and required hospitalization.

An employee was cutting demo scrap with a gas and oxygen torch when he felt his back getting hot. After removing his jacket and shirt, he found a burn roughly the size of a sheet of paper in the middle of his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was filling an ammonia tank with ammonia when it spilled on him, causing dermal burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when he slipped and fell on a patch of ice, breaking his left hip.

An employee was unloading a car engine with a coworker when the engine became caught on the truck bed and fell. As the injured employee attempted to catch the engine, his left index finger was caught between the pallet and the engine, amputating his fingertip.

On 3/22/17, at about 06:14 a.m., an employee was dumping trash from a trash hopper into a larger trash bin when the employee's left ring fingertip was caught and amputated between the two trash receptacles.

While descending from the top platform of an operator loader, an employee walked toward the affixed ladder, lost his balance, and fell approximately 4.5 feet to the ground level. He fractured his left ankle.
An employee was offloading perforating guns from a trailer to the ground when his fingertip was pinched between two sections of pipe, resulting in an amputation.
On March 22, 2017, an employee strained her back and chest while helping to stop a patient from falling.
An employee tripped and fell while walking, fracturing the left hip.
An employee fell on the sidewalk and hit her head.

An employee was attempting to adjust the print plate on a printer machine when his left ring and middle fingers were caught between the machine's rollers. His left ring fingertip was amputated, and his middle finger was lacerated. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was transporting forklift mast pieces using a crane and sling when the pieces slipped in the sling. The material shifted and pinched his right pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was bitten by a brown recluse spider and hospitalized for an allergic reaction to the spider bite.

An employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of dough that was hanging on a moving conveyor when his right hand was pulled into the machine. The teeth of a hard plastic sprocket wheel then lacerated and fractured his hand.
An employee's foot was struck by a forklift that was backing up, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was repairing a floor with a handheld saw. The employee shut the saw off, reached near the saw, and made contact with the blade, which was still coasting to a stop. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
While driving an electric jack, an employee went around a corner and struck a second, parked jack. His foot went off his jack and was crushed between the two jacks.
An employee was installing transition duct on top of a unit when he fell 5 feet to the concrete below, breaking his leg.
An employee's fingertip was amputated after entering a tube-cutting machine.

An employee was standing at the end of a conveyor catching long crossouts to be bundled. A crossout landed on the frame of the conveyor rather than falling off the end of the conveyor belt. The employee's left middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the crossout and conveyor frame.
An employee was stabbed by another worker at the worksite.
An employee was pushing a loaded scaffold rack onto a pallet jack and pinched his right thumb between the pallet jack handle and the pipe spool resulting in amputation of the thumb.
An employee was in a cage carried by a forklift with his harness on when the cage with him inside fell approximately 12 to 14 feet to the ground.
An employee was in the gym with a class when a student with developmental disabilities pulled her hair, causing her neck to twist and suffer a serious injury.
An employee was driving a forklift when his foot was caught between the forklift and a barrier, fracturing it in three places.

Employees were inserting 6-foot pipe into a mill lathe. When the machine turned on, one of the employee's hands was caught between the lathe and valve stem resulting in lacerations to two fingers on the right hand.
An employee was loading material into a densification machine when the material wrapped around his right arm and pulled him into the machine. His right arm was amputated at the shoulder.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when he made contact with bone in the meat and lost control. His right hand then contacted the blade, amputating his thumb and ring finger.
An employee was taking inventory when he pulled on an aluminum sheet stack and aluminum sheets fell onto his left leg, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing maintenance in the point of operation of a rock crusher. When the retaining pin for the rotor was removed, the employee fell with the rotor into the point of operation. The back of his calves were lacerated and de-gloved by the rotor, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was merchandising rose bushes in a client's garden center when she slipped on loose soil that was on the wet ground and lost her balance, falling onto her right side and breaking her arm.
An employee struck a tree while riding a tube down a snow-covered hill, suffering multiple arm fractures, five fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and possible kidney damage.

An employee was performing maintenance and degreasing near the chain and sprocket of a conveyor belt when the conveyor began running. The employee's right middle fingertip was then caught and amputated in the ingoing nip point of the chain and sprocket, which were unguarded at the time.
An employee slipped and fell on the ground while walking to deliver mail, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a power jack to do overhead work. As he came down off the power jack, he slipped and fell 1 to 3 feet, landing on the floor and hitting his head. He was hospitalized.

On March 23, 2017, an employee ascended to the fourth rung of a ladder when it collapsed and he fell to the ground. He lost consciousness, broke his wrist, and sustained possible facial fractures, requiring hospitalization.
On March 23, 2017, at 4:30 AM, an employee was packing snacks at a packing table when the employee fell and struck an adjacent table, suffering head lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a privately owned motor vehicle in the site parking lot, suffering elbow and leg injuries.
An employee on the ground was struck by a falling tree branch and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was cutting concrete with a power saw when it slipped and lacerated his hand.

An employee was clearing a jam on an indexing conveyor belt when the belt indexed unexpectedly, catching and amputating the employee's right ring finger at the first digit. The conveyor's emergency stop was not activated at the time of the incident.
While descending a step ladder, an employee missed the bottom step and fell to the floor, fracturing the left tibia and fibula and requiring surgery.
An employee was feeding his assigned K-9 at the kennels when his dog darted out, pulling the leash and turning him around. He suffered a herniated lumbar disc in his back.
An employee's left index finger was amputated after contacting moving parts in an exhaust fan in the paint department. The exhaust fan was unguarded at the time.

An employee was operating a forklift and driving it to the charging station when the forklift skidded on the wet floor. The employee tried to stop the forklift by extending his arm. In the process, he crushed his hand.

An employee was delivering mail. The employee stepped onto the back bumper of the postal vehicle to step inside the vehicle. His foot slipped off of the bumper and he attempted to break his fall using his right arm. The employee suffered several fractures to the right wrist requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a printing press when his right arm was caught and fractured in a roller.
An employee was cutting chicken with a knife when his left thumb tip was amputated. Cut-resistant gloves were not worn at the time.
An employee was cutting loose a cradle that was holding up a hose davit boom when the cradle broke lose and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was struck by a pipe while attempting to open a bleed line, suffering contusions and broken bones in his torso. He was hospitalized.

An employee had changed the packing on a frac pump and was preparing to install the plunger when the plunger slipped and smashed his finger against the corner of the fluid end, amputating a portion of his left pinky.

On March 23, 2017, an employee was at the nut welder retrieving an extra nut dropped by the nut feeder when the employee's left fingertip was caught and amputated between the nut being retrieved and the tip of the welder.

A crane operator was setting up to perform work on the HVAC units on the roof. The rear outrigger penetrated the concrete surface which caused the crane to partially turn over in the direction of the counterweights. The pill ball swung back towards the crane cab. The crane operator exited the crane cab and struck the injured employee standing outside the crane cab knocking him to the ground. The injured employee sustained fractured lower vertebrae, a foot fracture and a head contusion.
An employee was using a high-pressure water line when the water punctured the skin on his leg. His wound became infected and required hospitalization.

An employee wearing gloves was drilling a hole in an exterior wall when the drill became jammed. While trying to unjam the drill, the employee's left pinky was caught and amputated by the rotating drill bit.
An employee was moving boxes of raisins from a display when he tripped and fell, breaking his right ankle and requiring hospitalization.

On March 23, 2017, an employee was using a forklift to unload skids in a trailer when a box fell from a pallet. The employee stopped the forklift and applied the emergency brakes. While he was bending over to pick up the box, the forklift rolled and the forks ran into his ankle, pinning him against the skid in the trailer. His left ankle was fractured.
On March 23, 2017, an employee was working at the anilox roller when it began to move and caught the employee's left hand, amputating two fingers. The roller was energized at the time.

An employee was inspecting his 18-wheeler while it was parked on a truck weigh scale. The employee was climbing in or out of the tractor when his foot was caught on the scale railing, causing him to fall to the ground and fracture his tibia/fibula. He required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a crescent wrench to loosen a nut on the base of a lathe when the nut came loose and the wrench came off. The employee then lost his balance, fell backward to the concrete floor, and fractured his left elbow.
An employee tripped and fell on a concrete curb, breaking his kneecap.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when his hand was pulled in and his finger was amputated. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee and a coworker attempted to re-activate a dock plate after servicing the hydraulic pump. The employees removed their lockout devices and found that the dock plate would not lower. The injured employee went underneath the dock plate to attempt to adjust it to lower properly. As he was in the process of doing this task, the dock plate fell onto his body, puncturing his lung, breaking ribs, and breaking his left scapula.
An employee stepped underneath a coat hanger while reaching for an article of clothing and walked into a wall-mounted clothing hook, hitting and dislodging his left eye.
An employee was attempting to stow a boom lift in a truck carriage when the boom fork moved and amputated about 1 inch of his right thumb.
While participating in a group exercise, an employee suffered an acute loss of mobility in the arms and shoulder, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was supervising coworkers who were pouring castings when heat from the castings ignited the employee's clothes, causing second and third degree burns to both legs. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was hit by a soccer ball while coaching a soccer game, chipping a tooth and breaking an orbital bone. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 14, 2017, at 4:30 p.m., an employee was standing on the back of a company panel truck van after loading pipe on the trailer when the van began moving. He then slipped and fell from the truck and struck his head against the truck or trailer, fracturing his skull and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking when she missed a small step and fell down, fracturing her right elbow and right foot.

On March 24, at around 7 a.m., an employee was working on an HVAC piping system that was under a pressure test. Believing that the pressure test was completed, he removed the end cap from the pipe. There was still pressure in the pipe, which caused the end cap to fly off and strike him in the mouth area. He suffered lacerations to his mouth and cheekbone.
An employee sat on a backpack that had her personal knife stored inside the exterior pocket, cutting her right leg.
An employee was using a saw to cut a wood doorframe when the blade amputated the employee's left thumb tip.
An employee was working on the press room floor when his arm was pulled into a running roll, removing skin and requiring surgery.
An employee was inspecting and servicing fire extinguishers when a client's forklift struck the employee's left ankle from behind, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

On March 24, 2017, an employee was spotting a front-end loader that was loading barrier walls onto a low boy trailer when one of the barrier walls (12 feet long, weighing about 5,000 pounds) fell on his ankle and fractured his left leg. He was hospitalized and his leg was amputated below his knee.

An employee was rigging a dump cart to an overhead hoist using a metal chain when the chain came loose. The dump cart then fell and knocked the employee to the ground, fracturing the employee's neck, back, and hip.
An employee fell 2 to 3 feet from a bakers scaffold, suffering  broken ribs.
An employee was setting up a carousel when he fell approximately 8 feet and hit his head on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with head trauma.
An employee was leaning over a bucket elevated 10-12 feet by a forklift and fell resulting in two broken wrists and rib contusions.
While dumping a pan of product into a hopper, an employee's body twisted resulting in a broken hip.

On March 24, 2017, at 10:30 a.m., an employee was in a manlift trimming tree limbs with a chain saw when he lost control of it and received a severe laceration to his left index finger. He was hospitalized for surgery.
While standing on a raised lift gate on the back of a laundry truck, an employee fell and broke the right leg in two places.
On March 24, 2017, an employee's foot became caught on telecommunications wires, causing the employee to fall and suffer a fractured hip and bruised right shin.
An employee was descending a ladder when he lost his footing and fell from a few rungs high, breaking ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped back and tripped on a coworker's foot, falling to the ground and injuring her right shoulder. She was hospitalized.

An employee was leaving a roof where he was laying insulation when he fell 35 feet through an uncovered hole. He hit several air ducts on the way down and sustained head lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a plank supported by two A-frame ladders when the plank broke, causing the employee to fall approximately 5 feet and break the right femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning under a loom when the operator restarted the machine. The activated loom then crushed the employee's hand and arm. The loom was not locked out at the time.

An employee was moving a metal table on wheels next to another metal table when his right hand was smashed between the two. His pinky finger was avulsed and had to be surgically amputated to the knuckle.

An employee was running a brake press, bending flat aluminum sheets to form louvers. While she was handling an aluminum sheet, her right hand slipped and went toward the point of operation, which had a press knife. When she pulled her right hand back, the press knife amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was attempting to clear off some pellets from a transfer line when his right hand was caught by a rotary valve, amputating his middle and ring fingertips above the bone.
An employee was attempting to clear a potato jam in the flume area when he stepped on a potato and rolled his ankle, breaking it.

An employee was surveying a site to install cable when a brick wall from the neighborhood fence came crashing down on the employee. The employee was knocked down by the falling brick and debris, suffering trauma to the facial area, a broken jaw, and several fractures of the sinus cavity and eye socket. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee and a coworker were using an air-operated diaphragm pump and hose to transfer hot cooking oil from a fryer into a travel tote. 
The employees made the connections, turned on the air supply to the pump, and commenced pumping. After a few minutes, the discharge hose split due to the temperature of the oil (approximately 250 degrees) allowing the oil to splash the employee. He suffered third degree burns on his hands, abdomen, groin, and lower extremities.
An employee was removing a 4" valve with a flange. As he was removing the valve, his right pinky finger was caught between the flange of the valve and the pad-I, amputating it at the first joint.

An employee was smoothing a wrinkle in paper feeding into the converter machine with her left hand. Her middle and ring fingers were caught in a nip point between rollers removing both nails and some flesh.
An employee was moving equipment from a stand to the ground when his right middle fingertip was pinched and amputated between the equipment and the stand.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while trying to remove dough from a machine.

On March 25, 2017, at 10:30 AM, an employee was operating a drill press to drill holes in shower shelves when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught on the drill bit. The fingertip had to be amputated up to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a 10,000 lb. diesel forklift on uneven gravel in a construction zone when the forklift tipped over. The employee struck the ground and suffered head trauma.
An employee was working at the chlorine loading station and was changing out a transfer hose from a railcar. Upon disconnecting the hose, the employee inhaled chlorine, requiring hospitalization.

An employee and a coworker were changing out an actuator cylinder. They were using supplied air to operate the cylinder and align the holding pin by lowering and raising it. The employee aligning the holding pin asked the air supply operator to put air into the line. Afterwards, the employee was checking the alignment when the cylinder dropped and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip before the bone.
An employee was operating a piece of equipment when the equipment door struck and injured the employee's left hand.
An employee was walking past a wooden pallet when she tripped over it and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee was putting jewelry into a safe as part of closing procedures. As she closed the safe doors, they closed on and amputated her right middle and index fingertips.

An employee was operating a plastic strip collator when her right forearm was caught in the orientation wheel, lacerating and fracturing it. The machine was running and unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a pallet rider. When he stepped off the moving pallet rider, it ran over and injured his left ankle.

An employee was using an overhead chain lift to lift a 29-foot-long flat bar weighing 2900 lbs. when the hook holding the chain bent, allowing the flat bar to slip and amputate the employee's left middle and ring fingertips.

An employee accidentally drank sodium hydroxide, believing it was a bottle of water. He immediately spit out the fluid and suffered minor chemical burns to the mouth, requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was disengaging a truck trailer when the truck moved, catching him between the truck steps and the trailer. He suffered four broken ribs and a punctured lung. The truck brake was not set at the time of the incident.

An employee was working on the 3rd floor when she fell through part of the metal grate flooring that was cut out. She fell to the metal grating the next floor down and suffered punctures to her left and right leg.

Three team members were doing repair work on the bullnose dryer to repair a broken chain on the transfer system. A team member was located on each end of the dryer, with a third team member assisting. They were about 15 to 20 feet apart, trying to get the chain back in place. The team members had completed the proper lock-out/tag-out procedure on the equipment. The injured employee noticed the chain was twisted in the sprocket, so he asked them by radio to stop pulling the chain. While he was unjamming the chain in the sprocket, the team member on the other side pulled the chain, which pulled the injured employee's finger into the pinch point between the sprocket and chain. He suffered an exposure facture of the first phalange of the right index finger.
An employee was transferring H piling down a conveyor system when his right pinky finger was smashed between the H piling and the conveyor roller.
An employee was feeding lumber into a header saw when the saw was activated via the foot switch, causing it to cycle and amputate his left ring finger at the nail.
An employee was removing the flywheel from a paver when it came off and came down on his right pinky finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was eating dinner with a client at a support meeting when the client's cat bit him.

An employee was running the punch press and removing a piece of stamped metal from the press using pliers. The pliers got caught in the machine causing the employee's finger to get caught between the press bed and the pliers. The employee's finger was fractured and the nailbed was removed.

An employee was part of a team of deputies apprehending a fugitive on foot. The injured employee scaled a fence and upon impact with the ground suffered a compound fracture to his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized from over-exertion during physical fitness training.
After dumping trash in a dumpster, an employee lost her balance and fell, fracturing her hip and requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee and a coworker were positioning a wood panel on the bed of a milling machine when the coworker turned on the milling machine vacuum system. The vacuum sucked the wood panel down into the milling machine, and the panel pinched and amputated the employee's right middle fingertip between it and the milling machine bed.

A temporary employee was in an open area being instructed on how to operate a walkie/rider pallet jack. He was attempting to turn the equipment around and drive in a straight line down the main aisle when he ran into pallets that are kept on the endcap of each aisle. His right foot extended over the edge of the standing platform before impact and was injured in the collision, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was unloading equipment from the bed of a truck when his fall protection lanyard became tangled around his leg, causing him to lose his balance and fall. He broke his leg and dislocated his right ankle while trying to remove his boot, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was closing the vault door in the bank when the door caught her left index finger. As she pulled her left hand back, her index fingertip was detached and had to be medically amputated.

An employee was erecting steel grate flooring on a tower while wearing personal fall protection. He was repositioning himself to another location when he tripped and fell 30 feet to the concrete surface below, landing on his left shoulder and head.

An employee hooked up a chain sling to a section of I-beam so a bridge crew could move it with a crane. He was guiding the material as the crane moved it when the chain sling slid and allowed the beam to roll. His right index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the chain and I-beam.

An employee was cutting 2x4s with a circular saw for grout forms. The boards were on saw horses. The saw kicked back and the employee's hand slipped under the saw resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee opened the back doors of his trailer and the metal racks that were inside fell on him, fracturing his right foot, left leg, left elbow, nose, and face.

On March 27, 2017, an employee fell approximately 12 feet through a hole on the furnace deck and struck the floor below, suffering left shoulder, left internal, and facial abrasions that required hospitalization.
An employee had welded a clip onto a vent plate. He was using a come-along to straighten the plate when it broke off and lacerated his elbow.

On March 28, 2017, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was cutting around an old water main line in preparation to install a new main when the east wall of the trench collapsed. He was buried up to his waist in dirt from the collapse, suffering a possible hip fracture.
An employee was using a chainsaw when it bounced back and severely lacerated his index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was standing on a folding ladder painting the overhang of a house when he overreached, lost his balance, and fell to the ground, breaking his arm.
An employee's right hand was caught in a chain/sprocket system between the grain change and unscrambler machines, injuring four fingers.
An employee was jet rodding a sanitary sewer line when the jet rod hose ruptured and cut the employee's right hand.

On March 27, 2017, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was on the existing roof of the high school with a coworker, cutting a hole in that roof for the installation of an HVAC unit. He then stepped into the hole and fell to the floor approximately 15 feet below, suffering fractures to his hip and pelvis and contusions to the head and both hands. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking into the canteen to get lunch when she slipped and fell on an area where a customer recently had spilled their food and cleaned it up. She dislocated her patella and fractured a femur.
An employee was picking up trash from the back of a waste collection truck when the employee fell off the back of the truck and struck the ground, suffering head and shoulder injuries.
An employee and crew were laying pipe in an easement when the employee backed into the roadway and was struck by the rear wheels of an 18-wheeler. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was breaking a metal conduit to make it fit into a trash cart when the end hit his face, breaking a bone and requiring surgery.

On March 28, 2017, around 1:30 AM, an employee was using an air hose to clean equipment when the hose became wrapped on a steel stand. The steel stand was propping open a metal door. The employee tugged on the hose, which caused the steel stand to move and the metal door to close on and amputate the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee and a coworker were carrying a sink into storage when the employee tripped on a 4-inch curb and fell, fracturing his right hip.

The employee was using a hoist to lift a bundle of steel onto a flatbed trailer. The strap that held the bundle became stuck on one of the latches on the flatbed and the employee attempted to loosen it. The bundle of steel came loose and struck the employee's knee.
An employee was making a timber mat when a beam rolled over and broke his right ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was inside a stationary scissor lift, loading windows into the lift basket from a wooden box on a nearby all terrain forklift, when he exited the scissor lift to retrieve a window he could not reach and fell 6 to 8 feet to the ground below. He suffered a broken wrist, nose, and back.

An employee was tracing an acetonitrile solution pipeline to verify which pipe was leaking from the pipe rack when he came into contact with the chemical mist. He experienced a headache and signs of exposure to acetonitrile, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was checking the railroad gate when he tripped and fell on a pallet and a pile of glass. He broke four ribs and his sternum, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped on the curb and fell backwards, hitting his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was cleaning a patch kit machine after use. The employee was using an air wand to blow sand from around the machine. There was a clump of sand that he couldn't get out with the air pressure so he attempted to remove the clump of sand with his hand. At that point, the machine cycled and amputated his left index finger. The machine was guarded at the time.

On March 25, 2017, at approximately 2:30 a.m., an employee was cleaning off the sealers on the vertical bagger machine when the machine actuated and crushed the employee's finger between two sealers resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was removing a valve end cap that was located on the front of the temperature control skid of a reactor when steam and hot water exited the end of the pipe and caused second degree burns to the employee's left arm, leg, and side of the body.

An employee was lifting material with a 10-ton overhead crane when the load became unbalanced, swung, and struck the employee knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right radial bone.

An employee had just changed out a filter on the water treatment system. As he was putting the water treatment system back online, the stand that the filter sits on cracked and shifted, causing the filter to come down on and break his left arm.
An employee smashed his left pinky finger while pulling the lever of a 6-yard tilt dumpster. Half of his finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was changing the die press brake when the machine re-cycled and amputated her right index finger.

An employee was cleaning a roll-forming machine when her right hand was caught between two rollers. Her right middle finger was crushed and had to be amputated. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was pulling out a strapper from the home position when the strapper came loose, striking the employee's right middle finger against a stationary frame. The employee suffered a broken right middle finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was working under the trailer of a truck, bleeding the air lines, when the trailer slipped off the jack, fell on him, and broke his ankle.
An employee was descending an 8-foot A-frame ladder when he slipped on the second or third step and hit his head on the floor.
An employee slipped on a landscaping stone in the parking lot and fell, breaking her hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was conducting electrical line maintenance and was using the fixed steps of a bucket truck when he fell about 6 feet to the ground, suffering a compression fracture to his upper back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a cart when he was struck by a moving front-end loader, suffering nerve damage to the leg.
An employee was reversing a standup forklift when his left foot was caught between the forklift and a pole. He suffered an abrasion to his left foot/lower leg.
An employee was changing a light bulb when the globe around the bulb broke. The broken glass then amputated his fingertip.
An employee was shot in the right leg by a gun that went off as she reached back to grab it.
An employee was using a hose to unload a tank of hot asphalt when the hose broke, allowing the asphalt to splash and burn the employee.

An employee was using a hot tap device to drill a pilot hole into a steel pipe that had green liquor flowing through it. After drilling the pilot hole, the employee was attempting to withdraw the drill bit/holder beyond the ball valve, so the valve could be closed. While the employee was withdrawing the shaft, a coworker was trying to close the valve, but could not get the valve handle to turn. The employee continued to pull the drill bit out of the piping until the shaft came out of the device, allowing green liquor to spray him and burn his chest and side.
An employee was unloading a hold when his leg was pinned and injured between an I-beam and wire coils.

An employee was moving a steel beam to a truck with an overhead crane. The employee attached the crane hook into a bolt hole at one end of the steel beam to be moved. The steel was lifted and lowered to dunnage. The steel beam slipped from the dunnage and pinched the employee's left thumb, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while grouting a manhole, suffering multiple fractures and lacerations to the face and left knee.
An employee was cleaning out a trailer and fell three to four feet from the trailer onto a guardrail resulting in broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was helping to erect a balloon wall when the metal tie down straps gave way, causing the balloon wall feet to kick out and the wall to fall on him. He suffered a fractured vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a patching truck while holding onto a ladder rack. The employee's ring became caught in the rack, resulting in an avulsion or degloving injury to the ring finger.

An employee was cutting a band from a bundle when the bars started to roll. The employee tried to brace himself, but his hand went out toward the bars and his fingertip was pinched and partially amputated between two bars.
A trainee fractured his distal wrist while attempting to take down drywall with his hands.
An employee was attacked by two dogs while delivering the mail resulting in bites to the hand, arms and chin requiring stitches and a broken arm.
An employee was lowering a box of clay pigeons into a container when the container lid fell on his left middle finger, resulting in an amputation without bone loss.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 3/8" thick, 3' x 10' piece of steel plate. There was a chain on the crane hook, which was attached to an eye bolt for moving the steel plate. The steel plate came off the crane hook, bounced off of a bench, and struck the employee in the leg. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg and had surgery.
An employee was loading a climate controlled trailer with palletized product and experienced back pain. The employee suffered a slipped disc in the lower back resulting in a pinched nerve.
On March 29, 2017, an employee became engaged in a physical altercation with a coworker that resulted in hospitalization for cuts and bruises.
A truck driver was delivering product to a store and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was exiting a bus and broke their ankle in two places.
An employee suffered a right ring finger distal amputation while operating a sheeter machine. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum with a rotary saw when it kicked back and amputated his left index finger.
An employee was operating a ram packer machine when his arm was caught in a pinch point and his right forearm was punctured by part of the machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a disc sanding machine when the tips of the left index and middle fingers were amputated.

On March 29, 2017, an employee was clearing out jammed material in a machine when his hand was caught in the air lock. The rotating fan blades partially amputated his second, third, and fourth fingers on his right hand.

An employee was installing metal panels on a residential roof while wearing fall protection (harness, tied off to roof anchor) when he lost his balance and fell. The roof anchor failed, and the employee fell approximately 14 feet to the ground, bruising his vertebrae and requiring hospitalization.

On March 29, 2017, an employee was moving a roll of steel coil with a coil caddy and crane. The employee saw the coil tipping and tried to stop if from tipping over. As the coil tipped, the employee's left hand was caught between the coil caddy and steel coil, amputating the first and second fingers and breaking the third finger.

An employee was operating a press brake to flatten metal plates. The metal plate was held in place by a hoist hook. The hook slipped off the metal plate causing the metal plate to strike the employee's right arm. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to repair a broken right arm.

On March 29, 2017, an employee was troubleshooting an overhead door opener when their left finger became caught between the chain and sprocket of the side mounted overhead door opener, resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was driving a tractor trailer and exiting the employer's facility when the tractor trailer was struck by a train at a rail road crossing. The employee suffered a brain bleed, back fracture and other injuries.
An employee was manually feeding sheet metal into the roller when his right hand was caught in the sheet metal roller and crushed four fingers.
An employee was performing framing activities from a 6-foot step ladder and fell resulting in injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a crushing injury to the hand from a rebar shear.
An employee was working to install a box culvert. He was walking across a stream when he slipped and fell onto a hardline discharge hose from a pump, suffering internal bleeding.
An employee was cleaning out the cluster machine (mixer) while it was running and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was preparing an IBC container for recycling when the ethanol that was in the container ignited and burned the employee's arms, chest, and legs.
An employee was setting up the seamer to weld two pieces of metal together when an object hit and shattered the employee's jaw. The employee also suffered a concussion.

An employee was troubleshooting a conveyer belt when his left hand became caught in the chain and sprocket. He sustained amputation of his left pinky finger, partial amputation of his left index finger, and crushing injuries to his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was hospitalized with extreme dehydration.
An employee was inspecting a worksite when his leg fell into a hole. He struck the wooden cover on the opening and fractured his ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a Kevlar Rope wrapper to install Kevlar fabric onto a roller. The control was fixed so the machine continued to run while the employee adjusted the Kevlar fabric. Both of his pinky fingers were caught between the Kevlar rope and the metal roller, tearing the skin at the base of one if his left fingers that required surgery and fracturing one of his right fingers.
An employee was placing items into a baler (cardboard crusher). When she turned and walked away, she fell to the floor. She was hospitalized with a shattered tibia and fibula in her right leg.
An employee was installing a placard on a shipping container when he fell 16 feet. He bruised his forehead and broke his arm and left wrist, requiring surgery.

On March 30, 2017, an employee was standing on a three-step ladder torching a roll off box when a piece of steel fell and struck his helmet, knocking him to the ground. The employee fractured the left hip/pelvis area and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt wrapping machine when his right arm became caught in the belt. He sustained compound fractures in his right arm, fractured both ankles and lacerations to his head and face.
An employee was troubleshooting a piston machine and amputated the right index and middle fingers. The machine was powered down, but had not yet stopped spinning.

An employee was on a ladder at the mid-span making a connection between the customer and the telecom line. The employee cut the line and tension that was released from the cut wire caused the employee to fall off the ladder. The employee suffered a collapsed lung.
An employee was reading a meter at a residence when she was bitten by a dog and suffered the amputation of her right pinky fingertip.
An employee was using a wooden handled cant hook to move a wooden pole. The handle broke causing the employee to fall backwards, twisting and breaking his right ankle.
An employee was delivering packages, slipped, and fell fracturing two hip bones.

An employee was cleaning a blender machine and amputated his left ring finger, a portion of his left middle finger, and lacerated his left index finger. The blender machine was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was unloading freight from a silage trailer at a customer location. The silage trailer had a moving floor inside that runs on a web conveyor belt. The employee opened the door in front of the trailer when the web conveyor (PTO) was operational and got caught in the conveyor. The employee's left arm was amputated.
An employee was cutting framing materials with a fillet cutter and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was conducting a test on a valve, located on a trolley system. The valve is hydrostatically tested. The valve fell off the trolley system and landed on the employee, resulting in amputation of the employee's index and ring fingers.
On March 30, 2017, an employee was guiding a ply of paper into the winder machine when his right hand was caught under the machine belt, amputating part of his right thumb and index finger.
An employee was grinding meat using a meat grinder and amputated the left index finger.
An employee was installing ground rod, slipped, and injured his left palm.
On March 30, 2017, an employee was walking across the parking lot when she tripped over a trailer hitch, fell, and suffered a broken bone.
An employee was dumping trash, tripped and fell fracturing his hip.
An employee was walking in an area where a floor cleaning agent had recently been applied, when she suffered an allergic reaction and difficulty breathing and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving product with an electric pallet jack and pinned his left foot under the racking system beam. The left foot was fractured and lacerated.
An employee was unloading a pallet on a truck. He lost his balance and fell to the ground, suffering a broken bone.

Three employees were in a large interior area underneath a concrete silo. They were moving a screw conveyor housing out of the way in an area where they were planning to install a new screw conveyor flight. As they pushed the screw conveyor housing across the concrete floor, the front vertical angle iron support broke at the welded connection to the housing. As the housing fell approximately 21 inches to the ground, the injured employee's right foot was caught underneath and fractured. The injury required surgery and hospitalization.
On March 30, 2017, an employee was operating a press and suffered a partial amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was installing precast concrete fence panels when a panel fell onto his right hand, crushing his right index, middle and ring fingers.
An employee was removing stickers from duct work when they fell off an 8-foot ladder and suffered a concussion and bruises to the shoulder and back.
An employee was lifting a pallet when the pallet fell on their hand and wrist. The injury required surgery to relieved the pressure and swelling.
