An employee was observing delivery of equipment from a truck using the power lift gate. The equipment became unbalanced and fell off the lift gate striking the employee and knocking him backwards. The employee sustained a fractured right knee and a tendon injury.

An employee was removing some branches from the concrete driveway of the business. The branch that she was pulling broke causing her to fall backwards and break her elbow. She also suffered a contusion to the back of her head.
An employee was clearing the notching machine when his left hand was amputated.
An employee was repairing a switch panel and received third degree burns to his hands and face from an arc flash.
An employee was riding on the rear load yard waste truck and fell off resulting in a head injury.

The injured employee was loading bundles of shingles onto a conveyor and sending them up to his partner who was stocking the bundles on the roof. The injured employee stepped onto the pallet to reach for the last bundle and the wood pallet broke. The injured employee lost his balance and fell off the truck bed to the concrete driveway below resulting in a fractured left heel.

Employees were guiding a metal light pole from its base to the ground. As the employees were guiding the light pole, the top portion of the light pole came in contact with a 7200v overhead power line. All three employees received burns to their hands and one employee received burns to the upper torso.
An employee finished loading a trailer and exited the trailer via the trailer stairs. The employee slipped on the stairs and fell breaking her left wrist. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was moving patients to the dining room when she tripped over a patient's wheelchair leg rest, fell, and suffered a bone fracture.
An employee was on the roof inspecting it for an insurance claim, slipped and fell off the roof resulting in broken wrists and vertebrae.
An employee was testing a new matrix for respiratory care when a valve closed on the employee's right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
On March 30, 2017, an employee was pulling an aluminum extrusion on the table when the table jogged and injured his left wrist. He was hospitalized following complications to the wrist injury.
An employee was loading an exhaust fan on a flatbed truck when his left shin hit the fan and was lacerated.
An employee was using a pipe wrench with a cheater bar to tighten a nipple when the pipe wrench broke and the cheater bar struck the employee's head, causing blunt force trauma.
An employee was working on a railhead and loading railcars. As he was pulling himself up on a railcar, he slipped and fell off, fracturing his right femur.
An employee was exiting a golf cart when she tripped, hit her head on a wall, and then fell on her left knee. She suffered a left knee fracture and a concussion.

An employee was operating a baler machine.  The employee installed a new spool of baling wire on the back of the machine and then threaded the new wire through the eyelets and was twisting the new wire onto the old wire when the machine cycled severing his left hand. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was preparing to tarp the load in a single drop trailer. The employee walked up the ramp in the back, slipped due to rain, and fell approximately 37" resulting in a broken elbow and hip.
While attempting to unclog a floor drain, the employee turned and stepped into the drain that contained hot water causing first and second degree burns to the lower right leg.
A temporary employee was operating a reach truck and struck a rack resulting in amputation of the left thumb at the first knuckle.

While unloading a reel of wire with a pallet jack, the wheels of the pallet jack rolled off the truck's lift gate causing the wire and the pallet jack to flip over onto the ground and strike the employee's ankle and fracturing it.
An employee was unloading drill rods when their gloved right hand got caught in the boring machine and was injured.
An employee was walking around a work station, tripped on a table and fell breaking the right elbow.
An employee was walking down a grassy hill after delivering a package to a residence and fell fracturing her ankle in three places.
An employee was using a scraper to remove and clean dough off a mixer and caught a finger in the spinning chain and sprocket severing the fingertip. The mixer was not locked out at the time.
An employee slipped and fell from a ladder while cleaning, suffering a broken left leg.

An employee was unstrapping a tarped load on a flatbed trailer when the tarp became caught on the load. At the time of the incident, it was raining heavily. He was attempting to remove the wet tarp when he slipped on it and fell from the trailer, injuring his back.

An employee was polishing a shaft with an emery cloth while the shaft was spinning in a lathe when the emery cloth caught on a bur and pulled his right thumb into the machine, partially amputating it.

An employee was cutting a fallen tree that was laying on a telephone cable. When the tree was cut, pressure was released on the telephone cable, which sprung back up and threw the limb toward the employee. He suffered a contusion to the right side of his face.

An employee was lifting sheet metal bundles with a crane. He intended to separate and pass a strap between two bundles. 
The top one fell and trapped his left middle fingertip, amputating it with no bone loss.
While climbing into the cab of a semi-tractor, an employee fell backward onto the pavement and struck their head. The employee was hospitalized with an internal hemorrhage.
While performing wood framing activities, an employee fell through a floor hole and struck the ground, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee working in a gas station kiosk noticed a hose at a gas pump was not hung up correctly. As he attempted to go fix the pump, he tripped and fell to the pavement, fracturing his hip.
An employee was walking to a patient's room when a bug ran toward her. As she was moving away, she backed up, lost her balance, and fell, fracturing her right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
While lifting a crate, an employee suffered a compression fracture to the lower back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a straight ladder when it slipped out from underneath him. He fell to the ground and fractured his right hip and ankle.
An employee fell off a truck while inspecting it and he was knocked unconscious. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a winch to collect waste material in a rear load trash truck. As the winch was retracting, he held the winch cable to one side away from a cable bracket with his left hand. His left index finger was then caught between the cable and the bracket, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was working from an extension ladder to repair an overhead garage door when the bottom of the ladder, which was positioned on a dry floor area, slid outward. The employee fell approximately 9 to 10 feet with the ladder, suffering fractures to the right and left arms.
An employee was hand-felling a 4-inch diameter tree on an energy transfer gas line right-of-way when the tree trunk kicked back and struck him in the jaw, breaking it.
An employee was hospitalized with allergic bronchitis due to a possible inhalation of peracetic acid (PAA).
On March 31, 2017, an employee was moving a tarp on his tractor-trailer when he strained/sprained his back, suffering severe pain and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was manually lifting individual pieces of scrap metal and throwing them into a metal bin when he was struck in the right eye by a metal rod that was ejected from the bin. He was wearing gloves and eye protection at the time.
An employee was standing next to a conveyor and caught her foot on a dolly. The employee fell and fractured her kneecap.
A truck driver was stabbed while at a gas station and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a pouch line tank when a coworker opened the valve at the bottom the tank, releasing the 197-degree water. The water caused second degree burns to the employee's right leg and foot.
On April 1, 2017, an employee caught her ankle on a push cart and fell, suffering knee and head trauma. She required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a floor dolly and fell to the floor on his right hip, fracturing it and requiring surgery.

An employee was loading a wheeler with products from a truck. The employee went back into the truck to organize, moved toward the back of the vehicle, and then fell 33 inches to the ground, suffering back and leg injuries.

An employee was setting up a steel bar on a lathe and tried to move the steady rest, which was open. When contacted, the top part of the steady rest fell onto and broke his right hand. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was pulling cases to put on a cart when he tripped and fell, injuring his right lower arm.
An employee was painting a newly paved road when a vehicle struck him, breaking both of his legs and one of his shoulders.
An employee was retrieving merchandise from a walk-in cooler when a powered industrial truck ran over her left foot.

An employee turned the corner walking around a cooling blanket machine in the hallway. Her foot was caught on the blanket's clear tubing and she tripped and fell, landing on her left side chest wall and left wrist. She sustained a left chest wall contusion, left wrist sprain, and collapsed left lung.
An employee was troubleshooting a switch gear when an arc blast/flash occurred, burning his face.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet from a ladder while attempting to access the roof, suffering broken ankles.
An employee was outside of his tow truck helping a customer with a tow in the breakdown lane when he was struck by a car, breaking his pelvis.

An employee was exiting a vehicle when it started to move, causing him to lose his balance. He fell backward and hit his head on the ground/concrete, busting his eardrum. The parking brake was not engaged at the time of the incident.
An employee was injecting a cow with antibiotics when the cow began chasing him. As he was running from the cow, he fell to the ground, breaking his leg and kneecap.
An employee tripped over a flatbed and hit his head on the floor, suffering head an neck injuries.
An employee was loading metal racks into a trailer using a lift truck when the employee's left foot was caught and fractured between the lift truck and the metal rack.

An employee was operating a forklift while moving pallets in a warehouse. While he was backing up the forklift, his right hand was on the frame of the overhead guard. His right hand then made contact with a parked trailer, severely lacerating his fingers.

An employee's left index finger was severely lacerated while helping another employee clear a clogged mower chute on a commercial zero-turn lawn mower. The mower was turned off and the cutting blades disengaged, however the blower fan was still moving when the injured employee's  left hand entered the blower fan. The finger had to be amputated.
An employee slipped while working on a fry station. He put his hands down, and his right forearm and hand were burned by the fryer grease.
An employee was performing rig-down operations for an oil drilling rig when a large cylinder fell and crushed the employee's right leg below the knee resulting in amputation.
An employee was trying to get sand to flow through a slot gate when it closed and amputated two of the employee's fingertips.
An employee was cutting meat on a meat cutter when the blade cut his thumb (no amputation). He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was descending a ladder when his foot slipped off the rung. He fell 15 feet to the concrete below, dislocating his knee.
An employee was restocking a freezer using a stand-up forklift. He was turning the forklift and reaching for a product when his left middle finger struck a metal beam, fracturing it.
An employee was walking in the warehouse, tripped over a pallet and fell injuring her left knee.
An employee was on a ladder against the roof when the ladder slipped, causing him to fall to the ground. He sustained fractured vertebrae in his back and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a 45 degree elbow on a 10 inch pipe with an oxyacetylene torch while working on an elevated platform about four feet above the ground. A hot metal flash back occurred and the employee received second degree burns from his chest to the waist and third degree burns on the lower left side of his abdomen. The employee was wearing a harness and PPE at the time of the incident.
An employee was grabbing dividers that were stored on top of a cooler. The employee fell 12 feet to the ground and was hospitalized for head and back trauma.
On April 3, 2017, an employee was operating a tractor and brush got under the brake pedal. The operator could not stop the tractor and struck a fence resulting in leg contusions.

An employee was operating a press brake and suffered broken fingers. The employee was removing shims from under a four-way die on the press brake when the dies shifted and pinched the employee's fingers.
An employee was processing returns and moving 3-pound plastic totes by hand. He picked up an empty tote to stack it and hurt his lower back, requiring hospitalization for severe back pain.

An employee was working from a motorized order selector disassembling racking. A support beam fell striking the employee working from the order selector. The employee then fell from the order selector to the concrete floor resulting in broken bones. The employee was wearing a body harness connected to the order selector, but still made contact with the floor.
An employee became ill after participating in physical fitness exercise. He experienced cramping and nausea due to heat and dehydration.
An employee was working from an order picker and fell 52" to the concrete floor, breaking his left arm and hip.
An employee was cleaning saw dust from a wood chop saw. The power was turned off but the blade had not come to a full stop. The rotating blade then amputated his left pinky and ring fingers.

The injured employee was setting cribbing for the landing of c-channel shaped metal material on the ground. The injured employee was standing next to the powered industrial truck that held the stacked material that was going onto the cribbing when the stacked material rolled onto the employee's left leg resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was driving a forklift that overturned on him. The employee's left leg was caught by the forklift's mast crushing his toes which were amputated at the hospital. All five toes on the left foot were amputated.

An employee was removing rigging from cargo that was just unloaded from the ship and pinched his left index finger between the shackle and the pad eye when the rack shifted. The employee was hospitalized. The finger was not amputated.

The injured employee was cleaning the lower plates of a printing press with a towel wrapped around his right hand. A second employee was cleaning/setting up the upper portion of the press. The injured employee's hand was pulled into the press, due to the towel; partially amputating his right thumb and crushing the right ring finger.

Employees were setting a descaler ring into a housing unit. After the descaler ring was put into the housing, the crane began moving away and struck the housing unit which fell over and struck the injured employee who suffered neck and back injuries.
An employee was using a table router to trim a part when their finger was pulled into the blade resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was opening the lid to the vacuum hopper. The lid slipped out of his grasp and fell crushing his left index finger between the lid and the hopper resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was cutting material with a miter saw when the blade amputated his left index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was connecting a dolly to a trailer. The dolly rolled forward and the employee's hand was caught between the pintle hook and metal plate of the trailer resulting in crushed and broken left pinky and ring fingers.
An employee was spotting for a sanitation truck driver as he was reversing his vehicle when the truck tire ran over the employee's left foot, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was riding on back of a garbage truck, dismounted the moving vehicle and fractured his left hip.
An employee was reaching in front of his weapon during qualifications when the weapon discharged amputating the first digit of his left index finger.
An employee was performing training while on a combination ladder when the ladder slipped out from under him, causing him to fall to the floor. He injured his left arm and elbow.
An employee was leveling off debris from a trash box directly underneath the airlock system when the employee's hand was caught in the airlock, amputating the left index finger distal tip.
On 4/3/17 at approximately 10:20 AM, an employee was operating a bandsaw in the meat department and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was walking, tripped over a pallet on the floor, and fell resulting in a knee injury.

On April 3, 2017, an employee was adjusting a roll of plastic material being fed into a thermoforming machine while standing on a small metal grated platform. The employee stumbled and the employee's hand was caught in a pinch point where the machine chain drew the material in, resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee cut his fingers while using a circular saw.
An employee was operating the boom truck and received injuries to the chest, ribs, and shoulders when the truck rolled over onto its side and over the employee.
An employee leaned into a slitter machine throttle while clearing stuck material, crushing his left wrist and lacerating his left hand and right pinky finger.

A customer brought a car with transmission issues in to be washed. The car went through the car wash and an employee pulled the car forward and put it in park, but the car was actually in drive due to the malfunctioning transmission. The car moved forward and struck another employee fracturing his left leg.
An employee fell four to five feet off an extension ladder resulting in a broken lower right leg.
An employee was stepping down off the top step of a ground belt-loader, missed a step and fell fracturing his left hand.
An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack and fractured the left ankle when it became lodged between the pallet jack and the upright at the end of the bay.
An employee was taking a pulp sample from a washer when steam from the shower header (used to spray over the pulp to clean) caused second and third degree burns to her right arm and hand.

The employee was beginning the clean-in-place process. The employee disconnected the air line which de-energized the valve causing it to close on the employee's right index finger and amputate the fingertip.

An employee was unloading merchandise from the back of a trailer and was struck by a door that he was unloading, knocking him unconscious and causing him to fall to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was emptying trash cans into a garbage truck hopper and was struck by an oncoming delivery truck resulting in a broken left arm and two broken teeth.
On 4/4/17, an employee was walking on the conveyor cleaning edge, slipped and fell fracturing the right leg.

An employee was turning a valve when he slipped and fell into an uncovered hole containing storm water that had become very hot due to steam lines that ran through the area on a wash pad near hydro blasting activities. The hot water burned the right side of his body.

An employee was applying tape to metal flashing on a flat roof approximately 12 feet high. The employee fell from that roof and was hospitalized for a broken right toe, bruised ribs and a sprained right arm.

An employee was using a manual paper cutter and aligning the material to be cut when the cutter arm fell and lacerated the employee's left hand middle finger. The fingertip was amputated in order to close the wound.
An employee was descending a five foot ladder, missed the last step and fell approximately two feet to the ground resulting in a fractured right tibia and a fractured left fifth metatarsal.

An employee was performing his inspection rounds and lost his balance while transitioning from a dirt walking surface to a step and fell sustaining injuries to his ribs, lower back, head, left wrist and both knees. The employee was hospitalized for a brain hemorrhage.

Two employees were using a manlift to paint the bridge approximately 30 feet above the ground with an identified, energized, electrical power line running parallel to the bridge containing 12,000 volts of electricity. Either the manlift basket made contact with the electrical power line or the power line arched and made contact with the manlift basket resulting in injury to one of the employees. The employee suffered first and third degree electrical burns to his right arm, stomach and back.
The employee was descending from the basket of a boom truck when his left ring finger was caught in a bracket that held the bucket to the truck resulting in amputation.
An employee was using a 4x4 to lift a container of paint and suffered a strained back.
An employee was climbing onto a trailer when the hook the employee was holding broke off. The employee fell to the ground tearing their ACL and suffering a head injury.
An employee suffered the amputation of the left index finger while trying to dislodge a piece that was stuck in the die of the machine.
An employee was moving a girder and was pinched between a girder and a piece of steel resulting in a broken pelvis.
An employee was operating a printing press and amputated two fingertips in the rollers while removing debris from a roller.
An employee was transporting ice from the lower level to the first floor when the employee fell.
An employee was leaning on a glass tabletop desk when the glass broke and lacerated his left hand and finger.
An employee was carrying an aluminum pan full of hot water and lost control of the pan resulting in burns to the arms, chest and left hand.

An employee was speaking to a fellow employee. Her right ankle gave out when she turned in the hallway and she fell striking her shoulder on the wall. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left humerus and left patella.
An employee was installing duct work from the rafters in the attic when he lost his footing and fell to the ground landing on his head and shoulder.
An employee was taking bags off a pier and loading them onto a cart when the employee dislocated their right knee.
An employee amputated the left pinky finger above the first knuckle in a bushing machine.
An employee was working on a mill press and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting down a plastic part when their right thumb came in contact with the moving blade of a band saw resulting in a severe laceration.

An employee was replacing switches on the outriggers of a digger derrick. After the employee replaced the switches he adjusted the outriggers. The employee placed a bolt in the access hole of the outrigger to adjust it and pulled the lever to raise it. As the outrigger came up, it caught his right middle finger between it and the bolt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting a circle from a piece of plywood using a circular saw when it kicked back and lacerated his right toe and the one next to it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a pairing table when the steel slipped off of the table and struck the employee's leg.  The employee was hospitalized for a fractured tibia.
An employee suffered an asthma attack while checking a delivery.

On April 3, 2017, at 11:55 a.m., the injured employee and three other employees were transporting a decommissioned, pumped out, triple rinsed steel metal tank, 4' x 5' x 4' using a forklift to a metal recycling roll-off container located outside behind the plant. The injured employee was guiding the tank with his hands when the rest of the crew was attempting to place the tank into the roll-off container. The tank slipped off the forks and crushed the injured employee's left ring fingertip pad between the tank and metal container wall, amputating the left ring fingertip pad.
An employee was drilling holes into steel when his glove was pulled into the drill resulting in a finger amputation at the knuckle.

An employee was running a 30-minute boiler test on a diesel fueled boiler and caught the fingers on their right hand in the spinning belt and pulley. The boiler's diesel pump had been turned off but the belt and pulleys were still spinning. The employee's right middle finger was amputated below the first joint. The guard was not in place at the time.
An employee was assisting an operator with plasma cutting when a metal splinter went through the employee's glove and into his right thumb. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee tripped on a curb near the mailbox causing her to fall to the ground and fracture her right leg.
An employee's left index fingertip was partially amputated while placing livers into position on the giblet harvester.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the blade partially amputated three right-hand fingers.

An employee was retrieving a box that fell on the floor from the mail slot used for the pre-made boxes when her hair was caught in a moving conveyor used to load boxes into a trailer. The employee was treated for a partial scalping.

An employee was lifting the engine compartment door of a tank when it slipped out of his left hand. He attempted to catch the door with his right hand and crushed his pinky finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was opening the swivel step of a trailer and injured his right pinky finger.
An employee was cutting lumber to make a form for a concrete slab. The saw kicked back and cut the tip of his right index finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was picking up returns, tripped over a box of diapers, and fell.
An employee received second and third degree burns to the hand, neck, ear and foot when molten copper contacted water and "popped."

An employee was performing maintenance on a setting tool used in hydraulic fracturing. He opened a vise and turned the tool 180 degrees to make it easier to service. As he was sliding the tool back into the vise, the tool fell and caught his finger between the tool and the vise, amputating his left middle finger below the nailbed.
An employee was removing a 360 lb. block of cheese from the cutting harp and suffered an amputation injury to the left hand.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt with a dust rag when the conveyor caught the rag and pulled her finger into the belt, amputating her fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the dining/kitchenette area. When she stepped over a rope barrier, she tripped and fell, fracturing her right knee.
An employee was walking through the store to return a piece of merchandise when she slipped on an N-cap and fell, fracturing her hip.
On April 5, 2017, an employee was disassembling a setting tool when the employee's right third finger was caught in the tool, partially amputating the fingertip.
The bottom of an employee's right foot was burned when molten iron spilled over the mold and into the employee's boot.
An employee was repairing a kettle motor and amputated the right pinky finger when it was caught between the belt and pulley while putting the belt back onto the machine.
An employee was working in the valve box of a railroad car when the manway lid fell on his left hand, amputating his thumb.
An employee was exiting the office, lost her balance when her foot got caught on the carpet, and fell breaking her left hip.

An employee was cutting fabric strips on a strip machine when it jammed. While trying to clear the jam, the machine's blade came down and lacerated and fractured the employee's left index finger and thumb.
An employee was applying fertilizer and got an arm caught in the spinners of the fertilizer truck.
An employee was riding a bike when a sign flew into his face causing him to lose control and fall off the bike hitting his head on the road.

An employee was relocating a parking sign. While digging the relocation hole, the employee made contact with a cracked, buried PVC pipe. The employee initially thought it was irrigation piping, but upon closer examination saw electrical wiring and received a shock while attempting to isolate the exposed wiring.
An employee fell down the stairs of an MRAP vehicle and injured their knee.
An employee was cutting plywood using a powered saw and suffered a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was inspecting a 480v smart meter for repair and suffered third degree burns to the face, chest, hands and legs from an arc flash.
An employee was swinging a sledgehammer while removing tracks from the excavator and suffered chest pains.

On April 5, 2016, at around 11:00 AM, an employee and a coworker were loosening jam nuts while standing on a tractor hitch. When the employee loosened a jam nut, he lost his balance and fell backwards approximately 3 to 4 feet, landing on his back. He suffered a collapsed right lung and 2 or 3 fractured ribs.
An employee was driving a ground rod down with a ground rod driver when the driver came off the rod and broke his left thumb.
An employee was in an aisle way and was struck by a powered industrial truck resulting in a right forearm injury and pinky finger amputation requiring hospitalization.

An employee was in the bed of a company pickup truck. He was moving a tire on a pallet from the front of the pickup to the rear to make room for more tires in the front when he fell off the rear and struck his head on the ground, suffering a concussion and brain trauma.
An employee was riding on the back of the truck. When the truck made a left turn the rider contacted a wall and fell off the truck injuring ribs on his left side.

An employee was unjamming product from a machine when the equipment started and the employee's left hand was caught in the auger resulting in amputation of three fingers. The auger guard was not in place at the time.

The injured employee was riding in a golf cart driven by another employee. The golf cart struck a bump in the road and the injured employee fell off the cart onto the street resulting in a broken humerus.
On April 5, 2017, at approximately 1:30 a.m., an employee was operating a band saw when the employee's left hand contacted the running blade, amputating the thumb, index, and middle fingertips.

On 4/6/2017, an employee was part of a crew that was lowering a conveyor using a come-a-long. During the operation, the conveyor fell from the rigging equipment and struck the employee, fracturing the right side of his pelvis and shattering the left side.
An employee was using a mounted hand grinder to prepare the bevel on a rim for welding when the grinding wheel broke and lacerated his left index finger, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking on plant property when he slipped on wet fly ash and fell resulting in a fibula and tibia fracture.
An employee was attempting to dislodge meat from the inside of a meat processing machine when the machine was activtated and amputated several of the employee's fingers.
On April 6, 2017, an employee was cleaning a canning machine when the employee's right index fingertip contacted a rotating auger and was amputated. The machine was running and unguarded at the time.
An employee was removing pipe when the pipe shifted and he fell off the ladder. He fell on top of a floor-mounted motor, injuring his head and lacerating his elbow. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a pneumatic chipping gun to demolish a concrete foundation when the chipping gun fell from the employee's hands. As he tried to catch it, he fell 8 feet to the ground, suffering fractured vertebrae and a head laceration.

An employee was working inside a building when four shots were fired from outside into the building. The employee was hit, suffering a gunshot wound to the lower abdomen and requiring hospitalization.

On April 6, 2017, at approximately 3:10 p.m., an employee was spotting for a driver who was backing a 3/4 ton truck up to a trailer. The doors to the trailer were open for loading. Using the driver's side mirror, the driver backed toward the trailer. As the truck approached the trailer, the wind caused the door to the trailer to close. The employee moved between the truck and trailer to open the trailer door when his leg was pinched between the truck receiver and trailer bumper. He suffered a contusion to the left calf muscle.
An employee was unloading pipe from a trailer when the employee's right hand became caught between the pipe and trailer, breaking the thumb and causing lacerations.
An employee was attempting to push a sandwich through a wrapper machine when his left index and middle fingertips were partially amputated by the wrapper jaws. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee opened a valve to remove hot oil from a fryer. The hot oil then splashed him, causing second degree burns to his upper and lower left leg and minor burns to his face.

On April 6, 2017, an employee was cleaning the coffee grinder of an espresso machine when a door to the machine's hopper opened. As the employee was attempting to close the door, he made contact with the hopper and the piston came down, amputating his right index finger between the base of his fingernail and the first knuckle joint.

An employee was torch-cutting metal when the resulting sparks and slag caught his cotton coveralls on fire. He suffered burns to the back of his legs. Fire-retardant clothing was not worn at the time.

An employee was cleaning a build-up of metal shavings on the carrier plate of the double disc grinder when her right middle finger was caught and amputated between a hole in the carrier plate and the rotating disc.
A truck was moving forward with no driver and an open door when it caught an employee between the door and the truck cab. The door closed on and severely lacerated the employee's leg.
An employee was loading heavy metal parts on a conveyor when a part fell off the conveyor rack and landed on the employee's hand, fracturing fingers.

On April 6, 2017, at 8:20 AM, an employee was cleaning machine rollers when the employee's glove became caught in the rollers, which then pulled in and de-gloved the employee's right hand. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was emptying a trash dumpster into a 30-yard, roll-off container at the loading dock when the dumpster started falling into the container. The employee attempted to catch the dumpster when it slid down and amputated the last digit of his ring finger between the dumpster and roll-off container.
While going to grab a wheelbarrow, an employee stepped and fell through rotten metal decking, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a bender, welder, and trimmer when it was activated via the foot pedal. Her right hand was caught in the fixture, amputating her middle, ring, and pinky fingers.

While removing roof decking, an employee stepped on the end of a sheet of decking that was not supported. The decking tilted and the employee fell 10 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing three ribs.

An employee was using a front-end loader bucket to push against a plow. The employee went under the plow to knock a bolt out with a 3-pound hammer. When the bolt broke free, the bucket dropped and struck the employee in the head.
An employee was moving scrap casting material when it fell on top of the employee's right foot, causing an injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
While descending a ladder in an elevator shaft to inspect the fire system, an employee slipped and fell approximately four feet, suffering a compound fracture to the right arm that needed surgery.
An employee suffered a right middle fingertip amputation while attempting to remove film from a packaging machine. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was ripping wood on a gang saw when a piece of wood ejected from the machine and struck the employee in the chest. He suffered a punctured lung and laceration.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground while tightening a bolt on a ramp. The employee lost consciousness, suffered a possible concussion, and injured the left shoulder and arm.
An employee was replacing a gutter from a ladder when the ladder slipped. He then fell 15 feet to the ground and fractured his pelvis.
An employee was cleaning a glue roller machine when the employee's finger was caught in the rollers amputating the fingertip. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was inspecting a guide box outside of the millhouse when he attempted to pull a 20-pound pin on the guide box. His left hand was then caught and crushed between the pin handle and the box, and his left index, middle, and ring fingers had to be surgically amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee was hammering a packing gland when a pipe fell approximately 15 feet and struck the employee's left hand, causing severe lacerations.
An employee was removing the restraints from a mower in a trailer when he fell off the trailer and fractured his pelvis.

An employee operating a walk-behind (walkie) was attempting to turn the equipment when he was caught between the walkie and a wall. The walkie rolled over his left ankle, causing a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was installing a catwalk in the area where a new trimmer machine was getting ready to be installed when he fell 15 to 20 feet and landed on his head, suffering severe head injuries.

An employee was troubleshooting a pouring station when the cylinder activated and his right fingertip was caught between the plunger and the stop plate. The flesh on his right index fingertip was amputated (no bone loss). The pouring station was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning steam rolls and was pulled into the roll area, smashing a hand and amputating three fingertips.
An employee was walking upstairs when a stair gave way. The employee fell 24 feet to the ground and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was adjusting a machine when his arm was caught and fractured in the machine, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to repair the welding machine with a pair of pliers when the pliers became caught and pulled the employee's hand into the machine, partially amputating the left ring finger.

An employee was escorting another employee off the premises. The injured employee thought the coworker was gone and was walking back to the production area when the coworker started hitting and kicking the employee, causing cuts, bruises, and fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee began running to warm up when he fell and broke his left femur.
An employee was moving an axle unit on an assembly line when he slipped and fell backwards. His right leg was caught and crushed between the rails, causing a contusion and excessive pressure buildup.

An employee was greasing a skid steer in front of the lube bay. As he walked backwards to move away from the machine, he tripped on a wheel hub that was on the ground behind him, twisting his ankle and falling to the ground.
An employee was attacked by another employee, suffering a concussion, nerve damage, and orbital socket damage. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a saw to cut metal recreational vehicle parts. He was changing from cutting one type of part to another when he saw some of the old material inside the guard of the machine. As he attempted to remove the material, the saw blade amputated his left ring finger.
An employee fell from a work platform while servicing a ventilation fan drive motor, breaking bones and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was at a gas extraction facility cleaning a knock-out vessel. As the employee was pumping down the knock-out vessel, a fire ball from the flare backed up through the 4-inch line that was connected to the knock-out vessel and burned the employee's left hand, torso, and back.
An employee was walking down a pathway when she lost her balance and fell down a flight of stairs. She hit her head on the sidewalk and suffered a head contusion.

An employee was performing maintenance and clearing out a jam in the granulator when a section of the machine fell on and amputated his fingertip.
The machine was locked out at the time.
An employee suffered an amputation while using a band saw to cut meat.

An employee was moving a beam with an overhead crane when the beam went off center. The employee then stepped backward and tripped, and the beam fell on his leg, which was injured and required surgery.
An employee was painting the ceiling while on a scaffold system that was about 10 feet from ground level when the employee fell from the scaffold and suffered a head injury.
An employee was loading supplies into a truck and closing the tailgate when his right ring finger was caught in the tailgate, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was walking alongside a forklift and providing traffic control when he tripped and fell, and the forklift ran over his foot.
On April 7, 2017, at 1:30AM, an employee was opening the door to the dining area when she slipped on water and fell, breaking her right hip.
An employee was on top of the redi-mix concrete truck washing down the hopper/drum. As he was descending the truck ladder, he fell to the ground and was hospitalized with fractured ribs.
An employee was at a school function at a trampoline park. He was doing flips when he landed on his back, injuring his neck. He required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was waterproofing culvert boxes. He was trying to cross a 4.5-foot gap between the boxes when he fell backward to the ground and broke his leg.
An employee was walking into the restroom when the door struck her in the head. She suffered nausea, vomiting, headache, and dizziness.
An employee was waterproofing culvert boxes. He was attempting to cross a 4.5-foot gap between the boxes when he fell backwards to the ground and broke his leg.
An employee was filling an ice cooler, slipped on ice that fell onto the floor and fell resulting in a back injury.
An employee was climbing up the rungs of a ladder when he slipped. He was approximately three to four rungs up when he fell to the ground, injuring his tailbone and back requiring hospitalization.

On April 8, 2017, at approximately 2:00 PM, an employee was attacked by a dog while delivering mail. The force of the dog drove the employee backward to the curb, where the employee fell to the street and fractured the right shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working inside the shop when a propane leak caused an explosion. The employee suffered third degree burns.
An employee tripped over a rocking chair and fell down, fracturing her right hip.
The employee was troubleshooting a pump jack when an arc flash occurred burning both hands.
On 4/8/17, an employee was cutting bacon with a bandsaw when he made contact with the blade, amputating his right index finger. The saw was guarded at the time.
On April 8, 2017, an employee fell off the fourth rung of an A-frame ladder and suffered a broken left shoulder and left leg, as well as a right ankle injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing drywall when he lost his balance and fell backward onto concrete, dislocating his right shoulder.
An employee was attempting to close the tail on an aircraft when the employee's right index finger was smashed and amputated in the mobile tail enclosure.
An employee was adding hash browns to the fryer when he fainted or had a seizure and fell into the vat of hot oil. The employee suffered burns to his left arm from his fingers to above the elbow.
An employee was installing concrete moldings when he fell from the third floor porch and fractured his right femur and right wrist. He was hospitalized.
On April 8, 2017, an employee was cutting a 10-inch water pipe using a pipe saw when the saw blade kicked back and lacerated his face. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was taking part in an exercise program when he suffered vision loss.
An employee's arm was caught and fractured in a press brake.
An employee was cleaning a skinner machine when part of the machine fell off and landed on his right index finger, partially amputating it.

An employee was repairing a feed line auger that had tension in the system. The employee thought he had the energy released, but it was spring loaded. When the energy released, it pinched his finger against the cage. His finger was surgically amputated.
An employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation while using a meat saw to cut meat.

An employee was setting a piece of metal floor decking on the 2nd floor when he stepped back and fell through an undecked portion of the floor. He fell down onto the 1st floor concrete flooring, fracturing his right wrist and skull.
On April 9, 2017, an employee was removing felt from the collection pit of a paper machine when the employee slipped on water and fell, suffering a torn labrum.

An employee was trying to de-energize the medium voltage temporary switchgear. He was pulling down on the knife switch, which was spring loaded, and thought the switch completed the action to the "open" or off position when the knife switch sprung back up, striking him on the right side of the face. He was hospitalized with a laceration to the corner of the mouth, a fractured eye socket, and a damaged tear duct.
An employee was offloading a heavy pallet from a plane when his right middle finger was pinned against the pallet and the dolly lock. His finger broke and required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a cut-off bar saw when a counterweight that keeps the saw elevated broke, causing the saw blade to come down on and partially amputate his left thumb and left index and middle fingers.
An employee was exiting her cashier booth when a car hit her on the left side of her body, lacerating her left leg.
An employee responded to the ER reception area and had a verbal and physical altercation with a visitor. The employee was hospitalized with an acute myocardial infarction.

An employee was using the right hand to push meat across a meat slicer when the employee's vinyl glove was caught by the slicer blade, pulling the employee's right thumb into the blade. The employee's right thumb tip was amputated along with part of the thumbnail.

An employee was filling a quadrant ladle with molten iron from a holding ladle. The trough was not in the upright position because the machine was in between cycles. The quadrant ladle then overfilled, causing some of the molten iron to spill out and onto the employee's feet, burning them.
On April 10, 2017, an employee was cleaning equipment when it partially amputated the employee's left middle and ring fingers. The equipment was not locked out at the time.
An employee was operating band saw when he sneezed several times and his hand went into the blade, amputating his left thumb.
An employee installing a hose to an HVAC system and was hospitalized for lacerations to three fingers on his right hand after being struck by the fan blades when the equipment turned on.
An employee tripped after stepping into an uncovered floor drain with his left foot resulting in a swollen foot.
A steel beam fell on an employee's leg, resulting in amputation of the left foot.
An employee was cleaning a machine when his left hand was caught in the machine's rollers resulting in a skin avulsion and hospitalization.

On April 10, 2017, an employee was working on a door jam in an aerial lift beneath another aerial lift where a coworker was welding an angle iron. The angle iron tack welds were broken, causing the angle iron to swing downward and strike the employee in the upper back area. The employee suffered upper back and neck injuries and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was unclogging a trash chute at a construction site when something hit the top of his right foot resulting in fractured tarsals.
An employee was operating a lathe to polish a small steel bar when his glove was caught in a rotating shaft, pulling his right hand into the lathe and amputating his right ring finger.
An employee was burned by hot grease while removing a pan from an oven.

An employee was cleaning up a worksite when a storm-damaged limb became dislodged from the tree canopy and fell on the employee. The employee was hospitalized for two broken ribs and five fractured vertebrae.

On April 10, 2017, approximately 2:00 p.m. an employee was cleaning the belt of a live bottom asphalt trailer when her cleaning device and glove were caught in the belt pulling her in and injuring her right hand and forearm requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was moving furniture in the office and bumped their upper right thigh resulting in a blood clot in the thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing two rigging cables through the whip line head block to untangle them and amputated a finger.
While attempting to remove an obstruction from a valve that was located inside of a rail car, the valve closed and amputated an employee's left ring finger.
An employee was leaning on the railing located on the swim platform of a yacht when the railing gave way and the employee fell fracturing ribs, vertebrae and bruising their liver.
On April 10, 2017, a temporary employee was using a nail gun and shot a nail into his right knee resulting in hospitalization to surgically remove the nail.
On April 10, 2017, an employee was manipulating a steel sheet onto a line from a container when the sheet slipped out of his hand and cut his right bicep.
An employee was performing pest control services at a customer's house and was bitten on the right hand by the owner's dog.
An employee was removing cut lumber from a conveyor chain when their right pinky finger was caught between the sprocket and chain resulting in a partial amputation and hospitalization.
An employee was doing framing work while standing on a plank of wood when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, injuring his body and back.
An employee was cutting meat on a meat saw and amputated the middle fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was clearing the hydrolyzer when backpressure caused hot feathers to discharge onto the employee. As the employee moved out of the way, he fell six feet breaking a bone over his left eye and suffering first and second degree burns to the hands, arms, face and neck.
An employee was responding to a code, touched something on a patient's bed and went into anaphylactic shock which triggered a cardiac event.
While removing aluminum flash from the die of a hydraulic trim press, an employee amputated his middle finger when the press malfunctioned.
An employee walked under a manlift and the manlift struck the employee on the head resulting in a head and back injury.

An employee was checking the ID of a pipe for smoothness. While she was checking the inside of the pipe with her thumb, the machine cycled pushing the pipe back against a back stop and trapping her thumb between the back stop and the wall of the pipe. The tip of her thumb was amputated.
An employee was exiting the cab of his parked truck, missed the second step and fell to the concrete floor breaking his kneecap.
An employee was filing papers, tripped over a wrinkle in the runner rug, and fell fracturing her arm in four places.

An employee was moving a truck and trailer when the trailer jack-knifed. A second employee was assisting the first employee with the trailer. The injured employee was standing next to the trailer directing the truck driver, when the trailer rolled over on top of him resulting in broken legs.
An employee was standing on a six foot ladder applying plastic covering on overhead cables and fell injuring the right side of the body.

An employee was setting up a hydraulic pull tester station (5000 lbs. capacity). A plastic chain product was put under tension. While the employee was adjusting some locking washers with a spanner wrench, the plastic chain snapped and the employee's left middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the washer and a table.
An employee was lifting a transmission onto a stand when he lost his grip and the transmission fell on his leg, fracturing his tibia.

An employee was operating a forklift to lift a hopper/bin filled with approximately 950 lbs. of scrap metal. The employee's left hand fingers were caught between the forks and the bin while trying to release the waste into a dumpster resulting in the amputation of two fingertips.
An employee was assisting in a saw re-build. The employee tried to grab a ball screw as it was falling and his finger was crushed/pinched between the falling part and the machinery housing.
An employee was threading stock into the core machine and suffered a partial amputation of the right ring finger.

An employee was refilling a forklift cylinder when the fueling nozzle began leaking propane. As the employee went to turn off the nozzle, the propane ignited and the employee sustained burns to his neck, arms, face, and head.

On April 10, 2017, at approximately 11:15 a.m., an employee was performing maintenance on a rooftop HVAC unit when he fell 19 feet through a skylight to the ground. A personal fall arrest system was not worn at the time of the incident. The employee was hospitalized with severe internal injuries such as a lacerated liver, punctured lung and head trauma.
An employee was lifting a piece onto an auto-loader when a piece of metal swirled around and squeezed his right hand between the piece and the auto-loader, severely lacerating it.
An employee was setting up to do some roof work when the ladder he was on gave way causing the employee to fall to the ground and fractured the left heel and right tibia.
An employee was struck in the stomach by a patient while trying to get the patient to sign paperwork. The employee was hospitalized with an abdominal contusion.
An employee fell 11 feet from the hull of a vessel under construction to the floor below and was hospitalized for a fractured arm.

Employees were removing a gearbox from the frame of a laser-guided truck. After removing the last two bolts holding the gearbox to the frame, the gearbox fell and struck the employees' feet. Both employees suffered five broken toes.
An employee was paving a road when a passenger vehicle broke through the barriers at the construction zone and struck the employee, who was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was turning on an electrical box agitator near a high-speed mixing tank when hot liquid hair conditioner, at > 212 degrees F, came out of the tank and caused second degree burns on the employee's upper torso, head, and face.
An employee was walking from one building to another when she tripped and fractured her left arm. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was moving cables when he felt a pain in his abdomen due to a hernia.
An employee tripped over a dumbbell and fell on her knee dislocating the knee cap and tearing ligaments in the knee.
An employee was struck by the raised fork of a forklift, losing an eye.
An employee came in contact with the chain and sprocket of running equipment resulting in amputation of the left middle and index fingers between the first and second joint.
On April 11, 2017, an employee was cutting wire with a hand-held cable cutter and suffered a partial amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was struck by a vehicle resulting in amputation of his right leg.

An employee was disassembling an 75-ton conventional truck crane. The employee was watching the cables as they moved through the sheaves. The employee removed a pin out of the boom and the boom dropped, pinning the employee to the ground. The employee's knees and ankles were crushed.

An employee was removing tools from a storage shelf when several saw blades fell from a shelf above and struck the employee's head. The employee fell striking his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was cutting plywood with a planer and lacerated three fingers on the right hand and amputated a fingertip. The planer was unguarded at the time.
An employee was working on a roof installation and suffered a heart attack.

An employee was pulling freight at the customer location with his pallet jack when he began to feel intense pain in his lower back, which caused the employee to briefly lose consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the hydrovac tank when a valve failed and struck him in the face. The employee suffered injuries to his face and jaw requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell off a scaffold breaking his leg and pelvis.
An employee was using a table saw to build a podium for the training room when the blade lacerated his left thumb. He was admitted to the hospital.
An employee pinched her right thumb while closing a floor safe.
An employee was unloading equipment (sod cutter) using a boom when the employee was struck by the equipment resulting in a fractured left leg and ankle.
An employee was in a lift gate trailer when his right foot got stuck between the trailer and the dock. He fell and hit his head resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was walking into the building on a rainy day, slipped on the tile floor and fell fracturing the right kneecap.
The employee was changing a spring on a motor former on the production line when hot product from the line splashed into the employee's face resulting in burns.
An employee was walking through the parking lot while carrying a box, slipped on ice, and fell breaking the right leg.
An employee was struck by a forklift as it was backing up in the recycle center resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was checking bin fill levels on a bin platform. The railing had not sprung back into place and he fell about eight feet from the platform to the receiving floor. He was hospitalized.
An employee arriving to work slipped on a wet floor and fell fracturing the left tibia and ankle.
An employee was attacked by a patient. The employee received injuries to the face and suffered a heart attack. The employee was admitted to a hospital.
An employee was pulling wire through the conduit from a 14 ft. step-ladder when he fell to the concrete surface below resulting in serious injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was riding a horse to move cattle and was thrown from the horse. The employee sustained fractured ribs on the right side and a fractured left pelvis.

An employee was using compressed air to clean coolant from the bottom of a part that was suspended by a magnet. The part fell from the magnet and the employee's index finger was struck by either the air hose or the falling part resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee tripped over a plastic binding strap and fell breaking his knee.

An employee was inspecting the fireproofing from a 10 foot ladder. He began descending the ladder, missed a rung, and fell approximately six to seven feet landing on his left side and bumping his head. The employee was hospitalized with four broken ribs.
An employee was walking down stairs, tripped and fell resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was walking in the hallway and tripped on her pants or her shoe laces and fell on her knees. She was hospitalized for hip replacement surgery.

On April 11, 2017, an employee suffered fractures to his pelvis, knee and tailbone after a loaded metal racking unit overturned onto the employee as the employee was removing it from the burn off oven.

An employee's truck was stuck in the sand. The employee placed a board under the tire in order to gain traction and caught his index finger between the tire and board resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee fell from a ladder and fractured an arm and a leg.
The employee was operating a zero radius mower on a steep incline. The mower rolled over and the employee suffered a compound fracture to a leg requiring surgery and bruising of the spine.
An employee was cutting T-bone steaks on a vertical band saw and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee fell while climbing down a 16 foot aluminum extension ladder resulting in a broken left wrist/arm and bruised ribs on the right side.
An employee was operating a wire mesh making machine when his glove was caught in the rotating bar resulting n a broken arm. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was leaving work and fractured her ankle and injured her wrist after jumping from the loading dock.
An employee slipped on a wet surface and fell hitting their head on a wall.
An employee was troubleshooting a CT machine and received third degree burns to his right hand when it contacted an energized slip ring.
An employee was hospitalized after his fingers were crushed when a slab was lowered onto them.
On April 12, 2017, an employee was nailing plywood to a truss with a nail gun, when the nail gun double jumped and a nail went through his right foot.

On April 12, 2017, at 2:20PM, an employee was setting a shim on a press. When the press cycled, the employee's fingers were caught in the clamp used to secure the product resulting in a partial amputation of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was installing a band saw V-belt and amputated the right index fingertip in the belt and pulley. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was connecting a chain to a stunned steer and pinched their left index finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was releasing water from the hopper that was in operation. As he was releasing connections, he braced himself with his hand on an opening. His hand slipped and contacted the hopper lift resulting in amputation of the index, middle, and ring fingers up to the middle knuckles on his left hand.
An employee was unloading a truck trailer when their foot was caught on a load retainer and the employee fell. The employee's right foot was fractured in two places.
An employee's left foot and ankle were burned while cleaning out the ladle when the ladle tipped forward and the molten iron when into the employee's boot.

An employee was standing on a ladder trimming a tree branch on the building grounds. The tree branch snapped off and struck the employee in the face, knocking him off the ladder. The employee was hospitalized for injuries to the face, wrist and pelvis.

An employee was wiring a terminal block inside a breaker control cabinet. The employee repositioned himself inside the cabinet and struck his head on a bolt. After striking his head, the employee fell over and was shocked by a 240 volt AC knife switch resulting in a burn to the back of the neck, a head laceration and an electrical burn to the right thumb and index finger. The employee also sustained right arm numbness.
While walking from the west side of the building to the east side, an employee tripped over a stack of service bumpers that measured 18 inches and fell fracturing the right hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was working from a ladder approximately 11 feet above ground, lining pre-cast concrete panels and performing final welding of the panels. The employee fell from the ladder while attempting to align the panels. The employee was hospitalized for a traumatic brain injury.

An employee was working off a scaffold side bracket patching a concrete wall structure in an elevator shaft. While working off the outrigger platform, the platform failed causing the employee to fall about 30 feet to the ground. The employee suffered three fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and a dislocated right elbow.

An employee was cleaning grease from a sprocket with a rag when the rag got caught in the sprocket and pulled the employee's fingers into the sprocket and chain. The employee's right index and middle fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was operating a bending machine and crushed their right thumb in the machine resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was tightening the tension on a garage door spring when the winding bar slipped off the cone causing the spring to unwind. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration and fractures to his left thumb.

An employee was transporting a container of liquid nitrogen on a dolly. Upon entering a building the container fell off the dolly and pinched the employee's finger between it and the dolly resulting in a left index finger amputation at the tip of the distal interphalangeal joint.
An employee was unloading a truck and fell through a 13" gap in the dock plate resulting in broken ribs, a punctured lung and a shoulder injury.
An employee was mixing mortar with a battery powered drill. The employee's glove was caught in the drill chuck pulling his hand into the drill resulting in amputation of the thumb.
An employee was troubleshooting flow issues in a tank when he was splashed with the hot fluid chemical solution in the tank causing caustic burns to his legs and abdomen resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was operating a hi-lift forklift and was pinned against a racking system causing a chest injury and a possible punctured lung.

An employee was transporting a patient on a stretcher out of a room. In the process, the door handle trapped her pinky finger between the door handle and the stretcher resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a utility trailer hooking chains from a loader onto a big air conditioning unit that was brought for scrapping. After hooking the chains, the employee slipped on top of the unit and fell to the trailer floor, landing on his left foot and breaking his lower left leg. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was cleaning the walk-in shower in a guest home, tripped over the shower door sill and fell fracturing the right humerus.
An employee was climbing a ladder to get to the roof when the base of the ladder slipped out and the employee fell approximately six feet to the concrete sidewalk resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was struck by a pickup truck during a flagging operation on a road construction project, suffering broken ribs and left leg, spinal, and liver injuries.

An employee was repairing the hydraulics on a track loader and was checking for hydraulic leaks. The cab was removed from the machine for the repairs, but the hydraulic controls (joystick) were still mounted to the superstructure of the machine, which was sitting on jack stands. As the blade pushed down and raised the machine up off the jack stands, the jack stands kicked out. The employee climbed onto the equipment's mounted steps to reach for the joystick to stop the movement and was knocked into an open compartment door, striking his lower chest and abdomen.

On April 13, 2017, at 2:30 p.m. an employee missed the last rung of the A-frame ladder that he was descending and fell on his right kneecap, shattering it. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to stabilize his knee.

An employee was unloading merchandise in the receiving department and was carrying it to a nearby area when she tripped on the corner of a clothing rolling rack. She fell on her right side and fractured her right hip, requiring hospitalization.
On April 13, 2017, an employee was operating a skid steer when the attachment came up and struck him above the right eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold and stripping its platform when the employee fell approximately 8 feet from the platform to the concrete below. The employee fractured four ribs and four vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down the stairs and suffered a facial laceration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was ripping plywood on a horizontal panel saw when the top panel had a piece break off and a piece of plywood was kicked back into the employee's abdomen. The employee was hospitalized for torn intestines that required surgery.

An employee was helping a forklift operator load material onto his truck when his left hand was crushed between the trailer and mast of the forklift, fracturing and lacerating his index and middle fingers.
An employee was using a knife to cut food when the blade amputated his fingertip.
An employee was walking around the waste hampers to size up the load for a forklift, tripped over metal equipment on the floor, and fell breaking bones in his leg.
An employee fell from a roof and broke his hip.

An employee was weighing 55-gallon drums that were on a pallet next to a scale. When he tried to rotate a drum off the pallet and onto the scale, his right thumb was pinched between two drums, amputating the thumb tip.

On 4-13-17, two employees were working in an aerial lift when it ran over a septic tank cover. The cover then collapsed, causing one employee to be catapulted out of the lift and the other to slam into the guardrails of the lift.
An employee was cutting a palm tree, moved quickly and fractured his left ankle.
An employee was climbing a tree to prune it when the tree failed about 5 feet below his tie-in point and he fell 20 feet to the ground, suffering a fracture that required hospitalization.
On April 13, 2017, an employee fell from a ladder while insulating a residential home resulting in a head injury and hospitalization.
An employee was driving an ambulance when a coworker used a disinfecting product in the vehicle. The employee had an asthma attack and required hospitalization.
An employee was taking care of a patient and fell down the stairs breaking the right hip.
On April 13, 2017, an employee was injured when he fell approximately 10 feet from the top outside step/platform of a boom truck while tightening a rope around the bucket.

On April 13, 2017, an employee suffered a fracture of his right femur after he was struck by a displaced railroad rail while performing cutting operations. The rail was hoisted via backhoe grapple while being cut by the injured employee. As the employee was making the cut the rail fractured, striking the employee in the leg.

An employee was working on a mezzanine, assembling boundaries for volleyball courts. While picking up anchors, the employee fell approximately 9 feet to the loading area below, injuring both ankles and one heel. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee pulled a 40-foot long spool (pipe hardware) from near the bottom of a skid using a rope that was tied between the crane outrigger (rear passenger side) and the pipe spool. As the outrigger was retracting, the employee's left hand and arm were caught between the outrigger base and the crane outrigger causing a crushing injury to the employee's left hand/wrist that resulted in surgical amputation.
An employee was cutting a roll of flooring protection with a handheld circular saw when their left hand middle, ring and pinky fingers contacted the rotating blade. The ring finger was amputated.

An employee was cutting drywall with a table saw and contacted the saw blade resulting in amputation of the left middle finger between the first and second joint and a laceration to the left index finger that required medical amputation.

An employee had just delivered mail and was walking down the driveway when a dog jumped on him and knocked him to the ground. He lost consciousness and suffered a fractured skull and brain hemorrhage, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down a stream bed to access the riverbank and test the water flow when he slipped and fell, hitting his right knee on the bedrock bank and breaking his kneecap.
An employee was operating a brake press to form small metal parts and pinched his left middle finger between the material and the front of the ram amputating the middle fingertip.
On April 13, 2017, an employee was attempting to "block off" a cylindrical boiler and caught their right index finger between the boiler and the dunnage resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking behind the front counter when she tripped over a phone cord and fell into the counter striking her ribs on the counter. The employee was hospitalized for a rib fracture and collapsed lung.
An employee was performing maintenance on the cutter machine and partially amputated their left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was scrapping off polyurethane from rollers on a machine using a sharp tool. The employee was scraping towards himself and the tool slipped off the rollers and punctured the employee's right inner thigh. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck. When the employee raised the boom it lifted a bridge walkway between two aisles causing it to fall onto the employee. The employee suffered a laceration to the neck that required surgery.
An employee was grinding imitation crab in a meat tenderizer when her fingers were caught in the equipment rollers, crushing them and requiring hospitalization.
While performing re-roofing activities, an employee fell 7.5 feet off the roof to the surface below, fracturing two ribs.

Two employees using a six foot rolling scaffold on top of nailed down plywood were pouring concrete from a pump truck. Once they finished the area, another employee on the ground pushed the scaffold to the new area. The wheel caught a nail, the scaffold tipped over, and both employees fell to the ground. One employee was hospitalized for muscle strain and contusions.

An employee was responding to a car crash. The employee was walking down into a ravine to render aid to a crash victim when she crossed a creek. Her foot sunk into the mud, stopping the forward motion of her foot while her body continued to travel forward. Her foot broke and required surgery.
An employee experienced an allergic reaction while mixing an oral contrast medium, suffering respiratory distress and hives.
An employee stepped onto a shelf to reach a box when the shelf collapsed. The employee fell backward and the boxes fell on him, striking his forehead. He suffered a concussion.

An employee was power-washing the rig. He shut it off to address an issue with some equipment and returned to relieve the pressure in the washer. He had his hand out when residual pressure in the washer line caused the water to release and cut through his glove and into his right hand, requiring hospitalization.
While delivering mail, an employee tripped and fell on the lip of a raised sidewalk, fracturing a hip.
An employee was loading and unloading 3" pipe from a trailer to the ground when a pipe rolled and pinched his finger. His finger was amputated.
An employee outside an aircraft was helping a coworker inside the aircraft close the door when his right index fingertip was caught and amputated by the closing door.
An employee was in the parking lot assisting a customer when he tripped over a trash can and fell striking his head on a concrete curb. He was hospitalized overnight with a possible concussion.
On 4/14/2017, an employee fell from the dump body bed of a utility vehicle, suffering a contusion and/or possible head fracture.

An employee was trimming snouts with a powered knife as they came down a conveyor. During a lull in product coming down the conveyor, the employee shut off the knife and made a few adjustments to tighten the blade. When the employee turned the knife back on, it oscillated in the employee's hand in a manner that caused the employee to lose control of the knife. The knife then hit the employee's face, causing a deep laceration to the left side of the cheek and mouth area.
While carrying a tire, an employee tripped on a lift bracket that was left on the floor, falling to the ground and breaking a hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a machinery line to make PVC pipes when a pipe became stuck or misaligned. The employee was attempting to fix the problem when his right middle and ring fingers were smashed between two pipes, amputating the fingers to the first joint.
An employee was stepping across a threshold into a train when he twisted his left ankle and fell outside the train. His left ankle broke.

An employee was adjusting a dock plate with a trailer when the dock plate became stuck. When the employee attempted to unjam the dock plate, the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the dock plate and the trailer, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was holding a clamp while a coworker swung a hammer. The coworker struck the employee's finger with the hammer, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was chasing a patient leaving the emergency room when he tripped on the curb outside and tore his knee tendons.  He was hospitalized.

An employee was tightening straps to secure drill rods to the rack on the side of a drill rig. The drill rig operator was unaware that the employee's hand was on the drill rod rack and moved the drill rig, catching the employee's hand between the rig and rack. He suffered a dislocated wrist and damaged ligaments, requiring surgery.

On Friday, 04/14/17, at 08:15AM, an employee was disassembling a lattice boom crawler crane and removing a 10-foot section. After the pins were removed from the boom, the boom did not immediately break loose. The employee was then descending from the top of the boom when the section separated from the rest of the crane, causing him to fall 9.5 feet to the ground. He sustained a fractured cheek bone, multiple skull fractures, and a fractured shoulder.

An employee entered a corn silo to free up a jammed grain sweep when the corn he was standing on gave way, causing him to fall and strike the weights of the machine. He was hospitalized for possible fractured ribs and head trauma.

An employee was unloading large trees from the top of an 18-wheeler when the strap came loose from the backhoe digging arm. The arm then swung and hit him in the left upper body, causing him to fall 4 feet to the ground. He suffered broken ribs, a collapsed lung, a broken collarbone, and a head abrasion.

An employee was getting ready to pour a concrete footing when the outrigger became unstable, causing the pump jib to move and strike the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a compound fracture below the knee and above the ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a forklift and was attempting to retrieve a trash bin from the compactor when the forklift overturned. The employee's arm was broken.

An employee was removing debris from a machine while waiting on the machine's cooling process to be completed. Due to a software error, the interlock system failed, allowing the machine's die to move and contact the employee's right thumb, which suffered an open fracture. The thump tip had to be medically amputated.
An employee was securing the back of a compactor with a bungee cord when the bungee cord struck and injured the employee's left eye.
