An employee was ascending an indoor ladder into an attic space to replace air filters. While on top of the ladder, the employee lost stability and fell off, landing on a metal mailbox case and then the floor. The employee suffered severe pain in the lower back and right leg.
An employee was helping a die cast operator eject a jammed part when the part released under pressure and struck the employee's hand, crushing the thumb.
An employee was pulling empty packages from a flow wrapper machine. Her right hand was beneath the machine when it was struck by the wheel, breaking her middle finger.
An employee was using a 25-pound wrench to tighten disc gang nuts when his hand slipped off the wrench and his right ring fingertip was crushed and dislocated.

On April 15, 2017, at about 2:30 a.m., an employee was cleaning a primer day tank when the agitator in the tank started to move. The hose the employee was using to clean the tank wrapped around the agitator, causing her right arm to be caught in the moving agitator. She suffered a fractured right arm and right pinky.

An employee was sanitizing equipment on a filling line. The drain valve was opened while his finger was in one of the filler holes. The filler then cycled and amputated his left middle fingertip above the top knuckle.
An employee fell through a stair opening at a home construction site and was hospitalized for injuries to the head, ribs and hip.
An employee tripped and fell onto a hot piece of coke near a 1-3 battery, suffering burns to his hand.
An employee slipped while applying liquid floor stripper, fracturing his right hip.
An employee was connecting two baggage transporters when the hinge of one dropped, pinching and amputating the employee's left middle finger.
While exiting a truck in the wash bay, an employee tripped and fell on a wire installed inside the truck, breaking a leg in two places and requiring surgery and  hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a charging pad for robotic machines, which was in a confined space. As the employee was exiting the charging pad, he placed his right arm and hand outside the charging pad area to push off. Another machine then crushed his right hand and lacerated his arm.
An employee was pushed to the ground and struck their head on the ground.

An employee was performing demolition work. He opened a large heat treating oven door. When he opened the door, a piece of metal fell from atop the door and struck the employee's left arm causing a laceration to the arm.

An employee was using a portable angle grinder and a sanding disc to remove weld spatter from a 3-11 shell weighing approximately 11,900 pounds. The employee was checking the alignment of the shell with its flange when their gloved, left hand was caught between the shell and the poly wheel of the roller upon which the shell was sitting/rotating. The employee's left thumb, ring and pinky fingers suffered lacerations that required sutures. His index and middle fingertips were fractured requiring pins.
An employee was starting up the injection molding machine and was caught between moving parts resulting in a fractured right arm.
While operating a drilling machine, an employee was struck by the machine, suffering a broken left knee and pelvis.
An employee fell approximately 12 ft. from a scissor lift while doing electrical work. The employee suffered multiple fractures including vertebrae, foot, wrist and hip.
An employee was cutting wood stakes out of 2x4s with a hand saw and lacerated a finger on the left hand.
An employee was working from a ladder and fell crushing the left index finger.

The injured employee was pressing down a rail car pusher arm with a crow bar when another employee moved the rail car forward and crushed the injured employee's left index finger resulting in a partial amputation between the distal and middle joints.

An employee was working on the green stacker laying sticks. As the last course of lumber was coming towards the employee, a paper ticket blew off. The employee pulled the e-stop and picked up the ticket and handed it to another employee (the injured employee) who contacted the machine amputating the right ring finger.
An employee fell approximately four feet from the conveyor chain and fractured ribs.
A worker sweeping with a broom on a loading dock fell 4.5 ft. off the loading dock and hit his head on the concrete driveway below.

The employee had just returned from picking up a semi-trailer of scrap metal from a third-party and was opening the doors to the semi-trailer before backing into the loading dock. When the employee opened the door on the driver's side, scrap metal fell from the trailer onto the employee resulting in a broken hip and leg and internal injuries requiring surgery.
An employee was descending a ladder at a customer location, lost his grip on the ladder and fell about five feet.
On April 17, 2017, at approximately 3:30 p.m., an employee received an eye injury when he was struck by a nail from a second employee's nail gun.

An employee was changing a semi tire. While the employee was trying to mount the tire to the axle, the jack fell and severed the tip of the employee's pinky finger between the bottom rail and the tire.
An employee's arm was caught between an air hose reel and a gear box while moving the spillway crane resulting in a severe laceration to his arm.

An employee was ascending a ladder affixed to a paint booth to service the spray paint booth when he fell from the ladder to the concrete floor fracturing their left tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a chop saw and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered an acute asthmatic episode due to smells of smoke within the building.
An employee was hanging sheet rock from a six foot A-frame ladder. The employee fell and fractured his right wrist.
An employee was operating the punch press machine and amputated his left index finger.

While draining the product from a propane gas vaporizer, the igniter for the pilot light ignited the product causing a flash fire. An employee received second and third degree burns to the legs and arms.
An employee was clearing grass from the discharge chute of a lawnmower and amputated his right thumb, index and middle fingers.
An employee was installing HVAC ducts, fainted and fell approximately 10 feet injuring his head and back.

On April 17, 2017, an employee was using a stand-up tugger to move a cart to a staging area when his right index finger was caught between the light pole on the tugger and a frame that was on the cart that he was moving resulting in the amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was attempting to roll by hand a steel coil weighing approximately 600 pounds and measuring approximately 48 inches tall and 3 inches wide. The coil was upright and when the employee attempted to roll it, it tipped forward and fell to the ground and the employee fell with it. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation to the first three fingers on her right hand.
An employee was found unresponsive next to a front end loader. The employee was hospitalized for a head contusion.
An employee was hospitalized for burns to his body from the chest up from an arc blast.

An employee was masking the aircraft windshield while standing on a portable work stand. The work stand rolled, causing the employee to fall approximately 50 inches to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured fibula and a fracture of the L2 vertebra.

The injured employee was at a customer location to pick up lumber. The injured employee closed the back trailer door. As he shut the door, an employee of the customer location backed a forklift into him and pinned him between the truck and the forklift. The injured employee suffered broken vertebrae, three broken ribs, and an injured spleen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assaulted by a patient resulting in a broken nose.
An employee slipped on a wet floor, fell and broke her left knee.

An employee had climbed an A-frame ladder to install a window unit. As the employee was holding the window unit, a gust of wind blew and the employee lost his grip on it. The window unit fell out of the opening and onto the injured employee's right leg resulting in a double fracture to the lower leg and lacerations.
An employee was cleaning the quill puller (defeathering machine) with water and amputated the right pinky finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was manually pulling orders and loading 50 inch TV's (in box) onto a pallet when he suffered an apparent heart attack and then fell to the concrete floor where he also sustained a skull fracture and brain bleed.

The employee was repairing pallets. After repairs are made, the pallet goes to a conveyor belt/line. The pallet got stuck. As the employee tried to un-jam it, his glove was caught on the chain and his left middle finger was amputated in the moving sprocket chain.

An employee was emptying debris using a dump box on a forklift at a construction site. The employee released the latch on the dump box in order to tip it into the dumpster. At the time, the employee slipped and when he tried to catch himself his left hand got caught between the fork and the dump box pinching his middle and ring fingers resulting in a crushing injury to the ring finger and a middle fingertip amputation.
A temporary employee's leg was caught in a gap between two rollers on the conveyor belt and fractured.
An employee had finished delivery to a customer. As he was closing the lift gate, his left hand was caught between the handle and step of the unit resulting in a finger amputation.
On April 17, 2017, an employee was hoisting material via crane and suffered a distal finger amputation after it was caught between the crane hook and hoist attachment.
An employee was removing 6x6 cribbing on top of a 4" pipe when the pipe fell off and struck the employee's left ankle fracturing it.

An employee was attempting to remove an RTD (thermometer) from a hot oil pipe to replace it and was splashed with hot oil on his face and arms resulting in first and second degree burns. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was helping to clean the topping bars of a carrot harvester when his hand was caught in the topping bars. The employee received a severe laceration to his right hand resulting in hospitalization.

An employee, who was observing a boring operation taking place inside a turbine shell, was sitting on planks (located on the horizontal joints of the turbine) and repositioning in order to stand inside the turbine where it would not be slippery when the boring bar caught and crushed the employee's right thumb.

An employee was operating a forklift and struck a guard rail after hitting a pothole. His left hand was caught between the forklift and the guard rail resulting in the partial amputation of the ring and middle fingers.
An employee was walking along the catwalk of the log fume ride, kneeled to pick up something, lost balance and fell. The employee sustained multiple rib fractures and a pulmonary contusion.
An employee was operating the finger joint machine and amputated the tip of his left middle finger above the first knuckle.

On April 18, 2017, an employee was attempting to remove finished product from a magnetic wheel at the end of the conveyor when the employee's glove was caught in an unguarded moving chain and sprocket resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

During the tap/pour process, an arc flash explosion occurred and an employee that was standing approximately 30 feet from the operation received multiple burns to the face and chest from the molten metal and solids. The employee also sustained lacerations to the thigh and forehead.

An employee was operating a reach truck to put product away. When the employee swerved to avoid boxes that were in the aisle, his left foot was caught between the racking and the reach truck resulting in a laceration.
An employee slipped on the wet floor of the wash bay and fell resulting in a back injury.
An employee was operating a stand-on pallet jack. The pallet jack jerked and his left foot was caught between the jack and a wall resulting in a compound fracture of the left ankle.
An employee slipped on the wet floor and fell hitting her head on the floor.
The employee was working on a 20' x 40' sliding barn-style door. The employee lifted the door with a portable power jack to install a wheel assembly and the door fell crushing the employee's hand.
An employee fell from the top of a concrete form and fractured a hip and the left leg. The employee was not tied off at the time.
While cleaning a paper jam on the lid machine, the die amputated the employee's right index fingertip.

On April 18, 2017, at approximately 9:00 p.m., an employee was using a spray nozzle when it stopped working then suddenly started up again. He lost control of the nozzle and sprayed his right thumb lacerating it. He was hospitalized for surgery on a torn tendon.
An employee tripped and fell dislocating a shoulder.

An employee was chipping gunite from the underside of steel beams using pneumatic tools while in an aerial lift. A large piece of material (approx. 600 pounds) broke loose and fell into the lift basket, overloading it and putting it into an automatic slow descent. The employee fell and the lift basket struck him resulting in multiple cracked vertebrae, and head, wrist and knee injuries.
An employee was carrying a container of water. The water spilled and the employee slipped and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was walking around the outside of a trench while an excavator was removing old PVC pipe. The pipe shattered and a fragment struck the employee's left eye.
An employee was cutting wood using the trim track machine when the machine jammed. After clearing the jam, the employee's left middle, ring and pinky fingers were amputated by the saw blade.
An employee was making a delivery and was bitten on the hand by the resident's dog.
An employee was lifting 40 lb. boxes of chicken and suffered a groin pull.
An employee tripped over a pallet and fell breaking his hip.

Four employees were in a utility terrain vehicle (UTV) going up-hill when it tipped backwards and rolled down the hill. Two employee were hospitalized. One employee was hospitalized for a broken pelvis and the second employee was hospitalized for leg injuries.

An employee was working on a fresh air intake fan. The electrical source of energy was locked out, but the residual sources of energy were in the process of being locked out when his hand was caught in the pulleys resulting in the amputation of his left pinky at the knuckle and amputation of the ring, middle, and index fingers.
Two employees were walking down a steep grade. Employee 1 dislodged a large rock that rolled down the grade and struck employee 2 in the lower leg causing a compound fracture.
An employee was cleaning wood pieces out of a chop saw and suffered a partial amputation of the left index fingertip.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to move a semi-assembled motor mounted on a frame chassis. The employee was walking backwards with the pallet jack in front when his right thumb was caught between the steering control of the pallet jack and the storage rack resulting in blunt force trauma and a deep tissue laceration.
An employee was adjusting a rathole ring clamp. The ring clamp slipped off the rathole and the employee lost his balance and fell into the cellar resulting in a broken ankle.
On April 18, 2017, while making a delivery, an employee fell from the back of the delivery truck and suffered a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was handling a knife when it punctured his left forearm.
An employee was entering an aircraft hanger through a large rollup door on a powered wheelchair when the door descended on her head. She suffered a fractured jaw and severe lacerations.
An employee was placing a metal stabilizing ring on a cardboard drum when his left pinky finger was pinched between the stabilizing ring and the drum, partially amputating his fingertip.

Two employees were working between two walls of a machine, troubleshooting the vacuum system. One of the employee's ankles was pinned between moving parts when the machine started resulting in hospitalization for surgery on a broken ankle.

After loading asphalt on a roller, an employee attempted to clean the roller using a hammer. The hammer became caught in the roller and the employee's arm was pulled into the machine, fracturing the arm and wrist.
An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw when the saw kicked back and amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was struck by a bull while herding cattle, suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder painting when he fell off, breaking his heel and ribs.

An employee was transporting a pump used with hydrofluoric acid in a box. He was attempting to stop the pump from tipping over when he contacted the pump's acid residue, suffering chemical burns to his hand that required hospitalization.
An employee dumped wet mud out of a dump truck and was closing the tail gate when it smashed the ring and middle fingers on both hands, causing an amputation.
An employee was letting down a car lift when the lift came down on his left hand, amputating his middle finger.
An employee was packing bottles on a palletizer when his left hand was caught between a pallet and the palletizer, crushing four fingers. The palletizer was unguarded at the time.
An employee was dispatched to inspect an electrostatic precipitator (ESP). While walking from the ESP to the office trailer, the employee was overcome by sulfur dioxide fumes.
An employee was using a gasoline-powered demolition saw to cut a metal tower when a fire occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's leg.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the belt became energized. The employee's hand was caught between the belt and the conveyor pulley, causing a serious injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder trying to tie himself off onto a cable pole when the cable line broke. The employee then fell approximately 12 to 15 feet to the gravel ground, sustaining head injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was fitting pipe together for a sewer line when the bucket of a trackhoe fell off and struck him. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing pipe insulation from an extension ladder. As he started to descend from the fourth rung, he missed a rung and the ladder slipped. He fell to the floor and fractured his right hip.

While installing a building wrap to waterproof a balcony, an employee grabbed onto the 2x4 guardrails and fell 15 feet with the rails to the lower level before falling an additional 20 feet to the ground level. The employee suffered a broken back and twisted spine.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck with a man basket when the basket with the employee in it slid off the forks to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured wrist and a laceration to the side of the body.

An employee was driving a haul truck when the vehicle drove off the road and overturned. The employee struck his head on the cab of the truck, suffering a forehead laceration and compression fracture to his cervical vertebrae.

An employee fell approximately 15 feet through the roof and struck the concrete floor below. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae, a head injury and a lung contusion. The employee was wearing a personal fall arrest system at the time.

An employee and a coworker were securing a forklift to a trailer for transport using chains and ratchet binders. The machine was chained in all four corners and the last place to secure was the forklift mast. The forks were in the up position to allow the truck ramps to be folded. The coworker climbed into the forklift and lowered the forks. The employee had been adjusting the position of the tie-down block on the trailer deck and was unaware that the forks were being lowered. The employee's left hand became pinched between the block and the fork, breaking the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was drilling holes in copper tubing while wearing gloves. As she moved a part into position and began lowering the drill head, her right hand bumped the drill bit, which caught the fabric of the glove and pulled her right hand into the bit. The drill bit deeply lacerated her middle finger and partially amputated her pinky and index fingers.
On April 19, 2017, an employee suffered a hand degloving after it was caught in the point of operation of a milling machine during a maintenance activity.
An employee was clearing sticks from the chain belt of a machine when two of his fingers were caught and fractured between the chains.

On April 19, 2017, an employee was attempting to clear a plugged fiberglass tube from the sheet molding compound machine's glass cutter. While pulling the fiberglass through the tube, the employee's right middle fingertip struck the rotating cotton roller and was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
While installing a shear panel, an employee fell approximately 8 feet to a balcony below, breaking several ribs.
An employee was assisting a customer with his pizzas when he tripped over a box in the parking lot and fell, breaking both feet and his left femur. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was unloading a pallet of sod from the back of a box truck with a bobcat. He was holding onto the back of the bobcat when it tipped forward. Then the pallet of sod fell off and the bobcat tipped back upright, causing the employee to fall backwards onto the pavement. He sustained a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee fractured his left pelvis area on the paper machine winder when his body became wedged between two rolls of paper.
An employee was reheating food with a re-thermalizer when hot water splashed into the employee's face and eye, causing burns that required hospitalization.
An employee fell to the gravel ground while walking and landed on her left pinky finger, lacerating and breaking it and also sustaining a metacarpal fracture.
An employee was operating a punch press when it malfunctioned and came down, amputating two fingers on his right hand.

An employee was on a ramp with a dolly when the dolly moved away from him and he fell down. His right hand was then caught between the dolly and the ramp, amputating his middle fingertip with no bone loss.
An employee amputated the right index fingertip while attempting to repair the balance on the forklift truck.
An employee was climbing on a bulk of lumber when he fell and hit his head, requiring hospitalization.

On April 19, 2017, at approximately 3:20 p.m., an employee was operating the chipper when a slab became hung up in the mouth of the chipper. The employee turned off the vibrating conveyor and gained access to the opposite side of the chipper. He pulled on the slab. When the slab came free, his hand was smashed between the slab and mouth of the chipper, amputating his right ring finger near the first knuckle.

An employee was rolling a channel to punch holes. The employee had the channel in the vertical position and was attempting to lay the channel flat by hand when the employee's finger was smashed and amputated between the channel and a railcar
.

An employee was servicing a bulldozer and attempting to grease a fitting located between the blade and the bulldozer. He slipped and his right ring finger was caught and amputated in a pinch point between the bulldozer and the blade.

An employee was cleaning a sewer drain with a high-pressure hose. The hose had to make a 90 degree turn at the bottom of the manhole. Instead of making that turn, the hose circled back around and came out of the manhole, striking the employee on the left arm and causing three lacerations.

On April 20, 2017, at approximately 4:30 a.m., an employee was checking the inside of a solution tank. As he turned to walk away, his foot was caught by a hose on the floor, causing him to fall onto his right knee. He was hospitalized for a fractured right femur.

An employee was standing on the third rung from the bottom of a 6-foot step ladder patching concrete on an adjacent wall when he lost his balance and fell off, landing on his back and fracturing his pelvis.
An employee's finger was caught and amputated in a closing box truck door. The employee also suffered two broken fingers.

An employee was walking from his office to his personal vehicle in the parking lot. As he descended some wooden steps, he slipped and fell down 3 to 4 stairs to the asphalt parking lot, tearing the quadricep tendons in both of his knees. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was splashed in the face with hot rinse water (approximately 140 or 150 degrees F) from a hose as he was transferring the rinse water to another tank. The employee was wearing PPE-safety glasses, apron, gloves, steel toed shoes, but no face shield.

An employee was bringing a car onto a flatbed tow truck using a winch system when the truck slipped from the winch and hit the employee on the left side of the body. The employee suffered fractured ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was checking a tire on a car and was spinning the tire when his left hand was caught between the wheel and the brake caliper, breaking his left index finger.

An employee was guiding a forklift operator through the warehouse with a work platform when the work platform became caught on a pallet of animal food and slid off of the forks of the forklift and on top of the employee. The employee suffered a dislocated left shoulder and possible shoulder fracture.
An employee was using a drill press to drill metal when the metal became caught and then released. His left arm then became wrapped around the drill bit, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was gathering materials to construct concrete formwork. The employee picked up a sheet of plywood not realizing it was covering an existing floor hole. As a result, the employee stepped into the floor hole and fell approximately 12 feet to the next lower level, suffering wrist and neck injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee fell from a ladder and injured his back as he was ascending with a mortar bucket to a single story roof.
An employee was walking from a snow vehicle to the base area lodge when he slipped on black ice and fell, fracturing his right ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was attempting to unjam a pallet dispenser when the first digit of his left ring finger was amputated.

An employee was attempting to free an approximately 1/8" piece of plastic material lodged in a saw blade channel. He was wearing gloves and using his left middle finger to quickly sweep the material away when the running saw blade caught the glove and pulled his left middle finger into the blade, amputating it between the distal and middle joint.
On April 20, 2017, an employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt when his right thumb was caught and amputated in the belt's chain and sprocket drive.
An employee was unloading steel bars from a truck. The employee was prying bundles apart with a pry bar when the tool slipped and the employee fell off the truck, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was lifting a manhole cover when it slipped and amputated the right middle finger of another employee.
An employee was offloading dry fertilizer from a train car into a dry facility using an auger system when his foot and leg were pulled into the auger resulting in amputation of the leg.

An employee was replacing a broken bolt on a pneumatic cylinder of a 3,000 ton aluminum extrusion machine and amputated the right thumb at the first knuckle joint. The machine was guarded by distance with a guardrail system. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was moving pallets of freight on the dock and pinned their leg between the electric pallet jack and the pole resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee tripped over an electrical cord and fell on her right side fracturing the right hip.
An employee was attempting to unjam a wire cable from a winch when the employee's left hand entered the winch, amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a baggage tug when his lower left leg was caught and fractured between an upright pillar and the baggage tug.
An employee was inspecting a pressure gauge on the back side of a powder coating booth when a hose came loose and struck the employee in the left eye, lacerating the cornea.
An employee was delivering coffee to a customer when she fell and hit the ground, injuring her head.
An employee was using a chain to winch an object when the chain snapped and a tow cable smashed through the window and broke the employee's right arm.
An employee fell 20 feet while climbing a ladder, suffering fractures to the skull, back, right leg, and right ankle, as well as a small brain hemorrhage.
An employee was chopping raw bacon when the knife slipped and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee fell into a trench while chipping concrete and was impaled by a piece of rebar.
An employee was operating a bone-in saw to cut meat when his left hand slipped off the meat and contacted the blade, amputating his left index fingertip.
An employee was cutting material and amputated his left ring finger.
An employee was riding a pallet jack and fell off. The unit then ran over his foot fracturing it.

While installing a belt driven motor assembly an employee's finger was caught between a belt and the sheave resulting in a laceration to the little finger on his right hand. The employee was admitted to the hospital in preparation for surgery.

An employee was working on the rig floor installing a lift cap into a mud tool. As the driller came up with the elevators his right middle finger was caught in between the elevators and the lift cap, partially amputating his finger.

An employee was struck by a motor vehicle while working within the work zone installing reflectors and was hospitalized with severe injuries including four fractured vertebrae, a broken bone in the neck, a concussion and various abrasions on the arms.
An employee was operating a UTV while conducting soil sampling and struck a ditch causing the employee's head to strike against the roll cage of the UTV.
An employee caught a finger in a cardboard baler door causing a laceration that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee had climbed onto warehouse racking and stepped off the racking onto a pallet that was being carried by a forklift. The pallet broke and the employee fell 9 feet with the pallet falling on top of him resulting in fractured vertebrae and 10 stitches.
An employee fell 15 feet from a wet ladder fracturing the L2 vertebra.

An employee was checking water lines for leaks. When he found a leak, the employee applied a pincher device that crushes the line to stop the flow of water. A clamp on the device popped off and struck the employee on the chin fracturing four teeth on his lower jaw.
An employee tripped on the bottom step of a customer's residence while delivering a package. The employee fell and fractured her left ankle in three places.
An employee engaged in framing and drywall operations fell through an elevator shaft resulting in broken legs, a broken arm and multiple lacerations. The height of the fall was approximately 20 feet.
An employee was scanning merchandise and was struck by a forklift resulting in a fractured ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was cleaning a car lift using a water hose to remove oil and grease buildup. The employee was standing on the car lift which was about 12 inches off the ground. When the employee stepped down from the car lift, he slipped on the wet floor and fell suffering a head injury and broken ribs.

A temporary employee was using a metal drum lift to lift a 55-gallon plastic drum to raise and tip the drum over and pour the suntan product mix into a container to be weighed. He placed his hand on the lift's clamp while the drum was in a vertical position. The drum slipped and his right index finger was caught between the top lip of the drum and the clamp resulting in the amputation of his right index fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a climbing wall from an aerial lift. The lift tipped over after going over a slope. The employee fell to the grass and fractured his upper leg and arm.
An employee was standing near a pallet on a forklift when the load shifted and product fell off the pallet striking the employee and fracturing a hip.
An employee was operating a tail stretcher machine that uses a roller/rail system and caught his left finger in the roller amputating the fingertip.
On April 21, 2017, an employee was attempting to use a tool to remove a jam from a machine when the tool became caught in the machine's auger along with the employee's left index finger.
An employee sustained a partial amputation to the right thumb and index finger while cutting aluminum on a table saw.
An employee was feeding rubber into an extruder and got their hand caught in the conveyor belt, crushing their hand. The belt was not guarded at the time.

Two employees were approximately 15 feet up in a scissor lift working on the motor for the overhead dock door at a customer's site. The overhead door activated and knocked the scissor lift over, causing one employee to fall out of the basket. One employee damaged his jaw, lost teeth, sustained rib injuries and potentially broke a leg. The second employee fractured a wrist. Both were hospitalized.
An employee placing a mold into an injection machine had his finger crushed when the mold closed.

On 4/21/2017 at 11:30 a.m., an employee was using a circular saw to cut a 2x4 when his hand contacted the blade resulting in lacerations and a fracture of his left index finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to repair the fractured finger and tendon damage.
Two employees were moving a post tension machine to another location. The injured employee's left hand was inside the machine when it turned on resulting in a partial amputation of three fingers.
The employee was sanitizing a metal wire mesh conveyor belt. The employee dropped the wire mesh conveyor belt and it landed on his fingertip resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was performing roofing operations and fell from the roof sustaining broken ribs, arms and a leg.

An employee was driving an excavator down a ramp from the second floor to the ground floor when the boom struck a slab and caused the equipment to stop. The employee's body then moved forward and struck the windshield, causing head and neck injuries.
An employee was getting ready to perform an oil change and was struck on the head by an object or the employee struck his head on an object resulting in a concussion.

On April 22, 2017, an employee had one foot on a fold down platform located on a platform riser and another foot on the running gear step (holding nurse tanks). As the employee tried to connect the hose, the employee stepped back and missed the counter weight. The left leg slipped into the opening of the running gear (step) and was caught causing a contusion to the right leg and knee.

An employee was working on the extrusion line that was down for a quality issue. The rollers were still powered, but no boards were going through the tank. The employee's hair was caught in a roller that propels the product through the mist tank resulting in a scalping injury.
An employee was moving a manlift onto a freight elevator when it fell onto his left leg resulting in a compound fracture.

On April 22, 2017, an employee was picking product from a pallet on the floor to load onto a pallet jack and struck his head on the racking system. Later that evening, the employee collapsed at home and was hospitalized for a possible concussion.
An employee slipped on the wet, concrete floor and fell fracturing the left ring finger.

An employee was cleaning casters (wheels for carts) in a container filled with a solution of water and "soak tank charger." While cleaning the casters the solution splashed onto the employee's left elbow and right ankle. The employee was hospitalized with third degree chemical burns.

While an employee descended a wooden stair case, a stair tread began to give way. The employee shifted his weight to the handrail and the handrail gave way, causing the employee to fall approximately two feet to the ground. The employee landed on his back, then slid down the hill and contacted a concrete barrier. The employee was hospitalized with lower back pain.
The employee was stacking pallets outside the store near the dumpster. The employee stepped on uneven ground between the dock and the dumpster and fractured an ankle.
An employee was cleaning the top of a baler and slipped off a stool fracturing the left wrist.

An employee was wearing safety glasses while working on a water tower. When he descended the tower and took off his glasses, he felt debris in his left eye. His eye later began to bleed and felt painful, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered from smoke inhalation while evacuating patients from an area where there was a fire. He was hospitalized overnight.
Two employees were removing an air shaft. When one employee pulled the shaft, the other employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

The injured employee was pushing a tree that was being cut by another employee with a chainsaw. The chainsaw kicked back and struck the injured employee's left leg resulting in a four-inch laceration.

An employee responded to an alarm in the mechanical room. He noticed a loose belt flapping and turned off the motor to adjust the belt on the air handler. When he went to inspect the belt, his finger was caught between the spinning belt and pulley resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was transporting a resident and tripped over the wheelchair footrest. She fell and fractured her femur.
An employee was struck on the left side by a cable coming from the cable drive while drilling.
The employee was cutting a sample aluminum pipe using a paper cutter and amputated the left ring fingertip.

An employee was using a standing forklift to remove material from a weighing area and place it back on its rack. As he was reversing the forklift, he was about to strike the rack behind him and put his hand up to protect himself. His left hand was then crushed between the forklift frame and the metal frame of the rack.
An employee was moving from one scaffold level to another when a board slipped causing him to fall.

While attempting to align fiber cement boxes weighing 300-400 lbs. on a forklift, the boxes shifted, catching the employee's left hand between the edges of the top and bottom boxes. The employee's left middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle joint and the left ring finger was crushed.
An employee was walking from his workstation when he tripped over a sling strap resulting in a fall and a broken left femur.

Employees were tripping pipe out of the hole. An employee wanted to roll a pipe section from the catwalk onto the skate. The pipe was having difficulty rolling, so the employee changed the angle of the catwalk. The employee operating the catwalk lowered the catwalk on one corner using the hydraulic to level it out. The employee who was rolling the pipe got his foot crushed underneath the corner of the catwalk when it was lowered.

A forklift was used to attempt to remove a stuck electric pallet truck from inside a trailer. One end of a towing strap was attached to the forklift carriage and the other end was attached to the battery plate on the pallet truck. When the forklift operator backed up, the battery plate came off the pallet truck and struck an employee who was standing nearby in the head.

An employee was changing out a capsule of dish detergent in the dish machine when product spilled onto his arms. The employee sprayed hot water onto his arms to get the soap off resulting in thermal burns to both arms.
An employee was unjamming the slitter machine and amputated four fingers.
On April 24, 2017, an employee fell from a rolling staircase ladder while repairing the mast on a hi-lift. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture.
An employee was grinding sheet metal with a hand held angle grinder and lacerated his leg above the knee.
On April 24, 2017, an employee was pushing her chair to a storage area at the end of the shift and the chair tipped forward striking her arm/shoulder. The injuries will require surgery.
An employee was struck in the head by a garbage truck hopper resulting in a neck injury and hospitalization.
An employee was descending a wooden ladder and fell approximately 14 feet resulting in two broken ribs and two fractured vertebrae and a head injury.
On April 24, 2017, an employee fell off a rail car suffering internal injuries.

An employee was walking out of the facility at the end of her shift, tripped and fell resulting in multiple fractures and dislocations including a fractured left foot, a dislocated right knee and a fractured and dislocated right elbow.

An employee was working checking the hydraulics on the winder machine when his hand was caught in a pinch point. The employee suffered a laceration to the right palm and a fractured thumb. The hydraulic portion of the machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.

An employee was struck by a vehicle while walking across a customer's lot to speak to another driver. The employee was hospitalized for three fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, a head injury and a laceration to an ear.
An employee was cleaning the ink reservoir on a printing press and the rag he was using was pulled into the rollers along with his hand. The tip of the employee's right pinky finger was amputated.

In the shelf line area, an employee was reaching over a conveyor belt to inspect the welded brackets on a piece of thin sheet metal when her hair got caught in the conveyor belt. The employee used her left hand to try to pull herself free when her left hand got caught in the conveyor belt resulting in amputation of the left pinky fingertip.

An employee was using a hoist to align a bolt in a front disc brake when he dropped the bolt. The employee went to pick it up and his right index finger slipped inside the bolt hole. The hoist was activated at the same time and the employee's index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working in the garbage truck's engine compartment and amputated a finger when it was caught in the belt and pulley.
An employee was testing a condensate pump and received an electrical shock.

At about 8:50 p.m. on April 24, 2017, a press operator received a serious laceration to the elbow area of the left arm while handling a metal frame rail. The operator was hospitalized as a result of the injury.
An employee was operating a pedal-activated chop saw to cut boards and amputated two left fingers.
Employees were installing a jib crane. A beam fell off of a forklift and struck an employee in the back resulting in five broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was using a portable cutting and beveling tool to cut a bevel on the end of a 24" schedule 120 pipe. The employee's gloved hand was caught and pulled between the beveling die and the pipe causing a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was trouble shooting a planer that was making noise. The employee took off the guards and disassembled the planer. The employee plugged the motor in and while he was checking the bearings his right hand contacted the rotating planer blades resulting in multiple finger amputations.
An employee was driving a road grater when the blade struck something in the ground causing the grater to stop suddenly. The employee was jolted resulting in cracked or slipped vertebrae.

An employee was attempting to release an equipment die lock with a crow bar. When the die lock released, the crow bar slammed upwards pinching the employee's right pinky finger against the equipment guard rail resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving materials in his truck and injured his back.
An employee tripped and fell, breaking a hip.

An employee was lifting a trash compactor off the shipping skid using a forklift. The compactor started to lean over and the employee was struck by the falling compactor as he tried to catch it. The employee suffered injuries to the face and mouth and lost a few teeth.

An employee was installing a new gang saw when the employee's left hand was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in a laceration and crushing injury to the index and middle fingers. The fingers were surgically amputated at the middle joint. The machine was not guarded or locked out at the time.
An employee sustained a fractured ankle while delivering food at a customer site.
An employee sustained head and nose injuries while using an overhead crane/hoist/chain/hook system.
An employee had just removed a shaft from a film roller and had a finger in the air valve when the valve closed and lacerated/fractured the employee's finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped when dismounting a forklift and suffered a broken ankle requiring medical treatment.
An employee was moving a bulk mail container when his foot became caught on a strap protruding from a pallet he was passing, causing him to trip and fall. He was hospitalized for a broken left hip.
An employee was on a delivery route when she stepped out of her truck and onto the edge of a culvert and fell fracturing her left ankle.

An employee was loading a 3 inch iron flow pipe (18 inches long) onto a trailer when his left ring finger became caught between the pipe and the trailer, resulting in amputation of his left ring fingertip.

An employee was loading his grocery-delivering cart at a customer's location when he lost his footing while tipping the cart over and fell backwards. The loaded cart fell on his right thumb amputating it above the first knuckle.
An employee was moving heavy machinery over steel rollers when his hand became caught in the metal rollers. He was hospitalized for crushing injuries to his fingers.

An employee was installing a conveyor motor cover, when four of the fingers on his right hand were crushed by a chain and sprocket in the running motor. One fourth of the right index finger was later amputated at the hospital. The conveyor was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down the hall towards the elevator when she slipped on wet flooring and fell fracturing the left knee.
An employee was standing in an excavated pit approximately 2.5 feet deep and 5 feet wide when the side wall caved in on his leg resulting in a fracture.
An employee was connecting a gooseneck trailer to a truck and manually adjusting the hitch onto the ball when the trailer dropped onto the ball, amputating the employee's fingertip.
On 4/24/2017, an employee was working on the roof and started to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was checking a belt in an HVAC unit on a roof. The unit was shut off and locked out. However, 30 mile per hour winds caused the fan to move and pinch the employee's left pinky finger between the belt and the pulley, resulting in amputation of the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck while walking and was hospitalized for a crushed/fractured leg.
An employee tripped over an ergonomic mat in the kitchen and fell fracturing her femur.
An employee was pushed by a patient in the emergency room and fell backwards striking his head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was operating a moulding unit when the employee's left hand became caught in the machine resulting in fractures and lacerations.
An employee was waterproofing and fell while descending a ladder resulting in a broken left wrist and a broken right ankle.

An employee was loading a pallet into a trailer from the inside of the trailer when a pallet contacted the stack and caused pallets to fall. The employee shifted to avoid a falling pallet and fell onto the floor of the trailer. The employee was hospitalized for back and hip injuries.

An employee was servicing a molding press and was using a 4x4 to remove a press screw from inside the machine barrel. The 4x4 moved forward and pinned his right hand against the machine resulting in amputation of the right thumb tip.

An employee was installing a seal on a large shaft when it slipped and pinched his right index finger between the shaft and a flange. The employee was hospitalized and his right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was performing welding work from a ladder when he lost his footing, fell from the ladder, and fractured his leg.
An employee was struck by a check value that he was removing while it was under pressure.

An employee was wiping a bearing on the 50-gallon reactor with a rag when the rag was caught by the rack and pinion pulling the employee's left hand into the moving gears. The employee's left thumb tip was partially amputated.
An employee was operating a press when their right thumb became caught in the machine, resulting in amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was replacing a HVAC fan belt when their thumb became caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in amputation of the thumb.
An employee was checking merchandise totes in the grocery receiving area when the employee tripped over a pallet and fell, resulting in hospitalization for a fractured hip.
An employee was descending a wet staircase after delivering a parcel when she slipped and fell down the stairs, resulting in a broken right femur. The injury required surgery.

Employees were depressurizing a level bridle when the hose between the bridle and the flare system broke releasing hydrofluoric acid (HF). The two employees were exposed to the chemical vapor resulting in injury to their eyes, facial skin and lungs. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was working on drywall from a ladder, when the employee fell from the ladder approximately 6 feet to the floor. He was hospitalized for seven broken ribs and a kidney laceration.
An employee fell to the ground while sitting down in her desk chair and injured her left hip.
An employee was closing the overhead door on a truck body when the door contacted his left hand, amputating his left middle fingertip.

An employee was climbing a ladder on a fertilizer trailer to adjust a tarp. The tarp flapped in the wind and caused him to fall from the ladder to the ground. He sustained a compound fracture to his left wrist and a fractured heel. One of his injuries required surgery.

An employee was on top of the tanker truck loading fuel into the tanker. The vapors ignited causing an explosion and throwing the employee 20 feet into the air. The employee suffered third degree burns, broken bones and internal bleeding.
An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder stringing conduit when he fell onto a concrete floor and was hospitalized for four broken ribs.
An employee fell 15 to 16 feet from a ladder to the concrete floor while installing chains for a light system, suffering fractured heels.
An employee was struck by a 7-foot-high bakers scaffold, suffering a compound fracture to his leg.
While working at a metal shear, an employee's middle fingertip contacted the point of operation and was amputated.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut limbs from a tree overhead while standing on top of a brush cutting machine, approximately three feet off the ground. One of the tree limbs struck the employee's left foot, resulting in amputation of the left big toe at the first joint.
An employee was cutting a piece of cabinet wood on a table saw when his hand contacted the blade, resulting in amputation of his fingertips.
An employee was carrying a pot of hot water to the sink when the employee slipped, resulting in hospitalization for first and second degree burns to the employee's arm.

An employee was on a ladder scraping paint from an interior wall when the employee fell from the ladder and landed on the concrete floor. He sustained lacerations to the inside of both thighs, a loose tooth, and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was clearing a jam in a filler machine when his left index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was walking and performing routine duties when her foot was caught on a steam table causing her to fall. The employee was hospitalized for a broken shoulder.

An employee was returning from a garbage-collecting route when he experienced dehydration and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was removing a metal plate from a shearing machine when the blade cut his right thumb and index finger.
An employee was pressing a bearing when his finger became caught in the press machine, resulting in amputation of his left index fingertip.
An employee was struck by a beam that fell off a forklift and was hospitalized for a foot injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine from a ladder when he fell from the ladder and struck the floor. He was hospitalized for a fractured right leg and fractured right elbow.
An employee was moving a pallet jack when the employee's ankle became pinned between the pallet jack and a second pallet jack. The employee was hospitalized for a broken ankle.
An employee was leaning on a unguarded conveyor belt of a packaging machine when a finger on her left hand became caught in a pinch point resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was operating a coil slitter when his finger became caught in the roller, resulting in amputation of his right index finger.
An employee was performing inventory duties in a warehouse when he was struck by a forklift, resulting in hospitalization for an injury to his left leg.

An employee finished installing power line poles and stepped into a truck. The truck derrick made contact with the power line (12kV), resulting in electric shock to the employee. The employee received burns to the hands, feet, and internal body parts.
An employee was sanitizing the muffin machine auger when her right middle finger was caught in the running machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was performing maintenance on a vehicle when a car door fell off a stand and struck the employee's inner left elbow. The employee was hospitalized for a severe laceration to his left arm resulting in artery and nerve injuries.

On April 25, 2017 at 10:30 a.m., two employees were installing a fire hose on a fire hydrant for washing piping when a car ran over the hose, causing it to become lodged under the car. One employee was hospitalized for a laceration to the back of his head, bleeding on the brain, and a fractured right ankle.
An employee was changing slips on a rig when his hand became caught in the machine parts, resulting in amputation of part of his finger.
An employee was nailing flooring when a nail gun fired into his right foot, resulting in hospitalization for possible bone damage.

On April 26, 2017, an employee was performing rescreening repair on the roof of a screened enclosure when he lost his footing and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized for a head injury, broken ribs, and a spinal injury.

An employee was helping remove a skylight from a roof, when he fell through the opening and struck the ground. He was hospitalized for a broken pelvis, broken arm, and a fractured back. The employee's harness was not tied off at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a truck and moving trailers in the company yard. She stood on the back of the truck to connect air hoses when she rolled her ankle, fell from the truck, and struck the ground. She was hospitalized for an injury to her right upper body.
An employee was assembling a cooker valve when the employee's finger became caught between two valve parts, partially amputating the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was removing HVAC units, when the unit and the employee fell to the ground, approximately 7.5 feet. He was hospitalized for two broken wrists, a knee injury, and a concussion.
An employee was removing excess sheetrock around an elevator shaft when the employee fell approximately 20 feet through the shaft, suffering a fractured elbow and heel.
An employee was delivering mail at a customer's residence when the customer opened the door to take out the trash and a dog ran out and bit the employee's right forearm.
An employee was washing a piece of equipment while standing on a step ladder that was 24 inches high when he fell off and suffered a whole-body injury.
An employee was operating a bulldozer to clear debris when the bulldozer fell into an 8-foot pit. He sustained two fractured vertebrae in the lower back.

An employee was operating a forklift to move drums on a pallet. He dismounted the forklift to adjust two drums that had become off-center on the pallet when a drum fell and struck his leg, resulting in his hospitalization for a broken leg.
An employee was opening a dock door when the cable on the side of the dock door broke causing the door to fall on her. She was hospitalized for neck and back injuries.

On April 27, 2017, an employee was using an overhead crane to lower a frame onto the frame table when his left middle finger was pinched between the strut stop and the frame, resulting in partial amputation.

A temporary employee was operating a clamp truck. When the employee dismounted the truck, he was pinned between the truck and an automated guided vehicle. He was hospitalized for pelvic and abdominal injuries.

An employee was installing tips on a robotic welder when the employee tripped on a cover for hoses and cables that was mounted on the floor and fell, striking the door of a welding cage. The employee suffered a fracture to the right humerus.
An employee was operating a glue machine when his hand became caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in lacerations to four fingers and a partial amputation of his pinky finger.

An employee was tightening bolts on the back of a new blade for a wood chipper machine with an impact wrench when the employee's finger became caught between the blade and the washer on the back of the blade. The employee sustained amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was packing on the line using an extrusion machine when the machine blade activated and amputated her left index fingertip.

On April 27, 2017, an employee was descending a 20-foot ladder when he slipped and fell approximately 6 to 9 feet and landed on his left ankle. He sustained a compound fracture of the left tibia and fibula and was hospitalized. The injury required surgery.

An employee was climbing down a steep staircase aboard a ship, missed a step and landed on the bottom stair, sustaining a fractured left tibia. At the time of the incident, the vessel was on dry dock.

An employee was transferring chemicals from the tinder truck to the applicator when the transfer hose broke open and sprayed her face, especially her eyes, with 32% nitrogen, Acuron and Gramoxone SL. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to the back of the bucket truck across the catwalk when the employee tripped and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, sustaining a broken leg.
An employee was walking on the walkway grating when the grating fell off its clippings causing the employee to fall approximately seven feet resulting in a shoulder injury.
An employee was examining a tank of hot resin when the mixer turned on and hot resin overflowed onto the employee's arms. The employee was hospitalized for first degree burns to both arms.

An employee was melting steel in a furnace when the molten steel contacted piping carrying circulating water and caused an explosion. The employee was burned by steam and molten metal and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing chemical titration just before he was found lying unresponsive. He was hospitalized.
An employee was sitting on the ground when a loaded trailer pulled forward and rolled over his leg, resulting in hospitalization for a fracture to his leg.

An employee was walking on the deck of an all-terrain crane. When he held on to the crane door, it opened and caused him to lose his balance and fall 5 feet 10 inches to the ground. He was hospitalized for broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was adjusting film on the back of the matrix machine when his left index finger was caught between a pulley and a belt. He sustained the amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was finishing a coil slitting operation when the coil rotated and caught his left hand between the coil and the divider, amputating his left pinky fingertip.
An employee was cutting a beam with a circular saw when the saw slipped and contacted his right hand. He sustained amputation of four fingers on his right hand.

An employee was under a tractor operating a hydraulic bead breaker on the inside tire of the tractor when his hand became wedged between the bead breaker and the bar. He sustained a large laceration to his left hand between his ring and middle finger to the middle of his palm and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing pipe from a scissor lift when one of the scissor lift's tires fell into a hole in the floor causing the lift to fall over and eject the employee. The employee sustained a broken back and a head injury.
An employee was delivering feed to a farm when the employee's glove and hand were caught on an auger attached to a trailer, resulting in partial amputation of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was stepping down off a ladder when he missed the last step and fell to the floor, injuring his hip.
An employee was working on a power line when the employee received an electrical shock and burns from the power line and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was on top of a machine when the reset button was pushed, which caused the machine to pin the employee's foot. The employee sustained an ankle dislocation and severe laceration to the foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a board edger when he sustained a laceration to his left forearm and was hospitalized.
On 4/27/17, while cleaning a work platform, an employee stepped through a hole in the floor and fell against the guardrail, suffering a spleen injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was working in the irregular package section when a coworker extended a package slide so packages could migrate to a lower conveyor. The employee then walked and hit the slide, falling to the floor and breaking his femur.

An employee was recovering refrigerant from a chiller inside a store and was attempting to put a pressure gauge on the 1/4" port of the chiller. He tried to use a rag to plug the valve and in the process sustained refrigerant burns on both of his hands.
On April 27, 2017, an employee and a coworker were working on a street corner when two men assaulted them. The employee suffered a skull fracture and required hospitalization.

An employee was installing a wood chock to secure a steel pipe. The employee then stepped between two sections of pipe at the same time that a forklift operator was attempting to position the pipe. The employee was caught between the two sections of pipe and fractured four ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working under a table where a shaft was being installed onto a bearing. As a hoist was lowering the shaft, the bearing was displaced, fell off the table, and crushed the employee's arm.
An employee was operating a table saw when his left hand contacted the blade, amputating three fingertips to the first knuckle.

On 4/27/17, an employee was participating in physical training as part of a SWAT team tryout. The employee had been on site since 7:00 a.m. and experienced dizziness at about 11:45 a.m. He was hospitalized due to dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading steel beams when two of his fingers were smashed and amputated between two beams.

On April 28, 2017, an employee was assisting a customer refueling their vehicle when she stumbled and fell to the concrete. She suffered an injury to her left shoulder and a fractured left knee. The knee injury required surgery.
An employee was struck by a company truck.

On April 28, 2017, an employee was setting up a die on a roller conveyor when the die shifted and rolled on the conveyor, pinching the end of his left middle finger. He sustained a crushing injury resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was watering flowers when they stumbled and fell, requiring hospitalization for broken vertebrae in their back.

On April 28, 2017, an employee was using a rope to change the felt on a paper machine when his hand was caught in the nip point created by the rope and the shaft. He sustained amputation of the right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was operating a milling machine when their glove became caught in the machine. They sustained a partial amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was on a ladder tightening a bolt with a wrench when the employee fell and was hospitalized for a broken leg.

On April 28, 2017, an employee was mixing ingredients for soup when the mixer exit shoot became clogged. While loosening the clog, her glove became caught and she suffered a broken right middle finger and amputated right index fingertip.

On April 28, 2017 at 8:45 a.m., an employee was removing a piece of lumber from a stack of wood when he tripped over the plastic banding surrounding the lumber and fell on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fracture to his left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was polishing a part on a manual lathe while wearing cut gloves, when his glove became caught on the fixture and he suffered amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was using a saw to cut wood and cut his left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing screws in a electrical panel when a screw touched wires and created an arc flash. He sustained burns to the left hand and chest and was hospitalized.

An employee was transporting two pallets of pails using a swing lift reach truck, which operates on a guidewire system.
