An employee was manually feeding material into a punch press when the press amputated the employee's left second fingertip.
An employee was attempting to grab an operating circular saw when the employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to unjam the pins in a braid carrier machine when his right index finger was caught and amputated in the machine.

On April 28, 2017, an employee was performing torch cutting activities from a pallet supported by a forklift when the employee fell approximately 8 feet and fractured the lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee got two left-hand fingers caught in the palletizer machine's chain drive resulting in lacerations and hospitalization.
On 4/28/2017, an employee was operating a punch press when the employee's right index finger was caught and amputated in the machine.
On April 28, 2017, an employee was filling a propane tank at a customer's house when the propane ignited and he received minor burns on his arm and face.

An employee was placing a sheet of steel in a shear machine when the shear was activated via the foot pedal. The employee's right hand contacted the point of operation, amputating the index finger between the end of the nailbed and the first joint.

An employee was tying rebar at a work site when a rock rolled down a hill and struck the employee's upper body. The employee suffered a broken right arm and left finger, cut over the left eye, and a partially collapsed right lung.
An employee was hit in the head while handling a package and was hospitalized.
An employee was modifying a slide for a winder on an end milling machine when the employee's right little finger contacted the machine and was dislocated.
An employee was operating a grooving machine when his glove was caught in the machine and his right hand was pulled in, amputating his little finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee cut his hand in a cabinet sander and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a spreader/sprayer machine to apply fertilizers and herbicides to turf. He was attempting to repair/replace a belt in the machine when his right hand was caught and pulled into its pulley system, amputating his index fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
While adjusting the height of a machine, an employee's finger contacted moving parts and was partially amputated.
An employee was walking up the stairs when his knee popped and gave out. He fell back down the stairs, breaking both kneecaps and tearing a tendon.
An employee tripped over a rug that had buckled up in an area and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a ruptured spleen.
An employee was participating in a training exercise when he fell approximately 10 feet and fractured his right and left legs.

An employee was installing weatherproofing on a balcony of a new residential building when he leaned against the handrail and it failed. He fell approximately 22 feet to the lower working surface, breaking his right arm and left cheekbone and injuring his head.

On April 28, 2017, at approximately 12:14 p.m., an employee was standing on a 6-foot combination ladder to install a new service line from a utility pole to a residential home. He fell approximately 5 feet from the ladder to the ground, fracturing his coccyx bone and right wrist.

An employee was installing electrical work from a steel frame when he fell approximately 20 feet to the lower level and sustained broken ribs and a spine fracture. His personal fall arrest system was disconnected at the time of the incident.

An employee was dropping a fill cube into a basin when it was caught on bolts installed inside the basin. He pushed on the fill cube with his hand to free the fill cube. When the cube was freed it pinched his right hand between the casing panel and the basin, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee was delivering mail when she experienced pain in her right leg and numbness in her left leg. She was hospitalized for heat stroke symptoms.
An employee was stepping off a shuttle bus onto the pavement when she slipped and fell, breaking her left ankle.

An employee was replacing an overhead chute that had a hole in it. He began to clean excess cake mix off of the auger when his hand contacted the sifter auger, amputating his index and middle fingers to the first knuckle. The auger was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was lifting a treating iron to make up a connection. After the connection was secured, the employee started to lower the treating iron when he lost his balance and dropped the treating iron. The weight of the load landed on his right leg, breaking his fibula and tibia.
An employee fell off the back of a parked truck while closing the door, suffering an open wrist fracture.
An employee was using a standing drill press to drill a round hole into aluminum when his gloved right hand was caught and his ring finger was pulled into the drill bit, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was hit by a bull and sustained a right hip fractured that required surgery and overnight hospitalization.

An employee was operating a laminator that was on a cart when the cart hit a post, causing the laminator to come off the rails it sat on. The employee's right pinky finger was pinched and partially amputated between the frame of the cart and the laminator.
An employee was attempting to clear clogged material from a silo's inspection port when the rotary valve flights caught and amputated the fleshy pad of his left index finger.
An employee was looking at the coating on rollers when his hand and arm were pulled into the roller, breaking two fingers.
An employee was taking a tray out of a baking oven when her right forearm suffered second degree grease burns.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he lost control and struck a pole, injuring his left leg and foot.
An employee was cleaning out ash from ductwork when he misstepped and fell approximately 3 feet down onto a structural beam, suffering broken ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from a ladder while cleaning a shelf, breaking the left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered respiratory distress when she went into a restroom and found a patient that was smoking.
An employee was helping a patient stand when the patient lost balance, causing the employee to fall back and hit a sink. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was inserting a metal spacer between two roll supports when the rolls closed hydraulically, crushing and amputating the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was working from a pole that had just been set in wet and muddy ground. The employee was making the second power line connection when the pole began to lean. The pole slowly leaned to approximately 10 feet from the ground then fell over with the employee still attached to the pole. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee slipped on a grape and fell to the ground, fracturing the left knee.
An employee tripped over a liner strap while cleaning and fell to the ground, breaking both arms.
On 4/30/17, an employee was lifting and transferring a patient when the patient fell, causing the employee to injure her neck and back.

An employee and two coworkers were manually tensioning a belt on a belt drive when his left thumb was pulled into the in-running nip point created between the belt and the sieve, amputating his thumb above the first knuckle. He was wearing leather gloves at the time of the incident.

An employee was on an extension ladder attempting to dislodge ice that had become stuck in an ice bin when he fell to the concrete below, fracturing his right pelvis and right arm and suffering a head contusion and blurred vision.
An employee was going to cut a piece of flat metal and was using an air clamp to hold the metal in place when the employee's left thumb tip was caught and amputated.

An employee was waiting for potatoes to be graded (using a bulk grader) so that he could load them onto a tractor trailer when he noticed a bad potato on the conveyor. When he attempted to pull the bad potato out, his right index finger was caught in the conveyor's moving chain and sprocket, amputating it to the first joint.
An employee was unscrewing the oil and gas pipe and was pushed over the edge of the work floor by the high pressure release. The employee fell 10 feet to the ground and broke his left arm.

An employee was standing on top of a printing press, taping paper down to be run through the machine, when a coworker inadvertently activated the printing press table. The employee then fell off the table and hit the concrete floor, fracturing his right femur. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped and fell while descending stairs, fracturing the left ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was walking with a scanner, felt lightheaded and fell to the ground breaking his right hip.

An employee was preparing to feed cables to a coworker in an aerial lift. The employee received an electric shock from an elevated cable that came in contact with an energized power source, suffering burns to his left foot, hand, and abdomen.
On May 1, 2017, an employee's hand was caught and seriously injured in a small expander press that was activated via the foot control. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was using an extension ladder to change a light bulb outside near the trash compactor when the employee fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, suffering fractured ribs and a brain injury.

Employees were moving calendar rolls around in the roll storage area of a deep well. The injured employee was walking between a suspended roll and a roll on the ground when a crane operator changed the direction of travel to avoid striking an adjacent roll. This change of direction caused the suspended roll to pin the employee between the suspended roll and another roll, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was servicing an A/C unit with a clamp-on amp meter. He removed the cover to test the A/C when his left middle fingertip was caught and amputated (no bone loss) between a belt and pulley.
An employee was using a table saw to make prototype and merchandise products when the saw amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee was using a vertical stacker to raise trusses. When the employee pushed the stacker bar over, it started to fall. As the employee tried to catch it, the stacker pinched and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was walking to the front of the store to start her shift when she tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing her left hip.

An employee was operating a motorcycle on a trail when her wheels were caught in a rut on the side of the bike, causing the bike to overturn and land on her right leg. She broke her right tibia, fibula, and ankle.
An employee was using a sledgehammer to nail a stake into the ground. When he swung the hammer, it missed the stake and struck his hand, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a V-notch hydraulic press when it partially amputated the second, third, and possibly fourth finger of the employee's right hand.
An employee was walking in a main aisle when a forklift ran over the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was loosening turnbuckles to remove lashing bars from containers when one of the bars came loose and fell and struck the employee's mouth. The employee suffered a fractured jaw and broken teeth.
An employee was adding hot oil to a hydraulic line when an air pocket bubbled up and splashed his neck, causing burns.
An employee was descending a two-step round stool when she twisted and fractured her right foot. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
After removing a pipe hanger from the ceiling, an employee was descending a fixed ladder when he misstepped and fell 11 feet to the concrete floor, breaking three vertebrae and requiring surgery.
An employee was stepping off an excavator when his wedding ring was caught on the excavator catwalk and his ring finger was de-gloved.
While carrying a lid on a railcar, a temporary employee fell from the railcar to the ground, suffering a broken cheekbone and wrist.

An employee was in the bucket of a boom truck 20 to 25 feet in the air, removing vinyl lettering from a window, when a strong wind gust blew over the boom truck. The employee was ejected from the bucket as the truck hit the ground, suffering a possible fractured neck.

An employee was reaching through a 4-inch hole to drill a pilot hole into an electrical panel when his left finger touched the trigger on the drill and turned it on. The drill then lacerated the top of his left hand.

An employee was using a portable press to square a metal frame for a gasket application when the hydraulic hose became bound during expansion. The buildup caused a hydraulic rupture that dislodged the press from its mooring. The press struck the employee and knocked him from his ladder. He struck his head when he landed, causing a concussion and scalp laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was in a 4-foot-deep elevator pit removing forms from the area when dirt fell from the top, landing on and breaking both of his legs. He was hospitalized.

An employee used a ladder to get a box of batteries from a top bin. The box was too heavy and she fell off the ladder, landing on and injuring her right leg. The box fell on and injured her right arm.

An employee was gathering wooden door fronts from a conveyor when the employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught in the chain and sprocket along the conveyor line resulting in a laceration to the ring finger and a broken middle finger that required surgery. The chain and sprocket on the conveyor were unguarded at the time.

An employee was attempting to put a pick conveyor's idler roller back in its track when his left hand was caught between the idler roller and the conveyor (pick) belt. His skin was removed from the back of his left hand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was riding in a forklift being driven by a coworker when he fell off. The forklift then ran over both of his feet.

While using a tarp to cover cargo on a flatbed trailer, an employee slipped and fell about 4 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a partially deflated lung. The flatbed was wet due to rain at the time.
An employee was carrying a bucket of debris when he tripped and fell over a grate that had been removed, injuring his left knee.
An employee was servicing the puller at the end of a press when the puller moved and struck his knees. He was hospitalized.
An employee turned around, tripped over a wheelchair, and fell to the ground. She suffered a fractured hip and cuts to the face and knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was coming out of a group home when she turned around to avoid a bee and fell, fracturing her femur.

An employee was carrying a conference tabletop up a stairwell with three other men. He put the table down to reposition it and his right index finger became caught. When he pulled his hand, his index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing an oak tree limb from a powerline. After cutting a considerate amount of brush off the limb, he freed the powerline. The tree limb became disconnected and fell to the ground, where it bounced and hit his left leg below the knee, breaking his tibia and requiring surgery.

At approximately 12:45 p.m. on 5/1/17, an employee was holding a case of liquid shortening weighing approximately 20 pounds and was twisting to set it on an order picker when he tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing his right hip.
While loading water from a pipeline into a trailer, an employee was struck by a pipeline pig that ejected out of the pipeline. The employee suffered a broken ankle and leg.
An employee was mowing a lawn with a push mower and lacerated his left big toe.
An employee was removing insulation from refrigerant piping when a moving fan contacted the employee's right hand, breaking and lacerating the right index and ring fingers.

An employee was working at a client's commercial building and climbed through an attic opening to check a conduit. The attic had no stairs and a ladder was used through the opening. The attic opening was approximate 30" by 30". When he attempted to come back down the ladder, he slipped and fell 10 feet through the hole to the floor, breaking his left arm and two fingers and cutting his left hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was measuring the office for modification using a rolling chair when she fell, hit her head on a counter top and then fell onto the floor. She was admitted to the hospital for treatment of a head laceration and a fracture L1 and L2 vertebrae.
An employee was working on powerline switches when an arc flash occurred, burning his left hand and arm, stomach, and back.
An employee tripped and fell in the parking lot resulting in a fractured left arm.

An employee was handling sheet metal and assembling ductwork in the shop. While handling sheet metal, the employee lost his balance and fell, striking his hip against the concrete floor. He had a tape measure in his pocket on the hip on which he fell. Ductwork that was being handled then fell on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was walking to deliver a parcel when he stepped in a puddle and slipped, falling on his right side. He fractured his right femur and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was unloading equipment from the back of the trailer when the equipment slipped and fell onto his left foot resulting in the amputation of a toe.

An employee was operating an aerial lift at the worksite. A vehicle struck the boom of the lift causing it to swing into a steel column and the operator was bounced around in the basket resulting in facial and internal injuries and a fractured arm.

An employee was loading a cart with cases of water. The employee stepped onto a shelf to reach a case, then slipped and fell off that shelf. The employee suffered a compression fracture in the lower spine.

An employee was installing a mixer with a coworker. His right hand was inside the pulley assembly, attempting to get the cable back on the pulley, when the up/down air lifter was actuated to relieve tension on the cable. The mixer then came down and amputated his right index fingertip between the knuckle and the nail.

On May 2, 2017, at 3:00 PM an employee was repairing the brakes on a trailer. He released the jack and the trailer came down on his right hand resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was cutting beef shank with a bandsaw when the blade amputated his right index finger and damaged his right middle finger.

An employee was cleaning around the axle stacker machine. As he retrieved the cone used to mark the area he is cleaning, his right arm was caught in the running machine resulting in a forearm laceration.
An employee was working on an extruder when his glove became caught in the machine. The extruder then pulled his hand in and amputated a fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was getting out of a vehicle when a gust of wind blew the door shut on his finger, amputating the fingertip below the fingernail.

An employee was threading media through the rollers of the pleater machine and got his left hand caught between two rollers in the machine. The employee was hospitalized for a hand contusion.
The employee was walking down the concrete stairs for the day when she missed a step and fell down a few stairs onto the landing fracturing an ankle.

An employee was attempting to help a coworker whose garbage truck was caught on low hanging cable/phone line wires. When he removed the panel, the wire swung backward and struck him, causing him to fall off the back of the truck. He landed on his right leg and fractured his femur, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading ammunition rounds onto a tank when a round ignited and burned the employee's forearm, hand, and abdomen.
On May 2, 2017, at 7:00 a.m., an employee was performing concrete work when he fell four floors through an opening in a core shaft and was injured, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a scissor lift and pinched the left ring finger at the middle phalanges between the lift's guardrail and a steel angle support resulting in amputation.
An employee was handling a manual propelled cart loaded with drywall when the cart turned out and the bundle of drywall struck the employee in the throat, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a mobile scaffold about 3 or 4 feet above the floor when the platform became partially unsecured and tilted. The employee lost his balance and fell into a stand. He was hospitalized with a puncture wound and possible internal injuries in the sternum/chest area.

He was hospitalized with a back injury and had surgery.

On May 9, 2017, an employee was standing at the rear door on a vacuum suction tank when the employee was caught and pinned between the hydraulic-actuated closing door, suffering a crushed midsection and chest.
On May 9, 2017, an employee was attempting to remove a piece of meat material from a chain drive guard when his left index fingertip was caught and amputated in the chain drive.
An employee was attempting to unload 4x4 posts from the forks of a forklift when the posts broke the employee's leg.
An employee was helping to load a trailer with freight when the employee fell 5 feet off the freight to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a broken left shoulder.
An employee was using a safety knife or a box cutter to cut rolls of film that were coming out of a machine when the blade amputated his left middle fingertip (skin only).

An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw when the piece of wood kicked back. As the employee tried to catch the piece of wood, the saw blade cut his left hand, amputating his second, third, and fourth fingertips.
An employee was chasing undocumented aliens through rough mountain terrain when he fell from a height and landed on his back. He suffered a T-8 compression fracture, broken rib, and contusions.

An employee was performing pipe fabrication work on a 20-foot, 12-inch diameter steel pipe that was situated on a pipe rolling rack. The pipe rolled about 18 inches off the pipe rack and struck his left leg, fracturing it below the left knee.

An employee was checking if there was enough clearance between an excavator and a fence when the excavator operator tried to move the excavator tracks. The excavator bucket moved instead and struck the employee against a trench box. He suffered fractured ribs.
An employee was carrying a stack of glasses when one of the glasses broke, lacerating the palm of his right hand and requiring hospitalization.

On May 09, 2017, an employee had dismounted a tugger and was hooking carts onto it when a second tugger passed by. The second tugger's carts broke loose and struck the employee. The employee was knocked to the ground and suffered a laceration on the right foot and a fracture to the right knee.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when his right index finger contacted the blade, amputating his fingertip above the knuckle.

An employee was cutting metal pieces in a shear that is operated with a foot control. While he was leaning forward to adjust a piece with his hand, his foot pushed down on the foot control and activated the shear, which then amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was performing duct work from a ladder when he lost his balance and fell about 4 feet to the ground, breaking his wrist and collarbone.
An employee was using a chemical cleaner to clear a restroom drain when he began coughing and having trouble breathing. He was hospitalized with a burned esophagus and lungs and respiratory distress.
An employee was participating in a flow back operation when a sand separator tipped and fell onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur and a broken hip.

An employee saw that the engine on his vehicle was running hot. He was adding fluids to the vehicle when the radiator cap blew off. Hot antifreeze spewed on him, burning his lower arm, chest, and abdomen. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was connecting a tow bar to an aircraft when the tow bar fell and hit him on his left big toe and adjacent toe.

An employee was helping a forklift operator to move a granite slab with the forklift and an attachment clamp. The forklift operator put the forklift in neutral and got off of it. The forklift rolled forward and ran over the employee's ankle, breaking it.
An employee was operating a 9-inch grinder when it slipped out of his hands and lacerated his left leg above the knee.
An employee and a coworker were moving a dolly that was loaded with metal sheets. The dolly tipped over and struck the employee's left foot, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was pulling a bundle of cardboard when the band strap broke and he fell to the ground, breaking his left wrist. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was charging an A/C unit when Freon gases escaped from the machine and sprayed the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized with right hand burns.

An employee was moving a large heavy mold when his left pinky finger was caught between the mold he was pushing and another stationary mold. His finger was severely crushed and lacerated, requiring surgery.
While attempting to restore power to a downed pole, an employee came in contact with a 14,400-volt powerline, suffering an electric shock and burns.
An employee tripped and fell while walking and talking, fracturing the right humerus at the shoulder.
An employee was walking around a corner when her left foot caught on something and she fell on a hard object, fracturing her left hip.
An employee amputated his left index finger while cutting meat on a band saw.

An employee was elevated in a scissor lift, attempting to remove straps from a section of wall that was being lifted by a forklift. The forklift backed up while the straps were still connected and pulled the wall onto the employee in the scissor lift. The employee suffered a broken hip and ankle.

An employee was on a ladder, removing a vice grip from a garage door to open it. When the vice grip came off, the door rolled open and knocked him off the ladder. His right thumb was pinched and amputated between the door and the track.

An employee was attempting to remove dried lead paste from a paddle at the outlet of a hopper when his glove became caught on a sprocket or drive chain on the hopper. His right middle finger was pulled approximately 1/2 inch into the chain, amputating it at the first knuckle. The chain was unguarded at the time.
An employee was feeding sheet metal into a beader machine when his glove was caught in the roller, partially amputating his left index and middle fingertips. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was descending an extension ladder when he lost his balance and fell 8 feet to the brick patio floor. He fell on his side, fracturing six ribs and bruising his lower back.
An employee was driving an open cab tractor when a tree limb lacerated his cheek. The scratch later became severely infected and required hospitalization the following day.
An employee was moving a steel panel when the panel fell and hit him on the left forearm. The steel panel cut into his skin, muscle, and tendon. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee's left big toe was crushed and fractured when a pallet slid off the forks of a forklift and landed on the employee's foot. The employee had surgery and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was nailing felt paper on a deck when the felt paper moved, causing him to lose balance while holding the nail gun in his right hand. A nail then ejected and punctured his left middle finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was checking the back of a tractor-trailer for obstructions. The tractor-trailer driver lost sight of the employee while backing up and struck him. He suffered a broken leg, two broken ribs, and a road rash injury to the scalp.

An employee was re-erecting goal posts below a power line when the stringer of flags on one end of the goal posts became hung up on the passenger-side rear-view mirror of a haul truck. The injured employee was attempting to free the stringer of flags when a coworker raised a PVC pipe to place it over a t-post. The top of the PVC pole, where the stringer of flags was tied, came into contact with the overhead power line. The employee sustained burns to his left arm, left hand, and right foot. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was holding a davit arm base that weighed approximately 25 pounds. As he turned, he felt pain in the lower back area due to a back sprain/strain.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk, twisted a foot and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was cleaning a table at the home of a patient. When she bent over, she felt a very sharp pain in her back. She was hospitalized with a pinched nerve in her lower back.
An employee suffered an amputation while working on a press machine.

On May 10, 2017, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was using a hand crank to dolly up a trailer when the employee's hand slipped off the crank, which then swung around and struck the employee's right eye. The employee suffered right eye trauma.
While using a tag line to move a pipe, an employee lost control of the tag line. The employee's right arm was then caught between the pipe and a drilling rig, breaking it.

On May 10, 2017, an employee was removing pins and bolts from a roller when the roller opened up and moved, pinning the employee between the bench and the open roller. The employee suffered a smashed leg and shoulder.
An employee was conducting framing activities for a residential home when he lost his footing and fell approximately 24 feet from the roof to the ground, breaking his wrist and ankles.

An employee was manually feeding a 6' piece of 2x10 lumber into a rip saw when a piece of the lumber became caught in the saw and kicked back through the machine, striking and puncturing the employee's right forearm.
An employee had removed a loading dock plate when he fell into the gap between the truck and loading dock, fracturing his left femur.
An employee was bitten by a spider while sitting at a desk and was hospitalized.

An employee transported a sofa on a four-wheeled cart to a container truck and unloaded it at the rear of the container. He then positioned himself in front of the sofa to push it farther into the truck when the cart, which was set on a slight ramp, rolled into the back of his left leg. He lifted his leg rapidly and it hit the bottom of the cart. He suffered a laceration to the back of his lower left leg and tendon.
An employee opened the door to go outside and tripped over a water hose. She fell and struck her head, requiring hospitalization.
While walking, an employee tripped and fell fracturing a hip.

An employee was working on a pneumatic nut runner (air ratchet) equipped with a long extension to bolt seat rails to a bus. The employee was wearing gloves at the time. She was holding the air ratchet overhead with her left hand near the rotating ratchet head when the ratchet head and extension caught her glove, wrapping it around her left pinky and partially de-gloving it. Her left pinky finger had to be partially amputated.
An employee was helping a coworker with a kelly belt when a 48-inch steel pipe wrench kicked back and struck the employee, fracturing the employee's left forearm.

An employee was trying to move a trailer off the assembly line with help from coworkers. The trailer slid sideways and fell off its dolly. When the trailer hit the floor, the open tilt deck slammed shut onto the injured employee's left hand, severely lacerating it.
A temporary employee was troubleshooting a pressure washer when his fingers became caught in the tool, amputating his right index finger at the first joint.

An employee was pressing discs onto a roller using a hydraulic press when a steel plate in the press sheared its retaining bolts and the steel plate was expelled, striking the employee in the mid-section. The employee was hospitalized due to a slight tear to the liver, a torn groin muscle, and a laceration to the rear of the head requiring five staples.

An employee and a coworker were installing sheet rock while standing on a bakers scaffold that was approximately 7 feet tall. The employee needed to reach higher so he was also using a step ladder on the bakers scaffold. His coworker climbed down off of the scaffolding and the scaffolding began to roll. The employee was on the scaffolding standing on the step ladder as it was rolling. The scaffolding tipped over onto its side, and the employee fell approximately 8 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a broken wrist, foot, and skull.
An employee slipped and fell in the restroom, fracturing a leg.
An employee was shaving palm trees below the roof when a roll of roofing paper fell off and onto the employee's head and back, causing contusions to both.
An employee was helping to unload a truck and shortly thereafter suffered chest pains.

An employee was sitting in a chair and leaned back to look down the hallway. When she turned her head, she felt a pop, as well as numbness and tingling in her right arm and hand. She was hospitalized.
An employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between a roller and an aluminum extrusion.
An employee was standing in his designated area while waiting for a powered industrial truck to load his truck. The powered industrial truck then struck the employee, crushing both of his feet.

An employee was brushing metal shavings out of a seamer when a metal sliver punctured his right hand. He later experienced hot/cold flashes, nausea, swelling in his right palm, and numbness in his right arm due to blood poisoning, requiring hospitalization.

While operating a forklift, an employee lost control of the forklift and it tipped over, crushing the employee's foot and hand. The employee suffered a broken finger and had to have multiple toes amputated.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee contacted a metal hose clamp while working on a waste water pump, suffering a laceration and infection that required hospitalization the following day.
An employee was unclogging an airlock machine when her glove was caught in the machine. Her right ring and pinky fingers were then amputated at the first knuckle.

On May 11, 2017, an employee was attempting to feed wire mesh through a wall and into a building. The employee's left hand was pulled into the rotating pinch rollers, which amputated the index finger.
An employee was waiting for a bundle saw to complete its sawing cycle when the employee's left middle finger was caught between two pieces of steel, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was bending over to paint the bottom of a pipe when another piece kicked over behind him and struck his left shoulder. He was pushed into the pipe he was painting, making contact in the center of his chest. He was hospitalized with a contusion to the left shoulder (back), contusion to the front of the chest, and laceration to the chin.
A security guard was assaulted by a person on a train, suffering a broken jaw and requiring hospitalization.
While lubricating a loader, an employee lost balance and fell 3.5 feet to the ground, breaking the right leg.

An employee was working on a production line when the palletizer jammed. While attempting to clear the jam, the employee was pinned between pails and the moving equipment. A coworker stopped the machine and the employee fell out onto the rollers, sustaining left rib fractures and a punctured lung. The machine was not turned off at the time of the incident.
On 5/11/17, an employee fell from a step ladder to the concrete floor of a new home under construction, suffering a head injury and broken wrist.

An employee was traveling down an aisle in the warehouse when the forklift he was operating veered and struck a support column. His leg became pinned between the body of the forklift and the support column. He sustained multiple fractures to his lower left leg, which was amputated below the knee.

An employee noticed that a shaver box was making a strange noise and called a coworker for assistance. After the coworker identified that the noise was being caused by a piece of wood that was hung up in the shaver box, he pressed the stop button to initiate the shutdown process. While the employee was attempting to remove the piece of wood, his foot was on the chain of the shaver box. The chain was still coasting to a stop and pulled the employee's right foot into the drive sprocket. He suffered a hole in the top of his foot, a crushed fourth toe, and a deeply lacerated pinky toe. His right fourth toe had to be surgically amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on a film of fat on the platform floor, fracturing the right femur.

An employee was MIG welding when a spark ignited his shirt. He suffered second and third degree burns to the upper portion of his body, both arms, his neck, and the lower portion of his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was escorting a patron in the elevator. The elevator was called back to the first floor, but the doors malfunctioned and remained open at the second floor. The employee stepped into the open elevator shaft and fell approximately 10 feet, suffering a fractured kneecap.

A well-servicing rig crew was tripping pipe out of a hole when the safety pin on the tongs (torqueing device) broke, allowing the tongs to strike an employee and knock him off the work platform. He fell 10 feet, fracturing his ribs and back and lacerated his liver.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a filling machine when the machine amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee fell from an unfinished stairwell platform, hit his head on a wall on the way down, and then landed on the concrete floor 10 to 15 feet below. He suffered bleeding in the brain, a broken bone in the neck, and a broken bone in the chest.
An employee was on foot patrol along the US border and was bitten by an unknown insect resulting in redness and swelling.
An employee was using a towel to clean water drops off a press ink ball when the loose end of the towel was drawn into the press. The employee's finger was also drawn in and amputated.

An employee was working on the second level of a scaffold approximately eight feet high. The employee was reaching up to adjust the toe board for the level above when he slipped and fell through the mid-rail to the ground below. The employee suffered a left shoulder and elbow injury and a laceration above the left eye requiring stitches.
An employee was unloading materials from a box truck when the vehicle rolled backwards and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a lower deflector trough. As he pulled his hand away and across his body, his right index fingertip was pinched in a baffle. The force of the pinch amputated his fingertip. He was wearing gloves at the time of the incident.

An employee was guiding horses through a gate and into a corral for mane shaving when a horse pulled on its halter, causing the employee's left hand to become trapped between the stock and gate. The employee suffered a broken left thumb.

An employee was exiting the cab of a bulldozer. The employee slipped on the track while stepping down. The employee's lower left leg became lodged between the track and the bulldozer's blade, fracturing the tibia, fibula, and patella. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee had been at work since 7:00 a.m., unpacking boxes and building furniture on the dock, when he felt dizzy and collapsed. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

On May 11, 2017, an employee was guiding a generator that was being lowered to the ground by a crane. At approximately 9:45 a.m., the employee used his right hand to hit the headache ball of the crane to unhook it from the generator. The ball dropped suddenly, pinching his right pinky finger between the headache ball and the hook. Half of his finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee fell from a ladder while installing a flex duct. On the way down, he put his hand out to brace himself and his right hand came into contact with a metal RC channel, cutting three fingers.
An employee was cutting a short loin of beef using a band saw when the table stopped abruptly.  The employee's right middle finger then contacted the blade, amputating the fingertip (no bone loss).
An employee tripped over a table and fell, fracturing both of her kneecaps.

An employee was cutting lab samples with a utility band saw when his glove was caught on a blade and his hand was pulled into the blade, cutting his left palm from the little finger to almost under the index finger.
An employee was attempting to dislodge an obstruction in the powdered lubricant applicator unit of tire bead fabrication equipment when his right ring fingertip was amputated by a chain and sprocket.
An employee was starting a lawn mower when he fell down and the mower ran over his right leg, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's glove was caught between a part and a hydraulic roller table, smashing and amputating his left index fingertip.

Workers were using a mobile crane to lift several 60-foot sections of 4-inch coiled rubber hose when one end of one of the coils caught the single coil that was being lifted. Once the coil rigged to the load line was approximately 10 feet above the ground, the end of the coil that had attached itself to the coil being lifted came free, rolled back, and struck the head of an employee on the ground. He suffered a 2-inch scalp laceration and numbness in his right arm.
An employee was attempting to unload a trailer when a pallet of corrugated material (400 pounds) fell from the trailer and struck his lower right ankle, fracturing it.
An employee tripped and fell while wheeling an appliance out of a trailer, suffering a back compression fracture.

An employee was in a ditch assisting with setting a water pipe. A pipe attached to machinery with a chain struck the employee's leg when the equipment was moved. The employee suffered a fracture under the knee cap that required surgery.
An employee was removing a transmission from a car when the transmission fell onto the employee's left foot causing a crushing injury. Infection resulted in hospitalization and amputation.
An employee was feeding a sander's out feed when his third left finger was caught and amputated between two wooden components.
An employee was cleaning the rollers of a sugar packet sealing machine with a rag when the rag and her hand were pulled between the rollers, lacerating and fracturing her right middle finger.

An employee was running a service line to the residence. The ladder shifted as he was climbing it, causing him to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left wrist requiring surgery to repair and lacerations to the face and right arm.
An employee was power-washing a lift when the power-washer spray punctured the employee's left middle finger. The puncture became infected and required surgery.
While installing a catwalk on top of a grain elevator, an employee fell approximately 15 feet through an opening in a platform to a lower level, suffering a broken ankle and requiring surgery.

At approximately 4:30 a.m., on May 12, 2017, an employee was operating an extrusion line when the film caused the sheet to become stuck at the center trim saw. He went under the line and pushed the sheet up to free it. When he did this, the force of the sheet pulled his hand toward the saw, which amputated his ring and middle fingertips.

An employee was moving stressing jacks from one steel cable to another to pre-stress the steel cables before pouring the concrete beam around them when his right index and middle fingers entered the path of the stressing jack and were partially amputated.

An employee and a coworker were operating a saw with dual palm buttons. The employee was on the left side holding a 2 x 4 wooden board to be cut toward the back stop on the machine. The coworker was on the right side and actuated the palm buttons while the employee's left thumb was in the point of operation. When the blade came up, it amputated approximately 1/4" of the employee's left thumb tip. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was working on a machine when the yoke activated and caught four right-hand fingers, partially amputating them.

Two employees were changing out the skid steer attachment from a bucket to forks. The bucket did not fall free when the two retaining pins were removed due to the build up of dirt. The bucket was still lifted about six inches above the ground. The injured employee was standing near the bucket with his left hand resting on it, while another employee used a hammer on the opposite side to knock the dirt loose. The bucket fell approximately six inches and the injured employee's left hand was pinched between the bucket and fixed supports resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was pulling mail containers toward a truck trailer when the employee walked backwards off the loading dock, hitting the concrete and suffering a head injury.

A temporary employee was walking down a hill and mowing the lawn when he slipped and fell with the mower. He stopped but the mower kept going and ran over his right foot, amputating his middle toe and cutting the two adjacent toes.

An employee was using a string trimmer while standing on an uphill incline when he lost footing as a mower approached from behind. His foot slid backwards and into the path of the mower deck, which severed his Achilles tendon and ligaments and broke bones in his lower leg. A mulching block-off plate was not in place on the mower's discharge opening and pulley guards were not installed at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning a pillow fiber filling machine when his right index finger was caught and amputated in the machine's drum.
An employee was spinning a tire mounted on a car when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between the brake rotor and wheel.
An employee was providing resident care (diaper changing) when she felt a muscle spasm in her upper left back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a street light when the base kicked back and struck the employee in the stomach area.
An employee was using a step ladder to retrieve a container from shelving when he fell to the floor and fractured his right ankle.

On May 12, 2017, at 9:25 AM, an employee was operating a forklift to pick up a skid with two coils. As he backed up, the skid slid off of the forks. When the skid holding the material slid off the fork, it struck two employees. The first employee suffered a lower left leg amputation, while the second employee suffered a lower right leg amputation.

An employee was working on an electrical box while on a ladder when he passed out, fell 4 feet from the ladder, and hit his head on the concrete. He suffered a head injury, broken clavicle, and two broken ribs. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was welding pipes when his left index and middle finger were caught and amputated in a pipe clamp.

On Friday, May 12, 2017, at approximately 10:00 p.m., an employee of the restaurant was walking out of the manager's office when his right little finger was caught in the doorframe on the hinge side, amputating the soft tissue of the right little fingertip.
The employee was lowering planks down to another employee from approximately 10 feet high on a mast climber scaffold. The employee fell and injured his back and ribs.
An employee was cleaning a granulator when it amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was cutting a piece of duct work to size using a grinder with a cut-off wheel. The pipe was staged on the back of a truck parked approximately 5 feet from two manhole covers. As the employee was cutting, vapors from an underground tank beneath the manhole covers ignited, causing first degree flash burns to the employee's torso, chest, hands, arms, head, face, neck, and back and second degree burns to the chest and hands.
An employee's left foot was caught and fractured between the forks brace and step of a skid steer. His big toe was also severely dislocated.
An employee tripped and fell down a flight of stairs while engaged in construction operations. The employee sustained a mild concussion and was subsequently hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was sliding a section of grating into place and crushed his left middle finger between the grating and horizontal support steel member underneath resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The employee had been planting crops with a planting machine. The employee's hands were in the planting mechanism when it hydraulically lifted and caught his fingers resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he lost control of it while turning right. His right hand was then caught and fractured between the forklift and an upright rack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a pallet jack when it hit and broke his ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving a cart filled with cardboard to a dumpster. As he lifted the cart, it slid and fell into the dumpster. When he pulled his hand away, his left hand was caught on the cart front pivot bar and the side of the dumpster, de-gloving his middle fingertip.

On Saturday, May 13, 2017, at approximately 10:45 AM, an employee was slicing meat using a meat slicer. She placed her right hand on the slicer hold-down knob but her right thumb moved to the side of the hold-down/guard. As she proceeded to slice the lunch meat, her right thumb contacted the blade, amputating the thumb tip.
An employee was using a pedestal grinder to grind a work piece when his thumb was caught between the work piece and the grinding wheel, avulsing his thumbnail and the tissue below the nail.
An employee was attempting to inflate a tire on a trailer when the tire and rim exploded. The employee suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on a sidewalk grate, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was cutting concrete with a hydraulic saw when the saw kicked back, slipped from his hands, and lacerated his left bicep.
An employee was manually moving yarn stuck in the texturizer on the extrusion line. The machine was turned back on and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee was adjusting the clutch of a cake depositor when his left hand slipped and his left middle finger contacted the moving chain, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working in the server pantry in the kitchen when her foot stuck to the non-slip floor and she fell, breaking her hip.

An employee was dropping a pallet of product off at a loading dock using a powered pallet jack when he backed up into a rack. His hand was caught between the rack and the pallet jack's handle, fracturing and cutting his left thumb.

An employee was retrieving a wrench from his company truck. A water hauler truck (18 wheeler) reversed into the employee's pick-up truck. The employee's leg was caught in the door jam as he jumped into the truck resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee was working in the field and contracted the flu and typhus.

An employee was climbing a ladder to check an aerial internet terminal. The ladder was against a telephone pole and the employee was on his way up to tie a safety strap around the pole and top of the ladder. The ladder slipped when the employee was more than halfway up, causing him and the ladder to fall to the ground. He suffered a broken right leg just above the ankle.
An employee was utilizing a step stool to stock shelves, lost balance and fell striking his head on a shelf. The employee injured their head and shoulder.
An employee was working on a cutting machine when her left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was helping to sandblast an underground pipe with a hose and sandblasting wand when the wand pointed at his arm and released sandblasting material under high pressure. He suffered a serious arm abrasion.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of wood while working at an edger machine when his pinky finger contacted the trim saw blade and was amputated.
An employee was helping to unload a truck at the stock room doors outside when she collapsed due to heat-related syncope and required hospitalization.

An employee was ascending a portable ladder/platform system. The employee got to the top of the platform system and fell through the opening that would normally go over the man-hole of a tractor trailer, suffering a fractured heel and tibia.

An employee was securing a cabinet to the wall. He had one foot on a ladder and the other on a shelf so he could reach the top of the new cabinet. The shelf anchor failed, causing the cabinet and employee to fall approximately 42 inches. He suffered contusions to the right flank, a right rib fracture, and hip pain and needed right arm stitches.
An employee was marshaling a vehicle into a repair bay when the vehicle struck an alignment machine. The machine fell onto the employee and sprained his knee.
An employee was being trained on how to operate a shear machine when the shear caught and amputated his left middle fingertip and nail.
An employee was holding the material feed pendant while removing a part from the press. As the material was fed into the press, the employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was sorting metal pipes on a recycling line. When he discarded a section of pipe into a bunker, the pipe rebounded and struck his left index finger, resulting in a severe laceration.

An employee was placing a 12-inch elevator on a column pipe when the elevator opened unexpectedly and crushed the employee's right index finger in a pinch point. The employee's finger was also lacerated.
An employee was stepping off a 2-foot-high truck bumper when his knee gave out and he fell to the ground, breaking his right ankle.
On May 15, 2017, an employee was attempting to change hoses on machinery when his fingers were caught and amputated in an unguarded moving chain and sprocket.

An employee was helping a coworker set a dock plate. The coworker went to pull the rear dock plate spring as the employee was pulling the front spring. The dock plate sprung up and the employee's right ring finger was caught in the pinch point between the dock plate and the plate flap, amputating the finger below the first knuckle.

An employee flipped an LBX roof with a ceramic cam magnet attached to a hoist. The employee moved the magnet release handle, which operated a roller cam to release the magnet, then grabbed the opposite side to pull the magnet away. The magnet release handle switched back, engaging the magnet, which pinched and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was disassembling a racking system and stacking the racks when a rack shifted and the racks fell on the employee's leg fracturing it.
An employee was spotting for a tractor and trailer when he became trapped between the trailer and a piece of stationary equipment. His pelvis was crushed and he required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to start a chainsaw while in a tree when the employee's gear gave way and the employee fell 15 to 20 feet to the ground, fracturing the third vertebra and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a cooling coil on a rooftop HVAC unit. He removed a panel to the unit to wash the coil from the inside out. His left hand was inside the unit when the fan blade struck and amputated his left index finger and lacerated his middle finger.

An employee was feeding plastic film through a vacuum packing machine when it jammed. As the employee was trying to clear the jam, the machine's cutting blade amputated the employee's right index fingertip.

An employee was standing on a truck platform and was in the process of turning around to step down when he fell onto the gravel/rock. The employee sustained a broken right wrist and facial lacerations.

An employee was using a forklift to move pallets from the warehouse to the back side of the building when the forklift struck the building's gas shut-off valve, igniting the battery and starting a fire. The employee suffered second degree burns to both arms and first degree burns to the face and forehead.

An employee climbed a portable extension ladder (approximately 14 feet) to inspect and photograph a water line valve. The ladder slipped and fell, causing the employee to hit the concrete floor below. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and shoulder blade, a sprained or broken left ankle, and a nose injury.

An employee was preparing a pallet of garbage for disposal near the loading dock when the employee's right foot was caught between the pallet and a forklift, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing the tie-down straps from a slab lift clamp that was on a trailer when a forklift hit the top of the clamp on the opposite side, causing the clamp to roll off the trailer and strike the employee's left leg. His left leg broke above the ankle.
An employee was adjusting the cutting height of a 21-inch push mower when the blade lacerated and amputated two of the employee's fingers.
An employee was removing tiles from a loader when a pallet of tiles fell off a forklift and struck the employee's right knee, fracturing the kneecap. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to replace the lift gate on a 53-foot trailer. He removed two tall yellow jacks and then hit the pin in the lift gate cylinder. An employee was repairing a roof when a wind gust caught an aluminum sheet and pushed the employee off the scaffold and box truck resulting in a broken pelvis.
On May 15, 2017, an employee suffered carbon monoxide poisoning from an exhaust leak while driving.

An employee was helping to rig down a rig floor when the floor plate became hung up and slid out, striking him in the hard hat. He suffered a laceration on the right side of his forehead, requiring surgery, and fractures to his fifth and seventh vertebrae.
An employee was cutting PVC pipe with a circular saw when it kicked back and deeply lacerated the employee across the mouth and nose.
An employee tripped and fell over a dog leash while walking up residential steps.
An employee was working on a truck trailer when the trailer slipped and pinned the employee between it and the truck. The employee suffered a crushed rib.
An employee was working on a trailer resting on a wooden block when the trailer shifted off the block and fell on the employee's toe, breaking it.
An employee was using a floor-mount drill press to drill holes in aluminum plates when his left thumb and a left finger became tangled in the press, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell off a stepladder while installing a new HVAC unit, hitting the floor and suffering a head fracture.
An employee was removing a jammed pickle from a tumbler filler when it rotated and amputated the employee's left index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was preparing to weld on a small building frame and had removed the strap securing it when a gust of wind blew the frame over. The frame then struck him on the right knee and the back of his head. He suffered right leg fractures above and below the knee.
An employee was attempting to attach a chain to forklift forks when the forklift crushed his right hand.
An employee was carrying bags of garbage to put into a dumpster outside the facility when he had back spasms and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a standup forklift in the warehouse when he struck a bump post that buffers pallet racks. His left heel was caught between the post and the lift, de-gloving his heel pad. His foot was outside the driver compartment at the time of the incident.

An employee and a coworker were installing a new cable line at a house. The employee climbed a ladder to cut the old dropline loose. While descending the ladder, the employee fell approximately 5 to 10 feet and hit the concrete sidewalk with the left side of the body. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was stacking bags of beans in a railcar and was standing on them when the stack shifted and he fell to the railcar floor. He suffered a lacerated forehead and fractured right wrist, requiring overnight hospitalization.
As an employee was leaving a bathroom stall to wash her hands, her knee gave out and she fell forward. She suffered a broken bone spur in her kneecap and was hospitalized.
On May 16, 2017, an employee was driving a multi-purpose vehicle around a curve when the vehicle flipped over. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the hands and wrists.

A temporary employee and two coworkers were attempting to secure a tailgate onto a dump truck when one of them lost control and dropped the tailgate. It fell down on the employee's hand, amputating his left middle fingertip (to the cuticle) and fracturing his ring fingertip.
An employee was walking a horse around the barn. The horse spooked and hit the employee's face with its front leg causing an eye injury.
An employee was running a hydraulic press with a coworker when the press smashed the employee's left hand, amputating the ring finger.
An employee was taking a blood sample from a psychiatric patient when the patient punched the employee.
An employee was replacing a ballast when his hand contacted an energized wire, causing an electrical shock and second degree burn.
A temporary employee was operating a forklift when his arm was pinned and fractured between the lift and a wall.
An employee suffered a thumb amputation while testing a shock absorber machine when the machine dropped on his thumb.
An employee was tarring a roof on a building when he fell through an area of the roof where metal decking had been removed from the inside. He broke his left leg.
An employee was stepping out of a truck frame when he broke his left leg.

An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum angle iron with a chop saw when the saw caught the piece and pulled it out of place. The angle iron piece then cut and amputated the employee's right index finger at or above the second knuckle. The chop saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was descending 6 feet from an upper roof to a lower roof by stepping onto a stepladder and climbing down. The stepladder broke and the employee fell 5 feet onto the lower roof, injuring his back and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was shoveling sand on a roof. While stepping from one level to a lower level, the employee rolled and fractured the right ankle.

As an employee was preparing to hook up a trailer to a customer's vehicle, the customer hit the gas instead of the brake, colliding with the employee. The employee was hospitalized with back and rib injuries.
An employee was descending from a storage rack when he stepped into a wheeled cart and fell to the floor, suffering a contusion and concussion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was placing a cigarette box on a conveyor system. She was using a scanning device that was positioned on her right index finger with a power cord that connected to a unit located on her wrist. The cord and the employee's right hand were pulled between the rubber belt and idler tensioner of the conveyor. Her skin was pulled back from her hand.

An employee had just repaired an overhead door chain in an ambulance garage and was climbing down a 12-foot A-frame ladder. His left hand was resting on the chain he just repaired when a paramedic came in and activated the switch to raise the garage door. His hand was caught between the chain and sprocket to the garage motor, amputating both middle fingertips.

An employee was doing maintenance on a hydraulic tong. He was using his left index finger to remove water from the top of the tong's ring gear when the machine was activated. The tong began to rotate and pinched his left index finger, partially amputating it.

On May 16, 2017, at approximately 10:55 AM, an employee was putting protectors on the end of a pipe when it became misaligned on the table. The thread inspector was tasking the next step on the process line by actuating the mechanical control switch to prepare a pipe for inspection. The employee noticed that the pipe was rolling back towards the thread inspector and pushed the thread inspector away from the pipe. The device (or kicker) that allows pipes to roll was left in the up position, and a second pipe rolled toward the employee, whose left hand was caught between the first and second pipes. The  employee suffered an open fracture to the left ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was leaning against a guard that rotates a product conveyor when his glove became caught in a gap on the conveyor and began rotating. As he pulled his hand out of the glove, his left ring fingertip and nail were amputated.
An employee was climbing a ladder to remove a flag from the middle of a cable drop line when the ladder popped in half and he fell to the ground, breaking a leg. Proper PPE was worn at the time.
An employee was measuring and cutting metal studs using a 6-inch grinder/cutter. When he cut through the stud, the grinder kicked back at him and cut into his upper right leg.
An employee was on the loading dock when an 18-wheeler delivery truck backed up against his leg. He suffered a lower left leg contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was reaching onto a shelf when the employee lost balance and their ring was caught on the shelf resulting in a left ring finger degloving.

An employee was sitting outside on a stack of pallets. There was a 4' X 5' sheet of 1/4" thick plastic leaning against the wall. The wind caught the sheet of plastic and lifted it up into the air. The sheet then came down on the back of employee's head, causing a slight skull fracture.
On May 16, 2017, an employee was assisting a welder transition a pipe when he suffered from heat stress and required hospitalization.

An employee opened a metal grinder used to grind down plastic parts. A cord hanging nearby was caught in the pinch point, which tore off part of the wiring insulation. The cord then energized the metal grinder, which electrically shocked the employee.
An employee was operating a machine when it overheated, breaking an antifreeze line and spraying him with hot liquids. He received severe second degree burns to his shoulders, neck, and back area.
On May 17, 2017, an employee experienced a heat-related illness in the afternoon hours while delivering mail, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had installed solar roofing panels and was transitioning from the rooftop to a ladder when the employee missed the ladder step and fell approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and other injuries.

An employee was loading the resonator into the blow mold machine when the employee's shirt was caught in the machine which made him stumble and hit the actuation button for the clamps. A clamp closed on the employee's right middle finger, crushing it.

An employee was adjusting a conveyor belt's chain and sprocket when the employee's left index finger was caught by the chain and sprocket, amputating the upper left index finger. The conveyor was unguarded and was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee's finger was amputated between a gang saw's sprocket and chain.

Employees were changing weights on a work-over rig from a 12 o'clock to 6 o'clock position when one of the moving weights struck an employee in the back. He suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor line and got his right pinky finger caught in the rotating shoot, resulting in amputation.

On Wednesday, May 17, 2017, at approximately 5:00PM, an employee was attempting to change a 6-inch lawn tractor tire on a tire changing machine. His left index fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was unhitching a trailer and was putting it on a block when the trailer rolled off. The jack stand came off the block and landed on the employee's right foot, amputating his right big toe.
An employee tripped over a metal threshold and fell to the floor, suffering knee and shoulder pain and headache.
An employee's left thumb tip was amputated by a rotating belt and pulley. The belt and pulley were guarded at the time.
An employee was tightening a material guide tube on a cut-off machine when he contacted the belt and pulley, suffering a soft tissue amputation.
An employee was repairing an HVAC unit when the refrigerant leaked out and severely burned both hands.
An employee was trying to line up the back and front rollers of a jammed conveyor when his left ring finger was partially amputated between the sprocket and drive chain.
An employee was manually moving a small dumpster when it toppled over onto his leg, breaking it.

An employee was unplugging an extension cord from a wall on the fifth floor when it got caught on the door frame of the hydraulic double doors. He reached between the door frame and door to remove the cord when the hydraulics triggered to close the door catching his right middle finger between the door jamb and door. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cutting a board on a table saw when the board kicked back, causing the employee's finger to contact the rotating saw blade. The employee suffered a severe laceration through the knuckle of the fifth finger.

On May 17, 2017, at 8:30PM, an employee was standing on a platform and leaned against a railing that dislodged, causing him to fall to the ground. He fractured his left wrist and struck the back of his head.

An employee was moving pallets in a truck trailer and used his left foot to move a broken pallet stringer. The following morning, his left big toe was swollen and had blood blisters, requiring hospitalization.
On May 17, 2017, at 9:30AM, an employee was filling a bucket with hot tar when the spigot broke, allowing hot tar to splash and burn his left hand, right forearm, and face .

A temporary employee was assigned to conduct a flow test inside the jet bubbling reactor during a scheduled outage. The employee entered the reactor, stepped into the flow of air and was pushed out of the doorway and against a guardrail system outside the doorway resulting in a broken tibia and fibula and contusions.

An employee was processing parts. While lifting a parts processing basket out of a heated alkaline cleaner solution, the metal handle pulled out of the basket and the heated solution splashed onto the employee's right side. The employee suffered burns to the right-side neck, arm and upper leg.

On May 17, 2017, at approximately 10:45 a.m., an employee entered an area between the lumber deck and accumulation deck to clear sawdust. The employee's clothing became entangled around a rotating, unguarded horizontal shaft and he suffered a groin injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was opening the hood of a truck and caught a finger between the air handler and hood resulting in a laceration and hospitalization.

While operating a stand-up forklift, an employee was struck in the right ankle by another stand-up forklift operator who was turning a corner with the forks approximately 1 foot from the floor. The employee's right ankle tendons were severed, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing from one tether to another to get to a different section of a roof when he slipped and fell 10 feet to the ground, bruising his right knee and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered from heat illness and severe dehydration while performing carpentry work, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down an aisle to fill a customer order when a forklift backed up and ran over his right foot, crushing it. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was inspecting the motor of a shot blast machine when a coworker activated it. The machine amputated the employee's index finger.
An employee was moving a reel of wire when her left ring fingertip was caught and amputated between the reel she was moving and a stationary reel.
An employee was cutting ribs with a band saw when the blade amputated the employee's right index finger.

An employee was attempting to unlock barges at a job site when the employee's left middle finger was caught between the lock and the barge. The employee suffered a fracture and partial amputation to the top distal portion of the left middle finger.

An employee was about to throw water out of a 5-gallon container while leaning on a stair railing when the railing broke and gave way. The employee fell 30 feet to the ground and struck his head, losing consciousness and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bitten by a dog while delivering mail on a walking route. The employee's right palm was punctured and became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing a belt pulley on a running fan and a fan blade amputated the right ring fingertip.
An employee got a finger smashed in a door jam, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was in the stairwell, going downstairs to the conference room when the employee slipped, fell and fractured her foot.
An employee was on the roof of a high-rise preparing to clean windows when he fell five stories to the parking garage below.
An employee fainted from the heat while performing electrical work.
An employee was operating a forklift when she ran into a second stationary lift. The stationary lift's clamper entered the driver's cab and injured her right leg and hip.
An employee was struck by a motorist while flagging oncoming traffic in a work zone, suffering severe head and body trauma that required hospitalization and surgery.
On May 18, 2017, an employee was operating a mechanical power punch press and sustained a crushing injury to a finger.

On May 18, 2017, around 2:00 pm, an employee began to feel ill at the end of his shift. He had spent the morning removing a black buildup of pitch from a commercial roof and the afternoon installing new roofing material. He was hospitalized with heat-related illness.

An employee was working on top of a fire engine during the assembly process. The employee closed the back door, lost his balance, and fell to the floor, fracturing his shoulder, wrist, and clavicle and suffering a concussion.

On May 18, 2017, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee swung open a machine door to allow a pipe to roll into the machine. His left index fingertip was pinched in the door hinge and had to be amputated.

An employee was positioning a dipper arm on a mini-excavator line. His finger was in the pin hole when his coworker hammered in a pivot pin, creating a pinch point that amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was using a pressure washer when he noticed slack in his hose. He leaned over to pull the slack and lost his balance. He grabbed the wand and inadvertently engaged the trigger. The wand then ran over his right foot, causing a deep laceration.

An employee was punching holes in angle iron when the employee's left thumb was caught and partially amputated between the angle iron and the punch press. The punch was guarded at the time.
An employee's right forearm was caught and fractured in a moving conveyor belt, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a piece of electrical equipment when his wrench came in contact with an energized electrical box. An arc flash occurred, causing first and second degree burns to the employee.
An employee was cleaning out a concrete pipe using an air compressor to blow out the system. The air pressure inside of the pipe was relieved, causing the pipe to hit his chest and break his ribs.
An employee suffered a left thumb laceration while using a Skil saw.

An employee was working inside a dryer to change out a turn-flow. He was stepping on a 2-inch x 10 ft. board to hook his lanyard when the board broke and he fell 50 feet to the hard surface below, fracturing his skull and breaking his collarbone.
While cutting out a window on a construction site, an employee fell approximately 8 feet to the surface below and broke a leg.
An employee was driving a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when he lost control of the PIV and quickly dismounted it. His foot was then caught and crushed between a rack guardrail and the PIV.

After installing a wire for cable television, an employee was descending an extension ladder resting against telecommunication wires when the wires broke, causing him to fall approximately 10 feet. He fractured his left foot.

An employee was positioning a counterweight to be displayed in a renovated building. The counterweight slipped and slid down, partially amputating the employee's finger as it was caught between the flat face of the weight and the floor opening.
An employee's left thumb was pulled into a bench grinder and was partially amputated. The grinder was unguarded at the time.
An employee was stepping out of a truck when he missed the last step and fell to the ground, hitting his head.
An employee was moving a 400-600 lbs. lame sow in the barn. The sow slipped and fell on the employee's right leg crushing it below the knee.

An employee was loading an aluminum, oil-fired furnace (to make aluminum ingots) when a coworker threw a coil-covered shock into the furnace. The shock ruptured and sprayed hot oil onto the employee, resulting in third degree burns to the upper extremities.
An employee experienced heat exhaustion during the second 8 hours of a 16 hour work shift. The employee was later hospitalized.
On May 18, 2017, an employee was rolling a reel of steel when it tipped onto the employee's right foot, crushing it.
An employee was descending into a trench using a ladder when he lost his footing and fell off, hitting a pipe in the trench. He broke his ribs and clavicle.

On May 18, 2017, an employee was monitoring the flow of dough at a mixer. The employee was attempting to remove accumulated dough when the mixer's chopper mechanism partially amputated the employee's left ring finger.  The mixer was guarded at the time.
A powered industrial truck ran over and broke an employee's left foot.
On May 18, 2017, at approximately 11:05 AM, an employee was working with a valve when hot oil inside the valve caused second degree burns to his right arm and lower back.

An employee took a break from abrasive blasting and laid the abrasive blast nozzle on the ground. When he returned to the work area, he stepped on the blast control nozzle and suffered abrasions to the left thigh from the abrasive blast media.

Two employees were attempting to change the die on the press brake when their hands were caught and crushed in the press brake, amputating their fingers. The machine was active at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a pedestal-mounted band saw when it amputated his left index finger to the first knuckle.
