On Thursday, May 18, 2017, at approximately 12:30 PM, an employee tripped over an elevated concrete slab and fell, suffering a broken nose, chipped tooth, bruised ribs, fractured right arm, and right leg contusion. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

On May 18, 2017, an employee was guiding the electrical wire onto the wooden reel to ensure it went on evenly when the employee's right ring finger was crushed between the reel and the wire while it was turning resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee participated in a two-person lift of a core pole that weighs approximately 100 lbs. at a  loom machine. The employee suffered an incarcerated umbilical hernia that required surgery.
An employee was moving a manhole cover when it slipped and crushed his right middle finger. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee fell 8 to 10 feet from a boat deck while removing plastic wrap, suffering leg and hip injuries.
An employee was backing up his forklift when a second forklift operator, who was also backing up, struck him. When the two forklifts collided, his toes were crushed.

A temporary employee was using a pallet jack to unload materials at a jobsite when the pallet jack moved toward him. The pallet jack or the materials lacerated his legs, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was closing lids on the top of railcars containing grain. Wind was blowing, causing him to lose balance and fall to the ground. He suffered bruises and abrasions to his head and back and soreness in his left knee.
An employee was working on an aluminum platform when part of the platform's weld failed, causing the employee to fall 2 to 3 feet onto the wood deck of a semi-trailer. The employee dislocated a foot.

An employee was hosing down floors with water when he noticed a piece of chicken stuck in an external neck skin cutter and attempted to remove it. The cutter's moving blades then amputated his left index fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was trying to hook up a trailer to a truck hitch when his right index finger was pinched and amputated between the trailer hook and the truck hitch.
An employee was bending rebar steel with his hands and a rebar bending machine when his right pinky fingertip was pinched and amputated between the rebar.
An employee was pulling on a tarp that was on a trash truck when he slipped from the back of the truck and hit his head.
An employee's hand was crushed between a slip joint and a tubing stack that was being raised out of a well head. Two of the employee's fingers had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was offloading a mini excavator when he noticed that the trailer didn't fold back properly to its flat position. He tried to push it back down to lock it in place and was checking how much farther it need to go when the trailer came down on his left index finger and crushed his fingertip.
An employee was riding a short jack out of the dairy storage area onto the dock area and collided with an employee who was running a lift driver. The employee suffered a right leg fracture.
An employee was operating a mill machine when his hand contacted the moving parts in the point of operation, partially amputating two fingertips.

An employee was standing near the base of a material hoist when a wheeled trash cart fell from the hoist's elevated platform and struck the employee, fracturing two fingers and several bones in his left hand.

On Friday, May 19, 2017, at approximately 9:48am, an employee was driving her car on her rural delivery route when the car overheated. She parked the vehicle, got out, and attempted to raise the hood when hot antifreeze spewed out of the front grill and burned her from the waist down and on both wrists. She suffered second degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting thin plastic sheets using an office-style paper cutter when the cutter amputated his left thumb tip.
An employee was operating a forklift when it skidded on the wet floor. The employee's foot was outside of the vehicle and became caught on the wall, breaking bones.
An employee's hand slipped while changing a drill chuck, lacerating his left thumb.

An employee was holding a socket on top of a kingpin while a coworker struck the pin with a hammer. The coworker missed the pin and hit the employee's right middle finger, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized overnight and had surgery.
An employee was turning a saw horse when the saw horse's bay metal tube slipped and pinched his right index and middle fingers. His middle finger was fractured, and his index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing a threaded grease fitting from a valve. As the fitting came loose, it struck the employee's hand. Air, water, and grease also released with some pressure. The pressure or the fitting lacerated the employee's hand between the thumb and forefinger and abraded the skin between the thumb and wrist. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was cutting bone-in pork on a band saw. When he fed the product into the blade, it kicked out and rolled below the height of the guard, bringing his hand into contact with the blade and partially amputating his finger.
An employee was leaving a patient's home when the patient closed the door on the employees hand, amputating a fingertip.
An employee was directing a driver who was backing up into the dock area. The driver did not hear him say stop and backed into his hand, smashing and contusing it.
An employee was retrieving an item from her work locker when it fell over and knocked her to the floor, where she struck her head and suffered head trauma.

An employee was using a hose to transfer acid from a truck tank to a storage tank when the hose became dislodged from the tank, spraying acid compound on the employee. The employee suffered second degree burns to the chest, arms, and head.

Two employees were replacing a transformer to restore power to a residence. During the process, one of the employees came in contact with an energized line. An electrical current entered his right hand and exited his right knee, causing severe burns.

An employee was pulling water/fluid from a frac tank when he noticed a leak on a neighboring tank. He tried to stop the leak by hitting the valve with an end cap he found on the ground. When the cap hit the valve, it sparked and caused a flash fire. He suffered burns to his face, chest, and hands.
An employee was bleeding an ammonia line when ammonia came out of the valve and sprayed the employee's face. The employee inhaled ammonia refrigerant and had to be hospitalized.

An employee had just picked up a pallet of product with a forklift when he noticed the product had shifted. He stopped the forklift and climbed on the forklift to adjust the product. He lost his balance and landed on his left foot, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee stepped on a store fixture, slipped, and fell to the ground, breaking the left wrist.
An employee was unhooking bridles from the top of a bomb cart when he fell to the ground.
An employee was repairing a pusher motor when the employee's finger was caught in a metal grate.

An employee was escorting a coworker to the hospital's emergency room when the coworker pulled out a knife and stabbed the employee several times. The employee received lacerations to the head, left ear lobe, left upper back, left upper neck, left forearm, left arm and left shoulder.
An employee was taking money from a customer at the pick-up window and strained their back.
An employee was walking toward the register to relieve another cashier when she tripped and fell. She hit her side on a baggage carousel as she was falling to the ground, fracturing a rib.
An employee was driving an all terrain vehicle (ATV). He attempted to navigate a curve but was unable to control the ATV. The ATV went on its side and he fell on a rock and fractured his ribs.
An employee was walking in the cafeteria when he lost his footing and fell. He broke his left hip and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was removing train cars from a locomotive when the train wheel ran over and smashed the employee's right foot. The foot had to be amputated.
An employee was stacking wood near a dryer when he became dizzy and started to feel ill. He was overheated and needed to be hospitalized overnight.

An employee was talking to other employees who were replacing insulation panels on top of a shipping cooler when he fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor, injuring his head and fracturing his shoulder and ribs.

An employee was walking under a gizzard machine to retrieve a hose when his hand struck the machine, amputating his right middle finger above the knuckle. The machine was unguarded and not locked out at the time.

An employee had covered a leaky roof with a tarp and was stepping off the roof onto a ladder when it slipped out from under him. He fell to the ground, hitting a landing gear crank on the way. He suffered a fractured pelvis and cut on the back of his upper left leg.

An employee was driving a forklift to move pallets when he saw a box starting to fall. As he dismounted the forklift to catch the box, the forklift continued moving. His left foot was caught between the wooden pallet and the fork of the forklift, puncturing the skin and bone.

An employee was checking a leak at the bottom of a fluid bed machine. He was pushing the bowl back into the machine to prevent powder from leaking when his right ring finger was caught between the bowl and the machine, amputating his fingertip at the first knuckle. The machine was not running or powered on at the time.

An employee was inflating a skid steer tire and was putting the cap on the valve stem when the bead slipped off the rim. The escaping air caused the assembly to jump and hit the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with facial and head fractures.
An employee fell approximately 9 feet off a ladder while closing a roof hatch, fracturing an elbow.
An employee was operating a forklift (stand up-type) when the employee's foot and ankle were crushed between a column and the body of the forklift.
An employee was loading equipment in the service truck when a metal chute slipped and cut the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was operating a machine that prints logos onto fabric materials when the machine began to leak ink. As the employee was attempting to remove ink from the roller using a towel, the rollers caught the towel and pulled her hand into the machine. Her right little finger was crushed and de-gloved. Her finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was about to take an extension ladder down when he slipped and fell 6 feet off the ladder to the ground, fracturing his right knuckles.
An employee was building a gear box when the gears amputated his left middle finger.
An employee was operating a reach truck forklift when he was pinned between the forklift and a horizontal rack, fracturing his right-side ribs.
An employee lost his balance and fell over while using a urinal, cutting his head and fracturing his arm.
An employee was grating watermelons on a conveyor belt that was moving very slowly. He was attempting to make the conveyor belt move faster when it caught and amputated his right middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a forklift with a dump hopper attached to the forks. He drove the forklift to a dumpster, exited the vehicle, and activated the hopper's rotation handle to dump a load of paper into the dumpster. His left arm was caught in the moving parts of the hopper, which resulted in a compound fracture between the elbow and the shoulder. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two employees were working from a column form wall about 19 feet in height to complete rebar tie-in on the cage of the column. Both employees were descending from the column form wall when they lost their footing and fell to the concrete slab below. One employee sustained a crushed heel and broken lower leg and was hospitalized. The second employee sustained a back injury.
An employee fell 20 to 25 feet while climbing a pole and fractured his L-1 vertebra.

On 5/22/2017, at approximately 10:30, an employee was installing an auger inside the housing of a larry car. The employee rigged the auger with chain falls and come-a-longs to position it inside the housing. During the installation, the employee's left index and middle fingers were caught and partially amputated between the auger and the housing. The equipment was locked out and not powered at the time of the incident.
An employee was throwing trash into an open top rolling dumpster and fell, breaking his right hip.
An employee was helping to trip tubing out of a well hole while working on the rig floor when his index fingertip was crushed between pipe tubing and the rig elevator.

An employee was operating a melt stick former that cuts butter into sticks. She was attempting to remove a piece of paper that was stuck to the filler (blade) when the blade partially amputated her right middle finger below the nail and cut her right index finger.

An employee was walking inside the warehouse when he tripped and fell over a box that was sitting on the floor. During the fall, his head hit a wall, fracturing his neck, bumping his eye brow, and cutting his nose.
An employee cleaned a table top and turned to walk away when her feet became caught, causing her to trip and fall. She fractured her right hip.
While working on a band saw on the production floor, an employee suffered a pinch/crush injury to the right hand resulting in a hospitalization. The saw was running at the time.
An employee was opening the oil tank hatch when a spark ignited the material inside the tank. The employee sustained burns to the face, back and hands.

A temporary employee was operating a horizontal bandsaw. The employee started to adjust the in-feed rail on the saw using a wrench while the saw was running. The wrench slipped in the employee's hand and his right index finger contacted the saw blade. The employee was taken to the hospital and the index finger was amputated in the hospital the day after the incident.

An employee was clipped by a semi-truck while driving a company bus. The employee was taking photos of the damage when the semi attempted to flee the scene and struck the employee, chipping a bone in the employee's neck.

An employee was driving a company truck to a job site when he got lost and was trying to find another route. As he was trying to find his way, the truck entered the soft shoulder of the roadway. He overcorrected the vehicle and it rolled over. He suffered a concussion and a bruised clavicle and chest.

An employee was removing bumper metal from the side of a boat while working off of an electric scissor lift when he fell approximately 10 to 12 feet to the concrete and cracked his skull. He was hospitalized. The scissor lift was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was pulling a 3-inch piece of pipe out of a pile with a tractor. The employee then got off the tractor and was pulling the pipe by hand when it slipped and smashed the end of the left ring finger.
An employee's right index finger was amputated when strong winds blew a door closed on his finger.
An employee was working at a round table pulling lumber when his right arm became caught in a belt roller, crushing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a ladder approximately 7 to 8 feet from a lower level when the employee fell, fracturing ribs and suffering a head injury.
An employee was operating a cardiac monitor for a patient when a person visiting the patient sprayed a chair in the room with an unknown material. The employee then experienced respiratory distress.

On 05/23/2017, an employee attempted to fill a portable propane cylinder. The connection from the employee's tank to the customer's cylinder may have been cross-threaded. The employee was tightening the connection when the hose detached, allowing vapors to escape. The vapor cloud ignited and the employee suffered second and third degree burns to the upper torso and legs. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was doing a security round when he tripped and fell on a sidewalk, fracturing his nose and cutting his face.

An employee was operating a band saw. The employee stopped to use an air gun to blow excess metal chips from the area when his glove was caught on the running saw blade. His right hand was pulled into the saw blade, amputating his index finger.
An employee's hand slipped into a metal shear, amputating his right middle finger.
An employee was changing the ribbon on a linen press when his shirt became caught in the press machine. He twisted his body and fell to the floor, fracturing his femur and leg.
An employee was between two dollies of a dolly train when it started to move. While attempting to move out of the way, the employee tripped, fell, and hit the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was preparing coffee beverages and food items for patients in the work area when she slipped on water and fell onto the floor, fracturing her right leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a motorized overhead crane when the chuck became jammed. When he attempted to clear the jam, his left middle fingertip was pinched and amputated.
An employee had entered an excavation to remove misaligned sewer piping when the trench collapsed on the employee. The employee was bruised and required hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting an open-top tank that recirculates water when the bottom of the tank fitting popped off, spraying and burning him with hot water.
An employee was diagnosing a problem with a heat seal unit. His left forefinger was on the belt when it was pulled into the pulley, amputating it.
An employee was shoveling mulch and collapsed and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing edged weapons defense training when her right foot became lodged between two padded mats. She fell to the ground and a coworker fell on top of her, causing her right leg to twist. She broke her fibula and tibia.

An employee was riding in a utility cart. When the driver turned the cart, his foot became caught in the front wheel and he was thrown out of the cart onto the ground. He lost consciousness and fractured his leg and jaw.

An employee was working from a swing stage scaffold when the scaffold's up switch was activated, raising the scaffold and pinning him between it and the stone ledge above. He bruised his chest and lost consciousness.
An employee was changing a well pump and attaching the pump jack head when the pump jack amputated the last digit of the employee's right ring finger.
An employee was outside pulling a trash cart down a hill to the dumpster when he fell backwards and hit his head on the pavement, suffering a head contusion and a possible brain hemorrhage.
An employee fell 6 feet from the platform of a stock picker while getting an auto tire from a shelf resulting in a lower lumbar compression injury.

An employee was part of a team preparing to unload parts from a truck using a crane. The employee was removing traffic cones from the storage area on the crane when the crane operator lowered the outriggers and struck the employee's left foot, breaking five bones.
An employee was sitting in a golf cart, lost her balance and fell out fracturing her right wrist.
An employee was riding on the back of a pickup truck and slipped off the back fracturing his skull.

An employee and a coworker were conducting a lift using an overhead gantry crane. The coworker was operating the crane and lifting the load, so the employee began to leave the danger zone. As he was walking, he tripped and fell over a 4x4 spacer that was permanently set on the floor. As he was falling, his hard hat fell off and he struck his head against a rack of aluminum pipes (finished product), suffering a head laceration that required stitches.
An employee was using a saw to cut meat when his right index finger contacted the blade and was amputated to the middle digit.
An employee was loading molten sulfur into a trailer when the line clogged and the molten sulfur spilled out, burning the front right side of the employee's head.
As an employee was removing tamales from the stove, the cooking tray tilted and the hot water contacted the employee, causing second degree burns on the lower right leg.

An employee was using a lightweight miter saw to cut a 3 gauge (1/4") aluminum channel when the sawblade became stuck in the aluminum channel, causing the aluminum channel to spin in the employee's left hand, lacerating it and fracturing his left middle finger.

An employee was removing a hydraulic line from a piece on an excavator. The line was still pressurized and when the connection was broken, the line crossed his left hand, injecting hydraulic oil into the hand and causing a laceration. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder when his foot slipped and he fell back, striking his head on the ground.
An employee was on a ladder running overhead fiber optic cable and fell off the ladder fracturing the left heel.

An employee was using a lathe to machine a part when the employee's glove was caught in the lathe. The employee's hand was then pulled around the lathe, amputating the right middle finger and partially amputating the right index finger.

An employee came through the back door from the outside and when the door closed, it did not shut all the way. The employee attempted to close the door by grasping it with her left hand and pulling it shut. Her left middle fingertip was then crushed between the door and doorframe.
An employee was adjusting a coating machine's operating line using handheld tools when the machine activated. The moving rollers then broke the employee's arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in the basket of a lift removing lengths of pipe when the pipe loosened and fell unexpectedly, striking his forearm. He was hospitalized and had forearm surgery.

An employee was stabbing a valve on a stack while guiding a forklift operator who was lifting and holding the rigged valve. The strap slipped off the valve, allowing the valve to fall and strike the employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 308-pound galvanized grate. The chain slipped in the hook and the grate struck the employee's left pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was unloading a pallet from the bed of a pickup truck. The employee went to grab shrink-wrapping to pull the pallet back. The shrink-wrapping failed and the employee fell from the truck bed and landed on his head, fracturing his skull.
After loading a truck, an employee fell to the pavement while climbing off the vehicle, suffering a broken collarbone and possible concussion.
An employee received an electrical shock to his upper back while installing a powerline insulator.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut meat when the saw blade amputated the employee's right thumb tip. The saw was guarded at the time.

Waiting for his truck tire to be repaired when the vendor's air compressor exploded, causing truck damage and shrapnel to strike the employee. He suffered cracked vertebrae and lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a stairwell when she became dizzy and fell backward, striking her head. She fractured her skull and orbital bone.

A temporary employee was using a torch to cut scrap. A track-hoe with a shear was working approximately 40 feet from the employee. The shear dropped a piece of scrap to the ground, striking a 6-foot long, 3 1/2" in diameter solid shaft. The shaft went airborne and hit the employee. He was hospitalized with injuries to his left shoulder, left hip, and left leg.

An employee was delivering beer to a convenience store. He was turning a loaded cart to go up a slight ramp when some of the cases of beer fell off the cart and the cart tipped over. The cart and cases of beer struck and broke the employee's leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On May 24, 2017, at approximately 9:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to isolate a pump and needed to clean the strainer basket. After opening the system, the employee was hit with steam, suffering second degree burns and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was leaving the premises of a home when he missed a step and fell off the deck. He hit his head and broke a few ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on electrical connections from a scissor lift when an unexpected startup of a nearby suspended conveyor belt tipped the scissor lift over. The employee was injured and hospitalized. The employee suffered four broken ribs on the right side, nerve damage to the right wrist and hand because it was caught under the lift's handrail, and abrasions on the left knee and ankle.

An employee was standing on a ladder hanging up signs when the ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor. The employee fractured the right clavicle, right orbital socket, and skull.
An employee was moving metal pipes by hand when the piping moved and created a pinch point. The employee's hand was caught in the pinch point between two pipes, amputating a fingertip.
An employee had her hands on a metal drive-thru teller drawer at the same time that a nearby transformer blew, resulting in her hands being electrically shocked. She was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while stripping a floor in an office building, suffering a right hip compound fracture.
An employee was working on a gas/oven combo. When he turned on the gas burner on the 12-burner range, he received a flash burn on his face.

An employee was servicing a generator and had removed the last bolt from the armature housing when the housing came off and pinned his left arm between the housing and armature. He fractured his ulna and dislocated his radius.

An employee was getting into a footing approximately 3.5 feet deep to show a crew member how to tie the rebar. As he entered the footing, his foot slipped and fell on the rebar. He suffered a laceration/puncture wound to the base of his neck next to the clavicle.

An employee was driving a golf cart toward the golf cart parking area. The employee was driving too fast and struck the injured employee, pinning him between the wall and golf cart. The injured employee broke his left tibia and knee.

An employee was underneath a card apron attempting to remove fibers from the fan blower. He was trying to un-choke the hose inside the fan housing when his right hand made contact with the rotating blades, amputating his ring finger.
An employee received an electrical shock while installing a new powerline.
On 5/24/17, an employee was removing the bottom bracing of a wall when it began to collapse. The employee attempted to catch the wall and suffered an umbilical hernia, requiring hospitalization.

On May 24, 2017, at approximately 12:00 PM, an employee was working with metal parts when a metal sliver became lodged in his left middle finger. His hand later became severely infected and required hospitalization the following day.

An employee was near a loader truck that was picking up and transporting pieces of old road concrete when a piece of concrete fell off the loader basket and struck the employee in the head, causing a concussion.

On May 24, 2017, an employee was pushing a piece of wood into a wood shaper when his right pinky finger entered the point of operation and contacted the shaper. He sustained a soft tissue amputation of his fingertip.

An employee was standing on the floor positioning a roll of paper onto a wrapping station. A forklift came up behind the employee and lowered the roll of paper towards him when his left leg was caught between the wrapping table and the roll of paper resulting in a fractured fibula.
An employee was walking down the back of the house stairs and fell about eight steps down striking her head on the concrete wall. The employee injured her collar bone, ribs and head.
An employee was preloading a truck when a valve either failed or accidentally opened and sulfuric acid sprayed his face, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to move a rolling cart with a spiral weldment. As he was pushing the spiral and cart, the forklift entered an inclined area. The front of the cart and the spiral started drifting/rolling down the incline. He put the forklift in reverse and backed up to get in front of the spiral and cart as it was rolling and then reached out with his right hand to deflect the cart's direction of travel. His right finger middle finger was then caught and crushed between the spiral and the roll cage of the forklift.
An employee was installing an inflatable flow-through plug into a sewer pipe when the sewer pipe broke. The inflatable plug became dislodged and struck the employee's right leg, breaking it.
An employee's right middle finger was caught and amputated in a folding chair.
The employee was installing insulation. A 4' x 4' insulated metal panel slipped from the hoisting clamp, bounced and ricocheted off the building, and struck the employee's left arm fracturing it.

On 5/25/17, an employee was setting up a tote on a scale when a hose came out of the tote, which was being filled with hot deionized water. The water contacted the employee, causing first and second degree burns on the employee's back and foot.

An employee was pushing an assembly onto a conveyor when a heavy component fell from the conveyor and struck the employee's head. The employee suffered a fractured skull and neck, as well as shoulder injuries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was framing a soffit using screws and a drill when a screw became lodged in his hand, injuring his left index finger.
An employee was standing on a ladder placing a radiator on a top shelf when he fell and lost consciousness. He suffered a concussion and back pain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a fixed 12-foot ladder to the roof and fell resulting in compression fractures to both feet.
An employee was struck by a car in the parking lot.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while working on a machine.
An employee was riding an ATV, hit a rut in the dirt road and struck a tree. He was thrown from the vehicle and suffered back and right shoulder pain.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while cleaning a mixer machine. The machine was guarded and energized at the time.
An employee was trying to remove a board that was lodged in the infeed of an edger when his right ring finger made contact with the cutter-head and was amputated.
An employee tipped over an uneven portion of the sidewalk and fell to the ground, contusing her right elbow and shoulder.

An employee was breaking down a machine used to separate meat from the bones. The machine was locked out and de-energized. He placed the machine components on a cart to further disassemble them. He then picked up an outer housing off the cart known as the front flange. As he picked up the part, it slipped from his hand and his finger went into the guide bar opening. When the part landed back onto the cart, the guide bar slammed onto his finger, amputating his right index fingertip.
While installing new electrical wires from a boom lift, an employee fell to the ground, suffering bone fractures.
An employee was dismantling a one-tier scaffold and put all the boards to one side. It started to fall and as he tried to dismount the scaffold a board caught his foot and fractured the right ankle.
An employee's fingers became caught in a dough-dividing machine. The employee suffered a finger amputation and multiple finger injuries.

An employee was using a large screwdriver to clean hot plastic from the stationary cutting head of an operating repellitizer when the employee's right hand slipped and struck the cutting head blades, severing two tendons and lacerating the hand.

An employee was checking a noise under the hood of a vehicle in the belt area. A coworker started the car while the employee's hand was touching the belt. The belt and pulley then amputated his left index finger to the first joint.
An employee became dehydrated while working on a rig and doghouse, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing electrical work from the platform of a scissor lift when the scissor lift tipped over. The employee fell 20 to 25 feet to the ground and suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was using a torque wrench and socket to connect a pipe flange when the employee's fingertip was crushed and amputated between the torque wrench and the pipe.
An employee fell off the edge of a stage to the floor, fracturing the lower left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trimming a tree at a height of 30 to 40 feet when he fell to the ground, injuring his neck, back, and ribs.
An employee was cutting a metal tube with a band saw. While removing a metal shaving that came off the tube, the employee's right index finger contacted the sawblade and was amputated.
An employee was unloading merchandise when his right hand was pinched between the merchandise. He suffered a contusion and fracture.
An employee was working on a 16-inch stainless steel duct work. He was putting a coupling inside the duct and lacerated his wrist above his glove.
An employee had just exited a vehicle when it rolled and pinned him against a parked vehicle. He dislocated his hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading freight and fell off the dock resulting in a left hip fracture.

An employee was delivering steel material to a customer. As the customer offloaded the product from the employee's truck, the steel load shifted and fell, striking the employee's leg. His foot/leg were fractured and required surgery.
An employee suffered a back sprain while lifting a patient's leg onto the bed.
An employee was installing glass on the ground floor when a piece of glass fell from overhead where other workers were attempting to install from a lift. The piece impaled and lacerated the employee.
An employee was observing as a forklift was unloading his truck when the forklift dropped lumber on his leg, fracturing it.
An employee was framing on the job site when his pneumatic nail  gun shot a nail into his knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was exposed to carbon monoxide from a propane forklift inside the building.
An employee was going to sweep the floor when he tripped on his shoelaces and fell to the floor, fracturing his right leg.
On 5/26/17, at 1:00 AM, an employee tripped on a floor mat. The employee's jaw then struck a counter and was fractured.
An employee was prepping trusses on the ground when his framing nail gun shot his left leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor belt when the conveyor injured his left-hand tendons, requiring surgery.
An employee fell to the floor while pushing a machine. He suffered a femoral fracture of the right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee had been climbing trees for three days when both of his arms became rigid and tense. He was hospitalized with a muscle injury.
After dismounting a forklift, an employee slipped and fell on the steel deck of a vessel, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was loading a truck with 4x4 dunnage. When the load was lifted at one end, a 4x4 board snapped. The free end of the board struck and fractured the employee's face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a large valve onto a forklift. As the forklift lifted the valve, it tipped over and struck the employee, lacerating and puncturing the right leg.
An employee fell down a step and broke an arm while exiting a restroom.
A temporary employee was moving carts when one struck her and she fell to the ground, fracturing her left-side ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while driving a powered industrial truck, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was cleaning and removing debris from the printing press and their finger was caught in the infeed of the press when it started up for a new product run. The employee's right index finger was amputated and the middle finger was lacerated.
An employee was working from a ladder. The ladder shifted and the employee fell 11-12 feet to the ground fracturing the left femur.
An employee was on an extension ladder trying to access the roof when he slipped and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below, fracturing three vertebrae, his nose, his skull, and a wrist.
An employee fell off a portable staircase while fixing conveyor canopies, fracturing the right wrist and elbow.

An employee was attempting to remove a ring from a 96-inch pipe while standing on a rolling ladder. The ring popped out and bumped the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture his right wrist.
An employee's shoe caught on the floor, causing her to fall to the ground. She landed on and fractured her left elbow.
An employee's appendix became inflamed after being kicked by a patient, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to de-escalate a patient and shut the room door to keep the patient from entering. Her right middle finger was caught and amputated in the door.
An employee was welding outside when he experienced leg and arm cramps. He was hospitalized due to heat stress and dehydration.
An employee was assaulted while trying to prevent a patient from setting off a fire sprinkler.
An employee was closing a door and caught his left index finger between the door and the frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was taking a rolling trash cart to the building's compactor in the horizontal flat dock area when he fell about 1 foot from the dock to the lower concrete level and suffered a concussion.

An employee was sorting wooden boards on a finish line when a board weighing approximately 30 pounds fell on the employee's head. The employee suffered partial paralysis of the hands and feet and was hospitalized. The employee was wearing a hard hat at the time of the incident.
An employee stepped upon a retaining wall to throw a parcel over a fence during a delivery. When she stepped off the wall, she fell and landed on the driveway, breaking her wrist.
An employee was conducting tree trimming operations when he was struck by a tree branch that broke his collarbone.
An employee was injured when he fell approximately 20 feet from a flat commercial roof.

An employee was servicing an evaporative cooler and lubricating the bearings when his left index finger was caught and amputated between the belt and the pulley. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was working in the deli area when she tripped over a table and fell, injuring her buttock.
On May 27, 2017, an employee was a passenger in a golf cart driven by a coworker when the coworker made a turn and the cart flipped over, crushing the employee's right ankle.
An employee was making hamburger patties and amputated a middle finger in the meat grinder.
An employee was operating a moon buggy and got a foot caught between the buggy and a platform resulting in a broken foot.

An employee was standing near a pressure cooker at the end of the cooking cycle. The pressure cooker came open and the lid hit the employee in the head. Hot oil then sprayed and burned him on the face and hand.

The employee was performing a daily ride inspection when his left hand was caught in a sheave, amputating his middle and ring fingers to the first knuckle. As he used his right hand to free himself, the sheave injured his right hand.
An employee was rigging material on a crane. After releasing the rigging, the employee's pinky was smashed between a headache ball and the main block of the crane, amputating the fingertip.
An employee opened the gasoline cap to a utility trailer's generator when a flash fire occurred, causing first and second degree burns to the employee's face and hands.

An employee was unloading a truck to deliver laundry to a hospital. The tommy gate on the truck he was unloading was approximately 2 inches above the dock. He tripped over the edge of the gate and hit his head against a linen cart.

Two lift trucks were passing each other in a mobile truck aisle way. One was traveling in reverse, turned, swung wide, and struck a stack of panels, causing 8 to 10 panels to shift. The panels struck and fractured an employee's right arm.
An employee exited his vehicle in the parking lot and tripped over the precast concrete parking bumper, fracturing his right hip.
While traveling on a walkie stacker, an employee struck a coworker's forklift and suffered a left leg injury.

An employee was about to install a panel on the left wing of an aircraft when the panel started to slip. As he tried to stop it from falling, he lost his balance and fell about 8 feet, hitting part of the engine and then the ground below. He injured his lower back and ribs.
An employee tripped over a concrete jersey barrier, suffering a right knee contusion and lower back injury.
After exercising while on duty, an employee suffered arm and leg soreness due to a heat-related muscle injury. He was later hospitalized.
An employee was throwing trash into an outside dumpster when she tripped and fell, requiring hospitalization.

On May 30, 2017, an employee was diving to a depth of 82-84 feet with a team in the Gulf of Mexico. He was using an oxygen tank, got tangled in the line and the air shut off. He was found unconscious by other divers and was brought to the surface were he was resuscitated.
An employee was slicing meat with a handheld knife when the blade partially amputated his left middle finger (no bone loss). Cut-resistant gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing a fence post for a pole-mounted satellite dish. He was pouring concrete into the hole and mixing it with a shovel when his right middle finger was smashed between the shovel handle and top of the fence post. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was on a ladder working on a piece of equipment when he fell off and hit his head on the wall.
An employee was unjamming a glass container making machine and contacted the interior of the machine which is very hot. The employee suffered a severe burn to the right palm with embedded glass.
An employee was on a six-foot fiberglass step ladder and fell resulting in a fractured left ankle.
An employee was crossing a pit aisle. She did not see a forklift and walked into it, fracturing her right foot.
An employee was observing manure belts for problems when the employee's left hand was caught and crushed within the running gears that drive the belts.

An employee was waiting in front of a switch gear box when the C-phase arc came out of the box toward the fuse he was holding and knocked him unconscious. He suffered an electrical entrance wound to his left index finger and electrical exit wound to the left and right big toes. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a fairing step of a Blackhawk helicopter installing an armored wing. The employee slipped and fell 21.5 inches to the concrete hangar floor resulting in a concussion.
While sweeping the parking area of a pump island, an employee was struck by a car that had just pulled away from the gas pumps. The employee suffered a fractured ankle and required surgery.
An employee was pushing a plastic vat when his hand slipped. He then tripped over the vat while trying to stabilize himself, breaking his right ankle.
An employee was tearing up ceramic tile when a tile chip ruptured the employee's left eye globe, requiring hospitalization and stitches.

An employee and a coworker were attempting to loosen rusted bolts using a wrench and a sledgehammer. The employee was holding the wrench while the coworker struck the bolts with the sledgehammer. As the employee began to stand up, his coworker struck him with the sledgehammer, breaking his left middle finger.
An employee was loading oak blocks (90 lbs.) onto a planer when a block shifted and fell on the employee's foot.
An employee fell and hit his head while painting inside a mechanical room, suffering a potential head injury.

An employee was cutting stock on a table saw when their glove was caught in the saw pulling a finger into the blade. The left pinky finger was amputated at the second knuckle. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was on top of a three-foot step ladder to inspect a weld in a large diameter shell. The ladder slipped on the curved shell, the employee lost balance and fell resulting in a fractured right elbow and right tibia and fibula.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction while mixing an unknown chemical with water to clean surgical equipment, requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was trying to unjam a pipe that was stuck on a rack. He was using a rag to roll the pipe when it rolled back and pinned his thumb between the rack and pipe. His left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was operating a forklift. His foot was outside the tow motor when his pinky toe became caught on a walkway barrier. His pinky toe broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing a cheese mold and had her right thumb in a hole when a coworker moved the blade, amputating her right thumb tip.
An employee was offloading an appliance from the back of a truck when he fell backward on top of another appliance that was already offloaded. He broke several ribs and suffered a collapsed lung.

An employee was working on an ice machine when his left foot was caught by the raking mechanism and pulled against the frame of the machine, causing severe soft tissue damage. The ice machine was not locked out at the time.
While carrying a pan of gravy into a walk-in cooler, an employee tripped on a floor mat that was folded over and injured the left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting two chutes on a cement truck when one of the chutes slipped. The employee's right index finger was then caught and partially amputated between the two chutes.

An employee was trimming a tree from an elevated bucket at an approximate height of 50 feet when a portion of the tree that was cut fell and struck the bucket. This caused the bucket to fall to a lower position approximately 8 feet below the original work position. The employee was flipped out the bucket and fell 42 more feet to the ground, breaking bones and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was in a trench using a machine to locate the end of a pipe. A cylinder came off the machine, and the machine bucket became detached and rolled down the trench, striking the employee. The employee suffered a broken right wrist, left leg laceration and torn muscles, and a right ankle laceration.

An employee was attempting to flip a large steel assembly with a coworker. The employee stood the assembly on its end and was attempting to adjust it when it became de-stabilized and fell onto the employee, crushing the employee's shoulder and chest.
While replacing insulators inside a capacitor cabinet, an employee contacted live electrical conductors (11,000 volts). The employee suffered second and third degree burns and a fractured skull.
On May 30, 2017, at 11:45 p.m., an employee was attempting to remove a piece of scrap from under a saw blade when the blade amputated his right ring finger at the nailbed.

An employee was working on a milling machine using an overhead crane to flip a bloom bar. The bar struck the employee's legs, causing a laceration and two hairline fractures in his right ankle and left leg.

An employee was working on the ground in a scrap yard. A second employee operating a material handler released a bundle of scrap from the handler. The employee on the ground was struck by the bundle of scrap. He was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and tailbone.
After inspecting a roof area at a construction site, an employee stepped down on a ladder, slipped, and fell 20 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a fractured spleen.
An employee was hammering a punch out of a large piece of steel when a piece of metal flew up and over his safety glasses and went into his eye.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion and dehydration while walking, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a texture gun to spray ceiling texture when the spray nozzle became clogged. As the employee was attempting to unclog the spray nozzle, it injected ceiling texture into the employee's left ring and middle fingers, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting the perimeter of a condominium for termites when a large dog jumped from a condo balcony onto the employee. He sustained multiple fractures to his arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting the perimeter of a condominium when a large dog jumped onto the worker from the balcony. The employee's arm was fractured in multiple places.
An employee was caring for a cat when it bit the employee. The next day the bite became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was shaking out a mold and lowering a flask when his left hand was crushed between the flask and a pattern, amputating his left ring fingertip.

On May 30, at 11:50 am, an employee was exiting a crane. The cab of the crane was blocking the exit ladder on the right and left side, so he headed to the back of the crane and stepped on the maintenance access platform to head to the ladder when his feet became caught in rigging. He tripped and fell 5.5 feet to the ground, fracturing ribs.
An employee was performing maintenance on a crane part when a spring coil sprung and struck the employee on the thigh and lower stomach, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was servicing the elevator in the machine room and reached down to pick up a bottle. His left index and middle fingers were caught in a wire cable sheave in the elevator resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee noticed that a converting machine's airline was rubbing on a chain and sprocket. When he attempted to adjust the airline beneath the machine table, his right thumb tip was caught and amputated between the chain and sprocket. The converting machine table was unguarded at the time.
An employee was running when he tripped and fell, hitting the floor and suffering a collapsed lung.
On May 31, 2017, an employee's arm became red and swollen due to an insect bite. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a left thumb amputation while operating a spot welder.

An employee was troubleshooting a press machine. When maintenance was complete, the employee restarted the equipment. During the first cycle, the equipment had bolts inside the break. As he was troubleshooting the problem with the bolts, his coworker pushed the cycle button, which caused a rod to push through the equipment. The employee's right hand was resting between the rod and stationary machine. When the rod came through, it amputated his right index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was working near a seafood counter when she slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her femur and requiring hospitalization.

An employee contacted live wires in an electrical box while standing on a ladder and was shocked, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee broke a femur, a wrist, and vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to install an orbit valve when his right ring fingertip was caught and partially amputated between the orbit valve and a flowline flange.
An employee was operating a forklift when his left foot became trapped and displaced between the forklift and a filled intermediate bulk container.
On May 31, 2017, an employee was performing landscape work outside when around 3:45 p.m. he started showing symptoms of overheating such as vomiting. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.

An employee was working under a truck. When he removed the drive shaft, the vehicle began to roll backwards. The truck's catalytic converter then struck his chest area, injuring his ribs and clavicle. He was hospitalized.

Employees were restarting a digester after an acid cleaning. Hot liquor (300 degrees) was being introduced into the digester, but the valve to the acid tank was not closed, so hot liquor entered the acid tank and caused the lid on the fiberglass tank to blow. The hot liquid from the tank showered the injured employee, who suffered burns to the top of his head and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing electrical troubleshooting on a pump when an arc flash occurred, causing thermal burns to the employee.
An employee was using metal shears when the shear amputated his left fourth finger.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing his left wrist.
An employee was stepping out of an RV to answer a park visitor's question when she fell from the RV steps and suffered deep bruising to her pelvis and hip.
An employee was adjusting the levers on a knuckle boom when the boom came down and hit the employee's mouth and jaw, breaking it.
An employee's feet were run over and crushed by a forklift, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to fix a switch point that was gaping. His hand was between the switch point and the stock rail when the train moved away and the switch point snapped shut, catching and amputated his index and middle fingers.
An employee was cleaning the threads on a 6-inch hammer union when he lacerated his right middle finger, requiring stitches. The laceration was infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was breaking down an oil saver assembly when his left index finger was smashed between two end joints of tubing, requiring surgery.
An employee was climbing stairs when he felt a pop in his knee due to a torn tendon.
An employee slipped/tripped while carrying a tray of food and a pitcher, falling to the floor and fracturing the right hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a magnet to lift a steel plate from a table and was wiping water off of it while it was suspended when the power to the magnet shut off. The steel plate then fell on the employee's right hand, amputating the middle fingertip and lacerating the index finger.
An employee got into a physical confrontation with a coworker when the coworker struck the employee in the head with an iron rod.
A temporary employee was removing the tail from a coil on a conveyor belt when the employee's right index finger became caught and amputated between the coil and the conveyor belt.
An employee fell backward in the parking lot and hit his back on the asphalt.
An employee was climbing a stationary ladder when he fell and landed on his back.
An employee was helping to move a large, new broiler into a restaurant when he lost his footing and fell. The broiler landed on his hand amputating his index fingertip.
An employee was standing on a ladder when it slipped out, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a floor scrubber when it ran over his right leg, fracturing his fibula.
An employee was operating a core cutter when the employee's left hand contacted the fixed blade, amputating the index fingertip.
An employee was putting down adhesive for insulation when the employee fell 30 feet from the roof to the ground, requiring hospitalization. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee tripped and fell while descending a stairway, injuring the right ankle.
An employee was wiping dough off of a roller on a rotary machine when his hand and arm were pulled into the roller, fracturing and lacerating them and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over her shoes and fell, fracturing her hip.
An employee suffered a back strain while repeatedly bending and lifting products to remove them from a truck trailer.
An employee was driving a flatbed cart when his knee struck a guardrail, injuring his leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a compressor, fell backward to the floor, and broke his left arm.
An employee was placing a tarp on a trailer when he fell to the ground, dislocating his left hip, fracturing his pelvis, and suffering abrasions.
An employee was breaking out a stand of drill pipe when the pipe fell on and amputated two of his toes.

An employee was troubleshooting an air-reciprocating hand pump and checking for air leaks in the device. The pump started while his left middle finger was in the piston path. The piston then amputated his left middle fingertip. The pump was not locked/tagged out at  the time.
An employee was resting his right hand on the boiler room doorframe when the wind blew the door shut on his hand, amputating the padding of his middle finger.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, dislocating a shoulder.
An employee was trying to clear a jam at the discharge of the auger conveyor and amputated the left leg below the knee. The auger was not locked out or guarded at the time.

An employee was standing next to a banded pile of sheet metal that was sitting on the forks of a parked forklift. The shipping bands broke, allowing the sheet metal to slip off the forks and strike the employee's legs, breaking both ankles.
An employee was talking to a forklift operator when the forklift ran over and broke his foot, requiring hospitalization.

On June 1, 2017, at approximately 4:00 a.m., an employee was about to perform maintenance on an oil and gas down-hole mechanical setting tool. The employee picked up the 70 lb. setting tool to bump it on the ground and release the pressure. The tool was slippery from being covered with honey oil, and the employee's grip slipped. His right middle finger was then crushed and amputated by the setting tool.

On June 1, 2017, at approximately 4:00 PM, an employee was descending from a two-story roof onto a ladder. As the employee climbed from the roof to the ladder, the ladder slid sideways, causing the employee and ladder to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and two broken vertebrae.
While mowing the lawn on a slope, an employee lost their footing. The employee's right foot went under the lawn mower, which cut a toe.
An employee was placing grooves on a parts machine containing a cutting wheel when his right arm became entangled in the cutting wheel, amputating it below the elbow.
An employee was working at a pie machine when the machine bar came down and pinched the employee's right pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood flooring on a table saw when the blade caught the board and pulled his left hand toward the blade, amputating his middle fingertip to the knuckle. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was attempting to stop a truck from rolling backwards into another when his left hand was caught between the two vehicles, seriously lacerating his left thumb.
An employee was delivering mail when his vehicle struck a stone mailbox and shattered his right mirror. The mirror glass went into his right eye.
An employee was operating a plastic injection molding machine and attempting to retrieve a part when a flap on the machine's tool closed on and amputated her left thumb tip.
An employee was removing the cap on a temporary stand pipe when a pressure buildup inside the pipe caused the cap to fly off and hit him in the face, cutting his upper lip.

On Thursday, June 1, 2017, at approximately 6:55 AM, an employee was performing a change-over on a machine. He was holding a plate inside the machine with his left hand when the machine started and caught his left hand, partially amputating his left middle finger and lacerating his left index and ring fingers.
An employee was opening the tailgate to a dump truck when it crushed the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was in a go-kart accident and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a case floater to spread dry fertilizer on a farmer's field when he came over a hill and hit a washout. He injured his back and required hospitalization.

On June 1, 2017, an employee was spray painting in a compartment aboard a vessel when his spray gun became clogged. As he attempted to clean the tip of the spray gun, the gun discharged paint. The paint broke the skin and was injected into his left palm.

An employee was walking under the suspended boom of a pump concrete truck when concrete slid down the boom, causing it to fall and strike the employee. The employee was pinned to the ground under the weight of the concrete and boom, suffering broken ribs, a broken tibia, a lower left leg injury, and a back injury.
An employee was moving a 200-foot steel cable with a forklift when the forklift tipped over and landed on the employee's left hand, fracturing it and requiring surgery.
On Thursday, June 1, 2017, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was attacked by a patient, who grabbed her hair and pulled her to the ground. She lost consciousness and suffered a concussion.

An employee was rolling up a hose after filling a 250-gallon fuel tank when the tank stand collapsed and the tank fell on the employee. The employee fractured 14 ribs and the sternum and suffered contusions on the shoulders and upper back.
An employee was rigging with a chain hoist when the rigging and hoist lacerated and crushed the employee's left thumb, amputating it from the nail to the tip.

An employee was operating a sit-down forklift and transporting large tote bags filled with product to be incinerated. As the forklift was making a 90-degree right turn, it tipped over onto its left side and the employee fell from the driver seat and was pinned under the overhead guard. The employee suffered crushing injuries to the torso and legs including two broken femurs, eight broken ribs, two collapsed lungs, four injured vertebrae, lacerations to the liver, intestine, and vein to lower extremities. The employee's spleen was also removed.
On June 1, 2017, an employee was moving scaffolding frames when they fell on him. He was hospitalized with head lacerations, a punctured lung, and a broken rib.
An employee was working on the front flap of a dock plate when a coworker stepped on the dock plate, causing it to amputate the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when a forklift operator struck and broke his right ankle and dislocated his right toe. He was hospitalized.

An employee was looking at the orientation of a sprocket on a rotary machine when his right arm was trapped by a fixture on the machine. He suffered a cut/contusion/bruise on the inside of his arm above and below the elbow, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was picking up a cart with an overhead hoist. While he was rigging it up, a piece of the spreader bar shifted and his left ring fingertip was caught and amputated between the hook and eyelet.
An employee was removing a cat from a kennel when the cat bit the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 1, 2017, an employee was rigging an A/C unit when the unit moved, pinching and partially amputating the employee's finger between the unit and the floor.
An employee suffered a severe allergic reaction to bird seed while conducting an activity with children, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking on a makeshift pathway when she tripped and fell, fracturing her right arm.

An employee was performing an inspection in the backyard of a house when a dog ran outside of the house. The employee suffered shortness of breath and chest pain. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack.
An employee was looking for a hydraulic leak on a boom lift when the hydraulic hose burst and injected fluid into the employee's left middle finger and lacerated it, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to feed film through a jammed sealing machine when it closed on and lacerated his left middle fingertip. His fingertip had to be medically amputated. The machine was guarded and not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was unloading a window crate when a window fell and hit the employee, breaking bones.
An employee was installing a wash tray on a printing press when his rubber glove and then hand was caught in the press rolls, amputating two fingers.
An employee suffered dehydration while performing road work and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to connect a dolly to the hitch of a second dolly when his right pinky finger distal tip was pinched and amputated between the two dollies.

On June 2, 2017, an employee was installing a ceiling joist while standing on a ladder and guardrail when the guardrail failed, causing the employee to fall approximately 12 feet. The employee suffered a spleen laceration, abdominal bleeding, and an elbow fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was driving a utility tractor when he passed out and struck his head on a hatch cover lid and the inside of the tractor cab.
An employee was helping load cattle into a trailer when a cow kicked back and the employee's hand was caught between the gate and trailer frame. The employee's ring finger was severely lacerated.
An employee's left ring and pinky fingers were smashed between the top of a tank and a handrail on a gas buster tank. His left ring finger was partially amputated.
While checking an air handler in the attic above a garage, an employee fell through an opening in the attic floor and struck the concrete below, suffering severe head and shoulder injuries.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a conveyor that was locked and tagged out when a metal plate that is operated by a pneumatic cylinder closed and caught the employee's left arm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was clearing a jam from a paddle conveyor when the machine cycled and smashed his left hand. His left middle finger had to be surgically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee fell to the ground while working from a scaffold, breaking an arm and rib.

An employee was washing a tank trailer while standing on a ladder mounted to the trailer when he fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor. He suffered brain contusions and hematomas, a skull fracture, vertebrae fractures, and a right scapula fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was scraping a vessel when the employee's long-sleeve shirt was caught in the vessel's rotating spindle. The rotating spindle then broke the employee's right arm in two places.
An employee was loading product onto a die machine when it amputated three right-hand fingers.

An employee was changing out bolts and a gasket on a 1.5" acid line in the acrylonitrile unit. The line was blinded and locked out and the valve was in the open position to the bleeder. When the employee cut the bolt on the flange, trapped pressure between the bleeder and flange caused residual sulfuric acid to spray the employee, causing chemical burns to the left abdomen, left arm, and left lower back.
An employee was loading materials into a vehicle when she slipped and fell, breaking her right shoulder.

On June 2, 2017, an employee was power washing the outside of a building while standing in a man basket on a forklift when the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, suffering back injuries.
An employee was operating a boom lift. While the employee was in the boom lift basket, the basket came into contact with a steel beam, which struck the employee's head and face.
On June 2, 2017, an employee was driving and performing waste removal tasks when he experienced heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to transfer a load from a crane to a chain fall when the load shifted and partially landed on the employee's foot, breaking bones and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on railroad switches and a pressure-actuated rail greaser. He was attempting to reinstall the connecting bar for the greaser. When he picked up the bar from the middle joint, the joint straightened and amputated his left middle finger distal tip.
An employee was walking down an embankment when the employee's foot became caught and an ankle was shattered, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was painting the front section of the first floor entryway of a three-story split plan house. He attempted to access the exterior wall between the first and second floor using a 6-foot step ladder on top of a 3:12 pitched metal roof. He slipped and fell about 4 feet from the ladder onto the metal roof, fracturing his right hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing a wood utility pole from a hole when the pole slipped. The employee was then caught between the pole and an adjacent truck, suffering a collapsed lung and breaking ribs, an ulna, and a radius. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee and a coworker were working in an electrical room, pushing a ground cable through the top of the main distribution panel, when an arc flash occurred. The employee was thrown 5 feet back from the panel and required hospitalization.
An employee was rolling a 15-foot pipe on a table to coat it with oil when it rolled off the table and struck him in the right knee, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to reinstall the connecting bar for a pressure-actuated rail greaser. He was picking up the bar from the middle joint when the joint unexpectedly straightened and injured his finger.

An employee was cleaning/vacuuming a re-grinder when the employee's left middle finger came into contact with the moving scrapper/paddle and was amputated. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a bag on the floor while leaving the cash register area, falling to the floor and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was attempting to light a gas range when a gas cloud ignited, burning the employee's head, neck, and ears. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while putting items away at the head of a hospital bed, dislocating a knee.

An employee was helping a coworker roll a patient to the side to insert a harness for a lift. The employee grabbed the side rail, pushed backward, lost balance, and then felt pain in the back down to the lower left extremities. The employee was hospitalized overnight for a back sprain/strain.

An employee was working on the hull of a ship from scaffolding. When he was lowering himself down from the scaffolding, his ring was caught on the edge of a metal beam, which then amputated his finger.

An employee tripped over another employee's feet and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a hairline fracture, dislocated left knee, dislocated right shoulder, and head bruising, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping her mother move from a personal vehicle when the car began to roll back. She ran around the car to attempt to stop it, but either slipped or was struck by the car door and fell down. The tire ran over both her legs and dragged her 15 to 20 feet. She suffered a compound fracture of the left leg.

An employee was rotating a 14-inch steel casting pipe on a pipe rack roller when the employee was pinned between the rack and the pipe. The employee suffered a broken left leg and possible left middle finger amputation.
An employee was adjusting a slide seat in an excavator when his right middle finger was caught between the slide seat adjustment bar and the latch behind it, amputating his middle fingertip.
A flagger was struck by a vehicle.
An employee tripped over a power extension cord and fell while waxing the floor. The employee's head struck the floor, suffering a possible concussion and musculoskeletal trauma.

On June 3, 2017, an employee was kneeling and using a pneumatic staple gun to secure corners of a prop frame. The employee fired a staple into the wood and it kicked back, causing a second staple to eject from the gun and impale her knee. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was measuring neutral wire for a new feeder installation when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee's face and hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was shocked with 480 volts of electricity on the left index finger while trying to activate a pump in the pump house, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was returning to his station at a molten lead kettle when a coworker added a sodium hydroxide treatment too quickly to the molten lead, causing it to react and spill over onto the injured employee. He suffered second degree burns on his left foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a ramp off a trailer with a handcart of food when he lost control of the handcart. As he tried to stabilize himself, the handle struck his foot. The ramp then ripped open his shoe and lacerated his big toe.

On 6/3/2017, an employee was working in a trench to erect a retaining wall to insert a large machine. During the work process, the concrete company had to remove the trench walls so that the work crew inside the trench could apply mortar to a pre-set area where the cinder blocks were to be placed. As the concrete crew removed the walls, the side of the trench collapsed and toppled onto the injured employee. He suffered forehead lacerations and bruising and temporarily lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee lost balance while walking upstairs and fell from the top step, fracturing the right femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was erecting a pop-up canopy. The employee's left index fingertip was in a rod slot when the inner rod moved and amputated skin and muscle from the finger.
An employee was in a parking lot when a flatbed trailer struck her, knocked her down, and rolled over her legs, fracturing her right knee and left leg in three places.

An employee was removing steel plates to access a trough that contains water residue from boilers when a plate shifted, causing the employee to lose his balance. He slipped and his right foot entered the trough, causing second degree burns on his right foot and lower calf.
An employee was closing a gang box when his left middle finger was caught between the gang box, amputating the distal phalanx.
An employee was putting away clothes when she fell and injured her right hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt below a bin of coal when a bin broke loose and fell on the employee, who suffered lacerations and broken bones.

On June 4, 2017, at 5:40 p.m., an employee was unloading a patient from the back of an ambulance. While he was holding onto the door of the ambulance, lightning struck the vehicle. He suffered respiratory arrest and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was exposed to hydrochloric acid vapors while hooking up hoses to pump chemicals. The employee became dizzy and required hospitalization. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting a plastic roll with a J-knife when the blade cut and amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

On 6/4/17, at 8:55 a.m., an employee was backing up a piece of power equipment in an aisle and turning it when his ankle was crushed between the equipment and the bumper for pallet racking. He suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after an arc flash.

An employee was pushing a cart when she fell. She got up, but lost consciousness and fell back to the floor, hitting her head on the concrete. She lacerated her forehead and strained her left leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell off a step while climbing into the cab of a truck, suffering a broken hip.
On June 3, 2017, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was delivering mail when she felt dizzy and suffered an upset stomach. She was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee slipped to the ground while tearing down a carnival ride, breaking a leg.

An employee was placing frozen fruit into the freezer section and was using a two-rung step ladder. When she stepped down onto the floor, her right leg gave way and she fell to the floor, breaking her right leg.
An employee was cutting a brick form facade with a demo saw when the blade went down, hit the brick below, and kicked back toward him, lacerating his chest and chin.
An employee was bending over to cut a box open when she felt severe pain in her back. She was hospitalized with a protruding disc in her neck and multiple upper back spasms.

An employee was operating a standing reach forklift to load cargo into a rack when he reversed the forklift and drove into/under a rack. He was pinned between the forklift and the rack shelf, suffering muscular bruising.
An employee was taking out the trash using a hand truck and trash cart when his finger was caught and fractured in the trash cart.
An employee was repairing the steering linkage on a powered industrial truck when a jack gave way and the truck crushed his foot.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when the saw kicked back and pulled his hand into the blade, amputating his right thumb tip.

On June 5, 2017, an employee was pushing an empty parts cart out of the welding area when it struck a full cart. The employee's fingers were hanging over the outside lip of the cart and were caught between the two carts, amputating the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was going to pick up pieces of concrete that were cut from the building when his foot slipped and was caught between two pieces of concrete slab, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while going up a flight of stairs, suffering a lower back injury.

An employee was driving a tractor trailer when it began experiencing mechanical problems. He then opened up the engine liquid coolant cap, and hot coolant sprayed onto his right arm, causing second degree burns.

A temporary employee was operating a machine that converts large rolls of paper into narrow rolls of paper when his hand was caught in a pinch point between the shaft and the upright, amputating his left middle fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was installing an A/C unit in an apartment attic and suffered dehydration and chest pains due to the heat.
An employee fell inside a meat cooler and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking between a bagger gate and bagger snout of a bagger machine operated by a coworker when the coworker cycled the bagger machine. The mechanical bagger gate then struck and crushed the employee's left leg, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was jacking up a truck trailer while laying on the ground to replace a tire when the truck moved and pulled the trailer over the employee. The weight of the trailer crushed the employee's chest and abdomen.

An employee was working on a truck. He was going to back it out of the shop when he exited the truck to hook up something beneath it. When he hooked up the wires under the truck, the truck began rolling backwards and rolled over the employee. He was pinned under the vehicle, suffering head injuries and broken bones. The truck was running and in reverse at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a metal cutting band saw while wearing gloves. The blade of the saw caught the glove and then amputated the employee's middle fingertip.

While staging shingles on the roof of a single-story residential house, an employee slipped and fell off the roof along the front of the house. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and vertebra and was hospitalized.
