An employee was attempting to collect semen from a male pig that was in a pen when the pig fell down. The employee entered the pen to help the pig to its feet. The pig then kicked the employee, whose head struck a gate. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.

On June 5, 2017, an employee was rebuilding a bench cylinder when pressure began building in the cylinder and released. The cylinder then struck the employee in the abdomen and pushed the employee into a locker. The employee suffered internal bleeding and crushing injuries, requiring hospitalization.
While installing cable in an attic, an employee slipped on a joist and fell approximately 15 feet through the ceiling. The employee broke several ribs and punctured a lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing the bag on a screening vat when the hot water contacted the employee, causing third degree burns.

An employee was watching a load of glass being moved from a delivery truck to his company truck when the load lost its lean, became unstable, and fell. The employee tripped and fell as he attempted to jump out of the way, and a load of glass fell on and broke his leg.
An employee was using a setting tool to compress a tube when his left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading a powerline pole on the back of a digger truck when he fell approximately 4 feet off the truck platform to the ground, striking his head on the concrete.

An employee was feeding wood pieces into a press machine while a coworker was behind the press determining why the air hose was not operating properly. The employee's right hand entered the point of operation, crushing his hand and amputating two fingers.

An employee was installing flashing on a concrete deck floor to waterproof it. The employee leaned on a guardrail while attempting to reach a section of work just outside the balcony guardrails. As he leaned on the guardrail, it gave way and he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground floor, breaking his left wrist and requiring surgery.
An employee was segregating metal at the recycling shop when he cut his thumb with metal shears, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was attempting to clean a mower blade when it amputated his fingers. The mower was running at the time.
An employee was folding the mechanical lift on a bus when his left arm was caught in the lift. He injured two tendons in his left wrist and required hospitalization.

On June 5, 2017, an employee was picking up end pieces of lumber behind a 16-inch double-end trim saw and throwing them onto a conveyor that leads to a grinder when the employee's hand contacted the bottom side of the saw blade. The blade cut his pinky finger, which had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was reversing a mower when his right middle fingertip was pinched/amputated between the roll bar and a retention wire on a utility pole.

An employee shut the lid on a hopper, then backed away from the hopper on a forklift. At the same time, the employee was holding a rope that was attached to the hopper. The forklift then ran over the rope, drawing it taut around the employee's finger. The rope amputated the employee's right ring finger to the second knuckle.
An employee was struck on the head by a falling tree limb while cutting branches.
An employee and two coworkers were working on a malfunctioning vacuum pump when the pump ruptured and sprayed the employee with hot lubricant, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to move a half log with a pickaroon when the pickaroon slipped. The employee's pinky fingertip was then crushed and amputated between the wooden pickaroon handle and a log guide.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when he fell and injured his hip.
An employee was on a ladder pulling wires for a security system when the extension ladder slipped out from under him. He fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor and fractured his left arm.
An employee was using a torch to cut holes into a salvaged hydraulic cylinder when the residual hydraulic oil flashed back and burned the employee's left arm, left leg, right leg, and lower back.
An employee was preparing food and placing rice in an oven when she slipped on grease, fell to the side, and struck her head on the floor. She was hospitalized with a possible concussion.
An employee was performing maintenance on equipment while pressuring the unit up to the correct PSI. His hand was on top of the equipment when the air punctured his hand.

On June 5, 2017, at 11:50 AM, an employee was directing a tour of elementary school children and  attempting to retrieve biological samples from the Lackawanna River with a net. The employee dropped the net into the river. While attempting to retrieve the net, the employee fell down an 8-foot embankment and landed in the river, breaking three ribs and four vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing an empty roll of paper from a spiral when he strained his back.
An employee was preparing metal pallets. A ring got caught on a pallet resulting in amputation.
An employee was pulling on a V-belt for a cement auger screw when his left pinky fingertip was caught and amputated by the belt.
An employee was checking the placement of a wire in a hydraulic crimping tool when the tool was activated and partially amputated her left thumb.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her arm.

An employee was holding a pipe level as it went through a machine when he slipped, lost his balance, and let go of the pipe. He tried to straighten it, but the pipe crushed his pinky fingertip between it and the adjacent concrete wall. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking down the stairs carrying a metal door when he slipped and fell. The metal door landed on the employee's right hand, lacerating his ring finger and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a projector when he fell from his stepladder and injured his head.
An employee slipped and fell off a ladder, breaking the left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting open a metal 55-gallon drum when it exploded and struck him.
An employee was cutting 2x4's on sawhorses when the circular saw possibly kicked back and struck the employee's left ring finger, severely lacerating it and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was operating a punch press and caught his arm in the press resulting in an elbow injury.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a mower machine when a metal part fell on and broke his left pinky finger.
An employee was hospitalized for possible dehydration.
An employee was latching tubing with elevators at a rig when his left index finger was caught and smashed between the tubing collar and the handle on the elevator. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unhooking a hosed coupling when some hot oil splashed and burned the left side of his face, requiring overnight hospitalization.

At approximately 6:15 a.m., on June 6, 2017, an employee was stacking steel sub frames when his left hand was caught between two frames. As he attempted to pull his hand out, his left middle fingertip was torn off.

An employee was removing jammed frosting tubs from a line when she lost her balance and fell off the platform she was standing on. She landed on the next platform 3 feet below, suffering contusions, bruises, and a strained hip.
An employee was attaching a piece of plywood to the front of a wooden crate for a stack of marble slabs weighing between 3,500 and 4,000 pounds when the stack fell on and crushed the employee's foot.
An employee suffered overexertion, fatigue, and dizziness after performing training exercises, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing a part from a spark changer tool when her hand was caught in the tool's rotating platform, breaking three fingers and tearing skin off the back of her right hand. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a conveyor when it started unexpectedly and pinched his finger between the belt and pulley, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was standing on the platform of an electric pallet jack when he saw water/moisture on the ground floor and dismounted the equipment. His right foot was caught between the pallet jack and the wall, and he fell on the floor, fracturing his right foot.
An employee suffered a lower stomach hernia while carrying two tires.
On 6/6/17, an employee fell from a roof while performing gutter cleaning activities and was hospitalized.

While placing a tarp over a damaged skylight, an employee fell approximately 19 feet through the skylight to the concrete floor, suffering broken ribs, a bruised lung, a broken collarbone, and a skull fracture.
An employee was making bushings at a metal molding machine when the machine amputated half of her right middle finger. The machine was not guarded or locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to adjust transfer vice clamps while a hydraulic cylinder was in the process of transferring when his right pinky finger was caught between the actuator blocks and amputated to the first joint. The cylinder was unguarded at the time.
On June 6, 2017, at about 11:30 a.m., an employee was dusting on a stairway when he slipped and fell down the stairs, breaking his right foot. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was hit in the head by a paper towel cover that opened as he was trying to dry his hands.
An employee partially erected a scaffold and attempted to use it when he fell off the scaffold and broke his left wrist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a door and felt pain in his lower left side. The employee suffered a hernia.
An employee was moving a sand mixing head when his left hand was crushed between the mixing head and a building support beam. His left index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was feeding wire into a crimp cell when the employee's left hand was pulled through the crimp wheels, amputating a fingertip.
An employee was clearing a clogged paddle wheel on a transfer assembly unit when the paddle wheel rotated and amputated his right index fingertip without  bone loss.

An employee was removing the outside dual wheel on a farm tractor to get access to the inner dual tire. The employee had the rear wheel of the tractor raised up with a jack and was using a truck-mounted boom to help remove the outside wheel/tire assembly. After the employee unbolted the wheel and maneuvered it off the axel, the wheel tilted and struck the employee. The employee fractured five ribs, punctured a lung, and suffered a laceration behind the right ear.
An employee was cleaning a paint gun using MEK (methyl ethyl ketone), when the high-pressure stream of MEK was injected into his left palm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a pallet set on top of a forklift, which was then raised to reach the store's roof (10 feet above the ground), in an attempt to mitigate water leaking on the store's computers. The employee fell 10 feet off the roof to the ground, hitting the pallet on the forklift on the way down. He fractured an eye socket, his nose, and three ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a forklift when its power plug disconnected, causing the forklift to stop suddenly. The employee fell off the side onto the concrete floor and broke her hip.

An employee was taking a wheel out of the Kort nozzle on a boat. The employee was pulling out the wheel using a crane and a come-a-long when waves hit the bottom of the boat and caused the load to shift and land on him, breaking his left foot/ankle and pinching his left ring finger.
An employee was snapping a chalk line on the ground when he dropped the ball of string. He went to grab the ball and slipped on wet pavement, falling and fracturing his right leg.
An employee fell from a mobile scaffold and hit the wooden floor below, fracturing a lower vertebra.
An employee was dragging an ice cooler to her car using a metal hook and fell. The employee suffered fractures to her back and hip.

On 6/07/17, an employee was using a tunnel boring machine drill to install rock bolts in a tunnel roof when his right jacket sleeve became caught and began to twist around the drill steel, restraining and breaking his lower right arm.

An employee was removing a sheet of oriented strand board from the floor when he fell 5 feet through a floor hole to an HVAC duct below. He suffered a collapsed lung, two broken ribs, and a broken arm.
An employee was working on a de-energized electrical panel when the panel became re-energized, causing an arc flash that burned the employee's right hand.
An employee was aligning bolt holes on the turn table of a shrink wrapping machine when the turntable fell on/amputated his finger.
An employee was moving cows from one pen to another when he became caught between a cow and a post, breaking a rib, puncturing a lung, and suffering a chest contusion.

An employee was feeding boards into a sander when two boards overlapped. As he attempted to reposition them, his right middle finger became pinched between the two boards. When he pulled his finger out from between the two boards, the skin and tissue on his middle finger were removed. Part of his finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was hand digging a hole when an excavator struck his right leg. His right leg had to be amputated at the knee.
An employee was moving a large cart full of water when it fell on and fractured his pelvis (hips) and legs.

An employee was using an electrical drill to install aluminum railings on a second floor balcony when the drill became stuck in the concrete. As he tried to pull it out, he lost his balance and fell about 10 feet to the ground, fracturing his leg.
On June 7, 2017, an employee was removing a slide gate from a ladle when the gate struck him, fracturing his right shoulder and chest area.
An employee fell off a ladder and injured his back, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was manipulating the alignment bolts on a thermoformer machine when the machine's platen lowered onto his right hand, crushing it and amputating his right pinky fingertip.

An employee was standing outside the entrance of a power house when he heard a loud noise inside. The pressure relief valve of the absorber and the condensation released, spraying hot steam on the employee. He suffered burns on his back and shoulders.
An employee was using a saw to cut clay pipes when the saw kicked back and cut the left side of the employee's face.
An employee was struck by a customer's vehicle while giving hand signals to another customer who was leaving a parking spot. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee and a coworker were working on a reverse osmosis system, removing membranes from inside a metal pipe that was removed from the processing equipment. The coworker was pushing the membranes while the employee was attempting to catch them as they exited from the opposite end of the pipe. The employee's finger was then pinched and a portion was amputated between the outside surface of the membrane and the inside of a metal tube.

An employee heard an air handler making a squeaking noise. He shut the unit off and was checking the tension on the belt (motor/squirrel cage) when his left ring finger was caught between the belt and pulley, breaking it in two places.
An employee was caring for a feline patient and the feline bit the employee. The employee was hospitalized due to potential infection.

An employee was touching up paint on a fireplace located inside a new home when his extension ladder slipped out from under him. He fell approximately 18 feet to the floor, possibly breaking his leg and hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was six feet high on an extension ladder replacing siding. When he began to climb down, he lost his footing and fell to the ground, fracturing his heel.

An employee was guarding a trash chute opening as the chute was being dismantled when a contractor working overhead dropped a 2x4, which ricocheted off equipment and struck the employee's arm. The 2x4 deeply lacerated the employee's arm and fractured it, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a seamer machine when it amputated two of the employee's fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee snipped a metal band that restrains a steel coil from unwinding to remove it from the coil. The employee experienced some resistance and pulled the metal band to free it. The metal band held firm and sliced through the employee's protective glove and into his hand, lacerating it.

An employee was trying to grab a wooden component before it reached the end of a conveyor. The wooden component was positioned sideways between slats. As he grabbed the wooden component, it became lodged between slats, and his left ring fingertip was pinched and amputated between the wooden component and metal framework at the end of the conveyor.
An employee received an electrical shock while splicing wires under a reception desk.
While operating a press brake, an employee's hand entered the point of operation, amputating two fingers.

An employee was moving a large piece of welded steel (feeder hopper side) off of a sawhorse onto the floor using an overhead crane and chains. After the employee unhooked the chain, the structure fell towards the employee striking his lower right leg and fracturing the tibia/fibula.

An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when a piece of wood became jammed in the blade. As the employee attempted to remove the jam, the blade lacerated the employee's right middle, ring, and pinky fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was setting up a printing machine. He was trying to clean the printing plate with a rag when the machine's roller caught the employee's rag and pulled his right hand into the machine, amputating four fingers. The machine was not guarded or locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee used a crowbar to raise a valve part a few inches when his fingers entered a pinch point. The valve then fell apart, landing on and possibly amputating his fingertip.
On June 8, 2017, an employee was in the field working on a furnace when a flash fire occurred, causing second degree burns to his right arm and face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a pneumatic tool to cut a gas line when he received an electric shock to his hands.
An employee was clearing a jam on a cigar making machine when his left hand entered the in-going nip point of the conveyor, amputating his left index fingertip from the nail to the first digit.
An employee was cleaning a block machine when the employee's left arm became stuck in the machine and was crushed up to the elbow. The block machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

On June 8, 2017, an employee was holding one side of a manhole cover while a coworker lifted the manhole cover with a crowbar on the opposite side. The manhole cover slipped off of the crowbar hook and fell onto the employee's hand, pinching off the finger pads of his right middle and ring fingers between the manhole lid and lip. His ring fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was removing a block from an extruder vise when the employee's left ring finger was caught and crushed between the block and the vise. The finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was collecting recyclable materials to store in a salvage trailer when he tripped over pallets on the floor. He fell on the pallets and fractured his femur.
On June 8, 2017, an employee was performing road construction work and fell into a trench and broke his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a concrete slab with a gas-powered concrete saw when he lost his grip on the saw. The saw lacerated his chest and left arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee and a coworker were moving a headache rack when the coworker dropped his side. The employee's finger was then caught between the headache rack and the C channel, amputating the right ring fingertip.
An employee was moving a spiral metal sheet when the sheet deeply cut his right wrist.
An employee was reaching for parts on a press brake when the machine amputated four digits on the left hand and one digit on the right hand.

An employee was cleaning a client's residence and was struck by a folding chair that fell from a height or possibly tripped over a chair and fell. The employee suffered three fractured ribs and a lacerated spleen.
While positioning an aircraft engine part with a crane, an employee's finger was pinned between the part and a table surface.
An employee was working near a forklift that was transporting materials. The straps came undone and the material fell onto the employee's leg and fractured it.
An employee's finger was smashed by a pallet jack, partially amputating his right corner finger.

An employee was collecting a horse for horsemanship class when the horse became spooked, side-stepped, and threw the employee to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm and elbow.

An employee was troubleshooting a solid handling transfer system. He opened an observation port and was attempting to brush away some material from the machine's solid screw feeder when his left hand was caught in the feeder, partially amputating his ring and pinky fingers to the first knuckle. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to lock out a pump at an electrical box when an arc flash occurred, causing electrical burns to the employee's hands, arms, face, torso, and back.

An employee was moving a sheet metal press when one of the rollers used to move the press became loose and slid away. The press became unbalanced and fell on the employee, pinning a leg against the floor. The employee's leg had to be amputated.
An employee was operating a lathe machine to sand a brass cylinder when the employee's glove and right hand were caught in the lathe, amputating two middle fingers.
On June 8, 2017, an employee suffered a partial amputation of his left ring finger when a large shaft fell onto his hand.

An employee was attempting to use an air hose to remove debris from equipment when the equipment's conveyor caught the air hose and pulled his arm beneath a guard. His arm broke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell to the floor while getting a meal in the cafeteria, breaking an arm.

An employee was climbing a ladder to contact a contractor who was on the roof when he lost his footing and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground. He suffered an open fracture to his lower right arm and right wrist, temporary partial paralysis of both lower limbs, and L1 and L3 vertebrae fractures. He required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was testing a compressor motor by connecting an extension cord to it when a 480-volt power outlet exploded, burning the employee's hands and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's hand contacted moving parts in a gas-powered sprayer while loading equipment onto a trailer, partially amputating two fingers.
An employee was restocking boxes in a storage trailer when he became dizzy. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking behind a vehicle when it reversed and crushed the employee between it and a second vehicle. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was testing for wildland firefighter physical fitness. During the course of the examination, the employee displayed symptoms of a stroke. The employee was transported to the hospital.
An employee fell while walking on a customer's driveway, dislocating her left hip and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a slotting machine when it partially amputated his right index finger.
On 6/08/2017, at 10:40 AM, an employee was trimming trees when he was shocked, causing burns to his hand.
Two employees were cutting secondary cables in a pad-mounted electrical vault when an arc flash occurred, causing first and second degree burns.

On June 8, 2017, an employee was inspecting the nailing of roof plywood and the strapping of the rafters. While walking back to the access point, the employee slipped and fell 13 feet to the ground, fracturing his left tibia and suffering a compression fracture to his L2 vertebra. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was walking around a machine and stepping up and down to various positions to thread sheet film through the machine. He held the edge of the sheet film with one hand and stepped down to the floor from a 20-inch-high platform, resulting in tension on the film. While one of his feet was on the platform and the other foot was approaching the floor, the film in his right hand tore from the sheet. He lost his balance and fell to the floor. As he tried to break his fall, he broke his right arm and dislocated his right wrist when he hit the floor.
An employee was working at a car wash when his foot or leg was pinched in a conveyor. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was moving a drum filled with chunks of lithium. The employee hooked a drum cart to the drum and tilted it back. The drum lid blew off and struck the employee in the face and upper body.
An employee was operating a dump truck and was trying to level the load by shaking the trailer when the truck bed came down on his arm, breaking and lacerating it.
An employee tripped and fell into a refrigerator, breaking her nose and leg.
An employee was walking on top of a bridge beam when he was bumped off by a forklift. He fell 10 feet and injured his right humerus.
An employee was walking up the stairs to go into an attic when the stairs collapsed and he fell one story, suffering a head concussion.
An employee was splashed by hot plastic while changing screen filters on an extruder machine, suffering second degree burns to the forearms and face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift to empty equipment into a trailer. When he dismounted the forklift, his right heel was caught on the side of the forklift. He fell to the floor, fracturing his right hip and suffering an abrasion to his right elbow.
An employee was checking a valve on a blowout preventer when the position ram amputated his right pinky finger.

An employee was trying to remove sand that was stuck in a jammed sand equipment door. The employee was using a hammer on the door when the door slipped and caught the employee's left hand, crushing the index, middle, and ring fingers.

An employee was rigging up a crane when the employee's right pinky finger was caught in a pinch point between the outrigger cylinder and the outrigger beam, amputating it from the center knuckle and below.
An employee was moving a crane pad and amputated the right pinky finger at the first knuckle when it was caught in a pinch point between the outrigger and the cylinder.
An employee was handling a tilt wall brace when it lacerated and fractured the employee's left index finger.
An employee was changing lights when he fell through the store ceiling and hit his head on the ground.

An employee was opening the first of two plug valves on a blow-down line when a threaded nipple on the de-sander dislodged, causing the iron with the plug valves to strike him. He suffered a 2-inch laceration to the left knee, a small face laceration, a torn MCL in the right knee, and right shoulder tenderness.

An employee was on a 5-foot ladder, removing burnable material from the roof and gutters of a structure threatened by wildfire, when he fell from the ladder to the ground. He suffered an open tibia/fibula fracture to his left leg.
An employee was removing panels from an A-frame when six panels fell on the employee, who suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was using the punch press side of an iron worker machine to punch holes out of a piece of steel when his right pinky finger went under the hold-down dog area of the punch press. The press actuated and amputated his pinky fingertip.

An employee received an electric shock while troubleshooting a marinade injector machine. Moisture and water had entered the 220V plug on the side of the machine, causing an instant shock and partial right-side paralysis to the employee.
An employee was bitten by a spider while climbing a tank, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working in a trench box at an excavation site. When he exited the trench box, he sunk into mud up to his knee, suffering possible muscle trauma requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading the company vehicle and missed the bumper as he was stepping out falling on his left side. The employee suffered a broken leg and hip.
An employee was cutting billets with a propane and oxygen torch when sparks sprayed his left side. His undershirt caught on fire and he suffered second degree burns to the left side of his back.

An employee was standing on the wheel well of a sweeper vehicle. He was checking the radiator water level immediately after shutting the machine down. As he was filling the radiator with water, it began to bubble up, so he dismounted the machine. He landed oddly on the ground and fractured his left leg above the ankle.

An employee had just closed the door to a block mixer when he noticed that the door was not closed tightly. As he re-closed the door, his right pinky fingertip was crushed and amputated between the door and the mixer bin.
On June 9, 2017, an employee was trying to park a high-reach fork truck when the truck rolled and the employee's right foot was caught and broken between two pieces of equipment.

An employee was loading plastic onto the conveyor belt of a machine when the belt became stuck. He was attempting to unjam the belt when his hand was caught between the belt and the rotor, breaking his left wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading a mini-excavator onto a roll-back truck when the boom of the mini-excavator swung around, causing the machine to fall off the truck. The employee dismounted the excavator and landed on his buttocks. He tried to get out of the way, but the roll-over protection landed on his right leg, resulting in a compound fracture to his tibia and bruised lower back. He was hospitalized.

On June 9, 2017, at approximately 8:00 p.m., an employee was servicing a front-end loader. The employee was preparing to change an air filter on the front-end loader when the employee's right hand made contact with the alternator fan, amputating the index, middle, and ring fingertips. The loader was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a single trim saw to cut 2x4 boards. The machine jammed and the employee turned off the saw. She began cleaning out debris from under it when her left hand hit the still moving blade, resulting in amputation of the left pinky finger and lacerations to three other left-hand fingers.

An employee lowered the lift gate of a truck to unload materials. He was attempting to unfold the lift gate when it slammed back into place and smashed his right pinky between two pieces of steel, amputating it just below the fingernail.
An employee was assisting an electrical contractor with a bus plug when an arc flash occurred, causing second degree electrical burns to the employee's face and right hand.

An employee was inserting a plastic sleeve for some pipe to go through a granite curb stone. He was attempting to straighten the pipe when his left middle finger was caught between the pipe and the granite curb stone, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was helping a driver empty a rear-load waste container when the opening became clogged with waste. The employee was dislodging the waste when the lid frame moved and amputated the fourth distal phalange of the left hand.
An employee was filling a company vehicle with gas at a gas station when gas splashed into both of his eyes, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping two bandsaw operators while they where installing a saw blade. The employee was adjusting the tracking on the bandsaw's right wheel when the operators tightened the tension on the saw blade. The employee's left thumb tip was then caught and partially amputated between the saw blade and the wheel.
An employee was in a trailer helping to unload furniture when his foot was caught in the trailer opening. He stumbled and fell onto the floor, breaking his knee/leg.
An employee was standing in the warehouse behind an operational forklift when the forklift backed up and crushed the employee's foot.

An employee had washed a truck in a truck wash bay and was preparing to refuel the diesel exhaust fluid. He stepped into the truck to check the odometer, lost his footing, and fell backward onto the shop floor, fracturing his left forearm.
An employee was accessing fiber cable when he was bitten by a venomous snake.
An employee was trimming the top of the bead on the tire and was caught between the framework and the tire she was trimming resulting in a fractured pelvis and ankle.

An employee was using a paint gun to apply primer paint when the employee stepped back on a 2x4 and fell backwards. As the employee fell, the gun went off and injected paint into the employee's left hand.

On June 10, 2017, an employee opened a tub of liquid chlorine bleach with pliers and rinsed the pliers in a stream of what appeared to be running water, but was actually disinfectant. The employee then experienced shortness of breath and lowered oxygen saturation, requiring hospitalization.
An employee flipped over a beverage cart and broke her ankle.

On 6/10/2017, an employee was repairing a press brake cylinder. He was attempting to line up a pin to marry together the parts when his left index fingertip became caught and amputated between the parts.

An employee was tripping steel rods out when a string of the steel rods fell from their vertical position. He was running from the falling rods when his left leg was caught and injured on a cement pad and hardline.

An employee was using a chainsaw to remove trees during a fire when the fuel cap came off the chainsaw. Fuel spilled onto the employee and ignited, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's thighs and buttocks.

An employee was putting boxes away on a shelf using a ladder. On her way down the ladder, she missed a rung and fell to the floor. She broke her left elbow and a left finger, and she injured her left hip.
An employee lost his balance while working on an elevated surface that was approximately 24 inches from the ground, fell and broke his arm.
An employee was building molds in the mold shop, using a handheld circular saw to cut plywood, when his hand contacted the blade, amputating his left index fingertip to the cuticle.

An employee was packaging products into boxes on a conveyor line when the employee's hand slipped between the conveyor belt and a broken guard, de-gloving the ring finger down to the base of the nail which was then amputated.
An employee was drilling a hole to install an anchor when he received an electrical shock.
An employee was operating a milling machine when his glove was caught in the rotating bit, fracturing his left thumb.
An employee was delivering mail in a delivery vehicle when her finger was slammed and partially amputated in the vehicle door.
An employee tripped and fell over raised flower boxes on the front apron of an outside garden area, fracturing her left femoral neck.

A skid steer operator detached a spreader bar from the skid steer because the bar would not sit flat on the ground. The injured employee started to push the bar when it fell and struck his leg, breaking it.
An employee was loading a refrigerator onto a delivery truck when he lost his balance while the gate was raised and fell to the ground below, rupturing his spleen.

An employee was helping to strap and stencil loads of plywood using a strapper when he experienced severe leg and stomach cramps. He was hospitalized with severe high blood pressure due to heat stress.
An employee fell out of a golf cart-type vehicle. The employee's head struck the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a motel room and preparing it for the next customer. As she was re-dressing the bed, she backed up and slipped on the bed sheet lying on the floor. She fell and fractured her left hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving clothing items when the employee's foot was caught in a bag strap. The employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a bruised and swollen knee.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction while cutting red onions, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was repairing an 8-burner stove when a valve broke on the stove, releasing gas and igniting the pilot light. The employee suffered burns to the face and arms.
An employee was struck by a falling pipe resulting in a left radius fracture.

While replacing a roof, an employee walked by an asphalt lugger. The pipeline burst and sprayed hot asphalt on the employee, causing second degree burns on both forearms and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he missed a rung and fell 14 feet, striking a transformer box and breaking his ribs.
An employee was standing in a hanger, attending a 30-minute meeting, when she collapsed due to a lack of blood flow in her legs. She fractured three bones in her right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to remove a hook/bottom block from an under-the-hook lifting device when the crane hook latch partially amputated the employee's right thumb.

An employee was emptying a container with an automated side load truck when a bag fell out of the container. The injured employee got out of the truck to retrieve the fallen bag when he grabbed something sharp inside of the bag, amputating his right index fingertip with bone loss.

An employee was getting ready to repair a broken PVC pipe that was dripping water on the floor. He placed blankets in the area to contain the dripping water and then began climbing a ladder to the pipe when he slipped and fell off the ladder, fracturing his hip.

An employee was uncovering bins of raw product for the onion line when a forklift operator backed up and ran over the employee's right foot, crushing it and causing tissue damage. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On June 12, 2017, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was moving steel coils with a shop crane when his left ring finger was caught between a moving coil and a stationary coil, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was using an angle grinder with a cutting wheel to remove tabs that were incorrectly welded on a metal rack when the grinder hit the rack and came back across his left pinky finger, deeply lacerating it.
An employee was securing a 2x4 to the end cap of a shelving rack in the warehouse when the 2x4 slipped and partially amputated the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee was removing a shim from the eye opening of an edger when it amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was sprayed with hot water while draining a tank burning his abdomen and legs.

An employee was unloading a trailer at the dock. As the employee was unloading two wire cages from the trailer, the employee's right ring finger was pinched between the two containers resulting in a fracture, loss of the fingernail and amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk when she tripped and fell. She broke her left wrist as she tried to catch herself.

An employee was using a hydraulic clamp to clamp a part into an automated saw machine when the hydraulic clamp moved horizontally and pinched/crushed the employee's left thumb between the clamp and some metal parts, amputating the tip.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet while changing the roof on a shed, hitting the concrete below and breaking the jaw/cheekbone.
An employee was welding on a mud pump when an explosion occurred. A pipe cap blew off and hit his stomach, injuring his spleen.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking on a loading dock, fracturing the right foot.

An employee was working off an 8-foot step ladder, standing on the sixth step. As he started to descend the ladder, the ladder shifted and he lost his balance and fell to the floor. He landed on his left wrist, causing a severe fracture. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was removing a piece of metal from a roll-off trash container when he lost his balance and fell 4 feet off the container, landing on and breaking his hip.

An employee was operating a cant sorter when the block belt became jammed by a small block of wood that had been trimmed off a cant. The employee was attempting to free up the jammed material when it broke free. The conveyor then pulled the employee's right arm underneath the conveyor belt and roller, breaking it. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was climbing down a step ladder when he missed a step. He tried to grab onto a ceiling tile on the drop ceiling, but it could not hold his weight and he fell to the ground, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trimming a tree using a pole-saw while inside an aerial lift when the pole-saw contacted an electrical powerline. The employee was electrically shocked and fell 15 feet to the ground, suffering electrical burns, a fractured back, and a collapsed lung.
An employee stepped off a sidewalk curb, tripped, and fell to the concrete, injuring her wrist.
An employee was re-webbing a machine when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught and partially amputated between two rollers inside the machine.

An employee climbed a ladder onto an unguarded level below the work level when he became dizzy and blacked out from dehydration and fatigue. He fell about 6 feet onto the concrete below, suffering head injuries, a fractured clavicle, and broken ribs.
An employee was stepping down from a ladder when she fell and struck her head on the floor, lacerating it.
An employee slipped and fell in an area that was being cleaned, suffering a right ankle injury.
An employee tripped over tire chock while walking with a ladder, breaking the left femur.

On 6/11/17, at approximately 5:45 a.m., employee was operating a ride-on order picker in the mezzanine when he struck a pole. His left foot/lower leg was crushed and possibly fractured between the pole and the machine.
An employee was machining material on a 54-inch vertical turret lathe when his left arm became caught between the table and the machine. He suffered left arm lacerations and fractures.

An employee was using an overhead double-hoist, 20-ton crane to load a trailer when the material slipped from the chain, landed on the trailer, and spilled to the ground, knocking the employee to the ground and causing him to fracture his left hip.
An employee was attempting to repair an existing clay sewer pipe. He was cutting the pipe with a saw when it kicked back at him, cutting him from the chest to the chin.

An employee was acting as a spotter for a truck driver. They lost sight of each other, and the employee's arm was pinned between a pole and the truck back gate. He received a laceration on his left arm and hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell to the ground while carrying 30 lbs. of potato waste and broke a forearm.
An employee was hiking to fight a forest fire when he developed muscle cramps, dizziness, and weakness due to the extreme heat.

An employee was helping an excavator set a 16-foot steel post. The rigging was removed before the post had been bolted in place. The steel post then fell and struck the employee, who suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a radiator cap from a tug after it started to overheat when steam released and burned the employee's left arm.

The employee was cleaning a draft beer line with a draft beer line cleaning solution (Micro Matic Beer Line Cleaner [SDS #BDP-003])
. The pressure from the hose caused the chemical to spray out onto the employee's face. The employee sustained a chemical burn to both eyes on his face.

An employee was delivering mail and packages weighing up to 40 lbs. on a route that involved walking and driving when he began to feel the effects of heat stress. The employee was hospitalized for a cardiac event and heat-related illness.

An employee was disassembling a boom truck. During the process, the boom truck moved and the last bolt securing the crane assembly to the boom truck broke causing the entire crane assembly to move. The employee was caught between the outrigger of the crane assembly and the truck fuel tank resulting in a right leg laceration.

An employee was installing a bridging angle to a bar joist while wearing fall protection. He was welding it when he fell 30 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured skull, collapsed lung, and three broken ribs.
An employee was stocking product at a store when the employee's finger was caught and partially amputated between two packs of product.

An employee was pressing a pair of pants. As she leaned over to adjust an air vent, her body pressed the actuator button, causing the hot press to come down on her hand. She suffered a third degree burn and was hospitalized.
An employee's right leg was caught between a dolly and a K loader, lacerating and fracturing it.

An employee was unloading a trailer. He did not lower the dock plate because there was a drum too close to the end of the trailer. While stepping from the dock to the trailer to move the drum, the employee fell between the trailer and dock. The drum then rolled onto his leg and crushed it between the dock and trailer. His leg broke and required surgery.

An employee was replacing an empty propane tank on a propane floor buffer. While placing the empty tank in the propane cage, the employee fell to the concrete working surface, injuring the left side of his body and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was climbing an 8-foot ladder at the gallon milk filling machine to take a quality sample when the ladder shifted. The employee fell and her leg was caught between two rungs of the ladder, causing her to swing downward and hit her head on the floor. She suffered a head contusion, a laceration above the right eye, right wrist and elbow contusions, a broken ankle, and a broken toe on the left foot.
An employee slipped and fell in the hallway, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was using a 3-foot pry bar to lift a 3/8-inch piece of sheet of metal to remove the 3/4-inch wooden support blocks from underneath. The 3-foot pry bar slipped while the employee was removing the 3/4-inch wooden block, allowing the sheet metal to drop onto and amputate the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee fell from the tire of a front-end loader while performing maintenance on the vehicle, injuring his back and head.
An employee was on top of a machine, attempting to unjam it. He slipped while climbing down and fell 3 to 4 feet to the floor, injuring his left hip and left elbow.
An employee was climbing an 11-step stairway when he felt cramps in his arms and legs due to heat stress. He was hospitalized.
An employee was talking to a client when the client closed a door on the employee's right hand, breaking/dislocating fingers.

An employee was showing a coworker how to flip an empty spool (3ft by 1ft). The spool was on the tip of his steel-toe boot when it slipped off and fell on his right hand, lacerating it and breaking his right middle finger.

An employee was using a pry bar to move a grapple cylinder from a truck bed to a draining container when his left hand was caught between the truck bed and the draining container, amputating his pinky finger.
An employee was bending a piece of channel with a bender machine when it amputated his right ring finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was closing a bank vault door when the door closed on an amputated half of the employee's left thumb.
An employee tripped on a fatigue mat and fell, breaking her left hip.
An employee was using a band saw to cut metal parts and severed the tip of his left middle finger. There was no bone loss.
An employee was placing a section of masonry into a trash cart when the masonry fell on and amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.

An employee was unloading materials from a trailer. He leaned a table against the wall of the trailer. The table then shifted and fell, striking him in the head and injuring his neck. He was hospitalized.

An employee went to cross over a baggage belt when the belt started to move, causing him to lose his balance. He fell and his foot was caught between the drive motor and pulley guard, fracturing his right ankle.
An employee was cutting lumber on a table saw when the blade lacerated his left index finger. The table saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was walking to each collection location helping to empty recycling and garbage on truck. A woman offered the employee a cold bottle of water. He said sure and she went into a house and brought out a bottle of liquid which the employee drank. He took a sip and immediately started vomiting. The "water" turned out to be a diluted mix of bleach and detergent. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting a rotary feeder when his hand contacted the moving blender, amputating his thumb tip and his index, middle, and ring fingertips.

An employee was putting PVC pipe together while on a ladder while a coworker held the bottom of the ladder. The coworker let go of the ladder and stepped around the corner to check if the placement of the PVC was correct. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to a cement pad below, breaking a bone above the ankle.

An employee was moving a scissor lift downgrade in a parking structure. He was in the lift in the fully lowered position when he struck an overhead concrete beam with his upper body. He was pinned between the beam and the guardrail of the lift, suffering a fractured jaw and left sinus as well as chest contusions.
An employee was trying to dislodge a jam on the chipper machine when the employee's right hand contacted the blade, amputating a finger. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was picking up a stone slab to move it onto a cutting table when the slab fell and struck the employee's leg, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a sleeve machine when he stepped into a pinch point. He then fell backwards into a pallet of sleeves and injured his left foot.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a docking mechanism when it dropped. The employee fractured the left ring finger and suffered tendon damage when he tried to catch it.
An employee was struck by an automobile while setting up a work zone, suffering multiple broken ribs, a broken pelvis, several broken vertebrae, and multiple internal injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a crate of marble from a delivery truck. The truck gate fell off during the unloading and the employee fell 4 feet off the truck, fracturing the right pelvis, right elbow, and right ribs.
An employee lost balance and fell into a folding chair. The chair collapsed under the weight and pinched the employee's right pinky finger between the hinge, amputating it.
An employee was operating a trencher near a trench when the ground gave way. The trencher and the employee rolled down into the trench. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a chest laceration.
An employee was hanging privacy drapes in a resident room and was on a two-step ladder. She was descending the ladder when she missed a step and fell to the floor, breaking her right leg.

On June 13, 2017, an employee was performing preventive maintenance on an HVAC unit. The employee had loosened the screws from the access panel cover to the air handler and began to wiggle the panel in an attempt to lift it. The cover gave way and struck the employee's left arm, severely lacerating it.
On June 13, 2017, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was cleaning the belt on a machine when his left little finger was caught in the belt, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was hand scrubbing a stainless steel hinged folding product chute when the chute closed on the employee's left pinky finger, fracturing it and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working aboard a ship when he experienced nausea, cramping, and vomiting. He was hospitalized overnight for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was using an overhead crane, attempting to lift a weight off a mold, when the hook became caught as he was pushing the up button on the crane. The hook then snapped free and struck the employee's face, crushing it. He was hospitalized.

On 6/14/2017, at approximately 1500, an employee was riding in the rear of a line striping truck that had just completed striping a freeway entrance ramp and was travelling down the freeway to turn around in the median. While the striping truck was slowing down to turn around, it was struck from behind by an approaching truck. The employee in the rear of the truck suffered a fractured leg and thumb and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was picking up a 3 foot x 3 foot pallet to stack it on another pallet during a delivery when he suffered an acute lumbar sprain.
An employee's hand was on a chain that guides doors through a double pass trim saw when the chain moved and amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was using a stand-on commercial mower when the left rear mower wheel went off a curb, causing him to lose his balance and place his left foot on the ground while gripping the speed control handle harder. The mower then ran over his left foot, amputating three toes.
An employee had just put trash into the compactor and stumbled on an uneven floor surface causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered right-side injuries to the hip, shoulder and elbow.
An employee was performing a roll change when the employee's finger was pinched between the roll and a brake bar, avulsing the skin and crushing the fingertip.
An employee was carrying a bin of hot oil when she lost her grip and dropped the bin, which splashed hot oil on her face, neck, and shoulder, causing burns.
An employee's left hand was crushed in a pinch point while trying to oil an excavator. The injury required surgery.

On June 14, 2017, an employee was oiling the thumb of an excavator when the employee's hand became trapped between the excavator's bucket and thumb. The employee suffered left hand fractures and lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a tube bender when his right hand was caught in the point of operation. He was hospitalized with a fracture and possible amputation to his right index finger.
An employee missed the last step while getting out of the cab of a truck and fell to the ground, tearing the right quadriceps.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. While he was negotiating a turn, his left hand was crushed against a pallet on a rack, crushing and lacerating his left hand with tendon damage. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was attempting to remove sheets of cardboard from a feed conveyor when he suffered acute lower back pain, requiring overnight hospitalization.

On June 14, 2017, an employee was loading cardboard boxes onto a trailer when the employee became pinned between the load of boxes and the handles of a manual pallet jack. The employee suffered a cracked rib and bruised lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing decking on a roof when he attempted to cross over to the roof of an adjacent building. He fell approximately 30 feet to the ground between the two buildings, puncturing his lung, cracking two ribs, and shattering a pelvis. He was hospitalized.
An employee was sweeping outside the store past the gas pumps. When the employee stepped off the concrete and into sand, the employee fell and fractured the right ankle on both sides.
An employee was using an automated post-form beam saw when it amputated the employee's right thumb and right index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a meat slicer when the blade amputated his right thumb tip (no bone loss).

An employee was troubleshooting the air conditioning unit for an electrical panel and removed the filter screen to verify operation of the compressor inside the unit. He contacted a fan blade that was located above the compressor resulting in minor cuts to two fingers. Stiches were not required. While receiving first aid treatment, the employee fainted and hit their face on the concrete floor sustaining cuts to the face, broken teeth, and a fractured jaw.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal with an electric grinder when it buckled, pinched, and the grinder kicked back, striking the top of his hand by his knuckles.

An employee was milling rubber and while lifting the rubber from the pan, his glove became stuck and his arm contacted the hot rubber at 300  F. The employee suffered third degree burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was terminating an electrical panel. At the same time, a coworker located in a different part of the job site turned on a different panel that was wired incorrectly and energized the panel being terminated, causing a second degree burn to the employee's hand.
An employee was positioning himself to service a machine when his left pinky finger entered a drive sprocket, amputating his fingertip.
On June 14, 2017, an employee was stabbed by a patient wielding a knife, suffering lacerations to the arm, face, and neck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell and fractured the right ankle and left tibia, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a ladder approximately 3 feet in the air painting a doorframe when the extension slipped out and he fell, breaking his ankle.

An employee was working in a stairwell to conduct drywall finishing. The employee placed one end of a plank on the landing and the other end in the rung of an extension ladder and climbed onto the plank. The employee then fell 16 feet to the ground, fracturing the left heel and lumbar spine.

An employee had just climbed up part of an extension ladder approximately 12 feet high when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his nose and wrist and suffering a concussion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading boxes on a conveyor and attempting to remove tape from a carton when the tape became wound around the conveyor roller. When the employee attempted to free the tape, the employee's right hand became entangled and scratched in the conveyor, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove a mirror from an apartment ceiling when the mirror fell on him and cut his arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee walked onto a residential house porch to deliver mail. As the employee was coming down from the steps, the employee stepped on a stone embedded into the cement causing the employee to slip and fall landing on the left knee, causing an open wound.

An employee was tearing up drywall from a scissor lift when he tried to move the scissor lift closer to the wall. His left hand was on the scissor lift's guardrail when his left pinky was caught between the scissor lift's guardrail and the guardrail housing, amputating his pinky's first joint.
An employee became dehydrated while digging a trench, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting the blower above a roll-up door while standing in a scissor lift (15 feet high) when a bridge crane struck the scissor lift, knocking it over into a storage rack. The employee fell onto the storage rack and suffered a fingertip avulsion, bruised ribs, and lacerations.
An employee was stocking inventory in the store when she stumbled and fell, suffering multiple fractures to her leg.

An employee was emptying a ribbon mixer and attempting to grab a piece of meat when the ribbon mixer caught the employee's fingers, amputating three fingers at the first knuckle. The mixer was guarded at the time.
While loading a cart with debris and supplies during deck removal work, an employee fell about 20 feet to the ground, suffering a broken hip and wrist as well as a possible orbital fracture.

An employee was lifting and stacking cartons in a non-climate controlled warehouse. The employee felt a strain in a back muscle, and shortly thereafter experienced pain to the degree that he could not continue work. He was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee was taking a measurement from a rolling chair when she fell to the floor and injured her back.
While exiting a loader, an employee fell approximately 2 feet to a lower level and broke the left wrist, requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning the deli floors with a water hose when she slipped and fell, breaking her left hip.

An employee was cutting 3/4-inch strips of wood with a table saw when a piece of scrap wood became stuck between the guard and the saw blade. As the employee attempted to remove it, the left index fingertip contacted the blade and was partially amputated.

An employee was using a chop saw when he became dizzy. His left hand was resting on the wood cutting area when the saw was activated via the foot pedal. The saw came down, amputated his left pinky finger, and severely lacerated his left hand.
An employee was descending a ladder with a roll of paper towels when the employee missed a rung and fell to the ground, fracturing the left wrist and left leg.
An employee walked up two steps, lost her balance, and fell backwards, hitting her head on concrete. She suffered head trauma and was hospitalized.

A forklift operator attached a chain around a skid, but the tension was too tight in the chain. The injured employee was checking on the tension when the forklift operator got off the forklift, allowing it to roll forward. The employee's hand was then caught between the skid and chain, amputating the right index finger.
An employee tripped over a patient's walker and fell, fracturing the right femur.
An employee was tightening a belt on an HVAC system when the employee's fingers were caught in a pulley, amputating the right middle fingertip and ring finger above the second knuckle.
An employee was cleaning out a grass chute on a mower when the mower blades amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was using a machine to cut brushes when the employee's right hand slipped and came into contact with the cutting head, amputating the right thumb tip.
An employee was removing film from packaging equipment and amputated the upper portion of the left thumb in the jaws of the equipment.
An employee was manually turning the belts on a faulty cracking mill when it suddenly turned on and amputated one of his fingertips. The mill machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was repositioning a crane when the boom swung free and crushed the employee's left hand between it and the rack pin, amputating a fingertip.
An employee was welding a 10-inch pipe when the jack stand that was supporting the pipe sank into the ground, causing the pipe to strike and break the employee's left femur.
An employee was spraying penetrating oil under a truck when the oil entered his mouth. He suffered chemical burns to his mouth and lungs, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were in a trench attempting to cap off an underground water line. Part of the side of the trench came loose and pushed one employee against the side of the trench. The other employee was stuck in the mud up to his waist. One of the employees was hospitalized and had surgery for broken ribs and a lacerated small intestine.
An employee was stepping off a mower when it ran over his left foot and cut it.
An employee was using a table saw to cut acrylic glass when the glass kicked back and cut an artery in his forearm. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was removing fork extensions from a forklift when a fork fell on his right foot. He was hospitalized and had his right middle toe amputated.
An employee was standing on a scaffold plank along the side of a modular home when the employee fell nearly 7 feet to the ground, suffering a back injury and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was gathering work materials and was struck by a forklift that was backing up resulting in injury to both legs.
On June 15, 2017, at approximately 12:00 p.m., a temporary employee suffered a partial left index fingertip amputation while clearing a jammed part on the cutter section of an extrusion line.
An employee closed a security gate on an employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was cleaning a butter machine when it cycled and amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was de-burring an 8-inch x 2-inch piece of steel with a mounted disc grinder when the grinder amputated his right pinky fingertip.
An employee was working at her desk while construction was occurring in the basement parking garage. She was exposed to carbon monoxide and had to be hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam on a machine when a coworker re-activated it, causing stored air to cycle the machine parts, which pinched and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

On June 16, 2017, at 1:30 p.m., an employee was performing auxiliary cleanup work between pour runs when he fell 6 feet off a reclaimer, hit a pipe, and then landed on the concrete slab. He suffered a head laceration, concussion with minor loss of consciousness, broken ribs, and a punctured lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was reaching over piping when he lost his footing and fell over the piping. While falling, he used his left hand to break his fall. His hand was then caught and fractured between two pipes.
An employee was using a handheld saw to cut a stone countertop when the saw lacerated the employee's right index and middle fingers.

An employee was manually guiding metal blanks (weighing 22 pounds each) from a conveyor to a skid supported by a power pallet jack when the skid broke. The metal blanks then slid off the skid and struck the employee's lower right leg, fracturing it.

On June 16, 2017, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was working in the clinical laboratory when a post-graduation tour came through. She had an intense allergic reaction to a tourist's perfume and was hospitalized.
An employee was grinding concrete while on an extension ladder when the ladder slid out. The employee fell and landed on the ladder, breaking his right ankle.
An employee was working on engine mounts when the jack slipped and the engine fell on the employee's left hand, amputating the pinky fingertip.

An employee was spray painting while standing on top of an approximately 8 foot x 15 foot rectangular tank that was approximately 7 feet tall. There were five 2 foot x 3 foot holes cut out of the top surface of the tank that were not covered. The employee fell into one of these holes and suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was rolling pipe when he became fatigued due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was rolling up wire while cleaning a site when he was bitten by a spider on his leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee drove a truck to a customer location and was in the back of the truck loading crates of milk onto a wheeled hand cart. While pushing the cart, the employee slipped on a milk/ice cream mix that had spilled onto the floor of the truck. The employee fell forward in the truck with his hands in front of him trying to break his fall. The hand cart rocked back and landed on his right hand, amputating his middle fingertip.
On June 16, 2017, at 4:15 p.m., an employee was calibrating the burners on a furnace when the employee passed out due to possible heat stress/exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sitting in the back of a pickup truck, which had the tailgate down, when the truck moved. The employee then fell about 3 feet to the concrete ground, hitting the back of her head. She suffered bruising and two head fractures.
An employee was walking from one section of the facility to another when he became dizzy and fell to the sidewalk, fracturing both arms.
An employee suffered from heat stress.
An employee was searching through a vertical rack of wrapped tempered glass when he lost his footing and fell backwards. The glass fell on top of him, breaking his right leg.

An employee was expanding tubing using a 3/8-inch tubing expanding machine when a bearing bullet broke off in the tube. Pressurized air caused the broken bullet piece to eject and strike the employee's right hand, breaking his index finger.
While walking in the warehouse, an employee tripped and fell over a divider, causing him to displace his hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was wiping grease from a drive chain on a machine when the chain pulled his right index finger into the drive's pulley, amputating it. The machine was guarded and operating at the time of the incident.
An employee entered an area with a conveyor when a robot sensor activated and pinned the employee between the robot and conveyor, breaking six ribs. The area was guarded at the time.
An employee was at the back of a truck loading a small gas cylinder when he fell out of the truck and cracked his hip.
On June 16, 2017, an employee was preparing to replace a drill bit on a multi-spindle drill press when his left ring finger contacted the point of operation and was amputated.
An employee was pushing a piece of wood through the blade of a table saw without the use of a push stick thereby resulting in the amputation of the tip of his left thumb without bone loss.
An employee was picking up trash outside when she tripped and fell while going down the steps, injuring her hip.

An employee was carrying a mirror into an apartment building through an interior staircase. As the employee was entering the doorway, the mirror inadvertently hit the doorframe. This caused the mirror to break. A portion of the mirror fell and lacerated the employee's left forearm, severing arteries and cutting two nerves.
An employee was working on a drill rig when the hydraulic jaw crushed both of the employee's hands, amputating the right index finger.
An employee was delivering a package and sustained lacerations when he was bitten on the forearm by a dog.

On June 16, 2017, at approximately 10:50 p.m., an employee operating a terminal tractor was preparing to hook up airlines to a trailer. He exited the back door and stepped onto a catwalk made of metal grating when he lost his balance and fell between the catwalk and fuel tank. He fractured his left shoulder and was hospitalized.

On 6/16/2017, at approximately 1100, an employee was pushing a rack up a ramp when a forklift carrying a bin came up behind him. The forklift operator attempted to pass the employee and the side of the bin struck the employee, fracturing his ankle/leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unpinning a stand pipe to reposition it when his knee was trapped between the stand pipe and a substructure, causing soft tissue damage.

An employee was operating a self propelled modular transport trailer that had a load and was walking backward when he was caught between the edge of a jersey barrier and the power pack of the trailer. His right leg was crushed below the knee and had to be surgically amputated.
On June 16, 2017, an employee was performing a soil evaluation at a remote work site when he suffered from heat exhaustion and required hospitalization.

An employee was landing a pallet jack that was elevated by a tower crane. As the crane lowered the load into a courtyard where the employee was located, the load struck something and started to swing. The employee's right hand was caught between the swinging load and the aluminum joists, crushing and amputating the ring finger.
An employee was helping to remove a mast from a sailboat when the mast separated and three of his fingers were caught and amputated between the mast and another part of the boat.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on an amusement park ride vehicle. Brake cleaner had been sprayed to loosen parts. He was using a battery powered impact wrench to remove a bumper when a flash fire occurred, causing second and third degree burns to his arm.

An employee was on a ladder performing overhead door maintenance on a torsion bar/spring when the door became unstable. The employee then fell from the ladder to the concrete ground, fracturing the right femur.

An employee was reversing a truck down a road after offloading cargo when the truck wheels fell off into a ditch, causing the truck to overturn. The employee suffered two broken ribs, a broken shoulder blade, and a bruised lung.
On 6/17/2017, an employee was installing vinyl siding from a ladder when he felt dizzy and fainted. He fell approximately 10 feet from the ladder, breaking several ribs and his spine.
An employee was shot on the right calf by a patient in custody who had taken a police officer's gun after he was treated in the emergency room. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a bed and fractured her hip.

An employee was welding and constructing a steel cage from six 1,400-pound steel plates. He was guiding a steel plate from a forklift into position when the chains holding the steel plate slipped off the forklift forks and the 5' x 5' steel plate broke his right leg.
An employee was walking to a container berth dock when he was struck from behind by a jockey truck. He suffered a separated right leg calf muscle, requiring hospitalization.
While starting a press, an employee contacted the blade, suffering a laceration that required surgery.
An employee was replacing a magnet on a faulty pump when his left middle fingertip was pinched and lacerated between the magnet and the pump. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was helping to move blasting pots when a pot fell on the employee's left hand, amputating fingertips.
An employee was picking tomatoes when a snake bit her right hand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was reaching to remove product from the top shelf of a dairy cooler that was malfunctioning. She was stepping onto the front ledge of the cooler for a better reach when she fell approximately 1.5 feet, hitting her head on the ledge or the floor.
An employee was cleaning the farrowing building when she was bitten by a rattlesnake on the left pointer finger while picking up a bag of afterbirth.
An employee slipped on a workplace floor and fractured her pelvis.

An employee was using vise grips while changing out components and wiring to an elevator when the vise grips failed, allowing the components to fall and catch the employee's left thumb between the cable and a sheave. The employee's left thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning an assembly line and attempting to remove a piece of meat from a running conveyor belt when his left hand was caught between the chain and sprocket on the belt. He suffered several lacerations to his left hand and wrist. The conveyor was not locked out at the time.
An employee was exposed to hydrochloric acid vapors while operating a blender.

An employee was descending a fixed caged ladder when he missed the top rung and began to fall. He grabbed onto a vertical member of the cage assembly to catch himself and caught his right pinky in a 1/2-inch gap between the upright and a toe board section. His right pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving square tubing and cutting the banding around the tubes. When he cut the last piece of banding, the metal tubing shifted and fell over onto his right leg/ankle, breaking it.
An employee was working on a pump when the brake was released and the plunger smashed his left wrist and first knuckles.
An employee was working at the restaurant when an assailant entered the establishment and struck her in the face, breaking her jaw.
An employee was unloading a cart of laundry from a truck down a ramp when he slipped and fell between the truck and the building. The cart fell on top of him, and he suffered lower leg contusions.
An employee was struck by a dock lift while stepping off a long jack, injuring the left leg.

An employee was helping to pick up lumber from an overturned 18-wheeler on the interstate. The employee was standing on a bundle of lumber when the load shifted and catapulted the employee 4 to 6 feet in the air. He landed on and injured his neck.

An employee was using a 2-foot step stool to reach a gate key pad that was malfunctioning to repair it when he fell off the step stool and sustained a left wrist fracture. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was hit by a beam while walking between a saw and a roller cable at a jobsite. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was working with an acetylene torch when the hose blew off the torch and struck the employee in the groin.
While standing on an extension ladder to reach a light diffuser, an employee lost balance and fell to the ground, fracturing ribs.

At 2:00 p.m., on June 19, 2017, an employee was exiting the restroom when her fifth fingertip was caught and amputated between the doorframe and the self-closing door as she attempted to keep the door from slamming shut.
An employee's hand was caught between a turret spindle and ejector plate on a press, fracturing the wrist.
An employee fell off a roof suffering a head injury, multiple left-side face fractures and pain in his left shoulder. He was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting the height on a conveyor when the conveyor moved downward, pushing his upper body/head down. His right eye was pushed into the corner/edge of a cardboard box, causing a contusion/inflammation that required overnight hospitalization.

An employee was working in the dryer building area stacking units of veneer plywood with a forklift. The employee got off the forklift to place timbers between the stacks of veneer. In the process the employee's right index finger was pinched and smashed between the timbers and the forklift forks, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a steel I-beam when his index and pinky fingers were caught and smashed between the I-beam and a roller bed.
An employee experienced tightness in the chest and was disoriented during his mail route. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.

An employee was lowering a 3-inch pipe used as a guiderail for a lift pump when the crane cable broke below the cable clamp and above the cable eye. The pipe became unsecured and fell on the employee, lacerating the upper arm.

An employee and coworkers performed lockout/tagout procedures on a dryer rotary feed to clear a clogged plug. The employees cleared the plug and began to run the dryer, but the plug had not been placed back into the dryer. The injured employee was pointing to the rotary feed to remind the lead person to put the plug back in when the rotary feed amputated his right index finger from the fingertip to the bottom of the nailbed.
An employee was stacking materials on a horizontal panel saw when the saw blade amputated the employee's hand.
An employee was changing the bearing on a tilt belt when the employee's right hand contacted the belt, partially amputating the pinky finger. The belt was operating at the time.
On June 19, 2017,around 6:45 p.m., an employee was adjusting a paper tubing machine when his left hand was caught and lacerated between two rollers. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
