An employee was reversing a compact utility loader when it struck a forklift outrigger that was moving in the forward position. He suffered a left leg fracture and right calf laceration.

An employee was setting up a press brake and changing from a short die to a long die. While he was holding the lower die partway into position, the press brake was activated via the foot pedal. An employee fell from an 8-foot A-frame ladder, suffering a skull fracture, rib fractures, a vertebrae body compression injury, and a chest cavity injury.

An employee was unloading a padder from a trailer when the padder flipped and ejected the employee. He suffered a punctured lung, facial fractures, and a dislocated shoulder, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was providing a residential interior flea treatment when the employee slipped on a wet floor and fell back onto a stair tread, suffering a lower back injury.
An employee was putting a piece of concrete in a dumpster when it slipped and crushed his left ring finger between it and the edge of the dumpster.
An employee was guiding material through rollers when the employee's welding glove and left hand were pulled into the roller pinch point, amputating the left thumb and index fingertip.
An employee was operating a forklift when an empty beer keg he was moving started to fall off. As he attempted to grab it, the keg lacerated his right middle finger.
An employee was cleaning the patio area when she slipped on ice and fell, fracturing her left hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was wrapping PVC material on a rolling table when her right hand was caught between the table core and the material, amputating her fingertip.

An employee was removing a low-speed pin bracket during a main bearing replacement. When the bracket came loose, it swung and caught the employee's left middle fingertip between it and the bearing, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was changing his forklift battery when his right thumb was caught and detached between the forklift and battery.
An employee was driving a fence post and caught the left ring finger between the "T" post driver and the post, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was installing plywood on a second floor when he stepped backward and fell into a stairway opening, bruising a rib.

An employee was exiting his car when he stepped on a spray can and fell, breaking his ankle.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet while attempting to set a gable truss. The employee suffered a broken hip and wrist.

An employee was removing straps from a load of 18" pipe in a trailer. The employee was pulling a release strap from the passenger side of the trailer when one unsecured pipe rolled from the top of the load and struck the employee's head and neck, causing a contusion.

An employee was cleaning out a machine near the outside corner of the building when he was struck by the rear tires of a work truck driven by a coworker, suffering multiple torso injuries.
An employee was helping a forklift lift a door when the door became dislodged from the lifting straps and fell on the employee's right leg, breaking it.
An employee's foot and ankle were crushed and fractured between an electric pallet jack and a guardrail.
An employee fell and broke a leg after a patient fell on the employee.
An employee was removing wood from a double-head notching machine when the machine's blade amputated the employee's left middle, ring, and index fingers.

An employee was using a cart to load material (head stones) onto a trailer with a coworker when he lost his footing and tripped, causing the cart to tip over. His right ring fingertip was then caught and amputated between the cart and the floor.

An employee was cleaning plastic from a warehouse floor when he lost his footing and fell backward over a pallet, fracturing his left hip and femur.
An employee was removing a clog from a tail gate when the employee's left finger was caught between the tail gate and the latch pin. The finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was placing a roll of wire onto a bracket when the bracket broke. The roll of wire fell and pinched the employee's left little finger between it and a guardrail, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was descending a ladder from a roof when he lost his footing and fell 4 feet to the ground below, fracturing his right ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee suffered a left ring finger amputation while operating a chopper machine to cut metal scrap.

An employee was handling a flex line full of hot water when water drained from the hose and entered the employee's boot, severely burning the employee's foot and leg.

An employee was on a three-step ladder and pulled down a tote from an overhead shelf. As he turned to step down, he fell to the floor and broke his left femur.

An employee was working on a dust collector motor. The employee was manually moving the pulley motor when his finger was caught between the pulley and the belt. The employee's finger was amputated at the first knuckle at the hospital.

An employee was traveling inside a warehouse with a loaded forklift when he entered a cross-traffic intersection and struck another forklift. He stuck his foot out to brace himself. His foot was then caught between the forklifts, breaking his ankle.
An employee was on the front porch, pulling out weeds from the flower bed. As she stood up, she felt pain in her stomach area. She was hospitalized overnight for surgery.
An employee was installing ductwork and fell approximately 15 feet.
An employee was climbing a ladder when a rung broke. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken wrist and laceration.
On June 30, 2017, an employee suffered from heat exhaustion after doing deck demolition at a job site, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the ground setting concrete rubble onto an excavator bucket when the excavator bucket moved, striking the employee on the right lower leg. He suffered a skin tear and fracture to his right leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was repairing an abrasive blasting pressure pot. The employee turned off the blasting machine before leaving the area to get a different tool. The employee suffered a serious abrasion and punctures to the face, neck, torso, arms, and leg, requiring hospitalization. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was rolling pipes by hand on top of the first layer of pipes in the pipe rack, when he lost balance and his right foot was caught between the pipes from the first layer. As he tried to stop an incoming rolling pipe with his left foot, he fell on top of the pipes and fractured his left ankle and a little bone in the leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to install a rotating head when his right thumb was caught and amputated between the rotating head and a drill pipe.
An employee was standing on the deck of a vessel when a steel cable swept across the deck, causing the employee to fall and break his ankles.
An employee was testing a 50-foot liner that goes inside a hose when he suffered second degree steam burns to his back.
An employee collapsed due to dehydration.

An employee was tucking in a plastic wrap tail on a pallet that was on a conveyor belt when another pallet came down the conveyor and smashed his right index finger between the two pallets, amputating his finger just above the nailbed.
While climbing a fiberglass, 6-foot, A-frame ladder, an employee became dizzy, fell backward, and struck the ground, suffering a fractured skull, jaw, and vertebra.
An employee was on the ground waiting for a ride when a coworker ran over his legs with a vehicle and dragged him 10 feet.
While sandblasting a pipeline, an employee stepped on the sandblaster's air hose. The nozzle then swung toward the employee, and sandblast media was injected into his arm.
An employee was inserting newspapers into an inserter machine when her right hand entered the machine. The machine then broke her right arm.
An employee had mopped a floor, left the area, and then returned. While walking on the damp floor, the employee slipped, fell, and fractured the left kneecap.
An employee's left foot was run over and crushed by a moving forklift.
An employee suffered heat stress symptoms (cramps and excessive sweating) while loading returnable bottles and cans on a truck. He was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
An employee was overcome with heat stress and was hospitalized.

An employee was rigging down casing tools. He had two rig bales on the rig floor and was readying them to be let down to the rig floor. He had one bale upright when the rig-hand helper picked up the other bale and caught his ring finger between the two, partially amputating his distal fingertip.

An employee was hooking up two tandem trailers when the second trailer's dolly started free rolling. The employee's left hand was then pinched between the dolly and the hook on the lead trailer, amputating the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was connecting the fifth wheel of a tractor to a trailer when the wheel bounced up and caught the employee's ring finger, causing a compound fracture and severe laceration.
An employee was breaking out of a substructure when a driller went in the wrong direction with equipment and struck the employee's left thigh and calf, causing a laceration and severe contusion.
An employee was installing drywall sheathing and felt dizzy. The employee was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.
An employee was hanging a picture when it fell. The glass cover shattered, and a piece of glass lacerated his wrist.
An employee was putting a motorcycle on a lift when the bike missed the front wheel slot and fell on him. He suffered a hip contusion.
An employee was working at a retail counter window when she lost her balance while retrieving a package and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.

The employee was cutting a metal cabinet that was being scrapped and cut off one of the walls. The employee walked into the cabinet to cut the back wall, turned around to grab his torch hoses, and the piece of wall fell on the employee resulting in a pelvic injury.
An employee slipped in a walk-in cooler, suffering head, wrist, and knee injuries.
An employee was adjusting a dump table gear on a piece of work when a coworker who was helping energized the equipment. The rotating equipment then amputated the employee's pinky fingertip.
An employee was burned when a fire hose burst under pressure and sprayed him with hot water.
An employee was removing panels from a pre-existing roof when he fell 20 feet from the center of the roof to the concrete surface below, breaking his left wrist and severely bruising his pelvis.

An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when the employee's left hand came into contact with the cutting blade, lacerating the ring fingertip and amputating the index finger distal phalange and middle fingertip.

A workover crew was tripping out of a hole when the drill line parted, causing the blocks to drop from 10 to 15 feet up and fall onto the floor. The drill floor sprung up when the blocks contacted it, throwing an employee off the floor. He fell approximately 15 feet onto the ground, breaking a rib.
While walking quickly through a retail area to catch up to a coworker, an employee struck a table, tripped, and fell to the ground, breaking the arm/shoulder area and requiring surgery.

An employee was installing a tent. The employee fell off a 12-foot frame ladder while trying to access the second level of the tent. The employee suffered broken ribs, fractured vertebrae, torn tendons and a punctured lung.
An employee was carrying hot water to the work area in the kitchen when the hot water contacted and burned the employee's lower extremities.
An employee was driving a forklift around a corner when he attempted to adjust his forks. He then hit another forklift driver, lacerating his calf on the forks of the second lift.

An employee was operating an upright pallet rider and was coming around the corner to pick up a label for a shipment when the pallet rider accelerated. His right leg was then pinned and broken between a shelf's upright support and the pallet rider. He was hospitalized.
An employee was going to open the walk-in freezer when she fell and broke her hip.
An employee was struck by an automobile in the truck lot resulting in trauma to the right hip and elbow.
An employee was walking down stairs while carrying cleaning supplies when she lost her footing and fell, fracturing her left leg.
An employee was using a silage bagging machine to take samples of silage from semi-trailers when the machine wheel ran over his foot and broke his leg.

On July 3, 2017, an employee was erecting a system scaffold tower when it shifted, causing the employee's finger to become pinched between the wall and the scaffold system. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
On July 3, 2017, an employee was installing PVC pipe and using a chop saw when the employee experienced heat stress and heat exhaustion symptoms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was winding cable up on reels when the employee's finger was caught in a trailer and smashed, partially amputating the fingertip.
An employee was unloading a conveyor when his hand struck the conveyor guard and was lacerated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a drive shaft from a pump using chains when one of the chains came off and struck the employee's right leg, lacerating and dislocating the right knee.

An employee was delivering product from a truck. He was pulling on a strap to move the freight when the strap broke, causing him to trip over a pallet jack that was behind him. He fell on the truck's lift gate and then rolled off and fell to the ground, breaking three ribs.
On July 3, 2017, an employee was operating a range ball picker when it became stuck. The employee exited the range ball picker to push it and was run over by the picker.
An employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation while attempting to remove a bottle jam on a line. The line was unguarded and not locked/tagged out at the time.

On July 3, 2017, at approximately 7:10 AM, in the welding area, an employee was pushing his toolbox to the desired work area. At the time the employee was pushing his tool box there was a prybar sticking out beyond the side of the toolbox. The employee ran into a crane rail structure, crushing the employee's left pinky and ring fingers.

While spraying precast concrete from a scaffold, an employee slipped and fell 4 feet to a main scaffold and then fell an additional 14 feet to the ground, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, attempting to pull a control wire, when he fell to the ground and injured his pelvis.

An employee was operating a winch boom crane bucket truck. The employee was in the bucket using the winch to remove a manhole cover that was stuck. A harness was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was checking the fuel tanks in the parking lot and was struck by a vehicle resulting in a broken rib.

An employee was re-painting a patio ceiling while standing on an extension ladder when the ladder became unstable and fell backwards, causing the employee to fall 15 to 16 feet to the ground. An employee was getting a broom from a broom rack when his finger was caught in a metal broom holder, partially amputating his left second finger.

An employee was using an industrial hand drill to make a hole in a cinder block. The drill bit caught a snag and the drill spun around in the employee's hand, causing him to lose his grip. An employee was working at the plastic lid forming mold when the employee's left arm was caught between the mold wheel and a plastic sheet lay-down roller, crushing the soft tissue in the left forearm.

An employee was getting rags to wipe down a part that had just been dipped in LORCOAT when an explosion and fire occurred, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's arms, second degree burns to the neck, and first and second degree burns to the head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was backing up a pallet mover when her left calf was caught and lacerated between a conveyor guard and the pallet mover, requiring surgery.
An employee was bitten by a spider while handling baggage. The employee became ill and the area that was bitten became swollen.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was making caustic soda from water solutions. The caustic reacted violently with hot water and caused chemical burns on the employee's right kneecap, lower thighs, right leg, and left leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a perforated gun string to go down in a hole when the gun string broke loose and struck the employee's lower back, breaking the tailbone.
An employee was cleaning the paper roller with an abrasive pad and caught two fingers on the right hand in a nip point between two rollers resulting in amputation of the fingers.

An employee was tipping recycling waste containers into the truck. He was actuating the lever with his right hand while his left hand was on top of the container tipper. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was lighting fireworks when a firework exploded causing injuries to the employee's torso and legs.

On July 4, 2017, an employee removed a bonfire pit on the beach and then left. He went back to the beach later and his left foot stepped into the hole of the bonfire pit, suffering second and third degree burns.

An employee was picking up a trip nipple with a hoist when the hoist became hung on top of a drive. The employee used the left hand to free the hoist. Once the hoist was freed, the trip nipple sprung up and caught the employee's left hand between the nipple and the elevator, breaking it.
An employee was standing outside when an assailant struck the employee in the head with a stick. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured sinus cavity.

An employee was attempting to change a motor on an air compressor unit that was non-operational. As he attempted to disconnect the air hose, the coupler blew apart and struck him in the back of the head. He suffered multiple fractures and head trauma.
An employee was flagging traffic when a car went around the shoulder of the road and hit the employee. The employee suffered a fractured collarbone, broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a broken arm.
An employee was operating a corner notching machine to notch steel when the steel rolled up, causing the employee's right ring fingertip to be caught and amputated between the steel and the machine.

An employee was dismantling scaffolding. The employee raised a platform section from the lowest position (at four feet high) up to approximately eight feet in order to access and unbolt the top tower section to take it down. The employee removed the four corner bolts holding the section in place then proceeded to climb back down. The employee inadvertently grabbed the unbolted tower section while attempting to climb back down and it  fell onto the employee pushing the employee off the platform approximately eight feet to a compacted stone parking lot surface. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, a head laceration, and contusions and abrasions.
An employee was loading and unloading a truck. While exiting the vehicle, he hit his hand on the rear door, partially amputating his right middle finger.

An employee was changing a connection at a home power meter. He was trying to replace the coaxial cable line from the ground block to the pole mount. He cut the wire and his arm brushed against the bonding clamp. When he made contact with the clamp, he was electrically shocked and knocked down. He suffered electrical burns to his left forearm and left leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bitten by a dog while delivering mail, suffering puncture wounds and lacerations to the head, neck, hand, and arm.
An employee was operating a reach truck to move and retrieve products when her right leg was crushed between her reach truck and a bollard. She also suffered a possible broken pelvis.

An employee was carrying tools up an extension ladder when the ladder's feet began to slide back along the steel decking below. He lost his balance and fell approximately 7 feet to the steel decking, lacerating his right knee and breaking his right kneecap. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to put a wooden header into place when the header fell off the fork tines and broke a wall brace, causing the wall frame to come loose and strike the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling hose while spraying herbicide near power lines and was bitten by a poisonous snake. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was patrolling the grounds in a car when she suffered heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a fleshing machine when an animal hide became stuck in the roller system. The machine was guarded and was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was wiping shavings from the blade of a chopper machine when the chopper amputated his pinky finger and the tip of his ring finger. The machine was active at the time of the incident.
An employee was hospitalized after servicing equipment and received a finger amputation.
An employee was tarping a load of steel on a semi-trailer when he fell 3.5 feet from the trailer to the concrete pavement below, suffering a scalp laceration, skull fracture, and brain hemorrhage.

An employee was working on a binding machine when the wrench he was using was caught on the belt of the machine, causing his right ring and pinky fingers to be pulled into the system. His right pinky fingertip was amputated at the nail.
An employee was attempting to re-align a drive pulley when the system activated. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the pulley and the drive belt.
An employee stepped on a wet floor, slipped, and fell on his lower back, fracturing his hip.
An employee was about to go down an elevator to a service tunnel when the elevator abruptly dropped 50 feet. The employee suffered head and neck injuries.
An employee was operating a machine on a roof when he moved backward and fell 30 feet off the roof into a material roller on the ground, breaking his ribs.

An employee was replacing forklift cylinder seals on the outer main lift cylinder. The employee raised the mast channels to separate the cylinder from the mast. The jack failed and the employee's right hand was caught between the cylinder and the forklift mast resulting in a crushing injury to his right hand.
An employee was picking up trash when he fainted due to dehydration and hit his head on the floor.

An employee was driving a forklift clamp to pull stock from the warehouse when he possibly hit a short safety pole. He was found laying on the concrete dock floor with a head injury. He was hospitalized for a fracture and internal bleeding.
An employee was installing a down guy-wire on an overhead cable TV facility when the tail of the wire contacted the overhead powerline. The employee received an electrical shock and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading cartons onto a trailer. He was standing on a step stool when he reached to the side and fell, landing on the carton that he was loading and injuring his back. He was hospitalized.
On July 5, 2017, an employee suffered an amputation injury to his hand while performing a routine pin change on a facer. The guard was not in place at the time.
On July 5, 2017, at 10:00 a.m., an employee was dumping yard waste onto a garbage truck's hopper when he started to feel ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was carrying a box when he tripped over a pallet and fell to the floor. He broke his hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was emptying a waste pan on a portion saw when the pan slipped and caught his right ring finger, amputating the first digit.
An employee was riding a manlift on the top floor of a milling area. He missed a step while dismounting the manlift and fell to the landing floor, injuring his ankle.
An employee was roofing a house and was shocked when he touched a live power line.

The employee was working in the fabrication department on a machine that cuts the boat dashes and has a circular saw on one end and a drill bit on the other end. The employee was struck by the machine resulting in lacerations to his back.
On July 6, 2017, an employee fell from a ladder while performing HVAC servicing, hitting his head on the concrete floor below.
An employee fell down stairs and suffered an exposed fracture.

An employee was standing nearby as a crane operator attempted to remove a spindle from the mill. The operator hoisted the crane up too high and the chain sling broke. When the chain broke, it struck the employee on the right elbow, lacerating and fracturing part of the humerus bone.
An employee was picking up cans beneath a machine at about 1:45 a.m. when the employee's left hand came in contact with a gear chain, amputating the left middle fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a fork truck when a bug flew into the employee's face. As the employee was swatting at the bug, the fork truck turned and rolled onto its side. The employee's right leg was crushed under the fork truck and had to be amputated below the knee.

An employee was pouring concrete when concrete blocks began to fall on him. As he attempted to move out of the way, he hit his head on the ground, suffering head injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw when the blade amputated his right thumb tip.

An employee became ill and suffered heat stress while making a delivery. He was hospitalized for severe dehydration.
An employee was cutting plastic trim with a utility knife when the knife slipped and lacerated his left wrist.
A temporary employee was admitted to the hospital with heat exhaustion/stroke.
While loading a truck, an employee began to feel ill and experienced chest pains. The employee was hospitalized for potential heat stress, dehydration.

An employee was acting as a ground guide as a pickup truck was laying out a hose. The hose reel was not secured to the pickup truck bed and fell on the employee, injuring the left side of the employee's body and breaking the left ribs.

An employee was setting forms in preparation to pour a concrete deck on a bridge when he started to feel ill. He later experienced intense cramping and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee driving a truck pulled over to allow a police car to pass. The employee then stepped out of the passenger side to check the truck. At that time, the employee was struck by the car being chased by the police, suffering leg and other injuries.
An employee experienced heat stress while performing pump maintenance, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from a 20-foot extension ladder while installing a window, suffering a fractured jaw and losing some front teeth.
An employee tripped and fell while walking to a car in the parking lot, breaking the right arm.

An employee climbed the steps of a work platform to inspect the passenger side of a pump trailer that was leaking. As he was descending from the platform, he slipped and fell into a sitting position on top of a bracket that went through his coveralls and punctured the inside of his right thigh.
An employee was making an adjustment to a tool punch on a punch press. The press cycled while his hand was on top of the punch crushing a right hand finger.
An employee was loading a flatbed truck when he slipped and fell, hitting his head and shoulder on the flatbed truck.
On July 6, 2017, an employee suffered from suspected heat illness after forming concrete all day in temperatures in the mid-80s. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a hose to empty flowback water tanks at a drilling rig. When he removed the hose from the tank, he was sprayed with hot flowback water, which burned his arms and torso.

An employee was performing maintenance on a piece of equipment that was locked out. He was changing out the pulley and belt with a shaft when his left hand became caught in the pulley and belt, partially amputating his pinky fingertip.

An employee was removing gutters. The employee stepped off a ladder onto the roof to remove a screw from the gutter, disturbed a wasp nest, and was stung repeatedly causing the employee to fall 15 feet from the roof edge. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration on the forehead.
An employee was putting a stopper in the bottom of a glass tube. The glass tube broke and cut both of the employee's hands, amputating the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the cyclone on the AZO auger on the paint line when the employee's finger contacted a rotating auger resulting in a fingertip amputation to the right middle finger.

An employee was attempting to dislodge dough from a dough-separating machine when the machine's cutting blade amputated the employee's left middle and ring fingers. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was using a pair of pliers to clear jammed chicken from a cuber machine when the employee's left hand was pulled into the machine's knives, lacerating and partially amputating the ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was on top of a vacuum box, loosening a cap on a vent pipe with a pipe wrench, when he fell approximately 4 feet and landed in a sitting position. He suffered a compression fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, fracturing a shin.
An employee was pouring concrete when the hot concrete contacted and burned the employee's right foot.
An employee was moving an electrical cabinet when it tipped and fell on the employee, breaking the left arm.
On July 6, 2017, an employee was cutting grass using a lawn mower when he slipped and fell onto the ground. His left foot was caught under the blade of the lawn mower, amputating two toes.
An employee was using a skid-steer to scoop and dump scrap aluminum into a rotary furnace when the hot metal was blown onto his right arm and back, causing burns.
An employee stumbled, fell backward, and hit his head on cinder blocks. He lost consciousness and suffered a laceration to the back of his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder adjusting a Lally column when he slipped and fell to the ground, landing on his head and suffering a concussion.
An employee was preparing for a concrete pour when he began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized overnight due to heat related illness.
An employee was helping to direct a hose during a concrete pour when he cramped up due to the high heat levels. The employee was hospitalized and also diagnosed with a muscle injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on a printing press. The press was locked/tagged out, and the employee disengaged and removed the folder mechanism. The employee then attempted to re-engage the folder mechanism and slid it back into the press. As he was re-engaging the mechanism, his left index finger was caught and partially amputated in the mechanism's gear and chain.
An employee was standing on a ladder when he lost his balance and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground, breaking his arm.
An employee was moving a refrigerator through a doorway when his right thumb was caught and partially amputated between the door and the refrigerator.
An employee had been supervising employees installing overhead electrical lines when he felt ill and experienced cramping. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was operating a handheld grinder to cut cast iron when the grinder kicked back and lacerated the employee's finger, requiring surgery.
An employee was bitten by an alligator while diving for golf balls.
An employee was getting up from her desk when she tripped over a rug, fracturing her right upper arm.
An employee was installing an electrical box when a concrete form fell on and broke the employee's ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder servicing a solar heating unit when the ladder buckled and the employee fell approximately 10 to 12 feet to the ground, fracturing the L2 vertebra.

An employee was standing approximately 15 to 20 feet away from a kiln's fire box, which was being ignited with saw dust, when a flashback occurred from the fire box. The employee suffered burns to the face, neck, right ear, and arm.
An employee was descending an A-frame step ladder. While on the third rung, he missed the second rung and fell to the concrete ground, breaking his left arm.
An employee was performing residential waste management duties when he experienced heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a cable from a hoist when his left fingertip was partially amputated by the pulley apparatus and chain.

An employee went to retrieve keys from a utility truck during a thunderstorm when lighting struck the overhead powerline and energized the truck, causing him to experience shortness of breath. He was hospitalized.
An employee was in a work truck. When the truck stopped, the driver's-side sliding door slammed against the employee's hand, breaking fingers.
An employee was found unconscious and shaking on the floor after fixing an electrical wire of unknown voltage. The employee may have been shocked.
An employee was walking when their foot was run over by a forklift resulting in a crushing injury.
An employee was walking down stairs when he fell and broke his left leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor with a high-pressure hose when the employee's hand/forearm was caught and lacerated between the conveyor's end plate and a sprocket, requiring surgery.
An employee was using an end mill when his glove came in contact with the bit, pulling his left thumb into the end mill and amputating the tip.
An employee was rotating a large valve when the sling slipped and pinched the employee's fingers between the sling. The employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was moving from a ladder on the back of a mixer truck to a platform on the rear bumper to discharge ready mix concrete. His boots were muddy and he slipped off the platform. He fell about 3 feet to the ground, fracturing six ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to remove a drill pipe from a hole. His right hand was on the stand of drill pipe while an iron roughneck operator retracted the equipment so it could be positioned out of the way. The iron roughneck operator swung the piece of equipment and struck the employee's right ring fingertip, amputating it.
An employee was moving a stack of drywall when the stack became unstable and the sheets fell on the employee's leg, breaking bones.
On 7/7/2017, an employee began to feel unwell after monitoring equipment while steel solidified. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was working from a 6-foot step ladder to change an airline near a sterilizer. He was reaching when he lost his balance and fell, striking a pipe on the ground and fracturing his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was adjusting the belt wiper on the conveyor belt of a paving machine when the employee's right arm was caught in the machine. Part of the arm had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was manually pruning a tree when he fell approximately 30 feet to the ground below, sustaining multiple lacerations, broken ribs, fibula/tibia fractures, pressure buildup, a cheekbone fracture, a skull fracture, and two fractured vertebrae. He was hospitalized.

A truck driver backed up, stopped, and put the vehicle into park. The injured employee lowered the tailgate. At the same time, the truck settled and rolled back. The employee's index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the truck and the adjacent wall of the building.
An employee was torching flange bolts on a by-pass run when the by-pass twisted and swung down, striking and breaking the employee's ankle.
An employee was trying to move a pallet using a rope and pallet jack. The rope had tension and made contact with the employee's left middle finger, lacerating and amputating it.

On July 7, 2017, at approximately 10:15 a.m., an employee was prepping material to be cut on a bandsaw. When he went to put a spacer between the bandsaw clamp, the clamp closed on and crushed his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was setting up to hydro-blast inside a pressure vessel that was 72 degrees when he became nauseated and suffered cramps. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was installing a lock out latch on a knife blade circuit. The employee contacted the energized top contacts in the electrical box that resulted in an arc flash. The power source was not locked out at the time. The employee sustained second and third degree burns on the front of his upper body, face and hands.
An employee had tested a water filter when the water pump overheated and blew up the hose. He suffered burns to the back of his left leg and was hospitalized.
The employee was unloading a truck. He tripped and fell over packing material that was laying on the floor resulting in a right hip fracture.

An employee was using a 1-ton crane to move a 1,462 lbs. load when the crane's bridge beam broke, causing the crane and load to fall. He was struck by the crane's bridge beam, fracturing a shoulder and a rib.
An employee was in the restroom when one of her legs gave out and she fell, fracturing an ankle and requiring surgery.
Two employees were working in a ditch when the dirt wall collapsed on them. The first employee suffered a broken femur, tibia, pelvis, and T-3 vertebra. The second employee suffered a broken tibia.
On 07/07 2017, an employee was exiting a flatbed trailer (36" from ground level) when he landed wrong and fractured his right ankle.

An employee was checking for leaks inside a barge and welding in areas where there were leaks. The employee was shocked by a welding lead and collapsed. He struck the bottom of the barge injuring his shoulder. The employee also suffered burns to his hands.
On July 8, 2017, an employee fell approximately 5 feet while performing a dock plate inspection, suffering contusions to the right shoulder and hip.
An employee was doing maintenance on a roll-forming machine when her glove was caught in the machine and her hand was pulled in, amputating her fingertips.
An employee was descending a ladder from a truck water tank when his left ring finger was caught and severely lacerated in the rung. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two employees were stacking and organizing wooden temporary work platforms on dunnage when the injured employee heard a pop in his lower back while lifting a platform. The employee suffered two herniated discs in his lower back.
Two ball players collided with each other resulting in one player fracturing his right tibia and fibula.

On July 8, 2017, an employee was adjusting a part onto a CNC machine. He used a foot pedal to actuate an air clamp to hold the part in place. His left middle finger was caught between the part and the clamp, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was driving a hostler and transporting an intermodal container on a chassis to the back row of the yard. An employee was using a core cutting machine to finish a 3-foot-diameter cut when the machine's top cover came loose and rotated into a hydraulic line. The line then whipped and struck the employee's leg, while the cover struck his back. He suffered leg and back lacerations and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while walking in the lobby, twisting/rolling an ankle.
An employee was cutting a board using a circular saw when the sawblade amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was repairing an electrical meter for street lights when an electrical flash occurred, resulting in first and second degree burns on his arms and face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading pipe racks and drill collars when one pipe rack hit the other pipe rack, causing the load to shift and strike his lower leg. His lower leg broke and had to be amputated.
An employee was welding and attaching a manual load clamp when the employee's left little fingertip was caught and amputated in the clamp.
An employee was using a saw to cut blocks when his right hand contacted the blade, amputating three fingers and pinching his thumb.
An employee was working with chemicals and pouring phenol into a reactor when the chemical splashed and caused chemical burns to the employee's left leg and right foot.

On 7/14/2017, at approximately 1 PM, an employee was downloading a chemical from a bulk truck using a hose. When he attempted to remove the hose, it was still pressurized, causing it to release chemical that splashed on the employee. He suffered chemical burns and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was operating a forklift to move a load of tires. One of the tires slid off of the stack, so he stopped the forklift to move the tire. Another forklift hit the load and pinned the employee between the load and an adjacent wall, breaking his leg.

An employee was performing maintenance on and cleaning a conveyor that moves powders up to a reactor when he noticed powder coming out of an elbow on the conveyor's powder tube. As he was checking the powder's consistency, his right index finger pushed through the powder and was caught in the conveyor's belt linkage, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was exposed to mildew while replacing a cabinet that was damaged by a water leak. He had an allergic reaction and suffered respiratory irritation, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was manipulating a piece of concrete with a burke bar when the employee's left middle finger was caught and amputated between the bar and a piece of pre-cast concrete.
An employee was shrink wrapping a pallet and had mounted a box to reach the plastic wrap when the employee fell to floor, suffering a fracture.
An employee was repairing a rough terrain forklift when a hydraulic line failed and the forklift's mast came down quickly, crushing his knee against the ground.
An employee was climbing down a fixed metal ladder when he slipped and fell about 8 feet to a concrete mezzanine, breaking his tibia and injuring his shoulder ligament. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a ladder while installing electrical wiring, suffering a broken arm and wrist and a facial laceration.

An employee was hosing down a wall in the warehouse when water from the wall leaked onto loose electrical wires or into an electrical outlet/light switch. When the employee opened the door to leave, he received an electric shock. He suffered second and third degree burns to the right forearm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was crossing the street when she was struck by a car, suffering a possible spinal cord injury.
An employee was operating a forklift when the employee's finger was caught between the forklift cage and a beam, amputating the fingertip.
While rigging down after working for 12 hours, an employee began feeling weak and displaying signs of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing bags on a bag tail blower on a packaging machine. While she was unhooking a bag from the blower, the blower motor lacerated her right index finger. Her finger had to be amputated at the fingernail.
An employee was attempting to adjust a chain that was being used to hoist a load when the employee's left thumb tip was pinched and partially amputated between the chain and the piece of equipment.
An employee was moving a conveyor system when it tipped over and fell on the employee. The employee broke a leg, fingers, ribs, and vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to reposition a pipe that was being cut on a semi-automatic pipe band saw. His left hand was on the pipe when the hydraulic pipe clamp was activated. His left middle fingertip was then caught between the clamp palate and the pipe's side wall, requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was operating a machine when his right index fingertip was pinched and amputated by a vise clamp.
An employee was entering the building when he slipped on the floor and ran into a bollard, breaking his left ribcage.

An employee was pulling scrap from a beam saw when the compressor/die came down and crushed his left ring fingertip between pieces of wood. As he pulled his hand back, his fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was reversing a power pallet jack when he was struck by a forklift, fracturing his legs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was servicing an HVAC system in a ceiling crawl space. As she was walking in the crawl space, she stepped on a closed access panel that suddenly opened. She fell to the ground below and hit a table, fracturing her hip.
An employee was operating a panel saw to cut wood when the blade struck and amputated his left pinky fingertip.

An employee was attempting to plug a power tool into a receptacle outlet while stepping over a wire rope sling that was laying on the floor. He tripped over the wire rope swing, fell, twisted, and hit the floor, fracturing his right femur.
Three employees were performing masonry work on a scaffold that collapsed and they hit the concrete ground. One employee was hospitalized for a head laceration requiring stiches and contusions.
An employee was operating a drill press when the rotating bit caught his glove. The press then amputated his left thumb tip (no bone loss). The press was not guarded at the time.

An employee was installing a railing on the third-story breezeway of a new apartment construction when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below and was hospitalized with multiple injuries. There was no guardrail and fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee lost balance and fell to the floor, fracturing the left hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting a pallet jack before usage when he was pushed by a high riser driven by a coworker. His foot was pushed underneath the pallet jack, breaking a metatarsal bone.
An employee was carrying materials back to her workstation when she slipped, striking her chin against a dolly as she fell to the floor. She suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

On Friday, July 14, 2017, at approximately 12:15 PM, an employee was guiding cans (printing equipment) to a forklift platform when a can behind her fell and struck her left knee and lower leg. She was hospitalized with a crushing injury.
An employee was making adjustments on a V pusher when the machine s V flap came up and caught the employee s left ring fingertip, amputating the finger pad.
An employee was cleaning the gears of a printing press when the employee's right hand became caught in the gears, amputating the thumb, index finger, and middle finger.

An employee was at the airport walking away from the baggage claim area with her luggage and computer case in front of her. The luggage fell in a hole on the concrete sidewalk causing the employee to trip and fall over the luggage. The employee was admitted to the hospital for a fracture to the right elbow.
An employee was cutting a board on a table saw when the saw amputated two of his fingers.
An employee was trimming a tree away from utility lines when he fell and struck the tree's lower limbs, fracturing two ribs.

While conducting maintenance and repairs to the building, an employee became dizzy and fainted, falling into a pile of scrap metal. The employee suffered multiple fractures and lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a pressure washer while cleaning a loading dock when the washer wand and spray passed over the employee's foot, injuring it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pinned between a gang box and a wall, suffering a bruised spleen, fractured pelvis, and fractured L1 vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hanging sheet rock when he became sick due to possible dehydration. He passed out, started shaking, and fell, striking and scratching his face.
An employee fell 7 feet off the top of a step ladder while painting, breaking his wrist and hip.
An employee was cutting film stock after it was spooled when his knife amputated his left thumb tip.

An employee was operating a press when a part and the draw pad became stuck on the bottom of the die. The draw pad was under extreme pressure. As the employee tried to pry the part off of the die, the part released, causing the draw pad to spring up. This broke the bolts containing the draw pad, and the draw pad hit and fractured the employee's wrist.
An employee was trimming trees when a tree limb fell on and fractured the employee's left lower leg.
An employee was picking up water bottles near the guard gate when a black snake bit his index finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was handling a metal part as it was being forged in a forging hammer when the part shattered. A hot metal shard shot out of the forging hammer and punctured the employee's abdomen, causing internal damage. He was hospitalized.
An employee's fingertip was caught and amputated in a closing safe door.

An employee was pushing a pallet of water inside the store on a pallet jack while a coworker pulled it. They stopped to begin stacking the cases. The pallet fell from the pallet jack and landed on the employee's right second toe, amputating it.
An employee was delivering a refrigerator at a customer's residence when he slipped on the floor. The refrigerator and dolly then fell on and broke his ankle.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a loop car while standing on grating. As he was checking the wheels of the loop car, the grating gave way and he fell through the opening to the next level below, injuring his ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a 1/4 inch transit board resulting in a C7 fracture and a broken femur.
An employee was repairing a leaking 40-pound pipe when it fell on his right foot, lacerating and fracturing it. He was hospitalized overnight and had surgery.

An employee was attempting to build a wooden base for a manual sheet metal box pan brake. He lifted the brake onto the forks of a forklift. He then aligned the brake over bolts to secure the brake to the wood base. He exited the forklift and stood in front of it to make adjustments. He was leaning over to kneel on the floor when the brake slid off the forks and fell on him, trapping him underneath. He suffered a pelvic fracture, knee injury, and bruising and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a coworker drill pilot holes through a wooden block. The coworker was operating the drill while the employee checked the hole alignment when the drill bit cut through the block and contacted the employee s right index finger, amputating it to the first knuckle.

An employee was helping a forklift operator stack empty sacks on a pallet. The forks of the fork truck were raised, and the employee's right index finger became stuck in an open hole in the fork, amputating his fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell and the employee's head struck a railing. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a riveting machine when the rivet head fell on and amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was lifting a plate on a trailer while trying to pull onto a chain with force when he experienced sharp pain in his abdomen.
An employee was clearing a downed tree and debris from a trail. She was rolling a log out of the way when a venomous snake bite her on the left index finger.

An employee was loading a rail car when he collapsed and fell. His fall was stopped by his personal fall arrest system (PFAS), but as he was already unconscious he struck his head on a beam or the rail car after his hard hat fell off. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of a seizure, lacerations, and head injuries.

An employee was using a milling machine to make a metal part when a shaving from the part caught his glove and pulled his hand into the machine, amputating his right ring finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground while disassembling a crane. He landed on and broke his back.
An employee was standing next to equipment that was being moved when a piece of the equipment fell off and hit his face, fracturing his jaw.

An employee was pouring a ladle of molten iron into a sand mold. Radiant heat from the pour caused the employee's jeans to catch fire. The employee was hospitalized with third degree burns on his right leg.
On 7/15/2017, an employee received an electrical shock at a junction box for a pole-mounted light fixture, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to move a 24" by 14" transformer on a boat with a hoist. When he went to set the transformer down, the transformer slipped and landed on the table surface, trapping his index finger between the two. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee opened an electrical switching cubicle with 7,200-volt electrical lines to repair a dead line. He lost his footing and fell forward into the electrical switching cubicle, making contact with the energized electrical lines. He received electrical burns to his left arm and left knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell approximately 25 feet from a roof, suffering a broken back.

An employee was working from a raised bucket truck to troubleshoot a center phase when his right back shoulder contacted an energized electrical switch. He suffered burns to the right arm and upper back shoulder area, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing jammed material from a machine when his right middle and ring fingertips were caught and amputated in the machine, which was unguarded at the time.

An employee was operating a press brake to bend a piece of steel. After bending the piece of steel, he re-actuated the press brake with the foot pedal while grabbing the part out of the die. The part broke up toward the front/top of the press (ram) and a previously bent flange caught and amputated his left index and ring fingertips above the knuckle.
While polishing a throttle valve stem in front of a CNC lathe, an employee was caught in the machine, suffering left arm fractures, a pinky finger amputation, and damage to other left-hand fingers.
An employee was adjusting a swing arm that did not connect with a jack when his left index fingertip was pinched and amputated between the swing arm and jack.
An employee lost his balance while removing a safety latch on top of a truck and fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below, suffering a concussion and possible fractured vertebrae.
An employee was placing 135-pound panels on the rack of an automated storage system when a panel fell and hit his left leg, breaking it above the ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on a catwalk handing a bail of insulation down to a customer when the top rail of the catwalk slipped out of its designated bracket. The employee fell 8.5 feet to the concrete floor, suffering pelvic and shoulder pain that required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to unjam stackable potato boxes on a box palletizer when the machine began operating and crushed the employee's skull. The palletizer was not locked out at the time.
An employee was directing as 4-foot section I-beams were being loaded onto a flatbed truck when a beam fell from the truck and struck his right arm before landing on and breaking his right foot.
An employee was lifting equipment when it moved and fell on the employee's hand, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was pressure washing concrete and contacted his left knee with the high pressure water stream (3500 psi) resulting in a laceration to the kneecap and air behind the knee.
An employee tripped on the leg of a stand and fractured the left hip.
An employee was performing physical training when he became exhausted and ill. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a forklift tire and fell backwards into another forklift tire, hitting his back.
A door closed on an employee's little finger, amputating the terminal end.
An employee was operating a punch press when the press crushed his left middle fingertip. The press was unguarded at the time.
An employee who had worked his normal 12 hour shift went home and was later hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was cleaning the roller on a printing press when the employee's right thumb was pulled into the in-going nip point, partially amputating the thumb tip. The press was unguarded at the time.

On Monday, July 17, 2017, at approximately 9:30 AM, employees were attempting to hook a trailer to a truck in the parking lot of the facility. During the hooking process, the trailer moved, catching and amputated an employee's left index fingertip between the ball of the hitch and the trailer.
On July 17, 2017, at approximately 9:30 a.m., an employee fell while climbing down from a truck trailer. She suffered a compound fracture to the right ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee slipped and fell while filling compost bins with compost. As he was falling, he tried to catch himself by grabbing a chain. His right hand went into a cog and his index fingertip was amputated.
Two employees were using a ripsaw when a spark or small fire ignited in the ripsaw's dust collection bag. A flash fire occurred, burning the upper body and arms of both employees.
An employee was holding metal I-beams on a floating barge when one of the beams fell and struck the employee's right fingers, injuring them.

On 7/17/17, an employee was driving a stand-up riding forklift truck and negotiating a turn when the forklift struck a column. His left leg was crushed in the collision, suffering multiple fractures. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee climbed a ladder to access a tree. He fell approximately 10 feet to the ground as he was transferring from the ladder to the tree when his climbing line failed. The employee suffered a broken hip.
The employee was moving equipment around on a truck in preparation for fit testing. The employee started having chest pains from possible heat exposure and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a chair back part in a CNC bender when the machine crushed his right index finger. His finger had to be medically amputated at the first knuckle. The bender machine was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was delivering goods and using a pallet jack to move them inside the trailer when he slipped over the edge of the trailer and fell about 4 feet to the concrete ground. His left lower leg broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was lifting the cab off a skid steer. As the cab was being lifted and tilted back, the cab door swung down and pinched the employee's right ring finger resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was moving a 300-pound stone when the stone flipped and fell on the employee's right foot, lacerating it and fracturing the big toe.
An employee was conducting a field safety observation. While he was observing a coworker, he started sweating heavily. He was hospitalized for severe dehydration.
An employee was mowing and started feeling chest pain. The employee suffered a heart attack.

An employee was preparing to throw debris from a roof into a dumpster when he lost his footing and fell approximately 15 feet to the concrete below, injuring his back, ankle, and wrist. His safety harness was unhooked at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning the edge banding machine and amputated the right middle and ring fingertips on the blades. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking when a plywood board fell from the 18th floor and hit his hard hat. He suffered a head injury.

An employee was adjusting the board width on the roller conveyor that feeds stock through the painting machine and sustained partial amputations of the left middle and ring fingers in the roller chain and sprocket.
An employee was using an air gun to remove tire bolts from a truck when the truck vibrated off its jack. His right ring finger was then caught and amputated between the air gun and the bolt.
An employee was helping a coworker stack hydraulic shoring into the bed of a service truck when the shoring shifted and smashed/amputated the employee's ring fingertip.
An employee was preparing to clean a room. She had her hand on the doorframe when the door closed on her hand, injuring her left middle finger and requiring surgery.
An employee used tongs to pull a pipe apart and was trying to remove them from the pipe when the tongs struck and broke his ribs.

An employee was operating and moving a powered pallet jack when the employee's right ankle was caught between the pallet jack and a guardrail. The employee suffered a fractured right ankle, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

The employee was preparing to clean the stale roller. The employee was manually moving a belt and pulley when his fingers became pinched between them resulting in lacerations and amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was changing a tire on an 18-wheeler when his left pinky finger was caught between the tire and the fender amputating the tip.
An employee was on a ladder and grabbing onto a metal pipe when he suffered an electric shock. He then fell approximately 27 feet from the ladder.
An employee suffered from dehydration and heat illness while on a trash collection route. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was looking for an air conditioner leak inside a ceiling when the roof collapsed and he fell 7 feet, injuring his spine.
An employee fell as he was stepping off a ladder, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing wooden cleats from a top conveyor belt and tossing them onto a bottom belt when the employee's right thumb was caught between the bottom belt's chain and sprocket, amputating 3/4 of the right thumb tip.

An employee was changing out a cutter head on a planer and was using a lifting device to hoist the 100-pound blades from the machine. The lifting device has an adjustable balance so the blades can be tilted as they are removed from the machine. As the employee was removing the blades, his left hand was on the hoist between the collar and the end plate. The collar slid back toward the end plate, pinching and crushing his index finger between the collar and end plate. His index fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was pulling IV bags from a gray bin. While he was trying to shut the lid, he found that there was air in the bag. As he was attempting to release the air from the bag, he received a puncture wound to the left forearm.
An employee was wiping debris from the bottom of a bundle of lumber when the bundle shifted and pinched the employee's left middle finger, amputating the distal tip.

An employee was using a computerized panel saw. The guard came up and there was a piece of scrap underneath. The employee reached for the scrap and the guard came down on his fingers resulting in lacerations to the pads of the right middle and ring fingers. One of the fingertips was amputated.

An employee was helping to change out a roller on a stacker when his right foot was smashed between two pieces of metal. The steel safety toe in his work boot then bent and amputated the tip of his right big toe.

On 7/18/2017, an employee had been operating a forklift when he dismounted the forklift to pick-up material. A forklift operator then backed into him, pinning him between the two forklifts. He injured his lower back and hip on the right side of his body and suffered a small pelvic fracture.

An employee was walking as a nearby truck attempted to pull another truck using a hook and a synthetic sling. The hook on the sling broke and impaled the employee's stomach, requiring hospitalization.

An employee experienced chest pains throughout the day while making deliveries to customers. The employee was lifting stock, unloading stock, and setting up ramps at customer locations. The employee was hospitalized with chest pain and heart arrhythmia.
While operating a transit bus, an employee was assaulted by a passenger with a knife, suffering a cut to the left side of the face.
An employee became ill while on his route and was hospitalized with a possible heat-related injury.
An employee had been tying rebar outdoors in direct sunlight for approximately 12 hours when he suffered from heat stress and was hospitalized.
An employee was riding a horse in a cattle pen when the horse bucked. He was thrown off the horse and hit the back of his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a valve assembly for transport when the assembly became unstable and tipped, striking the employee's hip/thigh region.
An employee was installing a guardrail along the interstate and suffered heat stroke. The employee became light headed and fell over with cramps and nausea.
An employee was operating a 150-ton mechanical power press when his left hand entered the point of operation and was amputated.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to the avocado in a coworker's guacamole, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping a coworker lower a cutting trough. The coworker attached a chain to the cutting trough and a shaker walkway overhang. The employee centered a forklift on the cutting trough and raised the forks up until they came into contact with the trough, to relieve any pressure from the saddle supports underneath. He un-pinned and removed one saddle support, then attempted to un-pin/remove the second support. He took his left hand and held the tubing and the slide portion of the saddle support in order to gain additional leverage to free the stuck pin. Once the pin came out, the slide fell and smashed his left index finger between the saddle and the tubing.
An employee was skinning a wire to test for voltage on a light pole when he suffered an electric shock from the energized line.
An employee was walking behind a track hoe when it struck the employee's right foot, breaking the third, fourth, and fifth toes and the metatarsals.

An employee was driving a forklift to transport a dumpster full of wood scrap to a scrap pile. When he hit the trip lever to tip the dumpster forward, the bar came up and pinched his left-hand fingers between it and a forklift fork. His left middle and ring fingers were crushed and lacerated, and his ring finger had to be surgically amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was trying to guide an outrigger beam into an outrigger box. As the beam slid into the box, the hydraulic cylinder inside the beam smashed the employee's thumb against the inside of the box. The employee required surgery.
On 07/18/2017, an employee was working on a firewall when he began experiencing symptoms of heat stress, including nausea and vomiting. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee suddenly vomited and passed out while laying brick from a third-story exterior deck. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was ripping a board on a table saw when it kicked back. His left hand then contacted the blade, partially amputating his fingers.
An employee was on top of a structure retrieving a 2x4 piece of wood when he fell through a hatch opening to the ground 20 feet below. He suffered a punctured lung, broken rib, and cracked vertebrae.
An employee's lawn mower was stuck in mud. As a vehicle was pulling him out with a chain, the chain broke and struck his arm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was moving a traffic cone when a truck ran over his foot, fracturing it and requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to lower a tower on a light plant when the cable came out of the pulley and created slack. As the employee tried to put the cable back in the pulley, the cable snagged the employee's glove and pulled it into the pulley, amputating the first digit of the employee's right pinky finger.
An employee was hauling a 5-gallon bucket of water up a 20-foot incline to dump it when he experienced symptoms of dehydration. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.

An employee was working from the second floor of a mushroom house when he fell approximately 7 feet through an open walking/working platform and landed on the first level, injuring his head and neck. He was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling holes in a ceiling to add a conduit when the employee fell approximately 10 feet, suffering multiple head, back, and chest injuries.

An employee was using a hydraulic machine to test the torque on some nacelle bolts. The employee was placing the hydraulic head on the bolts when a coworker activated the machine. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the machine and the bolt, amputating the first digit.
While working on an elevated pallet racking system, an employee slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, injuring the head, back, and chest. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the blades on a forklift and crushed a finger in a pinch point.
An employee received steam burns to the lower extremities while repairing a sewer grate.
An employee was unloading a server rack from a truck when the rack fell over onto the employee's lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
On July 19, 2017, at 1:00 PM, an employee was standing next to a skid steer loader when the tracks ran over the employee's left leg and fractured it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling wooden cabinets and experienced dehydration related to heat exhaustion.
While tripping in the hole, an employee stepped on a rotary table to grab a stand of drill pipe. His left leg went out from underneath him and he fell, fracturing his right tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a saw to cut concrete when the saw bound and bounced back, hitting and lacerating his right cheek. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing an injection unit platform off a press bed when the unit slipped off. His index finger was pinched between the unit and the platform, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a plug press machine when his left thumb was caught in the machine, severing it to the knuckle.
An employee was on the roof and became faint or dizzy. He stumbled across the roof and fell. His life line caught him and he did not hit the ground. The employee suffered a heat-related injury.
An employee was moving pipes on an oil rig and became sick to his stomach and vomited. The employee suffered a heat-related illness.

On July 19, 2017, at approximately 2:00 p.m., an employee experienced dizziness, cramping, and nausea, during the delivery of mail on his route. The employee was hospitalized for acute kidney failure and heat exhaustion. The heat index at the time of the incident was 90 degrees.

An employee was descending a fixed ladder from the mezzanine (approximately 6.5 feet) to the ground level when she lost her footing and her grip. She attempted to jump from the ladder to avoid falling and landed hard on her feet, fracturing both heels. She then hit her head on the floor, injuring her head. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of glass when the glass fell and lacerated his wrist.

An employee was operating a walkie forklift to load a trailer when the walkie became caught on the edge of the dock next to the dock plate. The walkie stopped abruptly, sending the employee onto the dock floor. The employee suffered head and hip injuries.
An employee was cleaning a maintenance closet when he tripped over an extension cord and fell to the ground, breaking his hip.
On 7/19/17, an employee was dismantling a scaffold and removed a brace when the scaffold's end frame fell on his back and pushed him over. He suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the roof of a second story structure, approximately 17 feet from the ground, when he fell off and broke both ankles.
An employee was lifting a laundry bag when she felt severe back pain and was hospitalized.

On 7/19/17, an employee was cleaning near a zinc sulfate bagging operation when the employee tripped. The employee's right hand then entered the rotary air valve and contacted rotating parts, amputating the index fingertip.
An employee was cutting vegetables with a chef knife when the blade amputated 1/4-inch of one of his right fingertips (no bone loss).

An employee was helping a coworker install a 600-pound flange/pup onto another pipe. The coworker was using a homemade flange hook to hold the flange/pup when the flange/pup fell onto the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with broken toes.
An employee had been painting outside in high temperatures when he felt ill, experiencing nausea and vomiting. He was hospitalized overnight for dehydration and heat stress.
An employee tripped over a cord and fell, injuring her right knee (contusion).
An employee fell off a delivery truck lift gate as it was being lowered to the ground, suffering a forehead laceration.

An employee was getting ready to pick up tomato paste when his fork truck began to slide. He attempted to stop the truck with his left foot, and his foot was caught between the beam and fork truck. His foot became swollen and suffered a possible fracture.
On July 19, 2017, an employee had loaded a truck and was driving a delivery route when he was overcome by heat and passed out. He was hospitalized overnight for heat exhaustion.

An employee was attempting to adjust a conveyor belt when his arm was pulled into the rollers. His forearm broke, requiring overnight hospitalization. The rollers were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from the first level of scaffolding.

An employee and a coworker were assembling a manure agitator frame. They were using a rough-terrain forklift and nylon sling to support the weight of the right-side stabilizer wheel bracket while manually aligning and pinning alignment holes between the wheel bracket and mounting flanges on the frame. While walking around the stabilizer wheel bracket, the coworker bumped into the edge of the stabilizer wheel bracket. At that time, the bracket position shifted while the employee was using one of his left-hand fingers to feel the mounting hole alignment between the mounting flange and stabilizer wheel bracket. His fingertip was pinched in the shear point between the wheel bracket and mounting flange, resulting in surgical amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning debris from a bin when a forklift operator came into the employee's workspace and struck the bin she was cleaning. The employee was struck by the bin and lost her balance, falling to the ground and fracturing her femur at the hip.
An employee was trimming a palm tree from a boom lift when he fell approximately 25 feet. He suffered fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing satellite TV at a residence when he suffered heat exhaustion. He was hospitalized hospital for treatment.
An employee was using a small air-driven chisel to remove hardened asphalt from the conveyor slats of a hot mix asphalt transfer device when a piece of asphalt flew into his right eye.
An employee was cleaning acid out of a vessel, tripped, and sustained acid burns to the neck and arm.
On July 19, 2017, at 9:29 AM, an employee was processing a donation and fell from the trailer to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a fractured clavicle, scapula, ribs and a head laceration.
An employee was punching holes in metal plates using an ironworker machine when a piece of metal came out of the machine and struck the employee in the neck.
An employee was unloading rotors from his pickup truck when a two-wheel dolly fell on his right pinky finger and smashed it against the truck bed. His right pinky finger was amputated.
