The employee and a coworker then raised the bundle around 4 feet high and started to cut the metal strapping off the bundle. The employees were on their third band when the crane was moved southward, pushing them over a stack of angles and pinning them against some pipe. The material struck the employee's chest, cracking ribs and puncturing a lung. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was heating up an area on a cast work roll with a torch. Grease was sealed in a compartment on the work roll. When the compartment was heated, the employee was splashed with heated grease, suffering second degree burns on his neck, chest, and forearms.
An employee collided with a parked car while driving around the corner of a building.
An employee suffered a right middle finger amputation while working with a chain.
An employee was repairing a broken link on a flat breader machine's conveyor belt when a coworker activated the machine. The machine then fractured two of the employee's left-hand fingers.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with burns and other arc-flash-related injuries.
An employee was checking the load on his forklift to investigate a sound he heard when the two-pallet-high load shifted and the product fell, hitting and fracturing his right lower leg.
An employee was exposed to carbon monoxide while washing trays, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was climbing the ladder on the back of his tractor trailer when his fingers became entangled in the ladder and he lost his balance. He fell 5 to 6 feet to the ground and sustained fractured ribs, a left pointer finger laceration, and bleeding in the brain.

An employee was installing a computer cable in the ceiling while working from a ladder. While he was putting the ceiling tile back in place, he slipped and fell to the floor, breaking ribs and his back.
An employee was milking a cow when it kicked the employee's face, causing head trauma.

An employee was removing a 1' X 4' board from a stopped drive belt while standing on a 3-foot fixed ladder when he lost his balance. As he was trying to grab the rail, his left wrist struck the metal guardrail and was fractured, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were changing the grinding hammers on a tub grinder that is used to grind mulch. As one employee was using a sledgehammer to pound one of the grinding hammers, a piece of the sledgehammer chipped off and struck the second employee in the arm, cutting an artery and requiring surgery.
An employee was repairing equipment at the job site and became overheated.
Employees were rounding up bulls when a horse bucked an employee off and then rolled over the employee. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was walking down stairs, missed the last step and fell causing her to sustain a right ankle fracture which required surgery.

An employee was cutting a sample belt from a cure press to check for length when his left hand was pulled between the stretcher ring and the torque team belts on the press resulting in fractures to his left ring and pinky fingers and burns to his left hand and forearm.

An employee was using a table saw to make a part for a door. He was cleaning some of the wood dust and scraps from the side of the blade when his left thumb was pulled into the saw blade, amputating his thumb tip below the nailbed but above the knuckle. The saw was unguarded at the time.
On July 26, 2017, an employee was using a pry bar to lift a manhole cover when the pry bar slipped and the cover landed on his left hand, amputating the ring finger.
An employee was moving carts to be loaded onto a truck when his left middle fingertip was crushed and amputated between two cart handles.
An employee was stacking finished 12 packs on a pallet. He complained of being dizzy and went to the hospital where he was admitted with carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning.
After installing a mixer on top of a water tower and inspecting the tower in direct sunlight, an employee experienced cramping and could not move. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
After finishing his courier route, an employee began to experience cramps and later passed out due to dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was exiting her mail delivery vehicle when her feet became tangled underneath the vehicle and she fell, fracturing both ankles.
An employee became unconscious and was hospitalized for possible heat stroke.
An employee was lifting a piece of metal and it fell, amputating the tip of the left thumb.
An employee experienced heat-related illness and was hospitalized after working outside changing crossties on a railroad track.
Two employees were engaged in horseplay on the tongue trimming line resulting in injury to one of the employees. The injured employee sustained a right forearm laceration from a knife.
An employee was stepping from a company van when the van slipped into gear and moved. The employee was knocked to the ground and suffered a broken left femur.
An employee was using a grinder to cut a threaded rod when the grinder cut his arm.
While performing routine maintenance on an HVAC unit, an employee's shirt was caught in the pulley. The employee reached to pull their shirt free and sustained a right pinky fingertip amputation.
Two employees were in an open trench checking and making a grade when they were struck by a piece of rock. They both suffered leg injuries and were hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on the kitchen floor, suffering a broken femur.
While moving pipes with an overhead crane, an employee became weak, dizzy, and lightheaded from heat exposure, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was shutting down a restaurant's alarm when his left pointer finger was caught between the door jamb and the door, amputating his left pointer fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was standing on a ladder using a hammer drill when the drill amputated his left pinky finger.
An employee was spraying a rotating thigh de-boning machine with a high-pressure hose when her left hand became caught in the machine. Her left hand and arm were fractured.
An employee was installing underground powerlines on a very hot day when he started to sweat profusely and experienced heat cramps. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was lifting a cylinder off a rack when it slipped and caught the employee's right index finger between the cylinder and the rack, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was trying to catch a steel plate weighing approximately 45 pounds as it fell from a cart when his left pinky finger was caught and partially amputated in an open hole on the plate.

An employee was loading vehicles onto a two-level vehicle hauler. After driving a vehicle onto the upper level of the hauler, the employee exited the driver-side door, slipped, and fell to the concrete ground, breaking both ankles.

An employee was cleaning shavings from a drill when a coworker pushed a rail tie down the rollers. The injured employee's left index fingertip was pinched and partially amputated between the tie and the drill.
An employee's left arm became caught and injured in a closing wrapper guard door.
An employee was rigging the hook on a crane when his hand was caught between the hook and the D-ring, lacerating his left middle fingertip.
An employee's gloved hand was pulled into a conveyor shaft, twisting the employee's left hand around the shaft and severely spraining the ring finger. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was working in a yard servicing tires when the employee had an allergic reaction, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was conducting a taste-odor-appearance test when caustic soda that was still in the system entered her mouth, causing a burning sensation and swelling to her lips and tongue.
An employee was beginning to bolt up a section of pipe. The pipe fell, which resulted in the amputation of the left leg above the knee.
An employee was troubleshooting the corrugator when his hand came in contact with a rotating part resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee was operating a miter saw and experienced kickback when the material became bound. The employee's fingers were thrust under the blade which resulted in the amputation of three fingers.
An employee was tightening a bolt from a 4-foot A-frame ladder when the employee fell to the ground, breaking the left leg above the ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when she twisted her ankle and fell toward the sidewalk. She used her left hand to catch herself and broke her left wrist.
An employee set a 400-pound metal spindle on top of a metal table so that he could inspect it. The spindle then rolled off the table and hit his lower left leg, breaking it and requiring surgery.

An employee was performing maintenance on a hoist that was on a mill roof when the employee fell approximately 14 feet through a roof opening to the floor below, suffering a broken right elbow, broken right pelvis, and head trauma.

An employee was using a forklift to pull merchandise from a shelf when the employee was pinned between the forklift and a steel column, suffering a fractured rib, head bleed, and fracture to the left temporal area.
An employee was using hydraulic tongs to run pipe in a hole when the slips failed, causing the tongs to come down on the employee's right foot, fracturing it.
An employee was tripping pipe when his finger was caught and amputated between a set of power tongs and a pipe wrench.

An employee was trying to enter a room when she collided with a coworker, fell backward, and struck her head on the concrete floor. She sustained a contusion to the back of her head and a small brain hemorrhage, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing out a motor on a piece of equipment when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the equipment's chain and sprocket.

An employee was sorting lumber at an edger saw when a board became hung up on a cross-tie. As he tried to remove the board, the cross-tie fell and the lumber fractured his left index and middle fingers.

Two employees were traveling in an all-terrain vehicle with coworkers when it flipped over. The first employee fractured the right ankle, requiring surgery. The second employee suffered head and facial lacerations.

On July 26, 2017, an employee drove a utility vehicle up a hill to refuel a water pump. While driving the vehicle off the hill, the employee ran into mud, at which time the vehicle's back end kicked out. As he was trying to stop the vehicle, he fractured his left tibia, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had been assisting with a pipe weld. During clean-up operations, he began experiencing muscle cramps and shortness of breath. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was digging a ditch for an electrical line when he suffered from dehydration and heat exhaustion.
While adjusting a cotter pin in an engine, an employee's finger was injured, which resulted in the amputation of the fingertip.

The injured employee was standing on a wellhead that weighed about 8,000 pounds. The wellhead was sitting on a ring gasket about 10 feet off the floor. While the employee was unlatching the chain from the elevator to the wellhead, his colleague moved the elevator. The employee and the wellhead fell about 10 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a lacerated liver and spleen, as well as multiple fractures, which included several ribs, the pelvis, and the left arm.
While loading a forklift, an employee sustained a broken arm when the forklift fell on him.
An employee was walking and guiding a steel stairway suspended by a 7,000 pound forklift and had his right foot run over by the forklift causing a severe dislocation requiring surgery.

An employee was putting a tire on a vehicle that was on the automotive lift. The employee passed out due to heat exhaustion and struck his face and jaw on the metal lift frame resulting in a fractured lower jaw.

The employee had dismounted his pallet jack and was selecting the store order when another employee who was driving a forklift attempted to pass him. The selecting employee was struck by the forklift on his left foot as the forklift passed by resulting in a crushing injury.
An employee was replacing a roller belt on a conveyor system. The conveyor was running at the time and the employee sustained a partial amputation injury.
An employee was feeding a bearing through a machine when the grinding wheel shattered and severed a finger.
An employee was trimming trees and suffered a heat related illness.

An employee was asked to hold a wrench that was attached with a rope to a rod. The employee was retrieving the rod from the ground while the jaw on the drill rig was turning and the employee's left lower arm got caught between the wrench and the drill rig jaw. He was hospitalized for injuries to his lower left arm.

An employee was walking down concrete steps and caught his heel on the last step falling backwards. Both knees buckled due to the way he landed on his feet. The employee suffered torn patellar tendons in both knees.
An employee was cleaning the boiler sink when he lost his footing on a three step ladder and fell into the boiler sink resulting in burns to his lower extremities. He was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was securing tarps over a load of lumber with bungee straps. The "s" hook came out of the grommet and the bungee strap recoiled and the "s" hook struck the employee's right eye resulting in a severe laceration.
An employee was cleaning out a clogged mixer. The mixer cycled while the employee's hand was inside and partially amputated her left middle finger. The guard had been removed at the time.
An employee was on a pipe rack guiding pipe as it was being loaded. The employee fell 13 feet and broke his ribs.

An employee had been removing valve caps from acetylene cylinders using an electric drill equipped with an attachment. Acetylene gas was ignited by a spark and the employee was hospitalized for burns.
An employee had his hand in a door when he stumbled. The door closed pinching his finger and crushing the middle fingertip. The employee had the fingertip surgically removed.

An employee was loading pallets onto a trailer. After loading one, he turned and tripped on another pallet inside the trailer and fell resulting in a dislocated right knee and patellar tendon rupture.

On 7/26/2017, an employee was working on the forms and finishing concrete of curbs / sidewalks / driveways at a worksite. At the end of the workday, the employee started to experience cramping in their hands and legs. On 7/27/2017, the employee was admitted to the hospital for heat exhaustion.

On July 27, 2017, at approximately 7:10 a.m., while an employee was using a shear machine to cut a piece of steel, the back end of the steel came down and pinched their finger between the table top and the steel piece. The employee suffered an amputation to the left middle fingertip.

An employee was chipping asphalt in a dump truck. The employee tossed the spud bar from the truck and caught his right index finger between the spud bar and the truck body resulting in amputation of the first digit.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof and fell off the ladder resulting in a fractured rib.
An employee was stepping onto the top rung of a steel 3-rung fixed ladder when he slipped and hit his shin resulting in a fractured tibia.

An employee was observing a distillation column. He walked inside an area that was barricaded by a scaffold and fell approximately 25 feet, hitting a pipe on the way down. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, facial fracture, back injury, and also needed sutures.
An employee was cleaning out debris from a rip saw. The blade had not stopped moving and contacted the employee's finger. The pinky finger was amputated between the second and third joints.
An employee working with meat on a conveyor had his finger amputated when it was caught in the running conveyor.

An employee was shaking metal bar joists bundled on the forklifts to separate the metal bar joists and to move them to the staging area for edge grinding. One metal bar joist broke free from the bundle and smashed the employee's finger in between the metal joist and the forks of the forklift. The employee suffered an amputation to his left middle finger up to the first knuckle.

Two employees were installing mesh wire from the fifth level of a scaffold. The planks tilted to one side of the scaffold and the employees fell 40 feet. They were hospitalized with a broken left arm and broken ribs.
An employee's left index finger was amputated when it was caught in a door jam.
An employee was pumping lead molds in a work environment of 95 degrees Fahrenheit. After finishing his shift, the employee became dehydrated and had cramps. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been installing insulation and leaned against the safety rail of a second story interior balcony and fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a back injury and fractured vertebrae.
An employee had a metal die (121" long, 6" high, 7" deep ) on a bending machine. The metal die fell 103 inches to the ground and onto his legs, shattering bones in his right leg.
An employee was conducting steel roofing work and fell approximately 17 feet from the roof, breaking the hip and arm.
An employee was signing papers when the wall of a mobile home came down and struck her on the back resulting in a vertebra compression injury.
An employee was walking on the flat metal roof of a warehouse and fell through a skylight resulting in broken ribs and lacerations.
An employee was assembling a scaffold and fell approximately 12 feet resulting in a left hip fracture and a right shoulder contusion. A harness was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a punch press and suffered an amputation injury to the left hand.

On July 27, 2017, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was cleaning out the radish topper and reached inside to remove material. The machine was running and the employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee sustained left arm and leg contusions while driving a utility vehicle off road when the vehicle struck a tree.
A temporary employee was operating a mill machine which had two-handed controls. Her glove got caught in the spindle resulting in an amputation.

An employee was operating an excavator to excavate a pipeline. While scooping the bucket toward the machine, it hit a rock, and a tooth broke off and went through the windshield of the excavator. The employee sustained a broken right leg.
An employee was walking into the building after lunch when the wind slammed the door on his pointer finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee suffered a shoulder dislocation while carrying a sheet of membrane to another location with another employee.
An employee was walking a horse when the horse reared up and kicked the employee. The employee's right arm was broken in two places requiring surgery and hospitalization.
While walking down the hallway, an employee slipped and fell fracturing the left patella.
An employee was driving a powered industrial vehicle and struck a wall resulting in an amputation injury.
While driving a standup forklift, an employee's left foot was pinned and injured between the forklift and a concrete bollard.
An employee fell three feet off a metal rack system, resulting in head trauma requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift when another forklift ran into the injured employee, causing a laceration to the foot.
An employee was hospitalized after being splashed with frying oil.

The injured employee and another employee were lining up a W access adapter/base plate. Three of the four bearing pins were located/lined up. The fourth pin was then located/lined up and the base dropped, pinching the injured employee's thumb. The employee pulled his thumb away from the base resulting in amputation of soft tissue.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a conveyor. While using a towel to wipe down the equipment, the employee sustained an avulsion to the left index finger and an amputation to the first knuckle of the left middle finger. The equipment was running at the time.
An employee was operating a food slicer to cut potatoes, when her fingers made contact with the blade. The first two fingertips on right hand were amputated, and a nail was damaged.

The injured employee was inside the plant in the basket of a 60' aerial lift with another employee at the lift controls. The injured employee's head was pinned between the basket and the ceiling beam resulting in a fractured skull and bleeding from the nose and mouth. The injuries will require surgery.

An employee was repairing a 55-gallon stainless steel mixing tank from a six foot step ladder. He was positioned on the second step of the ladder when he miss-stepped and slid down the side of the tank. He was hospitalized for internal bleeding.

An employee was unloading a piggyback forklift from a tandem truck. The employee observed his truck rolling away and while attempting to catch his truck he was run over, resulting in a broken right foot.

Two workers were hospitalized with severe burns when a system malfunction in the industrial filter station caused rupture disks to burst and an overflow container to fill beyond its capacity ejecting "standard liquor," a hot liquid, onto nearby employees.
An employee was on a stack of lumber and fell about 10 feet, resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was struck by a trackhoe resulting in a broken right foot.

An employee was injured during tear down of an oil rig to be transported and set up at a new drilling site. The employee removed a retaining pin that held the pole upright and the pole fell onto the employee's leg breaking the femur bone and requiring surgery and hospitalization.
Two employees tried to calm a resident. The resident bit one of the employees, resulting in an amputation of the right thumb in the middle of the nail.
On 7/28/17, an employee was descending the stairwell and fell breaking a bone in their back.
On July 28, 2017, an employee suffered an amputation of the left ring finger when changing a mold.

At the packaging area in the facility, there was a piece of plastic hanging up to block cold air from a shrink tunnel cooler from blowing towards an employee's work station. The employee was placing a sticker to hold the plastic in place when her finger contacted the return side of the conveyor belt and was pinched between the belt and a metal support leg. The employee sustained an amputation to her left second digit below the first joint.

An employee was backing a forklift into the building. A finger was caught between the forklift and the garage door track resulting in a crushing injury that required amputation of the finger during surgery.
An employee's fingers were in the belt guard of a jammed and inoperable conveyor. Once the jam was cleared, the conveyor started to cycle and three fingers on the left hand were amputated.
An employee working in an overhead lift was crushed by a structural ceiling beam when the lift inadvertently went into gear.

An employee was tracing overhead conduit in a mechanical room. The room has HVAC ductwork that runs from the ceiling down to 2' x 2' louvers in the floor. As the employee was looking up at the conduit, he stepped backwards and fell through one of the louvers approximately 10 feet to a lower level, suffering a head injury.

On July 28, 2017, an employee was removing metal parts from the laser table and stacking them on a skid. As the employee placed a part (approximately 100 lbs.) on the skid, the left middle finger was pinched between two parts resulting in a distal amputation of the finger.

An employee was assisting in rigging the pull head from the trench box. The pull head slipped out of the chain while suspended and fell to the ground, striking the employee and causing a fractured right scapula, fractured sternum, nine fractured ribs, and a bruised right lung.

An employee was installing an electrical box (110 outlet) and received an electrical shock causing electrical injuries and burns on the center chest (entry point) and burns on the left hand (exit point).
An employee was using a circular saw to cross-cut a 2" x 6" board. The employee reached under the saw and his left middle finger was cut.
An employee was handling plants in the warehouse and inhaled some pollen from an Aglaonema plant causing an allergic reaction that required hospitalization.
An employee parked a pickup truck close to a bin and got out. He tripped on the foundation or something leaning against the bin and fell, breaking his arm.
An employee received electrical burns on the right arm, neck and face when a stirrup fell and struck an energized part causing an arc flash.
An employee's foot was struck by a forklift's rear wheel. The employee required hospitalization for a broken bone.

An employee was clearing a jam on the hot fill machine and amputated the left index fingertip when the machine started up unexpectedly. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing scale from a furnace and was overcome by heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder nailing struts. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained a back injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee had been working on a frack tank, when a truck hit the tank, causing the tank to hit the employee. The employee required hospitalization for a compound fracture of the left leg.

On July 27, 2017, an employee had been welding on steel casing outside. The employee felt sick/nauseous and went home. On July 28, 2017, the employee tried to work but felt nauseated and sick by 2:00 p.m. and went to the hospital for heat exhaustion.
An employee was welding a muffler onto a backup generator and something got under his glove and into the skin on his right finger. The employee was hospitalized the next day for an infection.
An employee put on work gloves and felt a stinging sensation due to a possible insect bite.

An employee was putting a piece of asphalt in the barrel of a skip loader and the tip of his left middle finger was pinched between the loader and the piece of asphalt. This resulted in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was in a manlift preparing to pressure wash a pump jack. When the pump jack lowered it struck the manlift basket. The employee suffered two broken toes on the left foot.

An employee was walking up stairs from the lower parking lot to the upper parking lot. At the top of the stairs, the employee fell and her right knee hit the paving bricks/concrete on the ground, fracturing the knee.

An employee took wood from the bin off the side of the large forklift. While he was handing the wood to another employee the rear tire of the forklift rolled up onto his left heel. His foot was pinned by the tire and the forklift had to be reversed off the foot. The employee sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was walking up a set of portable steps while carrying racking to stack in a trailer. The employee fell down three steps and was hospitalized for three broken ribs and a cut to the head requiring stitches.
While changing out a paper core on the DRC machine an employee's hand was caught in a running nip point resulting in an amputation on the right hand.

While clearing a piece of stuck paper, an employee sustained finger lacerations and amputation of the left middle and ring fingertips after their hand was pulled into the rope/sheave nips in the after-dryer section of the paper machine.
An employee was hanging drywall while on a ladder when he slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing his knee cap.

While rigging up the top drive, employees needed to move the Kelly hose into position. They had to swing the ST-80 all the way around. The injured employee was in a crush point, and his foot was caught while stepping out of the crush point. The ST-80 was pulled over, trapping the employee's body between the ST-80 and the derrick leg. The employee sustained three broken ribs, a lacerated liver, and a collapsed lung, all on the right side.
An employee was working to reposition an exhaust hood. The hood fell over and the employee sustained an ankle injury.
An employee was working with a high pressure pump replacing swab. When the cap plug was unscrewed it fell out onto the employee's right middle finger, breaking the finger.
An employee was unloading stock from a trailer and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee slipped on a wet surface while on a roof and tore his hamstring. He was admitted to the hospital the following day.
While an employee was removing a clamp from manifold plungers, the plungers came together and amputated the middle and ring fingertips on the left hand.
While conducting maintenance, an employee was pinned by a counterweight on a machine and sustained a chest injury. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was standing outside a storage tank while water blasting operations were being conducted inside. The employee's upper legs were cut by water coming out of the manway from a water blaster being used to blast asphalt inside the storage tank.
On July 29, 2017, an employee operating a forklift received an injury that resulted in the amputation of the lower right leg.
An employee was delivering mail and became dizzy and sweaty. The employee was hospitalized for a dehydration related injury.

An employee was walking across stored rebar on the ground to access some framework angle iron. He retrieved a piece of angle iron and was returning back across the rebar, when he slipped and fell. The band of rebar that was being carried in his right hand came down on his left ring finger causing an open fracture which required surgery.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to hit a piece of pipe. The hammer deflected and smashed his right pinky finger between the head of the hammer and the tubing tongs. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to his right pinky finger resulting in hospitalization.

The employee was assisting with mobile rig removal from a well site. As pipe was being pulled from the hole, rope used for pullout got caught up and pipe began to slip. The employee reached in to grab the pipe and his hand/finger was caught between piping and the drilling equipment, resulting in amputation of the right middle finger down to the knuckle.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was loading an empty trailer with rolls of paper using a forklift. The employee began experiencing irritation to his eyes, lips and respiratory system. The employee started having chest pains and leg muscle spasms approximately two hours later and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the palletizer and was caught/struck by the machine, resulting in a fractured foot.
While conducting maintenance on an actuator valve on a milk tank, an employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee working on the HVAC system on the roof became nauseous and couldn't keep fluids down. The employee was hospitalized for heat related illness.
On July 30, 2017, a temporary employee was operating an off-road vehicle on the beach when the vehicle rolled over and injured his left foot. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee tripped over a floor mat and fell, sustaining a fractured left forearm.

An employee was operating an order picker in the elevated position when it malfunctioned and he was unable to lower the unit and himself to ground level. As he was attempting to activate the unit, his right hand was caught in a pinch point between the unit's rail and arm, suffering compression injuries.

On 7/31/2017, an employee was trying to repair a spiker machine. The employee was working under the machine and could not reach a broken screw. Another employee got in the machine and made an adjustment to the anvil so that the other employee could reach the screw. After the adjustment was made, the employee accidentally pumped the controls for the anvil again, causing it to cycle and pin the other employee's right hand to the track. The anvil then hammered approximately 3 to 5 times, crushing the employee's right index finger and requiring surgical amputation. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
While unloading a pallet, an employee turned and slipped, falling on the right hip and fracturing it.
While an employee was removing a steel stall with a chain to load on a crane, the steel stall shifted causing the amputation of his left index finger.

An employee was starting the main compressor and checking it to see if it was operating correctly. The main airline supply hose, which comes from the air dryer to the sandblasting pot, came off and struck the employee in the lower right leg, resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was putting a part in the circular saw. The employee's left index finger got caught in the connector hole and the saw came down resulting in a fingertip amputation.

At approximately 9:10 AM, an employee was milling rubber using a milling machine. As he was feeding rubber into the machine, his right hand was pulled into the area between the two rollers.  The employee sustained an amputation to the tip of his right ring finger, and avulsions to his right index and middle fingers.
While carrying and loading cast iron boiler parts into a trailer an employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between boiler parts.

The injured employee was assisting a truck driver from another company when the truck lurched forward and ran over the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis and a ruptured bladder.
An employee suffered a heat-related illnesses while picking up trash.
An employee was on the roof of a building and was cutting a six-inch pipe to install a device on it. The grinder he was using kicked back, cut through his glove, and cut a tendon on his right hand.

Two employees were working in a man lift basket about 12 to 13 feet off the ground. They were using an overhead hoist to reposition a piece of equipment they were working on in the vertical boring mill. As the overhead hoist was being lowered, the limit switch plate of the hoist came in contact with an employee's left hand, which was resting on the man lift railing. The injured employee sustained the amputation of the left pinky fingertip.

An employee was clearing land and piling up debris to burn. As the employee was about to use diesel and a lighting touch to light up the pile of debris, he was exposed to fire and sustained burns to his arms, face, and the top of his back.
An employee was using the chain saw to remove the chime bone from rib-eye meat and amputated the right thumb tip.

An employee was bringing up mail in a cart from the basement. The employee exited the freight elevator and went to open the door to the lobby with her left hand. When she pulled on the door it gave no resistance and flew open. The employee's left pinky finger was caught and fractured between the steel casing for the doorstop and the door handle.
An employee had been working on building a foundation for a residential home. The employee was cleaning up for the day and collapsed from heat exhaustion.
An employee fell from the passenger side rear step of a garbage truck during routine collection. The employee sustained head and arm injuries.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and struck a safety kick plate. The employee fell to the ground.
An employee was doing milling work on a part using a milling machine when his right thumb was caught and partially amputated.
An employee was cutting 4" round solid bar stock on a band saw. When the employee reached to retrieve a part, the blade amputated part of the index and middle fingers.
An employee was positioned between a dynamic tamp table and a static structure when his body hit a switch that engaged the tamp table. The employee sustained a fracture to his left pelvic area.
An employee's left ankle was caught and fractured between a gantry press and a work table when the gantry rolled laterally.
On July 31, 2017, an employee suffered a broken leg when a pipe plug released under the pressure of compressed air and struck the employee.

On July 31, 2017, an employee's finger was crushed between a concrete form and a curved radius bar during form stripping operations. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the middle fingertip on the right hand.

An employee was stepping out of a semi-truck when he slipped on a wet step and struck the ground, straining his right knee and spraining his left wrist.
While servicing a water heater, an employee suffered burns to the hands and face.

An employee was unplugging beans from the squeezer at a waste pit. The employee put a 2x4 through an access window to break up the bridged beans. The 2x4 caught on the auger and slammed up against the waste pit chute. The employee's left ring fingertip was then pinched and amputated between the 2x4 and the waste pit chute.
An employee was repairing a flat tire when it came off its rim and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken rib and was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing jammed product from a guillotine cutter when it contacted his finger, amputating the first digit of his right ring finger.

An employee was climbing into a service truck while a coworker was moving an excavator into the parking area. The excavator boom struck the service truck door, which closed on the employee and broke his left leg.

An employee was attempting to remove a lettuce core from a conveyor when her glove and then left forearm was caught between the conveyor and a roller. She broke her forearm and required hospitalization.

Two employees were lifting an impression roll with a hydraulic lift cart when the roll fell off the cart and struck one of the employee's in the right leg. The employee's leg broke in the shin area and required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting chicken with a cleaver when it cut his left middle finger to the bone.
An employee was checking his trailer when he slipped on the trailer's bottom step and broke his ankle.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when his left foot was caught between the vehicle and an upright, causing lacerations and fractures to his left foot.

An employee was removing a skylight from a roof when the wood truss supporting the skylight collapsed. The employee fell 20 to 30 feet through the opening and landed on the plywood that was covering the pool below, suffering a back fracture.

An employee was tightening a bolt with a rotating bolt fastener when the employee's glove became caught in the gap between the sleeve and socket extension. The fastener then amputated the left-hand ring finger.
An employee's foot became caught in some banding while stepping off a forklift, causing the employee to fall to the floor and break a femur.

On August 7, 2017, at approximately 2:30PM, employees were coming down from the roof for a break. An employee unhooked the harness of their personal fall arrest equipment to come down the ladder, lost footing and fell approximately 24 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken femur, broken wrist, punctured lung, and a fractured hip.
An employee was moving a plant container when a copperhead snake bit his left index finger.
An employee was pulling electrical conductors when a conductor that was under tension struck the employee's left eye, causing tissue damage.

An employee was attempting to remove a pin from a derrick when a forklift operator moved the derrick board unexpectedly. The employee's right thumb was then caught and amputated between the pin and the handrail.
An employee was delivering mail to a business, tripped over a wooden walkway separator and fell striking a concrete planter and breaking several ribs.

Two employees conducting maintenance had just installed a new case belt and were working to make sure the belt was tracking correctly. The injured employee's left hand was caught between the belt and the end-roller, partially amputating his ring fingertip.
On August 7, 2017, at 5:45 PM, an employee and a coworker were arguing when the coworker stabbed the employee in the face and back with a knife or sharp object.
An employee lost consciousness while cleaning a small cut on their finger at the sink. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a head injury, skull fracture, and brain hemorrhage.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, suffering a severe back strain and pain.
An employee fell approximately 7 feet off a wall after climbing a ladder, hitting the ground and suffering a head injury.
An employee helped a coworker clear a jam on a stacker. The employee's hand was still on the equipment when it was restarted and his left thumb was partially amputated.
An employee was moving a box of pillows when he tripped over a piece of tape that was hanging off the box. He fell to the floor, fracturing three ribs and spraining his left shoulder and neck.
An employee was holding a board that was being cut in half with a circular saw when the saw jumped and swung backwards, hitting and cutting the employee's right thumb. The employee had surgery.
An employee was attempting to pick up a pallet when his foot became caught and he fell to the ground, breaking his right femur.
An employee was trying to remove a small piece of plastic near an extrusion die when his hand was caught and crushed between the die and the adjacent rollers.
An employee came to pick up a stack of recycled cardboard bales from a customer when the top bale fell and struck the employee, who suffered a fractured hip and fractured L1 vertebra.
An employee tripped over the leg of a clothing rack and fell, fracturing a shoulder.
An employee had been removing concrete forms from columns. The employee stepped onto a piece of plywood, which gave way, and fell 14 feet to the ground below. He fractured his lower back.

An employee was sandblasting steel above his head. While he was adjusting his hand position on the nozzle, it slipped out of his hand. When he tried to catch the nozzle, it blasted his arm above the elbow, lacerating his arm and a vein.
An employee was using a straight-line rip saw to shave wood when a 9-inch piece of wood impaled his right-side lower body.
An employee was checking the air brakes on the tractor trailer when it backed into the employee resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee ran outside to confront a customer stealing a generator and was struck by the customer's car door. The employee fell and the employee's head struck the asphalt, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving equipment and helping to load pipe when his thumb was caught and amputated between a generator and a piece of steel square tubing.
An employee was caught between a stack of lumber and a chain guard, injuring the internal left pelvic area. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access the HVAC system on a roof when the ladder came off the building. He fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, fracturing his legs.
An employee's right index finger was caught in a door jamb when the door closed, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was clearing plastic from the flow head of a blow molder wheel when he contacted a 220-volt circuit, suffering an electrical shock and an abrasion above the wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a dock plate that was 41 inches off the ground, preparing to load a truck trailer. As he was raising the trailer door, the truck pulled away, causing him to lose his balance and fall off the dock plate. He fractured his tibia.
An employee was riding in a cage on a forklift when the cage tipped off the forks. The employee's left middle finger was caught and partially amputated in the cage's metal platform.

An employee was standing on a footstool to remove a grating guard from underneath an overhead conveyor. He lost his balance while removing a cotter pin from the grating, and his right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the pin and grating.
An employee was driving and collecting recycling waste when he fell out of the driver cabin, hit the ground, and lost consciousness.
An employee was trying to move a cart with granite on it when the cart and granite overturned and struck the employee, injuring his neck and breaking the vertebrae in his lower back.
An employee was pulling a pin that holds the lip of the truck to the dock. The dock plate fell and caught his left thumb, crushing it.
An employee's left index finger was caught and crushed between an elevating latch and a pipe stump on a drilling rig, requiring amputation.
An employee was operating a notching machine when the employee's hand became caught in the machine, resulting in amputation of fingers.
An employee was washing surgical instruments in the decontamination room. She turned to take the instruments to the other sink, slipped and fell, sustaining a dislocation and a fractured humerus.
An employee fell 13.5 feet to the ground while connecting steel beams in a storm shelter, suffering a broken left arm and concussion.
An employee was helping to form concrete when he became hot and passed out. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was operating a forklift when he lost control of the equipment. His foot was caught and crushed between the forklift and a steel pole.

On August 8, 2017, at approximately 2:50 p.m., an employee tripped on a pallet inside the trailer of a delivery truck. As he fell, he reached for the rope that pulls the door down and his left hand became entangled in the rope. The injury resulted in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder stocking a top rack when the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a concussion.

An employee was stabilizing a tug boat that was being lifted by a crane. When the crane operator lifted the tug boat, it shifted and struck the employee. He was caught between the tug and the crane's concrete base, crushing his right leg.

An employee was installing an outrigger on a frac unit. The employee climbed a ladder to install the top pivot pin while a loader was positioning the outrigger. The top pin would not fully slide into place because the bottom pin's eye was not aligned properly. The employee dismounted the ladder and pushed the lower part of the outrigger to align the pins and eyes with the mount. When the employee placed the lower pin into the eyes, the top pin fell through the eyes and struck the employee's right hand, smashing the index and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a chain conveyor, moving slabs to be cut. The employee's left index finger was pinned in the drive pocket of the chain, pulling all the flesh off the finger.
An employee exited a fork truck to stack boxes of cereal on a pallet when the fork truck pinned him, injuring his right hand, arm, leg, and foot.

On August 8, 2017, around 4:30 p.m., an employee was helping a forklift operator load 18,000 lbs. of galvanized pipe into the back of a flatbed trailer. The injured employee was holding a trailer stake and when the forklift operator lowered the load onto the truck, the employee's hand with the stake drifted under the trailer. The trailer came down and crushed his hand between it and the stake. He suffered a fracture to his left ring finger metacarpal and was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting coaxial cable when he was stung by a bee or wasp. Later that evening, after his shift, he began experiencing an allergic reaction and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and veered into some pallets. The employee was hospitalized for leg fractures.
While walking into the store, an employee tripped over a door mat and fell, breaking her femur.
An employee was changing heat paper when the employee's finger got caught in a clamp that holds the heat paper. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was hooking up a trailer onto a truck at the job site. When the truck driver moved the truck, the trailer fell on his right foot. He suffered foot and toe lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee was rolling a roll of liner so he could lift it using a forklift. The roll slipped off the carrier and injured the employee's lower left leg.

While making an adjustment to a pouch manufacturing machine, an employee had his left thumb pinched by the machine's cutting blades resulting in partial amputation of the thumb. At the time the interlocked door had been bypassed.
An employee was clearing a film jam on a meat packaging machine when his left hand was crushed between moving parts, fracturing the two middle fingers.

An employee was disconnecting a hose from a pressurized railcar tanker when sulfuric acid sprayed from the tanker's attachment tube up the sleeves of the chemical jacket he was wearing. He suffered chemical burns to the arms and upper body, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping a concrete pump operator with a concrete system. He was trying to pick up a 4'' clamp that was wedged under the concrete pipeline when it surged, smashing his right middle finger and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was pushing a four-wheeled container in the rear cargo compartment of a truck toward a loading dock and over metal dock plates when he slipped and fell off the dock plate, injuring his right hand.

An employee was entering a portable water tank to erect a scaffold when he fell through a hole in the platform about 10 to 15 feet to the tank's floor. He suffered a broken left leg, back injuries, and two head lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting counter weight cylinders for clearance when the employee fell from the top of the counter weights to the crane deck, suffering a facial fracture.

An employee was trimming a tree canopy using a polecat aerial that was parked in a median. The traffic lane underneath was not active, but at some point the polecat overturned in the roadway. The employee hit the pavement and the aerial basket, breaking his femur, dislocating his shoulder, losing two teeth, and lacerating his chin.

An employee had been prepping concrete forms for removal and was on top of one of the forms. While moving from one anchor point to another, the employee fell off the form. His self-retracting lanyard failed and he fell to the concrete, 16 to 18 feet below, sustaining injuries to his head, hip and wrist.
An employee was working underneath a truck checking the wiring when a coworker got into the truck and drove away. The employee was dragged 2 feet, suffering injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee had dismounted a vehicle when it began to roll. As he was chasing his work vehicle, he was crushed between his vehicle and another vehicle, injuring his torso.

While an employee was checking the cam on a PLC machine, the machine indexed and caught the employee's right hand between the spring platform and the lock cylinder, resulting in a laceration. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.
An employee was involved in a golf cart accident resulting in a broken ankle.

On August 8, 2017, an employee was unloading feed from a truck to bins when an auger arm exiting the truck became bogged down. As he went to open or close the door of the auger, his left hand was caught in the auger, amputating his index, middle, and ring fingers and crushing his pinky finger.
An employee was putting product on the shelves of a produce cooler vault when he fell from a step ladder, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was cleaning an energized rotary valve when it amputated the employee's right index finger at the second joint. The valve was not locked out at the time.
An employee was lowering the leg of a demountable box when the leg fell down and caught his right index finger in a pinch point, amputating the fingertip.

An employee fell from a flatbed trailer to the ground while securing a load, suffering five broken ribs, a broken clavicle, broken scapula, broken shoulder blade, punctured lung, and slight concussion.
An employee was operating an up-cut saw when it amputated three of his right-hand fingers.
An employee was removing product from a hopper to prevent a jam when one of his left-hand fingers was pinched between the hopper's conveyor belt and guard.
Employees were using a fork truck to move a fertilizer hopper when the hopper fell on one of the employees, resulting in a crushed pelvis and ribs.
An employee was using a wooden post to remove a roll of paper from a press when his right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the post and a roll shaft.
On August 8, 2017, an employee was operating a tugger vehicle when the employee's left foot was caught and fractured between a post and the cart.
A temporary employee was using a manually operated hoist to move a 600-pound metal coil when the coil fell and landed on his foot. He sustained a fractured left foot and was hospitalized.
While standing behind a register, an employee tripped over a fan cord and fell to the floor fracturing the right leg.

An employee was taking a motor off a stand. When the bolts were loosened, the motor fell on the employee's knee and then left hand, crushing it between the motor and concrete. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pulling a blast pot with the assistance of another employee when he tripped and dropped the pot on his hand. His thumb and index finger were caught and partially amputated under the pot handle.
An employee fell off a ladder while performing ceiling maintenance, suffering rib, skull, and spinal injuries.
An employee was operating a lathe when the chuck of the lathe turned unexpectedly and forced the employee's hand against an edge on the tool holder. The employee's left pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was attempting to grease a conveyor when the employee's right thumb tip was caught and amputated between the conveyor chain and sprocket.

An employee was using a dolly to unload a vending machine from a truck to the loading dock when the dolly wheels became lodged, tipping the vending machine over and onto the employee. He broke his right shin.
An employee was walking by a freezer case when he tripped and fell over the guard, fracturing his left femur.

An employee was cleaning a concrete mixer with a hose when his right hand was caught between the mixer's paddles and the mixer's drums, fracturing his right middle and index fingers. He was hospitalized. The mixer was unguarded and energized at the time.
An employee was cleaning out a peat auger when his right hand contacted the spinning auger blade, lacerating his index finger and requiring surgery. The auger was not locked out at the time.

On August 9, 2017, at approximately 2:50 PM, an employee was operating a jib hoist to lift a rail component (350 lbs.) when his left index finger was pinched between the hoist rigging and the rail. His left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped and fell to the same level on an anti-fatigue, 12 X 12, piece-together mat, breaking the right wrist and requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was grabbing his framing gun when it shot a nail into his leg, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was in a bucket working on a primary electrical distribution powerline when he became disoriented and suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee fell from an exchanger rig as he descended. The employee fell onto a basket made of angle iron and fractured ribs and bruised a lung.
An employee was welding an H-beam and was putting an electrode on the holder when he was electrically shocked by the circuit. He momentarily lost consciousness and fell over. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working with a four man crew to remove and replace rotted electrical poles outside. He had been digging, tamping, pushing, pulling, and setting poles when he became ill and slouched over. He was hospitalized for multiple heat-related illnesses.
While operating a PIV, an employee struck racking and was pinned between the racking and the PIV, suffering contusions and a lacerated liver.

An employee was setting a steel beam while working out of an aerial lift when the beam leaned against the lift and pinched his left hand between it and the top rail of the man basket. His middle finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a forklift to move freight when he passed out and hit his face on the dock floor.
On August 9, 2017, an employee was looking through the end frame of a large, powered forging press when it cycled. The die then came down and struck his head and face, causing serious injuries.
Two employees were on eight foot ladders aligning connectors when the beam rolled, knocking them off the ladders. An employee suffered a torn left leg.
On August 9, 2017, an employee was driving an electric pallet jack when she became lightheaded and fainted. She fell from the pallet jack and broke her fibula, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing coating buildup from ink rollers when his hand was pulled into the rollers, lacerating it and crushing his fingers.
An employee was lifting a bucket of bolts when he strained his back.

An employee was adjusting a loose wing nut on a conveyor system rail when the employee's left hand entered a gap between the conveyor and a transfer plate. As the employee pulled the hand out, the left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unjamming a composite board from a cut-off machine when it engaged and came down on his right hand, fracturing and severely lacerating his index, middle, and ring fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was lifting a trailer door when the door broke and came down on his head and pinned his body underneath it. He fractured his neck.

An employee and a coworker were standing on 10-foot ladders while removing an old air duct when a segment of the duct separated and struck the ladders. The employee fell to the ground and broke ribs on the right side.

An employee cut a piece of wood with a table saw. When he reached to move the piece of wood, the saw blade cut his left hand beneath the fourth and fifth knuckle. The saw was running and unguarded at the time.
An employee was standing on top of a 54-inch reinforced concrete pipe when he slipped and fell to the ground, landing on his left side and lacerating his spleen.

An employee was monitoring packages being filled on a vertical form fill machine when the machine jammed. While she was trying remove the jam, the blades closed on her left hand. She suffered third degree burns and contusions on her left hand and fingers.
An employee was moving a mobile home wall that was on rollers when he was pinned between the mobile home wall and a dock. He suffered pelvic injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing a plastic wrap jam from a packaging machine when the guillotine blade came down and amputated the employee's left index fingertip. The machine was not guarded or locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while repairing isolated machinery.

An employee was sitting at her desk. When she stood up, her feet became tangled in some cords beneath her desk and she fell to the floor on her left shoulder. She suffered a fractured left femur and fractured left humeral head, requiring hospitalization.
A temporary employee was mowing around a curb at a jobsite when the self-propelled mower he was operating slipped and ran over his foot, amputating his left big toe.

An employee was lowering a truck after jacking it up to perform an alignment procedure. He placed his right hand between the shock bracket and leaf spring of the truck. When he began to lower the truck, it came down too fast and pinched his finger between the shock bracket and leaf spring. His right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning the shaft of a mixer with a solvent soaked rag and reached over to turn down the speed of the mixer. The rag on his hand wrapped around the rotating shaft, pulling on his left middle finger and amputating it at the second knuckle.
An employee was welding on a jig when a side screen fell on his left hand, amputating his thumb.
An employee was sorting concrete on a conveyor line when a piece of concrete moved and struck his right hand, fracturing his ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was removing a plug from a 6-inch pipeline when pressure in the line caused it to blow off and strike his hand and arm, requiring surgery.
An employee's right index finger was amputated while lifting a transmission jack out of the rear of a company vehicle.
An employee was unloading operating room supplies when she opened a box that had leaked formalin inside. She experienced respiratory issues and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a chemical (Thermastic) in a bucket when the employee lost balance and chemical spilled on his hands and forearms resulting in chemical burns.

An employee was adjusting a cable roller used to pull a nylon rope through a conduit when the nylon rope lost tension and came loose, striking and amputating the employee's right thumb to the first knuckle.

An employee climbed a 12-foot A-frame ladder to push concrete blocks that had shifted from the top of the loading dock retaining wall back into a straight line. A section of block fell off the wall and hit the ladder, causing the employee to fall 8 to 10 feet. His left ankle was caught on one of the rungs and he used his left hand to brace his fall. He broke his left ankle and left wrist and was hospitalized.

On August 9, 2017, an employee received an electrical shock while installing new ovens and suffered cardiac arrest which resulted in an inpatient hospitalization and medical treatment beyond first aid.
While clearing land, an employee unearthed a bee hive. The bees stung the employee over 100 times in the face.
An employee was removing furnace parts when he fell backwards, hitting his head on the concrete floor.

An employee was on an extension ladder scraping loose paint on the side of a building when the ladder slid down. The employee fell about 6 feet to the asphalt pavement, and the ladder landed on top of his left leg, breaking his femur.

An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack in the standing position when he lost his balance and his left foot slipped off the vehicle platform. His foot was then crushed between the pallet jack and a storage rack.
An employee collapsed and was hospitalized for suspected heat stress/exhaustion.
An employee tripped and fell while walking on the sidewalk, suffering a hip fracture.
An employee was using a high-pressure water jetter to clean out a piece of large pipe when the equipment turned around on its own and high-pressure water hit the employee's left arm, lacerating it.
An employee was climbing an 18-foot fixed ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground.
An employee was inspecting a paint job on the roof of an amusement ride. He slipped as he was stepping off a ladder and fractured his right heel.
An employee was attempting to remove a kink in a chain being used to pull out a stuck truck when the chain unkinked and struck the employee's left hand, amputating the pinky finger.

An employee was on a scaffold removing shoring from a concrete form when the shoring slipped out of the employee's hands and struck the scaffold planking. He then fell approximately 8 feet, suffering head lacerations that required stitches. He was hospitalized overnight.

On August 10, 2017, an employee was on a feed conveyor clearing material from an overhead conveyor when the employee's left ring and middle fingers contacted the chain and sprocket. The employee's fingers had to be surgically amputated. The overhead conveyor was unguarded at the time.
An employee was waiting for a work truck when the work truck placed an outrigger down on his right foot, crushing and fracturing the fourth and fifth toes.

An employee was holding a pullet while a coworker performed a vaccination when the employee was accidentally stuck in the right index finger behind the first knuckle with a quarter-inch, 18-gauge needle that was being used to administer the vaccine.
An employee bumped his head and suffered a brain hemorrhage while replacing lights/ballasts.

An employee was helping coworkers remove a dumpster to the trash compactor room when the employee was pinned between the dumpster bar latch and a wall in the trash compactor room, suffering a chest injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was reassembling food processing equipment after cleaning it. As the employee was positioning the auger screw in the auger screw housing, a coworker pushed the end of the auger screw into the housing, causing the employee's right hand to be pinned between the auger screw and the auger housing. The employee's index and middle fingertips were amputated.

A temporary employee was operating a powered industrial truck and struck a rack. The employee's right foot was pinned between the powered industrial truck and the rack, breaking and lacerating the right ankle/foot.
On 8/9/2017, at approximately 4:00 p.m., an employee had been operating a furnace when he experienced dizziness and finger numbness. He was hospitalized for heat stress and muscle damage.

On August 10, 2017, an employee was taking fall protection system anchors to the roof while using a ladder when the employee either fell from the ladder while placing the anchors onto the perimeter wall or while accessing the roof. The employee fell more than 20 feet to the ground and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a hammer to scrape concrete off a mud belt on a moving conveyor. When the hammer contacted the conveyor belt, it struck his hand and injured his right thumb.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was operating a 400-ton press when his right hand became caught in the press die. His index and middle fingers had to be surgically amputated.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet off a sidewalk shed and was hospitalized with a sprained wrist and hip injuries.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a 2X4 when the blade amputated his middle fingertip.
An employee was moving a bin of linen when his right hand was caught between the bin and a steel table, crushing his ring finger.
An employee was standing inside a tractor trailer waiting for the dock plate to connect to the trailer when the dock plate came down on his right foot, lacerating it. He was hospitalized.
An employee working on a carport fell through a damaged section of decking and was hospitalized with a broken kneecap and shoulder.

An employee was cutting a propeller blade from a propeller when the propeller gave way. The employee was then caught between the propeller blades, suffering a broken pelvis, ruptured colon and bladder, and internal bleeding.

An employee was moving empty pallets in his trailer. When he stepped onto the liftgate on the back of the trailer, he slipped and fell to the ground. He fractured his collarbone and two ribs and punctured a lung, requiring hospitalization.
On August 10, 2017, an employee was loading a paper roll into a machine when the employee's left fingertip was caught and amputated in the roll clamp.

An employee was working in an enclosed refrigerated warehouse when a propane-fueled forklift was brought in to move some boxes. The employee was exposed to carbon monoxide from the forklift, suffering nausea and a headache. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing intestines from chickens on a shackle line when her right thumb become lodged and amputated in a shackle.
An employee was operating an earth magnet when it was deactivated, creating a pinch point that amputated his right index fingertip. The magnet did not have a safety pin at the time.
An employee was walking up the stairs due to the elevator being out of service and suffered chest pains.
An employee was unloading a truck tank when he was exposed to hydrogen sulfide, suffering a headache and nausea.
An employee was operating a hammer machine when she inadvertently activated the foot pedal while her left index finger was in the point of operation. She suffered a left index fingertip amputation.
On 8/11/2017, an employee was in training and performing exercises when he suffered a muscle strain and was hospitalized.
An employee lost footing while exiting a truck and fell to the ground, breaking ribs and vertebrae and suffering a possible head injury.
An employee was cut on the right middle finger knuckle while unloading stainless steel.
An employee was on a stock picker platform picking boxes off a pallet on a rack when the employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, suffering a head laceration and a partially severed ear.

An employee was installing a 6-inch PVC sewer line. As he was holding the pipe, something smashed his thumb against the pipe. He suffered left thumb trauma and a possible fracture, requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was fixing a chain that was slipping on a unit when a finger on the right hand was caught between the chain and the gear when the machine was activated resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading equipment onto a trailer when the employee's thumb was pinched and lacerated between the equipment's roller and articulating plate.

An employee was standing on an extension ladder while affixing flashing around a door frame. When the employee attempted to drill into the flashing, the ladder slid and one of the rungs came down on top of the employee's right knee, injuring it and requiring surgery.
An employee was taking a scrap piece of foam off a bailer saw and amputated the right ring fingertip. The saw was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was setting up two pieces of a riser platform when one of the pieces got on top of the other. As he tried to lift up one of the pieces, his right middle finger was caught between the other riser piece, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was using a press brake to make a part out of a piece of sheet metal that was approximately 2'' in length. He was setting the sheet metal when the press brake crushed his ring finger. Part of his finger had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was servicing an oil rig when a rod transfer became hung up, came loose, and struck the employee, knocking him out of a rod basket. He landed face first on a tubing board and broke his leg, jaw, nose, and other facial bones.
An employee was running a machine that forms meat patties when the machine amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was attempting to move cows between two pens when a cow kicked her in the lower leg, causing a compound fracture.

An employee was fixing an overhead crane. His right hand was on the crane's trolley rail when the crane operator jogged the trolley, pinching and amputating his small right finger between the wheel and the trolley rail.
An employee fell in the parking lot and broke her femur.
On August 11, 2017, an employee was servicing a lawnmower when his middle fingertip contacted the rotating blade and was partially amputated.
An employee was changing out a blade on a handsaw when the blade lacerated the palm of his left hand, requiring surgery. The handsaw was not operating at the time.
An employee was troubleshooting a dock plate that was not working properly when his hand was caught and crushed in a hydraulic mechanism.

An employee was onboard a 30-foot vessel and was repairing the gill net retriever assembly because the teeth would not fully close. Part of the employee's left hand was caught in the retriever which crushed tendons and nerves.

An employee was working on a finishing machine when the stop bar sensor turned on and the press continued its operation. The press cycled and the employee's right hand was pulled and crushed in between the notches on the stop cylinder and the stop bar. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation while cleaning a molding machine.

An employee was preparing two splice plates for connection to a beam when the bottom splice plate fell open and onto a J-hook. His left-hand fingertips were pinched and fractured between the edge of the J-hook and the concrete bridge deck, and his left thumb was dislocated.

On August 11, 2017, an employee was changing the filter on a high-pressure die cast furnace when the employee's leg slipped off the edge and contacted molten aluminum. The employee's pant leg ignited, and the employee suffered burns to the right foot and lower leg.
An employee was cleaning asphalt from a silo door when his legs became caught in a rotating conveyor. Both legs were amputated.
While cutting plastic on a table saw, an employee got his hand caught in the saw and sustained a partial amputation to the right middle finger.
An employee was attempting to put a gauze muzzle on a dog when the dog bit and lacerated the employee's right thumb, requiring hospitalization.

Employees were moving a soda vending machine with a pallet jack. The vending machine became unstable. An employee attempted to stabilize the vending machine at the bottom. The vending machine slid off the pallet jack, crushing the employee's left second digit and amputating the fingertip.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet from an A-frame ladder to the ground while removing a DDC controller from a ceiling.
An employee was securing his positioning straps to the ladder and fell about 15 feet to the ground, fracturing the left wrist.
An employee was attacked and bitten by two dogs while visiting a member's residence.

While standing on the toolbox in the back of a pickup truck, an employee bent over to give a pair of safety glasses to a coworker. He lost his balance and fell onto the concrete floor, suffering 11 broken ribs, two fractures under the right eye, and a brain hemorrhage.
On August 11, 2017, an employee was doing maintenance on a yard truck. While exiting the truck cab, the employee slipped and fell to the ground, breaking the right leg.

On August 11, 2017, at 11:00 a.m., an employee was changing out a residential electrical meter. He performed a line-to-line voltage check and then proceeded with the change-out. When he hooked up the jumper cables, an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to his right hand. He was hospitalized.
On 08/11/2017, an employee slipped and fell while working on an escalator, and was hospitalized for treatment of a laceration to the shin.
A customer drove into the detail shop, striking an employee and other vehicles. The employee sustained a broken lower right leg.

An employee was walking from one forklift to another. As the employee was stepping onto the second forklift, the first forklift rolled and struck the employee's leg, shattering the left foot and ankle.

An employee was using a pry bar to pry form work when his right pinky finger was crushed between the pry bar and the form work. His fingertip fractured and he lost the fingernail, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was using a band saw to cut a manufactured plastic part (42-gallon waste container) to be ground up in a granulator when the saw blade and the part wiggled. The employee's left thumb tip then made contact with the blade and was amputated.
An employee was attempting to mount a forklift that was being operated by a coworker when the forklift knocked the employee to the ground and ran over his right femur, fracturing it.
An employee was cutting a radiator from a semi-truck using a cutting torch when he cut a Freon line. The Freon ignited, causing second and third degree burns to his face.
An employee was walking her mail route when she slipped and fell on wet gravel. She broke her left ankle in three different places, requiring hospitalization.
While working on an eight-foot ladder, an employee fell and sustained two fractured ribs.

On August 11, 2017, at 8:30 a.m., an employee was dismounting a ladder onto a roof when the metal shingle that he stepped on detached and he fell 15 feet to the ground, fracturing his lower lumbar, cervical spine, and three ribs.  He was hospitalized.
On 08/12/2017, an employee felt ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal plate to install it on a service truck when the grinding wheel came off and struck the employee's forearm just above the wrist, fracturing the ulna.
An employee had just finished hanging a TV on a wall mount when he fainted, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal with a shear machine when the machine amputated the employee's thumb tip. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was closing the rollup door of a trailer parked at the loading dock when his third and fourth fingers on his right hand were caught between the door panels, amputating his third fingertip and crushing his fourth fingertip.

On August 08, 2017, at approximately 9:20 a.m., an employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the cold dock when the forklift slid on condensation, causing the employee's left ankle to be caught between the forklift and a guardrail. He suffered a compound fracture of the left ankle and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was shutting the sliding door between two rooms when his left hand was caught between the door and the door frame, crushing and amputating his left middle fingertip.

An employee was trying to correct the feed on a label machine. She placed the machine in manual mode to use the jogging button. She was trying to clear the roller when her right hand was caught in the roller, avulsing/crushing the middle and index fingertips.

An employee was walking on the milk parlor floor to attach suction to a dairy cow. Teat dip had spilled on the floor and the employee stepped in it, slipped, and fell back. The employee's head hit the floor, suffering a concussion.
An employee was driving a stand-up tugger and trying to throw something in a garbage can when she fell to the concrete floor and suffered a concussion.

An employee was running a pallet destacker when it jammed. He used a pry bar to free it. When it unjammed, his right index finger was caught between the pry bar and the wood pallets, amputating his fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was putting products away when her scooter struck the edge of a sink and tipped over. She put her foot down as the scooter tipped, and her right foot and ankle were fractured, requiring hospitalization.

On August 13, 2017, at 9:30 PM, an employee was trying to help a forklift operator move a load through a stand-alone arc-way when she was struck by the rear reel of the forklift. She suffered a compound fracture to her left leg.
An employee slipped and fell while at work, fracturing her left patella and requiring surgery. She was hospitalized.

An employee was shearing galvanized metal in a shear. The employee used a wooden box to set the metal square. The employee's left thumb was then caught and amputated (flesh only) between the box and the shear arm.
