An employee was operating a powered industrial truck used to pull carts of packages when she turned hard to the right and fell off the left side of the truck, fracturing her left ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee was installing the vertical section of an EMT conduit beside a bucket elevator when a 10-foot joint became uncoupled and fell 60 feet from above. It struck and fractured the employee's right femur.
An employee was sitting on a chair and then fell to the ground, suffering broken arms.

An employee was operating a grapple log skidder to move cut trees when it rolled over the side of a hill and partially landed on the side of the turnpike below. He suffered multiple skull fractures and a fractured T3 vertebra.
An employee was attempting to remove a piece of cut angle iron from the fixed vice area of a band saw when his right index and middle fingertips were pinched and avulsed in the vice area.

A crew was changing out a single phase pole with a transformer on it. Work on the pole was completed and the cover-up was being removed when an employee noticed the animal guard that was installed on the arrestor was not in its proper place. As he attempted to correct it, he came in contact with energized parts while his elbow contacted a grounded surface. He received second degree electrical burns on his right arm.
An employee was clearing a jammed trimmer on a printing press when the machine amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was working on a ladder that was set up on a roof when his foot became caught on one of the rungs. The ladder then slid out from under him, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet. The ladder fell on top of his leg, fracturing his tibia and displacing tendons.
An employee suffered from heat stress while performing lifeguard duties.

An employee was operating a bucket lift with a coworker riding along. They were positioning the bucket lift prior to trimming branches off a tree. They were about two feet away from the tree and any powerlines when an arc came through the bucket controllers and burned the employee's hands and chest. He was hospitalized.
An employee rolled and fractured his ankle while moving a sign.

On August 14, 2017, at approximately 4:30 PM, an employee was attempting to deliver mail at a residence when she was attacked by the resident's dog. She suffered a serious laceration to the left lower calf, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was going to answer a phone when the employee fell to the floor and suffered a compound fracture, requiring surgery.
Four employees were repairing cars in an auto body shop when another temporary employee drove a car into the shop and struck the employees. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting steel bars with a horizontal bandsaw when the blade amputated his right small finger.
An employee's left- and right-hand fingers were smashed by metal plates as they were being lowered.
On August 14, 2017, at approximately 7:40 a.m., an employee was a cutting some plants using a cutting shear when the shear amputated her left ring fingertip.
An employee was measuring a keyway for a replacement sprocket when his left hand became tangled in the sprocket, amputating his index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was picking up concrete debris and throwing it into a skid steer bucket when the concrete fell out of the bucket and snagged his right ring finger, amputating it.
An employee inhaled hydrogen cyanide while taking readings from machines, losing consciousness and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was making a delivery. He was on an elevated surface pulling on a bungee cord to secure a tarp when the cord snapped, causing him to fall and hit his head. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
A dozer was dragging a flume pipe that came loose and struck an employee in the back. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and shoulder blade, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down from a 6-foot ladder when he missed the second step and twisted his ankle. He fractured his ankle in three places and had surgery.
An employee fell while installing trusses and hit the ground, fracturing an ankle and injuring a kidney. The employee had surgery.
An employee was cutting a tree on the ground when the tree rolled onto his feet, fracturing both and requiring surgery.
An employee collided with another employee while walking in a hallway and fell to the floor, injuring her head and hip and suffering a brain hemorrhage. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell into an elevator pit, striking concrete and injuring his back.

An employee was cleaning the rollers on a pipe roller machine when his glove was caught between the rollers. His right hand was pulled into the rollers, amputating all four fingertips to the first knuckle.
On August 14, 2017, an employee was doing quality inspections on tires when a tire tipped over and struck the employee's right calf and foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to clear a 4-inch tin pie from a die machine when the machine cycled, amputating the employee's left middle finger from the tip to the first knuckle.

On 8/14/2017, at 11:20 AM, an employee was installing a lateral cover on a mill feed row when it fell on his left foot, fracturing his fourth and fifth toes and lacerating his foot. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was climbing a ladder to assess a leaking roof when he missed a rung with his hand and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He suffered a gash to the left side of his head and a fracture to his left elbow.
On August 14, 2017, an employee was removing braces in a shipping container when granite slabs fell onto the employee's chest. The employee suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

A 19-foot box truck drove off the road, over the curb onto the sidewalk and struck an employee. The employee was hospitalized for collapsed lungs, head injuries, lacerations, and fractures which included broken ribs.
An employee was operating a water ride and fell into the water striking the boat. The employee was hospitalized with chest pain.

Two employees had shut down a can crusher because the auger was making a funny noise. The injured employee had climbed up to inspect the upper bearing and had set his right foot over to the baler to steady himself. The baler engaged and started down, and the bale ejector chain hook came down on his boot behind the steel toe. His right big toe was amputated.
An employee was helping to guide paper through a machine when the employee's right pinky finger was caught and smashed in the sprocket at the entrance to the drying run of the machine.
An employee was loading automobiles on a railcar when she fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, fracturing her left knee and sternum.
An employee was using an impact wrench when it amputated his left pinky finger at the first joint.
An employee's lower right leg struck a platform cart and received a laceration that became infected the next day, requiring hospitalization.
On August 15, 2017, at approximately 1:30 p.m., an employee tripped over a computer mouse cord and fell, fracturing her left tibia. She was hospitalized.

An employee was repositioning a pallet that was misaligned on a batch-off pallet magazine. When he raised the pallet, his left thumb tip was caught and crushed between the pallet and pallet magazine frame, removing flesh and the nail.
While picking up trash, an employee began cramping due to the heat and dehydration.
An employee was cutting a fiber wrap off a ring spinner when one of her fingertips became stuck and amputated in the spinner.

An employee was standing at the back of a truck watching the truck driver load a dolly of shrink wrapped boxes containing printer paper. The driver pushed the dolly onto the truck tailgate and raised the tailgate to the truck bed. The shrink wrap gave way and the boxes fell off the tailgate, striking the employee and knocking him to the ground. He broke his leg and suffered a bump on his head.

On August 15, 2017, an employee was placing two ends of steel wire in a machine to be welded together when the hydraulic clamp used to hold two ends of a wire together caught and amputated the employee's left ring and pinky fingertips.
An employee fell from a ladder and hit his head, suffering a minor skull fracture and requiring stitches.
An employee was reaching for a roll of tape on a blower motor when the employee's left pinky finger was caught and amputated between the blower motor guard.
An employee was attempting to clean a roller when his rag and then hand were pulled into the roller, fracturing his fingers.

An employee was welding near a bin of parts that was stored at an angle to provide better reach for employees when a fork truck came up behind the bin of parts to move another bin. The forks hit the bin behind the employee and the bin tipped over, hitting and fracturing the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.
On 08/15/2017, an employee was struck by a high lift truck while operating an electric jack, requiring hospitalization for severe leg injuries.
An employee was switching a tank connection from natural gas to propane when the gas ignited, causing thermal burns to his left and right hands.
An employee was walking, tripped and fell resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was operating a radial arm saw to cut packing material when the saw blade amputated his left middle fingertip and part of his left index finger.
An employee was standing and opening a large cardboard box when he twisted his right knee, lost his balance, and fell on his right hip. He broke his hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was steaming a pavement sealer when a gasket failed. Hot pavement sealer base blew out and struck the employee, burning the back of both legs and the right knee.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell resulting in a head and shoulder injury.
An employee was walking down a stairway when she tripped on the second to last step and fell, fracturing her right ankle.

An employee was under a car hauler/trailer greasing the fittings when the driver pulled the vehicle away. The employee was struck by the car hauler/trailer, suffering injuries to his back, shoulder blade, and ribs.
On August 15, 2017 an employee was struck by a motor vehicle while driving a utility vehicle, fracturing the employee's pelvis, hand, and leg.
An employee ingested Dimethyl Ethyl Amine and Rhodolian 675 (defoamer) after drinking from a cup that he believed contained soda.

An employee was working on a manual clamp. He was holding the clamp with his left hand and holding a cylinder with his right hand. His right index finger was inside a slot on the cylinder housing when the clamp arm slipped out of his left hand and fell. When the unit fell, his right index finger was still in the slot and the top portion of the cylinder came down and amputated his finger. The equipment was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was standing on an elevated platform and placing a tarp on top of a roll-off box when he lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet to the bottom of a metal solidification pit, breaking two neck bones and seven ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a press when the press cycled. The employee's right hand became caught between the beller head and the ring plate in the press, amputating his index, middle, and ring fingers.
While near a power line, an employee was holding the hose from the pump truck. He was electrocuted and received burns and internal injuries.
An employee fell while loading turkeys into a truck, suffering head trauma and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a dolly cart to move an armature that weighed approximately 1,500 pounds when the cart tilted and struck him above the ankle, breaking his leg and ankle.

An employee was working on I-beams while replacing a grating system when he fell approximately 20 feet to an electrical panel below. He suffered broken ribs, a broken leg, and a possible punctured lung.
An employee was performing maintenance on a chairlift when the chairlift platform started to move and came off the line. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was riding in the dump tank of a bean picker cleaning weeds out of the green beans. As he was climbing down from the bean picker, he fell to the ground, fracturing vertebrae and ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was washing a truck while standing on a ladder when the employee fell 5 feet to the ground, suffering head and back contusions.

An employee was operating a trimmer from a control panel when a chain came off the sprocket. After replacing the chain on the sprocket, he stepped out of the system, lost his footing, and fell 14 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and back.
On August 15, 2017, an employee was exposed to an aerosol disinfectant in the office and experienced breathing difficulty and vomiting, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing roof shingles when he fell to the ground, injuring his spine.
An employee suffered heat cramps while building trusses, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was labeling an export product on a skid when the employee tripped over the skid. The skid had a broken slat and the employee's hand fell between the broken slat, causing a seesaw action that partially amputated the employee's right pinky finger.
An employee got up from a chair and tripped over her purse strap. She fell to the ground, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was auditing a load of goods on a loading dock when the back of a forklift struck her. She suffered a compound fracture to her right ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a rebar bending machine when his right pinky finger was caught and amputated in between the machine's stopper plate and the return lever.
An employee was testing a transformer when an arc flash occurred, burning his arms and hands.
An employee was operating a chipper and came in contact with a guy wire. The wire was drawn into the chipper and broke the employee's ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading material onto a racking system while operating a reach truck. As he backed out of the space, he was pinned against a beam and the reach truck, suffering chest contusions.

On 8/16/2017, an employee was changing a band mill saw blade. The wheel of the blade was still turning as the employee removed the plywood covering the pit. The plywood made contact with the mill wheel, and the plywood then struck the employee on the left side of the face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling boards from a re-saw chain and feeding them through a ripsaw when a wood shard ejected from the ripsaw. The wood shard struck the employee and became embedded in the right buttocks, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was inventorying diversionary flash-bang devices when a device fell from its protective cover. The pin also fell out, causing the device to detonate. The employee's left hand suffered soft tissue lacerations that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was sitting on a picnic bench when she fell off and hit the ground, breaking her hip.
An employee was installing covers on radio cabinets. While walking backwards on a grated platform, the employee fell approximately 1 to 2 feet onto a handrail below, suffering rib injuries.

An employee was troubleshooting the lack of tar movement going from a tank truck to a storage tank when the flex hose disconnected and sprayed him with hot tar. He suffered burns to his right foot, right leg, both arms, and face.

An employee was crossing from a working platform (24' above ground) to another lower area of the scaffold when he lost his footing and fell, breaking his hip, wrist, and femur and lacerating his chin and forehead.
While loading an 18-wheeler trailer, an employee fell approximately 4 feet from the trailer to the concrete ground, suffering a concussion and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was tightening a bolt on a flange while standing on a wooden box when the employee slipped and fell from the box and struck a metal valve wheel, suffering a broken rib and punctured lung.

An employee was servicing an aerial drop. He set up his ladder, ascended to about 18 feet, and secured himself to the strand using his body belt and safety strap. As he started working, his ladder began to slide to the right. He began descending the ladder to readjust it. As he was descending, the ladder slid again to the right, causing him to fall off the ladder from about 14 feet. He landed on his feet on the street and fell backwards, breaking his left heel and several bones in his right foot.
An employee was emptying metal from a dump hopper that was on a forklift when the hopper fell from the forks and struck the employee on the left leg, breaking it.
A flagger was struck in the head by the chute of a concrete truck, suffering a contusion.

An employee was making odorant deliveries when he became ill. He had completed three of five scheduled deliveries when he stopped work due to feeling overheated. He was hospitalized for dehydration and possible heat stress.
After performing lawn maintenance in the sun, an employee became ill and began to cramp, requiring hospitalization for heat stress.
An employee slipped and fell down 13 steps while walking down stairs carrying tools and bags. The employee suffered a punctured lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a reversing vehicle, suffering a fractured hip.

An employee was using a lift magnet to lift and load a 121-pound plate into a CNC machine. He was guiding the piece of metal into the CNC to drop/set it down when it fell on and crushed his left index finger, amputating it at the knuckle.

An employee was operating an electric-powered forklift. He turned to back up while his hand was resting on the outside of the vehicle. His right ring finger was then smashed between the frame of the vehicle and an adjacent steel rack, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was delivering propane to a tank when the pressure relief valve popped off due to pressure buildup and struck the employee. The liquid propane then sprayed the employee, who fell approximately 10 feet from the equipment to the decking floor. The employee sustained multiple contusions, lacerations, and first and second degree burns.

On August 16, 2017, at 5:30 p.m., an employee was attempting to disconnect a crane magnet when an arc flash occurred. He was shocked, receiving a 4-inch burn on his right forearm, a burn in the middle of the right side of his back, and a burn on the top of his right foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a severe allergic reaction after possible exposure to latex and was hospitalized.

An employee was unwrapping a pallet of four drums to prepare an outbound shipment. The four drums were secured together and to the pallet with stretch wrap. After cutting away the wrap with a utility knife, the employee pulled on the wrap to free it from the pallet and drums. He had also staged his forklift next to the drum pallet. The forklift utilizes an implement known as a "drum picker," which would be used to lift individual drums from the full pallet to fill the outbound load/order. While he was manually pulling the cut stretch wrap from the drums/pallet, he lost his grip on the stretch wrap and fell backward into the drum picker implement, striking his upper torso/back. He was hospitalized for a fractured C3 vertebra.

A 5,400-pound magnet was attached to an excavator. Employees were using the magnet and excavator to pull metal out of piles of slag. When these activities were completed, the excavator operator placed the magnet on uneven ground. An employee was attempting to remove the magnet from the excavator when it slid and landed on the employee's feet, causing multiple fractures in both feet.
An employee was dumping a debris cart when the cart shifted and crushed a finger between the cart and the dumpster.
On August 16, 2017, an employee was on the ground inspecting a part when another part fell from a storage rack and struck the employee's head, causing a skull fracture.

On August 16, 2017, an employee was jackhammering concrete around an electrical conduit bank when the jackhammer struck an electrical line and an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered burns from the waist to just above the knee.
An employee was dismounting the rear of a backhoe when his wedding ring became caught on equipment, causing a traumatic amputation to his left ring finger.
An employee was carrying insulation material on a roof when he slipped on dew and fell on the roof surface, injuring his shoulder and possibly his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove a plastic jam in a tamper bander when the cutter activated and amputated the employee's right index fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was moving cargo when he suffered a heat-related illness.
Two employees were performing servicing work at a natural gas refrigeration plant when a fire erupted and seriously burned their backs.
An employee was burned on their back from a gas-related fire.

An employee was looking to retrieve shopping carts in the parking lot when a customer reversed her vehicle to get to an available parking space and struck him. He fell backwards to the ground and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.

Several employees were unplugging an electrical cable to install a new switch to a transformer containing 7,200 volts when an arc flash occurred. One employee sustained burns to his left hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was not feeling well while servicing a truck. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was checking the tension on a v-belt as part of preventative maintenance. When he grabbed the belt, it suddenly activated and pulled his hand into the pulley system, amputating his right ring and middle fingertips. The belt was unguarded and the conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.
Two employees were exposed to carbon monoxide from an open water fountain drain. They were hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the track on a skid steer that was on a jack when the skid steer shifted and caused the jack to slip. The skid steer then fell on the employee, fracturing the T2 vertebra.

An employee was operating a hydraulic press by foot pedal. Her right hand was on the press as she bent to retrieve parts that fell on the floor. As she reached for the parts, her foot activated the press and two of her right-hand fingers were caught in the die. Her pinky and ring fingers were partially amputated.
On August 16, 2017, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was stacking lumber from the green chain when he passed out. He was hospitalized with heatstroke.
An employee was about to step up onto a manipulator car in order to change a light when he slipped and fell onto the car and sustained multiple fractures to his left rib cage.
An employee was picking up a safe about the size of a printer and moving it from his desk to the floor when he lost consciousness. He regained consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a feeder when the employee's gloved left hand was pulled into the feeder's rollers. The employee sustained a laceration to the left palm and was hospitalized.
An employee was starting a plastic extrusion line when hot plastic burned his arm. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee attempted to remove a piece of tape that got stuck on a roller. The cutting device of the tape machine was engaged and caused a partial amputation of his finger.
An employee was standing on the running board of an Army M915 trailer looking into the side mirror. When he stepped down, his left ring finger was caught and de-gloved on the side mirror.

An employee was bleeding residual pressure off a hydraulic line on a tractor and held a metal bracket in front of his face to avoid being splashed with small amounts of hydraulic oil. When pressure was released, it hit the metal bracket and forced it into the employee's face, fracturing his jaw and knocking out a tooth.

The injured employee moved a super sack of product to the crystallizer area by forklift. The sack is lifted by a hoist over the hopper of the slurry machine and the bottom of the super sack is cut. The employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of sack that fell into the operating hopper when his left hand became caught in the hopper, injuring his middle and ring fingers.
An employee had taken work boots out of a box and put them on when she felt something like a sticker in her boot. She sat down and removed boot to find a baby rattle snake in her boot biting her.
An employee was counting laminate backer sheets when she fell and her leg was caught between the pallet and laminate backer sheets, breaking her knee.

On August 17, 2017, an employee was attempting to retrieve a dropped tool from a mill roller when the employee's right hand was caught in the ingoing nip point of the roller, amputating several fingers.
An employee's right leg gave out while stepping down from the second step of a platform. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a fractured hip.
An employee pulled over to the side of the road and stepped in an ant bed. He was bitten on his legs had an allergic reaction, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to tarp a roll-off container when he fell back on his tailbone, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a winding machine when his right middle finger was pinched and partially amputated between the machine's carriage and roller.
An employee was maintaining a forming machine (forms molten glass into glassware) when he became overheated and experienced stomach cramps and nausea. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
On 8/17/2017, an employee sustained second degree burns to her right cheek, right chest, right shoulder, and entire back when a client  threw a pot of hot coffee on her. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a mixer when a flash fire occurred. He suffered first degree burns to the left arm, hand, and face and second degree burns on his left arm and other areas.
An employee was operating a machine when the die became clogged. As he tried to fix it, the die amputated one of this left fingertips. The guard was in place at the time.
An employee was transferring a pot of hot oil from the kitchen to the oil disposal container for recycling when some of the hot oil spilled on his left leg. He was hospitalized with burn injuries.

An employee was using an air gun to clean the lacquer off a bead tooling machine part when the air gun and employee's left hand were pulled into the machine, partially amputating the middle fingertip. The machine's interlock was in place at the time.
An employee was bending sheet metal on a press brake when it cycled and crushed his left arm, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the tire of a piece of heavy equipment (loader) to clean the windows and change an air filter. While descending from the tire, the employee fell to the ground, fracturing the left pelvis.
An employee was injured on the jobsite and hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a bridge sidewalk when a passing vehicle with a ladder rack snagged a vertical hand line hanging from the upper portions of the bridge. The rope struck the employee along the midsection and threw him against the bridge's hand railing. He suffered two fractured ribs, a mild concussion, and minor bleeding in the spleen.
An employee tripped over a floor mat in front of an ice machine and injured her face.
An employee was cutting wood with a saw when it amputated the employee's left middle finger. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee and two coworkers were working from an elevated platform when it shifted, causing them to fall on top of each other and onto one end of the platform. One of the employees was hospitalized with a broken right wrist and right ankle.

An employee was operating a milling machine when the engine compartment caught fire. The employee had to go through the fire to exit the machine, suffering first and second degree burns to the left and right forearms, a wrist, and face.

On August 17, 2017, an employee was on a step ladder helping to remove a sanitary sewer pipe in a ceiling when the employee fell approximately 4 feet off the step ladder, suffering cracked back vertebrae and requiring hospitalization.
While working at a client's home, an employee was walking on a staircase and the stairs gave way. The employee fell 9 feet through the stairs and sustained a compound fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was reaching for a water bottle when his fingertip was caught and amputated between the chain and sprocket on a nearby drive line.

An employee was working to move material off a skid with a 6,000-pound electro magnet. When he activated the magnet's release mechanism, his right thumb was caught between the release handle and the magnet, crushing his thumb tip.

On August 17, 2017, at approximately 10:45 AM, an employee was attempting to hang a 3-day notice on a customer's residence when she was attacked by a dog. The dog bit and amputated her right pinky fingertip.
An employee was operating a laser guided vehicle (LGV). The employee put the LGV in manual, got off the machine and was pinched between the LGV and conveyor, suffering a right hip contusion.
An employee was on a ladder while moving a ceiling tile when the employee fell off the ladder and struck a countertop, suffering a concussion and dislocating the right pinky finger.
An employee became lightheaded from heat stress while reading water meters, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a cordless impact driver when the bit slipped off a screw head and landed on his left hand, puncturing the palm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a beam with a saw when it kicked back and amputated four fingers.

An employee was standing on a ladder in a well cellar installing a tubing head with the assistance of a forklift operator. The tubing head was moved into place by running a 2-inch lifting strap through swivel hoist rings on opposite sides of the tubing head and around the forks of the forklift. The employee was removing the swivel hoist rings from the tubing head when the forklift operator started to boom in the forks of the forklift. This caused the strap, which was still being attached to the forks and the swivel hoist ring, to tighten and lift the swivel hoist ring housing. The employee's left thumb was caught and severely lacerated between the hoist ring housing and hoist ring cap screw.
As part of a storm restoration project, an employee was on the ground disconnecting wires from electric poles. One or more poles started to roll and struck the employee, breaking the left ankle.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when his right pinky finger hit the saw blade and was lacerated.
A temporary employee was shoveling holes to plant trees when he was overcome by heat exhaustion and dehydration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a pickup truck to deliver a special events trailer to a ball field. The employee dropped the trailer off and exited the pickup truck. The unmanned vehicle began to roll and the employee attempted to stop the rolling pickup truck. The employee's right leg was struck by the vehicle. The employee sustained crushing injuries and was hospitalized for surgery.
While standing on the third step of a ladder and tightening an overhead bolt, an employee lost balance and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing the left leg.

A temporary employee was writing on a large roll of paper when a forklift driver pushed another roll against the roll she was writing on and her left forearm became lodged and fractured between the rolls.

An employee was directing a forklift operator to a location to offload a metal staircase when the  staircase slipped off the forklift and landed on the employee's right foot, fracturing his big toe and second toe.

An employee was on a lower level when an unsecured steel grate fell from the level above and struck the employee. The employee sustained a concussion, broken rib, broken vertebrae, and inter-laceration of the liver.

An employee was working on the molding machine when it jammed. The employee shut down the machine and attempted to remove the jammed piece. The machine's bottom head was still rotating and amputated the employee's left index fingertip and avulsed the left middle finger. The employee's left palm was also lacerated from the middle finger to the small finger (pinky).
An employee began to experience arm and leg cramps while slinging slabs in the hold of a ship, requiring hospitalization for possible heat exhaustion.
An employee was performing maintenance on a dryer when the employee's finger made contact with the dryer belt and pulley, amputating it.
An employee was clipping in a new conductor on an existing distribution line when a phase to ground fault occurred, causing an electrical flash that burned his left arm and shoulder.

An employee was working from an extendable boom platform when the boom was struck by an overhead crane's block and tackle, which had broken loose. The employee was thrown outside of the platform, suffering multiple spinal injuries and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting a 1-inch round stock on a shear. His right index finger was near the edge of the round hole on the guard when the shear was activated. The material kicked back, causing the employee's right index finger to become pinched and amputated between the guard and the 1-inch round stock.
An employee was struck by a load being carried by a forklift. He was knocked down and his foot was pinched by the load, suffering an open wound that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was attempting to clean dirt from a conveyor when her smock was caught in the pulley and her left hand was crushed and lacerated in the pulley, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a ground rod into the ground when he missed/slipped and fell into the rod. His head struck the rod, breaking the eye socket bone and driving it into part of his brain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping down from a ladder when he missed a step, fell to the ground, and broke his ankle and lower leg.
While exiting the cab of a tractor-trailer rig, an employee slipped on the step and fell, hitting an adjacent truck and breaking some ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

On 8/18/2017, an employee was operating a sheet metal electric power rotary beading and crimping machine to make collars. The employee's leather glove was caught between the roller and the crimping of the machine wheel, and the left index finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a brake press when the employee's hands were caught in the point of operation, causing a wrist contusion.
An employee was operating a baler when the baler door closed on and amputated the employee's left ring finger and possibly a second finger.
An employee was attempting to unjam a machine when one of the employee's fingers was caught and amputated between two machine rollers.

An employee was on the roof to see what was needed to be completed that morning when he stepped on a piece of felt paper, slipped, and fell on the roof, breaking his ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hitting a break room window from outside the facility to get someone's attention when the window glass lacerated and became embedded in the employee's right arm.
An employee fell backwards while walking up a set of stairs, hitting the concrete ground and injuring the left hip.
An employee was checking grade lines when he was struck by a front-end loader, breaking his leg.
An employee had cut a piece of a tree (a log) that became stuck in the ground in a vertical position. He was picking up a rope when the log fell on him, breaking his left leg and right ankle.
An employee was carrying a hot water tank down a flight of stairs using a dolly when the load shifted and the employee fell, hitting his head.

An employee was replacing a broken clevis and bolt on an automatic guided vehicle. When the employee moved the cylinder to inspect it, the cylinder released in the upward position. The employee's right hand was caught between the top of the stroke cylinder shaft and the hood base of the equipment.
An employee was walking across the parking lot prior to reporting for shift, lost her footing and fell resulting in a fractured cheekbone and lacerations that required sutures.
An employee was throwing a board over a cross-over belt when his right index finger was smashed between the board and a piece of metal, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was shot onsite by a family member.

On August 18, 2017, an employee was leveling a yard and dumping rock from a dump truck bed. While attempting to close the tailgate, the employee discovered a rock was lodged in the tailgate. The employee lifted the tailgate, which released the rock. The tailgate then came down and pinned the employee's right index finger against the dump truck bed. The employee was hospitalized and the finger was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a saw when he heard a pop sound. He turned off the saw and was inspecting it when then the still-rotating blade amputated his left index finger. The blade cover was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was feeding a coil of steel into a mechanical punch press die when the press cycled and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was trying to unjam a part on a sort table when a part slide mechanism pinched her right middle finger between the air-actuated slide and a part. As she pulled her hand out to remove her finger, her fingertip was amputated just below the cuticle.
When a patient became combative, an employee intervened and fell to the ground. The employee sustained back and knee injuries.
An employee was standing on a steel beam during a re-rigging operation when a steel beam struck his right leg, fracturing his femur.

An employee was trying to reset an air conditioning system. While troubleshooting the problem, his left index finger came in contact with 270 volts of electricity. He sustained a laceration to his scalp and burns to his left thumb, index finger, and middle finger, requiring hospitalization.

After cleaning out melamine resin lines that were blocked, an employee wanted to verify that a control valve was operating properly. While standing on a 4-foot ladder, the employee reached over to the far side of the valve and manually actuated the solenoid, causing the valve to open. The employee's right middle finger was in the valve to verify it was open when the employee lost their footing and released the solenoid. The valve then closed and amputated the right middle fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on a plastic bag, breaking a hip and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a chainsaw to fell a 68-foot tall, 16-inch to 20-inch diameter at breast height chestnut tree when the tree began to fall and struck another tree. The butt of the tree kicked back, striking and fracturing the employee's right leg just above the ankle.

An employee and a coworker were starting up the winder on a calendar machine when the employee became caught between the machine's spindle and material being fed into the winder, suffering a fractured arm and fractured left ankle.
An employee was stopping at a mail delivery point when he stepped out of his vehicle and rolled his ankle, dislocating it and requiring surgery.
An employee's hand was caught between a load and a chain sling, resulting in his right thumb being amputated above the knuckle.
An employee was apprehending a suspect at the west side building entrance. The employee was attacked by another suspect resulting in a broken jaw requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning a dough sheeter machine used for pizza dough using a rag when her fingers were caught in the machine, amputating her right middle finger.
After working a double shift in the mill, an employee felt ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee tripped over bun trays and suffered a broken right wrist, requiring surgery.
An employee was welding on a metal floor grate in the load-out building when some overhead blood meal came down causing a flash fire. He received burns to his left arm and hand.
An employee was working on a residential re-roofing job when he fell from the roof to the ground, suffering multiple fractures to the elbow/arm and possibly other bones. He was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a ladder when it started teetering back and forth. He fell off and fractured his leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had been positioning a natural gas trailer and the trailer slipped off of the hitch. The employee then tried to clean out/adjust the trailer hitch on the semi and the hitch moved which pinched his left middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder to a roof and either stepped onto the roof and slipped on dew or miss-stepped on the ladder and fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete ground.
An employee was walking downstairs, missed a step approximately halfway down the stairs, and fell the rest of the way down, fracturing the right shoulder and right arm.
An employee was blowing up a truck tire when it exploded and struck the employee's head, requiring hospitalization.

On 8/20/2017, at approximately 11:35 a.m., an employee was bagging a rotor assembly when the load shifted, pinching the employee's hand between the rotor assembly and the saddle of a skid and causing possible ligament damage.

An employee was operating a scissor lift to raise pipes near the ceiling. His hand was on the rail of the scissor lift when his left pinky fingertip was caught and amputated between a piece of electrical conduit and the scissor lift railing.
An employee fell 30 feet from a scaffold while installing siding on a new apartment building, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped on a rug and fell to the ground, breaking her hip.
An employee was struck in the crosswalk of a city street by a motor vehicle, requiring hospitalization for a torso injury.
An employee was using an air pressure hose to drain a nitric acid line into a tote when the hose blew out of the tote and nitric acid burned the employee's legs and groin.

An employee was inside a trailer getting ready to inspect a returned coil that was strapped to a crate. The employee was releasing the straps when the 2,800-pound coil pinned him to the floor, causing bruises and soreness to the chest and leg area.
An employee was working underneath a vehicle when it came down on his rib cage, fracturing his ribs.
An employee was working on a pump jack scaffold when he fell 15 feet from the scaffolding to the ground, breaking his shoulder, wrist, and ribs.
An employee had been leveling dirt with a shovel in the hot sun for almost 8 hours when he felt very faint. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
While walking the grounds, an employee stepped on a metal stake used to hold down landscape blanketing. The employee's right foot was impaled.

An employee was on the ground and walking to the rear of a trailer bed. His hand was on the trailer bed floor, which consisted of rolling slats (moving floor) powered by hydraulics, when the floor was activated for testing purposes. His hand was caught in the trailer bed floor, partially amputating his left fifth fingertip.
An employee was installing bearings on a conveyor when the employee's right ring and little fingertips were caught and amputated between the chain and sprocket.
An employee's finger was pinched between the core and metal shaft on a plastic roll, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was operating a 40-quart dough mixer. When the mixing was complete, the employee picked up the steel mixing bowl with the dough in it, which weighed approximately 40 pounds. The employee then suffered an incarcerated hernia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking around checking a truck when he stepped on a rock and twisted his foot. He then fell on his face, lacerating it.
An employee was pushing lumber back into a chopper saw when the saw cut his hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from an elevated lift platform while pulling furniture to fulfill a customer order, suffering head and wrist injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was dropping a trailer landing gear and was pulling the fifth wheel release when he heard a popping noise, directly followed by a sharp pain in his right elbow. His elbow started to swell up and required hospitalization.

An employee was unloading a pad transformer inside a trailer when he stepped back and slipped on the wet trailer floor. He slipped 2 to 3 feet and then fell off the back, hitting the concrete floor and fracturing his right humerus.
An employee was installing additional bolts on the secondary side of a transformer, which had a voltage of 277480, when a flash occurred and burned the employee's face.
An employee passed out and suffered a heat stroke when shoveling dirt to throw on plastic that was laid for strawberries.
An employee was climbing into a trailer when he slipped, fell to the ground, and injured his head and back.
An employee was using a bull knife while cutting meat when the knife lacerated his left forearm. PPE was being used at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting bacon with a knife and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a handheld circular saw when the saw kicked back and amputated his right small fingertip without bone loss.

An employee placed a 4-foot ladder on top of a 5-foot scaffold and climbed up the ladder to install drywall when the scaffold and employee fell over. The employee suffered a fractured skull and was hospitalized.
An employee observed an unoccupied tug rolling toward an aircraft and was attempting to stop it when the employee suffered a cut wrist.

On 8/21/2017, an employee was checking a natural gas compressor at an oil and gas lease when his right hand was caught and severely lacerated between the fan blade and the frame of the compressor. His hand had to be medically amputated. The fan was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was skiving a tire for retread when sparks from the skiver landed in the open booth used for retreading operations, igniting a flame. The employee suffered from smoke inhalation.
An employee fell from a truck and fractured their collarbone.

An employee was measuring the corner of a roof. When he adjusted his lanyard to get to the other side of the roof, he tripped and fell 21 feet to the ground. He broke his L1 vertebra and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a 3 x 8 metal plate when his right hand was caught between the metal plate and the top layer of a stone resting on a kiln cart. His right middle finger broke in three places and was partially de-gloved and surgically amputated.
A pole truck was lifting a piece of equipment when the chain failed and struck an employee on the head and shoulder. The employee suffered a head laceration.
An employee was mopping stairs in a stairwell due to some water accumulation when she slipped and fell down the stairs, suffering back pain and a bruised tailbone.
An employee was walking with a cane when she tripped on the cane and fell, breaking her right femur.
An employee tripped into the side head knives of a planer machine, lacerating his hand and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell 35 feet while standing on a wall, breaking his heel and pelvis and requiring surgery.
An employee was assembling a boom/dipper for a backhoe when the bucket ram was lowered and partially amputated his right pinky finger.
An employee was moving a large standing fan in the hallway to create some room. Her fingers went inside the guard and the running blades lacerated her left middle finger.
An employee was changing the bologna casing in a stuffing machine when the clamper and trim blade were activated, amputating his thumb tip.

An employee was changing a bearing on an auger. He stepped down on the auger, which was still moving, and his foot was caught between the auger and the wall, amputating his right pinky toe. The auger was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was changing the roller on a roller coater when it smashed two of his left-hand fingers, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was testing a transformer when his hand hit a primary and was shocked, burning both of his hands.
An employee was installing new storm drain pipes and storm inlets in a trench 9 feet deep when it caved in, trapping him up to the shoulder area and injuring his back. He was hospitalized.

While operating a winding machine, an employee was unable to let go of the finishing tape on the outside of the coil or to stop the machine via the foot pedal. Her arm was then caught and seriously injured, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had repaired a transmission valve on a backhoe and went to start the backhoe for testing when the transmission pressure control released and injected hydraulic fluid into the employee's left index finger.
An employee was pushing a trash cart to the dumpster when he fell onto the pavement. He twisted his left knee and suffered detached quadricep muscles in both legs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a table saw when the blade lacerated the employee's finger.

An employee climbed up four stairs to a landing, handed a survey to an employee, turned around to go back down, lost his footing, and fell down the four stairs, breaking his right ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee installed an insulator on a pole and was coming down from the pole using a boom lift when he saw something was not complete and went back up to the location where he was previously working. He then made contact with a switch, which sent an electrical current through the left side of his body and out through the right hand. His right hand was amputated.
An employee was finishing concrete when he became lightheaded and ill due to heat stress and dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was locking up the gate at the site when his personal vehicle, which was still in gear, struck him, injuring his shoulder and ribs.
An employee was unloading a goose neck trailer using a winch and cable. The employee's hand was caught in the winch hook when the truck pulled away amputating the index finger below the nail.
An employee suffered a heat related illness while working a game as part of the grounds crew and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was bitten by a spider.

An employee was operating a forklift while his right hand was outside of the driving compartment. He drove near a dumpster and his hand became caught between the forklift and the dumpster, causing a soft tissue crush injury to his right hand between the index finger and the thumb.
An employee experienced a fingertip amputation.

On 8/22/2017, an employee lost his footing while disconnecting hoses between a tractor and trailer. He fell and struck the ground, suffering fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, and a head contusion, requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was helping to offload a rock crusher and acting as the spotter when the load shifted. As he dismounted the rock crusher to inform the operator he broke his left lower leg and ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet while climbing up a scaffold ladder, suffering a possible fracture.
An employee fell approximately 12 to 15 feet from a ladder to the ground, suffering internal injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting the straps off a concrete tabletop when the tabletop fell on him, breaking his leg/foot.

An employee was running wire through a crawl space when he fell through the drywall ceiling and landed 18 feet below on a concrete surface, suffering blunt force trauma to the head, a severe laceration to the leg, and a fractured lower back.
An employee was walking to a table when her step locked and she fell to the floor, breaking her left arm.

An employee was repairing a tire and determined there was bulge on the side wall of the tire. The tire ruptured, knocking the employee over. The employee sustained a fractured arm and was hospitalized.

An employee had just loaded a liquid cargo trailer when his fall protection became stuck on the trailer's crash box and would not return to the full upright position. He was trying to loosen the platform from the crash box when it released, raising quickly and striking him on his hard hat. He was knocked off balance, causing him to fall backwards off the trailer. He broke his ribs and injured his back.

An employee climbed up a ladder to unhook it from a barge. The employee climbed up 4 to 5 steps when the ladder moved. He lost his balance and fell 6 feet to the floor of the barge, fracturing his left wrist and right knee and possibly fracturing his right hip.
An employee was hospitalized after a push cart hit her foot.

An employee and a coworker were clearing a valve jam on a valve inserter machine when the coworker cycled the machine while the employee's hand was inside. The machine then amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was clearing a clogged dust collector when it amputated two of the employee's fingertips.

An employee and a coworker were moving a metal cart that had metal pieces loaded on it when the employee's right thumb was caught between the cart edge and a metal piece. When the employee pulled his hand out, his right thumb was amputated (with bone loss) from the nail upwards.
An employee was operating a head stamping machine when it jammed. As the employee attempted to unjam the machine, it crushed and amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingers.
An employee was picking up trash on a roof when he fell through the rotted metal roof 7 feet to the ground below. A piece of metal cut him from his stomach to his esophagus, requiring surgery.
On August 21, 2017, an employee was on top of an 8-foot high box moving a pallet when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, injuring his head and torso.

An employee was adjusting the high/low switch on his truck-mounted welder. He was turning around when he lost his footing because it had just rained and his truck bed was slick. He went to steady himself and reached to grab onto something with his hands. His right hand slid underneath the cowling of his welder and two fingers were severely lacerated by the motor fan blades. He was hospitalized.
Two employees were working on a barge near a dock. They were receiving steel plates from the pier using a shore crane when they were struck by lightning. Both were hospitalized.

An employee located a ticket that required him to maneuver down an embankment under a highway overpass. A contractor then approached the area to have a discussion, so the employee proceeded down the embankment to speak with the contractor. About halfway down, he was stepping on a boulder when it shifted. His right foot twisted and broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was closing the doors on a water cabinet when the right door closed on one of his fingers, amputating the fingertip.
On 8/23/2017, an employee was exiting the driver area of a delivery vehicle when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his wrist.

While cleaning and sanitizing trays and racks, a temporary employee ingested diluted cleaner (Super Power Foam 5339) that got around his mouth, mustache, and goatee. The temporary employee suffered pain in his throat and right rib cage.
An employee was cinching up a rigging cable on a forklift when a steel beam fell off the forklift and struck the employee's legs, breaking the left femur and right tibia.

An employee was conducting preventative maintenance on a mixer when the employee's left hand was caught in the belt and pulley resulting in an amputation injury. The mixer was not shut down or locked out at the time.
An employee fell from an 8 foot ladder while working on the fan cool unit above the ceiling. The employee suffered a large laceration on the forehead above the left eye and a fractured C2 vertebrae.

An employee operating a resaw attempted to pull a stick from a chain driving the saw. The chain caught his glove, pulling his right hand into the sprocket and chain and amputating his right index fingertip. The chain was unguarded at the time.

An employee was shutting down equipment at the end of a work shift when she turned and her left foot was caught on a scanner cord. She fell, hitting and cutting her nose and bruising her right knee. She was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing a dough jam on a mixer when the gate caught the employee's hand, removing skin from two to three fingers. The employee was hospitalized. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving a portable welder from the back of a pick-up truck when his right ring fingertip and nail were amputated between the handle of the welder and the pipe rack.
While walking to the sink in the break room, an employee slipped and fell on the wet floor, suffering back and shoulder injuries.
An employee was trying to unjam boards that were fed into a notcher when a board slammed against his right hand, partially amputating his middle finger.
An employee was operating the tube bending machine and amputated the right ring finger half way down the nail.
An employee was on top of cabinets cleaning ceiling fixtures when he lost his balance and fell 8 to 10 feet, requiring hospitalization for a broken back, hip, and nasal bone.

An employee was troubleshooting a manure drive and attempting to change the timing by adjusting the tensioner on the drive chain when the chain caught his fingers, amputating half of his left middle finger and most of his left pinky finger and lacerating his left index and ring fingers. The three-phase switch next to the guard was off at the time.
Employees were removing storefront glass panels when a panel broke into three pieces. The glass lacerated the injured employee's right bicep.
An employee was brewing tea when the tea basket fell. The hot contents spilled on and burned the employee's chest, shoulder, and neck, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to clean a clog on a stringer machine when it cycled and amputated her fingertip. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was standing on the right side of a horse waiting for sedation to take place prior to surgery when the horse kicked him on the head, resulting in bruising/a contusion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a truck for the day and putting a pallet jack into the trailer. While stepping between the dock and the trailer, the employee's right leg went into the 8-inch gap. The employee sustained a deep laceration to the leg below the knee, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee suffered a chemical burn while removing a hose cap.
An employee was removing a chain on the floor from a self-supporting steel frame when the 1,500-pound frame fell on the employee, lacerating the employee's left arm and fracturing the left foot.
On 8/23/2017, an employee tripped over a small rise in the entrance doorway while walking into the facility, suffering several fractures to the tibia and knee damage. The employee had surgery.
An employee was hydro-blasting a column when the pressure end of the nozzle contacted and lacerated the employee's lower leg.
An employee's hand was caught in turning machinery, amputating the index and little fingers (with bone loss).
An employee was trimming a plastic cooling fan for a spindle motor with a pair of scissors when the scissors amputated one of the employee's fingertips.
While cleaning a seafood area, an employee tripped on a pan of hot fryer oil and was burned on the buttocks and groin, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was stepping on plastic bags on the floor when he fell, breaking his ankle and requiring hospitalization/surgery.
An employee was cleaning a fermenter room when his right foot was caught in a machine's roller mechanism, partially amputating his right heel.

An employee was operating a spreader bar while installing an HVAC unit on a rooftop. A load was being lowered while the injured employee got into position. The load came down too fast for the employee to move out of the way and the spreader bar slammed into his steel toe boot. His hand was caught between the load and the bar, amputating two fingers.
An employee was walking through an aisle and tripped over a broom. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip.

A security guard was performing a welfare check on a man who pulled a gun and tried to shoot her. She then fell back and braced her fall with her left hand, breaking her wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on the wet floor that was being cleaned while running to attend to a patient. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee was removing a utility pole from the ground when it broke loose and struck the employee's back.
An employee was carrying a large and heavy box of shoes up a ladder, lost balance and fell off the ladder resulting in a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee tripped and fell down the stairs, spraining and cutting her left ankle and fracturing her tibia. She was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a triple pallet jack to lift cases when he ran into a support beam. His right thigh and knee were pinched between the equipment and beam, resulting in a contusion that required hospitalization.

An employee was changing a tire on a piece of heavy mining equipment when the rim came off and struck the employee. The employee was thrown approximately 10 feet, breaking two arm bones and one rib. The employee as hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a hallway when he tripped, hit his head on the door, and fell, injuring his head and shoulder. He was hospitalized and had shoulder surgery.
An employee was moving a stack of chairs when they fell over, tripping the employee. The employee fell on the floor and suffered fractured hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was working at a stacker machine, building a log that was held up by a log sword, when the log sword fell behind the stacker. As he was attempting to retrieve the log sword, the log dropped, crushing his hand under the sword plate and amputating his thumb.
An employee was loading a riding trowel when the employee's finger was caught between the riding trowel and equipment, breaking and lacerating it.
An employee was loading a screed machine into a semi-trailer and descending the machine's ladder when he fell and hit his head on the asphalt below. He suffered a brain hemorrhage and brain swelling.

An employee was conducting maintenance on the triangle bagger. While attempting to re-attach a metal sleeve/tube to the machine, the employee's hand was pulled into the auger, amputating the right little finger.
An employee was learning to operate an edge sander and suffered a finger amputation while cleaning out the sander.
After stocking and organizing product in a warm warehouse, an employee felt ill. She was hospitalized with heatstroke.

An employee was replacing a broken pin at the sorter bay. After removing the pin, the employee used a carter pin to energize the valve. The cylinder rod extended and he used his left index finger to check the alignment of the clevis and Pad-I. The carter pin slipped, causing the valve to de-energize and the cylinder to retract and amputate his left index fingertip.

An employee was power washing a vertical pipe while standing on a step ladder when the employee's foot went off the ladder. The power washer wand was then pulled out of the pipe, and the high-pressure washer fluid contacted and cut the employee.
An employee fell approximately 35 feet while erecting a scaffold, suffering a broken left leg, broken right arm, fractured pelvis, and head bruises.

An employee was rigging down bales that were being lowered out a V door and down a slide with a winch. As the bales were being lowered to the catwalk via the slide, one section became stuck on a roller on the rig floor. When the employee reached down to free the bale, it came free and knocked him off balance. He fell through the V door and down the slide, striking an object and suffering fractured facial bones, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was walking down a loading dock when he tripped over a fixed object on the floor. He fell and fractured his right shoulder, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee had just walked through two double swinging doors to the mailroom. The employee attempted to cross a floor scale and tripped over the edge of the scale. She fell to the ground and as the double swinging doors swung back through, one of them struck her in the head and fractured her neck.

An employee was inspecting and photographing pipeline installation activities when he stepped backwards into an impression in the ground. He lost his balance and fell, hitting his head on a lowboy trailer. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae in his upper back.

An employee was standing behind a sit-down forklift. He was trying to lift out the LP gas tank and was having difficulty and asked for assistance. Another employee operating a stand-up forklift came over to help and struck the employee on his right hip. The injured employee fell to the ground. He was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis.

Two employees were installing MST boxes behind their company truck on the side of the road when a car traveling in the same direction struck both employees. One of the employees was hospitalized with a broken left femur.

An employee was trying to enter an elevator when the elevator door came down and hit the employee's head. The employee's hard hat was knocked off and the employee fell backwards into an open, metal-grated stairwell. The employee suffered head lacerations, hip bruises, and leg bruises, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to empty an aluminum scrap hopper. He exited the forklift and walked under the elevated hopper. His left hand was on the fork as he struck the lever that dumps the hopper bin. 

When the hopper dumped its load, it created a pinch point between the hopper and the forklift forks. The employee's left fourth digit was caught between the hopper and the forklift and had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was working on a loading dock when she slipped and hit her head on a mobile rack, requiring hospitalization for a head injury.
An employee was operating a backpack vacuum cleaner when the vacuum's power cord was severed, causing an electrical spark that shocked his left leg.
On August 24, 2017, an employee was exposed to sulfuric acid vapors while adding water to a sulfuric acid tank, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was checking a skid steer for a hydraulic leak. When he started the skid steer, it pushed him 10 feet away. He was then pinned between two pieces of rolling stock, fracturing his left leg.

While standing on a pole scaffold platform and cleaning a potable water tank, an employee fell approximately 48 inches from the scaffold platform to a lower platform. The employee was hospitalized with head trauma.
An employee was moving material with a standup forklift when the employee lost control of the forklift and was pinned between it and a pallet rack. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.

An employee had loaded boxes of food items onto a truck lift gate and was lowering it when he fell approximately 4 feet off the gate to the ground. He suffered a hairline fracture to the left ear area and was hospitalized overnight.
On August 24, 2017, an employee was attempting to close a gate when his right pinky finger was caught in the gate's roller, lacerating and amputating his fingertip.
An employee was operating a labeling machine when the employee's fingertip contacted moving parts and was amputated.

An employee was using an industrial drill press to add a 1" hole into aluminum castings. An employee was using a food processor to cut potatoes when the machine jammed. As the employee was trying to remove the jammed potato, the processor's rotating plate struck and amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was replacing the worn paddles of an airlock on a platform. The employee's left hand was then amputated between the airlock paddle and a wear bar.

An employee was underneath a residential home installing an HVAC plenum when his right hand made contact with an exposed energized electrical wire. He received an electrical shock and sustained burn injuries to his right hand and chest.
An employee was helping a patient to get a wash cloth when she tripped over a floor mat and fell, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking near the nurse's station when she slipped on water, fell to the ground, and broke her pelvis.

On August 25, 2017, at approximately 3:45 PM, an employee was working on a conveyor. The conveyor was turned off and locked out to perform the maintenance. An employee fell to the ground while suspended from a sprayer boom, suffering a concussion, two broken teeth, fractured bones around the sinuses, and a sprained wrist.

While performing maintenance activities, an employee began to feel ill, vomited, and sweated profusely. He started to have involuntary muscle spasms and difficulty speaking, requiring hospitalization for dehydration and other heat-related symptoms.
An employee was climbing off the bed of a pickup truck when she missed a step onto the tailgate and fell to the ground, breaking her left hip, left femur, and left wrist. She was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to repair an automatic welder when the operator cycled the machine, which amputated the employee's left index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was washing a cake depositor when the blades amputated his fingertip. The depositor was cycling at the time.

An employee was working with a coworker to build concrete forms that consist of a metal plate and metal rails held together with magnets. They were moving the rails when the magnets pulled the pieces together, pinching and amputating the injured employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was inside the trailer on the back of a truck. When he was exiting the trailer, he lost his balance and fell to the ground, suffering a head concussion.
An employee was unloading a running walk-behind mower from a trailer when the mower blade amputated a portion of his left thumb.
An employee was struck on the head by a falling metal cabinet, suffering a concussion.

An employee was wiring a low voltage wire gauge to the top of a chemical storage tank when he noticed the overhead light mounting bracket was broken. On August 25, 2017, at 9:00 a.m., an employee was dismounting his grappling excavator when he lost his footing and fell 3.5 to 4 feet to the ground. He suffered kidney pain and was hospitalized.

On August 25, 2017, an employee was attempting to retrieve a dropped tool under a portable power washing machine when the machine was activated. An unguarded drive belt then engaged and amputated the employee's left-hand little finger.
An employee was using a table saw when the blade amputated his ring and middle fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time.
On August 25, 2017, an employee was operating a radial arm circular saw to cut a wooden board when the employee's finger contacted the rotating blade, fracturing and lacerating it.

An employee was scraping the top of a machine with a small handheld scraper when the scraper fell into the machine. As the employee was trying to retrieve it, the machine's moving parts amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing material from a table saw when it partially amputated his left thumb. The saw was running at the time.
An employee stepped into the bight of a wire and suffered a broken right ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving an order picker backwards down an inventory aisle. One of the pallets on his lift became caught on an inventory racking, pushing the pallet into his leg and pinning him against the order picker. He suffered lacerations and a right leg sprain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing a broken board from a planer machine when the employee's right hand made contact with the side head and three fingers were amputated.
On August 25, 2017, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was operating a table saw when his hand slipped and his left index fingertip made contact with the rotating blade and was amputated.

An employee was standing approximately 20 feet away from a coworker that was hooking up a 6,000 psi sewer jet to clean out a pipeline. An employee was cutting lumber with a rough knot saw. The employee was moving planks of wood from a roller when the saw was activated. The saw's guard came down just before the saw blade came up, and the employee's right index and middle fingertips were amputate by the blade or the moving guard.

An employee was using a push bar to move a 260-pound piece of scrap from a 42-inch high table into a scrap bin. The push bar hit another piece of scrap, and the scrap piece rolled off the table and hit his right ankle, fracturing his distal fibula and medial malleolus.

An employee was in an elevated bucket, replacing an electrical pole, when his body made contact with a live electrical current, which entered his body in his elbow and exited out of his chest area. He suffered electrical burns.

An employee was handling compressed gas cylinders using a cylinder cart. The hook used to secure the cylinder to the cart slipped, causing the cylinder to lower onto the cart. An employee's right arm was caught and crushed in a machine roller.

 ligaments in the foot.

An employee was making a bed. As she was moving around the bed, her foot became caught around the cord for a fetal monitoring machine. She fell and fractured her left femur.
An employee was installing a new door on a machine when the door actuated while the employee was checking the operation. The door lacerated the employee's face and broke the employee's jaw.

An employee was walking beside a piece of 4-inch pipe on jack stands while a coworker was pushing the wind block. The wind block hit the pipe on the jack stand, causing the pipe to fall and strike the employee, who suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was driving a standup forklift and got their left foot caught between the pallets and the exterior of the forklift resulting in lacerations and broken metatarsals.
An employee was installing drywall on a wall next to a door opening when the door closed on his middle finger, amputating his fingertip.
Two employees became nauseated and began vomiting after unloading chemicals from the truck. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on two auger conveyors when the conveyor cover fell off and struck a pot of hot fat, which had a magnetic cover, 4 to 5 feet below the employee. The metal band/lock around the magnetic cover broke, allowing the pressurized fat to spray out and contact the employee, who received second and third degree burns, primarily on the lower legs.
An employee was unloading equipment from a work vehicle when his heart began beating rapidly.
An employee was using a forklift to dump trash. The employee exited the forklift, which then pinned him, breaking his ribs and shoulder blade and puncturing his lung.

The injured employee was cleaning in the mill room and was standing on top of a guardrail on a platform. A forklift operated by another employee struck the platform and the injured employee fell 6.5 feet from the guardrail he was standing on to the mill room floor below. The employee fractured both heels and the left ankle.

An employee was holding a 4x4 piece of wood against the wall of a vessel while a forklift operator placed a bundle of zinc ingots alongside the wood. The forklift operator went too far into the bundle, which caused the forklift blades to push against the 4x4, smashing and partially amputating the employee's right thumb.

An employee was unloading a piece of pipe from a dump truck when the truck moved forward and he slipped. As he slipped, he gave a stopping motion to the driver. The driver stopped suddenly, and the truck tailgate came down and amputated the employee's right pinky finger.
An employee was using a cutting wheel to open a crate when a piece of the wheel broke off and struck his ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On August 31, 2017, an employee was sitting on a riding lawn mower when the employee's right pant leg caught the edge of the mower deck, which then pulled the employee's right foot into the blade, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was changing a saver sub, using a sling around a grabber box, when the rating tag on the sling was pinched under the grabber box. The employee was using a wrench to try and pry out the rating tag when the grabber box fell and caught the employee's fingers, amputating the first digit of the right middle finger.

An employee was removing an air conditioning unit from a wall when he dropped an envelope in the unit. As he attempted to retrieve the envelope, the unit's fan blade deeply lacerated his hand, requiring surgery.

A crew was lifting a concrete power pole off a pole trailer to verify the lifting point was in the proper position. The injured employee's hand was on an insulator that was attached to the pole, checking for balance, when the pole shifted and caught his right pinky finger between the insulator and a bolt on a second pole that was on the trailer. His finger was fractured between the main and middle knuckles.

An employee was checking a water leak in a house stairwell. The employee went below the stairwell and was standing on the landing when the floor gave way. The employee fell a couple feet, fracturing the right foot and left tibia.
An employee was carrying a sandbag when the employee lost their footing and fell to the same level, suffering neck pain and a shoulder sprain/strain.
An employee slipped on a wet surface while performing pool maintenance and fell into the pool, fracturing the left leg.
An employee was trimming tree branches when a tree behind him fell on and crushed him.
An employee was repairing a balancer that had a broken pin when the high-tension springs released and the unit fell on his left index finger, amputating the soft tissue on his fingertip.

On September 1, 2017, an employee was riding in a golf cart after working the concession stand at a football game. While in the seat, she was seen kneeling over and then fell to the ground where she hit her head, fracturing her skull.
An employee was operating a punching press to punch out aluminum parts when the press repeated and struck the employee's left index finger, lacerating it and requiring hospitalization.
