On September 1, 2017, at approximately 2:01 p.m., an employee was operating a press machine when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated in the machine.
On September 1, 2017, a temporary employee fell through a hole from the second floor to the first floor, suffering a head injury and brain swelling. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a portable grinder with a wire brush wheel to clean a metallic natural gas pipe in preparation for welding. The flow of natural gas had been stopped with a metallic stopper pin. As the employee was using the grinder, the stopper pin became dislodged from a seated position, resulting in a brief ignition of the natural gas. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to the right side of his face and nose.

An employee was moving a storage trailer toward a dock when the trailer tipped on a hill. The cab then went into the air and fell down with the trailer. The employee suffered two vertebrae fractures, one tailbone fracture, and one shoulder blade fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a shrink wrapping machine when the side seal became wrapped around the seal bar. As the employee was trying to remove the side seal, the machine's blade cut and amputated the employee's left index fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee and a coworker were removing a 7-inch pipe from a rack when the pipe fell from the rack and struck the employee's left hand, amputating the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a forklift to move pallets. He was attempting to adjust the forklift mast chain when it amputated his middle and index fingertips.
An employee and a coworker were lifting a foot cart over a step when the cart shifted and pinned the employee's right pinky between the cart and the ground, amputating his fingertip.
An employee suffered an asthmatic reaction and had difficulty breathing after walking by a hallway that was being waxed, requiring hospitalization.
On September 1, 2017, an employee was nailing wooden trusses using a nail gun. As the employee went to kneel down, the nail gun fired a nail into his right knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a die machine when the die fell out of the machine and struck the employee's knee, causing bruising and swelling.
An employee stumbled while walking on a wheelchair accessible ramp to go into the building, tearing his right shoulder.
An employee was trimming weeds near a creek bed when he lost his footing and fell approximately 15 feet into the creek bed, breaking his left wrist, three ribs, and two thoracic vertebrae.
On September 1, 2017, an employee was standing and waiting for a silo to empty when a piece of angle iron fell from above and struck the employee's hand, amputating the thumb tip.

While employees were loading a shipping container with 2,200-pound tote bags of peanuts, an employee walked into the container to place a slip sheet on the floor. Before the employee exited the container, a forklift operator drove a forklift with a loaded tote bag into the container. The forklift set the tote bag down on the employee's leg, fracturing the leg, ankle, and toes. The employee was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was descending into a tank using a permanent fixed ladder when he received an electrical shock, which caused him to lose his grip on the ladder and fall. He fell approximately 20 feet and struck a platform. He then bounced off the platform handrail and fell another 8 feet to the bottom of the tank, suffering shoulder, rib, and back injuries.
While standing on a freezer ladder and removing items from a second-level shelf, an employee fell back and struck the floor, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on a machine. Her hand was on the rubber belt trying to make it engage and run. The belt began to run, catching and cutting her left ring fingertip, which had to be surgically amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time.
A temporary employee was moving a metal cabinet when his left pinky finger was smashed between the cabinet and a forklift tine. His finger had to be amputated.
An employee was operating a skinner machine when the blade avulsed her left thumb.
An employee was manually rotating the blades of a grinder machine to clear plastic out of it after a power outage when the blades partially amputated his left thumb.
An employee was raking ashes from a fire box when a blowback occurred, forcing flames out the door, which burned both of the employee's forearms and hands.
An employee was installing a pump at a remote site when he lost control of the pump. The pump then hit and amputated approximately 1/2 inch of his right middle finger.
An employee was using a produce bagger machine to fill sacks with potatoes when the machine's pneumatic clamp crushed the employee's left pinky finger, requiring amputation without bone loss.

An employee was feeding rubber into a rubber mill machine when his glove became stuck on the rubber. His gloved hand was then pulled into the rollers, partially amputating his left thumb tip and the second joint of his left index finger.
An employee lost his grip and fell from a ladder rung as he was climbing a scaffold, breaking two ribs.
An employee was attempting to remove a jammed box from a machine. When the box was removed, the machine moved and pinched/amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee attempted to get on his pallet truck to go in reverse when the handle swung out and caught his hand between the handle and the steel shelves in the perishable department causing approximately 3/25 inch tip of the pinky finger to be amputated.
An employee was making a bracket on a power press when his left hand contacted the moving components in the press, partially amputating his index fingertip.

An employee was at a construction/demolition site when he sat down on a piece of plywood that was covering a hole in the floor and fell through it. He contacted the floor below and suffered head trauma, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a machine chain with a rag when the rag became caught in the chain, pulling it and the employee's left index finger into the chain. His finger was amputated to the second knuckle. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was lowering a scaffold when the employee's left-hand palm was impaled on the scaffold lever.

While climbing down a secondary ladder in a water tower, an employee fell approximately 30 feet to a platform, breaking two vertebrae, puncturing a lung, and breaking a foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet concrete floor that had just been washed, fracturing her ankle.
An employee was in a harvester cutting a pine tree when the tree came down over the back of the harvester and struck him. He suffered three broken ribs, a broken left arm, and a concussion.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal (large socket) on a bench grinder when the piece of metal became caught and dragged his right index finger into the grinder, partially amputating it.
An employee was lifting boxes of retail merchandise off of a cart and felt pain in her back. The employee suffered a back injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling an engine block onto a steel plate when the employee's left hand was caught in the path of the moving engine block, amputating the middle fingertip.
While descending a ladder from a roof, an employee slipped and fell 16 feet, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. His left foot was off the platform when he ran into a roof support pole. He suffered a severe left foot contusion and laceration and broke a bone, which resulted in a toe amputation.
On September 2, 2017, an employee was adding chlorine tablets to a swimming pool when he inhaled chlorine vapor. He suffered respiratory/lung distress and was hospitalized.
Employees were driving on a lease road and hit a bump. The employee in the back seat struck his head on the ceiling of the van. The employee was admitted for a concussion.
A firefighter was working out and performing regular daily exercises under the firefighting physical fitness program when he suffered a muscle injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a valve when the valve closed on and amputated one of the employee's right fingertips.
An employee was cleaning kitchen knives when a knife punctured his abdomen.

An employee was walking through a furnace pit when the furnace trough kicked back. The employee then stepped back into a mold full of molten metal, suffering second degree burns to the right ankle and calf and to the left foot.

On September 3, 2017, an employee was driving a pallet jack down an aisle. At the same time, a coworker was dropping a plastic pallet onto another pallet. The plastic pallet bounced up and struck the backrest of the employee's pallet jack, then pinned his lower right leg/ankle between his jack platform and the pallet. His right ankle broke.
While stepping out of a pickup truck to purchase gasoline, an employee slipped off the running board and fell to the ground. The employee dislocated an ankle and had surgery.
An employee was aligning a draw bar on a gate ladle when his alignment tool twisted and pinched his right ring finger between the tool and the ladle, partially amputating it.

An employee was removing a bird from the bird chiller machine when the employee's right arm above the elbow was caught in the machine, fracturing and lacerating the upper right bicep. The employee was hospitalized. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
On September 3, 2017, an employee was observing a coworker running a cash register when she stepped back and fell off a step, breaking her leg and requiring surgery.

An employee was performing maintenance and replacing an equipment pump. The employee turned the pump on and opened a valve, which resulted in liquefied sugar spraying onto a product tank and then splashing onto the employee, causing burns.

An employee was lowering a well pump down a well shaft when a 1/2-inch cable snapped and whipped back up, striking the employee. He suffered lacerations to both hands and bruising on the chest, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to exit a facility through a turnstile when her knee gave way. She then twisted and fractured her ankle.
On September 4, 2017, an employee suffered an infection after processing raw poultry, requiring hospitalization.
An employee lost his balance and fell to the ground while transitioning from the top of a porch into a man lift. He injured his back.
An employee was setting up a machine using a rubber, 10.5-pound hammer, when the hammer smashed his left thumb, lacerating and fracturing it.
An employee was using a pallet jack when she fell backward and struck her head on the floor, suffering a head bump.
An employee fell from an extension ladder while inspecting a box truck, suffering two vertebrae fractures, fractured ribs, and a forehead laceration.

On 9/04/2017, at approximately 6:30 a.m., an employee was attempting to remove a plastic roll core from a machine when the machine's extractor arm moved the roll, causing it to pinch his right index finger. His finger had to be surgically amputated up to the first digit.
An employee was trying to light a propane grill when a propane explosion occurred. He suffered second and third degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a wellsite when his right little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving an excavator when the vehicle rolled off the road. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae and ribs, as well as an arm injury.
An employee was struck by a loose rock while monitoring recreational hikers/climbers. The employee then fell approximately 70 feet, suffering a concussion and collapsed lung.
An employee fainted in a stock room. The employee's head struck a cart and was lacerated.
An employee was opening a high-pressure relief valve with a pressure bar. He was pulling down on the bar when it gave way, causing him to fall on the second bar. He tore his left triceps and bicep.
On Septembers 4, 2017, an employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when it amputated his right thumb tip. The conveyor belt was running and unguarded at the time.
An employee slipped and fell while entering an elevator that was uneven with the main floor. She broke her left arm.

An employee finished a roofing repair patch at a completed installation and was descending from the roof using a permanent ladder when he slipped and fell 12 feet to the ground. He fractured his right foot and was hospitalized.
On September 5, 2017, an employee working on a residential home fell 10 feet from an A-frame ladder, suffering a head injury and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing the rope on a winch line when his left thumb was caught between the anchor on the drum and the frame, amputating the thumb tip.
An employee's left middle fingertip was pinched and amputated by a machine.

An employee was using a wrench to adjust a bolt on a conveyor belt when he came in contact with the geared conveyance system, which pulled the wrench away from his hand. His right middle finger was in a circular opening of the wrench handle. When the wrench pulled away, it amputated his fingertip.

An employee was un-decking a trailer and tying up the back when his boot became twisted between the block and chains, causing him to fall backward and hit his head on the trailer. He suffered cracked neck vertebrae and lacerations.

An employee was leading a young horse by a rope to a pasture when the horse tried to escape. He was trying to hang onto the rope when the horse's hind leg kicked him in the jaw, fracturing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a CNC bending machine when the clamp came up and caught his right-hand middle and ring fingers. He had surgery and was hospitalized overnight.
While unloading merchandise for delivery, an employee stepped on an unseated dock plate and suffered a right leg fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was shot in the leg by a disgruntled customer.
An employee had just finished roofing construction on a structure when he fell off a straight ladder and struck the compacted hard soil below, breaking his right leg.
An employee was on the ground balancing a truck load when the truck tire ran over and crushed the employee's right foot, causing a partial amputation.
After emptying trash containers on a rear-load truck, an employee experienced cramping and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was using an extendable conveyor and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was driving a forklift when he struck a pole and fell from the forklift to the floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was training coworkers on how to set up a lift. When he pulled the pin on the equipment and moved the support, the lift tipped toward him and landed on his right knee, injuring it.
On September 5, 2017, at 5:45 a.m., an employee was attempting to move a dolly containing a 55-gallon drum when the employee slipped and fell backward, breaking the left hip.

During a simulated building entry procedure, an employee was being dragged out of a building that coworkers were attempting to secure as part of the simulation. One of his coworkers lost his balance and fell on the employee, fracturing several ribs on his right side.

An employee was repairing/adjusting an air switch when the switch engaged. The clamps then amputated/avulsed the employee's left ring finger from the base of the nail down. The air switch was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was placing cardboard boxes into a bailer when he became light-headed and sweaty, requiring hospitalization for exhaustion.
An employee fell from a ladder while servicing a refrigerator, suffering a skull fracture.
On September 5, an employee fell approximately 10 feet off a canopy while repairing a roof. The employee suffered a fractured back.

An employee was dumping a chip hopper. His fingers were between the  hopper's box tubing, where the forklift forks pick up the hopper. When he released the dump latch to dump his chips, the weight of the hopper rolling forward caused the box tubing to slam against the forks. This created a pinch point that smashed and amputated his right index and middle fingertips.

An employee was troubleshooting a broken water hose on a cement truck. The employee lifted the charge hoop (chute), which then came down and smashed the employee's thumb between the truck's hopper and drum ring, causing a possible fracture or torn nail.

On September 5, 2017, a temporary employee was operating a press brake, which was being fed by a roll forming machine. During operation, the employee's hands entered the 5-inch gap between the dies. The press then amputated two of his fingers.
An employee was troubleshooting a piece of machinery in the valve area. While he was demagnetizing the machine, his left-hand tendon was cut, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was driving powered equipment when his leg was caught between the equipment and a nearby electrical panel, breaking his fibula.
An employee was attempting to unjam a chicken bagging machine when the machine cycled and amputated the employee's middle finger up to the first joint.
An employee was sweeping the floor around an olive pitting machine when her hand entered the auger chute, which then amputated her pinky finger and lacerated her middle/ring fingers.
On September 5, 2017, an employee parked and was exiting a vehicle when he lost his footing and tripped, fracturing his femur.
An employee complained of chest pains and shortness of breath during a training exercise at the fire training research center.
An employee was adjusting the conveyor belt when it amputated his right ring fingertip and lacerated his middle fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a cardboard die-cutting machine when his cleaning rag and his hand were pulled into the rollers, amputating fingers.
An employee was installing a culter on a frame when the equipment slipped and amputated the employee's finger.

An employee was standing at the bow of a barge operating a skid steer by remote control and had his hand resting on the top edge of the barge. The crane operator swung the bucket over and crushed his hand between the bucket of the crane and the barge wall.
An employee was holding the bathroom door for a fellow employee when his hand was caught in the door resulting in a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was using two hoists to lift a 5-foot section of channel iron that was supporting a 200-pound motor. Hoist hooks supported the channel iron through eyelets. While positioning the hoist, the employee placed his finger through an eyelet. Weight shifted, creating a pinch point between the eyelet and the hoist hook that amputated his finger.

An employee exited a vehicle to speak with a customer and then noticed the vehicle was moving. While attempting to get back into the vehicle, the employee was struck by the door and then run over by the vehicle, suffering tissue damage to the right leg. The employee was hospitalized overnight and had surgery.

On September 9, 2017, an employee was using a table saw to cut plywood when the saw blade broke. Blade tip fragments flew up and struck the employee's face and neck, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was removing fence pieces (platform). He was standing on a smaller fence piece and cut the rope from a large section of fence piece. The large section came loose and the smaller section gave way. He fell approximately 20 feet to ground level (roadway). His PPE was not tied off at the time.
An employee had removed dirt inside a trench using an air hammer. The air hammer was then being removed when it fell on the employee's head, causing a head injury and brain swelling.
An employee was pulling plastic to wrap an ottoman when a machine's gate door came down and amputated his left middle fingertip.
On September 6, 2017, an employee was operating a forklift when he hit a pole and fractured his skull.

An employee was spotting for a truck driver who was backing up in the truck yard. The driver did not see the employee and pinned him between his truck and another truck nearby. He suffered a collapsed lung.
An employee was inspecting communication cables and fell from a catwalk, sustaining two broken wrists.
An employee was patrolling the hotel premises on an all-terrain vehicle when he hit a slick spot on the road and swerved into a tree, fracturing his right femur.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw and amputated the left thumb tip and nail.

An employee was standing on an inclined mobile ladder using a pipe wrench to remove a shaft from an auger on a feed haul trailer. The wrench slipped off the shaft, causing him to lose balance and stumble backward down the ladder. He was unable to grab the handrails on the ladder to stop his fall, and he landed on his tailbone on the floor. His head then fell back and hit the floor. He suffered a lower back contusion and a head laceration.

An employee was painting the walls and ceiling in a school room. While descending a 12-foot A-frame ladder, he felt dizzy, missed a step, and fell 8 or 9 feet to the floor, bruising his head, scraping his right arm, and fracturing his right hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a cartoner when his hand entered the running machinery, amputating his thumb from the tip to the first knuckle.

An employee was riding a tractor mower back to the shop because it was running hot when the mower's radiator exploded. He was sprayed with hot radiator fluid, suffering first and second degree thermal burns/blistering to his face and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting a squeaky motor in a paint room booth. He was pulling the belt with his right hand to make the shaft and motor move. His right middle fingertip was then caught between the belt and pulley. When he attempted to pull his finger out, his fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was helping a coworker guide a metal basket into a tilling tank. The employee's left index finger became stuck in one of the basket holes as the basket brushed against the frame of the machine, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was scooping meat out of a stuffing machine tray when his leg pressed against the actuating device. The machine turned on and partially amputated his right ring finger between the first and second knuckle. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee and a coworker placed an approximately 52-pound box on a shelf. The box shifted and slipped off the shelf, striking the employee on the shoulder after he had turned his back and was walking away. He fell to the ground and struck his head, suffering a concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting a cart when a forklift drove by and hit the cart, which then pinned and injured his lower leg/ankle.

An employee was holding the wing side of a swivel connection in place to connect an iron riser to a wellhead when his right pinky finger was caught between the iron riser and the threaded part of the well, amputating it above the nail.
An employee lifted a four-pack of beer bottles to scan it. The wet bottom gave way, and a bottle fell on her right middle finger, severing the tendons.
An employee suffered an electric shock and/or burns on the hands and fingers while installing distribution lines.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access the storage mezzanine and fell off the ladder. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion, inflammation in the abdomen and bruising.
An employee's hand was caught between the tailgate and the truck as he tried opening it with his hands. A finger was injured requiring stitches.
An employee was placing a stem cutter back on a shelf when it amputated her left middle fingertip.

An employee was working at a station that packs parachutes into canisters. The hydraulic ram on the parachute packing machine initiated out of sequence, catching the employee's glove. She was able to extract her hand from the glove, but not before the end of the ram entered the canister and amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was installing an elevator and climbing over the elevator mid-rail when he suffered a herniated disc in his back.

An employee was walking back from lunch to the worksite when a piece of spiral duct on the rooftop blew down to the ground and struck the employee's neck. The employee suffered a laceration from the neck to the shoulder.
An employee was repairing a sash on a window when his hand slipped and his left forearm contacted the repair tool he was using, lacerating it. He was hospitalized for surgery.

On September 7, 2017, an employee was hoisting a large argon gas cylinder with a chain. As the cylinder was being lifted, the chain started to move and the cylinder shifted. The employee grabbed the valve ring on top of the cylinder and was trying to stabilize it when the first digit of the employee's left thumb was caught and amputated between the chain and one of the ring supports.

An employee was delivering a load to a company. When he opened his truck trailer doors, he was struck by falling pallets with products on them. He suffered hand and neck lacerations and a cervical neck injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was framing the garage roof at a residential home when he fell from an 8-foot elevation, suffering a head injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a piece of tile from a belt conveyor system when his left index finger was caught in the belt and pulley, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was unloading a hook block assembly. As he was removing the second pin from the hook block, the hook block fell and struck his left leg, crushing it. His leg was amputated above the knee.

An employee was aligning a coil to the guiderails of a mechanical power press' stamping die when the press cycled. The press came down and pinched the employee's left index finger, which had to be medically amputated.
An employee was knocked to the ground by a parked car that rolled down a sloped area, suffering a vertebral fracture, herniated disc, and bruised tailbone.
An employee was trying to pull a 2x4 through a table saw when his left hand contacted the spinning blade, lacerating his index and middle fingers.
An employee was hand-controlling a hoist to bring up a load of bricks when the entire hoist system tipped back and fell on top of him, injuring his back.

An employee was on top of the conveyor belt junction tower investigating some stoppages of a belt when he noticed some debris on a drum pivoting the belt to the tensioner a few floors below. He used a 5-foot pry bar to try to clear the debris from the area in front of the drum. The pry bar contacted a moving surface and shifted, pinching his right middle finger between the bar and either the electrical conduit or an adjacent machine guard. His fingertip was crushed and avulsed requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was driving a forklift when his foot became stuck between the forklift step and a stack of plates. He broke his ankle.

An employee's cellphone fell onto a conveyor belt while he was removing a jammed stick from the belt. As he attempted to retrieve his phone, the conveyor caught his right arm, removing flesh from his bicep and scraping his arm from his elbow to his knuckles. He was hospitalized.
An employee and coworkers were unloading a utility vehicle when it fell on and broke the employee's leg.
An employee was using a portable cordless drill to prepare tubing for welding when the drill started to slip. When he attempted to catch the drill, the attachment amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee's fingertip was caught and amputated in a self-closing door.
An employee was pouring cement when some landed inside his boot, burning his lower leg.
An employee was disassembling a cylinder head with a pneumatic torque wrench when the wrench pinched his left index finger, crushing and amputating the fingertip.
On September 7, 2017, an employee was adjusting a bottle cap removal machine when it amputated the employee's finger. The machine was running at the time.

On 9/07/2017, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was delivering mail when she was attacked by a vicious dog. The dog bit her right arm, wrist, and hand. She was hospitalized overnight for possible surgery.

An employee was cleaning suction holes on a stacker, using a 4.5" side grinder with a wire brush wheel. While cleaning pitch off the holes, he had the grinder in his right hand and was holding off some belts that were in the way with his left hand when the wire wheel contacted his left thumb. A piece of wire strand became embedded in his left thumb and had to be surgically removed.
An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw when the saw kicked back and amputated two fingertips without bone loss.
An employee fell to a different level while coming down a stairwell, breaking bones and requiring hospitalization.
An employee lost her balance while walking over a speed bump and fell in the parking lot, spraining her left knee and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell resulting in a sprained back.
An employee was loading a pallet of material onto a pallet jack and was struck by a forklift that was operating in reverse resulting in a broken left leg.

An employee was carrying a 25-square-foot kitchen granite piece upstairs with a coworker when the stairs broke off from the landing. He then fell about 4 feet to the ground, suffering bruises and a broken rib. He was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a 6-inch pipe within a horizontal bandsaw when the clamping mechanism caught and injured his right thumb tip.
An employee was checking the slack on a mail sorting machine conveyor belt that was moving slowly when his right index finger was caught and amputated between the belt and pulley.

An employee was using a pneumatic chisel to dig though asphalt when the chisel became stuck. He was trying to unstick it when the chisel came loose and caught his right pinky finger between it and the wall, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was using a scissor lift to pull cable. When the employee raised the lift, the employee's ring finger was pinched and partially amputated between the lift guardrail and sheet metal on the ceiling.
On September 8, 2017, an employee was helping to dismantle a scaffold when he stepped backward and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground. He fractured his right ankle and was hospitalized.

On 9/08/2017, at approximately 3:00 AM, an employee was attempting to clear a jam in a rotary die cutter when her right hand was drawn into the cutter rollers, breaking several fingers. She was hospitalized.

On September 8, 2017, an employee was clearing a machine jam. Once the jam was cleared, the machine cycled and caught the employee's left fifth finger in a pinch point, partially amputating the fingertip.

An employee was working on a crane when an employee from another company charged a melting pot. The charge was higher than expected, which caused the melting pot fire to go into the roof and burn the employee.
An employee was walking past a parked truck when four pipe joints fell off the truck and struck his back, fracturing it.
An employee lost her footing and fell fracturing the right hip.
An employee was replacing a power steering belt when his fingernail was caught and ripped off by the belt.
An employee was repairing a hand line irrigation system when a riser blew and hit him in the face.
While moving a crane trolley wheel from a catwalk onto an extendable boom lift, an employee suffered back pain and was hospitalized.
An employee was flipping a part over using a hoist and a chain sling when his right pinky fingertip was caught and amputated between the part and the chain sling.
An employee tripped and fell over rebar that was on the ground, breaking his right ankle.
An employee was making parts on a press brake and amputated their right thumb tip.
An employee was clearing a clog in a rotary kiln's discharge hopper when hot debris splashed onto his fire-resistant clothing and then into his boot, burning his right foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a conveyor system when the chain and sprocket partially amputated the employee's index finger.

An employee was welding on a steel casing pipe while laying on the ground. One pipe was on the bucket of a backhoe when hydraulics settled on the backhoe, causing the pipe to roll off the backhoe and onto the employee. The employee sustained a broken pelvis, internal bleeding, and a contusion to the left leg.
An employee was picking up trash at a construction worksite when he stepped in a hole and tripped, dislocating his right ankle.

An employee was using a pressure washer to wash a drilling rig when the washer hose became twisted. As the employee was untwisting it, the pressure washer ran over his boots, causing hot water to burn his foot and debris to enter his left middle toe. He required surgery to remove the debris.
An employee was leaning over a rotating strapping dispenser to plug in a fan when he was struck by the rotating steel strapping. The resulting injury required surgery.

An employee was using a utility knife to notch out sections of a composite trim when the knife slipped on the hard surface of the trim and struck the employee's left forearm, severing an artery and cutting veins. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was throwing scrap metal into a bin when the metal bounced back and pinched the employee's left pinky finger between the metal and the bin, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was stacking crates at a grocery store. She was stepping off a pallet when she slipped and fell to the floor, breaking her right femur and requiring overnight hospitalization.
Employees were placing a water line for the city when one of the employees stepped outside of the trenching box. The earth collapsed around him, fracturing his lower vertebrae.

An employee was nippling up a blowout preventer at a drill site when the employee's hand was caught between a blind ram and 4-inch gauge sealer valve, crushing the right pinky finger. The employee's pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was removing a boom from a forklift when the boom fell and struck his arm, tearing his bicep. He was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting finished lightbulb products in a cardboard box at an inspection station. The inspection station was on a work platform that is 33 inches wide, 8 feet long, and 9 inches high. The employee finished inspecting the parts in the cardboard box and turned to go get another cardboard box full of light bulbs. As she turned to step off the platform, she fell to the ground and injured her hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was attempting to replace a gasket in a valve on a separator trailer when he fell and struck a tire rim that was on the ground, breaking ribs and suffering spleen damage.
An employee was repairing a hydraulic lift that is used to dump totes. While working on the tote lifter, the lift came down onto the employee's leg and fractured it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stacking pallets when a nearby forklift operator reversed and struck the employee, who suffered lacerations to the right heel and ankle.
An employee was working in an electrical substation when a cable snapped and struck the employee on the shoulder and the side of the head. The employee suffered bruising.

An employee was laying on his back on the floor, welding on a valve, when another valve opened and dumped hot water on him. He suffered second degree burns on his chest, side, and right arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee came in contact with a live line while repairing a downed powerline, suffering electrical burns to the right arm and torso.
An employee was reaching under a pump when a rattlesnake bit his thumb. He was hospitalized.

An employee and a security guard were trying to get an upset patient out of a locked room. Once the patient was out of the locked room, the employee and the security guard attempted to physically move the patient onto a bed when both the patient and the security guard fell onto the employee, fracturing her tibial plateau.
An employee was struck by a 1,000-pound steel truss that fell off of a parked forklift, suffering jaw, pelvic, back, and rib fractures and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was changing out a roller for a steel band on the drive mechanism of a rod mill when the machine caught his glove and pulled his hand into the roller. Friction from the roller caused a burn and pulled some of his skin off.
An employee was inside a freezer relocating a case weighing approximately 15 pounds from the wall onto a transport cart when he slipped on a small patch of ice and fell, fracturing his left ankle.

An employee was walking down the street wearing a reflective vest and hard hat while conducting a visual inspection of a repaired powerline when he was struck by a hit-and-run vehicle. He broke his right leg and was hospitalized.

A drilling crew was in the process of tripping pipe out of a hole when the pulling cable snapped, letting the block fall freely on the rig floor. A piece of the cable hit one of the employees and became embedded in his right leg, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
While cooking at a grill, an employee was likely affected by heat stress and fainted. The employee fell on the grill and received third degree burns to the hands, arms, face, and head.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when the employee's foot became stuck between the pallet jack and a standing desk, breaking a toe and potentially amputating the middle toe tip.
An employee bent over to pick something up, lost his balance, and fell, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.

On September 11, 2017, at approximately 1:30 PM, two employees were performing service on a forklift (one employee was adjusting tension on the fan belt/the second was lubing the steering axle). The second employee attempted to start the forklift and the first employee's left hand was caught between the fan belt and pulley, amputating the middle, ring and pinky fingertips.
An employee was tightening the fan belt on a large compressor when his right pinky fingertip was caught and amputated in the fan belt.

An employee had just dropped off totes in the universal packing area. A jam on the universal pack bulk conveyor occurred and a box, weighing approximately four pounds fell from the conveyor and struck the employee resulting in a possible concussion.
Employees were removing slag with bars. A large chunk of slag fell and pinned one employee against a wall. The employee injured his pelvis and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was moving a motorized pallet lift across the floor when he lost consciousness and fell to the ground, striking his head on the concrete floor.
An employee was using a utility knife to open a box when the knife amputated his right thumb tip. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.
An employee and a coworker were lifting a tamper machine when his right ring fingertip was caught and amputated at the fingernail between the machine and its cover plate.
An employee was removing plastic from a molding press when the mold closed on his left hand, fracturing his fingers and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a flour silo when he went up to hook his harness and the ladder slipped beneath him. He fell and broke his tibia.
An employee was indexing two pieces of scrap tubing on rollers when a piece moved and caught his left middle and ring fingers, amputating his fingertips above the nail.
An employee separated a flange in a process line when 180  hot water came out of the line and burned him from the waist down.

On September 11, 2017, an employee was reinstalling a carriage in a lathe that cuts logs into veneer when a manual chain hoist that was stabilizing the pressure roll slipped. His right arm was then pinched between the top and bottom of the lathe.

As an employee was backing out of a trailer to close it down, the bands securing a skid broke. The skid collapsed, causing the bucket of a front-end loader to shift and fall on the employee's left foot, lacerating and breaking it.
On 9/11/2017, at 5:20 p.m., an employee was cleaning out a mixer when he fell through a grate on the floor and struck the grate plate, injuring his groin area.

An employee was operating a double baker machine when a plate became stuck in the machine. He was attempting to move the plate when a moving part of the machine fractured and lacerated his right index finger.
An employee was using an aluminum scrap brick clamping bar to move scrap to a pallet when the clamping bar amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
While walking across the production floor, an employee was struck by a forklift, breaking the left hip and requiring surgery/hospitalization.

An employee was auguring in a new pole on top of the digger derrick. The old pole cracked even more as it moved and falling telephone cables struck the employee on the chest knocking him about 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained three fractured ribs.

An employee was walking through the parking lot on her way into work to begin her shift. A parked car, operated by a customer, backed out of a parking space and hit the employee, knocking her to the ground. She broke six ribs and possibly broke her leg.
An employee was operating a press brake tooling machine when it amputated one of his fingertips.
An employee was stacking materials and stepped on a moving chain. Their right foot was caught in the gear and sprocket resulting in amputation of the right big toe.

An employee was selecting product and driving a pallet jack. While turning around a corner of a rack shelf, the employee's knee was caught between the pallet jack and the rack shelf. The employee suffered a knee contusion and was hospitalized.
While conducting a site visit at a residential home, an employee fell from a ladder and hit the ground, breaking both elbows and the hip.
An employee pulled up on a golf cart outside a work bay and got off the golf cart to plug it into a charger. A reversing tractor then ran over his right foot.
An employee was trying to straighten a pallet when she fell about 7 feet to the concrete floor, breaking her left tibia and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to mount the step of a moving garbage truck when he missed the step and his right foot became wedged under the truck's wheel. He fractured his right foot with a possible amputation.

An employee was letting down riggers on a bucket truck when a coworker parked a pickup truck behind him. The pickup trucked then rolled forward and pinned him between the two trucks, fracturing his left hip.

Three employees were using a portable hydraulic press to remove a part from a machine during maintenance operations. The portable hydraulic press weighs 40 to 50 pounds and is about half the size of a coffee can. The portable press disengaged during operation and fell off the machine, striking and amputating the injured employee's left pinky finger.
An employee was cutting metal with a milling machine when the cutting blade lacerated his arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was throwing a piece of plate glass into a dumpster when the piece of glass broke and fell on his left arm, lacerating his bicep. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was on a 20-foot ladder when it moved. The employee dismounted the ladder and landed on both feet, injuring both heels. The employee was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was operating a large dial machine that presses valve seats into an aluminum head when the hydraulic ram did not properly feed a valve seat. He opened the door, activating the interlock, and went to the control panel to place the station in manual mode so he could jog the feeder arm and displace the valve seat to reload another seat. The down side of the selector switch was activated, pinching and amputating his fingertip between the small ram and the valve seat.
An employee was hanging glove bags on pipes when he fell 3 feet from a mobile scaffold and hit his head on the concrete floor.
An employee was cleaning up debris from chipping vertical columns when a 20-foot beam fell and hit the employee, breaking the right leg and ribs and injuring the stomach and back.

An employee was glazing windows while on a lift. A tree uprooted and a branch fell onto the lift's cage knocking the employee out of the lift. The employee suffered a fractured nose and vertebrae and required 14 stitches in an eye.

A temporary worker amputated four fingers while removing an energized fan situated on top of a dust receptacle bag that collected dust from an attached industrial shredder. The fan was not locked out at the time.

An employee was servicing a moulder and checking the alignment of the cutter when the machine activated cutting his right middle, ring and pinky fingers. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery on his hand.
An employee was bitten on the neck by a black widow spider while carry a tool on his shoulder.
An employee was testing a 10,000 lb. frac valve. The quarter-inch needle valve came off and pressurized water shot through his left thigh.
An employee was welding a stair pan. The employee used a crane to lift the stair pan up six inches. The block slipped and pinched the employee's left thumb resulting in amputation above the knuckle.
An employee was sitting on a bench outside the work office and was bitten by an insect. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 12, 2017, an employee was operating a crane when the steel product he was moving slipped out of the under hook device and pinched his fingers between the falling steel product and material that was stacked underneath it. The employee sustained amputations to the right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was resetting a cone/twist lock when a container was lowered onto his hand amputating multiple fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
While delivering mail, an employee fell and broke an arm.
An employee was working on a machine when the machine indexed and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee squeezed through an area between a table and wall, tripped on the table cloth, and fell on his right knee fracturing it.

An employee was operating a 2,500-ton vertical press while the machine was in idle mode. The employee was manually spinning the die manipulator when his right middle fingertip was caught and amputated in a pinch point while spinning the die manipulator.

An employee was driving a bulldozer. When it drove on an unlevel surface (about 2 feet difference), his foot slipped off the gas pedal and he fell out of the cab hitting his mouth and nose on the side mirror. The employee fell on the tracks of the bulldozer and it ran over his arm and leg resulting in a fractured femur.
An employee was delivering product and fell off a ramp. The employee suffered a mild concussion and facial fractures.
An employee was lowering a 130-pound fixture onto a platform cart using a motorized lift when his left thumb was caught between the fixture and the cart, amputating his thumb tip.

The employees were bringing the paper machine back online. The waste paper stock went into the overflow chest to be returned to pulp. An employee went out to observe the overflow from the chest in the street to make sure the sewer drain did not clog. As the employee was standing by the sewer drain, the condensate tank released to the same area. The condensate, mixed with the product from the overflow chest, caused the product level at the curb to rise over and into the employee's boots burning his feet, ankles, and lower legs.

An employee was performing a routine gap-check by operating a resistance welder by foot-pedal. The employee noticed an obstruction before initiating the weld process. While clearing the obstruction, the weld process was initiated and amputated the tip of her left thumb.
As an employee was exiting a service elevator the service elevator door moved downward and struck the employee on top of the head.
An employee was operating a stamping press and caught their fingers in a pinch point resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle fingertip and a fractured left thumb.
On September 12, 2017, an employee amputated his right ring fingertip while cutting square steel tubing on a band-saw.
An employee was cleaning a rack when a stack of A-frames fell on him pinning him to the floor and resulting in a broken humerus and a head laceration that required staples.
An employee was moving a piece of glass when the glass broke and cut his arm.

An employee was on an extension ladder to line up ceiling/floor boards above him. The ladder slipped out from under him and the employee fell to the floor resulting in hospitalization for fractured ankles.

An employee was manually lowering a piece of steel from the fifth floor to the first floor using ropes when he lost control of the rope. His left ring fingertip was then caught and amputated between the rope and the fifth floor guardrail.
An employee was lifting a 1" steel plate. The steel plate hit a lip and dropped, smashing the employee's left thumb between the top and bottom steel plates amputating the thumb tip.

An employee was baling scrap aluminum. The employee attempted to dislodge a piece of aluminum while the baler was operating. The employee's arm was caught in the door resulting in a laceration to the employee's bicep.
An employee was disconnecting a baggage cart from another baggage cart when the upper portion of the receiver hitch dropped and crushed the tip of their right index finger partially amputating it.

Two employees were repairing a press. During the process, the two employees were repositioning the core rod assembly onto a pallet near the back of the press. The core rod assembly was in a vertical position, with the core rod component sitting on a pallet. One employee was operating a forklift to reposition the core rod assembly. The forklift operator communicated to the other employee that he was going to lay the core rod assembly down. At that point, the other employee had his right hand holding the core rod stop mechanism to help guide it down. At approximately three quarters of the way down, the core rod assembly slipped off of the pallet causing the core rod stop mechanism to move up, pinching the other employee's right index and middle fingers between the core stop mechanism and the core rod assembly and amputating the fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee was pushing a lift through the field house when it hit a basketball hoop and tipped backwards. The lift fell and landed on the employee's leg breaking his right ankle.

An employee was loading insulation into a bag pusher machine and two fingers were caught in the point of operation. The tips of his right middle and ring fingers were medically amputated to the first knuckle.

Employees were unloading a barge into a charge truck on the scrap dock. The crane operator was stepping out of the cab to relay a message to a dockhand. When he returned to the cab of the crane his shirt caught on one of the joysticks and pulled the grapple toward the machine. The grapple struck the charge truck driver resulting in a head laceration and contusion resulting in hospitalization.

An employee had locked and tagged out an air handling unit to replace covers that were removed during a hurricane. He noticed that the belt was loose and attempted to tighten it. He then checked the tension of the belt and rotated the belt with his right hand. The momentum created when turning the motor pulled his fingertips into the pulley, lacerating and fracturing his right index, middle, and ring fingertips.

The injured employee was operating a telehandler that had a man basket with two employees in it. He was backing it up and struck a large object. He stopped suddenly and began to lower the man basket. The telehandler tipped over. The injured employee had multiple broken toes on his left foot that required hospitalization and surgery. The employees in the man basket suffered cuts and bruises.
An employee was walking from the elevator to her desk when she twisted her ankle and fell. She suffered a fractured ankle that required surgery.

The injured employee was on a stand-up forklift when another forklift was unable to stop and struck the employee's right foot resulting in a laceration. The injured employee was wearing steel toed boots at the time.
While moving an air conditioning unit, an employee's hand slipped and a metal edge of the air conditioning unit caught and amputated his fingertip.
An employee was walking down a ramp, slipped, and suffered a knee injury that required surgery.

An employee was climbing a permanent ladder inside a wind turbine. The employee was wearing a fall harness attached to a climb assist mechanism. The employee's foot became tangled and he slipped off the ladder falling 6 inches. The injured employee was hospitalized for a muscle strain.

A temporary employee was using a packing machine to wrap a part in plastic sheeting. The plastic sheeting balled up inside the machine. The employee attempted to dislodge the blockage and amputated his right middle fingertip.

On September 13, 2017, at approximately 2:30 p.m. an employee was spraying a form with oil. The employee slipped and fell about 8 feet and was caught under the arm by a form rack. The employee suffered a cut to the arm that severed a nerve.

An employee was operating a cutting machine used to cut plastic. The employee's hand was caught in the point of operation during a cut, resulting in the amputation of his right middle finger above the first knuckle.

An employee was at the top of a fixed ladder mounted on the interior of a 10-foot deep trench box. It was raining and the employee's feet and the ladder were wet. The employee slipped off the ladder and fell onto his back on the plywood flooring of the excavation, sustaining a back injury.
An employee was removing jammed film from a sleever machine. The machine started, which engaged the auto knives, and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
While an employee was walking up a metal loading dock ramp, their foot became caught on the steel diamond dock plate which caused them to fall and fracture their left femur.

While working to reposition felt, an employee slipped on the felt and fell from the roof of a 3-story building to the ground below and was hospitalized for an injured pelvis, broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was working on a car and trailer that had an air hose hooked onto it. A coworker was pulling out another vehicle when it hooked onto the air hose and began to pull the trailer. The employee had to then jump off the trailer, suffering a contusion to the top of the right leg.
An employee was delivering produce and was carrying a box inside the truck when he fell out of the truck, striking his head on the ground. He was hospitalized for head injuries.

An employee was standing on a frac unit situating a high pressure pipe. The employee stepped on a tow hook while climbing down and his foot slipped causing him to fall approximately 24 inches and strike his right side on a pipe.
An employee fell off a step ladder resulting in a fractured knee, leg, and elbow.

An employee was riding as a passenger in a utility vehicle. While turning on a gravel surface the vehicle rolled over. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to the right leg near the ankle.
While working from a bucket truck, an employee received an electrical shock from a downed power line.
An employee had been performing roofing operations and was hospitalized for heat stress on 9/13/2017.
An employee was laying down drill pipe when he felt body cramps and said he was going to pass out. The employee was hospitalized overnight for renal failure due to heat exposure.
An employee went to use a recently cleaned restroom and suffered a possible allergic reaction to the cleaning chemical.

An employee was working on toning out a 277-volt three-phase transfer switch. When he connected a tone generator to one of the lugs on the transfer switch, an arc flash occurred and the employee's right hand was burned.

An employee had his hand on a car door. When a co-worker released the emergency brake, the car moved backwards and the employee's finger was caught between the car door and the building resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.
While moving pallets off a platform an employee fell approximately 7 to 8 feet and was hospitalized for a head injury.

Employees were conducting repair operations and lifting an 850-pound 8" pipe with a winch and swiveling block and tackle while working at a height of 15 feet. The employees were trying to position the pipe as they were hoisting it into place when the swivel bound, causing the lifting cable bind and break. A secondary come-a-long and chain kept the pipe from falling, but the pipe swung into an employee, fracturing a vertebra in his neck, breaking his left arm in two places and fracturing his wrist.
While working on the packing line, an employee felt dizzy and fell to their knees. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration due to heat.
An employee was cutting wooden pallets when a metal splinter struck the employee in the left eye, causing injury.
While cutting cardboard on a sheer, an employee amputated a portion of his left index finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot and was struck by another car backing up.
While framing an apartment complex under construction, an employee fell approximately 22 feet to the ground and sustained a fractured skull, broken back, sprained arm and contusions.

On September 14, 2017, an employee was hospitalized after suffering a head injury while operating a glass cutting machine. The employee bent down to the floor and was struck on the head by the moving bridge of the machine. The employee also suffered a heart attack.
An employee reached into a machine in the packaging room and sustained a partial finger amputation.
An employee was lifting a tire to install it on a vehicle when he felt a pop in his abdomen. He was hospitalized with a hernia.
An employee was painting a steel beam that was on a saw horse when it fell on and broke his leg.

An employee was locating underground utilities. He opened a hand hole to inspect inside for damage and was exposed to 750k electrical current. The employee was shocked and received injuries to his chest and calves.
An employee was struck by a motor vehicle while standing on a sidewalk, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was working on a rolling conveyor that was set on top of two sawhorses. The conveyor shifted and fell off the sawhorses, landing on and fracturing the employee's right ankle.
On 09/14/2017, an employee experienced symptoms of dehydration and heat stress while assisting with power restoration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a tree with a chainsaw when the saw became stuck. As he attempted to free the chainsaw, it came loose and lacerated his left foot.

An employee was cleaning around a molder press and attempting to remove a part when the press amputated her left middle fingertip above the first knuckle. The machine was guarded and active at the time of the incident.
An employee working outside of a steam manhole fell 8 feet to the bottom of the manhole and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was delivering packages when he started sweating excessively and suffered heat-related body cramps. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was clearing a jam on a punch press when their hand became trapped between materials on the roller table resulting in fractured middle and ring fingers.

On September 14, 2017, an employee was loading a 70-pound box of meat onto a non-powered conveyor line when the employee's left pinky finger was smashed and fractured between the box and the conveyor, requiring surgical amputation.

Employees used a box to hold up a decorative wooden box surrounding a vertical truss. As the injured employee pulled the cable out from inside the truss, the box holding up the decorative box slipped, causing the decorative box to fall onto the victim's left hand. The employee suffered lacerations, a contusion and possible fracture to the left hand.
An employee was operating a triple pallet jack when he collided with a coworker operating a forklift at a warehouse intersection. He suffered leg injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the pharmacy and using a company-approved step stool. When she stepped up onto the step stool, she rolled and fractured her left ankle, requiring hospitalization.

On September 15, 2017, an employee was walking between a tube handling system and a drawing unit when a copper tube impaled the employee's left upper leg, requiring hospitalization. The area between the two machines was unguarded at the time.

An employee was cutting up a tree that had fallen across a power line. The power line was under the tree and was stretched taught. When the employee cut the final log, it broke suddenly and was flung into the air. The employee ran a few steps and the log hit him in the head and shoulder area. He suffered a fractured spine, crushed vertebrae, and facial lacerations.
An employee was applying chemical paint remover to a beam when the chemical got inside his sleeves and burned both arms. He was wearing PPE at the time.
An employee fell four feet from a ladder and fractured the left tibia and fibula.

An employee placed a generator on a tractor trailer flatbed. He raised the flatbed while his left hand was on the trailer's frame rail. His left thumb was then caught between the frame rail and the flatbed, amputating his thumb tip without bone loss.
An employee fell from a ladder while dismantling a greenhouse, suffering a head injury.
An employee was standing on top of a 12-inch-diameter pipe, attempting to hang a chainfall, when he lost his balance and fell backward onto a piece of horizontal pipe, puncturing a lung.

An employee was traveling on a lease road making a left hand turn when the tractor trailer shut off completely causing power steering to no longer function. The tractor trailer left the roadway and rolled over onto the passenger side of the vehicle. The employee was admitted to the hospital and underwent surgery on vertebrae in the top region of the neck.

An employee was ascending a crank-up scaffold system via an affixed access ladder when one of the employee's hands slipped from a rung. The employee then fell approximately 3 feet to the finished concrete surface below, twisting and breaking the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was placing scaffold planks from the third to the fourth scaffold level when the employee fell approximately 15 feet from the scaffold.
An employee was testing a trim blower with tissue paper when he lost his balance and fell. During the fall, his left-hand palm contacted the trim blower's slitter blade and was lacerated.
An employee's left hand was smashed between a push/pull and a rotor.
An employee fell to the ground while transferring his safety equipment from one purlin to the next, fracturing his ankle and leg.
An employee was unloading waste material from a portable holding bin when a steel container fell off a forklift and onto her leg, fracturing her femur.

An employee was climbing a residential structure to reach the top plate when he slipped and fell, landing on a brace and breaking his left foot above the ankle. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee fell from a large planter while clearing storm debris, hitting the floor and breaking six ribs.
An employee tripped while getting off a forklift and fell to the ground. He lost consciousness and sustained injuries to his face and shoulders.
An employee began to fall in a customer's attic and grabbed a metal strap holding duct work. The metal strap cut his hand, damaging tendons in his index and middle fingers.
An employee was using a vertical hammer to pile drive when a steel piece of the hammer came loose and struck his head, lacerating it. He was has hospitalized overnight.
An employee's hand slipped while operating a meat slicer resulting in amputation of the right thumb tip.
An employee was walking from house to house delivering mail. As she was walking back through a yard, she fell while walking down an incline, twisting and breaking her right ankle.
An employee was installing satellite TV service in a customer's home when the employee suffered chills and a high temperature, possibly due to heat-related illness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting the restroom when she slipped on deodorizer on the floor and hit her left knee, fracturing her kneecap.
An employee was cleaning a reactor when an explosion occurred. The employee was hospitalized with second and third degree burns to the neck, shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers.

On September 15, 2017, an employee climbed onto a trash compactor to clear a jam and fell approximately five feet to the concrete surface below the compactor. The employee lost consciousness, suffered a seizure, fractured ribs and a wrist, and lacerated the spleen.
An employee was putting a tire on a vehicle when the jack slipped and struck his left wrist, causing six fractures.

On 9/15/2017, at approximately 3:10 p.m., two employees were in an articulating boom lift raising up along the side of a grain bin when they contacted overhead powerlines, receiving electrical shocks.
An employee was coming down a ladder attached to the side of a machine when she missed the last step and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing her femur.
An employee was putting a screw into an electrical box when an arc flash/blast occurred. The employee suffered electrical burns.
On September 15, 2017, an employee and a coworker were changing an extruder blade. After changing the blade, they purged the machine, which released hot water/steam that burned the employee's arms.
An employee was chasing two shoplifters when he slipped and fell in the parking lot, breaking his hip.
While making a service call, an employee stepped into a hole in the ground and broke his leg.

On 9/15/2017 at 6:00 p.m., an employee was power washing to prepare the store for business the following day. While on a dry surface, he slipped and fell causing a tibia or fibula fracture and a dislocated ankle. He was hospitalized and surgery was performed.
An employee was working on a heat exchanger when the filter for the drain line overflowed with a water/oil mix and exploded on the employee. He sustained burns to his upper body and knee.

An employee was standing in the parking lot of the establishment and was struck by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a degloving injury to the left ankle, a fractured left tibia/fibula, a left ankle fracture, and a left foot fracture.
An employee was removing meat from a skinner machine when the blades lacerated his hand and fingers. His ring finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was standing on the sidelines during a football game and was hit by a player during a tackle. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture or torn ligament.

An employee was operating a stand-up reach-forklift when it went out of control. His left foot went outside the forklift and got caught between a stationary guardrail and the forklift, causing multiple fractured toes.
An employee was assisting with maintenance on a mini mill when he tripped/slipped on a mill sled track and fell to the ground, injuring his lower back. He was hospitalized.

An employee picked up a load of production water at a well site with his truck. As he was leaving the site, his truck's back tires left the roadway, causing the vehicle to roll over. He suffered four spinal fractures.
An employee was pushing a board through a jointer to flatten rough-sawn lumber when his right hand entered the cutting area, partially amputating his pinky finger.

An employee was at a construction site installing a steel beam hoisted into position with a forklift. The employee climbed a ladder to access the beam and fell approximately 15 feet sustaining a fractured right femur and a right ankle compound fracture.

An employee was driving a double pallet jack. The employee turned into an aisle and struck a parked cherry picker pinning both legs between the pallet jack and cherry picker resulting in a compound fracture of the left leg.
On September 15, 2017, an employee was loading a core into the pinch rollers on a C-line when the employee's right arm was pulled into the pinch rollers.
An employee was cleaning out a dough mixing machine. The machine started while the employee's hand was inside, and the auger amputated one of the employee's fingers.

An employee was on the back of a trailer that was in the dock doorway. As he was filling an air bag, a coworker driving a yard truck pulled the trailer away from the dock and the employee fell out of the trailer. He dislocated his right elbow.
An employee disconnected what he thought was a steam hose but was actually a molten asphalt hose. The molten asphalt splashed his chest and arms, causing second degree burns.
An employee was cleaning a mixer chute and amputated a finger when it contacted the mixer blade. The machine was unguarded and was not locked out at the time.
On September 15, 2017, an employee was pinned between a stand-up lift and a pallet lift, fracturing his left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping a truck driver unload a container when his foot was caught and severely lacerated by the truck frame.

An employee was standing on a ladder to remove an obstruction from a conveyor when the employee slipped and fell off the ladder, striking the conveyor before striking the ground. The employee suffered a broken rib, bruised eye, and finger injury.
An employee was painting the ceiling of an indoor gun range, stepped off the edge of the scaffold and fell 11 feet resulting in multiple fractures to the back, hip, legs, ankles and feet.
An employee was retrieving a file box from the top of a shelving unit when the employee fell backward down a set of mobile stairs, suffering L1 and L2 compression fractures.

On September 15, 2017, at approximately 7:00 a.m., an employee was operating a paint machine when the paint wand hose sprang a leak and began discharging paint at high pressure. He was attempting to grab the wand gun handle when his right index finger was struck by the high-pressure paint (2,000 PSI). His right index finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was sitting by the stairs and said he didn't feel well. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

While an employee was cleaning the seeder line by blowing the line with an air gun, the line was activated and the employee's hand was caught between the chain and sprocket of the running line. The employee's right pinky and middle fingertips were amputated. The guard was not in place at the time of the incident.

An employee was delivering mail to a residential home when a dog broke free from his chain, ran into the front yard of the residence and attacked the employee. The employee sustained a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a forklift to clean up trash/debris at the end of the day and the forklift rolled over. The employee remained inside the cab area, resulting in a shoulder injury.
An employee was loosening the bolts on the wedge sliders of a steel chase form when his right thumb was amputated.

An employee was repairing the handle of a pallet jack. The spring in the handle was broken and as the employee started to disassemble the handle, the handle fell and caught his fingers between the frame and handle, amputating two fingertips on the left hand.

An employee was cleaning an energized air compressor and sustained an avulsion injury to his right hand that required hospitalization and surgery to repair.  The belt and pulley guard was not in place at the time.

An employee was manually placing components to be heat welded to film when the employee noticed that the film was sticking to the front of the hole cutter. As the employee was attempting to remove the sticking film, the cutter activated and amputated the right middle fingertip.
An employee was removing a box from under a hydraulic lift. The lift dropped when the box was removed and crushed the employee's arm.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder and fell breaking an ankle.

An employee was operating an earth compactor to compact soil so cement could be poured for a new driveway. The employee drove up an incline and then turned the compactor so it was parallel to the hill. The compactor tipped over, causing injury to the employee's left hip and breaking his left foot.
While walking, an employee's cane got caught on the door and she fell forward resulting in a broken hip.

On September 16, 2017, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee and two vendor employees were repairing a tank dike liner with a heating iron. Flammable condensate leaked from the plumbing at a hammer union on ground level going to the condensate tank. The heat gun ignited the vapors resulting in third degree burns to the injured workers' hands and face. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was fixing the chain on a tape machine when their fingers were caught between the chain and sprocket. The employee received a laceration to the left hand and broken fingers.

On September 16, 2017, an employee was removing material from a die machine when his left hand was drawn into the rollers, crushing his left pinky, ring, and middle fingers and amputating his middle fingertip.

An employee was attempting to get a pulley going on a stacker/trimmer machine when the employee's glove was caught in the pulley. The pulley then smashed the employee's hand resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence and was attacked by a dog. The employee fell suffering a fractured back vertebra.
An employee was hand drying a vehicle using a towel when he experienced cramps in his left arm. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was bumped into by a customer and fell. She broke her left wrist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking on the receiving dock and tripped on a plastic strap falling onto his right side. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was stenciling pipe when he dropped the stencil. As he was picking up the stencil, he placed his left hand on the pipe rack and a pipe moved, catching his left ring finger between the pin stop and housing. The employee sustained a partial left ring finger amputation.
An employee was chopping celery with a knife and cut his left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was manually putting product into the emulsifying machine. The plastic scraper fell inside the unguarded point of operation and the employee tried to retrieve it. The auger located at the point of operation caused multiple injuries to the employee's right arm.
An employee's hand was crushed while removing stuck parts or scrap from a full revolution press.

On September 18, 2017, an employee was holding a bar that loosened tension on the spring of the garage door with his left hand. While he was loosening set screws with his right hand, something let loose and caused the bar to swing around and smash the left middle finger between the bar and the metal structure.
An employee was on a roof doing prep work for painting. The employee fell off the roof and sustained a broken arm.

An employee was replacing a tie bolt on a vehicle's leaf spring when the vehicle slipped off the portable hydraulic jack and landed on the employee's left hand. His left hand was crushed, and the bolt pierced his left pinky finger, which required surgical amputation.
While climbing an extension ladder with a box to put in storage, an employee lost balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a pelvis separation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hooking up a 70-foot rebar into the ground when a 25-foot piece of rebar fell and hit the back of his hard hat. This resulted in a fracture to his C1 and C2 vertebrae.

An employee was watching the operation of a shuttle machine when parts jammed and fell beside the machine's rail. He was attempting to remove the parts when the machine cycled. The clamp then caught and amputated the first digit of his right middle finger.

On 9/18/2017, an employee was installing a residential roof and tearing off layers of the roof's pitch. While throwing a bundle of shingles to the ground, the employee fell about 17 feet to the ground, injuring the wrist and lower back. Fall protection was not used at the time of the incident.

An employee was working on a palletizer, went to the back side of the machine, and was struck by/caught between the machine's ram and frame. The employee suffered broken ribs and other injuries. The machine's guard had been bypassed at the time of the incident.

The lima bean combine harvester was having infeed problems. An employee climbed up on the machine head to observe the problem. The harvester operator was unaware the employee was there and raised the machine head. The employee was struck/pinched by the machine head fracturing three ribs.
An employee was unloading crates from a container when one of the crates fell on top of the employee, fracturing the right arm/shoulder.
An employee was attempting to cross a planer line when a barricade was lifted and a piece of wood struck him, fracturing his pelvis and rib. The planer was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee bumped into another employee and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured hip.

An employee and driver were unloading a frac tank from a winch truck. While trying to unhook the winch cable from the tank, the driver tightened the winch cable instead of loosening it, pinching the employee's finger between the cable and rear roller. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee operating an expanded metal manufacturing machine had his arm caught and fractured in the machine while trying to align it. The machine was guarded at the time.

On 09/18/2017, at approximately 6:45 a.m., an employee was loading a dumpster onto the truck to be dumped in the back. The dumpster was stuck in a pothole. The winch pulled the dumpster until it released from the pothole and the employee's finger was caught between the truck and the dumpster, amputating the left ring fingertip.
An employee was descending from a power pole when he fell, injuring his back and breaking his right foot. His safety belts were removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was reaching down to pick up a flashlight that he dropped when a rattlesnake bit his finger.

An employee used a push-stick in his right hand to push a piece of soft wood through a wood jointer to remove a 1/8 inch of wood from the board. He was using his left hand to guide the board through the jointer when his left-hand fingers came in contact with the jointer blade.
