The jointer blade completely amputated four fingers and partially amputated another finger. The jointer was guarded at the time.
An employee was in a basement looking for product when he bumped his head on a water pipe. He lost consciousness and suffered a concussion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading trash into a refuse truck when his pinky finger was amputated by the packer blade as it cycled.
An employee was performing utility line tree trimming and fell out of a tree approximately 30 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a cracked pelvis, broken rib, and a punctured lung.

An employee was in the basket of an aerial lift painting the exterior fascia in the front of a building. The lift moved and the employee contacted a 13.2 kV power line. The employee was shocked and received burns to the hands and head.
An employee was using a press to seal a plastic bag around a pillow when the press' heat sealer compression bar amputated the employee's left first fingertip.
An employee fell from a forklift while exiting it and suffered a back fracture.
An employee was working from a ladder when he fell 15 feet, breaking his wrist and cutting his leg.

An employee was using a forklift to move a bale, weighing approximately 1000 lbs., to a c-can for storage. When the employee unsecured the bale from the forklift, the bale fell off the forklift and onto the employee, fracturing his ankles.

An employee was backing a trailer into a building dock when the right trailer door came unlatched and hit the building. The employee pulled forward and walked to the back of the trailer to re-secure door. The door then broke from the hinges and started to fall toward the employee. As he tried to move out of the way, he tripped and fell, landing on a chock block, fracturing three to four ribs and suffering a collapsed left lung.
While moving furniture and equipment, an employee backed through a doorway and backed into a piece of exercise equipment. The employee fell on her left arm resulting in a forearm fracture.

An employee was working to cut sewer pipe to a specified size. The employee had cut one side of the pipe with a powered concrete saw and was turning the pipe to cut the opposite side. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's chest.

On September 18, 2017, at approximately 11:55 p.m., employees were re-installing furnace ducts after replacing the duct rollers. The injured employee was working from an unguarded service platform located about 6 to 7 feet above the adjacent floor level when he fell and struck his lower back against a guardrail that was temporarily placed below the service platform. He fractured his vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was running wires via an electrical panel to provide temporary lights when a ground wire touched the panel's line terminal and created a spark. The spark burned the employee's right elbow and left cheek.
An employee was working on a concrete jail cell when a steel wedge came loose and struck his right thumb, amputating it to the first knuckle.

An employee was standing on a ladder while removing shelves stored on top of a pallet racking system. The employee had placed a foot on a box for balance when the box collapsed. The employee then fell 12 feet, requiring hospitalization for fractured ribs and vertebrae.

An employee had activated a vertical turret lathe when the table began rotating and the horizontal cutting tool moved toward an unsecured pipe fitting. When the cutting tool contacted the unsecured fitting, it caused the fitting to jump off the table and strike the employee's right hand, fracturing and lacerating the right thumb. Part of the employee's thumb had to be medically amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while attempting to block a client from an off-limits item. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was on an extension ladder mounting a dish at a residence when wasps stung him several times and he fell off the ladder. He suffered a pinched nerve and numbness in his upper arms/neck, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to adjust a pot on a blow mold machine when the employee's right hand slipped and was caught in the mold. As the employee pulled the hand out, the mold amputated the pinky fingertip.
An employee was supervising a repair job on a stacker crane when a metal panel fell off of a structural member of the crane and struck him, causing a compound fracture to his right leg.

Two employees were in a scissor lift approximately 17 to 18 feet high to hang duct work. They had finished hanging a piece when the scissor lift activated, began moving quickly in circles, and overturned. One of the employees was hospitalized with vertebrae, wrist, and ankle fractures. Both employees were tied off in the scissor lift at the time of the incident.
An employee was installing a tire on a trailer when the tire exploded, dislocating the employee's right hand and lacerating the right knee.

An employee was getting pipe and weld data off a pipe that was being cut after hydrotesting when the pipe fell on the employee's legs, breaking two bones above the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was drinking water by a water fountain when she slipped, lost her balance, and fell to the floor, fracturing her leg.

An employee was operating a pallet jack to select dry product in an aisle around 5:30 p.m. along with several other pallet jack operators. He was walking between his pallet jack and a coworker's parked pallet jack when his pallet jack rolled forward and caught his right leg between the two pieces of equipment, fracturing his lower leg/ankle.

An employee backed a van into a cargo house. He exited the van, which was still running, and it began to roll toward him. To avoid the van, he ducked under a metal shelving unit. He struck his face and head on the shelving, breaking his nose and lacerating his head and ear. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee amputated a finger.
An employee was unpacking a pane of heavy glass when it fell on and broke his right leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was sorting mail when she tripped on a plastic band and fell to the concrete floor, injuring her hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a powered pipe threading machine when it amputated the employee's right middle finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was checking the end of the milk line filter, slipped and fell resulting in a head injury.
An employee was carrying a jug of concentrated chemicals that contained acid when the fluid ran under his glove, burning his hand and requiring hospitalization.

On September 19, 2017, an employee fell about 10 feet from an extension ladder to the concrete floor while working on a beam pocket. The employee was hospitalized with paralysis of both legs and the right arm.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet from an unprotected edge while installing rebar for a barrier wall, fracturing the sternum, wrist, rib, and vertebrae.
An employee was removing Styrofoam from a concrete slab that was being lowered when the employee's left hand was crushed between the concrete slab and a steel slab.

An employee was loading packages into a truck. As he picked up a box to put on a shelf, pet odor removal powder poured out of a hole in the box and contacted his body. He had an allergic reaction, suffering hives and respiratory distress. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was working near a cuber machine when it actuated and came down on him, injuring his abdomen. The cuber was guarded with a safety fence at the time.

An employee was on the third step of a 12-foot A-frame ladder disconnecting power to pantry coolers when a bolt from one of the side hinges came out, causing the ladder to collapse. The employee fell to the floor, fracturing the left wrist.

An employee was moving a cow from one pen to another. He was standing outside the pen fence when the cow charged the fence and smashed it hard enough to loosen a 2" pipe. The pipe hit the employee with enough force to break his eighth rib and lacerate his liver.

A employee was replacing a failed expansion valve on a refrigerated display case. He was soldering a copper pipe when a small amount of refrigerant in the pipe expanded when heated and flashed. He started coughing and had a runny nose, requiring hospitalization for respiratory irritation.

On September 19, 2017, an employee was using an unguarded table saw to cut a board when the blade hit a knot in the board. The employee's left thumb and pointer finger were pulled into the blade resulting in a severe laceration requiring surgery.
An employee turned a corner while operating a riding pallet jack and fell off of the machine to the concrete floor, suffering a possible ankle fracture.
An employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was inspecting and repairing a roof that had hurricane damage when he fell from the roof and struck a tree trunk, suffering a compression fracture to the L2 vertebra, a spiral fracture to the right tibia, and ankle injuries.

An employee was carrying egg cartons to stack on pallets when he tripped over a pallet on the floor, landing on his right side. He dislocated his right hip and fractured his femur, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle down a dirt road and turning left into a driveway parking lot when he lost control of the vehicle, fish-tailed, and flipped. He suffered a compound fracture to his leg.
An employee's ankle was run over by a truck.
An employee was setting drill pipe slips when his right foot slipped and was caught in the drill pipe slips, crushing the end of his foot. He was hospitalized overnight and had surgery.

An employee was operating a rubber calendar mill when his left hand contacted a moving fabric sheet and was then pulled under a roller. His left arm broke in two places as he was removing it from the equipment.

An employee was checking the level of grain in his truck trailer. He had climbed down the trailer ladder and was on the platform between the truck and trailer when he slipped and fell about 3 feet forward onto his head, lacerating his head and breaking his collarbone.

An employee was operating a yard tractor when he turned sharply and made abrupt contact with some bundles of pipe. The yard tractor was picked up by the momentum and then slammed down, shaking the employee in the process. He suffered head lacerations and a broken vertebra, requiring hospitalization. PPE was worn at the time.
An employee suffered a hernia while climbing a scaffold and was hospitalized.
An employee was making a deposit at the bank when he fell near a curb that had an incline, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.

Employees were running packers and had just finished a job. The injured employee was kneeling down on the left knee on the under floor (floor that was six feet off the ground) when a sudden burst of pressure and flow back struck the injured employee's right side dislocating an elbow, breaking the ulna and causing various abrasions and bruises.
An employee slipped and fell off a crane while climbing into the cab, fracturing his left arm and elbow.
An employee was on a scaffold when he became dizzy. As he was descending the ladder, he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his left femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee passed out due to heat stress while hand planting sugar cane plants at a farm.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of cardboard that had slipped over the packer blade of a waste collection truck hopper when the packer blade began to crush and lacerate his right hand, fracturing his right wrist. The truck hopper was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was trying to clear a plastic bottle jam in a running trimming machine when the trimmer amputated the employee's right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was drilling a concrete anchor with a hammer drill when he pulled on a loose duct hanger, which then cut his arm.
An employee fell from the second step of a stair set he was assembling, sustaining two broken ankles and a broken tibia.
While working in an aerial bucket truck to reinstall a primary conductor on a utility pole, an employee came into contact with the powerline and received electrical burns to the torso.
An employee was helping a coworker make adjustments to an electric drive motor belt on an asphalt house bag machine when the belt amputated his fifth finger.
On 9/20/2017, an employee was acting as a spotter for an aerial lift when the lift ran over the employee's left foot, fracturing three toes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adding ruthenium to a reactor when a chemical reaction occurred and released vapors. The employee suffered chemical inhalation burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a deli meat slicer when the guard came loose and hit her head.

An employee was maneuvering a manlift over a speed bump at a crawl when the manlift accelerated and lunged forward as the front wheels went over the speed bump. The employee was lifted into the air and straight back down onto his feet in the basket. He then dropped down into a seated position. This jarring action broke his lower right leg.

An employee was pulling the hook out from the front winch on an all terrain vehicle when a coworker activated the winch switch. The winch cable was then pulled into the winch and amputated the employee's right middle finger.
An employee started feeling ill while mounting and dismounting tires and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized with severe dehydration from the heat.

The injured employee and two co-workers were approached to assist a truck driver lift a small scissor lift back onto its wheels after it tipped over. While lifting the scissor lift, the injured employee's left index and middle fingers were caught in a pinch point when the machine was set upright resulting in amputation of the left index finger and a severe laceration to the middle finger.

An employee was attempting to remove residue from a machine's chain when the employee's right index finger was caught and lacerated in a pinch point between the chain and sprocket. The machine was running at the time.
An employee had been performing post-hurricane cleanup and demolition at an apartment complex for 10 hours when he lost consciousness due to the heat. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was working on a sheet metal machine when the sheet metal slipped. The machine then came down on his left index finger, partially amputating it.

An employee was attempting to unlock a cargo container twist lock as the container was being lowered onto a trailer. The right middle and index fingers were caught between the cargo container and the trailer resulting in amputation.
A temporary employee was working on a new construction job site conducting plumbing related activities and suffered dehydration and heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to manually unlatch a beam on a trailer to unload it when he fell and landed on the ground, fracturing his L3 vertebra.

A landscape cutting crew had just stopped in an area and were beginning to set up equipment when a car struck the back of their wood chipper and spun around, striking the employee. The employee suffered head and neck injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was at his work station trying to move the base to straighten out a machine using a hammer. He missed the station and hit his left middle finger with the hammer, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was waiting in the hammer mill to prepare a grate bar for rigging and removal when the grate bar suddenly shifted and fell on him, crushing his pelvis and right upper leg. He was hospitalized.

On September 20, 2017, at approximately 9:00 p.m., an employee was applying anti-caking material to an in-feed incline belt (inside a shredder feed on a conveyor belt) when the employee's left ring finger was caught between the metal idler pulley and the conveyor, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was performing pipeline tie-in activities when a natural gas product ignited, causing a flash fire that caused second degree burns to the employee.

An employee was using a forklift to bag ground-up dirt that is used for drilling operations. As he was removing a hook from a metal rack, the forklift moved forward and the mast struck his right middle finger, smashing it and amputating the fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, fracturing an arm.

An employee was ascending a pole to make electrical repairs after a hurricane when his climbing gaff (the nail of the climbing hooks that go into the pole) struck a metal washer in the wooden pole, causing him to hit his jaw on the wooden pole. The back of his neck was then punctured by a wooden splinter on the pole. He hung about 25 feet in the air with his fall arrest system. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a machine for corrugated boxes when his right thumb came in contact with a conveyor belt, fracturing and lacerating it. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee fell from the top of a catwalk to the ground while going to clean a tanker truck, suffering severe body injuries. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was witnessing a vehicle test when a lithium-ion battery caught on fire. The employee inhaled smoke from the fire and chemical fumes from the halon extinguisher used to put out the fire.

An employee was working on an encapsulation machine when a part closed on his finger. When he tried to remove his finger, skin and tissue were removed, requiring overnight hospitalization and surgery.
On September 20, 2017, an employee was moving a two-step ladder when it folded unexpectedly, catching and amputating one of the employee's fingers in a pinch point.

An employee was adjusting an energy-isolated industrial fan belt and pulley. The employee was manually rotating the motor and assembly when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the belt and pulley, lacerating and fracturing it.

An employee was attempting to clear dust from around a rotary valve when his right index finger entered the valve and was amputated above the first knuckle. The rotary valve plug was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was checking the alignment inside a mechanical power press' pilot hole when the material moved and amputated his middle fingertip.
An employee was loading water heaters and fell from a freight cart resulting in a head injury.
An employee was working on a scaffold when it tipped over. He hit the ground and broke his leg.

An employee was working on the backside of a breakdown mill, waiting for rubber to process through the mill so that it could be cut and sent back into the mill, when his right hand was caught between two rollers, amputating two fingers.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet onto a concrete slab while laying decking on joists because of windy conditions. He suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was blowing down a chemical tank. As he was unhooking the connection line from the blower machine, he fell approximately 10 feet to the cement ground and may have hit the metal tank on the way down. He suffered impact injuries to the head and face and was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell on and fractured her right knee in the hallway while running after a fleeing student.

An employee was exiting the bucket of a bucket truck when he fell approximately 6 feet, striking an adjacent pickup truck and cinder block. He suffered a laceration to the left side of his head and broken ribs on his left side.
An employee fell off a ladder while descending from a telephone pole, fracturing both ankles.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, breaking a rib and puncturing his lung.

An employee was operating an electro-pneumatic, air-powered, mold-controlled system. As the mold was coming out of the machine (the mold is heated up to 200 degrees), it became lodged between the doors. When the employee attempted to dislodge the mold, the doors slammed shut on his left hand, lacerating his hand and causing first degree burns on his left wrist and forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee began to feel ill, suffering leg and arm cramps, fatigue, and lightheadedness. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was drilling a hole into a fixture with a lathe on 9/21/2017. The employee leaned into the machine to line up the drill bit and the employee's shirt was caught in the worm-screw resulting in a left arm fracture and a stroke. The worm-screw was not guarded at the time.
An employee slipped on elevated steel beams and fell 11 feet to the floor, suffering a broken left foot, sprained left knee, broken tibia, and torn meniscus in the right knee.
An employee was attempting to disconnect a pressurized air hose when blasting grit struck the employee's left eye and face. PPE was not worn at the time.

An employee was cutting off different metal parts on a pipe using an 18-inch shear when the employee's left pinky finger became caught between the two blades, amputating it just below the first knuckle.
An employee was using a table saw when the blade lacerated his right finger.

An employee was driving a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) into a pump meat cooler to retrieve a vat of product. As he maneuvered into position, the vehicle slipped on the wet floor and the employee was pulled out of the PIV. He was pinned between the PIV and a vat of product, suffering rib, vertebrae, and pelvic fractures.
An employee was working inside the front cab of an airport fuselage when he tripped and fell on the aircraft's metal frame, injuring his back, neck, and head.

An employee was rigging a steel casing for relocation when the casing slipped, causing the employee to lose balance. The casing hit the ground/wall, and the employee's right hand was caught between the casing and a solid object, amputating the middle and index fingers.

An employee climbed into the shred trailer of a truck to clean out the shred portion when his arm was caught in the truck's conveyor belt, fracturing his arm and causing skin and tissue damage. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when she stumbled and fell on a scale, breaking her left ankle and requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was operating a lift with a man basket to install a drainage pipe underneath a bridge when the lift started to slide down a slope. The employee was then ejected from the man basket and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, suffering abdominal and facial injuries.
An employee was removing brick debris from a conveyor line when his left pinky fingertip was caught and amputated between brick stacks.

An employee was driving an aerial lift over a road and curb when the lift hit a bump or the curb. The employee then bounced out of the basket and was hanging by a harness and lanyard. The employee suffered left arm or wrist injuries, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was removing debris when one of his fingers was caught and amputated between two tables.

A crew was attempting to hang a metal horse head on a pumpjack while the injured employee was sitting on a 12-inch beam (12 feet off ground). As the crew was lowering the head, it fell out of its saddle and smashed the employee's left arm, which became very swollen and possibly fractured.

On September 21, 2017, an employee was sorting material on an unloading table when the employee's arm was caught between the loading arm and the table itself. The employee suffered contusions and was hospitalized.
An employee was mowing a field when the mower blade lacerated the employee's foot and lower leg.

The injured employee was drying off excess sanitation water from the bottom of the nest plates on a filling machine. Her hand was next to the mechanism that lifts the cups out of the nest plates, referred to as the "lift pad." The lift pad pushed her right ring finger up into the hole as the nest plate was rotating smashing her finger and resulting in amputation of the fingertip and nail.

On 9/21/2017, an employee was standing on a truck's catwalk hooking up a truck to a trailer when he lost his balance and fell about 3 feet to the asphalt ground. He suffered a cracked rib and collapsed right lung, requiring hospitalization.
Two employees were using a ladder near a powerline to assess the condition of a roof when they received an electric shock, suffering burns on their feet and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee fell through a roof deck to the concrete floor below, fracturing his legs and tailbone requiring hospitalization.
An employee was providing resident care at a group home when she got close to an open bottle of foaming disinfectant and suffered an asthma attack. She was hospitalized.
An employee was on a service call working on a lift gate when his pry bar slipped and crushed his right middle finger.
An employee was standing near concrete-crushing equipment when the ground gave way. The employee fell 10 feet and suffered a broken back.

An employee was moving a horizontal idler roller into a skid pan when a colleague tried to assist him. One end of the idler then came down and smashed the employee's middle finger underneath his glove. He suffered a laceration and broken bone, requiring hospitalization. Later, his fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was washing out a cement mixer when he slipped on a slick area and fell, fracturing his right tibia.

An employee was opening a pipe cap on a pneumatic trailer to unload plastic pellets when the pipe cap and plastic pellets released under pressure and struck him. He suffered contusions and lacerations to the chest, arms, and legs.
An employee was pulling string on the side of a new road to be paved when a reversing tractor hit the employee. The employee suffered a head fracture.
An employee was working near an unguarded chain drive when he slipped and fell. His left hand was caught by the machine, partially amputating his left index finger.
An employee was filling a tire with air when the tire exploded, breaking a bone in his left hand and lacerating his left knee. He was hospitalized. No tire cage was used at the time of the incident.

An employee was testing wire connections on a transformer when an electrical backflow occurred, shocking the employee. He suffered electrical burns to his hand and side. The shock also caused him to fall and fracture his shoulder and T9 vertebra.

An employee was attaching a shackle and sling to a tank when a crane operator began to take up slack in the sling. The employee's right index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the shackle and sling.
An employee was traveling to another floor when she slipped and fell onto a pallet, injuring her left arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to place a core plug onto a core of newly slit paper when the plug fell onto a running conveyor belt. As he attempted to retrieve the plug, the belt caught his finger and drew it into a pinch point, amputating his left middle fingertip to the first major knuckle.
An employee was bitten by a dog while delivering mail, suffering bites and lacerations to the head, face, arm, ears, and shoulders. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling protectors off of a casing when a forklift operator dropped pipes on a pipe rack. One pipe rolled over and smashed the employee's finger.
An employee was shot in the intestines by a temporary employee in the locker room.
An employee was attempting to get water from a pallet when the pallet rolled forward on gravity-fed rollers and pinned the employee's foot, breaking the ankle and a toe.
An employee's left index finger was caught and amputated in a conveyor's unguarded chain drive.

An employee was standing on top of a concrete wall to receive a hoisted steel member when he lost his balance and fell 14 to 15 feet to the soil below. He suffered multiple contusions to the body with minor facial lacerations.
An employee was grading rework parts and placing the parts on the conveyor of a drum and thigh cutter machine when his right hand contacted the machine's energized blades, amputating it at the wrist.

An employee was in a boat, inspecting a pipeline, when the boat hit something in the water and ejected the employee from the seat. The employee hit the boat floor and suffered a forehead laceration and fractured left wrist.
An employee was attempting to unplug an air compressor from a wall when the electrical socket was pulled out of the wall. As he attempted to remove the plug, he received an electrical shock.
An employee fell 15 feet to the ground while dusting exposed beams, suffering a separated shoulder and lung aspiration. He was wearing a body harness but was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee fell off a bucket truck while going up the truck steps to get into the aerial bucket lift.
An employee was operating a horizontal band saw when the blade amputated his middle and index fingers.
An employee was lowering a lift gate to retrieve empty milk crates when the gate's hydraulic line broke and the lift gate came down on her lower left leg, lacerating it. She was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw to cut insulation board when the insulation board kicked back and punctured his abdomen.

An employee was delivering rebar to a construction site. He tilted the truck bed to unload the rebar but it was stuck in place. He was attempting to loosen it with his foot when the rebar caught his pant leg and sent him to the ground, breaking his right ankle.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift and going into a freezer. As he made a left turn, his left hand was caught between the forklift frame and the freezer compartment, severely cutting his left arm.
An employee was standing at the end of a jumbo press, which had a flat roller holding 200-pound boxes. The roller with the boxes ran over and crushed the employee's left foot.

An employee was operating a reach truck when he hit a pallet of empty kegs. He attempted to catch a falling keg with his left hand, but the keg crushed and broke three of his fingers, requiring surgery.
An employee and several coworkers were changing out a utility pole when the pole snapped. The pole and energized electrical lines fell and struck the employee, causing an electrical shock and burns.
An employee was operating a winder machine when his left hand was caught by the roller. He suffered wrist and forearm fractures.
An employee contacted live electrical wiring during pole lighting repair work, suffering electrical burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was manually moving a scissor lift when it rolled over his ankle, breaking two ankle bones. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was working on the hydraulic line of a loader when the loader's bucket fell on the employee's foot, amputating some toes.
An employee was trimming wooden dowels at a trump saw when the saw guard struck the employee's right index and middle fingers. Part of the right middle finger had to be surgically amputated.

The employee added a liquid drain cleaner to the casing check valve to remove scale build up. The employee opened the system and hit the hammer union between two ball valves to relieve pressure that caused residual chemical in the line to splash back onto the employee's face and body. The employee suffered chemical burns to the face and body.

An employee was holding a fixed centralizer while casing tongs were being used to join together casing when the centralizer slipped from his hand. As he attempted to grab it, his fingertip was caught and amputated in the casing tongs.
An employee was fixing a spacer on a stack of 2 x 10's when a few of the 2 x 10's fell on his left leg, breaking his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee received second degree burns from steam from the coker drum while performing housekeeping duties.
An employee was removing an exit sign, received a shock and fell from the ladder. The employee was hospitalized for a left arm injury and a cardiac injury.
An employee was unplugging a chipper when the employee's right hand made contact with the chipper knives, amputating the distal tip of the small finger.

A temporary employee was removing folds from the plastic sheet/film product web that was running through the greenhouse rewind machine. The employee's right foot slipped and was caught in an ingoing nip point between rotating rollers. The employee sustained compound fractures to his lower leg, ankle and foot. The rollers were unguarded at the time.
An employee suffered from heat stress while working on a scaffold and stripping insulation, requiring hospitalization.

On 9/29/2017, an employee was attempting to install a pipe onto a wellhead when the pipe fell. As he attempted to shield himself from the falling pipe, his left little finger was caught between the falling pipe and the wellhead, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was bringing a suspended scaffold down to the ground when the attachment broke. The employee fell to the remaining platform and fractured his heel.

On 9/29/2017, an employee was spraying insulation to the interior walls of an attic. The employee was standing on a 2 x 6 plank, which had been set on the guardrails of a floor opening, when the plank cracked and the employee fell approximately 14 feet to the lower level. The employee sustained a head contusion and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was climbing down a gantry crane and knocked out the gantry pin pinching his finger resulting in amputation of the right index and middle fingers.
An employees thumb tip was crushed and amputated in a machine.

On September 29, 2017, at 4:30 PM, an employee was kneeling and setting up a hydraulic compacting press with his left hand on the control panel. As he moved to the standing position, his left hand flipped the core rod switch into the down mode. The core rods then moved down and partially amputated his right little finger.
On September 29, 2017, an employee was exiting a scale house when he tripped and fell down the stairs, breaking his ribs and puncturing his lungs. He was hospitalized.

An employee's work truck was disabled on the side of the road. He set two jacks under the bumper and crawled under the truck to place a jack under the axle. While he was under the truck, one of the jacks slipped, causing the truck to fall on him. He suffered 16 broken ribs, a broken sternum, and a broken left scapula.
An employee was making a bed when she tripped on the sheets and fell to the floor, injuring her right shoulder and back.

An employee was performing regular maintenance on a die machine when hot melted plastic fell from the machine and landed on his face. He suffered second and third degree burns on his face and was hospitalized.
An employee was using an oxygen/acetylene torch in a small walk-in cooler when the employee developed breathing problems and lung aspiration from the fumes or smoke. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was monitoring a tag line while a blade of a wind turbine was being hoisted in the air. The tag line came undone and struck the employee in the chest sending the employee 15 feet in the air. The employee suffered two skull fractures, two broken arms, a neck fracture, and a broken rib.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when the saw blade partially amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee received an amputation.
An employee was installing hurricane shutters when a metal reel fell and struck the employee's right hand, crushing the index finger. The finger was surgically amputated.

An employee drove a four-wheeler vehicle to an anhydrous plant to close a leaking valve. When he arrived at the site, he was overcome by the chemical smell and left the area. While he was driving away, the four-wheeler crashed. He broke his collarbone and wrist and suffered facial injuries, requiring overnight hospitalization.

The injured employee and another employee were working from ladders to stock groceries when the employee slipped and grabbed the injured employee's ladder, causing her to fall to the ground. She suffered back pain.

Employees were operating a bond tool. The employees were setting up counter weights to the 53K spar. Upon lowering the counter weight nest, the weight dropped from position and the employees were unable to set the counter weight into proper position. An employee had a hand on the counter weight nest and was pinched between the actuator and block resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was inspecting product inventory and contacted a rotary valve resulting in amputation of the right index, middle and ring fingertips.
An employee had unlocked a bi-fold door and opened it when the locking mechanism hit him in the head/face and he fell to the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell and broke his left wrist. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was driving a truck on the gravel road near the water treatment pond. The employee lost control of the truck and it rolled over. The employee sustained a head injury.

After shutting down and cleaning an extrusion chrome roll, an employee restarted the extrusion line. The extrusion sheets were fully threaded and winding when the employee's right hand contacted the sheet pull roller, amputating the first digit of his right thumb.

An employee was scraping wallpaper off the wall in an apartment while standing on a kitchen countertop. As he was descending from the countertop onto a step ladder, he lost his balance and fell about 3 feet to the floor, breaking his right hip, spraining his right wrist, and straining his right shoulder. He was hospitalized.
On September 30, 2017, at approximately 1:30 p.m., an employee was cleaning vines from a conveyor when the employee's right arm was caught in the conveyor, breaking the arm and hand.
An employee was lifting an H bar when his hand slipped and landed on the dock. The H bar then came down on his right hand and amputated his middle finger.
An employee was delivering a parcel at a rural residence when a dog bit the employee's left hand and shoulder, causing lacerations that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was hand drying cars after they came out of a car wash. The employee was walking backward close to the vehicle before it left the conveyor when his foot was caught between the moving conveyor chain and the side rail. His Achilles tendon tore and later became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, fracturing her right knee. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee fell from the back of a rental truck while sweeping it out. He sustained a brain hemorrhage and was hospitalized.

An employee was changing the die on a four-post press that was being supported by a block when his elbow knocked out the block. The top of the die dropped and crushed his left thumb, resulting in a partial thumb amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a leaky blaster. He slipped on the oil and fell into the machine catching his right hand in the unguarded chain and sprocket resulting in a broken index and pinky finger and lacerations on the ring finger. The blaster was not locked out at the time.

While walking around a corner, an employee tripped and fell over loose shelving leaning against a gondola, striking a wooden display barrel and then the floor. The employee suffered a hip fracture and torn rotator cuff, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was climbing onto a scaffold when he tripped on bricks laying on the scaffolding platform and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground below, fracturing multiple right-side ribs and contusing his thorax. He was hospitalized.
An employee was torch cutting a tank when residual fumes ignited burning the employee's abdomen.

An employee was walking away from a patient's bed when the employee's foot was caught in the bed's control module cord. The employee tripped and tried to brace the fall with their hands, breaking both wrists.
An employee was demonstrating how to install a blue tarp safely when he slipped on the tarp and fell, tearing ligaments in his neck. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood form with a circular saw when the saw kicked back and amputated the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee was pulling linen from a client bed when she tore a ligament in her right hand.
An employee went to clean a de-panner chain with a rag when the chain caught the rag. His right middle finger was then pulled into the chain, amputating a finger.
An employee was working in an elevated bucket stringing electric wire when the wire came out of the stringer/keeper and fell on the employee's right forearm, breaking it.
An employee was using a water hose to clean the inside of a walk-in freezer. The water turned to ice and the employee slipped on it, suffering a broken hip.
An employee inadvertently struck a wall-mounted fire extinguisher, which then dislodged from the wall and struck the employee's left hand, fracturing the pinky finger and requiring surgery.
An employee was injured when a fight broke out at work.
An employee was escorting an unruly fan when the fan punched him, causing him to fall to the floor. He fractured his hip and bruised and lacerated his face, jaw, and chest.

An employee was moving a rack full of meat from a rail onto the main rail. When the rack was passing through the switch, the switch got out of alignment and the rack fell to the floor. The main rack support hit the floor and bounced back crushing the employee's right foot.
An employee was exiting a vehicle when the vehicle rolled back on the employee resulting in fractured ribs, punctured lungs and a fractured cheek bone.

An employee was dumping garbage out of a tipster (a plastic garbage can on wheels) that had a crack. As the employee was putting the tipster back down, the employee's right index fingertip was caught and amputated in the crack.

An employee was manually rotating an extruder machine's flywheel to align the hole with a pin. The flywheel rolled, and the employee's right middle finger was caught between the extruder's belt and pulley, amputating it just behind the nail.

An employee was operating a leather sewing machine when a cardboard guard dropped off the machine. As he reached to the floor to pick it up, his left pinky fingertip was caught and amputated in the drive belt where the cardboard guard had been.

An employee was coming out of a bus and saw something laying on the ground. He was stepping to the side to miss the object when he fell and twisted his ankle, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a pallet jack with a battery extractor attachment to change out forklift batteries. The employee stepped off the back and was pinned between the pallet jack and a railing, fracturing both legs.
An employee suffered a left index fingertip amputation while operating a punch press.

An employee was working at a winder, cutting a roll of plastic film, when the shaft moved and caught his right arm, pulling it into the roll and dislocating it. He also suffered torn tendons and ligaments in his right arm.

An employee was using a manipulator/hoist to lift a mower deck off an assembly table when the mower blade became caught on an attachment on the table. The table then lifted with the blade as the deck was rising. The employee went to push the table back down and release it from the blade. At the same time, the controls were activated to lower the manipulator/hoist. The employee's left thumb was then pinched between the table and the manipulator/hoist, amputating the distal portion of the thumb just below the nail.
An employee fell off an order picker while retrieving product from a shelf and suffered broken ribs and a concussion. The lanyard was not attached to the body belt at the time.

An employee took a vacuum of powder to the burn pit where another employee had been burning scrap wood, old pallets and boxes. The employee dumped the vacuum of powder onto the burn pit and the fire reignited. The employee received first and second degree burns to both legs.
An employee was cleaning up foam debris on a boat when he fell 7 feet down to the floor of the boat dock, injuring his head and back.
An employee was picking up a saw when a coworker activated its power pack. The saw engaged and lacerated his right shin.

An employee was unhooking acetylene cylinders. One cylinder was still under pressure and released gas that ignited, causing the cylinder to explode. The employee suffered burns to the back, left arm, right arm, and abdomen.

On October 2, 2017, an employee was walking backwards and pulling a 994-pound cart of metal uprights when the cart tipped and the employee's legs were caught between the cart and the concrete walking surface resulting in a fractured left ankle, right tibia and right knee.

An employee was using an industrial mixer to mix filler when he attempted to wipe the filler off the mixer. His right hand went into the opening and was struck by one of the mixer paddles, lacerating and fracturing it. The mixer was guarded at the time.
An employee was placing a part in an upsetter machine when his right thumb was pinched between the backstop and the end of the backstop bolt, amputating his thumb tip.
An employee was grabbing a pipe he was torch cutting when the pipe fell on his hand, amputating one of his fingertips.

An employee and coworkers were attempting to change out a leaking O-ring. They were using a 3-ton come-a-long to create a gap when the hook on the come-a-long broke, causing the gap to close and smash the employee's right and left thumbs.
An employee was hooking a chain from a dump truck to a pickup truck when his left thumb was caught and amputated between the chain and hitch.
An employee was using a separator to process a coil for final packaging when his right hand was caught between the separator and the coil, amputating his ring finger and lacerating his middle finger.
An employee was clearing a dust clog at a cyclone rotary valve when the valve amputated the three middle fingers of the employee's left hand.
An employee was carrying an extension ladder on his shoulder when he stepped in a hole and injured his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was injured and hospitalized after a piece of scrap metal dropped on his toe.
An employee slid down a utility pole during training and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was pulling an order using a forklift and got his foot caught between the rack and forklift.
An employee was attempting to remove two or three pallets from a stack of pallets when he slipped backward and fell onto the floor, fracturing his left hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee working on the loading dock was trying to get the dock plate to line up with a truck trailer. The truck driver was moving the truck while the employee remained on the dock. The trailer moved back and the employee's head was caught and injured between the trailer and the building's wall. The truck driver saw the incident and moved the truck forward. The injured employee then fell off the dock and struck the ground, suffering head and arm lacerations.

While operating an electric stand-up forklift to pick and assemble orders, an employee backed the forklift up and became pinned against a rack behind the forklift, suffering contusions to the upper back and shoulder.
An employee was mowing the greens when the mower rolled over the employee resulting in six broken ribs and bruised lungs.
An employee was cutting/ripping a 3-inch piece of wood on a table saw when the saw blade amputated his right index fingertip and his middle and pinky fingers to the second knuckle.
An employee was entering the building to go to work, tripped over a floor mat and fell fracturing the femur.

An employee was working from a walk board (placed on top of rafters), installing hangers for a sprinkler system inside a cooling tower. He was wearing a harness with a retractable lanyard at the time. As he was turning around to talk to his coworker, the walk board shifted and he fell about 6 to 8 feet, ultimately hanging by his harness about 40 feet above the base of the cooling tower. He was hospitalized with a laceration, soft tissue damage, and a blood clot to his left arm.
An employee was cutting 3-inch tubing on a band saw when the employee's right thumb was pulled into the blade, amputating it.
An employee was sweeping the parking lot by the gas pumps when a customer punched him in the face multiple times. He was hospitalized with a broken jaw.
An employee was lowering a tailgate when his right middle finger was caught and amputated in the area where the tailgate hinged.
An employee was moving a heavy umbrella box with six coworkers when one of the coworkers let go of the box. The weight then shifted toward the employee, injuring his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a rag to wipe down a machine when the motor grabbed the rag and pulled her right hand into the machine, amputating her pinky finger and breaking bones.
An employee was moving a 500-pound metal pipe when it fell and struck the employee's hand, breaking it.
An employee was changing a tire using a large hammer. When he struck the tire with the hammer, it bounced back and hit his eye and head.

An employee was climbing off a roof onto a ladder when his foot slipped and he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He broke his right ankle and sprained his left ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee locked/tagged out a rotary sieve machine and cleaned it. Afterward, the employee removed the lockout/tagout, then noticed there was still material in the machine. The employee started the machine to push the excess material out and was attempting to clean it again when the employee's right hand contacted the rotary sieve, amputating the index finger.

An employee was attempting to remove a copper elbow that was jammed in an elbow machine. When the part was removed, the machine cycled and amputated two of the employee's right-hand fingers. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was sanding down a shaft with sand paper when his left middle finger and index fingers became caught in the lathe. His fingers had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was operating a rebar bending machine when their fingers were caught in the machine resulting in amputation of the end of the index and middle fingers.
An employee opened the hatch to a rotary valve's dust collector and was attempting to inspect it when the valve partially amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a shear when the bit came down and partially amputated one of the employee's fingers.
An employee was changing the yarn on a flat bed knitting machine when his body hit the start-up bar, causing the carriage to quickly move and amputate his left thumb.
An employee was participating in horse patrol training when the horse bucked him off. He suffered two broken vertebrae in his lower back.

An employee was tightening a loose hook bolt on a hops picker when her right hand was caught and pulled into the rotating hook, tearing ligaments and requiring surgery. The hops picker was unguarded at the time.
An employee was cleaning a drill press when his right hand was caught on the drill bit, partially amputating his thumb.

On October 3, 2017, at 8:25 p.m., an employee was stepping into the back of a semi trailer loaded with stock when he stepped in the gap between the semi trailer and the loading dock. He fell into the opening, broke his leg, and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was holding the lip of a dock plate open just before it was lowered into position on a shipping container when the employee's left hand became trapped between the lip of the dock plate and the rear floor of the shipping container. His middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was holding a stethoscope and walking around a bed when the stethoscope cord got hung up on something, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken right arm.
An employee was attempting to lift laboratory equipment when it became unstable and fell on him, trapping him underneath. He fractured his ankle, leg, pelvis, and ribs on both sides.

On October 3, 2017, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was descending a ladder when his lanyard became tangled around his feet. He turned and jumped approximately 13 feet, fracturing both of his heels and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell 20 feet from a roof, breaking his lower back and ankle.
An employee was riding in the basket of a scissor lift that was rigged with a steel beam when the lift toppled over. The employee suffered four broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was waiting for a crane operator to unload an I-beam from a flatbed truck. His right hand was on the load. When the material reached the ground, his middle and ring fingertips were caught and amputated between two H piles.
An employee was taking a measurement and had one foot on a portable step ladder and one foot on a wall when he slipped and fell 9 feet over the wall. He broke six vertebrae.

After preparing a stacker, an employee exited it and walked around to the operator side. His hand then contacted a moving shaft, which caught his left arm and pulled it back resulting in a broken forearm and an open wound.
An employee was walking downhill with a product when he slipped and the product fell on him, breaking his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was disassembling a crane when his right ring finger was smashed in a pinch point, requiring overnight hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a table saw to rip-cut molding and severely lacerated the right middle finger, which was later amputated. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a gas-powered cut-off saw when it cut the employee's arm near the elbow, requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was installing structural steel and moving to an existing pipe rack below his work area when he lost his balance and fell 4 feet, striking the pipe rack. He suffered a head laceration and a concussion, requiring overnight hospitalization.
A temporary employee was operating a standup PIT and struck a yellow safety pole catching his left leg between the pole and the PIT. His left foot was fractured.
An employee was operating a metal stamping press to manufacture a wheel-balancer when the employee's left hand became trapped and amputated in the press.
On 10/04/2017, at 12:10 p.m., an employee slipped/fell on ice or water by an ice machine in a cafeteria, fracturing her left femur and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was holding a piece of wood to help another employee cut the wood with a circular saw when the sawblade amputated the employee's index finger and lacerated the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the sawblade amputated the employee's right ring and pinky fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was attempting to grab a pipe that was laying on a gate roller when the gate door rolled over and amputated his thumb.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder that was on top of a drop cloth when the ladder slipped, causing him to fall to the hardwood floor. He fractured his right elbow and right hip.
An employee was struck by a concrete mixing truck while walking at a construction site, suffering a lower leg injury.
An employee was using a polishing machine to sand down a steel rod when his left hand was caught in the rotating sand paper, amputating his pinky finger at the knuckle.
While performing diagnostics on a street light pole, an employee received an electrical shock and burns on both hands, the abdomen, and the shoulders.
An employee removed a six inch valve off the HF unit and received a second degree burn to the back of the neck.
An employee was walking on the job site and stepped on a rock which caused him to slip and fall resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was positioning a hoist with rigging equipment to move a boom. As the employee was raising the hoist cable and hook, the hook was caught on the side lip of a work table. The hook then broke loose and swung, striking the employee in the face. The employee suffered a facial laceration, broken jaw, and tooth extraction.
An employee was trying to remove chicken guts from the chain of an eviscerator when the employee's left pinky fingertip was caught and amputated in the chain.

An employee was changing out a standard chuck and installing a collet chuck on a small twin spindle lathe. While attempting to take off the first chuck, the employee stepped on the foot pedal, which actuates the hydraulic draw tube and separates the chuck from the face plate. He placed his fingers between the chuck and face plate and attempted to unthread the chuck from the draw tube. While he was unthreading the chuck, the lathe was activated via the foot pedal. The chuck then drew back toward the face plate, crushing his fingertips. His left middle, ring, and pinky fingertips were amputated.
An employee suffered a left thumb tip amputation.

An employee was manually attaching a roll of media to a cardboard core on a rolling machine when another employee cycled the machine, causing the employee's right forearm to become pinned and fractured.
While descending a ladder on a front-end loader, an employee missed the last step and fell 2 feet, breaking his left arm and receiving a small laceration above his left eye.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam from a piece of demolition equipment used to recycle and process refuse concrete when his right arm entered the point of operation. His arm tendons and arteries were severed, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a 1 x 4 piece of wood. The employee held the plastic guard of the chop saw with his left hand and pulled the saw down with his right hand. He put pressure on the guard which resulted in the saw cutting the guard and lacerating his left hand.
An employee was operating a forklift when his right hand was caught and pinched between the forklift and a stationary skid of asphalt shingles.
An employee's pant leg was caught by an auger and the employee suffered two broken legs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing next to a crane truck when the crane truck touched an electric line and the employee received an electric shock.

On October 4, 2017, at around 10 a.m., an employee was cutting a piece of drawer box using a table saw. She was pushing the material through the saw when her left index finger contacted the blade and was amputated. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was helping to move an axle from one tripper line to another using a chain fall when the axle flipped and caught the employee's left hand between it and the rail, amputating the thumb.

An employee loaded a pallet jack with meat from a freezer and was exiting the freezer when a second forklift attempted to enter. The two pieces of equipment collided in the freezer doorway, crushing and breaking the employee's right heel.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated his fingertip just below the fingernail.
An employee had taken the trash out to the dumpster and was leaving the gated area when the gate came off its hinges and knocked her to the ground. The gate then fell on and broke her left ankle.
An employee was using a router when his right index finger became caught in the router, amputating and fracturing his distal phalanx.

An employee was walking across the roof of a shopping center to locate a leak when the roof and deck gave way. He fell about 15 feet to the ground on top of merchandise, breaking ribs and his C5 vertebra. He was hospitalized.

On October 4, 2017, at approximately 11:59 p.m., an employee was operating a manual lathe. He was resurfacing a solid shaft with an emery cloth while turning it in the lathe when his glove, the cloth, and then his left hand wrapped around the turning shaft. He suffered four broken bones in his left hand and broke his wrist, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was attempting to adjust forming bars on a paper bag machine when his arm was caught by the rubber rollers and pulled into the forming bars. He suffered a broken elbow and lacerations, requiring hospitalization.

On October 4, 2017, at 3:00 p.m., an employee was using a tape measurer to measure a warehouse roof vent hole where the vent cover structure had been removed to place decking material. The tape measurer then fell onto the retrofitted drywall vent cover. The employee was trying to recover the tape measurer when the drywall collapsed and he fell 28 feet to the floor of the warehouse, fracturing his right hip, left foot, right cheek, and lumbar spine. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped and fell while walking on concrete, suffering a head injury.
An employee was coming down a crank-up scaffold when he fell approximately 25 feet to the sandy ground below. He broke his upper back shoulder bone and some ribs.

An employee was manually rotating a transfer drum when his hands and fingers contacted the cutting mechanism inside the drum. His right ring and middle fingers were amputated, and his left hand was lacerated.
An employee was attempting to remove a dough buildup from a line when the line amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingers to the first knuckle.
An employee was setting up a new punch press when the press cycled and amputated the left pinky finger at the middle knuckle.

An employee was working near a crushing machine. A front-end loader was picking up a vehicle to be crushed when the vehicle fell off the forks. The employee was walking nearby and was struck by the falling vehicle, suffering a dislocated hip, lacerations, and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck to load a trailer when his foot came off the pedal and was crushed between the truck and an adjacent rack system.
An employee was using a tube bender machine to bend a tube section when the employee's right pinky finger was caught and amputated between the tube section and bender head.
An employee was working with a pallet recovery machine when he lost his footing and fell backward, hitting his head.
An employee was tying rope to a pole when a vehicle simultaneously pulled the other end of the rope. The employee's right index finger became entangled and amputated in the rope.
An employee was unloading a fertilizer trailer when he discovered a hydraulic leak. Hydraulic fluid was then injected into his hand.
An employee was using a pneumatic rivet gun to insert rivets into pre-drilled holes when metal shavings/fragments were blown into the employee's right eye, requiring surgery.

A temporary employee was operating a machine and holding a clicker to count/advance the machine when the employee dropped the clicker onto a shelf. As the employee reached to retrieve the clicker, the employee's left hand was caught in the machine, amputating the middle fingertip and fracturing the ring and middle fingers.
An employee was vacuuming water out of a part when the part swung and struck his head, lacerating it.
An employee lost consciousness and suffered a fractured skull at a multi-story apartment building construction site.
An employee was on the second floor of a building, making and lifting up new walls from the ground, when he slipped and fell 22 feet to the ground. He fractured his left arm and face.
An employee was pushing a board through a table saw when the blade caught his glove, pulling his left hand into the saw. His index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was in the process of performing a plate change on a printing press when a locking strut failed, causing a color head to drop. The color head struck the employee's right-hand third digit, causing a distal phalanx fracture and fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving paint from one storage area to another. He opened the door to the storage area and placed his right hand on the door for support while he bent down to pick up a bucket of paint. His right hand began to slip, causing the door to shut and trap his right ring finger between the door jam and hinge. His distal phalanx was amputated.
An employee was helping to unstring a drill line when the drill line became hung up in the fast line. The drill line then came free, striking and lacerating the employee's right thigh.
On 10/05/2017, an employee was attempting to open the hatch of a sugar beam/tank while using an 18-inch pipe wrench for leverage when he broke his leg, requiring hospitalization.
On October 5, 2017, a temporary employee was burned on the right forearm while attempting to light a torch, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a transfer hose to clean an area with hot water when the hose failed and sprayed the employee, burning the lower torso and thigh.
An employee was climbing a tree to trim the branches when he slipped and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, fracturing his L1 vertebra and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's foot slipped out while he was stepping approximately 2 feet down onto a work platform to access a conveyor's grease point. He fractured his left lower leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a pallet into a truck when he slipped and tore his left patella tendon, requiring hospitalization.
An employee lost her balance and fell to the floor, injuring her pelvis.
An employee was leaning sheet metal against his body when he fell and the sheet metal fell on top of him breaking his foot.
An employee was guiding an underground concrete pipe in a trench when the pipe fell off its cable and hit his right leg, breaking it.

On October 5, 2017, at approximately 9:00 a.m., three employees were working together to remove vinyl siding from the side walls of a residential balcony for demolition. They were working from extension ladders with hand tools. The injured employee entered the balcony from the extension ladder to look for a potential anchor location for his personal fall arrest system. When he entered the balcony, it collapsed beneath him. He landed on the ground and broke his leg.
On October 5, 2017, an employee was sprayed with chemicals while unhooking a hose from a chemical tank. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to the face and eyes.

While working in an electrical cabinet, an employee contacted the energized side of the cabinet, suffering electrical burns to both hands, the right side of the face, the right ear, and part of the nose.

An employee was operating a forklift truck when he extended himself out of the right side of the forklift cab and inadvertently activated the boom-down lever. The boom came down and struck him, fracturing three ribs and his rib cage.
An employee was cutting kale when his knife slipped and partially amputated his left thumb tip.

An employee was removing a jam from a labeler machine when his glove and right middle finger were caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation to his finger. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was trying to climb into the cab while the truck was moving. The employee fell and was run over by the back wheel resulting in a broken ankle and foot.
An employee was walking into the lobby, slipped and fell, breaking her elbow. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery.

An employee was moving a mainframe containing multiple drivers off a pallet. When the employee moved the mainframe off the pallet, it tilted. The employee tried to stop the mainframe from falling but it fell and hit the employee's right leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding wire into a drawing machine when the wire caught the employee's right hand and pulled their fingers into the block. The employee's right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a gasket that fell inside a pump housing when the pump amputated his left middle and ring fingers.
On October 6, 2017, an employee was cleaning a rotary printing press when his left index finger was caught and amputated between the press rollers.
An employee was pulling wire using a pulley when the pulley gave way and fell 10 feet, striking the top of the employee's head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood using a radial arm saw and amputated his right index finger. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was operating a walkie rider device when she lost her footing and smashed her foot between a column and the device. It clamped down on her foot and lacerated her toes.
An employee was placing belts on a pump jack when his right pinky finger was caught under the pump jack's belt, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the rollers of a machine when both hands were pulled into the ingoing nip point and amputated.
An employee was greasing a conveyor belt when his right index finger became stuck and amputated in the belt.
An employee was using a hand tool to retrieve parts from a candy press machine when the employee's hand tool and left hand were pulled into the point of operation, amputating the index finger.
An employee fell while installing safety clamps. During the fall, the employee's left pinky finger was caught and partially amputated between a safety clamp and a pipe.
An employee was placing products on a bottom rack and grabbing his calculator from the top of a box when he blacked out and lacerated his forehead, requiring stitches and hospitalization.

On 10/5/2017, at approximately 11:58 a.m., an employee was operating construction equipment when it flipped and threw the employee 100 feet from the cab. The employee suffered brain and arm injuries, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving shipping crates on a truck bed when he fell off the truck bed and struck the ground, fracturing his ribs, wrists, pelvis, and tailbone and puncturing his lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered heat stress and body cramping after finishing his work shift.

An employee was on the lift gate of a tractor trailer truck, closing the pull-down door, when his right pinky fingertip was caught and amputated (with bone loss) between the roller and the door's track.

On 10/06/2017, an employee was in the parking lot retrieving shopping carts when he tripped over some rebar that was sticking out of a bundle on the side of the building. He fractured his right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a rack of product from one location to another when the trolley of the rack fell off the rail, crushing the employee's big toe and requiring surgery.
An employee was on a haul truck trailer helping a mechanic tighten bolts. When they were finished and coming off of the trailer, the employee slipped on mud and fell to the ground, breaking an arm.

A temporary employee used a free-standing crane to lift a leveler's lip plate and was inspecting the welds underneath it when the hook slipped off the lip plate, causing the leveler to fall and strike his head.
An employee was standing on a stationary golf cart to empty a trash can into a dumpster when he fell about 2 feet to the asphalt ground, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.
On 10/06/2017, an employee's left hand was struck by a coworker's forming hammer, amputating his middle fingertip.

An employee was cleaning wet corn out of a probe used to check grain that is brought in by truck. The employee's left thumb was in the middle gate when the control room closed the gate, amputating his thumb at the middle knuckle.
An employee had just washed his vehicle and was walking back to the cab when he slipped on an object and fell to the ground, fracturing his left tibia.
On October 6, 2017, at approximately 11:30 p.m., an employee slipped on water and fell to the ground while assisting a surgical procedure, fracturing the left elbow and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using two hydraulic jacks on each side of a 36-inch pipe to create a drainage beneath the highway. The unit was under pressure when a 3-inch fragment of the jack separated and penetrated the employee's hard hat, fracturing the skull.

An employee was clearing a board jam from a conveyor when the conveyor activated. The conveyor roll then struck him, fracturing one of his ribs, his pelvis, and the L1 and L3 vertebrae. He also suffered one cracked rib and body bruising.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting a desk, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was moving a roll of material with a pallet jack when the material fell and struck his leg, causing possible vascular injuries.
An employee was attempting to adjust a machine that peels plastic off of bottles when the machine's striker plate pulled his glove in and then crushed his right pinky fingertip, amputating it.

An employee was using a lighter to light a propane steam table burner when the lighter ignited propane gas that had accumulated in the steam table due to a valve that had been left open earlier. The employee suffered burns to the face, neck, right arm, and right hand.
An employee was walking down an aisle when she tripped, fell, and injured her knee, suffering a contusion.

An employee was operating a digger near a 14-foot hole to replace a steel concrete pole. He was exiting the back of the machine using the ladder when he fell into the hole, fracturing his L2 lumbar vertebra and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was lowered into a peanut elevator to unclog the choke. Afterward, he was being pulled out of the elevator when his harness rope broke (cut on metal edge), causing him to fall approximately 10 feet. He injured his ankle.

An employee was standing next to a semi-truck and trailer when the employee's clothing became caught in the trailer. The truck pulled away, and the employee was crushed between the trailer and the ground, and then between the trailer and a guardrail. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee's left hand was caught in a print machine's rollers, amputating the index and middle fingertips.

An employee was fixing a switch on a rail line. The switch is near the main chain that pulls hog carcasses through the conveyor. The employee's glove was caught in the chain and the employee's left finger was amputated.
An employee was operating an electric powered industrial truck (PIT) when his right leg was pinned between the PIT and a handrail, fracturing his right tibia and fibula.
An employee was adjusting the die in a press when the press amputated two of the employee's fingers.
On 10/07/2017, an employee received first degree arc flash burns to his face, requiring hospitalization.
On October 7, 2017, an employee was clearing a jam from a hopper when the slide gate of a hopper closed on the employee's hand, amputating it.

An employee was helping another employee with a plate. The other employee hit the plate with a hammer, and the plate fell off its clamps and struck the first employee's left hand, breaking one finger.
Two employees were counting the safe at the end of a shift. One employee was bracing her hand against the open safe when the other employee closed the safe on her left ring finger, fracturing it.
An employee was pulling a truck out of a muddy field with a tractor when a chain slipped off the truck and struck the employee's head, causing a concussion and left ear laceration.

An employee was cleaning reactor stud holes using a hand-held drill with a wire brush attachment when the drill locked up in the hole. As he was reversing the drill, his gloved hand became wrapped around the brush attachment, lacerating and dislocating his left middle finger.
An employee was acting as a spotter on the road when he injured his foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling on rope to cut a limb out of a tree when his foot became tangled in the rope. He lost his balance and fell, striking the side of a truck and fracturing his face.

Employees were moving pallets to a different trailer when one employee was struck by the pallet as they were opening the trailer door. The employee suffered an injury to the right shin below the knee.

An employee was walking into work and tripped on the support bracket of the flood guard at the entry to the building. The employee lost balance and fell forward onto the ground resulting in a fractured arm, contusions to both knees and an abrasion to the bridge of the nose.
An employee slipped and fell approximately 4 feet while he was descending the four-rung fixed ladder of a tractor trailer. He broke his leg and ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while walking down the hallway, fracturing her left femur.
An employee was shot in the arm, buttocks, and abdomen while making a delivery, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing a piece of dough from a machine when the employee's right index finger was caught and amputated between the machine's blade and conveyor belt.
An employee's personal gun discharged into his left hand, injuring his index finger, which had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was stepping onto a fork truck platform to retrieve equipment when he fell 22 feet to the ground, fracturing his orbital bone an suffering a concussion.

An employee was working a bag machine when bags began falling into the machine and into the gears. While attempting to remove the bags, the employee's left index finger became jammed and amputated in a gear.

An employee was trying to remove a stuck valve when the valve feeding apparatus broke and either the feeding machine mechanism or a chain broke and amputated the distal end of the employee's left ring finger.

An employee was removing tin from the roof of a residential structure when he slipped and fell, grabbed the edge of the roof, lost his grip, and then fell 12 feet to the ground below. He struck the back of his head on a wall when making contact with the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was making adjustments to a prototype machine when his glove was caught in the rollers, pulling his right hand into the roller mechanism and amputating four fingers.

An employee was operating a telehandler on a county road and moved to the shoulder to avoid oncoming traffic. The shoulder gave out and the telehandler tipped on its side into the ditch. The employee sustained two broken ribs and was hospitalized.
A golf cart that was lifted on a hydraulic jack stand slipped and fell onto an employee while he was working underneath it, fracturing his left leg.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood with a "skew" saw when it kicked back and cut his right thigh. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On 10/09/2017, at 2:30 p.m., and employee was struck by a palletized load on a pallet jack, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was lifting a steel joist with two coworkers when the coworkers on the other end of the joist let their end go. The employee's right index finger was smashed under the joist, amputating it halfway below the nail.
