During rig-down operations, an employee's left hand was caught between a hydraulic torque wrench and a flange, amputating his thumb from the mid-knuckle to the tip.
An employee was leaving a room when she tripped on a chair and fell to her knees, fracturing her left kneecap and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a knee fracture, while working in a game as a professional football player.

An employee was standing on hay approximately 7 feet high to load bales one by one onto a flatbed pickup truck. The employee slipped on a wet bale and fell off the haystack, suffering a head injury, a broken collarbone, and broken ribs.

An employee was attempting to clear slugs from a C-press with a piece of steel when the steel came out of the press and struck the employee's face. The employee suffered a facial laceration and hairline fractures to the jaw.
While handing cases of milk from the dock to a coworker standing inside a truck, an employee slipped on the dock and fell, breaking three ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped while removing a peg line and rolled the left ankle, breaking it.

An employee was drilling a hanger in an overhead utility chase while on an 8-foot ladder. While he was descending the ladder, it kicked out, and he fell to the concrete floor, landing on his right hip and breaking his right femur. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a blender machine. As she pushed an onion through the processor, her right middle finger was amputated.

Two employees were lifting a moisture sensor onto a platform when one employee caught a finger between the sensor and the platform resulting in amputation of the right ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was turning a ball valve to allow sulfuric acid to gravity feed when the gasket in the ball valve failed and released acid. The acid contacted the employee, who suffered chemical burns.

An employee was stacking wood about 28 feet from a rip saw when a piece of wood was thrown from the rip saw and struck the employee in the back. The wood impaled his back and went through his stomach.
An employee was cleaning a machine when the chain and sprocket amputated one of the employee's fingers.
An employee dismounted a stack of lumber that was approximately 40 inches high and fractured his heel.
On 10/09/2017, an employee fell from a moving golf cart that made a sudden left turn and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working from a 6-foot ladder when she fell and broke her right arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had put his truck in park, exited it, and was walking toward a house when he noticed the truck starting to roll toward the house. He ran between the house and the truck to keep the truck from rolling into the house, suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was operating a press brake and caught their fingers in the tool.

An employee was maneuvering an electric pallet jack through a tight area when he lost his balance and stepped off the jack. At that moment, his right leg was caught between the pallet jack and the crash protector, cutting his calf and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was getting an oil sample from a hoist on the rig floor. He turned a valve and the hoist activated, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee was attempting to stop a bus passenger from falling when he lost his balance and fell with the passenger against the bus, pulling his hamstring.
An employee was removing debris from a drill press when his glove and right hand were caught by the press, amputating three fingers. The drill press was unguarded and running at the time.
An employee was removing a piece of corn from a conveyor belt when the employee's right arm was caught and amputated in the belt.
An employee was preparing to cut a piece of plywood with a radial arm saw when the employee's left hand contacted the blade, amputating approximately one half of the middle finger.
An employee was trying to dislodge a piece of plywood when the plywood pinched and lacerated the employee's right middle finger.

On October 9, 2017, at approximately 10:00 a.m., a traveling crew was working on a new natural gas pipeline installation. The crew was forcefully inserting a plunger (under mechanical pressure from an excavator) into the pipeline for standard pipe cleaning when its apparatus became disconnected from the excavator and flew out, striking the injured employee in the head/face. He lost consciousness and suffered a concussion, multiple contusions, multiple abrasions, and fractures to the nose and nasal cavity. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when the saw kicked back and amputated the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee was attempting to clean the head of a router machine when the blade amputated his left index finger and broke his left middle and ring fingers. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was lowering a cab onto a dump truck using an overhead crane when he lost his footing and accidentally hit a button on the overhead crane, causing the crane to hoist the cab with his finger stuck in it. His finger broke.
An employee was cleaning out a fiber filler machine when the machine's metal plate amputated the employee's left index finger. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was kneeling on the ground putting bolts on a rafter while a second metal rafter was leaning on a secured larger rafter section. A gust of wind blew the leaning metal rafter onto the employee, pinning him between the rafter on the ground and the rafter that fell on top of him. He suffered a facial laceration, broken foot, and broken cheek bones.
An employee became sick and dizzy while using a backpack leaf blower, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee tripped over a tree stump and fell to the ground, hurting his knee.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when his hand was smashed between the pallet jack and a metal broom hook that was mounted on an adjacent steel column. He suffered severe hand lacerations and broken bones below his knuckles.
An employee was removing stuck dough from a mixer when the mixer blade amputated part of her thumb. The mixer was running at the time.
An employee was using a band saw to cut short ribs when his left thumb contacted the blade and was cut. His thumb had to be amputated.
An employee was helping two other employees untwist metal strands from a pack when a strand quickly pulled back into the twisted position and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was shocked and fell from a ladder while changing out the ballast of a light fixture, suffering electrical burns and bumps/bruises from the fall.
A maintenance employee was reaching into a machine to straighten a cable when the machine activated and caused an amputation.
Two employees were moving a 500-pound valve set from a rack when the valve set slid off the rack and struck one of the employee's left foot, fracturing it.

An employee was troubleshooting the cleaning process on a malfunctioning tank. When he attempted to correct the flow of chemicals, the chemicals sprayed him and ran down his apron, contacting and burning his foot. Foot protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was loading a plastic fill bag onto a bagger holder when his finger was smashed between a bar on the fill and the bagger holder. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground while opening a storage trailer door for another employee, fracturing the left hip.
An employee was pinned between two tractors while transporting them, suffering broken ribs and a possible broken shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
On 10/10/2017, at 5:30 AM, an employee was running to apprehend a patient when he fell and fractured his right knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cleaning a drum roller and material belt when his hand was caught between the belt and drum roller, which then pulled his arm into the belt and roller. He suffered a broken wrist; three broken ribs; burns to the forearm, palm, and fingers; and skin removal from the forearm, palm and fingers.
An employee was picking up 5- to 10-pound recycling bins when he started feeling lightheaded and having leg cramps. He was hospitalized due to dehydration.
During very hot conditions, an employee who had been operating a forklift appeared disoriented when he dismounted the forklift. He then passed out, striking his head on the floor, due to heat stress.
An employee was attempting to cut a 6" diameter core on a chop saw when his right upper arm contacted the saw blade and was severely lacerated.
An employee fell approximately 7 feet from warehouse storage shelves and broke his left ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a crane to move loads of pipe from the shop floor onto the shelving system in the warehouse. He noticed that one of the pipes in the load was stuck on the lip of the warehouse shelf. He climbed a step ladder and attempted to unhinge the pipe using a crowbar. When he used the crowbar, the load began to shift on the shelf and he jumped from the ladder to avoid it, landing on his left leg on the concrete shop floor. He fractured his left knee and tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was completing the hands-on portion of stand-up forklift training when he drove into a wall. His left hand was crushed between the forklift and the wall.
An employee was moving an air compressor when it fell on and broke the employee's foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning near an orbit valve that had a new actuator. The actuator showed that the valve was open when it was actually closed, causing a release that broke the employee's left leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting the chute of a ready mix concrete truck when the chute mechanism pinched his finger resulting in an amputation.

An employee was inside a scissor lift bucket when the scissor lift hit a powerline, causing the live wire to break, fall to the bucket, and ignite the lift. The flames traveled to the lift arm, causing the bucket to give way. When the bucket gave way, it crashed into a pole that was live, causing an explosion that ignited the employee's clothing and propelled the employee out of the bucket. The employee suffered burns.
An employee was working in the tool room and was involved in a physical altercation with another employee resulting in a head injury.
An employee slipped and fell from his rig to the ground, fracturing his right clavicle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a bus while directing traffic, fracturing the left leg and collarbone and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing a gasket between flanges that were held apart with wedges. One of the wedges slipped out and the flanges came together smashing the employee's index finger resulting in partial amputation of the distal soft tissue.
On 10/10/2017, at 5:00 p.m., an employee was bitten by a snake while sorting through stakes, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a mower onto a trailer when the mower fell off the trailer and rolled on top of the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs.

An employee was attempting to determine if a packing machine's heat plate was warm when the employee's right hand was crushed between seal plates, amputating the ring fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

The injured employee was holding a metal part on a brake press while another employee operated the press. As the press operator hit the brake press pedal, the injured employee's right hand slipped off the metal and was smashed and fractured between the metal part and the press die.

An employee went to a residential house to provide assistance for a consumer. As she went to turn on the light, she tripped on the corner of a shoe that was laying in the floor. She tried to catch herself when she fell, breaking several bones in her left wrist and radial bone.
An employee slipped and fell while exiting his truck, injuring his third and fourth neck vertebrae.

Two employees were rigging up while a third employee was using a truck to light the worksite with headlights. When the third employee exited the truck to help them, the truck rolled down and pinned the two employees. One employee was hospitalized with a cracked pelvis.

An employee was rolling a trolley away from a coating press. As he was attempting to wheel the trolley between raw material rolls that were on the floor and a cart holding a cylinder, his right pinky finger was smashed between the corner of the trolley and the end of the cylinder. His fingertip was amputated down to the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to light a stove's pilot light when the stove lid came down and amputated the employee's middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. As he was turning, the product on his pallet began to fall. He adjusted the lift and lost control of it, hitting a rack. During the collision, his left foot was caught between the forklift and the rack, suffering bleeding, severe swelling, and a fracture.
An employee was operating a forklift when he ran into a board that was sticking out into the passageway, breaking his femur.
An employee as using compressed air to blow water from a urinal's water line when the pressure caused the urinal to break. A piece of broken porcelain then lacerated his right elbow.
An employee was climbing down a ladder with a tool bag swung over his shoulder when it swung and struck him. He suffered an infection and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam from a press machine when the press came down and amputated part of the employee's right hand.

An employee was wheeling a tool cart from one job location to another when a stack of sheetrock that was leaning vertically against the wall toppled over and landed on the employee, fracturing his right wrist and seven right-side ribs.
At a construction site, an employee fell from a ladder broke his pelvis.
An employee was attempting to adjust or repair the conveyor belt on equipment when the employee's right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the belt and roller.
An employee was installing peel and stick underlay material on a roof when his foot became tangled in the material and he fell 12 to 15 feet, breaking his ribs.
An employee was attempting to steady a carton on a pallet that was on a forklift when the employee's fingers were lacerated, resulting in the partial amputation of two fingertips.

On October 16, 2017, an employee was moving a patient and entering an elevator when the door began to close. He stuck his elbow in the doors to keep them from closing and the door scratched his arm. The scratch became infected, requiring hospitalization.
On October 10, 2017, an employee was inspecting a roof for evidence of vermin when the roof collapsed. He fell to the next floor down, fracturing his wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was making a service call and was physically assaulted by a number of individuals resulting in a concussion, a broken nose, an ocular injury, bruises and abrasions.

An employee was making a delivery when the employee slipped off the back of the delivery truck. The employee's head struck the asphalt pavement below. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a concussion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to load a beam onto a truck. He was trying to take a wood block out from under the beam when it fell from the forks of a forklift and caught his right index finger, amputating it between the first and second knuckles.
Two employees were filling cylinders when a flash fire occurred. They suffered first and second degree burns. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a closed loop process machine when his right index fingertip was caught and amputated between a broken plug and the meat form when the machine cycled.
A tree limb was cut and dropped to the ground. When it hit the ground, it shattered. Tree limb debris struck a nearby employee, who suffered a broken fibula and tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a rewind machine when his arm contacted the moving roll and was drawn into the machine, fracturing his lower right arm.
An employee was harvesting grass when his hand was caught between a conveyor and roller. He broke a finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was laying sod and spreading grass seed at the construction site. He complained of chest pains and numbness in his arm. The employee was hospitalized.

While working and walking on a flat roof, an employee fell through a skylight and metal decking that were being removed. The employee fell approximately 11 feet onto grocery carts below, requiring hospitalization for multiple fractures. Fall protection was not used at the time.
An employee was standing next to his truck in a work zone when he was struck by a drunk driver, suffering multiple head, neck, and back injuries.
An employee was operating a metal folding machine when the machine closed on her hands, amputating both thumb tips.
An employee was cleaning product lines and a pump when his left hand contacted the pump's rotating parts, amputating his left index fingertip. The pump was energized at the time.
An employee was trying to evade bees when he tripped and fell, breaking his right leg.

An employee was cleaning a spray gun. He had mineral spirits in the gun and was adjusting the spray tip when the gun shot the mineral spirits into the skin on one of his fingers. The finger was surgically removed and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell 18-20 feet through an uncovered hole in the roof while helping to install HVAC equipment. The employee was hospitalized for a facial fracture.
An employee was pushing a cart while wearing clean room gear. Her footwear became caught in the wheel, causing her to fall and break her right hip.

An employee was rigging down an isolation tool on a crane truck when he slipped on wireline grease that was on the bed of the mobile crane truck and fell to the ground, fracturing his left wrist, right elbow, and right shoulder.

An employee was supervising as two coworkers removed a plow from an overhead conveyor line. The plow was suspended from the conveyor by two j-hooks and two s-hooks. The coworkers were using a forklift to lower the plow to the ground. As the plow was being raised by the forklift, one of the coworkers guided it so that the mouth of the plow rested on the tines. The tines on the lift were wet due to rainy weather conditions, causing the plow to slide toward the end of the tines and fall off the forklift onto the ground. During its descent, the plow struck the employee on the right side of his body and sent him backwards into a hook rack, fracturing his ribs, shoulder blade, and T-12 vertebra.
An employee was recoupling bundles of aluminum in a vessel. When he placed a steel band around the bundle, the bundle fell over and pinned his right leg against a second bundle.
An employee was closing the door to an open safe when her right thumb was caught between the door and the frame, crushing the bone and amputating the tip of the thumb.
An employee was attempting to open a large warehouse door when he pulled a groin muscle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's left hand was lacerated by a chop saw while cutting scrap metal.
An employee was carrying a 50-pound case of potatoes on her shoulder when she fell and struck her head on the floor, losing consciousness.
An employee was cutting bellies using a boneless blade when the blade amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was raised on a forklift into a dumpster to press down the trash inside. Upon exiting the dumpster, he fell to the ground and fractured his ankle.

On October 11, 2017, an employee was feeding cardboard into the feed roller of a machine when his right hand became caught in the ingoing nip point of the roller. He received third degree thermal burns to the right hand and fractured three fingers.
An employee was using a table saw to cut foam strips when the rotating blade amputated his left thumb tip.
An employee was helping a second employee unload pipe when a piece of pipe became stuck. The employee was pushing on the pipe when it gave way and crushed his left index fingertip.

An employee was operating a tar truck on the highway and noticed a problem with the equipment. He exited the cab of the vehicle and noticed a large amount of hot tar coming from the valve of the equipment. He slipped on the tar and fell to the ground, contacting the 240-degree tar. He received burns on his hands and back.
An employee was cutting pork with a band saw when his left middle fingertip contacted the blade and was amputated.

On October 11, 2017, at approximately 9:10 PM, an employee was operating a press brake (equipped with laser guard) to bend a metal part when his right index fingertip was pinched and amputated between the part and the machine.

An employee was working from a 20-foot scaffold and cleaning a pipe system when the hook of a come-a-long tool that was holding the pipe hit the upper side of his right leg, cutting the soft tissue. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a machine operator with a changeover on a side frame welder, which forms a J- or U-shaped wire and welds it onto two other wires. The wire was caught in a groove, and the machine was turned off to fix the wire. The employee's left middle finger was caught in a leg wire and pushed up into a support bracket, amputating it close to the base of his fingernail. His left index finger was lacerated.

An employee was on the second floor of a job site, which had a safety rail system around the perimeter. He was bending over to pick up a piece of wire mesh when he lost his balance and grabbed for the safety rail. One of the uprights then detached, allowing him to fall to the first floor (concrete). He broke his right leg.
An employee's glove and left hand became caught in a rotary hammer, amputating a finger.
As an employee was stepping up on the cab area of a crane, the slide door of the cab slightly came off its track, causing him to lose his balance and fall. He fractured his right tibia and fibula.
An employee was standing on a counter to get cigarettes from an overhead rack when she fell to the floor, breaking her right tibia.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while cutting a piece of sheet metal with a metal working machine.

After hand loading 7 bags of pelletized horse bedding into the bed of a customer's pickup truck, an employee fell as she was getting down from the bed of the truck. She fractured her left femur, radius, and ulna.
An employee was working on 46-inch high stilts inside a building. The floor was slippery and dirty, and the employee slipped and fell. He injured his right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was bending down and cleaning out a box when a piece of angle iron fell on his left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was preparing to flush water through heat exchanger equipment when he was severely burned by hot water (about 280 degrees), suffering burns on his chest, left arm, and shoulder.
An employee was cutting fabric with an electric knife when his left hand slipped and struck the moving knife blade. He suffered a soft skin amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while loading a carrier plate.
An employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation while cutting pork chops with a blade.
An employee was trying to dispose of a wood pallet in a dumpster when his right index fingertip was caught and amputated between the wood pallet and the edge of the dumpster.
An employee was checking the status of a machine when his left hand entered the airlock, amputating three fingertips.
An employee was loading structural steel onto a truck using an overhead crane when the employee's hand was caught between two pieces of steel, partially amputated the index finger.
An employee was monitoring and collecting mussels in a river when she became low on oxygen and lost consciousness underwater. She was hospitalized.
An employee went to the elevator to help other employees with a combative patient. She was kicked by the patient, knocking her to the floor and breaking her right radius and right hip.

During loading operations, an employee's right hand was caught between a twist lock on a container and the flatbed of a truck, lacerating the skin between his thumb and index finger and crushing his middle finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was positioning a piece on a mechanical power press when the press was activated via the foot control. The part then shifted and the employee's fingers were caught in the press, amputating the middle fingertip.

An employee was removing hot tar from a hot pipe and placing it in a lugger when the wire broke, causing the lugger to fall on the employee. He received burns to the left side of his face, his left arm, and the back of his neck.
An employee was operating a powered industrial pallet jack when the employee's foot came off the platform and was crushed between the vehicle and a guard rail.
An employee was paving forms for sidewalks when his small left finger was smashed and fractured by a piston on a material loader.
An employee was reaching to grab a roll of plastic cover that the wind was blowing away when the employee's finger was smashed between the roll and the mandrel.
An employee exited a pallet jack and was crossing an aisle when his foot was run over by a passing forklift, breaking his toes and damaging ligaments.
An employee's right foot was pinched between a steel cage (protective barrier) and equipment being moved by a crane, partially amputating his second toe.
An employee was vacuuming the inside of a containment onboard a ship when he experienced stomach and leg cramping. He was hospitalized for severe dehydration.

An employee was removing a coil from a turnstile using a crane. His hand was on the C-hook of the crane when the C-hook moved backwards into a rack, crushing three of his left-hand fingers between the hook and the rack.

An employee just finished hand sanding a lugnut/lock, turned off the belt sander, and was returning to his normal work area when his right ankle gave way and he fell to the ground. He fractured his ankle and lower leg. The floor area adjacent to the belt sander was uneven due to previous equipment mounting.
An employee was using a box cutter to open a box when the cutter slipped and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

While stepping across a raised dock board to a trailer, an employee tripped on the dock board and fell between the truck trailer and dock board. The employee suffered a laceration to the left leg, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a CNC lathe and using a wrench to tighten the lathe chuck when the wrench hit his left hand, partially amputating his thumb and his second and third fingers.
An employee was working at a lower level when another employee at a higher level dropped a drift pin that hit and lacerated the employee's leg.
On October 12, 2017, an employee tripped and fell to the ground on the same level, suffering a laceration above her eye that required hospitalization.
An employee fell while walking down vestibule steps, suffering pain in the lower right leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working at a height of approximately 14 feet when he detached his fall protection system to move from one spot to another and fell to the lower level. He punctured a lung and broke two ribs and his right ankle. He was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was attempting to repair the cable and spool on a parts moving rack when the rack shifted, causing it to fall and tighten the cable around the spool. The employee's left middle and index fingers were caught between the cable and spool, suffering lacerations and compound fractures.

An employee was standing on a step ladder while arranging a plywood covering to protect the asphalt shingles of a townhouse roof. The plywood slid down the slope of the roof and struck the employee, knocking the employee off the step ladder to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a head injury, concussion, and brain hemorrhage, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing hammers on a roller when the roller grabbed the employee and rotated half a turn. The employee suffered a back injury.

A crew was preparing to load a spool onto a trailer to spool up flex-pipe. An employee was trying to guide the center spool shaft into the trailer guide so he could place the guide-pin into the spool shaft when the spool shifted, trapping his left middle finger between the center spool and the guide place. His fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee stood up at a desk, took a step, and tripped over a strap on a backpack that was on the floor. The employee suffered a nasal bone fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was bending a pipe with a metal punch when the punch amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee's wedding ring was caught by a moving forklift, amputating his left ring finger.
An employee was changing a beam on a skid steer using a hammer when a chip of steel broke loose and punctured the employee's left arm, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

Two employees were repairing the baghouse door on a warehouse roof. One of the employees stepped back and a portion of the roof gave way. The employee then fell approximately 15 to 17 feet to the concrete floor of the warehouse, striking a hoist on his way own. He was hospitalized with skull fractures, vertebrae fractures, and a torn ligament.
An employee was investigating a "hopping belt" on a ski lift pulley when the pulley grabbed his left ring fingertip, amputating it to the first knuckle.
An employee fell 20 feet while installing a metal roof, suffering a broken pelvis.
While returning from lunch and entering the yard office doorway, an employee tripped on a step and fell, suffering multiple fractures to the right leg and ankle.

An employee used an air hose to blow lids that had fallen on the floor into a pile. While walking by the lids to get a broom and dustpan, the employee slipped on the lids and fell, landing on and breaking her left wrist.
On October 12, 2017, an employee was removing a piece of scrap wood from a conveyor when the employee's right ring finger was pinched and amputated between two rollers on the conveyor.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the forklift veered to the left and impacted a bollard. The employee's left foot was crushed and de-gloved between the lift and the bollard, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning while standing on the back of a hopper trailer when the employee slipped and fell due to wetness and grain dust, breaking a wrist, kneecap, and pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a wrench to tighten a bolt on the back of a welder when the welder came down on his left hand, lacerating and fracturing it.

An employee was servicing a boiler at a client location. The employee was removing the belt from the motor on the outside of the boiler when the boiler started up, causing the power transmission belt to grab his finger and pull it into the ingoing nip point between the belt and pulley, amputating the tip of his left middle finger. The boiler was not locked out at the time.
On October 13, 2018, an employee was adjusting a hose on the back side of a mill machine when his sleeve was caught in a rotating shaft resulting a contusion to the arm.
An employee was operating a miter saw to cut aluminum when the blade amputated his left index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a pigeon hole ladder to transfer from one vessel to another when the employee's right foot was crushed and fractured between the vessels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was caught between a reversing electric forklift and racking as the forklift brought a pallet from a second level rack to the floor.

On October 13, 2017, an employee was operating a crane to move a counterweight block when his left ring finger was pinched between the counterweight block and the frame of an adjacent automatic saw. His finger was fractured and lacerated, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On October 13, 2017, an employee was untangling steel tubing on the front load end of a plating line when the machine recognized a change in tension and began pulling the tubing, which then pinched and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip. The machine was powered on at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to clean a hopper screen when his right-hand index and middle fingers were caught and amputated by the blades of the hopper's dust collection system. The hopper was not locked/tagged out at the time.

Employees were offloading pipes from an 18-wheeler and laying them on the ground. The operator dropped the load too soon, and the pipes struck an employee's left leg, breaking the tibia in two places.

An employee was wearing gloves while replacing a track tensioner on an excavator when his right hand was caught between the machine's track adjuster and the metal tracks, amputating his middle fingertip without bone loss.
An employee's glove was caught under a pallet jack, amputating the left index fingertip between the knuckle and first joint.
An employee suffered a broken leg while putting a hydraulic dock plate back in service.
An employee was pinned between two pieces of equipment.
An employee was inspecting a paper machine when his right hand contacted the blade of an unguarded fan, partially amputating his right thumb.

An employee was operating a foot-operated drill when his right ring finger was caught in the drill press area, amputating 1 inch of the finger. The drill's safety hold back device was not used at the time.
An employee was working on a pallet flipper machine when the machine unexpectedly started and injured the employee's hand.
An employee was standing on an empty pallet and either tripped or fell off of it, landing on the right side of his body and suffering a possible broken right hip.
An employee fell from a dock door and broke the lower right leg.
A temporary employee was cleaning when he made contact with a winged tail pulley, lacerating his arm and fracturing his elbow.

An employee was on a ladder removing overhead sprinkler piping with a reciprocating saw when the employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering head trauma that required hospitalization.
As boats were being separated, a cleat from the stern line of a boat broke loose and struck an employee's leg, fracturing the right tibia.
An employee was using a pallet jack to move a box when a piece of metal fell out of the box and landed on his hand, amputating a finger.
Two employees were working on a robotic spot welder when one employee initiated the machine, which then partially amputated the second employee's right index finger.
A security guard fractured his right ankle while subduing a patient.

An employee was pulling on a rope that was trapped under construction material when the rope freed unexpectedly, causing him to lose his balance and fall backward onto the floor. He broke his hip and wrist.
An employee was unloading a truck when he fell out of the truck and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting a roof when she fell off the ladder and hit the concrete below, fracturing her skull and right wrist. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was ground spotting for a wheeled loader in the vehicle dismantling area when a vehicle shifted, pinning the employee between it and a pile of crushed vehicles. He suffered hip and knee injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a tugger to pick up racks in a main warehouse aisle when she slid into some parts containers. The containers fell on her resulting in a c-spine fracture.
An employee was climbing a rolling ladder when he slipped and fell to the floor, injuring his hip.

An employee was greasing valves when he lost his footing and fell backward on a fluid pumping trailer. While he was falling, his right leg was caught in a 6-inch gap between the bumper and trailer, breaking his right fibula and tibia.

An employee was pressure-washing slag through a 3-inch port at the bottom section of a boiler. While blasting the slag, the employee lost his balance and released his grip on the pressure-washing lance. He slipped and fell backwards into a wingnut protruding from a hatch on the boiler and lacerated his right thigh.
An employee's right index finger was crushed by a rig floor during rig-down operations, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading an A-frame when it fell on his legs and then feet. He was hospitalized and had foot surgery.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake while walking through brush, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working in the laundry room when he heard a noise from a washing machine. He opened the running washer and his arm may have became wrapped in a sheet and rotated. His arm was badly broken, resulting in an amputation below the elbow.
An employee was operating a forklift when her leg was caught between the forklift body and a steel structure, breaking her ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was conducting an HVAC pre-install/removal inspection prior to crane arrival on a roof when the employee fell 11 feet off the roof to the ground, suffering broken vertebrae.
On October 14, 2017, at approximately 7:00 p.m. an employee was hospitalized due to a possible heart attack after restraining a combative patient.
A temporary employee suffered a right thumb amputation while attempting to remove a piece of meat that was hanging from a meat grinder. The grinder was guarded at the time.
An employee was about to descend a ladder when the employee's hand slipped. The employee then fell backward and hit a manhole opening, suffering a back contusion.

An employee was unloading gypsum from a trailer when he heard an air leak and tried to locate it with his gloved hand. His glove was then caught in a rotating PTO shaft and his left hand was pulled into the shaft, breaking multiple fingers and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading tempered glass one piece at a time when a stack of 10 panels fell on the employee. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.

An employee was using an auger to dig a hole for a sign. The auger bit went down approximately 3.5 feet when it reached clay soil, which pulled the auger down toward the ground. The employee's right middle fingertip was then caught and amputated between the auger handle and the sidewalk.
An employee was operating a grinding stone to sharpen knives and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was using a knife to gut a carcass. The knife slipped and lacerated his knee. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 14, 2017, at approximately 10:45 AM, an employee was using a hoist to move a basket containing a tool stack (approximately 1,060 pounds). He was using his left hand to operate the hoist remote while his right hand was on the basket. As the basket landed, the tool stack shifted, pinching and amputating his right middle fingertip.
An employee was cleaning out a concrete mixer when his right-hand fingers were caught between the mixer door, amputating his third and fourth fingertips.
An employee was driving a forklift and blacked out. The forklift struck the center support beam and the employee was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt roller when it caught and lacerated her right hand.
An employee was involved in horseplay with another employee when he tripped, fell backwards, and hit his head on the tile floor. He fractured his skull and was hospitalized.

An employee was draining water from a reactor vessel and was opening a low point bleed on the vessel when a flash fire occurred. He was burned on the hand and face by a combination of water and residual chemical catalyst.
An employee was kneeling and scanning packages when she was bumped and knocked down by another employee who was walking by. She injured her hip and was hospitalized.

On October 15, 2017, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse. While backing from a rack system the forklift bumped a rack and the operator's fingers were crushed between the rear of the stand-up forklift and the racking system.
An employee was walking when she twisted and fractured her left ankle.

An employee was assisting with carpet roll wrapping. He was starting to roll on the wrap cradle when his hands were caught in loose carpet and pulled into the wrap cradle. He suffered bilateral contusions to both arms, muscle trauma, and an avulsion to the right side of his face near his eye.

An employee was gassing up a furnace and attempting to light the pilot using a wand (igniting device). During a previous shift, one of the furnace's two gas valves was left open. When the employee began the start-up process, he opened the main gas valve without noticing that the other valve was already open. The front door on the furnace was open and a flash fire occurred, causing burns to his hands and forearms.
An employee was mixing chemicals in the compound room when the chemical mixture ignited, burning the employee's face, arms, and hands.

On October 16, 2017, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was operating his wire screen weaving machine when the material quality began to diminish. He went around to the press rollers and loosened the bolts holding them in the loom. The press rollers, which were unsupported by a cart at the time, then fell out of the machine and onto his right ankle, causing a traumatic displaced trimalleolar fracture.
An employee was re-positioning the strap on a bundle of pipe when his head struck the milled end of one of the pipes, lacerating the left side of his head near his eye.
An employee was offloading a pump from a trailer when the employee was struck in the right leg by the pump, requiring hospitalization.

On October 16, 2017, at approximately 3:30 PM, a cat-line was attached to a cable to raise up a rig floor. An employee was attempting to un-pin the floor to remove it when the cable snapped and the floor fell on the employee, striking him in the back and pinning him for approximately 10 seconds. He fractured his spine.
An employee was cutting wood blocks with a chop saw when the saw blade amputated his left index finger. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was attempting to align railcar couplers when his left thumb was caught and partially amputated (60 percent) between the couplers.

While operating an inserting machine, an employee pushed down the machine's strap. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were then clipped by the chain and pulled into the sprocket, amputating both fingers. The machine was running and unguarded at the time.
An employee was rehearsing a dance routine when she fell and struck her head on the floor.

An employee was transporting a 20-foot-long bundle of metal wall panels with an overhead crane when the bundle became unbalanced and slid to one side. The employee was then caught between the load and another stack of finished panels, suffering a right leg fracture.
An employee tripped over a pallet and fell to the floor, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was descending a 6-foot step ladder and missed a step. The employee then fell and suffered a hip fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was raising a manhole cover/ring to the proper height when the cover/ring was caught on some cable and fell on the employee's right index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was attempting to clean out the auger area of a machine when the auger caught and amputated the employee's left middle finger. The machine was running at the time.

A temporary employee was attempting to reset a safety roller in the housing of a conveyor when the conveyor belt caught the roller and pushed it into another roller, creating a pinch point. The employee's left ring fingertip was then caught in the pinch point and amputated.
An employee fell from a 6-foot stepladder and hit the floor, suffering a compound fracture to the right forearm that required hospitalization and surgery. The stepladder was not braced at the time.
An employee was struck by a falling tree limb, suffering a fractured back and multiple broken ribs.
An employee was using a miter saw when it lacerated the employee's left wrist, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was flattening yarn in an extruder machine when his right hand became caught in the machine's rollers.

On 10/16/2017, an employee was in an aerial lift cutting a tree with a chainsaw. He put the saw down on the tree and went to break off a tree limb to throw it clear of a fence. The chainsaw began to move and he went to stop it. The saw then revved up and amputated his left pinky finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was making collars for pedestal fans on a press when the machine powered on and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was operating a printing press when the employee's left hand was caught in an unguarded pinch point on the machine, fracturing two fingers.
An employee was cleaning a mixer when his right hand contacted the mixing blades, amputating his index finger.
While working on a roofing mission, an employee experienced heat stress symptoms, including nausea, vomiting, leg problems, and hypotension. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was taking a patient's vital signs when she bent forward and her foot was caught on a chair. She then fell to the floor, landing on her left elbow and left knee and fracturing her left shoulder. She was hospitalized.

A truck driver and an employee were holding a toolbox crate on a truck lift gate. The toolbox was too heavy for the lift gate. A second employee was taking things out of the toolbox to lighten the load. The truck driver then let go of the toolbox. It started to roll off the lift gate and fell on the first employee's feet, fracturing his left foot and requiring overnight hospitalization.

An employee was operating a clamp truck and pulling it into the battery charging area to park it. Her left foot was outside the confines of the clamp truck and struck a railing. Her left foot was then caught between the clamp truck and the railing, fracturing her big toe and avulsing the skin from the big and middle toes. She was hospitalized.

On October 16, 2017, at 12:15, an employee was laying roofing material when he suffered a cramp, lost his balance, and fell 5 feet onto the roof, fracturing multiple back vertebrae. He was hospitalized.

On October 17, 2017, three employees were testing the voltage of electrical equipment that was not labeled as high voltage during Hurricane Maria operations when an arc flash occurred. One of the employees suffered burns that required hospitalization.

A campus security guard was escorting trespassers off campus property when the trespassers surrounded the employee who felt threatened. The employee then suffered a heart attack as the incident was occurring.

An employee was operating a 48-inch laminator when the employee became caught in the machine's rotating parts resulting in dislocation of a hand and wrist, a fractured forearm, and displacement of skin on the forearm below the elbow.
An employee was using a cleaning scrub pad and water hose to clean a horizontal mixer when his right hand entered the mixer opening and was caught in the machine resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was helping a customer with a sale, tripped over an object and fell, injuring a hip.
An employee was climbing into the cab of a tree trimming machine when he lost his balance and accidentally closed the door on his left middle finger, amputating his fingertip.
An employee fell while climbing a ladder, landing on a concrete patio and breaking bones.
An employee was performing residential framing when a telehandler knocked the employee down and ran over the employee's right leg.
An employee fell approximately 16 feet from the top rung of a fixed ladder into a service closet resulting in a fractured left ankle and a dislocated right shoulder.

An employee was standing on a 6-foot platform ladder while attempting to get his welding wire to feed properly through his weld wire feeder. He fell off the ladder and landed on the hook of a torch cutting station stand, suffering a laceration that was approximately 5 inches long and required surgery.

An employee was removing or changing three dies on a hydraulic press brake when the top die, weighing approximately 250 pounds, fell and crushed the employee's left index fingertip. The fingertip had to be surgically amputated to the bottom of the nail.
An employee was repositioning a log that slipped off a splitter. His hand was under the wedge when the log splitter amputated his left pinky fingertip.
An employee was cutting materials using a saw when he lacerated his left thumb, requiring surgery. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was working in a caged area outside the building when he hit the right side of his face on an insulated pipe, suffering a head contusion.

An employee was inspecting/searching for an embossing roll stored on an A-frame storage rack. The employee was turning a roll to look for a marking when another roll on the same rack slipped. The employee's finger was caught and partially amputated between the roll and storage rack.
On 10/17/2017, at 3:15 PM, an employee was pulling a gate closed when it came off its rollers and struck his right big toe, breaking it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking down a hill after clearing trees when he slipped and landed on a tree stub. The stub punctured his buttock and required hospitalization.

An employee was on a roller conveyor attempting to replace a chain on a sprocket to get a pipe to move. Another pipe was placed on the conveyor, causing the sprocket to move. Both of the employee's hands were then caught in the sprocket, amputating the left index finger at the first knuckle and the left middle fingertip.
An employee was using a stand-up forklift to check tires on racking when the employee fell from the lift to the floor, injuring the mouth, knee, and shoulder.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was disconnecting two adjoining 4" hoses from a slurry pump when he was splashed by residual hot material left in the hose after a cavitation. He suffered burns to his leg and arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on machinery at a height of approximately 15 feet when the employee fell into a pit under the machine, breaking an arm and ribs.
An employee sustained burns to his right fingers while he was working on a machine that produces spring roll wrappers.
An employee was positioning cords bar to start roofing work when he stepped on a power cord, slipped, and fell 20 feet to the ground. He injured his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a well online with a wrench when the flow line blew up. The employee received lacerations to the right arm, and the left ankle was nearly amputated.

On 10/17/2017, an employee was disassembling scaffolding and unbolted a section of the tower using wrenches. As he started to climb down, he grabbed the loose section of the tower and it gave way. He then fell about 12 feet to ground, fracturing a vertebra and both heels.
An employee was struck by a moving cargo tug, fracturing her right ankle and lacerating her left leg.

On October 17, 2017, an employee was polishing a part on a manual lathe with an emery cloth while wearing gloves. The emery cloth or glove became entangled in the lathe's rotating part, and the employee's right middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was digging a hole near a broken electrical panel when he made contact with the panel, suffering a 1-inch cut on his left pinky finger. He was hospitalized.

A forklift was carrying two 600- to 700-pound gates made from pipe steel. An employee's arm was then pinned between the gates and a flatbed truck. His arm broke and was lacerated, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to remove a manhole lid when it slipped and pinched his left middle finger between the lid and the manhole rim. Skin was removed from his finger (no bone or fingernail loss).
An employee was attempting to repair a conveyor system when his arm was caught between the conveyor belt and guard, suffering multiple closed fractures.

An employee was doing preventative maintenance at a 480-volt motor control center. He was holding a screwdriver in his hand while tightening connections and cleaning at the line side of the breaker when an arc flash occurred. He suffered second degree burns to both hands.

On October 17, 2017, an employee was testing the voltage of electrical equipment when an arc flash occurred, causing first degree burns to his hands and left arm. He was hospitalized. The equipment was not labeled as high voltage.
An employee was bitten on the backside by a black widow spider while using a portable toilet.
An employee's arm entered the trimmer portion of a binding machine. His arm snapped in three places, resulting in a compound fracture, a deep laceration, and muscle and nerve damage.

An employee was standing and supervising the take-down of a pole and lines when the pole cracked, broke in half, and fell toward the employee. The employee avoided being struck by the pole but fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a broken pelvis, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was working outside behind a building, riding an all-terrain vehicle, when the throttle was jammed into full force and he lost control, striking a backhoe located on the property. He suffered severe lacerations to both the left arm and left knee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping another employee to roll a spool when the spool shifted. The injured employee attempted to hold onto it to keep it from falling to the ground. The injured employee's right forearm then became caught in between the spool and the cross members of a paint cart, suffering a compound fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding metal into a press brake to break it. He was holding the metal with one hand when the press brake die descended and struck his fingers. He suffered two broken fingers, one cracked finger, tendon tears, and lacerations.
An employee was securing a load to a flatbed truck when the employee fell from the truck to the ground, fracturing the right wrist and possibly the right foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was directing small trucks in a parking lot while riding a scooter. After directing a coffee truck towards the dock area, he was returning to his original spot when he was struck by a truck. He suffered injuries to his back and multiple other body parts.
On October 17, 2017, an employee was setting a part in a lathe when the employee's left fourth digit was caught and amputated between the part clamp and the bottom spindle of the machine.

An employee was using crossover stairs to bring tools to another employee when his foot slipped off the second to last tread and he fell. His back hit the stairs, suffering blunt trauma and contusions. He was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a top conveyor belt when he dropped a tool and his sleeve was caught by the lower belt roller, pulling his arm backward toward the belt. He suffered an elbow dislocation and fractured ulna. The lower belt was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was using a lathe with a grinder attachment to re-surface a roller. He was attempting to remove a pile of cuttings from the lathe when his right thumb entered a nip point created by the rotating material and grinder attachment. His right thumb was amputated to the first knuckle. The lathe was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was fixing a skewed board in the sorter machine, stubbed a toe and fell off the 42" sorter platform to a catwalk. The employee suffered a deviated nasal septum requiring surgery.

An employee was preparing to conduct a preventative maintenance inspection on an HVAC unit. The employee locked out the unit and placed a finger on the fan belt to slow down the fan. The employee was then pulled into the gear belt, suffering an amputation to the left index fingertip.

An employee was working/cleaning near a running conveyor when the employee's cotton glove was pulled into the conveyor. The employee's right arm was then fractured by the conveyor's sprocket mechanism.

Two employees were tightening up a connection on a pump when the wrench slipped and caught one of the employee's fingers between the skid and the wrench. The employee's finger was severely lacerated, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was pushing a bundle of lumber on a roller bed when the employee's right ring finger was caught between the lumber and roller, amputating it at the first unit.

An employee was cleaning out debris from a bag filter during maintenance when he came in contact with hot water that was trapped in a vessel. He suffered second degree burns on the left forearm and abdomen area, as well as minor burns on his right arm.

An employee was using a shackle to rig a beam plate. The shackle shifted and caught the employee's left ring finger, pinching and partially amputating the fingertip between the shackle and the steel beam plate.

An employee was pushing on a tree while putting on a wraparound when the lifting sup separated from the well head flange at the threads, allowing the flange to drop and crush the employee's right hand.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut a 2-inch by 8-inch piece of lumber on a saw horse. When he finished the cut, the saw's guard did not retract into the safe position. The blade then lacerated his right outer thigh, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by an oil rig weighing 700 to 800 pounds when it fell from a hoist. The employee was hospitalized with crushing injuries to the right leg.
An employee fell approximately 13 feet while connecting plates and was hospitalized. Fall protection was worn but not tied off at the time.
An employee was helping place a vault into an excavation when the chain moved. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra, an ear laceration, fractured neck and a possible dislocated shoulder.

On 10/18/2017, at 8:33 AM, an employee was assembling a crate to ship a door. After placing door components in the crate, he used a nail gun to secure 2-inch by 4-inch wood bucks in place to prevent them from moving during shipment. After completing these tasks, he lifted his left leg to step over a door component. The nail gun tip then inadvertently contacted his left leg and fired, puncturing it 6 inches above the knee. He was hospitalized.
On October 18, 2017, an employee was trying to take a sand sample from the molding line when his arm was caught in the conveyor, amputating it to the elbow.

Two employees were inside the top of a silo that was filled with corn silage. The employees were positioning an un-loader in the top of the silo to remove the silage. Another employee was positioned at the base of the silo. The employees heard a popping noise and the silo tipped over to the west. The two employees were free moving inside the silo cap and rode it down to the ground. The first employee suffered pelvic and rib injuries. The second employee suffered shoulder, rib, and lung injuries. Both were hospitalized.
An employee was fabricating a pipe using normal hand tools and a crane when a flange fell on his right foot, fracturing metatarsals 1-4. He was hospitalized for surgery.

On October 18, 2017, at approximately 9:55 a.m., an employee was working on a planned outage and ascending a white pine tree scheduled to be removed. He was in the tree at a height of approximately 59 feet when he inadvertently unhooked the wrong safety strap and fell 68 feet to the sloped ground below. He suffered a partial lung collapse, four fractured ribs, a small cut to the right eyelid, and a hairline fracture to the left leg.
An employee was clearing a clog at the bottom of the cooker outfeed using a rod when hot product and grease splashed onto the employee. The employee suffered second degree burns to the upper body.

An employee was connecting air hoses from a truck to a trailer when the employee lost balance and fell off the back of the trailer, lacerating the left leg on the trailer steps. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a channel (13.5: W X 11" H X 21' 7" L, total of 6,145 lbs.) into the channel cradle of a punch press. The employee entered the channel loading platform, which is used to remove banding and straps, prior to the load being placed. While the employee was guiding the load into position at the machine, the bundle traveled past the backstop and continued toward the employee. The employee was then pinned between the load and the railing of the work platform, suffering fractured vertebrae, a bruised lung, and a rib fracture.

An employee was operating an air-powered straight style grinder to polish welds when the disc of the handheld grinder broke apart and went through his face mask, fracturing his jaw. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was rigging up an I-beam with a jib attachment and a lifting hook on the bottom side. His left pinky finger was caught in a pinch point between the jib and the hook when the signal was given to move the I-beam, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was troubleshooting a golf cart that he uses to travel around the site. The employee reached into the engine compartment to manipulate the starter belt. When he pulled on the belt, stored energy was released and pulled his right index finger into a pinch point between the belt and pulley. He suffered an injury to his finger that resulted in amputation of tissue above his knuckle.
An employee had an allergic reaction to an influenza vaccination, suffering numbness and tingling in the fingers and lips, as well as partial paralysis.

An employee had just been lifted in a crane basket to the top of a bridge pier that was under construction. He unhooked his safety belt lanyard from the crane basket, stepped onto the top of the bridge pier, and waved for the crane operator to move the crane basket away from the pier. Immediately afterward, he lost his footing and fell approximately 18 feet to the ground below, suffering two broken wrists, several broken ribs, and lacerations to the face.
An employee was stepping up on a stool to reach product when the employee fell off the stool. The employee's head struck an adjacent machine or the floor, requiring hospitalization.
While working from a ladder to mark dimensions on a truck, an employee fell from the ladder and injured the right and left wrists and left ankle.
On October 18, 2017, an employee was attempting to retrieve a jammed part near the point of operation on a stamping press when his left fourth finger made contact with the tooling and was amputated.
An employee was standing on the second or third rung of a ladder and using a drill overhead to make a hole for a vent when he hit the back of his head on concrete, suffering a concussion.
An employee sustained the amputation of the index, middle, and ring finger on their right hand from a saw in the slicer room.
While descending a scaffold ladder, an employee fell 15 feet from around the second tier of the scaffold to the ground, suffering a hip fracture and concussion.
An employee was on a roof using a power saw to cut two-by-fours at a 45-degree angle when the saw slipped and cut his right leg.
An employee was unclogging a paint sprayer when it fired while his finger was at the end of the nozzle. The paint/toxin was injected into his left index finger, lacerating it.

An employee was on a catwalk walking to an oil pit when the employee stepped into an open section of grate that was being repaired and fell 27 inches to the floor below. The employee sustained a broken right leg.
An employee was moving boxes when a box fell and struck the employees' left big toe, fracturing it.
An employee, working at heights above 4 feet, fell while transitioning from a rolling ladder to a machine. He broke his right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a utility vehicle outside when it tipped and pinned his left leg beneath the frame, causing a compound fracture and lacerations.
An employee fell to the floor while walking, suffering a broken nose and right arm.

A crew was attempting to line up a catwalk with a vee-door. An employee's left hand was resting on the catwalk. The employee signaled the driller on the controls to move the catwalk. The vee-door, which was resting on the catwalk, then shook free and swung down, smashing the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee suffered a left ring finger amputation and injuries to his other fingers while cutting molding with a table saw.
On October 19, 2017, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee fell from a platform ladder to the ground and suffered a head laceration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee went to the back of the building, opened a wall box, and was attacked by wasps. While retreating, he fell to the ground and broke his hip.
An employee was breaking off lifting washers from pin protectors and hit his finger with a small sledge hammer, resulting in a fracture to the right ring finger.

On October 19, 2017, at approximately 10:15 AM, an employee was cleaning a vacuum conveying system when an automatic mechanical valve closed on his right middle finger, resulting in an amputation to his fingertip.

An employee was part of a rig floor crew that was picking up  2-and-3/8-inch drill pipe to make a connection with a power swivel. The employee grabbed the pipe above the elevators. At that point, 1/4-inch sling cables wrapped around the pipe and the employee's fingers, partially amputating the right middle finger and fracturing the right ring finger.

An employee was climbing onto a crane's folding ladder to enter the crane's cab. His hand was wrapped around the ladder's side rail when he put his weight on the rung to climb the ladder. When he applied weight to the folding ladder, the siderail parts straightened and caught one of his right-hand fingers between the two parts, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was changing over and typesetting the print on a press when the printer plate grabbed and de-gloved the employee's left ring and little fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was going down a ladder/stairway into a basement when he reached for his tool bag and fell 2 feet to the floor, fracturing his hip.

While cleaning a slicer head using chemicals, an employee pulled on a hose that released from a valve. Chemicals (caustic soda) then splashed the employee's face, causing a chemical burn near the eye.

An employee was moving an I-beam by rolling it. The I-beam rolled faster than anticipated, so the employee attempted to grab it. At that point, his finger was pinched between two beams. He lost the end of his finger.

An employee was helping another employee move lead-containing sheet rock with a dolly when the lead-containing sheet rock fell on the employee's right ankle and fractured it. The employee was hospitalized.
While trying to remove a piece of fat, an employee had their fingers caught in the de-fatter machine, resulting in amputation of the index fingertip and the middle fingertip on the left hand.

An employee was adjusting an edge bander when the employee suffered an amputation to the right third distal phalanges. An interlock was not in place and the equipment was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was cutting a steel object with a propylene/oxygen cutting torch when the remaining steel piece (weighing 2,320 lbs.) shifted and started to fall. The employee tried to walk away, but tripped on an uneven surface and fell into the path of the falling steel piece. The steel contacted his upper thighs and the weight of the material dislocated and fractured his right ankle.

An employee was operating the air system on a semi trailer designed to transport building trusses. The employee was lowering the air actuated plate into position and had their right hand where the plate came to rest resulting in a broken finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a peeling machine to peel fruit when her right hand was struck and lacerated by the blade, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a microtome to slice tissue. The employee was moving the sliced tissue when the microtome blade, which was still in operation, amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip. The blade was unguarded at the time.

On October 20, 2017, an employee was cleaning near conveyor belts when his right arm was caught in a rotating pulley assembly, lacerating and tearing the skin from his right arm. He was hospitalized and received stitches.
An employee's left pinky finger was caught in a metal rolling machine while handling sheet metal.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while cutting a metal panel, suffering a fractured wrist that required hospitalization.
An employee was either sitting or standing on a flatbed truck when he was run over by a skid steer that reversed in the direction of the truck. He suffered a fractured leg and concussion.

An employee was attempting to remove a jam on an injection molding machine when another employee inadvertently restarted the machine. A mechanical roller then pinched and amputated the employee's index fingertip (no bone loss).

An employee slipped while attempting to board a skid steer. The employee's left foot was then caught between the bucket and the frame of the skid steer, breaking the left ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was climbing down from the bed of a dump truck when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was grabbing the end ring of a pipe to move it when his right hand was caught between that ring and a second metal ring, partially amputating his right middle finger.
An employee was exiting his vehicle while it was being lifted by a tow truck when he fell on his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using an electric band saw to cut wood skids (to be used as spacers between pipes before they are buried and backfilled) when his hand was caught under the saw, amputating his pinky fingertip.

An employee was using a wrench to adjust a skirt board on a coke conveyor because product was falling off the conveyor. The conveyor caught the wrench, which then struck the employee's left index finger. The employee's fingertip was removed. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to reattach the fingertip.

An employee was operating a loom and attempting to remove fabric lint from it when his right hand came into contact with a moving gear that was located deep behind the fabric yarn and in the frame of the loom. His right pinky and ring fingers were amputated. The loom was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was lowering a blowout preventer (BOP) into position. He placed his hand on top of a stud on the BOP flange while the BOP was being lowered. The stud became hung up and bottomed out on the pipe ram body, smashing his left hand. His left middle finger and knuckle were crushed and required surgery. Impact gloves were worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was feeding a small diameter bar through the plate roller machine when his glove was caught in the roller, pulling his right hand into the machine and amputating the index finger.
An employee was adjusting a hopper machine when a piston from a product dispensary tube was accidentally actuated. The piston fractured her right middle finger and lacerated her right hand.
An employee was installing a bilge keel chock on a DDG unit when his oxygen/fuel gas hose caught fire and severely burned him.
An employee was pulling a die from a press when the employee's right index finger was caught in a channel on the press, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was found unconscious in the ramp area of the facility after placing garbage into an outside dumpster. The employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a catwalk to unjam cases from a line when he fell from the ladder and suffered a partially collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a pressure washer in his right hand and a drain tube in his left. The drain tube had a small hole in it. When the employee blew water into the drain tube, high-pressure water came out of the hole and lacerated his left hand between the middle and ring fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell down the stairs, breaking his neck.

While preparing to clean a mix tank, an employee bent down and tightened the clamp. The clamp snapped, shooting out a mixture of hot water and cleaning solution that contacted and caused first degree burns to the employee's face and both forearms.
An employee severed his left ring fingertip while rolling up a work vehicle's tarp (no bone loss).
An employee was stepping down from a machine bulldozer when he missed a step and fell, fracturing his left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee sustained friction burns to the left hand and wrist while reaching between two moving conveyors to retrieve a tape measurer.

An employee was working with a winch to pull a cable with steel ribbing to tighten the ribbing against lagging boards. He had a variable speed controller in one hand to operate the winch, while his left hand was on the cable. When the controller was activated, it pulled his hand into the winch, amputating his left index, middle, ring, and pinky fingers from the knuckle up.
On October 20, 2017, an employee was using a pallet jack to remove material from shelving when the employee bumped material that was leaning up against a shelf, suffering a left foot/toe injury.

An employee was cleaning a pipe with a lance that ejects high-pressure water when the hose burst. The high-pressure water was then injected into his right-hand palm, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was repairing a golf cart and checking the tension when the clutch engaged, catching and amputating 1 inch of his index and middle fingers.

On October 19, 2017, at approximately 10:30 AM, an employee was rigging a steel fabrication project to an electric hoist when the hoist was activated. The employee's right thumb tip was then caught and amputated between the metal project and the rigging strap.
An employee was hoisting a load of steel billets with a crane when the employee's right index and middle fingertips were pinched between the steel billets and the chain sling.
An employee was on a step ladder working on a soffit and fascia when he fell off the step ladder and landed on a sprinkler head. The sprinkler head punctured his intestines and stomach.
An employee was repairing a lawn mower by adjusting the carburetor when the mower ran over his hand and amputated three fingers. The mower was running at the time.

On October 20, 2017, at 11:34 PM, an employee observed a paper jam at an inserting machine. He was attempting to pull the paper out the machine when it pinched his left middle finger, lacerating it and amputating the fingertip.
An employee made contact with an overhead powerline while working with a well point injection. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hand loading a pallet of pulled material for a customer when the pallet of stacked packing material tipped over and pinned the employee down. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee tripped when she stood up from her desk chair and took a step. She fell forward and landed on her right side, fracturing the bone that connects the femur to the hip socket.
A temporary employee was performing preventative maintenance on a conveyor when he sustained a fingertip amputation.
On October 20, 2017, an employee received multiple fractures while exiting a revolving door at a hotel conference.
An employee was cutting chicken when he dropped his knife. As he tried to regain control of his knife, it punctured the right side of his chest.
An employee was operating a utility vehicle when it hit a pot hole and turned over. The employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee slipped and fell while walking through the facility, suffering a fractured ankle.
An employee was using an electric pallet jack when it ran over her left foot.

An employee was attempting to clean the index sensor on a bracket welder because of a machine fault. This did not clear the fault, so the employee attempted to clean the fixture. When the employee cleaned the fixture, the fault cleared and the machine actuated. This caused the magnet to come down on the employee's left index finger, amputating the finger at the second digit.
An employee was working with a depositor machine when the employee's index finger contacted the depositor, amputating it from the fingertip to the knuckle. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was pushing a cart out of a storeroom when the employee was struck by a transport cart being pushed by another employee. The employee suffered a fractured lower right leg.
An employee was attending to a horse when it kicked his hips. He suffered a dislocated hip and broken pelvis, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an abdominal hernia while reaching overhead for a box of pineapples.
An employee was walking into the receiving area to get a cart when she tripped on something or her knees gave out, causing her to fall and injure her left hip.
An employee was rolling a pipe by hand when his right pinky finger was caught between the pipe he was rolling and a stationary pipe. His fingertip was crushed and had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was using a band saw to cut ribs when he stumbled and lost his balance. He put his hand out to catch himself and it hit the saw blade, amputating the right index finger. He was standing on a floor mat and wearing slip-resistant boots at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to unjam a plastic lid from a conveyor when his right middle finger was caught and amputated in the conveyor.

An employee was using a gas-powered pressure washer to clean the inside of a walk-in cooler. The gas pressure washer was placed outside of the cooler in the production area. After completing the job, he became ill from carbon monoxide poisoning, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was participating in physical training when he became ill and fatigued. He was hospitalized with a suspected muscle injury.

An employee was inspecting a two-story residential roof for hurricane damage. While climbing a ladder from the first level to the second level, the employee fell from the roof of the first level and suffered a broken left arm.

An employee was working with a material handling system on an injection molding press and moving boxes of plastic components. She turned to move and her foot caught the leg of a table, causing her to lose her balance and fall to the floor. She broke her hip.
