On October 22, 2017, at approximately 8:30 PM, an in-bounder was operating a reach lift truck, when the operator lost control, stuck his foot out, and pinched his left foot between the truck and a concrete bollard. The operator suffered a left foot heel avulsion fracture.
An employee was operating a forklift when a piece of scrap steel popped up and struck his leg, breaking it.
An employee was cutting meat when his hand guard (made out of stainless steel) hit the blade of the electrical saw. He received a laceration to his right index finger.
An employee was lighting a boiler when a propane flashback occurred, burning the employee.
An employee was driving a forklift when it struck a pallet and a rack, which dislodged a metal bar. This bar struck and lacerated the employee's left thigh, rupturing a blood vessel.
An employee was found lying on the floor by two other employees who were passing through the area. He suffered minor bruises to his body.
An employee fell from an elevated lift platform while installing wall sheeting on a residential property, suffering paralysis.

An employee was operating a scissor lift when a steel beam swung and struck the employee and the lift. The scissor lift tipped over, and the employee fell 10 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured hip and pelvis.
An employee was climbing a concrete form wall when the wall shifted. The employee then fell about 6 feet to the ground, breaking ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was hooking up equipment to torque test when he stepped onto a wing valve that was 2 feet off of the ground. The wing valve broke, causing him to fall onto the ground. He suffered broken ribs and lower back injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee fell to the ground at a construction site, breaking his left leg.
An employee got into a confrontation with a customer and jumped on the customer's car. When the customer pulled off, the employee fell to the ground below, breaking his leg.

The injured employee was hanging parts on the paint conveyor. A forklift operated by another employee in the area was dropping off a pallet of parts. As the forklift backed up, it snagged the hanging pendant control for the overhead hoist. The pendant control was flung back towards the employee hanging the parts and struck the employee's left arm resulting in a fractured forearm.

An employee was cleaning out the feed-wheel of a wood chipper when the trailer jack holding the feed-wheel in place slipped out. The feed-wheel then struck the employee's left forearm, fracturing and lacerating it.
An employee moved a trailer into the dock to be unloaded. When he opened the trailer door, two bundles of scrap fell out and struck him, breaking his right ankle and knee.
An employee was painting a bilge and fell about 2 feet through a deck plate, injuring his right temple and the inner side of his right knee.
An employee fell approximately 40 inches to the ground while walking on a flatbed trailer and arranging a rack system, suffering broken shoulder bones.

An employee was hooking up a trailer with scrap lumber in it to a pick up truck. The trailer rolled and as the employee got out of the way of the trailer, a piece of lumber struck the orbit of his eye. The orbit was fractured and required surgery.

An employee was attempting to stab a piece of pipe while tripping in a hole when a boom gate fell on the employee's left foot, fracturing a metatarsal. The boom gate was up and in motion at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a roll bender when the employee's left hand was pulled into the machine's point of operation, amputating the fourth and fifth fingers.
An employee stepped backwards and tripped over another employee's foot. The employee sustained a fracture of the left wrist.
An employee was removing a piece of metal coping from a hydraulic brake press when three of his right-hand fingers were caught in the press, amputating the three distal phalanges.

An employee was performing maintenance on an aircraft's main landing gear. He removed a pin from the drag brace on the main landing gear and placed his thumb in the hole that the pin was in. The drag brace then shifted, amputating his right thumb tip just above the first knuckle.

An employee was securing a trailer to a truck with a hitch when another employee bumped the trailer with a piece of equipment, pushing the trailer forward. The first employee's left thumb was caught and crushed between the trailer and the truck.
An employee was placing trash in a bin when aluminum poles that were leaning against the wall fell on him, striking his head and fracturing his vertebrae.
An employee tripped over a fan that was used to dry carpets that were being cleaned and fell, fracturing an arm/shoulder.
An employee was operating a fiberglass pipe-making machine when his left gloved hand was pulled into the mandrel. He suffered muscle damage and his left pinky finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was working at a shaker table to properly dispose of oil and gas drilling waste when a water pump created an arc flash that burned the employee's face.

An employee had just rigged up a 3/4" thick plate (10'x 6') with a single hook chain. The chain was choked through a hole in the center of one edge of the plate. The employee was standing near the plate while an equipment operator was raising the plate with an excavator. The chain came loose, and the one edge of the plate that was 2.5" in the air came down on the employee's toes resulting in amputation of two toes.

An employee used a collapsible ladder to access a roof. After setting up the ladder and checking it for stability, he began to climb up the ladder. He reached the roofline and began transitioning to the roof when the ladder began sliding underneath his feet. He began sliding with the ladder, and his legs went between the ladder's rungs. He then fell backwards, landing on his back on top of the ladder and fracturing his T-12 vertebra.
An employee was walking outside when she tripped over a small sign and fell in the parking lot, suffering a possible wrist fracture and bloody nose.
An employee was moving product with a double pallet jack when he drove into a parked forklift, lacerating his ankle and requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a forklift. He had placed a stack of pallets down and was reversing with his left foot partially outside the forklift body when his left foot struck and was caught between a column and the forklift. His foot was partially amputated.
An employee was training on a Swege machine when her right middle fingernail was caught in the machine resulting in a right middle finger amputation.
An employee slipped on oil while walking and fell, suffering arm pain.
An employee slipped and fell on a slippery floor in a patient's room and tore a hamstring.
An employee climbed a pole to work on an order when the pole fell over. The employee also fell to the ground, and the pole landed on his legs. He fractured his back.

An employee in an order picker was traveling backwards at a height of approximately 4 feet when the picker struck a racking guide rail. Upon impact, he was thrown from the machine to the floor, suffering head trauma and skull fractures. PPE was not worn at the time.

An employee was walking under a spool of coil tubing to assist another employee. When the employee reached up and grabbed the tubing, his left hand was pulled into a pinch point between the tubing and a roller. The employee tried to get his left hand out of the pinch point using his right hand, but his right hand was also caught in the pinch point. He suffered multiple fractures and lacerations to both hands, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder removing a variable air volume box (VAV) from the ceiling when he fell approximately 5 feet off the ladder. The VAV box landed on his right leg. He was hospitalized with a broken right leg.
An employee was standing on the back of a lift gate when he attempted to kick a strap into the trailer, lost his balance, and fell to the ground, injuring his back.
An employee was cutting wood with a saw when he received cuts to two tendons and broken bones.
An employee was using a table saw when it deeply lacerated the employee's left forearm, requiring surgery.

On October 23, 2017, employees were cutting cross frames and a girder as part of the demolition process for a bridge. While torch cutting the girder, one employee connected his personal fall arrest system to a beam clamp that was connected to the tail section of the existing girder. The tail section was supposed to remain in place when the rest of the girder was dropped. After the employees finished cutting the girder, the tail section fell from its bearing and pulled the employee approximately 13 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken wrist and back injury.
An employee was cutting cardboard with a box cutter when it amputated his left thumb tip.

An employee was descending the built-in steps on an aircraft baggage belt loader when he missed a step and fell approximately 3.5 feet to the concrete parking ramp, striking his head. He suffered a possible concussion and pulled groin.

An employee was bulldozing parallel to a hill while installing an oil and gas pipeline on a 32-degree slope when the bulldozer tracks made contact with two large sandstone rocks. The bulldozer became unstable and rolled over. The employee suffered rib fractures and a dislocated shoulder, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a 22-inch wooden box while drilling holes into an aircraft panel when he fell off the box and hit the floor, fracturing his arm and lacerating his head.

An employee was standing three rungs up on an open step ladder using a pry bar to pry plywood off from studs when the pry bar slipped. He then lost his balance and fell to the ground, fracturing his left hip/femur.
An employee was repairing the engine on a construction vehicle when he fell 42 inches off the back of the vehicle's bumper and struck his head on the floor, suffering a concussion.

An employee was about to inspect and solve a leak on a condenser door when water pressure from the condenser caused the door to blow open. The water pressure then impacted the employee, who suffered a fractured leg, rib, and skull.

An employee was installing an overhead electrical power line. The tool the employee was using contacted the ground creating a direct short. The employee was hospitalized for electrical flash burns to the face.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while using a radial arm saw.

An employee was using a drift mandrel to check for the proper diameter inside a valve. His ring and middle fingertips on both hands were in machined holes on either side of the drift he was pushing into the valve when the drift became stuck. As he tried pushing the drift harder, the drift broke free and went into the valve, severing his four fingertips.
On October 24, 2017, employees were exposed to high levels of carbon monoxide while working in an office. One employee was hospitalized.

Two employees from two different companies were using a manlift to set a valve on a wellhead. The rigging from the crane carrying the wellhead became bound with the well, causing it to kick. The valve then loosened from the carrying straps and fell 14 feet, hitting the manlift. The two employees were knocked out of the manlift and fell 9 feet to the ground. One employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized. The other employee suffered minor injuries.
While cutting metal parts with a saw, an employee received a severe right arm laceration from the blade.

An employee was operating a roll groover to press a groove into the ends of pipe for coupling purposes. He was checking the depth of the groove with his right index finger when it was caught in the point of operation, amputating it between the first and second knuckle.
An employee was trying to turn on an electric fan used by employees working on the line when he was struck by a door carrier. The door carrier then pushed him into a steel guard.
An employee was taking clothing hangers to a clothing rack when she tripped over the rack and fell, fracturing her left hip and left elbow. She was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a golf cart that a coworker was reversing, suffering a broken leg.
An employee fell while climbing a grain pile to secure a tarp, suffering a right leg fracture that required surgery.

An employee was working at a stationary grinding machine to grind off the top layer of a conveyor belt. The employee was wiping debris off the top of the conveyor belt as it came out of the grinding wheel when the employee's right index finger came in contact with the grinding wheel, amputating the tip.
An employee was building a shipping crate using a pneumatic nail gun when he accidentally shot a nail into his left middle finger.
An employee was conducting a visual inspection of newly installed air heater seals used to preheat a boiler when his right pinky fingertip was amputated.

A spotter was directing a boom lift operator to move the boom lift forward and providing start/stop signals. The spotter was walking in front of the boom lift when the boom lift operator moved forward and struck the spotter, knocking him down and pinching his left leg between the boom lift frame and the ground. The spotter suffered multiple fractures, with an open traumatic wound to his left foot and ankle.
An employee amputated a fingertip while cutting meat with a band saw.
An employee slipped while stepping down out of the cab of his paving truck. He fell to the ground and broke his hip.

An employee was moving a 600 lb. piece of steel with a magnet crane when the steel fell from the magnet and landed on his right foot. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

Note: No amputation
An employee was cleaning inside a blender when it was activated by another employee. The blender paddle then broke both of the employee's legs.

An employee was helping a heavy equipment operator move a joint of pipe by holding a tag line. As he was walking with the pipe, he stepped on a rock and lost his balance, falling onto and breaking his right leg. He had surgery.
An employee was walking down a corridor when he opened a metal door that had an electrical current due to a pinched wire from temporary lighting in the corridor. He received an electrical shock.
An employee was operating a slitter machine when the employee's right hand was caught in the machine, causing an amputation to the little finger.
An employee was securing a tarp on a maintenance building office roof when the employee stood on and fell through a skylight, landing on the concrete floor below and sustaining head trauma.

An employee was testing a 20-horsepower motor when his left ring finger came into contact with the 100-pound rotor, which was spinning at 10,000 rotations per minute. His finger had to be surgically amputated at the second joint.

An employee was setting an electrical pole into the ground. As the pole was being raised, the choker on the pole slipped, catching the employee's third left finger in a pinch point. The distal portion of his finger was amputated.
An employee was attempting to place a heavy round metal plate into a slot by hand. He released the plate with his right hand and his left middle fingertip received a bone fracture.
While cleaning around an inspection table, an employee leaned on the table and suffered an open fracture to the left arm.
An employee was fabricating wooden targets for a firing range. He was using a table saw with a 10" blade when his left thumb and index and middle fingers contacted the blade, amputating two fingers.

An employee was cleaning a battery-powered caulk gun with gasoline when the employee bumped the trigger. The gasoline then ignited the employee's shirt sleeve and pant leg, and the employee received burns on the right arm and upper right ankle.
An employee was operating a joiner while wearing gloves when his glove was caught in the joiner. His finger was then pulled into the joiner, and his fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was shutting down a cotton gin and opened the metal cover for the lint cleaner. The belt or saw inside the lint cleaner partially amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was sealing highway asphalt when he tripped, fell, and dropped a hot asphalt sealer can. The hot asphalt spilled on and burned his left hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping an elevator mechanic install an elevator when his left index finger was caught and amputated in the pulley.

An employee was blowing zinc as pipe material was being raised from a kettle when the wire rope holding the pipe material broke. The material fell into the kettle, splashing zinc on the employee, who suffered second and third degree burns to the neck, arm, shoulder, and head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a sanitation cart across the floor when a reversing forklift driver struck her, fracturing her ankle.

An employee was pushing a small cart with boxes when the wheels of the cart became stuck on a drain cover. The employee pushed the cart with force and fell forward onto the concrete ground, suffering a concussion as well as head and body pain.
An employee fell from a lift gate while talking on the phone, suffering a wrist injury.

An employee was placing a wooden 2x4 between steel roadway grates when the employee's right hand was caught between two grates, fracturing two fingers and causing tendon damage and an amputation to the first knuckle of the right ring finger.
An employee was pushing a 7-inch channel on a conveyor belt when his left hand was caught between the belt and the channel, amputating his middle fingernail.

An employee was driving a forklift when the left fork hit a support beam, causing the employee to then hit the cage of the truck. He sustained three fractured vertebrae in his neck and a forehead gash.
An employee was driving a vehicle across a ramp when he backed into a wall and was hospitalized with a fractured neck and head lacerations.

An employee was driving a pallet jack when he struck a floor grate, which caused the jack to stop abruptly. He was ejected and struck the floor of the debone cooler. He was hospitalized with a left hip fracture and abrasions to his left elbow.

Two employees were moving 40-foot long pipes (30 inches in diameter and weighing over 1,000 lbs.) on an elevated pipe rack into the pipe coating facility. While moving the last pipe, one employee's right hand was caught between a stationary pipe and the moving pipe, partially amputating his right ring fingertip and avulsing his right long fingernail with a nailbed laceration. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was putting up stock in the produce cooler when he tripped on a box on the floor. He slipped and fell, hitting his head on a sink and his hip on the floor. He suffered a hip fracture, intracranial injury, sprain, strain, and dislocation.

An employee was working on an engine sub-line when he activated the two-hand control. The engine pallet then lowered onto his right thumb, crushing it. His right thumb broke, requiring surgical amputation and hospitalization.

An employee was driving a forklift  from a dock onto a truck trailer when the truck trailer began to pull away. The forklift fell from the dock to the ground and landed in an upright position. The employee suffered a broken rib and vertebra.

An employee was using a 10 lb. sledgehammer to secure pins to a metal form. As he was striking the last pin, the sledgehammer struck the small digit on his left hand, removing his fingernail and amputating the tip.
An employee was loading a truck with pipe. When he removed a support that was holding the tier of pipes in position, one of the pipes fell and hit his left leg. His leg broke and required surgery.

An employee was pulling pallets with a powered pallet jack when his legs were caught between the pallet jack he was operating and another stationary pallet jack that was behind him. He suffered lacerations to his lower left leg and ankle.
An employee was reversing a forklift when he struck a metal rack. His hand was caught between the forklift and the rack, causing an amputation.

An employee was cutting a bag liner to relieve the water pressure when the bag filled with hot water and ruptured. The hot water covered the employee, causing second degree burns to 40 percent of his body.
An employee was operating a small pieces folding machine when the employee's hand was caught and degloved in the machine.
An employee fell from a picker to the ground, injuring his head and back.
On October 25, 2017, an employee suffered a tuft fracture/amputation to the right thumb while attempting to re-feed the bag making machine. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was trying to move a barrel back onto a forklift when the pallet broke. The barrel then shifted, pinching the employee's finger between the barrel and the forklift mast. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was exiting her vehicle to go into the office when she tripped on a parking stop and fell to the ground, breaking her collarbone.

An employee was on top of a trailer tarping a load. As he was stepping down, his right foot was caught in the plastic tarp. He tripped and fell off the top of the load, landing on the ground and suffering an open distal radius fracture with radiocarpal dislocation and an L2 compression fracture.

An employee was cleaning a mixing tank and spraying water inside the tank when the water pressure hit the tank lid. The lid then fell and struck the employee's right hand, partially amputating the middle fingertip.

Employees were troubleshooting an elevator. The injured employee opened the overhead hatch and climbed halfway out onto the ladder to attempt to toggle some switches. Another employee hit the up arrow and the elevator moved crushing the injured employee's right arm between the ladder and the elevator resulting in a fractured and punctured arm. The interlock switch was damaged and did not work allowing the elevator to move with the overhead hatch open.

An employee was emptying a self-tipping dumpster that was attached to the forks of a forklift. He tilted the forks forward to help facilitate the dumping of the dumpster. He then got out of the cab of the forklift, walked to the side of the forklift mast, and placed his left hand on the lower portion of the mast. He reached up with his right hand and disengaged the release lever on the back of the self-tipping dumpster, causing the dumpster to quickly shift forward. The resulting shift in weight of the dumpster caused the forklift forks to swing back into the mast, pinching the employee's ring finger between the forks and mast. The tip of his ring finger digit was amputated.
An employee was standing in front of a palletizer when she was struck by a forklift, injuring both ankles and both feet. She then fell and lacerated the back of her head.
An employee lost his balance while sitting on a stool and fell to the ground, suffering a head injury.
An employee opened a secure cover on a still after a Clean-In-Place (CIP) wash and was splashed with a hot mix of water, detergent and Alkali LF 257. The employee suffered burns to the upper torso.
An employee was working a trail on an all terrain vehicle (ATV) when he hit a ditch. The ATV flipped over and landed on him, breaking his arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting bailing wire off a bail of corrugated cardboard when the wire released from the bail under tension and struck the employee's head, penetrating the skull.

An employee was servicing a boiler. After being notified that the boiler system had been depressurized, he removed a plug from a valve on the boiler. Hot sea water then hit him, causing second degree burns to his right arm, right shoulder, neck, and chest.

An employee was on a work platform helping a coworker weld a brace in place on a structure when the platform tipped. He lost his balance and then fell approximately 10 feet, suffering a liver laceration, minor concussion, and broken wrist.
An employee fell 20 feet while supervising employees installing a ridge cap on a metal building, fracturing his left hip and right elbow.
An employee was working on a ladder when it slipped. The employee then fell to the ground, suffering a left shoulder injury. The ladder was unsecured at the time.
An employee fell approximately 7 feet to the ground while descending a fixed ladder from a roof, fracturing the left leg.
An employee was cleaning the bottom drawer of the stove when she squatted and lost her balance, falling backwards. She put both hands out to prevent the fall and fractured both wrists.
An employee tripped over a cable tray on the floor and suffered a hip fracture.

An employee was inspecting work performed during the construction of a water tower. He was trying to remove a manhole cover when it slid off his hand and caught his left index finger, partially amputating his fingertip.

An employee fell 20 feet off a roof while installing fiber optic cabling, suffering two fractured hips, a broken collarbone, and multiple other broken bones. The employee was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was doing maintenance on a conveyor system when his right hand was caught in the conveyor, partially amputating his middle finger.

An employee was rigging a flow line on a crane when the pipe became stuck. The employee approached the flow line to check it when it unexpectedly came loose and struck him in the chest, breaking four ribs.
An employee was drilling holes in a metal angle piece when the metal angle slipped and his glove became wrapped up in the drill bit, severing a finger.
An employee slipped on a piece of broken paver and fell forward into a stack of pavers while attempting to catch himself. His fingertip broke and had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was sheeting a roof on a single-story residence when the wind caught the sheeting. He then lost his balance and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, breaking his wrist and suffering a concussion.
An employee was using a shovel to remove sod when the shovel hit an underground powerline. The employee received an electrical shock.

An employee was walking through the shop area when he stepped out from between large molds in front of a forklift. The forklift then ran over his feet, breaking toes on and lacerating both feet. He had surgery.
An employee was standing in an area waiting for a crane to put an H-beam in place when the H-beam struck and broke the employee's right leg.
An employee was picking up a box of raw chicken weighing approximately 40 pounds when she felt a pop in her back. She suffered bulging back discs and a torn ligament, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were viewing part of a conveyor line that had malfunctioned earlier. One employee gestured toward the conveyor system with his left hand. While stepping toward the system, he lost his balance. He attempted to steady himself on the conveyor frame, but his left hand slipped too far into the conveyor. The tabletop caught his gloved hand and pulled it into the transfer conveyor, partially amputating his left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was standing on a chair attempting to open a deli side door when the chair tipped over. She fell and broke her left leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a batter mixer pump when the employee's hand slipped into the machine's operating grinder, amputating the middle finger above the middle knuckle and the ring finger at the bottom of the fingernail.

On October 26, 2017, at approximately 5:20 p.m., two employees were riding an RTV on the road. While turning left, the RTV was struck by a car. The injured employee was thrown from the passenger seat and struck his head on the ground, suffering a head injury and arterial bleeding in the brain. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On October 26, 2017, at approximately 6:00 PM, an employee was operating a sit-down rider forklift truck. While traveling in reverse, he placed his right hand on the support beam of the forklift's overhead guard. His right pinky finger was then caught and crushed between this support beam and the metal counterweight or bumper of a large wheel loader. His right little pinky finger was amputated, and he was hospitalized.

An employee was using a crescent wrench to release a concrete riser from a mold when his fingers became pinched between the concrete riser and mold when the concrete riser released. His middle finger was degloved, and his ring fingertip was crushed.
While changing out tooling at a press welder, an employee hit the pedal that activated the machine, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation.
On October 26, 2017, at about 7:30 a.m., an employee was bent on the ground popping a chalk line when a scissor lift struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was painting a wall on a step ladder, lost his balance and fell several feet resulting in a fractured right heel and left ankle.
An employee was removing the barrel from a fire hydrant. As he removed the barrel, a pinch point was created. His left ring finger was caught in the pinch point, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was participating in a training exercise when he became ill, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.

An employee was resealing a control valve on a loader. He tipped the loader bucket and secured it into the ground, so he could access the valve. He then relieved the hydraulic pressure from the lines, but one of the lines still had pressure in it. The line blew fluid and released the loader arms, which came down and trapped the employee between the arms and the bucket linkage, fracturing his ribs.

An employee was cutting a steel coil using a 5-foot long torch. When he got to the last section of the cut, the coil broke open and struck his left side (elbow and torso). He suffered bruising and a potential internal injury.

An employee was inside a robotic area attempting to retrieve a bag that had fallen off a pallet when he tripped a sensor that triggered a conveyor to start. He rode the conveyor line, but when that conveyor ended and another began, his right foot was caught between the two belts. He suffered cuts to his knee and a laceration to his finger when he pulled his foot out of the conveyor.
An employee was standing on top of a rig taking pictures of the trailer when the employee stepped backward and fell into a gap between two grid plates, breaking the left leg.

On 10/26/2017, an employee was driving a walk/ride truck to load ice cream onto a trailer. The employee was traveling north toward a freezer doorway while a second employee operating a standup forklift was traveling westbound to the freezer. The trucks collided at an intersection, causing the first employee to fall to the floor. The employee suffered a fractured right femur and dislocated right ankle, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was checking out a customer at the front of the store when a vehicle drove into the store and hit the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering an A-frame from the back of a truck when he lost his grip on the A-frame and fell from the truck to the parking lot, breaking ribs and injuring his spleen and lungs.
On October 26, 2017, an employee was moving metal stock into a beveller machine when the employee's left middle finger was pinched and crushed between the metal stock and the machine guard.
An employee was operating a cold former and placed his hand between the wire and drum. His second, third, and forth fingertips on his right hand were amputated.
An employee was mopping the floor and lost her footing. She fell to the floor, fracturing her right upper arm and left hand.
An employee fell down stairs while at work.

An employee was attempting to lift and level a jammed loading dock leveling plate when his right index finger was caught between two sections of the dock plate and crushed at the hinged seam, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was removing a finished load of washed laundry from a side-loaded industrial washing machine when the drum spun, catching the employee's shirt sleeve and dislocating the employee's left elbow.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a header machine when his left-hand fingers entered a hole in the machine. The machine arm then fell on his left-hand fingers, amputating the index finger.

An employee climbed a ladder to put foam on a window. He was stepping onto a 2" x 4" that was on the edge of the window when the board slipped and he fell 20 feet to the ground. He broke seven ribs and possibly an arm.

An employee was repairing a hydraulic cylinder on a forklift when his foot engaged the tilt for the forklift mast. He was then crushed between the forklift cage and the mast, suffering multiple rib fractures and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt when his right forearm became caught and fractured in the conveyor.
An employee was slicing beef ribs with a band saw when his right thumb was caught and amputated in the saw.

An employee was on a forklift chiseling built-up material from the dust collector ducts when a bolt on the brackets holding the duct work broke. The metal duct hood fell and lacerated the employee's right leg.

Employees were testing a pipe fitting machine they had just installed when a pipe began to fall. The injured employee was trying to catch the pipe when it amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee was mounting a car tire to a rim when his right index finger was caught between the tire, the rim, and a duck face component while the tire was rotating. His right index fingertip was removed leaving the bone exposed.
An employee was prepping food and sharpening a knife when the knife slipped from his hand and cut the top of his right middle finger, amputating it.
An employee was caught between a roll-up truck and a trash container, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee was walking in an aisleway that was being stocked by an outside vendor when the vendor bumped and knocked the employee to the ground. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping down from a 6-ft. ladder and missed the last step, tearing tendons in both knees.

An employee was in the rear of the dairy truck unloading product when he fell backwards out of the side door to the ground below. The employee sustained broken ribs and a hairline fracture of the skull.
An employee fell 12 to 15 feet from a ladder to the ground below and hit his head on a drain pipe. The employee lost consciousness and had a cracked rib.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum strut into smaller pieces using a chop saw. A piece got stuck in the saw and the employee's left pinky finger was amputated.

An employee was blending a seasoning product when some of the product became blocked. He opened the blender lid and used a tool to loosen the product. The tool pushed unexpectedly to the bottom of the blender, and his right pinky fingertip was caught between the handle of the tool and the vane of the blender. His right pinky finger was smashed.

On October 27, 2017, at approximately 2:45 p.m., an employee was adjusting the forks of a lift. While holding onto the side of the forklift assembly, he boomed up and kicked the fork over with his foot. As the fork moved, it dropped into place, along with the bar that supports the forks. The employee's gloved finger was then pinched between the fork and fork assembly, amputating his right middle fingertip.
An employee was checking on a pipe in the bathroom and the pipe broke, causing hot water to come out and burn his arms and chest.
While operating a brake press, an employee's right hand was caught in the press and three fingers were amputated.
An employee was performing a change-over function on a machine when his index finger made contact with the machine, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee stepped off of a two-step ladder onto a box and fell breaking her left hip.
An employee was caught in the overflow and sustained a broken left arm.

An employee was positioned between a skidder and a forklift when the skidder backed up and pinned the employee between the two pieces of equipment. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, a punctured lung, a ruptured spleen, and a liver laceration.
An employee was working with a hammer to remove wall ties when a drill was dropped from the next level up, striking him on his hard hat and causing neck and shoulder injuries.

An employee was manually lowering a lift gate on a 5th wheel trailer. Other members of the team removed a camera arm from the trailer. The injured employee then bent down to remove wheel chocks and the camera arm struck him on the head resulting in a compression injury to the upper neck (C2-C5).
While changing a split-rim tire on a grader, the rim blew up and an employee sustained arm and chest injuries.
An employee was working from a scaffold and fell approximately three feet, sustaining a head injury that required surgery.
An employee was descending a railcar and fell approximately 12 feet. His PFAS was not anchored at the time. The employee was hospitalized for head trauma.
An employee had been running a concrete meter box machine. His right forearm was broken when a metal press fell on it.
While walking, an employee side-stepped and fell, breaking his leg.

An employee walked around a mobile crane and was inspecting it when a crane operator climbed into the crane cab. While entering the cab, the operator grabbed the steering wheel, causing the crane's wheels to swivel. The employee inspecting the crane was pinched between the swiveling wheel and a crane outrigger, suffering seven broken ribs, a broken pelvis, and a broken wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a soil boring tool and lifting it out of a 36-inch deep trench. As he was preparing to place the tool on the ground, he lost his grip on it. The tool dropped to the ground, and his left middle finger was caught between the falling tool and the concrete sidewalk, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was feeding a military dog. The employee approached the kennel, placed the pan on the floor, and unlatched the gate to allow the military dog to come out to eat. Before the employee could get the gate closed, the military dog bypassed the gate and bit the employee on the left side of the abdomen, right wrist, palm, and pinky finger, causing pressure bites, punctures, and multiple lacerations.
An employee reached into a recycling machine to clear a jam and suffered lacerations and fractures to two fingers and the thumb of the right hand. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was operating a pile driver. While connecting a vibrator to the pile, the pile was hit by the vibrator, causing the pile to fall into the cab of the pile driver, hitting the employee. The employee sustained a fractured left leg and three cracked ribs.
While using a utility blade to cut thin plastic film that had collected near the vacuum tube, an employee amputated their left middle fingertip.
An employee was driving an electric maintenance cart. While making a left turn, her leg hit a bollard, breaking it.
An employee was removing a terminal strip on a motor control center and was injured by an electrical flash. The employee suffered burns to the face, ears and hands.
While servicing a machine, an employee's finger became entangled and the tips of two fingers were amputated.

On October 28, 2017, an employee was walking to a forklift when he tripped over the safety bumper, which is on the floor of the facility as a safety measure to separate forklift traffic from the pedestrian walkway. The employee fell to the floor and injured his right knee and left elbow.
A temporary employee was injured when his foot was caught between a riding pallet jack with long forks and a guard.

An employee attempted to steady a drum of vinegar that was being transported by forklift. The drum moved and crushed her fingertip between the drum and a fork of the forklift. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on a scaffold connecting ductile iron pipe in a water treatment plant. The employee had to remove a side rail from the scaffold to gain access to the pipe. The employee lost his balance and fell approximately 15 feet onto pipes that were below. The employee sustained injury to their L1, L2, and L3 discs, which had to be fused.
On October 28, 2017, an employee's left hand was caught in an ironworker machine, resulting in the partial amputation of the employee's middle and ring fingers.
An employee fell into an open-top treatment tank containing caustic liquid waste and sustained chemical burns on his whole body.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a broom that was dislodged inside a dump pit when a coworker started the belt for the bucket elevator. The belt caught and broke his left leg and foot.
An employee was cleaning the floor when the floor cleaning machine hit a sticky spot on the floor and jerked backwards knocking the employee down. The employee hit their head and was hospitalized.

On October 28, 2017 at 12:40 p.m., an employee was operating a powered pallet jack; the employee hit a patch of water, the pallet jack slid and pinned the employee's foot in between the pallet jack and the wall, breaking the right ankle.
An employee was changing the heads of tongs. The rig operator lost control of the power swivel and it struck the employee's leg, breaking it.

On October 28, 2017, an employee was standing on a scaffold spray painting, when he leaned over the scaffold's top rail, lost his balance, and fell approximately 8 feet to the concrete floor. He suffered a skull fracture, broken collarbone, broken elbow, broken ribs, punctured lung, and broken ear drum.
An employee was pulling a cable for a tower operation when his right little finger was caught and amputated between the cable and a handrail.

An employee was painting soffits from a 4-foot height when he lost his balance and attempted to correct his body position. He then fell into a yard hole that was covered over with leaves, breaking his tibia.

A maintenance employee was repairing a conveyor belt sheave on an offal pump. His right hand middle finger was caught when removing the belt resulting in amputation. The machine was locked out/tagged out at the time.

A rig crew was tripping rod out of a hole. When the operations were complete, the derrick man removed the screw from the clevis that supports the safety transfer to clean it. The safety transfer then slipped from his hand and hit an employee that was standing on the rig floor on the head. The employee suffered a laceration and possible concussion.
An employee was checking voltage after restoring electrical power to a customer when an arc flash occurred causing second degree burns to the hands. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was on the raised dock taking out the trash when they slipped off the dock and contacted the ground. The employee bruised the side of their face and fractured their nose.

On October 29, 2017, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was delivering propane to a customer's home address. The employee was checking to be sure the furnace was on and the pilot was lit. When he went to light the pilot, the furnace exploded, causing burns to the employee's face and hands.
An employee fell into a floor opening filled with hot water and suffered burns to the right hand and both lower legs.

An employee was getting ready to load a truck. He was behind the winch truck, pulling on the chain that goes to the winch, when the driver in the truck pulled the lever that moves the chain that goes to the winch. The chain and the tail roll of the trailer trapped the employee's finger causing a partial amputation of the right ring fingertip.

Three employees were hospitalized for various injuries after being assaulted by a former employee. The former employee assaulted one employee with a hammer and beat another employee. The third injured employee was shot in the arm when he discovered the crime.
An employee was bitten on the right hand by a spider that was inside their glove. The employee was hospitalized due to infection.
An employee's finger was caught between the chain and sprocket of the decoiler machine, resulting in the amputation of the first digit of the left index finger.

An employee was travelling in a stand-up forklift when he came into contact with another parked forklift that no one was operating. His foot was outside the operator compartment at the time and was crushed, requiring surgical amputation.

An employee was adjusting a corrugation machine's stacking section when he used a box-end wrench to loosen the bolts that hold the internal plate down. The machine then cycled, pinching his finger between the bracket (movable part) and frame (fixed part). He suffered a trans-phalangeal amputation of the right index finger. The machine was in auto mode at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a slick line truck to pull production tools out of an existing well. He was in the cab and the truck was stationary, when one of the slick line cables snapped under tension. The cable shot back into the cab of the truck and lacerated an artery in the employee's neck.
An employee tripped and fell onto a metal A/C duct causing a serious laceration to the right forearm between the wrist and elbow that resulted in surgery.
An employee was in the process of washing the floor when he was splashed on the legs by floor stripper which resulted in chemical burns and possible nerve damage.

An employee was standing between pallet stacks of product, checking the product on the pallets. A rider pallet jack struck one of the stacks which then struck and fractured the lower right leg/ankle of the injured employee.
An employee's finger was in a pinch point while a van was being lowered onto a jig. The employee sustained the amputation of his left index fingertip.
An employee operating a powered industrial truck sustained foot and ankle injuries in a collision with the concrete wall.

An employee was loading a billet onto a roller that feeds an extruder when the billet became jammed. He was trying to unjam the billet when his right index finger was pinched by two billets. His finger had to be amputated.

An employee was standing on the back of a pickup truck when an unknown person jumped in the vehicle and drove off. The employee was ejected from the pickup truck and sustained severe head injuries after hitting the concrete road.
At 6:00 PM, an employee was doing his normal set-up duties. To check for sand, he reached into the top of the magazine and the clamp came down on his finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning a magnet while it was inside a metal dumpster. The magnet became attached to the side of the dumpster and caught the employees thumb resulting in a soft tissue amputation to the tip of the left thumb.

On October 30, 2017 at approximately 6:10 a.m., a temporary employee sustained crushing injuries to the third and fourth fingers of his left hand when the powered industrial truck he was operating tipped over and his hand was caught between the cage of the vehicle and the floor.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and suffered a broken ankle which required surgery.
An employee was traversing on deck when the dredging boat was involved in an accident. The employee suffered a broken nose.
An employee was up on a ladder working on an elevated fuel tank. The ladder tipped over and the employee fell to the ground and sustained three broken ribs.
An employee operating a table saw hit his elbow on a finished part and his fingers went into the saw blade, resulting in the amputation of the left pointer fingertip.

An employee was responding to a machine which was not functioning. The employee pulled the drive belt to move the mechanism and the equipment started, pinching and amputating the employee's right thumb between the belt and pulley.

An employee was removing the crane hoisting straps from an installed wooden beam when he fell approximately 20 ft. from a mobile scaffold to the ground. The employee sustained trauma to the face and right leg.

An employee was removing loose shingles and debris from the corner of a roof when debris shifted underneath him causing him to fall 30 feet to the ground. He was admitted to the hospital with a broken left forearm.
An employee was cleaning the scrap return machine blades. The mechanism cycled and the blade amputated the middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting wood on the table saw and made contact with the saw blade, resulting in an amputation to his right ring and middle finger. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was out on a playground with students when one ran into her and knocked her down. She broke her right arm and required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was disconnecting old wiring in an attic when the employee stepped onto a false board meant for drywall support and fell 12 feet through the ceiling to the floor, suffering a back injury.
An employee fell at work and fractured her hip.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing the right femur and requiring hospitalization.

An employee got a bucket of hot water to clean the floor when the hot water contacted his hand (no injury). He then dropped the bucket, and the water splashed onto the back side of the injured employee, who suffered a second degree burn and was hospitalized.

An employee was working in the parking area of the yard when a truck came out of gear and started rolling. The employee was pinned between the rolling truck and a stationary truck, suffering internal injuries that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating an overhead crane when he lost his footing, fell, and fractured multiple ribs.
An employee was putting stickers on a window and fell approximately six feet from an A-Frame ladder resulting in a fractured right femur and a laceration on the right arm.

On October 30, 2017, an employee was carrying/placing some boxes near a dock door when a forklift operator reversed out of a semi-trailer and drove over the employee's left foot, crushing and fracturing the employee's left foot/big toe.
An employee was using a router to groove the end of a piece of flooring when the router cut and amputated his right pinky finger. The router was guarded at the time.
An employee parked his tractor trailer and was exiting it when he lost his footing and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his hip.
An employee was moving cattle to load and/or unload a trailer when the trailer gate struck the employee's face. The employee suffered a broken jaw and was hospitalized.

An employee was coming down from the flatbed of a truck when he lost his balance and fell from the bottom step of the flatbed. He fell approximately 2 ft. and hit his head on the ground, sustaining injuries to the head.
An employee was unloading material from a semi-truck when the truck rolled back and pinned him. He suffered a collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting metal pipe with a portable saw. The saw kicked back and the handle struck the employee on the lower lip and chin.

A crew was removing trees from a drainage swale using chainsaws and a small excavator. The excavator was moving a tree limb when one end of the limb became stuck in the ground. As the excavator advanced, the limb bent until it suddenly released, springing forward and striking two employees. One of the employees was struck in the leg, requiring hospitalization and possible surgery.

An employee operating a powered industrial vehicle stopped and leaned out of the operating compartment to scan a product with a scan gun. Her left hand made contact with the truck's operating controls which caused it to move. She sustained a partial amputation to her left finger.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by the internal auger of a chocolate tempering unit.
An employee was adjusting Teflon and the machine shut down, amputating a fingertip.

On October 31, 2017, an employee loaded a car onto a trailer, stepped out of the car, and was walking toward the trailer's ladder when the employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, fracturing a wrist and rib.

An employee was cleaning out the drum inside a cement truck's collection hopper when his hand was caught by the blade inside the drum. He suffered hand and finger injuries. The hopper was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee stepped off the back of a waste collection truck to collect refuse when an SUV ran over the bridge of his right foot, breaking two bones. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack when his left ankle was caught between the pallet jack and the wall. His left ankle or foot broke, requiring hospitalization.

Employees were erecting a large tent. The first column bent was put in place using a forklift. Once the column bent was released from the forklift, the column bent fell and struck the injured employee who was on all fours resulting in non-displaced fractured lower vertebrae, broken ribs and head injuries.

An employee was nailing shingles on a roof using a nail gun when the nail gun hose became caught. When the employee went to nail the shingle, the nail gun pulled back and the nail shot into his right knee.

An employee was using a pallet jack to transport a pallet of food when he collided with another pallet jack operator. His right ankle was pinned and fractured between a rack and the pallet jack, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking in the lower level of a building while other employees were removing a section of temporary office wall. Wall debris fell and struck the employee, who suffered fractures to the upper and lower left leg.
An employee fell down 12 to 15 stairs while walking, hitting the floor and suffering head trauma.

An employee was loading cargo flat racks onto a barge when his fingers entered the 1-inch gap between the racks and a spreader bar. The flat rack came to rest on the barge, and the spreader bar continued downward and crushed his pointer and middle fingers. His fingers were later medically amputated.
An employee was operating a garbage truck when his hand was crushed in the truck blade, breaking a finger.

An employee was palletizing bags of salt. He was attempting to move a bag that was stuck on a conveyor belt when his right forearm was caught and crushed between two rotating pieces of equipment on the belt. He suffered skin damage that required surgery.

An employee was repairing a scale on a forklift. He then lifted the scale with another forklift and was removing its brackets when the scale fell and pinned his finger between it and the floor. His finger was partially amputated.
An employee became caught/entangled in rigging equipment during crane lift operations. The employee was hoisted approximately 40 feet before falling and breaking his tibia.
An employee was removing a guardrail post. His hand was on a 16-inch bolt when a piece of equipment began to remove it. The bolt bent on his index finger, which had to be amputated to the knuckle.

An employee was operating a heavy-duty tractor truck on the upper ramp of a vessel deck. When the truck was halfway up the ramp, it started to roll down the ramp and went in the air on its rear tires before coming down. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture and dislocated hip.

An employee was standing on an outrigger. He was accessing the super structure of the outrigger when he fell approximately 9 feet to the ground, fracturing his right shoulder and detaching a shoulder muscle.

An employee was loading a parked trailer using a forklift when the trailer began to drive off. The forklift with the employee rolled off the trailer and landed on its back side. He suffered spinal injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to assemble telescoping boom sections. Another employee was using a forklift to push the sections of the boom together. During this operation, the injured employee's right hand was inside the boom section to lift up and dislodge the chain, which had become caught on the outer boom. The employee's right middle finger was then caught between the gear and the chain, resulting in an amputation.

An employee climbed a mounted ladder on a semi-trailer to fill the generator on top of the trailer. He was trying to pull a fitting loose when he lost his balance and fell off of the ladder (height of 6 feet) to the ground, suffering fractured ribs and a concussion.

An employee was threading banding over the top of a coil and passing it between the coil and coil car when the turnstile moved. The employee's hand was then caught between the coil car and coil, smashing the hand and wrist and fracturing a finger.

An employee was attempting to pull paper from a clicker press when another employee energized the machine. The employee's right middle and ring fingertips were then caught in the press. Both fingertips were amputated.

A team was dismantling a machine for refurbishing in a specific order: extruder, core barrel, base plate, and carriage. The injured employee was holding the carriage as it was being lifted when the whole assembly rolled forward. The employee's right index finger was then caught and amputated between the extruder deck and extruder base.
An employee was working on a building roof when he fell through a weak area of the roof and hit the ground, injuring his tailbone. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

On October 31, 2017, an employee was attempting to clear corn stalks from a combine because the retrofitted blower was not working correctly. The employee's right hand was inside the combine when the still-rotating chopper blades amputated it.
An employee was standing on an extension ladder power-washing a water tank when he fell and fractured his tailbone.
Two employees were removing ball valves. When the employees began to install the gaskets, a flash fire occurred. One employee suffered burns to the face.

An employee was removing plastic trays from the back bed area of a field truck when the truck driver moved the vehicle forward. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground on his back, fracturing a vertebra.

An employee was moving steel reinforcing rods and associated supports with a skid steer when one of the employee's right-hand fingers was caught and crushed between a steel rod and the skid steer's grapple arm.
An employee was training at a computer when she stood up, turned, and tripped over her feet. She then fell to the ground, breaking her right femur.

On 10/31/2017, an employee was installing a new belt on an industrial washer. The employee had energized the industrial washer to adjust the belt's tightness and alignment when his right hand was caught in the ingoing nip point of the belt and pulley, injuring his hand and amputating four fingers.

An employee was moving a mortality from a farm using a tractor. The employee pulled in toward the pad and backed up the tractor. The tractor bucket became caught on the gate. The employee exited the tractor and was attempting to disengage the bucket when the tractor rolled forward and pinned the employee's right leg between the bucket and gate. The employee's right lower leg broke. The tractor was not shut down and the brakes were not set at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking over a conveyor track for cars when his left foot slipped and went into the track crushing his foot and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing a heater band when he received an electrical shock and burns to his arm.

An employee was trying to remove a pecan that was under a conveyor belt leading to a soak machine when his left middle finger was caught underneath the conveyor belt's chain, partially amputating his fingertip.
An employee's thumb was caught in an indexing chain, amputating the tip.
An employee was ripping a piece of synthetic board on a table saw when his left hand contacted the circular saw blade, amputating his pinky and ring fingertips.

An employee was in a tree trimming a branch with a hand saw when he leaned on another branch that broke, allowing him to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground. He injured his back and lungs. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

Employees were laying rebar when a gust of wind rolled an unsecured vapor barrier around three of the employees, causing them to fall to the ground. One of the employee's suffered a skull fracture and required hospitalization.
An employee was drilling a piece of metal when a part became stuck. When it came loose, it pulled the employee's glove and arm into the drill press. The employee suffered a broken arm.

An employee was operating a plastics extrusion machine when a pressure buildup due to temperature differences in the plastic material caused a release of liquid plastic. The liquid plastic contacted the employee between a seam in the employee's PPE glove and protective garment (sleeve), burning the left forearm and hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using shears to strip wires when the shear slipped and stabbed his left index finger.

On November 01, 2017, at approximately 3:45 p.m., an employee was helping to unload materials at a receiving dock. The employee was next to a pallet of columns measuring approximately 10 feet long and approximately 6 feet high. A forklift operator was on the opposite side of the columns and manipulating them when the pallet and columns tipped over, causing the employee to fall between the trailer and a guard system. He hit the concrete approximately 4 feet below, fracturing his neck and back.
An employee was picking orders using a standup counterbalance electric forklift when she made a sharp right turn and hit a pallet rack, fracturing her pelvis.
On November 1, 2017, an employee was admitted to the hospital due to a reaction to a flu shot.
An employee slipped on a toy that had wheels and fell on her right knee fracturing it.
An employee fell from a ladder while installing insulation, fracturing a thumb and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee scraped his right wrist on a cylinder head while working on a vehicle. The scrape became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was closing the lift gate of a delivery truck when the employee's finger was caught between the lift gate and the truck bumper, amputating the fingertip.
A crew of employees were tarping a haystack. A gust of wind caught and lifted the tarp and an employee, causing him to fall to the concrete ground and hit his head.

An employee was either riding an automated crane and fell off or was just trying to get away from an automated crane when the employee was pinched between the automated crane and square metal tubing on which retrievals were sitting. The employee suffered a fractured rib and required hospitalization.
An employee was stepping off a tractor, missed the last step and fell onto their hip breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing parts from a fixture and shelving and fell from a four-foot ladder resulting in a right femur fracture and a fractured left wrist.

An employee was walking in an assembly building. 
A steel cover plate covering a one-foot channel, which runs the length of the building, was raised about two millimeters above the floor surface. The employee's foot became caught on the steel plate, causing the employee to fall on the left arm and shoulder. The employee suffered a fractured left humerus.
An employee was putting together some equipment for startup when the employee's right index finger was pinched between a plate and a heat exchanger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was attempting to remove frozen meat from a meat grinder's frame when the grinder/extruder partially amputated his index finger. The meat grinder was unguarded and running at the time.

An employee was adjusting the rollers of a bar straightener and feeding a short bar through the machine when the employee attempted to grab material that was becoming deformed. The employee's left hand was caught in the machine, amputating the index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was walking across a dock in the cold storage area when a reach truck contacted his left foot, resulting in a partial amputation of his big toe.

The injured employee was manually pushing a sheeter machine with another employee and pinched a finger between the sheeter machine and a heat tunnel machine during a turn resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip with nail bed repair.

An employee was operating a 4-wheeler while moving cattle in the feedlot. The 4-wheelers have governors installed that limit speed to a maximum of 15 mph. Another employee on a 4-wheeler came upon the injured employee, who was sitting on his 4-wheeler, seemingly dazed. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture and bleeding in the brain.

An employee was driving an unloaded stand-up forklift down a ramp from the upper section to the lower section of a warehouse when the employee lost control of the forklift and hit the safety railing. The safety railing entered the cab area and hit the employee in the pelvis, fracturing it.
A battery slid and crushed an employee's fingertip resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee tripped while descending a flight of stairs, breaking an ankle.

An employee was operating a small plate roller when the employee's left hand became caught between the top of the plate and the bottom of the top roller, crushing the thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was filing documents when she tripped over a step stool and fell on her side, suffering multiple pelvic fractures. She was hospitalized.

An employee had placed a gas-operated carpet cleaning machine in the garage of a vacant home, left the door between the garage and the living area open, and proceeded to clean the carpet. The employee was then exposed to carbon monoxide fumes.
An employee was clearing a jam on a grinder hopper when a rotating component inside the hopper amputated the employee's middle finger. The hopper was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was repairing a truck when a driveshaft fell and struck the employee's head.

On November 1, 2017, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was helping to move a 30-gallon drum from a broken pallet to another pallet. His gloved hand was underneath the drum as he was transferring it. When it rolled onto the new pallet, his finger was pinched between the bottom of the drum and the pallet. His right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was carrying a sheet of drywall when he knocked over a bucket of drywall compound, causing the contents to spill onto the floor. He then fell and struck the floor, fracturing his knee.

An employee was walking alongside a trencher clearing rocks while installing a new sprinkler system. The trench gave way underneath the employee, causing his foot to slip into the trench. His foot was then caught by the trencher's rotating blade, and he suffered a broken right femur.
On November 1, 2017, an employee was setting up a machine when his index finger became stuck under a safeguard. When he tried to pull it free, his fingertip was severed.

While working in the factory/warehouse, an employee observed a trash truck that was dropping off a 20- to 30-yard roll-off dumpster. He noticed some pallets in the area that he thought needed to be moved and yelled at the driver to stop. The driver stopped, but only to release the chain to free the dumpster so it could be positioned. The driver did not hear the employee and proceeded to make the drop. The employee attempted to get up from the area but was struck by the dumpster. He was caught between the dumpster and the loading dock, fracturing his right tibia.
An employee was positioning drill rods on a high, flat trailer when he lost his footing and fell to a lower level, breaking his arm and wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a tool set on a punch press when it cycled and caught his left index finger.

An employee was tensioning a cable between two posts when the tensioner released and the cable struck the employee's left ring finger, removing skin. The distal phalanx had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was using a hand tool to dig beneath an underground electrical duct bank and expose a water main when the duct bank collapsed. The hand tool then contacted a live electrical line, resulting in an arc blast/arc flash. The employee suffered burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was soldering a pipe using gas when the gas tank exploded. The employee suffered burns and was hospitalized.
Two steel beams were being set into place on dunnage. An employee was placing pads under the bearing points when a beam struck the employee's left wrist, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting gates and risers off brass castings. The employee was operating a metal cutting saw when the blade separated and hit the employee's face shield. The impact caused the employee's safety glasses to hit and lacerate the employee above and below the eye on the right side of the face.
An employee was struck by a trailer that was backing up to a dock door, breaking his femur.
An employee was dismantling the scaffold, slipped on the stair tread and broke an ankle.
An employee was on a ladder working on a gutter when the gutter hit him in the head. He then jumped off the ladder to the ground, breaking his heel.
An employee was on a forklift, loading bricks into a hot furnace, when he was splashed with hot molten metal, suffering third degree burns to his arms.

An employee was un-hooking a speaker motor box on a stage when the employee stood up, wobbled, and then fell approximately 5 feet off the stage to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured skull, broken collarbone, and eight broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.

On November 2, 2017, at approximately 9:50 p.m., an employee was entering an airplane tail section while inspecting a depot. While climbing through the aircraft and stepping over ductwork, he pulled his upper groin, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck on the chest and face by a concrete pump truck hose when the pump operator started the pump.

An employee was picking products in the warehouse while operating a stand-up tugger. While driving forward and turning into a main aisle, the employee was thrown from the tugger, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was pressure testing a fire pump. As the pump was pressurized, a fitting blew off and struck him on the head.

An employee was replacing the conveyor belt on a press and was attempting to line up the belt while another employee ran the conveyor on manual mode. The running belt then sliced his left ring finger, partially amputating it to the first knuckle.
An employee was sweeping grain inside a bin when the employee stepped or slipped into an auger, suffering a left foot amputation.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of veneer that was plugging a drier infeed when the employee's glove and right hand were pulled into the chain and sprocket, amputating the ring fingertip.

An employee was operating a mechanical power press. The press cycled while the employee was unloading a stamped part from the point of operation, causing an amputation to finger(s) on the employee's left hand.

Two employees placed an electric pallet jack onto the back of a delivery truck. One employee got into the back of the truck and was operating the electric pallet jack; the injured employee was standing outside of the truck. The electric pallet jack was locked in place, and the employee in the back of the truck was moving materials around manually. The electric pallet jack started rolling toward the back end of the truck. The injured employee went to grab it to prevent it from falling out of the truck. The injured employee's right pinky finger was then caught between the rolling electric pallet jack and the side of the truck. He suffered a right pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was assembling a log splitter. He was putting on a sling choker for a log splitter beam when another beam rolled forward and severely cut and crushed his right finger between the two beams. The last digit of his right finger was amputated.
An employee was closing the door of an aircraft when it closed on his right pinky finger, amputating it just past the last knuckle.

An employee was working from an aerial lift basket installing conduit tabs on structural steel when the employee was caught between a structural steel beam and the control panel of the lift. The employee suffered facial fractures and was hospitalized.

On 11/2/17, an employee was driving a stringing truck that was carrying two joints of pipe when the truck struck a guardrail, causing the truck to rollover.  The operator was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae, a fractured nose and a fractured occipital bone.
An employee was using a cutting wheel to cut grate when it kicked back and sliced the employee's right knee open. The employee needed surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling HVAC filters and was bitten on the right forearm by a spider or bug causing an allergic reaction.
While towing equipment, an employee was crushed between a tug and GPU equipment, suffering a fractured leg.

An employee loaded a ladder into the back of a truck. Other equipment was preventing the ladder from laying flat in the bed of the truck. 
He entered the bed of the truck, rearranged the items, and positioned the ladder to set down in the truck bed. When he went to exit the truck bed, he placed one foot between the ladder and the inside of the truck bed wall, while the other foot was on the bumper of the truck. The tailgate was closed at the time. When he attempted to take his foot out of the bed, his foot became caught, causing him to fall from the bumper and truck bed. He broke his right femur.
An employee stopped at a gas station to get gas. She fell and struck her head near the gas pumps, suffering head trauma.
An employee was assessing roof damage. She put a ladder on a slippery deck and was climbing the ladder when it kicked out. She then fell to the deck, breaking her pelvis.
An employee was cleaning a machine while a mechanic was adjusting the center shaft. The collar came down and pinned the employee's left index finger causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a burn machine when he noticed the guide that lines up the metal was still in the machine. He was attempting to remove it when the head of the machine caught his finger between the head and guide, amputating his left pinky fingertip.

An employee was on-site performing scheduled preventative maintenance tasks in the building. He was attempting to break a pipe union on an external rear blow-down line to check it for obstructions when scalding water spontaneously released from inside the boiler and exited the pipe cleanout port, which had its cap removed. He sustained first, second, and third degree burns on his legs, the right side of his torso, and his right arm.
An employee had been cleaning an area near a conveyor. His left foot was resting on the frame of the conveyor when his left leg was pulled into the frame by a pulley or shaft.
An employee was sweeping the warehouse floor when a reversing forklift struck his right leg, lacerating and contusing his shin.
An employee was unwrapping a wire rope from a spool when the wire rope slipped and pinched his left middle fingertip between the rope and spool. His fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell from a scissor lift while painting a ceiling and broke his hip.
An employee was picking up trash when he stumbled into an unguarded pumping unit and was struck by the horse head, suffering pelvic, sternum, and rib fractures.
An employee was inspecting a foundation when he tripped over the string line surrounding the foundation layout, fracturing his right leg and requiring hospitalization.

On 11/3/2017, an employee was responding to a call about a leaking pipe in the hot wash area of the harvest floor. He suspected a pump and a leaking 2" stainless pipe as being the cause of the leak. He took the pump apart to repair it, then reattached the pipe clamp to the pipe. Two other employees held the pipe in place for it to be reattached. Once the pipe was in place, one of the other employees went over to the panel and found that the water was still on; only the pump was turned off.  When the pump was turned on, the sanitary fitting broke and hot water with a temperature of approximately 170 degrees sprayed the employee s arms, legs, and stomach. He received first and second degree burns on his arms and legs.
On November 3, 2017, an employee was rip sawing a board when it kicked back and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was reaching over a surgical tray and punctured an artery in the right forearm on a scalpel.

An employee was in a manhole, getting ready to set a pipe. As the pipe was being lowered into the manhole, it slipped from its chain and struck the employee. The employee suffered a head concussion, broken hip, and broken elbow, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a material storage cabinet on wheels when the cabinet fell over and landed on the employee's leg, breaking the femur.

An employee was installing a ladder safety system onto the top of a ladder when the ladder davit fabrication slipped and hit his finger. His finger was caught in a pinch point between the davit fabrication and t-cage steel, amputating his fingertip and causing an open fracture to the finger (partway up the nail).

An employee was stepping over a 3-foot beam. He got one leg over when the foot on his second leg became hung up on a flange. He then fell approximately 3 feet onto scaffolding and fractured his right kneecap.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by a manual office paper cutter.

An employee was working on a truck turbo. The intake for the turbo was removed and a wire was sucked into the turbo. The employee tried to grab the wire and his fingers entered the turbo. His middle fingertip was amputated and his ring finger broke.

An employee was removing a steam fitting from a pipe when steam released and burned the employee. The employee sustained second degree burns to both hands and first degree burns to the right ear and abdomen, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading a 300-pound concrete bucket using a hand truck when the employee lost balance and fell backwards. The bucket then fell on the employee's stomach. The employee suffered head and internal organ injuries.

On November 3, 2017, an employee was cleaning up the dock area at the end of a shift. The employee entered a stand-up forklift, traveled in reverse, and struck another lift that was also being used in the cleanup operation. Upon striking the other lift, the employee's foot was outside the confines of the equipment and was pinned between the two lifts. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the foot.
