An employee was smoothing the edge of a 1/4-inch thick steel plate with a disc sander when the employee's left thumb was pulled between the disc and the work rest, resulting in an amputation of the left thumb tip.
An employee was prepping a mast to be moved to platforms when his left middle and ring fingers were caught between the chain/hook and mast, amputating his fingertips.

On November 3, 2017, an employee was working with another employee to unjam a wrapper machine. The first employee was pulling on the jammed film wrap while the other was operating the controls. The sealer bar lowered and amputated the first employee's left ring and index fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was looking at a hydraulic lift that was stuck when the lift fell and struck the employee, causing a back injury.
An employee was transporting a structural steel roll on a cart when it tipped over. The structural steel then rolled back and crushed his toes on the right foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a baggage scale with two other employees. The employee was trying to obtain a passenger's ID under the scale when the scale fell onto the employee's left hand, amputating the middle and index fingertips.
An employee was walking to the rear of a machine when he slipped in a puddle of water and powder coating mix. He sustained a spiral fracture of his left tibia.

An employee was feeding lumber into a reclaim saw when a block of wood became stuck on the table. He was attempting to remove the block of wood with his hand when the saw blade cut across the middle of his right palm, lacerating it from the thumb to the pinky. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On November 3, 2017, an employee was cleaning a shear when it cut and caused an amputation to the employee's right middle finger. The shear was energized at the time.
An employee's index finger was crushed by a draw press, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a power tool when the tool cut his leg.
An employee was preparing pound cake mix when the employee's left middle finger was pinched and lacerated between a mixing bowl and a table.

An employee was cleaning a burr off of rectangular metal with a wire brush machine when the employee's glove became caught in the machine. The employee's hand was then pulled into the machine, scraping skin off the bottom of the hand and the pinky and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was retrieving a 2-cell block from a pallet when his foot was caught in a loose strap attached to the pallet. He lost his balance and fell to the ground. The block then landed on his finger, pinning it between the block and the concrete, resulting in a partial amputation of his finger.
While walking, an employee stepped off a curb and broke both ankles.

An employee was standing on the ground near a pipe rack while other employees picked up a joint from a catwalk. The joint came off its cradle, rolling back onto the pipe rack and hitting the employee. He was pinned between two joints, suffering bleeding in his abdominal cavity.

An employee was pushing a cart loaded with 4 steel columns that had plates at the end. A plate on the ground hit and pushed another column inside the cart. The employee's left pinky finger was caught between the plate and the cart, crushing it and amputating his fingertip.

An employee was monitoring the loading of a railcar when he noticed a vent was leaking. He tried to close the secondary valve to isolate the leak. He put his safety harness on and pulled a probe up to close the valve and isolate the leak. When he pulled the probe up, he heard a pop. The vent hose blew off, spraying him with acetic acid. He suffered first and second degree burns to his lower legs and feet, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder removing an existing aerial wire when the employee fell 16 feet from the ladder to the ground, breaking an arm, foot, toe, ankle, and the left knee.

An employee was operating a forklift and dismounted from it to pick up trash when the forklift started to roll backwards. As the employee attempted to jump back onto the forklift to stop it from rolling, the forklift ran over the employee's foot.
An employee was removing a clip from a motorcycle when his screwdriver slipped and punctured his left eye, resulting in an eye injury requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a utility vehicle with a mower attachment when he ran into a tree, causing his arm to become entangled in the steering wheel. The steering wheel jerked and struck his right wrist, breaking it.

An employee was performing a self-rescue drill from a ski lift chair. While belaying down using rock climbing/mountaineering skills and equipment, the employee's equipment allowed him to rapidly slide down his rope over 15 to 30 feet to the bare ground under the chair. He suffered two fractured ribs, lumbar spine fractures (vertebrae 1-5), a mild concussion, and a blistered and rope-burned right hand.
An employee was mixing caustic chemicals and water when the chemicals splashed the employee's shoulder, causing chemical burns.
An employee was carrying a cake when she lost her balance, falling to her knees and hitting her head.
An employee was clearing a jammed coil on a roll-forming machine when the die came down and crushed his left hand. He was hospitalized, and his left hand was surgically amputated.
An employee was cleaning jammed bread from a bread slicer when it amputated a fingertip.
An employee was using a step stool to place an item on a shelf when she fell, landing on and fracturing her left hip.

Employees were rolling tape onto a concrete floor to divide locations. The injured employee was stretching tape while another employee secured the tape in place. The tape ran out and the injured employee lost her balance falling to the concrete floor and breaking the right forearm and wrist.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a carbon brush when the saw amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was up on a stairway opening valves on a wellhead when the stairs gave way. The employee suffered a broken left leg.
Prolonged sitting lead to a blood clot in an employee's right leg that moved into his lungs, causing a pulmonary embolism.
An employee was working near a boring machine when the employee's hand was caught between a rotating pipe and cable. The employee suffered four finger amputations and a broken arm.

An employee was trying to access the roof from a ladder when he fell off and hit the ground, breaking his ankle.  The ladder did not extend 3 feet above the access point and was not tied to any structure at the time.

An employee was helping a maintenance electrician work on street lighting. The maintenance electrician pulled the 75-amp breaker in the panel and a small piece of the breaker broke off, staying inside the panel. The electrician was trying to retrieve the broken piece when it fell into the panel, striking the bus bar and causing an arc flash. The employee was holding a flashlight next to the electrician when the arc flash occurred. He suffered burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a meat processing line making product when the employee's hand was caught in a machine, amputating the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a fiberglass winder when the employee's arm was pulled into the winder, breaking it.
An employee was walking toward a register when she took a step, tripped over her feet, and fell to the floor. She fractured her right hip.
An employee was moving equipment at a trade show. The equipment fell off the forklift and crushed the employee's foot. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture.

An employee was moving a metal container of defective, water-filled bottles (which were about 700 degrees Fahrenheit) when a flash fire occurred. This probably occurred because one of the hot bottles fell to the ground and made contact with machine oil residue. The employee suffered a second degree burn to his right cheek and left ear from the heat of the flash fire, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working near a letter sorting machine when another employee pushed a rolling rack into his back. He suffered a neck injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding material into a mill on a polypropylene plastic consumable line when the employee's gloved hand was caught between the rolls in the mill, resulting in the amputation of four fingers and the thumb.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by a pneumatic piston pump. The pump was not guarded or sitting properly on its barrel at the time of the incident.
An employee was working under the rig load of an overhead cab crane when the load/sling shifted, came off, and crushed the employee. The employee was hospitalized with chest and abdominal injuries.
On 11/4/2017, an employee was dismounting a bulldozer when the employee's right foot slipped. The employee then made hard contact with the ground, breaking the tibia and fibula above the right ankle.

An employee was working inside a power boiler (permit-required confined space) while arc gouging (cutting) a 30-foot long by 27-inch wide I-beam into 5-foot sections. He was standing on the I-beam he was cutting and another I-beam that was positioned 6 inches away. The I-beam he was gouging shifted after he finished cutting through it and moved toward the adjacent I-beam. As the I-beam shifted, it caught his right arm between the I-beams. He sustained third degree burns to his right forearm and hand from the I-beams, which were heated from the arc gouging process.
An employee was delivering medication and suffered an allergic reaction to a vial of Rocephin powder on the floor.
An employee was picking up a mud motor to trip in a hole when a plate fell off the top drive and struck the employee, causing a right index finger amputation.

An employee was elevating a scissor lift while inside the lift's basket when one side of the scissor lift's guardrail system became caught on the guardrail system of an adjacent stationary lift. The scissor lift the employee was in then toppled over and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs on  the left side of his body.
An employee was trying to remove a jam on a kiln line when the line cart moved and amputated the employee's index fingertip.

An employee was prepping the stockroom to receive a distribution center merchandise truck. He was walking past a U-Boat with freight when he bumped into the U-Boat with his right arm, which caused the boxes to fall. The employee then tripped over the boxes and fell, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was threading paper on to a paper roll due to a paper break. While performing the threading procedure, the employee's left arm became stuck between the paper roll and the front winder drum. The employee suffered a fractured left humerus with damage to the upper muscular tissue and elbow arteries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was webbing film in a bag machine and amputated the right middle finger.

An employee was cutting on a column and began to cut into a pipe with a torch. When the torch cut through the pipe, diesel (residual fuel) splashed back onto his body. He sustained burns to his right arm, left wrist, and the right side of his face, requiring hospitalization and surgery. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was working on top of jet bridge stairs near a lift used for transporting items (bags, strollers) to the ground. The lift malfunctioned and fell approximately 9 feet to just about 1 foot from the ground. The employee fell from the platform onto the lift and rolled onto the concrete, suffering a broken collarbone, broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a cracked vertebra.

Employees were performing pressure services, hydrostatic testing on a blowout preventer. When one of the employees attempted to loosen bolts on the wellhead spool, the hydraulic torque hammer wrench and wellhead spool struck the employee s left hand, partially amputating the index finger.

A backhoe operator was digging a hole with the assistance of a spotter. As the operator began to set down the bucket, the spotter slipped into the hole. The spotter's foot was then crushed by the backhoe bucket, breaking a toe.
An employee was descending an exterior stairway when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete flooring (landing) below. He fractured his right tibia and fibula.

An employee was calibrating a scale on a compounding tank (where chemicals are mixed) while standing on a three-step ladder. While loosening up a connection on top of the tank, the employee fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, fracturing the left wrist and hip.

An employee was performing mechanical work on a roll-off truck by replacing the rear end on the axle. He was guiding the rear end on a chain hoist  when the rear end slipped. His left hand was then caught between the chain and the rear end, lacerating his left ring and middle fingers. His left pinky finger was also amputated.
An employee was driving a forklift. The employee's foot/leg was outside of the compartment when his foot was caught on a trailer, injuring his foot and leg.
An employee was stepping down into an excavation when he fractured his tibia.

An employee was using a screwdriver to dislodge a cotton wad in the cotton feeder. A second employee came to see what was happening and to help. The first employee bumped the second employee, whose hand was then caught in the chain and sprocket of the running feeder. The second employee freed his hand and went to the office. During that time, the first employee's hand was also caught in the chain and sprocket. They both suffered lacerations and smashed fingers. The first employee's middle or ring finger was surgically amputated. The second employee's forefinger was surgically amputated.

An employee was cleaning a walkway with a compressed air hose when he tripped over the hose and fell to the ground. As the employee fell to the ground, his right hand landed on the belt of a conveyor system. His hand was then pulled into the area of the conveyor where the belt turns over the drum, and his right hand was caught between the belt, drum, and frame of the conveyor. He sustained a laceration and burns to his right hand and wrist.

An employee was welding when it became necessary to replace the electrode. He lost his grip on the electrode and it fell, puncturing his leg through his denim jeans. The puncture wound became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was assembling a mower deck when it shifted and sliced the employee's left thumb, amputating it.

An employee was using a cherry picker to retrieve an order from pallets that were approximately 20 feet high. A swing reach forklift struck the cherry picker causing it and the employee to fall to the ground. The employee was wearing a harness at the time. The employee was hospitalized for injuries requiring surgery.
An employee slipped on the floor in a kitchenette and suffered a knee injury.
An employee was trying to light a propane grill when the gas in the grill caused an explosion. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to the face/neck.
An employee was walking back toward her vehicle after delivering mail when she fell down, breaking her knee and tearing ligaments.

An employee was installing a termination on an underground electrical distribution cable when the cable became energized and the employee made contact. The employee suffered electrical burns to the hand and knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to lift a container full of hot liquid when she made contact with the liquid, suffering second degree burns on her face, neck, torso, chest, and stomach.
An employee was moving sodium hydroxide containers when the chemical spilled on the employee's foot, causing a chemical burn.
On November 6, 2017, an employee slipped and fell while walking. The employee dislocated the left wrist while trying to brace for the fall, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While operating a forklift in a warehouse, an employee's left ankle was struck by another employee driving a forklift. The employee suffered a broken foot/ankle.
An employee was approximately 6 feet up an 8-foot ladder when the employee lost footing and tried to grab a ceiling grid for support. The employee then fell, breaking a wrist.
An employee was walking when she slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip. She required hospitalization.
While working on a drill press, an employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered a back injury while picking orders and lifting a box, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing a 900-pound counterweight rigging to transfer it to a forklift when the counterweight fell to the ground during the transfer and landed on the employee's lower right leg. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the lower leg, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was backing a tugger into a battery charging station when his left index finger was caught and smashed between the tugger and the charging station.
An employee was using a CNC machine when a part flew out of the machine and struck the employee's body, causing internal bleeding.

An employee was working on a storm-damaged tree that was leaning on a shed and on a car. The tree shifted and the shed wall collapsed, causing a piece of the tree to hit the employee's leg. He suffered a broken right tibia and fibula and a right arm bruise.
An employee was trying to remove a bag that had become lodged on the underside of a bagger machine when the bag cutter blade severed his fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a bathroom when she turned around and fell to the ground, fracturing her left hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was directing a sow to an area when the sow charged and caught his finger between a panel and a crate. His right middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was taking samples of sulfuric acid when the sample bottles fell to the floor. The acid contacted the employee, causing chemical burns to the face, arms, legs, and chest.
An employee was carrying a 4X4 in an alleyway when he tripped and fell, breaking his right lower leg.

An employee was installing an electrical breaker in a breaker box. When the box was energized, an arc flash occurred, and the breaker blew out of the side of the breaker box. The employee suffered a hematoma to the left arm.
An employee was exiting a step deck trailer approximately 42 inches off the ground when the employee fell off the trailer to the ground, injuring the right knee.
An employee was moving a travel trailer in a parking lot when he tripped. Another employee who was operating a forklift then ran over and crushed his right foot.
An employee was setting up a die in a hydraulic press when the machine was actuated via the foot pedal. The press then amputated 1/2 inch of the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was cleaning/wiping the face of a machine guard when his rag was caught in the drive chain, which then pulled his third left-hand digit into the chain/sprocket, pinching the tip. His digit tip was surgically amputated.
An employee's right thumb was pinched and partially amputated between the jogger and pallet on a paperboard sheeting machine.

An employee was working from a 6-foot portable step ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. He suffered a dislocated finger, fractured vertebrae, and a fractured skull, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was lifting a toilet into the back of a rear-load trash truck when the top portion of his right ring finger was smashed between the toilet and the rear body of the truck, suffering severe tissue damage. The damaged portion of his finger had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was working in a kitchen prep area, using a mechanical slicer to cut tomatoes, when his right index finger was amputated by the slicer blade. The guard for the equipment was in place at the time.

An employee was checking a truck out of the site and gave the driver his manifest ticket. The employee turned around to go to a guard shack. The truck driver may have turned his wheels too tight and ended up striking the employee's legs with the truck's rear tires. The employee suffered soft tissue injuries.
An employee was rebuilding toilet tank parts and cleaning out the tank when it shattered. Pieces of the tank lacerated the employee's left wrist (main arteries and tendons).
An employee was backing a truck to a dock. The truck contacted a low hanging electrical wire and the employee was shocked.

An employee was loading a partial roll of film on a bagging machine when a bar fell from one end of the machine. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the bar and the roll of film.
An employee's prosthetic leg/foot became tangled in an inventory cart and then dislodged, causing the employee to fall and fracture the right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking by a swag station to talk to another worker when her right thumb was caught on a small vent line clamp, causing an amputation to her thumb.
An employee was adjusting a press using a hammer when the hammer struck the employee's hand. The employee's injury became infected, requiring overnight hospitalization.

On November 7, 2017, an employee was using a chop/miter saw to cut a section of roll material when the saw kicked back and caused his left thumb to contact the blade. He suffered a deep cut to his thumb and was hospitalized.

An employee went outside the store to break up a fight in which two assailants were attacking a customer and to inform them he had called the police. The assailants then got in their car and tried running over the employee. He sustained a left wrist fracture and left hip socket damage.
An employee was spraying a conveyor with water as part of the sanitation process when the employee contacted a sprocket on the conveyor, suffering a flesh wound to the right arm.
An employee was troubleshooting a cutting machine when his left middle and index fingers were caught between a belt and a pulley. Both fingertips were amputated above the nail. He was hospitalized.

An employee was at the rear-end of a forklift, trying to see why the forklift was caught on an I-beam. The I-beam fell and pinned the employee's leg, breaking bones and causing a contusion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a front-end loader's drive sprocket. When he pushed the sprocket over the drive motor, his right middle finger was pinched between the surface of the sprocket and the drive motor, resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was shocked while installing suspended light fixtures.

An employee was loading a dock plate onto a trailer using a forklift and metal chain. While he was attempting to fix a dock flap on the dock plate, the plate fell and crushed his left hand/fingers, resulting in a partial amputation of his left middle finger.
An employee was using a powered pallet jack, lost control and struck a conveyor resulting in possible lower right leg fractures.
An employee was riding on a gas-powered cart when she went around a sharp curve and fell to the ground, breaking her left ankle.
An employee was using band saw to cut frozen pork meat when the saw amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee fell while descending a 6-foot step ladder that was used to access the attic, suffering a back injury.
An employee was attempting to remove debris from a roadway when a broken treetop rolled over and struck him, fracturing his femur and pelvis.
On 11/7/2017, an employee was hitching a trailer to a vehicle when the trailer hitch slipped, smashing and amputating the employee's left ring finger above the second knuckle.
An employee was entering a dark garage when her foot caught the edge of a 3-foot concrete rise and she fell forward, lacerating her head and hyperextending her neck.
An employee was stepping off a 2-step stool when his leg gave out and he fell to the floor, fracturing his hip.
On November 7, 2017, at approximately 7:20 AM, an employee fell 30 to 40 feet from a second story roof, breaking his back and sternum.
An employee was going to talk to a forklift driver when the forklift backed up and struck him, running over his foot. He suffered a left mid-foot fracture dislocation, with significant displacement.
An employee was cutting tape that accumulated on a box machine when his knife slipped and amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was troubleshooting a 480-volt electrical breaker box when it arc flashed. The employee sustained burns to his neck, face, chest, right hand, and right wrist.
An employee was tugging on a jack when he cut his finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was looking at bags that were coming across a belt. She was going to the belt when she tripped on a cord and fell to the ground, fracturing her hip.

An employee was cleaning out a tortilla machine when the employee's finger was caught and amputated between the conveyor belt and the machine's roller. The belt and rollers were not guarded at the time.
An employee was fabricating a wooden tool using a lathe. His left hand was resting on the tool. As the tool was turning, his left index and middle fingers suffered friction burns.
An employee was walking to grab zip ties from another employee when he tripped on a floor sill (approximately 5.5 inches high) and fell, breaking his hip.
An employee was injured while unloading a trailer.
An employee had an allergic reaction to something in the building (possibly painting on another floor). The employee's throat closed up, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was getting ready to insert a part into a shear when his pinky finger was caught in the rollers and pulled into the shear. His pinky finger was de-gloved and his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was clearing debris from a rip saw when the blade amputated the employee's right thumb and middle and index fingers. The saw was running at the time.
The employee was maneuvering freight within the trailer for delivery and pinched their finger between a loaded pallet and the trailer floor resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On November 7, 2017, an employee was driving a lift truck up a loading ramp while another driver was about to come down the ramp. The other driver stopped and signaled the employee to come up the ramp. The injured employee was trying to pull the truck to the side of the ramp when the wheel came off the ramp. He tried to raise the clamp-up boom to move the lift truck forward, but it started to tip over. He then jumped off and fell to the ground. The fork truck came off the ramp and the cage struck him in the back. He suffered a fractured hip, back and lower extremity injuries, and internal bleeding.
An employee was performing maintenance on a skinning machine when his hand entered the machine, pulling the skin off his right palm, thumb, and the back of his hand.

A digger derrick operator was positioning the boom off the back of a truck. He got out of the operator's chair and stepped onto the walk platform to the back of the truck to get a better view of the placement of the anchor and to instruct the ground man. He lost his footing and fell off the back of the truck resulting in a broken left elbow, a broken right wrist and facial lacerations.
While walking through an area that was having its floor stripped, an employee slipped and fell, suffering a back injury. The area was closed off at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to bring empty pallets inside when the employee was struck by the forks of an operator's forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot.

An employee was using a pallet wrapping machine. He stepped back from the machine onto the forks of a forklift that was parked behind him. His foot twisted as it landed on the fork, breaking his right ankle.

An employee was preparing to stow an auger drive shaft. To prevent the drive shaft from dragging on the ground, the employee planned to have the shaft tucked under a boom and temporarily tied off in an elevated position. Overhead obstructions prevented the employee from raising the boom and moving forward. To get the drive shaft into position, the employee stood to the side of the boom and had just started to pull the drive shaft toward the back of the truck when the boom was lowered. The tip of the drive shaft then contacted the employee s foot, injuring the big and second toes and requiring surgery.
An employee's left ring finger contacted a double head saw blade and was amputated.
An employee was changing out a lower die when his left index finger became caught between the bottom point of the die and the frame of the press. He suffered an amputation to his finger.

On November 8, 2017, an employee was starting to lift a steel I-beam that was wrapped with a steel chain and hooked onto a crane. The employee was holding the pendant and pressed the "Up" button on the crane. As he started to lift the I-beam, his left ring finger was caught and partially amputated between the steel chain and the hook.
An employee was clearing a paper jam when he slipped and fell on some soap that was on the floor, fracturing his right hip.
An employee was preparing pallets of bricks on a conveyor when the employee's fingers were pinched between two of the pallets, amputating the left little finger.
An employee was walking when he tripped over the tines of a parked forklift and broke his right femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was repairing a sectional garage door that had been hit by a motor vehicle and knocked partially out of its tracks. The bottom section of the door flexed, causing the rollers to come back out of the track. When this happened, the bottom two panels came out of the track and shot upwards, striking the underside of the employee's arm and knocking him off his ladder. He dislocated his shoulder.
While carrying a tray or bowl, an employee's right foot collapsed. The employee fell forward to the floor, suffering head trauma, a brain hemorrhage, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a ladder when she missed the last step and fell, breaking her left kneecap.

An employee was performing housekeeping when he went to pick up a plunger at a frac site. The plunger then slipped and amputated his middle fingertip. Impact gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was offloading material when his leg fell through a floor opening. He fractured his back.

An employee was diagnosing a problem with a crane gear box when the employee's left glove was pulled into the gear box, crushing the employee's left index fingertip. The fingertip was eventually amputated. The crane was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was operating a pallet jack when he ran over an oil spill on the floor, causing him to spin out of control. He stepped off the pallet jack and his right foot was caught between the jack and a rack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a pop-up saw when he activated it via the foot pedal and his hand contacted the blade, amputating his fingers. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was picking up a load for transport and trying to place a tarp over a trailer when the tarp started to have issues. He climbed the trailer and then fell to the ground below, breaking his right tibia.
An employee was making a bank deposit when a robber shot her right thigh.
An employee was cutting a small piece of wood on a table saw and amputated his left thumb. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing a hot bag of soup from a kettle when the bag fell and burst on his right leg, causing a third degree burn. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a foot fracture while running from the scene of an accident in an interstate work zone.

An employee was removing a floor tile with a crowbar when a piece of tile flew into his eye, requiring surgery and hospitalization. He was wearing safety goggles and gloves at the time of the incident.
On November 8, 2017, around noon, an employee was walking to clock in when she lost her balance and fell against the brick wall of the building, breaking her left shoulder and requiring surgery.

An employee was removing a diverter valve after emptying and depressurizing the holding tank. After the safety clamp was removed, the back-pressure splashed product on the employee, burning both hands and forearms.
An employee was walking behind a milling machine when it unexpectedly moved backwards and struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the right foot and ankle.
An employee was maneuvering pallets, slipped on the ice and fell resulting in a broken left leg.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of dough from a press mixer when the employee's right hand contacted the rotating auger, amputating the right ring finger. The press mixer was guarded at the time.
An employee was hammering one end of a hose when the opposite end blew off under pressure, striking the employee and causing a laceration.

On 11/09/2017, an employee was operating a blow mold machine when it jammed. The employee was trying to unjam it when the machine crushed and lacerated the right index finger. On 11/21/2017, an employee was operating a capper machine when it jammed. She was trying to unjam it when her sleeve was caught on a moving part, pulling her right arm into the machine and fracturing it.

On November 9, 2017, an employee was operating a welder in the tool room. The employee was attempting to grab a part from the welder when the employee's foot hit the foot pedal and actuated the machine. The welder then amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
The front wheel of a tow motor struck the back of a spotter's foot, fracturing it.

An employee was securing straps and cables to a tarp on top of a sugar beet pile when a microburst hit the pile. The straps and cables came off the tarp and hit the employee. He then became rolled up in the tarp and fell off the pile to the ground, suffering head, wrist, and rib injuries.

An employee was rebuilding a sprayer arm. He had bolted the sprayer arm to the main bench and was attempting to wipe off grease when the sprayer arm struck and crushed his right thumb, fracturing it. The sprayer arm was energized and running at the time.

An employee was working on a pump truck when a gear cylinder engaged unexpectedly. Both of the employee's hands were caught in the belt pulley, resulting in amputations of three fingers from each hand.

A temporary employee was operating a punch press and attempting to adjust a part when his foot stepped on the foot pedal and actuated the press. The press dies then amputated his left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was cutting ribs with a knife when the blade lacerated the employee's left pinky finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was retrieving items from a shelf while on a ladder when the employee fell to the ground, breaking a leg.
An employee was feeding paper into a tea bagging machine when it amputated her right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was operating a brake press when it pinched and crushed the employee's finger, causing a laceration and open fracture.
An employee was stocking roofing flashing when it fell on and lacerated the employee's lower left arm.

An employee pushed the button to start an oven's purge cycle when a metal plate came flying off the furnace and struck the employee's head/face. The employee suffered lacerations, a broken jaw, and missing teeth.
An employee was picking up a piece of material from the floor when an overhead hoist chain broke and struck the employee's head.

An employee was struck by a forklift, and the employee's left leg was briefly caught under the forklift. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and leg, as well as serious leg lacerations and contusions. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was identifying whips to ensure they were not hot and then ohming them out. When he tested the last one, electricity jumped across his hands, causing third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was splashed by hot water while cleaning a tank truck, suffering a second degree burn to the left shoulder and arm.

An employee was using an extension ladder to gain access to a section of a shredder to perform maintenance. The base of the ladder was inches away from the frame of a grapple crane. As he reached the top of the ladder and went to step onto the shredder platform, the ladder slipped back several inches into the crane frame and he lost his footing. He fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete below, striking his head and back.
An employee was manually moving material to a roller. His hand was on the leading edge when his left middle finger was caught between the material and the roller.

An employee was attempting to install a ship's ladder into a ceiling opening. He was leaning into the hole from the roof and using a cable come-a-long to hoist the ladder up to the opening. The hoist then slipped, causing the ladder to fall and pull the employee down 10 feet through the opening. He landed on the ladder, breaking his left leg and seven ribs.

An employee was cleaning a drum mixer when his clothing became caught in the mixer, pulling his arm into the machine. His upper right arm was lacerated. The machine was unguarded and not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was stepping from a ladder onto a roof, lost his footing and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground resulting in a fractured tibia and fibula.

On November 9, 2017, at approximately 10:30 AM, an employee was using a forklift truck to dump a dumpster full of trash. As the dumpster tipped forward, the weight of the dumpster shifted, catching the employee's finger between the fork of the fork truck and the dumpster. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was inspecting boxes when the employee's finger contacted a conveyor chain, amputating the fingertip.

On November 8, 2017, around 10:50 a.m., an employee was moving out of a man basket onto a housing unit to prepare it for rigging when he stepped on ice and fell 15 feet onto the dirt below. He was hospitalized with a fractured ankle and back.
An employee was delivering mail when his right thumb was slammed in a sliding vehicle door, suffering a distal laceration. His right thumb was amputated.
An employee was injured while cutting into a medium-pressured ductwork to tie in a VAV box.
An employee was spreading concrete when some of the concrete entered his boot, burning his heel.
An employee was loading a piece of machinery onto a truck when his finger was caught underneath a pallet resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was attempting to place a work station stand in a pump gear box when her thumb was trapped between the stand and a marination tumbler, causing an amputation.
An employee was unloading a pallet when he tripped and fell, breaking his right femur in two places.
While installing overhead electrical lines, an employee received an induced electrical surge, suffering electrical burns on the hands. The employee was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was pulling down the lift gate on his delivery truck when his left middle finger was pinched by the gate, suffering an amputation injury.
An employee was on a ladder cleaning a kitchen exhaust duct and fan when the ladder slipped from under him as he was descending. He fell 12 to 15 feet to the asphalt ground, fracturing vertebrae.
An employee suffered a propane burn to the right hand while changing a propane bottle on a forklift.

On 11/10/2017, an employee was backing a piece of equipment out of a trailer when a pallet on the equipment hit the trailer door, causing the door to come down and land on his arm. He was hospitalized with a broken arm.

An employee was working from a ladder, installing a header/beam and form board/plywood, when he suffered a cramp in his lower back, which caused his leg to fall asleep. He then fell from the ladder onto protruding pieces of unguarded steel/rebar, impaling his thigh.

An employee was working removing a set of elevators at a gas well drill site when a second employee started a power swivel. The employee's left arm became entangled in the power swivel, breaking it and partially amputating the left ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a power jack to move pallets when the power jack pushed the employee's foot into the wall, crushing and fracturing it between the jack and the wall.

An employee was directing a forklift operator in placing a motor. The forklift operator was moving the motor into position and the employee was rotating the motor to align the bolt holes when the lifting eye backed out of the motor. The motor shifted and fell, and the employee jumped a guardrail to get away from the falling motor. The guard rail was 42" affixed to a platform that was 25" off the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured tibia below the knee upon contact with the floor, requiring hospitalization.
While operating a drill press, an employee suffered a thumb amputation when material became caught in the drill press.
An employee was repositioning a cant when the cant rolled back, smashing his left index finger between it and the cant deck. His fingertip was amputated (no bone loss).
An employee was hoisting up into a rig derrick when his foot was caught between two braces, amputating his left big toe.
On November 10, 2017, an employee was installing carpet when he attempted to move an A-frame cart with 33 large sheets of hardboard. The cart then tilted and fell on him, fracturing his right leg.

An employee was operating a wire sleeving machine and re-inserted the screws into the machine. She was attempting to grab the wire sleeve when her right index fingertip was amputated by the machine's blade. The machine's safety bypass bar was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving a computer from one desk to another and began to have shortness of breath.
An employee tripped over a cord during a procedure in the operating room, suffering a broken arm.
An employee was on top of a spiral chiller, pulling on a belt, when he suffered a herniated disc in his back.
On November 10, 2017, an employee was taking out trash when he slipped and fell on ice, fracturing his right wrist and requiring surgery.
An employee was running a roller mill when the employee's right hand was pulled into the roller mill, amputating the index and middle fingers and damaging the ring finger.
An employee fell off a ladder raised to the second story of a house, fracturing his back.
While manually handling a skid, an employee tripped and fell backwards on the concrete floor, fracturing the right femur.

An employee was using a 4.5-inch handheld grinder to grind a concrete form when the employee's right glove was caught in the grinder. The employee suffered a laceration involving a tiny portion of flesh that was amputated from the right pinky finger.

An employee was gathering supplies and helping another associate when she stepped on the back of the associate's shoe heel, tripped, and fell. She hit her head on a cabinet and injured her right shoulder.

An employee was programming a garage door. The employee's hand was resting on the door chain when the equipment was started. The door chain then amputated the employee's index fingertip beneath the nail.
An employee was walking to get a mop bucket when she tripped over a chair and fractured two ribs.
An employee was struck by a forklift while riding a pallet jack, suffering a compound leg fracture. The forklift driver's view was obstructed at the time.
An employee was climbing a ladder, slipped and fell.
An employee was cutting down a tree. The tree was on a slope, and when the employee cut it, the tree fell and hit the employee's face.
On November 11, 2017, an employee suffered a hand fracture while attempting to stop a coil from falling off a horse.
An employee was unloading a pallet when the employee tripped over the edge of the pallet and fell to the floor, suffering a left hip injury that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee had loosened two bolts on an isolation plug and was working on the third one when the employee suffered fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.
While parking a car, an employee put it in reverse instead of drive. The employee then suffered a fractured right leg.

An employee was removing a flange from a client's oil/gas well with a hydraulic torque wrench. While the employee was placing the torque wrench on the nut, the employee's finger was in a pinch point between the torque wrench and nut. The employee then inadvertently stepped on the controller, which activated the torque wrench, amputating the employee's right index fingertip and nail.

On November 11, 2017, at approximately 4:45 p.m., an employee was looking at a form while walking up a stairway. The employee tripped and fell down the stairway (approximately 4 risers) and was knocked unconscious. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was riding on the side of a forklift when the employee fell to the ground and was run over by the forklift, fracturing his leg.
Two employees were discussing job tasks when they began arguing and shoving one another. One employee pushed the other employee, who fell backwards to the ground, injuring her neck, back, and foot.

An employee was working on a malfunctioning stem valve on the line. The employee's finger was inside the valve when 8 pounds of pressure came on and the valve closed on the employee's right third finger, removing the tip of the nail and some skin.

An employee was standing on the ledge of a booth to dust the blinds when her foot slipped and twisted her right ankle, causing her to fall down onto the booth and injure her right leg. She was hospitalized with a right ankle fracture.

An employee was conducting layout with a coworker. The injured employee was walking to move some construction material that was in the pathway of the layout. On the way back to his instrument, he walked behind a dump truck that was being loaded. As the operator attempted to place a load of concrete into the dump truck, a piece of the concrete missed the dump truck and fell, striking the employee on the top of the hard hat. The employee suffered concussion symptoms.
An employee was installing roof trusses on a new building. While standing on a masonry concrete wall, he fell 12 feet to the ground, injuring his spleen, ribs, and right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was running a mill when his left index finger was caught on the strip-off knife, amputating his left index fingertip.
An employee was installing a rotating head bearing when the bearing slipped and smashed the employee's right hand, breaking it.

On November 11, 2017, an employee was working on the fourth rung of a 10-foot step ladder, attempting to secure polyethylene plastic to an inside wall opening for weather protection. The employee  reached and grabbed a threaded rod protruding from the concrete ceiling to aid in stability while performing a stapling task. The threaded rod unexpectedly detached from the ceiling anchor and caused the employee to lose balance and fall from the ladder to the cement floor. The employee suffered a fractured leg, dislocated ankle, and torn tendons, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing rebar when adjacent rebar fell and hit the employee, who suffered bruises and a broken arm.
An employee was walking when he fell on the ground, fracturing his head.
An employee was welding on steel racks when his clothes caught on fire, resulting in burns to the torso.
An employee was restacking cases of soda when he rolled and broke his right ankle.

An employee was stacking an empty 40" x 48" pallet onto a stack of other empty pallets when his foot became hung up on the pallet at the bottom of the stack. He fell to the same level, striking and fracturing his left hip on the concrete.
An employee was attempting to clear extra material from a mandrel when part of the fabric looped over the employee's left little fingertip. The mandrel pinched the fingertip off at the last joint.
An employee was sweeping the floor when he lost his footing. He reached to steady himself and grabbed a pallet of diapers, which then fell onto his foot, fracturing his upper ankle.
An employee was pursuing individuals when the employee fell onto barbed wire, lacerating the left eye and damaging an eye tendon. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a metal staircase away from an in-feed conveyor when his thumb was caught between the metal staircase and the guard/control box on the conveyor resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was on a 12-foot extension ladder installing a client's Christmas decorations when the ladder slipped. He fell 6 feet to the ground, fracturing his left hand and left foot and suffering trauma to his right foot. He was hospitalized.
On November 12, 2017, an employee was delivering packages and pulled into a customer's driveway. While stepping out of her vehicle, she fell on uneven concrete, fracturing her pelvis.
An employee was emptying trash at a fuel island. A car attempted to change location at the fuel island, didn't see the employee, and hit her.

An employee was removing scrap veneer from a conveyor when his glove was caught in the conveyor. His arm was then pulled into the conveyor, fracturing his wrist and forearm. The conveyor was powered on at the time.

An employee was walking from a restaurant to his truck when he tripped and fell onto a concrete support beam. He suffered a sprained left ankle, a laceration near his right ear, and a contusion on the right side of his head.
An employee was walking out of the office when her leg gave out and she fell breaking a leg.

On November 12, 2017, an employee was caring for a patient at bedside when the employee stepped back and tripped on a piece of medical equipment's power cord. The employee fell, landing on the hip/lower back and suffering a lumbar compression fracture.

On November 12, 2017, an employee's foot became caught in a pallet fork notch. The employee turned to walk away and tripped, falling onto the concrete floor. The employee suffered a right hip fracture.

An employee was turning a box and lifting it to prevent it from stacking incorrectly on a palletizer. As he lifted the box, his right ring finger touched the palletizer's moving conveyor belt and suffered an amputation.

An employee was sitting on a casing head valve to hold himself up while working in a cellar. He was holding onto a stud with his left hand for support. He was cutting approximately 14 inches off of the casing using a torch when the blowout preventer became off-center and shifted to the side. His left index, middle, and ring fingers were then caught and smashed between the stud and casing, requiring surgical amputation of two fingertips at the base of the nail and one fingertip at the first knuckle.
An employee was struck by a 2' x 2' x 8' cement block that fell from 4 feet above the ground when it was hit by a skid steer. The employee's leg was amputated below the knee.
An employee was testing a motor when his right hand entered the rollers resulting in a crushed and fractured forearm. The motor was running at the time.
An employee was loading tubing into a double bender when her left index finger was caught between the tubing and the die, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun when it went off and shot him in the leg.

An employee was unloading a delivery from the side cooler door of a truck trailer when he stepped back, lost his footing on the platform, and fell backwards to the pavement, hitting the back of his head. He suffered bleeding inside his skull and a scalp laceration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading crane equipment onto a trailer truck. The employee was adjusting a pin on mats being stacked to a load when the employee's left ring and middle fingers were caught between the trailer and the mats. Both fingers sustained amputations.
An employee's foot became caught on a dock door ramp. The employee then fell on top of the portable loading ramp, suffering right shoulder pain and a chest contusion.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was backing up resulting in three broken bones in the left foot.

An employee was using a chain fall/come-along hoist to lift a steel tank. The hook on the chain slipped out of the welded lifting pad-eye on the tank. The tank then fell approximately 5 feet, striking and fracturing the employee's left forearm.
An employee was forming a small part on a press brake when his left index fingertip was caught and smashed between the punch and die, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was on a ramp loading a box onto a truck when he stepped back and fell approximately 3.5 feet to the ground, fracturing his left arm and wrist.

On 11/13/2017, at 7:00 AM, an employee was using a chain winch to remove a screw auger from a tube in the boiler room. The movement of the auger caused a pulley to turn, and the employee's finger was pinched between the pulley and a protruding bolt head. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unrolling shrink wrap from a vertical shrink wrap roll when a passing forklift ran over and crushed his foot.

An employee was climbing an aluminum ladder attached to a tanker truck when the ladder broke at the supports, causing the employee to fall 5 to 6 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee was exiting his truck when he was struck by a passing vehicle, fracturing his right tibia.
An employee was stepping off a stand-up forklift truck when another employee reversing a sit-down forklift struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a platform lift when he fell approximately 16 feet to the floor, suffering a concussion. He was not tied off to the lift at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped and fell while stocking a cooler, breaking her hip.
An employee was attempting to free a stuck piece of veneer from rollers when her right little finger was caught in the roller bed drive chain, amputating her fingertip.

Two employees were mowing vegetation under a powerline with a mulching machine. Due to the rough terrain, the machine had to be pulled out with a winch that was on the machine. The winch cable broke, causing the machine to roll onto its side with one employee inside. The employee injured his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a box truck when he stepped awkwardly and felt a pull or pop in his back, followed by tingling in his left leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was welding and installing an economizer for a boiler from a temporary elevated work platform when he fell approximately 15 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was picking up scrap and loose material when another employee swung some aluminum angle flashing and struck the first employee, who suffered a lower left neck laceration. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a pry bar to remove a section of a plywood from a panel when the pry bar slipped and fractured his left thumb. He was hospitalized.

An employee opened a rolling door, then walked out on a dock plate to speak to the driver of a delivery truck that was being unloaded. The dock plate collapsed, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet. He broke a femur and injured his hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee got on a manlift. When the lift reached the top level, the employee fell approximately 18 feet through the hole of the manlift to the lower level, requiring hospitalization for injuries to the right pelvis and knee.
An employee suffered first and second degree steam burns to the back while installing equipment at a customer's brewery.
On 11/14/2017, at approximately 1:30 PM, an employee was plugging a well when an unexpected flow of oil and gas occurred, causing a fire that severely burned the employee.
An employee was cutting an empty 55-gallon barrel with a blowtorch when vapor inside the drum ignited and the lid hit the employee's face, lacerating it and breaking the cheekbone.
An employee was changing a plastic roll on a pour line near a cut-off saw when his hand/arm were caught in the roller, resulting in a compound fracture to the left forearm.

An employee was standing on the rear left platform of a refuse truck. His right leg was on the truck's tailgate while the sweep blade was operating. The sweep blade then struck and lacerated his upper right leg.

An employee was walking near a machine that was in operation when he noticed a loose wire on a large reel as the reel was rotating. The employee was caught by the loose wire causing the reel to flip the employee over and onto the ground resulting in a concussion and whiplash to his body and neck.

An employee and a forklift driver were attempting to unjam a pallet of product that had become wedged under a guardrail. The employee's foot was on top of the pallet when the employee asked the forklift driver to back up. The forklift moved in the wrong direction, and the employee's right leg was trapped between the pallet and the guardrail, breaking the employee's right ankle.
An employee was standing on the side of the highway when he was struck by a passing vehicle's side mirror. The employee was admitted to the hospital for facial surgery.
An employee was attempting to remove adhesive from the gate valve while the machine was in operation. The gate valve closed on the employee's right middle finger amputating the fingertip.

On November 14, 2017, at approximately 3:05 p.m., an employee was operating a stand-up reach lift in reverse when he turned sharply. The powered industrial truck then slammed into a guardrail. His left foot was crushed and fractured between the guardrail and the powered industrial truck, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was conducting foot patrol when an assailant struck him multiple times, fracturing his right ankle.

An employee went to the south side of a machine to grab an extruded plastic sheet and realized the roller assembly was in the up position instead of down. While the assembly was lowering, the employee leaned forward over the tote bin. The roller assembly continued and made contact with the employee's back, causing the employee's torso to be wedged between the roller assembly and tote bin resulting in a fractured sternum.
An employee was positioning all-purpose containers when the employee tripped over some unsecured webbing and fell, suffering a possible leg injury or fractured hip.

An employee was walking down vee-door stairs, using the railing hand method on the hand rails. He was almost to the bottom when the roller assembly shifted and struck his left hand against the handrail, fracturing his pinky finger.

An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when he attempted to wipe fat off the bandsaw table. His left ring finger was then caught in the blade, amputating his fingertip. The bandsaw was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was reversing a forklift when the employee collided with a second reversing forklift. The employee's foot was wedged and injured between the two forklifts, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was watching a sub-winch cable run through sheaves to ensure that the cable was running smoothly when he noticed slack due to the cable coming off the sheave. He grabbed the cable with his left hand for balance and placed his right foot on the lower section of the cable to push it into the sheave. The cable then broke free into the sheave, consequently creating tension on the cable, which cut his right foot and three left-hand fingers. His three middle left-hand fingers were amputated, and his right foot was partially amputated.

An employee was having a pre-shift meeting with temporary employees when a temporary employee walked up to her side, hit her on the head, and knocked her down to the floor. She hit her head on the concrete floor, suffering a head laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was disassembling a machine to take it out of service and dispose of it. A slab of granite was on top of part of the machine's steel frame. The employee was attempting to remove the slab of granite when it slipped out of his hands and pinched his left hand between it and the steel frame. His left pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was carrying materials down a flight of stairs when he missed a step and fell. He dislocated and fractured his left ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
Two employees where painting in a scissor lift when they fell. The first employee fell on his back while the second employee fell face down on the floor. Both were hospitalized.
An employee was walking near granite handling equipment when the clamp that holds the granite hit the employee's head. The employee suffered minor brain bleeding.

An employee was moving a load of chicken on a rolling rack into a freight elevator. When he began to push the product into the elevator, he did not notice that the carriage was not there. The product/rack and the employee fell into the elevator. He fell 16 feet, 10 inches, hitting the product before rolling onto the concrete below. He was hospitalized with possible broken ribs, as well as lacerations on the back and left side of his head above the ear. The elevator's limit switch was not working correctly at the time of the incident.

On November 14, 2017, at approximately 10:40 AM, an employee fell while disassembling a work platform at a height of over 6 feet. The employee suffered a cracked L5 vertebra and bruising to the chest and shoulders, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to clear logs from a conveyor when the employee's left leg was pulled into the head shaft of the conveyor, suffering an amputation that required hospitalization.

An employee took a forklift off a truck to load lumber. He drove the forklift to the driver s side of the truck and parked it. He left the seat belt buckled. He had one foot on the forklift and the other on the truck bed when he reached over to grab a pail of roofing nails. His foot then hit the gas pedal on the forklift, causing it to go with him still straddled between the forklift and the truck bed. He then fell to the road and was run over by the forklift, injuring his hips and legs.

An employee was troubleshooting defects on a coating line's topcoat station when he contacted the impression roll, and his arm was pulled through the roll and the rail. He suffered third degree friction burns to his right forearm and bicep.

An employee was attempting to repair a refrigeration unit when he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground from either a ladder or the top of the refrigeration unit. He suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing outside of an excavator in a gore area worksite when a vehicle lost control and left the roadway, striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
On November 14, 2017, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was walking into a patient's room when he slipped on the wet floor and landed on his back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was counting 2-inch by 4-inch boards of lumber on a table when he lost his balance and grabbed a drive chain to catch himself. The chain caught his glove, causing his left hand to be caught between the drive chain and sprocket. His left-hand fingers suffered avulsions and fractures, requiring hospitalization. The chain was unguarded at the time.
An employee tripped on a pallet, fell to the floor, and suffered a left hip injury.
An employee missed a step in a stairway and broke the right ankle.

An employee was attempting to separate frozen hamburger patties with a kitchen knife. As he applied force to the knife, it separated the patties and slipped, puncturing his abdomen to the right of his naval.

An employee was repairing a metal platform that was supported by metal saw horses and jack stands. A metal shim was in place on the saw horse to level the platform. The employee noticed the shim had turned slightly, so he used a 4 lb. maul to tap the shim into its original position. The force of the strike caused the shim to dislodge, and the corner of the platform came down on the employee's index finger. The employee suffered an amputation.
An employee was going up a ladder to retrieve a product when he slipped from the ladder and fell onto his back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a residential route picking up bulk items in a trash rear-load truck when his left middle finger was caught and crushed between a gap in a saw horse. The side of his finger was also cut open from the knuckle to the fingernail.
An employee was descending a ladder when he lost his footing and fell, breaking his leg and injuring his right-hand fingers.
An employee was spraying what's called a "hot box," a process of strutting rubber. While spraying, there was a flash fire that caused second degree burns to his right hand and forearm.
During well-servicing operations, an employee was removing an on/off tool when it slipped. His finger was then caught and smashed between the tool.

An employee was training a new employee on the operation of a napkin folding machine when he heard a noise that concerned him and asked the trainee to bump the conveyor leading out of the machine. The employee went behind the machine to investigate and slipped as the trainee was bumping the conveyor. His left thumb was subsequently caught between the belt and a timing gear, damaging the bone and tissue. His thumb tip was amputated directly below the nailbed.

An employee was looking for a leak in a water main. He was walking on the pipe when he slipped and bumped his head on a trench box. His back also hit the pipe. He suffered head and back injuries, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working from a servicing rig platform while tripping out pipe. The pipe became unstable and swung over the edge of the servicing platform while the employee was holding onto it. The pipe pulled the employee from the platform, and he fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. He suffered lacerations and fractures to the eye socket, jaw, nasal bones, and one of his legs. The platform was unguarded at the time.

An employee was driving a pallet jack near the end of an aisle as another driver was turning into the same aisle. To avoid a collision with the other driver, the employee turned the pallet jack into some racks and suffered a 6-inch laceration to his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was going downstairs when her toe caught the end of a pallet. She then tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was operating a mortar mixer on a construction site when his right hand entered the mixer's moving parts, amputating two fingers. The mixer was unguarded at the time.

The injured employee was working in the bag room and was disconnecting baggage carts from the baggage tractors for staging purposes. As the tractor was moved away, the still connected carts struck and pinned the injured employee on the ground between another cart. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the second floor landing of some stairs when the employee missed a step and fell face forward down the steps. The employee suffered a broken nose, broken wrist, broken eye socket, concussion, and brain bleed.
On November 15, 2017, an employee tripped and fell while walking to assist a patient. The employee suffered a broken right arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was emptying a 55-gallon drum when it fell on his left hand, causing an amputation to his middle finger that required surgery.
An employee was cutting ribs using a band saw. While turning to get more product, the employee contacted the band saw blade, suffering a right index finger amputation.

The injured employee was standing on the driver's side of the trailer while another employee (customer's employee) was using a forklift to pick bundles of steel pipe off the passenger side of the trailer. A bundle fell and landed on the injured employee's right leg, breaking six bones in his right heel, foot, and leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was preparing to operate a tap hole sander when flames and heat escaped from the shell furnace, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's face and right hand.

An employee was getting into a mail delivery vehicle when a privately owned vehicle struck his vehicle from behind, knocking him to the ground. His head struck a concrete sidewalk, and he suffered possible bleeding outside his brain.
An employee was trying to get down to the ground from a loading dock when he injured his patella tendons, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working inside an elevator shaft when the elevator button was pressed, causing the elevator to descend. He was trying to step out of the shaft when the elevator landed on his back, fracturing his vertebra.
An employee was working on a mill press when the press came down and caught his right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
On November 15, 2017, an employee was unloading landscaping stone from a conveyor belt when his right ring finger was caught and partially amputated in a machinery clamp.

An employee was using a forklift to load a trailer when the truck rolled, causing the forklift to fall off the loading dock. The employee dismounted the falling forklift and fractured his right femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was closing trailer door panels when his right finger was caught between the panels, amputating his right ring fingertip. Gloves were worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from a 6-foot step ladder while inspecting heating unit coils. The employee suffered cracked vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a docking plate getting ready to load a truck when the truck driver moved the truck. The employee fell and hit his head on the docking plate, then fell approximately 10 feet off the plate to the ground. He suffered bruises and cuts on the back of his head, as well as nose and mouth bleeding.

The employee was moving pallets around the facility with a reach truck when he lost control of the truck and hit a pole. During the impact, his left arm was caught between the pole and truck, sustaining multiple fractures.
An employee tripped and fell while walking across a rig floor, suffering multiple fractures to the left elbow.
An employee tripped and fell while exiting a bathroom stall, landing on the ground. The employee suffered a gash above the right eye and forehead, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was guiding a bundle of scaffolding equipment into the bed of a truck when the scaffolding shifted. The employee's right fifth finger was then caught and partially amputated between the scaffolding racks.
An employee was pulling a crate with a banding strap to the rear of a trailer when the strap broke. He then fell from the trailer to the ground, injuring his right shoulder.
An employee was being trained to operate a powered pallet lift when his right foot was caught between a storage rack and the lift, fracturing his right lower leg.

An employee was driving back to a warehouse after completing his last stop when a black SUV pulled up beside him. Someone in the SUV shot into the employee's vehicle and then sped off. He was shot in the ankle, requiring hospitalization.
On November 16, 2017, an employee was using a cutting wheel to trim a filter element when the wheel amputated one of the employee's fingers.

On 11/16/2017, an employee was attempting to clear a hydrate formation in a gas pipeline at a tank battery when flammable gases and vapors ignited, causing first and third degree burns to his face, the back of his head, his back, and his hands.
On 11/16/2017, two employees were attempting to clear a hydrate formation in a gas pipeline at a tank battery when flammable gases and vapors ignited, causing significant burns to both employees.
An employee tripped over a box and fell. Her thigh hit the box.
An employee was stacking 55-gallon drums when his middle finger was caught and lacerated in the pinch point between stacked drums. He was hospitalized.
An employee was holding air scissors when the safety switches engaged and the scissors activated, amputating the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was attempting to dislodge a piece of poly from a bag sealing machine when the machine's jaws closed on his hand, amputating his left middle fingertip.

An employee was attempting to remove the valve from a fire extinguisher that he thought was empty in the waste processing cell. The fire extinguisher still had pressure, which caused it to launch across the floor and hit another employee's chest.
An employee tripped over the edge of a box scraper attachment and fell landing on top of the loader attachment. The employee sustained a head laceration and a broken collarbone.

An employee was operating an overhead crane/hoist to unload a steel snow plow blade when the load came loose from the clamp and struck his feet. He suffered a broken big toe on his right foot and fractures to the top of his left foot.
An employee was cleaning up a site when a sheet of plywood fell on his head. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was flagging loads on location when a substructure shifted and pinned the employee's left foot, crushing it.
An employee was installing tape in a windup machine when the tape caught his left glove and pulled his hand into the machine. He suffered compound fracture to his left wrist.
An employee was operating a jointer machine when the employee's left hand was pulled into the machine, partially amputating the middle finger.

An employee was attempting to align a misaligned running belt on a conveyor system. The running belt caught his glove and pulled his hand into a nip point, injuring his right index and middle fingers and requiring surgery.

An employee was closing the lift gate on a delivery vehicle. His left-hand fingers were resting on the lift gate when its down switch was activated. The lift gate then partially amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was walking across a meeting room when he fell and fractured his femur.

An employee was in an aerial lift using a chain fall to plumb a steel column and set a row of purlins when the lift's rise button was activated. His head was then caught between a purlin and the lift at a height of 13 feet. He suffered a laceration above his left eyebrow, a cut to his lower lip, and a hairline fracture to his cheekbone.
An employee was moving outrigger pads when his thumb was smashed between two pads.

Employees were setting, aligning, and starting a compressor. The injured employee was attempting to diagnose a squeak heard while the compressor was running when his left hand entered the rotating area of the compressor, amputating his left thumb.
An employee twisted an ankle while stepping out of a truck, suffering an ankle fracture.

An employee used pliers to pull or adjust the drive belt on a conveyor belt. The belt caught hold and began turning. It then caught his glove and pulled his right thumb into the conveyor, partially amputating his thumb tip (no bone loss).
An employee was cutting a lemon with a knife when the blade amputated his fingertip.
An employee was using a drill press. The drill bit had a burr on it and caught his glove, twisting and fracturing his right wrist into the drill press.

An employee was harnessed to an order picker. He stepped off the order picker onto a forklift and started pulling away. The harness yanked him off the forklift back to the order picker causing a cracked vertebra in his neck, a  four-inch gash on his forehead and a small gash on his right thumb.

On November 16, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was using a table saw to cut the edge off a board when the blade amputated two of the employee's fingertips to the first knuckle. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was moving crates with a hand truck when a crate tipped and fell. She attempted to catch it and her fingers were caught and crushed between the crate and a wall, causing an amputation.
On November 16, 2017, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was bending blades on a press brake when the press brake amputated the employee's left thumb.

An employee had placed fabric in a dye machine that uses hot steam to help the dye. The employee came back to check on the product and stopped the machine. When the pin released to open the door, hot steam came out of the port hole and burned the employee's forehead.

On November 16, 2017, an employee was descending a 6-foot step ladder when he lost his footing, slipped, and fell approximately 2 feet from a lower rung to the concrete deck below, fracturing his right tibia and fibula.
An employee's finger was amputated when a scissor lift raised up into a beam.

An employee was part of a crew that was placing stop bars, turn arrows, and crosswalks at an intersection. A vehicle entered the work zone and struck the thermoplastic handliner, which the crew was using to apply the roadway markings. The handliner is a small hand machine that uses molten thermoplastic (430 degrees F) to produce the markings. The impact of the vehicle on the handliner caused the molten material to splatter onto the injured employee, who suffered burns to the neck, right side of the face, and right ear.
An employee was draining a plug catcher when the valve arm became loose, spun closed, and hit his right leg, fracturing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee dropped a granite countertop and suffered a back injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lowering a crane hook to attach a cable for a saw blade change when his left index finger was pinched between the cable and hook, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was talking to a second employee when his left middle finger was caught between a reefer reinforcement part and a fixture being worked on by the second employee. He suffered a third metacarpal tip amputation.

On November 17, 2017, at approximately 1:30 p.m., an employee was moving a piece of steel that was suspended using a magnet when the magnet disengaged. The steel then fell on the employee's left hand, amputating two to three fingers.

An employee was using a tool to install a thread protector on a tubular when the tool's lithium battery exploded in the non-mag tubular, sending up debris and chemicals that struck employees on the rig floor. An employee was hospitalized with face and wrist burns.
A temporary employee's left hand became caught in a trash compactor, pinching and breaking a couple of fingers and lacerating the hand.
An employee was repairing a tear in an SMC machine. The dam that holds back pigment was lifted and then fell on the employee's right middle finger, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was walking a dog when an owl swept down from a tree. The dog pulled the employee to the ground while chasing the owl, causing the employee to fall and suffer ischial fractures.
