An employee dumped a load of gravel material from the dump truck he was driving. After he dumped the load, he drove off to a speed of approximately 45 mph with the truck bed erected. He began driving under a bridge when the elevated bed struck the lower part of the bridge and caused the truck to flip and land on its side. He suffered a broken nose, facial fractures, and a broken ankle.

An employee was guiding a concrete form that was being removed with a crane when it became unstable and swung into the steel guide beam, knocking it to the ground with the employee. The steel beam came down on and crushed the employee's hand.

An employee was trying to put cotton back in a bale press. His leg was inside the boxes below floor level. The press was in automatic mode and engaged in rotation, causing his leg to be caught and fractured between the edge of the floor and the edge of the box.

The injured employee was inspecting food on a conveyor line. The employee was leaning against a top rail that was 10 feet 11 inches above the ground. As the employee stepped away from the platform, her right shoe caught the edge of the toe board and her left foot caught the edge of a plastic bin. She slid down the guard rail and fell 12 feet between the mid rail and toe board resulting in a fractured pelvis.

On November 17, 2017, at about 5:30 a.m., two employees were loading a sofa onto a trailer. One employee got into the truck to move it, while the other employee stayed on the trailer while the truck was moved about 50 yards in the warehouse. While the truck and trailer were being moved, the employee in the trailer fell approximately two feet out of the trailer and hit his head on the ground, fracturing his skull and suffering a brain bleed.
While climbing down a wind turbine tower using a fixed ladder, an employee fell 25 feet and struck a platform, losing consciousness and fracturing a leg, hip, and pelvis.
An employee was resting her hand on a door jamb when the self-closing door closed on her little finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was delivering a reach truck to a customer. The employee was driving the truck up a ramp when the truck bottomed out, causing it to roll down the ramp and eject the employee to the ground. The employee suffered neck injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting re-roofing work while tied off to his harness when he slipped and fell 12.5 feet to the ground, fracturing both heels. He was hospitalized.

An employee was observing a yard horse after replenishing hydraulic fluid to the lift mechanism when overpressure in the fluid reservoir caused a hot fluid spill. The fluid contacted the employee, causing thermal skin burns to the face and abdomen.
An employee was plasma torch-cutting a 55-gallon drum when it exploded and caught on fire. The employee suffered second degree burns and a broken leg.

An employee was installing material strap while standing on the third step of a 6-foot ladder when the employee lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a punctured lung and broken rib, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing up railing to reach an upper hen box when his foot slipped on the rail. He then fell backward and hit his head on an adjacent hen cage, losing consciousness.
An employee was preparing to strip a column by attaching it to a crane when the column struck and fractured the employee's pelvis. The column's pins were knocked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was descending a flight of stairs when he tripped at the bottom three stairs and fell, striking his head on the concrete ground and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was slicing meat with a meat slicer when his right thumb came in contact with the blade and was severely lacerated, later requiring surgical amputation.

An employee was operating a concrete drill rig when the fast-acting auger valve was activated, causing the rig to push downward into the earth and tip over. The employee jumped from the tipping drill rig and suffered cracked vertebrae.
An employee was using a mixing drill when his glove and sleeve were caught in the chuck, causing his hand to become wrapped. His left ring fingertip was pinched and amputated.

An employee was using a jack hammer to remove concrete at a job site. The employee rested the jack hammer against some pipes while he used a shovel to remove debris. The jack hammer slid off the pipe, striking and crushing the employee's left middle finger, which had to be surgically amputated.

Two employees were working on a pulverizer on a second-floor mezzanine. They stopped to allow utility workers to look into a different pulverizer, which had coal dust inside it and was approximately 20 feet away. The utility work produced a spark that ignited the coal dust, generating a fire ball that traveled horizontally and burned the two employees  arms and faces. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the landing of a set of portable stairs washing out filter cake build-up from the raised bed of a dump truck. A clump of the filter cake broke free and slid down the bed of the truck onto the concrete floor. The force of the filter cake struck the base of the stairs, causing the base to move and the stairs to topple over. The employee fell 10 to 12 feet from the stair landing to the ground, sustaining an open fracture to his elbow and multiple rib fractures.
An employee was climbing a ladder to check a compressor on an upper level when the employee fell to the concrete below, suffering a concussion and fracture around the left eye.
An employee lost balance while pouring concrete in a paving machine. The employee's hand was then caught in the machine, amputating a finger.

An employee was attempting to jump onto the running boards of a pickup truck that was starting to leave the parking area when he fell off the running board. The pickup truck then ran over and fractured his leg.
An employee was rolling module tarp when the employee's right arm was caught by the module roller, breaking it.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt and sustained lacerations and a broken arm. The conveyor belt was not locked out at the time.
An employee was adjusting the tarp straps on the back of a truck when he fell off the truck and hit the ground, lacerating his liver.

An employee was working on the roll line machine, lost his balance and caught his right index finger in the reciprocating roller belt resulting in amputation above the knuckle. The reciprocating belt guard was not in place at the time.
An employee was helping to guide a beam into place when the beam slipped, catching the employee between it and a forklift. The employee suffered chest contusions.

An employee was troubleshooting a problem on a milking carousel when his jacket sleeve was caught on the running drive wheel of the carousel's motor. His right forearm was then crushed and broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a knife to cut insulation back on a wire when the knife lacerated his forearm.

An employee stepped up on a ladder to check/see what plants needed water. While stepping down, she missed the last two ladder steps and fell to the floor, breaking bones in her right leg. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was repairing a drive chain on a tote fill conveyor when the conveyor started. His left middle and ring fingertips were then caught and amputated between the conveyor's chain and sprocket. The chain and sprocket were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was setting frames when a frame gave way and struck him, injuring his back and requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning a running tub wash and amputated the left middle finger.

On November 18, 2017, a temporary employee was attempting to disconnect a power supply cord for a conveyor line to unjam it. The electrical power supply cord exterior was damaged and the employee contacted unprotected live parts. The employee was electrocuted.

The injured employee was lifting the brow from a ship in dry dock with a tower crane. The brow moved forward as it was lifted and caused a second employee to fall off the brow onto the weather deck of the ship. The falling employee struck the injured employee pushing the injured employee into the guardrails at the top of the stair platform tower resulting in fractures requiring hospitalization.

An employee was welding on a 1,000-pound steel beam when a bolt on the turnbuckle support loosed and the steel beam tilted, striking the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was threading woven material through the take-up device on a loom when his right middle finger entered the pinch point between the rollers while he was jogging them. As he pulled his finger back, the rollers fractured his fingertip and removed his fingernail.

An employee was loading pipe onto a flatbed tractor trailer when a pipe began to roll toward the edge of the trailer. The employee jumped off the trailer to avoid the pipe and suffered a right lower leg/foot fracture.

An employee was walking out of a pedestrian doorway at the exact same time that a construction equipment operator was travelling out of a large roll-up doorway to the left of the pedestrian door. Once outside, the equipment operator made a sharp right turn and struck the employee's right shin, breaking it.
An employee was cleaning explosive production materials from a universal loader with isopropyl alcohol when energetic material ignited, burning and lacerating his hand. PPE was worn at the time.
An employee was using a hydraulic torque tool to take measurements when the tool released pressure, amputating the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was on the metal edge of a roof when his knee rolled over and he lost his balance and fell to the ground resulting in broken ribs.

An employee was checking the speed of an exit roll using a tachometer when the employee's right hand was pinched between the roll and table, amputating and fracturing the second digit and lacerating the third digit.
An employee was attempting to release a skid steer bucket when he fell and broke his left ankle.
An employee was adjusting a machine for setup following maintenance when his left index fingertip was caught and amputated in a machine pinch point.

An employee was under a machine's conveyor system trying to clear a jam. When the jam was free, a helper turned the machine back on. His hand was then pulled into the conveyor system, causing soft tissue trauma, swelling, and bruising that required hospitalization.
An employee fell through an unsecured grate while moving fire hoses, suffering bruises and leg/foot fractures.

On November 20, 2017, employee 1 was working on the ground clearing fallen branches as employee 2 was in a tree clearing dead branches. A log fell from the top of the tree, hit the ground and bounced up, hitting employee 1 in the back of the head and propelling him forward into another tree. He sustained head injuries and partial paralysis to his hands and feet, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was supporting a shaft that was in a vice during repairs when the shaft fell through the vice, hitting and partially amputating the employee's left ring finger.

An employee was attempting to kneel on the upper deck of a crane to communicate with his coworker in a lower section while they moved the crane. He fell from the crane onto the ground, fracturing his right wrist and forearm and dislocating his arm.

An employee was using a hinged gate to push a stubborn cow onto a level ramp when the cow jolted backward and pushed the gate into the side of his head. He fell backward and his head hit the ground, suffering a laceration.
An employee was walking around to ensure no one walked on lifts when he was struck by a scissor lift, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bending material on a press brake when the employee's right hand slipped into the press brake, crushing the index finger.
An employee was walking from her car to the hospital when she lost her balance and fell, lacerating her left knee and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was disassembling a meat cutting machine to clean it. The machine was still plugged in at the time, and a switch was triggered while the employee's hand was inside the cutting area. The machine's blade then amputated the employee's left middle fingertip (no bone loss).
An employee was cleaning in the office using a step stool when she fell to the ground, breaking her leg and shoulder.
An employee was unloading dishes off the back of a truck, stepped off the lift gate and fell to the ground resulting in a broken rib and back injury.

An employee was overseeing another employee who was removing a pipe cap when the pipe cap exploded off the pipe and struck the first employee's torso. The employee suffered broken ribs and a torn esophagus.

An employee was polishing a feed screw with a handheld pneumatic grinder. The feed screw was in the grinding fixture. When he rotated the fixture, he noticed that the secondary safety pin fell out. He rotated the fixture to the vertical position and then applied upward pressure on the fixture arm. The 700-pound feed screw then fell out, knocking him to the ground and landing on his right leg and left hand. He suffered a broken and lacerated right foot, broken right ankle, broken right tibia, and lacerations to his left pinky and ring fingers that severed his tendons.
An employee was squatting change a patient's dressings when she suffered a left knee injury and required hospitalization.
An employee was repairing an asphalt paver machine when the machine's radiator cap came off. Hot water then splashed and burned his right forearm and hand.
An employee was using a handheld knife to cut duck when it cut his left middle finger.
An employee was standing taking merchandise out of box when she fell to the floor and fractured her left hip.
An employee received steam burns while performing maintenance on a transmitter, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a trailer when it slipped and caught his right ring finger, lacerating and breaking it. He was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was driving a sit-down forklift while wearing a harness/lanyard. The harness became caught under the forklift tire, and he was pulled out of the forklift to the ground, fracturing his scapula and vertebrae.
An employee fell from a roof while cleaning gutters, suffering two broken wrists. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was using a cordless planer to cut a log. The log rolled and the employee jumped, cutting his left thumb resulting in a partial amputation.

An engineer was working with an estimator at a customer site. The engineer was climbing a ladder when a foot slipped and the engineer fell about three feet to the ground resulting in a broken left arm and hospitalization.
An employee was wiping down a conveyor roller when the conveyor started unexpectedly and pulled his hand into the rollers. He suffered a broken radius and ulna, requiring hospitalization.
A 200-pound roll fell from a turret and struck an employee. The employee suffered a broken right leg, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was correcting metal parts when his fingers got caught between the part he was working on and parts that were on a table. The employee fractured a finger.
An employee was attempting to cross the road to the warehouses when he was struck by a traveling forklift. The forklift was carrying a pallet, and his leg was caught underneath it.

While installing a waterline connection, an aluminum trench box weighing 400 lbs. was removed so the legs could be adjusted. A mini excavator was used to tilt and hold the box while the leg pins were removed. The excavator operator set the box back down on all four legs and the legs pushed up inside the box causing it to fall over and strike one of the employees on his lower body resulting in a broken pelvis.

An employee was wearing gloves while using a rag and flammable solvent to clean dust and debris from a roofing lap. He lit a cigarette with a disposable lighter, which ignited the solvent on his gloves and caused burns to both hands.
While operating a standup fork truck, an employee struck a racking system. The employee's right foot was caught between the fork truck and the rack, fracturing it.
An employee was cutting a tree limb when it swung back and hit his leg. He suffered a lower right leg fracture and dislocated kneecap, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing a machine's router bit when the machine energized and lacerated the employee's right palm. The machine was plugged in at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to catch and rehang a chicken in the evisceration area when his third right-hand finger contacted an oil gland machine's cutting blade, amputating his fingertip and causing an underlying fracture.
An employee was sorting mail when he picked up a parcel that contained a sharp object. The object then came out of the parcel and hit his left eye, resulting in an eye loss.
An employee was loading a tractor trailer from a ladder when the ladder buckled. The employee then fell to the macadam, fracturing bones in the right leg and/or ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a circular saw and lacerated his right middle and index fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to clear the waste tank of an airplane when a baggage cart struck him, breaking his clavicle.

An employee was attempting to remove a part from a fracking unit using a torque wrench and a socket. The socket broke in half and the employee slipped and fell to the ground, hitting his head. He suffered a small skull fracture and brain bleeding, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on acorns and lost footing while operating a leaf blower, breaking a leg.
An employee was pulling a rack of food out of a chiller when he slipped and fell, hitting his head on the ground. He suffered a laceration to the back of his head.

A maintenance employee was checking the voltage on an automatic loading machine when another employee activated the machine. The loading arm then struck the maintenance employee, bruising the back and lung.
Employees were erecting a pump-jack scaffold when two employees received an electric discharge from a powerline, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking across the parking lot to the main office building when she bent over to pick up a piece of trash, lost her balance, and fell. She broke her hip and required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was part of a crew that was cleaning railcars. After cleaning the last car, they were getting ready to close the back door. One of the employees had his left hand in the doorway when another employee slammed the door closed on his left ring finger. His finger was smashed, and his fingertip had to eventually be surgically amputated.

An employee was using a pneumatic wrench to tighten a spring cap onto a bolt while repairing a metal shearing machine. As the employee added downward pressure on the spring, the bolt snapped, releasing the spring's compression and causing it to shoot out of containment and into the employee's forehead. The employee sustained a forehead laceration that required stitches and a minor skull fracture.
An employee was cutting concrete with a cut-off saw when the saw kicked back and hit the employee's face, causing a laceration.
An employee was moving a bale when she stepped back and her right foot was caught between a baler and a power jack. She suffered a traumatic injury to her right ankle/shin.
An employee was walking between a truck and a cement truck when the cement truck ran over and crushed his right foot. His foot had to be amputated.

An employee was using nitric acid to strip nickel-coated diamond reclaim from a process tank when a violent exothermic reaction occurred and caused an overflow of nitrogen oxides. The employee later experienced breathing problems and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to make a U-turn on a forklift when her foot was caught and fractured between the forklift and a pallet rack.
An employee slipped and fell down several stairs, fracturing her left humeral shaft and lacerating her forehead.
An employee was inspecting a clogged press when the clog broke loose and shot hot steam onto his legs. He suffered second degree burns to both upper legs.
An employee was preparing to make piping connections from a heat exchanger to a reactor when a pressurized release of liquid process material occurred. He suffered fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was assembling a store display and was trying to cut the peg board with a utility knife. He applied pressure with his right arm. When the knife went through the board, it broke loose went into his left forearm, lacerating an artery. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

Groundsmen were felling a 28-foot cherry tree with a 22-inch diameter base when the tree rotated on its base, spinning and falling in the opposite direction of what they anticipated. An employee was running along the pre-planned escape route when the tree struck his right shoulder and head, knocking him to the ground where he briefly lost consciousness. The employee suffered a skull fracture. He was wearing a hard hat at the time.

An employee was welding in a submarine s sail area. The lookout area of the sail has two large hatch doors with mechanisms on both sides that can latch and lock onto the top when closed. The hatch doors are also usually spring-loaded to prevent them from falling abruptly. Neither door has the latches installed, and the starboard door s spring was not installed to the foundation. The starboard door was raised to the closed position, with the employee working underneath. At approximately 9:20 AM, the employee completed his weld and called his supervisor over for inspection. When his supervisor began to step down into the work area from the port side, the starboard hatch door fell, striking the employee in the head and face and pinning his head between the ship s foundation and the door itself. He suffered blunt force trauma to his head and face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a hammer drill to install drywall when he lost control of the drill and broke his leg.

A temporary employee was pulling a piece of skin out of a skinner machine when his gloves were caught in the skinner blade, lacerating his right index and middle fingers and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking into a room that had recently been mopped when she slipped and fell on the wet floor, fracturing her left femur.
An employee was stepping down from the cab of a vacuum truck and tore a tendon in the right knee.

An employee was standing at a hardware desk when a coworker retrieved a tool box from a shelf and it fell on the employee, causing him to fall backward onto the floor. He was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was holding an office door open with his left hand while reaching into the office with his right hand. His left little finger was then pinched by the automatic-closing door, causing a partial amputation.

On November 22, 2017, an employee was performing boiler blow-down water testing when he bumped a steam line ball valve that opened and soaked his right forearm. He suffered steam/chemical burns to his right forearm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was burned on the face and hand while lighting a burn pile.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood pieces when the blade amputated a portion of his right ring finger.
An employee was removing meat from a saw table when his right little fingertip contacted the saw blade and was amputated. The saw was running at the time.

On November 22, 2017, at approximately 7:35 a.m., an employee was using a two-hand grinder to cut off bolts when the grinder slipped out of his hand and hit his left arm. The spinning cut-off wheel deeply cut into his left arm between the wrist and elbow, requiring hospitalization. The grinder guard was removed at the time of the incident.

An employee was clearing scrap from the exit end of a preformer machine when his middle finger was caught in the machine punch, cutting and amputating his fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee lacerated the top of the left middle toe.
An employee was rolling tarps when his right arm was caught in a roller, resulting in an open compound fracture to the right forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam in a machine and amputated the left index fingertip. The machine was running and was not guarded at the time of the incident.
During the offloading of a tanker truck, an employee's arm became entrapped in the PTO pump.  The employee suffered an arm amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to conduct roof maintenance when the ladder slipped. The employee lost balance and fell, suffering a fractured scapula, rib, and pelvis.

An employee was grinding the corners off of a part using a router table. The employee's left hand slipped off the part and into the machine's blades resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was setting up a ski run for opening day when his skis became caught in the snow, causing him to fall. He fractured his right tibia and fibula and his left elbow.
An employee was repairing the hydraulic line of a lift truck when the employee's elbow became stuck between the forklift mast, causing a compression fracture and broken blood vessels.

An employee was helping a powered industrial truck move a storage rack when the rack fell and landed on the employee's leg, resulting in an open fracture to the left tibia. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was preparing to weld on a bar joist when the bar joist rolled off one end of a saw horse and pinned the employee. The employee suffered a hip fracture.
An employee fell off a truck and broke his left wrist and cracked his heel bone.
An employee was preparing rigging to lift concrete piers when his left hand was pinched between the chain and the pier as the lift was initiated, amputating a finger(s).
An employee was repairing a railing on a fire escape when the counterbalance came loose from the wall. The fire escape and employee then fell to the ground. He suffered back and leg injuries.
An employee received an electric shock while turning off an electric breaker, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee suffered a left index finger amputation while installing punches on a press.
On November 22, 2017, an employee's right hand was pulled into the gears of a commercial paper shredder. The employee's hand had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was operating a forklift when the employee lost control of the forklift. It flipped over onto its right side, and the employee jumped out. While jumping out, the employee's toes were crushed by an overhead guard, amputating several toes.
An employee was offloading a cargo pallet from an aircraft when his right index finger was pinched and fractured between the pallet and a dolly lock, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was tripping out pipes when a pipe swung and crushed his right arm between two hanging pipes. His arm broke.

An employee was using a pickup truck to jumpstart a battery. He was standing on the truck bumper when the battery sparked and startled him. He then fell off the truck onto the pavement, fracturing his spine and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to loosen a tool with a wrench when his finger was caught between the wrench and the object he was loosening, resulting in an amputation.

On 11/23/2017, at approximately 12:47 p.m., an employee tripped on an uneven curb while going into a patient's home. The employee fell and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was setting up a tray for a procedure. He was opening a glass ampoule when the broken glass struck and cut his left hand.
An employee lost balance and fell down the last three-to-four steps of a staircase, suffering a fractured skull and ruptured right eardrum. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting a conveyor for remaining food product after a first wash-down when he dropped his flashlight inside the machine. He was attempting to retrieve the flashlight when his left arm became caught in the conveyor belt, fracturing his ulna and radius.
An employee was spinning a car wheel by hand when his hand slipped and was caught between the wheel spokes and the brake caliper, lacerating his right middle finger.
An employee was organizing doors when one fell and struck the employee's right foot, causing multiple fractures.
An employee suffered an injury while pulling a pole butt on a concrete metering pedestal that leaned over and pinned him. He sustained rib and back injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a belt when his right index finger was caught and amputated in the belt and pulley.
Two employees were moving a roller. When the second employee let go of the roller, it pinched and amputated the first employee's left index finger.

An employee removed product from an upper shelf while standing on a step ladder. She was then coming down the step ladder with product in her hands when she missed the bottom two steps and fell to the floor, fracturing her left knee and hitting her head. She was hospitalized.

An employee engaged a truck's power take-off and exited the vehicle to offload shredded paper. The vehicle started to roll. He attempted to re-enter the cab and his left arm was caught in the door causing lacerations to his left wrist and forearm.

On November 24, 2017, an employee picked up a piece of plywood that was covering a hole on a roof. The plywood was not marked as a hole. He stepped forward and fell through the hole to the ground, breaking his elbow and pelvis and suffering a brain bruise and concussion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing siding on a house's exterior wall while standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder. He was attempting to step onto another 8-foot A-frame ladder when one of the ladders fell. He then fell 6 feet to the ground and hit his head on the ladder's leg. He was hospitalized with a laceration and fracture to the head.
On November 24, 2017, an employee slipped and fell while exiting a semi-truck, suffering a broken left leg and requiring hospitalization.

While employees were standing for roll call in the warehouse, a temporary employee began hitting another employee with a handheld RF scanner. The injured employee received severe facial injuries and was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was walking toward the parking garage from the facility when the employee tripped on a sprinkler head near the sidewalk and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right patella and fractured left radius.

An employee was attempting to insert a catheter on a patient when she became violent and kicked the employee, who then contacted an adjacent wall. The employee suffered a fractured hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was energizing an auger when the employee dropped a tool into the machine. While trying to retrieve the tool, the employee's hand was pulled into the auger's rotating equipment, breaking it.
An employee ran into a pipe fence while operating an ATV, suffering head/facial injuries.
While transferring vehicles in the lot, an employee was struck by a vehicle that was being stolen.

An employee was painting while standing on an A-frame ladder. He slipped while stepping onto the ladder's third step. One foot stayed within the ladder while the rest of his body fell back. His back right leg landed on the floor while his left leg was stuck in the ladder. He suffered numbness in the saddle region along the medical aspect of his left thigh.
An employee was preparing to put gas in his truck. As he climbed down from his cab, he slipped and fell on the edge of the gas pump's elevated concrete floor, breaking ribs on his left side.
An employee was walking around his truck placing traffic cones when he tripped and fell over a cone, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working in the deli prep area when she slipped on grease on the floor and broke her left foot.

An employee was kneeling underneath a conveyor belt to troubleshoot the tug belt loader. When he went to stand up, his left forearm contacted the moving roller instead of the stationary bar and was fractured.

An employee was walking on a bar grate about to perform maintenance on a metal detector when the bar grate fell 11 feet 5 inches onto the work platform below. He landed on his feet on the platform below him, fracturing his left tibia and fibula.
An employee was removing a bearing from a dough lift when a pipe fell and hit the employee's left hand, resulting in two fingertip amputations.

An employee was on top of an air handler, troubleshooting it. As he came down, he twisted his ankle and fell on the cover of the air handler's pulley/belt drive, knocking the cover off of the rotating pulley system. Two of his fingers were then caught and amputated in the rotating pulley system.

An employee was securing a rope around a bag on the bottom of a dust collector when the rope became entangled around the employee's left thumb, causing a laceration and amputation above the first joint.

A garbage truck driver was collecting trash when a trash can became stuck at the top of his truck. He climbed to the top of the truck and fell approximately 10 feet, hitting his head on the pavement. He suffered a hematoma and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward a sink in the bathroom when she slipped on water and fell, hitting her head on the floor. She was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was unloading from a ski lift when another skier grabbed the employee and pulled him from the lift. He fell and broke his left femur.
An employee was sand blasting metal when the sand blasting nozzle came in close proximity to the employee's inner thigh, causing a laceration.
An employee was shredding chicken using a machine when his right hand entered the hopper and contacted the blades, amputating his middle finger from the nailbed.

On November 27, 2017, at approximately 1:45 p.m., employees were replacing bad decking and roofing. Materials were torn off and handed to the injured employee, who then placed the materials in a cart and transported them to a chute. He was receiving materials when he tripped and fell into an area where the decking was bad. He fell 60 feet to the floor below, fracturing his left leg.
An employee was removing a test ball from a manhole. An excavator was lifting the test ball when it struck the employee's head, fracturing vertebrae in his neck.
An employee fell from a 12-foot step ladder while installing HVAC duct work, hitting the ground and breaking his ribs.
An employee was trimming a block of foam insulation with a bandsaw when his right hand contacted the blade, amputating his right thumb tip just above the nail (no bone loss).
An employee was installing an overhead electrical conductor when he strained his chest, requiring hospitalization. A pull strap was not used at the time of the incident.

An employee was removing a 120-gallon propane tank from a residential location. Two additional employees were assisting him. The employee determined that laying the tank down and rolling it out was the safest way to remove it. While rolling the tank, they needed to maneuver it between a shed and a tree. The space was just slightly wider than the tank (approximately 57 inches). As they approached the tree, the tank slid down against the shed, pinning the employee's finger between the tank and the shed. His left pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a golf cart for landscaping work when the wheel went into a bunker. The employee fell out, and the golf cart rolled into her, fracturing her back vertebrae.
An employee was moving a bundle of decking when he fell 26 feet, fracturing his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to dislodge a chuck of dried glue from a glue spreading machine when the rollers started moving and caught his finger between two rollers. His fingertip was amputated.

On November 27, 2017, an employee was unloading a yard tractor trailer when the driver pulled it away from the dock. The employee then fell from the trailer to the concrete parking lot, breaking a leg in two places.
An employee was on the third rung of a rolling ladder (about 2 feet above ground) when he slipped and hit his right leg on the corner of the ladder, breaking his tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee was polishing a part on a polishing wheel when the part slipped or moved. One of the employee's left-hand fingers was caught and partially amputated in the wheel.

An employee was using a hydraulic pallet jack to move product in the warehouse when his right hand was caught between the handle and frame of the pallet jack, fracturing bones and tearing tendons in his ring and pinky fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to unjam a wire cutting machine when the machine blades caught and amputated his right middle finger near the fingertip.

On November 27, 2017, at 9:45 a.m., an employee was trying to manually roll a log in the log yard when it rolled back toward him and pinched his right pinky finger against another stationary log. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was trying to unjam a trolley chain when his fingers were caught in the belt, amputating his right pointer, middle, and ring fingertips at the distal joint. The equipment was not shut down at the time.

An employee was checking on other employees' work progress on a production line and stepped up onto a metal conveyor. It tipped forward and then back onto his lower left leg/ankle, causing abrasions, lacerations, and a chipped bone to his left tibia.
An employee was helping another employee move steel beams when the beams injured his left hand, causing lacerations and broken bones.

An employee was disassembling hydraulic components to determine the source(s) of a hydraulic system failure. The employee removed the track drive motor assembly from a bulldozer and placed it on a workbench to perform a complete cleanout procedure on the hydraulic assembly. The employee was operating a pneumatic impact driver with the right hand to remove a bolt while supporting/holding a hydraulic servo with the left hand. The servo rotated and pinched the employee s left index fingertip between the machined edges of the servo and the hydraulic motor housing, resulting in a distal amputation (about 3/8 inch) of the finger.
An employee was making a delivery when she missed some steps and fell, breaking her left ankle.

An employee was lowering a ramp from a loading dock to a tractor trailer when the handle slipped out of his hand and he fell off the loading dock to the ground, injuring his left ankle and left shoulder.

At approximately 1:00 AM on November 28, 2017, an employee was backing up a poly wheel using an approximately 1-inch ratchet. As the wheel was freed, it caused the motor pulley to spin. The gears inside the ratchet then caught and pinched the employee's right pinky finger between the wrench handle and stationary conduit raceway above the area, causing an open fracture to the employee's right pinky finger that resulted in a surgical amputation at the middle knuckle.

On November 28, 2017, an employee was attempting to remove a jam from a bubble manufacturing machine when the employee's right ring finger was caught and lacerated in the drive chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was tightening bolts on a pump jack with an impact wrench and 18-inch crescent wrench when it slipped. While trying to grab the wrench, the employee's hand was slammed against the pump jack, severing the last two digits of the left pinky finger.

An employee was operating a press brake with a stack of 16-gauge metal on an adjacent table. The stack tipped and began to fall. The employee braced himself against the press to stop the metal from falling. The stack of metal fell and activated the press. The employee's left pinky finger was in the point of operation and amputated.
An employee was picking up product from a freezer when a forklift ran over her right foot.

An employee was helping a customer cut an electrical cable. After the cable was cut, the customer pulled the cable and it was dragged behind the feet of the injured employee, causing her to trip and fall. She hit her head on the ground.
A scissor lift tipped over while an employee was inside of it.
On 11/28/2017, at 1:40 p.m., an employee was palletizing items on a pallet when a forklift operator drove over her right foot, breaking it.
An employee was loading a trash can onto the back of a garbage truck when his left middle finger was caught between the container and truck apparatus, amputating the fingertip skin.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw when his fingertip was caught in the saw blade, amputating the tip of his right middle fingernail.
An employee suffered a left ring finger amputation while cutting materials with a table saw.

While standing on a ladder and installing light fixtures, an employee touched live wires and was thrown from the ladder. The employee suffered a fractured tailbone from the fall and electrical burns to the right thumb and left shoulder from the live wires.
An employee fell off a ladder, suffering a possible fracture to the scapula, as well as head and neck injuries.

An employee was adjusting a tilted piece of pipe that was being held by a gripper on a band saw. As he was adjusting the pipe, the gripper caught his right pinky fingertip between it and the pipe, causing a partial amputation. The employee's pinky fingertip was later surgically amputated at the nailbed.
An employee was driving an ATV on the property when the throttle became stuck. The ATV then hit a sidewalk and flipped over, ejecting the employee. The employee suffered arm and hand fractures.
An employee was operating a surface grinder when the grinder's rotating wheel struck the employee's left hand, resulting in amputations of the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was attempting to move an extrusion head weighing several hundred pounds off a work table to a transfer cart when the extrusion head fell onto his leg, breaking it.
An employee was attempting to unfreeze brakes when an empty trailer rolled over the employee's legs. The employee suffered a broken leg, lacerations, and an internal injury.
An employee was exiting the bathroom when his ankle gave way and he fell, fracturing his ankle.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs when she missed a step, tripped, and fractured her ankle.
An employee was dumping a trash hopper into a larger bin using a forklift and crushed three fingers on the right hand resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
Two employees were attempting to deliver an order to a residential establishment when an assailant shot at them. One employee was hit in the right arm.
An employee was walking up stairs, missed a step, and fell down the stairs resulting in a shoulder and hip injury.
An employee was walking between two buildings on an outdoor level when she tripped and fell to the ground. She injured her right hip and suffered a small cut above her left eye.
An employee fell while installing windows at a customer's residence, suffering a concussion and dislocated finger. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 28, 2017, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was installing telephone service in the basement of a residential customer. He was standing on the second rung of a fiberglass step ladder when one of the ladder hinges buckled, causing him to fall to the basement floor. He fractured his tibia and fibula, requiring surgery.
An employee was working in the yard when he was struck by a reversing trailer, fracturing his hip.
A temporary employee fell 15 feet from a rolling staircase ladder onto the concrete floor, breaking a hip, wrist, and rib and suffering brain bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was packing up shoes in a heavy plastic case when it fell and lacerated his right index finger. The laceration became infected, and his right index fingertip and entire middle finger had to be amputated.
A stand-up forklift operator was backing out of a bay when he swung around to miss a rack behind him and struck the injured employee, who suffered a broken right leg.
A crew had just installed a high volume separator in an oil field when a blowout occurred. One employee sustained head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was on stairs applying insulation above his head when he lost his balance and fell, hitting a protruding pipe and breaking his left hip.

An employee was watching the control panel of a cotton gin when the lint cleaner became jammed. He turned the gin off and was attempting to remove the jam when his left hand was caught in the still turning saw blades, resulting in amputation of three left-hand fingers.
On November 28, 2017, an employee had removed a microline valve that controls the flow of hot tallow when the valve leaked and sprayed the tallow (180 F) on his body, burning his chest.
A forklift had just removed angled rebar from a flatbed when it struck a pothole, causing the angled iron to fall and strike an employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was standing on a grill cleaning the bun warmer. He stepped down onto a step stool and it slid, causing him to fall on a board (cheese) warmer and break three ribs.
On November 29, 2017, at approximately 9:15 a.m., an employee was repositioning his climbing line when he fell 50 feet from a tree and fractured his right leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder helping to install new lighting fixtures inside a drop ceiling when the employee contacted a live bare conductor and received an electrical shock, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a wood-wool machine to trim wood. He was attempting to rotate a wood piece when his fingers were pinched between the wood and a machine roller, partially amputating his right middle finger and causing soft tissue damage to his middle and ring fingers. Cut-resistant gloves and safety glasses were worn at the time.

An employee was standing on a pallet being lifted by a forklift to change out a light fixture. He tried to cut into a live cable with wire cutters and was shocked. He then lost his balance and fell 20 feet onto metal pipes below, suffering a head fracture, shoulder fracture, and left hand burns.

An employee was operating a forklift to pick up a pallet of finished product from a stretch wrapper when the employee lost control of the forklift. The employee's right arm then struck a post guarding the shrink wrapper, fracturing the radius.
An employee was putting a part on a punch press when the employee's right hand entered the press, amputating his index finger.

An employee was changing a motor and gearbox on a thermoforming machine. During the process, the shaft stayed up in the platen. While he was positioning the motor using his hands, the shaft released, causing the table to go to the lowest position and the arms to raise up. This created a scissor-like motion, which amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee's left arm was caught in a printer while clearing a paper jam, breaking it.

An employee was putting up a banner with bungee cords from a ladder when the bungee cord broke and snapped into the employee. He then fell from the ladder and hit his head on the extended arm of an automotive hoist, suffering a head laceration and blunt trauma.

An employee was performing framing operations when he tripped and then fell against a wooden midrail. The midrail broke and he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground, lacerating his head and bruising a shoulder.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a ladder, sustaining broken ribs.
An employee was fixing a broken pipe connected to an asphalt cement truck when the pipe leaked. Hot asphalt then contacted and burned the employee's right arm and right ear.

An employee was on a ladder clearing a branch over some powerlines in the back of the facility when the ladder fell sideways and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken ankle that required surgery and overnight hospitalization.

A crew was pulling a second string of tubing out of a hole and was warming up a collar to break the connection. A swivel operator was spinning the swivel when an employee placed a 36-inch pipe wrench on the top part of the swivel, then placed a cheater bar on the pipe wrench. The swivel continued to turn clockwise with the pipe wrench and cheater bar attached. The employee was still holding onto the cheater bar when it started turning. The employee was then pulled and thrown off the rig floor, suffering a broken clavicle, broken ribs, collapsed right lung, and broken back.
An employee slipped and fell while walking on a partially constructed walkway beam. His right leg became wedged and fractured on a support brace during the fall.

An employee was re-installing a 75-pound barrel on an injection molding machine when the barrel slipped. As the employee tried to catch it, the barrel crushed and amputated the employee's left pinky finger.

An employee was attempting to check a discharge pipe on a rotary seal machine when the employee's glove was caught by the rotary seal blade. The blade then amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was removing metal stake truck bed side gates when he tripped over the gates on the ground, dislocating his right hip and fracturing his right leg.

An employee was traveling through an area where a lowboy flatbed was being moved when the lowboy trailer struck and ran over the employee. The employee suffered multiple fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a 6-foot ladder when the employee's foot slipped on one of the steps. The employee then fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, injuring the left wrist and left side of the hip.

An employee was using a lift (most likely scissor lift) to remove plastic that was stuck on pallets when he lost his balance and fell 10 to 15 feet off the lift to the ground, breaking both wrists and shattering his knee. The lift was unguarded at the time.

Employees were standing on the median edge of an interstate lane's inside shoulder, removing traffic control barrels. They were behind the guardrail when a private vehicle lost control and struck another vehicle, which left the road and hit two employees. One employee was hospitalized with a broken leg, broken finger, and head laceration. The employee had surgery.
An employee was bolting a 20" pipe when the restrainer gave way and released the pipe cap. The pipe then struck and fractured the employee's left hip socket.
An employee came around a corner and tripped over a hand basket that was on the floor. She fell to the floor and fractured her left hand.

An employee was loading roofing shingles on the roof of a new construction residential home and had installed one anchor point on the roof. He then removed the anchor point and was scooting to a new location to reinstall the anchor when he slipped off the roof and landed on the ground below. He fractured his left arm between the elbow and shoulder, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was helping another employee move a concrete slab when it moved out of place and fell on the employee's right femur.
On November 29, 2017, an employee was moving a piece of equipment when the employee's left pinky fingertip was pinched and amputated between the equipment and a mounting framework.

An employee was climbing a ladder when it fell, causing the employee to ride it to the ground. The employee suffered a broken hip and jaw. The ladder was not 3 feet above the roof edge or tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was on a roof during construction work when the employee fell through a removed section of the roof. The employee suffered broken ribs and a back injury.
An employee was verifying the accuracy of field construction compared to engineering drawings when he fell to the ground, injuring his head and breaking vertebrae.
An employee was struck by a steel beam and hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to perform a load test on a customer's uninterrupted power supply system. The employee was making the final connection between the customer battery system and a string of temporary batteries. Upon attempting connection of the two connectors, an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to both of the employee's hands.

An employee was removing a ground from a power transmission line when either the line struck the employee or he grabbed the line from the hot stick. He received fourth degree electrical burns on his leg, requiring hospitalization.

On November 30, 2017, an employee was performing a daily inspection of the spiral conveyor at the employer's retail distribution facility. To access the drive chain, the employee crawled beneath the conveyor and used his left hand to brace himself as he performed the inspection. He had a rag wrapped around his left hand that was positioned near the moving chain. The rag became entangled pulling his hand into the moving chain and amputating his left middle fingertip. The conveyor was not locked out or guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a table saw when the saw blade cut and amputated three of his right-hand fingers.

An employee was standing on a 20-inch high chain conveyor while moving elevated paint cartons. When he went to step off the conveyor, his foot slipped and his leg became pinned, causing his leg to twist. He broke both bones in his lower left leg.

An employee was attempting to clean material build-up off of a rotoformer machine's rotating belt when his glove was caught by the rotating parts, pulling his right hand into the machine and lacerating his palm. He required surgery.
On November 30, 2017, an employee was laying down a single person lift to move through a doorway when he lost his grip. The lift fell on and broke his leg.

An employee was descending the ramp in shop #3 when the fork truck began to accelerate. The employee attempted to slow it down by pulling the throttle pedal. The fork truck continued picking up speed because the throttle pedal was stuck so the employee attempted to pull the key out of the ignition to slow it down. The employee clipped the guardrail while trying to unstick the throttle catching his foot between the fork truck and a 6-inch railing resulting in a compound fracture of the left leg and a dislocated ankle with a hematoma.
An employee was loading raw product into a carburizing furnace when the employee's left index finger was pinched, resulting in an amputation to the finger.
While chipping brush, an employee lost footing, slipped, and fell down an embankment to the ground. The employee suffered head and nose lacerations.
An employee was bent down and cleaning the bottom of a door when a piece of glass fell from the level above and hit her head, causing a concussion.

An employee was attempting to release an overhead door that was stuck in the raised position. The employee was pulling slack cable from around the wheel inside of the track when the door suddenly dropped, making the cable taut. The cable then sliced and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was servicing a horizontal panel saw that showed an error code for the score blade position. As the employee manually lowered the score blade, the saw carriage tried to return to the 'home' position. The employee was then caught between the saw carriage and the floor of the facility, suffering broken ribs, a fractured jaw, and lacerations.

An employee was pushing a wheeled cart by another cart when the two carts collided, causing vinyl doors to fall off the cart and onto the employee. The employee suffered a scraped shoulder and required knee surgery.
On 11/30/2017, an employee was using a fax machine when she fell and broke her arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing a pipe into a drainage structure when his thumb was caught and amputated between the pipe and structure.

An employee was walking on a roof to identify areas to work on from drawings when the employee fell 13 feet, 10 inches, through the roof to the ground. The employee broke the left leg and was hospitalized.

On November 20, 2017, a temporary employee was moving a piece of metal with a clamp to a plasma cutting table when the piece of metal came out of the clamp and struck the employee's leg causing a lower right leg fracture.

On November 30, 2017, at approximately 5:35 PM, an employee was walking by a scrap vacuum blower when he made contact with the cloth part of the blower, breaking the plane. The vacuum blower then caught and amputated his left index, middle, ring, and little fingers.

A cement crew had finished a surface cement job and was preparing to rig down the cement head and equipment. An employee was preparing to remove the cementing head and manifold from the casing. The drilling rig crew loosened the chain boomer and lifted the casing to remove the slips. When the rig operator lifted the casing, the hook on the chain boomer broke, striking the employee in the hard hat and knocking him to the rig floor. He hit his head on the floor, losing consciousness and suffering a head laceration.
An employee was attempting to remove a tool from a milling machine when the tool arm closed on the tool and pinched his left thumb, lacerating it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was positioning a piece of cardboard under a work table while two other employees held the table up when the table was dropped on top of her finger, which needed to be amputated.
An employee was changing a battery on a forklift when his left index finger was pinched and amputated between a spreader bar and a hook.
An employee was removing the sales tag from a golf card using a pocket knife when the knife slipped and punctured his forearm.
A temporary employee was hospitalized for lacerations and contusions to the front and left side of his face after fighting another associate.

An employee was moving an outdoor security camera from one building to another using a scissor lift when the wheel ran over a curb and fell into a hole below. The lift then tipped, and the employee fell 11 feet, breaking his leg.

An employee was preparing to move a steel bar stock. As he stepped back to allow a second employee to grab the other end of the bar, he lost his footing and fell. The bar then landed on him, hitting his knee and shoulder. He suffered torn tendons, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
A flagger was struck by a vehicle resulting in a soft tissue injury.
While unloading a trailer, an employee started feeling ill and had severe cramps. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was removing weeds from a roll topper when his right hand was pulled into the rotating rollers, crushing his hand and amputating a fingertip.
An employee was helping to position a barrier when both of his feet were struck by a concrete barrier, amputating three digits on his left foot and two digits on his right foot.

An employee was unloading tools and supplies from the bed of a pickup truck when the employee slipped on frost/ice that was in the bed of the truck. The employee fell off the bed and suffered a concussion, cervical and shoulder strains, and a tailbone fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pruning hedges with shears while working from an orchard ladder when he fell to the ground, breaking his left wrist and hip.
An employee was struck by a pallet jack while unloading a trailer, fracturing the right leg in two places.
An employee fell to the ground while exiting the side door of a truck, breaking the left hip.
A temporary employee operating a leaf blower stepped up on a curb, fell backwards, and hit his head. He was hospitalized.

A crane was lowering a concrete plank onto the first floor of a work site while an employee was providing direction (by radio) to the crane operator. The concrete plank hit a plumbing-up cable for steel and bounced back, coming toward the employee. He then fell approximately 15 feet from the first floor to the dirt floor below, injuring his hip and breaking some ribs.

An employee was crouched down beside the drilling machine and reached his hand up to lift himself up, during which time he bumped the power switch. His left index finger got past the guard and was amputated between the belt and pulley.

An employee was checking air pressure using a gauge and stacking wheels when his hand entered an auto-inflator head. His left hand was pinched between the head, tire, and wheel, resulting in a partial thumb amputation.
An employee was removing tree parts and pieces and suffered an electrical shock that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut a baseboard when the saw amputated the employee's pinky finger and partially amputated the ring and middle fingers.

On November 30, 2017, an employee was attempting to grease a tube mill bearing when the employee's coat was caught by the mill's rollers. The employee's forearm was pulled into the machine and caught/crushed between the rollers.
On November 30, 2017, an employee was webbing up a roller with paper when the employee's right hand was caught between two rollers, amputating the ring and middle fingertips.

An employee was helping to move a lime train in the yard when he noticed a coal car moving on its own. He was attempting to stop the car by activating the brakes when it ran over and severely injured his left leg, requiring surgical amputation above the knee.
An employee was maneuvering a boom truck when the vehicle tipped over on its side and ejected the employee, who suffered a dislocated wrist.
An employee was driving a dump truck. The dump bed was raised and hit a bridge overpass, causing the truck to tumble. The employee was hospitalized.

On December 1, 2017, at 1:40 p.m., an employee was cutting stock metal with a horizontal metal band saw. He attempted to align the stock metal and his hand was caught and drawn into the band saw blade, severing the three outer fingers of his right hand.
An employee tripped and fell off the back of a delivery van while unloading packages, contacting the ground and suffering a laceration and fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a packer machine and used a push bar to remove excess tuna from a metal plate located just beyond a conveyor belt and roller. She was attempting to grab the tuna when the packer knife caught and amputated her right index and middle fingertips.

An employee was securing a flat hose to a reel on a deployment vehicle when the hose rotated. The employee was then caught between the reel and the deployment vehicle, fracturing the skull, jaw, and cheekbones.
An employee was attempting to climb up an angle iron piece of a substructure when he slipped and fell backward 4 feet to the ground, suffering a spiral fracture to his right ankle.
An employee was removing parts from a shot blast machine when the door inadvertently closed on his arm, fracturing his left ulna and radius bones.
An employee was unloading freight from a forklift to a truck when the freight load flipped and fell on his right arm, breaking it.

An employee was 11 feet up on an extension ladder, installing straps into a window opening, when the ladder moved. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder, landing over the ladder on the ground. He fractured his right leg.

On November 30, 2017, an employee attached a plate clamp to the side of a 5x10 piece of sheet metal that was 0.5 inch thick. The plate clamp was connected to an overhead electric hoist installed on a jib crane. The clamp was attached to the side away from the plasma table; the clamp was manually tightened. The employee lifted the clamp and sheet up enough to clear the top of the table and moved the bottom of the sheet to the table's edge and then proceeded to lay the metal flat on the table. The employee had to make adjustments to the metal's position and stood up on the table. After the last adjustment, the employee went to get off the table and the sheet fell from the clamp. The sheet struck the back of the employee's legs as it fell to the table resulting in broken bones in the right leg.
An employee was bagging potatoes when his left little finger was caught between the chain and sprocket of the bagging machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning pipe rollers next to a pipe threading machine when his hand was caught between a pipe and the rollers, amputating his right middle fingertip.

Two employees were moving a scissor lift from the third level to the fourth when another employee's head became pinned between a concrete beam and the top rail of the lift. The injured employee sustained multiple contusions to the chin, cheek bones, nose, temple and eye sockets.

An employee was conducting mechanical maintenance on a flexible packing machine when packaging plastic became intertwined and was not sealing/cutting correctly. His right hand contacted the machine's cutting shears, amputating his right index fingertip. The machine was not properly guarded or locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was working a restaurant bar when a customer struck the employee's face with a glass. The employee suffered a laceration and was hospitalized.

On December 1, 2017, an employee was insulating an HVAC system in an attic when the employee stepped onto a foam panel and fell through the ceiling, lacerating and breaking a wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking across a job site looking for rebar when he tried to get on a 15-inch-high concrete slab. He then tripped and fell on the edge of the slab, which had a bolt sticking out of it, fracturing four ribs and lacerating his chest.
An employee was unscrewing a cap to connect a hose when hot liquid asphalt sprayed and burned both of his arms.
An employee was loading a fuel truck when he fell and hit his head on the ground.

An employee was pushing a cart filled with large and heavy packages when the employee's right hand was pinched between the cart frame and a handrail. The employee's right pinky fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was attempting to unjam a conveyor belt when his right jacket sleeve was caught in the tail guard, resulting in a cut and bruises to his right arm.

An employee was diagnosing a problem with a bump truck's steering. His left hand was between a stationary object and the steering components when a second employee rotated the steering wheel. The employee's left hand was crushed, suffering swelling.

An employee was hooking up a heavy part for an overhead crane to hoist off a machine when the part dropped and pinched the employee's finger between a strap and a lifting eye bolt. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving bails of insulation when he began to feel ill and vomited. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a lifter to lift a rack of steel sheets when the lifter caught the edge of a hot block. The hot block then kicked toward the employee's left hand, pinching it between the hot block and lifter body. The employee's ring fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was replacing a cable on a truck-mounted crane when the employee's left thumb was caught between the crane's drum and mounting bracket, amputating the tip.
An employee was moving material and stacking it in piles when a wood splinter punctured his glove and thumb. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press brake. His left hand was in the point of operation when the machine was actuated, smashing and causing trauma to his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw while using a push plate when the saw cut her right index finger. Her fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to grab an indicator near a lathe's cutting area when his shirt sleeve was caught on the lathe cutter. His arm was then pulled between the cutter and the roll, severing tendons in his arm.
An employee was using scissors to cut a length of twine when the scissors cut off his fingertip.

An employee was exiting the excavator when his foot slipped causing him to stumble on the uneven surface. As he attempted to maintain his balance, he fell forward extending his left arm and landing on his left hand/wrist. The left wrist was fractured.
An employee was working at a filing cabinet when another employee entered the room and struck the employee's back with the door. He was hospitalized with body twitching due to possible nerve damage.
On 12/1/2017, a lineman suffered an electrical shock and was hospitalized.
An employee was turning a mixer to clean it when the employee's finger was pinched and lacerated between the leg and drain plug of the equipment's oil reservoir.
An employee was leaning over the edge of a self-adjusting dock when the dock dropped and caught the edge of the employee's finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was showing a customer a wine rack on the sales floor when the rack hit the top of the employee's head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by the upright section of a pallet rack that fell and was hospitalized with a fracture.
An employee was picking up a steel cap when the load shifted and pinched his right foot, dislocating his big toe.

An employee was breaking down equipment for shut down. He was cleaning a heater when his right ring finger was pinched between the heater and an anvil, removing the soft tissue and fingernail from his fingertip.
An employee was attempting to troubleshoot a clogged crane auger when a piece of drill spoil fell 55 feet and struck his hardhat, injuring the back of his head and neck.

An employee was climbing a ladder to investigate a work area when the ladder moved. The employee then fell approximately 4 feet, landing on the concrete below and an empty 5-gallon bucket. The employee suffered broken wrists and vertebra.

An employee was cleaning a belt conveyor with a pressure washer when his smock was caught on a rotating shaft in the conveyor. As he tried to free his smock, his hand was caught and injured in a sprocket, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized with a hand injury after being struck by a fan casing while performing maintenance.
On December 2, 2017, an employee had been driving a stand-up lift when he passed out and struck his head. Another employee found him unconscious. He was hospitalized with a head contusion.
An employee was moving a box from a pallet to a shelf when she experienced severe pain in her lower back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing rocks that had been caught by a screen above a roller when the employee's right hand was caught between the rollers, partially amputating three fingers.
An employee was cutting down a tree with a chainsaw when the tree shifted and fell on top of the employee's legs. The employee suffered multiple fractures to both legs.
An employee's finger was caught between a cable reel and a tire, resulting in a contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a power head mounted to the back of a flathead when his right hand was caught between a pipe wrench and the bar on the power head, amputating his ring finger.

An employee was attempting to clear a bone jam on a conveyor when his frock became caught in the conveyor's pulley system. His right forearm was then pinched and fractured. The bone drop area of the conveyor was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was lowering a lid onto an extraction basket when the lid crushed and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was splashed by hot water while cleaning, suffering burns to the stomach, arms, and feet.

An employee was performing maintenance on a rotary wheel machine and attempting to make an adjustment when the employee's right arm became caught in the machine. The employee's arm had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was reassembling a milk/fat centrifugal separator. An overhead hoist was lowering stainless steel disks into the separator housing when the employee's left small finger was caught under the disks. The sharp edges of the disks amputated the employee's fingertip (1/4 inch).
An employee was walking and was struck by a forward-moving pallet jack resulting in a crushing injury to their foot.

An employee was operating a front-end loader to remove ash from the box of a power house generator that creates steam for wood drying kilns. The employee was dumping the hot ash into the bucket of another front-end loader when the hot ash blew back into the cab and contacted the employee's body. The employee suffered third degree burns to the right arm, second degree burns to the left arm and both legs, and minor burns to the face. The ashes had not been wet down or cooled at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to move merchandise from an overhead shelf while standing on a two-step stepstool. The employee then lost balance and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing the left femur.

An employee was cleaning a rotating part in a lathe machine when his left gloved finger was caught in the rotating part, resulting in a partial amputation to the left pinky finger and a fractured wrist.
An employee was bent over straightening a shelf of merchandise when he stood up and fell, striking his head and neck on the floor. He fractured his second and third vertebrae.

An employee was stocking a room in the labor and delivery department when she tripped over the cords to a fetal monitor. She fell forward and struck the floor, fracturing her left humerus and shoulder and lacerating her lip.
An employee was repairing a leaking valve when another valve opened and hot water was pumped into the system. The hot water scalded the employee, who suffered second degree burns.
An employee was walking on a ground level sidewalk when he stumbled, rupturing his right quadriceps tendon and partially rupturing his left quadriceps tendon.

An employee was helping to free a stuck pallet from the forks of a hand truck. She stepped up onto the pallet to use her weight to hold the pallet down. A second employee pulled on the hand truck and the momentum caused the employee to lose her balance and fall, injuring her hip.
An employee twisted her left leg while walking, suffering a pulled muscle/hematoma that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a cutter to cut smoked ham when the cutter amputated her left thumb tip.

An employee backed a trailer toward a customer's dock, then actuated the customer's dock lock and movable dock plate to bridge the height difference between the trailer threshold and dock. The mechanized dock plate would not clear the trailer threshold so that it would smoothly go into place. The employee grabbed the edge of the dock plate and attempted to lift and guide it into place. The dock plate then pinched his right hand against the trailer and tore off his right ring fingertip.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a 1 x 3 foot piece of plywood when his left-hand fingers made contact with the saw blade, partially amputating the distal tip of his ring finger and lacerating his ring and index fingers.
An employee was hoisting a motor with an "A" frame when the frame fell on and broke the employee's ankle and lower foot.
An employee was hospitalized due to a laceration.
An employee slipped and fell in the snowy parking lot, fracturing the left ankle.
An employee was hospitalized after breaking her index finger in a car door.

An employee was operating a hydraulic press when a part shifted inside the press's point of operation. The employee was attempting to reposition the part inside the point of operation when the press activated and amputated the employee's finger. The point of operation was unguarded and the press was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was working at a discharge canyon assembly and pushing two assembly pieces together when his left pinky fingertip was pinched between the pieces, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was cleaning a steel plate saw's chip chute when his right ring finger was caught and amputated between the clamp and the chip chute. The saw was running at the time.

On December 4, 2017, an employee was rehearsing a 25-foot fall from a platform onto stunt pads when the stunt riggers had to stop her descent with the safety line. She suffered a hyperflexion injury to her lower back.
An employee lost balance and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was manually adjusting a finishing saw stop when her right thumb was caught between the stop and the roller rail. She suffered an amputation to her right thumb (nail area).

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when he turned a corner and ran into a stationary forklift. His left ankle hit the forks of the stationary forklift, suffering an open fracture and dislocation.
An employee walked across a floor that was in the process of being re-waxed. She slipped on the wet floor and fell, fracturing her right elbow.

While working on a printing press, an employee noticed a problem and went to investigate. The employee was behind the press with a rag when it became caught in the ingoing nip point, pulling the employee's right hand into the press. The employee suffered a right-hand de-gloving followed by finger amputations.
An employee was stung by a bee while closing a valve.
An employee was replenishing wire on a baler when the baler was engaged. The wire then looped around the employee's left index finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was positioning an iron roughneck when his left middle finger was pinched between the lift nubbin and the roughneck, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was removing a copper cell when a weld on the copper cell ruptured, spewing molten copper onto the lower half of his body. He suffered third degree burns to the front and back of his body from the waist down.
An employee was adjusting the forks of an all-terrain forklift when his pinky finger was pinched between the forks, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was operating a press brake to fabricate seat mounting brackets when his right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the part and the press brake die.
An employee was attempting to free a jam on a conveyor when his arm was caught in the conveyor, breaking it. The conveyor was running and guarded at the time.

An employee was in a full bite suit, training a police dog on bite techniques. The dog chased the employee, then jumped and bit the suit, knocking the employee off balance. The employee contacted the ground, fracturing and dislocating the lower leg.
An employee was standing upright observing a trainee when a passing coworker bumped into her, causing her to lose balance and fall backwards. She was hospitalized overnight with a hip injury.
An employee was loading a power cell jack onto a truck when his finger was pinched between the jack and the truck, resulting in an amputation to one of his left-hand fingertips.
