An employee was chipping concrete from around the rollers of a truck when the drum turned and caught the employee's glove. The drum then pulled the skin on the employee's hand back from the knuckles toward the wrist. The truck was running at the time.

An employee was attempting to position a 16-foot foam block on its side to load it onto a truck. The injured employee was walking by when the block fell, striking and knocking him to the concrete ground. He suffered a facial laceration and herniated disk in his neck, requiring hospitalization.
A dump truck driver started to back up and did not see an employee that was walking behind the truck. The truck ran over the employee's legs.

An employee was using a small bending machine to bend a stainless 1/4 inch wide by 8 feet long metal rod into a circle. He was routing the material into the rollers when his fingers were caught in the rollers, resulting in a right middle finger amputation, first index (nail section).
An employee was dismounting from a pallet of boxes when he broke his femur.

An employee was using a forklift to empty a trash bin into a larger trash container. He dismounted the forklift to open the trash bin's door. When he opened the door, the release of the trash made the bin bounce on the forklift forks. His hand was on one of the forks when the bin moved, and his left index fingertip was crushed between the bin and the fork. His fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was operating a rough terrain forklift. As he was getting out of the cab, he fell to the ground fracturing the left arm, right leg and pelvis.

An employee was drilling holes in a concrete column with a hammer drill. While attempting to pull the drill out, he lost balance and grabbed onto the rotating drill bit, injuring several left-hand fingers.
An employee tripped and fell while exiting a loader, breaking his leg.
An employee was returning to the parking garage when the employee fell from the last step onto the garage and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was installing metal decking when another employee moved the decking into place where the employee's hand was located, partially amputating a finger.

An employee was loading a paper roll into a press. The employee had set the paper roll down with forklift clamps when it started to roll. As the employee tried to stop it, the force of the moving roll broke the employee's wrist.
An employee was working a counter when a customer entered the store and assaulted him. He suffered head and facial injuries.

On December 5, 2017, two employees were felling a tree on a powerline when a tree limb fell and struck them. One of the employees was hospitalized with a fractured skull, fractured shoulder blade, and fractured vertebrae.

An employee was standing on a motor while cleaning a carding machine. The employee was using a manually turned wheel to traverse the vacuum nozzle across the moving cylinder when his left arm was caught in the machine. He was hospitalized and his left arm was partially amputated.

An employee was standing in the basket of a scissor lift. As the basket was lowered, it lost power and hit the wall. The employee hit the side of the basket and broke three ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a meat band saw to cut a frozen pork hock when a piece of skin became caught and pushed his hand into the blade, cutting a finger.
While delivering mail, an employee went up to a house to see if it was vacant. A large dog then knocked her to the ground, breaking her right hip.
On December 5, 2017, an employee was attempting to retrieve a jammed piece of tubing from the drop-down rolls of a machine when the machine caught and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a gang saw when material became jammed in the planer section of the saw. He used the clutch mechanism to disengage the saw and then attempted to remove the jammed wood. However, the saw blade was still spinning and caught his coat sleeve. His right hand was then pulled into the spinning saw blade, amputating his thumb. The saw blade was uncovered at the time of the incident.
An employee was injecting fluids into a well. As he disconnected the hose, caustic solution sprayed his face.

An employee was trying to align cylinder connections on a cold nut forming machine to insert pins. He was using his left hand to feel for abnormalities to connect the pins when the machine suddenly activated, amputating his left thumb tip. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.
Two employees were attempting to light a pilot light on an incinerator when the gases ignited and back-flashed on them. They sustained facial and hand burns.
An employee was attaching a dairy hose from a bulk tank to a tanker when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught and amputated by a latch on the truck.
An employee was repositioning a displaced pallet full of cookies when the pallet shifted and fell on the employee's leg, fracturing the femur.

An employee was changing a machine's name plate when the employee's fingers became caught in the ingoing nip point between the machine's plate and arch cylinders, partially amputating the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee tripped on a curb as he was walking from the street into the front door of a building. He fell to the ground, striking his head, left shoulder, and left knee on the concrete sidewalk.
An employee was removing the sling from a piece of pipe. He set the nylon sling on the ground by his feet. He stepped back, tripped on the sling, and fell, breaking his wrist.

A maintenance employee was cutting a molded plastic platform using a handheld circular metal saw when he lost control and dropped the saw. The saw lacerated his right leg below the knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a fence post driver to install temporary fence posts. After he installed a post, he noticed that it was crooked. He was attempting to straighten it when he lost his footing. The post then swung back and hit him in the face, severely lacerating his nose and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was mixing mortar when he had trouble breathing. He was hospitalized for a possible allergic reaction.
An employee was cutting a board on a table saw when the board kicked back and struck the employee's stomach, causing internal bleeding.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground and suffered minor fractures.
An employee was attempting to clear a product jam on a breader machine's conveyor belt when he suffered lacerations to his first left-hand finger.

An employee fastened a load of steel beams and was moving them with an overhead crane. He reached the location where he was going to place the load and was lowering it when the load shifted. His right hand, which was guiding the load, was pinched between two of the beams, amputating his middle and ring fingers.

On 12/5/2017, an employee was using a reciprocating saw to cut a pipe while standing on a 12-foot stepladder. While he was making a second incision in the pipe, it swung down, hit the ladder, and knocked it over. He fell and his face hit the concrete floor, breaking a facial bone and causing cranium bleeding. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking into a closet when the motion light did not operate immediately. The employee then tripped over a chair and fell to the ground, breaking an arm.
An employee was servicing a forklift. When the panel was closed, it landed on his left hand and amputated two fingertips.

An employee was rebuilding a puller machine and had it locked out. The employee then re-energized and started the machine. Sometime after the machine was operational, the employee dropped a wrench on the floor next to the machine and attempted to pick it up with his right hand. His left hand was then pulled into the machine's belt and pulley system. The belt and pulley system was unguarded at the time.
An employee was assembling a control valve assembly. His left ring finger was in the valve opening when he applied air to test the valve. The valve moved and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a bundle of product. His hand was on the hook when he started to lift the load. His left ring fingertip was then pinched off between the load rigging and the hook.

An employee was making adjustments on a hydraulic machine used to bend metal. The employee's hand was resting on a steel block that was part of the machine when the block moved upwards. The employee's right middle finger was then caught and partially amputated between the block and the top of the machine.

An employee was using an overhead hoist to move an injection blow mold from a work bench to a pallet. The mold halves were being held together with a C-clamp. As the mold was being moved, it became entangled in the electrical cord for the hoist. The injured employee freed the mold from the electrical cord. The C-clamp then contacted the hoist beam supporting the leg and loosened, allowing the bottom half of the mold to fall. The mold struck the injured employee's left foot, lacerating it, fracturing the second metatarsal, and chipping the big toe bone. The employee was hospitalized.
On December 6, 2017, an employee was repairing a weapon when the weapon discharged and amputated a finger.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of rope attached to the outer flange of a machine when her glove and right hand were pulled into the turning machinery, amputating her right middle finger.
An employee was setting up chuck jaws on a piece of equipment when the employee was struck by a chuck wrench. The employee's index fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was shutting a latching mechanism on a piece of bakery equipment when his right hand and wrist were caught in the chain and gear. He suffered wrist injuries and a fingertip amputation. The equipment was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell off a ladder to the ground, breaking an arm and requiring hospitalization.

After performing loading activities on top of a hopper railcar, an employee stepped off the railcar. He was wearing fall protection, but the I-beam/trolley system failed. The trolley and employee fell to the ground. He suffered fractures and lacerations.

On December 6, 2017, at 5:00 a.m., an employee was adjusting the forks of his forklift after loading a trailer when another forklift operator backed into his forklift. The forklift impact fractured his left leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was descending a flight of stairs at a new home construction site when he slipped and fell, fracturing his leg.

An employee was prepping a blast pot for the next day and opened the top man-way. Pressure then escaped, causing the employee to be struck in the face by an unknown object. The employee sustained a laceration above his eyes and was hospitalized. The blast pot was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a paddle to pull onions out of an onion washing machine when his right hand slipped off the paddle. His right thumb was then caught and fractured in the rollers of the machine's conveyor.
On 12/6/2017, an employee was attempting to remove a linen sheet that was caught in a sheet folder ironer system when her hand was pulled into the machine and fractured.
An employee was operating a manual pallet jack when his right hand was caught between a pole and the pallet jack container. His right index fingertip was amputated.

On December 6, 2017, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was unloading a lumber order at the front of a construction site with a truck-mounted forklift when he hit an irregularity in the ground surface. The forklift then pitched forward, slamming his forehead into the rollover protection structure cage and rocking him back into the seat. He received a forehead laceration and fractured vertebrae, requiring hospitalization and surgery. A seatbelt and hardhat were not worn at the time of the incident.

Two employees were removing an old process line that contained residual dibenzoyl peroxide when the process line exploded. The first employee suffered a forehead cut, mangled right hand, lower arm amputation, and internal injuries due to piping puncturing the stomach/chest area. The second employee was hit in the face by a pipe, suffering a broken jaw.
An employee was working on a ladder when it slipped. As he attempted to stop the ladder from falling, his finger was caught in a clamp.

An employee was fueling a truck and went into the store to get a receipt. He then entered the truck before exiting it again. The truck began to roll forward and he attempted stop it when his shoe was caught on something. The truck then ran over and broke his right ankle and fractured a bone near the little toe on his left foot.
An employee was cleaning out a cat room from the night before when she tried to pick up a cat, and the cat bit her left hand. The bite became infected and required hospitalization that evening.

On December 6, 2017, at approximately 9:15 a.m., an employee was climbing a 12-foot step ladder to attach a retractable lanyard to a structural member when the employee fell backward from the fourth rung. The employee's head struck the concrete floor, and the employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, brain bleed, and abrasions to the lower left calf and ankle.

An employee was placing extruded rubber into a storage rack when a broken spring caused a section of the rack to fall uncontrollably, pinching the employee's right middle finger between two sections of the rack. The employee's fingertip, including the nailbed, was amputated.

An employee was using a cutting torch and cutting behind a piece of metal to prevent sparks from entering other areas when some sparks got behind him and ignited his clothes. He sustained possible second degree burns to both legs and his buttocks area, requiring surgery and hospitalization. Fire retardant clothing was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a table saw to cut loins of meat. When he attempted to grab a piece of loin his right middle finger contacted the blade and was cut, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was descending an 8-foot ladder when she lost her footing and fell approximately 5 feet to the floor, breaking her tailbone.
An employee was moving wires from one meter to another meter when one of the wires went two-phases to gear, burning the back of the employee's hands.
An employee was using a grinder tool when the tool struck and injured his left hand. The grinder wheel was unguarded at the time.
An employee was working on wooden barrels applying metal hoops when a hoop smashed his right middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was repairing a skylight when he fell 15 to 18 feet through the skylight, hitting his head and injuring his foot.

An employee was pushing of piece of wood through a table saw to build a frame for a concrete pour when the blade caused an amputation to the employee's right ring finger. The table saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was on a ladder prying on a shipping container when he slipped and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground below, breaking his left wrist and requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was unjamming a bagging machine when the machine's jaws, which cut bags, caught and amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was getting off a skid steer when his foot slipped and became lodged between the mast and the equipment. He broke his right leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bringing a drink to a resident in the dining room when the employee tripped on a rug and fell to the floor, injuring the left-side ribs, knee, and hip.
An employee was removing excess cotton from a lint cleaner machine when the machine turned on, amputating four of his right-hand fingers up to the first knuckle.
A steel piece fell off a load and struck an employee, lacerating his face and fracturing his left ankle and nose.

An employee was pouring molten aluminum into a mold when another employee activated a lever that opened the mold, spilling aluminum onto the injured employee. The employee suffered burns to the lower right leg and foot.
An employee was using a pocket knife to cut a 1/4" thick piece of rubber when the knife lacerated and partially amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was removing a fitting from an accumulator. Pressure was still in the safety bottle at the time. When he got down to the final threads, the fitting blew off, striking him in the face and neck. He suffered a facial contusion, orbital fracture, eye hematoma, and eyelid and neck lacerations.
An employee was hanging drywall on a ceiling while wearing stilts when the employee fell to the floor, injuring the right knee.

An employee was inside a truck trailer pulling a crate by hand using its banding straps when the straps broke. The employee fell approximately 4 feet backward off the trailer's lift gate onto the asphalt ground, sustaining a skull fracture, several broken ribs, brain bleeding and swelling, a fractured sternum, and a collapsed lung.
An employee fell from the truck and struck his head.

An employee dropped a utensil into a dish machine near its conveyor belt system. He was attempting to retrieve the item when his right hand became caught in the conveyor, suffering a large laceration and nerve damage. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was placing bags on a conveyor when a bag became stuck between the conveyor and the slide. As he attempted to dislodge the bag, the conveyor belt fractured and lacerated his right thumb.
An employee was repairing a conveyor when it crushed the employee's hand, requiring surgery.
Hot soup spilled, scalding an employee.

An employee was grabbing samples on a railcar. As he stood up, he slipped and fell chest downward, then began to slide on the downward slope of the car. He then attempted to turn his body and grab something but went over the side of the car. The webbing attached to the locking snap hook on his safety harness D-ring popped, and he felt a jerk before landing on the ground feet first and suffering an injury.
An employee was bending a pipe with a vice when he lost his grip and balance and fell onto a workbench. He suffered a fractured rib and collapsed lung.
An employee was sitting on a dock when he dismounted the dock and landed awkwardly on his left ankle, breaking it.

On December 7, 2017, at approximately 3:30 PM, an employee was taking parts off a combine and placing them in a pallet box when the employee stepped down into a pallet box and fell 6 feet to the ground. The employee fractured the transverse L1 vertebra, requiring overnight hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he slipped and fell. He broke his foot and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access a roof to repair an HVAC system when the employee fell from the ladder, breaking vertebrae and the pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee broke several bones as a result of a fall.

An employee was attempting to free a jammed hammer mechanism on an electric hammer drill. He was holding the drill motor in his right hand and the drill bit in his left hand when he inadvertently pulled the operation switch. The bit began to spin rapidly in the employee s left hand and caught his glove, which quickly tightened around his ring and pinky fingers. His ring fingertip was fractured and partially pulled off, requiring surgical amputation up to the first knuckle. His pinky finger was lacerated and required stitches.
Two employees were working in a trench when a backhoe bucket rolled into the trench and struck them. They suffered a broken ankle and shoulder injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting a dryer transfer system when his hand entered the airlock and contacted the rotating blade, partially amputating his third and fourth fingertips.
An employee was stepping off the back of a truck when the employee missed a step and fell to the ground, suffering rib fractures.
Employees were engaged in horseplay and one employee suffered a head injury when his head hit the wall.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 with a circular saw when the saw blade cut and partially amputated the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was repairing fiberglass bathtubs on roller conveyors mounted to the floor. He was attempting to cross over the roller conveyor when he landed in a way that fractured his tibia and fibula.
An employee was pouring concrete from a hopper into a pre-cast concrete mold when he was caught between the hopper and mold, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was setting up the rewinder and suffered a right thumb amputation while spooling fiber cable.
An employee was spreading out peanuts in a hopper, slipped and caught his hand in the bottom of the hopper resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was stripping concrete column forms. He was climbing up a ladder to a platform when he fell approximately 6 to 7 feet to the ground.

Employees were removing a piece of switchgear weighing more than 1,000 pounds when it fell forward, striking and pinning an employee between it and a wall. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured clavicle, fractured scapula, fractured vertebra, and fractured ribs.

An employee was holding a grade stick for a foreman to check the grade of elevations when an excavator driver rotated the equipment, causing the excavator bucket hook pipe to be spring loaded. The hook pipe then struck the employee, who sustained a contusion to the left side below the waist/hip.
An employee was carrying empty boxes when she tripped between two pallets and fell, breaking her hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was driving a concrete mixer. He exited the truck and fell due to an apparent heart attack.
On December 7, 2017, an employee was using a table saw to cut a wooden board when the board kicked back at him. He then suffered a left index finger amputation and broken middle finger.
An employee was pivoting a hand truck to move a refrigerator when his leg gave way and broke.
The employee contacted the rotating blade of a table saw resulting in amputation of the left thumb below the nail.

Employees were using an excavator to dig near a residential home when the excavator operator dug into an underground powerline, shocking a nearby employee. The employee was knocked backwards and received a concussion.

An employee was performing a change-over from a concert setting to a hockey setting. The employee was moving a load of materials when the load shifted and partially amputated the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was mixing cement using a mortar mixer. The employee started scraping the mortar patches inside of the mixer when the rotating paddles impacted the right hand, fracturing and lacerating it.
An employee was removing a chassis from a push cart and placing it on the ground when the chassis shifted and caught the employee's right thumb, amputating the tip.
An employee was rolling belts by hand when the employee's hand was caught between a belt and pulley, partially amputating the right pinky.
An employee was driving a tractor with a pull in the sales lot. The pull, which was carrying carpet, hit power lines, and fell down, striking the employee's head.
An employee was helping to remove a tree in a right-of-way when he tripped over debris and struck his head on a log. He suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was carrying window blinds in a hallway when she tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was clearing a board from an auto edger when the employee's coat was caught in a sprocket. The rotating equipment then amputated the employee's arm.
An employee tilted a trash hopper to empty it. When the trash hopper returned to its original position, it pinched his finger. As he pulled his hand out, his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was threading paper into the printing press and caught their fingers in a pinch point resulting in a fractured left ring fingertip.
An employee was using an overhead crane with chain slings to flip a 24 X 16 X 20-inch mold weighing 1,500 to 1,600 pounds when the employee's left hand was caught, amputating the middle finger.

An employee was using his right hand to feed a piece of metal into an iron worker metal forming machine and his left hand to operate the foot pedal, which had been moved up to the work surface near the machine. His left hand then entered the vertical metal forming device and was compressed, fractured, and lacerated.

On December 8, 2017, at 1:00 p.m., an employee was riding on the back of a trash collection vehicle, traveling at 13 miles per hour down a straight stretch of road, when the truck hit a bump and launched the employee into the air. He landed on both feet and then rolled onto his shoulder. He fractured his right ankle and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was feeding 2x4s into a pop-up saw by hand when his right hand contacted the blade, amputating his right thumb below the fingernail. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was inspecting a possible crack in a crane track when the crane operator swung the crane. The employee was crushed between the counterweight of the crane and a handrail, breaking two legs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was disconnecting a load from a powered industrial vehicle when the employee's right pinky finger became pinched between the vehicle and a connection bar, crushing and amputating the fingertip.

An employee was working on the second floor of a new construction building installing wrap on the outside walls when a guardrail broke, allowing the employee to fall approximately 12 feet to a lower surface. The employee suffered multiple leg and feet fractures.
An employee was setting up a horizontal mill when his left pinky finger was caught between the table and the bench indicator tool. Three-quarters of his finger were amputated.

An employee was at the top of a hill reversing a truck on the left side of a ramp when the truck rolled off the ramp. The employee suffered a collapsed lung and broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.

On 12/8/2017, at 4:00 p.m., employee #1 was on a truck containing racks of 25-foot sucker rods helping to offload the rods to employee #2, who was stationed on the ground. Employee #1 dropped his end of the sucker rod, which struck the ground. The impact caused a wave motion to propagate through the sucker rod, which then caused the end that employee #2 was holding to fling out of his hands in an upward motion, striking and lacerating his nose and forehead.
A temporary employee's left hand was inside a rotary valve when it closed, amputating three fingers and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's finger was caught in a trim press dye while trying to clear a jam resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was using a rolling cart to move heavy material stored in a wooden crate. The employee's hand was on the side of the cart while steering it. The employee's finger was then pinched between a metal frame on a door and the wooden crate, amputating the fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was rigging down a top drive on a drilling rig when a slide that was connected to a torque tube came down on the employee's left hand, amputating the middle finger just above the middle knuckle.
An employee was attempting to manually clean a tumbler when the employee's right hand became caught in the tumbler, amputating the index fingertip. The tumbler was in operation at the time.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of metal from a folding machine when he pressed the foot pedal. The machine then came down and crushed his right forearm.

An employee was using an airless sprayer when the employee's sleeve became caught in the sprayer, which then injected oil-based asphalt paint into the employee's left index finger. The employee's finger became swollen.
An employee was changing a die on a press brake when the press brake was activated. The employee's finger was caught in the point of operation, partially amputating the fingertip.

An employee was on a ladder cutting a ceiling grid down from the ceiling. As he snipped a wire, a portion of the ceiling fell and swung, hitting the ladder. The ladder started falling, and the employee put his right arm out to break his fall. When he hit the ground, he broke his right wrist.
On December 8, 2017, at 9:15 p.m., falling pallets knocked over bakery tables, which then struck an employee's stomach.
An employee slipped and fell on a snow-covered walkway between buildings, hitting the back of his head on the concrete.

An employee was on a roof removing old roofing materials and throwing them into a dump truck in the driveway below. He fell approximately 17 feet from the roof, and a coworker found him laying on the concrete driveway. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was drilling weep holes in a window sash and drilled through the material and into his glove. The glove became entangled and torqued his thumb resulting in a complex fracture of the left thumb. A fingertip amputation was also noted.
An employee was using a cutting torch to cut a clutch from the bottom of a truck when hot grease inside the clutch box melted and dripped onto the employee's face, burning it.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while moving a box. The employee's head hit the floor, suffering a concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was fixing an overhead pipe while standing on an 8-foot step ladder. He lost his balance and fell from the ladder to the floor, breaking his left wrist and left ankle.

An employee was walking to the staff break room when she slipped on water in front of the refrigerator, lost her balance, and fell to the floor. She dislocated and fractured her left hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a forklift during forklift certification and practical evaluations when the employee lost control of the forklift and hit a pallet racking system. The employee's leg was outside of the forklift at the time and suffered an injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a high-reach forklift when the employee's foot became crushed between a door guard and the lift, fracturing the ankle and foot.

On December 9, 2017, at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to remove a piece of meat from a hook when the employee's right index fingertip was pinched between the hook's handle and a conveyor siderail, resulting in an amputation just below the fingernail.

An employee was troubleshooting electrical fuses and relays on the driver's side of a skid steer when another employee rotated the bucket to actuate the hydraulics. The skid steer started moving and lurching, then knocked the employee over and ran over his ankle and foot, fracturing his right ankle and dislocating his right foot.
An employee suffered a cardiac incident while delivering a load to a customer causing him to fall out of lift gate and hit his head.

A temporary employee was making a sharp U-turn while driving a golf cart (delivery vehicle) when he tried to prevent the cart from tipping over using his left foot resulting in broken bones in his left leg.
An employee was moving a portable heater when his finger was caught in the grating protecting the fan blade on the rear of the heater. His left ring fingertip was amputated with no loss of bone.
An employee was using an "A" frame ladder to open the cargo hatch of an airplane when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his right ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was using a wet shovel to clean molten copper when an explosion occurred. He suffered burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to unjam a tube conveyor when the employee's leg was caught between the material and a roller, fracturing it below the knee.

An employee was using a towel to clean a roller underneath a machine when the towel was caught in the roller, pulling his arm into the machine. His forearm suffered multiple fractures. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was backing a forklift out of a racking location when the forklift cage became caught on a post and broke, causing it to move forward. The employee was then pinned between the forklift seat and steering wheel, suffering a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee slipped and fell to the same level surface while cleaning cars, fracturing the lower left leg.

An employee was hooking/rigging a forklift when the forklift operator began the lift. The employee's left ring finger was then caught and crushed by the forklift chain. His fingertip had to be amputated.
On December 9, 2017, an employee was turning a valve with a wrench while standing on a ladder when he lost his balance, fell from the fifth rung, and fractured both bones in his lower leg.
An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder passing a broom up to another employee when he fell to the ground, fracturing his left collarbone and ribs and suffering minor brain bleeding.

An employee was in a bucket truck restoring power to a residence when the employee contacted the electrical powerline and fell approximately 30 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered five broken ribs.

An employee was responding to a service call at an apartment that had lost electricity. While using a screwdriver to check the outdoor breakers, the employee received an electric shock, resulting in third degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was at a customer's home servicing their satellite when he either fell from a ladder or fell to the ground while walking. He was hospitalized with a brain hemorrhage.
An employee was cleaning bread slicer discharge using the blade when she contacted the blade edge, lacerating her fingertip and amputating the small tip of her finger pad and nail.
An employee was operating a chop saw when it cut his right index fingertip, causing a disarticulation injury.
An employee was operating a vacuum truck when the hose became disconnected and began spraying hot fluid. A fire and then explosion occurred, and the employee suffered serious burns.

An employee was on top of a concrete pile looking inside the grout box to ensure there was enough concrete against the existing header. He had placed his hand on a concrete plow cable to brace himself when the operator moved the equipment, causing the cable to move and catch the employee's hand between the concrete and the cable. His left pinky finger was nearly severed.
An employee slipped and fell in a freezer, breaking her ankle.
An employee was setting up an extrusion line and attempting to grab film when the employee strained the lower back muscles. The employee was hospitalized with a lower right-side back strain.
An employee was maneuvering a mud bucket away from a rotary table area when his right little finger was smashed between the mud bucket frame and a mast leg, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was getting out of her vehicle when she slipped and fell on a patch of ice, breaking her ankle.

An employee was putting a cylinder in a deck when the cylinder would not set into the deck properly due to a misaligned bearing. He used a pry bar to raise the cylinder and realign the bearing. He was attempting to align the bearing cap when the pry bar slipped and the cylinder fell, causing the cylinder bearing cap to close on his left index finger. He suffered a left index finger partial distal phalanx amputation.
An employee was walking on an icy sidewalk in front of a residence to deliver mail when she slipped and fell to the ground below, fracturing her left ankle.
An employee was walking down an icy, snow covered driveway after delivering a package and slipped and fell resulting in a fractured right femur.
An employee was opening the back door of a delivery truck when the truck moved forward. The employee then fell to the ground.
An employee was caught between the forks of a forklift and a building, suffering crushing injuries to the abdomen.
An employee was removing wood from a conveyor when the employee's left arm was caught between the wood and conveyor frame. The employee's left hand was amputated just above the wrist.
While unloading a personal vehicle by hand, an employee stepped back onto a curb and fell at the same level, fracturing the right femur and requiring surgery.

An employee was operating an auto fastening machine when the machine failed to complete a tool change. The employee was attempting to troubleshoot the problem when the sensor cleared and the machine cycled, catching, fracturing, and puncturing the employee's right hand. The machine was not in stop mode at the time of the incident.
An employee was surfacing the road for access and got too close to the edge of the road. The roller began to roll down the hill and the employee suffered a back and pelvis injury.
An employee was operating a lathe when the employee's left hand was caught in the lathe, resulting in an amputation of the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was repairing/replacing the insulation on a chiller unit when he attempted to lift a pedestal fan to dry the chiller's paint. He then suffered a bulging disc and pinched nerve in his lower back, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were spotting for a sand truck. The front spotter lost sight of the back spotter, who was then pinned between the truck and a sand silo. He suffered a hip injury and herniation, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to steady a load when his hand was caught between the load and the base, amputating two fingers above the second knuckle.
An employee was cutting a ring tool with a handheld grinder when the grinder wheel exploded and a piece of the wheel lodged into and lacerated his lower right leg.

An employee was moving cylinders onto a delivery truck when the employee lost footing and fell between the truck and loading dock, suffering a head contusion and muscle strain. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was checking tags on rods and moving a rod clamp when a suitcase, which held the rods, slipped. The employee's left thumb/index and pinky fingers were caught and smashed between the clamp and bridle. The employee suffered amputations to half of the index finger and the pinky fingertip.

While unloading a skid from a trailer, an employee tried to move the skid into place so a forklift could lift it out of the trailer. The skid then shifted and smashed the employee's right index finder between the skid and the fork, partially amputated the last distal joint of the right index finger.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a head injury and requiring hospitalization.
Three employees were lifting a piece of pipe when it fell. One employee tried to catch it, but it fell on his hand and smashed his pinky finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was attempting to release refrigerant gas from a cooling unit when the gas began to release from a valve and hose. He attempted to stop the escaping gas and suffered burns to the thumb and a forefinger on his right hand and a forefinger on his left hand.
An employee suffered a partial left thumb amputation while operating a manual pallet jack.
An employee was adjusting the brake on a running screw machine when the employee's right middle finger was caught and partially amputated in the brake.
An employee was in her car in the parking lot when another employee stabbed her chest and left hand.

An employee was running a machine when one of the rings would not enter the roller correctly. As the employee attempted to steady the ring, his glove became caught between the two rollers, causing his hand to be pulled into the machine. His left pinky finger was avulsed and amputated to at the first knuckle.

An employee was pulling a trailer away from a dock when the dock plate became stuck between the trailer and dock. The employee then used an aluminum pipe to dislodge the dock plate. It fell and struck him, pinning his right leg to the wall of the dock.
An employee was moving dunnage when a stack of lumber fell over and struck the employee, breaking the left leg.
An employee was installing framing for a concrete system when a forklift load shifted and struck his left leg below the knee, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was dismounting from his truck when he fell and struck a concrete ramp below.
An employee stopped at a fuel station to refuel the tractor he was operating. Upon exiting the tractor, he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his back and pelvis.
An employee was climbing down a cross frame to the top of a pier when the employee slipped and fell approximately 7 feet to the pier, suffering a head injury.
An employee delivered shingles to a roof and was using a ladder to exit the roof when the employee slipped on a rung and fell to the ground, fracturing a tibia.

While using a press brake to form a sheet metal component, an employee attempted to reposition the plastic die cover. The press brake activated while the employee's left hand was in the point of operation, amputating three fingers.
An employee slipped and fell on a patch of ice while taking trash to a dumpster, fracturing the right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a solvent cleaner to clean a filter housing and prepare for painting when he suffered from chemical exposure and dizziness, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing a ball joint from a vehicle when his hand slipped and contacted the metal covering, seriously lacerating his left hand.

An employee locked out an in-liner machine system and attempted to lift the flask and set it back on its designed track. The flask slipped off the side of the track that was supporting it, and the employee's finger was caught between the track and the 300-pound flask, resulting in an amputation.

On 12/11/2017, at approximately 12:30 p.m., an employee was operating a rubber molding machine when he attempted to remove a left-over piece of rubber from the heated top plate. The employee's gloves made contact with the heated plate and melted to the surface. Before he was able to free himself, the molding machine began operating and pinned his right-hand fingers between the top and bottom plates for several seconds, amputating all four fingers and his thumb.
An employee tripped and fell while walking up a flight of stairs, fracturing her arm while trying to brace her fall.
An employee was removing roll paper from a machine when two blades came together and amputated the tip of her thumb.

An employee was attempting to access the roof using a 14-foot fixed ladder. When he attempted to open the roof hatch, the weight of the snow on the hatch would not allow the hatch to open. The unexpected force caused the employee to fall off the ladder. He suffered three broken ribs and a ruptured spleen that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was approaching a skid steer from behind when the skid steer turned and struck the employee, crushing the employee's foot, ankle, and lower right leg. The employee suffered blunt force trauma and lost part of the lower leg.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a steam tunnel. The employee was greasing a fitting and attempting to spin the fan using the pulley belt when the employee's right pinky finger was caught and amputated between the belt and pulley.
While cleaning the expanding machine, an employee was about to replace the dies when he smashed his left thumb between the dies. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was helping to remove an abandoned 20-foot section of 10" pipe from a trench. When the pipe was free from the trench, it swung around and hit the employee's lower leg, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing 2x4 light fixtures into a ceiling grid. He measured how much tie wire he would need to secure the fixtures' catty corner onto the ceiling grid. He realized he would need a taller ladder so he started coming down and decided to cut the wire he had measured out. The wire spool was sitting on top of the ladder he was using. When he cut the wire, the end sprang upwards and went between the bottom of his safety glasses and his face, puncturing his right eye.

An employee was helping two other employees put a belt on a pulley when his right index fingertip was caught and smashed between the pulley and the belt. As he pulled his hand away, his fingertip was amputated. He was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was driving a pallet jack and attempting to make a U-turn in an aisle when her finger was caught and partially amputated under a rack shelf.

An employee was cutting windows in the sheet metal of a tank using high-pressure water (40k) when the equipment's magnet, which holds the cutter to the tank, failed. The water then lacerated the employee's right thigh above the knee.
An employee suffered a left pinky finger laceration, requiring hospitalization when he caught his finger in a door while cleaning.
An employee was unloading a shower door from the back of a rental truck when the door fell onto the employee's foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized overnight and had surgery.
An employee was using a radial arm saw to cut 12-inch pieces of wood when the saw cut and amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

Employees were performing demolition work on the second story of a residential property when an employee fell from the roof and landed on the ground approximately 20 feet below, breaking the left leg.
An employee was disassembling hot tar tanker pipes when the hot tar splashed both of his lower legs, causing first and possible second degree burns.
While walking into work, an employee slipped on ice melt on the stairs. The employee suffered possible cracked vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a saw down a ladder when he lost his footing and fell from the third step to the floor, breaking his left tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a wooden board when the saw slipped and cut his left-hand palm area. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was greasing an overhead conveyor chain when the employee's left index fingertip was caught and amputated between the chain and sprocket.
An employee was cleaning debris off a roller conveyor when his left middle fingertip was caught in the chain and sprockets of the machine. His fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was struck by a taxi cab while crossing the street, suffering a fractured left leg.
An employee was setting up an air valve when the valve shifted and injured the employee's thumb.
An employee was pressure testing a tanker truck and adjusting the tanker's wash-out cap when the cap contacted the employee's face. The employee suffered a broken jaw and lacerations to the chin.
An employee was unloading tires from a truck at a warehouse when he fell 2 feet out of the back of the truck and hit his shoulder and neck on the ground. He was hospitalized overnight.
An employee was found on the floor. He fell to the ground and struck his head while pulling out a floor scrubber, suffering a brain aneurysm.

An employee was operating a machine and trying to place a block of wood to hold the machine rail in place when the machine kicked out the block of wood. The employee's hand then went under the hood, resulting in a left ring finger amputation.
While cleaning a mix pan, an employee attempted to lower a roller into the pan. The employee's left index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the roller bracket and the pan.

An employee used brake cleaner to remove built-up grease from a cordless power tool. When the employee attempted to use the tool, it ignited, burning the employee's face and arms. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a robotic cell attempting to clear slag from a welding tip when the robot energized. The robotic arm struck and pinned the employee, fracturing and dislocating the employee's left hip.

An employee was taking material out of a freezer and walking by a bread rack when she tripped over shelving that was leaning against the bread racks and fell to the floor. She broke both knees and was hospitalized overnight.
A temporary employee was inside a truck standing on two boxes of vinyl siding when the employee fell to the truck floor, suffering a hip fracture and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to run a twisting machine when the employee's right fourth fingertip was caught and amputated in the machine.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to drive a stake when he felt a pop and pain in his lower back on the left side of his tailbone. He fell to the ground and was unable to move his left leg. He suffered a herniated L5 disk.

On December 12, 2017, an employee was driving a mini roller compactor on a roadway when the unit drove off the edge of the roadway and turned over into a ditch. He hit his head on the compactor's roll-over protection and was hospitalized with a concussion.

Two employees were driving powered industrial vehicles in opposite directions when they collided. One of the employees had a foot outside of the vehicle at the time of the collision. The employee suffered a broken foot/ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee was taking vibration readings of bearings in a fan when his right index finger entered the running fan and was fractured.
An employee was placing a string of paper into a winder when his fingertip was caught and amputated in a pinch point.
An employee fell over 12 feet from the building he was working on to the ground, breaking his left elbow.
An employee tripped on carpet while walking and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury.
An employee was taking off her boots in a patient's home when she slipped on the wet floor and fractured her ankle.

On 12/12/2017, an employee was attempting to remove a cut part that had tipped up on the end of a plasma cutting machine when the machine moved unexpectedly and caught his right hand between the part and a gantry. His index and middle fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was helping to manually accommodate carbon sheet metal plates when a pipe fell on him, fracturing his right ankle and fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was hooking up propane lines for heat at a construction site when propane spewed from the lines, covering the employee's hands. Another line then flared, flashing back at the employee and causing minor burns to the head. The employee's hand suffered frostbite from the propane, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering a 320-pound door when he strained his back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee dismounted his stand-up walkie and was picking a part out of a bin. He had parked next to another stand-up walkie. He was standing between the two stand-up walkies when the second walkie moved, crushing his leg between the two and breaking his fibula.
An employee was screwing a fascia into place while standing on an 8-foot portable ladder when he fell approximately 4 feet off the ladder, injuring his head and breaking three ribs.
On December 13, 2017, an employee suffered carbon monoxide poisoning while pressure-washing a car wash, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was outside helping a plane depart when he slipped on ice and/or snow and fell to the concrete pavement. His head hit the pavement and he was hospitalized.

An employee fell from approximately the fourth rung of a six foot ladder while waxing a boat hull. The employee fell onto a steel I beam used for in/out storage and suffered three fractured ribs and five small broken pieces of bone on the spine.
An employee was helping a technician rotate a blow molding machine when his finger was caught and amputated in a locking shaft.

An employee was using a clamp truck to load rolls of paper onto railcars. He was wearing his seat belt and hard hat at the time. He was driving in the forward position when he lost control of the vehicle, which fell on its left side. He suffered a 2-inch laceration behind the left side of his ear, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was setting a piece into a plate press when the plate press shifted. His left middle finger was then caught between the plate and the plate press, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was removing a drill collar when his glove became caught on it. His left hand was then crushed between the drill collar and drill stump, injuring his ring finger and requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was dismantling a scaffold when debris and dust fell into his face, causing him to step into a ladder/stairway opening on the scaffolding. He was trapped in the opening and twisted and fractured his arm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee's left arm was caught in a lint machine while trying to apply spray primer to the feed rollers on the condenser. The employee suffered a de-gloving of the left arm from the armpit to just below the elbow.

On December 13, 2017, an employee propped up a metal hopper with a wrench. The employee was looking for an O-ring that came out of the hopper when the wrench slipped. The hopper then fell and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

A forklift operator was traveling down a ramp with a stack of pallets, while another employee was walking up the ramp. The employees collided and the injured employee was struck by the pallets, requiring hospitalization for a skull fracture.
An employee was cutting meat using a band saw when the blade cut the bottom of his right index fingertip below the nail. His fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
A forklift operator was transporting product when the forklift hit an overhead door and ejected him. He dislocated his ankle and fractured his fibula, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on a high reach when two pallet stacks started to shift. He dismounted the high reach to stop the boxes from falling, but the boxes fell on him, breaking his ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On December 13, 2017, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee was descending stairs at a high school stadium when he missed the last step and fell, fracturing his hip.
An employee was placing parts into a die using a press brake when his left hand entered the machine, amputating his index finger.

An employee was using an air hose to blow air through a waterline to a well when the hose came loose from the strap that secured it to the water pump. The end of the hose struck the employee's left shoulder area, fracturing his collarbone.

An employee was instructing a trainee on how to set up a single-cycle stroke on a press machine. His left hand was adjusting a miss-feed of the lamination when the trainee initiated the cycle. The top section of the die then cycled down, crushing the first three digits (middle fingers) of his left hand.
An employee was using a cart to move a bundle of steel when the steel rolled off the cart and fractured the employee's right ankle.
An employee was going up on a lift. His hand was outside the lift railing, and his right index finger was caught between the railing and a steel erection. His fingertip was amputated.

At approximately 9:30 AM, on December 13, 2017, an employee was buffing a 1-and-1/4-inch piece of steel using a lathe machine and a 3-foot piece of emery cloth when his left hand and arm became entangled around the lathe's rotating shaft. His left middle finger had to be surgically amputated and he required surgery to his left ulna and radius.

An employee was looking for utility marks while surveying for a new fence when a car hit the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis, broken collarbone, removed spleen, lacerated liver, and punctured lungs.
On 12/13/2017, an employee was attempting to pull jammed paper out of a shredder when the employee's left index finger contacted the shredder and was amputated before the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to repair a rock crusher. The employee's hand was on the crusher's belt when the machine energized. The belt then crushed and amputated the employee's right index fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee's right middle finger was pinched between two filter element retaining plates while installing the plates as part of a filter replacement task.
On 12/13/2017, an employee was using a table saw to cut hardwood for a coffee table when his left index and middle fingers made contact with the blade, lacerating them and requiring hospitalization.
While climbing a chain link fence to reach equipment, an employee lost balance and fell backwards onto a residential plant stand, suffering back lacerations.

An employee was reversing a forklift when her right hand was caught between the sidebar of the forklift cage and a pallet stored on a rack. Her pinky finger suffered a compound fracture, and her fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was taping drywall on a baker's scaffold when the employee fell from the scaffold, breaking a hand and ribs.
An employee was boiling pasta. When he reached to remove the basket of pasta, the steam kettle tipped and hot water burned his feet and ankles.
An employee was using a handheld electric grinder when the grinding disc broke off and hit his left arm, deeply lacerating it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee had just finished installing gutters and was transitioning to a ladder when the employee slipped on the ladder rung and fell approximately 14 to 16 feet, suffering a fractured sacrum. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading empty 1-gallon buckets onto a chute of a labeling machine when the employee's right hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While walking up a ramp to deliver a package, an employee slipped and fell, dislocating a kneecap and tearing ligaments and tendons.
An employee was running cable through a wall and attaching it to a wall plate. He needed another screw to attach the plate to the wall. When he drilled the screw, it drilled through his left hand.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, injuring his foot and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from a drop ceiling and suffered an injury.
An employee was working near an encapsulation machine when he lost his footing, slipped, and fell to the floor, breaking his hip.

On December 14, 2017, an employee was operating a CNC router machine when the employee noticed a tool was loose on the machine. The employee was then struck by the router, suffering a right femur fracture and right thigh laceration.

On 12/14/2017, an employee was using a water jet "gun" with hot water coming out at 3,000 psi to spray columns in a sand pit. The high-pressure water then cut his leg, causing an abrasion and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was finishing a curing cycle and removing a steam line from a pot heater. The line was still under pressure at the time and the steam released, contacting the employee and causing second degree burns to the thigh and crotch area.

On 12/14/2017, an employee was disassembling a bakers scaffold. As he was descending the scaffold, his right foot was caught between the step rail and siderail. He then fell no more than 3 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing his skull and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pinned by a piece of heavy equipment, injuring his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over her belongings and fell on a carpeted floor, fracturing her femur.
An employee was driving a wooden stake into the ground using a sledgehammer when the sledgehammer missed the stake and hit his right index finger. His index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was descending a ladder from a roof when it began to slide sideways. He dismounted the ladder at a height of about 10 to 12 feet and landed with his right foot on the concrete pad below, suffering a compression fracture to the right leg above the knee and below the hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift with the mast in the air. The mast contacted an overhead cable (16 feet high), causing the front tires of the forklift to raise off of the pavement. The forklift came to rest unevenly and the employee's foot was crushed. The employee also suffered a hip abrasion.
An employee was returning to his vehicle after delivering a package when he slipped and fell on a patch of ice, fracturing his right fibula and tibia.
An employee was installing a new punch press when a piece of the machinery tipped backward and crushed the employee's middle fingers, requiring hospitalization.

On December 14, 2017, at approximately 5:00 a.m., a temporary employee was standing next to a door that was slightly ajar. Her index finger was in the door jam when another door was opened, which created a vacuum in the room. The first door then slammed shut on her finger. Approximately 1 inch of her right index finger was amputated.

On December 14, 2017, an employee was moving crates in and out of the building. As he was returning to the building, he slipped and fell onto the concrete floor, dislocating his left ankle. He was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was setting up a corner board of a manual/hydraulic lift for the next job when his left thumb was pinched between the lift and the base of the lift, amputating his thumb around the knuckle.
An employee slipped on a wet area of the floor, suffering compression fractures to her L1 and L2 vertebrae and a twisting/torsion injury.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk near the parking lot, fracturing her ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was un-chocking an incline cleaner with other employees. They finished working on the machine and started to climb down a ladder to the ground level. While passing another incline machine, the employee reached for a handrail. His hand then contacted the machine's running belt and his hand was dragged into the pulley. His left pinky finger's top joint was amputated just above the fingernail and his left ring finger between the fingertip and first joint was crushed.

An employee was installing a rolled insulation system on a building rooftop. The injured employee stepped from the controlled decking zone onto a galvanized purlin at the joint between the insulation and a ceiling liner panel. The purlin was slippery from weather exposure and the employee fell approximately 22 feet to the lower level (concrete), fracturing the upper left leg.
Two employees were performing roofing work and changing anchor points when they fell 20 feet. One employee broke his wrist.

An employee was troubleshooting why the latch to the door of a mini-excavator would not open. He had climbed up onto the mini-excavator to get a better vantage point when he lost his footing and fell backward onto a skid-steer bucket that was parked next to the mini-excavator, breaking multiple ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a 4-foot step ladder to the concrete floor while filing, suffering back pain.
While walking, an employee tripped and fell over a pile of pallets, fracturing the left wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee had inspected a vehicle and was exiting the parking lot when she slipped on black ice and fell to the black top walking surface. She broke her left leg.
An employee was driving in a fence post using a fence post driver when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between the fence post and the driver.
An employee was working on a 5-foot step ladder while using a saw to demolish a wall when he slipped and fell to a concrete slab, injuring his lower back.
An employee was descending a 3-step step ladder when she fell to the floor and fractured her leg.

The injured employee was holding the tagline rope assisting a dump truck driver dump a load. When the dump bed was raised, the load shifted causing tension on the tagline rope and fracturing the injured employee's right pinky finger.

On December 14, 2017, at about 10:35 p.m., an employee was rotating a manhole cover on a vertical turret lathe when his gloved right ring finger was caught between the part and the machine head. His right ring finger distal phalanx was surgically amputated.
An employee was clearing meat from a grinder machine when it amputated two of the employee's right-hand fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was feeding wood into a saw conveyor when a piece of scrap kicked out of the saw and struck the employee's chest. The employee was standing 10 to 12 feet away from the saw at the time. The piece of scrap became embedded in the employee's chest, requiring hospitalization.
While hanging Christmas lights on a pine tree, an employee lost balance and fell approximately 8 feet off a ladder to the ground, suffering fractured ribs and a partially deflated lung.

An employee cut an 8" crown molding using a sliding compound miter saw. When he attempted to pick up the cut piece, his right hand contacted the blade, amputating his thumb's top knuckle and requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a chop saw to cut wood when the saw cut the employee's arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell 6 feet from a cherry picker while picking orders, suffering broken ribs.
While walking from the dining room to the kitchen, an employee slipped (possibly on a piece of ice) and fell to the floor, fracturing the left wrist and left ankle.
An employee was descending from a scaffold when the employee fell approximately 15 to 20 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured ankle and vertebra.
