On January 1, 2018, at approximately 12:15 p.m., an employee was operating a bulldozer to build a logging road above a high wall when the bank gave way. The dozer slid and rolled at least once. The employee sustained a fractured right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was entering the facility through a roll-up door when a forklift driver reversed and ran over the employee. The employee suffered a broken right hip and left foot.

On January 2, 2018, an employee was retrieving a 14 ft. 2x4 board from machine he was operating when his hand slipped and was caught between the board and machine. His left ring fingertip had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was assaulted by a customer that came into the store. The assailant forced the sales clerk outside and proceeded to bang her head against a gas pump. The customer then beat her multiple times with his fists and ran over the employee with his car. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was running a jackhammer to break up concrete around metal beams when the jackhammer jumped up then came down. The employee's left hand was then caught between the jackhammer and a metal beam, amputating the middle and ring fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee was trying to reduce the high liquid level on the site-glass when a compress exploded, causing second degree burns to 5 percent of the employee's body.

An employee was guiding a trash pump that a crane was moving into place for a concrete pour. The employee had to climb onto the trash pump base to release the main block hook from the wire rope rigging. As he grabbed the rigging with his right hand, his footing slipped and he grabbed the top frame of the trash pump. In his efforts to keep from falling, he pulled the rigging (still attached to the main block) toward him, which caused the hook to amputate his left little fingertip.

On January 2, 2018, an employee was operating a crane to move a scrap bin to a dock when the scrap bin struck some steel and began to rotate. As the employee attempted to stop the bin from rotating, the employee's pinky finger became caught between the scrap bin and a table machine, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was helping a coworker clean an area when she noticed an airlock was clogged up. As she attempted to unclog it, the paddle inside the airlock amputated three of her right-hand fingers.

On January 2, 2018, an employee was moving a cart filled with parts weighing 38 pounds when the parts slid off the cart and onto his legs. He was pinned between the parts and a machine, breaking both legs.

An employee was operating a boring machine in a trench box when the bit became stuck and the torque of the machine caused it to tip over. The employee was then caught between the machine and the trench box, bruising his right side.
An employee was adjusting a rack to the center of a cart. When the rack was lifted, it came down on the employee's right hand, amputating the middle fingertip.

An employee tripped while stepping over a guardrail and fell to the same level. The employee tried to brace for the fall and impacted the concrete floor, fracturing the left humerus in the shoulder area.

An employee was working inside an 8' x 26' steel trench box and was helping an excavator operator install a 30" ductile iron pipe. He directed the track excavator operator to place a bucket of stone bedding for the next pipe to be installed. The excavator operator dumped the bucket of stone into the trench and began to level the stone. The employee was then caught between the excavator bucket and the bell of the pipe, suffering a fractured left leg, fractured ribs, a fractured pelvis, and punctured lungs. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

At approximately 19:00 PM on January 2, 2018, an employee was delivering mail along a rural route when he noticed he was off on the right side of the road. As he tried to pull the vehicle back onto the road, he lost control and it overturned. He was ejected and pinned under the vehicle, suffering four broken ribs, a broken collarbone on the right side, and injuries to his right arm and wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was spray painting polyurethane onto a tank from an extension ladder. The ladder slipped on wet paint, causing the employee to fall approximately 5 to 6 feet onto the concrete below. He suffered a head laceration, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was helping children get onto a bus when she slipped on water and a stone on the bus walkway. She fell to the bus floor and broke her ankle.
On January 2, 2018, an employee was performing maintenance on a valve when the valve closed and amputated the employee's right pinky fingertip.

An employee had to go inside an HVAC unit to conduct troubleshooting and repairs. The employee shut off power to the HVAC unit and entered it. The employee placed a hand on the box, which slipped off. The employee s hand then contacted the HVAC unit s belt and pulley, suffering a laceration and tissue damage to the right index finger and small cuts to the middle and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized. The HVAC unit was not locked/tagged out and the blower unit had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.
An employee was setting up an extrusion machine when the employee's right index finger entered a pinch point and was partially amputated.

An employee was about to exit a truck trailer onto a loading dock when the truck pulled forward, causing the employee to fall 4 to 5 feet into the loading dock well. The employee suffered right tibia, right fibula, and left heel fractures.
An employee was working on a press brake when the employee's left hand became caught and crushed in the press brake.

An employee was setting up a warming tent at a job site when a work truck struck and pinned the employee between it and a 54-inch reamer. The employee's lower right leg was crushed, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while breaking down inbound product, suffering a hip injury and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was eating lunch while sitting near a space heater. The heater then ignited his jacket, causing second and third degree burns to his back and hands.
On 1/2/2018, an employee's left foot became caught between a warehouse rack and a stand-up forklift. His foot was cut open and required hospitalization.
An employee was delivering mail on her route when she slipped on an icy curb and fell, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was using a firehose to clean the floor between slabs of granite when a slab fell off its support and struck the employee. The employee suffered a crushed pelvis, left hand injuries, and multiple rib fractures.

An employee was performing maintenance on an air handler unit when the employee's right hand came into contact with the air handler drive. The employee's glove and hand were then pulled into the pulley, amputating a finger.
An employee was operating a die press to blank silver strips when the employee's right hand became caught in the blanking die, amputating the index fingertip.
An employee fell off a 10-foot ladder to the concrete sidewalk below while fixing a sprinkler head, breaking both ankles.

An employee was exiting his vehicle to deliver cotton seed at a facility when he stepped on a concrete trap and tripped. He fell to the ground and fractured his left leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was taking out a screw from a roof panel when he fell from the roof, breaking his ankle/foot and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unjamming a screw auger when his right hand became caught in the auger. He suffered a traumatic laceration and fracture to his right hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee dumped a load into a hamper and was standing behind the truck when a cam flew out of the crushing part of the hamper and hit the employee's jaw, crushing it.
An employee fell while walking down an unobstructed hallway, suffering a fractured hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a space heater while retrieving a package and fell to the same level, suffering a concussion.
An employee was using an acidic solution to clean an indoor car wash when he received chemical burns to his right hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing condensate in a pipe that runs through a combustor when a flash fire occurred, burning the employee's face and hands.

An employee was working on a light fixture when the bulb broke and cut his right little finger. The employee wrapped his hand initially, but then unwrapped it to look at it and fainted.  The employee fell and hit his head on the baggage rack before hitting the floor and having a seizure.
An employee was descending a carpenter bracket scaffold. The scaffold shifted and the ladder moved causing the employee to lose balance and fall 20 feet. The employee sustained a broken right leg.

An employee was working inside when an outside driver lost control of her vehicle and crashed into the building. The vehicle hit a wall and caused a toolbox to propel into the air and strike the employee, who suffered fractured legs.

An employee was on a catwalk attempting to close a hatch near a shroud that was releasing concrete. The employee stepped from the catwalk to the shroud and was about to tie off a safety harness and lanyard when two bolts on the front of the shroud failed and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered right elbow and lower lumbar fractures, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping a customer in the parking lot. The customer's car hood was up and the employee was leaning into the engine compartment when the customer decided to start the engine. A fan or belt injured the employee's right hand, resulting in an amputation to the index fingertip.

On January 3, 2018, an employee was checking dampers on an air handling unit when his jacket became caught on a maintenance door. As he was attempting to free himself, the door slammed onto his left ring fingertip, amputating it.

An employee was starting to ventilate a tractor trailer tanker. Anhydrous ammonia vapors were to be ventilated before filling the tanker with propane. When the employee started to hook up the fan, leftover liquid anhydrous ammonia in the lines splashed him and caused first and third degree chemical burns.

On January 3, 2018, an employee was feeding/aligning a steel strip on an automatic welder. The employee was inside the welder attempting to remove a label from a steel strip when the welder operator activated the welder, which closed on and fractured the employee's right femur.
An employee slipped on ice while exiting a truck and impacted the ground, breaking a leg and requiring surgery.
An employee was installing handrails on a scaffold when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured neck.
An employee was walking from her desk to a printer when she possibly tripped over a plastic chair mat and fell to the floor, breaking both humerus bones.

An employee was walking across the hall to get coffee and water when she stumbled and hit the right side of her head on the wall before falling to the floor. She suffered left and right arm fractures and exacerbated a right knee injury.
An employee was riding his bicycle and suffered a heart attack.

An employee climbed a 14-foot straight ladder in a utility space to reach and close a compressed air supply shut-off valve. As he was reaching out, the ladder kicked out from beneath him and he fell approximately 10 feet to the floor, landing on and fracturing his right hip.

An employee was collecting rejected mail from a conveyor system and transferring it to another conveyor system using a small mail bin when the bin hit a metal post. Her body then twisted, resulting in a fractured left femur.
While repairing a roof, an employee tripped over a 10-inch parapet wall at the roof edge and fell approximately 13 feet to the ground, suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was exiting a locker room when a forklift ran over and broke the employee's right foot.
An employee was changing a drill bit when the employee's hand was caught in the drill bit.
An employee was putting a truck lift gate in the locked position when his left pinky finger was caught between the truck bed and the lift gate, amputating 1/3 of the digit.
An employee was working on a metal stamping press. The employee's right hand was in the point of operation when the press engaged, amputating the index fingertip and damaging the middle finger.

Employees were trying to thaw and open a frozen valve on a tanker. The tanker truck engine was running in the shop. One employee vented the tank and released volatile hydrocarbons, causing the engine to run away and catch fire. Other volatiles exploded, blowing the building apart and igniting the tanker engine. The injured employee had just started to run out of the building when the explosion happened. The force of the explosion caused the employee to be thrown approximately 20 feet from the building, landing on the frozen ground. The employee suffered burns to the face and hands, rib fractures, and a collapsed lung.
An employee had approached a boom truck to speak with a co-worker when his hand entered the pinch point on the truck, amputating one entire finger and two fingertips.
While exiting the lunch room, an employee tripped on a runner rug and fell down three steps (approximately 24 inches) to the concrete floor. The employee sustained internal head bleeding.
An employee was on a ladder picking product for shipping when he fell to the floor and broke his collarbone, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking near another employee who was cutting a tree stump with a chain saw when the saw kicked back and hit the first employee. He suffered a laceration to his left shin that required stitches and overnight hospitalization.
An employee was operating a triple pallet jack when his right foot was caught between his triple pallet jack and a stationary triple pallet jacket. His right toes were amputated up to the metatarsal.

An employee turned off an auger at the bottom of a ribbon blender to find pieces of a plastic bucket lift that had broken and fallen into the ribbon blender. The employee went around and had opened the drain cover of the auger to retrieve the pieces when the auger activated and amputated the employee's left thumb. The auger was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was walking to a dumpster to throw away trash when she slipped and fell on ice, injuring her hip and requiring surgery.

An employee's hand was on a paint can that was on a paint shaker machine when another employee activated the machine. The employee's right ring finger was then caught and smashed in the machine, amputating the fingertip.
An employee installed conduit and was descending from a ladder when he fell and hit his head. The employee suffered a seizure after the fall and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a drum barrel from a pallet with his hands when the barrel tilted coming off the pallet, pinching and crushing his finger between the barrel and the wall.
An employee tripped and fell down several stairs while carrying equipment, landing on the concrete floor and sustaining head (possible concussion), rib, and back injuries.
An employee's left index finger was smashed between a ratchet handle and measuring rod while doing a hot tap. The first digit of the employee's finger was amputated.
On January 4, 2018, an employee slipped on black ice and fell to the pavement as she was leaving work. She suffered fractured ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a stairwell when she stepped off a step and fractured her right ankle.

An employee was unloading paneling from a truck when the paneling fell on him, knocking him to the floor of the truck trailer. He suffered a concussion and lower back injury, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing test equipment on an engine and climbed a 6-step ladder to remove the electrical connectors. As the employee was reaching to disconnect the electrical connector, the ladder pushed outward from underneath the employee. The employee then fell 5 feet from the top step and suffered a contusion, concussion, and chest abrasion.

On January 4, 2017, at approximately 4:50 a.m., an employee used a stand-up forklift to place a pallet onto a storage rack. He was backing away from the pallet when his right heel was caught and lacerated between an upright behind him and the operator compartment of the lift. He required stitches and overnight hospitalization.
An employee slipped on icy stairs outside and fractured his elbow, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was lowering the safety guard of a mixer with his right hand and pushing ingredients inside the mixer with his left hand when his left hand was caught and fractured between the mixer and the safety guard.
An employee slipped on an icy walkway and fell, hitting his head on the ice.

An employee was polishing a metal bar on a manual lathe with an emery cloth when the cloth became caught around the rotating bar, consecutively catching the employee's glove. The lathe was rotating at 566 rpm at the time of the incident. The employee's right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
While sweeping up trimmings near a line, an employee slipped and fell on a piece of plastic, fracturing the left ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing near a forklift that was carrying a cage. As the employee braced himself on a nearby angle iron, his finger was caught between the cage and the angle iron, amputating his left ring fingertip.
An employee was welding on a flange when his shirt caught fire. He was burned on the face, right hand and arm, and right leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading steel parts from a storage bin, which was about 4 x 8 x 3 feet. During the unloading process, the weight in the bin shifted and the edge lowered onto the employee's right boot, smashing his right pinky toe and resulting in a partial amputation. He was wearing steel-toe boots at the time.

An employee was helping to unload a conduit bending machine from his van onto a forklift. The weight of the forklift shifted, and his finger was caught between the forklift and the bender. He suffered a transphalangeal amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee suffered smoke inhalation that exacerbated the employee's asthma while exiting the building during a small fire.
An employee was unloading chemicals from his truck when they splashed his eyes, face, and head, causing chemical burns.

On 1/4/2018, an employee was securing a part on a flatbed tractor trailer when the employee fell while descending the truck, breaking ribs and an arm, requiring hospitalization. A ladder was not used at the time of the incident.
An employee was working from a ladder and fell breaking the right leg.

An employee was removing a mini loader from a trailer when it overturned and landed on top of him. He suffered a broken face, five broken ribs, a broken right arm, a broken lower back, shoulder fractures, chest fractures, and a shattered right elbow, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a rig floor when equipment fell off a mast as it was erected and struck the employee, causing significant head and neck injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee delivered a full load of concrete to the jobsite. After noticing a pallet was uneven, he climbed onto the bed of the 18-wheeler and tripped over the pallet, fracturing his left femur.
An employee fell off a ladder while applying caulk under stairs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down a ramp and slipped on an icy surface, suffering a left leg fracture.
An employee was troubleshooting a coiler machine when a damaged pneumatic piston actuated and amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee was gluing PVC duct along the shoulder of a runway when he was struck by a pickup truck and thrown about 6 feet, hitting his head on the pavement. He suffered head lacerations, a broken left ankle, and a broken nose, requiring hospitalization.

The employee had been driving a fork truck to load empty cans (product). The injured employee then left the fork truck as another employee was reversing a fork truck nearby. He was in the other fork truck driver's blind spot, and the fork truck driver pinned him between the two fork trucks. He fractured his lower left and right legs, requiring hospitalization.

On 01/04/2018, at 10:45 AM, an employee was helping another employee attach a canvas from a ladder when he lost his balance and fell about 4 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing his left hand and wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stacking 12 x 16 boards when a board came down the slide and struck his finger. He suffered a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was putting pipe on a hanger rack using a ladder when the ladder shifted. The employee then fell 5 feet to the cement/concrete floor below and suffered a broken scalp, broken shoulder, and finger injuries, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was changing a truck battery with a clamp when his finger became caught between the battery and clamp. As he pulled his hand back, his left middle finger was lacerated, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was tied off from a railing performing work when an explosion occurred. The employee suffered severe burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was about to go outside when she saw mail on the floor near the door. She picked it up and was heading back in with the mail when she tripped and fell onto the carpet, breaking her femur.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy patch on the ground at the work site, breaking the left femur.

An employee was cutting through a weld on a glass furnace using a grinder with a cutting wheel. The cutting wheel broke after getting stuck between two pieces of metal and the employee lost control of the grinder, which then scraped the employee's chest and stomach and lacerated the right leg above the knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had jacked the cab of a semi-truck up to get underneath it and perform maintenance when it slipped off the jack and struck the employee.
An employee fell to the floor while closing a dock door, breaking the right femur.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while walking, breaking a wrist.
An employee was helping to move a large metal plate with a forklift when the plate slipped and crushed the employee's right leg, requiring hospitalization.
A metal pipe fell off a forklift and struck a nearby employee, breaking his foot. He required surgery.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a small metal piece when the piece became wedged by the saw blade and flipped with such force that it amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
On January 5, 2018, an employee was cutting cardboard on a table saw when the rotating saw blade amputated the employee's fourth fingertip.

While loading a loader onto a flatbed trailer, an employee lost control of the equipment, which then fell off the trailer to the ground. The employee was caught between the loader and the ground, suffering a fractured arm, bruised ribs, punctured lung, and neck injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was running a moulder machine when it jammed. The employee turned off the equipment, opened it, and was trying to clear the jam when the machine amputated a finger. The moulder machine had not completely stopped and was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to warm up near a stand-up propane heater when his buttocks and the back of his thighs contacted the heater housing. The interior flame then ignited his denim jeans, causing burns to his lower body.

On January 5, 2018, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was attempting to unjam a board from a machine when the employee made contact with the hogger head wheel, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping two other associates close a door to a cardboard baler. The injured employee and a coworker were pushing on the door while another was operating the baler controls. The injured employee instructed a coworker to close the hydraulic clamp that closes the door. The hydraulic clamp crushed the employee's four left-hand fingers (index through pinky) between the door and hydraulic clamp. The fingers were amputated.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground at a customer's house, suffering clavicle and rib fractures, brain bleeding, and loss of consciousness.
An employee fell 15 feet through a skylight while performing roofing work, suffering multiple face and skull fractures, as well as a right hand laceration.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when he could not stop before running into a pole. He jumped off the pallet jack and his ankle was caught between the pallet jack and the pole, resulting in a compound fracture.

An employee was warming up a hydraulic cylinder with a propane heater when hydraulic fluid shot through a pinhole leak in the feed line toward the propane heater and ignited. The employee suffered burns to the face and hands.

An employee was disconnecting a steam pipe that led from a building to a truck that was carrying liquid meat. When the employee disconnected the pipe, residual steam in the pipe released and caused second degree burns to the employee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor inside a work site building, suffering a broken femur. The weather was icy and snowy at the time and the floor was wet from employees entering from outside.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to clean snow off a truck when he fell to the ground.
An employee was walking when her leg became caught in a green strap that was attached to a pallet. She fell and fractured the orbital area of the left side of her face, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to apprehend a suspect when the employee's arm became caught in the suspect's car door. The suspect then sped off and the employee struck a parked car, suffering a broken arm and leg.

An employee was walking on a mulch pile to check for fire when a portion gave out. The employee then fell farther into the burning pile, suffering second degree burns to his right leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping another employee get a lid open on a railcar when he lost his footing and fell from the railcar to the ground. He broke his left ankle, left wrist, and right knee/tibia. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was preparing parts for treating in a salt bath when molten salt was propelled from the salt pot, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's hands and abdomen.

Employee #1 was walking in an area where employee #2 was nailing a bottom plate with a nail gun. A nail from the nail gun bounced off a board, hitting employee #1 in the neck and causing windpipe trauma.

An employee was standing on a step stool and locking out/tagging out an air valve on a bracket welder machine when her right second digit was caught between the frame and doors (guarding) on the back side of the machine. When she stepped down, her second digit fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was shoveling snow and experienced dizziness and chest pains. The employee pulled a muscle.

An employee was spotting for a pipe as an excavator moved it from the pipe yard to the fabrication area. His foot then became stuck in mud and the excavator ran over his foot. He sustained a contusion to his right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood for a cooler panel when the saw amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee was attempting to warm himself near a commercial floor heater. As he walked away from the heater, he felt heat close to his neck and realized his clothes were on fire. He rolled to extinguish the flame, but his left and right shoulders received second and third degree burns and both hands suffered first degree burns.
An employee was placing a part on a jig for welding when the part slipped out of his hand and crushed his left middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee had just delivered mail to an establishment and was returning to a mail vehicle when the employee slipped and fell on the icy ground. The employee suffered a right ankle/foot injury that required hospitalization and surgery.

On January 6, 2018, at approximately 2:50 p.m., an employee was inspecting storage units when he slipped and fell while walking on a slightly inclined grassy area. He broke his left ankle and the bone above it, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering mail when he slipped and fell while walking down ice- and snow-covered steps at a residence. He suffered two small lower back fractures.
An employee was performing a post-trip inspection of a truck when he slipped and looped his right arm through the truck handle bar to steady himself. His arm broke.
An employee fell to the ground while loading tower crane sections on a flatbed semi trailer, breaking the right hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was stabbed by a coworker.
An employee was setting blocks of wood down for a forklift driver when the forks crushed his steel-toe boot. His left big toe was amputated as a result.
An employee was reaching into the back of an EMS SUV vehicle when the hatch door closed and struck her head. She suffered a C6-C7 neck injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a hot liquid in a culinary area when it spilled and burned his right foot.
A reactor overflowed and hot liquid contacted an employee's body, causing second and third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was driving a tractor when it rolled over on her. She suffered a fractured hip and collapsed lung.

An employee was getting ready to climb a ladder to a chemical float trailer. He had put his right hand on the lower section of the ladder when it shifted, causing his right ring finger to be caught between the ladder and the trailer. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unloading a box truck when the truck left the dock area prematurely. The employee then fell off the dock, suffering a dislocated right shoulder and broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding wood pieces into a conveyor when his fingertip was pulled into a nip point between a chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to inspect a roof when the bottom of the ladder slipped, causing him to fall 15 feet to ground. He broke his elbow and pelvis. The bottom of the ladder was placed on top of plastic sheeting at the time of the incident.
On January 7, 2018, at about 1:15 p.m., an employee was struck by a truck while walking between truck bays. The truck dragged the employee, who suffered whole-body and hand injuries.
An employee was changing out an expansion joint with another employee. While they were breaking the bolts loose, oil-based mud leaked out and burned his skin. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clean out cotton that had accumulated in a gin's lint cleaner when his arm became caught in the lint cleaner.
An employee was reaching up to get a case of product off a shelf when he lost his balance and fell on a milk crate and the floor. He suffered pain/soreness in his upper back, ribs, and chest.

An employee was hooking a trailer dolly to a second trailer when he slipped on some black ice and fell on his right hip. He experienced severe hip pain and was hospitalized with a possible hip fracture.
An employee tripped and fell while stepping out of a vehicle, fracturing her arm.
An employee was unjamming a grinder when the blades moved again, cutting and breaking the employee's left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was jackhammering asphalt with his back to a backhoe. The backhoe bucket was resting on the blacktop to the right of the backhoe. The backhoe operator was reaching down for a head warmer on the cab floor when the operator's sweatshirt pocket caught the stick control. This action inadvertently moved the control lever for the "swing arm" and "bucket." The backhoe bucket then moved and pushed the employee who was jackhammering asphalt about 2 to 3 feet until he lost his balance and hit the ground. The bucket continued pushing him for approximately 4 to 5 feet. During that time, the bucket also rose, and the tooth contacted the outer portion of his right boot. The bucket continued to move up and over his boot. The operator then stopped the bucket, but it remained on top of his foot. The bucket's weight (approximately 300 pounds) crushed and lacerated his foot.

An employee had just finished working on top of a main engine, tightening bolts to the exhaust system. He was climbing down the main engine when he slipped and fell to the next lower level (approximately 6-7 feet). His torso struck a guardrail and he suffered a ruptured spleen, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking to her car when she slipped on ice in the parking lot. She broke her hip and suffered a contusion.

An employee was monitoring a section of production between the trimmer and edger saws when he noticed boards were jamming on the overhead conveyor between the saws. He stepped up onto a sheet metal barrier that was 22 inches high and then slipped and fell. His face struck an electrical closure (junction box) that was near the ground, fracturing his jaw and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was servicing a propane truck in a garage when a leak from the truck ignited and caused an explosion. The employee was burned severely and hospitalized.
An employee was taking a client to a doctor's appointment when she slipped, fell, and hit her head on the sidewalk, suffering a brain bleed.
An employee was compressing boxes for recycling. While trying to step on a box to compress it, the employee fell and broke an ankle.
An employee suffered a thumb amputation while degreasing a mixer.

An employee had just set up and started a new product run on a straight tube machine line. The employee was walking toward the cutter machine on the line when she tripped on an airline that was at the base of the machine near the floor. She fell toward the cutter machine and reached out to stop her fall by bracing the machine. At the same time, a copper pipe (5/8" or 1" diameter) was coming out and impaled her right palm, requiring hospitalization. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was walking through a coffee bar when she slipped on coffee creamer on the floor and fell, fracturing her right femur and left elbow.
An employee was carrying a container of food product to the cooler when the employee tripped over a box that a vendor left on the floor. The employee fell and fractured the left patella.
An employee was pulling a pallet of product with a hand jack. The pallet was stuck to another pallet due to the plastic wrap. His right foot was then crushed by the wheel of the hand jack.

An employee was stringing an overhead powerline of a pulling rig between two towers. When another employee started pulling the wire, the employee maintained contact with the wire and was raised approximately 15 to 20 feet above the ground. He then lost his grip on the wire and fell to the ground, breaking his pelvis and left wrist.
An employee was helping to subdue a patient who suddenly became violent when the patient punched her. She was hospitalized with lower back and hip pain.

On January 8, 2018, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was flagging traffic on a two-lane road. A log truck, pulling a trailer with logs, was directed through the work zone. The trailer's outside tires dropped off the pavement, causing the trailer to tip. As the trailer tipped over, the straps holding the logs broke. The employee, standing approximately 20 feet away, began running and was struck by the rolling logs, suffering multiple fractures to the face, hip, pelvis, neck, and back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was heating water in a stainless steel work sink to perform a cleaning operation. The water began boiling, so the employee introduced cold water into the bottom of the sink to cool it down. The reaction of the cold and hot water and the force of the water going into the bottom of the sink caused the water to spew out from the sink and splash onto the employee. He sustained second degree burns to the front of both of his legs and a spot on his abdomen and right forearm. The water was estimated to be at a temperature of 212 degrees.
While delivering products to a customer, an employee slipped on snow/ice in the customer's parking lot and broke a wrist, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to separate a hex socket from the sleeve of an adapter that was used to link a bore machine to an auger. The employee was supporting the hex socket with a finger while tapping the socket with a small hammer to unseat it from the sleeve. The socket gave way, amputating the employee's fingertip with a guillotine action.
An employee was skiing on intermediate terrain with students when he lost control and fell forward on both arms, suffering a bilateral upper arm fracture.
An employee was opening the door to a piece of pelletizing equipment when hot water contacted and burned his leg.

An employee was attempting to track a conveyor belt when his jacket was pulled into the conveyor belt, breaking bones in his right arm. He was hospitalized. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was trying to remove bread from an outer slicer blade. She swiped at the debris and her left index finger contacted the outside bread slicer blade, amputating her left index fingertip.

An employee was helping a tug operator line up the tug with a dolly tongue. The employee stepped between the tug and the dolly tongue and her leg was pinned between the two pieces of equipment, injuring her left knee.
An employee was retrieving hamburger patties from between moving conveyor belts when the employee's finger entered a pinch point and suffered an amputation. The machine was not shut off at the time.
An employee was working on a tire while a customer was putting air in an air tank. The tank exploded under pressure, causing injuries to both of the employee's legs.

An employee was clearing a jam in a panel/film and tensioner wheel. The employee raided the tensioner wheel set and began pushing the panel/film out of the wheels. The thumb of the his left glove became caught in the tensioner wheel assembly, pulling his hand through the top and bottom wheels. Once his hand travelled through, he was able to free it. His left thumb fractured.
An employee was cleaning out tote line equipment for a product change-over when the equipment amputated two of his fingers. The equipment was not locked out at the time.

An employee was operating a forklift and when he tried to stop the forklift it slid on the frozen floor. As the forklift was sliding, the employee dismounted the lift and sustained a laceration and fracture of the left arm.
On January 20, 2018, an employee was walking from the parking lot toward the main entrance when she slipped and fell, hitting her head on concrete.
An employee was walking behind the checkout counter when she tripped on a box and fell onto shelving, fracturing her left hip.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was pulling wire from a bobbin to correct a tangle in the wire. As the employee started the spooler to reload the wire onto the bobbin, the wire caught the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with an ankle fracture.

An employee had helped to load a backhoe onto a trailer and was walking toward the front of the trailer to get down. The employee was walking under the outrigger of the backhoe when the chain snapped and knocked the employee off of the trailer onto the ground. The employee suffered a ruptured spleen and internal bleeding.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down an incline that was covered in snow/ice, breaking a bone under the right kneecap.
An employee inside the stock room was walking around the product cart (U-Boat) and tripped over a pallet. The employee fell to the ground and fractured the right hip.

An employee was setting up a booth at a merchandise show when two furniture fixtures fell, pushing the employee to the floor and landing partially on top of him. He suffered an ear laceration and fractured tailbone.

On January 21, 2018, an employee was rigging down rig stairs to be picked up by a mobile equipment telehandler. While the telehandler was scoping out to pick up the rig stairs by the handrails, the forks bounced and struck the employee on his left shoulder. He suffered pain and numbness on the right side of his body, as well as inflamed bulging discs.

An employee was watering a lift battery (approximately 350 lbs.). The battery did not have the retainer in place at the time. As he was pulling on the lid of the battery, it rolled out of the compartment and fell over. He tried to catch it and it fell on his right hand, smashing fingers two - five. Sulfuric acid also leaked from the battery onto his hand. His right long finger had to be amputated at the second knuckle.
A security guard was trying to bring an unruly customer out of a restaurant when the customer hit the security guard with a glass, causing a facial laceration that required surgery.

A parking lot security officer was attempting to stop an alleged shoplifter while he stole her vehicle and started to drive away. She was dragged by the vehicle some distance while hitting barriers, suffering bruised ribs and a head laceration. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from the shop roof to the ground, suffering cracked ribs and a broken shoulder. He was hospitalized.
While working in the scrapping/milking area, an employee mistook formaldehyde for water and ingested approximately 4 to 5 ounces of 37% formaldehyde, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to peanuts while working at the hospital.

An employee was driving a street sweeper down a well pad access road when he applied the brakes, slid into a ditch, hit a mound, went airborne, and rolled two times. He suffered fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was loading bags onto an aircraft. He tried to stop the door to the aircraft from closing and missed. The door then closed onto his left index fingertip, severing it.

An employee was stepping from an office area into a production area and slipped. One of the employee's legs went forward, while one stayed put, hyperextending the legs (no fall). The employee suffered a torn leg ligament and was hospitalized.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and suffered a dislocated hip.

An employee was loading a conveyor belt from the front side of a skid. While he was bending down to reach for another product, a box fell on top of him, striking the back of his neck and upper back between the shoulder blades.

An employee was installing a tin shield over insulated wires that were exposed to hot metal when the shield touched a bare conductor and an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered an arc flash burn and possible concussion.

An employee was directing other employees who were installing a cured in-place pipe when hot water splashed from the installation equipment and contacted the employee. He suffered first to second degree burns on his upper body and fractured several fingers when he fell on the ground. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down the side steps of a tractor trailer when the employee missed a step and fell to the concrete, sustaining a hematoma of the brain.

An employee was framing the edge of a roof dormer when he leaned against an unsecured rafter and fell approximately 20 feet from the roof edge, breaking his back and knee and suffering lacerations. He was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was acting as a spotter as another employee was operating a portable crane to remove a bag house filter. His hand was holding the top part of the hoist's load cable when it reeled in his left index finger, pinching it and resulting in a surgical amputation.

An employee was inspecting a vehicle's wheel and tire while the vehicle was on a lift when the employee's hand was caught between the vehicle's brake caliper and wheel spokes. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on ice when she went to retrieve something from her car, suffering a broken leg.
While walking across a snow-covered parking lot, an employee slipped on a patch of ice and impacted the frozen ground, suffering a subcutaneous bleed and head trauma.
An employee had an asthma attack after being exposed to floor stripper.

An employee was using a wrench to adjust equipment when it jerked the wrench, causing his right ring finger to get caught between the wrench and the equipment. His finger broke and his fingertip was amputated. The equipment was running at the time of the incident.
An employee had just arrived at the home of a patient and walked in with wet shoes from the snow outside. She slipped on the wet floor and landed on her knee, breaking her kneecap.
An employee was reversing a standup forklift when extension forks that were stored on a pallet behind him protruded into the cab, pinning, dislocating, and breaking his left ankle.

An employee was attempting to remove a stub of core at a core cutter when his hand went between the ejector and roller, and his middle finger became caught. His fingertip was pulled off between the equipment.

Employees were emptying and transferring residual powdered plastic from a hopper to a supper-sack in preparation to tag out the equipment for cleaning. One of the employees reached into the bottom of the hopper and made contact with the rotary valve. The valve was in operation and amputated the employee's right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was in a lift changing light fixtures on a pole in front of a house when he contacted a powerline and was shocked, suffering third degree burns.

An employee was using a pick-axe to unjam lumber (approximately 192 lbs.) from a machine when the lumber slipped and pinned his left pinky finger between the edge of the board and another board. His finger was pinched off below the fingernail.

An employee slipped on concrete in a wash basin and attempted to prevent his fall by grabbing onto a section of portable scaffolding. The scaffolding fell on top of him and he struck the concrete, suffering a head injury, concussion, and brain bleed.
An employee was unloading materials from a truck trailer when an all-terrain forklift dumped timber onto the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and ankle.
An employee slipped outside while walking to his car and hit his head, suffering a contusion.
An employee was using a power drill to clean the barrel of an extrusion line when the employee's glove became entangled in the drill. As a result, the employee's left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking her right ankle.
An employee was stocking the upper shelves in a store while riding in an order selector/platform lift. The employee fell from the lift and suffered a concussion.
An employee slipped and fell on ice on a customer's driveway, suffering a leg injury.
An employee fell to the floor while walking out of a bakery freezer, suffering a right ankle injury.

One employee was in the back of a box truck while a second employee was standing outside when an air compressor exploded in the box truck's engine compartment. One of the employees was hospitalized with burns.
An employee was standing on top of a greenhouse pulling plastic off the frame when he lost his balance and fell approximately 14 feet, injuring his shoulder.

Two employees were driving pallet jacks and crossing the same intersection. One of the employees swerved to avoid hitting the other employee and hit an impact-protective pole, breaking his right foot.

An employee was putting tape on the back of paper at a paper cutter machine when his fingers became caught in the machine's rollers. He then fell on his right side and struck the steel frame of the machine, breaking five ribs and his collarbone.
An employee tripped and fell when walking over a transition between two different types of flooring, breaking her pelvis and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading an ATV sub component into a weld cell when his glove and right middle finger were caught between a clamping mechanism. His right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working at a height of about 15 feet to remove gang forms and strip out a bulk head with another employee working on the opposite side of him. The employee was wearing a positioning belt and was tied off to an anchor point affixed to a rebar. As he was working, the positioning belt's hook slipped off the tie-off point and he fell, striking a protruding rebar at a lower level and puncturing his right thigh.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while working from a scaffold resulting in a fractured right wrist.

An employee was walking near a conveyor when he slipped on fat on the floor and attempted to break his fall by grabbing the conveyor. His arm was pulled into the conveyor, fracturing his right radius.
An employee was sitting on the tailgate of a moving pickup truck when the employee fell to the dirt ground, suffering a fractured left hip.
An employee was grabbing a transfer cup to place it on top of a rod when his thumb became caught in the transfer cup's hole, amputating it.
An employee was driving a yard hostler when he crashed into a terminal light post with a concrete base. He fractured his leg and was hospitalized.
An employee strained his back while lifting a truck tire.

An employee was leaving for the day and walking toward the employee exit. She walked through the kitchen and was turning the corner when she fell through an open hatch to a crawl space under the kitchen that was going to be sprayed for bugs. She broke three ribs and bruised her shoulder.
An employee was in a manhole getting ready to test a pressurized sewer line when the line plug struck the employee's head.

An employee was unloading an I-beam from a flatbed truck and then hooked the I-beam's chains onto an all-terrain forklift's low back rest. He signaled the forklift driver to raise the I-beam. As the I-beam was being raised, the chain broke, causing one side of the I-beam to hit and break his left tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving scrap steel when it broke and fell on his feet, fracturing both of them.

Two employees were removing a bundle of glass by hand from a ground-level storage rack when the bundle fell, striking one of the employees in the back of the right leg. His right tibia broke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing new wiring for a sign when he received an electrical shock and fell off his ladder. He landed on his ankle, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a filling machine when he observed defective caps locked in the supply channels to the capper. He put the capper in manual mode and manually moved the joint with his left hand as he tried to remove the crowns with his right hand. During this operation, one of his fingers entered the moving machine, severing his fingertip.
An employee was walking backwards while operating an overhead crane when the employee tripped and fell over a pallet. The employee's right elbow struck the frame of the crane and suffered a fracture.

An employee was moving a pallet from a truck when the truck pulled away from the dock. She then jumped from the jack plate on the dock to the back of the truck and fell to the ground, suffering a skull fracture and slight concussion. She was hospitalized.
An employee was monitoring a molasses auger when the employee's right hand contacted the auger, suffering a partial de-gloving.
On January 23, 2018, at 4 p.m., an employee was switching railcars and walking beside a train when he tripped and fell. His right arm was then amputated by the train wheel.
An employee was standing on a 4-foot scaffold when the employee stepped off the edge and fell to the ground. The employee's head struck the ground, suffering a temporal fracture.

On January 23, 2018, at 4:10 p.m., an employee was placing a brass valve into a water test tank on a fixture system when he inadvertently hit the back lever, causing the clamp that holds the valve in place to clamp on his left middle finger, amputating it.
An employee was leaving work when she approached the entrance to the building and slipped and fell on the floor, which was being mopped. She suffered a possible hip fracture.
An employee was working near a shoulder spreader when it was loaded onto his foot, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a tugger when he went around a corner and fell off the tugger, landing on and fracturing his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead crane to remove product from a line when his left ring finger was caught between the crane hook and the product carrier, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was attempting to stop a fire in a lint cleaner when his left hand became caught in the machine, amputating four fingers.
An employee used a forklift to pick up a trowel and clean the pans that were underneath it. The trowel was still running when one of the pans ejected, striking and breaking an employee's left shin.

A truck trailer was parked at the dock. An employee was stepping backwards in the trailer when her foot became caught on a pallet or piece of freight. She fell backwards and broke her ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's foot became caught on a desk and she fell between the desk and a copier machine, breaking her right hip.
An employee was transferring boxes of product from one pallet to another when she lost her balance and fell to the ground, breaking her right ankle.
An employee was walking in the dry dock area when she caught her left foot on a trash bin, tripped and fell. She fractured her elbow and required hospitalization and surgery.
While moving a circuit breaker cabinet, an employee contacted live electrical parts, suffering hand burns and a wrist laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was riding the elevator down from the 5th floor. It stopped between the 1st and 2nd floors and would not move. He tried to get the elevator to move, worked his way out of the opening, and fell about 6 feet to the pavement below. He broke several ribs.

An employee was screwing a mechanical bar into rebar in concrete but was having trouble threading the bars. He used a drill to try to get the bar to go in, and caught the glove of another employee in the drill. This caused the injured employee's  left hand to spin around breaking his left pinky and index fingers and dislocating his ring and middle fingers.

An employee was on a ladder bolting a beam onto a wood column when the beam fell off the column. The employee tried to grab the falling beam and fell off the ladder to the ground, breaking his right arm.

An employee was grabbing an end piece from the billet box on a shear cutter when the shear cut another piece (an approximately 70-pound billet), which rolled and struck his left hand. His index and ring fingers broke, and the three middle fingers required stitches on the palm side. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was opening boxes of meat and then breaking the cardboard down for recycling when her right pinky finger contacted the blade of a bandsaw someone else was using and was lacerated, requiring medical amputation.

An employee was going to perform routine maintenance (cleaning) on the plasma cutter table. The employee lifted the top part off the plasma cutter table with an overhead crane. The interior slag tray slipped out of the rigging and fell onto the employee, who suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
While cutting a cedar tree, an employee fell from a height of about 12 feet and struck the ground, suffering a broken collarbone.
After installing ductwork, an employee was descending a ladder when he fell approximately 8 to 10 feet, suffering multiple fractures.

An employee was cleaning the site and putting debris in a skid steer bucket. He was dislodging a piece of wood that was caught between the mechanical arm of a skid steer when he inadvertently pressed the skid steer's foot control. His right leg was then caught between the arm and the bucket, breaking his tibia.

An employee was attempting to get an infeed belt to a chipper running again. He applied pressure to the belt with his foot so the belt would gain traction. At the same time, another employee was toggling the forward and reverse switch for the belt. The first employee's right foot then became caught between the conveyor belt and the end roll of the conveyor, breaking bones in the right foot and leg area. He was hospitalized.
An employee was crossing the street when an unsecured load of pipe fell off a flatbed truck and struck him, fracturing his leg.
An employee was moving a refrigerator with a hand dolly. While lifting, the employee's hip joint displaced out of its socket.
An employee was troubleshooting live circuit breakers that were tripping at a meter box when an arc flash occurred. He was engulfed in flames, receiving severe burns to his face and hands.

An employee was performing maintenance underneath a railcar mover unit when a stand failed, causing the employee to be pinned by the unit. The employee suffered internal injuries, broken ribs, and a broken collarbone, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling wire and received third degree burns from an electrical shock at a splice box.
An employee was adjusting the pressure spring on a label machine when it came down and struck the employee's right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading a roll of paper into a machine and the employee's finger was crushed between the mast of a mobile hand truck and a plastic chuck on the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a falling tree, suffering pain in his left lower back and left arm, numbness in his right foot, and burns.
An employee was walking down the stairs of a platform when she missed a step and broke her lower left leg.
On January 24, 2018, an employee was attempting to remove a part from a packaging robot when the employee's finger was caught in the spin line's point of operation, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was picking up trash on an interstate off-ramp when a car hit the employee, who suffered a broken right tibia. The employee was wearing PPE at the time.
While exiting a roof via an extension ladder, an employee fell off and suffered head trauma.
An employee was crossing the street in the crosswalk to another office building when he was struck by a car, suffering a head injury, fractured ribs, and lacerations.
An employee was getting into a burden carrier which is similar to a golf cart when their knee gave out.
While descending a ladder, an employee missed a step and fell to the ground, suffering back contusions.
An employee slipped and fell on ice after leaving her vehicle to begin work at the store, fracturing her ankle.
An employee was cleaning a coffee pot with bleach when he inhaled chemical vapors. He began coughing and his throat was burning, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a come-along to realign a chain on a sprocket when the employee's left thumb was caught between the chain and sprocket, lacerating and breaking it. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking to the facility from the company parking lot when she slipped on ice and injured her back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was trying to unjam a pipe that was stalled in a hydro tester. The employee was able to clear the stall, at which point the hydro tester allowed another pipe to enter it. The employee's right thumb was then caught between the two pipes, amputating it at the middle joint.
An employee was on a ladder pumping a residential column full of concrete. He was leaning on the column when it collapsed, causing him to fall to the ground. He injured his hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was collecting garbage and crossing the street to retrieve another garbage container when a vehicle hit him, fracturing his right tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee changed out two full bobbins of yarn on a spooling machine, reloaded the machine with two new empty bobbins, wrapped the fiberglass yarn around the two bobbins, and pressed the start button with the left hand while the right hand was on one of the bobbins. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were then caught and pulled into the bobbin, and the yarn abraded/cut the inside of these two fingers.
On January 24, 2018, an employee was exiting his car in the parking lot when he slipped and fell on ice, bumping his head. He suffered a brain hemorrhage and was hospitalized.

On January 24, 2018, at approximately 7:45 a.m., an employee slipped on ice after exiting her car on the top floor of the parking garage and fell, striking the back of her head on the ground. She suffered a concussion, requiring hospitalization.
While walking in a hallway, an employee turned around, lost balance, fell to the floor, and sustained a head concussion.
An employee was stepping off a pallet jack when it rolled and pinned him against a rack, fracturing his right leg in two places.
An employee was walking back to his patrol vehicle when he slipped and fell on a patch of black ice, suffering back and neck injuries, a concussion, and broken ribs.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while lifting a fire hydrant.

An employee was unloading a truck using an auger machine when the machine became jammed. As he attempted to clear the jam by pulling on the belt, the belt started up again. His thumb was then pinched between the belt and pulley, amputating the tip. The machine was energized and the belt and pulley were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee's face was struck by a falling piece of wooden billboard during vinyl installation. The employee suffered a face contusion and sore back.
An employee was using a miter saw when it became jammed with material. As he attempted to unjam the saw, his fingers were caught by the blades, amputating his right ring fingertip.

An employee was changing a preheater feed screw. He was using a 4-foot-long piece of pipe to bump the blow-back cylinder and make it retract so that the feed screw could be removed. The cylinder then moved forward instead of retracting, which forced the pipe back. The pipe pinned the employee's hand between the end of the pipe and a very heavy flange that was part of the machine frame. The employee's right index finger was amputated.

An employee was checking pressure in the fuel injector pump of a truck when his left hand slipped into the moving truck engine fan, lacerating it between the thumb and forefinger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was loading a truck with material when a metal banding brace that was holding the material broke and lacerated his finger.
While working in the laboratory, an employee fell. The employee's head hit a countertop or the floor, suffering a concussion and hematoma.
An employee was attempting to pull a dolly loaded with boxes when his foot slipped. The dolly then fell backward onto the employee, fracturing his right hip.

An employee and his crew were connecting a float hose and a head section (floating pipeline for hydraulic dredge). He was tying a 2-inch polypropylene line from the dredge tender to the pontoon tank when his left ring and pinky fingers were caught and amputated between the line and the bit.
On 1/24/2018, an employee suffered a fingertip amputation while repairing a truck's lift gate.
An employee was stacking boxes of cantaloupes from a conveyor line onto pallets located behind him. He grabbed a box from the bottom, and his pinky finger was caught and lacerated under the belt.
An employee slipped and fell resulting in a head injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on an exhaust fan motor for a salon. The employee performed lockout/tagout on the unit but the fan continued to rotate because of the positive pressure in the building. The employee was attempting to slow the rotation of the fan by slowing the drive belt when the employee's right hand was pulled into the drive pulley, amputating the right middle fingertip.
An employee was on an extension ladder cleaning snow off the top of a semi-trailer when the ladder slipped from under him. He fell about 13 feet to the ground and broke his pelvis.

An employee opened the door to a battery condenser and was attempting to push cotton through it when his left arm became caught and crushed in the feed works. The machine was operating at the time of the incident.
An employee was helping to install an engine and screwing in a bolt when the engine slipped off its rigging and smashed his right index finger.

On January 25, 2018, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was removing unused conduit when he stepped to his left and tripped over a 12-inch-high spill containment wall, falling to the ground and fracturing his tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a drill to install sheet metal beauty rings around ductwork when the employee's hand slipped and hit the metal duct, lacerating the right index finger.
An employee was snowboarding down a mountain after giving a ski lesson when the employee collided with another snowboarder, suffering a concussion.
An employee was reaching to pull paper off a spindle when she was pulled into the equipment. She suffered a compound fracture to her right arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift to bring material to a shrink wrap table. He got off the forklift and was taking the load off the skid when he bumped a spool piece, which then fell on his right foot, resulting in an amputation to the right big toe.

An employee was moving a steel plate with a magnet when the plate slipped off the magnet and landed on his right foot's big toe and second toe, amputating the phalanges. Straps were not used at the time of the incident.
On 1/25/2018, an employee was finishing drywall when he fell off a scaffold and broke his arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee stepped on a two-step stool and was putting away plastic containers when she lost her balance and fell backwards, fracturing her right leg.

An employee was training a new employee on how to operate a tug/dolly. She was trying to unhitch the dolly when the tug pulled it forward, striking her. She suffered a leg fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee dismounted a forklift to dump a hopper of scrap wood into a grinder stockpile area. He braced his left palm on the outside of the forks, which placed his left pinky in the path of the hopper channels where the forks were pre-positioned. When he moved the level to dump the hopper, the weight caused the hopper edge to drop and crush his left pinky fingertip, which had to be surgically amputated.
On 1/25/2018, at approximately 6:45 AM, an employee's right thumb rolled underneath a conveyor belt and was caught, amputating the tip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a dicer machine used to cut cheese curds when he contacted the star blade, resulting in an amputation of his right index fingertip and the top of his right middle finger. The machine was not completely shut down at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood plank that was bolted to a trailer with a circular saw when the saw kicked back, amputating half of the employee's right index finger.

On January 25, 2018, an employee was steering a scrap tractor that was brought in on a trailer while another employee was pulling the tractor with an excavator. The tractor rolled backwards, pinning the employee between the excavator bucket and the tractor steering wheel. The employee suffered torso contusions and was hospitalized.

An employee was marking a concrete structure that was frozen to the ground when an excavator operator went to push the structure with the excavator bucket. The operator did not see the employee and moved the structure, which then struck the employee. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and fractures.

An employee was using a hydraulic torque wrench to tighten bolts on a flange. The employee's left hand was near the head where the hydraulic hose connects to the wrench. The hose became punctured and injected the employee's left-hand palm with hydraulic fluid, lacerating it.
An employee was re-mounting a conveyor rear lift cylinder when the conveyor became over centered and pinned him between the cylinder and rear mount, breaking and lacerating his right arm.

Two employees were performing maintenance and troubleshooting on the B side of a reactor catalyst feed system when the tubing failed on the A side and caused an explosion of hydrocarbon products. Both employees received thermal burns and were hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to install a conduit on an outside wall. He was climbing an 8-foot A-frame ladder that was leaning against the wall when he lost his footing and fell about 6 feet, striking a table positioned next to the ladder. He broke his arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was attempting to adjust the core in a winder when his finger became caught between the core and the spindle arm. His right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a marking machine when his glove became caught and pulled his left hand into the machine, crushing his index and middle fingers.

Two employees were aligning a head pulley with a tail pulley on a vertical leg/bucket conveyor. The injured employee was measuring the distance from the tail pulley to the plumbing string at the lower level when he was struck by a 2x2x6 angle iron weighing approximately 14.64 lbs. that came loose while the coworker, 130 feet above, was repositioning it. The angle iron fractured and severely lacerated his lower right leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was cleaning when he bumped into a vertical pipe containing hydrofluoric acid. The acid dripped down under his gloves, burning the top of his left wrist. The pipe had been flushed at the time of the incident, but a section had a few ounces of trapped acid. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to pull out a blank from a machine when his right middle finger became caught between the feed rollers. His right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was performing a hydro test on a 16" pipe when the pipe's underground connection failed. The pipe then shifted and fell onto the employee's left foot, fracturing and lacerating it.
An employee was pushing a cart when he hurt his hand, became lightheaded, and fell, striking his head on the floor. He fractured his skull and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down the stairs, breaking her arm.

An employee was standing close to an excavator when the equipment hit a pipe, which then moved toward him. His boot was caught on something, so he was unable to move before the pipe struck his left leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula.
An employee tripped and fell on uneven pavement while walking to a patient's home, suffering a fractured hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee accessed a truck's roll-off container and fell to the ground, fracturing his left leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a bundler when the bundle ram came down on his left hand, smashing his left ring finger between the bundle board. When he pulled his hand out, his left ring fingertip was ripped off.
An employee was working in a warehouse when a forklift rolled onto the employee's foot.
An employee had been standing on an 8-foot step ladder to examine roof work. As she was climbing down, she slipped and fell off the ladder, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were carrying a glass shower door that had been returned to the store. One employee dropped his end of the door, causing the glass door to shatter. The shattered glass then lacerated his left wrist.
A employee was inspecting a motor home when a line underneath the motor home was severed, resulting in the amputation of his fingertip.
An employee was testing equipment when a valve ruptured. The employee was then struck by the valve or water pressure resulting in a leg laceration.

A temporary employee was driving a forklift to the battery charging area when he struck the bollard around a pole. The employee was not wearing a seat belt and struck the safety cage. When he tried to get off the lift, he passed out, fell, and hit his head on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized and had surgery for a broken neck.
An employee tripped over a box on the floor and fell, fracturing the pelvis.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground outside of the store, breaking his arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was repairing a door latch on an industrial washing machine when the washer activated and closed on the employee's left hand and forehead. The employee suffered four broken fingers and a forehead laceration.
An employee was pushing a cart that had fiberglass rolls on it when she slipped and hit her head on the cart. She required stitches and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a door stop while entering the office and fell to the ground, breaking a femur.
Two employees were involved in a physical altercation. One employee was shoved and fell to the ground breaking a leg.
On January 26, 2018, an employee was exiting a truck when he slipped and fell, breaking his femur and elbow.
An employee was walking from the company parking lot when he slipped on mud, fell, and broke his right ankle.
An employee was working at a register when she tripped over a cord and fell to her right side, striking the floor and fracturing her right hip. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was adjusting a "T" attachment on a loader to carry a bundle of guide rods. The driver of the loader exited it and bumped the steering wheel, causing the "T" attachment to shift. The employee's hand was then caught between the guide rod bundle and the "T" attachment, partially amputating his right ring finger.
An employee was pulling a shopping cart with garbage down a set of three steps when the load in the cart shifted, causing her to fall and injure her right hip. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was greasing the bearing on a sheet stacker machine when the machine's chain pulled his gloved right hand into the moving sprocket, amputating his right index and middle fingers to the second knuckle and partially amputating his thumb. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was building PIT mast cylinders when his leg was caught between cylinder machinery and a moving part, suffering a contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing steel guide plates when a guide plate fell on his left hand, crushing his third and fourth fingers and resulting in one surgical fingertip amputation.
An employee was about to open a box on the back of his truck when a retaining arm that holds up the tail gate came loose and struck the employee's face resulting in a laceration.
An employee was working on a scaffold when he fell to the ground below, shattering his leg and breaking his wrist.

An employee was working out of a bucket truck to cut off the top of a pine tree when the tree top fell and hit the boom of the bucket truck. The employee was ejected 40 feet out of the truck to the surface below, suffering facial and back fractures.
An employee was operating a reach truck. As he backed up, a piece of pallet was sticking up and it cut into his left thigh and came out the other end.
While cleaning a grill hood, an employee fell into a fryer with hot oil, requiring hospitalization for third degree burns.
An employee was repositioning a resident onto a patient lift pad with another employee when she experienced back pain and could not move. She was hospitalized.
While walking to the break room, an employee tripped over a concrete step-up and fell to the same level, fracturing the right patella.

An employee was climbing an 8-foot fixed ladder. When he reached the platform at the top, he let go of the railing on the ladder and grabbed the inward swinging safety gate. When he removed his first hand to grab the gate, his second hand slipped off the railing. He fell to the floor below, striking his elbow on the floor. He suffered a fractured humerus and elbow tip as well as an open wound contusion.

An employee was working from an 8-foot step ladder to change a lightbulb when a gust of wind blew the lens off. The employee fell to the ground while attempting to catch the lens, injuring both ankles and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was resetting paper when the employee's right hand went between two moving gravity fed rollers, suffering a right forearm contusion.

An employee was working at the customer service counter when her foot became entangled in an electrical cord that was sticking out from the bottom shelf. She tripped and fell to the same level, breaking her right hip.
An employee was attempting to stop shoplifters when he was pushed down, injuring his back and hip (possible broken hip). He was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a valve open by hand when a pig within the pipe struck the valve, causing the lever to strike the employee, who then fell to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs and a bruised lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet while descending a scaffold ladder, fracturing the right elbow and L3 vertebra.
An employee was climbing a two-step ladder, mis-stepped, lost her balance, and fell to the concrete floor resulting in a fractured and dislocated right wrist.

An employee was cleaning a piston-type vacuum pump attached to an extruder machine when his left glove was caught in the cylinder by the internal machine parts, resulting in an amputation to his left index fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while descending a ladder, fracturing the left hip.

An employee had been in a derrick helping a snubbing unit crew change out a stiff arm. He was coming down from the derrick when the snubbing unit dropped the short stiff arm, which then caught his left index finger against the handrail. He suffered an open compound fracture to his finger.
An employee's lower shirt sleeve ignited while he was lighting a cigarette in the designated smoking area. He suffered second degree burns to his lower arm.
An employee was walking out of a freezer and removing coveralls when the employee became tangled up in them. The employee then fell onto a pallet and the floor, dislocating the left shoulder.
