An employee was removing hanging pipes from a conveyor when her finger became caught in a nip point on the conveyor, partially amputating her fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the fitness center when she lost her footing while moving a stationary bike, hitting her back on a treadmill and fracturing her vertebra.
An employee was performing laundry services when clothes in a dryer caught on fire. The employee opened the dryer door and inhaled smoke, suffering lung irritation and exacerbation of asthma.
While walking from the main wastewater treatment facility to an out building, an employee slipped on ice and fell. The employee's head struck the blacktop ground, suffering brain swelling.
An employee was pulling passenger bags in the bag room when he was struck by a vehicle, breaking his left leg.
An employee exited a lift and was walking on pipes when he fell from the pipes to the ground, injuring his wrist and head.
An employee was cleaning when he slipped on a piece of paper and fell out of a dock door, hitting the ground and breaking ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lowering a catering box onto a truck chassis when her pinky finger was caught between the frame of the truck and the guard on the back of the truck cab. Her pinky fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was vacuuming sand from the rig sand box when a gas buster that was chained open came down and pinched the end of the employee's left index finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was securing a bell hook by wrapping a strap around the A-frame of a side boom when the operator moved the winch, causing the strap to fasten around the A-frame and the winch mounting bracket. The employee's left hand was then caught between mounting bracket and A-frame. The employee suffered a broken left hand, a ring finger compound exposure, and broken middle finger.
An employee's foot was crushed between a dock plate and a clamp, resulting in toe amputations.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering broken ribs and blood in a lung. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing roofing operations at a house when he walked over the opening of a skylight that had been covered with insulation and fell through it approximately 8 feet to the ground. He received cuts to his head, possible broken ribs, and a back injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when the bottom of the ladder shifted. The ladder and the employee fell, landing on his back and breaking his vertebra.
An employee was working in the tool supply room when she tripped over a box, fell to the ground, and broke her hip.

An employee was cutting a piece of particle board on a table saw when the employee's left index finger caught the edge of the saw. The saw blade then sliced off the employee's fingertip above the first knuckle. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was unloading a cylinder cage out of a truck when his leg was caught on the truck's side gate. He fell to the ground and broke his left leg.

An employee was working on a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machine when a part came loose inside the machine. The door of the machine stopped the part, but the door caused the employee to fall off the 15-inch platform and land on the ground. The employee suffered a broken collarbone, broken rib, and other injuries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking up and down an aisle inspecting lint cleaners when his right arm became caught in the rollers of a lint cleaner. The lint cleaner was guarded at the time.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift inside a warehouse. As he dismounted it, his left lower leg was pinned and fractured between the lift and an elevating caster deck. He was hospitalized. The forklift had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a possible hernia while stacking ice cream on a pallet, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a stock picker when he hit a rack and bounced out of the picker, falling to the floor and suffering a concussion. He was hospitalized. The magnetic aisle guide was not engaged at the time of the incident.

Two employees were installing an aerial service wire to a residence. One employee had connected the line at the pole and ran the wire across the road to the residence while a second employee was working on an 8' ladder to connect the wire at the residence. A car then drove over the wire and it became tangled in the undercarriage of the vehicle, pulling the second employee off the ladder. He fell into the bed of the residence's truck, fracturing ribs and suffering hand burns from the wire.

An employee was unloading a jib boom from his truck bed onto the ground to deliver it to a customer when the chain slipped, causing the unit to tip over and fall on him. He suffered a broken back, shattered pelvis, and damage to the knee and shoulder.
An employee was cleaning an area when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between two product safety magnets.
An employee was climbing a 12-foot ladder when he fell approximately 5 to 7 feet to the concrete below, injuring his head and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using chemical cleaners to clean urinals when she experienced coughing and vomiting, requiring hospitalization.
On January 29, 2018, an employee was cleaning up garbage when he tripped over a garbage can and bumped his head on the floor.
An employee fell to the ground while walking from a work cell, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was trying to move an X-ray machine 4 inches away from the wall by sliding a skate underneath it when a board broke and the skate twisted, crushing his right middle finger between the skate and the machine. His right middle finger was amputated at the fingernail.

On January 29, 2018, an employee was performing maintenance on equipment when he slipped and fell. His left hand then then went between a belt and pulley on an adjacent machine, amputating his left middle fingertip. The belt and pulley was unguarded at the time.
An employee was changing a chain on equipment when his hand was caught between the chain and a bolt, amputating his left thumb tip.

An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw when the blade kicked back and he lost control of the saw. The blade then lacerated the fourth and fifth fingers on his right hand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to clear a clogged pipe at a cooker when he inadvertently opened a drain instead of closing it. He was sprayed with 240-degree hot product, suffering second and third degree burns across the front side of his body.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, fracturing her foot and tearing her Achilles tendon.

An employee was standing on a rolling table to remove Christmas decorations at the top of the bulletin board. The rolling table moved from under her causing her to fall. The employee was hospitalized for a subdural hematoma and a partial scalp hemorrhage.

An employee was drilling a hole in a wooden mat when the employee's right glove was grabbed by the countersink piece of the drill bit. The employee's right arm was then pulled by the moving drill bit, resulting in multiple fractures of the upper and lower right arm.
An employee was operating a plasma cutter to cut metal when he stepped into the truck area of the cutter, breaking his left leg.
On January 17, 2018, an employee was using a crane to move a piece of steel that weighed over 100 lbs. when the steel fell on the employee's finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was using a slider table saw to cut a narrow piece of wood off when the narrow scrap piece fell between the blade and the table. As he attempted to retrieve the scrap, his left middle finger contacted the blade, amputating the fingertip (no bone). The saw was guarded and running at the time.
An employee was helping spot a tractor trailer and was caught between the trailer and flatbed resulting in a fractured pelvis.
An employee was moving items in the distribution warehouse when a modified electric pallet jack operator struck him, severely lacerating his lower left leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was pressure washing at a location when the pressure washer injected the employee's right little finger.
An employee was operating a deli slicer when it sliced off part of the skin on her thumb. She was hospitalized with a severe laceration to her thumb.
An employee and his coworker were repositioning a disconnected steel forklift mast when the mast attachment fell on his left leg, breaking his tibia and fibula and requiring surgery.
An employee was removing a piece of turkey from a de-skinning machine when the machine caught his glove and pulled his right hand into the equipment, amputating his right ring fingertip.

An employee was grinding down a piece of metal using an orbital sander when the sander disc pulled the material down to the work table surface, causing his right thumb tip to be projected into the spinning (2,500 rpm) disc. His right thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was adjusting the forks of her forklift when a second forklift backed into hers, pinning her left arm between the two forklifts. Her left forearm broke and required surgery.

An employee was cleaning grease marks around the drive chain area of a gear/sprocket with a shop towel. The chain caught the towel, pulling it and the employee's hand into the drive chain/sprocket. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the right index finger and three crushed fingers.
An employee was setting pieces of 24-inch reinforced concrete pipe when his right arm was caught between two pieces of pipe as they were being joined. His right arm broke.
An employee had just unloaded a truck when a dock plate flipped out of the way, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken hip.

An employee was carrying and stacking cement blocks when his gloved left pinky finger became caught under a block. As he attempted to pull the finger from underneath the block, his hand came out of the glove and suffered an amputation to the top of his left pinky finger.
An employee was pressure washing in an acid tank tanker and sustained chemical burns.

An employee was trying to grab a box of product to turn it around on a conveyor so the label on the box was facing the correct direction. Her gloved left hand slipped off of the box and was caught in the in-going nip point on the chain and sprocket, causing amputations to her left ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was delivering mail and turning in a cul-de-sac when the right sliding door of the mail truck slid closed on the employee's right ring finger resulting in amputation at the first joint.
An employee was struck by a stand-up, riding pallet jack.

The employee was repairing the broken shaft on the drum of the conveyor that had been locked out.  His finger was pinched between the shaft and the drum. When he removed his finger, the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was helping a forklift operator erect a 30-foot-tall frame when the employee lost control of the frame and it struck the employee's knee, breaking it in two places. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was using a pneumatic cutter to cut a turkey neck when the cutter amputated his middle fingertip.

An employee was attempting to repair a lawn mower. The employee's left hand was under the mower deck when the mower blade amputated the employee's left ring fingertip and lacerated the left middle fingertip. The mower was running at the time.

An employee was working on a miniature flexographic machine when the scrap belt stopped. As the employee attempted to reposition the belt, the employee's hand slipped and contacted the belt drive and sprocket, resulting in a partial right thumb amputation.
An employee slipped while getting off a skid steer, breaking a leg.

An employee was prepping chicken fingers to be fried when she backed up into a hot container of grease, knocking it over as she fell on the floor. The hot grease contacted her body, and she suffered first degree burns to her left leg and lower back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on a man lift greasing a bridge crane when he hit the controls of the bridge crane. The bridge crane then pushed the man lift until it fell over.  He fell approximately 20 feet to the concrete below, fracturing his left arm and left leg and requiring hospitalization. PPE was worn at the time.
An employee was rolling gizzards around peeler rollers when his left ring fingertip was caught in the roller, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access a hydro-mobile scaffold when the ladder shifted and pinched the employee's finger between the ladder and a scaffold component, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was adjusting a truss that was laying on a hydraulic press table when  his left pinky finger became caught in the press, causing an avulsion.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a dump tote when a solenoid energized and lowered a metal framework onto the employee resulting in severe crushing injuries.  The equipment was not locked/tagged out at the time.

An employee was hooking up a hydraulic hose to a blowout preventer beneath the work floor when a clamp on the cable holding the rig floor broke, causing the rig floor to fall. The employee was pinned between the rig floor and the blowout preventer, suffering a facial fracture.
On January 30, 2018, an employee fell approximately 12 feet while descending a ladder inside a building. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the ribs, pelvis, and femur.
An employee was removing a sheet of cracked tempered glass from a truck and caught a finger between the glass sheet and the truck step crushing a fingertip.
An employee was using a high-pressure sprayer to clean inside a vessel when the spray nozzle trigger became stuck. As the employee attempted to loosen it, it sprayed his left leg, cutting it.
An employee was between two asphalt rollers when one of them moved and caught the employee between the two rollers. The employee suffered broken ribs and a fractured collarbone.
An employee was opening a gate for a delivery truck when the truck ran over the employee's right foot, fracturing the ankle.

An employee was using an oxy/fuel gas cutting torch to dismantle a railcar when a small pinhole developed in the oxygen line near where the hoses meet the torch, causing a leak. Oxygen then migrated up the employee's sleeve inside his protective leather-cutting jacket and ignited. He received second and third degree burns on his right shoulder, armpit, and upper chest.

An employee was under a tractor-trailer placing masking tape on items to be painted while a second employee was working on the airline for the air brakes. The second employee then tested the airlines, which caused a rear axel to fall on the first employee's left leg. The employee suffered lacerations and a possible fracture.
An employee was bleeding down an injector line to bring a well back online when the line blew at a 90-connection.  A 14-foot, 6-inch section of pipe blew out and broke the employee's tibia/fibula.
An employee was preparing to re-install a repaired hydraulic cylinder onto an excavator when the cylinder detached and fell on the employee's left index fingertip, amputating it.
An employee was walking to her car and fell breaking the right hip.
An employee was walking on the curb to get on the bus when the employee tripped on the curb and fell backward. The back of the employee's head struck the pavement resulting in a head injury.
An employee was reversing a forklift while moving equipment/merchandise when his left foot was pinched between an I-beam and the forklift.
An employee was using a pipe wrench to loosen a fitting on a hot oil truck when the wrench slipped and amputated his left index finger.
An employee fell while climbing a rolling ladder, suffering a possible head contusion, body numbness, and a neck strain.
An employee was moving a 50-pound barrel in the back of a box truck when he lost control of the barrel and his finger was caught between another barrel, resulting in a finger amputation.
Am employee was walking up to a parked lift to get some paperwork when the lift moved, striking his foot and breaking two bones.
An employee was driving a forklift when his left leg was caught between the forklift and a building support pole, breaking it.
An employee was walking out a door and fell onto the concrete sidewalk fracturing her right hip.
On January 31, 2018, an employee was caught between two bales when a forklift operator tried to pick up a bale, which slid into the one behind it. He was hospitalized with broken clavicles.

An employee was going down a two-step ladder at the raised dock section when he fell backwards off the ladder and struck his head on the concrete floor, briefly losing consciousness and fracturing his skull.

On January 31, 2018, an employee was felling an oak tree that became hung up on a rotten tree, which caused the rotten tree to snap, fall, and hit the employee. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for facial fractures, a forehead laceration, broken bones, a lacerated liver and a brachial plexus injury.
An employee fell off an 8-foot ladder while performing residential construction, hitting the porch surface below and tearing ligaments in his back. He was hospitalized.

On January 31, 2017, an employee was installing a 4-inch by 4-inch board to flatten bags on a conveyor line when the employee's left hand was caught between the board and the conveyor amputating the left index finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a boring machine. He was attempting to remove a chip when he was caught between the machine housing and the boring arm, suffering a compound fracture to his right forearm near the elbow.

An employee was tripping pipe (drilling the pipe down) and screening a drill collar into a stump. He and another employee pushed the tongs into the spinning pipe. The tongs then bit back, crushing him between the tongs and the derrick leg. He received fractures to his upper torso and punctured both lungs.
An employee was assaulted by another employee resulting in a broken jaw, nose and eye socket and head trauma.
An employee's ankle was pinned between a pallet jack and a pole outside the store, resulting in a compound fracture to the ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

On January 31, 2018, an employee was processing returned product (a 3-bar bundle of 6-inch diameter round 120-inch long steel bars). He was cutting the metal straps that secured the bundle to the pallet. When he cut the fourth and final strap, the top bar sank down between the two bottom bars and one of the bars rolled onto his foot, fracturing his first and second metatarsals.  He was hospitalized.
An employee was being trained on a powered industrial vehicle when the employee's right foot was caught and fractured between the vehicle and a charging station. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a harness and was raised in the air with a winch line to remove a T-valve on top of a pipe. As the operator raised him up, the counterweight of the winch became caught on the tubing board and built up tension on the winch line. As the tension built up on the winch, it gave way and catapulted the employee through the air.  The employee suffered pelvic injuries.
An employee was cooking with a tilt skillet that had boiling water when it leaned forward and spilled, burning both of his feet and his right leg.
An employee fell backward and struck the back of his head while negotiating a stairway. He was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
While walking through a door opening, an employee slipped and fell to the ground, breaking a hip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, suffering an elbow injury that required surgery.

An employee was trying to light a burn box, but the ignition switch was not working. The employee used a hand torch to ignite the burn box, and the flames flashed in his face, causing first and second degree burns.

An employee was operating a shot blaster to clean parts. He mounted a platform on the shot blaster to remove a part from the machine. He then stepped back off the platform, lost his balance, and fell less than 48 inches to the floor, breaking his right hip.
An employee was operating a 90-ton saw to cut aluminum when the blade amputated the employee's left index fingertip to the second joint and middle fingertip to the first joint.
An employee was retrieving a product from a pallet. After picking up the product, she turned and inadvertently tripped, causing her to fall and fracture her hip. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he missed a rung and fell backward. He hit the floor and was hospitalized.

An employee helped a driver reconnect a dumpster to the dumping mechanism on the back of a truck. The driver then went to the other side of the truck to operate the dumpster, but the bin slipped out again. The employee again went to re-attach the dumpster as the driver began to operate it. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught between the dumpster and the dumping mechanism, amputating it.
An employee was cleaning a mixer with a can of air when it ignited, burning the employee's forehead and hands.
An employee was attempting to lift a bundle of angle iron to create space for a ladder when the employee's middle finger was crushed between the steel and the underlying wood.

An employee was kneeling on the floor and raising a hoist with a roller, using the pendant to change a roller at the bottom of a press. The employee's left hand was on top of the hoist rail when he raised the hoist using a pendant, and his left pinky finger was pinched between the hoist rail and the machine's frame, amputating the fingertip.

A maintenance employee was using a scissor lift to access and clean the interior windows on a garage door when another employee activated the door from the outside of the facility, knocking the lift over. The employee hit the floor and suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was greasing the bearing on a wood chipper when his left hand was caught in the fan, amputating four fingers. The wood chipper was running and the fan was unguarded at the time.

On January 30, 2018, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was spreading salt in the lumber entrance area when he slipped, fell, and struck his head on the ground, suffering a brain bleed that required hospitalization.

On January 31, 2018, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was struck on the left wrist and the left side of his torso by the end of a truss that broke in half as it was suspended from a crane. He suffered a bone bruise to the left hand, torn left rotator cuff, three broken ribs, and a hematoma of the left lung, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to clear a jam on a six-head saw belt when the conveyor belt caught his glove and pulled his right ring finger underneath a guard, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was delivering mail when he slipped on snow and ice and 
fell to the ground, cutting the left side of his head.
An employee became ill while cleaning with a grinder, requiring hospitalization for an abdominal hernia.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. When he stepped off, he moved the handle on the pallet jack, which proceeded to hit his left ankle, severely lacerating it.

An employee was working on the multi-gallon conveyor line while using a line jack to raise the conveyor line. The conveyor line slipped off the block and crushed the employee's left ring finger, amputating the fingertip and nail.
An employee was putting garbage into the dumpster and passed out striking his head. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee sustained a bulging disc in his neck while lifting a cardboard file box.

An employee was saving palletized boxes in a storage container. He stood up on the dashboard of the forklift with the back lever down causing the forklift mast to tilt back and pin him between the forklift cab and forklift mast.
An employee was setting up the warning fence around the top of an excavation when he stepped back and fell into the trench striking his head. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.

While walking on a welded frame, metal scaffold, approximately five feet off the ground, the injured employee went to grab a 2x4 that was over the doorway and fell resulting in broken ribs and a lacerated spleen.

An employee was testing and adjusting a valve assembly. As he was walking towards the valve assembly, that was mounted in a bench vise, his foot caught the air hose in front of the bench, causing him to lurch forward with his hands extended to catch himself. His right index finger entered the one-inch port of the valve as his left hand forced the 24 VDC supply leads connected to the solenoid operated valve to contact one another and short. When they shorted, the valve cycled and amputated the tip of his finger.

An employee was preheating a gooseneck with a torch on a machine when an electrical panel exploded approximately 6 feet behind him. He was knocked to the floor and found unconscious. He suffered bleeding, head trauma, and a broken arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to tie the boat to the barge and fell off the boat into the cold water. The employee suffered dry drowning and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the welding production table, welding a steel gate. He fell off the table and his torso struck the top railing of the steel gate. The employee was hospitalized for four broken ribs.
An employee was walking downstairs, passed out and fell down the stairs resulting in a fractured skull.

An employee was performing maintenance on the frac pump and was using a pry bar to roll the pump for re-packing. The pry bar slipped and struck the employee's head. He then fell striking his head on the ground and sustained a concussion.
An employee was restocking pallets that had fallen over on his flatbed trailer when he stepped backward and fell off the trailer to the ground, fracturing his right forearm.
An employee was connecting/disconnecting a dolly when the dolly tongue did not disengage properly and struck the employee's lower left leg resulting in a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was honing a pipe, saw oil spilling out of the machine and used a finger to stop the oil resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was walking to her car in the dark, tripped over a parking bumper and fell. The employee was hospitalized for hip displacement.
An employee was connecting the converter dolly to the trailer. He grabbed the part of the dolly that connected with the trailer and his hand was caught between the interlocking pieces fracturing it.
The employee was lifting a box containing a microwave by the handle. The handle broke and the employee fell onto their back resulting in a collapsed lung.
An employee was stepping down from the truck, lost his balance and fell to the ground resulting in a broken right hip.
An employee was working at the cash register, walked behind the counter, tripped over a cord and fell onto her right hip and fractured it.

An employee and coworker were moving a pallet jack with a forklift when the pallet jack flipped and fell, landing on and smashing his ring finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery. His ring finger was amputated.
An employee fell while descending a ladder and fractured their lower back.
The stabilizer from a low deck unloader struck and crushed an employee's foot while unloading baggage from a plane.

On February 1, 2018, two employees were unloading equipment from a truck. The injured employee was pulling the equipment while a coworker pushed from the other side. The equipment's casters were caught on the edge of the ramp and the equipment tipped over, falling on top of the injured employee, resulting in a back injury that required hospitalization.
While troubleshooting a booster pump, the cylinder actuated, pinching and amputating the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was performing demolition activities. The employee removed a ceiling tile and liquid from a water pipe spilled onto the employee. Shortly thereafter, the employee suffered lack of muscle control, nervous system depression, and memory loss. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift and pinned his left foot between it and another stationary stand-up forklift resulting in a broken foot.
An employee was working a punch press and amputated his left index finger to the second knuckle. The press was guarded at the time.
A technician was treating insulation in an attic when he fell through the ceiling and onto the floor of a residential home resulting in a fractured hand and L-3 vertebra.

An employee was installing skirt board around a stair radius. The board sprung back striking the employee and knocking him off the ladder. The employee sustained a head injury and a broken collar bone.
An employee tripped over a pipe and fell at a worksite resulting in bruising and swelling of the hip.
An employee was opening an oil valve at a client site. Pressure blew the employee off the platform and onto piping below resulting in a fractured back.

An employee was sitting on a haul trailer when an ATV backed into him pinning him against the haul trailer. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured right femur, a broken nose and a one-inch laceration on his right check.

An employee was attempting to clean a meat grinder by hand when the machine was activated, amputating the employee's right middle finger to the knuckle. The meat grinder was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was working from a man lift, installing siding to the exterior of the building. The employee unhooked his lanyard to enter a third floor window opening, when he slipped and fell to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and a broken foot.

A welder employee was stamping a part number onto the metal rim of a tire with a metal stamp and carbon steel hammer. When the employee struck the metal stamp with the hammer, the hammer shattered and shrapnel struck the employee in the midsection. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to remove the metal pieces.
A ski patroller was making rounds through trails and struck a tree resulting in five broken ribs.
An employee was struck by a forklift and pinned against a merchandise storage rack in the warehouse. The employee sustained three fractured ribs, pelvis and lower back as well as internal bleeding.
An employee was loading steel bars onto a loader and pinched their left hand between a bar and the frame of the loader resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was closing the safe for the night and caught her right middle finger in the door resulting in amputation.

An employee was pushing a cart weighing approximately 384 pounds and attempted to push it over a hose. The cart tipped over and the handle fell on her left foot fracturing it. She was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking and performing a visual inspection of the fire protection system, slipped on mud and fell fracturing the knee.
An employee was exiting her vehicle, slipped on a patch of ice and fell breaking an ankle.

An employee stepped through a hatch on a catwalk and fell approximately seven feet to a platform below injuring his shoulder. The employee then rolled off the platform approximately another seven feet resulting in multiple broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was making a delivery at a customer location. The employee slipped on ice while exiting the truck and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was operating a standup forklift and caught his foot under the lift resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee was walking through a doorway when the employee's smock got caught on the door handle. While trying to free the smock the door closed onto the employee's hand resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was using an impact driver to screw on the cover of the electrical panel and contacted a live wire. The employee was hospitalized for burns to his hands, arms and stomach as a result of an arc flash.

On February 2, 2018, an employee was operating a foot pedal activated shaver screw machine and amputated the right middle finger to the first joint. The point of operation was not guarded at the time.

An employee was using an oxygen lance to clean a cupola slag runner (a portion of a foundry furnace) when the oxygen line supplying the lance failed causing a flame to strike the employee and enter his glove. The employee sustained third degree burns to the back and palm of his right hand.
An employee slipped on ice and fell as they were walking from their car into work. The employee was hospitalized for knee surgery.
An employee was working from a 10-12 foot extension ladder and fell to the ground resulting in injuries to the employee's left wrist and shoulder.

The employee had parked his fork truck. He was stepping down from the fork truck when his left heel hit a plastic pallet and he lost his balance, twisting his leg and falling to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was moving a large job site tool. The tool fell and caught his right hand resulting in amputation of the pinky fingertip.
After parking a security vehicle and getting out, an employee slipped on ice in the parking garage and fell resulting in a broken ankle that required surgery.
An employee was removing a sprue from a machine and the machine closed on his right hand. The employee sustained a thumb amputation and a broken fore finger and middle finger.

An employee was attempting to raise the tongs up off the rig floor with a hoist when a safety pin became hung on the floor grating. The employee had his hand on the tongs while trying to see what they were hung up on. At that time, the tongs came free from the floor grating and caught the employee's left pinky finger between the tong body and mid rail resulting in amputation.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of dough ball from a machine when his right hand contacted the chain and sprocket mechanism. His right index finger was amputated to the second knuckle. The chain and sprocket were unguarded at the time of the incident.

The injured employee was standing next to his forklift replenishing the roller racks (by hand). Another forklift operator passed by and struck the injured employee's forklift, which pinned his left foot between his forklift stabilizing arm and the rack resulting in amputation of two-thirds of his left big toe.
A security guard was making his rounds when he slipped on ice and fell injuring his back and neck.
An employee fell down the stairs outside the main office resulting in a lower back injury.
An employee was riding a pallet jack when he tried to stop the jack using his foot. The pallet jack then crushed his right foot.
An employee was loading wood into a saw when he was pinched between the arm of the live deck that loads the lumber and the saw transport, rupturing his lower intestine.
An employee was cleaning the floor in the security post when he began having pain that radiated from his neck down his left arm. The employee suffered a heart attack.
An employee's finger was pulled into a laminator while changing a roll. The employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between the web and guard, causing the machine to shut down.

An employee was bent down checking the burner of a stove. A second employee was carrying a pot of hot soup to place in the soup jacket on the stove. He lost his grip on the soup pot due to a weak spot on the glove. The hot soup poured onto the first employee's head and right shoulder, causing burns.

An employee was removing dough from a dough hopper when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught in the plastic auger. While pulling the hand back, the employee suffered an amputation to the right middle finger nailbed.
An employee was operating a CNC lathe when his left index finger was caught and amputated between the material and the tool.
While providing ski lessons on a ski trail, an employee fell and sustained rib fractures, a lung contusion, transverse process fractures, and a fractured clavicle.

An employee was operating a pneumatic assembly press when the PLC programming did not activate the anti-repeat/anti-tie down feature and the press cycled. The assembly press ram/tooling then amputated the employee's left index finger at the second knuckle.

An employee retrieved two hams to slice for a customer and placed one of the hams on the table of a vertical band saw. When the employee made the first cut, the moving blade amputated the employee's right index finger above the middle knuckle. The guard was raised in the highest position which did not guard the saw blade.

After salting the roads, an employee returned to the shop to clean the truck. The employee's hand and glove became stuck in the salt auger at the back of the truck. His hand was pulled into the auger, amputating it to the wrist.

An employee was riding a horse when it saw or smelled a mountain lion and spooked, bucking twice. On the first buck, the employee's face smashed into the crown of the horse's head. On the second buck, the employee was thrown to the ground. The employee suffered blunt force trauma to the facial area, including a broken jaw, sinus damage, and three broken bones near the right eye. The employee also sustained a broken right wrist upon hitting the ground.

An employee was aligning a new fabric belt that was installed on a conveyor system. While handing a tool to a helper, the employee's left hand was caught between the conveyor belt and the tension roller. The employee suffered multiple fractures and abrasions to the left hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell, injuring her lower back and requiring hospitalization.
While working on a machine, an employee was exposed to air contaminants generated by floor stripping operations down the hall. The employee suffered a respiratory reaction and was hospitalized.

An employee was hydro-blasting a 2-inch line with a flex lance at approximately 18,000 psi. The tip inadvertently exited the pipe, striking him in the left arm. The contact resulted in a blunt force abrasion and a possible water injection. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a stone display board when it smashed his left hand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was closing the truck trailer door and caught their left middle and ring fingers in the seam between horizontal door panels. The employee was hospitalized for a crushing injury to the fingers.

An employee was loading peanut stock onto a scale from a hopper. An inspection cover was removed and his hand was inside an inspection-hole opening when another employee started the fan. The fan blade then partially amputated his right middle finger.

An employee entered a production line to make adjustments when he was hooked by the hoist and dragged down the line. The hoist pulled him through a 12-inch gap between two I-beams. He suffered broken ribs, a lacerated spleen, and cuts to his leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was assembling formwork when a section of formwork fell to the side and struck the employee resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was moving air freight bags when he tripped on an air freight bag and fell to the floor, fracturing his kneecap.
An employee was leaving the breakroom when she tripped over the carpet transition, breaking her wrist.
An employee was coming in from an outside area as another employee was exiting. When the door opened, it hit the employee and caused him to fall to the floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was feeding a parrot when it bit her left index finger, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning the inside of a car. As he was exiting the vehicle, his foot became stuck on the door and he fell outside of the vehicle to the concrete, suffering a spinal injury and paralysis that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was drilling front frame styles on a drilling machine. She pushed a piece in and her right middle finger was pulled under the plunger, amputating her fingertip. The plunger was foot-operated.
An employee was struck by a falling piece of a hot water tank, suffering a fractured left leg.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor, which was wet with snow from outside, breaking the right kneecap and damaging the tendon.
An employee was adjusting stamps in a roll mark machine when it amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was helping a crane lower a column when his left thumb was caught between the hook and rebar. His left thumb fractured and his thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was troubleshooting a packaging machine and was positioned between the top and bottom films when the machine cycled. The employee's right index finger was then caught and partially amputated in an in-running nip point. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
On February 5, 2018, an employee wearing shoes with cleat attachments slipped and fell to the floor, suffering an ankle injury requiring surgery.

An employee was moving laser guided vehicles (LGV) due to a jam up. One was in manual when another came up in auto. The employee kicked the sensor to stop the LGV in auto. The LGV reset after 15 seconds and started up again, trapping the employee between the two LGVs. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration and avulsion to the right calf.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot, suffering a fractured vertebra.

An employee was using a rolling machine to roll flat pieces of metal (about 8" x 12") into a tube that is then seam welded at another machine when the employee's left hand was injured, requiring the surgical amputation of four fingers.

An employee noticed a belt guard was off-center and was attempting to move the guard when his fingers wrapped around the back of the guard, coming into contact with the pinch point of the belt and pulley. His left index fingertip was amputated.
While dismounting a front-end loader, an employee slipped from the steps and hit the ground, breaking a shoulder and ribs.
An employee missed a step while walking down a flight of stairs, injuring her right and left ankles.
On February 5, 2018, an employee tripped over a dust pan while sweeping the kitchen and fractured a femur.
An employee was moving product from the back of a parked 18-wheeler to the back of a box delivery truck when he fell to the ground, fracturing his ankle.

An employee was using a telehandler to move cargo when a front loader lost traction at the top of a hill and slid down into the telehandler as the employee was trying to get out, crushing his right leg and pelvis.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a hydro flaker machine that was turned off and locked out. The employee manually tuned a pulley and his finger was caught in the belt. His right middle fingertip was amputated.
On February 5, 2018, an employee was attempting to lift a steel coil when it fell on and pinned the employee's left leg, breaking the femur. He employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing the bogie/axle on a trailer. The employee was underneath the bogie of the trailer when the jack holding the trailer up slipped away, allowing the bogie to fall and strike the employee. The employee suffered a broken rib and two bruised ribs.

An employee was using a 2x4 to help guide an injection core block onto some shelving when the board slipped, resulting in the block smashing his fingers. His left ring and pinky fingers were severed at the tips with about half of his fingernails removed.

While on an aerial lift, an employee was removing a tree top using a chain saw when the tree top fell backwards and struck the employee. The force of the contact drove the employee's face into the lip of the aerial lift's bucket. The employee suffered a broken nose and several facial fractures.
An employee fell while reaching for an elevated caustic hose, hitting a cell landing and suffering fractured ribs and a ruptured spleen.

An employee was wheel-barrowing patch mix to the bench area of an oven when he lost his balance and the wheel barrow tipped over. The handle hit his leg and he fell 12 feet to the next level. He was hospitalized for an internal injury around his kidney.
An employee was walking when he stepped on a loose piece of concrete and lost his footing. He fell to the ground and broke his left tibia and fibula, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was climbing a ladder to put up scaffolding. He was being handed a scaffold plank when he slipped from the ladder and fell 18 feet to the ground below, injuring his spine, head, and face.
An employee was shot in the shoulder by an armed robber who walked into the store.
An employee was on a ladder removing a light fixture with a screwdriver when he fell backwards off the ladder from approximately 4 feet, injuring his right arm and pelvis.
An employee was in an order picker counting product for inventory when he misstepped and fell approximately 5 feet to the concrete ground below, breaking five left-side ribs.

A temporary employee was feeding Styrofoam through a table saw when the foam jumped, causing the guard to move and expose his fingers to the blade. He received multiple cuts to his right hand and amputation of his right middle fingertip.

An employee was charging a furnace by adding material using a powered industrial vehicle. An explosion occurred, causing a fireball to come out of the furnace. The employee jumped from the vehicle to avoid the fireball and landed on the ground. He suffered first and second degree burns to the forehead and injuries to his left knee.

An employee lost control of a pallet jack, tried to avoid hitting a door, and stepped on the brakes. His leg was then caught between his pallet jack and a second pallet jack, breaking his ankle and fibula.
An employee had exited his vehicle to make a delivery when he slipped and fell on black ice, striking his head on the ground.
An employee was exiting a job trailer when he tripped and fell, breaking ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was talking to an edger operator while standing in front of the edger when a board from the edger kicked back and struck the employee's right leg, fracturing it.

On 02/06/2018 at 1:30 p.m., an employee was riding in a four wheeler utility vehicle that was pulling a trailer when the vehicle began to hydroplane on the wet road. The employee dismounted from the vehicle and was struck by the trailer in tow, suffering a broken leg.

On February 6, 2018, an employee was unloading pipe from a lift gate when the employee tripped off the end of the lift gate and landed on the ground, suffering cracked ribs and a back injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a lever to kick feed out from the chuck of a horizontal turret lathe when a metal shaving came out and struck the employee's left hand, causing a deep laceration between the thumb and index finger. The employee suffered tendon damage that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee had a water spray hose on her shoulder when she leaned in to look at a meat cutter machine during inspection. The water spray activated the machine and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was letting the air run through the bags on a vacuum truck when he adjusted the door to the truck and it slammed on his fingers. His middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was checking inside a trailer to see what liquid had spilled and why. Paint stripper had spilled onto the doors of the trailer. The employee closed the door on the trailer and the paint stripper splashed into both eyes, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading tires on a picker that was approximately 15 feet high when he fell off the picker, fracturing his legs.

Two employees were part of a crew performing a re-roofing job (TPO type roofing work) at night. The building was 22.7 feet high (at the highest elevation) and was a single-story warehouse-type building with two roof elevations. The employees were on the highest roof elevation when a rough terrain forklift with a material handling wooden box on the forks was used to remove debris from the roof. The box was raised to the roof and the two employees got in the box to get a ride back to the ground. While they were in the box, it became dislodged and fell to the ground. One employee sustained head and body trauma, while the second suffered a fractured wrist. Both were hospitalized.

An employee chipped concrete from inside a mixer. After re-energizing the mixer, the employee noticed that the chipping tool attached to the airline was still inside the mixer. When the employee attempted to retrieve the tool, the mixer paddle cut the employee and caused muscular damage. The mixer not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was attempting to place a spacer in a forklift's hydraulic sleeve cylinder when the employee's hand was caught in a pinch point, fracturing and lacerating a finger.
Two employees were struck by a vehicle while it was backing into the service garage. An employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a generator and testing the system for a leak when the generator's rotating fan blade struck his right pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a wrench to fix a leak on a feed line from a tote to a metering pump when one of the cam locks for the tote cap cover came loose, spraying the employee with 93% sulfuric acid. The employee suffered chemical burns.
An employee was helping to move bundles of steel with an overhead crane when the steel fell and struck the employee's right leg.

An employee was walking across a parking lot with his hand tools. The lot had been plowed and salted but patchy snow/ice was present. He slipped on the snow/ice and fell, fracturing his ankle and requiring surgery.

On February 6, 2018, an employee was attempting to remove a jammed bottle from a machine when the die closed on his right hand, partially amputating his index finger to the first joint and injuring his middle finger. The machine was not shut down at the time.
During rig down operations, an employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

On February 6, 2018, at approximately 6:25 p.m., an employee was installing and aligning deck frames on board a ship when his left index finger was caught between the metal deck plate and frame, resulting in a partial amputation to his fingertip.
An employee was securing a tugboat to a barge when his hand was caught in the rope and bitt, partially amputating the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a 2x4 when he contacted the blade, resulting in an amputation to his left index finger.
An employee was struck by a rubber hose that was displaced from the boom of a concrete pump truck.
While descending a ladder platform in the plumbing department, an employee missed the last step and stumbled. The employee's head hit the floor, requiring staples and hospitalization.

On February 6, 2018, an employee was driving a forklift when a piece of a plastic bumper became caught in the tire and flung up, striking his face. He suffered facial fractures, a cut on the eye, and facial swelling, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell on ice in the parking lot, requiring hospitalization.

On February 6, 2018, an employee was operating a ride-along pallet jack when the employee's foot slipped off the pallet jack. The employee's ankle was then pinned between the pallet jack and a rack rail, suffering a laceration.
An employee was sand blasting on the outside wall of a water tower when he lost his balance and fell at an angle. He hit the ground, breaking one rib and puncturing a lung.
While moving trailers with a shag truck, an employee complained of chest pains and was hospitalized.
An employee fell 6-8 feet off a ladder while traversing over a wall resulting in broken ribs and a bruised clavicle.

An employee was holding a pole and waiting for a forklift to push the pole into the ground. The pin was missing on the forklift forks, allowing them to fall and hit the employee's lip. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a back injury.
A temporary employee was walking in a cooler with a temperature of -25 degrees when he slipped and fell, breaking his left ankle.
An employee's foot was caught in computer cords as she got up from her desk. She fell, striking the left side her body and fracturing her hip.

An employee was working on a lighting issue while standing on a step ladder. As he climbed down the ladder, he missed the last rung and fell to the pavement, hitting his head and suffering a concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a moving vehicle while setting up a traffic control plan to install a sign. The employee suffered a head injury.
An employee was electrocuted while repairing a steam generator. The energy isolating device (LO/TO) for the machine was not used at the time of the incident.
While positioning a new cable around a new transformer, an employee contacted an electrical line, burning both hands.

On February 6, 2018, an employee carried a metal clamp (die) on a hoist and set it down on the edge of a table. The metal clamp then fell on his right leg, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning grease from the front hydraulic coupling hoses of a wheel loader to align the holes and coupling pins manually. Once the coupling pins were aligned, the system's hydraulic system was ready for testing. A second employee climbed into the wheel loader's cab as the first employee examined the pins. The second employee turned the wheel loader key, which automatically engaged the pins. At the same time, the first employee tried to clear out some additional grease from the coupling hole. The first employee's right middle finger was crushed at the nail bed by the hydraulic pin, resulting in amputation of the right middle finger at the nail bed.
An employee slipped on ice on the sidewalk when leaving the building, fracturing the left arm.
An employee was run over by a powered industrial truck while cleaning the yard, suffering severe dislocations of the right-foot toes.

An employee was helping an operator close a barbed wire gap. The gap was stretched across some digging mats (placed that morning) on a temporary crossing that was used to contain cattle. While attempting to close the gap, he walked backwards on the construction mats and stepped in a hole between them. He then fell backwards, landing on his right hip. The mats were uneven and were elevated right where he landed. He was hospitalized with a broken right hip/femur, requiring surgery.
An employee was replacing a hydraulic cylinder on a baler when the cylinder slipped from his hand and pinched his middle fingertip, amputating it (no bone loss).
An employee was on an electric pallet jack moving boxes and got his left foot/ankle caught between the jack and a pallet of product resulting in an ankle fracture.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee was hospitalized for head trauma.
An employee suffered electrical burns requiring hospitalization during routine maintenance activities on powered equipment.

An employee was on a step ladder securing a pipe. Afterwards, the employee pulled on the pipe to verify that it was secured and the pipe gave way. The employee then fell 15 feet to the concrete ground below resulting in two broken legs.
An employee was using a portable hand saw to cut up a wooden pallet for the trash and lacerated the right arm.
An employee was working behind the cash register, tripped over shopping bags on a hook and fell to the floor chipping her right hip bone. She also sustained contusions to her ribs and face.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a sugar tank and fell into the tank. He became stuck and lost consciousness.
An employee was operating a bag machine and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was replacing belts on the grain elevator gearbox. While removing the belts, the belt tensioner released striking the employee's right forearm resulting in lacerations and a broken bone. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was replacing the belt on the blower motor of a flour silo when the motor energized and amputated the left middle fingertip.

An employee received first and second degree burns to the face and arms and two small third degree burns on a finger and thumb when a network protector arced and blew back. Part of the door came off and went into the energized parts within causing an arc flash.
An employee was walking across the roof and fell approximately 20 feet through a skylight. The employee sustained broken heels, a broken ankle and broken bones in the back.

An employee was hooking up the converter dolly to connect a second trailer. As the employee was pulling on the dolly to position it, his left pinky finger was crushed between the trailer bumper and the converter resulting in surgical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking garage resulting in an injured ankle.

An employee was on the back of a goose neck flat bed trailer approximately four feet high unloading racks made out of pipe. As he started to unbind chains on two racks they slipped and started to fall. The employee then fell off the trailer to the ground and was pinned between two racks. The employee suffered an abdominal injury as a result of the incident.
An employee was taking measurements along a sidewalk, slipped on ice and fell hitting the back of his head on the ground.
An employee was replacing a wheel on a forklift. When the employee lowered the jack on the forklift the employee's right thumb was caught in the wheel spindle resulting in an amputation.
An employee was driving to an oil and gas site and drove into a river/ditch.

The injured employee was adjusting a pallet when another employee placed product onto the pallet that the injured employee was adjusting, pinching the injured employee's right middle finger between the pallet and a spacer resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On February 7, 2018, an employee received a partial left middle finger amputation while changing a mold on a blow molding machine.
An employee slipped and fell causing a head injury.
An employee tore a bicep muscle while attempting to lift the hood of a truck.
On February 7, 2018, an employee was operating a powered industrial truck and sustained a partial left thumb amputation when it was caught in a hole on a metal rack.
Two employees were stacking blocks of ice for an ice sculpture. One of the blocks landed on the injured employee's left middle finger resulting in amputation at the knuckle.
An employee was putting a tarp on a vehicle trailer, slipped on ice on the trailer and fell approximately four feet.

An employee was operating the vertical mill press when the employee's jacket sleeve came in contact with the rotating counter bore bit. His left arm was pulled around the machine fracturing it and also causing many lacerations.

An employee was cleaning the roll coater to prep it for the next adhesive by wiping down the rolls with a rag. During that process, the employee's right hand and arm were pulled into the roller up to just before his elbow crushing them.
An employee was walking by a blood canister when the canister filter fell and struck the employee's right leg lacerating it below the knee.
An employee slipped on ice on the trailer floor and fell sustaining a head injury.
An employee was getting out of his truck, slipped on ice and fell breaking a leg.

On February 7, 2018, two employees were talking on a dock. One employee was standing (injured) and one employee was on a forklift. As the standing employee turned to walk down the dock, the other employee turned the forklift to enter the trailer. The tail swing of the forklift caught the employee who was on foot on the right ankle fracturing it.

An employee was working underneath a long life vehicle (standard mail truck). He lowered the jack while still being underneath it and the vehicle fell on his right shoulder and sternum. He was admitted to the hospital for treatment of a broken right shoulder and sternum.
An employee was salting and shoveling snow when the employee slipped on the ice on the sidewalk and fell breaking an ankle.
An employee was clearing a jam on a production line and lacerated his right pinky fingertip.
An employee was carrying plywood on the roof when the employee's self-retractable lanyard locked up. The employee lost balance and fell dislocating an ankle.

An employee was cleaning a hydraulic press at shift end. The employee reached into a machine opening to retrieve a piece of material and the press platen struck and crushed the employee's hand. The machine was energized at the time.

An employee was on a scaffold approximately five feet tall working overhead to cut a hole for an access panel near a roll-up door. The door was energized and bumped the employee as it rolled up. The employee fell and sustained one cracked rib and two broken vertebrae (L1 and L2).

An employee was replacing a valve in a process line using a chain fall. The employee's finger was caught between the new valve and the top of the flange crushing it and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on snow covered ice and fell to the ground. She struck her head and suffered a severe concussion and a sprained left wrist.

An employee was clearing a rock from rollers inside a grain flaker. The rock was lodged between the rollers and the employee cut his right middle finger on the access door when he was pulling back on the tool. The laceration and bone injury required amputation of the injured finger.
An employee reached in behind the gin press to remove a knot that was causing the press to choke up and amputated the right forearm.
An employee was walking through the parking lot to her car, slipped on ice and fell injuring her pelvis.
On 02/07/2018, an employee tripped over a floor mat and fell resulting in a shoulder injury.
An employee was walking to the car, tripped over a sidewalk curb and fell fracturing the left wrist.

An employee was removing a ceramic nozzle from a packing crate, tripped on the plastic banding material and fell to the mill floor. When the employee fell, the employee's right hand was pinched between the nozzle and the mill floor resulting in amputation of the pinky fingertip.

An employee was prying rubber from a four-roll calender machine when his prying tool and glove were caught in the calender, pulling his hand inside. His right middle finger was amputated before he could get his hand loose. The machine was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a crane to lift a filtration tank filled with sand to the main level of a hydro lab when the tank fell. The employee was struck by the falling tank, an electrical conduit, and a metal pipe, suffering multiple broken ribs, swelling to the right leg, and a crushing injury.
An employee was cleaning a parts cage when dust caused him to start coughing and experience pressure in his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift to load cotton bales onto a cotton bale truck. As he was exiting the warehouse, he hit a hole in the ground, causing the forklift to tip. Thinking the forklift was going to flip over, he tried to jump off and broke his right leg.

An employee was preparing to rinse down a line with a water pressure gun when he had trouble removing the gun's water nozzle. As he attempted to remove the nozzle, the high-pressure water shot into and lacerated the inside of his mouth.
An employee was welding when hot slag dropped into his tool bag, igniting it and causing burns on his back and side.
An employee was changing a propane tank on a forklift. As he was connecting the hose, some fuel leaked onto his right hand (which was gloved), causing cold burns.
An employee walked into a knife, suffering lacerations under the rib cage of her left side.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a switchgear and received an electrical shock when his hand contacted a live conductor.
An employee was walking and running a crane using a remote control when he tripped over a water hose line that was on the floor and fell onto the remote control's crane box, breaking his sternum.
An employee fell on ice in the parking lot and was injured, requiring hospitalization.

On February 8, 2018, an employee was cleaning out the bed of a die cast machine's C-frame while a die setter was changing the machine's piston. The employee attempted to remove something from the machine just as the die setter activated it. His right ring finger was then caught between the platen and the sleeve ring, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was using a pancake huck tool to remove hucks from a column guide wear plate on a side frame when the hose on the pressure side of the tool burst where he was holding onto it, injecting oil through his glove and into his left hand.
An employee tripped and fell, fracturing her right hip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot while walking to a bus, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was doing pushups on the ground when a pickup truck ran over his right hand. He suffered broken bones and a pinky amputation.

An employee was working on a vessel at the dock. He was unlocking a hatch cover and reaching to turn one of the locking mechanisms when his foot slipped and he fell, fracturing his right foot. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on ice on a sidewalk, suffering a broken pelvis and arm.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a door when the saw kicked back and caught the employee's left pinky finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee had entered a belt conveyor motor room to troubleshoot it when his right jacket sleeve was caught on the conveyor belt, pulling his arm into and between the conveyor belt and drum tensioner. He suffered a broken hand, wrist, and arm and a dislocated elbow, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was blowing something out of an edge bander when the employee's left hand contacted the saw blade, amputating the middle and index fingers.
An employee was folding cartons to put them on a conveyor when his right middle and ring fingers were caught and amputated in a belt and pulley. The belt and pulley were unguarded at the time.

On February 8, 2018, an employee was removing operating room lights from spindles and replacing them. As he reached up to grab one, the knuckle where the light bends snapped on his left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation below the second knuckle.

An employee was operating a skinner machine and guiding hams to allow the tooth roll to grab and pull the hams into the skinning blade when a ham shifted, causing his smock sleeve and skinner glove to become caught in the tooth roll/skinning blade. He suffered an acute soft tissue injury of the right arm.
A employee suffered a T6 vertebra fracture after slipping on ice and falling down residential porch steps.

An employee was working from the top of a tank on a truck and was opening a dome lid to relieve pressure when he slipped and fell approximately 7 feet to a concrete surface. He suffered a spinal injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to move a beam when the employee lost footing, slipped, and fell, twisting/breaking an ankle and tearing ligaments. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot resulting in a fractured ankle that required surgery.
An employee was standing on a 5-gallon bucket when he stepped down onto an upright welding rod and impaled his right foot.
An employee was testing a food metal detector when his hand entered the point of operation on the machine. His right middle finger was caught and amputated in the machine.
On February 8, 2018, an employee was adjusting a tube cutting machine and amputated the pinky finger and crushed the ring finger.

An employee had rigged a plate to pick up and set it into place. He had hooked the plate up with a chain and was standing near it when the plate came loose and struck him, breaking his left leg and injuring his back.

An employee walked into a co-worker's cubicle to answer the phone. To access the phone, the employee positioned herself between the cubicle desk and chair. This position placed the employee's feet under the desk. As she exited the cubicle, her left foot became entangled with a satchel strap that was beneath the cubicle desk. She then tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a right hip femoral fracture.
A security officer was pushed to the ground by a patient resulting in a left ankle fracture.

An employee and a coworker were removing a 2,500-pound block of concrete using a front-end loader that was hooked to a crane. The coworker was driving the loader while the employee guided the concrete when a corner of the block hit another block and started spinning around. The employee was attempting to stop it from spinning around when the chain came undone, allowing the concrete to fall on and fracture his right leg.
An employee was struck by a tree while felling trees, suffering fractures.
An employee was standing next to carry deck equipment when an outrigger set down on the employee's right foot, fracturing a metatarsal.

An employee was walking through an aisle when he inadvertently pressed a battery powered pallet jack handle. The pallet jack activated, and his foot was caught between the pallet jack and stock, fracturing his lower leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee boxed product in the fabrication packaging area and was picking up trash at the end of her shift. She was standing on a wet grate, so she put cardboard on top of it. The cardboard shifted, so she bent down to pick it up. At that point, her fingers were caught underneath the return line of a conveyor. Her left third and fourth fingertips were partially amputated.
An employee suffered a broken leg when he was struck by a case of material that tipped over after it was struck by a lift truck.
An employee was feeding film through a machine after the film broke. The machine unexpectedly energized and fractured the employee's left hand.
On February 6, 2018, an employee fell to the ground while exiting his truck, breaking his left femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was washing dishes when he fell to the floor and fractured his right leg, requiring hospitalization. Non-slip shoes were not worn at the time.

An employee was moving a 23,000-pound platen using an overhead crane when the employee's arm was pinned between the moving platen and a second platen sitting on the floor. The employee suffered a vascular injury to the arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was climbing into a truck and lost contact with the handle and fell backwards suffering a broken vertebra, bruising, and a head injury.
An employee was testing a snowboard feature for a special event when the employee fell off the feature. The employee suffered a broken nose, shoulder, and ankle, requiring hospitalization.
On 2/09/2018, at approximately 7:45 a.m., an employee was moving a plastic pallet to the dock area when he lost his balance and fell to the floor, hitting and breaking his right hip.

An employee was climbing down a cage frame after repairing a feed line motor when he lost his footing and fell to the floor, landing on his head and back. He suffered a skull fracture and vertebra fracture.
An employee was pushing a cart with a mold on it when the mold shifted. The employee's right hand was pinched between the cart handle and the mold, resulting in a right thumb tip amputation.
An employee was moving boat motors when one of the motors fell on his right hand, fracturing his pinky finger and lacerating/damaging the nailbed.

An employee was aligning a steel tube on a conveyor when another tube bumped into the tube he was holding, causing his finger to become caught between the tube and lifting arm of the conveyor. His left ring finger was crushed, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was helping to move a scaffolding platform when his left middle finger was caught between two pieces of scaffolding, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was transporting a pallet of plastic with a forklift when a roll of plastic fell off. The employee stopped the forklift and was trying to stop the plastic from rolling away when his left leg was pinned between the roll of plastic and a metal post resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee's left hand was caught in a labeling machine, crushing one finger and amputating a fingertip.

An employee was helping a table saw operator cut 6-inch blocks when the employee's right hand entered the cutting area and contacted the blade, amputating the thumb below the nail. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was cutting a concrete pile when a previously cut pile of concrete fell on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, a broken left arm, and possible lung damage.
An employee was moving the bridle from a pumping unit when a brake gave way, catching the employee's right pinky. The employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was manually moving a pump jack to a neutral position so he could grease the gears when his right index and middle fingers were pinched between the belt and a pulley. His right index fingertip was amputated above the first knuckle and his middle fingertip was crushed.
An employee tripped over a chair in the school lunchroom and fell to the floor, breaking her shoulder. She required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was exiting his truck when he was struck by an oncoming vehicle. He was knocked to the ground and sustained a fractured right fibula, requiring hospitalization.
Employees were cleaning out a shaker trough with a pressure washer when hydrogen sulfide gas released from the shaker. Two employees were hospitalized due to gas exposure.

An employee was coming down a four-step rolling mobile ladder while carrying a bundle of cardboard sleeves when she tripped and fell approximately 2 feet to the floor. She broke her right ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee had delivered a package to a home and was returning to his vehicle when he slipped on ice and fell, suffering a crushed vertebra.
An employee was responding to a blue code when her feet became tangled, causing her to fall to the floor and fracture her hip.

An employee was emptying a filter pod at the flare stack when a small flame came out of the top of the flare stack, landed in the condensate, and burned him. He suffered second degree burns to the hands, stomach, and calves, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a pallet assembly machine when a board fell onto the employee's right index finger, opening an old scar and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working in a power room making temporary power connections on a 480V box when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered second and third degree burns over 60% of his body.
An employee climbed up onto a press, lost his grip, and fell while pulling a piece of cotton from the press breaking both wrists.

Crew members were attempting to clear a section of ice from a 300' section of 4" poly pipe when one employee was struck in the left leg by a 4" piece of poly pipe. The employee's left leg broke between the ankle and knee.
An employee was repairing the broken bucket of a conveyor when the machine moved, lacerating the employee's head and fracturing his jaw. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering mail via an automobile. As the employee was closing a mailbox with her right index finger, the vehicle began to slide due to snow resulting in amputation of her right index finger.
An employee was closing the main cabin door of the plane and caught the ring finger between the door frame and the door resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was standing on the second step of a portable step ladder while removing wall tiles and fell to the concrete slab, fracturing the right femur.
An employee turned on a vacuum cleaner to vacuum a second floor carpet and received an electrical shock in his foot that traveled up his leg.
An employee was cutting flower stems using a manual guillotine cutter and amputated the left thumb between the nail and first knuckle.

The injured employee was clearing a paper jam in a machine and had his right hand in the shear area when another employee jogged the machine resulting in amputation of the injured employee's index and middle fingertips and the tip of the nail on the thumb of the right hand.

An employee was attempting to relocate a 10-inch flange by hand. During the relocation, the flange started to roll onto its side and the employee attempted to control the flange catching the employee's right middle finger between the rolling flange and another flange on the pallet resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a 7-foot step ladder installing ceiling light fixtures. The employee contacted energized wiring with wire strippers and fell from the ladder. The employee was hospitalized for head trauma and broken ribs.
An employee was changing the blade on a food processor when it turned on and amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee was clearing a jam on a pasting line. While trying to clear the jam, the employee jogged the machine into reverse. As a result, his gloved left hand was pulled into the machine. The employee then reversed direction of the machine to "forward" and jogged the machine to free his hand resulting in amputation of the ring finger.
An employee was walking on the pool deck, slipped and fell resulting in a broken rib.
An employee slipped on ice while walking up a driveway to deliver mail and fell resulting in a broken and dislocated right ankle.
An employee was working on the roof and fell through an opening in the roof resulting in a broken wrist and three broken ribs.

An employee was using a spray wand connected to a hot water pressure washer to open up a frozen produce water tank. The produce water vented hydrocarbon vapors near the hot water pressure washer causing a fire. Two employees received second and third degree burns to the face, neck and hands.
An employee was lifting pipe out of the wrangler. The pipe slipped out of the elevator and struck the employee in the face and shoulder. The employee was knocked unconscious.
An employee was driving a golf cart and struck a curb. The employee then fell from the cart and fractured a knee and elbow.
An employee was exiting the cooler room, tripped on a bun tray on the floor and fell resulting in a back injury that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was attacked by a temporary employee resulting in a neck injury.
An employee tripped over a walker and fell fracturing her hip. The employee was hospitalized.
