An employee was adjusting the drill and mash machine to address a malfunction. The machine activated and caught his left middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was selling memberships at a home and garden show. As she was walking to a vendor booth she tripped on the lip of a display riser and fell injuring her left knee and right arm.
An employee's arm entered the running ribbon blender resulting in a broken wrist, a broken arm bone and tissue damage.
An employee was inspecting a roof for leaks. As he was accessing the ladder to get off the roof, he fell approximately 14 feet resulting in a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was pulling a stack of pallets from a pallet stacker to the end of the outfeed. Another stack of pallets was ejected from the stacker and pinned his right hand between the two stacks.
An employee was driving a snowmobile and lost control on soft snow. The snowmobile overturned and struck a tree. The employee was hospitalized for a scapula fracture and broken ribs.
An employee was walking through the warehouse, tripped over a box and fell breaking a femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a barge positioning the barge cover that was being placed by the ship's gear crane. The cover was not straight so the employee tried to straighten it and was struck from the mid-chest upward by the barge cover. The employee sustained a right anterior fracture of the first and second ribs, a left mandibular fracture, left hyoid fracture, bruising to the left side of the neck and a small pneumothorax.
An employee slipped and fell while walking into the building resulting in a head and neck injury.

An employee was clearing a clog in the air rotary. The paddles within the air rotary energized and began to rotate. As the paddles rotated, they pinched the tip of the employee's right ring finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was offloading a scissor lift from a truck to the company yard when the lift went off the ramp and tipped over onto its side on the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was loading a dumpster into the rear loading garbage truck. A bag of trash fell from the dumpster. As the employee put his hand over his head to block the trash, he placed his hand in a pinch point and inadvertently activated the winch of the truck, resulting in compound fractures to his left hand.

An employee had a bottle of drinking water sitting next to a bottle of odor eliminator. The employee grabbed the bottle of odor eliminator and drank that instead of the water. The bottle was not labeled.
An employee was packing boxes and tried to catch a falling box. Afterwards, the employee felt shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized for a lung injury.
An employee slipped on ice walking outside the north exit and fell resulting in a broken patella and hospitalization.
An employee was walking towards the entrance from the parking lot prior to starting work, slipped on ice that had formed overnight, and fell resulting in a concussion and bleeding on the brain.
An employee was clearing a clog from a dishwasher by using his mouth to blow into the tube and swallowed some corrosive detergent. The employee was hospitalized for burns to the tongue and throat.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift.

An employee was riding a continuous belt manlift down to the ground floor where he lost his footing and his leg became caught in the landing/step off at the ground floor. He suffered a laceration to the back of his right leg and his head.

An employee was retrieving her purse to go home. A plastic liner was sticking out from an empty yarn cage and the employee tripped over the plastic liner and fell fracturing her left femur and patella.
An employee was walking out of the facility, stepped off the curb, and onto a patch of ice. The employee slipped and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot fracturing her right hip.
An employee was walking into the dog house to warm up and closed the door on her hand resulting in a fractured right thumb.
An employee was stepping off a 4-step ladder, missed the bottom step and fell resulting in a head injury.

An employee was adjusting the coolant hose on the vertical band saw when the coolant hose came off. As he reached for hose, his glove got caught on the blade, resulting in amputation of the right index finger.

There was an overflow of water in the FT containment area causing an empty tank to float in the containment area. The overflowing water caused the tank to get pinned against a walkway. A waste treatment tech was attempting to dislodge the tank with a steel bar used for breaking up concrete and pinched his fingers between the steel bar and the tank. When he began using the bar to un-wedge the tank, the tank suddenly came loose, rolled up his right index and middle fingers and pinned them between the tank and the bar. The upward motion of the tank amputated the tip of his index finger. His middle finger was broken.
An employee was placing a piece of metal in the press brake and caught his left ring and middle fingers in the press. Both fingertips were surgically amputated.
An employee was called to fix a pallet that was going to fall and as she looked up to the third level the pallet fell on her injuring her lower right leg.
An employee was cleaning resin from a surface of a 16" globe valve and valve body. The globe valve closed and severed three fingers on the employee's right hand.
An employee was closing the rolling door of a trailer, slipped on the icy step bar and fell injuring the left pinky finger. The finger was amputated at the hospital.

An employee was entering a restroom when she slipped on the wet floor and fell. The employee's left side struck a metal trash can as she was falling. She suffered fractured ribs and was admitted to the hospital for her injuries.

An employee was grinding on a metal part when the grinding wheel broke during use and a piece of the wheel struck the employee's forehead. The employee was hospitalized for a large laceration to the forehead and other head trauma.
An employee was lighting the oven and suffered flash burns to the upper extremities.
An employee fell approximately 18 feet from an extension ladder and was hospitalized for broken bones that will require surgery.
An employee was walking back to the truck, slipped on the ice and fell onto his right hip cracking the pelvis.

An employee was cutting a section of a tree trunk with a chainsaw. As the employee finished the cut, the section of the tree fell and struck the employee resulting in a broken pelvis and internal injuries.
An employee fell approximately three feet from a scaffold resulting in a broken arm and a possible shattered elbow.

On 02/12/2018, an employee who was "riding the side of the belt" with a package, lost their balance after the package struck a pole on the side of the conveyor belt and fell from a two foot raised platform onto the concrete below resulting in a fractured left wrist.
An employee received an electric shock on his right hand while he was plugging an extension cord to a grinder machine and the extension cord contacted the wet floor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell resulting in a possible broken leg.

An employee was installing pipe hanger into the ceiling. The employee was working from a 12-foot step ladder using a full body harness with an MSA beam clamp and self-retracting lifeline attached to a 5-inch I-beam. The anchor point was located approximately 3 to 4 feet to the rear of the employee's position with the employee facing away from the anchor point. The beam clamp and self-retracting lifeline became detached from the 5-inch beam allowing the devices to swing downward towards the employee's position and striking the ladder's lower rung. The worker fell from the ladder landing feet first on the concrete floor below resulting in fractures to both lower extremities.
An employee was walking down the hall and fell breaking her femur in two places.

An employee removed a piece of plywood that was covering an HVAC chase hole approximately 2' x 2' in size. Upon removing the plywood from over the hole, the employee turned and stepped into the hole falling 11 feet to the wooden floor below. The employee suffered a broken right forearm, fractured ribs and several fractured vertebrae in his back.

An employee was putting together a large, heavy rack in the garden center. The rack fell over and punctured/injured the employee's left leg. Complications due to infection resulted in amputation of the leg.
An employee was working in the cattle receiving area and caught a finger on his right hand in a cattle pen gate, resulting in amputation at the nail just above the knuckle.
An employee exited the vehicle and slipped in mud while walking to the back of the vehicle causing her foot to roll and fracture.

An employee was stocking grocery shelves while standing on a stepstool. As the employee was stepping down from the stepstool, she missed the last step and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured left hip.
An employee was installing bracing on the top of a concrete column form when it fell over. He then fell to the ground, breaking his right foot and requiring hospitalization.
On 2/12/2018, an employee was closing a door when it caught her pinky finger, resulting in an amputation.

The employee was running a band saw machine and crushed the tip of the right middle finger in the bar holder when the machine cycled. The bone was exposed and the finger was amputated to just below the nail.

An employee was operating a bucket elevator/leg machine and opened a metal cover located at the bottom of the machine. The employee was attempting to remove grain from inside the running machine and amputated the left middle finger and lacerated the ring finger.

An employee was assisting a customer offload a delivery of steel from his truck and got his hand caught under the load. The employee sustained a partial amputation to his left ring finger and an avulsion injury to his middle finger.
On February 13, 2018, an employee was clearing a jam on a facial tissue converting machine and suffered a partial amputation of the left index fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was grinding while standing on a bakers scaffold and fell off the scaffold fracturing an arm.
An employee was taking trash to the dumpster. The wind caught the dumpster door and pinched the employee's finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was emptying packaging equipment and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee sustained second degree thermal burns to his feet from hot water while cleaning equipment in the facility.
An employee tripped over a computer bag laying in an aisle and fell breaking the left ankle.

An employee was inside a "dry room" at the press cell area. The room is environmentally controlled and a press is used to make heat pellets from powder. The powder is a flammable solid. The employee was cleaning the powder in the cell area with a broom and scoop and disposing of the powder at the satellite accumulation inside a fire cabinet. It is suspected that static electricity ignited the powder. The resulting fire burned both of the employee's hands.
An employee was adjusting a mixing machine and amputated a fingertip on the right hand.

An employee was attempting to cross to the main entrance roof from the 2nd floor hallway to perform pressure wash work. While climbing a railing, the employee fell approximately four feet to the main entrance roof resulting in a right arm and wrist fracture. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was troubleshooting/changing a belt on an air handling unit in the office area. The machine was shut off. As the employee checked the tension on one belt, the right middle finger contacted the still turning motor and was pulled into the flywheel resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a chain on a palletizer conveyor and got his finger caught in the master link resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was driving a stand up forklift in the aisle of a warehouse and caught her foot between the forklift and racking resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was feeding plastic into a sealing machine and amputated the right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was unlashing containers on a catwalk and fell resulting in a head laceration.

An employee was assisting the overhead crane operator to place an empty ladle in a ladle pre-heat station when the employee's right hand was caught in a pinch point resulting in a crushing injury to the hand.
An employee was welding steel to a column and suffered an electric shock. The employee's gloves were wet at the time.

On February 13, 2018, an employee was climbing a ladder in order to disconnect a cable television service from the main line. The ladder shifted during the employee's ascent resulting in the employee falling to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right wrist requiring surgery.

The employee was working at a sub-assembly jig that is 66 inches tall and 33 inches wide. The employee was getting up from performing a drilling operation on the underside of the jig. She grabbed onto the jig to assist herself in standing and the jig fell over onto her. The employee sustained subluxation and disruption of the spinolaminar ligament at C-7-T-1 and end plate compression fractures of T-7 through T-1.

An employee was cleaning batter from a conveyor hopper and amputated the distal end of the left ring finger when it was caught in a pinch point between the belt and a metal guard on the conveyor. The machine was operating and was not locked out at the time.
An employee was placing six foot pieces of dimensional lumber in a notching machine. He made contact with the blade resulting in a broken hand.

An employee was working a welding machine and a part got stuck. The employee reached in with his right hand to loosen the part and braced himself on the machine with his left hand. When the part was loosened, the actuators engaged and clamped down on his left hand amputating the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was entering his truck when he was assaulted with a hammer and robbed. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was operating a vacuum/scrubber machine in the cafeteria when he fell and landed on his left arm resulting in a fracture to the left wrist that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was drilling while conducting a SPT sampling and lacerated his thumb while covering a pinhole leak on the equipment.

An employee was working on the deck of a boat being built. As she was stepping across a gap in the boat deck, she lost her balance and stepped off of the boat. Her left leg was wedged between two structural beams of the boat dolly. She continued to fall (29 inches) onto the floor while her leg remained wedged between the beams resulting in a leg fracture.

On February 13, 2018, an employee was assembling a sand hopper for a customer. The sand hopper was in the upside down position. The employee was attempting to push the framework into position for the lifting lugs and hopper legs and pinched his left pinkie finger between the lifting lug and the post resulting in amputation at the distal joint.
An employee was operating a burn table with a pneumatic clamp when the clamp crushed his left index finger resulting in amputation of about 1/3 of the fingertip.
An employee's right thumb was crushed by a manhole cover.
A student was using a lathe to polish aluminum with sandpaper. The bandage on his right hand got caught in the lathe resulting in amputation of the right index finger at the distal phalanx.
An employee was reaching towards a patient to remove a blood pressure cuff and suffered a left shoulder sprain/strain.
An employee was setting up the press brake when the machine started amputating the employee's right hand.
An employee was at the front counter and collapsed, hitting her head on the counter resulting in a knot and contusion on the forehead.
An employee was cutting branches. He was using a rope to hold the branches. The branch fell and caught the rope fracturing the employee's forearm and lacerating a finger.

On February 13, 2018, at approximately 12:30 p.m., an employee incurred fractured ribs when pinched/crushed by the moving arm of the jig (fixture holding device) that held a large sheet of acrylic material during the foam insertion process.

An employee was loading frozen chubs (tubes of meat) into the hydrauflaker. As he was trying to manipulate the chub around, his left ring finger was caught between the chub and ram (pusher) as it was returning to the home position. The left ring finger was pinched and the muscle on the finger was amputated.
An employee was climbing a utility pole when the pole and the employee fell over. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was drilling with a hand held hammer drill. A second employee grabbed the bit to straighten it and their glove was caught on the drill bit dislocating three fingers.
An employee had started to move the rail car and was climbing the car to set the brake when the employee's foot slipped off the ladder resulting in amputation of the right foot.
An employee fell 8 feet while climbing down the ladder on a concrete truck. The employee sustained neck and back trauma.

An employee was clearing a jammed piece of wood from the 4-way splitter by pushing the jammed wood with another piece of wood. When the jammed wood was pushed free the 4-way splitter ram released and came forward striking and amputating the employee's left thumb at the knuckle.
An employee was going from one area of the plant to another and attempted to cross the roller conveyor when the employee lost balance and fell. The employee sustained a broken ankle.

A temporary employee was checking a groove that was being machined into pipe when the machine started up and amputated the left index finger from the tip to the second knuckle. Cut resistant gloves were worn at the time.
An employee conducting pressure washing suffered a laceration to his left foot due to a malfunctioning spray gun.

An employee operating a stand-up forklift struck a metallic rack guard with a fork and was ejected from the machine. The employee suffered head and back injuries after striking the concrete floor. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was struck by a hydraulic jack that kicked out from a concrete form and struck him in his ribcage and right elbow. The employee was admitted to the hospital for an open wound fracture to his right elbow.
An employee was cleaning underneath a kettle of boiling water when a hose came off the kettle and the boiling water burned the employee's shoulder and left arm.
An employee's pinky finger was partially amputated by a new reel string when performing a change up process on a paper machine.
An employee fell while trying to get onto a ladder from the roof shortly after removing fall protection. The employee sustained a broken left leg.

An employee was webbing up a press and standing between two units when she contacted her right leg against a small step ladder. The employee felt a pop in her left leg and sustained a broken left femur.
An employee suffered a smashed thumb while working to remove a 2" diameter metal pole from a shear.

On February 14, 2018, around 5:40 a.m., an employee was walking through the plant when a rope from an empty laundry sling tangled around her foot/ankle. The employee bent over attempting to remove the rope from her foot/ankle, lost her balance and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized for a hip fracture.
An employee fell from a ladder and fractured the tibia.

An employee was standing near a conveyor system wearing metatarsal guarded shoes when his left foot was pulled into the conveyor and his foot and ankle were caught between the conveyor paddle and a riser resulting in his foot and ankle being degloved.
An employee was troubleshooting a clogged chip conveyor and amputated (about 1 inch) the right middle finger.
An employee was removing a shelf from within a delivery truck. The shelf fell and cut the employee's right foot.
An employee was working on an electrical line when he came into contact with a high-voltage wire. The employee was hospitalized for electrical shock and burns.
An employee was lifting tarps off the ground and felt a pop. The employee was hospitalized for hernia surgery.

An employee was delivering materials to a jobsite. The employee pulled on a piece of wood used to separate loads when the piece gave way. The employee's momentum caused him to fall backwards off the truck bed. The employee suffered head and leg injuries.

An employee was lifting a pipe approximately 36 inches long. The pipe slipped from the crane rigging, contacted the floor first and then contacted the employee's lower shin area of the right leg. The employee suffered a lower leg fracture.

When the rubber was not moving on the mixing machine, an employee crawled into a live conveyor and reached into an automatic mixer that has a "gripper" on it. The employee's arm and shoulder were pulled into the 4.5 inch opening and bruised.
An employee was trying to release a pail that was stuck in the labeling machine. When the pail released, the pail and belt pulled the employee's right thumb into the machine, amputating the tip.
An employee was unloading a truck with a crane. The material shifted pushing him off the truck. The employee suffered multiple leg fractures.
An employee was trimming hedges using an electric hedge trimmer. While descending the ladder, the employee slipped and severely lacerated his hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee was standing near the edge of a cantilevered sheet of plywood and when he leaned over, the plywood moved, causing him to fall 38 feet to the ground and fracture both legs.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a conveyor belt and fell into the conveyor when he lost his balance. The employee suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was checking a vibration on the fiberfill machine when his wedding ring was caught on a shaft resulting in amputation of the employee's left ring finger.

An employee was driving a delivery truck and the truck got caught on cable. The employee used a ladder to try and free the cable from the truck. When the tension on the cable was released the employee lost his balance and fell to the ground landing on his heels. Both heels were fractured. One of them required surgery.

An employee was using a forklift to restack pallets. The employee's left index finger was caught between the lift and pallet as the employee was sliding a pallet off resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was climbing down a ladder inside an oven in order to clean it. The employee slipped and fell 2-5 feet off the ladder resulting in a bulging disc in the neck.
An employee was operating a die cutting machine and crushed three fingers.

An employee was loading an axle onto the engine subassembly table. When attempting to align the right side of the axle, a finger was caught between the axle and the axle rest stand resulting in amputation to the distal end of the finger.
On February 15, 2018, at about 1:15 a.m. five employees were transported to the hospital due to breathing problems after chlorine exposure. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a fractured foot when an excavator bucket struck a timber mat pile and the mat struck the employee's foot. The employee was 18 feet away at the time.
An employee tripped and fell while walking into the warehouse through an office doorway. The employee fractured her right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was testing electrical cables. An arc flash occurred while the employee was putting rubber boots back on resulting in an electrical burn to the left arm.
An employee was walking across the parking lot, slipped on ice and fell injuring the left knee.

An employee was bending a piece of metal in a press brake and pinched fingers between a piece of metal and the outside wall of the press brake. It was used manually and in a semi-automatic phase. The employee sustained a crushed right index fingertip and amputated the left index fingertip.

On February 15, 2018, at approximately 3:00 PM, an employee was standing on a gooseneck trailer unloading material when he lost his balance, falling approximately four feet and landing on the ground on his side. The employee was hospitalized for five fractured ribs.

An employee was retrieving a pallet from the upper shelving of the pallet rack (approximately 40 feet) using a pallet jack. As he raised the pallet, another pallet on the backside of the rack was overlapping and began to tip. As the second pallet tipped forward four wheel rims and the wooden pallet fell from the rack, one of the rims struck the employee's head. The employee sustained bleeding and swelling of the brain.

An employee was running after a child that was running towards a street and slipped in a grassy, muddy area. As she tried to catch herself on a chain link fence, the ring on her left ring finger was caught in the fence resulting in a degloving injury.

An employee was testing the repair on the slide cylinder of a refuse truck by operating the packer panel lever with his left hand. When he engaged the lever, the cylinder linkage malfunctioned and caused the lever to abruptly kick in toward the side wall of the truck body crushing the upper half of the left index finger between the lever and side wall of the truck body resulting in a contusion and fracture.
An employee was walking to the company vehicle to retrieve a tool and fell 18 feet through an uncovered 2' x 3' drain inlet resulting in a broken right femur.

An employee was sweeping out the back of a 53-foot semi-trailer when his foot slipped on the edge of the trailer and he fell approximately 4 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.
An employee was transferring from a platform to a crew boat, fell and fractured the lower left leg.

An employee was using a 2x4 to unclog the granulator. The employee's left hand was caught between the 2x4 and the metal feed chute of the granulator when the material began to flow. The employee's hand was broken and required surgery.
An employee was preparing items for the fabrication process and caught a finger between the bin that held the parts and the forks of the forklift resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was performing a rip cut on a table saw and amputated two fingers on the right hand. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was lifting a resident's legs into bed and sustained a lower back injury.

Two employees were offloading a truck. The pallet jack fell off the truck to the ground. The employees were setting the pallet jack upright and one employee amputated the right index fingertip when it was caught under the pallet jack forks.

An employee was fabricating a frame. The frame was sitting adjacent to a support column for a boom crane. The frame was struck with the crane boom that caused the frame to fall and strike his hand resulting in a broken index finger on the left hand that required surgery.

On February 15, 2018, an employee was removing a hose coupling from a pump after sanitation had been completed. The employee's fingers on the left hand were caught in the pump impeller. The index, middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
A temporary employee was cutting open cardboard boxes with a box cutter and cut his lower left arm. The employee was admitted to the hospital due to a deep laceration to the venous artery.
An employee's right small fingertip was caught between the tire rim and axle housing resulting in a partial amputation/open fracture to the distal phalanx.
An employee was changing liners in the mud pump and got his right index finger smashed between the liner and sledge hammer.

An employee was training another employee to take a water meter reading in the UV building. The employee stepped backwards to allow the trainee to get closer to visually read the meter and tripped over a 1" air line that had a 3/8" air hose attached. The employee fell to ground fracturing the right hip.
An employee got the right middle finger caught in a running machine while watching a maintenance employee troubleshoot the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A crew of four employees was cleaning out storm water sediment traps using a hydraulic pump to remove the water from the gravity well and then a vac truck to remove the sand and other debris caught in the sediment traps (using a cage to surround the manhole while performing the work). The crew had finished cleaning the sediment traps and three of the employees were putting the equipment back in the truck. The injured employee was replacing the manhole cover and fell approximately five feet into the gravity well. The employee sustained broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the meat grinding machine. The machine was turned on while the employee's hand was inside resulting in amputation of the right index, middle, ring and pinky fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee was skiing, lost the left ski and struck a tree with their head. The employee sustained three compression fractures in the upper back. The employee was wearing a helmet at the time.
An employee was working on a fan when the blade severed their right middle finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was ascending on a scissor lift to transfer insulation material. As the employee was climbing out of the scissor lift to the commercial roof, he fell 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs, a bruised liver and back pain.
An employee slipped on black ice and fell fracturing the left foot.

An employee was looking for her keys. She asked the building engineer to retrieve them from the elevator pit. The engineer stopped the elevator and went to get them. Meanwhile, the employee leaned over and fell into the pit resulting in a fractured left leg and a cut to the right leg.
An employee was attacked by a dog while delivering mail. The employee fell to the ground and broke a hip.
An employee was cutting balsa wood using a table saw and contacted the saw blade resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was maneuvering a pipe when the pipe fell on the employee resulting in broken ribs and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was moving a rug when she fell forward and sustained a hairline fracture of the right hip.
An employee was cutting steel with a cutting torch when a piece of hot metal fell into their boot, burning the right foot and ankle.

An employee was walking down a temporary ramp that was put in place to run wheel barrows. The plywood on the floor began to tilt and the employee jumped from the ramp landing onto a loose brick on the floor. The employee fractured the right heel and left hip.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder looking for a pressure washer hose and he fell off the ladder approximately 6 ft to the ground and sustained a fractured skull and a possible brain bleed.
An employee was helping to roll out geotextile material. As the employee was lifting the roll over a wall, it spun and struck the employee's leg fracturing it.
An employee was fixing a broken conveyor when their right arm was caught in the conveyor resulting in a fractured forearm.

An employee was cleaning around a 54-inch tall partition wall. The wall fell over and the employee was struck in the back of the leg. The employee sustained a fracture in the lower right leg, which required hospitalization.

An employee was using a pocket knife to poke a hole in a jug. The safety latch on the knife was not secured causing the knife to close and lacerate the employee's left index and middle fingers resulting in amputation of the distal portion of the index finger.
An employee tripped on a hose at a gas station and sustained a dislocated elbow and a broken arm.
While placing the dock plate an employee slipped between the dock and the truck. Skin was removed from the shin and a bone was broken.

Employees were replacing a pump at a gas well site. After set up, the pump jack was not pulling gas from the well. A cable was hooked up to the pump jack to move it slightly. As the cable was pulled, the pump jack tipped over onto an employee breaking the employee's tibia and fibula.
Employee was using a pneumatic impact wrench to remove a lug nut from a vehicle and metal debris entered their eye.
An employee working at the car wash was struck by a reversing vehicle resulting in a torn ligament in the left leg.
An employee walked around a shrink wrapped package/bundle and sustained a severe laceration to the right calf.
During a forging operation, an employee had their left index finger amputated while using a punch press.
An employee was found in the warehouse area of the store with an eye contusion/black eye and in a disoriented state. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture in two places and swelling.

An employee was standing on the rail of the mega mixer. The employee was crossing over the rails and slipped. The employee's right foot was struck by the mega mixer and pinned between the wheel and rail.

An employee was walking from the parking lot to the store to begin work,d slipped on ice that had accumulated on the sidewalk in front of the store, and fell onto the concrete. The employee received a compound fracture to the right leg.

The employee was opening the sliding door to the heat treating building by pulling the handle down, which enables the door to slide on its rollers. The metal sliding door was approximately 22.5 feet in length and 11 feet in height. The employee tried to push the sliding door along its rollers by placing his left hand on the door handle frame. While pushing the sliding door, the unlatched spring-loaded door handle released from its down position, and sprung upward, catching the employee's left pinky finger between the stationary and moving door handle framework resulting in amputation.
An employee was climbing out of a truck and slipped. His leg hit a broken part of the truck's bumper causing a severe cut to his right calf. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was walking through his department between two trailers to retrieve tools. The employee tripped and fell over a cable that is on a winch to remove trailers from the paint booth. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for a hip injury.
While unloading steel beams, a beam fell off of the truck and struck an employee's lower leg, breaking it.
An employee was stepping out from behind the garbage truck and was struck by a school bus resulting in multiple fractures.
An employee was walking in the hallway when 10-15 sheets of drywall fell on him causing a left leg fracture.
An employee slipped on snow/ice in the company parking lot and fell breaking the left ankle.

An employee was receiving scaffold materials up to the 21st floor via an engineered opening in the scaffold flooring. The employee fell approximately 14 feet through a gap in the scaffold flooring. The employee struck his head in the fall and was hospitalized. The employee was not tied off at the time.
An employee slipped on ice while stepping off the curb to the parking lot, while walking toward their car. The employee fractured her right ankle.
An employee was working from a ladder inside a hole (trench) rubbing the chamfer line on the concrete, removing nails and/or debris, and fell 6 feet, receiving a lower back fracture.

An equipment operator was loading a tripod onto a backhoe while standing on the ground. He inadvertently struck a lever with the tripod causing the boom to swing into him and pin him between the boom and stabilizer resulting in fractured ribs and a fractured pelvis.

At approximately 10:30 AM on 02/16/2018, an employee was working with a crew of pipe fitters and plumbers, moving a long steel pipe into position in a designated area. The crew was using a portable lift to move the pipe onto cricket. The pipe spun and struck the employee's left foot resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell fracturing the right arm.

An employee was walking on a walkway between buildings and brushed up against the guardrail. The railing detached and the employee fell about 22 feet to the ground. The employee also struck an air conditioner on the way down. He was hospitalized with a serious cut to the head and a broken ankle and sternum.
An employee fell out of the dump vehicle he was driving and was struck by it resulting in a crushed lower right leg.

An employee was being elevated in a scissor lift to install duct work. The employee's left hand was caught between the scissor lift's hand rail and the conduit suspended in the air resulting in a fractured and lacerated hand.

On February 17, 2018, an employee was injured while using a drill press. The drill press was set up with a paddle in lieu of a drill bit. While adjusting the speed of the press with his left hand, his right hand held a tachometer. With the paddle spinning, the shaft bent 90 degrees and contacted the employee's right ring finger, resulting in amputation.
As an employee was descending a 10-foot extension ladder, a gust of wind caused the employee to lose his balance and fall 8 feet, sustaining fractured ribs.
An employee was skimming impurities from melt when he lost his footing and fell forward into a pot of molten aluminum. He was burned on the left arm and hand.

Employees were replacing a damaged fabric felt on the paper machine. As the felt was being pulled into position using a new piece of threading rope, the rope broke, wrapped around both of the employee's knees, and the end of the rope struck the back of his right leg causing a deep laceration.
While opening a trail, an employee was skiing and fell. The employee sustained a cracked T3 vertebrae, a fractured T4 vertebrae, and a small brain bleed.
An employee was working on the line, slipped and fell. His hand went into the deep fryer resulting in hot oil burns.
An employee was offloading freight onto a conveyor belt. A tote weighing approximately 20 lbs. fell from inside the truck onto the employee's head.

An employee was refinishing a roll of paper in the refinishing area. The employee manually pushed the roll onto the slat conveyor, however the roll continued on, striking a barrier and causing the roll to bounce back to the slat conveyor. The roll then rolled back to the barrier, striking the employee in the left arm and fracturing the ulna.
While taking down a light fixture, an employee fell about 7 feet from an A-frame ladder and broke both heels.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground from the load on a flatbed trailer while trying to tarp the load. He sustained a concussion, fractures to the knee and wrists, and required stitches.
An employee was working in the breeding room and was exposed to an elevated level of ammonia from pig waste. The employee was hospitalized for a respiratory system burn.

An employee was walking over to check for leaks on a gauge. The employee noticed three lines/hoses had collapsed. The blender was on and when the valve opened 100 pounds of pressure hit the hoses causing them to jump up and strike the employee breaking the right tibia and fibula.
While inspecting a fryer, an employee's sleeve was caught and pulled into the fryer. The employee sustained a broken hand and forearm.
An employee sustained a laceration to the right leg above the knee while pressure washing shaker pits with an industrial pressure washer.
An employee was attacked and mugged in the parking lot.
On February 18, 2018, an employee bent over to pick up a dime on the floor and lost her balance and fell resulting in a fractured right hip and fractured right elbow.
Employees were hoisting drilling pipe, when the pipe fell, striking the back of an employee who was standing on the rig floor. The employee sustained fractured ribs and vertebrae.

An employee was checking the coolant level in a radiator for one of the rig's generators. When he twisted the radiator cap, the cap came off and he was sprayed with hot coolant resulting in burns to his right arm, shoulder, chest and scapula. Immediately afterward he ran towards the rig manager's trailer and while doing so tripped and fell resulting in a broken right clavicle and cracked scapula.
An employee fell off a two-story roof and broke his wrist.

An employee was opening the weather doors at the end of the jet way. The door is held closed by a latch pin and utilizes a hydraulic device to hold the door open during passenger loading/unloading from the aircraft. When the employee released the latch pin, the door swung back, knocking the employee to the floor of the jet way resulting in a back injury.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to the roof access hatch and lost their grip and fell to the concrete floor, causing a fracture.

Two employees were installing a new arm on a 200 foot power pole in a 295-foot aerial lift. The lift shifted and the employees fell out of the basket. The employees were using fall protection and suffered traumatic injuries from the fall protection equipment.
On February 18, 2018, an employee was working from a portable extension ladder that was staged on a slippery surface. The ladder became displaced and the employee fell, resulting in facial fractures.

An employee was helping to unload product that was in coolers from the back of the van. While exiting the back of the van with a cooler in hand, the employee slipped and missed the bumper and fell onto the pavement injuring his ankle and knee.
An employee was putting two pipes together and one of his fingers was caught in a pinch point, resulting in medical amputation of the fingertip down to the bone.

An employee was standing next to a free-standing doorframe when a second employee, who was attempting to run a cable to a spider box along the wall, bumped the doorframe. It fell towards the first employee and knocked him on his back on the cement floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured L1 vertebra.

An employee was escorting a patient to an exit door when the patient punched the employee in the head, causing the employee to fall and hit their head on the floor. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was standing on the third rung of a 10-foot step-ladder using a reciprocating saw, fell and fractured an ankle.
While recycling a large trailer, an employee was struck in the head when the 8-foot high side swing door was blown shut by a gust of wind.
An employee was installing pipes for a sprinkler system and started to descend a ladder when it gave way, causing him to fall to the ground.
An employee was standing in the parking lot and was struck by a vehicle that was backing up. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee had just finished unloading product from a trailer at a dock when the employee fell backwards off the dock and struck the concrete ground. The employee suffered head and shoulder injuries requiring hospitalization.
An employee was strapping and securing a load on the back of a trailer when he fell off, breaking five ribs.
An employee was operating a reach truck when he believed the brakes were failing and put his foot out to stop the truck. His foot hit racking and was fractured, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a block that fell from a 600-ton crane when the crane collapsed. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the body.

An employee was operating an industrial band saw that is equipped with a hydraulic pipe clamp when his hand was caught between the clamp and the pipe he was cutting. His two left middle fingers were amputated. The band saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was on the third-story balcony of an apartment complex. He was pulling up a 25-foot section of gutter with a rope so that it could be installed. When the employee grabbed the section of gutter the end of it hit a power line. The electricity exited out of the employees left foot causing an exit-wound burn.

An employee was gathering shopping carts in the store parking lot when a customer backed out of a parking space and hit the employee. The employee suffered bruised ribs, a sprained wrist, and a bruised arm.
An employee fell approximately 16 feet from an abutment while wrecking forms, and sustained multiple fractures.
An employee suffered a lower leg muscle injury after severe exertion during training.
An employee was opening a delivery truck door when floor joists fell off the truck and struck the employee, causing head and back injuries, as well as a neck fracture.

An employee was removing a small piece of wood that was stuck between the table saw guard and fence. While reaching for the wood, the employee pressed the foot pedal resulting in amputation of the right thumb, index and middle fingers.

An employee was changing electrical poles. The employee grabbed the chain to try and move it up on the pole and pinched the left thumb between the pole and chain. The tip of the thumb was crushed and amputated.

An employee was attempting to install ladder clamps to secure an extension ladder in preparation for the work activity and fell approximately 14 feet from the ladder, resulting in multiple hip fractures and a shoulder injury.
An employee reached into a press machine and suffered an amputation injury to the index finger.
On February 19, 2018, an employee was getting up from her desk when she tripped over an ethernet cable. She fell and suffered bilateral shoulder fractures, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was rigging a section of pipe into an upper-level steel structure when the pipes shifted, striking and crushing the employee's leg.
An employee was walking down the hallway and fell breaking a kneecap.

An employee was walking on a flatbed tractor trailer while loading equipment. He was checking to make sure chains were not trapped between the load and dunnage when he tripped over the dunnage and fell 57.5 inches off the trailer to the concrete below, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee climbed up an extension ladder to ensure it was setup correctly. The employee fell 23 feet, sustaining back injuries and broken ribs.
An employee was getting a part off of a shelf and fell off the ladder resulting in a possible concussion.
An employee sustained a partial finger amputation when moving the guard on a circular saw.
An employee was pushing a lorry tank on a monorail when the monorail broke, causing the lorry tank to fall over and break the employee's leg.
An employee was squatting while cleaning a taco fryer when she lost her balance and reached to catch herself. Her left hand was then caught in a sprocket, amputating her middle fingertip.

Employees were transporting hot water in a large plastic garbage bin from a kettle to a sink to wash dishes, because the water heater was not working, when the bin tipped over. The hot water splashed the injured employee on the back of the legs, calves, and feet, causing second degree burns.
An employee's right foot was run over by a forklift that was backing up, requiring surgery.
On February 19, 2018, an employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell, fracturing her right femoral hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a rubber milling/mixing machine when his left hand became caught in the mill. He was able to remove it, but the skin was separated from his hand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was struck on the head by falling sheet metal duct work during demolition operations, suffering a concussion.
An employee was unloading a truck when he began feeling sick. He was taken to the hospital where he suffered a heart attack.
An employee was assembling a scaffold when it tipped over, causing the employee to fall approximately 8 feet sustaining bruising and contusions to the head and ribs.
An employee was feeding a 4x8 into a laminating machine when the employee's foot was caught between the machine platform and the feed table resulting in a small toe injury.
An employee was operating a saw when the tool's fixed clamp closed on his right hand, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.

An employee was transferring a 55-gallon drum with an ergonomic drive lift. Her body was leaning to the left to view the drum placement when her right thumb became caught/crushed in the lift device. She released the drum, which freed her thumb.

An employee was using a table saw to cut wood stakes. The blade of the table saw pops up from below the table surface when a two-hand control is actuated and retracts below the table surface once the controls are released. However, the blade did not fully retract. When the employee grabbed the cut wood, his right index finger contacted the blade, suffering a partial amputation.
An employee was hospitalized after being assaulted by a patient.
An employee was operating a lathe when the employee's left arm was caught in the lathe, resulting in a left arm amputation.
An employee was walking to her car when she slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot, breaking her right femur.
An employee was troubleshooting a mobile power unit compressor when his hand entered the running machine, breaking two fingers.
An employee was unloading two bundles of trusses from a powered industrial truck when the second bundle fell off the forks and caught the employee's leg, fracturing it.
An employee and a coworker were involved in a fight. The coworker cut the employee with a sharp object, lacerating his stomach, chest, back, and arm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On February 20, 2018, at approximately 8:00 AM, an employee was sanding a vehicle's A/C belt when a pulley caught his glove and pulled his finger between the two, resulting in a right index finger amputation. The vehicle was running at the time.

An employee was pushing a cart with an equipment body into a paint booth when the wheel of the cart caught a raised grate in the paint booth floor. The raised grate caused the equipment body to roll onto the employee's hands, causing internal crushing injuries on the right hand and severe lacerations on the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a  ladder when he fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, landing on and breaking his left arm.

An employee was helping a coworker rearrange a crate (weighing 706 pounds) with an electric pallet jack. He was standing at the end of the forks and leaned the wooden crate to get it off the forks. His coworker then lowered the forks, which bumped the ground, and the crate tipped. He tried to stop the crate from falling, but it fell on his right leg, fracturing it between the knee and foot, and requiring hospitalization.
While surveying a construction site, an employee tripped over a wooden stake and fell to the ground, breaking the left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking back to the trailer after conducting maintenance outside when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was washing building windows when the clamp supporting him slipped off the parapet wall. He then fell approximately 36 to 42 feet, striking a tree and then landing on the grass lawn below. He broke his right arm, six right-side ribs, and one vertebra, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The clamp was not tied back to an independent life line at the time of the incident.

An employee was getting the loop out of a drilling line at a spool when the driller started the spool, catching the employee's right hand between the line and spool. The employee's right ring and index fingers were amputated.
An employee was connecting a converter dolly to a trailer when the dolly unexpectedly released itself, crushing the employee's finger against the bottom of the trailer.

An employee was operating a wire brush handheld grinder to smooth out concrete. The grinder hit the side of a stair and kicked back, hitting the employee's left leg and causing a 2" deep and 4" wide laceration on his thigh.
An employee was manually lifting a gear from the rotary die cutter when the gear slipped, pinning and crushing the employee's middle fingertip and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was processing meat when another employee stabbed him in the neck with a knife. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
While fueling a company car, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.
The injured employee was adjusting a die when a second employee started the machine. The injured employee suffered a partial amputation of the thumb.
An employee's hand struck a grinding wheel, suffering a fractured fingertip, a deep laceration to the index finger, and an abrasion on the middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a mail delivery truck when a vape cigarette in his pocket burned his leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the ground level manually lifting the dock plate to sit on a trailer. The dock leveler was a mechanical chain driven dock leveler that would not raise completely due to a mechanical issue with the tensioner. As the employee lifted the dock plate, he was pinned between the dock plate and the trailer resulting in broken ribs and a lacerated spleen.

An employee was doing routine minor maintenance on an automatic flagrod machine's gas meter when he noticed a flagrod was out of place in the machine's swage former. He was trying to push it into place when the head of the swage former came down on his hand, fracturing his hand, thumb, and middle finger.

An employee was standing on a couch dusting a picture frame. When she moved, her shoe was caught on a pillow, causing her to fall to the concrete floor. She suffered a left wrist fracture and left wrist/hand contusions.

An employee was climbing down a scaffold ladder when the employee's right foot slipped from the  third rung from the bottom. The employee then fell to the ground, fracturing the left leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a 7.5-ton overhead crane to move a suspended load while holding onto the load with his right hand. The load weight plate (with his hand on it) then struck the back of a forklift, and his right index and middle fingers were lacerated. He was hospitalized.

An employee operating a motorized pallet jack struck a support beam. A piece of protruding metal on the support beam caused a severe laceration to the employee's right calf, requiring hospitalization.
While placing boxes onto a loading dock, an employee fell approximately 5 feet off the dock to the ground, suffering multiple pelvic fractures.

On February 21, 2018, an employee was using construction equipment and a tow strap to pull a damaged wooden pallet of product. The rigging gave way, allowing a metal bar that the strap was looped around to strike and fracture the employee's knee, requiring surgery.
While installing screws on a sheet metal roof, an employee slipped off the roof and fell to the frozen ground, fracturing both feet.
While walking down a flight of steps during the rain, an employee tripped on the last step and fell to a concrete landing, breaking the left ankle.

An employee was operating a pallet rider powered industrial truck in an aisle. When he applied the brakes, the pallet rider skidded and his foot was pinned between the side of the pallet rider and the guardrail for some racks. He had multiple toes amputated on his left foot.
An employee fell off the back of a truck body and broke a leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to change the bucket on a skid steer when it fell off the skid steer and onto the employee. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was standing on the platform of a stand-up forklift when he passed out, fell off, and hit his head on the floor. He suffered a cut and contusion to the back of the head and was hospitalized with internal bleeding and a blood clot on the brain.
An employee was driving a side loader (PIV) to retrieve steel orders when the brakes went out. The employee dismounted from the side loader and was pinned between it and a column, breaking a leg.
An employee was working from a ladder about 8 feet high and fell fracturing a leg.
An employee was pinned between a bollard and a car that another associate was driving into the shop. The pinned employee suffered a fingertip amputation and the remainder of the finger was crushed.
An employee was pouring sows (molten metal) into a mold when the metal blew out, resulting in burns to the neck, chin, and hands.

An employee was cleaning a heart and liver machine and raised a cover to remove chicken parts. His right hand contacted the moving machine parts, resulting in an open fracture to the third finger. The machine was not shut down at the time.

An employee was driving a standup forklift and dismounting from the back of it when the heel of his boot was caught underneath the forklift, cutting his left heel severely. The forklift had not come to a complete stop at the time.
An employee was using a saw to cut wood when his left hand contacted the running blade, cutting his ring finger and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was unloading bales of straw from the back of a truck when he lost his footing and fell head first onto the asphalt, injuring his head.

An employee was working on revolving doors on a rolling machine when his left hand entered the pinch point between the machine rollers, crushing his hand and fingers. The pinch point was not guarded at the time.

An employee was attempting to drive out an insert in a die with a sledge hammer. He missed the insert while swinging the sledge hammer, and his left index finger was then caught between the sledge hammer handle and die, suffering a fracture and partial amputation.
On February 21, 2018, an employee was walking on the sidewalk when she stepped on a small rock, causing her ankle to turn awkwardly. She was hospitalized with an ankle injury.
An employee was pulling an engine block out of a wash tank by hand when the employee's left thumb was caught between the engine block and a non-powered roller, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift and made a sharp turn. The employee's left forearm was then caught between the forklift and an industrial shelving system (rack), fracturing the left radius and ulna bones.
An employee was closing a chain valve when part of the valve fell off and struck his head. He then fell down a set of stairs, lacerating his face, fracturing his C7 vertebra, and fracturing his ribs.
An employee was attempting to clean a clog out of a spray fire proofing hose when fire proofing and accelerant released under pressure and entered his eye.
An employee was helping to remove a tote filled with ink when the tote contacted his left hand and pinched his finger between it and a metal frame, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was removing the fourth stud on a four-hole bolt pattern to separate two vertical sections of pipe when the employee's finger was caught between the flange of the falling lower section of pipe and an adjacent pipe flange. The employee suffered an amputation of the fourth finger's distal phalanx.

An employee was handing a bag of landscaping debris to a second employee when he felt a sharp pain in his lower back and shortly thereafter could not move. He was hospitalized with a muscle strain/pull.

An employee was removing forms inside an excavation around the concrete foundation of a residential home. 
The excavated vertical wall caved in, trapping the employee. The employee sustained a concussion and was hospitalized. Rain was a contributing factor.

At approximately 9:45 a.m., on 2/21/2018, an employee was performing maintenance on a press. The machine was properly locked/tagged out and he was wearing all assigned PPE. The employee was using a pry bar to help remove a component of the press. As he was pressing on the pry bar, it slipped, and his left-hand pinky finger was then smashed between the pry bar and the edge of the mold he was working on, resulting in a partial pinky finger amputation.
An employee experienced muscle pain while running and was hospitalized with muscle damage.

An employee was adding oil to a fryer from a large pan when the pan slipped and spilled the oil onto the ground. The employee slipped in the hot oil and fell on his back, suffering severe burns to his back and the back of his legs.
An employee was climbing a 24-foot extension ladder to access a roof when he mis-stepped and fell approximately 16 feet to the ground, breaking his lower right leg.
An employee was working on the roof. A piece of metal roofing twisted and caused the employee to fall 8 ft. to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip and three broken ribs.
An employee fell down while walking and fractured her right wrist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing in an area where paint was stored, when a flash fire occurred. The employee suffered flash burns to her torso, arms, legs, and cheeks.
An employee was walking down the hallway, tripped and fell resulting in a dislocated and broken left elbow.
An employee was using a panel saw to cut a piece of raw walnut wood when his left arm went into the blade, partially amputating it.
An employee was hit from behind by a skier and fell to the snow-covered ground, hitting his head.
An employee was walking down stairs when he lost balance, fell, and broke his collarbone.
An employee was preparing an energetic mixture when the mixture detonated causing burns and lacerations to the employee's arms and stomach region.

On February 21, 2018, an employee was attempting to close the valve on a milk tanker trailer when pressure in the trailer pulled his right middle finger between the valve and the trailer, pinching it and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was descending stairs from a tank battery, slipped on an icy step and fell about halfway down the stairs, fracturing the left fibula.

An employee was unscrewing track studs from the ceiling while standing on a Bakers scaffold. The scaffold rolled and the employee fell to the concrete ground below resulting in a concussion and a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was feeding material into a 14-inch mill (also called calendar) with both hands when the employee's left hand was pulled into the mill, pinching off the fingertips. The employee also suffered a broken wrist and forearm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a tractor tug to move equipment. The employee dismounted the tug to hook up a bobtail cargo truck. When he was between the tug and the cargo truck, the tug shifter popped out of neutral, allowing the tug to run into and pin the employee, causing deep lacerations to both of his shins. He was hospitalized. The tug was running, and the shifter was not all the way in neutral at the time of the incident.
An employee was helping a saw operator cut frozen beef. The employee was placing a block of meat on the saw when it amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee sustained an amputation injury when his finger became caught between a fork of a forklift and the garbage dumpster.

Three employees nippled up a blowout preventer's operation while standing in ankle-deep water that had cement residue in it. Later, one of the employee's suffered first, second, and third degree burns to his feet, requiring hospitalization. Rubber boots were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a pillow and fell to the floor fracturing her right hip.
When leaving work, an employee fell on ice, resulting in a hospitalization.

An employee was trying out new tree climbing gear. While repelling down from the tree, the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture to the right wrist and a bruised/fractured pelvis.
An employee was spreading roofing cement and fell 20 feet fracturing his femur.
While prepping the winder on the SMS 2 machine, an employee's finger was caught between a non-powered tool and the machine's guard. The tip of the left pinkie finger was amputated.
An employee was running to his car, stumbled and fell falling to the cement and breaking the right hip.
An employee was injured while operating a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) to load a truck.
An employee's glove got caught in the belt drive of the chip conveyor injuring the employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on the ice in the parking lot during an ongoing freezing rain. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of torn ligaments and tendons in the knee.

An employee was un-tensioning a chain that was used to secure a crane counterweight to a trailer deck when the chain rolled and pinched the employee's left index fingertip between it and the counterweight. The employee's nailbed and ligament were damaged, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to blow down a pipeline pigging receiver chamber to load the pig when the chamber door swung open under pressure and hit the employee's right hand and knee. The employee's right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was walking when she tripped over a bolt that was holding a metal plate to the floor and broke her right femur head.
An employee was picking up a bulkhead when some sharp metal lacerated his right thumb.
An employee was walking to his car, slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground resulting in a broken hip.
An employee using a band saw sustained a finger amputation.

A temporary employee was cleaning a mechanically driven roller on a coating machine when the roller pulled the employee's left hand into the machine, causing an open fracture on a finger that resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell out of the back of a truck and off the loading dock while on a forklift.

An employee was helping to steady a bunker hoisted on a forklift jib attachment when the forklift drove forward over the employee's left foot. The employee's foot and toes broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was driving a flatbed along the interstate when he noticed that some material had moved and pulled over to the emergency lane to secure the materials. He then slipped and fell, contacting metal flashing with his hand. His left hand was lacerated (cut through the tendon), requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a scissor lift installing a column when a flange flipped and crushed their hand, resulting in amputation of the middle finger. Three other fingers were mangled.
An employee was guiding a piece of metal in place with welds when one of the welds broke and hit the employee on the hip. The employee suffered a hip fracture and was hospitalized.
An iron casting fell off a hook and hit an employee's shoulder, breaking it.

While pushing a pipe away from the dredge using a wooden paddle, an employee slipped and grabbed a cable, catching his fingers between a cable and a pulley. This resulted in the loss of part of his left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was using an air and water hose to air up a bicycle tire. The employee placed his hand over the nozzle to prevent the water from squirting out. Air got into the hand of the employee causing injuries to the right hand and forearm.
An employee was setting up a machine and suffered a fingertip amputation when his finger was pinched between two moving parts of the machine.
An employee was working on the cylinder of a trailer, attempting to loosen the bolt with a pipe wrench, when it loosened unexpectedly and he slipped onto the floor, breaking his lower left leg.

On February 23, 2018, an employee was pushing a bin of parts to their work area when a wheel on the cart broke off and rolled back onto the employee's right foot resulting in an injury that required surgery.
An employee was walking in a hallway and went to step over a pen when his knee gave in. The employee fell and sustained a bilateral quadriceps tear.
An employee suffered a left thumb laceration/crushing injury while installing a car engine.

On February 23, 2018, at approximately 3:00 a.m., an employee climbed a 24-foot extension ladder and tied off while replacing a camera. A second employee held the ladder below. The ladder was leaned against and supported by a metal plate/wall that keeps bales of paper on the opposite side.  After completing the work, the employee was on his way down the ladder when a bale of paper struck the opposite side of the metal plate. The deflection of the metal jarred the ladder, and the employee fell 4 to 5 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering a compound fracture to the left wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee climbed onto a trailer to attempt to close the door. The door strap was wrapped on the handle. The employee slipped and fell off the trailer approximately four feet to the ground fracturing the lumbar spine, left arm and pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder reaching for a box on a top shelf when she lost balance, fell backwards, and landed on her backside, striking her head on the concrete floor. She was hospitalized.
After welding a trailer, an employee stood up and the blow torch engaged toward his right hand resulting in third degree burns to his thumb and forefingers.
An employee received second degree burns to both feet after walking through a containment of hot (190 degrees) beet juice from a process disruption.

An employee was cleaning around a folding machine and lost his balance. As he went to catch himself he grabbed the safety bar. His hand slipped and went into the roller on the machine and was crushed.

An employee was standing on a catwalk bridge, attempting to clean the inside of a kiln, when the employee fell approximately 30 feet off the catwalk and contacted debris and material inside the kiln. The employee suffered head trauma, a broken shoulder, broken ribs, and a broken pelvis, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving a filled sand pot (4.5 feet tall, 3-foot diameter cylinder with wheels and a handle) into the building when the pot became caught on the door threshold and fell on his ankle, crushing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to remove part of a broken board from the planer machine and made contact with the cutting head. The employee's right hand thumb, index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was assaulted by a resident at a residential group home, suffering bites to the leg, finger, and head; a swollen eye; rib injuries; and a shoulder injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a piece of plastic (bag tie) and fell to the ground, fracturing her hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was setting up a three-stand mill machine. As he placed his right hand on the block, his left hand pressed the jog forward button instead of the tension off button, causing the block to rotate counterclockwise and amputate his right middle and ring fingertips. The jog button was unguarded at the time.
An employee was working when a fire occurred on the floor below her. She was potentially exposed to inhalants related to the fire and suffered an asthma attack, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing large magnets from a piece of equipment and placing them in a box. When the employee placed a magnet over another magnet, the magnets were attracted to each other and suddenly came together amputating the right index fingertip and cutting the middle finger.
An employee got his right hand caught in the blade of the upcut saw and sustained an amputation above the knuckle to the ring finger and cuts to the middle and pinkie fingers.
An employee heard a sound that caused them to turn and their left index finger came in contact with a saw blade causing an amputation to the knuckle.

An employee was operating a crane when his hand was caught between the lifting beam attached to the crane and the support structure of a bar-feeding piece of equipment. He suffered a right pinky finger laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell to the same level while trying to use the first step on a scaffold access ladder. The employee hit and injured their ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing up a fixed ladder to a roof hatch. When transitioning from the top of the ladder to the roof, he fell through the hatch about 15-20 feet to the ground.

An employee changing out a belt on a trimmer was struck by the machine's door when it disengaged from the position in which it was propped, causing injury to the employee's left hand requiring surgery.

An employee was 5-6 steps up a 12' orchard-style ladder when the ladder shifted on a patch of black ice. The employee lost balance and fell, becoming entangled in the ladder, and struck his head against the pavement during the fall resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was attempting to clear a machine jam when his right middle finger was caught between the machine's belt and pulley, requiring hospitalization. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was working when a pallet of celery and boxes of radishes fell on him, injuring his left hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was directing the loading of a truck trailer and fell off the truck approximately 12 feet to the ground, injuring his back.
On 2/23/2018, an employee slipped and fell off a loading dock fracturing his hip.
An employee was struck by a forklift in the breakdown area injuring both lower legs and a left toe.

An employee suffered a finger laceration that resulted in amputation of the left middle finger while cutting a piece of wood using a table saw. The wood kicked back causing the finger to make contact with the saw blade.
An employee tripped on a recycling box and broke her ankle.
An employee was unloading a roll of steel with a crane when the roll moved and hit the employee's leg, breaking it below the knee. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's left foot was struck by a reversing powered industrial truck, suffering fractures and lacerations to the toes.

An employee was cleaning the meat room when he picked up a meat poly board to carry to the sink. The board was too heavy, and he lost his balance and fell to the floor, fracturing his hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unjamming a cardboard compactor with a metal rod. The compactor pulled the metal rod in and the employee's hand was caught in the compactor, resulting in partial amputation of the ring finger on the left hand.

A team on the rig floor was attempting to rig down a cement head with a manifold assembly from the rig floor down the slide to the ground below. A winch line was being used to lift the cement head off the rig floor to allow the team members to push the head to the slide. The head was pushed out beyond the slide, but the manifold caught on the rig floor and the head swung back toward the floor and struck the swing gate. An employee was holding the swing gate open with his right hand and was struck on the pinky finger. The distal interphalangeal joint was partially amputated.
An employee slipped while attempting to move/adjust a dock plate from the ground. The employee's back struck a truck's safety bar, fracturing vertebrae and requiring hospitalization.
A 5,000-pound spreader bar rolled from its position on top of a pad eye and landed on an employee's right foot, crushing it.
An employee was exiting the building when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground. He felt a snap in his right leg and was hospitalized for a leg injury requiring surgery.

Two employees were removing a 4-foot long piece of 14-inch diameter ventilation duct work, which supported a second piece of 10- to 11-foot long duct work. When the employees removed the 4-foot long piece, the 10 to 11-foot long piece fell and struck one of the employees, who suffered abdominal and intestinal injuries, a head contusion, and a fractured hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to his working area and stopped to help a co-worker to flip the hatch cover weighing 80-90 pounds. The employee's right foot slipped and he lost his balance. The plate fell and smashed the employee's left ring and middle fingers. The ring finger had a laceration on the tip and the middle finger was amputated.
An employee experienced an asthma attack after being exposed to perfume or floor stripping chemicals, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working with a Kelly swivel to move pipe joints on the rig floor. His coverall became wrapped into a rotating joint and the employee sustained a fracture to the left forearm.
An employee was removing material from a bow rack using bolt cutters. When the wire was cut, the material fell down onto the employee's right foot, resulting in the amputation of two toes.

An employee was setting a packer on a flatbed trailer to connect and thread the pipe when the employee's hand slipped and the pipe fell on it, trapping a finger between the pipe and the edge of the trailer. The employee sustained a right ring finger amputation.
An employee slipped on newly waxed floors, resulting in hospitalization for a ruptured MCL.
An employee was bending to lift a pan that had fallen on the kitchen floor. The employee fell and fractured her hip.
An employee was stocking milk. As he lifted a case of milk he felt sharp pain and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized due to a tear in the abdominal aorta.
On 02/23/2018, an employee was working on the tee at a machine and putting a wire on it when she stepped on the foot pedal. The machine then came down and amputated her left index fingertip.
An employee reached into a tube with his right hand and his middle finger came in contact with the auger on the pre-dust machine resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee experienced stomach pains while transferring boxes from a pallet to a conveyor, requiring hospitalization and surgery for a hernia.
An employee was attempting to unclog hot (250 to 270 degrees) grease from a pipe when the grease caused second degree burns to the employee's shoulder and first degree burns to the arm.

On February 25, 2018, an employee was operating a standup forklift and was following another standup forklift. When the first forklift slowed at an intersection, the injured employee's forklift collided with the first forklift. The forklift tine entered the operator's station and struck the injured employee's right foot resulting in a fracture requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while crossing a road intersection to get to another post.
An employee was washing dishes when a spider bit his hand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a cart caddy to pull a semi-trailer into the paint booth. The employee was walking backwards and backed up against the bumper of the semi-trailer ahead of him in the paint booth. The cart caddy continued to move towards the employee and struck the employee in the lower leg fracturing the tibia and fibula.
An employee was working on the winder section of a line when the employee's left index fingertip was pinched between the ejector and a roll of product, resulting in an amputation.
