On February 25, 2018, an employee was cooking breakfast for a client. She had walked away from the stove and when she turned she found the skillet was smoking. When she grabbed the hot pan, grease spilled onto her hand and arm, causing second and third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder when he slipped and fell to the floor, breaking his femur.
After operating a deli slicer, an employee turned and slipped on lunchmeat that was on the floor. The employee suffered left tibia and fibula fractures, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when the employee's leg was crushed between the pallet jack and an aisle. The employee suffered a fractured ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder retrieving new brake pads for a customer from a storage self when he fell off the ladder, breaking his left ankle and shoulder.

While conducting rig-up operations, two employees were carrying a 2-inch joint of iron piping when the first employee dropped the joint on the second employee's finger. His right middle finger was crushed between the falling pipe and piping that was on the ground, resulting in an amputation.
An employee tripped over a stationary object and landed on his right knee and hip. He was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was cutting meat on a meat saw when the employee's hand slipped. The saw then partially amputated the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was operating a skid steer over rough terrain when he hit a culvert, which jerked the skid steer. The abrupt motion caused him to hit his head against the rear window of the cab, fracturing his skull and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing electrical conduit wrapped around a scaffold bracket when his finger was pinched between the conduit and scaffolding, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was trying to free up a belt wheel on an auto bailer that was stuck when the machine engaged. His right glove was pulled into the wheel, and his right index fingertip was amputated by the machine.
An employee was moving a crane into place to pick up a girder when the hook hit the girder, causing it to fall and hit the employee's right arm.

An employee was climbing a ladder at the job site. When he was approximately 4 feet up, the ladder slipped out from under him. He fell off the ladder and his arm was caught on a window sill, forcing his arm upward and causing his left shoulder to become dislocated.
An employee was placing material on a machine to be cut. When the employee actuated the clamp via the foot pedal, the clamp pinched the employee's left thumb, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee fell while descending a ladder, breaking a femur and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to load a BOP component on a tractor trailer when the tractor trailer operator started to move the truck. The employee jumped off the trailer to avoid being struck by the BOP and struck the ground, breaking the right knee.

An employee was checking the belt tension on a machine when the employee's right-hand fingers were caught in the belt and pulley's nip point. The employee's right index finger had to be medically amputated. The machine had not come to a full stop at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a magnetic drill press to drill holes into a C-channel. The employee was trying to hold the press in place with a strap, which was wrapped around the employee's left hand and became caught in the drill. The strap then crushed the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation above the knuckle.

An employee was operating a pallet jack in a warehouse with a wet floor when the pallet jack lost traction and slid into a concrete barrier. The employee's left foot was caught between the pallet jack and the barrier, resulting in a laceration and swelling to the foot.
A piece of concrete fell from a device and pinned an employee against a steel beam. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a bed roller when the operator started the machine. The employee's gloved hand became caught in the bed roller's chain, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting a frame using a straight cut saw when she moved her hand and the saw partially amputated her left thumb.
An employee was standing on a chair to change out a ceiling tile when he fell to the floor, breaking his left wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting an approximately 5-inch pipe with a powered hand saw while standing on a ladder. The pipe came loose and struck the ladder and the employee knocking the employee to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right elbow.
An employee walked into a wooden crate on a telehandler to dispose of trash/debris and fell 12 feet to a lower level. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a possible punctured lung.
An employee was troubleshooting equipment when the employee's right arm was caught and fractured between the equipment. The equipment was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was bending a 1/2-inch thick piece of stainless steel on a mechanical press when the steel broke and flew through the air, striking and lacerating his right cheek.
An employee was checking on the pull belt function of a bag maker machine when the employee's left middle finger was caught in the machine's belt and pulley, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was attempting to remove food that was stuck in a scallion machine when her left hand contacted the blade, amputating her pointer, middle, index, and pinky fingers. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was working on a conveyor belt when he slipped and fell into a molten lead pot, suffering burns to both feet/legs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove a stuck turret roller when a left-hand fingertip was caught and amputated on the turret roller.

An employee was in the back of a tractor trailer moving an empty pallet when he lost balance and fell from the back of the trailer to the ground, landing on his left side. He fractured his left wrist and left ankle.
An employee was unloading her car in the parking lot when she fell to the ground and fractured her left hip.
An employee was cutting blocks on an up-cut saw when his foot struck the pedal and activated the blade, which then amputated his left ring finger.

An employee was working on a horizontal mixer, evacuating the kettle into a receiving hopper. He saw a piece of cheese at the end of the hopper and attempted to remove it. His hand then became lodged within the turning auger, and his middle finger was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee working at the front counter attempted to stop a robbery and was stabbed with a knife.
An employee was pulling steel cables when one of the cables under tension broke loose and injured both of the employee's hands.
An employee was walking to her desk when she tripped to the floor, breaking her left arm.

The employee was operating a company-owned pickup truck and was backing up to a customer's loading dock when the truck struck the dock. The employee struck their face on the cab of the truck fracturing their jaw.
An employee was participating in training when he experienced sharp pain in his shoulders and upper body, requiring hospitalization for a muscle injury.
An employee broke his leg while involved in an intervention with a high school age student and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped while climbing an exterior fixed ladder, fell approximately 14 feet to the ground, and suffered a fractured heel bone, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was spraying paint with an airless sprayer (3,000 psi) when the spray stream struck his left middle finger, breaking the skin and injecting paint into his finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was transporting a patient on a stretcher when the stretcher collapsed, pinching the employee's fingertip and resulting in an amputation.

On February 27, 2018, at approximately 7:00 a.m., an employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor line when his fingers were caught between a pulley and belt, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking backward toward a jet bridge as it moved in his direction. The jet bridge and the tire then rolled on top of his left foot, fracturing it.
A employee sustained a laceration to the top of the left hand while washing out the hopper area of a mixer truck.

An employee was hooking up the hydraulic and electrical lines from a trailer to a semi-truck when the employee lost balance on the semi sidestep and fell face-first to the ground. The employee suffered internal bleeding and was hospitalized.
An employee was closing the door on his loader when his left thumb was caught between the vertical frame and the door. His left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was struck by another vehicle while driving an aerial lift, suffering rib, hip, and leg fractures.

An employee was working near a press while a coworker was replacing a chain. As the coworker was manually pulling on the chain, the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the sprocket and the chain, resulting in a partial amputation of her right pinky finger.

An employee was running board tiles through conveyor rollers of the sander when a board became jammed. As he attempted to remove the board, his right hand was caught and pulled into the hold-down rolls, suffering tissue damage above the wrist.

An employee was cutting a metal strap on a raw material pallet using a box knife when a piece of the metal strap struck the employee's eye, causing an eye orbital rupture. Safety glasses were worn at the time.
An employee was boarding a vessel through the aft shipping hatch when the 1,500-pound hatch inadvertently closed, striking the employee. The employee suffered back and neck contusions.
A crew was performing hydrostatic testing to a recently installed steel gas service. The injured employee was turning off the valve when it blew out, striking the employee in the face.
A maintenance employee accessed a cooling tower from a fixed ladder. While descending the fixed ladder, the employee fell approximately 6 feet to the roof surface, fracturing the right leg.

An employee was using a loader to unload coal from a vessel when the loader bucket contacted the bucket system moving the coal out of the vessel. The bucket system then lifted the loader, throwing the employee to the deck of the vessel. The employee suffered shoulder and head injuries, requiring hospitalization. A seat belt was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was standing in front of a 24" steel casing while an adjoining 24" steel casing was being moved. The employee was then crushed between the two casings, suffering a laceration to the lower part of the right leg.

An employee was operating a horizontal lathe to polish a metal part when the part being turned came loose. The employee tried to catch the piece and it slammed his right hand into the machine. He suffered a laceration and multiple broken metacarpals, requiring hospitalization.
On February 27, 2018, an employee was using a bench grinder when the employee's right hand was pulled into the grinding wheel, amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was using an industrial snake when his hand came in contact with the cable.

An employee was dry blasting garnet media from a step ladder. As he went to step down a rung, he stepped on the hose, angled the blasting gun down toward his leg, and blasted his thigh. He suffered a right leg media intrusion and required hospitalization.

Three employees were moving a large tire from the bed of one pickup truck to another. The trucks were backed up to each other with the tailgates down. As the tire was being rolled from one truck to the other, it caught on the lip of the tailgate and started to fall. At this time, the injured employee was either knocked over or fell over and his hip struck the tailgate. He suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was walking by the fryers when he slipped and fell, suffering burns on his right hand and wrist.

While installing sheet metal decking to the second floor of a three-story commercial storage unit being built, an employee fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor below and landed on sheet metal siding, suffering fractured vertebrae.
An employee was attempting to sit in a chair when the chair slipped out from underneath him, causing him to fall to the floor and fracture a femur.
An employee's right ring finger was amputated while pipe fitting.

An employee was placing a belt back on the track when the machine cycled and caught the employee's right index finger between the side of the pulley and the stationary table top resulting in amputation above the first knuckle. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee lost balance and fell to the ground while climbing a ladder, suffering a broken hip.
An employee suffered a ruptured hernia while staging boxes for shipment.
While inflating a tire, an employee was struck by the tire or a piece of the rim, suffering a forehead laceration and orbital eye fracture.

An employee was pinned between a stationary truck and a moving truck while at the loading dock at a customer's location. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a lacerated liver, soft tissue bruising to the legs and abdominal bruising.
An employee was cutting pipe with a band saw when his middle finger contacted the blade, amputating his fingertip.
An employee's right hand was caught inside a heated core machine while she was removing the cores from the box, suffering burns.

An employee was traveling west on a forklift through a warehouse when he impacted another forklift traveling east. The impact was a glancing left front to left front. The injured employee continued to travel and impacted a parked electric pallet jack about 20 feet away. The employee suffered a fractured left femur that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was carrying mark up mail to the CFS station, tripped on the edge of a pallet on the work room floor and fell striking their head and nose on the floor. The employee sustained contusions and bruising to the forehead and nose.
An employee was checking the odometer in a straight truck when she fell out of the truck to the floor. She suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on an actuator when an air fitting came out of the valve, causing the actuator to come down on the employee's right index finger. The employee suffered an amputation of the right index finger between the first and second knuckles.

An employee was changing the tooling in a trimmer. As he turned a wrench to loosen the bolt holding the trim blade, his elbow hit the cycle button, activating the machine while his hand was  inside. His right pinky and ring fingers had to be fully amputated at the hospital, and he had stitches in his middle finger. The machine was not locked out or turned off at the time of the incident.
While untangling a metal coil that was caught on a stand, an employee fell approximately 36" from a small work platform to the ground, suffering a fractured hip and pelvic injuries.
An employee turned and fell resulting in a chipped pelvis.

An employee was reinstalling an atomizer header pipe when the tack welds failed, causing the pipe to fall approximately 4.5 feet and strike the employee in the lower right leg, fracturing it above the right knee and ankle.
An employee was operating a saw to cut an alloy steel bar when he attempted to pull a piece out from the saw. The saw blade then cut his finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was talking with his supervisor when he tripped over a drum dolly and fell, breaking his hip.
An employee was letting down a car lift when his left index finger was caught between the lift lever and the lift, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was using a die tool to remove a die blade when his left pinky finger was caught between the tool and the blade, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was breaking out a second employee at the banding station area. A unit of plywood came into the banding station and was automatically strapped but failed to completely clear the banding area of the machine. The first employee walked over and was using his left hand to push the unit out of the strapper when his left foot contacted an electronic eye that controls the sequencing of the bander and triggered the machine. The top bar of the strapping machine then lowered onto his left hand, pinning it to the unit of plywood and breaking the bones behind the knuckles on his ring, middle, and index fingers. He was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting at a desk inside a dealership near the showroom window when a car drove through the showroom glass and pinned the employee against the wall. The employee suffered severe lacerations and glass embedded in both forearms, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was setting up the side matcher machine when the top head engaged and his hand was crushed, amputating part of the index and middle fingers.
An employee was loading a reel using take-up equipment when the equipment amputated the employee's right pinky finger. The equipment was not guarded at the time.

The injured employee was assisting with material offload. His hand was above the two part block line on the crane. Two employees were disconnecting the rig. When the rigger gave the signal to raise the crane hook, the injured employee's hand became caught within the hook mechanism resulting in amputation of the right middle and ring fingers.

Two employees were installing freight car side doors and were having trouble fitting them. A pin securing it in place was removed and it fell on both employees. The first employee suffered multiple fractures to the body and was hospitalized. The second employee suffered a laceration to the leg.

An employee was sliding an 11/64 thick sheet of steel off stationary rollers to an adjoining table. With his left hand positioned under the sheet and his left ring finger slightly through a hole cut in the sheet, he quickly and forcefully pulled and then pushed the sheet to the table. His left hand came in contact with the table edge, stopping and the sheet continued over the fingertip removing the tip of the finger and the top portion of the nail.

An employee was holding a 10-inch diameter, 90-degree acid line pipe, while his coworker was using a 4-inch cutting wheel to cut the 90-degree portion of the pipe. After the final cut, a 6-inch pipe came out from the inside of the 10-inch pipe and fell on the employee's knee, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken leg, possible shoulder injury, and chest pains after being struck-by a high-lift forklift.
An employee was troubleshooting the outfeed line of the weathered board system and suffered a left thumb tip amputation when he contacted an unguarded chain drive and sprocket.
An employee lost balance while talking to a customer and fell to the ground, suffering a hip injury.
An employee was operating a tube bender machine to bend copper piping when she attempted to adjust a mis-feed. The machine then clamped down on her left index finger, amputating her fingertip.

An employee was cleaning between the pipe roller stands in a prep rack when a pop-up roller was activated and lowered. The employee's arm was caught between the roller stops, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working upstairs in the bourbon barrel finishing department. Barrels are transported from a lower floor up an incline to a chain conveyor in the bourbon barrel finish department. When barrel supply was interrupted, the employee placed his hand on the chain conveyor to lean over and look down the line. The line started and his fingertip, extending down against the chain, was caught in a chain and sprocket. The incident resulted in medical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was walking to a control gate to retrieve an inmate for transport. The employee's hand was in the fencing of the sliding steel control gate. When the gate opened, it severed the employee's right pinky fingertip.

On 2/26/2018 an employee tripped over a curb and fell resulting in a left arm fracture that required surgery and hospitalization. The employee also sustained severe bruising to the left side of the head and body.

An employee was unloading a flatbed trailer attached to a semi-truck. The employee was on the load while a PIT operator was trying to adjust the load that had shifted. A steel plate broke from its binding and sliced into the employee's left leg just above the ankle, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee sustained a finger amputation while climbing a powered industrial vehicle.

An employee was dismounting from the step of a mixer truck when he lost balance and placed his hand on the pedestal that supports the barrel roller. When the mixing barrel came around, it caught his glove and pulled his right pinky finger into the barrel, amputating his fingertip.

An employee was walking on the sidewalk, tripped over the rain gutter and fell resulting in fractures to his right shoulder, forearm and wrist. The employee also sustained a rib fracture and bleeding from the mouth.
On 2/28/2018, an employee was helping an operator manually load a laser machine with metal material when the material struck and injured the employee's head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing trim around a window using a nail gun when he lowered the nail gun and it went off, shooting a nail into his leg.

An employee was unjamming a box on a packing line from the mezzanine catwalk above the line. The employee stood up after unjamming the box and was struck by an overhead ceiling fan blade. The force of the strike caused the employee to land on the conveyor belt, which was locked/tagged out. The employee sustained a severe head injury, requiring staples.
While climbing the steps of an RV, an employee tripped and fell to the shop floor, fracturing the right wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The employee was backing up the forklift and backed into an open machine enclosure gate. The back of the employee's left leg struck the gate resulting in a crushing injury and two lacerations.
A temporary employee was manipulating a roll bar when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught between the roll bar and a wall.
While washing a truck in a wash bay, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the pavement, suffering four broken right-side ribs, as well as chest and arm contusions.

Employees had cut out the concrete slab foundation inside a building that was being remodeled and were placing a sewer line in a 2' deep trench. The injured employee was walking towards the exit when the roof of the structure collapsed, striking and injuring the employee. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of a fractured collar bone and a sprained knee.

An employee fell from a ladder while attempting to remove a spike cylinder that needed repair. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury with internal bleeding and a fracture of the C7 vertebra.

An employee was in a back room using a nutrition cart that had a three step ladder attached to it. She was obtaining product from a shelf when she fell backwards off the step ladder, landing on concrete and fracturing her left knee.
An employee was driving a company personal transport vehicle when it hit a curb. The employee was thrown from the vehicle and hit the ground, breaking the left arm.
An employee was repairing a fire door when the track or door system struck his right foot, resulting in an amputation to the right little toe.

An employee was using a jump saw to cut lumber for dock decking. The employee was adjusting the board and pushed the foot pedal to engage the blade, which then cut off the employee's left index and middle fingertips. The employee's index finger had to be surgically amputated to the middle joint, and the middle finger was surgically amputated to the first joint. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a forklift to move cargo from one warehouse to another. A second employee was assisting with the cargo as the first employee was removing a lock. The first employee's right index finger was then caught between the cargo and the lock, resulting in an amputation at the second joint.
An employee was standing beside a tractor trailer when the 960-pound steel bundle that was being unload fell and struck the employee, breaking the left tibia and fibula and the right occipital bone.

An employee had dismounted his vehicle to make a delivery and was returning to his postal vehicle to continue his route. He was walking down a paved walkway with a slight incline. The pavement was wet due to rainy weather. He slipped and fell, landing on his knee and breaking his kneecap in two places. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on the interior of a building and leaning out the window to weather proof the flange when the employee slipped and fell 14 feet to the ground. The employee punctured a lung and broke the upper left arm, clavicle, upper chest bone, six left-side ribs, and lower back.

An employee was disassembling a dull extruder machine when the machine's plate crushed the employee's left ring and middle fingers, fracturing one and crushing the bone in the other. Both fingers had to be surgically amputated above the first knuckle.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder approximately 3 to 4 feet off the ground, attempting to install a porch ceiling soffit, when the ladder and employee tumbled to the ground. The employee's leg was pinned in a rung of the ladder, fracturing the tibia and fibula. The ladder was placed on loose fill rock at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a saw to cut a board. He was adjusting the board when he hit the pedal to lower the saw. The saw came down on his hand and amputated his right middle and index fingertips.

On March 1, 2018, an employee was repairing a tank engine and revving it manually near an exposed turbo air inlet fan blade. The employee's right hand then came into contact with the rotating fan blade, amputating the index and middle fingers. The air intake was unguarded at the time of the incident.

On March 1, 2018, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was entering the break room, which had a newly surfaced floor, when she slipped and fell, fracturing her hip and requiring hospitalization. Her boots were wet at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped while running a lathe and his shirt was caught in the workhead, pulling him into the machine.
An employee was untangling a crimped hydraulic line and hydraulic fluid was injected into the employee's hand.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor when his right arm was fractured in the conveyor rollers.
An employee tripped and fell into a metal racking system, suffering possible broken hands and two severe cuts on the forehead.
An employee was preparing for a training course and developed symptoms of heat stress and a muscle injury.
An employee was using a miter (chop) saw to cut tubing when the saw guard became stuck on the tubing. As she attempted to dislodge the guard, the saw severely cut her left middle and ring fingers.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet to a lower level while cleaning equipment, suffering a back injury.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder putting away a mannequin on a shelf when he lost his footing and fell to the floor, suffering a broken tooth, hairline fracture of his left wrist, and sprained right wrist.
An employee was on an order picker 3.5 feet high, retrieving a windshield from a rack, when a stack of glass windshields struck him. He fell to the concrete floor and injured his nose.
An employee was delivering packages when he lost footing while going down some steps. He tried to catch himself by grabbing onto the stair rail and injured the two middle fingers on his left hand.

An employee was preparing a cleaning solution for a weekly scheduled cleaning when two incompatible solutions were mixed, exposing the employee to chemical vapors. The employee experienced difficulty breathing.

An employee was cutting meat with a center-cut saw when the saw did not cut through the meat. He reached for the meat to tear it off and his left thumb hit the saw blade, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee leaned half of an extension ladder against the side of a power unit and started to climb up while two other employees held the sides of the ladder. When he extended his hand to receive a nozzle from one of the other employees, the ladder slipped out from underneath him. He fell approximately 4 to 5 feet and hit the ground, breaking his ankle.
An employee was moving a pallet jack when the employee's ankle was pinned and fractured between a rack system and the pallet jack.

An employee was hoisting a large part off of a paint rack. The part shifted as it was pulled off the rack using a chain and sling. The employee's finger was caught between the part and the cart resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was using a knife to cut bacon and sustained an amputation injury to the left index finger.
An employee was rolling pipe when his right index finger was pinched between two pipes, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was helping to lay down pipes on a work-over rig's pipe wrangler when a pipe jumped out of the wrangler and struck his side, breaking four ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was mopping the floor in the gas station when she slipped on a wet spot and fell, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was moving a sheetrock dolly with dense glass down a small plywood ramp that bridged a concrete curb to the next level (approximately 8 inches high) when the dolly tipped over and fell on the employee, fracturing his right leg between the knee and calf area.

An employee was using a hydraulic jack to lift a truck and change a flat tire. The jack slipped, catching the employee's right index finger between the bead of the tire and the wheel. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell approximately 36" from a ladder while installing flashing on ductwork, fracturing the left hip and left wrist.
An employee was operating a jointer when the blade amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip to the first knuckle.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while cleaning a conveyor. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a hernia while unloading 25 pounds of material from a truck and onto a forklift.
An employee was using a belt sander to sharpen a rod when his hand was caught between the sander and the table, resulting in an amputation to his left middle finger's first digit.

An employee was holding a handheld drill in one hand and using his other hand to place a bit in the drill when it unexpectedly energized. The glove he was wearing twisted around the drill and his left fourth fingertip was amputated. His fifth finger sustained a laceration that required stitches.
While changing a light fixture from a 12-foot step ladder, an employee fell to the ground, suffering a fractured pelvis.

On March 2, 2018, two employees were using a tractor and hay chopping machine to place bedding in calf hutches. The first employee was behind the tractor when the second employee lost sight of him and backed the tractor over his left foot. He suffered left foot fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was manually feeding bags into a machine when his left index finger was caught and partially amputated between the machine's belt and sprocket.

A crew was rigging down when a weight bucket became hung up while the derrick was being scoped in. One of the employees pulled on the cable, causing the climbing assist weight to come loose and descend toward him. As a result, he let go of the line and was struck by the weight. He suffered a right arm fracture, broken ribs, and lacerations to his left gallbladder and kidney.

An employee was cutting into an excavated PVC waterline with a pipe saw when the PVC pipe shattered under pressure. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the forearm and cheekbone and lacerations to the face and neck.
An employee was changing the air can on a crane swing drum when the drum turned and caught the employee's right hand between it and a beam bracket. The bracket runs across the drum.
An employee was checking the radiator fan of a vehicle after the fan was replaced when the fan blades amputated his left index finger.
An employee was removing a roll of material from a digital printer when the roll bar/shaft amputated the employee's left index finger to the first knuckle.

An employee tripped over a ladder that was placed in the bed of a truck and 
lost his balance. He then jumped off the truck bed to the ground and broke his right heel.

An employee was loading material onto a metal catwalk when a forklift hit the catwalk, causing it to fall off the dunnage supporting it and onto the employee's foot. His foot was crushed and required hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to transfer boxes from one building to another. Strong gusts of wind blew the boxes over, and the employee reached to grab the plastic wrapping that held the boxes together. The wind continued to pull the boxes and twisted the wrapping around his index fingertip, severing it.

An employee was punching holes in business cards using an electric, foot-operated, three-hole punch. When she cycled the machine, the clamps descended and closed on her right little finger. She lost her fingernail and fractured a bone in her fingertip.
An employee was stepping off a truck while holding a tire in each hand when the employee slipped on snow and fell to the ground, breaking the collarbone.
A tree branch fell on an employee during inclement weather, injuring his leg.
An employee was adjusting a trailer hitch when it fell on his right foot, breaking his pinky toe. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was flagging a forklift operator while he picked up a pipe rack to be moved. The pipe rack fell from the forks of the forklift and landed on the employee's feet, crushing both.
On 03/02/2018, an employee was restraining a patient when the patient struck the employee's rib area, lacerating the liver.
An employee was working on a chicken processing line and cleaning chicken from a motor box when his gloved hand was pulled into a gear shaft, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On March 2, 2018, at 6:05 a.m., an employee was welding or grinding to install table slats on a plasma cutting table when an explosion occurred, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee suffered thermal burns and fractured arms, legs, and ribs.
An employee was walking to a company truck when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.

An employee was moving a cart that contained metal strapping when the cart tipped over and the employee's pinky finger was pinched between the cart and a workstation. The employee suffered trauma to the finger and required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell from a flatbed trailer while making a delivery, suffering head and rib injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to remove a bushing from a fabricated piece of steel. The weld failed on the bushing extraction device and struck the employee in the forehead. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to the bones in the forehead, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was lacing up the line with paper when he lost his balance and fell to the floor, breaking his foot and ankle. He required surgery.
An employee was attempting to cut horns off a carcass at a horn removal machine when the machine activated and amputated two of the employee's fingers.

An employee was servicing a customer's propane tank at the customer's residence. The employee reached down to pick up a tool and was bitten by a copperhead snake. The employee received anti-venom and had an adverse reaction to the anti-venom, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling cable down on a swing stage to roll it up when the cable touched a crosswalk pole and meter pole, causing an electric arc that shocked him. He was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished sheathing a roof and was exiting it. He slid off a wall walker scaffold to get into a window, but his tool belt was caught on something, causing him to be pulled out of the window and fall 12 to 15 feet to the ground below. He fractured his leg.
An employee was preparing for a confined space entry and got stuck between two pieces of process equipment resulting in a broken shoulder, lacerations and facial bruising.
An employee was working at the front register. When she turned around, she tripped and fell on her back resulting in four fractured ribs.
An employee was attempting to unjam a piece of meat from a meat tenderizer machine when two of the employee's right middle fingers were pulled into the tenderizer and crushed.
An employee used a step ladder to enter the ceiling of a building and then fell through the ceiling, striking his head on the floor below. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to perform maintenance on a machine's gears when the chain drive partially amputated two of the employee's fingers. The machine was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a balancing machine to balance tires when a wheel fell and the employee's hand was caught between the wheel and balancing machine. The employee suffered a finger amputation.

An employee was helping to offload a three-bar while a second employee went to get a walkie forklift. The employee was grabbing some dunnage when the second employee passed and brushed the dunnage, which then pressed the employee s right knee between the dunnage and a pole. The employee suffered a fractured right knee.

An employee was moving boxcars on a rail line in a plant when his jacket pocket was caught on a boxcar. He was then dragged approximately 20 yards over a pile of 4x4's and into a concrete post, injuring his left hip area.
An employee was watching the wrench. When the wrench moved, the employee's hand was caught resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
On March 3, 2018, an employee struggled to open a trailer door and suffered a hernia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were installing a metal panel ceiling. As they flipped the panel over, it slipped from the injured employee's hand and lacerated his wrist, slashing the artery. He required sutures and hospitalization.
An employee was securing a load onto a flatbed truck when an empty pallet fell off the truck and struck his neck, fracturing his vertebrae and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking beneath a ladder to get some towels when he hit his head on the ladder, suffering a contusion and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was accessing a ladder. The ladder kicked out and the employee fell breaking an ankle.

An employee was conducting a metal detector portal security check and was directing a guest to go through the detector when she tripped on a floor mat that was covering power cables to the portal. She fell and fractured her left wrist.

On March 3, 2018, an employee was going to his vehicle when he was struck in the eye by shattered plexiglass light globe debris during a wind storm. He suffered face and eye lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee broke an ankle while working in the lumber facility, requiring hospitalization.

Employee was back-filling a trench with a skid loader when the skid loader fell forward into the trench and flipped over onto an H-pile beam. The employee was trapped inside the flipped skid loader, breaking a leg and arm and dislocating a thumb.
An employee experienced difficulty breathing, coughing, and an allergic reaction after being exposed to isolating material in an elevator's machine room. He was hospitalized.
An employee was checking residents when she slipped on water and fell, injuring her right hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was feeding material into a machine and amputated two fingertips with bone loss in the gear system. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee tripped and fell on uneven concrete, breaking her left wrist and scratching her head.

An employee and his colleagues were relocating a dough extruder with a forklift. While they were placing the extruder on a rolling platform, the extruder tipped and fell on the employee, who suffered a lower back contusion.
An employee was unloading a warehouse truck. While backing out, he tripped over another pallet and fell. His foot/leg was pinned between two pallets resulting in an internal injury to a vein.
An employee was helping to trim the nails of a large dog when it bit the employee's arm, breaking the skin.

An employee was inspecting his equipment to make sure all safety equipment was in place and properly operating. He was moving a flex lance to another tube when the dump valve was engaged. High-pressure water from the flex lance tip released and cut his left hand.
An employee was pushing a toboggan when she strained her back, requiring hospitalization for a bulging disc.
An employee was using a meat saw to cut pork neck bones when the employee's left index finger contacted the saw blade, suffering an avulsion or amputation.
An employee fell on the sidewalk while walking and broke a femur, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was pushing a plastic ice cart when the cart wheel hit a rut, causing it to stop. The employee's forward momentum caused her to then fall onto the cart, striking her head and finger. She suffered a fracture to a right-hand finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was loosening a plug on a union. The pipe wrench fell and the employee lost his balance causing him to step awkwardly and break a leg.
An employee was shutting the door to an armored truck when the door struck and lacerated his right pinky fingertip, which had to be amputated.

An employee and three other coworkers were setting a wall panel down on the floor. As the wall was lowered, the employee's finger was caught between the wall and his steel-toed boot. He sustained a traumatic amputation of the tuft of the left third digit.
An employee was applying grease to the sprocket of a traffic roller when his right ring fingertip was caught and amputated in the chain of the sprocket.
An employee was cleaning a machine when his glove was caught in the machine, which then pulled his hand in and amputated his index and middle fingertips.
A temporary employee slipped and fell while walking on loose rock at a construction site, breaking his left ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to catch a closing steel door when the employee's left middle finger was pinched between the door and the doorframe, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was placing barricades into a row of other barricades when his left ring finger was pinched between two barricades, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck by a truck while walking across a lot early in the morning, suffering a lower leg laceration. A high-visibility vest was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was turning a walkie forklift when he pulled out in front of a hi-rise lift that was approaching the end of the aisle. The hi-rise was unable to stop and pinned his right lower leg against the walkie, breaking his tibia.
An employee was loading bags onto a plane when she felt discomfort in her back due to a spider fracture.
An employee was using chemical paint remover in the basement area when a heater's pilot light ignited the fumes. The employee was hospitalized for smoke inhalation.

Employees were using a crane to put a spud in a barge. When an employee attempted to unhook the crane, the crane cable became caught and the block of the crane swung back and caught the employee's hand between the block and the spud. The employee's middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

An employee was transferring a 54' pipe that weighed 12,000 pounds with an airlift cart when the pipe rolled off the cart to the ground. As he attempted to stop it from striking another employee, he was struck by the pipe resulting in a pelvic fracture.
An employee was standing on a billboard catwalk and preparing to install a billboard vinyl when the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs, bruises, and scrapes.
An employee was moving a single-person lift into an elevator when the lift tipped over and struck the employee's left foot, breaking four bones.

An employee was dry mopping and sweeping a pedestrian aisle near a packing line when she slipped and fell on the floor, injuring her head and back and suffering a possible concussion. She was hospitalized.
An employee was being trained by a second employee on how to close a golf cart tailgate when the second employee closed the tail gate on the employee's left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was operating a heat shrink cutter and amputated a fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was pushing meat down a rail system when a beef carcass fell off its hooks and fractured the employee's ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting copper wire on a shear when the blade amputated his right pinky finger. The shear was not guarded at the time.
An employee was spotting a dozer truck when it ran over the employee's legs, breaking the thighs and legs.
An employee fell to the ground while skiing, fracturing the right and left femurs.

An employee shut down a saw and was attempting to grab something from the machine when the blade cut his left-hand palm, requiring surgery. The blade had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing natural gas lines above a drop ceiling when the platform he was standing on gave way. He fell through the ceiling to the concrete floor approximately 25 feet below, suffering internal organ damage.

An employee was on site collecting trash from a dumpster. The enclosure gate for the dumpster had drop pegs that normally hold, but 70 mph winds overtook the gate and slammed it against the dumpster while the employee's hand was in the way. The employee sustained broken bones, a dislocation, and vascular injuries to the right hand.
An employee was installing duct work from the fourth rung of an 8-foot ladder when it slipped out from under him and he fell to the floor, breaking vertebrae.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while walking, fracturing her left wrist and requiring surgery.
An employee was moving a cart full of streetlight poles and got his finger pinned between the poles resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a table saw when the blade amputated one whole finger and part of another finger. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was using a forklift and a crate to raise himself to dismantle a grain drying system when the crate became unstable and he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. He fractured his leg and three vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was connecting jumper cables to a truck when he slipped off the tire of the truck and fell on his arm, fracturing it.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to move product in the warehouse. During the process, he stepped off the pallet jack and it struck his left foot, causing a laceration and fracture.
An employee was troubleshooting auxiliary (clinch nut) equipment inside a robotic cell when it activated and pinched the employee's left index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working on the press floor changing a die. The spacer under the die slipped and the die amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was working near the end of a gin/conveyor in the press/bagging area and caught an arm in the conveyor roller resulting in injury to the upper arm.

An employee was attempting to remove a grinding blade on a 4" grinder. He lifted the grinder and put it under his right arm to help him grip the tool. While grabbing the blade with his left hand and applying pressure, he inadvertently flipped the safety switch with the underside of his arm. The trigger then activated, causing the blade to move and suck his glove between the guard of the grinder. The blade then cut into his left index fingertip.
On March 6, 2018, an employee was walking down five stairs when she missed the last step and fell onto her left knee, fracturing her leg and requiring surgery.
An employee was standing on a 39-inch platform and inspecting a rocket launcher that was on the back of a truck when the platform tilted and the employee fell to the ground, fracturing a leg.
An employee was struck in the head by a fitting that fell when a contractor was working overhead, requiring hospitalization for a concussion.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut vinyl and contacted the saw blade lacerating all four fingers on the right hand. The index finger was amputated.
An employee was loading an aircraft. As he stepped from the aircraft to the deck loader, he fell 10 to 12 feet to the ground, lacerating his face and breaking his pelvis.

An employee was on top of a sand box container preparing to close the lid when a strong gust of wind blew him off the container to the ground. He fractured his elbow, hip, and ribs; punctured a lung; and suffered some scrapes and bruises.

An employee was in an aerial lift preparing to install mechanical rigging onto a new power line when the fourth and fifth fingers of the employee's right hand were pinched and crushed between the aerial lift basket rail and the cross arm of the power line structure.
An employee was changing a tire on a vehicle when the jack fell, allowing the vehicle to descend on and break the employee's pelvis.

An employee was standing on a lift wearing his harness to remove a section of duct work. He took the bolts off from around the section of duct work and then lowered the lift. The section of duct work was supposed to lower with the lift, but when he looked back, he noticed that the duct work was not coming down. At this time, he used his upper body, shoulder area to loosen the section. The duct work then fell and pinned him underneath it. He suffered a lumbar fracture.

After refueling and boarding a bus, an employee placed items into her purse, which was on top of the first seat of the bus, and decided to exit the bus to visually confirm that the fuel cap was secure. As she turned and made her way to the stairway, her right foot caught the corner of the cushioned partition that blocks the first seat from the stairway, causing her body to twist while simultaneously falling. She fractured her right ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was moving an electric motor on a shelving unit when the motor began to roll. The employee tried to stop the motor from rolling by placing a wedge under the motor and got his finger caught between the motor and the shelving unit resulting in amputation of an index finger.

An employee was on a step ladder using a hammer drill to drill concrete when the employee fell approximately 6 feet to the cement ground, suffering skull fractures, bleeding from the ear, and fractured ribs.
An employee was trying to wind up plastic on a packaging machine when the employee's right hand was caught in an 18-inch sprocket, resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee was descending a two-step stool when she missed the bottom step and fell to the ground, striking and fracturing her knee on the floor. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while exiting an elevator, striking his head on the wall in front of him. He broke his neck and suffered paralysis, requiring hospitalization.
On March 6, 2018, an employee slipped and fell on snow/ice in the parking lot, breaking his right femur and requiring hospitalization.

An employee had finished working on a truck and went to let the jack down. The jack was all the way down but the tires were still off the ground. He jacked the truck back up and put a wood block under one side's tires and the old axle seats under the other side's tire. He then let the jack down again, but the truck still was not all the way down. He jacked the truck back up and slid one of the frame stands back under the rear frame section. He then put his left hand under the stand to push the tube up to the frame to pin the tube with his right hand. Before he got the pin in the tube, the truck came off the jack and fell onto the stand tube, catching and crushing his hand between the truck frame and the jack stand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling stock with an electric pallet jack when his right leg was crushed between the jack and a rack, breaking his leg and requiring surgery.
An employee was helping another employee move a transmission when he lost his balance and fell, allowing the transmission to fall on his lower left leg. His left tibia and ankle broke.

An employee was performing a quality check on incoming materials on a machine's feed line. A nearby forklift operator was attempting to lift a two-tiered stack of cardboard for loading into the machine when the top tier fell on the employee. The employee's right leg broke in several places, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was sitting on a thermoforming machine's exit tray when it collapsed and she fell to the floor, breaking her ankle.

An employee was removing unwanted film material from a machine when he flipped a small piece of the material with his finger. His right index finger was then caught in the belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The belt and pulley were unguarded at the time.
An employee was unhitching a trailer when his left pinky finger was caught between the chain and the hitch. As he pulled his hand out, his left pinky fingertip was severed.
An employee was walking on tube steel at ground level when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his left leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a wire draw machine when the employee's glove was caught in the machine, which then pulled the employee's hand into the machine. The wire pressed the employee's right index finger against the plate, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was unloading cargo containers off an airplane when an airline shipping container began to roll off the platform. As he attempted to stop it, the container struck his right arm and pinned it against another container. His right arm broke, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had been operating a sweeper truck and wanted to enter another room. To access the room, he had to move some bagged materials. He climbed to the top of the 7-foot stack of materials, stood up, and fell backwards onto the concrete floor. He fractured his tailbone and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving material with an overhead crane when the crane released and dropped the material on the employee's foot causing injury.
An employee was operating a forklift and trying to avoid a pallet in an aisle when the employee struck a rack system, injuring a foot.
An employee was loading a pallet onto a forklift when the pallet fell down and struck his left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was operating an extrusion machine when his left hand was caught on a chrome roll in an in-running nip point. Three fingers were amputated.
An employee was moving a panel switch to the open position on a 480-volt motor control center breaker when an electrical arc flash occurred, burning the employee's eyes, face, neck, and hands.

An employee was part of a crew rigging a vertical tank to be lifted by a crane. His gloved right hand was holding a 1.5-inch wire rope choker (sling) when it slipped and his right pinky finger was impacted by a nearby pipe barrier. His finger broke and was lacerated above the first joint, resulting in an amputation above the first joint.

An employee was descending the ladder of a scaffold when he stepped off the ladder too early. Attempting to catch himself, he grabbed for the ladder and his ring was caught, tearing the skin on his left ring finger. His finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was placing an extension on a hand-operated drill when his hand was caught and pulled into the drill bit, amputating his left pinky finger.
An employee was on a ladder installing a flag pole when the employee fell to the ground, suffering right side, face, rib, wrist, and shoulder injuries.
An employee was attempting to stop a steel load from swinging when the employee's left middle finger was smashed and partially amputated between two steel loads.

An employee was teaching a new employee how to operate a guillotine when the alignment of a product roll inside the guillotine needed to be fixed. The employee was attempting to grab the roll when the controls were activated. The guillotine then came down on the employee s left hand, amputating the pinky, ring, middle, and index fingers. The guillotine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was struck by a pallet that was struck by a powered industrial truck, breaking an ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was hanging on a long line from a helicopter, clipping in travels on the arms of a transmission mono pole, when the helicopter maneuvered the employee into a three-phase distribution line. The employee suffered an electrical shock to the hip and buttocks, and later required amputation of the left arm from the elbow.
An employee was dismounting from the front fender of a powered industrial truck when the truck ran over and fractured the employee's lower leg.

An employee was working at a press when the employee took a ladle coated in molten aluminum and dipped it in water. The ladle then popped/exploded, sending flying molten metal in multiple directions. The metal burned the employee's head, neck, back, and hand.
An employee was unloading a trailer when he stepped back and had his foot run over by a skid steer.

An employee was up on an I-beam, tied off to set a long span joist on the wide flange beam. As the joist was coming up into position, it got close to his foot. He moved his foot, lost his balance, and fell off the beam. The retractable caught him, bounced once, and swung toward the building. The bottom flange of the I-beam then severed the retractable and the employee fell approximately 10 feet onto the sand/concrete floor. He fractured his left wrist and was hospitalized.

An employee was replacing shingles and roofing paper on a residential home when he tripped on the roofing paper and fell about 15 to 20 feet through a skylight cutout hole to the concrete floor. He injured his head and fractured his nose, cheekbones, neck, and right arm.

Two employees were un-spooling a wire rope when it became snagged on a flange. When it came loose, it caught one of the employees and spun him around the reel. He hit a (powered off and protected) saw and then the ground, suffering a concussion and bruise on the brain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning around a saw and struck their thumb against the saw blade resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee had just loaded a truck with dry ice when the lift gate closed and pinched the employee's finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

While loading vehicles onto a multi-car hauler trailer, an employee fell from the top of the 10-foot trailer to the ground, breaking several ribs and suffering a serious head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to run to the inside of a pickup truck that had accidentally been placed in reverse instead of park when the employee was pinned between two vehicles, suffering broken ribs and a fractured left shoulder.

An employee was climbing out of a box truck when his feet became tangled, causing him to fall approximately 4 feet to the ground. He struck his head on the concrete, fracturing his skull and left wrist and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lining up the casting for trimming on a pneumatic press when the machine activated and severed his distal phalanx, requiring hospitalization.

An employee applied methyl ethyl ketone (MEK) to a metal washer and was attempting to weld the part when an explosion occurred. The pressure from the explosion released the washer, which struck the employee in the shoulder and the side of his face.
An employee delivering at a customer store fell and fractured his pelvis.

An employee was pulling a cart of glass windows to be loaded onto a truck when he backed up to a pillar and his left hand was caught and lacerated between the cart's handle and a fire extinguisher. He was hospitalized.

An employee was jogging a cylinder cart onto the lift gate of a service truck when he lost his balance and his right leg was caught by the cart, leaving him hanging upside down. He managed to pull himself back up and fell from the lift gate (3.5 to 4 feet high) to the ground below, fracturing his left tibia.
An employee was using a tire machine when the tire dismounting arm struck the employee s right middle finger, partially amputating the first joint.
An employee was installing a ground rod, slipped and fell impaling himself on the ground rod. The rod entered his left thigh.
An employee was using a wrench to remove a filling from a transformer when he felt something pop in his right arm.

An employee was repairing a well. He was connecting a polish rod to a rod string and stuffing box. The box was 3 inches above a pipe wrench that was on the polish rod. The employee's hand was on the pipe wrench when the stuffing box slipped down onto his left index finger, crushing it and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was inspecting the attic of a home when she fell through the garage ceiling to the concrete floor below, breaking her femur.
An employee was walking down outdoor stairs when he slipped on ice and fell down 8 to 10 steps, fracturing his back and bruising ribs. He was hospitalized.

On March 7, 2018, an employee stepped off a forklift and went near the forks to take inventory. While she was near the load and forks, another forklift struck her forklift, which caused it to strike her chest. She suffered a collapsed lung.
An employee fell 15 feet from a roof when his lanyard broke and fractured his knee.
An employee was running a large CNC lathe machine when the employee's hand was pinched between the moving pallet and a fixed point on the machine, partially amputating the right middle finger.

An employee was surveying joints and concrete inside a construction zone about 5 feet away from the safety cones when a pickup truck with a trailer hit him. He suffered a broken left leg, concussion, and laceration to his lower back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was mowing grass when he crashed into another mower. The other mower's blade cut and partially amputated his right heel.

An employee was cutting insulation on a large diameter wire to repair an amusement ride when the knife slipped out and deeply lacerated his left wrist just above the leather work gloves he was wearing.

An employee was guiding a mobile office unit to the correct location when the employee's left index finger was pinched and smashed between a cement curb and the unit, resulting in an amputation from mid-joint.

An employee was installing a gas service/main and was in a trench standing on the gas main to push it down. His hand was on the lip of the excavation while an excavator operator was moving a road plate several inches. The operator put the road plate down, catching and breaking the employee's thumb between the excavation lip and the road plate.

An employee was trying to escape a construction fire while working on the third floor. He was climbing on the exterior of the building to get to the fire department's ladder when he lost his grip and fell to the ground, breaking his legs and ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking up an exterior staircase, fracturing his leg and requiring hospitalization.

On March 7, 2018, at approximately 4:15 a.m., an employee was operating the press brake and completed the first bend. As he was performing the second bend his left thumb was pinched in the part between the two bends amputating the tip of the thumb.

An employee was trimming trees in a scissor lift and attempted to pass a pole saw down to the injured employee. The cord holding the blade guard let loose and the guard snapped on the injured employee's right index finger, partially amputating it.
An employee was moving an arcade machine when his middle finger was caught between the control panel door and edge, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was hooking up two bundles to an overhead hoist when the operator raised the hoist, pulling up slack in the chain. The employee's thumb was then pinched and fractured between the chain and the bundle.
An employee was walking to her car in the parking lot when she tripped on a stone and fell to the ground, fracturing her right wrist. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was moving cows from one pen to another when a cow hit him in the leg. His leg became swollen and his leg/knee tendons were injured, requiring surgery.
An employee was welding tube steel above his head when a spark entered his coat and caught it on fire. He received second and third degree burns to his left arm from his elbow to his fingers.
An employee was reaching into equipment and caught the left thumb between the metal pulley and the rubber pulley belt resulting in amputation at the first joint.

An employee was using a board hook to try to pull a crate out of a trailer, but it did not latch onto the crate. The employee pulled and fell backwards out of the trailer to the ground, fracturing a wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when he encountered another PIV that was blocking his path. When he attempted to move the other PIV, it struck him, breaking his leg and ankle.
An employee was in an aerial lift when the building fell. A steel beam struck the employee, who suffered back and lung injuries.

While retrieving parts from a shelf, an employee operating a cherry picker fell approximately 15 feet to the lower level, suffering a concussion and neck, arm, and leg injuries. A harness was not worn at the time.
An employee slipped and fell down steps, potentially fracturing his patella and sustaining tendon injuries.

An employee and co-driver prepared to pull a trailer to a dock door. Before pulling this trailer, the employee went to make sure that the trailer's door was closed. The employee ducked under to check and leaned into the adjacent bay, which was empty at the time.  Then, another driver backed a 53-foot long trailer into the previously empty adjacent bay and did not see the employee.  The employee was struck by the trailer, resulting in two broken clavicles, which required hospitalization.

An employee was in the process of installing a metal curb on a roof for placement of HVAC. He was kneeling and reached his hand over a floor hole cover. The floor hole cover gave way and the employee fell 18 feet. The employee suffered skull fractures as well as a broken pelvis and femur.
An employee was walking in the facility yard when a boom lift ran over him, breaking his left leg and dislocating his right leg.

Employees were attempting to move a crate of six granite slabs (weighing approximately 800 pounds each) from the back of a trailer using a chain. One end of the chain was tied to the mast of a forklift and the other wrapped around the bottom of the crate. Before they pulled the crate from the trailer, a strap that was holding the slabs broke, allowing the slabs to fall onto the injured employee, who broke both legs.
An employee lacerated his finger while working, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was reaching to grab an air freshener container for the office bathroom when an easel began to fall toward her. As she turned to catch the easel, she twisted her ankle and fell against a supply closet cart, knocking it against the shelving as she fell to the floor. She fractured her tibia and fibula.
While stacking granite, an employee became pinned between a slab and a block of granite, breaking two ribs.

An employee was moving a steel column onto a cart when the bar used to transport the column slipped, causing the column to fall onto the cart and then strike the employee's left foot. The employee's foot broke and suffered lacerations.

An employee was welding a vessel and put his hand down in a pre-cut hole to roll the vessel. His hand was then caught in a pinch point between the wheel roller and vessel, severely cutting his left index finger, which had to be surgically amputated at the distal interphalangeal joint.
An employee was conducting a presentation when she stood up and fell, fracturing her hip.
An employee was walking away from a bus when she missed the step at the curb and fell to the ground. She fractured her right elbow and the radial bone of her left wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a 220-volt breaker when an arc flash occurred, resulting in third degree burns over much of his body.
An employee collapsed at their workstation during normal operations (stacking) and went into cardiac arrest.

An employee was inserting a power spreader beneath a feed truck while replacing the crossbar of the vehicle. As he attempted to place the tool in the proper position, the coupler on the tool failed and discharged the adapter, striking him in the face. He sustained a laceration on his face and a skull fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing chute extensions to a cement mixer truck when his left index finger was pinched between the first and second extension, amputating his fingertip.

An employee had accessed a snow-covered roof to set up roof anchors for a solar panel installation job. While he was clearing snow from the roof edge, he fell 18 feet to the ground below, suffering cracked ribs and a hairline fracture to his hip/pelvis.

A crew had completed drilling a 4.5' diameter shaft for a micro-pile installation and were placing thread bar reinforcement into the drilled shaft. Two employees used pipe wrenches to hold the bar and lower it into the shaft. The first employee was holding his wrench approximately 6' above the ground and the second employee was holding his at waist height when he lost his grip on the wrench. The full weight of the bar fell on the injured employee's wrench, which pulled his wrench and hand down to the ground. His right middle fingertip was pinched between the bottom of his pipe wrench and the ground, resulting in a partial amputation to the distal phalanx.

On 3/08/2018, at approximately 12:45, two employees were transferring material from one roll to another. Employee 2 pressed the jog button to advance the rolls while employee 1's hand was sitting on the fabric. Employee 1's left ring finger was then caught between the fabric and the roll or the rubber, suffering a laceration that required surgical amputation of the fingertip.

On March 8, 2018, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee got out of a front load garbage truck, closed a dumpster enclosure, and slipped and fell on ice in the area around the enclosure. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
On March 8, 2018, at approximately 11:00 AM, while picking up trash at a restaurant, an employee slipped and fell onto ice, fracturing a hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending down a flight of steps located in front of a residence when he tripped and fell, damaging the ligaments and tendons in his knee and leg.
An employee was trying to push a piece of meat out of a press when it cycled, amputating parts of his four right fingers.

An employee was standing on an aluminum extension ladder while removing house siding at approximately 10 to 12 feet above ground when the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured collarbone and rib, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sorting construction and demolition materials on a pick station conveyor when he saw a plastic band that had fallen off the pick belt near the head pulley of the conveyor. He grabbed the band and was attempting to free it when the plastic band wrapped around his glove and right hand, breaking his thumb and index finger and cutting his thumb/hand. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was on a flatbed truck moving steel dunnage for a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) to unload when the PIV operator came forward unexpectedly and the steel shifted, catching the employee's right ring finger. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee was removing a 3-feet by 5-feet AC wood platform while on a 6-foot A-frame ladder when the weight of the platform shifted and knocked him off balance, causing his left leg to be caught between the ladder's rungs as he fell about 4 feet to the floor. He suffered a compound fracture to his left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing telecommunication lines and fell off a ladder resulting in a concussion.

An employee entered a customer's attic and was attempting to place rodent traps when he miss-stepped and fell, breaking through the ceiling. He broke his tibia and fibula and tore a tendon in his left leg.
An employee was walking in a parking garage when an automobile started approaching. The employee went to step back behind a protection barrier and fell to the concrete ground, breaking a femur.

An employee was under a truck using an impact wrench to remove the first of two bolts located on the carrier bearing of a driveline. When he removed the first bolt, he noticed the second bolt was stripped, but still needed to be removed to successfully remove the entire driveline. As he tried to remove the second bolt, the driveline shifted toward him in a downward motion, causing him to react and catch the driveline with both his hands and feet. He then asked a coworker to help remove the second bolt. Once his coworker removed the nut and bolt, the driveline became loose and fell on his right elbow, smashing it to the concrete and causing a fracture.

An employee was troubleshooting a lift gate to identify why it was not working and had no power when the gate closed on and pinched the employee's left index finger, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee has just set his truck up for tree trimming and climbed the steps of the ladder to enter the basket. He noticed he didn't have gloves on so he asked another employee to toss the gloves to him. As he attempted to catch the gloves, he lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet, 5 inches to the ground, breaking his right tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing scaffolding when he attempted to hand a kick board up to the next level. He then lost his footing and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, fracturing his wrist and vertebra.
An employee was on the second step coming down from a ladder when he lost his balance and fell into a shelf on his left side. He was hospitalized with broken ribs.

An employee was running a pointer machine when he attempted to manually move a steel tube from the index table into the bunk. His left pinky finger was then smashed between the index table and the tube, requiring a surgical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a trash chute where it opened into a dumpster. The employee climbed into the dumpster and was removing material from around the bottom of the chute when he stepped backwards and fell over the edge of the dumpster, landing on the ground head first. He suffered head trauma, a fractured neck, and broken ribs.
An employee was attempting to reset a circuit breaker when the breaker box exploded, causing second degree burns to his left arm and hand. He also received first degree burns to his face.
An employee was closing the door to the paint room when it closed on the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was performing a plug draw operation on a tube when his finger became stuck between the tube and a wood fixture, removing skin from his hand and finger.
While walking into the laundry room, an employee suffered respiratory and eye irritation from airborne fumes caused by a pan being soaked in deliming chemicals.
An employee was struck by a truck that was reversing to hook up a trailer, suffering back and hip injuries.
An employee was operating a double pallet jack to unload a trailer when his foot struck a stationary pallet, breaking his right ankle.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground while walking, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was reaching for an item while standing on a ladder in the bakery freezer when she lost her balance and fell, breaking her left ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell after mopping the floor, fracturing the right hip.
An employee was getting tools out of a toolbox drawer when the drawer closed on the employee's right pinky finger. The fingertip had to be medically amputated.

An employee was installing an inflatable blow plug into a 30-inch ADS pipe when it ruptured as he was pumping air into it, knocking him unconscious inside the catch basin. He suffered a concussion and lacerations to his upper lip and left ear, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting to find a squeaking noise beneath a conveyor in the shipping area. He was tapping on a bad bearing when his right hand was pulled into the rollers and frames. He suffered a hand fracture and was hospitalized. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was cutting a metal beam when the beam shaft fell on his left thumb, requiring a partial surgical amputation.
An employee slipped on snow and fell to the pavement while walking into the building, breaking a thumb and hip.

An employee was adjusting tempering rollers and cleaning belts on equipment when the employee's glove was pulled into the pulley, resulting in an amputation of the right pinky finger. The equipment was running at the time.
An employee was bleeding down the well in the process of plugging an abandoned well when the valve blew apart resulting in a lower left leg fracture.

An employee was testing a customer's telephone line and walking back to his work truck, which was parked on the road about 50 feet away. As he walked down the steep gravel driveway, he slipped on snow and landed on his left foot, rolling his ankle and breaking his left fibula and tibia.
An employee was moving a dumpster from inside an apartment to the outside when he stumbled and his ankle was pinned between the curb and the dumpster. He suffered a broken left ankle.

An employee was working on an overhead door while standing on a 10-foot rolling stair unit with a wheel locking mechanism.  A reversing forklift ran into the rolling stairs, which were knocked over, and the employee fell 10 feet to the ground. He broke his right elbow and his right hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
