Employees were replacing the double block-and-bleed valve on an aircraft fuel check-out stand when one employee's finger became caught between the pipeline valve and the stationary pipe. The injured employee was wearing leather gloves. The left middle finger was de-gloved and later received a partial medical amputation.
An employee was attempting to clean a doctor's blade on a laminating machine when the blade partially amputated his right middle and pinky fingers.
On or about March 9, 2018, an employee was cleaning out pipes in a trench when the trench caved in. The employee was hospitalized with a pelvic fracture and two broken ribs.

An employee was getting ready to light the hydrogen exiting the exhaust port on the end cap at a quartz tube furnace when the tube exploded. He received a severe laceration to his upper left arm and was hospitalized.

On 3/09/2018, an employee was descending a fixed ladder after performing air conditioner work on a roof when the employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, fracturing a vertebra and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was shoveling snow, went on a break and collapsed from a possible heart attack after returning from the break.
An employee was cleaning a guest room when a dog charged at her and she jumped on the bed. She then fell off the bed, dislocating/fracturing her elbow and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pushing a chair across the floor when the chair was caught on a rubber transition strip. The chair and employee then fell to the floor. She fractured her shoulder.

On 03/09/2018, an employee was installing AC vents on the second floor of a residential house under construction. He opened a door to an elevator shaft and subsequently fell to the first floor, injuring his head and requiring surgery.

An employee was releasing 9,500 PSI pressure by surging a 2-inch 1502 iron bleed-off line when the bleed-off iron shifted and struck his right leg, fracturing his foot and ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On March 10, 2018, at approximately 2:45 a.m., a temporary employee (injured employee) was assisting another employee operating the carpet separator. The injured employee's right hand entered an unguarded area of the rotary lock system resulting in amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was taking samples and reading gauges when the sight glass blew out on a flake caustic line. The blow-out caused lacerations to the employee's arm, face, and chest and chemical burns to his face and right hand.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. A different employee had backed his lift out of a trailer and left the forks slightly raised. The employee on the electric pallet jack ran into the raised forks, striking his right leg and catching it between his pallet jack and the raised forklift forks. He suffered a compound fracture to his right leg.
An employee was delivering clothing to patients when the employee's knee gave out.  The employee fell to the floor and broke the right femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing a die mold when the employee's finger was amputated just below the fingernail line.
An employee was working on a scaffold when the scaffold fell. The employee impacted the lower surface, suffering whiplash and a concussion that required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to change a blade on a knife straightener when the blade amputated half of the first digit on the employee's right hand. The knife straightener was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating an ATV in dusty, dark conditions when he ran into a pipe. He was thrown from the ATV and hit his head, cracking his skull and fracturing the orbital bones around his eye. A seat belt was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped on a desk and fell to the concrete floor, breaking her hip.
An employee was turning a piece of stainless steel sheet metal when the corner of the sheet metal contacted and cut his right wrist.
An employee was prepping food when she had an allergic reaction and experienced difficulty breathing, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to unjam material from a bag sealer when a moving part amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee walking in the "pre-soak" area slipped on ice and fractured his left leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting a lint cleaner machine when his left arm was caught and severely crushed by the rollers.
An employee was de-rigging a metal pipe while standing on a roof when the pipe touched an overhead power line. The employee then suffered serious electrical burns.

A generator was being replaced on a drilling rig. The 3700 pound generator was lifted and held with a chain attached and carried by an all terrain forklift. While the injured employee was pushing the generator with two other employees, the chain holding the generator slid from the forks of the all terrain forklift and fell backwards onto the employees. The injured employee sustained rib fractures.

An employee was placing bags on the belt loader at an airport ramp when his jacket sleeve was sucked in by the running belt on the belt loader. He attempted to remove his sleeve with his other hand and was caught by the belt, which removed skin and damaged the tendons on his left hand.

A temporary employee was cleaning the discharge chute on a seed cleaner when his hand came into contact with the moving chain, lacerating his right index and middle fingers and fracturing his index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to take containers off the back of an aircraft when he fell off a ladder and broke his wrist, requiring surgery.
Two employees were involved in a physical altercation at the work site. One employee suffered a broken nose and was hospitalized.

An employee was rolling a non-mag drill collar on a paint rack when the collar started rolling toward him. He tried to stop the collar with a rag and the collar rolled over his right hand, resulting in a right thumb amputation.
An employee was replacing a submersible well pump and pulling out a pipe when a wire that was connected to the pipe wrapped around and amputated his left pointer finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was teaching a beginner skier how to get off the chairlift. While unloading off the lift, the beginner skier and the employee became tangled up. The employee then fell on the ground and fractured his hip.
Two employees turned at the same time and stepped on each other's feet. One of the employees then fell to the ground and injured her knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On March 12, 2018, an employee was installing roof decking on an addition to a school. The employee was in the process of landing the leading edge of the steel decking when they stepped on an unsecured piece of decking material causing it to shift. The employee fell 14.8 feet to the ground below and fractured both hips.
An employee was closing a vehicle door when the door closed on his right hand, amputating his ring finger.
An employee exited his vehicle and was standing in the median when he stepped backwards and tripped on the curb. He fell to the ground and broke his left humerus.

An employee was trying to grab a box overhead while on a step ladder when he lost his footing and the step ladder tipped over. He fell to the concrete floor, lacerating both elbows and breaking his left elbow. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a dozer when he was thrown out of the seat and into the roof of the dozer, fracturing his neck. A seat belt was not worn at the time.
An employee was feeding stock into a punch press when he lost his footing and his hand entered the press as it cycled, amputating four fingers.

While walking in an area where hot water was on the ground (approximately 1 inch deep), an employee tripped and landed in the water, sustaining second and third degree burns to the hands, knees, forearms, and hip.

An employee was using an outrigger for balance while he used his foot to clear snow from the area where the outrigger foot would sit. While the employee's hand was on the outrigger, the outrigger activated. The employee's right index finger that was inside a pin hole when it moved resulting in amputation.

An employee was walking by some crates/boxes that were stacked in the yard when a huge wind gust blew one of the top crates off the stack. The crate struck his head, left shoulder, and left rib cage area and knocked him to the ground. He suffered broken ribs, a mild concussion, and a bleeding spleen, requiring hospitalization.
An employee 's hand was pulled into the in-running rollers on a cold press gluing machine while she was cleaning it, causing significant skin abrasions.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a discharge conveyor belt when another employee activated the machine. The employee was then thrown into the moving conveyor, breaking several ribs. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was filling a water trough when he was run over by a cow, dislocating his elbow.
An employee slipped on a substance on the floor and fell, hitting his back and head. He became nauseous and vomited, and he was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was pinned between a customer's truck and an alignment rack, suffering four fractured ribs, multiple bruises of the body, and a hematoma to the liver. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing sampling in the pulp mill area when the employee slipped on a puddle of water and fell to the ground, dislocating a shoulder and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell on black ice while walking into the building, breaking a femur.

On March 12, 2018, an employee was stuffing metal liners into media packs and placing them on a conveyor line when the employee attempted to adjust an element that was on the conveyor. The employee's left middle fingertip was then pinched between the end of the element and a step crossing over the conveyor, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was mixing acrylic purge with a mixer when the mixer drum tipped. He attempted to catch the drum and stand it back up. While he was standing it back up, his left thumb was crushed between the mixer drum and the stand, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee fell while dismounting his truck and struck his head on the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using his hands to pull out one roll of underlayment roofing material from a middle pallet (in a stack of three) when the middle and top pallets fell down and knocked him on the floor. He fractured a foot and femur, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering a client to an airport terminal when he fell and hit his head on the ground or curb, suffering head trauma.
An employee delivering mail was attacked by a dog and knocked down. The employee sustained an injury to the right ear.
An employee was examining a standpipe that had been disconnected when a standpipe valve struck and cut the employee above the eye.
An employee was loading new tire tread in a press when the employee's right gloved hand was caught between the roller and conveyor, injuring the right arm.
An employee was using a bender machine to bend a short pipe when his right hand was caught in the equipment, amputating one of his fingertips.

Two employees were breaking a seal between the pulverizer and the pyrite seal box using a prybar. Once the seal was broken, a five-inch gap was left between the two. The injured employee's left hand was in the gap between the pulverizer and the seal box. As they slid the box, it dropped three inches off the shims and onto the injured employee's left hand resulting in an open fracture and amputation of the pinky fingertip.
An employee was walking into a housing unit when the metal door shut on and crushed the fourth digit of the employee's left hand, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee's thumb was smashed in a press machine.
An employee was flying to a training and fell down an escalator at the airport, breaking three ribs and lacerating a knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward an oxygen cylinder to adjust the regulator when an oxygen hose burst and ignited, burning the employee's right forearm.
An employee was on the lid table to help wrap chain around a tank, lost balance and fell approximately three feet through an opening in the lid table striking their head.

An employee was removing a roll shaft from an expired roll of paper. The employee put the other end of the roll shaft into the new roll to use the weight to free the old core. When the core came free, the shaft going into the roll pinched the employee's finger between the core and the roll shaft, resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, striking a metal garbage can and injuring his rib cage.
An employee was attempting to turn a standup tractor, but the tractor kept going straight, causing the employee to tumble and fracture a leg.
On March 12, 2018, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was walking to the break room when a turret truck ran over the employee's left foot, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting a piece of board with a table saw when the wood kicked back and he came in contact with the blade. His hand was severely lacerated, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation at the hospital. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was working inside a trench approximately 3 feet deep. An excavator was working above him when the weight of the excavator caused one of the trench walls to fall, pushing the rebar cage into the employee and striking his abdomen. He was hospitalized with abdominal bleeding.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while walking from one building to another, suffering left elbow and ankle fractures, as well as a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was making a connection with a drill pipe and had a hand around the pipe when it moved into an iron roughneck. The employee's right pinky finger was caught between the iron roughneck and pipe, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was walking out of a restroom when she tripped and fell, breaking her arm and requiring hospitalization.
While prepping a bucket truck, an employee slipped and fell to the snow-covered ground. The employee's head hit the ground, suffering a skull fracture.
An employee was installing a side quest saddle tank axle bearing on a tractor when the tractor tire tipped over and struck the employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was walking down the stairs when she tripped and fell, breaking her ankle.
An employee was helping a delivery person put a 70-pound box on the ground. His foot got caught in a pallet and the employee fell to the ground resulting in a right hip fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground, suffering broken ankles and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was trying to unjam a skewed piece of wood panel from a press when the press door unexpectedly closed on his left hand, resulting in fingertip amputations to his index and ring fingers and a 1-inch amputation to his middle finger.
An employee was operating a machine when the employee's right middle finger was caught and amputated in the machine's moving parts.
An employee was assisting with grinding operations and got a hand caught in the grinding wheel resulting in a partial amputation of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was cleaning an air valve in the wash room when his finger slipped off the release button and the valve closed on his finger, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee was using a hoist to lift a basket weighing about 500 to 600 pounds when the basket fell about 36 inches onto the employee's right leg, breaking it.
An employee was using an iron worker to cut a piece of metal and partially amputated the left thumb.

An employee was cleaning the feed conditioner when his left index finger was caught in the rotary valve in the feed cyclone resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time.

An employee was moving a trailer from the blasting area to the paint shop using a hook attached to a trolley. The hook disengaged from the trailer, allowing it to fall on and break the employee's right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was machining holes into a piece of channel flange when the employee's finger was pinched and then amputated.
An employee was sanitizing equipment when a moving belt caught and crushed the employee's right hand (first three fingers). The equipment was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee fell while walking a horse. The horse then fell on top of the employee, breaking a bone in his back.

An employee was adjusting a pipe underneath a vault. His hand was close to an aluminum skid when the vault was lowered. His left index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the iron pipe and the skid.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down the icy office steps, breaking his hip.

An employee was operating a ham skinning machine when a ham became stuck on the roller skinners. The employee was attempting to pull the ham back when the skinners on the machine regained traction and pulled the ham into the machine. The employee's right index finger became caught between the ham and the skinner blade, partially amputating the fingertip.

On March 13, 2018, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was using a crane to unload a 6x6 concrete box when the crane became unbalanced and rolled over, pinning and crushing the employee's legs under the fuel tank. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off the bottom rung of a ladder while retrieving a part from a shelf, landing on a tape measurer hanging from his belt and breaking his hip.
An employee was taping a box cutter to lathes to test the thickness of force mains when the box cutter cut off his thumb tip.

An employee was adjusting the sliding support on a trailer (150 pounds) when the employee's right index finger was caught between the slide and trailer, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a forklift to load a bundle of steel plates onto a trailer that had wood timbers installed on it. He tried to reposition the timber with the forklift and then with his hand. He bumped the forklift controls and his right hand was caught, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a hand grinder when part of the grinder wheel blade came loose and struck his right eye, puncturing it and requiring hospitalization. The grinder was guarded a the time.
An employee was unjamming a log from the "kicker" when the log fell on the employee's right index finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was removing shirts from a conveyor belt when the employee's left hand became caught between the conveyor belt and guard, resulting in a partial index finger amputation.
An employee was loading a nitrogen bottle onto a cart. The bottle fell and crushed the employee's finger resulting in amputation.
An employee was trying to catch his glove, which had slipped off his hand, when his hand was caught in a conveyor. His middle finger was partially amputated.

An employee was propping a door open to sign for a mail delivery. As the employee was standing against the door, the door moved and pinched the employee's hand. The employee quickly pulled the hand away from the door, which resulted in a partial amputation to the left middle fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell, breaking a leg.

An employee was standing near a skylight on a roof while setting up equipment when a gust of wind pushed him. He then fell through a skylight approximately 18 feet to ground level below, suffering an amputation.
An employee was climbing onto a flatbed truck to retrieve materials when he hit and lacerated his head on a steel member of the parking garage, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inserting a part into a manufacturing machine when the employee's left index finger was pinched and amputated by the machine's plunger.

An employee was using a scrub pad to clean the drip tray underneath two moving rollers when the employee's right hand was pulled into the rollers, causing soft tissue damage to the right middle, ring, and pinky fingers.

An employee was attending a tag line while a forklift was lowering a steel joist to the ground when the joist fell from the forklift and struck the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs, a perforated lung, and a broken leg.
An employee was removing a piece of paper that was stuck in an offset press when the employee's finger was pinched in the rotating rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving a file cabinet and the cabinet fell back towards the employee, amputating the tip of the employee's right middle finger.

While picking an order from a ladder, an employee received an electrical shock and fell from the ladder. The employee suffered difficulty speaking, shaking, and difficulty walking, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was servicing an overhead garage door system and operated the door via remote. The door struck the ladder, causing him to fall approximately 15 feet to the floor. He fractured his left ankle.

An employee was working on a ladder, installing insulated metal panels, when he lost his balance and grabbed a metal stud to keep himself from falling. The metal lacerated his left-hand fingers, requiring stitches and hospitalization.
While working on a sterilizer, an employee opened the damper door and came into contact with steam, suffering burns to the hands and face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a scissor lift applying plastic sheeting to redecorate the walls of a shop when the employee fell 6 feet from the lift to the cement floor, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was checking for car engine noises while a second employee was moving the steering wheel when the engine lacerated the first employee's left hand.

An employee was pushing a piece of stock through a double miter saw when the stock stopped. The employee's left hand continued to move forward and went under the guard, contacting the two 12-inch saw blades. The employee's left middle and pointer fingers were amputated.

An employee finished using a vehicle-mounted boom arm/crane to load clean-out tubs and was retracting the stabilizers when he was caught between a stabilizer and the truck. The employee's spine, mid-torso, and abdomen were crushed, causing internal injuries that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was measuring the depth of a hole when the employee fell into the hole and hit the ground, suffering a broken pelvis, arm, back, and ribs.
An employee was on the ground talking to an aerial lift operator when the operator lost sight of the employee and ran over her ankle, fracturing it.

An employee was reversing a stand-up forklift when her left ankle was smashed between the forklift and a parked aerial lift. She suffered an ankle avulsion and contusion with broken skin, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a hand-powered industrial forklift jack when his left thumb was smashed and fractured between the control handle and a cooler door. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was working from the ground cutting logs with a gas-powered chain saw when the chainsaw lacerated his left foot, severing a tendon. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a right thumb amputation while changing the belt on a pulley that drives a conveyor auger.
An employee was physically beaten by a patient including having a pot of boiling water thrown at her. The employee sustained a concussion, third degree burns and facial lacerations requiring sutures.
An employee was on a ladder putting up masking for painters when he lost his balance. The ladder kicked and he fell to the ground, injuring his right wrist.
An employee fell on ice in the parking lot, breaking the left patella and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a hand drill when the drill bit broke and a chip flew into his eye. He was hospitalized. Safety glasses were worn at the time.
An employee was descending a ladder in the produce cooler when she missed the bottom rung and fell, striking her head and left knee on the floor. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on snow and ice in the company parking lot, suffering a head injury (brain bleeding).

An employee was using a rag to clean grease from the bottom roll of a laminator when a moving roll grabbed the rag and pulled the employee's fingers into the roll. The employee's right index finger had to be surgically amputated at the first joint, and the right middle finger had to be surgically amputated at the second joint. The laminator was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a die stringer machine when his right hand entered the area between the die holder and the capstan. A wire then pulled the employee's middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation. The area between the die holder and the capstan was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee slipped while walking on a scaffold. The employee was ducking under a beam and fell approximately 10 feet between the walk plank and the stock plank. The employee hit the full planked area below and then fell from there, suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was walking from a loading dock to his tractor when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, fracturing his right femur.

An employee was coming down a ladder after inspecting a roof and was four rungs from the bottom when he lost his footing and fell to the ground. He landed on his buttocks and hurt his lower back, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was trying to remove a door that was stuck in an equalizer machine when the door kicked back and struck the employee's abdomen, causing internal bleeding.
An employee reversed a standup forklift into a racking system and was caught between the lift and the rack, suffering a broken hip that required hospitalization.

An employee was taking electrical measurements from a battery interface board when it caused an arc flash. The employee suffered second degree burns to the left hand and first degree burns to the right hand.

A temporary employee was drilling holes on a sub frame while wearing gloves when the employee dropped a screw in the machine. He tried to pick up the screw with his left hand and the machine caught the glove pulling his hand into the machine amputating his left pinky fingertip.
Three employees were installing a battery cabinet when it fell over and landed on one of them. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and torn ligaments, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was dismounting from a modular scaffold that was approximately 28 inches high when he landed on the edge of his foot, which then rolled underneath him, breaking his right ankle.

An employee was loading a part onto a slotter when the part began to fall off of the holding fixture. While straightening the part out on the fixture, the employee actuated the slotter with her other hand. Her right index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the vice fixture and the part.
An employee was on a catwalk when it broke loose at the mounting points, causing the employee to fall 12 feet to the ground and suffer a shoulder injury.
An employee was manually releasing the hand brake on a trolley when his left pinky finger was pinched between the trolley and a rail, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was helping another employee lift a box when the weight shifted in the box and he felt a pinch in his back. He was hospitalized with a lower back strain.
An employee was on a ladder connecting a fire alarm conduit when the employee fell backwards off the third rung to the ground, suffering a concussion, swollen left eye, and broken ribs.
An employee was walking up a staircase when he slipped and fell, breaking a leg.
An employee slipped on a fork after leaving the dishwashing area and suffered a femur fracture in the hip/thigh area, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was mixing cleaning chemicals to clean a filter when sodium hydroxide splashed in his face, causing skin and eye irritation.
An employee was filling molds with molten lead. When he turned a valve to open it, the line split and sprayed him with the molten lead, burning his abdomen and right arm.
An employee was working on a overhead exhaust fan when his left pinky finger was caught between the belt and pulley, amputating his finger. The fan was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing a rock from a mixer when the employee's finger was caught in a pinch point in the vein feeder housing, resulting in an amputation.
An employee walked in front of an operating concrete/asphalt saw cutter. The employee's foot contacted the 36" saw blade resulting in amputation of the employee's toe.

Two employees were observing a crew post-tensioning a rod while standing on a bridge structural beam when the beam collapsed. They struck the ground, suffering fractures and lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee was getting ready to put an insert inside a distribution panel when an arc flash occurred. He sustained first, second, and third degree burns to the face, legs, arm, and stomach.
An employee was repairing a tractor tire when the tire rim failed. The employee suffered a broken arm and a hand injury.
An employee tripped over his feet while vacuuming and fell, landing on and breaking his right hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was standing in a work zone next to his sweeper truck that had just been filled with water from a water truck parked adjacent to it when a vehicle driving the wrong way entered the work zone and collided with the trucks. The employee was struck by the vehicle and/or debris from the struck vehicles and suffered a broken leg, bruises, and road rash.

While in a trench taking a material survey for the next day, an employee was struck by a 1,000-pound electrical panel and caught between the panel and trench wall. The employee sustained multiple rib fractures on both sides, as well as a lacerated liver and spleen.
An employee was surveying a building to determine the routing of fiber for a communications installation when he stepped into a ditch that was unmarked and fractured his left knee.

An employee was adjusting a dock leveler that was jammed when a third-party employee stepped on the dock plate, causing it to drop on the employee's right hand. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the right pinky and ring fingers, requiring surgery.
An employee was unloading mail from a vehicle to a cart when a gust of wind blew the cart over and caused the employee to lose her balance. She fell to the ground and broke her hip.
An employee was walking through a swinging door when her right pinky finger was caught in the door hinge, amputating her fingertip.
An employee was using a table saw when the employee's finger contacted the blade, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was preparing to dig a sump underneath a residential home while wearing personal protective equipment when he suffered from heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing maintenance on a pump. While pressure testing the pump before returning it to service, he was splashed with 93% sulfuric acid, receiving chemical burns to his thigh area and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on hot floor wax while lifting boxes, receiving third degree burns to the upper back and shoulder.

An employee was attempting to push an AC unit that was stuck on a conveyor elevator down with her foot when one of her right toes was caught between the elevator and the framework as the elevator was descending.
Two employees were cutting concrete with a power saw when they were overcome by carbon monoxide poisoning.

An employee entered a machine area to clean the concrete agitator. As the employee was cleaning the agitator, a hose caught the gate. The gate shut and the machine reset. When the machine resets, the agitator moves slowly. The employee's right foot was caught between the agitator and the base box in the machine, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The agitator was guarded and not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing packaging from a block of frozen meat when the block tipped and pinched the employee's fingertip between the block of meat and the table, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was at a meeting and received gun shot wounds.
An employee slipped on ice outdoors and broke his ankle.
A n employee was mounting a tire when it blew up, breaking the employee's arm.
An employee was at a job site and was struck by a car resulting in amputation of his left leg.
An employee fell approximately 3 feet from a scaffold ladder to the ground while climbing, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was helping to load a dump truck with construction debris when, unbeknownst to him, another employee lowered the truck's lift gate. When he attempted to walk backward out of the truck, the lift gate was no longer there to support him and he fell 3.5 feet to the lift gate below, fracturing his L1, L2, and L3 vertebrae.
An employee was walking on the path to the office, slipped on ice and fell resulting in a torn muscle in the left knee.
An employee was troubleshooting the hydraulics of a work station. He was underneath the station looking at the line when the steel station fell on him, causing head trauma.

An employee was preparing a road for asphalt paving when a nearby forklift operator put a forklift in neutral and exited the cabin. 
The forklift started to move forward and struck the employee, pinning him between it and a pile of soil. He injured his lower back and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in a snow blower when the augers amputated the employee's finger.

An employee was entering a chicken meal silo to perform a 6-month cleanout when the silo sweep arm activated while the employee was inside. The employee's lifeline became tangled in the sweep arm, and the employee was pulled into the sweep arm and auger, suffering fractures and soft tissue injuries to the left scapula and humerus.

An employee was one of several workers moving a large motor when the motor slipped and pinned the employee's foot against a wall. The employee sustained several broken bones in the left foot and ankle.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move a bundle of metal piping. As he lowered the load to the ground, the strapping came loose, allowing the piping to fall on and break his leg.

On March 15, 2018, at approximately 11:05 a.m., an employee complained of chest pains while working in the receiving department, transferring cardboard boxes that weighed 50 lbs. or less to wooden pallets. The employee was hospitalized for a possible heart attack.

An employee was troubleshooting a problem with a chemical pump. During a fracturing operation, the employee disconnected a chemical hose that was under pressure. Chemicals released and entered the employee's right eye, causing a chemical burn.

An employee was holding a nail gun as he placed plywood down to get cut. He then stepped on a rail, lost his balance, and fell. As he fell, the nail gun shot a nail into his right knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a telephone cord at the foot of a bed, injuring the right knee and leg.

An employee was attempting to open a malfunctioning locking mechanism on a hydraulic car lift when his left second finger was pinched between the mechanism and the lift frame, resulting in a distal amputation.
An employee fell on icy stairs and broke a leg.
An employee was feeding material into a press when his left hand was caught in the press clamp, partially amputating his index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a roof walking toward a ladder to get down when he stepped on a tile that broke off. He then lost his balance and fell 8 to 10 feet off the roof to the ground, breaking his arm.
An employee was using an electric router to shape rough-sawn lumber. The router engaged the employee's right wrist and forearm, causing deep lacerations to the muscle, tendons, and bone.
An employee was on a metal A-frame ladder moving conduit above a false ceiling and fell off the ladder fracturing his cheek and neck.
An employee was on a catwalk performing a clutch check. While stepping off the catwalk, the employee fell approximately 8 inches to the concrete floor, striking the right elbow and right hip.

An employee had taken all parts and tools off a steel drop table. One half of the drop table rested partially on the other half of the drop table. When the employee closed the door near the drop table pieces, the vibration caused one piece of the drop table to slide and fall onto the employee's left foot, breaking several metatarsal bones.
An employee was using a band saw to cut angle iron when their glove was caught in the saw blade resulting in amputation of the right index finger.

On 3/16/2018, at 2:49 PM, an employee was helping a second employee move a large plastic part. The second employee was holding a knife at the time. The first employee's left wrist contacted the knife, severing an artery. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two employees were inspecting an electrical cabinet after pulling new cable into a 6.9 KV lift pump breaker cubicle when an arc flash occurred. The first employee suffered burns on the face, chest, and arms. The second employee suffered burns on the face, but mostly on the arms and hands. Both were hospitalized.
An employee fell off a scaffold and suffered a head injury.
An employee was assisting a patient when she tripped over an extension cord from a surgical compression device and fractured her hip, requiring hospitalization.
While participating in running exercises, an employee suffered a shin splint, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a saw when it amputated his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was working in a walk-in freezer when a powered industrial truck hit and dragged him against an upright beam. He suffered a contusion to his lower back and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove a part from a press when the die cycled on the employee's left hand, severely cutting two fingers and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a stand-up reach truck while pulling products (order) from a racking system. As he reversed the stand-up reach truck, his left forearm was caught between a metal storage rack and the body of the reach truck, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a paint machine when the pistons became stuck, so he applied lubricant oil to make them come loose. He was cleaning near the piston by hand when the piston suddenly came loose and caught the his right index fingertip, amputating it.
An employee picking product in warehouse when another employee's pallet jack rolled back and hit the employee. The employee suffered a right ankle fracture.
The injured employee was removing chicken cages from the truck using a forklift when the truck pulled away causing the forklift to tip over breaking the employee's left leg.

An employee was trying to move a 500-pound mold for a vertical hydraulic press when the mold slipped and fell. As he tried to catch it, the mold crushed his left hand, resulting in the amputation of his left index fingertip and possibly middle fingertip.
An employee was working behind a fork truck when the truck's rear right tire struck the employee's left leg, breaking two bones.

An employee was pumping water down tubing to get mud back to a frac tank. When the pump pressured up, the inner rubber of the hose came apart, plugging the hose and causing it to blow out of the tank. The hose then struck the employee's wrist and chest.

While shoveling concrete debris into the bucket of a mini-excavator, an employee was pinned between the bucket and an existing pier face. The employee sustained a leg injury with lacerations and possibly broken bone(s).

An employee was standing by a frame machine (pulls automotive body and frames) while his co-worker was operating it when the machine's hydraulic tower (8-foot, L-shaped machine part) came off and hit the employee's right upper arm, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam from the blow molding machine and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was prepping window frames from an extension ladder when the ladder slipped from the wall. The employee then fell 6 to 8 feet to the ground, fracturing the left elbow and pelvis. The ladder was unsecured at the time of the incident.
A temporary employee was removing a metal plate off a truss when a piece of metal flew into his eye, causing a serious injury.

On March 16, 2018, an employee was unjamming a pallet. The hand movement triggered the electronic eye to load another pallet and the employee's left hand was caught between the two pallets, resulting in a fracture and fingertip amputation of the fifth finger requiring surgery.

An employee was modifying the scoreboard at a stadium. The employee was attempting to re-spool the cable on the drum of the hoist. He was guiding the cable with his left hand and operating the hoist by the pendant remote with his right hand. His glove was caught on the cable and the cable pulled his hand into the hoist resulting in the amputation of the right index finger and an avulsion injury to a second finger.

An employee was in a road work zone using a measurement wheel to determine how many feet of temporary pavement markings were painted when a pickup truck struck him resulting in a broken wrist and leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by an auxiliary chain that was used to hook up a ladle to an overhead bridge crane for transport.

The injured employee was extracting the drill string from the well bore (tripping out of the hole) and was struck by the drilling slips when the drilling string rotated resulting in a broken left leg.

On March 17, 2018, at approximately 7:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to clear debris from an auger when it lacerated and fractured the employee's right hand, requiring hospitalization. The auger was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking to his truck when he was run over by a truck, suffering neck, left leg, skull, face, and jaw fractures.
An employee was removing folding wings from the bridge of a loader when the folding wings fell and hit his left thumb, causing a partial amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was inspecting and photographing a running dough divider machine when the employee's left ring finger was caught and amputated in the moving parts.
An employee was pulling a manual pallet jack when he slipped on the floor and his right ankle was struck by the pallet jack, fracturing it.
An employee was attempting to close a valve on a milk transfer line when the valve snapped shut under pressure, closing on and partially amputating the employee's right ring fingertip.

Two employees had just finished installing a replacement sand bucket conveyor. One employee was adjusting the conveyor when the employee's arm was caught between the bucket and the door frame/opening to the elevator door. The employee's arm then hit the jog button, causing the moving conveyor to lift the employee to a point where the jog button was disengaged, stopping the belt. The employee suffered a deep laceration and broken arm, requiring hospitalization.
While trimming flash from a plastic pallet, the knife slipped and stabbed the employee's thigh.

An employee was operating a standup forklift while putting parts up on a conveyor line. He was backing up when the forklift appeared to speed up and move toward some stairs. He attempted to stop the forklift using his left foot, but his foot was caught and fractured between the standup forklift and the stairs.
An employee was performing unloading activities when a 4-inch cap flew off an undrained vent-and-fill line and struck the employee's head.

An employee was standing next to a flatbed trailer. A load of steel rails had just been hoisted onto the bed of the trailer. When the steel was unlashed from the crane, two pieces fell off the bed and struck the employee. The employee sustained toe amputations on one foot and trauma to the head, hands, abdomen, and feet.
An employee was poking at a sprocket on a machine from a ladder when the sprocket amputated his index fingertip.

An employee was changing a roll of shrink wrap when his right pinky finger was smashed between the roll of shrink wrap and the bracket where the roll sits, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was moving magnets when two of the magnets were drawn together and crushed his fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was running to respond to a patient's body alarm when she slipped while trying to avoid a chair in the hall and fell to the floor. She fractured her right hip and injured her right shoulder.
An employee was pulling orders while riding a powered pallet jack down an aisle when his left foot was crushed between the pallet jack and an adjacent rack support, fracturing his left heel.

An employee was on a ladder getting shipping supplies. He placed his hand on a shelving unit to brace himself. When he stepped off the ladder, his left middle finger was caught and ripped off between a brace and the shelf.
An employee was riding a horse when the horse went down and the employee landed on his shoulder, breaking his left arm.

An employee was waiting as paper was being fed off a spool at the end of a paper reel into a dry end pulper. As the paper on the spool came to an end, the employee stepped onto the moving paper. As a result, his feet came out from underneath him and he fell fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was removing a bushing on a transformer when the transformer's turret slid and he tried to catch it. The turret then amputated his right ring finger.

An employee was helping to install low-profile concrete barrier walls when his left hand was caught between barriers, fracturing his pinky finger and lacerating his hand. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a hammer drill when his work glove was caught in the drill bit, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation.
An employee was exiting a truck and fell fracturing the right arm.
An employee was physically assaulted by a customer while standing in the dining area, suffering a fractured skull.
An employee was walking behind a cash wrap when her foot became caught on a bag handle that was sticking out, causing her to trip and fall. She broke her left hip.

An employee was operating a reach truck and orders and labels began to fall off the dash of the reach truck. When the employee reached out with the right hand to catch the papers, the employee struck the cross beam of the fixed rack on the reach truck fracturing the little finger.
An employee was rolling a propane cylinder when his left pinky finger was caught on the cylinder and fractured, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
The injured employee was doing construction work from scaffolding. The scaffolding tipped over injuring the employee's arms, chest and legs.

An employee was ascending a fixed ladder and opened a roof hatch. The roof hatch then slammed on his hand and broke his finger, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet, where he broke three vertebrae in his back.
An employee was drilling a hole into a wall from a 3-foot ladder when he pulled the drill back and lost his balance, falling off the ladder and injuring his right heel.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when he collided with a second pallet jack, breaking his right leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting pork loin chops on a bone-in band saw when the bone slipped from his grip. When the bone hit the saw, it caused his right index finger to hit the saw blade. When he pulled his index finger back, the saw caught his middle finger diagonally from the top joint upwards to the fingertip. He received an amputation of the distal half of the distal phalanx of the right middle finger and a soft tissue avulsion of the tuft on the index finger.
An employee was climbing into a semi cab when he slipped and rolled his ankle, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was driving a tractor trailer in the truck yard when it rolled into a ditch. The employee fractured a vertebra and was hospitalized.

On March 19, 2018, at approximately 5:41 a.m., an employee was stocking shelves while standing on two milk crates that were stacked on top of each other. The employee fell off the top milk crate and struck the bottom crate with their chest, suffering cracked ribs and a lung contusion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck to transport pallets when he engaged in a collision avoidance maneuver and his left foot was caught between the powered industrial truck and a beam. He fractured three toes.

An employee was offloading material from inside a tractor trailer using a forklift. The employee was backing out of the trailer when the tractor trailer pulled away from the loading dock. The employee and the forklift fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken jaw and broken bones around the eye socket.
An employee fell approximately 4 feet from a loading dock while pulling a tool cart. The cart landed on his leg, breaking his right femur.

Employees were disassembling a blowout preventer. During the process, one of the employees was attempting to investigate a blockage when the 500-pound BOP dropped onto his right arm between the wrist and elbow. He received a laceration and a fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pushing a piece of wood into a joiner when the employee's hand slipped into the machine action, resulting in an amputation of the right thumb and right pinky finger.

An employee was standing on top of a mobile crane's stabilizer, calibrating the boom while holding onto part of it with his hand. The boom came down and started to pinch his fingers. When he pulled his hand out, he lost his balance and fell about 9 feet to the ground, breaking both legs (a compound fracture to one leg). He was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting why a suction cup plate assembly was binding up. To do this, the employee cycled the machine to see what component on the suction cup assembly was creating the binding. As he grabbed the plate to make a manual movement, the suction cup plate was freed, allowing his left thumb to contact the housing of the plate cylinder. His left thumb tip was smashed between the plate and the cylinder housing. When he pulled his hand back, it removed the very tip of his thumb.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a 2,000-pound polyester fluff separating drum when the employee's left arm became entangled in the drum's spikes. The employee's entire left arm was amputated. The drum was moving at the time of the incident.

On March 19, 2018, at approximately 9:30 a.m., an employee was inspecting the hoist wire rope on the drum of an 85-ton crane. While standing on the crane deck, the employee slipped, fell, and grabbed the drum, which pinched the employee's right index fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was assisting movers to unload medical equipment using a pallet jack and amputated his right index finger.

Employees were working at a steam/hot water-filled drain box and had removed the cover for the drain box. An employee was walking into the area to hook up a vacuum truck when he stepped into the uncovered drain box. He suffered burns to both lower legs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was assisting the crane operator with the four way rigging to a crop bucket for removal at the melt shop area of the plant and was caught between the lifting device and the hand rail resulting in three fractured ribs on the right side.
An employee was delivering a plastic sheet to a customer when the sheet tipped over and lacerated the employee's leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell to the floor while retrieving merchandise using a staircase ladder, breaking the right hip.

An employee was in a bucket truck attempting to replace solar light cells when the employee contacted energized parts and suffered an electrical shock. The employee then fell approximately 25 feet out of the bucket truck to the ground, breaking ribs.
An employee was making a bundle out of individual pipes. A single pipe rolled against his left foot trapping it against the pipe behind his foot resulting in a fractured left foot.
An employee's right middle finger was inside a threaded hole to lift a crammer machine when the crammer cycled and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was exiting a rock crusher and getting onto a 6-foot step ladder. He was holding onto the handrail while getting his feet onto the ladder. His feet were on the second rung from the top when the ladder kicked out from underneath him. He held onto the handrail momentarily and then fell 4 to 5 feet to the ground (gravel pad), breaking his left wrist and suffering a small compression fracture in his lower back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was making a delivery and was closing the door to a freight elevator at the customer location. The door came down faster than expected and caught his left hand between the two metal doors resulting in a fractured left index finger.

An employee was cleaning a kitchen hood canopy. He put a plywood board on top of a boiling kettle to reach the hood but fell into the kettle, sustaining second degree burns to his left leg and buttock.
An employee was sanding a fiber board when the employee's hand was caught in the sander, partially removing skin.
An employee was standing on a ladder taking a sticker/decal off of a propane truck when he fell off the ladder and struck his head on the concrete floor.

An employee was helping a road bore move pipes from one place to another. The employee was strapping up the pipe casing as a backhoe was reversing nearby. The backhoe then struck the stem connected to the pipe's auger, which resulted in a teeter-totter effect, causing the pipe to strike the employee around his right thigh. He suffered a compound fracture to his right tibia and fibula, as well as a twisted ankle.

An employee was working on the rig floor assembling a bottom hole assembly when a shock-sub struck the top of his right foot, damaging his pinky toe. His toe had to be surgically amputated from the last joint.

An employee received a thumb pad amputation while troubleshooting a wooden pallet dispenser.  The ram of the dispenser came forward to dispense a pallet and on its backward stroke caught the employee's thumb and pinched it between the ram and ram housing.
An employee was placing her lunch up on a coat hook when she turned around and fell approximately 12 inches from stairs to the ground, fracturing her right femur.
An employee was walking down a store aisle when she tripped over a metal plate and fell to the floor, breaking her hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was selecting a pipe fitting from a cart for installation. The employee took a fitting from the cart, moved to get back onto a ladder, and slipped. As the employee started to fall, he grabbed the handle on the cart and suffered a hernia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was dropping a tree. The falling tree struck a nearby tree, causing the felled tree to spring up and strike the employee. He suffered a left shoulder injury and collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a crane and sling to support a part while changing the inserts when one leg of the two-leg sling became hung up on part of the machine. The employee continued to raise the crane, and the unconnected sling leg released and struck his chin, fracturing his mandible.
An employee was troubleshooting a dual portioning valve tester. His finger was in the point of operation when the machine cycled, causing an amputation.

An employee was standing and welding in a scissor lift that was approximately 11'-8" above the finished concrete floor when his clothes ignited and he tried to remove them. He then tried to dismount the scissor lift through the chain gate on the rear of the lift. He attempted to step down the scissor supports of the lift but lost his grip and fell to the ground. He landed on his left wrist and left side. He suffered burns and a broken wrist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unscrewing bolts and the ceiling collapsed. The employee sustained a broken wrist, arm, and collarbone.

An employee was lifting a 500-pound backpan with a crane when slack in the line caused the backpan to drop. He tried to catch the backpan, which severely injured the middle finger on each hand. His left middle finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was cutting sheet to attach to an extrusion winder when the employee's left hand was pulled and flipped by the winder, fracturing the employee's upper left arm.

An employee was adjusting the lumber on a chain conveyor when the chain came off the sprocket. His left hand was caught by the chain and sprocket pulley as he tried to put the chain back on the sprocket, partially amputating his pinky finger (first knuckle), fracturing his ring finger, and damaging the ligaments on his other fingers. The chain conveyor was moving at the time of the incident.

On March 20, 2018, at 6:10 PM, an employee was helping to tighten a tension pulley on a ripsaw when his right hand was caught between the chain and sprocket. He experienced pain, swelling, and bleeding and was hospitalized with contusions and a broken bone that required surgery.
An employee was descending a tower crane when he fell approximately 20 feet from one landing to the lower landing located inside the tower crane. He sustained head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee received an electrical shock while using a shrink wrap machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was riding as a passenger on a golf cart when it struck a forklift. The employee sustained a broken nose and mandible, as well as a laceration to the knee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sprayed with hot coolant from a pressurized hose while performing a coolant flush on a vehicle. The employee suffered second degree burns to the chest and arms, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was leaving the building, slipped on a wet/icy area and fell resulting in a rib injury.
An employee was demonstrating an exercise to a patient during a physical therapy session when the employee fell onto the carpeted floor, suffering a neck fracture that required surgery.

An employee was installing insulation from a scissor lift that was 15 to 20 feet above ground level when he flipped over the railing and landed on the ground, injuring his back. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was using a handheld grinder to cut thread rods on pipe stands when the abrasive wheel on the grinder kicked back and cut his left wrist.
An employee was injured while removing a pole with a boom truck.

An employee was standing on the delivery ramp at the rear of his straight truck closing the back door of the trailer when he mis-stepped and then fell approximately 4 feet to the ground, fracturing his right arm.
An employee's left hand was caught and crushed between a C-channel and a building wall while he was hooking a dock lock at the loading dock, resulting in a left ring finger amputation.

An employee was on a scaffold platform waiting for bricks to be delivered. When the bricks were placed on the scaffold, they broke the wooden platform, causing the employee to fall over 20 feet. The employee suffered shoulder and torso bruising.

While catching cut lumber boards from a saw, an employee attempted to remove an off-cut board from the blade, resulting in in a finger amputation. The saw was not locked out and the blade was rotating at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving a pallet from side to side using a pallet jack when he felt a pop in his stomach due to a hernia.
An employee was climbing a ladder to retrieve a window in storage when he lost his footing halfway up and fell to the ground below, fracturing his left arm and leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a drill press when the drill bit caught his glove and pulled his right index finger into the moving drill bit. His right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was patrolling the mountain when air caught under the ski causing the employee to fall and break their leg.

An employee was using a driver to drive a T-post into the ground. When he raised the driver, the T-post fell to its side and his right index finger was pinched between the T-post and the driver, fracturing his fingertip.

An employee was working at a flexographic machine and setting up for the next order. He manually turned the pull roll with his right hand while his left hand was above the shaft, and his left middle fingertip became lodged in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped over a mobile hanger carry rack, fell and fractured his right hip.
An employee was using a push stick to cut small strips of wood on a 14" table saw when his left index finger contacted the saw, causing a severe laceration that resulted in a partial amputation.

A temporary employee was washing down a crumb machine with a water hose when his left hand contacted a rotating auger, partially amputating his middle finger below the second knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was moving a pallet of toilet paper with a stand-up forklift when the employee's right leg was crushed between the frame of the stand-up forklift and the steel upright post of a rack system. The employee's right leg broke below the knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was moving a sheet backwards on a roof when he slipped and fell on top of a shooting boom lift basket, breaking a femur.

An employee was preparing to change knives on a wood cutting machine when the moving plate struck the guard that had the knife block resting on top of it. The movement of the plate launched the knife block into the air. The block then struck the employee, causing facial injuries and broken teeth.
An employee was maintaining a lift gate when it fell. His fingers were caught between the lift gate and the ground, resulting in a partial amputation of the ring finger and a lacerated middle finger.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a piece of foam rubber. As the employee repositioned the foam, the saw cut the palm of the employee's left hand.
An employee was shoveling wood scrap into a chipper when the employee was struck by a board that came off a conveyor, suffering a neck injury.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when he tripped over the parking divider, suffering an open wound on his knee.

While pushing a wheel caster with a cart, an employee ran into another piece of equipment. This created a pinch point between the employee's hand and the equipment, resulting in a left fifth fingertip amputation.
An employee was handling/moving materials on and off of pallets when the employee's right ring finger was pinched and partially amputated between pallets.

An employee was helping a jockey truck driver close the doors of all of the trailers to prepare for a snow storm. The employees could not completely close the doors of the holding trailer, so the employee stood behind the trailer and held the doors closed while the jockey driver backed the trailer up the bay door. The employee was then pinned between the dock plate and the trailer, suffering a broken left arm and bruised upper/lower torso.
An employee was taking a sample of aluminum when molten aluminum splashed on his right hand, causing burns.
An employee smashed a finger between bearing housing of rolls and a sander framework.
An employee fell while pushing a recycling bin, suffering neck and back pain.
Two employees slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, fracturing their ankles and requiring hospitalization.
The injured employee was placing a wooden 4"x 4" stud under a metal roll and the load slipped pinching his left index fingertip.
An employee was using a push stick to trim a wooden board on a table saw when the board kicked back and hit the employee's abdomen.
On March 21, 2018, an employee was clearing the side guard on a table saw when his fingers came into contact with the saw blade. Two of his left-hand fingers were amputated at the middle knuckle.
An employee was moving narrow steel coils. When he removed the chain from a coil, the coil fell over and struck him, trapping and bruising his left leg.
An employee was pressing the safety latch on a hoist hook and lowering a sheet lifter when his left thumb was caught between the safety latch and eye hook of the sheet lifter.
An employee was changing out of his uniform at his locker when he tripped on the strap of a costume roller tote (hamper) and hit the floor, breaking his left hip.
An employee was measuring and cutting insulation using a water jet cutter when his hands went under the water jet, lacerating his right pinky. The machine was guarded at the time.

While unloading a pallet of boxes, an employee stepped onto a pallet. The employee's foot went between pallet boards and became stuck, resulting in spiral fractures to the tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was attempting to clean the adhesive on a rotary die cutting machine when it lacerated two of the employee's left middle fingertips. The machine was operating at the time of the incident.
An employee was fine grading dirt around a concrete channel box when he tried to jump over the box, suffering a concussion and facial contusion.

An employee was performing maintenance work, which included greasing lines at a kiln. The screw broke while the employee was installing it for a clamp, making the employee lose balance and fall 21'. The employee suffered injuries to the face, mouth (tooth loss), and leg (compound fracture), requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to straighten out a bad part with a flattening die when the part slipped off the flattening die and severed his left index finger against the front face of the die.
An employee was working on a piece of equipment when his glove was pulled by the chain. His right middle fingertip was then caught and amputated in the chain and sprocket.
The injured employee was lifting an aluminum style window and amputated his left index finger between the window seal and the window base.

An employee was loading up a car to transport a client to a doctor's appointment. The client locked the employee out of the car and started the engine, then put the car in reverse and struck the employee. The employee suffered third degree burns to the leg and two leg fractures.

An employee was on a ladder testing an energized wire in the ceiling to make it safe when his pliers touched the electrical junction box, causing an arc flash. The flash startled the employee, causing him to fall off the second rung of the ladder to the floor, re-aggravating a pre-existing shoulder injury.

An employee was tightening a bolt on the end of a cutter machine's bed knife when the ratchet handle slipped off the socket, causing the employee to fall backwards. He broke his right tibia and fibula, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a can crusher machine when it amputated half of one of the employee's fingers.
An employee was walking in a common area hallway while returning from the restroom when he tripped and fell, fracturing his hip.
An employee was attempting to break up a fight between patients when she was pushed to the ground, fracturing her right femur.
An employee was driving a boom lift when it bounced off a curb, causing him to strike his mouth on the bar above the controls. He suffered a head contusion as well as fractures to the jaw and ribs.

Two employees were setting wooden trusses when the trusses collapsed on them and the employees fell to the concrete floor below. They were both hospitalized for fractured bones, concussions and contusions.
An employee was cleaning a product mixer when his hands entered the stock cutter opening. His left hand and three fingers on his right hand were amputated.

An employee was setting a pin in a boom to connect two sections. When the employee went to hit the pin with a sledgehammer, his hand slipped and the sledgehammer struck his hand, fracturing his finger and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was moving a load with an overhead crane. The load was not centered and struck a frame supporting it. The load then fell and struck the employee, who suffered a fractured left leg and laceration.

An employee was introducing a new chemical (copper sulfate) into a 6,500 gallon tank of sodium hypochlorite when a chemical reaction occurred, exposing the employee to a gaseous reaction (chlorine gas). Respiratory protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was taking trash to the compactor, tripped on the stairs and fell fracturing the right clavicle.
While descending stairs to a basement floor work station, an employee lost balance and fell, suffering a head injury.
An employee was working on a baker's scaffold when the platform gave way and he fell approximately 4 feet, suffering a vertebral compression fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the truck yard. The employee's head struck the ground, suffering internal bleeding.
An employee was operating cheese shredder when the unit malfunctioned. The employee was troubleshooting the machine when it automatically activated and amputated several of his fingers.
An employee was providing access control to other employees. She was walking down the hall when she fell and injured her nose, forehead, and left arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting the tip on his pressure washer with his right hand when he accidentally hit the trigger with his opposite hand, shooting a stream of high-pressure water into his right hand. He suffered a laceration to his right hand and was hospitalized for an embolism.

On 3/22/2018, an employee was clearing bottles from a conveyor when her finger was caught in the sprocket and pulley mechanism at the junction between the conveyor and the machine, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee closed the trunk of her vehicle on her right hand resulting in amputation of the right middle finger.

On 3/22/2018, an employee was attempting to remove glue buildup from a machine's rollers when the machine's cutting knife amputated the employee's right middle finger. The machine's gate was open at the time of the incident.
An employee finished installing trusses and was climbing down a ladder when it slid out from under the employee. The employee fell 8 to 10 feet to the ground, breaking a leg and ankle.
An employee tripped and fell over the charging cable to her forklift, suffering a femoral neck fracture of the left femur and left shoulder pain.  She was hospitalized and had surgery.

The injured employee was preparing samples for testing and was processing nitric acid and oil and gas samples in a glass container when the glass container exploded resulting in burns and puncture wounds to the employee's hands and arms.
An employee was disassembling scaffolding when he lost his balance and fell, impacting the ground and breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was caught between a lift basket and a crane.

An employee reported the smell of glue outside the hallway to operating rooms under construction.  After being exposed to the smell for approximately four hours, the employee became sweaty and began vomiting from possible vapor inhalation.

An employee was delivering beverages to a customer location. He climbed onto the rear of the truck, stepped onto a concrete wall and climbed over the safety rail. His foot got caught on the rail and he fell forward onto the concrete surface resulting in an elbow injury.

An employee was preparing to make vertical saw cuts in a hard wood floor for removal. The employee was using a 7.25" circular saw set at a depth of 0.75" when the tip of his glove was pulled into the rotating blade, cutting and partially amputating his left thumb at the tip.
On March 22, 2018, an employee slipped on ice in the parking lot, fracturing his left leg and requiring hospitalization.

On 3/22/2018, at around 12:35 a.m., an employee was walking to her car in the parking lot when she slipped and fell on ice, breaking her right ankle in three places. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was operating a power buggy to help pour a concrete slab and footer. He had to get off the power buggy platform to fold a piece on the equipment. While he was walking beside the machine, the steering tires hit an obstruction, causing the machine to push him between a large glass window panel and the power buggy. He broke his right lower tibia and fibula.
An employee left her car to deliver a parcel and was walking through a parking lot when she tripped on a parking bumper and fell to the same level, fracturing her left arm.

An employee was cleaning at the exterior rice bins when the employee attempted to clean a drag conveyor. The employee's left hand was in the conveyor when it started, breaking the employee's left hand and forearm. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The conveyor was unguarded at the time of the incident.
On 3/23/2018, an employee became ill after shoveling snow, losing consciousness and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a press to stamp a fender. He was attempting to remove the fender when the cam crushed his right index finger between the part and the cam, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working in the office when water entered the office as a result of a broken water pipe (exterior to the building). The employee was attempting to contain the water leak by spreading linens when she slipped and fell to the floor, breaking her right patella and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on the lamination line when he saw some hardened resin on a roller.  He used a tool to try and remove the resin, but his hand was pulled into the rollers, resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee was struck by a forklift while fitting a pipe, crushing the employee's hand.
While removing parts from a tumbler, an employee slipped and fell toward the tumbler. The employee's left hand was caught in the machinery and a tumbler gear smashed the left ring fingertip.
An employee fell while entering a bus, suffering swelling to the arms and legs.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot, fracturing an ankle.

An employee was performing a change-over of the web lead at a press machine when the employee's left arm was caught between the machine's drive/drag roller and the slitter roller, resulting in arm bruises.

An employee was cutting a cardboard core on a core cutting machine when the core spun out of the machine, striking the employee in the face and mouth. The employee suffered nose, sinus, and palate fractures.
An employee was moving a lathe. The machine tipped over and the employee tried to catch the machine. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw when the meat became caught on the saw and caused the employee's hand to contact the saw, cutting a fingertip.

Two employees were sitting on a beam facing each other and protected from falling. They were working to drive barrel pins for a field splice. Employee 1 was using an 8 lb. sledgehammer to drive a pin, but missed the pin and hit a spud wrench that was sitting on the splice. The wrench was propelled upward and struck employee 2 in the face, causing nasal and facial fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a screw conveyor and when he lifted a lid to clean underneath it , the conveyor pinched his left-hand fingertips. His index, middle, and ring fingertips were medically amputated. The conveyor was in motion at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, suffering a left ankle fracture. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
A temporary employee was assembling store fixtures using a staple gun when a 1-inch staple penetrated his head.

An employee was picking up an I-beam with a magnetized lifting device when the I-beam slipped off the lifting device and struck his left foot and ankle just behind the metatarsal, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was securing a ladder and fall protection on a roof when the employee fell 20 feet to the ground.
An employee was trying to remove a piece of rebar from a magnet when his arm was caught in the magnet pulley, breaking his arm and wrist.
An employee had a seizure after a stressful staff meeting.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unplugging a hydrolyzer machine when it dispensed hot steam, burning his right neck area and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working within the cubicle of a primary switch when an energized buss (approximately 13,200 volts) arced and caused a flash fire. The flash fire burned his left arm between his shoulder and elbow.
An employee was constructing a pipe bomb when it blew up in his face. He suffered severe facial swelling and blurry vision.
An employee was walking backward while pulling a cart when she tripped and fell to the concrete floor, striking her head. She suffered a head laceration and head contusion.
On 3/23/2018, an employee was using a table saw to cut cardboard boxes when the cutting material jumped off the table. The saw blade then amputated two of the employee's fingertips.

An employee was inspecting a pressure relief valve on a unit when the relief valve discharged heated gas into the employee's face. The employee suffered a corneal abrasion and superficial burns to the face.
On March 24, 2018, an employee was changing a die on a punch press when the machine actuated, amputating the employee's right index finger. The press was not powered off at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping a forklift operator move pallets when the forklift operator turned and pinned the employee's shoulder between the forklift and a pole. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.
An employee was talking to the driver of a vehicle when it ran over his right foot. He experienced bruising and swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the floor removing a sample of molten iron from a furnace. The sample cup became caught on the lip of the furnace and molten iron spilled onto the employee's aluminized pants, contacting his leg through a pocket opening. He received burns to the thigh, calf, and ankle.
An employee was removing dough from the floor when the employee's arm was caught in a conveyor and fractured.
