An employee was attempting to unjam a food processor when the blades spun and cut her hand, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation and an index finger laceration.
An employee was lowering a 24-inch long steel I-beam that was connected to a chain sling. After he disconnected one end of the rigging, the loose end struck and broke his leg.

An employee was loading up a payoff machine when the employee's left index finger was caught between the reel and the drive arm of the payoff, resulting in an amputation of the distal phalanges on the left index finger.
An employee was standing behind a door when a patient suddenly opened it. The door hit the employee, causing her to fall to the ground and break her hip.
While extinguishing a fire in a warehouse, an employee inhaled smoke and became dehydrated.
An employee was unloading cargo from an aircraft when a container of chemical ripped open. The employee was exposed to the chemical and suffered an asthma attack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a stacker to stock papers when his hand contacted a gear and belt, resulting in a partial finger amputation. The stacker was unguarded at the time.
An employee fell from a pickup truck while unloading equipment, suffering a fractured right wrist and left elbow.

An employee was manufacturing copper pipe fittings using a hydraulic press when a fitting fell into the machine. The employee was attempting to retrieve the fitting when the die came down on the employee's left index finger, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was working underneath a lift table when the table started and came down on his chest, breaking five ribs.
On March 24, 2018, at about 9:30 p.m., an employee brought his gun into work and was cleaning it when the gun discharged, shooting and fracturing his right femur.
On Saturday, March 24, 2018, at 10:00 AM, an employee was using a chop saw to cut PVC pipe when the saw amputated his finger.
An employee was walking behind a banding machine when the employee tripped over excess banding material and fell to the floor, fracturing a patella.

An employee was pushing an electrical pallet jack loaded with parts baskets. While going through a doorway, the parts baskets caught the door frame and fell back onto the employee, who suffered fractures to the skull, cervical vertebrae, and ribs, as well as an ankle injury.
An employee was dumping containers at the parking lot level when one of the container doors closed on his right hand. His right index fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was choked by a resident, fracturing her trachea and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was reversing a double power industrial truck when his left foot was smashed between a yellow valet bar and the industrial truck. He sustained an opened fracture to his left ankle.
An employee tripped over a mat and fell at a food stand, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee tripped while wrapping a pallet, fracturing a leg and requiring hospitalization.
A crew of employees were cleaning a site to prep it for oil rig drilling work. While lifting debris from the ground, one employee was bitten by a cotton mouth snake, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working underneath a machine and when he stood up he hit the back of his head on a PVC part that is fixed to the machine.

An employee was standing on coiled wire while removing strapping from other coiled wire inside the cargo hold of a vessel. As the employee was removing the strapping, he fell approximately 8 to 10 feet from the coiled wire he was standing on down onto the metal deck below. He sustained fractures to his lumbar spine.

Two employees were troubleshooting a piece of equipment. The first employee had his hand on a sprocket when the second employee jogged the machine. The sprocket moved and amputated the first employee's fingertip.
A temporary employee tripped and fell on the carpet while walking, breaking a rib and rupturing his spleen.

On March 26, 2018, at approximately 11:35 a.m., an employee was moving wire through the rollers of a strander machine when the employee's glove was caught between the wire and roller. The employee's right ring finger was then pulled into the in-running nip point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a sweeper machine when a passing motorist struck it, causing the employee to be ejected and strike the ground. The employee suffered head trauma, broken ribs, and exterior abrasions on the arms, requiring hospitalization.
An employee stumbled while walking down a flight of about 15 stairs, hitting his head on the landing and suffering a concussion.
An employee was walking in the rebar shop when he fell to the floor, suffering facial contusions and an injury to the vertebrae in his neck.

An employee was erecting signage while other employees loaded scrap metal into a ship for export. During these loading operations, a piece of metal fell from a grapple and struck the employee's side and back. He suffered five broken ribs and two fractured vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was turning on an oxygen tank to a nitrous oxide mixer when the machine burst into flames, causing second degree burns to the employee's right thigh, left hand, and face.

An employee was using a blower as a vacuum to pick up broken glass when the nozzle became loose. He turned off the equipment and as he was trying to secure the nozzle, his left ring finger made contact with the blower fan, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating an L-panel machine when his hand was caught and crushed between the rollers.
An employee transferred paint thinner into a water bottle and placed it on his working station. After working for a while, he became thirsty and drank out of the water bottle.
An employee fell from the roof of a residential construction project.

An employee was walking away from a screw conveyor when his right foot stepped into a square floor drain opening. While his foot was in the floor drain, hot water (140 degrees Fahrenheit) flowed into the opening and onto his right foot, causing second degree burns.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was approaching a doorway while carrying several large items in her hands. As she approached the step leading to the doorway, she tripped on the concrete curb and fell, fracturing her right ankle.
On March 26, 2018, an employee was trying to restrain a client when he twisted his knee and tore a muscle in his thigh. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was building a skylight curb on the roof of a building. He was cutting a piece of plywood with a saw when it kicked back, cutting the little, ring, and middle fingers of his right hand. His little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking down the aisle, tripped and fell resulting in an ankle fracture and hospitalization.
An employee was disconnecting a trailer and pulling on the release when he fell backwards and hit the ground, passing out and injuring his spine.

On 3/26/2018, at approximately 21:01, an employee was unloading coffee pods from pallets and placing them onto a conveyor when her fingers were caught in an unguarded chain and sprocket, resulting in four finger amputations.
An employee fell to the ground while climbing a ladder, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee slipped and fell in an icy parking lot while delivering product, injuring his back.

An employee was transferring fuel from a fuel truck to an underground storage tank when he noticed that the fuel truck started to roll forward. While attempting to prevent the truck from hitting a concrete pillar, his body was caught between the front of the truck and the pillar. He suffered a pelvic injury and internal bleeding, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was sliding a cant onto a scissor lift material table when his right index finger was caught between two cants and amputated.

An employee was cutting a banded pack of 1-inch thick lumber boards. Immediately after cutting the band, the uneven pile of lumber fell toward him and knocked him over. His middle fingertip became trapped between two of the boards, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was manually sliding a tail stock into a slitter machine's arbors when his right index finger was pinched between the stock and a bolt, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was filling a tank with nitric acid. The nitric acid sprayed out of the ball valve onto the employee's back and leg. The employee received second degree burns to the buttock area, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing tools on a router when his left hand was caught and partially amputated by the router head. The router was guarded at the time.
An employee vomited and passed out due to heat stress while collecting corn, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to rope a steer when the steer jerked. The rope caught the employee's right hand, pulling it into a pole and amputating two fingers.

An employee was bending over to grab some trays from a pallet that was on the floor when a pallet of raw material boxes tipped over and fell from a rack, landing on top of the employee. He suffered a head laceration and concussion, cervical fracture, and left ankle sprain.
An employee was directing the lowering of a trench box while standing on a sewer inlet when the box swung and crushed his foot between it and the sewer inlet.
An employee tripped and fell while walking, suffering fractures.
On March 27, 2018, an employee was operating a mandrel machine when it amputated the employee's right hand/arm.

An employee was dusting a window sill from a 6-foot step ladder when the employee fell to the ground, suffering a hand laceration and bruised ribs resulting in breathing difficulty that required hospitalization.

An employee fell about five feet off the back of a flatbed trailer while securing a load of coiled steel spools with ratchet straps and impacted the concrete driveway below.  The employee sustained a head injury, a right arm fracture and a fractured pelvis.

An employee climbed up a pilaster wall panel to hook up with the crane. The employee removed the she-bolt and the wall panel fell while the employee was hooked off to it. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and left shin laceration.
An employee was cutting down dead tree underbrush with a chain saw when the saw bounced back and contacted his shin, severely lacerating it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a fiberglass extension ladder that was on a deck and leaning against the gutter of a house. The ladder slid out and the employee fell approximately 7 feet, landing on his chest. The employee sustained three broken ribs, a punctured lung and a strained elbow.

An employee was working from a portable ladder to install an industrial refrigeration unit using a handheld grinder. He lost his footing and fell approximately 2 feet from the ladder, striking the ground and breaking a rib.
An employee was riding an electrical pallet jack when he struck a table and his left leg was caught and broken between a wall and the pallet jack.
An employee was working inside an excavation when a loose rock (1.5 feet in diameter) rolled into the excavation and struck the employee on the back.
An employee was walking backwards alongside a forklift to help steady the load (scaffold component). He tripped and fell and was run over by the forklift injuring his right thigh and left leg.

An employee was tightening a light fixture from an A-frame ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. He hit his head, suffering head and tongue lacerations that required hospitalization and sutures.
An employee was pulling a hose off a dishwasher. When the hose broke free, the employee's forearm slammed against a piece of glass under the dishwasher, causing a laceration that required sutures.

An employee was attempting to hook up an airline for an air sander. The employee's left arm was between the straining rod and control box of a press when it became caught between a caution sign on the straining rod and the control box. The employee suffered left arm contusions near the elbow area, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was checking for a bind in the chain of the "tipper" when the machine actuated and caught the employee's right index finger between the chain and sprocket resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was working from a ladder putting equipment above the drop ceiling when the ladder slipped and he fell to the ground. He sustained fractures to both arms and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing reflective orange traffic cones from an eight-lane roadway when he was struck by a vehicle, suffering a broken right leg, broken orbital bone, and facial lacerations.
An employee was struck by a forklift.
An employee was exposed to vapors and became ill while walking through the building.
An employee was examining the brakes of a trailer as part of a pre-use inspection when another employee  moved the trailer and ran over his right leg, fracturing it.

On March 27, 2018, an employee was using a prybar to free bound material on a wire dispensing carriage station when the prybar slipped free, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a spiral fracture of the upper left leg.

An employee had climbed onto the top of a one-unit lumber truck to strap down the load. When coming down the side of the truck, he lost his footing and fell to the ground, suffering a concussion, a broken rib, and a  facial fracture.

On March 27, 2018, at approximately 7:30 AM, an employee noticed a piece of trim tangled up on a slitter and was in the process of clearing the machine when the blade cut him. He suffered a distal tip amputation of his left thumb.

An employee was moving product onto a pallet. The employee was moving out of the way of an oncoming powered industrial truck (PIT) when the employee stepped backwards into the pallet on the PIT resulting in a fractured fibula near the ankle.
An employee was dumping a portion of a load from a buggy when he lost control of the buggy and descended down a ramp. His right leg was pinned and broken between the equipment's gas tank and a wall.

An employee was transferring trash from a rolling hopper to a dump hopper when his right hand entered a pinch point between the dump hopper and the rolling hopper. His right thumb was crushed, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee fell to the concrete floor and landed on her back after she slipped in water while walking, fracturing her lower vertebrae. She was hospitalized.
A crane was lifting a slab of concrete when the concrete fell and pinned an employee. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture.

An employee was using small material handling equipment (MHE) to place a box of product onto a shelf. Another employee was operating a larger MHE to retrieve empty pallets from the shelf racks in the same aisle. The second employee's MHE equipment was raised in the air approximately 20 feet as it was being moved to the next pallet. The second employee did not see the first employee working below him or her MHE sitting in the aisle, and the MHE equipment collided.  The first employee's left ankle was caught and crushed between the two pieces of equipment, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was crossing through an alleyway to reach another building when a trash truck backed up and ran over his right foot, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee walking in the receptionist area tripped over the electrical cord of a paper shredder and fractured her left hip.

An employee was adjusting wooden dunnage under concrete piling when the pile unexpectedly shifted due to a wind draft. The employee was then caught between a metal form and the concrete pile, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee experienced difficulty breathing due to paint fumes coming from a nearby work station, requiring hospitalization.
While tearing shingles off a roof, an employee fell about 14 feet, 9 inches to the ground, suffering breathing difficulty.

A employee was troubleshooting a mechanical problem on a stacker. His hand was in the chain/sprocket area when another employee on a different part of the equipment started the stacker. The distal portion of his index finger was then amputated. The stacker was unguarded and not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

A maintenance employee was working from a 6-foot step ladder to repair an overhead door when the pipe wrench he was using slipped off a tension spring and hit his head. He then fell off the ladder, landing on his right side and hitting his head on the dock floor. He sustained two skull fractures and a hairline fracture to the jaw.
While disassembling a scaffold, an employee fell from the fourth level of the scaffold to the ground, fracturing the C-6 vertebra and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a porch delivering mail to a residence when a portion of the porch gave way. Debris from the porch struck the employee, causing back and neck injuries.
An employee was rigging I-beams for a crane when an I-beam fell on his right leg, fracturing it below the knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was standing on a porch that was 13 feet from the ground and was tying off to a hand rail when another employee from a different company took out the pin that stabilized the porch. The porch swayed, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken collarbone, four broken ribs, one lung bruise, and a head injury that required stitches.
An employee was crossing railroad tracks with a tractor when he was struck by a train, suffering fractures.
An employee missed a step while attempting to climb down from a top stock cart ladder and fractured a bone in her leg. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee's left arm was inside a three-knife trimmer when the machine cycled, deeply puncturing and breaking the employee's left arm.
An employee was initiating the cleaning process for a crepe cooker when the employee's hand was crushed and burned between two rotating drums. The crepe cooker was unguarded at the time.

An employee lowered a truck lift gate to unloading the trailer at a store. He was pulling a table to the back (end) of the trailer when the table became caught on a stirrup, causing him to trip/fall and strike his jaw. He suffered a fractured jaw and was hospitalized.
An employee inhaled vacuum testing gas (stannic fluoride) from what appears to be a horseplay incident.
An employee was moving a crane and outriggers when his middle finger was pinched between the lip of an outrigger and the crane, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a sit-down forklift in reverse and ran into a trailer. As the forklift struck the trailer, the employee's right hand was crushed between the exterior frame of the forklift and the trailer. The employee sustained crushing injuries to three fingers on his right hand.

An employee needed to replace the wheels on a sliding gate so he jacked up the gate with a hydraulic jack and was removing the wheel. The gate slipped off of the jack and lacerated his right ring finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack and struck a column resulting in a foot laceration requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to splice a roll after a blowout. He was bringing the tail from the reel under the rider roll and was positioned on the tending side of the winder as the tail came around the back of the roll.  As he attempted to thread the tail under the rider roll, his finger became caught in the nip created by the rider roll and the roll of paper. He suffered an open fracture and amputation of his left index fingertip as a result.

On March 28, 2018, an employee was changing a battery in a fork truck. He was attempting to remove a hoist chain from the battery hook when his right thumb tip was caught and amputated between the chain and battery hook.
An employee slipped and fell while walking by the kitchen, suffering back and rib injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a cement/sand mixer when the machine amputated the employee's left index finger. The machine was on at the time.
An employee was moving freight when he damaged a disk in his back.
An employee was walking up garage steps from a car to a work building. The employee stepped on one of the wet metal step edges and slipped, falling to the ground and fracturing an ankle.

An employee was using a tractor to drag a lumber yard. He then got off the tractor to move an object. The tractor rolled forward and struck his right leg, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization. The tractor was in neutral at the time of the incident.
On 3/28/18, an employee was working on the air valves for a spot welder when the valve actuated, pinching and amputating the employee's pinky finger against the frame.
A pallet was lowered onto an employee's hand, amputating a fingertip.

An employee was making repairs to a cylinder on a crane.  When the hydraulic line was removed, the pressure in the hose blew and cut the employee's left hand.  The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee felt chest pain and heart palpitations while working in a staging area outside a pharmaceutical filling room. The condition possibly resulted from chemical sensitivity.
An employee was staging materials when he fell backwards. A carton containing a patio tabletop then fell on him, fracturing his lower back.

An employee was working from an extension ladder about 6 to 8 feet above ground level.  He had a volt meter in his hands. The volt meter began to fumble and he attempted to catch it to prevent it from falling to the ground. In the process, he lost his balance and fell from the ladder to a 55-gallon metal drum that was located below.  The front of his right lower leg struck the metal drum, causing a laceration/avulsion to the skin.
An employee was on a ladder installing guttering on a residential house when he lost his balance and fell approximately 20 feet, injuring his vertebrae.

An employee was using an 8-foot fiberglass A-frame step ladder to access the ceiling. When he went to descend the ladder, it slipped. This startled the employee, who lost his balance and fell to the floor below. He fractured his left elbow and right wrist, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was rolling a bar out of the way when the employee's left middle finger became stuck between the bar and the edge of a beam that was connected to an entry table, resulting in a distal amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was using a table saw when the blade partially amputated the employee's fingertip. The blade was unguarded at the time.
An employee was moving a metal coolant tray and caught a finger in the caster wheel resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell through an open shaft while installing drywall, suffering a broken collarbone and back.
An employee was clearing scrap from a jammed machine and got a hand caught in the machine resulting in amputation of the left middle and ring fingertips.

An employee shut off the disconnect box of a condenser and went to pop off the belt when the belt amputated three of the employee's fingers. The belt had not stopped moving at the time of the incident.

An employee was loading a flat bed semi-trailer with a part that was almost as long as the trailer.  As he was walking the part up the deck of the trailer, his right foot broke through the rotten wooden bed of the trailer and his right shin struck a metal cross beam, suffering a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a gizzard machine when his left eye struck the machine lid.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a malfunction on a shaker table. He was clearing material from the table when his gloved left hand slipped and was caught in the rotating parts, amputating his left index and middle fingers to the first knuckle.
An employee was using a hammer on a stuck valve when the hammer broke. A metal shard from the hammer pierced the employee's eye.

An employee fell approximately 15 to 20 feet from a ladder while changing words on a billboard sign in the front parking lot. The employee impacted the pavement below, injuring an artery and breaking both wrists, a femur, and a rib.
An employee was helping to stow an auger in a truck when the controls became stuck in high speed and his hand was entangled in the auger, partially amputating a finger.
An employee was sorting cattle and one of the cows kicked the employee in the leg causing a bruise and a large hematoma. He was admitted to the hospital to have the hematoma drained.

An employee was loading a fully assembled sheet metal coil rack into a parts cart. The coil rack was placed on the edge and was started into the cart. As the employee began to slide the product into the cart, the rack slipped off of the table. The top portion of the rack that the employee was holding came in contact with the table. This created a pinch point where the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the coil rack and table, resulting in a partial amputation of the distal phalanx on the pinky finger (right hand).

On March 28, 2018, at approximately 11:45 a.m., an employee was moving lumber down a green chain when a piece of lumber fell. The employee went down some stairs to retrieve it and while coming back up the stairs, he slipped and fell into the green chain. He put his left hand out to break his fall and it struck the green chain, breaking and lacerating his thumb. He was hospitalized and had surgery. The chain was not guarded at the time.

While conducting a die change, an employee attempted to remove a clamp ring from around the die. The die ring assembly slipped and pinched the employee's left middle finger between the ring and the table of the press, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
Two employees were collecting a catalyst sample from a tank when the chemicals splashed them.  They were hospitalized with burns on their face and hands.
An employee was attempting to unjam a food processor when the blade partially amputated the employee's fourth right finger. The food processor was running at the time.
An employee was using a fixed ladder to take copper piping to the roof when he missed a rung and fell approximately 6 feet. He was hospitalized with fractures to his neck, back, and pelvis.
A temporary employee was welding when the employee's apron caught fire. The employee suffered second degree burns to the upper left arm.
An employee was hospitalized after showing signs of a possible heart attack while completing a work-related treadmill stress test to keep his SCAPE certification.
After moping the floor, an employee was putting away a mop and broom when a resident ran toward her and fell on her, breaking her left knee.

On March 29, 2018, two employees were using a propane-powered forklift to treat seed in a seed warehouse when they became ill. They were both hospitalized with carbon monoxide poisoning from the forklift.
An employee was lifting a beam and suffered an aneurysm in the torso.

An employee dropped a case of 8 oz. glass bottles on top of another case of product while building orders. One of the glass bottles inside the case burst and pieces of glass shot up and struck his right eyelid, causing a laceration. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while operating a floor stripping machine, breaking a leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal with a horizontal band saw when his right hand went between the metal and a vise used to hold it in place, resulting in a right thumb tip amputation.
An employee drove a bus to a gas pump to fill it with fuel. As the employee was descending the bus steps, he slipped or missed a step and fell, striking the back of his head.

An employee was separating meat from its casing using an air injecting needle when his hand slipped and the needle penetrated his cut-resistant glove. Air was injected into his hand, causing swelling.

An employee was removing tape from pipes at a powder coating booth.  As a pipe exited the powder coating booth, he attempted to remove the tape at the end of the pipe. His left forearm was then pulled into the pipe, receiving third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was placing strap around a bundle of pipe. The strap broke and the pipe shifted knocking the employee backwards resulting in a lower left leg fracture.

An employee was rigging a crane to pick up a piece of channel off the top shelf of a material rack.  The employee was using a 4-foot step ladder.  While stepping down, the employee missed a step and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a femoral neck fracture of the right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while walking down a hallway, suffering a broken hip.
Employees were repairing a cooling unit on a new oil tank battery when a piping union failed and struck the injured employee, who suffered an amputation of the right leg below the knee.
An employee was conducting truck maintenance when his left index finger was caught between the truck bed tailgate and a floor jack, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was repairing an electrical part on a turning machine when he came into contact with the exposed, 480-volt live electrical part, resulting in an electric shock on his right hand. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was loading a CNC lathe with a metal rod when his left hand was caught between the rod and the machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing items from a box when he stumbled, fell, and broke his left arm.

An employee was spreading material for footing when a crane that was holding the material reversed and caught the employee's right thumb between it and a 4 x 4. The employee's right thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was using a stand up forklift to move pallets of product in the warehouse. The employee lost control of the forklift, jumped off and was pinned between the forklift and a steel beam. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis, pinched arteries in her leg and severe trauma to her lower extremities.
An employee slipped on some water that was on the floor and fell, breaking her kneecap.
An employee was moving a pallet jack out of the way when his left leg was pinned between the pallet jack and a rack, breaking it.

An employee was preparing to buff the inside of a flange. He set the buffer down inside the tower while the section was being rotated. He noticed that the buffer cord was going to be pinched between the tower section and a stop, so he attempted to grab the cord. The tower section then amputated his right little finger at the first knuckle.
An employee opened a door and was walking into a building when she slipped on the wet ground surface and hit her head, suffering a brain bleed.
An employee was using a rolling ladder to access inventory and slipped on the third step and fell backwards breaking her leg in two places.
An employee's right hand was inside a pneumatic-powered slide gate of a blender clearing debris when the slide gate valve amputated the employee's index finger.
An employee amputated a fingertip with a manual paper cutter.
An employee suffered third degree burns on the back and lesser burns in the armpit area while torch cutting on a bolt.
An employee was using a chain and tractor to pull a tree down when the tree fell and pinched the employee's hand between the tree and the tractor. The employee suffered broken bones in the hand.

An employee was cleaning the production floor with acidic chemicals. He was pouring the chemical into a bucket to dilute it when it entered a hole in his glove and contacted his finger, causing a second degree burn that required hospitalization and a skin graft.
An employee was removing an outrigger pad from the far right front side of a rough terrain crane when the employee was pinned between the crane and a trailer, suffering a fractured pelvis.

An employee was trying to remove a jammed piece of wood from a saw when the saw caught the wood, resulting in a fracture of the employee's forearm that required hospitalization and surgery. The saw was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to hitch a trailer to a floating boat dock when his hand was caught between the dock and the trailer, suffering severe bruising and a laceration.

A crew was in the process of putting a sub-spreader beam in place so that they could raise the rig floor. An employee's hand was resting on the spreader beam when the derrick hand pulled the beam from its stowed position. The employee's small finger was then caught between the spreader beam and the sub leg, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was attempting to move a kiln car to add materials to the burner when his right arm was caught between the wall and the kiln car, causing skin to be removed from his arm.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot while walking toward the building, breaking her hip.
An employee sustained a head injury after being struck by a falling object from a storage rack.

An employee was removing a 66-pound slug out of a machine. The employee had a jack under the slug and was attempting to put a washer on when the jack slipped, causing the slug to fall and hit the employee's right middle finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
On 3/30/2018, an employee was operating a chop saw when the employee's left hand contacted the blade, requiring a surgical amputation of the index finger.
An employee had just finished mopping the floor when she tripped on her shoe lace and fell to the ground, fracturing her left femur.
An employee was riding up in a scissor lift when the employee's finger was caught between the lift and a piece of conduit, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was feeding handrails into a bending machine when his gloved right hand went into the machine, amputating the first digit of one of his fingers above the knuckle.
An employee was airing a tire when the tire burst and debris fractured his hand.
An employee was installing a view point on a chamber body when he lost his footing, slipped, and fell, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was feeding wires into a wire stripping machine when the employee's right hand was caught in the machine, lacerating two fingers.
An employee was working on an escalator when he was struck by an escalator step, lacerating his left lower leg.

An employee was performing HVAC maintenance at the ceiling level. While he was moving his fall protection lanyard from one side of a beam to another, the working surface on which he was standing collapsed. He fell to the floor, breaking three ribs and his scapula.
An employee was cleaning a work area with a hose when the lid of a batter machine came down on and broke the employee's left ring finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee received burns to his face due to an aerosol spray paint can explosion.
An employee was using a table saw to cut lumber when the saw back fed and then became stuck. As he tried to unjam the saw, the blade contacted his left hand, amputating two fingers.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a piece of equipment when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the drive chain and sprocket, resulting in the amputation the employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold system when a cable line supporting the counterweight for the scaffold broke. This caused the counterweight to suddenly drop and catch the employee's left thumb and index finger between the weight and a steel cross beam, resulting in the amputation of the thumb at the first knuckle and fracture of the index finger.

Two employees were transporting a container of hot grease when one employee tripped, causing the grease in the container to spill to the concrete. She then fell onto the hot grease, receiving multiple burns to the hands and feet.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot. He injured his knee and required surgery.
An employee had just completed slicing deli meat for a customer when he moved his hand and came into contact with the slicing blade, resulting in a partial amputation of his right index finger.
An employee stood up and struck the top of the head on a pallet rack, then fell and struck the side of the head on a pallet. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up the maze for customers to enter the ski lift area when the employee slipped on ice, breaking the left ankle.
An employee was mounting tires when his right index finger was caught in a pinch point, amputating his fingertip.

An employee entered a tower and was vacuuming out adsorbent that was stuck to the inside walls when the adsorbent became detached from the wall and engulfed the employee. The employee suffered upper body trauma and partial asphyxiation, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while installing drywall, striking the back of the head and neck on a step.

An employee was dismantling a pump.  As bolts were removed from the housing, hot water released from the pump, making contact with the employee. The employee suffered burns to the head, neck, arms, trunk, chest, hips, and thighs.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on conveyor belts and checking a malfunctioning belt when his finger was caught between the belt and the conveyor frame, amputating his fingertip. The conveyor was running at the time.
An employee fell while providing a ski lesson, suffering a collapsed lung and possible rib fractures.
An employee was operating a self-dumping hopper when the employee's hand entered a pinch point as the hopper emptied, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

Employees were trying to contain a fire at the bottom of a silo using a water hose. After they contained the fire, an employee opened the silo's side door and a small explosion occurred. One of the employee's suffered second degree burns on the forearms and face (right side).

A pallet in the vicinity broke, causing a 12-foot high stack of pallets containing gas meters to fall and strike the injured employee's work station. The injured, temporary employee was struck in the chest resulting in hospitalization of a partially collapsed lung.

An employee was in a vessel's freezer offloading frozen fish cargo when his left arm became caught between two conveyor belts on the freezer carousel, crushing his left arm from the hand to the bicep. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking by a dolly of milk that was rolling down a chute when the dolly fell over onto the employee. The employee potentially suffered a collapsed lung.

An employee was on skis patrolling the mountain at the end of the day. As the employee transitioned from groomed to ungroomed terrain, the ski binding failed and one ski came off. The employee lost control and pitched into a lift tower, losing consciousness momentarily and suffering broken ribs, a lacerated kidney, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was walking down the stairs with his lunch when he tripped and fell approximately two to three steps, landing on his left shoulder. He suffered a closed radial head fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to put a catheter into a cat when the cat bit her hand. The bite became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was spotting for a forklift driver during pallet reorganization when the reversing forklift struck her, breaking her right leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when he tripped over rails on the floor and fell, striking his head on pieces of equipment. He suffered head lacerations, requiring sutures and hospitalization.
An employee was heating up a yoke nut on a piece of equipment. When he removed the nut, the differential fluid flared up and burned his face and hair.
An employee was operating a service rig when a natural gas explosion and fire occurred, burning the employee's face and neck.
While installing decorative stone on an exterior wall, an employee became dizzy and fell from a 6-foot ladder to the ground, suffering lacerations and possible fractures on the face and head.
An employee was trying to move a pallet when his left pinky finger was caught between the pallet and a rack, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was climbing a ladder to access the ladder jack scaffolding when the employee either tripped or slipped when stepping on the plank and fell. The employee suffered chipped vertebrae in the back.

An employee was on a ladder approximately 7 feet off the ground, using a reciprocating saw to cut a pipe that was hanging from the ceiling. The end of the pipe was not secured, and when the cut was nearly completed, the far end of the pipe swung down and hit the ladder out from underneath the employee. He fell to the floor and landed on his head, suffering a head injury, scratches on his back, and a bloody nose. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling meat off a conveyor belt when the belt amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was sorting debris from a conveyor line when his left index finger was caught and lacerated between the belt and a piece of metal pipe.
While running timed laps on a track, an employee slipped on a wet patch and fell to the pavement, fracturing the left tibia.
An employee was cleaning a packaging machine when the machine started. The employee's right index finger was then caught between the machine's sealer bars, resulting in amputation.

A temporary employee was walking down the metal steps of a horizontal side sheet when he slipped and struck his face and abdomen on a roller. He suffered a chin laceration, fractured nose, and bruised abdomen on the right side.

An employee was attempting to tie his shoe when he lost his balance and fell onto the corner of a three-bay sink, fracturing multiple ribs on his left side and suffering a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee walked back from her car, slipped on wet snow, fell to the parking lot, and broke her right ankle.

An employee was helping to remove wind screens from around the rig when his right little finger was caught between a wind screen and an eye on the side of the doghouse. His right little fingertip was partially amputated.
A maintenance employee was walking when he fell on some ice and struck his head, suffering swelling and bleeding that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a roof cutter when the employee's left middle finger was pinched between the roof cutter's crank shaft and a metal plate, resulting in a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation.
An employee was inserting a plug into a 12-inch valve when the tip of his gloved thumb was pinched between the plug and the body of the valve, resulting in a possible amputation.
An employee miss-stepped while coming down a portable step ladder and fell to the ground, fracturing the right leg.
While hooking a chain to a ladle, an employee was struck in the head by a piece of falling slag, suffering a concussion.

An employee was operating a table saw when the material kicked back. His hand then contacted the sawblade, amputating his left index finger at the second digit and his middle finger at the first digit. His pinky was also crushed.

An employee was connecting structural steel at a height of 13 feet when a piece of steel that was coming toward him bumped the steel he was standing on. He lost his balance and fell to the ground, fracturing both wrists and his right elbow.
An employee was attempting to remove a pipe from a waterline when the pipe moved and caught his foot, fracturing it.

An employee was going to use a forklift to push down a dock plate. The employee's head struck the forklift when it came into contact with the dock plate, suffering a head contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the sidewalk while walking to the front door, fracturing her wrist and forearm.
An employee was re-installing ceiling tile from a ladder when the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the floor, suffering a spinal fracture, broken collarbone, and broken ribs.

An employee was running from a dog while delivering a package when the employee leapt or fell into a vehicle, suffering back and knee injuries. The employee suffered a cut to the knee that required surgery.
An employee was turning a pallet full of molds when his right hand went between a pallet and the backstop. When the pallet rotated, his right thumb tip was caught and amputated in the pinch point.

An employee was installing MC cable from an extension ladder. The ladder feet slipped out as the employee stepped up a rung on the ladder. The employee fell to the floor, suffering sprains and torn ligaments in the ankles.
An employee was operating a pneumatic nail gun when it fired a nail into his knee.
An employee was leading a ski lesson when his ski became caught in soft snow, causing him to fall to the ground and fracture his hip.
An employee was loading packages inside a trailer when she slipped and struck her left-side ribs against a roller. She suffered fractured ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking through a doorway where a plastic parking lot boundary stake (approximately 3 feet in length) was laying on the door threshold, propping open the door. The employee stepped over the stake to exit. When she returned to re-enter the door, she went to reach for the stake to move it and fell face forward, hitting her chin and landing on the concrete floor in the vestibule. She fractured her shoulders.

An employee was replacing a hydraulic hose on a mobile log lift machine when the main boom of the  machine came down and caught the employee's right arm between the boom and the machine frame. The employee suffered right arm lacerations and was hospitalized.
An employee was disconnecting 440-volt, 3-phase temporary power when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered arc flash burns over 18% of the body.

An employee was pulling a cart through a cooler swing door when the employee's foot became caught on the cart wheel and the door. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor, fracturing the left hip and left humerus and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a wooden board when the saw kicked back and lacerated his left thigh, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on 8-foot ladder removing sheetrock from a ceiling in a room with 10-foot ceilings. The ceiling gave way and fell hitting the ladder. The employee then fell and broke his foot and wrist.

An employee was standing on the rig floor when a chain broke while cement was being piped into the casing. The broken chain struck the employee on the hard hat resulting in a laceration and a possible eye socket fracture.

An employee was waiting for a production line to finish. The employee's right hand was on the hoist controls when the employee's pinky finger became caught in the hoist clasp, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift inside a trailer. As he backed out of the trailer, the trailer pulled out from the dock, causing the employee to fall onto the ground with the forklift. He hit his head and received a concussion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was kicking pipe that was being loaded on a pipe rack when a joint of pipe began rolling toward him and another worker. He attempted to stop it, but the pipe rolled over his foot, resulting in an open fracture of the tibia and fibula.

An employee was working on a centrifuge on top of a centrifuge stand. The employee lost footing while stepping down from the centrifuge and fell backward into the handrails. The hand rails gave out, causing the employee to fall approximately 12 to 15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered bruised muscles and a pinched nerve in the buttocks.

An employee was moving a pallet to turn it in a different direction. A nail gun was about to fall and the employee tried to catch it. As the employee reached for the nail gun, the trigger was activated and the nail gun discharged a nail into the employee's right thigh.
While climbing a ladder, an employee missed a step and fell backwards onto a concrete slab, suffering a concussion.

An employee was loading bushings (a part used in the manufacture of commercial truck suspensions) into a hydraulic press when his hand went between the bushing and the piston of the hydraulic press. His left index finger was crushed, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the engine compartment of a manlift lining up the holes on the boom to apply the pin. As another worker hit the pin, it vibrated and caused the employee to lose his balance. He fell 7' 3" to the ground, fracturing his right wrist, dislocating his left collarbone, and suffering two contusions to the back and front of his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a metal ring when the employee's left hand was caught between the ring and a metal platform, amputating the tip of the employee's left-hand middle fingers.
An employee was working on a packaging machine when his right thumb was caught in the chain drive, fracturing and partially amputating his thumb at the distal first phalanx.

An employee was on a ladder (fourth rung) cutting ductwork loose when a piece of the ductwork became caught on an internal metal liner. The ductwork then swung to the side, knocking the employee to the ground. The employee broke both wrists.

An employee was unloading steel roofing panels at a construction site using a forklift with a spreader bar. The mast was fully extended when the forklift tipped forward. The employee's head struck the steel cage, suffering lacerations and a possible orbital fracture.
An employee was forming parts with a press brake when his left hand slipped on a part. His left index finger was then pinched between the tool and the v-die, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping another employee load metal onto a truck when the metal load shifted and fell on his left leg, amputating it below the knee.

An employee was walking when she slipped on the floor surface. As she tried to catch herself, her right hand entered a hot oil container from fryers that were being cleaned. She suffered burns to her right hand and arm.
An employee was installing wall ties when he stepped on a non-scaffold-grade board and fell approximately 20 feet through to the ground below. He suffered back pain and was hospitalized.
An employee lost his balance and fell, hitting his head.
An employee was closing the sliding door of a trailer when his right middle finger was caught in the door, severing his finger pad.
An employee was operating a crane and connecting a jib to the main boom when the jib unhooked from the boom, causing it to strike his head and shoulder. He broke his sternum and L-3 vertebra.
An employee was working on the brake pads underneath a broom (equipment vehicle) when something fell and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken right arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was making adjustments to a bender machine when the employee's right ring finger was pinched and amputated between the bender's carriage and bracket.

An employee was gathering a 3/4" thick, 3' to 4' in diameter piece of plywood from a stack of approximately 9 similar pieces of plywood when the stack tipped over and struck the employee, pinning him against a forklift. He sustained a fractured jaw, fractured ribs, laceration to the lip(s), and broken teeth, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was transferring sanitizing chemical between storage totes and splashed chemical in their face resulting in chemical burns to the face and eyes.
An employee was pre-inspecting a powered industrial truck when he slipped on hydraulic fluid and fell to the floor, injuring his head, back, and hip.

An employee was testing the assembly of a blade part on food processing equipment. He was leaning on a chest-high conveyor while his left hand was between the conveyor and the blade when the blade toggle switch was turned on. The blade then cut and amputated his left index finger and thumb.

On April 4, 2018, an employee was moving material on a pallet jack when a crate of material began to fall over. As the employee attempted to stop the crate from falling, the employee's right pinky finger was pinned by the material, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was gathering samples of frozen chickens that were being conveyed on a product freezer belt to a plastic scrapper when her right index finger was caught in between the scrapper and the conveyor belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The nip point between the scrapper and belt was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee tripped on a pull chain that moves wood up to a resaw and fell against the machine. While attempting to push themselves back up, the employee felt a pop in the lower back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing a strenuous rough march when he collapsed. He was hospitalized with a muscle injury and kidney stones.

An employee was installing a water jet holding fixture into a water jet when the fixture became slightly misaligned with the left locating pin. When the fixture was lined up and fell into place, the employee's glove and right middle finger were caught in a pinch point between the fixture base and the bed of the water jet, resulting in the amputation of the distal tuft of the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a punch press to cut a bracket and amputated the left index finger.
An employee was using a three-step ladder to remove product from a bin when the employee fell to the floor, fracturing the right knee and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on trusses when the ladder slipped out from under him. He fell approximately 14 feet onto concrete, fracturing a heel, a shin, and the L4 vertebra.

An employee was sliding a mechanical seal/sleeve onto a shaft. The shaft has a small groove with sharp edges. The employee's hand was on the shaft with his finger in the groove. When the employee slid the mechanical seal/sleeve on the groove, it amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was filling heaters in a filler and moving to a capping machine when the employee's middle finger was smashed between a cartridge heater and the machine press, resulting in a partial amputation.

On April 4, 2018, at approximately 8:30 p.m., an employee was cleaning a pizza dough sheeter machine's rollers when his right pinky finger was caught in the rollers, resulting in a medical amputation at the first knuckle. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a pneumatically actuated chop saw when his left hand entered the table opening where the blade comes up from below the table. The foot pedal was pressed and the saw actuated, amputating his left thumb just above the first knuckle.

A security guard was trying to detain a customer in the employee break room when the customer grabbed the security guard's gun holster and pulled the gun's trigger, shooting the security guard in the left lower calf.
An employee was attempting to adjust a belt on an exit conveyor when the belt pulled his left middle finger in and around the pulley, amputating his fingertip. The conveyor was running at the time.
An employee was unloading tools from a truck when he fell off the truck and landed on his left side, suffering bruised ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was reinstalling wiring on a lowboy trailer. The door on the hydraulic compartment was open. Strong winds from a storm blew the hydraulic compartment door shut and the employee's right hand was caught in the door resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was grinding material with a handheld grinder when the grinder slipped from his hands and fell on his left foot, lacerating it and requiring stitches.

An employee was attempting to attach a lifting clamp to a steel flange plate when the plate fell approximately 6 inches, pinching his fingertip between the ground and the plate. As he pulled his hand out of the pinch point, the fleshy part of his fingertip ripped off of his finger.
An employee was attempting to shackle the right rear leg of a cow when the cow kicked the employee's head, resulting in a concussion.

An employee entered a scrap dumpster to remove metal scrap. As he was attempting to remove metal scrap, an aluminum table in the dumpster fell, striking and knocking him down into the bottom of the dumpster. He was pinned by the aluminum table and unable to free himself, suffering a head contusion and back injury/strain. He was hospitalized.

On April 4, 2018, an employee was leaving the kitchen when the employee's left hand was caught on the hinge side of the service door, crushing the pinky finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was pulling a hand truck of soda up the steps to deliver to a customer. At the doorway, the employee stepped on a brass plate that was wet, slipped, and fell, tearing the quadriceps muscle.
An employee was operating an industrial table saw to cut a metal part when the saw kicked back and struck the employee's left hand, amputating three fingers.

At approximately 11:15, an employee was stepping up onto a curb in front of the elevator lobby on the G2 level of the garage when he slipped on a wet walkway and fell onto his knees. After he fell, he could not bend his knees or get up. He tore a knee tendon and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a kettle and added chlorine to the hot water and chemicals that were already in the kettle. When he added the chlorine, the water bubbled up and burned him, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to cross the road to pick up a trash can when a driver swerved around a car in front of him, and struck the employee, who suffered minor bruising.

An employee was cutting carbon steel on an automated bench saw when he lost consciousness and fell, striking his head on the concrete floor. He suffered a laceration, concussion, and hematoma to the head.

An employee was conducting housekeeping operations around a wood chipper when the employee's hand potentially became caught in the wood chipper conveyor. The employee suffered amputations of the pinky finger and ring finger.

An employee was hand feeding strips of steel into a full-revolution press and punching out multiple parts from a single strip. He was trying to remove the raw material skeleton blank from the die when the press cycled, causing the die to close on his hand. The die came to a stop at the bottom of the stroke, trapping his hand in the die and severing his left middle fingertip.
An employee was standing outside a potato truck and pulling a mat that was under some potatoes when the mat broke, causing him to fall and land on a railing. He broke his left leg and arm.
An employee was removing an existing concrete culvert with an excavator when the concrete culvert broke, causing a jolt to the employee, who suffered five fractured ribs.
An employee was rinsing out the methanator tank from the top portal opening when the employee lost consciousness. The employee recovered and was helped down by other employees at the job site.

An employee was using a handheld shovel to level out a ditch for a retention pond pipe. At the same time, an off-road truck was being loaded beside the retention pond. A rock (2 to 3 inches in diameter) then fell off the dump truck and rolled downhill into the ditch, striking the employee. The employee suffered back and left side injuries.

An employee was cutting wire with a quickie saw to remove the core of a storm drain structure. When he got to the last wire, the concrete fell on the saw and knocked it out of his hand.  The saw landed on his left ankle, lacerating it.
An employee was adding a belt onto an HVAC unit when the employee's right ring finger was caught between pulleys and consequently amputated.
An employee working with pallets began to have chest and rib pain.
An employee slipped on an ice patch while walking across the parking lot, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was operating a rebar bending machine and caught their glove in the machine's roller resulting in a degloving injury.

An employee was manually pushing a conveyor part to prepare the line for a pallet transport when his right pinky finger was pinched between two conveyors, (one belt, and one gravity roller conveyor) that were not running at the time; resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working at the log deck of the hew-saw. He was attempting to free a stuck log when the rotary feeder pushed the log, causing his left foot to become pinned between the log and the wall of the equipment. This resulted in a fracture to his left foot, requiring hospitalization. The rotary feeder was in operation at the time of the incident.
On 4/05/2018, an employee was in a car accident due to ice/slick roads. He broke his arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking from her car when she fell on some steps outside the cafeteria and landed on the ground, striking her head and suffering a brain hematoma. She was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a coworker drill out bad grain with an electric drill when the employee's loose-fitting glove became entangled in the drill's chuck. The employee suffered fractures to the left index, middle, and ring fingers; a laceration to the left index finger; and a subsequent amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee slipped on ice and fractured his ankle.
An employee was moving a trash can when he tripped and fell, potentially suffering multiple leg fractures.

An employee was operating a spring forming machine to cut a compressed piece of wire when a piece of metal flew and struck the employee's chest. The employee suffered broken ribs and internal organ damage that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a stand-up reach forklift to unload material. As the employee backed up, he was pinned between the forklift and a wall. He tried to exit the forklift but suffered a broken pelvis and internal bleeding.

An employee was hooking up a mail transporter to a tow motor. He was holding onto an APC (all purpose container), using his foot to connect the second APC to the tow bar, when his foot became tangled in the tow bar and caused him to fall. He held onto the APC to prevent his fall and dislocated his right shoulder, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was securing the roof of a manufactured home from the rear of a mobile scaffold when the scaffold moved, causing him to lose his balance as he was walking toward the catwalk. He then fell 9 feet to the ground through a gap between the mobile scaffold and the catwalk, fracturing his collarbone and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was watching a mini excavator operator drive the equipment when the excavator ran over and fractured the employee's right leg.

An employee tripped and fell as he was walking around and troubleshooting a machine. His left hand landed in the machine, and his index finger became trapped in a gear. The gear amputated his left index finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was descending from a ladder with a drill while a second employee was on the ground. As the first employee came down, his drill caught and cut the second employee's neck.

While moving a box with parts, an employee tripped over the corner of a pallet, fell, and hit the corner of the table. The employee suffered hematoma to the left breast area and a knee, as well as a blood clot.
An employee was finishing delivery to a customer's home. The employee's left thumb was crushed in the gate on the back of the truck while closing it.

An employee was adding mortar to a mixer when he noticed some build-up inside the mixer. He was attempting to clean the build-up when the mixer's rotating blade caught his gloved left hand, amputating his index finger and damaging his middle finger (possible amputation).

An employee was running a peeling machine when he noticed some scrap foam by the blade. As he attempted to remove the scrap, his left hand was caught by the blade, cutting his pinky, ring, and middle fingers. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was performing a take-off above a ceiling measuring duct. The ceiling was 2 x 10 plywood decking with plywood below. He walked off the plywood and slipped and fell through the sheetrock ceiling, striking and lacerating his head on a pile of material.
An employee was operating an idle roller. The brackets failed and the idle roller struck the employee, resulting in contusions.
An employee was trying to fix a roller on a conveyor belt when the rollers caused an amputation/crushing injury to his left hand. The conveyor was running at the time.

An employee was closing a gate on an APC when the secondary safety latch released, causing the upper shelf to fall and strike the middle section, which then fell onto the employee's right hand. The employee's right hand was crushed, suffering a fracture and swelling.

An employee was using a "tugger" to help another employee move two-tier racks with a forklift. The forklift knocked over the top tier of racks. The employee using the tugger fell while getting out of the way of the falling racks or the racks struck the employee and he fell. The employee sustained a fractured jaw.
An employee was working on a scaffold when he fell approximately 60 feet through the boards he was walking on to the ground.
An employee was cleaning a flower bed and was bitten by a rattlesnake on the left index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee's right foot was run over and crushed by a forklift being driven by another employee.
An employee was performing a drill outside and changing his SCBA tank when he stepped against a curb and tripped. He fell and fractured his hip.

After installing a camera system inside the cab of a truck, an employee mis-stepped while using the cab's ladder to exit and fell to the ground, fracturing his right pelvis. He had tools in his hand at the time.
An employee was on a roof attempting to remove a piece of underlayment when the employee stepped back and fell from the roof to the ground, suffering fractured ribs.

An employee was rinsing (spraying water) down a piece of equipment (pump) when he attempted to remove a piece of pipe. He removed a clamp from the pipe, and his finger entered the pipe. A blade (flight) that moves water inside the pipe then amputated his left middle finger at the first joint.

An employee was standing on an out feed table stacking boards when the fork carriage moved forward, catching his left leg between the fork carriage and a roll case. His left leg suffered a laceration/fracture. The out feed table was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was nailing framing above his head at a residential property when the nail gun fired a nail into his head. He was hospitalized and had brain surgery.
An employee was installing a unitizer when he lost his footing on non-powered conveyors and fell to the cement walking surface, breaking his left elbow.

An employee was hanging a sign while working from an extension ladder when the hooks for the fly section slipped, causing the ladder to drop. The employee fell and contacted an intermediate shelf, suffering a concussion.
Employees were unlatching a trailer when the trailer moved, catching the injured employee's left index finger between the truck and the trailer hitch. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a chop saw when the guard broke. The saw then cut his fingers, resulting in one partial finger amputation and one finger laceration.
An employee was walking by a pallet jack when a box fell off the top. She attempted to avoid the box and tripped over her own feet, fracturing her upper leg.

An employee was lifting a metal grate off the top of a ribbon blender when the grate slipped. The employee almost dropped the grate, which tipped toward the back of the ribbon blender. His hand slipped down to the bottom of the grate where his finger became pinched between the grate and the stop point of the gate. His left small fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking between vans in the parking lot when he lost his balance on uneven pavement and fell, breaking his hip.

An employee was trying to manually rotate a shackle that was turned in the wrong direction when his right hand was caught in the in-line shackle turner to his right, crushing his right index finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was moving a chip cart to a chip pit to have the metal chips dumped when the employee fell approximately 3 feet into the pit, landing on a bin. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left middle finger, bruising, and a possible broken rib.

On April 6, 2018, an employee was coming down after installing cameras and walking along the joists at a front entrance when he missed a joist and fell approximately 10' to the concrete below. He suffered an internal brain bleed, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck (PIT) in reverse. The employee's hand was outside of the PIT when it came into contact with a skid, crushing the employee's index and middle fingers and resulting in two fingertip amputations.
An employee was operating a forklift when his left leg went outside of the forklift and was pinned against a guardrail, fracturing his left ankle.

On April 6, 2018, an employee was descending a stair to an airfield when she fell to the ground, hitting her head on the concrete floor and suffering a skull fracture, concussion, and cranial hemorrhage.

An employee was operating a wood notching machine (notcher) when the blades or delta heads of the notcher amputated three of his right middle fingers. The blades were unguarded and the machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee stepped into an equipment curb area (approximately 6' x 10') that had a roof opening (approximately 2' x 5') that was covered with plywood. The plywood was not secured and moved. The employee then fell through the opening approximately 15 feet to the level below.

An employee was unloading pipes off the back of a truck. As the employee removed a section of pipe, the 2 x 3 wood spacer that was in place between the pipes came loose and struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was attempting to use a conduit seal-off tool to push a dart when the dart struck his left leg above the knee, breaking his femur.
An employee was bending metal using a press brake when his right hand was caught between a piece of metal and the press brake, breaking four fingers. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were working together to lower a transformer hood. One employee let go of the hood and it fell onto the injured employee's hand  amputating the left middle finger's distal phalanx, second digit.
An employee was holding a door when wind blew it. The door then caught and caused an amputation to the employee's left ring finger.
An employee was removing concrete forms from the top of a company truck when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, fracturing his ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was escorting a person to inspect equipment on the roof when the employee slipped and fell on ice, fracturing the left femur.
An employee was descending a ladder from the roof when the employee fell to the concrete pavement below.

An employee was manually loading a delivery truck with 65-pound tractor trailer jack stands when the employee's left middle finger was caught between two jack stands, amputating approximately 1/2 inch of the finger.
An employee was removing a coupling on a steam valve. The valve was under pressure, and when the steam was released, the coupling hit and crushed his right middle finger.
An employee was cutting lettuce with a standard chef's cutting knife when the blade amputated the employee's thumb tip.
While cutting grass on a zero-turn mower, an employee fell approximately 10 to 16 feet from a box culvert to the surface below, suffering severe injuries.

An employee was removing cargo straps from the truck on a flatbed, low-profile trailer. The employee sat on the edge of the trailer, which was approximately 4 feet above the ground, and dismounted. Upon impact with the ground, the employee fell and fractured the right hip.
An employee was lifting a cooler that he thought was empty (but was packed with utensils) when he lost his balance and fell, injuring his lower back.  He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was operating a grapple truck and loading 30-foot sections of railroad track at the storage yard. The end of the rail struck his abdomen and pinned him against the truck seat while he was attempting to load the rail on the truck. He suffered a traumatic hernia of the abdominal wall.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift while walking to a building, suffering a broken leg and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
While cleaning equipment, an employee fell from the steps and struck their head against a machine, suffering head trauma. The employee also suffered a twisted leg/hip.

On 4/7/2018, at 2:30 p.m., an employee was stripping concrete dismantling form-work. He removed a U-bolt and was climbing down a shoring frame when he slipped and fell about 10 feet to the ground, fracturing his left wrist and requiring hospitalization. He was wearing harness and lanyard and was anchored to the shoring frame at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a forklift when it tipped over while making a turn. The employee was tossed from the cab and pinned at the waist between the top frame of the lift and the ground. The employee was hospitalized with crushing injuries.

An employee was walking alongside a forklift that was carrying panels when he lost his balance and tripped. The forklift ran over his foot, causing fractures that led to a medical leg amputation 6 inches below the knee.

An employee was descending a ladder after washing windows when one foot of the ladder sank into the dirt, causing it to shift sideways. The employee then fell off the ladder to the ground, fracturing two ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a tow motor and stopped it. He stepped off of the tow motor and it began to move. He tried to stop it but slipped, and the tow motor struck him. He suffered broken ribs, a concussion, and cuts.
An employee was operating a machine that clamps onto a metal-framed brush and drills holes in it when her fingertip was caught in the clamp. She suffered a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was crossing a road when she tripped on the pavement and fell forward, injuring both hands and her stomach.
An employee was using rope to lower a pallet jack to a lower level when the employee's right pinky finger became tangled in the rope, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was raising a pendant crane when the hook became caught on a spacer block and knocked the other blocks over. The blocks rolled to the floor and onto the employee's feet, fracturing both.
An employee was taking a cart with trash to the dumpster when her foot was caught on the cart, causing her to fall to the ground and fracture her right hip.

On April 7, 2018, at about 10:15 a.m., an employee was on a ladder placing a drip pan under a mezzanine. He was descending the ladder when the drip pan moved out of place and hit the ladder, causing him to fall from the ladder onto his left arm. He suffered a compound fracture to the left arm and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee twisted to reach for something while working at the counter and experienced severe back pain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was transitioning off the ladder onto the lower roof, lost his footing and fell resulting in a skull fracture and brain swelling, a broken collar bone and a severed artery in the brain.
An employee tripped while climbing house steps to deliver a package. She used her left hand to brace for the fall and fractured it.

An employee was working from a straight ladder putting the cover on a junction box while another employee braced the ladder. The foot of the ladder slid out and dropped the employee 3 to 4 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

An employee was dumping a hopper on a forklift attachment. The attachment dumped the load and was returning to the upright position at the same time that the employee's left index finger was in a pinch point position. The employee's left index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was checking the granule flow from a silo to a conveyor when the silo pneumatic door closed on his right ring finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking downstairs from the second to the first floor when he missed a step, lost his balance, and fell, suffering a head concussion.
An employee was at the airport traveling to a training for work when she tripped over a curb, falling and hitting her knees. She fractured her right patella.
An employee was swabbing a glass mold when his hand was caught by the funnel arm, burning the palm of his hand.
An employee was found trapped in a conveyor belt system. The employee suffered abrasions to the right side of the head, right shoulder, and upper right back; ruptured ear drums; and left knee pain.
An employee was attempting to place a harness on a boar when she was pinned between the boar and a crate, tearing ligaments and tendons in her lower left leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a ceramic ring that was stuck to a target when the lid came down and amputated his fingertip (no bone loss).
An employee's right ring fingertip was caught and amputated between a manlift guardrail and a ship ramp as a second employee was attempting to free the manlift basket from the ship ramp.
An employee's left hand was inside skid rail pin holes checking the alignment when the skid rail moved backwards and amputated his left middle and index fingertips.
An employee was completing preventive maintenance on a screw conveyor oxide reactor when the machine amputated two of his fingers and partially amputated a third finger.
An employee was making collars to go into the hole at an oil drilling rig when the drill collar tongue struck the middle part of the employee's body.
An employee suffered an upper muscle injury while exercising and conducting physical training. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attaching a cable to a plug container to move it to the main rig floor. The employee had attached a hook to the plug container and was turning to continue pulling it when the employee stepped backwards into a pipe nest, falling approximately 2 feet and landing on a drill collar or pipe. The employee suffered a contusion and small crack to the right femur, requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee was directing the driver of a trailer truck that was backing up into the bay to make deliveries. The driver stopped the truck and got out to see what the employee was trying to tell him.
