The truck then rolled backwards and pinned the employee between the dock and the truck resulting in injuries to the employee's right side inclusive of his legs, ribs, back and abdomen requiring surgery.

An employee was fabricating a four-post stand. While the employee was bolting the stand together, one of the posts (weighing approximately 1,500 pounds) fell over and struck the employee's head. The impact resulted in fractures to the C6 and C7 vertebrae and a laceration to the employee's head.

An employee removed the master link out of the chain supporting a counterbalance that he thought had no weight. The counterbalance then fell and struck his upper arm, lacerating it and peeling off the skin.
An employee was coming down the ladder on the back of a trailer when he lost his balance and fell onto the ground, fracturing his right leg.
An employee was welding a 1,000-pound beam that was sitting on two stands when the beam rolled off the stands and pinned him to the floor, injuring his right leg and right arm.
An employee was walking down stairs, missed the last step and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee was sanding drywall in the corridor of a building when he fell approximately 6 feet from the platform of a wheeled baker scaffold to the concrete floor, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was going in and out of an attic via the access ladder when the third rung of the ladder broke, causing him to fall about 3 feet to the floor. He experienced back and shoulder pain, requiring hospitalization.
While securing a load on a tractor trailer, an employee tripped on the girder and fell to the ground, suffering head trauma.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut smaller pieces of wood from 2- by 3-foot wood parts. The employee was holding the wood with his gloved left hand when the saw caught his glove and pulled his hand into the blade, amputating his left thumb tip and index fingertip.
An employee was walking through the WIP area when she tripped on the WIP lane divider, lost her balance, and fell to the concrete floor at the same level. She fractured her right hip.

An employee was descending a ladder from the second floor of a remodeled construction site when he stumbled, lost his balance, and fell. He suffered a broken rib, shattered wrist, and a fractured hip and ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a chain to install sewer pipes with the assistance of an excavator when his thumb was caught between the chain and the pipe, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was helping another team member move a 1/4-inch steel plate. As he was sliding the plate off the table, a piece of metal underneath the plate fell onto his right foot above the steel toe, breaking bones.
An employee had been using a pressure blasting gun. As the employee was moving an aerial, the pressure gun abruptly started and the water blast hit his leg, causing a laceration.
After cleaning wet grain from a bin, an employee fell 99 feet from the exit at the top of the bin, suffering a broken arm and pelvis.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking, sustaining injuries to the right heel, right knee, and the back of the head.

An employee was walking down module stairs carrying a tote that was approximately 1.5 feet by 2 feet. On the last stair, she lost her footing and fell, fracturing her left knee and elbow. She was hospitalized.
An employee was using a knife to cut banding on flattened boxes. The knife slipped and lacerated the employee's left forearm. The laceration required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking in the parking lot, breaking her leg.

An employee was taking a wheeled garbage can outside to the dumpster when the wheeled base came off on the ground. The employee did not notice the wheeled base on the ground and stepped on it, which caused him to fall to the pavement and fracture his left hip. It was dark outside at the time of the incident.

An employee was kneeling down next to an ice machine to unclog the drain. When the employee rotated his upper body to reach the drain, he felt a sharp pain in his lower right back. He was then unable to move. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee tripped over a chair leg while standing up, fell and broke the right hip.

An employee was performing site preparation on a roof when he fell approximately 17 feet through a skylight to the ground. He suffered broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and shoulder injuries and required facial surgery.

On April 9, 2018, an employee was vacuuming the floor at a client's house when the employee tripped over an extension cord and fell to the floor. The employee suffered contusions to the right side of the head and body, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was checking measurements on a vertical mill to drill two holes in the blank channel of a lubricator part when his gloved hand was drawn into the drill bit, resulting in a left index finger amputation. The vertical mill was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was dismantling a giant theme park wheel. As the injured employee was putting a pin on a screw jack, another employee who was holding the screw jack let it go. The screw jack fell on the injured employee's finger, severing the fingertip.

On April 9, 2018, an employee was cutting fiberglass with a right angle grinder when the grinder kicked back, catching and lacerating the employee's right hand between the thumb and index finger. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches.
An employee was attempting to pick up a flower stem cutter when the cutting bar cut her right middle finger, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell while moving an air compressor. The air compressor landed on his left his hand, pinning it to the ground.

An employee was securing a forklift to a flatbed truck with a chain and bar when the bar snapped and struck him in the face, causing a laceration, nerve damage, severed artery, and salivary gland damage.
An employee was trimming a neck bone with a band saw when the blade lacerated his left ring and middle fingers. He was hospitalized. The band saw was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut hams when the saw partially amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee fell from a concrete catcher basket to rip rap (rock) and suffered a broken nose and contusion to the chest.
An employee was helping to erect a steel building when he slipped and fell approximately 14 feet off a beam and contacted the ground, breaking his right ankle and heel.
An employee and a coworker were lifting pieces of a stage and stacking them on a cart when the employee felt sharp pain in his back and collapsed onto his side. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing udders with a knife when the blade severely lacerated his left calf.

An employee was standing underneath a column dumper cleaning up food waste when a cart of diced potatoes fell from the column dumper and struck the employee, causing multiple fractures and a punctured lung.

An employee was walking down a warehouse aisle while a coworker was driving a forklift truck from the opposite direction. They passed each other, but the forklift truck driver remembered that he had a question for the employee. The driver reversed the forklift truck and the employees had a conversation. Once the conversation was over, the employee turned to walk behind the forklift truck. The forklift truck driver forgot he was in reverse and hit the employee, driving over the top of his leg. The employee sustained an open compound fracture to the left leg.
An employee was struck by the skid load on a pallet jack being operated by another employee. His leg was pinned and broke 4 inches above the ankle.
An employee was in his truck at a loading dock to make a delivery when he stepped into the gap between his truck and the loading dock and fell. He suffered an infection and possible fracture.

Two employees were replacing a 3-inch fire hose on a dock. A nylon rope was tied to one end of the fire hose and to a forklift. The forklift was used to stretch out the fire hose. The nylon rope snapped under tension and struck the injured employee in the mouth, causing a laceration and swelling of the lip.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking, suffering a broken left wrist.

An employee was changing a J-hook on a trailer while standing on a 14-foot A-frame ladder when the employee slipped and fell from the fourth rung to the ground, suffering broken ribs and vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was offloading a section of structural steel from a trailer when he slipped on ice and the beam landed on his finger. This pinched his fingers between the concrete and the beam, resulting in a right ring finger amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder after cutting down awning. The employee missed a rung and fell approximately 6 feet, rupturing the spleen and requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a 2-inch joint of pipe when the pipe struck the lid of a toolbox. The employee tried to catch the lid when it was closing, but it struck his left ring finger, resulting in an amputation before the first joint.

An employee was moving a pallet so it could be loaded by a forklift. The employee was utilizing a strap attached to the pallet when the strap broke, causing the employee to fall backwards into the forks of a fork truck. The employee suffered three fractured ribs on the right side, a bruised spleen and liver, and a laceration to the left ear, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a boom truck. He went to retrieve the outriggers from the driver's side and was caught in between the outrigger and the building wall. The employee suffered a fractured hip and internal bleeding.

An employee was standing at the cash register desk when a third-party vehicle came through the wall and hit him. He suffered a fractured pelvis, cracked ribs, and possible broken femur, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a car in the oil change area when wind caused the car door to move and strike the employee's face. The employee's prescription glasses then broke, and broken glass cut the employee's left eye, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's right index finger was caught in a link of a conveyor belt, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was cutting a fallen tree with a chainsaw when the chainsaw slipped and cut his left leg below the knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was attempting to cut a plastic container with a knife when it slipped and cut his left thumb, injuring his extensor tendon.

Two employees were loading large rolls of material onto a trailer. One employee was using a forklift. He unloaded one roll of material and it rolled across the bed of the trailer and fell off the other side, bouncing into the other employee's leg and fracturing his right fibula.
On 4/10/18, an employee was operating a manual fillet chopper when it partially amputated her fingertip. The chopper was guarded at the time.
An employee was stacking/moving steel beams when they became unstable and fell against the employee. The employee was pinned and suffered bruises, scrapes, and soreness.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet from a portable ladder while installing gutters, suffering a broken ankle and wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward a customer's HVAC unit when he slipped and fell on the garage's wet concrete floor, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving signs to the rear of a truck when he tripped and fell out of the truck onto the ground, fracturing his right elbow.

An employee was operating a web press. He was attempting to wipe up an ink bloat with a shop rag when the rag became caught in the press ink rollers, which then pulled his right hand into the rollers. He suffered lacerations and a broken middle finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood when the blade cut and amputated his thumb tip (no bone loss).
An employee was pulling a tire dolly containing tires outside the building when he tripped and fell onto the dolly/ground while in the parking lot. He suffered a broken hip.
While exiting a truck cab, an employee missed the last step and fell to the concrete pavement, suffering a laceration to the back of the head, as well as pain in the neck, back, and hips.
An employee was injured when a candy cane in a Poseidon tank came loose and a ratchet strap that was holding the candy cane struck and lacerated his arm.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk when she tripped on an uneven area and fell on her left side, fracturing her left shoulder.
An employee was climbing into a truck when he hit his head on the door frame. He suffered a possible concussion, contusion, and hematoma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking between buildings, suffering multiple ankle fractures.
An employee was helping to break up concrete slabs when the employee's right pinky finger was caught and amputated between two pieces of concrete.
An employee fell from an 8 foot A-frame ladder while removing a duct system. The employee's head struck the ground floor.
An employee was using an industrial stapler to construct a shipping crate when a 2-inch staple punctured the employee's right leg above the knee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing a new roll of paper in a machine when the paper became jammed. As the employee tried to pull the paper out, the machine's cross-cutter knife amputated two of the employee's fingers. The machine was unguarded and active at the time.

An employee was dumping shredded paper into a horizontal baler when the wire tie mechanism malfunctioned and did not tie a wire around a bale. He was attempting to fix the issue when his left hand was caught and crushed in the wire tie mechanism, requiring hospitalization. The baler was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee caught a finger on the conveyor belt while picking up a package off the conveyor belt resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee was helping to move some roofing equipment and was walking on the flat roof when he stepped into standing water, slipped, and fell to the same level, breaking his lower left leg.

On April 10, 2018, at approximately 10:40 a.m., an employee was working from a bucket truck, installing a cable to a new utility pole, when his left shoulder made contact with a primary power line. His clothing then ignited, resulting in third degree burns to his left shoulder, neck, and face. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hand cart to take empty containers into the store. While he was wheeling the cart up the ramp, one of the cart's wheels fell off of the ramp. He then fell to a concrete driveway below, fracturing his right tibia and requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning up wood scraps from a table saw when his glove was caught in the blade, resulting in a left index finger amputation.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while using a band saw to cut meat.

An employee was feeding coil into a coil line machine. While readjusting the coil, the employee's gloved right hand was caught in the rollers. A strip of skin was removed from the employee's right index finger. The coil machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was unjamming a graphic packer when the employee's right pinky finger was caught and de-gloved between the machine's belt and pulley, requiring an amputation at the knuckle.
An employee was operating a drill machine when her hand became stuck in it, suffering a laceration.
An employee was using a chain saw when it cut the tendons in his left arm.
An employee was investigating a malfunctioning conveyor belt when his left index finger became stuck and crushed between the belt and the drive pulley.

An employee had cleaned drill pipe threads with rags containing chemical cleaner and then threw the rags into the back of a work truck. Exhaust from a generator inside the truck ignited the rags. The employee grabbed the rags and his coveralls caught fire. He received burns to his hands, stomach, thighs, and lower legs.
An employee was accessing a utility pole, slipped and fell onto a fallen tree resulting in a cracked rib and collapsed lung.
An employee was putting vegetation into a hopper when two of his left-hand fingers were amputated by the hopper blade roller.

An employee was on a scaffold finishing a ceiling with plaster when a pin came out of the scaffold, causing it to move. The employee lost balance and fell 6 feet to ground level, breaking the right ankle.

An employee was clearing a jam on an automated press when another employee activated the press while the injured employee was still in the die. The press die then caught and partially amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers.

An employee was operating a horizontal die press to cut out foam rings. The employee used the manual switch to cycle the press and the employee's right hand was caught between the ram and the cutting blade die. The employee suffered a right hand laceration and two fingertip amputations.
An employee was taking a glass of water to a bedridden client when she tripped over the client's baby bounce, fell to the floor, and broke her hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to load a derrick board onto a flatbed haul truck with a forklift. His hand was between the forklift fork and derrick board as he tried to remove a rope from the bottom section of the derrick tarp. The derrick board then shifted, catching his right hand and wrist between the derrick board and forklift fork. He suffered fractures to the right wrist and hand.

On April 11, 2018, at 1:13 p.m., an employee was walking on the sidewalk and reading a package label to make sure it was the right address when he tripped on an elevation between two concrete sidewalk panels. He fell on his right side and broke his right hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting and rolling material when her hand was caught in the rollers. She suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading freight and unfolding the lift gate deck extension behind a trailer when the employee's left hand became caught in the fold of the lift gate deck extension, resulting in removal of skin on the left ring finger and a laceration to the left middle finger.

An employee was running a power washer when the tip became stopped up. The employee turned the washer off to unclog the tip, but pressure remained in the line. The clogged tip suddenly dislodged, and the residual pressure lacerated the employee's left index finger.
While entering the building, an employee slipped on concrete fines that had been dumped outside the door during floor resurfacing activities. The employee suffered a fractured leg/ankle.
An employee was moving steel drums in a truck when the employee's finger was pinched between drums, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating an excavator to clear trees when a tree shifted in the bucket and broke through the front window of the machine. The tree came in contact with the travel controls, pushing them into the forward position. The machine moved forward farther into the tree, causing it to go through the cab and forcing the employee out the back window of the machine. The employee then attempted to re-enter the machine to shut it down. At this point, the moving machine caused the moving branch of the tree to strike the employee's left hand, smashing and lacerating the ring finger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was descending an extension ladder when it began to slide. He fell approximately 10 to 12 feet to the ground, breaking his hip. The ladder was not secured at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing steel decking. The deck had not been placed across three supports. When he stepped on the deck, it tipped and he fell about 8.5 feet onto concrete forms, breaking his left ankle.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while troubleshooting a packaging machine.

An employee was sorting carcasses when one of the carcasses became caught. The employee turned off the chain and was attempting to free the carcass when the guide bar came off and struck the employee across the bridge of the nose and cheekbone. The employee's nose was shattered.
An employee was clearing sand from a conveyor belt when his pinky finger was caught and amputated between the belt and pulley. The belt and pulley were unguarded at the time.

An employee placed a casting on a fixture in preparation to start grinding. The employee's glove was caught on the casting flash as the part was being rotated, pulling the employee's fingers into the grinder wheel. The employee suffered fingertip amputations and lacerations.
An employee was walking down the hallway when she tripped and fell, fracturing her right knee.

An employee was part of a three-person team transporting a patient to the operating room when she tripped and fell to floor, landing on her right side. She suffered a non-displaced ring fracture to her pelvis and a hemorrhage.
An employee was cutting a barrel with a plasma cutter when a fire started. He was burned on both legs from his knees to his feet.

An employee was picking up safety cones on the interstate and placing them into the back of a pickup truck when he lost his balance and fell beside the truck. The rear wheel of the truck then struck and broke his right ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was preparing to position foam to the table of a foam cutter and slipped from a 17 inch high 4x4 inch square tubing barrier used as a step resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was patrolling a facility in a golf cart when he came up behind a trash truck. The trash truck began to back up, and the employee swerved to miss the truck. The golf cart tipped over, causing the employee to hit the ground and break his ankle.
An employee stepped backward from automatically swinging doors, lost balance, and fell to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to the left wrist and lower arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee became overheated while packaging and experienced facial numbness, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was assaulted by a non-worker while walking in the parking lot, suffering facial fractures.

An employee tripped on the leg of a whiteboard, fell, and hit their head on the floor. The employee remained alert but experienced a seizure after a few minutes and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.

On April 11, 2018, an employee was removing plywood from a picnic shelter when the employee slipped onto a small fiberglass piece, which broke and sent the employee falling approximately 15 feet to the concrete below. The employee suffered a fractured wrist and ruptured spleen, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking in front of a forklift that was moving a concrete slab, holding onto the slab to keep it steady, when the forklift ran over his left foot, ankle, and leg. He suffered broken bones in his foot and ankle.

An employee used a step ladder to get onto a flat trailer and then climbed onto a precast plank. At the same time, a crane was lowering clamps onto a nearby plank to lift it. As the crane lifted the plank off of the truck, the plank came toward the employee. He jumped from the precast plank and trailer to the ground and landed on large rocks. His left leg rolled, breaking his left ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was standing on planking located on the top buck of a two-end frame, tubular-welded frame scaffold when one of the scaffold planks broke, causing the employee to fall 10 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a fractured hip and two fractured ribs.
An employee was taking a tractor-trailer apart when he fell and hit his head.

An employee was trying to throw out construction debris contained in a wheel barrow. The employee went through an unlatched gate on the third floor of a five floor building while attempting to enter a hoist. The hoist was located on the second floor. The employee fell three stories, suffering a dislocated shoulder, possible leg fractures, and a sprained wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
On April 10, 2018, an employee was washing aluminum shelving with water when he fell 6.4 feet through the work platform structure onto a concrete floor, breaking his right wrist.

An employee was trying to come off a well and was laying a tool string to lay up for another run. His hand was on the wireline when the bottom sheave was raised and pinched his right ring finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was taking voltage measurements with a multi-meter while performing preventative maintenance when he contacted live voltage. An arc flash occurred, causing third degree flash burns to his right hand. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to clear an SMC sheet jam when the slitter knife amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was adjusting  a vice on a drill press table when the device shifted, causing his left pinky finger to become caught between the key slot and the fixture. A chunk of flesh was removed.

A temporary employee was stacking material when the punching equipment line was stopped by other employees so they could address the recycling baler. The temporary employee went to the area around the shredder and was attempting to pull some material from underneath a conveyor when the employee's left hand was caught between the roller and the belt of the conveyor. The employee suffered a crushed left hand, fractured left thumb, and skin removal from the back of the left hand.

While conducting shut-down operations on the bottom floor of a fluid cracking catalyst, an employee stepped on a U-drain that cantilevered, allowing both feet to contact hot water condensate. The employee suffered severe burns to both feet and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a left middle fingertip amputation while attempting to clear a jam in a pasta forming machine.
An employee was putting a shim in the pit furnace when he suffered second and third degree burns to his torso.
An employee was rolling out roof insulation between the purlins when the employee fell to a concrete slab below, suffering head injuries (blunt force trauma) and broken bones.
An employee was operating a press when a piece of metal slipped off of a casting and struck his left leg, breaking it above the ankle.
An employee was opening a sliding door with his right hand when it was caught between the door handle and a safety pole outside the door, amputating a fingertip.
An employee was using a knife to cut through the hide of a dead cow for an autopsy when the knife slipped and struck/lacerated the employee's left lower calf muscle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee twisted his back while maneuvering a wheel barrow full of concrete through a building that is under construction.
After cleaning dust off of shelves and straightening up the area, an employee was descending a ladder when she missed the bottom step and fell to the floor, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was removing scrap material from a machine when the employee's right index fingertip was caught and amputated in the machine. The machine was guarded and energized at the time of the incident.
An employee was directing concrete operations when he became dehydrated and was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a photo sensor on a pallet wrapper. As he was lowering the top plate onto the machine, the plate dropped onto one of his fingers, amputating the fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell while descending stairs, injuring the left arm.
An employee was removing posts for a fence when the employee's right foot was crushed between the frame and body of a skid steer.

An employee was cleaning under and around the discharge conveyor of a flexographic printer when the employee's right hand came into contact with the drive chain and pulley, partially amputating the index finger and lacerating the middle and ring fingers.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while climbing a ladder, fracturing most of the bones in his face and suffering a concussion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was hanging a sign on a swinging door while on a motorized cart when a forklift operator reversed through the swinging doors and pinned the employee's foot and ankle between the swinging door and the motorized cart. The employee suffered fractures to the right leg and ankle.
An employee was disassembling a butterfly valve and using a ball-peen hammer to remove the seal insert when the hammer struck and amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.

An employee was returning from a business trip and was at the airport. She was going down on the escalator when she lost balance and fell backwards, fracturing her wrist and neck vertebrae. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a reach forklift and was traveling down an aisle when he lost control of the lift and turned into a racking upright, crushing his left ankle.

An employee was planning to walk into the slab area to inspect some plumbing work prior to a concrete slab pour when he stepped up on the perimeter slab formboard with his right foot and then stepped in a bleeder ditch (located outside the slab area) with his left foot. His right ankle then got in a bind and broke, causing him to fall to the ground outside of the slab area.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a process vessel. While the employee was lowering the vessel head plate into position over the vessel, a member of the lifting mechanism unexpectedly shifted, causing the employee's right ring finger to become pinched between the mechanism and the head plate. The employee's finger was partially amputated.

An employee was walking under an amusement park ride track to diagnose a fault error when the ride's cart bogie (wheel) struck the employee. The employee suffered right shoulder and right ribcage injuries.

An employee was putting straps on steel beams by hand. The smaller beams were being moved by two employees using a long reach arm excavator. A larger steel I-beam flipped and rolled off the block it was on and pinned the employee's ankle to the ground, fracturing it.
An employee was ascending or descending stairs when she tripped and landed on her right hip, suffering right hip pain.

An employee was checking a power swivel's back-up securing line to see if it was tight enough. As he reached out to slap the line, residual stored energy released, causing the securing line to back spin. The line was attached to a turnbuckle with a safety pin in place. The safety pin spun backwards, catching and lacerating the employee's right inner elbow area and causing potential muscle damage.
An employee was installing a metal roof on a non-residential building when he fell approximately 16 feet to the ground below, breaking both wrists. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning out a temperature port when heated carbon powder came out and sprayed his face, neck area, and right forearm. He suffered first degree burns to his chin and neck area and second degree burns to his right forearm, requiring hospitalization. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee loaded a reel of cable onto the payoff machine area. The employee was rocking the reel into place when the reel went too far forward, catching the employee's left ring and pinky fingers between the side of the metal reel and the vertical support structure of the machine's control panel. The employee's pinky fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was using a circular saw when it kicked back and grabbed his glove, resulting in a severe laceration into the bone.
An employee fell 12 feet to the ground while performing electrical work, suffering a punctured lung, broken rib, and back fractures.

While installing a sewer line using the horizontal directional drilling method, an employee was helping to add a drill stem to the tail string when his hand got too close to the nylon sling and the drill pipe and was crushed between the two. His right hand was amputated.
An employee was installing glass on ground level when wind blew a door from its hinges on the second floor. The door struck the employee, who suffered broken neck vertebrae.

An employee was descending on an angled concrete embankment when his right foot slipped downward and shifted his body weight to his left foot. This caused his left ankle to rotate laterally, fracturing it.
An employee lost balance while closing a gate and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee tripped on grass and fell while walking into the building, fracturing the right ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to thread a drawblock on a dry drawing machine by placing a come-a-long chain on the drawblock head when the machine malfunctioned, causing the drawblock to suddenly turn. The chain then tightened and pinched the employee's right ring finger, causing an open fracture and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was installing an electric cable below street level when his foot was caught and lacerated between two metal plates.
An employee had run a water hose through a doorway and was trying to keep the metal door open when high winds blew the door shut on his left hand, partially amputating his index and middle fingers.
An employee was loading a bus from the rear when the bus rolled over its chocks and pinned the employee against a truck. The employee suffered a contusion to the chest area and fractured ribs.
An employee was setting up a machine when he smashed his thumb, resulting in a left thumb amputation.
An employee was performing touch-up painting on a commercial truck when he fell off a ladder, suffering broken ribs and lung injuries.
An employee was helping to spot trailers when a forklift operator ran over his right foot, breaking it.

An employee was working in the back of his delivery vehicle (a tractor trailer) pulling a pallet of food products onto the lift gate of his trailer. As he pulled the pallet to the liftgate, he fell approximately 4 feet from the lift gate to the blacktop street below.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a cant when the saw slipped from his hand and cut the inside of his left foot behind the steel plate of his safety shoe. He suffered a deep laceration to his left foot, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was setting up a hydraulic press brake when his fingers were pinched in the die, amputating four fingers on the left hand and one finger on the right hand.

An employee was patrolling and securing the area to make sure the doors were locked. On the way back to his vehicle, he tripped over a concrete parking block. As he tried to break his fall, he fractured his left wrist.
An employee fell 2 feet while climbing a wooden shelf, breaking his hip.

An employee was standing near a combo machine waiting to relieve someone on the casing puller when he attempted to move casing that was stuck in the combo machine. The rollers grabbed his gloved hand and pulled it into the rubber-clad rollers. His right pinky, ring, and middle fingers were crushed.
An employee was skimming a trough of molten aluminum when it spilled into his boot, causing third and fourth degree burns.
A maintenance employee was working on a banding machine when he slipped/lost his footing and his left leg/calf hit a piece of steel pipe, suffering a laceration.
An employee was cutting down a tree limb when it struck the employee's right arm, crushing it against the tree.
An employee was loading potatoes onto a conveyor belt when the employee's sleeve became caught on the conveyor. The conveyor then crushed the employee's left hand/forearm.
An employee was getting the turf roller off a trailer when the roller ran over his left leg, fracturing it and requiring surgery.
An employee was standing on a pipe one foot off the ground when the employee fell, breaking the right arm.

An employee was attempting to clamp a saw's ancillary vice to advance a piece of stock on the saw when he activated the main vice. The main vice then clamped down onto his left ring and pinky fingers, amputating his ring fingertip.
An employee was prepping for the day when a contractor dropped a CO2 cartridge in a deli fryer and it exploded. The employee received grease burns on the face, arms, chest, and hands.
An employee was descending a ladder when the ladder shifted and the employee fell 10 feet resulting in a fractured left foot and elbow.
On April 13, 2018, an employee was hooking a lavatory dump cart up to a tugger when the employee's right index finger was pinched in the hitch, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.

Two employees were replacing a water pump on a flatbed truck. The water pump had been raised underneath the truck with a jack. The injured employee had just finished removing the bolts that attached the old water pump to the rest of the vehicle, and was attempting to lower the pump to the ground with a floor jack. The second employee attempted to release pressure off of the hydraulic floor jack in order to lower the old part to the ground while the injured employee was attempting to hold the part steady on the jack while it was lowered. The jack lowered faster than expected and the injured employee lost his grip on the part, which rolled off of the jack and onto his abdomen. He suffered blunt force trauma to his abdomen and a torn intestine.

Employees were using a pallet jack stand to move several pallets of stacked ceramic tile weighing approximately 2,200 lbs. from one end of the floor to the opposite end when the tile hit a hole and the bundles of tiles began to wobble. The injured employee was standing on the side of the tile bundles and was attempting to balance them when they eventually tipped over and fell on him. He was pinned beneath the floor tile and a wall, sustaining a displaced open wound fracture to his left foot and ankle that required surgery. He also sustained minor injuries to both of his legs and scrapes, cuts, and bruises on other parts of his body, including a laceration to his head.
An employee was fixing the gate to a silo at a concrete batch plant when the gate fell and caught his right thumb, resulting in an amputation.

On 4/02/2018, employees were replacing a pin in the chain for a slat conveyor. The sledge hammer used to pound the pin into the chain missed the pin and struck the left pinky finger of the employee who was holding the pin. The employee's fingertip had to be later amputated.
An employee was operating a press to separate two pieces of metal when the press turned and lacerated the employee's left index finger above the second knuckle.
An employee moved a bundle of sheetrock in order to look behind it but it fell on his leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to stage a stack of pallets when he lost control of the jack's throttle and crashed into a racking support. His foot was caught between the pallet jack and the racking support, causing a deep contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was offsite at a customer location stocking merchandise and began having chest pains. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on a standup forklift when he became stuck in a hole. Another employee on a forklift was attempting to get him out when the forks of the second forklift struck and injured the employee's right heel.

An employee was installing a top bearing onto a fan inboard shaft when his left ring fingertip was caught in a pinch point between the inner radius of the bearing and the thrust ring, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was finishing up on an interior wall from a baker scaffold when the scaffold fell over. The employee fell over 10 feet and suffered a head injury.
An employee tripped and fell over a broken sidewalk and broke her ankle.
An employee was driving a fertilizer tender truck and moving over to accommodate traffic when the truck rolled over. The employee suffered lower arm avulsions.

An employee was operating a band saw to cut a pork bone when he attempted to catch the meat and his left pointer and middle fingers were caught by the blade, resulting in the amputation of both fingertips.
An employee was attempting to clean debris out of rotary valve piping when the employee's left index finger contacted the rotary valve, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was walking down the hall when she stumbled and fell hitting her head on the wall before landing on the floor. She fractured her C2 vertebra.

Employee #1 was shutting down the system where molten resin goes through a filter prior to being cooled and processed on the belt. The employee tried to clean the material from the filter using nitrogen. The O-ring on the filter failed, allowing hot molten resin to spray out. The employee moved away from the area thinking that the pressure was relieved from the filter. When he returned with another employee, more molten resin sprayed out, burning both employees.

An employee had been cutting through a section of a conveyor that was being removed. He was using a reciprocating saw, handheld grinder, and ladder. He removed one foot from the ladder and placed it on a metal stationary ladder that was inches away. He had one foot on each ladder when the metal ladder shifted, causing him to fall. His left wrist was fractured in two places and he sprained his back.

On April 14, 2018, an employee was attempting to remove bead tape from a spiral wrap machine when he stepped on the foot pedal and engaged the machine. The roller began to move and pulled his left middle finger into the nip point between the roller and machine frame, amputating his fingertip.

An employee bent down to retrieve his keys, which had fallen on the ground in the loading dock area. As he grabbed them, he lost his balance and used the dock's railing to support himself. The railing then collapsed and he fell about 5 feet to the concrete floor, suffering two broken ribs and a fractured pelvis. He was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a 55-gallon drum in place with his right leg while another employee was attempting to puncture the drum with the forks of a forklift. As the forklift operator applied pressure to the drum with the forks, the injured employee's foot became pinned to the ground under the drum, resulting in a fracture to his right leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On April 14, 2018, at approximately 9:50 PM, an employee was straightening a pallet on an overhead conveyor when the employee fell 30 feet to the next lower level. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and torn arm tendons.

An employee was working the wood chipping machine and was attempting to remove the cable hook from the tree when his left hand was caught between the tree and the cable, which tightened up on his hand and severed his left middle fingertip.
While opening and closing valves on stage two of an acid transport, an employee lost footing on the second step and slid down, landing hard on the ground and breaking the left leg.
An employee was steaming out a line when a candy cane propelled out of the tank, striking the employee in the head and hands. The employee suffered a facial cut, facial burns, and a broken hand.

An employee was walking from the guard house to a parked car to sign in a guest when he fell to the ground, hitting his face on the concrete. He fractured his eye socket and suffered minor cuts to his head and face. He was hospitalized.
A crew was attempting to lift a balloon wall when wind caught it, causing the wall to fall back on the crew. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning and maintaining switch gears when an arc flash occurred resulting in burns to the employee's right arm.

The floor of an exam room had been freshly mopped and a "Wet Floor" warning sign had been put out. An employee came into the exam room and slipped and fell on the sign, breaking ribs on his left side. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to lower forks on a forklift when a fork released and fell on the injured employee's foot, crushing the pinky toe and resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was standing on a piece of equipment to assist in a maintenance task when a second employee inadvertently started the equipment. The injured employees' left foot then became caught and fractured in a rotating piece of machinery. The equipment was unguarded at the time.

An employee was using a cart to push a turbine diaphragm out of a temporary sandblasting tent when the wheels encountered sandblasting grit on the floor, which stopped the progress of the cart. When the cart stopped, the weight shifted, causing it to tip over and the diaphragm to fall on the employee s right leg, breaking it.
An employee was loading clips into a robotic welder when a clip fell into or near the machine. As he attempted to retrieve the clip, a moving part struck and broke his hand.

An employee was operating a lift carrying cleaning supplies in the warehouse. The employee reached back to keep a mop handle from falling and struck the racking support. The employee sustained a right leg laceration and femur fractures. The left patella was also fractured.

An employee was lifting a heavy chiller in order to clean the area when the end plate (approximately 300 pounds) fell on his finger while trying to move it. His right middle finger was partially amputated (3/4 inch to the base of the nail).
An employee was profiling door skins on a table saw when his right-hand middle finger and palm made contact with the saw's blade. His middle fingertip was amputated, and his palm was lacerated.
An employee experienced a hernia while lifting something, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was turning a pallet jack around a corner when he met another worker with a pallet jack.  His foot became caught between the two pallet jacks while attempting to negotiate his pallet jack around the other, breaking a bone and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking by a glass panel when his hand struck the panel and was severely lacerated, requiring surgery. Cut-resistant gloves were not worn at the time.

An employee was skiing from the top of a mountain lift station to the bottom when she hit a tree, suffering four broken ribs, a lacerated liver, a bruised kidney, facial lacerations (one required stitches), and a black eye. She was hospitalized.
An employee received an electrical shock when operating a palletizer, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was at a client's automotive shop helping them remove a car frame when his left middle finger was pinched between the car's frame and chassis, resulting in a finger amputation from the nail.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when his left leg snapped/broke, causing him to fall to the ground.

An employee was painting from a mobile scaffold that was 6 feet by 3 feet and three frames high. The scaffold had railings on three sides and no railings at the wall side. The employee was cleaning his painting trail when other employees moved the scaffold about 2 to 3 feet from the wall. At that point, the employee lost his balance and fell about 16 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing both ankles. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On April 16, 2018, an employee was helping another employee install a pin in an auger coupling. As employee #2 struck the pin with a hammer, a small piece of metal flew into employee #1's eye. The employee was hospitalized. Both employees were wearing PPE.

An employee was getting off the roof of a single story house using a ladder. While getting on the ladder from the roof, he stepped on the first course tile adjacent to the ladder and it broke, causing him to lose his balance and fall about 10 feet to the driveway. He fractured his left femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was removing plywood from a roof when he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground, breaking his arm and dislocating a vertebral disc. He was hospitalized.

On April 16, 2018, at 2:20 PM, an employee was inspecting a pipe when another pipe rolled into the pipe he was inspecting, crushing his left index finger and resulting in an amputation at the first joint.

An employee was moving a pallet of material with a non-mechanized pallet lift. The employee lost their balance and grabbed onto the lift, tipping it over and causing the lift to strike the employee's foot. The employee sustained a foot fracture requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unstrapping piping from a truck trailer when two bundles of four pipes came loose and struck the employee, dropping him to the ground. He suffered a bruised head, head injury, internal injuries, bruised spleen, broken left shoulder, and broken vertebrae.

An employee was cleaning and sanitizing a machine when the employee's fingers were caught between the wall of the shaft and the blade as the machine cycled. Several fingers on the employee's right hand were amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was climbing a ladder with a sharp bladed tool when it impaled his right knee as he raised his leg to climb.
An employee was checking paperwork when a forklift inadvertently hit a hand cart that then hit the employee. The employee fell to the ground and fractured a leg.
An employee was feeding a band into a strapping machine when the machine reactivated and caught his left hand, crushing and lacerating it. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was servicing a grease trap at a restaurant. The employee had two trap lids open with a hose running into one of the trap holes. The employee tripped and fell into the open trap hole, fracturing the left femur.
On April 16, 2018. an employee tripped on a door threshold and fell to the floor, requiring hospitalization for a fractured hip.
An employee was walking down a ramp when he slipped on ice, fracturing his left fibula. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing trash on the first floor near a wall opening when the employee slipped and fell off the building to the ground, suffering multiple internal injuries.
An employee was using a crane to lift a 10,000 lbs. part and got his left ring finger caught between the lifting strap and the part as it was raised resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using needle nose pliers to remove a rifle cartridge from an adhesive pot filled with hot glue when the heat from the glue ignited the propellant powder in the rifle cartridge and caused it to burst open. Hot glue then splashed onto the employee's left arm and left hand, causing burns that required hospitalization.

Two employees were trying to loosen a bolt to disassemble a coupler between an engine and compressor. One employee was on the engine side while the other (the injured employee) was on the compressor side holding a shim. When the employee on the engine side turned the bolt for the coupling assembly, the engine crank rolled and amputated the injured employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was reversing a truck into a parking space. He had opened the door to get a better view when he accelerated instead of pushing the brake. The truck went over the curb and he was thrown on the ground against the cement boards (parking stops), breaking a rib and two vertebrae. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice and fell while walking from the main building to another building, fracturing an elbow, knee, and ankle.

Two employees were unloading a box from the back of a truck. One employee was spotting and the other was on the forklift. The box became unstable and fell off the forklift striking the spotter as it fell. The box hit him in the hip area and pinned him underneath. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was standing in the top dog house of a drilling rig when a 3/8" plug shot out of a jar tool and struck him, injuring his left bicep. He was hospitalized.
An employee was providing peritoneal fluid to the son of a patient when the son assaulted the employee. The employee suffered a punctured lung.
While in the process of sandblasting, an employee lost control of the hose and sandblasted his leg. He was hospitalized with severe abrasions and raspberry burns to his leg.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and suffered a seizure after the fall. She suffered fractures to her nasal bones and part of her jaw.
An employee was operating a forklift when it crushed his left foot.
An employee was placing cardboard on a cardboard baler when the pin that secures the press-down plate on the baler broke, allowing the plate to land on and break the employee's left arm.
An employee was walking across a warehouse roof when he fell through a deteriorated section and broke his leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a roller on a press machine when the employee's right index finger was caught and smashed between two rollers.
An employee was climbing a portable ladder with sandblasting gear on when he tripped and fell to the floor, suffering fractures.

An employee was standing on the ground using an overhead crane to move small light beams from a conveyor to a 
staging area when the stack of beams became unstable and started to fall over. As he attempted to get out of the way of the falling beams, he fell to the ground, dislocating/fracturing his left elbow. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee received left index, middle, and ring finger amputations above the middle knuckle when his hand was crushed between a dock plate and the forklift frame. The forklift had fallen between the dock plate and the trailer when the truck pulled away from the dock.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when he tripped and fell to the ground, breaking four ribs. He was hospitalized.
After a tree had been felled, a dead limb fell out of an adjacent tree and struck an employee in the back of the neck and back. He was hospitalized with a fractured neck and back.
An employee was climbing a ladder when the employee's feet slipped. The employee then fell approximately 5 feet from the ladder, fracturing the right ankle.

An employee was clearing a polymer jam buildup in a hydraulic chopping machine when the hydraulic blade cycled and caught the employee's finger between the blade and the bottom metal block. The employee's right index finger was amputated at the second joint.
An employee was stocking shelves when a shelf shifted, fell, and struck the employee's left pinky finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was performing a stream test and opening the ladle stopper mechanism when molten metal splashed on his leg and burned through his protective leggings. He suffered a small burn on his calf and upper ankle.
An employee was attempting to move his car when he slipped on ice in the parking lot and broke his ankle, requiring surgery.

A crane was used to tilt a steel cradle, which was attached on either side with slings. The slings were attached to clamps and the clamps were attached to the cradle. As the cradle was tilted, one of the clamps came loose and swung in the air, striking the back of an employee's head. He sustained a head laceration, requiring hospitalization and stitches. A hard hat was not worn at the time.
An employee slipped on black ice while walking between two parked trailers during a trailer inspection, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was descending the aft port ladder of a derrick to remove a rope from the barge kevel when he slipped and grabbed the winch cable with his right hand. The cable was moving and his right hand was pulled into the snatch block, causing a laceration and amputation of two fingers.

An employee was unloading metal rails from a transport trailer when the rails slid off the trailer supports and struck the employee in the back and lower leg. The employee suffered damaged vertebrae and a lower leg injury, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was installing new metal commercial shelving units when the shelving collapsed and landed on the employee's left pinky finger, amputating it above the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing a portable ladder being held by another employee when he slipped and fell 8 feet inside the vessel, injuring his right heel.
An employee was moving a furnace basket with a hoist when the basket fell off the lifting device and onto the employee's finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was descending a ladder to move from one roof level to another when the bottom of the ladder slipped out, causing him to fall from about the halfway point of the ladder to the lower roof level. He landed on his back and ruptured a disk.
An employee was using a cutting torch to cut a scrap vehicle's brake line when the brake fluid shot out and burned his right eye.

An employee was preparing to take a sample from a tanker truck when a reaction occurred, causing the vapor inside the tank to combust. He received second and third degree burns to his hands, arms, and the top of his head.

At approximately 22:50 hrs. on April 17, 2018, an employee was changing a reel on a machine when the die actuated and came down on his left hand, resulting in a partial amputation to the first knuckle of his index finger.
An employee was using a table saw when he sustained a left middle finger amputation.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of wood when the saw cut and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was receiving hands-on powered pallet jack training and was attempting to turn the pallet jack when the employee struck a storage rack, fracturing the left ankle and leg.

An employee was helping another employee move a RRU from the top of a wooden tower pole to the bottom. Another employee was holding onto a piece of conduit when a gust of wind picked up the conduit. The conduit came down, striking and possibly fracturing the injured employee's right hip.
An employee was aligning lumber on a conveyor as it exited an oven when his glove was caught in the belt, resulting in a partial left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was working from an electric distribution wood pole to remove an electric conductor when the pole broke and fell to the ground. He was utilizing fall protection and the pole was rotten from the inside out. He fell approximately 40 feet suffering broken ribs, a broken left wrist, and a lacerated liver that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing bottles from inside a blow mold flamer machine when her right middle fingertip was cut by a chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a hydraulic press on a hub when something slipped and struck his left thumb.

An employee was standing on a load on top of a truck using a chain to tie down precast concrete beams when he passed out and fell 10 feet off of the truck onto gravel-covered ground, suffering fractured vertebrae.

An employee had just started going down a ladder (+/- 4 rungs) when one of her feet slipped off a rung, causing her to lose her balance. She attempted to catch herself, but was not able to stop her momentum backwards. She hit the concrete floor below, suffering traumatic damage to multiple body parts, including but not limited to her head, neck and shoulder.

An employee was feeding foil inner lid seals into the shuttle stacker on a pint filler machine when some of the seals fell onto the conveyor. The employee attempted to grab a stack of the seals from the conveyor. Her right hand was then caught and pulled into the machine, making contact with the heat seals. She sustained third degree burns on her right palm and forearm and multiple lacerations to her hand and arm, requiring hospitalization. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on a tile floor while walking. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured femur.
An employee was removing a dead fish from a fish tank when the fish's spines stuck the employee's finger, resulting in an infection to the finger and arm.
An employee was removing debris from the job site and was on a digger derrick dumpster truck when he fell off the truck edge to the ground, fracturing his patella and lacerating his forehead.

An employee was operating a roller to roll the asphalt near a handicap post and sign. He pressed the vibration button while moving at around 1 to 2 miles an hour. The roller then drifted to the right, closer to the sign. As he neared the post, his hand was sliced by the sign.
An employee fell to the floor while standing in the break room, suffering a broken hip.

At around 3:30 PM, an employee was using a tool to pry open a manhole to clear the main drain line when the tool slipped while his thumb was in the manhole. The manhole lid then came down on his left thumb and severed it above the knuckle.
An employee was walking across a room on carpet when she tripped over her own feet and fell, fracturing her hand and bruising her face and knees.
An employee was loading a racking system when it collapsed on top of the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis, femur, and ribs.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move pallets of product through a warehouse. He was attempting to reposition the jack when he backed against the racking behind him. His arm was pinched between the rack and the pallet jack, resulting in a pinched nerve.

An employee manually moved material on a conveyor without the knowledge of the injured employee. The injured employee's hand was then pinched between two bundles of material on the conveyor, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.

On April 18, 2018, an employee was helping to clean out heat exchangers when a metal rod attached to a cordless drill used to clean salt deposits slipped and fractured/lacerated the employee's right thumb.
An employee tripped over an object while providing in-home care to a patient, breaking a leg.

An employee was using polishing paper to polish the rotating shaft on a lathe machine when her right-hand fingers were pinched by the polishing paper and her wrist was pulled down into the rotating shaft. Her right wrist was fractured and three digits were de-gloved.

On April 18, 2018, an employee was standing on a bale of hay while restacking straw in a barn when the straw bales moved, causing him to lose his balance and fall. He hit a railing as he fell and landed on the other side, breaking ribs and requiring surgery.

On 4/18/2018, at 8:00 PM, a pallet of juice, which was being moved by an electric pallet jack, struck the corner of a packing table, causing it to pin an employee between the table and the discharge conveyor. The injured employee suffered contusions to her abdomen and back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was setting up the conference room when a table tipped on his toe, causing trauma that required surgery.

An employee was walking backwards while operating a concrete burnisher when he tripped over a protruding pipe and fell. The burnisher handle then hit his abdomen, perforating his bowel and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was ground-guiding a loader that was moving a suspended concrete block. The loader went down an incline and the concrete block swayed. As the operator lowered the block, it came loose and struck the employee's foot, breaking it.
An officer was participating in training when a flash-bang grenade exploded in or around his hand lacerating it.
An employee was operating a drill when he lost control of it and it fell onto his arm, deeply lacerating an artery. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was stacking pallets and lifting one overhead when it fell back and landed on the employee's head, causing a laceration.

An employee had just topped a white pine tree and was using his climbing line to descend the tree when he lost his footing and fell approximately 40 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and a broken wrist.

On April 18, 2018, an employee was attempting to clear a jam on a machine when a second employee accidentally engaged it, causing the machine to lower on and crush the first employee's left lower arm.

An employee was cutting short ribs with a band saw. While pulling the meat through the saw with his left hand, his right index finger contacted the blade causing a partial amputation to the side of the finger.
An employee was attempting to take a part out of a punch press machine's point of operation when the machine actuated, crushing her right index finger and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was drinking coffee when she inadvertently dropped her coffee mug, which struck a chair and then impacted the floor mat. The cup handle broke and struck the employee's foot, causing a puncture wound and bleeding that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was trying to open the rear door of his hostling tractor when he lost his footing and slipped off the tractor. He hit his head and left shoulder.
While performing maintenance activities, an employee experienced back pain that required hospitalization.

An employee was undergoing SWAT paramedic training. He was on the monkey bars when he swung his feet up, slipped and fell about 7 feet off of the monkey bars, and landed on his head. He fractured his D6 and D7 vertebrae, requiring surgery.
An employee was helping a press brake operator bend a part when his right hand became caught between the metal part and tooling, lacerating and fracturing it.
An employee was dropping books into a binding machine and pinched the tip of her right middle finger in the clamp resulting in fingertip amputation.
An employee was inspecting a leaking roof when he fell approximately 39 inches to a lower roof, fracturing his left wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was manually closing the passenger door of an aircraft because the door's hydraulics were broken when his right pinky finger was caught between the door and the body of the aircraft, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was feeding blocks on the finger jointer and got her left pinky finger caught between the lug and the feeder plate amputating it at the first digit.
An employee was pounding a header onto a metal tank and struck his hand with a sledgehammer resulting in amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee was setting up the excavation with lamp light and fell into the excavation after his glasses fogged up. The employee sustained a fractured rib.
An employee was helping to open a door and got her left index finger stuck in the door latch. She pulled her finger away and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood with a portable saw when the tool lacerated his right thumb.
Employees were using a forklift to raise a conveyor. The straps attached to the forklift forks slid off and the conveyor fell onto the employee's left foot fracturing the tibia and fibula.
While working with a crane, an employee was hit by a 1.5-ton magnet, suffering a broken pelvis and L5 vertebra fracture.
An employee was sandblasting when the hose became disconnected. As he attempted to fix the hose, his right arm was sandblasted. The sandblaster was running at the time.

An employee was helping to load a container with logs. The logs are picked up with a knuckle boom loader and placed onto racks for temporary storage. The racks are then pushed into 40-foot containers with a front-end loader. Jockey trucks are used to position the containers at/in the loading area. The injured employee was standing in the loading area helping to load a container with logs when a 19-foot log from the knuckle boom loader fell onto the employee resulting in a broken facial bone, a broken femur and a cracked right hip joint.
A temporary employee was changing a bay door rope from inside a man cage lifted on a forklift and fell approximately 7-8 ft. to the ground resulting in right arm and ankle injuries.
An employee was assisting a co-worker change a forklift battery using a large automated battery changing system. The employee was caught in the middle of the system and suffered broken ribs.

An employee was using a hand-held drill to ream a hole in a sheet metal bracket held in a vice. The injured employee was attempting to remove a wire loop from the hole being drilled when his glove was caught in the bit. The glove pulled the middle finger on his left hand into the bit, causing cartilage and tendon damage that resulted in a finger amputation.
On April 19, 2018, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift while walking in the packing area. The forklift crushed the employee's foot, resulting in an amputation below the knee.
An employee reached up to a window sill to retrieve her phone and the window closed on her right pinky finger amputating the fingertip.

An employee was using a crane to lift a 1,200 lb., 36" x 18" solid copper block that was chocked with a nylon strap. The strap was not centered. When the employee lifted the block approximately 3" from the pallet it was sitting on, the block pivoted, fell from the strap, and struck the employee on his right foot. His 1st, 2nd and 3rd metatarsal bones were fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell and suffered laceration injuries to his head.
An employee received a burn to the face when lighting a pilot light on a gas furnace at a residential home with a match.

An employee was retrieving a tool that was dropped into the container former machine when the baffle arm on the machine struck the employee's elbow forcing the employee's right hand into the machine where it was trapped under a baffle. The employee's right ring finger was amputated just above the knuckle.

An employee was inserting a hand held wand with a burning cloth attached to the end into a 4" opening of the main burner valve to ignite the pilot. The flame ignited residual gas and burned the employee.

An employee opened the access door of a saw and was showing maintenance an issue with the equipment when the saw lacerated the employee's right-hand index finger and thumb. The saw was running at the time.
An employee was helping to hook up a trailer when the trailer jack failed, allowing the trailer tongue to land on the employee's left foot, causing an amputation.
An employee suffered an electrical shock when he touched a metal cart that had become energized by an electric welder that was mounted on it. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 19, 2018, at around 9:00 AM, an employee was standing on the tailgate at the back of his pickup truck trying to get something out when he slipped and fell backwards off the truck to the ground. The employee was admitted to the hospital due to a fractured vertebrae and compressed lower back disc.

An employee was cutting a piece of lumber with a cut-off saw when the piece collapsed and pinched the saw blade, causing the saw to 
kick back. The employee lost control of the saw, and it contacted/lacerated his left bicep.
An employee was climbing up an extension ladder and fell about half-way up (6 feet) onto loose conduit on the ground resulting in a broken leg near the ankle and hospitalization for surgery.

An employee was riding on the back of a truck as part of an escort crew for milling equipment on a road construction project. The truck stopped and the employee was ejected, hitting his head on the pavement.
An employee lost her footing or balance and fell down the three-step stairway outside the building resulting in a lower left leg fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a stepladder, slipped on the fourth rung and fell approximately four feet to the asphalt ground resulting in a broken right wrist and a bruised right hip.
An employee was descending a 20-foot extension ladder when the employee slipped off the ladder rung and fell at least 6 feet to the ground below, breaking the left leg.
An employee was cutting metal in an alligator shear machine when a piece of cast aluminum flew off and jammed his left index finger causing two one-inch lacerations.

An employee was moving an electric buggy to gain access to an electric pallet jack. While operating the buggy in reverse, the employee was pinned between the buggy and a new loader tire resulting in a fractured left tibia and fibula.

Employees were cutting steel pipe into sections. A backhoe bucket was holding pipe about two feet above ground level. Employees had cut pipe on the west side and walked to the east side to cut sections. When the crew arrived on the east side, the backhoe lifted the pipe an additional two feet in preparation to start jarring the pipe to complete the cut on the west side. As the backhoe was lifting the pipe, the pipe on the west side broke completely causing the pipe on the east side to swing north hitting an employee and causing him to fall. The pipe landed on the employee's left knee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left knee that required surgery.
An employee was using pneumatic nippers to cut line stake material. As he made a cut, the tip of his left hand was caught in the nippers. He suffered a left thumb tip amputation.
An employee was trimming a tree when a part of the tree broke off and hit him, breaking his jaw.

An employee was directing a lull operator. The employee jumped onto the back of the unbalanced lull, slipped and fell striking their face on the lull. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to the face and a fractured foot.
An employee was standing on decorative rocks (pebbles) when he lost his balance and fell, injuring his back.
An employee experienced fatigue, jaw pain and a rapid heartbeat while hiking.

An employee was attempting to unclog a riding lawn mower when the spinning mower blades broke his right index and middle fingers and partially amputated his right middle finger. The mower was running at the time.

An employee was operating a forklift and moving toward a truck when wind caught the door to the truck's gate and swung it toward the forklift. The employee was attempting to stop the gate when the employee's right middle and ring fingertips were smashed between the gate and forklift.
An employee was attempting to clear plastic from a machine's ram when it cycled. The employee's right middle finger was then caught between the ram and a mold, amputating the fingertip.
While checking a conveyor, an employee was caught in the moving parts of the conveyor and suffered compound fractures and lacerations to the left forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a site when construction equipment backed over the employee's leg, fracturing the tibia.

An employee was working from a ladder secured to a cable strand, removing a tree branch at 10 feet. The cable strand snapped and the ladder jolted, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee broke his left ankle and required surgery.
While digging holes into the ground outside, an employee suffered from dehydration, renal failure, and a muscle injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while transitioning from a vertical temporary ladder to a scaffold platform.
An employee was adding water to the water tank on a concrete mixer truck when high wind caused the truck door to slam shut on his finger. His left middle fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was working on a steel beam that was sitting on a work bench when a chain from a crane (being operated by a different employee) hit the beam, knocking it off the bench. The beam fell on the employee's left foot, resulting in a foot amputation.
An employee slipped and fell while getting out of his delivery truck. He landed on the concrete pavement, suffering four broken ribs and a hematoma. He was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling holes into asphalt to install a pin barrier when the drill bit dislodged, striking the top of his right foot and causing a laceration, contusion, and broken bone.
An employee was clearing a jam from a stripper machine when the employee's hand came into contact with the machine's blade, resulting in amputations to the right ring and middle fingers.
An employee was walking in the lobby of an office building when she fell and broke her hip, requiring surgery.
An employee was riding a mule while tracking a mountain lion with hounds when the mule bucked him to the ground. He suffered six broken ribs and a separated shoulder.

An employee was conducting maintenance work in the cargo area of an aircraft. The employee was leaning on the guardrails of the elevated work platform when the hinge on the guardrail failed and the employee fell approximately 4 feet, landing on a work bench below and injuring his lower back.
On April 20, 2018, an employee suffered an electrical shock.

An employee was attempting to wipe something off a drill press table when the employee's glove was caught in the press, which then pulled the employee's hand into the drill bit. The employee's left pinky finger was injured and eventually had to be amputated.

Employees were setting trusses on a multi-family apartment building. A truss was leaning against another truss when it tipped over, swung down, and struck an employee in the shoulder. The employee suffered a shoulder fracture, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was holding a rope that was used to secure equipment when a second employee cut the rope from below. The rope then severed the first employee's right thumb.
On April 20, 2018, at 8:30 PM, an employee was loading a truck and adjusting the load with a crane when the lifting strap came off the end of the load and crushed/fractured the employee's left hand.
On April 20, 2018, an employee tripped over wires and fell while vacuuming. The employee broke a humerus and required hospitalization.
An employee was walking across an aisleway when he was struck by a forklift that ran over his leg. He sustained severe injuries requiring a possible leg amputation.

An employee was conducting a climbing try-out on an obstacle course. During his descent from the climb, he let go of his climbing rope. The climbing rope's carabineer became detached from his rigger's belt, and he fell into the base containment box, suffering a right lung contusion, lumbosacral sprain, and paresthesia to his extremities. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were repairing a broken gas line on the roof of a commercial business. One of the employees was stepping off of the roof and onto a ladder when he fell to the ground, injuring his skull and puncturing a lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a heated press when it came down and crushed his left hand, breaking several fingers and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was at a dumping facility when he rolled his right ankle and fell to the ground, fracturing his right femur.
An employee was sliding a piece of meat onto a saw when he contacted the saw blade, lacerating his finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was unloading a transport trailer at a customer site when his left index fingertip was pinched by the customer's dock plate and amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating an aerial lift when the main control feed line ruptured, injecting fluid into his right palm.
