An employee was walking to a golf cart when his lower leg moved awkwardly. He fractured both lower leg bones and experienced sharp pain.
An employee was working on a customer's packaging machine when the employee's screwdriver slipped and punctured the employee's hand.

An employee was operating a forklift inside the warehouse. His right hand was outside the lift when it was smashed between the lift and some warehouse racking shelves, resulting in partial amputations to his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was attempting to open the jaws of his truck's fifth wheel using the manual handle when he lost his balance and fell down to the ground, fracturing his right hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was about to go down a flight of stairs but noticed someone coming up the same stairs. He then re-directed to go to another set of stairs but tripped and fell. He shattered his left elbow and was hospitalized.
On April 21, 2018, an employee was troubleshooting a press when it amputated the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was conducting preventative maintenance on a fan bearing. While circulating the grease, the employee grasped the fan belt and manually manipulated the fan. His right index and ring fingers were then caught between the fan belt and the pulley. He sustained a partial amputation to the right index finger and a fracture to the right ring finger.

An employee lost control of an unloaded electric pallet jack and was pinned between the pallet jack and fixed racking. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, internal bleeding, and a fractured foot.
An employee was removing grounds when he was electrically shocked by induced voltage coming off an existing 138 KV line.
An employee was preparing to groove a pipe when his left pointer finger was pulled into the groove machine, sustaining a fracture and cut.
An employee was washing equipment when her finger became caught in a washer door, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was using a crane to lift and repair a tool when the strap broke and the chain came down on his left hand, amputating his index fingertip.
An employee was handling a piece of pipe when it slipped and caught his right pointer finger between the pipe and trailer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning a part with an air hose when part of the air hose broke off and struck him in the face, fracturing his right eye socket. He was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a pneumatic chuck's plastic air line when his left index finger became trapped between the air chuck he was working on and a work pusher that was active on the opposite side of the equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was at an assigned pickup location and was sweeping out a semi trailer with a broom prior to loading it when he fell out of the trailer. He struck his head on the concrete below and was knocked unconscious for a brief period. He suffered a laceration requiring staples, a concussion and hospitalization.
An employee was stepping out of an ambulance when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, causing a flexor tendon injury to his left hip. He was hospitalized.

On April 21, 2018, at approximately 09:00 a.m., an employee was inspecting and rolling a 7" casing on a flat rack when the employee's right ring finger was smashed and amputated between two joints of pipe that another employee was rolling into position.
An employee was riding a lift gate with cargo when his right big toe went over the edge and was amputated.
A building became engulfed with smoke from a worn drive belt to a ceiling exhaust fan. An employee with asthma was overtaken by the smoke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was stepping off a 12-foot ladder when he missed one or two steps and landed wrong on his right foot. He broke his right ankle, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was welding nuts onto studs when his foot slipped and was caught between the platform he was welding on and a piece of equipment. He broke his leg.
An employee was caught between a sand truck and a sand bin while serving as ground guide/spotter on location. He suffered a laceration on his left inner thigh, requiring surgery.
An employee fell off an A-frame ladder.
An employee fell 4 feet off a ladder while mounting equipment on the ceiling, suffering pelvic and wrist injuries.
An employee was outside of a scissor lift and attempting to navigate it through a door well when the lift ran over his foot and crushed his little toe.
An employee was working from stilts when his stilt broke and he fell to the floor, breaking his right fibula and tibia.

Employees were rigging down and started removing fluid from a line. They placed a clamp at one end of the line, but the clamp loosened and two employees were struck. One employee was hospitalized with internal injuries.
An employee fell off a ladder while changing a light bulb, breaking her leg and injuring her shoulder.

On April 21, 2018, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was on top of a walk-in freezer performing contracting electrical work, installing J-hooks and cables on the inside of a rooftop, when he fell 23 feet to the concrete floor below, damaging his ankles and back.
An employee was unloading a railcar when the railcar hose became disconnected, causing asphalt to spill on the employee's left and right hands and left wrist.

An employee was operating a fuel truck on a construction access road when it struck a berm and flipped. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right shoulder, lumbar spine, left leg, right finger, and ribs.

An employee was providing psychiatric care to a patient that was undergoing a blood draw. The patient became aggressive, kicked the employee, and pushed her across the room. She fell and hit her head on the floor, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped while climbing back onto a forklift and fell to the ground resulting in a broken right wrist and hip.
On April 22, 2018, an employee was using a ladder to obtain product for a customer when the employee fell 8 feet off the ladder to the ground, suffering multiple fractures.
An employee was placing sheet metal panels onto a base form when his left middle finger was pinched between the panels, resulting in a surgical amputation.
An employee was hit by an elevator door while loading costumes onto the elevator, suffering injuries to the face and chest.
A volunteer missed a step and fell down stairs, suffering a dislocated elbow.
An employee was cleaning a gutter from a ladder. While coming down the ladder, he missed a step, lost his balance, and fell, fracturing his legs.
An employee was bending over to assist a patient dress. The patient put his weight on the employee's shoulders causing a strain to her left knee.
An employee was working at a bagger machine when the pusher cycle was activated. He was then trapped between the bagger and the bagger chute, crushing and fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was welding next to railroad tracks. He removed the slag pan, stepped across the rail, and down the ballast section to dump slag from the slag pan. The slag slipped out of the pan and into a ditch with water adjacent to the tracks, resulting in an explosion. The employee suffered third degree burns, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift to transport palletized material into a warehouse freezer when the forklift slid on some ice. His left foot was pinned between the forklift and a pallet on the floor causing a fractured ankle.
An employee was backing a powered pallet jack into a spot when his fingers were caught between a rack and the handle of the pallet jack, resulting in a middle finger amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was unloading boxes of furniture from a shipping container when a large tabletop struck and knocked the employee to the floor. The employee suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was loading material on a loading dock when he lost his balance, fell, and rolled off the edge of the loading dock, lacerating and contusing the back of his head.

On April 23, 2018, an employee was kneeling down to measure a fuel cover lid when a fuel truck backed up and struck the employee. The employee suffered a severed liver/spleen, fractured pelvis, broken right ankle, and broken left foot.

Employees were hoisting a motor for an elevator with a gantry crane. The crane tipped over and the top support beam for the gantry crane struck an employee in the left leg. The employee suffered a broken and dislocated left foot.

An employee was using a lattice boom crawler crane to unload a 20-ton section of anchor chain from a vessel. As the employee was moving the anchor chain with the crane, the crane flipped over. The employee jumped out of the cab as the crane was flipped over was injured. The employee sustained broken teeth, a severe pelvic ring injury with sacral fracture, and vertebral disc herniation in the L3-L5 and L5-S1 areas.
An employee was getting supplies from a laundry supply closet when a spider bit her lower left leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping another employee weld a truck when the truck rolled. The back tire then pinned the employee in the hip area, requiring hospitalization. The truck wheels were not chocked at the time of the incident.
An employee was transporting a 30-yard container to a transfer station. The employee opened the rear door of the container and a plant pot fell, hitting and lacerating his left arm.
An employee was moving a trailer with a yard tractor when he fell from the tractor cab ladder onto the concrete floor, striking his head.

An employee was installing a gravity fed conveyor belt when his left ring finger was crushed between two conveyor systems. His left ring finger broke and had to be medically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was crushed between a truck and a trailer resulting in a fractured and lacerated arm.

On April 23, 2018, an employee was loosening a bolt from a lifting device that was attached to a piece of steel when the steel shifted. The employee's left hand was caught between the suspended steel and another piece of steel, fracturing three fingers and requiring surgery.
An employee was exiting his truck when he slipped and fell, injuring his left buttock and leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a rope and pulley system to lower asbestos bags from the seventh floor of a boiler when the rope (which was wet) slipped in his hands and looped around his right thumb, severely lacerating it and resulting in a surgical amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to adjust a tote on a cart when one of the tote legs slid down and sheared off two of his fingertips between the tote and cart.
An employee was working on a car engine when his finger came in contact with a sharp object, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.

An employee was tearing off a roof when a tool in his hand came into contact with an overhead powerline. He suffered an electrical shock.

An employee was using a railing for support while she was going down a two-step stairwell at a unit that was not in move-in condition when the railing broke. She then lost her balance and fell backwards on the floor, bruising her back and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was guiding a crane that was hoisting an air conditioning unit onto the roof. The crane released and the unit fell, snapping a riser clamp against the employee's right index finger, which was crushed and amputated.

An employee was operating a forklift with a hopper attachment to dump trash in a dumpster. While releasing the handle to allow dumping, the employee placed his left hand between the hopper and the forklift tine to reach up to release the lever. When it released, the weight shifted, pinching his left ring finger between the hopper and the forklift tine. This resulted in a crushing injury that required amputation to left ring fingertip.
On April 23, 3018, an employee stepped back and fell approximately one story though a hole in the floor to a concrete floor below. He broke his wrist, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was helping to place a pin into a shoe bolt on a frame that was being raised and lowered by a forklift when material slipped and smashed the employee's left middle finger. The finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was cleaning out debris around a fixture when he came in contact with a milling bit, puncturing his skull. The bit was guarded at the time.

An employee went inside a truck trailer while it was being loaded by a forklift. The forklift operator did not see the employee and turned the forklift in a way that smashed the employee's left hand between the forklift and the side wall of the trailer.

An employee was climbing a ladder built into a fertilizer tank trailer to access the lid and fill the tank when the employee slipped and fell from the ladder to the ground, landing on and breaking the right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 1-1/2" square compression sample with a chop saw when the saw blade struck and lacerated the back of the employee's left hand.
An employee was using a strap to move trees. He was pulling a tree by the wire basket around the ball when the wire basket broke. The strap snapped back and the hook cut the employee's face.
An employee was hooking up an aerator to a power tractor when the PTO shaft slipped and crushed his left middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a band saw to cut samples from a sub frame when the saw cut into the employee's right index finger, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was servicing a material handler (mobile equipment) and bringing the hood down when he stepped backwards and fell. When he fell, the hood came down on his right arm, fracturing his wrist and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was starting up an aluminum sweat furnace when he received burns on his arm and elbow.
An employee was on a ladder taping off a window for paint when he fell to the ground, breaking his back.

An employee was cleaning underneath a bulk tote dumpster using a compressed air wand when he noticed a piece of cardboard lodged underneath. He was attempting to blow out the cardboard when the machine cycled, pinning his arm between the piece of equipment and the floor. He sustained injuries to his left forearm that included a broken radius and ulna as well as lacerations to the skin. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a machine when a tube became stuck in a pneumatic roller. He went to remove the tube from the roller. When he removed enough pressure from the roller, the tube ejected out of the machine, lacerating and breaking his left pinky finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was retrieving a door when it fell on top of him, knocking him down to the concrete floor. He hit his head and arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was under a boom lift and while the boom lift was being lowered the employee lifted his head striking the boom lift resulting in a concussion and laceration to the head.
An employee was patrolling his area when the ATV he was using rolled and landed on top of the employee resulting in a broken lower right leg and injury to the right eye area.

An employee was assembling a metal cabinet while standing on a 36" platform. When he dismounted from the platform, his wedding ring became caught on a bolt or other fitting on the cabinet, which removed the skin from his left ring finger. His finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was lighting a cutting torch to remove an out-of-service tank when a second tank ignited. The employee suffered a broken leg and second degree burns to the face.

A temporary employee was taking glue and paper from the cutter end of a pleater machine. Another employee was at the pleater belt end of the machine. The employee at the pleater belt end rolled the belt and her right index finger went under the knife, amputating her fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On April 24, 2018, an employee fell approximately 24 feet from a new power pole that was having a light installed. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured back.

An employee was installing a 215-pound toggle into a crushing machine when the toggle slipped and fell onto his left ring finger, catching it between the toggle and the machine frame. His finger suffered an avulsion that led to a surgical amputation of his fingertip.

An employee was transporting a ladle from the furnace to the casting area using an industrial truck.  The front tire hit a pothole causing the molten silicon to spill to the ground which caused an explosion resulting in second degree burns to the employee's face, upper back, left arm and neck.
While unloading scaffold materials from a flatbed truck, an employee slipped off the truck and dislocated his right ankle.
An employee suffered an asthma-related reaction when other employees were performing maintenance on an ice machine down the hall using a degreaser product.
An employee was using a circular saw when it lacerated the employee's pinky finger, requiring surgery.

An employee was testing a machine to ensure it was not leaking when water sprayed from the machine, which had an electrical current running through it, and onto the employee's left hand. The employee received an electrical shock.
An employee was installing siding on a wall from a scaffold when he fell about 8 to 10 feet to the ground below, fracturing his ankle and suffering other injuries.

An employee opened a closet door, which struck a nearby ladder and caused it to fall. He heard the striking noise, turned toward it, and was struck in the head by the falling ladder. He suffered a concussion, laceration, and broken nose, requiring hospitalization and stitches.
An employee was cutting rebar with a cut-off saw when the employee's clothing caught fire, causing burns to approximately 70% of the employee's body.
An employee was operating a shaper machine (table mounted router) when the employee's hand slipped and went into the bit resulting in amputation of skin on the left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a trim machine when the employee's right middle finger contacted the rotary trimming knife, amputating the fingertip at the fingernail.
An employee was operating a motorized, ride-on pallet jack to load a freezer when the pallet jack struck a bollard, throwing him to the floor. He suffered a fractured skull and minor bleeding.
An employee fell to the concrete floor while working in the shop/warehouse area, fracturing both wrists, a femur, and an eye socket.
An employee rode a bike off the back of a truck that was approximately 4 feet off the ground. He fell off the bike and hit his face on the concrete, breaking his jaw.
An employee was acting as a spotter for a crane to help guide sheet metal into place when a nearby light pole became loose and fell on top of him, breaking his leg.

An employee was driving a reach machine from the cooler dock to the dry dock carrying approximately 14 pallets. As he was driving towards the fast roll-up door between the cooler dock and the dry dock, he turned his reach machine to the left. The reach machine then headed toward a yellow bollard that protects the fast roll-up door. Worrying he was going to strike the yellow bollard, he attempted to stop the collision using his foot. His left foot was then caught and severely crushed between the yellow bollard and the reach machine.
An employee suffered a burn and was having chest pains. The employee went to the hospital where they treated the burn. The employee was admitted to the hospital for chest pains.

While transferring a plastic sheet onto a pallet, an employee fell 7 feet into a grinder pit due to an unfastened floor plate. The employee suffered three broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a broken scapula.
An employee was hospitalized from an injury caused by a forklift accident.

An employee was cleaning out a cable stripper and opened the cabinet that houses the stripper wheel when his glove was caught in the wheel, pulling in his left hand. His left ring finger was amputated and his left middle finger was severely injured.

An employee was using a cat's paw tool to pull out a screw when the screw popped out and hit his eye, scratching his cornea and iris. He was hospitalized. Safety glasses were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking on the roof to bring tape to his co-worker who was repairing a skylight when he stepped onto the old skylight with plexiglass in place and fell about 15 feet through it to the floor. He sustained three cracked vertebrae, a cracked rib, and a bruised hip, requiring hospitalization.
While stepping up onto a truck sidestep, an employee missed the step and fell less than 3 feet, suffering two fractured ribs and a possible bruised lung.

An employee was in a bucket truck installing a temporary drop when the employee fell approximately 12 feet out of the bucket to the ground, fracturing the spine and ribs and suffering a broken blood vessel in the brain.
A employee was fastening a structural member at a roof eave strut when the employee fell from the eave and landed on a concrete slab, suffering a broken pelvis, broken nose, and contusions.

An employee was tensioning a come-a-long that was attached to a brace plate. The injured employee noticed the come-a-long needed adjustments and stopped work. As the injured employee straddled the come-along to make adjustments, the come-a-long broke free and hit/fractured his left leg.
An employee conducted a training jump and was gliding through the air with a parachute when the employee landed hard and fractured the L1 vertebra.
An employee walked out from behind some boxes and was struck by a fork truck, suffering a fractured right foot and other internal injuries that required hospitalization.

On April 24, 2018, an employee was attempting to unjam a blanket machine when another employee operated the machine, which then lowered a metal bar on the first employee's arm. The employee's arm was crushed.
The injured employee was conducting housekeeping operations and struck his upper left eye lid on a file holder.
An employee was walking in the parking lot from one office to another when she tripped and fell between the curb and sidewalk, breaking her left leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a chair to access a circuit breaker panel when the employee fell from the chair and into a mirror. The mirror broke and a piece of glass from the mirror amputated the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee slipped on a boulder while crossing a creek, suffering a compound fracture of the fibula. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was reaching into a plasma punch machine to retrieve a stuck part when the trap door inside the machine closed on the employee's right forearm, crushing the soft tissue and fracturing the ulna.
An employee was using a powered saw to cut a piece of wood that was supported by two saw horses when the saw cut his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting lumber on a chop saw when his right hand contacted the blade, amputating his index finger and thumb and partially amputating his middle finger.

An employee was helping to load a conveyor during a new equipment startup. His left hand was on top of the conveyor enclosure with his thumb near the door rail track bearing when the operator actuated the equipment's door closure switch. The door then came down on and partially amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee lost control of a chainsaw and lacerated his right thigh. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.
An employee was pulling a wire while walking backward when the wire came loose. The employee then fell over a tree limb and landed on his back, breaking three ribs and suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee slipped and fell while exiting an excavator, suffering head, face, and hand contusions.
On April 25, 2018, an employee tripped over a loose plastic box strap, contacting the ground and sustaining a spiral fracture to her femur.
An employee's foot was crushed by a forklift.
An employee was trying to disconnect a high-level flow sensor that was going off in the acid farm area when acid contacted the employee's foot and lower leg, causing second degree chemical burns.
An employee was cleaning a glue spreader roller when the rag he was using was pulled into the roller, catching and injuring his thumb.

An employee was helping to clear a plug from a ventilation duct. The duct work was unattached at the top, bottom, and one side. The duct then shifted and caught his right hand, amputating his index fingertip, fracturing his index finger, and lacerating his middle finger.
While getting into the cab of a truck, an employee slipped and fell, suffering a laceration to the head and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a grease trap and dropped the grease trap onto his toe. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured toe.
While attempting to remove a bumper from a rack, an employee suffered a right pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was in an aerial lift cutting a section of a tree when the tree section spun around and hit him in the face and head. He was hospitalized with a concussion, small facial fracture, skull fracture, laceration to the face, and chipped teeth.
An employee was walking down the sidewalk when she cut across a grassy area and tripped. She then fell to the ground, fracturing her hip.
An employee was dropping off a patient at the facility. After he placed the patient in the room, he tripped and fell while coming out of the room, fracturing his right tibia.

While conducting fire/evacuation drills, an employee dismounted from the back of a school bus (approximately 4 feet from the ground) and suffered a right hip fracture, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was inspecting a bent rim on a car when his hand was caught between the rim and the car's caliper, severing his middle finger.
An employee was going to clean an evaporator when the employee's right middle finger was pinched between two stainless steel-hinged lids (doors), resulting in an amputation just behind the nailbed.
An employee was exiting a building when a door closed on her left pinky fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading a railcar to a tanker truck when 50% sodium hydroxide splashed in the employee's eye and face, causing chemical burns.
An employee was tightening a screw cap on a pipe when the cap broke loose and struck the employee's face, breaking bones in the cheek and below the eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the hall pushing a cart when the employee tripped over the cart and fell on the left knee. The employee suffered a left femur fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was installing metal trusses when he fell approximately 15 feet before he was caught by his harness' fall protection system. He landed on his feet and then fell to the ground, breaking an arm and elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was checking on a maintenance employee who was working on a deflasher when the turn table came down and pinned his left forearm, fracturing it and requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a metal cart when he began to fall. He then grabbed the corner of the cart and avulsed his right middle and index fingers. Slip-resistant shoes were worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking near a railing system used to move large parts along a trailer manufacturing production line when a trailer's sub frame weighing 200 to 300 pounds fell off the railing and struck the employee. The employee suffered broken metatarsal bones and required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a table saw while cutting PVC pipe when the saw amputated the employee's left pinky finger.
Employees were moving a piece of floor tile during a two-man lift when one of the employees slipped on a wet grassy area and fell on his back, suffering a back injury.

While covering vent systems with plastic, an employee stepped onto a hole cover for a vent shaft and the cover gave way. The employee then fell from the 16th floor to the 5th floor in the vent shaft, fracturing both ankles and three vertebrae and suffering several lacerations.

An employee was holding/guiding a chain that went to an underwater slide gate when the gate became free and squeezed his finger between the chain and cement wall. His right little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was caught between a paper roll and the guard protecting the control panel, suffering a broken pelvis and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a cap that was installed on a 12" water line. The cap blew apart, striking and amputating his right leg.
An employee was pulling clothes on an overhead trolley when the overhead trolley jumped on a curb, came off, and hit her head. She was hospitalized with a concussion.
While performing maintenance, an employee was crushed between the cartop of an elevator crosshead and an overhead safety beam. The employee sustained broken ribs on both sides of the torso.
An employee was installing metal decking when a sheet moved off its support. He then fell to the next level and broke 5 to 6 ribs.

After cutting a hole in a concrete wall, an employee was attempting to pick up a pallet when the employee slipped and fell through the hole, falling approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor on the other side. The employee suffered cracked ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished delivering mail to a residence and was taking a shortcut across a yard when he tripped over a tree root and fractured his left hip. The ground was a bit muddy at the time.
An employee fell backwards while mopping the floor, suffering a tailbone contusion.

An employee was cleaning the hallway and moving drywall when another employee pulled a piece of drywall from the top. The drywall fell on and injured the left lower leg of the employee who was cleaning.
An employee was cleaning a fat removal machine when it cycled. The employee's left fingertip and middle finger were caught in the equipment, resulting in amputations.
An employee was cleaning rollers when his hands were caught in the rollers, causing amputations to three fingers.
An employee fell off a ladder and hit his head on a printing press. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was driving a pallet jack around a corner when his left leg was pinned between the pallet jack and rollers. He fractured his leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a tool to unjam a grinder machine when the grinder grabbed the tool and pulled his right hand between the tool and the framework of the grinder, de-gloving his hand and smashing his right ring fingertip. His fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

While conducting maintenance on top of a double cone process, an employee stepped on a valve that released >200 degrees of fluid. The fluid contacted the employee, causing burns to the shoulder, abdomen, and torso.
An employee was rolling metal material in the rolling machine and pinched their left index finger in the roller.
An employee was operating an overhead crane to lift a metal rod when the rod fell on and amputated his left hand.
An employee was cutting a big piece of aluminum on a vertical band saw and amputated his right middle finger.

On 4/26/2018, an employee was performing maintenance on the conveyor belt system at the start of the work shift and partially amputated his left middle and index fingers. The machine was running and unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee's hand went under a motorized conveyor, resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle and index fingers.

An employee was climbing a 15-foot, job-made wooden ladder to access a machine room when the ladder shifted. He then fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below, landing on his feet. He fractured his right heel, sprained his left ankle, and strained his back.

An employee was attempting to straighten a pipe that was sitting on a pipe rolling rack when his right middle finger was caught between the pipe and one of the rollers that was on the rack, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unclogging a pulp screw conveyor drain cup when his hand contacted the moving screw auger, amputating his middle and ring fingers and his index fingertip.

An employee was cutting pipe at a wellhead when a pocket of oil suddenly surfaced (well was plugged). A flash fire then occurred, causing second to third degree burns to both of the employee's hands and the right side of the stomach. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was bagging bread at a bagger machine when it became jammed. As she attempted to unjam the machine, another employee activated the machine, which then amputated an eighth of an inch of her left index fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning out a piston on a chemical pump and amputated the right index finger to the fingernail in a pinch point between the piston and the cylinder.

A rigging crew was adjusting the straps of an 800 lb. steel beam member being lifted as part of a steel building construction when the beam clamp slipped and the beam fell, striking an employee who was checking rigging nearby on his back. He suffered broken ribs and lacerations.
While using a handheld burner torch, an employee caught on fire, suffering burns to the right hand and leg.
An employee was assisting a patient in a shower when the patient slipped and fell. The employee suffered back injuries while attempting to catch the patient from falling, requiring hospitalization.
On April 26, 2018, an employee fell from a single-story garage onto the concrete below, suffering a fractured skull, punctured lung, and fractured ribs.
An employee was cutting wood with a bench saw when it amputated the employee's left middle fingertip. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was checking equipment in the paint shop when he tripped over a bag that was sitting on the floor and fell, landing on and fracturing his left elbow.
An employee was climbing up onto a racking system to straighten the load that was stored on the rack when he fell off and ruptured his colon.

An employee was cutting rebar using a 4-inch grinder when it started to spark and created a fire. The sparks ignited his vest and sweater, and he received a burn to the right side of his abdomen and chest.
An employee was de-burring a part on a rotating machine while wearing cotton gloves when her glove was caught in the machine. Her right index finger was then amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was loading a stamped part into a die. The employee's hands were inside the press when it cycled resulting in amputation of the last joint of the left ring finger and the middle and index fingertips.
An employee was working on a pipe rack arm when it slipped and pinched the employee's left index fingertip, amputating it.

An employee was hooking up a trailer to a truck. His left index finger was on the trailer tongue when the tongue dropped over the truck ball, catching and partially amputating his finger between the trailer and the truck.

An employee was using a gas-powered pressure washer inside the basement of a residential construction site to wash out the concrete floor when he started to feel dizzy and was overcome by carbon monoxide poisoning. He was hospitalized.
During a training exercise, a CS gas canister prematurely exploded and injured two employees, who suffered a broken femur and chest laceration.
An employee climbed out of the passenger side of a waste truck to position some waste containers. The truck continued moving and ran over his right foot, breaking it.
On April 25, 2018, an employee was driving a side loader when the brakes locked and the loader abruptly stopped. The employee fell to the ground and fractured both wrists.

An employee was attempting to clean a glue rolling machine with a rag when the roller caught the rag and pulled the employee's right hand into the machine, crushing her pinky and ring fingers. Her pinky and ring fingertips had to be  amputated.
An employee was walking to his truck when he slipped in the mud and hit his head and back, suffering a concussion and spinal fracture.

An employee was making his rounds when he identified a level indication in the vessel that he was not sure was accurate. He then drained the sit glass and the material (mineral spirits polyethylene wax and ethaline gas) ignited a flash fire, burning his left palm, both forearms, and his left calf. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift and backed into another lift catching his left leg between the two lifts and fracturing it.
On April 24, 2018, an employee was operating a hydraulic shear to cut samples when the shear's hold-down clamp crushed the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was helping a second employee feed corrugated fiberboard sheets into a slotter machine at approximately 16:15. They determined that a piece of tape was creating issues with the sheets as they fed them into the machine. The first employee was attempting to remove a piece of the tape when the machine cut his left little finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was standing on the second stage of a forklift trying to reach and wrap around to hook an attachment. He then lost his footing, tripped on the overhead guard, and fell to the floor, where he passed out. He was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was removing dirty dishes when he dropped a glass. As he tried to catch it, the glass shattered and cut his right hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving an ATV and struck a tree resulting in a fractured left femur.
An employee was simultaneously disconnecting a plug from its power supply and a plug from a barrel crushing machine when his hands crossed and he received a 480-volt electrical shock.
An employee was grabbing a stand pipe from a 'V' chute to guide it when the pipe swung out. The employee then fell approximately 15 feet, breaking ribs and the hip.

On April 27, 2018, an employee was removing a saut  pan from the stove when oil from the pan spilled and entered the cuff of the oven mitt/glove the employee was wearing. The employee suffered a burn to the left hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a single-man aerial lift when the lift fell back and struck him, fracturing his skull and lacerating his face and ear. He also suffered a possible leg fracture.

An employee simultaneously rolled two test coupons to prepare them for a pre-test for a new welder. A coupon consists of the end of a pipe and weighs about 50 pounds. The employee's left thumb was pinched between the two rolling coupons, tearing the tissue from the thumb tip, which required surgical removal of about 1 mm of bone.

On April 27, 2018, at approximately 7:00 AM, an employee was operating a drill and had just finished drilling two holes in some square tubing when he attempted to grab a shaving near the drill bit, which caught his glove. His left thumb was then pulled into the drill bit, severely cutting it and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using an overhead crane to stack steel beams in the beam yard when the employee's left ring and pinky fingers were smashed between two beams, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was loading a container on a tilt bed trailer when the container shifted and crushed the employee's right foot, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was retrieving PVC pipes from storage for a customer. The PVC pipe bundles were stacked. When the employee cut the bands on a PVC pipe bundle near the bottom of the stack, the bundles shifted and collapsed on top of the employee.

Two employees were moving a dolly containing sheet rock when a wheel became caught on top of a drain. When they tried to free the dolly, some of the sheet rock fell. One of the employees tried to stop the sheet rock but was struck, breaking a leg, knee, and ankle.

A 2,000-pound tote of rice was placed on the top of another tote that was leaking rice. An employee and two others were trying to repair the bag, which had been damaged by forklift forks, when the top tote fell on the employee, who suffered a broken left tibia.
An employee fell from the trailer of his delivery truck, breaking his ribs and clavicle.

An employee was walking next to a pipe that was being moved with a forklift when the synthetic strap slipped off the pipe and one side of the pipe fell onto the top of the employee's foot behind the protective steel toe. The employee sustained a dislocated big toe and open and closed fractures.

An employee used a stationary horizontal band saw to cut a piece of sheet metal about 15 feet long. When the employee went to move the piece of sheet metal, the end hit an adjacent portable band saw, causing the portable band saw to tip off its stand. The employee walked over to upright the tipped over portable band saw and it completely fell off the stand. As the portable band saw fell, the employee's finger was caught between the stand and the falling portable band saw, causing lacerations and crushing injuries to the left pinky finger, which required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell backwards off a step stool, hitting her head and suffering a possible concussion.

An employee was pushing a food cart through a door jam when another employee walked to the opposite side of the food cart, reached up, and tried to help the employee pull the cart through the door jam. When he did that, the food cart pinched the first employee's finger between the food cart and the door jam, amputating the very tip of the middle finger on his right hand.
While playing volleyball, an employee jumped and collided with a participant, landed awkwardly, and broke the right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 27, 2018, at approximately 11:50 PM a forklift operator attempted to pass another employee who was on a standup forklift moving product. The forklift operator bumped the standup forklift platform as the back end of the forklift swung out and the standup forklift struck a rack where the injured employee's left calf was pinched between the rack and the standup forklift resulting in an avulsion injury to the left calf.
An employee was riding on the rear step of a residential refuse truck. When the truck made a left turn, his left hip hit a concrete pole, causing a stress fracture to the left side of his pelvis.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat when the moving blade lacerated his right index and middle fingers, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a piece of equipment when he tripped over a rail and fractured his left ankle while trying to catch himself.

An employee was cleaning her workstation and organizing her files when a section of the acoustical ceiling (tiles and grid), adjacent light fixtures, and portions of the plaster ceiling above suddenly collapsed due to a prolonged, concealed steam leak that weakened the fastener connections. She sustained a cut to her head, bruise to her head, scratches on her neck, a scratch to her left hand, and irritation to her right hand, requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was operating an order picker and was 20 to 30 feet high when the employee fell from the order picker onto the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with severe head trauma due to a skull fracture.

A crew was installing a top drive track during a rig move when it became hung up on a girt. The top drive track was freed and whipped, striking an employee in the head. The employee suffered broken right cheek bones, a broken jaw bone, and a right shoulder injury.

An employee was attempting to clean off a machine's sensor when the machine started to move. As he attempted to remove his hand, his right middle finger was caught in a chain and sprocket, tearing off his fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee had replaced a truck's fuel filter and got fuel on his wrist and hand. When he reconnected the power wires to the fuel pump, it sparked and ignited the fuel on his left hand, burning it.
On April 28, 2018, an employee was guiding a forklift operator when the forklift lowered a crate onto his foot, crushing his right big toe. His toe was later amputated.

An employee was checking a possible problem with a chain and sprocket while holding a screwdriver with his left hand. He attempted to jog the machine over and the chain caught the screwdriver. The nail and underlying part of one of his fingers was then pinched off.

An employee was cleaning kitchen hood fans from a step ladder when he lost his balance and stepped into a rethermalizer filled with hot water. He received second and third degree burns to his foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a ladder to try to enter a window that led to an office that had inadvertently been locked with the keys to the door left inside. The employee fell off the ladder from the third or fourth rung, sustaining broken vertebrae.
An employee was coming down from a fixed ladder when he missed the last step, lost his balance, and fell to the ground, breaking his ankle.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a fixed ladder. The employee's hard hat then lacerated the back of the employee's head.

An employee was performing sub-arc welding on a power section when a flux catcher bin ignited due to someone throwing plastic and other trash in the bin (it is strictly for catching welding pieces). The employee was overcome by smoke inhalation and required hospitalization for carbon monoxide exposure.

An employee on a vessel out at sea opened an unlabeled container that smelled strongly while preparing to clean and sanitize factory equipment resulting in burns to the employee's nose and throat. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee experienced shortness of breath and pain in the rib cage while pushing equipment onto a truck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was winding tape onto a condenser when the employee's glove became caught on the tape, which then pulled the employee's arm in and around the condenser. The employee's arm broke and required surgery.

An employee was running a jumper on a dead-end structure when an electrical event occurred. He received electrical burns to his forearm, the underside of his bicep area, and his left-side torso, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to remove cake batter from a hopper when the machine cycled, catching the employee's right thumb between the moving plunger and the fixed die cutter. The employee's right thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was going to retrieve supplies from a storage shed when he disturbed a hornets nest. He backed up quickly to avoid being stung and fell to the ground, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove waste/scrap yarn from a roller shaft when the turning roller amputated his left index finger. The roller shaft was unguarded at the time.

An employee was adjusting the wire length setting on the machine when the hydraulic hose on the machine failed at the crimped connection causing the hose to whip and strike the employee's lower leg. The employee sustained lacerations to the leg and a broken ankle.
An employee was walking through a semi-wooded area when a rattlesnake bit the back of his leg.

An employee was cleaning remaining asphalt out of the corners of a buggy hopper with his back to a delivery truck. When the buggy moved forward, the employee was caught between the buggy and the delivery truck. The employee sustained a broken hip, bruising and abrasions to the right leg and an abrasion on the left leg.

An employee was climbing a caged area to reach a wooden pallet. While the employee was descending the cage, he lost his footing and fell against a metal pole, suffering three cracked ribs and multiple bruises. He was hospitalized.

An employee went to close a breaking machine. When he grabbed the handle he reached over the top of the machine to secure the handle with his left hand. He then pulled the handle and lost his balance. His right hand slipped into the pinch point, which closed on and amputated his right pinky fingertip.
An employee was talking on the phone at the front desk when he slipped and fell on the wet floor, landing on his back and fracturing his L-1 vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee lost his balance while exiting from a ladder onto a one-story roof.  He fell, hit the roof, and then fell to the ground, landing on his feet. He fractured his right ankle and left heel.

On April 30, 2018, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was in a bucket truck tapping up a new service on a secondary 120/240 volt line when two hot wires made contact, causing an electrical flash. The employee received a second degree burn to his left hand, which was ungloved at the time.
An employee was burned with hot water while operating a dish washing machine. He received second degree burns on his face, left arm, and abdomen.

An employee was in a cooler getting something off a top shelf. The employee stepped up on a dunnage rack with the left leg to reach the product. When stepping back down to the floor, the employee's left leg slipped out. The employee then fell to the floor and suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was hanging a coil of steel on a coil holder using a metal mesh sling. The sling was being removed when the crane eye caught the shaft of the mandrel.  The employee's left middle finger was then caught between the eye of the sling and the mandrel, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was stepping from a doorway down a single step to the main floor when he fell and re-injured a knee that had recently had surgery. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing down the ladder from the catwalk area on the front of a discharge ready mix cement truck that was wet from being washed. While standing on the finder, the employee turned right toward the grab rail. As the employee stepped down to the next step, the employee lost balance and fell approximately 51 inches to the ground. The employee suffered nine broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to feed meat through a meat grinder when it injured the employee's right-hand muscle and ligament. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was servicing a bucket on a wheel loader when the coupler fell and struck the employee's legs, breaking them.

An employee was performing maintenance on a pump at a gas well frac job. The employee removed the top cap off of the pump and removed the top valve. The employee went to remove the bottom valve and the pump stroked, catching and crushing the employee's right hand. The employee suffered a hand injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was shutting the door to a truck when the employee fell from the lift gate, fracturing three ribs.

An employee was standing on a 6- to 8-foot A-Frame ladder to change curtains in an ICU hospital room when he lost his balance and fell.  He landed on a sitting chair that was next to his ladder, fracturing ribs on his upper right side and puncturing his lung.

An employee was unloading material from a platform ladder when the arm of a hydraulic tarping mechanism contacted the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the ground below. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was helping a team move a railcar on a high rail when his left hand became trapped and crushed by the rail car wheel. His pinky was amputated.
An employee was moving a full 55-gallon drum onto a cart when it tipped and began to fall. As he tried to catch the drum, it struck and broke his right ankle.
An employee was helping to hitch a trailer to a truck when the truck backed up. He was pinned between the truck and trailer, suffering a laceration and partial amputation.
An employee was working on field equipment when a bearing fell on his right toe, crushing it.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a starboard panel when the panel kicked back and broke his wrist, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was installing insulation in a home. As he was closing an open hurricane-resistant window, it came down on his left pinky finger and severely lacerated it.
An employee was retrieving a canine from a kennel when it bit the employee's left forearm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was placing material onto an electric pallet jack when a forklift operator ran into the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured toe.

An employee dropped a sampling container into a cooling airlock. As he attempted to retrieve the container, his right index finger was amputated (between the middle and distal joint) by the cooling airlock.

An employee had unstrapped some downhole tools that were brought to a wellsite. While another employee was going to get a forklift, the load shifted and smashed his finger between the load and the rub rail, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was setting a utility pole when it contacted the field phase of an existing three-phase primary conductor. The employee received an electrical shock and burn.
An employee painting from an A-frame ladder fell approximately 3 to 4 feet to the ground below, injuring his lower back and sustaining a head laceration requiring staples. He was hospitalized.

An employee was having his dump truck loaded by a front end loader. When loading was completed, the employee jumped off the truck to talk to the operator of the front end loader and stumbled onto the dirt between the cab and the loader tires. The employee sustained a knee fracture, a shoulder injury and a forehead abrasion.

On April 30, 2018, at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was helping to conduct a prescribed burn on a forest. He set his tool down to use the radio and communicate with others on the burn. When he reached down to pick up the tool, a copperhead snake that was camouflaged by leaves struck him on the right index finger knuckle.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a blower fan when the machine started back up after shut down. Moving parts contacted and severed his lift middle and ring fingers.
An employee injured his fingers while operating a mixer.
An employee tripped and fell while walking to a collection box, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was winding a coil on a winding machine when he noticed the insulation paper was walking out of alignment. As he was realigning the paper, his left middle fingertip was caught between the coil and the roller, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was painting a wall from a 32-foot extension ladder when the ladder slipped out, causing the employee to fall 14 feet to the ground. The employee suffered hip, pelvic, and humerus fractures.

An employee's right hand went between a UBT roller and a feed conveyor belt while she was cleaning around an automated case packing machine. The conveyor pulled her right arm through up to her armpit, causing cuts and bruising.

At the truck dock area, an employee was finishing up loading a truck with carts of bread when the dock leveler fell on her right foot. The initial injury was a toe fracture that later resulted in an amputation.
An employee's cleaning rag was caught by a piece of equipment's in-going roller, resulting in a right ring finger amputation.
An employee fell down the stairs and broke an ankle.
An employee was walking past basketball courts when the employee fell in a hole, twisting and fracturing an ankle.

An employee was standing and giving instructions to other employees when a co-worker slightly bumped a pallet with their hip, causing a double door to fall and hit the employee in the back of the head.

An employee was walking through the shop when she stopped to watch a mechanic doing maintenance on a truck. The mechanic was changing the rear spring axle on the front of the vehicle. The bottle jack was keeping the spring open to pull out the pins. As the mechanic was tapping the pins out, the bottle jack shifted and shot out, hitting the employee and injuring her right cheek.
An employee was cutting wooden forms from a scissor lift when an 8-foot piece of wood form struck his left thumb, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to open a hatch on a railcar when the employee fell off the railcar to the ground, fracturing the hip and a wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of iron pipe with a chop saw when the saw kicked back and lacerated his left cheek, requiring stitches.
An employee was cleaning dishes in the kitchen when she experienced dizziness and double vision, requiring hospitalization.

Employees had placed netting on the ground to capture debris. The injured employee stepped backward over the mesh netting and his foot became caught. He then fell, fracturing his right arm at the elbow.
An employee was working on a catalytic converter when he slipped and injured his leg. His leg swelled and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to install a battery in a powered industrial truck when his left index finger was caught between the battery retention plate and the surrounding area, amputating his fingertip at the nailbed.
An employee was unloading a truck when his leg was cut on the hydraulic gate lift.
An employee was grinding a weld when the grinding disc broke. The shattered disc then fractured the employee's orbital bone.
An employee was installing shingles from a ladder when the employee fell 20 feet to the ground, fracturing the left wrist and left arm.

A temporary employee was cleaning out the track pad on a milling machine using a wire brush. As he moved the wire brush, his glove became caught in the machine and his arm was pulled into the machine. He fractured his right forearm and was hospitalized.

An employee was retrieving a comfort standing mat under a conveyor when her hair was caught in the conveyor and pulled into a rotating shaft. She suffered hair and skin loss, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was performing a die setup. He was unbolting the die and stepping down from a step stool when he lost his balance. He reached up and grabbed the feed bar and it fell on top of him.  He suffered a broken nose, broken facial bones, and bone fragments in the eye.
On May 1, 2018, an employee's left hand was caught and fractured in a dry roller, requiring hospitalization. The roller was unguarded at the time.
An employee was installing step bolts on a pole while standing on a metal plate that was 28 inches from the ground when the employee slipped and fell, sustaining a laceration injury.
An employee was removing a roll from a coating/laminating machine when the machine partially amputated his right thumb.

A temporary employee was showing a coworker how to run a particular job on a machine press. She was attempting to position a part in the point of operation when the machine actuated. Her right hand was then crushed by the machine, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell to the floor while walking down the hallway, suffering a head injury.
An employee was stepping back from a patient's bed when her right femur broke and she fell.

An employee used a forklift to stack pallets on a stack and was backing up when he thought he was going to hit a desk and drove forward instead. The floor had condensate and the forklift skidded into his foot, crushing it between the forklift and an angle iron that was installed on the floor. He suffered a fractured talus bone, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was aligning an auger with the boom on the back of a utility line truck when his left finger was pinched between the auger and the boom truck, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was moving a scaffold when he slipped on some stones and fell off a retaining wall onto his side, breaking ribs.
An employee was looking out the window with hands placed on the window sill when the window case came down onto the employee's right middle finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was cooking in the kitchen when she bumped into another employee and fell to the ground, breaking her arm.
An employee fell to the concrete floor while descending a fixed ladder, requiring hospitalization.

An employee climbed on the back of a pickup truck bed after he finished picking up signs off the side of the road. The driver was driving the pickup truck along the interstate shoulder going eastbound toward the jobsite when the employee fell off the vehicle, striking his head on the ground and requiring hospitalization. He was wearing a hard hat when he fell.

An employee finished rigging and was walking in an area where a crew was loading an exchanger bundle on a trailer when the load shifted, pinning the employee between the active load and an adjacent stationary load. The employee suffered a fractured left femur and pelvis.

An employee was operating a pneumatic shear and pushed a sheet of metal into place on the shear. He was holding the metal as the material hold-downs came down. His right pinky finger slid underneath the fixed guarding on the front of the shear. The shear was actuated via the foot control and his right pinky finger was pinched by the material hold-down, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning the top of a vacuum tube cooler when he fell off the top of the vacuum tube and onto the concrete, breaking his knee.
An employee was trying to loosen a pipe with a wrench and a vice stand when the wrench slipped and the employee fell, dislocating and fracturing the right ankle.
An employee slipped and fell on a concrete floor while loading a sandwich rack, fracturing the left hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift and came in contact with another forklift. The employee's foot was caught and fractured between the forklifts, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a core drill to dill holes into a concrete wall when his sweatshirt was caught in the rotating shaft, which then drew his right arm into the shaft. He suffered a compound fracture of the radius and ulna of his right forearm.
An employee was adjusting the selector on an elevator when the employee's right leg became caught and lacerated between the elevator cab and a rail bracket.
An employee's foot was run over and bruised by a road grader.
An employee fell from a retail counter while attempting to change a light bulb, suffering fractured vertebrae.
An employee was trying to remove an object from the paddled rollers in a machine when the employee's left pinky finger was caught between the rotating rollers, resulting in amputation.

An employee was manually helping a production line lead at a capper machine apply caps to bottles of windshield washer fluid when he noticed that a cap had fallen into the machine's chain and sprocket. He was attempting to remove the cap when the chain and sprocket amputated four of his right fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was returning to her vehicle while delivering mail when she stepped in a pothole and broke her right ankle.
An employee was looking for a connection when he bumped into a 10-pound flow key and it fell on his ring finger, fracturing it.
An employee slipped after stepping off a rebar wall, suffering a fractured bone in the right shin.
An employee was setting up a manual kick press when it cycled and amputated the employee's left index fingertip in a pinch point. The pinch point was unguarded at the time.

On May 2, 2018, an employee was observing a crane lift when the load shifted and struck the employee, pinching him between a demolished walkway and existing handrail. He suffered six broken ribs, two broken transverse processes, a lacerated kidney and a lacerated liver, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was working as a packaging assistant when she tripped and fell, breaking her arm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell down some stairs, suffering an arm injury.
An employee was setting a choker when the line flipped a tree onto him, fracturing his back.

Three employees were removing sand bags after installing a steel pole when a digger truck boom contacted electrical wiring (phases), exposing them to an electrical current that burned them. Two employees were hospitalized.
An employee went to unhook a chain attached to metal tubing when the operator raised the load. The employee's right hand was then crushed between the chain and load, resulting in a pinky amputation.
An employee was sharpening a tool on a bench grinder when the tool slipped and he injured his left index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a feeder's conveyor belt pulley, which was not moving. He was checking the belt's tension when it started to move, catching his right index finger and resulting in an amputation of the first digit. The feeder was not locked out and was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee lost balance while operating a vacuum cleaner and fell on her left side, breaking her left hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on top of a cooler removing conduit when he struck his head on the ceiling while wearing his hard hat. He was hospitalized with a pinched nerve in his C7 vertebra.

An employee was hand feeding a piece of sheet metal into a roll forming machine when his right hand contacted the rolls, pulling his hand into the machine. Four of his right fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was cutting plywood using a table saw when the blade amputated his right pinky finger and lacerated his right ring fingertip.
An employee was attempting to remove scrap wood from around a trim saw blade when he sustained a serious cut to the knuckle of his left index finger.

An employee was cleaning the trailer community's pool cage with a pressure washer. He was later found on the ground with a bleeding wound to the head. The pressure washer was running and a ladder was lying beside it when the employee was found.
An employee tripped over her foot and fell to the floor while walking down the hall, injuring her head and shoulder. She was hospitalized.

An employee was loading 500 gallon tanks onto his tractor-trailer truck with a crane on the backside of the truck cab. When the employee lifted one of the tanks that he had rigged to the crane, it still had propane in it, causing it to be heavier than expected. The rigged tank bumped another tank next to it that then rolled into the employee on the ground resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee was operating a hydraulic machine when it amputated three fingers.

An employee was turning rolls with a roll clamp when one of the rolls shifted. A second employee instinctively tried to keep it upright. The roll then fell on the second employee's left leg, breaking his tibia and fibula.

An employee was performing vocational training at a recycling center. The employee was emptying a cart of sorted materials as a customer was backing up their car. The car ran over the employee's left calf and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was testing recent repairs to a cooler system when he was electrically shocked, causing him to lose his balance and fall down a flight of stairs. He suffered a head laceration and body trauma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating the brake press and amputated the left middle finger.
An employee was standing on a 4-foot step ladder scraping the side of a tank to prepare for painting when he fell off the ladder to the ground, injuring his ribs and back.

While cleaning a meat grinder, an employee's hand entered the discharge tube and contacted the blades. 

The employee suffer amputation of the left index and middle fingertips. The meat grinder was not locked out and was in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee ingested a chemical degreasing agent while trying to siphon the chemical into a bucket.
An employee became ill while picking up shrubbery debris from the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove a piece of cheese from a cheese slicer when the blade amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was pouring material into a vessel containing xylene and butanol when a flash fire occurred, burning the employee's face, ear, and neck.

An employee climbed onto a catwalk in the kill room to get a bird out of the facility. The employee stepped on some foam in the overhead thinking it was a solid floor and fell approximately 18 feet to the floor, suffering a fractured elbow and head contusion.

At approximately 12:50 p.m. on 5/02/2018, an employee was operating a remote control crane in the rolling mill. He and three other mill employees were changing out a mill stand. He had the remote control box for the crane hanging from a strap around his neck. When the stand is slid out of position for removal, an opening to the flume approximately 2' x 5' is exposed until the stands are swapped and a new stand slides into position. While positioning the crane to pick up the entry box, the employee stepped within about 2' of the opening onto a pile of mill scale. Under his weight, the mill scale gave way, causing his feet to slide out from under him. Subsequently, he slid feet first into the flume. He landed on the scale in the flume, a drop of approximately 10", sustaining broken ribs and a broken shoulder.
An employee slammed a thumb in the door of a cutter amputating the tip of his thumb.

An employee was part of a crew that was reconstructing an apron in front of a house in a safety work zone when a passenger vehicle entered the work zone and struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to bones near the right ankle.
An employee was assembling a wooden pallet using a pneumatic nail gun when a nail went through the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized for hand trauma.
An employee was rolling up a 2.5 inch hose when their glove was caught by the hose resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was using a horizontal wheel press to push the shaft out of a drum when a 2" nut  that was being used as a spacer was ejected from between the piston and shaft of the drum. The nut contacted the employee's left bicep, fracturing the humerus.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on an elevator conveyor and caught their hand in the conveyor resulting in soft tissue damage.
An employee fell to the concrete floor while descending a refrigerated truck ladder, suffering a broken left hip, broken left collarbone, and broken rib.

An employee was cleaning out the slag runner on a blast furnace when the employee began to experience muscle cramping in the arms, legs, and back. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and/or potential heat stress-related symptoms.
An employee was disassembling duct work on a press when the blades of the grinder/chopper partially amputated three of his left-hand fingers.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when she slipped on a wet substance and fell, fracturing her left knee and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was clearing a jam on a shearing machine when the machine actuated via the foot pedal. The employee's left index finger was in the point of operation and was amputated between the first and second knuckle.

On May 3, 2018, an employee was opening the concrete composite cover of a hand hole with a screwdriver when the cover slipped off the screwdriver and fell on the employee's finger, pinching off the fingertip.
An employee was climbing up a step to access the cab of a semi-truck when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering three broken ribs and a partially deflated lung.
An employee was checking an oil leak underneath a flatbed truck when the flatbed cut his right middle fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On May 2, 2018, an employee suffered heat stress after working outside to finish concrete. He was hospitalized.

A load of steel was being moved with a powered industrial truck. An employee was guiding the load while walking down a corridor when he lost his grip on the tagline and attempted to stabilize the load with his hand. The load then pinned his hand against the wall, fracturing it.
An employee was loading tools on a truck when his left middle finger was caught and amputated between the truck bed and the bell.

An employee was ascending a set of stairs attached to a flowback tank. The employee placed his hand on the rail between a fixed section of the railing and a removable section of the railing. The railing shifted and his finger was pinched, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving pallets when a heavy pallet landed on and crushed his right middle finger, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was attempting to grab a bad case before it entered a case sealer when he slipped and fell, breaking ribs on his right side.
An employee was feeding metal into a power roller when his glove was caught between the roller bars and his left pinky and ring fingers were crushed by the roller bars.

An employee set up an extension ladder in the back of a building near a rooftop unit that needed service. While he was on the ladder a strong gust of wind from an approaching storm caused him and the ladder to fall approximately 10 to 15 feet onto the concrete sidewalk below. He fractured his right ankle and fibula, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was working on an assembly line, running a non-woven manufacturing machine, when the employee's left hand became caught between two running spindles. The employee's left thumb was amputated, with the possibility of additional left-hand finger amputations. The machine was not powered down or locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was removing a setting tool from the back of a truck when the tool began to fall. As he reached out to try and catch it, his finger was caught between the tool and the truck floor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On May 3, 2018, at approximately 4:00 p.m., an employee fell approximately 4 feet from the back of a box truck while delivering vegetable plants to a hardware store. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting weed eating while trimming grass when he was stung by bees, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the running boards of his delivery truck and cleaning the inside of the windshield when he suffered a medical event and fell backwards to the ground. From the fall, he suffered a fractured skull and bleeding in the brain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while collecting solid waste on his trash route, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was manually turning over a dock plate that was sitting flat on the lifts of a forklift truck in preparation for installation. The dock plate consisted of two metal pieces connected by a hinge. Three of the employee's right-hand fingertips were caught and amputated in the hinge.
An employee was removing a pipe when he lost his balance and twisted his back, causing inflammation to an existing back injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a scissor lift onto a trailer when the scissor lift came off the left side of the ramp and landed on the employee's leg, breaking it.
Employees were switching railcars when one of the employees was caught between the two cars. He was crushed, suffering internal injuries to his upper abdomen and pelvic area.

An employee was unfolding the fixed ladder on a concrete mixer truck when he lost hold of it as it was being lowered down, causing it to fall quickly. His left index finger was then pinched in the hinge where the ladder unfolds.

An employee was using a jointer to shape some wood when his left hand slipped and contacted the tooling/blade. He suffered a partial amputation of his left middle finger and a possible ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was descending an inside interior stairwell when he turned 180 degrees while stepping onto the level surface landing between flights. His left knee twisted and popped out of socket, dislocating his knee and kneecap. He was hospitalized.
An employee received an electrical shock while unplugging an extension cord.

An employee was unloading the hot melt glue from a heated reservoir of a glue application machine. He unloaded the unit into a medium-sized cardboard box. The volume of material was about 2 gallons. He then immediately carried the open-top cardboard box outside to the dumpster. He attempted to cleanly throw the box into the dumpster, but the box hit either the edge of the dumpster or something else and bounced back towards him. The hot glue was expelled from the box and landed on both of his bare hands and right bare arm. He suffered second and third degree burns.

On May 3, 2018, after picking up product with a tow-motor, an employee turned the tow-motor to the right and hit a large yellow metal curb. The employee was thrown to the concrete working surface, suffering multiple rib fractures and a possible collapsed lung.
An employee was inventorying products when a forklift struck her, fracturing her left leg.
An employee was checking the tension on the roller chains on the back of a skew roll when his middle finger was caught between the sprocket and roller, lacerating it below the first knuckle.
An employee was under a conveyor using a rag when her gloved right pinky finger was pulled into the conveyor, amputating her fingertip.

An employee was picking up trash bags and was then attempting to climb up the back of a rear load trash truck to clean off the rear view camera when he slipped and fell due to wet conditions, breaking his left arm.
An employee was moving material in a semi-trailer when he lost his balance and fell out of the trailer to the ground, fracturing his right shoulder, arm, and wrist.
An employee was walking on the gangway from a ship to a pier when he tripped and fell, bruising and potentially cracking his ribs. He was hospitalized.

On May 4, 2018, an employee was operating a forklift truck when it ran into a pole in the warehouse, throwing the employee from the truck. The employee suffered a spinal injury and contusion, as well as a herniated neck disc.
An employee was cleaning the crimper edges on a crimper machine with a scraper when the lid of the machine came down on her right middle finger, causing an amputation.

On May 4, 2018, an employee struck the tongue of a shipping container trailer while operating a utility vehicle, suffering two broken ribs and contusions to the mid-torso. The employee was hospitalized.

After driving a forklift to retrieve an empty drum, an employee was found unconscious next to the forklift, which was parked with the forks lowered. He suffered a head laceration, head contusion, and shoulder contusion.

An employee was trying to connect a drive to duct work when it became stuck. He pulled on the drive, which released and knocked his safety glasses out of the way, lacerating his eye. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
