An employee was using a printing machine to print boxes when his right hand entered the running machine, amputating his thumb and index finger.

An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack near the dock door. The employee had stopped the jack on the dock slope, then drove down the dock slope to turn around in the parking lot and go back up the dock. During the turn, the employee lost control of the motorized pallet jack and stepped off of it, planting the left foot on the pavement while continuing to hold onto the jack. The employee's foot then twisted, breaking the ankle and the top of the foot.
An employee had an allergic reaction to industrial paint and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while stepping down from the bed of a company truck, suffering a possible concussion and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the employee stopped and was struck from behind by a second forklift, suffering a leg injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was driving a forklift into a trailer. Before the employee could get completely in the trailer, the truck pulled forward, causing the forklift to fall sideways between the back of the trailer and the loading dock plate. 
The truck then pulled forward some more, dragging the employee and the forklift. The forklift then fell to the ground on top of the employee, who suffered a fractured pelvis and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was sorting packages off a conveyor belt when he fell approximately 2 feet from a set of steps, breaking his hip.

An employee walked to the front of his double pallet jack and placed his right hand on the throttle and his left on the body of pallet jack with both feet on the ground. When he turned the throttle, the pallet jack ran into his lower left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was strapping down the lid on a dumpster when the bungee cord let loose and struck his right eye. The eye became swollen.

An employee was loading a lift onto a flatbed truck when he became pinned by the lift's articulating boom, suffering a left arm fracture, right wrist fracture, scalp laceration, and neck and lower back vertebrae fractures.
A piece of metal fell off of a roof that was being worked on and struck an employee on his left leg, causing a laceration between his ankle and his calf.

On May 4, 2018, an employee started to build a scaffold when the vertical scaffold leg fell and hit the cross braces. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the cross braces and the vertical scaffold leg. His left ring fingertip was amputated (no bone loss).
While working in an elevator shaft, an employee fell from one floor to the next, suffering two broken ribs and lacerations to the head and back.
An employee was opening the window in her office when her foot gave out and she fell to the floor, injuring her hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was using a table saw when a horn sounded, startling him and causing his hand to contact the saw. The tip of his left thumb was amputated.
On 5/4/18, an employee was lowering a die into a wax injection press when his left hand was caught in the die, partially amputating his index fingertip.
On May 4, 2018, an employee was removing timber from a patio when a rusty nail punctured the employee's hand, resulting in an infection that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee touched a button to open a gate and received an electrical shock to the hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was offloading crates of glass panels from a truck when a crate fell off the truck and struck the employee.

An employee was installing a device in an AC vent. While resetting the sensor, he installed a screw that hit a power cord underneath it. The voltage was about 220 volts. Two employees received an electric shock, and one was hospitalized.
An employee was grabbing onto a crane track while standing on a scaffold when the wheel moved and amputated his left pinky and ring fingers.

An employee was gathering a porta power to slide a piece of equipment into alignment. His finger was resting on a conveyor lip approximately 24 inches below when the porta power fell. He tried to catch it by the hose, which caused it to fall and swing directly onto his left index finger, amputating about 3/4 of an inch of his fingertip.
An employee was unloading steel rods (25 rods to a bundle weighing 2.5 tons total) from a trailer when the rods came loose and rolled over the employee's left leg, breaking the leg and foot.
On May 4, 2018, an employee was carrying a bumper to set it on a conveyor when the bumper slipped and severely lacerated his left cheek.

An employee was helping to move an ice sculpture with two other people when the sculpture became imbalanced. He then felt a severe pain in his back. He was hospitalized with a lumbar herniated disc and back pain.
An employee received a hand injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting pork loins with a band saw when the blade cut his right index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a crane to lower a coupling box. He was guiding the coupling box onto another coupling box when his right ring finger was caught and amputated between the two coupling boxes.

An employee was standing by a door entrance speaking with another employee  while her hand rested on the door frame near the hinges. Another employee then tried to shut the door, crushing her fingers.

An employee was performing blasting work from an 8-foot step ladder when either his foot or weight shifted, causing him to lose balance and fall to a lower level. He fractured his right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding wire into a spooling machine when a loop in the wire caught and amputated his left thumb.
An employee was going down dock steps when she fell, bruising her head and arms. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a vehicle's valve cover gasket with a needle tool when it stabbed his left hand.
An employee was using a pallet jack to move pallets when his right hand was caught between the pallet jack handle and some racking in the warehouse. His right hand broke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a wire choker to remove sparger tubes when the employee's left ring finger was pinched between the sparger tube and the wire choker, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking through the parking lot when her shoe became caught in a concrete seam. She fell to the concrete, fracturing her hip and hand.

An employee was running new overhead powerlines from a lift when the lift's bucket contacted a pole insulator and moved unexpectedly, throwing him against the side of the bucket and the pole insulator. He strained a back ligament and was hospitalized.

On May 5, 2018, at 11:15 a.m., an employee was using a scissor lift to change light bulbs. The scissor lift was equipped with a platform extending feature that was not properly latched. The platform handrail then moved and amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.

On Saturday, May 5, 2018, at approximately 11:30 AM, an employee was walking through the side wall department when he walked into a piece of lumber (2X4) that was jutting out from a table. The lumber struck his abdomen. The next day, he experienced abdominal pain and was hospitalized with a ruptured spleen.

An employee was operating a rider hand truck and struck a guardrail and the right side of the hand truck struck an order picker. The employee suffered an oblique fracture to the first phalanx of his foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was trying to open a pastillator basket filter (turns resin product into quarter-inch beads) when the pressure built up underneath the filter, causing the liquid resin to splash onto and burn his face and right forearm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to turn a reach truck left down an aisle but the truck unintentionally turned to the right. The employee was then caught between the truck and the wall, suffering a compound fracture in the left leg with a severe laceration.
An employee's hand was on a dock lever as it was rising when his left middle finger became caught in the lever, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was walking into an entryway leading to a construction area when she lost her balance and hit her left arm on the corner of an exterior wall. Her left arm broke and required hospitalization.

An employee was running coils through a sealing machine when the coils stopped going all the way into the sealing area. He was attempting to grab a coil that was not properly in the sealing area when the seal bar came down on his left hand, causing third degree burns.
An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) when he  collided with a storage rack. His left arm was pinched and broken between the rack and the PIT.
An employee was opening the trunk lid of a theme park car when the car lurched forward. The lid then came down on her right ring finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell approximately 36 to 40 inches off a stool to the ground, fracturing the left upper femur.
An employee was walking to his car when he tripped on a concrete barrier and fell in the parking lot, breaking his right femur.
An employee was startled by a pigeon and fell, fracturing the tibia in both legs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a pallet outside when his foot became caught and he fell, breaking his left foot.

An employee was dumping powdered sugar into a portable oscillating blender. A tag was dropped  into the machine. The employee attempted to remove the tag and the blender pulled the employee's left hand between the metal bars and a screen, resulting in two broken fingers. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was sitting in a chair talking with a patient. Wen he stood up he felt back pain, and almost fell twice. He was hospitalized with a back strain.

After loading a truck, an employee pulled away from the dock so that he could swing the trailer doors shut. Upon looking at the load from the ground, he noticed that a pallet at the rear of the load might shift or tip in transit and decided to install a load strap to restrain the product. After installing the strap, he stepped back to inspect his work and fell off the edge of the trailer, fracturing his right tibia.

An employee was removing chickens from a bin. His right hand was resting on the rail next to the bin when the bin moved, catching his right hand between the bin and the rail. His right ring finger broke at the center joint, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and a rack protector, lacerating the foot from a toe to the ankle.
An employee suffered a fractured hip after crawling under a conveyor belt to tend to a cello machine at the case packer line.

An employee was observing a machine that was not advancing a plastic sheet correctly and jamming as a result. The employee was checking the tension of the drive belt by depressing the belt with his fingers when the machine unexpectedly advanced the sheet, causing the drive belt to move. When the drive belt moved, the employee's left index finger was caught between the belt and pulley. The employee's left index finger broke at the knuckle near the hand (proximal phalanx) and was lacerated in the same location, damaging the top tendon.

An employee was lifting a client's folded wheelchair into the back of a vehicle when she felt a sharp pain in her lower left back, then felt the pain radiate down her left leg. She suffered a possible muscle strain or pinched nerve.
An employee was cutting sections from 4x4x8 cedar board when their hand made contact with the rotating blade. The thumb and left index fingertip were amputated.

While walking through a building that was under construction an employee stepped onto a portion of the floor where the tiling was uneven. The employee lost balance and fell, fracturing the left ankle.
After processing apparel freight in a back room, an employee went to the break room to cool down when her left arm and neck started hurting and she still felt hot. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a press machine and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was testing the humidity in an air handler unit that supplies air to a clinical laboratory. While exiting the air handler, the employee tripped on a 7-inch lip on the step down. The employee fell forward and caught his left index finger between the door and the doorframe, resulting in an amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was walking by a door when he tripped on a yellow guardrail and fell to the ground, injuring his ankle.

An employee was standing on top of a tanker truck with a water hose preparing to clean it when the water was turned on. The force of the water caused him to fall from the trailer, fracturing his right hip. The employee's lanyard was not secured at the time of the incident.

While backing away from a delivery truck, an employee stepped onto a box (case) that was stacked behind them. The employee became unstable, lost balance, and fell to the ground, breaking a bone in the bottom of the left foot.

After delivering product at a customer's farm, an employee was driving a feed truck away from the farm when the feed trailer's raised auger came into contact with an electrical line. The employee exited the cab of the truck and came into contact with the electrical current, suffering severe burns. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was on a ladder installing fire alarm wiring in a new construction building when the employee lost balance. The employee reached out to brace themselves and grabbed a metal stud that was part of the framing, suffering a hand laceration.
An employee was cutting wood with a radial saw when the wood became caught in the guard. He was trying to remove the wood when his left middle finger was amputated to the middle of the first knuckle.

An employee was deburring a 4x4 inch plate on a sander. When he tilted the plate, the plate went between the sander base and then flipped back and pinched his thumb between it and the sander, amputating his right thumb tip.

An employee was installing lighting over a trim press machine while standing on a ladder. He touched a live wire, fell off the ladder, struck a metal container, and fell to the floor. He injured both shoulders and his knee.
An employee slipped on the bathroom floor and fractured her hip.
An employee was setting up wooden blocks when the employee's left middle finger was pinched between blocks. The employee was hospitalized with a broken finger.
An employee was picking parts from underneath a truck when it shifted and pinned his leg against the ground. He suffered a broken knee and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee received an amputation.

An employee was scraping burrito filler from a machine's kettle when the actuation pedal was pressed and released water into the kettle. The injured employee then suffered a middle fingertip amputation.

On May 7, 2018, aluminum pieces 15 to 20 feet in length were being unloaded from a truck. When a PIT operator removed straps from the load, several bundles of aluminum fell and struck an employee from behind. He suffered a broken leg and severe head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped on the last step while walking down stairs and fell breaking her ankle.
A customer knocked into an employee, who suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

An employee filled a propane cylinder on a platform and was uncoupling the hoses when he lost balance and fell approximately 3 feet from the platform, landing on the tongue of a trailer. He dislocated his right shoulder and broke six ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to remove the tube from a knurling machine when the machine pushed the tubing and the employee's hand into a pinch position against the base of the machine. The employee suffered a right middle finger amputation.

An employee was giving directions to a forklift operator who was stationary by a dock door as another forklift backed out of a trailer from a different dock door. The second forklift turned sharply to the left and pinned the employee between the two forklifts.
An employee fell approximately 14 feet from a scaffold while installing siding and dislocated a shoulder, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking when she slipped on stripper that was on the floor to remove glue and fell, fracturing her left humerus.
While leaving a patient's room, an employee tripped on medical wires and cords and fell, fracturing the right shoulder.
An employee was walking out of the building down the stairs when she fell and broke her fibula.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder while attaching a cable to a residential house soffit. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground, landing on their left side and fracturing a rib.
On May 7, 2018, an employee sustained a fingertip amputation as a result of being caught in a pinch point while assembling snowblower components.
An employee riding on the outside of a waste collection truck fell from the truck while it was in motion, striking his head on the pavement.
An employee was cleaning a car when it accelerated, causing the employee to suffer a shoulder injury and broken jaw.

An employee was operating an excavator to drag a swamp mat. The excavator was going around a fallen tree when it pivoted and the weight of the swamp mat caused the excavator to pivot up and down. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture and broken bones.
An employee tripped on a pallet and fell, fracturing a hip.

An employee was using a scissor lift to fill a mold on a rotational molder when the molder moved to the next step of the rotation while the scissor lift was still in its path. The scissor lift was pushed over and the employee suffered a broken right arm and injuries to the right foot, left ring finger, and left middle finger.

Two employees had removed a 50-pound plate from a machine and were preparing to put it back on. An employee lost their grip on the plate, it slipped and caught their finger between the plate and the machine resulting in amputation of the fingertip from the third digit on the left hand.
An employee was stocking milk when his right knee hit shelving. His injury later became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down the stairwell when she slipped and fell resulting in hospitalization for injuries to the head and feet.
An employee was spraying weed killer from a 4-wheeler when the 4-wheeler's throttle malfunctioned and got stuck. The employee tried to turn the 4-wheeler and fell off resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was troubleshooting the shaker table on a plate machine. As the employee bent over to pick up a screw, the machine was activated catching her hand that had been placed on the table in the shaker table chain resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time.
On May 8, 2018, an employee was pushing a pallet of water back onto his trailer with a pallet jack at a customer location when he felt pain and a bulge in his abdomen area due to a ruptured hernia.
An employee was cutting steel with a torch on an elevated expressway structure. As he was lighting the torch, he was burned on both ears, the front of his face, and neck.
While changing a tire on a rim, an employee's finger was amputated by the tire changing machine.

An employee was standing in front of his powered industrial truck looking over his load when a second employee working in the trailer next to him struck him with a powered industrial truck. He suffered bruises to the right foot and a broken left ankle.

A clamp was pulling a slab from an A-frame and lifting it in the air when it hit other slabs that were resting on safety poles. Five to six quartz slabs then fell from the A-frame and struck an employee, who suffered a fractured left knee and was hospitalized.

An employee was wearing a personal protective equipment belt that holds hoses for an air-supplied hooded respirator when the belt rubbed his side/waist, causing an infection that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating an excavator when it tipped on the edge of the road adjacent to a trench. This caused the employee to fall against the inside of the cab resulting in hospitalization for broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a bruised spleen.
An employee was drilling into a pressurized container and the container ruptured. The contents of the container were hot and burned the employee's hand and arms.

An employee was walking on a wooden catwalk when the floor gave way resulting in the employee falling approximately 22 feet into a fertilizer bin with material about 5 feet high. The employee sustained a bruised lung and four broken ribs.
An employee fell at the facility and suffered a brain contusion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal and set the grinder down. Their hand made contact with the grinder before it stopped spinning. Two fingers on the left hand were cut.

The injured employee was wiping off condensation from a drip pan located above the poultry processing machine. The employee reached his hand above the machine and his hand became wedged between a trolley rail and the machine resulting in a fracture to the employee's right arm and lacerations to the right hand.
While attempting to remove a chicken thigh from a plastic modular belting line, an employee's finger was caught on a section of the belt resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.
An employee was drilling holes in concrete in cattle pens to build fences when cattle in the area became spooked and started running. The employee rolled out of the way and was found unconscious.

Two employees were transferring rinsate from a chemical tote to frac tanks using a bucket. Approximately six hours later, both employees stated that they felt winded with slightly strained breathing. One of the employees was hospitalized due to strained breathing and low oxygen levels.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when he was struck by a powered industrial truck entering the warehouse. He suffered a head laceration.

An employee was verifying the belt tension for a belt-driven fan for conveyor coal unloading. The fan was locked out. While checking the belt tension manually, the employee had his left hand on the belt. The mass of the machine allowed the belt to move despite it being locked out, pulling the injured employee's hand into a pinch point. After pulling his hand out, he required a medical amputation of the left ring fingertip.

An employee was running a steel cutting saw. The machine indexed and the employee was caught between the vice cylinder and the machine resulting in a back and leg injury. The machine was unguarded at the time.
While walking beside a skid loader, an employee tripped and fell and his right foot was run over by the skid loader. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and smashed toes.

Two employees were cutting a plaster bulkhead from a scaffold when the cut piece fell and tipped the scaffold over. One of the employees suffered a broken jaw, facial lacerations, and a possible broken leg.

An employee was operating a crane to lift a 4,300-pound bundle that was 24 feet long. The bundle was being raised with one strap of a 8-foot sling; the other strap was snagged on something. As the bundle was raised, it shifted and the employee placed his left hand on the end of the bundle in an attempt to stabilize the load. The bundle moved approximately 31" and struck another bundle.  The employee's left hand was caught between the two bundles. The middle fingertip was amputated, the ring finger required surgery, and the pinky finger required stitches.
An employee's right index finger was caught in a spring-loaded door resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

On May 8, 2018, at 10:30 p.m., a temporary employee was operating a standup powered industrial truck.  When turning at an intersection, the forklift skidded toward the corner of a wall. He attempted to stop the vehicle with his foot, but it was crushed between the truck and wall. His foot/leg suffered multiple fractures, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were installing siding from an aluminum plank that was between two step ladders when the plank gave way, allowing them to fall to the ground. One employee sustained a sprained ankle, while the other sustained multiple fractures to his left leg. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee struck a support beam with a forklift truck and suffered internal injuries. He then exited the forklift truck and fell, striking his head on the concrete surface. He suffered neck, back, and head injuries, as well as fractured vertebrae.
An employee fell off the wheel chair lift of a van while trying to unload a patient. The employee sustained a broken left tibia.

On May 8, 2018, at approximately 12:10 a.m., employees were running some traded pipes and casing. The crew had a problem connecting two pipes (casing), so they unscrewed those pipes and continued to work with the casing. The injured employee's left hand was on top of an open pipe when a hoist operator (driller) let a second pipe come down. The employee's left-hand fingers were caught between the two pipes (casing), resulting in an amputation of his index finger and a broken ring finger.

On May 9, 2018, an employee was inspecting a machine from an extension ladder when the ladder slipped from underneath the employee. The employee fell 6 feet and dislocated an ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was running a cement mixer when the employee's left hand was caught between the paddles inside the mixer, resulting in the amputation of the employee's middle, ring, and pinky fingers.

An employee was attempting to free an apple that was stuck in an auger when the employee's clothing became caught in the auger. The employee then suffered a left hand amputation at the wrist, broken bones, contusions, and lacerations.

An employee was helping another maintenance employee install a hydraulic cylinder. During installation, the square cylinder base was not fully seated in the slot. The injured employee's finger was pointing to where the cylinder was stuck when the 90-pound cylinder base dropped down and pinched the employee's left index finger, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was manually flipping an 18" by 30" cross head guide that weighed 150 pounds when the part landed on his right hand, crushing his ring and pinky fingers. His pinky finger required stitches and his ring finger was amputated to the first joint.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut the end of a wood piece when the saw lacerated the employee's right hand between the thumb and index finger.
An employee was exiting the office through a door and going down steps into the courtyard when she fell as she approached the last step, breaking her left ankle. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee fell 24 feet to the ground while erecting a concrete wall form. The employee suffered a right arm fracture and laceration, pelvic fracture, rib fracture, and vertebra fracture.
An employee was working from a ladder using a grinder when he slipped and cut his left forearm.  He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee became ill after repairing a gas valve in an excavation.
An employee suffered a right index fingertip amputation while cutting meat with a meat saw.
An employee was erecting scaffold and fell 15 feet from the top of a mobile scaffold to the pavement below, suffering a chin laceration and broken ribs.
An employee was changing a filter when he fell off his step ladder, possibly breaking his ribs and collarbone.

An employee was overseeing and monitoring the glass manufacturing process at a press machine when he noticed marks (contamination) on a glass pack as it exited the press. He then walked to the entry side, grabbed a paper towel, and attempted to clean the rollers in the press, which was running at the time. His right hand contacted the roller and was pulled into the press. His right hand and part of his forearm were crushed, requiring hospitalization. All required personal protective equipment was worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was troubleshooting the pneumatic plunger under the conveyor belt track of a heat stacker machine when his left index finger was caught by the lift table, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was attempting to dislodge a stuck pin in a sheet shackle when the pin engaged after being struck and caught the employee's fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation (no bone loss).
An employee was cleaning a furnace when hot iron burned his elbows, knees, and stomach. He was hospitalized.
An employee was relighting a residential pilot light when a fire/explosion occurred. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns to the face and arms.

An employee was standing on a truck lift gate while a forklift operator was removing a tub full of coin. The tub shifted and fell to the side, knocking the employee from the lift gate but trapping his ankle underneath the tub and causing him to hang off the gate for a few seconds. His right lower leg suffered a contusion.
An employee was helping to unload a concrete pole from a pole trailer when it fell onto the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was walking across the factory floor when he slipped and fell, breaking a hip.
A maintenance employee was walking between buildings during his shift when he tripped on the curb and fell, breaking his upper left leg.
An employee was prepping a part for painting with an abrasive blaster when he lost control of the blaster and the blasting media contacted his left forearm. Sand was used as the abrasive media.
An employee was cleaning and trying to move a bench when he tripped over a rug behind him and fell to the floor, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a saw to cut a piece of wood when the blade amputated the employee's left index fingertip. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was working on a refractory dry-out project using a gas-fired heating method. During the process of lighting one of the burners, the bulkhead blew out. The employee suffered second degree burns to the face and hands, first degree burns to the throat and lungs, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was on a scaffold removing duct from overhead when the employee lost balance and fell 4 feet to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee had an allergic reaction to a latex balloon and was hospitalized.

On May 9, 2018, at 1:17 p.m., an employee was operating a forklift and struck another forklift. His left thumb was caught between the lifts, resulting in a fractured thumb/thumb joint. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a tractor to apply grass seed to a golf course. He then went behind the tractor to the seeder. The tractor rolled backwards and crushed him.
An employee was reaching into a blow molding machine when he struck his head on the interlock guarding device and collapsed. He lost consciousness.
An employee fell from an extension ladder and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to pull off the bottom side of a drain hose on a corn flaker to see if it was plugged when the top side of the drain hose came off and hot water was dumped onto the employee. The employee suffered burns to the neck, arms, and stomach.
An employee was attempting to enter a pick-up when he lost his footing, fell, and struck his right side flank on the side step of the vehicle. He suffered a right kidney contusion and hematuria.

Two employees were running a test on a prototype tankless water heater that ran on natural gas when the unit started to overheat. The carbon monoxide alarm sounded and the employees evacuated the room, but one employee was exposed to the gas and required hospitalization.
While tracking a group of individuals, an employee experienced difficulty breathing, pain in his right shoulder, and black-out sensations.
An employee's pinky finger was crushed between two snow plow push frames that fell onto each other when the employee touched them to see if they were dry.

On Wednesday, May 9, 2018, at approximately 11:15 a.m., an employee was removing transite panels on a construction site when he lost his balance and fell 4.5 feet to the ground. His left ankle struck a small pile of brick rubble. He was hospitalized with a possible broken ankle and abrasions to the left forearm. A lanyard was not connected at the time of the incident.
On May 10, 2018, an employee felt a pop in the abdomen while lifting a 50-pound coil. The employee was hospitalized with pain and nausea.

An employee was in a bucket connecting parts on a pole when a wire in the employee's left hand touched something and caused an arc flash (7,200 volts), burning the top and palm of the employee's hand.
An employee was struck by a sit-down forklift mast while walking out of an office, suffering a fractured metatarsal.

An employee was reattaching a telephone wire to a residential home when the ladder he was working from slipped out and caused him to fall approximately 8 to 10 feet to the ground. He sustained bruising, three broken ribs, a laceration to his forehead, and a sore thumb.
An employee was working in a 4-foot-deep excavation applying epoxy to welds when the employee became ill with heat cramps. The employee was hospitalized for heat exposure.

An employee was on the loading dock, loading a trailer. He climbed onto the trailer-door track-guard at the rear of the trailer to reach and strap freight, securing it in the trailer. He slipped off the door-track guard and fell into the gap between the trailer and dock, sustaining multiple fractures to his right ankle.
An employee was adjusting a road case near a column when her right index finger was crushed between the road case and a thermostat.
An employee was struck from behind by shoplifters as he was walking to the restroom. He suffered bruises, scratches, and a sprained knee, requiring hospitalization.
While walking from the job site to a truck, an employee slipped and tripped on the curbside. The employee suffered a broken left ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was servicing rooftop HVAC units and turning off a water valve when he was attacked by bees or wasps. As he tried to swat and move away from them, he fell approximately 13 feet from the roof to the ground.
An employee became overheated while cleaning an oven, requiring hospitalization.
On May 10, 2018, an employee was hospitalized after tripping on a box that was on the floor.
An employee was opening the door to a car that was on a flat bed truck for recycling when the door fell and struck the employee's left middle finger, amputating it.
An employee was manually guiding valve stacks into place when the employee's left index finger was pinched, resulting in an amputation.

An employee on a work over rig went to the rig platform to relieve the rig operator.  Wind was blowing very hard (30 to 40 mph) with gusts. An umbrella was attached to a handrail to protect employees from elements and blowing dust. The employee was adjusting the umbrella when a strong gust blew him off of the rig platform. The gust carried the umbrella, the 4-5 foot handrail, and the employee over the edge. He fell approximately 15 feet to the ground, breaking his femur.
An employee suffered partial scalping when their hair was caught in a moving shaft while cleaning around the seed treating equipment.

An employee was plugging a gantry crane into an outlet when it arced and caused him to fly back a couple of feet. He was unresponsive for about 10 to 15 seconds. The electricity had entered his right hand and exited his left hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a pallet jack configured to haul roll tainting equipment. He backed up the equipment and switched it to coast pro mode, then walked between the coasting pallet jack and a rack. His ankle was caught and fractured between the jack and the rack.
An employee experienced a stroke while moving boxes off a pallet and onto a table.

On May 10, 2018, at 5:40 p.m., several employees were attempting to remove a machine from a semi trailer. The machine was returned by a customer and had not been crated. The employees used a forklift and lifting straps to move the machine. The machine tipped, pinning one employee against the wall of the facility. The employee suffered a broken ankle and cracked rib, as well as a possible concussion.
An employee was attempting to change a truck trailer tire and was pinned by the bumper of the trailer. The employee suffered severe bruising and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a table saw to cut wood for a TV set prop. He was guiding the wood through the saw with his left hand when the saw amputated his left index fingertip. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was setting trusses at a building when he slipped and fell 5 to 8 feet, dislocating his ankle. Fall protection was worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was cutting the bolt on the back of a truck to repair it when the lift gate fell on the employee's left thumb and index finger. The employee sustained a small laceration on the index finger and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was installing a box behind a stack of drywall when the drywall fell on his legs, fracturing them and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was fitting a welding key into a slot to join two pieces of iron that were on a work table. The key did not fit properly so he removed it to investigate. His finger was in the key slot when one of the pieces of iron shifted, resulting in the amputation his left middle fingertip.

An employee was holding a piece of looped carbon fiber thread when his left index finger became tangled in the loop as it was entering a pre-carbonizer. As he removed his finger from the loop, his left index finger was amputated.
An employee fell off his extension ladder while installing a cable line to a residence.

An employee was operating a receiving conveyor line when it stopped. The employee removed a label that covered a photo eye and the conveyor started to run again. The employee's right hand was then caught between the conveyor belt and a roller, causing contusions, swelling, and skin removal.  The employee was hospitalized.
A trench collapsed with one employee in the work area.

An employee was on the fourth step of an 8-foot ladder removing a piece of HVAC duct work from the ceiling while a coworker supported the duct work from the floor. The coworker lost control of the duct work and it swung down and knocked over the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right scapula, fractured right clavicle, and seven fractured ribs.

An employee was taking a pin from a heavy duty jack stand to use on another jack stand. As another employee removed the pin, the lift dropped and caught the injured employee's fingertip in the adjustment holes in the stand, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hospitalized due to a splinter received while sanding a hardwood floor.
An employee was cutting a tree off of a communication line when the tree snapped and the tension on the line flipped the tree/limb back onto the employee, striking his forearm and fracturing a bone.
An employee was troubleshooting a laser cutting table when it indexed/articulated and knocked him to the floor. He suffered a back injury.
An employee was working on a forklift propane tank leak when the fuel ignited. The employee received burns to the arms, torso and face, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was pulling a pallet down from a rack with a reach truck. He reached up to adjust a light with his left hand while his right hand was on the joy stick. He unintentionally pulled back on the joy stick and the truck went backward, catching his left hand between the rack and beam behind him. His left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a hydraulic pump when his left pinky fingertip was smashed in the valve, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell in the parking lot, sustaining two fractured elbows and a laceration to the forehead.
An employee was removing the bagging device from a lawn mower when his fingers contacted the spinning blades and were amputated.
An employee was using an air nailer to perform framing work when the nailer shot a nail into his chest.

An employee was performing maintenance on a press when the employee's hand touched the two-hand trip. The press then cycled while the employee's hand was in the point of operation, amputating a finger.

Three employees were manually offloading a steel H-brace from a utility trailer. As the crew was attempting to push the brace away from the trailer, the brace slid down and struck one employee across both knees. The employee suffered a fracture to the left knee and a 4-inch laceration above the left knee.
An employee was moving a disc with a hoist when the disc fell on and fractured his foot, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was ripping and cutting sheeter sidings (a piece of wood) on a table saw when he attempted to flick a piece of wood out of the table saw area. His hand was then caught on the saw blade, amputating his index and ring fingers.

An employee placed a cover in a welder and hit the two-hand control. The cover was not situated correctly. As the employee attempted to adjust it, the welder amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was opening a box storage trailer when two large bundles of cardboard boxes fell out and hit the employee in the head, knocking him to the ground. He was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee wrapped a rope around a truck crane outrigger leg to use as an anchor to lower a large jack from a steel utility pole. The rope was wrapped once around the outrigger leg and when the jack started lowering from the utility pole, the rope let out quickly and knocked the employee off their feet falling onto the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right hip and left scapula.

The employee was performing repairs on a fire truck while the truck's cab was being held up in a tilted position by a safety latch. The pivot point on the cab broke and released the cab lock. The cab fell from its tilted position and the employee was crushed between the engine and cab frame. The employee sustained severe head trauma.
An employee was operating an off-road vehicle when he lost control of the vehicle and it rolled. He suffered a broken left radial bone and a fractured left foot.

An employee was moving product with a forklift when he lost control of the load (pallet) and it struck a second employee on the left leg. The injured employee suffered multiple fractures to her left leg.

An employee was guiding another employee who was driving a car into the bay. The car accelerated, striking and pinning the employee between the car and the tire machine. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the right leg.
An employee was walking to a cardboard baler with a cardboard box in his hands when he tripped and fell, fracturing his femur and hip.

An employee was going to work carrying multiple bags and a newspaper.  She was using her right arm to open the front door to enter the lobby when she lost her grip on the door, lost her balance, and then fell. She suffered a displaced right distal radius fracture with posttraumatic carpal tunnel syndrome.

An employee drove a road-rail material handling truck to a fabrication business/shop to transport a rail cart. The road-rail truck was equipped with a boom lift, and the employee sat in the boom operator seat and used the boom to lift the rail cart off the truck. While lifting the rail cart off the road-rail truck, the boom over-extended, which caused the road-rail truck to lean. The rail cart then fell off the boom, causing the road-rail truck to rock and the employee to fall out of the boom operator seat to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken left elbow, broken right knee, and minor brain and liver bleeding, which required hospitalization. A seat belt was not worn at the time.

An employee was hydro blasting a vertical pipe with a lancer to unclog the pipe.  When the material that was clogging the pipe broke free, it knocked the lancer out of the pipe. The employee was then hit on the left arm by the lancer water pressure, suffering a laceration.

An employee was descending a 20-foot extension ladder that was secured at the top and had an employee holding it at the bottom. The employee missed a step and fell down the ladder while holding onto the side bars. The employee hit the ground, fracturing the left leg and both ankles.

On May 11, 2018, an employee was helping another employee load panels onto a CNC router. He had just placed two panels on the vacuum work station when his right hand entered the running tool cutter, amputating his middle and ring fingers. The tool cutter was guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a lift truck (sit down rider forklift) when his lower left leg was caught between the truck and a railroad wheel. His lower left leg broke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was sanding a part on a lathe when his right index finger became caught and amputated in a hole on the rotating part.
An employee was performing maintenance on a machine when the machine cycled and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee tripped over a bench and fell to the floor, breaking an arm and requiring surgery.

An employee was watching a 30-foot belt sander when the grinder belt got in a bind, causing the motor stand to tip over and catch the employee's hand between the stand and a rail. The employee's right hand was crushed, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a heart attack while laying water line pipe at a construction project.
An employee climbed onto a sweeper truck to replace the lid on the water tank. The employee slipped on the wet surface and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground, suffering a spinal fracture.
On 5/11/2018, an employee was signing a truck call ticket when a truck driver struck and ran over his feet. He suffered fractures to both feet as well as his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a vice that was not cranking down, so the employee tried to push down on the side of the vice. The vice let loose and the employee's right pinky was crushed between the anvil side and the mechanical side of the vice. The employee eventually required a medical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee tripped over a box and fell fracturing the left elbow and forearm.
An employee was about to change a damaged belt in the air handler unit on the roof when his glove was caught in the moving belt resulting in a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.

Two employees were using a mechanical lift to lift a resident from a bed.  As the resident was being lifted, he started thrashing and the lift tilted. The employees tried to hold the lift and one of them suffered a strained back, while the other was hit by the lift frame and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was walking down stairs when she slipped and fell, fracturing her right medial malleolus.
On 5/12/2018, an employee tripped over an equipment cord while assisting a patient in the emergency room. The employee fell to the ground and broke a leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee went outside to investigate the cause of some noise and commotion. An assailant was going through the neighborhood on a crime spree with a baseball bat and struck the employee. The employee suffered head and facial trauma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a machine when two of the employee's fingers were caught in a rotating roller. The employee broke a thumb and required stitches.

An employee was installing painter's tape around a window while standing about 12 feet up on a 24-foot extension ladder. After he finished the installation, he was descending when he slipped and fell about 8 feet onto the sandy ground below, resulting in a micro-fissure fracture on his L-2 vertebra. He was hospitalized.

On May 12, 2018, at approximately 9:30 a.m., an employee and a coworker were responding to a motor vehicle accident that had caused a down power line. He ducked below the downed powerline to provide assistance to the injured victims. His forehead then made contact with the energized power line, and an electric current entered his forehead and existed his foot. He was hospitalized.

On May 12, 2018, at 10:30 a.m., an employee used a chair with wheels as a step ladder to hang a wall decoration. The chair inadvertently rolled, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee fractured the front and back of the left leg and the left knee, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was helping a coworker repair an aircraft tire. He removed a tire from a cart and leaned it against the cart to ready it for installation. The tire then fell onto his lower left leg, breaking it.

An employee was ripping off shingles from a single-story residential re-roofing project when the employee stepped on a piece of loose felt and slipped from the roof, falling to the ground and injuring the right elbow.

An employee was preparing hamburgers on a portable grill when a fire broke out, causing propane tanks to explode. He received first degree burns to his hands, a head injury, and possible smoke inhalation.

An employee was driving down a lease road when the employee struck a rock in the road, over-corrected, and ran off the road, striking larger rocks that set the airbag off. The employee suffered a possible concussion.
An employee fell from a 6-foot scaffold while removing a temporary wall, suffering a fractured pelvis, knee injury, and concussion.
An employee fell approximately 30 feet onto the driveway of a gated garage. He was then struck and run over by a car, sustaining femur and jaw injuries, loss of teeth, and a collapsed lung.

On 5/13/2018, an employee was attempting to clear a jam on an overhead bread cooler conveyor when the moving parts amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers. The conveyor was unguarded and was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was attempting to chase down a customer's runaway vehicle in the parking lot when the vehicle ran over the employee. The employee suffered leg and pelvic fractures.

An employee was opening the forks of a forklift to pick up a bag of casing protectors when his left ring fingertip was partially amputated between the fork and the forklift carriage. Impact gloves were worn at the time of the incident.

An employee stepped onto PVC pipe flanges to view the water level in a tank when the pipe flanges broke under the pressure of his feet, causing him to fall. He broke his jaw and lacerated the right side of his face, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a cash register at a grocery store checkout lane when she chased after a non-paying customer and slipped and fell on an entranceway rug. She broke her hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing the blade on his safety cutter when the blade lacerated his right index fingertip, resulting in the amputation of a small portion of the skin on his fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a hopper when it activated while the employee's hand was inside, causing a finger amputation.
An employee was using medicated shampoo to bathe a dog with a lot of ticks when the employee became ill with nausea and dizziness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the wood became bound up in the saw, pulling the employee's left hand into the blade. The employee's hand and fingers were cut.
Employee lost part of thumb in machine.

On May 14, 2018, an employee was working on a sheet metal roof and started to experience symptoms related to heat illness. The employee was admitted to the hospital for heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee fell from a ladder while servicing a residence and broke his humerus.

An employee was mixing a batch of raw materials under a hood using a hot plate and a 2-gallon steel pot when flames emerged from the pot. A second employee, who was also working under the hood on another batch of product, responded and placed a lid over the pot to suppress the flames. Shortly thereafter, an energy release occurred, creating a larger flame and a pressure wave that knocked the pot onto the floor. Some of the pot's contents landed on the first employee's body and clothes and the second employee's hand. The first employee received third degree burns to both hands and second degree burns to the arms, face, and stomach. The second employee received second degree burns to the right hand.

On 05/14/2018, at approximately 2:45 PM, an employee was working from a 12-foot fiberglass A-frame step ladder. The employee was using a drill to install conduit for a junction box when he fell 8-9 feet from the ladder onto the concrete floor below, fracturing his right/left wrists and lacerating his face above the left eye. He was hospitalized for surgery and stitches. Proper PPE was worn at the time.

An employee was taking a work capacity test that required the employee to walk 3 miles on flat terrain with a 45-pound vest in 46 minutes or less. At the end of the test, the employee experienced cramps and then lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a ladder to enter and clean a liquid fertilizer tank when he fell. He sustained a cracked skull, broken ribs, and bruised organs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking in his working area when he slipped on mud and fell, injuring his leg.
On May 12, 2018, an employee was stepping off the side platform on the passenger side of a yard truck when his right leg struck against the metal step, fracturing his tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking with a mini-excavator that was carrying a sewer vault in a marked construction zone on a public roadway. A privately owned vehicle sped through the zone, causing the employee to step sideways into the path of the mini-excavator. The mini-excavator then struck and broke his leg.
An employee became dizzy and overheated while delivering mail.
Two employees were moving and tilting a large steel beam when it suddenly fell over and struck the injured employee's right and left shins. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was lowering a fiber optic cable while working on a scaffold when a bus ran and hooked the cable, causing the scaffold to topple. The employee fell onto an air conditioning unit below.
An employee was removing waste nylon from a winding machine when the nylon became caught on the moving spindle. The nylon then amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was riding on an all-terrain vehicle off road when the vehicle overturned. The employee sustained a head injury, damage to the C-4 vertebra, and a cracked rib, requiring hospitalization.

The employee was stripping some forms using a crowbar when the crowbar slipped, causing him to lose his balance. He then put all his weight down on his right foot and rolled his ankle. His ankle suffered a fracture and required surgery.
An employee was working outside and became ill later that evening. He was admitted for possible heat exhaustion.

An employee was using a forklift to unload a trailer of pulp material when the forklift struck a dock plate as he was backing out of the trailer. The forklift abruptly stopped, which caused the employee to suffer neck and back injuries.
An employee was walking through a door when strong winds grabbed the door and slammed it into her left hand, partially severing her left pinky finger. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was checking a side puller to see whether a contractor had sanitized it when the machine actuated while his hand was inside. His left hand was caught in the side puller, amputating portions of his index, middle, and ring fingers. The side puller was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was guiding yarn into machine rollers when the rollers pulled his right hand into the machine, crushing his fingers. The machine also released steam that burned his fingers and right forearm. The rollers were unguarded at the time.
An employee slipped while walking behind a counter after another employee had previously mopped the floor. She fell to the floor and fractured her wrist.
While driving a forklift, and employee was caught between a metal rail and the rear of the forklift. The employee's left foot was crushed and broken.
An employee was walking backward with a wheelbarrow and as he transitioned between surfaces he slipped and fell onto his back and right side. He fractured five ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when two dogs became loose and mauled the employee's fingers. The employee's right middle finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was talking to a forklift driver when the forklift reversed and struck the employee. The employee sustained a right ankle/foot injury that required hospitalization.

On 5/14/2018, an employee was reversing a PIV when it struck another PIV that had its forks raised. The forks struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a vertical splitter to split logs and was holding the log on the top. As he depressed the foot pedal, the blades came down and amputated a portion of his right index finger.
An employee was pouring concrete when the concrete pump truck struck and knocked him to the ground, bruising his ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was performing a change over on a machine when the machine cycled and amputated one of her fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.

On May 14, 2018, an employee was manually moving a laundry trolley system and became caught and crushed between the system and the trolley. The employee suffered abrasions to the legs and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a cart of ice cream from a truck when the cart started to roll off the hydraulic truck lift. The employee attempted to stop the cart but was injured, suffering a fractured hip and lacerations to the head and elbow.

An employee was driving a beverage cart around a golf course when a drawer on the cart opened and became caught on a fence, causing the driver to be thrown from the cart and the cart to flip. The beverage cart landed on top of the employee, who suffered two pelvic fractures.
An employee was upending a transformer that was on a skid when the employee's left fourth fingertip was pinched and partially amputated between a runner and the skid.
An employee tripped over a piece of plastic in a warehouse and fell to the floor, sustaining a broken hip.

An employee was working on a strand pack (a frame that holds cable in place) and attempting to remove a section of cable when his fingertip was caught in the cable windings, resulting in a partial right index fingertip amputation.

On May 14, 2018, an employee was attempting to clear material from a mower vacuum when the blades amputated his thumb and several fingers on his left hand. The mower blades were running at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a jointer/lathe when a small strand from his protective gloves became caught in the machine. The small strand forced his right index finger into the blade of the rotary spindle and he sustained a partial amputation to his right index fingertip.
At around 10 a.m., on 5/14/2018, an employee was weed-eating in a shipyard when he experienced a headache, dizziness, and cramps. He was hospitalized due to dehydration and low sodium levels.

An employee was moving a steel beam with an overhead crane when the crane's pin (clip) broke and the beam fell, hitting the employee on the head and right hip. He was hospitalized for a concussion and leg contusion.
On May 14, 2018, an employee was helping a co-worker load a compressor onto a truck when he was caught between the compressor and the truck frame, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was preparing to spool a bucket truck line with an electric winch when the employee's right thumb was caught and smashed in the winch.

An employee was preparing to set a carrier hydraulic cylinder in place. His finger was in the retaining pin hole slot checking the alignment when the hydraulic cylinder was set in place, amputating his fingertip.
On 5/14/2018, an employee fell off a roof to the ground that was approximately 16 feet high, breaking both ankles and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a mirror when it cracked and lacerated his forearm, severing a tendon and causing nerve and arterial damage. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of meat with a knife and amputated the left ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a polishing wheel and amputated a fingertip.

Two employees were changing the filter in the parts washer. The injured employee was lifting the metal basket out of the housing with another employee. It slipped out of the second employee's hands landing on the pinky finger of the injured employee. The finger was amputated.

An employee was using a boom lift to unload equipment from a flatbed truck when the turntable of the boom turned around 180 degrees with the bucket remaining on the trailer. He drove the boom toward the end of the trailer and before he could stop, the front wheels went off the back of the trailer. He was thrown off the lift and landed on the street, fracturing his right wrist and right hip. He also sustained a laceration to the right side of his face.

An employee was helping another employee lower a lift gate on a truck. His left hand was on the edge of the lift gate when the latching mechanism closed, catching his left pinky fingertip and resulting in an amputation.
An employee struck a support pole in the warehouse while driving a forklift, suffering a head laceration and potential bone fragmentation. He was hospitalized.
An employee was checking the tong heads on some tubing tongs when the tongs engaged and amputated the first digit of the employee's left index finger.

On May 15, 2018, an employee fell approximately 15 feet while accessing a cargo ship, suffering a head injury, multiple facial fractures, mandible fractures, a left elbow fracture, and a soft tissue injury and laceration to the left ankle/foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a 1,250-ton press brake to bend parts. As a part was being bent by the press dies, it swung up toward the face of the ram. The employee was still holding the part, and his right middle and ring fingertips were then pinched and amputated between the part and the front of the machine.
An employee's sleeve became caught in an auger that he was using to drill holes for fence posts. He suffered an arm fracture.

An employee was pressure testing a fuel tank and void tank on a boat. Liquid was coming out of the pot into the test hose when the T-bar hatch blew off, striking the employee in the left knee and face and knocking him onto his back. He suffered a fractured tibia and broken nose.
A maintenance employee sustained an amputation while cleaning a meat pump.

An employee was loading a box truck. He was sitting on a stack of 20 doors (each door was 1 inch thick) that had been wrapped and stacked onto a 4-inch-high pallet and was in the bed of the truck. He then fell off the stack of doors and onto the truck bed (a distance of about 24 inches), fracturing his left femur and left wrist.

An employee was disconnecting gauges from a condenser when a valve failed to close, releasing refrigerant from the system. The employee attempted to shut the valve with a wrench and was exposed to refrigerant, receiving a chemical burn to the right hand.
An employee was walking to his truck at a remote site when his knee gave out due to a torn or dislocated tendon. He was hospitalized for surgery.

While inspecting a residential roof for damage, an employee fell approximately 12 feet from the third floor to the second floor roof. The employee suffered cracked ribs, a punctured lung, and a possible back fracture.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete below, landing on his back. He sustained a head laceration and fractured vertebrae in the back.

An employee had conducted landscaping, including rototilling, hand raking, and planting, at a work site. Around 4:30 PM, he was riding in the company truck to leave the work site when he felt ill, lightheaded, and dizzy. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

On May 15, 2018, at about 4:40 p.m., two employees were using a forklift to transport a frac tank onto a flatbed trailer. The tank was placed on a metal plate positioned on the forks of the forklift. During transport, the frac tank and metal plate shifted, striking the two employees. One employee sustained two fractured knuckles to the left hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing janitorial services in a bathroom when she slipped and fell, breaking her clavicle.

An employee was operating a hydraulic pallet lift conveyor to remove cans of tomatoes from a pallet. His leg was between the pallet lift conveyor and a guardrail when the hydraulic control was pressed, causing the pallet conveyor to rise and squeeze his right leg between the pallet and guardrail. His right leg broke.

An employee drove a tractor to a paint load station, stood up, and was about to begin sanding an area of the tractor when the employee tripped and fell approximately 2 feet to the tractor tracks, before rolling and falling approximately 4 more feet to the concrete below. The employee was hospitalized.
While operating a stand-up forklift, an employee was struck by another forklift operator who was traveling in reverse. The employee suffered an open left foot fracture.
An employee tripped on a floor transition strip and fell while carrying mail, suffering a compression fracture.
An employee's finger was smashed between a gate latch and a pipe on a cattle pen, requiring a partial surgical amputation.
An employee was walking to a linen cart to get towels when she lost her balance and fell, striking her head on the floor.

An employee was working on a two-story condo unit's roof area when he slipped and fell from the roof, hitting an air conditioning unit before hitting the ground. He sustained fractures to his left-side ribs.

On 5/14/2018, a temporary employee was walking through a warehouse when his phone was knocked out of his hand. As he reached to pick up his phone, a powered industrial vehicle backed over his left foot, breaking it and requiring surgery. Steel toe shoes were worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning underneath a conveyor belt with a rag when the employee's right arm was pulled in by the conveyor belt, breaking two bones in the right hand.

An employee was using a hand held drill to mix concrete when he noticed the mixing pedal was coming loose. He tried to tighten it and his left glove became caught in the mixer, which then amputated his left pinky. The mixer was running at the time.

An employee operated a forklift to transport a hopper outside in order to empty the hopper contents into a dumpster. The employee got off the forklift and tried to move down the manual lever that causes the hopper to empty, but the lever was tight. When the employee finally got the lever to go down, the hopper shifted and caught the employee's hand between the hopper and a forklift fork, resulting in the amputation of the employee's left middle finger at the first knuckle.
On May 15, 2018, at approximately 9:15 p.m., an employee was moving an empty, non-motorized dolly on an air ramp when the dolly struck her knee, fracturing it and requiring surgery.
An employee was unloading a mower from a trailer when he suddenly fainted. His head hit the concrete and his left leg slid under the mower stand and was scraped. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a clamp at a joint in a stainless steel water line that was diluted with peracetic acid when the acid contacted the employee, who received second degree burns to the left shoulder, left chest, and neck, as well as eye and chest irritation.
An employee's fingers were inside a machine when a second employee activated the two-hand controls, powering the machine's hock cutter. The hock cutter then amputated the employee's fingers.

An employee was preparing girder #2 to be raised from the ground and put in position with girder #1. He was standing on top of girder #2, which was approximately 9 feet high, when girder #1 rolled over and fell. He heard the noise and jumped from girder #2 to avoid being struck. He fell and hit his head, suffering a left eye bruise and multiple facial fractures.
An employee was helping another employee carry an abandoned couch out to the dumpster when he stepped off the curb backwards and broke his ankle, requiring surgery.
While walking alongside an excavator, an employee tripped on a curb. The employee's left ankle was run over by the excavator track, breaking bones above the ankle and in the foot.
An employee was climbing onto the operator's seat of a digger derrick when he lost his balance and fell backwards 6 to 8 feet to the ground. He suffered a lower back compression fracture.
On May 15, 2018, an employee was spotting for an excavator that was pulling a tree when a tree branch whiplashed and struck his hip, fracturing his pelvis and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was disconnecting a hydraulic line from a cylinder that was being lifted from a core press by a crane. The cylinder then slipped from the cylinder bracket, and the employee's left little finger was pinched between the cylinder bracket and press core frame. The left little finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee suffered a laceration to the face and forearm and a fractured rib after being struck by the door of a walk-in freezer. The employee was hospitalized.

On 5/15/2018, an employee was loading tubular product onto a tractor trailer when the employee fell off the edge of the unguarded truck/work platform to the ground, sustaining a leg/foot injury that required hospitalization.
An employee fell from an A-frame ladder to the ground while installing duct wrap insulation, fracturing the right leg.

An employee was cutting up blemished rolls of aluminum for re-melting. He was using a pry bar to create gaps in the rolls when his left middle fingertip was amputated in the roll where he was prying the material.
An employee tripped over a stool while walking behind a snack bar, falling to the floor and fracturing the right hip.

A maintenance employee was splicing an underground cable. As he was heat shrinking the waterproofing tubing around the cable splice with a torch, the heat caused a gas service line under the cable to break, leaking gas. A flash fire then occurred, burning the employee's face and causing second degree burns to his arm.
An employee was working in a molding injection machine when the employee's right ring finger was pinched, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

While sweeping the street, a temporary employee attempted to adjust a water filled barricade. When he pushed the barricade, the chain link fence portion shifted and severed his left index fingertip between the nail bed and the first digit.
An employee was cutting meat with a saw when he received a laceration to his right middle fingertip, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was helping coworkers place a window in a leak test chamber when his right index finger was caught between the opening of the test chamber and the window, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee used an extension ladder to access a roof. He slid off the roof and fell to the ground, fracturing an elbow and some left-side ribs.
An employee suffered a health-related incident that caused her to pass out against a wall and then fall backwards onto a concrete floor. She was hospitalized with a head contusion and concussion.
An employee was ripping a 2x4 on a table saw when the employee's hand contacted the blade, amputating the thumb tip.

A temporary employee was loading product onto a tractor trailer as a crane operator was lowering product onto the truck. The temporary employee's hand was then caught between the crane's load and the product on the truck. The employee suffered a broken hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to prevent pouches from jamming on a machine when the guillotine knife came down and amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

An employee was sweeping the warehouse floor. At the same time, a forklift driver was backing up in a designated lane and made a left turn. The operator was turned around looking as he reversed. The injured employee was in the operator's blind spot and was struck as the forklift turned, suffering two broken leg bones.
An employee was using a spud pole while using a crane to hold a large ring when the ring moved and caught the employee's left ring finger in a pinch point, amputating the fingertip (no bone).

An employee was changing spacers on an over arm. The over arm slipped off the stand and pinched the employee's left little finger between the arm and table top resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was re-spooling a chain on a machine used to spray insulation. As he finished, the machine energized and two of his left-hand fingers where caught in the chain, amputating one and fracturing the other.
On May 16, 2018, an employee was using a stationary disc grinder to grind the edge on metal stock when his left thumb contacted the disc, amputating his thumb tip.
An employee was working in a scissor lift to remove beams and a canopy when a beam sheared off and fell, striking and fracturing his back.
An employee was walking toward the exit door of a freezer. He bent over to pick up a piece of wood and slipped on ice, falling to the floor and fracturing his right arm below the elbow.
An employee suffered a hip fracture after falling from a loading dock to the ground.

An employee was servicing and cleaning an air handler when back pressure (air) from the unit caused it to spin backwards.  The employee attempted to grab the belt with his gloved hand and it was pulled into the pulley, amputating a fingertip.

An employee was climbing on a trailer to retrieve a hardware bag when the employee tripped and lost footing, falling off the trailer to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to the left wrist and left ankle.
While inspecting a metal roof, an employee slipped on debris and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground below, suffering broken ribs, a collapsed lung, left shoulder pain, and head lacerations.

On May 16, 2018, a temporary employee had been cutting an aluminum extruded bar stock on a circular saw and then turned the machine off to blow dust off of the blade using an air hose. The blade had not come to a complete stop and nicked him, lacerating his right index fingertip. His fingertip had to later be surgically amputated.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun to install asphalt shingles on a residential roof when the nail gun brushed his head and was triggered, shooting a nail into his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was knocking clumps of seasoning down to an auger when the auger hit his right hand, amputating his ring finger and severely lacerating his middle finger.
An employee was operating a disc grinder when a piece of metal became caught in the grinder and pulled the employee's left hand into the disc. The employee's left thumb was lacerated.

An employee was standing behind a counter when a customer came in and started swinging a knife at the employee. The employee was chased around the store and stabbed multiple times, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was dragging a large plastic container to another trailer when the employee's pant leg became caught on a step, causing the employee to fall and fracture an ankle.
An employee was performing routine maintenance on an aircraft and amputated the right index fingertip while attempting to position a cable.

An employee was offloading sand at a dust collection unit that was clogged. The auger was not rotating, so employees struck it with a hammer. The employee's fingers were inside the housing unit of the auger when it inadvertently began to rotate, crushing his fingers. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee's right arm was struck by a valve discharge door while emptying out a blender, suffering a contusion.

An employee was going down stairs when the employee's glasses fogged over due to coming out of a 40-degree room. The employee missed the last step and fell down onto concrete, sustaining left shoulder and left hip fractures.
An employee was operating a tugger with an attached trash hopper. He reached to pick up an item off the floor and suffered a knee cramp. He fell to the floor and fractured his right hip.

An employee was sweeping flour dust off of equipment when the machine guard unlatched and opened the machine guard door. The employee was attempting to close the door when another piece of the machine guarding became unsecured. While attempting to reinstall the guard that became unsecured, the employee's hand contacted the exposed motor chain, which was running. This caused the employee's hand to be pulled into the in-running chain and sprocket, partially amputating the employee's left pinky finger and lacerating three fingers.
An employee tripped over a fan cord and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was exiting the roof and stepped onto a tied off ladder. The ladder shifted and the employee fell 20 feet, sustaining two fractured ribs, a fractured collarbone, and a head laceration that required stitches.
An employee was using a forklift to support a stamping die set so he could clean underneath the suspended load. His hand was under the 4,000-pound die set when it slipped and trapped his left hand.

On May 16, 2018, an employee was cutting a piece of stainless steel on a shear in the maintenance shop when two of his left-hand fingertips were caught in the shear point. One finger lost a fingernail and some flesh, while the second lost flesh.
An employee was using an elevator to bring materials to co-workers. He had been at work for about 1 hour when he started feeling dizzy due to a possible heat-related illness.
An employee was making adjustments on a bread bagger chain and sprocket when his right middle finger and ring fingertip were amputated in the chain/sprocket.
An employee was lifting a compressor from a rack with a crow bar when the crow bar slipped. The employee's left index fingertip was then amputated between the compressor and the rack.

On May 16, 2018, an employee was replacing windows on the fourth floor of an apartment building when the employee fell out of a window to the ground below. The employee broke both legs and wrists, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering steel from a truck that was not on level ground. He was untying the tie-down strap when a piece of steel pipe rolled off of the truck and broke his lower right leg.
