An employee was putting nuts and washers on bolts while standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder that was in the closed position when the ladder slipped. The employee fell and struck his head on the concrete below, suffering head trauma and a skull fracture.

An employee was welding an 8-inch pipe into a future furnace. The electrode holder "stinger" came in contact with the pipe while the employee was also touching the pipe, creating a circuit through the employee to the ground. The employee received an electric shock and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a knife sterilizer to clean the flooring when his hand slipped off of the container, causing hot water to run down his leg and into his boot. He received burns to the right ankle.
An employee was lifting and piling stacking sheets when pieces of the sheets hit his left ankle, breaking two bones. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

A patient got up from a wheelchair to be weighed on a scale as an employee stood nearby to record the weight. The patient's knee buckled and the patient began to fall, so the employee performed an assisted fall and helped the patient to the ground. In the process, the employee suffered a back strain and pain, requiring hospitalization.

An employee drove a forklift over a shrink wrap machine, then got off the forklift to fix the machine. The forklift rolled into the employee, breaking his right foot and leg. The forklift was not in park at the time of the incident.

An employee was taking the temperature of a panel box with a probe when the employee touched the hot line, receiving an electric shock. The employee suffered electrical burns to the left middle finger and was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a piece of siding in position with his left hand so he could nail it in place. His right hand slipped while positioning the nail gun and the nail shot into his left hand, puncturing it and possibly fracturing one bone. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
Employees were troubleshooting equipment. An employee's right ring and pinky fingers were between the belt and pulley when the stuck pulley activated resulting in lacerations.

An employee was cleaning underneath a belt on a machine at the chain drive when her glove became caught on the chain drive, pulling her hand into the moving part. She suffered a right finger amputation and fractured right wrist.
An employee was reversing an electric pallet jack and backed into the corner of a storage rack. She suffered a fractured ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee drove up to a facility to drop off a trailer. The brakes were not set and the vehicle started rolling. The employee reached to set the brakes and slipped and fell. The vehicle tire then ran over and fractured his lower left leg between the ankle and the knee.

An employee was performing end-of-shift cleanup near an overhead dust collection pipe, which collected steel shot from a blast machine and delivered dust and dust particles to the dust collector. The pipe broke free from its connecting joint, striking the employee in the back and head.

On 05/17/2018, an employee finished unloading a boat in the yard area and was walking off a travel lift when he tripped on a piece a wood, fell, and hit his head on a concrete pedestal. He sustained head and neck trauma, requiring hospitalization and stitches.

An employee was working near a crane helping to install unit carts when the employee grabbed the steel cable of the hook sheave, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation. The crane was operating at the time.
An employee was cleaning up debris at a demolition site when the employee's hand was pinched between a backhoe bucket and a concrete wall, amputating the right middle fingertip.

An employee was removing a nitrogen line from a unit. The employee did not realize that the nitrogen hose was back-pressured with 30 psi of steam that originated from a manifold located at the north end of the unit. The steam caused second degree burns to the employee's right inner thigh and left arm.
An employee was pulling wire and installing conduit and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was repositioning the remains in a cremation chamber using a repositioning tool. The tool slipped and sprung back toward him, leaving him off balance. He fell, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was cutting an aluminum molding with a chop saw when the saw caught and amputated two left-hand fingers.
An employee was going up a roof hatch ladder when the employee slipped and fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete floor, fracturing the right femur, right pelvis, and multiple ribs.

On May 17, 2018, an employee and a coworker were preparing to move steel plates. The coworker had the steel plates lifted with a pry bar while the employee's hand was placing a clamp under them. The coworker removed the pry bar, which caused the steel plates to fall onto the employee's left middle finger and resulted in an amputation.
An employee was adjusting a jig when it shifted and amputated the employee's right small fingertip.
An employee was using a shovel and digging to locate a gas line when the employee began to feel symptoms of heat exhaustion, including muscle cramps, nausea, and dizziness.
An employee was sitting on a recycling truck that was making pickups when she stepped down from the truck onto uneven gravel and sprained her ankle.
An employee was attempting to flick a rock out the bottom rollers of a roller mill when a roller caught his middle finger, amputating it just past the nailbed.
A piece of wood/splinter from a wooden crate embedded in an employee's left thigh.

An employee was working at an injection molding machine. A fire started at an extruding tower, when some silicone tubing broke and fell into the oven. The employee tried to fight the fire and suffered smoke inhalation.

An employee was descending out of a tree after completing his cuts when the 4-inch limb that he was tied off to began to bow and then broke below the tie-off point. He fell approximately 40 feet to the ground, injuring his ankles and back.
An employee was helping to spray concrete when he fainted due to dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a blow molding milk container machine when it closed on and smashed the employee's right pinky, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was retrieving electrical wires with a tugger machine when a pulley or wheel mounted on the wall came free and hit her legs, fracturing her left leg and bruising her right leg.
An employee was placing a piece of angle iron on a roller to stop the rotation of the drum when the employee's arm became stuck between the roller and drum, crushing the employee's arm/hand.
An employee was delivering packages when his leg began cramping due to heat stress and dehydration.
An employee was struck by the right rear wheel of a reversing reach forklift while performing maintenance on an excavator.

An employee was attempting to step from a step platform to a mobile telescoping stand. There was a 21-inch gap between the two platforms and the employee fell 8 feet down to the platform below, suffering multiple body injuries.

An employee was moving an 800 lbs. control panel onto a rig floor via forklift operations when the control panel became caught on a handrail, shifting the control panel from the strap. The control panel fell, striking the employee and then falling on top of the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.
An employee was loading parts into a parts washer when a 25-inch pressure plate fell and struck the employee's right index and middle fingers resulting in amputation.
An employee was bitten by a mouse in a research laboratory.

An employee was changing out the saw cylinder on a de-linter machine when a helper accidentally bumped the hydraulic lever that controls the door. The door closed on the employee's right index finger, causing deep lacerations that required surgery and hospitalization.
On May 17, 2018, an employee fell 6 feet from a support to the floor while changing a fermentation filter, suffering multiple skull fractures.

An employee was attempting to pull a bag down on a poly bagging machine with his left hand when the jaw clamp closed on his finger. His left index finger was caught in the forks of the machine, resulting in the amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was emptying garbage into a steel bin when a forklift operator struck the employee's foot, pinning it against the steel bin. The employee suffered leg/foot fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning showers when a shower stall door closed on and amputated the employee's right pinky finger.

An employee was operating a setting machine when a load of green brick became jammed in the machine. The employee turned the safety keys to set the machine to safe mode, removed the key, and attempted to unjam the machine. The machine then cycled with the employee inside, causing two tibia fractures and a puncture wound to the ankle.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 with a circular saw when the blade contacted and deeply cut his left wrist, wounding the muscle and nerves. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a portable expandable roller conveyor system in the truck loading area when the conveyor system wheel rolled into a divot in the ground and the expandable portion of the conveyor closed on the employee's left middle finger, amputating it to the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning out a machine with a trainee when the air pressure line activated, turning on the machine. The employee's right hand was then caught in the machine, amputating the middle finger.
An employee's hand became infected due to a metal sliver, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell off a gasoline tank while pumping gas, breaking three ribs.
An employee was helping to unload a truck when a U-box smashed and fractured his right pointer finger.

Employees were in the process of packing up to leave a jobsite. One of the employees was opening the back door of a trailer when his right hand was caught on the wire that is used to open and close the door, amputating his right middle fingertip and lacerating his right index finger.

An employee was watching a forklift operator remove a pallet from a semi-trailer when he reached down to catch a box falling off a pallet. The forklift operator maneuvered the pallet into the trailer wall, causing the employee's finger to become caught between the two. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
A pallet fell and pinned the employee's right index finger between the pallet and the rack resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was moving a cart with sheet metal on it when the sheet metal ran into a building pole. The employee's arm was between the pole and the sheet metal, resulting in a laceration to the employee's left wrist.
An employee was climbing out of the back of a truck when their foot slipped on the step and the employee fell to the ground, suffering head and back injuries.
An employee was walking through a temporary construction area when he stepped into a 3-foot-deep footer and fractured his heel.

An employee was observing pile driving from a sea wall but needed to obtain a reading from the barge, so he began descending an extension ladder to access a floating platform. He fell from the ladder onto the platform, breaking a rib.
An employee sprained his back while lifting an empty bag.

An employee was installing sheetrock off a scissor lift when he leaned against the scissor lift railing.  The railing gave way and he fell approximately 24 feet to the ground, suffering lacerations and bruising.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fractured her left arm and ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was observing a driver trainee dumping a loaded trash compactor when he was struck by the compactor's metal container door, causing him to fall backwards and strike his head on the ground, suffering a laceration to the back of his head.

A driver was found on the ground and may have fallen off of the lift gate that is located on the back of a straight truck.  The driver was hospitalized for two blood clots on his brain and three broken ribs.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while feeding a machine.
An employee was suffered an amputation to the right index finger while cleaning a chiller.
Two temporary employees were involved in an altercation and one was stabbed with a knife.

An employee was under the waste collection truck he had been driving, adjusting the rear driver-side brakes. The truck was idling and began rolling downhill, running over the employee and crushing his legs and abdomen.

On May 18, 2018, an employee was performing rooftop work with a coworker when the coworker left the roof to get a drill from a vehicle. The employee walked to the neighboring building's metal roof, stepped on a fiberglass skylight, and fell through to the concrete below. The employee was hospitalized with a shattered left elbow and fractured left arm.
During an unloading operation, an employee was struck by a separator after it was unstrapped from a trailer, suffering internal injuries and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was rigging steel on a truck bed when he was caught between a steel column and the truck bed, suffering an 8-inch gash on his left inner thigh and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a rivet buster to break up a concrete floor for demolition when the employee fell through the working level to the level below, suffering a concussion.

An employee was conducting a qualifying exercise with his 9mm handgun on a shooting range. While he was removing the handgun from his holster, it accidentally discharged, striking his upper right leg.

An employee was walking on the right side of equipment in a blind spot. The equipment operator maneuvered right to avoid another piece of equipment, and the front right tire caught the injured employee's legs and pinned him to the ground. He sustained a back injury and potential pelvic fracture.
An employee was using a sheet metal roller machine to make a part and was attempting to straighten a piece when the roller caught the employee's left hand, amputating the little and ring fingers.

An employee was in a bucket tightening nuts on the a transformer cutout when he contacted 7,200 volts, suffering a burn to the left hand that required hospitalization. Rubber gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was running a core machine when the employee's finger was pinched between the box and plate, suffering a fingernail avulsion and subsequent amputation.
An employee was using a horizontal band saw to separate wood pallets when the employee's left thumb came into contact with the blade, sustaining an amputation.

An employee was climbing out of an open air electrical vault. As the employee reached to gain access out of the vault, the manhole grate door became dislodged and fell onto the employee's right arm, fracturing it.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when his foot slipped. When he tried to correct himself, his hand came off the steering control and the forklift struck a guardrail. He suffered a foot fracture.

An employee was standing 5 feet away from a sump pump casing cover helping a coworker pull the casing cover with a hydraulic puller. When pressure was applied to the puller, one of the bolts came loose and struck the employee, who suffered a fracture/laceration to the forehead.
On May 18, 2018, an employee was operating a bag machine when the employee's hand was pulled into the machine's drive rollers, suffering a severe laceration. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was operating a punch press while holding an aluminum extrusion with both hands. He pressed the automatic push pedal with his foot, and his left hand was caught between the press and aluminum extrusion, breaking his left ring finger.
An employee was driving a golf cart when his left leg struck a dumpster as he drove past it. He sustained a left calf laceration and left calf muscle injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working inside a greenhouse when she slipped on the wet concrete floor and fell on her right hip and right wrist. Her right wrist was fractured and required surgery.
An employee was on her way back to the office from a training when she was shot in the face during a traffic incident.
An employee tripped over a bin that was placed in the hallway, breaking her hip.
On 5/18/2018, a temporary employee was operating a punch press when it amputated the employee's finger(s).
An employee was moving material with a hoist. As he was setting the material down, the I-beam that held the material fell over onto his left leg, crushing and causing an open wound to his left shin.

An employee was walking on a metal walkway to get more roofing materials to patch a building's flat roof holes when he tripped, fell, and hit his head on the grated metal floor, resulting in a concussion and head laceration. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting timber logging with a chainsaw in an upward direction with the top of the chainsaw bar when the chainsaw kicked down, cutting the top of his foot.

Three carpenters were removing glass from a crate. Two employees placed the glass on the cart while the injured employee was at the end of the crate. The glass began to tip and the injured employee attempted to stop the glass from falling. The glass pinned the injured employee's leg to the ground resulting in leg bruising.
An employee fell off a step ladder while throwing trash into a compactor resulting in a broken left ankle.

An employee was working on the rig floor while setting a casing when the employee lost balance and placed the left hand on the casing. At the same time, the casing slips were released and the inter-tool slid down, amputating the employee's left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting a metal washer with a torch when a piece of the washer fell on and broke the employee's arm.
An employee was installing cabinets in a building. He was using a saw to cut cabinet doors when the saw kicked back and amputated his left thumb.
An employee was walking through the brush on an unpaved path when she tripped on an exposed root or her lace became caught on a root and she fell. She fractured her pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee lost consciousness while working in the corn field due to a possible heat related injury.

An employee went to sit down on a bench in a wire line support trailer when he felt pain in his left middle finger. He removed his gloves to investigate and noticed a puncture mark below the first knuckle on his left middle finger. The puncture later became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An iron worker was repairing a platform at a paper machine when the employee suffered dehydration or a heat-related illness, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a truck transporting a 40-foot container. The employee was making a turn when the container fell sideways and the truck overturned. The employee sustained a broken right femur inside the cab.

Two employees were performing a crane inspection from a man basket on a fork truck approximately 20 feet in the air when the truck malfunctioned and the basket fell stopping about 2 feet above ground level. One employee was hospitalized for broken heels in both feet.
An employee was inside a dish washer area carrying three glass mugs when he slipped and fell to the floor cutting his right hand and suffering nerve and tendon damage that required hospitalization.
After working in the garden department, an employee experienced heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a scalder. He laid the nozzle end of his water hose over the side of the scalder while he left to perform another task. When he returned to pick it up and lifted it, the hose became entangled in the running shackle line. As he tried to pull the hose out, his left middle finger was caught on the handle of the water valve nozzle attached to the hose. He pulled his finger back as the line was moving, sustaining a finger avulsion that required surgical amputation.

An employee was working from the extended boom/basket of a bucket truck. The outriggers of the bucket truck were not set on solid ground, resulting in the outrigger sinking into the ground as the boom was further extended. The truck became unstable and collapsed with the employee inside the basket. He rode the bucket to the ground and fractured his back and ribs.
An employee was loading a truck when the employee passed out, requiring hospitalization for a blood clot in the lung.
An employee was getting tap water from a resident's restroom when the employee fell, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was in a bucket operating a chain saw to cut a tree limb that was laying on top of an electrical distribution line (7,200 volts, single phase tap). The tree slid off the line and the wire caught the employee, flipping him out of the bucket (approximately 20 feet) and onto the ground. He suffered a collapsed lung, broken ribs (left side), broken shoulder (clavicle), and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was setting drums on a highway for a lane closure when he tripped and fell on the road, fracturing his lower left arm.
An employee was on a ladder trying to locate a gas leak when an explosion occurred, causing a second degree burn to the employee.

A temporary employee was closing the door on a loaded tractor trailer. A bar was in place in the E-track to keep the product off the door. The employee's finger was caught between the E-track bar and the closing door, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation as well as broken middle and pinky fingers.
On 5/20/2018, an employee was caring for a patient when she fainted and fell onto her right side, injuring her right posterior shoulder, ribs, upper back, hip, and leg. She was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning poly from the edge of the pressure roll on an extruder. The employee tripped and caught his hand in a nip point as he tried to brace himself. The Injury resulted in a partial amputation of two fingers and a de-gloving injury to two other fingers.
An employee was walking when she lost her balance and fell, fracturing her kneecap. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the concrete ground on her right side, striking her head on a safe. She suffered a fractured pelvis and a head laceration, requiring hospitalization.
A security guard was attacked by a patient, suffering a concussion and a blow to the forehead that required stitches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a ladder while hanging a poster, sustaining a fractured tibia.

An employee was working from drywall stilts while installing a ceiling grid when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor. He sustained a concussion, skull fracture, fractured sphenoid bone, subdual hematoma, and intracerebral hemorrhage.

An employee was putting material into a press brake when the machine cycled. The employee's hand then entered into the point of operation, cutting the right index fingertip, which had to be surgically amputated.

Employees were relocating a VFD to its installation location using a rough terrain forklift. The load was not secured at the time and as the forklift changed gears from 2nd to 1st, the load swayed and fell off the forklift, striking the injured employee in the leg. The employee's leg broke above the knee.

An employee was using a jackhammer to break rock in an excavation when a section of asphalt (approximately 2 feet by 2 feet by 8 inches) broke away and struck his left leg, fracturing his tibia. Person protection equipment was worn at the time.
Two employees were fighting over a nail gun when one employee was shot in the stomach with the nail gun, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was moving a cart out of an elevator when a metal plank contacted the handrail on the opposite side, creating a pinch point between the plank and the handle on the cart. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was in bucket replacing a utility pole when he contacted an energized powerline (7,200 volts) and received second and third degree burns to the upper left arm.

Two employees were operating the welding jig. When one employee activated the two hand controls, the injured employee's hands were between the part and jig, resulting in a partial amputation to the injured employee's left little finger.
An employee was driving a baggage tug to pick up bags from a default belt when the employee hit a pole outside the bag room. The employee's left foot made contact with the pole, fracturing the ankle.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder while performing maintenance on a large press, suffering a skull fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a circular saw at a residential construction site when the saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was placing skids for pipes that needed to be unloaded when a mechanical lifting device failed, allowing a steel pipe to hit the employee's right leg. The employee sustained a broken right femur.
An employee was inspecting a tile roof when he slipped off the roof, suffering compression fractures in his back and head lacerations. He was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was in the back of a flat bed boom truck handing shingles to another employee when he lost his balance, fell on a wooden pallet, and broke his right arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was scraping excess dough off of a sheeter machine's roller when the roller cut his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was running and unguarded at the time.
An employee suffered syncope twice while walking to a private residence, falling to the ground and suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.

On 5/21/18, a maintenance employee was working on the back of a straight cut eight machine, troubleshooting the lights of a folding gate's sensor, when his right hand was placed on the folding gate. The folding gate then came down on his right middle finger and amputated his fingertip.

An employee was using a drill press machine. His left hand was under the press when it was activated via the foot pedal. The drill then came down and drilled through his left hand at the thumb and forefinger webbing area. He suffered an amputation of the left forefinger, fused first joint of the left thumb, and nerve damage to the left thumb.

An employee was sweeping debris from a roof when the employee stepped into an 18-inch by 18-inch hole that was covered with an unsecured piece of metal before falling 14 more feet to the concrete below. The employee suffered a broken right elbow and right wrist.
An employee was checking the oil in a golf cart when his right hand was caught in the cart's pulley, amputating his right index and middle fingers.
An employee was walking down stairs holding the railing. When she reached the bottom stair, she fell and fractured both feet, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing an internal spindle part when the spindle fell from the employee's hand. The employee tried to catch and grab the spindle. The employee's fingertip was crushed between the grind wheel and the steady rest for the work piece, resulting in a surgical amputation.
An employee slipped on water and fell on the floor, injuring her foot and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
On 5/21/2018, an employee was inside an aerial lift and raising it when the employee's right hand became pinched, causing a laceration that resulted in a right pinky finger amputation.

An employee was kneeling down to receive product when a nearby stand-up pallet operator turned a corner, causing the 240-pound load to fall and strike the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and collapsed lungs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee operating a tug was struck by a police car, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was trying to climb up a 6-foot scaffold to paint an 8-foot fiber glass tank. He was using a step stool to step up to the scaffold ladder when it slipped out from underneath him. As he tried to catch himself from falling down, he broke his left ankle and fell about 18 inches to the concrete floor below. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was walking behind a top loader when the top loader operator reversed the equipment to pick up a container. The employee's right foot was struck and caught on the top loader wheel, resulting in an amputation below the knee.

An employee was inspecting a hydraulic hose for leaks when another employee activated the hock cutter that was powered by the hose, releasing a high-pressure stream of hydraulic fluid into the employee's right hand. The fluid cut his hand and was injected under his skin.
An employee was unloading products from a company vehicle. While lifting the rear gate, the employee's left hand was caught in the lift mechanism, amputating the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was filling a sweeping machine with water using a hose.  The employee pulled on the hose, got tripped up, and fell backwards, breaking the right leg and requiring surgery.
On May 21, 2018, an employee was exhibiting erratic behavior due to possible acute manganese toxicity, requiring hospitalization.
On May 21, 2018, an employee was cleaning a cheese grinder when the chemical he was using splashed onto his chest, causing chemical burns.

An employee was hand loading demolition concrete into a backhoe bucket. When he adjusted the broken concrete in the bucket his right hand was caught between the concrete and the bucket, cutting and breaking his right index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the top of a tank trailer when he fell to the ground, breaking his femur.
An employee fell to the ground while climbing onto the driver's seat of a box truck, suffering a head injury.

An employee was helping to break down an 80-ton crane that was lowering a weight onto a trailer. He was guiding the weight when the load shifted, catching his hand between the rigging hooks and the counterweight. His right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee fell while servicing a truck, suffering a head contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was dewatering the work site. A guy line on a drill came loose and knocked a live electrical powerline into the employee, shocking his forearm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was part of a crew that was replacing piping and cable. While removing a pipe with a C-clamp, his left thumb and index fingers were caught between the C-clamp, causing an open fracture on his hand that required surgery.
An employee was adjusting a piece of locked out pay off equipment when the arm of the equipment sprang back and struck him in the chest resulting in fractured ribs (5) and the right shoulder.

An employee was operating a tractor with a feed wagon attached. The employee exited the tractor cab to uncouple and disconnect the wagon from the tractor. The jack stand was up and the wagon hitch fell onto the employee's foot, injuring a toe.
An employee was exiting a truck when his leg became tangled in an airline. He lost his balance and jumped from the catwalk landing, then fell against the truck, injuring his lower back.
An employee was cutting a window sill with a chop saw when the saw cut his left index finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was operating a bender machine when his right hand was caught between the rebar and the roller arm as the foot pedal was activated. His right index fingertip was then caught and amputated.
An employee was unloading furniture from a truck. He was climbing down the back of the truck when he fell, hitting his head on the ground and fracturing his pelvis.
An employee fell 5 or 6 feet from a dumpster and was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was preparing to install a fire alarm part while standing on a 6-foot A-frame ladder (second rung from the top). He was attempting to get a marker from his pocket when the ladder twisted and he fell to the pavement, injuring his pancreas and requiring hospitalization. His right leg also became caught up in the ladder, causing dislocation and damage to the knee.

An employee removed nuts on a stripper head and was raising the head up over the annular when the head slipped and struck the employee's left arm, pinning it against studs. The employee's arms sustained multiple fractures.

An employee removed a belly pan to work on a bulldozer component. As the employee was re-installing the belly pan, it fell and pinned the employee's arm to the ground. The employee sustained a broken arm.
An employee was performing maintenance on a press brake machine when an adapter bar fell approximately 18 inches and struck the employee's left pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was down in a culvert directing an excavator operator who was moving a 24-inch cast iron pipe. The rigging slipped from the excavator and the pipe struck the employee's left leg, possibly fracturing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to inspect a roof for a leak when he fell to the ground, injuring his arm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pushing a grill out of the stock room for a customer when she turned the corner and felt a pop in her right knee. She fell to the floor and shattered her right knee.

An employee was securing a horizontal form when the employee stepped away from the work platform and onto an exposed area of the building's leading edge. The employee then fell to the ground, suffering potential body fractures. Wooden guardrails were in place at the time.

An employee was lifting an outrigger float (pad) off a crane when the outrigger swung around and the float slid off, pinching the employee's right middle finger between the deck of the crane and the float. His right middle finger distal tip was amputated.

An employee replaced the tape on a part that was going through a guillotine saw cutter. Afterward, the part would not come through the machine properly. As she was checking on the part, the saw blade came down and amputated her right index finger. The saw cutter was guarded at the time.

An employee was using a jack hammer on the fourth floor of a four-story concrete garage when the jackhammer broke through the floor. The employee then fell approximately 10 feet to the floor below, suffering a back fracture.
An employee working at a private residence fell off the first step at the front entrance when his knee buckled.  The employee was hospitalized with a torn tendon.

An employee was using a vehicle jack to hold up a vehicle while operating a speed impact gun. The vehicle jack failed and the vehicle struck the employee's head, causing a concussion and skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hoisting an elevator platform when the rope broke, causing the elevator to fall into the pit. The employee's left index finger was then caught between the elevator platform and the rail (where the elevator moves up and down), resulting in an amputation to the second knuckle.

On May 22, 2018, at approximately 8:40 a.m., an employee was in the enclosed cab of an excavator preparing the ground for the installation of a silt fence. While the employee was digging around the base of a dead oak tree, a limb broke off of the top of the tree and fell onto the cab of the excavator. The limb shattered the glass sunroof, and the employee was struck by glass and broken limbs.  The employee was hospitalized for a skin graph to the right index finger, cut on the head and cheek, and bruise to the hand and shoulder.
An employee fell to the floor while walking, injuring the right knee and requiring surgery.
An employee was removing an ice tray in the dish room when the employee stepped/slipped on a tray liner, injuring the left knee.

An employee was trying to adjust brakes on a pulling unit and was installing a chain around the main drum. His left hand was on the chain when the drum moved, catching and smashing his left pinky between the drum and chain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was running wiring when it became stuck. He then contacted a live 480-volt bus bar and an arc flash occurred, burning his left hand and wrist.

On May 24, 2018, at approximately 10:20 p.m., an employee drove to a local site to pick up a drilling jar/tool. While the employee was waiting for the trailer to be loaded, the drilling jar (which was over 20 feet long, 6 inches wide, and weighed approximately 2,000 lbs.) rolled out of the trailer and struck the employee's right foot. The employee's right foot broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was washing a CIS (center in shell) pump on a mogul machine when the employee was caught in the pump, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation. The interlock was not operational at the time.
An employee was helping to move a railcar using a locomotive when the employee became dizzy and lightheaded.

While two employees were working in a aerial lift near powerlines, a piece of metal fell from the lift and contacted the powerlines. One employee attempted to remove the metal from the powerline and was burned. The second employee was not injured.
An employee was cutting down a tree when a branch hit the chain saw he was operating, causing the saw to lacerate his left leg above the knee.

An employee was removing a box from a cart machine when the machine was jogged, which then caught the injured employee's right hand in a nip roller. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the right hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was tightening the belt to a screen drive motor assembly when the employee's right thumb became caught between the belt and pulley, amputating the thumb tip.
An employee was pulling scrap paper from the press folder when his left index finger became caught under a belt, amputating his fingertip. The belt was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a stair chair to carry a patient upstairs when he slipped. His right leg was caught between the stair chair and a step, breaking his tibia and fibula.
On May 22, 2018, an employee slipped on the bathroom floor and injured her back while trying to prevent the fall. She was hospitalized.
An employee was coming down the stairs when he missed a step and fell, cutting his left hand and breaking his left humerus. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
While transferring from a ladder to the roof of a single-story house, an employee lost balance and fell 12 feet to the ground, breaking an ankle.

An employee was milling a piece of aluminum with an end mill machine. The employee was raising the drill bit up when the employee's glove was pulled into the machine, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw when the wood came back and struck his left hand, resulting in the partial amputation of his left thumb and index finger.

An employee was moving a tag line on a soil bucket when the tag line became hung up on the stop block. The employee was attempting to grab the bucket handle when his right third finger was caught between the stop block and the tag line, amputating his finger past the first knuckle.
An employee was slicing chicken when the meat slicer and severed her right thumb tip. Cut-resistant gloves were worn at the time.

An employee was attempting to retrieve paper that had fallen into a labeler machine when the employee contacted the timing belt, amputating the left ring fingertip. The machine was running and guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a cart and fell to the ground, fracturing his right knee/patella.

An employee was attempting to hitch a box trailer to a pickup truck. As the employee was aligning the ball with the trailer hitch, their fingers were inside the hitch. When the ball aligned with the hitch the fingers were pinched resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip. The fingertip was reattached at a medical treatment facility.
An employee tripped over a box and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

On 05/23/18 at 3:00 p.m., an employee was assisting in pile driving operations. A drill bit was removed from the pile, and the employee's left thumb was caught in a pinch point on the hammer drill, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was transferring young chickens from a cage onto a cart. The employee lost balance and slipped from the access step falling backwards about 22 inches against a metal railing. The employee was hospitalized for a rib injury and possible pneumothorax.
An employee was stung by a bee and had a severe allergic reaction.
An employee was removing an end cap in the filler room when the pressurized end cap struck and lacerated the employee's right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was training when he became lightheaded and experienced an irregular heartbeat.
An employee was conducting training when he became dizzy and experienced blurry vision, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to remove items from a rack when the forklift became stuck. Another employee came to assist using a different piece of equipment. When the forklift became unstuck, it jerked and the forks entered the first employee's foot.
An employee who prepared roads for asphalt patching exhibited dehydration symptoms and began to have chest pains. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a hook to reposition metals inside a metal bin when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing his right hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was tightening a coupling on a piping system that was under pressure. The coupling failed and the air pressure released and steam contacted the employee. The employee suffered stomach and facial burns and fractures.
An employee was lifting a cylinder with a sling and hoist when the sling slipped off and the cylinder fell, amputating one of the employee's right fingertips.
An employee was moving a catch pan that was filled with water (heavy) when his right thumb was caught between the pan and a cross bar, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was climbing down a ladder scaffold when the employee fell about 3 feet to the concrete ground, fracturing an arm and the pelvis.

An employee started work at 6:00 a.m. in the extruder room. At 8:00 a.m., he went to the break room and passed out. He was hospitalized for dehydration. The temperature in the extruder room was 100 degrees.
An employee was attempting to unload a pallet from a truck when the pallet broke and the employee fell off the truck, striking his head on the ground.
On 5/23/2018, an employee was mopping the floor when she backed into a capped conduit, slipped, and fell, breaking her wrist.
An employee was closing a money safe door when the employee's left index finger was pinched in the door, partially amputating the fingertip.
An employee was moving cattle when a bull broke loose and mauled the employee, who suffered internal and external bodily injuries.
An employee was cutting parts from a sheet of paneling using a table saw and amputated the tip of his right index finger.

An employee was removing a lock from the front of a 40-foot container when a third-party truck driver backed up and pinned the employee between the truck and the container. The employee suffered four broken ribs and bleeding around the liver.

An employee was leaning against the loading dock's railing when it broke and he fell off the loading dock about 4 feet to the ground, striking a bollard along the way. He injured his back and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a piece of plate steel from the floor to a work bench using a crane with an under-hook magnet attachment when the piece of steel fell and crushed the employee's left pointer finger, resulting in partial amputation.
An employee was using a box cutter to open a box. The cutter slipped, cutting the employee's wrist.
An employee slipped on grease that spilled onto the floor from a hamburger tray when it was retrieved from an oven, breaking bones in his leg.

An employee was unloading  steel drums from a tractor trailer at a customer's site when a drum tipped over. He attempted to catch the drum and his right ring finger was caught between the ring/bolts on two drums, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee had an allergic reaction to the wax used to clean floors.
An employee was erecting a divider in a storage unit when the employee slipped and fell off of a 22" mobile scaffold. Part of the scaffold entered the employee's backside, causing a severe injury.
An employee's hands came in contact with the grinder blades in a meat grinder resulting in the amputation of fingertips.
An employee was using a packet screw machine to build cabinets when the machine cut his right index fingertip.

Employees were mowing and trimming grass. While one employee was holding a mower's rear push bar, another employee lifted the front of the mower to carry it down four or five steps. While the employee was holding the front of the mower, his left ring finger came in contact with the spinning blade amputating the fingertip.
An employee climbed into a bagger/loader machine and it closed on him, fracturing ribs and lacerating his liver.

An employee was working from a ladder while performing an electrical evaluation at a substation. An arc flash occurred, causing second- and third-degree burns to the employee's hands and arms. The employee also fell about 4 feet from the ladder, sustaining broken ribs.

An employee was outside doing maintenance tasks when he suddenly experienced symptoms compatible with heat-related illness (increased heart rate, profuse sweating, feeling of lightheadedness, and tingling in arms).

On May 24, 2018, an employee was operating a forklift and struck a stationary coupling tongue from a material transport wagon while turning a corner, breaking a bone in the left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's knee gave out while he was walking in a parking lot. He fell, breaking his hip.

An employee was using a crane to stand a metal pole piece and coil vertically for installation in the frame. The metal piece slipped out of the coil and fell onto a tabletop, striking two fingers on an employee's right hand and breaking a bone in the middle finger.
An employee was loading liner onto a machine when the chuck mechanism pinched a finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pulling a tractor out of the mud using a second tractor and a winch. The hook of the winch-cable slipped out of place and hit the employee's left thumb, catching it against the tractor resulting in amputation of one phalanx.
An employee was stepping from an overhang to a walkway when he fell, landing on the grass below and sustaining a contusion.
An employee turned around after brazing a piece of copper wire; the back of his upper right arm contacted the hot pipe, and he was burned. He was hospitalized with a blood infection from the burn.
An employee was fabricating a honeycomb part on a table saw and contacted the blade resulting in amputation of the tip of his right thumb and a laceration to the underside of his middle finger.

An employee was attempting to un-jam a belt on the machine he operated, using a rod to try to release the belt. His right index finger was caught between the roller and a pin and he sustained a laceration. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was drilling a hole when their glove was caught in a chuck. Their left thumb was amputated at the nail.
An employee was driving the recycling collection truck and began experiencing stomach pains. He was diagnosed with dehydration and hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell in a dish room while bringing dirty pots to the sink for washing, dislocating his elbow and suffering a concussion.

An employee was sucking bark and debris from a water tank when the hose clogged. The employee attempted to remove the clog and his arm was sucked into the hose up to his shoulder. He was hospitalized for a bicep injury.
An employee suffered third-degree burns to their hand while extinguishing a fire.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a running rolling machine with a rag when their right hand was caught between two rollers causing a laceration and abrasion to the right hand.
An employee was removing a piece of plywood from a container when a sliver penetrated their glove, injuring a finger. The finger swelled up, and the employee was hospitalized to treat the infection.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and got a foot stuck between the pallet jack and the wall. He suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was repairing a lawnmower. The mower was running, and its belt caught their right middle finger.

At 7:08 p.m. on May 24, 2018, an employee was driving a pallet jack near the heavy pack conveyor. he stepped backward off of the moving pallet jack as it simultaneously veered towards the conveyor. The pallet jack struck the conveyor and pinned his left lower leg between the jack and the steel conveyor causing a severe laceration to his lower leg.

An employee was operating a deep fryer when a lighter fell out of the employee's shirt pocket into the fryer. The hot oil melted the casing on the lighter causing a fire and explosion of the hot oil that  resulted in burns to the employee's face and neck.
An employee walking to work near the parking garage tripped on the pavement and fell, fracturing her left femur.
An employee was clearing a jam on a waste chipper's conveyor using a pry bar. The bar kicked back, striking his face and breaking his jaw. He was hospitalized.

A forklift was used to turn a rudder while an employee's hand was on the rudder stop. The tiller (attached to the rudder) pinched his right middle, ring, and little fingers against the stop. The fingers were amputated.
An employee lost balance and fell while turning away from a workstation on wheels, fracturing her right wrist and right hip. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was sitting at her desk when she had an adverse reaction to roofing fumes that came through the vents, experience itching eyes, chest tightness, shortness of breath, a headache, and coughing.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor while descending from an elevated position, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was struck in the back by a piece of a stainless steel organic solvent container that became over-pressurized and burst, suffering back lacerations. The container had at least 200 pounds of pressure and was full of liquid nitrogen at the time.

An employee was at a residential house cleaning windows. He climbed a ladder onto a wet metal roof with tools in hand to clean a second story window. He then slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his right tibia and fibula.
An employee fell while operating a demolition saw and cut his arm.
An employee was hooking blinds on an elevator lift for assembly. When the lift was lowered, the employee's left ring finger was next to a stop and was partially amputated.
An employee backed their forklift into a storage rack. The rack's bottom shelf passed over the lip of the rear of the forklift, striking and fracturing the employee's right foot.
An employee was stepping from a ladder to a roof when he fell to the ground. He suffered a broken bone and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a plastic mail placard that had fallen from a mail tub and fell resulting in a broken right elbow and two torn ligaments.
An employee was riding on a machine when his right foot was caught between the machine and a wall, sustaining a fracture and laceration.
An employee slipped inside the cafeteria and fell to the floor, breaking her wrist and requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a machine and sustained a finger laceration that resulted in medical amputation of the fingertip.

A mechanic was opening the slide gate of a plastic extruder machine when the heat zone element overheated the plastic up to 900 degrees instead of 400 degrees. The hot plastic sprayed out and onto a different employee who was approximately 10 feet away. The injured employee suffered burns to the arms and face.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck in the back by a pitch.
An employee was cutting potatoes with a manually powered slicer and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee fell while climbing freight, dislocating his ankle.

Two employees were working in a vacant apartment. One employee had a gun and was showing it to the other employee when the gun went off. Both employees were shot, the first in the hand and the second in the stomach; both were hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder with equipment. He fell, landing on his feet 4 feet below; then he lost his balance and fell backward, hitting his head on the concrete ground. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was replacing a roller on a conveyor. The conveyor started up, catching the employee's right hand (which was lacerated) and arm (which suffered a fracture).

An employee was working on a utility pole from an aerial lift bucket. He fell from the bucket to the concrete sidewalk below, suffering a laceration to his head, a fractured shoulder, and broken ribs. Fall protection equipment was not worn at the time of the incident. In addition, the safety chains on the door to the aerial lift bucket were not engaged.

The injured employee was operating part of the paving machine near a roller machine. The roller was being repositioned when it lunged forward instead of reversing. It pinned the injured employee's left leg between the roller and the paver, severely lacerating the leg from the thigh to the top of the ankle.
An employee was crossing from one side of a work site to another side in a work gator when he was struck by a pickup truck. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury requiring surgery.
An employee was climbing a pole during training evaluations when he suffered a heat-related illness.
An employee was removing jammed wood when their hand made contact with a rotating blade. Two of their fingers were amputated. The blade was guarded at the time.
An employee was taking the pin out of an outrigger plate when his fingertips were caught under the plate and injured.
An employee was closing an office door and caught a finger in the door jam resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was operating a drill press when the bit made contact with a cable, amputating a finger.
An employee was digging a trench. The employee stood up, got dizzy, and lost consciousness resulting in hospitalization for heat stress due to dehydration.
At 3:00 p.m., an employee was cutting a tree from the ground. A tree limb separated and rolled back on him, breaking bones in his hip, ribcage, and chest. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a van. He bent to pick up his cane from the ground and fell, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting fish when the blade sliced off the pad of his left middle finger.

An employee was unpacking doors from a pallet. As a door was being removed, the remaining doors separated from a wood support, tipped, and knocked him to the floor. His shoulder and chest were injured.

At about 3:30 p.m. on May 25, 2018, an employee was in a cell renewal building, hydroblasting deposits from a cell body. A 4-foot section of hose connected to the blasting gun ruptured in the palm of their left hand, causing a laceration.

A caster operator was removing a safety blank while wearing heavy welding gloves to insert a smaller nozzle in a casting tundish holding molten steel. The blank fell onto the top of the shroud, causing the molten steel to splatter onto his flame-resistant clothing and metatarsal safety boots. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to his lower legs and feet.

A temporary employee was in a roll-off dumpster, breaking down empty cardboard boxes. He stepped backward out of the dumpster with his left foot. When he turned to put his right foot down, his left knee twisted and was dislocated.
An employee was stocking milk cartons in a dairy cooler when he felt a strain in his back. He was hospitalized for hernia surgery.
A waitress picked up a glass and it fell from her hand, breaking. A piece flew into her right eye. She was hospitalized.
An employee was observing pressure line testing, heard a hissing sound, stepped back to observe and fell into steel rebar. The employee was hospitalized for puncture wounds and internal bleeding.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat stroke after working in the equipment yard breaking down equipment.
An employee was struck by a forklift's forks, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was on his bicycle, maintaining a bike trail. He fell off the bike, sustaining an injury to his colon. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was standing next to a pile of reinforcing steel. A bundle of the steel slipped off the pile, striking the employee's lower left leg and breaking a bone.
A bindery operator's finger was caught in a belt and pulley while pointing to the reflector on the line. The tip of his right index finger was amputated.
An employee was cleaning between two CNC machines while they were operating. One of the tables struck the employee, injuring their left arm between the elbow and the hand.
An employee was cutting trim with a table saw. While he was using a "push stick," his left index finger contacted the sawblade. The blade amputated his fingertip.
An employee was in a freezer, standing on a two-step ladder. The employee reached for a box, lost balance, and landed flat-footed. The employee's left knee was hyperextended and sustained a fracture.
An employee slipped, fell, and injured his knee while turning to exit an open trench.

An employee was pulling a piece of plastic off a bale of paper products at a loading dock. As the plastic broke free, he lost his balance and fell through the chain across the dock, landing on the ground about 2.5 to 3 feet below. He suffered multiple fractures to his shoulder and lower back.
An employee suffered an asthma attack at work triggered by excessive heat in the building.

A nursing assistant had just moved a patient. She stepped away and to the side, tripped, and fell. She sustained fractures to her left radius and ulna (the radial fracture requiring surgery), as well as her left tibia/patella.
An employee was mowing grass using a riding mower and struck a tree. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was exiting the back of a semi truck trailer. They stepped down and their right ankle rolled on the rocks, suffering a dislocation.
An employee was descending an extension ladder carrying a power tool. As he stepped down to the concrete floor, he slipped off the last rung, falling on his right elbow and fracturing it.
An employee was stung by a bee and suffered an allergic reaction including arm and hand swelling. She was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a broken ankle after getting caught in a fence.
An employee was climbing onto the dump truck to tie down trash, slipped and fell to the ground sustaining a head injury.

An employee was using an abrasive blaster when its hose caught on the platform he was working on. The blaster turned on the employee, and its steel shot caused an abrasion below his chin. The dead man's switch on the blaster had been disabled.

An employee was testing a gas-powered weed-eater when its blade disengaged, cutting through their footwear. They suffered lacerations to the second, third, and fourth toes on their right foot; the second toe was lacerated to the bone.
An employee was walking down stairs when he fell, landing on the concrete below. He suffered detached patellar tendons on both knees and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through a maintenance area that was being hosed down. He slipped and fell to the cement floor, breaking his left leg in two places.

An employee was cleaning around an internal diameter blasting machine before the end of his shift. The arm of the in-feed loading table had a steel pipe staged on it; the arm lowered, causing the pipe to roll into the employee and pin him between itself and another pipe. He sustained contusions around his midsection.
An employee was grooming a dog when she got a hair splinter in her arm. The area became infected and the employee was hospitalized.
At 2:00 p.m. on May 26, 2018, a city mail carrier began vomiting after completing a route. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was standing on a ship, waiting to perform a lashing operation. A steel locking shoe fell from above, striking and breaking the employee's forearm.

On May 26, 2018, border patrol agents were pursuing two people. At about 5:40 p.m., one of the agents had run out of water and was not feeling well. He had become dehydrated and exhausted from the extreme heat (suffering a heat-related muscle injury).
An employee was changing a tire on a tractor. While the tire/wheel was on a truck crane, it slipped, pinching the employee's left ring finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading a part into a CNC machine. While stepping down from the 4-inch machine platform, he lost his balance and rolled his ankle, sustaining a lower leg/ankle fracture.

Employees were releasing pressure from a well, moving lines from one well to another and placing a cap on the well-pumping lines. A crown valve was open and blew up. One employee sustained a broken right forearm, a second employee sustained a head injury and a third employee sustained an injury requiring surgery.
An employee was attempting to remove dough from a slot in the dough hopper when the donut press sheared off his fingertip.

On May 26, 2018, an employee was removing a truck tire from overhead. The tire fell, bounced on the ground, and hit him on the shin. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery to remove a severed internal artery.

An employee was filling a nurse tank with anhydrous ammonia. The employee noticed a small leak coming from the fill coupling and attempted to tighten it. The coupling popped off and the employee was exposed to anhydrous ammonia and was hospitalized.
An employee was talking to patients. Two of the patients got into an altercation and one fell backward, landing on the employee. The employee fell to the ground, sustaining a hip injury.

An employee was unscrewing a 2-inch iron elbow from a 2-inch iron straight pipe. The pipe shifted, and his left index finger was pinched between the elbow and the pipe. His left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was standing on some small pipes, lining the flange on the top of a pump skid on a foundation about 3 feet high. He lost his balance and went over the side of the skid, fracturing a vertebra in his neck.
An employee was closing the gate of a cardboard baler with her right hand. The gate closed onto her left hand. Her middle finger was amputated.

An employee was attaching a wireline tool to a metal dolly after the tool had been lifted out of a well hole. The tool shifted on the dolly. The employee's right thumb was pinched between the tool and the dolly, and the end of the thumb was cut off above the first knuckle.
An employee was repairing an auger when debris punctured his foot through the boot. He was hospitalized to treat an infection.
An employee was outside, washing out a trash can using a water hose. As she walked away, her foot was stuck in a hole in the ground and she fell, breaking her left ankle.

An employee was un-securing loaded carts for removal by trailer. The employee grabbed a cart on the crossbraces to pull it forward, and the brace cut the employee's right middle finger at the first joint.
A rural mail carrier tripped and fell in a customer's driveway, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a torch to melt brazing weld on a copper line. An unexpected release caused a fire, and two employees were burned. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bitten by an insect while working on a cable TV connection box. The bite became infected, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a lathe. The lathe caught the employee's glove, amputating the right little finger at the second knuckle.

An employee was in an underground electrical vault, splicing a damaged electrical cable. A different 12-kilovolt cable (not the one being repaired) had an arc fault. The arc flash caused first-degree burns to the employee's face and second-degree burns to both hands.

Throughout the day, the employee was driving a scooter and delivering 6-foot tables and chairs to booths. While standing next to another employee and discussing the daily tasks, the employee suffered a cardiac event and collapsed.
An employee had just clocked into work. She was walking across the floor carrying a tote (to return it to another area) when the tote struck her leg. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was trying to access a ladder from the roof of a building and fell to the ground about 13 feet below.

A forklift operator was operating a forklift, moving empty wood pallets to the back of a building. The forklift's wheels went off of the blacktop and onto the dirt ground; the forklift went down a slight downhill grade and tipped over. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and lacerations to the hands that required stitches.
An employee was coping an SDL bar on a fixed router table. The tip of his left little finger was amputated.
An employee was carrying a pallet on an order picker. The pallet caught on the leg of a storage rack and kicked back, striking the employee's thigh and breaking the femur.
After the day's physical training, a firefighter was hospitalized for heat-related illness and muscle injury due to exertion, altitude, and possibly dehydration.
An employee was using a router table. The router bit amputated about 3/4 inches of the employee's right middle finger and lacerated two other fingers.
An employee was driving a forklift when his ankle was crushed. He was hospitalized.
An employee doing maintenance indoors became ill and exhausted. He was hospitalized and treated for dehydration.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift down the aisle of a pallet staging area. The forklift showed an error code and started to slide away from the aisle. The employee's right hand was pinned between the forklift and a rack beam causing a deep laceration that required surgery.
An employee was walking across a floor that was being stripped and waxed when he slipped and fell, hitting his face and losing consciousness. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were inspecting a 3-way actuated ball valve that was not working properly. One employee went to the control room to switch the valve position in a different direction. The injured employee's left index finger entered the valve and the valve closed on his finger causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing on the step of a garbage truck when another garbage truck tried to squeeze between the truck and a car and struck the employee. The employee suffered pain on the left side of the entire body.
An employee was lowering a vehicle on a jack when his finger was caught between the jack and vehicle resulting in an amputation.
An employee was removing a gutter system from the back of his work truck when he slipped and struck his right knee on the truck bumper, suffering an abscess that became infected.

On May 29, 2018, an employee was performing routine maintenance on a rooftop A/C unit when the employee's left glove came in contact with the belt and pulley, which then pulled in the employee's left hand, causing an amputation of the left middle finger.
The injured employee was at the hand wash sink. Another employee went behind her and fell backwards lacerating the injured employee's upper left shoulder with a knife.
An employee was helping a carpenter put up some concrete forms. He was installing anchor bolts when he started having cramps in his feet, legs, and arms due to dehydration.

An employee was attempting to remove a spare tire carrier from underneath a minivan that was elevated by four wheel stands when the minivan shifted off the front loader forks and struck the employee's face and shoulder. The employee suffered a fractured eye socket and left-side collar bone and lacerations to the head and face.

An employee was doing preventative maintenance on a conveyor. After applying oil to the chain and sprockets, the employee used a rag to clean up spilled oil. The rag and the employee's right middle finger got caught in the chain and sprocket. About 1/4 inch of the fingertip was amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was stocking shelves and suffered a heart attack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was diagnosing an issue with a trailer lift gate when his right ring fingertip was caught and amputated in the lift gate's pinch point.

Two employees were cleaning rubber out of the inside of a grinder. One employee (the operator) was manually rocking the grinder blades to free the material while communicating to a temporary employee when to reach into the machine to remove the scrap rubber material. The operator rocked the machine while the temporary employee's left hand was in the grinder, and the blades amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.

On May 29, 2018, the injured employee was standing between two automated guided vehicle (AGV) train cars adjusting a crate. Another employee drove alongside the injured employee's AGV in his own AGV. Cargo on the second employee's AGV struck a car on the injured employee's AGV train. This caused the cars to fish tail and the injured employee's left leg was caught between two cars fracturing the fibula.
An employee was positioning an overhead crane's suspended load onto cribbing when his fingertip was caught and amputated between the load and the concrete floor.
An employee was wrapping a pallet by hand when he fell and fractured his lower back.

An employee was working from a 6-foot step ladder to install a shelf onto a wall used as a clothing display when the employee lost balance and fell to the floor. The shelf the employee was attempting to install landed on and broke the employee's right leg.

On May 29, 2018, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was on board a cargo vessel tending loading spouts when the employee leaned against a man cage. The man cage fell on the employee causing a fractured tibia.
An employee was approaching an intersection on a fifth wheel and struck another fifth wheel, suffering blunt force trauma and internal injuries.
An employee was operating a press machine when the employee's left hand entered the point of operation, amputating the middle fingertip.

An employee was troubleshooting a sewing machine's feeder belt that was not moving when his right ring and middle fingers went between the belt and the pulley and the machine started, amputating his right ring fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was loading a forklift into a trailer when it overturned.
While moving from an aerial lift to a roof, an employee slipped on roofing material. The employee fell to the ground more than 16 feet below, breaking bones in their left arm.

An employee was on a roof applying valley tin. The employee slipped on the valley tin and fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained lacerations to the face and arms. The employee's lanyard was unhooked at the time.
An employee was cutting a short piece of flat bar on a chop saw when the saw came down on his left thumb, amputating the tip.
While walking down stairs, an employee missed a step and fell, suffering severe back and shoulder injuries.
An employee was installing a piece of sheet metal in the CNC press brake and suffered a finger amputation.
On May 29, 2018, an employee grabbed her sweater next to her desk and put it on. Upon doing so, she felt something on her elbow and realized she had been bitten by a spider.
An employee was removing an old kitchen countertop when the countertop broke and fell on his right leg, lacerating the skin. He was hospitalized and required stitches.

An employee was operating a walkie rider while trying to reach a pallet on a rack when the employee's left hand was caught between the walkie control and the racking. The employee suffered a left middle fingertip amputation and a fractured finger. The employee's index finger required stitches.
An employee put blocks on an 18-wheeler trailer and was climbing down when he fell approximately 6-8 feet and hit the concrete floor with his head, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was disassembling wooden pallets when his left hand went into the rotating circular band saw. The saw blade amputated his left thumb and finger behind the fingernail. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a needlestick on her left index finger while using a syringe to subculture a pathogenic culture. The wound required surgical debridement.

A backhoe operator was exiting the cab of the backhoe when his wedding ring got caught in the door handle. When he stepped down, the momentum caused injury to the left ring finger that required partial amputation at the hospital.
An employee was working on a three-phase distribution power line, made contact with the line and suffered electrical burns.

The employee was performing geotechnical and environmental drilling services using a truck-mounted drill rig as well as common drilling tools such as drill rods, bits and samplers. The employee suffered from dehydration and heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to unclog a rotary airlock feeder. The valve cycled while the employee's right hand was in the point of operation resulting in amputation of the index finger. The airlock feeder was not locked out at the time of the incident.
While pushing a cart on a walking platform, an employee slipped and tried to hold onto the rail before falling 4 feet to the ground. The employee fractured an ankle.

On May 30, 2018, at 5:30 p.m. an employee was working from an elevated table to remove a metal casting. While removing the metal casting, the employee felt light headed and was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration during their shift.
An employee was slicing boneless round steaks on a meat saw and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was removing a 1600 lbs. die from a flanging machine. The employee had removed 4 of 6 bolts. The final two bolts failed, and the die fell, striking the employee's leg and briefly pinning it against the wall of the machine pit. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of lacerations and fractures to his right knee/lower leg.
An employee was setting up the machine for a reverse tamper when the chuck pressed his left index finger against the flange resulting in an amputation between the second and third knuckle.
An employee was standing beside a machine on the floor when a reversing forklift struck the employee and ran over his leg. The employee's lower leg and foot were fractured requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an injury while conducting normal duties on a well servicing rig.
An employee was working with a table saw when it amputated part of his finger. The saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was working on an extension ladder that was being held by another employee cutting old wire off a pole. When the line was cut, the wire struck the employee on the ladder causing the employee to fall approximately 14 feet off the ladder. He fell onto a portable toilet and then onto asphalt. The employee sustained a six-inch laceration to the back of the head, broken ribs and fractured vertebrae in his back.
An employee finished mowing the lawn and was pulling the lawn mover onto a trailer when he fell back into the trailer, suffering a broken rib and a partially collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a hand saw to cut a 2" x 4" board when it slipped and cut the last three fingers on his left hand, resulting in amputation injuries.

An employee was descending a ladder from a roof where he had been removing shingles. The ladder, which was set on a tarp on the ground, slid and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained a right ankle fracture and two fractured vertebrae.

An employee was working from an elevated platform, 35 feet high, while wearing a harness and retractable lanyard, to change out a gear on a paper machine. He fell from the platform an estimated 2 feet before the fall protection system caught him. He sustained some leg pain possibly due to the fall protection. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting steel bars on the ironworker machine. The end of a bar raised up and amputated the employee's middle fingertip.

An employee was trying to repair the winch line on a crane. The cable on the winch got twisted. The injured employee was on the base of the boom and was holding the cable from an access hole when the boom retracted all the way back smashing his right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder taping insulation to a duct. His shirt got caught on something and as he tried to wiggle free, he lost balance and fell off the ladder feet first. The impact with the ground fractured the employee's left foot.

An employee weighed and placed a drum of material onto a pallet and released the drum grabber fixture from the drum. As the employee began walking and repositioning the hoist with the remote control pendent, the hoist released from the beam and struck a drum causing impact with the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a fractured left leg and foot.

An employee was using the pull cord to start the air compressor when the cord snapped and he fell approximately three feet off the service truck. The employee sustained lacerations to the face as well as head and arm numbness.
An employee was checking the progress of waste being ejected from a walking floor trailer when a pressurized hydraulic hose blew apart. The employee's lower leg was lacerated.
An employee was working on a junction box when an arc flash or electrical shock occurred, injuring the employee.
An employee tripped over a protective bollard and twisted his body and knee while falling to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress after experiencing severe cramping in his legs, arms, and abdomen.
An employee was greasing the chain on a running conveyor belt. Their left hand fingers were caught in the conveyor/chain resulting in amputation (past the fingertip) to three to four fingers.

An employee was entering the paint booth and was closing the door when the negative pressure of the paint booth caused the door to close quickly catching the employee's left ring finger and amputating the fingertip.
