An employee was stocking product on racking using a reach truck. When he returned to ground level, a second reach truck struck the employee resulting in a foot laceration.

An employee was going back through and tightening bolts on the girt that was recently placed. While sitting on and tightening a girt, a bolt snapped causing the girt to slide down. The employee's left leg was pinched between the girt and beam. The employee was hospitalized with a leg fracture.
An employee was in a walkway and was struck by the rear of a forklift that was making a left-hand turn. The employee was hospitalized for a hip injury.

An employee was making a feed mill delivery at a customer location and squeezed his body into a gap between the semi-trailer and the loading dock before climbing into the back of the semi-trailer. Afterwards, the employee began experiencing upper body pain. The employee was hospitalized for a hernia.
An employee was folding a table when she tripped and fell on her hip.
An employee was decking on the 53rd floor while standing on a joist supported by props. He lost his footing and fell 7 feet, hitting a plumber stack and breaking his left tibia.
An employee fell to the ground while working, suffering broken ribs and vertebrae that required hospitalization.

An employee was walking from a vehicle to the work site when a powerline fell on the employee's truck and the yard and shocked the employee. The employee suffered electrical burns on the feet and lacerations to the head.
An employee became hot and dizzy while working at a machine, potentially due to heat stress.

A temporary employee walked up to a palletizer that another employee was operating. The palletizer was being lowered when the first employee's foot was caught under the machine, amputating the left big toe and partially amputating the middle toe.
An employee slipped while operating a push mower, and the employee's right hand fell beneath the mower, amputating the index fingertip past the nailbed.
An employee was walking in the warehouse when a forklift operator backed into the employee, causing a de-gloving injury to the left posterior leg.
An employee was struck by a tool while performing hydrostatic testing on a work-over rig. The tool impaled the employee, who required hospitalization and surgery.
On May 31, 2018, an employee fell while climbing a ladder out of a grain leg boot pit, fracturing the left heel and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing the cover on a machine when his right index finger was caught and partially amputated in a chain and sprocket.

An employee was using a tread machine when it became stuck, causing the handle on the tread machine to spin and pinch the employee's left index finger between the machine and the bumper of the truck next to him, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was placing a post when his left ring finger was caught between the post and an excavator bucket, amputating his fingertip.
An employee fell backward while walking up stairs, and the employee's head struck the floor.

An employee was turning around after getting supplies from a cabinet to attend to a patient in a dental chair when the employee's foot became caught in hoses/tubing/the cord under the dental chair. The employee fell, striking the floor and countertop. The employee suffered left kneecap fractures and a chin laceration.

An employee was trying to repair a cable on a box trailer door when the 
cable snapped and the trailer door closed on his right thumb, causing an amputation.
An employee was using a 52" mower to mow native grasses. He heard a popping sound and the mower caught fire, spreading to his clothing and causing burns to his skin.

After spraying a field with pesticides, an employee was preparing to drive the sprayer back to the facility. The employee had to fold the booms to leave the field, and an outrigger breakaway weld had broken on one boom, requiring manual effort to fold it. The employee was using a ratchet strap to help fold the boom when the employee's hand/fingers were caught in a pinch point, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was running a load former when the load starting tipping. He was trying to stop it from tipping when the load former's cookie sheet fractured and dislocated a bone in his right hand.
On May 31, 2018, an employee was standing on a manlift applying dunnage when he began to experience nausea, sweating, and an increased body temperature. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was walking out of the locker room toward the workroom floor when he fell and hit his chin on the concrete floor, sustaining a 1-inch gash on chin. He was hospitalized.

An employee was running casing down. He was leaning with one hand on a slip and one hand on a guide bar that guides the casing down when he reached up and grabbed a roller without realizing it. The roller then rolled over and crushed his right pointer, middle, and ring fingers. Two fingers were amputated.
A temporary employee was cleaning a wrapping machine when the employee's left middle and ring fingers were caught by the crimper bar, amputating the fingertips.

On May 31, 2018, an employee was training another employee on the trim press. The employee was pointing at the part to say what portion of it needed to be trimmed off when the machine was activated while the employee's left hand was in the press, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle finger.
An employee's right hand was crushed in an oven sheet line roller.
An employee was attaching a tong to a pipe when his left leg was caught in the tong pull line and the drill string, resulting in a left leg amputation.

An employee changed the regulator on an oxygen cylinder from an empty bottle to full. When the employee opened the gate valve to supply the oxygen, an ignition occurred and the gate valve ejected from the bottle, striking the employee. The employee suffered a fracture and laceration to the right hand and a contusion to the sternum.
An employee was using a saw when it cut three of the employee's fingers.
An employee tripped over a vehicle axle that a customer had placed on the floor, suffering a fractured hip.
Employees were putting rebar together with chicken wire at a construction site when one employee became ill and dizzy, requiring hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee was checking in the back of a trailer when metal debris fell and struck the employee's right hand, fracturing it.
An employee was cleaning in the service area when he slipped around some equipment. He was not able to move his legs and required hospitalization.
An employee was oiling a conveyor chain when his right index and middle fingers were caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in amputations.
After stocking shelves, an employee stepped down from a step stool and missed the last step, causing him to fall and break his hip.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a piece of wood for a window frame when the saw lacerated the employee's left thumb and index finger, resulting in an amputation of the index finger down to the second knuckle.

On 5/31/2018, two employees were holding/restraining a student against a wall. One employee later experienced shortness of breath, abdominal pain, nausea, and neck pain. The employee was hospitalized with a possible aortic tear or aneurism.

An employee climbed the ladder on the back of a water truck to load water into the truck using a fire hose. When the water to the hose was turned on, the employee was startled by the pressure and fell back off of the ladder. The employee fell 7 feet to the ground, suffering a left-side skull fracture, left rib fracture, and L4 vertebra process fracture.
An employee was helping to move a motor when the motor shifted and a piece of metal fell, hitting the employee's left big and second toes. Both toes were amputated.
An employee was using a hammer when it struck his left index finger.
On May 31, 2018, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was performing re-roofing operations when he fell from a two-story building, fracturing both of his ankles. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to clean residual oil from a 4 ft X 4 ft plastic tote. The employee put approximately 1 quart of denatured alcohol into the tote and then moved the tote to swish around the alcohol in the bottom. The employee's cotton rag then fell into the tote and it flashed, causing a flash burn to the left side of the employee's face and neck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reversing a forklift when he struck a steel cross beam and fractured his vertebrae.
An employee was lifting a hydraulic driller (coring machine) from the ground when he injured his back, requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was operating an eccentric slotting machine when he saw a piece of paper caught in the blade and hit the stop button. Before the rotation stopped, his right hand entered the machine. The blade then amputated his right ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was installing gutters on a patio roof. He was transitioning onto the patio roof from a ladder when the structure collapsed. The employee fell 9 to 10 feet to the ground, fracturing his right knee and separating his left shoulder.
An employee was on a lift changing a lightbulb when the lift tipped over. The employee fell approximately 25 feet to the floor, breaking a rib and the L1 vertebra.
An employee was walking down steps when her foot became stuck on a step and she fell, dislocating both ankles.

An employee was climbing a ladder to install cable television when the ladder collapsed. The employee fell with the ladder to the ground, suffering a laceration above the left eye, three broken ribs, and a fractured left wrist.
An employee was attempting to remove a die from a machine when the die fell on and crushed the employee's hand.
An employee was working at a nurses station. He stood up and struck his head on the corner of a cabinet causing a contusion.
An employee fainted and fell to the ground while putting gas into a vehicle, fracturing vertebrae.
An employee was using a rack loader to repair a rack when the rack fell on and injured the employee's right hand.
An employee fell from a track hoe, suffering a broken wrist and shoulder and neck injuries.
An employee was cutting a cardboard drum clasp with a reciprocating saw to sample contents when a spark reacted with the contents and burned both of his forearm's and hands.
An employee suffered heat stress and dehydration while driving a package cart, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bending down to pick up medications. On her way up, she experienced a sharp back pain/strain.

An employee was picking a piece of emery cloth out from between the roller and arbor of a tube cutting machine when the employee's right thumb was caught between the roller and arbor. The employee pulled the thumb back, and the nail and some skin were partially amputated.
An employee was ascending a three-step stairway looking for leaks when the employee's foot became tangled on the first step and the employee fell down 6 inches, breaking a tibia.

A maintenance employee was working on a bailer compactor. He inserted a screwdriver into the chain to give it slack to reset the chain to the sprocket. The screwdriver slipped, and the chain came down catching his left ring finger between the chain and sprocket and amputating a small part of the fingertip.

An employee was on a ladder installing a new aerial cable on a utility pole at a height of 15 to 20 feet when a car caught the aerial cable with its bumper and began pulling it down the street. The employee was pulled from the pole and fell, striking a chain link fence before landing on his left side and also hitting a log that was on the ground. He suffered contusions.

An employee was mixing mortar when a bag fell in the mortar mixer. The employee was attempting to retrieve it when the mixing paddle struck the employee's hand, breaking a finger and causing lacerations.

An employee was running a filter element wrapping machine when a part became lodged in the machine. She was attempting to retrieve the part when the machine cycled and pinched her finger, causing an avulsion to the bottom pad of the right middle finger.

An employee was attempting to load a new paper roll into a machine when the employee's left arm was caught between the roll and the machine, causing puncture wounds and contusion/pinching injuries around the left elbow.
On 6/01/2018, an employee had a heart attack and collapsed after taking care of a patient, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a draw bench when the tube broke, causing it to recoil into and partially amputate the employee's finger.
An employee was cold starting a wire draw machine when his left middle finger was pinched between the dead block and wire, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

After an employee adjusted a loose belt on a conveyor, the operator began using the conveyor again when it balled up. As the employee attempted to remove the ball-up, the employee's right arm was caught in the conveyor belt, suffering multiple fractures and pulling the skin away from the arm between the mid-bicep and mid-forearm.

An employee was standing on some equipment (24" from ground level) spraying down parts when he lost his footing. He reached out to catch himself when his right-hand pinky finger hit the sharp metal blade on a machine that cuts the feet off of chicken. The joint where his pinky finger and hand meet was dislocated and the blade cut through the area, causing a severe laceration. The machine was locked out at the time of the incident. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was pulling a pipe from a rack using a tool when the tool slipped, causing her to lose her balance in a backwards motion. While in motion, her foot became caught on a rail (extends approximately 1/2-inch above the surface), causing her to fall on and break her right hip in two places. She was hospitalized.
An employee became ill from dehydration and heat stress while working at a port, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was servicing a hydrant truck at a flight line when his finger was caught and amputated between a chain and sprocket.

An employee was training another employee. They had positioned a part being worked on in a press. The "set" call was given to ensure everyone knew the pedal was being pressed. The injured employee's hand then slipped on the material and moved under the die. The employee realized his hand was under the die and removed it while the die was coming down. Two of his fingertips were pulled off, while a third finger broke.
An employee was setting up bottles for filling. A bottle fell; while the employee was trying to remove it, their arm was caught and bruised by a depalletizer.

An employee was off-loading a tractor-trailer when his foot became caught between the lift gate and the end of the trailer. He suffered toe amputations and severe broken bones, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was travelling on the dock on his pallet jack and was unable to stop before his hand was pinned between the jack handle and a four-way clamp attachment on another forklift, resulting in a fractured hand.

An employee was walking in a hallway at the clinic when she attempted to step around an electrician's box and her foot was caught on the side. She lost her footing and fell to the floor, landing on and fracturing her right elbow. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a table saw to cut molding for a picture frame when the blade amputated the employee's middle fingertip just above the top knuckle.
On June 1, 2018, an employee was completing a machine job when the blade partially amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was pumping out portable potties when he fell. He went to grab the truck to pull himself back up when his finger became caught in a fan on the truck, amputating his left middle fingertip.

On June 1, 2018, an employee was pressing a hydraulic shaft with a manually operated hydraulic press when a piece of metal that had not cleared the press table ejected and struck his left pinky finger, causing tendon damage that required hospitalization and stitches.

An employee was on the third rung of a 10-foot step ladder pulling wire when he fell off the ladder and broke his leg, requiring hospitalization. The ladder had a bad rear horizontal section at the time of the incident.
An employee became overheated and lost consciousness while prepping a railroad car to bulk load sugar onto it. The employee suffered from heat stroke/heat exhaustion/heat stress.
An employee was loading a baler to compress scape foam for disposal when his left arm was pinched/crushed between the bailer door and the bailer ram.

An employee was on the ground guiding a coconut tree that was suspended by a piece of equipment to position it in a hole. The palm frond touched an overhead powerline while the employee was touching the root and he received an electrical shock, burning his hands and the bottom of his feet.
An employee was discharging a patient when they became violent, hitting the employee in the chest.
An employee was repairing an air bag when it exploded and fractured his chin.

An employee was installing a motor onto an assembly using a bridge crane. The stabilizing bolt was removed and the motor swung and struck the employee's face and chest. The motor swung back and struck the employee in the back. The employee sustained a laceration to the face, a broken clavicle and fractured ribs.
A temporary employee was riding a slow-moving truck when it hit a bump and he fell to the pavement, suffering a possible fractured skull, abrasions, and a cranial bleed.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was using an electrical food slicer when it amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a rotary star valve when the valve actuated and amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was adjusting the height on a mower deck and amputated two fingertips on his left hand when they struck the spinning blade.
An employee tripped over a bag and broke a finger.

An employee was positioning a main cylinder on the back of a truck. The cylinder has a hole in it that is to line up with a hole on the back of the truck. Once lined up, a pin is to be inserted to hold the cylinder in place. A pry bar is used to help keep the cylinder straight and prevent bowing. 

The employee used a finger to see if the holes lined up. The pry bar moved and the employee's finger was pinched in the opening where the pin should go. The employee sustained a fingertip injury that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was carrying an air siren mast when he lost his balance and broke his ankle.

An employee was in the process of moving a piece of equipment (pipeline scanning tool) that was attached to a large pipeline. The employee's left hand was in a pinch point when the equipment was engaged. The scanning tool closed down onto the pipeline catching the employee's left hand in a pinch point resulting in lacerations and amputation of the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was restraining a patient in the emergency department when the employee experienced chest pain and an irregular heartbeat.

The injured employee and another employee were removing a water pump and moving hoses when the ground they were standing on gave way. The injured employee fell forward into the excavation and directly onto the form beam sustaining injuries to the left side of their chest including broken ribs.
An employee was working as a bottom pour laborer and became disoriented. The employee was diagnosed with heat stroke.
An employee was performing rigging down to move the rig and began experiencing symptoms of heat-related illness including cramps.
An employee was driving a vehicle and struck a guardrail. The employee sustained a fractured knee and injured jaw.
An employee amputated the left ring finger to the middle knuckle while cutting pork ribs with a meat band saw.

An employee dismounted her vehicle to make a delivery and then noticed the vehicle was moving. She attempted to stop the runaway vehicle and fell onto her elbows and knees. The employee sustained a dislocated right elbow.

An employee was trying to remove a bag from a conveyor and caught her right hand between the guide roller and the conveyor when her hand slipped resulting in a laceration to the palm and back of her hand.

An employee was standing between two digesters drawing a sample from one digester when the hot copper sulfate solution erupted from the other digester and splashed onto the employee's back. The employee sustained third degree burns on their back.
An employee was testing electrical equipment with an automated insulation test set and went to grab it and receive and was shocked. The employee sustained electrical burns.
An employee sustained a laceration to the right elbow and the back of the head after falling down the stairs.
An employee was loosening bolts on a flange to drain water from a furnace header when he was contacted by condensate, burning his right and left forearms.
Two employees were operating powered industrial trucks (individual order pickers) when they collided. One of the employee's suffered a leg injury.

A temporary employee was removing safety cones after installing a safety barricade. The employee stepped back and fell down an elevator shaft from the second to the first floor. The employee sustained a collapsed lung.
An employee was fixing a belt and pulley and caught their left index and middle fingers between the belt and pulley resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was riding a pallet jack down the right side of an aisle. As he passed another forklift on the left side of the aisle, his lower left leg got caught on the edge of the wooden pallet that was on the forks of the other forklift. The employee sustained a fractured left shin.
An employee was cleaning meat processing equipment, tripped and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a left hip fracture.
An employee was beginning to remove a cap off of equipment when it flew off and struck the employee in the head.

The headache rack on a forklift had come loose during transport. While unloading the forklift, the headache rack struck the employee on the side. The employee was hospitalized with rib fractures and a punctured lung.

On 6/04/2018, at approximately 1630, an employee exited her car in the parking lot and was walking to the end of her car when a customer's vehicle struck her. She fractured both legs and her right ankle, requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee was scanning pumps/piping that were stacked four to five feet high for inventory purposes. The pumps/piping (10 ft. long) rolled down and crushed the employee. The employee sustained compound fractures to the left leg.
On June 4, 2018, an employee was setting up a vinyl extruder when the employee's right middle finger was caught and pulled into the extruder, suffering a partial amputation.
An employee stumbled over a chair and fell to the ground while working a fundraiser event. She broke her left hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped on the gap between the dock plate and a trailer and fell to the ground.
An employee was walking on the jobsite, tripped over an elevated manhole and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken femur.
An employee was feeding a new roll into the web press and caught his right hand between two rollers. He sustained fractures to the right pinky finger and internal trauma to the right hand.
An employee was placing a jack stand under a truck. The jack slipped and their right index finger was caught between the jack and the jack stand and amputated.
An employee fell off the back of a truck to the ground and fractured a hip.
An employee was centering a flange and was struck by a falling clamp resulting in injury to the left hand.

An employee was changing a screw driver drill bit while holding a hammer and small pry bar under one arm. The drill activated and caught the employee's glove and the pry bar resulting in amputation of the right index finger at the third knuckle.
An employee was placing a sign into the ground and the stake lacerated their left ring finger resulting in a soft tissue amputation.
While removing an old post, an employee's right index fingertip was struck by a hammer. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was vacuuming, got tangled in the electrical cord and fell to the floor. The employee landed on his left shoulder and suffered a dislocation. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was installing a safety pin into the locking device on a trailer that was being positioned into a jig. The employee was sliding the safety pin into place while adjustments were being made to place the trailer in the correct position and her left ring finger was pinched between the trailer and the locking device resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in the break room and slipped on the floor. The employee hit his chin and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was sitting on the edge of a chute greasing the rams of a delivery system. The employee lost his balance and fell into the chute. As the employee fell into the chute, the chute doors closed fracturing both legs.

An employee was trying to stop a truck from driving away from the loading dock with an item left inside the trailer. The employee jumped from the loading dock to the ground about three feet below and fractured the left leg.
An employee was hospitalized due to burns sustained in a fire.

An employee opened the transformer/fuse drawer and changed two medium voltage fuses while the drawer was de-energized. As the employee began to push the main power drawer (13,200 VAC./1,200 amps) back in an arc flash occurred. The arc blast energy and fire ball came out of the bottom door of the main power drawer and up. The employee was standing next to the main power drawer, on the bottom rung of a four-rung step ladder, when the fire ball engulfed his upper torso. The employee sustained second and third degree burns to his arms.

On June 4, 2018, an employee was operating a mill machine when hot rubber stock would not feed into the rollers correctly. He was attempting to push the rubber stock with his gloved hand when the machine pulled the glove from his hand. A piece of hot rubber then flapped onto his left forearm, causing second and third degree burns. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a new side head grinder on a planer machine. He was attempting to straighten the alignment of the machine's lifting shaft when the grinder freed from its position, dropped, and trapped the employee's left middle finger between the lifting shaft and a bolt head. His left middle finger was crushed, and the end joint was amputated.

An employee was injured while working on a mobile scaffold inside of a water tank under construction. While in the mobile scaffold, the employee was struck by a 2X10 piece of lumber from above and hospitalized for a concussion.

An employee was checking an exhaust fan on the roof. While descending from the roof using the fixed ladder, he missed one of the ladder rungs and fell approximately four feet to the concrete floor. He broke his left hip/femur bone and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee crushed his left index finger between a pipe and a guard resulting in a fingertip amputation without a bone loss.
An employee was working from a one-tier scaffold to install drywall sheets when he lost his balance and fell, breaking his left leg.

An employee was attempting to wind a hose onto a pneumatically actuated drum. While tying a knot onto the hose with string, the pneumatic drum actuated and applied tension to the string. The employee's finger was caught in the string as it tightened, amputating the flesh off his index fingertip.

An employee was operating a lift vehicle when it became unbalanced and started to roll. The operator attempted to exit the vehicle, but was thrown out. The employee sustained head injuries and broken ribs.
An employee was ascending a 20 ft extension ladder to access the roof. The ladder was set on wet concrete ground. It slipped out and the employee fell to the ground and onto his ankle fracturing it.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a printing press with a rag when the rag was caught in the rollers. His left hand then went into the rollers, amputating his index and middle fingers.
Two temporary employees were involved in an altercation and one employee was cut in the rib area by a knife.
Two temporary employees engaged in an altercation and one employee sustained a stab wound to the chest.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when his right index finger and thumb were caught in the tooling clamp, amputating the tips. An energy isolating device was not used during this process.
An employee was walking near the trash compactor, tripped and fell sustaining a bilateral ankle fracture.
An employee crushed their right index finger in the back door of a delivery truck.

An employee was delivering marble to a customer using a flat bed truck. The employee was standing on top of the truck and was about to dismount. The employee reached out for the door of the cab, which swung open, causing the employee to lose balance and fall off the trailer to the ground below. The employee sustained a fracture to the spine and injuries to the left arm and shoulder.
An employee was preparing to install sprinkler pipes. While installing the pipe brackets, the beam clamp snapped onto his right index finger crushing it and resulting in amputation.
An employee fell to the ground from the seat of a fork truck and struck the back of his head, requiring hospitalization for bleeding in the brain.
The employee was cutting stone on the mini splitter and injured a right hand fingertip resulting in fingertip amputation.

Employees were riding an ATV up a steep incline which caused the ATV to flip backwards and roll down the hill. The employees were ejected from the ATV. One employee was hospitalized for fractured vertebrae, fractured ribs and a broken hand.
An employee was on a bakers scaffold taping drywall. The scaffold tipped over and the employee fell 8 feet. The employee sustained a back fracture.

During a training event, a smokejumper clipped a tree with his parachute, resulting in a partially collapsed canopy and a hard impact to the dirt ground. The employee was hospitalized for a hip injury.
An employee was walking behind a roofing tar kettle when the kettle door exploded, causing hot tar to contact and burn the employee's face, back, shoulder, and neck.
An employee was sitting down and passed out when he stood up possibly due to heat-related illness. The employee sustained rib fractures and a back injury.

An employee was helping to load the log slicer. A log slipped from the log deck crane onto the log slicer and struck the employee's left little finger. The finger was crushed and surgically amputated.

An employee was driving the forklift and encountered a metal post shore in the way. He stopped the forklift, shut it down and attempted to move the post shore. While moving the post shore, his right middle finger was caught within the locking hole causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was checking a water filter and was doused with 180 degree water causing burns to both thighs and knees and the right side of the abdomen.
An employee fell at work and was admitted to the hospital for a broken hip.

An employee was working on conduit from the elevated basket of a boom lift. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between the elevated basket guardrail and the conduit causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking through the tunnel, slipped on the wet floor and fell fracturing his right knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling a piece of drilling pipe when his left pinky was caught under the pipe resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On June 5, 2018, at approximately 2:00 p.m., an employee slipped on soybeans while exiting a flat storage building and his left leg went into the running floor auger resulting in amputation of the left leg. The auger was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was transferring equipment from a forklift to a platform and fell approximately six feet off the platform. A drum of mud then rolled off the platform and struck the employee. He was admitted to the hospital for treatment.

An employee was troubleshooting an atomic absorption analyzer when it exploded. The analyzer uses acetylene and nitrous oxide. The employee was admitted to the hospital with contusions to the left arm, legs and lower left abdomen.

An employee was staging product in a 34-degree cooler. He used the platform end of a double pallet truck to move a stack of pallets that were in an area he wanted to use for the staging. While he was pushing the stack of pallets, one of the pallets pushed against a bollard and trapped his leg against the body of the pallet truck, fracturing his tibia.

An employee was attempting to install a floor covering over an opening on the third floor of a new construction tri-plex when he fell 19-20 feet through the hole. The employee sustained a hip and brain injury.
An employee was unloading a 50 lbs. bucket of powdered grout from a pallet. His feet got tangled in cellophane and he fell to the ground fracturing a hip.
On June 5, 2018, an employee was making moldings with a shaper. His left hand was caught in the shaper, and his left index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was stacking 50-pound bags on pallets when he became overheated from heat exhaustion.
An employee was repairing a pasta cooker and was burned by hot water.
An employee working at a residence was hospitalized for heat stress and dehydration.

An employee just finished installing a new conveyor belt on the system and was tracking the belt to make sure it was installed properly. The employee lost his balance and his left leg was pinned between the roller and the belt causing a fracture to the lower leg.
An employee was cleaning gutters with a leaf blower and fell off the roof sustaining broken ribs and a fractured back and hip.
An employee was stepping over a torque machine when he slipped and fell. He sustained a severe laceration to the arm and was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was working with a temporary worker installing electrical wiring and lighting throughout a distribution center. An argument and physical confrontation occurred between the two workers. The injured employee had been thrown to the ground by the temporary worker and extended his hand to break his fall. He was hospitalized for a broken wrist that required surgery.

An employee was securing a set of chains to the slip for the blowout preventer (BOP) when the tongs engaged causing the slip to grab pipe and begin to spin. The injured employee's right hand was caught between the slip and BOP, amputating the index fingertip.
An employee was unloading an all circuit container. The metal, middle shelf fell and hit him on the head causing lacerations.

An employee was loading pizza boxes onto a hand cart while standing on an elevated liftgate when the cart became unstable. The employee attempted to stabilize the cart and subsequently lost his balance, falling approximately 3 feet to the ground and fracturing his left ankle.

An employee was unloading cargo off a trailer. The employee removed the retention strap from a pallet leaning against the wall of the trailer. As the employee walked by the pallet, it fell to the floor, pinning the employee's foot between the pallet and the trailer floor. The employee sustained fractures to his foot and ankle.

An employee was trying to unjam a case of product in the palletizing machine when the machine cycled and a metal bar came down and fractured his arm. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
While walking up a ramp toward the entrance of a building, an employee passed out and fell face first to the pavement, suffering broken teeth and a fracture jaw.
An employee was offloading tools from the pickup truck bed when the tailgate extender fell striking his left ring finger and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was pulling a hose that was stuck in mud and when it came loose the employee fell backwards breaking the right tibia.
An employee was loading a parts van for delivery when he tripped over a large box on the ground, breaking his right hip at the top of the femur.

An employee was removing a window tint film using a long handle razor blade. As he was entering the car, he stumbled and the handle of the razor blade caught against the seat with the razor facing him. His right knee struck the razor blade, cutting his leg above the knee.
An employee transferred hot chicken stock from a 3 gallon bucket to a larger bucket located on a dolly. The dolly tipped over and the employee was burned on the legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was throwing trash in a dumpster when his ring was caught on material, resulting in a partial amputation of his ring finger.
An employee tripped on the corner of a mat and fell forward, landing on her right side and fracturing her femoral head.

An employee was operating a press brake. The employee placed the part into the brake press opening to the backstop and actuated the ram lowering it onto the part. The employee's left hand then slipped forward off the edge of the part and up against the front of the punch where two fingers were pinched between the part being folded upward and the upper die surface. The fingertips were amputated and surgically reattached.
An temporary employee was operating a punch press and amputated the left index finger.
An employee lost consciousness and fell to the concrete pavement while blowing grass off of the concrete with a grass blower. The incident may be heat-related.
An employee was using a magnetic hammer to nail eave flashing when a 2.5 inch nail went through his thumb and into the frame of the house.
An employee was attempting to hoist a cow with a winch. When the winch was activated, the  employee's finger was caught in the chain causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was injured by another employee with a pipe because of an altercation/disagreement at the workplace. The injured employee sustained a right forearm laceration and fracture.

An employee was checking the brakes on a cab crane while donned in a safety harness with a 6 ft. lanyard. The employee leaned over a gear box that controls the auxiliary hoist to the crane and his lanyard was caught in a shaft that was turning inside the gear box. When the lanyard was caught it pulled the employee quickly to the catwalk surface on top of the crane. During the fall the employee hit his head and suffered a scapula fracture due to being constricted by his harness. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was walking down stairs, missed a step, and fractured her left ankle. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was bitten by a client's dog during an in-home treatment session, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was restraining a student. While the employee was on the floor holding the student's leg, the student kicked which in turn caused the employee's head to hit a door frame. The employee sustained a concussion and spinal swelling/compression.

An employee was working from an extension ladder installing lights on the outside of a building. The employee and the ladder fell approximately 10 feet landing on a concrete sidewalk. The employee suffered a dislocated right shoulder, left distal wrist fracture, left non-displaced radial head fracture (arm), multiple right pelvic fractures, a concussion and laceration.
On June 6, 2018, an employee was walking out of her cubicle when her computer bag's straps caught her feet. She struck her head on the wall, sustaining fractures to her neck. She was hospitalized.
An employee was installing cable services at a customer's home and felt dizzy. The employee sat down, stood up and then lost consciousness possibly due to heat-related illness.
An employee lost his footing while climbing down off a crane and fell approximately six to seven feet to the ground. The employee sustained a hip fracture.

An employee was prying precast with a pry-bar when the bar flipped up and struck the employee's face. The employee sustained a fractured jaw, broken teeth and a laceration to the chin requiring stitches.

On June 6, 2018, the injured employee was assisting in rigging up a load of tubing blocks. The equipment operator lowered the rig to pick up tubing blocks. The injured employee's hand was leaning on the blocks and when the load began to lift the injured employee's right ring finger became caught between the blocks and the chain/rig floor amputating it to the first knuckle.
An employee was installing a security system and fell off a ladder to the ground. The employee sustained three broken ribs and a bruised kidney.
An employee was loading a deposit into a safe and when she turned the mechanism to load the deposit bag, it caught her hand and amputated part of her left middle finger.
An employee was moving irregular carts (in a train format) to the end of a conveyor system and crushed his left pinky finger between two carts. The pinky (from the knuckle up) will be amputated.
An employee was setting a meter in the meter bank. The box slipped and the raw edge lacerated the inside of his right arm. The laceration required surgery.
An employee slipped off a rung of a ladder and fell 7 to 8 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured heel.
An employee was cleaning a transfer belt and was burned by scalding hot water.
An employee was engaged in roofing operations and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.

Two maintenance employees received second degree burns on their torso, legs and arms while troubleshooting a pump that moves ambient air, water and paper stock through a sewer/pipe system. The line/pump was plugged and the pump was shut down. After a period of time where the pump was running (not moving water and paper stock) and plugged, the ambient water and paper stock heated up. The maintenance personnel did not realize that the water had heated (temp unknown at time) and proceeded to open the inspection port. As the inspection port was opened, a sudden release of hot water/paper stock sprayed the two maintenance personnel.

The injured employee was part of a 6-7 person crew of linemen in a boat assessing a leaning pole in slough due to the weather. One of the poles being inspected slipped out causing the live 7200 V primary line to contact the injured employee's shoulder and ground out through their right leg to the boat/water. The employee was hospitalized for electrical burns.
An employee was struck by a reversing vehicle being moved on the lot by another worker. The employee sustained head trauma and an elbow fracture.
An employee doing demo work on the third floor of building was struck by falling material from above when the fourth floor collapsed. The employee sustained lacerations to the head and broken teeth.

A piece of sheet metal was hanging from a dumpster and an employee attempted to flip the metal into the container. As he did, the metal caught his right wrist causing a laceration that required hospitalization for surgery to repair a nicked artery.

An employee was in a tree approximately 10 feet up to perform tree cutting. As the employee was descending, the tree fell and the employee fell about 8 feet. The employee sustained an L2 fracture to his back and fractured bones in his left foot.

An employee reached for cases on a second level pick slot, grabbed the product and sat it onto their pallet jack while standing on the pallet jack platform. The employee then lost their footing and tried to catch themselves by grabbing the control handle. The directional control was triggered in the forward direction. Their right foot was struck-by the platform and pinned against a rack leg. The employee sustained a laceration above the right ankle and a crushing injury to the right foot.

Employees were raising a structural steel beam (L 27' x  W 24" x 104") when it fell striking the injured employee. They were lifting the beam using a beam clamp and a crane to orient it to slide in place to be bolted up. The injured employee's lower left leg was amputated. The employee also sustained serious injuries to the right leg, a bruised hand and a possible fractured cheekbone.
An employee fractured a femur when he lost his balance while climbing over a chain-link fence and fell 2.5 feet.
The injured employee was standing next to an I-beam that had been removed from a rebar mat. The I-beam fell to the ground and struck the employee's right foot causing four metatarsal foot fractures.
An employee was using a bar to open the manhole. The manhole cover slipped and smashed the tip of his middle finger resulting in amputation.
An employee tripped over a document disposal bin and fell breaking her right ankle. She was admitted to the hospital for surgery.
An employee was operating a forklift and struck a curb and overturned. The employee sustained a leg injury requiring surgery.

A temporary employee was working at an extruder shear when a plastic sheet became jammed. As the employee attempted to remove it, the employee's thumb became caught in the equipment, amputating the tip between the first joint knuckle and the nailbed. The shear was guarded at the time.

An employee was lacing using an oxygen lancer. Concrete was heated by the lance and metal slag shot into the air and contacted the injured employee. The employee sustained burns to the left foot and right hand.
An employee was standing on a step ladder to hang a picture. The employee fell from the ladder and broke a leg.

Employees were moving a metal ring weighing 578 lbs. from a hydraulic lift table to a work bench when the metal ring fell onto one of the employee's left hand catching it between the ring and the work bench and amputating the ring and middle fingertips.
Employees were working on an electrical power outage. An employee received an electrical shock from the left triceps to the right index finger and thumb and was hospitalized for electrical burns.

On June 6, 2018, at approximately 7:15 a.m. an employee was removing the operator's seat from an off-road dump truck to perform maintenance on the seat's air ride suspension. While removing the seat from the cab, the employee lost his footing and fell 6.5 feet to the ground. The employee suffered compression fractures to multiple vertebra and was hospitalized.

On June 6, 2018, at approximately 7:15 a.m., an employee was running the stacker on the brewer line when the employee reached into the notcher head to remove stringers from the machine. The employee's right hand then made contact with rotating parts, resulting in amputations of the ring, middle, and index fingers. The machine was running and guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was struck by a forklift, suffering fractures.
An employee was driving a forklift down a steep slope when it overturned. The employee sustained cuts to the head and arms as well as fractured ribs.
An employee was walking, tripped on a raised section of the floor, and fell resulting in a fractured femur.

The injured employee and a crew were prepping for a prescribed burn by cutting down dead and dying timber. The injured employee dropped a 25" diameter tree and the tree took an unusual spin on the ground and rolled over his lower leg. The employee sustained a puncture wound, a laceration and a fracture to his left tibia.

An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack, turned a corner and struck a stack of pallets. The injured worker was operating a powered industrial vehicle on the opposite side and was struck. The injured employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was carrying a toilet bowl to the dumpster for disposal. It slipped from the edge of the dumpster and shattered. The employee was hospitalized for lacerations to his right forearm.

On June 6, 2018, around 9:00 a.m. an employee parked and engaged the breaks of a loaded forklift on a slight incline and got off the forklift to verify space availability in the cargo van that was being loaded. The forklift rolled forward crushing his legs between the bumper of the cargo van and the material on the forklift causing fractures to both legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up for a climb when the worker fell and was injured.

An employee was operating a CNC lathe as he polished a part. The part came off the spindle and struck the employee in the forehead and on the left shoulder. The employee sustained a laceration above the left eyebrow requiring stitches and a broken shoulder.
Employees were cleaning rollers on a machine with abrasive pads when one employee's fingers were caught in the rollers. The employee's middle, ring and pinky fingers were crushed.
On June 6, 2018, at approximately 9:30 p.m. an employee was cleaning a roll press when their right hand became entangled in the machine resulting in injury requiring hospitalization.

On June 6, 2018, at approximately 10:00 a.m. an employee's left hand fingers were pinched between the table and the guard of a an up-cut saw, when the saw unexpectedly cycled, resulting in surgical amputation of the fingertips.
On June 6, 2018, an employee partially amputated her left ring finger while operating the manual paper cutter.
An employee's right middle finger was amputated while operating a table saw.

On June 6, 2018, at approximately 11:00 AM, an electrician was attempting to remove a termination from a bushing on the transformer when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered first degree burns to the face and arms.
An employee was cutting a lift gate loose from the metal packing cradle. The lift gate shifted and caught his middle finger between the lift gate and the cradle resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking and tripped and fell resulting in a fractured arm.

An employee was on a step ladder installing a slide lock at the top of the pump house door and fell approximately 10 feet onto the asphalt outside the pump house. The employee was hospitalized for head lacerations and a broken collarbone.
An employee was conducting routine maintenance and fell from the sixth rung of an eight-foot step ladder. The employee was hospitalized for a brain bleed.
Two employees were cutting a section of pipe. As the injured employee was cutting the pipe, a 8' x 14' aluminum trench box fell over onto the injured employee resulting in a cracked pelvis.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when a dog broke through the screen door and bit the employee in numerous places on the arm and leg.
An employee was loading the chamfer machine with wood and crushed their left index finger between a board and the machine guard. The fingertip was surgically amputated.

Two employees were traveling in a utility vehicle. As the driver made a sharp turn, the vehicle overturned and caught the passenger's right leg between the vehicle and the ground. The employee's right fibula was fractured and lacerated.
An employee was performing drywall work and fell approximately six feet from equipment, landing on the floor and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was cutting open a bundle of wooden studs with a knife and severed an artery in his left wrist resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was cutting lumber with a computerized saw and amputated his thumb.
An employee slipped and fell while walking by the sink in the seafood department. The floor was somewhat damp. The employee suffered a fractured left femur.
An employee was installing guardrails on the highway and was hospitalized for heat stress/exhaustion.

An employee was testing flashing welds for proper depth and fell approximately 25 to 30 feet through the mid-rail of a guardrail and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a lacerated liver.
An employee was trimming the edge of the lawn, was startled and stepped back into the mower chute. His legs and feet were lacerated by the mower blade.

On June 7, 2018, an employee was cribbing up a figure eight eccentric wheel block assembly. The cribbing fell as he was tightening bolts with a ratchet and socket, pinching his left hand. His hand was crushed and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting on her coat when she tripped and fell to the floor breaking a hip and wrist.
An employee was cutting a precast storm sewer pipe. He slipped off the pipe and cut the left side of his rib cage with the saw.
An employee was operating a machine and amputated fingertips.
The employee had just completed their route and began experiencing symptoms of heat-related illness.

At the job site the injured employee used a vacuum to extract water from one pit, backfilled three small pits, helped coworkers fill two other pits, and then performed sweeping on the road and sidewalk before leaving. Afterwards, the employee began experiencing symptoms of heat-related illness, including vomiting. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

Two reach trucks (stand-up forklifts) collided in the loading dock area while loading semi-trailers. One operator was not injured. One operator was thrown from the reach truck and fractured the right wrist and left ankle.

An employee was operating a lathe to test a 1" diameter, 6" long metal part. The part had a burr and the burr caught the employee's glove pulling his fingers into the lathe. The skin on his left index and middle fingers was degloved to the middle knuckle resulting in surgical amputation at the middle knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell while walking to the deli department. The employee suffered a broken leg.
A crew was slowly bleeding off pressure into the next section of valves when the Kelly hose burst and the hose struck an employee's leg causing a right tibia fracture.
An employee was walking to his vehicle when his knee gave out, resulting in a fall that ruptured his patella tendon.
An employee was cutting a hole in a ship hull with a plasma cutter. The steel in the center of the opening fell onto the employee's finger causing a partial amputation.

An employee was pumping liquid asphalt from a storage tower to a distribution truck when the employee was sprayed with the hot asphalt resulting in burns to the right thumb and index fingers and the left foot. The valve was not shut down at the time.
An employee was leaving a client's home, slipped on steps and struck an elbow on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized.
A delivery driver was unstrapping the load from the semi-trailer when a concrete window sill fell onto his hand breaking bones in the hand.
An employee was running the rotary machine and caught his right middle finger in the machine resulting in amputation to the first knuckle.

Two employees were performing a routine inspection of the neutron generator. One of the two workers heard a hissing sound and they detected a leak that could be corrected by tightening a flange bolt. When one of the employee's set the wrench on the flange bolt, the clamp failed and the internal pressure propelled the dome (globe) away from the base and the dome struck the other employee (without the wrench) in the chest. The injured employee sustained one broken rib and a punctured spleen.
An employee slipped and fell down stairs and fractured a leg.
An employee was moving scaffold equipment while standing on top of a concrete wall. The employee fell backwards to the ground sustaining a bruise and cut to the back of his head.
An employee was loading a trailer when she slipped on cow manure and fell onto the trailer floor. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.

The injured employee was acting as the "ground man" and lowering a large tree limb that had been cut. The limb slipped from the rope and fell, striking the employee on the head and causing a skull fracture. The employee was wearing a hard hat at the time.

An employee was performing a shift clean-up on a blend line when his left arm was pulled into the blending rollers. The blend line was turned off, but the rollers were still rotating. The employee was admitted to the hospital with a left arm amputation below the elbow.

An employee was crouched on the ground cutting a piece of stainless steel. A large piece of steel fell from the grapple of a scrap handler, struck the ground and skidded 24 feet striking the employee and causing a fractured right arm.

An employee was participating in a live fire training/qualifying exercise utilizing a rifle and sustained a gunshot wound to the left foot causing a compound fracture while transferring the rifle from one hand to the other.
An employee was guiding a dock plate down and crushed a finger between the dock plate and his steel-toed boot, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was taking a king pin out of a trailer and fell to the concrete working surface. The employee suffered a fractured hip.
An employee was installing insulation and became dizzy. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was standing behind the planer/molder machine operator. The employee reached around the machine operator, grabbed a piece of wood flooring, and pulled it forward into the top cutter head. His right hand made contact with the cutter head resulting in severe lacerations to the third, fourth and fifth fingers. The fourth and fifth fingers were amputated.
An employee fell from a belt loader and caught himself with his hand. He fractured his right wrist and required surgery.
An employee was flipping a beam in the shop when the beam fell off the horses and struck his right leg causing a fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was sweeping the road and was run over by a skid steer fracturing both legs.
An employee's left index finger was amputated on a bandsaw.

An employee was working at a remote job site delivering chemicals. When he had finished delivering chemicals at that location, he began having a headache. The employee was looking for headache medicine in his backpack and removed a handgun from the backpack placing it on the truck console. When he later reached for the gun it discharged into his left hand. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was moving a roll with an overhead hoist. The load moved and struck the operator's hand against the machine causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working in the iron yard sorting incoming metal scrap at the exit point of the metal shear. The metal shear is located outside and there is a hole through the wall where the conveyor conveys metal scrap into the building where the operator workstation is located. There is a heavy rubber matting that hangs above the conveyor as a safety barrier to protect the employee from potential flying metal. A gap in the heavy rubber matting caused some metal to come underneath the plastic strip and strike the employee on the left side of the neck. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration to the neck.
An employee was speaking with the skid steer operator when he became trapped between the loading bucket and track of the skid steer causing a left leg fracture.
An employee was walking into work, tripped and fell onto her right side breaking the right arm.
An employee was moving tables after a blood drive. She leaned against a folding table and the table and the employee fell to the floor. She suffered a right hip fracture.
An employee was changing a forklift battery. The battery slipped from the device it was on, fell off the hoist and landed on the employee's left foot shattering it.
An employee suffered heat related illness including slurred speech and vomiting while driving back to the office after working all day. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was attempting to move a rack of chicken product when the roller that held a roll of plastic wrap fell catching the employee's right index finger between the roller and the frame. A second employee attempted to assist the injured employee and lifted the roller off the employee's hand. The employee shifted their hand and the roller fell a second time. The roller landed on the injured employee's hand causing their right index finger to be caught in the frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The employee was shadowing on an auto chop saw. He put a piece of wood into the molder and it jammed between the fencing. Other product hit the jammed piece of wood. The employee went to remove the jammed piece of wood and his left pinky finger was pinched between the wood pieces. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the pinky finger on his left hand.

An employee was clearing a jam on a panel stacker when several oriented strand board (OSB) panels fell onto her hands causing a laceration and fracture to the left hand and a laceration to the right ring finger.

An employee was installing a water tie-in and walking on cooler panels in the ceiling. The employee stepped on the drop ceiling above the bakery and fell approximately 10 feet. The employee suffered a broken right clavicle, humerus, ribs and wrist.
An employee was walking up a flight of stairs at a private residence. The stairs gave way and the worker fell through suffering broken ribs and internal injuries.
An employee was assisting a patient sit up in bed, turned, and got tangled in the alternating leg pressure cord causing her to trip, but not fall. She sustained neck and back strain.
An employee was hospitalized after falling 28 feet from an elevated walkway to the ground.
An employee was cleaning slag from a vessel containing molten copper. The slag and molten copper splashed onto the employee's left foot burning it.
An employee tripped over an open filing cabinet drawer breaking her right arm.
An employee was walking through a doorway and caught a heel beneath the door causing her to trip and fall and break the left hip.
Three employees were removing attachment pins from a skid steer to remove the bucket. The skid steer bucket fell onto on employee's right foot resulting in five broken toes.

On June 8, 2018, an employee was moving a beam while on a scaffold. The employee stepped off of the scaffold onto a shelf and it collapsed causing the employee to fall 11 feet to the floor below. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured right ankle.

The injured employee was installing the last two pieces of decking to the floor of a mezzanine being built within the warehouse. The employee pushed the decking back so that he would have room to cut it and fell through the exposed hole approximately 14 feet to the concrete floor below. He struck steel framing on the floor and broke his arm. He also suffered lacerations to his forehead.

On June 8, 2018, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to repair a pipe hose on a wheeled fire extinguisher. The employee's right eye was struck with a steel pipe he was using for leverage causing cuts around the eye, swelling and impaired vision.
An employee was walking and tripped over the ground elevation difference, fell and broke the upper right arm.

On June 8, 2018, at approximately 12:40 PM, four employees were moving a truck cab into the paint shop. The truck cab was on a rolling cart. As they were moving the truck cab, a temporary employee got his right hand caught between the truck cab and the paint shop door causing a severe avulsion injury. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 8, 2018, an employee was burned on the face, neck and back after opening a hot oil valve in the browning area.
An employee was pressure washing the stage windows from a 6-foot step ladder when he lost balance and fell on the stage's floor breaking his left wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was checking equipment and adjusting lines. As the employee was unplugging a plugged line that uses steam, a handle was bumped releasing steam condensate (300 degrees) that struck the employee's chest causing a second degree burn.
An employee was on horseback when the horse pitched forward and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered four broken ribs.

An employee fell 12 feet from a scaffold platform inside of a tank to a lower level of scaffolding while pressure washing the ceiling of a vessel. The employee sustained a right ulna fracture and a left shoulder fracture.
An employee was installing lighting, came in contact with a live circuit and jumped off the ladder after receiving an electrical shock.
An employee was cutting water pipes when the saw kicked back and cut the employee's face and chin.
An employee was helping a contractor install a swivel and the swivel fell on his hand breaking the left index finger.
An employee lifted a box (60 lbs.) and tore a hernia.
An employee was on a table when the iron handle on a utility cart struck him. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee got their left index finger caught between a compressor frame and a skid resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was standing by a metal plate that was leaning against the wall. A forklift struck the metal plate causing it to fall. When the plate fell, the employee lost his footing and fell to the floor sustaining a right hip fracture.

An employee was working on a balcony about 12 feet high, removing the railing in preparation to work on the balcony floor. After removing the railing, the employee fell to the concrete pavement below. The employee suffered a fractured skull and ribs, broken vertebrae and collarbone and a bruised lung. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was power washing a roof and fell approximately 30 feet through a sky light. The employee sustained a fractured leg, pelvis and sternum.
An employee was working in a semi-trailer placing packages onto a conveyor when one of the packages fell and struck the employee on the head. The employee suffered a possible concussion.
On June 10, 2018, an employee sustained an amputation to the right ring finger when using a meat cutting band saw.
On June 10, 2018, at approximately 3:30 p.m., an employee suffered a partial amputation to the left middle finger while greasing the gears of the power tongs.

The injured employee was operating a forklift to remove pallets of bananas from inside a container. A yard dog operator hooked up to the container and pulled it away from the dock as the forklift was exiting the container. The forklift fell between the container and the dock. As it was falling, the injured employee grabbed the overhead guard supports at the same time the forklift hit the steel ramp, amputating the right hand just above the wrist.

While hand-scrubbing the chute on a vacuum system, the employee's hand entered the vacuum pump chute and his finger was caught on angle iron. When he pulled his finger back, the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was preparing to clean an air duct system and fell down a shaft when backing up along the duct system. The employee sustained back and pelvic fractures. A piece of sheet metal duct work at the end of the shaft also lacerated the employee's left hand.
An employee was walking to his office, tripped over a tow motor hook and fell to the floor sustaining a right hip fracture.

An employee was working on the boiler room air conditioner and fell from a step ladder. The employee fractured the right arm and suffered a head contusion, bruising down the right side of his body as well as an abrasion on his left hand.

On June 10, 2018, an employee was clearing a jam in the polybag machine. The machine cycled and the heated pins used to punch holes into the plastic bags amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was cutting metal parts with a saw and suffered an amputation injury to the left index and middle fingers. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee tripped over a microwave cord and fell breaking the right hip.
An employee was doing roofing work. As he approached the roof edge, he lost balance and fell 18 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractures.
An employee was changing a tire using the tire machine and sustained a left pinky finger amputation at the base of the nail bed while removing the tire from the rim.

An employee was transporting a section of plates from the inspection area to shipping. There was a 1-inch gap created between the top and second plate during the lifting/lowering of the plates and the employee's left middle fingertip was caught in this pinch point.

An employee was moving a metal buggy while getting ready to clean. While rolling the buggy, the employee's pinky finger was caught between the buggy handle and the side of a conveyor resulting in a fractured finger and torn ligament requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on the roof exposed to heat from the sun. The employee was hospitalized that night for dehydration.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a stump. The saw kicked back and cut the employee's upper thighs.

An employee lost their balance while riding on the machine as the machine slowed to change direction. He stepped backwards onto the front tire of the machine. Since the machine was in reverse, he was pulled down under the machine by the tire causing fractured vertebrae and a leg laceration.

An employee was injured while positioning a trough for a well. The trough fell on the employee's right hand resulting in a fracture of the middle fingertip and lacerations to the middle and index fingers requiring stitches.

A truck driver with RJ's Transportation was unloading 93% sulfuric acid from the tanker truck to a holding tank at a customer site. Pressure lines failed and acid was released striking and burning the employee. Personal protective equipment (PPE) was not worn at the time.

An employee was disassembling gear boxes. As the employee reached under a load that was lifted by a crane, a bearing fell out and landed on his left hand causing fractures to two fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were dismantling forms from a cap on a bridge column. The concrete forms shifted and collapsed onto both employees. The first employee was hospitalized for a broken pelvis. The second employee was hospitalized for a broken jaw.

On June 11, 2018, an employee was stepping off of a flatbed trailer onto a six-foot step ladder. As the employee stepped on to the ladder it shifted causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture both ankles.

An employee was operating a saw machine and was cleaning the saw dust off the belt using his right hand when his hand got caught in the conveyor belt was pulled into the roller amputating his right index finger.
An employee was pinching a 10" nitro hose line and the line burst. The hose struck the employee flipping him and breaking his right tibia.
An employee's finger was caught in a door resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On June 12, 2018, an employee fell while descending an extension ladder resulting in a broken wrist.
The employee was moving a wall partition and cut the end of his finger on the edge of the wall partition resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using a concrete pump to repair sidewalks and curbing. The pump could not reach the location where pumping was done and additional hoses were connected. While holding the hose end, he lost control of it and was struck in the head by the hose end. The employee sustained head lacerations requiring stiches and was hospitalized overnight.

An employee was pushing an assembled engine on an engine cart down a conveyor roller rack. As the employee attempted to slow down the momentum of the engine cart, his left index finger was pinched and amputated between the engine cart and a roller on the conveyor.
An employee went around a corner and tripped over a box on the floor, falling to their right side and fracturing their hip.
An employee was prepping the ground for a concrete sidewalk and suffered leg cramps. The employee was later hospitalized and diagnosed with dehydration/acute kidney failure.
An employee slipped on a grate while walking in a building and fell to the floor. Their hip and pelvis were injured requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a manual pallet jack to load the delivery truck. The employee moved backwards inside the cargo area while pulling the pallet of merchandise with the manual pallet jack, stepped off the back edge of the box truck bed and fell approximately four feet to the ground. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was helping to load wood crates in the bag boxing area. The employee was caught between a strapping machine and a crate. The employee sustained five broken ribs.
An employee was standing on the top step of a 2-foot stepladder to change paint booth filters. The employee fell off the stepladder to the concrete floor and fractured the right hip.
An employee fell off an eight-foot scaffold, hitting a crossbeam and then the concrete ground. The employee sustained a broken rib and three transverse process fractures.

Three employees were on a paint truck applying paint stripping on the highway when a semi-trailer struck the rear of the paint truck flipping it over. Two employees were hospitalized for a concussion, brain bleeding and broken ribs.

An employee was installing decking on a mezzanine level. The employee stepped backwards and fell 18 feet through an undecked portion of the mezzanine to the concrete floor below resulting in hospitalization for a concussion. Fall protection was not secured at the time of the incident.

An employee was in the asphalting area applying asphalt to the exterior of a ductile iron pipe, 20 feet in length and was struck by a pipe that was being rolled in the direction of his work station. The employee sustained fractures of the left knee and pelvis.
An employee suffered a thoracic lumbar strain while lifting a heavy rock on site.
An employee was dismantling a building and fell approximately 14 feet from a truss resulting in back injuries. Fall protection was not attached at the time.
An employee was walking through the grass from her car to her office and rolled her ankle. Her right ankle was fractured.
An employee was lowering a 60 lbs. lashing rod when it slipped from the employee's hand and fractured their jaw.
An employee was making a delivery at a customer location. While exiting the delivery truck, he missed the step with his foot causing him to fall to the ground and fracture his right elbow.

Employees were outside moving equipment and disturbed a wasps' nest. The injured employee was fleeing from a wasp when he tripped and fell to the ground landing on his right elbow. He suffered an arm fracture requiring surgery to repair.

The injured employee was working in the GE plant purging the gas in the building. Work in a 4-foot pit had just been completed and the diamond floor plating over the top of the pit was replaced incorrectly. As the injured employee was walking to check the valve, he fell through the floor plating over the pit. The injured employee sustained a right leg laceration on the corner of the plate.
An employee was greasing rolls on the roll former and fractured his fingers in the chain and sprocket.

An employee was operating a forklift and went in between a dump truck and another vehicle. The dump truck struck the forklift and the employee's left arm was caught between the dump truck and the forklift and fractured.
An employee was driving a logging truck and lost control of the truck. The truck fell onto the shoulder of the road. The employee sustained right shoulder and neck injuries.

An employee was closing the front gate when it came off the track and fell on top of the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis, compression fractures to the spine and a right rib fracture.
An employee was struck by lightning as he was returning to his car to seek shelter.
An employee was working in a building on the third floor attic draft stop (9ft 6in). The employee fell landing on his left side and fracturing the left ankle.
An employee was clearing a jam in the pelletizer machine and got their right-hand fingers caught in the auger. The employee's fingers sustained deep lacerations.
An employee was trying to remove the rent tag off a self storage door. As the employee was pulling on the tag it popped and punctured the base of their right thumb. The tag required surgical removal.

An inmate was slicing a turkey loaf in an electric meat slicer. When the turkey loaf was trimmed down to a small piece, the employee tried to reposition the meat in the running slicer and suffered the amputation of soft tissue and part of the nail on the end of the right thumb.

The injured employee was guiding marble slabs as they were being unloaded from a flatbed delivery truck using a forklift. The forklift picked up two slabs of marble (120" x 77") weighing approximately 2,200 pounds. The weight caused the forklift to tilt forwards which in turn caused the booms and slabs to fall forward. The impact of the slabs slammed the employee into the truck. The slabs fell back toward the forklift and injured employee fell on top of the slabs. The injured employee was hospitalized for a fractured jaw and vertebrae in the neck.
An employee was getting out of their car at a client's residence, tripped on the sidewalk and fell fracturing their hip.

An employee was installing a receptacle on a live floor box. He was extending the floor box using PVC glue to secure it. The flammable glue ignited with the live wire in the floor box. The employee's left hand sustained second degree burns.
An employee was working in the blow molding area making bottles when the machine jammed. As the employee tried to clear the jam, his index fingertip was amputated by the trimmer.
An employee was using a machine and amputated a finger.

An employee was standing in front of the ice cream trailer preparing to load ice cream onto the straight truck. He turned and reached into the trailer to pull out the ramp. At the same time the employee was reaching into the trailer, the truck continued to back up and struck the injured employee on his left side pinning him between the trailer and the straight truck. The employee sustained a lacerated spleen and liver.

An employee was rigging up a piece of equipment when it began to roll and the employee was caught between the equipment and the subframe of a drilling rack. The employee suffered a broken right arm, broken vertebrae and the separation of muscles on the hip.
On June 12, 2018, an employee was installing a gear guard and began experiencing blurry vision and shaking. He was admitted to the hospital for heat-related illness.

An employee was attempting to remove the pin of a track on a crawler type crane. The employee swatted at flies (insects) and his right hand was on the track as the crane moved forward. The employee's right hand pinky finger was caught in between the pads of the track and amputated to the first joint.
An employee was walking behind a trailer. The trailer backed up and pinned the employee between the trailer and the loading dock breaking bones.
