An employee was shoveling pellets into a silo toward the auger. Pellets shifted under the employee when the auger was turned on. The employee's right foot was caught in the auger resulting in amputation of the lower leg.
An employee was delivering mail and experienced heat-related symptoms. He was hospitalized.

An employee was caught in a rain storm while attempting to button up a roof and fell 26 feet to the gravel surface below resulting in hospitalization for a broken left wrist, fractured ribs and a broken pelvis.
An employee was scanning freight and was struck by a forklift resulting in a broken leg and hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a piece of 15" pipe. When he got to the end of the cut, the pipe pinched, causing the saw to kick back and cut his left shoulder.
An employee said that he was not feeling well and fell to the floor, but did not lose consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for a possible heat-related illness.
An employee was attempting to hit a hammer wrench with a sledge hammer and missed.  His hands hit the hammer wrench.

A forklift operator was attempting to move a single stack of pallets (22 high). Behind the single stack of pallets was a double stack of pallets (44 high). As the forklift lifted the single stack of pallets, a pallet in the double stack of pallets became dislodged. The double stack of pallets fell down over the top of the single stack of pallets, over the forklift mast, and onto the forklift operator's cab enclosure. As the pallets fell onto the forklift, the forklift operator reacted by putting his hands up and his fingers went through the grated enclosure. A falling pallet struck and severed the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was installing a metal roof on a building, lost footing, and fell to the deck. The employee slid approximately 16 ft on 4/12 pitch roof. The employee then fell off the roof edge 13 feet to ground. The employee sustained a fractured L2 vertebra and a fractured wrist.
An employee had finished his trash collection route and started having cramps. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was running a machine that dresses a form on a grinding wheel. The employee was cleaning off the grinding wheel when their right index finger was pinched between the grinding wheel and the dressing wheel amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was using a pry bar to lift a manhole cover. The manhole cover slipped and fell onto the employee's left middle finger, crushing the fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was driving around to feed calves. When she stopped the truck to tend to an injured calf, the truck began to roll backwards with the door open and struck her in the ribs. The calf then rolled over onto her legs. The employee sustained fractured ribs and bruised legs.

An employee was operating a forklift and reached to adjust the materials on the forklift. Their knee hit the lever and the materials on the forklift fell onto their right hand. The middle and ring fingers were crushed.

Employees were removing a piece of glass from a building when the glass panel caught on a screw in the wall and broke in pieces. A piece of the broken glass cut an employee's arm just below the elbow.

The employee exited the loading dock and went down the stairs next to the container to observe the seal being put on the container. While waiting for the truck to pull forward he noticed that the right side container door was swinging out and was going to strike the yellow bollard pole at the base of the stairs. In an attempt to keep that from happening, he stepped between the door and pole to push the door out of the way. The door struck him in the chest and pushed him back into the pole. The weight of the door pinned him against the yellow bollard pole causing a bruised lung and a liver laceration.

An employee was rewiring replacement batteries in an existing battery string and created a short circuit that resulted in an arc flash. The employee sustained second degree burns to his left hand and fingers.
An employee's left thumb sustained a severe laceration when it was pinned by a power press.
An employee was cutting lumber to box a water pipe. The saw jumped the workpiece and struck him in the leg, causing a laceration.

A temporary employee was hooking a chain to an excavator bucket when the excavator bucket moved toward the right side of a bulldozer. The employee's right leg was pinned between the excavator bucket and a part of the bulldozer causing a fracture at the knee.
The employee was engaged in paving operations. He walked into the ditch and was struck by the bulldozer causing a fractured shin.
An employee was attempting to secure a metal track to a metal base when the employee's hand slipped and the metal came down, crushing the employee's finger between both pieces.
Employees were setting up cross members on a pallet rack. The members snap into place. One of the cross members fell down striking one employee and breaking the right leg.

An employee was loading squash onto a trailer when he lost balance and fell to the ground. The trailer was moving forward and rolled over the employee's torso. The employee sustained broken ribs and a fractured spine and hip.

The employee was walking back to her work cell, tripped on a guard rail anchor plate, and fell to the ground hitting her chin on the concrete floor. She sustained a laceration to her chin, a fractured jaw on the left and right sides and a fractured nose.

An employee was cutting the leading edge of a structural member as part of a structural demolition. After cutting the beam, the roof collapsed and the employee fell 12 feet. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture.

An employee was operating an overhead crane inching a hoisted cylinder into place on a material handler with their left hand placed on the cylinder. When the hoisted cylinder slid into place on the material handler, the tip of the employee's left middle finger was pinched between the cylinder and the material handler's stabilizer bracket and amputated.
An employee was splashed with a hot wax and ink mixture after opening a pipe and experienced burns to his hand.
While changing a wiper rubber on the rig floor, an employee stepped on the Kelly (rotating piece of the floor) as it was moving and broke his right leg.
An employee suffered the amputation of the right index fingertip from contact with two boards.

On June 12, 2018, an employee was holding a cooling block on the downstream extruder "B" wheel, while another employee was bolting it in. The extruder machine's wheel rotated catching the employees left thumb and amputating it.
On 6/12/2018, an employee was moving plastic parts and lacerated his thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing wood to paint while standing on a residential roof. He fell to the ground about 8-12 feet below, breaking his right heel and suffering contusions to his right shinbones.

A pipe burst in the department store and water was leaking onto the floor. An employee slipped on the wet floor and fell hitting her head on the floor. She was hospitalized for pain in her shoulder, neck and lower back.
An employee was cutting a pipe with a power saw. The pipe slipped and the saw amputated the employee's left hand fingers.
An employee was moving pans on and off a production line and tripped on a guide rail for the production line. His left shoulder hit a pan cart resulting in a dislocated left shoulder.

On June 13, 2018, an employee was clearing debris away from the photoelectric eyes on a conveyor that housed a kicker that moved logs. The machine engaged when the debris was moved which caused the kicker to cycle. The employee's right foot was crushed by the kicker resulting in the partial surgical amputation of two toes.

An employee was installing the flooring of a portable storage building when he stepped on a flexible air hose, lost his balance and fell approximately ten inches to the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip and ankle.

An employee's left shoe got caught on the ladder causing him to start to fall. When it became unstuck, the employee used his left leg to catch/stop his fall and his leg slammed into the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a hyperextended knee.
An employee stepped onto a board in the attic which broke. He lost his balance and fell about 9 feet down the ladder accessing the attic of a residence, resulting in a broken bone in the lower leg.
An employee operating a forklift suffered an ankle fracture when he struck a column and the forklift's battery cover struck him.
An employee was on a stool retrieving a book. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor fracturing a femur.

The injured employee was preparing to assist a second employee with riveting a trailer during the manufacturing process. The injured employee was holding a bucking bar while a second employee was riveting. The trailer was sitting on a set of stands when it shifted and caught the injured employee's left hand between the trailer frame and the stand. The injured employee suffered an amputation of the left fifth finger at the second joint and the fourth finger at the first joint.
An employee was working with a small tank of glue product and spilled glue on the lower portion of their legs and feet resulting in chemical burns.

Two employees were tying rebar and getting ready to pour a concrete slab for a ramp to a parking lot of a multi-family dwelling under construction. A vehicle struck a temporary chain link fence that the employees were working in close proximity to causing it to fall over onto the employees and trap them. One employee was admitted to the hospital for a strained back and contusions.

An employee was operating a lift to retrieve merchandise from an elevated rack. The employee's left hand struck the rack and his pinky finger was partially amputated. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was assaulted by a shoplifter and sustained a broken hip and lacerations on the right arm.
An employee was operating the press brake and partially amputated the right thumb.
An employee was walking and fell breaking a hip.
An employee went home after completing his shift; not feeling well, he went to the hospital, where he was admitted for severe dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An employee was attempting to refill the fuel tank on a compressor in a trailer when the fuel tank cap pressurized and ignited gas vapors. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to the face, ears and nose.
An employee was operating the core machine and became sick while on break. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of lathe from a jack ladder chain. When she pulled the lathe loose, the jack ladder chain started up and pinched the tip of her right middle finger between the chain lug and the metal plating. Her right middle finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting steel tube to specification with a powered saw. While removing a jammed part from the saw, the employee's right middle finger was amputated by the blade.
An employee was working on a stamping press and amputated his right thumb.
The employee was working from a platform when they slipped and fell approximately 15 feet through an opening to the surface below. The employee sustained trauma to the upper rib cage.

An employee was standing at the rear of a digger derrick truck loading it. The employee's finger was caught between a railing and a concrete pier as it was being loaded into the truck. The left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking into work, tripped over a crack in the sidewalk and fell resulting in a fracture and a torn ligament in the left elbow.
An employee was repairing the brakes on a trailer and crushed their right hand between the brake chamber and the trailer frame causing injury to the ring finger and amputation of the pinky fingertip.
An employee was on a four-foot ladder adjusting a handicap sign. The employee missed a rung and fell to the ground fracturing the right knee.
An employee walking down an egress ramp fell and broke his leg.
While cleaning out the A-side actuator with another employee, the valve closed on the injured employee's right middle and index fingers resulting in amputation of the fingers.
An employee was installing a 50 lbs. chain onto a metal sprocket (non-moving) and crushed their right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
A machine was shut down for maintenance. During removal of the machine guard, the guard fell and struck the injured employee's right middle finger causing ligament damage.
An employee was struck on the head by the frame of the trailer's side door when it fell after opening it. The employee sustained a laceration to the head and pain in the head, neck, and shoulders.

The injured employee was asked to help flip over the gondola to get the debris out. While flipping the gondola with the operator, the employee pinched his left middle fingertip between the corner of the gondola and the cement floor. When he pulled his hand away from the pinch point, skin from the fingertip (palm side) was severed above the first joint. The employee was wearing nitrile gloves with cotton gloves over them at the time of the incident.

An employee was working on a ladder attaching gutters to the roof. The ladder started sliding to the right and the employee jumped 18 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fracture in his lower vertebrae and possible ligament damage to his knee.
An employee was clearing brush and debris from around a house for sale and was bitten on the abdomen by a rattlesnake.
An employee was scrubbing the floor with a ride along industrial scrubber. The employee stepped off of the scrubber, slipped, and extended her leg.
An employee was cleaning a stainless steel vat and their right thumb was caught and amputated between the frame of the vat cleaner and the bracing bar.
A temporary employee slid bottles of cleaning fluid down the line with his hand and some of the liquid splashed onto his face, causing his lips to swell.

An employee was operating a paper trimmer machine. While removing a piece of trim after a cut, the tip of his right third finger was caught in an opening in the paper clamp as the control was released. His hand followed the clamp up and the fingertip contacted the retracted blade. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing a valve from an acetylene tank with the valve machine when his right hand slipped and the equipment activated amputating the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee suffered an amputation on his left hand middle finger while adjusting the guides on the paper converting machine.

An employee was removing expired chlorine tabs from a dilution system tank that was shut down for maintenance. He was exposed to chlorinated water from a leak in the system, as well as wet chlorine tablets stored in a bucket during the maintenance. He reported having a heavy cough after his shift and difficulty breathing the next day and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the gutters on the second level of a residential structure and fell from the roof breaking a wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee operating a forklift struck a stationary forklift crushing the left foot. The foot was amputated.
An employee was walking behind a trackhoe when it backed up and ran over both of the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized with leg lacerations.

An employee was working on an air conditioning unit in a closet-like area when he received an electrical shock and fell, hitting his head. He received third degree burns to both hands and lacerated his forehead, requiring hospitalization and stitches.

An employee was repairing a butterfly valve when a coworker turned on the pressure. The disc inside the butterfly valve then rotated and cut the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's finger was pinched and avulsed while moving I-beams.
An employee fell about 10 feet off a ladder to the ground, breaking his heel and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was stepping off of a ladder onto an uneven surface when he twisted and broke his ankle.
Employees were using a nail gun to frame wall studs for a shed. While a co-worker was passing the nail gun to the injured employee, it fired and a nail punctured the injured employee's knee.
On 6/14/2018, an employee was placing trash/debris in a dumpster when the lid/door closed on and crushed his finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing/walking nearby as a compactor was being unloaded. The door of the compactor failed, swung open, and struck/pinned the employee, who suffered a severe laceration to the back of the neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a two-wheeled dolly to move furniture. He grabbed banding on the product to help lift it onto the dolly when the banding broke, causing him to fall backwards and injure his left thigh.
An employee was delivering product to a customer when he experienced severe leg cramps, requiring hospitalization for dehydration and heat stress.

An employee was operating a rough terrain forklift to repair a metal guardrail along the highway when the forklift drove off a 6-foot ledge and rolled over. The employee suffered dislocated vertebrae, a fractured left eye socket, lacerations, and contusions.
An employee was pulling electrical wire through an outlet box when his left thumb was cut on the edge of the box, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a pump jack when his right hand was caught in the pump jack's belt, severing the first and second digits of his second and third fingers, as well as his thumb tip.
An employee was cleaning off the cutting area around a router machine when the router bit partially amputated his fingertip. The router was running and guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was struck by a mooring line connecting a barge to a ship when a passing vessel's wake caused the barge to shift outward from the vessel.
An employee was riding in an air-conditioned pickup truck to another jobsite when he felt dizzy. He was hospitalized due to dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee was inspecting a Bradley Fighting Vehicle when he fell about 5 feet from the top of the vehicle to the concrete ground below. He suffered seven broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was descending a ladder when it became displaced. The employee then fell from the ladder  to the roof and fractured a leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell 8 feet through a ceiling hole to the ground while working on a modular home, fracturing his back and cutting his head. He was hospitalized and required staples.

An employee was operating a large off-road vehicle when he lost control and the vehicle rolled over. He was ejected and the vehicle rolled over him, fracturing his pelvis and hip, and causing scrapes and abrasions. He was hospitalized.

On June 14, 2018, at 6:30 p.m., an employee was attempting to re-thread material in a press when his fingers were caught by the cylinders and his hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in an open fracture and lacerations to four digits on his right hand. He was hospitalized. The press was not shut down at the time of the incident.

An employee was unloading and loading multiple boxes of supplies in a supply trailer when he suffered heat-related symptoms, including heartburn, vomiting, and thirst. He was hospitalized. The supply trailer was not air conditioned and the outside temperature was in the 90-degree range at the time of the incident.
An employee was trimming a pork loin with a saw when the meat slipped and his right index finger contacted the blade, amputating his fingertip.
An employee was testing material for color accuracy when the material ignited, resulting in a flash fire that burned both of her hands and arms, the right side of her head, and her right leg.
An employee was cutting wood furniture parts on a band saw when the moving blade struck and amputated the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee was using an awl to line up a frame rail prior to stud welding operations when his right index finger was caught in the frame rail rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was stocking merchandise when a bucket of pool chemical fell and struck his leg, causing him to fall. He broke his leg.
An employee was removing a pallet in a trailer when the pallet fell on him, fracturing his right leg.

On June 14, 2018, an employee fell approximately 17 feet while performing roofing work. The employee sustained a broken ankle, fractured ribs and abdominal pain. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee was removing a drill stem from a drill stem rack and his right middle finger was caught in a pinch point created by the drill stem and a caliper resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee sustained a back injury  during an ATV training event. The employee was operating the ATV up a berm, lost control and was ejected backwards off the ATV onto the ground as the nose of the ATV continued in a forward motion.

An employee was attempting to engage a dock board. It was stuck so the employee used his hand. When the board came loose, it crushed several digits on his left hand. The left ring finger was partially amputated.
An employee went up a set of stairs to a catwalk to turn on a conveyor. He then turned around to come back down and fell all the way down the stairs to the floor, fracturing his left leg.
A temporary employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the employee stepped off the forklift and was struck on the left foot by the wheel. His left foot was amputated and he was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out a cement mixer when it turned on and mangled the employee's left arm, requiring hospitalization.

A lift truck backed out of a sea container while another employee was walking by. Due to a blind spot, the lift truck operator did not see the employee. The lift truck then struck the employee, who suffered a hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell approximately 15 to 18 feet from a ladder to the ground and suffered a compound fracture to the left tibia and fibula.

An employee got into an altercation with an employee of another subcontractor on the job site. During the altercation, the employee was cut on the left forearm with a carpentry razor blade, requiring reconstruction surgery.

An employee was stacking a piece of 2x12x24 lumber with a second employee when the second employee dropped his end of the lumber, causing it to fall out of the first employee's hand. While attempting to grab the falling lumber, the first employee's right middle fingertip was caught between the lumber and a nearby pole, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground during tree trimming activities, sustaining neck and spinal nerve injuries.

An employee was performing maintenance on the load break switches of a 13.8 kV circuit when the employee came into contact with energized equipment and an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered third degree arc flash burns from the shoulders up to the head, requiring hospitalization.

On June 14, 2018, at 11:40 a.m., an employee was installing rebar bands on a gabion wall when he suffered a seizure, requiring hospitalization. Dehydration contributed to the seizure. The employee was tied off at the time so there were no physical injuries.

An employee was sandblasting on a pipeline when the blasting hose became tangled. As he pulled on the hose to release it, he inadvertently hit the trigger of the blasting gun. Blasting media then hit his upper thigh, causing an abrasion/laceration.
On June 13, 2018, an employee was delivering mail when she was bitten by a dog. The employee suffered lacerations and a broken arm, requiring surgery.

An employee became dizzy from heat while stacking lumber and reached out to regain balance. While reaching out, the employee's left middle finger was caught in a chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was cutting grass behind the shop using a rotary mower attached to the back of a tractor. He was passing a rack that had a sputter bar when a tractor part became hooked on a pad-eye on the sputter bar, causing the rack to be pulled down onto the employee. The rack landed on his back and pinned him against the tractor steering wheel. Another employee ran over and cut the tractor off. The employee suffered six cracked ribs, a punctured lung, and broken vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to flatten a 1-inch by 12-inch piece of metal when it broke in half and struck his left middle finger, resulting in a surgical amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a molding machine when it cycled and caused amputations to fingers on both of the employee's hands. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was trying to remove a bucket attachment that was stuck on a skid steer. He raised the bucket off the ground, exited the steer cab, and was hammering on the stuck release pin when the bucket fell to the ground, striking him below the knees and scraping several inches of skin off to the bone.
An employee tripped over a rock while walking and fell, fracturing his right lower leg.

An employee with Peninsula Roofing Company, Inc., slipped and fell approximately 26' as he was transitioning from a ladder to a roof with his personal fall arrest system harness. He suffered fractured wrists, a broken heel and right foot, and a small fracture to the spine near the tailbone, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working in the office while a forklift operator was outside unloading a truck. The forklift operator struck a beam, cutting a hole in the container he was unloading. As he was attempting to patch the hole, he was caught under soy beans that spilled from the container and yelled for help. The employee in the office ran out and slipped on the spilled beans, falling onto the concrete floor and breaking her right ankle. She was hospitalized.

An employee was positioned on the ground cutting a tree that had fallen on a power line (the line was de-energized) when a 4' tree limb fell on him. He fell to the ground with the tree limb, which pinned his left leg and broke his femur.
While on a trash pickup route, an employee experienced cramping in the legs and arms due to dehydration/heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a deli slicer when it sliced off the tip of the employee's right thumb.
An employee was working on an oven press when he became dehydrated and fell backwards, hitting his head on a pallet and fracturing his skull.
An employee was walking through the kitchen area when she stumbled and fell into a food storage shelf, fracturing her femur.
An employee climbed a ladder attached to a hopper bottom trailer to tighten a knot on a tarp. He slipped off the ladder and fell 6 to 10 feet to the concrete floor of the shop, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was taking a pallet off a loading station in a distribution center when the chain that creates movement on the line popped into motion and amputated his left index finger at the first knuckle behind the nail. Lockout/tagout procedures were not performed at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking in a hospital parking lot. She stepped onto the sidewalk, which caught her flip-flop. She tripped and fell onto a nearby car, then rolled, her right hip striking the pavement. She was hospitalized with a broken right femoral neck requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a PVC pipe with a cut-off saw when the saw kicked back and severely lacerated his face. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
A forklift ran over an employee's left leg as it backed up, fracturing his tibia.

An employee was transferring a bundle of steel to a conveyor table with a hoist when the load shifted and struck the employee's hands, resulting in amputations to the right and left middle fingertips.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a stack of pallet boards when his left-hand fingers made contact with the rotating saw blade, amputating his middle and pointer fingers down to the third knuckle. His thumb was still partially attached at the time of the incident.
An employee was reversing a walkie-rider when she became caught between the equipment and a guardrail, breaking her right tibia and ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a jam on a pallet board notcher machine when the employee's left hand became caught in a chain and sprocket, resulting in a ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing jammed material from a mill. The tip of the employee's left ring finger was amputated.

An employee was using a come-a-long to raise a basket out of a sump to clean it. When the basket reached the top, the come-a-long slipped out of gear and the basket fell. As it fell, the basket pulled the employee's left index finger into the come-a-long, resulting in an amputation of the left index finger up to the first knuckle.

An employee was setting forms for a concrete pour. A steel plate that shortens the form was askew in the track and did not seat properly. The employee began to wiggle the plate to get it in place when it released and pinched his left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A RackMasters employee and a temporary employee were in a scissor lift at an elevation of approximately 20 feet, using a hand-held tool to unscrew angle joints and dismantle a rack. They were removing the final piece of the rack, which was against the wall of the facility (almost flush with the wall), when the rack became loose, fell, and hit the scissor lift. The scissor lift then fell over and the two employees jumped when it was about 2 feet from the ground. The employees suffered a spinal fracture and fractured arm.

An employee was attempting to remove a compressed spring and tension rod assembly from a dock leveler when the spring and tension rod came loose and struck the employee's left femur, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to catch a part after it fell from a horizontal lathe when his right hand was caught in between the part itself and the surface of the lathe. His right pinky finger was smashed, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was on a ladder pulling cables through the ceiling when the employee lost balance and fell approximately 2 to 3 feet to the ground, fracturing a femur.
An employee was operating a pipe handler when a drilling pipe was released and struck his right hand, resulting in a pinky finger amputation and fractures to the ring and middle fingers.

An employee and another employee were performing scrapping work on site when a 2" lip failed, causing some structure piping to fall. The pipe hit the employee, causing him to fall and land on his left foot. He broke two toes, suffered a right shoulder strain/torn muscle, and broke two right-side ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading material onto a conveyor at the back of a truck when he missed his step, lost his balance, and fell off the truck to the ground, fracturing his left wrist. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was changing the die on an extrusion press machine when the machine actuated amputated the employee's right index finger to the first knuckle. The die was energized at the time of the incident.
An employee was loosening a bolt on a piece of equipment when he slipped and suffered an open fracture of his right ring finger phalanx.

An employee was operating a string line reel to roll up the string line used in concrete paving operations when the reel stopped working. As he then walked towards the string line reel, it activated, causing the string line to wrap around his legs. He suffered a compound fracture to the right leg.

An employee was trying to dislodge jammed plastic in a plastic sheet line; a shear in the machine amputated the tips of his left middle and ring fingers. The machine was guarded with a metal grate at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a plastic bottle trimmer on the blow mold machine when the trimmer lacerated and fractured the employee's right thumb, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to load a reel of cable into the rear of a bucket truck. His left middle finger was caught between the cable and the truck bed, and the tip was amputated.

A temporary employee was entering a trench that was 4 feet by 8 feet and 4 feet deep to help install a propane gas tank. While entering the trench, which had wood and aluminum siding installed, the employee slipped and fell. The siding then lacerated his left forearm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell while walking, suffering a brain bleed that required hospitalization.

An employee was steadying a road boring machine as it was loaded onto the back of a truck. The employee's right index finger was in a pinch point when the machine was lowered onto the finger, crushing it and requiring a medical amputation.
An employee was pulling a pipe out of a pipe cutting machine when the pipe fell on his finger. As he pulled his finger out, the end of the pipe amputated the pad of his right index finger.
An employee working on a car sustained third degree burns to 50 percent of his body when a spark ignited the gas tank of the car he was working on.
An employee was using hot water to de-ice the floor of the cooler/freezer area when he slipped. Hot water then spilled on and burned his face, chest, and arms.

An employee was removing a salvageable part from a forklift that was being decommissioned and removed. The part was a 2"x3"x6' steel block. When he cut the part away from the forklift using a torch, it fell to the ground and struck his right foot on the metatarsal area (behind the steel toe cap), fracturing it.
While working in high temperatures, an employee suffered a rapid heart rate, stomach pain, and weakness due to heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.

On June 16, 2018, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was attempting to check the gear box on top of a ready mix truck when the employee slipped, fell, and struck the truck fender and the floor. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was cleaning debris from a charging machine with a rod that had a spade on the end of it when his left thumb was caught between the shield on the rod and the charging machine. His left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was struck in the eye while picking up steel strapping, suffering an eye laceration that required hospitalization. Safety glasses were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was struck while walking behind a reversing mixer truck, suffering broken bones that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving metal material when one of the employee's right fingers was caught between the material, resulting in a traumatic amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was grabbing a winch to make a pipe connection on the rig floor when his finger was crushed between the winch cable and the power swivel, partially amputating his pinky finger.

An employee was finishing a vertical mold set-up when the lid fell. The employee entered the mold to try to retrieve the lid. The mold next to the one he was in was filled with molten steel. He could not get out of the mold and was burned by the radiant heat from the adjacent mold. He suffered burns to 6% of his body (hands, back, buttocks).
After checking air conditioning units on a roof, an employee was coming down the roof access stairs when he slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a slipped disc in his back.
An employee was at the end of a trans-load (transferring from railcar to tanker truck) of nitric acid when a line broke, exposing him to nitric acid burns on his legs.

An employee was walking backwards in front of his pallet jack when he tripped on a nearby pallet. He fell towards the floor and grabbed the drive handle of his pallet jack, causing the pallet jack to release its brake and drive forward. His right ankle and foot were crushed between the pallet jack and a pallet.
An employee was riding on a K-loader when the operator applied the brakes. The employee lost her balance and fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete below, suffering a traumatic head injury.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while mopping a resident's room. The employee broke the right knee and was hospitalized.

An employee was getting a well head to stop on the down side and the weights on top. He was trying to roll up loose cable running from the rod rotator to a Samson post. His hand was on the brake and he was watching the weights when he pulled back on the brake to stop the weights. His hand then struck the top of the cross bar of the weight guards and his finger was struck in the middle. His right thumb was pinched and injured, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was removing a critter from an electrical panel box when he received an electrical shock, suffering electrical burns that required hospitalization.

An employee was trying to avoid a car passing through the work zone when she stepped into the path of an asphalt front roller. The roller's steel drum then ran over her left foot. She suffered severe left ankle/foot fractures with open wounds, lacerated tendons, and a right tibial fracture. Her left foot and ankle eventually had to be surgically removed.
On 6/17/2018, an employee's right thumb was caught in a clamp as it clamped down on a wheel, pinching off his thumb tip.
On June 17, 2018, an employee fell on the last step while walking down a stairway.
An employee was assembling a wooden door when the employee's left index finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hospitalized for back spasms after lifting a stack of seven 9.5-pound parts into a box.
While cleaning up materials and equipment on a hot day, an employee suffered heat-related injuries, including an acute kidney injury, liver problems, and a muscle injury.
An employee was walking down steps when he tripped and fell, fracturing his left fibula and tibia.
A team was unloading a beam with a crane when an employee walked between the beam and a pipe. The beam leaned in toward the pipe, and the employee was pinned between the two.
An employee was lancing heater tubes with pressurized water equipment. When he pulled the lance out, the pressurized water struck his left bicep and chest, resulting in abrasions and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a machine when the employee's arm was caught between the bottom edge of the machine's door and its conveyor system. The employee suffered a laceration and fractured forearm.
An employee was in a bucket truck when it became overloaded and ejected him. He suffered collapsed lungs and a broken back. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was climbing a ladder to inspect roofing work when he lost his balance and fell approximately 17 feet, landing on two subcontractors below. He broke five ribs.
An employee was doing mechanical work on a military truck. The truck started up and the alternator belt caught the employee's right hand. The tip of the employee's index finger was amputated.
An employee was attempting to move sheets of drywall stacked against a wall when the stack fell over and landed on his left foot and leg, damaging tendons and requiring hospitalization for surgery.

An employee was standing near a conveyor while another employee was pushing a conveyor section to move it at a different location. The conveyor then tipped over and struck the first employee's left ankle, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was feeding material into a machine when the employee's hand was pulled and crushed between the rollers.
An employee began to suffer symptoms of carbon monoxide poisoning while walking by an area with elevated carbon monoxide levels, requiring hospitalization.

An airport ramp agent was trying to connect a cart and hitch when his left little finger was caught between the tongue of the cart and the hitch. He suffered a bad cut and was hospitalized. He was wearing a glove at the time of the incident.
An employee was exiting the building through a revolving door when she tripped and fell onto her right leg, fracturing her femur.
An employee's feet were struck by a forklift's forks. He suffered ankle/foot contusions, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trying to diagnose why a customer's windshield washer pump was not working when his right ring finger was caught in the vehicle's serpentine belt, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was sorting packages on the dock when she exhibited signs of dehydration and heat stress, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move steel racking from the sales floor to outside of the store when the steel racking slipped off the pallet. The employee and another employee attempted to lift the steel to reposition it on the pallet. The employee lost his grip and his right middle finger was caught between two sections of the steel racking, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was changing a metal wheel on a print cylinder transport while a coworker supported the side of the transport with a pry bar. The pry bar slipped and the employee's right index fingertip was caught between the metal wheel and the side of the transport, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was attempting to assemble a section of a racking system when his right middle finger became caught between the racking system, amputating his fingertip.

An employee began picking up collapsed cardboard from a motor assembly cover next to a conveyor that was in the up lift gate position. His finger was caught next to the pivot point of the conveyor lift gate as it fell, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was sandblasting a 3,000-pound metal injector body when it flipped and fell on his left foot.

An employee was lifting and moving a 40-foot shipping container with a top-loader stacker vehicle to place that container on top of two other shipping containers that had been stacked. While driving the top-loader forward, he activated the vehicle braking system as the shipping container was lifted. The vehicle then tipped and fell forward. As the vehicle was tipping forward, he jumped from the operator's cab, fell to the pavement below, and fractured both legs.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor when he noticed raw meat on the underside of the conveyor roller. He was attempting to brush the meat off when the conveyor caught his glove and pulled his arm into the conveyor, causing a laceration, torn muscle, and broken bones in the arm and shoulder. The conveyor was not turned off or locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was opening a bagged product at a table. A 10-inch knife on the table became caught on the bag as it was being opened and flung in the direction of the employee, striking and lacerating his left arm.
An employee was setting up an auto roll thread machine when it cycled and amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell off a delivery truck while attempting to secure a pallet jack in the truck. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
On June 18, 2018, an employee tripped on a floor mat and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured hip and requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was using a band saw to cut pieces of metal when his gloved left-hand index finger entered he saw's point of operation. The glove was caught in the blade, resulting in an amputation of the employee's index fingertip.

A pallet of material had been received in the warehouse, and receiving had removed straps holding the material to the pallet in order to stock the material. While walking through the warehouse, an employee tripped on one of the straps and fell to the ground, sustaining a fractured femur above the left knee.

Two temporary employees were cleaning around a machine. One of the employees lifted the machine with a forklift as the second employee reached underneath it. The machine then slid off the forks and onto the second employee's left hand and fingers.

An employee was taking apart some pipe on top of an oil and gas tank when he slipped and fell approximately 22 feet. The employee sustained cracked ribs, a collapsed lung and a cracked collarbone. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was removing debris from a conveyor belt when his right middle fingertip was caught between the conveyor and a moving slat, resulting in a fingertip amputation and tissue loss. The conveyor was unguarded and active at the time of the incident.
An employee stepped into an area where a setting machine pushes a brick column into the setting heads. He was then struck by the machine and sustained a fracture to his lower left leg.
An employee was using a mag drill to drill holes when the drill broke friction and spun, amputating his left index fingertip.
An employee was climbing on a trash bin to remove debris when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his leg.
A temporary employee's left hand was crushed and lacerated by a shear. The shear was guarded at the time.
An employee was closing a separator when a pipe popped off, releasing tallow that burned the employee's left upper arm.

An employee was providing air to support a bridge dismantling project. He began to walk to a truck where the air compressor was housed when his knee gave out at the top of a hill, causing him to slip down the embankment approximately 12 to 15 feet. He sustained knee injures and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was delivering mail to a business when he tripped and fell onto his left side, fracturing his left hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a tree with a chain saw when the tree snapped back and broke the employee's leg.
An employee was performing concrete work when he fell from a scaffold and lost multiple teeth.
An employee was installing the cylinder of a rebuilt hydraulic lift on a fire truck. The cylinder dropped onto the employee's right ring finger; the fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was working from an A-frame ladder while installing cardboard baffles in a garage's roof truss seals when he lost his balance. He grabbed the garage door track to try and regain balance, and the sharp track partially amputated his right ring finger.

An employee exited his switcher truck to ask another driver where to drop his trailer when his truck started to move. He was trying to stop the truck when he was caught between it and another trailer. He suffered head trauma, broken ribs, and multiple lacerations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee felt dizzy and nauseous after working in a cooling tower. He collapsed, blacked out, and then vomited. He was hospitalized for dehydration and a fractured left big toe.

A flagger was directing vehicular traffic when the traffic light turned green and a vehicle (minivan) proceeded through the intersection and struck the flagger. The flagger sustained a broken right leg and a broken left ankle.

An employee was standing on a pipe and attempting to cover a small caustic leak when he slipped and fell off the pipe, striking his head. During the fall, caustic splashed under his face shield and burned his face.
On June 19, 2018, an employee was repairing the roof of a two-story residence when he fell from the roof, breaking his ankle(s). He was hospitalized.
An employee was working in an aerial lift to loosen a cam-lock trap when a cap struck the employee's face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a shear when his left index finger was amputated.
An employee tripped over a traffic cone and fell, striking her face on the pavement and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing shingle siding from a scaffold when he fell through the guardrails to the ground below, fracturing his vertebrae, pelvis, and arm.
An employee was walking down the hall near the laundry room of an apartment complex when he slipped on the floor and did a split, injuring his leg muscle.
An employee slipped and fell on a concrete entryway that was wet from rain, suffering a fractured right kneecap.
An employee was in a bucket cutting in jumpers to energize a new electrical line when his hands started cramping due to heat-related illness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a parking lot when she fell, suffering a ruptured Achilles tendon.

An employee was wrecking form work on the elevated deck portion of a structure. He was attempting to help a second employee lift a sheet of plywood when he fell through an unsupported open space and struck the scaffold underneath before hitting the ground. He fell a total of 15 feet and suffered six broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was operating a table saw when the blade deeply lacerated his left thumb.
An employee dropped a concrete form on his hand, causing an injury that required surgery.

An employee was on site troubleshooting magnetic door holders and investigating a short in the low voltage wiring. She was on a 6-foot ladder in the access hatch of a first floor rotunda when she located an unmarked junction box near the assumed trouble area and removed the cover. She then came into contact with a high-voltage bare wire (287 volts) and received an electrical shock, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking through a construction site when he tripped over some construction debris and fell onto his knee. He suffered a knee sprain and was hospitalized.
On June 19, 2018, an employee was cutting with a chop saw when the blade broke and impaled his leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee turned off and dismounted a lawnmower. The mower started to roll and he tried to stop it. His foot was caught between the front wheel of the mower and a rock, resulting in foot lacerations.

An employee was taking a joint of iron off the back of a truck and rotating it back into the cradle where it was stored. A brace was missing; when the joint was put into its resting spot, it kept rolling, crushing the employee's left little finger against the work platform. The finger was amputated.

An employee was using a platform on a forklift to reach merchandise when he fell to the ground below, fracturing his wrists and shoulders and suffering a concussion. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was stacking and nailing small sections of wood trusses on top of each other when the stack of trusses, which was about 4 feet high, fell on him. He suffered upper body trauma and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered heat-related illness while performing construction work outside, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was handling steel sheets when a metal sheet fell and injured his finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pushing a box down a conveyor when the employee tripped on a pallet and fell off the conveyor, suffering a broken hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a machine when his left hand entered the machine, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a generator that was not connecting to a switch gear. The employee slipped on the steps in front of the generator, and his left hand touched an energized busbar. He suffered a third-degree burn.
An employee attempted to walk over some cartons that were in the walkway. He tripped, lost his balance, and landed awkwardly on his right ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was grinding a piece of round stock when their glove got caught in the moving pedestal grinder and pulled into the grinding wheel. The employee suffered a broken fingertip resulting in surgical amputation.

A temporary employee was cleaning a mold while preparing it to be placed in a mold press. The employee stepped down some steps and lost balance. While attempting to catch themselves, the employee's hand went into the machine's conveyor system and was caught between the roller and the mold plate, partially amputating the left ring finger.
An employee was setting cones when a vehicle entered the work zone and struck the employee causing fractures and lacerations.

An employee had exited a vehicle when it began to roll. The employee was attempting to shut it off when another vehicle clipped the employee. The employee suffered a broken femur and injured calf, as well as a possible amputation.
An employee was sweeping the floor when a forklift ran over and fractured the employee's left foot.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a truck while standing on a ladder when the employee fell 6 feet to the ground, head first. The employee suffered a concussion and cut above the right ear.
An employee was attempting to calm an aggressive client when the client pushed her to the ground. She suffered a fractured wrist and bruised ribs.

An employee was sitting on the side of a truck trailer with his arm resting on the ramp, which was in the up position. The truck driver got into the truck and began reversing the trailer. The employee's right arm was then caught between the trailer and a skid steer that was behind it. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated right shoulder and swelling.
While operating a helical machine used to dig holes, an employee was struck by the machine's stabilizing bar. The employee's right thumb was amputated.
An employee was operating a handheld router when a metal chip went up her nose and lodged into her throat, requiring hospitalization and surgery. A face shield was not worn at the time.

An employee was attempting to hold branches from one shrub out of the way while trimming another shrub with a gas-powered hedge trimmer. The trimmer then amputated his left little fingertip and cut his ring finger.
An employee was lifting a wheelchair from the grass to the sidewalk and suffered a back injury.
An employee was tightening bolts with an impact wrench. The employee's left middle fingertip was caught and crushed between a bolt and the wrench's stabilizer arm, resulting in a surgical amputation.

An employee was at the register. She took a few steps back to look out the window and identify which gas pump the customer was on. When she stepped back she tripped over a box/crate on the floor and fell, landing on her right hip.
An employee fainted while packaging perfume on an assembly line.
While loading a pallet, an employee was struck on the back by a bag of flour that fell from a rack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a drill press when the bit caught the employee's glove and hand, resulting in a fingertip amputation to the fifth digit and lacerations to the third and fourth digits.

An employee missed a step and fell while walking down the stairs, injuring the left knee and suffering a ruptured patella tendon. Both of the employee's hands were occupied at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to shake a pebble out of her shoe when she lost balance and fell on her right side in the employee parking lot. She fractured her right hip.
An employee was using a rib saw to cut brisket when the blade contacted his right middle finger, cutting it through to the bone. The finger had to be medically amputated.

An employee was climbing up scaffolding to put plastic on the roof and keep water out of recently poured wet concrete when the employee slipped on the wet scaffolding and fell approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was performing landscaping work when he began feeling dizzy and unwell. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was descending a ladder after cleaning a light fixture when he fell to the ground, fracturing his arm and elbow.
An employee was changing out a filter on the filler when hot water spilled on him, causing serious thermal burns.

An employee was helping a crew inspect a newly installed pipeline. High-pressure water and construction debris escaped from the pipeline during pigging operations, knocking over the employee and injuring their head, torso, and leg.

An employee was moving an accordion punch press into position to punch materials. Its wheels got stuck and it tipped onto him, fracturing a vertebra in the thoracic region of the back and causing abrasions to his shoulders and knees.
An employee was helping two other people remove a bush from a ditch when he became ill and experienced cramping. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was burning brush and sustained burns to their left arm and leg.
An employee was stabbed by another employee during an altercation they had while delivering papers.

On June 20, 2018, an employee was using a hose to transload caustic soda from a railcar to a truck when the hose became disconnected and the caustic soda splashed underneath the employee's face shield. The employee suffered burns to the eyes.
An employee was installing a chain when the motor fell, pulling on the chain. The employee's middle finger was caught between the chain and the sprocket and amputated at the tip.
An employee fell between a dock plate and the rear of a truck in a loading dock area, striking and injuring a knee.
An employee was finishing the installation of LED lamps on a scissor lift when he suffered an electric shock resulting in hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell while getting out of his truck cab during a rainstorm, injuring his back.

An employee as pulling the motor out of the water into the locked position. When it didn't lock, the motor descended and the employee was pulled overboard pinching her right thumb between the motor and the clasp to the bracket. Her fingertip was amputated.
An employee experienced heat exhaustion while collecting solid waste.

An employee was connecting a gooseneck trailer to the ball hitch of a pickup truck. As the trailer was being shifted into place, his left middle fingertip was pinched and severed between the trailer and hitch.
An employee was climbing a stairway. He fell, cutting his left leg on metal strapping at the bottom of the stairs.
An employee was driving a new vehicle in reverse to an airport gate. When he turned the vehicle, it overturned. He suffered a concussion.
An employee was climbing on a jetveyor at an airport gate when the handrail collapsed while she was holding onto it. She then fell and hit her knee on the jetveyor step.

An employee was assisting a client who was laying in bed. He bent over the bed to cover the client with blankets when he felt a sharp pain and pull in his lower back area, then fell onto his knees on the floor. He was unable to get up and required hospitalization.
An employee fell over a retaining wall, breaking his leg.

An employee was working on a concrete wall splitting production line. When he turned to discard waste into a hopper, he lost his footing on the raised platform and fell forward into the waste material in the bin. His right middle finger was pinched between the concrete waste in his hand and the concrete waste in the bin, and the tip was amputated.
An employee was on a processing floor, operating a shell saw. The saw contacted the employee's left thumb, lacerating it.
An employee was moving a glass container of hot liquid when the container broke. The hot liquid then splashed and burned the employee.
An employee was sliding the fork of an extendable boom forklift when the employee's left middle finger was amputated to the first knuckle between the sliding fork and the forklift carriage.
An employee was carrying a radio out of her office when she tripped and fell to the floor, suffering two fractures to her left arm that required surgery.
An employee was working on a bulldozer. His left hand was caught and smashed between the track and its frame.
An employee was operating an ATV when it rolled over. He contacted the ground and the rolling ATV, suffering a punctured lung and shoulder injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading produce greens and fainted twice. The second time he struck his head against the wall case in the produce department.
An employee was using a hot stick to test an electrical circuit in a junction box. He came into contact with an energized electrical circuit and was shocked.
An employee received an electrical shock while getting ready to tie in a light ballast, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a small bundle of metal flashing when he lost control and the flashing cut his wrist, tearing a tendon.

An employee was unloading a crate from a truck onto a forklift when he lost his balance and fell. Another crate (weighing about 70 pounds) was pulled onto his body, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was participating in a scheduled evacuation drill when her right knee gave out. She fell onto the parking lot and suffered a knee injury.
An employee was entering the cab of his truck when he slipped from the top step, fell, and struck his head on the ground. He suffered head trauma.

An employee was trying to manually move a conveyor belt that was clogged. When he unclogged it, the belt moved quickly and his left index finger was then pinched between the belt and pulley, resulting in an amputation above the first knuckle. The equipment was turned off at the time.
An employee was clearing a jam in a mulch blower when it activated, amputating the fingers on the employee's left hand.

An employee was observing a customer unload freight with a forklift when the 2,650-pound freight fell off the forklift forks and struck the employee's right foot, fracturing and crushing the metatarsal. The employee was hospitalized.

Five employees were transported to the hospital and two were admitted. The employees suffered from some type of a reaction during a monthly birthday celebration where fake mustaches were worn. One employee had difficulty breathing and eventually stopped breathing. Another employee suffered a seizure.
An employee became nauseated while installing HVAC filters on a rooftop. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was inside a box truck, using a hand truck to rearrange pallets. The hand truck got stuck, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall about 4 feet to the concrete. His head struck the concrete, and he sustained subdural hematomas and a fractured clavicle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was turning around a riding pallet jack. The employee's left leg became pinned between the jack and the bottom rail of a storage rack, and the employee suffered a broken lower leg.

Two employees were installing center bars, plates, and nuts on cased micropiles. As one employee was holding the center bar with a pipe wrench, the injured employee went to lift the plate. The wrench was released which caused the nut to catch and pull the plate down. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the plate and the casing; the first digit was amputated.
An asphalt roller operator fell approximately five feet from the operator's platform and was hospitalized for a severe head injury with concussion. The roller was parked at the time.

Emergency work crews were dispatched to an area that had lost power. An employee was climbing a pole to repair a powerline that he thought was de-energized when he came into contact with an energized line. He suffered first degree burns on his left hand and third degree burns on his left thigh, requiring hospitalization. Electrical insulating gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking through the door frame and caught his leg on a stringer on the bottom of the frame and fell to the floor of the adjacent room which was about  6 to 8 inches lower. The employee sustained a broken right hip.
An employee was pulling weeds by a flower bed when a rattlesnake bit her right hand. She was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a die from a press. The press activated and a clamp broke apart, ejecting shrapnel that struck the employee. He underwent surgery to remove the metal.
An employee was cleaning a pump. While his finger was in the pump's discharge port, the end of his right middle finger was amputated.

An employee was on top of a molding machine, trying to start it, when the safety bar activated and smashed his right ring fingertip. He was hospitalized and had surgery to remove the finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting the flange on a fire stop collar with a portable bandsaw and amputated his left index finger to the knuckle.
An employee was pushing a trim bucket cart into a meat cooler when he slipped, falling on his right hip and suffering a right leg fracture.
An employee was taking down a sign and used a knife to cut the strap holding the sign. The employee slipped and the knife cut his wrist, damaging the tendons.
An employee was rinsing out an empty 55-gallon oil drum with hot water. The water splashed out of the drum, burning the employee's left shoulder, arm, thigh, and hip.
An employer suffered a lower back injury while lifting a trailer door, and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a ladder to the ground and broke his pelvis.

An employee was using an oxy-acetylene torch to repair a leaking refrigeration line to a walk-in freezer. The heat ignited some oil trapped in the line. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the left arm and less serious burns to the right arm and neck, and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the ground pouring five gallons of silicon coating into a tub reservoir to accommodate the pump sprayer when the employee became ill and started vomiting. The employee suffered a heat-related illness.

An employee was opening an airwall and got his finger caught between two folding doors resulting in a fingertip amputation. The convention center is under construction and plastic sheeting on the floor made it difficult to push the doors closed.

An employee was clearing a jam in a wood chipper. As the employee dislodged the wood that was causing the jam, the chipper machine re-engaged. Wood chips flew from the chipper, striking and lacerating the his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was putting a finished mold (45-48 lbs.) onto a storage rack when he suffered a back injury.
An employee was about to clean okra cutting blades and sustained an amputation to the right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was helping unload a delivery truck while an all-terrain forklift was being used to remove a stuck side gate from the truck. The forklift began to raise the gate, which was caught on a pallet. The gate came loose from the pallet and struck the employee under the chin resulting in a broken jaw.

An employee was standing on a 41-inch-high railing, shifting scrap metal inside an 8-foot container. He fell from the railing to the concrete below, breaking his pelvis, clavicle, and four ribs and suffering a contusion on the back of the head.
An employee was holding a turkey so it could be injected with a vaccine by another employee. The turkey jumped, and the employee holding the turkey was injected. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a threaded rod with a portable bandsaw. The saw jumped and struck his left hand, cutting and pulling his cut-resistant glove into the guard and amputating the tip of his left index finger.

An employee was setting up for a work shift and walked past a paint booth with a compromised seal. The employee then suffered an asthma attack possibly due to chemical sensitivity to the spray paint. The employee was wearing a half-face respirator.

An employee was using a forklift to install a lifting beam on the top of a tower section when his finger was pinched between the beam and the forklift, resulting in an amputation of his left ring fingertip.
An employee was helping a truck back up to a loading dock when his finger became caught between the truck and the dock plate and/or loading dock door, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to nail in building siding when he became startled and fell off the ladder, hitting the ground.

An employee was cutting a piece of copper from an exterior wall using a 10-foot A-frame ladder when he lost his footing and fell about 6 feet to the ground. He injured his spleen and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a 4" angle grinder to cut a steel plate. The grinder kicked back, striking the employee's right knee.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when it slid sideways along the telecommunication wire it was resting on. He fell to the ground below, fracturing his right elbow.
An employee was ejected out of a stand-up forklift as it turned. He struck a shelving support with the right side of his body, suffering blunt force trauma including a fractured pelvis.
An employee slipped and fell while carrying a tray of product into a storage cooler. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.
An employee was climbing off a work truck's ladder. He fell about 3 feet to the ground, breaking his right wrist.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal when the grinding wheel shattered, lacerating the employee's right hand.

At 11:00 a.m. on June 21, 2018, an employee was preparing equipment for transport. The equipment shifted as he tried to remove a piece of metal from it, and his fingers were caught between the top of an A-frame ladder and the metal piece. He suffered a crushing injury and laceration, and was hospitalized.
At 11:00 a.m. on June 21, 2018, an employee was splashed with Isopar. After leaving work at 5:30 p.m., he began coughing up blood and was hospitalized for chemical exposure.
An employee was using a rivet gun when it cycled, pinching his fingertip between the wide internal chamber and the narrower neck of the nozzle opening. He suffered a finger amputation.
An employee was on a step stool, placing merchandise on a rack against the wall. The stool broke and she fell to the ground, breaking her leg.
While walking between buildings, an employee tripped on the step up onto a sidewalk. The employee fell, sustaining a hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was removing parts from a rotator table at a spinner machine and placing them into a bin for inspection. While the employee was at the greasing station, the greaser nozzle caused a partial amputation of their right index fingertip. The station was guarded at the time.
While descending from the back of a work truck, an employee caught their left leg on an attached work light, suffering a laceration to the lower leg.
An employee was inspecting a vault when a water hose popped out of the top of the vault. The 180-degree water caused first- and second-degree burns to his torso.
An employee was moving a 3,500-pound bundle of parts with a jib crane and a sling. The sling broke and the bundle fell on the employee, breaking his leg.
An employee was slicing a ham when the meat slicer cut the tip of their left little finger; the employee was hospitalized. The slicer's backplate was not in use at the time of the accident.

An employee had put a pipe in a vise and was adjusting the flange to insert a ring into the unit. The unit slipped from the vise; as the pipe fell and the employee tried to grab it, the vise pinched the employee's finger. He suffered a fingertip amputation on his left hand.
An employee was painting about 8 feet off the ground on a metal walk board. He fell about 8 feet to the ground below, suffering head trauma and broken vertebrae.
An employee slipped and fell in a wet car wash area, breaking two bones in his lower right leg and injuring his left elbow. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was dropping trash off at the edge of a loading dock. She fell, landing on the ground about 4 feet below and striking her head on the wall of the dock. She suffered hemorrhaging and was hospitalized.

An employee was on the back of a semi truck attaching hoses to a trailer. He fell off the side of the truck, landing on the ground about 45 inches below. He was hospitalized to treat fractures in his back.

An employee was feeding steel into a punch press and removing the product. The press picked up two sheets of steel instead of one. The employee attempted to separate the steel to prevent a jam, and the machine table struck the employee while they were placing product on a pallet. The employee sustained a hairline fracture to the hip.
An employee was working inside the hatch of a ship's discharge pipe when he suffered heat cramps. He was hospitalized to treat heat stress and dehydration.
While on foot helping offload autos from a rail car, an employee was crushed between two of the autos.
An employee fell twice (once at 4:30 a.m., once at 11:30 a.m.). The first fall caused her significant pain; she also suffered a broken right hip, possibly in the second fall.
A maintenance technician was replacing a belt on a beam shear drive. The drive was jogged, and the technician suffered partial amputation injuries to the middle and ring fingers of his left hand.

An employee was cutting the straps holding an aluminum log, which was being carried on the forks of a forklift. The log fell, crushing the employee's right foot. The first joints of three of the employee's toes were amputated.
An employee was working on a die casting machine, running an angle mold. The employee's hand was caught in a pinch point, causing a finger amputation injury.
An employee was placing a tray on a conveyor line when their finger was pinched between the conveyor's belt and side rail. The employee's right index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee was unloading and stocking boxes of tile onto a shelving area when his index finger was pinched between a box and a shelf, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A temporary employee shot another temporary employee.

At 7:05 p.m. on June 22, 2018, an employee was bitten by a dog on the lower right arm while delivering a package to a residence. She was treated and released from a medical facility. At about 5:00 a.m. on June 23, she began to experience infection symptoms and was admitted to the hospital.
The mast of a forklift came down, striking and breaking an employee's right arm.

An employee was folding over a rain flap on a generator to pin it before an oil rig was moved. The employee's right middle finger was caught between a pad eye on the generator roof and a pad eye on the rain cap. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was setting up and adjusting a milling machine. While one of the machine's gearbox doors was open, the machine activated and the gearbox pinched the employee's left thumb, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was rolling a piece of wire and pinched their left middle finger against the other roller resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was assaulted by a client while providing home health care. The employee suffered a concussion, contusions, and abrasions.
An employee fell through or over a residential balcony's guardrail to the ground 21 feet below. The employee suffered a collapsed lung and fractured vertebrae.
At about 8:30 a.m. on June 22, 2018, several employees were working to change a mold. The mold fell onto an employee, severely crushing his legs.

An employee was troubleshooting a CNG machine. While his left hand was on top of it, it engaged and rotated. His left middle finger was amputated just below the nail. The machine was in manual mode at the time.
Two employees were removing the condenser head of a chiller. While the head was suspended, it pivoted, causing one employee's finger to be caught between a bolt and a hole. The finger was amputated.
An employee's left little finger was pinched in a door jamb causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working near a 13,200-volt switchgear cabinet. An arc flash severely burned the employee's face, neck, and chest.
An employee was preparing a metal drip edge on a roof. The employee fell from the roof, breaking both heels and one tibia.
On June 22, 2018, an employee was attacked by a nursing care resident while trying to usher the resident back to his room. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was positioning a support block under a generator enclosure. The enclosure was set down, catching the employee's right thumb between itself and the block. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was walking in an ice house when he stepped on a roller bearing access cover, causing his left foot to fall into an auger. He suffered a laceration to the foot and a fractured toe.
An employee was helping unload an aircraft pallet when it ran over his left foot. He was hospitalized for surgery. His big toe was partially amputated.
While doing steel erection work, an employee fell 20 feet to the ground, breaking both heels. He was not tied off at the time.
An employee was opening a door when a strong wind pushed it shut. The tip of the employee's left index finger was trapped between the door and the frame, and was amputated to the first bone.
An employee was troubleshooting a manufacturing robot. A drive belt and pulley caught the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was lifting a piece of aluminum guttering to install on a gas station canopy when it contacted a high-voltage power line. He suffered electrical burns to both hands and a foot.
An employee was struck by an unchocked car in a fenced area, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was hanging conduit using an 8-foot ladder. He fell to the floor, suffering a concussion and broken ribs, pelvis, and thumb.

An employee was pulling weeds, helping another employee prune shrubbery. The other employee's clippers caught the employee's right index finger, causing a partial amputation and a bone fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on a puddle of water and fell as she entered the facility. She suffered a torn hamstring and was hospitalized.
An employee experienced muscle cramps while rigging up isolation tools. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was transferring cattle to a corral when a cow charged and trampled him. He suffered lacerations to the back of his skull and his bottom lip, as well as contusions on the right shoulder, right leg, left knee, and left leg.

An employee was removing a sock from the inline filter at the filler after a hot water wash. When he removed the clamp, hot water sprayed onto his right side in areas from his neck down to his legs and onto his back. He suffered second-degree burns.
An employee fell from a 6-foot A-frame ladder, and their head struck the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured skull and bleeding in the brain.
An employee just accessed a roof and fell off to the ground below sustaining an ankle and sacrum fracture. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
While an employee was climbing off a barge that had just been unloaded, he fell head first onto a vessel deck. He suffered lacerations to the back of his head and his right knee.
An employee slipped and fell on a muddy concrete floor as he was going around a corner, fracturing his left hip.
