An employee was using a radial arm saw to cross-cut boards. A piece of wood got stuck behind the return device; while trying to clear the jam, the employee suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger.

On June 23, 2018, an employee was trying to remove a tube that had jammed in the in-feed rollers of a tube cutter. The roller's caught the employee's left glove, pulling in their fingers. The employee suffered an amputation injury to their left index finger.
An employee had just finished servicing a belt on a vehicle. As he was inspecting his work, his hand contacted the belt and the tip of his right index finger was amputated.

On June 23, 2018, an employee was operating a tube bender machine while sitting on a chair. The machine actuated, and the employee's finger was caught between the clamp and the metal piece; the employee suffered an amputation to the tip of the right index finger.

At 11:40 a.m. on June 23, 2018, a conveyor jammed while an employee was sorting garbage. As he attempted to clear the jammed conveyor belt, his hand was caught and his right little finger was amputated.
An employee was cleaning up a work area when a piece of a metal panel fell from a set of sawhorses. It struck his foot, severing the Achilles tendon.
An employee was installing tile when an abrasive wheel grinder kicked back, striking him in the left shin. He was hospitalized.
An employee's finger was smashed in the pinch point of a buggy and a tugger. The finger was medically amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on a floor, wet from condensation, in front of a lab incubator. The employee suffered a fractured left patella.
An employee tripped and fell as he entered a diked area. He struck a ground-level grating, suffering a broken tooth, a nose laceration, and neck pain.
An employee was strapping cargo in a trailer when he fell from the trailer, landing on the concrete about 48 inches below. He suffered a fractured hip.
An employee was backing a center control pallet jack into product and struck racking crushing the employee's right thumb.
An employee fell on a freshly mopped tile floor, suffering injuries to her left arm and knee. The muscle separated from the bone on the knee, requiring surgery.
A bailer operator was fixing a wire from a bailer unit. The bailer's hook caught his left wrist, lacerating it. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking from her car into the building, fracturing her right ankle.
At about 11:30 a.m. on June 24, 2018, an employee opened the doors of a shipping trailer and was struck in the head by an empty plastic drum weighing about 23 pounds. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a mule truck. The employee was inside the mule truck when a crane lifted a container on the truck bed. The employee struck her right hand inside the truck and suffered multiple hand fractures.

An employee was placing a channel iron inside an automated vise to secure the iron for cutting with a bandsaw. The vise automatically closed while the employee's left ring finger was between it and the channel iron causing an avulsion injury and hospitalization.

On June 24, 2018, an employee was working in the warehouse to prepare the upcoming week's jobs. He used an extension ladder to try to retrieve a dolly from a box stored on a mezzanine. The ladder slipped out and the employee fell to the floor, breaking his hip and foot. His injuries required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was making adjustments to the hamburger press when his left thumb was caught between the top and lower part of the press resulting in the amputation of the tip of his thumb without bone loss.
An employee opened the inspection lid of a tank to see if the water in it was boiling. Hot water splashed out, causing second- and some third-degree burns to his torso.

Two employees fell while installing second-floor decking. One employee fell approximately 10 feet to the deck below and sustained facial lacerations and fractured the C7 vertebra requiring surgery and hospitalization. The second employee sustained a muscle strain and bruising on the chest, shoulder and back from the retractable lanyard. Both employees were wearing retractable lanyards at the time of the incident.

On June 25, 2018, an employee was using a chainsaw to trim dead branches from a magnolia tree. He was 2.5 feet off the ground, standing in a tree notch, when he fell. The chainsaw lacerated his left forearm. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was penning cattle. The employee's horse fell over on top of him/her, causing a laceration to the upper right leg, a leg fracture, and a crushed pelvis.
On June 25, 2018, an employee's right femur was fractured as the employee stepped up onto a curb.

On June 25, 2018, an employee was using a hydraulic press brake to square up two 90 degree bends in a steel product. When the ram came down, his left index finger was pinched and crushed between the brake and the product, leading to an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was experiencing cardiac stress while collecting recycling resulting in hospitalization.
An employee fell from a step stool to the ground, fracturing her right wrist.
An employee was climbing down a fixed vertical ladder when he fell to the floor. He suffered a back injury with broken bones, and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to wipe grease from a stay rod nut. A torque wrench (connected to another stay rod nut) engaged and pinched the employee's right little finger, amputating the tip.
On June 25, 2018, an employee was using a sling to offload 120-gallon tanks from the back of a truck. He fell from the truck to the ground, sustaining a lumbar compression fracture.

At about 5:45 p.m. on June 25, 2018, an employee's hand was caught in the nip point of two press rollers and injured. The employee was using a tool to remove paper from the rollers and his hand was pulled in while the rollers were coasting to a stop. He suffered fractures and degloving.
An employee fell between a trailer and a loading dock, suffering a laceration to the left shin.
An employee slipped on a patch of grease/oil on the floor and fell. The employee's face struck a metal basket, causing a fracture to an orbital bone.
An employee was pushing a machine down a gravel ramp when the machine pinned the employee against a beam. The employee suffered a back injury.
An employee was adjusting the air pressure on a log kicker when their finger was caught, resulting in an amputation of the left middle fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was closing a loading dock's rolling door when his left ring finger was caught between the door and the metal plate ramp. He suffered an amputation injury to the finger.

An employee was responding to a "rapid response team" page. While avoiding a collision with another person, she fell, striking a wall corner. She suffered a fracture of the right humerus, as well as a partial avulsion of the right middle fingernail and a minor scratch over her left eyebrow.

An employee was cleaning a label machine. He was jogging the machine and cleaning glue off the glue roller when the sponge he was using got caught between the roller and the pallet, pulling in his fingers. Part of his right middle finger was detached and the tip of the ring finger was crushed.
An employee was climbing down an 8-foot ladder when an air hose became caught. While trying to free it, he fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering several broken vertebrae.
On June 25, 2018, an employee was struck by a forklift. She was hospitalized with a hip fracture.
An employee was guiding a crane load from a scaffold. The scaffold gave way and the employee fell to the ground, suffering leg injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a temporary switch gear with a pallet jack. The gear rolled off and fell onto the employee's right leg, breaking two bones.
An employee's foot was caught by a wood pallet while she was sitting in a chair. She suffered fractures.

An employee was climbing down a ladder to weld a joint inside a tank that was being built when the ladder slipped out from under him. He fell 6 feet, landing on his feet and breaking his tibia in three places.

An employee was cleaning liner to the bucket truck and fell to the ground 9 feet below. He suffered a broken vertebra in his lower back, as well as two cut fingers. He had not been tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a back injury while reaching into a cooler to retrieve a water bottle.
An employee was using a crane on a truck line, lowering a part into place. His thumb was caught and injured between the frame and the dog bone.
An employee fell from a 47-inch-high baker scaffold to the floor, suffering broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell over a forklift's fork, landing on the floor and suffering a fractured left hip. He was hospitalized.
While working on a metal roof, an employee suffered shortness of breath, lightheadedness, and chest pressure. He was hospitalized for heat stress and dehydration.
An employee was bitten by a spider in the office. She experienced swelling and pain on her left leg, and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting pins to get a concrete pouring machine into position. A spring-loaded pin came out of the machine and struck his hand, causing an amputation to the tip of his right ring finger. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time of the incident.

On June 25, 2018, an employee was pinching the metal pins (weighing about 25 pounds) out of an 18-wheeler flatbed truck, preparing the bed for a new load of steel I-beams. One of the pins caught his cloth causing him to lose balance; he fell to the concrete floor, breaking several ribs and his collarbone.
An employee was using a meat slicer and amputated the tip of her right thumb.
An employee was repairing an exhaust blower on a tugboat. The blower sucked his hand in, causing the amputation of his left index finger.
On June 25, 2018, an employee's right foot was crushed by scrap metal falling from a roll-off box that was being unloaded. He suffered a fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was monitoring a wood chipper when a piece of wood was dislodged from the chipper and struck his index finger. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, suffering a fractured hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a conveyor belt when his left foot went through the conveyor belt and was fractured. He was hospitalized.
On June 25, 2018, an employee was fixing a leak in a liquid dish bottle labeler when the machine started up, fracturing both of the employee's hands.
On June 25, 2018, an employee's head struck the door frame of a mail truck. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell out of a tractor trailer, striking the ground. She suffered a fractured orbital bone, fractured neck vertebra, and laceration to the face.
An employee's ankle was pinned against a warehouse rack while he was operating an electric pallet jack.
An employee was using an ATV to spray weeds. The ATV rolled over on an embankment, injuring him.
An employee was using a handheld grinder to grind off a bolt on a mower that was stuck when the grinder kicked back and the handle hit the employee's right eye, causing a retinal detachment.
A baseball pitcher was struck in the right lower jaw by a line drive baseball, suffering a fractured mandible.

An employee was performing a headboard change out on a mold machine. The employee stepped back onto a limit switch causing the hydraulic pusher to traverse and catch the employee's left foot between the 900 psi hydraulic pusher and a fixed portion of the roller conveyor. The employee's left foot was fractured. The conveyor with hydraulic pusher was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was walking down a stairway when she fell down the last two steps to the landing, breaking her tibia in three places.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs in front of the building, fell down the stairs and broke both ankles.

An employee was digging a pole hole inside a construction work zone on a city street when a motorist who had fallen asleep at the wheel drove their car into the work zone and struck the employee. The employee suffered a right leg fracture.
An employee was adjusting the lever on a bandsaw. The employee's hand contacted the saw blade, and the employee sustained a partial amputation to the right thumb tip.

An employee was loading the engine pistons and cylinder liners onto a pallet to remove from the area for housekeeping purposes. He lifted the last piston by placing his fingers into the large holes on each side of the piston. The piston did not have rings installed on it. When he sat the piston (98 pounds) on the liner it slid into the liner catching two of his fingers between the piston and the liner, amputating the tips of two fingers on his left hand.

An employee experienced severe pain, back spasms, wrist numbness, and an inability to support himself to walk after coming down from a 4-foot loading dock with a heavy leaf spring (approximately 75-100 lbs.). He was hospitalized.
An employee's left middle fingertip was caught, crushed, and amputated by a stacker/rake machine.
An employee was using an angle grinder on a bearing pack for a snow groomer. The grinder slipped and cut the employee above his glove on the forearm. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was working on the assembly line with specialized machinery and suffered from heat exhaustion.
An employee was loading a truck with plywood when his ring became caught on a rack and ripped his left ring finger. His finger was later surgically amputated.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while working on a rooftop. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while getting into his truck and injured his head.
An employee was taping liner on a combo when he tripped over the corner of a pallet and fractured his tibia.
An employee was working on an egg processing line (boil and peel machine) and amputated a fingertip after contacting the moving rollers. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was coming in out of the rain when the wind blew the door shut on his right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was in a loading dock, staging and sorting auto parts. He slipped or tripped on tailgate liners that had fallen to the concrete floor, striking his head against the floor.
An employee experienced heat-related dizziness and lightheadedness. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were lowering a jumping jack into a 2-foot trench. One employee's left hand was caught between the handle and the roller; the employee suffered a broken little finger and a broken ring finger and fingertip amputation (without bone loss).

An employee was walking next to a ramp while a forklift was bringing a 10-foot wooden crate down the ramp. The crate's door swung open; the employee was trying to close it when the forklift began moving backward. The employee's right arm was caught between the door and a metal beam, causing a substantial laceration near the elbow.
An employee was helping to unjam a trimmer machine when it amputated his left index finger.
An employee was picking up a box that had fallen off a pallet. A nearby stacked pallet of boxes became unstable and fell, breaking the employee's femur.
A metal valve attached to a flow line fell over, striking and lacerating the employee's left calf.
On June 26, 2018, an employee suffered a broken wrist after falling 5 feet from a scaffold to the floor while reaching to apply insulation in a ceiling joist.
An employee was using a press brake to form a metal part. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the part and the mold; the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a mobile ladder stand clearing a stacker transfer when she slipped and fell, striking her face on the concrete floor. She suffered a fractured cheekbone.

An employee was loading and unloading fiberglass blanks on a heated hydraulic press. One of the press's cylinders broke and the platen dropped onto the employee's right hand, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.
An employee was topping leek bunches when her harvesting knife cut a one-inch flap of skin off her left thumb.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when his foot became caught between the pallet jack and the floor, breaking his left leg.
An employee was opening a 4-inch condensate line to replace a gasket. Hot condensate steam was released from the flange, burning the employee's elbow and hand.
An employee slipped and fell down a wet staircase, suffering nerve damage.

An employee was connecting a new transformer while in a bucket truck. The pole was a three phase tangent with a single phase tap. The employee's arm contacted the bottom of the cut out fuse serving the single phase line. The line fuse blew on contact, and the employee suffered burns to the arms and back that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing a piece of lumber from the conveyor and her finger was caught in between a belt and pulley system causing an amputation injury.
Two employees collided; one fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was shoveling material to expose a temporary drainpipe. A piece of clay/rock rolled down an embankment and struck the employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was climbing a ladder to wash fourth-floor windows. The ladder slipped on a wet surface, and he fell about 8 feet to the third floor platform. He was hospitalized with a neck injury.
An employee was walking around the corner of a foundation under construction, tripped and fell into rebar, suffering a laceration to his inner right thigh.

An employee was on a ladder over an extrusion machine, handling a 1,500-pound screw that was hanging from a crane. The employee felt as if he would fall and grabbed the screw. The screw then swung and crushed his right little finger against the machine. He suffered an avulsion and broken bones and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a punch press when a piston came loose, striking the employee in the abdomen. The employee suffered a laceration/puncture injury.
An employee was placing cribbing to accommodate a load from a forklift. The load was lowered and came down onto the employee's hand, leading to a partial amputation of his right ring fingertip.

An employee was changing a die in a machine. After locking/tagging out the machine, the employee removed a pin securing the die in place. While the employee's hand was between the upper and lower dies, the upper metal die fell due to gravity and crushed the employee's hand between the two dies. The employee's hand suffered bruising.
An employee was doing a compression test on an engine when diesel fuel was injected into his hand.

On June 26, 2018, an employee was maintaining overhead ductwork and ceiling tiles. The employee fell from an 8-foot stepladder to the tile floor, suffering two broken wrists, broken ribs, brain bleeding, cracked vertebrae in the neck, and a broken shoulder.

An employee was cleaning up saw dust with compressed air when the air hose became entangled in the batten saw guide chain table, pulling it into the saw box. The employee shut down the chain table, reached for the hose inside the saw box, and contacted the saw blade, suffering  lacerations and broken bones to the right ring and middle fingers. The saw was still energized at the time of the incident.

While disconnecting a strap at the back of a flatbed truck trailer, an employee fell from the side of the truck, landing on wood mats about 5 feet below. The employee suffered a broken nose, broken ribs, broken teeth, fractured sinus cavity, fractured wrist, and facial lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing dunnage between concrete telephone poles. A pole was lowered onto another pole by crane, and the tip of the employee's right index finger was crushed.
An employee suffered smoke inhalation during a building fire and was hospitalized.

An employee was making hamburgers on the hamburger press when his left thumb got caught between the top and bottom part of the press resulting in the amputation of the tip of his left thumb without bone loss.
An employee was working on a construction site finishing concrete and was hospitalized with heat illness.
An employee fell off a metal roof sustaining leg fractures and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was operating the lift gate of a truck when his hand was caught between the lift gate, resulting in an amputation of two fingers.
An employee was walking on the crane deck when he slipped and fell into the engine compartment, breaking his left arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was replacing an underground transformer when an arc flash occurred, causing a second degree burn to his left forearm. He also fell forward, striking his head on a distribution service bar and suffering a laceration.
An employee was struck by a lock ring fracturing his lower right leg while inflating a tire.
An employee was climbing a ladder to clean gutters on a house, mis-stepped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a pulled muscle that lead to a blood clot and hospitalization.
An employee was loading sprockets in the load station when a pneumatic malfunction occurred and the employee's left thumb was pinched, resulting in a partial amputation with tuft exposure/fracture.
An employee was working on the muller putting parts on it. The employee reached up on an I-beam to move himself and when he stepped back down his knee twisted and his femur was fractured.
An employee working on a utility pole fell approximately 13 feet to the ground below, fracturing the left leg.

On June 27, 2018, at 1:30 p.m., an employee was adjusting an off-balance rotating rack so it could accommodate a different sized wire when the rack spun quickly and pinched his right index finger, severing the fingertip.

An employee was using a scraping tool (located on the mixer's door) to remove resin from the bottom of the mixer when the door of the machine closed on the employee's arm pulling his arm into the drop area. The employee was admitted to the hospital with a fractured radius and second degree burns to the arm.
An employee was operating a grinder in an aerial lift when the grinder struck a structure, bounced back, and struck the employee's face, causing a deep laceration.
An employee fell from a three-step step ladder to the floor and sustained a head laceration and broken ankle.

An employee side stepped and then tripped and fell. When he reached his arms out to brace for impact, his right arm entered a mop cart of hot asphalt and sustained burns from the top of the hand to just below the elbow.
An employee was closing a door when the knife edge of the door closed on and amputated her right pinky finger.
An employee fell off the top of a liquid tanker/trailer while washing it and sustained a head injury. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was operating an industrial band saw to cut sprues from bronze castings when the employee lost consciousness due to severe dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the flow coat furnace area and was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was leaving the break room and pushed open the right-side door. Instead of exiting through the door, he turned back into the break room to throw away thrash in a trash can located immediately to the right side of the exit door. As he leaned towards the trash can, he placed his left hand on the door frame with his little finger between the door and the door jamb. When the door closed, it pinched his left little finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation (without bone loss).
An employee was dry sweeping the floor when she slipped and fell, twisting her right ankle.
An employee was pouring gas into a gasoline-powered pump when the gas ignited and burned the employee's chest and legs.

A journeyman electrician was removing wires from a panel. The wire was tied to another cable and when he pulled the wire it pulled the other cable into a bus bar in the gear causing an arc flash and electrical burns.
An employee was assisting others in a team lift effort to put a large bumper into the back of a truck and suffered a herniated/ruptured disk requiring surgery.
An employee was walking down the corridor, tripped on the base of the fence post and fell breaking a hip.

On 6/27/2018, an employee was attempting to remove a bolt from the control arm of a disassembled train locomotive wheel assembly. After he removed the nut, the arm shifted due to its weight and came down on his right middle finger, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was pulling tape through an underground PVC electrical conduit to measure the conduit length. The tape contacted some moisture that created an arc flash when it came in contact with the energized switchgear. The employee suffered second degree burns on both arms. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating equipment that stacks used bun trays and started to have cramps. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee suffered a hernia rupture while loading bags from a conveyor onto a plane, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell while walking up steps into the office, fracturing her leg.
An employee was delivering mail when he felt unwell due to heat-related illness, requiring hospitalization.
An employee lacerated their forearm while using a boot knife to cut tape from the trim puller.
An employee was pushing open a door and caught a finger between the door and the frame at Disney's Hollywood Studios. The employee sustained a middle finger fracture and a fingertip laceration.

An employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of rubber from a guillotine cutting machine when the machine was actuated. The guillotine blade then dropped from its housing and amputated the employee's left hand at its midpoint, severing four fingers and half of the thumb.
An employee was attempting to clear a wood jam in a five-headed saw when his right hand entered the machine and contacted the blade, injuring his right thumb and resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was removing a jammed piece of glass with tongs when the glass punctured through the employee's glove and cuff. The glass lacerated the employee's wrist and became embedded in it, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was manually turning a V-belt drive and belt on an air handling unit when his hand and glove were pulled into the belt and pulley, amputating his left pinky fingertip below the first knuckle.
An employee was standing on a ladder that had been placed on a material lift and was adjusting the gear box on the material lift when he fell, fracturing a rib and puncturing a lung.

An employee was ascending a tree while carrying a pruner tool to prune around utility lines. He reached his area and hung the pruner on a limb above his position. The limb broke and the pruner fell, striking and piercing his left forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a press when a slider pulled his left hand into the press. He suffered second and third degree burns.
An employee was adjusting plates on a printing press and caught a finger in the gears resulting in a partial amputation to his left middle fingertip.

A pool technician was adding water to chlorine shock powder and sustained chemical burns to the face, arms, back, and legs when chlorine foam erupted from the container. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was placing material on the roof as part of a retro-fit project. The employee laid the material down to measure so he could cut it to the proper size. The employee then fell about 10 feet from the roof causing a broken clavicle. Fall protection was not utilized at the time.
An employee caught their leg brace on a work desk, fell to ground, and was hospitalized for a fracture leg.

An employee was getting out of a dump truck and facing the truck with three points of contact. As he stepped onto the slip-resistant tread, his foot slipped off and he fell backwards, striking his head on the step of a backhoe that was parked next to him. He suffered a head laceration and lost consciousness.
An employee was working on a conveyor on the sorting deck when the employee's hand was caught in the moving conveyor, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The conveyor was unguarded at the time.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking in a puddle of water in the parking lot, fracturing the right ankle.
An employee was helping to move a patient on a stretcher into an elevator when the employee tripped while going backwards and fell onto the right buttock, fracturing the right hip.

On June 27, 2018, at approximately 11:00 p.m., an employee was injured while winching a derailed coal car. During this procedure a piece of metal came off the car and struck the employee in the stomach and upper right arm. The employee was hospitalized for a severe laceration to the upper right arm.

Three employees were moving a tool from the wash bay to two tool stands. The rear tool stand became caught on the lip of the floor and collapsed, causing the tool to fall off the stand. One of the employees attempted to catch the tool, resulting in it falling onto and amputating his left small finger.

An employee was laying decking material for a reinforced concrete roof. The employee was not able to get decking material under a piece of bent rebar. The employee was attempting to bend the rebar up when it suddenly became free from the cinder block wall, causing the employee to lose balance at the leading edge and fall approximately 10 feet to the floor. The employee fractured the left wrist and femur.

An employee was disconnecting a breaker attachment from a backhoe. He used another pin to push the attachment pin out. When the attachment pin became free of the backhoe, the attachment dropped slightly, causing the pin in his hand to shift and pinch his left pinky finger between the attachment frame and the pin. His left pinky fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee lost balance and fell resulting in a left tibial plateau fracture.

An employee fell off the second step of a step ladder while installing a vacuum hose on a plastic injection mold machine. The employee fractured the right leg below the knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was delivering mail when a wasp flew into the vehicle and stung the employee.

On June 27, at around 12:55 p.m., an employee was operating a powered pallet jack when they became pinned between the pallet jack and a bollard, suffering fractures to the left pelvis, hip, and tailbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to assist a patient and suffered a dislocated shoulder and muscle strain to the back.
An employee was installing a machining center when the employee's right index fingertip was amputated by a ball screw on the machining center's horizontal axis.
An employee was removing a meter when a dog chased him and he broke his right ankle in two places, requiring hospitalization.

The employee was replacing an O-ring that sits on top of a hydraulic oil accumulator tank. The O-ring seals the accumulator tank and the oil manifold to the central cylinder, which had been removed for repair. The employee used a hydraulic jack to raise the oil manifold approximately 1 inch to allow for installation of the O-rings and the central cylinder. The jack slid from its position and the manifold dropped back to its normal resting position, striking and pinching the employee's right thumb. The employee sustained a fracture and open laceration to the thumb, near the knuckle joint.

An employee unloaded a beam and laid it down. While attempting to remove chains from underneath the beam, the beam slipped and crushed the employee's leg between the beam and a pipe. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the lower left leg.
An employee tripped and fell while walking, suffering a compound fracture of the left ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped and fell into a puddle of sulfuric acid resulting in a chemical burn.
An employee struck his foot with a pitchfork and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving concrete forms when a five inch concrete form fell on top of him.

An employee was producing a roll of metal building insulation on the laminating machine. While trying to fix a problem with the machine, the employee's left hand was pulled between two rollers and causing a left forearm fracture.

A delivery driver was out on route, overheated and lost consciousness. He then fell and hit his knee. He was admitted to the hospital the next day for IV fluids and observation. He also fractured his knee cap.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack and it rolled over his left foot. He then fell to the ground breaking his right proximal femur.

On 6/27/2018, at approximately 4:30 a.m., an employee was cutting a tree off a power line when a limb popped back and struck his side. He suffered fractured ribs and a chest contusion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an amputation to the right ring finger while working with a crane. The employee was injured by an engine turbo charger fan.
A furnace operator was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was grinding a part when the grinding wheel caught the tip of his glove, pulling his finger into the grinder and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Employees 1 and 2 were using a winch to load equipment onto a trailer. As employee 2 went to loosen the winch, employee 1's hand went between the equipment and the winch strap. Employee 2 accidentally tightened the winch instead of loosening it, trapping employee 1's left hand and resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

A student wildland firefighter was being trained on a prescribed burn and was hiking up a 2.5 mile incline when he began to have a rapid heart rate and difficulty breathing. The student was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting the conveyor and severed the distal tip of his right index finger when his right hand contacted the chain and gear.
An employee was installing satellite TV at a private residence and passed out due to heat illness.

An employee was troubleshooting the raw bacon packaging machine. The employee's left hand was in the machine when it cycled resulting in amputation of the left index finger to the first knuckle and amputation of the left middle finger to the middle of the finger nail.
An employee was walking in the basement of the building and fell over, breaking seven ribs and her wrist.

An employee was diagnosing an electrical issue on a skid steer when the unit knocked the employee to the ground and rolled up onto his leg. The employee sustained a dislocated left ankle, fracture left knee, and muscle damage to the left side of his body.

An employee was driving a trap rake vehicle to a golf course bunker to rake. The employee's glasses became foggy/wet due to inclement weather. As the employee attempted to clean his glasses, the vehicle overturned into a ditch/embankment and landed on the employee. The employee sustained a mild concussion, ruptured appendix, and a laceration to the left side of the head.
An employee was working on an elevated screw conveyor to repair a leak when his left hand slipped and his left index finger slid into the conveyor amputating it at the first knuckle.

An employee was walking on a grassy area at the facility when they stepped in a low spot concealed by the freshly mowed grass. The employee twisted their left ankle and fell on their right foot, sustaining fractures to both ankles.

An employee was installing a line to a camera outside a residential home. The employee tripped while working from an A-frame ladder in the closed position and sustained a small fracture to his left ankle.
An employee was on a bakers scaffold when it tipped over and the worker fell six feet. The employee sustained a broken wrist and a dislocated hip.

The employee was sitting at the machine lowering the bowl on a spindle while welding areas of the mixer bowl. The lip of the mixer bowl became trapped on top of his knee, pushing his foot (which was operating a speed pedal) downward and trapping his lower leg. The employee required assistance to remove him from the machine. The employee sustained a right knee sprain.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a rip saw when a piece of wood impaled the worker's arm.
An employee was delivering parcels and suffered dehydration related to the heat.

An employee was checking an order being pulled for shipping when a stack of finished product toppled over onto him and knocked him to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
An employee finished unloading building supplies on the roof and was descending the ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and broke bones in the left leg.
An employee was walking into the store, tripped over the front step and fell resulting in possible fractures.
An employee was performing routine maintenance on the proctor machine (compacts soil into a steel mold). The employee's left index finger was caught in the hammer resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting wood with a saw. The saw kicked back and caught his glove and amputated his left pinky finger.
An employee delivered the mail and while descending the steps, misstepped, and fell injuring the left ankle.

An employee was repairing an axle on a mobile home that was set on blocks. During repair, the home shifted and fell off the blocks onto the injured employee who was sitting underneath. The employee's upper body was pushed over onto the lower body causing a fractured back.

Two employees were moving soil in a large dump truck. The lid on the dump truck was stuck; while one of the employees was removing dirt to free it up, the lid came down on his hand. His right middle finger was amputated to the first joint.
An employee was altering a costume. While cutting fabric with scissors, the employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

A forklift was transporting two stacked intermediate bulk containers (IBC) which are plastic containers in a metal cage. The IBC containers fell off the forklift and struck the injured employee in the face causing a fracture to the left cheek and nose.
An employee was on the loading dock and was struck by a reach truck causing pelvic and tibia fractures.
An employee was helping a patient walk at the patient's residence. The patient started to fall and the therapist got her arm caught and broken between the patient and a wheelchair.

An employee was walking and while turning a corner, the employee's pant leg got caught on a corner of a shelf. The employee then tripped over a tote and fell to the ground onto their right hip. The employee suffered a hip fracture and contusion.
On June 29, 2018, an employee was descending a three to four-foot ladder after replacing a light bulb and fell off the ladder. He suffered a broken hip and cuts on his elbow from the broken glass.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and got their foot caught between the jack and a rack guard resulting in multiple toe amputations.

An employee was providing care to a patient aboard a fixed wing aircraft in transport to the hospital. The aircraft encountered clear air turbulence and the employee struck the cabin ceiling causing brain and spine contusions.
An employee was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.

An employee was working with a demolition crew on a bridge deck set up below an overpass. While working from a horizontal shield, the employee fell approximately five feet through an opening in the shield and onto the bed of a company dump truck that was parked directly below, suffering a bruised hip.
On June 29, 2018, an employee fell into a trench containing hot fluids (150 degrees F) and sustained second degree burns to the legs requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a press when the V-block cracked and shot out breaking the employee's finger.
An employee was disassembling a switch on the extruder machine when an arc flash occurred and burned the employee's face and body.

An employee was standing on the lift gate of the delivery truck directing the driver to back up.  He fell off of the lift and was caught between the truck and a moving vehicle. The employee sustained rib and spleen injuries.
An employee was hospitalized over the weekend due to heat-related symptoms.
An employee was hospitalized for illness due to dehydration.
An employee exited her vehicle to make a delivery, tripped over the curb and fell to the ground resulting in a broken arm. She was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was carrying an extension receptacle outlet (240 V) up a flight of process equipment stairs. The receptacle contacted the stair handrail at which time the employee experienced an electrical shock for an extended period of time.
On June 29, 2018, an employee was attempting to clear plastic from a granulator when his left middle finger contacted the grinder blade amputating the fingertip.
A temporary employee tripped over an empty, wheeled dolly and fell to the floor.  The employee was admitted to the hospital for a broken wrist or elbow.
An employee was operating a ladder machine and suffered the partial amputation of the right pinky finger.

An employee was inspecting pipe. The employee walked through a rack opening and was struck by a 4.5 inch pipe in the abdomen while the pipe was being passed through the rack. The employee suffered lacerations to the liver and bowels.
An employee was operating the descrambler machine. His left pinky finger was partially amputated when his glove was pulled into the machine belt.
An employee was walking down the hallway, slipped and fell breaking her left arm.

An employee was cutting the coke or removing the coke from the drum to the loading area. Steam was released during the coke cutting process and the employee suffered burns to the neck/jawline and hand/wrist areas.

An employee was installing a roof on a metal building and cut his hand on one of the screws protruding through a metal sheet.  It caused a laceration that tore a ligament between the thumb and index finger in his left hand.

During the start of shift operations, the injured employee was guiding rubber along the bottom of the machine when his thumb contacted the mill knife door located under the roller area. The thumb was fractured.

An employee was moving a piece of 12-inch PVC pipe with a crane hoist. The hoist's slide rail broke, dropping the pipe. The pipe fell onto the employee's left hand, pinching his left ring and middle fingers against a steel rail. Both fingers were broken and severed; the middle fingertip was removed at the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a circular saw. The saw kicked back on the employee while trying to cut through a knot in a piece of 2 x 6. The employee's left ring finger was broken and the middle finger was cut.
An employee was operating a press brake and amputated two fingertips.
An employee fell three feet from a loading dock and struck his head on the steel floor. The employee sustained a head injury.
While dumping a bag of chemical onto the screw conveyor, an employee caught their finger in the conveyor and amputated the right index fingertip at the base of the nail.

An employee was working on an aircraft carrier in drydock. While climbing across from one tower of free standing staging to another, he fell, landing on the dock floor about 30 feet below. He was hospitalized, having suffered two compound fractures in his left arm that required surgery, bruised kidneys/spleen, and a broken left wrist.
An employee sustained an electric shock while pulling electrical cable through conduit on the roof and was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling soil samples and running a geotechnical soil sample rig. The employee was lowering a section of the soil sampling rod into the previously advanced bore hole when their right hand was caught and crushed in the rod clamp. His right hand was fractured and sustained lacerations on both the dorsal and palmer side. His right index finger had a significant laceration which subsequently resulted in a portion of his finger, below the metacarpophalangeal joint (MCP), being surgically amputated the following day.
An employee was operating the slitter machine and got their right hand caught in the machine's rollers causing a laceration to the palm.
A warehouse employee was struck by a powered industrial truck (PIT) causing leg(s) fracture(s).
An employee was notching a 2x4 on a table saw and sustained a distal amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was bitten on the hand by a maned wolf resulting in a deep puncture wound and laceration.
An employee was on a portable ladder, hanging chairs on a display, when they fell about 6 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered six broken ribs and a broken pelvis.

On June 30, 2018, while attempting to pick up a tote and move it to a table, an employee stepped on a wheeled cart and fell into a split position, suffering a complete detachment of muscle from the right sit bone.

An employee was using a man-up forklift to look at the stuck forks of another forklift, about 15 feet off the ground. The employee's hand touched the stuck forklift's mast, and the slack of the chain dislodged. The chain amputated three of his fingers just below the knuckle.
An employee fell off a truck, breaking his hand.
An employee fell from the lowered standing platform of a powered industrial truck onto the concrete floor about 8 inches below, breaking his hip.

At about 1:45 a.m. on June 30, 2018, an employee (who had been loading packages into a trailer in extreme heat) was found slumped over. The employee was taken to the hospital and diagnosed with heat stress illness.
An employee turned to hand product to a customer when she tripped and fell on the floor, suffering a broken left hip. She was hospitalized.

Two employees were tripping pipe on the rig floor. One employee slipped, and his right index fingertip was caught between the matting and the pin end of the pipe. He was hospitalized; the tip of his right index finger was amputated.
On June 30, 2018, an employee was delivering mail when he started to cramp and feel dehydrated. He went home after completing his route, but was then hospitalized for heat stress and dehydration.
Employee was cleaning an overhead conveyor while standing on a ladder. The conveyor activated, causing her glove to be pulled into the rollers and fracturing her left forearm. She was hospitalized.

An employee was in a forklift basket, retrieving material from an upper shelf. Another forklift came around the corner and struck the basket, causing it to rotate. The employee suffered broken ribs and vertebrae.
A U.S. Customs and Border Patrol employee was conducting area orientation activities in his station's area of responsibility when a rattlesnake bit his lower right leg.
An employee was helping load pallets onto an aircraft. He tripped and a pallet of freight ran over his right ankle, breaking it.

At 6:45 a.m. on June 30, 2018, two employees were rebuilding a truck's transmission. They started the truck after replacing the bearings. The back shaft caught one employee's hair, pulling his scalp away from his head and partially amputating one of his ears. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a delivery truck. While attempting to unjam the dock door, he fell from a stack of pallets, landing about 10 feet below and suffering a broken leg.
An employee was hospitalized after suffering a heart attack while installing a concrete pad on June 30, 2018.

At about 11:20 a.m. on June 30, 2018, an employee was operating a paving machine when a 7,200-volt uninsulated power line arced to a tandem truck, which then arced to the paving machine. The employee was shocked while touching the operator toggle. He was hospitalized, having suffered electrical burns to his left hand and an exit burn on his right foot.
An I-beam support fell from the top of a scale, striking an employee and fracturing bones in the employee's left leg.
An employee was bitten by a snake while refueling a propane-powered forklift outdoors.
An employee was in a company vehicle on the side of the road when another vehicle struck the employee's vehicle. The employee sustained a bruised spine.
An employee was pressure washing the sidewalk, tripped over the hose, and fell. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bagging potatoes. As the employee adjusted packaging, part of the machine engaged and amputated the tip of the employee's finger.

An employee was cleaning around an industrial screen machine during production operations when the employee attempted to remove a piece of debris from inside the glue trough. The trough then engaged and came down on the employee's hand, causing the skin to be pulled back. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was working with a team to seal gaps in a furnace. The employee was overcome by the heat and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning condensation off a roller on a coating machine when a nip point (between that roller and another) caught the employee's fingers. The employee suffered an amputation of the right index fingertip and crushing injuries to the middle and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a wet metal ramp while loading a car onto a car carrier when the employee slipped and fell, hitting the concrete and breaking the left leg.
At 9:00 p.m., an employee was working in the skinning line on a killing floor when a knife he was using cut his left ankle.

An employee was reapplying thread seal tape on the surface of a conveyor belt's metal transfer plate when the employee's right middle finger and right index finger became pinched between the conveyor belt and the metal transfer plate. The employee suffered a fracture/partial amputation to the right index finger (distal to joint) and right middle finger (distal to joint).

An employee was performing maintenance on the multi-port valve in a process line. While he was rebuilding the valve (the valve was out of the valve body), the solenoid was activated. The airline blew off the valve and the valve closed on his left pinky finger, amputating it.
An employee was struck in the chest by a cow.
An employee was emptying a hopper into a dumpster using a forklift. The hopper rolled backwards after being emptied and crushed the employee's fingers resulting in amputation of three fingers.
An employee was tightening lugs on a pipe coupling when the line became pressurized, causing the coupling to blow off the pipe and strike the employee's leg, fracturing it.

An employee was part of a team of four that was moving a large catalyst cartridge using a permanent hoist. The employee was aligning flanges on the bottom of the equipment as it was lowered into place using the hoist. The cartridge was lowered onto the support ring in the cartridge housing while the employee was gripping the support ring with both hands. The employee's fingers were crushed between the cartridge and its housing, causing fracture/amputation injuries to eight fingers.
An employee tripped on a mat and fell to the floor, requiring hospitalization for a fractured hip.

An employee was on a scaffold stripping paint from the exterior of a commercial building when he lost his balance and fell backwards to the ground, suffering several broken ribs on his right side, a bruised lung, and a concussion.
An employee working outside applying grout began showing signs of physical distress including sharp pain in the right back, shoulder and arm areas. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack.
While stepping out of an electric car, an employee's right foot was caught between the accelerator pedal and the side of the car's frame, causing him to fall and twist/fracture his right ankle.
An employee was cleaning a sewer line with a hydro-jet. While he was pulling the hose, it came too far out of the manhole and the nozzle struck the employee's face, lacerating it.
An employee was connecting gauges to check the freon in an HVAC unit when he was shocked by 208 volts at 30 amps and received a burn on his left arm.
An employee fell and fractured his ankle while descending an unstable ladder that moved during a roof inspection.
An employee was gathering boxes with a pharmacist in the warehouse. She stepped backwards, tripped, and fell over the corner of a pallet fracturing her left wrist.

An employee was sitting on an 8-foot scaffold, preparing to descend to the ground below, when a plank shifted. He fell to the ground, suffering a fracture and dislocation of the left wrist, a broken nose, and contusions. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing exterior drywall while working in a boom lift. The employee suffered six fractured ribs when caught between the boom lift basket and a structural I-beam. The employee was hospitalized.
An AT&T employee was at work and started having symptoms of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a walkie pallet jack to pick up a load when she turned the pallet jack sharply. The pallet jack then increased speed and threw her into a support beam. She was pinned between the pallet jack and the beam, and as she attempted to get un-stuck, she accidentally hit the accelerator, causing the pallet jack to strike her again. She suffered a laceration to the right leg, pelvic fracture, and fracture to the L5 vertebra.

An employee was attempting to remove a bird that was in a neck skinner machine's 6-inch-diameter drain. He had inserted his arm about 14 inches when his hand contacted the machine's enclosed rollers, resulting in the partial amputation of his left ring and pinky fingers.
An employee experienced leg cramps and dehydration while delivering mail, requiring hospitalization for heat-related illness.
An employee was carrying buckets of hot tar to perform roofing activities when he tripped and lost his balance. The hot tar contacted his body, causing third degree burns to both of his hands.
An employee was removing supports under an auger when the auger fell and struck the employee's head. The employee suffered bleeding and swelling of the brain.
An employee was on a ladder when he was shocked by a live electrical component. He fell from the ladder, suffering an electrical burn and an open wound on the right thumb.
An employee fell on top of another employee as he was setting a form wall. The employee on the ground suffered a broken hip and shattered ankle.
An employee was clearing buildup on a table saw when the saw blade amputated part of his finger. A push stick was not in use at the time.
An employee was struck by a customer's car while walking across the parking lot, suffering lower back, stomach, and head pain that required hospitalization.

An employee was opening a gate and trying to put his vehicle in park when the vehicle started to roll. He tried to stop it and his left foot was caught under the tire. The vehicle then rolled over his left leg and pelvis, crushing and bruising them.

On July 2, 2018, at 10:00 a.m., an employee was running the beginnings of a new job on a forging hammer when his right hand went between the top and bottom die as the foot pedal was pressed, amputating four fingers.
An employee was installing a wood pole while performing electrical work when he experienced cramping. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was clearing gypsum from a pump trailer machine's hopper while standing on the machine's auger. The machine started unexpectedly and twisted his right foot into the opening below the auger. His first toe was badly damaged, the second was partially cut off, and the third was lacerated. The machine was off but had been switched to an automatic setting at the time of the incident.

An employee was working with a veteran in her cubicle when a patient's motorized scooter struck and injured her right knee. She sought medical attention at the facility where she was working, and was later admitted to a hospital.

An employee was getting out of a 15-passenger van to go inside the office and retrieve keys to move a car to another location. He went out the back door of the van and exited backwards, mis-stepped, lost his balance, and fell backwards through the plate glass front of the building. He suffered deep wounds to his right leg and left arm (with arterial damage) and many smaller cuts on his arms, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was on the fifth step of an 8-foot ladder when he turned/twisted to his left to grab a pipe to make a connection. The ladder also turned/twisted, and the employee fell, striking and lacerating his head on the floor.

An employee was webbing paper into a press when the press's blanket cylinders caught the employee's left hand. The employee suffered damage to the middle and ring fingers, resulting in surgical amputation of the middle finger to the first joint.

An employee was standing in the inbound operation area checking products coming in when a forklift hit the employee's left foot. The employee's leg was amputated below the knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was installing screws and clips in insulation before placing roofing sheets when the employee slipped and fell approximately 45 feet to a lower level, requiring hospitalization for multiple broken bones.

An employee was brushing off excess meat from a grinder when the spiral knife blade amputated her right pointer finger above the first knuckle. The grinder was in operation at the time of the incident.
While closing the gate to a lawn and garden area, an employee suffered a pinched finger, causing an amputation to the tip of the finger.
An employee was dusting within an office when she experienced chest pains and shortness of breath possibly due to heat. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 28-foot extension ladder, trying to reach a clogged gutter drain with an auger and gardening spade. While he had one foot on the gutter and one on the ladder, the ladder shifted and he fell to the ground. He suffered three fractured vertebrae, two compressed vertebrae, bruises to his arms, and a bruise to the back of his head.
An employee was removing an RTD sensor with a wrench when a release of hot, caustic water caused second-degree burns to the employee's chest, left arm, and hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just used a baler to create a bale of cardboard when another employee approached with an electric pallet jack. The operator of the pallet jack then pinned the employee between the baler door and the finished bale of cardboard. The employee suffered a cracked pelvic bone.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when his right leg was caught between the pallet jack and a guardrail, suffering a compound fracture.
A construction worker assisting with street construction in a new residential community began experiencing symptoms of heat related illness and was hospitalized for heat stroke.

An employee received an electric shock from 480-volt electrical current while trying to place an overhead hoist back on its track. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the left index finger, left thumb, left wrist, and chest.

After spending about 20 minutes in an attic, inspecting for wood-damaging organisms, an employee was found unconscious by an open door. The day was hot, and the employee had suffered a heat-related injury.

An employee was pulling a car into a bucket wash bay to wash and vacuum it for rental. The car began to roll backward, and the employee's hand was caught in the door. He suffered an amputation of the middle and index fingers of his left hand.

An employee went over to where two other employees were working on a pump to see if the belt was aligned. The motor turns on and off via a float. When the motor turned off, the employee attempted to check the drive belt s tension. The motor then kicked on, and his hand was caught between the belt and the pulley, amputating two fingers.
Two employees were shutting down equipment to move a condenser's breaker box from one building to another when an arc flash occurred, burning their left and right arms.
The employee was walking a regular postal delivery route and started feeling cramps. The employee suffered possible heat stress/stroke.
A 5-gallon waste can overpressurized while an employee was pouring a waste liquid into it. The can exploded, injuring the employee's hand, abdomen, and chin.
An employee tripped and fell over a cart, rupturing the left quadricep and requiring hospitalization.
While inspecting a piece of glass, an employee suffered an arm laceration from the glass that required stitches.
An employee was cleaning out a greenhouse with a blower when the employee became dehydrated and suffered heat stress. The temperature was in the upper 90s at the time.
An employee was coming down a 6-foot step ladder when he slipped on a rung and fell backwards approximately 3 feet to the concrete floor. He landed on his lower back and fractured his tailbone.
An employee was operating an excavator. The excavator was running hot and the employee was burned while removing the radiator cap.
An employee dropped a piece of equipment onto their left foot breaking bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered from heat exhaustion while on his delivery route.
An employee was operating a mold press and amputated their thumb above the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a forklift when a tire outside the forklift caught their left leg. The employee's leg was broken.
An employee was descending exterior building stairs when she slipped and fell, striking her right knee on the stairs and ground. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a cash register when they tripped over a power strip. The employee fell, suffering fractures to the right shoulder, right knee, and a rib on the left side.
On July 3, 2018, a welder began to feel sick and went home. He was hospitalized the following morning to treat a heat-related illness that affected kidney function.
An employee was repairing a sensor on a robotic trimmer's automatic curtain door when the door cycled, amputating the employee's index finger.
An employee was measuring a pipe from the ground to a panel box when an electrical arc flash caused burns to the employee's left hand, neck, ear, and possibly face.

An employee was helping a punch press operator punch holes in a sheet of aluminum that was approximately 72" x 80". The employee and the punch press operator attempted to flip the sheet in order to punch the other side when the sheet slipped. The employee attempted to catch the sheet and received a laceration to his left wrist, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee hand-fed parts into the mechanical power press. His arm was resting on the bolster plate when his right hand and fingers went underneath the light curtain at the front of the press. While either loading or unloading a part from the die, the press activated and the die then closed on his right index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation down to the distal interphalangeal joint.
A roofing employee was working at a jobsite and suffered from heat related illness. He was hospitalized.
An employee's hand was caught in a machine's chain and sprocket, amputating two fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was repairing a truck clutch when the clutch flywheel crushed the employee's left pinky and ring fingers.
A forklift ran over an employee's left foot as it backed up.
An employee fell to the concrete ground while coming down an extension ladder, suffering hip, pelvic, rib, and wrist fractures.

While stripping a container, an employee signaled to boom down and the forklift extension became caught on bracing material. When he went to retrieve the strap, the forklift extension slipped off the bracing material, having a spring effect that crushed his left hand.
While an employee was collapsing a folding table, the metal hinge trapped his right little finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was walking down the stairway and tripped. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee's right little finger was partially amputated while the employee was unjamming a radish de-tailer in a packing house.

An employee was attaching an extension chute onto his fold down chute on a concrete truck when his hand entered an area where the metal chutes came together. The chutes then pinched off his right index fingertip.
An employee was welding a 25-foot steel A-frame. As the employee lifted the A-frame, a chain about 10 feet high came loose and the A-frame pinned them, causing a possible fracture to the left femur.
An employee was using a ladder to access a mezzanine storage space. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a skid loader to dump gravel into a pit. The skid loader was overloaded and tipped into the pit. The cab broke loose and pinned the employee's legs, causing multiple injuries.

An employee was working from a ladder to tie electrical into a junction box on a new construction commercial building. When the employee opened the junction box, a wire fell and contacted his hand, causing a shock. He then fell off the ladder and contacted the ground, fracturing his skull and ribs.
An employee was cleaning ceiling tiles from an A-frame ladder when he fell to the ground.

An employee was driving a delivery van when a tire blew. The employee lost control of the van, which struck a utility pole. Later that day, it was discovered that the employee was suffering from a brain hemorrhage that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was manipulating a steel plate into a roller machine. During the rigging of the plate, the overhead crane hoist/crane hooks disengaged. The plate fell, crushing the employee's pelvis. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
A surgical resident was preparing to begin a surgery when he fainted and hit his head on the operating table and then the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left temporal bone.

An employee was standing between a sheet stacker and a conveyor. The employee hit the switch for the stacker to drop a sheet, which caused the suction head to retract. This resulted in the employee becoming pinned between the suction head and the conveyor chassis. The employee suffered fractured ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clear a piece of wood that was jammed on a conveyor belt when his left hand was pulled into the moving belt, resulting in a partial ring finger amputation.
On July 2, 2018, an employee was disposing of chemicals. A floor cleaning chemical spilled onto his right foot, causing a third degree burn requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered severe dehydration while delivering mail in the heat.
An employee was on the side of a refuse truck, picking up residential garbage. A tire blew and he fell off, hitting his head on the pavement.
An employee was walking to the kitchen area when she slipped and fell, striking and bruising her head on a vending machine and then falling on her left arm and breaking it in multiple places.
An employee slipped and landed on the right ankle while cleaning the tops of vertical trampolines, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had been working for 5 hours and was packing plastic bags into a case of finished product. The employee began cramping and feeling nauseated, possibly due to heat-related dehydration.
An employee's forklift struck the side of another forklift. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was driving his motorcycle to lock up the propane tank area after clocking out for the day. He had an accident with the bike and suffered an severe laceration on the right leg.

Two employees were removing a valve from a 4-inch hydrogen line in a sulfur unit. One employee was loosening the bottom bolts of the flange. As the flange was opened, hydrogen escaped and caused a flash fire that burned the two employees. The employees suffered second degree burns on the ears, right wrist, right arm, back of the neck, and the back. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a 30-pound case of frozen dough when the employee became sore due to a previous hernia, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working in the flooring area of a machine while an employee working above was attempting to disconnect a 2-inch hose for sanitation purposes. The hose slipped from the employee's hand, striking the employee in the flooring area in the head and causing a contusion.
As an employee stood up from her desk to let 911 responders into the building, a telephone cord caught her foot. She tripped and fell, fracturing her hip and pelvis.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle on a pathway toward a bridge when the front right side wheel struck a fenced area, causing the steering wheel to strike and fracture the employee's hand and arm.
An employee was setting up a machine when her left index finger went through two rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working with a patient in the emergency room when she experienced respiratory problems due to cleaning chemicals from the adjacent area. She was hospitalized.
An employee's foot was run over by a forklift. Her foot broke in multiple places, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
At 11:00 a.m. on July 4, 2018, an employee was working in a tree, about 30 feet above the ground when his safety harness failed and he fell resulting in a head injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized with blunt force trauma to the back of the head.
An employee felt overheated and went to the office to cool down. While sitting, the employee fell over and hit their head.

An employee was observing an oil leak on an injection molding machine. The employee climbed a ladder to get a better look. The employee's right hand then contacted the machine's platen, resulting in the amputation of the pinky, ring, and middle fingertips.
An employee was lighting a furnace for operation when a malfunction caused the flames to shoot out of the furnace, burning the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized for facial burns.
An employee was retrieving paperwork that was next to a printing machine. As she leaned down, her left hand contacted a roll of laminate. Her arm was wrapped around the roll and broken.

An employee was tasked with cutting a bale that had a combination of plastic and cardboard. He was using a pair of shears to cut the wire banding when the bale collapsed onto his left leg, breaking his femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing with his hand on the end of a piece of 4x4 wood that was under a flatbed trailer. A forklift placed a load of steel on the trailer, and the weight of the load pushed down on the trailer bed. The employee's hand was crushed between the piece of wood and the trailer.

On July 5, 2018, three employees were using a fork truck while rigging a machine. The bay doors were closed to keep the air-conditioned air in the shop. Exhaust from the fork truck built up in the work area; an employee suffered carbon monoxide poisoning and was hospitalized.
An employee received a possible electrical shock while trimming a palm tree.
An employee was using a saw when the blade struck and partially amputated his right thumb.
An employee was stocking in the storage room when she tripped over a tote and fell, breaking her left hip.
An employee was installing a wood floor. While ripping a piece of wood on a table saw the employee's fingers contacted the saw blade causing amputation injuries to two fingers.
An employee was lining up a rig auger and kelly when the equipment shifted and made contact with his right index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was loading an aircraft with a unit load device. The wheel of the container rolled over his foot, breaking it.
An employee was inspecting roof trusses when he fell through an elevator shaft from the second floor to the first floor. He suffered a head laceration, a dislocated shoulder, and a broken elbow.
An employee was installing sheet metal on a curtain rail using a forklift when the employee fell 15 feet, suffering trauma.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor in a break room, suffering a fractured right hip.
An employee was loading a machine when he touched a part on the machine and received an electrical shock on his right hand from a 220-volt circuit. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to adjust a conveyor belt when the sprocket caught her glove. Her left arm was pulled into the machine, and she suffered a compound fracture.

An employee was sitting as a passenger in a utility vehicle, which was traveling on a boardwalk at an amusement park. He was coiling rope in his hands; the rope became entangled under the vehicle's tire and removed the tip of his left index finger.
An employee used two 3,500-pound nylon slings to lift a heavy slide blade (about 1,000 pounds) on a forklift when the blade slid onto his right foot, fracturing all of his toes. He was hospitalized.
On July 5, 2018, an employee was guiding a gear into a gearbox. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the gear and the gearbox, resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was troubleshooting a fan for an oxidizer when his finger was caught between the fan belt and the pulley wheel while manually pulling the belt, resulting in an amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee was checking a rapper on a recovery boiler precipitator when the rapper rod (weighing approximately 10-15 lbs.) fell from inside the rapper coil assembly and struck the employee on the left middle finger. The employee received a cut/laceration, resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle fingertip with no bone loss.
An employee in the shipping department slid across a conveyor and his glove was caught in the sprocket amputating his left index fingertip.

An employee was changing a cylinder on the steering column of a motor grader while standing on the raised blade. He hit the lever rod that controls the blade with his hands or arm, causing the blade to rotate and pinch his left leg between the grader and the step. His left leg broke.

An employee was testing a 240V to 480V transformer when he received an electrical shock, causing him to fall to the ground. His back and head struck a concrete step, and he suffered cuts, bruises, electrical burns to his fingertips, and a possible concussion.

An employee was using one hand to operate a hoist that held a wire-containing bobbin and one hand to guide the bobbin into the slot of a strander machine when the hoist started to lower faster than anticipated. The employee's left index fingertip was then pinched between the bobbin and strander machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping a skid steer operator. The skid steer struck the employee, who suffered a broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to re-start a production line. He was troubleshooting and climbing up and down a ladder to reach the internal bake oven. The employee became overheated and suffered a heat stroke.
An employee was trying to move 8 sheets of sheetrock when a sheet fell on the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg/kneecap.
An employee was operating a machine and fainted possibly due to heat resulting in a concussion.
An employee was removing a transmission line from a bucket truck. The line sagged, contacting a live wire below, and the employee suffered an electrical shock and burn.
An employee was offloading a truck when he turned and tripped over a box on the floor. He fell and fractured his hip and shoulder.

An employee was on a scissor lift, installing a disconnect to an energized engine bus stop. The disconnect made contact with two phases, causing a short and an arc flash. The employee suffered burns to the skin on the neck, stomach, and left arm and hand.
An employee was in a warehouse, operating a powered industrial truck, when his left leg was caught between the truck and a support beam. The leg was amputated from the calf down.

An employee was running conduit below conveyor belts when he went onto a platform and fell approximately 10 feet, breaking his left wrist, five to six right-side ribs, and his right-side pelvis. He was hospitalized. The platform did not have guardrails at the time of the incident.

An employee was checking the entry gauge function on a machine. The machine's lid closed, coming down on the employee's right hand. His right little fingertip was severely injured and had to be surgically removed.
A smokejumper was injured while landing during a parachute jump.
An employee fell off a dirt bike while taking it to the track, suffering three broken ribs, a punctured lung, internal bleeding, and a broken scapula.

A Lone Star Wolf Service employee was testing tubing going into a well when he began helping an operator who was lowering testing bars and pressuring them up for testing. After a couple of repetition runs of inserting the testing gun into the testing bar eye and hydrotesting the tube, the operator lowered the bars a bit more to have a complete seal. At the time, the injured employee's  hand was on the testing gun handles, and his right index finger was pinched between the wiper cup and the testing pan. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by lightning while walking to his vehicle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's right arm was crushed by a tree stub that fell back on the stump as the employee was pushing it. The employee's right arm was amputated.
An employee's right index fingertip was caught and amputated in a hose reel assembly on a new construction truck.

A forklift driver was scraping some foreign material from the slide plate of his forklift when the fork was moved back into the neutral position, causing the driver's right middle finger to be caught between the mast and the slide plate. This resulted in the amputation of his right middle finger from the nail up.
An employee opened a door, and his right hand jammed on it. The index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing the fixed ladder of an open top dumpster when he fell backwards and struck his head on the concrete ground, suffering a concussion and broken tailbone.
An employee was helping move a trauma patient to a gurney. The patient began to wake up and kicked the employee, who suffered a spleen laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning beneath a moving conveyor when the tip of his left glove was caught in a chain and sprocket. His middle, ring, and little fingertips were pulled into the chain and sprocket and amputated.

An employee was painting a 35-foot trailer from beneath. The trailer had been lifted on two forklifts, one at the front and one at the back. The tilt cylinder on one of the forklifts had a slow leak and tilted forward, causing the trailer to slide off the forks. The trailer struck the employee across the shoulder and upper back, knocking him to the ground. He suffered fractured vertebrae and three broken ribs.
