An employee was using an electric pallet jack to haul freight at the end of an aisle when his left foot slid off the jack as it was turning and was crushed/fractured between the jack and a corner beam.
An employee was working on a boat fuel tank in an outbuilding when the fuel tank ignited and the building caught fire. The employee escaped the building but suffered second degree burns.

An employee used a 6-foot step ladder to pull a box of sanitizers from a shelf that was approximately 8 feet above the floor. He worked from the 3rd step of the step ladder to place a box on the shelf. He fell from the ladder, hitting his head on equipment and the floor. He suffered contusions, cuts, and lacerations to his forehead and other areas of his head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in a scissor lift installing metal trusses on a building when he fell approximately 15 feet from the lift, breaking multiple bones.
An employee was out on a job and felt sick. He passed out on the ride home. The employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion/heat stroke.
An employee was moving a packaging uncoiler to the cutter/sealer when her hand entered the cutter/sealer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On July 6, 2018, a temporary employee was scanning skids for order picking. A stand-up picker turned, and its load of double-stacked product pallets fell off its forks. A pallet fell onto the employee's lower left leg and fractured a bone.
An employee shut down a mixer and was reaching inside when the mixer amputated his left ring finger. The mixer had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from an extension ladder while climbing it. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee drove a forklift over a dock board into a trailer and felt back pain.
Two employees were lifting a valve into place. It slipped and one employee's finger was pinched, leading to a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was cleaning a probe on a hot condensate line. The employee was sprayed with hot steam and liquid, suffering second- and third-degree burns to 30 percent of the body.
An employee was accessing the second floor with a ladder when he lost his grip and fell off the ladder more than 10 ft., landing on his feet and suffering a compound fracture to his ankle.
While plugging a computer into a wall outlet, an employee was shocked. She suffered lasting tremors and right-side weakness.

On 7/6/2018, an employee was operating a vertical mixer and was using a rag to press against the rotating shaft. The rotating shaft then caught the rag and pulled the employee's right hand into the mixer, resulting in a pinky finger amputation as well as a fracture and abrasions to the right wrist. The mixer was guarded at the time.

An employee operating a stand-up motorized pallet jack order selector was passing another operator when his right leg became caught between a pallet in the aisleway and the order selector. He fractured his right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to direct a traveling block off the ground. As the block was being raised, his left foot was caught between it and a well head, and was lacerated and broken.
An employee was on a ladder placing items in the rafter of a ceiling when the ladder slipped out and he fell to the floor.
On July 6, 2018, an employee was stepping off of a sprayer that was being refueled when the employee stumbled and rolled an ankle. The employee's ankle fractured and required hospitalization.

An employee was working from a Baker scaffold, cutting a steel ceiling joist. Part of the joist fell, striking the scaffold; the employee lost his balance and fell 4 feet to the floor, breaking his right ankle.
On July 6, 2018, an employee was pushing a piece of lumber on a rail end shaper. The shaper partially amputated his left index finger, just below the nail.
Two employees were exposed to chemical vapors being emitted from a chemical tote, suffering eye, mucous membrane, and lung irritation. They were hospitalized.
An employee's foot slipped off of the second step of a loader as he began to climb into the cab. He fell to the ground and fractured his left hip, requiring hospitalization.
A temporary employee was trying to remove a piece of rebar that was stuck in a machine when the employee's right pinky and ring fingers were smashed between the rebar and the machine.
A driver was loading a logging truck when a post on the truck broke. A log was dislodged and rolled off the truck, striking the driver. The driver suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was running telephone wire in a residential attic when he blacked out for a moment and became unwell due to heat stress, requiring hospitalization.
While clearing materials from a banding machine, an employee suffered an amputation injury to the right index finger. The machine did not have a guard at the time.
An employee was lifting a quartz slab using a clamp attached to an overhead crane when the slab came off the clamp and fractured the employee's right hand.
An employee fell through drywall in an attic, landing on a lower level 11 feet below. He suffered a fractured tailbone.
An employee was buffing a shaft while operating a lathe when a piece of the employee's clothing was caught by the lathe, resulting in a broken right forearm.
A home health care worker was at a restaurant with a patient when she slipped on a wet floor. She suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was walking through the warehouse when he was struck by a forklift (clamp truck), knocking him to the floor, breaking his foot, and crushing his heel.
On July 6, 2018, an employee was installing pipe in an excavation four feet deep. The walls collapsed and the employee was struck by falling rock and dirt, suffering a compression of the L2 vertebra.
An employee tripped over a water hose and fell to the floor, breaking her knee.
An employee was attempting to clean a spray painting gun when it struck his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell onto a hard tile floor, suffering a severe right forearm contusion and possible broken bones. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a 2-foot step ladder and hit boxes while stocking a shelf, suffering cracked ribs and a punctured lung.
While stripping and waxing the floor in a hospital, an employee slipped and fell on the wet floor, breaking ribs on the right side.

An employee was on a ladder unhooking the ground clamp of a welding machine with the right hand when the employee grabbed a piece of conduit with the left hand for support and received an electric shock. The employee suffered a burn to the right hand around the thumb and ring finger.
While walking toward a cooler, an employee tripped over a filter pan that contained filtered debris from hot oil and received third degree burns.

An employee was sandblasting walls. As the employee reached to sand blast a spot, the ladder became unbalanced. The employee fell and the blast stream contacted his left hand and wrist causing abrasions requiring a skin graft and nerve damage.
An employee was operating an ice batch machine and amputated a left fingertip.

An employee was cleaning debris from and around a conveyor with an air hose when his arm was caught in the conveyor's pulley, causing him to be pulled into the running belt. He suffered a broken left clavicle, a broken rib on the left side, and abrasions to the torso. The conveyor's guards were removed at the time of the incident to identify why material was getting stuck in the conveyor.
Two employees were lifting a hog panel when one of the employees tripped and fell with the panel, amputating his right middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a blender. Noticing that a booster pump was running, he began walking toward it to turn it off. The booster pump deadheaded, causing pressure and steam to build up in the line, and as the employee approached an 8-inch suction hose broke loose from the pump and struck him in the lower left leg. He suffered a compound fracture to the left leg and second-degree steam burns to the torso.
An employee was carrying a glass in a server area. She turned and her knee dislocated. In falling, she suffered hand lacerations from the drinking glass.
An employee was dismounting a ladder when the ring on her ring finger was caught on metal material holding up a conveyor system, resulting in an amputation to her ring finger.
An employee was operating a riding pallet jack when he was caught between a pallet and a rack, fracturing his left leg.
An employee was hit in the head with a motor that fell when its support bolt was removed. The employee sustained a head laceration.

At about 8:00 a.m. on July 7, 2018, an employee was walking in a Price Chopper bottle return area when he fell for an unknown reason, striking his face. He suffered facial injuries and several of his teeth were knocked out. He was hospitalized.
An employee was assaulted by a patient and was hospitalized.
While replacing a valve on a furnace (which was not on), an employee became overheated.

On July 7, 2018, employee was engaged in sand blasting operations when he began having issues with his pot. As he inspected the connections, the sand blasting nozzle activated and the blast media hit his face. He was hospitalized with foreign bodies embedded in the eyes and face.

An employee was checking the chlorine levels in a therapy pool. A cover was removed so that chlorine tablets could be added; chlorine gas was released and the employee breathed it in. Suffering respiratory distress, the employee was hospitalized about 7 hours later.

An employee was setting up a hydraulic press with a new die. The employee inserted hold-down pins and a large metal bar. As the die came down during the initial work, it hit the edge of one of the hold-down pins, which vibrated past the end of the jig and entered the path of the ram. The ram hit the edge of the pin and flung it out violently. The 1-pound metal pin hit the employee's head, causing facial lacerations and a skull fracture.

On July 8, 2018, an employee fueled a pressure washer and the fuel ignited. The employee suffered severe burns to both legs and a broken left ankle. The washer was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was retrieving shopping carts from a parking lot. A car backed into the employee, who suffered a broken wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee lost her balance while walking in a store and fell to the floor. She suffered a dislocated hip, requiring surgery.
An employee fell from a truck bed while loading pallets, landing on the floor and fracturing his hip.
An employee was organizing a Conex box when his right ring finger was caught between a hose and metal shelf in the box, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using an overhead crane to install a new wheel hub into a tugger drive. She was guiding the unit and when she lowered it, her finger was pinched between the unit and the wheel, severing her middle fingertip and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was rolling a kiln as part of scheduled maintenance when the kiln stopped rolling. As the employee checked on the kiln, the employee's left middle finger got too close to a belt or blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working with a gunite mixer when the auger failed due to an abnormal valve. The auger pulled his gloved hand into the mixer, resulting in the amputation of his ring and middle fingers.
An employee was cleaning a meat grinder when it amputated the tip of the employee's right middle finger. The grinder had not completely stopped at the time.

An employee was using a shovel to hold down a boring machine bit to guide it into place at the start. When the machine was turned on, the drill bit slipped out and grabbed hold of employee's pant leg. His left leg was caught between the winch rope and the drill bit. He suffered a left leg abrasion and a sprained ankle.
An employee was shearing a piece of metal and amputated a fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee traveling to Connecticut for business was involved in a motor vehicle accident while riding in a taxi. The employee experienced abdominal pain and was hospitalized.
A nurse experienced allergy symptoms (including possible anaphylaxis) after treating patients who might have received an antibiotic she was allergic to.
An employee was walking down the sidewalk when she lost her balance and fell on her right side, suffering a possible broken hip.
An employee was assisting with beveling the ends of a pipe when he was struck by a 24" diameter pipe. His right leg was caught between the pipe and a roller, which broke his ankle.
An employee was going out to get some trucks ready at the terminal when he fell over a curb stop and then fell into a shallow concrete berm. He suffered a broken right hip and two broken right ribs.

An employee was descending a set of stairs when his boot tread may have become stuck in the stair grating causing him to trip and fall to the ground. The employee sustained multiple fractures to his left leg.
Two employees were driving all-terrain vehicles, using them to control cattle, when their vehicles collided. One employee suffered a fractured left femur.

An employee was waiting for an excavator to move its boom into place and stop operating. The excavator stopped, and the employee walked toward the machine. The bucket began to move again and struck the employee, causing a spleen injury.
An employee was in the process of sitting in an office chair with rollers when he stepped on one of the wheels, causing the chair to roll out from under him. He then fell on and injured his tailbone.
An employee was hospitalized for burns to his right foot when he rinsed himself with hot water.
An employee was making tea when the basket that holds the tea fell into the water. The hot water then splashed on her hands, arms, and feet, causing burns.
An employee was working on a drilling rig location, adjusting and pushing forklift blades, when the blades pinched the employee's middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down the hallway, lost her balance and fell breaking a femur.
An employee was walking on a metal roof when he fell through a section that had been cut out. He landed 12-15 feet below, breaking his foot.
An employee was using a manual wrapping machine to wrap pipe for an oil field when he tried to manually adjust the machine and his hand was pulled into it, breaking his right forearm.
An employee was putting chlorine tablets in a pool's chlorinator. A reaction caused the release of chlorine gas; the employee inhaled the gas and was injured.

An employee was signaling for a load to be brought up. The employee's finger was caught between the load line and the sheave of the block, and the employee suffered an amputation of the little finger on the left hand.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor fracturing the left shoulder.

An employee was attempting to repair a deboning machine when it lacerated the employee's left ring finger, requiring hospitalization and surgery. The machine was operating at the time of the incident.

On 7/9/2018, an employee was assigned a troubleshooting service request regarding air conditioning in a villa. He was checking the HVAC equipment for the kitchen to determine why it had a temperature change. At around 9 p.m., he fell approximately 10 feet off a fixed ladder to the lower level. He was hospitalized with multiple injuries, including a concussion and soft tissue injuries.

An employee was operating a concrete mixer. As he attempted to clear up clogged concrete mix, the mixer's blades struck his right hand. The middle finger was partially amputated, right above the knuckle.
An employee suffered a second degree burn from an electrical arc flash.

On July 9, 2013, an employee was setting up equipment on a naval ship when the employee stepped onto a floor opening covered by a tarp and fell through it into an open hatch. The employee suffered a head injury/trauma.
An employee was pushed by another employee and a cement cigarette ashtray fell on his feet. His left toe was crushed.
An employee was applying home coating around the exterior of a rooftop when the employee fell off the edge of the building, suffering a broken wrist and other trauma.

An employee was cutting a piece of metal in a 12" compound miter saw when the material became caught in the saw and pulled his arm into the extruded aluminum knife edge metal, causing a deep laceration to his left forearm.

An employee was driving a side-boom operator across a temporary bridge. The bridge collapsed and the machine rolled slightly and came to rest at about a 45 degree angle. As the employee disconnected his seat belt, he fell from the machine and landed in the creek bed on his back. The fall caused hairline fractures to his scapula and a rib.
An employee was sitting on the dock when a coworker started an RTV, which then moved forward and crushed her leg between the RTV and the dock. She was hospitalized with a leg fracture.

An employee was operating a pump supplying water for a fracturing operation (oil/gas) when the pump's discharge hose disconnected, and the hose clamp securing the hose to the flange failed. The hose then struck the employee's right shoulder, upper right back, and pelvis. The employee suffered two fractures to the pelvis, contusions, and abrasions, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking near the fry station when she tripped over another employee's foot. She fell to the ground and fractured her left forearm.
A security guard was feeling faint and dizzy and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning breading out of an auger when their hand was caught in the machinery. The employee suffered a fracture injury to the left hand and arm. The machine's guard had been removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was drilling with a press and amputated a finger.

The injured employee was on a two-step ladder cleaning the rotisserie area in a deli while a second employee was using a container to recover drained grease from the same equipment. The injured employee came down and repositioned the ladder next to the grease bucket and used it to clean. When he came down the ladder, he stepped into the grease bucket and burned his foot.

On 07/09/2018, at 12:30 PM, an employee was sitting in a chair at a desk. When he stood up and stepped away from the chair, his foot was caught underneath the chair's wheel, causing him to lose balance and fall to the ground. He fractured his hip.

An employee was coupling a dolly to a tug. The dolly rolled and the employee attempted to quickly connect the dolly and the tug. The employee's left index finger was then partially amputated at the top.
An employee slipped and fell while moving material, twisting and fracturing a leg.

An employee was rolling a metal pipe to the end of a pipe rack so he could pick it up with a forklift when the pipe rolled over the pipe rack chock and landed on his left foot, breaking bones. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was on the roof securing plastic when he went to step off the roof and onto a catwalk. The catwalk was not in place and he fell approximately 13 feet to the floor, suffering a dislocated and fractured left elbow as well as a broken left ankle.

An employee was moving an interface box into a small space in the basement ceiling of a house. The employee came into contact with an exposed live wire in the space and was shocked. He suffered contusions and bruising on his right elbow, as well as dizziness.

While operating a drill/saw machine, an employee attempted to see why the drill tooling kept falling out of the drill head. The machine's conveyor rollers then moved a channel iron back out of the machine, and the employee's left leg was struck by the channel iron, resulting in a laceration above the knee. The employee's left calf was also caught between the machine and the channel iron, suffering a muscle injury requiring surgery.
An employee was working in an area with an open-ended line when hot steam/water splashed on his back.
On July 10, 2018, at approximately 3:15 p.m., an employee began experiencing muscle cramps after MIG welding on a tank car. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An employee was moving rolls of paper back onto a conveyor (roll may weigh up to 9,000 pounds) when his right little finger was caught between two rolls, resulting in an amputation of the first two sections.
An employee was transporting shingles onto a roof and became dehydrated. He suffered heat illness symptoms and was hospitalized.
On July 10, 2018, an employee was hospitalized for dehydration after finishing his shift insulating tank cars.
An employee suffered heat stroke while working on a jobsite installing foundation drains.
An employee showed signs of heat stress while operating a paver during a heat wave. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attending to a customer and walking backwards when she lost her balance and fell, breaking her right hip.

An employee was working with another employee, torqueing the manways on a tower. He came down around 2:30 p.m. due to the weather and went back up around 3:30. Around 4:45 the two finished the job. They came down and walked back to the lunch tent to rest, at which point the employee began vomiting. He was hospitalized for heat-stress-related illness.
An employee was guiding a leg assembly being lifted by a crane when the weld broke, allowing a bracket on the leg assembly to fall and scratch the employee's thigh.

An employee was working at a carcass splitter when a carcass became caught on the splitter blade. As the employee attempted to clear the carcass, the line restarted and the blade amputated the employee's left index finger to the distal interphalangeal joint. The blade was unguarded at the time of the incident.
While finding a gas line's tracer wire, an employee moved vegetation from around a gas meter and was bitten on the right ring finger by a snake. The employee was hospitalized.

At 5:13 a.m. on July 10, 2018, an employee was working on a barrelmaking line when her glove was caught in a feed belt and pulley. She suffered a deep laceration to the right thumb, and was hospitalized for surgery.

On July 10, 2018, an employee was unloading a tandem dump truck at a dump site. The locking mechanism on the truck's gate was stuck. As the employee tried to unjam it, their hands were caught between the gate and the truck bed. The employee's left-hand fingers were crushed, with a possible amputation to the left middle finger; the right-hand fingers suffered contusions.
An employee was carrying a box with a part in it to a shelf when he stepped on a creeper, causing him to slip and fall. He fractured his right ankle.

An employee was helping a process cook set up a process line. The employee's left foot entered a food contact tub, containing water heated to 180 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee suffered second-degree (and possible some third-degree) burns to the foot.

An employee was using a forklift to load a sterilization chamber with pallets of medical devices. As he drove out of the chamber, ethylene oxide gas exploded. The employee suffered second and third degree burns over his body and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an ATV to move base plates on a roof when the throttle became stuck and he lost control, falling off the roof to the ground and breaking ribs.

An employee was adjusting the chuck on a roll fed machine. He released the sidewall carriage chuck to decrease the tension and used his left hand to manually operate the lever while holding the core with this right hand. His right thumb was then caught between the roll core and the sidewall carriage chuck, resulting in a right thumb amputation.
An employee tripped and fell, hitting her head on a kitchen stove. She was hospitalized for a possible head injury.

An employee was removing a large hydraulic ram to gain access to a hydraulic leak when he unbolted the cradle and it fell out, pinning him against a steel bulkhead. He suffered an amputation to his right arm.
An employee tripped and fell while leaving his car in the workplace parking lot. He suffered a fractured right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to dislodge a plugged drain on a fish meal auger when the auger amputated his right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee finished loading a truck with trash and was securing a winch to the truck when the employee's finger was caught between the winch and truck, amputating a portion of the left ring finger.
An employee was using a cart to move a bundle of rebar when the cart flipped. The employee tried to catch the rebar to prevent it from tipping over and injured his left hand.
An employee was handling parts coming from a cast machine when he began experiencing cramps. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was handling the electrical power cord of a refrigerator truck when he was shocked. His hand became numb and required hospitalization.
An employee received an electric shock while unplugging his computer, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing maintenance on a machine when her left hand was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation of the tip of the ring finger.
An employee was putting flour on cookies. The employee's right arm was caught inside the product belt. The employee suffered a fracture, requiring surgery.
An employee of G&H Underground Construction, Inc., was cutting a concrete pipe with a gas-powered concrete saw when the saw kicked back, striking and lacerating the employee's throat.
An employee's head hit a metal beam as he stood up on top of a conveyor belt system. He suffered head contusions and spinal injuries.
An employee suffered heat-related illness while prepping a site for utility pole installations, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing bolts from a pipe flange when he lost his balance and fell, striking his right side against a valve handle and breaking a rib.

An employee was working near a manhole when a car drove through the work zone and caught the line/cords to the employee s water pump equipment, causing the equipment to strike the employee s right arm.

An employee was about to climb a 15-foot chain ladder to exit a horizontal vessel. When he stepped onto the ladder, it became unstable and he fell. He landed on his back on the vessel's floor, suffering multiple broken vertebrae.

An employee was installing house wrap tape while working from a 300-pound-rated, 28- to 32-foot fiberglass extension ladder, which had filler lumber material elevating and supporting one side of the base ladder side rails to level the ladder base. During the house wrap taping operation, the ladder and employee fell an estimated 20 feet. The employee suffered wrist, elbow, arm, and rib fractures, as well as lacerations to the kidney and face.
An employee was moving plastic milk crates when the crates fell and hit the employee's head, causing a mild traumatic brain injury.

An employee mounted a moving forklift while walking through a warehouse. The employee later dismounted and entered the path of the moving forklift. The employee's right leg was run over and fractured.
An employee was aligning a grinding wheel when the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the wheel and flywheel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was bent down, stocking shelves, when a mobile cart struck her. She fell, breaking her left femur.
An employee got into a physical altercation with an airline passenger at a terminal gate. The employee was punched in the face and fell to the ground, suffering a concussion.
An employee became overheated while casting molten lead ingots, requiring hospitalization for severe heat exhaustion.
An employee fell from a 15-foot extension ladder to the ground while pruning a tree, suffering a broken back.
An employee was trying to deburr a small metal part using a multi-flute countersink when the employee came into contact with a 15-inch drill press, resulting in a left thumb amputation.

An employee was changing a die in a hose crimping machine. The machine cycled while his right hand was in contact with it. The fingers on his right hand suffered severe damage: his index finger was pinned and stitched with permanent loss of the fingernail, his middle and ring fingers were amputated to the second joint, and his little finger was amputated to the first joint.

An employee was operating a pasta manufacturing extrusion press when his arm entered one of the bins where pasta flour was being mixed to push the pasta remnants into an extrusion bore. The press paddle lacerated his right bicep area. The press' safety gate was in place at the time of the incident.
An employee was changing the die in a machine when the employee's left hand contacted the brake, resulting in amputation of the left index and pointer fingers.
An employee experienced severe heat cramps after conducting electrical rewiring activities, requiring hospitalization for heat stress.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle (tug) when it took an abrupt turn. The employee lost balance and was thrown from the vehicle to the concrete surface, suffering a head laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee fell from some boxes, striking against a U-boat cart and suffering fractured ribs and vertebrae.
An employee was cutting meat with a vertical bandsaw when the blade contacted his right hand, causing an amputation and laceration to the tip of his middle finger.

An employee was about to remove debris within a repaired rotary valve when the valve amputated his left middle fingertip. The valve's lockout/tagout had been removed and it had been energized to ensure that it worked following the repair.
A temporary employee working in the kitchen area was hospitalized for severe dehydration.
An employee was stepping off a stand-up forklift while delivering materials to production when the employee's left foot was caught under the stand-up forklift and suffered a fracture.
An employee was cutting chicken with a knife in the kitchen and amputated his fingertip.
The injured employee was working on a crew finishing a concrete curb. After finishing, the employee started cramping and was hospitalized for potential heat stroke.
An employee was vacuuming the cab of his truck, missed all of the steps while exiting the truck and fell. The employee sustained a brain bleed.
An employee sustained an amputation to the right index fingertip while cleaning the chuck of a die press machine.
An employee was changing the length of a sliding, adjustable table leg. The leg pinched and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was feeding slabs of bacon into a slicer. While he was clearing bacon scraps from under the machine, the cutting blades amputated the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee struck his back against a racking system column while operating a powered industrial truck (reach truck). He suffered contusions that required hospitalization.

On July 11, 2018, an employee was in the locker room after working near an extremely hot smelting furnace when he became disoriented and experienced nausea and fatigue. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was reversing a pallet jack to retrieve a garbage can which was underneath the rollers when his right leg was caught between the rollers and the pallet jack. He was admitted to the hospital with lacerations and broken leg.
On July 10, 2018, an employee was operating a press shear when his left middle finger went under the hold-down, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A store employee was struck in the abdomen by a shoplifter, causing the rupture of a prior hernia repair. The employee was hospitalized.
After working on equipment at a customer site, an employee left work feeling ill and was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

On July 11, 2018, at approximately 5:00 PM, an employee was operating a riding pallet jack in the warehouse when the operating handle of the pallet jack went under a racking system. Her right middle finger was crushed between the handle and the rack, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was stepping off a baggage cart when she slipped and fell, fracturing her right arm.
An employee was driving a pole truck. The truck contacted a power line resulting in burns to the employee's right arm and leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the ground at an active job site when a reversing milling machine ran over the employee's left foot. The machine continued running up his leg to approximately his hip. His left foot and leg were crushed, with damage to the left hip and amputation of the left leg from the knee down. He also suffered a fractured right leg and hip.
While walking across an auction lane, an employee was hit by a car. The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken hip.
An employee was doing electrical work when he fell 6 feet from a ladder, injuring his back and head.
A trainee was undergoing a combat baton evaluation. The instructor bear-hugged her and they fell to the ground; the trainee suffered two fractured ribs and a partially collapsed lung.
On July 11, 2018, a mail carrier felt ill after finishing his route at 6:25 p.m. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was using a wrench to adjust a screw on a mold machine when her right hand was pinched between the wrench and the machine's plate, fracturing two fingers of her right hand. Her index finger had to be partially amputated.
An employee was using a deli slicer when its blade cut the tip of his right thumb, causing a partial amputation.

On July 11, 2018, an employee was working from a mobile scaffold, about 12 feet above a concrete floor, to remove asbestos. He fell to the floor, fracturing his wrist and hip. The scaffold's guardrails had been removed at the time of the incident.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder up to a water tower when a stranded metal safety cable located beside the ladder came loose at the top anchor point and struck his leg, puncturing his right thigh.

An employee was preparing to lift a DC motor. While he positioned the nylon sling, the crane activated, pinching his right ring finger between the motor frame and the sling. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving furniture when he started cramping, vomiting, and feeling exhausted. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
A temporary employee was sitting on a bag of cargo, waiting for operations to begin. A 2,000-pound cargo bag struck the employee.

An employee was in a lift basket placing corrugated roof panels on a roof when the employee exited the lift basket to measure the next piece of decking and fell 15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractures and lacerations, as well as bruised heels on both feet.

An employee was placing a metal screen on a sheet metal folding machine when his foot inadvertently pushed down on the machine's cycle foot pedal, causing the upper ram to close down on his hands. He suffered a compression injury and fractures to the left hand and bruises to the right hand.
An employee was operating a table saw and amputated a fingertip on the saw blade.
A rack of sheet metal tipped, and an employee's face and nose were lacerated by the falling sheet metal.

An employee was helping to transfer a steel plate off a flatbed truck with an overhead crane. The rigging equipment was put under tension while the employee's left ring finger was between the shackle and the plate hook; the employee's fingertip was pinched and amputated.

A crew was working to remove tubing from a well. A 2-inch hose was connected to the tubing for fluid circulation. The crew was raising the tube when the hose was caught and came under tension. An employee attempted to dislodge the hose, which reacted and sprung into the employee's face, breaking bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a manual pallet jack to push a transformer when he made a sharp turn and the transformer fell on his leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula.
Two employees were involved in an altercation and one employee was cut on the face with a knife.

At about 10:30 a.m. on July 11, 2018, an employee was clearing wood dust from a horizontal belt near the chipper. He was using a piece of wood to knock the dust from the belt; the belt splice caught the piece of wood and pulled his finger into a belt roller. The tip of his right thumb was amputated.
A transmission pole was in a 42-inch diameter hole that was being backfilled. An employee slipped into the hole and suffered an ankle dislocation.
An employee sustained electrical burns to his back and both hands when he made contact with an energized primary line.
On July 11, 2018, an employee began having symptoms of heat-related illness while installing rebar at a construction site. He was hospitalized.
An employee was crimping terminals on a mechanical power press when the press amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was valet parking cars and struck a light pole.

On July 11, 2018, an employee was mounting a 16-inch tire onto a 16.5-inch rim. The tire would not seat on the rim, so the employee used a 150-psi air line to inflate it. The tire and wheel assembly then burst and struck the employee, who suffered a broken arm and lacerations to the arm and face.
An employee was in a manlift conducting demolition work. A piece of steel beam broke loose and struck the employee causing a left arm and shoulder fracture.

An employee was removing a 2" riser pipe from a casing head with a pipe wrench when backside pressure pushed the riser up and it struck the employee's forehead. He was then covered in drilling mud, which evacuated the well behind the pipe. He suffered a forehead laceration and skull fracture.

An employee was feeding a slab of wood into a chipper machine when the slab became stuck. As the employee attempted to loosen it, the employee's finger was smashed between the end feed of the machine, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was working from a ladder, clearing dough from an overhead conveyor. His left hand was caught in the conveyor system's chain and sprocket, and a finger was amputated above the knuckle.

An employee was attempting to repair a slide on a grid casting machine when the die closed and caught his gloved hand. His left thumb was pinched in the mold, resulting in a soft tissue amputation to the left thumb tip (no bone loss).

An employee was replacing batteries on an uninterruptible power source. During the final stage of connecting the cables to the lug, a dead short was created, causing the employee to receive a burn to his hands.

An employee was standing at the exit rollers talking with two coworkers. A truss exited the line and struck the back of the employee's leg. The employee sustained severe bruising to the upper right thigh.
An employee entered the modular office building and slipped and fell on the floor, breaking her right wrist and left leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a partial amputation of the left middle fingertip while opening the access door on a filter pod.
An employee was working on a truss press machine. It closed while the employee's left hand was still in it, and the tip of the employee's left thumb was amputated.

An employee was removing a vessel cap when 60% chromic acid solution sprayed out of an open valve and contacted him, causing third degree burns on his shoulder, back, and wrists. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

At about 3:45 p.m. on July 12, 2018, an employee was replacing seals on a plastic extrusion machine. As the employee was installing a pin to connect the screen change plate to the hydraulic cylinder, the cylinder actuated causing the shaft to move outwards and crush his fingers against the extruder. One finger was amputated.
A CNC machine operator suffered an amputation to the left little finger, from the hail to the end of the finger.

An employee was performing maintenance work on top of a pickle line tank with the lid off when he became very hot and had difficulty breathing due to heat or hydrochloric acid exposure. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hand stacking pallets of bagged talc on a railroad car when the bags slid and fell on top of him.  He fractured his right arm and two vertebrae.
An employee started cramping and vomiting in a work truck after chipping bush in a hot outdoor environment. The employee was dehydrated.
An employee injured his back while lifting luggage from the trunk of a vehicle.
An employee cut the wire of a lightning arrester. The hot wire then made contact with a metal bracket and a flash occurred, causing thermal burns to the employee's face and chest.
An employee was testing/troubleshooting a wood chipper when the employee's hand was caught in the drive belt, resulting in multiple broken bones and a severely lacerated thumb.

An employee was using an underwater blaster to clear barnacle off of wooden columns when a wave came in and splashed against him, knocking him off balance and into the path of the blaster's water jet, which cut his left index finger. His left index finger was amputated.
An employee was mounting a horse when it bucked him off. He struck his head on the ground, suffering a head laceration and injuries to two vertebrae in his upper back.

An employee was cleaning out a bone jam from a conveyor with a hook when the hook came loose from the bone and his hand jerked back. His hand hit the conveyor and about 1/4 inch of his right ring finger was amputated.

An employee was standing on the tines of a forklift while the operator was driving it through a parking lot. The forklift hit a bump, knocking the employee off the tines. The forklift operator then ran over his leg, breaking his femur and ankle bones. He was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a leaking valve on a POD with a wrench. While he was loosening the bolt, the wrench slipped off the bolt and his right middle finger was pinched between the wrench and the edge of the equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was driving a turf carryall vehicle, which went down a grassy hill and rolled. The employee sustained a cut above the right eye and broken vertebrae.
An electrical engineer was checking a newly installed cooling fan in the drive cabinet and received electrical burns to both arms and the face.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a conveyor belt and amputated his left index finger.
An employee was manually jogging a belt pulley on a dust collector motor when he sustained a partial right pinky finger amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was hospitalized from heat exhaustion.
Employees were rolling telephone poles off a trailer. As a pole came off the truck, it landed on an employee's leg, breaking his tibia.

An employee unloaded two pipe racks off a flatbed trailer, set them aside, and climbed on the trailer to remove the chains from the other racks. The employee then climbed off the trailer and began walking back toward the cab on the driver's side when a pipe rack rolled off the trailer and caught the employee's left thigh, fracturing the left femur.
An employee was wearing gloves while operating a drill press. The employee's glove was caught in the drill, resulting in an amputation of the left pinky finger.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the floor and fractured the right hip.
An employee fell down an unmarked elevator shaft, breaking his foot.

An employee was installing drywall on a piece of wall that was laying flat on the ground. Nearby, a 9-foot wall with drywall was already framed and standing on its own with four support braces. Strong winds blew the standing wall down and it struck the employee's back.

An employee was troubleshooting a machine when he pressed something that actuated the pin on the machine. His left thumb was then pinched between the pin and table, resulting in a partial thumb amputation.
An employee was helping to position a jack stand onto a staging area when his left hand went between the edge of the stand and a parked trailer, lacerating his palm.
On July 12, 2018, an employee was cutting a sheet of sticky foam with a manual shear. The shear amputated the employee's left ring finger below the nail and severely lacerated the little finger.

An employee was standing on the second level of pallet bay racking while removing shelving boards above him. As he moved, the boards he was standing on broke and he fell, breaking his left hip and bruising his upper left arm.

On July 12, 2018, an employee was helping to move a 30-foot rinse tank with a castor frame from storage to an operations facility when the top housing of the rinse tank shifted and came down on the frame and the employee's right hand. The employee sustained a right pinky fingertip amputation.
A forklift operator was climbing off his forklift when he slipped and fell, suffering a hip injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting reels of wire from the floor onto a golf cart. The employee suffered a fractured vertebra in the lower back.

At about 1:15 p.m. on July 13, 2018, an employee was driving a forklift. His lift struck a rack and ran over his left foot, lacerating the top and bottom of the foot and breaking several bones. He was hospitalized, and his left little toe was medically amputated.

An employee was attempting to remove a bag that was jammed in a machine when his right hand was caught in the machine. As he pulled his hand out, he fractured his thumb and degloved his hand. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was on a roof taking measurements when he slipped and fell 10 feet off of the roof, breaking both heels and requiring hospitalization. The pitch of the roof was 6- to 7 in 12.

The injured employee was using an oxy-acetylene torch to remove one of the legs from the outside of a centrifuge (used process equipment). After 10-15 minutes, the injured employee began having issues with the torch. He paused his work briefly and a second employee came over to assist with lighting the torch. Once the torch was relit, the injured employee resumed cutting activities on the centrifuge and an explosion/fireball occurred. The injured employee sustained severe burns to his forearms and was hospitalized. The second employee was treated and released on the same day.

An employee was delivering concrete beams to a construction project along a highway. During the unloading process, the employee was on the tractor when the employee lost footing and fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. The employee suffered bruised ribs and a dislocated finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working at her desk when ceiling tiles and frames fell, striking her on the face and head. She was hospitalized.

An employee exited a lift truck to undo the strap on a core buggy. The lift truck rolled onto and pinched him. He suffered a broken clavicle. The lift truck's emergency park brake was not in place at the time of the incident.
On June 13, 2018, an employee was removing blanks from the rear of a press and suffered an amputation injury to the right middle finger.
An employee suffered an amputation while changing a die press.

An employee was trying to secure dunnage in a trailer using a pneumatic nail gun. He was in the process of standing up from a kneeling position when the gun's trigger was caught in his work boots. The tongue of the boots depressed the trigger, causing it to fire a nail into his right lower leg.
On July 13, 2018, an employee felt ill after inspecting a boom lift. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was unchaining a grader from a lowboy trailer. He tripped and fell, and his head struck the trailer. He suffered a cut to the forehead and possibly other injuries.
An employee was cleaning a floor when a dropped knife fell from above, point down, and struck him on the left arm. He suffered a laceration and a severed artery.

An employee was using a crane to move steel plates onto a scaffold's deck. The plates shifted and made contact with a scaffold pole, pinching the employee's left little finger. The employee suffered an amputation/avulsion of about a quarter inch of the finger.
On July 13, 2018, an employee was on a stationary lift under a table. The lift activated and moved up. The employee was smashed against the table, suffering crushing injuries to the pelvis.

An employee was moving a package (containing the casing for an electrical panel) from unloading to a conveyor. As the employee took the one step to the conveyor, the package fell and struck the employee's right ankle, causing a laceration.

An employee was standing in the work area waiting for a pipe fitter to lower when the pipe fitter, which was hoisted on a chain, became dislodged and struck the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a fractured fibula and tibia, requiring hospitalization.

At about 7:30 p.m. on July 13, 2018, a production technician was loading an in-mold labeler with plastic labels. When he reached around the basket to grab labels that had fallen off, the swing arm came down, amputating the tip of his left middle finger without the lost of bone or nail.

On July 13, 2018, an employee was performing a change-over on a foamer. The employee was lowering the locking plate onto the plug; it was misaligned, and the employee pushed on it. The plate aligned and amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
A maintenance employee was working on a plastic mold injection machine when it sprayed hot liquid product onto his face. He was hospitalized with second degree burns to his face and hands.
An employee was attempting to remove green bean debris from a machine when his hand became caught in a roller, partially amputating his right middle finger. The machine was guarded at the time.

On 7/13/2018, an employee climbed an 8-foot A-frame ladder to tape an area for painting. The employee finished and was starting to descend when the employee missed one of the ladder rungs and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a head cut and broken right ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was working from a ladder that was 8 to 10 feet in height when he fell off the ladder, suffering brain bleeding, disorientation, and back fractures.
An employee was out delivering mail and parcels when he started to feel ill because of the heat. He was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was feeding gasket material across a shoe die press when she attempted to clear a piece of material that jammed in the die. The press was activated and severed two of her right-hand fingertips.
An employee was walking down the hallway while carrying tools when he tripped on the seam of a curled up Masonite board and fell, breaking his nose and left eye socket.
An employee was setting a spud on a hydraulic dredge when the spud fell on and crushed the employee's right index finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was descending the stairs, tripped and fell fracturing the right fibula.

An employee was working from a catwalk to perform maintenance on the engine of equipment used to transport crude oils and liquids. While descending the ladder from the catwalk, the employee slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in rib fractures, abrasions to the arm and shoulder, and a collapsed left lung.

An employee was waiting on a backhoe to bring a manhole down from a stock pile to be installed at a pump station. The employee was sliding the manhole ring when a bolt that holds the backhoe blade caught the ring and lid. This caused the employee to lose his grip, and the ring and lid dropped on his left hand, smashing his index and ring fingers and resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing metal bar stock from cantilever racking using an overhead crane. The metal bar stock dropped onto the employee's right middle finger causing an amputation.

An employee was working on a roof, performing preventive maintenance on an exhaust fan. As he tried to grease the pulleys, his hand was caught and pulled through the pulley by the belt. He was hospitalized.

An employee was traveling on a forklift beside a second forklift when her arm became pinned between the two forklifts. She suffered a hand injury that required surgery. Her arm was outside the confines of the equipment at the time of the incident.
An employee was descending a 6-foot A-frame ladder when his left leg was caught between the first and second rungs, breaking his left tibia.

A lineman was working on a switch from a bucket, covering electrical power lines with blankets and sleeves. As he reached for a jumper, his sweat-soaked shirt touched a hot jumper at the right arm while his left sleeve touched the switch bracket. A flash occurred, and he suffered first- and second-degree burns.
An employee was found on the ground with a fractured tailbone after attempting to clear a conveyor jam. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when the saw amputated a finger.
On July 13, 2018, an employee was cutting the top of a concrete wall with a gas-powered handsaw. The saw kicked back, striking and lacerating the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing an underground irrigation system when a cap for a 2-inch PVC pipe blew off with approximately 60 pounds of pressure and struck the employee in the right eye area, causing a laceration above the right eye and fractured right eye socket.
An employee was in a warehouse, operating a cherry picker, when another cherry picker struck him. He fell from the cherry picker, breaking his right leg.
An employee was working on carpentry with a nail gun when something shot into his eye.

An employee was conducting quality assurance work on a conveyor belt where maintenance was being conducted when he placed his hand on the conveyor rail and the roller pinched his left pinky finger, resulting in a partial amputation/avulsion. The roller was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was on stairs, crossing over a production line, when she fell to the floor and broke her left ankle.
An employee tripped and/or fell to the floor, suffering a broken humerus.
An employee was outside blowing off a concrete pad when he experienced nausea due to dehydration (heat stress), requiring hospitalization.

An employee was stepping over a velvet rope used to quadrant floor areas when the employee caught their trailing foot on the rope and fell to the floor, fracturing the right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the kitchen area when she passed out due to dehydration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sweeping the floor inside a building. A conduit was being installed from the outside of the building; a 4x6x5 piece of stone was jarred loose from the top of a masonry column above where the employee was sweeping. The stone fell 23 feet onto the employee's hard hat, penetrating the hat and lacerating his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to the break room when she tripped and fell on a piece of plastic that was sticking out from a pallet, fracturing her left elbow and tearing her shoulder tendons.
Two employees were lowering a patient into a chair using a lift. The lift tipped and hit an employee on the shoulder and the top of the head. The employee underwent surgery for a brain bleed.
An employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was using an overhead hoist to lift a rig composed of three steel poles. His left thumb was pinched between the chain and the product being lifted, and the tip was amputated.
Two employees were clearing a jam on an extruder machine when the hot plastic ejected from the mold and burned one of them.
On July 14, 2018, while delivering mail on foot, an employee became dehydrated and began vomiting. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness.
On 7/14/2018, at approximately 5:30, an employee was found unconscious in his mail vehicle due to possible heat exhaustion.
An employee was on a drilling rig when the shaker tank's overflow line hit and tripped the employee, who fell down stairs off the rig floor. The employee suffered a fractured right tibia and fibula.

At about 11:00 a.m. on July 14, 2018, an employee was cleaning the front/feed roll of a three-roll mill after milling a batch. He was scraping the front roll using a metal spatula, 10 inches long with a 4-inch blade. He had finished cleaning the left side and center of the front roll and had started cleaning the right side of the roll, applying pressure to the spatula with his right hand and using his left hand to support his right hand. He suffered amputations to the left ring and pinky fingers. At the time of the incident, the mill was powered and a guard was in place between the middle and front rolls.

An employee was installing an air handler on a building's second floor using an all-terrain forklift. The equipment had been placed on a 12-by-12 skate and moved to a placement pad. It shifted and struck the employee, causing fractures to the wrist, elbow, and leg, and a laceration to the forehead.

An employee was cutting insulation on a roof edge when the employee fell approximately 25 feet off the roof, landing on pavement. The employee injured the left hand and foot and sustained two spinal fractures.
An employee was working on a press brake when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The employee's right thumb was then caught between the machine and a part, requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was working on a frac tank and fell into the guardrail resulting in injury to the left torso/ribs.
An employee was repairing a water heat exchange. When the water valves were turned on, a PVC pipe burst and hot water struck the employee's face, ear, back and leg.
An employee was troubleshooting an interlock switch on an HVAC unit. The employee's left pinky finger was caught in the HVAC door panel as the employee closed it, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was pumping raw milk from a tanker truck into a silo when he noticed a connection was leaking. He stood in front of the pipe to tighten the clamp when the pipe separated from the clamp, striking him in the lower abdomen. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a forklift into a battery charging station. His foot and leg were caught between the forklift and a guardrail, and his leg was broken.
An employee was replacing the cover on an exhaust fan. The employee's little finger was caught between the belt and pulley disk and the tip was lacerated.

An employee was cutting bone-in rib eye steaks with a band saw when the meat moved and the blade cut his left index and middle fingers, resulting in a partial finger amputation, a finger fracture, and a skin avulsion.
An employee was working on the work-over rig floor when he slipped on some hydraulic fluid and fell into casing tongs, injuring his head and shoulder.
On July 15, 2018, an employee was patrolling on an all-terrain vehicle and rolled it, suffering a broken right forearm.
An employee was removing the lower section of a valve. The pump plunger came forward and pinched the employee's finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was sitting in a vehicle and was ready to set rail on a railroad crossing when a train struck the vehicle with the employee inside. The employee suffered fractured ribs.
A spotter was attempting to stop two moving forklifts from colliding when he was pinned between the two, fracturing his tibia and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered from heat stroke after working outside with asphalt.
On July 16, 2018, an employee was traveling to the airport on a business trip. The employee fell at the airport, suffering a broken right femur, and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a mobile scaffold when the wheel hit a hole, suffering fractured heels and a bicep cut.

On July 16, 2018, an employee was returning to his vehicle after delivering mail. He tripped on the uneven sidewalk and fell into his vehicle, fracturing an arm and elbow and sustaining a laceration to his knee.
On July 16, 2018, at approximately 1:45 p.m., an employee was climbing a stool to reach papers on a top shelf when she fell and injured her left knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was on a ladder installing a visual display when her foot became stuck and she fell off the ladder, fracturing her leg.

On July 16, 2018, an employee was using an auto cutter when a part became jammed in the cutting hole. As he attempted to clear the jam, the cutting mechanism cut his left middle fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation. The machine was running and guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was working from a platform at a residence. The platform collapsed and he fell to ground level about 10 feet below. He suffered fractured vertebrae in his back, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a forklift to move equipment into a demonstration room. The forklift hit a 480-volt connector. The employee was shocked and hospitalized.

Two employees were working on a roof above 20 feet, both tied off. Work was also being done about 60 feet above them, and debris from that work was striking the employees. The employees detached their lanyards and got closer to the edge of the roof to get the attention of the employees who were blowing the debris down onto them. One of the employees fell from the roof to the concrete about 14 feet below, breaking ribs and his arm.

An employee was changing the shield on an aluminum pot. As he removed the shield, he tried to toss it to the floor, but the latch on the shield caught his glove, causing him to lose his balance. He then fell from the walkway between the pots (approximately 36 inches above the floor) to the floor, landing on his left shoulder, with the shield landing on him. He suffered a contusion to the left shoulder, laceration to the left hand, laceration to the left flank area, and abrasions to the left side of his face, requiring hospitalization and sutures.

An employee was helping another employee put a block under an aluminum mold machine. After he stepped away from the machine, another employee began to turn it on; noticing that the block had shifted, the first employee tried to adjust it. The machine smashed his right index and middle fingers (causing severe lacerations), as well as the tip of his ring finger.

An employee was riding on a pallet of flooring materials on a powered industrial truck (PIT) to stabilize the load. The PIT was being operated with the forks 4-6 feet high. While it traveled from inside the building to outside the building, the bottom of the pallet broke. The pallet flipped forward and the employee was thrown into the air and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a separated shoulder blade, fractured wrist and arm, torn ACLs in both knees that required surgery, and a chest contusion.

An employee was setting up a packaging machine. He tried to pull the packaging film between the machine's cutting jaws, which closed and amputated the tip of his left index finger. At the time of the incident, the machine's safety doors were closed and the safety switches were not activated.

A nurse was working at a nurse's station when she had an allergic reaction to the medication she was administering to a patient. She began to have trouble breathing and became flushed and incoherent, and was hospitalized.
An employee returned from his mail route and was not feeling well due to the heat. He was later hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was dumping grease from a deep fryer. The grease melted the bottom from the bucket and it spilled out. The employee fell in the spilled grease, suffering third degree burns to the knees and random second degree burns to the rest of his body.

An employee was parked on the side of the road changing a tire on a company vehicle when the jack slipped, causing the vehicle to come down. The employee was pinched by the vehicle and sustained multiple fractures to the pelvis and sacrum.
An employee suffered from heat-related illness while delivering packages, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a drill press when the rotating bit caught his glove, resulting in the amputation of his right little finger.

On July 16, 2018, an employee was moving a battery on an assembly line when the employee's right ring finger was crushed between the battery and the conveyor, resulting in a partial amputation. The conveyor was unguarded at the time.
An employee was setting up for a job when a hydraulic hammer fell on and crushed his foot, breaking bones.
An employee was clearing a jam in a case packing machine. As he moved away from the machine, his head struck the frame of the safety cage, suffering a hematoma and possible concussion.
An employee was trying to move a train track switch when his finger was caught in the switch mechanism. The tip of his left ring finger was amputated.

On July 16, 2018, an employee was disassembling concrete wall forms while standing on scaffolding when he attempted to transfer from one side of a wall to the other side and fell 14 feet to the concrete below. He suffered rib, pelvic, and heel fractures.
An employee was getting mortar for bricklayers when she fell partway through a gap on a scaffold. She suffered bruised/broken ribs.
An employee was moving steel beams when the load hit another beam. He was then pinched between the loads, fracturing his knee and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a stepladder trimming a tree branch when the branch fell and knocked the ladder over, causing him to fall to the ground. He suffered a head laceration, a fractured collarbone, and fractured ribs.

An employee was cutting wood with a table saw to make a box for shipping. The employee turned the saw off and was trying to remove a piece of scrap wood when the blade amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was putting a strap around a bundle of rebar to be moved when his left middle fingertip was caught between two pieces of rebar, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access the roof when the ladder broke. The employee fell 8 to 10 feet, landing on his feet. He broke his right leg and ankle, and dislocated his left knee.
An employee was cleaning the front of a meat grinder that crushes cherries when the employee's index finger was caught in the running blade, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee used starting fluid as a cleaning agent. Afterward, he lit a cigarette that ignited chemical residue on his hands. He sustained burns to the face and bilateral upper and lower extremities.
An employee troubleshooting a 24V circuit on a heat pump when he received an electric shock, burning his pointer finger and experiencing tingling in his hands and arms.

For three days, an employee's task had been to clean sea salt from an injection pump's inlet tube. The employee had trouble breathing, feeling a sharp pain in the shoulder and pressure in the chest, and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder to the sidewalk while scraping paint from a building facade, suffering a fractured ankle and tibia.
An employee was walking to his car when he slipped on moss growing on the parking lot surface and fell to the asphalt, fracturing his right hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing a gas line. When the employee began to cut the line, a fire caused second-degree burns to the employee's right arm, neck, and face.

On July 16, 2018, two employees were performing maintenance on a piece of heavy equipment that was having issues with its rubber tracks. Employee #1 was operating the machine while employee #2 was watching the tracks. As the track was moving, employee #2's arm entered the track. His left arm was crushed, requiring hospitalization.
An employee hit a deer while driving an all-terrain vehicle. He suffered injuries to his face and wrists and was hospitalized. A helmet was not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was 8 feet up a 10-foot A-frame ladder. As he began to climb down, he lost his footing and fell to the floor, sustaining a lumbar fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was in a trench, cleaning off a duct about 8 feet away. A steel plate slipped while being placed in the trench; it knocked another steel plate (which had already been placed into the trench) against the employee and pinned him against the duct. He suffered a broken pelvis and femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to step onto a rolling rail car when his foot slipped and his right foot went under the rail car wheel amputating all five toes.
An employee had climbed down a ladder and was on the ground beneath a concrete form when it fell onto him, breaking his left arm. He was hospitalized.
On July 16, 2018, a forklift operator's arm was pinned between the forklift and a racking system. The employee suffered contusions and was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming vegetation from an aerial lift. The employee fell from the lift to the ground, suffering a broken left arm.

On 7/16/2018, a temporary employee in training on a filling/packing machine suffered an amputation on her left middle finger. The safety interlocks on the front doors of the machine had failed and it continued to cycle as she was performing maintenance on the machine.
An employee was laying sewer line when their hand was caught between the top of the shoring box and the bottom of the excavator bucket. The employee sustained a fractured forearm.
An employee was helping a maintenance employee work on a can wash when the employee was splashed on the mid-section with scalding, hot water.
An employee was moving computer equipment and boxes and started feeling numbness in the arms and shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized for a ministroke.

An employee was helping to move rafters to build a cone on a tank. One of the rafters was hooked onto a tractor. When the employee went to pull the rafter, the joint of the rafter caught the rafter below it, which then slid and put the employee in a pinch point and the line of fire. As a result, the employee broke two bones above her left ankle (tibia and fibula) and three bones in her left foot.

An employee was using acetone to clean dripping foam insulation from a basement wall when the pilot light flame of a hot water tank ignited the acetone fumes, causing first, second, and third degree burns to the employee's legs.
An employee was using tongs to pull a pipe out of a hole when he lost his grip on the tongs and they swung around, striking him. He suffered two pelvic fractures and a tear in his bladder.
An employee was on a site making a delivery when his truck became stuck in sand. As he tried to get the truck unstuck, he became light-headed, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee was trying to adjust a washer's idler roller with a crowbar. The roller slipped off the crowbar and struck the employee's left middle finger, amputating the flesh of the fingertip.
On July 17, 2018, an employee climbed up the bed of a truck to inspect the lining and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a head and back injury and was hospitalized with a concussion.
While walking into a home, an employee tripped on the threshold. The employee fell into a wall corner and to the ground, suffering four broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

While descending a portable step ladder to reposition it, an employee missed the bottom rung and fell approximately 18 to 24 inches to the concrete floor below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right forearm, elbow, and pelvis.

An employee was removing lumber from the flatbed of a trailer when he slipped on lumber and fell about 4 feet off the trailer bed. He broke three ribs and one of the ribs punctured his lungs, requiring hospitalization.
While replacing a transformer fan motor, an employee was shocked through the shoulder and out the chest. The employee lost consciousness.
On July 17, 2018, an employee opened the door of a trailer and was struck by unsecured cargo, injuring his knee and requiring surgery.
An employee was using a hole punch machine when the handle came down onto the employee's hand and caused an open fracture to the right ring finger.
An employee was adding water to the radiator of a piece of heavy equipment when a front end loader struck him. He suffered abdominal injuries and a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was running a compacting press when his right hand entered the machine while it was in a downward motion. The press compacted, severing his right index finger and requiring hospitalization. The punch process of the machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was clearing a plugged production line when the employee contacted the pump rotor, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was adding a bag of sodium thiosulfate to a storage tank containing sodium hypochlorite and a weak caustic solution. The bag fell into the tank and the liquid in the tank splashed onto the employee causing second degree burns to the right and left thigh, abdomen and left hand.

On July 17, 2018, an employee had just finished a bar change when he bent over to grab a part. His hair was caught in a rotating bar on the screw machine. He suffered a partial hair/scalp removal and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was training another employee on how to operate a forklift and pick orders. The injured employee stepped between the forklift and a rack beam before the employee driving the forklift came to a complete stop. The employee driving the forklift turned to straighten out the forklift, at which time the injured employee became pinned between the forklift and the rack beam, suffering a broken bone in the shoulder area, broken ribs, and a facial cut.
An employee was unrolling a roof ice guard when the employee fell off the roof to the ground, suffering a ruptured spleen, collapsed lung, and injured rib.
An employee was holding a knife while putting on his personal protective equipment (PPE) when his PPE fell on the ground. As he bent down to pick it up, the knife punctured his abdomen.

An employee was holding bushing pullers while attempting to set bushings when he was struck on his lower back area with a bushing puller (an approximately 1 inch X 2 feet metal device connected to a hoist for lifting). He suffered a spleen injury that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was moving dishes. As she turned her body at the waist, she felt a pain, which did not go away. She was hospitalized, having possibly suffered a torn abdominal muscle.
An employee was standing on a 10-foot A-frame ladder installing an eave drip. The ladder shifted and he fell about 5 feet to the ground, fracturing a vertebra in his lower back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a falling utility pole and suffered a fractured ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was making a patient's bed when she slipped, fell to the floor, and broke her hip.

At about 10:15 a.m., an employee entered an operating room that had recently been "turned over." He slipped on the wet floor as he entered the room, falling to the floor and hitting his neck, head, and shoulder. He suffered swelling and contusions to two vertebrae in his neck.
An employee was attempting to remove chips from the vise in the material holding area of a band saw when the sawblade caught his left pinky, causing an amputation.

An employee was struck on the right elbow by a rod wrench while he was backing off a rod coupling. He suffered an open laceration and non-displaced fracture to the right elbow, as well as a fracture to the left index finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was struck in the jaw by a section of conduit as it was being pulled from the ground by an excavator and broke free. The employee's jaw fractured.
A certified nursing assistant felt severe lower back and hip pain after pushing a shower chair.

An employee was working outside on July 17, 2018, preparing for the next day's job when he started not feeling well. The next day, July 18, 2018, the employee was at a customer location working and started vomiting and was unable to keep any fluids down. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and renal failure.

An employee was fabricating a frame support for a shackle line. The frame detached and fell, hitting the employee's right leg above the ankle. The employee suffered a laceration and fracture to the leg and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a severe laceration to the right foot from being struck by a loaded pallet/forklift.
An employee was mixing lithium aluminum hydride with dioxane when a reaction occurred, causing an explosion. He suffered a torn tendon in his upper extremities among other injuries.
An employee was walking from a desk to a copier when she fell to the floor, suffering a broken rib, torn liver, and facial bruising. She was hospitalized.

On July 17, 2018, an employee was working in an elevator platform when one of the hoist sheaves suddenly rotated and hit him in the head. It then returned to its original position, knocking off his hardhat and lacerating his scalp.
An employee was stepping on a pallet when a slat broke. As he attempted to remove his foot from between the broken slat, he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing his left hip.

An employee tried to reconnect an airline hose to a tilt table after using the hose to clean a piece of equipment. The table had been switched on, and it began to move to a vertical position while the employee was leaning under it to connect the hose. The employee was pinned between the table support beam and the front edge of the table. The employee suffered broken vertebrae in the back and was hospitalized.

A crane operator was off loading nine foot steel round billets from a trailer to a nearby billet pile.  Steel yard attendants assist the operator with final positioning of the billets from ground level using no-touch tools. The injured employee used his hand on the end of the billet to push and align it with the row. At this time, the second billet released from the crane magnet and contacted the injured employee's right hand. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right thumb at the distal joint.
An employee was on the back of a trash truck throwing trash when his body started cramping, requiring hospitalization for dehydration and heat stress.
An employee was installing a chain on a conveyor when another employee activated the conveyor. The employee's right middle fingertip was then caught in the chain and sprocket, causing an amputation.

On July 18, 2018, the injured employee was operating a stand-up commercial riding mower. At approximately 2:15 p.m. a skid steer driven by a second employee collided with the riding mower. The injured employee was knocked to the ground during the collision. Immediately after falling off the mower, the employee was run over by the skid steer causing multiple leg fractures and lacerations.
