While flushing chemical from a tanker truck an explosion occurred that burned three employees. One of the injured employees was hospitalized with burns to the face and hands.
An employee was laying down casing. The casing elevators opened and the 7" casing fell onto the employee. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder and ribs and head trauma.
An employee was standing on site when the wind picked up a 3/4-inch plywood board and threw it towards the employee. The board struck his head, causing cerebral contusions.
An employee was on top of a heat furnace line, tightening bolts on a motor. The employee's left ring and little fingers were amputated.
An employee was caring for a patient in the patient's room. The employee tripped (possibly over a cord) and fell, suffering a broken right leg/pelvis.
An employee was helping build a water pump when he fell, hitting and breaking his leg on a concrete wall.

An employee was stocking bananas while standing on the pallet containing the bananas. She picked up a box of bananas while still standing on the pallet, then attempted to step off the pallet. As she did so, her foot became entangled with the shrink wrap, causing her to fall to the floor and injure her hip.
An employee was loading packages into a trailer for 10 hours and began cramping throughout their body. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress and dehydration.
An employee tripped on a floor mat and fell to the floor, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee picked up concrete at a concrete plant and delivered it to a home. At an unknown point he suffered a concussion, apparently from slipping and bumping his head on a hard surface.
An employee turned 90 degrees to reach for a part, lost her balance, and fell to the floor. She injured her hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking between rooms, tripped and fell striking her head on the wall.
An employee was driving a forklift close to a stack of crates and his left hand was caught between the forklift's protective cage and the stacked crates causing a broken wrist.
An employee was throwing scrap glass into a dumpster. The glass hit the corner of the dumpster and bounced back, lacerating the employee's forearm.

An employee was attempting to clean a tank when the air distribution system was activated, causing the solution (hot water mixed with a 10% concentration of degreasing agent) in the tank to cavitate over the edge and land on the employee's neck, upper back, leg, right ankle, and chest. The employee suffered first and second degree burns.
An employee was stung by a bee during a delivery and suffered an allergic reaction.
An employee was operating a mechanical punch press, which caught the employee's left middle finger. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial vehicle while unloading cargo, suffering multiple right foot fractures.

An employee was trying to adjust a metal personnel door on a building that was being assembled. The door was not closing properly; he was pushing on the outside bottom of it, trying to adjust the fit, while another employee was on the inside trying to help him. The door closed unexpectedly, pinching the bottom of his right index finger in the jamb and cutting off the flesh below the nail.
An employee was working from a stepladder when it broke. In falling, he grabbed the steel rail of a garage door and his right hand was lacerated.
An employee fell to the pavement in a company parking lot, suffering contusions to the right arm and left knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An aircraft mechanic was working on the left wing of an F-18 aircraft removing a component section of the wing known as a flight control surface. During this process the employee pushed on a bolt with his finger. When the bolt moved, the employee's right index finger followed and was caught in a pinch point by the weight of the falling component. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was performing a quality control check on a loom and became lightheaded and lethargic. The ambient temperature was high and the employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was working on an overhead garage door opener. The employee's left index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was working on a work-over rig. The employee climbed onto a derrick, about 5 feet above the ground, then slipped and fell to the ground. The employee's left wrist was fractured.

An employee was sliding a part over a diamond hone when the reamer caught his heavy-duty glove. The glove was pulled in, and he suffered lacerations and possible fingertip amputations to his right index and middle fingers.

An employee was adjusting a bar sitting on two posts. When the employee moved the hook that the bar was hanging from the bar dropped one to two inches and struck the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was moving a pallet from one location to another when he struck an upright support beam for a racking system. His left hip struck the upright beam, resulting in a broken pelvis on his left side. He was hospitalized.
An employee was helping one of his co-workers move an extension ladder to another location when he felt a pain in his chest due to a possible muscle strain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a steel plate with an overhead crane when the employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught between the steel plate and a steel block, smashing the fingertips.

The injured employee was forming a semi tank trailer bulkhead when the bulkhead material failed and released air that dislodged the machine guarding shield. The shield struck the employee and knocked the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was cleaning a printing press after a press run. His gloved finger became stuck in the equipment. His left middle finger was crushed and had to be partially medically amputated.
An employee was working outside weed eating a pond area when he became dizzy and unresponsive due to heat stress and dehydration.
An employee was pushing a cart when he slipped on spilled liquid soap, fracturing his left ankle. He was hospitalized.

At about 2:00 p.m. on July 18, 2018, an employee had opened the top hatch of a heat exchanger hopper and was changing an air filter. The employee became unresponsive due to a lack of oxygen, possibly because nitrogen gas had displaced the oxygen.
An employee was laying poly pipes when he reached under the poly pipe and was bitten by a rattlesnake, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing the cap from a hot radiator. The cap exploded when the employee's wet towel touched it and hot radiator fluid burned the employee's face, neck and torso.
An employee was lowering a steel I-beam when the beam shifted, striking his chest. He suffered broken ribs and bleeding in the lungs. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered dehydration while working outside.

An employee was going to remove the tarp from a compactor. Another employee was unloading a roll-off container in the transfer station and didn't realize the injured employee was there. The injured employee's right leg was pinched between the roll-off container and the compactor, resulting in a right leg amputation.

An employee was performing manual labor to build a solar farm outside when he began feeling unwell and experienced severe cramps in his stomach, legs, neck, jaw, and hands. He was hospitalized for dehydration and kidney malfunction due to heat stress.

An employee was helping straighten out steel coils. Bands were in place to hold the coils; a hold-down bar was about to be lowered so that pressure could be applied to a coil and the bands would be further tightened. The bar was lowered while the employee's right hand was on top of the coil. His index fingertip was caught between the coil and the bar, resulting in an amputation.
The cable of a ladder hoist amputated two of an employee's fingers.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation while either opening or closing a glass door.
An employee was bitten on the left thigh by a brown recluse spider. The bite became infected and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a 12-passenger bus at the Hall of Fame Museum located at the Speedway. When the employee exited the bus to assist a passenger, the bus rolled and the employee was hit by the door. The employee then fell under the bus and the bus ran over the employee's chest and continued to roll approximately 25 feet before it struck a building. The employee sustained several rib fractures and a laceration that required stitches.
An employee was working from a scaffold and fell 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken shoulder, hand and pelvis.
An employee experienced severe heat cramps after hauling trash. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning pieces of metal from a catwalk and stairs into an automobile shredder when they began to feel ill and vomited. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee suffered heat cramps while delivering mail and was hospitalized.
An employee was fertilizing lawns and suffered heat stress symptoms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working at an oil well when his work truck failed to stay in park and rolled downhill, pinning him against a generator. His tibia and fibula were broken.
An employee was testing a coolant system when coolant sprayed from the radiator's open cap, burning his face, neck, chest, and arms.
An employee was assembling a sheave and amputated the left pinky fingertip when it was caught between the belt and the metal edge of the sheave groove.
An employee was engaged in various electrical installation activities throughout the day. That evening he began to feel ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was setting up a band saw for cutting round bar. While cleaning out the shavings, the clamp closed onto his left hand causing a partial amputation of the left pinky finger.

A employee was attempting to chisel through a tuyere on a cupola melt deck that had started to solidify. When he created a hole through the chilled iron, molten iron exploded out of the tuyere and struck him on the right side of his face and neck. As he moved out of the way, he tripped over a water pipe on the deck; he fell, striking his head on the metal deck and losing consciousness.
An employee was running a metal press when the material shifted, pinching his finger and amputating the tip.
An employee was painting a wall using a six-foot step ladder. The employee fell backwards off the ladder when the ladder wobbled and suffered a back injury.
An employee's fingers were pinched between a mold panel and the ground. Three of the employee's fingertips were amputated.
An employee was on a metal deck roof when he fell through a skylight to the concrete floor, about 15 feet below. He suffered a broken left femur and a laceration to the face.
On July 19, 2018, an employee was installing a brace assembly. While stretching over machinery, he sneezed and injured his back.

An employee was driving his forklift down a receiving aisle when it collided with another forklift. The employee's left leg was caught between the two forklifts, suffering a fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to unload liquid asphalt from the tanker truck into the storage tank at the asphalt plant. Hot oil splashed onto the employee after the cap was removed to hook up the hose. The employee sustained burns to the arms and shoulders (4.5% of his body). The safety valve was not closed at the time of the incident.

An employee was on the roof of a residential property cutting plywood with a circular saw. The employee lost his footing while operating a circular saw and the saw lacerated his left forearm. The laceration reached the artery and required surgery.
While welding a tab to the end of a pipe, an employee was struck in the head by another pipe that was being moved laterally by another employee. The employee suffered an epidural hematoma.

An employee was working from a scissor lift about 4 or 5 feet above the ground, removing R-panels from the outside of a tin building. He slipped, and his right hand contacted an exhaust fan mounted on a panel. The fan blade lacerated his right ring finger and partially amputated the nail bed on the little finger.
An employee was installing sod at a golf course when the sod installer ran over his left foot/ankle fracturing the ankle.

An employee was standing behind a gate in a cattle barn. Some cattle entered the barn and hit the gate, pushing the employee into a horizontal pipe and severely injuring his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing boxes from the conveyor belt and caught their left middle finger in a pinch point causing a deep laceration.
While operating a double pallet jack, an employee ran into a warehouse shelf. The employee was caught between the shelf and the jack and sustained lacerations to his legs.

An employee was riding in the basket of a bucket truck placing cable from pole to pole. As the truck advanced slowly along the ground, it struck a hole. As the truck moved out of the hole, it rocked and the employee fell from the bucket to the ground. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae and a spinal injury.

On July 19, 2018, an employee was operating a rebar bender. While attempting to correct a previous bend, the rebar bent back around itself and pinched the employee's finger resulting in a laceration requiring three stitches and a partial amputation.

Two employees were in an altercation in the breakroom. The FASI employee was struck in the face by a temporary employee, fell to the floor and sustained a fractured skull and a head wound that required staples. The injured employee also sustained internal bleeding and was hospitalized.
An employee was applying sealant to a duct from an 8-foot ladder. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken left leg that required surgery.
An employee was using an excavator to lift a pipe. The pipe slid off the sling and fell through the cab, striking and injuring the employee's right leg.
An employee fell while replacing a valve on a hydrus tank and injured their C6 and C7 vertebrae.
An employee was clearing a jam on the decaser machine and amputated the right pinky fingertip below the nail.
An employee was repairing a billboard and fell approximately four feet to the ground, resulting in a broken left leg.
An employee's foot was run over by a scaffold used alongside aircraft for maintenance repairs.
A temporary employee tripped on the corner of a pallet, falling to the floor and breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was assembling a hydraulic cylinder and rod assembly with the gland on it for a ram car. A crane was used to support the rod while it was partially lowered into the cylinder to start the gland. As the employee was pushing down on the gland to start engagement of the threads in the cylinder some slack was left in the chain holding the rod, allowing the rod to drop and pinch his fingertips between the rod eye and the gland. When the rod dropped down into the cylinder his right index and middle fingertips were pinched off between the rod eye and the gland.
Two employees were working at a table saw. The injured employee walked past and a 4x4 piece of wood that was being cut kicked back from the table saw and struck the injured employee in the eye.

An employee of Balfour Beatty was partway up a 12-foot A-frame ladder, working with a crew to put up steel canopies on a rail corridor expansion. A tack weld broke on the steel post that was being used to push a canopy up into position. The post struck the employee's ladder, causing him to fall about 5 feet. He hit his head in falling, suffering a possible concussion; he also suffered a fractured wrist and a cut on the neck from the post.
A temporary employee was cleaning behind the radial saw and contacted the saw blade causing a laceration to the right index finger and amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a long fork when he struck a metal rack. He was caught between the long fork and the rack, fracturing his left femur and the base of his spine.

An employee was jacking up a truck at a scale house on the interstate. He was underneath the truck trying to position the jack stand in the correct spot when the truck slipped off the jack and the jack handle hit him on its way to the ground. He suffered a fractured sinus.
On July 19, 2018, an employee was changing a sprocket wheel on a cold-forming header machine when the sprocket wheel turned and pinched his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On July 20, 2018, an employee tripped on a sidewalk and fell, suffering a fractured hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was throwing chains under a 4-foot bar. When he went to grab the hook, the bundle shifted and pinched his forearm between two bundles. He suffered a fractured forearm and muscle damage.
An employee walked for a quarter of a mile on foot escorting oversized loads. As he got back into his vehicle, he started having severe cramps and abdominal pain due to heat-related illness.
An employee was holding a motor while making adjustments. The belt and pulley caught the employee's left little finger, amputating the tip and causing an open fracture of the last joint.
An employee was operating a ramp service SUV when he crashed into a catering operations truck behind an airport gate. He fractured his ribs and neck, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking on the roof of a school, 20 feet above ground level. The employee fell through the gypsum roof deck and was injured requiring hospitalization. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis, ribs, right hip, tailbone, vertebrae, wrist, and humerus as well as nerve damage and temporary blindness.
While gathering hogs, an employee received a puncture wound in the leg from the tusks of a boar. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a knee injury and infection.
While cutting branches with a table saw, an employee suffered a severed little finger and severe lacerations to two other fingers.

An employee was mowing turf using a stand up riding mower when he struck a surface root and the mover overturned. He was hospitalized for severe damage to muscle and tissues of the arm and amputation of the right ring finger.

Two employees were about to weld two steel coils together. An employee was lining up the two pieces so that a clamp could come down to hold them. The clamp came down while the employee's left hand was still under it; his thumb was smashed and the tip was amputated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was tripping pipe out of a hole when his right hand was caught between the handle and the elevator, injuring his index and middle fingers.
An employee was walking on a 36" I-beam, uncovering it, when he lost his balance and fell five feet to the ground, hitting his head.
An employee was attempting to remove fibers from a mat cutter blade when it cut his right index fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was moving an aluminum sheet when it slipped. The employee attempted to grab it and the sheet lacerated the employee's right wrist.
An employee was cleaning out an onion slicer when the blade amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was driving an order picker by a parked pallet that had a portion of rail protruding into the lane of traffic. The employee did not see the protruding rail, which contacted the picking plate area of his order picker, causing the rail to swing around and strike his calf.

An employee was staging an air compressor that was set on a trailer in preparation to run a "pig" through a pipeline. The trailer wheels jumped the vehicle chocks and started to roll. The employee tried to grab the trailer to keep it from rolling. The employee fell to the ground and the jack stand for the trailer landed on the employee's legs. The employee suffered a fractured left leg and possible fracture to a right toe, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was preparing an HVAC unit for shutdown when the employee's left index finger became stuck between the HVAC unit's belt and sheave, resulting in an amputation of the finger.
An employee was washing a crane tire when it fell on his lower leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula.

An employee was scanning parcels outside of a delivery address when an axel broke on a large catering truck riding on the freeway and a tire flew off the vehicle, hitting the employee's face, head, and chest. The employee suffered a broken nose, broken ribs on both sides, and broken vertebrae.
An employee's finger was caught between a door and a door frame when the door closed on her hand, smashing her index finger. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
At about 10:35 a.m. , an employee was mowing grass in a playground when he became ill. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee was conducting a training exercise with a canine unit when he suddenly felt a shortness of breath and dizziness. He was hospitalized for dehydration and renal failure.
An employee's foot was caught between a truck's lift gate and the truck when the gate was raised. The employee's right big toe was amputated.
An employee was using a powered can opener. When the opener activated, it put pressure on her little finger, partially amputating it.

An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift when his right ring finger was caught between the forks and the mast of the forklift. His right ring finger was severely lacerated, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While walking on the shop floor, an employee tripped on a motor guard and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell 12 feet while decking a first floor resulting in broken ribs, a fractured wrist and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was using a ladder to retrieve material from a top shelf. The employee fell, suffering an injury to the left ankle.

An employee was walking down the stairs with two trays of food. The employee missed a step, dropped a tray of food and reached for the handrail. Her right arm went between the wall and handrail and her right forearm was fractured in two places.
An employee was using a walk-behind mower on an incline. The employee tripped over a rock, and the mower ran over the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a personal elevator when it moved to level itself to the floor and caught his foot in a pinch point, crushing his foot and breaking two toes.

An employee was working inside a tractor trailer during a delivery when he lost his balance and fell from the open door of the tractor trailer, landing on the lift gate support. He suffered three fractured right-side ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was sanding a thin piece of metal on a table disc sander when a metal piece and the tip of the employee's right thumb were pulled into the gap between the disc and the table. The tip of the employee's thumb was amputated.

A temporary foundry employee was sitting in the break room to seek relief from the heat when he vomited and lost consciousness. He fell out of his seat and hit his head on the ground, suffering head trauma. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was walking when a customer's child ran into her, causing her to fall to the floor. She broke her right hip and right shoulder.
An employee was exiting a service truck when he shut the door on his left middle finger, smashing his fingertip and resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was doing preventive maintenance on an air handling unit. The employee's right ring finger was caught between a belt and pulley, leading to a partial amputation above the first joint.
An employee was assisting to subdue a patient when they fell and struck their head on the floor causing a subdural hematoma.

An employee was using an overhead crane to remove a scrap box (2,800 pounds) when the hook disengaged during the lift. The handle (which weighs about 500 pounds) then hit his leg, breaking his right tibia.

An employee was in a lift with a blasting hose that was tied to the lift basket so the employee could work at an elevated position. During this time, the hose was charged, activating the discharge of shot blast. This caused the hose to whip around violently while discharging grit. The blasting nozzle struck the employee's face and shot blast was embedded in his face.

Two maintenance employees were working on a compressor inside an exhauster building, tightening screws on the valves/pistons. The outside cover was removed on this unit to gain access to the set screws. One employee left the area and the other employee continued to work when a flash explosion occurred. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to the face and arms.
On July 21, 2018, an employee shut the sliding door of a mail truck on their hand, causing a laceration that required surgery.
An employee felt ill and was hospitalized with symptoms of dehydration.
An employee was adjusting material on a tail stretcher when his right index finger was caught in the tail stretcher's clamp, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was unloading furniture from a truck to a dumpster when an armoire fell on the employee's left hand, resulting in a finger amputation.

On July 21, 2018, at approximately 11:15, an employee was getting up from her desk when her foot was caught under her desk and she fell to the floor, striking her head and suffering a spinal injury. She was hospitalized.

Employees were on site cleaning up after a benefit event when an employee lost control while rolling a table. The table then hit a second employee and caused her to fall to the floor, fracturing her pelvis.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut two-by-fours. The saw kicked back, causing the amputation of the employee's left thumb.

An employee was attempting to remove a piece of structural steel from around a furnace. He stepped down, then tripped and fell approximately 20 feet down a chute to the ground, dislocating his right shoulder. His harness was unhooked at the time of the incident.

An employee was cleaning a distributor belt when the belt was manually moved forward and pinched the employee's foot between a cog and track (rail). The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right small toe to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting a piece of dealt paper with a box cutter when the blade cut through the paper and lacerated his knee.
An employee was picking furniture with a lift when a piece of furniture fell from above, striking the employee in the head.

An employee was completing a tooling repair on a set of trim dies. While he was maneuvering the trim component, he slipped and his left ring finger was caught between the two die components. He suffered a severe laceration and fracture to the fingertip.
An employee slipped on spilled fuel and fell, striking their head on concrete. The employee suffered brain swelling.
An employee was shocked while plugging in a vacuum cleaner, suffering an injury to the right hand.

An employee was changing a bottom hole assembly and laying down a stabilizer and pony sub. Nearby rig hands could not get a pipe to a trowel. He saw they were in trouble with the pipe and attempted to help get the pipe to the trowel, but the driller did not land the pipe in the trowel. The pipe landed on the edge and rolled out, pinching him against a frame and stabilizer. He fractured his scapula and the spinous processes on his vertebrae.

On 7/22/2018, an employee was moving  a piece of equipment when his left thumb was smashed between it and another piece of equipment. As he attempted to pull his thumb out, his left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was performing start-up activities when piping failed and hot process condensate water caused second degree burns to 20% of the employee's body (torso and legs).

An employee was checking the vacuum on a machine when he noticed that the water level was getting high in the slurry. He discovered that pellets were clumping together; when he tried to stir the water, he received an electrical shock caused by a wire that had shorted out. He suffered head and neck pain and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking toward a disconnect to de-energize a plant air compressor that was making an odd noise when an oil line (that supplied lubrication for the compressor) burst, spraying hot oil onto the employee. He suffered burn injuries to his back, left forearm, and shoulder blade.

At about 8:10 a.m., an employee was working at a saw unload station when fingers on his left hand were pinched between two heavy parts. He suffered lacerations and a partial fingertip amputation to the middle finger.

An employee was standing on an extension ladder 16 feet above ground and pulling wire through a conduit when the wire broke, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the concrete floor. He broke his left and right heels, as well as his L3 vertebra.
On July 22, 2018, an employee was operating a roller on golf course turf when it hit a rock and rolled over. The employee suffered shoulder and sternum injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after fainting due to work stress.
An employee stepped up to enter a guard shack, lost balance, and fell onto a concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was struck by a falling tree limb while standing on a sidewalk in preparation for powerline work. He suffered an L1 vertebra fracture and seven broken ribs.
On July 22, 2018, an employee tripped and fell to the ground while bringing up mushrooms for a price check. The employee suffered a fracture to the left hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a walk-behind pallet jack when he bumped a stack of pallets with his left arm, causing him to lose his balance. He then fell and fractured his right hip.

An employee was adjusting a tube-bending machine when the machine cycled, causing a partial amputation to the tip of the employee's right ring finger. The machinery was not locked out at the time of the incident, and blocks designed for it were not being used.

An employee was using a prybar to help another employee remove a quick coupler from a wheel. When the coupler came free, it landed on the employee's right foot, breaking every toe. The employee was hospitalized. Steel-toed boots were not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was stripping concrete forms in a lube oil sump. The temporary 2x4 handrails failed, and the employee fell 12 feet to a lower level, fracturing ribs and injuring parts of his spine.
An employee was walking into a day room when she slipped and fell on a wet floor that was just recently mopped. She fell on her left knee and fractured her kneecap.

An employee was acting as a ground guide for a rough-terrain forklift that was loading material onto a flatbed truck. The forklift's boom came into contact with overhead power lines while the employee was touching the forklift. The employee suffered electrical burns to his hands and feet.
An employee was walking on a carpeted floor when she tripped and fell to the same level, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was doing preventive maintenance on a fan belt. The motor to the belt started, and the fan blade amputated the employee's right little finger. The disconnect was off at the time of the incident.

An electrical crew was about to jump out a potted porcelain cutout that had cracked. An employee was under the cutout, preparing the jumper, when the bottom of the cutout broke free. It hit the employee in the jaw, causing jaw and ear injuries.

An employee was using a three-step stepladder to hand a blind into a nursing care resident's room. The employee fell from the ladder, breaking their left tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing metal chips or shavings from a horizontal band saw cutting table when his gloved hand made contact with the saw blade. His hand was pulled into the blade and drive wheel, resulting in an amputation of his right pinky finger at approximately the second joint.

An employee was at a log deck area when a log got hung up on the deck. When the log was lifted and placed down on the deck, the employee's right index finger was caught between it and a piece of support metal. The employee suffered a crushed finger and an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a saw to cut 4" off of a 4" diameter pipe when their left index finger contacted the blade causing a partial amputation.

An employee was installing a bread handling machine. A crane was lifting the steel frame from the bread handler when the cables lifting the frame broke. The frame struck the employee, breaking the employee's pelvis and arm.
An employee was standing on a 2-foot platform that has rails on three sides, reaching for strips of lumber to come out of a rip saw, when he fell on the ground. He broke his left wrist and hip.
An employee was walking when she fell off a loading dock platform to the ground, requiring hospitalization for contusions to the right wrist and head.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken hand due to a machine injury.
An employee was standing in front of a wooden pallet, preparing to position a box on it. The employee bent over and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right ankle.

On 07/23/18, an employee was working with a grinder and low carbon cast steel shot that contained iron, manganese, carbon, and silica. He experienced respiratory issues and leg and foot swelling. He was hospitalized for congestive heart failure.

An employee was threading paper on an inner folding machine's rollers. At the same time, another employee began turning the manual hand wheel to turn the rollers. The injured employee struggled to position the paper and reached around the vacuum drum to help thread the paper when his hand contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The blade was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was making a wooden pallet. With a nail gun in his right hand, he picked up a board with his left hand. The nail gun discharged, shooting a nail into his left wrist.
An employee fell while walking away from a register, suffering a broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a lift to move a pallet of plywood when the forks extended to another stack. When the lift started to lift the intended pallet, the subsequent stack behind it started to lift and tilt and then fell. An employee walking nearby was caught under the pallet of plywood and suffered a fractured skull, two broken ribs and lacerations.
An employee was walking by a cart when a box fell off the cart and landed on the employee's foot, breaking it.

On 07/23/2018, at approximately 8:55 AM, an employee slipped and fell approximately 4 feet off a flatbed while attempting to secure a dozer that had recently been loaded on the flatbed. The employee suffered a fractured hip and shattered foot. It was raining at the time of the incident.

An employee was positioning blankets and a dolly in the bed of a truck when the driver entered the cab and started to pull forward, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall approximately 4 feet to the ground. He broke his right foot.
An employee was operating a press when the feeder jammed and the product did not advance. The feeder cycled, partially amputating the employee's right thumb.
An employee was injured at the worksite and hospitalized.

An employee was hooking a cable from a truck to a dumpster, preparing to raise and empty the dumpster. His left index finger was pinched between the trunnion bar on the dumpster and the guide plate on the truck, and partially severed.

An employee was carrying a pitcher with a heavy-duty caustic liquid cleaner (containing 50% sodium hydroxide) to a large drum. The liquid spilled onto his legs, causing third-degree chemical burns to his ankles/shins. He was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was operating a powered industrial truck and went to dump garbage. After approximately 10 minutes, he was found on his back on the ground. He was hospitalized with skull, neck, and spine fractures.
An employee was moving hardwood cants when his right last finger was crushed between two cants.

An employee was showing an apprentice how to lock down the metal to a cut-off saw machine when the machine was engaged as he was placing his right index finger on a slot. His finger was caught between the slot and the machine's chain, resulting in the amputation of his right index fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was replacing the bearings on an icing station machine's belt as part of regular preventive maintenance when the shaft came off from the other side and tilted against the frame, catching the employee's thumb between the shaft and frame. The employee's left thumb was smashed, resulting in a partial amputation with bone loss.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when it shifted to one side. The employee's hand came into contact with wires, which cut his right middle, ring, and little fingers.

An employee was installing the bolt inside a tank's counterweight, which was held by a chain, when the chain suddenly broke. His left arm was then caught between the counterweight and the inner tank, resulting in a left arm amputation.

An employee was performing maintenance on an air bladder. The employee was connecting the air bladder when the conveyor started. The employee's arm became caught in the conveyor and the employee suffered a broken arm.

A temporary employee was driving a tugger to retrieve a case of product when he stepped off the tugger and suffered a left leg laceration, requiring hospitalization. The tugger had not stopped moving at the time of the incident.

An employee was changing the membrane for a reverse osmosis system when someone pushed the membrane into the tube. The employee's hand was then caught between the membrane and the tube, resulting in a right middle finger amputation.
An employee was attacked in the store by a person wielding a machete. The employee was stabbed several times and required hospitalization.
An employee was fitting metal baskets together with an overhead gantry crane when his left ring finger was caught between baskets, severely lacerating the front and back of his left ring fingertip.
An employee was bitten by a dog belonging to a resident at a nursing care facility.
An employee was preparing to unload the trailer on his tanker when his foot was caught in a tangled cable on the ground. He fell to the ground, breaking his right hip.
An employee was helping a crew lift a welded steel beam that came apart and fell. The beam hit a metal pipe that then hit the employee's lower leg, fracturing and lacerating it.
An employee was delivering mail when he felt faint. He went to his vehicle and had a hard time breathing. He was hospitalized with dehydration, dizziness and weakness from heat exposure.
An employee was cleaning using a hot water pressure washer. The safety switch on the pressure washer failed causing a release of steam that burned the employee's right arm near the elbow.
An employee was installing solar rails on a building roof. The employee was shocked by electricity flowing from the line to the ground, suffering injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
While reaching for a paper towel dispenser, an employee lost balance and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a cutoff wheel when the portable tool kicked back and the blade lacerated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was holding a 5-gallon bucket while its lid was being cut off with a bandsaw. The saw lacerated the employee's left wrist.
While wiping store shelving, an employee fell from a ladder to the floor. The employee suffered a fractured left wrist, requiring surgery.
An assembly mechanic was reinstalling an aircraft wing when his fingers were crushed. He suffered a potential amputation of the right middle finger.

An employee climbed up a ladder to reach an operator's platform to show the operator how to push buttons for a loader. As the employee was descending from the platform ladder, he twisted his body and suffered a lower back strain.
An employee started feeling ill during a trash pickup and threw up. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.

An employee was applying grease by hand to holes that a 
hoist pin travels through when the pin engaged and pinched his left index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The vehicle was running at the time.
An employee spent the work day inspecting roofs in high temperatures. At the end of the day he felt exhausted, and was hospitalized for possible heat-related illness.
An employee opened a radiator cap to add water to the radiator. Hot fluid sprayed out, burning his abdomen, an ear, and his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a turret truck that hit a piece of wood. While bending to retrieve the wood, he felt pain in his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding a truck to a loading dock when the truck pinned him against the dock. He suffered two broken legs and a fractured pelvis, as well as possible knee injuries.
An employee was standing in a workstation producing an industrial hose when his right index finger became caught in a wire roll, resulting in an amputation of his fingertip at the first knuckle.

An employee was getting off a creeper, moving from lying to standing; the employee's knee twisted and the employee felt a pop. The employee had suffered a ruptured artery in the right knee/leg and was hospitalized the next day, undergoing surgery.

An employee was performing home health care services in a resident's private home when the employee fell down a set of wet stairs and experienced internal bleeding, contusions, and a bruised spine, hip, and buttocks. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to move a 30-inch floor fan. The fan blade caught and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was up on a ladder grabbing a rug off a shelf when the employee's hand slipped and the employee fell down the ladder to the ground, suffering a right ankle fracture.
An employee fell into an excavation. The employee was in the excavation for about an hour and suffered dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving steel plates with an overhead crane when a piece slipped off the chain and struck the employee's foot/ankle.
An employee was lining up a 1-inch pipe when his finger entered the pipe as it was rolling and was lacerated.

An employee was cutting grass on a low sloped area using a riding lawn mower. The mower slipped on wet grass, but did not overturn. The employee jumped off the mower and landed near the discharge chute. The mower blade caused a laceration to the employee's right hand and wrist.

An employee was changing out the knife of a wood planer. After shutting down the machine, his hand entered it before the knife had completely stopped. As a result, his right hand had to be medically amputated to the wrist.
An employee was hospitalized with chest pain due to work-related stress.
An employee was trying to remove a pin from a set of tracks using a hydraulic ram. The ram shifted and struck the employee in the abdomen, causing internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was confronting a former employee in the parking lot when a physical altercation occurred and the employee suffered a head wound.

An employee was operating a carton sealing machine when a box lid got hung up on the advancer conveyor and jammed. The employee reached over to correct the jam, and the employee's finger contacted the conveyor or rollers. The pad of the employee's left middle finger was amputated.

An employee was installing a TPO membrane on the edge of a flat roof and as he was about to throw out some garbage, he slipped and fell 10 feet from the roof into the dumpster. He fractured his wrist and lacerated his right eyebrow, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was rewiring a power line pole when the back of his right hand touched the 7,200-volt tap line. He suffered second-degree burns to his right hand and an exit wound on the left side of his torso.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor fracturing her right ankle. She was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a hot glue gun machine while assembling a steel door when the employee noticed an odor. A second, maintenance employee was called to inspect the ventilation system in the area. The two employees were hospitalized due to respiratory issues.
An employee was cutting felt paper for a mold using a box cutter and amputated the left index fingertip.

An employee was on a 12-foot step ladder getting ready to strap up a flexible conduit on a light fixture. When he grabbed the flexible conduit, he was shocked by ~277 volts and fell off the ladder to the ground, fracturing his L3 vertebra.
An employee was setting up a machine when moving parts caught his thumb tip, resulting in a soft tissue amputation.
An employee was trying to remove a jam from a soup dispenser packaging line. The employee's right little finger was caught in the mechanism and the tip was amputated.
An employee was pulling a 5-gallon glass water bottle out from a holder. The bottle shattered, lacerating the employee's right little finger and severing nerves and two arteries in his hand.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a part from a press shop shear when the shear struck the employee's right hand, amputating four fingers.

An employee was on the roof of a house, securing overhead electrical service to a mast. The mast failed and broke off from the attachment point, causing the employee to fall from the roof. The employee suffered a broken left femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was placing a weight on top of a mold. The weight slipped off, striking the employee on the left foot. The employee then hit his head against the metal flask surrounding the mold. He suffered a crushing injury to the foot and a fracture to the forehead and sinus area, and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on water on the floor while walking in a commercial kitchen, fracturing an ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was retrieving his tools when he suffered a right pinky fingertip injury that later resulted in an amputation.
An employee was cleaning a grout machine when his hand entered the machine. The paddles grabbed and dislocated his index finger. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was trying to get a shrink-wrapped pallet out of a trailer, using the truck's lift gate and a pallet jack. He fell about 3 feet to the ground, landing on his back and injuring his back/shoulder/neck area. He suffered a possible fracture in his back.
An employee was lighting a burn pile with gas when it exploded, causing second degree burns to his arms and legs.
An employee was manually lifting a steel manhole cover when it fell on his left foot. He suffered a fracture of his left foot metatarsal bone, requiring hospitalization.

A forklift operator picked up a hollow core so an employee could put dunnage underneath it. The hollow core was rigged with hooks when it broke and fell on the employee's thumbs, breaking and spraining both of them.
An employee was removing doors from an oil and gas treater with an electric impact gun. His tool arced and lit the gas in the room on fire, causing severe burns to both of his arms.
An employee was using a small handheld grinder to grind drain grates when the grinder lacerated the back of the employee's right leg.
An employee was working on the brakes of a school bus using needle nose pliers. The plier slipped and impaled the employee's right eye.
An employee was building an excavator bucket when the 130-pound bucket slid off the work bench and landed on his foot, amputating a portion of his right little toe.

An employee was helping to adjust the alignment of a pneumatic cutter. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the cutter's cylinder and a spacer block attachment amputating  two joints of the finger.

An employee was replacing gaskets on a disc stack centrifuge and using a specialized tool to pull the disc stack when the employee's left ring finger was caught between the tool and the stack, resulting in a partial distal amputation of the left ring fingertip.
At approximately 3:15 p.m. on 25 July 2018, an employee was cutting pipe with a saw when the saw lacerated his knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning paper donuts from a scrap conveyor when his hand contacted the underside of the conveyor and was caught in the moving part. He fractured his right radius.

An employee went into the produce cooler to load up stock. The employee was pulling stock off a rack that had previously been hit by a pallet or jack when the product rack fell and hit the employee. The employee suffered a sprained ankle.

An employee was using a push cart when her right pinky fingertip (5th digit) was pinched and smashed between the cart she was using and another cart in the area. Her fingertip had to be medically amputated.
While backing up with a clothes rack, an employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
A worker was hospitalized due to electrical flash burns.

An employee was aloft in an insulated bucket, freeing an unpowered secondary wire from a snag in a tree. His shoulder touched the primary wire above him, causing electricity to pass through his left arm and exit through his left hand. He sustained third degree burns to the left shoulder and had exit wounds on his thumb area and between his ring and middle fingers. Personal protective equipment was not being worn at the time of the incident.
While counting money, an employee had an allergic reaction to an unknown substance, suffering tongue swelling.
An employee was helping load interior/exterior doors into a van trailer. He jumped from the dock to the concrete less than 4 feet below, breaking his right leg in two places.

An employee was driving from a pest control service location. Suffering from heat-related dehydration, the employee drove off the road and into a fence. The employee was also observed vomiting on the accident scene. He was hospitalized for dehydration and kidney failure.

An employee was trying to clean built-up product from the sensor/photo eye of the conveyor on a weigh blend system, which was failing to start after being calibrated. The tray of the conveyor actuated, and the tray's reciprocating motion caught the employee's arm, fracturing the left humerus. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a forklift when its forks hit a trench plate. The employee fell into the forklift's shield, suffering a head contusion and neck pain. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting a new battery to the floor machine when it sparked and caused a fire. The employee sustained an electric shock and burns to the right index finger and palm.

After measuring a hot forging using calipers, an employee turned and was walking away when the forging came loose of the manipulator and hit the back of his left leg, fracturing his ankle and causing second degree burns on his leg.

An employee was carrying a 5-gallon bucket filled with 3 gallons of a chemical containing 77 to 100 percent sulfuric acid, preparing to add it to an anodizing tank. He tripped and the acid splashed out of the bucket, burning his torso area.
An employee was trimming vegetable roots with a harvesting knife. The knife lacerated his finger.
An employee was struck by an excavator bucket while backfilling a rock wall, suffering a back injury.
An employee slipped and fell backwards while moving a couch, suffering a lumbar compression fracture.
An employee was using a cart to deliver bags of coins to a bank. The employee's fingertip was amputated between the cart handle and the ground.
An employee fell from a ladder and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after being bitten by a resident.

An employee was installing electronic equipment on an electronics rack when the rack came loose from the wall and fell on the employee's head. The employee suffered bruising, abrasions, a nerve injury, head injuries, and vertebra injuries to the upper neck and back.

An employee was attempting to unjam a piece of ash edging that was stuck between the belt and frame of an edging machine when the machine pulled employee's hand back into the frame, resulting in three finger amputations.

An employee was removing items from a top stock ladder when the employee missed a step, lost balance, and fell off the top stock ladder, landing on the floor and suffering a right wrist fracture and elbow bruise.
While helping with the load on a forklift, an employee tripped and fell. The forklift ran over the employee's left foot, breaking bones.

On July 25, 2018, an employee was reaching around a tube to back a wax applicator out because it was applying too much wax when the employee's finger was caught between the wax applicator and the tube, resulting in a distal amputation to the right index fingertip. The equipment was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was plastering on the floor when he fell about 20 feet to the ground below, sustaining shoulder fissures. A safety railing was installed at the time of the incident.
An employee was going up in a bucket truck when he fell approximately 10 feet out of the bucket and injured his back/spinal cord.

An employee was working from a step ladder to repair a hole on a shipping container. While climbing down the 8-foot step ladder to retrieve a new battery for the grinder, the ladder and the employee fell to the ground below. The employee sustained a concussion and fracture of the spine.
An employee was working on an electric panel when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee on his face, arms, and torso.

After cleaning a mixing machine that was locked out, an employee was going to remove the safety chain that held the sliding door in place when the chain broke and struck the employee's nose. The employee suffered a broken nose and an eye injury.
An employee was operating a router when his hand slipped and his right index finger was caught in the router blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a split saw bench when the bench came down on him. He suffered a broken shoulder and laceration. There was no block in place at the time of the incident.
An employee was performing concrete work when he fell in a hole that had a piece of rebar in it and was impaled. He suffered internal injuries.
An employee was moving boxes with a stock picker. The employee backed into a box in the aisleway and fractured his ankle.
An employee was conducting landscape work when a moving automobile hit the employee, who suffered a broken neck, ribs, and skull.
An employee was descending a ladder when it slipped, causing him to fall to the ground. He fractured his right ankle.
An employee became dehydrated due to heat stress while working.
An employee was moving material in a cart when a part closed on the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation to a finger on the left hand.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder. The employee fell about 6 feet to the concrete floor, landing on their head and suffering an injury that required 16 stitches.
An employee was lowering a pump when his finger was caught between a block and cable. He suffered a right ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to install gutter guards on a house. The employee fell 10 feet from the ladder to the ground, breaking his left ankle and right heel.
An employee was drawing meloxicam out of a bottle and poked her thumb with the needle. The employee woke up the next day and her hand was swollen. She was hospitalized for infection and surgery.

On 7/26/2018, an employee's finger was caught in an auger, resulting in a right middle finger amputation at the first digit. On 7/28/2018, an employee's fingers were caught in a belt and pulley powered by an electric motor, resulting in an amputation of the left index and middle fingers at the second knuckle. This record contains two separate events that were reported simultaneously to OSHA by the employer. These events are captured as one report.
An employee was attempting to repair a string break on the head of a twisting machine when the machine's mandrel amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.

An employee entered a supply area and opened flaps. An open valve from a draining stack and bell emitted carbon monoxide vapors into the supply area; the employee suffered carbon monoxide poisoning and lost consciousness.

An employee was performing maintenance on a service drop line from an extension ladder when the employee fell between 15 and 20 feet from the ladder to the ground, suffering fractured vertebrae and a punctured lung.
An employee was cleaning the tracks of a bulldozer when he fell to the pavement and suffered an intestinal injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee was fabricating a shop aid out of aluminum sheet metal. While he was using a manual, foot-operated shear, his left ring fingertip was caught under a material clamp on the shear, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured hip.

An employee was pushing a money tray into a safe when his right middle finger was caught between the dummy door (which hid the money) and the bottom of the safe. The tip of his right middle finger was amputated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading asphalt milling onto a state highway from a dump truck. The dump truck rolled over onto the driver's side and the employee sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was stepping off a forklift onto soft, wet soil and turned his ankle. The ankle fractured.
An employee was working in a building and suffered an allergic reaction to a chemical and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a piece of chicken on a hook to run through a cutter/saw machine. The machine caught his right hand, partially amputating his right index finger.

An employee lost his footing on wet grass as a rear-loader truck (garbage truck) was drifting backwards. The tire of the truck ran over his right foot, causing a contusion and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing a wood scrap from a table saw when the saw blade caught his left hand. His left index and middle fingers were severed at the first knuckle. The safety guard was not in place at the time.
An employee was attempting to get lifting straps underneath a 2,100-pound steel part when the part came off the straps and crushed two of his left-hand fingers.
An employee tripped over a bag on the floor and fractured her hip, requiring hospitalization.
While cutting away brush, an employee picked up a piece of brush that had a brush cutter attached to it. The blade cut his left hand.
While an employee was feeding lumber into a saw, the employee's fingers were trapped between the wood and the feed chain and amputated.
An employee was using a hammer drill to drill a hole in a concrete floor when he struck a 480-volt electrical line. He suffered burns and bodily injuries in the resulting blast.
An employee fell from the rear of a trailer to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was walking around the job site supervising the work activities of the other employees. A telescopic boom lift was lifting a piece of metal to an elevated location when the piece of metal fell from the boom lift and struck the injured employee in the head and upper torso areas. The employee suffered a head laceration and fractured collarbone, requiring hospitalization.
A floor scraper's blade cut the palm of an employee's right hand.

An employee was preparing to work on a heavy roll press. He was setting down a 3-inch roll when his right index finger was caught between the roll and the cradle where the roll was going to be rested. He suffered an amputation to the tip of his right index finger, just above the nail bed.
An employee was laying 4x4 dunnage on the ground to set cargo and felt light headed, had stomach cramps and blurred vision. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was unplugging a welder. The prongs of the plug arced to the breaker box and the employee was shocked.
An employee was preparing to load a truck. As the truck backed up, it crushed the employee against the loading dock, injuring the employee's back.
An employee fell down a five-step staircase and broke his right leg in three places.
An employee was cutting plywood and the saw blade amputated the left pinky finger.
An employee was moving a 700 lb. cylinder with an appropriate lifting device when the cylinder fell on him, causing chest and leg contusions. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when his hand went between a rack and the forklift, crushing his finger.
An employee's right hand was caught in the point of operation of a CNC tube bender. The employee suffered amputations to the right ring and little fingers.
On 07/26/2018, at approximately 12:00 PM, an employee was standing on a rock during his lunch break when he fell off and broke his right leg, requiring hospitalization.
On July 26, 2018, an employee was preparing a truck for loading by moving straps off the deck. The employee fell from the deck to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was cleaning the front foot separator saw when their foot was caught in the pull chain causing an open fracture and amputation of his right lower leg.
An employee tripped and fell to the same level while walking to the facility from getting the mail, suffering a broken hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a 2-inch hose on a concrete walkway when he tripped on a parked forklift fork. He fractured his right hip and was hospitalized.
A pickup truck rolled and pinched an employee between it and an oil truck. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the lower extremities.

An employee was working atop a 7-foot-high refrigerator case, spackling a sheet rock column. He was about to climb down when he tripped on debris and fell to the concrete floor, suffering severe injuries including six broken vertebrae and two broken collarbones. He was hospitalized.
At 7:30 a.m., an employee began work with an asphalt crack sealing team. At 2:30 p.m., he had begun to suffer severe leg cramps due to heat and dehydration. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a breader's main drive belt motor from its gearbox. When the motor released from the gear box, it fell, crushing the employee's left ring fingertip between the bottom of the motor and the framework of the breader. The finger tip was subsequently medically amputated.

An employee was placing a weighted mold onto a molding machine when the mold became stuck on a bolt. As the employee attempted to push the mold off the bolt, it crushed and lacerated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was using a table saw to cut molding. His hand slipped and the saw blade partially amputated a finger.
An employee was cleaning a mixer with a hammer. The hammer bounced back, hitting him in the face and fracturing bones beneath his eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell into a sump of boiling water, suffering second degree burns from the waist down.

An employee was changing out the anode on a treater shack when the anode, which was under pressure, struck the employee's waist. The employee's torso twisted and the employee sustained a broken leg. The wrong line on the treater shack was locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was transiting between units within the hospital when the employee slipped on a wet floor and fell to the ground, fracturing the left patella and requiring hospitalization.
On July 27, 2018, a lineman fell while guiding a steel tower foundation leg in place. His thumb was caught in a pinch point in the tower frame, suffering a fracture.

An employee was trying to grind corn using a table grinder. The grinder's jar came off; while the employee tried to reconnect it to the base, the grinder lacerated her right middle and ring fingers. The grinder was running at the time.
An employee was helping two dock workers to upright a power jack that had overturned.  While uprighting the jack, his middle fingertip was amputated and required stitches.
An employee had closed a plug valve halfway with a valve bar when he immediately felt a sharp pain in his lower back due to bulging discs that caused a pinched nerve.

An employee was attempting to pull a 12" die when a synthetic web sling that was being hoisted by an overhead crane slid unexpectedly back down the shaft of the die, catching an employee's left thumb between the sling and the die. The employee's left thumb was amputated.

On July 27, 2018, an employee was working from an elevated basket platform. The platform lowered and contacted the item she was working on. Her thumb was pinched between the basket and the item, resulting in a partial amputation.
While signaling a crane operator, an employee fell through an opening and landed on the floor of a container ship, about 25 feet below. He suffered fractures in his leg, hip, ribs, and right arm.

An employee was leaving a mobile scaffold platform while holding a tower section that had just been unbolted. The employee and the tower section fell to the ground about 3 feet below, landing on an outrigger and suffering four broken ribs and blood in the lungs.
An employee was draining an oil hose when the hose broke and a spill occurred. He took a step and slipped, falling on and breaking his hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was working on a elevated machine platform and fell off onto the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun to nail 2x8 boards together when his right leg bumped the nail gun. The gun then discharged a nail into his right leg, striking his bone.
An employee was drying a pump outlet pipe with a towel. The pump's turning blades caught the employee's finger, amputating it to the first joint.
An employee was pushing a board through a manual chop saw, controlled by a foot pedal. As he was adjusting the board, the saw blade amputated his left index finger. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut expansion board material when his right index finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation at the bottom of his fingernail.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground and sustained a head injury, broken ribs and a punctured lung.
Two employees were sliding a metal grate along a stationary floor. One employee's left middle fingertip was pinched between the sliding grate and another grate, suffering a fingertip amputation.
While replacing a fluorescent two-by-four light fixture with an LED fixture, an employee was shocked and fell off a 6-foot ladder (likely from the third rung) to the ground.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and maneuvering it to park in the battery charging area when the pallet jack struck a pipe. The sudden stop caused the employee to fall from the lift to the concrete floor and fracture a hip.

An employee was on an orchard ladder approximately 10 feet above ground level, using an 8-foot long pole to prune tree branches, when he lost his balance and fell to the ground. He suffered rib and pelvic injuries.
An employee's left hand was crushed by the hydraulic clamp on a drilling machine.
On July 27, 2018, a police officer collapsed due to heat-related dehydration while taking a firearms training course. The officer was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell down and a road grader hit him, breaking his pelvis.

After prepping a patient's blood sample, an employee was walking toward the waiting room to call another patient when she fell on the floor and could not get up. She was hospitalized with a shoulder injury.
An employee was working on a roof above the ceiling pulling cables when his hands were burned on a hot pipe. He then fell and broke some bones and was in serious condition.
An employee went over a fence and struck his head against the ground. He was hospitalized.
After being sprayed with brake cleaner, an employee suffered second-degree burns when the cleaner was ignited with a lighter.
An employee fell down stairs, breaking her ankle. She was hospitalized.

An employee was working in the pit pulling impurities in the trough while facing backwards. The molten metal splashed and burned the employee's left leg. The employee received first and second degree burns to the thigh and calf areas.
On July 28, 2018, a concrete truck driver was climbing the ladder attached to his truck when he fell to the ground, breaking his ribs. He was hospitalized.

At about 8:30 a.m. on July 28, 2018, an employee was trapped by the boom of a skid steer while trying to help another employee change the skid steer's forks. The employee suffered eight broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a pasta machine when it amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was washing a spray dryer unit. The rotary valve caused the amputation of the employee's index and middle fingertips.
An employee was forming aluminum sheets in a press brake when he suffered the amputation of the tip of the fingernail and skin on right index finger.

An employee was undertaking a washout task on a skid when a hydrocarbon release was ignited by an unknown source. A flash fire burned the employee's lower back, face, neck, and hands. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was descending from one deck level to another in a ship. The employee slipped and fell about 4 feet to the bottom of the stairwell. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and fibula, as well as a small cut under the left eye and a contusion to the right lower back.
An employee was struck by a roof truss, suffering head injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

On July 28, 2018, an employee was in a tree trying to rescue an injured eagle. The employee slipped and a large branch struck her shin, fracturing her tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was stocking produce in a store's cooler when someone stabbed her in the back. She suffered a laceration/puncture wound and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet hallway floor and fell, fracturing her knee. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working from an order picker at about four feet high. She fell off the order picker and broke several ribs.

An employee was leaving a top bunk. As he swung his legs over the edge of the bunk, the fitted sheet caught his leg and he fell, striking his right knee on the tile floor. He suffered a spiral fracture of the distal femur.

An employee was walking backwards, helping carry a section of perforating gun string to the gun stands on the ground. He tripped over a stand, falling backwards to the ground. The gun string came down on his right hand, breaking and lacerating his right ring and little fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a motor when it shifted, causing an amputation to the employee's left middle fingertip.
An electrician was working on electrical equipment in the motor room when he was shocked and burned on his hands. He was hospitalized.
An employee cleaned a shower area with a multipurpose spray cleaner. She experienced breathing problems once she got home and was hospitalized.
An employee was unplugging a welding machine when he was shocked. He was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting an inspection of a warehouse under construction. She opened a door that does not have a landing and fell approximately four feet through it. The employee sustained a left wrist fracture.
An employee was involved in an altercation with a shoplifter and sustained a broken left arm and a laceration to the eye.
While working at a maintenance workbench, an employee was struck from behind by an unattended golf cart. The employee suffered a contusion and left leg injury.
While walking, an employee tripped and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing leftover material from the bed of a flatbed truck. He tripped on dunnage and fell off the flatbed, landing on and injuring his right elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when it unlocked and slid down. The employee fell, breaking his ankle and leg.
An employee was operating a micro welder. The welding die clamped down on the wire, breaking the employee's left index finger.
An employee climbed out of a pool and slipped on the pool's smooth plastic edge. She struck her left hip on the side of the pool, suffering a contusion.
An employee was retrieving his radio from a sewage grinding pit when the grinder crushed the tip of his little finger, causing an amputation.

An employee was working from an extension ladder, about 16 feet high, to check an air conditioning vent. The ladder slipped and he fell to the ground, breaking ribs and his right arm, suffering kidney and lung contusions, and striking his head.
An employee had just picked up a teller tape that had fallen to the floor. Her head struck a countertop, causing a concussion.

An employee was using a broom to sweep debris from the floor in a receiving area. While he was moving a fan out of the way, the fan blade amputated his right ring fingertip and cut his right middle finger.
An employee was clearing a jam in the wrapping machine and suffered an amputation injury.
An employee was climbing on a skid steer when his right foot slipped and was pinched in the vehicle. The foot was broken, requiring surgery.

An employee was cutting open 50 lbs. bags of solids and emptying them into a screener with the use of a lift table and vacuum lift. The employee was hospitalized that evening for surgery to correct a hernia.

With a storm approaching, an employee was trying to secure an A-frame rack with parts on it. The wind blew a nearby metal shed toward the rack; the shed's door swung into the rack, pushing it into the employee's legs and causing a compound fracture of the right leg.
An employee was shocked while using a vacuum cleaner. He was hospitalized.

An employee was completing final tasks for the day, including putting up handheld equipment used for order processing, when he collapsed in a warehouse. He was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat-related illness.
An employee was using a 3,000-psi hose attached to the side of his vacuum truck. Water from the hose struck and lacerated his hand.

While installing a piece of ridge cap on a roof, an employee fell to the ground about 28 feet below. The employee suffered a dislocated right shoulder, a broken left wrist and left leg, and facial lacerations.

An employee was trying to remove carbon fiber wrap in a washing area. He placed his hand on the fiber to cut it, and it became trapped in the fiber. When he pulled his left index finger out of the fiber, the fingertip was amputated.
On July 30, 2018, an employee was delivering mail when a dog bit him on the left calf.
An employee fell 28 feet while laying metal decking, suffering broken bones in the face, knee, and foot.

An employee was shoveling hot asphalt mix inside the box of a truck. The back vertical gate opened partially and the employee fell through, coming into contact with the hot material. The employee suffered severe burns to the stomach, palms, and wrists (requiring skin grafts), as well as possible nerve damage to the right forearm.
While tagging palletized inventory, an employee tripped over a pallet and suffered a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
After finishing a delivery, an employee began experiencing dizziness, shortness of breath, sweating, and a racing heart, possibly heat-related.
On July 30, 2018, an employee was behind her forklift when another forklift backed up into her, pinching her between both lifts. She suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a waste bin across the floor and tripped, suffering an injury to his left knee.
An employee was standing on the bed of a flatbed trailer, banging on the drum of a concrete mixer while it was being washed. He fell to the ground 5 or 6 feet below, breaking his tibia and fibula.

An employee was rolling a 4-yard trash container into a trash room on casters. The employee's right ring finger was pinched and crushed between the container and a wall, causing a compound fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an air stapler to staple bands on pallets. He tripped on the stapler's air hose and fell to the ground, fracturing his left femur.

An employee was preparing to move an 8-foot piece of piling from a 6-foot by 6-foot metal box. While the employee was partly inside the box, some welds holding the box together failed and the box partially collapsed. The employee suffered lacerations and fractures.

An employee was in a scissor lift, helping rig iron beams to be removed as part of concrete form work. A beam struck the scissor lift, knocking it to the ground with the employee inside it. The employee suffered injuries including an injured spleen.

An employee was standing at a press brake machine, getting ready to bend a metal piece. The machine was activated while his right index finger was on the feeder; the eave drip die came down, resulting in the amputation of his right index finger below the knuckle.

An employee had placed one foot on a pallet, about 3 inches above the floor, to retrieve banded cardboard. When the employee turned and stepped down, they twisted and broke their ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring pins in their ankle. Low-cut shoes, not boots, were being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a shearer, which cut off the tip of his finger at the first joint.
An employee was cutting a piece of 4-by-4 lumber with a handheld circular saw. The saw amputated the tip of his left index finger.
On July 30, 2018, an employee was cleaning an oven in an apartment. The employee began experiencing asthma symptoms and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while climbing down a ladder, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was scrubbing a cow, preparing it to be milked. It kicked her in the face, cutting her above the left eye and loosening teeth.

The governor on a portable welder had been replaced. While an employee was checking the wiring behind the governor, a coolant fan blade broke his left index finger and caused tendon damage and lacerations on the other fingers.

A temporary employee (from Hughes Agency) was using an overhead crane to lift skids for a fuel tank. The rigging slipped, causing the metal frame to tip over onto the employee. The employee sustained a fracture to the left lower leg and was hospitalized after surgery.
An employee was installing a control box outside in the shade and started feeling lightheaded. The employee later passed out. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee fell when a rail broke, landing on the asphalt ground. The employee suffered fractures and was hospitalized.
