An employee was installing a concrete chute extension when his left ring finger was caught between the fold-over chute and the extension chute. He suffered an avulsion of the pad of the finger.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to install gutters 21 feet above the ground. The employee fell at the fourth rung from the top, landing on the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs, vertebrae, and sternum.
On July 30, 2018, an employee detailed the inside of a vehicle using heavy-duty carpet cleaner. Two or three hours later, he began to suffer respiratory distress and was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking clothing when a piece of clothing fell from a hanger to the floor. The employee slipped on it and broke her right ankle.
An employee was placing a sheet of decking on metal roof rafters. While trying to adjust the roof sheeting, he slipped and fell 30 feet, suffering a head laceration from a metal sheet.
An employee was putting bases on bowling pins. His left index finger was caught and the fingertip was amputated.

On 7/31/2018, at 1:00 AM, an employee was inspecting an auto-pour machine shuttle that was not operating normally. He was bent over with his hand on the rail of the shuttle when the equipment unexpectedly engaged. The shuttle's front roller then amputated his left pinky finger.
An employee was grabbing and stacking tires when his face became red; suffering cardiac arrest, he collapsed and struck his head.
An employee was walking up a customer's indoor stairs, slipped, and fell landing on his tailbone. He fractured a vertebra in his lower back.
An employee was attaching the blade attachment to a mini excavator. His finger was caught between the rack and the attachment resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was assisting with a cable/winch line for a crane. His foot entered an access panel on the crane boom/jib and was amputated.
An employee was being lifted by a forklift to place plastic sheets on a greenhouse. The forklift slipped, and the employee was caught between it and a piece of the greenhouse.

An employee was working on the bed of a truck, moving a drum and then repositioning a pallet jack to be unloaded for charging overnight. The lift gate had been lowered; as the employee walked backward to move the pallet jack, he fell off the end of the truck to the concrete driveway about 3 feet below. He broke his right elbow in five places, also suffering a broken shoulder.
An employee fell 3 feet from an auto frame machine resulting in a head injury.
A piece of cable came loose from a crane, amputating part of an employee's foot.

An employee was delivering a manlift from a trailer. The manlift's wheels came off the trailer and the employee was ejected from it, falling to the ground and suffering several broken ribs and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a 40-pound grate when it fell onto his right hand and fractured it.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to reach a platform. The employee fell, landing on the concrete below and suffering a broken leg.
An employee was setting material in a cutoff saw. The clamp to hold the material in place closed, pinching the employee's left little finger against the material. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to drive a forklift onto a flatbed trailer when the forklift tires fell off the side of the trailer. The employee then fell or was thrown from the forklift, suffering broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and lacerations to the face.
Two employees became ill while removing asbestos tile. They were hospitalized.

An employee lifted the lid to the glue cooling area of the machine to examine the equipment for issues. The lid covers two pulleys; one is 4 feet and the other is 16 inches in diameter. When he lifted the lid, it swung back and he raised his left hand to protect himself. He then lost balance and tried to steady himself with his right hand by placing it on the belt. His right hand got caught in the pulleys and when he pulled back, he suffered avulsions to his ring, pinky and middle fingers requiring hospitalization.
An employee had just installed a telecommunication cable and was climbing down a ladder when he began to feel light headed and dizzy. He was hospitalized for heat stroke symptoms.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut corrugated cardboard. The knife cut off the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
Two temporary employees were feeding sheets into a roller mill and one employee's right hand was caught in the mill. He suffered a dorsal avulsion and fracture to the right hand.

An employee was in a break room when a spare lithium ion flashlight battery in his pocket reacted with spare change and ignited. He suffered burns to his left thigh, both hands, and his fingers. He was hospitalized.

An employee had her right hand in a bird carcass, cutting it with a bone saw, when the saw amputated the tip of her index finger and the first digit of her middle finger. She was wearing a wire mesh glove at the time of the incident.

An employee was talking on the phone when he felt something crawling on his arm. He noticed a black spider, was bitten, and within minutes began to exhibit signs consistent with a black widow spider bite.

An employee was standing on the drum of an oil rig washing and removing grease from the drum when the operator activated the drum. The employee then fell between the drum and cable, fracturing his right femur.

An employee was cutting hay when the cultivator jammed with weeds. The employee got off the cultivator to remove the weeds. As the employee was removing weeds from the implement, the cultivator moved forward and pinned him, causing contusions to his leg and torso. It was turned on at the time of the accident.
An employee was installing a drip edge along the roof eave and fell striking an air conditioner during the fall to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for back fractures.
An employee was cleaning a vessel (VAT). The pump lid was not fully allowing hot water to escape the opening and burned the employee's left arm and back.

An employee was walking inside the office area on carpeted floor when she tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured left shoulder and a hairline fracture of the L4 vertebra. She was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling up the dock leveler to unload equipment from a truck when their middle finger was caught between the hole of the leveler and the dock amputating the fingertip.
An employee was riding in a trailer being pulled by a tractor. As the tractor turned, the employee was thrown from the trailer and broke an ankle.
An employee was climbing down a 6-foot step ladder when he lost his footing at the third rung. His leg was hung up in the ladder and he fell to the ground, breaking his left leg and/or ankle.
Two employees were using a propane saw when they suffered carbon dioxide poisoning. They were hospitalized.

An employee was cutting the ends off boards with a circular saw. After cutting the board, he slid it back with his hand and his left middle finger was caught between the board and a chain, resulting in a possible partial fingertip amputation.
While working on a cope machine, and employee suffered crushing injuries between a mold and a rail system.
Two employees were adding magnesium powder into an industrial mixer. An explosion occurred in the mixer, causing a small fire and smoke; one employee suffered burns to the face, hands, and wrists.
An employee was working near a junction box when his foot was caught in the corner of the 2x3 junction box. He fell down approximately 1.5 feet and broke his hip.

An employee was in a bucket trimming the branch of a cherry tree when an adjacent ash tree fell and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with C6 and C7 vertebrae fractures and a bruised spine.

An employee stepped from a man basket onto a roof that was being demolished. The roof collapsed and the employee fell 10 feet to the ground, breaking an arm and several ribs. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving material onto a pallet lift jack. The jack was moved as he was walking backward and he fell to the ground, fracturing a vertebra in his lower back. He was hospitalized.
At about 11:30 p.m. on July 31, 2018, an employee was working on an air valve actuator when the plunger came down, amputating the tip of the employee's right middle finger.

An employee was standing on a loading dock ramp when the wind caught a transport door, blowing it into the ramp. The employee was knocked from the ramp, landing on the concrete parking lot and suffering a cut to the back of his head. The cut required scalp staples.
An employee was cutting wooden crates using a powered saw when the saw slipped and contacted his right leg, causing a laceration.

An employee was washing out a cement mixer when he noticed a rock in the hopper that was interfering with proper operation. While he was removing it, the blade on the auger caused the partial amputation of his right middle fingertip. The mixer was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was loading a truck with framed windows when a window struck the employee's left arm, causing a fracture that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was making a connection when a heavy pipe got away from the employee and caught the employee's left forearm between it and a board.
An employee was performing maintenance at a cell site when a bug landed on the employee's chin and stung him. He went to his vehicle and observed that the bite started to swell. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a de-energized conveyor when the weight of a bearing slid down on top of one of his left-hand fingers, fracturing it.
An employee fell to the ground while decking a building, suffering a head laceration and damaged ribs.
An employee received a 5 milliamp shock to the left arm during an equipment test procedure, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hit by a falling sheave from a tester that was being placed in a well. The employee was struck in the chest below the collarbone, suffering a liver laceration and bruised lung.
An employee was moving a granite piece when it fell on his left leg and broke his knee, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning the magnet on a machine's belt when the machine was activated. His hand was then caught in the machine, resulting in his right arm being severed at the shoulder. He was hospitalized.

An employee was placing 33-inch bolts of wood into a three-head trim saw with two blades in operation. The employee reached into the saw to adjust a crooked bolt; the saw severed his left index and middle fingers at the middle joint.
An employee was sitting at her post in or near a school gymnasium while the floor was being stripped and waxed. Vapors emitted from the process aggravated her asthma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was welding a metal plate to the top of a stand. The plate fell onto his finger, injuring it, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was on the back of a truck when it started to pull forward. The employee jumped off and landed hard resulting in a fractured right leg.
A discharge hose failed, striking an employee and causing a laceration and fracture of the right tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
A ready mix truck rolled backward, pinning an employee's right leg between it and the metal pipe of a pumping truck. The employee's leg was broken.
An employee was going up a step ladder to trim a hitch when he lost his balance, fell to some bricks below, and landed on his right wrist. His right wrist broke and required hospitalization.
An employee was working at the cashier station, tripped on a box fan and fell onto the ground fracturing a hip.

An employee was feeding a steel coil into a press. The material buckled; the employee was trying to free it with his right hand when it moved forward and pulled the hand in. His right index finger was caught and the tip was amputated.

An employee was on a step ladder working on a shaft drive for a cooling bed when he missed a step while coming down, falling backward and hitting his head on equipment or the ground. The injury required stitches.

An employee was cleaning a lab when he attempted to grab what he thought was an empty black container. The container had hot asphalt in it and caused the employee to jerk back. As he jerked back, the hot asphalt dripped down his left hand, causing second degree burns to his fingers and palm.

An employee was removing a transmission from a diesel truck. He had a jack positioned underneath the transmission. After removing the top two bolts, he proceeded to remove the bottom bolts when the thread came loose from the transmission. The transmission displaced the jack and the transmission fell on the employee, breaking 10 of his ribs.
An employee was pouring concrete cement on the ground when it got into his boot, causing second-degree burns to both his legs.
An employee was climbing down the ladder of a front-end loader when he slipped on the bottom rung and rolled his foot, falling from the ladder to the ground and fracturing his right ankle.
An employee was trying to repair a stalled recycle asphalt bin machine. His right arm got stuck between the tail pulley shaft and the pulley, and he suffered broken bones.

An employee was dumping a 50-pound bag of solid particulate into a dump station. The employee's left hand contacted a butterfly valve in the bottom of the station. The valve was activated, and the employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated below the fingernail. The valve was not guarded with a screen.

An employee was attempting to exit a tractor when it rolled over the employee's right leg, fracturing it in two places. The tractor's motor was running and the brake was not set at the time of the incident.
An employee was crossing a conveyor belt when it was started. The employee fell, breaking her left leg.

An employee was using a belt sander to sand down a sharp edge from a piece of metal he had just cut. The belt caught a piece of the sharp steel, causing the employee to move forward. He was wearing leather gloves while sanding and as the metal was pulled in between the rest plate and sanding belt, it caught the glove, pulling his left thumb in between the metal piece and sanding belt. His left thumb was amputated.

An employee was repositioning a tank turret that was suspended from a crane when the turret shifted, pinching the employee's fingers between the turret and the loading chains. The employee's right middle and index fingertips were amputated.
An employee was performing maneuvers and felt faint. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
On August 1, 2018, a mail carrier began to feel faint. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.

On August 1, 2018, an employee was using a small hoist to lift a mold. The employee was using the left hand to stabilize the mold during the lift when a movable component on the mold unexpectedly shifted and trapped the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation of the left little finger above the first knuckle.
While using a trimmer to cut hedges, an employee suffered a partial amputation to the middle finger on his right hand.
An employee was raising a lift gate on the back of a box truck. Her right wrist was caught between the control box and the gate's side rail, suffering an open fracture.
An employee was operating a rivet gun when the end of the rivet flew up and broke a fluorescent light bulb. Broken glass from the bulb fell on and lacerated the employee's left arm.

A temporary employee was operating a power press used to stamp metal parts. The die actuated while his hand was in the point of operation; his fingers were crushed and the index and middle fingers on his right hand were amputated.
An employee was climbing poles and attaching cables. One of the throw lines got caught in a tree. The employee climbed the tree and fell breaking an ankle.
An employee was placing a broken concrete piece under a concrete slab as support when the slab broke and came down on/pinned the employee's right hand, cutting it and requiring stitches.

An employee was watching as equipment ripped curbing from the side of a roadway when a piece of the curbing became lodged between the middle blade and the wheel of the curb removal equipment. When the wheel was turned, the piece of asphalt was ejected and struck the employee's chest, breaking ribs.
An employee was walking away from a pipeline when it exploded. He suffered second-degree burns.
An employee was hospitalized after sustaining a forklift injury.
When rounding a corner in a hallway, an employee made contact with another employee and then fell to the floor. She suffered a hairline fracture to both hips, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a forklift to unload a piece of steel pipe off a flatbed truck. The pipe fell off of the forklift and rolled onto the right leg of the injured employee, breaking it.

An employee was operating a crane with a sling to lift a cylinder from a basket when the employee's left ring finger was caught between the sling and the cylinder, crushing it and resulting in an amputation to the first joint.

An employee was climbing down a 6-foot step ladder after opening a damper on a trailer-mounted rental chiller when the ladder tipped and he fell to the ground, fracturing his left ankle and right toe.
A temporary employee was placing baking racks into a row when a cart hit her from behind and caused her to fall, fracturing her femur.

Three employees were aligning a pump motor when it became engaged and broke the tool they were using. The broken tool struck the employees, and one of them suffered an amputation to his left pinky finger.

An employee was adjusting the throttle controls on a high-pressure water pump when a hose on the equipment ruptured. Pressurized water came out and contacted his right wrist, causing a deep laceration.

An employee was cleaning materials from a table saw when his left hand made contact with the table saw blade, resulting in an amputation to part of his finger. The table saw was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was assembling a flex wing with a coworker. They had to line up three holes and place pins in them to secure the alignment. The injured employee's finger was in the center hole lining up the hole for the pin when the coworker moved the assembly, pinching the employee's right middle finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A temporary employee was on a ladder attempting to work with an electrical wire after placing a light in a ceiling grid when he fell to the ground, suffering a sore back. He may have been exposed to electricity.
An employee was maneuvering an aerial lift when he was caught between two aerial lifts.
An employee was cutting a piece of steel. The saw blade caught the employee's right thumb, causing a partial amputation.
While operating a machine, a circular enclosure degloved one-third of the employee's left middle finger resulting in an amputation.
An employee was exiting a forklift when a pallet on the ground caught the employee's foot. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was working at the back of a bottle-making machine, adjusting one of its parameters. His hand was caught between the arm and frame of the machine, and his left ring finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee tripped over a long-handled squeegee and fell to the floor, tearing her rotator cuff.
An employee slipped off a ladder and fell to the ground sustaining a severe head injury.
An employee was carrying a tray of glasses when she slipped on a wet floor and fell, cutting her thumb on a glass. Her thumb sustained ligament damage, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to replace a conveyor line roller that had popped out. As he was trying to replace the roller, with the line momentarily shut down, his finger was caught between the roller and the belt. He suffered a partial amputation of the right ring finger, about halfway down the nail.

An employee unloaded a broom tractor from a trailer. He then got off the tractor to check the hub locks on the wheels. When he moved the hub locks, the boom tractor grabbed his leg and took off with him underneath. The tractor then made a 360 circle and ran him over a second time, breaking his pelvis in two places. He was hospitalized and required surgery. The boom tractor was in operation at the time of the incident.

An employee was guiding a dozer back to tie it to a stuck vehicle. When the dozer stopped, the employee stepped between the vehicles to tie them together. The dozer then moved and caught the employee between the vehicles. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
While walking through a recreation room, an employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was standing in the back of a semi trailer, which was being loaded from an outside loading dock. The truck (and trailer) pulled away from the dock and the employee fell to the concrete below, suffering a fractured right ankle.
An employee was cleaning a milling machine when the employee's glove was caught in the rollers, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a CIP system when he realized a hose was not connected properly. As he disconnected the hose, his lower body was splashed with 170-degree F fluid. He was hospitalized with burns to his lower body.
An employee was disconnecting a pressurized hose from a truck when the hose popped off, causing the employee to fall backward on his left side. He broke his pelvic bone and was hospitalized.

An employee was spotting a forklift, which was moving three sections of structural pipe. The third section shifted and began to roll; as the employee tried to stop it, his right ring finger was fractured and his little finger was partially amputated to the first joint.

An employee was trying to install a new industrial burn-out oven. He climbed on top of a section of the oven and was using a pry bar to pry another section of the oven out when the pry bar slipped and he fell approximately 12.5 feet to the ground. He broke his nose and both wrists and suffered a cut above the eye.
An employee was inspecting equipment when a sweeper belt/pulley caught her right little finger. Part of the first digit was amputated.
An employee was on a tractor bucket, being lowered into a trench that was being excavated. He slipped and was struck by the thumb of the excavator, suffering puncture wounds to both feet.

While walking to her office, an employee slipped on water that had been spilled when a dehumidifier was moved. She fell to the floor, sustaining a fracture to the right shoulder that required surgery.

An employee was attempting to remove a blemish that developed on the press plate of a sheet-fed press machine when his right index finger was caught in a roller, resulting in an amputation to the top portion of his finger.
An employee was cleaning a filter press, which included removing hot oil and earth material from the filter, when the hot oil spilled on and burned his upper body, shoulders, triceps, and face.
An employee was setting trusses in a residential construction when he lost his balance and fell approximately 16 feet to the next lower level, suffering fractured ribs.
On 08/03/2018, an employee fell off a baker's scaffold while installing ceiling tiles, injuring his upper left leg and requiring hospitalization for surgery.

An employee was using a steel rod to break up sugar lumps in a silo when the rod was pulled in by the silo's screw conveyor and the employee's right hand was caught in the rod handle, amputating the right pinky, ring, and middle fingers.

An employee was setting up a rolling mill. Once he properly sized the wire, he went to cut the nonconforming wire off. At this point, the machine was stopped and he released the tension. He held the loose material in his left hand and went to reach for his snips. As he was holding the material, tension was engaged, he felt a pinch of his left ring finger and instinctively pulled his hand away. As he did so he sustained a partial amputation to his left ring finger.
An employee was cutting and racking in a street utility service box when a cap came off a cut live cable and contacted the employee, causing an electrocution and burns.
An employee was helping to complete a tree felling job when the tree was cut and fell on the employee's left leg, resulting in a leg amputation below the knee.
An employee was cutting aluminum siding with a siding brake when his right pinky finger was caught in the siding brake, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was prepping to run a batch of feed when a grain dust explosion occurred at the establishment elevator, burning the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reversing a forklift when the employee became caught between the forklift and a racking system, suffering rib and vertebra fractures.
An employee was cleaning a paint gun when it went off due to pressure and shot cleaning fluid into his fingertip, resulting in a possible finger amputation.
An employee slipped while working on a blowout preventer, falling about 2 feet to the ground and suffering a broken thumb.

On 8/3/2018, at 4:15 p.m. CST (5:15 p.m. EST), an employee used a three-step step ladder to retrieve "To-Go" boxes from a storage area. As he was stepping down, his foot slipped on a step and he fell off the step ladder to the floor, landing on his left hand and fracturing his left wrist.
An employee was standing on a pallet reaching for a mattress when he lost his balance and his foot became tangled in the plastic, causing him to fall to the ground and fracture his left leg.
After removing dirt from a residential crawl space for 8 hours, an employee experienced cramping, nausea, and vomiting from heat exhaustion. He was hospitalized.
An employee operating a forklift drove off the back of a trailer, sustaining a back fracture and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was spotting a well servicing rig to a well when his right ring finger was caught between a wire cable and well-head bolt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was spotting for a skid steer when the skid loader struck the employee. The employee suffered a left femur fracture, a right ankle fracture, multiple pelvic fractures, a hematoma to the popliteal region, and an L7 transverse fracture.
An employee fell to the ground while handling shopping carts, breaking the pelvic bone.

On August 3, 2018, at approximately 7:30 AM, an employee was helping to unload a railcar. He was attempting to thread a tow strap onto the forks of a forklift when his right pinky finger was caught between the fork and the railcar. He sustained a fracture and partial amputation of the right pinky finger.

An employee was clearing an unloading pump for maintenance. He applied steam, had the pump blocked in, and was relieving pressure on the unloading hose. When he began to loosen the hose, hot water and condensate sprayed onto his clothes and skin. He was hospitalized with first and second degree burns.
An employee was climbing down from a truck by stepping on the forks of a forklift when the employee slipped and fell on the forks, suffering a punctured lung and broken ribs.

An employee was attempting to remove a tangled shirt from an industrial washer when the washer twisted the employee's right arm, injuring the wrist and elbow. The washer was operating at the time of the incident.
An employee was installing metal roofing when the employee slipped and fell 16 to 20 feet from the roof to the surface below, fracturing the right leg.
An employee collided with a vehicle while riding a bicycle at the work site, suffering facial trauma and a broken jaw.

An employee was training with a trainer to operate a high reach forklift when the employee crashed into another parked fork truck, suffering a fractured ankle that required hospitalization and surgery. The employee's leg was outside of the forklift at the time of the incident.
An employee was gathering carts in the parking lot when a vehicle struck him. He was hospitalized with a compound fracture to the left leg.
An employee was tightening a lathe chuck when his hand slipped and he fell to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured or dislocated hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a piece of plywood onto a table saw when the saw blade severely lacerated his right little and ring fingers.

An employee was going down the stairs outside a sales home when he lost his balance and fell down the steps, hitting his head. He suffered a concussion, two skull fractures, and a broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was retrieving clothing to help a client get dressed when she tripped over some loose carpet and fell. She struck the right side of her face on the dresser as she fell to the floor onto her right side. The employee sustained contusions and a concussion and acute right shoulder and knee injuries.
An employee was shocked when he came in contact with a live power line. The line was not insulated and his gloves had perforations at the time of the incident.
An employee experienced symptoms of dehydration and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off the cab of a truck while trying to clean the back window, landing on the ground and breaking his right arm and dislocating his elbow.
A security representative was attempting to get a disruptive patient back into bed when the patient kicked his abdomen and right side multiple times, causing contusions.
An employee was working with tongues on the drilling floor when his hand entered a pinch point and the tongues caught his ring finger, resulting in an amputation at the first joint.
A sheet metal panel fell from a machine and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee tripped on a piece of wire while pulling a pallet jack, suffering a right lower leg fracture.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
After lifting heavy trash bags, an employee may have aggravated a recent surgical incision.
An employee tripped while attempting to jump back into a moving van, injuring his knee.
At approximately 4:00 a.m. on 8/5/2018, an employee was repositioning a patient when she felt an intense pain in her lower left back due to a herniated disk.
On August 5, 2018, at 4:15 p.m., an employee was repairing the air conditioning unit in a guest room when the blower fan activated and lacerated his left hand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee amputated a pinky fingertip when it was pinched between a pipe and a stationary object.
An employee's right hand was caught in a conveyor and fractured while removing a tool.
An employee was on a step stool cleaning the restroom when he slipped and fell head first onto the concrete floor, fracturing an eye socket.
An employee was attempting to erect a boom when the boom failed, resulting in contusions to the employee's head and knees and multiple fractures to the vertebrae.

While on a ship, an employee was lifting one side of a pipe and putting a strap underneath it. As the employee was about to break out, one end of the pipe joints slipped out, allowing the pipe (6"/40') to roll and strike the employee's lower left leg. The employee's leg was fractured above the ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped on a loading rack and fell down the stairs, fracturing his leg.

While replacing a spray line on a continuous anneal line, an employee installed a come-along on a pipe to remove it. The pipe was rusty on the backside and broke under tension, flying back and striking the employee's arm. The employee suffered a broken left ulna.
An employee was lifting and moving 15-pound cases of sports drink when he felt a pop in his lower back. He was hospitalized for a herniated disk in his lower back.
An employee suffered an arm injury while entering a gate.
An employee was unloading a trench box panel from a forklift when it fell on the employee, who suffered lower vertebra fractures. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at the capping station on a bottling line when some caps fell off the automated capper onto the moving conveyor belt and were caught under the guard. The employee was attempting to retrieve the caps when her right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a two-step ladder retrieving and lifting a sign overhead when the employee suffered an abdominal hernia, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell and became wedged between a conveyor and the inside of a mobile shredding truck. The employee lost consciousness.

An employee was part of a five-person crew that was removing a polishing rod when the clamp that holds the stuffing box failed, causing the stuffing box to catch the employee's hands against the clamp and stuffing box. The employee's right thumb was crushed, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was changing the tire and axle of a forklift that was blocked up with jacks when the forklift slipped and fell on the employee's right hand, breaking his ring and pinky fingers and requiring hospitalization.

A maintenance employee had just tightened a deer stand's railing using a battery-operated screwdriver. As he was descending the stairs, he slipped, fell 12 feet to the ground, and suffered fractures to the right wrist and ribs and a punctured right lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a golf cart when he struck a concrete pole, suffering abrasions to his forehead and left knee.
Two employees were fixing leaking unions when an employee was struck by anhydrous ammonia that released from a pipe, suffering respiratory distress.
An employee was working on a cable pedestal near the ground when he was bitten by a snake.
An employee was climbing into his truck cab when he lost his balance and slipped on the second step, twisting his knee and requiring hospitalization.
After conducting flagging operations, an employee experienced hand cramps and nausea at the end of the day. She was hospitalized with low potassium levels and dehydration.
An employee was climbing a wall-mounted ship's ladder while holding a PVC pipe under his arm when his hand slipped off a rung and he fell 10 feet to the floor, fracturing both legs.
An employee was on a ladder checking a fertilizer tank for a potential leak when the ladder kicked out, causing him to fall to the ground. He suffered rib and facial fractures.
An employee was struck by a forklift causing a lower right leg injury.
An employee was standing near a winch system when the I-hook to the system broke and whipped around, fracturing the employee's right lower leg.
An employee was operating a shear cutter when his finger slipped and was caught under the part that holds the product down prior to shearing, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was climbing a 15-foot fixed ladder to access a roof when the employee slipped off the ladder and fell 8 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was cleaning windows and light fixtures using a step ladder when she lost her footing and fell to the ground, breaking her leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was sorting mail packages when a 10-pound package struck his groin, causing a contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee was down on one knee putting away supplies. As she rose from that position, she became dizzy, took a step, and fell to the floor, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was operating a microfluidizer when the beaker punctured his left palm and the liquid stream came in contact with his blood. He developed an infection and was hospitalized.

A boat had capsized and 300 pounds of dead fish were on a shoreline. Employees were gathering the dead fish inside heavy-duty trash bags. A fish fin punctured through its bag while being carried by a coworker and struck the injured employee's leg. The employee's leg became swollen and the employee experienced a high temperature, requiring hospitalization.

A temporary employee was assisting a coworker on a metal folder. His hands were inside the folder when the machine's foot pedal was activated. The folder clamps then crushed his hands, degloving his fingertips and resulting in the surgical amputation of two fingers.

An employee was blasting a girder outside when he stopped to refill his blasting pot. As he opened the door/lid, sand and debris released under pressure and struck his face and eyes. A blasting hood was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was laying standing seam metal roof decking when he stepped on insulation that was laid out underneath the metal decking and fell 30 feet through the insulation to the ground, landing on a crushed stone surface. He suffered a fractured left arm, fractured pelvis, and diaphragmatic hernia. A safety lanyard was not attached at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking toward a shuttle stop from the parking lot when she tripped and fell to the concrete ground, fracturing her left middle and index fingers.
While checking for failures in the pipe, a pipe that was being lifted by a track hoe rolled and hit the employee's leg, breaking it.

An employee was applying initial stress on a concrete cable using a jack when either the cable snapped or the chuck that holds the cable in the jack failed, creating a pinch point. The employee's left thumb was caught in the pinch point, resulting in a surgical amputation to the thumb.

An employee was working on the metal decking of a new dorm when he went to get a tool and stepped on the deck. The deck collapsed and he fell 12 feet to the ground, fracturing his left hip and requiring hospitalization. A retractable lifeline was not hooked up at the time of the incident.
An employee stepped on mud while exiting a shipping container and fell backwards, suffering a concussion and possible injuries to the neck and back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee placed his left little finger on the expandable cable of a concrete mold. When he turned the airline connection on, the cord partially pinched his finger. When he attempted to remove his finger, it was amputated and degloved to the base of his nail.
An employee was walking through the warehouse going to lunch when he was struck by a forklift, suffering a broken ankle, concussion, and abrasions to the legs and arms.
An employee was working a piece of wood through a machine when the employee's right index finger was caught between the wood and the machine's guard, resulting in a finger amputation to the knuckle.
An employee sustained an adverse reaction to prescribed medication after a needlestick.

On August 6, 2018, at approximately 12:16 PM, a hydraulic line located at the 3,000-ton press shear station unexpectedly released pressurized hydraulic fluid. The hydraulic fluid traversed to a separate operation next to the press and landed on a hot part (small ring expander), resulting in a flash fire. As a result, two employee suffered second and third degree burns to their hands and face, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was securing a series of cast iron fixtures called shop blocks (used for material elevation and support) in place by tightening bolts to a rotary table using a pneumatic impact wrench. Before tightening the last bolt, he had to secure the fourth and final shop block. The impact wrench was shifted into its reverse position. When he operated the impact wrench, the bolt backed out and pinched his right pinky finger between the impact tool and the internal cavity of the shop block, resulting in a partial amputation of his right pinky finger.

After performing a welding operation inside of a tank, an employee was exiting the tank when his leg caused a welding lead to short against the side of the tank and an electric arc occurred. His leg was burned, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on the forks of a forklift to reach a u-box cover that was not fitting when she fell approximately 3 feet to the concrete floor and fractured her right ankle.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck by a forklift.
An employee was working on an electrical switch gear when an arc flash occurred. He sustained first and second degree burns on his head and face and was hospitalized.
An employee was working outdoors and became ill due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was removing chairs from a room when the door slammed closed on the employee's left index finger, severing the fingertip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a lawn tractor up a paved roadway when the tractor went into neutral and started rolling backward down the hill. The employee turned the wheel and the tractor flipped onto its side. The vehicle was equipped with a rollover protection system and the employee was wearing his seatbelt. When the tractor flipped on its side, the employee's fingertips were pinched between the ground and the tractor, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

On August 7, 2018, an employee was operating a hydrovac when the metal braided hose began leaking. The employee attempted to repair it with tape, and pressure built up in the hose. The hose then struck and lacerated the employee's hand, and high-pressure water and debris were injected into the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a 246-pound steel plate when it fell on his left foot, crushing and lacerating it with possible toe fractures.
An employee was using a powder-actuated decking tool when the pin caught the edge of a beam flange, causing the washer on the deck pin to shear off and lacerate the employee's right eye.

On August 7, 2018, an employee was erecting a framed scaffold when he fell approximately 11 feet from the scaffold to surface level, suffering a fractured vertebra, pulled muscles in the shoulder and back, a bruised sternum, and arm abrasions. He was hospitalized.
An employee picked something up and his feet came out from under him. He fell straight back and his head hit the floor, suffering a concussion.

An employee was putting away a pallet consisting of 16 cases of canned carrots in a warehouse. While unpacking the pallet of canned carrots, the employee lifted a case off the second to last row and a can of carrots from the bottom row exploded upward, striking the employee's face. The employee suffered facial lacerations, a left nasal bone fracture, a left orbital floor fracture, a soft tissue hernia in the maxillary sinus, left lateral rectus swelling, and loose teeth, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration after performing highway construction.
An employee was working from a ladder when it slid, causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground. He broke a bone in his right forearm.
An employee began experiencing cramps while working at a refinery, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a handheld spot welder when he started to feel ill and experienced cramps and nausea. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was working on the cheese production line and began to look unwell towards the end of their shift. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized due to heat stroke.
An employee did not feel well at the end of the day and experienced muscle cramps and vomiting. He was hospitalized for heat stress.

On August 7, 2018, an employee was releasing air from a winder shaft when another employee pushed the core onto the shaft while the employee's finger was still on the air release valve. The employee's left index fingertip was caught between the shaft and the core, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hospitalized after experiencing leg cramps.
An employee fell 20 to 50 feet from a manlift to the concrete ground below, suffering a concussion, contusions, and a broken leg.

An employee was on the roof (new two story house) fixing an incorrectly installed metal flashing. As he was lifting the metal flashing to add a peel stick, a roof drip edge flashing came out of its box and landed on his left hand, resulting in the amputation of his left middle finger from the first joint.
An employee was overcome by heat exhaustion while stacking pails, requiring hospitalization.
While driving from site to site, an employee experienced nausea, vomiting, and loss of consciousness due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was struck by a powered forklift while pushing a shopping cart on the work floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee manually pushed an unwind shaft into the mill roll and got his right ring finger pinched between the shaft bearing and the mill roll resulting in amputation just below the fingertip at the first knuckle.
An employee experienced heat stress symptoms while working outside at a construction site. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
Three employees were repairing an aircraft ejection seat when it fired and ejected from the aircraft. One of the employees was hospitalized with burns and lacerations to the face, arms, and chest.
An employee was pushing a vitals machine down the hallway when she tripped and fell, suffering a dislocated right elbow and three breaks in her lower right arm.
An employee was backing up a powered industrial truck after staging a pallet and crushed his left foot between his truck and one parked next to it.
An employee was moving a welding positioner when the weight shifted and the positioner arm came down and caused a compound fracture to the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was climbing up an extension ladder to inspect a roof when the bottom kicked out. The employee fell and hit the ground, suffering fractured feet and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving pallets around in a trailer when his boot lace became caught on a pallet. He twisted around and tripped on the pallet jack, then fell backwards and hit his head on the floor of the trailer, suffering a concussion.
A temporary employee was operating a magnetic crane to pick up and move a 6000-pound sheet of metal when the metal fell and struck the employee's left foot, fracturing the fourth and fifth digits.
An employee suffered two herniated discs while raising the landing gear of a semi trailer.
An employee was returning to his truck from delivering freight when an insect stung him. He suffered an allergic reaction and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress illness after working in a wheat field.

Employees were running a machine (controlled atmosphere plasma spray). The process involves titanium powder. They noticed some sparking on the piping that goes to the dust collector and they started wiping the residue off the piping. A cap on a second set of piping was removed to clean the piping which introduced air into the piping and a flashback occurred. Both employees were hospitalized for burns.

An employee was trying to unclog a filter on a deflasher machine when the airlocks caught the employee's right thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation. The airlock was not locked out and was turning at the time of the incident.
An employee was delivering mail to a box mounted next to a customer's door when a dog pushed the door open and jumped on the employee, biting him.
An employee was walking away from a house after delivering mail when the home owner opened the door. A dog ran out and bit the employee's lip.
An employee was setting up a bag-maker machine when the employee's left index finger became caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was walking in the hallway when she slipped and fell, breaking her right tibia.

An employee was trying to hold or guide a wrench and bolt together while using an impact gun at the same time to loosen the bolt. The impact wrench slipped and caused a severe laceration to the employee's left index finger.
An agent was wounded after an exchange of gunfire during an attempted arrest.
An employee was cutting paraffin blocks on a microtome when the microtome blade partially amputated the employee's left ring finger.
An employee fell from a roof ladder and suffered a fractured leg.

An employee was operating a hose reel to rig up the swivel when his fingers were caught in the in-going nip point of the hose reel chain and sprocket drive, amputating his right pinky and ring fingers.
An employee was using a scissor lift to hang ceiling wires. As he was getting off the lift, he slipped, lost balance, and fell backward, breaking his femur and hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was activating a walk-behind lawnmower when his left ring finger was caught in the brake assembly, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was untangling shackles in the live hang area of a plant when the employee's finger slipped inside a groove in the shackles' track, suffering an avulsion that resulted in a medical amputation.

An employee was operating the tail stretcher. After stretching a profile, he began releasing the profile from the stretcher. He was facing the stretcher with his left hand in front of the machine and his right hand towards the back. His left hand passed across the light bar on the stretcher, which opened the jaws. His left ring finger was then caught in the jaws, amputating his fingertip.

On August 8, 2018, employees were rigging an engine coupling on a ship when the tension in the chain fall released and the load shifted, pinning the injured employee's arm against the ship's piping. The weight of the load (coupling) was 4,800 
lbs. The employee's right arm was crushed, fracturing the radius and ulna and requiring surgery.

An employee backed his delivery truck to a loading dock. When he stepped from the truck, his left leg slipped between the truck bumper and dock. His leg was lacerated above the knee. A dock plate was not installed at the time of the incident.

An employee was repairing the front tie rod of a milling machine that broke. He was trying to put the rod together to align it when the end yoke moved and hit his left hand, fracturing his index and middle fingers.
An employee was setting roof trusses when a truss broke below him, causing him to fall approximately 13 feet and break his ankle.
An employee was splicing wires outside when the employee experienced dizziness and incoherence due to heat stress.
An employee pulled on a winch line, causing a horse head to slide down and strike the employee's right foot, fracturing it.
An employee was helping crew members set up a hydraulic pump when he started to experience leg cramps. He was hospitalized due to possible heat-related illness.

Conductors were being strung up with ropes. While signaling to allow a conductor to be pulled up, an employee did not release the rope and it pulled him in the air. He let go of the rope while in the air and fell to the ground, suffering fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was attempting to move a piece of carbon steel with a crane when the steel fell off the crane hook and landed on his left hand, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee acting as a spotter was walking alongside a forklift when the forklift operator turned to the right and the left rear tire pivoted outward, contacting the employee. The employee suffered a fractured foot and elbow.
An employee was assisting a circular saw operator by holding a piece of wood in place when the blade deeply lacerated his left hand.

An employee was attempting to clear a plugged pipe when a 3/4 " threaded nipple blew out, causing the contents of the line and flush water to strike the employee. He suffered thermal burns on his abdomen, hands, and arms.

An employee was using a forklift to load a semi-truck trailer. The employee set the forklift brake, got off of the forklift, and walked to the front of the forks. The forklift moved forward and pinched the employee's left calf between the double forks of a slip sheet attachment. The employee suffered a left calf laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee was diagnosing failed equipment when he made contact with the side of the equipment, which had a short, and experienced an electrical shock.

Employees were disposing of hazardous chemicals when two components mixed and caused an explosion, resulting in a 20-foot flame. The injured employee's entire body caught on fire, suffering severe third and second degree burns.
On August 8, 2018, an employee was cranking the landing gear on a tractor-trailer when he experienced lower back pain, requiring hospitalization for a back strain.

An employee was winding rolls of sorbent plastic material when one of the cores became stuck. She hit the core with the palm of her hand as instructed to make it move again. It began rolling and her left hand was caught and crushed in the machine. She suffered bruising and a fracture to the middle finger, a cut to the end of the middle finger that needed stitches, and some bone chipping to the pinky finger.
An employee was working next to wrapped pallets of boxes when the boxes fell and struck her leg, fracturing it. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
While working on a conveyor, an employee fell from the crossover walkway which runs over the conveyor.

An employee was in a man basket at a terminal unloading a rubber tired gantry crane. He was taking the pin off the crane shackle when his left thumb was caught between the shackle, resulting in a partial amputation to the thumb tip.

An employee was attempting to move a dolly/basket out of the way with his foot when his foot became stuck on the basket, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the floor on his right side. He suffered a right hip fracture.

An employee was leaning against a handrail located in front of a tool trailer when the handrail gave out and the employee fell backwards, striking his head and back against the ground. He suffered bleeding inside the brain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered heat-related stress after delivering mail, requiring hospitalization.

An employee mixed epoxy paint and thinner (two-part epoxy) and added it to a pneumatic spray gun before entering a negative pressure paint booth to paint a pump. The employee wore safety glasses, gloves, and a half-mask respirator before entering the paint booth. Within 10 minutes of removing the respirator and cleaning the gun, the employee began itching due to a suspected allergic reaction to the paint. The employee was hospitalized for a possible heart attack.
An employee was pulling grass from a grade stake when a coral snake bit his right forearm. He was hospitalized.
A beam was being moved when it fell on an employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet from a ladder, resulting in a little finger amputation.
An employee was responding to a call to provide assistance when he came upon a wet concrete floor and slipped, falling to the concrete floor and injuring his hip.
An employee was operating a pneumatic nail gun at the ridge of the roof when the gun shot a nail into his foot, entering the bone. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clean out a tack truck when the spray bar expelled tar/tack onto the employee. He suffered second degree burns to the right side of his face, ear, neck, chest, and arm.
An employee was making a patient's bed when the employee's knee gave out. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving a cart when it became stuck. The employee slipped and fell onto a piece of angle iron while attempting to unjam the cart, cracking a rib.
An employee was chopping sun dried tomatoes when his knife hit and amputated his left thumb tip.
An employee slipped and fell off a ladder to the floor, suffering a fractured right leg.

An employee was working on a broken limit switch, attempting to place the stop pin back in place, when the employee's right fourth finger distal tip was compressed between the housing and stop pin. The employee's distal tip was amputated (no bone loss).
An employee was carrying serving trays from the dining area to the kitchen sink for cleaning when the employee struck a cart and fell, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee fell off a 10-foot step ladder when he missed a step, falling on the concrete floor and impacting his back and head.
An employee lowered a ladder into a ventilation shaft to rescue a cat. The employee fell to the ventilation shaft floor while trying to get down the ladder, suffering a spinal compression.
An employee amputated their right pinky finger while unjamming a machine.

An employee was trying to look at electrical devices that were on a wall behind vertically stacked drywall when the drywall fell towards him, striking and breaking his right ankle. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

On 08/09/2018, an employee was installing a new baler when it shifted and he fell approximately 5'8" off the baler to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to disconnect the whip line from a lifter on a pre-cast concrete member. As the whip line got tension, the employee's left ring finger was caught between the lifter and the cable, causing a fracture and laceration.
An employee was assembling valves on a filler machine when his left hand was caught between the valve housing and the valve opener, resulting in an amputation of his ring finger's first joint.
