The door was stuck and the employee was under the unit troubleshooting the problem when the door released and pinned his forearm under the weight of the door. He sustained nerve damage and a laceration from his left elbow to his forearm that required stitches.

An employee was on a ladder attempting to install artwork on a wall when the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, suffering a broken collarbone and a concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to cut excess gauze from a production machine's rollers when the material caught the employee's hand and pulled it into the roller, amputating the left middle fingertip.

An employee was moving a metal part from one pallet to another when the part slipped and the employee's finger was caught between a pallet and a strapping table. The employee's finger was fractured, lacerated, and crushed.
A temporary employee was removing a jammed corn cob from a conveyor system when his left ring finger was caught in the conveyor's drive side sprocket, amputating his finger in the nail area.
An employee tripped and fell while walking, suffering a fractured hip that required hospitalization.

An employee placed a ladder on a mid-span and was ascending the ladder when it shifted. The shift caused one of the hooks to come off the mid-span. He dismounted from halfway up the ladder and landed on his feet, breaking both ankles.
An employee was performing maintenance on forging machines when a set of dies ejected from the machine and struck his foot, resulting in a medical toe amputation.

On August 15, 2018, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift and turning a corner when the vehicle hit a wet spot and started to slide. The employee released the dead man switch to stop the forklift and then dismounted the vehicle during the slide. His left foot/ankle was struck by the vehicle and a plastic pole protector as the vehicle continued to travel in the direction he exited. He suffered multiple fractures and a puncture wound.
An employee was cleaning a print roller's nip point when his right thumb was caught in the nip point, degloving his right thumb. The print roller was running at the time.
An employee was unloading windows from the back of a flatbed truck. The employee fell from the truck, and windows landed on his right lower leg. He suffered broken bones requiring surgery.
An employee suffered heat-related illness and dehydration while working outdoors.

The injured employee was applying flammable, solvent-based adhesive on the roof. As he walked by another employee using a torch to dry the roof, the employee's clothes ignited. The injured employee then entered the area where the adhesive was being applied and a fire started. The injured employee sustained burns to about 80 percent of his body and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a fiberglass extension ladder along the side of a building when his foot became caught on a wooden stake protruding from the ground, causing him to fall. When he fell, his other foot became tangled between the first and second rungs of the ladder, and he suffered compound fractures of the right tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting neck bones with a saw when the employee's right thumb contacted the blade, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was standing in the bed of a stationary truck mixing cement with a pail and shovel. He fainted and fell from the truck bed. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and subdural hematoma.

An employee was cleaning debris around a laser cutting table with an air hose when the table shifted and he was caught between the bracket arm of the cutting device and a portion of the table. He suffered a laceration and fractured arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee became unresponsive due to significant dehydration and heat stress, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized after an electrical explosion took place.
An employee was cutting open a bag of materials with scissors when they cut his right forearm.
On August 15, 2018, around 3:00 PM, an employee was hit in the back of his head from a falling shackle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning and sharpening a deli slicer when the blade amputated her right index fingertip without bone loss. Cut-resistant gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was stocking cleaning carts in a supply storage area when some boxes fell off a shelf and struck her head and left shoulder, fracturing her neck.
An employee was evacuating residents from a unit during a small fire when the employee inhaled smoke, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working in a grinding room, cleaning out a common line connected to two fat pumps. When he opened the inspection door on one of the pumps, hot fat blew into his face. He suffered second-degree burns to the face, both arms, the chest, the upper back, the neck, and the top of the head.

While training another employee on swabbing techniques on a glass forming machine, an employee experienced cramping in the hands, legs, and stomach. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration and a muscle injury.

On August 15, 2018, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was attempting to clear a jam in the feeding section on a box former machine when the employee's gloved hand was caught by the machine's shuttle carrier, causing injuries that required surgical amputation of the middle finger on the employee's left hand. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting pork chops when a bone became caught on the blade, causing the saw to buck. The saw blade then amputated her left index finger pad.
An employee's right index finger was pinched between the rollers of a drawing compound roller coater machine, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was using an extension ladder to reach a store roof when he slipped and fell, landing 10 to 12 feet below on concrete. The employee suffered broken bones in the lower extremities and was hospitalized.
An employee was transitioning from an electrical pole to a ladder when he fell 20 feet to the ground, injuring his spine.
An employee was walking at a residential construction site when he tripped at the front door entry threshold and fell to the ground, breaking a femur.
An employee was cutting wood stakes with a powered saw when it cut four fingers on his left hand.

An employee was unloading the back of a triaxle truck when the tailgate would not lock due to excess material in the bed of the truck. He placed his left hand on the side of the tailgate and his right hand on the latch to open the tailgate. The tailgate opened briefly and then closed immediately, catching his ring and middle fingertips. As a result, his left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving a pallet with a pallet jack. He was pinned between the jack and a pallet of cases behind him, suffering a compound fracture of the right lower leg.
An employee was cutting a 16" water main with a saw when the sawblade kicked back and cut his face on the right side.

An employee was using a riding mule to move stock when he hit a bump and jammed his right hand and wrist on the handle bar. His hand later became swollen due to a possible infection, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a kettle up with asphalt to be pumped up to a roof when he became ill due to heat stress and dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a machine press and preparing to remove the fixture for a change-over when the hydraulic press came down on his left index finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was cutting a tree branch while standing on top of a truck when he lost his balance, fell to the ground, and landed on his left side, fracturing his humerus.

Two temporary employees were stacking plates of frozen food product. One  employee went to straighten a crooked plate while the second employee set another plate down, which smashed the first employee's fingertip between the plates. The first employee suffered a right middle fingertip amputation.
While unloading freight from a semi-trailer, an employee fell off the back of the trailer to the ground below, suffering a broken rib and collapsed lung.

An employee went to step onto the top of an H-pile (metal beam) to get a laser level from the other side when his foot was caught on an extension cord, causing him to fall onto the pile. The H-pile deeply lacerated his lower left leg.
While climbing a ladder, an employee slipped and fell to the ground, landing on both feet. The employee suffered a fracture to the lower left leg and a compound fracture.
An employee was holding onto a rack at a top cross member when his finger was caught between the rack and a pipe, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee ran to catch up to a truck and was attempting to jump on the truck's entry stair when he missed the step and fell to the ground. The truck then ran over him, causing fractures and other lower body injuries.
An employee was attempting the grab a black box that was going into a waste disposal truck's hopper when the hopper's blade struck and injured the employee's hand.
An employee tripped over a pallet while guiding a pipe being carried by a forklift. The pipe fell and struck the employee on the head and chest.
An employee slipped off the tire of a dump truck after finishing cleaning operations in the tub. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a fractured ankle and broken wrists.
An employee was stepping out of a vehicle toward a fuel pump when his foot slipped off the cement pad of the fuel island and he fell to the ground. He fractured his right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to lift a bread sled off another one when his finger became pinched between the two sleds, resulting in a finger amputation.

A spotter was directing a telehandler operator who was picking up an empty rack of piping. The operator picked up the load and did not see the communication from the spotter. As the operator was backing out, the spotter was crushed between the load and a parked trailer, fracturing his back.
On August 16, 2018, an employee was bitten by a mosquito while delivering mail on his route, suffering a headache and illness that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking near the front end of a store when she tripped/fell over a box, fracturing her tibia and fibula.

An employee operating a 30-ton mobile crane was backing out down a hill when the brakes felt like they were not working, so the employee opened the door and exited the crane. He jumped approximately 6 feet and fell on his right leg at an odd angle, breaking it.

On August 16, 2018, an employee was using a shovel to help a motor grader operator clean off the road in preparation for milling when he was struck by a dump truck, fracturing his right tibia and pelvis. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee suffered a fractured wrist, fractured pelvis, and bleeding in the head after running into a glass wall and falling to the floor.
An employee was operating an automatic cutter. His hand was resting on the rail when the equipment was cycled. The blade returned and cut his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was mowing grass when they tripped over a hole, fell backwards and the mower was pulled over their left foot amputating the big toe.
An employee fell to the floor while mopping it, breaking his right hip.
An employee moved a belt that controls a rotating auger to clear a clog. When the clog cleared, the auger started up, pulling the employee's right hand into the auger and lacerating it.
An employee was leveling out a mold when the employee slipped on hydraulic fluid and fell on a press bolt, injuring the upper right arm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell off a ladder and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading pallets on a trailer with a single jack when the jack's forks became stuck on a dock plate. While maneuvering the single jack, the employee lost control of the equipment and ran into a conveyor system located nearby. 

The employee suffered a laceration to the left lower leg that became swollen, requiring hospitalization.

An employee had changed a bearing on a fan (air handling unit) and was manually checking (rotating by hand) the tension of a drive belt he had reinstalled when his left hand was pulled between the motor and the drive belt pulley, resulting in a left ring finger amputation.

An employee was wrecking a framework on a commercial construction building. As he was unclamping his harness, the anchor broke and he slipped and fell approximately 14 feet to the ground. He suffered a lacerated left eyelid, lacerated left knee, spinal fractures at the L1 and L2 vertebrae, and a hematoma of the bladder. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a trailer of freight into a store when he became dizzy and took a break. While drinking a sports drink in the shade, he immediately vomited and shortly after passed out. He was hospitalized for heat illness.

An employee was preparing to burn off a wire spool when the spool fell. It struck the employee, causing a rupture of the right bicep tendon, a minor burn on the right palm, a bruise on the left knee, a traumatic hematoma of the upper right quad (thigh and knee), and a closed degloving lesion of the upper right quad (thigh and knee).

An employee was troubleshooting a pneumatic valve located in the control cabinet of a jet mill. The employee had removed the presence sensor cable and was proceeding to remove the presence sensor when the pneumatic valve actuated and caught his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading eight boxes of frozen chicken using a dolly. As he was going down the truck's ramp, he lost his footing, let go of the dolly, fell on the ramp, and broke his right leg. He was hospitalized.
On August 16, 2018, an employee suffered a muscle tendon strain in the upper right shoulder while moving a server cabinet that weighed approximately 800 pounds.

An employee was on the roller bed of a band saw to re-measure the next cut that he was going to make when a steel piece (22" x 26" cross section and 7" long) that was previously cut fell on him, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee suffered a heart attack after excavating concrete, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a hoist to lift a 4-foot long, 133-pound channel when the rigging on the hoist released, causing the load to fall onto his right arm. He was hospitalized with a fractured right forearm.

An employee triggered a pressure washer while the nozzle was pressed against the top of the injured employee's boot. The water blast penetrated the injured employee's boot and cut the top of the foot.

On August 16, 2018, an employee was moving garbage bags near a dumpster when a waste hauler truck pushed the dumpster onto the employee's right foot.  She suffered severe injuries to her foot that required surgery.

Two employees were trying to lift a container from an aircraft. One employee's hand was caught between the aircraft and the container, causing the amputation of the employee's middle, ring, and little fingers.

On 8/16/2018, at approximately 12:30 p.m., an employee was on a trail installing a sign and pruning a hedge when he became lightheaded and passed out due to heat stress. He fell and injured his neck, requiring hospitalization.
An employee experienced stomach cramps due to heat-related injuries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a container of merchandise at a receiving dock when he stepped on a nail in the container, puncturing his right foot.
An employee suffered a left middle fingertip amputation while attempting to clear product from inside the drain hole of equipment.

An employee had stopped welding at a small part welding station and was walking around the table when he tripped on the welding leads and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was burned by liquid stock, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing alongside a conveyor placing pans on the belt when his left hand rested on a pneumatic rod that controls the tempo of production. The pneumatic rod retracted and caused an amputation to his left pinky finger. The rod was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a 16-inch pop-up saw to cut pieces of lumber. The employee's left hand was between the saw guard and blade when the cycle button was pressed. The saw then amputated three fingers on the employee's left hand.

On August 17, 2018, around 3 p.m., an employee was driving back to a postal station after delivering mail when she threw up and became nauseated. She was hospitalized for kidney failure, dehydration, nausea, and vomiting.
An employee was connecting a hose to a production tank to transfer sulfuric acid when the acid released and contacted the employee, causing chemical burns to the lower extremities.

An employee was repairing belts on a motor drive when a coworker started the motor. The employee's glove was caught, pulling the employee's right pinky finger into a pinch point between the belt and pulley. The employee's right pinky finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
A Wescom employee was working near newly installed electrical panels when the panels were energized, causing an arc flash that burned the employee.
An employee became dizzy and sick while working in a meat room, requiring hospitalization.

After loading metals onto racks to be picked up by a crane for the anodizing process, an employee was standing idle when he was stuck by the control cab of the crane, which was about 4 feet above the ground. The cab of the crane pushed the employee into one of the support steel columns of the building, where he suffered a collapsed right lung and one broken rib. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working under a truck when a coolant line ruptured. The coolant burned his chest, left arm, and stomach.
After working all day, an employee became ill due to heat-related injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was in a scissor lift setting a truss for a T-hangar when the truss hit the scissor lift after becoming bound up on a column. The employee was ejected from the scissor lift to the floor as the lift overturned. The scissor lift then landed on the employee's face. The employee suffered multiple facial bone fractures; lacerations on the forehead, back of the head, nose, and face; a small brain bleed; a small fracture on the spine (C6); and a broken upper jaw.

An employee was using a wheelbarrow to pour hot stone and rubber into a bridge plug joint when the wheelbarrow started to tip over. As he tried to stop it from falling, the hot rubber contacted his skin, causing a third degree burn to his right forearm between the wrist and elbow.
An employee was cleaning a weld with a 5-inch sander and was working in a tight spot when the sander kicked back and lacerated the employee above the left knee.
An employee fell  4 feet from a rail car to the ground while opening the rail car door, breaking his left leg.
An employee was assembling office furniture when the employee contacted the blades of an adjacent ceiling fan, sustaining a broken and lacerated nose.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell onto her right side causing a torn muscle with bleeding.

An employee was saw-cutting a floor indoors for about one hour using a walk-behind concrete saw with an oxidation catalyst when he became dizzy, exited the building, and collapsed. He was hospitalized due to carbon monoxide exposure.
An employee was removing product bags from a conveyor when his right ring finger entered one of the belt connection holes, resulting in an avulsion the right ring fingertip.
An employee was using a battery-powered circular saw to cut material on a shipping crate when the saw kicked back and the blade made contact with his finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to a cargo loader to unload packages when he fell approximately 10 feet to a lower level, fracturing his right ankle.

Two employees were moving a one-man lift into a traveling position. The employees leaned the lift backwards 45 degrees in order to move it. The injured employee thought it was going to fall on him and he lifted his right leg to kick the lever down and his leg buckled causing the lift to fall on him. His left leg buckled resulting in a dislocated patella and torn ACL.

An employee was operating a feeder that laminates Styrofoam panels to produce garage door insulation. She was feeding the Styrofoam panels and sheets of film into the feeder when her glove was caught and her right hand was pulled into the machine. She suffered contusions and swelling of the hand and wrist.
An employee was cutting a metal band from around lagging boards when the boards fell on him, pushing him into a metal beam. He suffered contusions and swelling.
An employee was clearing a shelf when an air bag unit was knocked off the shelf, struck a car battery, and deployed, striking and fracturing the employee's lower leg.
An employee was running a piece of machinery when his hand was caught in a feed wheel, cutting his right index finger and amputating his right middle fingertip.

An employee was installing street lamps from an aerial lift bucket when a car struck the aerial lift's control panel. His right hand was then crushed between the bucket and structural steel, requiring hospitalization.

On August 17, 2018, an employee was stepping over a rafter while holding a pneumatic staple gun when the gun hit the employee's right ankle and shot a staple into it. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was working on a locked-out cooling section of an exhaust fan. The employee's hand was caught in the nip point of a belt and pulley in the fan; the employee suffered an amputation of the right little fingertip and a broken right ring finger.
An employee was attempting to de-burr a part on a lathe when his glove was caught in the rotating part of the lathe, causing his left index finger to be amputated.
An employee was connecting a pillar cord into a cellar outlet when a short occurred, burning his left hand and left arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a step stool and attempting to grab an empty pot from on top of an oven when the step stool collapsed and slipped out from under her feet. As she was falling to the ground, her left hand grabbed a pot of boiling water from a stove below, spilling the contents on her body. She suffered third degree burns to her stomach, chest, left arm, elbow, and left hand.

An employee was riding a horse to check the health condition of cattle in a pasture. The employee went to rope a calf when the horse slipped and fell. The employee's leg was caught in the stirrup as the horse was regaining its footing. The employee's leg  twisted, fracturing the tibia and fibula and requiring surgery.

An employee was installing wooden blocks between liner plates and a steel rib when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the steel plate, the steel rib, and a wooden block, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was working with two cylinders when the weight of the cylinders crushed the employee's first two right-hand fingers, resulting in two finger amputations.
An employee was at a public refueling station attempting to clean the windshield of an 18-wheeler after making deliveries when the employee fell and suffered a punctured neck.

At approximately 11:15 a.m., on August 17, 2018, an employee was attempting to clear a powder buildup that was stuck in a dryer's rotary valve when the employee's right-hand fingers contacted the rotary valve, amputating the ring, middle, and pinky fingers. The rotary valve was not turned off and/or locked out at the time of the incident.

A rolling crane was raising a bridge beam to move it to a trailer when the bridge beam became caught on another bridge beam, causing the other bridge beam to tip over and hit an employee in the area. The employee suffered significant lacerations to the right lower leg.
An employee was attempting to put an aerator machine in a shed when he was pinned between the aerator and the wall of the shed, injuring his stomach area.

On August 17, 2018, at approximately 12:15 PM, an employee was unloading a dairy truck. The employee had one foot on the truck trailer gate and one foot on the loading dock plate. The truck moved forward without notice and the employee fell through the area, breaking a leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working at the dock when a second employee who was using a dolly with approximately 30 pounds of furniture bumped her. She fell to the floor, fracturing her right knee and hip.
An employee exited her car in the parking lot, lost consciousness, fell to the ground, and struck her head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a left index finger amputation while operating machinery. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was using an overhead crane to attach a hydraulic rock clevis to a pad eye on a grinder tub when his fingertip was amputated.

An off-duty employee felt ill and pulled his truck over in a store parking lot  to sleep in the cab. He was found unresponsive after falling in the parking lot, suffering head and rib injuries that required hospitalization.
On August 18, 2018, an employee was cleaning the fryer room when another employee inadvertently sprayed the employee's eyes with a caustic gel cleaner.

An employee was applying wax to the floors when he walked on the wax, slipped, lost his balance, and fell, hitting his head on 
a clothing rack before ultimately hitting the ground. He suffered a hemorrhage and laceration to the head.
On August 18, 2018, an employee suffered a back injury while lifting heavy aircraft equipment onto a rolling cart. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was helping a customer with a bow when his right ring finger was caught by the bow, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing tooling on a gear blank that was supported by an overhead crane when the weight shifted, causing the gear blank to push the employee into the side of an adjacent machine. The employee suffered a broken nose, jaw, and scapula, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pinched and amputated between a stand-up lift and racking in a warehouse.
While descending stairs outside of a building, an employee missed a step, tripped, and fell on the stairs, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee fell backwards into the side of a conveyor while walking up crossover stairs, suffering a broken tailbone.
An employee was assessing a broken tree branch when another branch fell, striking and fracturing the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting in the break room when she stood up and slipped on some water on the floor, falling to the ground on her left side and hitting her head on the table on the way down. She was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was walking when she tripped and struck both forearms on a desk. She fractured both arms, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's ring and index fingertips were amputated and the middle finger was crushed while retrieving dough from inside a dough divider.
An employee was removing compost material from a bed, lost his balance and fell six feet to a lower level landing on a board. The employee sustained fracture ribs and other body trauma.
An employee was setting up a saw when the saw started while the employee's hand was inside. The employee received a serious laceration to the hand.
An employee was straightening an extension cord when his feet became caught in the cord and he fell to the cement ground, fracturing his right hip.

An employee was cutting plastic bands on a bundle of 36 sheets of plywood that was suspended about 3 to 4 inches on another bundle placed on a rail tram. The employee was standing on the ground while cutting the bands. A forklift driver moved the forklift and the plywood shifted. About 10 to 12 sheets fell onto the employee, causing him to sustain three fractures on the right leg and right ankle.
An employee tripped over a curb and fell to the floor while walking, breaking two right shoulder bones and suffering minor scrapes on the right elbow and right knee.

On August 18, 2018, an employee was cleaning a gymnasium after a summer graduation ceremony when the employee's right hand became entangled in a tarp that was being automatically rolled up by a tarp-rolling machine. The employee suffered a broken right forearm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
On August 19, 2018, an employee was trying to close a stuck valve in a milk house. The valve cut the top of the employee's left ring finger, causing a fracture and a fingertip amputation.

An employee was repairing a tower master where cables come out of a bucket to load modules of dough into a trailer. He climbed into one of the buckets and a kink formed in the cable, which slid off a U-bolt and jerked, dropping  about 4 feet. Later, the cable came loose and the bucket fell about 25 feet to the ground with the employee still inside. He fractured his right foot and pinky toe and injured his vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee dismounted from the back of a trailer and fractured her leg.
An employee was handling a concrete road barrier when an automated lifting bracket moved and crushed the employee's fingers, resulting in amputation injuries.
An employee suffered from carbon monoxide exposure while inside a blood donation bus, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor when he tripped into the conveyor and attempted to brace his fall. As he did, his right hand entered the rollers and was crushed. The rollers were moving at the time of the incident.
An employee was using an angle grinder when the tool kicked back and severely lacerated the employee's left forearm, causing tendon and muscle damage. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

While repairing a brown stock washer, an employee was attempting to remove a tie rod from the packing with a come-along when the tie rod fell. The employee reached out to grab the packing and his right fourth finger was crushed between the tie rod and a hydraulic shaft, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was attempting to clean a printing machine roller when the employee's finger entered a pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The roller was unguarded at the time.

An employee was attempting to adjust a small pulley belt inside equipment when his left hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket, amputating his left pinky finger (below the middle knuckle) and left ring finger (above middle knuckle). The equipment was live at the time of the incident.
An employee was handling a domestic cat when it bit the employee's left hand.
An employee was placing the chute of a screw conveyor that weighed approximately 400 pounds when the chute dropped 3 feet and fractured his right foot.
An employee was using a standup powered industrial truck to move a bundle of aluminum when the truck struck his left little toe, causing a contusion.
An employee was cleaning a vat when she disconnected a water pipe and was sprayed by a 160-degree caustic solution, suffering burns.
An employee leaned back and fell off a 5-foot fixed rail ladder while cleaning blankets on a printing press. He suffered a laceration to the right side of his forehead and two cracked ribs.

An employee was standing on ladder reaching up to grab rods under the clamps. The rods lowered and pinched his thumb between the rod clamp and the rod rotator. The thumb was amputated below the second joint.

An employee was closing a flying cut-off saw door when his hand slipped and his right ring finger was cut in the pinch point created by the closed door. He suffered a partial amputation of his ring finger.

An employee was using a sledgehammer to drive an 8" railroad spike to secure a street road plate. As the employee struck the railroad spike into the asphalt, it ricocheted out and cut the employee's right shin.

An employee was helping to change out the sump pump in a manure pit. As the employee attempted to step over the manure conveyor belt, the employee's foot slipped and the employee fell, fracturing the right leg and ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The conveyor was moving at the time of the incident.

An employee was on an 8-foot scaffold conducting a repair activity on a vessel when a hot substance shot from an opening in the vessel, striking the employee's face and causing second degree burns. The employee also fell off the scaffold and suffered a swollen right wrist.
On August 20, 2018, a maintenance employee was positioning a broken log turner to prepare for welding when the log loader was actuated and broke the employee's right forearm.
An employee was stung by hornets and suffered an allergic reaction while removing brush outside the store.

An employee was changing blades on a granulator. While he was rotating the blade assembly to check the top clearance gap, the front tip of his right pinky finger became lodged between the rotating blade and stationary blade, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation (no bone loss).

An employee was operating a bulldozer in a pond where hydrogen sulfide had been detected by monitoring devices. The employee was found unconscious and required hospitalization. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.

At approximately 3:45 p.m., on 8/20/18, an employee was changing roof anchors when he fell approximately 10 feet from the roof to the ground, spraining his ankle and fracturing his spine. He was hospitalized. The employee's fall protection was disengaged at the time of the incident.
An employee jumped up to reach aisle blockers that were on top of an order picker. When she landed, she fell to the floor, injuring her hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was walking around inside the building making sure that all doors were locked. As she walking towards the entry to the kitchen, she tripped and fell to the floor at the transition between the rubber tile and the ceramic tile, suffering a left shoulder dislocation, fracture to the left arm, and contusion to the left eye. She was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting the cover on an LED light when he contacted a live wire and was shocked, suffering electrical burns that required hospitalization. Gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to extinguish a small fire on an exhaust dock machine when the employee experienced smoke inhalation and a sore throat.

An employee was attempting a stunt that required him to roll off the wheel well of a tanker truck moving at 15 miles an hour and to be dragged. He bounced off the wheel well, causing his feet to hit first and flipping him upside down. His head struck the pavement and he was dragged a short distance as the truck he was tethered to came to a stop. He suffered head trauma, causing pressure in the brain.

A temporary employee was attempting to plug in a computer into an outdoor weather-protected outlet. Upon opening the weather cover, he discovered hornets/bees inside. As he retreated from the insects, he tripped and fell into a vehicle, striking his face. He suffered a broken nose and bruises, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking behind pack mules on a trail when a mule kicked the employee's chest, causing a contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee turned to walk and slipped, twisting and fracturing her ankle in three places.
An employee was repairing a piece of heavy equipment when a metal plate fell, pinching his right ring fingertip between the plate and the ground and resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was feeding chicken leg quarters into a skinner when the employee's fingertip was caught in the machinery, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving a scrap bin with an overhead crane. As he was lowering the bin, a 20-inch diameter and 80-foot long pipe automatically kicked off of a conveyor into the area where he was standing. The pipe hit the bin and caused the bin to catch his right leg between the bin and a stationary table, fracturing it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was pushing a rolling cart when she fell and broke her hip.

An employee was attempting to climb into the driver's side of a pickup truck when his left foot slipped off the running board and his left hand lost grip of the handle inside the truck, causing him to fall to the ground and land on his back. He sustained five fractured ribs and a punctured lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning the blade to a microtome machine when it was activated via the foot pedal. The blade then amputated the employee's left fingertip. The machine was energized at the time of the incident.
An employee was climbing a ladder when his hand slipped off a rung and he fell to the concrete ground below, breaking a hand and foot.
On August 20, 2018, an employee tripped and fell while walking, suffering a wrist fracture and head contusion. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was on a trailer at a loading dock helping to load some bags of merchandise when his foot went into the gap between the dock plate and the bay door, lacerating his left shin on the side of the bumper metal bracket that required stitches.
An employee was hammering a steel wedge when a piece of metal flew off and lodged in his chest, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning cake residue from an indirect contact cooler when he was exposed to 0.02 to 0.03 ppm of chlorine dioxide, aggravating his asthma.
An employee was using a foot to set slips when the right foot was caught between slips and the rig floor, resulting in a partial amputation of the little toe.

An employee was attempting to flip over a concrete column form using a tower crane to access and tighten the pipe braces on the bottom side of the form. His hand was on a partially suspended form when his left thumb was pinched between the form and the pipe brace, resulting in a partial thumb amputation (just below the first knuckle).

An employee heated up a 500 mL bottle of violet red in a mug in the microwave. Upon removal, the heated glass bottle was shaken and shattered. The heated liquid contacted the employee, causing second and third degree burns to the face, neck, and right wrist.
An employee had finished loading drywall from a truck onto two carts at a construction site when one of the carts started to roll and struck the employee, breaking his right leg.

On 8/20/2018, an employee was operating an electric pallet jack when the employee turned a corner, crashed into a wooden pallet, and flew off the pallet jack, impacting the ground and suffering knee and leg injuries.

Two employees were using survey equipment to set a center line measurement in a cross-over median section of the roadway when a vehicle drove across the roadway at a hard 45-degree angle and struck both employees. One employee suffered a knee injury and abrasions, while the other employee suffered a clavicle fracture and laceration.

An employee was building a wooden crate with another employee. His arm moved forward at the same time that the second employee lowered the nail gun. The nail gun discharged upon contact with the first employee's arm. The nail entered the employee's right forearm.
An employee was stacking boxes of tile when one box fell on and broke his foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a stock cart when the employee's right ring finger was caught and crushed between the cart and a pole.

An employee was repairing an AC unit and had pumped down the refrigerant to the outside unit. His gauge read less than 0.1 psi and he therefore began to remove a joint using an acetylene turbo torch. However, a quantity of the refrigerant unexpectedly leaked under pressure and was ignited by the torch. This created phosgene gas, which the employee inhaled, causing coughing, nausea and irritation to his throat and lungs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to start a truck engine by adding fuel to the carburetor. There was a fire, and the employee suffered burns to the torso and left arm.
An employee stepped backwards off a trailer lift gate and hit the ground, suffering broken ribs.

At about 10:30 a.m. on August 20, 2018, an employee was measuring a steel bar stored on a storage rack. A 12-foot steel tube, on the rack below the steel bar, fell onto the employee's foot. The employee suffered a broken foot and toes.
An employee was de-clumping some material and feeding it through a chute when the chute's auger amputated part of his right index finger. The auger was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a chair dolly to remove stacked chairs from a box truck onto a loading dock. While backing out of the truck, his right foot stepped into a void off the right side of the truck. He then fell 4 feet off the dock onto a concrete curb and the chairs fell on top of him. He suffered three broken ribs on the right side, a cut to the forehead, and a nose laceration.

An employee was bending pipe on a tube bending machine when he attempted to adjust the tube. The tube bender then caught and crushed his left middle finger. The start button was activated at the time of the incident.
An employee was rigging a crane with a panel. When the crane lifted the panel off the floor, another panel that was next to it fell on the employee, who suffered a broken leg and back fracture.

An employee had just pushed meat across the roller and blade of a skinning machine when the roller grabbed the employee's skinning glove and pulled the employee's right index finger into the blade, lacerating it.
An employee fell 15 feet off a roof to the concrete below, dislocating the right shoulder, fracturing the right elbow, and fracturing the right heel.

On 08/20/18, after helping to locate, expose, and splice a fiber optic service drop to a customer's residence, an employee experienced heat-related illness and was hospitalized with lower leg swelling and heat stroke.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam on the back side of a shaver box when he stepped over  the handrails and slipped, coming into contact with the shaver knives. His right foot was amputated and he was hospitalized. The shaver heads were not locked out at the time of the incident.
On August 20, 2018, an employee sustained a back injury in the course of lifting activities at a job site.
An employee walking up a grand staircase tripped on the upper step and fell onto the landing, suffering a left humerus fracture.
An employee was tightening a chuck on a lathe machine when a bar slipped off and he fell backwards off a 5-foot platform to the concrete floor, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was hit on the head by the cross beam on a racking system while bringing down furniture.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground in an infant classroom, suffering a broken hip. The employee's head also hit the wall.

On 08/20/2018, an employee was moving an unstable load stacked on a forklift truck when the truck began to tip over. The employee jumped off the forklift as it tipped and was struck by the load, which fell off the forks. The employee was hospitalized with back and spinal injuries.
An employee backed into a safety pole while manually pulling a cart. The employee's right wrist was pinned between the pole and the cart, injuring it and requiring hospitalization.

While carrying HVAC equipment on a roof, an employee walked over a foam board covering and fell approximately 18 feet through the rough opening of the skylight to a lower level floor. The employee broke both ankles and suffered a fractured vertebra.
An employee's shin was hit by a hammer.
An employee was replacing a cable line on a pole when the pole snapped and the employee fell to the ground/pavement, injuring his shoulder, back, and hip.

An employee was performing metal casting work with molten steel when molten metal spilled onto his right leg and into his boot, burning his foot. Leg protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was standing on the ground observing pole line construction when he began showing signs of heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.
Two employees were arguing in the break room when one of the employees punched the other employee in the face. The injured employee's chest later began hurting, and he suffered a heart attack.
On August 21, 2018, an employee was climbing a step ladder to measure a house foundation when the employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a broken rib and collarbone.

An employee was walking and carrying a bucket of hot rubberized material when he tripped and fell over a propane tank line. The bucket hit the ground, causing hot tar to splash onto his arms and burn his skin.

An employee was attempting to depressurize a threaded natural gas line. He continued to disconnect the pipe and a significant pressure release occurred, dislocating his left shoulder and bruising his right thigh. He was hospitalized.
An employee was rigging up an isolation tool when he started to experience symptoms of heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

On August 21, 2018, a temporary employee was mounting a truck tire on a rim. The tire was too large for the rim; when it was inflated, a sudden release of contained air caused broken bones in the employee's right arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing brush along a fence line using a mini excavator when a small branch fell onto the controls, pinching his finger between the control arm and the branch. His fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was walking up a ramp to the office trailer when he rolled his ankle.

An employee was using a core drill to drill into concrete when the drill bit became stuck, spun around, became airborne, and struck the employee in the head. The employee suffered a small fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered from extreme cramping and vomiting while tying rebar outside, requiring hospitalization for dehydration and heat illness.
On August 21, 2018, an employee was operating a riding pallet jack when his foot slipped off the equipment. His right ankle was then crushed between a column and the pallet jack.

An employee was cleaning under a mutton saw that had been shut off when the blade came into contact with her right index finger, causing a severe laceration. She was hospitalized. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was arriving at his workstation when a flash fire occurred inside a plastic scrap recycling machine. He suffered burns to his left arm and shoulder area, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking up the ramp to a flammable chemical storage room to empty a container of waste alcohol into a drum when the employee tripped over a 1-inch lip and fell to the spill containment floor, fracturing the right hip.

An employee was clearing a jam on a shredding machine when his right hand was pulled into the conveyor belt, causing an amputation of his right pinky finger. He also suffered lacerations to his right ring finger, middle finger, and thumb.

An employee had just lowered a steel mold to the floor using an overhead crane. He needed to disconnect the lifting chain ring that was attached to the crane and the hoist ring connected to the mold. He was grabbing the lifting chain to disconnect it when his right hand was caught between the chain ring and the steel mold, breaking two bones in his hand.

An employee was performing an ergonomic push/pull meter evaluation while pulling a cart with meter straps when the straps broke away and he fell backwards, hitting the towing hitch of a tow-tugger. He suffered a fractured left leg and broken ribs.
While attempting to clean out the inside of a bin, an employee stepped in the auger, which cut off the back of the employee's heel.
An employee was removing an overhead door during demolition-type activities when part of the door came down and injured the employee's finger.

An employee was moving steel from a flatbed trailer when the steel flipped off dunnage on the trailer and rolled onto his right ring finger. The finger was pinched between the steel and the trailer, causing the amputation of the fingertip (with no bone loss).
An employee was standing in the store when a customer stabbed him in the back with a crowbar.
An employee was stacking slabs of granite when a slab fell over and broke his left leg.
An employee had been applying coating to pipes for about 30 to 45 minutes when he became ill due to heat exhaustion, dehydration, and kidney failure, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking into a supply closet when her lab coat became caught in the door and she began to fall. While falling, she attempted to catch herself and grabbed a door jam, lacerating her right pinky fingertip.
An employee was bitten by a rattle snake while cleaning out a flower box.
An employee fell 19 feet off a two-story residential roof to the concrete below during roofing activities. The employee suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was clamping a cast iron gas meter housing unit into a hydrostatic test unit. While actuating the clamping mechanism, he was holding the body with his right hand. As the clamping mechanism was clamping, the cap on the outlet end (left side of the body) shifted. At this point, he grabbed the body and cap to prevent it from falling out of the testing machine. His left thumb then became caught between the cap and the hydrostatic test clamping mechanism, causing a partial amputation of his thumb tip.
An employee was lifting tiles when he started to feel sick and nauseous due to a herniated and bulging disc in his back, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was blowing down fish with an airline hose when he took a step back, lost his balance, and fell on a step located behind him. He injured his right rib and right lung.

An employee was saw-cutting a concrete slab with an electric flat saw powered by a generator. The electrical cord was being run through an open doorway. A doorstop was holding the door open. Someone removed the doorstop, and the cord was crushed and shorted out, energizing the saw. When the employee touched the saw, he sustained an electrical shock to the right arm and torso.
An employee was unloading freight/boxes from the lift gate of a straight truck while it was elevated when he fell and struck his head on the ground of the parking lot, suffering a head injury.
An employee was greasing a waterwheel as part of minor servicing when his hand slipped and became stuck in the waterwheel sprocket, causing hand lacerations that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing gloves while holding a drill when the drill trigger was pushed. The tool drilled into his left hand, causing a laceration and tendon damage to his pinky finger.
An employee was trying to retrieve a part that was not loaded correctly in a machine when his finger was pinched and lacerated between the part and a component of the machine.
While making a delivery, an employee fell and suffered a possible amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was working at a press when his right hand was caught between the press and a fixture he was bending, resulting in a partial amputation of his right ring finger.

After checking material that was loaded in a tractor trailer, an employee was stepping off the truck when it pulled out. She slipped off the truck and fell 4 feet, breaking her left leg above the ankle.

An employee was inserting a part into a CNC machine and lining up the cutting device when the machine started to rotate and caught the employee's finger, resulting in the amputation of half of the left index finger.

An employee was being trained on a wood chipper machine when a second employee switched the machine on. A piece of the blade that was attached to the blade assembly blew off and punctured the employee's right forearm.
On August 22, 2018, an employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee drove a roll-off truck to a landfill and was emptying a load when he noticed a hydraulic leak on one of the hoses. He was looking to see where the leak was coming from when the hydraulic stream hit his left index finger, penetrating his work glove and cutting his finger, which allowed the hydraulic fluid to enter his finger. He was hospitalized.

On 8/22/2018, an employee was putting plywood down between two joists while laying floor decking when he stepped on non-secured plywood and fell through the gap between joists. He fractured his ribs, elbow, and left arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was handling a 30-pound tube block to place on a trailer bed. In an attempt to keep the tube block from falling, his right thumb was caught between the tube block and the bed of the trailer, resulting in a right thumb tip amputation.
A forklift struck an employee during sod installation, causing a broken foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a rooftop air conditioning unit and changing a fuse when the fuse exploded, burning the employee's right hand.
An employee was working on the roof of a building when he began to feel overheated and experienced cramping in his hand. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

Three employees were performing maintenance on a pipeline by using a pig to clean the line when a hose connected to the pressurized line flew back and struck two employees. The air from the hose injured the third employee. Two of the employees were hospitalized with broken bones and abrasions.

An employee was loading containers onto a vessel when his right thumb was caught and crushed between a 20' container's side wall and the outside corner casting of the container, resulting in a partial amputation of the right thumb tip.
While operating a yard truck, an employee struck a stack of chassis and fractured the left tibia.

An employee was grinding a piece of metal on a drum grinder when her glove became caught, pulling her hand into the grinder. She suffered a right middle finger amputation, fractured right ring finger, and fractured ulna.

At about 3:10 a.m. on August 22, 2018, an employee was changing filters in a residence's attic. As he walked from one end of the attic to the other, he fell through the floor, landing on the floor about 10 feet below. He fractured his right foot and suffered a laceration to the right hand, and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a concrete block tank. The blade engaged, amputating the employee's right arm above the elbow and left hand except the thumb.
An employee was standing in line to check out for the day when he suffered a seizure due to dehydration and collapsed.

An employee was cutting a banding on a bundle of pipes when the bundle rolled toward him and knocked him down, pinning his right leg beneath the pipes. He suffered a sprain to his lower right leg and ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a rotary mill machine when the employee's fingers were caught in the running cutting tool, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee tripped or slipped while running down the hall to respond to an emergency code on the PA. She fell and suffered a broken arm and wrist, bruised ribs, and a swollen face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was guiding a die-mounting plate that was suspended from an overhead crane when the crane's eye bolt broke, causing the load to shift and crush the employee's left hand.
A temporary employee slipped while mopping the floor and suffered a broken hip.
An employee fell 10 to 12 feet from a roof to the ground while delivering roofing supplies to a residential location, suffering a broken pelvis and elbow that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a soil compactor when it rolled over. As a result, he suffered arm, collarbone, and rib fractures.

An employee was working on a wood planer when a piece of wood became lodged in the rollers. The employee was attempting to remove the wood when the rollers pulled the employee's left pinky finger inside, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.
An employee fell 6 feet off a straight ladder to the cement floor, fracturing both wrists.

On August 22, 2018, an employee of Industrial Machining Services was replacing a valve on the tank cluster in an isolated work area. After the employee finished welding on the tank outlet cluster, the employee began to assemble the valve when an unknown hot water line sprayed the employee in the arm, resulting in second and third burns and a hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to clear a piece of steel out of a cutting press cutter when the cutting press was engaged via the foot pedal. The cutter then partially amputated his right pinky finger.
An employee suffered a partial right thumb tip amputation while trying to disengage an airline from a gear at a press infeed roller.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when the right side of her vehicle was struck by a clamp lift that was being operated by another employee. She suffered hip and back injuries.
An employee tripped while walking around a desk and fractured an arm.

An employee was moving an articulating dump truck on a mat bridge when one of the tires caught the edge of the mat bridge and began to slide. The truck slid off the bridge and rolled onto its side. The employee suffered a punctured lung, fractured ribs, and a head laceration, requiring hospitalization.
On August 22, 2018, an employee was attempting to unjam a manual blanking press when his  left hand was caught in the tooling, resulting in three middle fingertip amputations.

An employee was responding to a request for assistance for a sick patient in a cardiac rehab outpatient unit. The employee was running to get towels when the employee's knee struck a bench. The employee then fell backwards incurring additional injuries. The result was a fracture of the left tibia plateau, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while delivering mail.

An employee was working on a press part revolution clutch and attempting to reach the die when the die crushed her right hand, causing three fractures. The press was guarded at the time of the incident.
After cleaning a patient's bathroom, an employee experienced shortness of breath and nausea due to exposure to bleach-based cleaner and isopropyl alcohol. She was hospitalized.

While backing up an excavator, an employee reached out to pull in a mirror to avoid striking a telephone pole. The employee's hand was caught between the mirror and pole, resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was collecting trash when a razor blade protruded through the bag and severed his fingertip.
An employee was caught between a core puller (a hydraulic cylinder machine) and a quench table. His back and left hip were severely injured.

An employee was on his hands and knees, doing maintenance work on a roof. He stood up, became dizzy and then fell off the roof, landing 12-15 feet below. He suffered broken ribs, a broken pelvis, a head contusion, and a cut to his right little finger. At the time of the incident, the employee's harness that was not tied off.
An employee was lifting the tongue of a pull behind mobile light tower when their right ring finger was pinched between the tower's tongue and the ground resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping to move a patient to another bed when he suffered severe pain due to a hernia, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping remove a raised elevator basket when a chunk of debris fell from the basket to the ground, 70 feet below. The debris bounced off the ground and struck the employee's hand, causing an amputation to his ring and little fingers at the second knuckle.
An employee was using a forklift to load a truck. The forklift ran over the employee's foot, fracturing the right ankle.

An employee was installing new breaker hardware in existing panels. While the employee was wiring the hardware, crossed phases caused an arc flash. The employee suffered severe burns to his face, neck, and both arms and was hospitalized. The hardware was not shut down or locked out at the time of the incident.
A roofer fell off the edge of a roof, suffering broken legs.
A facility was evacuated. One of the evacuated employees was hospitalized, suffering from nausea and headaches suspected to have been brought on by leaking carbon monoxide.

An employee was painting steel beams from an aerial lift. The lift basket got caught on a metal beam while the lift was moving and when it freed the employee was thrown against another beam. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder.
An employee fell down two exterior steps while leaving the facility, fracturing the right ankle and requiring surgery.
An employee was attempting to change out a belt on a fan when his left thumb was caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

An employee was lowering a concrete pipe (weighing approximately 2,000 lbs.) into a trench when the pipe struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and ruptured bladder.
Two employees got in a fist fight. The injured employee broke his jaw in multiple places.

An employee was preparing two 12-inch by 40-foot pieces of channel iron to be marked and drilled. The two pieces were on work stands; while the employee was moving them closer together, they fell over, bounced off the stands, and struck the employee's lower left leg. He suffered a fracture to the leg, just above the ankle.
An employee was working on a meat stuffing machine when his finger was caught and pinched by a piston returning to its sleeve. He suffered a cut to his fingertip with tissue loss, requiring stitches.

An employee was helping to steady a resin pump that was undergoing a troubleshooting test following maintenance on the pump. His finger entered the path of the pump coupling, which was moving up and down. When the pump closed, it pinched the his left index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was climbing a ladder with a 46-pound aluminum box frame. The frame hit a wall and began to fall; as the employee tried to stop it, he suffered a shoulder dislocation that required surgery.
While stepping from a counter back onto a step ladder, an employee fell to the floor. She was hospitalized for knee surgery and to treat a head injury.
An employee fell 11 feet, 5 inches through a roof hole opening to the next lower level, suffering back, rib, and head injuries. The hole was unmarked and unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting brass castings with a cutoff wheel when his left ring finger was cut, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a forklift to stack two boxes when her right hand was caught between a box and the forklift forks, resulting in a right index finger amputation.

After reporting to work at 7:00 a.m., an employee became lethargic and shaky at about 9:30. Suffering from possible heat exhaustion, he was hospitalized for testing related to a possible heart attack.
An employee was stacking boxes when his gloved right index finger was caught in the strapping belt, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

While discharging pressure from and testing a well head, an employee opened a steel valve fitting under 400 pounds of pressure. The fitting unscrewed and was ejected, striking the employee's lower right leg and breaking it.
An employee was helping to build a fence. He reached down to pick up some fencing material when a rattlesnake bit him on the right hand through his gloves. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on the catwalk of a mixing plant at a completed well site. He was burned by a fire, centered on a forklift and a flowback tank that was releasing natural gas. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to his right hand and arm to the shoulder, his left hand, and his back on the right side. He also suffered second-degree burns to the right side of his face (excluding the eyes) and first-degree burns to his forehead. Personal protective equipment and flame-retardant pants were being worn, but not a flame-retardant shirt.
An employee was servicing a truck from underneath when hot antifreeze/engine coolant poured onto him. He suffered burns to the face, arms, and chest.
An employee was cutting grass and was adjusting the wheel guard on the lawn mower when the blade cut his fingers.

An employee was installing wire mesh on a second floor, about 20 feet high. He fell, breaking his right arm. A harness was not being worn at the time of the incident, and the employee was outside the area protected by a safety wire.

An employee was removing a wire from a 480 VAC meter when the employee made contact with a live wire. An arc flash occurred, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's face, neck, torso, and left arm. Proper personal protective equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee fell while stepping out of a manufactured home. The employee's hip struck the corner of a house jack during the fall, resulting in a fractured hip that required hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were talking near the machine one of them had been operating. A double pallet jack backed out of the adjoining aisle and struck one of the two, pinching his left leg/ankle against the other employee's machine. He suffered fractures to his left tibia/fibula.
On August 23, 2018, an employee was attempting to repair a drain snake that was turned off. His little finger got tangled in the line and the tip was amputated.

An employee was preparing to wash off a mower when he noticed a clump of grass on the mower deck. As he reached down to clean it off, the spinning mower blade struck his left ring finger, amputating the top 1/2" portion of his finger.
An employee was sprayed by 180-degree process condensate water while attempting to remove a level puck from the side of a vessel he thought was empty.

An employee was in a scissor lift welding a clip angle and needed to reposition the scissor lift for the next weld. While repositioning the scissor lift, his left hand was caught between the top rail and an existing pipe support, resulting in a partial pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee passed out while having lunch in a packing shed, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while working inside a tunnel pipe.

An employee was pushing a cart, holding two fryers filled with hot oil, to a new position. Two of the cart's wheels broke off. Hot oil spilled onto the employee's lower left arm, causing first-degree burns.
On August 24, 2018, an employee was servicing a conveyor when it pinched the employee's thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee suffered heat-related stress due to dehydration while pursing a group of people.

An employee was operating a tandem gin pole truck to assist with a load when the front of the truck began raising up and slammed down to the ground. He then exited the truck and laid on the ground in pain. He was hospitalized with an L2 vertebra fracture.
An employee fell to the cement floor while putting away a mop. The employee suffered a dislocated right knee, sprained right ankle, and broken right wrist.
An employee was using a grinder when it caught onto his shirt and contacted his chest, requiring stitches.
While in a manhole, investigating water complaints from cemetery visitors, an employee lost consciousness due to lack of oxygen.

On August 24, 2018, at around 1:57 p.m., an employee was cleaning a line using a central vacuum system. She went to the discharge side of the system (where scrap barrels get changed out manually) and was reaching through the collar when she made contact with the rotary valve. The moving valve amputated her right index and middle fingertips.
On August 23, 2018, an employee was training to use a coping machine. The employee's glove was snagged on a part, and the employee suffered a partial amputation of the right little finger.
An employee was standing on the tongue of a tractor trailer attempting to loosen the safety strap on a load of pipes when he fell 2 feet off the trailer to the ground and broke his hip.

Employees were getting off the roof of a single-story home due to rain. While retrieving tools from the roof, an employee slipped on the wet panels and fell to the ground, about 10 to 12 feet below. He suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was working on a drill rig floor, repairing a draw works cabling system. He began to suffer from illness due to the high temperature outside and was hospitalized.

On August 24, 2018, an employee was bleeding out a line carrying cetyl 16-18 fatty alcohol. The material was frozen in the line; when the employee opened the bleeder valve, the hose blew off and struck him in the face. He suffered fractures of the hard palate and nasal spine and a lacerated gumline that required stitches.

A Rozell Industries employee was working near a contractor who was using a stone wheel grinder when the stone wheel blew apart. The shrapnel hit and broke the employee's leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a two-handed dolly to move stacks of totes to load into a trailer. The stacks weighed roughly 216 lbs. He picked up a stack, leaned back, and then dropped to the ground in extreme pain. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee became ill while doing landscape work. He was hospitalized for possible heat-related illness.
An employee was in a wash bay pulling a grate up to a drain when his right middle finger was caught in the grate, tearing off flesh from his fingertip.
An employee was descending steps when he missed a step and fell to the floor landing, tearing his patella tendon.
An employee was opening a box with a utility knife and cut their left thumb.
An employee's leg was run over by the front tire of an aircraft in tow.
An employee got dizzy while walking and fell, striking her head against the wall and suffering two fractures to her left foot.
An employee was attempting to manually adjust a printing press when the machine amputated her right ring finger down to the first knuckle and lacerated her pinky finger.

An employee was walking beside a stand-behind trencher as it dug a trench. The cutting chain pulled in one of his shoelaces and severely lacerated his lower left leg. The chain was guarded at the time of the incident.
A flowback operator was cutting a hole in a 55-gallon poly drum. The knife closed on his left little finger, cutting it. He was hospitalized; the finger was amputated.

An employee was on top of a catwalk to gauge the oil. He opened the thief hatch and fell approximately 13 feet to the ground, suffering multiple broken ribs, a lacerated spleen, a hip injury, and a pelvic injury.
An employee was manually feeding dough into sheeting rollers when his right hand was caught and crushed between two rollers, resulting in index, middle, and ring finger amputations.
An employee was moving a spooling machine when it tipped over, smashing and breaking three of the employee's fingers.

An employee was aligning/guiding a workover rig onto a well-head using a spacing cable when his left ring finger was caught between the spacing cable and the rod blowout preventer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A crew was stretching a strand that was part of a concrete product when the strand broke and punctured the injured employee's left cheek area.
An employee was moving rebar with an overhead crane. The rebar shifted and smashed two fingers causing partial amputations to both fingers.
An employee was descending from a 6-foot ladder when he missed the second step from the bottom and fell to the floor, landing on and breaking his hip.

An employee was observing the hoisting of a steel roof beam. As the crane was setting the beam down so its rigging could be tightened, the beam fell out of the rigging, hit the ground, rolled, and struck the employee. It broke his left ankle and lacerated his right foot.

An employee was operating a joiner saw. While the employee was pushing a board on the saw, the employee's left hand slipped into the guard and touched the blade, which amputated the middle fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a scissor lift welding lintels. The scissor lift platform was struck from below by a moving personnel hoist crushing the employee into the ceiling. The employee sustained a fractured arm and wrist, a collapsed lung, a blood clot in the lung, and kidney damage.

While an employee was sanitizing hard candy tumblers, a bucket of sodium hydroxide cleaner spilled and the chemical splashed onto the legs of his coveralls and jeans. It soaked through, burning his knees. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a piece of steel to its landing position when his left fourth digit fingertip was caught between the steel and its landing position, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was picking up one end of an 80 lb. steel plate to be moved when the employee's thumb was caught between two steel plates, causing a sheering action that resulted in a right thumb amputation.
An employee had just changed a winder. As he started the winder back up, his finger was caught in the spinning winder, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working to free a press feed that became stuck when hot plastic resin contacted the employee's left hand, causing a second degree burn to the palm and fingers. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee's right middle finger was struck by a sledgehammer during precast concrete manufacturing. The fingertip was amputated.

A technician was installing communication cables from a ladder. The ladder buckled and he fell about 15 feet, landing on a concrete floor. He suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized for surgery.
While unstrapping cargo straps on a flatbed, an employee lost his balance and fell to the ground. He suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was hit by a contractor's truck while crossing the street, breaking both of her legs.

An employee was helping guide a pipe into place to connect to rig equipment. His left hand was caught between the pipe flange and the rig equipment's frame, and his ring finger was pinched. The tip was amputated. Personal protective equipment and impact gloves were being worn at the time of the incident.
While standing on a mezzanine doing electrical work, an employee fell through a cover for the light panels to the floor below. The employee sustained a hip fracture.
An employee's finger was caught between a pipe connection, resulting in a left fingertip amputation.
An employee was holding onto a pressurized hot water hose when hot water splashed onto the employee causing burns to their arms, chest and leg.
An employee was operating an order selector machine when it jumped the wire guide and hit a rack, fracturing the employee's right leg.
An employee was repairing an underground drop at a customer's home when a copperhead snake bit his right middle finger, causing pain, swelling, and nausea.

An employee was using a ladle to pour molten aluminum into a tilt when he started feeling ill and then vomited. He later experienced aching arms and hands, and was hospitalized for severe dehydration.
An employee was standing on the second step of a stepladder painting a wall. As she went to step down, she missed the first step and fell to the floor, breaking her arm.
An employee was assisting a customer with a car that was set on a jack when the car's tire fell onto his left hand, fracturing it.
An employee stepped backward into a fueling pit on the ground that was about 2 to 3 feet deep, suffering a hematoma to his left leg just above his knee.
An employee was mowing a lawn when the blade of a lawnmower contacted his hand, amputating his left middle finger.
Between 6:00 and 7:00 p.m. on August 30, 2018, after returning home from a 10-hour shift, a burner operator began to feel ill. He was hospitalized for severe dehydration.
An employee was grinding a casting using a 20-inch face-front grinding wheel when the employee's finger was pinched at the bottom of the wheel on the seal plate, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was stepping down an extension ladder after installing a ceiling anchor for a section of duct when the ladder and employee fell. He suffered a broken right wrist, broken ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee was using a table saw to cut backsplashes to a shorter length. The saw lacerated three of his fingers, amputating the first joint of his left middle finger and the tips of his left index and ring fingers.
An employee was delivering packages along his truck route when he became dehydrated due to the hot weather, requiring hospitalization.
An employee became ill while shoving grain inside a kiln, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee tripped and fell while pulling a cart. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

At 3:11 a.m. on August 31, 2018, while working in a manhole, an employee was overcome by an unknown air contaminant and lost consciousness. A second employee entered the manhole to rescue the first, but also lost consciousness. One of the employees was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a boom lift in reverse when he hit a parked mobile crane. His left arm was pinched between the basket guardrail and the crane, fracturing it above the elbow.
An employee used a forklift to pull a pallet from a stack. He got off the forklift and the boxes from the pallet fell on him, fracturing his ankle.
On August 31, 2018, an employee was struck by a forklift's forks while walking across an aisle. The employee suffered a broken leg.

At 4:00 p.m. on August 31, 2018, an employee was installing water lines in a trench when it collapsed, partially burying the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis, broken ribs, head trauma, and broken facial bones. Cave-in protection was not installed in the trench.

An employee was helping a customer in the parking lot when a customer's car struck the employee. The employee was crushed between the car and the service center building, suffering a crushed abdomen and ruptured kidney. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while walking down stairs, suffering a broken left ankle.

An employee dismounted his machine and was on the warehouse floor about to pull an order when the machine activated and struck him, pinning him to a wall. He fractured his pelvis and sacrum, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing metal bars from the base of a hammer cage being held up by a crane when the cable holding up the hammer snapped. The hammer dropped and pinned the employee's left hand, which had to be amputated at the wrist.
An employee was loading a forklift machine with steel walings (I-beam) when a waling fell off the forklift and caught his right hand, amputating his ring fingertip.
