An employee was cutting a metal piece with a shear and suffered an amputation injury to the right thumb. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was lifting a basket of wood chips with a chain saw that had two choker chains attached when a link in one of the choker chains broke, hitting and fracturing the employee's right forearm.
On August 31, 2018, at approximately 8:50 a.m., an employee was helping an associate cut limbs from a tree when he was struck by a pole saw, suffering an abdominal laceration.
An employee was installing a garage door counterbalance. The spring action lifted the employee 6 to 8 feet into the air, causing fractures to the hip and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's right foot was run over by a forklift as the forklift operator was backing out of a freezer. The employee's right foot was crushed and the large toe had to be amputated.
An employee was opening a double hung window. When he operated the sash release, the upper sash dropped and amputated his ring fingertip.

An employee was about 25 feet up a tree, trying to cut off a large overhanging tree limb. The limb he had tied off to broke. He fell to the ground, landing flat on his stomach. He suffered collapsed lungs, fractured ribs, and an internally relocated stomach, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to straighten a lumber board on a stacker when her left ring finger was caught and crushed between the end of the lumber and the unit lift mechanism, resulting in a fracture and lacerations.

An employee was picking up a 56-pound casting piece out of an elevated tub that was full of casting pieces when another casting piece became dislodged and fell against the employee's left hand, causing a partial fifth fingertip amputation.

An employee of AROCK Services, LLC, was overexposed to hydrogen sulfide gas while changing a valve on a pumper unit. The employee experienced nausea and inflammation of the throat, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing shingles on an approximately 8-foot-high roof when the employee fell from the roof onto a concrete wall, suffering a lacerated lip and fractured jaw.

An employee was under a parked vehicle performing repair work on brake lines when the vehicle rolled over his left arm and left side, momentarily pinning him between the vehicle tire and the ground. He suffered broken ribs as well as multiple cuts and contusions.
An employee was driving a truck when the fifth wheel came off and the truck turned over. The employee suffered brain bleeding.
An employee was loading a railcar when he lost his grip on a ladder and fell to the ground. He suffered a fractured right wrist, a sprained left wrist, and chipped vertebrae.
An employee was walking across the parking lot while escorting a patient to a work van when she lost her footing and fell to the ground, breaking her right arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was testing the gun for a pressure washer when it shot high-pressure water into his hand. He suffered possible tendon damage, water under the skin of three fingers, and abrasions, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working in the field, installing and overseeing the installation of a midstream flexible piping system, when he started to feel weak. He was hospitalized due to heat stress and dehydration.

On August 31, 2018, an employee was clearing debris from a small piece remover machine. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the left index finger, a full amputation to the left middle finger, and an injury to the left ring finger. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking when she tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing her right wrist and elbow.
An employee was taking inventory inside a truck when he fell out of the truck to the concrete floor, suffering a back injury and internal bleeding.
An employee slipped on the iced floor in a cooler, falling to the floor. She suffered a broken left leg, requiring surgery.
An employee was loading a metal locker onto a forklift when the locker door opened and slammed back, cutting his left ring fingertip and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was on a 6-foot step ladder pulling a box out from under three other boxes on a shelf when she lost her balance and fell approximately 5 feet, hitting the shelves and floor. She was hospitalized with a head contusion, right hand laceration, right ankle sprain, and neck and back strain.
An employee was starting the company van to begin work when he felt chest pain. He was hospitalized for a possible lifting injury.
An employee was installing an underground utility when the employee contacted an energized bus and was shocked, suffering electrical burns.
An employee was opening cardboard dumpster when the dumpster gate struck his upper thigh, causing a contusion.
An employee tripped over a floor sweeper and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was sorting hops when the employee's finger was caught in a chain and sprocket, resulting in the amputation of a finger. The chain and sprocket were unguarded at the time.
An employee was attacked by a patient. He then fell and hit his head on the floor, suffering a subdural hematoma.

At about 4:00 p.m. on September 2, 2018, an employee was parking a forklift when his left foot was caught between the forklift and a bollard. The foot was crushed; part of his big toe was medically amputated.
An employee was walking when she slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing her left arm and injuring her head. She was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hoist to change a cooling liquid bag filter on a machine when the strap broke, causing the filter's metal strainer to come down on the employee's left hand and amputate the left middle fingertip.

At about 8:20 p.m. on September 2, 2018, an employee was trying to unjam a can necking machine. An aluminum part of a can flew out, striking the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated. The machine's guard was open at the time of the incident.

An employee was pouring drain cleaner down a clogged pipe when it mixed with a different cleaner that had previously been poured down the drain. The two chemicals reacted and created fumes that the employee inhaled, suffering respiratory distress.

An employee was retrieving water from a frac tank when he contacted a 25 kilovolt line with a pig pole and was electrically shocked. He sustained burns to his hands, feet, and abdomen, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were lifting a box of freight into a trailer when the box fell and struck one of the employees. The employee was hospitalized for a sprain/strain to the shoulder and left hip and a head contusion.

A rig hand was guiding pipe to a racking system on a rig floor to rack back the pipe. He slipped and fell on the rig floor. As he fell, the 90-foot drilling pipe was stabbed into the floor of the rig, pinching his finger against the floor. His finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped off a platform at a height of approximately 12 feet and fell to the ground below, suffering a broken hip.
While entering a patient's room, an employee slipped on a wet floor mat and fell, striking their face on a bed rail and the back of their head on the floor.
AN employee was carrying a roll of insulation tape when he slipped and fractured his left leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to clean out excess dough from a pretzel folding machine when her hair became caught in a rotating shaft. As a result, she lost hair and a portion of her scalp, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was changing a transmission on a loader/crane. While he was removing a bolt, the flywheel caught and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.

An employee was walking by a room where a subcontractor had been working on a pipe and heard a hissing noise that made him think that gas was leaking. He evacuated the room and told the subcontract workers to leave when the gas ignited. The employee received burns to his hands, face, and shoulders.
An employee was pinning the center section of a mast on a drilling rig when the pin was forced out of the pad eye connection and struck the employee on the right side of face, breaking bones.
An employee was installing trusses when the truss he was tied to faulted and he fell 12 feet to the ground, suffering lacerations to the head and shoulder.

An employee was moving a vibratory plate compactor from the bucket of a mini-excavator. The employee's right little finger was caught on the excavator's bucket hook. It was dislocated and severely lacerated, requiring surgery.

An employee was striping lines in a soccer field.  He placed a metal stake in the ground, using string as chalk. The string did not reach as far as needed and when the employee tugged on the string, the stake came out of the ground like a slingshot, striking his left bicep. The stake traveled through his arm and punctured his lung.
On September 4, 2018, at approximately 2:40 PM, an employee felt dizzy, passed out, hit his head, and suffered a head laceration. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee at a water line drilling site was struck by a hose when its fitting broke at the threads. The hose broke the employee's cheekbones.

An employee was scrubbing an aluminum panel while a coworker was pressure washing nearby when the water jet from the coworker's pressure washer lacerated the employee's finger. He was hospitalized and required stitches.

An employee was using a tape measurer to measure the circumference of a steel tank that was sitting on rollers when slack in the tape measurer began to create a loop that was getting hung up. As the employee reached for the loop, he inadvertently activated the roller. His left pinky was then caught and smashed between the roller and the tank, resulting in a surgical amputation.

Two employees were working from an aerial lift to install insulation within the interior walls and roof of an aviation hangar. The lift operator drove it into an existing two-foot deep excavation causing the lift to tip over. Both employees fell out of the lift basket onto the concrete hangar floor. One employee was hospitalized for multiple leg fractures. Both employees were wearing a personal fall arrest system at the time of the incident.

At about 3:40 a.m., on September 4, 2018, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and a curb; she suffered a long bone fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing tubing and sucker rods from a well when a sucker rod broke and fell, striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.

An employee was cleaning and clearing regrind from the area around a large mechanical grinder. The grinder was powered down and locked out with the machine guarding and covering removed. The employee spun the shaft of the grinder by hand to check and see if the shaft/rotor was clear. This caused the shaft to rotate. He then tried to stop the shaft from spinning and his right hand contacted a blade attached to the shaft, causing multiple lacerations to his fingers.
An employee in a slaughter plant tripped on a pallet and fell, breaking his right arm.

The injured employee was walking from a staging area to a receiving bullpen while talking to a forklift operator who was at the dockside of a forklift aisle. A second forklift operator was traveling in the forklift aisle and struck the injured employee's left foot, breaking four toes and causing a large contusion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a hallway that was just mopped when he slipped and fell. He attempted to break his fall with his right hand, splitting it on impact.

An employee was cutting a 5-inch by 6-foot floor board using a table saw. The board jammed, and the employee's left hand was pulled into the saw. His left thumb and palm were severely cut. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was loading his car after finishing his work shift when he fell and broke his hip.

Two employees were cleaning a car in a car lot. One of them was struck by a pallet carried by a forklift, suffering a broken arm, broken shoulder, broken ribs, and ruptured spleen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lubricating a shaft on a drum machine when the drum released onto the shaft, crushing and fracturing the employee's right index finger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating the tongs at a rig when the winch line broke and the equipment struck the employee's lower right leg, breaking the tibia. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a plastic sheet from the plastic feeder part of a bottom crust freezer transport system. Her sleeve was caught and her right hand was pulled into the machine; she suffered broken bones in the wrist and lacerations to the hand.

An employee was being trained by a second employee on how to cut a metal frame on a lathe. As they set the metal frame down on the lathe, the first employee's right thumb was caught and crushed between the frame and the lathe chuck.
An employee was hitching a trailer onto his truck. His thumb was caught under the hitch, suffering a laceration.
An employee began experiencing cramps and trouble walking while surveying on a steep slope. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and heat-related illness.
An employee was walking down a stairway. He tripped on the last step and fell forward, striking his head on a wooden table. He was hospitalized for facial surgery.
A temporary employee was pinning holes using a K-file tool. He placed the K-file in his mouth while checking something and swallowed the tool, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unwrapping a large coil around a conveyor belt. The coil bounced back, striking and breaking his left hand.
An employee suffered from heat stress while torch-cutting a waste disposal container outside, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a dock, pulling product. A forklift in reverse struck him, smashing the top of his left foot.

An employee was attempting to replace a pressure gauge on a hot gas ammonia line. As the employee loosened the gauge for removal, a quarter-inch pipe and valve broke, releasing ammonia vapor above the processing floor. The employee inhaled the ammonia vapors and required hospitalization.
An employee fell from the back of a truck while moving appliances.

An employee was pulling back the rods of a boring machine when the rods became bound. Once they became loose, the bore rods flipped over and a bore head struck the employee's right leg, breaking bones.
An employee was trying to change out a die on a cutoff press. The die crushed his hand, resulting in an amputation. The machine was not locked out or tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was tightening a new battery on a truck when the truck slipped off its jack. The employee's left leg was caught on the truck's battery box, breaking the leg and causing a laceration.
An employee was pulling a fan that was packaged in a cardboard box when the packaging ripped, causing the employee to lose her grip. She then fell to the ground and injured her hip.
A security officer was assaulted by an individual he was attempting to restrain in the emergency department. He twisted his right ankle and fell to the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee began to experience cramping after completing a shift as a pusher side doorman.  The employee was hospitalized to treat heat exhaustion.

An employee was attempting to remove a jammed pallet from a conveyor. The employee's left glove was caught by a moving mechanical part and pulled into an ingoing nip point created by a chain and another mechanical part. The ring finger was amputated below the first joint.
While holding a grout hose, an employee suffered chemical burns from grout runoff. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a walk-in cooler carrying a box of tomatoes when she tripped over a box on the floor and fractured her right ankle.

Three employees were cutting bolts off a man way using a grinder.  Sparks from the grinder caused a flash fire and the employees were burned. Two employees were hospitalized. The third employee was treated and released.
An employee was using pipe wrenches to disassemble a 16-gun assembly. After pulling a wire line out of the hole, the employee lost consciousness due to heat stress.

An employee lost consciousness while standing on the second step of a front end loader, 3 feet off the ground. The employee fell, suffering a kidney laceration, a facial fracture, and several fractured ribs. The employee was wearing a hard hat.
On September 5, 2018, an employee was operating a machine to form a part when his right index finger was pinched between a quick clamp and the part, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking in the company driveway during a 15-minute break when the employee's left foot rolled and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a meat saw to cut down a bone. The saw cut his left middle finger, partially amputating the tip.
An employee was burned in an explosion that happened while a vacuum trailer was being power-washed.
An employee was descending a customer's steps when the bottom step broke, kicking up and hitting her; the employee fell and suffered three broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was overseeing as a wire was being run through a machine when the wire became jammed. As he tried to help unjam it, the wire caught his left hand and amputated his upper left thumb.
Am employee was using a grinding wheel to repair a mini-excavator when the grinding wheel became caught, kicked back, and struck his thigh, lacerating it in two places.

An employee was operating an automated linear saw and trying to reposition a board that was being fed into the saw when her finger became caught between the board and the guard of the machine, resulting in the amputation of her left index fingertip.

An employee lost the keys to her postal vehicle while delivering mail. She sat in the vehicle and called for assistance. When the assistance arrived, she was found unresponsive in the vehicle due to dehydration.
An employee was changing the water filter on an extruder. The lid, which was hanging from a hook, came loose and fell onto his hand. His right middle finger was amputated.

Before 6:00 p.m. on September 5, 2018, an employee tripped/slipped and fell on a dryer while carrying a chainsaw. The chainsaw cut the employee's lower left leg above the kneecap, causing a deep laceration.
An employee was climbing up a 6-foot ladder to install a carbonated beverage line above a restaurant ceiling. The ladder shifted and he fell to the floor, breaking his right leg just above the knee.
While cleaning up a work area and shutting down the job for the day, an employee suffered shortness of breath, possibly heat-related.

An employee was on a stand-up forklift, putting trash in a compactor. As he was discarding some netting it snagged the operator control, causing the forklift to move forward. His foot was caught between the forklift and the compactor, resulting in a fracture to the left foot.
An employee was walking through a hydraulic door when he slipped and his pinky finger was caught between the closing door and the door frame, resulting in a pinky amputation.
An employee suffered dermatitis on the upper right thigh while working with 1,6-hexanediol diacrylate.
An employee was entering the cab of his truck after fueling when he fell and hit his head on the tractor step or door well.  He was hospitalized for bleeding on the brain and required sutures.
An employee was using an embossing machine when it activated and contacted her right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

A temporary employee was removing a window from a building during demolition activities when the window broke and lacerated the employee's left wrist, severing a vein. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was removing a guard and frame from a machine during maintenance work when the guard dropped onto his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing a water pipe when he became overheated and later experienced leg cramps, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee tripped while walking and broke her kneecap on the floor, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was changing a belt on a machine when the belt lacerated the employee's right hand, causing tendon damage that required surgery. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking into her office when she tripped on a torn section of carpet and fell, suffering a sprain/dislocation to her left shoulder. She was hospitalized.
An employee was opening the rear doors on a semi trailer. A 227-pound skid of freight fell out of the trailer, striking the employee in the back of the head and neck.
On 09/05/2018, at 10 a.m., an employee was putting together crates when a piece of thin metal fell or came in contact with his left arm, lacerating it.

An employee was changing a roll of film on a bagging machine when the employee's left hand was caught between the machine's belt and guard, resulting in a partial amputation to the left index finger and a laceration to the left middle finger.
An employee was attaching a bar to a cart when the employee tripped over the bar and broke a leg.

An employee was offloading grain from a rail car to a truck. While crossing over a conveyor belt, the employee tripped and fell into the conveyor and was caught in the tube. He suffered "road rash"-type burns to his back, ribs, and arms and was hospitalized for burn treatment.

An employee was moving a lift into another room and had closed the room door when a sheet metal damper installed in the wall above the door fell from the ceiling and hit the employee's back, fracturing the C5 vertebra and compressing other vertebrae.

At 10:30 a.m. on September 5, 2018, an employee unlocked a shipping container that was mounted on a train, then lost his balance and reached out to grab the container. It shifted, and his right hand was caught between two containers. Three of his fingertips were crushed/amputated.
Two employees were trimming trees and bushes in a mobile home park when they both had heart attacks due to possible oleander bush poisoning. They were both hospitalized.

On 9/5/2018, an employee was walking to move a customer's vehicle to the installation area when another employee backed a vehicle up and struck the injured employee. He fell and hit his head, suffering a subdural hematoma that required hospitalization.
An employee was setting up equipment at an electrical substation when the employee became ill and passed out due to heat exposure, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking when her foot became caught on the floor. She then lurched forward and fell, fracturing her right elbow and left knee.

An employee was moving products from one pallet to another when the employee's shoe lace was caught on the corner of a pallet, causing the employee to trip and fall to the floor. The employee fractured the right femur.
An employee fell and broke his leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee's left index finger was caught in a pipe crimp cutter as he used it to cut a piece of tape. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered a left palm laceration and broken fifth metacarpal while removing the retaining ring from a remote anti-armor munition (RAAM) mine.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when the employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a shattered heel and other injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking torque on automobiles when she fell off a work platform. She fell about 18 inches, breaking her left leg and left elbow. She was hospitalized, possibly needing surgery.
An employee was threading paper through a roller. As he tried to remove a piece of paper, the roll caught his hand and pulled it into the machine. His right ring finger was amputated.

An employee was driving a clamp lift truck and following another clamp lift to the dock. The lifts were travelling in reverse so the employees had a clear view to the front. The front lift stopped suddenly, and the employee's lift ran into the clamp on the front lift. The employee was struck by the clamp, lacerating his leg from the ankle to above the knee.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder, taking apart a light fixture in a ceiling grid. A live wire shocked him and he fell to the floor. He suffered burns and lacerations to his left hand.

After cleaning a conveyor belt, an employee noticed something in the belt and was attempting to pull it out when her hand was caught in the sprocket. The skin was removed from the top of her hand. The belt was re-energized at the time of the incident.
An employee became weak while delivering mail due to dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
While walking at a work site, an employee fell and broke her hip.
An employee was operating a concrete mixer when the employee's hand entered the running mixer and contacted the blade, breaking the hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood when a miter saw amputated the tips of his left index and second fingers.

An employee was working from a 12-foot ladder, pulling parts off a shelf. Two boxes were stuck together; when they gave way, the employee lost his balance and fell to the ground. He suffered contusions to his head, left elbow and left shoulder.

An employee was using a table saw and a push jig to cut a wooden piece when the piece came out of the push jig. As he reached to remove the piece, two of his fingers contacted the blade and were cut. The saw was unguarded at the time.
A temporary employee was using a shovel to finish the edges of a clay tennis court. The employee became ill due to heat stress and was hospitalized.
An employee was behind a forklift when the forklift reversed and ran over his foot.
An employee was using an air compressor to add air to the compressor on a bus when the bus rolled, pinning him between it and a work truck.
An employee was leaving a yard truck when the door slammed on his foot, breaking it in two places.
A robber shot a retail sales employee in the left side of the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee missed a step while descending a mobile A-frame ladder and fell to the ground, fracturing a wrist.
A temporary employee was operating a forklift. The employee's hand was caught and crushed between the lift and an I-beam. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was holding several of an oil drilling rig's electrical cables while the rig was being transferred from one well to another. The cables were damaged, and the employee was shocked.

At 9:00 a.m., an employee began a shift loading crates full of cans into pressure cookers. At about 11:30, he began to feel cramping. By the end of his shift, at about 6:30, his cramping had worsened. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was cleaning a rotating mold using a pole with a brush attached to the end. The brush got caught on the mold, and the employee was pulled over a barrier wall and slammed to the ground. The employee suffered a lacerated liver and a cracked sternum.
An employee was hit by a tree limb, suffering a partially collapsed lung that required hospitalization.
A tow tractor struck an employee, pinning her against another tow tractor. She suffered an injury to her lower left leg and was hospitalized.

On September 6, 2018, an employee was drying the conveyor belt from the underside of a machine when his hand made contact with the machine's roller and was pulled into the conveyor, breaking his arm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

A temporary employee was on an elevator under a high-speed sheeter, helping clear a jam between two belts. The elevator activated, pinning the employee between itself and the machine walking platform. The employee suffered a partial collapsed lung and an abrasion injury.
An employee doing maintenance on a roof fell 7 feet, suffering internal injuries.
An employee was installing bolts to hold the metal parts of a framework when a metal part slipped and trapped his right pinky fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's left middle finger was caught and crushed between the press leg and a metal ring on a tire.

An employee was on a 12-foot ladder changing a light fixture. He lost his balance and fell to the tile floor, suffering a head laceration and fractures to his right elbow, his left wrist, three ribs, an eye socket, and his skull. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a push mower to mow a sloped portion of grass when he slipped and his left foot slid under the mower. The rotating plastic blades then lacerated his foot, and he was hospitalized.
As a banded load of concrete forms was lowered onto a flatbed trailer using a forklift, it crushed a trailer truck operator's finger. The tip was amputated.
An employer was caught in a conveyor, suffering an amputation 4 inches below his right elbow. The conveyor was guarded with a gate at the time of the incident.
An employee was struck by a load of shoring equipment being moved by an excavator when the boom swung, breaking an ankle and heel. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a keeper pin with another employee when the keeper pin released more easily than expected and the pin removal tool slipped into the opening of the frame.  The employee's fingertip was caught between the head of the pin removal tool and the turn table, amputating a portion of the fingernail.
An employee was standing in a breezeway near a roll-off paint booth taking photos of sub-assemblies when a forklift struck the right side of his body. He suffered a lacerated kidney and contusions.
An employee was cranking down the landing gear of his trailer. The gear handle struck him in the face, breaking a bone on the right side.
An employee was welding when his shirt sleeve contacted a hot weld and ignited. He suffered a second degree burn to his forearm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was supervising mechanics who were attempting to replace a gauge roller s drive motor. The mechanics had begun to lift the replacement drive motor and frame assembly with a motorized material handling device when the motor and frame assembly began to move off of the forks and tipped over, making contact with the injured employee's right foot. He then fell and his leg impacted the floor, fracturing his right ankle and tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee's left arm was caught between the roller and belt in a cotton gin conveyor system. The arm was broken; the employee was hospitalized for surgery. The system was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was working on a utility line when an electrical flash occurred. The employee suffered second degree burns to the face and neck.
An employee of Liberty Technology was setting a pattern on a trolley using a hoist. His fingertip was caught between the form and the carriage and amputated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a carrier when the employee tripped and fell on the aircraft door. The employee's right middle finger was then caught in the carrier handle, breaking and lacerating it.

An employee was operating a powered lift. The employee raised the control arm upright and the emergency brake engaged. The employee lost balance and extended the left leg, which was caught between the back of the vehicle and a barrier. The employee sustained a left lower leg laceration and fracture.
A file cabinet toppled under the weight of wet sheets of paper that had been placed on it to dry, breaking an employee's right femur.
An employee was driving a buggy down a hill when he hit a curve and fell off the buggy onto a concrete sidewalk, hitting his head and suffering a concussion.

An employee was putting his pallet jack into a trailer when the jockey began pulling the trailer, causing the employee to fall from the dock and strike the dock plate before landing on the ground and fracturing three ribs.

A forklift operator had walked away from a forklift when an employee noticed the forks were covered with gravel. The employee was removing the gravel by hand when the forklift operator returned and began operating the forklift, unaware that the employee was below.  The forks then crushed the employee's right index finger, resulting in a medical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was attempting to separate product as it was exiting a wrapping machine when her left hand was caught in the machine, crushing and fracturing her middle finger. She was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee slipped on wet asphalt and fell, landing on and breaking her left knee. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a small cardboard box in the aisle next to her work table. She fell to the floor, landing on and breaking her left hip.
An employee operating a stock picker backed up and was struck by material requiring stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the floor and moving a mobile cart when the cart rolled into a drain in the floor and rolled over, falling on and fracturing the employee's lower leg.
A patient closed a door on an employee's hand, causing amputations to her left ring and little fingers.
An employee was servicing a soft roll packaging machine when the machine started. His left index fingertip was then caught and amputated in the machine's chain.

On September 7, 2018, at about 6:15 a.m., an employee was using a forklift to empty a trash hopper when the hopper shifted. The employee's middle finger was then caught between the hopper and the forks of the forklift, resulting in a medical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor of a facility, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee had set down an electrical breaker box inside a motor control center he was preparing to replace the breaker in. He turned to walk away and an electrical arc flashed out of the open door of the cabinet, burning his palms and wrist and causing a slight burn to his right cheek.

An employee was pulling a piece of drill stem when the drill stem dropped. The employee's finger was caught between the drill stem and a metal grate, resulting in an amputation of the distal left ring finger.
An employee was installing an anchor on a roof when the employee slipped and fell off the roof and onto the ground below, breaking a shoulder and hip.
An employee's finger was caught in a conveyor's belt and pulley, and the tip was amputated. The guard was not in place at the time of the incident.
The top of an employee's gang box fell on his finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was installing a transformer when an arc flash occurred, causing second degree electrical burns to the employee's right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was manually moving a belt on an HVAC unit when three of the employee's fingers were pinched and amputated between the belt and pulley.

An employee was delivering sodium hypochlorite (bleach) to a customer by tanker truck. The customer directed the employee to the incorrect unloading station, and the sodium hypochlorite was unloaded into a hydrofluorosilicic acid tank. The chemicals were incompatible and produced chlorine gas, which the employee inhaled.
An employee was driving a 4x4 all-terrain vehicle when it hit a tree stump and rolled down a steep hill. The employee suffered a neck injury and an abrasion to the left shin and was hospitalized.
On September 7, 2018, an employee fell from a 6-foot step ladder while cutting wiring in a test unit, suffering a fractured skull, broken ribs, and a back injury that required hospitalization.
Two employees were transferring a patient from a bed into a chair when one suffered a back and shoulder injury.
An employee was using a ratchet puller to remove a clutch plate off a press while standing on a 10-foot portable ladder when he fell to the ground below, fracturing his left heel and right ankle.
The injured employee intervened in an argument between a coworker and a former employee. The former employee stabbed the injured employee three times with a knife.
An employee's feet became entangled in loose metal banding and she fell to the floor, suffering a right arm fracture that required surgery.

An employee was offloading bags from an aircraft when a bag became lodged at the top of the belt loader. The employee stood on a step and tried to dislodge the bag with one hand while holding a rail with the other hand. As the bag became dislodged, there was some spring action that caused the employee to lose footing and fall from the step to the concrete below. The employee fractured the left elbow.

The injured employee was helping a welder while a nearby trackhoe operator had a 4' pipe joint hooked up to the trackhoe with a strap. The operator leaned forward to adjust his side mirror and as he sat back down, his shirt was caught on the joystick, which caused the machine to move the 4' pipe forward. It struck the 6' main line pipe, which in turn fell off the cones and landed on the injured employee's legs. Both legs were broken and she was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a walkway when a motorized wheelbarrow struck his foot, resulting in a cracked ankle and puncture wound that required hospitalization.

An employee was changing a conveyor chain inside a robot cell. He pushed the transmission case forward to take the chain off the sprocket. The transmission case activated a photo sensor, which pushed the next case up the line. The employee's right index finger was then pinched in the chain, resulting in a finger amputation. The conveyor was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was leaving the sleep berth of a truck when she fell, breaking her left knee.
An employee was walking through a dish area when he slipped and fell to the floor, breaking his hip.
An employee fell from an order picker in the warehouse and suffered head trauma.

Two employees were taking meat and placing it in yellow trays at the tail end of a production line. The two employees began to disagree about the pace, and one employee punched the injured employee in the face. The injured employee suffered a broken mandible.
An employee was assaulted leaving the store after his shift. He was hospitalized with multiple lacerations and a possible concussion.
An employee had been filling steel kegs and moving the kegs using material handling equipment when the employee began to feel unwell, requiring hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee was servicing a paper machine when he attempted to align a pin and contacted a limit switch, causing the machine to cycle and crush his hand.

An employee was rolling a steel beam with an overhead crane and a plate clamp. The clamp slipped and the beam fell, crushing the employee's left middle fingertip. The tip was surgically removed at the first knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell down a flight of stairs that were wet with water, suffering a broken left ankle and fractured kneecap.
An employee was using a chop saw when a piece of wood fell to the floor. As the employee was picking it up, the saw activated, amputating the employee's right middle finger and ring fingertip.

An employee was operating a shear machine when his left middle finger made contact with the hold-down, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

During the breaking of a connection, an employee was holding a "mud bucket" against a pipe to minimize the splashing of mud on an oil rig floor. As the two pieces of pipe were moved apart, a spray of mud caused the employee to fall and hit his head on a piece of equipment behind him. He suffered a scalp laceration and a skull fracture.
An employee was removing a part from an assembly press when the press cycled and crushed her right arm, breaking bones and causing lacerations.

An employee was standing near a bundle that a forklift operator was unloading when the bundle's wood bracing hit the dock plate. The wood bracing then broke and struck the employee, causing a deep head laceration.
An employee was leaving the server aisle when her apron became caught on a trash door. Her hip caught the door and she fell, fracturing her hip.

An employee was using a forklift to move a pallet of coffee when the employee dismounted the forklift to retrieve an item that fell. The pallet of coffee then struck the employee, who suffered a broken hip.
Two employees were involved in horseplay when one employee tripped the other employee who fell to the floor breaking a knee cap.

An employee was vacuuming fly ash on the top section of a boiler when he stepped into an unusually deep section of fly ash, sinking into it up to his knees. The fly ash, which was still hot, went under his pants and into his shoes, causing second degree burns to both legs from the knees down.

An employee was cleaning up waste plastic under a manufacturing line. A sprocket pinch point caught the employee's left ring finger, causing an amputation of the fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning inside a tank with a pressure washer. The stream from the washer cut through the employee's right boot and into the employee's foot.
An employee was exposed to mold and moisture while working and began to experience coughing and tightness in the chest, requiring hospitalization for pneumonia and exacerbation of asthma.

An employee was attempting to straighten out the material on a stamping press when a sensor was tripped, causing the automatic clamping/straightening action of the press to activate. The movement caused an amputation of a finger on the employee's left hand.
An employee was cleaning a machine's overhead transfer belt when her hand was pulled between the rollers, breaking her right arm.

At about 12:10 a.m. on September 10, 2018, an employee was walking toward a vehicle when she tripped over the base of a temporary fence set up around a medical services tent. She fell to the pavement, breaking her left arm and shoulder.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while walking through a turnstile door, hitting and injuring his head.

An employee was training a new employee on a belt sander when the actuator was engaged, which caused the machine to move. The employee's finger was then caught between the sander's holder and fixture, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting wood with a chop saw. The saw caught the employee's left index finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was using a high-pressure hose to find an underground utility line. The wand fell on his left foot, cutting it with water pressure.
While searching for a lost hiker, an employee was bitten by a copperhead snake. The employee was hospitalized to receive antivenom.
An employee was walking in a log yard when a loader drove near him and struck his foot with the left front tire. He suffered a left foot laceration.

On September 10, 2018, a tree trimmer was removing a limb from a utility line after a storm. When the tension was released, the limb hit the employee in the face, breaking the skull near the eye socket.
An employee was on a hydraulic tank attached to the back of a truck. He slipped on hydraulic residue and fell from the tank, suffering a punctured spleen, bruised rib, and collapsed lung.

An employee was running a concrete pump truck when the boom struck either the employee or handrail, causing the employee and handrail to fall 29 feet. The employee was hospitalized with a head laceration, five broken ribs, a broken ankle, and a fractured fibula.

While an employee was using a manual post driver, his left middle finger was trapped between the driver and a post. The fingertip was crushed; he was hospitalized, and the tip was medically amputated.
An employee was removing a hose from a mud pump with a crescent wrench when the wrench slipped off the nut and his hands were mashed between the wrench and pump.
An employee was cashing out a customer when she stepped back and tripped on a floor mat, falling to the floor and fracturing her right hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was using a tool to check the correct diameter of sheet metal in a roller machine when his gloved right hand was caught by the roller and pulled into the machine, crushing four fingers. As a result, the four fingers were amputated.
An employee was welding laps on a commercial roof. The employee slipped and fell about 13 feet, suffering a broken humerus, broken rib, broken spinal wing, and pelvic fractures.
An employee was stepping out of his mail delivery truck when he was struck by a moving vehicle, fracturing his left ribs and left arm.

An employee had disconnected a transfer hose from a splitter line and was turning to connect the hose to a tote. Her foot was hooked by a second hose, still connected to the splitter line, and she suffered a broken femur.

An employee was standing on a lift gate and engaged the gate's controls. As the lift approached the bed of a box truck, the employee's right wrist was caught between the control box and the lift. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right wrist and had surgery.
An employee was operating a shaper machine when his finger came in contact with the 1/4" round over bit, resulting in a left index finger amputation.
An employee was ripping lumber using a circular saw. The saw kicked back, striking the employee's left thumb and cutting off the tip just below the nail.
A temporary employee was lifting a door forming tool when the 150-pound tool dropped on his right index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an HVAC system that was making a squeaking noise at the belt. The employee applied pressure to the belt, which then made contact with the pulley system and pulled the employee's left hand into the system. As a result, the employee suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken arm.
An employee was checking for a bad bearing on a press when the employee's right middle finger went into the rollers, resulting in an amputation. The roller was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was standing on a two-step stepladder pulling on a tire during a front end alignment. The ladder moved out from under him and he fell to the floor, fracturing his hip and wrist.
An employee was using a circular hand saw to trim the edge of a pallet when the saw jumped back and cut the employee across the left hand, amputating three of his fingers.
An employee was cutting 4-inch shelving. While he was retrieving a piece of wood, the spinning blade amputated his left thumb to the first knuckle.

On September 10, 2018, a truck driver was helping unload steel rolls from a flatbed truck. When the chain supporting the rolls was removed, a roll came loose from the stack and fell onto the employee's leg. The employee suffered a fractured wrist and an above-knee amputation of the left leg.
An employee was underneath a tractor supported by two jacks to repair a flat tire when the tractor slid off one of the jacks. The tractor frame struck and cracked the employee's pelvis.
An employee was removing tie straps from freight in a trailer when he turned around and a securement stand slipped off the trailer, striking and fracturing two discs in his back.
An employee was lifting a panel of fencing when it slipped and the employee's ring finger landed between the fence panel and the truck bed, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was dumping a hopper when the hopper slid and amputated one of his fingertips.

An employee was securing the air seal on a motor mount when another employee, who was attempting to lower a fan assembly, loosened the come-along on the load and the fan assembly shifted, pinning the injured employee into the motor mount. The employee's head was crushed, breaking several bones in his face.

An employee was carrying a car bumper down an enclosed stairway. As he approached the floor level, he missed a step and fell to the floor, breaking his right ankle and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing out a work roll in a tilt plant at a finish mill. His left foot was caught and broken in a pinch point.
An employee was walking across the street when he was struck by a pedestrian driving a vehicle, injuring his hip.

An employee was on top of a baker style scaffold that was approximately 5 to 6 feet high attempting to move it when the employee became unstable and fell to the concrete ground below, suffering neck fractures.

On September 11, 2018, an employee was attempting to clear a jam from the rollers of a long coiler machine when the employee's finger was caught in the roller, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger area.
An employee twisted a knee while walking. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a possible torn ACL/MCL.
An employee was descending from a steel column when he became stuck on a protruding steel plate, suffering a laceration.
An employee fell from a third floor while conducting roofing work, fracturing a leg.
An employee was carrying hot tar for a roofing installation when the tar burned him.

An employee was crossing the street while a crew was paving a section of road.  He was within the work zone when he was struck by another passing car that was in the wrong temporary lane of traffic. He flew over the car and landed on the ground behind it. He was hospitalized with a broken ankle, two fractured/chipped vertebrae, minor cuts to his head, loss of skin from the back of one hand, and a small brain bleed.
An employee tripped on a mat and fell to the floor, suffering fractures in the left pelvis area and the left arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing out an air bag on a trailer when the bag came free and pinched the employee's left index finger between the bag and a bracket on the trailer, resulting in a fingertip amputation to approximately the base of the nailbed.

A FedEx employee backed a delivery truck into a driveway. Upon exiting the vehicle, she walked to the rear doors to retrieve a package. As she turned to walk around a car that was behind her, the car proceeded to unexpectedly back up, striking the truck first, then pinching and crushing her legs between the bumpers of the truck and car. She suffered multiple fractures to her right leg below the knee.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift truck when he struck a guardrail, lacerating his right leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking across a production floor when she tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a dislocated shoulder, a knee injury, and a laceration to the face.
An employee was raking leaves in the front yard of a building when a rattlesnake bit his lower left leg above his work boot, causing nerve injuries.
An employee was climbing a ladder when he fell, suffering a broken wrist and a cut on the forehead.
An employee was stepping out of her mail truck in a parking lot. She slipped in a water puddle and broke her right ankle.
An employee was placing a steel plate onto the back of a flatbed truck when the employee slipped off the bed of the truck and fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, fracturing the left femur.

An employee was operating a boom in a bucket truck. One outrigger of the truck was placed on the pavement and the other outrigger of the truck was on soft ground. The outrigger that was on soft ground sunk into the ground and caused the truck to roll and the weight to shift on the truck. The employee and bucket then fell to the ground. The employee suffered L1 and L2 vertebrae fractures and a right cheek laceration. Fall protection was worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was pushing an air conditioner on an assembly line when he bumped a valve with his right shoulder. The valve then opened and sprayed refrigerant onto his right back area, causing chemical burns.
On September 11, 2018, while caring for a patient, an employee suffered a strain/sprain to the back.
An employee was clearing debris from a shear area when the shear was activated via the foot pedal. The shear then caused an amputation to the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was pushing a camera cart when his right little finger was caught between the cart and the wall. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down a wet sidewalk in a parking lot. The employee broke both bones of the left arm below the elbow.
An employee was on a ladder performing work when the ladder collapsed. The employee fell approximately 8 feet, landing on his right foot and fracturing his right ankle.

An employee was stripping epoxy spray finish from tile floors when he experienced difficulty breathing and vomited. He was hospitalized for chemical exposure. PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee placed a ladder against a telephone pole, climbed up, and tied off to the pole with a climbing belt/rig when the pole broke at ground level and fell, pulling the employee down with it. The employee suffered a broken nose.
An employee was walking when she lost her balance and fell, fracturing her kneecap and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was exercising a horse when it was startled and threw her off. Her head struck the ground; she was knocked unconscious, suffering a concussion and minor internal head trauma and bleeding. She was wearing a protective helmet and safety vest at the time of the incident.
An employee had thrown a ratchet strap into a truck when the strap bounced back and struck him. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a stool.
An employee was conducting a maintenance repair on a rotor shaft when the chain grabbed his gloves, pulling his fingers between the chain and sprocket and fracturing them.
An employee was using a band saw to cut pork chops when the saw blade cut the employee's left thumb, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was attempting to adjust stacked carriers that had been bumped by a forklift when his left middle finger was pinched between two carriers, resulting in a fingertip amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was standing on top of a molding platform and reaching for a guard arm when the employee fell 7' 8" from the platform to the floor, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee's leg was pinned between a stanchion and a forklift jack.
Two employees were untangling lines along a furnace line when one of them, suffering from heat dehydration, became dazed and fell. The employee head struck the concrete floor, causing a head wound.
An employee was riding in the back of a company work truck when a pipe roller made contact with his hand, causing multiple fractures.

An employee was changing a die on a press. He had removed the bottom half of the die and loosened the clamp on the top die, and was sliding the top half of the die to the right of the press when the top half fell about 6 inches onto his right hand. His middle and ring fingers were broken.
An employee was installing an aluminum soffit from an aluminum ladder when he made contact with an electrical line, causing him to fall from the ladder and receive electrical skin burns.

An employee opened the front door to a commercial dryer to add some garments. The dryer did not turn off when the door was opened. Garments in the dryer caught her arm, twisting it and tearing tendons in her hand.
An employee picked up a portable bandsaw. It activated and its blade touched his right hand, amputating the little finger up to the first knuckle.
A maintenance employee was aligning a belling head when the machine amputated the tip of his index finger.
An employee was found laying on the ground unresponsive after shearing bushes, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was servicing an oil well. The employee's left hand was caught between a rod rotator and a bridle, and the little finger was amputated.

While in training, an employee lost control of her powered industrial vehicle. As she was attempting to gain control of the vehicle, her left arm went outside the vehicle's cab and became pinned between the vehicle and inventory racking. Her left arm broke.
An employee was moving steel with an overhead crane when the crane hook slipped off the chain and the steel fell on the employee, cracking the employee's right femur.
An employee was crossing a car wash conveyor when the rollers (which pushed the cars) caught her left foot. She suffered lacerations and broken bones, and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a screwdriver when it slipped from the employee's hand and struck the employee's left eye. Safety glasses were not worn at the time of the incident.

A flagger was trying to instruct a passenger vehicle to stop when the vehicle's side mirror struck her. She fell to the ground and the truck ran her over, breaking her leg and hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a stand-up lift while walking, suffering a left-foot degloving.

An employee was using a hand truck to deliver a 160-pound beer keg to a basement. The keg fell off the hand truck, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall down the steps to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to treat a severe break to the foot/ankle.
While standing on a bumper checking water levels on a truck, an employee slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right wrist.

An employee was helping a client load a metal door into a dumpster. His hand was on the edge of the dumpster and, as they were lifting the door into the dumpster, his right little finger was caught between the door and the dumpster. As a result, he suffered a partial amputation of his right little fingertip.
An employee fell while walking, landing on the floor and hitting their right elbow. The employee suffered a dislocated elbow and broken arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a rolling ladder to stock shelves. When he stepped onto the rail, the ladder shifted, causing him to slip and fall to the ground. He suffered a concussion and required stitches to his head. The ladder was not locked into place at the time of the incident.
An employee was taking speed shoring out of a truck when it opened, pinching off the employee's little finger.
An employee was exiting the back of a trailer when he fell to the ground and broke his leg in several places.
While building a platform to cover an elevator shaft, an employee slipped and fell 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was loading a press machine when another employee suddenly started the machine. The injured employee's left hand was then caught between the press machine, fracturing fingers.

An employee was climbing the stairs on a coker unit to reach a crane cab. A drum of coke was cut open, releasing steam and hot gases; the employee suffered first-degree facial burns and second-degree burns to the left wrist.
On September 12, 2018, two employees were operating the press brake. One of the employee's left hand was caught in the point of operation and crushed by the press.
An employee was exiting a front-end loader cab using the ladder and grab rail when the employee fell backwards to the ground, suffering a possible skull fracture.

An employee was reaching for an item on a shelf in a storage room when she turned and tripped over the wheel of a portable dialysis machine. She fell to the floor and landed on her left kneecap, breaking it and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped and fell off a roof while performing maintenance work, suffering a fractured femur.
A forklift went out of control, breaking through a chained roll-up door opening, skidding out, and tipping over in a loading dock. Its operator's right ankle was broken against the floor.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while walking down a hallway, suffering a right hip fracture.
An employee was checking a noise on a rapid packer machine when the machine cycled. Its die caused a crushing injury to the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was driving a powered pallet jack when the employee was caught between the jack and a cantilever rack, fracturing the left leg.

An employee was delivering shingles to a customer on the roof of a house. The employee fell from the roof edge, landing on the ground 12 feet below and suffering injuries to the nose and cervical vertebrae.

Employees were using a machine to remove a phone pole on the street. After the pole was pulled from the ground, an employee's left middle finger was crushed between the pole and the concrete. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was slicing a zucchini on a floor mixer with a slicer attachment when the zucchini became lodged in the slicer. The employee was attempting to dislodge it when the top portion of the employee's left ring finger was caught in the slicer, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was performing abrasive blasting when a pipe made contact with his blasting hood and slid down his chest and waist area, knocking him to the ground. He suffered fractures on his spine and pelvic area.

An employee was removing yard debris from a residential customer's home. He stepped up onto his truck to remove a pitchfork, lost his balance, and fell to the ground, fracturing his right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting metal with a radial arm saw when the material kicked back, causing the back of the employee's hand to touch the sawblade. The employee suffered a laceration.
An employee was lifting the locking mechanism of a trailer when it snapped down and severed his fingertip.
A stand-up lift struck an employee, causing a degloving to his left foot.
A nurse was administering medication to a resident when she tripped on a light cord and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

Two employees were installing a jumper between two power lines from an aerial lift when an arc flash occurred. The first employee suffered a second degree burn on his left thigh, and the second employee received a first degree burn to his left arm. They were both hospitalized.

An employee was repairing an air handler pulley when his right hand was caught in the belt on the pulley, causing a partial amputation to his right index fingertip and deep lacerations to his middle finger.
Two employees were cutting with a saw when carbon monoxide built up. They suffered carbon monoxide poisoning and were hospitalized.

An employee was helping another employee move a generator when he stepped onto a skylight that had been coated over. He fell about 13 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured rib and internal bleeding.

On September 13, 2018, an employee was climbing through an air vent to access a locked garage when the employee fell from the air vent to the ground, breaking the right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending aircraft stairs, tripped on the second to last stair and fell striking their back on the last stair near the ground. The employee sustained three inflamed discs.
A temporary employee was removing a garage door coil spring from recycling equipment. The spring retracted, lacerating the employee's left hand and breaking two of his fingers.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, breaking her wrist and knee. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee sustained a broken right ankle while stepping off an electric pallet jack.

An employee was securing a trunnion to a gantry crane with bolts. A bolt slipped while he was tightening it, and his fingers were crushed between the wheel assembly and the blade of a forklift. The tip of his left index finger was amputated.
An employee was walking down the hallway when she tripped and fell on the floor, suffering a hematoma on the forehead and subdural bleeding.

An employee was using a hand truck to move a sofa down a staircase when the employee's finger was caught between the hand rail and hand truck component, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was directing an excavator in the installation of water piping. The employee's left middle finger was caught and fractured between the excavator's quick disconnect and a piece of lumber. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee tripped while walking down a hallway, falling to the floor and suffering face, nose, and right arm injuries.
While building a shipping crate, an employee tripped on a nail gun's air hose. The nail gun shot a nail into the employee's left ankle.

An employee was standing in front of a tractor trailer that had been brought into a customer dock area to unload product. The truck began rolling, pinning the employee against another truck in the dock area. The employee suffered head trauma, sternum damage, and broken ribs, and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while walking down a corridor, suffering a compound fracture of the left arm.

An employee was climbing down a 10-foot jobsite wooden ladder from floor 8 to floor 6 1/2. The employee slipped and fell 10-12 feet, striking against the brick wall with his head and body and landing on his right leg. His right femur was broken.
A maintenance employee was replacing a ball valve on a pump in a wastewater treatment system when she knelt in a puddle of 20% sodium hydroxide and sustained caustic burns on her right knee.
An employee was checking a cooling fan when it cut his right thumb and broke the bone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was acting as a fire watch during operations to weld off steel beams when a steel beam came loose and fell onto his left hand, resulting in partial amputations to four fingers (up to first knuckle) and lacerations to the wrist, face, and ear.

On September 13, 2018, an employee was attempting to move a stuck battery from a heat seal machine when the employee's left index finger was caught between the lid and body of the battery, causing an amputation.

The injured employee was stripping concrete forms from jersey barriers in the crane staging area. An overhead crane (crane 1) had the form lifted up just enough to take the weight off it so the concrete could cure. Another employee was operating a mobile crane (crane 2) to move concrete forms into place in the staging area. Crane 2 bumped into crane 1 moving crane 1 slightly out of place. This caused the concrete form to fall over and knock the jersey barrier over onto the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized for fractured vertebrae in the back and a lacerated kidney.
An employee sustained a broken hip after tripping on shrink wrap and falling to the same level.
On September 13, 2018, an employee was framing a home when a wall that was being moved by a telehandler lift fell over and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee fell off a bakers scaffold.
A maintenance employee was repairing a chicken grill. As he was lifting the steel top of the grill, it fell on his left hand and severed his index fingertip.

An employee was attempting to remove a wire from inside a fence line machine when the machine cycled, trapping the employee's lower right leg. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right tibia and fibula.

On September 13, 2018, at approximately 11:00 p.m., an employee operating a CNS computer identified a blocked photo eye and used water to clean the photo eye.  The employee then saw wood in the machine and was attempting to remove it when the employee contacted the spline remover, resulting in an amputation of the right hand.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to pick cases of beer on a warehouse floor. His jack came into contact with another one as he was stepping off it, and his left foot was pinched between the two pallet jacks, suffering bruising and swelling. He was wearing safety shoes.
An employee was taking a stainless steel cutting machine down from a shelf when the machine fell and struck her head, causing blunt force trauma.

A lease employee was on an A-frame ladder, testing wires for live electrical service. When he made the tap, he was shocked. He fell about 4 feet onto concrete, breaking his left hip, left scapula, and right shoulder.

A temporary employee was working from a metal ladder, troubleshooting a lighting problem. The employee was shocked and thrown from the ladder, suffering injuries including (but not limited to) a broken hip and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was tightening a bolt to begin the starting process for a coiling machine. The tool being used to tighten the bolt slipped off; the employee fell to the floor, suffering a head laceration.
After working in the heat for the past 2.5 days, an employee experienced excessive sweating and occasional vomiting and nausea. He was hospitalized for dehydration and a muscle injury.

While installing a metal roof, an employee fell 5-6 feet to a lower working surface. The employee suffered a broken vertebra and was hospitalized. Fall protection was not in use at the time of the incident.

An employee was feeding material into the in-feed trough of a saw. While the material was being automatically fed by the in-feed device, his right hand came into contact with the activated blade, resulting in the amputation and partial amputation of his right index, middle, and ring fingers. The saw blade was guarded at the time.

On September 13, 2018, an employee was attempting to clear a jam in an automated rubber cutter when the cutter lacerated his right index finger. The rubber cutter was guarded and running at the time of the incident.

An employee was climbing into the passenger side of a truck cab when the truck moved forward and ran over the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the right upper leg.
An employee was climbing up and over a concrete wall and broke his fibula when he jumped down from the wall to the ground.

An employee was cleaning a filter basket with a 40,000 PSI pressure washer when the water gun rotated towards the employee and the pressurized water blast lacerated his right arm. The employee was hospitalized and the arm was amputated.

An employee was delivering feed to a site when he picked up a gallon jug of an odorless cleaning chemical (sodium hypochlorite) and drank it. He suffered internal burns from the corrosive chemical requiring hospitalization.
At about 1:30 p.m. on September 14, 2018, an employee descending a stairway while sweeping the stairs. The employee fell to the ground at the last step, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee slipped, suffering a broken leg.
On September 14, 2018, an employee was repairing a combine feeder house from a stepstool when the employee fell approximately 24 inches onto the concrete floor and broke the right hip.
Two employees were working around an extrusion machine when it overheated and sprayed molten aluminum on them. They were hospitalized with burns.
An employee fell while sweeping in a freezer, suffering fractures.
A pallet jack and an order picker collided. The pallet jack operator's right lower leg was injured.
An employee was going up an aisleway while operating his pallet jack when his foot was crushed between his pallet jack and a stationary pallet jack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had put his foot on a man lift when another employee turned on the man lift and the first employee fell on his face, suffering head and back injuries.

On September 14, 2018, an employee was changing out a plate on a grinder. The old plate became free, and his finger was caught between it and the new plate. He suffered a fingertip laceration that required medical amputation. The grinder was locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was inspecting bumpers on a paint line when his foot became stuck in a 4-inch gap on the floor, causing him to trip and fall. As he tried to catch himself, his hand/arm struck the metal frame of equipment and were fractured, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a tortilla machine when the employee's right hand was caught in the gears/chain, causing a muscle injury that required surgery.
An employee was working in a residential attic when he fell through the ceiling. He landed on the residence's floor, injuring his left ankle.

An employee was loading wood onto a conveyor that carried the wood away from the employee when a piece of wood became jammed. The employee hit the reverse button and the piece of wood started to come back toward the employee. The employee reached down and grabbed the nearest end of the piece of wood. The conveyor pushed the piece of wood against a metal guard and the employee's thumb tip was caught between the wood and metal guard, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was cleaning debris out of a machine's door jamb when the door closed on his left middle finger. The tip was amputated.

An employee was un-banding a coil on the forks of a forklift. When the banding was cut, the coil fell forward and the employee was caught between the mast of the forklift and the coil. The employee was hospitalized with a broken clavicle, scapula, and finger, as well as broken ribs.
While making rounds during unit startup, an employee suffered respiratory irritation, possibly due to chlorine inhalation.
At 8:20 p.m. on September 14, 2018, an employee was descending a ladder when he fell into a small cart, suffering an injury. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee had been performing helper duties on a blast furnace, including cleaning/loading the mud gun, installing the slag dam, and cleaning the sides of the trough, when he was overcome by heat approximately 6.5 hours into his shift. He suffered heat-related illness, cramping in his arms, and loss of consciousness.
An employee was adjusting the blade tension on a band saw when the blade amputated the employee's fingertip. The band saw was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was compacting dirt using a plate compactor when a rubber-track mini-excavator ran over his left foot, breaking two bones.
An employee tripped and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his left forearm.

An employee was preparing to cut the tap to a telecommunications cable. The mid-span line his ladder was leaning on was cut, and he fell 20 feet from his extension ladder to the surface below. His left shoulder blade was shattered.
An employee walked and slipped on the ground level of a terminal, fracturing his right arm.

An employee was walking on the top of the back of his semi trailer (flatbed) where he just finished securing a load when he tripped on the top surface of the flatbed trailer and fell to the concrete slab he was parked on (fall distance height of 3.5'). He fractured his right scapula, right clavicle, and one to four right-side ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was guiding boxes through a transition point between two conveyors when the employee's left hand entered a gap between the conveyor belt and the frame, fracturing the left index finger.

An employee was attempting to cut off some strings from a set of rollers when the belt being rotated by the rollers caught his scissors and amputated his right middle and ring fingertips. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on an overhead conveyor. While he was removing a belt from a pulley, his gloved hand slipped between rollers and was pinched causing an avulsion injury requiring hospitalization.
The rollers of a mangle caught an employee's right arm, causing a crushing injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee experienced heat-related illness and cramping while working outdoors, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were using ATVs to help transport a 236-foot length of pipe. One ATV struck the other, causing it to roll over; its driver suffered broken legs, a broken pelvis, and a hand laceration. The driver was hospitalized. One of the driver's legs was amputated.

An employee was replacing a roof panel on a storage building when a panel gave out and the employee fell approximately 9 feet onto a concrete block, fracturing bones in the face. The employee was hospitalized.

After loading and unloading parts off an inspection conveyor system, an employee switched to inspecting parts in a black light room. He began to feel unwell and lost consciousness, falling backwards and striking his head on the concrete floor. He sustained severe head trauma and was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

On September 14, 2018, an employee was checking oil levels in units. While manually rotating a unit's door, the employee's left ring finger was caught between the door and a water coupler, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working on a gift wrapper machine when she collapsed and struck her head on an adjacent conveyor. She got up and then fell again, striking her head on a pallet and then the concrete floor. She was hospitalized.
An employee was placing plywood down on flooring at ground level when he tripped over a gap between two pieces of plywood, causing him to fall and fracture his right arm.

An employee was recording patient information at a hospital while a crew was performing cleaning operations nearby with a bleach-based cleaner. The cleaner triggered an asthmatic reaction in the employee, who required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the pan under a separator water reuse screen. His left hand touched the screen drum gear, and it amputated the tips of his index and middle fingers.
An employee was working on a machine when it caught his glove. His right thumb was deeply lacerated.
An employee was operating a core bag machine when he attempted to straighten a bag and his left ring finger became tangled in the bag material, causing an amputation to the left ring finger.

An employee was walking between an aisle that was lined with ropes when the employee stepped over the ropes. The employee's foot became caught on the ropes and the employee fell to the concrete floor, fracturing both arms.
On September 15, 2018, an employee removed a pipeline cap on a CIP line and was burned by hot water and chemicals. The employee suffered burns to the face, back, arms, and legs.

At about 5:00 p.m. on September 15, 2018, an employee was driving a utility vehicle at a natural gas pipeline site when it flipped over. The employee suffered a potential stomach tear and was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking freight and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was using a ratcheting air tool to remove bolts from a tower when the employee's left third finger was caught in the tool, resulting in an amputation of the distal phalanx.
An employee was operating a meat cutting machine when the blade sliced off the top portion of his right thumb just behind the fingernail.
While re-roofing a home, an employee fell off the one-story roof to the ground. The employee suffered a broken forearm.
An employee was vacuuming and washing a confined space hole when he suffered from carbon monoxide overexposure, requiring hospitalization.
