An employee was working on a hydraulic dock leveler at a loading dock door. The lift fell and struck him on the head/neck, breaking his C5 vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee was burned when diesel fuel was thrown into the firebox of a kiln and a fire started. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling part of a tie rod section using a power-assisted tool. His fingertip was pinched when the tool moved, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was carrying dishes from the line to the dish station when the employee tripped over a container of oil and fell. Some glass from the dishes lacerated the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was manually resetting a nut feeder when his right index finger was pinched by the weld gun and nut guide, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was unhooking a tractor trailer in a parking lot. The employee fell and was impaled by a piece of rebar. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping close the dividers separating ballrooms in a country club. Her hand was caught between two moving panels, which amputated her middle finger midway up the fingernail and crushed her ring finger up to the beginning of the nail.

An employee was on a blowout preventer (stationed on a pressure control trailer), using a wrench to align the tool trap. The wrench slipped and the employee lost his balance, falling about 7.5 feet and injuring his wrist, hip, and shoulder.
While getting an 8-pound container of cider out of a box, an employee felt a pop in the back and became unable to walk.
An employee was driving a straddle when the equipment tipped over.

An employee was picking up a spare tooth from under the wheel of a ditching machine when the machine operator lowered the crumming shoe, striking the employee. The employee suffered bruised lungs and a bruised abdomen, as well as two broken ribs.
An employee was adjusting a pipe with a cheater bar when the pipe struck him and he fell on his side, breaking his hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was obtaining shift change information in a patient's room when the employee suffered respiratory issues as a result of a deodorizer that was sprayed in the room, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's finger was caught in an opening at the bottom of a sorting bowl when the bowl engaged. The finger was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was helping to place a paper roll on a machine when the cable for the pulley came loose. While he was helping get the cable in the right place, the machine started up and pinned his left middle fingertip between the pulley and cable, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was positioning molds onto a car using a remote control crane when the two molds that were on the crane moved and pinned his leg between the two molds on the crane and the two stationary molds. His right femur broke.
At approximately 1:15 PM, was accommodating an empty bucket  to sit on it when a snake bit his left hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down a stairwell when she tripped and fell down 10 steps. She suffered a subdermal hematoma.
An iron worker was injured when a clamp fell approximately thirty-five feet and struck the employee in the head.

On September 17, 2018, an employee was testing a steel hammer handle in the gripper of an all-steel handle rougher when the employee's hand was caught between the steel hammer handle and a 50-grit belt, avulsing the employee's posterior right hand.

An employee was descending from the driver-side platform of a lift truck when he slipped and fell approximately 3 feet from the platform onto the ground. He suffered a partial lung collapse, three fractured ribs on the right side of the ribcage, and a displaced sternum.
An employee was cutting bands around a pipe bundle. When the last band was cut, the pipes shifted and one struck his right shin, causing three fractures to his right tibia.
An employee was using a pneumatic staple gun when the employee's knee bumped the staple gun, causing it to fire a 2-inch staple into the employee's right knee.

A spreader chain was holding a tailgate open. The employee pulled the chain out while the employee's finger was between a box and the gate. The tailgate then smashed and severed the employee's right ring fingernail and index finger at the distal joint.
An employee's right ankle turned and broke while he was walking between two houses. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing at a table when a cart of metal plates came by and some plates fell off, causing him to stumble backwards, trip over a pallet, and hit his head on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with head trauma and a concussion.

An employee was working at a store cash register when an individual robbed the location at gunpoint and demanded money from the employee. When the robber began to flee the store, the employee chased after the robber and was shot in the arm.
An employee pulled a muscle while lifting a table, suffering a hernia to the lower torso area that required hospitalization.
An employee was placing a chain around a steel coil to pick it up with a crane when the steel coil slipped and rolled out onto the employee's right foot, breaking it.

An employee was operating a bag-making machine. One of the bags had lodged at the point between the machine and the offloading chute. While the employee was trying to clear it, the machine cycled and the press plate closed, pinching and injuring her fingertip. The nail and a small part of the fingertip were torn off. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was on the third rung of an A-frame ladder applying caulking to a wall when the employee slipped and fell off the ladder, fracturing both ankles.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a wood wedge when the saw struck a knot in the wood and kicked back, partially amputating the employee's thumb tip.
An employee was changing the tools on an auger driller. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the kelly bar and the slide box. The finger was amputated.
An employee was walking down an aisleway. A forklift struck her while backing up, breaking her left wrist.

An employee was coming down the stairwell and using the handrail when another employee started up the stairwell. As the first employee was crossing over to the other side of the stairwell, she slipped and fell, landing on her wrist and backside. She suffered a collapsed vertebra in the thoracic region and a fractured left radius.
An employee became faint after receiving an immunization and fell down stairs, breaking her kneecap.

An employee was using a power saw to rip 2x4 lumber. The lumber kicked back, striking the employee's hand. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated; the little finger and ring finger were lacerated, with tendon involvement.
An employee was casing mail when the employee became lightheaded due to possible dehydration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee performing carpentry work fell from an 8 foot stepladder to the ground below and sustained a broken right wrist, bruised chest, and bruised face, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using an electric miter saw to cut aluminum extrusion frame parts for a bulletin board cabinet. He began to pull a remnant piece of the extrusion from the saw to place in a recycling barrel. The end of the extrusion inside the saw was grabbed by the spinning saw blade and pulled into the machine. The blade lacerated his right index finger, which was medically amputated between the first and second joints.
A maintenance employee was attempting to clear out a rotary valve on a dust collection system when the valve struck his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was placing a wooden spacer between slit steel coils (weighing approximately 600 pounds) to transport them by crane when a coil shifted and fell on the employee's legs, crushing them.

An employee was performing a pre-cording operation, which is part of the manufacturing of snowmobile tracks. While pulling a cord tight, the machine caught and amputated the tip of his left little finger.
An employee slipped on an anti-fatigue mat and struck his head on a cabinet, lacerating his ear and fracturing his neck. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to unjam lead ribbons in a mill machine when his right index finger became pinched between two pieces of lead, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress and dehydration after working indoors for a couple of hours.

An employee was hooking up a chipper to a truck. The chipper was resting on a jack stand; the truck hit the chipper as it backed up and knocked it to the ground. As it fell from the stand, its neck/tongue hit an employee's lower leg, causing a spiral fracture.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut a 10-inch steel pipe that was suspended in the air using a telehandler. A piece of cut pipe fell to the ground and toppled over, striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left leg and right ankle.
An employee fell while moving household items into a moving truck and hit his head.
An employee was holding a bearing and shaft while using a hammer when the hammer hit his left middle finger, causing an avulsion that resulted in a surgical amputation at the first joint.
An employee was removing a metal ring from a concrete mold when the employee's finger was pinched between the metal ring and the concrete mold, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift to pull a load of wood pulp from a three-high stow in a warehouse. He grabbed a load from the stack with the clamp and was backing out when the load pulled an adjacent bundle, causing it to become unstable. The adjacent bundle fell against the forklift mast, causing the forklift to tip over. The employee suffered a left forearm laceration and a crushed left leg above the ankle, which required amputation.

An employee was working on a propane cylinder, switching out a valve that was placed in a cement vice on the floor. He attempted to use a breaker bar to remove the bar when the strap slipped and he fell onto the concrete floor, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was climbing a ladder up a scaffold that he was erecting. He was carrying a section of the scaffold in his hand when the section became caught on the scaffold, causing him to lose his balance and fall approximately 8 feet. He suffered a cerebral injury, bruising, internal bleeding, loss of feeling in his legs, and paralysis.
An employee was standing on pallets, about 3 feet off the floor, scanning boxes with an electronic scanner. He fell to the floor, breaking his left wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stacking parts using a jib crane when his finger became stuck under a metal sheet he was lifting, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was slicing ham on a band saw when the ham became caught on the blade. The ham lifted and rotated sideways, causing the employee's hand to slip and contact the blade. The employee suffered a laceration/partial amputation to the left index finger and a small laceration to the left ring finger.
Employees were pulling a fiber optic cable with a rope attached to an ATV when the rope snapped and struck an employee on the left arm.
An employee was cleaning press rollers with a rag when his rag was caught between both rollers, pulling his fingers into the nip point between the rollers. The skin was torn from his fingers.

An employee used an air powered grease gun to grease a skid steer following track repairs. As he was rolling up the grease gun and hose, the trigger was pulled and grease injected into the palm of his left hand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating a planer when it amputated all five fingers of his left hand.

Employee was using a stand-up forklift to load a pallet onto the a truck. As his lift backed up, it struck the closed door of another truck. He suffered a fracture to the left pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift when its mast lowered, lacerating the employee's right arm.
An employee experienced an unpleasant situation and started to hyperventilate, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was in a truck-mounted aerial lift, trimming trees around a power line. The edge of the lift caught on something, then jerked free, throwing the employee out. The employee fell about 30 feet, landing on the ground and suffering a broken back and head trauma.

An employee was on a ladder next to a wooden wall when the wall bracing broke off, allowing the wall to fall and knock into the ladder. The wall fell on the employee's ankle, fracturing it and requiring surgery.

An employee was assembling truck wheels for tank cars. When he cut the banding straps from side frame parts, the side frames fell on and struck his leg below the knee, fracturing his shin. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered severe cramping after completing a mail route. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was on a 5-foot tall scaffold painting above pipes while holding onto another pipe when the pipe broke and the employee lost his footing, falling to the concrete floor. He hit his head and landed on his shoulder, suffering a scalp hematoma, fractured shoulder, and fractured vertebra. The scaffold was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was working in a boom lift to take measurements for a replacement panel when the weld between the boom lift mast and jib broke, causing the employee to fall 12 to 15 feet within the basket to the ground. The employee fractured six ribs.
An employee was preparing to connect a tow dolly when it pinned and crushed his left hand. He suffered a broken index finger and severe bruising.

An employee was ripping a 2/4 plank on a table saw. As he reached to grab the 2/4 plank, the saw blade lacerated his right index finger and thumb, requiring hospitalization. The saw blades were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from a scaffold to the ground while removing foundation pins, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was using an air wand to align a conveyor belt when the belt caught and pulled the air wand, sending the employee's hand into the equipment. The employee suffered a laceration to the left-hand little finger, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip. The conveyor was energized and running at the time of the incident.
A temporary employee was putting a cylinder on a pallet when his left hand was smashed between the pallet and cylinder, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered an amputation injury.

A maintenance employee was releasing pressure off a valve in the melt shop when a pipe failed and ruptured. The metal pipe, under pressure, struck the employee in the head and face, causing an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift when he turned into a cross aisle that went into a freezer and hit an upright rack. His left foot was pinned between the forklift and the rack, breaking three toes and requiring hospitalization.
An employee as working on a cover on a barge when the cover slipped and the employee fell about 20 feet to the bottom of the barge. The employee broke his left femur and was hospitalized.
A 488-pound metal tank flange dropped from an overhead crane connection and struck an employee's right hand, fracturing four fingers.

An employee was observing as a forklift operator removed a voltage regulator from the assembly line when the load became unbalanced and began falling from the forklift. The employee was struck by the falling product and fell to the concrete floor while moving away from it, straining his right shoulder and left knee.

Two employees were working in a designated paving area. The first employee was operating an asphalt paver while a second employee was walking to the left of the paver, examining the paving, when a publicly owned vehicle veered into the designated paving area and struck the two employees. The first employee suffered fractures to the left leg, while the second employee suffered multiple fractures to the body.

At about 11:40 p.m. on September 18, 2018, an employee was backing up a stand-up forklift in a warehouse. The forklift struck another, stationary forklift; a two-by-four board supporting the pallet on the stationary forklift struck and broke the employee's left ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to set a pylon when the nylon sling that was holding the vertical pipe lost some tension and slipped over the employee's left pinky finger, then cinched back onto the finger and crushed it. The employee's pinky finger had to be surgically amputated.

On 9/18/2018, an employee was descending a staircase from scaffolding on an aircraft wing when the employee slipped and fell. The employee's head struck the staircase, causing an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was installing trip savors on an electrical line (13,200 volts) from an aerial lift when he attempted to tighten a bolt on a switch bracket using a cordless drill. An arc flash then occurred, resulting in second degree burns to both of his hands. He was hospitalized. Rubber gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a pneumatic butterfly valve to mix flour and sugar when the flour stopped feeding from above. The employee was attempting to clear the flour when the pneumatic valve closed on the employee's right-hand fingers, resulting in a fingertip amputation and a right ring finger amputation.
An employee was descending from the 6th to the 5th floor when she fell down the stairs. She fractured her elbow and cut her head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee lost consciousness while preparing food and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee suffered an amputation to his right hand (middle finger) while using a band saw to cut meat.
An employee was changing socket blocks when he slipped on a box of rags and fell to the floor, breaking his right femur.
An employee became overheated, lost consciousness, and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee fell approximately 9 feet from a basement wall to the concrete floor while installing anchor bolts due to possible heat exhaustion, suffering a broken neck and spinal injuries.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the ground, suffering an injured hip.
An employee was setting up a core drill when the bit fell and amputated his fingertip.
While changing a fan on an overhead air conditioner, an employee suffered a 220-volt shock. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a horse while participating in teambuilding horseback riding. The employee's head struck the ground and the employee lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was turning quickly to catch a vender's attention when she fractured her ankle.
An employee started feeling hot after finishing his route as a service provider driver. He then experienced muscle cramps and vomiting, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.

A laminator crushed an employee's right hand and injured his left hand. He was hospitalized, and three of his right fingers were surgically removed. The laminator was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was struck by a brass tube at the mill, suffering injuries to the back of the head, the chin, and the chest.

An employee was leaning over to pick up an air hose when his left pinky finger was run over by a motorized cart that ran on precast form molds, resulting in a partial finger amputation. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was operating a combine to harvest soybeans when an access door became unlatched, exposing a rotating auger. As the employee attempted to re-latch the door, the rotating auger amputated the distal phalanx of the employee's third right finger.
While cleaning, an employee picked up a vacuum hose to move it. The employee's hand was sucked into the hose, suffering swelling and bruising.
An employee's right ring fingertip was caught in a shutting door. Almost half of the last joint was amputated.
An employee was making a connection for drill collars when a tong struck him, breaking ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was offloading pallets from an aircraft onto a dolly when his right index finger was caught between a pallet and the dolly lock, resulting in an amputation of his fingertip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out a belt on a blasting machine when his left ring fingertip was caught between the belt and pulley, causing an amputation.

An employee was operating a production line that packs batteries into blister packs when the conveyor belt became jammed. The employee suffered a left index finger amputation while attempting to clear the jam.
An employee was trying to remove a stuck board from a finger jointer's out-feed roller line. When the board dislodged, it kicked up and injured the employee's left pinky and ring fingers.
An employee missed a step on a two-step ladder in the dock area and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee began to feel ill on September 17, 2018; after leaving work on September 19 she was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle beside a track, towing a small trailer. A railcar mover struck the rear of the trailer, which jackknifed and struck the utility vehicle. The employee suffered fractures to the pelvic region and two ribs.
An employee was threading a pipe on a CNC lathe. The machine activated while he was holding a piece of sand paper between the chuck and the pipe. His right middle finger was amputated.

An employee was lining up a slip sheet by hand on a pallet when a forklift operator he was working with activated the slip sheet push and pull attachment, which grabbed the employee's fingers, resulting in an amputation of the first joint of the left index finger.
An employee suffered a heart attack after arguing with another employee.
An employee was using a lathe to machine a steel bar. The bar struck him, breaking his elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a bread machine when the blade cycled, causing an amputation to his right index fingertip. The machine was not guarded.

An employee was taking cryogen readings from MRI equipment when he tripped over a cabling trough that was part of a new MRI staging set-up and impacted the floor. He suffered fractures to his left-side shoulder and hip.
An employee was framing a new building. The employee fell from the building's roof to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a concussion, and possibly other injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was looking for signs of mold inside an air handling unit. The unit was locked out, but outside air caused the fan to rotate. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated between the belt and pulley.

An employee was installing telephone and broadcast service. He was on a cement slab that was covering a water well at ground level. He fell off the cement slab when it collapsed, suffering leg injuries.

An employee was standing in the back of an open box truck when a stack of 96-gallon garbage cans fell over, causing the employee to be pushed from the truck to the ground. The employee fractured his lower right leg.

An employee was standing on a piece of plastic that was on top of a piece of metal while a second employee was drilling up through the metal. The drill bit then punctured the first employee's right foot.
While performing metal decking, an employee slipped and fell 14 feet to the ground, suffering a broken back.
Two employees suffered carbon monoxide poisoning from a generator.

An employee was unloading dirt from the dump truck and noticed that the back door was not opened all the way. As the employee manually attempted to open it, the door slammed back down onto their left ring finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was performing a clean-out of the boiler when fire from the boiler back-flashed and caused second and third degree burns to his body.

An employee was operating a compactor truck in a parking lot. The compactor tipped over; the employee was thrown out, then its rollover protection system struck his right leg, causing an amputation injury. A seat belt was not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was shocked while removing the steel cover from an underground electric pull box. The employee lost consciousness.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it hit a rack. His right foot was crushed between the pallet jack and the rack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking through a containment, verifying chemical levels, when a chemical splashed onto his left calf. He suffered chemical burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on an underground transformer when his arm made contact with the conductor and the side of the transformer housing. He sustained an electric shock and slight burns to his right finger and right elbow, requiring hospitalization.

An employee climbed onto a flatbed truck to rearrange pallets and create space for another pallet. The wooden pallet the employee was moving broke and the employee fell approximately 4.5 feet to the ground, hitting his head on a paved surface. He suffered head trauma and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up reach lift in a warehouse. As the employee stepped off the lift, it ran over their left leg crushing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a utility task vehicle, spraying weeds on a trail at a high school. The employee became light-headed, possibly from heat stress/exhaustion.

On September 20, 2018, an employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the employee's left middle finger was caught between the belt and plexiglass, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The belt was moving at the time of the incident.

An employee was lowering an electronically controlled bay door by leaning over and pushing the control button with his right hand. The bay door rolled over the tip of his left ring finger as it closed, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was troubleshooting a boom lift with an oil leak when the employee's left middle finger was injected with pressurized oil.

While operating a clip rail machine, an employee attempted to relocate 3 x 24 inch boards along the conveyor when the employee's left index finger was caught between two boards, resulting in an amputation of the finger at the nail end.

An employee was changing a filter on an air conditioning unit when his ladder slipped. The employee grabbed the side of the unit and their hand struck a piece of angle iron projecting from the unit as it slid down amputating his pinky finger.
An employee was fixing a tap on a sewer line. The trench collapsed, inuring the employee's shoulder, ribs, and back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing next to a zero turn lawn mower when the mower operator ran over his left foot, resulting in a partial amputation of the big toe.
While exiting a vehicle in a parking lot, an employee slipped in a pool of brake or power steering liquid. The employee's left ankle was broken.
An employee was rigging and helping an excavator operator connect a reinforced concrete pipe when the pipe twisted and struck the employee's right femur, causing a deep contusion.
An employee was going to get a drill when the employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, suffering a broken patella.
An employee was operating a roller/compactor when he went down an uneven slope and jumped out of the vehicle. He stepped into a rut in the side of the slope and fractured his lower right leg/ankle.

An employee was attempting to position a die on a punch press machine. When the employee turned the die to position, a portion of the die fell through the hole, trapping the employee's right little finger between the die and the bolster plate. The employee's fingertip had to be amputated.
An employee was sanding a portion of a work basket placed on a saw horse stand when the equipment fell onto the employee's left leg, breaking it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was wrapping fishing line onto a spinning hub when the employee's right index finger became caught in the line. The employee pulled the finger away, resulting in an amputation above the top of the nail.

On September 20, 2018, an employee was cutting scrap metal with a cutting torch when the employee cut into a metal cylinder that had hydraulic fluid inside it. The torch ignited the fluid, and the employee received burns above both calves and below the waist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee received a right middle fingertip amputation while adjusting the main drive on a machine. The machine was not locked out and the safety cover was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was verifying that ground beef transfer equipment had been cleaned. The equipment lacerated her lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was filling up a truck at a gas station when he tripped over the gas pump hose and fell to the ground, suffering a broken collarbone and dislocated shoulder.
An employee's left middle finger was caught in a door and partially amputated.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a conveyor belt when an electrical discharge occurred, causing burns to his right hand. The conveyor was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee responding to an electrical outage made contact with an energized, 5,000-volt electrical line, suffering an electrical shock that required hospitalization.
An employee was stepping up into a truck when he missed a step and fell to the ground, breaking his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working with window frames in an aluminum extrusion machine. The machine kicked a frame back and it lacerated and broke the employee's thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a stepladder removing a sling from a lifting lug that was welded onto a 300-pound weir wall when the lock nut came loose from the bolt, causing the weir wall to fall and knock the employee 4 to 5 feet off the stepladder to the ground. The employee suffered a lower right leg fracture.
An employee was repairing a steam condensate line. The employee removed a flange and steam condensate was released, causing first and second degree burns to the employee's upper body.
An employee was attacked by another employee over a work disagreement. He was thrown on the floor, hitting and injuring his head.

An employee was on a waste management collection route. The employee was reaching under a broken cylinder of a tipper area when the cylinder crushed the employee's forearm, resulting in soft tissue damage. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift when it ran over his foot. He was hospitalized.
While decontaminating equipment and boots, an employee potentially came in contact with chemicals. The employee suffered an infection to both feet and was hospitalized.

An employee fell backwards while exiting from a trailer. His right knee hit the tongue-side of a dolly below, before he fell to the ground. He fractured both kneecaps and suffered tendon injuries in both knees.
An employee was closing a freight truck door when he slipped and fell off the bumper and struck the ground, breaking his right femur.

An employee was operating rig equipment to drill and install soldier piles. The rig was traveling to the next pile location when it encountered a soft spot on the bench. The employee immediately stopped on command from the spotter. The left side track of the rig then started to sink, causing the rig to tip over on its side. The employee's left leg struck the tramming levers and computer inside the cab when the rig tipped over, suffering two fractures below the knee.
An employee was holding wood pieces to be cut by a bead cutter. The machine actuated and its sharp blade amputated the tip of her left middle finger.

An employee was operating a tumble blast machine and dumping the blasting media from the blast onto the conveyor belt. During the process, the employee's left hand came close to the lip of a pan that was contacting the conveyor belt. The glove on the employee's hand became caught between the lip of the pan and the conveyor belt. The rotation of the conveyor belt grabbed and pulled the glove between the pan and the conveyor belt, causing a deep laceration to the employee's left hand below the thumb.
An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder when he lost his grip and fell to the lower level of the building, 10 feet below. He suffered a fractured femur and a fractured back.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to move pallets when she became caught between the pallet and a racking system, crushing and fracturing her foot or ankle.

An employee was sitting in a chair when she dropped an item on the floor.  She reached for the item and the chair rolled forward, causing her to fall and land on her right hip. She suffered a hip fracture.

Two employees were driving on a lease road, hauling a pump. An antenna on the pump got caught on an overhead electrical wire, directing energy to the truck. One employee suffered an electrical burn, as well as a sprained ankle when he jumped out of the truck; the other suffered a shoulder injury when he jumped out of the truck and rolled on the ground.
An employee was plugging an electrical cord from a grill into a wall socket when a flash occurred. He was shocked and received a third degree burn to his left hand, requiring hospitalization.
An auger came loose and struck an employee, breaking the employee's left arm in 16 places.

An employee was helping to install routers under a table when the on switch was hit, causing the router to start and lacerate the employee from the wrist to the upper forearm. The router was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating her machine from the box packing area when a coworker asked where to place a tape gun and she pointed with her left arm to the location. At the same time, an air cylinder retracted and caught her left arm, causing an elbow dislocation, laceration, and fractured wrist.
While setting up temporary traffic control, an employee was struck by a distracted driver in a work zone, suffering facial, skull, rib, and clavicle fractures.
An employee was on a mobile ladder, trying to unjam a machine. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was cleaning a 10-inch line using a high-pressure hydro-blaster with a lance at the nozzle tip when the lance pushed back out of the pipe opening and the tip kicked, redirecting the pressurized water across the employee's left forearm and causing a water laceration.

An employee was descending from an electric pole when he stepped into 6-foot tall weeds and fell backward, impaling his left buttock on a metal fence T-post that was covered by the weeds. He was hospitalized.

On 9/20/2018, an employee was using a spatula to break up clumps of sugar in a commercial mixer when the mixing blades grabbed the spatula, pulling the employee's hand into the blades and resulting in an amputation of the left index fingertip. The mixer was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was removing a top screen of rollers off a chute when he dropped the rollers. His middle finger was then pinched between the falling rollers and more rollers that were below, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was turning on a 480-volt breaker to reenergize machines when an arc flash burned the employee's left arm and left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck driver was driving around a corner on a logging road. The trailer went over the bank, causing the cab to flip on its side. The employee suffered possible internal injuries.

An employee walked about 20 feet from her desk to open the front office foyer door. She tripped on the edge of a flat lobby floor mat and fell, fracturing her right shoulder and requiring hospitalization.
A pipe fell onto an employee breaking his femur.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting/inspecting a section of a roller conveyor line on a third-level catwalk that was not functioning correctly. He was sitting on the catwalk with his legs hanging over the edge when an automated transfer car system on the second level (directly below the third-level catwalk) traveled beneath the catwalk and pinned his legs between the upper portion of the transfer car and one of the support beams of the catwalk. He was hospitalized with two fractured bones in his lower right leg.

An employee and a contracted forklift operator were moving matting boards that had been stacked in two piles. The top matting board in the shorter pile was forward and off center, leaving a gap between that mat and the taller pile of mats behind it. The employee was standing in the gap. When the forklift extended forward the lifting apparatus became caught on the off-center matting board and pushed it forward. The employee's right ankle was pinched between this mat and the pile of mats behind it, resulting in a broken right tibia and fibula.
One employee hit another in the head with a measuring tape. The second employee was hospitalized.

An employee was fitting a skirt to the center core of an upper frame for an excavator when the pneumatic clamp was actuated, making contact with the employee's left thumb and resulting in a fracture and partial amputation of the thumb.
An employee had arrived at the facility and was walking into the building when he tripped on an air hose and fell on the concrete floor, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee had replaced a fire extinguisher on a wall and was turning when her foot caught on the base of an air dryer. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken right arm and facial injuries (including a possible broken nose).

An employee was removing crab legs from a steamer when he slipped and dropped the container that was holding the hot water and crab legs. He received second degree burns on his thighs, arms, and hands and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was cleaning equipment when an air valve actuated, closing a container lid on the employee's left forearm.

An employee was trying to flip over a D ring so it could be used to secure deck cargo on a vessel. A 20-foot bundle of rebar was being held up with a pry bar so the ring could be flipped. The rebar slipped off the pry bar and crushed the employee's right index finger. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
On 09/21/2018, an employee was on a step stool attempting to remove merchandise from a store shelf when she fell from the step stool and fractured her wrist, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning the rollers on a roll former machine when his glove was caught in a roller pulling his left hand into the machine and causing a crushing injury. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was unplugging a bin on a hog feed truck when the auger caught his left foot, causing crushing and laceration injuries.

An employee was trying to remove a board that was jammed in an elevator on a production machine. The board fell about 4-5 feet and struck the employee's right knee, causing lacerations and a dislocation.

An employee was on the second step of a step ladder, using a box wrench to tighten a bolt on a pipe flange. The wrench slipped off the bolt and the employee fell backward, striking his head on a toolbox and losing consciousness.
An employee experienced an allergic reaction to floor waxing vapors, suffering respiratory distress.
An employee was searching for a water line connection in a flooded basement. He stepped into a stormwater sump pit, breaking a rib. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a residential roof to a concrete floor 12-15 feet below. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a rebar bender when the rebar rose up and struck his torso, causing a bruise below the ribcage that required hospitalization.
An employee fell off a roof and fractured his skull, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working from a portable ladder when he fell straight down from the top of the ladder, hitting his head and breaking his ribs and clavicle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to descend a ladder when the employee fell from level 6 to the concrete floor on level 5, sustaining a compound fracture to the right leg below the knee.
An employee was leaning on a pile of sheet metal and amputated a finger between sheets of metal.
An employee was hospitalized due to smoke inhalation.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a plank that was stuck under a log at a log table when the log table was lowered down on his hand, resulting in a left ring finger amputation.
An employee slipped on a freshly mopped floor and fell fracturing her femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adding an extension to a rock drill when the rock drill rotated and fractured the employee's arm.
An employee was clearing a jam in the sludge machine when the machine cycled and partially amputated the employee's middle finger.

An employee was cutting a chamfer on the edge of the concrete curb with a cut-off saw. The curb broke and pinched the blade which caused the cut-off saw to kick back and cut the employee's shoulder/armpit area.
An employee was removing a piece of steel from the top of a mold. The employee's wrist was caught/pinched between the mold and the mold clamp.
While working on a bridge, an employee was catapulted off a surface and fell 20 feet off the bridge onto a dirt embankment, suffering broken vertebrae that required hospitalization.
An employee was servicing a mold in an injection molding machine. A 15-pound rack cylinder fell onto the employee's hand, causing an amputation to the right ring fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder about 15 feet high repairing cable and fell to the concrete below fracturing both wrists, the right hand, the right upper leg and the right hip.
An employee was bagging frozen leg quarters with a machine and was attempting to remove a jammed staple when the machine activated and the employee's thumb pad was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting insulation from a roll with a circular hand cutter. The cutter amputated his left index fingertip.
While transporting a piece of cut concrete curb that was to be removed, the curb fell off of the forks of the forklift and landed on the injured employee causing a leg fracture.

An employee was setting out cones in a work zone after the required signs had been set and was struck by a vehicle. The employee was hospitalized for multiple fractures of the right tibia and a single fracture of the right fibula and lacerations on the left elbow and above the left eye.
An employee tripped and fell while leaving a gas station store. The employee landed on the concrete ground and suffered a lung injury.

An employee was punching holes in steel plates and caught their hand between the punch and the steel plates causing an open displaced fracture to the middle and distal phalanx of the left index finger with injury to the distal nerve.
An employee slipped on water that had spilled onto the floor and fell. The employee sustained right hip and wrist fractures.
An employee was setting up rig equipment and pinched his right middle finger between the pipe rack and the laydown machine index arm resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee lost his footing while walking down the stairs and sustained a right ankle fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing on a stepladder, replacing coaxial cable on the outside of a home. The employee fell, landing on a cable reel and suffering broken ribs.

An employee was washing a vehicle with a power washer. The hose got caught and as he pulled on the hose, the pressurized water blast struck his right boot under the steel toe and caused a deep open wound on the right toe.
An employee was moving a printing machine when he experienced stomach pain. He was hospitalized for a hernia.
An employee was emptying a spinal vacuum tank. The employee's right middle finger was caught in a valve; the tip was amputated.
An employee fell from a ladder, suffering bleeding from the ear as a result of the fall.
An employee was pushing a mobile cart (non-construction) filled with IT gear through a doorway and caught his left pinky finger in the door as it was closing resulting in soft tissue amputation.
An employee was showing the owner the possible issue with the electrical panel when the panel arced. The employee suffered burns to the left side of the face and neck.
An employee was pushing a housekeeping cart around a corner, lost balance and fell striking her head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was operating narrow aisle equipment to place a wooden pallet with plastic-wrapped product in the lower level of an aisle. He was attempting to move the equipment forward when the reverse handle was engaged. The movement caused him to be pinned under the second level cross beams and the narrow aisle equipment, fracturing his right kneecap, bruising ribs, lacerating his spleen, and puncturing a lung.
An employee had just put a box on the top of a cabinet. As he descended, his ring caught on a shelving bolt and his left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was operating the meat cubing machine when their glove was caught in the roller blades resulting in surgical amputation of the hand.
An employee was taking inventory of pieces of round bar. The round bar was sitting on an incline and rolled off the storage timbers striking the employee's legs fracturing both tibias.
An employee was standing in a row of curbing and was caught by granite curbing. The employee was hospitalized for a lower leg fracture.
On September 24, 2018, an employee fell approximately 9 feet off a roof when he was taking a measurement of the gutter system. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured T6 vertebra.
An employee was operating a stand-up truck. The employee's hand was smashed between the truck and a storage rack.
An employee was washing a car when a pressure washer sprayed his hand, lacerating it.
An employee was assisting another employee unchoke a lint cleaner and amputated two left-hand fingers.
An employee was connecting a trailer to a pickup truck and pinched their left index finger between the trailer and the ball on the trailer hitch resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While working in an emergency department, an employee had an anaphylactic reaction to an unknown substance, suffering respiratory distress and swelling. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting a shear rack that was sitting on wheeled dollies. The rack shifted, causing the amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip in the pinch point between the rack and the dolly.

An electrical lineman working in an elevated bucket sustained an electrical burn under his ribs and atrial fibrillation when the rope he was using to dismantle an overhead electrical distribution system contacted an energized line.
An employee was removing the nozzle from the pellet barrel when hot plastic came out of the barrel and burned the employee's left arm.
An employee slipped and fell while walking in the kitchen. The employee sustained a fractured tailbone.
An employee was delivering a load of gravel in a dump truck. The truck tipped over and the employee struck his head, suffering a concussion. He was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a metallizer machine to insert a new roll of material to run for production when their right arm was caught inside the machine and lacerated.
An employee was inspecting baggage handling belts. The employee's hand was caught between the rollers on a belt, causing the degloving of two fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the air lock used for moving peanut flour in the conveying system. The paddles unexpectedly activated and partially amputated their right index and middle fingers.
An employee was handling a coral snake when she was bitten on the right hand. The employee suffered an allergic reaction and was hospitalized for administration of anti-venom.
An employee fell off a loading dock and fractured an ankle.

An employee was realigning a cardboard lid in a lidding machine. His sweatshirt was caught on the pulley driving the machine's infeed belts, and his arm was pulled in. He sustained bruises and scratches to his right arm and shoulder and fractured his knee while trying to free himself.
An employee was outside work, walking toward the emergency entrance in the rain. The employee slipped and fell, suffering a knee injury.
A long-term care resident shoved an employee, causing her to fall and hit her head on a desk. She lost consciousness and was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a malfunctioning disengagement clutch in a wood chipper. The tip of his right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle joint by the disengagement belt and pulley mechanism.

An employee was watching the hydrotesting of tubing to find a leak. A release of water from the tubing sent the employee back into the tubing board; the employee suffered broken ribs and injury to their spleen.
An employee was working on the packaging machine and suffered the partial amputation of the left index finger.
On September 24, 2018, an employee was using an electric sewer cleaning machine to unblock a drain. The coil spring got stuck and caught his left ring finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was trying to unclog a blowing machine when its rollers caught his right hand. He suffered injuries resulting in an amputation (of the right finger at the second knuckle) and hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell, and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking over a portable dock ramp when it tipped over. He fell and the ramp landed on him, breaking his hand, right foot/ankle, jaw, and ribs and lacerating his face.

An employee was on a 6- to 8-foot A-frame ladder, sawing an overhead pipe. The side of the pipe gave way and hit the ladder, knocking the employee to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was shearing metal and amputated the left ring and middle fingers at the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a forklift when the forks/mast began to raise and struck a structural steel beam in the ceiling. The collision with the beam abruptly stopped the forklift causing the employee to be ejected from the cab. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs.
An employee was using steam to unclog lines. The steam burned the employee.
An employee was assisting with maintenance on the oscillator that was on a rack. The oscillator rolled and fell off the rack onto the employee's left foot fracturing it.
An employee was observing work being performed by other employees and was struck by the air horn in use. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was setting up a mill to work on an auger. The auger fell from the jack, hitting the employee's left index finger and amputating it at the first joint.
An employee was troubleshooting a 277-volt light pole and suffered electrical burns to his hand.

The injured employee was standing on a trailer signaling a forklift operator who was loading pipe onto the trailer deck. The pipe rolled and the injured employee tried to stop the rolling pipe. The pipe knocked the employee off the trailer face first and then landed on the fallen employee. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis and collapsed lung.
An employee was climbing a 10-foot A-frame ladder and fell striking his head on the floor. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
At about 11:30 p.m. on September 24, 2018, a temporary employee was trying to clear a jam in a lid shoot machine and partially amputated the second finger on his right hand.

An employee was using an order picker to place products onto a warehouse rack/shelf. The employee stepped out of the operator's platform and was struck on the head and face by two falling boxes. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured sinus cavity.
While descending a ladder, an employee was struck on the neck by a battery pack and suffered a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking, tripped over the foot of the merchandise cart and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured and dislocated shoulder.
An employee was installing a gas pipe at a residential construction site. He was descending an A-frame ladder when he missed a step and fell. He was hospitalized for a broken foot and ankle.
On September 24, 2018, a dance professor slipped and fell to the floor while walking into her class, breaking her hip.
An employee was re-roofing a residential roof in the rain. He slipped and fell from the roof, landing on the concrete ground 19 feet below. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was installing a new drum of sealant into the road sealant machine and caught their left thumb between the compression piston and plunger assembly resulting in amputation of the distal end.

On September 25, 2018, an employee was chasing after a customer to return their change when the employee missed a step on the entrance stairway, lost balance, and fell, suffering an elbow fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning up in a picking area. A forklift/picker backed over the employee's left foot and toes, causing an amputation to a toe.
An employee was guiding the removal of an 8-foot piece of reinforced concrete pipe. The pipe cantilevered downward and struck the employee's left little finger, causing an amputation.

An employee was shoveling inedible scraps from the floor into a small tote to dispose of them when his hand reached up and into a meat grinder's moving auger, resulting in the amputation of his left middle, ring, and pinky fingers.
An employee was attempting to clear salt from an inductor. The system energized, causing a gate to close on the employee's hand. This resulted in an amputation of the right ring finger to the nail.

An employee was operating a plasma table with a movable control panel when he backed into a forklift and was caught between the table's controller and the forklift, suffering a contusion to the leg. He was hospitalized overnight for internal bleeding.
An employee was found unconscious after loading a wheelchair. The employee had suffered a head injury, fractured ribs, and a fractured back.

Two employees were trying to start up a plastics extruder after a maintenance shutdown. As they tried to resolve an overpressurization problem, molten plastic began spraying from the screen changer vents. Both employees suffered burns to the head, torso, and upper extremities. They were hospitalized.
While performing maintenance activities, an employee began to suffer from heat exhaustion, becoming nauseated and sweating heavily.
A temporary employee was funneling cat litter into small bags when a sack of the cat litter fell on him. He suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was working with a crew, pigging a pipe. Built-up pressure shot out a small piece of steel pipe, which struck and lacerated the employee's left leg, resulting in an amputation below the knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming brisket when the board and the knife slipped. The knife hit her thumb; a piece of skin and the knuckle cartilage were detached, exposing the bone.
An employee was adjusting a steel beam on two work horses. It fell off the horses, breaking the tip of his thumb and a bone in his foot.
An employee was verifying ingredients inside a tank when his hand was caught in a moving airlock on a conveyor system. Four of his fingers were amputated.
A temporary employee's right index and middle fingertips were amputated in a spray dryer.

An employee was clearing a bottle jam from a trimmer reamer when the machine cycled and the employee's hand was caught in the machinery, fracturing four fingers and severely lacerating his hand and fingers.
On September 25, 2018, an employee was walking across a parking lot when a motor vehicle struck her, causing a broken hip and broken ribs. She was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a pickup truck as it backed up, suffering head and neck injuries.

While trying to straighten straps across a double-stacked, plastic-wrapped unit of lumber on a flatbed trailer, an employee slipped and fell about 10 feet to the paved ground below. During the fall, the employee struck the edge of the trailer bed. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury with brain bleeding, a cracked T4 vertebra, a cut left ear and contusions. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell off a ladder while hanging banners at a community event, suffering a contusion on his pelvis and requiring stitches between his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was descending stairs, slipped and caught their right arm on a stair stanchion resulting in a fracture to the arm.
While pushing a trash cart in a hallway, the employee stepped onto the base of the trash bin and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was replacing a rotating belt on a baler when the belt pulled him in. His right arm was crushed, requiring surgical amputation.
An employee was attempting to unjam a machine when the roller/blade amputated his left index finger.

Employees were trying to connect a wellhead with a two-to-one swedge and a quick coupler. A valve was opened to route pressure through the swedge. The swedge's threads stripped and it struck an employee in the ankle, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped/tripped in a parking lot and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken and dislocated elbow.

Employees were using two 10-ton hydraulic rams in disassembling a sump pump. The rams slipped from position, hitting an employee's left thumb and causing a comminuted distal phalanx fracture. The thumb was subsequently amputated at the base of the nail.
An employee was inching a printing press. Two of the employee's fingers were caught in the press, suffering injuries; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing jammed lumber in an edger machine. A piece of lumber flew out of the machine, striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered injuries to his internal organs, broken ribs, and a broken wrist.
An employee fell to the concrete floor while climbing down a flatbed trailer, suffering broken ribs.

An employee was overseeing the changing out of product on the end of aisles after store closing. She was walking on the sales floor when she slipped and fell in the front speedway, falling to the ground and breaking her right elbow.

On September 25, 2018 an employee was checking fluids in the engine compartment of a vehicle when a gust of wind blew the vehicle hood off of the hood strut. The hood then closed on the employee's left hand, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.
A mechanic had just changed out a broken sprocket on a yard conveyor. The conveyor was powered up, and the sprocket broke his left little finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell over a wheelchair. Her right knee struck the floor, and she suffered a kneecap fracture that required surgery.
An employee was carrying a metal piece when the employee tripped and fell. The metal piece then cut off the employee's left thumb tip.

A garbage truck driver was servicing a recycling bin as part of his training. He was getting back on the truck, on the passenger side, when it began to move; he lost his footing and fell onto the road. The truck ran over his left leg, breaking it in several places. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered an electrical injury.
An employee was helping a co-worker hang a peg board in a cottage garage when he tripped over another peg board that was propped up against a lawn mower. He fell and broke his hip.
An employee was bleeding down the pressure from a well to a vacuum truck when the gas fumes ignited, causing the employee to receive second degree burns to his hands and face.
An employee was cutting a 6-foot pipe with a chop saw when the blade kicked back, hitting the employee in the face.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground, about two stories below. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and sacrum, as well as a compressed spine.
An employee was standing on a sitting stool when he lost his balance and fell, fracturing his left tibia.
An employee was hydroblasting a vertical line when the hose came out and the pressurized water blast lacerated the employee's right wrist and forearm.

An employee was transporting a chemical tote when it began to leak. He then slipped and fell to the ground that was covered with the chemical. The employee suffered chemical burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was in an aisle writing down information about a product order when a swing reach truck ran over his left foot/toes, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bending a piece of metal in a hydraulic press. The metal shifted, striking and lacerating/amputating the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was feeding foil into a packing machine when the jog button was hit and his fingers became struck between two rollers, resulting in fingertip amputations.

A 3-foot-diameter concrete pipe was being lifted by an excavator while a well point was removed. The load swung over and pinned an employee against a 42-inch iron pipe, causing hairline fractures to his left hip. He was hospitalized.
On September 27, 2018, an employee was injured while using the elevator, sustaining a concussion.
An employee tripped over a vacuum cleaner cord and broke her hip on the floor.
An employee slipped and fell on cobblestone in a service alley near loading docks.

An employee was operating a forklift to transport a pallet of shoddy pads when the boxes of shoddy pads fell off the pallet. The employee stopped the lift and was trying to exit from the right side when the employee tripped over the levers and pedal and started to fall. The employee grabbed a rack with the right hand to stop themselves from falling to the ground. However, the employee continued to fall while holding onto the rack. The force exerted on the employee's right arm caused a compound fracture.

An employee was attempting to help a forklift operator load a customer's vehicle with a pallet of purchased materials. The employee's hand went under the pallet as the forklift was setting it down behind the customer's vehicle, resulting in a right little fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading a flatbed trailer when the employee fell onto the blacktop ground, suffering possible broken ribs and a left shoulder dislocation. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 26, 2018 an employee had been performing housekeeping duties and working with cleaners and/or chemicals when she fainted and fell to the floor, suffering abrasions on her head and the bridge of her nose. She was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack. The jack went out of control while the employee was avoiding an object, and the employee jumped off. The jack then ran over the employee's right lower leg, causing a broken ankle.
An employee was driving around the warehouse order picking when the employee started experiencing lower back pain, requiring hospitalization for a lower back strain.
An employee was inside a trailer, hand-stacking cases of tuna onto a pallet. A stack of cases fell, pinning the employee between the cases and the pallet. The employee suffered a broken left femur.

On September 26, 2018, at approximately 10:30 AM, an employee was offloading two I-beams when his finger became trapped between two of the beams. As he pulled his hand away, his third left finger was partially amputated.
An employee dismounted a forklift to secure pipes in a row when a pipe rolled off a rack and hit his pelvic region, causing fractures to the right side of his pelvis.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down the stairs, suffering fractured vertebrae.
An employee was drilling a hole in a piece of wood when the drill bit grabbed his glove and caught his right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee sustained a fingertip amputation while using a band saw.
An employee fell 17 feet through a hole in a deck and was hospitalized for multiple fractures.

On September 26, 2018, an employee was pressure washing a truck conveyor when he tripped over the pressure washer hose and fell approximately 14 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized with a dislocated left shoulder and fractures to the right arm, L1 vertebra, and pelvis.
An employee fell approximately six feet during gaffing competency training and was hospitalized with a back injury.
On September 26, 2018, an employee became ill after being exposed to Legionella bacteria in the building's HVAC system, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was in the meat department, cutting pig feet using a bandsaw. One of the cases of pig feet rolled away from him and his hand was caught in the saw. The blade severely cut his finger, causing an amputation.

On September 26, 2018, an employee was helping unload a concrete panel off a forklift truck onto a pickup truck bed. The panel slipped and its weight came down on the employee's little finger, pinching off the tip.

An employee was removing a pallet jam from a block machine when the machine's chain and sprocket amputated his right middle fingertip. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was standing on the ground, waiting to clear the branches/limbs that fell from a tree being cut above, when a tree limb struck his hard hat. He suffered a laceration to the back of the head and an epidural hematoma, requiring hospitalization.

On September 26, 2018, an employee was using a hardware insertion machine to repair a bent metal panel. The employee was holding some scrap metal (being used to help flatten the panel) when the machine's downward-acting plunger engaged with the panel. The employee's right second finger was pinched, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was putting a urinal in a dumpster when it shattered, lacerating the employee's wrist and cutting an artery. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was driving a forklift when he ran into a building column and fell off of the forklift to the ground. He hit his head on the floor and suffered shoulder pain and cuts/scratches. A seat belt was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a car. As he walked away from it, he tripped on an air hose and fell to the floor, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was talking with a truck driver when the employee was struck and fell under the truck. The truck/trailer ran over the employee, who suffered broken bones and internal injuries.

An employee was standing on a wooden platform, lifted by a fork truck, while changing rack levels for a lumber company. The platform slid off the truck's forks and the employee fell about 8 feet to the ground, landing on his back. He suffered broken vertebrae and cracked ribs.
An employee slipped and fell after opening a switch gear. The employee came into contact with live electrical equipment and suffered burns to both hands.
An employee was on a garbage route. The employee's finger was caught between the door and the hopper of a truck; the employee suffered pinched/crushed fingers and contusions.

An employee was assembling a boom lift, inserting and sliding a section of boom into another boom section. The underside of her left middle finger was pinched the two sections, resulting in a partial amputation to the fingertip.
On September 27, 2018, an employee was shoveling corn kernels when his hand hit the side of a conveyor, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

At approximately 5:40p.m., an employee (positioned on the south end) was moving a laydown cart to the home position (approximately 20 feet long) with a co-worker (positioned on the north end). When the employee reached the end of the track (home position), the cart closed in on itself (accordion style cart) and pinched his right thumb between the cart frame and extension, resulting in an amputation of the right thumb tip and distal phalange.

An employee was standing on the passenger-side rear step of a recycling truck, moving house to house to pick up recycling material. The sweep blade in the truck's hopper activated and began to push a cardboard box out of the hopper. As the employee tried to keep the box from falling out of the back of the truck, his foot became lodged in the box; the sweep blade came down on the box and his left foot, causing a compound fracture of his ankle as well as a muscle injury.

At about 6:00 p.m. on September 27, 2018, an employee lost their balance and fell, hitting their face against the pavement. The employee suffered a cut below the left eye, head injuries, and bruising/swelling around the brain, and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a platform spraying a surfactant onto the bed of an asphalt truck. The truck pulled next to the platform, then veered right; the platform fell over and the employee broke his left leg.
An employee was walking with an electric pallet jack when he stopped quickly and the jack hit his foot, fracturing his lower leg or ankle.
An employee was stepping from a picker lift truck platform to a nearby platform when the employee fell 6 to 8 feet to the ground below, fracturing a leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was tying his shoe when he lost his balance and fell backwards, hitting and lacerating his head on the concrete floor.
An employee's fingertip was amputated as he operated a horizontal broaching machine.
An employee was struck by an I-beam that was being hosted by a crane. The employee's lower left leg was broken, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on water while cleaning the floor, injuring the left hip and requiring surgery.
An employee lost his balance and fell to the floor, injuring his right knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell 14 feet from an I-beam to the concrete floor below, suffering head trauma and broken ribs.
An employee was walking behind an excavator operating in reverse. The employee's leg/foot was run over and crushed by the excavator's steel track. The lower leg was amputated at the hospital.

An employee was conducting preventive maintenance with two other people. One person was responsible for turning the power switch for the motor of a rotating floor. While the motor was in operation, the employee's hand was near the pulley and his right middle finger was caught in the belt, resulting in an amputation at the top joint.
An employee was installing electrical boxes when a plumbing pipe broke loose and fell on his right knee, severing cartilage and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a heat attack while escorting a suspected shoplifter from the hospital gift shop.
On September 27, 2018, an employee was replacing a bolt on the clamps of a drill rig when a clamp closed. The employee's hand was crushed, causing broken bones and an amputation of the ring finger.
An employee fell from a bucket truck that was two stories high to the ground during tree trimming operations, suffering three broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a hand injury.
On September 27, 2018, an employee was adjusting a wrapper feed and caught their left index finger in a channel. The end of the finger was degloved resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell on slush while walking out of a freezer. The employee's right leg was broken.

An employee was positioning a swivel into a cradle when the employee's right hand slipped and was caught in a pinch point between the swivel and cradle, resulting in an amputation to the right ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was servicing a conveyor roller when his right arm was caught in the machine. He suffered a broken forearm.
A yarn cabling operator's finger made contact with moving yarn. This caused an amputation of the tip of his left index finger.

An employee was wearing a harness and tied off to an advertising sign that he was disassembling with an oxy/fuel torch when two fighter jets flew overhead and caused the cut members to vibrate and collapse.  The employee "rode" the collapsing structure down and hit his elbow on the steel, breaking a bone. The structure was approximately 17 feet in height and the employee fell approximately 6 feet.
An employee was removing rubber from a sliver cutter when the employee's hand hit the handle. The cutter blade then came down on the employee's left index finger, partially amputating the fingertip.

Employees were pumping concrete into a 6-foot wall. The pump was plugged, then surged, causing concrete to spray out of it in force and the hose to whip. One of the employees was struck by the hose and knocked off the wall to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee's arms were lacerated by falling metal sheets.
An employee was removing a pipe plug and attempting to clear debris from a rotary valve when the valve amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
While painting, an employee went to drink water out of a plastic bottle, but the bottle contained a chemical called xylene. The employee ingested the chemical and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a golf cart when it flipped it over. He broke his left arm and scraped his knee.
An employee was cutting tissue blocks on a microtome machine when the employee's right index finger became stuck in the blade, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a mixer when she contacted the moving mixer blade, amputating four fingers on her left hand and requiring hospitalization. The mixer was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to assemble a rocket cart. The top rack of the rocket cart was not secured and fell on her head, causing a contusion that required hospitalization.
An employee collapsed while leading a hiking group and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to paint a gas tank inside of a building and was removing a valve when the tank exploded. The employee received burns to the face, both arms, and the stomach.

An employee climbed into a man lift on the ground. He was about to ascend when a piece of hardened asphalt dislodged from the top of a silo, fell toward the ground, and struck his right hand. He suffered fractures and lacerations to the hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was backing up a walkie rider. The employee's right leg struck a static roller section, suffering a laceration; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a bridge deck when he walked across an unsecured deck mat and it slid, causing him and the mat to fall approximately 30 feet to the road surface below. He suffered arm, leg, pelvic, and skull fractures; liver bleeding; and a concussion.
An employee was pruning a plant when the pruning shear cut off part of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was moving furniture when a fingertip on her right hand was caught and amputated between two pieces of the furniture.
An employee picked up a dumpster from a job site location and was strapping 2 x 6 wood on a roll-off dumpster truck with a bungee cord when the cord snapped and hit the employee's right eye.
An employee got out of his car to go into the engine room when the car reversed over his leg.
On September 28, 2018, an employee was realigning a conveyor end shaft when the conveyor amputated the tip of her left index finger.
An employee tripped over an oxygen hose in a patient's room and fell, suffering a fractured hip. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee's forearm was injured by flying casing material in an explosion.

On September 28, 2018, at 8:00 a.m. two employees were working together to install an exhaust pipe on the rear engine compartment of airport-sized snow removal equipment. The injured employee was working from an attached catwalk on the snow removal equipment to install the exhaust pipe while the other employee was on the roof of the equipment to hold the top of the pipe and secure a bolt. While installing the exhaust pipe, the injured employee stepped back and fell approximately 59   inches landing on the concrete floor below. He was hospitalized for a severe concussion, broken vertebrae in the neck and a shoulder injury.
While kneeling in front of a meter cabinet, an employee came in contact with a 13-kilovolt wire within the cabinet. An arc flash severely burned the right side of the employee's body.

An employee was working with a mold machine when the mold's lock slipped out of place, causing the lid to open up too far and crush the employee's finger. The employee's left ring finger was amputated, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking to a jockey truck, suffering a broken right tibia and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's finger was caught between a delivery truck's lift gate and its frame. The finger was amputated.
While moving freight, an employee tripped and fell from a trailer to the ground about 5 feet below. The employee suffered a fractured right elbow.
An employee was unstrapping a pallet of steel product weighing 3,500 pounds when the steel product fell onto his legs, pinning him. He was hospitalized for a fractured femur and crushed ankle.
An employee was pulling a utility cart when his thumb was caught between the cart's handle and a ladder, resulting in a partial amputation.
A service employee was walking close to the edge of a dock when he stepped off the edge but did not fall off the dock. He fractured his right ankle in two places and required surgery.

An employee was steadying a glass panel in a crate with five other panels when the six panels (weighing approximately 900 pounds each) fell on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right fibula, torn ligaments in the right ankle, and cuts to the right hand and forearm.
An employee was cleaning out the inside of a bin indicator when his left hand contacted a rotary valve, resulting in the partial amputation of his index and middle fingers.

An employee was holding a ladder for a coworker, who was installing wiring. A wire fell out of a box at the top of the ladder, striking the employee between the brow and the eye and lacerating the employee's cornea.
An employee was packaging nuts using a bulk vacuum sealer. The sealer's press caught her middle fingertip, crushing it and causing the fingernail to be removed.
An employee suffered a foot injury and was hospitalized.
An employee experienced cramps and difficulty breathing after rigging up on location, requiring hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee was unloading a bundle of 4-inch pipe out of a cargo hole when the bundle of pipe shifted and rolled over the employee's left foot, resulting in toe amputations.
