Three employees were attempting to relocate a shoring tower when the tower fell over and struck them. One of the employees received neck injuries and required stitches to the index and ring fingers. A second employee fractured the lower left leg and was hospitalized. The third employee received a contusion to the right hand.
An employee was trying to move out of the way of merchandise that was falling off a pallet when he tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was lifting a cesspool cover when it fell on and fractured his toe.

An employee was framing a floor and attempted to push the floor assembly unit using a piece of wood at the end of a pusher. When the employee actuated the pusher, the employee's left hand was caught between the floor frame and the piece of lumber at the end of the pusher, resulting in an index fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a pad print press when his right middle finger was caught between two metal blocks of the press's conveyor belt. The finger was amputated above the knuckle.

An employee was on a ladder, changing a battery on a motion sensor above a door. The ladder legs slid out and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken right arm and a laceration above the right eye.
An employee was attempting to move a display in a cart when the cart and the employee fell onto the floor. The employee suffered a broken right femur.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor fracturing the right hip. The floor had been recently cleaned.
An employee was servicing a running ear corn picker machine when two fingers were amputated, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell while preparing fast food orders, injuring the left ankle.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while walking in the deli department, fracturing her right hip.

An employee was standing on a stack of sheeting 44 inches high, adjusting a shelving unit. The employee fell backwards, striking their neck on another stack of sheeting and suffering a neck injury. The employee was hospitalized.
Employees were replacing a control valve on a propane tank. A flash fire began in the tank, and an employee suffered second-degree burns to the face and hands.

An employee was operating a dock leveler at a loading dock. As the leveler rose, the employee's left hand was caught between the dock plate and the flap. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated (with no bone loss).

On October 1, 2018, at approximately 2:15 a.m., during removal of asbestos containing 1/4-inch transite panels, an employee walked along the nailing strips where the panels were secured by nails to the structure. As the employee walked from the top row of panels towards the ladder access point, a transite panel broke and the employee fell 20.6 feet to the concrete surface below the roof. The employee was admitted to the hospital and treated for fractures to three vertebra and the pelvis.
An employee was cleaning debris from the table top of an atomizer. The atomizer sucked in the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the arm.
An employee was removing a board from an edger when the board pinned him, causing two lumbar fractures.

An employee was operating an overhead crane, using it to move a 20-ton ladle. While the employee was unlatching the safety hook, the crane moved and the hook tightened on the employee's left hand, crushing it against the ladle trunnion/bar. The employee's ring fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle, and the tip of the middle finger was crushed to the first knuckle.

An employee was descending from a warehouse racking shelf to a 4-foot ladder. He fell past the ladder and landed about 7 feet below, on a trash can that had materials in it. He suffered two broken ribs and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a roll on a line. The machine activated while the employee's left hand was in the pinch point of the roll; his hand was broken.
An employee was using an abrasive blaster and as he set it down the high-pressure abrasive medium punctured the back of his left calf.

An employee was removing a defective pipe from a pressure washer. The reservoir cover bent, causing his left foot to slide into the hot water. He suffered second-degree burns to the ankle and shin and was hospitalized.
An employee was blowing down equipment with an air wand. The employee's hand was caught in a belt drive. The drive was guarded at the time of the incident.
While reaching into a crate of parts, an employee was bitten on the right hand by a spider. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stamping metal with a brake press. The guard fell off and hit the brake press brake, causing the press to catch and fracture the employee's thumb.
An employee was standing on the second-to-bottom rung of a step ladder, adjusting ladders on top of a van, when he fell backwards and his head struck the ground. He suffered a head laceration.
An employee was hammering the ends of metal angle bars to align them. The bundle of bars shifted and fell toward the employee, lacerating his left knee.
An employee was checking a grinder for product when a 40-pound block of meat fell. The employee's right little finger was caught between two metal plates, suffering a partial amputation.

An employee was adjusting food in a food chopper when the blade severely injured the third and fourth fingers on the employee's right hand. The middle finger was partially amputated, requiring surgery.

An employee was scraping mud off the inside of a negative paste mixer. The employee's right arm came into contact with vertical mixing blades within the machine, causing amputation of the hand and part of the arm.
An employee was moving wood at a logging site when a copperhead snake bit him, causing his right index finger to swell. He was hospitalized.

An employee stepped up into a truck to get his tool box, which weighed 40-50 pounds. While pulling on the box to get it out of the truck, he felt pain in his back and down his right leg, so severe that it caused him to fall back out of the truck onto the ground.
An employee was feeding a planer when his heel caught on the table leg. He fell to the ground, breaking his hip; he was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a dump truck on the side of the road when his finger was caught in the pulley and belt of a compressor. He suffered a partial amputation of the left ring finger at the tip, after the nail.
After working at a pellet mixing machine, an employee was found disoriented and bleeding from the head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee stepped on a piece of loose plywood and fell through the floor.
An employee suffered an amputation to the right index finger while placing K-cups on a machine.
An employee was unloading a truck when boxes of merchandise collapsed, striking him on the back.
A skid steer ran over an employee's foot, breaking her right shin.

An employee was using an overhead crane to flip a carbon steel metal plate, weighing 400 pounds, 2 inches thick, and 36 inches in diameter. The plate fell from the crane, breaking bones in the employee's right foot.
An employee was on a ladder when it kicked out, injuring the employee.
An employee got lightheaded and fell while walking, striking the ground and suffering minor brain bleeding.

An employee was loading a hutch into a moving truck, pulling it up a ramp as a coworker pushed it from the other side. The hutch knocked the employee off balance; the employee fell, crushing two fingers between the hutch and the ramp. The employee suffered multiple finger fractures requiring surgery.
An employee was pushing a gurney hamper, which turned and hit another hamper. The employee's little finger was broken.
An arborist was trimming a tree when his chainsaw cut his life line. He fell about 28 feet to the ground below, suffering a broken back and ribs.

An employee of The Phoenix Group was in a sample room at a steel plant, using a shear to cut down a steel specimen. The hold-down device contacted his ring finger, causing a partial amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee tripped and fell to the linoleum floor, suffering a broken hip.

On October 1, 2018, an employee was working on a line pasta forming machine. She was removing accumulated dough from the machine when a gear caught her cover coat sleeve. Her left hand was pulled into the gear, suffering an injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was working on a retract cylinder that was locked up. The cylinder released and came down on the employee's right middle finger, amputating it above the first knuckle.

An employee was dressing a weld on a metal drum when his glove was caught between two rotating wheels on a rotating metal drum machine. The employee's left index fingertip suffered an injury leading to amputation.
An employee climbed a ladder on the front of a trailer to try to lift part of the cover tarp out of the trailer. He fell into the trailer, suffering broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
While walking down steps, an employee fell down two steps to the floor and suffered a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming cable with a knife and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
A scaffold carpenter was climbing a ladder to build a deck of scaffolding. He fell about 16 feet to the ground, breaking his right arm. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
While planting sugar cane, a temporary employee began to feel dizzy and weak. He was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat exhaustion/dehydration.
While cleaning inside a residential complex, an employee bent down, felt ill, and struck his head on a concrete floor, suffering a head injury.
A temporary employee was walking with a 55-pound bag of seeds when he tripped and fell backwards. The bag landed on him, injuring his lower back.

An employee was climbing a ladder with a bundle of shingles when another bundle of shingles was dropped from the roof onto him. He was knocked to the ground, landing on his head and suffering a head injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee drank from a bottle that contained a diluted cleaning chemical (degreaser). The employee became ill and was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was riding a three-wheel cart down a ramp. While it was stopping, the vehicle flipped and threw the employee to the concrete ramp. His arm and leg were injured.
An employee was on a ladder, holding a bucket of hot asphalt. He lost his balance and fell to the ground; the asphalt splashed onto him, burning his face, arms and legs. He was hospitalized.

On October 2, 2018, an employee was doing quality control checks on shotcrete application, using a welding rod as a probe to measure the thickness of the shotcrete. Shotcrete material separated from the face of the excavation and struck the employee on the head, neck, and face. The employee suffered fractures to the face, neck, and leg.
An employee was running a trash compactor when one of the trash bags burst open, releasing a puff of drywall dust. The employee was hospitalized for tightness in her chest and difficulty breathing.
An employee was hanging a light when it began to fall and its wire wrapped around the employee's left ring finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was crossing the street to collect trash from a residence when he was struck by a car, suffering injuries to multiple body parts.

An Aerotek contract employee was helping a press brake operator position a 4-foot by 2-foot metal sheet, weighing about 35 pounds, in a press brake. The contract employee's right index finger was pinched between the metal part and the press brake support, causing an amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was adjusting a machine below a rotary airlock valve. The employee's left hand came into contact with the rotors, causing the amputation of two fingers. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered ankle and face injuries when he struck a pole while operating an order picker lift.
A door slammed on an employee's right little finger, amputating the tip at the first knuckle.
An employee was putting cheese into a hopper when his finger was pinched in the hopper's funnel cavity. He was hospitalized; the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was carrying a 22-inch by 96-inch piece of particle board. The board he was carrying struck boards in a rack; two of them fell out and hit the employee's right big toe, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was changing filters and greasing the shaft on an air handler unit. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the pulley and the belt, and the tip was amputated.
While standing up, an employee struck his head on a machine motor mount, suffering head trauma with possible cranial bleeding. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a dock as the dock plate was being lowered, striking his face on the ground.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, suffering an ankle fracture/dislocation.
An employee was helping install a stair stringer. It fell onto the employee's right lower leg, causing a fracture.

An employee was loading a vibratory roller onto a trailer. The employee missed a step exiting the machine and fell onto the trailer, striking his back and head. He then fell from the trailer onto the ground. He suffered a head abrasion and fracture to the mid- to lower back.
An employee was doing maintenance work on one of two cylinders of a front end loader. The loader's mast fell onto his left leg, pinning it to the floor and breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a boar when it became agitated, striking the employee's thigh and causing a laceration about three inches long.
An employee was holding a sheet metal brake on a dolly when it rolled away, fell, and hit the employee's leg. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was handling material on a hand cart when the load shifted. A sheet of aluminum twisted and broke the employee's arm.
An employee was driving a walkie rider down an aisle when it struck another, parked walkie rider. He broke his left ankle and suffered a head injury.
While wiping down a table in an operating room, an employee slipped and fell to the wet floor. She suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a pin press when it cycled, causing the amputation of the employee's right index fingertip. The press was not locked out at the time.

An employee was checking a can filling line lid infeed. The lid feed actuator tripped and the feed mechanism started, amputating the tip/side of his right thumb. The guard had been removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and struck a stack of pallets. The employee's foot was twisted.
An employee felt pain in the center of his chest after lifting a furniture dolly cover caught under a dolly wheel.
An employee was rotating an asphalt plant baghouse rotor when his right index fingertip was pinched between the rotor and the rotor brake. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was hammering 20-penny nails into a header when the second blow glanced off a nail, causing the nail to ricochet off the header and puncture the employee's cornea. Safety glasses were not being worn at the time.
An employee was pulling a rocket cart when it caught her pants leg, causing her to fall to the ground. She suffered a broken femur.
An employee collapsed while loading and unloading mill works. He was hospitalized for a heart condition.

At 11:00 a.m. on October 2, 2018, an employee was installing 15-inch PVC pipe in a storm sewer when his left hand was caught between the pipes. Three of his fingers were smashed; the index finger suffered a partial amputation.
An employee was driving a stand-up tug when it accelerated as he was going around a corner. He jumped off, injuring his head and back on the floor.
An employee tripped while walking, injuring her left knee.

An employee was using a press brake to straighten out a piece of bent product. The employee suffered an amputation to the left thumb before the first knuckle, either from the press brake or the product being pressed.
On October 3, 2018, an employee fractured her wrist in a fall down a flight of stairs.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut off the top of a 5-gallon plastic pail. The knife slipped and severely lacerated his left forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was kneeling down, working on a dead panel box, when an arc flash and explosion occurred in the adjoining panel. The employee suffered burns to the face and arms and was hospitalized.
Employees were replacing fuse cutouts from an underground riser. An impact gun touched a fuse cutout, causing an arc flash that burned two employees.
An employee was working next to an engraving machine when it caught fire. While he tried to extinguish the fire with a portable extinguisher, he was overcome by the smoke.

On October 3, 2018, an employee stepped down onto an extension ladder from a roof and lost his balance. He fell about 8 feet onto a front porch's wooden rail, then onto the ground. He suffered four broken ribs and scraped his arms.
An employee was disconnecting an asphalt hose from a truck. Hot asphalt splashed onto the employee's arms, torso, and neck, causing third-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a backhoe for a tractor when his right middle finger was pinched between the backhoe and the swing frame. The finger was amputated.
While stepping out of a truck, an employee stumbled and fell to the ground. The truck's rear tire ran over the employee's right leg, causing a crushing injury that led to amputation below the knee.
An employee fell through a hatch hole in a metal roof deck, landing on the ground below and suffering injuries to the back and right leg.
An employee was fitting a casting roll into a machine when his right index finger was pinched between the roll and the machine frame. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was trying to remove a piece of lumber from a web saw. The saw blade kicked the lumber back, pulling the employee's middle finger toward the fixed guard and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was cutting flooring with a table saw when the blade amputated two of the employee's fingers.

An employee had gone up a rig to unhook a block. The rig was clutched in, throwing the employee about 8 feet to the tuba line. His left knee struck a drum guard, which broke the kneecap. He was hospitalized.
While pouring a powdered fiber supplement into cups, an employee inhaled the powder and had an asthma attack. The employee was hospitalized.

At 6:11 a.m. on October 3, 2018, a temporary employee was using a cut and fold machine to crimp pieces of mylar (film strip). While the employee was straightening a piece of mylar, the machine activated and struck her left index finger. Her fingernail was amputated.
While fighting a rooftop fire, two employees slipped on melted tar. The tar got on their hands and arms, causing second-degree burns.

An employee was unloading a concrete floor polisher from a vehicle using a lift gate. While trying to stop the polisher from slipping, the employee grabbed a bar that was a part of the machine's suspension system and it moved, pinching the employee's fingers and causing the amputation of the left index and middle fingertips above the first knuckle.
An employee's hand was pinched between a conveyor and a guide strip. The employee's left thumb was amputated.
An employee was assaulted by three people while helping a customer. The employee was stabbed with a box cutter and suffered a concussion, and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking through a warehouse. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and hip bone, and was hospitalized.
An employee was rotating a multi-sample tool on a tool cart. The tool came off the cart and his middle finger was caught between the cart and the tool, amputating the fingertip.
On October 3, 2018, an employee was delivering paper to a customer when he fell off the back of a truck, landing on the ground and breaking his pelvis and legs.

An employee was holding an H frame while temporary welds were cut. The frame twisted after a weld was cut, and its edge caught the employee's glove and pulled the employee from the ladder. The employee fell onto a work flat, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was spooling a cable on a door when the cable came off and the door fell. The lip on the door's back side lacerated the employee's lower left leg.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut two-by-four plywood. The employee's fingers came into contact with the saw, causing an amputation to the left middle, ring, and little fingers.
A roll-off container door was unlatched to be dumped. It struck an employee in the right foot, breaking it.
An employee was using a beam saw to cut a sheet of plywood. The saw blade contacted his hand, resulting in an amputation of four fingers and part of his thumb.
While working from a roof, an employee fell through a skylight to the concrete floor about 14' below, suffering a broken left leg.

Employees were finishing concrete on the second floor of a deck. An employee was about to mop the concrete with a 10-foot pole. Noticing that the top of the pole was about 6-8 feet from a power line, he moved to grab the pole; he then felt a shock and fell backwards onto another employee. Both received electrical burns and were hospitalized.
An employee was walking down an aisle when she fell straight forward, striking her face and head on the concrete floor. She suffered a concussion and facial swelling.
An employee fell from a rolling scaffold.
An employee slipped on water, hitting the right side of her head on a countertop. She suffered a contusion on the right side of her head.

An employee was leaving an oil platform when he lost his balance while stepping over a centrifugal pump. He slipped off the skid to the ground about 6 inches below, twisting his ankle and suffering a broken fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking on plywood to check an HVAC unit when he stepped off the board and fell through the ceiling. He suffered a fractured orbital socket and two fractured ribs on the lower left side.

Between 9:00 and 10:00 a.m. on October 3, 2018, an employee was guiding the butt of a wooden electrical pole, which was being lifted by the winch of a digger derrick. The employee's neck came into contact with the pole as it was being grabbed by the pole claws; the top of the pole moved into (or close to) overhead high-voltage electrical lines. The employee suffered a 69,000-volt electrical shock down the body and out his foot.

An employee was performing a compression test on a diesel engine. All of the injectors were removed since several of them were broken. A rag was held over an open cylinder to prevent debris and fuel from exiting. When the engine started, air pressure exited the cylinder and caused a puncture wound through the palm of the employee's left hand.
An employee was removing belts from a belt-making machine when the machine activated, degloving the employee's left index finger.
An employee turned into an aisle while driving a pallet jack. During the turn, his right leg was caught between the pallet jack and a yellow bollard, causing a compound fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a ladder, taking pictures of system suppression valves, when it tilted. He fell head first onto the carpeted concrete floor about 6 feet below, suffering fractures to the base of his skull, his right wrist, and his left middle fingers.
An employee fell off a 6-foot ladder while cleaning, breaking his ankle when he struck the floor.
Two employees were engaged in horseplay with an industrial staple gun when the gun fired, impaling an employee on the right side of the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was removing old plywood sheets from a lean-to roof when he stepped into an opening between joists and fell onto a joist, breaking his ribs and puncturing a lung.

An employee was using a forklift to put away palletized product. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and a bollard; the employee suffered a crushed ankle and fractures to the foot and lower leg.

An employee was sweeping the floor on the second level of a building. The employee fell through an opening in the floor, suffering forehead injuries that required stitches, bruised ribs, and a hip contusion.
An employee was removing sheet metal and studs from a ceiling soffit when a steel stud caused a deep cut to his arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood for a cabinet when the table saw lacerated the tip of his left index finger and thumb.
A flywheel machine cycled while an employee's hand was inside it, breaking his finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was struck in the chest/abdomen area by a girder being moved by a crane. The employee suffered internal complications, among them injuries to the appendix and large intestine and cracked vertebrae.
An employee was walking through the parking lot when a 50 mph wind blew a piece of plexiglass at her and severed her right ear.
An employee's left index finger contacted a moving part inside a pump, which cut off the tip of the finger.
An employee was working from a combination ladder, drilling a hole in a ceiling. He fell off the ladder, breaking two ribs.
An employee felt ill while on his waste collection route. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee connected a nail gun to an air compressor line. The nail gun shot a nail into the employee's left thigh, deep enough to reach the bone.
An employee was on a garbage route when he lost consciousness, suffering from dehydration and muscle injury.

An employee was attaching parts to a motor grader as part of its assembly. A part to be attached was on a mobile cart; the employee's right ring finger was caught between the cart and the grader, and was partially amputated at the third joint.
An employee was bending metal sheets with a hydraulic press. As the employee adjusted the press, it crushed the employee's hand.
An employee suffered repository distress after smelling perfume and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting lettuce with a lettuce chopper when it caught the tip of his left thumb, amputating the skin from the tip of the thumb.
An employee was removing bagasse from a machine. A pry bar pinched off the employee's right little fingertip.

An employee had adjusted the tension on a machine's chain/belt, then energized the machine to evaluate its operation. His hand slipped into the chain area; his finger was caught between the chain and sprocket, and he suffered partial amputations to the left ring and middle fingers. At the time of the incident, the machine's lockout/tagout had been removed and the chain area was unguarded.
An employee was standing on a two-step stool to place an electrical item onto a rack. He fell from the stool and broke his femur.
An employee was cutting metal banding. After being cut, the banding shot up and struck the employee's eye causing a corneal injury.
An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move stock. The jack pinned the employee's right foot against a wall, breaking it.

At 4:45 p.m. on October 4, 2018, an employee was using a self-propelled fertilizer spreader to spread dry fertilizer on a customer's farm. He struck a washout in the field, and the spreader's air-ride seat bottomed out. He suffered a compression fracture of his lumbar spine and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping others determine why a roll of fabric was not feeding correctly into a machine. A metal roller, under tension from fabric, bent and slipped out from the roller guide. It struck the employee, causing a compound fracture of the left tibia and fibula.

An employee was using a 20-ton air jack to lift the front end of a self-propelled telescoping boom. The machine shifted off the jack and pinched the employee's left middle finger between the machine frame and the jack. The employee's left middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was working on a panel box when his screwdriver touched a 480-volt panel. He suffered flash burns to the neck, face, chest, and right arm and a laceration to his forehead.

Three employees were moving a motor onto the back of a golf cart. While two employees lowered the motor, the third began to push the motor in place. The motor flipped over, crushing the third employee's right ring finger and crushing and amputating his right middle finger.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift in an aisle and caught her right foot between the forklift and a merchandise display; she was hospitalized, requiring surgery for an injury to her big toe.
An employee received a flu shot, had an allergic reaction, and was administered an EpiPen. The EpiPen caused an additional allergic reaction and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the end platform of a railcar to the ground, 4.5 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was changing the forks on a forklift. A fork slid down and crushed the employee's right index finger, causing an injury requiring stitches.

An employee was feeding a new roll of stock material into a slip roller. The employee's left glove was caught between the material and the rolls of the slip roller; the employee's hand was pulled into the machine, suffering amputation of multiple fingers. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

Two employees had rigged a 3,000-pound tank to a crane hook using straps. The straps slipped off the hook and the tank fell, hitting one of the employees. The employee suffered broken vertebrae and was hospitalized.
A cart of cabinet doors tipped over while it was being moved, crushing an employee's foot.
A forklift hit a skid, pushing it into a berm. An employee's foot was caught between the skid and the berm; the employee suffered broken toes and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground as she left an office, breaking her left arm.
An employee was climbing up to a machine platform when his left hand came into contact with a conveyor pulley system. Three of his fingers were amputated. The pulley system was unguarded at the time.

An employee was handling steel beams while installing a rack. Two of the beams struck each other, crushing his left middle finger between them. The fingertip was amputated, including part of the nail bed.

An employee was guiding a vault into a grave when the wire cable suspending it snapped. The cable struck the employee's right hand, causing injuries to three fingers that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a derrick digger truck to lift wooden power poles. A pole lodged partially in the pile while being lifted. It shifted direction erratically after being dislodged and bounced toward the employee, striking his right leg and breaking the tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a nail gun to secure a board. A nail shot into the palm of the employee's left hand.

An employee had been machining a part on a vertical lathe. The employee was discovered inside the housing of the machine, having suffered a broken neck, jaw, and ribs, a punctured lung and multiple lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell 15 feet through a roof opening while doing roofing work. The employee struck a CNC lathe machine during the fall to the floor and suffered a dislocated shoulder.
An employee lost consciousness while sitting and fell, striking the wall and then landing on the floor. She suffered a head laceration.
An employee was placing a citation onto the windshield of a parked vehicle, lost balance and fell to the ground causing fractures to both wrists.
An employee tripped on a curb and fell to the ground, injuring his left shoulder. He was hospitalized and had his shoulder replaced.

An employee was cooling off a radiator with a water hose. The radiator was uncapped, and the fluids inside it boiled off, burning the employee's torso; he fell to the ground and broke his right elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the top of an industrial truck, breaking eight ribs and a vertebra in his upper back and suffering a punctured lung. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.

An employee was driving an ATV uphill. Having pulled over and parked to allow a tracked vehicle to travel down the right-of-way, the employee was trying to pull out and resume when the ATV tipped sideways and rolled about 400 feet downhill. The employee suffered a head laceration and a broken arm, as well as trouble breathing.
An employee moved from a dock plate to the ground to remove a wheel chock. The plate was operated, causing a partial amputation to the employee's left thumb.

An employee was helping lift a 10-foot ductile iron pipe section into a trench box. The pipe came loose from the clamp, bounced sideways, and struck the employee, causing tooth loss and soft tissue injury to an arm.
An employee was deburring a piece of flat metal stock, 3" x 3", about 1/8" thick. The stock lodged in the disc sander, catching and causing the amputation of the tip of the employee's right thumb.

An employee was leaving a second-floor window of a home that was under construction. While hooking his lanyard to a safety rope, he slipped on a wet piece of paper and fell, landing on the ground about 15 feet below and breaking his pelvis on the left side. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder, installing a toe line for a tubing lift. A weld on the structure broke, bringing it and the ladder down. The employee fell 15-20 feet to the ground, breaking ribs and a scapula.
An employee was connecting a portable GPU unit to an aircraft tug when his right ring finger was caught between the two connections. The fingertip was amputated.
A felled tree kicked back and slid down a hill, striking an employee. The employee's pelvis was broken.
While dragging a pallet to the edge of a trailer, an employee fell off the trailer to the ground, suffering thumb and back fractures and a head laceration.

An employee was on a barge, cleaning and cutting out rebar from a concrete trophy. Suffering from dehydration, he became overheated and dizzy and fell. He landed on a steel beam, which struck the left side of his ribcage and caused a pneumothorax.
An employee tripped over an empty wooden pallet on the floor while carrying another empty pallet. The employee fell, suffering a non-displaced fracture in the lower back.
An employee tripped and fell over backwards while moving wooden pallets. The employee broke a bone and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unclog a feed haul when the auger inside the feed haul pulled in his glove. His left middle finger was amputated.

An employee was on a 12-foot A-frame ladder, working on a plumbing fixture in a home under construction. He fell off the ladder, striking his head on the concrete floor. He suffered a head laceration and broken ribs, and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while inside a refrigerated truck. The employee's head struck the floor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was injured by a cow when moving a calf, suffering broken ribs.

An employee was walking along a catwalk between a tractor and a trailer when he slipped and fell. His leg/hip area struck the side of the catwalk steps, and his pelvis was fractured. He was hospitalized.

Two warehouse workers were moving six wooden bedroom doors set on a metal cart. One of the doors moved against the side of the cart, causing an amputation (without bone loss) to the tip of one worker's middle finger.
An employee was skimming a wash tank. The employee's index finger was caught in a rotating part and amputated.

An employee was standing on a ladder in a stairway, holding ductwork that was being lifted into place. While attempting to secure the duct work, it slipped loose from its collar on the wall and struck the employee, knocking him off the ladder to the ground. He suffered fractured vertebrae in his neck.
An employee's clothing was caught by an uncovered rotating shaft. The shaft mangled the employee's left leg, which was amputated from the knee down.

On October 5, 2018, an employee was moving an electric pallet jack. His right foot was caught between the pallet jack and a pallet of water. He suffered a severe ankle/leg injury and was hospitalized.
On October 5, 2018, while preparing food on a line, an employee slipped and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was using a shear to cut a piece of sheet metal. The employee's finger was pinched under the shear's hold-down; the tip was amputated.
While making deliveries in a truck, an employee experienced heat exhaustion symptoms, becoming nauseated and vomiting.
And employee squatted to pull his 30-pound toolbox toward him when he felt a severe pain in his lower back. He was hospitalized.

On October 5, 2018, an employee was lowering a press's ejector head/roller into position when it shifted, pinching the employee's right ring finger between itself and the ejector/roller stand. The finger was broken and punctured by a splinter.
An employee was clearing excess product away when his left hand came in contact with a high-pressure water jet. He suffered deep lacerations to the hand and fingers.
An employee's hand was lacerated by a thermal lance.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was instructing an excavator operator to lift a piece of reinforced concrete pipe (weighing about 10,300 pounds, 6 feet long, and 60 inches in diameter) when it rolled off the excavator bucket and onto the employee, causing a fracture and a torn ligament in his pelvis.
An employee was descending a ladder when it slid. It and the employee fell about 4 feet to the ground; the employee suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was using a dolly to remove bottles from a box truck when he slipped and fell on the dock plate, landing flat on his back and striking his tailbone.
An employee was hospitalized for a panic attack after hearing another employee was terminated due to restructuring at the company.
An employee tripped over a case of water on the floor behind her. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee fell while walking down a hallway, landing on the floor and breaking her right arm. She was hospitalized.
An employee's forklift struck a pallet of product while backing up. His left index finger was caught between the pallet and a leg guard on the forklift, and was amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting a new machine. A piece of metal fell from the machine and struck the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation.

An employee was cleaning the house of the grain probe machine and their left hand was caught inside the opened area of the probe cylinder resulting in partial amputations to the middle and index fingers.
Cardboard bales shifted in a trailer and fell out when the doors were opened. One struck an employee, injuring his pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder, pulling a 2x4 from an overhead rack. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering five broken ribs and a punctured right lung.
An employee was working on a bridge site when he tripped on angle iron and fell onto rebar. He suffered an injury to the parotid gland on the right side of his face.
An employee was operating a press brake when it crushed his left hand. The index, middle and ring fingers were amputated to the second knuckle.
An employee was handing a piece of ductwork to a coworker when it slipped from his hand and landed on the ground on top of his left wrist. He suffered a deep laceration to the wrist.

An employee was checking the alignment and tightness of ventilation system drive belts. A belt snagged the employee's glove, pulling the employee's hand into the machinery. The employee suffered multiple fractures, including an open fracture/fingertip amputation.

An employee was inspecting highway work when a passenger vehicle entered the work zone and struck his parked vehicle. The employee was pinned between his vehicle and a concrete barrier, suffering head trauma. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a rope ladder out of a pit. The employee fell from the ladder, landing on the cement floor about 10 feet below and breaking ribs and back vertebrae.
An employee was changing a tire on a tire machine. The machine's arm came down and pinched his right middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
While trying to stop a customer to check a receipt, an employee fell, struck her head, and lost consciousness. She was hospitalized.

An employee was punching out a piece of metal channel material with an ironworking machine. His left little finger was caught between the channel material and the equipment, and the tip was amputated.
An employee was wiping down a roller with a rag when the rag and the employee's right hand were pulled into the rollers. The employee suffered a finger amputation.
An employee was leaving an elevator when she slipped on a wet floor and fell. She hit her left knee, fracturing the kneecap, and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through a vestibule when he tripped over a stack of hand baskets on the floor. He fell to the tile floor, breaking his hip.
An employee was walking to a receiving dock when she tripped over a bed frame and fell to the ground. She suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was unloading a 205-pound emergency generator from the back of a pickup truck. The generator slipped, coming down on his hands and amputating two fingertips.
An employee was cutting a 4-by-6 board at a 45-degree angle. The saw blade contacted a knot in the wood, causing an amputation to the employee's left index finger.
An employee's fingers were caught between a mixer door and a scraper. The employee suffered a finger amputation and three broken fingers.
An employee was on a moving conveyor belt when he suffered bruises and a cut on his face. He was hospitalized.
An employee had been picking pickles at an agriculture site. The employee became unresponsive due to the heat and was hospitalized.

At about 3:15-3:30 p.m. on October 7, 2018, an apprentice meat cutter at EGW was cutting lamb using a bandsaw. The saw blade hit a bone in the lamb, and the employee's hand was pulled into the blade. He suffered a laceration and fracture of his right index finger, and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a temporary bypass cable. While reaching down to pick up a wrench, he fell into the pedestal he was working on. His arm was broken, either in the fall or when he was pulled free of the pedestal.

At about 7:40 a.m. on October 7, 2018, a temporary employee was operating the roll stand on a filament extrusion machine. She was stringing up the line when the machine pulled her in, breaking five bones in her left arm. She was hospitalized.

On October 7, 2018, an employee was putting cardboard into a baler when the machine's guard was lowered onto his finger, pinching his left little finger against the frame. The end of the finger was amputated.
On October 8, 2018, an employee tripped on an anti-fatigue safety mat, lost balance, and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken hip bone and was hospitalized.

On October 8, 2018, an employee was helping a coworker clean a building's gutters. He got off a ladder onto the roof, then lost his footing and fell through a skylight. A cart broke his fall; then he landed on the ground, suffering a broken wrist and elbow and lacerations on his forehead.
An employee was preparing to remove plastic rolls from an extruder machine. The employee's right ring finger was crushed and amputated between two of the rolls.
While checking the belt on a conveyor, an employee was caught in the machine's rotating rollers and belt. The employee suffered a broken left arm and right leg, and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it struck a ballast, resulting in a fracture to the employee's left foot.
An employee tripped and fell while moving equipment, suffering a back injury.
An employee was attempting to park a pallet jack when his toe was pinched and fractured between the pallet jack he was operating and a parked pallet jack.
An employee was cleaning an awning with a vacuum on top of a ladder when the employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was on a roof cleaning gutters . The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured elbow and lacerations to the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a roof when he tripped on a stone and fell, suffering a broken right femur, a contusion on the right side of his chest, and a cut on his right hand.

An employee was using a tugger to pull a cable on a rope. The tugger began to shake out of control; while the employee was trying to stop it from shaking, his hand was pulled into the tugger. The tugger began to roll on the ground, bringing the employee with it until his right index finger was partially amputated.

An employee was performing a calibration to test sulfur content in butane. The valve was stuck so he used a wrench and butane sprayed out and ignited in the lab. The employee suffered second and third degree burns to his arms and face and was hospitalized.

An employee was steering a three-wheeled sweeper that was being towed by a tow motor. The sweeper tilted while going through a curve, and a bar on it (which the employee was holding on to) hit the ground. The employee broke two bones in his left hand and severed his left pinky finger.
A temporary employee bent over to pick something up off the ground when her hair was caught inside a machine grinder. She was pulled in, sustaining a hematoma.
An employee was operating a drill press. The press caught his right glove, and the drill bit lacerated the top of his hand.
An employee was shearing edges off titanium flashings when a piece was ejected from the shear, striking the employee's abdomen and lacerating it above the navel.
An employee was hanging up a pump jack head. As the head was being lowered, it smashed the employee's hand against the pump jack. The employee suffered an amputation of the right forearm.

A temporary employee was using a large bending machine to bend a 3/4-inch by 8-foot piece of metal. As he guided the piece through the rollers on the machine, his fingers were caught in the rollers and his left little finger was amputated.
While getting out of his truck, an employee missed a step and fell onto the ground. He suffered broken ribs and a broken wrist and was hospitalized.
On October 8, 2018, an employee was using a knife to cut a conveyor belt. The knife slipped off the straight edge and cut off the skin on the tip of the employee's thumb.
On October 8, 2018, an employee stepped down the step ladder, lost his balance, and fell off the balcony 11-feet to the ground, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.
Employees were raising a 10-foot wood wall during framing operations. The wall slipped and fell on one of them, injuring his left elbow and shoulder. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing trim on a home. The employee fell off the second rung of a ladder onto the sharp edge of trim debris causing a laceration including cut tendons and arteries.
On October 8, 2008, an employee was struck on the left leg by an electric pallet jack. The employee suffered a broken left tibia and was hospitalized
An employee was trying to open a large mechanical door when his right hand was caught in the door. Part of his right little finger was amputated.
An employee was conducting a bike patrol when he fell from his mountain bike. He landed on the ground, fracturing and dislocating his right femur.
A concrete truck driver was washing out the truck's concrete drum when the nozzle of the hose he was using made contact with a hopper. The pad of his right thumb was torn off.
While installing conduit overhead, an employee fell through an opening in a steel platform to the concrete floor below. The employee suffered a head laceration, broken finger, and ruptured spleen.

An employee was showing a coworker the adjustment needed on one of the blade heads on a planer machine. The blade head lacerated the employee's right thumb, index, ring, and little fingers and partially amputated the thumb and index finger. The employee was hospitalized. The blade head was unguarded at the time of the incident.

A dual-drummed roller was lining up on a pad that was being paved, preparing to roll asphalt. The roller slid and its operator went over an embankment, suffering lacerations and multiple skull fractures.
An employee's right foot was run over by a forklift, suffering an amputation of two toes on the right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking around a portable ramp when a forklift, coming off the ramp, struck him and broke his ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down an embankment at a construction site. He slipped and fell to the ground below, breaking his tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking through a metal entry door and pinched their right thumb in the door resulting in amputation of skin and muscle from the thumb.

An employee was working on a three-step stepladder, moving paint containers from the top of a shelf down to 
another location. As she descended the ladder, she missed the last step and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.

An employee was using air skates to move an industrial drill, weighing about 20,000 pounds. The drill tipped over and crushed the employee's thumb against a wedge mounting block. The thumb was surgically amputated up to the first knuckle.

An employee was bolting a steel beam (weighing approximately 720 pounds) to a structure when the steel plates shifted and pinned the employee's left hand. The employee sustained a broken left wrist, middle finger, and ring finger, as well as a severed thumb.
Two Automation employees got into a fist fight; one suffered a facial injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a table saw. The blade lacerated two of the employee's fingers and amputated a finger.
While climbing down a ladder, an employee lost footing and fell about 10 feet to the ground. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae.
While doing outside maintenance, an employee tripped over a garden hose and suffered a head injury.
Employees had attached a winch to lift a window rack when the winch gave way and hit the injured employee in the head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was test-driving a go-cart he had been working on when it struck a parked car. He broke his left ankle and two ribs on the left side.

An employee was a passenger inside a work truck that was driving down the road. She stepped out of the work truck to collect roadway signs. As she was walking around the vehicle, a pickup truck struck her, sending her to the ground. She suffered lacerations to the face, ears, and scalp and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a paint buffer when his headphones cord became tangled in the buffer, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving steel beams when his finger was pinched and lacerated between two of them. He was wearing cut-resistant gloves.

An employee was connecting a pipe to a new manhole inside an excavation when the soil caved in and pinned the employee against the manhole. The employee suffered fractured ribs and shoulder and wrist injuries.

On October 9, 2018, an employee fell from the roof of a two-story home while cleaning gutters. The employee landed on the ground, suffering a fractured pelvis, ribs, and lower back, and was hospitalized.
An employee was providing maintenance to a blower when the blower blade energized and the employee's right hand was sucked into the blade, partially amputating the index finger (from the nail up).
A paramedic was riding in the back of an ambulance when it ran over a pothole or bump in the road, jarring his back. He suffered lower back pain and was hospitalized.
While walking across a warehouse floor, an employee was struck by a powered pallet jack. The employee suffered a broken left tibia.

An employee was standing on the top rung of a 6-foot ladder and using a drill to repair a vinyl crown when he reached to one side and fell off the ladder, landing on a house dolly that was adjacent to his work area. He suffered a dislocation and fracture of the left ankle.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a motor assembly with a belt/pulley. He was inspecting the belt for tears when his right pinky finger was caught in a pinch point between the belt and wheel, resulting in a partial amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was attempting to drive a standup lift through a doorway while moving a storage rack when she missed the door opening and her left foot was crushed by the wall.
An employee tripped and fell to the pavement while stepping from a curb in a parking lot, suffering a knee injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a three-wheel cart up a ramp outside a building, at the second floor level. The cart flipped over during a turn and the employee fell to the ground. Striking asphalt, the employee suffered a mild concussion.
On October 9, 2018, an employee was stung by a wasp while sitting in a guard shack. The employee suffered an allergic reaction and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an iron worker machine to cut a flat bar when the bar flipped up, catching the employee's left thumb between the bar and machine and resulting in an amputation to the thumb.
Two employees were building a stage deck. The platform shifted, and both employees fell about 11 feet to the ground. One suffered a head injury.
On October 9, 2018, an employee was helping to clear a jam on a paper winder when the winder cycled and the blade caught the employee's right index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was loading mineral tubs for cattle onto a truck when the employee's right index finger was caught and crushed under one of the tubs, requiring surgical amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was exiting a room when she attempted to straighten a high chair, turned, and her foot became caught on the wall. She fell to the ground and fractured her femur.
An employee was obtaining a sample from a sample port when 400 degree liquid sprayed the employee, causing burns to the face, hand, and chest.

The injured employee had dismounted his lift truck to pick up garbage. A second employee backed a forklift into the injured employee and pinned the employee against equipment causing an intestinal injury.
An employee was carrying three pieces of 3/4" PVC up a ladder. He fell from the ladder to the concrete slab roof, injuring two vertebrae in his lower back.

A supervisor was on a utility cart, watching another employee cut brush using a tractor with a brush head. An object was ejected from the tractor, striking the supervisor in the head just below his hard hat and causing a fracture.
An employee was going up the starch platform when the top handrail of the platform broke and he fell 8 feet to the ground, breaking his ribs and neck bones.

On October 9, 2018, an employee was preparing to unload packages from a trailer when the employee tripped and fell into the wheel well of the trailer, suffering a broken lower leg. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was clearing a lintel machine. The machine moved and trapped the tip of the employee's right middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was attacked by a stray dog while walking up to a patient's home, suffering multiple deep lacerations to the right lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hit in the head by the side gate of his flatbed truck. He suffered head trauma.
An employee was struck by an excavator while sweeping debris from the street into a trench, fracturing a leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing by a baggage carousel as a second employee driving a baggage tractor made a U-turn. When the second employee completed the turn, the last dolly slipped and hit the first employee, who sustained a broken right tibia and fibula as well as crushed blood vessels.

An employee was driving a baggage cart when it struck a belt loader. The employee suffered a broken left radius and ulna, damage to the left elbow and left shoulder, and an amputation of the left little finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was moving muck that had been dredged from a waterway with a bulldozer. He drove over a ledge and the bulldozer went down quickly and came to a sudden stop. He was thrown forward and struck the front console and windshield, suffering neck and arm pain. A seatbelt was not worn at the time.

At 3:00 p.m. on October 10, 2018, an employee fell while entering an elevator. The employee's forehead struck the rail, suffering an abrasion; the employee's humerus was broken when they landed on their shoulder on the elevator floor.

On October 10, 2018, an employee was banding aluminum strips that were standing vertically in a gaylord container when the container split open. The aluminum strips then fell toward the employee and knocked him to the ground. He suffered head injuries and a broken hip.
An employee was replacing a panel on a machine that weighed approximately 15 pounds. While lifting and adjusting the panel, the employee pulled a muscle in his lower back.
An employee opened a rail car. A fireball blew out of the car into the employee's face, causing second-degree burns.
An employee was preparing a cow for milking. A cattle gate closed on the employee's hand, causing a partial amputation to the left little finger.
An employee fell in an asphalt parking lot, hitting his head. He suffered an eye socket fracture and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a satellite dish from a ladder. The employee slipped from the ladder, which lacerated the employee's bicep. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking merchandise in a freezer and became short of breath, with numbness in the extremities. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a possible heart attack.

An employee was sanding the head of a stainless steel chisel when the employee's right thumb became caught between a vertical belt sander and the work rest, causing an abrasion that resulted in a partial amputation to the thumb tip.

On October 10, 2018, at approximately 7:36 p.m., three employees were working inside an ammunition manufacturing facility on a primer manufacturing line. The injured employee was operating a primer cup shaking unit when the motor stopped working. The employee was troubleshooting the motor and reached through a sliding guard to try and push it to get it going. When the pulley motor started, the employee suffered an avulsion injury to their right index finger. The fingertip was surgically amputated.

On October 10, 2018, an employee was resting his hand on the belt and pulley of a sawdust removal system while attaching a chain when his hand made contact with the pulley, resulting in the removal of a portion of his thumb.

An employee was adjusting the photo eye at the back side of a conveyor. His right hand was resting over the cover of the drive chain and sprocket when his left hand activated the eye. He leaned forward and his right index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, causing a laceration that resulted in a surgical amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee's ring caught on a part of a scissor lift while he was descending. The skin on his finger was torn off.
An employee exiting the building slipped on some mud and fell to the ground, fracturing his tibia and requiring hospitalization.

A roofing crew was starting a roof installation, carrying up large rolls of insulation to be laid out. A gust of wind blew a roll over while an employee was holding its end, and the employee was pushed over the edge of the roofline. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a forehead laceration and a broken elbow. Fall protection was being worn, but was not adjusted for the distance to the ground.

On 10/10/2018, around 8:30 a.m., an employee was attempting to replace a motor on a press machine when the employee was pinned between the motor and the machine frame, suffering contusions that required hospitalization.
A patient came into the ER for treatment and smelled like smoke.  The smoke scent caused an employee to have an asthma attack.
An employee got into a fight with another person and suffered a broken tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while carrying a box, suffering a laceration to the face/lip and knee.

An employee was installing exterior plywood while standing on a second floor deck when he fell one story (about 12 feet) to the ground and broke his left arm, requiring hospitalization. A harness with a lanyard was worn at the time of the incident.

Employees were attempting to jumpstart an SUV with a weak battery when the SUV moved forward and struck an employee. He suffered internal bleeding, skull and brain trauma, a crushed pelvic area, and other injuries.
An employee was shot by someone in a vehicle in the parking area, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was welding metal plates when a plate fell onto the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing to lift a vehicle on an auto lift. The vehicle moved forward, striking the employee and pushing them against a tool box. The employee's legs were broken, and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a screwdriver to remove a stick jammed in a descrambler chain. The screwdriver kicked out and the employee's thumb entered the chain area, causing a laceration and amputation injury to the thumb tip.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a head injury, fractured ribs, and a fractured collarbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was running a cup filling machine when she came into contact with the lidder mechanism and her right hand became stuck underneath it, resulting in an amputation to the pinky finger.

An employee was attempting to start a lawn mower. When he pulled the cord, the mower lifted and landed on his left foot, resulting in a  partial amputation of his big toe. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was pull starting a snow blower and tore a knee ligament.

Employees tilted an oven and its stand so that the floor behind it could be cleaned. As the oven and stand were put back on the floor, the stand's adjustable leg caught an employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated at the nail.
An employee was clearing a jam from an automatic box folding machine when the machine cycled, resulting in an amputation of the employee's thumb tip.

Employees were cleaning a mixing machine. The injured employee was attempting to remove meat when the other employee rotated the mixer blades, resulting in an amputation of the injured employee's right hand above the wrist. The injured employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on an extension ladder, about to power-wash a section of roof, when he slipped and fell 10 feet to the ground. His left leg was broken below the knee and his right toe was also fractured.

On October 11, 2018, an employee was using a handheld, gasoline-powered cutoff saw to cut aluminum material for recycling. The saw kicked back and struck the employee's face, causing laceration and fracture injuries. The employee was hospitalized. The hard hat's face shield was not in place at the time of the incident.
An employee lost his footing while moving concrete panels. A panel shifted, knocking him backwards to the ground. He suffered two broken ribs and an injured shoulder.

An employee was using a bending machine to roll a piece of stainless steel when the employee's glove was caught in the dual roller, crushing the employee's hand and causing an amputation. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was climbing up a ladder secured to a one-story home. Once the ladder was untied, it slipped and the employee fell. The employee suffered a broken left arm and swelling on the left side of the face.
On 10/11/2018 at 6:00, an employee was receiving an airplane when she tripped over a chock, falling to the pavement and breaking her left wrist.
An employee was adjusting a machine. The machine malfunctioned and its clamping mechanism closed on the employee's hand, causing a partial amputation of two fingers.

On 10/11/2018, an employee was observing and recording information about a conveyor drive motor while standing on a step ladder. The conveyor line was located approximately 9 feet above the floor. The sleeve of his smock became caught in the line, causing him to lose his balance and fall from the ladder. He was hospitalized with a laceration and fracture to the left arm.
An employee was spreading MEK solvent on the floor with a broom when a pilot light ignited, causing a fire. The employee suffered first-through third-degree burns on the chest, hands, and arms.
An employee was walking in a dock area. A forklift ran over the employee's left foot while backing up.
An employee was cutting material with a saw when it cut his finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was moving a piece of furniture. As he was setting down the piece, his middle finger was smashed beneath the furniture, resulting in a partial surgical amputation.

An employee was working on a PNC forming machine when the employee made contact with the grinding wheel on the machine, resulting in amputations to the right index fingertip and thumb tip. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee tried to clean a gang rip saw and its blade injured the employee's right thumb, causing an amputation.
An employee tripped while walking down the stairs of an amphitheater and fell onto a table. The worker suffered a lacerated liver and a breathing problem.
While trying to lower and move a loaded pallet jack, an employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were attempting to light flat-top grill pilot lights with long butane lighters when a burst of flame from the grill burned the employees. They were both hospitalized.
An employee was washing out a pole when an electrical contractor dropped a primary/high voltage line onto the employee's left shoulder area, resulting in an electrocution.
An employee was using a disc grinder to grind off the legs of a bracket. The grinder kicked back and lacerated the employee's left leg above the knee.

An employee was washing his hands when he reached up to grab a piece of ceramic steel. At that time, he bumped a knife pouch, resulting in the knife coming out and poking/lacerating him on the right hand above the wrist.
An employee was in a client's home carrying a flower pot down stairs when the employee tripped and fell, fracturing the left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a band saw when his right ring finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck by a falling piece of plywood while cleaning a work surface, resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle finger.

An employee was working with a wood production scanner when a board jammed in the machine. When the jam was cleared, the board moved and the employee's hand was drawn into the machine. The employee suffered an avulsion to her right index finger and a broken right thumb.
An employee was walking down stairs and fell, fracturing a leg.
An employee was walking on the bridge deck when he fell approximately 16 feet and landed on concrete panels. He suffered left-side rib fractures and fractures to the lower lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was positioning a piece of angle iron on a concrete pad when the angle iron fell off the concrete pad and struck his right leg, breaking it.

An employee was operating a stand-up counterbalanced forklift and was attempting to push a stack of empty pallets using the rear, passenger compartment side of the forklift. As the pallets were being pushed, they became lodged between a rack and the forklift, causing the wooden pallets to break. Pieces of a broken pallet entered the passenger compartment of the forklift and struck the employee in the left leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula.
An employee was descending a scaffold ladder when the employee missed a rung and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, breaking a leg.
An employee was shocked while doing electrical work and fell from a ladder. The employee suffered fractures to the shoulder, tailbone, and ribs on the left side.

An employee was operating a transfer pump on a drilling rig. The employee removed the dog ear on the cam lock fitting on the suction side hose to unpack the pump. Water base was released from the pump fitting onto his right forearm, causing third-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee fell through an open false-floor panel in a mausoleum, landing on a granite and concrete floor 10-12 feet below. He suffered a head concussion/laceration, cracked vertebrae, and strained ligaments in his right knee.
An employee was removing a drive pin from a transmission on a conveyor belt system. The pallet the transmission was on smashed her left index finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was loading a piece of equipment into a trailer. A piece of freight struck the employee's head, causing a laceration and a cut on the ear.
An employee was pushing a bagel rack into a walk-in cooler. The employee's shin was cut by the rack and became infected.

A concrete structure became stuck inside a concrete form, and a maintenance employee was called in to remove the tilt doors to enable the concrete structure to be removed from the form. The employee was removing a pin from the form tilt door when the door fell and landed on his leg, dislocating his right knee.

After practicing shooting at a firing range, a public safety officer started to dismantle the gun. A round was still chambered and the weapon discharged, shooting the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was at a client's home when she tripped over his cane and broke her arm. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was installing gutters on the ridge of a residential building. The employee fell off the roof, suffering a broken pelvis. No fall protection system was in place at the time of the incident.

An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder repairing a glass panel over the boards in a hockey rink when he fell from the ladder to the skating rink ice. He lost consciousness and suffered a concussion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was triaging machines when a forklift ran over and fractured the employee's right foot.
An employee was scouting deer in a deer blind and began having chest pains. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack.
An employee was attempting to unjam a pill from a pre-forming machine when the machine amputated the employee's left thumb and index finger.

An employee was pulling a patient in a wheelchair through a door when the patient resisted by holding onto the door frame. The patient became combative and in the struggle, the employee fell down and hit her head on the floor, suffering a concussion.

An employee was hanging plywood to the exterior of an apartment building. The employee was straddling a guardrail and was leaning past it when it swung outwards and the employee fell approximately 11 feet out of a wall opening onto a concrete patio. The employee was wearing a harness and a lifeline, but it failed to arrest his fall. Both of the employee's knees were fractured and his chin and right hand were lacerated.
An employee was struck by a steel beam, suffering a fracture to the left ankle/foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was inserting the final bolt to install a 1,000-pound electrical substation switch on a metal frame. The switch was supported by a magnetic lifting device, which released the switch; it dropped about 2 inches and pinched the employee's left hand against the metal frame. The employee suffered injuries requiring surgery: two broken bones in the hand and lacerations to the index finger and thumb.
An employee was using an aerial lift to change lights in the garden center and fell from the lift sustaining a broken shoulder, pelvis, and leg as well as facial fractures.

An employee was transferring a steel mold plate from one work bench to another using an overhead hoist when the mold plate already on the work table began to fall/tip over. As he tried to catch the plate, it crushed his right hand.
An employee was offloading hydrochloric acid (15% concentration) when the employee was sprayed in the face, suffering acid burns to the face and eyes.
An employee was welding a metal container when a spark ignited a cylinder of hydraulic fluid, causing a flash fire. The employee suffered burns to his face and the left side of his body.

On 10/12/18, an employee was moving a large loom that was mounted to a table on iron caster wheels when one of the caster wheels broke, causing the loom to tip forward and strike the employee's chest. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting on top of a scissor lift platform that was extended 19 feet when the lift went over a ramp incline and became unstable, tipping over. The employee impacted the ground, suffering broken ribs and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift down an aisle. While he was trying to stop, his left foot and toes were crushed between his forklift and another, parked one. He was hospitalized.
An employee was checking an HVAC control reading at a unit when he tripped over gas line piping and braced himself for the fall, fracturing both wrists.
An employee was climbing on a 10- to 15-foot roof to inspect it for claim damages when he slipped and fell to the ground, suffering bone fractures.
An employee was unjamming a machine and suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger and thumb. The machine was guarded at the time.
On October 13, 2018, an employee was cleaning a wall when the employee's right little finger struck a sharp corner, suffering a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a vehicle and was hospitalized.

A crew was coming out of a rig hole with tubing when the air backup on the tubing tongs slipped and bumped the injured employee, knocking him over a hand rail of the rig floor. He fell 6 to 7 feet head first, lacerating his forehead and breaking his left eye socket. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing roller pins from a tray with a hammer when an automated piece of manufacturing line equipment was activated by a sensor and caught the employee's lower left leg between steel components. The equipment continued to press down, causing a compound fracture of the lower left leg above the ankle but below the midpoint of the shin.

An employee was repairing a car's air conditioning unit and checking the tension on the serpentine belt when his hand got caught in the moving belt, causing lacerations and bruises to his right hand and index finger. He was hospitalized and had surgery. The car was running at the time of the incident.

An employee and a coworker were moving an aluminum extrusion weighing approximately 43 pounds when the coworker dropped his end. The employee's right middle finger was inside the extrusion at the time and suffered an avulsion that required surgical amputation.
An employee was walking on an uneven surface when she slipped and fell on wet grass, breaking her right foot and ankle in three places. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was helping to correct the tiedown straps on a palletized load on a flatbed trailer with multiple fixed ladders when the third fixed ladder slammed down onto both his right and left hands. His left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle, an his right index and middle fingers were lacerated.

An employee was sitting at the reception area when a resident asked for help. She stood up and her right foot became tangled with her left foot, causing her to fall to the floor and fracture her left hip.
An employee was walking alongside a hayride cart when she was run over by the cart's wheel, suffering a broken femur.
An employee suffered from smoke inhalation while troubleshooting an electrical fire.
While installing a new roof on a facility under construction, an employee fell to the lower level and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was descending the mobile staircase after removing an oil heater from storage. She missed a step and fell to the ground resulting in a broken hip and femur.

An employee was carrying branches and brush to a chipper machine when the employee was struck by a dead tree that fell over, suffering spinal fractures and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to cut yarn from a shaft twister machine when his glove was caught on the rotating shaft, resulting in a left thumb amputation to the first joint. The machine was unguarded and not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down a driveway to deliver mail when the employee slipped in a puddle and fell, breaking the left leg.

An employee was patrolling on a horse when the horse stumbled and fell. The employee fell with the horse, striking his face, shoulder, and arm on the ground. He was hospitalized with facial fractures.

A bucket in a drag conveyor came loose and fell to the bottom of the drag conveyor. A temporary employee was attempting to retrieve the bucket when the drag conveyor energized, pulling the temporary employee's left arm into the conveyor and amputating it at the elbow.
Two employees were engaged in arm wrestling when one of the employees sustained a compound fracture of the right arm requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating an iron roughneck while moving drill pipes when a pipe struck his fingers against the iron roughneck's control box, resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring fingertip. The employee's hand was outside the equipment at the time of the incident.

On 10/14/2018, an employee was securing a container to be loaded with a crane. When the crane lifted the load, he was hit by the bottom container and fell 10 feet, suffering a facial fracture, broken arm, internal bleeding, and a fractured spine. Some of the connectors were not connected correctly at the time of the incident.
An employee's foot was run over by a forklift.

An employee was leading a horse from the field to the barn when the horse got away from him. He left the horse in the field to calm down. While he was closing the metal gate (8 feet wide and 4.5 feet high), the horse ran towards the gate and pulled it off its hinges. The gate fell on top of him and the horse ran on top of the gate and the employee. He suffered a brain injury and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in the store parking lot helping a customer load a trailer when the trailer hitch broke and rolled back, striking his left leg. He was hospitalized with a broken left leg.

Two journeymen were tasked with operating the capstan and guiding the spider rope on the drum.
