The injured employee was operating the capstan controls and the second lineman was guiding the spider rope onto the drum utilizing a fiberglass rod. While pulling in the spider rope, it became taught when a roller failed causing the fiberglass rod to come out of the second lineman's hands and strike the capstan operator in the right hip. The injured employee suffered a right leg laceration and a fractured iliac bone requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was run over by a forklift that he was directing, suffering a left leg injury.

An employee was working in an excavation to install a new water line. The employee was cutting an existing steel pipe with a cut-off saw when the pipe broke and caused the saw to kick back. The saw blade contacted and lacerated the employee's neck, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was guiding a stay rod onto the body of an isolation tool when his left thumb was crushed between the tool and the stay rod, resulting in an amputation to his thumb.
An employee's left thumb was caught between a lift truck mast and the side of the truck, resulting in a partial left thumb tip amputation.
An employee was installing duct work from a 10-foot A-frame ladder when wind blew plywood over, knocking the employee off the ladder. The employee sustained a fracture injury.

An employee was on the fourth step of a 10-foot ladder installing wood blocking over an exterior doorway when he lost his footing and fell to the ground, hitting it face first. He suffered a broken nose and back injury.

An employee was getting ready to bypass a transformer to install a new line pole when the employee clipped the bypass lead onto the center power line and created a short circuit. An arc flash occurred, causing burns to the employee's face and neck.
An employee was cutting plywood with a handheld circular saw when it kicked back and lacerated his upper left thigh.
An employee was loading a crane onto a transport vehicle (low boy). The employee jumped down from the exit area of the crane and rolled his right ankle fracturing it.
After completing roofing work, an employee experienced headaches, cramps, and vomiting, requiring hospitalization for kidney failure.

An employee was attempting to retrieve a piece of strap lumber from the edger un-scrambler machine when his left gloved hand came into contact with the end rolls' drive chain and sprocket. As a result, he sustained an amputation of the left ring finger, partial amputation of the left pinky finger, and laceration of the left middle finger.

On October 15, 2018, at approximately 6:30 PM, an employee was loading a product roll when the roll fell and clipped the employee. The employee suffered a deep laceration on the left thigh, requiring stitches and hospitalization.

An employee was operating a horizontal broaching machine to cut two metal parts when his index finger was caught between the two parts, resulting in an amputation between the first and second knuckle.

On October 15, 2018, at approximately 7:25 a.m., an employee was walking into a freezer when the employee slipped on some cardboard and fell to the floor, breaking the right arm. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was manually stuffing a tote liner inside the torn opening of a sack full of peanuts that was positioned on a pallet on the ground when another sack stacked on top of the sack the employee was stuffing fell on and pinned him against the ground. He sustained a right ankle fracture and lumbar (L5) vertebrae fracture.

An employee reached into a truck with his foot to press the clutch down and start the truck. When he took his foot off the clutch, the vehicle started to move in reverse and he fell to the ground. The truck then ran over the employee, causing a pelvic fracture.

An employee was draining a cylinder supported by an overhead crane when the middle tube of the cylinder slid down and trapped her fingers. She was hospitalized with possible amputations to two fingers on her right hand.
An employee was loading H braces onto a truck when one of the H braces fell from the upright position and struck his right leg, causing a fibula fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration after not feeling well at the end of his shift.

An employee was standing on a machine table 25 inches off the floor tightening bolts. The employee attempted to step down from the machine table and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a chain on a forklift when his finger was caught between the mast guard and the vise grip hand tool, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking from his workstation when he tripped on a sling and fell to the ground. He tried to break his fall and broke his right wrist, requiring hospitalization.
On October 15, 2018, an employee was welding a rack when the employee's clothing caught fire. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the chest, three right-hand fingers, and left arm.
An employee was bitten by a black widow spider requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a hernia while removing a 19-pound strut from a rack, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee and a foreman were removing a steel walkway door when the door closed on the employee's finger, smashing it and causing a soft tissue amputation under the fingernail (fingernail still attached).
An employee was mowing the lawn when the mower caught a silt fence, pulling the stakes out of the ground. A wooden stake then struck his face, causing a burn.
An employee was making beds in a room at a senior living facility when she tripped over the corner of a bed, causing her to fall to the floor. She suffered a dislocated and fractured right shoulder.

Four Turner employees were working to remove discharge piping to make modifications. While removing the piping from pumps, the crew placed the pipe (approximately 300 lbs.) onto a cart. It rolled unexpectedly and pinched an employee's left ring finger between it and the cart rail, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's finger was amputated while removing a stuck piece of lumber from a chipper machine.

An employee was activating a barring system to lock in the position on a hyper compressor and conduct preventative maintenance when the employee's right ring finger was crushed between the barring system and the fly wheel, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was working on the roof bringing down materials to the ground floor. Afterwards, he went to the tent area to take a break and was abnormally fatigued, requiring hospitalization for dehydration and a muscle injury.

An employee was preparing a die to be lifted with a forklift while a second employee was positioning the forklift to pick up the die. The second employee crushed the first employee between a rack and the forklift while moving it into position. The first employee suffered multiple rib fractures on both sides.
An employee was walking on a level hallway surface inside an office building when she collided with another employee and fell to the floor on her hip area. She fractured her hip and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was bailing scrap wire. The bailer operates by pulling the wire into the machine and winding the wire. The bailer was operating in automatic mode while the temporary employee used their right foot to guide the wire into the bailing machine. The employee's shoe lace was then snagged by the wire, pulling the temporary employee into the bailing machine. The employee suffered fractures to the right leg below the knee.

An employee was loading canopy deck pans onto a truck and placing cardboard spacers between the canopies to protect the surface. In order to place the spacers, he was standing on the canopy deck pans. His right foot became caught on the edge of a deck pan, causing him to lose his balance. He then fell approximately 10 feet onto the gravel parking/loading area, fracturing his left arm, breaking several ribs, and bruising his left hip.
An employee was getting up from a chair at a lunch room table when he tripped on the chair, lost his balance, and fell, fracturing his right hip.

On October 16, 2018, at 1:15 PM, an employee was building a small roof attached to another building and was setting rafters when one of the rafters started to fall. The employee attempted to grab the rafter and fell head-first about 9 feet, 6 inches, to the concrete below. The employee was hospitalized with a cut on the head, bruises on the chest, and fractured vertebrae.

An employee was performing a test on a diesel fuel tank that is 10 feet high. He used an extension ladder to reach the top of the tank. While descending the ladder, he fell 9 feet to the ground and struck his head, suffering a concussion and skull fracture. The ladder was not tied off at the time of the incident.

An employee was on a ladder checking security cameras at the front of a building when the employee fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transporting a large roll of plastic via hand cart. The hand cart had a vertical pole that struck an overhead piece of equipment, causing the employee's right hand to become caught between the pole and the cart frame. When the employee attempted to removed the hand, the ring and middle fingers were de-gloved. The fingers were later medically amputated.

An employee was descending a wooden electrical pole line with his climbing belt, pull strap, climbing boots, and spikes. He unbelted in order to climb below the telephone lines. While he was putting his climbing belt back on with the pull strap, his spikes lost contact with the wooden pole, causing him to fall 20 feet to the ground and fracture both hips. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lowering a plow attached to a forklift with a steel cable. The cable failed and the employee's left pinky finger was crushed between the plow and a fork. The finger was amputated below the fingernail at the first joint.

An employee was exiting the bucket of an aerial lift truck when his foot missed the step, causing him to lose his grip and fall about 8 feet to the ground. He struck his head on the rear outrigger of the truck, suffering a broken C1 vertebra, torn vertebra ligaments, a skull fracture, and two broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning his work area when his finger was smashed in a pneumatic vice press, causing a laceration on his right index finger.
An employee's right hand was caught between two magnets during a cleaning operation, causing tendon damage.
An employee tripped over the lower chain at the loading dock and fell resulting in a contusion and laceration on the head.

An employee was pouring cement into a foundation form when he was struck by the cement pump truck dispensing arm, causing him to fall approximately 7 feet to the lower working surface. He suffered facial, neck, and head injuries.
An employee was operating a standup forklift and was pinned between the steering wheel and rack while going around a corner, suffering three cracked ribs, a punctured lung, and a ruptured spleen.
An employee tripped and fell into a wall, fracturing her left arm.

On October 16, 2018, at 3:45 PM, a temporary employee reached through the mast to scan a pallet that was on the forks of a powered industrial truck. While the employee was leaning forward to scan the pallet, the lift mast was engaged, crushing the employee's hand between the mast and fixed point of the lift and breaking bones.
An employee was cleaning a kettle pump when his hand entered the pump inlet, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.

An employee was cleaning a meat grinder machine when his right index finger slipped into the faceplate hole and was struck by the screw drive mixing blade, resulting in an amputation of the first finger digit.

On October 16, 2018, an employee was using a ladder to retrieve a box of crab legs from the freezer area when the employee lost balance and fell from the ladder, suffering a broken right wrist that required hospitalization.
An employee fell off the side of a vacuum truck while putting his belongings in the cab. He struck another truck before hitting the ground, suffering fractured lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was crushed between two sections of corrugated pipes being pushed by a loader, suffering a cracked pelvis, bruised spleen, and broken tailbone.

An employee was handling a racking board section. When the employee knocked a pin out of the racking board section, the racking board fell and hit the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a dislocated hip and fractured pelvis, requiring hospitalization. The racking board was not properly tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a machine when the hydraulic clamp initiated, causing an injury to the employee's left ring finger that resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee received an electric shock and arc flash burns to the hands and neck while pulling cable.
An employee was moving a ketchup box that weighed 42 pounds when he suffered a musculoskeletal injury in his back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a truck when an unoccupied forklift rolled into him, striking him in the back. He suffered injuries to the back and pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a vendor unload material from a truck when the material shifted and fell on the employee, causing a right tibia fracture.

On October 16, 2018, an employee was walking through the parking lot when she jumped over a 54-inch-wide drainage ditch and slipped on landing, breaking two bones in her lower leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was administering a breathing session when the employee tripped over oxygen tubing and hit the floor, fracturing the area right below the right hip (trochanter).
An employee was climbing metal, diamond plated stairs when his foot slipped and he fell into the railing causing a hematoma to the left waist area.
An employee was trying to re-light the pilot light on a combustor. It failed to ignite, then ignited when the door to the box was opened. A flash fire burned the employee's hands and face.

An employee was cutting a piece of angle iron with a horizontal fixed-stand band saw when the employee's left index finger entered the point of operation. The blade then amputated the employee's left index fingertip just below the cuticle.

An employee was on break in his vehicle and had taken his handgun out of his glove box and placed it onto his left thigh/leg. When he was putting the gun back in the glove box, it fired. He was hit in his left thigh, and the bullet exited through his left knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a steel bar when a hopper gate fell on the employee's head, causing fractures.
An employee was on site cutting down a line of trees with a chainsaw when a branch struck his head, causing head trauma. Personal protective equipment was worn at the time.
An employee was conducting an inspection in a single family home's attic when he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below, fracturing one of his middle vertebrae.
A temporary employee tripped over the forks of a forklift and fell backwards, hitting her head on the concrete and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was binding cardboard totes near the beehive equipment. He fell and contacted moving parts within the equipment sustaining a left index finger amputation.
An employee had just pried up a sewer cover using a pick when it fell onto his right hand, resulting in amputation of his index fingertip.
An employee was stung by a wasp or bee while emptying garbage into a dumpster, suffering swelling on the back of the neck.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw when the saw blade cut off the employee's right middle fingertip (no bone loss).

On October 17, 2018, at approximately 1:40 PM, an employee was straddling a truss approximately 16 feet above the ground and cutting the top off the post with a chainsaw. As he made the cut, the chainsaw cut into his right leg above the knee, requiring hospitalization.

A forklift operator was unloading building materials when the forklift got off balance and the operator struck his head on the forklift cage. The employee was hospitalized and received stitches on his head. The operator was not wearing a seat belt at the time.
An employee was conducting maintenance activities on solids control equipment when his right hand was caught in the equipment's grinder, resulting in the amputation of his right-hand fingers.
An employee was working on duct work when a piece of duct dislodged and struck the employee's arm.

An employee was putting a piece of decking on the 8-foot roof of a new construction residential home when he fell off the roof and hit the dirt below. He suffered a broken wrist and fracture below his eye, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a paper bag machine when his right middle finger was caught between the machine's frame and pusher arm, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was doing formwork when he moved and struck a horizontal rebar near his right eye. He suffered a laceration to his right eye that caused significant swelling, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on a hot press in a semi-metallic area when the shoe became stuck between the insert and side of the box. He was attempting to release the shoe with a pry bar when his glove was pulled into the box, resulting in a left index finger amputation.

An employee was operating a concrete dumper to transport soil to a bike/walking trail when the concrete dumper rolled over, pinning him underneath. He suffered a broken left arm and several lacerations to the face.
An employee was struck by a wire reel that was being dragged by a pick-up truck, suffering two fractured legs.
A temporary employee was reaching for a part when his left forearm was lacerated by a horizontal blade saw. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped and fell resulting in a cracked kneecap.

An employee was installing a gas shock on the lid of a large box in the dress-out area. The box requires two shocks and after installation of the first shock, another employee asked the injured employee to move the box that he was working on. The injured employee was in the process of moving the box when the lid closed and caught his hand between the lid and the box frame. The employee suffered an open left thumb distal phalanx fracture with a nailbed injury.

An employee was troubleshooting an ammunition handle box press machine. He was attempting to use a pair of plyers to remove a stuck part in the die when his right hand was caught between the upper die and the stripper sensor. He sustained a laceration and fracture to the fifth metacarpal on his right hand. The press was running and unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was getting ready to empty a 30-yard dumpster and was opening the back door when plywood fell off and struck his left ankle. He was hospitalized with a broken left ankle, requiring surgery.

An employee was standing next to a hot, metal plate when his cotton shirt caught on fire from the metal plate. The employee sustained third degree burns to the stomach and chest and second degree burns to the left arm.
An employee was hospitalized for anaphylactic shock after being exposed to cashew nuts while preparing to assist with a case in the cardiac catheterization lab.

An employee was trying to retrieve concrete blankets that blew out of a truck on the highway when the employee was struck by another vehicle, suffering a fractured right ulna and humerus. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing scrap from the die of a press when the die cycled and sheered off the tip of his left thumb up to his first knuckle.
An employee's arm and hand were caught in a conveyor, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting steel with an oxygen/acetylene torch. The hose of the oxygen line had a small hole that caused a small fire to burst while he cut the steel. His polyester jacket melted from the fire, and he received second degree burns to his right arm.
An employee suffered a heart attack while working in the cooler.

An employee was standing next to his forklift when another forklift turned a corner and struck his forklift, causing it to roll over his left foot. Two toes on the left foot (big toe and adjacent toe) were surgically removed.
An employee was delivering parts at a customer location when he tripped on a mat and fell to the ground, breaking his elbow and shoulder.
An employee was using a nail gun and injected a nail into his wrist.

An employee was visually inspecting the liner plates. While conducting the inspection, the employee's gloved right hand was caught in the machine roller resulting in a crushing injury to the hand. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was on a 24-foot ladder that was not fully extended, hooking up a new electrical connection, when he fell approximately 6 to 10 feet backwards off the ladder and landed on a generator below. He dislocated his left elbow and broke four ribs and four spinal tips. He was hospitalized.

On October 17, 2019, at 9:50 a.m., an employee was clearing soft condiment from a blocked pipe on a displacement pump when his left index finger contacted the moving propellers inside the pipe, amputating his fingertip. The equipment was not de-energized and locked out at the time of the incident.
On October 17, 2018, an employee experienced an allergic reaction to the flu vaccine administered earlier that day during a hospital-sponsored flu clinic.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, suffering a spinal contusion.

An employee was working on the conveyor of a chocolate line when her right hand entered the exit port of the chocolate tank. The paddles of the agitator then rotated and amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was stepping down from a rolling scaffold when the employee lost balance and fell to the ground, fracturing the left hip.

An employee was on the back side of a knot saw when he bent over to pick something up. He then placed his left hand on the top of the saw and reached over the saw with his right hand. As he reached across the saw, he pressed down on the top and his left hand slid over the blade, resulting in the amputation of his left index and ring fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee was troubleshooting equipment when the employee's left index finger was caught in a chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

Employees were attempting to lift a trailer with a forklift when the trailer slipped off the forks and fell on a stand underneath. The stand kicked out and hit the employee, causing a head injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was on the shoulder of a highway unloading boxes from the bed of a material truck when a parked stripe truck rolled approximately 75 feet across the highway, side-swiped the material truck, and hit the employee. The employee's lower left leg was fractured in multiple locations with multiple lacerations.

An employee was setting up to put tires on a trailer. The trailer was jacked up and he was putting jack stands under the front axle when the trailer bags released and the trailer dropped down, crushing his right index finger between the axle and the jack stand. His fingertip was amputated.
An employee sustained a left ring fingertip amputation while opening a hydraulic tank.
An employee was removing a bolt cluster ring from a concrete foundation when he slipped on gravel and the ring struck his lower leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped as he was exiting his tractor and fell to the ground, striking his left elbow against the pavement. His left elbow fractured.
An employee tripped over the forks of a stand-up forklift and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury that required hospitalization.
An employee's finger was clamped between a forming plate and a field box, causing an amputation of the fingertip.

On October 18, 2018, an employee was attempting to put down a dock plate when the employee's right middle fingertip was crushed between the dock plate and the dock, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was laying down tubing. He reached to unlatch the tubing elevator with his right hand and his right index finger was caught between the joint of the elevator and the joint of the tubing. His finger was amputated just above the second knuckle, and he was hospitalized.

An employee was moving cattle from a staging area into a horseshoe for slaughter. He was on top of a closed gate when a cow moved the gate. He lost his balance and fell about 5 feet to the concrete pad below, landing on his right arm and breaking his right wrist.

An employee was un-hooking a strap from tank containers while standing on the fourth step of an A-frame ladder when the ladder collapsed and the employee fell to the ground below, landing on his right leg. He was hospitalized with a broken right ankle.

At approximately 2:00 p.m., on October 18, 2018, an employee moved a recreational vehicle, exited it, and then walked in front of the vehicle. The vehicle was not in park at the time and it rolled over the employee, causing trauma to her lower torso and legs. She was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a pump that was extracting slurry material from a tank. When the employee removed the pump's discharge hose, slurry material splashed and burned the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was on a ladder cleaning a transfer when the employee slipped off the ladder and caught an arm in a pusher chain. The employee suffered a left triceps injury.
A crane was carrying a load when its handle was bumped, causing the crane to release the load. The load dropped onto the injured employee's finger, crushing it and later resulting in an amputation.
An employee was placing roofing supplies on a roof when he lost his footing and slid approximately 12 feet off the roof to the ground, dislocating his right ankle.

On October 18, 2018, at approximately 2:50 PM, an employee was traveling from the locker room and through the warehouse area when he tripped over a pallet and fell on his right knee. He fractured the right kneecap and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was on a 1-ton flatbed truck moving a piece of equipment when he fell approximately 4 feet off the flatbed truck and struck the ground, suffering a head injury and fractured pelvis. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee saw another employee using a power drill with a wobbling drill bit. The employee was attempting to adjust it with his gloved hand on the chuck when the drill turned on. His right middle finger was caught in the rotating chuck, causing a fingertip avulsion.

An employee was pulling a wheeled rack in a holding cooler when one of his left-hand fingers was caught and crushed between the rack he was pulling and another rack, later resulting in a surgical amputation.
An employee was operating a lathe machine when the metal bar became loose and hit the employee's jaw. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was adjusting a part in the vertical molding machine when the piston of the machine came down on the left index finger resulting in amputation of the finger.
An employee was walking through the welding department when the employee tripped on cords and fell, fracturing the left hip.
An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot at the end of his shift, fell and fractured his wrist.
An employee was walking down the stairs when the heel of their boot caught on the step and the employee fell down five stairs to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken collar bone.
An employee was driving a motorized cart when she impacted a wall. Her leg was caught between the cart and the wall, causing a severe laceration to her right leg.
An employee was helping to secure materials on a truck when a tie-down strap flew back and hit the employee's head above the right eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was checking a machine and opened the top access where the gears are located. The machine was jogged and caught the employee's right index finger in the gear resulting in surgical amputation.
An employee fell off a ladder onto the floor and injured her left hip and right arm.
An employee was cleaning up the recycling area and was walking backwards when he was struck by a mini-loader. The employee fell and the loader ran over his left foot, fracturing it.
An employee took a misstep while delivering mail, suffering a fractured left ankle that required hospitalization.
An employee was helping to move an open pallet of goods when the pallet shifted and the load began to fall. The employee injured his right hip while trying to steady the load.

An employee was using a power washer mounted on a flatbed truck to clean up a grease spill. When the employee started to add fuel to the power washer, a flash fire occurred and he received first degree burns to the face, second degree burns to the left forearm, and third degree burns to the elbow.

A maintenance employee was performing a repair on the door of a rubber mixer.  He was adjusting the limit switch under the machine. When he attempted to climb out from under the mixer, his hand was caught in the rotor. The machine cycled and three fingers on his left hand were amputated.

An overhead crane was being used with a four leg chain to assist in opening a door to a precast form. The hooks from the rigging equipment were attached to the side of the form. As the crane trolley traversed to the side, the trolley made it to its maximum allowed distance. The crane operator stopped operating at that time. A second employee saw the rigging go slack and placed his hand on the hook to remove it from the form. As he had the hook in his hand, the trolley moved back towards the center on its own while the employee s hand was still on the hook. His middle finger was smashed between the hook and the form, amputating his middle fingertip from the middle of the fingernail to the tip.

On 10/18/2018, at 8:25 AM, an employee experienced back pain while bending over to pick up material from floor level. He had been purging material from an extruder onto poly sheeting placed on the floor. The back pain caused him to sit on the floor, and he was unable to stand up on his own. He was hospitalized with lower disc inflammation.
An employee was removing dough that was stuck inside a machine. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated when the blade activated.

An employee was attempting to relight a pilot light on a customer's hot water heater when the unit flashed, causing a propane blowback into the employee's face that knocked off his safety glasses and caused a possible injury to his eyes.
An employee was attempting to clear scrap wood from a web saw's catch tray when the employee made contact with the saw blade, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was repairing a front rubber bumper on a vessel when the rubber bumper came loose, striking the scaffold the employee was standing on. The employee fell approximately 6 feet to the ground with a torch in hand and was burned on the left upper thigh and upper left neck.
An employee was cleaning hospital rooms when she slipped on an unknown fluid and fell to the floor, fracturing her femur.

An employee was descending from a two-step ladder. He was holding onto a core sampler when his right middle and ring fingers entered a 2" gap between a hydraulic pipe. A tube then came down and amputated his two fingertips.

An employee was putting down a roof deck when he lost his footing, tripped, and fell on the deck (same level), suffering spiral fractures to both bones in the lower right leg. Fall protection was worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was stung by a bee and had a severe allergic reaction, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a ladder to install roofing flashing when the ladder slipped out from beneath him. He was hospitalized with a broken rib.
An employee was retrieving a log from a bundle of wood logs that was stacked high. The employee was struck by a log and sustained right leg fractures.
An employee was riding as a passenger in a utility vehicle (UTV) when the driver made a sharp turn and the UTV rolled on its side. The employee suffered a fractured right leg.
An employee was delivering mail when she tripped over screws/rods sticking out of the ground and landed on the ground, dislocating her right elbow.

An employee was struck by a nail that ricocheted from another employee's nail gun. The nail struck his eyebrow and went behind his glasses and under his hard hat. The nail did not hit his eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was placing wings between separators feeding a wing segmenter machine when her left pointer finger was caught between the edge of the manufacturer's guard and the top of one of the separators, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was attempting to insert the lock pin when the machine started and crushed the tips of his middle and ring fingers resulting in an amputation injury to a finger.
An employee was guiding a truck out a refining unit when the employee bent over to pick up an 8-inch hose and was struck by a vehicle, suffering a broken left heel.

An employee was sitting in her office chair when she bent over to pick something up from the floor. The chair slipped out from beneath her and she fell to the ground, fracturing her right hip and suffering contusions to her head and elbow. She was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to push a cart of medicine for distribution when she was pushed by a client/individual and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell and struck their head while checking a semi load, suffering a head laceration and possible concussion.
An employee was installing a new bar grating machine when his right thumb was caught and broke between the rods of the machine.

An employee was adjusting the chuck jaws of a vertical mill so the material would fit and was placing a 24" flange into the chuck of the mill. While she was removing the sling strap, the piece slipped and caught her right-hand first fingertip at the base of the nailbed between the material and chuck jaw, resulting in an amputation of her fingertip.
An employee was preparing a molten metal alloy mix to pour a sample for quality testing when the alloy exploded, causing second and third degree burns to the back of his neck, arms, and legs.
An employee was walking on a conveyor belt when he fell and twisted his ankle.
An employee was moving product using a crane when he became caught between his suspended load and a fixed object, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was climbing down from a portable manlift when the cage area he was holding onto collapsed and he fell about 6 feet to the floor, breaking his wrist and pelvis. He was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting in the setup of a crane with a fixed jib. As he was handling a tag line, the load moved quickly. When he grabbed the rope, it wrapped around his right middle finger and broke it, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting a cut and square machine which has two functions. First it compresses the ends of a flexible wire into a square and then cuts it into 36-inch segments. It uses two grinding wheels driven by a set of gears to cut the segments. The employee was checking the grinding wheels when the wheels activated and pinched his left hand in the gears. The employee's left middle finger was amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was working from an extension ladder to hang drapes on second-floor level windows when he transferred from the ladder to a small plywood ledge. The ledge gave way and he fell backwards, landing on top of a folding table. The table then broke and the employee landed on the floor. His tape measurer was on his belt and it impacted his lower spine. He was hospitalized with a fractured coccyx.
An employee was filling orders using an order picker machine when his left leg was caught between the equipment and a rack, breaking bones.
An employee was crossing the road to retrieve flagger signs when the employee tripped and fell to the road surface, fracturing the left forearm and wrist.
An employee tripped over another employee's foot and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured right hip.
On 10/19/2018 at 6:30 PM, an employee was trying to pick up a box when he fell over and hit his hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was working with a crew to move a drum cutter from a line. While the crew was tugging on the machine, the employee's right middle finger entered a hole in the area the employee had grasped to pull. The employee's right middle fingertip was then amputated at the nailbed by the pulling or rocking movement. The hole was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a hand drill while building a pallet when her finger was caught in the chuck of the drill, resulting in a possible break or amputation.

An employee was clearing a jam in an air filtration system when another employee re-energized the machine without realizing the injured employee was still working inside it. The blades activated and amputated four fingers of the employee's left hand.

An employee was stacking trusses for shipping. He pushed a truss toward a press and was standing between the truss and press when the back/bottom edge of the truss struck his legs, knocking him forward. He then fell back onto the truss, which allowed his right foot to become caught in the press rollers. His lower right leg and foot were crushed.

An employee was monitoring a plating tank when the employee tried to retrieve a part that fell into the tank. The employee came in contact with the plating solution (hexavalent chromium) and suffered an infection.

A temporary employee was inside a portable toilet as other temporary employees were steam spraying a pipe when a welding rod shot out from the pipe and penetrated the portable toilet, striking the employee in the abdomen. She was hospitalized and required stitches.
An employee's fingertip was amputated while installing racking for a solar system.
An employee was driving a school bus on a field trip. At a stop, he tripped on a curb and impacted the ground, fracturing his wrist and ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting an 8-foot-long vertical section of an 18-inch-diameter pipe with an oxygen and propane torch when the pipe twisted and fell on his foot after the final cut. His right foot was de-gloved, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading corn from a dump bin attached to a skid loader. He was standing at the back of the dump bin and pushing it upward to get it to dump its contents. As he pushed up, his left hand was placed between the fork and base of the dumpster. The base then lifted up, shifted, and came down and pinched his left fingertip. As he pulled his hand away, his fingertip was amputated.

An employee was manually moving a belt on a fan when his hand slipped and his left index finger was pulled between the belt and pulley of the motor, resulting in a partial amputation of the finger. The fan was locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was setting up a double tee in a storage section when his finger was caught and crushed between the double tee, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was inspecting a belt on a refrigeration unit when the unit started. His thumb was pulled into the belt/pulley system, causing a partial thumb amputation.
An employee was operating case packing machinery when her right index fingertip was caught in the machine and amputated.
An employee was helping to load a truck at a loading bay when he turned around and was struck by a reversing forklift, suffering a fractured ankle.

An employee was transferring from a blowout prevention structure to a man basket when he fell approximately 12 to 13 feet to the ground below, fracturing his pelvis and ribs. He was hospitalized. The employee's lanyard was untied at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down a step when the employee fell approximately 10 inches to the floor, breaking the left tibia.

An employee was moving dirty linen to the laundry room when her right hand entered the hinge side of the door as it was closing, catching her middle finger between the jam and the door. Her right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working in a ditch and was struck by a stolen vehicle. The employee sustained nose and lower back injuries.

An employee was unloading a trailer containing 600-pound rolls of roofing materials when a roll of material rolled off the trailer and struck his right leg, breaking his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was working on a procedure checklist at a splice table machine. His hand was on a bar support above the roll break when it was caught by the roll break and his fingers went into a small gap. His left ring finger was amputated up to half of the nail.
An employee was organizing merchandise on an upper shelf when she lost her balance and fell on her right hip, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was closing the door at the back of a trailer truck when the driver pulled away from the dock and the employee fell to the ground. He suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a mixer machine and was attempting to scrub the paddle inside the machine when the paddle cut half of his finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell from the back of a box truck to the ground, fracturing an arm.
An employee was operating a table saw when the blade cut his left index finger, causing an avulsion that resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was entering a building and pushed the door open with his foot when the door shut on his right lower arm, causing a contusion that required hospitalization.

An employee was getting down from a roof using a scissor lift when he fell 30 feet to the base of the lift scissor mechanism, suffering internal bleeding, kidney damage and multiple fractures to both legs that required hospitalization.

An employee was holding a bolt while another employee was operating an impact driver to install the bolt into a metal shredder. The employee's glove was caught by the bolt, causing a partial amputation of his left index finger.

An employee was rolling caution tape while walking backwards near a concrete manhole opening when he tripped and fell backwards into the open manhole, hitting his head on the concrete manhole rim. He suffered a skull fracture and bleeding in the brain.

An employee was directing an overhead crane from the ground. The employee noticed that the load did not appear to be rigged correctly. The load was brought back down by the crane operator. The employee was re-rigging the load and moved one of the 2x2 boards when her right middle finger was caught under the load. The weight of the load amputated a 1/4 inch of her fingertip.
An employee was riding a horse to perform pen moves when the horse became spooked and bucked the employee off. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was setting up a precast concrete bed when his finger was crushed between the sled and end of the precast bed, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a 200-pound part and fixture to be welded. As the part was lifted, it swung upright and the employee's left thumb was caught and crushed between the table and part, resulting in a medical amputation to the thumb tip above the knuckle.

An employee was installing a door rail into a drilling and dowel inserting machine when the employee attempted to adjust the position of a rail so it would be tight against the fence. At the same time, the machine was activated via the foot control and the employee's fingertip was pinched between the rail and hold-down clamp when it closed. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation (finger pad; no bone loss).

On October 20, 2018, employees were in the process of removing and replacing a telephone pole. As they prepped the area, the pole fell and struck an employee. She suffered vertebrae fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee lost footing while loading materials onto a truck and fell face first onto concrete, suffering a broken jaw.

An employee was unloading tables from a golf cart when a table fell, hit the power pedal, and launched the golf cart forward. The employee was pinned between the golf cart and a large appliance, suffering leg fractures that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was attaching an inspection onto a conveyor screw when a cooker gate opened and spilled hot oil that caused second degree burns to his neck and back.

An employee was performing maintenance to a conveyor screw system that contained a cooker with hot oil when the oil splashed his right arm and shoulder, causing second degree burns. The cooker was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee had her safety vest on and was using a walker stacker to pull down a pallet of bags from a steel rack. She backed up against a beam and the walker ran over her foot. Her foot became caught between steel and the walker, causing a compound fracture to the big and little toes. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a beef shank when the meat flipped and pulled his right finger into the band saw, amputating his right index finger at the first knuckle.
A terminated employee attacked another employee who was then hospitalized for a heart condition.
An employee was struck by a car when guiding it on and off an alignment lift.

On October 21, 2018, an employee was walking on a concrete roof when the employee tripped over a broom that was laying on the roof and fell to the same level surface. The employee suffered a broken right femur and required surgery.
An employee was hospitalized after falling off of a ladder.

An employee was oiling a chain and sprocket. He was attempting to brush some debris off of the machinery when his glove was caught in the sprocket, pulling his left hand into and around the sprocket. His left index, middle, and ring fingers were partially amputated.

An employee was using a pallet jack to pull cases in the freezer. He positioned the pallet jack close to the racking and dismounted it. The pallet jack then ran into his left ankle, fracturing it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
Employees were moving containers on tugs. An employee was connecting one dolly to another when the tongue of the dolly fell, resulting in an amputation of the employee's right ring fingertip.

On October 21, 2018, an employee was working with another employee to replace a low temperature hot water pump. When he went to disconnect the pump, the water sprayed on him, scalding his left arm and the left side of his torso. The water line to the pump was not turned off at the time of the incident.

An employee was riding on the side of a garbage truck when the employee's right foot became wedged between a small push cart and the truck. The employee felt pain in the lower leg, fell off the truck, and was unable to get up. The employee was hospitalized with a right ankle injury.

An employee was attempting to clear out bridged material from a support hopper in the compounding process. The employee opened the bottom of the hopper to insert a tool to break up the material. Upon clearing the jam, the slide gate closed while his hand was in the zone. The employee's middle fingertip on the right hand was pinched by the slide gate as he pulled his hand out, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On October 21, 2018, an employee's thumb was amputated by a hand tool/utensil.
An employee was troubleshooting equipment. The employee's hand was on the grounding of the equipment's static bar when static electricity discharged through the box and shocked the employee.

An employee was welding and repairing a grapple hook on a knuckle boom loader. The lift driver raised the grappler from the ground to reposition it so the employee could continue welding. The grappler then swung swiftly due to being attached to a come-a-long and struck the employee in the left ankle, fracturing and dislocating it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a pallet with a forklift. As he was turning, he backed into the rack behind him. This in turn pushed his body into the windshield of the forklift, causing it to break the glass protective screen, and his body bumped the forklift. He suffered lacerations to the left side of his face and fractured ribs.
An employee had an allergic reaction to cleaners used in the restroom.
While delivering a package, an employee missed a 2" to 3" step and fell, breaking the ankle in three different locations.
An employee was wiping excess grease from the clamp of a tube bender when the employee's left ring finger was caught in the clamp of the tube bender, resulting in a partial amputation.

A temporary employee was filling carts on a rail system with concrete. There were two carts on the system. His hand was on the front cart when a second cart was pushed into the first cart, pinching and smashing the employee's little finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning gutters on a residential home. He was working from a ladder and climbed onto the roof to reach a section that was beyond the reach of the ladder when he slipped and fell 20 feet from the roof to the concrete below. He suffered a head laceration, requiring hospitalization and staples.
An employee was sitting on a partially open tool box when the tool box lid closed on and pinched his left ring fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was mowing the back side of an apartment complex when he felt a sudden burning in his chest. He looked down and had a gun shot wound in his chest, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was flagging trucks into a job site when a pickup truck drove through the construction zone and struck the employee, who suffered two broken ribs and a bruised elbow.
An employee was standing behind a truck when a joint of pipe was pushed and landed on his ankle, causing him to fall and fracture his left ankle.

An employee was test driving/being trained on an ATV when he hit rough terrain. He was thrown from the ATV onto a hard, rocky terrain, breaking his right scapula and a right-side rib. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell 14 feet from a fixed ladder while climbing up to access the roof, hitting the ground below. He suffered two fractured ankles, a fractured pelvis, and other bruises and contusions.

While sorting packages on a conveyor, an employee attempted to push a loose bolt that came out of a package and became lodged between the roller's transition plate and incline conveyor belt when the conveyor pinched the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee's right ring fingertip was pinched between sections of an interlock belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The belt was unguarded at the time.

An employee was balancing 15 4x8, 3/4-inch-thick sheets of plywood while another employee attempted to remove one sheet from the stack. The sheets of plywood then slipped and fell onto the employee's left foot. He sustained fractures to four toes, the top of his foot, and possibly his left ankle.
An employee tripped over a pallet and fell on a concrete surface, suffering a fractured hip that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a saw to cut plastic boards when he made contact with the saw blade and sustained a laceration to his middle right finger, resulting in a partial amputation of his fingertip.
An employee was walking and carrying dialysis fluid when she opened a door and tripped over a scale. She fell, dislocating her left shoulder and fracturing her left arm.
An employee was helping another employee with a test rig tower when the splitter came out of gear and the metal tub came loose, falling and striking the employee on the head and arm.

An employee was cleaning under a label machine conveyor to remove labels that fell off a production line. As she attempted to pull a label that was stuck, her left ring and middle fingers were amputated at the distal phalanx.

An employee was backing a telehandler off of a dovetail trailer when the right rear tire rolled off the side of the trailer, causing the telehandler to roll over. The employee suffered head injuries, a broken clavicle, broken ribs, and two fractured vertebrae, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was moving toward the side of a bale press to pick up a cotton sample bag. The press pushed him and he was thrown to the floor. He suffered a pubic bone fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was doing general cleaning when he slipped on a piece of meat and lost his balance. As he attempted to catch his fall, his left middle fingertip was caught on the blade of a nearby deli slicer, resulting in a fingertip amputation (no bone loss),
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to something at the bank while processing day-to-day teller transactions, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing next to a steel road plate that was suspended and being moved by a backhoe. While in transit, the suspended road plate started swinging and struck the employee's right foot, which was then caught between the road plate and a concrete curb, resulting in the amputation of his toes.
An employee was operating a dough depositor machine when the employee's right hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was packing parts from a flow wrapper when his finger became stuck in a piece of the equipment. The flow wrapper blade then caused a finger amputation. The equipment was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was conducting a team lift of a piece of equipment that weighed 135 pounds to put it up on a table for cleaning when the employee strained the lower left abdomen, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when the employee's right foot was trapped between the pallet jack and a rail. The employee sustained a broken right ankle and broken right lower leg.
An employee was removing nuts and bolts from the brace for a fuel tank. The tank shifted and pinned his left arm and leg, breaking the arm.
An employee was walking on the pedestrian walkway along the perimeter of the building when she tripped and fell hitting the left side of her face on a bollard. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading an order of office chairs onto the second level of a semi-trailer truck, which required other employees to pass the chairs up to him so he could roll them back across plywood flooring that he was sitting on. He then attempted to stand up on the edge of the sheet of plywood when the plywood shifted and tilted vertically, causing him to fall approximately 4.5 feet to the wooden floor of the trailer. He landed on his back, head, and neck. His head struck the floor, bounced up, and struck the floor again as it came down. He sustained back, neck, and other bodily injuries, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the side of the excavation and leaned in to check the source of a noise coming from inside the trench. The concrete gave in where the employee was standing and the employee fell. The employee sustained broken ribs on the left side.

An employee was using a hoist and sling to move a shaft. After the employee hooked the sling to the shaft, the up button was pressed on the hoist's wireless remote. The strap then tightened on the shaft and the employee's right hand was caught between the two, causing an amputation of the right middle fingertip above the knuckle.
An employee was attempting to maneuver a headstone when it slipped and fell on the employee's hand, amputating the end of his right middle finger.

In a cleanout area at a plant, an employee was cleaning out the tailgate of a dump truck that was tilted up. A piece of asphalt in the dump body of the truck broke free, falling and striking the employee in the right leg, ankle, and foot. The employee suffered five broken toes and a broken ankle, as well as a laceration on the right leg requiring stitches, and was hospitalized.
An employee climbed a short wooden ladder to a landing platform. While turning around to face the extension ladder, he fell to the ground, injuring both ankles.

An employee fell approximately 7 feet from the top of a concrete wall to the bottom of a stairwell after plugging an extension cord into an outside outlet. The employee sustained a fractured pneumothorax and injuries to the left ribs and lung.

An employee was entering the cab of his tractor trailer and opened the door as the tractor trailer beside him was pulling out. His left hand was then caught between the door and the adjacent trailer, suffering swelling, lacerations to the index and middle fingers, and fractures to the ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was getting off a forklift when he missed a step and fell backwards, hitting his head on a parked pickup truck nearby. He suffered fractured vertebrae.
An employee was picking up a skid/small steel I-beam when the skid slipped off and fell on his right foot, fracturing it.

On 10/23/2018, at 2:00 PM, an employee was unloading an 80-foot boom from a trailer. The ramp from the trailer was not lowered at the time. He attempted to stop the lift, but the wheels were already at the edge of the trailer, and the momentum of the boom caused the back two wheels to slide off the trailer. When the wheels hit the ground, the boom had a catapult effect that threw the employee up onto the controls. His foot was still in the accelerator shroud, and his body momentum in combination with his foot being held by the shroud caused the tibia and fibula in his lower right leg to break. When the safety harness lanyard engaged and pulled him back into the basket, he landed on his broken leg, causing the bones to break through his skin.
An employee was lifting a spoil box out of a cart when the employee's fingertip was pinched between the box and cart, resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee was performing repairs on a shredder machine when a shaft fell and caught his left index and middle fingers, causing broken fingers and tendon injuries.
An employee was using a handheld grinder to cut off steel bolts on a dock bumper when the grinder grabbed his gloved hand and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was working on a telephone pole from a ladder. The employee fell while descending the ladder, suffering two broken right-side ribs, fluid on the lungs, and a bruised kidney and liver.
An employee was helping a worker lift a dock plate when the dock plate fell and caught the employee's finger between it and the dock. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was exiting a machine's lower level. As he stepped up, he fell 1.5 feet backwards from the second riser to the floor, suffering bilateral fractures to the wrist and a head contusion. He was hospitalized.
An employee was in an area cleaning when she was struck by a forklift truck, crushing and breaking her foot.

The injured employee was walking down the length of the QA final bench or pipe inspection area. One employee pulled the release cord while another employee pushed the bridge arm down button that signals the hydraulic bridge arms to rotate approximately 90 degrees to the stop position. The arm struck the injured employee across the chest and pinned him to the post at the stop position. The employee suffered bruising and contusions to the chest area including the lungs.

An employee was part of a crew engaged in dismantling a mast climber type scaffold. The crew was attempting to fully retract the power unit grab hooks to clear the scaffold mast so it could be removed. One employee was positioned at the controls for the power unit while the injured employee knelt down next to the mast to control/verify the position of the hooks. The grab hook inadvertently contacted one of the rungs of the mast, causing it to tip over and strike the injured employee. The employee suffered broken ribs as well as a broken pelvis and sacrum, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving from one location to another with a forklift. The employee was attempting to clear a rolling door when the doors caught the mast of the forklift. The employee's left leg was then caught between the unit and the left platform, causing a compound fracture to the leg.

An employee was attempting to clear a paper jam from a moving machine belt when the employee's left hand was caught by a pickup cylinder on the belt. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the back of the hand and palm, as well as a broken middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of her car and tripped over a laptop bag, breaking her foot and ankle.
Employees were laying sewer pipe when an employee was struck by a pipe, fracturing his hip.

An employee had just completed a tooling change on a forge press and the machine was restarted. The employee then attempted to remove some dust or miscellaneous materials from the machine and his hand contacted moving parts. He suffered an amputation of the middle finger on his right hand to the first knuckle.

Two employees were working together to lift a manhole cover. One employee placed a claw hammer in the manhole cover to lift it approximately 12 inches when the hammer slipped. The other employee tried to grab the cover but it fell and amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was driving a personnel carrier (cart) outside of a plant (courtyard area) when the employee ran into a 4x4 piece of lumber, which caused the cart to fall on its side. The employee fell off in the opposite direction of the falling cart and impacted the concrete floor, suffering a broken bone near the hip socket.

A material handler was running an overhead crane from on top of a table, stacking one rip cut plate onto another to create a two-piece lift. As he approached the edge of the table, carrying one piece on the crane, the injured employee came up to the table and tried to help him line up the piece on the magnet with the piece that was on the table. The injured employee's hands were on top of the plate that was on the magnet. As the plate on the magnet was lowered onto the plate on the table, the employee's finger was pinched between the two plates, cutting off his right ring fingertip above the knuckle.
An employee fell while exiting the back of a truck, suffering four broken ribs.
An employee was setting wall forms when his right thumb was smashed between two forms, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell during work and injured her knee, requiring surgery.
An employee was positioning kegs on his truck when a keg (165 pounds) dropped on his right hand, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's electronic cigarette batteries ignited, catching his pant leg on fire and leading to second degree leg burns.

A Cardinal Logistics Management Corporation employee was operating a forklift to drop a load when the forklift tipped over. The employee hit his head on the overhead guard of the forklift, requiring hospitalization for a C-1 neck fracture.
An employee stepped backward, tripped, and fell backward, striking her head against a wall and suffering bleeding in the brain.

An employee was installing flashing on a 19th level balcony when he lost his balance and fell backwards off the fourth rung of a ladder, hitting the balcony landing and fracturing his lower vertebra. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stabbed in the stomach by a homeless man on the jobsite.
An employee fell from a truck to the ground while loading the bulk truck with material, suffering arm, wrist, and rib fractures.
An employee was operating a shear when his hand got close to the point of operation. When the shear was actuated, the blade amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was assaulted while stocking freight in an automotive department and was hospitalized with a fractured skull.

An employee was attempting to open up a broken garage door when his right pinky was caught between two panels of the garage door. His pinky was sliced open and broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was pulling a differential when the employee's fingers were caught between the differential and another piece of metal, resulting in a middle finger amputation and partial index finger amputation.
An employee was working at a residence and began feeling light headed with chest pains. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee's right index finger was crushed between a crane and a ring mount; the tip was amputated.

An employee was conducting routine cleaning using a long hoe to scrape and collect excess material (ammonium sulfate) from a moving conveyor line when she was struck by and caught in the line. Other employees came to her aid and cut her loose. She was hospitalized with injuries to her neck, chest, and sternum. The conveyor line was unguarded at the time.

An employee was unstrapping a tote container that had been loaded onto a stake bed truck. The strap became unfastened and struck the employee's left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the tip of the little finger.
An employee fell off a kiln car to the ground, about 38 inches below. The employee suffered a hip injury that required surgery.

An employee was inspecting a low sloped roof that was damaged in a hurricane when he fell 15 feet through a skylight to a concrete floor.  He sustained a broken left hip, broken tailbone, three broken ribs, a torn spleen, a left orbital eye fracture, and bleeding on the brain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck and pinned against a forklift by a second forklift. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was in a flat grain storage bin using a sweep auger for cleaning when the employee stepped into the floor auger discharge hole, severing the right lower leg.

An employee was cleaning an electrostatic paint gun when the trigger was pulled and air pressure from the electrostatic paint gun injected undercoating material into his left index finger. The trigger was not locked out and the electrostatic air valve was not turned off at the time of the incident.

On October 24, 2018, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee was exiting the cab of his truck when he fell backwards to the asphalt parking lot and struck his head. He was hospitalized for a laceration and possible concussion.
An employee fell approximately 4 feet off a ladder to the floor while working on a trailer, suffering a broken right arm and forehead laceration.
On October 24, 2018, an employee was moving two bar stocks with a magnet when a piece of bar stock fell on the employee. The employee suffered two broken ribs and a fractured pelvis.

On October 24, 2018, an employee was cleaning inside a grain bin. The foot peg that the employee was standing on came loose, causing him to lose his balance and slide down the bin slope. He suffered a broken tailbone and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to close the sliding door on a silo to conduct maintenance (replacing the gate) when the employee's right hand was struck by the sledge hammer. The employee's right index finger was crushed.

An employee was working with a driver who was backing a box truck into the garage of a newly built home to unload construction materials. He was standing behind the truck guiding the driver towards the garage. The ramp had been pulled approximately 8 feet out of the back of the box truck at the time. As the driver was attempting to position the truck, the employee was pinned between the ramp and the inside door jam of the garage door, fracturing his upper leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a machine when the foot clamp was pressed and the employee's finger was crushed and amputated in a clamp.
An employee was trying to clear rubber from a mixer when the door came down and crushed the employee's left arm. The arm was surgically amputated.

An employee was creeling on a beamer. The employee was tying in (from a semi-crouched position) a package on the bottom row of the creel. As the employee finished tying in the package, the employee side-stepped (without standing) to start tying in another package that was on the same row, but one creel section over. While side-stepping, the employee's left foot hit the heel of the right foot, causing the employee to fall from the same level to the floor. The employee landed on the concrete floor, suffering a partial fracture to the left hip on the exterior of the bone.
An employee was clearing a clogged drain. The conveyor scraper blade caught the employee's hand between the drain screen crushing three fingers.
An employee was traveling on an ATV to inspect a fire line when the ATV overturned, breaking his ribs.
An employee was trying to hook up a trailer. As he lowered the landing gear with a crank, the crank handle slipped and struck him in the jaw. He was hospitalized, needing surgery.

An employee was moving freight when she tried to move an electric pallet jack out of her way by releasing the lever on the electric pallet jack and allowing it to roll away. She was standing between the pallet jack and the dock door when the pallet jack rolled towards her. She was caught between the pallet jack and the dock door, injuring her right leg.

An employee was manually taking folded rubber off a skid when his hand slipped off the rubber, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.

An employee was struck by a forward moving forklift being driving down the aisle by another temporary worker. The employee's leg was pinched between the side of the forklift and a pallet resulting in fractures.
An employee was sharpening a cup cutter. The employee was sprayed in the face with SaniDate chemical when a pressurized line broke.

An employee was spraying and cleaning metal rollers near a conveyor belt that was in a raised position to clean underneath it. She tried to pull a piece of meat out from between the metal rollers when her right hand was pulled in by the moving conveyor belt. She sustained a broken right index finger and had her right ring and middle fingers surgically amputated. The belt was moving at the time of the incident.
An employee was jacking up the front end of a truck when the jack slipped and hit him in the forehead, causing a contusion and large gash/cut on his forehead.
An employee was cleaning a tarp underneath a conveyor from a ladder. As he turned on the ladder to reach behind him, he lost his balance and fell off the ladder, suffering back and leg injuries.

A maintenance employee was attempting to remove clogged sand from an air blower hole that was approximately 2 inches in diameter when the blower's auger amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee fell from a fiberglass ladder, suffering a broken right leg and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was trying to remove plastic from a termination machine when the machine actuated and caused an amputation to her finger. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a vibratory truss screed for concrete paving. The employee was guiding a winch cable back onto the cable spool; the nip point between cable and spool caught the employee's hand, severing the fingertip.
While stepping down from a step, an employee lost his footing and fell to the ground. His arm was broken, and he was hospitalized.
An employee's hand was caught in a rotary grinder. Two of the employee's fingers were amputated.
While making a perimeter check around a courthouse building, a security guard was involved in a hit-and-run accident. The employee suffered a cracked pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to close the door of a yard jockey. As he pulled on the door his finger was caught and crushed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Employees were servicing a tool and attempting to remove the pivot pins while the tool was in the horizontal position. The first employee was kneeling and facing the tool, while a second employee was operating the grab handle to remove the pivot pins. The first pivot pin was successfully removed.  While attempting to remove the second pivot pin, the second employee rotated the handle from the unlock position to the lock position. He then rotated the grab handle downward. During this operation, the pivot pin came out and allowed the grab handle to rotate past its normal stop (lock position). The second employee's right middle finger was then caught between the grab handle and a weldment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee's right hand was on the front of a moving bundle (cube) of pavers to check the quality of product. His finger was then pinched between the bundle and the roller on a non-powered roller conveyor, resulting in multiple contusions and the right ring fingernail being removed. The weight of the bundle was approximately 3,300 lbs.
On October 24, 2018, an employee's thumb was amputated by an object that was being lifted or handled.

A valve was installed on a sewer line. When the line was repressurized, a hose with a brass fitting came off the line and struck an employee in the face. The employee suffered a fractured jaw, a broken nose, shattered cheekbone, loss of teeth, and cuts and abrasions to the right eye.
An employee was descending the front stairs of a house after making a delivery when he tripped and impacted the stairs, suffering head trauma.
An employee fell from a drilling rig when its wing collapsed, landing about 14 feet below and suffering injuries to the right leg.

On October 25, 2018, an employee was pushing a casing through a finishing machine when the employee's left-hand fingers were caught and fractured in the machine's rubber rollers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a V roller on a line when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The power was on at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking to a desk and tripped over loose banding straps, falling to the concrete floor and suffering a left hip fracture.
An employee suffered a laceration and wrist injury while operating a roll groove machine.
An employee fell, striking the wall with their shoulder and dislocating it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was riding on the back of a garbage truck, standing on a foot platform and holding onto handholds. The truck hit some bumps on the road and the employee fell off, suffering a head injury and skin abrasion on the back.
An employee was cleaning ink from rollers when she lost her balance. Her hand was caught by the rollers and partially degloved.
An employee was reassembling pipe components after a valve replacement on a mud pump. A section of pipe crushed his finger against a pipe flange. The finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was attempting to troubleshoot and repair a compressor blower in the rail yard and removed a filter using a hex head wrench. His left hand was inside the filter housing's air intake shaft when his middle fingertip came in contact with rotating rotors, resulting in a partial amputation of the left third distal phalanx. The compressor blower was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was on a platform, manipulating the inner diameter of a vessel with a hydraulic press using quarter-inch square steel tubing. The tubing became free and knocked the employee off the platform and onto the floor. The employee suffered injuries including contusions, lacerations, and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
While laying out a tarp at the end of the day, an employee fell about 10 feet off the edge of a roof. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs, fractured back and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was measuring tank levels when he slipped and fell on the slick/muddy ground. He broke a vertebra in his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a steam hose in a sulfur recovery unit. The hose sprayed the employee with hot condensate, causing steam burns to the thigh area.
An employee was operating a press. When the machine cycled, his left hand was caught in the injection area. He suffered an amputation to the middle fingertip.
On October 25, 2018, a forklift was depositing a load when it shifted laterally, striking an employee and causing broken bones and lacerations to the head.

An employee was cutting meat in the cafeteria with a meat slicer when the meat slipped and fell. He reached to catch the meat and his thumb contacted the slicer blade, amputating the tip of his thumb.

An employee was following a bison to another location to prepare for a medical operation when the bison turned to run. The bison ran into the employee, causing several injuries to the left cheek and shoulder area, including fractures, contusions, and lacerations.

An employee was connecting wires on the line side of an electrical cabinet when an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's right hand, soft tissue of the neck area, and lower part of the face and right ear. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a rock from a truck tailgate when the tailgate closed on his right ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access an HVAC system on a roof when he fell about 12 feet to the ground. He suffered a back and pelvis injury and was hospitalized; the pelvis injury required surgery. Gloves were being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over the end of a rug and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a small section of exterior wall assembly above a precast concrete panel that was being removed.  While he was removing debris around the top of the precast concrete panel, the precast concrete panel shifted, causing his left middle finger to be caught between the top of the precast concrete panel and the bottom of a horizontal structural steel member above. His left middle finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was pulling a sewer cover back into place when the employee's left middle finger was caught in the pinch point between the cover and the road surface.
An employee was unbinding cages on a live truck when a forklift operator backed over and fractured his leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading shower doors from a straight truck when several pieces of glass in the truck fell over and pinned the employee against a rack with boxes on the other side of the truck. The employee suffered broken ribs, a bruised sternum, and a punctured lung.
