An employee used a forklift to lift a hopper bin full of wood fines. When the employee pulled the release lever on the hopper, it rotated and allowed the contents to be released. The employee pushed the hopper to release the remaining material. The hopper then rolled back, striking the employee's left ring finger. The employee sustained broken finger bones and a laceration. Gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell about 15 feet from a collapsing scaffold to the ground while installing fascia, suffering fractures.
An employee was helping to work on an 8" water line when it erupted, striking the employee in the left leg and causing a deep laceration that required 100 stitches.
An employee was walking down the stairs to a basement to make a repair when he slipped on the last few stairs, fell to the floor, and fractured his kneecap.

An employee was working inside an interstate lane closure installing raised pavement markers when an automobile swerved into the work zone and struck his right elbow. His right elbow was fractured, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was resetting a traffic barrel on its side when an automobile veered off the road and struck the employee. The employee sustained injury to the legs, ribs and wrist.
An employee was transferring a load of copper cathode to a furnace when a piece of the cathode slid off a pallet and struck his lower left leg, lacerating it and requiring surgery.
An employee was observing a saw operation when the saw blade broke and struck the employee, causing serious cuts to the employee's fingers.

An employee was using a portable ladder to change ceiling tiles. While descending the ladder after changing a tile, the employee lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the back of the head, several fractured ribs, and a contusion to the right hip.
An employee was mopping a room when the top of the mop handle smashed into an overhead light's protective glass cover. The glass lacerated the employee's right hand.

An employee was connecting steel tube sections for the installation of helical piles. He was checking the alignment of two tube sections when one of the sections was turned in an effort to align it, and his left index finger was caught in in a bolt hole amputating the fingertip.

A temporary employee was lifting a drum of product to be dumped into a mixer when the drum slipped and caught the employee's left middle finger between the drum and frame, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was shot in the face, neck, and stomach while getting materials from a work vehicle, suffering trauma and requiring hospitalization.
On October 26, 2018, an employee was retrieving change from a safe drawer when the drawer closed on the employee's thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was shutting down a water pump. When the hose was disconnected, hot water was released and burned the employee's leg.

An employee was cleaning a tanker car using a grit-blast hose and stretched it out to roll it up. The hose trigger button was then hit and pressurized grit was released, striking him in the neck. He was hospitalized with a laceration and contusions, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a crane with a magnet to move steel. A steel plate detached from the magnet, and the employee's left ring finger was caught between it and another plate. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered a left arm fracture after being pushed by a guest and falling, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on the slider section of a flatbed trailer tandem to determine why the slide lock mechanism was not functioning properly. Repairs were made and the employee needed the trailer tested to ensure proper function of the lock. During the testing process, the trailer brakes are applied and a pallet jack is used to pull the trailer, allowing the lock to engage. His middle finger entered the pin slot right as the trailer was starting to move. When this happened, the plate caught his middle fingertip, causing a deep laceration that resulted in a partial, surgical fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving a manually extending roller section when his right index finger was caught in the rollers, suffering tendon injuries.

An employee was passing a platform crossway when it collapsed and he fell about 5.5 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a concussion and fracture to the spine area. The platform did not have guardrails at the time of the incident.
While exiting the truck shop, an employee mis-stepped off a 6-inch step and fell to the ground, breaking a femur.
An employee was adjusting the jig fixture on a table saw when the jig slipped, causing an amputation of the employee's right index finger.
An employee was using a chop saw and amputated the right thumb tip.
On October 26, 2018, an employee was unloading a container of furniture while standing on two boxes (about 2 feet high). He lost his balance and fell backwards.
While working from a podium ladder, an employee lost balance and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left wrist and ribs.
An employee was operating the butter filler when her finger was caught and amputated inside the rotary valve.

Maintenance employees were using a sliding C clamp to press bearings onto a shaft. As one maintenance employee tightened the C clamp by hand, the C clamp slipped off the bearing and pinched the injured employee's middle finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was removing a piece of stuck plastic from a corrugator. The corrugator cycled and her right index finger was caught in the machine's dies. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was pulled into a conveyor, with their clothing wrapped around a sprocket. The employee suffered internal injuries and amputation of fingers, and was hospitalized.
An employee was burned by hot water and a caustic cleaning chemical while rinsing out filling equipment. The employee suffered burns from the waist down to the kneecaps on both legs.
An employee was operating a press brake, which cycled while the employee's hand was in the point of operation. The ram caused the amputation of the tips of the employee's ring and middle fingers.
An employee was adjusting the blade of a head saw when the employee's right index finger was caught in the blade and amputated. The saw was running at the time.

On 10/26/18, an employee was operating a horizontal gun drilling machine when the employee's fingers were caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation of the index finger (1/2 nail) and the middle finger (first knuckle to the tip).

An employee was placing a part in a metal bin. He attempted to open the bin door but it was stuck. When it came open, the force caused his left ring finger to become caught between the door and a rack, resulting in an open fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a trailer door hinge and fell from a ladder breaking the tibia and fibula.

An employee was driving a forklift out of a truck trailer when the truck trailer rolled away from the loading dock. The employee and the forklift fell to the ground. The forklift's back seat support hit and cut his head.

An employee had just finished rigging a bundle of channel iron together to be lifted to the roof of a building. When the load began to lift, the employee was stepping back from the load to grab the tagline when he reached out and lightly placed his left hand against the load to steady it. At that time, the bundle of channel iron rolled inward, catching his left glove and pulling his hand in between two pieces of iron. He was able to pull his hand back immediately, but his left middle fingertip was crushed, resulting in an amputation (without bone loss) of the distal tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was preparing to jet drain lines when a hose developed a pinhole and water shot out at 3,800 psi. The employee's hand was lacerated between thumb and finger.

On October 26, 2018, an employee was in a trench inspecting a pipe connection when one of the side booms that was holding the pipe in place began to slide downhill. The pipe was then released from the clamp and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised kidney.
An employee made contact with an overhead powerline while setting a street light pole and received severe burns to the body.

An employee was attempting to unjam wood that was caught in a drive belt when she suffered a partial amputation of her right middle finger. The belt was unguarded and not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
On October 26, 2018, an employee was torch cutting a steel racking system when the system struck and fractured the employee's leg, requiring hospitalization.

Three employees stopped their PIVs to clean up a soap spill. The injured employee was standing outside the PIV when the second employee moved their PIV and struck the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift, suffering a broken leg and ankle.

An employee was performing a die change during a product change-over. The employee removed the chute and used a metal tool to scrap debris from the opening. The tool became caught in the auger, which pulled the tool and the employee's hand into the auger blade. The employee sustained complete amputations to the four fingers on the right hand. The auger was not locked/tagged out and was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was lowering a valve machine into the cradle using a hoist and got his right index finger caught between the lifting ring and the cradle. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was standing in the parking lot when he lit a firecracker and it exploded in his hand, causing a fracture, lacerations, and an amputation to the index and middle fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee put on gloves that had been previously used and suffered a chemical burn.
A temporary employee was attempting to clear a jam on a cross cut saw when the saw amputated three fingers.
An employee was working on a milling machine when its drum caught his left foot, amputating the third and fourth toes.

Employees were constructing a tank battery and removing a bottom hatch with a grinder when a fire and explosion occurred from an empty tank. The injured employee received body burns that required hospitalization.

On October 27, 2018, at approximately 9:15 PM, a crew of five employees was working on a drilling rig when the traveling block hit the crown, which caused the travel block to fall to the rig floor. One employee was struck by debris from the damaged rig and suffered a fractured neck, broken left arm, and two broken ribs. Another employee jumped away from the rig structure and fell to the ground below resulting in a left foot amputation.
An employee was attempting to wipe grease off of a mixer motor when the mixer shaft caught his left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation. The mixer was running at the time of the incident.

On 10/27/18, an employee was helping to construct a parade float and was working on a wooden platform that was 54 inches off the ground. As he walked back to the ladder to exit the platform, he took a misstep off the side of the platform and fell to the ground, fracturing his thoracic vertebrae and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on the roof cleaning a skylight when the employee fell 25 feet through the skylight to the concrete floor, suffering head trauma and multiple fractures.
An employee tripped and fell over the corner of a pack-and-play crib after opening it, suffering a broken left arm.
An employee was grinding an I-beam when the grinder disk ruptured and blew into the employee's right leg, fracturing the tibia and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was leaving the facility when she collapsed onto the warehouse floor, suffering a possible broken hip.
An employee walked into a stack of pallets and fell breaking their arm and shoulder.

A maintenance employee was trying to remove a choker sling on a pulley when the choker became caught and the pulley counterweight fell, causing the employee's foot to slip off of the equipment frame and become caught between the frame and the pulley. The employee suffered multiple ankle fractures.
On October 28, 2018, an employee was servicing a sheet ironer when the employee's right index finger was caught and severely lacerated between a gear and chain, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was dumping a quench tank slag barrel into a dumpster when he grabbed the barrel and it slipped, creating a pinch point on the barrel and self-tipping hopper that amputated the distal phalanges on his right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was cleaning a railcar that was previously carrying phenol material when the employee noticed a valve in the railcar was clogged. The employee applied steam to the clog for 20 minutes to melt the material. Once complete, the employee opened the valve, which had built pressure, forcing the phenol and steam out of the pipe and onto the employee's face and neck. The employee suffered first degree burns to the face and neck and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a shuttle car when the wheel ran over his right foot, breaking metatarsal bones and two toes. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

The employee was bending a piece of 3/4" diameter round bar in a vice and utilizing a 3" length of pipe over the bar for leverage. The pipe slipped off causing the employee to lose balance. As a result, the employee fell to the ground and pinched their left index finger between the length of pipe and their body causing a fracture.
An employee was slicing onions on a slicer. She was grabbing an onion off of the slicer when the blade amputated her left middle fingertip without bone loss.

Two forklifts were traveling in the same direction. The operator of the first forklift realized he had gone too far and stopped to turn around. When he started to turn, one of the forks struck the employee who was operating the second forklift in the left foot, causing a possible fracture to the foot/toe.
An employee was operating a machine and suffered the partial amputation of two fingers. The blade was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking/working on a roof and stepped through insulation, falling 8 to 12 feet onto a catwalk. The employee suffered multiple bruises to the neck, shoulder, and shin (tibia).
An employee was clearing jammed scrapped aluminum on a moving conveyor and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was in a derrick, making a connection. The employee's right thumb was caught and crushed between the drill pipe and the elevator, suffering an open fracture/dislocation.
An employee tripped over an employee's feet and struck a locker door, injuring her head.

An employee was installing a new ventilation system on the roof of a business and fell four feet through an opening about 24-34 inches between the catwalk and the various water system pipes. The employee suffered two fractured ribs, a laceration of the left ear, contusions and a skull fracture.
An employee was installing the pins in the exterior carriage basket of a machine when the drive struck the employee's right leg crushing it.

An employee was backing into an industrial lift on the main floor with a cart of books. The lift was not on the main floor and he fell 12 to 13 feet down the shaft, with the cart of books landing on top of him. He suffered bleeding on the brain and a broken shoulder, and he required stitches to the back of the head and hospitalization.
While preparing to clean the deli/bakery, an employee tripped and struck a pan of fryer oil. The employee sustained second degree burns to his hands and legs.

Two employees were operating a side-by-side piece of equipment when it fell over and struck one of the employees. The employee sustained injuries to the head, knee, leg, and left hand. He was hospitalized and his left index finger was surgically amputated.

Employees were breaking the concrete median of a road under construction (widening) with a jack hammer. The jack hammer struck an electrical duct bank causing an arc flash. Two employees were burned and hospitalized.
An employee was in a trench clearing away dirt when the trench collapsed on the employee. The employee sustained two broken ribs and a collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was lowering a hydraulic tank using a manual bridge hoist when his left pinky fingertip was caught between the clasping hook and the eye bolt, resulting in the removal of a small piece of his pinky finger pad.
A mail carrier was walking across a lawn when he tripped over a stump and fell to the ground, fracturing his skull and spine.

On October 29, 2018, at approximately 6:15 a.m., an employee was standing on the top step of the stairs connected to a truck cab when the step gave way. He fell to the ground, suffering three fractured ribs and a ruptured spleen.

An employee was changing out a die on a machine when the machine suddenly rotated, pinching the employee's finger between the die and the handle of the machine. The tip of his fourth phalange was amputated as a result.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when it crushed his right middle fingers. He was hospitalized, needing surgery.

A dive team was attempting to investigate a target of interest near a buoy. After all pre-dive checks, the diver was given clearance to descend. He followed the marker buoy line to the bottom. When he arrived at the bottom, he lost the marker line and ascended back to the surface. Once he found the proper marker, he descended again to the bottom. He was not able to breathe with his breathing apparatus and lost communication with the dive master. When he was pulled to the surface, he was not breathing and required hospitalization.
An employee was treated for an infection after a metal fragment was lodged into her right thumb.
An employee was setting up a molding run. While calibrating the machine, the board kicked back and splintered. A piece punctured the employee in the abdomen.

An employee was straddling an I-beam and scooting across it when he lost his balance and the yo-yo to his harness grabbed him, pulling him backwards. He fell 15 feet from the above floor to the finished concrete below, fracturing his face and lacerating his ear.
An employee was climbing onto an excavator when the ring on his finger became caught on the equipment's mirror bracket. He received an avulsion on his left ring finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking between buildings when she tripped and fell to the sidewalk, fracturing her left hip.

An employee was oiling a conveyor chain when the employee's glove became caught in the chain, which pulled the employee's hand into the wheel cycle and chain. The employee experienced a fingertip amputation.

An employee was struck in the forehead by a metal hook and rope combination that was thrown to him by another employee. The employee sustained a forehead laceration and possible intracranial bleeding.
An employee was on a ladder trimming drywall with a reciprocating saw when the employee fell off the second rung of the ladder to the ground, fracturing the left leg below the knee.
An employee was operating a food processor and suffered a partial amputation of two fingers on the right hand.

A diesel mechanic was repairing the marker lights on a box truck. He was entering the body of the truck through the rear door when the gate chain caught his right hand and pulled it into the lift gate chain and roller, crushing the middle finger. The employee was hospitalized, needing surgery; the middle fingertip was amputated and the ring finger required pins.

An employee was slicing cucumbers with a manual slicer when the handle came off the slicer. The slicer then amputated the employee's left ring fingertip. Cut-resistant gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee turned off an optimizing panel saw, went to the back of the machine, opened the blade compartment, and attempted to remove a piece of wood. The employee's right hand then came in contact with the still-rotating main blade, resulting in a partial amputation of the little finger between the first and second knuckle and lacerations to the right palm and thumb.

An employee and two coworkers were attempting to unload hay that was strapped on the back of a truck. When he unstrapped the hay elevator, it slipped and fell 4 feet. The motor portion of the elevator struck his head and mouth, causing a severe laceration to his scalp and a loss of teeth.
An employee was washing dishes in a catering facility when wet ceiling tiles fell and hit his head, causing head and neck contusions.

An employee was replacing a fixed wheel on a tire rack when the tire rack, which was approximately 8 feet high, tipped over onto the employee as he removed one of the fixed wheels. The impact broke his back and ribs.

An employee was rotating an A-frame steel weldment on saw horses. As he was laying it down it slipped off the saw horses and his left pinky finger was smashed between the saw horse and the A-frame resulting in amputation of the fingertip (flesh).
An employee was welding a patch onto a fuel tank. A flash fire occurred when the employee passed the cutting torch over the tank. He received first and second degree burns to 15% of his body.
An employee was changing an insert in a lathe and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was chasing after a youth psychology patient who was running down a hall. The employee got a hold on the patient but fell to the floor, breaking her left humerus. She was hospitalized.
A dryer's fan was started up for testing. It caught an employee's shirt and pulled him in, causing back and arm injuries.

On October 30, 2018, an employee was cleaning a blender when the blade, having been rotated manually, pinched the employee's left little finger and caused an amputation of the fingertip. The machine was locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting parts with a circular saw. It kicked back and the blade entered his left bicep.
An employee was walking down an embankment when his leg gave out. He suffered a torn quadriceps.
An employee was grinding a steel beam for grounding bracket installation when a gantry crane ran over his foot and crushed it.

On October 30, 2018, an employee was working with a crane, trying to remove lifting forks from a pallet. The employee's left hand was crushed and fractured between the lifting forks and the post supporting the stowed boom. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was boring a 28-inch hole using a concrete boring machine. The machine's anchor bolts broke and the machine spun around and struck the employee causing a left arm fracture.
An employee was hoisting a snubbing unit with his hand on the unit  and got his hand caught between the snubbing unit and the derrick resulting in amputation of the right thumb.

An employee was laying metal floor decking on the second floor of a building. While dragging a sheet of deck, the employee fell, landing on a 4-foot pier cap about 18 feet below. The employee suffered two broken ribs, a broken left arm (between the shoulder and the elbow), and a fractured pelvis. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.

The injured employee was on an 8-foot step ladder holding piping while helping another employee install HVAC piping. The employee fell from the ladder and suffered a broken collarbone and a head laceration.
An employee was helping two coworkers change a front end loader's bucket. His finger was in a pinhole when the locking pin actuated, partially amputating his left middle finger.

An employee was driving a golf cart after loading it with firewood from a storage bin. While the cart was maneuvering in the tight space between the bin and a construction truck parked next to it, the employee's left leg was caught between the bin and the cart. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from swelling and laceration to the leg.

An employee was working from a 12-foot step ladder (on the third rung from the top), reaching to clip a wire tie while he was roughing in a heating and air conditioning system. The ladder started to tip, and he jumped from it to avoid falling to the ground. He landed on his feet on the concrete floor, breaking his left heel in five places and his right heel in three places. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was walking on an I-beam in the lay down area. The employee stepped down from the I-beam and another I-bean (approximately 3,200 lbs.) rolled over onto his ankles fracturing both ankles and the lower right leg.

An employee was attempting to stop a shoplifter who was pushing a cart of stolen merchandise out of the store. The employee's foot got caught in the cart and the employee fell fracturing his left foot.
While walking near a loading dock, an employee was struck in the foot by a forklift truck. Her right leg was broken.

On October 30, 2018, an employee was engaged in sanitation procedures and suffered amputations to four fingers on the right hand when his hand was caught in the serpentine chain located on the rollers between the coring machine and the trim table.

A temporary employee was operating a baler when a box was caught in it. He attempted to free the box. His left foot was caught between the blades; four toes and part the big toe were amputated. He was hospitalized, needing surgery.

An employee was assisting a motorist on the side of the highway and was struck by another vehicle while standing at the back of the assist vehicle. The employee was crushed between the two vehicles and suffered a bilateral leg amputation.
The employee was a passenger on an ATV looking at a tract of lumber for purchase. The ATV rolled and the employee sustained an ankle fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending a step ladder and missed the last step. Her knee snapped and she was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was installing light fixtures in a drop ceiling from an 8-foot step ladder. The employee slipped off the third rung while descending the ladder and fell to the ground. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying a box and walking in a tool department when his right foot became caught on a display item and he fell to the ground. He suffered a fractured patella and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
As an employee turned to walk back into the store, he fell to the ground and fractured a hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of foam when his arm was trapped between the foam and the sawblade. He suffered a laceration on the inside of his right elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a long tube that was resting on a pallet and fell breaking an arm.
An employee was reworking an automotive air conditioning hose and amputated the right index fingertip in the hose cutting machine.

An employee was tightening a plate on a sauce chip tunnel machine when the plate moved (indexed), resulting in an amputation to the tip of the employee's right little finger. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was drilling a well. The employee's jacket was caught by the auger and the employee was pulled into the drill auger. The employee sustained a broken neck, shoulder, ankle and also internal injuries.
An employee was in a scissor lift troubleshooting a machine. The machine activated and the employee was pinned between the machine and the scissor lift railing resulting in six broken ribs.
An employee was dizzy and fell from the second floor.
An employee was cutting scrap logs with the swing saw and amputated the left index and middle fingers at the middle knuckles.
An employee tripped over a pallet of empty tubs and fell breaking a femur. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee's arm was caught in a hydraulic press while cleaning it resulting in two fractures in the arm and five fractures in the hand. The employee was hospitalized for surgery. The arm was later amputated below the elbow.
A stage hand tripped while rolling a box over a cable ramp and fell backwards striking her head. She was hospitalized for a skull fracture.

An employee was lowering fins into a 95-degree-Celsius water bath, used to stretch fibers. A hole in the employee's left glove allowed water in, and the employee's hand was burned. The employee was hospitalized. Hot stretch gloves over cut-resistant gloves were being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a grinder machine and while pushing down on a part amputated their right index fingertip.

An employee was changing out vacuum switches on the third level in an electrical room. The employee fell through the space created by the removal of the switches, landing 7.5 feet below and suffering fractured neck vertebrae and a lacerated scalp.

A crane operator had placed a steel mill beam into a staging area with an overhead crane and was removing the lifting chain. The mill beam (29.5 feet long, weighing 956 pounds) fell forward, striking the crane operator on his left leg. His lower left leg was broken, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a microtome machine when it activated. Its blade cut off the tip of her finger.
An employee suffered a self-inflected gunshot wound to his left thigh, when the firearm in his jacket pocket slipped out and fired.

An employee was investigating smoke coming from a 55-gallon drum of resin sitting on a heated rack. After investigating the smoke, he began walking away from the drum; it ignited, producing a ball of fire. He suffered second- or third-degree burns to the right side of his face, back, arm, and knee area. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was spotting for a track hoe when he was caught by the tracks, fracturing his right leg in three places.
An employee was trying to unclog an FCM machine when his hand was caught between the hydraulic jack and the machine. His left thumb was broken.

An employee was installing tubing, joining connections onto structural beams. He was tied off to the beam he was trying to connect when one end of it came down, pulling him to the ground from about 15 feet up. He suffered a broken left femur and several cracked ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was showing another employee how to run the portable lathe when their finger contacted the lathe resulting in surgical amputation of the left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was carrying a plastic bag while walking when she stepped on the bag, fell to the floor, and fractured her right hip. She was hospitalized.
In either pulling down an elevator door or installing a 5- to 10-pound vibrator on a carbon scale, an employee suffered an abdominal hernia.

An employee was doing overhead piping work while using a manlift. The lift contacted hot water pipes that provided supply and return to a heater in a garage, causing the pipes to bow. When the lift was lowered, one of the pipes burst. The employee was burned with hot water from the pipe. He jumped approximately 10 feet from the lift to the ground and fractured his hip.
An employee was working at the furnace raking iron when a furnace tending machine pulled the employee into a beam causing a crushing injury to the employee's left hand.

An employee was crimping the tops of flash bang grenades while they were on a lathe. The crimp is applied via a plunger that rolls the edges. The employee placed a flash bang grenade onto the lathe and engaged the jaws to hold it in place. While the employee was still holding the grenade, the pneumatic plunger engaged and struck the employee's index finger on his right hand, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was using a forklift to unload pallets. The forklift fell from the dock and the employee broke his left foot.
At about 8:15 a.m. on October 31, 2018, an employee lifted a 5-pound fishing net and felt pain. The pain intensified and he was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a seat on a tractor. While she was torqueing the seat base with a 90-degree torque gun, the rear of the tool rotated toward her in reverse. The tool and its battery struck her face, causing a dislocated jaw and torn ligaments requiring surgery.
An employee fell off the lift gate of a van while moving a patient. She struck the ground and broke her knee, foot, and rib.

An employee was kneeling in the street beside a curb, holding an expansion joint in place while concrete was being poured. As the concrete truck pulled forward, its passenger-side front tire ran over the employee's feet. The employee suffered a fracture in the right little toe, damage to blood vessels in the left foot, and lacerations requiring five stitches to the toes on the left foot.
While installing decking, an employee fell from the decking and suffered a dislocated shoulder. The employee was tied off at the time.
An employee was overcome by carbon monoxide fumes while working on a truck tire in a garage. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an air-powered hand grinder when its disc broke apart, lacerating the employee's arm and face.
An employee slipped off a ladder onto a second employee that was holding the ladder before hitting the ground. Both employees were hospitalized with fractures.
An employee's finger was pinched in the articulation where the fork on a truck went up and down. The finger required surgery.
A joint of pipe slipped through elevators and fell on an employee. He suffered head and arm injuries.
At about 11:00 a.m. on October 31, 2018, an employee was carrying a bundle of rebar that was tied with wires. A wire popped and hit him in his safety glasses, lacerating his right eyelid.

An employee was standing on a flatbed trailer helping another driver secure a load on the trailer when he lost his grip on the load and fell approximately 3 to 4 feet off the trailer to the concrete. He fractured his left femur and left radius.
An employee was adjusting air nozzles on a grinder and removing jammed parts. His little finger was amputated between a part and the grinding wheel.

An employee was scraping hot melted plastic from an extruder machine. The employee's putty knife penetrated a skin formed on the plastic; molten plastic sprayed onto the employee, causing burns to the face, torso, and left and right arms.
An employee tripped on a permanent fixture while stocking and injured the left knee requiring surgery.
An employee was reaching for a part when his glove was caught by a CNC saw, causing a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee fell approximately 15 to 16 feet off a scaffold to the wood sub-floor while preparing a ceiling for painting, suffering two broken wrists and a broken nose.

An employee was standing in front of a warehouse office door when the employee was struck by a 10,790-pound forklift and pinned against a protective railing barrier. The employee suffered bruising and soreness of the right side of the body, both legs, and both knees, as well as trapped blood in the right leg muscle. The employee was later hospitalized with an infection and blood clotting.
An employee was retrieving a tool from a "chucker" machine when it caused an amputation to his right index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
A temporary employee was operating a chop saw when the saw blade cut the fingers on his right hand, resulting in a right pinky finger amputation.
An employee was working on a piece of directional drilling equipment. Its fan blade lacerated the employee's right thumb, index, and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was putting a piece of metal into a shear press. The press activated, and his left hand was caught by the spring under the guard that automatically returned the press to its starting position. He sustained a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in the facility when a forklift ran over the employee's foot and broke it.

A groundskeeper was cutting the base of a tree at a private residence. His chainsaw kicked back and struck both his legs, causing severe cuts above the knees. He was hospitalized. Personal protective equipment was not being worn at the time of the incident.

Two employees were loading a dolly with metal frames. One was using a "J" bar to hold the frames in place while the other positioned the dolly. The frames hit the employee handling the "J" bar on the leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula.

An employee had been dispatched to a store parking lot to tow a disabled vehicle. He parked the tow truck behind the vehicle, then laid on the ground and under the vehicle to hook it up to the tow truck. His legs were sticking out a little more than 1 foot from the side of the vehicle when a car drove over both of his feet, then went into reverse, drove over his left ankle, and parked on it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was helping bring in a new fry hopper. While removing it, he tripped and it fell back on him, breaking his tibia.

An employee was demolishing an abandoned pipeline in a trench, about 5 feet deep, using a demolition saw. He lost balance and the saw cut into his left forearm above the wrist, possibly cutting or nicking tendons. He was hospitalized.
An employee stepped on a recently poured concrete form and suffered a fractured right foot.
An employee was feeding bars into a bar machine. While attempting to unjam the machine, the employee suffered an amputation to a finger.

An employee was setting up a pressure washer to clean a roof. The employee was uncoiling the pressure washer hose when the employee fell through a skylight fixture and hit the ground, suffering a fractured left knee and left wrist.
An employee was attempting to open a railcar coupler when the railcar ran over the employee's right leg below the knee, resulting in a right leg amputation.
An employee was hospitalized after falling off scaffolding.
An employee fell while walking, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was using a walkie-rider powered industrial truck to move pallets. The employee stopped the machine and stepped off the platform. The machine continued to roll and pinned his foot between the machine and a guardrail on the floor, breaking his ankle.
An employee was operating a firewood cutting machine when it crushed the employee's hand, amputating two fingers.
An employee was unloading furniture from a trailer when he was struck on the head by some stacked furniture, suffering a probable concussion.
An employee was handling large glass when it fell, causing the employee serious abdominal wounds.
An employee was operating a press when the rollers caught the fingers of her left hand. She suffered crushing injuries to the fingers and was hospitalized.

An employee was rolling a liquid gas cylinder from a lift gate to a gas supply room when he lost his footing and fell backwards. He reached up to regain his balance and pulled the cylinder over onto his leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a remote-controlled crane to stage coil rolls for shipment. His right leg was pinned between two coils, causing a laceration to the knee and a fracture to the lower leg.

An employee was gathering paper tube scrap. While he was grabbing a piece of the tubing from a drop table, the table caught his left middle finger as it opened, causing a (non-bone) fingertip amputation.

An employee was stepping out of a tractor when he fell forward, striking his head on the pavement.  He suffered a gash on top of his head (requiring staples), swelling on his brain, a concussion, and memory problems.
An employee was picking up materials out of a hopper when a forklift operator moved forward and hit the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was helping others open a retractable security fence gate. The gate's guide wheel caught his hand, breaking fingers and causing an amputation of the left ring finger above the knuckle.

An employee had been watching the gears on the back side of a pleater, trying to determine what was causing a pleater to "jump" and not work properly. The cuff of her left glove was caught in the gears; as she tried to free it, the gears grabbed the tip of her right glove, pulling in her right index finger and causing an amputation to the finger. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was under a panel machine, clearing jammed wood. When the jam cleared, a chain caught his left middle finger, causing a partial amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident, and was not locked/tagged out.

On November 1, 2018, at 10:05 p.m., an employee in a lab was using a filter leak checker when his left index finger was caught between the bottom of the filter and the metal base of the machine, resulting in the removal of his fingernail and amputation of his fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized after experiencing an respiratory allergic reaction to a flu shot.
An employee was unloading metal stock after it had been bent in a press brake. The employee was caught between the brake and the stock, suffering an amputation to the left middle fingertip.
An employee was unloading doors from a box truck. A pallet of doors fell from the truck's tailgate, breaking the employee's pelvis.
An employee was placing a pallet on the floor in the produce receiving department, tripped backwards over another pallet, and fell to the ground resulting in an open fracture to the right wrist.

An employee was delivering a 75-inch TV in its box. He was carrying the boxed TV from the van when he lost his balance and fell on his left wrist onto a wooden crate, breaking the wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder installing fire dampers at a retail store when the employee fell from the ladder to the floor, sustaining a fracture to the right wrist and right pelvis.

An employee was on a ladder using a wrench to remove brackets from a wash bay wall when the wrench slipped, causing the employee to lose balance and fall approximately 5 feet to the ground. The injured employee suffered a fractured hip.
An employee was hit by a collapsing concrete boom truck, suffering trauma, a severed spine, and paralysis. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a hole from the third floor to the second floor, landing on a concrete floor. The employee suffered broken ribs and a hip/pelvis fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee poured a degreaser into a bucket to clean a floor. He added hot water, then started having breathing problems. He was hospitalized with chemical pneumonitis.

An employee was preparing to perform a load test on a battery system. He was receiving directions over the phone from the lead supervising  technician. He and his co-worker were attempting to divide the 240-volt battery system into two 120-volt systems to perform the load test. His supervisor was directing them on where to divide the battery string. The system was then divided at cell 56 instead of cell 58. He was attempting to move the battery strap when the battery connector was placed on the terminal post, closing the 240-volt system. This created a short in the system, resulting in a DC arc flash that burned his left hand. Gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
While painting the inside of a walk-in freezer, an employee lost consciousness and fell to the floor, suffering a bump on the head.
An employee tripped on cables and fell to the ground, suffering a hip fracture. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was erecting steel in an elevator shaft. A winch was engaged while his hand was on a cable, and his fingers were pulled into the snatch block. His first two fingers were amputated.
An employee suffered a sprained ankle while stepping off a backhoe.
An employee was making repairs to an overhead gantry crane when a second crane moved, pinning the employee's left foot against the rails. The employee suffered a lacerated heel and was hospitalized.

A flaker operator was trying to unplug a flaker's conveyor belt in order to clean up excess bark with a rake. He lost his balance and fell onto the bark accumulation belt's crossbar, suffering five broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a trailer while using a pry bar at a construction site. The employee suffered a broken right wrist and elbow, bruised ribs and chest and road rash on the left side of the face.
An employee slipped and fell to a wet floor, suffering a head injury.
An employee was climbing a ladder to stock shelves when he lost consciousness, falling to the concrete floor and suffering internal bleeding.
An employee was pulling crates off a cooling line when a crate hung up on the line and fell onto the employee's foot. The employee's right big toe was fractured.
An employee was parking a golf cart when it went over a 4-foot retention wall. The employee suffered head trauma and bruising to the buttocks.

An employee was pushing a loaded pallet to the end of a conveyor at a press. The employee noticed a plastic pad lying in front of the pallet and was removing it when the pallet, still rolling, pinched the employee's right ring finger against the metal conveyor end stop amputating it.
An employee was doing a routine equipment check when hot condensate leaked from a steam drum onto his back and shoulder, causing first- and second-degree burns.
An employee fell from an A-frame ladder to the floor, suffering a skull fracture.
An employee was assaulted and robbed in a parking lot, suffering a concussion.
An employee was building wooden forms using a staple gun. The gun shot a staple into the back of his left hand. He was hospitalized for surgery to remove the staple.

An employee was performing a quality test on some small pipes and was putting the tubes in a hydraulic ram press. A three-inch disc was projected from the press, lacerating and injuring the employee's head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's shirt was caught in the chain of a conveyor belt; the employee's arm was dragged into the conveyor and crushed/lacerated.
An employee was using a chop saw when it cut off his left thumb.
An employee was using an air nozzle to clean a dual-head table router. The router's blade hit the employee's right thumb, lacerating it.
A forklift struck an employee, breaking his leg.
An employee was working in a warehouse. A forklift pushed a load forward and the employee was trapped between the load and another forklift, suffering a fractured right foot and a dislocated toe.
An employee was wrapping a pallet with plastic wrap. The plastic wrap ripped and the employee fell backward, striking his head on a rack. He suffered a head injury.

At about 9:40 a.m. on November 2, 2018, an employee was reinstalling a chain onto a heat transfer sublimator's sprocket. The employee's left index finger was caught between the chain and the rotating gear, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee had just filled the slug pot and lost balance while descending from the 2-step platform. The employee fell and broke their left arm.
Two sliding glass doors caught an employee's finger as they closed, causing an amputation.
An employee was helping repair a gate when its pulley rolled onto his right hand. His middle finger was caught between the pulley and the road, and the tip was amputated.

An employee was on the back of a trailer (about 3 or 4 feet off the ground), loading pieces of a roller coaster. The releasing ratchet strap holding the equipment in place slipped; the employee fell, landing on a piece of the roller coaster's track and suffering two broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was flagging traffic in a highway work zone. A car struck the employee, who traveled an estimated 90 feet before landing. The employee suffered broken legs and back and head injuries, with multiple lacerations.

An employee was adjusting his lanyard to get more slack so he could move to a different part of the roof he was working on. He slipped and fell 8 feet from the leading edge of the roof to the ground, breaking his arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was rigging a 6-foot bundle of steel to be hoisted off a roof, approximately 105 feet high, with a crane. When the crane lifted the bundle off the roof, the employee's hand was caught in the wire rope sling. He suffered an amputation to the left index finger.
A heavy tree branch was cut down, striking an employee who was walking below. He suffered a fractured pelvis and fractures to the thoracic spine.
An employee was working in a poly wrap area, taping pipes, when his shirt was caught on a conveyor.
An employee slipped on uneven terrain and fell to the ground. The employee suffered bulging discs.
An employee was trying to remove a scrap wrapper box from below a forming section. A chain and sprocket caught the tip of the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

An equipment delivery driver was lowering coolers using a lift gate. He lost his balance and fell backwards from the lift gate to the ground about 3 or 4 feet below, suffering lacerations to the back and front of his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was disassembling an electric pump when his left ring finger was caught between the shaft and the diffuser. The finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a car wash when she lost consciousness and fell to the floor. She struck the back of her head on the floor, suffering a closed fracture of the occipital bone.
An employee tripped and fell on her back, suffering a broken bone in her neck, a stroke, and a blood clot.
An employee was dragging tree limbs alongside a truck. He tripped on a culvert and fell against it, suffering two broken ribs on his right side. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a maintenance cart in a warehouse. His left leg struck a steel racking system, and the lower leg was broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee was descending an 8-foot stepladder when it twisted, causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered a contusion to the left leg.
An employee stepped on a pallet, lost her footing, and fell over, suffering a fractured ankle that required surgery.
An employee was working with a plant component that was being released from tension. The component struck the employee, causing a fractured cheekbone, right wrist, and four ribs.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it struck another, parked forklift. The employee's left arm was caught between the two pieces of equipment, suffering a contusion.
While helping a coworker perform hydroblasting, an employee was struck in both shins by the high-pressure water stream.
An employee was placing a bed sheet in a laundry compressor. Her right hand was caught in the compressor's rollers, and her right forearm and hand were amputated.

An employee welded an ISC spool on a payoff to reconnect the wire. After completing this task, the employee went to the control panel and pressed the start button to begin running the machine. While the machine was running, the employee noticed a loop was in the loose wire on the payoff spool and attempted to twist the loop before the wire closed on the spool, which would have made an "eye" in the wire. This would have created a snarl and caused the machine to stop. The employee was attempting to get the loop twisted out when the wire closed down on the spool with his fingers in between. The fingers (index, middle and ring) of the right hand were pinched between the wire, resulting in a partial amputation of the index finger to the second joint, middle finger to the second joint, and ring finger to the first joint.
An employee slipped in an attic and fell through the ceiling, suffering upper body bruises.

An employee was entering the building from a lunch break and slipped and fell in the vestibule, fracturing his L1 vertebra. It was raining at the time of the incident and the employee's shoes were wet.
An employee was cleaning a drain when her left hand came into contact with a running riser auger. Four of her fingers were amputated.
An employee fell from the second level to the first level in a mushroom house, suffering a broken tibia.
While moving to a different position on a production line, an employee tripped over a yarn bale and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was de-wiring bales of pulp when a forklift (which was bringing him more bales) dropped a bale onto his leg. He suffered a compound fracture of the leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting 3-inch copper pipe, locked in a tripod vise, with a portable bandsaw. While he was controlling the saw with his right hand and supporting the end section to be cut with his left, his glove caught on the blade and pulled the end of his fourth finger into the running blade. The fingertip was amputated, and he was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a floor hole, suffering a fractured vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was reaching between a semi-trailer and a semi-trailer lift to retrieve tail-light wires when the lift operator activated the lift. The employee's hand was then crushed between the lift and the semi-trailer.
On November 4, 2018, an employee slipped on a tree root, falling and suffering a broken arm.
A super sack full of pellets fell onto an employee's right leg, breaking it about 3 inches below the knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to cut lumber with a saw. The saw energized while his left hand was on top of the lumber; four of his fingers were amputated.
An employee was opening a tank lid from a ladder, about 3 to 4 feet off the ground. The ladder slipped out from under him and he fell to the ground, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a stepladder in a car wash tunnel, wiping down a stainless steel structure and air cylinder with a cloth. The passenger-side grill brush came into contact with the employee's ladder as it pulled away from a vehicle, throwing him to the ground. He landed on his left side and suffered lacerations to the spleen. He was hospitalized.

At 2:39 p.m. on November 5, 2018, an employee was putting a metal storm drain grate (which had been removed for cleaning) back in place. It pinched a finger on his right hand, causing an amputation that left bone visible. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was trying to chunk a box elder tree when a dead limb, about 3 inches thick and 5 feet long, struck him in the face. He suffered forehead, nose, and eye area injuries.

While removing a tree branch from the edge of a one-story-high roof, an employee fell through a skylight to the concrete floor. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a lacerated liver, and a broken wrist.

An employee was unloading fertilizer from the cargo hold on a vessel. The employee was standing next to the hauling bucket when the load was grabbed. The employee's leg was pinned between the hauling bucket and the cargo hold wall. The employee suffered crushing injuries and fracture to the lower right leg.
While bending over to pick up a tool, an employee heard a pop in his lower back. He felt pain as he tried to straighten up.
An employee's right glove was caught by a rotating tube in a tube straightener. The employee's hand was pulled into the roller, causing an amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was operating a road roller when it rolled down an embankment and tipped over, throwing him to the ground. His left hand was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was trying to push something off the auger in a fresh mozzarella mixer. The machine cycled, causing a partial amputation of the employee's left index fingertip.

A sewage transfer pump had been installed on a vessel; during the testing and jogging phase of the installation, the pump was engaged. A mechanic's hand was caught in the drive belt/pulley, and his left middle finger was amputated.

An employee was struck by a forklift as it backed up. The employee fell backward and hit their head on the warehouse floor, suffering a small brain bleed, a fracture to the back of the skull, bruising of the left eye, and a small left cheek laceration.
An employee was struck by a tugger after its operator dismounted. The employee's leg was broken.
An employee was trying to remove a breaker plate from an extrusion machine. A piece of metal flew off, striking and lacerating the employee's neck.
An employee was repairing an excavator arm when it fell out of its sling, amputating the employee's index finger.
An employee's arm was pulled into a moving conveyor on a recycling sort line. The employee's left ulna was broken.

An employee was driving a powered pallet truck when it veered left toward a rack. The employee jumped off; the pallet truck continued to move forward and struck the employee's right foot, causing multiple deep lacerations.
An employee was cutting window muntins with a chop saw. The saw cut off the tip of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was running a chamfer machine when a board got stuck. While the employee was attempting to unjam it, the employee's finger was pinched between the machine and the board, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was setting up a press brake when it cycled. The die came down on the employee's fingers, causing an amputation.
An employee was using a food slicer to cut onions. The slicer amputated a small portion of the employee's left index fingertip. The guard on the slicer was not on, and a glove was not being worn.

An employee was pulling serial numbers off a hydraulic valve. The strap that was being used to hold the valve snapped and the valve fell, pinning the employee against a forklift. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing/removing a gantry arm on a finishing line. An I-beam dropped, crushing and fracturing the employee's hand against a fixed structure.
An employee was on a palletizer when it fell on top of him, resulting in a cut to the head and a broken jaw.
An employee tripped and fell while entering a store from a parking lot. She fell, breaking her right leg.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a board. The saw cut two of the employee's fingers off.
A slitter operator was removing a piece of plastic that had fallen when the slitter machine was activated. It amputated the tip of the employee's finger.

On November 5, 2018, an employee was placing scrap metal onto a trailer when the load began to shift and the employee dismounted from the trailer. A few pieces of steel slid from the trailer and onto the employee's right leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

A truck pulled under a conveyor system (being used to remove dirt that had been excavated from an interior courtyard). The truck's canopy roller struck the conveyor, moving it forward and causing it to strike a nearby employee and break three of his ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unjam a four-saw edger machine. The employee's right arm was caught in the machine and amputated at the shoulder.
An employee's feet fell through the grate covering a pit, coming into contact with an auger in the pit. The employee suffered amputations to multiple toes on the left foot.

On November 5, 2018, a painter was cutting in the paint from a wall to a ceiling, working from a scaffold 6 feet high. The employee fell from the scaffold, landing on the concrete floor below and suffering fractures to both wrists and a fractured skull. The employee was hospitalized.

A roofer was on a one-tier rolling scaffold, applying lateral pressure to metal roof sheeting. The scaffold fell over and the employee struck the pavement, suffering a bruised right elbow and a fractured vertebra and needing stitches to the head.

On November 4, 2018, an employee was standing on the loading dock, helping dump 50-pound bags of salt into a salt hopper. The employee lost balance and fell about 6 feet to the ground, suffering four fractured ribs, then a collapsed lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a metal roof and fell 8 feet from a ladder onto a concrete sidewalk. The employee sustained a concussion and a bruised elbow and knee.

While helping offload concrete traffic barriers at a construction site, two employees were struck by a flatbed truck as it backed up. One of them suffered a broken right foot and ankle and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
While hanging doors, an employee fell from a fourth-story balcony, landing on the ground 40 feet below. The employee suffered a fractured right wrist and a contusion to the lower back.
An employee was helping close a fence when his finger was caught between the fence's top horizontal post and its metal guide roller. The tip was amputated.

An employee was working on top of a ladder when it shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a spiral fracture to the right femur. The employee's safety gear was unclipped at the time of the incident.
While installing lights, an employee fell from a ladder to the floor and suffered a fracture to the left femur.

An employee was on the third step of an A-frame 6-foot ladder in the galley kitchen removing a long fluorescent light cover when he lost his balance and fell on a 30-inch-tall, 30-inch-wide steam kettle that was half full of 200 degree Fahrenheit water. This resulted in second and third degree burns to his right calf and right lower part of his arm and hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift in reverse toward trash compactors when the forklift crushed her foot.

On November 6, 2018, at 1:30 p.m., an employee incurred an amputation of the tip of his left thumb when his hand was caught between two print-down sections on a flexo-gluer-folder machine as he was closing the sections.
An employee was assisting a press brake operator. The employee's hand was in the point of operation when the press brake actuated, resulting in the amputation of four fingers on the left hand.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a tree limb when it became wedged in the limb. A coworker used his chainsaw to cut part of the limb to relieve pressure on the chainsaw. As the employee was retrieving his chainsaw, he moved in the direction of his coworker and his left pinky came in contact with his coworker's chainsaw blade. His left pinky finger had to be medically amputated.

A bolt sheared in the middle of a 3-ton feed mixer. An employee was attempting to align the hole with a punch while another employee hit the switch on and off.  This on/off action pulled the first employee down into the feed mixer. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right shoulder and arm, fractures on the right side of the face, and head lacerations on the right side that required stitches.
An employee was about to clamp a small part into a horizontal bandsaw when the hydraulic clamp smashed his fingers. He suffered partial amputations to his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was standing on a truck bed, positioning bundles that were being loaded onto the truck by an overhead crane. The crane lifted a bundle on the truck and it struck the employee, breaking his left femur.
A pre-framed interior wall fell over and struck an employee, resulting in cracked vertebrae.

On November 6, 2018, after spending about 45 minutes unloading cardboard boxes containing chocolate packed with dry ice from a trailer, an employee became ill, vomited, left the trailer, and lost consciousness. Suffering from carbon dioxide intoxication, the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing inside the building looking out a window on the garage door. The employee knocked on the window to get the attention of employees outside. One employee that was outside knocked on the glass in response. The window shattered and the injured employee had shards of glass enter his eye, resulting in the probable loss of the eye.
While operating a guillotine blade cutter on the mixing line, an employee received an injury resulting in the amputation of the ring and pinky fingertips. The middle finger was also crushed.
An employee became ill while running on a treadmill during his annual physical. Suffering from a fast heart rate and high blood pressure, he was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while opening a door, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee felt sick (suffering from heat stress and dehydration/malnutrition) at the end of the work day.

An employee was removing rigging hooks and chains from a concrete storm drain that was being hoisted into a trench when his hand was caught between the hook and the concrete structure. His hand was fractured and lacerated.
An employee sustained a broken nose after being struck in the face by a tablet computer that fell from a residential roof.

A backhoe was removing tub and frame forms from a new drill pier foundation. An employee got his right index finger caught between the hoisting chain and the bucket of the backhoe resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a mechanical vegetable slicer to cut squash. Her left hand slipped during the process resulting in the amputation of her left middle fingertip.
An employee's finger was caught between the operators handle of a pallet jack and the VRC gate, resulting in a left fingertip amputation.
An employee was on break walking around the building when a truck drove through the parking lot with lights off and hit her. She suffered pelvic and shoulder fractures.
A temporary employee was moving pallets using a powered industrial truck. The truck went out of control and her lower left leg was broken.
An employee was performing maintenance on a semi truck on the side of the road. Another semi truck struck the one he was working on, and his right leg was broken. He was hospitalized.
While closing a roll-up door, an employee tripped and fell onto his shoulder and hip, fracturing his clavicle and pelvis.
An employee was training on a pallet jack. While reversing, he struck a parked pallet jack and sustained a foot laceration.
An employee sustained a fractured leg after being caught between a concrete wall and a front-end loader, resulting in hospitalization.
A chain on a tote machine amputated the tip of an employee's right index finger, below the nail bed.
An employee tossed a dirt clod at the injured employee, who lost his balance, fell to the ground, and fractured his right arm while trying to break his fall.

On 11/06/2018, at 10:17 a.m., an employee was in a golf cart spraying the lawn in the median when a truck struck the golf cart. The golf cart was on the roadway. The employee sustained injuries to his pelvis, spine and ribs, as well as lacerations, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to remove a slab of wood from a conveyor line that had hung up on a metal chute. His right hand was caught between the slab of wood and the metal chute causing fractures to the right hand and fingers.
An employee was using a load brindle to load a truck. The truck rolled backward, pinning the employee against the load. She suffered a partial collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking, tripped over a root and fell resulting in a kidney injury.
An employee was reaching for a roll of masking tape when he slipped on an aircraft stairway and fell to the concrete ground, fracturing his left arm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee came into contact with a 5 kV power line and sustained an electric shock, requiring hospitalization.
An employee developed an MRSA infection and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a shear when it came down on the employee's fingers, resulting in amputations to the left index and ring fingers. The guard was in the up position at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking downstairs when he lost his footing on the last step. He fell into the guardrail, suffering two fractured ribs and a kidney laceration.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and as he was crossing a threshold, he lost control and the jack struck his left foot, fracturing toes.

A forklift operator was attempting to make a three-point turn after backing up from an aisle. An employee had their back towards the reversing forklift and was struck. The employee's foot was caught in the forklift's wheel well resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was removing a 200-pound paper roll from a bar on a press. His middle finger was caught between the plate on the side of the machine and the bar. The finger was crushed and had to be amputated.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when the blade touched his hand, causing the amputation of his right middle finger.

An employee was unloading a piece of machinery (approximately 800 lbs.) down a ramp with the assistance of other employees. The employee's foot became lodged in the mud and he could not get out of the way when the machine came down the ramp. The machine then hit the employee resulting in a broken right leg and ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was stocking shelves from a ladder and fell from the ladder to the floor, injuring their head, neck, and spine.
On November 6, 2018, an employee was delivering parts to a store and slipped from stairs resulting in hospitalization for head trauma.
An employee was adjusting a part of the pneumatic tool on a piece of equipment when his left index finger was caught by the tool and amputated.
An employee was conducting off-road, nighttime motorcycle training. The employee's motorcycle struck a tree stump along a trail, and the employee's right foot was broken.

An employee was walking by a transfer conveyor located at about knee level that moves dimensional lumber into a sorting and stacking machine when he noticed that a board was stuck on the conveyor. As he attempted to unjam it, a running chain and sprocket power transmission apparatus caught his right middle finger, resulting in an amputation at the middle knuckle. The conveyor was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was raising a lift gate while standing on it with a hand cart. The hand cart moved, and when the employee attempted to retrieve it, the employee's right foot was smashed in the lift gate. The employee suffered dislocated or fractured toes on the right foot.
On November 7, 2018, an employee stepped on a wire that cut his toe.
An employee was carrying a floor truss across other set trusses when the truss he stepped on broke and he fell 9 feet to the floor, fracturing his ribs and shoulder.
An employee was lifting metal coils via a crane and attachment when the employee's hand was pinched between a metal coil and coil lifting device, resulting in an amputation to the left pinky finger.

An employee was helping a delivery driver offload equipment from an 18-wheeler trailer. He fell from the trailer to the ground about 3 feet below, suffering a head laceration (which required sutures) and a broken left third rib. He was hospitalized.

On November 7, 2018, a quality technician was providing training to one of the departments and was speaking to a co-worker while by her desk. Her foot got wedged in the lower opening of a metal skid that normally holds layers of gum. This caused her to lose balance and fall over causing a closed fracture of the left ankle.

An employee was on a roof, hanging Christmas lights along the edge. He fell off the edge, landing about 9 1/2 feet below with his heels on the edge of the sidewalk and the fronts of his feet in the grass. He suffered two fractured heels and, possibly, fractures to the left tibia and fibula. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.

An employee operating a stand-on motorized pallet jack got his left leg and foot caught between the pallet jack and the platform of a machine that he was delivering materials to. The employee sustained a fractured tibia, fibula and ankle.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to read the meter on the outside of a business facility when he fell off the ladder to the ground, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was pushing a wood rail through the blade of a table saw when the rail broke, causing the employee's right index finger to contact the saw blade.
An employee was climbing a ladder with a pneumatic nail gun. The nail gun actuated and sent a nail through his knee.

An employee was using a rag to clean the paddles on a machine. The machine caught the rag, pulling the employee's hand in; the employee's left middle finger became wedged against the hopper wall and the blade on the rotating conveyor. The finger was amputated up to the second knuckle, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling orders from warehouse shelving when a forklift ran over her foot, causing a sprained left ankle.

An employee was taking down a shore post for deck forming. After removing the pin from the shore post, he put his left hand on the top portion of the post and his right middle finger in one of the adjustment holes for the pin. When he proceeded to remove the shore post, it slid down and his middle finger was caught between the adjustable top slide and the adjustment hole itself, lacerating the very tip of his middle finger and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was standing next to a bulldozer when its blade was set down on his foot, causing two fractures. He was hospitalized.

At about 4:10 p.m. on November 7, 2018, an employee was operating a foot-pedal-activated riveting machine. The employee's left thumb accessed the point-of-operation during a riveting cycle, and a rivet (along with the employee's glove) was embedded in the  thumb.
An employee was participating in a coiled pipe cutting activity when the piece being cut sprung loose and hit the employee, fracturing several vertebrae in his back.
An employee was moving a forming mold when it slid off its blocks and crushed the employee's left middle fingertip, resulting in a medical amputation of the finger.
An employee was running a meat mixing machine when his right index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was racking drill pipe from a derrick mans platform into a drill rack when a pipe likely swung at the top and struck the employee's head, resulting in a fractured skull.

On November 7, 2018, at approximately 6:15 p.m., an employee was working with a coworker to troubleshoot a counterbalanced forklift. The employees were working on the engine, but immediately prior to the accident had trouble getting the transmission to disengage. They were standing opposite of each other on either side of the forklift with one hand on the ignition switch key and the other in the engine compartment. The forklift's transmission was left in gear and safety switch was disconnected or otherwise not functional to prevent unexpected startup and rolling. Suddenly, the forklift started to roll a few feet and struck a nearby feeder machine staged on saw horses that had some plastic and aluminum material placed on it. Upon impact, that material shifted counterclockwise and struck the injured employee, crushing and pinning him against the forklift. He suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was adjusting the outboard stand of a tube mill. The crow bar slipped and the employee fell backwards into the machine behind it resulting in a bruised lung.

An employee was stepping out onto a 12-foot-wide, 6-foot-deep wood platform raised to a third-story window opening with a telescoping boom forklift. The platform flipped off the side of the forks and the employee fell about 24 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a fractured neck vertebra and was hospitalized.

An employee was putting freight away and was cutting open zip ties with a knife. He missed the package and the knife hit his arm, resulting in a large laceration to his left wrist. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was training on a forklift when it struck a column. The employee's left foot was broken.
An employee was walking when she felt pain and fell to the floor, breaking her left femur.

An employee was laying a cement block on the second floor balcony of a new residential building. At the same time, a crane was hoisting a pallet on the eighth floor when a cement block unit fell from the pallet and struck the employee on the balcony. This knocked the employee from the balcony to the ground floor below. The employee suffered a fractured clavicle.

On 11/7/2018, at approximately 8:45 AM CT, an employee was installing a polymer bell and a shackle between an eye bolt inserted through a pole and energized conductor. He made contact with the hoist that was attached to the energized conductor while attempting to push a cotter pin through the shackle pin. The contact with the hoist caused a phase-to-ground incident, electric shocking the employee. Gloves were not worn at the time.

An employee released the top clamps holding the central arm of a weld fixture in place. The arm was under pressure, and it swung down quickly. The employee jumped out of the way and twisted his right knee, causing a fracture just below the knee.

An employee was observing as a crew spooled up a quarter-mile of 3-inch poly pipe. The tail end of the pipe caught on a bush and the middle section pulled inward, knocking the employee to the ground and breaking his right arm and leg. He was hospitalized.

The injured employee was using a chalk line to mark the location of conduit under the roof membrane. The employee slipped on standing water/ice that was near the flag line and fell towards the warning line system. As the employee tried to catch himself, he fell approximately 17 feet off the roof to the ground below. The employee suffered a left hip fracture and lower lumbar fractures (L3 and L4 vertebrae).
Upon turning to exit a van, an employee missed the bumper he intended on using as a step and fell approximately 42" to the ground below fracturing two bones in his lower leg.

An employee had just cut the last metal band from a bundle of steel tubes that had been placed on top of another bundle of steel tubes. Both bundles collapsed toward his right leg, causing blunt trauma and a possible broken tibia.
An employee was collapsing a set of stairs. The stairs caught the employee's left middle fingertip, cutting it. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee fell to the floor while walking, fracturing her left femur.

An employee was reroofing a two-story condo complex. While reaching to access a ladder, the employee slipped on debris and fell 18 feet, landing on the ground and coming into contact with a bush. The employee suffered cuts on the eyebrow and lips, a minor fracture of the eyebrow, and a suspected concussion. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was closing an access door at the bottom of a spray dryer when a rotary valve partially amputated three fingers on his left hand.

An employee was walking along the ridge of a roof when he slipped and fell approximately 10 feet and landed on a concrete patio.  He sustained broken bones in both legs and ankles, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was putting a skid around a 24-inch pipe, which was in a sling attached to a crane. The crane raised the sling and the employee's right leg was broken between two sections of the pipe.
