An employee was using a manual lathe to remove Teflon coating from a 5-inch steel pipe. When the machine was turned on, an unsecured pipe broke the employee's left hand, necessitating surgery.
An employee was pulling laundry out of a washer when she heard a pop in her left arm. She had suffered a strain or tear in the arm.
An employee's foot turned in a rut in the ground, and the employee's ankle was broken.

An employee was sitting at a desk in a chair when she stood up and her foot became caught on the strap of her bag. She lost her balance and fell directly onto the floor, breaking her left femur and requiring surgery.
An employee was working with an augerbore pipe. His skin contacted concrete and he suffered chemical burns. He was hospitalized.
On November 8, 2018, an employee was sanitizing a 4-by-4 bucket. The bucket hit the employee in the head, causing a brain bleed that required hospitalization.
A temporary employee was moving aluminum extrusions to a saw area. The blade of a radial arm saw cut his left index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out the blade of a gang rip saw. As the arbor/blade assembly was set on the saw's spindle it lacerated the employee's left forearm, right palm, and right little finger.
An employee stepped into a hot water trench, burning his left foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to remove a wheel from a rear wheel manipulator. The air cylinder holding pressure to the wheel became stuck. The employee worked to remove the wheel while the power was off; it was then turned on, and the employee's left little finger was amputated to the first knuckle. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee had positioned a jack under a steel casing and was hand-pumping it when it slipped. It struck him in the forehead, cutting him and fracturing his skull.
An employee was cleaning a cement mixer when his right leg was caught in the mixer paddles. His right leg was broken and his left knee was lacerated.
An employee was troubleshooting a meat forming machine when the sensor tripped and the machine caught his hand. His right ring finger was injured.

An employee was removing a piece of material from an airlock when the blades amputated the tip and fingernail of his right middle finger. The airlock had been locked out, but then reenergized, before the incident.

An employee was removing the guard from a driven roller assembly (to see why the roller was not operating) when his right index finger was caught between the drive belt and the pulley. The finger was amputated just below the nail line; he also suffered a small laceration to the right middle finger. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor belt when his right sleeve wrapped around a horizontal rotating shaft. He suffered a fracture to the right forearm.

An employee was on a mezzanine to start to dismantle it. He was in the process of moving a piece of plywood that had been installed to cover an opening in the mezzanine where an exhaust stack had been previously installed. While in the process of removing the plywood, he lost his footing and fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering a fractured elbow and leg, as well as a cracked pelvis and hip.

An employee was removing accumulated metal from an overflow trough with a metal lancing rod. The rod became separated from the holder, and oxygen accumulated in the lancing tube and ignited. The employee's left palm received a second-degree burn.
An employee was hit by a car while walking in a parking lot. The employee suffered an arm/wrist injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was in a walk-in refrigerator when she tripped on the wheel of a rolling cart. She fell on the stainless steel floor, hitting her face. She suffered a suspected broken nose and bleeding on the brain, as well as a possible concussion; she was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting and applying plastic wrap when acid from a leaking battery on a pallet splashed into his eyes.
An employee was troubleshooting an edge bander machine when his right little finger was caught in the machine. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was trying to bend the top rail of a rig mat frame using a pry bar so that he could install a filler block. While his right foot was inside the frame of the rig mat for leverage, the bar slipped, and the momentum caused him to fall to the ground with his foot still in the rig mat frame. His leg was broken above the ankle. He was hospitalized for surgery on his right leg.
An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a radial arm saw. The saw amputated his left index finger.

An employee was walking by a lower pulley that had a wire rope running through two large pulleys when he slipped and grabbed the wire rope to keep himself from falling. His fingers were then pulled into the rotating pulley, resulting in the partial amputation of three fingers.

An employee was preparing to perform preventive maintenance on an air handler. The air handler had not come to a full stop when he lost his balance and went to hold onto the machine. Three of his fingers were caught between the belt and the pulley, resulting in avulsions.
Two employees were engaged in horseplay when they fell to the floor. One broke his leg and knee.
An employee was unloading a truck for delivery when a bed rail fell on the employee's finger, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was descending a ladder. The employee's foot caught on a ladder-up device and the employee fell 18 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and fingers and was hospitalized.

At 11:00 a.m. on November 8, 2018, an employee was feeding an HDPE plastic lumber panel into a self-feeding table saw. The scrap piece being cut off the panel kicked back at the employee, striking him in the hand and chest and breaking his left ring finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was chasing a student to stop him from going through a fire exit. She turned and broke her ankle.

An employee was assembling a large fan when his glove was caught in the sheave of the fan as he manually turned the drive. The tip of his left middle finger was crushed, necessitating a surgical amputation up to the knuckle.
An employee was beveling a pipe flange with a compact router. The router's bit jammed and struck the employee on the right hand, lacerating it.
An employee was using a 5,000 psi high-pressure washer. The water stream penetrated his steel-toed rubber boot, cutting the top of his foot.
At about 11:53 p.m., an employee was driving on patrol when his vehicle struck a pole at 15 MPH. The employee seems to be paralyzed from the neck down.

An employee was using a cut-off wheel to cut off the bolt suspension of a customer's vehicle when it shattered, causing a laceration to his left arm. Wheel fragments became embedded in the wound, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a round steak with a vertical meat band saw. The meat slipped, and the blade amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was operating a saw when his right index finger came into contact with the blade, causing a laceration to the finger that resulted in an amputation.

An employee was cleaning a press roller with ink buildup when his right thumb was caught between two rollers, resulting in a partial amputation of the thumb tip. The pinch point was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was pouring UV primer from one container to another. Some of it spilled on his left pants leg, later causing chemical burns to his leg. A Tyvek-type suit was being worn, but it had ripped.
An employee had removed the filter from the end of a vacuum pump when the rotating fan blade severely cut his middle fingertip. The pump was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was climbing a ladder holding a bushel basket. The basket hit a shelf, which fell; the employee flipped backwards off the ladder and landed on his back on the floor. He suffered a broken vertebra in his lower back, with fragments sticking into the spinal canal.
An employee was moving a 3-foot-wide sheet of metal when its edge cut his left lower forearm. He was hospitalized. Cut-resistant gloves were being worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was punching holes in metal pole base plates using a piranha machine. A piece of metal flew into his left eye, injuring the side of his pupil. He was hospitalized for eye surgery. Eye protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.

Two employees were providing maintenance to a vacuum wheel when their hands were caught in the vacuum wheel. One employee received broken bones in his hand and forearm, requiring hospitalization. The second employee suffered acute carpal tunnel in the left wrist. The vacuum wheel was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee tripped over a pallet, falling on his left side and suffering a hip/femur fracture. He was hospitalized, needing surgery.

An employee was preparing to brew tea on a dual tea maker/dispenser machine. A customer came up to get some tea from the other dispenser. When the customer pulled on the handle, the housing was pulled too, causing the hot water going into the filter to spill onto and burn the employee's right arm and hand.
An employee fell from a tow truck and the employee's head struck the ground, requiring hospitalization.

A crew was felling a tree on a transmission power line. When the last cut was made, the tree came off the stump, crashing to the ground. Due to the terrain, it bounced and came straight back, striking an employee in the left leg. He suffered a compound fracture between the knee and the ankle.
An employee was preparing a bus for daily use when she slipped and fell in the gravel lot next to the bus, striking the tire and rim and injuring her leg and hip.
An employee was loading a truck when she lost balance and fell off the ramp resulting in a fractured right leg.
On November 9, 2018, an employee was changing a battery on a powered industrial truck. The employee's finger was pinched between the battery and the lifting equipment, suffering a partial amputation.
At about 7:00 a.m. on November 9, 2018, an employee was walking in a blacktop-surfaced parking lot. The employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was assembling a mold, holding the block with his left hand on the table and placing the top of the mold with his right hand. The top section of the mold tipped over and crushed the employee's left index finger on the table, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was fabricating a bracket on an iron punch press. The press activated while his hand was still in it, and its punch partially amputated his left thumb.

Two employees were doing maintenance work on a dust collector. One employee's right index finger was caught in a belt and pulley on the machine, and was amputated just below the nail bed. The machine was not locked out or guarded at the time.
An employee was adjusting a building's flag when his left middle fingertip was caught in a wire rope and amputated.
An employee fell on a shipping dock, suffering a hairline fracture of the left femur near the hip.
An employee was flipping a pallet on material handling equipment when he lost balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering crushed vertebrae.
As she was about to use a ladder to climb down from a roof, an employee slipped and fell off the roof. She suffered fractured ribs and a concussion.
An employee slipped and fell on a frosty deck, breaking an ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working with a group of three other employees to strip a column form. The employee was holding the column form upright so that when it loosened it would not fall, while another employee was striking the outside of the form with a metal burke bar to loosen the concrete. The injured employee's left hand slid down the side of the form and the burke bar struck it, causing a laceration and fracture to the left ring finger.
A 9-foot alligator bit an employee on his right leg.
An employee was taking a part out of a pointer clamp when the clamp caught the employee's left index finger, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was bending a piece of metal tubing on a horizontal tube bender. The employee's thumb was caught between the tube and the die, and the tip of the thumb was amputated.
While driving a sit-down forklift, an employee backed up into a rack, suffering an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was performing maintenance on a generator at the plant and fell through an open platform. The employee sustained rib and tailbone injuries.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move steel tubing when one stack of tubing fell and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg.
An employee was walking on pavement, delivering mail, when his patellar tendon tore and his knee buckled.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut wood. The chainsaw kicked back and struck the employee in the kneecap, causing a laceration.

An employee was arc welding when the welding rod came loose from the employee's welding gun. The rod became lodged near the employee's ankle, causing second- and third-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning his service weapon when it was unintentionally discharged, striking his upper thigh.
An employee fell 12 feet while erecting a steel beam, suffering a broken eye socket, nose, and leg.
An employee was measuring the level of a sand silo when his head struck the metal top of the silo. He suffered a subdural hematoma.
Employees were using a trencher to dig when the trencher chain struck a natural gas line and exploded. Two employees suffered burns.

An employee was climbing onto an out of service frac tank. At the top of the tank, he tripped on a rope and fell about 9' 4'' to the ground. He experienced three broken ribs, a concussion, a fractured wrist, a ruptured 
spleen, ad a collapsed lung. His personal fall arrest harness was not tied off to an anchor point at the time of the incident.
An employee was climbing a ladder to paint. The hinge was not locked in place, causing the ladder to collapse. He fell to the ground, injuring his back/spine.
A forklift backed over an employee's right foot, breaking it.
An employee was riding as a passenger in a golf cart. The employee's right foot was hanging out the side of the cart when it struck a concrete wall/barrier, fracturing the right foot.

An employee was leaving work for the day. After turning off the lights, he turned to walk out the exit door of the building and tripped over a cart that is used to move supplies and equipment around in the warehouse/docks. He sustained a compound fracture to his right arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating an automated bagger. The bagger cycled and the seal bar pinched the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was checking the tension on a belt on a vehicle. The employee's left hand was pulled into the belt and pulley, causing a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was loading rolls of paper on a skid. He lifted the paper up to put a wedge on the skid when the hoist tipped and a roll fell off the skid. It rolled against the employee's right ankle, breaking it.
On November 10, 2018, one of a temporary employee's left-hand fingers was pinched between a truss table and an ejector. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he fell to the floor, suffering a compound fracture to his right leg.
An employee was holding a plastic water line under a sink while using a razor knife to trim the line. The knife cut his left little finger, lacerating a tendon. He was hospitalized, needing surgery.
An employee tripped on a 5/8-inch-thick steel plate, used as a wheel stop for forklifts. He fell, breaking his left hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder hanging a flag up on a flag pole when the employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering contusions and a concussion.

An employee was cleaning the wheels on an oven infeed conveyor using a drill with a brush attachment when his hand slipped and his glove was caught in the wheels, resulting in amputation of his right index fingertip.

Employees were changing a gasket on a steam line, using a tubular welded scaffold with 28-inch aluminum work planks two sections high. An employee fell about 12 feet from the scaffold, making contact with the scaffold on the way down and suffering five broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a laceration to the forehead. A harness was being worn at the time of the incident, but had been unhooked.

On 11/11/18, an employee was looking for a cargo container on the vessel. He had climbed a ladderway to a catwalk when he lost his balance and fell backwards over a safety railing. He fell approximately 9 feet onto the deck level, before rolling and falling farther onto the main deck. He suffered a dislocated left knee and ankle and had some broken bones in his left foot.

Two employees were pulling a loaded dumpster along a sidewalk. The dumpster's wheels locked up, pushing the front of it into a scaffold on the sidewalk; one employee's hand was wedged between the dumpster and the scaffold's pole. His left hand swelled.

At about 9:00 a.m. on November 11, 2018, an employee was removing a basket of cooked pasta from a pasta cooker. The bottom of the basket got caught on the cooker.  As she pulled it, the cooker tipped over onto her; the water came out and caused second- and third-degree burns to her lower left leg and foot.
At 9:00 a.m. on November 11, 2018, an employee fell off a ladder while stocking shelves. The employee landed on the floor, suffering a leg injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the rig floor watching another employee operate a set of power tugs when the tugs slipped and rotated, hitting the employee. The employee was knocked from the rig floor and struck the ground. The employee suffered a fractured lower right leg and right wrist.
An employee was stocking shelves with apparel from a rolling platform ladder when the employee fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was rigging a load when his hand was caught between the load and a pendant line. His arm and finger(s) were broken.

On November 10, 2018, an employee was in an aerial lift using a propane and oxygen cutting torch while performing demolition of a vessel. During the demolition process, the vessel caught on fire and the employee jumped out of the aerial lift. The employee sustained burns from the fire and a fractured pelvis and wrist from the fall.
An employee tripped on a piece of plastic shrink wrap that was hanging off a pallet. She fell, breaking her hip.

An employee was opening straw bales and loading them into a conveyor. As he was trying to cut the string off a bale, the string snagged and cut his left middle finger, causing a laceration that led to an amputation.
An employee was removing turkey gizzards with a gizzard removing machine when the back of the employee's left hand made contact with the gear section of the machine and was degloved.
An employee was attempting to break up ice in a frozen water line when a fitting broke, causing the line to whip around and hit the employee's leg. The employee sustained leg fractures.
An employee was grooving the end of a steel pipe using a roll grooving machine. The machine caught his right middle fingertip, cutting it off.
An employee was in an aisle, doing cycle counts with a scanner, when a forklift struck him. He suffered a broken jaw and skull.
An employee fell approximately 8 feet while descending a ladder and struck his head.

An employee was attempting to close a gun vault in the rear bed of a law enforcement officer's patrol vehicle when the employee's right third fingertip was pinched between the drawer and cabinet of the gun vault.  The incident resulted in the loss of the right third fingertip past the fingernail and a fractured bone.
An employee was walking in the parking lot, slipped on ice and fell breaking ribs and suffering a punctured lung.
An employee suffered partial amputations to the right first, second, and third digits when her fingers were caught in the rollers of a machine.

An employee was stepping out of a skid steer inside a building. The employee's foot was caught on the bucket and the employee lost balance and fell to the concrete, suffering a right hip/pelvis fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to his car after work, slipped on a patch of ice and sustained a dislocated ankle and two broken bones. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell and was hospitalized because she could not put any pressure on her leg.
An employee was struck by a plastic shopping cart, lost balance, and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip and wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a hinge leaf into the gang mill. When the clamps activated her right middle finger was caught between the clamp and the fixture and amputated above the third knuckle.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when the ladder slipped and he fell to the ground, fracturing his hip and right shoulder.

A trailer shifted while an employee was standing on it. He lost his balance, reached out to catch himself, and placed his left index finger in the pinch point of a power swivel he had been loading onto a trailer. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was dismantling scaffold that was three frames high and had planking that was three planks wide. As he was dismantling the ladder portion, the ladder tipped forward and he lost his balance and fell 18 feet to the ground, suffering a left heel fracture, a right ankle fracture and compression of numbers 1, 2 and 3 vertebrae.
An employee was operating a bender machine and caught their right index finger between the part and the clamping device on the bender resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee's glove was caught between a conveyor and drive sprocket while the employee was pushing accumulated bagels forward on the conveyor, resulting in a partial amputation of her right index finger.
An employee was on a five-foot scaffold conducting framing operations and fell when the scaffold  was moved.  The employee suffered injuries requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing a shear pin in a cog and drive chain system when the employee's left index finger was caught in a pinch point between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was unpacking lockers from a shipping box and stacked a bundle of locker doors to the side. The employee then attempted to move several of the locker doors. A pile of doors fell onto the employee's left leg, fracturing it.

At about 9:00 a.m. on November 12, 2018, an employee was testing a 6000 HP electric motor.  A piece of metal came off the motor and struck the right side of the employee's face, causing multiple head and face fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an electric hand jack on the mixing floor when the jack backed over his right foot, bending his toes back. His toes broke, requiring surgery.

An employee was cleaning a roll coater machine while it was on the cleaning cycle. While she was wiping the rollers with a rag, the cleaning cycle reversed, causing the rollers to reverse. The rag was then caught in the ingoing nip point, pulling her right index finger into the machine. Her fingertip was amputated.
An employee's right arm was amputated in a spinning towel dryer.
An employee was standing on the third ring of a 6-foot ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. His lower left leg was fractured and he was hospitalized, needing surgery.
An employee was running a shear machine when it amputated his right index finger.
An employee tripped while climbing back into a work station. The employee's hand entered the gap in a saw blade's guarding, and the blade severed the top of the employee's ring finger.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing her right ankle.
An employee was operating a cold saw and suffered an amputation to the left index finger and part of the middle finger.
An employee was cutting scrap foam seat material into smaller pieces using a bandsaw. The saw blade amputated the first joint of the employee's right thumb.
An employee was using a grinder to buff concrete when the wheel broke apart, striking the employee in the chest and causing a chest contusion.

An employee was packaging cheese when the line where the cups go in became jammed from excess cheese. While he was cleaning the area around the cups, the machine became unjammed and caught his lab coat on a metal chain. The chain then fractured his left forearm.
An employee exited a vehicle in the parking lot and was walking toward the office entrance when the employee fell on the wet concrete pavement and fractured the right hip.

An employee was directing a large articulating forklift that was moving some insulation off a flatbed truck. Two bales of insulation were stacked vertically on the forklift when the top bale slipped off, falling onto an employee and breaking the employee's hip.
An employee was watching traffic when a rotted pole's base snapped, causing the pole to strike the employee on his back and shoulder. He suffered back and neck injuries.
An employee was shocked and burned on the left hand while working on a light switch.

An employee was replacing the bolts that held the tongue to the main frame. The trailer was on the jack stands. Using the torch, he cut out the bolts on the left side then cut out the bolts on the right side. Some slag was still holding the tongue frame to the main frame. The employee used a bar to pry them apart when the front of the trailer fell off the jack stands and onto his foot breaking all five toes.

An employee and a coworker were retrieving a large aluminum-frame screen from among several other aluminum-frame screens. One of the screens hit the employee's left index finger, catching it against the side of a press and causing an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was cleaning an HVAC unit when his left hand entered the unit and contacted the belt, resulting in an amputation injury to his left middle and ring fingers. The unit was running at the time.
An employee ran into a flatbed trailer while driving a golf cart, suffering rib fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing bases from a truck's trailer when it lifted off the ground. The employee fell off the trailer and hit the sidewalk, suffering a shattered shoulder, a broken left arm, three broken ribs, a punctured lung, a broken left hip, and a broken bone in his back.
An employee was performing maintenance on a piece of heavy equipment when he slipped and fell from the machine to the ground, injuring his head and ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was stacking lead bottoms (lead blocks) beside the furnace in order for them to be transferred to the cast and alloying department. The employee stacked the blocks one on top of another and unhooked the gantry crane hooks. While raising the gantry crane to reposition it, one of the hooks was caught on the top of the lead block and the block was pulled over onto his feet. Both feet were broken.
An employee was filling a truck with gas when the gas spilled on his pants leg. The gas-soaked pants later ignited, causing serious burns to his lower right leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was loading and unloading oiled steel material. A load of the steel fell off the play hook and landed on the employee's left foot, crushing the ankle.
An employee was wrapping pallets when the chain on the pallet wrapping machine nipped the tip of his left index finger. He underwent surgery to graft skin onto the fingertip.

At approximately 5:00 p.m., on 11/13/2018, an employee attempted to cut a plastic piece hanging from his ink pen using a utility knife. The knife missed the plastic piece and instead amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was helping to lift a flatrack and had placed his hand on the cable to keep the tension when the tension cable amputated his right ring fingertip.
An employee was setting up webbing on a machine when a dye cutter roller pinched him in the machine. He suffered six broken ribs and a stretched nerve in his arm.
An employee was using an 8-foot step ladder to access boxes stored on an upper shelf when the employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering a lumbar spine injury.

An employee was stepping off her motorized tug when she tripped and fell to the ground. Another tug ran over her right index finger, causing a laceration to that finger and lesser injuries to three other fingers.
A forklift operator struck a stack of bales weighing approximately 1,200 lbs. As a result, a bale container fell on top of an employee standing in the area. The injured employee was hospitalized.

At about 7:20 p.m. on November 13, 2018, a maintenance worker was installing a plastic clevis pin in the fully extended ram of an air-pressurized pneumatic cylinder. The clevis/pin ram caused a fracture and laceration to his right index fingertip that later resulted in a medical amputation.

An employee was using a crane to place a bundle of steel into a rack. An upright of the rack broke and the topmost steel bundle (about 7 or 8 feet high) fell on the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a box while carrying a 40- to 50-pound rotor. The employee's finger was then smashed between the rotor and the ground, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was stacking a microwave on a shelf when the microwave fell and struck his head. He suffered a head laceration and lost consciousness.
An employee was walking near a dryer when the employee slipped and tripped on a plastic bending tool that was on the floor, fracturing the right arm and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using an improvised bailing wire tool to retrieve a piece of scrap metal from the extruder. The tool got entangled in a moving part and was snatched from the employee's hand. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.

A maintenance employee was attempting to move a fridge from the kitchen when the fridge tipped over and struck a steam table, causing the hot water to splash the employee. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the arms and face.
An employee was cleaning branches on the ground when another employee who was trimming a tree from an aerial bucket dropped a log on the employee below. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was operating a wood splitter when its blade amputated his left index finger.
An employee was helping install a fork onto a forklift. The employee's right index finger was pinched when the fork snapped onto the carriage, and the fingertip was torn.

An employee was on a metal ladder straightening boxes on top of a five-foot rack. He lost his balance and jumped two to three feet off the ladder landing on the concrete floor and shattering bones in his right ankle and leg.
A temporary employee was laying down insulation in the attic of a commercial building under construction. The employee fell from the attic to the concrete floor and suffered a concussion.

On November 13, 2018, Cleargage employees developed symptoms such as nausea and respiratory distress the day after an indoor fountain had been waterproofed. One employee was hospitalized for observation and given oxygen.

An employee was working on the roof of a car wash that was being built. The employee fell through a roof panel to the floor about 25 feet below, suffering 22 broken bones and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing on a step ladder that was leaning against a van when the ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground, striking his head and sustaining a concussion. The stepladder was closed at the time of the incident.

On November 13, 2018, at 10:30 a.m., an employee was at a customer's facility, loading the truck, when the employee walked around the side of the truck, slipped on ice and snow, fell on the ground and a storm drain, and broke the left femur.
An employee was clocking in with a key when he tripped on tools on the floor and fell to the cement ground, injuring his hip and requiring surgery.
An employee's head struck a porch beam. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was standing on a chair while hanging holiday decorations in the break room. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a fractured pelvis and hematoma that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a horizontal saw and attempting to release a part under the saw plate when the blade lacerated his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was trying to spray de-galvanizing solution onto the entry rolls of a roll former. The gear grabbed his glove and pulled his hand under the guard, causing an amputation to his left little fingertip.
An employee was setting up a welding/cutting machine when the robotic welder pinched the employee's fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing rubber roof material at the edge of a roof. He fell to the ground 39 feet below, suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was changing out a motor when the motor fell and crushed his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting meat on a bandsaw when he suffered amputations to three fingers on his left hand.

A 12-foot steel plate fell while being lifted with a crane. The head of the plate caught an employee's hand, crushing the hand and the index and middle fingers. The tip of the employee's index finger was surgically amputated.
An employee suffered contact burns to the left and right hands after booming down on a power line.
A nurse was putting an IV in a restrained patient. The patient grabbed the nurse, twisting her arm and causing numbness. She was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder putting merchandise away. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a broken foot.

An employee was sitting in a wheeled office chair at a computer station. While going to stand up, the employee's foot became caught on a computer cable/cord. The employee then tripped and fell, fracturing the right ankle.
An employee was trying to hang a bicycle on a ceiling hook when he lost his balance. The bike fell and hit him on the left lower leg/ankle, breaking it in two places and requiring surgery.

Employees were cleaning the "skin puller machine" with a water hose. The injured employee was operating a water hose and nozzle, spray cleaning the machine. After the machine was cleaned and re-energized the employee noticed a tag of skin inside the machine and attempted to retrieve it. The employee's hand contacted the rotating parts resulting in partial amputation of the employee's middle, ring and index fingers.
An employee was placing/staging PVC pipe in various areas when the employee fell approximately 22 feet through an opening onto a wooden platform below, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a front-end loader to push flowback solids into the solids bay when fumes from a liquid were ignited causing a flash fire and burning the employee's face and the backside of a hand.
An employee was using a drum transfer cart to move a drum. When the employee disengaged the lock on the drum cart, it broke and injured the employee's hand.
An employee was building pallets, nailing the boards together with a pneumatic nail gun. The gun fired a nail into his left leg above the knee.

An employee was using a rake to brush excess breading from the top of a conveyor belt when his right index finger was caught by the conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation. His hand was under the conveyor at the incident.

An employee was climbing a wooden ladder built at the jobsite to go between the third and fourth floors. The employee slipped and slid down the ladder, falling onto the third floor and injuring the left heel/ankle.

An employee was using a hover mower when it slid forward on the dewy grass. He slid forward as well, and as he released the mower his left foot was caught in the bottom of the machine. His big toe and second toe were injured; the big toe was amputated.
An employee experienced body cramping and was hospitalized with a muscle injury possibly due to heat stress.
An employee slipped and fell while climbing out of a truck, fracturing his hip.
While cleaning a die press, an employee's left middle and ring fingers were crushed.

An employee was removing a swing drive from an excavator. He had a lift strap wrapped around the swing drive and was attempting to lift the drive out of the machine.  The strap was underneath a fitting and caused excessive pressure on the fitting, which caused the fitting to break off and hit his forehead. He suffered a fractured skull.
An employee was placing a heat exchanger into an outer cabinet. The employee's finger was pinched between the cabinet and the heat exchanger, suffering an amputation near the fingernail area.

An employee was cutting pork loin with a band saw. As he tried to adjust a stuck gauge plate, his left hand contacted the band saw blade, causing a deep knuckle laceration that required surgery to repair the ligament.
On 11/14/18, an employee was setting up a die on a wax press. At approximately 10:30 p.m., the press knockout came down on the employee's left pinky, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was loading film into a packaging machine when the machine activated and partially amputated the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was admitted to the hospital for an anxiety attack after a co-worker placed a fake rat on the employee's keyboard.  This caused immediate panic and chest pains.

Two employees were moving a 125-pound piece of steel plate from one pallet to the next when the piece dropped on his right ring finger, resulting in an amputation to their right ring finger and a middle finger injury requiring stitches.

An employee was descending an A-frame ladder when he slipped and fell on a 4-foot long light bulb tube that was set near his ladder. He suffered lacerations and cuts, as shards of glass were embedded in his right arm and lips.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift putting away products. As the forklift made a sharp turn, his left leg was caught between it and a safety bollard breaking his left foot.
After unloading a truck, an employee went to close the tail gate when her right index finger was pinched by the tail gate, resulting in an amputation of the finger.

On 11/14/18, at approximately 12:15 PM, an employee was using a foot-operated vertical splitter to re-split firewood logs when the blades struck the employee's right thumb, resulting in an amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was counting tanks in a canister room when she tripped over an O2 cart and was cut on the O2 stands. Suffering from disorientation when she was found, she was hospitalized.
While surveying in the middle of an intersection, an employee was struck by a vehicle and suffered broken ribs.

An employee was operating a walk-behind asphalt roller. The employee's left little finger was caught and pinched between the handle of the roller and a building. The upper part of the finger was amputated.
An employee was stocking supplies in a parked ambulance when she fell out the back door to the ground and twisted her ankle.
An employee was installing panels for a garage when the wind blew a panel onto the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured foot.
Two employees were operating a stamping press. As one employee was feeding aluminum strips their right hand was caught in the machine and crushed.

An employee was holding the top portion of a load bar and resting it on the dock when a coworker operating a forklift bumped the bottom portion of the load bar, pressing it into the injured employee's abdomen. The employee lost consciousness and suffered abdominal pain and bruised ribs.
An employee was using a 4-foot ladder when he fell, fracturing his right ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On November 15, 2018, an employee was stacking glulam timbers when one of the timbers fell. The employee's gloved hand was caught between it and another timber, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on ice on a stairway, losing his balance and landing on concrete. His leg was broken.

An employee was driving a forklift to the shipping dock when he struck a shrink wrap machine. His left leg was caught between the forklift and the machine's guardrail, resulting in laceration to his left leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was building a platform above a rotating grain leg head (shaft) when his lanyard was caught in the rotating shaft, breaking his right shoulder and left clavicle.
An employee was holding a pipe that was being threaded in a pipe threader when the employee's right hand and arm were pulled around the pipe. The employee sustained a right hand injury.
Employees were loading materials when a box of gears fell onto one of them, causing compound fractures of the tibia and fibula.
A WUSM employee was walking down a wooden ramp covered with snow and ice. She fell, breaking her left tibia near the ankle. She was hospitalized.

On November 15, 2018, an employee was changing the bands on the rollers of an automated rolling line. The employee's left arm was caught in the rollers, causing compound fractures that required surgery and hospitalization. The equipment was not locked out or powered off at the time of the incident. Gloves and long sleeves were being worn.

An employee was operating a heat shrink cutting machine when she attempted to adjust the chute. The plastic window/guard came off the machine and her hand entered the machine, contacting moving parts. She suffered an amputation of the middle finger on her right hand.

An employee parked a garbage truck on the side of the road, then began to cross the road to pick up garbage. The employee was struck by an oncoming vehicle, suffering a broken leg, arm, and ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hooking a trailer to a truck when he attempted to push up on the chipper plate and the plate came down on his left middle finger, pinching it between the plate and the ground. His left middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting carrots with a food processor when the equipment amputated her right middle fingertip.

An employee was unloading a large flat metal sheet roll (6 feet width) off a trailer. Each roll weighs about 8,000 lbs. The roll was not secured and rolled off the trailer, crushing the employee's lower left leg and resulting in an amputation below the calf muscle.
An employee was using a jointer when the employee's left pinky finger made contact with the blade, resulting in a partial amputation.

A truck driver was unloading his truck. Product fell off the pallet he was unloading and struck him, causing him to fall off the truck's lift plate. He suffered a torn ligament in the elbow or a broken bone.
An employee was repairing a conveyor when the conveyor switched on and his hand was caught and pulled into the sprocket, resulting in an amputation of 50% of the pinky.

An employee was grading mouldings on a moulder machine. When she attempted to blow off the machine with an air hose, her hand went between the guard and the moulder head. The moulder cutter head amputated  her right thumb and index fingers from the end of the nailbed to the tip.

An employee was walking into the building when he slipped and fell to the concrete floor, striking his head on the floor. He suffered a head laceration and brain bleeding/swelling, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was conducting janitorial work when he was found unconscious at the bottom of the stairs by another employee. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture.

Four employees were attempting to push electrical fitting material over a lift gate when the material fell onto the injured employee, who was standing below them at the time. The employee sustained five broken ribs and shoulder pain.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a strapper machine and asked the machine operator to place the machine in "Service Mode On." However, the operator placed the machine in "Service Mode Off." The maintenance employee entered the machine and triggered the service eye, causing the machine to cycle. The machine then struck his foot, piercing his safety boot and resulting in the amputation of his right pinky toe.
An employee was cleaning the back window of a truck, lost his balance, and fell to the ground fracturing his ankle.

An employee was wrenching down a clamp on a rolling platform ladder. He completed his task and was about to descend when he missed his footing and fell about 50 inches to the ground. He struck his head and right shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a vent plug on a pressure transmitter. Hydrofluoric acid and propane sprayed out of the instrument onto the left side of his face, causing chemical burns.
An employee was shoveling snow as part of his duties as a residential apartment maintenance mechanic and began feeling tightness in his chest. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when the saw blade amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb.
An employee performed maintenance in conveyor tunnels under a packaging warehouse.  As he was attempting to leave the tunnels, he slipped and his foot was caught in the conveyors, breaking it.
An employee was operating a spot welding press when the hone (the cylinder that welds a nut to a part) came down and caused the amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was working on a roof when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below, suffering head lacerations and fractured ribs.
An employee was descending on a scissor lift. An electrical conduit on the wall cut through his glove, smashing his left little finger.

An employee was operating a tabletop crimper machine. The crimper was not working; the employee was trying to push the gears when they activated and amputated the tip of his left index finger. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was straightening boxes. The employee's left-hand fingers were caught and injured in a conveyor belt.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet out of a lift that tipped over onto a concrete surface, breaking bones in both feet.
An employee was working with equipment when his hand was caught in the equipment, amputating half of a finger.

An employee was cutting material on a bandsaw that had a hose connection to a vacuum system to collect the debris. The vacuum system became clogged, so the employee disconnected the hose and tried to clean the system. The system's motor or impeller broke his right wrist and lacerated his palm. The vacuum system was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee raised up from a squatting/kneeling position to avoid a fire hazard from hot work. While doing so, he ruptured/tore his right quadriceps tendon.

An employee was operating a scissor lift to offload a customer's trailer when the scissor lift lost traction on the trailer and slid down the trailer bed before tipping over and throwing the employee from the lift. The employee attempted to catch his fall with his arms, resulting in a broken right wrist and two broken right fingers.

An employee stepped off an electric pallet jack and walked alongside it. He then attempted to stop the pallet jack by operating the controls on the handle. The pallet jack approached another piece of equipment, and his right leg was caught between the two pieces of equipment. He was hospitalized with a fractured right fibula and tibia.

An employee was driving a mule (motorized tractor) outdoors to retrieve an asset. As he exited the mule cab to walk to the asset, he slipped on the frozen ground and fell onto the door frame of the open cab, hitting his back. He suffered several broken ribs and a fractured spine.
An employee was in a parking lot, walking to her vehicle, when she tripped and fell to the ground. She suffered multiple fractures.
While helping unload a trailer, an employee was struck by a forklift and fell off the loading dock to the ground. The employee's left tibia and fibula were broken.
An employee was backing up a forklift when it struck a static conveyor, pinning his leg against the conveyor's support bracket. The employee's leg was amputated.

An employee was installing sheeting on a roof. He slipped near the edge and fell 11 feet to the ground below, suffering broken wrists, broken arms, a head laceration, bruises on a leg, and a back contusion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing housekeeping activities on a walking/working surface before installing an electrical panel board. While removing plywood on the walking/working surface, the employee stepped forward and fell through a floor hole opening, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking into the car processing area to inspect a van when a heavy lift operator struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
An employee was tightening a drill bit with a wrench when the wrench broke free, causing the employee to fall to the ground. He landed on his back and suffered broken vertebrae.
An employee was pulling a pin to uncouple the fifth wheel of a tractor trailer when the employee lost grip and fell backwards onto the ground, suffering a fractured hip and requiring surgery.

An employee was installing girt on the metal roof (30 degrees) of a newly built greenhouse from a scissor lift. He got off the scissor lift to nail down the top of the girt, then fell 26 feet through the roof to the ground, breaking his left leg and injuring his neck. He was hospitalized. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.

A maintenance employee was removing a hydraulic cylinder from a paint conveyor lift. When the cylinder was removed, the counterbalance was freed. The employee's left hand was then caught between the counterbalance and the stop plate, fracturing the hand.
An employee was delivering packages when a dog attacked her, biting her face. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was trying to grab a letter from the conveyor belt when his hand became stuck between the protective transfer plate and the conveyor belt. He suffered a hand injury and burn marks.
On November 16, 2018, an employee was driving a forklift when it struck a crane "C" hook. The employee suffered broken vertebrae and chest injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove rubber from a mixer door when his left arm entered the mixer, resulting in a left middle finger amputation and crushed left ring finger.
An employee was threading a rod on a lathe when the rod caught his gloved hand. His finger was amputated.
An employee was walking from her vehicle to her workplace when she slipped on ice and fell, breaking her ankle. She underwent surgery.
An employee was working from a 6-foot scissor lift. He stepped onto an adjacent ladder and fell, suffering broken ribs and a broken collarbone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder when the ladder slipped out from under him. He fell approximately 12 feet to the floor, injuring his right shoulder, right wrist, and right ankle and suffering a right knee laceration.

An employee was performing checks on a chain and sprocket when he tried to remove a piece of tape from the chain and his hand became caught in the chain and sprocket. He suffered broken bones in his hand.
An employee fell to the same level in an icy parking lot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left tibia.
An employee was cutting wood on a band saw when the blade cut his right hand.

As an employee crossed the door threshold into the building, the employee's left foot slipped and caught a rug edge, causing the employee to fall onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the left knee and left eye, as well as a left arm fracture.
An employee fell 8 to 10 feet from a shed while inspecting shingles on its roof.

An employee was standing on a 5-gallon bucket while attempting to take a gas meter reading in a residential housing complex. The employee fell approximately 2 feet to the ground and was hospitalized for a broken leg that required surgery.
An employee was climbing a ladder up to a roof when the ladder kicked back. He then fell from the ladder to the ground and fractured his fibula and tibia.

An employee was on the second from the top step of a 9-foot step ladder reaching into a bay when he fell to the floor between the ladder and adjacent racking. He suffered a head laceration, requiring staples.

An employee was standing on the second or third step of a 6-foot step ladder, guiding a control box door with a pry bar. The pry bar slipped and he lost his balance and fell to the floor, breaking his right upper tibia below the kneecap.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a residential attic through a hatch. He slipped and fell, and his body struck against the ladder or another solid object as he fell. He broke four ribs.
A reach truck and a forklift collided. The reach truck driver's right foot was broken.
An employee was scraping condensate from a furnace when a condensate flash fire occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee.
An employee was replacing a breaker in a high voltage integrated circuit (HVIC) unit when an arc flash occurred, causing second and third degree burns to both hands.

An employee was helping move a fusion welding unit with a forklift and a sling. The unit was frozen to the ground; when it was suddenly freed it swung, hit a pole, and knocked the employee to the ground, lacerating his face and breaking both his ankles. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an extended reach all-terrain forklift to move construction materials. The boom struck his right arm, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to get a heater to light up when it ignited, causing a flash fire. The employee was hospitalized with first and second degree burns to the face, neck, and hands.

An employee was cutting a board on a rip saw while using a push stick.  The board kicked back during cutting and the employee's left hand was drawn into the saw.  The employee suffered an amputation of the thumb, and partial amputations of the pointer and middle fingers on his left hand.
While exiting a plane, an employee tripped over the ramp in the jetway. The employee's left ankle was broken.

An employee was operating a blow mold machine when a piece of plastic became jammed between the chain guard and the conveyor belt bed. As she tried to remove it, her left ring finger was caught and suffered an amputation. She was hospitalized.

An employee had walked about 150 feet up a steep hill after helping pull conduit across a lake. His right foot slipped about 5-6 inches into a ditch and he fell onto his back, breaking his right ankle.
An employee was holding the pedal attachment of a pressurized pneumatic torque wrench when the pedal shifted and amputated the employee's right pinky fingertip.
An employee was starting a plastic extruding machine when the die area caught fire, causing third degree burns to the employee's neck, nose, and ears.
While installing reflectors on a street, an employee was struck on the head by the mirror of a car that had driven into the work zone.
A concrete truck backed over an employee's right ankle.

An employee was replacing a fabric sheet on a paper towel machine. The employee removed a pin on the winch and was checking to see if the machine was lined up when the employee's finger was caught by a moving part. The finger was partially amputated at the middle knuckle.

On 11/17/2018, at 4:00 AM, an employee was working in an enclosed trailer at a customer's location, preparing down-hole tools using a break wash chemical. He was in close proximity to a space heater that ignited the fumes from the chemical. This caused second degree burns to the employee's face, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in a chemical room when cleaning agent sprayed into the employee's eyes.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, hitting his head on the icy pavement. He suffered a mild concussion and body bruising.
An employee was hospitalized with broken ribs after being struck by forks that dropped from a powered industrial vehicle.
An employee was moving from one platform to another. The platform gave way and the employee fell 10 feet to the ground, suffering a broken left foot.
A process technician was taking a sample of heated resid. Some of the resid got on the employee's face, causing first- and second-degree burns.

An employee was ventilating a building containing a gas leak and the gases ignited when the employee opened the door. The employee suffered first degree burns to the face and neck and second degree burns to both hands.
An employee was putting away equipment in a supply closet. The employee's right ring finger was caught and crushed in the closet's door frame.
An employee was trying to ignite a grill pilot light when built-up propane gas caused the flame to flare. The employee suffered burns to the eye and the right side of the face.
An employee suffered a lower back strain/sprain while bending over to put on boot covers.
An employee's hand was on a cable that was being used to lift a pipe from a rig when his finger was amputated.
An employee was using a walkie stacker when his thumb was caught between the handle and a rack, resulting in a laceration to his left thumb.
An employee was going to her vehicle in the parking lot when she slipped and fell on ice, suffering probable head and hip injuries.

An employee was spotting for an articulating manlift operator that was moving materials. The employee climbed down a ladder and turned to go out a doorway, and was caught between the doorway and the lift's knuckle boom. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was manually pushing a conveyor belt when her finger was caught underneath the belt, suffering a deep cut.
An employee was transferring a hot steam well inside the kitchen when she tripped and dropped the hot steam well and hot water on her foot. She suffered burns to her left foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping install a conveyor belt. The employee had pulled the belt off the frame when the conveyor started. The employee's right middle fingertip was smashed between the belt and the frame, and the fingertip was amputated.

On November 18, 2018, an employee was trying to clear a clog in the feeder throat of a press. The press cycle was initiated, and the tip of the employee's left middle finger was pinched in a metal door inside the feeder that closed when the press was activated. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

At 11:00 a.m. on November 19, 2018, an employee was testing a fire pump controller. The controller arced, causing burns to the employee's neck, eyes, face, and hands. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery for the burns to the hands.
An employee was installing a drain pipe on a canopy when he started vomiting at the job site and eventually lost consciousness due to heat. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was winterizing a water craft using a power tool when the tool fell into the engine compartment, causing an explosion. The employee suffered first, second, and third degree burns to his arms, face, neck, and ears.

An employee was operating a small roll press when both of the employee's gloved hands were caught between the rollers, resulting in a right index finger amputation at the second knuckle and smashed middle and ring fingers on the left hand.

On November 19, 2018, an employee was cleaning a sink with drain cleaner that contained sulfuric acid. The cleaner reacted with another cleaner that had already been poured down the sink, and a chemical cloud formed in the bathroom. The employee was exposed and was hospitalized for chemical burns to the lungs, face and skin.
An employee was assaulted by another employee, suffering contusions to the neck and head and a laceration along the left side of the jaw.

An employee was performing repair work on a truck. He was inside the shoot attempting to dislodge a door. When the door popped open, he fell onto the ground 2 feet below, fracturing his pelvis and breaking his left arm.
A temporary employee was changing a part in a bucking machine. The machine engaged and his thumb get stuck under the part, suffering an amputation.

A maintenance employee was preparing to replace a steel catwalk grate with a fiberglass grating. He was standing on the steel grate when the supporting bolts and/or grate gave way and he fell to the ground below. He suffered a fractured right ankle and right heel.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering broken vertebrae. He was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering packages at a customer's location when he was assaulted by five youths, suffering lacerations, contusions, and a broken jaw.

An employee was attempting to clear the cheese feeding port of a cheesecake machine when the machine moved, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation and broken bones. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a meat band saw to cut up beef feet when the employee's gloved left hand was pulled into the band saw, resulting in a left index finger amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was working with two other employees to ensure the proper setup/startup of an extrusion machine.  The injured employee was conducting a quality check of the product on the conveyor between the extrusion and fibrillation roller when his left hand was caught between the conveyor roller and fibrillator, resulting in a left hand amputation.
On November 19, 2018, at about 6:45 a.m., a temporary employee slipped and fell while removing snow from the walkways, suffering back and neck injuries.
An employee was helping a coworker in a parking lot. The gate arm came down on the employee's head.
An employee tripped and fell on a sidewalk while delivering mail, injuring her right leg.

An employee was using a forklift to move an electrical cabinet into packaging. The cabinet was secured to a skid for transport; the skid and the cabinet began to tip off the forks. The employee jumped off the truck to stabilize the load and the cabinet fell, breaking a bone in his lower leg.

A maintenance technician was installing new plug outlets in a sixth-floor tenant space. He was standing on a 6-foot step ladder, working in the ceiling, when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. He suffered six broken ribs on the right side of his torso, as well as a bruised right lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a steel beam that pivoted on one end. When the beam reached the end of its travel, it swung back and struck the employee on the shin. The employee suffered a fractured tibia and was hospitalized.

An employee was rigging down an oil rig mast. While the pin was being removed from the derrick board brace, the derrick board swung and hit the employee in the rib area. The employee suffered contusion and fracture injuries in the rib and chest area.
An employee was guiding a trench box into place in a trench when he lost his balance and fell approximately 9 feet into the box, striking his head. He suffered a cut on his head and a concussion.
An employee was fixing an electrical sign while on an extension ladder outside a local bank when he fell from the ladder to the ground, breaking a femur and shattering an ankle.
An employee was making a delivery when he fell out the back of his delivery box truck and hit the ground, injuring his ribs and head.

An employee was using a saw to cut logs of tape on a floating machine. The employee was holding a towel that was then pulled into the saw blade, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time.
While stretching roof insulation, an employee fell through a roof and landed on the ground. The employee suffered head and back injuries.

Two workers were separating a bundle of 2-3 angle iron bar joists. The injured employee was using a pry bar on the ground and was the "hook-on" man. He was separating the angle iron (30-feet length x 2ft. high) when a loose iron bar joist fell onto the employee's left leg crushing it.
An employee was sitting at her work station when she got up and tripped over a purse strap that was on the floor. She was hospitalized with a broken right femur.
At about 9:55 a.m. on November 19, 2018, an employee slipped on a wet metal decking plate and fell to the floor, breaking his right femur. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was putting logs on a crimping machine when it amputated the employee's left index and middle fingertips.

Two employees were moving a sheet of metal from a shear onto a table. One of the employees dropped his end of the metal while the other employee was still holding his end. The employee's left index fingertip was pinched between the sheet of metal he was holding and a sheet of metal that was on the table, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was trimming bushes from a ladder when he lost his balance and fell off the ladder and onto a fence and the ground. He suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to cover the exhaust fan when he slipped and fell approximately 12 feet. The employee was hospitalized with two broken ribs and a perforated liver.

An employee was using a pallet jack to maneuver freight inside a delivery truck trailer when he stepped backwards and fell over the edge of the truck trailer. He fell approximately 4 to 6 feet to the ground below, fracturing five ribs on his right side.

An employee exited a backhoe to help other employees raise a pitman arm. As he was on the walking platform, it raised and tilted and he lost his balance. He fell and the pitman arm landed on him, breaking his pelvis.
An employee fell while removing a wheelbarrow from a building. The employee suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.
On November 20, 2018, an employee had used solvent to clean a paint spray gun. The pressurized solvent cut into the employee's finger; later the wound began to burn and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a bagging machine. The employee was on a forklift so that the machine's legs could be adjusted; the machine tilted, smashing the employee's finger between one of its legs and the floor. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was laying down on a maintenance service catwalk to examine the electrical busbars on a crane when the crane moved in his direction and snagged his right foot. His right ankle was severely lacerated, eventually leading to a right foot amputation above the ankle.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the concrete ground, suffering a broken arm. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was about to reposition a mandrel by hand when a puller engaged, causing the tooling to press against the puller plate. The employee's ring fingertip and nail were lacerated.
An employee was trying to remove a wedged food tray from a heated meal delivery cart. The employee's left index finger was lacerated.
An employee was working from a platform about 4-5 feet off the ground, installing deck joists. The employee fell from the platform onto the concrete below, suffering a head injury.

An employee was lining up a water injection pump when naphtha and hydrogen sulfide were released. The employee was exposed and was hospitalized for injuries to the lungs. Personal protective equipment was not being worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating the V door on a drilling rig. The joint of the casing was brought up to the rig floor, and the employee was pinched between it and the stump. The employee suffered a bruised spleen and was hospitalized.

An employee was unhooking the converter dolly to a trailer when the dolly rolled and flipped up. The employee's left ring finger was then caught between the dolly and the back of the trailer, resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was using a hand drill to put holes in metal door slats. The drill drilled through the employee's glove into the left middle finger, necessitating the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking back into the store when she tripped on a pallet. She fell and broke her left hip.

An employee was unloading poles with another employee when one employee dropped his end of the pole and the other end bounced and hit the injured employee in the jaw. The employee was hospitalized with a broken jawbone.
An employee was clearing jammed plastic trim from a plastic recycling machine. His hand got stuck at the channel for plastic; he suffered a broken wrist and burns to his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was being trained to use a manual lathe when her hand was caught and pulled into the wrap, causing her to flip over the lathe and injuring her arm.
An employee stepped off an electric pallet jack, and their right ankle was caught and lacerated between the jack and a guardrail. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a concrete pipe with a saw when the saw kicked back and struck the employee's chest, lacerating it.
An employee was delivering parts to a customer when he tripped over a tire rut in an unpaved parking lot and fell, fracturing his right hip.

An employee was spotting for a forklift driver while it was moving 20-foot long I-beams. The employee walked into a gap about 3 feet wide, between the stacks of I-beams the operator was lifting. 
As the operator was raising the load of steel with a combi-lift, the front stack started to tilt forward. The operator quickly lowered the steel to keep the front stack from toppling over onto the injured employee, but the front stack had passed the tipping point and the steel fell onto the employee's left leg, breaking it.
An employee was reentering a building through a roof hatch when he slipped on the fixed ladder, falling to the level below. The employee was hospitalized for a shattered elbow that required surgery.
An employee was riding on the back of a waste truck. The truck backed over the employee's right foot, breaking it.
An employee was trying to access a rooftop from an adjacent wall. He fell 6 feet to the ground below, suffering fractures to a thoracic bone.

An employee was installing sensor equipment and fell from a fixed ladder to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left femur, pelvis and arm. He also needed stitches for a laceration on the eyebrow.

An employee was conducting an experiment in which he cleaned a piece of equipment with pentane. The pentane spilled onto him and his work area; a nearby open flame caused it to catch fire. The employee suffered second-degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to put a dock leveler in place. A load of product was in the way; the leveler came down on his right little finger, causing an amputation up to the first knuckle.

An employee was working on a gang wall when their hand was caught between a metal waler and plate washer while installing wall spacers. The left middle finger sustained a laceration requiring surgery.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a belt and pulley system on a scrap conveyor. He was tracking the belt. He had loosened the head pulley and was retightening it when his hand slipped into the running belt and pulley system. His right index finger was amputated up to the first joint. The system was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a cheese sealing machine. The sealer bar came down on his fingers, causing crushing injuries that necessitated the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw. The saw lacerated his right index, middle, and ring fingers. Its blade was unguarded at the time of the incident.
While trying to install a conduit, an employee moved a pallet and tripped over a hole in the floor. A piece of metal stud lacerated his arm.
A grit blasting hose pressurized, blasting an employee's leg with compressed air and blast grit.
An employee had a finger under a T-post and was straightening it out when a piece of equipment contacted the T-post. The employee suffered a partial metacarpophalangeal amputation of the finger.
An employee was on a ladder painting the outside of an apartment. The ladder legs slipped and the employee fell to the ground, breaking his leg and nose.
An employee slipped on ice in the company parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg and dislocated shoulder.
An employee was on a dock standing next to a ladder where a portable bandsaw was located. The saw tipped and cut the employee's left thumb, causing an amputation.
An employee was in an aerial basket, monitoring an operation. The employee's fingers were caught between a demolished pipe and another pipe, causing amputations to the left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was sitting in a chair when she fell from the chair and dislocated her right ankle.

An employee opened a trailer's doors to dump a load of scrap material, then fell through an opening in a railing into an open wood pit. The employee suffered neck fractures, as well as a head laceration (from scrap wood in the pit) that required stitches.
An employee was sitting an axle when the employee's left pinky finger was caught and fractured between the I-beam and tie rod.
An employee was cleaning roasting equipment when his hand entered an airlock unit, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was attempting to locate a noise coming from a conveyor system. The employee was checking the pulley for tightness when the belt grabbed his glove and caused severe friction burns to his right hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was adding sodium hydroxide to a batch of product. The liquid contents foamed out of the kettle and burned the back of the employee's head, cheek (causing redness), and leg.

A post pounding machine was being used to pound a post on site. The operator lifted the hammer top high and the hammer came out of the mast. The mast assembly missed an in-plate that would have prevented the hammer from separating from the mast when lifted above a certain height. The hammer struck the employee while he was setting up another post for placement. The hammer fell onto his hard hat and grazed his lip/chin area. The impact caused significant lacerations to the head and face.
An employee was walking on the roof of a building when the employee stepped onto a skylight panel and fell through to the floor below, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was operating a tape-making loom. A knot formed in the line; as it tightened, it caught and amputated the tip of the employee's little finger.
An employee was walking down the stairs when she missed the bottom two stairs and fell, breaking her right femur.
An employee tripped over a rocking chair in the den of a mental health outpatient's residence. She fell to the floor, suffering displaced and fractured ribs.

An employee was removing glue from the label paddles on a filling line. The employee's finger was pinched and amputated between a paddle and rollers. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was rotating an axle with a spreader bar that had hooks when the axle fell out of the hook and smashed the employee's finger between that axle and another axle. The employee's fingertip was de-gloved.
An employee slipped and fell in an asphalt parking lot, fracturing her tailbone.
An employee was delivering construction material to a residential home construction site, slipped and fell, suffering a broken right ankle.

An employee was operating a paper cutter machine that cuts and folds paper into envelopes of different sizes. Part of the process is to stick adhesive onto the envelopes. The adhesive is poured into a reservoir located directly underneath a set of gears (sprockets). The operator was trying to remove a piece of paper that had fallen onto the reservoir when their right index finger was caught in the gears and amputated.

On November 21, 2018, two employees entered a trench to manually locate a fiber optic cable that had been cut. The trench was 9'8" deep and 5'6" wide and had no protective systems in place.  At approximately 8:30 p.m. the east wall of the trench caved in, trapping both employees. Both employees were hospitalized for nerve damage to their lower extremities.
An employee was using a router on a wooden door in a construction shop when the router moved unexpectedly, making contact with the employee's left hand and lacerating it below the thumb.
An employee was lifting a barge cover via a crane with a strap when the employee's right thumb was caught between the strap and the lifting hook of the barge cover, resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was connecting the trailer to the tractor. While turning the crank on the trailer to level it up with the tractor, the crank flipped around and struck the employee's right elbow fracturing it.
An employee was cutting the bands on a stack of 38-foot railroad ties. When the last band was cut, the ties fell onto the employee's leg and ankle, resulting in a fractured left leg.
An employee slipped while standing up, and his right index finger jammed into a stopped lint cleaner machine. He suffered a three-quarter amputation of the finger.

An employee was helping to remove a manhole cover when the tool used to remove the manhole cover slipped out of the groove, causing the heavy cover to crash down on the employee's finger. The employee suffered a left middle finger laceration that resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was holding a chain to attach to a hook on a hoist. The employee's finger was pinched between the chain and the hook, and the tip was torn off.
An employee was cleaning parts of a pill-making press. The employee's right hand was caught between movable machine parts, and part of the middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was performing drilling operations when his sleeve was caught in the drill. Four fingers on his left hand were amputated.
An employee was doing maintenance work in a substation. As the employee inspected a piece of electrical equipment, an electrical flash occurred in the equipment. The employee's finger was burned.

An employee was using a box cutter to cut shrink wrap from a pallet when the cutter head broke and exposed the blade, causing a deep wound to employee's left index finger. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee's knee buckled while they were walking down stairs. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee was cleaning a chute when his right hand came into contact with the rotors at the bottom of the chute. Four fingers were amputated.

An employee was cleaning out the salt in a pellet press with an air hose when the air hose wand was pulled into the press by the rollers.
