As the air hose wand was forced upward by the rollers, the employee's hand was caught in between the air hose handle and the frame on the press' latch door. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated and the same finger was fractured.

An employee was feeding whole fruit and vegetables into the feeder chute of a food processor.  A pepper became stuck in the feeder chute; as he advanced it down the chute, the blade struck his middle finger and severed the tip.
An employee was operating a bagging machine. As the employee replaced a bag, the machine was triggered; the employee's right little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was attempting to close a metal mail cage when it closed on her right middle digit, lacerating and breaking it.
An employee was performing a service check on an aircraft and suffered a compound fracture to the right leg/ankle.

On November 23, 2018, an employee was dumping metal scrap into a charge pot in the melt room when an explosion occurred and hot mag flew out and peppered the employee. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the left wrist, right hand, right shoulder, neck, upper arm, head, and scalp.

An employee was changing out the plastic core on a portable winder machine. After replacing the core, the employee turned on the machine and began to wind some material onto the new core. The employee's right hand then contacted the chuck of the winder, resulting in a right index finger fracture and partial amputation. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
A mail carrier was struck by a vehicle while crossing the street, suffering broken ribs. The carrier was hospitalized.
An employee was walking back into a client's home when she fell on a step, fracturing her hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was maneuvering a golf cart to do a U-turn when the cart tipped over. The employee suffered a dislocated left second toe and an amputation of the left big toe.
An employee tripped or slipped, suffering injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a forklift when it rolled, pinning the employee to the wall. The employee suffered two broken legs.
Employees were loading pigs onto a pig launcher when a flash fire occurred, burning two employees. Fire-retardant clothing was worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was hospitalized with lower back pain after engaging in housekeeping activities.

An employee at Dean Steel Buildings, Inc., was operating a flashing machine to bend siding when the machine was activated via the foot pedal and pinched his right hand with the material he was bending. This resulted in a fourth finger amputation and a partial right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was pre-sorting construction debris. A loader was being used. A wire caught on the loader and tripped the employee, flipping him backwards; he hit his head on the floor, suffering head trauma. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was instructing skiers when a skier collided with the employee. The employee suffered a fractured left leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
A truck driver was helping a crane operator unload the truck. The crane hook was dropped onto the driver's right index finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was lifting an approximately 20-pound glass rack for a dishwasher when the employee's back seized up, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was clearing a jam when his smock became caught on a sprocket and pulled his right arm in, resulting in a severe laceration to the upper right arm.
An employee was chalking lines on a second-level floor when the employee fell 10 to 12 feet to concrete below, suffering a broken right foot, broken toes, a broken vertebra, and a head injury.
A Disney employee tripped over a stone in the hardscape while walking to her car. She suffered a broken elbow and arm and was hospitalized, needing surgery.
On November 24, 2018, an employee was overcome by ammonia leaking from a cooling system.
An employee was putting a belt onto a scalping machine. The machine was activated and four fingers on the employee's right hand were amputated.
An employee slipped on ice walking in a parking lot. She fell, breaking her ankle, and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was in a parking lot, leaving a car to go to work. He slipped on ice and fell to the ground, pulling a thigh muscle.

A maintenance employee was performing a pre-trip inspection of a trailer. After inspecting the tires he used an air tool to tighten a lug. While tightening the lug, the tire exploded and the employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was spraying a chemical to clean a bathroom. After bending down, she felt dizzy, got up, and lost her balance. She fell to the floor, breaking a bone in her right leg under the knee.

An employee was in a feed yard, using a winch to move livestock panels. The suspended panels shifted; as the employee tried to reposition them, he was knocked to the ground. He was hospitalized to treat two vertebrae in his lower back.
An employee was washing glasses when a glass broke and lacerated the employee's right thumb tendon, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading a tractor-trailer when the driver moved the tractor. The employee then fell from the tractor and was run over by the trailer, suffering a fractured pelvis.
An employee was exposed to bleach vapors while attempting to pressurize a 5-gallon spray can and suffered difficulty breathing.
An employee was using a bandsaw to trim meat from a bone. The blade amputated his left index finger.
On November 25, 2018, at about 11:10 AM, an employee was cleaning a shower when she slipped and fell on the shower floor. She injured her lower back and was not able to move her right hand and leg.
An employee was installing house wrap on a deck when he bent over the temporary railing to pick up debris and the railing gave way. He fell 6 to 10 feet to the ground, fracturing a tibia and fibula.

An employee was attempting to troubleshoot a machine that was not working properly when the chain pulled his gloved hand into the moving conveyor, crushing his middle and index fingers and resulting in finger amputations.
An employee was cleaning a roll former machine with a rag when his fingers got stuck between the rollers. His index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee fell to the ground while climbing down a ladder, suffering a broken femur and two punctures to the arm.
An employee was caught between an air compressor and a stationary bucket truck. The employee suffered a hip fracture.

An employee stepped out of a scissor lift onto a roof that was approximately 11 feet above ground. A second employee was handing the first employee a piece of 14-foot metal trim when a gust of wind swung the metal trim and the first employee into a powerline approximately 15 feet away. The employee suffered an electric shock and second/third degree bilateral arm/leg burns.
An employee was shot in the head and hand during a robbery at gun point.
An employee was working at a nurse's station when she had an allergic reaction (sneezing, clogged ears, closed throat) to a coworker's lotion containing tree nut oil. She was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead crane to stack steel angles when the sling loosened and the stack of angles tipped over toward him. The stack struck the bottom of his left leg, breaking a bone.

On November 26, 2018, an employee was helping a forklift driver move a 4,000-pound load of rubber when the forklift driver hit the tilt button, causing the load of rubber to shift. This caused the bar that was supporting the rubber to release from the forklift tines and strike the employee, who suffered skull, cheekbone, and neck vertebrae fractures; a broken femur; and a smashed third right toe. The employee required surgery and stitches to the back of the head.

An employee was pulling electrical cables in an electrical vault. The employee was splicing an energized electrical cable when it came close to completing the ground and flashed, causing a second degree burn to the right side of the employee's face.
An employee was cleaning a flashbutt welding machine when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The two ends of the welder came together and pinched the employee's left forearm, breaking it.

An employee was cleaning a theater and walked up the ramp to the projection booth to turn down the volume. When he left the projection booth, he jumped over a guardrail (6 feet) and impacted the floor, suffering neck and back pain. He was hospitalized with a neck injury.

On 11/26/18, an employee was operating a press brake to bend parts. The employee had slipped the part into the machine when the part fell back behind the press. As the die was coming down, the employee attempted to retrieve the part and the employee's right hand was crushed between the dies.

An employee was standing on the dock waiting for a container to be off-loaded so that he could place the container twist-locks. The employee moved in towards the container as the driver began to pull away. The employee was struck by the rear axle of the empty trailer chassis and suffered a fractured pelvis and right hand.

While installing an air system from a walkway, an employee attempted to tighten a pipe with a pipe wrench. He used his body weight to apply more force and fell 12 feet from the walkway to the ground below, breaking his leg.
As an employee reached between a coil roll of steel and a slitter machine, the employee's hand was lacerated and severely fractured.
While doing landscape work in a garden, an employee tripped over a speaker rock and broke his leg.
A nurse was moving patients within a building because of a carbon monoxide leak in the boiler room.  The employee became ill and was hospitalized, suffering from suspected carbon monoxide poisoning.

An associate was removing a loose piece of cardboard from an automated storage and retrieval system to clear a fault. When the cardboard was removed, the machine cycled, pinching and partially amputating a finger on his left hand.
On November 26, 2018, a maintenance employee was working on a packaging machine and amputated the right index fingertip.
An employee was leaving a vehicle to go to work. The employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was working inside a saw when his hand/arm wrapped around a rotating square shaft that powered the conveyor system for the saw. His hand was mangled, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was in a trailer unloading freight. Some of the boxes began to fall, and when she jumped back she tripped over a box and fell to the floor, breaking her right knee and right ankle.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet corridor floor, suffering a broken right arm, one broken right rib, and a broken right hip.
An employee was trying to clear out cheese from the wheel area of a molding machine. His left middle fingertip was caught and sliced off.

At about 7:30 p.m. on November 26, 2018, an employee was moving a pallet into a freezer using an electric pallet jack. As the jack turned, his right ankle was pinched and broken between the load and a wall. He was hospitalized.
On November 26, 2018, a material handler was cleaning debris from a clogged chute on a grinder and suffered amputation of the first digit on the two fingers on the right hand.
An employee was moving hams from a dumper to a trimming line. The trimming machine activated, and the trimming blades partially amputated the employee's right little finger.
An employee was greasing the plate of a semi-tractor when he fell to the concrete ground and injured his shoulder and ribcage.
An employee was looking for keys when a door struck the employee's head. The employee suffered a concussion.

On November 26, 2018, at approximately 9:30 AM, an employee was operating a barrel machine when she attempted to pick up paper scraps that were behind the machine. Her head then entered the running machine and was scalped, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting 2x2 stakes out of 2x4 material with a circular saw. He was making vertical cuts when the cut went through the material and down his right leg, causing an 8- to 10-inch laceration to his lower leg (below the knee and above the ankle) that cut an artery.
An employee was emptying ashes from a dump box when his left ring finger was caught between the handle and the ash box, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

A correctional officer was supervising inmates and had just entered the officer's station when an inmate attacked the officer. The correctional officer was hospitalized with two cuts on the left hand, a laceration on the left forehead, a laceration on the left side of the nose, a laceration on the inside of the left upper lip, a hematoma to the right forehead, a laceration through the right ear, bruises on the chest, bleeding from the right ear drum, and a broken nose.

An employee climbed up a turbine, inspected the chain hoist, and noticed that it was stuck. He was attempting to release the chain when it recoiled and pulled his hand into the hoist. He suffered a laceration to the left middle finger and a fracture to the left middle phalanx, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating a sheet metal bending machine when both hands were caught in the machine. The fingers on both of the employee's hands were crushed up to the knuckles.
An employee was cleaning a mortar machine. A paddle in the machine amputated half of the employee's left ring finger.
An employee's right hand was pulled into a moving conveyor, and the ring and little fingers were degloved.
An employee was wiping down the rollers on a glue applier machine. The rollers caught and injured the employee's right hand.
An employee was attempting to restrain an aggressive and combative student. The student pushed the employee and hurt her neck. She later went to hospital and was admitted for a mild stroke.
An employee slipped and fell, striking his head on the concrete floor and suffering a subdural hematoma.

At 12:05 p.m. on November 26, 2018, an employee was trying to unjam the sheet metal feeder on a seam welder. The pneumatic pressure pushed the sheet metal against the employee, causing an amputation to part of the left thumb.
An employee was bolting lumber onto a steel beam that was sitting on the ground. The beam tipped over onto his leg, causing compound fractures of the leg bones.

An employee was standing in front of his computer entering information when he felt lightheaded and blacked out, falling flat on his back and hitting his head on the concrete floor. He suffered a brain bleed, a contusion, a concussion, and neck and back soreness, requiring hospitalization.

On November 27, 2018, an employee was driving a stand-up forklift backwards when another forklift operator struck him at an intersection. He suffered a broken heel and torn Achilles tendon, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was rolling metal when his glove was caught between the metal and the roller. The roller pulled in his fingers, smashing them and causing fractures.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood. Their hand slipped and contacted the saw blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was checking to see how a cutoff switch worked when the machine's paddle mechanism amputated the tip of his right index finger.

An employee was rinsing off the hen line and noticed a shackle that was off the rail. He reached to put it back on the rail and caught his right thumb in the shackle. The thumb was amputated between the first and second joint.

An employee was loading/unloading a refrigerated truck when his hand was caught in one of the panels of the truck's sliding door as it was being closed. His fingertip was pinched, removing his fingernail and the surrounding skin/flesh. He was hospitalized.
On November 27, 2018, an employee drank contaminated water out of a previously unopened bottle and was hospitalized.
An employee was in a trench, helping fit up a section of 24-inch pipe. The pipe section pinned him to the trench wall and broke his pelvis. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a 6- to 8-inche slope between two rooms when she slipped and fell to the floor, landing on and fracturing her right femur.
An employee was installing flashing around the garage door and fell approximately 9 feet off the scissors lift to the concrete floor. The employee suffered two broken heels.

An employee was standing on the offloading side of a bending machine. The counterweight of a side boom that was backing up came into contact with the machine's radiator. This caused the bolts to break loose from the mount, pushing it forward into the employee's waist. He fell forward into the fan area with his left elbow leading; the elbow suffered a gash/laceration.

Two employees were performing a brake job on a vehicle. A passing coworker flipped an ash or a cigarette, causing some spilled brake fluid to catch fire. One of the employees suffered burns to the left arm and shoulder.
An employee slipped on a blanket and fell breaking a hip.
An employee fell from a stack of pipes in a cargo dock, suffering fractured ribs and a dislocated little finger. He was hospitalized.
On November 27, 2018, an employee was leaving a hotel where training was being given. She slipped on ice and fell, breaking her femur.
An employee was moving a piece of steel with a five-ton hoist. The metal cut the sling and the steel dropped onto the employee's foot fracturing the metatarsals.

On November 27, 2018, an employee was walking in the trailer yard when the employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a lacerated kidney. The employee was hospitalized.

An batch operator was loading beans from a grain bin into a screw conveyor system (auger).  The grate which sits above the conveyor and allows the product to flow into the auger became displaced exposing the auger. The auger blade caught his boot and pulled it into the conveyor system causing the amputation of the operator's big toe.

On November 27, 2018, an employee was lifting a 150-pod ram out of a tripod with a lifting device. The ram twisted free, fell onto a jackleg, and struck the employee in the head. He stumbled forward and dislocated his shoulder as he fell onto his workstation. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after falling and sustaining a head injury.

An employee entered a cafeteria to retrieve his lunch, tripped over a cafeteria bench, and fell to the floor. He broke his left arm and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to install pins/plates in the arm.
An employee was preparing structural beams for hoisting and was struck by a beam that tipped over during hoisting. The employee sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was installing lightning arrestors at a new electrical substation. The employee had climbed a ladder to see how the lightning arrestors were installed on the energized side when an arc flash occurred. As a result, the employee received burns on his arms and back.

An employee was unloading baggage with a belt loader from an aircraft when the employee's scarf became tangled in the belt loader and pulled the employee into the opening between the belt and the guard. The employee suffered swelling and a fracture to the throat.
An employee was checking the level of a floor when a backhoe bucket shifted toward him, pinning his lower legs and causing contusions.
An employee was hospitalized as a result of a spider bite.
An employee fell from a ladder while painting with a sprayer. The employee suffered a fractured skull, broken ribs, and a broken pelvis.
On November 27, 2018, an employee was unrolling tarp on a flatbed trailer when he fell off the trailer and broke his leg.
An employee was hospitalized after drinking methanol from an unlabeled bottle.
An employee was changing accessories on a trackhoe when his index finger was crushed between the trackhoe and the jackhammer, resulting in a broken bone that required hospitalization.
An employee was on a baker scaffold preparing to perform plastering work and fell. The employee suffered a broken right ankle and three broken ribs.

An employee was sleeping in the upper bunk of a tractor trailer. At around 9:45 PM, the employee fell from the top bunk onto the tractor floor, fracturing his right tibia. The bunk safety net was not in place at the time of the incident.
An employee's pallet jack crashed into a rack, causing an injury to his left leg.
An employee was climbing down a ladder with a nail gun. The gun fired a nail into the employee's chest, where it caused tissue damage but missed all vital organs. The nail was surgically removed.
A dropped paint can injured an employee's leg.
An employee fell at the workplace, sustaining a contusion to his elbow and twisting his left foot.
An employee was using a knife to cut parts from inside a cow when the knife slipped from his hand and lacerated his right leg.

Wire rope was coming out of the hole of a wellhead, being wound onto a counterwheel. As an employee tried to adjust the drum speed, the retracting wire caught his left ring finger. He suffered a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was adjusting blades on a slitting machine when the rollers pulled in his left arm, injuring his bicep.

A temporary employee was cutting metal using a cutting torch when hot metal popped up and landed on the back of his shirt. His shirt ignited and he suffered severe burns to his back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee missed a step of a 4-step stairway and fell to the floor, fracturing the right foot.
An employee was moving wooden pallets onto the floor in a dry shipping dock. As he pushed a pallet, a wood splinter punctured his right hand.
An employee was dismounting from a truck when he slipped from the icy truck deck and fell 5 feet. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was restarting a conveyor. When it started, it removed part of the pad of the employee's left ring finger and fractured the bone.

On November 28, 2018, at approximately 1:45 PM, an employee was wrapping a tree with lights from a ladder at a residential location when a wind gust caused the employee to fall to the ground. He was hospitalized with an L1 back fracture.
While a truck was being moved, a conveyor shifted in a trailer. An employee went up into the trailer to move the conveyor. The conveyor began to tip and struck the employee in the right thigh.
A temporary employee was feeding sheet metal into a roller when the roller caught his glove. He suffered an amputation to his left index fingertip.
Air pressure was being applied to an underground natural gas line. The air escaped from the line, and air and dirt entered an employee's skin under his pants leg. He suffered a serious leg injury.
An employee was placing wire on an aerial strand. He fell to the street from about 20 feet up, suffering head and body lacerations.
An employee walking down a dirt incline slid and fell to the ground, breaking two bones and dislocating an ankle.
An employee was dismantling a scaffold at ground level. A scaffold leg component fell over and struck the employee on the thigh, causing a femur fracture.
On November 28, 2018, an employee had a hand on the top of a retort's door frame when the seal was broken. His right middle finger was pinched between the door and the frame, suffering an amputation.

An employee was using a pallet jack when his scanner fell. He bent to pick up the scanner and the pallet jack moved and pinched his pinky finger between the battery and plate. The finger was amputated.

Ironworkers were connecting structural steel framing members at roof level. A scissor lift platform was extended approximately 25 feet above the concrete slab when the tagline rope on the end of the beam snagged on the handrail of the scissor lift. 
The top of the scissor lift was pulled over to the north. 
When the lift's center of gravity moved outside of the wheels, the scissor lift fell over. An employee was on the platform when the scissor lift fell over. He was tied off to the anchor point in the scissor lift and hit the concrete slab on level 4, suffering broken bones and internal damage.
An employee had his foot/leg run over by a roadway tiller during roadway demolition work in preparation for pavement. His foot and lower leg were crushed and surgically amputated.
An employee was repairing concrete and fell from a ladder. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs.

An employee pulled eight cases of orange juice inside bread baskets weighing approximately 170 pounds across the dock from the staging area to a van. He was trying to load the cases of juice onto the van by hand when the baskets became stuck on the dock going into the van. He pulled the bread baskets and they started to tip over onto the van. As he tried to catch the falling baskets, his right hand was caught between the van floor and bread baskets. He pulled his hand out, resulting in a right middle index fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down stairs while holding two bags when she fell down the stairs, suffering brain bleeding, broken ribs, a broken scapula, and a broken clavicle.

A Nesika Energy employee had an allergic reaction to laundry detergent used in his flame-retardant uniform. He developed a rash on his forearms and legs, then swelling on the right leg due to infection. He was hospitalized.

An employee was hand-tightening a ground cable in an electrical switchgear enclosure. A fault between two phases above the isolated work area caused an arc flash, and the employee suffered burns to the right side of the face and the backs of both hands.
An employee was rolling a tarp using a tarp roller. His right arm was caught in the roller and fractured. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a stuck piece of wood from a gang rip saw when the employee's hand was caught by the rotating blade, causing a severe laceration.
An employee was rolling a belt on a driver on a re-saw machine. The machine was started up; the employee's right index finger was caught between a belt and pulley and amputated at the first joint.
An employee was unloading a trailer and moving pallets when his foot was pinned between the forklift he was operating and another, parked forklift. The foot was broken.

An employee was working on a machine. The belts and pulleys caught the employee's left hand, causing a partial amputation of the middle finger. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was coming down from a scaffold when he fell to the ground and broke his left ankle.

An employee was standing on the dock talking to an employee sitting on a forklift. Another forklift operator was backing out of a trailer adjacent to the employee and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was cleaning logs at a log deck when one of the logs went into the deck crooked. While the employee was straightening the log, the eye beam recognized another log and sent it to the log deck. The new log hit the employee's hand, which was then crushed between the two logs. As a result, the employee sustained a right pinky finger amputation.
On November 28, 2018, an employee that was discarding trash to an outside dumpster slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering fractured ribs.
An employee was spotting a roller truck driver from the top of a dumpster. The lower half of his body was pressed between a beam and a truck, and he suffered ruptured organs.
An employee was clearing a line between a tender boat and a shear barge. The boat and the barge met, smashing the employee's right thumb between them. The thumb was partly amputated.
An employee was cleaning a meat/cheese slicer. The slicer amputated the tip of the employee's right thumb (with no bone or nail loss). The slicer was not energized; PPE was not being worn.
An employee was operating a standup clamp powered industrial truck (PIT) when he was caught between a concrete bollard and the PIT. He was hospitalized with a crushed ankle.

An employee was operating a work vehicle and driving on a private road to meet with her supervisor when she hit an icy patch in the road and lost control of the vehicle, striking a telephone pole. She suffered a contusion of the left lower leg, a contusion of the right hand, and a contusion and laceration of the cerebrum, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing asbestos-covered insulation from electrical lines underground when an arc flash occurred, burning his right and left hands. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing continuity testing on a circuit breaker. An alligator clip touched energized parts of the circuit breaker, causing an arc flash. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns.
An employee's ankle broke when he slipped on ice while walking in the parking lot.

An employee was setting up stamping arms on a 60-pound pig casting machine. One of the stamping arms was not operating properly, and the employee was on top of the mold chain conveyor trying to fix the stamping arm. The employee was walking up the mold chain conveyor when the employee s foot became caught in the mold against the slide and the machine began to pull the employee down with the chain. The employee's right foot and ankle were smashed, and large amounts of swelling occurred. The conveyor was moving at the time of the incident.

At about 9:45 a.m. on November 28, 2018, an employee was walking back to a conveyor to make sure no packages had been left behind. The employee slipped, fell forward with the left foot caught, and suffered a broken left fibula. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a directional drill to install 12-inch water pipe. The employee's right leg got stuck between the gearbox and the rod box, suffering breaks in many places. The employee was hospitalized.
After delivering mail, a letter carrier returned to the post office and was lifting 10- to 15-pound tubs and pulling trays. His lower back seized up and he was hospitalized.

On November 28, 2018, an employee was attempting to remove a jammed part from a tumbler door. When the part was removed, the air-actuated door closed on the employee's finger, resulting in the amputation of the right middle finger distal tip.
An employee tripped while stepping over a 5-inch curb and fell into a guardrail, fracturing the left humerus. The employee was hospitalized.
While installing roof decking, an employee fell 15 feet to the ground.

An employee was walking out of a mobile office trailer. The access stairs for the trailer had been moved; the employee fell about 4 feet from the trailer to the ground, suffering several rib fractures.

An employee was operating a brake press to bend a long narrow part that required multiple bends. During the last bend, the bottom of the part popped out and he attempted to grab the part to keep it from falling. His finger was pinched between the part and an exterior holding arm, resulting in an amputation of the end of his finger.
An employee was cutting a tree limb with a chainsaw in an elevated bucket when the limb (after it was cut) fell toward the employee and struck his left forearm, causing a muscle injury.
An employee was guiding/feeding rope through a winch when the winch caught/pinched the employee's left thumb, causing a partial amputation.
On November 28, 2018, an employee was standing in a 4 1/2-foot trench when it collapsed. The falling clay/dirt broke the employee's left leg.
An employee was erecting steel racking when a piece of the steel fell and hit the employee. The employee suffered a broken skull, shoulder, arm, and wrist.

On November 28, 2018, an employee placed a check fixture on a rolling cart using an overhead hoist. As the employee was rolling the cart, the cart struck a seam in the concrete, causing the fixture to shift and crush the employee's left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On November 28, 2018, an employee was unloading bars with a forklift and then reversed in order to realign the forklift. The forklift mast was elevated at the time and hit a cross beam overhead, causing his forklift to overturn. His fingers were caught between the overhead guard and a concrete column, resulting in finger amputations.
An employee was pushing meat through a short rib saw. His right thumb was caught by the saw blade and was amputated just below the fingernail.

On November 28, 2018, at 9:40 a.m., an employee was removing some meat bins from the meat grinder. As he was removing a meat bin, he was holding the top of the meat mixer cover open. The cover accidentally closed on his finger, injuring the middle finger on his left hand. The injury resulted in a surgical amputation of his left middle fingertip.

An employee working as a bus monitor stood up to aid a student. When the bus hit a bump in the road, the employee fell and hit their head and the left side of their body. The employee was hospitalized for a stroke and brain bleeding.
An employee was attempting to release the fifth wheel and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was walking into work from the parking lot to start her shift. She slipped on ice and fell in the lot; her left patella was fractured into multiple pieces. She was hospitalized.

An employee was next to a house, using an excavator to dig a trench for drainage pipes. Seeing a coworker run toward the back of the house where another coworker was working, the employee quickly swung the cab away from the side of the house (to make space to exit) and jumped out. The cab swung back, pinning him against a brick chimney. He suffered a crushed torso and collapsed lungs and was hospitalized.

A truck had dumped a load of scrap metal, and a large piece of pipe rolled under the tandem tire. An employee was standing to the side of the truck (about 15 feet away) as it started to pull away. The tire then rolled over the pipe, causing it to shoot out from under the tire and strike the employee in the shin. The employee suffered a broken leg.
During horseplay in a trailer, an employee attempted a backflip and landed on his face. He suffered severe facial lacerations, as well as a fractured and dislocated jaw.
An employee was cutting an HDTP pipe with a chainsaw. The saw kicked back and struck his left leg above the knee, causing a laceration. He was hospitalized.
An employee reached into a conveyor to remove a stuck piece of tire. The guarded tail roller of the conveyor caught his glove and pulled in his left arm, resulting in a broken bone and muscle damage.
An employee was clearing the asphalt sprayer bars on the back of a distributor truck when asphalt sprayed and burned his hands and forearm.
An employee was preparing wiring for an industrial baler when the wire uncoiled and lacerated his sternum.

An employee was climbing an access ladder attached to the rear of an RV. He slipped and fell about 8 feet to a concrete floor. His left wrist and shoulder were broken, and he was hospitalized for surgery.
A driver was picking up packages. While walking with them, the driver tripped on a wheel chock and fell off the dock to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was walking through a parking lot to his car when he slipped on ice and fell, suffering several rib fractures.
An employee was preparing for work when her left foot struck an object. She then fell to the concrete floor and broke her hip.
An employee was providing home healthcare services when the employee fell to the kitchen floor of a private residence and fractured a shoulder, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was going up a ladder near the top of a module builder when he stepped off the ladder and went to open the door of the module builder cab.  He reached to open the cab door and lost his balance, falling to his right. He grabbed at the ladder but missed, and his right leg went through the ladder and snapped, breaking both bones in his lower leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was positioning an angle iron to set a stop for punching holes. The punch machine was engaged, crushing his left middle finger and necessitating a medical amputation.

On 11/29/2018 at approximately 7:45 a.m., an employee was positioning a choker strap between a pipe and a reducing "T" as it was being lifted when the pipe fell/slid off a skid and pinched/crushed the employee's right thumb between the choker strap and the pipe.
An employee slipped on ice/snow and broke his ankle.
An employee was cutting lumber using a powered saw when the blade cut his left hand, resulting in the amputation of two of his fingers.
An employee lost her balance while mopping a restroom. She fell to the floor and struck her left elbow, causing bleeding, swelling, and a possible fracture (pending surgery).

An employee slipped on ice while walking and carrying a block of salt lick through the company parking lot. He slipped and fell on a patch of ice and the salt lick landed on his right index finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee fell off a roof to the ground 8 feet below, breaking both feet.
An employee stepped on a piece of plywood over a screened porch and fell 17 feet backwards to the ground. The employee sustained head and back injuries.

An employee was attempting to anchor down on the top ridge of a new two-story house (7:12 pitch) when his feet became tangled on the tie-off rope, causing him to lose his balance and eventually fall about 20 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with three broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a fractured pelvis.

On 11/29/2018, at approximately 9:30 AM CST, an employee was conducting a pressure test of a plug valve manifold when a sudden drop in pressure occurred. He was going around the blast wall to determine the cause of the leak when a bonnet likely separated from the manifold and struck his leg, fracturing and lacerating it.
An employee was cutting and removing the wires from a paper bale when part of the bale fell apart, causing a fracture to his leg.
An employee was pulling an empty mail hamper into the building when the employee lost grip of the hamper and fell backwards onto the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibia.

An employee was working on a needle press when it became jammed. While he was attempting to unjam the press, his left hand was caught in the press, resulting in the amputation of his left hand and part of his arm. The press had not finished its cycle at the time of the incident.

Employees were moving a piano down the stairs of an apartment. The dolly slipped and an employee was pinned by the chest between the piano and the wall. The employee suffered contusions and pain in the chest/neck/back, losing consciousness briefly.

An employee was laying bricks from the working platform of a scaffold. Boards gave way and the employee fell 25-30 feet to a dirt floor. The employee suffered a broken heel and a hairline fracture of the hand.
After strapping a child into a seatbelt, a bus driver's assistant fell to the floor while going to her seat. She broke her ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A welder was welding when some paint thinner fell from above, causing an ignition. The welder suffered facial burns.
An employee fell in a facility, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee jumped out of the tailgate of a work truck, breaking his lower left tibia.
An employee collapsed while working on a scaffold, falling to the concrete below. The employee suffered a broken neck and a brain injury.
An employee opened the door to a brewery kettle to check the liquid level. The boiling contents overflowed, causing second-degree burns to the employee's upper body.
An employee was walking down a hallway when her toe caught on the floor. She fell, breaking her arm.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lower a wind wall. As he lowered the piece into place, it crushed the fingers on his left hand. The nail bed had to be surgically removed and two fingers were fractured.
An employee tripped and fell, breaking his right wrist on the ground.

An employee was going to hammer in the shaft of a paddle wheel and was waiting for it to rotate to the correct position before shutting it off. His hand was on the guard when it slipped off the guard and became caught between the pulley and the belt. He suffered an amputation of the left ring finger just below the fingernail.
An employee was cutting metal rod when the band broke and fell onto the employee's leg breaking it.
An employee was mounting an extension ladder to climb down into a trench when he fell into the trench, breaking a vertebra.

A service technician was working from a bucket truck about 14 feet high, repairing a sign. He received an electrical shock after touching the metal channel letter raceway, suffering severe burns to both of his hands. He was hospitalized.

An employee was reaching between a blowout preventer (BOP) and tubing slips to pick up the BOP ring gasket when the chain broke on the BOP, causing the BOP to fall and crush the employee's right index finger. The employee's finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
A rural mail carrier was walking his route when he fell on a metal object in a yard, cutting his left thigh.
An employee fell off the third or fourth rung of a ladder when its feet slipped. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery for an elbow injury.
An employee was filling pitchers with ice and water. The employee's hand was caught in a door, causing the amputation of a fingertip.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and impacted the ground, sustaining a concussion.
An employee tripped over a power cord and fell to the floor, fracturing her shoulder.

An employee was moving a production pallet into place to be picked up by a forklift. Another pallet shifted and both pallets fell onto the employee's legs, breaking a femur. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was intervening with a resident in crisis. The resident punched her twice in the face, causing her to fall to the floor and hit the back of her head. She lost consciousness and suffered a concussion, and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting film when her arm was pulled into a spindle on the winder machine. The arm suffered multiple fractures.

At about 6:45 p.m., an employee was riding in a rear-loading garbage truck, helping the driver. The truck stopped to pick up garbage, and the employee got out to pick up garbage cans. The truck drove forward over his right foot, breaking it.
An employee was sanding an elastomer-covered pipe using an abrasive belt. The rotating lathe caught his right hand and arm, pulling them in and fracturing the arm.
An employee reached under a bacon slicer to remove scraps when his right index finger contacted the slicer blade, resulting in an amputation to his fingertip pad with no bone loss.
An employee was unhooking a shackle when the machine moved the washout box, pinching the employee's left middle finger between the box and the shackle and causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, suffering a leg fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a manual, lever-style paper cutter to cut lintless wiper tiles to size when his left thumb went over the bar. The paper cutter blade then cut his left thumb tip, resulting in an amputation from the base of the nail through the front tip of the thumb.

On November 30, 2018, at approximately 8:30 a.m., an employee was attempting to adjust the rollers on a rewind machine when his left gloved hand was pulled between the wire and rollers, resulting in the amputation of part of his left middle fingertip.
An employee drove a car into a bay for service work. She fell while leaving the car, breaking her left ankle.

An employee was placing and moving product onto a conveyor belt when he tripped over a pallet on the floor. He hit his head and arm on a support pillar, suffering a laceration to the arm and an injury to the head.

Employees were setting a 700 lbs. I-Beam for bridge construction. The beam was lying on the ground in the roadway. As it was lifted into position to hoist, the beam tipped over onto the injured employee.  The employee sustained multiple broken bones in both lower legs.
An employee was cutting a used 55-gallon drum when it exploded. The employee sustained contusions and broken bones.
An employee was attempting to remove frozen material when his hand was crushed by a steel gate, breaking three bones.
An employee fell off a roof to the ground while removing shingles from the roof, suffering a neck injury.

An employee was taking a hydraulic cylinder that was still under pressure off a forklift. The pressurized hydraulic fluid then released, de-gloving the employee's left pinky finger and cutting the ring finger. The pinky finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee struck his head on a metal oil pan while jumping from one bay platform to another. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was struck by a semi-trailer while pulling product out of the truck, suffering six broken ribs.

Two employees were in a van when one of the employees drove the van through the doors of a maintenance garage at a cemetery and struck another unoccupied work vehicle. One of the employees was hospitalized for contusions.
While operating a power washer, an employee fell and hit their head, suffering an injury that required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while carrying a metal part. The metal part dropped on his hand, crushing his right middle finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On November 30, 2018, an employee was loading a shaft onto a winding machine using an electric hoist when the shaft caught the corner of the machine and began to fall from the hook. The employee's foot was struck by the falling shaft, partially crushing it and resulting in a big toe amputation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a tent with three other employees when he stepped in a grassy area and fell, fracturing his right femur.
An employee's leg was caught between an order picker and a guardrail.
An employee was cleaning the interior of a gasoline storage tank using a power washer to facilitate disposal. A fire in the tank caused third-degree burns to the employee's face and hands.
An employee was working as a cashier in a convenience store. A man in the store attacked her with a knife, stabbing her in the throat and abdomen.

An employee driving a powered industrial truck (PIT) had paperwork on the PIT and the papers flew off. The employee stepped off the PIT to retrieve the paperwork and the PIT struck the employee's right lower leg, fracturing it.

An employee was using a 6-ft. self-supporting fiberglass ladder to remove light fixtures. He was working from the top step when the ladder kicked out from under him and he fell approximately 5 ft. to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle and a compressed L-4 vertebra disk.
An employee dismounted a skid-steer loader and fell into a trench injuring his right shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had connected two pieces of large wire together to provide a continuous feed of wire into a plastic extruder. The feed wire comes into the process on large metal reels; the employee was taking up the slack using a reel pay-off machine. As the wire slack was taken up on the reel, the wire swept the employee off his feet. The employee landed on his left shoulder and the left side of his head. He was hospitalized, suffering a subarachnoid and subdural hematoma as well as a shoulder injury.
An electrician was troubleshooting 480 volt 3-phase wiring when their left hand fingers contacted exposed wiring causing burns to the ring and pinky fingers.
An employee slipped while walking out of the freezer.
An employee was walking backwards while pulling a pallet jack and tripped and fell resulting in a fractured left leg.
While accessing a second floor window for cleaning, an employee slipped and slid down the roof to the ground. He fractured his left elbow and left ankle.
An employee was hospitalized with a facial laceration and concussion after being struck in the head by the loading bar of a crane.

An employee was performing maintenance on an auger at a gin and was pulled into the auger when it was activated. The employee sustained damage to both legs including an amputation injury to the left leg.
An employee was cutting corn. As he dumped it onto a trailer, he slipped and the trailer ran him over, possibly breaking his ribs.
An employee was performing maintenance on a drilling rig when a lever was inadvertently pushed, causing a hydraulic ram to crush the employee's foot and resulting in the amputation of two toes.
On 12/01/2018, a driver was unloading freight, pushing a cart, when it rolled back and jerked and then fell over onto the driver's right leg/ankle. The right ankle was broken and required surgery.
An employee was pulling non-recyclable material and fell, suffering a broken left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a cord and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken hip.
An employee fell while stepping out of the cab of his truck. He suffered a head injury.
An employee was driving the company car and collided with another vehicle in the pumping area. The employee suffered convulsions and difficulty breathing following the collision.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck to transfer and deliver palletized supplies to a staging area. The employee was found lying on the ground next to his truck, which had struck a storage rack and was partially underneath it. He was hospitalized, having suffered rib damage and a punctured lung.

An employee was driving a car and ran into the back of another car that a second employee was cleaning. The employee who had been driving was dazed and short of breath. The second employee sustained injuries to the back and neck. Both were hospitalized.

At 8:35 p.m. on December 2, 2018, an employee was on a 9- to 10-foot mobile work platform ladder, using an air hose to dry the head pulley of a feed conveyor to keep it from slipping. The employee lost balance and began to fall forward, and their right glove was caught between the conveyor belt and the head pulley. The employee was pulled in, suffering a closed fracture to the ulna and radius.

An employee was moving an air hose that was under a table, which was being lifted by a forklift. The table shifted, and the employee's right middle finger was caught between it and another table. The finger was partially amputated.
During roofing installation, an employee fell 18 feet from the roof to the ground and sustained broken wrists and facial fractures. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.
A grocery store cashier was shot twice (once in the cheek, once grazing the chest) by a handgun during an attempted armed robbery.
An employee working with a tire was injured and hospitalized.
At about 12:30 p.m. on December 2, 2018, an underground worker was working on a power line when it became energized. He suffered a burn to his hand and finger.
An employee suffered a right thumb tip amputation while working on a shaping press.
An employee was installing duct work from a 10-foot ladder when the employee fell off the ladder and was struck by the duct, fracturing the right elbow and left leg.

An employee was placing product into a condemn barrel. The barrel is underneath a conveyor belt. Her left arm was caught by the conveyor belt and pulled into the drive shaft resulting in a fractured left arm.

An employee had been setting up a machine for production. The employee reached into the die to check a bolt that may have been loose. At this time, the controls were engaged resulting in a right middle finger amputation.
An employee was walking on an elevated edge, using a broom to clean cobwebs and dust. The employee fell about 9 feet to a concrete floor, suffering a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting 4x4x15 pieces of steel on a wall saw. While positioning the steel, the employee's right hand was pinched between the hydraulic clamp and the steel. The right pinky was degloved up to the second knuckle. The employee required a medical amputation of the pinky just below the knuckle.

An employee was undoing a snag of wire splice hung up on a pole. The wire snagged the employee's left glove, pulling the employee's hand into the wire rollers; the employee's left thumb suffered several fractures.

An employee was attempting to clean out clogged product from the bottom gate of an industrial mixer screw conveyor when the screw caught his left index finger, resulting in the amputation of his finger to the first knuckle. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a truck behind a vehicle laying down road striping. A tractor-trailer veered into the work zone, striking the employee's truck. The employee suffered back, neck, hip, and head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was transferring liquefied petroleum gas to a residential storage tank when a faulty valve released propane vapors that burned the employee's face and caused eye damage.
An employee was conducting an estimation for house insulation when a contractor on site threw debris out of a window. The debris hit the employee's head, causing a head laceration.

An employee was attempting to bend a 90-degree angle on a part at a press brake when his right index finger was caught between the machine and the part, resulting in an amputation from the nailbed to the fingertip.
While repairing a truck trailer, an employee fell backwards to the ground, suffering a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot between vehicles. The employee was found unconscious and unresponsive.

An employee was on a 20-foot extension ladder replacing a light fixture on the outside of the building next to the basement entry. The employee fell approximately 10 to 15 feet off the ladder and was hospitalized.

On December 3, 2018, an employee reached into the fluff grinder of an extrusion machine to empty the fluff. The employee sustained an amputation of the right pinky finger to the first knuckle. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was test-riding a bike he had just assembled. The bike crashed, and the employee suffered a compound fracture to the upper right arm.
An employee was lifting a 35-lb. battery and injured his back. He was hospitalized with lower back pain.

On December 3, 2018, two employees were making tablets of an automotive airbag propellant (MA3-71) on the rotary press. The employees were remotely operating the press from the hallway and observing the operation through a window. An explosion in the press occurred and a piece of metal shrapnel penetrated the glass window and lacerated one of the employee's shoulders. The injured employee was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a broken pin on a 7-millimeter expander. During the repair, a 200-pound guide plate dropped about 5 inches and landed on top of the employee's right fingers. He suffered a broken bone on his right index finger and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was running a test/debugging equipment when his left thumb was amputated down to the knuckle by the machine blade. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was positioned on an extension ladder to pour concrete. The concrete bucket slid from the forks of the forklift and struck the ladder causing the employee to fall 8 to 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right wrist and left ribs.
An employee was punched by another employee causing them to fall to the floor and hit their head. The employee sustained a brain bleed.
An employee was driving a forklift, which struck another forklift. The employee broke a bone above the left ankle.
An employee on the production line suffered a fingertip amputation when their finger was caught between a roller and a belt while grinding automotive belts.
While trying to fix a pulley and tarp system on a shred truck, an employee sustained the amputation of half an inch of the middle digit on the right hand.
An employee fell from a ladder and was hospitalized.
An employee's fingers were amputated while attempting to clear a jam in a sliding table saw. The saw was running at the time.

An employee was performing a pre-trip inspection of a tour bus when she tripped on an opened wheelchair ramp and fell to the ground. She suffered fractures in her arm and right shoulder, and was hospitalized.
An employee was placing screens at a sifter when his left middle finger was caught in the press plate of the sifter resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was lifting heavy boxes in the warehouse when the employee strained the upper arm, experiencing pain that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a 45-degree angle. The saw kicked back during the cut and the employee's hand was forced into the saw blade. The employee suffered a cut on the right palm and a partial amputation of the fifth digit of the right hand. The saw was not guarded at the time.
While using a glass sheet cutting machine, an employee suffered a compound fracture and a partial amputation of the left ring finger.

An employee was getting out of a semi-truck passenger door, inside the mechanic shop. He put his foot on the foot board and went to move it down to the lower step when his foot got caught on the board's grating. He fell approximately 34" onto the concrete floor sustaining a fractured left hip.
An employee was assaulted while attending to a patient under constant observation. The employee was rendered unconscious due to a head injury or strangulation.

An employee was operating a chainsaw while cutting brush and small trees in a utility right-of-way. The employee cut an 8- to 9-inch ash tree and the tip of the saw came in contact with a stump resulting in a kickback. The chainsaw struck the employee, resulting in a laceration and fractures to the face.

Two employees were performing aerial work using a bucket truck. One employee was in the bucket when the truck backed into a 3-phase electrical line (7500V). The power grounded him and held him on the wire. He was hospitalized for second to third degree burns to 30-40% of his body.
An employee was removing files from a rolling filing cabinet when her foot was caught on the file base of the cart, resulting in a fractured left ankle and right foot. She was hospitalized.

An employee had blocked the presser to remove a jam from the gasket machine. After starting the machine the employee realized the safety block needed to be removed. When the employee tried to remove the block, the machine completed its cycle and caused the partial amputation of a finger.

An employee was removing ketchup from a fixed pusher bar. The employee's fingernail was caught in the conveyor; the fingernail was removed, the fingertip was amputated, and the distal phalanx was fractured.

An employee was using a forklift to transport a mechanical part. During transport the part fell off the forklift causing the operator to look sideways. The forklift struck a support pole of the warehouse canopy. The employee's left foot was crushed between the forklift and the pole.
An employee was plowing a conduit, watching warning tape go into the shoot. The tape holder brushed against a telephone pole while his hand was on it, and his fingertip was pinched and amputated.

An employee was unloading chicken coops from a trailer on a dock. The employee turned to place a coop on a conveyor, and his foot slipped down next to the knuckle chain. He fell, breaking his left leg between the tibia and fibula.

An employee was unloading a telehandler on a flatbed trailer when the telehandler fell from the flatbed trailer and overturned. The employee struck the ground and telehandler as he fell, suffering broken ribs that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was transferring a steer into a trailer from a holding pen. An animal struck a gate panel, which caught the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized, and three fingers were medically amputated.

An employee sprained their left foot after falling from an upper roof surface to a lower roof surface. The employee was connected to a lifeline, but there was enough slack to allow the employee to contact the lower level before the lifeline stopped the fall.
While lifting a case from the floor, an employee suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was screwing a saver sub into tubing when the employee's left pinky finger was caught between the chain and saver sub, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was driving a forklift when it and an automated vehicle collided. The employee's right hand was smashed and broken between the two vehicles.
An employee was turning on a power press while trying to install a crimp ring when the crimping die amputated parts of the employee's right index and middle fingers.

An employee was manually feeding boards into the planer to put a jointing edge along the long side of the boards. Their left hand slipped, bounced off the guard's edge, and contacted the cutting blade. The left ring fingertip was amputated up to the first knuckle.
An employee was grinding a part when their glove got caught on a flange and their hand contacted the grinding stone. This resulted in the partial amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was climbing down from a ladder while stocking light bulbs on a shelf. The employee slipped off the last step and fell to the floor, suffering a shoulder injury.
An employee was cutting chicken with a parts cutting saw. The employee's hand contacted the saw blade, amputating the little finger.
An employee's left index finger was caught and amputated in the piercing machine.
An employee was breaking a flange free from a pipe that was approximately 90" in diameter. When the pipe flange broke free it smashed the employee's left foot against an immovable object.
On December 4, 2018, an employee was walking with a dolly carrying boxes when an unmanned forklift struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was moving a gate valve to a different pallet. His left middle fingertip was caught between two hand wheels (one used to open and close that valve, one for another valve) and amputated.
An employee was rigging down a well servicing rig. As the derrick was lowered, it severed his right index finger and thumb under the knuckle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was demonstrating a single-man rescue kit. It is a product that allows an employee to escape from a bucket truck if the truck becomes inoperable. The kit includes a rope and a descender. The employee was to hook onto the bucket and to his harness. While descending, he fell to the ground and sustained a broken right leg.

On December 4, 2018, an employee was getting off a forklift to dump a bin into a dumpster when the bin flipped back. It pinched a finger on the employee's left hand, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was standing on a 10-foot extension ladder while winding a garage door spring.  The spring broke, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall off the ladder.  The employee suffered sprains in both hands and spinal compression fractures (L1-2 and T-12), requiring hospitalization.

On December 4, 2018, an employee had repaired a hot water system line and it began to leak after it was turned back on. It was then shut off, and an adjacent line and pump were turned on. The employee went to find the serial number off the pump that had leaked; when he was in the area, the adjacent pump sprung a leak and sprayed 180-degree water onto him. His back, shoulder, and eye were scalded.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor inside an elevator, injuring both shoulders.
An employee was stocking shelves. He turned to place an item on a shelf and suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was cutting down a pepper tree from ground level using a chain saw which became stuck in a branch. While attempting to free the saw it engaged, kicked back, cut through his glove and lacerated his right palm requiring stitches.

On December 4, 2018, an employee was dismantling and installing pallet uprights. The employee was struck by a narrow-aisle forklift being operated by the host employer Luk USA LLC. The employee sustained a fractured hip and injury to the pelvic area.
A 16" diameter pipe, being lifted with a crane, was lowered onto an employee's hand. The tip of his right thumb was amputated.
An employee was walking under a beam and struck his head.
An employee was changing a liquid propane tank on a forklift. Gas leaked from the tank and the employee suffered frostbite on the hand.

An employee was removing plywood from a pallet rack when he slipped and fell. The wood cut his left hand (three middle fingertips) against metal shelving, resulting in the amputation of the three fingertips.

On December 4, 2018, an employee was assisting the operator of a multi-blade cutting system in the woodshop. The employees were cutting down wooden barrels. The operator was adjusting the machine and struck the still spinning blade while removing a piece of wood causing a severe finger laceration.
An employee was cleaning a sand muller when their right hand slipped into the machine and the middle finger contacted the blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was adjusting a part on a threading machine when their finger was caught between a clamp and v-block on the machine. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee was working from a 16-foot ladder wiring a light fixture; while doing so the fixture fell. The employee tried to catch it and fell off the ladder. The employee landed on the tile floor and sustained a broken arm.
An employee was moving materials and caught a finger between steel and concrete resulting in a left thumb amputation.
An employee was working from a ladder performing repairs on a truck. As he stretched out from the ladder, he lost his balance and fell breaking both wrists.
An employee was about to repair a module truck chain. The chain caught the employee's fingers, causing an amputation. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was moving a cart of waste cardboard when her finger was crushed between a swinging door and the cart resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a pry bar to free metal trim scrap that had become lodged at the exit of a slitter. The weight of the 700-pound scrap caused the pry bar to strike and crush the employee's right thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing up a ladder when it shifted and both the employee and the ladder fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured lower right leg.

An employee used a chair to look for some books on the top of a cabinet that was approximately 7 feet tall. As the employee stepped down, she lost her balance and fell to the floor, breaking her upper right arm. She was hospitalized.

An employee was tending a sandblasting pot when he attempted to get the hose unstuck and it struck his hand. He then fell backwards and began convulsing. He was hospitalized with a burn to the back of the right hand and internal issues.

An employee was stocking 50-pound bags of sugar. A load had shifted during transport in the rail car; the pallet collapsed and the load fell over. The employee was struck by a bag and suffered a fractured hip and nose.

An employee was running the horizontal band saw. As the employee was pulling out the piece of cut tubing the saw blade caught the employee's glove and pulled his hand onto the cutting surface under the blade. The employee sustained the amputation of four fingers from his left hand.
An employee was operating a mechanical power press and amputated the right index, middle and ring fingers.
An employee was guiding a steel beam during crane operations. His finger was fractured between a sidewall and the steel beam.

An employee was inside a work zone, spotting a dump truck that was backing up to a milling machine. Another truck, coming from the other direction, ran over the employee's left foot with the passenger-side front tire as it passed. He suffered several fractures to the foot, and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was observing a truck bed being loaded with logs and other tree debris when a log slipped out of the grappler machine and then contacted the employee's right foot. He was hospitalized with a laceration to his right foot.

An employee was preparing to remove a jammed spout from a spout block. The employee attempted to manually lift the spout block by pushing up on the cylinder underneath to get to the spout. The spout block came back down and caught his hand, causing a laceration and fracture. He was hospitalized. The machine was locked out and de-energized at the time.
An employee was pushed to the ground during a shoplifting event inquiry. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was on a ladder helping to guide a 400-pound angle iron into place so he could weld it to the brackets on the precast wall. The angle iron hit a bolt and disconnected from the magnet that was attached to the rigging of the crane. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and sustained a laceration to his head and bruising throughout his body. The employee was wearing fall protection.
On December 5, 2018, an employee was walking across the shop when their back locked up and they fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with back pain.
An employee was discarding metal pieces into a bin when the metal bounced back and struck the employee's cheek. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured cheekbone.

An employee was greeting customers at a grocery store entrance. While trying to help another employee push carts into the building, he tripped over his co-worker's feet and fell to the floor. He suffered cracked ribs and possible internal injuries.
An employee was exiting an aircraft when he slipped and fell sustaining a fractured hip.

An employee was distributing parcels for delivery. 
The dock door was propped open with a pallet and the employee proceeded to unload parcels and carry them inside the building. The door started closing and the employee lunged toward the dock door to catch it. The employee then tripped on the pallet and fell forward onto the concrete dock resulting in a possible broken orbital bone and fracture to the mandible as well as a bruised forearm and bruised elbows.
On December 5, 2018, an employee was operating a compound miter saw when their glove was caught in the machine, pulling their left thumb into the machine and causing a partial amputation.
An employee was driving a pallet jack when it stopped suddenly. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground fracturing the left hip.

On December 5, an employee was moving a bundle of 25 square pipes with an overhead crane. He hooked the bundle at each end. When he lowered the bundle, the pipes, which had separated, pinched back together. He was using his left hand to guide the load and his fingertip was caught between the pipes when they went back together, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation (tissue only).
An employee was filling a liquid storage tank. When the employee tried to open the filter by the pump, hot waste beer sprayed onto the employee's arm, causing a second-degree burn.
On December 5, 2018, a temporary employee was working at the Interline Brands, Inc. warehouse when her foot was run over by a powered industrial truck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was making photos of finished product in the yard before loading when the employee stepped backwards, tripped on level ground, and fell, suffering a leg fracture.

An employee was lifting a bucket of spilled fertilizer into a spreader tractor when the employee fell from the side of the tractor and hit the ground, suffering a concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was placing roofing supplies on the conveyor of his delivery truck when his hand slipped on the conveyor and his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was lifting a metal plate with a hoist when it fell, striking the employee's right ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery and stitches.
An employee was loading vehicles in a loading area. When a choke was removed, a vehicle struck the employee, fracturing the employee's tibia.
An employee was mopping the floor when he attempted to prevent a door from closing, slipped, and fell to the floor, injuring his left hip.
An employee was struck by an 800-pound coil that was on a spindle when it fell resulting in injury to the left leg and knee cap.
An employee was using a hammer drill when his glove became entangled in the drill, causing an amputation of his left middle fingertip.
An employee tripped on a box while walking through a door, falling to the floor and fracturing the right hip.
While setting up a CNC router, an employee contacted the cutting head resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
On December 5, 2018, an employee slipped and fell on the polished floor of the manufacturing plant and broke his arm, requiring hospitalization.
Two employees were at a roadside, digging pole holes using hydro pressure. The boom on a truck got close to electrical lines, which arced; the employees were shocked. Both were hospitalized.

An employee was in the grain elevator working to un-choke an airlock using an air gun with a long extension. In the process, the safety tip on the air gun contacted the airlock causing the air gun to twist. The employee's right index finger was caught between the trigger and the body of the air gun, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was on a ladder in a stock room, using a top stock cart. While descending the ladder, she fell from the last rung to the floor. She landed on her side, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.

At about 12:40 p.m. on December 5, 2018, two employees were rolling a starter on a compressor that involved inserting a large breaker into a switchgear. An arc flash burned both employees, and both were hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a roll-on/roll-off ship. While walking down the side ramp he slipped and fell, landing on the steel ramp surface an breaking his left hip.
An employee was moving a defective tank with a PIV walker. The tank rotated to the side and the handle of the PIV knocked him to the ground. The employee sustained a fracture to his right shoulder.
An employee was preparing to clean a neck skinner machine when the employee's hand was caught in the machine rollers, resulting in finger amputations.

An employee was removing a concrete barrier wall. He had his hand on the bolt that joins two pieces of wall together, trying to remove it, when the backhoe shifted slightly and pinched his right middle finger. He pulled the finger out of the pinch point and ripped the skin off the end. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was using sandpaper strips to polish a part on a rotating parts polishing machine. The employee's gloved hand was caught by the sand paper and was drawn into the machine resulting in the amputation of the right index finger up to the second knuckle.

Employees were purging an epoxy supply hose with MEK (paint thinner) inside an unventilated 4-wheel tow trailer. A torpedo heater in was in use at the time and ignited the MEK. Two employees received burns to the hands and face. A third employee inside the tow trailer was uninjured.

An employee was exiting from a scaffolding unit and transferring to a fixed ladder when his foot slipped on the top rung of the ladder. The employee attempted to grab the ladder while falling and dislocated both elbows. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking through the store, tripped over a box, and fell fracturing their hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a shaft in a confined space when a microbiocide chemical landed in their eye. The employee was hospitalized for chemical burns to the eye and back.
An employee was closing a trailer door and smashed their left hand in the door resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle finger.

An employee was standing approximately 10-15 feet from a worker that was hammering on a sheer pin. The pin snapped off and flew into the employee's eye, having passed between his cheek and safety glasses.
An employee was working below a rig platform. A rod transfer device was dropped from the  platform and struck the employee in the face. The employee sustained a fracture jaw and other facial bones.
An employee was reversing an electric pallet jack into an empty wooden pallet when he slipped off the pallet jack and his left foot was run over resulting in a partial amputation of his big toe.
An employee was operating a pallet jack in a refrigerated warehouse. The pallet jack malfunctioned and backed into racking. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.

On December 6, 2018, an employee parked a forklift behind a trailer on the loading dock, got off the forklift and was reading a shipping manifest. Another forklift backed out of a trailer and pinned the injured employee between the two forklifts. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hoist as part of the cleaning process for a reaction vessel. While moving the basket/screen that sits atop the vessel, a hoist strap on the spreader bar caught and then sprang loose. The employee was struck in the face fracturing maxillary and nasal spine bones and causing a laceration.

An employee had hooked his powered industrial vehicle (PIV) onto an empty rolling rack that is used to haul tire components. While attempting to pull it out, the tip of his right index finger was smashed between the empty rack and the light pole on the PIV. The right index fingertip was surgically removed.

An employee was painting structural beams on a cart. When it came time to flip the beam with the help of other employees, the beam pinched the injured employee's left index finger between it and the cart causing a partial amputation.

While attaching a trailer attachment to a low-boy trailer, an employee's  left index finger was  smashed between the attachment and the low-boy trailer's connectors resulting in amputation of the first knuckle.
An employee was hospitalized after both legs were lacerated with a drill bit.

A field tech was working on a ladder on a service call when the messenger cable broke causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, elbow and shoulder.
While walking into work an employee slipped and fell on ice and was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.

An employee was moving a panel on a sliding panel dry-erase board to access the panel beneath it when the board fell on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with stress fractures to the right hip and two fractures in the lower left leg.
