An employee was sliding boxes along the lobby floor. The top box was lighter than she expected so as she pushed the top box she fell to the floor along with the box. She landed on her side and suffered a broken femur.
A forklift's brakes malfunctioned, resulting in an employee being struck by the forklift. The employee was hospitalized with an injured pelvis.
An employee caught an edge and fell while testing a feature in a terrain park. The employee's right arm was broken.
An employee had been climbing or positioning himself on rebar and fell approximately 10 feet to the lower level decking. The employee sustained a broken femur.
While operating a rotary drill rig, an employee's right little finger was caught on a winch cable and amputated.
An employee was trying to unchoke a machine when their left middle finger was caught in a chain resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working from an aluminum telescoping scaffold approximately 12 feet high. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right wrist requiring surgery. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was walking near staging on top of a roof and fell 14 ft. through a hole between the staging and the ladder. The employee sustained 3 broken ribs and a back injury.
An employee was removing an end bell (round heavy piece of steel) from a chiller unit. The end bell slipped and fell on the employee's foot crushing bones that required surgery.
An employee performing preventative maintenance on an air handler. He was about to check the belts that rotate the shaft when the belt amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a mini-loader when it tipped over and fell on top of them breaking their left femur.

An employee had just welded a clip onto the side of a tube column and then started to weld a second clip. The employee leaned back against the hot clip that had just been completed, and the employee's shirt caught on fire. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the back.
An employee was standing next to his forklift when a second forklift backed out of a trailer and struck him. The employee's leg was broken.

An employee was in the parking lot gathering shopping carts. A car struck the shopping carts and the employee was crushed between the shopping carts and a parked car. The employee was bleeding from the head, sustained a back injury and one leg was twisted.

An employee was using a hydraulic submersible pump to clean a sewer main. The pump became clogged with rags. The employee suffered partial amputations to two fingers while clearing the clog. The pump was still operating at the time.

An employee was welding a rack together. The welding lead was draped over another rack which he had just finished welding together and had placed onto its side. As the employee was welding, he pulled on his lead and the rack it was draped over tipped and fell onto his lower left leg causing a fracture.

An employee was framing in a wood beam. The hoisting strap from a crane got stuck on his 8-foot ladder and pulled the ladder out from under the employee. The employee fell to the floor and was hospitalized with a fractured wrist.
An employee was reeling up a pneumatic hose, lost balance and fell, hitting their lip on the hose reel handle. The lip was cut and required surgery.
An employee was walking from one department to another when he slipped and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his hip.
A temporary employee was cleaning tables and pulling a cart that had multiple tables loaded onto it. The tables shifted and collapsed onto her. She was hospitalized with pelvic fractures.
An employee was using a horizontal bandsaw. Their glove became caught pulling their hand/thumb into the blade. The employee suffered the amputation of the right thumb tip.
An employee fell from a ladder and injured her knee.
An employee suffered electrical burns while securing a panel to the front of a panel box.
A Disney employee was servicing a noisy washing machine when something at the back of the machine caught his hand. He suffered an amputation injury to the right ring finger.
While repositioning his anchorage point (retractable safety device), the employee fell approximately 30 feet. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture, a broken arm and a spleen injury.

An employee was operating an electric forklift in the facility and backed into a control box. The employee's right index finger was caught between the forklift's overhead support and the control box resulting in amputation to the second knuckle.
An employee was performing maintenance on a pipe when it broke and sprayed hot water onto the employee causing burns.

An employee was unclogging a drain using a rotary cable. The cable snapped back and hit the employee's left hand, causing a laceration to his left middle finger and a partial amputation to the  ring fingertip.
An employee was moving drywall when the weight shifted and the drywall fell on the employee, resulting in a knee injury.

An employee was performing a routine check of the retainer system. He opened a valve to flush the solution back through the closed-loop system into the tank when a part of the valve failed. The heated solution struck the employee causing second degree burns to the right side of the torso and third degree burns to the right forearm.
While scanning at the rear door of a postal truck, an employee tripped over a pallet jack that was on the lift. The employee fell against the railing of the lift and sustained fractured ribs.
An employee slipped on a rag, fell and broke their knee.
An employee was walking on the tarmac to remove a cone from the tip of an aircraft's wing when they slipped on ice and fractured the right ankle.
An employee was operating a tugger when their left index finger was caught and amputated between the tugger and material.
On December 7, 2018, at 6:15 a.m., an employee delivered a package to a residential customer's door. The employee then slipped and fell on the customer's driveway, resulting in a fractured right leg.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press and amputated his left thumb above the knuckle.
An employee was walking down the stairs and tripped. The employee fell down several steps and sustained a broken ankle that required surgery.

A custodian was working from a portable scaffold system approximately 15 feet above the floor of the gym to repair lights in the scoreboard. Two additional employees were holding onto the scaffold at floor level. The employees tried to move the scaffold while the custodian was still on the platform. The scaffold tipped over and fell to the floor. The custodian and one of the employees on the floor suffered injuries. The custodian was hospitalized with a fractured knee cap and heel. The employee on the ground was treated at a hospital and released.

An employee on a loading dock took a step backwards to load a package onto a truck that had been backed up to the loading dock. However, the truck had pulled away and the employee fell 50 inches to the pavement, resulting in a broken wrist, elbow, hip, and pelvis.
An employee sorting paper and plastic recyclables suffered a heart attack.
An employee was cutting a tree's root ball using a chain saw. The tree moved and pushed him against another tree resulting in fractures to both legs.

An employee was working to clear a piece of trash from a roller on a pallet sorting machine. The roller control actuated causing a piece of plastic trash to wrap around the top part of the employee's left ring finger and pinch it. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the left ring finger just below the nail bed. The roller was not guarded at the time.
An employee was feeding the hose for the air dryer and hit their elbow on a frame bracket. The employee sustained an elbow bruise and infection.

An employee was climbing down into a basement egress window using a 6-foot A-frame ladder between the bottom of the window and the floor. He was on the second step from the bottom and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was trying to determine why an air compressor was leaking oil. While the employee had his arm inside a shroud covering a fan, the air compressor cycled on, causing the amputation of the employee's right arm below the elbow.
An employee was pulling service power wire through an occupied conduit on a utility pole and contacted a live 120-volt service resulting in burns to both hands.
An employee was on an order picker in an aisle when he fell approximately 8 feet to the ground and sustained a laceration on his forehead and a fractured right wrist.

An employee had been installing an approximately 52-foot long hydraulic jack into a PVC pipe in the ground. When there was about 5 feet of jack remaining, a pipe clamp broke causing the jack assembly to fall vertically. There was an approximately 2-foot square piece of metal plate attached to the top of the jack assembly. The employee's right arm was caught between the jack assembly's metal plate and the PVC pipe. The employee sustained crushing injuries including multiple fractures and the amputation of the arm from the elbow down.

An employee was dumping a tub of potatoes onto a conveyor. He lifted his foot to help lift the tub and brought his foot down onto the underside of the conveyor belt, causing the employee to fall. His right foot was then caught and crushed in the roller.
An employee had been heating a ball joint with a torch. A 2-inch piece of steel broke off and hit the employee in the chest.
An employee working on a forklift reached out to the forklift mast and his hand was crushed by the mast. The employee sustained broken bones in the left hand.

An employee was placing a board on a chop saw and lost their footing. The employee extended their left arm to regain balance and contacted the rotating blade of the chop saw resulting in an injury to the left middle finger. The end of the finger had to be medically amputated.

An employee was using a manual slicer to slice potatoes. A potato got jammed in the slicer and when the employee removed the potato, the slicer came down on their right middle finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was operating a forklift to move a bundle of steel from a truck. The bundle shifted on the forks. The employee then got off the forklift to adjust the bundle and the bundle shifted and began to fall off the forks. The employee attempted to get out of the way, but was struck by the bundle and sustained a broken left leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning out a piece of equipment prior to restarting. The palletizer noise dampening lid dropped on the employee's right thumb after the shock absorber failed resulting in amputation of the thumb.

An employee was hooking up the crane to the lifting collar. The pin would not enter the holes on the lifting collar. When the employee checked the holes for obstructions, the collar shifted and the tip of his left thumb was amputated.
An employee was performing maintenance on a machine when their left index finger was caught and amputated between the piston and the back of the barrel.

An employee was working to connect a sewer line (sewer tap) to a residential building. The wall of an 8-ft. ditch collapsed and the employee was pushed back against the other wall causing a fractured rib and fractured vertebrae between the shoulder and neck.
An employee was operating a pull-behind tugger and tripped over the forks of another forklift. The employee fell breaking her elbow and ankle.
An employee was lifting an aluminum tank when their right index finger was caught between a chain and the tank. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee tried to stop a fire associated with food burning in the kitchen oven. The employee inhaled smoke and was hospitalized with difficulty breathing and dizziness.

An employee was getting ready to load a forklift with a 55-gallon drum of hydraulic fluid. While the employee was manually pushing the forks into the pallet, the forks shifted and his right little finger was caught between the forks and the pallet resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
While an employee was scanning bills in the dock area, pallets that were on the forks of a forklift tipped over and fell on the employee. The employee sustained possible broken ribs.

Two employees used lock out/tag out (LOTO) procedures to change carrier chains. The chains became stuck. When one employee tried to release the chains, stored pneumatic energy was released catching the employee's right ring finger and crushing it to the first knuckle resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was servicing a pump and replacing the plunger pump when their left hand was caught between the plunger and piston. The employee sustained amputations to the tips of the middle three fingers and the tip of the left thumb.
An employee tripped over a cart and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip ball.
An employee was entering the plant on a windy day and the door slammed onto his right middle finger resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was climbing over a scaffold handrail to access a pipe rack when the employee fell approximately 5 feet to a lower level. The employee landed on his right side and sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was grinding castings on a large snag grinder. The part slipped and the employee's fingertip contacted the grinding wheel resulting in a severe abrasion requiring a surgical amputation.
An employee was operating a machine and amputated approximately 3/8" of the tip of his right middle finger.

An employee was on the safety platform on top of a tank car tightening up the bolts on a hatch with a ratchet. While turning the ratchet, the socket came off the bolt causing the employee to fall backwards approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.
An employee was using a torch under a vehicle when the fuel line exploded and a fire occurred. The employee was hospitalized for burns.
An employee had shown a car to a customer. After exiting the car, it rolled and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was leaning on a machine in the production area when his hand became caught in the machine. He sustained fractures to his thumb and index finger.
An employee was working with a wire sizing machine when a spool of wire became unraveled and the employee's finger was caught behind the spool resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was moving filing cabinets during hurricane cleanup at a job site. A second employee was moving filing cabinets that were on a dolly. The filing cabinets on the dolly tipped over and fell onto the first employee pinning him against a wall and fracturing his left leg. The injured employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was cleaning the belt on the meatball line. While removing a meatball from the moving metal conveyor their glove was caught in a nip point and the employee's left pinky finger sustained a fracture, torn ligaments and a severe laceration.

At 11:30 a.m. on December 8, 2018, a rural mail carrier slipped on an icy patch while walking through a parking lot toward an apartment building. The carrier fell to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee exited their car in a parking lot and slipped and fell on a patch of ice, breaking their right ankle.

An employee was helping to move a pipe using a tagline. The pipe was being lifted by a forklift. The pipe began to swing and the employee placed a hand on the pipe to stop it from swinging. The employee's pinky finger became caught between the pipe and one of the forks. The pinky finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was moving a well head blow out preventer (BOP) stack and the chains slipped, amputating approximately 3/8" of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was walking backwards, pulling a jack dolly when the employee fell backwards on his back and the dolly struck his legs.
An employee was installing master bushings during the casing running operation and suffered a crushing injury to the left index fingertip resulting in amputation of the first digit.
An employee slipped in the cooler, hitting their right rib cage on the vertical lip of the floor chain conveyor pan. The employee was admitted to the hospital with a collapsed lung.

An employee was moving items from an industrial washer to an industrial dryer. The employee grabbed the laundry with her right hand. The washing machine kept spinning and the employee's right arm got stuck in the laundry resulting in a dislocated elbow and torn ligaments and tendons.

On December 9, 2018, an employee operating a stand-up pallet jack in the stand-up pallet jack parking area backed up his machine and struck another parked stand-up pallet jack. His foot was pinched between the two pallet jacks. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated and broken left big toe.
About 90 minutes after an employee had completed the processing of an inmate he became unresponsive and was hospitalized, apparently due to an exposure to fentanyl.

On December 9, 2018, at approximately 11:00 AM, a maintenance employee of Toledo Elevator Company responded to a call to service a downed elevator. The employee tripped and fell down three flights of stairs. He was found at the bottom of a stairwell near the elevator shaft with multiple head lacerations, partial loss of an ear, and a fractured C-5 vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.
While an employee was delivering mail, a dog located at a residence jumped into an open window of the postal vehicle and bit the employee on the nose causing a loss of cartilage and a nose fracture.

An employee was conducting a test on a pipeline. While pushing a "pig" through a 20" pipe using compressed air, the steel door at the end of the pipe was blown off and struck the employee causing a broken arm requiring hospitalization and surgery.

A forklift got stuck in the loose gravel outside the facility. It began to fall over while pulling it out of the loose gravel using a yard truck. The forklift operator's left hand was crushed between the roll over protection cage and the ground resulting in the amputation of three fingers. One finger was reattached.
An employee fell while walking to the office door and sustained a broken lower right leg.
An employee was walking across a tractor trailer flat bed when his left leg gave out causing him to fall and fracture his left hip.

On 12/10/2018, an employee was replacing metal roof panels on a steel framed building. There was an open section in the middle of the roof where the old panels had been removed. The employee went to step on a metal purlin to walk across the opening and lost their footing. The employee fell about 12 feet through the opening and landed on top of a tractor cab that was parked inside of the building and then fell off the tractor about 12 feet onto the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

An employee was repairing an RV. The employee was using a flashlight and it fell inside the engine. As the employee was retrieving the flashlight, their right hand was caught in the rotating fan blade. The employee sustained amputation injuries to his right pinky, ring, and middle fingers.
An employee was using an upcut saw. It activated while her left hand was on the platform, amputating part of her thumb and forefinger.

An employee had been loading a gas cylinder containing chlorine gas. During loading the cylinder fell and struck the employee in the chin and the valve of the cylinder opened. Chlorine gas was then inhaled by the employee.

An employee was stepping down from an elevated platform, that is 30 inches above the floor, onto two stacked pallets that had two pieces of cardboard stacked on top of each other on the surface of the top pallet. The employee placed his right foot on a piece of cardboard that was not aligned with the pallet. His left foot slipped and he fell backwards, hitting his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained head injuries including hemorrhagic contusions with associated subarachnoid hemorrhage, subdural hematomas, and a fracture of the occipital bone.
An employee was hospitalized for surgery after sustaining a crushing injury when their hand was drawn into a conveyor belt.

An employee was in the entrance area moving a cart back into place when a second employee bringing in carts from the parking lot came in and bumped the first employee from behind. The first employee fell to the floor and landed on her side. The employee's wrist and hip were broken.

Two employees were working at a height of 35 feet to perform steel erection. The employees were using a horizontal lifeline for fall protection. They were using the stanchion from the lifeline for leverage when pushing beams with a pry bar. One of the fall protection stanchions that was attached to a beam popped off, and the horizontal lifeline pulled the employees to the ground. One employee struck the concrete half-wall of the parking garage next door and then fell down to the ground. The employee sustained a broken right leg, lacerated liver, heart bruise, and broken ribs.
An employee fell 7 feet from a ladder to the floor and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee fell from an 8-foot ladder while repairing a freezer door. The employee sustained a right tibia fracture.

An employee was driving a cement mixer. Upon entering the facility, the driver was unable to see the facility entrance due to the elevated lights and veered into a ditch. The employee was hospitalized for brain swelling.
An employee was stepping down out of his yard truck and missed the bottom step of the truck. The employee fell and struck the side of the truck while falling, fracturing four ribs.

An aircraft mechanic was conducting maintenance on an aircraft from the ground. When he extended a boarding ladder, which is built into the aircraft, his left thumb was caught in pinch points and amputated from the nail to the knuckle.

An employee was assisting another employee with loading package carts onto a delivery truck when his finger was smashed between the wall and the cart. The employee's fingertip was amputated. The fingertip was later reattached.
An employee was carrying a propane tank for a tow motor when he slipped and fell. The tank landed on his hand causing a severe finger fracture.
An employee fell from a tree to the ground during trimming operations and sustained an L1 vertebra fracture.

An employee was standing on stilts installing acoustic ceiling grids. He saw a ladder leaned on a corner and a 3-foot diameter plastic ring on the ground. When he took a step, one of the stilts got caught against the ring throwing the employee off balance. As he attempted to regain balance with his other foot, the employee stepped on a piece of conduit lying on the ground causing him to slip and fall. The employee sustained a right femur fracture.
An employee's finger was lacerated by a circular saw while cutting plywood.
An employee sustained a severe leg injury when a steel splice plate was dropped from an overhead crane.

An employee sustained a contusion injury when they closed their left thumb in the package car rear door.
An employee stepped from a platform (approximately 4" high) to pick up something from the floor, slipped, and fell to concrete floor resulting in a broken lower left leg.

An employee was laying down tubing and guiding the drill pipe when it got hung up and jerked causing the employee to fall through an unguarded V-door from the workover rig floor to a hydraulic catwalk. The employee suffered a fractured skull.

An employee was transferring liquid steel into a buildup area. As he was disconnecting a compressed natural gas hose, it struck him in the face causing a laceration to the jaw and cheek bone area and a potential fracture.
An employee's hand was lacerated while clearing a blockage in a leaf vacuum.
An employee was climbing up a straight ladder to access a hydraulic excavator when he slipped and fell 6 feet. The employee suffered a fractured left hip.
An employee was waxing the floor when they slipped and fell striking his head on the wall. The employee was hospitalized with possible bleeding on the brain.
On December 15, 2018, an employee sustained a partial amputation injury to the thumb while operating a spot welder.

On 12/15/2018, at 10:00 a.m., a ski instructor at Breckenridge Ski Resort fell on difficult terrain while leading a ski class. The employee broke their lower left leg and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was unloading a pallet of orange juice containers. The shrink wrap broke on a pallet and the employee was struck by the containers.

An employee was attempting to clear accumulating plastic bags in the rejection area with his gloved right hand. His gloved right pinky finger came in contact with the rejection feeder, amputating the fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was driving a vehicle to his station to be cleaned. Once he got out of the vehicle, the car moved forward and pinned him between the vehicle and a yellow pole. The employee sustained injury to the left side and stomach.
While an employee was removing a piece of plastic from a machine, the machine cycled, striking the employee and amputating part of her finger.
An employee was making preparations and fell approximately 12-14 feet. He was hospitalized with two fractured ribs, a broken wrist, a broken shoulder and a dislocated elbow.

An employee was retrieving material off the fourth floor. The employee stepped on the platform of a forklift outside the window and the platform collapsed. The employee fell to the ground and sustained injuries to the jaw, ribs, collar bone, hip, leg and ankle. All injuries occurred to the right side of the body.
An employee was collecting payment from a customer near the cashier booth when the customer's vehicle ran over the employee's right foot.
An employee fell from unsecured decking on top of structural steel resulting in seven broken ribs and a contusion.
An employee was dismantling a railroad car using a cutting torch and was struck by the end of the railcar and the slope sheet, resulting in a fractured right arm.
An employee was using a saw to bevel a 2x4 and amputated a thumb tip.
An employee's finger was amputated while cutting meat with a band saw.

An employee had been cleaning a paint gun. He tripped over the paint hose, lost balance and pulled the trigger of the paint gun. His left hand was sprayed with methyl ethyl ketone (MEK) and the force of the spray cut his glove and caused a laceration to the hand. The employee was hospitalized for infection.

An employee fell on a staircase at a new customer location. The fall resulted in right knee injuries including dislocation of the patella and a patellar tendon tear. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was driving a golf cart with an attached trailer, delivering packages in a residential neighborhood. The golf cart flipped and the employee sustained a right eye injury and a scalp laceration.

An employee was moving a rack of purchased glass with an electric power jack. The power jack jackknifed and the employee's hand was caught between the jack handle and the rack of glass resulting in amputation.

On December 17, 2018,  the injured employee was standing near where two other employees were disassembling the winch line from the easement machine. The winch line was being drawn in and the injured employee noticed that the eyelet at the end of the winch line was about to become stuck in the boom tip. As the injured employee grabbed the eyelet with his left hand and twisted it  to free it, the eyelet was abruptly pulled through the boom tip and his left index finger was amputated below the distal joint.
An employee was hit by a falling tree branch (4-5 inches in diameter and several feet long) and sustained lacerations to the left eyebrow, left forehead and right side of the scalp.
An employee had completed her mail delivery route and was headed back to the vehicle when she was struck by an on-coming car. The employee suffered a left leg injury.

On December 17, 2018, at approximately 4:00 p.m., the injured employee was directing a shuttle buggy operator who was moving a shuttle buggy which had contacted a light pole. The light pole fell and struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized with cerebral swelling.

An employee was taking packages to the drop-off box, located near the stairwell door, when someone opened that door and caused the employee to fall onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a broken hip.

An employee was standing and talking to another employee. He had his hand on the platform of a double impact or divine grinder. He stepped on the foot pedal which actuated the machine and his right hand was pulled in resulting in amputation of the pinky, ring and middle fingers as well as the index fingertip.
An employee slipped in water on the dock and fell onto his left side. The employee suffered a broken left hip.

A pallet jack driver was unloading cases of dry groceries from the trailer to the pallet jack when the trailer's door came down striking him in the face/head. The employee sustained fractures to his skull and nose and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a ladder pulling Romex cable. The cable got stuck and the employee lost his balance, falling from the ladder and landing on the right side of his lower back.
An employee was setting a beam inside a column when the beam came loose and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was unloading a machine and a part fell off. The employee reached to catch it and the glove on their left hand was caught in the belt resulting in an amputation to the left middle finger.

An employee was operating the retread builder, applying tread rubber to a casing. The tread rubber was a little short. He put his foot on the builder for additional leverage and grabbed the tread rubber with both hands to "stretch" the tread as the machine advanced. His foot was caught by the hub and pulled into the machine resulting in a compound fracture to his left ankle.
An employee was working on a light fixture when he lost balance and fell off a ladder to the floor sustaining a broken elbow.
An employee fell approximately four feet from a dumpster resulting in a broken right wrist/hand and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was on horseback checking cattle in pens. A cow scared the horse and the employee fell resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was ascending the stairs, slipped and fell.
While an employee was cranking down the landing gear, the handle spun backwards and struck the employee in the face and neck causing a fracture to the jaw.
An employee leaving work tripped over a curb in the parking lot and fell breaking a leg.
An employee was discovered with breathing issues while making a delivery. The employee was hospitalized with a collapsed lung.
An employee was struck-by an 1800 lbs. I-beam as it was being turned over by a crane resulting in multiple fractures of the left leg and tendon damage to the left knee.
An employee was working from a ladder replacing a tank liner when the ladder slid out from underneath causing the employee to fall 10 feet. The employee sustained a broken wrist and thumb.
An employee was going up a flight of stairs, missed a step and fell landing on his right side and fracturing the right hip.

An employee was operating a 12-inch dual compound miter saw to make a 45 degree angle cut into a 1-inch thick lead ingot. The employee wore leather-welding gloves and had his left hand on the ingot to hold it in position. As the saw blade contacted the ingot, the ingot shifted, which caused the employee's left hand to contact the saw blade. The employee sustained a laceration to his left hand.

An employee had been operating an excavator inside of the gondola building. Upon exiting the vehicle, the employee fell approximately 4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a laceration to the right side of the head, rib fractures to his ribs and left wrist and damage to his vertebrae.
An employee was setting a side rail on a trailer and smashed his left thumb resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was finishing the edge of a concrete pour for a highway section. He tripped and fell while moving out of the way, and his leg was run over by the wheel of the tube float. The employee sustained a displaced fracture of the right tibia.
An employee was pouring liquid nitrogen into a container. When she moved the container, her thumb was on the rim and liquid nitrogen splashed onto her thumb and index finger.
On December 18, 2018, an employee was cleaning a residential sewer with a steel cable. The cable wound around the employees' right hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was inside a rebar cage, helping a coworker hook up chains to rig for lifting. The cage shifted and the rebar collapsed to one side; the employee suffered crushing injuries to the chest and an ankle contusion. He was hospitalized.

On December 18, 2018, at a tower erection site, an employee working as an oiler was crushed when the jib of the crane fell on them. The employee suffered fractured ribs, pelvis and femur in addition to a collapsed lung and kidney damage.
An employee picked up a chicken from a moving conveyor belt and his glove became caught. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.

Three employees were sliding new auger flighting into a bin. The piece of flighting was 30' long and had to slide across an electric motor mount bracket. The injured employee's left index finger was caught at the pinch point created by the flighting and the motor mount bracket. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered a left ankle injury when it was struck by a moving vehicle while his leg was still outside of the vehicle.

An employee was unloading material that was stacked on rolling pallets on the truck. When the employee removed the tie-down strap, the rolling cart struck him and knocked him off the truck and he fell four feet to the pavement below. The employee was hospitalized for a subdermal hematoma to the head, lacerations, fractured ribs and a subdermal hematoma to the abdomen.

While securing the access ladder to the roof, an employee slipped on roofing paper and fell 8 feet. The employee was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae. At the time of the incident, the employee was wearing a harness but was not connected to an anchoring point.

An employee was reaching to access the roller area of a conveyor belt system to clean gypsum from under a roller. His hand was caught between the roller and the conveyor belt, resulting in second and third degree friction burns to the back of his right hand. The machine was running and guarded at the time.

An employee had been using a stone saw to cut granite countertops. After making a cut, the employee used a suction cup to pull a cut countertop toward them. The material dropped onto the table, and the employee's left thumb was caught between the two objects. The thumb was amputated from the first knuckle down.

An employee was unloading a pallet containing brake shoes onto pallet racking using a stand-up reach truck. His arm became pinned between the reach truck and the metal racking causing lacerations/bruising to his forearm and elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pinned between a wall and a reach truck and sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was clearing a jam in a bread slicer and suffered amputation of the left middle fingertip.

An employee was putting product away using a powered industrial truck. While stepping off of the equipment, the employee felt pain and discomfort in his foot. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured big toe that required surgery.

An employee was building a wooden crate around an industrial fan for shipment. The employee's material slipped and as he tried to catch a board a staple was shot into his right knee cap and femur. The staple need to be surgically removed.
An employee was trying to unlock an electrical breaker in a motor control center. An arc flash burned the employee's hands and upper left arm.

On December 18, 2018, an employee was using a cart to transfer a glass making device called a "baby cooler." The cart tipped over and the baby cooler fell off onto the employee's left leg fracturing the lower leg.

An employee was loading freight with a forklift and positioning freight against a trailer wall to be secured for transport. Heavy cargo that was moved against the trailer wall, slipped and fell onto the employee before it could be strapped in place. The employee was hospitalized for a possible spinal injury.
An employee was hospitalized with a skin infection after checking security in hospital rooms.
An employee was running a punch press, reached to grab a part out of the press, and the ram came down on top of their hand amputating the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a chainsaw to cut a small tree next to a fence and suffered lacerations to the left hand. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was walking towards a ramp over a large pit. The employee missed the ramp and fell into the pit, landing on the floor approximately 30 feet below. The employee sustained a fractured skull, broken T-5 and T-7 vertebrae, a collapsed lung, and head trauma.

An employee was operating a tooling center machine behind a barricade inside of a building when an explosion of unknown source occurred. The explosion blew the front of the barricade inward, forcing the employee backward and pinning him to the floor. The employee sustained multiple traumas and both legs were broken.
An employee was on a rooftop loading shingles from the conveyor to the rooftop. The employee slipped and fell to the ground breaking the left arm.
While an employee was installing a door opener, the limit switch chain engaged and amputated his fingertip.
A transport platform fell about 15 feet to the street below during dismantling operations, injuring five employees. Two were hospitalized for broken bones, bruises and contusions.
On December 18, 2018, a temporary employee was spotting equipment being loaded onto a trailer, when a wooden plank fell from the trailer and broke the employee's leg.

A temporary employee was installing duct work at a jobsite when he fell 10 feet through a drop ceiling to the office below. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle, heel, lumbar spine and thumb.
An employee was using a pedestal grinder to grind burrs off metal. The employee's right thumb was pinched between the metal and the grinding stone resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was cutting chicken using a knife and amputated his left index  fingertip.

An employee was operating a table top drill press drilling one-inch holes into a plastic part. The plastic part became stuck on the drill bit and spun. The employee's gloved right hand was tangled in the rotating chuck resulting in amputation of the index fingertip.

An employee was about to exterminate bugs in an oil well using acrolein. The chemical sprayed out of a valve, striking the employee in the midsection and causing chemical burns to his chest. He was hospitalized.

The injured employee was assisting a tie back drill. As the operator moved the drill toward the wall, the injured employee's left leg was caught between the rotating part of the drill and the wall. The injured employee's lower left leg sustained soft tissue swelling requiring hospitalization.
An employee was conducting pest control duties at a residence and was bitten by a dog. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee lost consciousness when they slipped and fell on ice while exiting a barn.
An employee dropped a humidifier panel on his left middle fingertip resulting in amputation.

An employee's right ring finger was caught between the hydraulic cylinder of the juice line press and the cylinder stopper while helping to transfer pineapple juice into a transfer cart to be used on another line. This resulted in an amputation.
An employee was removing Christmas tree lights from a trailer when his little finger was smashed between a forklift bar and a steel bar. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell while ascending a ladder, catching and breaking his leg between the fifth and sixth rungs.
An employee was cutting basil with a knife and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was performing maintenance on a heater treater. When he opened the heater treater door an explosion occurred. The employee sustained hand, body, and face burns.
An employee was getting out of the truck at a gas station, slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a ruptured spleen.

An employee was climbing a 24-foot extension ladder to get to the roof of a new one-story house when he lost his balance and fell to the ground. He sustained a fractured left wrist and dislocated left shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was obtaining product samples on a sample testing conveyor when his right hand was caught in a pinch point and the tendon between his thumb and index finger was severed.
An employee was oiling a running machine and suffered an amputation injury to the right middle finger when it was caught in a nip point. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee tripped over his machine's pedal and fell, suffering broken bones.
An employee was leaving work, slipped on a puddle of water on the floor and fell breaking a kneecap.

A temporary employee was cleaning a conveyor on a machine when the glove on his right hand was caught on the hinge of the conveyor and pulled into the motorized wheel causing a laceration, contusion, and bruises. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs and fell after missing a step. The employee was hospitalized for a tear in the quadriceps.
An employee was walking up or down the stairs, slipped or tripped and fell striking his head on the door. The employee suffered a laceration to the head.
An employee was stepping out of her truck to perform a pre-trip inspection. As she turned to step down, she slipped and fell to the ground, breaking her left ankle.
While changing the tire on a disabled semi, a technician was struck by a car. The technician suffered multiple lacerations and contusions from the neck to the pelvis, as well as a fractured pelvis.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting a box of gloves weighing between 1 ounce and 20 pounds.
While adjusting a rotating table on a process line, a mechanic caught and amputated the tip of his finger in the drive chain sprocket.
An employee was helping to load pipe onto a truck when a pipe came down onto the employee's right index finger causing a fingertip amputation.
While walking on a newly graveled area, an employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was struck from behind by a golf cart causing two fractured ankles and ribs.
An employee was installing a hydraulic cylinder when it slipped and fell. His right little finger was caught under it and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading bags of resin into containers at a loading dock. His head was injured between a container and the loading dock doorframe. He was hospitalized to treat a brain bleed.
An employee stepped into an aisle and was struck by a powered industrial vehicle (PIV). The PIV pinned his foot to a guardrail/toe board. The employee's foot was crushed.
An employee suffered fractured ribs, a fractured ankle, and facial lacerations after falling out of a mountain coaster cart while performing opening maintenance and cleaning on the track.
An employee was walking under the racking system at a grease plant when he hit his head on a crossbeam and fell. He suffered a head injury and two broken bones in his right ankle.
An employee slipped while unloading a home health care client's groceries from her car. The employee fell to the wet ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was hanging a sign, fell and struck their head on the floor.

On Wednesday, December 19 at approximately 10:00 p.m. an employee was retrieving boxes to take to her work station when she was struck by a forklift that was backing up resulting in injuries to both lower legs.  The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
Three employees were exposed to chlorine fumes while draining a tank. One of them was overcome by the fumes while descending a staircase and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on an antifatigue mat, falling to the floor and breaking a femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a propane buffer in an enclosed area when he felt dizzy and fell striking his head against a wall. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury and carbon monoxide poisoning.
An employee was moving a stack of drywall that was leaning against a wall. The stack tipped over and fell back onto him, breaking his left tibia.

An employee was loading insulation into pans to go into the oven. The molds jammed and the employee used a crowbar to unjam the molds. When the jam cleared, the crowbar broke loose and struck the employee in the face causing damage to an eye socket.
An employee was operating a horizontal band saw to cut pipe and amputated four fingers on the right hand.
While walking around to the other side of a pallet on a movable platform, an employee tripped over the pallet's corner and fell, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee opened the electrical enclosure to do an inspection. The employee reached into the enclosure to check the incoming wiring and contacted the wiring on the top of the breaker with his right ring finger, middle finger and thumb. The employee was hospitalized for burns and electric shock.
An employee was rigging a 5th wheel to be lifted by an overhead crane when the employee's right index finger was caught in a pinch point resulting in an amputation.
An employee was performing security services at a gate when she was startled and tripped, falling backwards to the ground. She struck her head, suffering a contusion.
Two workers received flash burns to their faces and hands while bleeding a residential gas line. The fire was ignited by the customer's cigarette.
An employee tripped and fell while walking in an office hallway. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the right elbow and left knee.
An employee was installing a tire on a rim. As the machine was running his left hand was on the wheel and the roller caught and amputated the tip of his left pinky finger.

Employee 1 was slowly transporting an electric motor via a lifting strap from a forklift while another employee (employee 2) was trying to keep the electric motor from swinging as the forklift was passing under a door. The electric motor slipped out of the lifting strap. Employee 2 tried to catch the falling electric motor and severely cut three fingers on his left hand. Employee 2 was hospitalized for hand surgery.

An employee was rinsing the inside of a tank with water from a 1-inch hose. The water pressure surged and the hose whipped around. Its metal nozzle struck the employee's head and face, causing a fracture to the right mandible, a head laceration on the right side of the head behind the ear, and trauma to the right side of the head.
An employee was walking in the grass to deliver a package to a customer when they slipped and fell breaking their lower left leg.

An employee added flux to molten metal. As the employee tried to push the flux into the metal with a rake, the metal erupted and splashed the employee. The employee suffered burns to the left side of the face, the top and back of the head, the left arm, the back, and the right ankle.
An employee was on a 9-foot ladder installing cables. He fell to the floor, breaking two ribs on his left side and suffering a concussion.
An employee was repositioning a bucket truck and struck an electrical line. The employee sustained burns to the forehead, left palm and buttocks.
An employee was cleaning out a salt machine. The employee's hand was caught in the auger area, suffering a broken bone.
An employee was climbing into a bucket truck, slipped, and fell. The employee hit their head and suffered a laceration.
Three employees were placing forks onto a backhoe. As the forks were slid onto the holder, an employee's finger was smashed between the forks and the backhoe. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was injured when their left arm was caught between the coiling can and idle can of an embosser. The employee suffered a broken left forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting air into an expansion tank when it exploded and fractured the left side of their jaw.
An employee was servicing a vision sorter. While the employee was retrieving paper under the machine, the belt and pulley amputated the employee's left index finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was handling a bandsaw in preparation to use the tool and severely lacerated a finger while removing the tool from a gang box.

An employee was cleaning a spot of asphalt from two rubber-coated rollers. The employee's left hand was pulled into the nip point between the rollers; the hand and fingers were partially degloved on the top side.

An employee was attaching/engaging a plate bug or clamp to a finished metal part weighing about 100 lbs. still within a press brake. The downward motion of engaging the plate bug onto the part caused the part to fall off of the press brake. The employee suffered an amputation injury to the right middle finger.

An employee was assisting a forklift operator by pointing out where the forks on the lift needed to go. His left index finger was caught between the forks and some lumber, causing lacerations and an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee operating a guillotine paper cutter amputated the top of the left middle finger while attempting to straighten 24" X 36" newspaper sheets that were being cut.

An employee was working on an air conditioning unit while on an 8-foot fiberglass ladder. He fell approximately 4-6 feet to the ground hitting his head. The employee sustained four broken ribs on the left side and scrapes on the hands.

After three metal pallets fell off a trailer, an employee came down from the trailer. The trailer then moved, and the tire of the trailer struck a metal pallet. The employee's left leg was caught between the pallet and a retaining wall resulting in a degloving injury to the calf.

An employee was working with a team to move a forming mold: a large steel tooling that weighed about 4,000 pounds. The employee was pushing the cart that held the mold in position. The mold did not position correctly; it kicked back, pinching the employee's right ring finger against the roller wheel on the cart. The finger was amputated.
An employee was about to enter a parked car and was struck by a vehicle being operated by another employee resulting in a broken right leg and wrist.
The injured employee was working with a mechanic to locate an oil leak on the crane. When the mechanic moved the crane, the injured employee was struck in the head by the grapple attachment.
An employee was cutting lettuce with a manually operated food slicer. His right thumb contacted the slicer's blades, causing a partial amputation to the tip of the thumb.
An employee was descending a two-step ladder, missed the last step and fell fracturing her hip.

While preparing to lock out equipment, an employee was caught under a platform as air bled from a cylinder. The employee suffered injuries (as well as difficulty breathing while pressed under the platform) and was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized on 12/21/2018 for an infection resulting from a spider bite that happened at work.
An employee was on a ladder inspecting a roof. The ladder slipped out on a wet deck and the employee fell. The employee fractured 10 ribs, an arm, their head and punctured the right lung.
An employee was cutting a rib loin with a bandsaw. The blade amputated his right middle finger at the highest joint and cut his ring finger.
While walking along railroad tracks, an employee was struck by a load that fell from a forklift. The employee's foot was broken.
An employee lacerated his ankle while operating a stand-up forklift.
An employee was threading paper onto a spool when his hand was caught in the rollers crushing his right arm.
An employee stood up from her desk, tripped on her chair's wheel caster and fell striking a filing cabinet with her shoulder. She sustained a shoulder injury requiring surgery.

An employee was welding a 25-foot, 1,700-pound steel I-beam when a forklift knocked it off its supports. It fell onto the employee, breaking his right collarbone and six ribs on his right side and causing a hematoma on his left leg.
An employee was shot by another employee during an altercation with a customer.
An employee was cleaning hot, hardening plastic from a barrel when the plastic exploded out of the barrel. The employee suffered burns to the face and hands.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to insulate a railcar. The ladder slipped and he fell about 4 feet, hitting the concrete floor and breaking his right tibia.

Two employees were unloading a slab of granite weighing about 1,000 pounds from a fifth-wheel trailer to an A-frame on the ground, using a clamp attached to a rented forklift. The A-frame shifted and the slab tipped over. One of the employees suffered a broken tibia and fibula, requiring surgical repair and pins; the other suffered several broken bones in the leg, as well as a possible broken hip and shoulder.
A dock employee suffered back pain and a muscle spasm after picking up a box of plastic shopping bags. He was hospitalized.

At about 6:00 p.m. on December 21, 2018, an employee was trying to clear a jam in a hopper. The push plate moved while his right hand was in the hopper, resulting in a crushing injury to his right index finger. The finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was moving a wooden shelf when a skid steer loader ran over his right foot, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on an eight-foot step ladder on the third or fourth rung hammering a nail. The employee slipped and fell hitting his head on the ground. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee was checking the tire pressure on a semi-trailer when the tire exploded causing swelling to the employee's head and face.
An employee was operating a vertical press and sustained the amputation of the right thumb tip.
A finger on an employee's left hand was caught and lacerated in a meat grinder.
While picking up trash, an employee was struck in the head by cinder block debris that fell from a scaffold. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was stamping a brass header plate on a press. When the press was activated, the die crushed his left hand, causing amputations to the index finger (from the middle knuckle) and the ring fingertip.
An employee was using an industrial paper cutter to open plastic bags. The cutter caused an amputation (with bone involvement) to the employee's left index finger.
While working at a sorting machine, an employee was struck and pinned against the machine by a forklift. The employee's leg was partially amputated.

At about 10:34 a.m. on December 21, 2018, an employee was replacing a chain on a chain-driven conveyor. While his hands were on the chain, it began to move, amputating the tips of his right index and middle fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee performing work outdoors was bit/stung by an insect on the back of his lower left leg and subsequently admitted to a hospital for an allergic reaction.
While unpacking glass, an employee suffered a hand laceration from broken glass and was hospitalized.

An employee was checking 112" corrugated board for moisture coverage/dry spots to ensure that starch content was correct. While the employee's hand was on a fixed bar, the machine was turned off and another, pneumatically operated bar moved to its off position, pinching the tips of the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers against the bar the employee was gripping. The employee suffered amputations to the fingertips.

Employee 1 was selecting and moving an order onto the platform of his order picker. Employee 2 was operating a reach truck and entered the aisle where employee 1 was located. Employee 2 drove down the narrow aisle toward the inbound side of the building. While moving, the engine compartment of the swing reach truck impacted employee 1's left leg, pinning it between the moving truck and the platform of the parked order picker. The injured employee suffered a crushed left leg from mid-calf to ankle/foot and sustained multiple broken bones and lacerations.
An employee fell after being playfully shoved on the shoulder. Her head struck the floor, and she suffered a brain injury as well as an ankle injury.
An employee was moving a stand-up powered industrial truck. His left ankle was caught between the truck and a dock plate, causing a hairline fracture of the lower tibia.
While standing by an exit door, an employee was struck by three store signs that had been pushed over by strong winds. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a fracture to the left shoulder.
An employee was injured in a fall from height.
An ape bit an employee's right middle finger as she was feeding it, breaking a bone.
An employee suffered a broken forearm while operating a lathe machine.
An employee slipped while walking on tanks, suffering a broken leg.

A maintenance die mechanic was lowering a 16-foot extension ladder after inspecting a boiler. His foot became lodged between a gas line on the floor and the ladder, and he lost his balance. He suffered broken bones to his left and right legs.
A maintenance technician was pouring gasoline into a pump when the gasoline ignited, causing second-degree burns to both of his arms. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to an office, tripped and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was checking freight when a forklift struck him from behind, breaking his left big toe and second toe.
An employee slipped and fell on a kitchen floor, suffering a broken rib and collapsed lung.

A welder was installing weights on 24-inch plastic pipes, using a wedge to install the two half weights. The wedge moved and the tip of the welder's right thumb got caught between the pipe and the wedge. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was walking by a parked forklift when a second, moving forklift struck it. The parked forklift was pushed forward and broke four bones in the employee's foot.
An employee was pulling a cardboard box from a shelf when other boxes fell, causing the employee to fall backward to the ground and suffer a broken hip.

Employees at a rig were removing a section of piping from a basket using an air hoist. The piece of piping was lifted from the basket and raised about 2 feet high, at which point a second piece of piping leaning against the same basket (called a reacher pipe) was bumped. The reacher pipe fell and crushed an employee's lower right leg, breaking his ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unjamming a baler when it started, catching the employee's right foot. Two of the employees toes were amputated and one toe was partially amputated.
An employee was burned by hot fryer oil while replacing metal dividers between fryers.
An employee had just removed a cash box from a safe. The safe door closed on the employee's left hand, cutting off the tip of his thumb.
While traveling between buildings during work hours on a public roadway, an employee was involved in an altercation with a pedestrian and sustained a gunshot wound to the hand.

An employee was feeding paper from a roll into a paper machine. A piece of paper was caught in the machine; the employee was removing it when his left middle finger was caught between a pulley and the paper roll. The fingertip (including tissue and bone) was amputated.

Employees had just finished rerouting conduit and wiring beneath a rooftop air conditioning unit. The unit had been moved off its stand to access the wiring. While it was being lowered back onto the stand, an employee's right middle finger was caught between the unit and the stand. The fingertip was amputated at the top joint.

An employee was repairing lights in a parking lot from a knuckle boom lift. He parked the truck next to a light pole and boomed up; the boom struck a 14-kilovolt power line, and he suffered burns to 32% of the left side of his body.
An employee fell while skiing down a mountain, landing on a large rock and suffering a hip/pelvis fracture.
On 12/22/18, an employee was clearing a film jam in the forming tube on the packaging machine when the machine unexpectedly energized and amputated his left index finger.
A forklift operator was trying to exit a forklift before it struck a column; the operator's lower left leg was crushed between the forklift and the column.
An employee's finger was caught between a drill pipe and part of a rig structure during rigging up. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was using a ladder to take a building measurement of a mansard. The ladder slid and the employee suffered two broken heels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending from a windmill fixture when he fell from a fixed ladder, landing 9 feet below on the vessel deck. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee was defrosting a valve using methanol. The valve ruptured and sprayed methanol on the employee's flame-resistant clothing, causing skin irritation.
An employee tripped while cleaning, suffering a broken tibia.
An employee was turning an electric pallet jack. The employee's left little finger was pinched between the pallet jack's handle and a hinge on a freezer door. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was overcome with carbon monoxide and suffered shortness of breath.
An employee was blowing down a boiler when a cap came off the steam check valve. The steam caused first- and second-degree burns to the employee's chest, arms, and neck area.
An employee was cleaning cotton in a press pit when the press ramrod pinched his right forearm.
An employee was fixing a glazing machine on a cake line. The machine amputated the employee's finger.
A driver fell, hitting his head on the pavement. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut the top off a tree he had felled. A limb from another tree (weighing about 30 pounds) fell about 30-40 feet and hit him on the back. He suffered four broken ribs and three smaller broken bones near the spine.
An employee's right index finger was slammed and broken in a postal vehicle door.

An employee was in a chick room at a hatchery. The room was being washed down and the concrete floor was wet; the employee bent over to pick up a chick off the floor, and when he stood up and began to walk again he slipped and fell to the floor. He struck his head, shoulder, and back and suffered a concussion.

The high density clean out drain knife gate valve was stuck in the open position. When the employee attempted to confirm the knife gate valve was closed, by feel, the knife gate valve closed on the employee's fingers causing the amputation of three fingertips on the right hand.
An employee was fighting a fire caused by an exploded furnace when he was overcome by smoke, fire, and powder from the fire extinguisher.

A tire technician was changing a customer's tire on the shoulder of an interstate highway. As the technician removed a spare tire from under the customer's car, a car left the road, striking the van and the technician. The technician suffered multiple injuries, including a head injury.

An employee was cleaning a masa pump. As he was removing residue from the intake, the tip of his left middle finger was amputated. The product intake cover had been removed at the time of the incident.
A security guard was engaged with a belligerent visitor who had been escorted out of an emergency department waiting area. The visitor stabbed the guard, lacerating the guard's head and neck area.
An employee sustained a hernia while throwing the daily trash into the dumpster.
An employee was working on a soybean press. The press caused the amputation of the employee's right arm above the elbow.
While walking to a vehicle in a parking lot, an employee tripped on a curb and fell, suffering a broken left leg and left thumb.
An employee fell while stacking boxes on a flatbed truck, landing on the ground and suffering a collarbone fracture and a head injury.

An employee was inside a shipping container, securing it for transport, when a crane component shifted and wedged the employee against a neighboring frame. The employee suffered lacerations to the liver and kidneys and a fractured lumbar vertebra.

An employee was driving a loaded stock picker down an aisle. The loaded product struck a support beam and swung around, pinning the employee against the front of the stock picker. The employee suffered damaged tendons in the right leg.
An employee slipped on ice while walking across a parking lot to a personal vehicle. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken upper right femur.
An employee was using a pressure washer to clean a paper machine. High-pressure water from the nozzle caused a 4-inch laceration on his left forearm.
While engaged in stocking and clerk activities, an employee fell on water spilled by a customer. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee was attaching one end of a steel strip from a pancake reel to the end of a steel strip in a machine. The machine started pulling the strip and pulled the employee's hand in, causing a deep laceration (including bone) to the right middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been checking the brake system of a customer's truck in the parking lot. The truck rolled over the employee and caused a fractured pelvic bone and a torn ligament.
An employee fell from a delivery truck, losing consciousness and suffering broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading recyclables into a hopper at curbside. A cardboard box began to fall out of the hopper; as he pushed it back in, the tote lifted toward the hopper and trapped the left side of his torso against the truck body. He suffered chest injury, including a punctured lung, and was hospitalized.
While taking inventory of wood in a lumberyard, an employee fell about 6 feet to the ground. The employee suffered multiple head fractures and a possible concussion.
While unloading a truck, an employee fell off the back of the trailer to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left elbow.
An employee was walking with a tray of chocolate when her right leg slipped, causing her to fall and suffer a muscle tear to her right leg.

An employee and a delivery driver were trying to right an electric pallet jack that had fallen to the ground. The employee's right ring finger was caught between a moving part and a fixed part of the pallet jack, causing an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee had just delivered product to a transfer station. He was on his way back into his truck when a dock plate gave way and he fell between the truck and the loading dock. A powered pallet jack fell with him and struck him in the face, fracturing his face and cheeks.

An employee went to drive his golf cart after a safety meeting, but it would not start. While working on the golf cart, the engine started and the employee's finger was caught in the running belt between the belt and pulley. The employee's right index finger was damaged in the nail area.
An employee was installing the harness bracket from an 8-foot ladder. The employee slipped and fell to the ground from the roof line. The employee sustained injury to the lower back.

An employee was cleaning rollers on an extruder with a rag. The employee's right arm was caught in an ingoing nip point, suffering an injury that required hospitalization and surgery. Lockout/tagout was not in effect and the nip point did not have a guard at the time.
An employee and his supervisor were repairing an electrical panel when an arc flash burned the employee's left hand.
A shuttle driver was receiving a gas card from the driver of another shuttle. The driver's hand was pinched between the two vehicles, suffering fractures and lacerations.
An employee was walking through the parking lot to her office building when she slipped on ice and fell, breaking both legs near the knees.

An employee was clearing a jam in a trimmer machine when the machine cycled and caught his fingers. He suffered amputations to his right index and middle fingers. The machine was not locked out or guarded at the time of the incident.
While a line was being blown down at a gas lift well, an object struck an employee on the head. The employee suffered a forehead contusion with a possible fracture.
While sanitizing a guide roller on a conveyor belt system, an employee sustained fractures to the radius and ulna in his right forearm.
An employee was sweeping at the front of a store. The door opened and hit him on the ankle, causing him to fall and break his hip. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was removing lint from a monitor behind a robot. As the employee was pulling his hand out of the docking piece, the robot moved and caught his finger between the docking piece and the flat piece of metal on the bottom of the robot. The tip of his right little finger was amputated.
An employee was descending a ladder in the back room and missed the last step. The employee fell and suffered a broken hip and minor lacerations.
An employee slipped on muddy ground while backfilling a trench. His face struck against a metal gas riser, causing a broken facial bone.
An employee was fabricating sheet metal on a jump shear when the jump shear amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee's arm became stuck in a tile counting machine. The employee's hand was injured, suffering nerve damage that was surgically treated.
An employee was trimming pieces of lumber on a table saw and partially amputated their left thumb and middle fingers.
An employee's right index finger was crushed.
On December 27, 2018, an employee fell from a fixed ladder and struck the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured clavicle and potentially fractured ribs.
An employee was picking orders using an electric pallet jack. The jack ran over his foot, fracturing the foot and a toe.
An employee was loading a roll of material with a pallet jack. The jack rolled backwards and crushed his right arm against a machine and fractured it.
An employee was using a forklift to remove a loaded pallet from a rack shelf. As he turned the forklift, a beam struck his left leg and fractured the tibia.
On December 27, 2018, a security officer was struck by a motor vehicle while working at a base entrance gate. The employee suffered a crushed left leg, which had to be amputated.

An employee was installing TPO roofing on the parking garage side of a 3-story building. When he lifted a sheet of insulation, the wind pushed the insulation and caused the employee to lose balance and fall 10 to 12 feet onto the third floor level of the parking garage. The employee sustained injuries to the ribs and arm. The employee was wearing a lifeline at the time.

An employee was assisting with the cleaning of a batter applicator machine. While removing a segment of poultry from a pipe, which was connected to a 1.5-inch positive displacement pump, the employee's right index fingertip was amputated by the pump.
An employee was walking through the parking lot, slipped on ice/snow and fell. The employee suffered a concussion, a skull fracture and a brain bleed.

An employee was adjusting a bending machine, using a crescent wrench on a nut. The wrench slipped off the nut and his finger was smashed between the wrench and the machine. The middle and index fingers of his right hand were lacerated, requiring stitches and cleaning.
An employee's back condition was aggravated when he moved a drum from a scale to a pallet. He was hospitalized.
An employee opened a safe to make change. When the safe closed, it struck his right thumb and severed the tip. He was hospitalized, requiring plastic surgery.
An employee fell off a truck while unloading tanks. The employee suffered a skull fracture, a fractured left elbow, and brain bleeding on the left side.
An employee was raising the landing gear on a tractor trailer when the cranking handle for the landing gear hit and bruised his jaw.

An employee was working from a scaffold to remove an HVAC unit from a ceiling. Part of the unit fell out and struck the scaffolding, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a cut to the back of the head and a back injury requiring hospitalization.
While checking rebar, an employee fell from an 18-foot height to the ground. The employee fell on their face and suffered a broken pelvis and a nicked artery.
A mail carrier tripped on a 2x4 in a driveway and fell, breaking his upper arm.
An employee was delivering a load from a truck. While pulling on a strap attached to the truck, he fell backwards and hit his head on the ground. He was hospitalized, suffering bleeding on the brain.
On December 28, 2018, an employee fell from a ladder while installing playground equipment. He landed on the concrete and the ladder below, breaking ribs and bones in a foot. He was hospitalized.
On December 27, 2018, an employee was bending over to pick up plates that had fallen to the floor and caught their hand in a machine. The employee suffered lacerations requiring skin grafting.

An employee was lifting a unit load device's lock into the upright/locked 
position after the container had been slid into place on a 777 airplane. The control lever to move the container was struck and the container moved, catching the employee's left ring finger in the lock. The fingertip was partially severed.
An employee was trying to move a concrete box when his left ankle was caught and broken between two concrete boxes.
An employee was checking the rollers on a conveyor when their glove was caught in the rollers and belt resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a printing press with a rag when a finger was caught in the press causing an amputation injury.

An employee was untangling the whip line and main line of a crawler crane. The employee finished untangling the crane lines and the crane began to move. The main line caught the employee's hand, causing an amputation to the left index finger past the cuticle, an amputation to the left middle finger halfway into the nail bed, and a fractured ring finger.

An employee was standing on a rack installing a fire alarm system when the rack collapsed causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, a broken right wrist, and a laceration to his hand.
An employee was lubricating a tabletop paper punch machine. The machine activated and caught and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was walking to her car when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground. She suffered neck and back injuries and was hospitalized.
While placing parts on a paint rack, an employee slipped and was struck on the shin by a steel beam. The wound became infected and the employee was hospitalized.
A line foreman was responding to an outage and was using a plastic covering to keep dirt from the end of the cable when a flash burn occurred. He was hospitalized with burns to his hands.
As an employee approached her vehicle, she slipped on ice and fell breaking her right ankle.
An employee was helping a customer hook up a trailer to a truck. The customer hit the gas and the truck struck the employee, resulting in a cut to the leg and a brain hemorrhage.
Two employees were on a rig, adjusting arms to line up the holes with the bracket of a power wrench. The bracket caught an employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was cleaning a motor/chain drive on an overhead trash line. The sprocket caught the rag he was using, pulling his right hand into the chain. His right little and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee was cleaning up behind a counter when she fell over a step stool, breaking her hip.
An employee was vacuuming dust for epoxy floor installation when she fell approximately 9 feet into a lube bay pit. She suffered a broken rib, collarbone and three vertebrae.
An employee slipped on ice while unloading feed. He fell, injuring his head on a trailer hitch.
An employee was repairing a chain on a forklift when the forks suddenly moved causing the employee's hand to get caught in the chain. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking/standing and waiting for instructions on the floor next to a machine, when his right hand became entangled by the fiber and the machine. The middle finger was amputated.
An employee fell while descending a ladder and broke his left wrist requiring surgical repair.
An employee tripped over another employee's foot, falling and breaking her left hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a light fixture and was shocked. The employee also fell 4 feet from a ladder.

The injured employee was performing a parts inventory. Four parts-bins were being moved with a forklift by another employee. One of the bins collapsed and the load shifted. The upper bins fell, striking the injured employee and causing lacerations to the face requiring stitches, abrasions to the left side of the back, and fractures to the left scapula, one left rib, and the left clavicle.

An employee was handling a chain binder that was positioned between the gap of two deck plates inside the hold of a ship. The fourth distal phalange was pinched between the blade of a forklift and the chain binder that was being held causing an amputation injury.

An employee was using a hand-held angle grinder to cut 1/8" wire. As he was cutting the wire it became entangled in the grinding wheel and the wire struck the employee. The employee sustained lacerations to the first and third fingers on the left hand and two tendons were cut on the left index finger.
An employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering broken wrists. The employee was hospitalized.

A crew was removing and replacing shafts/rolls on a conveyor using an overhead crane. A roll did not fit correctly and needed to be repositioned. A wire rope choker was positioned in a basket configuration around the shaft/roll with the ends of the choker connected to the crane hook. The injured employee was holding the top legs of the choker as the operator lifted up on the hook to put tension on the choker. While the employee was holding the choker legs, the crane hook started to twist. His left hand and glove became tangled between the steel choker legs. His left index finger was stuck between the choker legs, resulting in a distal phalanx amputation.
An employee was skiing on an intermediate run and fell sustaining a brain bleed.
