On December 29, 2018, two employees were moving a drum with a forklift. One employee's hand was caught between the drum and the forks of the forklift, causing an amputation of the right middle finger.

An employee was trying to retrieve a box cutter that had fallen into a tape machine. The chain inside the machine lacerated the employee's left index finger. The cover had been removed from the machine at the time of the incident.
An employee was unjamming a package on a conveyor and caught their hand in a pinch point resulting in the amputation of the left pinky finger.

An employee was helping others tuck a new sheet onto a re-reeling machine spool. His right hand got caught in the spool, and the machine pinched his middle, ring, and little fingers. He was hospitalized and his little finger was surgically removed just above the nail.
An employee was traveling across the working surface on a roof, inside the warning lines. He lost his balance, stumbled, and fell from the roof to the ground, breaking his ankle.
An employee stepped off a pallet and fell onto the floor fracturing their upper right arm.
An employee was walking a client down steps when she slipped on the wet ground, suffering a 90 percent tear to her right quadriceps.
An employee was injured when he fell 25 feet from a roof. The employee sustained a broken arm, pelvis and ribs.

An employee was cleaning out a compound receiving bin to remove a jam around the flow valve. When the compound receiving bin flow valve became dislodged, the compound bin started again and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was lifting CRRT bags and sustained a spine injury.
An employee suffered a spinal disk injury while moving a box of baby food. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's right leg gave out causing them to fall to the floor and fracture their right hip.
An employee cut his left calf on a roll of coiled steel while cleaning a warehouse. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a slicer when he attempted to remove a piece and his right thumb tip contacted the blade, resulting in a partial amputation to the right thumb tip. The blade was not closed at the time of the incident.
The injured employee was operating a pallet jack down a rack tunnel and collided with a forklift. The employee suffered a broken left tibia and fibula that required surgery.
While walking down steps, an employee tripped and fell onto the concrete surface. The employee suffered a broken shoulder and was hospitalized.
The employee was oiling the spring on an M13 clamp. He placed his right hand on the clamp. The employee pushed down on the clamp and his right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a golf cart on paved asphalt though an area that had become muddy due to heavy rain. The golf cart tipped over and the employee's left ankle was broken.
An employee sustained a fingertip amputation while cleaning a band saw.
An employee was working behind the counter when her boyfriend walked up and stabbed her in the neck with a knife.
An employee was cleaning plastic debris off a machine. The employee's left index fingertip was caught in a chain and sprocket, suffering a partial amputation.
Two employees were installing conduit when they experienced headaches and felt unwell. Both employees were hospitalized with carbon monoxide exposure/poisoning.
An employee was operating a metal rod straightener when the machine caught his shirttail. As he tried to free the shirt, the machine caught and fractured his left arm. He was hospitalized.
On December 31, 2018, an employee was trying to break up a fight between two clients when a door was slammed on the employee's right ring finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee dropped a heavy crate on his hand and crushed a finger.
An employee was walking to the car at the end of a shift, slipped on ice on the sidewalk and fell fracturing the left hip.
A refinery operator was changing filters in a refinery. While getting down off a step, he ruptured his quad tendons. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was using a stand-up forklift to transport a pallet. The forklift struck a storage structural beam, pinning his ankle against the beam and breaking it.
An employee fell down a stairwell that was wet resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was loading casing on a rack with a PIT. One of the casings was hanging off of the rack. When the employee went to move it by hand, it rolled off and struck the employee resulting in a broken clavicle and lacerated spleen.
An employee was assaulted while stocking freight and suffered injuries to her head and face.
An employee was working on an airlock system. Rotating cups within the system lacerated the employee's left index finger; the fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee aggravated a back injury while lifting a 20-pound pan of chicken in the kitchen.
On January 1, 2019, an employee sustained a right middle finger amputation while loading unfinished metal core plates into an automated core plate racking system.
While working on a natural gas drilling rig, an employee sustained a partial amputation to their little finger.
An employee was working in the kitchen when a heated can of oil spray exploded and burned the employee's back and legs.
On January 1, 2019, a truck driver slipped on an icy parking lot and fell to the ground, striking their head and losing consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was restocking an aircraft from a raised platform catering truck when the employee fell 10 feet off the platform to the ground. The employee's right forearm struck a truck bumper during the fall, sustaining a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was using a jack. His hand was on top of the jack when it went up and crushed his left hand, fracturing it.

At approximately 11:30 AM, an unidentified male attempted to exit the store carrying a power tool combination kit without paying. An employee approached the man and grabbed the merchandise. The man quickly pulled a firearm and shot the employee in the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a ditch installing drainage pipes when a backhoe slid into the ditch, breaking both of the employee's knees.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a twin screw machine when his left ring finger was caught between the pistons and was amputated.
An employee was removing a pin from a machine with a foot-long bolt driver. When the pin was driven out, the bolt driver dropped, severing his left middle finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to remove an obstruction from a food craft machine chain when the employee's fingers were pulled into the chain, resulting in an amputation of the left index finger to the end of the nailbed and left middle finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was removing a tarp from a flatbed when a bungee strap broke causing him to fall off the flatbed to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with four cracked ribs.

An employee was on an 8-foot fiberglass step ladder checking faulty LED lighting in the ceiling using a volt meter when the employee made contact with 277 volts and received an electrical shock. He fell to the floor, hitting his head.
An employee was exiting his pickup truck when he slipped/tripped and hit his running board(s). He sustained multiple rib fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was refilling a tote tank that was on the back of a flatbed trailer when he lost his balance and fell from the trailer to the ground, fracturing his right wrist and requiring surgery.

An employee was troubleshooting the hydraulic system on a customer's skid to get the hydraulic pump to run. He started up the engine and an unexpected release of hydraulic energy occurred. He attempted to open the dump valve and the discharge hose exploded with his hand on it, releasing oil and severely lacerating his right index finger.

An employee was guiding a crane to pick up a spool of wire. While pulling the crane hook over to the spool of wire he reduced the distance to the 19.9 phase 2 ground overhead power line. The power line then arced across to the crane's wire rope shocking the employee. He was also burned on the left wrist and hand and both feet and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a metal platform when his finger was pinched in the platform, removing skin and flesh (no bone damage) and causing lacerations.
An employee was trying to pull a dock plate out at the loading dock when the plate popped out, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An Effingham Equity employee was delivering bulk feed to a customer. He had to climb a bulk feed bin to open the lid. While he was climbing the ladder, a rung broke, causing him to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken ankle.

A carpenter was walking on trusses eight feet above the ground at a residential home construction site. He lost his footing and fell toward the ground. He was wearing a safety harness and lanyard that activated and stopped his fall. His safety helmet fell off and he crashed into the plywood siding of the house. The collision with the plywood caused a laceration to the head requiring hospitalization.
An employee was refueling a gas-powered air compressor. Fuel contacted the hot muffler and ignited. The employee suffered burns to the hands, face and chest.
An employee was holding a horizontal release bar when his left ring finger was pinched between the bar handle and the floor, resulting in an amputation of the finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was helping to take apart a fixture/grid display when the top grid fell and struck her above the eye, causing a laceration. She was hospitalized.

An employee was watching a folder start up when printed books started jamming in the press equipment. He was attempting to pull the jammed paper out when his left hand was pulled in between the tape roller and jaw cylinder. His left hand was crushed, suffering lacerations and fractures.
An employee was offloading chocolate from a tanker truck when the valve assembly closed on his finger, resulting in an index fingertip amputation.

An employee was attempting to unjam a piece of cereal packing equipment when the equipment cycled and crushed the employee's right index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

Three concrete panels were placed on dunnage, approximately 6" off the ground in the batch end area of the plant. The dunnage was perpendicular to the panels and approximately 3 feet from each end of the panel. These panels were spaced about 3 to 4 feet apart and were free standing on the dunnage. At 6:40 p.m., an employee was picking up foam pieces in the same area and placing them into a 5-gallon bucket. He bent down to pick up an item about midway down the panel when the second panel from the bay door started to tip as the employee stood up. The panel came down and hit the employee about waist level (front side) and pushed him back into the third panel (closest to bay door). Both panels fell towards the south end of the building and the second panel ended up on top of the employee's right leg. The dunnage acted as a buffer to keep his leg from being fully crushed. He was hospitalized with a broken right tibia and torn right knee ligaments.

An employee was raising dock doors to inspect a trailer for unloading and loading when the door came down. The corner of the door struck the employee on the inside part of the left knee, resulting in a small laceration/puncture.  The knee became more painful while walking and the employee required hospitalization. The dock door was not secured with a chain at the time of the incident.

An employee was driving a stand-up powered lift truck down an aisle. He was about to strike a parked powered lift truck when his left hand went outside the cage and struck the second truck. He experienced swelling and pain in his left hand, requiring surgery.
An employee was removing an injection bottle from a riser pole using an extended fiberglass pole when he felt a strain in his chest.
An employee was using a band saw to trim/cut pork skins when the saw cut his right thumb tip, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

An employee was replacing a belt associated with a pasting machine cutter when a second employee jogged the machine via a two-hand control. As the second employee activated the two-hand control, the first employee's hand slipped into the cutting head, severing three fingers between the first and second knuckle. One finger was amputated and two other fingers may require amputation.

An employee had finished repairs and adjustments on the small piece folder machine. The employee was confirming proper operation of the machine when their right sleeve was caught by a moving part and drawn into the machine causing a severe laceration on the palm of their right hand. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was inside a cargo hold on a ship, guiding in a steel slab load, when the load hit a two-by-four. The two-by-four then popped up and pinched the employee's pinky fingertip between it and the load chain, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee lost his balance and fell off of a step ladder onto a concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture to the wrist.
An employee was assisting a chainsaw operator with felling a tree when the chain bucked, striking and lacerating him on the lower left leg.
An employee was at a customer's home installing home theater equipment when the employee slipped on icy stairs and fell, suffering a broken tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a carpeted sales floor when the employee fell to the floor and fractured the left femur.
An employee was walking down stairs and tripped and fell, fracturing her left ankle.
An employee was reaching into a cart when a door closed, smashing her right little finger. She was hospitalized.
On January 2, 2019, an employee was removing an iron pipe cap from a pressurized water line when the line burst and the cap struck him, fracturing his leg.
An employee suffered the partial amputation of his middle finger during the installation of a 6-inch diameter water line inside a trench.
An employee was cleaning a machine area when the machine caught the employee's pant leg, causing a fracture that resulted in surgical amputation of the leg.

On January 2, 2019, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was transferring anhydrous ammonia from bullet tanks to two 1,000-gallon nurse wagons when the cross-over line connecting the nurse wagons ruptured, exposing the employee to anhydrous ammonia. He suffered chemical burns to the right side of his face and his respiratory system, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a hand truck to unload his delivery truck when he turned around and slipped. His hand truck load also slipped and fell on his left leg, fracturing it in two places.
An employee was operating a punch press and sustained a laceration on his left index finger. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was operating a double pallet jack, carrying plastic pallets. As he was dismounting, he put his hand on a stack of plastic pallets for balance. The momentum of the pallet jack caused the backrest to strike and mash his hand. When he pulled his hand away, he suffered a fracture to his middle finger and a laceration to his ring finger.

An employee was adjusting the hydraulic fluid pressure valve on a thumper truck when hydraulic fluid spewed from the pressure valve onto the walking surface of the thumper truck. The employee then slipped and fell approximately 6 feet from the truck to the ground, sustaining four broken ribs on the left side and a left lung contusion.
An employee was operating a table saw when the employee's hand slipped. The blade then amputated the employee's index finger.
An employee was unjamming corrugated sheets from a pre-feeder machine when his right arm was caught in the self-closing gate.

An employee was working on top of a mezzanine. He was getting ready to come down from the mezzanine floor when he fell approximately 12 feet from a fixed ladder to the lower level, suffering forehead and kneecap injuries that required stitches, a concussion, a swollen right eye, partial hearing loss in the right ear, and four broken ribs.

An employee was changing plates on a paper envelope machine. He was holding a metal plate with one hand and using his free hand to jog the machine when his right hand was pulled into the machine's moving parts. His middle finger sustained severe lacerations that required stitches, while the tip and first joint of his pointer finger were amputated.
An employee was moving a chair in a break room. The employee's feet became entangled in the feet of the chair and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
On January 3, 2019, an employee was setting up steel beams when a beam fell and struck the employee's left ankle, causing a fracture and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on the first or second step of a 6-foot step ladder.  He was applying drywall mud to the ceiling tape when he lost his balance and fell to the ground.  He suffered a broken hip.
An employee was working on a skinning machine when his glove was caught in the machine, resulting in an amputation of his right index fingertip.
An employee was burned on the right side of his body by 176-degree water that discharged from a pipe.

An employee was attempting to clear scrap from a cavity on a machine's rotating drum. When he extended his arm and tried to clear the scrap, the drum pulled his left index finger into a pinch point between the drum and a form roller. As he pulled his finger away from the pinch point, the nail and a small portion of skin were removed (de-gloved) from his fingertip, exposing a small portion of bone and resulting in an amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
While descending a ladder, an employee missed the bottom rung and contacted the floor, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was manually lifting/flipping a large steel plate when he slipped on some grinding dust and lost his footing. The steel plate, which measured approximately 25" X 28" X 2.5" fell, crushing the employee's right hand. He sustained amputations to his index and middle fingers and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a crumble maker roll machine when his left hand entered the machine and was drawn into the roller, amputating four fingers up to the last knuckle. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was standing on the front of a utility trailer near the end of a forklift load that was being secured. Only one end of the load was secured when the forklift was removed. The load proceeded to lean over and fall toward the employee, knocking him to the metal fabricated loading dock. He suffered a broken leg, broken collarbone, shoulder blade contusions, and a collapsed lung.
While using a tool to unclog a shredding machine, an employee was caught by the machine's moving parts, suffering lacerations to the right index and middle fingers.

A J.B. Hunt employee was walking across a crosswalk toward his parked truck. He was struck by another J.B. Hunt employee in his personal vehicle, suffering microfractures around the left eye, a bruised right knee, and a fractured cranium on the left side near his hairline.

An employee was operating an articulating hauler and preparing to dump concrete onto a designated site when the earth gave way beneath the truck, causing it to fall and topple on its side. As a result, the employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a truck body fixture when a pneumatic clamp on the fixture cycled onto the employee's hand, amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was standing under a roll-up door when it automatically closed, striking her on the head. She fell to the concrete surface and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was installing petroleum piping and working with a dispenser sump at a work site when a small explosion occurred, causing burns to his body.
An employee bent over to pick up a binder and suffered a fractured vertebrae.

An employee identified a damaged product on a line conveyor system, about to be caught up into a leg of operations. He tried to remove it as it approached a break in the covered line and his right index finger was caught in the product's nylon material. The chain and sprocket amputated the fingertip.
An employee's right index finger was caught in a foiling machine, causing a traumatic distal amputation to the finger.

An employee was engaged in demolition operations and pulling up a plastic sheet when he fell backwards, striking his head on the gravel ground. He suffered a laceration and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing the third bend on a piece of metal in a hydraulic press brake when the machine amputated his left middle finger midway down the fingernail.

On January 3, 2019, at 10:45 a.m., two employees located at ground level pulled a duct transition piece out of a pit conveyor through the pit conveyor ladder access area. As the first employee was exiting the pit, he put his left hand over a 2-inch metal drip edge that goes around the pit access area. At the same time, the second employee was setting the transition down next to the metal drip edge, striking the first employee's finger. The first employee's left middle finger was pinched between the duct transition and the metal drip edge, suffering a partial traumatic metacarpophalangeal amputation.
An employee was on a loading dock about 4 feet high, draping a tarp over 16-foot-long elevator rails. The employee fell backward off the dock, breaking an ankle and a knee.
An employee attempted to sit on a table and fell to the floor, suffering a fractured back/spine.

A temporary employee was parking a forklift and exited the vehicle. The employee's left foot was then pinned between a guardrail and the forklift, sustaining a laceration, soft tissue damage, and ligament damage. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The forklift had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking next to a pile of I-beams when a 12-inch I-beam slid off the pile and fell on the employee's right lower leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating a golf cart when the employee's knee struck an I-beam, fracturing the patella. The employee's knee was outside the vehicle at the time of the incident.
An employee operating a standing forklift struck a rack, and the employee's head became pinned between the forklift and the rack.
An employee was riding a horse while herding cattle when the horse tripped. The employee fell forward into the saddle and then onto the ground, fracturing multiple ribs.
An employee was standing next to a propane heater when his clothes caught on fire, burning his lower legs.
An employee slipped and fell in a restroom, suffering an injury to the left ankle that required surgery.

An employee was walking across the furnace floor and was passing an I-beam column at the same time that a forklift was in operation. The operator did not see the employee due to the I-beam and hit him with the forklift, injuring his head and chest. He was hospitalized.
An employee was grinding a large stainless steel part on a double-end belt grinder when his right index finger was caught between the belt and the grinding wheel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was sweeping a floor when a cotton lint-cleaning machine partially amputated the three middle fingers of his right hand. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a cut-up system (merchandiser) when the employee walked by a photo-eye and triggered the log kicker. The log kicker rolled a log into the employee's lower leg and broke it.
An employee suffered pulmonary edema after participating in a high-altitude simulation.

An employee was on a stepladder cleaning a bathroom ventilation unit. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder, hitting his head on the wall and then landing on his shoulder on the vinyl-covered concrete floor. He was hospitalized.

An employee was servicing an overhead hoist while standing on a trimming table. The employee came down from the table and their right foot was caught on the crossbrace, causing the employee to land awkwardly. The employee suffered fractures to the right ankle, fibula, and tibia.
An employee was bending down to lift a pallet when pain caused his back to seize up and he fell backwards. He suffered a back strain or possible disk injury, requiring hospitalization.
A crane two-blocked while lifting a boat railing. The cable snapped and the headache ball fell onto an employee, severing the employee's leg.
A temporary employee was backing a forklift up to a charging station when the employee's left foot was crushed between the forklift and the charging station, requiring surgery.

While pumping concrete, an employee was struck by the boom of a pump truck when the right front outrigger sank into the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left arm, dislocated right hip, and wound on the right leg.
An employee was delivering mail when a dog bit off the employee's left pinky fingertip, causing an amputation from the knuckle up.
An employee was at a machine loading plastic film on a cardboard tube when the employee's wrist was fractured in the machine's roller.
An employee was attempting to remove a piece of cardboard from a conveyor when one of his left-hand fingers was pinched between the bars and the cross member.
An employee tripped and fell while walking to a vehicle in the parking lot, suffering a fractured right elbow.

An employee either hit his head while exiting a truck and fell to the ground, or he was standing on the truck catwalk and lost his balance, causing him to fall. He suffered a concussion and multiple contusions.

An employee was dumping a load of pulp material from a tractor trailer when part of the load became stuck in the elevated position, causing the load to become unstable. The trailer then flipped over, ejecting the employee out of the cab and onto the ground. The employee suffered fractured ribs and fluid on the lung.
An employee tripped over a box after putting away a tablet in a cabinet. She suffered fractures to her left arm.
An employee suffered a partial amputation from a grinder while cleaning up paper.
An employee's finger was caught in a door hinge as he held the door open for other employees to enter. The left middle fingertip pad was amputated.

An employee was adjusting the pin lock on a chassis that had a container that was not sitting flush to it. The employee struck the pin multiple times with a hammer in the left hand and chisel in the right hand. On the last swing of the hammer, the chisel hit the pin and then slipped, sending the employee's right ring finger under the container as it fell flush to the chassis. The employee's right ring finger was crushed between the chassis and container, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was climbing down a ladder attached to a preservation oil truck when he slipped and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was lifting a bundle of wood with other employees when the bundle of wood slipped and fell on his hand, pinching and fracturing his right index and middle fingers.
An employee was removing a vehicle's wheel. The employee's left middle finger was caught between a spoke on the trim and the brake caliper and was amputated.
An employee was holding a door when the employee stepped back and lost balance, falling down six to seven concrete steps. The employee suffered a fractured eye socket and facial lacerations.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor belt when the employee's right arm was caught in the conveyor belt, breaking the forearm, injuring the wrist, and pulling skin from the top of the hand.

An employee was picking up a cleaning device sitting on top of a mixing vessel when he fell about 9 feet from the vessel, hitting his back, head, and buttocks on the mobile stair ladder during the fall.
An employee was about to sit on a chair but missed the chair and fell on the floor, fracturing her left hip.

An employee was putting a membrane on the roof of an exterior walk-in cooler at a country club. The employee fell from the cooler, suffering injuries including a skull fracture, brain bleed, a fracture to the upper jaw, and a torn ear.

An employee was loading a pallet of empty shells in the back of a trailer while standing on a raised liftgate when his foot became stuck under the pallet jack. While attempting to remove his foot from under the jack, he lost his balance, pulled down on the pallet jack handle, and fell on the floor. He landed on his right hip and suffered a contusion. The jack handle was engaged when he fell, causing the jack to move backward off the liftgate and fall on his left foot. He suffered a 1-inch laceration on his left foot and bruise on his left knee.
An employee was changing the head on a caser machine. An unsecured piece of equipment fell on the employee's hand, causing the amputation (without bone loss) of the right index fingertip.

An employee was pushing containers off of a machine's conveyor belt. Her right hand was on the containers that were accumulated on the belt when her right pinky finger was caught between the machine's product lane straightener mechanism, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An engine backfired and ignited gas in the building, causing an explosion and fire that burned an employee's face and neck.
An employee was driving a walkie/rider pallet jack when it suddenly stopped. He fell about 6 inches to the concrete floor, breaking his hip.
An employee was moving material through a plant. The employee's right foot was caught between a conveyor and the transfer car, suffering a laceration.

An employee was on a trailer attempting to secure drilling equipment to the trailer for transport when the employee fell approximately 5 feet off the trailer to the ground. The employee suffered a concussion, loss of consciousness, and hand and wrist contusions.

A temporary employee stepped inside a packaging tote to collect parts and move them into a smaller container. Upon exiting the packaging tote, his foot was caught on the side of the tote, causing him to trip and fall to the floor. He broke his hip and was hospitalized.

Two employees were helping welders by holding a 16" flange when a flash fire occurred. The first employee suffered a puncture wound from a vent pipe and burns to the face. The second employee suffered burns to the back of his neck, his back, and his right arm.
An employee was operating a walkie stacker and pinned their left foot and ankle against a storage shelf on the opposite side of the aisle causing a fracture and laceration to the foot and heel.
While responding to a 911 emergency call at a residence, a paramedic was overcome by secondhand smoke and suffered an asthma attack, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a stepladder, pulling product down from a shelf, when she lost her balance and fell backwards. She broke her right leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing emergency repairs on a roof when he noticed that the wind had blown a piece of insulation across the roof to the edge. As he went to retrieve the insulation, it caught the wind and he was pulled off of the roof, falling approximately 30 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with fractures to his wrists, two broken fingers, and cracked disks in his spinal column.

An employee was standing on a top drive unit (which was sitting on a skid about 18 inches off the ground) helping to test it. The unit was in vertical position at that time. The employee touched a bail that had a sling wrapped around it and the bail fell to a track. The bail brushed the employee s shin and then landed on his right foot. As he pulled his foot out, he fell backward about 5 to 7 feet away from the bail. He was hospitalized with a bruised metatarsal and tarsal on his right foot and bruised back. He also required stitches on his left arm.
An employee fell to the snow surface while skiing to a duty station on a mountain, fracturing the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was troubleshooting a packaging machine and adjusting the media when his left index finger was caught in the perforation blade, resulting in a traumatic amputation of the distal phalanx.
An employee was removing a valve from an air hose when his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking into work when she slipped and fell in the parking lot, striking and breaking her elbow on the ground. She was hospitalized.
An employee was offloading a jack when the back right wheel slid off the side of the belt loader and struck his right ring finger, fracturing it.

An employee was holding a cat in place so an IV could be administered when the cat became agitated and bit the employee's right hand. The bite puncture wounds became infected, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking in a customer's basement, tracing an old cable line, when he lost his balance and fell into an open pit that housed an old water tank. He struck the water tank, suffering intestinal bruising and a small liver laceration.
An employee was setting a vehicle on a lift when the lift began to rise. His right ring finger was caught between the vehicle and the lift. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a lumbar strain while lifting and carrying boxes of merchandise up and down a ladder.
An employee was on a deck on an elevated section of an interstate, shaking out some pans. The employee fell to the ground, suffering broken bones.
An employee was helping to lower an exhaust catalyst to the ground with a rope when it created a loop that caught the employees' right gloved finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was observing and troubleshooting cement powder transfer equipment. He placed his right hand into adjoining piping while clearing cement powder from the pipe. His fingers entered the machinery and two of his fingers were struck by moving parts.

An employee was working from an extension ladder, hanging a gutter on the outside of a 1.5-story barn. The employee came into contact with a hornet's nest and fell from the ladder, landing on the ground about 10 feet below and fracturing two vertebrae.

An employee was in the bucket of a bucket truck, about 16 feet above the ground. A semi truck driving down the road struck the bucket, throwing the employee to the ground. The employee suffered fractures to the leg, elbow, wrist, collarbone, teeth, etc., and was hospitalized.

An employee dropped a bit behind a railroad wheel that was leaning against another wheel. The employee was pulling the wheel to its vertical position to retrieve the bit when the wheel fell backwards onto the employee's right lower leg, fracturing it. The employee also fell and attempted to break the fall, resulting in a fracture to the right wrist.
An employee was cutting a loose bar or rebar using a handheld saw. The sparks generated by the cutting process ignited the employee's right pant leg. The employee suffered burns to the right leg.
An employee was trying to unstick a chicken breast from a breast slicer machine when the slicer lacerated the employee's left hand, resulting in a medical amputation of the hand.

An employee was working on an elevated surface when he walked across a board to grab a piece of equipment. Upon returning to his work area, the board he was walking on gave way and he fell 10 feet to the concrete below, breaking his elbow. A harness was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning at a construction site when a board with a nail in it caught her pant leg, causing her to fall from the second to first floor. She was hospitalized with a broken right heel.

A foreman and his crew were about to take a section of a crane hook and move it into position. The foreman stopped work, noticing something wrong, and the pipe shifted and struck his hands while they were on the handrail. He suffered amputation injuries to his left ring and little fingers.
An employee was loading paper into a die press when the employee's finger was caught by the nipper, resulting in the amputation of a finger.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck inside a trailer. His finger was caught between the exterior frame of the truck and the inside wall of the trailer.
An employee was walking on the company road to work when he was struck by another employee who was driving a car away from the premises. He suffered a spinal injury and head laceration.
An employee was lifting a microwave to place on a pallet when he felt a pop in his neck. He was hospitalized with a fractured neck.
An employee was walking away from a pallet to begin cleanup when he slipped/tripped over a strip of banding material and fell to the floor. He broke his hip.

An employee was on a loaded barge when he leaned over the stern of the barge and attempted to free the port stern wire from the lower port knee rubber. He was then crushed between the port knee and the barge, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was standing next to a building post when a tote, carried on a forklift, crushed his right ring finger. The tip was amputated.
An employee was operating a standing tugger, which came into contact with a forklift. The corner of a pallet hit the employee's leg, breaking the tibia.
Two overhead cranes collided. The glass they were transporting fell, striking an employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on warehouse racking during disassembly when a front piece of the racking swung out and the deck boards gave way, allowing the employee to fall approximately 6 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right leg.
An employee tripped on a cord and fell on the concrete floor, landing on the right knee. The employee was hospitalized with a right knee contusion and right tibia fracture.

An employee fell from a snow-/ice-covered two-story residential roof while removing snow. The employee landed on their back and cracked two vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was working in rooms along a hospital hallway, performing respiratory treatments for her assigned patients. She noticed a bleach smell in the hallway as she entered a room. While in the room she continued smelling bleach, so she put on a surgical mask and closed the door behind her. Later, after working in other rooms and removing her mask, she entered a room with a recliner that had been wiped down with bleach shortly before she entered. She was hospitalized, suffering respiratory distress.
An employee was washing buckets when the employee's left pinky finger was caught in a door jam, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting an abandoned cable when an arc flash occurred, causing electrical burns to the employee.

An employee was on top of an injection molding machine, looking into the machine with a flashlight to find jammed material. The material splashed up onto the employee's face, neck, and arm, causing second- and third-degree burns.

An employee was driving a forklift while another employee drove a second forklift behind him. The first employee slowed down and made a U-turn. The second employee did not see the first employee and the two forklifts collided. One of the employees suffered a laceration on the left foot and a fractured heel bone, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was emptying a 4-yard garbage dumpster. The employee's right middle finger became wedged between the garbage container and the garbage truck, suffering a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was emptying a garbage container when the employee's right middle finger became wedged between the garbage container and the garbage truck, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was attempting to clean the printing plates of an envelope machine with a towel when his fingers were caught in the printing rollers, resulting in a partial amputation of the third and fourth right-hand fingers.
While walking on the top floor of a parking garage, an employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was doing longshoring work inside a vessel. He stepped into a ladderway that was covered by cardboard, fell 17 feet, and suffered spinal injuries requiring hospitalization.

On January 7, 2019, a maintenance employee was replacing a fork on a forklift when the fork smashed his finger between the fork and the forklift. He was hospitalized with a broken right middle finger.
On 1/07/2019, an employee suffered an abdominal hernia while moving pallets with a pallet jack, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee opened a transformer cabinet and an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's hands.
An employee was preparing a truck for loading when he slipped on ice and fell, injuring his head on the walking surface.
An employee was running wire while standing on a stepladder. The employee slipped and fell 4 feet to the ground, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was attacked by four dogs while delivering mail. He received bite wounds from the top of his head to the back of his calf. His ears were avulsed.

An employee was wearing cloth gloves while holding a 50-pound concrete brace that was attached to a wall panel being lifted by a 200,000-pound capacity crane. The concrete brace moved toward his left pinky finger, and it was caught between the concrete brace and the brace foot, resulting in a finger amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was on a van reaching for a ladder when he slipped on the van bumper and fell to the ground, injuring his knee.

An employee was relieving the pressure on a tank lid. He pulled the first and then second latch to let the pressure release, then hit the third latch with his foot.  The third latch opened and the lid struck him, knocking him up and over the railing onto the ground below. He was hospitalized for a fractured wrist and spleen and back injuries.

An employee was removing parts from an oven. The employee removed one part with tongs, went to remove the second part, and lost balance. The employee's left hand touched the first part and was burned. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was taking off his coat to start his shift when his left index finger hit scrap metal, causing a laceration that required hospitalization and surgery.
A temporary employee was taking a battery-powered pallet jack up a loading ramp when the jack slid off the ramp and rolled over the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a lower leg fracture.

On January 8, 2019, at 6:15 a.m., an employee was trying to unplug shot beads from a die cast machine. His finger was inside the area where the machine discharges the beads when the machine activated, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning up in a tire and battery shop when he fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee put his weight on a trailer hitch while getting up from connecting a chain. The hitch was not connected to the ball and sank down, catching his finger and later resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee fell off a step stool to the floor, suffering three broken ribs and a back injury. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working from a 42-inch-high platform while unloading a trailer. He fell from the platform, breaking his left hip.
A leg skinner machine amputated an employee's left ring finger above the knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell 16 feet to the lower floor while pulling electrical wire and sustained back, neck and hip injuries.
On January 8, 2019, an employee slipped on ice and was injured, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were trying to roll an I-beam that was on top of another beam when the beam slipped off the bottom beam and fell onto the injured employee's right hand, crushing the ring fingertip and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was in a parking lot, walking into work. The employee slipped and fell on the snow/ice, suffering a head injury.
An employee was riding in an aerial lift when it contacted a high-voltage power line. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the torso and upper body.

An employee was walking back to his utility vehicle while doing landscaping work. He tripped on the sidewalk and fell, hitting his head on a tree. He suffered a left eye injury and a broken nose and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell from an 18-foot ladder while doing roofing work. The employee suffered a leg fracture and was hospitalized.
While running wires at the bottom of an excavation, an employee slipped on clay and fell resulting in a broken right tibia.
An employee's hand was caught in a printing press roller. The employee suffered an open fracture of the right thumb and a partial amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was walking from a front office to a mailbox located outside when the employee slipped and fell to the floor at the front door. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for a fractured right hip.
On January 8, 2019, an employee was helping move a wooden board along a chain system. The board fell and struck the employee's left little finger, breaking it.
An employee was operating a press brake when it was activated via the foot pedal and crushed the employee's fingers.

At about 9:35 a.m. on January 8, 2019, an employee was clearing a jam in the bagel slicing area on a production line. She came into contact with a moving pressure conveyor and her left index fingertip was amputated. The bagel slicing area was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee collapsed while walking and struck his head on a wooden crate, suffering a laceration above the right eyebrow.
On January 8, 2019, an employee was holding a fixture in place when their right ring finger was caught between a flange and a target nut resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was standing on the ground dumping from a hopper rail car while operating a pneumatic car door opener. He was then struck by a compressed air hose and the car door opener while being partially dragged on the ground by a utility vehicle for 15 to 20 feet. He was hospitalized with multiple contusions to the body.
An employee was approaching an aircraft door to recover the aircraft when the pressurized door released and hit the employee. The employee lost a tooth and suffered right arm and facial fractures.
An employee was attempting to remove sheet rock that was blocking a shut-off valve when he became caught and fell with the sheet rock, fracturing his lower leg in three places.

An employee was working from an aerial lift to replace telecommunication lines. He lifted the telecommunication line onto his shoulder to get a lashing machine out of a tree. An employee on the ground pulled the lashing line and caused it to come into contact with an overhead power line. The employee in the lift was shocked, resulting in an amputation of his left arm from the elbow down.

An employee was maneuvering a steel transport cart next to a similar steel transport cart when his left fifth digit was pinched between the two carts, causing a laceration, fracture, and dislocation to the distal phalange.
An employee was placing an anchor and was aligning the Kelly bar when his left index finger was pinched between the anchor and Kelly bar, resulting in a partial amputation to his fingertip.
An employee was reaching for a scrap piece of wood and contacted the sawmill blade resulting in the amputation of digits on the left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was washing down brick from a scaffold when the employee fell approximately 25 feet from the scaffold to the ground/wall. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg, broken hip, and broken nose.
An employee was stepping off a forklift when his foot was caught between a guardrail bollard and the rolling forklift. He fractured his ankle.
An employee was working on a conveyor system when the rollers caught his left ring finger, amputating part of it.
An employee was conducting welding operations when a steel pipe rolled onto his leg. His lower left leg was broken.

A line crew was digging post holes with a vehicle-mounted auger. The crew had finished digging a hole and was attempting to stow the auger back onto the vehicle. They had just stowed the Kelley bar when a restraining strap broke. The Kelley bar then sprung loose and hit an employee in the chest. The employee was hospitalized with a spleen injury and seven broken ribs.

An employee poured molten iron into a mold. The molten iron ran out of the mold at the bottom corner of the jacket and onto the employee's right foot causing a burn to the top of the foot, which required hospitalization.
An employee was helping a forklift operator load a 1000 lbs. marble slab when the slab slipped out of the clamp and fell onto his left big toe amputating it.

Employees were waiting on a delivery truck to unstrap electrical panels and control panels for unloading. The driver of a tractor trailer unstrapped the electrical and control panels so the employees could unload them. An electrical panel slipped and hit a control panel, which then struck the injured employee, knocking him to the ground where he hit his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized with a contusion to the back of the head and ligament damage to his right knee.

An employee was up righting a table with another employee when the other employee dropped the table and the tabletop fell on the injured employee's finger, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was running a mulch bagging line when the employee's clothing became stuck in the conveyor, resulting in a fractured upper arm that required surgery.
An employee was conducting maintenance work on an overhead garage door when the employee's thumb was caught in the overhead door's chain drive, resulting in a partial left thumb amputation.
An employee was standing on a semi truck trailer attempting to move a pipe when the employee fell 3 feet off the trailer to the frozen ground.
An employee was entering the building when they slipped and fell onto the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a scaffold setting up a 30" pipe for pre-heat. The pipe was tack-welded where the set-up was taking place. Workers on the other end of the pipe removed the pipe fitting dogs, and 15 minutes later the tack welds at the set-up area failed. The employee's lanyard was between the pipe and the scaffold deck at the time. When the tack weld failed, this caused the pipe to fall and pinch the employee's left knee against the pipe, cracking the fibula.

An employee was using a 10-foot water lance to clean the ash off of a wet sifting conveyor located underneath an incinerator when the lance made contact with hot ash, causing the hot ash to make contact with his face. He sustained first and second degree burns to his face, neck, arms, and hands, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was running a line when the case elevator jammed. He climbed up to the level of an overhead conveyor belt and attempted to release the jam. His left arm was struck by the case elevator when the jam released, breaking it. The case elevator was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was installing new lines and working around 2700-volt power lines. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained burns to the jaw, chest, and arms.

An employee was assisting with the changing of steel banding material on an automatic bander. Other employees completed their work and exited the fenced area. When the gate closed, the machine started moving a bundle of pipe down the rollerway where the injured employee stood, pushing him off his feet and pinning his left leg against the roller. This caused a laceration to the side and back of the left leg above the knee and a fracture to the right ankle requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee reached into a lathe near the point of operation to adjust a lubricant nozzle. His shirt became entangled on the rotating work piece and the employee was pulled into the lathe. He contacted the rotating chuck and received multiple cuts and lacerations and a loss of consciousness.
On 01/09/2019 at 7:25 PM EST, an employee was walking from her vehicle to the seasonal entrance when she tripped and fell on a curb, fracturing her right elbow and requiring hospitalization.

Employees were operating/driving a boom lift back to the shop and were crossing a road when a pickup truck struck the lift. One employee was injured and sustained five transverse process fractures and one spinous process fracture in the L2-L4 vertebrae.
An employee attending an operating room event experienced low blood pressure and collapsed, striking his head when he fell. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee fainted while writing a report on a bench, suffering a laceration to the forehead.
An employee slipped and sustained injuries to her right foot/ankle while selecting products in the freezer.

An employee was transitioning from a ladder to the upper level platform of a 3-buck tubular welded frame scaffold when the employee fell off the ladder to the ground, requiring hospitalization for a fractured heel and possible cracked vertebrae.
An employee's fingers contacted the spinning blade of a table saw and were amputated.
An employee was cutting tree branches with a chain saw when it kicked back and lacerated the employee's left arm.
An employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the right pinky toe after slipping and falling in the kitchen while leaving the restaurant.

An employee was using a roll of shrink wrap to wrap a skid of plastic lugs. He was using a plastic "handle" that inserts into the cardboard tube holding the shrink wrap. He was wrapping the skid from the bottom to the top. As he neared the top and was pulling the last wrap tight, the handle came loose from the roll of shrink wrap . He stumbled a few steps and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the left femur.
An employee was connecting a hook and winch cable to a waste container when his left ring finger became tangled in the cable, resulting in a fingertip amputation with no bone loss.
On 1/09/2019, an employee tripped over a floor mat under a chair and fell breaking her tibia in five places.

On January 9, 2019, an employee was crossing the road when a vehicle ran a stop sign and struck an SUV driving down the road the employee was crossing. The SUV spun and struck the employee in the crosswalk. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
An employee fell to the ground while walking across a snowy/icy storage yard and sustained an injury to the upper left arm.
An employee was operating the patty machine and was wiping off excess meat when the machine cycled and amputated the employee's right index finger between the first and second distal joints.

An employee operating a corrugated machine attempted to jostle a metal tube that was not working correctly.  When the tube moved, it activated a sensor that lowered an elevator gate down on the three middle fingertips of the employee's right hand. Her fingertips were amputated.

An employee was operating a fork truck during fork truck training. At approximately 12:05 PM the fork truck collided with a bollard outside of the building pinning the employee's foot between the fork truck and the bollard and injuring the ankle.

An employee working as a climber was removing a storm damaged tree that fell on a communication line. The employee was tied to an adjacent tree and the communication line was secured to keep it from snapping back. The climber started making small cuts on the tree to release tension slowly. On the final cut, the communication line released suddenly and struck the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with facial contusions, a swollen left hand, and a concussion.

An employee was assisting a customer to unload their electronic recycling items from the trunk of their car. The customer's foot slipped and put the car into reverse slamming into the employee and pinning him against a utility cart and bollard pole. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the leg which lead to surgery and leg amputation.

A crew was rigging down when a winch line became hung up on the operations platform. The platform then failed and an employee was caught between the rails and control panel, suffering bodily contusions.

An employee cycled a saw/weld machine using the two-handed control. The machine did not immediately cycle so the employee attempted to pull the workpiece out. The machine then cycled and amputated the first digit of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was ascending a ladder toward a roof access hatch when the employee mis-stepped and lost balance, falling to the floor. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized with a severe head injury.
An employee operating a stand-up forklift went to exit the forklift while it was in motion and their foot was crushed between the forklift and a guard rail.

An employee was sitting on a stack of three plastic milk crates. When she stood up, the crates became unstable and upended, causing her to fall and land on one of the crates. She suffered a contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was washing out a concrete pump when their hand became stuck in the cylinder. The middle, ring, and pinky fingers were amputated above the second joint.

An employee was loading shocks onto a machine when the machine cycled and the employee's right pinky finger was pinched between the machine cuff and shock. As a result, the employee's right fifth digit was amputated to the first knuckle.

A driver for S&H Transportation was using a tugger to unload his trailer. A forklift operator employed by another company collided with him as he was exiting the trailer. The S&H Transportation employee was hospitalized with two broken ankles.
An employee was cutting tripe using the band saw and amputated the little finger on his right hand.

An employee was walking through the front doors of the facility. She was holding the door with her left arm and holding two bags when her arm shifted downward, causing her to lose balance and fall to the floor. She suffered a left hip fracture.

An employee was using a compound miter saw to cut wood for packaging when the blade cut the back of the employee's right hand, requiring hospitalization. The saw was guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was trying to hang a portable crosswalk on hangers when the employee's left hand was pinched between the portable crosswalk and a barrier rail, resulting in an amputation of the ring finger and a fracture to the forefinger. No tools were used at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a glass forming machine when the funnel closed on his left arm. The molten glass burned his left hand and forearm, and the machine caused contusions to his forearm and hand.

An employee was attempting to unjam a pelletizer pull roller when the machine's fly knife blade drum amputated his right ring finger. The machine was unguarded and running at the time of the incident.

On January 10, 2019, an employee was helping in the operation of a sheet metal slitting machine and was operating a sheet metal re-coiling machine. He was trying to tighten up the sheet metal coil before banding it. As the coil turned, his right pinky finger was caught in a pinch point between the coil and the tensioning bar of the re-coiler. The finger was cut about halfway through and was later surgically amputated just below the first knuckle.
An employee slipped on snow while walking into work and required hospitalization for a broken ankle.
An temporary employee 's foot was run over by a forklift, fracturing it and requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder installing sheet rock. The employee fell 3 feet to a lower level and broke an ankle.

An employee had been operating an embossing press. The employee noticed a piece of splicing tape was not adhering correctly. When he attempted to fix the tape, his right hand became caught in the embossing rollers. Four fingers on the right hand were degloved and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was adding enchilada mix into a mixer when her hand was caught between the paddles and the mixer, resulting in ligament and nerve damage to her left arm and possible broken bones. She was hospitalized.
An employee was processing scrap aluminum with an alligator shear and amputated multiple fingers.
An employee was unhooking the rig floor from the derrick when the rig floor struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with leg and rib fractures.
An employee was washing his cement truck when his right foot slipped, causing his ankle to roll and resulting in a fractured right fibula and tibia above the ankle.

A temporary employee was sweeping the production floor when a nearby tube cutting machine missed a cut causing a glass tube to miss the landing equipment and strike the employee's left calf. The employee was hospitalized with a puncture wound to the left calf muscle.
An employee was helping to moor a coal barge when a rope pinned his foot between it and the barge amputating his left big toe.
A truck driver jumped from the cab of the truck, at seat height, to the ground to avoid a fire and sustained a broken tibia and fibula.

An employee was on an extension ladder installing a window reveal trim inside the second level of a house being constructed when the ladder slipped on the floor, causing the employee to fall approximately 12 feet. The employee suffered a broken wrist, concussion, and sprained ankle.
An employee was loading the truck and sustained a left ring finger amputation after being struck by a rolling lighting case.
An employee was found unconscious and unresponsive, lying at the foot of the third floor stairs. It is believed that he fell. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder accessing the roof and sustained broken ribs, lacerations, and contusions.

An employee put a repaired motor back on a stamping press and was turning the belts to make sure they were all lined up in the groove. His hand became caught between the motor pulley and belt. He sustained a crushing injury with an open distal phalanx fracture and a nail and nailbed injury to the left index fingertip.

An employee was operating the garbage truck's lift handle to pull a garbage can up to the truck to dump the garbage. On the way down, his left index finger became caught in the safety latch of the lift. The employee sustained the amputation of the left index fingertip.
On 1/10/2019, an employee fell from a portable staircase while picking orders and suffered bleeding on the brain, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was looping coil on a machine when one of the wires came out of alignment and he moved it back in place. His hand was in the path of the loop when the machine was activated via the foot pedal, causing the loop bar to turn and amputate his right middle fingertip.
An employee fell from about 24 feet to the ground below and sustained slipped spinal disk injuries.

An employee was performing a cleaning task at the start of a product change-over on the production line. The machine includes a free-floating pan and scraper drum. The employee's left arm became trapped between the pan and drum causing a laceration and fracture.
An employee finished football practice and was on the team bus when he experienced abdominal cramps due to dehydration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning up the shop area with a co-worker. There was a plunger on an I-beam. The employee picked up the plunger, then dropped it. The employee tried to catch it, and his right hand was caught between the plunger and a metal pipe stand. The employee sustained a laceration, torn tendon, and fracture to the middle finger.

An employee was operating a chamfer machine that bevels metal bars when the machine jammed. The employee was attempting to remove the jam by pushing on the bars when the machine engaged and amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee poured chlorine (thinking it was water) inside a pump sprayer that had an acidic cleaner inside, creating a noxious fume that caused the sprayer to explode. The chemical mixture spilled onto the employee's left leg and foot, causing chemical burns.
An employee sustained the amputation of three fingers while operating a mechanical press brake.
An employee fell down about eight steps while coming downstairs from the second floor and was hospitalized with bilateral arm fractures and a possible head injury.
An employee was mopping when his head struck a metal merchandise rack, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was cleaning a pipe when a 14,000 psi hydro-blasting hose exited the pipe and struck his left buttocks area, causing a high-pressure puncture wound.
An employee suffered a blister to his left toe from rubbing on his safety boot. The blister became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was exiting a scissor lift when he slipped on the step and fell, suffering a broken wrist and hip.
An employee fell through a cover over a staircase opening to the basement level and was hospitalized with a neck injury.

An employee was helping a backhoe operator place a concrete inlet box. The employee was holding the wire rope cable with his left hand when the backhoe lifted the box. The cable cut the employee's hand, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was in the back store room moving small boxes when she stepped on a pallet tie which caused her to trip and fall striking the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken left elbow.
As an employee stepped out of a car in the parking lot, the car began moving in reverse and ran over his leg. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
On 1/11/2019, an employee opened a barn door to release animals when a gazelle cornered her and punctured her leg with its antlers. She was hospitalized.
While exiting a guard shack, an employee missed the first of two steps and fell to the concrete ground, fracturing the left knee and right ankle and lacerating the left middle finger.
An employee was positioning a 2x4 wood beam on a table saw when the saw blade deeply cut the employee's right hand.
An employee was cleaning windows from a step ladder. Upon descending from the step ladder, the employee fell and injured the left knee.

An employee was troubleshooting a roller that was not rolling on the rolling mill. He stepped to the side and tried to manually roll it when the roller began to roll and his fingers were pinched between the roller and the pipe going through the mill. He suffered partial amputations to his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee un-bolted two rotary mowing machines and was lowering them when they fell onto his foot, causing injury.
A maintenance employee was attempting to remove a jam when the employee's left middle fingertip was caught between a sprocket and chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a corrugated air gun to repair a pallet when the corrugated fastener cut his left hand and struck an artery. He was hospitalized and required hospitalization.

While an employee was cleaning fiber and metal shavings from a separating machine, the machine energized and the rotating auger struck the employee's right hand causing the amputation of the right thumb.
While unjamming the mandrill unit, an employee sustained a wrist laceration requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting roofing work when the employee slipped and fell 10 to 13 feet from the roof to the ground, fracturing the right heel.
An employee was cutting a 4-inch piece of foam in half using a band saw when his left thumb contacted the blade and was partially amputated.

An employee was using an 8-foot A-frame ladder to pull stock from the shelves in the back room. The employee fell from the ladder from an unknown height and hit the floor, lacerating her hand and injuring her back. She was hospitalized.

An employee was getting material from inside a bucket truck bin (compartment) to provide to a lineman working aloft. When the employee released the locking mechanism for the bin door, the door swung open and lacerated the employee's face.
An employee was positioning metal grates on the back of a trailer when his left middle finger was caught on the metal grate, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was changing blades on a forklift when a blade fell and pinched his left middle finger between the blade and the ground, resulting in a partial amputation.

While operating a forklift, an employee reached for an object and lost control of the vehicle, which collided with another parked forklift. The employee was pinned between the two forklifts, suffering a crushing injury to the upper chest area.

At approximately 2:12 PM, an employee was operating a wax machine when his left sleeve became caught in the gears of the machine, pulling his arm into the gears. He was hospitalized with a fractured left arm.
An employee was leaving a patient's house and getting in her car when she was struck by a passing motorist. She suffered a head injury.

An employee exited the vacuum truck he was driving to close a pen gate at the end of a barn. After closing the gate, he started to walk back to the vacuum truck when he slipped on the snow-covered ground, fracturing his right ankle and damaging the ligament and cartilage.

An employee was loading a tanker truck with hot asphalt oil. The hose came loose and splashed the employee with hot asphalt oil causing third degree burns to the arms and legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had just finished delivering a parcel, turned and slipped, and fell down a flight of stairs hitting their head. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured neck bone.
An employee was walking in the trailer yard when the employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, fracturing the lower leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting meat with a bone saw and lacerated the tip of his left middle finger resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking in packed snow when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured right femur.

An employee was adjusting an overhead conveyor belt (8 feet in the air) on a scissor lift when her finger became pinched in an in-running nip point, resulting in a fingertip avulsion. The conveyor belt was running at the time.
An employee experienced carbon monoxide poisoning while chaperoning a field trip to see monster trucks.
On January 12, 2019, at approximately 11:10 AM, an employee was walking to the cafeteria when he slipped and fell breaking his femur.
An employee was using an airline to blow condenser tubes out. An obstruction was dislodged from a tube and struck the employee in the hand and chin.
An employee's ski tips crossed, causing him to fall to the snow and injure his knee.
An employee was demonstrating an electric bicycle on the sales floor for a customer when the employee fell to the ground, fracturing the left leg and required hospitalization.
An employee was closing the door to the bathroom when the door slammed quickly and caught the tip of the employee's left pinky finger, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee was performing maintenance activities on hospital grounds when the employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a hip fracture.

The injured employee was spotting for another employee who was backing a conveyor out of a warehouse using a forklift. The injured employee noticed that the forklift was about to hit the overhead door to the warehouse with the conveyor. The injured employee went to lower the conveyor to prevent damage to the overhead door and the conveyor and the forklift struck the employee breaking both legs below the knee.
An employee was struck on the lower left leg by two joints of pipe.
An employee was splashed in the face with caustic soda, resulting in some of the material getting in his eye. The employee was hospitalized.
While taking trash outside to a dumpster, an employee tripped and fell resulting in hospitalization for a right shoulder injury.
An employee had climbed a ladder to snap a light cover into place. The light cover swung back and knocked the employee off the ladder, causing injury to the head and back.
A metal brick was ejected out of a grinder and caused injury to an employee's left arm and chest.
Two employees were on break sitting in a parked car. One employee accidentally discharged a gun, hitting the other employee's hand and leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was offloading frozen product from a vessel's main freezer onto a conveyor belt system leading to a shoreside warehouse when a box weighing approximately 40 lbs. struck/crushed the employee's left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was in the process of putting a tray in the oven when she slipped and fell on her left leg resulting in a broken tibia.
An employee was chopping basil with a knife and amputated his left middle fingertip.

On 01/14/19, an employee was working on an injection molding machine and packing plastic parts when a piece of plastic fell to the floor. She bent down to pick it up and her scarf became caught in a grinding machine bearing, resulting in her being choked and suffering lacerations. She was hospitalized.

An employee ascended a flight of seven metal stairs to check supplies. He was going back downstairs with  and was making a turn on the landing when his boot became caught in the galvanized serrated metal grating, causing him to slip and fall to the metal steps, injuring his neck and back. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a laceration to their pinky finger while operating a lock former.

An employee was unloading couches from a truck. He had three couches boxed up on an industrial-sized hand dolly when the load hit the top of the truck. The couches fell on him with the dolly in between, causing a severe left leg laceration.

An employee was operating a roller press cutting felt paper when the employee's left hand slipped and was caught between the upper roller and the cutting die, resulting in an amputation at the left wrist.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy cement sidewalk outside of a patient's home, suffering a fractured wrist and femur.
An employee was inspecting the parking lot conditions and internal roadways of the facility when he stepped on ice and fell, breaking the right side of his hip.
An employee was removing dust from the hooking clasp (called a dog) on a kiln car on a tram and amputated his right index finger.
An employee hitched a ride in the back of another employee's pickup and was thrown from the back of the truck to the ground, suffering head trauma.

Employees were loading 6.5-inch drill collars onto a 40-foot flatbed trailer for transport. The injured employee was attempting to install a band around a collar to secure it when the drill collar rolled off the trailer and struck the employee's right foot. As a result, five of the employee's toes were amputated.

An employee was helping a maintenance man adjust the belt on a stainless steel deburring machine when the employee's left hand was caught between the belt and drum, removing skin from the palm. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to push chunks of ice/sawdust/bark into the bucket of a skid steer. In an attempt to gain leverage, the employee grabbed the bucket of the skid steer. At the same time, the equipment operator tilted the bucket. The employee's fingers were then caught between the bucket and a metal support beam, resulting in the amputation of four right-hand fingers at about the second knuckle.
An employee was walking at the worksite when the employee tripped on a 4X4 piece of wood and fell to the ground, fracturing the left elbow.

An employee lost balance and fell from the third rung from the top of an 8-foot portal ladder while positioning air ducts in a drop ceiling. The employee contacted the concrete floor and suffered a head injury.
An employee was taking out trash behind the outpost and slipped on some ice and fell resulting in injuries to his right hip and pelvis.
An employee was using a tire machine and attempted to see if the tire was coming off the rim.  The spinning tire then amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee's left hand was caught between a chain and sprocket, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.

On January 14, 2019, at 4:30 PM, an employee was standing on the back of a dump truck at a residential construction site when he slipped and fell onto a dirt surface, landing on and fracturing his left wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading unit load device containers from an aircraft. He was pulling a pallet when his foot became stuck. The pallet then rolled over his left foot, causing pain, swelling, and bleeding to his toes. He was hospitalized.

An employee was manually clearing a clog in a centrifuge machine when his fingers were caught and crushed between the dryer mechanism and the centrifuge, ripping the skin and meat off and leaving the bone. As a result, his right middle and ring fingers had to be surgically amputated.

An employee was bringing in equipment to complete a case. The employee tripped over a cord attached to a piece of equipment and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right arm requiring surgery.
An employee was leaving a bathroom when the employee's left hand was caught in the hinge side of the restroom door, resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a powered handheld saw to cut 2 x 4's, when his right leg was lacerated above the knee. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was attempting to push a waste bin when the waste bin became stuck on a hanger wire. As the employee attempted to get the waste bin unstuck, the employee fell on concrete and injured the right hip.
An employee was unloading a semi-truck into a route truck when the employee's feet became tangled in plastic wrap. The employee tripped and fell off the truck to the ground, suffering a concussion.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground inside a parking garage, hitting his head and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving a pallet loaded with empty milk crates when the crates started to fall. The employee tripped and fell to the floor while attempting to move out of the way of the crates, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was conducting hourly lot trailer exterior security rounds when the employee lost balance and slipped, falling on black ice on the cement ground and fracturing the right leg in two places (below and above the knee). The employee was hospitalized.
An employee amputated his thumb while cutting lettuce.
