An employee was driving an electric stand-up pallet jack when another pallet jack driver struck him. This caused him to lose control of the pallet jack and to hit a metal railing. His left ankle hit the metal railing, resulting in a laceration and fracture to his left ankle. He was hospitalized.
While clearing snow, an employee slipped on snow/ice and fell, breaking four ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was relocating a rack of glass using a manual pallet jack when the glass fell on his foot, fracturing four toes. He was hospitalized.

On January 14, 2019, at 8:10 p.m., an employee was scanning mail on a roller table and stepped to the right. The employee's right foot was caught on the edge of a mat and the employee fell to the floor, fracturing the right hip.
An employee had chest pains after shoveling snow, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was acting as a spotter and guiding a flatbed operator while standing on the rear passenger side of an outrigger leg when he stepped back onto a mobile crane platform and fell approximately 70 inches to the ground. He was hospitalized with an open fracture to the left ankle.
An employee fell off a ladder from a height of less than 10 feet, resulting in fractures, dislocated bones, and torn ligaments of the wrist.
An employee suffered partial amputation of the right index finger during engine maintenance.
An employee slipped on ice and fell resulting in a hip fracture.

An employee was attempting to remove a scroll compressor and was pulling on the suction line while his helper was heating the solder joint enough to allow him to pull the joint apart. His helper was in the process of removing the flame when hot refrigerant oil sprayed onto the employee's face, forearm, and neck, causing burns.
An employee fell off a scaffold to the floor, injuring his back, neck, and elbow.

An employee finished drilling a hole into a hinge and was wiggling the hinge out of the drill when his hand raised up and the rotating drill caught his glove, pulling his hand into the drill. He suffered a crushed finger and several fractures to the left index and pinky fingers, leading to amputations.
An employee slipped on ice and hit his leg on the underside of a trailer, fracturing both bones in his leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attaching a cable to a D-ring when the cable tightened, catching and fracturing his right hand between the cable and D-ring.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell injuring her knee.
An employee slipped on ice and fell resulting in a fractured rib and a bruised lung.
An employee was checking concrete grades when a skid steer backed onto the employee's leg, causing multiple fractures.

An employee had been doing an infra-red scan of an uncovered electrical switchgear panel (600 volts, 4,000 amp). As the employee replaced the cover on the panel, an arc flash fire occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's legs, wrist, and neck.
Six employees on night shift were attempting to put out a fire in one of the buildings when they were overcome by the heavy smoke. Two of the employees were hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when he fell, breaking his arm and wrist.

An employee was cutting beef shank on the meat saw. After getting toward the end of the shank the saw blade became caught in the bone and jerked the beef shank. This caused the employee's right index finger to be pulled into the saw blade resulting in the amputation of about two-thirds of the finger.
An employee was working from an aerial lift to measure a sign when the employee contacted power lines and was shocked, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was in a hole helping to install two sections of a gas pipe at a bend when the pipe slipped through the clamps used to hold it and crushed the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking to her vehicle after her shift when she slipped on the ice and fell to the road, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a metal pipe on a flatbed semi-trailer when the employee fell off the side of the flatbed semi-trailer. After the employee fell off the trailer, the pipe shifted position, rolled off the trailer, and landed on the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower left leg.

An employee thought they observed a loose screw towards the rear of a machine and reached in to check the screw. The machine completed its cycle and crushed the employee's left hand. The left middle finger at the knuckle and a portion of the pinky finger were surgically amputated.

While clearing a jam in the head rig chipper an employee had to remove the chipper's lid. When lifting the lid, it was found that a pin which allows the lid to pivot, was not in place. This caused the bottom of the lid to rotate and roll over the bump stop. The lid then rolled over towards the employee, striking the employee in the left arm and the front of his hard hat. The employee sustained a broken left humerus.
An employee's right hand was caught between a conveyor and a chain guard. The employee sustained amputations to the right ring and index fingertips and the middle finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was in a guard shack helping a second employee unload tickets and codes when suddenly the shack caught on fire. The employees exited the shack to help a truck driver and to put the fire out. At that time, the first employee received burns.
An employee was adjusting a belt on a pulley. The belt and pulley caught the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the little finger.
An overhead rigging chain with a splice box broke. An employee was struck in head by the chain sling resulting in a contusion and skull fracture.
An employee was cleaning the chains in the bed of the module truck. His clothing became caught in the chain and sprocket causing a separation to his right arm's pectoral muscle.

An employee was unloading a bulk trailer. He pressurized the trailer and heard a hissing sound.  He climbed up on top of the trailer to investigate what was leaking. He discovered the cleanout hatch was hissing.  At that time, he touched the cap and it flew off, striking him in the forehead. He was hospitalized with a forehead laceration and required stitches.

Part of the safety cable that ran vertically along the post that was covered by previously poured concrete had been chipped away. As the employee squatted and held onto the safety cable to look at the outer side of the post, the safety cable gave way, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall forward 14 feet over the edge of the second level of the parking garage. The employee was hospitalized with 2 broken heels.
An employee was stepping onto a step when he fell and broke his right ankle.
A temporary employee was pulling freight and scanning product when his arm went through a forklift mast to scan a carton. The mast closed on his arm, breaking it.

An employee was redressing a compact setting tool and had it in a vise. He put the mandrel in the sleeve and attempted to screw the mandrel onto the tool. When he let go of the mandrel with his right hand, it fell. As he attempted to catch the mandrel and sleeve, he stumbled and the mandrel struck/pinched his finger on the floor, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was working from a foot hop. The plank fell off its support when the support moved under it, causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered internal bleeding and contusions.

An employee was looking for a crescent wrench and dropped his flashlight. He reached for the falling flashlight and his hand contacted the fan blade of a running generator engine. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index fingertip and a laceration between the thumb and index finger on the right hand.
An employee tripped and fell to the asphalt pavement while exiting his truck for a delivery, fracturing his left hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a loader to place a 4.5-inch casing onto a pipe rack. The employee noticed the casing was rolling off of the pipe rack and exited the loader to stop it. The casing rolled onto the employee's left arm, pinning and breaking it.
Two employees were using Dexpan when the chemical sprayed into their eyes, causing eye injuries to both. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading rolling bins from the rear of a semi trailer. A forklift ran over the employee's feet, causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered severe bruising of the left foot and right toes, as well as a hip injury, and was hospitalized.

On January 15, 2019, at approximately 4:53 p.m., an employee delivered a package, turned to descend the stairs, tripped over raised carpet, and fell down 8 stairs to the ground, suffering a lower left leg fracture.
An employee was adjusting the position of a paper roll. His hand slipped on the roll causing him to lose balance and fall. The employee fractured his femur.

Employee was attempting to remove a jammed box on a conveyor system when his apron was caught in the conveyor roller and pulled him down. The employee caught himself with his hands  and then his left  pinky finger went into the roller. He pulled his finger free and then his right pinky finger went into the roller. The roller partially amputated his right pinky fingertip and his left finger was fractured.
An employee was standing beside a conveyor gate when another employee closed the gate latch on the first employee's left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking when he fell near the chip chain by the bind. His right hand was caught in the belt at the drive of the chip chain bend, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.
An employee sustained a right-hand laceration and fracture to the fourth finger while operating a vertical turret lathe.

A contractor employee was taking a press machine apart when another employee bumped into him, causing him to fall into the pit where the press is housed. He struck his back along the wall of the pit as he was falling to the ground.
A garbage truck ran over an employee s left foot crushing it.

An employee was operating a press brake machine to form 16-gauge cold rolled sheet metal into an 18" x 12" metal pan with a 1-inch lip on all four sides. The bottom foot of the press brake fell out of the machine and landed on the employee's left leg/foot, crushing the foot and lacerating the calf and shin.

On January 15, 2019, at 8:45 a.m., an employee was walking into work from where she parked on the street when she slipped and fell, striking her head on the icy sidewalk. She was hospitalized with a fractured occipital bone.
An employee was prepping a vehicle to be dismantled by removing parts when gas splashed near the heater, causing it to ignite. The employee was burned on the face and hands.
On January 15, 2019, an employee was trying to unjam a machine when his finger was caught between a belt and pulley assembly, amputating his right index fingertip.
While installing utility meters, an employee contacted overhead power lines and sustained burns to their hand and face.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor while moving a cooler, tearing the left thigh muscle tendon from the knee.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot and broke their left femur.

An employee was aligning a casting body that was not centered. The employee was using shims and the tailstock to align the casting body. While holding some pieces of shim material on the center, the employee activated the foot pedal to move the tailstock forward to hold the casting body. The foot pedal malfunctioned and did not move the tailstock forward. When the employee looked at the foot pedal, the tailstock engaged, moved forward, and the employee's fingers were caught between the casting body and the tailstock. The right index and middle fingers were amputated halfway through the fingernails.
An employee slipped and fell from the roof of a two-story house to the ground while on his way to secure his harness to the rope, suffering a right ankle fracture.

An employee was loading plants from a metal trailer on the top shelf of a rack when he stepped on the metal trailer and slipped, catching his right middle finger in the side post of the metal rack. His finger was fractured.
An employee turned around after stacking boxes. The boxes had fallen over, and the employee then tripped over the boxes and fell to the floor, fracturing the right hip.
An employee slipped and fell, breaking a leg.
An employee was removing paper stuck in a vacuum roller when the employee's left thumb was caught in a pinch point, resulting in an amputation at the mid-nail area (no bone loss).

An employee was trying to push a bar that had jammed the chain and the sprockets of a plate freezer machine when his left first finger was caught between the chain and sprockets, resulting in an amputation of his finger.
An employee was attempting to wipe dust off of a machine when his finger entered the exhaust chamber and contacted a blower, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.
An employee was carrying luggage and descending the stairs from a plane when the employee reached ground level and slipped on black ice. She injured her leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was sawing a board when the saw kicked the board back. The saw blade contacted the employee's left hand, lacerating it and amputating the ring finger.

An employee set a ladder on a second landing's snow and ice rubberized surface. The employee was climbing the ladder when he fell with the ladder from 15 feet onto a concrete slab. He sustained a broken right wrist and four broken ribs.
An employee tripped over a door stop while pulling wires, suffering severe abdominal pain likely due to a severe hernia.
An employee was unstrapping 20 sheets of glass in a truck. After being freed, they fell on him. The employee suffered a torn ACL.
An employee was performing maintenance on a Powerite box and was splashed with a mixture of hot and cold water, receiving second degree burns.

An employee was installing a cap on a gas fireplace vent on the exterior of a house. He fell 6-7 feet off a step ladder onto the ground. The employee sustained a broken rib, punctured lung, and a fractured wrist.

An employee was attempting to fix a hydraulic leak in the stacker/grader when the electric eye was activated. The employee's arm was then fractured and an artery was lacerated in the stacker/grader. The stacker/grader was not locked or tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was working to unjam a reject bin when her glove was caught in a conveyor belt sprocket. The force fractured the employee's right ulna and radius.
An employee was hammering a wooden stake into the ground with a sledge hammer when the hammer hit his right hand, injuring his index finger.
An employee was burned on both hands while testing electrical equipment using a pin and sleeve insertion withdraw method.

On January 16, 2019, at approximately 1:30 p.m., an employee was cleaning a storm drain when the J-hook attachment used to pick up and move the storm drain became disengaged from the grate and the 300-pound iron storm grate dropped on his left foot. He was hospitalized with fractures to his three smallest toes and required surgery.
An employee was repairing a hole on a steam and condensate blowdown line in the power house when the steam caused second degree burns to 50 percent of the employee's body.

An employee opened the top of the copier, which contacted a fire extinguisher on the wall. The fire extinguisher fell onto the employee's left foot. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the middle toe.

An employee was using a forklift to unload trailers. His hand was under the protected forklift cage as he leaned onto the controls that lowered the boom. His left hand was then caught between the boom and the mast, causing a laceration and three broken bones in his hand. He was hospitalized.

On January 16, 2019, at approximately 3:35 p.m., a machine operator was working to run normal production on the ravioli forming machine. The employee was tasked with continuously supplying (feeding) the filling into the machine and to start/stop the machine to make small production adjustments to the product. At some point during production, the injured employee contacted moving components inside the machine and sustained an amputation, without bone loss, to the middle fingertip of the left hand.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder about 12 to 15 feet above the ground while attempting to light a waste oil heater that hangs from the ceiling. The employee pushed the reset button (electric ignition) and a flame came out of the heater, causing second degree burns to the employee's face.

An employee was using a tabletop date code stamper to record information on cardboard packaging when his finger was caught between the stamper head and base of the stamper, resulting in a finger amputation. The plexiglass face had been removed from the stamp at the time of the incident.
After removing an air hose and a 1/2-inch nipple from a line that was being tested, a plug in the line hit and injured both of the employee's hands.

On January 16, 2019, at approximately 4:00 PM, an employee was installing insulation to a steel exhaust vent in the storage garage as a temporary solution to reduce escaping heat. The employee was working from an aerial lift and was found unconscious and face down on the gravel surface below the lift. The lift was positioned in an elevated position with the basket door open. It is presumed that the employee fell from the lift. The employee was hospitalized for head trauma. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
On January 16, 2019, at approximately 4:52 a.m., an employee fell in the parking lot upon arrival to work, fracturing her left femur/hip and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
Two employees who worked for different employers got into an argument and began to shove each other. The injured employee fell backwards and fractured his hip.
An employee fell in the parking lot.
An employee fell while mopping floors. A fire extinguisher was knocked off the wall and landed on his right index finger, causing an amputation up to the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam at an LED attachment machine when the employee's right fourth finger was pinched between the LED tube feed magazine and the horizontal stationary guide, resulting in an amputation to the distal end of the finger (no bone loss).

An employee was bent down picking up trash from the ground in the parking lot when a snow plow reversed into the employee and struck the employee's torso. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee was adjusting a nail machine when their hand was caught in a belt and pinched in the pulley. The employee sustained the amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was using a reciprocating saw when his right pinky finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee removed a piece of decking for a welding inspector to see under it when he inadvertently fell through the opening about 16 to 18 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized with a collapsed lung and fractured ribs.
On January 16, 2019, an employee was exiting her car to enter work when she slipped on ice and fell. She suffered a broken left tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to a vehicle in the parking lot when he slipped on black ice, dislocating and fracturing his right ankle.
An employee was walking down steps when she fell, breaking her left ankle.

An employee was rinsing cheese conveyor belts when he saw a piece of cheese on a weigh belt and attempted to remove it. His arm was then caught in the weigh belt, resulting in a broken forearm. The weigh belt was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a crane and experienced respiratory distress caused by exposure to toluene vapors. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 16, 2019, while moving from a front end loader to a semi trailer to strap down a load, an employee slipped and fell about 4 feet to the ground below. He suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing straps from the top of a load of lumber in a truck trailer when the employee slipped on snow/ice and fell to the ground, breaking the left foot.

An employee was taking a photo of a product shelved in an upper part of the warehouse. As she was climbing a warehouse extension ladder, it slid downwards. She jumped from the ladder and hit the floor, breaking both legs.
An employee had been assigned to perform a heater inspection. The employee planned to use a ladder to access the roof. The employee was found on the floor of the facility with a concussion.

An employee was drilling holes in steel beams when his right hand and glove became entangled in the magnetic drill. The employee was hospitalized due to lacerations, possible ligament damage, and a nail avulsion on his right hand.
An employee dropped a container which contained acetic acid, adam, and MEHQ. The container hit the edge of a fume hood and splashed onto the employee causing second degree burns.

On January 16, 2019, an employee was bending sheet metal on a hydraulic press brake. The height adjustment guard had loosened and created a larger clearance between the sheet metal and the die. The press brake was activated via the foot pedal while the employee's fingers were in the point of operation. His left index finger was crushed, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was struck by a rotation bar during a change-over on a thermoformer machine, injuring his spleen, colon, and pancreas. He was hospitalized.

An employee climbed up a portable stair ladder to grab a box from the shelf. On the way down, he missed a step of the ladder and slipped, falling and hitting the back of his head on the concrete floor. He suffered a head laceration and fracture.

A leg from a concrete paver had been removed at the job site and transported to the yard by a material loader. A mechanic truck was used to lift the leg off the loader and place it on the ground. Once on the ground, the leg shifted and the employee was pinned between the leg and a low-boy trailer in the chest and right shoulder area. The employee sustained three broken vertebrae.

An employee was reducing pressure on an over-the-road tank truck for unloading purposes. Due to an over-pressurization event and/or a defect, a 3-inch stainless steel washout pipe nipple cap failed and struck the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with head injuries.

An employee was cutting metal from an elevated position of approximately 10 feet. He was tied off to the structure he was cutting. When he cut the structure, it came loose, and both he and the structure fell to the ground. He suffered a broken left leg above the knee, a bump on the back of the left ear, and scratches above the right eye.

An employee had been disassembling a scaffold, working on the fourth tier. Components being stacked on exterior outriggers caused a shift in weight, which led to the collapse of the scaffold's top section. The employee fell 25 feet and sustained a fractured and lacerated right arm.

On January 17, 2019, an employee was cleaning a fryer machine and sustained a partial amputation to the right thumb after it became caught in a chain and sprocket. The machine was not locked out at the time.

On January 17, 2018, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was picking up ventilation duct work on the outside retaining wall of an outdoor grain pile. A second employee was operating farm equipment inside the grain retaining wall to move corn seed. As the second employee was moving seed, a piece of ice on the tarp covering the pile was dislodged and slid down the tarp, striking the retaining wall and sending pieces into the air. One of the pieces of ice struck the first employee on the right side between the rib cage and hip. The employee was hospitalized due to internal muscle bleeding.

An employee was working on the product fill line when the product injection needle injected into the employee's hand, wrist, and arm, requiring hospitalization. The injection needle was guarded at the time.
An employee was climbing a ladder when the ladder slid and the employee fell to the ground sustaining back and leg contusions.

An employee was assisting others in rotating a canopy on a piece of heavy machinery which was to be placed where welders were working when his finger was caught between two pad eye stops. The employee sustained the amputation of the distal fourth finger on the left hand.
An employee was moving steel flat bars from the forks of a forklift by hand when the material shifted and caught the employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking next to a forklift being operated by another employee. When the employee stopped walking, the forklift struck and injured the employee's foot.

On 1/17/2019, an employee was walking through the production area when he was struck by a powered industrial vehicle while crossing an intersection. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot and amputated toe(s).
An employee was running the punch machine when the punch came down and blew apart. Shrapnel scattered and struck his left arm.
An employee was putting bricks on an elevator when he fell from a scaffold, landing about 20-30 feet below. Blocks fell on top of him. He was hospitalized with a broken arm and broken back.

On January 17, 2019, an employee was setting up a cut-off grinding machine to smooth two castings. When the cutting/grinding was initiated, the abrasive wheel disintegrated and shot out at the employee. The employee sustained a thumb amputation and other injuries to the hand and chest.

On January 17, 2019, an employee was dumping scrap by hand when a scrap hopper tipped over, causing scrap to spill out onto the employee's feet. The employee's feet were pinned against a conveyor, fracturing both ankles.
An employee was cutting laminate with a table saw when the blade cut his index, middle, and ring fingers on his left hand. His ring finger was completely amputated.

An employee was sending a part through a pass-through parts washer. He was attempting to guide the part when his glove and finger were caught in the conveyor, pinching his fingertip at the transition from the washer to the roller conveyor. As a result, his right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on an ATV retrieving material from an outdoor storage area when the employee hit an ice patch on gravel and the ATV flipped. The employee suffered pelvic fractures.

An employee was loading bags of powdered mixture into a sifter. While he was trying to retrieve a fallen box cutter from the hopper, the rotating blade in the hopper severely cut fingers on his right hand.

An employee was moving an under-trailer storage box when he tripped on a trailer. He fell backwards and the storage box fell onto him, landing on his left hand. It smashed his left index finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was struck by an outrigger while delivering spa equipment to a residence. The employee suffered a compound fracture to a finger on the right hand.

An employee was pouring a small quantity of heptane into a 1' x 1' pan to conduct a fire test in the laboratory. When the heptane was poured into the pan, it flashed and burned the employee's right hand and left thumb.
An employee's feet became tangled in stretch wrap on the floor of a freezer, causing him to fall fracture his right hip.
An employee's foot became caught and injured on a chair leg in the kitchen area of the office, requiring surgery.
An employee was coming out of a cooler into a passageway in a packing house. A forklift struck her, rupturing tendons in her right ankle.
An employee was emptying basil from a blender and amputated their right middle finger. A guard was in place at the time.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut boards. The saw cut into the employee's right thigh.
An employee was dry mopping the floor when she tripped over her safety shoe and fell to the floor on her left side, breaking her left arm.

An employee was servicing a forklift at a jobsite and changing out the forks when he lost his balance after picking up the first fork. He stumbled and fell backwards to the ground, fracturing his right arm.
An employee was working at a dismantler when a coworker hit the employee with a wooden board. The employee suffered a broken arm.

An employee was moving a basket into position to connect a steel beam when the employee was pinned between the basket and a jack beam, requiring hospitalization for fractured ribs and an absence of oxygen in the tissues.

An employee was cleaning the throat and screw on a plastic extrusion machine using a rag. The rag and the employee's right hand were pulled into the rotating screw causing the amputation of the middle fingertip and an avulsion to the index fingertip.
An employee was standing on a ladder running fiber optic cable when he fell and landed on his feet sustaining a broken right ankle.

An employee was navigating an obstacle course on a powered pallet jack (as part of training to operate the jack). While turning a corner, the jack slid into a rail, pinning the employee's left foot against the rail. The foot and ankle were broken.
On January 18, 2019, an employee tripped/slipped while walking through a parking lot. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle, and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped off a lift gate, fracturing his leg and cracking his right heel.
An employee incurred several arm fractures while cleaning a machine.
An employee was replacing the guard on a lint cleaner machine when his right hand was caught inside the machine, amputating multiple fingers.

An employee was attaching a sucker rod "birdie" to remove rods. The employee's left hand was pinched between the sucker rod and a tong winch line. The employee suffered a broken finger and a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell in a parking lot while cleaning snow off her car, breaking her leg.
An employee sustained a thumb amputation while using a circular saw.
An employee was walking on an ice rink surface to retrieve a hockey goal when he slipped and struck his head on the ice, suffering a concussion.

An employee was in a wood shop, using a table-mounted radial arm saw to cut wood for pallets. As he turned after deactivating the saw, the saw blade cut his finger, causing an amputation. The part of the blade that cut him was not guarded at the time.
An employee's left middle fingertip was caught by the latch of a door as it closed. The fingertip was amputated about halfway down the nail.

On January 18, 2019, at approximately 6:45 a.m. an employee climbed on a two-step ladder to gather containers from the top shelf. On the way down, the employee missed the first step and fell on the floor, requiring hospitalization and surgery for a fractured right hip.
At 7:15 a.m., on January 18, 2019, after stepping outside to go to a garage area, an employee slipped and fell on ice. The employee's head struck the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a bolt gun when the bolt shot his temple and he sustained a head injury.

An employee was showing another employee how to perform a process on a drill press and moving shavings away from the drilled area when the employee's glove was caught in the press. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

On January 18, 2018, at approximately 7:30 p.m., an employee was packing lamps when she experienced severe back pain as she bent over to pick up an empty tote weighing 5.6 lbs. that was laying 12 inches from the floor. She was hospitalized with a bulging disc.
An employee sustained a fractured left leg after slipping and falling on ice in a parking lot.
An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder, loading a truck. The ladder kicked out; the employee struck the truck bed and fell to the ground. He suffered head and lower back injuries.
While walking to class, an employee slipped on ice on the pavement, falling and suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was investigating a problem with a pants press when it trapped his hand, damaging tendons. He was hospitalized.

At about 8:15 a.m., on January 18, 2019, two employees were trying to clear jammed lumber in a saw. While one of the employees was holding up a lumber indexing guide, the saw switched to reverse feed. A 2-inch by 4-inch piece of lumber caught the bottom of the guide, moving it forward, and pinched the employee's index and little fingers. The tip of the little finger was amputated.

An employee was standing on a ladder while working on a light. He had some wires in his left hand and a tool in his right hand. He was in the process of stripping the wire when he experienced an electric shock (220 volts) through his hand and fell off the 10-foot ladder to the ground, suffering bodily trauma. He was hospitalized.
An employee turned while carrying a ladder, then felt a severe back pain. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from swelling on a nerve.

Employees were attempting to lift and move a cellar cover in order to install a work platform in the cellar for a welder. The cover came into contact with the blowout preventer spool, causing it to fall back. An employee's right middle finger was caught between the cellar cover and the tin horn, causing an amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was replacing the floor trim, using a pneumatic nail gun. A nail hit something and bounced back into his left eye. The employee sustained an eye injury requiring surgery.

An employee was standing on the back side of an 8-foot fiberglass portable ladder at the lower brace and handing a piece of ductwork up to a second employee who was standing on the 3rd or 4th rung on the front side of the ladder.  The ladder collapsed and both employees fell to the ground.  The ladder and ductwork landed on the first employee, who was hospitalized with a fractured lower left leg.
An employee was pulling a dolly toward her when she lost her balance and fell to the concrete floor; the dolly may have fallen onto her. She broke her right hip.
An employee fractured a leg after falling from a step ladder.

An employee was unbolting a hopper on a vertical fertilizer blender so that it could be loaded for transportation. When all the bolts except the corner bolts had been taken off, the top corner bolts pulled though the rusted angle iron (and welds broke on the angle iron itself), causing a motion that sent the employee back and to the ground. The employee suffered a broken coccyx.

An employee was using a plastic-handled bristled brush to clean dough from a rotating cutter on a dough sheeter when the brush was caught in the cutter and the employee's index finger contacted the cutter. The employee's right index finger was partially amputated.
An employee slipped on water on a hallway floor and fell, fracturing the right ankle.

While operating a stock picker at the Value City Furniture Distribution Center, an employee's hand slipped off the steering mechanism and the stock picker veered towards racking. The employee jumped off the stock picker while it was in motion, and the machine ran over his left foot.
An employee stepped from a catwalk onto a roller bed module feeder to remove plastic from a cotton module. The employee's right foot was caught in a roller, causing an amputation to the foot.

An employee was spraying out glue pans and machine side frames with a water hose. As the employee used a brush on the glue roll as it was turning, his glove and the tip of his right ring finger were caught and pulled between the glue roll and the anti-wrap bar. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was exiting the building to access her car in the parking lot when she slipped and fell on the icy sidewalk, fracturing her left leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending a flight of stairs when she tripped and fell sustaining broken ribs and a knee injury.

An employee was driving a wedge into a tree that was being felled. The wind blew the tree down in the opposite direction from the one intended; part of the tree struck the employee, causing a broken left ankle.
An employee was standing behind a trailer, holding its door closed. As the trailer backed up, it pinned the employee against the dock, causing hip fractures and pelvic and back injuries.
An employee was pushing a patient in a wheelchair and developed chest pain. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's finger was caught in a chain and sprocket causing an amputation.
An employee was injecting a vaccine into turkeys when he missed the intended turkey and injected his left index finger.
An employee was holding two young turkeys for vaccination. One of the turkeys fell, and the employee was injected with a small amount of the oil-based vaccine while trying to catch it.
An employee was sharpening a chalk stone using a 7-inch hand held grinder. The employee was struck by the grinder and sustained a laceration to the right wrist requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping a forklift operator when the forklift struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle.
While walking down stairs, an employee lost balance and fell, suffering an abrasion to the left leg and a bloody nose.
An employee was helping a mechanic replace a drive belt on an electric motor when the belt and pulley lacerated the employee's right thumb.

An employee was traveling down the right side of a ski run. At the bottom, there is a drop called the water bar. The employee hit the water bar, crashed, and tumbled to the bottom of the run, suffering a back injury.

An employee was inserting a pipe into a piece of a pasteurizer while troubleshooting a problem. The employee's right ring fingertip was pinched between the end of the pipe and a stationary part of the equipment. The fingertip was amputated.

At 2:45 p.m. on January 20, 2019, an employee was walking back to her parked vehicle after a delivery. She slipped on ice, and her right foot went backwards while her body fell forward. She suffered a closed fracture of the right ankle as well as the foot being dislocated.
An employee was walking on a concrete sidewalk at a landing platform, carrying coffee supplies. Fell on ice and snow, fracturing a tibia and a fibula.
An employee was pumping out water from hospital parking lots with a pump connected to a hose. When disconnecting the hose from the pump, the hose came up and struck the employee's nose, breaking it.

An employee was attaching a pipe wrench to a saver sub in order to torque it to a power swivel. Once the pipe was attached, the power swivel unexpectedly began turning, causing the wrench to spin around and push the employee into the handrails on the rig floor. The employee suffered four broken ribs and internal bleeding.

A piece of plumbing was being removed from a piece of equipment (blender) between the discharge pump and the tub. The piece of plumbing slipped out of the clamp and fell onto an employee's right arm, fracturing it.
An employee was exiting the freezer of a restaurant when she tripped and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on the tile floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee was pulling a new fiber optic line and fell approximately 30 feet from the bucket to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs, hip, pelvis, and an arm.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot while cleaning her car and sustained a fractured tibia and ankle.

On January 21, 2019, at approximately 1:00 a.m., an employee was walking in the parking lot when a second employee threw a snowball at the first employee. The first employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground while running away from the snowball, fracturing the right ankle and requiring hospitalization.

On January 21, 2019, at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was attempting to hook up two trailers using a converter dolly. As the employee was maneuvering the dolly, he slipped and fell to the ground due to ice. When he fell to the ground, the dolly pinned his right ankle against the trailer bumper. He was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

An employee was inside a semi truck scale. He was thawing out the scale using a portable propane heater. A flash fire occurred within the confined area of the scale and caused second degree burns across 70% of his body.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot during snow removal and sustained a fractured left hand requiring hospitalization.
An employee missed a curb step and fell in the parking lot breaking her ankle in three places.

A janitor was entering a restroom, holding a mop with her left hand and the door with her right hand. The door slammed shut, catching her right middle finger between the door and the door jamb. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was helping to move a piece of machinery using the boom of a small backhoe, guiding it with his right hand. His right index finger was caught by the bucket when it was set down, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was exiting a warehouse when the employee slipped on some icy metal stairs, suffering a back injury.
An employee was setting a load bar inside a trailer, on the upper deck. The deck slid, causing him to fall to the floor of the trailer. His leg was lacerated and broken.
An employee was under a wharf crane resetting a water side twist lock. The crane's spread bar and its load of containers shifted and crushed the employee's fingers, causing an amputation.

Two employees were troubleshooting a 750-pound dock plate that was standing vertically in the air. The plate fell onto one of the employees, breaking bones in the right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a gin stand when the employee's left pointer finger was caught in the pulley, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee had been operating the strapper machine to strap a bundle of lumber. The employee stepped inside the strapper to remove plastic material from the machine. Plastic strap wrapped around her right leg, pulling her into the bundle of wood and breaking her right tibia.
On 1/21/2019, an employee was opening the door to the laundry area when the employee's hand was caught in the automatic closing doors, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

After scraping ice off a garbage truck's windshield, an employee fell while stepping down from the cab. The employee landed on the concrete of the parking lot about 2 feet below, suffering a broken left femur.

On January 21, 2019, at approximately 6:30 a.m., a seamer operator was attempting to remove a can end when their left arm was pinned between the pocket arm and the frame of the roto-feeder machine. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the left ulna and radius.

An employee was operating a lathe and was sanding a 1.5 x 20-inch chrome pipe with sand paper when the sand paper became caught on the rotating chuck. The sand paper grabbed his glove and pulled his right hand and arm into the machine, up to his neck. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the face and neck.

An employee was walking through a bay in an airport building. An airplane in the bay had just been coated with de-icing fluid, which was dripping onto the floor. The employee slipped on the accumulated fluid and fell, suffering a broken right arm and a broken right femur.
An employee was measuring the radius of the community exit/entrance when he was struck from behind by a car, dislocating the left ankle and shoulder and fracturing the left fibula.
An employee was carrying a bucket of flowers up a flight of stairs. He lost his footing and dislocated his ankle.
An employee was walking across the driveway when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking his right lower leg and ankle.
An employee was attacked by a patient while cleaning bathrooms, suffering head and face injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was working near the forming line when the employee's clothing was caught in a conveyor, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was setting up a portable desk in a jobsite trailer. His left index finger became caught in the hinge area of the desk and was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was riding a four-wheeler from a shop to an office. As he made a left turn, the ATV rolled over him, fracturing his skull. Personal protective equipment was not being worn at the time.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground about 20 feet below. The employee suffered a concussion and fractures to the vertebrae and hip.
An employee fell while walking on top of a new construction ship due to a cramp in his foot. He  sustained a broken hip.
An employee was standing on a 3-foot step ladder in a kitchen area, cleaning a hood. The employee fell to the floor, suffering head and back injuries.

An employee was exiting a metal dumpster after dumping a small pull cart with wheels when she took a misstep from a height ranging from 11.5 to 13.5 inches, resulting in a broken and dislocated ankle.

After one of the mechanics repaired the chocolate pump on the trailer, an employee reached into the hose opening and sustained the amputation of the left middle fingertip. The pump was in operation at the time.
An employee was operating a pulling unit to pull rods when his finger was smashed under the rod elevator, resulting in a little fingertip amputation.
An employee was in a warehouse when a forklift ran over their feet. The injured employee was hospitalized.

Three employees were constructing a dugout in a baseball stadium. They were on top of the dugout, laying decking down. One of the employees picked up a panel and a gust of wind took him and blew him off the dugout roof. He fell 10 feet, landing on a pile of packed dirt and breaking his hip. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.

An employee was unloading a trailer using a pallet jack on a raising platform. The pallet jack got stuck and when the employee tried to move it, he stepped back and fell off the platform, sustaining a broken left arm.
An employee was cutting T-bones with a band saw. The employee's fingers contacted the band saw blade resulting in amputation of the left thumb tip and fingernail.
A tractor operator fell backwards while getting out of the spreader. He was hospitalized with back pain.

An employee was re-aligning a chain and sprocket on a conveyor. The employee's left hand slipped and his finger was pulled into the sprocket causing a fingertip amputation. The machine was on at the time.
A nursing care technician entered a soiled utility room to place a dirty food tray in a cart. She slipped on a liquid on the floor and fell, injuring her lower back.

An employee was operating an overhead crane to move an I-beam that was 30 to 40 feet long. Half of the beam was outside, while the other half was inside. The employee was walking beside the I-beam when a gust of wind started to move the beam, causing it to strike and pin the employee against a wall. The employee sustained chest and internal injuries, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working from a ladder when it began to wobble. She fell to the concrete floor, suffering a compression fracture of a vertebra in her lower back.
An employee was pulling a mail tray to put in a container and felt a pull in his back.

An employee was working in a manlift basket when the basket launched him into the air. The employee fell back into the basket and stuck his head causing a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been adjusting a belt on the deboning machine. As he was checking the belt his left middle finger got pulled in between the belt and pulley and was amputated.

A temporary employee was preparing to clean excess sludge from a slow-RPM paper roller. The roller caught the employee's shift sleeve, pulling his left arm into the in running nip point and breaking bones in the arm.
An employee was sanding product on a lathe with both hands when the employee's glove became caught, pulling both arms into the lathe machine. The employee suffered broken left and right arms.

An employee was maneuvering a large pump when the hose at the top of the pump hit the ceiling, causing the pump to tip over onto the employee's left ankle. The employee sustained two left ankle fractures.
On January 22, 2019, an employee was struck by a truck that was backing up in the parking lot and sustained broken ribs and an air pocket in the lungs.
An employee was using a pipe wrench to loosen a part in a vise. When the wrench moved, the employee's thigh muscles were torn at both knees. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working in the mattress department when she tripped on the wheel of a mattress frame and fractured her right hip.
An employee was feeding the cone on a machine with wire. The wire wrapped around the employee's hand, causing the amputation of a fingertip.

An employee was working on a conveyor that had just been manufactured, testing its speed. A section of the conveyor was missing rollers; this exposed the V-belt and pulley sheave. As the employee measured the belt's speed, his left ring finger was caught between the V-belt and pulley sheave and was amputated.
An employee was hospitalized with a head injury after a slip, trip, and fall incident on an icy working surface.

An employee was preparing to dispose of an old box of pyro-technics (known as stars), which required conducting a controlled burn. He dumped his box out onto the ground and a few stars rolled over to a hot area where a previous controlled burn had just occurred. The stars ignited, creating a chain reaction. The employee sustained first degree burns on the neck and face, as well as third degree burns on both arms, hands, and legs from the knee down.
An employee was mixing batches of food in an industrial food mixer. The mixer blades amputated the employee's right hand at the wrist.

An employee was working on a planer, either cleaning or unjamming the in-feed rollers. The rollers caught the employee's right hand, breaking it in three places. The planer was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

After operating a liquid pharmaceutical machine to make a batch, an employee began to disassemble the machine for cleaning. The employee placed a towel in the machine, which sucked in the towel and the employee's left hand. The employee sustained a partial left index fingertip amputation. The machine was not turned off and was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground, breaking the right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's hand was inside a press brake when the machine was activated via the foot pedal, causing it to partially cycle and crush his hand.
A mail carrier slipped on ice and fell to the ground while delivering mail, suffering a broken right clavicle and broken ribs on the right side.
An employee was putting a module chain on a sprocket on a yard truck. His hand was caught and pinched under the chain, causing the tip of his right first finger to be amputated.
An employee was spotting a delivery truck that was backing up to the back door of the building when the truck struck the employee. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture.
An employee was walking down a hall to a work area when his left pinky fingertip was caught in a door hinge, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof. The ladder slipped and the employee fell, suffering a crack and a hairline fracture to two lower-back vertebrae.

An employee was moving pallets with a stand-up rider pallet jack. He was entering a large garage door style opening with his pallet jack when he hit the side of the opening. He lost his balance and overcorrected. His leg was then caught between the pallet jack structure and the guardrail, breaking his lower leg.
While walking toward a parking area, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right fibula and right ankle.

An employee was walking across the deck of a barge in the dark to move a vehicle that was in the way of the 
unloading process. About 6 feet before the employee reached the truck, he stepped into an open deck plate. The employee 
fell into the tank and dropped about 18 feet down onto an elevated metal platform inside the tank. He fractured both ankles and also sustained 
bruising on both elbows and forearms; a large contusion to his right shin; and minor bruising on his chest, back, and face.
On January 22, 2019, an employee suffered a broken hip while walking over a mound of snow.
An employee was climbing down from a six-step ladder. She fell, suffering a broken leg.
On January 22, 2019, an employee fell from the top of a heating oil truck, breaking several ribs and suffering a concussion.
On 1/22/2019, an employee fell to the ground in the parking garage and broke his hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing a plastic component that was jammed in a de-energized machine. The employee placed their left hand on a metal slide, then used pliers with their right hand to pry the slide open. Upon applying significant force to the slide with the pliers, the jam broke free. The employee's left index fingertip was pinched and amputated between the slide and an adjacent metal surface.

An employee was walking from a general contractor's trailer to a work area, near a temporary roadway that was being used to bring heavy equipment to the construction site. The employee was struck by a trailer, suffering two broken legs.
An employee was trying to move a roll cart to access a cable. The cart fell on top of the employee, breaking the employee's femur and right knee.

Two employees got into a heated argument and agreed to step into the men's restroom to fight. One of the men fell and struck his head on the sink, suffering a fracture and swelling of the right eye socket. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to undo a sling between a crew material handler truck that was struck in the mud and a four-wheeled pickup truck that was pulling the crew material handler truck when the four-wheeled truck rolled back, pinning his right leg. He suffered lacerations, punctures, and a damaged main artery behind his right knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was carrying a gear box weighing approximately 35 pounds when the gear box was dropped on the employee's thigh, resulting in a blood clot.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground in the parking lot while walking from a vehicle. The employee suffered rib and pelvic fractures.

While checking on equipment on the back of a welding truck, an employee fell off the back of the truck to the ground about 36 inches below. The employee suffered multiple fractures and was hospitalized.
A caregiver fell down a flight of stairs while taking the trash out of a resident's apartment. She suffered broken facial bones and was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting carpet at a third-party contract coating facility. As the carpet was run through a shearing machine, the employee's left hand was pulled into the machine, causing lacerations and amputation of fingers.

An employee was standing on a stool while cleaning a piece of equipment when the employee slipped. The employee reached out to catch themselves, and the employee's hand contacted the blades on a machine, causing lacerations to three fingers.
An employee was walking and guiding a piece of equipment on a well pad. He slipped and fell on a large containment pad, landing on the ground and breaking his right tibia.
While walking across a parking lot, an employee slipped and fell on the icy surface. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a punctured/collapsed lung on the left side.
An employee was unpacking boxes at a receiving table. The employee tripped on a cable that had dropped off the table and fell, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell off an extension ladder while bringing material up.
An employee was putting a part into a milling machine when a pneumatic vise closed on the employee's fourth fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee stepped into an indentation under the carpet while vacuuming and suffered a fractured right tibia and torn right meniscus.

Employees were replacing a cooling tower fan belt. After the new belt was installed, the injured employee started up the equipment and the belt caught the employee's glove resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
On January 22, 2019, an employee was walking up exterior stairs that were icy when he fell and hit his head on the stairs. He was hospitalized with head injuries.
An employee was troubleshooting a compressor when a fire occurred, burning his hands. He was hospitalized.
A delivery driver was closing a rollup trailer door. The door closed on his left hand, amputating the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was working on a ladder inside of a hot zone (internal part of the furnace). While stepping off of the ladder, he fell approximately 6 feet.

An employee was operating a block chopper. A frozen block of product was not feeding properly. While the employee was adjusting it with a meat hook, the chopper grabbed the hook and the employee's right little finger was pinched between the hook and the chopper's feed shoot. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was throwing trash into a dumpster when he slipped and fell onto the paved driveway below, breaking his ribs and tearing his kidney.
An employee was servicing a conveyor. He fell in a pile of sand and the conveyor caught his left hand and forearm, causing fractures to both. The conveyor was not guarded at the time of the incident.
A delivery driver was beaten in a robbery attempt. The driver was punched and kicked in the ribs and torso area, suffering a potentially punctured lung and broken ribs.
An employee was unloading a shipping container when an aluminum door and window fell over, striking the employee in the right leg. The employee suffered a broken femur.
While getting materials from their car in the hotel parking lot, an employee slipped on ice and fell. The employee sustained a fracture to the pelvic head of their left femur.
An employee was welding from a scissor lift. As the lift moved, he was caught between its rails and a beam. His chest was crushed.
An employee was working on a production line, removing a piece of a cable from a spooler. His hand was smashed between the machine and the wire spool. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was cutting metal on a manual shear and sustained a finger amputation.

Two employees were demolishing brick and stone from a facade. The first of them was using a hammer drill to demolish the brick and stone; the second was holding the stone to prevent debris from falling to the ground. The drill bit slipped and the second employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell on a sidewalk, breaking his collar bone.
An employee lost his balance while working on a roof installing metal sheet over metal joists. He fell 14 feet landing on the ground and suffering a fracture.

Employees were using a cable grip device to remove the end cap of a water main. An employee's left hand became entangled in the device's metal cable; the tip of his ring finger was amputated and his middle finger was broken.
An employee dismounted a vehicle and hit the ground, suffering a punctured lung.

An employee was operating a walk-behind skid steer. He was traveling under an elevated 18" pipe when the front of the machine dropped into a hole, raising the back of the machine and pinching his left hand between the machine and the pipe. He suffered an amputation of his left middle fingertip (approximately 1/2 inch).
An employee was walking across an aisle to her work station when she tripped and fell to the concrete floor. She suffered a tibiofibular joint dislocation and was hospitalized.
An employee was unjamming a meat grinder when it amputated the employee's fingertip.

On January 23, 2019, a temporary employee was operating laser cutting equipment. As the employee lifted a part out of the laser nest with a magnetic lift and chain hoist, one of the employee's fingers got stuck between the part and the laser nest. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped on ice while exiting a job trailer, suffering a broken hip and shoulder.
While walking down steps, an employee slipped and fell on ice, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee working in the warehouse was lifting a 250-lb. laundry bin when the lifting arm failed. The employee was hit by the bin and sustained a broken rib.
While lifting a bucket of oil, an employee slipped on the floor. His foot was caught between two pipes that ran along the floor, and the fall caused him to dislocate his ankle and break his fibula.
A driver was carrying out an onsite propane fill from a bobtail truck. There was a fire, and the employee suffered third-degree burns to 36 percent of his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on the roof of a new one-story house installing fascia and a drip cap when he lost his footing and fell 10 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized with a broken back and head trauma.
An employee was sweeping up construction debris on the floor when he fell down a stairwell, breaking his pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder when it shifted backwards. The employee fell about 12 feet to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle and a closed compression fracture of a lower-back vertebra.
An employee was struck by a car while crossing the street after verifying the depth of a fire hydrant's water valve. Both of the employee's legs were broken.
An employee was on a 6-foot A-frame ladder, doing maintenance in a packaging area. The ladder twisted and/or collapsed, causing the employee to fall to the floor and suffer a broken pelvis.
An employee was cutting a 4x8 piece of laminate on a router. The laminate fell; the employee reached over, picked it up, and suffered an amputation to the right little fingertip from the router.

An employee was attempting to retrieve an object off of the ground. He leaned over and braced himself with his left hand using part of a forklift. His hand contacted a metal fan inside of the forklift, resulting in a left index finger amputation to the first knuckle.

A driver was about to hook a trailer up to a converter dolly. He bent over and used the handles to pick up the converter dolly, then lost his footing as he moved it forward. As he was catching himself, the eye of the converter dolly amputated the tip of his left thumb just below the bottom of the nail bed.
An employee was sweeping up in a loading dock area when a truck hit him, crushing his ribs.

During a towing and recovery task, two employees were unchaining a forklift from a heavy duty rollback. One of them fell from the deck to the ground about 4 feet below, suffering fractures to the ribs and hip. He was found unresponsive, apparently not breathing, and blue in the face.
While walking into an office building, an employee tripped and fell over a construction fence near the entrance. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was operating a mini-excavator in a saw-cut hole. While the employee was trying to climb out of the hole, the excavator became unstable and tipped over. The employee's left foot was wedged and crushed between the excavator and concrete.
An employee was hanging a calendar. As he leaned on his desk, it broke and he fell, breaking a vertebra in his back.

At about 11:00 p.m., on January 23, 2019, an employee was moving stock with a forklift. The employee dismounted the forklift and some tube stock slid off the forks, striking the employee's right foot and causing amputations to the big, first, and second toes. Steel toe boots were being worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was working from plywood in the space above a storage room and bathroom, running new wiring. The employee fell through the drop ceiling into the bathroom, suffering facial lacerations and a concussion, and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a glue block saw machine, which caused amputation of the employee's left middle and ring fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was walking to the front of the building after fueling a truck when the employee slipped on ice and broke a leg.

An employee was about 10 feet up a ladder in a parking lot, preparing to run cable through a hole drilled in a wall. The ladder's feet lost traction on the wet concrete of the parking lot, and the ladder slid down the wall to the ground. The employee fell, suffering a laceration to his chin, two broken fingers on the left hand, a broken left elbow, a broken right arm and elbow, and broken teeth.

An employee was signaling a truck as it backed up. The truck rolled back, pinning the employee's hand between a camlock union and the DOT bar (bumper). The employee suffered a fracture and dislocation of the left thumb, which was surgically amputated and reattached.
An employee suffered a heart attack while shoveling road salt from the back of a truck.

An employee fell approximately 15 feet from a portable extension ladder to the cement floor in a chiller plant while attempting to attach a chain-fall onto nylon straps near the ceiling. He was hospitalized with a broken tibia plateau in his right leg.

An employee was standing on a catwalk, helping unload bone meal from a truck in a receiving area.  While trying to address a jam, the employee fell from the catwalk down the side of the truck, landing about 10 feet below and suffering a closed displaced fracture of the left patella.

An employee was winching a dumpster box onto a hauler truck. The dumpster got stuck. While the employee was getting it loose and reeling it in, his thumb was caught between the wire rope and the reel. His left thumb was amputated above the knuckle.
An employee was showing another employee how to clear a part if it gets stuck in the conveyor belt and sustained a right index fingertip amputation.
While opening a ladder, an employee slipped on water on the tile floor and suffered a broken leg.
While coming down the ladder of a machine, an employee missed the last step, fell onto the concrete, and broke a hip.
An employee was operating a polishing machine when the polishing wheel caught his gloved right hand. The tip of his middle finger was amputated.
A carpenter was cutting a 2 x 6 using a circular saw when it amputated his right little and ring fingers.

An employee had installed a flapper valve on a fresh water tank on a boiler. He was standing next to the pipe release valve when the valve turned on and potassium chloride sprayed into the employee's eyes causing chemical burns.

At about 3:45 a.m. on January 24, 2019, an employee was emptying parts from an electroplating barrel. He rotated the barrel to get the last of the parts, and the gears caught his glove. His left hand was pulled into the gears, resulting in the amputation of the last joint of the left middle finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on a ladder using a handheld drill with a 5-inch hole saw tool. The drill kicked back and ejected the hole saw. The circular saw blade hit him in the face, lacerating his face from his eye to his jaw. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
A temporary employee was struck by a forklift which was reversing. The employee sustained broken toes and an injured Achilles tendon.

An employee was repairing the gearbox in front of an extruder when he came in contact with molten plastic and sustained second degree burns to the left temple and third degree burns to the left forearm.

An employee was using a wire sling to stand up a 1,000-pound sheave wheel in a vertical position. The wheel fell over and hit his left foot, crushing it against a 4-by-4. He was hospitalized, and a toe was surgically amputated.
An employee was hospitalized with chest pains, headache, and nausea due to hydrogen sulfide exposure.

An employee was operating a sheeter machine that made copy paper. While he was removing a butt roll from a core chuck, his left hand was pinched between the chuck and the roll on the core side. His little finger was broken and lacerated.
An employee tripped while exiting his office, falling to the ground and tearing his hamstring. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was walking into a building when he slipped on the floor and fell, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was walking from their car to the building, slipped on a piece of ice and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left knee.
An employee was walking to his work truck when he slipped on black ice in the parking lot, falling to the asphalt pavement and breaking his left tibia and fibula.
While brushing snow off a work truck, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left foot.
An employee slipped while walking up stairs, falling down the stairs and suffering a broken arm/elbow.

Two machine operators were clearing a jam in a feeder machine. When the jam was removed the lever that drops the feeder chains was activated and the feeder chains dropped on the injured employee's left hand. The injured employee sustained deep puncture/lacerations and a compression injury to the left hand.
At about 8:15 a.m., while walking into work from the parking lot, an employee slipped on ice and broke a leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a cooler, picking orders, when he struck some racking behind him and broke his leg.
While cutting lumber using a chop saw, an employee sustained a partial amputation of the right middle and index fingers.
An employee had clocked out and was leaving the parking lot, when they got into an altercation with a non-employee that resulted in hospitalization.
An employee suffered a back injury while maneuvering a rear seat in a transportation vehicle.
An employee was struck in the leg while cutting a piece of metal. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to align a bushing when the machine suddenly energized. The tap head lacerated the employee's right hand and broke a finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was loading sheet steel on the wood with the crane when his finger was caught and crushed between the wood and the steel.
An employee was transferring materials using a dolly cart. As he was trying to load the cart on a weighing scale, it tipped over on top of him, lacerating his nose and lip and breaking his ankle.
A mail carrier had been delivering mail on their route and was hospitalized for frostnip to fingers and toes and for dehydration.
At 9:30 p.m. on January 24, 2019, an employee was outside a building, pulling an empty metal cart up a slight elevated grade to a truck. The cart struck him, tearing his Achilles tendon.
An employee was walking out of a stock room when she tripped over a box and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was helping a forklift driver position the forks behind a vehicle to be picked up. The forks were raised, and the employee's right thumb was crushed between them and the vehicle.

An employee was placing a sheet of glass into a hard rack. The glass slipped from his hand; a piece broke off and hit his steel-toed shoe just above the toe cap. His foot was cut and he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to remove a shard of glass.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was cleaning a rotating rubber-covered roller with steel wool when his arm was caught and broken by the rotating shaft.
A delivery driver slipped on ice while exiting a vehicle and fell backwards. The employee's head struck the asphalt, causing lacerations and trauma. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice outside of the store. The employee was hospitalized with an injured elbow.

At 11:45 a.m., on January 24, 2019, two employees were inspecting the feed throat of the barrel in an injection molding machine that was having a material flow issue. The screw was retracted and overheated degraded nylon was forced out through the screw feed throat, burning one of the employees on the hands and face. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.
A pressure gauge was removed while observing a pressure survey on the crude unit and an employee received first and second degree burns.
An employee stepped out of his vehicle to deliver a package, slipped and fell on ice. He sustained a hip fracture/fractured ball joint.
An employee was manually cleaning rotating rolls when they caught his gloved hand. His arm was pulled into the rollers. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

A crew of carpenters were in an electric work cart near a handrail. As the driver of the cart was backing the cart up, the heel of his left foot came into contact with the rail, causing his foot to twist. The foot was broken and he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was training on the operation of a pallet jack when it tipped over, pinning him. He suffered a possible fractured rib.
While breaking apart drilling augers an employee was struck in the head by a pipe wrench and sustained a head injury.

An employee had just finished maintenance on a case erecter and had removed lock out from the machine to re-energize it. As he was explaining to another employee what he had done, the machine cycled and amputated his left middle finger.
An employee was descending a ladder, lost footing and fell to the floor breaking a hip.

An employee working inside the street barriers on the shoulder of an on-ramp was struck by a  vehicle that swerved into the jobsite. The employee was hospitalized due to a fractured pelvis and internal injuries.

An employee was working outside conducting a bump test on a rotor motor for aircraft fuel when the rotating motor amputated the employee's right index finger and partially severed the right middle finger.
An employee was working on a ladder at a customer site when they fell from the ladder to the concrete floor and sustained a back injury and fractures to both wrists.
An employee was walking in the corridor, slipped on water and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a hip fracture.
While walking and working on the road widener machine, an employee fell and broke his left ankle.
While bending rebar, a piece of rebar sprung loose from the bending machine and struck an employee in the neck. The employee was hospitalized with a torn esophagus.
While administering oral medication to a bear, an employee was bitten by the bear and the distal phalange on the left middle finger was amputated.

An employee was completing a film change over on a bag maker machine. She engaged the machine to advance the film and as she realigned the film, her right middle finger became caught in the machine resulting in the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a conveyor chain drive on a polisher when their right hand was caught and rolled though the sprocket. The index, middle, ring, and pinky fingers were lacerated.

On January 25, 2019, at approximately 4:29 a.m., an employee fell on icy/snowy cement stairs while walking to his car to leave work for the day. He was hospitalized with syncope, lower back pain, and sprains/strains to the lower back, left hip, left knee, and left femur.
An employee was cleaning a restroom when the door struck her foot, causing her to fall to the floor and break her arm. She was hospitalized.

A swivel snagged on a Kelly bar. An employee was trying to un-swivel the wire rope while the swivel was turning. The wire rope was winded up and when the tension was released it caught the employee's left hand resulting in the partial amputation of a finger.

An employee was working to unhang a belt on a dryer with an extension device. The device got wedged and the employee went through a barrier rail to remove it. His left arm came in contact with the belt sprocket and was pulled into the equipment. The employee received a fracture and laceration to the left arm.
An employee was cleaning the rollers of a conveyor belt when their arm became caught in the rollers and sustained open fractures of the radius and ulna bones in the left forearm.

An employee was trying to remove and re-stack cases from a pallet that had turned over on the fourth level of a storage rack in a freezer. He placed two empty pallets in the rack, one to stand on and one to stack product cases on. He climbed up the end cap and onto one of the empty pallets. The turned-over pallet of product shifted, knocking the empty pallet through the racking. The employee fell approximately 20 feet from the fourth level and sustained a neck fracture.

An employee was driving a forklift when it ran over a 6 x 6 piece of wood. The employee was thrown up in the air and hit his head on the top of the forklift cage causing a deep head laceration and ruptured artery.

An employee lifted a 55-gallon plastic tank filled with trash to empty it into the dumpster. He placed the 55-gallon tank upside down so it could be completely emptied. The employee then climbed into the dumpster and knelt on the container wall. When he tried to shake the tank to empty it, he lost balance and fell 4 feet to the pavement resulting in a compression fracture to the back.
An employee's leg was pinned and broken between a repair rack and a tool box.

An employee was in a man basket that had been lifted by a forklift feeding a kiln. The man basket fell from the forklift approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and elbow.
As an employee stepped out of his vehicle he slipped on ice and fell to the ground breaking his left hip.

An employee was working on a flat roof with a 2-foot parapet. He was laying a roll of tar paper when he stumbled and fell over the parapet onto an adjacent scaffold and then fell down to the ground. The 30-foot fall caused a head fracture and a broken arm.

An employee was walking away from the worksite where he had just attached a steel cable to the pulling machine. The employee was struck by a steel cable that broke off from a fiber rope. The employee sustained a right side clavicle fracture, left side rib fracture, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was climbing up a ladder to replace a metal roof. As he was getting ready to connect to a life line, he slipped and fell approximately 20 feet onto metal roof panels. The employee sustained a broken arm, pelvic fracture and facial bruises.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the terminal yard. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated and broken ankle.

An employee was working in a boom lift changing out light fixtures when their arm became caught between the lift basket and a rack. The employee was hospitalized with a right radius fracture and open wound.
An employee was on a scissor lift approximately 20 feet high when a forklift made contact with the aerial work platform causing it to tip over. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
