An employee was cutting the banding from around a group of pipes when the pipes rolled over his foot and twisted his knee. The employee suffered a left kneecap fracture.
An employee was ripping plywood on a table saw and amputated the tip of his right thumb.
An employee was standing on the bank of an excavation. The side of the excavation gave way and the employee fell in. Concrete pieces fell on top of him and he sustained a broken leg.
An employee tripped and fell in the office, hitting her head. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking across a parking lot, slipped on ice and fell sustaining a fractured hip.
Two mechanics were working together on a spring assembly bench. A leaf spring being held by a hydraulic clamping system flipped, and the clamp caught and broke one mechanic's arm.

At approximately 11:00 p.m., on 1/25/2019, an employee pulled a bottle from a running machine for a required quality check and caught his left index finger in the machine resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.

On January 25, 2019, an employee was on a step ladder changing a lightbulb. The bulb dropped and as he tried to catch it, he lost balance and fell from the step ladder onto the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.
An employee's hand was caught in the screw feed of a milling machine. One of his fingertips was amputated.
An employee's right ring, middle, and little fingers were partially amputated while removing a box jam from a rotary die cutter.
A forklift backed into an employee and fractured his hip.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a stand-up dock stocker and struck the bollard protecting the sprinkler room. The employee sustained the amputation of three toes on the left foot.

An employee was cutting tissue for examination. During this process, the employee sprayed a freezing agent on the tissue while it was in the cryostat and a flash fire occurred. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the face and neck.
An employee was clearing a jam in the chute of a running machine and was caught by the auger. The employee sustained the amputation of the right index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a roof top air conditioning curb and fell approximately 15 feet though a skylight to the floor. The employee's pelvis was fractured in four places and surgery was required.
Two forklifts collided; one of the operators had a heel caught between the two vehicles.
An employee was engaged in drywall installation in an attic. The employee fell through the ceiling and landed on the concrete floor below, injuring his hands and nose.
An employee was cutting T-bone steaks with a push tool when their hand slipped. The employee sustained the amputation of two fingers on the right hand.
An employee slipped on ice and fell breaking his tibia in three places.
An employee was putting returns away when she fell and bruised a knee.

An employee was clearing a jam in a gear machine. The employee cleared the jam using a small torque wrench, but another part jam occurred right behind the original jam. After unjamming those parts, the employee used a screwdriver to hold the parts back and his left index finger to prevent the next parts from coming down the track. One of the parts was released and caused the sensor to call for another part. The gate came down and cut his index finger resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee fractured a rib when he slipped and fell on a hose reel.
An employee was towing empty storage racks with a tug. The employee stopped the tug and was adjusting the racks when the tip of his left thumb was pinched and amputated between the racks.
An employee walked into the lobby at work and tripped/slipped on an umbrella bag and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured shoulder.

An employee picked up a wear bushing that weighed approximately 50-60 pounds from a table. The employee carried it and went to set it down when it slipped. His finger was pinched between the bushing and the sub-setting. The employee sustained the amputation of his right ring fingertip.
An employee was tightening a bolt for the mill draw bar. He lost his footing and fell approximately 3 feet sustaining a fracture to the left arm.
While lifting boxes containing bananas, an employee experienced a pinched nerve. The employee was hospitalized with a herniated disc.
An employee was lowering an 82-pound steel stud into a PVC pipe when his right little finger was caught and fractured between the steel stud and the PVC pipe.

An employee slipped and fell on snow/ice while walking from the rail shed to a stationary rail car to tighten the hand brake. The employee sustained a rib fracture and possible pneumothorax. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a locomotive's ladder.

An employee was boarding a rail car that was moving approximately 2 miles per hour. The employee fell down and their left foot was run over. The employee required the medical amputation of the leg to just below the knee.
An employee was reversing a reach truck when he struck a bumper and sustained a broken left leg.

An employee was standing with one foot on the end of a fryer and the other foot on another surface, while cleaning a fryer hood with a duster. The employee's right foot slipped and went into the hot oil causing second and third degree burns to the right foot.
An employee had chest muscle pains after finishing snow blowing. The snowblowers reverse gear was not working properly.
An employee fell, suffering brain bleeding as a result.
An employee fell to the ground while exiting the bathroom and suffered a left hip fracture.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor resulting in a broken leg.

On January 28, 2019, at approximately 1:30 p.m., the injured employee, a scrap operator and employee in training for locomotive operations, was performing scrap railcar spotting operations with a trainer at the half track at Timken Steel Corporation scrap yard. Both employees were riding the leading edge of the railcars proceeding in an easterly direction. The injured employee was riding on the north side of the railcar and the operator was on the south. As the railcar went around a slight bend in the tracks, the injured employee was struck in the lower left leg by a piece of scrap steel. The scrap steel was frozen into the ground and sticking up and was not clear of the railway. The injured employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula that required surgery to repair.
An employee was moving boxes from one conveyer belt to another when something scratched her left ring finger. Her finger became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing adhesive with a jointer when the jointer caused a partial amputation of the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was cleaning the rotary valve of a machine when his right middle and ring fingers were caught in the valve. The employee was hospitalized and both fingers were amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was wearing a lead vest while bending down to troubleshoot ultrasound equipment when she felt pressure and pain in her lower back and legs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized for irritation and swelling of the airway after being exposed to anhydrous ammonia from a leaking condenser on the roof.
An employee was loading metal onto a skid when he turned his foot, lost balance, and dropped the metal. He then fell onto the metal, which lacerated a tendon in his left forearm.
An employee was collecting carts when the employee's left index finger was caught between two carts, resulting in an amputation to the finger (no bone loss).
An employee was cleaning the operating room, slipped and fell resulting in a fractured left hand.
An employee was climbing a ladder to switch off a valve when the employee fell from the ladder, suffering knee and hand injuries.

An employee was microwaving water during food preparation when her apron string was caught on the microwave. When she walked away, the microwave was pulled violently. This caused the hot water to fly out and land on her right hand, resulting in severe burns.

An employee was sticking a rod through an inspection port to clean lime from the bucket elevator inside a lime kiln. He slipped and the rod and hot lime came out of the inspection port. The solid lime particles contacted his right forearm, causing second degree burns that required hospitalization.

On January 28, 2019, at approximately 4:35 p.m., an employee was attempting to move a plastic banded pallet in the bed of a pickup truck when the strap broke causing the employee to fall backwards out of the truck onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained head and neck trauma.
An employee was riding a maintenance tricycle in the facility when he fell from the tricycle, striking the back of his head on the concrete floor.

An employee was fixing a frozen sump pump drain. As the employee was walking up two steps, the employee slipped and fell. The employee suffered two brain bleeds and a contusion to the back of the employee's head.
An employee was setting up RNC (mesh) bags when she slipped on a bag and dislocated her left ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading boxes from a conveyor belt when his left hand contacted the belt while it was moving and was then caught under the conveyor plate, resulting in the partial amputation of two left-hand fingers.
An employee tripped over her coat and dislocated her shoulder on the floor.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell striking his upper back and head. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture of the T5 vertebra.

An employee was lifting a coil of metal with his forklift. The load did not settle properly so he attempted to adjust it. The load then shifted and amputated his left middle finger above the first knuckle.
On 1/28/2019, an employee was hospitalized after slipping off of the step of his dump truck and suffering a concussion.

An employee was working from a scaffold chiseling mortar. As the employee set his tools down onto the walk boards between two outriggers, the walk boards gave way and the employee fell feet first to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing near a sandblasting pot when the 2-inch air hose came uncoupled from the pot. Its four-lug couple struck him in the face, causing a fracture to his lower jaw, soft tissue damage to his face, and deep lacerations to his lower face. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a floormat and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was cleaning the floors using a floor scrubbing machine when she fell and came into contact with corrosive floor stripper chemicals. She was hospitalized with chemical skin burns.

An employee was jogging a machine to verify a preventative maintenance task had been completed when his fingers were pinned between the machine's belt and pulley. He suffered fractures to the topmost joints of his right index and ring fingers, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was stepping down from her work stand when her foot was caught in a cardboard box and she fell to the floor. She was hospitalized and required surgery for a compound fracture of the right wrist.
An employee was stepping off an 8-inch step, slipped on some concrete slurry and fell breaking the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was crawling under a truck/trailer to service the water pump PTO when his arm was caught in the rotating PTO driveline, severing his right forearm and requiring hospitalization.

Two maintenance employees were working together replacing a shaft pin, bushings, and spacers on a crimping machine. While they were attempting to lower the top half via a crane into the bottom half, the parts became misaligned. The first employee used his finger to feel inside the shaft hole and determine why it was not fitting together. The second employee, who was at the controls of the hoist, lifted the part, causing the very tip of the first employee's left index finger to become caught. The first employee suffered a fingertip amputation to the index finger on his left hand.
When an employee clipped the metal banding on a paperboard roll, the banding snapped and struck the employee in the left eye causing a laceration.

An employee was filling a tank with water and was struck by a pressurized water blast that knocked him to the ground. The employee hit his head on the pavement and sustained a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
On January 28, 2019, an employee was using an industrial reamer and suffered the amputation of the right ring finger past the second knuckle.

An employee was driving a delivery vehicle when he determined that he needed to put on chains to reach the delivery location. While he was stopped in a parking lot to put on chains, a vehicle in front of him (also putting on chains) began to slide into him due to icy conditions, pinning him against the truck. He sustained damage to his ribs, lungs, and shoulder, as well as nerve damage to his neck and left arm.
An employee fell while exiting the bucket of a bucket truck and suffered a fractured tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was using an electric nail gun to build product when a nail nicked his right thumb nail. He was hospitalized due to an infection.

An employee was trying to free a piece of trim that was stuck in the rollers of the roller machine when his left hand was pulled into the machine and crushed. Four fingers on the left hand were amputated. The employee was wearing gloves at the time.

An employee was descending stairs while carrying a flat mail tray when the employee missed the last two steps. The employee fell and fractured an ankle. The handrail was not used at the time of the incident.

While working on a training project (maintenance and rebuilding of a diesel engine) an employee caught two fingers on their left hand between the camshaft and the front of the engine. The left middle and ring fingers were lacerated near the nail and partially amputated.
An employee was opening a heavy steel door when a strong wind blew the door closed striking the employee's head.

The injured employee had just finished delivering gas cylinders to a customer. As the employee was folding the lift gate on the truck to put it away, their left ring finger was pinched between the lift gate and the ramp resulting in amputation below the first knuckle.
An employee was taking out the trash at a worksite and suffered a suspected heart attack.
An employee was burning debris in an irrigation canal when he lost his balance and fell into the canal, which contained hot ash and burning weeds.  He was hospitalized with skin burns.
An employee was delivering mail on a rural route and fell on an icy surface after exiting the car. The employee sustained a fracture to the lower left leg.
A bike messenger was riding a bike to make a delivery. The bike slid on wet/icy pavement and the employee fell resulting in hospitalization for a broken ankle.

Three employees were running cans at an aerosol manufacturing plant. Some cans fell into the hot water bath and while unjamming several cans exploded. All three employees were injured. One employee sustained a laceration and bruising to the chest that resulted from a flying can and required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to unjam a punch press when it was activated via the foot pedal, causing the press to injure the employee's left hand. The employee suffered a left index finger amputation and crushed left ring finger. The press was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a forklift and staging 10" pipe on a concrete parking lot. The first joint of pipe was set down and the second joint was being retrieved when the first joint began to roll. The employee secured the forklift and went to stop the pipe from rolling, but was struck by the rolling pipe on the back of his leg. The employee fell and the pipe rolled up his leg. The employee suffered a broken foot.
An employee was on a ladder working on recessed lighting and was shocked. The employee also sustained a burn to the pinky finger.
An employee was walking to their car after work, slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee struck their head on the ground and suffered a concussion.

An employee was moving a converter dolly for a tandem trailer. While pushing the converter dolly, the employee felt a pop in his lower back, followed by severe pain. He was hospitalized with two bulging discs and a fractured vertebra.

An employee was attempting to free a stuck casting from the casting feeder hopper door. The employee sprayed lubricant on the casting and the casting freed from the door. The employee's right forearm was inside the casting feeder hopper door when the casting was freed and the door closed on and crushed his forearm.

On January 30, 2019, at approximately 4:27 PM, an employee was exiting his tractor-trailer at the truck stop, slipped on an icy L bracket on the truck and fell. He proceeded to disconnect the trailer. While cranking down on the legs of the trailer, which were frozen because of the temperature, he felt pressure and heard a pop. The employee was hospitalized for a hernia.

A lasher employee was injured by a fallen lasher rod that was approximately 8-10 feet in length and 1 1/2 inches in diameter. A second lasher employee was removing a container lasher rod on a top tier rack about 20 feet above ground level on a cargo vessel while the injured employee was working on the middle rack approximately 10 feet below the second lasher employee. The lasher rod popped out of the container corner casting and the second employee's hand and fell striking the injured employee on the left eyebrow and causing a laceration. Afterwards, the employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.

A delivery driver climbed into the back of a delivery truck to retrieve a hand truck. He slipped on ice/slush and fell off the back of the truck onto the hand truck. The employee fractured the left tibia/fibula and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was polishing a pipe with sandpaper. His right index finger was lodged in a hole in the pipe while it was turning and fractured. His finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken ankle after slipping and falling on snow and ice in the parking lot.
An employee was rolling a patient onto their side to provide care.  The employee pulled the draw sheet to help assist the patient with rolling and heard a pop in their back.
While conducting well servicing operations, an employee's right hand was caught on a spinning rod resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee had just completed mixing the ingredients and was dumping the mix into a tote.  The tote was placed under the ribbon blender and the two discharge doors were opened. The blender pushes the product out the discharge doors and into the totes. Towards the end of this process, the employee noticed a small pile of product inside the discharge door. She attempted to knock it into the tote, at which time, the blender rotated around and caught her right hand between the edge of the discharge door and the blender. She sustained crushing injuries to the hand and severe lacerations to the hand and index finger.



An employee was cleaning a mixer in the grinding room and suffered a finger laceration.

An employee was dismounting a stand-up forklift, lost his balance, and tripped catching his ankle between the forklift and a rack. The employee sustained two broken bones in his ankle and a laceration requiring stiches.

An employee was operating the metal machine to make metal roofing panels when a piece of metal got stuck in the machine. As he attempted to remove the metal piece, the employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee stepped off a powered pallet jack he was operating and the pallet jack coasted into him causing an open fracture on the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was manually maneuvering a steel coil weighing 1,320 lbs. from the storage area to the forks of his forklift when the steel coil fell onto him. The employee was hospitalized for bruises and lacerations and leg fractures.
An employee stepped onto a dump truck to check the load. As he was climbing down his ring finger was caught on the steps and lacerated.

An employee was performing maintenance on a wind turbine generator. Their jacket was caught on a turning gear pulling his right arm into the gears and causing a crushing injury and laceration to the right arm.

An employee was attempting to grab a soil sample when he slipped and his left hand was caught in the chain and sprocket of drilling equipment. He suffered a small finger amputation and two broken fingers.

An employee was changing out a battery with another employee. They were lifting the battery out of a forklift with a battery changer when the battery changer hit the injured employee's ankle and broke it. The injured employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were going to install a new building service line on an existing power pole. One of the employees climbed the pole when the pole broke at its base and fell on top of the employee. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung.
An inspector was at a private residence performing general job duties, slipped on snow and ice and fell breaking the left hip.

An employee was spreading pesticide around the perimeter of a customer's house and slipped on snow/ice. His foot got caught on a divot and his left leg twisted causing a fracture of the tibia and fibula.
An employee was fueling a tack distributor with gas when it suddenly caught fire on the burners. The employee received burns on his right hand.

On January 29, 2019, three employees were connecting rail cars using a forklift. While connecting the cars, the injured employee noticed the coupler was closed and reached in to open it. His right hand was crushed between the two couplers resulting in surgical amputation of the index, middle and ring fingers.
An employee was treating a patient when the employee tripped over a rolling machine and fell, suffering a left elbow fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a chop saw and was lacerated between his left thumb and forefinger.

An employee was installing a steel band to a pole when the band became loose and one side hit an energized conductor. An arc flash occurred, causing first degree burns to the employee's cheeks and neck and second degree burns to both ears.
An employee was making a delivery, slipped on ice and fell onto a customer's driveway. The employee suffered a fractured left hip.

An employee was driving a dead forklift being pushed by a second forklift when the second forklift's forks slipped and hit the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized due to crushed bones in the foot.

An employee was loading the rings into the furnace. The employee was steadying the load with one hand and operating the hoist with the other hand when the lifting device pinched the end of their left middle finger resulting in amputation of one-half inch.
An employee was operating a seated motorized pallet jack and struck a steel bollard causing a fracture to his left hip.

An employee was pouring drain cleaner from the manufacturer's bottle into a clogged floor drain when some of the solution splashed onto his face and into his left eye. He was hospitalized due to chemical burns.
An employee was bitten by a cat while restraining its legs for a vaccination. The bite became infected.
An employee was walking into another office when she tripped on a cord and hurt her left knee.

On January 30, 2019, two employees were loading boxes into the baler. Once the boxes were loaded, the gate was lowered and one of the employee's fingers was caught in a pinch point resulting in the amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was working in a trench (3' 10" deep by 6' wide) when the walls of the trench collapsed onto the employee's right leg, breaking it.

An employee was inspecting a slitting machine after set-up by using his right hand to check the tension on the roll bar. His cut-resistant gloves became caught in the tooling ring and pulled his fingers into the rings, resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee was found on the floor with a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

A trainee employee was connecting a propane hose to a cylinder tank when his hand hit the handle to open the valve. The propane hose came loose and the employee's jacket was soaked with the propane. The employee received propane burns on his left leg and ankle, his right wrist, and abdominal area.
On January 30, 2019, an employee was making a delivery when the employee slipped and fell on black ice, fracturing the left elbow.
An employee was working outside on a dock in zero-degree weather when he experienced numbness in all fingers on both hands. He was hospitalized with frostbite to fingers on both hands.
An employee was checking tractors in the freight yard when he slipped on the snow and fell fracturing his ankle.
An employee slipped and fell while exiting the cab of a roll-off truck, striking his face on the truck and dislocating his jaw.
An employee was disassembling a form tool when the form tool fell from an overhead crane and crushed the employee's left leg/foot. The employee's foot had to be medically amputated.

An employee was doing maintenance on the bottom part of a two-piece die. He then tried to install the top die but it was rotating. As he tried to stop it from rotating, his finger was caught between the arm of the die and the track, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was stepping off the shuttle bus, lost her footing and fell fracturing the right ankle.

On January 30, 2019, two employees were attempting to remove a nut from the bolt of a blow-out preventer (BOP) stack with a torque-n-test. The BOP stack was lifting 1-2" with the pick up line connected to the block when the rigging shifted and came down on one of the employee's left index finger severing it at the second knuckle.

An employee was moving the backside of a unit load device (ULD) to push out a container from an aircraft while another employee was pushing a different container. The employee's left foot was then caught between the side rail and the ULD. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left foot.

An employee was loading steel parts into a bending machine when the intake roller on the bending machine grabbed his glove and pulled his left hand into the roller, resulting in an amputation to his left index finger.

An employee was operating a hand held electric core drill to create a 2.5 inch hole through concrete to install refrigerant piping when the drill became bound in the concrete. It started to rotate, then threw him off the drill. The employee sustained a dislocated hip and was admitted to the hospital.
On 01/30/2019, at 0855, an employee was moving luggage from a cart to a belt loader when he twisted and felt his knee pop. He sustained a dislocated knee and torn ligaments.

An employee was attempting to load a shaft onto a flatbed truck using an overhead crane. The pull chain got stuck in the hook on the chain fall. The employee reached up to free the pull chain and his right ring finger was pinched between the chain on the overhead crane and the chain fall resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was securing a load on a trailer, slipped off the trailer and fell to the ground breaking the right radius and ulna.

On January 20, 2019, at approximately 10:30 PM, an employee was descending a rolling staircase after retrieving a vanity from a storage location, missed the bottom step and fell. The employee suffered a hip injury requiring surgery.
While working behind a cash register, an employee tripped on a rubber mat and fell to the ground, suffering a fractured hip.

An employee was directing a forklift operator from the top of a truck flatbed when the forklift pushed the trash box or skid pad, which caused the employee to fall from the flatbed to the ground. He suffered a fractured right arm.
An employee was rotating pallets of product on a forklift when he tripped over racks in the distribution area and fell to the same level, injuring his pelvis and back. He was hospitalized.
On 1/30/2019 an employee was feeding a railing into a chop saw and amputated his right thumb half-way through the nail.

An overnight team was stocking a store. A forklift driver was in the main lumber aisle and turned into a middle aisle to return to the receiving area, while the injured employee was standing nearby. The forklift driver ran over the tips of the injured employee's toes. He suffered two broken bones in his foot. Steel-toed boots were worn at the time of the incident.
An employee fell off a ladder and onto the ground while removing a car seat from the stock room storage. He fractured his pelvic bone.
An employee was attempting to secure material in the shear machine when the machine activated and amputated the left middle fingertip.

An employee was helping another employee guide a fuel line tubing through an idler wheel when the employee's finger was caught between the rotating wheel opening and a fixed frame. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was setting up a thermo-forming press and placing a shim while standing on a step stool. The employee slipped and inadvertently activated the press crushing his left thumb. He was hospitalized for surgery.

Two employees were loading a gas furnace with electrical connectors. They were near the controls to close the furnace door when an explosion occurred. They sustained second and third degree burns to the face, neck, and hands. One employee also sustained burns to the legs.

An employee was cleaning the egg processing machinery. The tool she was using to clean the machinery fell and her right hand contacted the rotating machinery resulting in amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was loading a coil in the metal stamping press when his left middle finger was caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation to his finger (distal portion).
An employee was operating a punch press when his finger was caught in the press, resulting in an amputation to his left index finger.
An employee was connecting a gooseneck trailer to a hitch when the employee's finger was caught and smashed between the trailer connector and hitch body, resulting in a surgical finger amputation.

An employee was delivering mail on her route.  She stepped out of her vehicle onto the edge of the black top road surface. She was on the edge of the road and on uneven ground when she fell and attempted to brace herself with her left hand. As a result, she fractured her left wrist in multiple places. She stood up and immediately passed out. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was retrieving a patient's chart when the employee tripped over an open file cabinet and fractured a shoulder.
An employee was tearing down a fence when the employee was hit on the head with a fence post, suffering a head injury.
An employee was taking plastic from a pallet jack wheel when the pallet jack amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was removing the ink from a printing press when her hand was pulled into the rollers, de-gloving her finger. Her fingertip had to be medically amputated.
An employee slipped on a mushroom and tried to break his fall by grabbing a small slicer machine. His left hand fingers were crushed by the machine, resulting in one finger being amputated.

An employee was working on a machine that crushes brass shells when a part became congested. He was attempting to remove it when the machine's conveyor belt caught his shirt and then his right arm. He was hospitalized with a fractured right arm.
An employee was injured due to carbon monoxide exposure from a gas heater.

An employee was filling a company vehicle with gas when her feet became entangled in the gas hose, causing her to fall and strike her right knee on the concrete. She sustained a fractured knee with a depressed bone, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee suffered an incarcerated hernia while lifting a patient out of a shower stall.

An employee was sweeping out the back of a trailer at a loading dock when the driver began to reposition the vehicle. The employee tried to exit the trailer onto the loading dock but missed and hit the ground, fracturing the right ankle, tibia, and fibula. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
On January 31, 2019, an employee was struck by a motor vehicle in the employer parking lot while walking from the building to her car. She sustained left lower leg and ankle fractures.

An employee was using a rag to clean rollers when the employee's glove became caught in the rollers, resulting in the amputation of two fingers. The rollers were unguarded at the time of the incident.

Two employees were attempting to fix leaks in a gasoline tank. When they went to heat up the area of the leaks to braze them closed, the gasoline fumes ignited from a small bucket under the tank. The fire burned the injured employee's arms and back, requiring hospitalization.
On January 31, 2019, an employee was opening a door while carrying a battery pack and a clipboard when he tried to catch the door and lost his balance. He then fell onto the floor and broke two ribs.
An employee was loading an ATV using a winch when the employee's right thumb was caught in the winch, resulting in a partial thumb amputation.

An employee was unloading a trailer full of packages with his co-workers while his left hand was resting on the rollers. His left ring finger was caught between the two rollers when his co-workers pushed back the roller section, resulting in the amputation of his left ring fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was changing the fluid flow through piping when an expansion joint on a pump failed, allowing chemical to contact the employee. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to the hand and legs.
An employee stood on a 2-foot square 4-inch high step to do a die change. The employee misstepped and fell to the floor, breaking the left hip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was conducting quality assurance on the packing line when a forklift ran over and crushed the employee's left foot.

An employee was working on door railings for rollers to a trailer when he slipped off a 6-foot A-frame ladder and then fell on the trailer floor, hitting his ribs. He then fell back and hit his face on the concrete surface below. He was hospitalized with neck and back injuries, requiring surgery.

An employee was lifting a magnet to put down on a conveyor when the magnet dropped onto the conveyor. The employee's fingertip was amputated (from the nailbed up) between the magnet and conveyor belt.

An employee was operating a trash bucket and had raised the bucket to open the side trap doors in order to scrape out debris when the handle that raises/lowers the bucket was struck. The bucket then came down and struck the employee in the face. The employee sustained eye socket damage to the right side and a broken jaw.

An employee was trying to put a cable back onto the pulley of a furnace door when his gloved left index finger was caught between the cable and the groove of the pulley. The cable tightened and the employee tried to pull his gloved hand out. At that time, the cable amputated his left index finger to the second knuckle.
An employee was opening the rear door of his semi-trailer when pallets of freight fell down on top of him, fracturing his left-side pelvis and T-12 vertebra.

An employee was using a grinding machine with a guard attached to grind on a bevel and prepare it for a welding seam. He was holding his tool with both hands when the grinding machine became stuck, kicked back, and cut the top of his left hand.
An employee was working on or near a machine when his hand was crushed between the machine's two rollers.
An employee was carrying installation material up a ladder onto a slate tile roof when the employee slipped on the roof and fell 10 to 12 feet to the ground, breaking an ankle.

An employee was unloading a box truck at a customer's home and was in the back of the trailer putting a thin plastic strap on the product to allow it to slide into the truck. The strap broke and the employee started to fall backwards. He tried to grab the door strap but fell out of the trailer onto the concrete ground on his back, suffering back and neck trauma.

An employee was setting up foil wrap on a new wrap machine. He reached into his back pocket with his right hand while his left hand remained in contact with the machine. His left hand then slid and contacted the blades of the running machine, resulting in a partial left middle fingertip amputation. The blades were guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to correct a rubber seal that had flipped upside down when a concrete panel shifted and crushed the employee's leg between it and another concrete panel. The employee suffered a left femur fracture and left knee laceration.

Three employees were working on the roof of a newly constructed residential home when the brace holding up the roof over the back patio gave way and the patio roof collapsed. The employees fell 21 feet and impacted the frozen ground. All three employees sustained multiple cuts, bruises and fractures to their lower extremities, specifically their feet and legs. Two of the three employees were hospitalized.

An employee was running a vertical milling machine. During the milling process, he was brushing away particles (swarf) near the cutting surface when his glove became caught while the mill was still cutting. The machine then pulled the glove and his left pinky fingertip from his hand, amputating it to the first knuckle.
An employee was walking when a forklift pushed the employee down and drove over his left foot. He was hospitalized with fractures to his left foot.

An employee was using the foot control while hand-feeding bed hook components into the point of operation on a 60-ton hydraulic press brake to emboss part numbers on each of the components. The employee's right index finger was in between the upper and lower dies when they came together, resulting in the partial amputation of the index fingertip.

An employee was delivering a pallet of forging material to a vendor. When he opened the rear door of the delivery truck, one piece of material weighing 456 pounds fell off the pallet and landed on him, bruising his arm.
An employee was inspecting a recirculation piping system when the rubber connector failed, releasing hot water onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized for burn injuries.

A dump truck tailgate was elevated, wedged, and would not work correctly. An employee tried to free the tailgate by removing a clump of clay when the tailgate came down and pinched his left middle and ring fingers, amputating them below the nail.

An employee was attaching rigging gear to steel joists during crane operations. When the load was lifted his foot was entangled in the tagline and the employee was lifted to a height of approximately eight feet. The employee freed himself and dropped to the ground fracturing his pelvis.
An employee tripped on a power cord while hanging drywall and fell down the stairs. The employee was hospitalized with back, neck, and rib injuries, as well as fractures to both wrists.
An employee working on a milling machine was replacing a chip transfer tube when his right index finger contacted the milling head, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was supervising as contractors erected a work-over rig on a drill site. As the floor of the work-over rig was being hoisted, a cable snapped, causing the floor to fall. When the floor struck the ground, it ejected the centerpiece of the floor, which struck the employee. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated his left thumb tip.

An employee was sanding a steel shaft on a lathe and performing maintenance when their glove was caught by the shaft pulling his right hand into the shaft and amputating the middle finger at the first joint below the finger nail.
An employee fell off an application spreader rig while washing a window and struck the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured cheek bone.
An employee was preparing to put a harrow on a tractor in order to clear ice off of the racetrack, when the employee slipped and fell on the ice sustaining multiple rib fractures.
An employee picked up material from a lower shelf, got back up, turned around, and lost balance and fell. The employee suffered a broken elbow.

A press crew was webbing up the press. A press operator was standing in the folder area when the ribbon started to crinkle. The operator was fixing the ribbon while the press was inching and his left index finger was pulled in by the diverter plate, amputating his left index fingertip.

An employee was troubleshooting a paving machine. He was cleaning the grease on the sprocket using a rag wrapped around his finger. The sprocket was running at the time and caught his hand and amputated the left middle finger.
An employee was stepping out of a truck when he slipped and fell off the steps and broke his femur.
An employee was loading a cardboard baler and caught their left middle finger between the baler and the cardboard resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.

On February 1, 2019, at approximately 4:45 a.m., an employee was feeding sheet plastic into an extruder-winder when his arm became caught in the machine. He sustained a fractured right arm requiring surgery.
As a forklift operator pulled onto a trailer, the trailer pulled away. The operator and forklift fell to the ground (42"), injuring the employee's back.

An employee was climbing down from the roof using a fixed ladder. About five feet from the ground, the employee lost footing and fell landing on his left hip. The employee sustained a hip injury requiring a pin and a sprained left wrist.
A machinist was setting up the inserting machine and his hand got caught on a clip causing injury to the hand that required surgery.

An employee had just started his shift in the pullet house and noticed a pullet chick caught in the feed chain end wheel. He attempted to retrieve it and his finger was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was lifting a metal coil wrap. The coil fell off a cart and struck his left leg and foot. The employee sustained amputation of the left leg.
An employee was reattaching a trailer hitch. The trailer dropped and crushed his hand resulting in the amputation to the knuckle of one finger and another fingertip amputation.
An employee was rolling casing down a pipe rack. The employee's thumbs were in a pipe when it fell off the rack, resulting in the amputation of both thumbs.

A maintenance employee was pulling on a belt while clearing a labeling jam. When it became free, it caught his fingers in the conveyor belt, amputating the end of his pinky finger and fracturing his ring finger.

An employee was loading fiberglass into a mold that was suspended from a hoist. The chain broke on the mold and it knocked the employee down. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a broken pelvis.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift out of a trailer when the truck pulled away. The forklift fell to the ground causing contusions to the employee's face and crushing injuries to the employee's leg that required surgery.
While clearing a machine jam, an employee suffered finger lacerations.
An employee was working on a catwalk when he slipped on ice and fell onto his side. He was hospitalized with a broken left hip.
An employee was working underneath a motor home installing a steering control when the motor home fell on him, crushing his pelvis, spine, and tailbone.

An employee was performing maintenance on a roof top unit and was either ascending or descending the roof hatch ladder when he lost his footing and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained broken eye sockets, a concussion, a fractured knee and internal bleeding.
While unloading a fork attachment for a front-end loader, an employee's finger became caught between a fork and the fork plate resulting in a partial amputation to the right middle finger.
An employee tripped and fell and sustained a broken arm and leg.

As an employee was climbing down from a ladder, the ladder began to slide and move. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below and sustained two fractured ribs, a broken radial bone on the left arm, and a broken left wrist.
The injured employee was outside the building talking to another employee. As the injured employee went to lean back on the railing, he fell onto his left side and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was driving a pallet jack down an aisle when it turned and pinned him to a rack resulting in a fractured leg/ankle.
An employee was cutting brush and trees. He stepped onto a tree stump, slipped and landed on a branch or small tree that caused a puncture wound requiring hospitalization.
An employee was traveling down a road on a four-wheeler. While he was avoiding an oncoming semi truck, the four-wheeler rolled over and landed on top of him. He suffered a broken leg and wrist.
An employee was visiting a residence when they slipped and fell in the driveway sustaining a fractured ankle.

An employee was loading a lift onto a trailer. As the employee attempted to drive past the hinge point, the lift lost traction and slid off the back of the elevated beaver tail ramp. The employee's chest struck the operator control panel breaking ribs and his sternum.
An employee had been loading furniture into a customer's rented box truck.  As the employee stepped down from the truck, they felt a pull/pain in the pelvic region.

An employee was standing on a pipe trailer to disconnect cabling from a pipe that had just been loaded. While reaching to disconnect the cabling, the employee lost footing and fell 7 to 8 feet from the trailer to the ground. The employee landed on the right hip, causing fractured vertebrae in the lower back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was shutting the dock door and her right foot became tangled in the rope used to close the door causing her to lose balance and fall to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right tibia and fibula.

An employee was standing on a drilling rig when a piece of guarding fell from the tower and struck the employee's head, causing a contusion to the left eye, a laceration to the cranium, and fractures to cervical vertebrae and the left scapula.

The injured employee was talking to another employee as corrugated sheets were being fed into a press brake on the back side. The injured employee placed his left hand under the die and the press was activated resulting in amputation of the left hand.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when her foot was caught between a pallet and the jack resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when his right hand slipped against the blade resulting in partial amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was struck by a motorist while installing a temporary traffic control pre-warning sign. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and a ruptured bladder.

On February 1, 2019, around 11:00 a.m., an employee was troubleshooting a unit at the mill. He was removing the wet coal from the feeder wheel using a three-foot flat steel bar and the bar got caught in the rotating wheel. The employee attempted to pull the bar out and pinched his right middle finger between the bar and the inspection port housing resulting in a laceration and broken bone that required surgery to repair. It later required surgical amputation.
An employee was walking behind a telehandler all-terrain forklift when the forklift ran over the employee and crushed both legs.
Sometime between 8:00 and 9:00 AM, on 02/02/2019, an employee was walking behind a telehandler when it struck him and his legs were crushed.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when the machine's gears amputated three fingers.

An employee was carrying laundry down to the basement when the stair railing gave way and she fell down 12 steps. She was hospitalized with a subdural hematoma, fractured left thumb, contused forehead, compression fracture to the C7 vertebra, fractured right humerus, abrasion to the buttock, and contused right thigh.
On February 2, 2019, an employee's fingers and thumb tip were amputated while operating a radial saw.
On 02/02/2019 a ski instructor was manning the finish line of a race when he was struck by a racer. He was hospitalized with lacerations to the thigh.

An employee had jacked up a car to change the front driver's side tire. While loosening the rim from the rotor, the car fell off the jack and struck the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the left shoulder and head.
An employee fell off a stool and sustained a right eye socket fracture.
An employee was working with a patient who became combative and tried to lock her out of a room. The employee's finger was pinched in the door jamb, and the tip was amputated.
An employee was working from a mobile scaffold and vacuuming the ceiling in order to prepare it for paint. The employee fell approximately 15-18 feet to the concrete floor and suffered a head injury.
An employee was overcome by the smell from a kitchen and vomited, becoming dehydrated. The employee was hospitalized.
There was a fire in the foam department. An employee knocked over a bucket of acetone which splashed onto his clothes. The clothes ignited and the employee was burned.
An employee was cleaning out glass fibers in a small channel that houses a cutting blade on a cutting machine and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking to her vehicle, slipped or tripped and fell in the parking lot breaking a hip. The injury required surgery to repair.
On February 4, 2019, an employee's right index finger was caught in a pipe bending or tube bending machine and partially amputated.

An employee was blowing down a vessel through a stinger pipe that was pointing up. As he reached with his right hand and opened the ball valve to release pressure, the stinger pipe swung to the left and struck his left elbow, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was pulling pipe from a hole using a drill machine. A weld broke and the pipe struck the employee's face breaking the right cheek bone.

An employee had been driving in the middle of a bad snowstorm when he was notified to go home. He walked over to the passenger side of the truck, climbed up the side to grab his belongings, slipped, and fell to the ground, landing on and breaking his left ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking toward the locker room when he slipped and fell on his right side, twisting his leg and resulting in a fracture.

An employee was performing maintenance on a docked ship. The employee was descending a ladder and then stepped off the ladder and then fell 6 feet off a mezzanine. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower left leg.

An employee was helping to fabricate a new catwalk when a metal burr went through the employee's glove and into the palm of his right hand, leaving a sliver. He removed the sliver, but the next day his hand and arm became swollen due to an infection. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was walking to his car in the company parking lot and fell. The employee suffered a possible concussion and loss of teeth.
An employee was performing evening kennel rounds and walking dogs. The employee was knocked down to the concrete floor by a dog and suffered a broken hip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot and was hospitalized with a broken ankle.

An employee was repairing the overhead dry and shine automatic towel dryer of the car wash when it fell onto the employee. The employee sustained severe head and facial fractures and lacerations including a broken jaw and teeth. 

The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into the store and was struck by a car. The employee suffered a head injury.

An employee was opening a 15' wide by 20' tall manual overhead door using the pull chain. While using the pull chain to the pulley and sprocket, a spring mechanism fell and struck him on the head. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and a cracked C1 vertebrae.
An employee operating a forklift in reverse when their left leg was caught between the stand up tow motor and the racking system resulting in a fractured left tibia.

An employee was servicing a pump and was struck by a 10 or 12-inch pressure hose that blew off piping at an adjacent job site. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a broken collar bone and a back injury.
An employee was cutting plywood/particle board on a table saw. The board jumped causing the employee's right hand to slip into the blade resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

A material handler from Remedy Intelligent Staffing was using a forklift to load 95-pound rectangular tubing (4 feet long, 4 inches high, and 6 inches wide) onto a cantilever rack. He got off of the forklift to push the metal tubes onto the rack when one of the tubes fell between the cantilever arms and his right middle finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was unloading countertops from a pallet. After the banding was cut, some of the countertops slid off the pallet and hit the employee's left foot, causing a broken left ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was lifting a part with a hoist. As the part was being elevated, the employee's finger was caught between two parts causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was inside a crane positioned on top of a sink hole when the crane tipped over. The employee jumped out of the cab and suffered a hairline fracture to his right leg.
An employee was accessing a roof hatch from a fixed ladder and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. One ankle was broken and the other ankle was injured.
An employee was cutting paper with a paper cutter when the cutter slipped and amputated the employee's left thumb tip.
An employee was taping/finishing drywall when he miss-stepped and fell, breaking his wrist.

On February 4, 2019, an employee was removing a sheet of aluminum from a pile of aluminum (~ 4 feet x 10 feet) when the aluminum sheets fell on the employee. The employee was pushed into a rack and pinned. Both legs were broken just under the knee caps.
An employee was troubleshooting an insulation saw and caught their left ring finger in the belt and pulley. The fingertip was amputated including most of the fingernail area.
An employee was struck in the abdomen by a skid steer.

An employee was felling a tree. Part of a tree that was leaning on the tree the employee was felling fell onto the employee causing a concussion, cracked vertebrae, a cracked rib, broken teeth and a broken femur.
An employee was operating a table saw when his left hand contacted the blade, cutting his hand and fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to their vehicle, slipped on ice and fell hitting their head. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee was using the dock ramp at the facility where he was delivering product when drinks fell under the ramp. When the employee attempted to retrieve them, the ramp moved and pinched his finger causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift to move reinforcing steel spirals and backed into a parked flatbed trailer. As the employee tried to free the forklift from the trailer his left hand was crushed between the forklift and the trailer. The employee's hand was fractured and lacerated and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a fingernail avulsion as he was checking a cable he had replaced on a golf cart.

On February 5, 2019, an employee was operating a cutter machine to cut hooks when a hook became jammed inside the cutter. She stopped the machine on the control panel and attempted to remove the jammed hook. As she was unjamming the machine, the control panel was reactivated and the cutting blade contacted her finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was servicing a fan belt and pulley when the belt shifted and amputated the employee's right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was helping to unload metal sheet panels from a truck. A panel sat on a piece of wood and the wood broke crushing the employee's right pinky, ring and middle fingers.
An employee was walking when her pant leg became caught on a tote and she fell to the floor. She required surgery for a dislocated shoulder.
An employee slipped on an icy sidewalk while delivering mail and fractured the right ankle.

An employee was using a chain hoist to position a pipe to be welded when the chain caught a valve on the existing pipe and opened the valve, releasing hot water on the employee. He suffered burns to the right arm (from his forearm to his bicep) and right torso (from the ribs to the stomach).

An employee was working to repair an 1,800-pound tubing guide. When the employee disassembled a bolt on one side, the gooseneck tipped over, partially pinning and striking the employee's lower right leg. The employee suffered a fractured lower right leg.
An employee came down from a two-step stepstool and fell, injuring her knee on the floor.

The employee was riding a horse, sorting cattle. Due to ice and mud, the horse slipped and fell on top of employee's left leg and shoulder. The employee suffered a rotator cuff dislocation of the left shoulder and a muscle injury to the left leg.
An employee fell from a ladder and fractured the left ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee was hooking up a trailer onto a pickup truck when he stepped on a pygmy rattlesnake, which bit him on his right shin. He was hospitalized.

Employees were installing trusses and were tied off to a truss when a crane with another truss struck the truss where the employees were tied off. The employees and the truss fell and suffered injuries requiring hospitalization. One employee suffered a fractured skull. The second employee fractured ribs.
An employee was observing the closing of the coker drum. Their right index finger was pinched when the coker drum closed causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was putting pipe stoppers into a casing block and then onto a pipe rack when one of the casings came loose and rolled onto his right hand, smashing it and requiring hospitalization. The casing was 36 feet long and weighed 20 pounds per foot.
An employee was walking alongside a walkie rider pallet jack when the pallet jack turned and struck the employee's left leg resulting in an ankle fracture.

An employee was stepping off a reach lift truck when the employee's foot was caught between the truck and a post, fracturing the foot and requiring hospitalization. The lift truck had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.
An employee was feeding wire into a drawing machine when the wire caught the employee's left hand, resulting in the amputation of the employee's middle and ring fingertips.

Two employees were removing a skid strapped to the wall of a trailer. One employee cut the strap while the other employee held the skid. The skid fell onto the injured employee after the retaining strap was removed, resulting in leg fracture.
An employee was driving a forklift down an aisle when it slid into a rack. The rack entered the forklift compartment and broke his left foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down the stairs, tripped and fell hitting her head on the door at the bottom of the stairs. The employee sustained a laceration under her left eye and a head injury.
An employee was going down the stairs when she fell and broke her ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working from a ladder to remove ductwork from the ceiling. He snipped a hanger on one end at the joint and the duct joint gave way, causing the ductwork to drop at one end and swing back, striking the ladder at the base. This knocked the ladder out from under him, and he fell to the floor, landing on his hands and knees at an angle. He broke his arm, fractured his elbow, and hurt his knee.

An employee was carrying a 10-pound box of aluminum  parts when he fell backwards to the concrete floor. He struck his tailbone and then his head, suffering a fracture to the tailbone and a laceration to the head.
On February 5, 2019, an employee's middle and ring finger tips were amputated while retrieving a part from a stamping press.
An employee was stomping on boxes to break them down when she fell to the floor and broke both wrists.
An employee was carrying a box up on a track ladder when she lost her balance and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing her right hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a rope out of a tree and fell backwards onto the ground fracturing his ankle.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a hip fracture.

A maintenance employee was making adjustments to the measurements on a tube laser. The employee was inside the inter-lock doors when the machine started up. The employee was struck in the torso by the machine arm and suffered ruptured intestines and internal bleeding.

The employee was assisting to load parts onto a sorting table. An attachment to the forklift tub is filled with parts that are dumped on the sorting table. The forklift operator had just rolled over half a tub onto the sorting table. When the employee was removing a rollover bar from the bin, it broke free and came out of the bin. The tub shifted on the forklift forks and fell over landing on the employee's shoulder, ribs and hip area. The employee sustained three broken ribs and a lumbar hernia.

An employee was pushing steel scrap with one hand into a container when a finger was pinched between a piece of scrap metal and the edge of a metal bar railing amputating the fingertip. The employee was wearing gloves at the time.
An employee was throwing debris into a dumpster. As the employee was throwing a pole into the dumpster, it bounced back and struck his left arm fracturing it.
An employee left his vehicle and was walking to the office when he slipped on ice and fell. He was hospitalized with a dislocated and broken elbow, requiring surgery.
An employee was activating a coding machine when its chain and sprocket caught his right hand, resulting in the amputation of the distal joint of his right middle finger.
An employee was using a 9-step ladder to pack down dryer ducts. As she was descending the ladder, she missed the bottom step and fell, breaking her ankle.

An employee was helping tear up an old carpet when he received a minor cut on his left hand between the thumb and the index finger. He was hospitalized the next morning, suffering from blood poisoning.
An employee was using shears when his hand got close to the shears, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was moving equipment and caught their leg between the equipment and a wall.
An employee was lubricating the towel folder and got his right hand caught between the chain and sprocket resulting in a laceration that required surgery.
On February 5, 2019, an employee fell to the ground while exiting or entering his vehicle in a parking lot. He suffered broken bones in his leg/ankle.

An employee was working on an exhaust fan from an A-frame ladder. As the employee was attempting to pry the exhaust fan, the ladder twisted and the employee fell approximately 8 feet. The employee suffered a concussion and back injuries.
An employee was descending a jobsite-made ladder when he slipped and fell, breaking his right ankle.
On February 5, 2019, at approximately 12:10 a.m., a housekeeping employee was walking in the facility parking lot to their vehicle when the employee slipped on ice and fell, fracturing the right hip.

A maintenance technician was using a pallet jack to move blast doors when his right middle finger was caught in the pinch point created by the moving pallet jack handle resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.

An employee was preparing a line for maintenance work. The line contained a combination of propane and hydrofluoric acid. He was hooking up the hose to the valve to put a vacuum on the line and pull out the remaining chemicals. Before he could place the hose on the valve, residual chemicals came out and splashed his legs, causing skin burns. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a fractured right fibula while uninstalling recording equipment from a military vehicle.
When a machine cycled, the tongs inside it whiplashed and struck an employee on the right side, by the ribcage.

An employee was reversing a forklift truck down an inclined and elevated driveway when the forklift fell upright off the elevated driveway, which was approximately 16 inches above level ground. The employee's right hand was crushed between the cab of the forklift and a guardrail post, breaking the right middle finger and tearing tendons.

An employee was standing near a winch truck that was being used to pull out a workover rig that was stuck in the mud. The winch cable was hooked to a cross member on the rig. The winch truck driver attempted to pull on the rig and the cross member welding broke. The cross member swung around and struck the employee's chest. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, and a ruptured spleen.

An employee was removing a storefront sign using an 8-foot step ladder. While descending the ladder, the employee slipped and fell backwards, hitting the sidewalk with the back of his head. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 6, 2019, an employee was loading a jack into a manual press and attempting to secure it when the jack leg fell and struck the back of his head. He suffered a concussion.
An employee was run over by a forklift resulting in severe leg injuries.

Employees were terminating cables at a job site. The electrical room was locked out and all grounds were applied. 
The employees had finished the task and were grabbing their tools.  As they were walking out, an arc flash occurred and caused burns to the injured employee's right hand and face.

An employee was performing maintenance repairs on a packing machine when the vertical clamping mechanism activated and partially amputated his right thumb. The safety guard was disengaged at the time of the incident.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a collapsed lung.
An employee was working with a heavy motor when the employee slipped. The employee's hand was then caught in a bolt hole, resulting in a partial phalangeal amputation to the left middle finger.
While accessing an electrical junction box, an employee suffered burns and lacerations to the left- and right-hand fingertips.
An employee slipped on an icy exterior sidewalk and fell to the ground, breaking the right hip.

An employee was walking in a crosswalk between the building and parking lot when the employee was struck by a moving private vehicle. The employee suffered a spinal fracture, L2 process fracture, facial and arm lacerations, and a concussion.
An employee bent over to pick up a part off the floor and felt a pull in the lower back.  When he stood up, he felt a lot of pain. He was hospitalized with two bulging discs.
An employee slipped on ice while stepping out of her car, suffering a fracture and a torn ligament in the right foot.

At about 6:50 p.m. on February 6, 2019, an employee was on top of a generator enclosure, getting ready to clean it in preparation for painting. He fell through a 4-foot by 7-foot opening whose plywood cover slid, landing on the concrete floor about 12 feet below and fracturing both heels. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a left middle fingertip amputation while operating a production machine. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the company parking lot while walking into the office. She hit her head, suffering a subdural hematoma and a concussion.
An employee was loosening nuts and bolts on the engine of a drill rig when his finger was caught between a drive belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was monitoring a dipping operation through an observation window on the closed door of a hot dip galvanizing kettle. Zinc spattered from the kettle, entering the top of the employee's boot and causing a third-degree burn to his left heel. Personal protective equipment was being worn at the time of the incident, but pants were tucked into boots.

An employee was trying un-stop a conditioner on an extruder with a shovel when the shovel became caught in the machine and pushed his thumb against the conditioner housing. The tip of his right thumb was amputated between the nail and knuckle.

An employee was operating a forklift to move product inside a warehouse when the forklift struck a support pole. The employee then fell to the concrete floor while exiting the forklift, fracturing his left femur.

An employee was trying to close the trailer door at a dock. The dock plate was not operating correctly. When the dock plate released, it caught the employee's right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.

At about 8:45 p.m. on February 6, 2019, an employee was operating a blow bagger. The employee noticed that the blender, which is operated in close proximity to the bagger, no longer had material flowing from the valve. The employee was investigating this issue and amputated his left hand in the rotating blade in the valve.

An employee was modifying a weaving machine to run a new type of fiberglass product. A bolt dropped before the machine's guards had been replaced; as the employee was retrieving it, his right hand was caught in the belt and pulley system and his right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was lifting the gate on a cargo truck. The lift gate became stuck, so the employee attempted to loosen it. The gate jolted, and his middle finger was caught between the gate and truck, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was feeding fig bars onto a line/conveyor belt. The employee was walking along the conveyor belt line to address a jam when the employee tripped on the leg of a chair and fell to the ground, fracturing an ankle.

An employee was part of a team unloading material from a truck. The employee was waiting for the forklift to pick up the next crate when the crates fell over due to a gust of wind. The fallen crates (weighing approximately 1,500 pounds) pinned the employee's leg to the truck bed. He was hospitalized with a broken right leg and required surgery.
An employee was attempting to spin the wheel on a car when his finger was caught between the caliper and the wheel, resulting in a right middle finger amputation.
An employee was aligning a pipe. The steel pipe slipped and struck the employee's left leg and fractured the tibia and fibula.
An employee was core drilling concrete when the drill bit became stuck, causing the drill to spin out from underneath the employee's feet. The employee then suffered a fractured femur.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw. The piece of wood kicked back and his hand came into contact with the saw blade. He suffered amputations to the middle and index fingers of his left hand.
An employee was walking in the kitchen when her foot was caught on a drain, causing her to slip and fall. She fractured her left femur.

An employee was removing a piece of cardboard that was on top of a pallet and underneath a spring hanger when the spring hanger shifted, causing his left ring finger to be caught between two spring hanger parts. His left middle fingertip was amputated with bone loss. Cut-resistant gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

After a manifold trailer had been pressure-tested to 3,000 psi, a Renegade employee bled it off to 1,200 psi. The accumulator broke and struck the employee's face under pressure, causing lacerations inside and outside the mouth. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to move a power pole. The aerial crane carrying the pole made contact with 7,200-volt power lines, and the employee suffered first and second degree electrical burns to the right foot.
An employee slipped on ice while walking between a vehicle and a patient's home. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured kneecap.

An employee received a shock and subsequently dislocated his shoulder. Two other employees were investigating why the employee was shocked when an arc flash occurred and the two employees were burned; one employee was hospitalized due to second degree burns.

An employee was working on a vertical lathe when a part became dislodged during the machining process and struck the lathe door, which then pushed the employee. He lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking a leg.
While on a ladder picking oranges, an employee came into contact with a power line and suffered electrical burns.

On February 7, 2019, a dump truck an employee was driving broke down and was placed on a flatbed. The dump truck driver climbed onto the flatbed and inside the truck cab to retrieve his lunch box and upon climbing down he fell to the ground below and struck his head. The employee was hospitalized for a head laceration requiring stitches.
An employee was torch-cutting a flatbed railcar when he was showered with sparks and pieces of slag that penetrated his flame-resistant coat, causing severe burns to his left-side abdomen.
An employee was performing maintenance on a plastic compression molding machine and suffered the partial amputation of the right thumb. The machine was not guarded or locked-out at the time.
An employee was working in the warehouse when a pallet of cauliflower fell from a shelving unit onto the employee's head.

On 2/7/19, an employee was exiting the building to go to her vehicle when the wind blew the papers in her hand. She went to reach for them and lost her balance, tripped, and fell to the ground, fracturing her left wrist.

An employee was standing on the top of concrete forms, which were part of the setup for the basement walls of a new house under construction. The employee was directing the flow of concrete into the forms. The hose from the concrete pumper truck moved unexpectedly as a result of a clog in the hose and knocked the employee to the ground in the interior of the basement. The employee suffered minor vertebrae fractures.
On February 7, 2019, at 3:16 p.m., an employee slipped and fell on the sidewalk while walking to the employee's vehicle. The employee sustained a hip injury.

An employee was standing on the second floor balcony of a multistory home at a construction site. The employee was leaning over the rail, lost his balance, and fell to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and a bruised right shoulder.
An employee was changing a belt on a machine that had been locked out when the employee's hand slipped and was caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a right pinky finger amputation.

A crew was using a crane to lift a section of sheet piling with a chain and clamp lifting device. While the injured employee was guiding the load with a guide line, the clamp malfunctioned and released the load. The sheet pile fell to the ground and over striking the injured employee causing him to fall to the ground resulting in a dislocated hip, a laceration to the eye, and a fractured jaw bone.

On February 7, 2019, an employee was operating a hoist controller to remove chain slack during hook storage. The employee's left hand held the hoist chain in place while the hook was secured to an I-beam. The employee attached the hoist hook to the storage bar and tightened the slack so the hook would not swing. While tightening the slack, the employee's left little finger was caught between the hoist chain and the I-beam, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking on top of rebar reinforcement that was part of a new bridge construction site to measure a bid well motor.  As he moved from one location to another, he tripped, fell and fractured the left wrist. 

The employee was transported to the hospitalized for  surgery.
A sheave cable fell from the rig and struck an employee's hand causing a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was changing out the insulator on a buswork at a substation. An energized lightning arrester shocked the employee, causing burns to the left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
A spotter truck driver fell after opening a trailer door in a parking lot. He broke his left wrist and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was working to remove the side forms from a 72" bulb tee line. He was unhooking the forms from a jack using lifting devices and steel pins. As he pulled the pin from the lifting device with his right hand, he attempted to push the pin with his left hand. His left index finger then entered the hole on the form brackets. The jack operator then lifted the device from the form, catching the employee's left index finger in the hole on the bracket. He suffered a left index fingertip amputation just below the first joint.
On 2/07/2019, an employee was carrying two bulletin boards out an exit door when the employee tripped and fell on a mat outside the door. The employee fell to the concrete and fractured the left hip.
An employee was on a roof, putting material near a chimney for work later that day. He slipped and fell off the roof, injuring his left lower leg above the ankle. He was hospitalized.
While loading orders from a warehouse, an employee was caught between a stand-up tugger and a 5-S board. The employee's right femur was broken.
While cleaning a pool cover, an employee slipped and fell twice, suffering a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing ice from the ropes used to pull power lines through a traveler. The grip broke and the rope pulling the cable through the roller pulled the employee's right hand into the traveler, breaking some bones and tearing the carpal tunnel ligament.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the concrete sidewalk, breaking his left kneecap and fibula.
An employee was cutting a piece of trim when it kicked back. His hand came into contact with the saw blade, causing an amputation to his left thumb.
A gust of wind blew a fence onto an employee, injuring his back.
While building furniture, an employee suffered a smashed finger. The finger became infected, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee felt faint so she grabbed racking. She fell over and hit her head on the shelving or ground.
An employee was climbing an 8-foot A-frame ladder to work on bolted ceiling blocks. He slipped and fell from the ladder to the floor, breaking his wrist and suffering a brain hematoma.
