An employee was picking up a man lift from a job site. He was operating the lift inside the man basket and driving it up onto his truck. About halfway up the truck's ramp, the lift lost traction, slid off the ramp, and tipped over. The employee was tied off inside the basket and the fall was approximately 3 to 4 feet to the pavement. He suffered a fractured left femur and dislocated right shoulder, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On February 7, 2019, an employee was operating an egg flat washing machine. The employee was attempting to unload the washed egg flats when the employee's left middle finger was caught in a chain driven by a sprocket that moved the egg flats along the conveyor through the machine. The employee suffered a left middle finger amputation.
A service technician was working on a rooftop heating/AC unit. The technician slipped on ice and snow and fell from the roof to the ground, suffering a crushed vertebra in the lower back.

An employee was standing on top of a 10-foot ladder platform, prying loose a form panel, when the panel fell and struck the foot of the ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and suffered a dislocated right wrist and fractured finger.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, breaking his left ankle.
An employee was splashed in the face with sodium hydroxide while repairing a transfer pump, suffering chemical burns to the face.
An employee fell while tracking individuals, breaking the left fibula and tearing ligaments.
An employee fell to the floor while working at a cash register, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was forming parts on a press brake. While he was pulling out a part, the machine activated and smashed his left ring and middle fingertips, causing amputation injuries.
On 02/07/19, at approximately 11:45 AM, an employee lost control of a forklift. She attempted to brace herself with her left hand, which struck a desk and was lacerated.
An employee was working in a walk-in freezer, unloading boxes onto a cart, when a box of muffins fell on her head. She was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was repairing a forklift when a fork fell and injured the employee's right leg.
An employee was retracting a truck-mounted winch cable when his right index finger was caught between the cable and a lever. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was organizing flattened boxes by picking them up and stacking them on the floor. She picked up a few boxes and began to walk to the other side when she tripped over a plastic packaging strap that was laying on the floor and broke her left arm.

An employee was lifting a steel screen on a vertical boring machine. The screen got caught on a fixture and the employee's hands were caught between the screen and a rail. The employee suffered a fractured left hand and a fractured right thumb. The employee's right index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was stepping over branches lying on a sidewalk. The employee slipped and twisted her knee resulting in a torn ACL in the right leg.

An employee of Complete Environmental Remediation delivered material to a landfill where a  landfill employee was operating a track hoe. When the employee got out of his truck along with his assistant to cover the truck and prepare to return to the office, he was struck by the bucket of the track hoe in the shoulder, neck and jaw areas.
An instructor contracted MRSA through an abrasion on his right knee from bacteria on the padded mats used by personnel during training.

An employee was preparing to hook a chain to a broken, wooden light pole laying on the ground.  A backyard machine tipped over and the boom attachment fell onto the employee. The employee sustained a lacerated spleen, a fractured back, a crushed diaphragm, multiple broken ribs and internal bleeding.
An employee was operating a stamping die and crushed his fingers in the machine resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was repairing a roll-up door from an aerial lift. The lift basket suddenly dropped. The employee was admitted to the hospital with nerve damage to their shoulder, back, hip and a foot.

An employee was working in the heading department near a molder and dropped a hand warmer into the conveyor belt. The employee attempted to retrieve the warmer and suffered a partial amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a cutting machine and suffered the partial amputation of a middle finger.
An employee was stepping on a shelf while reaching for product and fell five feet. The employee sustained an ear laceration and a head contusion.
An employee was walking to the front door, slipped on ice and fell to the ground resulting in injury to their left side.
An employee was walking from his car to the nursery entrance and was bitten by a stray dog resulting in the loss of a thumb tip.

An employee was operating a galvanized kettle machine. As he was adjusting the chain link, his right arm slipped and contacting the scalding hot water. The employee was hospitalized for second-degree burns.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell striking their head on the ground.

An employee was installing chains in the lifting lugs of the transformer to secure the transformer to the trailer. The employee fell from the top of the transformer and sustained a concussion, fractured ribs, a broken clavicle, and a punctured lung all on the left side.

An employee was in an aerial lift connecting a wire to a pipe inside the warehouse. When he raised the lift, his right arm contacted an overhead rotating ceiling fan blade causing a laceration and fracture to right arm/elbow.

An employee opened the right door of a 53-foot trailer loaded with plastic bulkheads and empty 1/6 barrels. As the employee started to open the door, the weight from the shifted cargo pushed the door open causing the employee to fall approximately four feet to the ground. Some of the cargo fell on top of him as well. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left hip and bruising to his left elbow.

An employee was struck by a hatch lid due to over-pressurization of a void tank. This caused the employee to fall approximately 12-14' to the dry dock floor below resulting in broken ribs, a bruised brain and bruised vertebrae.

On February 8, 2019, at approximately 8:30 AM an employee was cutting a 3" pipe with a bandsaw.  While cutting, the pipe spun and hit the employee's left thumb area resulting in a laceration and a fracture.

The injured employee was assisting coworkers to set a fiberglass wall inside a trench. The injured employee had his hand on the wall when the wall shifted and pinched his finger between it and another section of already placed wall. His right middle finger was amputated behind the nail at the first knuckle.

An employee was changing a razor blade on his non-retractable utility knife. He put the knife down on the ground and removed his glove. As he began removing a plastic strip on the bottom of the sheetrock his hand brushed against the knife and lacerated his index finger.
On February 8, 2018, employee was cutting plastic material with a metalworking shear when the machine amputated the tip of his right ring finger. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a torch to cut a weld on an semi-trailer truck when the employee's coat caught on fire. The employee suffered burns to his chest and back and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a concrete ramp carrying carpet and fell. The employee sustained an arm fracture that required surgery.

A crew was dismantling a hoist on the exterior of a building when one of the turnbuckle ties snapped at the eye where it was bolted into the mast. The mast which weighs approximately 100 lbs. and measures approximately 10.5 feet swung down approximately 4-5 feet and struck an employee on the back of his head.  The employee was hospitalized with skull fractures and hemorrhaging.
An employee was walking from the company truck to the worksite, slipped on mud and fell resulting in a broken right ankle.
A custodian was found at the bottom of a stairwell. The employee sustained multiple fractures.
An employee was painting a trailer from an A-frame ladder. The ladder shifted and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken left ankle and right heel. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 8, 2019 an employee was checking the airflow in the aluminum chip collector on a saw when a right fingertip was removed by a flapper.
After a roll change, an employee was scooping up waste paper when his left hand was caught in a conveyor on the newspaper press, resulting in a de-gloving injury and hospitalization.
On February 9, 2019, an employee received multiple concussions after tripping over a chair and falling at the nurse station. The employee struck her head on the coat/shoe rack.
An employee was working on a section of roof when the chain saw kicked back and cut the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 9, 2019, an employee was operating an abrasive blasting tool when the pressurized media hit the employee in the knee. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking down the sidewalk, tripped and fell forward resulting in injuries to her mouth and a forehead abrasion. The employee was hospitalized and had four teeth removed.

An employee was attempting to remove remelt aluminum for a sow mold as it was not full. Ice on the piece of scrap metal he was using caused the molten metal to pop and splash onto his left wrist and the right side of his face, causing first- and second-degree burns. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.

A crew was investigating a leak on the side of a road. The injured employee was walking back to his truck when he was struck by a passing vehicle. He suffered a leg fracture. The employee was wearing his high-visibility vest at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell breaking the left leg.
An employee slipped on ice and fell breaking an ankle.
An employee was cutting palm trees and two thorns got stuck in his left hand.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk and was struck by a car resulting in a head laceration and broken leg bones.

An employee was removing an idler roll from a lathe using a hoist. The idler roll was rigged using a single nylon web strap that was attached to the idler roll with a choker hitch. When the idler roll was lifted, one end of the idler roll dropped. The employee reached out to catch the roll and the tip of his left little finger was crushed between the idler roll (200 lbs.) and the lathe. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was restocking the ice cream bar and lifting boxes from a lower level to table height and was hospitalized for a back strain.
An employee was loading a railcar. While loading the last coil the band broke and struck the employee. The employee was knocked down and sustained an elbow injury.
While discharging bundled pipe, an employee fell into a hole caused by the pipe shifting in transit.  The employee suffered a fractured right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder when the ladder broke and the employee fell to the floor resulting in a broken leg.
At approximately 4:30 p.m. there was an explosion and fire while starting up a unit at a refinery. One employee was burned on the face.
An employee was struck by a forklift causing left foot fractures.
An employee was being trained to operate a forklift. The forklift collided with a storage rack and the employee's left foot was lodged between the forklift and the rack.
An employee slipped and fell on ice breaking a leg in two places.
While walking into the building an employee slipped on ice and fell suffering a possible leg fracture.

An employee was replacing a battery on a sporting clay machine out on the ranch when the sporting clay arm unexpectedly energized and hit the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized for swelling in the brain.
An employee was cleaning the hopper on a roll making machine and lacerated their hand and fingers when the machine was energized.
A driver was stepping out of his truck when he slipped and fell on snow and ice. He lacerated his arm and was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately three feet from a step ladder.
An employee was cleaning a spill off of racking, tripped over their fall protection and fell breaking an ankle.

On February 11, 2019, at 1:30 p.m., a journeyman mechanic was performing a diagnostic test on a tractor (truck). While standing inside the engine bay of the truck between the frame and the left steer tire axel, the vehicle started and the truck moved forward pinning the employee under the steer tire. The employee's upper leg was crushed and the hip and ankle were fractured.
On February 11, 2019, an employee was working on a machine pinched their left index finger  between the top of the machine and the punch resulting in amputation.
An employee was on a residential property collecting electrical meter readings, slipped on icy grounds and fell fracturing her left foot. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was putting a basket into a dryer using a hoist. The lid came down on his right hand causing a laceration with exposed bone and tendon.
An employee was operating a milling machine when their glove was caught in the machine resulting in amputation of a thumb.
A home health aide was leaving a grocery store when she slipped and fell to the ground in the parking lot, breaking her left hip.

An employee was installing a 20-pound replacement motor assembly, banging on the part. The employee experienced altitude change and heavy lifting stress and was hospitalized with a collapsed right lung.
An employee was breaking loose a sheet metal duct connection that was sealed with pure duct seal using a flat head screw driver. The screwdriver slipped and struck his left eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was coming off a fracturing pump when he lost his footing and fell to the ground approximately 17 inches onto this left knee.  The fall resulted in a broken left leg just below the knee which will require surgery. The employee was wearing the personal protective equipment at the time.
An employee fell from a ski lift and suffered a fractured right hip.
On February 11, 2019, an employee was helping put a vehicle onto the lift when their left index finger was caught between the lift and the vehicle and amputated below the nail bed.
An employee was rolling a bull gear when it rolled over a bolt causing the gear to fall and strike the employee's leg and fracture it.

An employee took a sweeper outside because the sweeper had caught on fire. Maintenance came outside with a fire extinguisher to put out the fire. The extinguisher chemicals flew into the employee's face and the employee swallowed some of it. The employee was hospitalized with difficulty breathing.

An employee was using a cutoff saw to cut a hole in the top of a digester tank. Sparks ignited the methane gas in the digester tank. He was thrown over a railing and fell. The methane gas explosion burned his back and midsection.
An employee was placing a tarp on the load of the truck bed and fell off striking their head on the trailer and the ground. The employee suffered a fractured skull and wrist.
An employee slipped on the wet walkway and fell hitting his head. He was hospitalized for bleeding on the brain.

An employee installed a fuel pump on a customer's car and was bleeding the air out of the fuel lines. When all of the air was bled out fuel started to spray out onto his face, chest, arm and hand. He jumped back to get away from the spraying fuel and the wrench he was using to loosen the fuel line touched the positive terminal on the battery and caused a spark which ignited the fuel. The employee suffered third degree burns to the right hand.

An employee was moving freight inside the truck trailer with a pallet jack and pinned his right foot between another skid and the pallet jack. The employee's foot bent back and the steel toe tip lacerated and fractured the top of his foot/toes.
An employee was using a snow blower and attempted to clear the snow from around the rotating brush when it energized and severed the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was walking in the parking lot, slipped on ice and fell breaking a femur.

An employee was letting visitors out of a set of double doors when a patient bolted from an adjacent room and struck the employee knocking her against a wall. The employee suffered a fractured left humerus that required surgery to repair.

A forklift was backing out of a pick location after doing some work on a raw material container.  While in reverse, the lift struck another employee in the back. This forced the employee's foot into an open end on a drum lifting device. The pressure compressed his steel toe boot and fractured toes on his left foot.
An employee was clearing jammed plastic cups and lids in a sauce packaging machine. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder and fell to the ground sustaining a head injury.
Four employees were renovating a pre-existing commercial facility. One employee fell four feet from a scaffold and sustained head and hand injuries.
An employee was reaching between oven lines when the robotic arm was tripped and the molds closed. The employee's arm and face were caught in the molds causing severe burns.
An employee was walking to the store from the fuel station, slipped on ice and fell breaking bones.
An employee was walking a client to the car to drive the client to work when she slipped on ice in the driveway and fell striking the back of her head.

An employee was checking on equipment in the area where a 55 gallon drum of cleaner was located. The drum is hooked up to a pump and oven and set to clean the oven on an automatic timer. The automatic timer went off while the employee was in the area and he was sprayed with the cleaning chemical, causing chemical burns to the face.

An employee was removing wiring from deactivated poles. As the employee got to the top of the pole, the other pole that was connected by the wires gave way and pulled the pole the employee was on top of down. The employee fell approximately 15-20 feet and was hospitalized for a fractured left hand and lacerations. His left middle finger was surgically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was slicing tomatoes with a slicer and amputated the tip of her right thumb.

An employee was on the ground in a customer lot. He was throwing a strap over the load on a flat bed trailer to prepare for unloading when he slipped on ice and fell injuring his lower left arm and elbow.

An employee was on a forklift loading/unloading trailers when the trailer he was on pulled away from the dock door. The forklift with the employee strapped in fell four feet and landed upright. The employee suffered a fractured vertebra.

An employee was using a rodder snake to unclog a 4-inch sewer line. The rod hit a blockage while being pulled back and bound around the employee's left hand severing part of the ring finger at approximately the first knuckle.

An employee was using a crowbar to lift the back left side of a section of electrical switchgear cabinet to install a shim. The crowbar rolled, and the weight of the gear came down onto the tip of the flat piece of metal he was pushing the shim with. His left index finger was pinched between the shim metal and the concrete pad amputating the fingertip.
An employee was walking outside, slipped on ice and fell fracturing the right hip.

On February 11, 2019, at approximately 11:29 a.m. a flight attendant was walking from an aircraft to the fixed-base operator's building when she walked into a static wick on the wing of a Cessna airplane. The employee sustained a laceration next to the left eye resulting in five stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was pulling the kingpin from the fifth wheel attachment point, slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was pulling two sheets of plastic together with his hands. He was holding a nail in his right hand which he was going to use to stitch the sheets together. His right hand slipped off the plastic and traveled toward his face and the nail struck his right eye. The employee sustained an eye injury requiring hospitalization. The employee was wearing safety glasses at the time.
While installing new steel decking on an interior mezzanine, an employee fell 29 feet, suffering a forehead laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized when his pacemaker was exposed to magnetic fields causing an irregular heartbeat.

On February 12, 2019, an employee was training to use the pneumatic foam compacting tool and caught his right hand fingers between two plates. The right index, middle and ring fingers were crushed resulting in surgical amputation.
An employee amputated his pinky and ring fingers while cutting laminate on a table saw.

An employee was conducting concrete crushing operations. The equipment was turned off and the employee moved to an area to remove debris. The concrete crusher was turned back on while the injured employee was in the area causing the amputation of his right arm.

An employee was unloading the back of a trailer with an electric pallet jack and smashed his foot between the pallet jack and the trailer interior wall. The employee sustained a broken foot and several broken toes.
An employee was moving rail cars. While standing on the rail car trying to set the brakes, he slipped and fell and the rail car rolled over his foot. The employee's foot was surgically amputated.

An employee was loading packages onto a van. He turned around and was walking on the concrete floor when plastic from pallets he had straightened up caught his legs, causing him to trip and fall to the ground. He suffered a broken left hip.
An employee stood up from a chair and tripped over an open file cabinet drawer.  The employee fell to the floor and fractured her right humerus.

An employee was working from a walk plank over stairs, installing sheets of insulation. He fell off the plank to the floor 16 feet below. He was hospitalized for fractured ribs and a kidney laceration.
A temporary employee suffered a fingertip amputation while cleaning an oil basting machine.
An employee was performing maintenance on the electrical service and was shocked.

An employee was servicing a garage door at a commercial establishment from an extension ladder approximately 15 feet in height. The ladder slid out from under him and the employee fell to the ground, breaking his right arm and spraining an ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on his arm.
An employee was teaching swimming lessons when a participant jumped into the pool and landed on the employee. The employee sustained injuries to his head, neck and shoulders and was hospitalized.
While arriving at work, an employee slipped in the icy parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering two broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while exiting a truck fracturing the tail bone.
An employee was using a panel saw and positioning a piece of plastic to be cut when his pinky finger was amputated by the saw blade.
An employee fell and fractured the right leg.
A mold cart rolled backwards and off the side of the ramp at the dump station striking an employee and causing a lower right leg fracture.
An employee was climbing a ladder to retrieve some tools on location at a job. The employee slipped, lost his balance, and fell to the ground breaking both of his legs.
An employee fell while salting a concrete sidewalk. He suffered an elbow injury and was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was removing a guard to check a pulley size on a drive when the motor came on and the guard caught on the pulley. The pulley spun and hit the tip of his right middle finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip and nail.

An employee was being trained by his supervisor as they removed structural steel from a transfer line. An 8-foot-long .25 thick steel C channel tipped over and the employee's left middle finger was pinched between the steel and the fixed rail support. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell on the stairs and broke her left leg.
An employee was feeding a machine when their glove was caught on a shaft resulting in fractures to the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was filling a tire with foam. A sudden release of the foam struck the employee causing abdominal trauma and a contusion.
An employee was stacking a skid and tripped over a roll of stretch wrap that was on the walking surface. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was exiting an elevator when she slipped on a puddle of water and fell to the floor, fracturing her right shoulder. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee lost his balance while stepping onto a baker scaffold in the parking garage and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured wrist.
An employee's hand got caught in the gate resulting in partial amputation.
An employee stepped onto the plexiglass window on the binding machine. The window broke and the employee fell three feet suffering a broken leg.
An employee was walking up a grass hill to the workplace. The employee slipped in mud and slid down the hill, hitting a concrete barrier. The employee suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee tripped and fell breaking her femur.

An employee was operating a differential crane weighing 300 pounds. He placed a clamp to secure the crane onto the cable. The clamp came undone and the crane fell onto the employee's left leg breaking it. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was walking on wet concrete to get to a different shop/unit. He fell, breaking his right tibia and fibula.

The injured employee was working with another employee stripping wax off the floor. The injured employee backed into the area just mopped by the second employee, slipped and fell hitting his head on the floor. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was helping others load pipe onto the back of his trailer. His right hand was caught under some pipe and the tip of his right ring finger was amputated.
An employee was changing the pump at a wellsite. The line froze up and the trapped hot condensate shot out and burned the employee's right forearm.

An employee was cutting down packaging materials to build cardboard pallets for export orders. His  fingers contacted the table saw blade causing a left middle fingertip amputation and a laceration to the left index finger requiring stiches.
An employee was moving a steel I-beam using a pendant-controlled crane. The I-beam struck the employee's right foot, causing the amputation of two toes.

An employee was climbing a straight ladder that was secured to a boiler.  On the third or fourth step of the ladder, the employee's foot slipped causing him to fall backwards and hit a fire extinguisher that was on the wall before falling to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized due to an injury to his twelfth vertebrae.
A saw operator was rolling a bar on a roller table. The bar fell off and struck his right foot, breaking his second toe. He was hospitalized, requiring immediate surgery.
An employee was walking from his office when he tripped over a temporary wooden sidewalk structure. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula, as well as torn ligaments in his leg and ankle.
An employee was using a wheel grinder and severely lacerated his thumb. The grinder was unguarded at the time.
An employee was delivering mail on her route. While walking up to an address to deliver a parcel, she slipped and fell on accumulated snow and ice breaking an ankle.

The injured employee was driving a shuttle. He parked the shuttle in an aisle in front of storage racks in the warehouse. A forklift backed out of the storage racks and struck the injured employee's left leg fracturing the shin.

A carpenter was using a 7.25 inch circular saw to cut a 2 x 4  wooden board that will be used to construct a barn. The circular saw kicked back causing the amputation of the right tip of his thumb including bone loss.
An employee was climbing a six-foot A-frame ladder to access TV wiring, when she lost her balance and fell to the floor, fracturing six ribs on her right side.
An employee was finishing a roof inspection. While stepping down onto a ladder, the employee fell to the ground and was injured.
A metal worker had raised his air staple gun up to install a soffit when it fired, stapling his left wrist to the bone. He was hospitalized.
An employee was returning to his truck after making a delivery, slipped, and fell to the ground breaking a hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on top of a tank that was about 3 feet off the ground, filling it with treatment mixture. The employee fell from the tank onto metal stairs, suffering two broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was quenching aluminum when boiling water went down the employee's boot. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns and infection.

The injured employee was part of a wrecking crew removing plywood formwork from a structural concrete deck. He was using a pry bar to loosen the formwork. As he was pushing the pry bar upward, the formwork separated from the concrete and the pry bar slipped upward, smashing his left index finger between the bar and a metal support pole and causing amputation of the proximal joint.
An employee was setting up a piece of metal stock on a lathe to work on. As he adjusted the cutting knife, his right thumb was caught between the knife and the stock. The tip was cut off.

On February 13, 2019, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was cleaning and greasing a conveyor line in the pick area (enclosed building) when something got stuck in the roller/brake below.
