When the conveyor line was turned back on, the employee, who was back on the conveyor line, was carried via the conveyor to the end of the line and out of the building falling approximately 13' feet below onto a debris pile. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.
An employee was moving a floor pallet jack down a sloped sidewalk from one building to another. The employee fell, striking his head on a pole. He was hospitalized.

At about 4:00 p.m. on February 13, 2019, while measuring glue at a veneer press, an employee was pinned between the press and an automated stacker. The employee suffered contusions/cuts and was hospitalized.
An maintenance employee was painting the curbs at an apartment complex and was struck by a car. The employee suffered a broken hip and pelvic bone.
An employee was cutting a calf hip carcass with a 5-inch butcher knife when the knife slid off of the carcass and impaled the employee's right thigh.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a molding machine and suffered a transphalangeal amputation of the right index finger while trying to retrieve a marker.
An employee was adjusting a bicycle's rear gear assembly. The employee's chisel tool slipped and lacerated the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was working on the mill cut off press and lifted a door flap to add oil to the press. The press cycled and crushed the employee's right hand.
An employee tripped on a carpet and fell, suffering a torn right anterior cruciate ligament.
An employee was scraping glue off a machine when their left right finger was caught in a cam on the machine and fractured.
Employee was walking to her car when another car struck her, breaking her leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a paver and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured right knee.
An employee fell on a snow-covered embankment, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb. The saw was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was exiting the building he was cleaning. The wind slammed the door back onto the employee's hand causing a left right fingertip amputation.
An employee was attaching the tie off to the roof, slipped on ice and fell off the roof to the ground. The employee sustained facial fractures and a fractured left foot.
An employee was transporting a 1700 lbs. electrical panel. The panel fell to the floor and struck the employee causing a fractured back, contusions and facial lacerations.
A worker was positioning the forks on a back hoe when one came loose from the bracket, fell and hit his left leg resulting in left leg fracture.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell resulting in a broken ankle that required surgery.
An employee was disassembling a scaffold and reaching for a scaffold pole when he fell forward into another horizontal scaffold pole causing a fractured right forearm.
An employee fell five feet off a ladder and landed on frozen ground. The employee sustained broken ribs and an injury to the collar bone area.
An employee was using a handcart to move kegs. The cart slipped and pinched the employee's right ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was MIG welding on the frame of a forklift when his clothing caught on fire. He suffered first- and second-degree burns to the left arm and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was standing next to his parked forklift. Another forklift was backing out of a trailer and struck the injured employee pinning him against the parked forklift. The injured employee was hospitalized for a leg injury that required surgery.
An employee was dropping honeycomb (stomach liner) using a 6" knife. As he was making his upward cut, the knife slipped out of his hand and propelled backwards into his chest and lacerated his liver.

An employee was working on top of an overhead crane and changing a wire rope which is considered a half gantry. The crane was activated and the employee was pinned between the two cranes. The employee sustained contusions and bruising to the left thigh.
Two employees were using a propane torch to thaw a valve on a water tanker trailer. There was an explosion and both employees were burned.

An employee was observing/testing a five-spindle nut runner machine (wheel torque wrench) after preventive maintenance was completed and suffered a partial thumb amputation after contacting one of the five rotating spindles. The employee was wearing gloves at the time.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor outside a cafeteria, suffering a vertebral compression fracture.

An employee was operating a head press to manufacture tanks/vessels. A piece of metal fell into the work area and was removed. As the press cycled back up, the employee's glove was caught on a burr on the side of the head pulling their left hand into the press. The left ring finger was lacerated and surgically amputated.
On February 14, 2019, while making an auto parts delivery, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee had been using paint thinner to clean auto body parts. When he went outside to smoke, paint thinner on his gloves ignited and burned his hands.
An employee was filling an order when his leg was pinned between a pallet and a steel rack. He suffered hairline fractures of the right tibia and fibula, as well as a laceration.
An employee was removing an old garage door and installing a new one. A piece of the door struck him in the right eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it struck a pole. His left hand suffered crushing/fracture injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a dock area. A forklift struck the employee as it backed up, breaking the employee's right ankle and toes.

An employee was reaching for a cardboard box to begin assembling it when he lost his footing and fell back onto a mold that was stationed behind him. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration injury.

On February 14, 2019, a truck mechanic sustained the amputation of his left index fingertip while inspecting work he had performed on a forklift while it was running. The employee had replaced the drive wheel on the forklift.
An employee was moving cars to be detailed and was pinned between a moving car and a parked car resulting in knee and leg fractures.

On February 14, 2019, the injured employee was preparing to move an underground boring machine. As the employee was standing next to the machine, another employee was backing up a "Vac Truck"  and struck the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized for severe back and neck injuries.

On February 14, 2019, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was stepping off a ladder onto a low slope roof approximately 10 feet in height. He stepped onto a section of rotten plywood covered with asphalt shingles which gave way and he fell to the ground below. The employee injured his upper back and was hospitalized.
A mail carrier was attacked by two pit bulls at a house, suffering injuries to the right forearm, left forearm, left hand, and left ring finger.
An employee was working on a palletizer when his left index finger became entangled in a conveyor belt and was amputated.
An employee was moving drums in the back of a truck bed using a drum lifter. The employee's thumb was caught between the drum and the lifter, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a wrench to adjust the belt tensioner on a screening machine when the wrench slipped off the bolt and his hand went into the belt and pulley resulting in amputation of the right pinky fingertip and a right forearm laceration.
An employee was operating a machine that makes straws and amputated the right middle fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a groove machine. As he checked the grooves in a pipe, his right hand was caught between two metal plates. The index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was removing a pipe with a 36" pipe wrench. The employee was backing up when he slipped and fell backwards hitting his head on a rack.
An employee was on a six-foot ladder replacing an aluminum balcony hand rail system and fell onto the concrete bed landing on his hip and breaking his pelvis and possibly his back.
An employee contacted an open gear at the gear box under a conveyor belt and amputated the right index fingertip.
A masked shooter shot two employees. One employee was shot in the chest and killed. The second employee was hospitalized for multiple gunshot wounds.
An employee was unjamming chicken frames in a rapid deboner. His left index finger was caught between a guard and a chicken frame, resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.
An employee was helping set up a banquet hall and was walking with a tray when the employee lost balance, fell to the floor and fractured the right hip.
On February 14, 2019, an employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while entering a building. The employee suffered a broken shoulder and facial injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a wrench, trying to loosen a bolt. The employee slipped and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was scooping dog waste when a dog bit her on the left hand and right calf.
Two employees were delivering construction materials to a school site that was being renovated. An employee climbed a rope that was hanging in the gym and fell breaking an ankle.

An employee was trimming a tree limb from a ladder. The limb fell and struck the employee, who in turn fell from the ladder. He struck his head on the concrete sidewalk below, suffering head trauma, and was hospitalized.
An employee was servicing an overhead crane and caught their left hand in the chain and sprocket mechanism. The employee suffered the amputation of the right middle fingertip at the at nailbed.

An employee was operating a forklift and backed into a pallet of packaged bottles. As she stepped out of the forklift the product fell onto her. Her right lower leg was caught between the pallet and the floor causing injury to the lower leg.
An employee was working from a Baker scaffold when he fell 6 feet to the floor, breaking his hip.
On February 14, 2019, an employee slipped on ice while walking into work. He fell to the ground, shattering his ankle, and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was installing a piece of equipment that was being lifted by a mobile crane. The equipment shifted, striking the employee on the right hand and injuring it.

An employee was loading construction and interior office garbage into the rear loader of a garbage truck. As he pushed in a desk, the loader activated; his finger slipped and was caught between the inside wall of the truck and the desk. He suffered a partial amputation of the left thumb above the knuckle.
An employee was moving cars on the lot, slipped on ice and fell backwards hitting his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were pulling electrical wires to facilitate the installation of a new air compressor. While  pulling wires, the wall/barrier inside of an electrical cabinet contacted buss bars located in an adjacent cabinet creating an electrical arc blast. One Cayuga Milk Ingredients, LLC employee and two contractor employees were burned on the hands, neck, back and face. Two of the employees were hospitalized.
An employee was operating a drill press. The bit bottomed out, causing the vise to rotate and crush the employee's left hand. The employee suffered an amputation to the ring finger.
An employee fell on ice and fractured the left femur.
An employee was handling a catalyst hoist. As he tried to stop the load from swinging, his left little finger was caught between the hoist and a handrail. The fingertip was crushed.
On February 14, 2019, an employee was between two I-beams while attaching rigging when the second I-beam rolled onto his right foot trapping it. The employee sustained a severe ankle strain.

An employee was operating a curl and bead machine and attempting to adjust a part that had dislodged from the machine when his right index finger was caught between a pail and the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee fell from the roof of a commercial building, landing on the ground about 20 feet below. The employee suffered cracked vertebrae (one in the neck and one in the back) and broke both wrists.
An forklift ran over an employee's right foot, injuring it.
An employee was using electrical testing equipment while working with light fixtures and was shocked by a 110-volt current. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working inside the grain bin loading grain into a truck and stepped on the auger causing a partial amputation of the left foot.
A mail carrier slipped while walking across a snow-/ice-covered lawn. He fell to the ground, breaking his shoulder.
An employee fell off a manhole structure to the ground 8-10 feet below, suffering a broken right knee and a hairline fracture to the left ankle.
Two employees were mounting a metal rod on a workbench mounted vice. The metal rod slipped from the vice and struck the tip of one employee's right ring finger causing a fingertip amputation.

While walking across a driveway, an employee was struck and dragged by a delivery truck as it backed up. The employee suffered a concussion, a broken collarbone, four broken ribs, and a broken right femur.
An employee slipped and fell in a parking lot, landing on his back and hitting his head. He suffered back and head injuries.

An employee was standing on the third step of a 6-foot ladder, pulling telephone cable through a ceiling. He fell to the carpeted floor about 10 feet below, and his head struck the wall. He suffered two skull fractures and a trace mastoid effusion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was reaching for a rope when his gloved left hand was pulled into a chain and sprocket on the back of a truck. The tip of his index finger was amputated and his middle and ring fingers were broken. The chain and sprocket was unguarded at the time.
An employee was operating a lift gate on a truck. The lift gate mechanism pinched the employee's left ring finger, causing its amputation.
An employee was cleaning pipes. The employee's left index finger was caught between a pipe and a machine, suffering a laceration and a cut tendon.

An employee was on an order selector. The employee fell while reaching for a tire, landing on the warehouse floor about 30 feet below. The employee suffered a broken ankle, hip, and arm. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.

An employee was cleaning out a machine when an edge pusher activated, catching the employee's right index finger and amputating the tip. A different part of the machine was locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee's foot was caught between an electric cart's accelerator and its brake as the employee stepped off the cart. The cart accelerated forward, striking a building column and breaking the employee's right leg/ankle.
An employee was installing a concrete storm drain pipe from inside a concrete storm drain box/catch basin. The pipe rolled over and struck the employee in the face/jaw. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing wooden 2-by-4 deck boards from a bulkhead flat railcar. He was using an overhead crane and lifting device to pull the boards up from the securement bolts. He was near the end of the railcar, removing the final groups of boards. The overhead crane's steel lifting device caught a 1/2-inch steel body bolster plate under the wood; as the crane began to lift, the lifting device slipped off the plate and flew into the air. It struck the employee in the face and right arm, causing non-displaced facial fractures and lacerations to the lip and gum line and a bruised right upper arm.
A trackhoe moved a concrete storm box, causing it to break an employee's lower right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a dryer room. Her left hand contacted a rotating airlock/rotary feeder valve in a pipe, causing the amputation of her index fingertip.
An employee was nailing a double-headed nail into a form. One of the heads flew off the nail and struck him in the eye, causing a cut that required surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting and adjusting the edger bar on a strapper. The horizontal bar struck the employee's left arm, causing a contusion.
An employee was checking piece mark numbers on pipe braces. A timber dunnage broke and a pipe rolled off, striking the employee's right foot and breaking his big toe.

An employee was rehearsing a motorcycle stunt for a motion picture: a maneuver in which the motorcycle was stopped on the front wheel with a sidecar attached. The motorcycle's handlebars locked to the left, causing the motorcycle to tip over and the sidecar to strike the employee. It broke the employee's left ankle and collarbone, as well as two ribs.

On February 15, 2019, an employee was using a rolling ladder to retrieve a chair from the top shelf in a warehouse area. He fell while descending the ladder, first landing on the box containing the chair (where he broke three ribs), then landing on the concrete floor (where he struck his head and suffered a concussion). He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to repair a machine used to flip kettles. A screw had broken in the pivot block, causing a kettle to get stuck; the employee was using a hoist to lift the kettle to reduce tension in order to remove the kettle. The kettle fell onto his hand, amputating the tip of his right thumb.

On February 15, 2019, a truck driver was unstrapping metal beams from a flat truck. A forklift on the opposite side of the truck lifted the beams and they fell onto the driver, breaking ribs and other bones. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting a double-tee into storage with the help of a gantry crane. As he was guiding the piece into position, it swung and pinched fingers on his left hand. His index fingertip was amputated (including bone) and his little finger was injured.
An employee was moving a fixture from a forklift. The fixture slipped and pinched his right index finger, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a band saw when the blade came down on his thumb causing an amputation.
An employee caught fire while warming up next to a heater. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the left leg.
An employee slipped in an icy parking lot and suffered a closed compression fracture of a vertebra in her back.
An employee slipped and fell on a patch of ice while taking out the trash, suffering a knee fracture.
A piece of crane rigging struck an employee's right arm, breaking the radius, dislocating the ulna, and causing a laceration. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee stepped off a ladder onto a 5-foot-wide porch roof. The roof collapsed, and the employee fell with it to the ground about 18 feet below. The employee suffered wrist and leg fractures and facial lacerations.

An employee was working from a 6-foot stepladder, pulling a piece of wood from a concrete wall. The employee fell backward from the ladder to the ground, landing on their tool belt and suffering a back sprain.
An employee was ironing when a sheet became lodged in the gears at the lower part of the ironing machine. The gears injured the employee's right arm.
While installing a pin on a trailer an employee lost his footing and fell to the ground below. He broke a vertebra in his back.

An employee was installing a sewer pipe in a trench. He was changing the bucket to a smaller bucket using the quick connect attachment on an excavator when the bucket fell on the employee, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a skid of antennas from the back of a pickup truck. The truck's lift gate was wet with rain; the employee slipped and fell backwards from it to the ground, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was cutting steel stock on a shear machine. The stock kicked back when it got to the end of the steel bar and pushed the employee's right index finger into the machine's pinch roller. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.
While helping reposition a patient, an employee became tangled in an emergency call wire and fell. The employee suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee's toes were caught between a metal track and a metal roller, causing a fracture to the second toe and lacerations to the first and third toes.

On February 15, 2019, an employee was standing in an aisle when a nearby forklift stopped suddenly, causing a sack of pet food to come off its forks and strike the employee. The employee suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a machine. He was lubricating the pulley chain using a rag when the machine cycled and the rag and his right hand were pulled into the pulley chain causing two fingertip amputations.
An employee was changing a cylinder on a printing press. The employee's left index finger was caught in the hoist used to change the cylinder, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder pulling merchandise when the employee fell from the ladder and struck the ground. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a dress through a store when she tripped and fell onto the hardwood floor, landing on her right hip and breaking it.
An employee's hand was caught and injured between a pipe and a wooden skid, with an excavator applying pressure.
An employee was standing next to his pallet jack when another employee's pallet jack hit him, injuring his left ankle/foot.

An employee was standing about 18 feet away from a 4-inch hose monitoring a pigging operation. The pig became stuck in the hose, causing pressure to build up; the hose whipped and struck the employee in the right upper arm, breaking his humerus.
An employee was rip cutting on a table saw. The blade came into contact with the employee's right hand, partially amputating the index finger and lacerating the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was pulling the locking pin from an attachment on an excavator. Pressure buildup caused the pin to pull back. The employee's right hand was caught between the locking pin and the attachment and the tips of the middle and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee fell on steps in a parking garage, suffering a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was working on a conveyor line when a chain and sprocket tore the skin off his right middle finger, broke the bone, and amputated the tip.
An employee slipped on ice while walking across a parking lot, falling to the asphalt. He suffered a skull fracture and brain bleed.

An employee was operating a walkie powered industrial truck (PIT) and smashed their left middle finger between the PIT handle and a concrete bollard on the way into the ice room. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell while mopping a floor, suffering a broken hip, a bruised left shoulder, and a head contusion.
On February 16, 2019, an employee was placing a liquor bottle on a shelf. The bottle broke and lacerated his right palm. He was hospitalized.
While working on a production floor, an employee was struck by a board kicked from a pallet dismantler. The employee was hospitalized.
A pressure washing stream crossed an employee's left foot, lacerating it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was rinsing equipment from a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor and was hospitalized, suffering a concussion.
An employee was removing film from the seal bar on a bagging machine. The sealer bar came down onto his right middle finger, causing a partial amputation.
After being removed from a charger, a dead forklift battery exploded in an employee's face. The battery acid caused an eye injury.
An employee was grinding glue off wheels on top of a corrugator machine. The employee's right index finger was caught between two of the machine's rollers, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee developed an umbilical hernia after moving a bed. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell over a crack on a cement floor, suffering a fractured pelvis.

An employee was helping a forklift operator stabilize a load in the top pallet. The employee steadied the load while the operator adjusted the forks. The top pallet slipped and struck the employee in the right leg, breaking the tibial plateau.
An employee's hand was caught between two conveyor belts. The employee suffered a crushed finger, two broken fingers, and a dislocated little finger.
An employee was bending down to move a box so that it would not be run over by a forklift. The forklift ran over the employee's foot, breaking bones.

An employee was de-stressing cabling on a flat pour due to a failed concrete test. The de-tensioning tool slipped and struck the employee, breaking the employee's left radius and causing a hand laceration.
As a tree was being felled, one of its branches struck a second tree, broke loose, and sprung back. It struck the sawyer, causing broken ribs, a broken shoulder, and a facial laceration.
An employee was cutting a ductile pipe with a gas-powered chop saw. The saw kicked back and its blade lacerated the employee's chest. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was consolidating two pallets (on the second tier of some industrial shelving) into one, using an 8-foot ladder. While trying to get back onto the ladder, he fell to the concrete floor, breaking his right wrist.

An employee was removing a clamp to replace a blind. As he removed the bolts on the clamp, the blind came free, striking him in the chin. He suffered a broken jaw, a broken nose, and facial lacerations.
A patient punched an employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice as he left his tractor. He fell, breaking his left hip.

An employee was using an air gun to blow and remove crumbs from the drip pan of a conveyor. The conveyor belt struck the air gun, pulling its trigger handle into a fixed conveyor support and pinching the employee's right little fingertip between the handle and the conveyor support.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left wrist and head and nose injuries.
An employee was bucking rivets on an aircraft skin when his finger was smashed. He suffered an infection and was hospitalized.
While delivering mail, a mail carrier slipped on ice and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was using water to put out a fire started by cutting torches. Some fuel ignited, burning the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a shipping container when he lost his footing on a damaged section of the container. He fell, breaking his wrist and dislocating his elbow.
An employee fell down a flight of seven metal stairs, breaking his skull.

An employee was working from the fourth or fifth rung of a 10-foot ladder, checking for weak parts in a plaster ceiling. He slipped and fell, striking the back of his head against a concrete stair next to the ladder's base.
An employee slipped on ice while walking and fell. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a crane to lift the actuator out of a machine. The actuator fell onto the employee's right hand, breaking four fingers and the wrist and dislocating the radius. The employee was hospitalized.
A field employee was walking to her car when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking her ankle in four places.

An employee was working on a leveling drill rig that was tied down by a winch cable. The employee began pulling on the cable so that it could gain slack. The winch was engaged, pulling in the employee's hand. The employee's right little finger was amputated above the metacarpal.
An employee was removing a nail gun from his tool belt when it fired a nail into his right hip.
An employee was consolidating non-regulated material into a 55-gallon drum when there was a flash fire. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the face and hands and was hospitalized.

Employees were conducting a training exercise on rescuing employees at a cell tower. One employee, acting as the victim, was being brought down by another. The descending apparatus came down to the ground too fast. In the fall (about 15 feet), the employee acting as the victim broke both ankles and needed to be hospitalized.
An employee fell while climbing down a fiberglass ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a broken left hip joint.

An electronic maintenance technician noticed that part of the tarp covering a radar dome had come off. He was standing on the bed of his pickup truck, pulling a rope attached to the tarp, when he fell off and landed on his back on the asphalt pavement. He suffered a skull fracture and brain hemorrhaging and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a wrench to tighten a header bolt nut to a vertical load rack. The wrench slipped off the nut, and the employee's little finger was caught between its handle and a beam. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell while leaving work, suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell on ice in a parking lot after stepping out of his struck. He suffered a head injury and bruises on the arm and leg.
At 5:20 a.m., on February 18, 2019, an employee slipped and fell in a parking lot. The employee suffered a broken femur (directly above the knee) and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving an MRI table when it started to veer the wrong way. As the employee was correcting its course, the employee's right little finger was caught between the table and a doorframe, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee's left hand was caught between an assembly machine and the equipment being assembled. His index finger was broken and he was hospitalized.
While walking into an office, an employee tripped on a step and fell, landing on his arm and chest. He broke two ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing the lid from a liquid tote of hypochlorous acid. Exposed to the vapor, the employee began experiencing shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a case of coffee when his artificial hip broke loose from his femur.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when he slipped to the ground during a freezing rain event, fracturing two neck bones and requiring surgery.
A load (concrete pile) struck an employee as it was being moved by a crawler crane, breaking the employee's pelvis.
An employee collapsed after lifting a boat and was hospitalized with a cervical spine injury.
An employee fell while climbing over a scaffold's cross-braces. The employee landed on the ground, suffering a broken femur and a burst fracture of a lower back vertebra.
An employee fell from a rack or shelf to the ground about 6 feet below. He suffered a broken pelvis and minor head injuries.

An employee unhooked a grain wagon from a pickup truck. The wagon began to roll, and the employee's right ring and middle fingers were caught between the concrete ground and a piece of wood being used to stop the wagon from rolling. The employee underwent a revision amputation.

An employee was using a forklift on a rail dock. Its tires went off the dock, causing the forklift to lean; the employee's right hand was pinched between the forklift and a rail car, causing fractures and a laceration.

An employee was trying to retrieve a tray that had fallen in a stacker. The stacker cycled and the employee's right middle finger was caught between the tray and the stacker frame. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder on a stationary horizontal tank that was 10 feet above the ground. He fell off the ladder to the ground 6 to 8 feet below, injuring his back.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in a machine. The machine cycled, pinning the employee's arm and breaking it.
An employee was working on top of a trailer when he fell to the ground, breaking his hip and his arm.

An employee entered a trench (about 7 feet deep and 7 to 8 feet wide) to install a fitting on a sewer main at the bottom. The trench's one vertical wall collapsed onto the employee, who suffered four broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a broken shoulder blade.
A technician was inspecting an aircraft's wing. A vortex generator on the top of the wing struck and lacerated his left knee. He was hospitalized.
On February 18, 2019, an employee slipped on pavement while walking in a parking lot. The employee fell to the asphalt, breaking a hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee and three other volunteers were lifting a children's climbing caterpillar (about 4 feet long) off two 2-inch posts. The employee's hand was caught between the caterpillar and a post. The tip of the employee's left middle finger was amputated.
An employee fell to the ground, landing on his right leg and hip and suffering a contusion to the leg.
An employee fell off a roof at a job site, suffering head, back, and foot injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to remove the obstruction from a jammed notched. Its blades caused the amputation of the employee's right first and second fingers to the second knuckle, and the third finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was handling a mud pump liner when it shifted. His left little finger was caught between the liner and the mud pump and the tip was amputated.
An employee was operating a brake press in safe mode while changing a die on the press. The press cycled, breaking the employee's left arm.

At 1:37 p.m. on February 19, 2019, a temporary employee was taking an empty 280-pound steel wire reel off a machine when he suddenly felt pain in his neck and back and fell to the floor. He was hospitalized, having suffered sprains/strains of ligaments of the cervical spine and a contusion of the left shoulder.
An employee was working with a plastic insertion machine when it cycled and caught the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving material using a forklift. A spreader bar (being used to carry the material) fell on his right foot, causing a dislocation. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was on top of a trailer inside a wash bay area, loosening bolts to the trailer's open dome lid. The employee was found on top of the tanker unconscious and was hospitalized for respiratory failure and cardiac arrest due to toluene exposure.
An employee's left ring finger was amputated after a pressurized airline ruptured in his hand.

An employee was trying to transfer lumber from a bundle on a forklift into the bed of a truck. The lumber was frozen together, and another employee began to tap it with a hammer. The wood began to slide, and the first employee's hand was caught between the falling wood and a stack of wood. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.
A chair slid out from under an employee as the employee sat down. The employee landed on the ground, suffering a tailbone injury (possibly a fracture). The employee was hospitalized.
While completing a capacitor bank storage installation, an employee came into contact with live equipment and suffered electrical burns to the arms and torso.

An employee was running a microwave bagging machine. A belt jammed; while the employee was fixing the jam, the employee's right index finger was amputated up to the first knuckle. The machine was guarded at the time.

On February 19, 2019, an employee was lowering a purlin onto a rack using an overhead crane. The employee had one hand on the control pendant and one hand on the chain. When the purlin was placed, it rotated and pinched the tip of the left ring finger between the chain and the purlin resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking to his work vehicle when he slipped and fell on a small, icy hill, landing on his laptop in the chest area. He fractured ribs and suffered a collapsed lung.
A truck driver was climbing down a fixed ladder on his truck when he fell, suffering a small head laceration. He was hospitalized.
On February 19, 2019, an employee slipped on ice while walking to a building. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a trailer when he slipped on the wheel well inside the trailer. He fell to the trailer floor and broke his right leg.

An employee was trying to retrieve a box behind some metal fence pickets. The employee was standing on a pallet between the pickets when a bundle of pickets (weighing about 1,020 pounds) toppled over on the employee's ankle, trapping it between bundles of pickets and causing multiple breaks.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a dust collector blower, which was resting on an adjustable work station. The work station was lowered and the blower fell off the table. It struck the employee, breaking the employee's left forearm.

An employee was installing decking. While reaching for a piece of the decking, the employee slipped and fell off the building to the ground, suffering two broken ribs and a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 19, 2019, while sandblasting outside a tank, an employee tripped over the sandblaster hose and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was leaving a car to go into work. The employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering sprains to the back and knee.

An employee slipped in a kitchen and fell to the floor, striking his face and hand. He was hospitalized, having suffered lacerations requiring sutures, a concussion, and a cheekbone injury that required surgery.
An employee was helping move and sort material at ground level using a hydraulic crane. A bundle of angle iron beams pinched and amputated three of his fingertips. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw when the wood jumped back, dragging his left hand into the blade and amputating his ring and middle fingers.
An employee was hit by a snag backed rail, suffering a broken left forearm and knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was boring a hole for a power/telephone pole using a utility truck with an auger bit. The employee finished the hole and was stowing the auger bit when the safety cable broke. The auger bit struck the employee, breaking his jaw and causing facial contusions.
An employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken hip.
A valve in a piping system closed on an employee's left fourth and fifth fingers, amputating the tips.

An employee had just unhooked and secured the hitch pin of a transporter. As the transporter pulled away, the pin slid down, causing the hitch to reattach to the transporter. The employee's foot was trapped between the moving transporter and a metal bollard, causing a broken right heel, an 8-inch laceration to the top of the right foot, and smaller lacerations to the inner ankle.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut blocks for manufacturing. The saw blade caught his glove and cut off the tip of his left thumb.

On February 19, 2019, an employee was using a saw to cut extruded aluminum when the saw jammed up. The employee was attempting to clear the jam when the saw functioned and cut off the employee's right index fingertip. Gloves were worn at the time.

On February 20, 2019, an employee was walking outside behind a maintenance shop when he slipped on ice. He fell to the ground and struck the back of his head. Suffering from dizziness and vomiting, he was hospitalized.
An employee was positioning a steel plate to be welded to the bottom of a railroad car. His left index and middle fingers were caught and broken between the plate and the car. He was hospitalized.
On February 20, 2019, an employee was loading raw material into the vertical plunger system on an injection press when the plunger came down onto the employee's fingers, causing an amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting an exhaust fan on a roof. The employee came into contact with the fan's impeller, suffering an amputation to the tip of the left index finger.
An employee was using a power trowel to smooth a concrete surface. The employee was overcome by carbon monoxide fumes.
Employees were troubleshooting a slicer. Its timing belt had just been replaced when it pulled in an employee's latex-gloved right hand, resulting in an amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was using a bailer machine when it crushed his arm.
An employee suffered a laceration to the right leg on top of an elevator that was being serviced. The laceration required surgery.

An employee was loading a gas tank on a conveyor belt to be taken to another station. The employee tripped on a metal cable (connecting a go/no-go gauge to the conveyor belt) and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee started to cut a thermowell (a 2-inch piece of pipe with a sensor inside) using a portable bandsaw. A flash caused minor burns to the employee's chin, neck, and wrists; the employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while climbing onto a trailer. He hit his left lower leg on the guardrail to a scale, breaking it.
An employee was on a platform ensuring that all rails had been pushed in. A lining bar struck his mouth and head, breaking four teeth.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet from a conveyor to a concrete floor, suffering multiple rib fractures and a concussion.

An employee was carrying scrap wire near a rotating machine barrel. The spinning barrel caught the wire and pulled the employee's left arm into the machine, causing cuts, abrasions, fractures, and lost feeling/circulation.
While installing an attic ladder in a home, an employee slipped and fell from the attic onto some shelving and a concrete floor. The employee suffered a facial fracture.
An employee was waiting for the launched component (pig). The launch component was jammed in the pipe and when it released, his right arm suffered abrasions near the wrist and above the elbow.
An employee's left hand contacted a blower's belt and pulley amputating his left ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was moving packages from a conveyor when a package struck her, breaking her left hip.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to a vehicle. The employee's head struck the asphalt parking lot surface; the employee suffered a head injury including internal bleeding.

Employees were performing a drill pipe inspection using an x-ray/ultrasonic test. A forklift was picking up pipes; its boom pressed down on two joints of pipe, and when the pipes were raised they jumped off the pipe rack, striking and breaking an employee's left tibia and fibula.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder, using a beam clamp to guide a truss onto a beam on a new home. The beam clamp broke and the employee fell about 6-7 feet to the ground, suffering back contusions.

An employee was driving a tractor-trailer truck as it dumped a load of logs. The truck hit a bump and the trailer tipped over, taking the cab with it. The employee suffered bruising to the left shoulder and body.

An employee was using a metal pipe with 1/2-inch tines to scrape the feathers off the side of a dryer. The force of the spinning dryer caught the pipe, which impaled the employee in the upper chest and passed through his shoulder. The force then pulled out the pipe and knocked off the lid of the dryer, sending the employee to the floor. He was hospitalized.

An employee was manipulating a finished part by hand by sliding it across the work table when the metal part fell over, catching his right ring finger underneath it and resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a survey boat when he slipped, fell, and hit his head, losing consciousness. The boat subsequently struck a channel buoy and sank. He was hospitalized for a brain bleed.
An employee was loading materials onto a buggy. A 2-by-4 struck the buggy's gear shift, causing the buggy to move and pin the employee against a wall. The employee's leg was broken in two places.

An employee was using a pallet wrapping machine to wrap product on a pallet. He had turned the machine off and was at the bottom with the wrap when the pallet shifted and knocked him off balance. His thumb was pinched between the pallet and the machine; the tip was amputated to the first knuckle.

A temporary employee was loading material into a projection welding machine when it was activated via the foot pedal, causing the welding machine pin to hit his finger. He suffered a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was transporting a machine part using a forklift. As the forklift made a sharp turn, the employee's hand was caught between the forklift and a nearby assembly line machine and his little finger was crushed. The finger was amputated.
Employees were cleaning out tubing to set a packer, using a tool that screwed onto a joint 25-30 feet in the air. The tool came unscrewed and fell, breaking an employee's pelvis on the left side.
While skiing with a guest, an employee hit a patch of soft snow and fell forward in a twisting motion. The employee suffered a fractured tibia and fibula and was hospitalized.

An employee was working near the boom of a wheel loader. Hydraulic pressure was lost and the boom came down on him, pinning him against the loader. He suffered head and arm injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a piece of rebar while another employee was cutting it with a cut-off saw when the saw kicked to the side and into the employee's arm, causing a laceration to the right forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working from a ladder in a 20-foot-deep press pit, fixing a sensor on the press. He fell from the ladder to the ground (at least 12 feet below) and broke his foot.

An employee was preparing to nipple down a blowout preventer. The fingers on his left hand were caught between a metal door and the latch; the middle and ring fingers were amputated at the first joint.

While pulling a pallet off a roller bed conveyor, an employee tripped over a ground-mounted forklift guardrail. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
While stepping out of a company van, an employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip or upper leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was entering the building to start work. The pads of her crutches, wet from rain, slipped on the tile floor, causing her to fall onto her right side and shatter her right hip.
An employee was on an 8-foot stepladder when one of the spreader bars broke causing the ladder to twist and turn throwing the employee off the ladder. The employee suffered a broken right arm.

At about 2:00 p.m. on February 21, 2019, an employee was descending a rolling ladder on the first floor of a specialty mill. The employee fell from the last step to the ground, suffering multiple fractures to the left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a skinner machine and was guiding a ham when the ham slipped, causing the employee's skinner glove and smock sleeve to become caught in the roll/skinning blade. The employee's left elbow was de-gloved as a result.
On February 21, 2019, an employee was using a chain hoist to lift a mechanism housing. The housing broke free of its eye bolt and landed on the employee's left foot, amputating the big toe.

Two officers were inspecting an SUV that was pulling a trailer. An officer asked the driver to pull forward a little while the injured officer was inspecting the trailer hitch area. As the vehicle moved forward, the injured officer was knocked down and became wedged between the trailer driver's side tire and axle and dragged approximately one foot before the vehicle stopped. The injured officer was hospitalized for a fractured lower left leg that required surgery.
An employee was repairing a furnace at a job site. While the furnace was being lifted, it struck him in the leg, breaking his femur.
An employee slipped while getting off a flatbed truck. His left ring finger was caught on the truck and amputated.

Two employees were acting as spotters while a forklift moved pipe joints. One of them, on the left side of the forklift, was laying down a tagline when a pipe began to roll. It struck and broke his leg.
An employee was in a flooring mill, clearing a board from a belt. The belt caught his hand, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was on a scissor lift 8 or 9 feet from the ground, installing some blast chill fans for a new ammonia refrigeration system. The employee fell to the ground, hitting his head.

An employee was assisting a co-worker to straighten lumber in the saw mill stacker. His foot was caught in the chain and sprocket causing severe tissue damage, a hairline fracture to the heel and a damaged tendon.
An employee was repairing the gearbox on a machine at a client location. He slipped or tripped and fell backwards resulting in a laceration on the back of the head and bleeding in the brain.

An employee was working from a 10-foot ladder, cutting into a copper line. A blast of pressurized air was released from the line and the employee fell, landing on the concrete floor 8 feet below. He suffered injuries to the head, back, and spine.
An employee was operating a manual table bender. His left thumb was caught between the backup roller and the bar. The tip was crushed, leading to an amputation.
An employee was clearing a blockage of the top photo eye of a baler. A shear inside the hopper caused the amputation of the employee's right index fingertip.
Two employees were involved in an altercation. One employee's injuries required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a slitter machine with a rag. The rag got caught on the rollers pulling his right hand into the machine. The employee sustained a degloving injury to the hand and a right thumb fracture.
An employee was slipped on ice in the parking lot and fractured her right hip.
An employee was hand threading new material into a rolling mill when his glove got caught on the threaded material and pulled into the rollers causing a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was transferring from their wheelchair into their car, slipped and fell. The employee suffered a bilateral fractured elbow, a broken nose and a cut on the nose.
A roofer fell from the roof and was hospitalized for a head injury. It was raining at the time of the incident.

An employee tripped on the edge of a ramp in a parking lot, falling face first between the wheel and the wheelhouse of the truck that was on the ramp. The employee's shoulder struck a step on the truck, and the whiplash action caused tingling and restricted movement.

An employee was performing quality checks on a press with a built-in stair system. As she came down the stairs, she fell to the concrete floor, breaking her left ankle and lower leg. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A maintenance employee was spreading ice melt outside of the building when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing three ribs.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, falling to the ground and breaking her right ankle.

A production operator was cleaning a tank. He had just set aside a bag of caustic soda beads (after adding beads to the tank for the necessary cleaning solution) when boiling water erupted from the tank, burning the left side of his back, the back of his left leg, and the back of his left arm.

An employee was working on piping products using a flanging and finishing machine. His left hand was caught between the jaws of the machine and the product, causing the dislocation/fracture of the middle and index fingers.

A maintenance employee was repairing a guard on a machine. When he went to remove the guard, the machine's belt caught and severed the tip of his thumb. The machine was turned off and locked out at the time.

On 2/21/2019, two employees were working to repair/resurface a 120-inch, five blade, four-ton wheel propeller inside the propeller repair shop at a shipyard repair facility. The propeller was just removed from the straightening press and the employees were in the process of moving it over to a floor stand so they could weld it, grind it and apply cosmetic treatment to it. They used an under the hook hoist system to move the propeller over to the floor stand. Once in position, they attempted to place the propeller on the stand by lowering it down onto the top of the stand and then slacking the chain. However, it would not sit flush on the stand and both agreed that they needed a different stand. One employee went to get a different stand, heard a crash and saw that the propeller had started to slide off the stand with the hoist chains now tight. The second employee suffered a deep laceration/fracture to their left leg.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift in a warehouse. The forklift backed into a concrete pole and the employee stepped off at impact. As the employee stepped back on with one leg, the forklift moved and caught the employee's other leg against the pole.
An employee was helping a coworker cut pine boards with a cutoff saw. The sawblade caught his gloved left hand, amputating his left index and middle fingers just behind the knuckles.
An inmate stabbed an officer in the abdomen with a knife.

An employee was walking alongside a forklift loaded with frames. The frames began to fall, and the employee tripped and fell while moving to avoid them. The forklift then ran over the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a welder's cable out of the way when the cable shocked his right hand and arm.

On February 21, 2019, an employee was guiding a load of steel that was being moved from a flatbed truck to the ground by a crane. As the load was about four feet from the ground, a rigging failure caused the steel to buckle and strike the employee. The employee was launched into the air about 15-20 feet. The employee sustained a broken arm, collar bone and pelvis.
An employee sustained an amputation to his left ring finger while working on a drilling rig.
An employee was turning off a conveyor belt when his hand contacted the timing belt. His fingers were crushed and the tip of his left ring finger was amputated.

At about 11:00 a.m. on February 21, 2019, an employee was retrieving a steel channel beam from a stack. The employee pried two steel channel beams apart with a 12-inch pry bar to attach a lifting device. One beam slid off the other, and the employee's right ring fingertip was pinched between the beams and was amputated.

An supervisor was performing a safety observation of another employee who was installing an electric meter. The supervisor slipped on a wet walking surface and fell, breaking his right arm against a railing. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell more than 12 feet to a concrete floor, suffering broken bones and a concussion. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a PIT when the employee lost control of the PIT. The employee's left foot slipped, and the left leg became pinned between the PIT and a rack. The employee suffered a severe ankle laceration and a broken heel.
An employee suffered a finger injury while using an alligator shear.
While tracking people through ranchland, an employee suffered heat stress, dehydration, and cramping.
An employee was conducting product tumbler cleaning operations when the tumbler struck the employee's head and face.
While leaving a building, an employee slipped on hard-packed snow on a shipping/receiving ramp. The employee fell, suffering a broken hip and femur.
At about 1:00 a.m. on February 22, 2019, an employee was using a grinder when it caught the drawstring of his sweater. It pulled up the string and cut the employee's neck.
A security guard was injured while trying to break up a fight between students. He was punched and kicked and hospitalized for elevated blood pressure and heart rate.
An employee was cleaning a double pouch sealant machine. The blade caught the employee's finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was refueling a tracked excavator. The employee slipped and fell off the excavator to the ground injuring their back, shoulder, and head.
An employee was walking out of the building at the end of a shift, tripped on the door sill and fell to the ground breaking the left arm.
An employee slipped on snow-covered ice, suffering an injury to his left foot/ankle.
An employee was performing a re-bend on a press brake. When the brake was actuated, the part being bent rotated up, pinching the employee's right thumb against the upper tooling and severing the tip.
A roofer fell off a roof to the ground 20 feet below, suffering broken wrists and a puncture injury to the head. He was hospitalized. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down a hallway when she tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her right knee.

An employee was checking the belt on the infeed conveyor of a palletizer. The belt began to move and pulled the employee's right middle finger into the running palletizer resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a powered pallet jack to move a pallet of material. The jack backed into a metal post, pinching off the tip of the employee's right ring finger.
As a forklift driver was closing a gate, it caught the driver's left thumb against the forklift frame. The thumb was amputated.

On February 22, 2019, an employee was finishing a repair on an HVAC unit when a belt and pulley (on a different piece of equipment) caught the employee's left hand. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was installing a metal roof when he slipped and fell on the roof. When the employee fell, he hit the edge of a metal roof panel with his right wrist and suffered a laceration that cut tendon and ligaments, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a stand up forklift and attempted to go through an elevated door way. The top mast of the forklift struck the brick wall of the doorway causing the forklift to tip over and land on the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized for a foot injury requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a bucket truck picking up road signs along the side of the road at the end of the day. The employee was on the back of the truck strapping down the signs. When he stood up, he struck his head on the bottom of the bucket, lost his balance, and fell approximately four feet off the side of the truck to the ground breaking the lower left leg.
An employee smashed his hand between a block of wood and a metal bang board resulting in a partial amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee stepped into the back of a trailer parked in a store's dock area. The truck moved forward and the employee fell out, suffering a right hip injury.

An employee was cleaning a moving table top (carrousel) on a concrete pipe manufacturing machine during set-up. As the employee went to clean the table skirt, his rag and a finger were pulled into the wheel. His right middle finger was crushed and the fingertip, up to the first knuckle, was surgically amputated.
An employee was removing bacon from the oven. The pan hit the door causing grease to spill and burn her arm, neck, chest and stomach. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 22, 2019, an employee slipped on an ice patch in a parking lot and fell, hitting his head and breaking a finger. He was hospitalized, suffering from a subdural bleed.
An employee was walking to his unit. As he went around a corner he was struck by a hostler truck resulting in a left knee injury.

A material handler was picking components in the receiving storage area between rows C & D on the south end of the storage area. As the material handler was scanning and loading components onto a cart, a forklift operator was loading components onto the top level rack in row E, adjacent to where the material handler was picking parts. While loading the parts onto the rack, the pallet that was in row D in the same location began to shift and eventually fell from the top level onto the material handler causing fractures to the employee's neck and spine.
A temporary employee was working on a roller machine when it caught his right glove and pulled in his hand. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery, and lost the tip of a finger.
A falling cement block struck an employee on a job site, causing a fractured skull and a laceration.
An employee collided with a guest while skiing, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was gathering shopping carts from a parking lot. She slipped and fell to the icy concrete pavement, breaking her right wrist and suffering contusions to the tailbone area and right knee.
An employee was assisting a client in their home when she lost her footing and fell, fracturing two discs in her back. She was hospitalized.

An employee was performing rigging operations at a well pad. He was walking on a containment pad walkway that was slippery from a recent rain/snow event. He slipped and fell. He attempted to catch himself during the fall and fractured his left wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was leaving a front end loader when the wind caught the loader's door, causing the employee to fall to the cement curb about 5 feet below. He suffered broken ribs and a head laceration and was hospitalized.

At 10:45 a.m., on February 22, 2019, an employee was working at an extruder line, clearing accumulated plastic between the guillotine blade and pulley belts. The timed chopping cycle took place, amputating the employee's left index finger above the first knuckle. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
A driver was exiting his semi-truck, missed the last step and fell to the ground fracturing a hip.
An employee was repairing a weigh bar on a feed truck. His left hand was pinned between the truck box and frame, causing the amputation of his ring finger and the top of his little finger.
An employee was emptying a bag of collected dust from a dust collection system. The bag and the employee's hand were pulled into the airlock hopper valve. The employee's hand was lacerated.
An employee was drywall mudding the back corner of a tub. She slipped on some mud that had fallen on the floor and dislocated her ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee got two metal chips imbedded into his toe. The toe was surgically amputated.
An employee was sitting in her chair talking with another employee. When she stood up, she tripped over the leg of the chair and fell breaking a hip.

An employee was traveling through a facility on a stock picker. The stock picker began to tip during a turn, and the employee's left arm struck a rack upright support. He suffered fractures to the arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was attaching a crane hook to the mold with his left hand. The hook twisted and crushed his index finger.

An employee was cleaning shelving inside the safe room. The employee climbed a ladder and stepped onto a countertop to clean the shelving. When stepping down from the countertop to the ladder the employee fell and fractured her hip.
An employee's finger was caught in shelving and  was hospitalized after sustaining a partial finger amputation.

An employee on a 6-foot ladder, cleaning an external dryer vent that was about 11.5 feet above a patio. The ladder tipped over and the employee fell; his head hit the patio furniture and then the concrete patio itself, and he briefly lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken wrist and hip socket.
An employee was transferring from an aerial lift to a scaffold platform and fell approximately 50 feet to the ground. The employee suffered two broken legs and the loss of teeth.
An employee was cleaning saw dust in the basement near a vibrating conveyor and suffered a partial amputation of the right pinky finger just above the first knuckle.
An employee fractured her tibia and fibula while skiing down a run.

On February 23, 2019, an employee was removing dust from the sensor of a recycling system. The fingertips on the employee's right hand came into contact with the paddle blade, causing amputations to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was walking toward his car in a parking lot. He fell to the ground in a grassy section, suffering bruises to the left hip and head.

An employee was changing filter bags on a pan water filter. As the employee was form-fitting the filter to the basket, 200-degree water flowed into the employee's glove, causing second degree burns (and a subsequent infection) to the employee's left wrist/hand.
An employee was moving a bucket and mop when he slipped on a waxed floor and fell, cutting his face on a conveyor lever.
An employee was performing maintenance on an industrial printer and suffered the amputation of his right index finger from the knuckle.
An employee was trying to stab a joint of tubing to make a connection. The string of tubing knocked the employee off the rig floor to the ground, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was walking in the dining room, slipped and fell breaking a hip.

An employee was operating a press brake. The parts were being held in place by a magnet near the point of operation to allow for a hands free process. The employee's right hand was caught in the point of operation as the press engaged causing a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee walking in the parking lot slipped on ice and fell breaking his ankle. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was using a bone-in saw to cut a piece of meat. The saw severed a tendon on the top of the employee's right hand, requiring hospitalization and surgical repair.

At 10:30 a.m. on February 23, 2019, an employee of Starfire Corporation sustained a laceration of his leg and burn injuries to his back from the premature ignition of a fireworks shell as he was loading the shell into the mortar tube in preparation for a fireworks aerial display.
An employee was walking through a door. Another employee pushed the same door and hit her on the head. The employee suffered a seizure as a result.
An employee was placing finished goods in the back hallway and was struck by a forklift. The employee suffered a lower left leg injury and a fractured right toe.
An employee was pushing a product through a band saw and suffered a severe laceration to her left pinky finger.
An employee was rotating a compressor flywheel when the first digit of his right index finger was forced against the shaft of the flywheel locking device.
On February 24, 2019, while adding a chemical to a 300-gallon reactor, an employee was exposed to trifluoromethanesulfonate ester and had an allergic reaction. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a pallet jack, lost balance and fell off the pallet jack. The employee was pinned against a wall and suffered a broken foot.
An employee was outside a trailer rolling down its roll-up door. His right middle finger was caught in the door's ridge panel as the door came down, causing an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was feeding bran into a rice mill machine when it became clogged. The machine was turned off. It was still turning as the employee attempted to unclog it and his left right fingertip was amputated.
An employee was opening a horizontal manway on top of a drum using a jack. When the manway opened, the employee's right index finger contacted a valve on the manway causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was bitten by a cat and hospitalized for an infection.

An employee was climbing a light tower on stage during the loadout of a show. The tower began to tip and the employee jumped so it would not fall on him. He landed on the stage more than 10 feet below, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.
On February 25, 2019, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee lacerated their left forearm on a grinding wheel. The employee was cutting a 2" pipe for replacement.
An employee broke his leg while descending from a belt loader to the ground 29 1/2 inches below. He was hospitalized.

After a chipper knife change in the wood yard, employees were rotating the chipper disk to measure the knife clearances. To perform the measurements, the chipper disk is manually rotated to each knife location. To rotate the chipper disk, the injured employee placed his right foot on the card breaker for leverage. The employee's foot slipped and was caught between the card breaker and the feed chute resulting in an avulsion to the top of the foot and two fractured toes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee collapsed while using a ladder in the orange grove. The ladder up against the power lines was seen sparking.
An employee was working on a paving job and was pinned between a paving machine and a dump truck resulting in fractures to the left femur and both ankles.
A derrickman was trying to latch a stand of drill pipe at the derrick board. The stand pulled him off the board, pinning his left forearm against the safety gate and breaking it.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was backing into position. The employee suffered a fractured lower right leg.

An employee was cutting a band from a bundle of 8-inch sewer pipe with a gas-powered chop saw. The saw's diamond blade struck the employee's lower left leg, cutting it and breaking the tibia. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a stand up forklift and contacted the closing brackets on the corrugated baler machine. His left leg was caught between the forklift and the baler causing a fracture and laceration to his ankle and foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a crushing injury to the right hand and arm, broken ribs and lacerations to the arm when his right hand was caught in the cable and drum while troubleshooting a winch.
An employee slipped on ice and fell breaking an ankle.
A security officer sustained a lumbar strain while taking a patient out of restraints and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered amputation of his right pinky finger while working on an oil rig.

Three employees were walking down the stairs. The stairs collapsed and two of the employees were injured. They suffered multiple fractures, contusions, and lacerations to the legs, arms, ankles, back and chest.
A forklift operator's left leg was pinned between the forklift and a racking system.
A truck driver was unloading an auto from the lower level of an auto transport trailer. He fell about 40 inches to the asphalt, suffering lacerations to his left hip and elbow and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was conducting a car check in a snow packed parking lot when he turned or twisted his body and fell to the ground. As a result, the employee suffered a spiral fracture of the left tibia.

An employee was in a weld shop, using a powered metal shear. The employee's fingers were caught in the shear point of the equipment, which amputated the tips of three fingers on his left hand and amputated his right middle finger to the knuckle.
An employee's left hand and right leg were burned by hot plastic when it spilled from an injection molding machine. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the bun molder machine and suffered a left thumb amputation when it was caught in the machine's belt and pulley.
An employee was walking into work, slipped on ice and fell in the parking lot. The employee fractured her right hip.
An employee was clearing snow in the parking lot with a snow blower. The employee slipped and fell breaking his tibia.
While picking up repair parts at a local distributor, an employee slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk. The employee's left leg was broken.
At 7:45 a.m. on February 25, 2019, an employee was working as a well tender when he suffered a head injury.
An employee was sweeping around metal roofing beams when a metal beam collapsed onto the employee's foot fracturing it.
An employee was painting from a bakers scaffold. The scaffold shifted and the employee fell approximately 6 feet to the floor below fracturing their lower back.
An employee slipped and fell on icy ground while unloading a down hole pump off of a trailer. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was riding on the back step of the sanitation truck. When the packer cycled, his right index finger was amputated.

A framing contractor was standing on top of a concrete podium deck on the second floor, working on framing in that area. As he was trying to move a wall, he slipped and fell approximately 10 feet to the first floor, injuring his wrist and lacerating his nose and upper lip.
An employee was picking up debris from a lawn when a tree snapped and fell on her, breaking her knee and injuring her back. She was hospitalized.

An employee was operating the manual fish skinner. The employee's glove was caught in the skinning device and the side of her right pinky finger was skinned. Her hand then rotated resulting in a laceration to the top of her right hand.

An employee noticed a blockage in an auger system while delivering grain to an offsite customer. The auger caught her hand against the side of the trough, causing the amputation of the tip of her little finger.
An employee was helping to free a stuck shot tip and was struck by the automated ladling system. The molten metal caused second and third degree burns to his right shoulder, back, neck and face.
An employee was cutting wood material with a table-mounted radial arm saw. The saw blade amputated the employee's thumb.
An employee was moving a plastic bead box weighing about 5 pounds. He tripped over a pipe stub and fell, landing on his tape measure. He suffered a broken left leg that required surgery.
A carpenter was on top of a one-story warehouse, moving roof panels during roof installation. He fell through a skylight and suffered rib fractures. He was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding the first joint of casing into a conductor in a cellar area. A centralizer (secured around a pipe) was pushed through the rotary table. The centralizer slid down the pipe and caught the employee's left ring finger against the collar on the casing. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
While changing a propane tank, an employee was struck by a forklift. The employee suffered significant swelling on the right leg from the hip to the knee and was hospitalized.
While walking out of a stock room, an employee tripped on the rubber transition piece between the concrete floor and a carpet. The employee fell, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was using a brake press to flatten a part. When the machine cycled, his right thumb was pinched between the part and the ram and the thumb tip was lacerated.
A tree blew over in the wind, striking the arm and head of a postal worker who was delivering mail. The postal worker suffered fractured vertebrae.
An employee was taping drywall on stilts. The employee tripped on an electrical cord and fell to the ground, suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee tripped and fell while coming out of a walk-in refrigerator, suffering six broken ribs.

An electrician was taking out an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) system. One of the systems was set on the ground by an aerial lift. While the second system was being set on the ground, the employee was walking between the two systems. One of the units fell on him trapping him between the two systems. The employee suffered an ear injury, a broken jaw and a broken leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting the actuator on the metal detector in-line unit. The valve was stuck open. The employee's right index finger was inside the valve when the pneumatics were activated and the ball closed on his finger. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
On February 24, 2019, an employee was assisting a resident and fell. The employee's leg was caught between the resident, mattress and floor resulting in a fractured tibia.

On February 25, 2019, at approximately 11:30 AM, an associate was carrying an empty pharmacy tote through an open doorway. The tote struck the door causing the associate to fall backwards onto her hip and leg. She was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a telehandler onto a flatbed trailer to transport it to the next jobsite. The employee was backing the telehandler off the trailer to realign it. While backing up, two tires slipped off the trailer causing the telehandler to tip over on to its side and fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken pelvis, bruised ribs, and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were in a trailer. A lit cigarette ignited gas that had leaked from a propane tank in the trailer, causing an explosion. Both employees suffered second-and third- degree burns to the hands, arms, and face.

An employee was cutting the edges of paper between the rolls at a winding machine using a utility knife. His right index finger was caught in the ingoing nip point between the drum and the core, causing an amputation at the knuckle.
An employee pushed an unloaded pallet into a bin pallet stock/storage area (pallet flow slot return) for reprocessing, then fell to the wood floor, breaking her left hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was on the back of a waste management truck when it was rear-ended by a pickup truck. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to open an air valve for a machine being operated. His left hand was caught on a drill bit and the glove he was wearing was twisted and torn off, causing an open fracture of the left little finger and amputation of the last joint.

An employee was using a dipper (a 5-foot pole with a cup) to retrieve molten metal from a gas rotary furnace. The metal splashed him, setting his cotton overalls on fire and causing burns to the left side of his torso and left arm.
An employee was trying to straighten a piece of metal on a belted table. A roller caught his left index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee slipped or tripped in a hospital parking lot on the way to the building. She fell to the ground and broke her left tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder doing drywall work. He fell, suffering a broken left arm and a cut on the forehead above the left eye.
A nail gun shot a nail into an employee's right knee.
An employee was trying to move a fixture for a B-52 strut. The fixture was on a pallet. The fixture roller crushed the employee's right little finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was standing between the carriage and the machine frame to change a water rinse bath on an auto plating line. The carriage began moving and the employee's head was crushed between the carriage and the plating line frame, causing a skull fracture and a partial ear avulsion.
An employee was working on the warehouse dock. As he stepped from the dock into a tractor trailer he fell and injured his right knee.
On March 5, 2019, an employee slipped on a shallow patch of oil/water mixture on a garage floor. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
Wear plates for a mixer were being manufactured. The bit that was used to punch holes shattered and a fragment of it lodged in an employee's neck.
