An employee slipped and fell on an icy walking surface.
An employee suffered a broken right leg when his weight shifted.

While preparing a gizzard machine for cleaning, an employee suffered amputations to the right middle and ring fingers, as well as an index finger injury that required nailbed repair. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was riding on the back of the truck and amputated his right middle finger in the cart tipper.
An employee choked on water and fell. The employee's head struck the floor. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 5, 2019, an employee was working near the chain driven conveyor (near the front line) when the glove on their left hand was pulled in by the conveyor chain. The employee sustained the amputation of two left fingertips.

An employee was on a ladder trying to remove a concrete form from a grain silo that was being built. The form shifted, causing the employee to fall to the ground about 8 feet below. His ankle was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A city mail carrier slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking a leg.

An employee was connecting railcars. The employee's right foot/ankle was caught between the railcar connection devices, causing crushing injuries that required hospitalization and surgical amputation.

An employee was next to a mini-excavator when its control handles caught his coat. The excavator activated, causing the employee to fall, and its track then ran over and broke his right foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw. The saw blade cut his left middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was cutting on a dry bulk trailer with a 6-inch grinder. The grinder kicked back and cut off his left index finger at the second knuckle, as well as lacerating his palm. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was soldering parts together. A cable was tangled around her right foot, under her desk; when she stood, she lost her balance and fell, dislocating her left knee.
An employee was performing maintenance on an air-gate. The door of the gate closed on the employee's hand, amputating the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee was torch-cutting steel coils when a piece of steel coil fell and struck the employee, breaking the employee's leg.

On March 6, 2019, an employee was assisting in rigging up. He was working from about 10 feet high when he slipped and fell, his face striking the beam he was standing on. He suffered a facial injury and was hospitalized. Fall protection was being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving windows when a window slipped and pinned his left hand to the floor, causing the amputation of his left ring finger at the base.

On March 6, 2019, an employee was working in a trench when a 20-inch-thick gas pipe slid off a skid and fell into the trench. It struck the employee, injuring the employee's ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was loading a medical laser when it fell onto his stomach, causing an umbilical hernia.

An employee was working on a delinting machine when a newly added belt caused the machine to begin wobbling. The employee turned off the machine and tried to remove the belt, which caught and broke the employee's right ring finger.
As it backed up, a mini excavator ran over an employee's left leg and broke it.

On March 6, 2019, an employee was working from the third or fourth step of a ladder, installing steel on a horse barn. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken wrist and arm, and was hospitalized.
An employee was about to preheat 1-inch carbon steel with an oxygen/propylene torch. The torch caught fire, and the heat caused second-degree burns to the employee's hand through the leather glove.
A safe closed on an employee's left thumb, causing an amputation between the thumbnail and the first joint.
While administering dialysis to a patient, an employee tripped over a machine cord and fell to the floor, suffering a leg injury.
A police officer was on a roof during his rounds. He slipped and a closing door ripped the fourth finger off his left hand.

An employee was cleaning up around a sawmill, throwing logs onto a long-log chain-conveyor. The nip point between a metal trough and a log caught his right index finger, causing a partial amputation at the first joint.
An employee was stocking shelves when an electric pallet jack injured his foot.
An employee was performing setup procedures on explosives production equipment when some extra energetic residue in the area ignited. The employee's hands, back, and forearm were burned.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a tray cart. One of the trays struck a beam and pushed back into his hand, pinching his right middle fingertip against the push handle. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning his handgun when it fired into his left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was about 6 feet up on an order picker, trying to reach a case. The employee fell from the machine to the rack below, suffering broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while picking up a package. He suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was spot-welding an "eye" onto a prefabricated wire ladder. The wire machine amputated his left thumb.
An employee was in a truck bay, servicing 18-wheeler trucks. A propane heater ignited an oil rag on his clothes, causing third-degree burns on his front and back. He was hospitalized.
A powered industrial truck ran over an employee's foot, injuring it.

A Trinidad employee was helping pull a winch line with an attached hook through the substructure of a drilling rig. The hook snagged on part of the substructure, causing the line to tighten. The line was lying across the employee's foot, which it crushed and lacerated as it tightened.

An employee was preparing some food in a nursing facility's kitchen. The employee fell on a slippery surface, landing on the floor and suffering a broken right shoulder, right arm, right foot, and left knee.
A powered industrial truck ran over an employee's foot as she walked past it.
An employee was moving equipment when a J-hook came loose and struck his left leg, breaking his femur.

An employee was performing maintenance on a backhoe, removing a hydraulic hose. The right valve released hydraulic fluid under pressure. His hand was scraped, and an amount of hydraulic fluid got under his skin.
An employee was loading steel beams onto a flatbed truck using a crane. The controls pinched and amputated his right ring finger.
At about 10:00 a.m. on March 6, 2019, an employee was opening the doors of a trailer when a pallet of freight fell out. The freight struck the employee, causing a broken ankle and leg.

A maintenance technician was trying to free a piece of metal lodged in a metal roll former. The machine engaged and crushed the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers. The ring finger was amputated.

An employee went to the bank for the employer and was driving back to the employer's facility when a vape pen battery reacted with change in his pocket, causing his pants to catch on fire. His leg and hands were burned and he was hospitalized.
Employees were cutting and bending metal using a manual sheet metal brake. The brake closed on an employee's left hand, causing the amputation of the index fingertip.
A mechanic was installing wheel studs when a tool popped out of place and hit him in the jaw, dislocating and breaking it.

Employees were trying to raise the elevation of a working platform turntable. A crane lifting the table applied too much upward pull to it before the pins that would release it were removed. An employee on the turntable was flung off when it broke free from its concrete anchors. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken lower right leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a conveyor when his right hand was caught between the conveyor frame and the crush roll. His hand was broken.
An employee was repairing a machine. A moving gear caught his sleeve and amputated part of his right little finger.
An employee was disposing of liquid from an empty cryovac package of pork. He slipped on liquid on the floor, landed on his left side, and broke his left hip.
An employee suffered chest pains after shoveling snow off the shop entrance.
A pallet vendor was counting pallets in an aisle when a forklift struck him, breaking his left leg.
An employee and his supervisor were arguing on a loading dock when his supervisor pushed past him. He fell off the dock onto the ground below, suffering a broken hip.
An employee tripped over the safety guardrail near the floor at the end of a storage rack system, breaking her right ankle. She was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was taking a measurement using a micrometer while material moved toward a traction roller. His right little finger was caught on the strip line and amputated; his right ring finger was lacerated.
An employee was marking out roof beam locations and fell off the roof. The employee sustained rib fractures.
An employee was using a driveline tool to make repairs to a truck. The tool fell onto his knee, breaking his femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a new AC motor on a sheller. The come-along chain was pulled into the conveyor below and pulled the chain down onto the employee's left hand, amputating the middle and index fingers.
A kitchen cook was cleaning a meat slicer when the pad of her right index finger was amputated.
An employee was on a ladder replacing ceiling tiles. The employee fell while descending the ladder and injured their elbow. The injury required surgery.
An employee was installing a cover in a sand machine. The cover shifted, causing the amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was unloading lumber from a trailer. As he was getting down from the truck, his right knee was caught between a nearby forklift cage and the edge of the trailer. He suffered a broken right knee and was hospitalized.

An employee was sandblasting sheets on the ground. The sandblaster was low on media, and the employee released the trigger to refill it. The hose applied pressure to the employee's wrist, which twisted toward the employee's upper leg and hip. The sandblaster then shot media into the employee's midsection, causing a laceration between the hip and leg.
An employee had placed UHMW (ultra-high molecular weight) tube material on a mandrel, then turned on the equipment. The rotating mandrel caught his sleeve and the tube material broke his left arm.
An employee was raising the dock plate at a receiving dock. The employee's finger was crushed in a pinch point, suffering a partial amputation.
An employee's left index fingertip was caught between two horizontal product trucks, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a demolition saw to cut pipe. The saw bucked back, lacerating his neck.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to the environment and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while carrying boxes, rolling her ankle and falling. She suffered stomach pains and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to disconnect the chain from a birdbath that was still connected to the stinger of a loader. The loader began to back away from the birdbath, which was pulled onto the employee's legs. Both of his lower legs were broken.
Employees were attempting to dislodge a flow line from a hand rail. The rail came loose and fell on the employee's thumb, crushing it.
An employee's right hand and arm were caught by a fiber fine opener machine. The arm was amputated just above the elbow.
A door closed on an employee's left hand, causing the amputation of the tip of the little finger.
While processing meat on a fab line, an employee suffered a stab wound to the left calf.

At about 6:00 p.m. on March 7, 2019, an employee was performing preventive maintenance on fans/belts on the HVAC system. He was working on a vertical stack of components that included four belts, working from top to bottom. The bottom belt pulled in his left hand, causing the partial amputation of three fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a chair, filling the ice bend of a soda fountain. The chair slid out from under her and she fell, breaking her ankle.

An employee was mowing the ground using a riding mower. When he placed his hand on a branch to avoid hitting his head, the mower slipped toward the tree. As a result, the employee suffered a right middle finger amputation.
An employee fell from the step of a truck to the ground, breaking his right leg.
An employee was moving a cart down an aisle in the stockroom to pull product. A block riser fell from the top shelf of the cart, striking the employee on the head and causing a contusion.
A closing toolbox lid caught an employee's left index finger, causing the amputation of the tip.

At about 10:45 a.m. on March 7, 2019, an employee was at the back of a printing press, where dried paper had wrapped around a carrying roll. He was 3 feet up a 6-foot ladder, removing the stuck paper, when he fell to the cement floor, encountering wall-mounted valves, a metal catch tray on the floor, and a metal grating. He suffered back pain and two lacerations, one to the back of the head and one on the left elbow. Each laceration required stitches.
An employee was trimming from the basket of an aerial lift. The basket tipped and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken femur.
While walking to a conveyor, an employee tripped over a yellow metal guard on the floor. The employee suffered an injury to the right knee.

An employee was on the roof of a nursing facility, replacing an air filter. The roof was completely covered with snow. The employee fell through a skylight and landed on the ground level about 12 feet below, breaking his left ankle.

An employee was rigging up the head section of a bucket elevator for installation. The forklift holding one side of the load shifted, causing the head section to twist. The employee fell 15 feet to the ground, hitting concrete.
Three employees were unloading bundled windows from a box truck. The windows tilted over and fell, striking one of the employees on the right leg below the knee and breaking it.
An employee was walking on a wood 2-by-4 when the wood broke and he fell to the ground about 10 feet below, suffering a right ankle fracture.
An employee suffered frostbite on his left little toe after spending most of the day outside pumping gas. The toe had to be amputated.
An employee was making a cardboard bale when he started to experience chest pains.
Am employee slipped on a piece of cardboard and fell to the floor, breaking his right hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into a garage area. The handle of a closing door caught his jacket cuff and his right index finger was caught in the door. The tip was amputated (without loss of bone).
An employee was hoisting hides with a hoist attached to a support beam. The beam failed and fell, striking the employee in the head and breaking the employee's jaw. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a shopping cart when she tripped on an anti-theft alarm post at an entrance doorway. She fell, breaking her left hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift when its hydraulic hose became bound. While the employee was trying to remove the hose, the forklift's mast chain moved, causing an amputation to the employee's left thumb to the first joint.

At about 1:15 p.m. on March 8, 2019, an employee was loading grain decks onto a trailer. He fell off the end of one grain deck onto another deck, striking his head, arm, and lower leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on stilts when he tripped and fell to the ground, breaking his hip.
An employee was being lowered on a forklift man basket when the hydraulic mechanism of the forklift pinched the employee's right pinky finger, amputating it at the top knuckle.
While walking out from behind a counter, an employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee fell off the edge of a platform to the ground about 32 feet below. He suffered a broken arm, leg and pelvis. A harness was not being worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was sweeping a floor to remove lime. The employee was hospitalized with lime dust irritation in the eyes.
An employee was setting up the butt welder to weld a cable. The employee's right hand was in the point of operation when the butt welder clamp activated, amputating two fingertips.
An employee was inside the rear of an 18-wheel truck unloading freight when he fell from the truck onto the ground below. He was hospitalized with a left elbow fracture.
An employee was walking out of the cooler in a meat department. He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his right femur. He was hospitalized.
While exiting an excavator, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken tibia that required surgery.

An employee fell through a sheet-metal-covered opening to the concrete floor below. He landed on his feet, then fell down. He suffered soreness, pain, and difficulty putting weight on his feet and was hospitalized.
Plant maintenance workers were disassembling some machinery in a plant. A conveyor tipped, lacerating an employee's forearm.

Two employees were in the bucket of a bucket truck energizing a 13,800-to-2,400-volt stepdown transformer by closing three 100k fused cutouts at the riser pole. A voltage meter used to take readings on the ground was overloaded and failed, causing an arc flash. One of the employees in the bucket suffered first- and second-degree burns to both wrists, the face, the neck, and the ears and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a forklift unload a metal bin filled with mill scale. When the load was lowered, it slid off the forks and landed on the employee's left index finger, causing the amputation of the tip.
An employee was installing a counterweight on a laser machine when it dropped onto the employee's toe. The employee suffered bruising and cuts.
An employee was respooling wire coming from a press. His left hand was caught between the wire and the wire guide pulley, and the ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a bottle descrambler. A bottle flew at him and as he tried to deflect the bottle away his right hand was caught in the machine resulting in amputation of the ring fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was re-threading a roll of paper at a paper treating line. His right forearm was caught and broken between two rollers moving in opposite directions.

An employee was cleaning concrete off an aluminum formwork panel and placed it on the ground. Another panel carried by a forklift had gotten stuck on some steel rebar. It fell and hit another panel, causing it to fall and strike the employee.

An employee was holding a crane lifting chain while the load was starting to be lifted. When the chain tightened, the employee's thumb was caught in the chain, resulting in a partial amputation and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift when it pinned his left foot against the steel post of some industrial shelving. His ankle was broken.

At about 2:14 p.m. on March 9, 2019, two employees were taking recycling outside on a receiving dock. One of the employees fell off the dock onto her back, hitting her head on the concrete below. She was hospitalized.

An employee was bringing a group of cows to the milking parlor and walking them down a ramp walkway when a bull came up and pushed him against a concrete wall, then lifted him up and over the wall onto the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and fractured lower vertebrae.
An employee was trying to apprehend a fleeing subject, who fell on the employee's right leg. The employee's leg was broken.
While climbing a ladder to clear a baggage jam, an employee fell to the concrete floor, suffering a head injury and losing consciousness. He was hospitalized.

On March 9, 2019, an employee was repairing a splice when the transfer rollers came down and caught his head between a drum and a transfer roll. The employee suffered fractures to the right eye socket, nose, and jaw. He was hospitalized.
While closing up a cargo bin, an employee fell about 6 feet from a belt loader to the ground, suffering a head injury.

An employee was unjamming a push rod on a loader. The employee's left middle finger was caught in a pinch point between the loader and the loading ram. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was leaving her car when she slipped on ice, fell on her back (suffering a herniated disk), and lost consciousness.

An employee was pulling a nylon sling up from between loose pieces of material in a bundle cart. The bundle cart tipped over, and seven loose pieces of tubing fell from it to the ground about 30 inches below, then rolled into the employee's left ankle/foot. The employee was pinched between the tubing and a stack of material.
An employee was getting a cooler from the passenger side of his truck. He fell to the ground below, breaking his left hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hooking up a chain under a metal floor base. The floor slipped and smashed three fingers on the employee's right hand, breaking them.
An employee was pulling a baggage cart toward a belt loader. The tongue of the baggage cart struck his right middle finger against the belt loader, amputating it at the first knuckle.

A truck driver was parked and waiting outside on the back platform of his truck. The truck was rear-ended by another truck, and the employee fell down on his empty trailer bed, suffering a head injury.
An employee fell about 13 feet from a mezzanine to the concrete ground floor, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee fell from the fourth rung of a ladder to the ground below, breaking his left forearm.

An employee was using a 6-foot breaker bar to demolish an old concrete sidewalk when the concrete slipped off the excavator forks, causing the breaker bar to pop up. Concrete hit the employee in the chin and Adam's apple area, lacerating his neck and knocking him unconscious.
An employee was feeding 8-foot lumber into a pop-up chop saw. As he pushed the lumber up to make the second cut, the saw engaged and amputated the tips of his left index and middle fingers.
A store patron struck an employee in the jaw.

At about 11:20 a.m. on March 9, 2019, an employee and his employer were working on the roof of a new construction structure. They were installing paper in the roof when both slipped and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered massive bleeding from the head and severe bruises on his left shoulder.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw when it cut the tips of the employee's fingers, causing a thumb laceration and a partial amputation to the index finger.

BMWC employees were unloading 18-inch pipe from a trailer and placing it on the ground. The pipe began to roll, trapped an employee's foot, and rolled up onto his leg, breaking his tibia. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on tarmac between airport gates when he slipped on ice. He suffered a torn left quadriceps and a broken patella.
A forklift operator stepped off his forklift and it ran over his foot, breaking his ankle.
An employee suffered a broken rib and lacerated liver in an altercation with a group home client.
An employee was helping put a scrubber machine away when he felt a strain and pain in his elbow.
While walking on base, an employee slipped on ice and fell backwards. The employee's head struck the ground. The employee suffered a concussion and a laceration to the back of the head.
On March 10, 2019, an employee was getting off an order picker when a high-reach lift came around the corner, striking the employee and breaking bones in his ankle.
An employee was changing a blade on a kitchen appliance when the blade lacerated the employee's hand.
An employee was moving a cart when a pole hit her hand, breaking and lacerating it.
An employee was assisting with oil well rig-down when the rigging equipment failed. The employee was struck by a sheave, suffering broken vertebrae and ribs.
An employee experienced abdominal pain due to a hernia while hose washing the promenade.
An employee was cleaning out a trash can with bleach. The bleach reacted with some residual descaling solution in the can; the employee was hospitalized to treat chemical inhalation.
An employee was operating a chuck saw when it lacerated two of the employee's fingers, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder repairing a light fixture. The employee fell from the ladder, suffering broken shoulder blades, broken ribs, and a bulging lower-back vertebra.
An employee was servicing a pneumatic pump. After he attached an air hose, the air control valve caught his right middle finger, causing a partial tip amputation with no bone loss.
An employee tripped over carpet, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was climbing a 35-foot ladder. He slipped and fell from about 12 feet up, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip and a facial laceration.
An employee was working with a manual core blowing machine with a sliding door. The platen came down on her finger, causing a partial amputation to the right thumb.

An employee was pulling a tarp over a semi truck load when he fell from the trailer's platform to the ground 4 to 6 feet below. He suffered fractures to the head of his left humerus and his left elbow.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was unjamming an obstructed tube in a donut injector. The machine cycled, pinching her index finger and amputating the tip.
An employee was loading propane into a tanker truck at the end of the day. When the fill valve was opened, propane from the hose hit the employee on the left side of his chest, causing a cold burn.
After retrieving a part from a shelf, an employee fell from a ladder to the floor. The employee suffered a broken elbow and broken ribs.
While walking out of a job trailer, an employee slipped on ice and fell on his back, suffering broken lower-back vertebrae.
An employee tripped over a concrete parking stop and fell, breaking her left arm.
An employee performing patient care tripped and fell over a blanket to the floor, resulting in a broken left hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was dismantling a stage at the convention center when the stage fell onto the employee's foot, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was walking toward a 3-foot-high pile of new power poles. The pile shifted and a pole rolled up onto the employee's left foot, breaking bones. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on an icy walkway while entering a job site. He fell to the ground, suffering a leg fracture that required surgery.

An employee was operating a pallet truck. As he was turning into an aisle from the south dry dock, he struck a guard rail with his right hand, causing the pallet jack to come to a full and complete stop that thrust him forward off the machine. As he fell from the machine, he held onto the throttle. His left foot and leg were then pinned against a rack. He was hospitalized with a crushed right hand, left leg laceration, and fractured fibula.
An employee was walking from her car when she fell onto a concrete curb, suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell on ice while walking into a facility where he was scheduled to conduct maintenance on machinery. He broke his leg in two places.

On the morning of 3/11/2019, a temporary employee working for Deventry, was working on an exterior facade that was located on the rear of the school on top of a lower roof using a 16' extension ladder. The employee fell approximately 10 feet from the ladder and struck his head on the lower roof.

On March 11, 2019, an employee was checking a jet nut on a roll forming machine. The nut and its shaft rotated, and his right ring finger was pinched between his Allen wrench and a guide rail within the machine. The fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee had arrived at a patient's home and was preparing to deliver oxygen and durable medical equipment to the patient when the employee slipped on ice or snow and impacted the ground, fracturing the right tibia and fibula.
An employee fell from an 8-foot step ladder, suffering a broken right lower leg.
An employee was helping a customer unload granite/quartz slabs from the bed of his truck. A slab tilted and fell toward him. He jumped from the trailer to the ground, breaking his leg.

A crane operator was cleaning the outside of a deck crane. He tripped and fell from the back of the crane to the ground floor about 6 feet below. He suffered six broken ribs on his left side, a punctured left lung, and a broken pelvis.
An aerial forklift struck an employee as it backed up, breaking his right leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A crane operator was doing rigging work on the deck of a crane. He fell off the deck to the ground 5 to 6 feet below and broke his right femur. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

As part of a performance dexterity test, an employee exited a bus via the back emergency door: she opened the door, sat down, scooted out the door, and landed on her feet. She then fell forward, landing on her front on the parking lot pavement. Able to sit up, but not get up, she was hospitalized.

An employee was checking a pressure washer motor belt's tightness when the motor energized, catching the employee's right index finger in the belt and pulley. The employee's right index finger was amputated.
While refilling a condiment station in a dining room, an employee slipped and fell, breaking his hip.
A truck driver slipped as he got out of his truck, falling to the ground and suffering a hip injury.
An employee was operating a mulch grinder in a landfill. The grinder jammed and the employee was caught between the mill and the chain, suffering a broken pelvis.

Four employees were working inside the shop on a propane tank. They were removing a valve from the propane tank when the gas filled the workspace and ignited. One employee was burned and required hospitalization.
An employee was standing up when he tripped over the leg of his chair. He fell to the floor, breaking his left hip.
An employee was walking back to their desk, tripped over an ergonomic mat on the floor and fell striking their right hip on the back of a desk. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee fell while walking down an operating room hallway, striking her head on the wall and suffering a head injury.

In the feed mill warehouse, an employee was leaning up against a 36" industrial wall fan. The fan blade sliced through the steel enclosure and lacerated the employee's right palm. The employee was hospitalized.
While taking trash to a dumpster, an employee slipped on black ice and fell. The employee suffered a broken left leg and underwent ankle surgery.

An employee was lifting a piece of steel weighing approximately 100 lbs. onto the work bench utilizing a magnetic lifting device attached to a jib crane. When the employee began to move the piece of steel, it fell from the magnet and struck the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized for foot fractures.

An employee was using a table saw to make an angle cut on a trim board. The board jumped as he pushed it, causing his left hand to come into contact with the sawblade. His middle, ring, and little fingers were lacerated; he was hospitalized, and the ring finger was medically amputated just below the first knuckle.

An employee was using a knuckle boom to clear hurricane debris. A log slid off the grapple bucket and hit him in the face, knocking him out of his seat. He fell about 15 feet to the ground. He suffered a traumatic brain injury, a broken wrist, and other injuries.
An employee was doing a demonstration on how to perform a compact jump. When she jumped into the water, she struck the bottom of the pool and fractured her tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking through the office area when she stumbled and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee had completed routine reduction cell skimming prior to installation of a new carbon anode. He had exited the catwalk and immediate work area to store tools and cool off when he discovered his shirts were on fire. He suffered third and second degree burns across the lower back, upper left back, and right arm, as well as additional burns to the left-hand fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it struck a sit-down forklift. The sit-down forklift's forks struck his right foot, causing lacerations and possible broken bones requiring surgery.

An employee was measuring a section of boat. He was stepping onto the lower swim platform when he lost balance and tried to grab the boat's boarding ladder to brace himself. He fell approximately 7 feet to the cement ground below, landing on his feet and breaking both heels.
An employee opened an interlocked guard door and caught their hand in a pinch point causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking into the lobby of the building, tripped and fell.

An employee was helping an equipment operator remove the cover and dye roll on a rotary machine. The employee's hand slipped on a fixed roller and came into contact with a knife edge. Two fingertips on the employee's left hand were amputated.
A maintenance employee was fixing a chain on a conveyor line when the equipment restarted and amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was installing new wire during construction of a residential townhome and contacted a live pedestal buss bar resulting in electrocution. The employee was wearing flame resistant clothing and electrical protector gloves at the time.

An employee was doing preventative maintenance on a forklift and was checking the fuel regulator on the unit. After cleaning the filter, the employee popped the bolts off the cover of the regulator and the propane blew up in his face. He suffered chemical burns to the left side of his face and both eyes.

An employee was preparing to load asphalt into a truck. The employee was about to line up the hose into the opening of the truck when the asphalt in the tanker flashed causing second degree burns to the employee's face and arms.

On March 12, 2019, a Trillium Farms maintenance employee was cutting a T-shaped piece of plastic with a table saw. The blade amputated the employee's right index finger. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee was pushing a 3-foot ductile steel pipe into an excavator bucket and felt a pop in his lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a fill plug from the differential on a heavy loader. Hot oil causing second degree burns to the employee's left hand and right arm.
An employee was operating a forklift and pinned his left foot between the forklift and a metal rack causing a fracture to his left ankle that required surgery.
While walking across a warehouse, an employee was struck by a forklift and fell over. The forklift then ran over the employee's right foot, breaking it.

An employee had been cutting a plastic sheet using a panel saw. As he was picking up the pieces he had cut off, the saw grabbed his left glove and pulled his thumb into the blade, resulting in an amputation between the nail and the joint.
An employee fell off an 18-foot-tall tanker to the concrete floor, suffering a broken skull and five broken ribs.

An employee was suspending a pour pot above an open kettle of hot tar when the wire broke and the pour pot fell into the kettle, splashing hot tar on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the face and neck.
An employee was cutting baseboard with a chop saw and amputated a finger.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck picker to retrieve a shower door. The employee fell from the picker to the ground about 8 feet below. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered brain bruising and a nosebleed.
An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum of malt liquid weighing 655 pounds. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the drum and a frame, causing a partial fingertip amputation.
Employees were conducting rigging operations and lifting a 350-pound lug when it swung unexpectedly and struck the injured employee in the lower left leg, fracturing it.

An employee was working at a well site where tubing was being pulled. As a block was being lowered to place a tube, the brake handle broke, allowing the block to fall down to the decking where the employee was working. The employee was struck by the block or other materials falling from about 6 to 10 feet above. He suffered a head laceration.
An employee was adjusting a jammed machine when his finger was amputated.

An employee was cutting a recessed cabinet panel on a table saw. The panel jammed and then quickly slipped forward into the blade. The employee's hand was in-line with the saw blade as the panel slipped forward and the employee sustained a left fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was closing a large sliding door when it closed on his right hand, causing a right ring fingertip amputation.
On March 12, 2019, an employee suffered a finger amputation on a powered hand tool/appliance.
An employee was cutting wood down to size when the sawblade cut his left hand.
An employee lacerated and sustained multiple fractures to his left foot while clearing a jam on a block machine.
An employee placed the wire mesh into the wire trim machine. His left middle and ring fingers were amputated when the machine was activated.

An employee was working with a team to lift and move a metal skylight curb. The curb slipped and while the employee tried to stabilize it, the metal corner of the curb lacerated his forearm/wrist area.
An opened valve sprayed hot, hexamethylene diamine (HMD) onto an employee, causing second-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.

An electric hand grinder was being used to cut an empty metal 55-gallon drum that had held motor oil. The drum exploded. The employee suffered a broken facial bone, moderate burns on the side of the face, and burns to the esophagus and lungs.

An employee was walking up the sidewalk to a patient's home on an uneven, cracked concrete surface. She stepped in a crack and fell, suffering an open fracture of the lower left leg. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning a lot with an excavator. As he was pulling down branches, a tree limb came through the windshield and smashed his right leg, perforating the skin.
An employee was backing up a forklift when his right hand was caught between its cage and a pallet of plywood. His middle and little fingers were amputated above the knuckles.

An employee was driving a tractor along a farm road to collect bags of garbage. She stepped off the tractor and grabbed a trash bag from the ground. While getting back onto the tractor, she slipped and fell. The tractor tire ran over her leg, breaking it.

An employee was loading pipe onto a truck using an overhead crane with chains as the lifting attachment. The chain slipped while the employee's hand was on the chain amputating the left ring finger at the first knuckle.
A technician was removing wiring when his right arm came into contact with an energized bus carrying 277 volts AC to ground. He was shocked.
An employee was trying to latch a waste container door. The door opening caught his left little fingertip, crushing/cutting it.

A temporary employee was working at the plating line to prepare parts for the plating process. He was dipping hooks into a bath solution to remove oil from their surfaces for further production handling. His left hand was pulled into a hot (180 degrees) 4% caustic solution bath and suffered second degree burns. The employee was wearing gloves at the time.

An employee was moving the floor scrubber to an area of the warehouse to drain the water reservoir. He opened the door and proceeded to move the floor scrubber towards the door. The scrubber fell out of the door and the employee jumped off of the scrubber and landed on his right elbow and side causing a right elbow fracture and bruising on the right side of his body.
While trying to free a semi's landing gear (which had been frozen to the ground), an employee suffered an abdominal strain. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking a process line when a liquid pulp container blew up, causing second degree burns to the employee's arms, legs, and back.
An employee was attaching a trailer to an electronic cart and he severely lacerated his left index finger.

On March 13, 2019, at approximately 6:45 p.m., a temporary employee was setting up a new job on the sheet metal cutting machine when his fingers contacted the blade, resulting in a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation of the left ring finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was a passenger in a dock cart when it struck the rear of a forklift. The employee's left leg was pinned between the cart and the forklift, sustaining a fracture and vascular damage.
An employee tripped and fell while arriving at a patient's home, breaking her kneecap.
An employee was walking along the slope of a trench and jumped towards a ladder causing fractures on right leg.
An employee fell 4-5 feet off the back of a truck and struck the back of his head. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was loosening a fixture (a piece of metal weighing about 30 pounds) that held steel rolls on a lathe. The fixture fell on his right index finger, causing an amputation of the tip.
An employee was disarming safety and arming devices when detonators exploded, causing burns and lacerations to both the employee's hands.
An employee slipped while climbing into a truck cab, falling to the ground and breaking his right arm in three places.
A truck driver slipped and fell while getting onto a truck, breaking his arm in three places.
While moving a traffic barrel/drum, an employee fell into an open manhole. His left tibia was broken in the 2-foot fall.
A piece of a tree that had grown into a service drop was removed. It came loose and fell, striking an employee on the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal when the metal became stuck and created a pinch point that caused the amputation of the right index finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor when the employee's finger entered a nip point on the conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The equipment was not de-energized at the time.
An employee was loading a truck when a piece of bar stock slipped pinching his right thumb between two pieces of bar stock (1.5" diameter; 21 feet long). The employee sustained a partial amputation.
An employee fell down stairs and was injured, suffering bleeding in the brain.
A temporary employee was watching another, full-time employee adjust a whipped topping machine. Rotating parts in the machine amputated the tip of the temporary employee's thumb.

A temporary employee was operating a forklift with a dumping attachment. The mast extended in the air during a sharp turn, causing the forklift to tip onto its side. The employee suffered a broken foot.
An employee was troubleshooting a soap stamping machine. The stamper cycled crushing his right hand and wrist.
A piece of equipment fell on an employee's little finger, breaking it. He was hospitalized.

At about 12:30 on March 13, 2019, an employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder, reached the third or fourth rung, and opened a light fixture lens cover to replace the light bulb. The light fixture (and an 18-by-7-foot section of the T-bar ceiling) fell and knocked the employee off the ladder. He suffered a concussion.
While cleaning floors, an employee was caught in a candy manufacturing machine. He suffered broken ribs and crushing injuries to his chest and arms.
An employee was struck by an automobile while retrieving shopping carts in the store's parking lot, suffering multiple injuries.
An employee was leaning on a guardrail when it broke and he fell approximately 10 feet, breaking his arm and ankle.
An employee was walking down a slope when he hit ice, fell to the concrete, and broke his right arm in seven places. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift to stack pallets. While the employee was backing up, the forklift began to fall from the loading dock. He attempted to dismount the forklift, but it pinned his leg and knee. He was later hospitalized for a blood clot in his leg.

An employee was waiting for water to come through the trench drain and then across to him in the wastewater treatment area. Since the water was not coming through the wastewater treatment area, the employee determined the transfer line must be clogged, so he added steam to try to clear the line. The hose popped out of the discharge line in the pit and sprayed the employee with hot steam. He suffered burns to the wrists and abdomen.
An employee slipped on a metal bar inside a truck trailer, suffering a knee injury.

An employee was on top of a trailer, leveling out product. He stepped over a gap about 18 inches wide and fell about 11 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a broken left hip; his spleen was removed.

An employee was using a fusion machine and attempting to clamp a pipe when the machine's vise arm closed and the employee's finger was caught in a shear point of the clamp arm. The employee received a partial finger amputation.

An employee was checking moisture on the sheet conveyor belt. The employee's left hand was pulled between the two conveyor belts and pinched between a roller. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a muscle injury. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee's foot/toes were caught between a moving lift truck and angle iron. The employee's left big toe was crushed, resulting in its amputation.

An employee was trying to push a stuck stack of cardboard from one conveyor belt line to the next. The first line reversed and the employee's left foot was caught between the two lines, sustaining a fracture and laceration.
An employee was struck by a car while doing road construction, suffering an amputation.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his elbow and pelvis.
An employee was removing jammed blanks from a picker head assembly. The machine was jogged, causing the amputation of the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee's left ring finger was amputated in a nip point between rollers.

An employee was serving as a lookout for a forklift operator who was picking up steel beams to move them on the job site. The forklift arm caught something on the ground and caused the load to bounce. When the load bounced, the beams toppled over. The employee was then pinned between a steel beam and a vehicle, suffering a cut to the upper left leg and bruising on the upper right leg.

On March 14, 2019, an employee stepped on a 36" high pallet to observe a part stored on an upper rack. The employee slipped and fell from the pallet and the stored part fell and struck/grazed the employee's head, causing a skull fracture.
While lifting a box that weighed 34.4 pounds, an employee twisted and experienced a pain in the back. The employee was hospitalized with a strained/sprained back.

An employee was moving a small generator with a cart. The wheel of the cart got caught in a floor seam and the generator tipped over and fell on his right knee and ankle, causing a broken ankle and a chipped knee.

The injured employee was positioning wooden chock blocks/boards for leveling a piece of equipment. Another employee tossed a board towards the board the injured employee was holding. It struck the board the injured employee was holding and smashed the tip of the employee's right ring finger. The employee suffered an open fracture and avulsion and underwent a medical amputation of about 1/2 inch off the tip of the finger.

An employee was repairing a motorized boom conveyor used to load trailers. The employee used an open end wrench as a pry tool in an attempt to correct the tracking of the conveyor belt near the end pulley. When the unit was actuated to start to the re-track process, the wrench moved and pinched the employee's right pinky finger against a hard metal surface, amputating the finger from the first joint.
An employee was overseeing a carrot bagging machine. A bag got stuck in the machine; while the employee was trying to remove it, the machine's knives cut off the tip of his right index finger.
An employee was performing maintenance on a workover rig when the employee's left middle finger was pinched in the pin, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on an assembly line for refrigerator cases when he noticed wiring had fallen from the top of the refrigerator case to the bottom, near the rollers. When he was retrieving it, the case was pushed down the line; the tip of the employee's right ring finger was amputated.
An employee on a step ladder was retrieving inventory from a shelf when he stepped back and fell off the ladder, suffering leg trauma.
On March 14, 2019, an employee fell on a seating area while assisting in a concrete pour. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
While cleaning a restroom, an employee slipped and fell to the damp floor, suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was operating a pallet machine when his glove was caught in the chain and his hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket. The tips of his left little and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee was repairing a garage door when it slipped. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the closing panels, and the tip was amputated.

An employee was pulling a cart with a cast manifold and mopping the floor. The cart rolled forward, dropping one leg into a drain, and the cart tipped. The manifold then fell and landed on the employee, breaking her left index finger, left ankle, and four left toes.
An employee was grading and pulling strips. The employee's right ring finger was caught in a conveyor roller on the grading line. The finger was amputated.

While installing underground plumbing, an employee was holding a PVC pipe straight as a skid steer backfilled the pipe. The skid steer bucket struck his fingers, resulting in a left index finger amputation.
An employee was painting from a small scaffold, about 5 feet high. The employee fell off the scaffold, suffering broken ribs and a broken clavicle.

An employee was working on the end of a spiral cooling conveyor belt. During cooling activities, the employee bent over and placed their hand at the end of the cooling conveyor belt. The metal conveyor belt met with a pointed cylindrical free spinning wheel approximately a half inch from the metal conveyor. The employee's middle finger was caught between the conveyor and the free spinning wheel resulting in an amputation injury.
A maintenance technician's finger was caught between two gears while he was greasing a machine. He suffered severe damage to his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was using a cut-off saw to cut an 8-inch pipe for a water main when the saw kicked back and struck the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized with multiple lacerations.

At about 11:20 a.m. on March 14, 2019, a truck driver was working on top of a tractor trailer to check the fuel level. A gust of wind blew the employee off the top of the trailer. The employee suffered broken bones and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the stairs and fell. She broke her knee.

On March 14, 2019, at approximately 11:40 AM, an employee was cutting a piece of quarter stock for a trim on a residential housing unit.  As the employee cut the piece, which was approximately 3 inches in length, the employee's left hand became unstable from the wood, and the left index finger contacted the blade. The employee suffered a left index finger amputation.
An employee was walking down a corridor when he slipped on the wet floor, and fractured his left kneecap.

At 1:28 p.m. on March 14, 2019, an employee was in the parking lot helping a customer check their battery. The employee lost his balance, partially due to high winds, and fell onto a concrete parking block. He was hospitalized, having suffered a broken right hip.
An employee's hand was caught in a metal press brake, resulting in amputations to his left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was stacking product in the back of a trailer at a customer's site when he lost balance and fell forward to the trailer floor, landing on his hands. He was hospitalized with broken bones in the hands and wrists, requiring surgery.
An employee slipped on icy slush and fell to the ground while stepping off a curb, fracturing his ankle.
An employee was cutting the banding from bundles of wood when the bundle became unstable, hitting the ground and the shin area of the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a broken leg.

On March 15, 2019, at 1530, two employees noticed smoke from the sawdust bin. The two employees attempted to move the sawdust in the bin to the ground via an auger system.  Thirty minutes later, the employees opened the lower hatch. A blast of fire shot from the hatch, severely burning the two men. The first employee suffered burns on the neck, face, and hands. The second employee suffered burns on the chest and stomach area.

An employee was delivering scrap metal at a site and entered the truck trailer to sweep leftover metal for the crane magnet when the employee was hit by the magnet. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting material.
An employee was operating a press brake while forming parts when the employee's fingers entered the line of fire, resulting in three fractured fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was picking citrus. At the same time, a loader was backing up. The employee attempted to remove a ladder from the path of the loader when the loader ran over his lower right leg, breaking it.

An employee was part of a crew conducting maintenance on a rail siding. The jack holding the rail fell, and the tip of the employee's left middle finger was caught between a tie plate and the underside of the rail. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading glass shower door panels (3 feet x 7 feet), when the pile (approximately 20) fell on him, breaking both of his ankles.
An employee suffered an amputation of the right arm just under the shoulder when his arm was caught in a machine roller.

At approximately 9:00 AM on March 15, 2019, an employee was seated on the back of a 3-wheeler cart. The driver was reversing the cart when the driver lost control and propelled the employee into a wall and onto the floor. She suffered a severe sprain to her bilateral ankles, shoulder pain, and four dislocated toes (phalanges) on her left foot. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was setting a truss on a tie-beam when he fell 20 feet to the ground. He suffered broken ankles, legs, arms, a broken neck and back and a fractured skull.
An employee slipped and fell down stairs, breaking the right ankle.
An employee was picking up roofing debris from the ground when a roll of roofing insulation fell and struck his leg, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered an index fingertip amputation while attempting to clear a jam.
On March 16, 2019, an employee was using a knife to prepare a meal.  The knife slipped and cut the employee's thumb, amputating the end of it.

An employee was dumping a residential garbage container into the hopper of a refuse truck when the container handle broke, causing the employee to fall backward on the pavement. He fractured his left hip.
An employee was installing a hydraulic cylinder onto a dump truck/bed when the employee's right thumb was pinched and lacerated between the hydraulic cylinder and the truck bed.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a piece of equipment when the employee's finger entered a pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The equipment was locked out at the time.
An employee was installing bolts on an electrical pole. The employee fell about 40 feet, suffering a shattered right ankle and a broken left heel. Fall protection was worn at the time.

An employee was standing on a ladder trying to unclog a bark hopper using a high-pressure water hose when he fell from the third step (about 3 feet), then rolled over the ledge (about 3 feet) and onto a bark pile on a truck ramp. He was hospitalized with a fractured T-12 vertebra.
Three employees were power washing when the washer caught fire. Two of the employees were hospitalized with burns.

On March 15, at 11 a.m., an employee was running a cable to the floor of a pulling unit when the employee was shocked by approximately 1,050 volts DC from the trailer truck. The employee was hospitalized with an electrical shock to the hands.
An employee was auditing an establishment when the employee fell on the floor, breaking the left hip. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was mounting a track assembly machine when the machine tipped over, pinning the employee underneath. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the left middle finger and a hairline fracture to the left fibula.

An employee was feeding an assembled truss into a finish roller to press truss plates into place. The truss was not centered in the opening so it contacted the left vertical safety stop and the rollers stopped. He tried to reverse the roller, but it would not turn back on due to the safety stop being engaged and wedged against the truss tail. He attempted to pull the safety stop back into operating position. When he bent it around the truss, the rollers started moving and the tail of the truss went up the vertical safety stop and pushed his finger against the truss tail. His left pinky fingertip was pulled off the bone.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw. The saw blade cut the employee's hand. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, suffering a broken foot.
An employee was opening the door to a delivery trailer with the help of two other employees. He was hospitalized for treatment of a pinched nerve on his lower back.
A car struck a temporary employee in an auto auction yard, causing broken ribs.
An employee was filling a pot that dispenses hot glue when his right hand contacted the glue and was burned.

An employee was installing a safety block in the dough press. The employee was attempting to insert a safety block into the press when the press came down while the employee's fingertip was between the block and the frame. The employee suffered a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was tightening the east side of a slitter after a job change and checked to see if the mat was being cut properly. As he was checking, his glove was caught and his fingers were pulled into the compaction roller, de-gloving his left middle, ring, and pinky fingers and resulting in amputation.
An employee was feeding cards into a clam shell die cutting machine when the machine closed on and crushed his right hand resulting in amputation of the middle finger and thumb.
An employee was helping to asses a patient to be admitted into the acute stabilization unit when the patient poked him in the eye. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee suffered an amputation to the left index finger while operating a tortilla-making machine.
An employee was cutting material on a radial arm saw. The saw blade cut his left thumb, amputating the tip.
An employee was about to walk into a control room when the door closed on his right middle finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee turned to talk to a member and tripped. She fell into the doors, scraping her face and injuring her back as she hit the ground. She suffered a neck injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a foam fixture machine and placing lids in the working area when the top of the blow mold machine crushed the employee's right index and middle fingers resulting in surgical amputation of both fingers. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An actuator got stuck on a rusted stud and did not release. An employee tried to unjam the actuator and it moved, pinching his finger against the base of the pipe. His right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking down stairs. An oil pipe fell on top of the employee, who suffered skull fractures, a contusion, and head trauma.

An employee was walking in the parking lot from his vehicle to the building when he slipped on ice and fell, striking the ground. He sustained multiple fractured ribs and bruising to his spleen, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing a roller from a press machine when the roller frame moved up and caught the employee's finger between the stopper block and roller frame. The employee received an amputation to the right ring finger.
An employee was adding water to a forklift battery when it fell, fracturing his legs.
An employee fell off a stool and was burned by hot cooking oil.
An employee was inspecting an overhead conveyor 9 feet above ground level. The employee's hand was entangled and crushed in the tension roller of an overhead conveyor belt.
Two employees were sliding a 150-pound metal I-beam across a deck. One employee's right hand was caught between the I-beam and the deck. The employee's right index finger was crushed.
An employee was about to flip a breaker when he suffered a burn to his right hand.
An employee was on a truck, loading a customer's cargo bed. The employee fell from the back of the bed, suffering a broken arm. The employee was hospitalized.
While at work, on a break, an employee was shot twice in the leg, once in the jaw, and once in the stomach.
A case of pickles was about to fall. As an employee tried to stop it, his throat came into contact with the control handle of a pallet jack. His esophagus was crushed.
A employee slipped on a kitchen floor, falling and suffering a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
As an employee exited his vehicle, his coat caught on the gear shift and the vehicle dragged him on the ground, breaking a vertebra.

An employee was working in a chick trailer. As he was repositioning a flat hook (on a winch) attached to the last chick tray, the attached cable straightened out. His left hand was caught between the hook and the dolly and his index finger was crushed. The finger was amputated.
An employee was re-dressing a setting tool. The employee's right little finger was caught between the setting sleeve and a mandrel porthole. The tip was amputated.
While setting up a pressure washer, an employee fell to the ground from a height of about 4 feet. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a ruptured spleen after a day moving heavy furniture.
An employee was using a crane when a strap attached to a work bench broke and whipped back, hitting the employee in the hand and amputating the right middle finger.
A trackhoe excavator backed over an employee's leg, injuring the leg and breaking the ankle.
A Rent-A-Center employee was picking up a couch from an offsite location. His right wrist was caught and crushed between a truck and its lift gate.
An employee was working on a metal molding machine. He was removing a piece of metal from the mold when the machine activated, amputating the tip of his index finger.
An employee was operating a forklift when it flipped, pinning and spraining the employee's ankle.
An employee suffered a thumb fracture while trying to fix a jam in a pallet sorting machine.

An employee was bending a piece of 1-inch-thick, 6-inch-wide, 6-foot-long flat steel in a press fitted with a four-way die. One of the fins on the die broke, allowing the steel to fall and strike the employee's right leg above the knee. The employee suffered a contusion and swelling and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped on rocks and dirt at a construction site and fell, suffering possible broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to reignite a natural-gas-fueled torch when a flashover occurred, causing second-degree burns to the employee's hands and face. He was hospitalized.

A packer lifted a 46-pound box containing packaging materials from floor level to a cart at waist level. The employee experienced severe pain in the lower back and down the leg and fell to the floor, unable to stand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the scraper bar on a freezer belt exit. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the scraper and the belt; the top knuckle (right under the nailbed) and finger pad were amputated.
The employee was cleaning scrap wood debris off the deck at a sawmill cant dock. He fell off the edge, landing on the floor 7 feet below and hitting his head.
An employee tripped on the lip of a concrete pad near the rear entrance of a bus garage. The employee fell to the concrete, suffering a knee injury.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a fixed ladder and suffered a broken rib, broken vertebrae, and a lacerated kidney.
Two employees were servicing equipment. While a guard was being removed, it fell onto an employee's left hand, breaking two fingers. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
On March 18, 2019, an employee fell from an airplane catering truck to the ground over 10 feet below. He suffered broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and an injured right shoulder.

Two employees were cleaning on the back side of a coater, standing on decking 50 inches above the floor. One of them fell through a 2-foot-wide gap in the decking, suffering broken vertebrae, diabetic issues, and bruising.
An employee fell about 6 feet while dismantling scaffolding and suffered a broken right tibia.
Two employees bumped into each other. One fell, suffering an injury to the right hip that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting a tree with a chainsaw when the tree fell. The butt of the tree rocked back onto the employee, breaking his right arm and left leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a tractor trailer, standing in the back with the door open. The trailer stopped and moved forward to realign; the employee fell out, suffering a dislocated tibia and a broken knee.

An employee was using a dolly leg handle to lower a trailer so it could be connected. The handle slipped from his hands and it sprung back, striking him in the jaw and neck area, bruising his esophagus, and breaking his jawbone.
An employee was taking a measurement when he contacted a power line, suffering injuries to a nerve in the right forearm.
An employee tripped on an anti-fatigue mat in a production area and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was exiting a room and reached to grab the exit door handle. Her hand slipped off the handle due to the resistance of the door, causing her to lose her balance and fall backward to the floor. She landed on and broke her right hip.
An employee was holding a Goldberg fitting up to ductwork. The fitting fell and struck the employee's left forearm, lacerating an artery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a weak area on a roof, landing on top of a rack about 6 feet below and then falling another 12 feet to the ground level. The employee suffered a broken lower-back vertebra.

An employee was applying tape to the loose trim on a paper roll. Her right jacket sleeve was caught in the shaft of the winder, pulling in her arm. She suffered a severe laceration of the forearm and a broken wrist, and was hospitalized.

An employee was a passenger in a vacuum truck, which was traveling on a dump road at a client's site. The truck hit a washout and leaned to one side; the employee was bounced around in the cab and suffered a possible concussion. He was hospitalized.
On March 18, 2019, an employee was discarding a toilet in a dumpster. The toilet shattered and deeply lacerated the employee's right forearm.
An employee was installing insulation in the 2x6 exterior wall on the third floor when he slipped and fell to the ground about 22 feet below. The employee suffered back and neck fractures.
An employee was on the lift of a delivery truck. The employee's foot was caught between the ramp and the lift gate while the lift was operated. The employee's big toe was crushed.

On 3-11-19, around 8 p.m., an employee was moving a sheet of 1/2" plate from a water-cutting machine using an overhead crane. He tried to transfer the plate from the overhead crane to the forklift by placing the plate on its edge on the floor and moving the forklift close enough to switch the plate clamp from the overhead crane to the forklift.  He lost control of the plate, which fell and struck his left leg.  He was hospitalized with two fractures and ankle dislocations.
An employee was operating a 105-ton press. The press caught the employee's right hand, causing the partial amputation of the middle and index fingertips.
An employee entered a restroom, tripped over the raised threshold, and fell on the floor. The employee injured his lower back.
A pipefitter was climbing down a detachable ladder attached to the side of a flatbed truck. He fell off the ladder and struck the ground, suffering a concussion, a broken collarbone, and broken ribs.

An employee was holding metal inside a shear machine. The machine cycled and its guards came down onto the employee's left index and middle fingers. The employee suffered a broken middle finger and an index finger avulsion.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while cleaning a machine.

An employee was adjusting a stack of pallets so they would interlock and could be moved safely by his forklift. The pallets clicked into place, and his left middle finger was caught between them. The tip was partly amputated.
An employee was climbing a ladder to provide customer service when it shifted and the employee fell off the ladder, breaking his right arm.

An employee was on an A-frame step ladder, rebuilding an inverted bucket trap. After loosening the six bolts holding the trap door in place, the employee was hit by hot condensate steam and suffered burns to the neck, upper arms, and chest area.

An employee was under a crane in his truck. The crane picked up the reefer container the employee's truck was hauling. The container was still locked onto the employee's truck, which was lifted about 1 foot off the ground with the employee inside. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting an aluminum oxygen cylinder when it exploded. The employee suffered broken fingers and burns.
While cribbing under equipment, an employee was crushed by a 60-pound load. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell, suffering a hip injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just lowered a partially filled carrier of wire onto a machine turntable and was disengaging the crane hook from the carrier. The hook raised, and the employee's left middle fingertip was amputated between it and the carrier.
An employee slipped on ice while walking into a building. Her head struck the concrete and she suffered a broken skull.
An employee was welding in a maintenance shop when the welder shocked him.

Two employees were loading cardboard into a baler. The overhead door was closed, but the baler did not read that it was closed properly. When the door was re-closed, it caught an employee's right hand, causing an amputation to the index fingertip/print.
An employee was cutting a 6-inch fire hydrant pipe with a handheld circular saw. The saw blade came up and struck the employee in the chin and chest, causing lacerations.

At 6:30 p.m. on March 19, 2019, a temporary employee was operating a stacker machine. The magnet came up and pinched the employee's right middle finger against the product. The fingertip was amputated (without bone loss).
An employee was cleaning the chain on a machine. The sprocket chain and gear caught the employee's right middle finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was working on a helicopter engine when he slipped and fell on the engine firewall, lacerating his left forearm. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was loading a tire into a vehicle trunk when another vehicle struck the employee from behind. Both of the employee's tibias were broken.
An employee was removing chicken parts from a jammed half cutter machine. The machine amputated the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee tripped on a box and fell to the floor, breaking her right hip.
An employee was working on a pad-mount transformer. An arc flash burned the employee's face, shoulders, and chest. The employee also suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was cutting cinderblock with a masonry saw and amputated his thumb.
An employee was carrying a duct strap hanger and drill up a ladder. The employee fell 6 feet to the concrete floor, suffering head, left shoulder, and collarbone injuries.

A temporary employee was welding an end plate on a beam. The clamp was on the beam and he was moving the beam to a vertical position when the beam fell on his right foot, causing the amputation of two toes. Steel toe safety shoes were worn at the time.

An employee was reaching over a conveyor belt when a tear in the belt caught her glove, dragging her finger between the belt lacing and head roller. She suffered an amputation to the right middle fingertip.
An employee was walking across a crosswalk in a breast deboning department with a knife in his hand. He lost his balance and the knife punctured his chest and lung.
While delivering mail and packages to an apartment building, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee suffered three fractures to the lower right leg.
An employee was in a trench installing a storm drain. A dirt clod fell from the unprotected side of the trench and struck the employee, causing him to fall to the ground and break his left leg.

At 11:10 a.m. on March 19, 2019, a janitor working near the loin saddle position on the main break of a cut floor suffered a right ring finger amputation when reaching to grab a hook that was caught in a conveyor.
Employee fell from a dock to the ground, breaking three ribs and bruising his lung.

An employee was climbing into the cab of his truck when his knee gave out and he fell out onto another parked truck, hitting the top step. He suffered a broken rib and a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.

An employee was turning over an open caulk bucket with the metal lid partially attached. During this process, the open lid scratched the employee's right forearm, causing a 6-inch laceration to the underside that required hospitalization.

A temporary employee was operating a pipe cutting machine and had his hand on a pipe when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The machine engaged and crushed his right index finger, resulting in an amputation of the entire digit.

An employee was working from a 16-foot extension ladder installing insulation. The employee was standing on the seventh step when he fell to the ground level. He received a broken left arm, bit his lip, and suffered bilateral cracked ribs.

An employee was walking down stairs and fell. The employee struck their head on a block wall on the opposite side of the hallway at the bottom of the stairs. The employee was unconscious and bleeding from a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was operating a trim saw when one of the chains on the material conveyor jumped the tracks. The employer shut down the saw and proceeded to disconnect the conveyor chain to move it into the correct tooth of the driver sprocket. Once the conveyor chain was loose, the injured employee lifted it out of its track to reposition it and contacted the sawblade, which was still spinning at the time, with the back of his hand. The spinning blade contacted all four fingers of the injured employee's right hand, completely cutting off the end of the little finger.  The injured employee's ring finger was not completely severed, but the second (middle) joint of this finger was completely cut by the spinning blade. The employee's middle and index fingers were mostly still intact, but deeply cut.
An employee was using a table mounted circular ripsaw and amputated a finger. The saw was unguarded at the time.

At about 2:00 p.m. on March 20, 2019, an employee was walking down the steps of a client's home when she fell down six steps. She suffered bruised ribs, a nasal fracture, a possible bruised frontal lobe of the brain, and injuries to the left knee and ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was attaching hooks and a sling to remove a battery. The hook came loose from the connection to the battery and swung, striking the employee who sustained a leg fracture.

An employee was ripping plywood into 2 1/2" strips with a table saw. He was toward the end of his rip cut when the blade hit a knot. His push stick and his right hand were pulled into the blade. He suffered cuts to the thumb and index, middle, and ring fingers; the index finger was cut through and had to be amputated at the second joint from the tip.
While resting/on call in crew quarters, an employee was exposed to furnace fire fumes and began coughing. The employee was hospitalized for aggravation of asthma.

An employee was assembling a roll. The shaft got stuck in the roll and as he used a press to force it out, he was struck on his left hand by flying metal debris (possibly the shaft). He left index finger was medically amputated.
An employee was unloading industrial glass off of a roller conveyor when his glove was caught in the powered conveyor shaft. His left index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.
On March 20, 2019, an employee was towing material with a tugger. The employee's foot was caught between the tugger and a guardrail, sustaining broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing and installing skylights when the employee fell approximately 42 feet through a skylight to ground level, injuring the lower body and head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to reposition a log that was hung on a conveyor belt when it moved and pinched the employee's left ring fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell from a ladder to the walking surface, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was replacing the chain on a hose reel on the back of a delivery truck. As he was putting the chain on the sprocket, his left index finger was caught between the chain and the sprocket. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was hospitalized after falling on ice.
