An employee was turning on the water to a pump after replacing a broken flange. The upper pipe gave way and hot water caused second degree burns to the employee's face and hand.
An employee was installing a 3" schedule 80 line when the load shifted, pinning his lower left leg between the pipe and the ground. He suffered a fractured left tibia.
An employee was operating an ATV down a closed street on the jobsite and crashed. The employee suffered a dislocated shoulder and broken bones in the elbow and thumb requiring surgery.

An employee was setting up and trying to adjust a barrel fan when it tilted and caught the employee's right hand, causing a middle finger fracture that required surgery and an index finger laceration.
An employee was exiting her car when she slipped on ice on the pavement and fractured her ankle. She was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was setting angle iron in a machine when his right hand was caught between the machine and the machine's rail as the machine changed direction resulting in amputation of the thumb just below the knuckle.

An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack. He picked up two pallets with the jack; the top pallet shifted, causing the bottom pallet to move as well. This caused the pallet jack to suddenly lower. It struck the employee's right shin and dropped onto his left foot. He was hospitalized for surgery on his foot.
An insect bit an employee who was working at a caf . The bite became infected, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was shoveling left-over wet concrete from under a machine that made concrete blocks. He felt a sharp pain in his lower abdomen and was hospitalized, requiring hernia surgery.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when his leg was pinned to a guardrail.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell fracturing her tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting plastic using a band saw. As he moved the plastic, his hand was caught by the blade causing a deep laceration on the left hand.

An employee slipped off the second or third rung of the ladder on a cattle feeder trailer, falling approximately 2 to 3 feet.  When he landed, his hip hit a railroad tie and his head hit the corner of a concrete slab.
An employee was changing a saw blade when his right hand was caught on the chain/sprocket that holds the wood in place causing a partial amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized after a piece of plastic from the insert of a carpet roll broke off and punctured the employee's left eye.
An employee was inserting a PVC pipe into a spindle mold machine. The employee's fingers were caught in a pinch point, and the employee's right middle fingertip was crushed/amputated.

An employee was climbing into the cab of a crane when he lost his footing and slipped off the access platform, falling 5'8" onto the concrete pavement below. He landed on his feet and suffered severe foot pain and broken heels.
An employee was setting a pallet and was struck by a forklift.  The employee sustained a laceration above the left knee requiring surgery.

An employee was pushing a load on a pallet jack up an incline in a mushroom house. The load slid back toward the load backrest, and the employee's left thumb was caught between the load bin and the backrest. The employee suffered an amputation to the nail and bed of the left thumb.
A temporary employee was walking alongside a skid steer, tripped and fell. His right hand was caught in the skid steer's track causing an amputation injury to the pinky finger.
An employee fell down an escalator at the airport while traveling for work, suffering skull fractures.

A welder was welding a nipple to a tank when a flame shot from the tank opening and caused second degree burns to another employee's chest. The injured employee was hospitalized. There may have been some residual cleaning product left after cleaning the oil from the cut (2-inch hole) where the weld was going to be made.

An employee was cutting a small piece of wood on a table saw. The wood jammed, and the sawblade amputated the employee's right little finger and cut two other fingers. The saw was guarded at the time.

An employee was changing the tooling on a press brake when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. This caused the machine die to crush and break his left middle and index fingers. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw when a part on the vacuum on the top of the saw came off and hit the employee. As he reached to grab the part his left thumb was lacerated.
An employee was using a saw when it amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was trying to remove a board that had stopped a belt. The belt broke free and amputated the employee's left index, middle and ring fingers.
While cleaning in an operating room, an employee slipped on a black anti-fatigue mat on the wet floor. The employee suffered an injury to the left ankle.
An employee was adjusting the tines on a forklift. A tine slipped back into place and amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.
An employee was operating a circular saw when the circular saw jumped and contacted the employee's left thumb causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning up the warehouse and disposing of old inventory. While trying to compact the trash in a dumpster by standing on it, the employee fell out of the dumpster onto the ground and fractured the right arm.

An employee was mixing feed when the transition (elevator leg) backed up. While he was clearing the backup, the system was turned back on and the employee was caught inside the machine causing a laceration to the back side of the employee's right arm between the shoulder and the elbow. The system was not locked out at the time.
A material handler was hospitalized with a knee injury that required surgery after taking a sharp U-turn in a tugger vehicle and falling off the vehicle to the floor.
An employee was on a ladder removing insulation. The employee slipped and fell about 5 feet, suffering a jammed finger on the right hand and a head injury.
An employee was riding a pallet mule when his leg was caught between it and a stanchion. His tibia and fibula were crushed.
An employee was moving AC units with a forklift. As a unit was placed on a wooden block, it pinched the employee's right index finger.
An employee was getting off an elevator when she starting having respiratory problems from the cologne of someone getting on the elevator.

An employee was reaching over to straighten an 1800-pound super bag filled with regrind material when the bag gave in. The super bag fell striking the employee in the shoulder and knocking the employee down. The regrind material then covered the employee. The employee suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was pulling a wire through a conduit when their left ring finger was caught in a tugger and partially amputated.
An employee was opening the overhead bay door at the back of the shop. His right middle finger was pinched between the cable and the roller and was medically amputated to the first knuckle.

At 3:10 p.m. on March 21, 2019, an employee was trying to reset the gauge on an ID grinder. The parts loader cycled and pinched the employee's left index finger, causing an avulsion and later surgical amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was flushing a transloading hose with cresylic acid into an intermediate bulk container. The hose slipped out of the tote and splashed residual product on the employee's face, causing burns to his face and eyes.

Saw dust used to feed the boiler is off-loaded from specialized transport trailers to a drag chain conveyor trough. The trailers are equipped with a conveying system that is driven by a stationary motor and drive shaft at the facility. The trailers can be parked on opposite sides of the trough. The shafting from the motor connects to yokes on the trailer. There is a yoke on each side of the shaft to accommodate bi-directional parking. The injured employee was cleaning between the trailer and the trough on the side that was not connected to the shaft to the motor drive while the trailer was being unloaded. The employee's left arm was caught in the yoke on the trailer that was not connected and the upper arm was fractured.

An employee was manually pushing two sections of 3-inch pipe on two jack stands with wheels. One of the wheels on the stand struck a welders line (cable) and the jack stand stopped quickly and fell over. The pipe fell off the stand and struck the employee's left leg fracturing it.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder, helping repair a service bay garage door that would not roll up and down. The top three glass door panels fell, causing the employee to fall to the concrete driveway. The employee sustained a punctured lung and a cut on the head from the broken glass.
An employee was getting a box from a freezer while standing on a ladder. She fell from the ladder and broke her leg.
An employee was checking for an air leak under a pump control stand. A pinhole leak in a hydraulic line caused hydraulic fluid to be injected into the employee's right index finger near the tip.

On March 21, 2019, a maintenance technician was working from an extension ladder to get to the ceiling of a structure to perform maintenance of a heater unit. The employee fell from the ladder, suffering head trauma and fractures to the skull and lower jaw. The employee was hospitalized.
On March 21, 2019, a mail carrier was on route delivering mail when the mail truck door shut on their left middle finger amputating the fingertip.
An employee was performing a pressure plate test when a fixture came down on his right hand and amputated the thumb. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was preparing a steel frame to be painted. The frame fell, causing a laceration across the employee's forehead that required stitches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder and fell approximately 5 feet to the deck then rolled and fell another 3 feet to the ground. The employee suffered 2 broken ribs and head trauma.

An employee was realigning two pieces of machinery on a press. An ejector plate retracted in the machinery, catching the employee's left hand and causing amputations to the index and middle fingertips.

An employee was moving a metal plate with a crane. The plate moved/shifted while the employee was guiding it to set it down on top of another plate. The employee's fingers were caught between the two plates causing an amputation injury to the left middle, ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was standing in a 6.5- to 7-foot deep excavation preparing to install a plastic drainage pipe when part of one excavation wall caved in, burying the lower half of the employee's body in dirt.  A large chunk of dirt also rolled against his upper body. He was hospitalized with fractures to the pelvis and several vertebrae.

An employee working next to the filter house was blowing down a fan slab under the filter house hopper when his jacket sleeve became tangled in a rotating shaft, pulling his left arm into the shaft. He suffered a mangled left hand, wrist, and forearm.
An employee was struck in the head, upper back, and shoulder by a heavy steel door and suffered a seizure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee felt abdominal pain while getting out of his truck. He was hospitalized, having suffered a hernia.
An employee was attempting to straighten a digging bar that was wedged in a backhoe. When the bar moved, the employee lost balance and fell breaking the left ankle.
An employee was checking for air leaks on a coater when the hydraulic clamp that holds the coating rod in place struck his fingers and amputated his right index and middle fingers.
An employee's left index finger was amputated as he was troubleshooting a machine. The machine was not locked out or guarded at the time, and was running.
An employee slipped while ascending a stairway. He fell and his throat contacted the railing, suffering a contusion of the throat and a fracture to his neck.
As an employee jumped approximately 5 feet from a rack to the ground, a broom leaning against the rack punctured the employee's midsection.
On March 21, 2019, an employee was pouring molten aluminum into a casting when the aluminum contacted the employee's foot, causing severe burns.
On March 21, 2019, a sign installer fell from a step ladder and suffered a head injury that required hospitalization.

The injured employee and a forklift operator were unloading bean totes out of rail cars. The totes are large fabric bags with fabric loops that are used to move the totes. The injured employee was guiding the forklift operator to place the forks into the tote's loops when the injured employee's right pinky finger was pinched between the forks and the loops resulting in a partial amputation.

Three employees had moved a metal electrical cabinet (about 8 by 11 feet) for a new power wall at a new construction site. The cabinet was placed against a wall. While holes were being drilled in it, it tipped over and struck one of the employees. The employee was pinned beneath the cabinet and suffered injuries including a broken tailbone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working near a cure pot when its lid caught the employee's finger, causing an avulsion to the fingertip.
An employee was adjusting the forks on an electric pallet jack and crushed a right hand finger resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee tripped over a piece of plastic wrap attached to a pallet. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a hip fracture.
An employee's foot hit a shredding recycling bin as she walked. She fell on her right knee, injuring it.

An employee was conducting steel erection activities. He fell approximately 12 feet to the ground below while descending a ladder from the steel structure and fractured his elbow, wrist, pelvis and leg. Fall protection was not connected at the time.
An employee was hooking up a chain from the bucket of a backhoe to a trench box. The trench box was moved, and the employee's right ring finger was amputated.
An employee stepped on a conduit, rolling and fracturing his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on paper trash on a kitchen floor and fell, suffering a broken right femur.

An employee was removing slack from a sand line when the downhole tool hung up on a pipe scale. The tool slipped past the scale, creating tension on the line around the sand line drum. The employee's fingers were pinched between the line and the drum; his right thumb and index finger were amputated.
An employee was assembling/manufacturing a pneumatic press when the press activated and crushed his right hand. The employee sustained muscle damage and a laceration to the hand and required surgery.
An employee tripped over a yellow cement barrier, suffering a broken leg.

A transfer vessel was about to be pressurized to clear a blockage; an employee was standing in front of the discharge piping, holding a sheet of plywood to prevent material spillage. Air suddenly released from the discharge piping at 70 psi, forcing the plywood into the employee's face and throwing him about 15 feet. He suffered a fractured orbital socket, a laceration above the eyebrow, and a subdural hematoma.

An employee was kneeling between the rear end of a crane load (an aircraft tug) and the crane's outriggers. While the back end of the tug was being lowered, it swung toward the employee, striking him and pinning him against an outrigger. He suffered a broken jaw, a collapsed lung, and broken ribs.

An employee received a partial amputation to his right middle finger while attempting to secure a load on a tractor-trailer at their facility. Air was released to lower the rollers on the bed of the truck; the employee's right hand was pinched in the rolling slots, causing an amputation to his middle finger.
An employee slipped and fractured a leg while walking in the lobby of the north campus location of Staten Island University Hospital, requiring hospitalization.

On Friday, March 22, 2019, two employees were lowering material in a wind turbine after repairing a turbine motor. A 6-foot-long tool fell from more than 90 feet up, striking an employee on the ground and causing head trauma.

A window assembler was setting completed mulled windows (about 6 feet wide and 8 feet high) onto the shipping cart (4 feet deep and 8 feet long). When he went to maneuver the cart containing the seven mulled windows to set more windows, some of the windows fell off the cart and onto him. He was hospitalized for a spinal cord injury.

An employee was moving a round bar stock from the pan to the saw when the bar slipped. The employee grabbed it and their left thumb was crushed between the bar and the saw arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left thumb.

An employee was working on a sub-roof assembly approximately 13 feet high. The employee was pushing down on a pry bar and lost balance, falling 13 feet to the ground. The employee fractured both legs and the left wrist.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, landing on the floor and suffering fractured ribs and a head contusion/hematoma.
An employee contacted the moving auger while cleaning it. The employee sustained three fractured fingers and tendon and nerve damage. The auger was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee fell from the curb while crossing the street and hit their knee on the ground. The employee suffered a dislocated right knee.
An employee was using a rebar bending machine. The machine caught the employee's finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
A roll that was being handled by hoisting equipment shifted and knocked an employee to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured hip.

An employee was operating a tractor with a hay bale spear attachment. The employee was attempting to spear a round hay bale weighing 800 to 1500 lbs. when the hay bale was pushed off the flatbed truck and struck the truck driver who was retrieving a strap on the ground below the bales. The truck driver sustained a dislocated hip, broken ribs, a punctured lung, a back injury and a facial laceration.
An employee lost balance and fell, suffering broken wrists.
A forklift struck a scissor lift, causing the employee inside the scissor lift to fall. The employee suffered a facial fracture and a broken right collarbone.
An employee was cutting a pack of patio umbrellas when his pocket knife stabbed his leg, cutting the femoral artery.
An employee was putting a guard back onto the warper machine after cleaning the machine to remove cotton fibers. The guard slipped and landed on his left index finger amputating the tip.
An employee was test-driving a Humvee when it flipped over. The employee suffered head lacerations requiring stitches, as well as broken cervical bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the office when she slipped and fell on the floor that was wet from rain, injuring her head and face.
An employee swung their leg over to climb down a baker scaffold. Their pant leg caught on the frame causing the employee to fall approximately 4.5 feet and suffer a fractured tailbone.
An elevator technician was trapped under an elevator.
An employee tripped on nylon plastic banding and fell to the floor, suffering a broken kneecap and a head laceration.
An employee was operating an order picker when it struck a storage rack system. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was cutting wood shims on a table saw using a push stick with his right hand. He used his left hand to hold a wood piece. His left hand slipped and struck the blade amputating his thumb.
A welder ignition arced into a nearby container of brake cleaner/oil, which caught fire. An employee was caught in the flames and suffered burns to the arms, shoulders, face, and neck.
An employee was loading a 400-pound roll of plastic bags into a bagging machine and pinched his right ring finger between the shaft and the cradle causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a load dock. The plate struck the employee's head, knocking the employee unconscious and causing a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift while taking inventory. The employee suffered an open fracture of the left ankle.

An employee was cutting a steel beam, about 15 feet long and weighing about 5,000 pounds. The beam reacted to the heat and split in half lengthwise, landing on top of the employee. The employee suffered two broken ankles, a broken knee, and four to six broken ribs.
An employee was working on a cyclone fan and amputated the tip of his left thumb on the blade.
An employee was carrying a pipe stand when he lost his footing and fell to the ground. The stand smashed his hand. His right ring finger was injured and had to be amputated.
An employee was cleaning a mixer from the outside. The auger caught the employee's glove, amputating the tip of the thumb.

An employee was working on a compressor valve. As the cap was being removed, the valve blew off. It struck him, causing a laceration above the eye and injuries to the wrist, midsection, and ankle. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the ankle.
An employee was removing a metal drain cover when it slipped out of his hand and pinched the tip of his right middle finger.
An employee tripped in a parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering broken teeth, a concussion, hand abrasions, and a swollen knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee was securing a line from the vessel to the dock when a line struck him in the lower leg, causing a compound fracture that required surgery.
An employee was standing on the fifth step of an 8-foot A-frame ladder, painting a set piece. He lost his balance and fell to the floor, breaking his right tibia.
An employee was loading a container onto a garbage truck. He was about to lock in his truncheon bar when the mechanism was turned on. He suffered an amputation to the left index finger.

An employee was part of a four-person crew that was removing a form after a concrete pour was set. A crane tried to pull the form off a concrete column, and the wire rope guideline hung up on something. The employee tried to release the guideline; the employee's right hand was caught between the form rebar and the guideline. The employee suffered a pinch-type amputation of the right index, middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee tripped over an angle iron while walking at a jobsite and was hospitalized for a knee injury that required surgery.

An employee was working on a conveyor belt and was trying to adjust the belt when he slipped and fell into the belt and roller. He fell on the ingoing nip point of the belt and was hospitalized for a fracture and a burn on his left hand.
While exiting an oil change bay, an employee was struck by a vehicle pulling into the bay. He suffered a laceration and damage to his right ear.
An employee was cutting plastic wrap. The tip of the employee's utility knife broke off and struck the employee's eye, causing an eye injury requiring stitches; the employee was hospitalized.

Three employees were moving new tires from a stack onto a rack at the back of a store. The stack of tires fell on one of the employees and he fell backwards, striking his head on the floor. He suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting cable with a knife and severed tendons on his left thumb.
While moving from one work station to another, an employee was struck by a moving piece of pipe. He suffered a broken rib and a collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting lumber with a chainsaw. The saw made contact with the employee's left foot, causing a laceration and bone fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the top of a flatbed trailer when the employee slipped and fell from the edge of the trailer while coming down, suffering multiple leg fractures and requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a broken right ankle while turning to walk.

An employee was training another driver on how to operate a yard truck. While riding on the back of the truck, the employee was caught between the truck and trailer. Both of the employee's legs were broken.

At about 2:30 a.m. on March 25, 2019, an employee was using a modified hydraulic press with a knife tool to remove defective vinyl grips from new hammers. While the employee was retrieving a hammer, his right middle and ring fingertips were caught between moving and stationary parts, causing amputations.

An employee was aligning bolts on an excavator counterweight weighing 4400 pounds during assembly. The counterweight slid sideways and pinned the employee's left arm between it and the surface level causing a fracture below the elbow.
An employee was hanging up a DC electric gun. The employee's foot got tangled up in the gun's power cord, and the resulting twisting/pulling motion caused a broken left hip.
An employee fell on a staircase at a home being built, suffering head trauma with concussion, a shoulder injury, and rib damage.
An employee was on a stand-up counterbalance forklift when his leg was caught between the forklift and a building column. He suffered crushing injury and a broken bone in the lower leg.

An employee was replacing a motor on a platform in the production area. The employee's left hand was on the motor when the chain shifted and pinched the tip of his middle finger between it and the motor causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was in the wash bay area, turned, tripped on a water containment curb and fell face down. The employee suffered head and neck injuries.

A press operator was helping to change out a press stamping die. The die was rolled from the press and onto a cart; the press operator's left ring finger was pinched between the die and the cart, sustaining a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation and lacerations on two additional fingers while operating a wood jointer.
An employee was cutting lumber with a table saw. The saw nicked the employee's left little finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was using a wrench to get a conveyor back on track when the wrench slipped, causing an injury to the employee's right index finger that resulted in a finger amputation.
A temporary employee was operating a forming station. A robot carrying hot thermoplastic composite struck the employee.
While walking down a hall, an employee tripped over a box and fell to the concrete floor, breaking her left hip.
An employee was guiding an oil rig elevator while rods were being pulled. His right hand was pinned between the elevator and a rod and was amputated.

Two employees were repairing a filter fence around a storm drain. A semi-trailer lost its two back wheels, which struck the employees. One of the employees was hospitalized, having suffered a broken wrist, ribs, fingers, and shoulder along with head trauma.

An employee was trying to remove a piece of wood or staple that was stuck in an underpinning machine. The machine activated, catching the employee's left little finger and causing an amputation to the tip.
An employee had just dropped mail through a mail slot when a dog came through a screen door and bit her right calf. She fell to the ground, and the dog removed the calf muscle from her leg.
An employee was walking up onto a barge via the steps between the two tow knees. The tow boat and the barge made full contact, and the employee's right foot was crushed between the two vessels.
A temporary employee was cutting lumber using a saw and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was moving/positioning a rolling barricade when the employee tripped and fell to the pavement, fracturing the left hip.
An employee was moving a propane storage cabinet. The dolly and the cabinet hit together and the cage flopped back, hitting the employee's right ring finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pushing a muffled cart on a non-energized roller. The employee's left hand was caught between the steel and the roller, causing the amputation of about 1/8 inch of the index fingertip.

An employee was helping to manufacture a trailer and attempting to remove a sheet of metal off of a cart when the metal sheet fell. The employee attempted to grab the falling sheet, which lacerated the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was picking product from baker-style rolling carts. While moving the middle of three carts, the employee's left middle finger was caught between carts and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing balcony railings and fell from the second floor to the ground resulting in a fractures to his spine.

An employee was welding an 24-inch diameter flange to a pipe that was attached to a weld positioner. The flange and the pipe combined weighed approximately 1,500 to 1,600 pounds. The employee went into the pipe to check the completed partial weld on the opposite end of where the positioner was located. The employee's feet were hanging outside the open end of the pipe. The weld broke causing the pipe and the employee to fall to the floor. The employee's feet were caught between the beveled ended of the pipe and the floor. All of the employee's toes on his right foot were amputated and the big toe on his left foot was fractured.
An employee tripped and fell in the office parking lot while conducting her safety surveillance walkthrough of the property site. She fractured both wrists.
While unloading freight, an employee was struck by a falling box, suffering a neck injury.
An employee fell from the steps of his truck to the ground below. He suffered torn ligaments on both knees.
While working as a spotter, an employee was struck by a 3,000-gallon plastic tank that fell from a forklift. The employee suffered a broken left tibia and ankle.
An employee was attempting to restrain an aggressive student when he fell backwards and struck his head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
A bundle of folded corrugate fell on an employee, knocking the employee to the ground. The employee suffered a broken nose and a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while descending a 28-foot ladder, suffering two broken wrists.

An employee was on the second level of an aircraft maintenance platform installing tags on equipment. The employee stepped on a hole cover and it gave way, allowing the employee to fall 9 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained head trauma, five fractured ribs, and a fractured L5 vertebra.
A temporary employee was cutting wood with a miter saw when his hand contacted the blade, causing a left thumb amputation. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee suffered a hip injury while moving furniture.
An employee fell to ground level while installing a wall form, suffering a femur fracture.
An employee was banding coil when it fell over and hit his leg, causing lacerations.
An employee was walking down stairs when the employee missed a step and fell approximately 10 steps to the bottom of the stairs, breaking a bone in the neck.
An employee was inserting a sheet of corrugated cardboard into a machine. The machine was activated, catching the employee's left hand. Four of the employee's fingers were injured.
An employee was playing volleyball with the residents, twisted an ankle and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken shoulder as a result of the fall.

An employee was mowing the green on a golf course when the mower's tire got caught on the edge of a retaining wall. The employee jumped from the mower and landed on a ledge about 5-6 feet away, suffering fractured back vertebrae.

An employee was cleaning grain spillage adjacent to a running conveyor belt when the employee's arm was caught in the belt and pulley, resulting in a broken radius and ulna in the left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee lost his fingertip while operating a lift gate on a truck.

An employee was using a steel brush to clean glue from the lay-up machine when the steel brush was caught in the rollers. The employee's right hand was then lacerated by the steel brush and rollers, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was breaking a bolt on an engine head with a breaker bar when the bolt gave way, which caused the employee to smash his hand into the engine head. He suffered a laceration to his left middle finger and crushed part of the bone.

An employee was attempting to perform physical intervention techniques on an agitated individual in a bus seat while other employees were calming the agitated individual. The agitated individual head-butted the employee, who was hospitalized with a concussion, fractured nose, and bruising to the lip/cheek.

An employee was repairing a door on a shipping container. A 4-by-4 piece of lumber, being used to brace the door, fell onto the employee's right hand. He suffered a partial amputation to the right ring fingertip.

The injured employee was standing next to a metal beam to connect it to a wooden beam. An excavator bucket hit the 2,000-pound metal beam, which in turn knocked the injured employee to the ground. The beam then landed on the employee's right hip/thigh, injuring it. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was using measuring tape to shoot grade when he slipped in mud and fell, striking his face above the right eye. He suffered a cracked sinus cavity and required stitches above his right eye.
An employee was using a braider machine and suffered an amputation.

A bundle of piping was being moved with a crane, with an employee holding onto the tagline to guide the bundle through an opening. A pipe was dislodged from the bundle and struck the employee in the forehead, knocking the employee unconscious and causing an open laceration and a small skull fracture above the eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An operator was working at the north end of a strip table with another operator at the south end of the table at a nylon unwrapper. The operator was trying to keep the 3/8" pole on the rollers to help the pole spin as the nylon was being removed from the pole. The end of the pole got caught in a roller and the operator's hand got tangled together with the pole. When the operator pulled his hand out of the entanglement, his right middle fingertip was amputated. The finger was also broken below the amputation point.
An employee was cleaning a dough mixer machine when the mixer's spinning blade contacted his hand, causing a laceration and broken bones. The machine was in operation at the time of the incident.

A Probst Group employee was inspecting a leaking line inside a 5-foot trench when the east wall of the trench caved in on him. His legs were compressed and he sustained a fracture to his pelvis, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was helping to load a rice tote on a railcar. He was near the edge of the platform when he fell off the platform (2 feet) and broke his femur.
An employee was using the escalator to access the second floor while holding shopping bags when she fell down the escalator and fractured her right leg.
On March 26, 2019, an employee slipped down an embankment, hitting a post and suffering fractures to the face.
An employee was driving a golf cart around a warehouse. The cart went under a storage rack and the employee was pinned between the rack and the cart, suffering head and chest injuries.
An employee was helping to change over a material hopper that used compressed air. The employee's left index finger was caught in the gate as it closed resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving a 72-inch industrial magnet (weighing 8,460 pounds) on steel sawhorses. The employee was repositioning the sawhorses while the load was suspended from a crane. A weld securing the magnet broke. The magnet fell on the employee's left index finger, crushing it against the sawhorse. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was removing the straps that secured wall panels that weighed approximately 2000 pounds to the wall of a semi-trailer. The panels fell onto the employee causing multiple contusions to the left arm, sternum and head.

An employee was transferring cleaned printing dies from a vertical drying rack back to a horizontal storage rack, about 4-6 feet away. As she turned toward the storage rack, she slipped on the printing plate and fell to the concrete floor, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was moving box lids on a conveyor. A knuckle chain caught his right hand and severely smashed part of his index finger. The finger was medically amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was on a step ladder installing a low voltage telecommunications cable when he fell from the step ladder to the concrete below, suffering a bruised lung, broken ribs, and a dislocated and fractured shoulder and elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking near an operating backhoe. The bucket struck the employee and fractured three ribs.
An employee was retrieving a bottle cap from a de-capper machine. The mechanism caught the employee's right hand, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were moving a 500- to 600-pound shaker that was about 6 feet tall and 4 feet in diameter. As the employees were loading the shaker into the bed of a truck, it fell over and struck a temporary employee in the left knee. The employee suffered muscle damage.
An employee was sedating an aggressive dog for grooming when the dog bit the employee's hand. The bite wound became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was stripping a floor with a chemical stripper, which got into his boot and burned him.

On March 26, 2019, at 10:15 p.m., a maintenance employee was working on the loader of an extrusion machine when the ram drifted forward and caused the loader to drop on the employee's left leg, pinning it against a lower tie-rod.
An employee was slicing cucumbers using a food processor and amputated the tip of her left middle finger.

An employee was working with two other employees, standing on a work platform, and using two chain fall hoists to remove a 2600 lb. pulley out of the active coke pellet conveyor. When the pulley was hoisted out of the conveyor slot, the weight of the conveyor changed and the pulley moved and pinched the employee's toe between the pulley and its box/container. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the right big toe.

An employee was operating a packaging machine when a package bag became misaligned in the machine. As he tried to fix the position of the bag, his left hand was caught by the sealer/cutter of the machine, resulting in the amputation of three fingertips.
An employee was trying to clear cement from a cement silo knife gate. The gate closed on his left hand, amputating the tip of his little finger.
At 11:30 a.m. on March 26, 2019, an employee was on the lift gate of a truck when it was raised and pinched his middle toe against the truck. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift struck a tank under pressure and knocked off a valve. High-pressure water struck him, causing contusions to the lower legs and left buttock.

An employee was standing behind a lowboy trailer, and attempting to unload an excavator. His left hand was underneath the winch cable when the winch line activated, pinching the employee's left index finger between the roller and winch cable. The employee's fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was riding outside on the running boards of an SUV as another employee was driving the SUV. He fell off and was hospitalized with a fractured clavicle.
An employee was repairing an air conditioning unit on a truck. The unit's alternator belt amputated the tip of his left middle finger.

An employee's foot became caught on a carpet protector, causing the employee to fall forward to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken humerus, bruised rotator cuff, and sprained wrist.
An employee was unjamming a rubber calendar mill and got a hand caught in the rollers. Multiple fingers were amputated.
An employee smelled spray paint which aggravated a respiratory condition. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting wire away from a bar joist that was being held/moved by an excavator. The excavator was moved, and the joist struck the employee in the back. The employee suffered back pain and broken ribs.

An employee was in an elevated scissor lift, repairing vertical struts on the outside of a building. The scissor lift was elevated over an overhead crane; the crane moved and struck the scissor lift, knocking it over. The employee suffered a broken ankle and a lumbar fracture.

An employee was standing on a concrete form, pumping concrete. The pump drew in air and it caused an air hammer in the line, knocking the employee from the form. He suffered broken ribs, a broken arm, and other injuries.

An employee was working around the metal grate for a concrete inlet. The employee's fingers were pinched between the grate and the concrete; the employee suffered severe lacerations and the possible amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was cleaning out the rear of the company van and when he closed the rear door, his right thumb was caught in the gap between the hinges. The tip of the thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was hand-feeding the end of a plastic roll into the nip point of a forming roller machine when the machine amputated the employee's left middle finger and partially amputated the left ring finger.
An employee was assisting a crane and flipped a duct panel when the employee fell and was struck by the duct panel, injuring the pelvic bone.

An employee was lowering the boom of the manlift. The manlift basket became entangled with a rope attached to a pulley used to hoist screens and tools to the top of the plant. As the manlift descended it put tension on the rope which broke the gantry frame. A section of the frame struck the employee's head/shoulder area. The employee lost consciousness and sustained multiple fractures to his skull, face, shoulder and ribs. The employee was wearing personal protective equipment at the time.
While working on a propane gauge, an employee suffered severe burns to the chest, abdomen, and legs.
An employee was cutting a block of graphite with a bandsaw. The saw amputated the employee's left thumb right above the knuckle.
An employee was cleaning out a trailer when chemical hydrated lime slurry splashed on his chest, causing burns and an infection.
An employee was loading thermal paint into tanks for heating when he contacted the metal edge of the cover opening, severing his right pinky and ring fingers just below the nail.

An employee was observing a conveyor after repair. The conveyor cycled and the employee's right index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee fell down from a deck platform.

At 6:45 p.m. on March 27, 2019, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift in reverse. As the forklift approached a stack of filters, the employee's left little finger was crushed between a pallet in the filter stack and the vertical safety bar on the forklift. The finger was broken and part of it was amputated.
While walking toward a parking lot, an employee tripped on a forklift tine and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.
While stocking shelves in a grocery story, an employee suffered a head injury. Disoriented and with a forehead laceration, he was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting steel with a torch when their shirt caught on fire and the employee was burned.

An employee was attempting to change some broken belts on a dust collector when the guard slipped down and lacerated his right index fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The dust collector was locked out at the time.
An employee was cutting wood with a miter saw. The saw lacerated her left hand.

An employee was adjusting a hydraulic torque wrench to attach a fluid end when a second employee engaged the high torque controls, resulting in an amputation of the first employee's right middle finger.
On March 27, 2019, a maintenance employee was attempting to free a jammed chain inside of a hoist when the chain moved, causing an amputation to the employee's left index fingertip.

The motor on the side of an oil tank, approximately 3-4 feet off the ground and weighing about 585 pounds, fell off a skid and landed on an employee's leg. The employee suffered an open fracture of the left tibia and fibula, as well as a laceration of the left middle finger.

On March 27, 2019, at 8:45 PM, an employee was attempting to clear a clog when the employee's left middle finger was struck by a rotating mixer blade, resulting in a broken finger and partial amputation.

An employee was holding a butterfly valve to adjust it prior to installation. The injured employee asked a second employee to apply compressed air to the valve. When the compressed air was applied, the valve actuated to the closed position, pinching the injured employee's left thumb tip between the disk and the valve body. The employee suffered a laceration/amputation to the left thumb above the knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell in a hallway breaking her femur.

An employee was on a baker scaffold when one of the wheels rolled off a curb. The scaffold tipped over and the employee fell about 8 feet to the ground, breaking his left humerus, clavicle, wrist, ribs, and pelvis.

At about 1:00 a.m. on March 27, 2019, a driver unhooked a chemical delivery hose at a customer facility and was sprayed with a corrosive chemical (45% caustic potash). He was hospitalized. Personal protective equipment was not worn at the time.
An employee was operating a tortilla making machine when the employee's left hand was caught between a piston and a door. The employee's left hand and wrist were crushed.
An employee suffered chemical burns to both arms and legs when her arm entered a container holding caustic residue.

An employee was attempting to clean a tail pulley from a conveyor system. The tail pulley caught his shirt and pulled him into the conveyor. He suffered a cut on the left arm. The machine was not guarded or locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee tripped and fell, breaking her right hip.
An employee amputated the tip of his finger while moving a terrain park rail.

An employee was using a vacuum to suction sand out from the bottom of an air filter bed used to filter fiberglass during paper production. The employee stepped down from a plywood plank being used as a temporary work platform; the employee's foot got caught between two dividers in the filter bed, causing the employee to fall. The employee suffered a torn anterior inferior tibiofibular ligament and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a hoist when the hoist retention hook failed causing the hoist to fall and strike the employee on the head. The employee sustained a head contusion and laceration.

An employee was prepping a foundation for a concrete pour and walked behind an active excavator. As the excavator was turning, the employee was caught between the counterweight and a wall causing a broken pelvis.
At 11:30 a.m. on March 27, 2019, a paramedic suffered a slipped disc in the lower back while lifting a 350-pound patient into an ambulance. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a hammer to disrupt a bridge of sugar inside of a storage vessel. The employee was outside the vessel. The hammer was dropped into the 12" x 12" auger inspection opening. As the employee retrieved the hammer, the auger started and the employee sustained broken bones and lacerations.
An employee was using a drill with a hole saw attachment to cut holes for bar ties on a wall form. The drill's chuck snagged his work glove and his left little finger was amputated.

An employee was walking on the rafters in an attic while blowing fiberglass. He stepped on a 2-by-4 board, which slipped out of place, causing him to lose his balance and fall through the ceiling. He suffered a broken right elbow and three compressed vertebrae in his back.
An employee was drilling into a concrete wall with a rag in hand. The rag became tangled in the drill, which then amputated one of the employee's fingertips.
An employee was checking the chlorinating system of water wells when the employee removed a section of tubing from the chlorinator and inhaled chlorine gas.

An employee was trying to take readings inside a 480-volt electrical disconnect panel. An arc flash caused burns to fingers on both the employee's hands, as well as the employee's left wrist. Personal protective equipment was being worn at the time.
An employee had placed a dog on a drying table after bathing when the dog bit the employee's lower left arm, causing two puncture wounds.
An employee was manually pushing an industrial cart/buggy by a container when his finger was caught between the cart and the container, resulting in an amputation of the left ring fingertip and nail.
Two employees were painting street lines in a middle lane work zone when they were struck by a vehicle, suffering head injuries.

An employee was in an elevated scissor lift, running wires to light ballasts. The lift fell over and the employee fell with it to the cement floor. The employee suffered two broken ankles, a broken pelvis, and a broken vertebra.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when his leg was caught between the jack and the racking system. His ankle was broken.

An employee was operating a reach truck (stand up forklift)and struck a metal support beam. Her left leg was caught between the operator's cabin of the reach truck and the beam, causing a compound fracture that later required removal of the leg below the knee.

An employee was driving a hustler pulling a container in the middle lane towards a crane when he veered to the left lane and hit a crane stopper. A seat belt was worn at the time of the incident. He suffered back, neck, and knee injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was adding yarn to the slasher machine when his hands were caught in the machine.
An employee was directing a forklift operator to push a skid into a trailer when the forklift struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs.
An employee was attempting to unclog a drain when his left pinky was caught in the drain snake, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On March 28, 2019, an employee was manually operating an automated guided vehicle (AGV) when the AGV swung around and collided with another AGV. The second AGV struck the employee's leg, pinning and breaking it between the two vehicles.
At 6:00 p.m. on March 28, 2019, an employee was repairing a machine from underneath it. The machine was hit and fell onto the employee, causing a rib contusion and bruises.
An employee fell to the ground while exiting a van and sustained a broken right hip.
An employee was sitting at a computer printing paperwork. When she stood up, she tripped on a cord and fell, striking her left hip on the desk and floor. She broke her upper left leg.
An employee was pushing a linen cart through a doorway when her right-hand  fingers were crushed between the cart and the door. Her middle fingertip and nailbed were amputated.
An employee was loading mail carts when a cart fell, hitting the employee in both legs and injuring them.
An employee was riding a horse in a barn. The horse startled and she fell off; the horse landed on her. Her right leg was broken.
An employee was refilling a juice container when a coffee container stored above the juice on a shelf fell and hit the employee's head, causing a laceration.
Two employees were walking down an aisle in a warehouse. A forklift's rear wheel ran over the left foot of one of the employees, causing crushing injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping unload a food service truck. As he was putting the ramp on the back of the truck down, the ramp caught his left index finger, causing a partial amputation that required surgery.

An employee had to remove a plug from one furnace to allow molten aluminum to move along a trough to another furnace.  When he removed the plug, the molten aluminum splashed out of the trough and went on his pant leg and into his open boot, traveling into the bottom of his shoe and burning the bottom of his foot. Proper PPE was not worn at the time of the incident.

A driver was delivering a zero-turn lawn mower that was strapped to a pallet to a customer. While unloading the shipment, it fell and landed on the driver's side and leg causing multiple rib fractures and a fractured left fibula.

Employees were at a drydock, lifting a section of fin tube onto a foot pad. An employee's gloved hand was caught between two fin tubes. The employee was hospitalized; one of the employee's fingertips was amputated (with no bone loss).
An employee was welding an exhaust hood when the welding wire punctured his right index finger.
An employee was on a finished section of the roof of a single-story house during a reroofing job. He slipped and fell off the roof, breaking his left arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was blowing down a conveyor when he slipped and his hand was caught between two rollers, causing a hand injury.
An employee was testing a transformer when the employee suffered an electrical shock, receiving burns on both palms. The power supply was not turned off at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a piece of wood to move a metal tube on a lathe. The lathe amputated the employee's left thumb above the nail.

An employee was on top of an 18-foot flatbed trailer, delivering trees (stacked two high on the trailer) to a nursery. He fell from the trailer to the ground 8 or 9 feet below, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unjamming a palletizer when the machine actuated, striking the employee and causing facial/head injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was jumping over a wooden railing that separates the property when the employee fell to the ground, breaking the right leg and ankle.
An employee was helping another employee take inventory when the mast of a forklift caught his right ring finger. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was working from a 6-foot step ladder inspecting a duct detector when he fell from the fourth step of the ladder to the ground, fracturing his tibia. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On March 28, 2019, an employee was cleaning a wood planer when the rotating blade caught his glove. He suffered amputations to two fingers on his right hand.

An employee attempted to depressurize a roller to change out the guide paper on the pouring line. While depressurizing the roller, another employee moved a roll of paper that contacted the injured employee's right thumb tip, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was rolling a 15-inch by 12-foot pipe off a trailer. When the pipe started to roll, a band clamp on it bent. The pipe caught the employee's glove and pulled the employee off the trailer. The employee's wrist and hand were crushed under the pipe; the employee's thumb was amputated and other fingers were crushed, with skin torn off exposing bone.

The injured employee was supervising another employee who was operating a track skid steer loader during a backfilling excavation. The operator lost control of the skid steer and rotated toward the injured employee's path, striking him on the chest with the bucket. He suffered five to seven broken ribs and a possible collapsed lung.
At about 7:00 a.m. on March 4, 2019, an employee slipped on ice in a parking lot. The back of the employee's head struck the asphalt pavement, causing a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead crane to set 12-by-10 box culvert. His left hand was caught between two structures, and the index finger and thumb were crushed and broken.

On March 28, 2019, a temporary employee was working inside the USS Iwo Jima's 50-foot tank from a mid-level platform, marking up areas needing repairs, when he fell 17 feet to the bottom of the tank. The platform was unguarded and personal protective equipment was not worn at the time of the incident. The employee was hospitalized with a head contusion and a broken arm.

An employee working in a bucket of bucket truck approximately 16 feet above the ground was securing a steel support strand to a building facade when a tractor trailer hit the steel support strand. It detached from the building and struck the employee causing a broken right arm and facial lacerations.
An employee fell down stairs, suffering a broken right femur.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, dismantling pallet stacks. The racks collapsed and knocked the scissor lift to the ground. The employee suffered a head laceration, a fractured elbow, a left hand contusion, a laceration to the right hand, broken ribs, a partially collapsed left lung, and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was fixing rollers that were not rolling on a conveyor when his right hand was caught in the pinch point area. He was hospitalized with a dislocated and lacerated right hand.

An employee was assisting a forklift driver with moving flanges. The last flange fell over. The  employee walked over to stand the flange up. The employee picked up the flange and it slipped from his hand. The employee's left ring finger was crushed between the flange and a pallet and amputated.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while delivering food, suffering a hip fracture.
An employee was picking oranges when an orange tree branch scratched his left eye, causing blurred vision.
An employee fell while coming down a ladder, dislocating his arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to set a dock plate. A truck was moved so that the plate could be reset, and the plate reverted to its resting position. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg and broken ribs.
A temporary employee was standing on a truck loading gate when the employee fell to the ground, fracturing an ankle.
An employee fell while descending a fixed ladder to a lower-level roof. He fell 5.5 feet, landing on his feet and suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was being trained on a walkie stacker when her left thumb was caught between the handle and a storage rack. The thumb was broken.

An employee climbed up the side of a pallet to secure a strap when his foot became tangled in a plastic covering. He lost his balance and fell to the trailer floor, fracturing his humerus. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was performing maintenance on a weaving machine when his right middle finger was caught in the machine, crushing/shattering the bones in his finger.

An employee was cutting welding wire from a welding machine's welding head when he was struck from behind by the welding machine boom and knocked into a steel pipe that was being loaded onto the welding rack. He suffered a ruptured intestine and torn ligament in the right leg.
An employee was taking dirty dishes into the back of the store when she slipped on a wet spot and fell onto her back fracturing the T9 vertebra.
An employee was transitioning from a ladder to the fender step of a ready-mix truck when the employee slipped and fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured tibia.
An employee was attaching a base frame and mast section together on a hoist when his right middle fingertip was caught between the base frame and mast section, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee's right thumb was crushed while the employee was moving a pre-conditioner. The thumb suffered an amputation injury.
An employee was unstacking a pallet when her foot got caught in plastic wrap. She fell to the floor, breaking her left leg.

An employee was rigging on a project to remove large pieces of scrap material when the foundation of the structure gave way, causing it to fall on the employee. The employee suffered a cracked rib and cut on the head.
An employee was going to a store to get balloons for an in-store event when she tripped on the sidewalk and fell, hitting her shoulder on a brick pillar and sustaining shoulder fractures.
An employee was replacing coolant on a chiller. The pump leaked propylene glycol on the floor and the employee slipped and fell, tearing a hamstring. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was boring a fly wheel when his hand entered the boring machine and his finger was caught between the fly wheel and the cutting bar. His left ring finger was amputated.
An employee was cutting a log when his chainsaw cut his leg.

An employee was working on a roof. The fall protection system the employee was using fell at a gap in the roof, pulling the employee with it; the employee fell 30 feet, suffering maxillofacial and wrist injuries, and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell off a ladder to the ground, breaking an ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder when the open end of a stanchion caught a ring on his finger. He suffered a severe laceration to the third phalange, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was in a boom forklift that had a box attached to it cutting down a tree to clear power line. The employee was in the box. After cutting down the tree it fell towards him and he jumped from the box to avoid it. He fell on a ladder and fractured his leg requiring surgery.

On March 29, 2019, an employee was offloading cypress boards from a machine. The machine caught the employee's shirt and pulled his right arm through, crushing it. The employee suffered a broken right arm and a severed primary nerve in that arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was strapping down plastic water barriers on a lowboy trailer. A gust of wind knocked a barrier into the employee, knocking him off the trailer. He fell about 2 feet to the ground and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a steel jamb near the opening of a rotary forging furnace and was struck by the steel jamb when it fell causing a contusion injury to the right calf.
A pickup truck backed into an employee, knocking him to the ground and breaking his right hip.
A well tender was putting methanol in a dump-line when the nipple broke off the line. Methanol sprayed into the employee's face and eyes; the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to a table when he fell, hitting his head on the table or a chair. He developed a knot and a cut.

An employee was loading a docked trailer with an electric pallet jack. The trailer moved, creating a gap that the employee fell through to the ground. The employee suffered a dislocated right ankle and broken right foot.

An employee was attempting to close the swinging gate in the central hospital when a bovine hit the metal gate causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee fell on concrete and sustained a concussion.
An employee was in a warehouse, standing on a pallet on the second level of a rack. The employee fell to the floor, suffering broken vertebrae and ribs.
An employee was repairing a meter. The meter's glass cover shattered and the employee's left wrist was lacerated.

A security guard was trying to quell an argument between two park patrons when they began fighting. The guard was grabbed from behind and thrown to the ground and the two patrons fell on her. She suffered broken ribs and a head injury.
An employee was picking up a box in a meat room. He struck his head on a steel beam as he stood up, suffering a brain bleed.

At about 10:00 a.m. on March 30, 2019, an employee dismounted a backhoe. The backhoe rolled into the employee, pinning the employee between the front bucket and a storage trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and a perforated intestine.
An employee was going to retrieve a part stored in an auto parts storage cage when he tripped and fell to the floor breaking a hip.
An employee was carrying curb forms and experienced chest pain and fell to the ground.

The injured employee was operating a forklift in aisle CB while another employee was operating a forklift in aisle CA. The forklift in aisle CA pushed elevated stock into aisle CB and a plastic skid fell and struck the injured employee on the head. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was working from a ladder, removing a tile from a ceiling. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering a broken left elbow.
An employee was loading a vehicle when an automatic loading dock pinned the employee's toes, causing partial amputations to three toes.

An employee was loading equipment onto the seat of his golf cart. He turned around to get some more equipment when something fell off the seat and hit the pedal causing the cart to move forward. The employee attempted to catch the cart when he fell and hit his head.

An employee was attempting to pull an exchanger using an air winch and a pulley. A chain securing the winch broke, causing the winch to lurch forward. The winch struck the employee in the leg, causing a broken left femur.

A truck driver had parked a truck, carrying a container, under a crane. The crane picked up the trailer and took the truck with it, lifting the truck about 10 feet. When the crane lowered the truck, equipment inside the cabin injured the employee's neck, lower back, and right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
Hot water spilled out of a pasta cooker onto a cook, causing burns to the right side of his body that required surgery.
An employee was walking with a client at a diner when she tripped on a rug, fell, and broke her right arm.
On April 1, 2019, an employee was struck by a forklift, resulting in an injury to the right calf that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee injured his hand while using a press brake.
An employee was on an aerial man lift inspecting a roof when the employee contacted a powerline, suffering second/third degree burns on the right arm from the bicep to the wrist.

An employee was applying pipe dope to a thread on a tool joint. His left hand was caught between a lifting sub and elevators, causing crushing injuries that led to the total amputation of the pinky and ring fingers and partial amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was cleaning a sauce depositor head when the machine's photo eye was tripped. The machine's filler head actuated and caught the employee's right index finger, causing a fracture and partially amputating the fingertip.

A driver was positioning a truck for loading at a dock. The driver had gotten out of the cab to place a metal plate between the dock and the truck bed when the truck rolled into the driver, causing a broken left femur.

An employee was working at the eave of a roof when rotten wood in the fascia, decking, and trusses gave out, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a laceration to the right cheek and a broken bone in the right shoulder.
An employee was using a metal shear when a hold-down foot pinched his finger, causing a crushing/amputation injury.
An employee was unloading cardboard from a flatbed truck when the employee missed a step and fell to the cement floor, injuring the right cheek and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee experienced back pain while carrying a 20 lb. box by rope to the next level.

At about 3:30 p.m. on April 1, 2019, an employee was operating an angle broom machine. A bundle of broom bristles had not loaded correctly in the feed table; the employee was straightening the bundle when the machine cycled, amputating the employee's left little fingertip.
On April 1, 2019, an employee was bending tubes on a CNC tube bending machine when the employee's finger was caught between the dies and material, resulting in an amputation.
While walking down a flight of steps, an employee missed a step, causing him to fall and land face first on the concrete ground. He received several lacerations and fractures to his face.
An employee was standing behind a registration desk when she fell, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was clearing a paper feed jam when the knife cycled and amputated his left middle fingertip. The knife was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was exiting a truck. Two of the truck's side steps had been torn off and the employee fell to the pavement, suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was preparing a crane to load a sheet of metal on a plasma table. The employee straddled the spreader bar to unhook it from the crane, attached a plate clamp, and then stepped over the spreader bar while raising the clamp. The clamp snagged on the lip of the spreader bar, which tipped over. The bar struck the employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was using a cutting torch with oxygen and acetylene when the hose caught fire, resulting in burns to his left thumb.
An employee was installing/splicing bulkhead sheet piling when the employee's hand was caught between sheeting. The employee was hospitalized with a hand fracture.
While operating a CNC lathe machine, an employee was caught in the part. The employee suffered head trauma and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a plate with a grinder. Sparks caught the employee's shirt on fire, causing burns to the right hand and right abdomen.
An employee was walking through the cafeteria when she walked into a door on the bulletin board, fell backwards to the floor, and injured her left hip, femur and pelvis.
An employee was pushing a 40-foot goose neck trailer down a finish line when the chain broke, causing the employee to fall and hit his head on a metal rack. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a ladder to access a roof. He fell about 10 feet to the grass/concrete ground, suffering wrist, forearm, and pelvis injuries.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a free pump when the pump amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was using a water hose to clear material out of the discharge end of a screw auger of a tender truck. The employee's fingers were pulled into the discharge end of the auger; two fingers were amputated.

Two employees were using a telehandler forklift with an adjustable spreader bar to transport rebar at a construction site. When the load was lifted off the ground the spreader bar beam slipped off the forks and struck the employee on the right leg fracturing it.

An employee was cleaning a reject from a press machine when the rollers came on. The employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers were caught between the rollers; she suffered a soft tissue amputation to the tip of the index finger, a missing nail on the ring finger, and a scratch on the middle finger.
An employee pulled a lower back muscle while lifting a 50-pound bucket. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting paper with a manual cutter. The cutter cut off the top of his left thumb to the bone, requiring surgery for a skin graft.

At 10:00 p.m. on April 1, 2019, an employee was on a pallet jack, transferring and lifting equipment. The jack lost power after hitting a bump in the floor, and the employee fell off it and struck his head on the concrete. He suffered a severe head injury and brain bleeding.
An employee was standing on a cart tipper when he fell 3 feet to the ground. His right leg was caught and his left leg hit the ground, breaking the femur.
An employee was laying rebar next to a roadway when an oversized load of wooden trusses on a truck struck the employee in the back, fracturing three ribs and both shoulder blades.
An employee was cutting angle iron when the hold-down mechanism smashed the tip of his left middle finger. The employee underwent a medical amputation to the finger.
An employee was guiding a customer's vehicle as it reversed. His right arm was caught between the vehicle and another, stationary vehicle. The forearm was broken.
An employee was walking across a highway when a motor vehicle struck him, breaking his right hip.
An employee was stepping up on concrete stairs and slipped and fell on the stairs. She fractured her right femur.

An employee was bucking a fir log when the tension released, launching the log into the air. The log landed on the employee, resulting in two fractured vertebrae in the neck, one back vertebra fracture, five broken ribs, a broken clavicle, a punctured and collapsed lung on one side, a partial collapsed lung on the other side, multiple contusions and scrapes, and a chipped tooth.

An employee was adjusting/moving an aluminum float during a concrete pour when the 30-foot long float swung outside of construction working limits and contacted a 13,200 volt primary power line. The employee received electrical burns to both palms.

An employee was participating in an observation training tour to learn about other locations. He was on the outside perimeter of a substation when he stepped into an uneven portion of natural ground, fracturing his right ankle and leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing up from a desk and began to walk away when she tripped on a cord underneath the desk. She fell to the ground and fractured a femur.

An employee was pushing and pulling carts inside a shop area. The front cart got stuck on a ball bearing on the floor and the second cart continued moving, catching the employee's left middle finger between the two carts and amputating the tip.
An employee was unbolting an I-beam when it fell on his right foot, resulting in the amputation of four toes.
An employee was threading a carding machine when the employee's left middle finger was caught in the threading rollers resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee hit the back of his head on a metal spout.

At 3:00 p.m. on April 2, 2019, an employee was setting a frac pump in place. While a Pitman arm was being pulled into place, it struck him in the left leg, causing a dislocated ankle and fractures to the tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was stacking boxes for loading onto a van. A package struck her from behind, causing her to fall. Her left knee struck the floor and the kneecap was broken. She was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was changing the plastic film on a machine when her glove became caught in the film, resulting in the right wrist being crushed by the machine.
An employee was using an infrared gun to check the temperature of hot mix that was being loaded into an elevator to feed a silo. The flames rose, burning his face and neck.

An employee was trying to remove a board that was stuck vertically in a mill stacker reject bin when it moved toward instead of away from him and it hit his hand. The board caught his finger, causing an amputation.

An employee was holding a flashlight for another employee who was doing maintenance on a downhole sucker rod pump. The second employee was installing a plunger back into the rod pump, using a pry bar. The bar slipped and the plunger was propelled out of the pump toward the first employee. It caught his right hand and carried it downward, pinching the third finger against the fender of the pump. He suffered an avulsion and partial amputation of the finger.
An employee fell off a roof to the ground and suffered a back injury.

An employee was trying to close a flatbed trailer door. He stepped off a two-step ladder he had used to reach the door's handle. As he lowered the door, his middle finger was caught between the bottom of the handle and the top of the ladder, causing the amputation of the finger from the first knuckle.

On 4/02/2019, an employee was approximately 6 feet off the ground on an 8-foot ladder, hand-adjusting a wire on ducting/sheet metal that was being hung. He became unbalanced and fell to the concrete floor, fracturing his left upper arm and requiring surgery.

An employee was opening a disk grinder while grinding a metal plate when his glove was caught in the grinder, causing a severe laceration to the left index finger that resulted in a fingertip amputation.

An employee had just finished loading metal products onto a flatbed trailer and was attempting to egress the flatbed trailer by stepping on the frame of an adjacent machine when the employee fell approximately 3 to 4 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones (including a compound fracture) to the left tibia and fibula.
An employee suffered an asthma attack after being exposed to potential chemical fumes while working in the laundry room.

An employee was working on a ladder resting on a wooden plywood platform. As the employee was climbing down the platform, the plywood came loose and broke. The employee then fell 6 feet off the ladder and broke an ankle.
An employee was feeding material into a machine when the employee's left pinky finger was pinched between the material and the machine, resulting in a partial left pinky finger amputation.

An employee was helping a sheet metal foreman measure a small sheet metal roof over the dock. The employee walked onto the sheet metal roof and fell through a flush skylight on the canopy.  He fell 16 feet, landed on some 55-gallon drums, bounced, and ended up on the dock concrete flooring. He was hospitalized with broken ribs, broken vertebrae, a punctured lung, an injury to the other lung, and a damaged spleen.

An employee was adjusting the installation of a PDC drill bit on a horizontal grinding machine. The grinding wheel started and his right glove and index finger were pulled between the wheel and the surface to be ground. He suffered a partial amputation of the finger.

An employee was in a dry laundry area packing line. When the employee opened a door to adjust a rail, a chain and sprocket caught the employee's left hand, causing cuts and amputations to the index finger (tip amputation), middle finger (amputation to the second knuckle), and ring finger (amputation from tip to nailbed).

On April 2, 2019, an employee was holding onto a hoist chain with one hand and placed the other hand above the hoist block. As the employee pushed the load away from the handrail, the employee's glove pulled the employee's right hand into the hoist block, pinching the fifth digit between the chain guide and hoist chain. As a result, the employee suffered a right pinky finger distal phalanx fracture and soft tissue avulsion, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a box cutter to remove a zip-tie on a tote when it slipped and cut his left arm, severing an artery. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was pressure-testing a valve outside when it broke and struck his left leg, fracturing his pelvis and lower leg.
A temporary employee suffered an index fingertip amputation while attempting to free a package that was stuck on a conveyor belt.

An employee was operating a pneumatic bell press that had a two-hand trip. The employee attempted to adjust a part when the employee's finger was caught between the part and the point of operation, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation. The machine was activated at the time of the incident.
