Employees were swabbing a well when a lubricator came down and smashed an employee's left index and middle fingers. The fingers were amputated.
An employee was moving a mat from the asphalt at a golf course and stepped on a sod staple, puncturing the left foot and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was hooking up a sling for an excavator to move a piece of concrete pipe when the excavator operator pulled up on the sling, crushing the employee's left hand between the pipe and teacup.

An employee grabbed a stop bracket to pull himself across while underneath a trailer tightening up rear-frame attaching bolts. His left middle fingertip was caught between the rear frame and stop bracket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was receiving freight when the loading plate malfunctioned and would not move up. The employee tried to move the plate with his hand, and the dock plate was knocked back and hit his right hand, resulting in an index fingertip amputation.
An employee fell to the pavement in a parking lot, breaking her arm.
On April 2, 2019, an employee was cutting garbage can tops with a jamb saw. The saw jammed and went out of control, lacerating the employee's wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a tool to clear a jam in a mechanical power press. When the jam cleared, the stop gate activated, catching the employee's right hand and resulting in the amputation of the right ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was sweeping ash off a kettle when trapped moisture caused molten zinc to pop after steel was submerged in the kettle. The molten zinc contacted the employee, causing second degree burns.
An employee fell from a flatbed trailer as he tried to secure the load. He landed on the ground and suffered a broken right wrist.
An employee was taking a half-keg of beer off his truck. The keg fell onto his right ring finger, crushing it and causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was on a riding lawn mower when it tipped over into an embankment. The lawn mower fell on top of him resulting in collapsed lungs, fractures to the wrist, ribs, collar bone, shoulder blade, and cheek bone as well as cuts to the left ear and wrist.
An employee slipped in a hall and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left arm and shoulder.

An employee was working on a second floor deck and fell through an opening in the tool floor approximately 6 feet 8 inches to the first floor deck. He was hospitalized with a cervical strain, concussion and abdominal pain.

On April 3, 2019, at approximately 2:00 AM, an employee was MIG (metal inert gas) welding on a steel bridge cord. A piece of hot silica (slag) fell into the employee's left boot causing a severe burn to the bottom of the foot.

At 2:00 p.m. on April 3, 2019, two employees were removing meat from bones when they began fighting. As the first employee punched at the second, the second raised both arms. The first employee's right wrist was cut by a 6-inch flexible boning knife that was still in the second employee's hand.

An employee was on a raised platform with an inspector, trimming fat from a carcass using an 8-inch knife. As the carcass moved down the line, the knife nicked an artery in the employee's forearm, requiring surgery.

An employee was walking through a facility when she tripped on a wire that was hidden beneath the seat. The wire wrapped around her ankle, causing her to fall and break her knee. She was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a 5-ton compressor on an HVAC unit using an acetylene torch. While applying heat to the discharge line, residual oil/freon that had been expelled during brazing ignited, causing first and second degree burns to the upper chest and face.
An employee was folding a lift gate after delivering a package to a customer. The gate pinched the employee's right middle finger; the tip had to be medically amputated.
An employee was walking across the workroom floor to retrieve a scanner when she slipped on a puddle of water and fell onto her left side resulting in a fracture to the right femur.
An employee was using a router machine and got caught between two tables on the router machine resulting in a pelvic injury.

An employee was transporting a box placed on the seat beside him on the forklift. The box fell while the forklift was in motion. The employee reached down to retrieve it and lost control of the forklift while going down a ramp. When the employee tried to regain control, he was ejected from the forklift and injured his hip.
An employee tripped while stacking electrical conduit and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left arm.

An employee was insulating an AC duct pipe in a ceiling area about 10 feet above ground level, using an 8-foot A-frame ladder. He fell to the ground, injuring his head and breaking his left femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was prepping to band material when the material tipped off the staging area and struck the employee's leg, fracturing it.
Three employees got into an altercation; one was stabbed in the arm and another suffered a broken jaw.
While walking in a blast freezer hallway, an employee was struck by a forklift and suffered a broken lower right leg.
An employee was walking into a building when she tripped and fell. She suffered a broken left femur and an injured left knee.

An employee was working from the third step of a 6-foot A-frame ladder when it fell over. He fell onto the ladder and the concrete floor, suffering a lacerated spleen, multiple rib fractures, and a broken left foot/ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a resident shower when the resident dropped a tissue. As the employee bent over to pick the tissue up, the employee suffered back pain due to two herniated discs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a 24-inch PVC pipe when it struck the employee, causing broken ribs and possibly collapsed lungs.

An employee was dismantling masonry scaffolding with a partner from a six-foot ladder.  When he pulled one end of the 2x8 boards free the other end also broke free and caught his gloved left pinky finger in a pinch point between the board and a steel pipe. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unplugging heat tape used in an exterior drain spout from an electrical box. The box was positioned so that the employee had stand on a grate to access it; the grate gave way and the employee fell into the window well about 90 inches, suffering broken ribs and four broken vertebrae.

An employee was replacing a bearing assembly on the outside of a weighted feed bin. After repairs were completed, the employee was putting the completed assembly back into the feeder housing when the feeder coil suddenly retracted into the feeder housing. His finger was pinched between the bearing cap and the feeder housing, resulting in a partial amputation and open fracture to the left middle finger. The motor on the feed bin was locked out at the time.

On April 3, 2019, at about 9:10 a.m., a temporary employee was hydro-blasting inside a tanker trailer when he slipped backward. The hydro-lance crossed his left foot, causing lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee had been attaching barricade tape when their right foot was fractured by a crane's outrigger.

An employee was operating a ride-on zero-turn mower in a sloped residential yard. The mower slid off course and the employee landed on its blade, suffering amputations to the right first and second toes.
An employee cut a piece of wood on a table saw and was reaching to grab the leftover stock when the employee's thumb struck the saw blade, severing a tendon.
An employee fell while walking, and a paring knife he was carrying stabbed into his abdomen.
An employee had a heart attack while at work. The employee was descending a utility pole when he began to present symptoms.
While an employee was using a chainsaw to trim a coconut tree, the chainsaw kicked back causing lacerations to the left forearm and bicep.

A cable installer at a residential single family home hooked his ladder over a metal strand line, climbed up the ladder and hooked up his fall protection to the strand line and began diagnostics on the communications line. A splice on the strand line failed resulting in the ladder and the employee falling 18 feet to the concrete driveway below. The employee sustained fractures to the elbow and pelvis.
Two truck drivers got into a fight; one suffered injuries to both eyes and was hospitalized.
An employee was filling chemical bottles with sanitizer when the sanitizer entered the employee's boot and caused a severe chemical burn to the top of his foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was taking the plug out of a press. The forks of a forklift had been placed under the plug so it could rest on them when it was unbolted. The employee was unbolting the plug when the forks slipped. The plug fell and crushed the employee's right hand and wrist.
An employee fell from planter racks and suffered a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was opening a valve when they slipped onto a concrete barrier and broke three ribs.
An employee was holding a cat during a nail trim when the cat bit the employee.
An employee was standing on an extension ladder to trim a bush when he fell approximately 4 feet off the ladder to the ground. His ankle was fractured and required surgery.
An employee was approached by a dog while delivering mail. He fell and injured his right ankle.

The injured employee (mechanic) was troubleshooting a box truck and asked another employee (Employee 2) to go inside the truck. The mechanic told Employee 2 to press on the break and push on the accelerator to hear the sound the truck was making. The mechanic was under the truck when it came off the jacks and rolled forward striking the mechanic and causing rib fractures and trauma to the chest.
An employee was riding an ATV when he lost control and jumped off, fracturing his tibia and fibula.

An MWD tool was being picked up with an air hoist. As it was being lifted and was about 8 feet off the ground, it slipped out of the lifting clamp and fell onto an employee. The employee suffered bruised vertebrae.

An employee was on top of a trailer delivering acid when a 2-inch valve came loose, hitting the employee in the face.  He suffered missing teeth and facial fractures, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial vehicle near a racking system. The vehicle moved under the rack and the employee's arm was trapped, suffering multiple breaks.
An employee returning from a meeting was walking down the stairs and fell. The employee suffered a head injury, lost consciousness and was hospitalized.

Two mechanics were trying to reposition a crooked race inside a pit furnace that was preventing the furnace cover from closing properly. One of the mechanics was at the upper end of the furnace using a long, steel tool to strike the race in an attempt to pry it loose. The second mechanic was near the bottom of the furnace, checking the position of the race after each attempt to move it. The steel tool  struck his hand and amputated his right ring fingertip.
An employee was cleaning the top of a mixer using an air hose. The employee fell from a platform to the concrete floor, suffering a broken wrist and a concussion.

A border agent was riding on an ATV, chasing after a group of people. The ATV hit a rut with deep vegetation. The agent was thrown from the ATV and suffered broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a punctured lung.
An employee was using a floor-operated crane to haul a steel beam. The beam struck a stationary beam, which fell and pinned the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a torn ligament in the leg.
An employee was lowering the flop chute on the back of a cement truck. As he was unfolding the flop chute, his right pinky finger was pinched between the sections of the chute and amputated.

An employee was carrying a container of a corrosive solution that is used to wash produce. The solution leaked onto the employee's pants and caused a chemical burn to the upper left thigh that required hospitalization.
A dumpster attached to a forklift by a chain was being lowered when the dumpster hit an employee's left foot. The employee sustained a fractured big toe requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized with head and neck injuries after falling to the ground while skiing down a trail.
An employee was driving a golf cart when his left leg contacted a barrier. He suffered a fracture to the left leg.

An employee was walking in the hallway when the tread on her shoes caught on the floor causing her to trip and fall. Her face, right eye, and teeth struck the floor. She sustained a right orbital fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee had been repairing the winch truck. A pipe on the winch truck fell and hit the employee's head causing an injury that required 15 staples.
An employee was unloading a tractor trailer. The load became unstable while the chains were being removed; the employee fell off and was struck by a pipe rack, suffering injuries to both legs.
On April 4, 2019, an employee was unloading pipe from a van to a loading dock. The employee suffered a hernia and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a 16-20 foot extension ladder to secure it. While stepping onto the roof to tie off the ladder, the ladder slipped and the employee fell. The employee landed on paver stones on a walkway and was hospitalized with a broken arm and leg.
An employee was working to dislodge a log from a hydraulic log flipper. When the log dislodged, the log flipper's leg came down and amputated the employee's right big toe.

An employee was moving a 300-pound piece of sheet metal from its stored position to the shear to cut it to size. The sheet metal fell onto the employee's steel-toe boots. The employee's right foot was punctured by a corner of the metal and several bones in the foot were broken.
An employee was attaching a trailer to a truck when the employee's left pinky finger was pinched in a trailer hitch, resulting in a slight amputation of the finger.

An employee was grinding a flywheel on a lathe. As the machine was winding down, the employee's fingertips were trapped between the wheel and the grinder. The employee suffered amputations to the left little and ring fingers above the first knuckle.
An employee was lying on his back underneath a kitchen sink installing a laminate countertop and felt pain in the lower chest while pulling on the countertop.

An employee was working on an automation assembly laser machine when parts moved unexpectedly. The employee's finger was caught in the machine as it advanced, and he suffered a broken bone and a partial fingertip amputation requiring surgery. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground 12 feet below, suffering bruises to the heels, the left arm, and the wrist.
An employee was operating a press when a piece of steel snapped in half and caused a head injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee's foot was run over and crushed by a telehandler.

An employee was doing setup on a slitter arbor. The table moved; the employee was caught by the chest between the table and the splitter arbor. The employee was then released and fell, striking his head and suffering head injuries.

An employee was spraying the gears of a citrus machine. The gears caught a towel tucked into his pants, then pulled in his right index finger. The finger was crushed and was amputated up to the first knuckle.
An employee was walking along a sidewalk at work when she tripped on an uneven section and fell to the sidewalk, fracturing her right arm and wrist.

An employee was refueling an excavator from a fuel cell located in the back of a pickup truck. When the employee was rolling up the fuel hose and cable, the excavator rotated counter-clockwise and crushed the employee's lower back/torso between the excavator and the pickup truck.
On April 4, 2019, an employee became ill while operating a wire drawing machine. The employee was hospitalized due to carbon monoxide exposure.
An employee was clearing a jammed board from an edger machine. The employee's left hand was caught in the blades of the edger, suffering lacerations and an amputated index finger.
An employee suffered an avulsion to the middle fingertip while working on a metal stud machine.

An employee was operating a polyurethane machine. When the employee was detaching the water line, the teeth of the polyurethane machine caused a laceration to the left wrist requiring hospitalization.
An employee had been operating a golf cart and then exited it. He was in front of the golf cart when it rolled into him, running him over. He suffered back injuries.

An employee was installing a new outdoor fire pit. When the pit was ignited, a fire blast knocked the employee back 5-10 feet into the shrubs. He went into shock and suffered minor burns to the hands.

An employee was troubleshooting a calender machine when some of the cords became misaligned. The employee's hand was caught between the machine's rollers, causing lacerations, fractures and the amputation of the employee's ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was cutting plywood with a circular saw when it became stuck and kicked back, making contact with his left hand. The top portion of his left hand below the fingers and above the wrist was lacerated, as well as his left pinky finger below the knuckle.
An employee was feeding a client when the client bit off the tip of the employee's right little finger.
On April 5, 2019, at 2:00 p.m., an employee was walking to their car, tripped over a rolling computer bag and fell. The employee sustained fractures to the left foot, ankle, and lower leg.

On April 5, 2019, an employee was feeding the edger machine when a board jammed. After clearing the jam, the employee proceeded to operate the machine when a board kicked back and struck the  employee in the abdomen. The injury required surgery.

On April 5, 2019, at about 3:00 p.m., an employee was performing setup procedures on a press. While feeding webbing into the cylinder, the employee's right middle finger got caught in the cylinder resulting in an amputation to the finger.
An employee was clearing a piece of wood that was stuck in a jump saw when the blade activated and amputated his left thumb tip.
An employee was straightening a barrel liner. The liner slipped off the supports, pinching the employee's left index finger between itself and the machine. The employee suffered a partial amputation.
While mopping the stairwell, an employee lost her balance and fell at the bottom of the stairs, breaking her hip.
An employee was servicing equipment when it started up. The employee's right index finger was caught between a fan pulley and a belt, causing an amputation to the upper part of the finger.
An employee was loading aluminum ingots from a truck to a conveyor belt. An ingot fell and struck the employee on the left index finger, causing an amputation to the tip.

An employee was using an angle grinder when he tripped on a sea wall grounding wire, causing the angle grinder to contact and lacerate his right knee as he fell to the ground. The angle grinder blade was unguarded at the time.

An employee was doing maintenance on a semi trailer from a rolling ladder. The ladder broke, causing the employee to fall and strike the ground. The ladder landed on top of the employee. He suffered a broken left hand and two broken bones in his right foot.
A temporary employee was lifting boxes of parts when the box fell on the employee's right foot, resulting in the amputation of the big toe and the second toe.
A bus driver fell out of a bus, which rolled backwards and ran over the driver's leg.
An employee was assaulted by an employee of another contractor, suffering a crushed esophagus, a shattered nose, and bruises to the face.

An employee was cutting angle components on a table saw. His hand contacted the backside of the saw blade; the nail and skin on his left index finger were amputated without bone loss. The table saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was trying to remove some bubble from a line. It wrapped around a roller and his hand was pulled in and stuck between two rollers. His left arm was injured.
On April 5, 2019, an employee was loading a roll-off container when the chain slipped. It struck the employee in the face, causing a fracture; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to remove a stuck towel that was caught in a bin dumper machine when her finger was caught between the bin and bin dumper machine, cutting and lacerating her left index fingertip.
An employee was descending from a closet to the sales floor about 4 feet below. He suffered a hairline fracture of the left knee.
An employee came into contact with hydrofluoric acid vapor while working on a line, suffering a second degree burn to the lower face and neck area.
Two employees were fighting when one of them threw hot grease on the other. The second employee suffered second- and third-degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was participating in a formation run with his class when he became exhausted. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a stack of drywall that was leaning against a wall when the drywall fell onto his right leg breaking his tibia and fibula.
An employee was attempting to repair a cargo door when the door fell down and struck him, causing head, neck, and shoulder injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee was shutting down a centrifuge for cleaning when it broke off the points just above where it was bolted to the floor. A piece of it struck the employee's chest, causing a cut and injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while skiing and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.

An office manager asked an office assistant to circle something on a patient's treatment plan. The assistant responded, then came up behind the office manager and put her arm around the office manager's neck and squeezed. The office manager felt a pop in her neck and was hospitalized with neck pain, and elevated blood pressure and blood sugar.
An employee was repairing plumbing under the crawl space of a residential dwelling when a spider bit the employee's abdomen, causing an infection that required hospitalization.
An employee was opening a trailer door when freight that was against the door amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was carrying a garden hose up a fixed ladder. A swing gate at the top of the ladder swung open, causing him to fall 8 to 10 feet to the ground below. He suffered a broken ankle.
An employee fell from a dumpster rail to the ground, suffering a head laceration and fractures to the shoulders, breast plate, and spine. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing up in a forklift when his left arm was pinned between the side of the forklift and the steel racking behind him. The arm was crushed between the elbow and the shoulder, suffering a compound fracture.

Four employees were moving stored chairs out of a golf cart barn. An employee was between parked carts when a charger connected to a cart fell and struck the employee in the head, causing a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was connecting two LD-3 containers on dollies. He was moving the rear dolly with his right hand on the dolly tongue and his left hand toward the front dolly's connection hitch when the rear dolly's ring impacted his left ring finger, fracturing it.

An employee was on the fourth floor of a building under construction. The employee was discussing getting welding leads down from up above to ground level. When the employee looked down to see where the welding cables would go, the wooden safety railing failed and the employee fell approximately 25 feet. The employee fractured their right arm, sternum, and two vertebrae in their back.

At approximately 8:10 p.m., a Wood employee was engaged in opening a filter pot. He was holding a box-end wrench while another employee assisted in pushing on the wrench. The nut gave way, pinning the injured employee's left ring finger between the wrench and the filter pot. The fingertip was amputated. The injured employee was wearing gloves at the time of incident.
An employee was transferring chemicals from a chemical tote into a tanker truck when the hose whipped out of the tote and struck the employee on the chin. The employee's jaw was broken.

On April 6, 2019, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was attempting to close a drawer in the gun vault of a vehicle when the employee's abdomen bumped the drawer closed on the employee's left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee went to fill the day tank and was sprayed in the face with sodium hydroxide, requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered a thumb amputation while performing maintenance on a grease pump.
An employee was helping to unload pallets when the pallets tilted and fell on the employee's legs. The employee suffered lower left leg fractures and a fractured right ankle.
An employee tripped over a space heater cord, fell and broke her hip.
An employee was cleaning up the processing floor with water and cleaning solution when he turned and lost his footing, falling to the ground. He was hospitalized with a left hip injury.
An employee was restocking a wall display. As the employee dismounted the ladder, their foot got caught on the display causing the employee to fall to the floor and fracture a hip.
An employee was performing roofing work when he fell from elevation and fractured his arm, requiring hospitalization.
The cap blew off a camlock, striking and breaking an employee's right hand.
An employee missed a step as she was walking down the stairs and fell, fracturing her right lower leg and ankle. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two maintenance workers were servicing an electronic fill button on a nearby 12 to 17 percent sodium hypochlorite chemical day tank. A 1-inch chemical line became dislodged and sprayed both employees, causing chemical burns on their chests, torsos, and arms. Both employees were hospitalized.

Employee was cleaning with a power washer when his foot became stuck in the mud. As he tried to pull it out, his boot came off, causing him to lose balance and activate the power washer. The power washer then amputated a toe.

An employee was administering shots to chickens with an avian vaccination needle containing Autogenous Orthoreovirus vaccine. The employee missed the chicken and stuck himself on the left hand resulting in an infection.
An employee was escorting a coworker operating an order picker when the coworker turned the picker around and struck the employee's right foot. The employee had surgery on two toes.
An employee was working in a 15-foot-deep foundation when a boulder from the perimeter rolled down and fell on the employee's lower right leg, causing muscle injury.
An employee was lifting a 100-pound CMU block while on a scaffold. The board he was walking on flipped over and he fell about 5 feet to the ground, suffering a broken left leg and ankle.
An employee was in a trench for a sewer line. Part of the trench wall collapsed, knocking the employee to his knees and burying him. He suffered bruises and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder into an attic while carrying HVAC supplies. The ladder slipped and the employee fell approximately 9 feet to the ground below. A jug of freon then landed on his head. He suffered a bruise on the left arm, pain/soreness in the hip and back, and a head injury.
An employee was moving a supply cart when she fell to the concrete floor, suffering a wrist fracture that required surgery to install a plate.

An employee was using a wrapping machine to wrap a roll of roofing material when the employee's hand was caught between the machine's guard and wrapping arm, resulting in a right little fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a baggage tug and struck a baggage chute. The employee suffered a laceration to the liver and was hospitalized.
An employee was working from a baker scaffold, removing ceiling tiles. He fell 4 feet to the ground, breaking his shoulder.
An employee was working on a blower line air vent when the blades of the vent amputated his right hand.
An employee was getting some roofing material from the top of a pallet. As he stepped down, he twisted and broke his ankle, requiring hospitalization.
On April 8, 2019, an employee tripped and fell on a carpeted floor, breaking her left hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb, removing soft tissue and bone. The saw was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a conveyor when the employee's arm was pulled into the rollers, breaking the left arm.
An employee was turning the corner with an electric pallet jack when the employee's leg was caught between warehouse racking and the jack, breaking the employee's tibia.

An employee was tightening a clamp (using channel lock pliers) on a pasteurizer system when a leak was identified. The clamp fastener dislodged while turning and 240-degree liquid discharged onto the employee, causing burns to the waist, abdomen, legs, and knees.

An employee was operating a forklift when the employee stepped off the lift to reach for a roll of shrink wrap and fell, landing on the roll of shrink wrap. The employee suffered contusions to the ribs and chest area.
An employee was performing maintenance on an aircraft when he fell 2 feet from a stepstool to the floor, hitting his head and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a railcar mover to move a damaged rail car to be unloaded. The rail car did not have functioning brakes at the time. As the employee backed the rail car down the track, it started to go down an incline. The employee lost control and the rail car and railcar mover flipped on its side. He was dislodged from his seat and his knee struck an object inside the railcar mover.
An employee sustained soft tissue damage to the upper left leg when he was caught underneath a trailer tire.

An employee was offloading a 55-gallon steel trash can drum into a larger 30-yard roll-off trash container. He was rolling the drum inside the container, on its edge, when it shifted quickly and pinched his right thumb against the container, causing a deep laceration. He was hospitalized for surgery to repair a tendon and nerve in the tip of his thumb.

An employee was standing near the top of a step ladder, trying to clear a jam on an overhead transport belt, when the ladder legs kicked out. The employee fell to the floor, breaking two ribs on her right side.
An employee was freeing stuck baggage at an airport baggage carousel. The carousel caught the employee's index finger, causing an amputation to the end of the finger.
A skid steer machine's bucket was knocked loose from the machine and fell on an employee's foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a basket attached to a forklift working on light fixtures. The basket fell off the forks and the employee fell to the ground, suffering fractures.
An employee had reached down to pick up debris from a milling operation. A dump truck rolled over his right hand as it backed up, causing compound fractures of two fingers.
An employee was helping unload pallets of metal parts at a client's site. His foot was pinned between a truck and a metal strap, lacerating his foot and fracturing his little toe.

An employee was tightening the bolts of a saw blade on a tube cutoff machine. The blade was turned, and the employee's wrench followed its movement. His left little finger was crushed between the wrench extension and the framework of the machine. The tip was amputated.
An employee was working in a hoist way. The employee's hand was severely injured.

A partially assembled stair landing/post assembly was being hoisted when it shifted and the top of the landing rolled over. It hit an employee in the small of the back, on the left side, and knocked him down. He suffered a hematoma and was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a vehicle to fuel up when his finger was caught in the pinch point between the driver's side door and a metal post, resulting in an amputation to his right ring fingertip.
An employee was standing on the opposite side of the metal brake press machine when it tipped over and fell on the employee. The employee suffered right lower leg bruises.
A plumber was repairing a customer's cast iron stack pipe. As he lifted it to install the band connector, it slid down and amputated the tip of his right index finger.
An employee was walking out of a pantry area when she tripped and fell, sustaining a fractured hip and right shoulder.

An employee was hooking up tandem trailers with a dolly when the rear trailer shifted and pinned the employee against the dolly. The employee suffered bruising on the left leg and a broken left thumb.

An employee was unloading feed from a tractor trailer when a blockage occurred.  He was attempting to clear the blockage when his left hand made contact with the auger, causing deep lacerations to his fingers.
An employee's motorized wheelchair rolled out from under him and he fell to the sidewalk, suffering a broken femur.

On April 8, 2019, at 12:26 p.m., an employee was using a manual rolling light duty tilt truck to dump collected garbage into a dumpster at the dock. The employee tilted the truck and its contents backward, and while doing so, his hand was caught between the metal handle of the tilt truck and the edge of the dumpster, amputating his right pinky fingertip.
An employee was lifting an automated wire stripper and suffered a right rotator cuff injury.
An employee tripped over a rug and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was loading material between rollers on a press machine. The machine engaged and caused the material to shift, catching his right middle finger. The fingernail and nailbed were amputated.
An employee was closing the door on a gate. Her right little finger was caught in the door latch and the tip was amputated.
An employee was stepping down a stepladder when she fell from the third step to the floor. Her right leg was broken below the knee, and she was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on the top of a restaurant hood. He fell off the hood to the floor below, suffering a right tibia/fibula fracture.
An employee was cleaning out a frac tank when a tube came into contact with the opening on top of the tank. The employee's right index finger was crushed, and the tip was medically amputated.
An employee was working on a generator with a grinder, cutting off the end of the exhaust pipe, when the grinder flew back and hit the right side of his face. He sustained a cut.
An employee slipped and fell on the stairs.
An employee was adjusting a capper. The drive chain and sprocket caught and injured the employee's right hand, causing the amputation of three fingers.
An employee tripped on a skid of product while walking in a warehouse. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was engaged in changeover activities on the press stacker when the stacker table activated and pinned him, injuring his head and right arm.
An employee was fixing a coffee machine when a blade cut his finger. He lost consciousness and fell, hitting his head and suffering a concussion and a ruptured blood vessel.
A tailgate fell, striking an employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized.
A wooden pole loosened as it was being pulled down and smashed an employee's left hand. One of the employee's fingertips was amputated, and another had the skin and flesh stripped to the bone.
An employee was cleaning an upstairs storage area. A motor was being tossed to a lower level when an attached hose clamp snagged his clothing and caused him to fall 10 feet. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee was using a horizontal band saw to dismantle wood pallets when the employee made contact with the band saw blade, suffering a thumb laceration. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was standing on a wooden railing 1-2 feet high, hanging a clock. He fell forward to the ground and broke his hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was locking and unlocking container cones aboard a container ship utilizing a lashing rod. The employee slipped and fell due to wet conditions on the deck, landing on a lower deck about 4-6 feet below and suffering a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was fixing a wire breaker from a spool roller machine. The machine engaged, amputating both of his middle fingertips.
On April 9, 2019, an employee was cutting a piece of 6" pipe with a demo saw.  The saw kicked back and cut the employee's face.
An employee was working on a baler when it caught his hand. He suffered two broken fingers and lacerations, and was hospitalized.
An employee was in a work zone flagging traffic. An automobile entered the work zone and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury and a broken leg.

On April 9, 2019, an employee had just gotten off his fork truck when it rolled back onto him, pinning him to the floor and fracturing his pelvis. The emergency brake was not set at the time of the incident.
An employee was lacing up on a roofing shingle maker. The machine caught the employee's hand, peeling off the skin from his left index finger to his left little finger.
An employee was standing up from her seat when she tripped over an ottoman and impacted the floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee was framing a residential home when he fell approximately 4 feet off a step ladder to the ground, breaking his left leg and requiring surgery.
A truck driver was on a truck flatbed, securing a tarp. He fell 4 feet to the concrete floor and suffered a compound fracture to his left ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was riding on the passenger-side riding step at the rear of a garbage truck. The employee fell off the truck to the pavement, suffering fractures to a heel, an ankle, a wrist, and two ribs.

An employee was handling and cutting a 44 lb. aluminum cast on a vertical saw work station. The cast became snagged on the saw as the employee attempted to cut the cast. The employee attempted to pull the cast loose from the saw and the saw blade forced the cast downward. The cast fell on the employee's right fifth finger/little finger, crushing it and resulting in a medical amputation of the fifth digit fingertip.
An employee was abrasive blasting a metal platform with aluminum oxide. The abrasive medium struck the employee above the left knee, causing a severe laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling up warning line on a roof when he fell through a skylight to the floor. His lower back was injured and he was hospitalized.
An employee was chopping vegetables with a handheld knife. The knife cut a portion of the employee's thumb, causing an amputation to the fingernail and thumb area.

An employee was operating a standup forklift to move stock. His left leg struck a pallet jack that was not being used at the time and pinned between it and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized for a leg fracture.
An employee was operating a forklift when it pinned her leg against a concrete end cap.
While performing infill insulation repairs, a roofer fell 20 feet through a repaired roof opening.
On 4/10/2019, a home health aid tripped and fell on an uneven sidewalk while leaving a patient's home and sustained a dislocated/fractured shoulder requiring surgery.

An employee was using an electric belt sander to sand plywood. The employee's left index finger was caught between the sander's belt and the rollers, and the fingertip (to the rear of the nailbed) was amputated.
An employee fell through a skylight while conducting roof repair. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a broken section of concrete and fell to the floor, breaking her pelvis.

An employee was removing a metal roof at a stable. The employee fell through an opening left by a removed roof panel, landing in a horse stall about 15 feet below. The employee suffered injuries to the back and pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was dragging a piece of plywood to the dumpster. The wind caught the wood and knocked him to the ground. He landed on his hip, breaking it.
A dock plate got stuck while being deployed into a trailer. While an employee was getting it loose, it caught on his glove and slammed down onto his right index finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was carrying a piece of plywood across a parking lot when the wind caught it, causing him to fall on the pavement. He suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was under a vehicle, troubleshooting a component. The engine started, and the compressor/alternator belt caused the amputation of one of the employee's fingers and the partial amputation of another.
An employee was on a ladder, using a pressurized hose to wash a refrigeration unit on a semi trailer. The ladder slipped and he fell to the ground, suffering a concussion.

An employee was operating a planer feed table. As he was clearing a jam, his left hand was caught between the speed-up roll and a piece of timber. He suffered amputations to the left ring and middle fingers to the first and second joints. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

A temporary employee was placing a wheel assembly onto a bead seating machine. When the machine cycled, the cylinder bolts failed allowing the piston, bell housing and wheel assembly to swing out toward the employee's head. The tire struck the employee's face and knocked him backward onto the concrete floor. The employee suffered a loss of consciousness and a laceration to the mouth and the back of the head.
At about 8:10 p.m. on April 10, 2019, an employee was backing a shuttle bus into a parking space. She fell from the bus and it ran over both of her legs, causing severe injuries.
An employee was painting from a baker scaffold. He fell from the scaffold to the floor 1.5 feet below, suffering a tibia/fibula fracture and a fractured ankle.
An employee was defrosting a vessel with a flexible steam line.  He set the steam line in the vessel and it slipped out, allowing steam to burn his neck, chest, and stomach.
An employee was installing Tyvek on a 7:12 pitch roof and fell about 12 feet to the ground, suffering fractures to both wrists and a broken vertebra. Fall protection was not being worn at the time.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor. The employee suffered bleeding in the brain.
An employee was raising a pallet jack when the pedal kicked back, striking the employee on the shin causing a cut and severe swelling.
A valve amputated an employee's fingertip.
An employee was operating a rough terrain forklift. The forklift rolled 270 degrees on an embankment and the roll cage struck the employee, breaking the employee's ribs and scapula.
An employee was working near a drive shaft on a naval vessel. He ducked under the propulsion shaft and his hard hat struck the shaft causing a broken vertebra in his neck. He was hospitalized.
An employee had just finished maintenance work on an HVAC system. He was closing the guard cover when it slipped, smashed his left hand (bruising two fingers), and severed the tip of the ring finger.
An employee fell 7-8 feet from a fence, breaking his left ankle.
An employee was stacking material that was coming off a press. The stack fell over and the employee fell backwards, cutting the back of his head on the ground.
An employee was diagnosing a water leak on an ice machine when the tip of his left index finger was cut off in a small hole on the machine.
An employee was closing a valve hatch cover on top of a tank railcar. The cover closed on the tip of his right index finger, lacerating the skin. The employee was hospitalized.

On Wednesday, April 10, 2019, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was using a step ladder while fixing a piece of exterior siding on a modular home. The employee was at a height of approximately 4 to 6 feet when the ladder tipped and he fell to the ground on his left side. He was hospitalized with a fractured left pelvis.

An employee was unhooking chains that held a de-limber in place on a transport vehicle. The de-limber moved and pinched his right ring finger against a chain, causing an amputation at the first joint.

An employee was holding the tag line for a debris bucket that was being lowered to the ground. The bucket caught the edge of a floor and tipped, spilling part of its contents onto the employee. He suffered fractured neck vertebrae and was hospitalized.
A temporary Jacobs Engineering employee's leg was caught in the deck of a mower. His leg was broken.

Two employees were installing a cross-beam on a racking system from 6-foot-tall step ladders. One of the employees fell and their head struck the concrete floor, sustaining an open head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying a board from his work area to the green chain. He was putting the board on the chain and caught his left middle finger between the board and the chain resulting in an amputation.
An employee was cleaning parts of a metal fabrication machine. His left little finger was caught between moving rollers and amputated.
Two forklifts were being driven, one behind the other, when the first forklift stopped. The second forklift's fork went through the first forklift's cab, injuring an employee's left foot.
An employee was climbing down from a street sweeper when he fell about 3 feet to the ground, breaking his right leg.
An employee was cutting steel at a burning table. His clothes caught fire and he suffered burns to the chest and face.
An employee fell while walking down stairs. She suffered a broken left tibia and a dislocated left ankle.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder set up on a telephone pole. He fell about 20 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a broken shoulder.

A pallet jack went into motion without an operator, crushing an employee's lower leg against a piece of angle iron. The employee suffered an ankle fracture. The pallet jack was tagged out at the time.
An employee fell from a ladder while climbing down, landing on the ground 6-7 feet below. He suffered a broken right ankle and a fractured left humerus.
An employee was connecting a propane tank to a sweeper/scrubber machine. The tank began to leak and the employee's right hand was frostbitten by the gas. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a mat on the way into the building, suffering a broken right arm. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was preparing to install an electrical conduit on a switch gearbox when he fell about 7 1/2 feet to the floor. He suffered nine broken ribs on the left side of his body.
An employee was unbundling bales of recyclable material. When he cut the wire with his wire cutters, it snapped back and poked his left eye. He underwent surgery to relieve pressure behind his eye.
An employee was working on a ladder inside a car wash. The car wash activated, causing the employee to fall off the ladder and suffer a wrist injury.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground, breaking her neck.
An employee was fixing low-voltage wires in a store's garden center when he fell 25 feet to the ground, suffering a broken back and brain hemorrhaging.
An employee was retrieving a piece of plastic from a plastic cutter machine when the blade amputated his left ring and middle fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was stocking in a frozen food department when she was thrown off balance by an L-cart of freight and the tape around it. She stumbled and twisted her right ankle. The ankle was dislocated and fractured, requiring surgery.
An employee was crossing the street when a passing car struck him, breaking his femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a hammer to loosen a piece of cement from the paddle inside a mixer. The paddle amputated three fingers and part of his right hand.
Employees were drilling a water line/pipe when a sling, used to stabilize the pipe, caught an employee's arm and shoulders. His hands and arms were broken.
An employee was at the top of a ladder changing light bulbs and fell onto a music stand, which impaled the employee and punctured a lung.
An employee was walking in a parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground. He suffered a concussion and a fracture to the upper jaw, and was hospitalized.

A subcontractor employee was working on a residential trash collection route. As he crossed the street to get to a customer's residence, a passing vehicle struck him. He suffered head fractures and trauma.
An employee was about 6 feet up an 8-foot ladder, fishing wire down a wall. He fell from the ladder to the carpeted floor, breaking his right leg.
An employee was getting ready to open the department store when a gust of wind hit the front double doors, causing them to strike the employee's head. The employee suffered a concussion.
A tree was cut down and fell on an employee, causing a back injury.

An employee was performing putty work and final painting work when he reached for a water bottle. After drinking from the water bottle he began to vomit. The employee had ingested paint thinner and was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a threader. Shavings had balled up; the employee was removing them with a tool when the shavings were caught and pulled his hand into the machine's disc guard. He suffered a displaced fracture with partial amputation of the right little fingertip.
A temporary employee was helping a forklift driver lift the base off a mold on the ground. The employee's finger was pinched between the lifting loop and the base, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was bending sheet metal roof cleats on a folding machine. The ram came down on his hand, amputating the three middle fingers at the knuckle and crushing the little finger. He was hospitalized.
A tree rolled onto an employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck driver fell off the flatbed of his truck to the ground, suffering a broken hip that required surgery.

An employee was standing on a disassembled section of scaffolding frame, which was lying flat on the ground connected to a second frame. The second frame was hit with a hammer to dislodge it from the first, and the employee lost his balance and fell backwards. His right jaw and head area struck an I-beam and his jaw was fractured.

An employee was working on a rail car ladder, 8-10 feet off the ground, putting a tarp on the rail car. A strong gust of wind blew the tarp, causing the employee to lose his footing. He fell from the ladder to the ground, breaking his right leg and right elbow.
A security officer working for Paragon was escorting a customer out of an office when the customer physically attacked him. He was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding a crane as it moved pieces of steel. The employee's right thumb was smashed between two of the pieces, suffering an amputation.
A wood chipper caused a partial amputation (to the second joint) of an employee's right index finger.
An employee was cleaning the ram on a plastic extruder machine when the employee's hand and arm were caught in the machine causing a fractured right radius.

On April 12, 2019, an employee was removing a jammed bottle from a bottle takeout device machine on a line. A cylinder closed on the employee's right little finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was using a core drilling machine to take samples from larger concrete samples. The drill bit became stuck in the concrete, causing the drill base to swing around and strike the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was cleaning out concrete at the bottom of a concrete pump hopper. The pump turned over and caught his fingers, causing partial amputations to two of them. He was hospitalized.

At about 2:15. p.m. on April 12, 2019, a postmaster was on a back dock as empty all-purpose postal containers were being loaded onto a scissor lift to load onto a truck. As the lift was being raised to the level of the truck, one of the containers rolled off and struck the employee in the back, pinning her against the brick wall. She suffered a 2-inch laceration on the top of her head (requiring five staples), a fractured vertebra in her neck, and a concussion.

An employee bent down near a conveyor to inspect a jammed tire shredder. The conveyor caught the tail of his jacket, pulling him into the machine and causing broken ribs and lacerations to his right arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was refueling a gas pump when it caught fire. The employee's legs and arms were burned.
An employee was re-banding a unit of lumber on outfeed chains. The lumber advanced and trapped the employee's right middle finger against the end stop. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee's left index finger was caught between a parts rack and a jib crane hook, resulting in a partial amputation.
While using pliers to lift a urethane anvil cover, an employee suffered a slipped disc.
An employee was walking on a second-floor joist when he fell, breaking his right hip.
An employee slipped on a floor and fell, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was moving a gun safe with a manual pallet jack. The safe slipped, crushing his right toe.
An employee was cutting onions when the knife amputated a portion of his right thumb.

An employee was on a third floor balcony of an apartment building that was being built. He fell over a guardrail to the ground below, suffering broken vertebrae and a thumb injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a linear saw using compressed air. The saw activated and the employee suffered lacerations to the right hand.
An employee was loading brush into the bucket of a backhoe. His left ring finger was caught between the bucket and a limb of the brush, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was examining an unresponsive cat when it suddenly awoke and became aggressive, biting the employee's right hand near the little finger.
An aide was working in a client's home when her foot was caught in a bedframe wheel, causing the employee to fall to the floor and break her hip.

An employee was unloading material from a trailer. When the employee cut the load strap, some pipe rolled off the trailer and onto the employee's legs, breaking the right tibia and dislocating the left knee.
An employee was removing casing. The casing swung from the rig and struck the employee's right index finger against the rig tongs, smashing the fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a tablet compression machine when it started, catching the employee's fingers and causing an amputation to a finger.

A roofer was carrying a box of nails when he fell off of the roof of a one-story house and landed on the ground. He sustained a broken left arm and left pelvis and was hospitalized. A safety lanyard was not connected at the time of the incident.

An employee was replacing the carbon set on a furnace. His fingers were caught in the carbon/head intersection of the furnace, causing the partial amputation of his right ring finger and an injury to the right middle finger.

Several employees were riding in a flatbed truck. The truck had to swerve to avoid a barrel in the road and an employee fell out onto the street. The employee suffered a laceration to the right ear, a broken bone in the right ear area, and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was removing a device from an ice cream freezer when ammonia came out and hit the employee, causing burns.
An employee fell through a ceiling into the room below, landing on the floor and suffering a punctured left lung, rib fractures, and a broken clavicle.
An employee was inspecting a cabinet when a wind gust shut the door on the employee's finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was throwing a pallet into a dumpster. The pallet shifted and landed on his right ring finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning shavings from a drill press. The press caused a partial amputation to the employee's hand.

An employee was replacing insulated roof panels when his right foot slipped causing him to fall forward into an open space  He fell approximately 10 feet from the roof to the floor of the building striking a wall section and the edge of the stone fire place. The employee sustained contusions and strains to the back and neck and left side of his body. The employee was wearing a harness, but it was not tied off to an anchor point.
A maintenance tech was cleaning a piping system (piping from granulator D) and amputated his left thumb. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An emergency room nurse was treating a patient when she was exposed to fish and suffered a serious allergic reaction. She was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a muffin depositor machine when the machine activated, causing partial amputations to two of the employee's fingers.
An employee was testing new padlocks on a water tank lid. The lid closed on the employee's right thumb, lacerating it at the nail bed.
On April 13, 2019, an employee's torso and right arm were burned when a pH probe came out of a fermentation vessel fitting and steam was released through the open port.
On April 13, 2019, an employee was delivering mail when the employee slipped off a curb and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.
An employee was degutting a cattle carcass with a knife. The knife punctured the employee's left lung.
An employee was loading product into the back of a customer's vehicle when the vehicle struck the employee.
An employee was clearing a jammed part from a chopper on a line. The chopper lacerated the employee's right middle finger, causing an amputation of the first quarter inch of the finger.
An employee was removing a broken board from a green chain when his hand was caught in a pinch point. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was pushing an air handler on a conveyor system when he suffered a hernia. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On February 7, 2019, an employee was standing on a dock plate when a truck pulled forward from the dock. He fell 4 feet to the floor, suffering a compound fracture to the lower right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding lumber into a planer. A flying object struck the employee below the left ear.
An employee was stung by a bee while collecting mail from a mailbox. She suffered an allergic reaction and was hospitalized.

On April 13, 2019, an employee was descending a 16-foot fixed ladder after replacing filters on an extraction system. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor 6 feet below, breaking his right arm in two places. A safety harness was not being worn at the time.
While receiving shopping baskets in a parking lot, an employee tripped and fell over a concrete parking stop. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.
On April 14, 2019, an employee was trying to clear fluff from the cone in an extruder. A rotating screw caught the employee's left index finger, amputating the tip.
While blocking product in a supermarket aisle, a grocery clerk slipped and fell, suffering a broken left hip. The clerk was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while walking near a water cooling tank that had just overflowed. The employee suffered a broken left femur.
An employee fell from an aircraft loader, injuring his right knee.
An employee was moving a lawn mower deck on a forklift. While the employee was adjusting the deck, his left ring finger was pinched and cut. Part of the fingertip was amputated.
After test leads were attached to an energized cable, a flash burned an employee's face and hands. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping up onto a platform. The employee's foot caught on a step and their right shin contacted the step as they fell, causing a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was kneeling down next to an empty IBC tote when a forklift approached to lift the tote. The tote struck and injured the employee; he was hospitalized for a fractured left tibia.
An employee was driving a forklift and was pinned between the forklift's backrest and a rack. The employee suffered multiple back fractures.

While working at a cooling tower, an employee was adjusting/leveling a motor and fan. The fan was turned on, which activated the belt and pulley. The employee's left hand contacted the fan's belt and pulley, resulting in a partial amputation (first joint) of the fifth digit.
Employee was on a 6-foot stepladder hanging cables. The employee fell off the ladder, striking his head on the floor 4-5 feet below. The employee suffered a skull fracture and soft tissue trauma.

An employee was cleaning and lubricating the drive chain on a pipe coating machine. The rag he was using to remove excess oil was caught in the machine, which resulted in his hand being pulled in. He suffered a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was using a circular handsaw to cut a wooden board at ground level. The blade ricocheted and cut the toes on the employee's right foot, causing an amputation. The safety guard was not in place at the time.
An employee was on an extension ladder when it slid out from under him. The casing of a pump motor lacerated his scalp.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder, trying to unjam a garage door, when he slipped and fell backwards, landing about 4 feet below on his back. He suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was conducting well-servicing operations. He was attempting to guide a rotating rod away from a winch line when the spinning rod, which was covered in paraffin, caught his gloved left hand, amputating the pinky finger near the knuckle.
An employee was vacuuming catalyst inside a confined space. A piece of the catalyst rolled down from the pile and struck his leg, breaking the femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was grabbing material out of a shipping container when the wind blew the door closed on the employee's arm, causing a closed fracture to the right forearm.
An employee fell down two steps in a theater. She hit her head and suffered two broken fingers and a strained back.
An employee was conducting abrasive blasting inside a tank in a submarine. Blast media from the nozzle struck his chest and was embedded in the skin. He was hospitalized.
An employee of Apache Scaffold was disassembling a scaffold when he fell 20-40 feet inside a confined space boiler, suffering multiple injuries.
An employee was backing a forklift up to a rack and his leg became lodged between the forklift and the rack. He suffered damaged muscle tissues on the left leg.

An employee was holding up 18 27-by-83-inch pieces of glass while another employee was pulling a sheet of glass from the middle of the stack. The employee fell backwards between two pallets of wood doors. The force of the fall shattered half the glass. The employee suffered two broken tibias, a broken left ring finger, and a laceration on the right thigh.

On April 15, 2019, an employee was cleaning tables in the warehouse area with acetone. The employee heated up the acetone and the solvent ignited, burning him below the knee, on both legs, and the right hand.

An employee was trying to free a dock plate when his right hand was caught between the surface and the dock plate. The top of the hand was lacerated and the little, ring, and middle fingers were broken.
An employee was cutting metal with scissors. The metal cut his right hand and he was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a beading machine. The machine caught his left glove, causing the amputation of his middle fingertip.
An employee was enroute to show a property to a client when she tripped and fell on an uneven public sidewalk and fractured the left elbow.

A loss prevention employee was bringing a shoplifter back to the office when the shoplifter ran toward the exit door. The employee slipped on the shoplifter's jacket (which had fallen to the ground) and fell, breaking his hip.

A temporary employee was taking wood off a saw and placing it on a cart. His hand was caught by a roller mechanism; the rollers and a chain caused the partial amputation of his middle, ring, and little fingers.
A forklift struck an employee in a warehouse, injuring his left ankle and foot.
An employee was taping a wall for painting when plastic became tangled in his stilts. He fell, suffering two broken elbows.
An employee had been cleaning a boat when he was found unresponsive and was not breathing. He sustained a bump on his head above his eye.
At about 2:30 p.m., an employee was documenting a trailer load when a forklift was backing up and struck her, causing fractures. She was hospitalized.
An employee was moving totes full of magazines out of his truck. The tool he was using got stuck and flung him forward; his knee struck the floor and was injured.

The injured employee and a co-worker had just finished packing up items in a house and were transferring them to a new location when the injured employee felt chest pains as he was driving the moving truck. The employee had a stroke.
While vacuuming a floor, an employee got tangled in the cord and fell sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was hanging lights from a ladder when the employee fell from the ladder to the ground, breaking the left foot.
An employee was climbing a fiberglass extension ladder when it gave way. He fell to the ground, breaking his right kneecap.
An employee was working on a pad-mounted transformer when an arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's ear, face, neck, and shoulder area.
An employee was lining up a door into a jam to staple it together with a pneumatic staple gun when the gun stapled his stomach with a 2-1/4 inch staple.

On April 17, 2019, an employee was helping to fix an issue with the pipe system. The employee removed a hose from the boiler truck used in the pipe lining process and hot water sprayed out, burning the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized.

Three employees were working on a welding positioner. One of them was installing a belt when it caught their finger, injuring the finger and necessitating a partial amputation during surgery. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was placing a bag over a motor to start clean-up procedures on a mixer when his right hand was caught between a belt and pulley. The middle and right ring fingers were severed to the second knuckle. The index and small fingers were also damaged. The mixer was still running at the time of the incident.
On April 14, 2019, an employee was cutting the ends off frozen pork loins using a bandsaw. The blade amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee's right hand and four fingers were caught between a tracking roller and conveyor belt, causing abrasions and burns to the knuckles and the back of the right hand.

An employee was cleaning a paint gun with xylene. He had removed the gun's spray tip when pressurized xylene sprayed out, lacerating and injecting his hand. He was hospitalized with hand swelling and a potential infection.
An employee was closing a vehicle gate when her hand was caught in the gate, smashing three fingers on her left hand and amputating her left middle fingertip.
On April 16, 2019, an employee was cutting product on a bandsaw. The saw caught the employee's left middle finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was setting stairs onto a rig platform when the stairs became disconnected from the rig platform, causing the employee to fall 6 feet from the platform and be struck by the stairs. The employee was hospitalized with four fractured ribs.
While working in the kitchen area, an employee bent over to pick up a phone and fell on the wet floor.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was helping a driver slide the tandems on a containerized chassis when the employee's hand was smashed on the containerized chassis, cracking the wrist bone and a bone in the hand. The employee required surgery.

An employee was attempting to land a pallet jack on an outrigger landing platform (Level 12). The employee was signaling the crane and controlling the load at the same time. His hand was in the open slot at the end of the forks where the wheel retracts into the fork. The wheels were not powered down, but extended because of gravity. As the load was brought down, the wheels retracted into the opening, pinching the employee's fingers. The index and middle fingers were severed at the first knuckle.

An employee was manually adjusting the tongue on a loader in order to place it for towing to a new logging location.  The employee's finger was caught somewhere near the tongue, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on ice while getting out of her car and suffered a broken right femur.
An employee jumped down from his semi-truck, lost balance, and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.

An employee was shelving a shipment of pallets with a pallet jack that had been staged in the staging area. The employee was returning from the shelves to pick up another pallet when she was struck by a forklift at an intersection. She fractured her lower left leg.
An employee was climbing up an 18-foot fixed ladder. He fell to the cement floor about 15 feet below, suffering a broken right heel.
An employee was folding up a mat used for therapy when it caught her foot. She fell forward toward a cabinet, breaking her left arm at the shoulder.

An employee had been trimming logs with a chain saw when he started to move to a new location. His left foot became caught under a log as he stepped over it, causing him to fall forward and fracture his left leg.
An employee was welding when the welding hose blew out, causing third degree burns to his lower abdomen.

An employee was removing wooden forms from 30-foot-tall poured concrete cylinders at a building site. The employee's right hand was caught between the wooden panels of two forms, and the employee's ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was handing masonry blocks to another employee on a scaffold when the employee walked backwards off the scaffold and fell approximately 5 feet onto a concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken right arm, requiring surgery, and a fractured right hip.

An employee was climbing down from a scaffold. The locking key to the midrail came undone, and the employee lost his grip on the rail (which was wet) and fell. He landed on the ground about 12 feet below, suffering cracked ribs and bruised lungs.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor while walking.
An employee was putting frozen packages into a box when his right little finger was caught on the spiral freezer belt, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was helping his work crew perform maintenance on furnace slide valves. While the valve components and hardware were being disassembled, the employee's right middle finger was caught between the flange's slide plate and blind. The tip was amputated.

An HVAC service technician was responding to a service call at a customer's residential location. The employee was investigating a portion of the HVAC system in the backyard and fell from the elevated deck to the unpaved ground below. The employee suffered contusions and lacerations to the spleen and lower arms that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on a press. After the machine cycled, he pushed down the short pieces with a tool. As he was doing this, the machine was activated via the pedal, causing the spring to come down on the tool and crush the employee's right third finger.

On April 16, 2018, an employee was on a 12-foot ladder soldering a water pipe in the ceiling with a propane torch when the torch flashed, causing first degree burns to the employee's right shoulder and face. The employee fell from the ladder and sustained a concussion, fractured ribs, and fractured vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting pipe when his left middle finger was pinched between a fixed ladder and a swivel pipe component, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was manually adjusting the battery on a forklift in order to add water when the battery shifted unexpectedly due to the forklift's position on an uneven floor.  The employee's finger became caught between the top of the battery and the forklift structure.

On April 16, 2019, an employee was using a staple gun to secure paper to a bundle of completed product to a line roller system. The bundle moved and the employee's finger was pinched between the product and a roller, resulting in a partial amputation of the right middle finger.

On 4/16/2019, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was mowing grass along the road when he attempted to remove a piece of wood that was lodged underneath the mower. The mower's moving pulley and belt lacerated his left hand, damaging the tendons and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was struck by a cargo truck that was backing up at the outside dock. The employee was hospitalized with internal bleeding, a spleen injury, and broken vertebrae.
An employee was in her car during her break when an unknown assailant approached the car and stabbed the employee with an unknown weapon.
An employee who was taking apart shelving slipped and fell off a beam. The employee fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete ground, suffering a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was hospitalized for severe back spasms, heat stress, and dehydration after vacuuming up blast media on an aircraft carrier.
An employee was participating in training intervals on a treadmill and began displaying signs of fatigue. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hanging printing plates with a coworker when the coworker released his stop button, allowing the printing press to jog forward to hang the next plate. The injured employee's left hand was caught in a pinch point, suffering lacerations.
An employee was working from a step ladder with a reciprocating saw. The saw kicked back, causing the employee to drop the saw, which contacted his ankle lacerating it.
An employee's head contacted a nail gun, which fired a nail into his head, puncturing his skull.

Employees were checking to see if an automatic valve to a condensate line was operable. When air was applied, the valve opened and hot condensate went to the U-drain. An employee was standing on the U-drain and sustained second degree thermal burns on the calf and buttocks.
Broken test tools came free after being stuck inside tubing on a workover rig. They struck an employee, breaking the employee's foot.
An employee was splashed with chemicals while pressure washing a tank containment area, receiving chemical burns to his legs.

Employees were installing floor decking on the second floor deck when one of the employees fell approximately 14 feet through the roof, landing on the concrete ground. The employee suffered head trauma.
An employee was cleaning inside a machine when another employee started the machine. The employee suffered hand injuries, broken bones, and a deep laceration of the middle finger.
An employee using an air nozzle to blow out a grinder sustained a finger amputation when the grinder energized and the shredding wheel pulled the air nozzle and the employee's hand toward the wheel.
An employee was driving a forklift in reverse and hit a shelf which caused a pallet to break the employee's leg.
An employee tripped on her purse strap while getting out of a vehicle, impacted the ground, broke her leg, and was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting maintenance, with several other employees, changing out a wire roller. The doctor blade holder was lifted up on one end of the machine, came loose and fell down on the employee's thumb, fracturing it.
An employee was clearing a jam in a drop saw trimmer. The machine caught his clothing and amputated his left arm.
On 4/17/19, an employee was checking a gun for jam when it discharged into the employee's upper leg, damaging the muscle and artery.

An employee was on a scaffold performing overhead demolition of ductwork when a piece of duct swung loose and knocked the employee off the scaffold. The employee fell approximately 5 feet onto the concrete floor, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a parking lot, suffering full-body injuries. Both employees were performing work activities at the time.
An employee was changing transmission belts on a 40-hp cooling tower fan, when the fan turned on and amputated the left index finger.
An employee was operating a bar bending machine to bend rebar when their fingertip was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was shocked by a 480-volt piler power cord, suffering electrical burns to the left wrist and fingers with entry and exit wounds.

On April 17, 2019, at about 7:50 a.m., an employee was working on a roof measuring a section to be cut out and replaced when the employee fell through the roof inside the building. The employee was hospitalized with head and spinal injuries.
A valve assembly separated and a piece hit an employee's leg, breaking it.

A piece of iron became lodged in the jaw of a material processing plant. An employee climbed up the plant. Some material fell from the bottom of the jaw causing the counter-weight to rotate. This caused a belt to move and the employee's finger was pinned between a pulley and the belt. The employee's left ring finger was amputated to the first knuckle. The plant was locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was installing water lines on a truck frame when the employee fell off the frame to the ground, suffering a head injury.
An employee was cutting lumber on an upcut saw. The saw amputated his right middle, ring, and little fingers. It was guarded at the time.

An employee was visiting a client in an assisted living facility. On the employee's way out of the facility, the employee tripped while exiting an elevator and fell to the ground, fracturing the left leg above the knee.
While walking out of a cooler, an employee was struck by a forklift. The employee suffered a skin tissue injury.

An employee was using a handheld propane torch to heat the end of another tool. The employee turned the propane torch off and set it on a truck. The truck caught on fire. The employee and another employee tried to suffocate the fire, then used fire extinguishers to put the fire out. Both employees sustained burns to the right arm and face. One employee also sustained a burn to the back. They were both hospitalized.

An employee was in a truck lowering a uniform rack to the ground with the lift gate when the employee fell approximately 3 feet out the back of the truck to the ground, fracturing the right wrist, five ribs on the left side, and a kneecap. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a parking lot, suffering a head laceration and bruising.
An employee was unloading a garbage bin from a truck's lift gate when he stepped back, lost balance, and fell about 4 feet to the ground, fracturing his right ankle.
