An employee was helping load a CNC machine into a shipping container. The employee's finger was pinched between wood blocks, causing a fingertip amputation.
A forklift had placed a pallet in a wrapper and was backing out of the wrapping area when it ran over an employee's foot, breaking it.

An employee was helping to move a piece of casing off a guide wire from a rig. The casing was on a pipe rack. As the pipe was pushed to move it out of the guide wire, the pipe rolled and caught his right hand, pinching his middle finger and resulting in partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was on a three-step ladder down-stacking boxes from the top shelf of a freezer to a lower shelf. While descending the step ladder, the employee missed the last step and fell to the ground, fracturing the left leg.

As part of training, an employee climbed a ladder and attached a safety strap to the stand. While leaning back into the positioning belt, the employee fell feet first through the belt to the ground 12 feet below. The employee sustained a dislocated elbow and back pain.
An employee was re-roofing a commercial building when the employee fell to the ground, suffering a head injury. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting lumber with a portable circular saw when it kicked back. The saw blade struck the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was fixing uneven wood on a nailing machine conveyor when the conveyor started moving. His right middle finger was caught between two pallets. When he pulled his hand out, his right middle fingertip was lacerated, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was inspecting a metal bar that had come out of a straightener machine when a second metal bar was sent out of the machine, causing the employee's finger to become caught between a metal bar and the table. The employee's right ring finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was driving an SUV out of the carwash. He lost control of the vehicle and it struck a second employee and another vehicle. The second employee suffered multiple injuries to the back, legs, and rear.

An employee was ascending a ladder to stock items when her foot slipped from the second step (approximately 21" from the floor). She tried to grab onto the ladder to steady herself but missed and fell. Her left leg and knee struck the ladder, a shelf, or both. She suffered a fractured left knee/tibia.

An employee was going up in a bucket truck. Nearby, police were pursuing a vehicle that then struck the bucket truck.  The employee was ejected from the bucket that was about 10 feet high and struck the alleyway. He suffered scrapes and contusions to the face.
An employee was servicing a wrapper machine when it cycled or shifted unexpectedly, catching his right middle finger between the chain and sprocket. His right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a scissor lift using a manual 2-inch hand threader, threading a piece of pipe to put a valve on. He strained his back, suffering a herniated disk.
An employee was operating a universal swing arm press machine when her fingers entered the press. The press then came down on her fingers, amputating the right middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was removing a metal obstruction from a bailer guide when the ram moved and pinned the employee's right index finger between the scrap metal and the bailer resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was working in an oil lube area and pulled on a bungie cord attached to an oil drain pan stand. The cord dislodged a flat tip screwdriver that was in the nipple valve of the oil drain pan. The screwdriver flew and hit the employee in the eye, causing an injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning the masa process line with a high pressure water hose. As the employee removed masa dough from the machine, their left middle finger was caught in the rotating blades resulting in an amputation injury to the finger. The machine was energized at the time.

An employee was changing out a compressor at a store. While sweating the lines, the pressure built up in the line and the oil shot out along with flames, causing second degree burns on both arms from his fingertips to the elbows and a slight burn on his lower abdomen.
Employee 1 was hospitalized after becoming dizzy and having a headache during SWAT training. Employee 2 was hospitalized after completing SWAT training having possibly suffered a seizure.
An employee was cleaning away excess dough on a hopper when the machine was activated. The guillotine engaged and cut the employee's right thumb, resulting in a distal tip amputation.

An employee was entering the back of a truck when the truck pulled away from the dock and the employee fell to the concrete ground, suffering a contusion and lacerations of the cerebrum.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a roof, painting the exterior of a garage. He fell to the ground and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was pulling a strip of beef off the belt with force when his right second finger was caught between the meat and the trim saver, receiving lacerations. He was hospitalized.

An employee was bailing fish when the bail line received pressure. The employee lost control and fell backwards, striking his head on the grating. He suffered a laceration to the back of the head and a brain bleed.

An employee was bleeding down injection lines, using a 36-inch pipe wrench, to let hydrates thaw overnight. A valve was opened and pressure (about 900 psi) was released, causing a section of pipe to come loose and strike the employee's leg above the knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to clean the applicator rollers on a coil coating machine when the employee's right fingers were caught between the in-going rollers. The employee was hospitalized and sustained amputations to the right small, ring, and middle fingers.
An employee was using a sledgehammer to remove a bearing from a completed wheel set. A piece of metal broke off the sledgehammer and penetrated the employee's bicep.

While cleaning inside a wind turbine tower, an employee stepped through an open access hatch and fell to the deck below.  The employee sustained fractures to the face, arms and legs. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to unjam a machine when the trimmer plate lowered, smashing his finger between the trimmer plate and the machine frame. His fingertip was partially amputated. The machine was energized and guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was loading a steel griddle/grill into a customer's vehicle fell when it fell onto her foot, resulting in a fracture and partial medical amputation of the right pinky toe's distal phalanx.
An employee was operating a drill press. His glove was caught while he was cleaning sawdust off the machine. The employee sustained a severe laceration to his hand.

An employee was assembling corrugated boxes and was operating a pneumatic stapler when he attempted to move a box that was stuck. His fingertip was then caught in the stapler, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a seamer when it rolled over his right thumb, causing a partial amputation. The seamer was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping to remove a large, damaged 30-foot-high by 4-foot-wide insulated metal building panel from a structure using a mobile telehandler equipped with a vacuum attachment. The telehandler unit retracted the loosened panel from the structure and set it on the ground with its small dimension (4 feet) on the ground. At this point, the panel was standing 30 feet straight into the air when it detached quickly from the vacuum and fell on the injured employee, breaking his right femur.

On April 18, 2019, an employee was removing a dent in a tank using a hydraulic jack and pipe assembly with a saddle. The pipe at one end came loose and fell on the employee's left hand, causing a crushing injury. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was climbing a ladder to the second floor when he fell 6 feet to the ground, suffering a non-displacement right wrist fracture, hairline right patella fracture, and left arm fracture.
An employee tripped on a crack in the sidewalk, fell, and fractured his left femur. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee had taken a 10-foot x 1-inch piece of steel rod out of a straightening machine. The piece of steel was buckled in the middle. With his glove on, the employee grabbed the end of the piece of steel. At that time, the buckle released, causing the end of the steel to jump up and hit his hand. He was hospitalized for surgery on a broken middle finger on his left hand.

An employee was running a lathe to finish a repaired shaft. The employee was using sandpaper to finish the shaft when the employee's shirt was caught in a rotating piece, pulling the employee's arm and hand into the rotating piece. The employee suffered a left ear laceration as well as a broken left arm, wrist, and hand. The employee's left little finger had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was unloading baggage and suffered a heart attack.

An employee was moving a steel plate onto the plasma cutting table when the steel plate hit the plasma table gantry shutoff cable and pivoted down. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the steel plate and the grating of the plasma cutting table.

An employee was visually inspecting the feed of shavings to a furnace when his hand became caught in an auger at the top of the furnace. He sustained multiple fractures and lacerations to the right hand and wrist.
While exiting a building, an employee slipped on the edge of a sidewalk and impacted the ground, resulting in a fractured left ankle and hospitalization.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk, headed towards her car, when she tripped over some sod and fell to the sidewalk, fracturing her left femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee's right leg was pinched between a rolling welder and a structure. He suffered an avulsion and fracture to the leg.
An employee was tightening tie-down straps on a flatbed truck when he fell off the truck to the ground, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was watering plants from a platform that was 7 feet high when a golf cart hit the platform, causing the employee to fall off and onto the ground. The employee suffered a broken wrist and chin laceration.

An employee was operating a sit-down cleaning machine to clean the shop floors. He used the machine to push a heavy metal cart out of the way and pinched his right thumb between the cart and the machine. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was retrieving a test sample from an ingredient feeder when her right thumb made contact with the auger screw of the feeder. Her right thumb was caught between the screw and the auger housing, resulting in a digit amputation of the right thumb.

An employee was using a hand torch while a second employee was cleaning the floor 2 to 3 feet in front of the hand torch. While the second employee was standing in front of the wall-mounted hand torch array, an internal explosion dislodged the cover, which then struck her in the back of the head. She was hospitalized with a concussion and laceration to the back of the skull.
An employee was performing maintenance on a baler. Knives on the baler amputated the employee's right hand.

On April 19, 2019, an employee was weighing the filament density on a twisting machine. The machine was equipped with a semi-portable control panel with a toggle button. While the employee was operating the toggle control, his right hand was inside the machine. The carriage moved and pinched his right index finger, resulting in an amputation to the finger.
A temporary employee was parking a pallet jack and stepped off the jack when it rolled on top of his right foot, pinning it against a guardrail. He suffered pain in his right foot.

An employee was moving a 30-to 40-gallon container of cement/mortar that was on wheels. The container tipped over onto the employee resulting in a back fracture.

An employee was running on the field to retrieve a baseball bat and ball when he fell to the ground and broke his left femur.
An employee was performing a screen change on an extruder and was burned on the right forearm by molten polyvinyl butyral (PVB) after sliding the door open.

A maintenance millwright had used an aerosol degreaser to clean the shaft and key on a power press prior to MIG welding. Vapors and/or overspray were in the cavity surrounding the area and did not dissipate prior to striking an arc. A fire resulted that caused burns to the employee's body.
Two employees were troubleshooting the sensor on a skid steer unit. The unit started and an engine component partially amputated an employee's right index finger.
An employee was walking down a corridor when a stack of drywall fell over and landed on the employee's left ankle fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was laying out wire mesh for a precast concrete form when he slipped on a piece of corrugated duct that was being placed in the product. He fell to the ground, dislocating his right hip and breaking his right femur. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An extruder auger crushed an employee's finger.
The injured employee walked behind a forklift that was being operated by a second employee. The injured employee's foot was caught and crushed by the forklift.

An employee was using a crane to separate two 700 lb. steel plates when his hand was caught between the two plates which resulted in the amputation of the tips of the third and fourth digits on the left hand.

An employee was operating a forklift in the yard. After unloading a pallet of shingles, he headed towards his supervisor, set the forklift's brake on parking, and exited the forklift. The forklift rolled forward and pinned him between his forklift and his supervisor's parked forklift. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was lifting a patient and suffered a neck strain. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a 1000 lbs. tire rack. His right middle finger was caught between tire racks and amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was directing a garbage truck as it backed up. He tripped and fell on the road, suffering a head injury and abrasions.
An employee fell off a 16-foot ladder to the concrete below, suffering a broken right ankle.
While an employee was making a template on a table saw from 3/4" plywood, the blade kicked the plywood up and the employee's finger contacted the blade. The employee's middle finger was amputated.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut a block of ice. The block jerked and drew the employee's hand into the saw, which amputated the employee's left little fingertip.
An employee was unloading his truck using a lift gate. He fell off the gate, injuring his hip.

A temporary employee was using a de-riveter machine to remove rivets from a brake shoe. The employee placed a sheet of material down on the table of the de-riveter and then placed the brake shoe on top of it. The employee held the brake shoe in place on the table and engaged the de-riveter. During the machine's cycle, the brake shoe shifted on the surface and crushed the employee's right ring fingertip between the shoe and the de-riveter table, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

The injured employee was installing metal cap facia using a 20-foot extension ladder at a residence. The ladder was set up on top of gravel and shifted laterally. The employee fell approximately 13 feet to the ground breaking the left humerus.
An employee slipped and fell while pulling a hose, striking his head on the ground and suffering head and neck injuries.
An employee was working on a crane and suffered a broken leg.

A journeyman iron worker was working on top of a piece of iron to cut it loose from the rigging. The piece rolled causing the journeyman to fall off the piece and strike his ribs on the connecting point.  The employee suffered two fractured ribs.
A client choked an employee and repeatedly punched him in the head and face, causing swelling and bruising. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a roof behind a parapet wall, guiding a rough-terrain forklift as it raised a trash bin to the roof. The bin crushed the employee's right middle finger against the wall. She was hospitalized and the fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was repairing a grease gun. The piston dropped from the gun and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was welding the outside of a tank. Developer fumes within the tank ignited and the employee suffered burns to the right hand, arm, and shoulder.
An employee was manually lowering a lift. The elevator weight on the tensioning chain jammed between the frame and elevator; the employee's lower leg was broken as she tried to clear the jam.
An employee was lifting an animal carcass while tightening a chain and pushing buttons on the controls at the same time. His finger was amputated in the chain.
An employee was cleaning a tank when a trouble light broke, causing the cleaning chemicals to burst into flames. The employee suffered burns to the hands and forearms.
While cleaning and watering plants in a nursing area, an employee slipped on a piece of a plant on the floor and suffered a left knee injury.

An employee was loading pigs weighing approximately 270 lbs. into a truck. The pigs were coming down the ramp in between the barn and the truck, when a hog got out, and struck the employee from behind causing a broken tibia.
An employee was working with hot cooking oil. The oil spilled onto his right foot, burning it.
While thermally treating stone, an employee suffered third-degree burns to the face and ear. The employee was found face-up on the floor.
An employee was taking apart an extended conveyor after using it to unload a package. The equipment sliced his right thumb and he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was disconnecting two barges that were pinned together for the duration of a project. After cutting through the pinned connection with a torch, the barge shifted unexpectedly on land and struck the employee's chest resulting in broken ribs.
An employee had been working at his desk. While getting up from his chair, he tripped on a torn piece of carpet and fell backwards. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised back.
An employee was closing a gate, when she was struck by her personal vehicle, which pinned her against the gate. She sustained injuries to the torso and a broken arm.
On April 28, 2019, an employee was walking down a hallway she slipped and fell. Her left kneecap was fractured and she was hospitalized.
While working in a cold warehouse, an employee suffered frostbite on the right index finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was dropping equipment off an 8-foot roof when he lost his balance and jumped to the concrete ground approximately 11 feet below. The employee suffered fractured heels and ankle.

On April 29, 2019, at approximately 1:45 p.m. an employee was attempting to lift a metal locker that had tipped over. The locker door closed on the employee's right middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was delivering a package and suffered a dislocated ankle while stepping off a porch. The injury required surgery.

A welder was removing a steel production part from a welding fixture using an overhead crane. He connected the lifting hook to the steel part's center post, then applied tension to the overhead crane. His little finger was pinched between the lifting hook and the steel part, causing the amputation of the tip.

On 4/29/2019, an employee was conducting landscaping operations at a street corner. He pushed a tree branch out of his way, and it snapped back and struck his face. A splinter pierced the left upper cheek just below the eye. Safety glasses were worn at the time.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wooden frame parts and suffered amputation injuries to his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was cutting plate steel with a flame cutter. Sparks caught his trouser leg on fire, causing second- and third-degree burns to his leg.
On 4/30/2019, a carrier tripped over a raised piece of sidewalk and broke their right arm. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was stacking beams in a yard. A 10-by-4-by-6 block was in the middle of the pile. He lifted the end of the bundle of beams and got off his lift to pull the block out. The block twisted and its weight caught the tip of his finger on the flange, amputating the fingertip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was placing parts on a conveyor system. The employee's left middle finger was caught in the system's chain and sprocket, resulting in the amputation of the fingertip. The system was guarded at the time.
An employee was repositioning a unit on a skid with a crane when his finger was caught between two units (transformers) causing a partial amputation to his right pinky finger.

On April 29, 2019, at 4:30 p.m., an employee was assisting with the final pass of torqueing the hydraulic torque wrench when the tip of the employee's glove got stuck between the nut and the tool. The tool engaged and the employee's ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking into work from his personal vehicle when he tripped and fell hitting his head on the concrete sidewalk. He was hospitalized with a head laceration.

At about 5:30 a.m. on April 29, 2019, an employee reached into a machine, through a light curtain, to adjust a proximity switch. The carriage of the machine lifted up and pinned the employee against the roof of the machine. The employee suffered rib fractures and was hospitalized.
A forklift was carrying two stacked pallets. The top pallet fell and struck an employee, who suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off the loading dock.
An employee was unloading a freight trailer when a sheet of metal shifted, pinning the employee's leg against a pallet and breaking it.

An employee was working in the hydro area cleaning flanges. The employee reached over to try and level the berry hone device (a rotating shaft inside of a pipe that removes burrs) that was in another pipe and the employee's left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was climbing a rail car ladder when he fell about 10 feet, hitting the ground and an adjacent rail car. He suffered a broken jaw and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was walking into the guard shack, lost her footing and fell, hitting her head on a metal table. She lost consciousness and sustained a head injury.
A nurse tank was being filled with anhydrous ammonia when a valve was opened. Ammonia was released, causing chemical burns to an employee's midsection.
An employee bent over to hook up the truck to a fire hydrant to load water. While bending over, he herniated a disc in his back.
An employee was on the ground handling a cable attached to a crane. The crane touched a power line and the employee was shocked.
An employee's hand was caught between a hoist lifting crane device and a frame that was being hoisted causing a partial amputation.

On April 29, 2019, at approximately 9:50 a.m., an employee was operating a punch press when their right index finger was pinched between the dye plate and the post being stamped causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on a tool box in a truck bed and fell to the concrete floor 5-6 feet below. He suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to hook a piece of aircraft equipment to a trailer when his right index finger got caught between the pintle hook and tow bar resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was switching rail cars. After he stepped off a railcar onto the rail, the railcar that was just uncoupled rolled over his right foot. Three toes were crushed and the tips of two toes were surgically amputated.

An employee was spraying walls and ceilings with paint. While trying to fix the tip of the paint sprayer, the air valve trigger was pressed and the employee suffered a small cut on the left side of the thumb. Paint got inside the wound and the employee was hospitalized for an infection requiring surgery.

An employee was unhooking a trailer when the trailer started to roll. The employee placed a hammer in front of the wheels to stop it and the employee right index finger was pinched between the trailer and the hammer. The fingertip was amputated.

Employee 1 was operating a forklift in reverse and collided with another forklift, operated by Employee 2, that was stopped in an aisle. The forks of the moving forklift were raised and penetrated Employee 2's right leg upon impact. Employee 2 was hospitalized with lacerations and a fractured tibia.

An employee was attempting to operate a newly installed dock leveler. It was not operating properly. He thought it was a pin on the leveler that was causing the hold up. The maintenance pin for the leveler is located underneath it and can only be accessed from the underside of the leveler.  He went underneath the leveler to release the pin. When the pin was released, the leveler fell on top of him breaking his leg and ribs and fracturing his back.

The injured employee was on a ladder and was holding two wires out of the way for the lead technician. When the wires were energized, the injured employee was shocked. The employee sustained an electric shock to the right hand and a dislocated shoulder when he slid off the ladder.
An employee tripped and fell while walking on a tile floor. The employee sustained a left hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was removing a pressure relief valve from a mud pump with a 36-inch pipe wrench.  The pipe wrench slipped and caught the employee's finger between the wrench and the mud pump resulting in amputation of the left middle finger and a fracture to the ring finger.

An employee was working in a new underground table conductor that was not energized and was using a machine to conduct a test to determine if the table was ready to be energized. While using the machine, he was shocked (2400 DC volts). The employee was hospitalized with blisters on his right leg and red marks in his chest.

The injured employee was working on the catwalk pedestal of an oil and gas drilling rig. While lifting a single joint of drill pipe, it fell out of the elevator and came down on the injured employee's left hand which was on the handrail. The employee sustained lacerations, fractures and nerve damage to the left hand.
An employee was exposed to high levels of carbon monoxide while working on a press line.

An employee was removing roofing material from a retail store front canopy. The employee was walking on plywood that had been placed over the support braces. The employee stepped into an area that did not have plywood and fell to the ground. His fall was partially arrested by his safety harness. The employee suffered fractures to the face, nose and right arm.

An employee was using a table saw to cut wooden shingles. The shingles kicked back and the employee's hand contacted the blade resulting in a laceration to the left index finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was disconnecting the rigging on a 6x6 precast panel and his right middle finger was caught between the cable and the anchor resulting in a partial amputation.
While troubleshooting a clogged pump an employee's fingertip was amputated by the gears in the pump motor.

Two employees were removing tin from a roof. One employee fell through a piece of unsupported tin to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left elbow that required surgery and a head laceration.
Three employees were hospitalized for burns after a propane gas explosion occurred.
An employee was sorting boxes in a recycling bin while standing on a concrete wall that was 18 inches high. As he stepped down, he twisted his knee and fractured his left tibia.
An employee was stepping off of a scale (approximately 6.5 inches) and his knee buckled. The employee was hospitalized for swelling.
An employee was descending an 8-foot stepladder after doing a paint touch-up above a garage door when he missed the last step and fell to the floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was working from a step-ladder approximately 14 feet above grade to paint a ceiling. The employee missed a rung and fell to the ground resulting in fractures to the face and wrist.

On April 30, 2019, an employee stepped up onto a electrical box to gain access to plastic pellets inside a hopper. Due to oil, the employee slipped and fell off the electrical box approximately 46 inches tall. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture and laceration to their left pinkie finger.

An employee was walking from the side of the building toward the parking lot. As she entered the parking lot area, she tripped over a parking space marker (marker /speed bump in the front of the parking space to prevent vehicles from rolling forward) and fell to the ground, breaking her left kneecap.

An employee was attaching sandbag straps to a lifting chain hook in preparation for lifting a bag when the employee's right thumb was pinched between the strap and chain hook. The tip of the thumb was amputated.
An employee was ascending a ladder and fell on his right side striking a metal grate. The employee suffered a torn tendon on his right arm.

Just before 5:00PM, several employees were heading to the front office to clock out. Employee #1 used a company yard truck to drive to the front office. The tailgate of the company yard truck was down at the time. Employee #2 was walking and jumped onto the tailgate and then fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was putting pieces of steel on one side of pallets. He then turned around the pallets to put on other pieces of steel when the steel pieces slipped and hit his left foot, breaking two toes.
An employee was operating a wood table cutting machine when the clamp smashed his left ring finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was using a saw. As the employee tried to remove the trim piece with his left hand, the clamp closed and pinched his left index finger between the clamp and the material causing an amputation of the distal phalanx.
An employee was sweeping and picking up construction trash when the employee started having cramps and nausea due to possible dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee was stepping out of a vehicle while making a delivery when he stepped into a pothole and broke his ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating an ATV when the employee lost control and the ATV flipped over. The employee sustained a fractured left foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing cable. A saddle fell and hit him knocking him backwards. He landed on a rock on his back and suffered a spine injury.

An employee was driving a mini-roller onto a lowboy trailer when the mini-roller slipped off the trailer and rolled on its side. He struck his head and had his leg semi-pinned by the steering column. He was hospitalized with a head knot and possible concussion.
A cowboy was bucked off a horse and broke their left tibia and fibula. The cowboy was hospitalized.
An employee was walking into the seat shop, slipped on water that had collected on the floor due to the rain and fell breaking their right hip.

The injured employee was walking out of the building next to a soft-side tandem-axle delivery truck when the soft-side and tie-down straps were released and the load fell onto the employee causing a broken hip and femur.
An employee was operating a press brake and amputated the right thumb tip.
An employee was adding dunnage while assisting in picking materials for processing. The material fell and struck his right thumb. The employee was hospitalized the next night.
A medical assistant suffered a respiratory reaction to a cleaning chemical and was hospitalized.

A crew was in the process of tripping pipe back into the well bore. The elevator failed to latch properly allowing the pipe to fall approximately 4 feet back down to the matting board. The stand of pipe bounced off the matting board and struck an employee who was working on the ground on the right foot resulting in amputation of the fifth metatarsal.
An employee contracted a bacterial illness while providing nursing care in the hospital.
An employee felt faint during a mandatory physical training run. He sat down on the running trail and started going in and out of consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to remove a spur gear from a die casting machine. The spur gear slipped and caught his left finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was in the trench putting a gasket on the previous pipe joint when an excavator  started lifting the cut joint. The pipe swung like a pendulum as it was lifted and smashed the employee's left-hand fingers between the swinging pipe and the existing pipe. Two fingers were surgically amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was performing maintenance on a dock plate. The docking plate chain that holds the plate in place failed. The employee received a crushing injury that resulted in amputation of the right ring finger.

An employee was attempting to lift a manual pallet jack up 18" with another employee. When setting the pallet jack down on the concrete walkway, the employee's left ring finger was crushed by the bottom of the pallet jack causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was transferring hydrogen chloride (HCl) from one container to another when the HCl sprayed into the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized for inhalation burns.
An employee was adjusting a machine with a crowbar. The crowbar slipped and the employee's finger was crushed and amputated between the machine and the tool.
An employee was removing a rear trailer door. The door fell on him causing him to fall forward and hit his face on the ground. The employee suffered facial fractures.
An aerial zipline guide lost his grip on a rappelling rope and fell approximately 15 feet to the wooden landing platform breaking both ankles.

An employee was using a backhoe to move dirt from the material holding area to a low spot where dirt is discarded for backfill. While the employee was moving the dirt, the soil collapsed under the weight of the loader, causing it to slide down an embankment before overturning. Upon overturning, the employee fell from the seat and landed on his left side, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was mopping hot tar on a roof when his foot stuck to the roof. As he tried to move he fell and his arms landed in the mop bucket which contained hot tar. The employee sustained burns to the left arm and right hand requiring hospitalization.

A maintenance employee was accessing the roof using a temporary ladder. When the employee grabbed the safety rail, it gave way and the employee fell approximately 14 feet. The employee struck lockers and then the floor resulting in four fractured ribs.

An employee was removing a tarp/cover from a container to unload cargo from the container. While standing on top of the cargo the employee reached for a tool while bracing himself against the cover ribs. The employee fell from the cargo to the bottom of the container and then fell from the container to the floor below. The employee sustained a fractured C2 vertebrae.

A temporary employee was operating a metal crusher machine, which binds two metal pieces, when her right index and middle fingers were caught in the machine. She sustained multiple fractures to her fingers and was hospitalized.

Employees were lifting the top plate from a stack of finished steel plates using an overhead crane. The plate hooks were inserted and positioned for hoisting. The crane s trolley travel button was pressed. The steel plate began to slide off the stack and contacted an employee below the left knee, pinching the lower left leg between the plate and an adjacent stack of plates. The employee sustained a laceration to the left lower leg.

An employee had been topping a dead tree while tied into an adjacent buckeye tree. When the employee had finished topping and was descending the tree, the top of the buckeye tree broke and the employee fell about 33 feet to the ground sustaining multiple fractured ribs.
An employee was backing up a golf cart to a dumpster. Her left leg was caught between the golf cart and a steel wall resulting in a laceration and fracture to the left ankle.

An employee had been painting the steps on a log truck loader from the loader's ladder. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, landing on his face and shoulder. He sustained a facial fracture requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on the wood waste belt when their arm was caught in the power transmission drive. The arm was amputated at the bicep area.
An employee was shot in the chest during a robbery at the store.

On May 3, 2019, an employee was placing pipe in a trench and was working in the vicinity of an excavator. A hydraulic line on the excavator ruptured causing the bucket to swing down and strike the employee. The employee sustained a fractured right arm and kidney damage.

An employee was unloading and picking up merchandise from a truck when several boxes of canned dog food fell from the rack. The employee was struck in the head and was hospitalized with internal bleeding.
On May 1, 2019, an employee sustained a chemical burn to their right eye while pouring bleach from a gallon jug into a bucket of water.
An employee was unloading a truck when the employee slipped between the dock and the truck. The employee fractured a hip.
Employee was on a section of 7-foot scaffold doing propeller repair. The scaffold shifted causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture the left arm.
An employee was hospitalized after a case of shoes fell on his right foot and his third toe became infected.

An employee operating a pallet jack was making a turn near a racking system. When the pallet jack got too close to the racking system, the employee jumped from the pallet jack. He was pinched between the pallet jack and the storage rack and sustained a broken ankle.
When an employee was relighting the dryer burner, the system malfunctioned and flashed. The employee's arm was burned.

On May 1, 2019, an employee was cleaning out the cyclone of the cryo line downstream of the mill take-away. The employee contacted the rotary air lock and amputated his right middle, ring, and pinky fingers.
An employee was removing a bearing from a bearing loader. The bearing loader cylinder cycled when the extra bearing was removed resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking when their toe caught on the floor causing the employee to fall and fracture their wrist and hip.
An employee fell in the break room and suffered a head laceration.

An employee had been burning off old cloth that was on tongs so it could be replaced. To cool off the tongs, the employee accessed the water coolant stream on the upsetter forging machine. The employee slipped and stepped on the pedal that engaged the machine and half of his left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was test driving the company utility vehicle. The vehicle turned onto its side and the employee sustained a fractured left leg.
An employee was opening a treatment pot of the hot water loop system to adjust treatment levels in the system when hot water was released and caused second degree burns to his face and hands.
An employee was lifting a cover for a hole using a crane. A cheater bar that was inside the cover fell and struck the employee's face causing a laceration requiring hospitalization.
An employee was checking the cat pump for pressure loss. When he removed his hand it was sucked down and his middle finger was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee slipped while walking and fell backwards striking her head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a severe concussion.
An employee fell about 40 feet off an order picker to the ground.
On May 1, 2019, an employee was walking toward the packaging conveyor to remove boxes when she tripped and landed on her right knee resulting in a hairline fracture of her right patella.
An electric pallet jack operator was pulling a load of boxes when he was struck by a stand-up forklift and sustained a crushing injury to the right tibia.
An employee tripped on forklift forks while walking and fractured both wrists while breaking the fall.

An employee was programming a press brake and leaned against a pallet that was being used for parts placement. The pallet tilted and spilled twelve metal parts, each weighing 11.5 pounds. Some of the falling parts fractured the employee's left foot.

A maintenance employee was transporting a pizza oven to a truck using a cart. The oven slipped from the cart during transport and hit the employee's leg. The employee suffered lacerations and cut tendons in the calf area. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell from a 6-foot scaffold and hit his forehead on a concrete block. He sustained a head injury.

An employee was helping dismantle and transfer dispensing equipment to a van in the parking lot. The employee stumbled and fell from the loading dock to the parking lot surface hitting his head and left shoulder.
An employee was deburring a small metal part and got a metal sliver in their left hand which developed an infection.
An employee was trimming a tree when the rope slipped off the tree and the employee fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a broken back.

An employee was picking product from a rack 64" off the ground. The employee stepped back from the pallet on the rack and slipped off striking his leg on the order picker or the pallet and lacerating his right leg just below the knee. Fall protection was worn at the time.

An employee was unloading carpet from a truck's trailer using a forklift. When the truck rolled forward away from the dock, the forklift fell off the dock and the employee was thrown from the forklift to the ground, injuring her left-upper back and two right-hand fingers.
On May 1, 2019, an employee's thumb was amputated by machinery.

An employee had been using a chipping gun to dislodge hardened concrete inside a plant mixer drum. The employee was being relieved by another employee and stood up to exit the drum. He then slipped on concrete debris, lost balance and fell forward striking his right side on a mixing fin in the drum. The employee fractured two ribs.
An employee was greasing and manually turning a bearing when his left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a chainsaw and severely lacerated his left forearm.

An employee was reroofing a flat roof of a single story dwelling. The employee went to get a chalk line from the ground. He then climbed back up the ladder and knelt down on the edge of the roof to snap the chalk line. The roof gave way and he fell 8 feet 4 inches onto a pile of landscaping posts and sustained fractured ribs. The employee was wearing fall protection, but it was not connected at the time of the fall.

While an employee was operating a forklift at the loading dock, the tractor-trailer moved away from the dock plate. The forklift fell off the tractor-trailer or the dock and impacted the ground. The operator was hospitalized for a concussion and fractured vertebrae.

A temporary employee was stacking wooden trusses about 3 feet high. When he was finished, a forklift lifted up the trusses to be moved elsewhere. The trusses on the forks shifted and the employee s gloved, right ring fingertip got caught between the bottom truss and the forks. He sustained the amputation of his right ring fingertip without bone loss.

An employee was going to heat up a burrito in the dog house (work trailer). When the employee went to turn on the stove/cook top, a flash fire occurred due to gas accumulation. The employee sustained burns to the face and neck, and had second degree burns on both hands.
An employee operating a forklift stepped off the forklift before it was completely stopped. Their left foot was caught between the forklift and a cement curb resulting in several broken toes.
An employee's right ring finger was caught between a door and the door frame when the door closed resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was entering the utility closet when their finger was caught between the door and the door frame resulting in a partial amputation of the right fifth finger.

An employee was adjusting and lubricating a chain and sprocket on a conveyor belt roller. His hand became caught between the chain and sprocket, causing a laceration to his right palm and an amputation of the right middle fingertip without bone loss.
A maintenance technician was fixing a machine's roller belt, which was off center, when his hand got caught on the belt, causing the amputation of his right thumb.
An employee was loading a ball warp onto a cart. The cart tilted and the ball warp fell on him causing a fractured left pelvic bone.
An employee fell approximately 6 feet from an elevated area of a roof and sustained a head injury and a fractured leg and wrist.

On May 2, 2019, at 9:00 a.m., an employee was working from an 8-foot step ladder while washing interior windows. The employee fell from the step ladder to the floor and sustained a fractured right elbow.
An employee was standing behind a press operator and adjusting a part in the press when the hydraulic press activated. The employee sustained the amputation of his right middle fingertip.

An employee was unloading a van using a non-energized unloading device. While lifting, the employee's finger got caught in a pinch point on the unloading device resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee's left pinky fingertip was partially amputated when it was caught in a closing door.

An employee was installing metal edging on roof fascia while working from an extension ladder when he lost balance and fell approximately 18 feet onto a pile of rocks. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis and hip, and also sustained injuries to his knee, elbow, and heel.

Two employees were preparing to pour concrete in the tie beams. Both employees were holding the concrete pump hose when the hose kinked and swung knocking both employees off the tie beam onto the plywood floor. One employee was hospitalized for a concussion. The second employee was hospitalized for a fractured tailbone.
An employee was walking toward an excavator to get the operator's attention when he fell in dirt. The excavator then rolled over his left leg and broke his tibia.
An employee was grinding a cast iron part when his hand slipped and contacted the grinding wheel. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.

While operating a trash compactor on a client's property the injured worker noticed hydraulic fluid on the ground. He had punched the start button on the compactor and it began its cycle. While the compactor was cycling, he looked for the source of the hydraulic leak and in doing so reached forward to touch the hose. The hose became pressurized when the hydraulic ram reversed. There was a hole in the line and hydraulic fluid injected into his right thumb. He was hospitalized for chemical exposure and debridement of the thumb.
As an employee was moving a pallet jack, she was caught between the pallet jack and the dock plate. She sustained lacerations and punctures to her right ankle.
An employee was standing at the rear of a refuse truck, picking up a refuse container and was struck by a passing motor vehicle resulting in severe leg injuries.
An employee was operating a printing press when their hand was pulled into the rollers resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On May 2, 2019, at approximately 11:45 AM, an employee was utilizing a hanger tool to remove fibers from the bottom of the C beam diffuser from the side of the beam. The employee was using the tool with his right hand and reached over the railing and grabbed the fibers with his gloved left hand. The fibers pulled the employee's left hand and forearm into the heated press roll (248 degrees F). The employee was hospitalized with severe burns to the left hand and forearm.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground breaking both heels and dislocating an ankle.
An employee was exiting his truck to make a delivery. While he was walking down the truck's ramp he lost balance, fell off the ramp and broke his left hip.
An employee was working near the reverberatory furnace when it exploded. The employee sustained burns to his head, neck, hands, and legs.
An employee was waiting to get delivery papers signed by the docking area when a 30-inch sheave wheel, weighing approximately 40-50 lbs., came down on his big right toe.

On May 3, 2019, a forklift was moving pallets when the forks struck and broke a pipe. The injured employee went to examine the broken pipe when a blast of air struck the employee causing a surface burn to their right arm and hand.

An employee was trimming an oak tree on a golf course. A branch fell and swept the ladder from underneath him. The employee fell to the ground and sustained nine broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung.
On May 3, 2019, at approximately 1:05 p.m., after completing a mail delivery at the front entrance, an employee was stepping down to the cement walkway and fell to the ground breaking her left femur.
An employee was changing out a meter for a 277-480 volt line that was servicing a fire pump. There was an arc flash and the employee sustained burns to both hands, both arms, and the face.

An employee was repairing the speed sensor alignment on a plastic grinder's out-feed blower. A pipe wrench on the blower shaft spun around and caught his hand between the wrench and the blower housing resulting in lacerations to his hand and a crushing injury to his middle finger.

The injured employee was holding an overhead garage door while a second employee was making repairs. While working on the door, the cable support broke. The door came down and the injured employee's finger was caught in the door track and amputated.
An employee was attaching a dumpster to the sanitation truck and got their right ring finger caught between the truck and the dumpster. The employee suffered an avulsion injury to the fingertip.

An employee fell from the edge of the third floor of the building to the ground while unloading HVAC fan coils from a forklift basket resulting in a dislocated shoulder, two broken ribs and a bruised lung. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee tripped while walking backwards in the service drive area and fell to the concrete floor. The employee's right femur was fractured and required surgery.
An employee missed a step while getting down from a truck bed and fell 8-10 feet. The employee sustained fractures to the ribs, jaw, and both wrists.

An employee was testing jig operations at the beginning of his shift. After a cycle did not complete properly, he reached to adjust the jig. The jig cycled another 1/2 inch causing the partial amputation of his left middle finger.
A grain elevator operator was shoveling wheat toward the auger when he caught his boot/pant leg on the auger and was pulled in, resulting in amputation of his left leg.

An employee had been manually loading a wooden shoe holding device with a die-cut urethane foam piece. As the employee moved the shoe into the cutting machine along a fixed pathway, one of the saw blades came in contact with the shoe, causing the 4" blade to break into many small pieces. One or more of these pieces struck the employee s fingers. The right-hand pinky and ring fingers sustained cuts that required stitches. The ring finger also required surgery for a cut ligament and blood vessel.
An employee was wrapping film around a new roll in a printing press during a roll change over. The employee's hand became caught in the press resulting in a fracture to the left forearm.

An employee was teaching a non-violent crisis intervention refresher course. While being held by a student and demonstrating how to manage the movement of an aggressive person, the employee tore his right hamstring.

An employee was skiing down a designated route to reach a locker at the end of a shift. The employee skied over a patch of snow that was sticky and fell forward sustaining a fractured tibia requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when she became caught between the pallet jack and a pallet that was in front of her. The employee sustained contusions to both legs.

An employee was standing on the ground retrieving product from a pallet. A pallet truck struck the pallet on the ground and the employee's left leg was caught between the pallet and a rack resulting in a fractured fibula.

On May 3, 2019, at 5:15 p.m., an employee had finished working for the day and began walking up a slippery grassy incline to his truck. He slipped and fell fracturing the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hitting a concrete hose with a hammer to unjam a plug in the line. The plug released and the pressure in the hose caused the hose to whip around and strike the employee in the leg breaking his tibia and fibula.

An employee was staging pallets with a double selection pallet jack. The employee was reversing the pallet jack and making a turn when his right thumb was crushed between the pallet jack and a stationary rack.

The injured employee was standing next to the drilling piping, holding material over the pipe joint to channel residual mud downward, ready to swing the disconnected piping out of the way. Oil-based drilling mud came out under pressure and three employees got mud in their eyes when their hard hats and safety glasses were blown off. One employee was hospitalized for an eye injury. The eye was burning, swollen and the employee was unable to see.

An employee standing on the back of a flatbed chassis was securing 3-inch cables to the block of a ship's crane. The crane began the lift and the cable rolled and landed on the employee causing a fractured left ankle and a strained right rotator cuff.
An employee was trying to stop an aggressive patient that was springing toward a nurse and was pushed into a door frame, suffering head, neck, and elbow injuries.

An employee was using a table saw to rip wood when the employee's right hand made contact with the spinning circular blade, causing a severe laceration between the right thumb and forefinger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped while working on an extension ladder and fell six feet to the ground. The employee suffered a left knee injury and was hospitalized.

An employee had been performing preventative maintenance on a shrink wrap machine. While replacing the chain guard, the employee's glove became caught in the chain drive and he sustained a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a shrink wrap machine. After oiling the chain, the employee was replacing the guard and his glove became caught in the chain, amputating his right middle fingertip.

On May 3, 2019, at approximately 8:00 AM, an employee was buffing a 4-foot long metal shaft on a lathe using an abrasive pad. The spinning shaft caught the employee's glove causing a partial amputation of the right thumb.
An employee operating a pallet jack turned a corner and his foot was caught between a rack and the pallet jack. The employee sustained a fracture to the top of the left foot and fractured toes.

An employee was performing maintenance on a ski lift motor. The employee was removing a coupling from the gear box when his finger was pinched between the belt and pulley. His left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was repairing a window from the roof. While climbing back into the window from the roof, he slipped and fell approximately 11 feet rom the roof to the ground. He sustained fractures to the hip, femur, ribs, and back.
An employee was engaged in pest control duties at a private residence. The employee lost balance while descending brick steps, fell, and sustained a dislocated left knee requiring hospitalization.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold. He was placing a section on the ground and when he turned around an aluminum plank fell 10 feet onto his left forearm causing a laceration that required surgery to repair a tendon.

An employee walking back to the area after lunch break was struck on the head, neck and back area by a stack of pallets that fell. The employee sustained fractured ribs and possible fractured vertebrae.

An employee was manually unfolding the chute (wing) on a fast loader machine (sorting conveyor), so boxes could be removed from a semi-trailer and sorted into individual department carts. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between a hinge and partially amputated.
An employee was operating the rotor die casting machine and amputated the medial phalange of his right pinky finger in the V block drawer.

An employee was operating a fork truck. The load was suspended above a plastic bin. When the employee reached to untie the load his shirt pocket caught on an operating lever and the load lowered with his arm inside the mast. The employee sustained a fractured right ulna and radius.
On May 3, 2019, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift resulting in a fractured wrist and a broken ankle.
An employee was cutting an 18" pipe with a demo saw when the pipe kicked back. The employee was hospitalized with a cut on the chest that required stitches.

An employee was helping another employee dispose of an old forklift truck into a dumpster truck. After placing the forklift in the dumpster the forks of the forklift slipped and struck the injured employee's ankle.
An employee was trimming a tree when the branch he was cutting came close enough to a power line that electricity arced over to him, causing burns to his right hand and toes.

A maintenance employee was working alone on May 4, 2019. The employee may have been performing a sanding operation in an office and fallen from a 6-foot step ladder. He was found with head trauma and was hospitalized.
An employee was painting a window frame when a window frame that was above the employee fell and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury and a blood blister.
An employee lifted the cover off a five-gallon pail of liquid chlorine and was overcome by the chlorine gas that was released and was hospitalized for chemical pneumonitis.
On May 4, 2019, at about 2:30 p.m., an employee had finished a service call and started having symptoms of heat stress including leg cramps. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on the lift gate of a box truck unloading when a cart containing food started rolling towards him. The employee jumped from the truck to the parking lot and fractured the right knee and left calcaneus.

An employee was repairing an agitator on the production line when their hand was caught in the machine's chain. The employee's pinky finger was severed and three other fingers suffered severe damage. The machine was energized at the time.

An employee tripped and fell while carrying a container of sulfuric acid. The acid splashed under the employee's face shield. The employee was hospitalized with first degree burns to the face and the right side of the neck.
An employee was walking into the cooler, slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a bulging disc in her neck.
On May 4, 2019, a valet parking attendant fell from a continuous belt manlift that he was riding.
An employee was siphoning curing compound and inadvertently swallowed some, causing him to vomit. The employee was hospitalized with mouth and stomach pain.
An employee was operating a rewinder machine. Her left middle finger was caught by a nip roller and pulled into the machine resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was connecting elevators to pipe. He slipped on the wet muddy floor and while trying to catch himself, his right ring finger was caught between elevators and a tool joint at the moment when the driller was going to pick up the elevators. His finger was smashed and partially amputated.
An employee was performing maintenance on a pellet mill when his gloves were caught between the rollers and the die resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.

A technician was working in a customer's attic replacing a cable line. As the employee pulled on the cable, he lost footing on the rafter and fell through the sheet rock ceiling to the carpeted floor 9 to 10 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.

An employee was learning to use a lathe when his finger was caught between the rotating chuck jaws and the tool rest adjustment lever. The employees right index fingertip was pinched and required medical amputation.
On 05/05/2019, at 3:46 a.m., an employee was cleaning inside a cabinet when his headset came in contact with one of the cables and he sustained an electric shock. He was hospitalized.

An employee was dehydrated so he went to the cafeteria to retrieve some water and then returned to his work station which is an exhausted, electric, heat-treating oven. Later, another employee walked around the work station and saw the injured employee lying unconscious on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured C7 vertebra.

An employee had been scraping ice from the walk-in freezer door. The employee slipped and fell on ice or a wet floor while coming out of the freezer and broke her right ankle. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

Two employees were sitting on cradles (U-shaped steel beams) staged between the outer wall columns in Pot Room A to take a break. While the employees were seated, the outermost cradle began to shift. The employees stood and attempted to get out of the line of fire. The falling cradle struck one of the employee's legs causing a broken tibia.
An employee was polishing a tool on the engine lathe and his finger got caught.
An employee was cutting bone-in pork when his hand slipped and contacted the band saw blade. He sustained a partial amputation to his right index fingertip.

An employee was performing maintenance on a refrigerator unit while working from a ladder. He went to step down from the ladder, missed a step and fell 3 feet onto the concrete floor. He sustained right rib fractures.

An employee was working on a vehicle that was elevated on a car lift. While walking beneath the elevated car lift, the employee tripped on the 4" lip of a well that the lift retracts into when in the stored position. The employee fell to the ground and broke the left ankle.
An employee was helping to lift a plate using a chain when the chain snapped and caused an amputation to the employee's finger.
An employee was cutting conduit with a battery-operated band saw. The band saw jammed and kicked back amputating the employee's left index finger to the nail bed.

An employee was loading incoming merchandise onto a pallet racking system using a forklift. The forklift struck a loose pallet on the floor and spun out of control. The employee was thrown from the machine and pinned against the racking system. The employee was hospitalized for internal bleeding.

An employee was removing a three-inch diaphragm pump from a storage room in the accumulator house. After placing the diaphragm pump onto the ground outside the storage room, he tripped on a board protruding out from under the right side of the accumulator house and fell to the ground knocking the pump onto his right calf muscle and crushing it.
An employee was on top of a platform ladder near the door jam section of the facility. The ladder fell over and the employee suffered injuries to the shoulder.
An employee was climbing on the back of a fuel truck to remove a chain when he slipped and fell. The employee suffered two broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was using a hammer to remove a sprocket when a piece broke off the sprocket and embedded into his left knee. It required surgical removal.

On May 6, 2019, at approximately 3:49 PM, an employee working on a brake press and handling a piece of sheet metal (approximately 2' x 4'). The sheet slipped and lacerated the ulnar artery on his left wrist, just above the glove. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee reached into the oxygen compartment to obtain a broom. The ambulance door then closed on her left middle finger and amputated it.
An employee was cutting coil tubing with a handheld band saw. The tubing swung back and lacerated his knee.

An employee loaded pallets onto a pallet jack. When he started moving the jack his leg was pinned between the pallet jack and a cinder block wall. The employee sustained a fracture to the lower leg and ankle, and a laceration to the heel.

On May 6, 2019, at approximately 5:50 PM, an employee was taking a sample from a slurry tank when his fingers were caught in the slurry tank causing a partial amputation of the employee's right index finger and injury to his right pinky finger.
Two employees were adjusting the insertion machine. The machine unexpectedly started up and the injured employee's right thumb was caught in a pinch point and crushed.
An employee working near a conveyor was reaching for a bag of cooked chicken when her sleeve was caught in a rotating shaft resulting in a broken left radius and ulna.

On May 6, 2019, at approximately 7:00 AM, an employee was pulling bones from a conveyor and stacking them on the table of a bandsaw. The employee turned to retrieve more bones and his left pinky finger struck the running saw blade causing a partial amputation.

A driver was tightening a strap on his trailer to secure a load. The ratchet came loose and flew off the trailer hitting the driver in the mouth. The driver sustained an injured lip, broken mouth, and broken teeth.

An employee was finishing the process of evacuating sugar from the pocket of a railcar. The employee lifted a portable air-operated railcar vibrator, weighting 47 pounds, to place it into the railcar. While lifting, he felt a pop in his back. He required hospitalization for a lumbar disk herniation.

An employee was adding a pad to the pusher in order to square up the boards on a running bundler machine. The employee's right index finger was caught between a lug and the guard around the chain and was partially amputated.
An employee was trying to remove a jammed nail in the pneumatic panel nail machine and suffered the amputation of the left index fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was cleaning out a dryer when the rotary valve struck their left ring finger and amputated it to the first knuckle.

An employee was using a roller board device placed in a trailer to load packages. While moving the device his finger became caught in it. He sustained a severe laceration to his right index finger requiring hospitalization and a skin graft.

On 5/06/2019, at 9:00 a.m., a temporary employee was installing ceiling tiles from a scaffold. She went to move the 3-foot scaffold, but the scaffold broke and she fell onto the concrete ground fracturing her right wrist which required surgery.

An employee was using a bucket lift to work on the hull of a ship. The employee's hand was on the top of the bucket when the lift made contact with the hull of the ship and the employee's hand was caught between the bucket and the ship's hull. Two fingers were damaged and a third finger was medically amputated.
An employee was operating a reach lift and caught his foot between the lift and a piece of equipment.
An employee fell from a ladder which resulted in a fractured left wrist, right elbow, and possibly fractured ribs.

An employee was walking during a demolition job when he tripped and fell onto the steel decking of the working surface he was on. He sustained several fractured ribs on the right side of the body, an injury to his right lung, and a laceration to the liver.
An employee was inspecting carriers traveling down the conveyor system and was walking over a mezzanine when his right foot slipped and was caught and amputated in the conveyor rollers.
The injured employee was standing in the back of a trailer at the loading docks. Another tractor trailer rolled into the trailer and crushed the employee's legs.

An employee was helping to move pieces of scrap metal. When the magnet crane was loading the  scrap metal, the employee's left ring finger was caught and crushed between two pieces of scrap metal. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a room when the door to the room was slammed shut by a gust of wind. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated in the door jam.
An employee walking across an existing metal roof stepped through a skylight and fell 20 feet to the floor below. The employee sustained two broken arms.
An employee had been operating a pumping unit at a salt water disposal facility when a fire/explosion occurred. The employee sustained third degree burns to 60 percent of his body.

While scarfing a forging, a hot spark got inside the employee's protective clothing. When the employee opened his clothing, enough oxygen got in to allow the clothing to catch fire. The employee sustained second degree burns.

An employee was securing a trailer to the dock to unload products. The employee engaged the dock lock and extended the manual dock plate. The plate did not go down when the employee stepped on it. The employee then used a stand-up lift to lower the plate. The employee backed the lift towards the dock and his left foot was caught between the stand-up lift and the dock plate. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to his left toe requiring surgery.
An employee was dismantling an engineered scaffold and fell approximately 57 feet. The employee was hospitalized for compound fractures to his legs and ankles and two fractured ribs.
An employee was instructing a class on 5/6/2019, when the employee tripped over a stool and fell onto the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a left hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was walking down the stairs at a new construction site when he tripped and fell. The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken left arm.
An employee was walking in the accessories department by the price checker, tripped on a fallen mesh bag on the floor, and fell breaking the right elbow.
An employee was carrying a tool box to a coworker's car to place it in the trunk. The employee's finger was caught between the tool box and equipment in the car and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was flipping a concrete slab, tread side up, in preparation for shipping. As he was flipping the concrete slab, the load shifted and started to swing. The employee s hand was caught between the slab and an adjacent object. The employee was hospitalized with a hand laceration.
Two employees were replacing a 4 x 8 floor tile. The floor tile was on pedestals when the injured employee's finger was caught below the tile, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was riding a horse and struck a guy-wire attached to a power pole. The employee suffered a head laceration, a broken finger and severed a finger.
An employee was escorting a person who was having behavioral issues to a quiet place. The person assaulted the employee, head-butting him on the side of the head. The employee suffered a concussion.

An employee was being trained on the operation of a 5-step depositor machine that fills muffin baking cups with batter. While the working motion of the machine was being demonstrated the employee contacted the slicing blade resulting in amputation of the pad of a finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.
A cashier returning to her cash register tripped and fell. The employee struck her head on the ground and was hospitalized.
An employee was tossing old light fixtures into a scrap bin when he felt pain in his lower left quadrant. He was admitted to the hospital for surgery to repair a hernia.
An employee was operating a chop saw to cut wood and amputated the right index fingertip while indexing a board.

On 5/7/2019, an employee was working on the ground level collecting falling brush from a tree and disposing of it in a wood chipper. A second employee was performing tree pruning and utility line clearance operations in a utility truck bucket approximately 45 feet high. The second employee began to cut a tree lead, approximately 15 feet in length, with a chainsaw. The tree lead then fell and struck the first employee's face, causing nose and facial lacerations, fractures, and contusions.

A temporary employee had been cutting a section of a catwalk with a torch. After completing the cutting, the catwalk made a twisting motion and caused a light pole on the far end of the catwalk to fall and strike the employee. The employee sustained a puncture wound to his left upper cheek and a laceration on his back and was hospitalized due to symptoms of a concussion.
An employee was cutting wood blocks with a circular saw and lacerated their left ring finger. The finger was medically amputated at the first joint.
A pipe slipped while an employee's hand was on it, breaking the employee's little finger.
An employee was positioning an alloy bar in a vertical band saw. His finger became caught between a horizontal clamp and the alloy bar and sustained an amputation.
An automotive technician was spinning a tire when his right middle finger got stuck between the rim and caliper. The fingertip was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been using a bucket truck to repair a telecommunications cable at a customer's residence. The employee completed the job and got down into the truck bed from the bucket itself, and was then stepping off the platform at the rear of the truck when he missed a step, lost balance and fell from the back of the truck to the ground approximately 4-5 ft below. The employee landed on his tool belt and the right side of his lower back. He was hospitalized with four fractured vertebrae in the lower back.

While a crane was lifting a jaw crusher that was being removed for repair a section of ductwork that was connected to the building fell and struck employee on the head. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra.

A hydraulic line on an excavator blew as the machine was picking up a 60" tube. When it lost pressure and fluid, the arm suddenly came down and fully extended striking an employee and pinning him to the ground.
An employee slipped down the stairs and was injured resulting in hospitalization.

A painter working in the sonar dome of a submarine was power washing in a confined space when they fell three levels (approximately 20 feet) through a 2' x 4' access hole. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a contusion to the back of the head and pneumonia from inhaled water.
An employee was building a horse stall when an unlocked roof panel swung open catching the employee's left ring finger in the hinge and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was working inside a bucket truck replacing old power lines with new power lines. An arc occurred between the two lines and one employee was burned on his stomach and left arm.
An employee removed the radiator cap and was sprayed in the face by hot liquid. The employee suffered burns to the face.

A jockey truck driver was attempting to make a U-turn and collided with another truck in another lane. The employee suffered blunt-force trauma to the neck, head and shoulder and a laceration on the head from initial impact inside the cab and subsequently striking the ground after being discharged through the driver-side window.

An employee was cleaning a rotary die cutter machine, which takes sheets of corrugated cardboard and cuts out pizza boxes. The employee was cleaning out ink that accumulates at the side section of the ink metering rolls and suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger below the nail. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was pushing a piece of plywood through a table saw and amputated his left ring and middle fingers. The index fingertip was also amputated.
An employee was carrying insulation to a second floor when he injured his lower back.

While adjusting the rigging for the bull gear installation, the bull gear became unstable and shifted. The shifting gear contacted the mobile platform on which the employee was standing knocking the platform over and causing the employee to fall to the ground. When the gear shifted, the employee's right index finger was caught between the rigging and the wood block resulting in amputation of the finger.

An employee was operating the cabinet hinge press to attach doors to cabinets. The employee's left hand got caught between the cabinets and the machine which resulted in the amputation of a fingertip.

The injured employee was picking up the first concrete tilt-wall panel. As they were bringing the panel in to set it, another employee put his pry bar in to catch the panel. When the panel hit the bar, the bar came back and struck the injured employee in the shoulder/neck area causing a cervical bone fracture.

An employee had been sand blasting and removed a valve pipe plug when it became clogged. As the employee was removing material, air bled out of the system and caused the valve piston to shut and amputate the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee was on a roof inspecting network hardware and cabling. As the employee transitioned from the roof edge onto a ladder, he slipped and fell 25-30 feet to the ground below and suffered a broken left leg and ankle.

An employee was removing two stacked pallets from a truck while standing on a scissor lift. The top pallet of product fell and struck the employee knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained injuries to his head, back, arms and legs.

An employee was watching boxed product enter the tape machine when his shirt was grabbed by the machine, pulling the employee's arm into the equipment. The flight arm retracted and pinched the employee's wrist between the flight arm and the frame of the machine. The employee suffered a broken wrist that required surgery.
An employee was pushing boxes down into the trash compactor with his foot. The compactor came down on his foot and fractured it.
An employee was positioning a pallet jack within a trailer when the pallet jack lurched back and pushed his right foot into an awkward position causing the dislocation of the first and second toes.

A maintenance technician was changing a light fixture inside a CNC machine. When the employee was taking his hands out the machine, he was punctured by one of the machine's drill bits. The drill bits are sharp, needle like. The drill bit broke off inside the employees left index finger, just above the knuckle and had to be removed surgically.
An employee was feeding lumber into the up-cut saw when their right hand was caught in the saw resulting in the amputation of three fingers.
An employee was attacked by a customer with a knife. He was stabbed multiple times.
