An employee was running the floor scrubber while other employees were cleaning up glass bottles. One glass bottle was put in the hopper and shattered. A glass fragment hit an employee's head and went into the employee's left eye causing a laceration to the cornea.

An employee was painting from a scissor lift and fell 30 feet between the platform and the middle guardrail to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured hip. The employee's harness was not tied off to the equipment at the time of the incident.

Employee 1 was working on a piece of equipment when the equipment lost power. Employee 2 was working in the precision sheet/pickle room. Employee 1 checked the electrical panel for burned out fuses. Employee 1 donned arc flash gear and retrieved a meter to test the circuits. While testing the leads of the meter, the employee contacted vice grips that were located in the panel. The vice grips toppled into the panel creating an arc flash. Employee 2 was processing titanium sheets for the pickle line when the power shutdown. Employee 2 was exposed to nitric oxide and hydrofluoric acid. Employee 1 sustained second degree burns to five percent of the body and Employee 2 inhaled nitric oxide and hydrofluoric acid.
An employee was teaching a class and while walking towards a student her leg twisted causing a fractured femur.
An employee fell from a 6-foot ladder and suffered a wrist fracture requiring hospitalization.

An employee was bending rebar on a fabrication/bending machine when his right pinky finger was caught between the two ends of a piece of rebar as the ends overlapped to form a circle. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a forklift to unload a pallet of 55-gallon drums from a tractor trailer. A 55-gallon drum containing hydrofluoric acid was leaking and the acid was released into the air. The employee was hospitalized for exposure to the acid including lung and throat injuries.

An employee was attempting to disconnect a trailer and stepped up onto the tractor's catwalk. He slipped on the wet surface and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a left hip fracture and multiple rib fractures.

On May 8, 2019, a temporary employee was feeding candy into a machine hopper on a line while standing on a three-step metal ladder. The employee moved to the left and fell to the floor resulting in a closed head injury.

An employee was on a ladder that was leaning against a pole to disconnect cable TV from a client's house. The pole the ladder was leaning on broke at the base and the employee and the ladder fell to the ground. The employee sustained four broken ribs and a bruised lung.

On May 8, 2019, an employee was operating a pelletizer machine when it became blocked with plastic. The employee's finger was then caught in the feeder of the pelletizer, resulting in a middle finger amputation.
A truck driver was climbing into the cab of his semi-truck when he lost his footing and fell backwards to the ground and struck his head.
An employee was working near a backhoe and was struck by the rig of the backhoe. The employee suffered a leg and hip injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling a separator vessel onto a concrete slab when the vessel became unstable and fell onto the employee's right leg breaking it.

An employee was operating a winch to unload a 2-yard rear loading dumpster. The employee's gloved left hand got caught in the winch mechanism causing an amputation to the first joint of the left pinky finger.
While loading and unloading meat from a trailer, an employee slipped on condensation that had accumulated on the floor and fell breaking his left ankle.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell to the cement floor. He was hospitalized for a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was blowing chips off his machine when the machine was turned on and started to spin. The employee was repeatedly struck by the table chucks and suffered six broken ribs.

An employee was operating a forklift to move product from one plant location to another. While backing up, his left hand was crushed between the forklift frame and a roll of product hanging from a hoist.
A delivery driver slipped while walking on wet concrete and fell, landing on his right side. The driver's hand cart, loaded with food products, fell and amputated the driver's right middle finger.
An employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken bone in the lower leg.

An employee was installing a vent fan when it shifted and the employee's right hand was caught between the fan and a storage container. The employee pulled the hand back and the right index finger was de-gloved, resulting in a surgical amputation.
An employee was moving a cooling fan out of the way when his left thumb passed through the guard on the fan resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was moving a bulk cart when the employee's right index finger was pinched between the bulk cart handle and a support beam, crushing the fingertip. As a result, the employee's fingertip was partially amputated (no bone loss).

The injured employee was holding a cart carrying a 10' section of drilling pipe. A crew attached a snatch block to the section of pipe to lift the piece and connect it to the rig to continue digging deeper. As the crew began to lift the section of pipe off the cart, dirt had accumulated on the chain causing the pipe to fall around 6 inches and crush the injured employee's right hand between the cart and the pipe. The employee suffered fractures and lacerations to his fingers.
While closing the cash office's safe door, the employee's left index finger was caught in the safe door resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Two employees were operating the cut-down saw in the distribution area. While the cut-down saw was in the lowered position, the injured employee was taking measurements. When the saw engaged, the injured employee's finger was caught in the saw guard and partially amputated.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 wood stud with a hand-held saw. The blade contacted his left hand and amputated two fingers and lacerated a third finger.
An employee was feeding a reel onto the pasting machine. The tension tightened on the reel and it snapped. The employee was hit by the recoiling reel and his left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground suffering injury to the right shoulder and elbow.

An employee was operating a magnetic-mounted drill to drill one-inch holes in a stainless steel I-beam. As the employee was using a fox-tail style brush to sweep metal shavings off the I-beam his right middle finger was caught in the rotating drill bit. His right middle finger was degloved and two other fingers were fractured. He also sustained a fractured wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing an automated metering valve in a cyclone overspray collector and amputated the left index and middle fingertips when the metering valve actuated.
An employee had been walking on the flat roof of a school when he fell approximately 20 feet through a hole to the ground below. He was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and fractured ribs.

An employee was monitoring a 4-inch pump line being used to pump flood water away from a retention pond next to the facility. Two men drove up to the employee and robbed and stabbed him with a box cutter. He was hospitalized for bowel injuries.

An employee was sliding a mold frame onto a table with another employee when his finger was pinched between the table and mold frame, resulting in a partial amputation on the left middle finger between the bottom of the nail and first knuckle.

An employee was operating a router machine mounted to the table. As he was pushing the wood, the router kicked back and his left ring finger contacted the blade resulting in amputation of the employee's left ring finger at the nail bed.

An operator was showing another employee how to switch out the dies on a staker/crimper. The operator's right hand was caught in the staker/crimper and the middle, ring and pinky fingers were amputated.

An employee was cleaning a water sprinkler system used to keep rock moist before use. The employee as standing on top of the material bin wall. The wall is about 2.5 to 3 feet thick. The height of the wall is about 8 to 9 feet (3-blocks high : 6ft long by 3ft high). The sprinkler system's pipes run on the top of the wall. The employee was cleaning one of the holes on the pipe with both feet on the wall. When the employee was standing up, his right foot slipped and he fell forward 9 feet into the empty bin that was next to it. The employee sustained multiple fractures including the right scapula, left pelvis, lumbar vertebrae and two left ribs.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder while trying to loosen a nut from the top of the boom arm of a car wash. The employee was putting force on the wrench when the ladder tilted to its side and the employee fell five feet to the ground. The employee suffered a broken collar bone, nine broken ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee was installing a downspout from a ladder. The ladder was leaning on the side wall of a two-story house. The employee dropped the downspout and tried to catch it with his foot. The employee lost balance and tried to get his foot on the ladder, but missed the rung. The employee fell 12 - 15 feet from the ladder to the mulch bed resulting in fractures to his left arm, the first two left ribs and left scapula. The employee was hospitalized.

A warehouse technician was moving a cart with two pieces of granite countertop weighing 300 pounds. The cart tipped over and struck the floor. One of the broken pieces of granite landed on the employee's left foot and lacerated it. He was wearing steel toed boots at the time.
An employee was operating a slitter machine when it malfunctioned. As the employee attempted to fix the malfunction, their hand slammed into the blade and sustained a laceration.
An employee was disassembling a scaffold and fell approximately 7 feet from the scaffold to the ground resulting in hospitalization for fractured ribs and an injury to the left side of his head.
An employee was adjusting freight in a trailer and suffered a compound fracture to the left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting away a pallet jack when the employee's foot was caught between a pole and the pallet jack. The employee was hospitalized with a broken foot.

An employee was standing on the doorway less than four feet high while setting up a press. The employee was stepping across tie bars and fell to the floor below. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured femur and wrist.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder when he slipped and fell about 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured left arm.
An employee was reaching up to close a trailer door from the loading dock when his foot slipped off the dock plate and the employee fell into the trailer breaking his right arm.
An employee went to sit down on a computer chair when it rolled away from the employee. The employee fell to the ground and hit her head.

An employee was positioned on the second step of a three-step stepstool conducting inventory. While descending the stepstool, the employee missed a step and fell approximately 15 inches onto the floor and fractured the left hip.

On May 9, 2019, an employee was performing a tool change on a quenching press and suffered multiple fractures to their left arm when their left arm was caught between the tooling on the hydraulic cylinder and the base plate.
An employee working on a metal roof fell 20 feet through an opening to the interior concrete surface below. He was hospitalized with a fractured wrist and two compressed fractures in his back.
An employee was performing internal maintenance on a waste sorting machine and sustained a back injury while attempting to crawl out of the tight space.
An employee was entering the facility and got his finger caught in the door resulting in amputation of the right middle finger.

An employee was shearing a piece of 1/4" thick X 4" wide piece of steel flat bar on an ironworker machine. The employee's gloved, left middle finger was caught between the flat bar and the shear resulting in a fingertip amputation with bone loss.
An employee was inserting small pieces of steel into an iron worker when the clamping mechanism activated and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was in a manhole when he mis-stepped and lost his balance. His right hand then contacted an energized wire, causing an arc flash that burned his right wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding rebar into a rebar bending machine when the employee's glove became caught and was pulled into the conveyor belt, resulting in the amputation of the employee's left pinky and ring fingers.
On May 9, 2019, an employee was stepping down from a work platform when a forklift drove by and pinned his leg between the platform and the forklift tire. His leg was fractured.
An employee was pushing product into a molding press when the employee's left index finger was smashed between the mold and the safety bar, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was patching a 2-inch hole in the bottom of a corn auger with a glove and duct tape. The auger caught the glove and pulled his thumb into the machine resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
Employees were preparing to unload material with a crane. When the front outriggers were extended it contacted an employee's right foot resulting in a crushing injury and great toe amputation.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to access heating and air conditioning units on a building rooftop when the ladder wobbled and he fell off, requiring hospitalization.
The injured employee was exiting a tractor-trailer. He stepped down onto the front tire, slipped and fell approximately four feet to the ground resulting in four broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was installing an exterior aluminum trim when the employee fell from a ladder jack scaffold to the ground, suffering a broken left wrist and fractured pelvis.

Four employees were unloading a vehicle lift off the back of a trailer. As the injured employee and another team member were backing the lift down the trailer ramp, the back wheel of the lift got stuck in the space between the ramp and the concrete. This caused the lift to fall onto the injured employee and fracture his right ankle in two places.
An employee amputated a fingertip while cutting cabbage with a chef's knife.
An employee slipped or tripped and fell hitting her head on an autoclave cart. The employee sustained a head laceration.

An employee was lifting a machine frame off of a welding bench and lowering it down to the ground. His fingers were under the frame to shift it when the frame fell and pinched his fingers, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder to install a cable connection to a business and fell to the ground resulting in a broken bone in their back.

The injured employee was watching another employee utilize a drill reamer. The injured employee slipped or fell into the hole being reamed and contacted the drill reamer. The employee suffered a foot amputation.

The employee was operating a forklift to unload a rack from a trailer at the dock. The employee stopped the forklift and dismounted it. The forklift rolled forward and the employee's right leg was pinned between the racks and the forklift causing a right ankle fracture.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood and amputated the left index fingertip.
An employee was working overhead and brazing 4" copper when a galvanized hanger was heated and he inhaled zinc. He later experienced respiratory distress and was hospitalized.
A temporary worker was operating a press brake to bend a 70mm piece of sheet metal. Their right hand was caught in the press when it was actuated resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee tripped over an extension cord and impacted the ground, fracturing his left hip.

An employee was removing a broken/damaged box from a conveyor when the employee's safety glove was caught in the gap between the conveyor side guards, resulting in a partial amputation to the right pinky fingertip.

An employee was cleaning out water and debris around column footers in preparation for filling with concrete. The employee experienced skin irritation to the hands including discoloration suggesting possible infection.

An employee was assisting in the removal of a trench box from an excavation. The employee noted that a rigging hook was stuck on a corner of the trench box and went to unlatch it. At the same time, the excavator operator lifted the rigging and the employee's middle finger was caught between the rigging and the trench box resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking from a parking garage in downtown Pittsburgh to a client's office when she stepped off the curb and fell backwards into a puddle. She broke her ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was crossing the street with a client when a vehicle struck the employee. The employee sprained the bi-lateral knee, neck, and left and right shoulders.
An employee was climbing out of the lower section of a crane cab when he grabbed a strap from the door for assistance and the strap broke, causing him to fall to the ground. He fractured his femur.

An employee was operating an aluminum extrusion press. He was attempting to cross over a table roll section with two automatic puller machines overhead and was struck by the returning puller and caught between the puller rollers. Four fingers on the employee's left hand were crushed and severely lacerated. The thumb was partially amputated.

An employee noticed that a pallet slipped on the shelving while he was centering a pallet below. The pallet shifted and fell on top of a box that was on the lower pallet. The employee's finger was pinched between the box and the lower pallet. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left middle fingertip.

An employee was training a new employee on how to operate a hostler tractor to hook into a trailer. The trainee high-hooked the trailer and pinned the employee's left leg between the trailer and the tractor. The employee suffered a shattered left ankle.

On May 10, 2019, at about 7:00 p.m., an employee was working on a fleshing machine to remove the manure roller when the roller (weighing about 1200 pounds) started to roll. As he attempted to move out of the way, the roller struck and broke his lower right leg.
An employee slipped and fell on the concrete sidewalk while walking, sustaining a broken left arm and cuts.
An employee was climbing down a concrete column form and fell. The employee suffered a dislocated shoulder and a laceration.
An employee was operating a forklift and pinned a leg between the forklift and a pillar. The employee's left leg was fractured.
An employee was straightening boards when a board fell and hit the tip of his left little finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee fractured his left ring finger while disconnecting a baggage cart.

An employee was on a scaffold shaking mortar when the employee stepped backward and fell approximately 20 feet between two boards to the ground below. The employee suffered a collapsed lung, fractured vertebrae, and a skull contusion.
On May 10, 2019, at approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee was putting a tarp on a semi trailer and fell to the ground below. The employee suffered a head laceration and fractured ribs and vertebrae.

An employee was in the middle of a procedure in the lab. The employee went to get an injector and while turning left and walking her left leg gave out and she fell forward to the ground resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was loading a hand truck onto a trailer, slipped and fell out of the trailer to the ground below. The employee fractured a hip.
An employee was feeding cardboard into a flexo folder feeder when a jam occurred. As the employee tried to unjam the machine his left pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a 10- foot rolling staircase to perform repairs on the roof of a fifth wheel travel trailer. He slipped from the staircase and landed on his feet causing injury to his right heel.
An employee wearing cut resistant gloves was utilizing a retractable knife when the knife slipped resulting in a partial amputation to the left thumb.

An employee was accessing the area above a drop ceiling using a ladder. While he was ascending the ladder, it shifted and he lost his balance, falling approximately 4 feet. He struck a table and then landed on the floor, requiring hospitalization for fractures.

Two employees were preparing to stop working for the day and had started to lower the scissor lift to the ground. Both employees were tied off with their fall arrest systems. A gust of wind caused the trusses on the building to fall. It resulted in a domino effect and the last truss struck the scissor lift that was approximately 16 feet high, causing it to tip over while the employees were in it. One employee sprained his ankle and was treated and released that day. The other employee suffered injury to both elbows that required surgery and a laceration on the forehead that required stitches.  He was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a flat-bed trailer. A building material item fell from the trailer and struck the employee's leg causing a knee fracture that required surgery.
An employee was conducting a food product demonstration. The employee took a bite of the product and had an anaphylactic reaction requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unloading steel with a crane. He placed an 8-foot wood block under some angles. The angles shifted and the block popped out and struck him causing him to fall. The employee suffered a concussion and a neck injury.
An employee was getting out of his truck on the driver's side when he fell to the ground, breaking his right hip bone and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was connecting a vibratory hammer using a 2-inch, 10-foot choker. The employee contacted the point of operation at the sheave and cable and their right ring finger was amputated below the nail.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated their right index finger between the first and second joint.

Two employees were arguing over a method to fix an overhead garage door. Employee 1 lunged at Employee 2 with a box cutter. Employee 2 struck Employee 1 on the head with a cordless impact wrench. Employee 2 was rendered unconscious and was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was hit in the head while racking and was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was cleaning a light fixture and pipe on a 12-foot A-frame ladder near an entryway with an automatic upward sliding door. The door was activated, opened upward and knocked the employee off the ladder. He fractured his left shoulder and neck.

An employee was operating a scissor lift, traveling down a ramp in a parking garage. The lift started slipping due to the flooring conditions and a 9-degree grade. The scissor lift slid until it hit a curb at the bottom of the parking garage. When the lift hit the curb it stopped and the employee was ejected onto the concrete floor. The employee sustained 4-5 broken ribs, a fractured tail bone, a contusion to the right side of his head, and a lacerated liver.

An employee was power washing the top shed of the shakers approximately 8 feet above the lower level. As he was transferring to the ladder to leave the shed top, he fell and struck his head on the tank's metal grating. The employee suffered a torn muscle in the neck and a concussion.
An employee received an electrical shock and burns while securing the power cable to the tower crane.
An employee walked through an area of wet carpet and then stepped onto a tiled area and slipped. The employee fell and broke her wrist.

An employee was setting up a board over a 3-foot deep excavation so that he could access the control valve to stop a leak. The employee fell into the excavation that was filled with hot water and suffered burns to the feet, leg and knee.
An employee was moving straws from one side to the other of a hopper when the employee's hand slipped into the conveyor, resulting in a right middle finger amputation.

An employee placed a customer's car onto an automotive lift to check the wheel bearings. The employee manually spun the wheel to emulate movement in order to hear if the wheel bearing was bad. While the wheel was spinning the employee's left index finger was caught between the wheel and the brake rotor amputating the finger to the first knuckle.

An employee was helping to set up a tent for an event and was holding a metal pole. A strong electrical current struck the metal pole due to a lighting strike. The injured employee had pain in his right arm.
An employee was servicing a re-grinder and amputated four fingers.

An employee had been connecting/disconnecting air lines from his yard spotter truck to the trailer. When the employee was stepping down from the spotter truck, he slipped and fell to the ground sustaining fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was working on a ladder approximately 45 inches high when his wrench slipped, causing him to fall off the ladder to the ground. He suffered fractured ribs.
An employee slipped on a plastic wet floor sign that was lying on the floor when she walked through a back door and jammed her leg into the door, sustaining a left leg injury.

An employee was making a key way in a concrete platform when he stepped on a 3 X 4 bracing that gave way. He then fell about 24 feet to the next 3 X 4 bracing and broke eight ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was watering plants in the garden center when she tripped over the hose and fell to the floor, breaking her right femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking down stairs, missed a step and fell fracturing the right hip.
An employee was struck by a golf cart while he was filling in divots on a golf course tee hole. He suffered a fractured nose, cut lip, and scrapes.

On May 13, 2019, the injured employee was performing demo work with a pry bar in one hand while his other hand was leaning against a door jam. Another employee closed the door causing and pinched the injured employee's finger between the door and the door frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading a pallet of milk on a trailer. His pallet jack fork hit a piece of wood that had broken off from a pallet he had just loaded, causing the milk to start to tip over. The employee dismounted the pallet jack and tried to stop the pallet from falling. His finger was pinched between the falling pallet of milk and the side of the trailer, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee carrying a large filter and assembly from a warehouse area into a pump shop tripped and fell forward, cutting his right middle finger on the filter edge.
An employee was standing on top of a string line when he lost his footing, twisted, and dislocated his hip.
While operating a coupling machine, an employee got a laceration on her hand that required stitches and immediately started to have seizures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was grinding a part on a grinding wheel when his finger came into contact with the grinding wheel, resulting in a de-gloving of his finger and bone loss.

An employee was operating the manual side of a press stretcher (the tail side). He placed a block inside the channel of the aluminum extrusion and clamped it in the jaw end of the stretcher. When the employee noticed the block was out of alignment, he opened the jaw with his right hand and used his left hand to re-align the block. While he was re-aligning the block, the jaw handle slipped from his hand and closed on his finger. This occurred at the same time the head stretcher began pulling on the extrusion. 
The employee's left index finger was caught between the jaw and the extrusion. He pulled his hand back and lost his fingertip.

An employee was picking up rigging shackles at the foundation base of a purposed cell tower. A climber on the tower had a tool pouch with a wrench that came loose off of his belt. The tool bag and metal wrench fell and struck the employee in the face, lacerating his upper lip and breaking his jaw and teeth.

An employee was using a scraper to clean debris from an asphalt paver when his safety vest became caught on the paver and he was pulled in toward the auger. He was hospitalized with second and third degree burns from the mid-torso to the armpit. The paver was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a scrapper on the side of the road and began to feel unwell. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was electric welding a goose neck trailer when the employee's shirt caught on fire from welding slag, causing second degree burns to the employee's torso and left arm.
An employee was removing a tube stand from under a piece of equipment when the tube dropped and partially amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was starting to do work on a mobile scaffold when the scaffold fell over. The employee fell on a bench, suffering broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee fell and struck their head on the floor, requiring hospitalization.

On May 13, 2019, an employee was asked to locate a motor in the storage room. About 20-30 minutes later a maintenance employee came into the storage room and found the injured employee leaning against a rack and bleeding. A ladder was found on the floor and the injured employee later said he had been on the ladder about 4 feet high. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was riding a horse looking for sick cattle when the horse was spooked and threw the employee off into a fence. He broke his jaw and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a gurney past a mounted sink and pinched his right pinky finger between the gurney and the laminate support for the counter top resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was hauling cardboard to a dumpster on an industrial forklift. He reached to open the gate while on the lift. The gate stopped when he was trying to drive through it and his hand was smashed and a finger was broken between the forklift and the gate.

An employee was selecting a grocery order using a double pallet truck. The employee's hand became caught between the handle bar of the pallet truck and a product pallet. The employee sustained an injury to the right thumb.
An employee was operating a crane to lift a compressor and put shrink wrap around a flange. The load shifted, causing the compressor to strike him. He suffered a broken fibula and tibia.
An employee was struck by a rail buggy while working on a gas pipe line, suffering a crushed ankle.
An employee was cleaning a printing press with a rag when the press cycled and struck her right hand, amputating her right fifth digit at the first knuckle and fourth digit at the second knuckle.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he had a seizure, lost consciousness and slumped forward onto the steering handle. This caused the forklift to travel in reverse. The employee's left foot became pinned between the forklift and a trash can, which in turn was pinned against a guardrail post. The employee's left foot was amputated back to the heel.

An employee was sliding a heavy piece of stone when it slipped down and pinched his left index finger between the stone and a meter cover on the ground. His left index finger was smashed, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a hand saw to cut a piece of 1 x 6 fence picket when the saw cut his left middle finger, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was pumping down an existing refrigeration line set in a mechanical room when there was a release of liquid refrigerant. While working to stop the release, the employee received burns to the right hand, requiring hospitalization.

On May 13, 2019, at approximately 8:20 a.m., an employee was pumping anhydrous ammonia from bulk storage tanks into a 1000 gallon anhydrous ammonia mobile nurse tank. Ammonia released from the valve and burned the employee.

An employee was removing a pin on the lift cylinder of a mini excavator when the cylinder fell. He tried to catch the cylinder and his right ring finger was crushed between the cylinder and the blade, causing a dislocation with an open wound.

An employee was using a tool to clean film buildup off of a set of equipment leveler rollers. Once completed, the employee selected jog mode on the operator console to turn the leveler rollers and inspect if all of the film was removed. During the process of jogging the rollers forward, the employee's right hand was pulled into the leveler rollers causing a laceration to the palm.

The injured employee was standing on a flat bed truck reading labels on parts to another employee who was on the ground. The injured employee put their foot on an interior support column weighing 826 pounds that was stacked four high and the stack shifted. The employee jumped to the ground and the column fell on top of him. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs, a punctured lung, a punctured liver and internal bleeding.

An employee was using a chain come-a-long to move a boiler down the steps into a building. The neutral lever hit a solid surface and disengaged the come-a-long. As the chain began moving freely the employee's finger became caught in the sprocket of the come-a-long resulting in the amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was walking through the facility near where flattened boxes were stacked when the boxes fell and knocked him down. He suffered broken bones in his leg.

An employee was operating a saw to cut a raw aluminum ingot. The employee's finger was smashed between the ingot and the saw table resulting in amputation of the left middle finger from the tip to the top knuckle.
An employee was reaching from one conveyor belt to the other  and fell over 12 feet onto the concrete floor. The employee suffered a concussion and broken bones.
An employee fell back and struck his head on the ground after a faulty control valve back fired.
An employee was working at the service desk when a customer brought in a leaking battery. The employee inhaled the off gassing from the battery and experienced respiratory discomfort.
An employee had an allergic reaction while installing stuffer blocks and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a flo freezer. He was on the conveyor belts between two rakes and got caught by the rake behind him. The employee suffered a puncture wound to his left thigh and injury to a right knee ligament.
On May 14, 2019, an employee exiting the cab of a semi truck when he fell and struck his head.
An employee was carrying a large piece of sheet metal when it was dropped on his foot, causing an injury that resulted in a little toe amputation.

An employee stood up to walk away from her desk when her foot became entangled in the computer cables under her desk/workstation, causing her to lose balance and fall to the floor. She extended her arms to break her fall and broke her left arm in two places.
An employee was removing a 48-inch x 8-foot long pipe from a machine when the employee's fingers were smashed between the pipe and an I-beam.
On May 14, 2019, an employee was airing up a 14" tire on a 14-1/2" rim when the tire exploded. The employee suffered a broken and dislocated elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing a self rescue operation as part of his annual recertification as a tower climber. The employee attempted to lower himself to the ground using the release mechanism on his climbing equipment.  When he was approximately 8 feet off the ground, he fell to the ground and landed on his back, fracturing his vertebrae.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking toward the front of the building, suffering a right foot injury.
An employee was using a telescoping radial miter saw to cut an aluminum angle extrusion when the saw kicked back, cutting the employee's right bicep.
While driving a water delivery route, an employee felt unwell due to heat exposure. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee's hard hat slipped off of his head. He leaned forward to catch it and struck his eye on a smock rack. He was hospitalized with lacerations to the upper eyelid, lower eyelid, and tear duct.
An employee was installing lights in a deli area from an 8-foot ladder when the ladder slipped and he fell to ground, fracturing both ankles.

An employee was trying to find a gas leak on a heater that was returned by a customer. In order to test the fuel injector spray pattern, the employee pressed the start button. Fuel was expelled from the engine and caught fire. The employee's right arm was burned.

On May 14, 2019, at 4:30 p.m., an employee was repairing an RV when the 6-ton jack stand failed, allowing the RV to fall. The employee's leg was caught under the RV, puncturing his upper right thigh and breaking his right lower leg. He was hospitalized.

On 5/14/19 at 5:30 a.m., an employee was clearing a jam in a forming machine when the machine cycled and caught the employee's right arm in the machine. The employee suffered lacerations to the right forearm.
An employee was resetting crimp plates and caught her left ring finger in the crimper head when it recessed into the machine causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was checking oil on a loader. He went to shut the side engine panel/cowling when his right index finger was smashed in the hinge area of the panel, requiring surgical amputation of the bone.
On 5/14/2019, an employee fell down stairs and fractured the right ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bending (stamping) a part when her hand entered the die. The die came down and caught her hand between it and the press. She suffered four broken fingers.

An employee was stripping a wire at a job site when he lacerated his wrist or arm and went to get a bandage out of his truck. He then passed out and hit his head on the truck or ground, sustaining head injuries.
On May 14, 2019, an employee was removing a temperature gauge from a piece of equipment when he was sprayed in the face with a chemical. He suffered chemical burns on his face and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by an electric pallet jack that lurched forward while he was loading his delivery truck, fracturing his right leg.
An employee was putting parts into a machine when the employee's hand slipped on oil and was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a partial thumb tip amputation (no bone loss).

An employee was operating a high-speed, automated robotic component saw. After running a series of parts through the saw, the employee rested his right hand on the lumber feed conveyor, which pinched his right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was trying to nail a rafter while standing on a joist. He was stepping onto the wall and slipped, falling 10 to 12 feet to the ground. He suffered a fractured arm and back soreness.

An employee was using a saw and feeding a piece of material into the saw when she attempted to fix material that became dislodged. Her right ring finger was pinched/crushed by the feeding mechanism, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was parking a forklift by a charging station. When the employee stepped out, the employee's left foot was caught and broken between the forklift and a metal barrier.

An employee was transitioning from a forklift platform to a roof when the employee fell approximately 18 feet from the roof to the ground, suffering a dislocated right wrist and a compression fracture in the back.

An employee opened the swinging doors of a truck trailer. A pallet had shifted during the drive and fell out. The pallet hit his lower body, injuring both his knees. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

Employees were cutting heating coil pipes using an electric reciprocating saw inside a starboard cargo tank on a barge. Gasoline vapors ignited and employees received first, second, and third degree burns. Two employees were hospitalized.

An employee was using a chop saw to cut pieces of wood. He made a cut with the chop saw and moved back to his workstation with the piece of wood. He went to make an additional cut. The chop saw blade was still spinning from the previous cut when his left hand contacted the moving blade, causing a laceration between the index finger and the thumb.
An employee was attempting to rekindle a small fire with gasoline to burn scrap wood when the resulting fire burned the employee.

An employee was cutting vinyl on a saw when a piece of vinyl was caught. She removed her foot from the pedal and went to remove the caught material. The saw was reactivated via the foot pedal resulting in amputation of her left middle fingertip at the nail bed.
An employee was processing cattle in the feed yard when his right little finger was pinched, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee's left hand was caught in the moving rollers of a rolling machine, crushing four fingers.
An employee was pulling a pallet with a pallet jack when a forklift backed up over the employee's foot, crushing it.
An employee was climbing a 20-foot ladder while transporting roofing materials when the ladder slipped and the employee fell, landing on an air conditioner unit and suffering broken ribs.

An employee was operating a wood splitter machine. His left hand was in the point of operation when the machine was actuated via the foot pedal. The vertical knife blade contacted his left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger and a severe laceration.
An employee was opening the door to an asphalt truck when it exploded, causing burns to both arms and his chest, neck, and face.

An employee was washing conveyor belts that run food into a chopper when the employee's rain coat sleeve became caught between the conveyor belt and the roller, resulting in a laceration to the left wrist/hand.
An employee had a reaction to an MMR vaccination; they had chest pains and an elevated heart rate.

An employee was operating a pasting line when several plates fell. The employee attempted to remove the plates from under the moving V-belt flattener and suffered a partial amputation to the right ring finger.
An overhead dock door fell and struck an employee on his head as he was rolling it down. He was hospitalized with a cervical strain.

An employee was working under a platform when a piece of slag fell off the furnace, hitting him in the hard hat and knocking him into a 2.5-foot pit. He suffered injuries to his scalp and a fractured leg.

On 5/15/2019 at approximately 8:00 p.m. an employee was using an acetylene torch to cut the top off of a 15-gallon, metal drum. The drum's last contents were highly flammable and the drum exploded as the employee was cutting the top. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was on the third floor decking and reached down to pick up his gloves and fell to the second floor decking injuring his chest and back.
An employee was working on an extruding machine when an arc blast occurred. The employee sustained burns to his face, ears, neck, chest and arms.
An employee was involved in an altercation with a shoplifter and was hospitalized.
Two employees were carrying rebar. One employee lost balance and fell onto a stack of rebar fracturing their left leg.
An employee was tracking a group through brush country and was bitten by a rattlesnake.
An employee was operating a forklift to load a box truck when the truck moved away from the loading dock, causing the forklift to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a knee injury.
An employee fell to the ground and fractured her right hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was unjamming a cable splitting machine when his left hand was caught inside the machine, resulting in a severe laceration to the thumbs and partial amputations to the tips of his index and middle fingers.
As a bundle of steel was being lowered by an overhead crane, it shifted and pinched an employee's left middle finger. The tip was amputated.
An employee's hand was crushed in a 32-ton press, amputating four fingertips.
An employee fell off a ladder to the ground and broke a leg.

Employees were performing maintenance on a fertilizer truck loading arm when the spring tensioner released, allowing the arm to drop and strike an employee who was offering guidance and observing the work. The employee was struck on the head and knocked down.

An employee was using a sponge to remove dried ink from a press ink pan when the employee's right hand and arm were caught by a rotating cylinder that was near the ink pan. The machine was operating at the time.
An employee was attacked and bitten on the finger by a dog while delivering mail, resulting in a possible amputation of the pinky finger.

An employee was using abrasive blasting equipment as part of the fabrication process for a steel tubular rack. The employee's left hand suffered an abrasion that required hospitalization after it was struck by the blasting media.
An employee was rigging and walking around a construction site when he became ill and required hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee was pushing a rack when she tripped and fell into the rack, striking her arm on a roller and fracturing her elbow.

The injured employee transported chemicals to a field location. A second employee was operating an applicator and drove up to receive the chemicals. The injured employee hooked up the hoses to the applicator. The applicator dropped the spraying arms down and they contacted a power line. The injured employee was shocked and hospitalized for burns to a hand and foot and amputation of the lower left arm.

An employee was riding a bicycle on the flight line apron headed to a building when the employee was struck by the trailing edge of a B-1 stabilizer on a parked trailer. The employee suffered facial fractures and lacerations.
An employee suffered the amputation of the right middle fingertip while installing a chain over a drive gear sprocket on the ribbon blender.

An employee was driving a utility terrain vehicle (UTV) and struck some 4-inch PVC pipes laying on the ground. The employee lost control of UTV and as he was about to be ejected he grabbed the rear view mirror causing it to break and lacerate his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was preparing to install a wiring harness to the base of an outside air conditioning unit that was being manufactured. The base of the unit contained the compressor and two sets of wires. One set of wires had fallen below and was caught in a section of rotating chain and sprocket on the conveyor. The employee attempted to remove the wires and both of her hands were caught between the chain and sprocket. Both middle fingertips were amputated.

An employee was lifting a 5,000-pound steel plate with a small ground hoist that was rated for 7,500 pounds. The plate suddenly lowered down onto the employee's lower leg, causing him to fall to the ground. The plate rested on the side of his right foot, resulting in two bone fractures. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was in an aerial lift installing a section of angle iron for the installation of a new elevated walkway at a tank farm. There was a pipe racking system located behind the aerial lift's basket. When the employee retracted the lift basket it retracted into the racking system and the employee was caught between the lift's controls and the fixed racking system. The employee lost consciousness and sustained chest bruising.

An employee was sweeping grain and got caught in the drag chain conveyor after stepping into an opening in the walking surface. The employee suffered the surgical amputation of three toes on the left foot.
An employee was pulling out a marble slab when the slab leaned on the employee's head, causing a head injury.

An employee was loading a rear load container to dump into the back of a garbage truck when the container shifted and smashed the employee's fingers. The employee fractured multiple fingers and received a severe laceration to the middle finger.
An employee was polishing a rod using an emery cloth and a lathe. The employee's left hand was caught in the lathe resulting in a fractured wrist.
An employee was rotating a crane when the crane tipped over. The employee jumped off the crane and fractured a leg upon impact with the ground.

An employee was walking on metal grate flooring above a chemical tank and fell through a section of the grate. His right foot was submerged in the chemical mixture that was heated to 160 degrees, and caused second degree burns half way up his shin.
Two employees were welding pipe when the 9x9 steel welding hut blew over due to a microburst. One employee was hospitalized for a fractured leg and hip.
An employee was assisting in the laundry room when the door slammed on his right index finger, resulting in an amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was loading a truck with the assistance of a power conveyor belt. The employee was struck by two boxes that fell on him while he was stacking the boxes.
An employee was troubleshooting a rotary furnace and caught their left index finger in a pulley under the furnace. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee opened a container with dichloroacetyl chloride residue, which is acidic. When the container was opened, tank pressure was released and some product discharged onto the employee. The product got on his back, the side of his body, and his face. He suffered first degree burns and irritation to the body and face, and was hospitalized for redness/irritation to his eyes. Safety glasses were worn at the time.
An employee was cutting chicken wings with a circular saw when the saw amputated her left index finger distal to the third knuckle.
An employee was operating a press brake machine and making an adjustment. Her left middle finger was caught in the point of operation, amputating it at the first knuckle.
While using a hand held 1/4" drill the injured employee's glove became entangled in the rotary file bit resulting in the amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a roller during the recoil process when the employee's right hand was caught in the roller, suffering a broken bone and laceration.
An employee was carrying auto parts inside the store, tripped over a cart, and fell breaking the left hip.

Two employees were tightening a belt on a conveyor while standing on a platform on a flatbed truck. The platform slipped down off the truck and both employees fell off the truck bed. The first employee sustained right-side stomach abrasions. The second employee fractured four ribs and was hospitalized.
While working on a platform lift installing electric service an employee was electrically shocked. The employee then fell 18 feet from the lift to the ground and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was working on a weakened power pole from a ladder. The pole snapped and the employee fell to the ground resulting in a fractured jaw.

An employee was helping a mechanic install a boom on a pipelayer. They were trying to pin the block when the block caught the employee's left pinky finger between the boom and the block, resulting in a finger amputation behind the nail.

An employee turned on a process pump inside a fish processing plant. The pump cap housing blew off causing hot water to forcibly flow out of the pump and strike the employee in multiple areas on the front of his body. As the employee turned away from the hot water, he was struck in multiple areas on the back of his body and knocked to the ground momentarily. Hot water also struck a second employee on the back while running away from the area.

An employee was addressing an alignment issue with the metal trim at the end of the conveyor. After making the adjustment, the employee's right hand was caught in the moving conveyor belt. The employee's pinky finger was fractured and dislocated. The employee also sustained a laceration from the mid-pinky to the middle of his right palm.
An employee was placing tools and equipment in a line truck when he slipped on the steps at a height of 2 to 3 feet and fell to the gravel ground, injuring his back.
An employee was performing roofing construction and fell through a skylight fracturing a hip and leg.

An employee was cleaning a large bearing in a wash tank. The employee fell backwards with the bearing and landed on concrete. The employee suffered head trauma, a broken right forearm and lacerations.
An employee was using a fire extinguisher on the brake area of his semi-trailer when a tire exploded causing burns to his neck and left hand along with debris in his left eye.
An employee was picking up a 30lbs. case of turkeys and suffered a torn muscle.

An electrician was in an elevated bucket truck utilizing a tie wire to tie a conductor. A live power line above the employee's head contacted his body and generated an arc flash. The employee suffered burns on his face, mid torso and his abdomen.

An employee was attempting to enter a semi-trailer, lost balance and fell backwards off the step approximately 18 inches to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a right hip fracture that required hospitalization.
The employee stepped onto the sweeper and fell to the tile floor breaking a hip.

An employee was on a manlift changing light bulbs. Rail cars were being moved and the employee felt like the rail car was going to hit the lift therefore, he jumped approximately 10 to 12 feet to the ground resulting in a fractured left arm and a fractured right leg and ankle.
An employee was involved in a mock exercise for a hostage situation when an impact grenade detonated close to her. She suffered tissue damage to the left calf area.
An employee was dragging a stack of I-beams using a chain and a forklift. The chain snapped and hit the employee in the jaw, breaking it and requiring surgery.

An employee was operating an 18-inch wood chipper with a winch attachment. The employee had tied a piece of wood to the machine's winch and a piece of excess rope from the winch was wrapped around his leg. As the machine began feeding the piece of wood into the chipper, the employee's leg was yanked towards the machine. The employee was able to engage a safety mechanism that stopped the chipper before his leg reached the chipper wheel. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis and other injuries.

An employee was using a pry bar to shift a water line over to connect it to the existing line. When he ran the pry bar into the ground, he struck a 15,000-volt electrical line, resulting in shock and burn injuries.

An employee was checking a wheel bearing noise by spinning the tire and listening with a stethoscope when his right hand slipped into the rim and it caught his fingertip. As a result, he suffered an amputation to the right index finger from below the nail to the top of the first knuckle.

An employee was working at a pug mill, loading clay chunks into a wad mill and offloading pugs that came off the wad mill. An extrusion plate, which pushed chunks of clay off a push cart, pinned the employee's left leg against the push cart, causing injuries and fractures to the leg.

A maintenance team member was walking down a set of stairs. He was holding the rail with one hand and was holding a tool bag in the other hand. He lost his balance and slipped on the last couple of stairs. As he attempted to catch himself he landed hard on his foot and felt pain in his knee. He was hospitalized for a tear in the tendon that stabilizes the knee cap.
An employee was loading/unloading a delivery truck when the employee's right toe was pinched by the lift gate, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing an adjustment pin on a tail bearing and amputated the left middle finger.
A crane operator was closing the crane door and pinched his left thumb between the door and the door frame.
An employee was working from a ladder when he fell approximately 7 feet to the concrete floor and suffered a shoulder injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out a propane tank. As the employee tightened a fitting on the tank, propane leaked out and contacted the employee's right hand resulting in cold burns to three fingers.
An employee tripped on an electrical cord and fell striking their face on a medication cart. The employee suffered a dislocated right shoulder and a fractured right patella.
An employee fell from a small 4-step ladder to the floor in a store meat cooler, suffering a skull fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell down one to two carpeted steps in the chapel and suffered a brain bleed, a left shoulder fracture and a black left eye. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting a noise that was coming from a machine. The machine started and the employee's left index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was in a scissor lift approximately 22 feet in the air attaching a gutter to the hopper. The crane pendant dropped into the gutter. The crane began to move dislodging the gutter and it swung out and struck the scissor lift knocking it over. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip and a contusion to the skull.

The injured employee was rigging up a component of a very large transformer to remove it by lifting it off the main transformer body using an all terrain telescoping forklift. The employee was positioned on top of the transformer completing the rigging with lifting hooks when the forklift operator accidentally bumped the joystick causing the boom to drop and catch the injured employee's right arm between the boom and a metal beam. The employee suffered broken bones in the right arm.
An employee was walking in the building when the employee tripped and fell on carpet, fracturing the left hip.

An employee was operating an electric power jack in an aisle and lost control of the jack when it went through a milk spill on the floor. The operator jumped off the jack and was pinned between the jack and pallet racking. The employee sustained a compound fracture to his lower leg/ankle.

An employee was unloading a truck and placing metal rods onto a cantilever rack with the aid of a hoist. A metal rod dislodged from the rack, fell, and struck the employee on the back. The employee suffered a fractured back bone and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a drill press to drill holes on a door frame. As the employee was holding a piece of the material, the glove on his right hand got caught in the drill. The force of the glove being twisted severed his right index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee fell four to five feet off the ramp of a ramp truck and landed on his back. The employee was hospitalized for a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was collapsing an empty wire display bin and amputated the tip of her right middle finger near the first joint.
An employee was going to step up on an 11- to 12-inch rail to measure a piece of steel when he slipped off and fell, injuring his hip.
An employee was using a toe kick saw to cut flooring when it struck a nail and kicked back. The employee's fingers were caught in the blade resulting in amputation of his right index finger.

An employee was working from a fiberglass ladder to install an electrical conductor on a 120v circuit when he received an electrical shock, became startled, dismounted the ladder, and fell on the concrete floor. He fractured his hip and pelvis. The power to the conductor was not shut off at the time of the incident.

Two employees were operating remote-controlled guillotine concrete breakers. The breakers have steel plates that come down and break the roadway concrete for removal. The injured employee's breaker was not operating and he got between the two units. When the second unit moved, the injured employee was pinned between the two breaker units resulting in a fractured left fibula.
An employee was leaving the building for the day and jumped off the loading dock to the paved parking lot. The employee fell and broke a hip.

An employee was attempting to place a bundle of conduit on a rack. The employee was stepping on another bundle of conduit when that bundle shifted and caused the employee to fall to the ground, fracturing his pelvis, hip, and tailbone and injuring his shoulder.
An employee was walking into the bar area when the employee slipped and fell on the wet floor that had just been mopped, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was operating a drill press, drilling a hole in a piece of plywood, when his gloved right ring finger was caught in the rotating drill bit, causing an amputation.

The injured employee was acting as a spotter in the parking lot for a lift operator that was loading a pallet of mulch into a customer's vehicle. The lift operator was positioning the load when the pallet of mulch shifted, toppled over, and struck the injured employee on the shoulder, knocking him to the ground. The employee struck his head on the pavement and was hospitalized for head trauma.
An employee was centering product on a roller bed when their finger was crushed between the roller bed and a rail lift. The employee sustained the amputation of the left index fingertip.

The injured employee was washing out a 55-gallon barrel with a hose next to the U-drain. The U-drain screen was clogged so another employee removed one grate to remove the clog. The injured employee was about one foot from the U-drain washing the barrel and stepped into the unguarded drain. The U-drain was about 10 feet in length, 16 inches wide and about 3 feet deep and had hot water in it. The injured employee suffered second degree burns to the leg, waist and stomach.
An employee was lifting chairs when he experienced pain in his back from a bulging disc.

An employee was sitting at the light station inspecting glass containers and noticed a piece of metal equipment from the forming department on the line. The employee was removing it from the line when the metal snagged her glove and amputated her left pinky finger.
An employee was moving behind a structure that was being installed when an I-beam dislodged, rotated, and fell, striking the employee's head and arms.
An employee was threading the pulp sheet machine when their left hand was caught in a pinch point resulting in a fractured hand and wrist.
An employee was operating a forklift and navigating around a metal container. His left arm was severely lacerated when it was pinned between the forklift and the container.

An employee was entering the back of a truck to load a handcart when the truck pulled away from the loading dock and the employee fell four feet to the concrete parking lot resulting in a head injury.

The employee was verifying a tag on a stainless steel coil. The employee took the coil out and set it on the floor. The crane adjusted weight on the floor and the coil rolled back towards the employee, hitting the employee and fracturing their pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder spraying water on a conveyor line when the employee lost balance and fell 2 feet onto the moving conveyor, suffering a broken arm.
An employee was positioning two concrete form panels (8 ft. x 30 in.) when their left pinky finger was caught between the two panels and crushed as the forklift moved the panels together.
An employee was bending down to get something from a bottom counter when the employee's eye hit a metal bag holder, causing an eye injury.

An employee was helping a patient use the toilet when the patient lost grip and started to fall. The injured employee grabbed the patient to keep her from falling. The force required to lift and hold the patient caused the employee's pre-existing hernia to be aggravated, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee's gloved finger was caught while aligning a swivel causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading product from the back of a tractor trailer. While coming down the ramp with a two-wheeled hand cart, the employee's foot slipped and he fell off the ramp. The hand cart then fell on top of him lacerating his ankle and crushing his heel.

An employee was working from a ladder cutting an old pipe. When the pipe was completely cut through, it fell and struck the ladder, knocking the employee to the floor. He broke his femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was prepping deli sandwiches, tripped over a box on the floor, fell and was hospitalized for a hip injury.
An employee was straightening the file after making a film change on a bagger machine when the clamp that seals each end of the product bag amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum from a pallet onto a hand truck. The employee's left hand was smashed between two of the 55-gallon drums, causing an amputation to the tip of the middle finger.
An employee was erecting a scaffold and fell approximately eight feet to the ground when a plank broke. The employee suffered a chipped bone in his shoulder.
A maintenance employee was using a fly mower and ran over his left foot resulting in amputation of two toes.
While chasing a shoplifter out of a store, an employee fell and suffered a knee injury.
An employee had climbed a ladder and unsecured the top of the ladder from the building so that it could be lowered when he fell from the ladder to the ground below fracturing a hip, ankle and heel.
An employee fell from the deck of a front-end loader to the ground below, sustaining a hairline skull fracture.

An employee was training another employee on how to clean the shake machine when the shake machine expelled excess cleaning solution onto an electrical outlet. The employee unplugged the shake machine's cord from the outlet and was shocked.
An employee was walking, tripped over the edge of a broken floor tile and fell breaking her left wrist.
An employee tripped while pulling carts and landed on the ground, injuring the left shoulder.

An employee was installing roof decking and fell approximately 20 feet through the roof, landing on the practice gym floor. The employee sustained fractures to both legs that required hospitalization.
On 5/20/2019, at 1:00 PM, an employee was training on a stand-up forklift and pinned his left ankle between the forklift and a pallet. The employee's ankle was fractured.

The injured employee was spotting a truck while it backed up. The employee slipped on fresh snow and his legs went under the rear passenger-side, dual truck tires resulting in a muscle injury to the lower left leg.
An employee was setting up form work for concrete and was struck in the left eye by a tie bar.
A letter carrier was delivering mail to a residence and was bitten by a dog. The employee sustained severe lacerations to the right hand and middle finger and the lower right leg.
An employee in the wood department lacerated three fingers while cutting wood on a table saw. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee tried to sit on a tall, wheeled lab chair. She slipped off the seat, pushing the chair back and fell backwards against a lab refrigerator and hit her head. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

Tri-axle dump trucks were importing stone to the worksite. After one of the trucks emptied its load the injured employee noticed stone on the tail of the body where the tailgate would close. The employee notified the driver who, again, raised and lowered the bed of the tri-axle to dislodge the debris. When the bed lowered the employee's left hand was caught in a pinch point between the truck body and the tailgate resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.

An employee had entered a forging press to make adjustments. The employee was stepping down from a step stool when he slipped and fell to the ground striking his jaw on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on his jaw.
An employee was on a ladder reaching for a metal basket on a shelf when the employee fell to the concrete floor, suffering a head injury and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
On May 20, 2019, an employee was pushing a semi-truck to be placed onto a jack stand and slipped. The truck rolled over his left leg and fractured it. The employee also sustained a bruised right leg.

An employee was sorting a truck/warehouse delivery. Totes are stacked 7 high x 2 on dollies with wheels. She was reaching for a top tote when either a tote fell and hit her on the head or she fell and hit her head. She was hospitalized with head trauma.
An employee felt dizzy and lightheaded while working in the black oxide room with chemicals. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to the lungs, chemical irritation, and skin blisters.
An employee was placing broken glass into a hopper when the glass hit another piece of glass, which then struck the employee. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the lower forearm.
An employee was loading a log onto a log splitter when the splitter was engaged and amputated the employee's right thumb.

A temporary worker was operating a motorized pallet jack to move pallets. While in reverse, the employee dismounted the lift and pinned his right leg between the lift and a support beam. The right leg was fractured.

A diver was underwater cutting steel floor beams from an anchor span truss when the anchor span moved and pinched his hand between the previously cut lateral beam and the truss. The employee was trapped for a few minutes until the steel structures moved and released him, allowing him to surface. He suffered a right ring finger and pinky fingertip amputation, as well as a right middle finger laceration.
An employee was driving a utility terrain vehicle (UTV) to close the worksite gates. The UTV overturned and the employee was ejected from the vehicle. The employee suffered a broken nose.
An employee was fixing a garage door from an extension ladder when the employee fell approximately 14 feet to the ground, suffering wrist, ankle, and rib fractures.

An employee was moving product with a cart. An empty cart was positioned next to a full cart. As the employee was positioning his cart next to the empty cart, he pinched his left pinky finger between the carts causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee stepped off a curb and fell fracturing the left ankle and tibia.
On 5/20/2019, at 8:00 AM, an employee suffered a spiral fracture to his tibia and fibula while turning around.

An employee was using an air gun to remove paper from a cylinder. The air gun struck their left hand causing a laceration and compressed air was injected into their left arm. The employee was hospitalized that evening with pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema in the left chest wall and neck.
An employee was compacting cardboard and crushed their left ring and pinky fingers in the compactor's safety gate.
An employee on the cleaning crew was struck from behind by a forklift and suffered broken ribs.

An employee was unloading equipment from a flatbed trailer, lost his footing and fell less than 4 feet off the side of the trailer to the ground. The employee shattered his elbow and was hospitalized.

On 5/20/2019, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was helping another employee unload a large cylindrical item off of a trailer bed using nylon straps/slings. The object began to fall on one end, which pulled on the sling the first employee had wrapped around his arm. The force of the falling object caused the first employee to be pulled off of the ground, and he started to be pulled up and over the flatbed. His foot became caught on a gate, and his right femur became a fulcrum and was fractured.

An employee was helping to unload a steel pipe (10"x40' / 2850 lbs.) from a truck. The pipe was lowered onto 4x4s when it rolled forward, jumped the chock, and rolled over the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg, three cracked ribs, and a broken collarbone.

An employee was positioning a piece of steel in a band saw's pneumatically powered clamp mechanism to hold the sample for cutting when his right thumb distal tip was caught in the clamp. He suffered a partial amputation of the thumb tissue under the nail.
An employee was sanding a chock on a belt sander when their right middle finger was caught in the belt resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting an air conveyance system when his left hand was struck by the spinning paddles resulting in amputation of the left index finger and part of the left thumb just below the nail.
An employee was palletizing finish good products. When he turned towards the pallet while holding a package, he tripped on the corner of the pallet and fell to the floor resulting in fractured ribs.

Two employees were pulling a messenger cable from one utility pole to another when the messenger cable contacted an adjacent power line. Both employees suffered electrical burns to the hands and arm and were hospitalized.
On 5-20-2019, at approximately 11:30 AM, an employee was attempting to stand up in the bathroom when he slipped on water and hit his head against the sink. He suffered blunt force trauma to the head.

An employee was on a ladder troubleshooting a faulty CO2 sensor. As she was removing the existing mounting bracket, a hot water pipe became dislodged due to corrosion and sprayed her with hot water, causing her to dismount the ladder and fall on the floor. She suffered hot water burns on her upper and lower back and left ribs, as well as bruises from the fall.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when their left foot slipped off the compartment and was run over by the lift wheel smashing the big toe and the two toes next to it. The employee was hospitalized.
A roofing employee fell 10 feet from a roof and was hospitalized for a back injury.
An temporary employee was working on the sanitation crew cleaning a meat grinder when his right hand was caught in the grinding aperture. The employee's hand was amputated.
An employee was adjusting the pouch line machine and amputated his right ring finger just below the first knuckle.
An employee was operating an alligator shear and amputated his right thumb tip.

A temporary employee was attaching a dump door pan to a spreader bar using a hydraulic fastening gun. The employee's right index finger was caught and crushed between the spreader bar and the trigger of the gun. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell off a utility truck while loading a drain pipe. The employee's head struck the concrete floor.

An employee was working in the field where a tornado had destroyed 4 to 5 substructures. The employee was marking lines with tape when a wire was freed and sprung up, striking and injuring the employee's back.
An employee was walking, tripped over an anchored stop plate for equipment and fell breaking their left femur.
An employee received a fingertip amputation while pushing meat through a blade after it was shut down.
An employee was cutting pipe on a portable band saw and lacerated his left index finger. The finger was surgically amputated at the first knuckle.
A temporary employee was feeding film into a pancake line machine when his right hand was caught on the cutting head, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was operating a forklift in the warehouse. He turned abruptly to avoid another forklift, got off balance and jumped off the forklift. His left foot was caught between the corner rack guard and the forklift and fractured.

An employee loaded plants onto a trailer wagon. The trailer was being moved to another section and the employee was walking behind the trailer. The trailer wagon was being pulled by another empty trailer in the same driveway. The employee thought the loaded trailer was going to contact the empty one and put his hand between the two trailers resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was removing the headpin from a high load scaffold (shoring system) when it fell on his left ring finger resulting in an open fracture and partial amputation.
An employee was leaving the facility when the employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, injuring the left knee.
An employee was exiting the office space via the rear door when a wind gust pushed a door mat up, causing her to trip on the mat and impact the ground. She fractured her left femur.

Two employees were on the roof of the Scooters ride installing the top canvas. One of the employees was on a catwalk. The two employees were pulling on the canvas in opposite directions to straighten it out when one employee unexpectedly let go of the canvas causing the other employee to lose his balance and fall backwards approximately 10 feet off the roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg immediately below the knee.

An employee was sanding/deburring the edge of an S-hook part against a sanding belt when the S-hook's open end slipped over the edge of the sanding belt drive wheel, pinching the employee's hands between the S-hook and the sanding belt's lower guard. His right middle finger was lacerated, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking down the steps between the second and third floor, missed a step and fell. The employee hit his head during the fall down the stairs and again at the bottom of the stairs against the marble baseboard. He briefly lost consciousness while waiting for the paramedics. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured vertebra in his neck and a laceration on his forehead.
An employee tried to catch a discharge head. It slipped while he tried to catch it and pinched his finger between the strap and the discharge head causing a laceration.

Two employees were in the dock area and walking towards the parking lot. One employee climbed over a railing to take a short cut and the railing gave way and fell on both employees. One employee was hospitalized for traumatic injury to the neck, shoulder and foot.
An employee was shutting a garage door while carrying supplies when the employee's little finger was caught between door panels, resulting in a smashed finger and a possible amputation.
An employee was unloading packages on a trailer's lift gate when the employee mis-stepped and fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee performing plastering activities fell 20 feet from a scaffold and was hospitalized.
An employee walking on the job site slipped on a piece of cardboard and impacted the ground, fracturing his hip.
An employee was cutting meat using a band saw and lacerated a tendon on the right third finger.

An employee was flipping the "boom strip" from a horizontal position to a vertical position with a flipper bar when the tool slipped causing the "boom strip" to shift and strike the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a fractured and dislocated left ankle.

An employee was handling 6-inch PVC piping from a dewatering system that was full of water and heavy while trying to connect it to a pump. The pipe fell onto another pipe and the employee's right ring finger was pinched between the two pipes causing a partial amputation.
