Maintenance employees were moving a catwalk with a forklift. The catwalk fell off the forks and struck the legs of one of the maintenance employees. The employee suffered broken bones in both legs.

An employee was doing routine maintenance (replacing worn belts) on a bag sealing machine when his left hand was caught in the machine. The employee's hand was crushed and burned and a fingertip was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was working to unjam a press brake when the paddle was hit, turning the machine on. The press brake then partially amputated the employee's left thumb.

An employee was removing excess dough around the cutter of a dough machine when the cutter partially amputated the employee's left index and middle fingers. The cutter was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was visually checking a conveyor system located outside. The employee slipped and fell and amputated their right index fingertip.
An employee was dismantling a shore tower at a construction site. The shore tower tipped over and struck the employee causing a compound fracture to the lower left leg.

An employee was cleaning out a 1-inch diameter pipe that feeds organic peroxide catalyst into a mixing bucket. A pneumatic valve closed on the employee's right pinky finger and amputated half an inch from the tip of the finger.

A temporary employee was operating a standup reach forklift when the forklift slid and struck a pole. His left leg was pinned between the lift and the pole resulting in multiple fractures to the left foot, three fractured toes and an open fracture on top of his foot.
An employee was struck by a forklift and hospitalized with fractures and a laceration.
An employee was struck by a reversing forklift and was hospitalized for a leg fracture.

An employee was checking the power and ground at the pigtail of a vehicle's AC compressor when his right hand contacted the serpentine belt, causing a laceration to his hand and fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell two to three feet from the elevated platform of a powered stock lifter onto the floor resulting in a hip fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing up a 24-foot extension ladder to paint the top portion of a building when the ladder slid backwards, causing him to fall on the concrete floor. He suffered fractured ribs and a fractured skull, as well as a broken back.
An employee was climbing a ladder placed on soil when the ladder shifted. The employee fell 3 to 5 feet to concrete ground and suffered a concussion.
An employee was walking through the aisle, tripped over boxes and fell striking their head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with swelling and bleeding in the brain.
An employee was hospitalized with a broken lower left leg after being struck by a forklift.
An employee was setting steel channels on a layout line when the employee's right middle finger was pinched between a channel and a steel plate, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was spotting for a forklift operated by a coworker. The employee attempted to pick up debris behind the forklift and was struck by the forklift, suffering a left tibia fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a ladder when a forklift struck the ladder causing the employee to fall and fracture the left wrist.
An employee was walking in the storage yard, tripped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with head and neck injuries.
An employee was hoisting loads. The load swung and the employee's hand was pinched between two loads. A finger was crushed and required surgery.

An employee was cleaning out the fuel additive bucket at the gas pumps when a customer's vehicle struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fracture ribs, facial injuries and a lacerated liver.
An employee was cleaning around a belt guard for a shaker motor and amputated her left index fingertip and left thumb tip in the belt and pulley.
An employee was turning on a breaker on a disconnect box when an arc flash occurred, causing burns to the employee's left hand and face.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while attending a meeting at a restaurant. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured right hip.
An employee was injured during a  filter change when the filter caught fire. The employee was hospitalized with first and second degree burns to the hands, neck and face.
An employee fell to the ground while walking across a parking lot, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was loading a coupling into an assembler when the employee's right index fingertip entered the pinch point as the machine cycled, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a roller to compact dirt along the edge of an embankment in a construction zone. As the machine was backing up, the left rear tire ran off the edge of the embankment and the machine rolled down the embankment four to five feet and came to rest on its side. The employee was hospitalized for a rib fracture and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was loading watermelons into the field truck and stated that he was feeling tired and started passing out due to heat stroke.

An employee was on a 12-foot A-frame ladder inspecting an air leak on a discharge pipe. As the employee was descending the ladder, he accidentally opened a release valve, which released a powder-like substance onto his face; this caused him to lose balance and fall from the ladder to the ground.  He suffered broken ribs.
An employee was edging a lawn and began to feel sick and ended up vomiting. He was hospitalized due to heat syncope.

A crew was applying hot asphalt to a built-up roof. They were tearing off the old roof and applying layers of asphalt and roofing materials to build the roof up at several layers. Asphalt is heated on the ground and built up through a pipe, put into a pie boy and a low-profile mop cart (400 to 500 degrees F), and applied to the roof with a mop that spreads hot asphalt at the right thickness. Because the asphalt cools quickly, the crew had to lay it out in a grid on rolls of felt. The injured employee was dry-setting some felt while others were mopping. He was walking backwards and bent over, rolling out the felt. As he walked back to the cart, someone called out to him. He then fell over the tires and back onto the hot cart, rolled to the side to try and avoid the hot asphalt, but tipped over the cart. His inside forearm and outside forearm came into contact with hot asphalt, suffering third degree burns.

An employee was walking in the field and was struck on the shoulder by a flat bed truck that was backing up. The employee fell to the ground and the truck's rear passenger tire ran over their left leg.
An employee was greasing hook rolls in the house while the machine was running. The employee's hand was then caught in the machine's belt and pulley, amputating the middle and ring fingers.
An employee slipped and fell while climbing a caged ladder. The employee struck the cage and landed on the floor, suffering fractures.
An employee was entering a production line to weld a tab on a pipe when the employee's left leg (between the ankle and knee) was caught and injured between a steel pipe and a roller breaker.
An employee slipped on gravel while throwing trash away, falling to the gravel and fracturing/dislocating the right arm.

An employee was caught between a counter weight and the crane outrigger when the outrigger slipped during crane assembly. The employee sustained approximately 4-5 fractured ribs and a fractured T12 vertebra.

An employee fell 10 feet from a bridge that was being demolished to the ground and suffered a left wrist fracture and a contusion on the left side of their body. Fall protection was not used at the time.
On May 22, 2019, an employee slipped on a wet floor and fell while walking down a hallway. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left patella.

An employee was performing maintenance on a rotator. The rotator had a catch in it so the employee was manually rotating the machine by pulling on the strongback, which was not bolted to the machine. As the machine rotated the strongback fell and struck the employee's right leg causing a fractured tibia and fibula.

An employee was standing on top of a conveyor belt that feeds the main bowl in the concrete plant trying to adjust the pulley. He was trying to loosen clamps or bolts when the belt started and the employee's right leg was caught in the belt opening resulting in amputation of the employee's right foot.
An employee tripped over a coolant container in the tool refurbishment department and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right shoulder and either a broken right hip or femur.

An employee stepped onto a wooden pallet, then onto a box to reach a box of vinyl gloves that were on a storage rack. She was approximately 12 
inches off the floor when she stepped down, tripped on plastic wrap, and fell to the floor, landing 
on her left side. She broke her left hip and required surgery.
A steel pallet fell off a conveyor that was not moving and onto an employee. The pallet crushed the employee's elbow.
An employee was securing the tarp on top of the trailer while standing on the trailer's fixed ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered a head laceration and a bruised back.

An employee and a second employee were cutting a log with a chain saw next to a storm water ditch. The employee walked to the downhill side of the log to position a 6-foot crowbar to assist with the log cutting. When he repositioned the crowbar, the log began to roll towards him and he fell into the ditch (approximately a 2-foot dry ditch). While he was in the ditch, another log rolled down. The second log crushed him and pinned him to the ground. He suffered a fractured pelvis and punctured bowel.
An employee was working on the controller drive for the down hole equipment when he received an electrical shock, resulting in burns to the right thumb and left forearm and face.
An employee was operating an offset roll machine when a steel part rotated and fell from the machine, striking the employee. The employee suffered a broken femur.

An employee was delivering pool supplies. The rope used to lift the roll-up door on the back of the truck got stuck. The employee attempted to use the powered lift gate to get the rope out by operating the lift gate and caught their left index finger between the lift gate and the truck. The finger was amputated.

An employee was operating a golf cart in which he was carrying boxed materials. When the employee made a turn, the materials shifted and the employee reached back with his left hand to stop the boxes from falling out. At the same time, the golf cart was over-steered, causing the employee to fall out and hit the ground. He broke his wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee was watching a crane operator lift a man-lift when the man-lift shifted toward the employee. He was pinned between the lift load and a piece of metal, fracturing his left arm.
An employee opened a bleed down valve and was struck by the bleed down line in the head and shoulder causing a laceration over the right eye and injury to the right shoulder.

An employee was feeding metal bar stock into a plate roller. The employee's right hand was caught between the rollers crushing the index and middle fingers. The two fingertips were surgically amputated.
An employee was working on a 120, 240, service when a hot leg touched a neutral and an arc flash occurred. The employee received a third degree burn to the right middle finger.
An employee slipped on a trailer ramp and fractured a leg.
An employee was cleaning off a roof when the employee fell 19 feet off of the roof to the ground below, suffering a fractured foot and vertebrae fractures.

On May 22, 2019, at 12:00 PM, while an employee was trying to remove a valve on a forklift truck tire, it exploded in his face causing two lacerations on the face and fractured left elbow. The tire was not attached to the forklift at the time.
An employee entered the newly remodeled fitness room, slipped on the wet concrete floor and fell breaking their pelvis.
An employee was filling bags with dry paint and had difficulty breathing. The employee experienced an allergic reaction to the paint.
An employee was helping a crew perform a dry run for placing concrete slab when his hand was caught in a wrench drive shaft that engaged, causing a right hand laceration and finger dislocation.

An employee was on top of a tractor trailer to secure dunnage and a spreader bar at the front of the trailer. He stepped backwards and fell off of the trailer, suffering a laceration to his right arm above the elbow that required hospitalization.
An employee was running a chain hoist to stack concrete lids on concrete bases. His left middle finger was caught between a lid and a base and the tip was amputated.
An employee sustained a knee injury while pulling a pallet off a truck.

An employee was operating a lift truck to move a pallet when the lift truck collided with a support pillar. During this collision, the employee's hand was trapped/crushed between the vehicle and the pillar, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working with another employee on top of an oil storage tank at a field site, dismantling piping and attachments to the tank. They had removed a piece of 4-inch vent piping and were attempting to throw the pipe to the ground. While they were throwing the pipe from the tank top, the pipe caught the harness of the injured employee, causing him to fall 15 feet to the ground. He broke his right wrist and pelvis. The employee's fall protection harness was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a laceration to the left palm and amputation of the left thumb while using a saddle saw.

An employee was loading an approximately 550-pound cargo box onto an aircraft when his finger was caught between the cargo and the aircraft's cargo bin door, resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a pallet jack when the employee backed up into another driver whose load of pallets then fell onto the employee. The employee sustained a crushed left leg and broken left femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee, using a sling and hoist, was flipping a liner plate to inspect the underside. When he flipped and laid it down, the plate began to slip across the table. The employee used his right hand to try and stop the plate from sliding and the plate pinched his fingertip against the frame of the table. He suffered an amputation of the last digit of his right middle finger.
An employee was trying to hook up a trailer when he lost his grip and the middle of his left palm was crushed.

An employee was bent over using a multi-purpose saw to cut a knee-high plank lagging board that was jammed. During the cut, the saw blade pinched, causing the blade to kick back and lacerate the employee's right shoulder.

An employee was working near a conveyor that carried totes of tank bottoms. Another employee stopped the upstream. The employee placed a tank bottom on the stopped conveyor and it fell off.  The employee tried to catch it, and the tank bottom lacerated the employee's right inner forearm.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to adjust the tarp on his dump truck when he fell from the top of the dump truck to the ground, injuring his head and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in front of the housekeeping storage room, suffering a right knee fracture.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when a board kicked back. The employee's left index finger contacted the saw blade and was amputated. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was pulling a pallet of produce out of a truck when he fell 3.5 feet off the truck's lift gate to the ground, suffering a skull fracture.
An employee fell to the ground while exiting a delivery truck, breaking six ribs and his collarbone.

An employee was directing a toter tractor operator to park a manufactured home in the second yard. He attempted to mount the moving tractor while the operator was in the process of making a turn. He fell and was struck and run over by the rear tire of the tractor, injuring the left side of his body. He suffered fractured ribs and a fractured leg.

An employee lost control of his standup lift vehicle and dismounted it. The steering tire rolled onto his left foot, de-gloving his foot from the metatarsal to the toes and resulting in the loss of three toes.
An employee was cleaning a reciprocating conveyor. When the machine started the employee's right arm was caught in the conveyor and suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was talking to another employee when his legs started to give and he fell backwards and struck his head on the floor. He sustained a skull fracture and head trauma.
An employee was cleaning/replacing blades on a potato slicer when the slicer caused a partial right thumb amputation.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck by an airborne piece of wood. He sustained head and shoulder contusions.
On May 23, 2019, an employee was operating a tube bender when her left hand was crushed in the pinch point between the clamp and a part. She was hospitalized with broken and lacerated fingers.

An employee was helping a patient onto an elevator when the employee's foot was caught in the gap between the elevator and the building floor. The employee fell to the floor and fractured the right hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a pallet transfer lift when she reached under the lift to check the alignment of the lifting tabs and the lifting tabs engaged the underside of the unit, catching her left index finger between the lifting tab and the bottom of the unit. She suffered a fingertip amputation.
The forklift an employee was operating rolled and the employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was putting a license plate onto the front of a truck when the truck ran over him and drug him into the wash bay. He was hospitalized with lacerations and a puncture to the face, lacerations to the arms, part of the ear cut off, and multiple internal injuries.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a circular saw when the saw amputated his left thumb.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam in the dust collector and caught their left ring and pinky fingers in the belt and pulley. The ring finger was amputated to the first knuckle and the pinky fingertip was broken. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was working on a conveyor system trying to replace a chain that got out of the sprocket. The employee's middle finger was caught on the sprocket and amputated.
An employee was performing her duties as a flagger when she was over by a forklift, fracturing her right leg and dislocating her pelvic bone.
An employee was washing down a neck skinner machine when his left hand contacted the cutting blades, amputating five fingers.
An employee was operating a lift inside a wind turbine. He was outside of the lift when it moved and crushed his left arm between it and a rung. His arm broke and required surgery.
On May 24, 2019, an employee was bitten by a spider. The employee was hospitalized the next day when the bite became infected.
An employee was guiding a forklift into a building when an A-frame that was holding four slabs of marble/granite broke. A slab then broke the employee's leg.

Employees were installing a coupler in a rail car. The coupler got stuck to the forks on the forklift and as they were attempting to loosen the coupler, it fell onto an employee's right foot causing an open fracture to the big toe.
On May 24, 2019, an employee was filling an oxygen tank when a valve on the tank failed and a flash fire occurred. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the face and torso.
While cleaning a liquid bulk tank truck, an employee made dermal contact with aniline and was hospitalized for methemoglobinemia.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to install low voltage wiring when he stepped back and fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, breaking his leg.
An employee was cutting a concrete pipe with a saw when the saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's bicep.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a trimmer and when he went to lower the saw box platform, the pin holding the platform became stuck. The employee hammered at the pin, and when the pin dislodged, the platform swung down and hit the employee. The employee suffered a smashed upper arm with swelling and numbness.

An employee was operating a pallet jack and went to turn his pallet jack around when the jack slid on a piece of fat causing it to slide into a pillar that was holding a plastic roll holder. His left leg was caught between the plastic roll holder and the pallet jack resulting in a compound fracture to his leg.
An employee was moving a cart of scrapple when the wheel of the cart became stuck in a floor drain, causing the cart to topple onto the employee. The employee suffered a dislocated left hip.

On May 24, 2019, at approximately 0540, an employee was adjusting the sensors on the doors of a molding machine when the doors closed, trapping the employee. The employee suffered a fractured femur and fractured ribs.
An employee was setting up a picking room when hot water spilled and caused second degree burns to the employee's neck, back, arm, and chest. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake while measuring stream flow, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning batching tank equipment when the employee disconnected a process pipe that was pressurized with hot water and chemical solution. He was sprayed with the mixture, causing first and second degree burns to approximately 11% of his torso and back.
An employee was walking on a tiled hallway leading to the kitchen when he slipped and fell on the wet or damp floor, fracturing his right femur.
A crew was cutting trees along a fence line when a branch fell and hit an employee on the back of the head.
When an employee disconnected a hose from a steam line, steam burned the employee's arms, hands, and stomach.

An employee was threading a 12" tail into the lead-out roll under the thru air dryer on a paper machine when the paper tail fell out. The employee went to manually tuck it into the nip point, and his right arm was drawn into the roller. He suffered a third degree burn to the right forearm that required hospitalization.

Two employees were positioning a roll body on the floor in the vertical position to remove the profile sleeve. Once the roll body was positioned, an employee started to remove the lower drive key retaining bolt with a hex key. He was kneeling on the floor next to the roll body with his right hand resting on the side of the sleeve and his left hand operating the hex key. When the retaining bolt came loose, he lost his balance and his right hand moved to the floor to stabilize himself. As the retaining bolt and key fell out, the sleeve slid down the roll body to the floor, striking the employee's right hand. He suffered broken bones in the backside of the hand and a minor laceration when he pulled his hand out from under the sleeve.
An employee was going into a resident's room and slipped on a wet floor, falling to the floor and breaking her right leg.
An employee dislocated an ankle when she turned resulting in a hospitalization.
An employee was disassembling a powered actuated tool that was jammed. As he attempted to put the barrel back on the device, it was actuated and the ram rod impaled his right hand.
An employee was installing duct work for an HVAC system when a 10-foot ladder slipped out from under the employee. The employee fell, breaking four ribs and lacerating a heel.
An employee was operating a deli slicer. After she was done cutting, the moving blade amputated her left middle fingertip.
Ae employee's right hand was crushed while changing the forks on the forklift resulting in amputation of two fingertips and a crushing injury to a third finger on the right hand.

An employee was patrolling the complex in a golf cart when the employee collided with a stationary trailer, suffering a laceration to the right leg, body contusions, a bruised aorta, and a blood clot in the heart.
An employee was standing on a 24-inch high platform cleaning exhaust fans when he slipped and fell to the floor, breaking his hand and some bones in his fingers and dislocating his wrist.

An employee was changing the machine to another job and filling the tank with water. Her foot was caught on the machine as she turned the valve. She lost balance and fell backwards striking her head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was performing maintenance on a rotating blower wheel when his pinky finger became entangled in a manually moving belt and pulley. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered a broken left ankle with contusions and bruising to the right ankle after being hit by a forklift.
On May 25, 2019, an employee was pulling a cart when it spun out of control and smash the employee's finger. As a result, the employee's finger was amputated.
An associate was cutting a pork hock with a powered meat saw when the hock rotated and his right middle finger contacted the blade causing a partial amputation.
On May 25, 2019, an employee was removing a 480V breaker when an arc flash occurred, resulting in burns to the upper parts of the employee's body.
An employee was moving a pallet of merchandise with a pallet jack when their arm was caught between the pallet jack and a carboard baler and fractured.
An employee's right index fingertip was amputated when it was caught in a chain and sprocket while working on a piece of equipment.
An employee closed the door of her vehicle on her finger, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was changing out a mud motor on the directional drilling rig. To make sure the motor was aligned, the employee did a bump test with a wrench. The wrench then swung and hit the employee in the hard hat, causing a small fracture to the head and slight bruising.

An employee was changing an anode mold. The employee's right hand was caught in a pinch point when a forklift raised the hot anode mold. The employee received second and third degree burns on the right hand.

An employee was ripping plywood with a circular saw and prepping it to attach sheet rock when the saw hit a knot hole and bucked, landing on the employee's left hand and amputating the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was walking through an aisle, slipped on detergent that spilled on the floor and fell. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was opening vertical coil tongs that were on the floor. As the employee began to open the device, it fell over and struck him on the right side. The employee suffered a right leg fracture and three broken ribs.
An employee was stepping out of a plane onto the platform at the top of a movable stairway, slipped and fell fracturing an ankle.

On 5/26/19, at approximately 11:30 p.m., an employee was using a chicken cutting blade to separate a leg quarter from a shackle when the employee's fingers contacted the blade, resulting in right index and middle finger amputations.
An employee was trying to dislodge a container lock on a vessel when he fell from a catwalk to the deck surface. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture to the lower right leg.
An employee was lifting a bin and suffered a muscle injury.

On 5/27/2019, a grocery clerk was moving a pallet in the produce department with a powered pallet jack (walkie). The employee's foot was caught between a steel bollard on the corner of the deli case and the pallet jack resulting in fractures that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was getting food from the walk-in refrigerator when she slipped on the wet rubber floor mat and fell backwards, hitting her head and back on a large metal keg of beer. She was hospitalized with a concussion and back strain.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. He jumped from the pallet jack and the jack struck a racking system. The employee's right big and second toes were crushed between the pallet jack and racking system.
An employee was filling anhydrous ammonia in a nurse tank when it sprayed his face, causing a chemical burn.
An employee was getting out of a truck cab after driving when he started to have back spasms, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning out a grain bin when their left leg was caught in the auger resulting in amputation of the lower leg.

Two employees were working on the Matterhorn ride. A cart came towards the injured employee and as he tried to push it out of the way he stepped into a hole on the machine. His leg twisted and fractured.

While conducting fracking operations, an employee was digging out sand from the auger to a blender when the auger released and struck the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a laceration and amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a reciprocating belt conveyor when the belt started up and the employee's arm was caught and fractured.
An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder removing a display. The employee fell from the ladder and fractured an ankle.
An employee was riding a stand-up forklift and lost control, hitting a guardrail and lacerating a leg.

On May 27, 2019, an employee was exiting her vehicle to deliver mail to a residence and stepped into a hole causing her to lose balance and fall to the ground. The employee suffered a left leg fracture.
An employee was assisting with a boat docking when his finger was caught and crushed between the rope cleat, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was climbing down a ladder after installing a sign. The ladder's leg slipped on muddy ground and the employee fell about 6 feet to the ground, suffering a broken wrist and lacerated liver.
An employee was standing on a ladder working on a garage door when the employee's left index finger was caught in the garage door opener chain and sprocket, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a testing machine and cleaning the laser. The machine has a rotating table above a hole where the laser shines through. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the edge of the hole opening and the rotating table when the machine was activated resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was landing steel decking. A bar joist where the steel was being landed gave way causing the employee to ride the decking 25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a cracked sternum and a broken rib.

An employee was operating a blister sealing machine. While the employee was holding house wrap paper in place, the paper slipped and the employee's right hand entered the sealing machine. The employee's right thumb was amputated.
An employee fell while on stairs, suffering a broken T-12 vertebra in the back.
An employee was on a work platform placing a tarp on a mulch trailer when the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, suffering a head injury.
An employee was moving a rack of product to the staging area when the employee's left hand was caught in between the racks at the staging area, resulting in an amputation to the left ring fingertip.
An employee was using a circular saw to trim a wood frame. The blade slipped and severely lacerated the employee's index finger.
An employee was walking to the time clock at the end of her shift, tripped over a mobile clothing rack and fell breaking her scapula and three ribs.

On May 28, 2019, an employee was attempting to clear a jam from a foam swab machine when the employee's right hand was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation. The machine was guarded and not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking through the yard toward the shop when he was struck from behind by a feed truck. The employee was hospitalized with seven broken ribs.
An employee became disoriented while working outdoors during the pouring of a concrete bed. He poured ice cold water on himself and cramped up. He was hospitalized due to heat exposure.
An employee was walking in the lunch room slipped on the wet floor and fell. The employee suffered a fractured right foot that required surgery.

An employee was operating a re-cutter machine and turned it off to remove a piece of trim from the mandrel. The machine was not fully stopped before he began to remove the trim and the moving parts contacted his left hand, resulting in a partial left index finger amputation.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse when he approached another forklift and his left foot was caught between the forklifts. He received a fracture and laceration on his left foot.

An employee was stepping down from a semi-tractor cab to hook up airlines and raise the trailer landing gear when the employee's foot missed one of the cab steps, causing the employee to fall 3 to 4 feet and strike the pavement. The employee injured the left elbow, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An arc flash occurred while an elbow was being removed from a transformer, and an employee suffered third-degree burns on the face, hands, and belly. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a cleaning agent when the employee ingested the agent, requiring hospitalization.
A safe door closed on an employee's right thumb and amputated it.
An employee was operating a shear and amputated the left middle finger.
An employee was found on the floor between two stacks of lumber. The employee had been stacking lumber in the frame mill upholstery department. The employee was hospitalized for cardiac arrest.

An employee was standing on a 4-foot elevated platform at a loading dock when the employee fell from the platform. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left heel and a shattered left foot. The chains on the platform were not up at the time of the incident.

A maintenance employee and a coworker were responding to a call in which an air intake hose had become disconnected from the air pump inlet. Upon arrival, the injured employee and coworker went to the electrical panel, which powered four 40-horsepower motors. The power to pump number 13-1 was turned off. The employee then went to the location of air pump 31-2 and reached around the intake to confirm there was no suction. The unit was still operating and sucked his left hand into the air intake impeller, severely injuring four fingers and resulting in the amputation of the first digit to the middle finger. The left hand index finger required sutures with no loss of bone, and the ring and little fingers had minor avulsions.
An employee attempted to slide an MC connector to splice an electrical wire and received an electrical shock.
A nurse was checking on a patient in their room, tripped on a power cord and fell. Her head struck the floor causing a hematoma.
An employee was welding two steel plates when one fell from its lifting device and struck his leg, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was walking to pick up tools on the 14th floor when he slipped on the wet floor and fell into a metal stud causing a laceration to the left hand/wrist.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when he was pinned between the jack and a rack.  He suffered a leg injury.

An employee fell to the ground when his boot lace became entangled on the fuel delivery hose fitting connected to the underground fuel tank. The employee suffered a torn right anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).
An employee was grinding stainless steel shim packs. The grinder kicked back and struck the employee's left hand causing a laceration to the index finger.
An employee was stepping over a washer and caught his foot in the loop of the rope attached to his cart. He fell and suffered a subdural hematoma.

On May 29, 2019, at 1:30 p.m., an electrical maintenance technician was using a wrench to tighten a bolt on a roof exhaust fan assembly. As the employee was tightening the bolt, it broke causing their right hand to strike against the fan assembly resulting in amputation of the ring and index fingertips. The fan's energy source was isolated and locked out at the time.

Employees were replacing a gasket on a well head that was tied to a crane. When they removed the bolts from the flange, the well head tipped over and fell onto the injured employee. Both of the employee's shoulder blades (scapula) were fractured as well as multiple vertebrae.
While cleaning the restroom with bleach, an employee suffered an asthma attack and was hospitalized.

On May 29, 2019, an employee was hospitalized after being struck in the chest by a piece of metal while troubleshooting the chip compactor after an explosion inside the machine. The employee sustained a chest burn and bruise.

An employee was burning some pallets in an incinerator. Gasoline was poured on the pallets to help start the fire. When the fire started, the employee suffered burns on both arms, elbows and hands. His neck, face and ears were also burned.
An employee was wiping paint residue off a tire and lacerated their right arm.

Three employees were in an all-terrain vehicle when the accelerator pedal stuck, causing the ATV to speed up. It rolled over as it swerved to miss a solar panel and pinned one of the three employees, breaking his femur and foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting a curver machine and amputated the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor and caught their left ring finger between the conveyor and the conveyor frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee became ill and threw up while loading bales of hay. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was helping a drill rig operator and was cleaning out a pinhole when the pin was removed, causing the drill rig bar to raise and pin the employee's finger between the pinhole and the rig bar. The employee's left index finger was completely amputated at the distal phalanx joint.
An employee was lifting a box in a meat cooler and felt pain in his back. The employee suffered a lower back fracture and was admitted to the hospital.
An employee was icing the hides. A tub fell from a forklift during transport and struck the employee fracturing a leg.
An employee's left foot was caught in the load wheel on a forklift causing a crushing injury and a laceration to the big toe.
An employee was pushing an emergency panic bar on an automatic sliding door, trying to close the door. Her left little finger was caught between the door and the frame, suffering a fracture.
An employee was pumping gas into a car. The car pulled away from the pump while the nozzle was still in the gas tank. The employee fell and suffered a hip injury that required surgery.

Two employees were coming down a ladder when one slipped and started to fall. He grabbed the other employee in an attempt to stop himself and pulled him down with him to the concrete floor. The first employee suffered bruising to the ribs, shoulder, and neck. The second employee suffered a fractured wrist and pelvis.
On May 29, 2019, at 6:09 p.m., an employee was operating a manual metal lathe when his gloved, right hand was caught by the rotating equipment causing partial amputations to four fingers.
At about 7:00 a.m. on May 29, 2019, an employee was pulling two pots apart when he had a severe allergic reaction to shellfish. Suffering breathing difficulty, he was hospitalized.
An employee was unhooking a float and crushed their right hand. The employee sustained an open fracture of the distal phalanx of one finger and a laceration to the middle finger.
A press cycled and the die came down on an employee's left hand, amputating the little, ring, and middle fingers. The machine was energized and not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine and was shocked causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture their left arm and hip.
An employee was tightening down the cables on the railcars. As he was putting tension on the cable it pulled the slack and knocked him to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was helping to move floor tiles when the tiles struck and fractured the employee's foot.
An employee was descending a ladder, lost his balance and fell 7 feet. The employee sustained a broken orbital bone and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was using a grinder to sharpen a pick axe when his finger struck the rotating grinder wheel, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was working on a package delivery truck inside the shop when he started to feel dizzy and lightheaded and then fell to the ground. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee's stool collapsed, and its leg punctured the employee's leg.
An employee was conducting abrasive blasting on a 2-inch wide support for a garden chair. The hose dropped and the blasting material struck the back of his right leg.
A maintenance employee was working on a leaking pump and amputated the left ring finger.

An employee was exercising and riding a horse for guest rides when a deer jumped out from behind garbage cans. The horse reacted to the deer, moving quickly or bucking. The employee was thrown to the ground, where the horse may have stepped on the employee. The employee suffered a right calf injury with swelling.
An employee was performing electrical rewiring operations and received an electric shock that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing at her work station doing spray bottle quality control when she turned around and fell fracturing her right leg.
While cleaning a food processing machine, an employee suffered a severe laceration to the left ring finger.
An employee was walking down a flight  of stairs when she slipped and fell to the hard floor, injuring her knees and striking her head. She suffered a possible concussion and was hospitalized.

On May 29, 2019, a forklift was picking up a wooden pallet with parts on it off of a flat bed trailer. The pallet broke and the parts fell off the skid and bounced off the trailer, striking an employee that was walking by on the left knee. The employee was hospitalized for a knee fracture and lacerations.
An employee was taking a box off the conveyor belt. The employee turned and felt pain in the ankle. The employee then tripped and fell.
A sharp aluminum piece on a die punctured an employee's left thumb. The wound became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a manual cutting machine and suffered a partial amputation to his left pinky finger while adjusting the die for a 10x10x16 piece of metal.
An employee was operating a grommet machine and suffered an amputation to their right index finger after their hand was caught in the machine.
On May 29, 2019, at approximately 9:32 a.m. an employee was returning from a water break when he tripped and fell to the concrete sidewalk resulting in hospitalization for a fractured left hip.

An employee was grinding a steel part on a stand-up grinder. While he was putting the part into the grinder and turning it, the wheel grabbed the part and then his gloved hand. His right thumb was ground down to the first knuckle.

An employee was helping a customer unload palletized merchandise from the back of a trailer using a pallet jack. The employee's foot slipped off the ICC bumper while the employee's hand was on the strap to the overhead door; the door came down as the employee's body reached ground level, slamming on top of her hand. She suffered finger injuries that required pins and bolts to be installed.
An employee was using a reaming/beveling machine when his right index finger was caught in the clamp of the machine. The fingertip was amputated and was reattached at the emergency room.
On May 30, 2019, an employee was using a battery-operated pipe shear to cut PVC pipe and suffered a partial amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was cutting aluminum with a miter saw when their left index finger was pinched by the plate of the miter saw. The finger was medically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was using a miter saw when the blade cut the employee's left index finger, resulting in a medical finger amputation.

An employee was operating a conduit-fitting pull test machine when he noticed the cable was not fully seated in the jaws. He pushed down the cable into the jaws. When the cable clicked into position, the machine finished the cycle with his fingertip still inside it, resulting in an amputation. The machine was guarded and had a light curtain on at the time of the incident.
An employee became dizzy from heat stress while driving a mail vehicle.
An employee was opening a trailer door when the door hit the employee's head, cutting it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a pry bar to loosen a chipper wheel on a piece of machinery when wet saw dust caused the chipper wheel to lock up. When the employee loosened the wheel, his position and force caused him to fall backwards. His foot was under the frame of the machine at the time and because of his momentum and angle, he fractured his right femur.
An employee was moving a water tank. Their finger was in a hole in the handle when the water tank struck the barrier protecting the electrical panels and removed the fingertip.
An employee was riding on the forks of a front loader and fell off. The employee was run over and sustained cracked ribs.
An employee was walking around the plant doing inventory when a 200-pound load lift bar that was leaning against a wall fell onto his right calf, requiring several stitches.
An employee was lifting bags of salt for a water softener when he suffered a back injury. He was hospitalized.
An agent was operating an ATV during field operations when it rolled over. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee fell from his truck and landed on the floor, breaking his arm, his shoulder, several ribs, and his tailbone.
An employee fell out of a chair and injured their hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a screw on an air puncher machine. The machine activated and pinched the tip of his left index finger, amputating it.

An employee was removing a plywood blockout from inside a concrete box culvert segment. As the employee was sitting on the lip of the culvert and trying to grab a ladder, he fell off the culvert onto steel plate decking 3-4 below. He suffered a broken left tibia and was hospitalized.

After placing empty cardboard into the baler, an employee grabbed the baler gate handle with his right hand and began to pull the gate down to close it. While he was adjusting cardboard with his left hand, the gate closed on his hand. The left index finger was partially amputated without bone loss, and the left middle and ring fingers were fractured.
An employee was in a truck loading a wheelbarrow when the employee slipped and fell off the truck to the ground, suffering a head contusion.

An employee was investigating a leak on a mobile nursery tank that was filled with anhydrous ammonia when the anhydrous ammonia released contacted the employee. The employee experienced temporary vision loss and respiratory issues.
While cleaning carpet in an office, an employee fell onto their left hip. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

Two employees were working from an aerial lift about 10 feet off the ground. One employee was taking off a bracket to remove an overhead wood platform. The platform fell and pinned the other employee's pinky finger against the lift's rail resulting in the amputation of the employee's pinky finger.
An employee was unloading food from a truck when the employee fell between the truck and the dock to the floor, suffering contusions to the thigh and elbow.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder in the waffle room cleaning the wall. The employee was on the third rung of the ladder and fell to the floor breaking his pelvis.
An employee tripped over forklift forks and fell to the pavement, suffering a concussion with bleeding from the nose and mouth.
An employee was using a handheld grinding tool when sparks ignited fuel vapors. The employee received burns to the legs, back, and arms.
An employee was working on a ladder when the ladder's foot shifted on loose soil, causing the employee to fall 8 feet off the ladder. He fractured and dislocated his left ankle, requiring surgery.

An employee was picking up a roll of paper from the corrugator with a clamp truck to take it to the roll room. The roll was elevated approximately 3 feet. The employee noticed that the outer wrap around the roll was loose. She got off the clamp truck to tape the loose paper while the roll was still elevated. She taped one edge of the roll and then walked in front of the roll to tape the other edge. As she was bent down in a crouching position to grab the loose paper, the roll came out of the clamp and fell on top of and then rolled over her. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the left ankle, pelvis, tibia, rib cage and bruising.
An employee was descending a loader and fell fracturing his hip.
Four employees were lowering a boat into the water at a dock. An employee's left middle finger was caught in a gear resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was handling a tag line for a unit assembly when the employee fell approximately 5 feet and suffered a back injury.
An employee lost his balance and fell 8 feet from a residential flat roof to the grass/ground below, suffering a compound fracture of the tibia and a fractured tailbone.

Two employees were trying to move a 62-foot-long, 2,000-pound part over on a conveyor table. On the third attempt, the part fell off the conveyor and landed on one employee's left foot. The employee suffered two broken toes and was hospitalized; the little toe was medically amputated.
An employee tripped and fell to the sidewalk while turning, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was clearing a jam on a juice filling machine when his left middle finger was caught on the conveying chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee unlocked part of a two-part door. A metal lip was left at the bottom of the door. The employee tripped over the lip when walking through the open door frame. She fell and struck her left leg, fracturing the lower leg.

An employee had climbed to the top of a ladder to stock tools. The wheels on the bottom of the ladder were not locked and another employee began to move the ladder to another location. The employee on top of the ladder lost balance and fell to the floor, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was delivering mail when a dog attacked the employee. The employee fell and hit their head, suffering a broken hip and head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip after tripping over merchandise in an upstairs office and falling to the floor.
An employee was driving a go-cart on location when the employee showed signs of dehydration, confusion, and vomiting, requiring hospitalization for possible heat stress.
An employee was taping empty tubes on a bar when the bar started to rotate grabbing the tape and the employee's left arm. The employee suffered a broken left wrist.
A 2,640-pound tote was being unloaded from a delivery truck when it rolled onto an employee's left leg, breaking it.

An employee was forming a part on a brake press machine when the employee's finger was pinched between the part and the die, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation and a broken right index finger.

On May 31, 2019, an employee was filling a propane gas cylinder used for forklifts when pressure from the nozzle came off of the propane cylinder and knocked him to the ground. He sustained a fracture to his right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing through the entrance door when he reached back to keep it from slamming shut. His right ring finger was then caught between the door hinge. When he felt the door closing on his finger, he pulled his hand away. The fingernail to come out and amputate his fingertip.

An employee was cutting chicken when he reached over a box and his plastic apron became caught on something. He was attempting to pull on his apron when his arm to flew out and struck a saw blade, resulting in an arterial laceration to the left forearm.

An employee was operating a die cutting machine when his left hand was caught between the clamshell platen and a stationary die. All four fingers (except thumb) on the left hand were crushed resulting in amputation.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a filler machine when her right hand was pulled into the machine and pinched between the mandrel, resulting in lacerations and broken bones to the right hand.
An employee was locating a dog pin in the reel when their finger was caught between the dog pin and wire reel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was connecting a water pump on a truck when the truck driver pulled forward, running over and fracturing the employee's right foot.

On May 30, 2019, at approximately 7:40 p.m., an employee was performing set-up tasks on a material molder when the employee's right hand contacted an unguarded rotating cutter head.  The injury resulted in an amputation to the right index finger at the second joint, and a partial amputation to the right middle fingertip.

An employee was cleaning an elevator shaft pit prior to installation of elevator doors. The employee began descending a step ladder into the elevator shaft pit when the employee fell from the ladder onto a steel pipe at the bottom of the pit, fracturing the right femur. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery. The step ladder legs were not set and locked at the time of the incident.
An employee was nailing siding on a building with a nail gun in a lift. The gun shot him in the lower chest and upper stomach.
An employee was filling concrete molds when a cement auger amputated the index and middle fingers from one of his hands. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was helping care for youths when one of them struck her seven or eight times from behind, in the head, with the metal gooseneck of a faucet. She was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an electric cart in reverse down an incline. While coming down the incline at an increased speed, he turned the wheel and was thrown from the cart onto a concrete driveway, injuring his head.

An employee was catching veneer material off a moving table. When the table moved upwards and then down, the employee's pinky fingertip was caught under the tabletop, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was crimping wire terminals using a crimping machine. As she was fixing a jam, the machine crushed a finger on her left hand, causing the amputation of the tip. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was lifting a dry goods box to unload it from a semi trailer. The employee was facing a 2 in. x 4 in. x 4 ft. wooden brace, lodged across the width of the trailer. The brace moved and struck the employee in the face, causing a cervical contusion, a disc herniation with radiculopathy, cervical stenosis, and facial lacerations.

On May 31, 2019, an employee was clearing a jammed bag from the bagging machine sealer when his right middle and ring fingers were caught between the transfer belt and the bagging machine's shaft. He sustained a laceration to both his right middle and ring fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was serving as the spotter while iron was being offloaded from a loader. The iron struck him, causing fractures to the face and jaw.

An employee was working on a scaffold 3 feet off the ground when the employee lost footing and slipped, causing the employee's arm to come down onto the frame of the scaffold. The underside of the employee's arm caught the scaffold pin, causing a 3- to 4-inch laceration that required sutures and hospitalization.
An employee was mowing a lawn when the mower amputated his ring finger.
While terminating some cables in an electrical cabinet, an employee suffered second- and third-degree burns from an arc flash.
An employee was adjusting a slow-flow valve while resting his free hand on the H block. As he was tuning the valve, his finger was caught and crushed by the H block.

An employee was changing a tire on a spreader at a farm. The employee removed the right, rear tire and was rolling it to the front of the spreader. The tire kicked out and as the employee tried to get away from the tire, he slipped on loose gravel and fell to his knees. The tire landed across his back and pinned him to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for three fractured lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was attempting to load a tractor into the bed of a pickup truck when the tractor flipped and landed on top of him. He was hospitalized with two fractured vertebrae in the back.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack and heading to the north cooler door. When the employee made it to the north cooler, another pallet jack operator was leaving the cooler. The employee backed out to allow the other pallet jack operator to exit the cooler. After the other pallet operator exited, the employee turned the handle on his pallet jack and the machine went backwards. The pallet jack then hit the cooler guard and the employee's lower left leg was caught between the jack and guard, resulting in a broken lower left leg.
A temporary employee was running a spot welding machine when it was activated via the foot pedal. The machine then cut his right index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was manually trying to slide the forks over on a forklift. A finger on his left hand was caught between the fork and the forklift's carriage (a piece that hung down). The fingertip was amputated.
An employee driving his scheduled route in a semi-truck was shot in the left shoulder, in a random act of violence, and was hospitalized.

At approximately 12:55 a.m., an employee was helping another employee load steel beams onto a tractor trailer. He picked up a beam with an overhead crane using the crane's remote control box.  After attempting to maneuver the beam into an open space on the trailer, he determined the beam would not fit because it was too wide. He placed the beam on top of a smaller pile of beams. During this process, the chain holding the load caught the flange of an adjacent beam, tipping both beams and a tube. One of the beams landed on him. He was hospitalized with a fracture to his right ankle, a laceration on his right leg, and a sprain to his left ankle.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when a nearby belt and pulley system caught his left hand, causing the amputation of the little finger.
An employee was working with archived files in a large outside metal container in the heat and suffered dehydration, an acute kidney injury, and muscle breakdown.
An employee was working at an aluminum press. As he was inserting the clean-out ring, the press closed on his left hand, amputating four fingers.
Two employees were in a scissor lift removing a brick wall using a cutoff saw. The saw bucked and lacerated the left forearm of the second employee.

An employee was working at a new home construction site on a ladder, lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor below. The employee fractured the right wrist and had pain in the lower back and hip.
An employee was removing dough caught in the stamping station of a roll-making machine. The machine caught his right hand, amputating the little finger.
An employee was stepping off the bottom rung of a ladder when he fell to the floor and fractured his right hip.

An employee was operating a standup counter-balanced forklift when he lost control and was about to hit a vendor's vehicle parked inside the warehouse. His foot stuck out before impact and became stuck between the forklift and the vehicle. He suffered a broken and lacerated big toe and a punctured calf.
An employee was stabbed multiple times with a knife while working at a client's home.
An employee was replacing a light on a trailer using an extension ladder. The employee fell off the ladder to the ground about 4 feet below, breaking his right tibia and fibula.
An employee had just finished installing knives on a planer. When power was connected and the machine was started, a knife broke and part of it flew into the employee's left forearm and head.
An employee fell while working in a concession stand and was injured.
An employee was caught in between a vehicle and tool boxes when a van came off the lift.
An employee was operating a press brake and partially amputated the left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was on a 10-foot ladder retrieving product from a shelf, when he fell and struck his head on the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured skull and an intracranial hemorrhage.

An employee was up a tower in a wind turbine. A metal plate (a blade access cover) moved, causing the employee to fall about 7-10 feet into the inside of a blade. The employee suffered internal abdominal injuries.

An employee had just straightened a crooked stack of pans going into a pan unstacker. The pan eye activated the machine, causing it to cycle. The employee's left index finger was caught in the machine, causing a degloving injury and an amputation injury.
An employee working in a deli tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.

On June 2, 2019, at approximately 3:00 a.m. an employee was working on the line in the converting department. The employee's duties were to flip packs of towels as they exited the bundler and before they entered the case lift. The employee flipped a pack and noticed it did not flip completely over. As the employee tried to retrieve the pack, his left arm slipped and his left hand was caught in the conveyor rollers. The employee was hospitalized with hand and arm injuries.
An employee was securing empty barges when his right middle finger was caught between a mule rope and a barge cleat. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was adjusting a screw machine when the 18-pound lid on the back of the machine fell on his left ring ringer. The tip was amputated.
An employee was involved in a truck accident on a private road and was hospitalized.
An employee was involved in a motor vehicle accident at an intersection at the port. The employee was knocked unconscious and suffered broken bones.
An employee amputated a fingertip while using a hydraulic cylinder and wrench to remove a nut from a blow out preventer.
On June 2, 2019, an employee was aligning watermelons on a conveyor belt when a forklift pushed a flat plastic pallet against his feet. He suffered an injury to the right ankle and was hospitalized.

Two employees were using a scissor grab to lift a graphite spacer. As they were standing the spacer upright, the grab slipped off, fully extended, and spun, striking one of the employees on the left hand. The tip of the employee's little finger was amputated.

An employee was checking a conveyor through an inspection port. The employee's left hand was caught in the inspection port and lacerated, on the top and bottom, by the paddles on the auger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was riding a horse while herding/checking cattle when the gate to the pen contacted the horse she was riding. The horse was startled and the rider was bucked off resulting in a fractured right clavicle, right scapula and ribs on the right side.
An associate fell off a ladder while working in the produce cooler. The employee fell onto a knee and sustained a knee injury that requires surgery.
An employee was cleaning off a saw table at the end of the day and amputated the right pinky fingertip.
An employee tripped while climbing stairs, and his hand was caught in the pinch point of a conveyor belt. He suffered an amputation injury to a finger.
An employee was removing a piece of wood from the off end of a wood dryer. The employee's right hand was caught in the dryer's chain and sprocket; four fingertips were amputated.
An employee was cutting a steel beam on the 11th floor. As the employee was relocating the steel beam, it slipped and amputated a portion of his right index finger.

An employee was in a stairwell, going downstairs, when a loose stair nose caused her to fall forward down the stairs. She suffered a broken jaw (in three places); a broken tooth; and bruising to both thighs, her chest, and her left shin.
One employee struck another during a physical altercation, breaking the second employee's jaw. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reeling in a winch cable on a garbage truck. The employee's finger was caught between the cable and the winch drum, and the tip was amputated.
An employee's foot was caught between a metal storage rack and a 6-inch beam that a forklift was pushing. The employee's left ankle was broken.

An employee was on fire watch and fell 18 feet from an open catwalk to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured scapula and a broken rib on the left side, a head laceration and heavy bruising on the right arm.

An employee was using two-wheel hand carts to move merchandise. The hand cart trays separated and the dolly was knocked out from under the stack. The stack came back toward the employee causing him to lose balance and fall off the dock onto the ground fracturing an elbow.
An employee fell while climbing down from a step on a tractor catwalk. The employee's head struck the concrete floor.
An employee slipped and fell on wet grass and struck his head on the sidewalk. He was hospitalized for a concussion.
On June 3, 2019, an employee experienced heat stress/dehydration and was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a thermoformer machine. The machine started up while his hand was near the belt and pulley causing a partial amputation of his thumb.
An employee was clearing a clump of dough from a pasta machine when the machine's knife amputated the tip of his finger. The machine was guarded at the time.
A roofer felt dizzy and nauseous. He was hospitalized for heat related injuries.

An employee fell from the back of a garbage truck to the ground near the road. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured skull and a back strain. The employee also had a seizure and/or a brain bleed.
A pipeline inspector was walking up a hill when he started having pain in his chest and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized for a potential heart issue.
An employee was releasing the tie-down strap and fell from his truck. He sustained a broken hip, bruised ribs and a right shoulder injury.
An employee was unjamming a paper bagging machine and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.

An employee was removing and stacking pieces of lumber from a saw when his shirt became wrapped around a shaft on the outfeed resulting in a laceration to his left shoulder that required hospitalization.
An employee was feeding steel into the die of a press. The tip of the employee's left pointer finger was amputated.

An employee was hooking a trailer to a tractor. The truck began rolling backwards, and the employee's upper left arm was pinned and broken between a container parked next to the truck and the open driver-side door.
An employee was closing an air hole on a charcoal kiln with insulation when the kiln surged and fire came out of the hole. The employee sustained third degree burns.
An employee was using a powered weed trimmer at a customer site and passed out. He was admitted to the hospital for heat exhaustion.
An employee stepped down from an uneven surface and fractured their right tibia and fibula.

A welder was placing a long piece of metal (18 ft. x 1 ft. x 2 in.) on a table in preparation for welding when the metal slipped from his hand and smashed his left thumb between the piece of metal and the table. The employee was hospitalized for a possible left thumb tip amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum with a chop saw, which caused an amputation to his left index finger.

An employee was sanding plates on a sander when his left hand was caught between the material and the sander wheel as it was rotating. The employee received stitches on the ring and index fingers and amputated the middle finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a rewinder machine and partially amputated the right index finger (distal phalanx).

An employee was preparing to melt granulated sugar with hot water to make liquid invert sucrose. The employee turned on the drum pump and walked over to the measuring tank to monitor filling. While the employee's back was facing the pump, the pump discharge hose came undone and a discharge of hydrochloric acid (HCl) struck the employee's back causing first and second degree chemical burns.
An employee tripped and fell in the store and broke a knee.

At about 10:30 a.m. on June 3, 2019, an employee was on an oil rig that was being rigged down. As the rig was reaching half mast, the employee was on the rear of the rig, placing the weight bucket onto the storage hook. As he dismounted the rig, he lost his footing and his right hand was caught in a pinch point between the top and bottom sections of the derrick mast as it came down. He suffered injuries, including an amputation injury, to the index, middle, and ring fingers.
At about 10:30 p.m., an employee was collecting mail outdoors when he tripped and fell onto a rock, breaking his jaw. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was separating a cow from a gate. The cow struck the gate which in turn struck the employee in the left forearm causing a forearm fracture that required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell on their way into work, suffering a broken hip.
A server was carrying a bowl of cornbread and fell resulting in a fracture of the distal humerus and hospitalization.
Employee received an electrical shock while pulling cable from a customer's attic.

On June 3, 2019, at approximately 12:00 PM, a temporary employee was placing reams of paper onto a conveyor when her glove was caught pulling her left hand into an area where two conveyors converge. The employee's left ring and pinky fingers were injured and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a gas meter post to a truck, tripped and fell. The post landed onto his left hand and fractured three fingers.
An employee was changing out a hydraulic cylinder when his finger was pinched between the cylinder and the base, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

On June 4, 2019, an employee was working on a residential garbage route. As he was cycling the hopper's blade to make room for more garbage, a chemical splashed onto his upper limbs and abdomen, causing second-degree burns. He was hospitalized.
A Ramco employee was directing a dump truck into position at a worksite when a pickup truck backed over the employee breaking both legs.
An employee operating a forklift collided with another employee operating a pallet jack. The pallet jack operator suffered fractured toes on the left foot.
Two employees were carrying a pipe when a connection clamp released and closed on a finger on one employee's right hand. The finger was amputated at the third phalanx.
An employee was opening a large dumpster lid when the lid fell and the employee fell down to the ground hitting her head on the concrete. She sustained a concussion and a hematoma to the head.

On June 4, 2019, a crew was installing fiber across a railroad crossing. A train came through and snagged the fiber. The fiber caught an employee in the neck area and the employee was thrown to the ground. The employee sustained cuts to the head and neck and was hospitalized.

On 6/04/2019, an employee was performing a sanitation detail on a conveyor belt. His arm was caught in the roller and twisted resulting in a fractured forearm that required surgery and hospitalization.
Wire wrapped around a bulldozer operator's ankle, breaking it.
An employee was working outside at a vegetable farm, pulling plastic off vegetables. The employee lost consciousness due to heat-related illness.
On 6/04/2019, an employee was cleaning debris off the roof of a residential property and fell off the roof. He was hospitalized for injuries to his head and left arm.
An employee's feet were crushed by a mud bin.
A lineman was working in an aerial lift when a leaking, broken hydraulic line injected fluid into his hand. He was hospitalized.

On June 4, 2019, an employee was using an ATV to spray herbicide along the grass beside a highway. The vehicle got stuck in a rut and was being pulled out by another ATV when it rolled over, ejecting her to the ground. She suffered a fracture to the lower left leg and was hospitalized.
While walking to her work vehicle an employee tripped and fell on the concrete fracturing her right hip.

An employee was moving a loaded roll cart from the room to the staging area. He was pulling the cart by the handle using an underhand grip and struck a support beam crushing his right thumb between the beam and handle.

An employee was assessing the condition of a boat, an auction item. While exiting the boat, the employee fell 3-4 feet to the floor, suffering injuries including a broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the tension on the conveyor belt and caught their index finger between the belt and the roller resulting in a laceration.
An employee was finishing a vehicle when he lost consciousness due to dehydration, causing him to fall and hit his head.

On June 10, 2019, an employee was exiting a railcar after loading a vehicle on the top deck when the employee slipped on the ladder rung and fell to the ground. The employee experienced fractured ankles and fibulas and a broken right foot.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when it slipped out of place and fell, taking the employee with it. He broke his left leg.
An employee retrieved a box of film from a shelf and was climbing down a step stool when the employee missed a step and broke the right ankle.

An employee was adjusting the flywheel on a partial revolution power press. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the flywheel rod and a piece of metal, causing the amputation of the last digit.
An employee fell while working at the rear of a delivery truck. The employee's head struck the asphalt ground, causing a head injury; the employee was hospitalized.
On June 10, 2019, an employee was using a hammer to nail a pallet board when a piece of the nail broke off and hit the employee's eye, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was moving a part off a welding fixture using a hoist. The magnet released, dropping the part on the employee's left hand. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift to remove shrink rolls when a shrink roll fell off the dashboard. He tried to move it with his left foot and his left ankle was pinned between the forklift and a mobile lifting machine.
An employee was adjusting a portable temperature probe used to take temperatures on blanks when the blanks closed on the employee's finger, amputating the right index fingertip.
An employee was transporting a patient on a gurney and walking backwards up a slight incline when the employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was driving a golf cart in the lot area. The employee was returning inside the building because it started raining. There was an open metal bed trailer parked in the lot with the tongue hitch sticking out. The employee did not see the trailer's tongue hitch and hit it with the golf cart. The plastic windshield of the golf cart hit first and came off. Then the employee hit the tongue hitch with his face. The employee suffered lacerations to the face and a fractured left eye socket and a fractured lower jaw.
An employee fell on a wet floor while walking through a shop. She suffered a broken left femur.
While unloading a truck, an employee saw a pallet falling over and tried to stop it. The pallet fell on the employee's left thigh, causing a contusion.

An employee was using a die changeover table with a snake chain conveyor. The e employee activated the snake chain via remote and it moved quickly, causing the employee's right index finger to be pinched between the pin and edge of the die and amputated.

An employee was near a scrap pile. An excavator was pulling metal from the pile when a piece of railing got caught on some scrap, broke free, and went flying. It struck the employee's left calf and lacerated it. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 11, 2019, an employee was using a powered press to heat-press leather sheets together. The machine crushed the employee's left ring finger as it closed. The finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was loading furniture in a car when a bee stung him, causing an allergic reaction. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a bit on a millwork machine. A wrench fell into the machine while it was spinning, contacting the employee's little and ring fingers and causing amputations to both.
An employee's left hand was caught between an elevator rail and the floor while he was moving the rail using a channel dolly. The middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
On June 11, 2019, an employee was pulling a pallet off a truck when it fell on him, dislocating his shoulder and breaking his foot.
An employee was using an A-frame ladder to access a backyard when the employee fell to the ground, suffering fractured vertebrae.
An employee was working from a 3-foot step ladder while cleaning a machine when the employee fell from the ladder, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was walking into the store when she tripped on a rippled rug at the entrance and fell to the floor, fracturing her right shoulder.
An employee was on top of a stacker attempting to adjust some bundles. The bundles became unstable and fell on the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis and broken ribs.
An employee was raking cans into a pit for recycling. While the employee was in the pit, his arm was caught in the conveyor, suffering an amputation at or near the elbow.

An employee was visiting a site prior to it becoming fully operational for shipping. He exited the warehouse and was walking towards the parking lot when he fell approximately 5 feet off the dock and into the loading pit. The loading dock was open at the time of the incident.
An employee was hoisting a 5,000-pound steady rest with a 50-ton overhead shop crane. The load fell on his left leg, crushing it from the knee down. The leg was medically amputated.

An employee was attending firearm training at a shooting range. A second employee had a live round in his rifle that discharged while he was doing a gun function test. The first employee was shot in the right foot.

An employee was "rodding" a boiler (unclogging a plug of smelt) when the plug let loose. The smelt, which was under pressure, then sprayed the employee. The employee was severely burned by molten smelt on the face, neck, shoulder, and leg, requiring hospitalization.
