An employee fell down a flight of stairs, striking a planter and suffering head contusions and lacerations.

An employee was moving an extension ladder from a house in order to load it back onto a truck. The ladder either made contact with an electric line or the electricity arced to the ladder and electrocuted the employee.
An employee was operating a chop saw to cut dunnage when the employee's right pinky finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was washing the inside of a tanker with a high-pressure hose when he lost control of the hose and jumped off the top of the trailer. He suffered a shattered left foot.

An employee was completing an inventory when the entire second floor where she was working collapsed beneath her. She fell and landed on construction material, fracturing her neck and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing rope from a pipe when the employee's right hand was caught and crushed between the pipe and a tire, requiring hospitalization.

On June 11, 2019, an employee was climbing an extension ladder. The ladder shifted when he was on the third or fourth rung, forcing him to jump; he broke his left leg upon landing on the ground. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was trying to assist another employee in getting a downed animal to stand up. When the downed animal was able to stand, it charged one of the employees from behind. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.

An employee was loading packages inside a trailer. The employee was standing between the boxes and the edge of the conveyor when the conveyor moved forward and pinned the employee against the boxes. The employee suffered a punctured lung.
An employee felt dizzy and had cramps while conducting landscaping operations. He rested to the end of the shift and was later hospitalized for heat illness.
An employee was closing a door to a paint booth. The employee's left thumb was caught between the door and the jamb, sustaining a partial amputation to the tip.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. It backed into a parked forklift and the employee suffered lacerations to the thigh. The employee was hospitalized.

On June 11, 2019, an employee was attempting to reach the edge of a metal roof when he slipped and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. He sustained a fracture to his right wrist, multiple facial fractures (including his mandible), and a concussion. He was hospitalized. The employee's lanyard was unhooked at the time of the incident.
An employee was pinned between an outrigger and a truck, suffering a fracture of a lower-back vertebra and abdominal trauma.
An employee was helping to clear a pallet jam in a pallet exchange machine when the pallet machine released and pinched his left middle fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting a wooden 2x4 using a hand-held circular saw and amputated his left thumb.
An employee was trying to retrieve stuck candy from a wrapping machine when the lid came down on the tip of her left ring finger, amputating it.
A load of material suspended from a forklift became unstable and fell, breaking an employee's leg.

An employee was operating an asphalt saturator when a break in paper occurred. The employee was removing the asphalt-saturated paper from the saturator box when a roller caught the employee's gloved left hand and pinned it against the gate, crushing and burning it. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was removing a roller from a conveyor belt. The roller fell, smashing his left little finger against the floor and amputating the tip.
An employee was walking across a bulk dock when she was struck by the forks of a passing forklift. She broke her left ankle and foot.
A temporary employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the forklift struck a rack. The employee suffered a left foot injury.
An employee was lifting a walkway grating over a cross joint when the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the grating and the cross joint, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a portable grinder. Its wheel lacerated the employee's forearm, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a hot tar burn on his hand from a hot tar kettle splash.
An employee was on a ladder when it slipped on the smooth floor, causing the employee to fall. He suffered a laceration to the left knee, fractured left-side ribs, and a punctured left lung.
An employee was using a saw to cut a sample ceramic tile piece when the saw blade cut her right pinky finger, resulting in amputation of the finger.
A U.S. Postal Service employee suffered heat-related dizziness, shortness of breath, and cramps while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing casings on a clipper machine when the employee's left hand entered the machine's point of operation, resulting in an amputation of the left pinky finger and laceration of the left ring finger.
An employee was offloading bags when multiple bags fell and struck the employee's left knee, resulting in a possible infection to the knee joint.

An employee was in a loader bucket 10 to 13 feet high working on a crane when he fell and landed on the ground, suffering fractures to the ribs, kneecap, and toe. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was exiting the break room as another employee was entering. The door or the other employee bumped into the injured employee, resulting in her falling to the floor. She was hospitalized with a right hip fracture, requiring surgery.
An employee was inside a trench putting lube on a laid pipe when an iron pipe came loose from a backhoe and struck him, injuring his left side and left lung.
An employee received an electric shock to the head and face while testing a battery bank, suffering head and facial electrical burns.
An employee was cleaning a press. The employee's right ring fingertip was caught and amputated in a pinch point.

An employee was working in an airplane's aft cargo section. A tug struck the belt loader and pushed it into the belly of the aircraft, where it scraped the employee's feet (causing swelling) and broke the employee's legs above the ankles.
On June 12, 2019, an employee delivering mail for approximately 4 to 5 hours experienced heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was addressing a break in the paper product on a production line. The employee removed some asphalt-saturated paper from the saturator box. As the employee attempted to remove additional paper from the machinery, the employee's gloved left hand became caught and crushed on a roller. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down from a trailer truck when he fell to the ground, breaking his left leg and right wrist.

An employee was loading and unloading trailers on a dock when he was involved in an altercation with a coworker. The coworker hit him on the left side of his face with a dock hook. He was knocked unconscious and hit his head on concrete when he fell, suffering facial fractures and a concussion.

An employee was banding a bundle of cut flat steel bars with an overhead crane when the bundle slipped out of the hoist chains and fell onto the employee's right middle finger, crushing and breaking it.
An employee fell over a pallet in a stock room, landing on the floor face first. The employee suffered a head injury that required stitches, as well as a broken kneecap.
An employee was turning to climb down a fixed ladder when he lost his balance and fell approximately 15 feet to the floor, breaking three vertebrae and his left elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a pallet jack when he entered a lane of traffic and was struck by a pallet on a forklift. He suffered a dislocated ankle, fractured fibula, and fractured tibia.
An employee was aligning a bushing on a tubular machine. The housing moved, pinching the employee's left index finger against the bushing. The tip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to reposition a board on a stacker unscrambler when the unscrambler moved and caused another board to fall on the employee's hand. The employee's hand was caught between the two boards. The employee sustained a crushing injuring to the right middle finger, resulting in amputation. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
On June 12, 2019, an employee was adjusting the air line on the back of a truck. The employee slipped and fell, suffering a head injury and a lost tooth.
An employee was using a 9" grinder on a skid when the grinder slipped off the skid and slashed the inside of the employee's left upper leg. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was working from a ladder above a suspended ceiling. The employee fell through the ceiling to the concrete floor and suffered a broken clavicle and multiple broken vertebrae.

On June 12, 2019, at approximately 10:06 a.m., an employee was working near the back of a concrete truck when the bolts that hold the tag axle in place broke, causing the tag axle to fall and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken clavicle, broken foot, broken ribs, and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was cutting a stainless steel line with a chop saw. Residual radiation-curing resin inside the line sprayed out onto his chest, stomach, and thighs, causing second-degree burns.

An employee was on a man basket near the wellhead on an oil and gas rig. The employee was screwing an entry guide onto a blowout preventer while a crane was removing it from the wellhead. The lubricator/blowout preventer moved and caught his right middle and ring fingers between the entry guide and the cap on the frac head. The middle finger was amputated and the ring finger required surgical treatment.
An employee fell from an order picker, suffered a broken wrist, and was hospitalized.
An ironworker was using a magnetic drill to drill a steel beam. The drill bit caught his left glove and amputated his left thumb.

An employee was helping to drain a knockout pot containing 65% nitric acid. The drain hose became loose and the employee was sprayed in the face. The employee received burns to the face and eyes, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was evaluating a firearm that a customer brought in to sell when the firearm discharged and shot the employee's hand.
An employee tripped over a jack, fell to the floor, and sustained a fractured left wrist that required surgery.
An employee's left index finger was punctured and cauterized by a tungsten rod. The employee hospitalized for surgery.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while delivering mail and was hospitalized.
An employee was handing a piece of cardboard to a co-worker when she lost her balance and fell backwards, hitting her head on the ground.
An employee was assaulted by a former employee, suffering injuries to the face. He was hospitalized.

On June 13, 2019, two employees were in an area operating standup forklifts to select product. The first employee struck the second employee's forklift. The second employee's left forearm was pinched and crushed between the two forklifts, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking at ground level when he slipped and fell, injuring his head on the concrete floor.
On 06/13/2019, an employee was cutting a piece of flooring tile with a knife when the blade cut his right thumb, causing an avulsion.

A temporary employee was attempting to remove a piece of plastic foam from a foam-cutting machine when the cutter snatched her glove and pulled her left hand into the moving cutter blade, resulting in the amputation of her left middle finger from the first knuckle and a broken ring finger.

On June 13, 2019, an employee was standing on a post peeler machine by the motor watching his two coworkers change out a busted hydraulic hose. His coworkers turned on the machine. After the machine was energized, his right middle fingertip was amputated with bone loss by the machine's moving belt.

An employee was riding a bike to go on patrol. As he was coming around the corner, a gust of wind began to blow off his hat. He used his right hand to keep his hat on and accidentally hit the front brake with his left hand. He then went over the handlebars and fractured the top of his left hip at the socket. He was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a bumper on a car that was on a lift at eye level when a hand tool slipped and struck the employee's eye, lacerating it.
An employee was cutting a metal pipe. The pipe struck the employee's left foot, causing a contusion.
In a postal facility, an employee tripped over the corner of a wooden platform, fell to the ground, and broke her elbow.
An employee was operating a tub grinder when a conveyor fell and hit him, breaking his hip.

An employee was positioning a wooden pallet on top of a stack of steel. The pallet dropped onto a steel coil from about 18 inches up, crushing the employee's right index finger and causing a partial amputation.

An employee was moving a steel box to remove excess molten zinc after it came out of a kettle when the wire holding the box broke and the box fell into the kettle. Molten zinc splashed on the employee, causing second and third degree burns to his neck, chest, and arms.
An employee was loading a truck when he fell 52 inches from the flatbed section. He suffered a broken left wrist and was hospitalized.
On June 13, 2019, an employee was kicked in the stomach during a patient restraint procedure. The employee was hospitalized with a left abdominal contusion.
An employee was cleaning up a spill when he slipped and fell on the floor, injuring his right hip.

An employee was installing a piece of sheet metal on a roof when he fell through the 4-foot by 4-foot hole for it. He landed on the concrete floor, suffering two broken ribs and injuries to both legs.
On June 13, 2019, an employee was washing windows at a four-story building and fell approximately 40 feet from the roof, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was climbing down the steps of a pump trailer when he slipped and injured his left knee, resulting in a torn patella tendon.

An employee was removing finished spools from the stranding machine. As he lifted the spool, the end of the wire got caught on the side of the cradle that supports the spool. He grabbed the wire to dislodge it and was struck on the chest by the wire causing a laceration/contusion. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting metal parts on a saw. While he was retrieving the parts, the saw lacerated his left index finger.

An employee was using a work assist vehicle to get folded boxes from a storage rack. She was stepping back from the rack onto the wave when she fell to the ground, suffering injuries to the shoulder, ribs, back, and leg.
An employee was repairing an overhead door and installing cable when the cable slipped and struck both of the employee's hands, amputating three fingers.

Employees were installing a precast concrete barrier wall. An 18-wheeler drifted over and struck a piece of equipment that was being used to set a section of the wall. This knocked the wall section loose, and it crushed two of an employee's toes. The toes were medically amputated.

An employee was installing form panels for pouring concrete when the row of panels tipped over and landed on top of him. He suffered several fractured ribs, right knee pain, and a laceration on the lower left jaw.
An employee was grinding meat for burgers when the grinder jammed. As he attempted to unjam it, the stored energy was released and his left thumb was caught in the meat grinder and amputated.
Employees were fighting and one employee was injured and hospitalized.

An employee was working on a powerline pole. The employee was installing an equal potential zone while using a cluster bar that attached to the pole. A chain hangs from the cluster bar, which started swinging back and forth after it was attached to the pole. The employee attempted to grab the swinging chain and came into contact with the energized powerline. An entry wound was present on his hand and an exit wound was present on his chest. He was hospitalized with burns.

An employee was removing a filter screen while cleaning a line for a flavor change when hot water sprayed out from the pressurized filter and contacted the employee. The employee was hospitalized with first degree burns to the torso, arms, and upper legs.

An employee was standing on a level surface and was using his hands to guide an iron column, which was being moved by a small tower crane. As he was guiding the suspended column, his finger was caught between a flange of the column and a tie-back cable (for a swing-stage) that was behind him. This resulted in a crushed right index finger and a laceration to the right middle finger. Following the injury, his right index fingertip was amputated at the hospital (from the top knuckle up), and his middle finger required stitches.
An employee was removing line from a trimmer/weedwhacker when he injured his right index finger, suffering a potential fracture.

An employee was operating a tractor when it became stuck in the field. While he was unhooking the chain from the front axle, the steering wheel was inadvertently turned, pinning the employee between the front tire and the tractor frame. He broke 8 ribs and punctured a lung.
An employee was securing a jib with a chain fall. His right index finger was caught and crushed between the chain and hoist rail. He was hospitalized.
An employee experienced anaphylactic shock while completing intake forms on a patient in the emergency room, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from his tractor-trailer and broke his hip.

An employee was operating a saw cutter while cutting a concrete slab (balcony) on the second floor level of a residential home when he slipped and fell approximately 8 feet down to the concrete ground level. He was hospitalized with a head fracture, a spinal fracture, and rib fractures.

An employee was placing a molding machine on two 3-by-4 pieces of wood on the forks of a forklift. When the wood was adjusted, the employee's right thumb tip was caught between the wood and the forks and was amputated.
While walking toward a customer to deliver product, an employee tripped on a concrete step and fell. The employee's right knee struck the ground, and the employee suffered a broken patella.

On June 14, 2019, an employee was getting onto a scaffold to descend to the ground and retrieve more materials. When he stepped onto the unsecured planks, the planks fell off and he fell about 12 feet to the ground, landing on his feet. He sustained a fracture to his lower back and ruptured a lower back disc, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was conducting cleaning services inside a school when she mis-stepped on a step, tripped, and fell on the last step of a stairway. She attempted to stop her fall with her hands and fractured her wrist.
An employee was bitten by a dog on her lower right arm while working on her mail route, suffering a possible infection.
An employee was walking from the back of a warehouse to an office when a bundle of rolled insulation fell and struck her, knocked her down, and rolled on top of her. She suffered a head injury.
An employee was using a trim saw machine to trim boards. While he was clearing clippings from the machine, the saw amputated his right ring fingertip.

An employee was walking around the driver's side of a semi trailer to secure the trailer doors when the wind blew the semi trailer door into the employee. The employee sustained a laceration to the head and two broken ribs.
An employee stepped into the floor auger of a grain bin, resulting in the amputation of some toes.  The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was attempting to close an overhead door when it closed on his fingers, crushing his fingertips.
An employee was working on a garage/bay door when the ladder he was standing on crumpled beneath him, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet. He suffered broken ribs and a back injury.
An employee slipped and fell 10-12 feet off a picker, landing on the floor and suffering fractures to the skull, collarbone, back, and face.
An employee was working in a bucket changing out a utility pole when an electrical flash occurred, causing burns to the employee's face, neck, and upper chest.
After delivering mail on a rural route, an employee experienced an aggravated heartbeat due to heat stress, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking when she tripped on her sandals and suffered a broken femur and laceration. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a saw when the blade amputated a half-inch of his fingertip, requiring surgery.
An employee slipped on water and fell to the floor while walking to get water from a water dispenser where the drip tray had overflowed onto the floor. The employee suffered a right fibula fracture.

On June 14, 2019, an employee was dumping approximately 3 tons of asphalt that was left inside the bed of a dump truck from the night before. The employee raised the dump truck and then exited the truck. While the employee was standing at the rear of the truck, the asphalt broke loose and fell onto the employee, pinning the employee between the pavement and the tailgate of the dump truck. The employee suffered burns, lacerations, broken bones, and the amputation of toes.
An employee was moving merchandise with a pallet jack when it ran over his foot.
An employee was operating a boot turning machine when the employee's finger was caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On 6/14/2019, an employee was watching an apprentice lineman perform work. The employee took control of the work from the apprentice lineman, and grabbed the base of the utility pole. The pole came within proximity of a 69 KV line and an arc occurred, energizing the utility pole. The inside of the employee's right forearm contacted the pole at the time it became energized. The employee suffered superficial burns to the right forearm (just above the glove cuff) beneath the elbow, and burns to both feet.

An employee was guiding a steel header piece that was being lowered by a crane on top of a mold. When the crane set the header down, the employee's right index finger was caught between the piece and the mold. His right index finger was amputated.
An employee pulling nails on a roof fell 10 to 12 feet to the ground, breaking a leg.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking between roof trusses, breaking the left and right wrists.
An employee was on a ladder servicing a cooling unit at a customer site and fell to the ground, suffering a possible fractured back.
An employee was closing the door to an audiology booth and pinched their right little finger between the door and booth, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was attaching a dolly to his lead TRL when he slipped and his left pinky finger was caught between the front dolly and the TRL pintle hook.

An employee was using a pry bar to unload steel from the back of a semi-trailer for a customer when he slipped and fell, hitting his head on a spreader bar. He lost consciousness and suffered blunt trauma to the head, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a meat slicer when the employee's fingers contacted the blade, resulting in amputations of the right index and middle fingertips.
An employee was reaching for a hook caught on the side of a carcass with his left hand when his right hand came in contact with the piston of the bone clipper, amputating his right middle fingertip.

On June 14, 2019, an employee installed an adapter on a compressed gas cylinder, then actuated the cylinder. There was a suspected failure in the adapter, and the cylinder struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the ribs and shoulder, as well as a head injury.

An employee was loading a bottle of water into a cooler in the back of a work truck when another employee entered the driver seat of the vehicle to move it. When the second employee moved the truck forward, the injured employee fell out of the truck and hit his head on the ground, suffering head trauma.
A part of a boring machine struck a hand tool, sending it flying through the air. It struck an employee in the back and injured the employee's spleen.
While helping a resident out of a wheelchair, an employee slipped and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right wrist that required surgery.
An employee was operating a molding press when a hose detached from the mold and sprayed hot oil in the employee's face. The employee suffered burns to the face and neck.

At 11:00 a.m. on June 14, 2019, an employee of Manhattan Construction Company (MCC) and an employee of Centennial Moisture Control were in a yard when a piece of corrugated metal decking fell onto them from about 140 feet above, knocking them to the ground. The MCC employee suffered significant facial trauma and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a road crew that was replacing asphalt in a closed left lane when a vehicle involved in a high-speed police pursuit entered the left lane road closure area. The speeding vehicle swerved around a state police vehicle stationed at the construction site and struck another vehicle. One of the vehicles struck the employee, who suffered a punctured lung; a ruptured spleen; and lacerations to the right knee, ankle, and wrist.
An employee was repairing a light bulb on a light pole when the employee received an electrical shock, suffering two burns on the right middle finger and one burn on the right pointer finger.
An employee was using a pinch-off tool when the tool struck his head/jaw.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam inside a dust collector chute when a rotating part in the chute amputated three of the employee's fingertips.
An employee was passing out fliers when she fainted due to the heat.
An employee was cleaning the inside of an incline auger when the running blade amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was punched by another employee and fell onto a hamper, suffering a broken jaw and lost tooth.
An employee was in the freezer, standing on a ladder to cap bins. She fell off the ladder to the ground and fractured her hip. She was hospitalized.

On 6/15/2019, an employee was observing glass-making machines, removing jammed bottles, performing housekeeping, and lubricating equipment when he began feeling weak and dizzy from heat stress. He was hospitalized with dehydration and acute kidney failure.
An employee was getting out of a vehicle and stepped onto a branch, causing her to slip on mud on the street. She fell and injured her left hip.
On June 15, 2019, an employee was using a hoist to lift a finished roll when the employee's left index finger was pinched by the roll, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning bottles of consumer alcohol with a rag and disposing of broken glass. The employee ingested a 3-millimeter piece of glass and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a 6-foot step ladder to clean a convex mirror when she fell from the ladder, striking her head on the concrete floor. She suffered a fracture of the skull at the base of the head, a broken right shoulder blade, and two brain bleeds in the front of her head.

An employee had just completed replacing the oxygen block in a furnace port. As the employee was walking away, his left pant leg caught on fire. He attempted to extinguish the fire with his left hand, causing his shirt sleeve to catch on fire. He was hospitalized with second and third degree burns.
At 9:45 a.m. on June 15, 2019, an employee suffered a possible hernia while lifting a door onto a dolly.
An employee was at a register when she tripped over a shopping hand basket on the floor, falling to the floor and fracturing her left knee.
An employee's head hit an oil change tray as the employee was walking in a lower bay. The employee was hospitalized.

A sanitizing crew was in the picking room and had removed the drain grates in the floor to clean. While the crew was cleaning in the picking area, a maintenance employee entered the picking area. As the maintenance employee was walking to the equipment needing maintenance, he tripped in an open drain. He fell and tried to catch himself, fracturing the radius and ulna of his left arm.
An employee was attempting to clear parts from a belt when his left index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was squatting down to pick an order when a pallet jack struck the employee, injuring his right ankle and knee.

An oil rig floor hand was connecting elevators to a lifting sub. When the elevators were lifted, the floor hand's right middle fingertip was crushed between the elevators and the lifting sub. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was going back to her classroom when she tripped and fell to the floor, suffering multiple fractures to her arm and kneecap.

An employee was teaching another employee how to operate a backhoe. He was standing on the top step by the cab when the other employee hit a rough area. He then fell off the backhoe to the ground, breaking his left upper femur just below the pelvis area.
An employee was pulling out a tea filter holder that still had hot water in it when the water splashed on the employee, burning her face and arm.

Two employees were working to clear trees from powerlines. The tree being cleared had fallen onto the power line, which was angled down due to recent storms. A tree limb had been cut into three pieces, and the injured employee was trying to free the limb from the power line. The tree limb swung and hit the employee's face, causing lacerations from the nose to the lips.

An employee was tarping a truck load and applying plastic between the load and the tarp. The employee became tangled in the plastic and slipped from the trailer, hitting the ground. The employee suffered two broken wrists, a broken left cheekbone, and eye socket damage.

While a confectionery machine was being reassembled, an employee's hand was pinched between the caramel-dispensing part of the machine and the machine frame. The employee's right little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a printing press folder. The employee was jogging the machine to feed the paper back into the folder, after changing out the cutting blades, when his right hand was pulled in. The folder's cutting blade amputated his middle finger and the tips of his index, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was repositioning a 55-gallon oil drum when his left little finger was caught between the drum and the enclosed belt conveyor frame. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.

On June 17, 2019, an employee was receiving a scaffolding piece on the ground as other employees dismantled a scaffold. The well wheel used to manually lower the equipment broke apart, causing the load to fall and strike the employee, who suffered a laceration to the upper left shoulder.

The injured employee asked the skinner operator for a long hook that was hanging over a meat conveyor. As the skinner operator retrieved the hook, the injured employee's right hand became caught in the skinner roller and the blade amputated three fingertips. There are no guards along the edges of the top of the skinner.
While delivering mail, an employee was bitten by a dog on the right knee and left ear. The employee was hospitalized.
On June 17, 2019, an employee was stapling wood together using a pneumatic staple gun. The gun shot a staple into the employee's elbow.
An employee was operating a mill saw. The saw caught his gloves, broke his middle finger, and amputated his left ring and little fingers at the first knuckle.

An employee was helping a forklift operator identify parts to pull for orders. The employee had mounted the right side of the forklift when the operator turned sharply. The employee then fell off the forklift, which proceeded to run over his right heel, cutting the inside of his heel pad.
An employee was dismounting a conveyor after flagging a sensor. Upon dismounting, her left arm was pulled into the equipment, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell from a trailer hitch to the concrete floor about 3 feet below, suffering fractures to the rib cage, elbow, and hip area. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was banding foundation blocks. The tier lift came down on his foot, injuring his left fourth toe.

On June 17, 2019, an employee was painting on an elevated platform when the power went out. The employee fell 10 feet 6 inches to the floor and was injured. The employee was hospitalized for facial fractures.

An employee was in a scissor lift, loading it onto a trailer bed. The scissor lift skidded and went down the side of the trailer bed; the employee was ejected onto a paved parking lot. The employee suffered a scraped elbow and a broken left femur near the hip socket.

An employee was cleaning pieces of meat from a poultry skinner. Her hand was caught in the machine, two opposing rubber belts (which rub skin off the meat as it enters the machine) caused an amputation of her left little fingertip, broke the tip of the bone, and degloved the palm side of the finger.

An employee was sitting on top of the middle section of a truss while waiting for another truss to be delivered by crane. The truss broke and employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground and suffered a compound fracture to the left elbow, a fractured hip, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee tripped on a dolly behind him and fell on the concrete floor, fracturing both elbows.
An employee was fixing a tractor when it moved and struck the employee. The employee suffered a left leg injury.

An employee was cutting a block of cheese with a cheese harp when the harp string snapped, causing the employee to fall backward onto the same level. The employee suffered a broken bone in his left hip as a result of the fall.
An employee was operating a walk-behind grass aerator when he became hot, dizzy, and weak, suffering from blurry vision, low blood pressure, and dehydration. He was hospitalized for heat illness.
An employee was dropping a 10-inch cast iron pipe into a hole when his hand was caught between the cement wall and the pipe. He was hospitalized with a swollen hand.
An employee became dehydrated while picking up residential trash and was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up a spray gun to spray ceiling texture. The gun injected sheet rock material into the employee's right ring finger, causing an infection.

An employee was using a cutting torch to disassemble a metal staircase. The stringer became loose, causing the landing to begin shaking, and the employee lost his balance and fell 9 to 12 feet. He suffered injuries to his head and right shoulder.
An employee was run over by a forklift and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the left arm and right leg.

On June 17, 2019, an employee was picking up residential garbage containers when he began to suffer heat-related illness; after being put in the air-conditioned cab of the garbage truck he became unresponsive. He was hospitalized, suffering from kidney failure.
An employee fell to the ground while exiting the cab of a tractor trailer, suffering a broken arm.
An employee who was ill inside a moving roll-off container truck fell out of the truck while trying to roll down the window.

An employee was standing on the forks of a forklift approximately 10 feet off the ground when the forklift turned around a corner and tipped over. The employee jumped off the forklift, breaking one ankle and spraining the other.

On June 18, 2019, an employee was attempting to retrieve a dropped pin from the inside of a pin-sitter machine when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The machine then caused a finger amputation, requiring surgery.
On June 18, 2019, an employee was operating a riding pallet jack. She was thrown from the pallet jack and collided with a rack, suffering a lower lumbar fracture. She was hospitalized.

On June 18, 2019, at approximately 1:30 AM, two employees were blowing out an asphalt hose after loading a barge when the lines pressurized and blew apart, spraying them with hot liquid asphalt. One of the employees was hospitalized with first, second, and third degree burns.

An employee was attempting to remove empty film and jammed candy from the discharge end of a wrapper machine when his right index finger was cut by the machine's crimper blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was trying to place a gearbox/motor unit into place using a pry bar and his hands. 
The gearbox/motor unit was partially in place but did not sit all the way down. The employee tried to feel what was blocking the unit when the unit fell the rest of the way into place and pinched his left thumb, resulting in a thumb amputation at the nailbed.

An employee conducting electrical work was descending a 10-foot step ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, striking his right arm on a metal stud. He was hospitalized with back pain and an arm laceration that required surgery.
An employee suffered a right middle finger amputation when a drain cover fell on his hand.
An employee was moving a battery when it dropped and fell on the employee's right big toe, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the cab of his truck. As he was climbing down using the cab steps, he lost his balance, fell backwards, and struck the back of his head on the paved ground. He sustained a contusion to the back of the head and bleeding to the back of the brain.

An employee was working 4 to 5 miles offshore on board a utility vessel and helping to retrieve a box core (device that goes to the bottom to scoop sediment) when his fingers were caught in a 24-volt winch, resulting in the partial amputation of his left ring finger.

An employee was using new retraction tool to disassemble an air cycle machine unit. In the process of removing the retaining nut, the retraction tool's thread shaft adapter broke, causing a bubble or burst of hydraulic fluid to rupture at up to approximately 6,000 psi. The fluid cut/lacerated the employee's left hand between the middle and forefingers. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was at a job site helping to unload a truck when the employee became overheated and dehydrated. The employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a two-hand control O-ring stretcher. When she attempted to dislodge a stuck O-ring with her finger, the stretcher partially amputated her right middle fingertip.

On June 18, 2019, at approximately 4:10 p.m., an employee was preparing a conveyor system to discharge kiln-dried concrete blocks to the tumbler line. The employee was attempting to correct a misaligned photo sensor when a different sensor eye was covered, causing the machine to cycle. As the machine cycled, the push arm swung out and pinned the employee between the pusher and the block turnover frame. The employee was hospitalized with a pelvic fracture. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was performing short training (bending, squatting, hiding behind barricades) exercises at a firing range when he developed muscle cramps and tingling in his legs. He was hospitalized for a heat related illness.

An employee was using a roller to roll a tarp out over concrete when the employee's right ring finger was caught between a push plate and the handle of the roller. The employee suffered a deep laceration to the middle of the right ring finger.

An employee was removing a hook from an outfeed table that pulls tubes through the annealing furnace. The hook did not come off the chain and table on its own. The employee noticed the hook still attached and went to unhook the table. The hook and chain were still moving. The employee's right finger was smashed between the hook and chain and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee had been installing solar panels on a roof during the day. As he was installing the last two, his hands cramped up and he was removed from the roof. He then began to have whole-body cramps and he was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee fell while getting past a 6-foot gate and broke his left ankle.
An employee was loosening up plastic resin on a machine. An air bubble popped and resin got on the employee, causing a burn.

An employee was using a motorized pallet jack to load products when she stepped off the motorized pallet jack and accidentally pulled the throttle handle. The pallet jack then backed into her leg and broke it.
An employee was picking tomato stakes from a tomato field when the employee experienced dizziness, cramps, weakness, and stomach pain. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee was operating a bandsaw when its blade amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was grinding meat in a meat market when his hand entered the meat grinder, resulting in an amputation to the end of his right middle finger.
An employee was checking a belt in an air handler. The employee's hand was pulled into a nip point and the belt and pulley amputated three fingertips.
An employee fell to the ground while performing maintenance on a crane, suffering a head injury.

An employee was removing the inside steel pieces of a 91-inch by 91-inch by 6-foot concrete form, breaking the form down. The floor piece of the form (weighing more than 1,000 pounds) fell onto the employee's right side, lacerating his liver and injuring his right kidney and spleen.

An employee was moving a buoy with a forklift when he attempted to move a piece of wood by the buoy. The buoy then rolled and caught his left index finger, resulting in the amputation of 2/3 of the finger.

An employee working on an elevated platform fell 25 feet through the oxygen load opening, landing on the lower level of a basic oxygen furnace. The employee was attempting to arrest flames while tapping steel. The employee suffered multiple fractures and second degree burns.
An employee was cutting a board with a chop saw when the blade partially amputated the employee's finger.
An employee was clearing a jam in a running conveyor. His left hand was drawn between the belt and the rollers. He suffered three crushed fingers and a burn from the belt that requires skin grafts.

An employee was doing demolition work in a storm drain culvert. As he was adjusting a steel I-beam, the tip of his right index finger was caught between the two pieces of the adjustable beam. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working in a de-molding section. While he was walking on the back of the plate of the mold, the tension plate fell off and landed on his legs. His left fibula was broken and tissue was torn in his right leg, requiring stitching. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a step ladder and his tools from the first floor to the lobby when he fell down a single set of stairs breaking both legs.
On June 18, 2019, an employee suffered three finger amputations while operating a band notcher machine.
An employee slipped and his foot went under a lawnmower, resulting in the partial amputation of his toes.
An employee was walking a family member into a surgical care suite when she tripped and fell, hitting her head on the aluminum door and fracturing her first cervical vertebra.
An employee was disassembling a scaffold and fell to a lower level. He suffered fractures to the left scapula, right forefoot, and right ankle.
An employee was exiting a scissor lift and fell 2.5 to 3 feet to the concrete ground, suffering a broken left wrist and hip.

An employee was operating a trenching machine when it struck an old, unmarked natural gas pipeline. The machine caught fire before the operator could turn it off; he suffered burns to his right hand as he left the cab, as well as a broken right knee and left wrist as he jumped to the ground. He was hospitalized.
An employee became dehydrated and suffered heat exhaustion while delivering shingle pallets to a roof.
An employee was moving a safe on a wheeled dolly when the wheel of the dolly ran over imperfections in the floor. The safe then tipped off the dolly and onto the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was assisting with rigging a 500 lbs. load. The employee was standing by the truck when the load fell onto his foot causing four metatarsal fractures.

An employee was disconnecting a hose when the employee lost control of the hose. The hose ripped the employee's personal protective suit, and the chemical that was coming out of the hose contacted the employee's body. The employee was hospitalized with third degree burns to the lower body.
An employee fell approximately 25 feet while making his way down a cell phone tower.
An employee was transferring product from a trailer to a tote when the employee was splashed with sulfuric acid on the face and left eye.
An employee had been pulling cable and was hospitalized for heat related illness.
A temporary employee was trying to clear a jam on a final press machine when his right thumb was pinched by the wood object being moved through the press. The tip of the thumb was amputated.
An employee overheated while driving and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading his forklift when it moved and pinned him against a pallet, fracturing his tibia and fibula.

An employee reached down to check the lawn mower tire while the mower was running. The lawn mower blade lacerated his left ring finger and fractured the left middle finger that resulted in the amputation of the distal phalanx.
An employee was fabricating metal parts on a brake press when his hand was crushed by the brake press, resulting in an amputated left index finger and three crushed fingers.
An employee was diverting product trays along a conveyor system when his left ring finger was pinched between the conveyor and a stationary metal tray diverter, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was performing construction work when he became lightheaded and vomited due to heat stress.

An employee had been wearing a training suit while instructing law enforcement trainees in personal defense. Early the following morning, he woke with a fever and a severe headache, requiring hospitalization for a staph infection in his leg.
An employee was replacing catalyst parts in the heat and became ill due to heat exhaustion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift outside the facility to move a  mast weighing approximately 3700 lbs. As the mast was lifted to maximum height to avoid another parked forklift, it shifted to the left and the forklift overturned. The employee suffered a broken collarbone and broken ribs.

On June 19, 2019, two employees were moving an electrical cabinet with a forklift to place in a new control room when the cabinet fell from the forklift and pinned the injured employee's left leg. The employee suffered a fractured tibia, fibula, and femur.
An employee became ill after doing an install and doubled over in pain from heat cramps. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was helping correct a malfunction in a trim press, adjusting the limit switch. The machine activated, cycled, and came down on the employee's right little finger, causing an amputation.

On June 19, 2019, an employee was operating a machine that carries shingles onto a roof when the belt came off. As he attempted to set the belt onto the machine's pulley, his right index finger was caught between the pulley and the belt, resulting in an amputation of his right index finger without bone loss. The machine was energized at the time of the incident.

An employee was at a dock operating a high-low forklift when a bulk mail cart (BMC) started rolling towards him.  He extended his right arm in an attempt to stop the BMC and his right middle finger was pinched between the BMC and his forklift, resulting in an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell approximately 18 feet from a ladder while performing work.

An employee was using a drill press with a hole saw bit installed, when the bit caught the employee's glove, pulling the employee's left thumb into the bit and resulting in an amputation (from the middle).

An employee was attempting to unclog salt that was damp from recent humid weather. The salt was added to the process through a 10-inch-long pipe with a rotary gate valve at the end. The employee's finger was caught in the turning valve, resulting in an amputation.
An employee contracted an infectious parasite while servicing a client.

An employee was hooking a front end loader to his tow truck to get it out of a wash pit in a concrete plant. The employee suffered chemical burns to the legs from the 3-foot-deep water the loader was in. He was hospitalized.

An employee was reconfiguring a 1" airline. The employee's hand was on a 90-degree fitting while a co-worker turned the pipe using an 18-inch pipe wrench. The employee's hand then became caught between the 90-degree fitting and a steel skid, resulting in a fractured left ring finger and nail avulsion that required surgery.

Two employees were in a scissor lift lowering support pipes down. As they began lowering one of the pipes, the bottom of the pipe slid into the scissor lift, causing the lift to tip over. Both employees jumped out of the lift (approximately 3 feet) before the lift collapsed to the ground. The first employee suffered a broken hip, a broken tailbone, bruises, and cuts. The second employee suffered a broken pelvic bone, a fractured left elbow, bruises, and scrapes.

An employee was cleaning a 3-way valve (ball type), using a 10-inch screwdriver to remove process powder. A vacuum hose was attached to the other end of the 3-way valve to suck out the powder removed by the screwdriver. While he was cleaning, the screwdriver became stuck inside the valve. After several attempts to remove the screwdriver from the valve, the employee then placed his hand on the side of the valve to generate force to remove the screwdriver. Once the screwdriver was freed from the valve, the employee's left ring finger slipped and entered the valve. Because the hose was on the other end, an alarm for low pressure immediately triggered the valve to actuate while his finger was inside. As a result, his left ring fingertip was amputated in the nailbed area.
An employee was positioning a flap gate airlock valve. The valve was turned while his hand was on it, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was attempting to move a wet log that was dislodged from a loading platform in a sawmill when the log slipped and crushed the employee's finger against equipment, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was using a rag to clean a machine when the rag became caught, pulling his hand into the machine's chain and sprocket. As a result, he suffered an amputation of his middle finger, a partial amputation of his ring finger, and lacerations to two fingers. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing a transducer when high pressure fluid struck his hand, penetrating his skin.
At 10:00 p.m., on June 19, 2019, an employee was helping a coworker line up a flange prior to bolt-up when he lost his footing and fell to the ground, fracturing his femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was fixing a chain and unjamming an edger machine when the machine was turned on. The employee's right hand was pulled into the machine, injuring the back of the right hand and the right wrist.
An employee was loading boxes onto a pallet when the employee tripped over the corner of the pallet and suffered a broken hip.
An employee unscrewed a platen collar during set-up. The vibration of the thermoformer caused the platen to shift and fall on the employee's finger, amputating the tip (without bone loss).
An employee was hammering a concrete nail into the brace of a concrete pad when the concrete nail broke and went into the employee's right eyeball.

An employee was placing a metal plate into a furnace to be heat-treated when he tripped and fell forward, resulting in his hands making contact with the hot metal plate. He suffered burns to the palms of both hands and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped while walking on a wet floor and experienced a hip fracture, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was mounting/installing a motor into place when the motor shifted and his finger became pinched between the motor and the wall of the machine. He broke his left index finger.

An employee was on a track ladder stocking merchandise when the employee missed a step and fell approximately 6 feet from the ladder to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a right ankle injury.

An employee was installing an air conditioner at a customer's home. He was using a set of needle-nose pliers. The pliers slipped off from the object they were grasping and the employee's fist hit his left eye. He sustained a laceration to the globe of the left eye.

An employee was disassembling a guardrail on a rig floor when his safety harness became caught on the guardrail and the weight pulled him down to the ground, breaking his left leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell off the ladder 4-5 feet fracturing the left hip and heel.
An employee was stacking boxes on pallets at a loading dock when a forklift struck his left foot, breaking several tarsal bones.
An employee was dumping trash when he lost his balance, fell off the loading dock (approximately 4 feet), struck the concrete floor, and broke his left tibia. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was burned while performing underground installation when the cable was inadvertently energized.
An employee fell 8 feet from a scaffold while setting a roof on a modular home, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a nail gun when a nail ricocheted off another nail and impaled the employee through the tongue and into the roof of the mouth. The employee was hospitalized.
A garbage collection crew was on its way to a landfill when one of the employees became ill with cramps and started sweating. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress and dehydration.
An employee was sweeping a curb when his left foot was run over by a reversing mini excavator. His left foot broke.
A temporary employee was using an upcut saw when the blade amputated four of his fingers.
An employee was installing bracing on the edge form as the crew prepared a bridge for a deck pour. The employee began to feel hot and thirsty and then fainted. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee slipped and fell on the wet grass and mud while walking to her car, fracturing her foot/ankle.
An employee was bitten on his left finger by a venomous snake and sustained effects from the venom.
An employee was working in the yard when it began to hail. He was running for cover when he ran into the back of a truck, sustaining fractures to the face.
An employee was struck in the face by a rigging hook.

An employee on a commercial roofing job was gluing an adhered membrane when he stepped backwards and fell approximately 20 feet through an unguarded skylight opening in the roof. He fractured his pelvis.
An employee became light-headed due to heat and missed his step on a rebar mat. His left leg went through the rebar mat and his left knee sustained a cut.
An employee was assembling a shutter when his right thumb was struck by a punch press, resulting in a thumb contusion.

On June 20, 2019, at 6:11 p.m., an employee was attempting to remove a gaylord box on a pallet from a flatbed trailer when the corner of the box tore, knocking the employee off balance. The employee fell about 5 feet to the concrete floor and broke three ribs.
An employee was harvesting peas when his foot was caught between a combine frame and a hopper, fracturing his foot.
An employee was checking the tension on an exhaust fan belt when his finger was caught between the fan's belt and pulley, injuring his fingertip.

An employee was manually catching a carcass that went down the incorrect rail line. The employee caught the carcass before it passed a gate and signaled a nearby employee to shut down the line to allow the carcass to be pulled backwards and moved onto the correct rail. During this process, the carcass fell off the rail system and onto the employee's leg, fracturing a shin bone.

An employee was working near the edge of a concrete slab preparing a skip pan to be removed from the building. The employee fell 10 feet when a skip pan that was on a cart rolled off the side of the first level of the building. The employee suffered a broken nose, three dislocated fingers on the right hand, and a right front hematoma.
An employee fell from the deck of a trailer, suffering injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell while taking the trash out, breaking the L1 vertebra.

An employee was changing a tire on a company truck with a bottle jack when the jack started to slip. Another employee pulled the injured employee out from under the truck before it fell off the jack. The trailer hitch on the truck struck and broke the employee's left eye socket and lacerated his nose.
An employee used a glass cleaner chemical to clean her eye glasses. When she put the glasses on her face, she had an allergic reaction.
An employee was digging a trench for a new water service line when they became short of breath and had chest pain. The employee was hospitalized with a collapsed lung.
An employee was on a ladder installing a canvas cover for a customer when he fell off the ladder and hit the ground, breaking his ankle and wrist.
A low impact collision occurred when a skid steer backed into a buggy. During impact, the injured employee suffered a fractured fibula, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking in the pharmacy when she tripped on an anti-fatigue mat and fell fracturing the right humerus.
An employee slipped and fell on her knee in the deli department. She fractured her kneecap.
An employee was struck by a company vehicle while taking out the trash, suffering a knee injury.
A firefighter had been taking a running test and suffered either heat exhaustion or heat stroke.

An employee was trying to release the brake on the engine twister of a compactor bailer using a crescent wrench. The twister motor spun out and the wrench struck the employee's right hand causing an injury that required surgery.
A temporary worker was walking in a warehouse and was struck by a forklift. The forklift ran over his left foot resulting in amputation of two toes.

On June 21, 2019, an employee was visually inspecting product packaging seals on a conveyor. He went to grab a suspect package with both hands when his right pinky finger became stuck in the conveyor belt webbing, resulting in an amputation of tissue from the distal phalanx (nailbed to tip).
An employee was closing his tool box when it shut on his finger, resulting in an amputation of the skin on his fingertip.

An employee was approximately 1 foot high on an uneven surface, removing the cross-over pin from a casing collar, when the employee slipped on the uneven surface and fell to the ground. The employee fractured the first four vertebrae.

An employee was repairing the feed rail on a strapper machine when his hand was struck by the pendulum and rotating assembly of the strapper. He suffered lacerations to his right hand and a fractured right pinky finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a four-step step ladder repairing a pane of glass over a door frame. While descending the ladder, he missed a step and fell backwards into a corner wall. The employee was hospitalized for back pain and tingling in his legs.

An employee was sweeping around a cluster cutter. The machine was dropping some beans on the floor. The employee tried to attach a deflector to the running machine to keep the beans from falling onto the floor. His right middle finger contacted the sickle bar on the machine and a small piece of the side of his middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was helping a driver unchain a load on a haul trailer. The load weighed approximately 20,000 to 30,000 pounds. The trailer was lowered onto the employee's feet fracturing the employee's toes.
An employee was making deliveries when he began to experience signs of heat-related illness, including feeling lightheaded and weak. He was hospitalized due to dehydration.
While descending from a forklift, an employee was caught by the moving parts of a conveyor and suffered a leg fracture.

Two employees were moving parts from one area to another area for cleaning. The equipment was on a cart and the non-injured employee slipped causing the piece of equipment to shift and pinch the other employee's left middle finger between the equipment and the cart. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was setting up a tube to be bent in a machine. As the employee reached for a dropped tool, a finger was caught in a clamp resulting in an amputation injury.

On June 21, 2019, an employee was working on his route for at least 5 hours and started experiencing cramps. The employee continued driving for approximately two hours alongside a supervisor who was delivering the packages to the clients. The employee was later hospitalized due to heat exhaustion and was diagnosed with a muscle injury.
Bleach was mixed with acid that resulted in a chemical reaction and a cloud. An employee inhaled a chemical mixture and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a heat sealing gun powered by propane when he experienced asthmatic symptoms, including shortness of breath and slight disorientation. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while walking towards his motorized golf car, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to change out rubber belts on a fine screw system when he slipped and fell from the fine screw system approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for contusions and lacerations to the jaw and shoulder.

An employee was trying to dismount the operator seat of a boom truck when he lost his balance and fell approximately 6 feet to the ground, landing on his back. He was hospitalized with six fractured ribs, lumbar vertebrae chipping, and a slight puncture of his left lung.
An employee was removing narcotics from a safe when the steel door closed on her finger, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing fiber from beneath a machine when their right hand was caught in the rotating roller.

An employee and his coworker were lowering a 10-foot long, 3-inch conduit steel pipe to be installed at the ceiling part of the tunnel when the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the end of the pipe and a fixed ladder located at the west wall of the tunnel. He suffered the amputation of his right pinky fingertip without bone loss. Leather gloves were worn at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on water on the floor while washing the dishes in the kitchen area. The employee suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was following up on preventive maintenance when a pressured pipeline exploded. As a result, the employee was hospitalized and suffered a leg amputation.

An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder using a saw to cut sheathing for fireplace pipes and a firestop when he stepped onto a piece of wood that was not load bearing and fell to the ground level. He injured his head, left hand, and ribs.
An employee's left ring finger was caught and crushed in a door frame.
On June 21, 2019, at 11:30 a.m., an employee's right index fingertip came in contact with a sharp object while threading paper into the two-fold napkin machine causing an amputation injury.

A temporary employee was operating a press brake machine to form a piece of aluminum. As the employee engaged the press brake, the ram of the press brake crushed the employee's fingers on both hands. The employee sustained partial amputations to four of his fingers.
An employee was checking/inspecting the hose to a trencher that was parked over a pit when he fell into the floor of the pit, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was struck by a service van in the parking lot resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was performing paving work and was pinned between the paver the employee was standing on and a roller machine. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was working on a modified scaffold preparing to install an I-beam and fell approximately 9 feet to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a head and back injury.
An employee was pulling pipe when the employee became ill, requiring hospitalization for possible heat stress.

An employee was using a scoop to clean grit from a lube box on a draw machine when his gloved left hand was caught by a running wire. He suffered a left middle finger injury and a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was shocked while working on an AC unit and suffered a brain bleed.
An employee slipped on a trash can lid while walking in the deli department and fell resulting in a fractured hip.

A maintenance employee was completing work on a metal shaft that was in a milling machine. The employee turned the milling equipment on and was polishing the end of the rotating shaft with a piece of emery cloth. During the process, his glove or the emery cloth wrapped around the rotating shaft, pulling his hand onto the shaft. He suffered a dislocation to his left little finger, as well as an avulsion and partial amputation to a left distal fingertip.
While exiting the passenger side of a truck, an employee mis-stepped and fell 2 to 3 feet to the ground, fracturing a femur.
After welding from 6:00 a.m. to 7:30 a.m., an employee suffered from heat-related illness.
In the facility shop area, an employee was overcome by chemical vapors. The employee experienced shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
An employee was placing jars into a cashier's safe. Her left middle finger was caught in the closing safe door, amputating the fingertip to the knuckle.
An employee was repairing a front load vehicle in the shop when a build up of compress natural gas (CNG) that was leaking from the regulator or the vehicle ignited and burned the employee's chest.
On June 22, 2019, an employee stocking merchandise was found laying on the platform of the order picker he was using. He suffered head injuries.
An employee was cutting sirloin steaks on a bandsaw and lacerated a finger and a knuckle bone.

An employee was troubleshooting and performing maintenance to the limit switch on a casting machine trough. The trough became energized causing the trough (and the attached chute) to turn over and strike the employee in the head/neck. The employee was then pulled under the trough. The employee suffered broken ribs, a broken chest plate and a punctured lung.

An employee was preparing  to replace wires in a manhole. As he was slicing a cable, the knife slipped out of his hand and cut his finger at the second joint where the finger bends, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.
An employee was bitten on the left thumb by a snake while picking up valves to discard them.

An employee was carrying a pallet rack upright and went to stack it on top of the forklift forks. The employee's right pinky finger was pinched between the pallet rack and the forklift forks resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee fell 4 feet from a ladder to the concrete ground while pulling a boxed lawn mower down. The employee suffered head and brain injuries.

Employees were providing customer care in an assisted living facility when a gastrointestinal virus broke out among customers and employees. Multiple employees experienced stomach and other health effects. Two employees were hospitalized.
An employee was working on a water well when he was caught in a winch line and fell, fracturing his ribs.
An employee was moving a cooling fan from one section of the plant to another when the employee fell onto the concrete floor, suffering a lumbar fracture.

An employee was working at a customer's home, replacing an aerial drop. His ladder was on the strand approximately 15 feet above the ground. As he began to descend the ladder, the strand shifted, causing the ladder to shift, and he fell about 10 feet to the ground. He suffered a bruised rib and liver.

On June 22, 2019, an employee was descending the ladder of a 20-foot container when a 20-pound metal top plug swung and struck his head. The top plug was connected via rigging wire to a cargo vessel's aft crane. He sustained a contusion with a 2-inch cut above his left eyebrow, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was observing a chipper repair when he was shocked and received electrical burns to his legs and feet, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was inspecting a roof for storm damage when the employee fell to the ground, suffering elbow, rib, and pelvic fractures as well as a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to fix malfunctioning saw equipment when the saw blade cycled on and lacerated the employee's left upper arm and elbow. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.

On June 24, 2019, at 1:20 p.m., an employee and coworker were attempting to install a transverse compartment box weighing approximately 60 pounds in the back of a cab when the box slipped out of the employee's hand. The employee's left index finger was then pinched between the box and the wall of the cab, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was applying hot asphalt to material layers. As the employee moved toward a parapet wall to cut a roll of felt, the employee slipped and fell forward. The employee's hand then entered the mop cart that contained the hot asphalt, causing third degree burns to the right hand and wrist.

An employee was welding on a newly fabricated fuel tank when a flash fire occurred. Residual fumes in the tank ignited and flames exited the tank opening, causing burns to the employee's face and chest.

An employee was troubleshooting a noise on a conveyor. Noticing some oil dripping off the chain as it ran, he reached to stop the machine; the chain caught the rag he was using and pulled his left ring finger into the chain, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was riding an electric pallet jack selecting cases for orders. He turned into an aisle and collided with a parked forklift. His right foot was caught between the two forklifts, amputating his right middle toe.
Two employees were using conductive tools to install a PLC when they came into contact with an energized component. An arc flash occurred, causing second and third degree burns to the employees.

An employee was using a cart to transport a full liquid nitrogen dewar when the liquid nitrogen dewar slipped/shifted position on the hook holding it in place. The employee's right middle finger was then crushed between the dewar and the cart, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On June 24, 2019, an employee was operating a CNC mill when the employee's glove was caught by the tooling, resulting in the amputation of the left-hand ring and middle fingers.

An employee bent down to pick up a small section of rebar so a backhoe operator would not run over the rebar and puncture a tire. When the employee stood upright and started walking, he tripped on a small object, causing him to fall and land on his right shoulder. He was hospitalized due to a right shoulder fracture.

An employee was delivering trusses from a tractor trailer. He tilted the truck bed to dump the trusses and went to the back of the truck to see if they had come off. He walked back to the cab and had his hand on the trailer when the trusses began to slide off. His finger was caught between a truss and the roller at the edge of the trailer, resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee was working on a step stool. When she stepped down, she mis-stepped and twisted/fractured her left ankle.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor after losing his footing, fracturing five vertebrae, his ribs, and sternum.

An employee was sandblasting a steel bridge beam when he tripped on a beam behind him and fell with the sandblaster in hand. The sandblaster's deadman switch was tripped, but a residual amount of media made contact with and abraded the employee's torso area.

On 6/24/2019, an employee was using a 4-inch blade scraper to remove vinyl from a store fixture when the scraper cut the employee's left hand, causing tendon, nerve, and artery damage that required hospitalization.

An employee was pushing wet corn meal down into the throat of a twin screw cooker with his left hand when his fingers were caught in the ingoing nip point of the twin screws. He suffered amputation injuries to four fingers (excluding the thumb) on his left hand.

An employee was exposed to fumes from solvent/adhesive that entered the building's air handler as a result of roofing contractor activities. The employee was hospitalized with back pain from coughing and other respiratory ailments.
An employee slipped on brake fluid located on a convenience store floor and suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee stepped into a hot water drain while cleaning, suffering second degree burns to the left foot.

An employee was running terminals through a press machine when a terminal became jammed in the press. He was attempting to unjam the press when it was activated via the foot pedal. The press then partially amputated his left index finger.
Hot laminate splashed onto the back of an employee's head, arm, and hand.

On June 24, 2019, an employee was on a flat roof checking an HVAC leak. As he was descending from a fixed ladder without a cage, he fell to the ground. The building's height is approximately 20 feet. He sustained several rib fractures and a head wound, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped while stepping off a flatbed truck, fell to the ground, and landed on his side, breaking his wrist.
An employee tripped over a patient blanket warmer in a clean linen storage room and fell to the floor, breaking her leg.

An employee was working in the extruder area preforming purging activities when the employee became injured by the material compound and sustained burns to the left side of the face and right wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was threading pipe that was chained to a winch when the chain lurched and caught four of the employee's left-hand fingers. The employee suffered four broken and de-gloved fingers.
An employee was standing in the parking lot when a truck backed up and struck him. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture and broken ribs.

An employee was walking down a hallway to use an office printer when she tripped on the carpet and fell to the floor. She hit her head and fractured her left hand and wrist while trying to catch her fall.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift 25 pieces of 1/8" x 10" x 20 long flat bar material to block it for loading onto a tractor trailer. During the blocking process, the employee was installing the wood block when the chain in the overhead crane slipped out due to the bow of the material at the lifted height. The 25 pieces of material fell, smashing the employee's left gloved thumb between the wood block and the material. When he removed his hand, his thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was performing a repair on a downed utility line. The utility line arced and caused third-degree electrical burns to his left arm and left side of the back.

An employee (an assistant utility operator)was  removing ash build-up and cleaning at the Metals Recovery Systems (MRS) building in high ambient temperatures. The MRS building houses an incinerator and it is made completely of metal materials. The employee experienced heat exhaustion and was hospitalized for severe dehydration.
An employee was climbing into a quad axle dump truck cab when he slipped to the ground and suffered broken ribs.

An employee was working on an extension ladder 10 to 12 feet from the ground. Upon descending, his foot was caught in a ladder rung and he fell to the ground, injuring his hip and right foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 24-inch concrete pipe with a cut-off saw when the saw kicked back and struck his head, causing a concussion and jaw fracture.
An employee's wedding ring and finger were caught on a hopper's stationary J-bolt while the employee was climbing down a ladder, causing a partial amputation of the finger.
On June 24, 2019, an employee working on a shear suffered a crushing injury/amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was cutting T-beams with a cutting torch when the employee's pants caught on fire possibly due to a piece of molten slag, resulting in second and third degree burns to the employee's inner thighs.

An employee was carrying a bucket of plastic waste when she stepped in a spot of oil and slipped backwards. She braced herself with her right arm, and when her right palm struck the concrete floor, she sustained a right wrist fracture.
An employee was hand carrying a piece of sheet metal when it fell and severely lacerated his forearm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell approximately 30 to 40 feet out of a scissor lift while painting, hitting the ground and suffering broken bones.

An employee was operating a tractor with a pull-behind mowing deck when a stick became caught in the mowing deck. As the employee attempted to remove the stick, the employee's right ring and pinky fingertips were amputated by the moving belt and pulley.
An employee was chopping bacon when the knife amputated the tip of his thumb.
An employee was climbing up a 10-foot ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, injuring his left wrist and right eye.

An employee was setting up a hand-operated coil punch machine. Her index finger was in the area of the clamp when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The clamp then came down on her left ring finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was cleaning the hydraulics on a macaroni press. The machine started and crushed the employee's arm and hand, breaking two bones. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was climbing the upper portion of an extension ladder when the ladder slipped. The employee then fell 8 feet to the ground, suffering fluid in the lungs.

On June 24, 2019, an employee was guiding a steel pipe into a pipe clamp to marry it to another piece of pipe when the pipe moved unexpectedly, pinching his right pinky finger and causing an amputation.

An employee went out to the parking lot to help gather loose carts as a thunderstorm was approaching when a strong gust of wind blew the employee down. The employee's face struck the ground, requiring hospitalization.

On June 24, 2019, an employee was hooking up carts to his tugger when he tried to turn around and lost his balance, falling to the floor. He suffered a non-displaced fracture to his right hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting the belt on a slicing machine. The employee went to step up onto the platform, missed the step, and fell to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken lower leg.
