An employee was welding material when the material fell on his finger, causing a traumatic amputation of the distal portion of the phalanges .
An employee experienced a severe allergic reaction while sitting in the grass during a break.

An employee was driving a four-wheeler. As the employee was leaving the dirt parking lot, the vehicle's tire caught the edge of the concrete. The vehicle tipped and the employee's right foot was caught and twisted between it and the concrete ground. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was closing the trailer bay door while operating a dock jeep and got his head stuck between the safety bars of the dock jeep and the trailer bay door. He suffered multiple facial fractures and a right temporal intracranial skull fracture.

An employee was burned by steam, hot water, and a caustic cleaning chemical while disconnecting a pipe during a clean in place (CIP) process. The employee was hospitalized with second and third degree burns.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat and amputated his left thumb.

An employee was delivering a load of ready mix concrete to a location. The employee climbed on a silo's fixed ladder to adjust the customer's airline when the line came loose and startled the employee, who fell off the ladder and landed feet first. The employee suffered an ankle fracture.
An employee was preparing for the second job of the day, which consisted of putting up fencing when he experienced heat stress due to dehydration. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a loader with a grapple attachment to unload tree logs from a truck when he noticed the temperature indicator light flashing. The employee turned off the loader and waited a few minutes to let the engine cool off. Next, the employee started to remove one of the radiator caps on the loader. As he started removing the cap, hot water and steam released from that area, striking the employee. He sustained third degree burns to his left wrist, left arm, and left side torso.
An employee suffered an amputation to several fingers on both hands while operating a press brake.
While walking across a parking lot, an employee tripped over an ergonomic mat that had been placed over a drain hole. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress  while collecting waste.

An employee was attempting to remove a metal wedge from a tall tunnel boring machine when pressure from the equipment caused the wedge to strike the employee's face, injuring the right cheek and nose.

Two employees were moving a 2-inch iron pipe to their acid pump truck when the injured employee's right ring finger was caught between the pipe and the pipe rack it rested on. He suffered an open fracture to the fingertip.
An employee was using a jackhammer when it jumped back on his big toe, lacerating and breaking it.
On June 25, 2019, at approximately 7:30 a.m., an employee was filling a hopper full of sand when the auger at the bottom of the hopper amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee injured their left leg with a nail gun.
An employee was fixing a leak under a break room sink when the employee was shocked and burned by 110 voltage. The employee recoiled and hit their head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working under the front of a truck when another employee got in the truck and backed up over the employee. The employee suffered a fractured right hip and pelvic area.
An employee was emptying a waste container that was elevated on a forklift into a dumpster. He fell six feet to the ground below and broke an ankle.
An employee operating a powered industrial truck fell from a loading dock.
An employee was walking through the production area, tripped on plastic banding that was lying on the ground, fell and broke her hip.
An employee was recovering items in the men's department after the store was closing when she slipped on water on the floor, fell and fractured her right leg.

After an employee removed an obstruction from a box loader machine, the pusher arm returned to its home position and caught the employee's forearm, resulting in a forearm laceration and tendon damage.

An employee was hooking up air lines on a trailer when the employee's heel became caught on a buffalo box (curb box). The employee then fell backwards onto a fire hydrant, fracturing the lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was attaching a casing ring tool to an overhead crane when the employee's left middle finger was caught between the hook and the pad eye amputating the finger pad.
An employee was working in an aisle way filling an order when he was struck by a narrow aisle rack truck. He was hospitalized with rib and pelvis fractures.

An employee was tightening a guy wire in proximity of an energized line and received an electric discharge causing burns on the left leg and right arm and hand. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on the arm and leg.

On June 25, 2019, an employee was repairing a machine that moves pipes (36 inches in diameter, 1/2-inch thick, and 40 feet long) from a set position to a skid position. He was welding on a hydraulic cylinder clevis that holds the cylinder to the machine. When he moved the machine arm, it triggered the automated car to deliver a pipe to the machine. Seeing that a pipe was coming toward him, he jumped out of the way and landed near a skid pipe. He fractured his left foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a bagging machine at a cereal plant. The machine's jaws (which shut and sealed bags) caught the employee's left index finger and amputated it.

An employee was going up an escalator from the second floor to the third floor when she lost her balance and fell backwards to the second floor level. She was hospitalized with a fractured spine and arm scrapes.

An employee was checking (from an 8-foot A-frame ladder) the inside of an asphalt drum through the chute's opening to make sure there was no clogging. As he was descending from the ladder, his feet became tangled on the fourth rung and he fell backwards about 3 feet to the gravel floor. He injured his left ankle and lacerated the back of his head, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving a piece of debris from a motorized chain and steel pan when a piece of lumber struck him in the chest. He suffered a left rib fracture, right rib fracture, left transverse process fracture, left scapula fracture, and left collapsed lung.
An employee was working on the flat roof of an elementary school and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground below, suffering fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
An employee was working on a high-power electrical line when he made contact with a hot line. He received an electric shock that entered through the arm and exited through the stomach.
An employee was opening a 150-pound 5-foot by 3-foot metal hatch on a ship while standing on a 6-stair inclined stairway. The hatch fell on the employee and fractured his wrist and T6 vertebra.
An employee was assisting in the removal of a monomer pump bowl when he was sprayed with hot monomer (a slurry of PET plastic) and sustained a second degree burn to the lower face.
An employee was running a table saw and pushed the material through the saw. After the material was through the saw, his thumb contacted the blade. His left thumb was amputated below the knuckle.
An employee was changing out a welding head when it slipped and fell on his left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of his third left digit.

An employee was driving a forklift to a charging station. As the employee was backing up the forklift to park it at the charging station, it struck a wall and the employee's right leg and foot were crushed between the wall and the forklift.
An employee was sealing a gas furnace exhaust pipe on a two-story roof. The employee fell off the roof and broke a rib and bruised a leg. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee was helping to set up furniture in a conference room when a cart tilted and landed on the employee, causing an L1 fracture.
A maintenance employee was attempting to loosen a bolt with a wrench and a sledge hammer. As he swung the hammer, he struck his left index finger, fracturing his fingertip.
An employee suffered a heat-related illness, including cramping, after being exposed to excess heat while operating a wood chipper.
An employee was walking to her car in the parking lot at the end of her shift. She tripped on an uneven surface and fell breaking a rib.
An employee was walking to the truck and was struck on the right side of the face with the bucket of a front end loader. The employee suffered a facial laceration that required surgery.
An employee was cutting trim work with a power miter saw. The saw cut his hand.

An employee was using a power washer to clean heavy equipment when high-pressure water from its nozzle lacerated the top of his right foot and injected dirt and water into the foot. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was assembling a wire line gun. His finger was pinched between the gun and a workbench causing an amputation to his right ring finger.
An employee was moving a mobile scaffold vertical lift that was approximately 800 pounds. It fell back on the employee causing a fractured left ankle that required surgery.
After picking debris up outside between 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m., a temporary employee became overheated and was cramping up due to heat exhaustion.
An employee's right foot was caught between the ground and the outriggers on a magnet crane. The employee's toes were fractured.
An employee was repairing a storage rack and suffered a partial amputation to the distal phalanx of the right index finger.

An employee was getting ready to leave for a jobsite in the morning and needed to put something away in his car when a stranger approached him and hit him in the head. He suffered a cracked skull and bleeding/swelling on the brain.
An employee was changing the wire on a cheese harp when the wire snapped, hitting the employee in the eye.

An employee was attempting to align the chain and dog ears of a component cyber saw when the spinning saw blade flicked his hand towards the blade teeth, causing an injury that resulted in a thumb amputation. The saw was locked out at the time.
An employee suffered a nose bleed and dizziness while working on a vertical machine, possibly due to coolant exposure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling backer plates using a 5' plate roller. Their glove was caught between the bottom roller and the underside of the plate resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee fell while climbing a stairway and broke a knee.
An employee was unloading a flat bed truck. He slipped off the truck and fell to the ground breaking the left ankle.

An employee was delivering chemicals and removing transfer tubing at a bulk chemical storage tank when residual peracetic acid reacted with an unknown substance, causing off-gassing. The employee was hospitalized with a respiratory injury.
An employee was exiting a racking aisle on a reach truck and collided with another employee in the main aisle traveling on a walkie rider. The employee suffered a contusion fracture to the hip.
On June 26, 2019, an employee reached into an electrical cabinet and received a shock injury to the arm, requiring hospitalization. The cabinet was energized at the time of the incident.

A maintenance employee was removing a conveyor belt. The employee performed lockout/tagout and removed the guard from the V belts and pulley on the side of the head pulley. The employee then began to manually move the V belts over the pulley. His left pinky and ring finger were caught  between the V belt and pulley resulting in amputation of the top 1/4 of the employee's left pinky finger.
An employee was hitching a trailer to a truck when the employee's left pinky finger was pinched between the trailer and the ball of the hitch, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was standing on a third floor fire escape balcony while moving trash debris from an inside apartment unit when the balcony gave way, sending him to the ground below. He suffered head, neck, and knee injuries.
An employee was performing maintenance on a MCC bucket. The fuses went phase-to-phase and shocked the employee. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to the right forearm.
An employee was exiting his truck. As he began to descend the steps, his foot missed a step and he fell to the ground, injuring his head.

An employee was clearing product from the bottom of a load-out hopper. The product was not flowing correctly from the hopper, so the employee tried to remove any obstructions. The electrically driven slide gate valve then closed on and crushed the employee's right forearm, fracturing it.

An employee was assembling shoring to prep for a concrete pour when the employee fell from an approximately 40-inch high platform to the concrete below, breaking the left ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was in a forklift lift cage (man basket) replacing a piece of metal siding. The employee fell out of the man basket 8-10 feet and fractured his right arm. He also sustained a cut on the forehead.
An employee was setting up hoses and a sprayer to spray coat a roof. He fell 30 feet off the roof and fractured bones.
An employee suffered burns to both hands and forearms, the face, and neck, when an arc flash occurred as he opened a 480-volt electrical panel door.

An employee was working outside around noon, putting up a satellite dish outside a house, when he started feeling dizzy and nauseated. He came off his ladder to stand on the ground and was walking to a van to sit in the shade and drink water when he passed out. He was hospitalized for possible dehydration.
An employee was cleaning a fryer when hot oil from the fryer splashed onto and burned his right foot.

An employee was using a vertical belt sander to smooth the edges of a 3-inch by approximately 14-inch piece of steel. The employee used his hands to tilt the back end of the piece of steel upwards in order to sand it at one end when the belt grabbed the piece of steel, causing his left index finger to be caught between the belt and the piece of steel. His left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking toward a container and stepped on a lock bar that was propped up against a container. The lock bar struck the employee in the head. The employee then walked away and fell backwards, hitting their head on the concrete floor. The employee suffered a hairline fracture to the skull.

An employee was unloading a sign trailer and disconnecting a sign from its travel supports. The employee's right arm was caught on the horizontal stiffener (Z-bar). The employee fell off the trailer and suffered a laceration to the right arm from under the arm pit to below the elbow. The brachial artery was severed.
A maintenance employee fell from a scissor lift to the floor while repairing a roof, suffering a skull fracture and bleeding and broken bones in the back.

An employee was working outside most of the day landscaping, tilling, and laying out straw roll. He was driving a tractor tilling the ground when he started to feel exhausted, was excessively sweating, and felt like he was overheating. He went inside to drink some water. He felt nauseous and threw up. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion, an acute kidney injury, and dehydration.

Two employees were engaged in horse playing at the loading dock. One of the employee's forcefully contacted the ground, suffering compression fractures to the T10 and T11 vertebrae and a right elbow contusion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a heat-related injury, becoming nauseous and fatigued, while walking throughout the unit checking valves and preparing the unit for start up.

An employee was removing a paper jam (newspapers) from a stacker when his left hand was caught in the belt and pinched in the pulley wheel, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
At approximately 3:00 p.m., an employee whose shift started at 8:00 a.m. was found unresponsive under a tree due to heat stress.
An employee was walking across a paved parking lot when a strong gust of wind picked him up and slammed him to the pavement. He suffered broken ribs and punctured lungs.
An employee was clearing debris from a running taper machine and suffered a level 2 amputation to the tip of his right middle finger.

An employee was preparing to pull in new electrical power lines with a rope when the rope became entangled in the base of a street sign, causing the sign to become loose and strike the employee in the back. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised left lung, cracked ribs, and bruised vertebrae.
A CCA employee suffered a heat-related injury (confusion and heavy breathing) while training with another employee delivering mail.
An employee was responding to a grease fire on an apartment tenant's stove when the burning grease caused second degree burns to the employee's right hand.

An employee was working inside the belly of an aircraft to dislodge a 6,000-pound container. He reached down to release a lock on a container and his thumb was crushed between the container and the lock. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On June 27, 2019, an employee drove an upright pallet jack into the trailer to retrieve a pallet. He slipped off the pallet jack and his right leg was caught between the pallet jack and the trailer's wall. He sustained a fracture to his right shin and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a meat grinder and amputated the right ring finger.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while directing vehicles coming into the parking lot. The employee suffered chin and ankle injuries.
An employee was assaulted at a rest area along I-95 South by another driver resulting in a broken ankle.

An employee was applying sealant to the roof of a covered bridge when the employee slipped and fell off the roof to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured back and broken right arm.
A crew was removing an old, silt fence.  As the injured employee was reaching for part of the fence to pull it out, a rattlesnake bit the employee's left hand.
An employee was operating a shear and amputated a fingertip on their right hand.
While an employee was inspecting tooling in the storage rack, the lid closed on his hand and smashed his pinky finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was on a scaffold and fell approximately 6 feet to ground resulting in a leg injury.

An employee was pumping chemicals in a hot oiler pump truck. A chemical reaction caused an explosion that propelled the employee into the back of another vehicle. The employee suffered facial contusions.
An employee was working near a machine. His left hand was caught in the machine and lacerated in the metacarpal area. The employee also suffered a torn tendon and a fractured pinky.
While walking in a downdraft paint booth, an employee tripped and fell on the steel grating covering the pit. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was cutting lumber with a cut-off saw when it kicked back and lacerated the employee from the cheek to the chest.
An employee fell off the second step of a crane ladder to the ground while attempting to secure the jib on the crane. The employee suffered a bruised right knee.
An employee fell from the catwalk of an excavator, suffering broken ribs and a bruised left lung.
An employee was working on a metal press when the die broke and his head lunged forward, striking the equipment. He suffered a laceration requiring stitches.
An employee was cutting chicken with a saw when his hand contacted the saw, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was getting equipment from a truck when the truck door closed on him, rupturing a disc in his back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping a flatbed semi driver receive a load. The employee had cut banding on 3 rolled coils of metal. The coils shifted, causing one of them to fall onto the employee. The employee's right leg had to be surgically removed below the knee. The employee also suffered fractures to the left ankle and right wrist.
An employee was climbing up a ladder and lost grip, falling to the floor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a drill press on a 3-inch by 3-inch square of aluminum. The drill bit caught the employee's right glove and amputated the tip of the employee's middle finger.

Employees were cleaning and removing sludge from a pit. A vacuum truck was vacuuming the sludge out of the pit. An employee was using a pressure washer to help make the sludge more flowable.  Another employee was holding the vacuum hose to evacuate the sludge when his foot became stuck in the sludge. The employee operating the pressure washer used it around the other employee's stuck foot in an attempt to free it. The water from the pressure washer penetrated through the top of the employee's boot, injuring the fourth toe of his left foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying a pipe while approaching steps when he dropped the pipe. He went to pick up the pipe and tripped, falling down the steps and injuring his neck, back, and arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a manual concrete bagging machine when his finger became pinched, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation between the fingernail and first knuckle.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration after feeling dizzy and lightheaded while on his route.
An employee was assisting in patient care when the employee stepped on a medical line attached to a piece of equipment, causing the equipment to strike and fracture the employee's left ankle.

An employee got off of a forklift to reposition a steel coil (4,980 pounds, 68 inches high, 5.5 inches wide) that was on the forks of the forklift before setting it on an uncoiler machine when he was struck by the coil. He suffered broken ribs and a punctured right lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning oil off the floor of a turbine unit with a pressure washer at a compressor station when he began to feel dizzy and later experienced headaches. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
A temporary employee was moving boxes by hand from a conveyor onto pallets. He tripped over a pallet jack and fell to the floor breaking the left leg.
An employee was delivering mail when he began feeling sick. He was hospitalized that evening, suffering from heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was cleaning around a walking beam machine. She went to remove the last three channels that were in the machine. Her left arm was lying on the press die when she removed the middle channel and the press came down and lacerated her left forearm.

An employee was operating a crane and changing out a roof-top air conditioner at a school building when the employee began to feel symptoms of heat-related illness, including vomiting and feeling overheated, tired, faint, and weak.
An employee suffered a heat-related illness and began vomiting. The employee was hospitalized.
An 120-pound roll of environmental fabric struck an employee as it rolled off a delivery truck. The employee suffered a dislocated hip.

On June 28, 2019, a maintenance employee was cutting through a damaged highway guardrail with a portable reciprocating saw when the guardrail moved and struck his left forearm, resulting in a tendon laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating an extrusion line and had fed fibers through the roll stand. While he was attempting to separate the strands of fiber, his right middle finger was caught in the roller causing amputation of the fingertip.
An employee got up from her desk to walk away. Her foot got caught in the computer wires underneath the desk. She fell and fractured her left hip and femur.
An employee was operating a multi-vac bag sealer and amputated the left ring and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut slabs of cooked bacon when the saw cut his finger, resulting in an amputation to his right index fingertip.
An employee was working on a lift and was pinched causing a contusion.

An employee was removing a steel wedge from a bending clamp that was used to secure a steel pipe in a bending machine when the wedge came out with force and struck the employee in the head. The employee then fell from the steps he was working from and to the ground, fracturing his skull and back.

While spinning a belt onto a pulley, an employee's right ring and middle fingers were caught and contacted the pulley.  The top of the ring finger was cut off at approximately the top knuckle joint.  The middle finger suffered lacerations and is possibly broken.

An employee was inspecting a mower when his hand went under the deck and made contact with the blade, resulting in amputations of the right-hand index, middle, and ring fingers at the middle phalanges. The mower was running at the time of the incident.

An employee had cut the bands on a bundle of rails in a bunk above him. Three rails rolled off the bunk and two hit the back of his head. He was knocked out for about 30 seconds, then regained consciousness. He suffered bruising in his head area.

An employee was removing a box on a pallet when the strap on the box broke, causing the employee to fall onto the floor and racking system behind him. He suffered a head laceration and a broken right femur.

An employee was standing on a ladder trying to remove an anode when the anode struck him and he fell 4 feet off the ladder onto a dirt berm. He landed on his right waist area and was hospitalized with kidney and liver lacerations.
An employee was descending an 8-foot A-frame ladder and fell approximately two feet. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee grabbed a drilling line that was being used to lift gin poles and the line pulled the employee's hand into the top sheave of the gin poles, smashing four of his left-hand fingers at the mid-knuckle and resulting in an amputation.
An employee exited a tug at the Denver International Airport. Lightening struck near-by equipment and travelled to the employee's leg.
An employee was using a band saw to cut pork steaks when his right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was closing overhead dock doors when the rope attached to the bottom of the door broke and the employee fell off the loading dock to the ground. The employee suffered a cracked vertebra in the neck.
An employee was operating a utility terrain vehicle (UTV). The UTV rolled onto its left side and the employee sustained lacerations and skin damage to the left leg and knee requiring hospitalization.
An employee's muscles cramped up while emptying trash cans due to heat stress.
An employee was working on trucks when his shop rag ignited from a spark, causing his clothing to catch on fire. He sustained burns on his arms and legs and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut wood when the saw cut the employee's right thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.
While planting shrubs at a worksite, an employee suffered heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a tree, fell off the tree and was hospitalized.

An employee was riding in a forklift basket through a warehouse while inventorying insulation rolls. As the forklift placed the basket down, the employee's finger was crushed between the basket and the forklift mast, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was operating a standup forklift and backed into a clamp truck. The employee was caught between the two forklifts and hospitalized for a fractured pelvis.

An employee heard a loud noise coming from the pool pumps. During the employee's investigation of the noise, the pump exploded and trichloroisocyanuric acid splashed onto the employee's face, neck, and chest causing chemical burns.
An employee became ill due to excessive heat exposure and dehydration after delivering mail, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over the leg of a window test wall and fell to the same level, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was climbing down from a tree after cutting a limb when he was struck by lightning, suffering burns.
An employee was working on a canopy when the truss and pole caught and smashed the employee's right pinky finger.

An employee was removing pallets of merchandise from a trailer using a standup forklift when there was a pallet he could not reach. The employee got off the lift to arrange the pallet in such a manner that he could reach it when an unstable pallet next to the pallet he was manipulating fell on and broke his leg.
An employee was installing sheet metal when a panel of the metal slipped out of his hands and cut his left arm, lacerating an artery. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

Employees were "daylighting" (exposing) a 2-inch pipeline in the ground to remove the pipeline. Thirty feet of pipe was already exposed. An excavator was digging down 6 inches to expose the pipeline. When the bucket of dirt was rotated away from the pipeline, the tooth of the bucket struck the pipe causing the far end of the pipe to shift and strike an employee at the far end of the pipeline (30 feet) in the neck and jaw. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured jaw.

An employee was walking from a carwash exit to a detail shop entrance. The employee transitioned from a rock hardscaped island and was stepping down from the curb when he slipped on a steel storm-sewer grate and fell on the surface of the grate. He fractured his left hip.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat-related stress.
An employee was cleaning under a cheese tower conveyor belt when hot water (175  F) was released on the employee, burning the left shoulder and arm.

An employee was moving a mobile unit postal vehicle. He parked the vehicle and proceeded to dismount it. After exiting the vehicle, he turned to face the vehicle to push in the side mirror and was struck by a customer's car. He sustained lacerations to his head and pelvic region, an abrasion to his right elbow, and pain in his right leg.
An employee was performing a manual shutdown of a glass furnace during a power outage when a fire occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's face.
An employee slipped on a wet bathroom floor and the left side of her stomach struck a trash can and the floor. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was delivering mail when he started experiencing stomach cramps and nausea. He was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee was removing a piece of plastic from a conveyor when the conveyor's cradle retracted, caught the tip of his left middle finger, and amputated it (without bone loss).
An employee tripped over an extension cord on the floor and fell to the ground, breaking his right hip.
A maintenance employee was working at the service desk when a customer's child ran into him, causing him to fall. He suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was fitting/welding on a structural type weldment while standing on a ladder approximately 3 to 4 feet off the ground. The employee stepped off the ladder and onto the weldment. The weldment then became unbalanced and fell to the ground. He suffered a fractured left shoulder and broken left ankle.
An employee was manually wrapping a pallet when the wrap broke. He lost his balance and fell to the floor, injuring his left hip.

An employee was part of a crew replacing a joint on a bridge. As he was pushing and pulling to get the joint in position, his finger got caught between the concrete and steel joint, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While working on top of a paint booth, an employee suffered a cut to the left knee from a glass panel.

On July 1, 2019, an employee cleaning a room sprayed cleaning material that was in a spray bottle. The employee inhaled the mist from the spray and suffered an asthma attack, requiring hospitalization.

A lift was being used to place a stack of ten scaffold planks on an erected scaffold. Several planks fell off the lift and hit an employee, pinning the employee's leg between the planks and construction equipment. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
While taking recycling debris to a dumpster, an employee tripped on wooden skids in the path. She fell to the concrete and injured her knees, hand, and elbow. She was hospitalized.
An employee working inside a trench box located in a 9' deep excavation slipped and fell, hitting his head on the trench box spreader bar and suffering a head injury.
An employee fainted due to the heat while working on a roof. The employee was hospitalized.

On July 1, 2019, an employee was on a riding mower cutting grass beside a highway, 20 feet from the concrete shoulder. A vehicle veered to avoid tire debris and struck him on the left side. He suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and other injuries, and was hospitalized.

An employee was holding 1-inch by 2-foot stainless steel duct strapping. The strapping spun when a self-tapping screw was set into it; the employee suffered a laceration at the base of the left thumb. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was loading a machine onto a trailer that was not attached to a truck. The trailer or machine started to move and the employee attempted to dismount the machine. The employee suffered a compound fracture to his right leg.

An employee fell from an 8-foot step ladder while washing down a metal ceiling. The employee was found on the floor unconscious and bleeding from the head, having suffered contusions and brain swelling.
An employee was repairing a palletizer and removed some bolts from the palletizer. A piece of metal then slipped and pinned his right ring finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was flagging a forklift driver when metal slag broke off a piece of steel being welded and hit the employee in the leg, causing a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a linen cart in a hallway. The employee's foot became tangled and the employee fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was holding a cow's tail when part of his index finger was cut off by a hydraulic tail clipper.

An employee was attempting to close a manual valve after flushing a hydraulic choke. When the manual valve would not close, he went to retrieve a tool (wrench) to help close the valve and tripped over a flow line. He fell to the ground and broke his left arm.
An employee was driving an excavator onto a parked trailer when the trailer tipped up and rolled into the back of the truck, pinning a second employee between the trailer and the truck.

On July 1, 2019, an employee was using an air compressor to fill a forklift tire that was mounted to the forklift and attached to a single-piece rim wheel. While the employee was filling the tire it exploded and blew the employee back. The employee hit the wall and suffered a possible concussion.
An employee was disassembling a hydraulic dumper when the carriage assembly came down on his left hand, amputating his middle finger.
An employee was connecting a 3-phase, 460-volt, 50 amp male-to-female plug when an arc flash occurred, burning both of the employee's hands and forearms.
An employee was walking around her supervisor's desk when she tripped on a pallet, fell, and cracked her kneecap.
An employee was adjusting a box maker when it pinched her finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
A forklift struck an employee, breaking his pelvis.
An employee injured his back while pushing a cart of product weighing approximately 600 lbs. up a ramp.
An employee tripped and fell into an elevator that had stopped 8-10 inches above floor level. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a broken humerus.
An employee was attempting to remove a metal lid that had been stamped and was stuck in a punch press die when the press was activated via the foot pedal, causing it to cycle and sever his left hand.
After working a full shift delivering mail, a mail carrier suffered from heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
On July 1, 2019, an employee was attempting to restrain a patient when the patient headbutted him, knocking his head into a television set. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee fell to the ground while walking in a garage, fracturing a wrist.

An employee was climbing back into a dump truck when he lost his balance and fell backwards, striking his head, back, and ribs on the ground. His head required stitches, and his back and ribs were possibly broken.
On 7/1/2019, an employee amputated a finger on machinery.
An employee was on a scaffold doing masonry work when he fell 5 feet to the ground below, suffering broken ribs and requiring hospitalization.

An employee leaned out a doorway and fell 15 feet to the ground after the temporary safety railing failed. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to the hip, pelvis, ribs, and sternum as well as head lacerations.
An employee was manually cutting blackberry canes in the field. The employee sustained heat stroke and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a portable boom lift by driving it from a trailer onto a portable loading ramp. The forward wheel base of the boom pushed the trailer forward and the boom dropped about 18 inches; the employee's right upper arm struck the upper guardrail and was broken.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while driving a tractor, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was 6 feet up an 8-foot ladder. While descending, the employee slipped and fell to the dirt ground, suffering a right shoulder injury.

An employee was on the roof on his knees drilling holes on the edge of a building with a hammer drill. He used force to push the hammer drill into the concrete edge of the building and strained his left knee.
An employee was unloading a tree (approximately 1,500 lbs.) from a truck when the tree fell on top of him. He was hospitalized with rib fractures.
An employee was near a truck loaded with pipes when a pipe shifted and rolled off the truck. The employee was pinned between the pipe and a stack of pipes, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee suffered an amputation of the left index finger to the first knuckle while working on a metal press.

An employee was operating a table saw to make cuts on a die holder (16-18 inches L, 4x4 wood) when his fingers made contact with the rotating blade. The employee suffered a complete amputation of the left ring finger and a partial thumb amputation (to the first knuckle).
An employee was sitting power tongs down on a base. The employee's right hand was resting on the rig where the tongs come down and the tongs smashed and deeply cut the employee's right thumb.

A forklift was used to lift a set wall, which weighed several hundred pounds, so an employee could shim it. The forklift blade was inserted beneath a metal beam that the 10' by 8' wall sat on, causing the beam to bend when it was lifted. When the employee attempted to shim the wall, his left pinky finger was crushed/pinched, resulting in a partial amputation.

A forklift operator was loading plastic pipe onto a trailer. The forklift backed up and ran over another employee's leg. The injured employee suffered a laceration to the leg and broken bone in the ankle.
An employee was using a handheld knife to cut meat. The knife cut his left index finger.
An employee was moving masonry blocks when he dropped a block on his hand, pinching his fingertip. As a result, his fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it collided with a stack of wooden pallets. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was using fish tape to retrieve a broken rope that had been used to pull wires from a 480-volt panel when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered third degree burns to the arms.

A crew was finishing setup of crane outriggers and then prepared to switch from a 3-sheave block to a headache ball/pill. An employee was helping to un-reeve the crane block. The operator swung the crane over to the side and placed the block on level ground. He got down from operator's cab and checked to ensure it would not topple over under its own weight. He then helped the employee remove pins from the block to remove the rope. The crane operator then went up onto the crane and heard the employee yelling. The block from the crane had shifted and pulled the wire rope down, causing the rope to tighten up. The employee's finger was caught between the crane boom tip sheave and wire rope. The crane operator ran to pick up the block and relieve tension on the wire rope. The employee suffered an amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee's right ring and little fingers were caught in a swinging door with a self-closure hinge. Both fingertips were partially amputated.

At the chill dock, an employee who was picking orders dismounted a pallet jack and was struck by the pallet jack, suffering a fractured tibia. The pallet jack had not made a complete stop at the time of the incident.

An employee was servicing a baling machine on a farm. A hydraulic lever was activated and the employee was caught in the machine, suffering a severe laceration (with possible nerve damage) to the left bicep.
An employee was moving kegs and a pallet onto a truck when a keg slid into another keg and crushed the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was walking in wet grass to get to the office when the employee fell on the grass, breaking the right ankle.

At approximately 9:30 a.m. on July 2, 2019, an employee was walking on a ship cableway located on the port side of the space en route to the port forward corner of the space when he tripped on the cableway and fell. As he fell, his calf impacted and was impaled by a U-channel bracket that was holding up the raceway. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on an area rug in a hallway and fell to the wood floor, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was moving the chute on a ready-mix truck. The chute was opened and the employee's right-hand fingers were caught between two folding parts of the chute. The middle and little fingers were broken and the ring finger was dislocated.

An employee was moving merchandise from a trailer truck when the employee was hit by three king-size headboards while pushing a hand dolly outside the trailer. The employee suffered a right-side head and shoulder injury (contusion).
An employee was working on overhead lines in the bucket of an aerial lift when the employee was overcome by heat and had to be hospitalized for a heat stress-related injury.

An employee was helping another employee (the operator) operate a press machine. The employee was feeding rubber into the press machine, which punches 1-inch-diameter holes in the rubber, when the punch came down and amputated his fourth and fifth fingers.

On July 2, 2019, an employee had been bending down to take temperature measurements from solar panels. The next morning, he awoke with a pinching sensation and pain. He was hospitalized with a herniated disc.

An employee was working on a residential roof when she went to get additional screws. As she was walking, she stepped on an ISO board that was hanging off of the roof and fell down to the surface below, fracturing her ankle and the base of her spine. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was joining rail links when a bolt (1" diameter X 6" long) failed to line up. The employee struck the bolt with a hammer and it jumped out, striking the employee's leg. The employee sustained a left lower leg fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was taking photographs at the main entrance of the park and then went on a break. The employee was found on the floor of the stock room/break area and was hospitalized with cardiac arrhythmia and heat stress related symptoms.
An employee was holding a screw when the metal shaping machine came down and crushed the tip of the employee's thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was walking outside to take out a customer order when the employee stepped off the curb and fell, fracturing the lower tibia and sustaining a ligament injury to the ankle.
On July 2, 2019, an employee was operating a chop saw when his left index finger contacted the spinning blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

After inspecting an HVAC unit on a roof, an employee was coming down from the roof on a ladder when the ladder kicked out, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee broke both wrists and both ankles.

An employee was attempting to pull a motor out of a sump tank when both eye bolts on the hoisting rig snapped, dropping the motor on top of the employee's right hand. The employee received multiple lacerations and broken bones on the right hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a vertical panel saw when it cut the employee's left little finger.

An employee was making adjustments on a flag indicator for a block unloader machine. The employee had climbed up onto a 12-foot-high block rack to access the flags and make the adjustments. The employee placed his right hand on the track as the unloader returned to gather another row of palletized bricks. The unloader then crushed his fingers, resulting in broken bones, cuts, and severed tendons in the right index finger, as well as cuts and a partially severed tendon to the right middle finger.
At about 1:00 p.m. on July 3, 2019, a truck driver returned to work after a shift and became ill. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on a chain roll when the employee's left index finger came into contact with the chain roll, resulting in amputation.
An employee was operating a table saw, which cut his hand. He was hospitalized and part of his index finger was medically amputated.
A pile rack was being lifted during bridge construction. A piece of the load slipped off the rack and struck an employee, causing fractures to the scapula and pelvis.
An employee had just inspected hail damage on a one-story roof and was coming down a ladder to inspect a gutter. The employee fell from the ladder and broke both legs.
An employee was removing thread protectors and was caught between two joints of pipe. The employee suffered four broken ribs and was hospitalized.
Two employees were working out of a bucket truck moving a service line higher up an existing utility pole. Both employees were shocked and hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail and started feeling bad due to heat exhaustion and dehydration. He was hospitalized.
On July 3, 2019, an employee suffered from dehydration while working on roofing activities.
An employee had been picking squash in the fields all day. He sustained heat stroke and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken collarbone.

An employee was manually rolling pipe on a pipe rack when his right thumb was crushed between the pipe and rack, resulting in a partial amputation of the skin and a bone fracture on the top digit of his right thumb.
An employee slipped and fell while getting out of a truck, suffering a broken rib and punctured lung.

On July 3, 2019, two employees were off the clock and in the parking lot, inside one of the employee's privately owned vehicle. One of the employees was accidentally shot in the leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was holding a piece of material in place for a bandsaw. When the clamps were closed, the employee's little finger was smashed between the clamps and the material. The fingertip was amputated.
On July 3, 2019, an employee was struck by a powered industrial truck that was moving in reverse, resulting in a right foot injury.
After delivering packages, an employee became dizzy and light-headed due to heat stress and dehydration. He was hospitalized.
An employee was in a yard starting a gas-powered air compressor. As the compressor started, a flash fire burned his left arm and face. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a radial arm saw to cut 2 X 4's and 2 X 6's, both 4 feet and 8 feet, into 2-foot pieces when the blade grabbed his glove, pulling his right hand into the saw. This resulted in a middle fingertip amputation midway down the nail. His ring finger on his right hand was cut almost completely off at the first knuckle.
An employee was stripping concrete forms while tied into a form. The employee's lanyard became unattached and the employee fell 14-16 feet, suffering fractures to the back and wrist.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when the ladder's footing slipped out and it fell. The employee fell to the ground, suffering knee and head injuries.

An employee was helping set up a crane jib. The jib fell about 7 feet and hit the employee's left ankle, causing a laceration and fracture to the ankle as well as lacerations to the left middle and ring fingers (with no bone loss).

An employee was installing cable in a customer's attic when he fell through the drywall ceiling and landed on a rafter between his legs. He suffered an injury that required surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee was working as a material handler on the back side of an aluminum extrusion machine when the employee's arms and legs started cramping. The employee was hospitalized with a heat injury.

An employee was cleaning a thermoplastic cart. The thermoplastic was being drained into a 55-gallon metal drum and was heated. The drum had trash in it and the thermoplastic heated up some aerosol paint cans that were not visible and caused them to explode.  The explosion threw the hot thermoplastic on the employee's head and arms, causing burns.
An employee was changing the elevated blade on a bulldozer when the blade slipped, resulting in a full left middle finger amputation.

An employee was using a hoist to lower round stock into a module after a grinding operation. He was controlling the hoist pendant in his left hand and guiding the lifting sling with his right middle finger. The sling was being pulled up by the hoist, its loose end drawn through the bars. The bars were not separated at each end to have space for the sling to move freely and they rolled, pinching his finger. The sling was then drawn through the bars with his finger still attached. His finger was trapped in the hole of the sling, causing a partial amputation.

A temporary employee had been picking up trash cans and dumping them in the rear loader of a garbage truck. At the time of the incident, he was helping the truck driver back up in the street. As the driver was backing up, the employee's right hand (finger) was caught between the rear loader and a 4 x 4 piece of wood, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was operating a forklift inside a truck when the truck began to pull away. The employee jumped out of the forklift and broke both heels.
An employee was working on grain fertilizer equipment. The cheater bar he was using slipped, causing him to fall and break his leg.
While unloading a trailer, an employee experienced muscle cramping due to dehydration.

An employee was cutting a top round steak at 1/8 inch, at a customer's request. His hand slipped and contacted the saw blade partially amputating the left middle fingertip. The blade was not guarded at the time.

An employee was working on a 28-foot extension ladder that was leaned against a telephone pole.  While he was coming back down, the ladder shifted and he jumped to the uneven ground and landed on his feet. He fractured both ankles and was hospitalized for surgery.
While changing out the belt on a conveyor, an employee was caught in the machine, suffering a broken arm and lacerations.

An employee was preparing to lift and move a 25-foot, 1,897-pound structural beam from a conveyor system with a crane. He was using a lifting chain to make the lift when the thumb on his left hand was caught between the chain and the structural beam, resulting in a thumb fracture.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was removing leaves from gutters. The employee returned to the truck to get water, lost consciousness due to heat stress and dehydration, and struck their head on the truck. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee fell 4 feet from a boat while removing shrink wrap and landed on the concrete floor below. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip.
An employee was walking outside, slipped and fell on the ground resulting in a fractured right ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee fell about 12 feet to the ground while descending an extension ladder at a customer location, fracturing his pelvis.
An employee was performing a preventive maintenance procedure on a drum/thigh separator when the employee's finger contacted the blade, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a press machine when the machine amputated his right middle finger.
An employee was guiding a load being lifted by a crane. The employee's right little finger was caught between the crane hook and the load and partially amputated.

An employee was guiding a concrete barrier onto a flatbed trailer. The barrier crumbled in the employee's hand, causing him to lose his balance and fall off the trailer. He struck his head on the crane tire rim and suffered a laceration to the rear crown of his head.
An employee was cutting parsley with a knife, which amputated the tip of the employee's index finger.
An employee was walking across the floor to inspect an eyewash station. The employee slipped and fell on the wet floor, suffering a broken right ankle and right wrist, and was hospitalized.
An employee stepped off his powered equipment and it pinned his left foot against a tier rack. The foot was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
On July 4, 2019, an employee was inserting a part into a pneumatic vise. The employee's finger was pinched between the part and the vise, causing a fingertip amputation.
On July 4, 2019, an employee was changing a blade on a derinder machine. The machine fell onto the employee, lacerating the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling a hole in a concrete wall with a hammer drill. His right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a trim press in a forge shop with tongs and a swab. He was putting oil on the trim press when the machine was activated, causing a partial amputation to his right index finger and the next two fingers.
An employee was removing a jammed tortilla from a tortilla machine. The machine grabbed and cut his hand.
An employee was hanging a hose on a wall-mounted rack. The hose sprayed hot water on the employee, causing second-degree burns to his torso and right arm.
An employee was bitten by an insect. The bite became infected, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a customer who was in a powered scooter. She fell; the scooter ran over her left wrist (causing pain) and injured her left leg (causing bruising and swelling).
An employee was using a bending machine when it cycled on his right hand, amputating the tip of his thumb above the knuckle.
An employee was building pallets using a nail gun. As he bent down to nail a pallet, the gun fired into his leg, lodging a nail into his knee.
An employee was placing freight inside a trailer. The trailer pulled away from the dock and the employee fell to the ground, suffering injuries to the right leg, right hip, and left arm.

On July 5, 2019, an employee was working in a flatbed trailer area, consolidating corrugated metal culverts on a pallet at ground level. The employee lifted one end of a culvert and it slipped and cut the employee's left ring and little fingers. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was hospitalized after being struck in the head by a falling pipe.
While moving tables for a banquet, an employee suffered a sprained right middle finger. The finger became infected, and the employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was using a pneumatic staple gun to secure components of a wooden truss together. The gun shot a staple into the knuckle of the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning up a conveyor system. The employee's left index finger was crushed and amputated in the system.
An employee was operating a press using a foot pedal. As he was changing the die, the machine cycled and the press came down on his left hand. The tips of his ring and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee tripped over the corner of a pallet and fell, suffering injuries to the right elbow and leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was manually moving material to finish fabrication. The angle rolled over the employee's finger, smashing it between the sawhorse and material. His fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning a condenser coil on a rooftop unit. The access plate slipped while the employee was reinstalling it, and the employee's hand went into the unit's fan blade. The employee suffered severe lacerations to the right thumb, index, and middle finger and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a beam saw to cut cabinet parts. The clamp of the saw came down and amputated the tips of the employee's left ring and middle fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was putting material on metal racks using a forklift. The forklift struck the racks, which fell on him and broke his jaw. He was hospitalized.
An employee was testing the repair of an electrical cord. An arc flash from the cord burned the employee.
A machine activated during material changeover, inserting a rivet into a finger on an employee's left hand.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it moved. She jumped off to avoid a fall and suffered a broken ankle and minor cuts to the face and arms.
An employee was installing labels on the insides of cones when she became ill. She was hospitalized the next day for dehydration.
An employee was cleaning excess batter from a batter machine. His left hand was caught in the machine; three fingers were broken and his palm was lacerated.

An employee was working in and out of a customer's attic pulling fiber optic cable. The employee's body began cramping, with muscle contractions. The employee was hospitalized for severe dehydration causing kidney failure.
An employee was pushing a metal hopper when the wheel became caught in the grating. The hopper tipped over and struck the employee in the leg, breaking the employee's tibia.
An employee was loading cardboard into a baler. She tripped over a pallet and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.
Employees were moving a cart full of metal product. One of the employees was pushing the cart when his left little finger was caught between the cart and the product and partially amputated.

An employee was helping start up an extruder, pulling the sheet over the mandrel for string-up. The sheet bunched up on the bar of the mandrel blade, and the blade amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a sealing machine when the lower die moved. The employee's left index finger was caught between the lower and upper dies, sustaining a partial amputation.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a head injury.
An employee was clearing stuck slices of bread from a bread slicer. The blade amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee stepped on a tack. The employee's left foot became infected, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. The jack hit a bollard, and the employee stepped off. The jack then pinned his right leg against the bollard, causing a break above the ankle.
An employee was cleaning a skewer in a meat prep room when she slipped on wash water and fell to the floor, breaking her right radius and ulna.
An employee was working on a stud mill machine. The machine amputated the employee's left thumb, index finger, and middle finger.
An employee suffered heat illness (vomiting, cramps, and dizziness) while slabbing cores.
An employee was cleaning out an outdoor fire pit when he began feeling ill and had difficulty speaking. He was hospitalized due to heat stress.

An employee was cleaning up water on the floor of the facility. She finished cleaning the water spot and took a step away from the area and slipped and fell to the floor. She sustained a fractured right hip and right knee contusion, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was assisting on a refiner in a paperboard mill. While his hand was in a drain, a valve was opened and hot water splashed onto and severely burned his right hand and wrist.
An employee was putting up a fence on a construction site when he experienced heat-related cramping, pain, and nausea. He was hospitalized.
An employee was closing a door when he tripped on a 2-inch lip and fell, hitting his head on the doorframe.
An employee working as a cashier was shot during a robbery attempt.
An employee was on the second floor of an apartment complex, collecting trash at each door, when he became lightheaded and dizzy. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

On July 7, 2019, an employee arrived at a gated residence to deliver a shipment. The front door was located in the rear of the residence past the garage. To access the front porch, the employee entered the gated property. The employee was then attacked by a dog and hopped over the fence, hitting the ground and landing on the tailbone. The employee was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.

An employee was operating a plastic extrusion line. The employee was using a hand tool to scrape excess plastic from the end of the line when a pocket of hot gas and plastic erupted and burned the employee's hands and forearm.
An employee was in the parking lot collecting carts and collapsed. She had been outside for approximately 15 minutes before collapsing. She was hospitalized for a heat induced seizure.

An employee was moving an overhead, empty 500-gallon fuel tank with a truck-mounted crane and chains when the chain came loose and the tank fell on top of the employee. He sustained a femoral fracture, rib fracture, and medial tibia fracture, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down stairs while delivering mail, suffering leg fractures.
An employee was changing out an emergency lighting fixture. The employee was shocked and fell from a filing cabinet to the ground, suffering back and shoulder fractures.
Two maintenance employees were investigating a water leak on a furnace when the furnace exploded, causing hand, neck, knee, and leg burns to both employees.

An employee was guiding a guardrail post out of the ground. It released from the hole with force and jumped up. The employee's right hand was pinched between the post and the boom of the puller machine, causing an amputation of soft tissue on the ring finger.
An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder conducting repairs. He fell from the ladder to the floor, breaking his right femur.
An employee had been performing landscaping work. While riding in the truck after leaving the job site, the employee experienced cramping in the legs. He was hospitalized with heat stress.
An employee had left a roof during a lightning storm and was entering his work van. Lightning struck the ground and the employee was shocked as he entered the van.
An employee became ill while installing irrigation pipe. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat fatigue.
An employee was on the back of a flatbed truck, cutting with a torch. The employee lost consciousness due to heat/dehydration and was hospitalized.

On July 8, 2019, an employee was using a forklift (to unload a heater from a truck) when it caught fire. The employee suffered second and third degree burns to 40 percent of his body and hospitalized.
A loose belt on a gluer caught an employee's right hand, causing the amputation of the little fingertip and lacerations on the ring and middle fingers.
An employee was working to prep rebar lines, an activity that involved a lot of movement. He experienced cramping and was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
A steel construction employee was hospitalized with heat stress symptoms.
An employee lost consciousness while typing at his desk and fell to the floor. He suffered a fractured shoulder and compression fractures to vertebrae in his back, and was hospitalized.
An employee was kneeling down to retrieve parcels from a pallet. The employee's knee gave out and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken foot/ankle.
A forklift fork slid off its slide rail, striking and fracturing an employee's left big toe.
An employee fell 20 feet from a mast to the ground, suffering a broken wrist.
An employee was using a handheld hydraulic crimping tool. A hose failed and injected the employee's left flank with hydraulic fluid.
An employee was pulling weeds and trimming bushes using a hedge trimmer. The trimmer severed the employee's first finger and severely cut the second finger.

An employee was closing the back door of a dump truck when he slipped on debris on the ground. He grabbed the bottom edge of the entranceway and the door shut on his finger. The tip was amputated and later reattached at the hospital.

An employee was helping unload metal piping material at a delivery location. While he was repositioning piping that had become crooked during unloading, the pipes shifted and his left hand was smashed between them. He suffered the  amputation of the little finger.

Two employees were checking on a clogged dust collector at a baghouse unit outside a facility. After the bag had been removed, one of the employees tried to unclog the collector. The fan blades amputated the employee's right middle and index fingertips.

An employee was trying to unjam a conveyor of pipe when the conveyor actuated. His right hand was caught between the conveyor and the pipe, and his middle finger, ring finger, and little finger were amputated. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was cutting plastic during packaging and it wrapped around his leg. He fell, breaking his left hip.
An employee fell about 30 feet through a metal roof. The employee suffered facial fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a loaded dumpster on wheels. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the lid and the hinge, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was welding on a pipe bracket between a pumphouse and tank batteries at a salt water disposal site. A flash fire burned the employee.
An employee was on the fifth rung of a ladder, securing it to the wall. The ladder's feet slid out and the employee fell to the concrete floor, breaking his wrist.

An employee was performing maintenance on a natural gas compressor. He was turning over an engine by barring over when his left pinky finger was caught between the bar and the guard for the bull wheel. Two centimeters of the tip were amputated.

An employee was lifting the elevator chain of a 1,200-ton press to place on a gear. The counterweight fell and the employee's left middle finger was caught in the elevator chain, suffering an amputation/crushing injury to the fingertip.
An employee fell about 6.5 feet from the utility body of a truck and suffered a wrist injury. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was painting equipment from a platform approximately 30 inches high when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, fracturing his right hip and requiring surgery.
An employee fell from a stepladder to the gravel and concrete ground, suffering a compound fracture of the lower right leg.
An employee's left ring finger was caught in a door as she closed it. She suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hit and knocked to the ground by a fellow team member.

At about 11:45 a.m. on July 8, 2019, an employee was working with a crane operator to flip a sheet of steel piling with two shakeout hooks hung from the crane. While the sheet of piling was being lifted, a hook became dislodged and struck the employee in the right leg, breaking the tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
On July 8, 2019, an employee was making an adjustment under a round bailer when the accumulator was activated and moved downward. It crushed the employee against the ground, breaking ribs.
An employee was pulled into a coil line machine when her right arm was caught between a coil line belt and a straight bar going across the belt. The arm was broken in two places.
An employee was dislodging a forklift from a drain. The employee's hand was caught between two forklift cages, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered a leg injury while climbing into a jockey truck. The employee was hospitalized.

At 12:30 p.m. on July 8, 2019, an employee was helping supervise the unloading of a truck with a forklift. A package tilted over while the forklift was moving and fell onto the employee. He was hospitalized to treat a head injury (requiring 18 stitches) and a fractured vertebra.
An employee was pulling an empty lumber cart when his left index finger was caught between it and another cart. The fingertip was amputated.
While removing a power swivel and tank from a drill site, two employees sustained chemical burns on their legs from an unknown caustic chemical.

An employee was travelling in an ATV to the worksite. The ATV passed through tall grasses, fireweed, and cow parsnip. The employee had an allergic reaction to the local vegetation which affected the eyes, skin, and airway and required hospitalization.

An employee fell from a ladder to the crushed concrete ground while hanging security cameras on the outside of a building. The employee suffered a broken and dislocated left elbow, a broken right wrist, and a laceration to the floorhead.
An employee suffered heat-related illness (vomiting, dehydration, kidney function issue) while hanging steel. The employee was hospitalized.

On July 9, 2019, an employee was being trained to calibrate an oxygen test bench. He was lying on the floor under the bench during a simulated repair when a 40-pound counterweight's cable broke loose. The counterweight fell from 3 to 4 feet above the floor onto his head. He suffered a broken eye socket and possible skull fracture and was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting with moving a large medical cart. The cart's legs caught on a door jam during the move and the equipment fell onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the back and hand.

An employee was in-cutting a steel slab with a portable burning machine. The machine did not cut all the way through the slab. The employee bent down to turn off the machine and the end of the slab broke loose, causing the machine to come down and hit the employee in the back of the head. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from a laceration and bleeding.

On July 9, 2019, a maintenance technician was replacing the plastic wrap at the pin and arm of a baler machine when the arm moved toward him causing him to be caught between the arm and door of the baler. He sustained two rib fractures and a contusion to the kidney and was hospitalized.
After installing grounding wire in rebar mats, an employee became dehydrated and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a beef shank with a meat saw when a bone struck the blade causing the item to flip. The meat cutter blade caught the employee's right index finger and the employee sustained an amputation.
An employee was climbing down from the back of a semi truck when he fell to the ground and sustained a broken leg.
An employee was hand-digging to access a natural gas line. He became ill and was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress/exhaustion.
An employee fell five feet ten inches from a rebar wall mold to the ground below and suffered a concussion and a fractured hand.

An employee was pulling plastic film on a patch line when a wrap-around occurred on the core.  The employee's hand became entangled in the material and came into contact with the core. The employee's left arm was broken.

An employee had been tying rebar prior to pouring concrete at work. The employee finished work and when he got home he was getting cramps. Later, the employee felt sick, fainted, and was hospitalized for a heat injury.
An employee lost balance, fell on the floor, and sustained a right knee injury.
An employee slipped while climbing a rack. The employee's ring was caught on a metal crate resulting in amputation of the ring finger.

An employee was moving some equipment with an electric power jack. When she dismounted, her foot got caught under the machine and sustained a crushing injury. The employee was later hospitalized with a swollen foot.
An employee was shoveling wood chips in a sawmill near a chipper conveyor. He fell and broke his leg. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

At about 7:00 p.m. on July 9, 2019, at an employee was putting equipment in the back of a pickup truck when the truck backed up, running the employee over. The employee suffered fractures to the upper left arm, the left femur, the left-side pelvis, and three ribs on the left side.
An employee had cramps after a work shift and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when he fell, suffering a broken heel and hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was welding a spigot to a 55-gallon drum's lid. Flammable residue caused the drum to explode and the lid struck the employee, causing a facial fracture and a laceration to the right arm.

Two employees were traveling in a UTV on a gravel road. The UTV slipped off the road. While it was being maneuvered back onto the road it slipped and hit a tree. The driver was ejected and suffered a broken femur and knee damage; the passenger suffered fractures to the ankle and arm and a head laceration. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee's right foot was caught on the edge of a guardrail and she fell, injuring her right knee. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
While tracing security camera conduit lines, an employee fell 28 feet from a second-level platform to a platform outside a grain receiving control room. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was using a production band saw to cut beef. The saw amputated the tip of his finger.
On 7/9/19, an employee slipped on water on the floor by the nurse's station and broke an elbow, requiring hospitalization.
After collecting carts, an employee had trouble breathing and was hospitalized with a heat related illness.
An employee was retrieving 9-inch rebar from a saw when the saw actuated and amputated the tip of his thumb.
An employee was operating a metal brake shear when his left little finger was caught in the machine's hold-down. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was throwing brush into a chipper. A guy wire attached to the brush caught the employee, pulled him to the ground, and caused severe lacerations to his back and arm.
On July 9, 2019, an employee was using a low-pressure washing system when it failed. A hose or fitting from the system struck the employee in the ankle and broke it.
On July 9, 2019, an employee was using a pneumatic handle press when it came down on his right thumb and forefinger, amputating the tip of his thumb.
An employee fell from a ladder and suffered a broken wrist and a contusion over one eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was hanging drywall from a scissor lift. The employee fell off the scissor lift after having an apparent seizure. The employee landed on the floor and sustained brain swelling, a broken back, and a broken neck.

An employee was in the passenger seat of a vehicle, winding a trimming string. The loose string caught on a tire, wrapped around the employee's fingers, and tightened until it severed the tips of his left ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was loading a trailer when he became dizzy and sat down. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee suffered dehydration and possible kidney failure and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking beside a skid steer, adjusting the width on the skid swing arm. The skid steer ran over the employee's left leg, breaking the tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.
While working on a network panel, an employee fell through the panel into an opening and broke four ribs.
An employee was wrapping a pallet with shrink wrap when another employee noticed he was acting strange and seemed confused. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was bitten by a spider while stocking shelves in a warehouse. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was mixing concrete using a drill with a paddle attachment. The employee's right middle finger got caught in the drill and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was moving freight inside a truck when his pallet jack became stuck on a pallet. The employee tugged on the pallet jack to free it. When the pallet jack became free it began rolling toward the employee. He fell off the lift gate onto the parking lot, landing on his left elbow and side. He sustained a broken left arm.
An employee fell from a swing set to the ground, suffering a broken vertebra in his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a steel trolley. The employee's left thumb was caught between the trolley and a door frame, causing a loss of tissue and the nail.
An employee was working on a door latch when it closed on his left ring finger. The skin beneath the fingernail was amputated.
An employee was spreading a gasket for sound wall installation. The vacuum lifter released and dropped the barrier, which crushed his right hand.
An employee was unloading pipes from trucks. The employee began to suffer cramps from the heat and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack. It collided with a parked stand-up forklift, whose forks cut and fractured the employee's right foot.

An employee was loading 50-pound bags of chocolate into a commercial-grade mixer. The employee slipped and fell into the mixer, where the agitator broke the employee's left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's right index fingertip was caught in a belt and pulley and amputated.

A forklift operator and two spotters were removing a 600-pound pump from a paper machine's virgin pulper. The pump was being lifted by nylon straps, attached to the tines of the forklift, when it became stuck on a pipe flange. The pump disengaged from the housing and started to swing, striking one of the spotters twice in the right leg. The employee received a laceration to the right thigh and another to the right knee, and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when the pallet jack rolled over his foot, resulting in hospitalization and surgery for a fractured foot.
An employee was opening bag of lettuce when the knife slipped and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was completing a transaction at the register when they tripped over the scanner's cord and fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to the face.
An employee was cleaning up residual igniter powder when the igniter powder flashed, causing second and third degree burns to both hands.
