An employee was servicing equipment when his right hand was caught between a roller and a drum and his right-hand fingers were amputated.
An employee was assisting the operator of a window sill mold press. The machine cycled in reverse while the employee's hand was inside resulting in amputations to the right ring and pinky fingertips.
An employee was conducting a grading operation and cutting down a 25-foot tree for new homes to be built. The tree struck the employee and fractured the right hip.
An employee was putting product away in a warehouse. While walking backwards he struck a stack of pallets, fell and sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was cleaning the rig floor and felt sick from dehydration.

After an employee had completed a delivery, the boom lift was moving back into position and struck the employee in the chest. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the right side ribs.
An employee was plunge-cutting a 2x4 for an outlet using a circular saw. The saw grabbed the wood and then lacerated the employee's wrist.

An employee was reversing an unloaded powered buggy down a concrete ramp. The ramp was damp from the rain. The buggy slid as it was descending the ramp and struck a tandem dump truck that was parked near the base of the ramp. The employee's ankle/leg was caught between the wheeled buggy and the dump truck and the employee sustained a fracture to the left ankle/fibula.

An employee was operating a CNC wood router table. As he reached for a loose piece of wood, his hand was struck by the router bit resulting in the amputation of his right pinky finger to the first knuckle.

A Brock employee was installing insulation in or near the vent drum of an aerator when hot water condensate released out of a steam line directly above the employee. The employee sustained second degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was rigging four sets of pipe from around 12:30 PM to 2:30 PM. The employee then began to feel ill. The employee sustained heat stress and kidney failure.
An employee was setting up a new product line for plastic bottles. The employee's finger was caught in a mold, causing an amputation.

An employee was line trimming and edging at multiple properties throughout the day. When he returned back to the branch at 3:00 PM, he was showing signs of a heat illness. After about an hour, the employee's condition did not improve and he was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a mobile conveyor when it fell and landed on their foot fracturing it.

An employee was at the feeding table, feeding molding/wood pieces into the wrapping machine. The employee complained of chest pains and then slumped over a pallet of wood. She was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

A machinist was drilling a core out of a part with a drill press when their glove became entangled resulting in a broken wrist, broken fingers, and a partial amputation of the right index finger past the first knuckle.
After their work shift, an employee began to feel sick, light headed, had stomach cramping and was ill. The employee was hospitalized for possible dehydration.
An employee was carrying two plastic drums/containers when the top one bounced. It pinched and fractured his left thumb between the two containers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was testing the low side of a transformer. The test equipment exploded and the employee sustained arc flash burns to the face.

An employee was moving a piece of aluminum into a furnace. The aluminum fell off the forklift that was transporting it, landed in molten aluminum, and created a splash that caused molten aluminum to burn the employee's arm.
An employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee backed up a tugger to attach it to a transport rack. After the employee dismounted the tugger, his fingers were caught between the tugger and a part on the transport rack. He sustained the amputation of the right middle fingertip and a contusion to the ring finger.
An employee working from a platform lost their footing and fell to the ground 28 inches below. The employee's ankle was fractured.

Two temporary employees working in the forming area were involved in a physical altercation. During the altercation the two employees grabbed one another and fell to the ground. One employee fell on the other employee. The employee that was fallen on sustained a fractured right ankle.

Two employees were removing a screw from a high-speed injection molding machine. As they were removing the screw tip, pressurized molten plastic was released through an opening around the screw tip which resulted in both employees being burned by the molten plastic. They sustained burns to the forehead, right neck, face, right arm, and right hand. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attaching a sensor to a robot arm. When he manually released the clamp, it closed on his left pinky causing a fracture and partial amputation.
An employee was removing wood debris from a planer machine when his right hand was caught in the machine. His index and middle fingers on the right hand were amputated.
An employee was walking to her desk, tripped over a raised floor tile, and fell hitting her head on the desk. She sustained a laceration above the left eye.
An employee was working on a drilling rig as a pipe was being raised out of the hole. The pipe struck the employee resulting in hospitalization for broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a broken back.
An employee was inserting a shaft into a cardboard core on the winder machine when his right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a stand-up mower to mow a lawn. The mower slid approximately 10 feet down a hill and hit a board. The employee fell off the mower and the mower ran over his left foot lacerating the heel.
An employee was moving a 55-gallon metal drum onto a pallet when his left middle finger became caught between two barrels. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on an air conditioning unit. Two fingers on the right hand were lacerated when they came in contact with the fan blade.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw. The wood jerked and caused his hand to slip and contact the saw blade. The tip of his pinky finger was amputated below the fingernail, and two other fingers were cut.
An employee was monitoring ladles and was hospitalized due to heat related illness.
An employee was preparing to cut a de-energized and grounded primary cable. An energized cable was cut and the employee was burned by an arc flash and hospitalized.

An employee was changing a tooth on the bucket of an excavator. He was using a hammer and chisel to remove the tooth when a piece of the tooth fragmented and struck him on the left wrist and in the stomach. The employee sustained an internal injury to the stomach resulting in surgery.

An employee operating a tire shredder was using a pry bar to free a jammed tire from the tire shredder's conveyor guard. The employee's hands became caught between the pry bar and the guard. The employee sustained four fractured metacarpal bones in the left hand and the right thumb was amputated and later reattached.
An employee was installing culvert ends. While removing a temporary light, the light fell and struck his head. He was hospitalized with scalp and facial lacerations.
An employee was changing a die on a stretch blow molding machine when the die press fell and crushed his right hand, resulting in index and middle finger amputations.
An employee working on a roof was sweating profusely and had pain in their side. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
On 7/10/2019, an employee fainted while riding a self-propelled walk-behind mower. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration on his forehead.

An employee walked from the sales area to the cash register. From the cash register, the employee started to turn and then fell to the floor. The employee stood up and walked away. Later, the employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip and femur.
An employee was clearing out an 8" pelletizer. The employee's hand got caught in the pelletizer resulting in the amputation of the thumb and index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.
While operating a one-yard cement mixer, a temporary employee (working for Express Employment) was caught and entangled by the mixer. The employee suffered a crushed left forearm and lacerations.
An employee was working from a ladder replacing a fan belt. The employee fell 12 feet to the floor and was hospitalized with head trauma.

An employee was troubleshooting an aircraft from the cockpit. The employee exited the left side of the cockpit and stepped on the engine intake. When his weight shifted to his right foot, his foot slipped off the intake and he fell off the aircraft. He sustained a compound fracture to the wrist that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee suffered heat-related cramping on returning to the ground after cutting/trimming trees.

On July 10, 2019, an employee pressed the button to raise a dock plate, but the dock plate did not lift all the way on the left side. He went to raise it by hand and it fell, pinching his left hand between the plate and the dock resulting in amputation of the ring fingertip.

An employee was learning to climb a utility pole using a climbing strap and spikes. As he was descending, he lost balance and his weight shifted. His climbing spike became stuck in the pole, causing his knee to buckle. This resulted in a dislocated knee and fractured tibia.
When a boom fell, a 5-inch concrete delivery pipe attached to the boom struck an employee in the leg resulting in a compound fracture of the right femur.
An employee operating a punch press was struck by the die and was hospitalized with crushing injuries to the left hand.

An employee was retrieving a pan of chili meat and hot water that had been cooking inside the microwave. The pan slipped out of her hands and hot chili spilled over her left arm and hand. She sustained first and second degree burns.

An employee was pealing sand away with a bar to direct the flow of molten iron. The iron ejected and contacted the employee causing burns from the base of his left index finger to his left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a coating machine for a print run when two of its rolls moved together, pinching the employee's thumb. The thumb tip was medically amputated.

Employees were driving piles. An employee was using his left hand to guide the leads (upright portion that drives the hammer). The lines were suspended by a crane and the third line was not in use. As the crane lowered the leads, the weight of the leads draped onto the third line. This caused the third line to tighten against the employee s hand causing an amputation to the left thumb just below the nailbed near the first joint.

An employee was operating an aerial lift to reach an elevation on a baler. The employee exited the aerial lift to gain access to the baler. The employee fell from the baler to the ground below and was hospitalized for multiple fractures including hip fractures.
An employee was assisting three other employees in sliding a new A/C unit under a house. The A/C unit exposed a live electrical line that was buried and the employee was shocked.

An employee was operating a core drill with a 4-inch core barrel to cut concrete and asphalt, and an enhanced sub-base to collect soil samples. The drill bound up and rotated, striking the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the left hand and fingers.

An employee was getting ready to repair an air handler. He looked inside the air handler to see what tools were needed. He was attempting to shut off the equipment when his left hand contacted the moving fan blade, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation. The fan was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was reinstalling the mast chain on a forklift after it had jammed. When the chain went back on, the mast dropped and pulled his hand around the sprocket causing the amputation of three fingertips on the right hand.
On July 10, 2019, an employee was adjusting a hold-down on a molding machine and contacted the spinning circular blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the left middle finger.
A temporary employee was cutting wood on a band saw when the saw amputated his middle fingertip.
An employee was patrolling the border on an ATV when the ATV rolled over. The employee sustained injuries to the neck, back, and face.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw. The blade amputated his left index finger.

An employee had been feeding wood slabs into a slab recovery saw. The employee turned the saw off and was sweeping out the saw dust when the still spinning blade amputated a finger on the employee's right hand.
While removing insulation, an employee lost their footing and fell 12 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee fell to the ground, breaking her right kneecap and left wrist.
An employee was operating a mobile pallet jack and moving product in a warehouse. When he stepped off the pallet jack, it struck the employee's foot and lacerate the lower left leg.

On July 11, 2019, an asphalt maintenance technician was removing a handicap sign in preparation for resurfacing the parking lot when a bee or wasp nest was disturbed and he got stung. He collapsed to the ground and had difficulty breathing. He was hospitalized for an allergic reaction to the sting.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder. While transitioning from the ladder to the top of a transformer unit he slipped and fell off the ladder. The employee landed on their left hip and the back of the head resulting in a left hip fracture requiring surgery, and a laceration to the back of the head requiring staples and stitches.

Employees were working to re-line sewer lines with a fiberglass liner. The employees had cut out a piece of fiberglass liner and were pulling it up using a forklift and rope when the piece caught on the manhole rim. The rope was severed and the piece fell and struck an employee, who was in the manhole, on the left foot amputating the middle toe.
An employee noticed the flames of a propane grill had gone out. While re-lighting the grill, the employee sustained burns to his face.
An employee was loading a block (meat ice cube) onto a conveyor. Their left ring and pinky fingers were smashed under the block and fractured, requiring hospitalization.
While leaving work for the day, an employee started to suffer from severe cramping. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration/heat stress.
An employee was four steps up a track ladder, bringing boxes down, when she fell to the concrete floor and broke her leg.

An employee was checking for vibration on an applicator roll drive shaft. The grease fitting came around and caught the ring on the employee's left ring finger. The left ring finger was pulled into the applicator roll drive and was de-gloved and medically amputated at the lower knuckle.
An employee was working as a surveyor in the field. He felt ill and left work. Later, he suffered muscle cramping and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was washing the shaker screens when he felt short of breath and light-headed. The employee was hospitalized with pneumonitis that was induced by diesel fuel inhalation.
An employee was separating a bundle of joists when one of the joists fell on him and hit him in the shoulder. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a clog from the tumbler when the conveyor belt activated and broke the employee's arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting lay-out work from a one-tier bakers scaffold and fell 4 feet to the cement floor resulting in head trauma.
While walking and turning, an employee slipped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was bitten by a copperhead snake while pruning a tree. He was hospitalized.

On July 11, 2019, a maintenance employee was removing the motor from a pump in the wastewater area outside of the plant. The motor fell onto the employee's left middle fingertip, which was crushed and required medical amputation.

An employee was removing aluminum from a piece of scrap copper using a shear. As he was using the shear, it cut his finger, resulting in an amputation to the right pinky fingertip just below the fingernail.
An employee sustained a possible electrical shock while vacuuming.
A forklift struck a box bin, which in turn struck an employee, breaking the employee's legs.
An employee was picking up a piece of plywood to move it to another area. The plywood had been covering an 8-ft hole. The employee fell into the hole and sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was collecting welding leads to leave work for the day. A 1-foot round pipe was on the ground and slid in mud caused by heavy rain. The pipe struck the employee in the leg, breaking his ankle.

On July 11, 2019, an employee was laying an 8-foot, 36-inch diameter concrete pipe as an excavator was pulling the grade. As the excavator was setting the bucket (54-inch wide) down on the ground it pushed the employee towards the 36-inch pipe. The employee's lower back got caught between the bucket and the pipe. He sustained bruising and a contusion to his lower back and was hospitalized.
An employee had been dragging tree limbs to the brush chipper 30 feet away. His hands and legs started cramping and he felt ill. He was later hospitalized for heat stress.

Two employees were cutting a concrete wall with a chop saw. The blade got stuck within the cut and the saw kicked back, cutting both employees on the leg. One employee received stitches and was not hospitalized. The other employee had to have surgery on the right leg.
An employee became dizzy while building forms along an interstate. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
While walking down the hall after lunch, an employee lost balance and fell resulting in bruises to the shoulder, head and face.

An employee bagging material at the 200-cubic foot mixing station was clearing a jam in the dust collector using a mallet. While bracing his body with the left hand, he contacted the rotary airlock resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when the employee's left leg hit a pole, resulting in a left ankle fracture.

On July 11, 2019, an employee was making a delivery. While pulling a skid to the back of a trailer, the skid broke causing the employee to fall out of the back of the truck onto the ground. The employee sustained a hip injury.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder replacing a light on top of his truck when he fell approximately 3.5 feet to the ground below. The employee hit his head and hip.

An employee was utilizing a magnetic drill to drill holes in 1.5" tube. The employee was removing metal shavings and his glove was caught by the bit pulling his left hand into the drill. The drill amputated his index fingertip and thumb, and lacerated his middle finger.
An employee started working from an aerial lift after returning from lunch when he started to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.

An employee directed the driver of a tractor trailer to disconnect and pull forward so he could place a trailer stand underneath the trailer. The truck disconnected and rolled backwards, pinning the employee between the rear of the truck and the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
A maintenance employee was cleaning drain pipes and fell from a 6-foot high retaining wall to the concrete surface below and sustained fractures to both ankles.

An employee working as a framer was putting hardware on the bottom of an exterior wall on the right side of the house. He was standing on the completed deck floor of the second story when he fell to the dirt ground. The employee sustained a spinal cord injury resulting in paralysis from the chest down.
On July 12, 2019, a crane operator was trying to hook 6-foot-tall steel cover sheets. His left ring fingertip hit the corner of the cover sheets and was broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while connecting conductors to underground transformers.

On July 12, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was working in the warehouse on the second floor stowing material. The employee tripped while walking and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.

The injured employee was working in the lumber yard and was standing next to a yard forklift talking with the operator. A truck backed up and struck the yard forklift and the injured employee was pinned between the truck and the forklift. The employee sustained broken ribs.

An employee was operating a CNC machine when a cutter attachment installed on the machine contacted the employee's head. The employee sustained a laceration to the forehead on the left side, extending upward.
An employee had finished two coke oven charges and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion after his shift.
An employee had been working on electrical panels in a room at a new construction site. The employee was found on the floor at the bottom of a ladder unresponsive and not breathing.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move parts when a part slipped, causing the load to become unbalanced. While trying to stabilize the load and catch the falling piece, the employee sustained a broken thumb.
An employee suffered heat cramps while collecting residential trash.

While an employee was loading a crate into a container, the crate began to break into pieces. A sharp piece of wood punctured the safety boot behind the protected area and caused a fracture which later required medical amputation of the right great toe.
An employee was using a tag line on a pipe with a sling. The pipe slipped out of the sling and pinched the employee's hand between the pipe and the pipe stand resulting in smashed fingers.

A temporary employee was towel drying a moving belt conveyor. The employee's arm became caught between the conveyor and a product quality control roller. The employee sustained compression injuries to the arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing roofing material. While walking on trusses he fell approximately 9 ft. to the ground and sustained a broken right ankle. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was cleaning debris from the rollers of a calendar machine while it was in operation. The mill cleaning cloth the employee was using caught on one of the rollers and the employee was pulled in between two rollers. He sustained crushing injuries to the upper body and head.
An employee walking through the loading dock area became entangled in discarded plastic wrapping. The employee fell to the floor, sustained a fractured left femur, and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift in a warehouse and sustained multiple fractures.
An employee was sitting on the rear tire of a lift truck when it pulled forward and turned to the left. The employee sustained a broken leg.

An employee stepped over a pump, put his arm out to brace himself, and came in contact with a valve which then opened and sprayed sulfuric acid on him. He was hospitalized with chemical burns to the face and neck.
The injured employee was holding a piece of 2x4 wood while a co-worker was cutting it with a circular saw. The circular saw kicked back and amputated the injured employee's left thumb.

An employee was installing a ramp into the body of a box truck. When the ramp was pushed into the body of the truck, his left thumb was pinched between the ramp and the cross members of the box truck. The thumb was amputated from the middle of the nail.
Employees up the hill were cutting down a tree. The falling tree caught onto a leaning tree which then struck an employee in the chest. The employee was hospitalized with cracked ribs.

An employee was loading a truck. While positioning a steel chemical drum on a drum tipper apparatus, the drum slipped through the straps and pinched the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized for a severe laceration to the thumb.

An employee was applying stickers to boxes. He went to remove something that was stuck in the rotary valve when the valve became energized and caused the amputation of the left index finger at the second knuckle.

An employee completed pressure washing the deck of an onstage area in the water park. The employee was gathering equipment to clean up the pressure washer. The pressure washer activated while it was resting on his left work boot. The employee sustained a wound to his left foot that required surgery.
An employee was operating a motorized concrete buggy that was filled with concrete when his lower right leg was pinned and broken between the buggy and a fence.
An employee sustained a foot injury when he fell off a roof and landed on the ground.

An employee standing on a step ladder was struck in the chest by a truss jib and fell 12 feet onto a boulder retaining wall. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the right arm, broken ribs, a partially collapsed lung, and lacerations to the head.
An employee was repairing a forklift when the forklift's axle moved. It caught and dragged the employee several feet resulting in broken ribs and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a dicer machine when a sharp part of the machine amputated their left index finger.

An employee was working to de-chock a set of four high work rolls which were being removed from the roll mill for maintenance. While he was removing the spreader bar, he was caught in a pinch point between the spreader bar and a roll resulting in amputation of the right pinky fingertip.

An employee was mounting a tire to a rim when the tire and rim assembly fell over. The employee attempted to protect the rim and his finger was caught between the rim and the floor resulting in an amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was de-rigging and unplugging motors. While sliding a motor to a cart, the employee fell and the motor landed on their hand. The employee sustained a stretched ligament in the right hand.
An employee was struck by a food truck at the jobsite resulting in contusions and a possible concussion.

A thermo-former operator had been trimming excess flashing off the hot water pan and then placing the bar code stickers onto them. He clocked out for lunch when he started to feel cramps in his legs and arms and was sweating profusely. He then felt pain throughout his body. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

While an aircraft was preparing for departure, a ramp service employee was conducting a physical walk-around safety check. He noticed that the forward wing slat was deployed and a piece of rubber stripping was protruding. As the employee attempted to push the rubber back in, the slat retracted, trapping his hand. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated at the nail cuticle.

An employee was helping a resident move from the bed to a bedside commode when she tripped over a wheelchair. She fell to her knees and her face hit the bedframe. She suffered a facial contusion and fractured right tibia.

An employee was at the ironing machine making adjustments to the machine's performance. She used a hammer to press down on a belt inside the machine. While pressing down on the belt, it moved and caused the employee's hand to strike a sharp edge on part of the ironing machine. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving a granite table top and lost his grip. The table top fell, pinching his finger when it hit the ground. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unloading an asphalt roller off of a trailer. The roller slipped off the ramp and the employee was pinned between the ramp and the roller. The employee sustained fractures to the left hip, knee, and ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was making a repair to a forklift. The tines of the forklift were elevated in order to access the brackets at the bottom of the backrest. While the employee was loosening one of the brackets, the backrest and tines fell off the forklift, striking the employee's back, legs, and feet. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg that was broken in two places and a laceration to the right foot.
While tightening a hold-down strap on the roll-off truck, an employee slipped and struck their head on the bumper. The employee was knocked unconscious and hospitalized with a contusion to the head.
An employee was working outside when he passed out from heat exhaustion.

An employee was welding the inner rim plate of a pontoon using a wire welding machine with .045 flux-core welding wire. The employee stopped welding and then proceeded to chip the slag from the weld when a piece of hot slag popped off the weld and landed on the employee's right upper and lower eyelids resulting in second-degree burns.

An employee was pressure washing an excavator. The pressure washer hose became tangled. When the employee went to untangle the hose she was hit by high pressure water. The employee was hospitalized with a puncture wound and burn to the left calf.

On 7/13/2019, at 8:00 AM an employee working as an operator and carpenter was stripping the wall forms of a structure. While repositioning himself he lost his footing, fell to the ground and landed on his foot. He sustained a broken lower left leg requiring hospitalization and surgery. The employee was wearing fall protection, but it was not connected at the time of the fall.

An employee was moving material using a telehandler. He was on the road, which is elevated, and the right wheels dropped off the embankment. The telehandler rolled over and the employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee was filling gas into a vehicle while standing on a trailer. The employee tripped on the trailer, fell to the ground and hit his head.

An employee was attempting to unjam a pump. The pump unjammed while the employee's right hand was on the v-belt. The employee's hand was drawn into the pulley and the pinky finger was amputated. The tendon on the ring finger was also severed.

An employee was helping to move precast concrete panels in the yard using a gantry crane. The employee was caught between two panels as one was being placed and the employee tried to reset the foot panel on which the panel rests. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was walking in the yard when he was struck by a truck backing up. He sustained fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and his left ear was removed.
An employee was working on an air compressor when a steel plate fell on his hand/fingers. The steel plate crushed his finger and he sustained an amputation injury.
A postal employee was bitten by two dogs, causing the employee to fall and hit their head on the concrete walking surface. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was lowering an industrial mixing bowl. The mixing bowl malfunctioned and continued to lower, crushing the employee's foot.

An employee was operating a standup forklift when the back wheels struck a piece of wood causing the forklift to become unstable. The employee lost balance and the forklift struck a shelving rack. The shelves' horizontal member struck the employee in the chest causing a rib fracture on the right side.

Two employees were installing a sink. An employee was underneath the sink while the injured employee was pushing the sink down. The sink fell through and broke. The injured employee's right arm went through the sink and his forearm was lacerated.
An employee was standing on a pipe rack and fell 3-4 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fracture to the T3 vertebra.
An employee was cutting meat with the saw machine when the bone slipped and the meat cutter lacerated his left index finger.

An employee was installing conduit in the ceiling area of a new school building utilizing a 12-foot A-frame ladder. The employee's legs got caught in the ladder rungs, causing the ladder and the employee to fall. The employee struck the floor and was hospitalized with cracked ribs and lacerations to the head.

An employee was walking on the second level of a mushroom house. The employee fell to the first level due to an unsecured walk board. The employee sustained three fractured transverse processes in the lower spine and was hospitalized.

An employee was threading the web on a coater machine. While verifying the tape on the silicon roll was under the web, the employee noticed contamination (scrap film) on the coater drum and attempted to remove it. The employee's left hand was caught in an ingoing nip point and was degloved.
An employee opened a pressurized heat exchanger to conduct maintenance. The employee sustained second degree burns on the torso and was also burned on both arms.

Two employees were working on a tooling cross bar section. One employee had his right hand on top of a pneumatically controlled front tilt head. The tilt head actuated and pinched the tip of his right ring finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was greasing a chain on a 5 cubic-foot blender. The employee's hand was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation of three fingers on the right hand.
An employee fell to the ground level of a vessel while climbing down a ladder. The employee sustained a broken left radius.

On July 14, 2019, an employee was helping to set a die into a machine. The slack in the chain tightened and caught the employee's right ring finger between the chain and the die, resulting in an amputation.

While checking product temperatures in a smokehouse, an employee got something slippery on his boots and then slipped on the floor outside of the smokehouse. The employee's left kneecap made contact with the floor and was displaced.
An employee was working with an emergency response team to restore electricity after an earthquake. The employee suffered heat stroke, then kidney failure.

At approximately 1:00 a.m., on 7/15/2019, a machine operator was performing a maintenance procedure on a board press. The operator was connecting a wire when a cog (wheel) grabbed her right hand and damaged the tissue between the thumb and index finger and knuckles.
While cutting limbs from a tree, an employee sustained a severe laceration to the arm/wrist from a chainsaw. The injury required surgery.
An employee was fixing a pivot and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, sustaining two broken ribs and a sprained back.

While performing rounds in an apartment complex parking lot, a security officer was struck by a vehicle that was backing into a parking spot. The security officer was hospitalized for a broken leg and abdominal and head injuries.

An employee was roping an elevator car and lowering the ropes to the counterweight. Several feet of rope slack on the machine room floor needed to be released from the hoisting rope. When removing the wire rope clamps, the rope slid through the remaining clamp. The rope gained momentum and struck the employee on the right forearm and fractured it.
On July 15, 2019, an employee fell into a ribbon blender while taking a sample resulting in a broken right leg and ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a cable around a stack of steel bars when a 4x4 supporting the stack broke and the stack rolled down, pinning and breaking the employee's leg.

An employee was installing steel decking to the roof a warehouse while standing on a roof truss. The employee lost his footing and fell. He was wearing personal fall protection which included a full body harness, a D-ring extension, a retractable lanyard, and a beam anchor clamp. After falling approximately 21 feet, the retractable device caught and stopped his fall but then the D-ring extension s threading failed and it broke. The employee then free-fell approximately 27 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries including: the right knee shattered into twenty pieces, the right leg fractured in three places, fractures to the front of the skull/forehead, a broken nose, five teeth knocked out, and numerous facial lacerations.

An employee was operating a truck-mounted aerial lift to remove a dead ash tree. The boom truck tipped over while the operator was in the aerial lift. The employee suffered a broken leg and a back injury.
A temporary employee was struck by a vehicle that was backing up and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right wrist.
While attaching a low-bed trailer to a tractor, the trailer fell off the attaching device and landed on an employee's feet crushing them.
An employee was pulling/stacking tree limbs on the curb when he felt nauseous and dizzy and was ill. He was hospitalized with a heat related illness.
An employee was training a young colt when the horse reared up and the saddle horn was pushed into the employee's abdomen rupturing the employee's spleen.
Two employees patrolling the U.S. border suffered from dehydration. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while working in the family birthing unit and was hospitalized with a possible seizure and bruising.

On July 15, 2019, at approximately 5:15 PM, an employee was cutting meat on a bandsaw. The employee's glove got caught on the bandsaw blade and pulled his left thumb into the blade resulting in the amputation of the thumb tip.
An operator was working near the sifter on the bun line. While troubleshooting the flour flow on the sifter, the operator sustained the amputation of the right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee on a portable ladder was placing merchandise on an overhead shelf when she slipped and fell off the ladder. The employee sustained head and hip injuries.
On 7/15/2019, at 5:50 AM, a temporary laboratory technician was going to clock in when he slipped and fell to the ground breaking a hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
While walking, an employee stepped on a wooden board and landed on the floor, sustaining a broken femur.

An employee was using a product picking machine while standing on the machine's platform at a height of almost 10 feet. The employee fell from the platform to the ground and sustained blunt force trauma injuries to the body.
An employee was walking on the sales floor, tripped over a rug, and fell fracturing a femur.
While working in a stairwell installing shoring, an employee was struck by an aluminum beam and sustained injury to the right shoulder.
An employee was working near a register when they lost balance and fell resulting in leg fractures.
An employee carrying a bucket of hot water was splashed by the water and sustained severe burns.

An employee was checking the position of the grinding wheel to ensure that there was a correct gap between the wheel and the steel. His left thumb came in contact with the grinding wheel while it was still rotating, resulting in severe lacerations and a broken knuckle.

An employee was in a scissor lift raising to an elevated working height to install fire suppression equipment. The employee was caught between a structural beam and the scissor lift and sustained a severe head injury.
An employee was coming down from a tower. He stepped onto a transformer cover and fell approximately 4 to 8 feet. He sustained two broken ribs, cuts to the face, and a dislocated shoulder.

Employees were using an overhead crane to move logs. One employee was controlling the crane with a remote control. Another employee had his right hand on top of the hoist block when the block was raised. The employee's index finger was caught between the block and a pipe resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was in a trench cleaning soil off of the water line in preparation for a connection. The trench collapsed along with the soil pile that was approximately one foot from the edge of the trench. The employee was completely covered with soil and was hospitalized for a broken jaw and lacerations to the ear and right arm.
An employee was assisting in lifting a 55-gallon drum with a crane and a chain. The chain slipped on the drum and the employee sustained a left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing a clog from the impeller of a filter press using a pipe wrench. When the clog became free, a V-belt moved as a result of gravity and crushed the employee's left middle finger, resulting in an avulsion.
An employee fell while climbing out of a truck. A barrel fell on him, breaking his tibia and fibula.

An employee was operating a tractor with a bush clearing device attached to the rear to mow along the pipeline. While descending a steep grade, the tractor slipped, turned sideways, and then rolled over. The employee sustained multiple fractured ribs, collapsed lungs, and lacerations to the head and elbow.

An employee was working on the sixth rung of an 8-foot ladder. He was unplugging temporary lights when he received an electrical shock from the temporary lighting cords and fell from the ladder. He landed on and fractured his left ankle.
An employee was operating a full revolution mechanical power press when the dies closed while the employee's hands were in the die area. The employee sustained a partial right hand amputation.

A delivery employee lost his footing while off-loading a crate during a liftgate delivery and fell off the back of the truck approximately 48 inches to the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and punctured lungs.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to move pallets when his leg was pinned between a guardrail and the pallet jack. The employee sustained a compound fracture to his leg.
An employee had been shoveling sand when he felt light-headed and dizzy and fell to his knees. The employee suffered from dehydration and heat illness.
An employee was cleaning a tank of sand using a high-pressure water hose. The high-pressure water ran across his right foot and cut the big toe.
A soil compacting machine rolled over and an employee was caught between the ground and the roll bar.
An employee was delivering mail, walking house to house. The employee became overheated and ill, collapsed, and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on the deck of a brush clearing machine. The support gave way and the deck landed on the employee's ankle causing injury.

An employee was servicing a skid steer bucket from a quick attachment point when the spring holding the hydraulic cylinder gave way and crushed their finger. The employee sustained a broken index finger and lacerations to the skin that required surgery and stitches.
An employee was working above a turbine. The employee fell about 15 feet, suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was running the hand coiler when his thumb made contact with a turning flange on the reel and his left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was repairing a winch cable when it came loose, struck him on the chin, and fractured his jaw.
An employee was sitting inside a trailer with a/c and had a seizure, possibly brought about due to heat stress.
While troubleshooting a conveyor system, an employee's right hand became caught in the machinery. The employee sustained some degloving and two fingertips were amputated.
While removing material from a blender that had a malfunction, an employee sustained a fracture and laceration to the right arm.
An employee was checking the freight he had just loaded into a truck for transport when a forklift backed into him and fractured his left ankle.

An employee was changing/mounting a tire onto a wheel that was not mounted on a vehicle. Something popped and the wheel/tire struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm and head injuries.

An employee finished cutting a 2x4 with a circular saw and set the saw on the saw horse. The saw then fell and as he tried to catch it, his right middle finger became caught in the spinning blade amputating a portion of the finger.

On July 16, 2019, employee 1 was spraying down an area with hot water. Another employee lost their balance, causing them to spray employee 1 with hot water. Employee 1 was hospitalized with burns to the right leg and foot.

An employee was performing re-roofing work when he lost his footing, slipped, and fell 7 feet to the ground, breaking his left leg. He was hospitalized. Personal fall protection was worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was adding lubrication to a tortilla machine when the machine caught her glove and amputated her right pinky fingertip. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was unloading a semi-trailer truck. As he was repositioning a pallet, he stepped on some moisture that had accumulated and fell 4-5 feet onto the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg.

Two employees were loading appliances into a delivery truck using a 2-wheeler/dolly. One employee was helping push a refrigerator while the other employee pulled it towards the dolly. The refrigerator fell on one of the employee's lower extremities and mid-section, causing the employee to fall on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured T7 vertebra.

An employee was working on the harvesting floor as a steamback operator. The trolley came into the room and the employee removed it from the track. The employee's fingers were pinched by the trolley wheel and rail and a fingertip was amputated.
While inserting an air hose on a conveyor belt, an employee's right pinky finger was amputated by the conveyor belt.

An employee was walking on a concrete walkway, heading to a designated break area. The employee stumbled on the walkway and fell on their knee, resulting in a fracture of the left lateral tibial plateau.

An employee was boring holes using a milling machine, along the bottom of an amphibious transport dock ship. He was also checking alignment measurements on the intermediate strut of the ship. He stepped down from an upper level work platform and fell to a catwalk below. The employee then rolled under the bottom railing of the catwalk and fell 8 feet to a concrete surface. He sustained broken ribs, a fractured right wrist, and a head laceration.

An employee was pulling the pull cord on a generator. The cord jumped and wrapped around his right hand, then retracted and pulled the hand in, causing an abrasion across the hand and an abrasion on the index finger.

A third-party truck was departing the facility and stopped at the gate. An employee was walking over to the passenger side of the truck to talk to the driver and got caught in between the gate and the truck as the gate was closing. The employee was crushed and sustained internal bleeding.

An employee had been cutting grass on a tractor. The employee was found laying on the break room floor. He was shaking, feeling ill, and could not get up on his own. He was hospitalized with possible dehydration, a heart attack, or heat stroke.
An employee had been inspecting a leg processor machine. While adjusting a water sprayer hose on the machine, their right hand was caught and crushed in a moving gripper chain.
An employee walking down a landing, slipped, and fell on the floor, breaking a wrist and the left ankle.
An employee walking along the catwalk on the back of an 18-wheeler fell 3 feet to the ground and sustained a compression fracture to the L1 vertebra.
An employee slipped while walking up a flight of wet stairs. The employee fell, suffering a broken kneecap and ankle.
An employee was operating a shear when his left ring fingertip was amputated by the blade. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee had been performing regular packing duties. When he finished processing a cart of boxes, he went to the cooler to stack the boxes onto a storage cart inside the cooler. While transporting the boxes, he tripped over the corner of a pallet and struck his head on a stationary cart inside the cooler. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised head and a cut to the nose.
An employee had been weeding in the field and experienced chest tightness resulting in hospitalization.

On July 16, 2019, an employee was feeding product into a silo 30 minutes before the end of his shift. He began to sweat and have hip and lower back cramps, then later dizziness and vomiting. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was helping install a belt and pulley roller when his left hand was caught on the conveyor belt of the grain truck. His hand was injured.

An employee was assisting in the operation of a pallet inverter. The employee noticed wood debris near the roller. As the employee was removing the wood, the inverter actuated and caught the employee's hand/arm resulting in a fractured arm and a laceration from the fingers to the forearm.

An employee was using a hose and hot water to clean a belly line on a trailer. When the employee removed the end cap, pressure in the line caused hot water to spray out, resulting in burns to the employee's stomach area, shins, and the front of the thighs.

Employee 1 went behind a press to turn on the oiler. At that time, another employee pushed a steel I-beam along a manual roller bed to the press. The I-beam struck the right arm of employee 1 and caused a puncture wound requiring hospitalization.
When an employee was walking to the garage of a residential dwelling, the home owner's dog came from the garage and bit the employee's right forearm. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee was feeding dough into the forming die when the fingertips of their middle and ring fingers were caught and amputated by the dough roller.
An employee was found semi-conscious on a lower stairway landing. The employee was spitting up blood and was bleeding from the face, mouth, nose, and ear.
While carrying items, an employee tripped on a table cloth and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.

An employee was cutting an 8-inch PVC pipe with a saw. When the saw cut through the pipe, both ends of the pipe came together and pinched the saw's blade. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's chest. The employee had surgery to clean the wound.

While an employee was using a wet-saw to cut a concrete wall for a door header, he fell from staging and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a laceration to the right side of the head and a fractured skull.

An employee was waiting out a storm in his work truck but had to use a nearby portable toilet. While he was in the portable toilet, a lightning strike occurred approximately 50 feet away. He collapsed after coming out of the toilet. He suffered a concussion and brain swelling, requiring hospitalization.

At a summer camp, an employee was leading a group of young men on a hiking trip. He stepped on a rock which rolled, and he fell approximately 40-50 feet down a mountain and was hospitalized with multiple internal injuries, a collapsed lung, and cracked ribs.
An employee was using gas powered sheers to trim shrubs and lacerated their fingers.

The injured employee was driving a forklift and following another forklift. When the other forklift stopped, the injured employee's forklift continued forward and his leg was caught between the two forklifts. The employee sustained a broken left foot.
An employee was using a portable worm-drive circular saw to cut slots in 4X4 lumber for trailer stairs and cut their left middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was standing up while riding on the back of a scissor lift. The employee was crushed between the scissor lift's rail and an exterior metal door frame, resulting in broken ribs and blood in the lungs.
An employee was pressing down on a pressing board foot pedal with her right foot when her left foot became caught under the pedal, cracking her toenail.

An employee had been sitting idle in an air conditioned 18-wheeler and then came into the office with symptoms of lightheadedness, dizziness, and slightly elevated blood pressure. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress (dehydration, heat exhaustion).
An employee was exiting from the back of a tractor trailer. The employee slipped on wet diamond plate and fell to the ground, breaking his hip.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw and sustained a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was moving a chassis onto a dolly to transport it to the paint both. The employee's hand was smashed between the chassis and the dolly, resulting in a left index finger amputation.
An employee was wiring batteries (125 volts) to test them. One of the batteries was placed backwards. The wire became hot and burned his hands.
An employee was burned by an arc flash while screwing a face-plate onto an electrical gutter.
An employee was sanitizing equipment when the auger from a meat grinder amputated their right index finger. The machine was energized at the time.

On July 17, 2019, a temporary employee was hand picking discarded construction materials while using cloth gloves when a piece of ceramic tile flipped and lacerated his left forearm near the wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was manufacturing acoustic panels with fiberglass products. The employee was cutting a panel with a table saw when his right pinky finger contacted the saw blade. The finger was amputated below the second knuckle, and was later reattached.
A wooden crate that contained plate glass toppled over and struck an employee resulting in fractures to the ankle, leg and hand.

An employee was returning a cart mule (a machine used to move carts) to the grocery receiving side of the front of a store. The employee's right-hand fingers were caught between the cart mule and a concrete wall, causing an amputation.
While working a 12-hour shift as a laborer and forklift driver in a molding department, an employee suffered heat-related illness and was hospitalized.
An employee was building manhole tops at a construction worksite. After work, the employee was hospitalized for heat stress and dehydration.

An employee was unloading freight inside a trailer while standing on a deck that was 3-4 feet above the floor of the trailer. The employee fell from the deck and landed on the trailer floor. The employee was hospitalized for injuries to the ribs, left clavicle, and back.
An employee was building a concrete structure while on top of a 20-foot wall. The employee fell from the wall and was hospitalized with fractures to the femur, jaw, and hip.
After working from 6 AM to 7 PM as a flagger for an asphalt crew, coordinating traffic around an area that was being repaved, the employee became ill and required hospitalization for dehydration.
An employee was walking in the office building and slipped on the vinyl flooring. The employee sustained a spiral fracture of the right leg/ankle.
An employee performing acoustical ceiling work fell from a scaffold to the floor and was hospitalized with a possible wrist fracture.

An employee was rolling a piece of carbon steel pipe from a conveyor onto a storage rack. The pipe was 14 inches in diameter, approximately 65 inches long and weighed about 300 pounds. When the pipe shifted and began to fall between the supports of the storage rack, the employee attempted to regain control of the falling pipe. The employee s fingers were caught between the pipe and the storage rack resulting in lacerations to the middle and ring fingers of the employee s left hand.
A golf equipment operator was mowing a bunker with a hover mover when he slipped on grass and the mower contacted his left foot. Four toes were cut and the employee had surgery.
An employee was servicing a skid steer when its bucket came down, striking the employee in the head.

While an employee was observing and lubricating a chain-driven conveyor belt, a spray bottle he was holding slipped out of his hand. As he attempted to catch the spray bottle, two of his fingers contacted the moving conveyor belt resulting in the partial amputation of his index and middle fingers.
An employee's hand was pulled into a machine roller, resulting in an index finger amputation.
An employee was getting out of a chair when she fell to the floor and sustained a fractured elbow and wrist.

On July 17, 2019, an employee was operating an asphalt paver for a road construction company. At approximately 10:00 a.m. the employee was stepping down from a platform on the paver when he rolled and fractured his ankle.
An employee was using a portable band saw to cut threaded rod when the blade cut his left thumb. The employee got an infection that required surgery and antibiotics.
An employee was working from a telephone pole to provide service to a residence when he felt a sharp pain in his back. He was hospitalized with a bulging disk.

An employee was building a scaffold frame for use as a temporary structure. While attaching a truss frame, he lost balance and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was using an abrasive wheel to cut water pipe when the wheel kicked back, knocked the employee's face shield off and caused facial lacerations.
An employee walked into a press to grab a tire that was in the unloader. The press pushed the employee into a hot ring, causing burns.
An employee was riding a bike on a mountain trail to replace a sign when the employee crashed while trying to avoid a customer. The employee was hospitalized with a left knee injury.
While reversing an electric pallet jack, an employee's left foot struck the step to the cab of a truck that was in the loading area. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the left heel.
While walking in a hallway, an employee slipped and fell on the floor sustaining a broken hip and wrist.

An employee was standing on a 10-foot aluminum step ladder reaching through a ceiling hatch during maintenance on a unit. After placing his tools through the hatch he lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee sustained seven broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a spleen injury.
An employee was screwing a nut onto a bolt using a battery-powered torque tool when their left index fingertip was pinched between the tool and the bolt. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a pallet jack when he was hit from behind by another pallet jack. His foot was then caught between the pallet jack and a pole, resulting in a small left toe amputation.

An employee was working inside a robotic cell, handling parts coming out of an X-ray machine. While waiting for the next tray of parts to come out of the X-ray, he rested his hand on the side edge of the roller system. The chain/sprocket teeth then caught his right glove, pulling his fingers into the sprocket. He pulled his right hand out of the sprocket gear and injured the tip of his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The chain and sprocket were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was getting off the truck after washing it down. The employee fell to the concrete ground and landed on his right knee, sustaining a knee injury.

An employee was changing a die inside the pellet mill of a press. The employee was using a torque wrench to tighten the inner bolts, applying pressure in a downward motion, when the wrench either gave way, or reached the desired amount of torque and completed its designed function to break loose. The employee's right thumb was caught between the wrench handle and a piece of adjacent equipment (the aspiration line) resulting in an amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was climbing down a ladder on the side of a tank truck when he lost his footing and fell approximately 7 feet to the concrete ground. The employee sustained fractures to both ankles.
An employee was using a meat band saw to cut some pork when his hand slipped and went into the saw blade, resulting in a right thumb amputation.
An employee was shot in the stomach by a robber while delivering a pizza to a private residence at 12:30 AM.
An employee was moving furniture and boxes into a new home when the employee became overheated and suffered heat exhaustion.

A block of cheese was transferring from the brine area to the packaging area on the metal mesh transfer conveyor. An employee was straightening the block of cheese when his finger got caught in the metal mesh belt. When the employee pulled his hand free, the pad of the employee's left index finger was amputated.

An employee was using a bridge crane to replace slag trays in the burn table. The employee's left ring finger was caught between a slag tray and the inside receiving edge of the burn table, resulting in the fracture and amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee experienced cramping from dehydration while riding in a truck.
While opening the door of his car, an employee turned around, slipped, and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.

An employee was on a ladder, using a saw to trim back low branches from a tree on a golf course. The ladder shifted against the tree and he fell about 5 feet to the grass below. He suffered fractures to his hip, collarbone, and some ribs, as well as a punctured lung and a torn carotid artery.
While an employee was moving a bowl ladle with an automatic control, molten metal splashed from the bowl ladle and landed on the employee's feet. The employee sustained burns to both feet.

An employee had been draining a small vat used for cleaning machine parts; he had carried a 5-gallon bucket of cleaning fluid upstairs four times to pour it into a waste oil collection tank. He suffered dehydration and heat-exhaustion-related hand cramping, then chest and abdomen cramping.
An employee's right middle fingertip was amputated by a saw.
An employee lost the tip of his finger while working with a lathe.

An employee had been setting up a steel plate to cover an excavation. The employee signaled the excavator operator to move the plate using an attached chain. The employee's left hand became caught in the chain resulting in amputation of multiple fingers.
An employee was delivering mail in an apartment complex when she slipped and fell on a wet floor. The employee sustained a broken right leg.
As an employee exited the lab, he lost footing on a slippery floor. His left pinky finger got caught in the door jam as the door closed and his finger was amputated.

An employee was in a baler, attempting to unjam cardboard from a hook. When the cardboard came free, the hook struck the employee in the left side of the head and face. The employee suffered a fractured left jaw and left orbit, as well as a cut under the left eye that required stitches.
An employee suffered leg cramps due to heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee had been pushing carts from the parking lot to the front of the store. The employee reported back pain and wrist pain and was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

After operating a forklift, an employee walked to an outside shipping area, lost consciousness, and fell, striking his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion and the head injury.
An employee on a scaffold was pulling up a load of stone when he fell approximately 50 feet to the lower working surface and sustained a crushed pelvis and internal injuries.

While bending down and leaning forward to open a chuck on the fabric calendar, an employee released a lever manually (not powered). A tiny part then slid across and pinched their right pinky finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was taking out trash when a sharp object in the trash injured his right thumb.
An employee was loading pallets onto a trailer using a stand-up forklift when their right hand contacted the trailer and was fractured.

On July 18, 2019, two employees were washing down ash in the economizer hopper. The water that was being applied struck a pocket of hot ash, causing it to flash. Ash and steam contacted one employee s thighs and forearms, and entered his work boots, resulting in burns and hospitalization. The second employee sustained a minor burn to his arm requiring first aid.

An employee was conducting a changeover on a blow molding machine and was caught in the machine while making an adjustment. The employee's left arm was amputated at the elbow and the right hand was also amputated.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when it collided with a moving forklift. The employee fell from the pallet jack and the forklift ran over and broke his lower left leg.
While pulling and pushing a patient onto an examination table, an employee suffered a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a reach truck. The employee's hand was pinned between the truck and a warehouse rack.
An employee was retrieving plastic film from a machine. When the employee pulled the film the machine's blade amputated the left pointer and middle fingertips.

A temporary employee was manually clearing plastic material off the air rod of an extruder as it was running into the corrugator when the corrugator machine caught his finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning material from behind a press. The press cycled and crushed fingers on his left hand. The index and middle fingers were surgically amputated.
While walking down from the twenty-seventh floor to the twenty-sixth floor, an employee slipped and fell down the stairs fracturing the left leg.
An employee slipped while walking down the stairs, fell to the ground, and sustained a broken ankle requiring surgery.
An employee was opening the door of a dishwasher when it came off the track and seriously lacerated his arm.

Two employees were working on a malfunctioning conveyor, attempting to free it by hand. When the table became free, one employee's hand was pinched and the padding behind his right fingertip was amputated.
An employee was moving a pallet of boxes from a rack. A second rack rolled forward; the employee's left hand was pinned and the little finger was amputated.
An employee was running electrical conduit when he suffered cramps and felt ill. He was hospitalized for heat-related muscle injury.

An employee was removing a suspension bushing from a 53-ft. trailer using a pry bar. Part of the suspension moved, catching his left hand. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle finger.

An employee was working with a router, rounding the corners of boards. The employee's push stick got hung up. As he attempted to free it, his finger was caught in the router blade and the right middle fingertip was amputated from mid-nail.
An employee was walking around a table inside the kitchen when she tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while working from a ladder, suffering a jaw injury that required surgery.

An employee was operating a push mower. While pushing the mower under playground equipment, his finger got caught between the mower's handle and a bar on the playground equipment. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was preparing to shrink-wrap a tote for shipment. She got a roll of wrap from the floor and was carrying it when an unknown insect bit her in the abdomen area. She was hospitalized.
An employee in pursuit of a suspect was struck by a motor vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.

An employee was not feeling well after his shift. He worked the next day and when he got home that night, he was still not feeling well and could not sleep. The next morning he was hospitalized with low kidney function due to heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee stepped off the frame of the crusher and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with injuries to his ribs and right hip.
An employee was using a handheld power saw when the spinning blade struck and amputated his index finger.

An employee was working on a beam about 12 feet from ground level, prepping for welding operations. He became lightheaded and dizzy due to the heat and fell from the beam. His personal fall arrest system stopped him from falling to the ground, but his head struck the beam. He lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting an inspection of the product line when the product being inspected, a spar cap, fell from the cart. It landed on and injured the employee's legs.
While adjusting pallets with a lift truck, an employee slipped and fell to the ground, breaking seven ribs.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while loading a barge with wood pellets.
An employee was struck by an 80-gallon water heater in a staging area. The employee suffered fractured vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping to unload a truck frame using a forklift. The frame shifted and fell off the forklift, striking the employee and causing a partial amputation of the left thumb tip.

An employee was running a trencher in a yard. The trencher hit a 10-foot rod that had been covered with dirt, and the rod flipped into the employee's back thigh and caused a puncture wound above the knee. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking to the back of the building, wet ruts caused an employee to stumble and fall to the ground. The employee sustained a broken thumb.

An employee had disconnected a trailer from a pickup. The trailer started to roll away and the employee tried to slow/stop the trailer while two other employees went to get a block to put under the wheels. The employee sustained broken bones in the right foot from the rolling trailer.
An employee had been driving a garbage truck and loading garbage when he began to experience cramps. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

An employee was wrapping a box of shrink wrap using green banding. While moving around the box, the employee slipped on some of the shrink wrap causing him to fall on his right hip. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip.
An employee was assembling a pallet at the end of an aisle. A 10-pound box of material fell from a third-level rack and hit him on the left shoulder, breaking his clavicle.
An employee was working on a mezzanine when it collapsed. The employee fell to the floor and suffered shoulder and head injuries.
On July 19, 2019, wet cement got on an employee's elbow. The employee developed cellulitis on the elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was relocating traffic control signs when a gust of wind blew the sign the employee was holding causing injury to the left wrist.
An employee was descending a ladder when it slipped out, causing the employee to fall 15 ft. to the ground and sustain a broken ankle.

At 5:45 p.m. on July 19, 2019, an employee was using a jib on a bucket truck. He had his left hand on the winch line to help with the slack; when he turned, his left little finger was drawn into the pinch point created by the winch line and spool. He suffered a partial transphalangeal amputation of the left little finger, as well as a fracture to the little finger and ring finger.
An employee was walking and collapsed, having a cardiac event from heat exhaustion.
An employee was re-welding a part when his finger was pinched between a cylinder and the part. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was trying to clean out a key slot on a sifter shaft. When the employee pulled the trigger, the wheel fell apart, causing a compound fracture to the employee's left hand.

An employee slipped off a wet metal roof and fell 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion and his face was fractured on the right side. The employee was not tied off at the time of the fall.
An employee was headed to the exit door when she tripped and struck her shoulder on the floor, bruising it.

A driver was backing a refuse truck down a dead-end street. Another employee attempted to mount the riding step on the left rear side of the truck while it was in motion. The employee slipped and was struck by the rear tandem wheels of the truck. The employee sustained fractures to the lower left ankle/foot that required surgical amputation and also sustained multiple fractures to the right leg.
An employee was cleaning the fingers of a spray booth machine. When the employee turned back to the machine, he was picked up by the machine and sustained a back injury.
An employee was unloading a piece of equipment when the chain broke and struck him in the leg fracturing his tibia and fibula.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck. The truck struck a rack, and the employee suffered a broken left femur and a laceration to the interior back side of the leg.

An employee was switching out an empty storage rack with a full storage rack that she had towed to the production line. The employee began closing the shelves on the empty rack, lowering each shelf, one at a time, starting with the bottom and working her way up. As the employee lowered the third shelf from the top, the second shelf dropped and closed on her right index finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning and sharpening a meat slicer blade when it contacted the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The meat slicer was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving steel from a trailer using a boom truck. The load shifted and caught the tip of his right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
On July 19, 2019, an employee was working on a crew cleaning a rest area when he collapsed and experienced seizures and heat stroke.

At 9:15 a.m., on July 19, 2019, an employee was installing gutter screens while standing on the roof of a house. The employee slipped and fell from the roof, landing on a concrete sidewalk about 10 feet below and suffering a broken pelvis and vertebrae.
An employee's left foot was caught between the forklift he was operating and a storage rack, resulting in amputations to his left toes.
An employee was attempting to remove metal shavings from a horizontal band saw using a no-touch tool. The sawblade lacerated his right hand.

An employee was trimming a tree and unknowingly cut his primary climbing rope. When he completed his cutting work, he unfastened his secondary (safety) rope to begin his decent down the tree and immediately fell to the ground.
An employee was clamping down a truss. The employee's finger was pinched between a board and the truss jig. Part of the fingertip was amputated.

A temporary employee was operating a forklift and dumping a tilt hopper full of aluminum turnings. When the hopper tilted forward, the employee's fingers were pinched between a fork tine and the hopper. Three fingertips on the left hand were amputated.

A service technician was installing an excavator's hydraulic cylinder by hand when it slipped and his right index finger was caught between the base of the cylinder and the "thumb" (a part of the bucket and boom arm). The employee sustained amputation of the right index fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was welding on a cargo trailer when he began to feel lightheaded and dizzy. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was on the roof setting up a ladder to reach higher elevations during siding installation operations. He fell off the roof and landed on a table 10 feet below. The employee sustained fractures to his shoulders and face.
An employee was using a sandblasting gun on a pipeline. The gun hit his right arm and the sandblast media caused an open wound on the forearm.

An employee was completing a fluid treatment process. The employee had just closed a 4-inch valve on a "T" manifold when he tripped and fell forward, striking the shin of his right leg against a valve handle and then landing on the ground. The employee's right leg sustained a spiral fracture requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was going to hammer protruding nails into a wall in preparation to take down shelving. The nails were more than 10 feet above the ground. The employee was standing on a wooden pallet which was raised on the forks of a forklift when the pallet failed. The employee lost balance and fell more than 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken left ankle.
An employee was walking backwards and pulling a chain when he tripped over an existing chain that was on the floor and fell fracturing the left hip.

An employee was pushing a hand cart full of packages to a loading bay when her left ring finger was caught between the hand cart and the building's metal support beam causing the amputation of her left ring fingertip without bone loss.
While installing a guide rail, a post pounder machine backed up and ran over an employee's left foot. The employee suffered a broken foot and ankle.

An employee was loading angle iron onto a trough which was attached to an overhead crane. The trough became disconnected from the overhead crane and it fell along with the angle iron, striking the employee. She sustained fractures to the tibia, six ribs, and multiple vertebrae.
While working in the foundry, an employee became light-headed and nauseated. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
A caretaker was leaving a patient's residence when she slipped on the wet floor  tile and fell, breaking a femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a wheel chock and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder while cutting a tree branch. The employee struck the ground and suffered a broken left femur and dislocated left shoulder.
On July 20, 2019, an employee was not feeling well while performing her normal job duties as a laborer. She went home and was later hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee was hospitalized with a right hand laceration after being bitten by a cat.

At 4:50 p.m. on July 20, 2019, an employee was clearing a tree caught in a downed telecommunication line. The tree shifted and struck the employee, who suffered a severed spinal cord and fractures of vertebrae, pelvis, shoulder, and ribs.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet sidewalk and fractured the left wrist.
An employee developed a heat-related illness while charging a furnace and was hospitalized.
An employee was transporting a 64 pound box of parts using a hand truck/dolly. As the employee was bringing the dolly up some steps, he felt a severe pain in his lower back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was changing out a battery for a pallet jack. The new battery was hooked up to a hoist when it slipped, falling down onto the employee's foot. The employee sustained a fractured left foot.

An employee was manually moving a 55-gallon drum of caulking from a wood pallet to a dolly. The drum slipped back into its original position, pinching his finger against an adjacent drum. The injury resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a table saw when the blade caused an amputation of the index finger and a laceration to the thumb and middle finger.

An employee was serving as a spotter for the adjustment of staging when several of the staging planks became dislodged and fell to the ground. One of the planks bounced far enough to strike the employee in the back. The employee was hospitalized with an umbilical hernia and had surgery.
