An employee had ascended a ladder to stand on the diesel tank of the frac pump to change the transmission oil filters. When stepping down from the ladder, he slipped and fell to the ground breaking four to ten left-side ribs.

An employee was feeding a bear during a safari tour when the bear reached through the 4"x4" cage and grabbed and bit the employee. The employee was hospitalized with damage to the right forearm and bicep.

On July 20, 2019, an employee was on a lift making a pipe connection inside of a garage door when  the garage door opened and pushed the lift over. The employee fell and sustained face and head injuries.
An employee was repairing the belt on a vacuum pump when it started and rotated, causing the amputation of the employee's right ring finger.
An employee operating a press brake sustained partial amputations to the left index finger and the right middle finger when both of his hands were caught between the dies.

An employee was troubleshooting a limit switch on a conveyor when he dropped his wrench. The wrench hit the limit switch and caused the conveyor to move forward. The hanger on the conveyor caught his hand and he sustained a severe laceration to the right hand.

An employee was inspecting a 12,000-volt transformer for an overload. When the employee approached the transformer's door, an electrical flash occurred. The employee sustained second degree burns to both hands and was hospitalized.

A conductor bled rail cars. The cars started to roll southeast down the lead. An employee attempted to apply the handbrake. While reaching for the handbrake, the employee stepped on a rail and then a rail car ran onto and stopped on his left foot. Half of his foot was amputated.
An employee was near a stand that was holding a swivel when the stand fell onto the employee's foot behind the steel toe cap, causing a laceration.

A wireline operator was rebuilding a hydraulic setting tool. He finished rebuilding the bottom section of the tool and noticed it was partially stroked out. He went to use the weight of the setting sleeve to finish stroking the tool vertically. His finger was in the hole at the end of the setting sleeve and when he hit the ground with the tool, it stroked and amputated his right ring fingertip.

During a brush fire, an employee was spraying water on a hot spot. The employee stepped on hot ash which collapsed and he fell into a pit of hot ash. The employee sustained second and third degree burns on the legs, arms, and hands.
During training, an employee's right thumb was amputated while closing a hose cover on the fire truck.
On 7/21/2019, an employee was threading a paper machine when their fingers got caught. The employee's left thumb, middle and ring fingers were amputated.
While climbing down a ladder, an employee missed a step, fell to the floor, and fractured a hip.
An employee felt symptoms of a heart attack and was admitted to hospital with heat stress.
On 7/21/2019, an employee returned early from their delivery route and felt tired. The employee was hospitalized for a possible heat-related illness.

An employee was doing preventative maintenance on a conveyor motor. The employee was using a rag to wipe off excess lubricant from the motor's housing when their right hand became caught in the sprocket and chain on the motor resulting in the right index finger being amputated to the first knuckle.
At 4:30 p.m. on July 21, 2019, an employee tripped over frozen metal and fell into a sow mold containing molten metal. The employee suffered burns to the arm and torso.
An employee experienced heat stress.

On July 22, 2019, a controls technician was working on a rewiring job. He was pulling the top off a box containing equipment parts. As the top came off, he jerked backwards and went over the railing of the walkway he was standing on. He fell 14 feet, hit a wire reel, and struck his head on the floor. He was hospitalized and had surgery for severe head injuries.

A housekeeper was cleaning a room. Her left hand was holding onto the door frame. When she reached with her right hand to get something off her cart, the door closed on her left hand. She was hospitalized with an injury to the index fingernail.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse and struck a rack. The employee  and sustained a hip laceration.

An employee was rigging angle steel sections to be hoisted by a crane. A section was lifted by hand and pushed in order to free it from the rest of the bundle. While holding the section, gravel shifted under his feet and caused the employee to lose control. The steel pulled back to its original position and caught the employee's hand against the resting section of steel. He sustained a crushing injury which required amputation of the right middle and ring fingertips.

An employee driving a forklift was looking for a shelf to put his load on when the forklift hit a puddle of water and slid to the side. The employee's left heel was crushed between the forklift and a wall.

An employee was standing between the cab of a truck and a trailer. The truck's automatic tarp arm had been activated and was under tension when it broke and swung, hitting the employee in the back. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a spleen injury.
While an employee was loading pieces of wood into a machine, two pieces of wood pinched his left ring finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip and part of the nail bed.
When an employee jumped off a platform that was 54 inches above the ground, his left armpit was punctured by a metal tube. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading cattle onto a shackling chain when he stumbled and a finger got caught in the shackling chain resulting in amputation to a fingertip.

A truck driver was opening up the back gate of his trailer when a forklift that was pulling a trailer down the street struck the truck driver. The truck driver sustained lacerations to the right side of the stomach and two broken ribs.
An employee was using a tool to tighten a bolt to a flange. As the employee was removing the tool, the tool actuated resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was testing a hot water solenoid for the dripping process when he was sprayed with hot water and sustained burns to his chest, neck, and face.
An employee attempted to lift a brake actuator when he felt a sharp pain in his back, resulting in a back strain.

An employee was getting ready to place a pin in the rod basket. The employee slipped and fell approximately 14.5 feet from the top of the derrick to the ground below and sustained a fractured skull, fractures to the face, and a fractured right hand.
During a truck inspection, an employee opened a valve on the truck and was sprayed with phenol and detergent. He sustained burns on his forehead, abdominal area, chest and underarm area.
An employee was walking across a lawn to deliver a package. The employee fell approximately 5 feet off a wall and landed on the driveway, breaking his femur.
An employee was pouring molten aluminum from a hand ladle when the aluminum spilled and burned his leg.
An employee had been delivering uniforms, mats, and towels. The employee was sweating, lost consciousness and was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee was loading a one-person aerial lift onto a trailer and securing the lift to the trailer with a come-along. A hook from the come-along came loose from its attachment point on the trailer. The tension from the come-along cable ratchet system caused the hook to fly back toward the employee, striking and injuring his left thumb resulting in medical amputation of the thumb tip.
While assembling hydraulic cylinders, an employee's finger was pinched between a rod bearing and a cylinder barrel resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was pinned between the spreader bar of a trench box and an excavator bucket during a sewer main installation. The employee sustained lower lumbar and thoracic compression fractures, a bruised liver, and dislocated ribs.
On July 22, 2019, an employee was hand feeding metal rods into the chute of a welding machine when her right ring finger was caught by a clamping device and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a large wheel loader, installing a ring and pinion in an axle. His left ring finger became caught between the ring and pinion and he sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee set the brake and exited a forklift inside a trailer. The forklift then moved and struck the back of their right foot/ankle area. The injury required surgery.
An employee taking meter readings at a customer's home was attacked by a pack of fifteen dogs. She sustained bite injuries to the head, arms, and legs.
An employee was riding on the running board of a moving pickup truck when his hat blew off. He jumped off the truck and hit his head on the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was installing a mirror in a home under construction. The mirror broke and fell on their forearm causing a laceration that required hospitalization.
On 7/22/2019, an employee was walking out of a patient's room when she slipped and rolled her ankle. She was hospitalized for a fractured ankle and required surgery.
An employee was cutting a door on a table saw when his right hand contacted the blade resulting in amputations to the index and middle fingers. The saw was unguarded at the time.
An employee's apron became entangled in the mixer paddles of a mixer and the employee's arm was pulled into the mixer paddles, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee was operating a jointer and was pushing a hold-down across the jointer table when their hand slipped and their left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was setting up a tool to cut. While pushing the tool into a machine, a clamp closed on the employee's finger and he sustained a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was kneeling beside a core drill in order to put water on it while another employee was drilling a 2" diameter hole into the bonded overlay. The core drill seized up in the concrete, causing the entire drill to spin, striking the kneeling employee on his left side and throwing him into the foundation wall. The employee sustained contusions to his knee and elbow.
An employee was getting parts out of a box to inspect, tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the left side and right arm.

An employee was ascending a tree when the tree limb that their climbing line was attached to failed. Their fall protection equipment activated and the employee sustained suspension injuries including bruises.

An employee was moving pallet jack out of a charging station in order to put another jack in the charging station and struck metal racking. His right foot was pinned against the metal racking, causing a heel laceration.

On 7/23/2019, an employee was attempting to remove a crate from a pile of stacked materials when a pile of steel beams became dislodged and fell toward the employee. The smaller steel beams struck a larger steel beam, which then fell onto the employee's right foot. The employee sustained multiple broken foot bones, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped and fell down a stairway, injuring both elbows.
An employee crawled under the lamination line she was operating  and her right hand and arm were burned by a heated roller.

An employee was helping to move a granite slab onto the photograph station using an overhead crane with a clamp attachment. The clamp holding the slab lost its grip and the slab fell, causing crushing injuries to the employee's right foot and the amputation of all the toes.
An employee was installing lighting from an 8-foot A-frame step ladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his right wrist and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was strapping a boat mold onto a trailer when he lost consciousness due to heat exhaustion and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a laceration to the head from striking the ground.
While tripping pipe, an employee tried to catch a pipe collar as it was falling. The employee's fingers were lacerated.
An employee was making electrical connections for lighting in the first floor locker room. While connecting two wires the employee sustained a transthoracic electric shock and burns on both hands.

An employee was making a delivery at a customer's job site. He went to step into the job site trailer when his left foot became stuck on the threshold, causing him to lose balance and hit both knees against the wall of the trailer. He then collapsed to the floor inside the trailer. He fractured both kneecaps.
On July 23, 2019, an employee was walking down the hallway pulling a travel suitcase when she tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was walking to the parking lot when she tripped and fell, fracturing the right knee.

An employee was using plywood to cover access openings in the bridge decking when he slipped and fell through. He fell about 5.5 feet to the temporary platform below, sustaining bruising and fractures to the ribs and wrist.

An employee was installing a crank seal on the mid-bore assembly line using an automated seal press. The press completed and was returning to the home position when it pinched the employee's left ring finger and amputated the finger pad.
An employee was walking up stairs and fell, fracturing her foot.

An employee was walking between the dining room and kitchen when she tripped over the flipped corner of a mat. She fell forward, hitting the front of her face on the ground and injuring her neck. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
While operator training was being conducted for an excavator operator, an employee was run over by the excavator and sustained a right leg injury.
An employee was hooking up a foundry hook to a load when their right thumb was trapped and smashed between the hook and the load.
On July 23, 2019, at 10:00 a.m., an employee was in an elevator at the plaza level when the elevator dropped one to two floors causing a fractured right ankle and a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee fell down stairs.

On July 23, 2019, at approximately 10:30 AM, an employee was installing new hinge pins on the driver's side door of a truck. He bent down to move the stand arms of the lift, and when he stood back up the adjustment handle of the tool holding the door in place poked/contacted his armpit. Approximately 30 minutes later, the employee reported that it was getting painful and difficult to breathe. The employee was hospitalized for a partially collapsed left lung.

A work crew was tasked with installing a 21-inch diameter, 9-foot long, 200-pound pipe sleeve for a duct bank installation through an underground transformer room (vault). The crew knocked out a hole from the wall of the existing vault leading out to an excavated space. Four crew members, located in the vault, got the pipe sleeve into position, approximately 10-feet off the floor, and were able to push the pipe sleeve into the hole towards the employee inside. The center of gravity of the pipe sleeve shifted and slid into the hole. The employee's left pinky was caught between the pipe sleeve and the concrete wall. The top portion of the pinky required medical amputation.
An employee was helping to move a pump assembly when the pump fell off the forklift and struck the employee breaking his pelvis.
An employee had been spinning yarn on a frame when her hair got caught in the yarn take-up shaft. The hair was completely pulled out and the scalp was peeled back.

An employee had changed out belts/sheaves on fan motors for a dry kiln machine. While the employee was manually turning the belt to test the tension, his left index finger got caught between the belt and a sheave and was amputated.
An employee was moving pallets with an electric pallet jack. The employee was backing out of the aisle when falling pallets injured her legs.
During the dismantling process, an employee was removing shoring poles from underneath forms. He was struck by a horizontal beam and sustained crushing injuries to the left leg.

An employee was removing roofing materials and trusses from a camp structure. He was walking on the tin roof when he slid off the roof and fell approximately 22 feet to the ground, suffering a fracture.
An employee was putting away inbound freight using a forklift and struck a wall. The employee's left leg was caught and broken between the forklift and the wall.
On 7/23/2019, an employee was cleaning a dock plate. When a tractor trailer disengaged from the dock, the employee fell from the dock and landed on the ground below. He sustained broken ribs.
On 7/24/2019, an employee slipped on a wet tile floor and fell on the right hip, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on top of a tanker truck while filling it with ethanol using a gravity-fed mechanism. As the employee was filling the ethanol through the top hatchway of the tanker truck, a flash fire occurred. The employee's shirt caught on fire and the employee jumped approximately 12 feet from the top of the tanker truck to the earthen ground below. The employee sustained burns to his torso and arms, as well as a fractured left leg.
An employee was using a forklift to unload building materials. The forklift tipped and he was hospitalized for head injuries.
At the transition of the carpet and tile floors, an employee tripped and fell onto a cart and then the floor, fracturing her arm above the elbow.

While using a forklift to elevate a 500-gallon tote to put 400 gallons of diesel fuel into the fourth compartment of the fuel truck, an explosion occurred and the employee was burned on the face, arms, hands, left side of the body and left leg.

An employee was sealing cracks in the highway with a wand that dispenses rubber sealant from a slowly moving truck when the truck's light tower struck overhead power lines. Electricity traveled through the vehicle and down the wand where it shocked the employee.

The injured employee was holding materials while another employee was pouring molten metal using a spoon. The spoon failed, allowing the molten metal to spill and contact the injured employee's right leg. The molten metal then ran down into the employee's boot causing burns to the ankle and foot.
An employee was operating a shrink wrapper. The employee stepped out from behind a pallet on the shrink wrapper and was struck by a powered industrial truck causing a right leg fracture.
After making a delivery, an employee was shot and sustained injury to the lower abdomen and left leg.
An employee took the handle of a press and went to a lathe to reshape the handle. While using the chuck to reshape the handle, the employee's fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was climbing a ladder with a pack of shingles when he fell off the ladder and landed on a pallet, injuring his back.
An employee was either ascending or descending an equipment-mounted ladder when he fell to the ground, breaking his scapula, rib, and elbow on the left side of his body.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a palletizer when the machine cycled, crushing the employee between a pallet and the wall. He suffered a spinal injury at the waistline.
An employee was entering a construction trailer with a box when the employee tripped, fell, and landed on the trailer floor, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was on a platform cutting boards when he fell approximately 12 feet from the platform to the ground, suffering spinal fractures, a broken left collarbone and shoulder, a rib fracture, a torn lung, and a concussion.
An employee was cutting boards with a circular saw. The saw hit a knot in the board and kicked back, amputating the employee's left thumb tip.

An employee was using a 7,000-psi pressure washer to clean out caulk from concrete. The hose to the pressure washer got entangled and as the employee freed the hose, the pressure washer traversed across his foot while spraying, causing a severe laceration requiring hospitalization.
An employee was ducking under a manual chute when his nose was caught on a small "s" hook attached to a chain. The hook went up his nose and had to be surgically removed.
An employee was standing next to a tractor when it rolled backwards and the right front tire rolled onto the employee's right foot. The employee sustained torn tendons and a fractured right foot.
An employee was clearing trash from an area surrounding a lift when the lift was lowered onto his right foot, resulting in the partial amputation of his middle toe.
An employee was trimming shrubs when he was bitten by a copperhead snake.
An employee was walking in the split case picking area of the distribution center when she tripped or lost her footing and fell. She sustained a fractured right wrist.

While getting down from a dozer, and employee stepped onto the track and was then stepping onto the arm of the dozer when he lost his footing. His left leg slipped between the dozer track and arm, breaking it.
An employee was unloading boxes while doing a delivery and became ill. He was hospitalized due to severe dehydration and heat exhaustion.
An employee sustained a hernia while lowering a 5-gallon bucket of grease.
An employee fell to the ground while clocking out, fracturing the left humerus and left femur.

An employee was operating a forklift when the side of the forklift came in contact with a guard that was protecting a piece of equipment. The guard snapped and hit the employee in the elbow resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting another associate in utilizing the large roll bender to bend 3-foot steel pipe. The employee's left index finger was caught in the machine and sustained an avulsion resulting in amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was involved in a forklift accident, fracturing his pelvis and foot.

At the loading dock, an employee was assisting a co-worker with closing a trailer door. As the trailer was pulling out about 15 feet, the employee was caught between the trailer door and an adjacent concrete wall. He was hospitalized with a crushed shoulder/arm.
An employee working on the debone line was looking for a pair of scissors when the employee's smock pulled her arm into the line resulting in a fracture to the left arm.

An employee was unjamming boards from a rip saw and contacted the spinning blades. He sustained three lacerations to the left hand and forearm, broken fourth and fifth metacarpal bones in the left hand, and a broken ulna in the left forearm. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was welding on a part that was standing upright in a metal stand when the part tipped, pinching and breaking the employee's thumb between the part and the stand.

An employee was performing a mid-shift wash down in the evisceration department when she saw a chicken hanging in the neck skin cutter. She was trying to remove it when her fingers were caught in the cutter, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was wiping off a machine's safety guard while the bottom side rolls were forward coating. Part of his rag dropped into the nip and sucked his hand into the rolls, de-gloving his left index finger.
A driver was making a delivery. While unloading the trailer, his foot became caught in the lift on the back of the trailer causing the employee to fall and break his right ankle.
After returning from her afternoon break, an employee felt dizzy, nauseous, and had shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized for possible heat-related illness.

An employee was sitting in the cab of an excavator as employees were taking a trench box apart. A pin was pulled and the trench box's connecting bar went into the cab of the excavator, striking the employee's left leg and fracturing it below the knee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
On July 24, 2019, at 10:00 p.m., an employee suffered an anaphylactic reaction to honey while sitting next to someone eating honey-flavored cereal.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut beef when the left index finger contacted the bandsaw blade, amputating the fingertip above the first knuckle.
A temporary employee's right arm was caught between two slabs of concrete, causing deep lacerations.
An employee was polishing a small stainless steel part when their glove was caught in the spindle of the polishing machine resulting in amputation of the right middle finger.

An employee was using a ratchet strap to plumb and shim a vertical post that was part of a mezzanine installation. The employee released the ratchet strap and his right index finger was caught in the strap, resulting in a broken finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was releasing tension off a securement binder when it rolled and pinched his left ring finger between the binder and the trailer edge. As a result, his fingertip was amputated to the nailbed.
An employee sustained a gunshot wound to his buttocks and lower body area when another employee (temporary worker) discharged a bullet from a firearm.

An employee was cutting lumber with a pull saw. He had accumulated some scrap lumber underneath the blade. He turned the saw off and proceeded to clean under the saw blade and guard when his hand hit the blade, lacerating his left thumb and index finger. The blade had not come to a complete stop at the time of the incident.
An employee was heating tar with a propane torch. Tar and fire blew out of the tank when the valve came off. The employee suffered burns to the arms, legs and body.
An employee was feeding a web into the rolls of a printing press when the rolls were jogged while his finger was in the pinch point, resulting in the amputation of the employee's fingertip.
An employee was using a sledgehammer to strike a stake into the ground when the sledgehammer struck and broke his right index finger.
An employee was adjusting a clipper using a hex key when the clipper's ram activated and amputated his left fingertip.
An employee was aligning an elevator inside a tower when the employee fell from a height and suffered a head injury, broken pelvis, and broken back.
An employee was merchandising an account when he began to feel symptoms of heat stress and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the end of a rotating shaft. The shaft caught the cleaning cloth and the employee was flipped over it, suffering a broken arm and ribs.
While an employee was being trained to operate a forklift, his left leg was pinned between the vehicle's cab and a column.

An employee was working with an automatic can palletizer when he noticed cans had fallen off a pallet. While the employee was resetting the cans, he was struck in the right leg by the machine causing a fracture to the tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating a punch press when his left middle and index fingers became caught in the press and were crushed.

An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when his left hand was caught and lacerated in the saw, resulting in possible amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingers. He was hospitalized. The saw was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was hospitalized for head trauma after falling 20-25 feet from an order picker onto the cement floor.
An employee was moving a cart of glass mat sheathing when the cart tipped onto his lower left leg and fractured the tibia and fibula.

An employee was walking down concrete steps from a 19" concrete platform. On the last step, the employee's left foot stepped on the front edge of the step, causing the employee's right foot to roll. He lost his balance and continued to step down. His body and leg moved in a twisting motion, causing a break in his right tibia as his right foot impacted the ground. He did not fall down. He then sat down on the step and radioed for help.
An employee was cleaning small pieces of material off a fan when the fan cut his fingers, resulting in amputations to his thumb, index finger, and middle finger.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut wood and amputated his thumb.

On July 25, 2019, an employee was opening a dock door and preparing to load a truck when the employee's left ring finger was crushed between the dock plate and truck, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

Two employees were changing out machine pads on a bar turner machine. To get to the machine pads, they needed to open another door within the machine that was pinned and hinged, however the door was stuck. Both employees pushed the door. When the door moved, the injured employee s right middle finger was caught in one of the pin holes and the distal portion of the finger was amputated.
An employee was pulling a mold out of a machine when the mold pinned the employee's hand against the machine, causing a laceration and fracture to the hand that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning up an aisleway. The employee picked up a portion of a log and went to throw it on the waste conveyor. The employee slipped on the incline that led up to the conveyor, fell down, and his foot got caught on the conveyor. The conveyor belt pulled off his boot and cut his foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained an amputation to the tip of his left thumb while lifting a street grate.

An employee was bundling in the finishing department. The employee was fixing a twisted piece of product in the stacker. While trying to reorient the metal, the employees right middle finger was pinched in the stacker resulting in a partial amputation. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was testing a welding robot for routine maintenance when his left ring finger was caught and amputated in the hydraulic clamp.

An employee was using a rag to wipe off the motor of a running blower when the rag was pulled into the blower. He was trying to remove the rag when his left hand contacted the blower fan blades, resulting in a left index finger amputation.
An employee was attempting to adjust material in a machine when the employee was pulled into the machine, fracturing the left arm and ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped on a nail or screw and suffered a puncture to the foot.
An employee was performing a pre-trip inspection of a pallet jack when it moved forward and pinned his left leg against a guard rail. The employee sustained a broken leg that required surgery.

An employee was installing a belt over a pulley on a fan when his left middle finger was caught between the belt and the pulley. He pulled his hand out and tissue was removed from the first joint of his finger.
An employee was repairing a water leak on a pier and fell approximately 15 inches to the ground, suffering a broken femur.

An employee was using a pipe to pry a stacker table back into the cart as it came off the tracks. The pipe sprung back towards him and hit him on top of his head. The employee sustained a contusion and laceration to the head.
An employee was removing an old meter face. When he attempted to restore power an arc flash occurred. He was electrocuted and required hospitalization.
An employee was putting a box into a trash compactor when his leg was caught in the compactor, breaking his left tibia and deeply lacerating his leg above the left knee.

On July 25, 2019, at about 9:45 p.m., an employee was checking a machine to ensure the line was clean and all food was removed when the employee's right hand became stuck and was crushed in a 3/4-inch gap between the two augers.
A forklift was moving a skid down the dock when it caught the corner of a crate that was on the dock. The crate was pushed into a dockworker's left foot and fractured it.
An employee was rinsing the immersion blender when it slipped from her hands and she tried to catch it. Her right ring finger was caught in the blender and sustained a partial amputation.

On July 25, an employee was installing a metal spiral duct at a newly built grocery store. He was walking backwards while moving the spiral duct to a different location when he lost his footing and fell on a piece of metal conduit. He suffered a pelvic injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an ATV during recertification training when the employee lost control of the vehicle during a turn and rolled over. The employee suffered six fractured ribs (right side), a fractured right arm, and a bruised liver.
An employee was performing HVAC start-up work when he was found unconscious and was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was operating a weed eater cleaning around guard rails when he disturbed a yellow jacket nest and was stung numerous times, suffering an allergic reaction to the stings.

An employee was engaging in metal-working operations, handling a large coil of metal. A hydraulic holding bar came down to secure the coil prior to the machine performing its work. The metal holder came down onto his right thumb, causing a broken bone and laceration to the right thumb.

An employee was operating a plate compactor when a dump truck backed into him. The tire ran over his leg and pelvis. He was hospitalized with a broken pelvis and tailbone and required a skin graft on his leg.

An employee was trying to remove round bar risers from pipelines to replace them with marine board risers. He rigged two pipelines to be elevated so that the round bar could be cut off and replaced with marine board. His hand was on an outside pipe and when the two rigged pipelines were elevated, they swung and collided with his right hand. His right middle finger was crushed and had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was running a bag machine. When he attempted to clean a roller his right index finger was amputated. The roller was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was holding the doors open for employees leaving the fab area when his right thumb was caught in the hinge of a door, causing an amputation to the tip of his right thumb.
An employee was driving a forklift when it hit a support column. The employee suffered a broken arm.

An employee was operating an edger when a stave (board) became jammed in the edger. The employee tried to push a second stave through to clear the edger when the stave kicked back and hit the employee's stomach, causing internal bleeding.

On July 26, 2019, a technician was installing a short belt to circumvent the air conditioning system in the engine compartment of a truck. The employee's right second and third fingers got caught between a pulley and drive belt resulting in partial amputations at the first joints.
An employee was charging an AC unit when freon splashed onto his right hand from an open valve, causing frostbite.
An employee was working in her office when she fainted due to fumes from painting in the area. She was hospitalized.

An employee was laying deck. He was attempting to untangle his retractable when he fell 27 feet onto the concrete floor below. He suffered a back fracture and puncture wound near the liver, requiring hospitalization and surgery. His retractable was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was repairing an automatic pool cover machine when his left middle finger was caught in the moving parts, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was lubricating a chain and sprocket when he dropped the spray nozzle. He was attempting to retrieve the nozzle when his finger was caught by the chain and sprocket, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation. The chain and sprocket were covered at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a sprayer to spray a soybean field when a pin in the equipment broke. She was examining the sprayer's hydraulic hoses and loosened one when the spray boom dropped and struck her lower right leg, breaking it.

An employee was driving a forklift when he approached a steel rack. He was attempting to use his left leg to prevent the forklift from hitting the rack when he struck a steel rack, fracturing his left tibia.

An employee was using a 6-foot A-frame ladder to access and clean windows. The employee fell approximately 2 feet from the ladder and hit their head on the pavement, resulting in a concussion and brain bleed.

An employee was operating a telehandler to set trusses on a new construction site. The employee was making a y-turn maneuver to position the telehandler perpendicular to the sidewall and raise the small post frame truss up and over the 12-foot sidewall. The telehandler was on a steep grade. As the employee was making the maneuver, the telehandler began tipping to the side. The employee attempted to jump from the operator's seat and was struck by the roll cage. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the forehead and fingers.
An employee was pinned between two trailers and suffered internal injuries, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing insulation into the cavity of a wall. A wooden guardrail system was installed around the opened area. The employee was leaning over the guardrails when one topsail separated, allowing the employee to fall from the fourth to the second level floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and right arm.
An employee helping to clean the patio area was pinned between a manlift and a welder resulting in a laceration to the right calf requiring surgery to repair tendons.

An employee was using a ratcheting lifting device to lift the tongue of the pull-behind hydro-seeder off of the hitch of the bull dozer. Once it was off the hitch, the tongue fell and landed on the injured employee's left foot. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the left foot and toes, as well as the amputation of the fourth toe.

An employee was in a trailer moving a pallet of merchandise with a pallet jack when the shrink wrap around the boxes of merchandise came loose. The boxes then fell and struck the employee, causing him to fall from the back of the trailer to the ground. He broke his wrist.

An employee was using a powered industrial truck (PIT) when his right leg was pinned between the PIT and a storage rack. His left tibia was fractured and he sustained two puncture wounds on the left leg as well.

An employee was attempting to free a section of tarp cover that was caught on a trailer when the trailer s air-operated gate was engaged. His hand was caught and crushed by the closing gate, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was on a plane returning from fighting a forest fire in Arizona when the employee became ill due to heat and dehydration. The employee was hospitalized with a muscle injury.
An employee was holding the door open for a co-worker when a fire extinguisher fell off the wall and landed on the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a broken femur.

On July 26, 2019, at approximately 8:30 a.m., an electrician was using a reciprocating saw to remove a bolt from a sump pit at a gas station in order to make a repair. As the employee was sawing the metal bolt, a flash fire occurred and the employee was burned on several areas of the upper body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a golf cart in the facility when their left leg came in contact with a steel safety barrier and was fractured.
An employee was walking to his workstation when cardboard bales fell over and struck him. He sustained shoulder pain and a possible broken ankle.
An employee was prepping a truck for painting when a paint scraper grazed the employee's left hand, injuring the middle finger.
After performing ground work, an employee experienced leg cramps at the end of his shift that became worse. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was on a tractor trailer, securing a load. He lost footing while getting off the truck and fell to the concrete ground breaking his left ankle.

An employee on a roof was headed towards a lift, and slipped on a fiberglass panel and fell 12 feet to a dock below. The employee was hospitalized with a broken nose, bruised and lacerated right eye socket, broken right elbow, broken ribs on the right side, and injuries to the pelvis. Fall protection was not connected at the time of the fall.

An employee was standing on the step on the back of a stopped trash truck. The police were pursuing a vehicle at a high rate of speed when the vehicle hit the back of the trash truck. The employee was thrown from the truck. He stood up and walked for a moment before falling down. He suffered a concussion and neck/upper back strains.

An employee was performing a tool change in an eight-spindle chucking machine. After completing the other seven spindles, he rotated the machine to the eighth spindle and pushed the stop button. The employee's left middle finger contacted a spindle before it had come to a complete stop resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working to remove a broken bolt out of the top drive unit. While removing the swivel/quill, it shifted and fell back into place causing the partial amputation of his left index finger.

An employee was operating water-jetting equipment when it got plugged. He reported the issue and stepped back while another employee started troubleshooting. After steps were taken to continue working, the second employee restarted the equipment. The equipment stopped working again and quickly turned sideways under pressure. Pressurized water struck and penetrated the first employee's blast boot, piercing the skin on his right foot.
An employee was working with a crew on the road to help install cable when the employee crossed the road and was struck by a pedestrian vehicle. The employee broke both legs.

While an employee was cleaning around boilers, a blast of fire came through an open observation door of a boiler. The employee sustained second degree burns to the back of his hands, arms, neck, and face.

An employee was unloading a safe-way trailer using a remote control when he pushed the "in" button instead of the "out" button. His finger was then caught between the hook and cart, resulting in a left ring finger amputation when he pulled his hand back.

An employee had a team working on a new conduit feeder to a substation switchgear. The 480-volt side of the switchgear where the work was taking place was locked out, tagged out, and verified with a meter to not have power.  At the entrance point of the conduit into the substation, another employee was using a knock-out set to punch a hole into the gear. He was having trouble getting the knock-out started, so the injured employee attempted to help him. The injured employee was standing on a two-step riser working with his hands over his head. He was trying to adjust and move some existing wires out of the location of the new knock-out location to thread on the cutting die. As he was moving and pulling, he pushed against the side wall of the switchgear. The side wall flexed into the adjacent compartment, touching a buss that caused an arc flash. The injured employee suffered burns to the hands, left arm, and midsection of his body.

On July 26, 2019, an employee tripped and fell on a carpeted surface while walking out of a patient's room. The employee suffered five bone fractures in her hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped over a box and fell to the floor, fracturing a fibula.
An employee had just climbed down a ladder after completing a welding job. The employee was then struck by a concrete block and sustained cuts, scrapes, and a fracture to an arm.

An employee was putting together an order by stacking materials on wood pallets. The employee went to step over a pallet, caught his foot, and fell to the concrete ground. He landed on his shoulder and was hospitalized for shoulder surgery.

An employee was performing work between a tender truck and an applicator truck. The applicator truck coasted forward and pinned the employee between the two vehicles. The employee sustained multiple fractured ribs.
An employee was delivering mail when he became ill due to dehydration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was preparing dunnage for the setting of concrete products. The employee's hand was on top of the dunnage when the product was placed, pinching the employee's finger between the dunnage and the product. As a result, the employee's left index fingertip had to be amputated at the nail.
An employee was cleaning out a rotary valve when his right hand contacted the moving valve, resulting in the partial amputation of his right index and middle fingers.

An employee was assisting another driver in loading a couch onto the company truck. As the employee was stepping into the truck he slipped off the tail gate, fell backwards, and hit his head on the ground. He was hospitalized with contusions to the head, right shoulder and right ribs.
An employee fell off a powered industrial truck, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was operating a manual dough cutter. The cutter amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was adding paneling on the roof of a 25-foot tall home when he fell off the roof onto concrete. He was hospitalized for a head injury, broken arms, and a fractured skull. Multiple surgeries have also been performed. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was doing maintenance on a piece of machinery with a rotating belt drive. The belt caught the employee's hand, amputating the fingertips.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor/line at the deli walk area of a plant with a chlorine liquid solution (foam spray) and went to the breakroom because she experienced difficulty breathing. She was eventually hospitalized due to inhalation of the foam spray.

On 7/28/2019, an employee was attempting to manually let down a dock plate when another employee released the safety latch because the plate would not come down. The dock plate came down and struck the employee, pushing him into product and the wall of a trailer and landing on his right leg. He was hospitalized with a fractured leg and dislocated shoulder.

An employee was purging material through a silo that has a rotary air lock on the bottom. Product was not flowing; when the employee tried to get the product flowing again, three fingers were amputated in the air-lock mechanism.
On July 28, 2019, at approximately 2:15 p.m., an employee was in the office when her knee gave out. She fell to the ground and sustained fractures to the left shoulder and was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was attempting to repair a dripping A/C unit on top of a mezzanine when he fell 9 feet through a drop ceiling, suffering a head injury, broken ribs, broken vertebrae, and a concussion. The mezzanine was not fully guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was checking an unsecured tow bar connected to a push-out tractor and an aircraft when the tow bar fell onto his right big toe, causing a fracture that required surgery.
On July 28, 2019, a temporary employee was packing containers of product into boxes when the employee's left pinky finger got caught in a pinch point of the turn table and was amputated.
On July 28, 2019, an employee was bent over at the waist to access bottles on a low shelf in a kitchen. An opening cooler door struck her and she fell to the floor, breaking her right hip.
An employee fell about 10 feet to the ground while loading a tanker trailer, resulting in a broken left forearm.
An employee was operating a floor auger when it jammed. When clearing the jam, the employee's finger became caught on an internal shaft resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was unplugging raw material from a feed elevator when he asked another employee to turn on the elevator to make sure it was not plugged in. He saw sticks piling up at the bottom and  went to pull them out. His hand was near the opening of the elevator when he lost his balance and one of the buckets caught his right hand. His right hand was then pulled inside the elevator, causing a laceration to the right middle finger. As a result, the bottom of his right middle fingertip was amputated and he shattered the tip of the bone on the same finger.
An employee fell to the ground and hit his head, suffering a spinal cord injury.
On July 28, 2019, an employee was fixing a steel grading product to a fixture. A steel grading product fell and the employee was hospitalized with fractures to both arms.

An employee was driving a side-by-side ATV along a berm checking a levee for damage when he hit a rock and lost control of the ATV, causing it to roll. He was ejected from the ATV, breaking his left ankle and receiving lacerations to the head.
An employee was working on a ladder adjusting the line on a flagpole when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, breaking his hip.

An employee was on a roof guiding insulated roof panels into place to secure them into steel beams with self-tapping bolts. He was working with two other employees who were in a scissor lift. The roof panel slipped from the beam at the peak before being secured and fell to the scissor lift below.  This caused the other end of the lift to teeter upward, making contact with a 7,620-volt powerline. All three employees were shocked and received electrical burns. The employee on the roof fell approximately 25 feet to the concrete ground below. He was hospitalized with multiple breaks of the right leg and arm, numerous broken facial bones, severely damaged lungs, a tear in the aorta, and possible spinal damage.
While on patrol, an employee was ejected from an ATV when it rolled over. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, contusions/bruising, and a brain bleed.

An employee was searching for scrap debris behind tailing rolls. The employee was descending a step at the tension reel area towards the coil car when his heel slipped, causing him to fall into the coil car, striking his rib cage. He sustained three broken ribs and a contusion on the side.
An employee was trying to determine what was wrong with operation of a miter saw when the saw amputated the end of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was helping guide a fiberglass barge cover as it was lowered onto a hopper barge. The employee's right middle finger was pinched between the cover and the steel barge coaming wall, causing an amputation of the end of the finger.
While loading baskets with material, an employee's hand got caught between a basket and a stop. The employee's right middle finger was smashed and amputated.

An employee was rigging a muck box on a crane. As the crane operator hoisted slack out of the rigging, one of the lifting eyes did not align. The employee attempted to hit the lifting eye with his hand to straighten it out when his left ring, middle, and index fingertips were crushed by the muck box lifting eye, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was stocking shelves from a two-step step ladder. The employee fell, suffering a broken left ankle.

A Metro Public Safety security officer was following someone through a store. As the guard turned a corner, the person they were following struck the guard's face and head with two thick glass bottles, causing a skull fracture.
An employee was packing muffins into containers and felt ill. She was hospitalized with heat exhaustion/dehydration.
An employee was performing maintenance activities from an A-frame ladder when he fell from the ladder to a lower level, breaking his right arm.
An employee was leaving the building to go home when she fell and landed on her right hip on the concrete.
An employee was inside a box truck walking backwards while pulling out equipment on wheels when he overstepped and fell backwards onto a lift gate, fracturing his right arm.
An employee fell, hitting his nose and forehead on the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury and lacerations to the nose and above the right eyebrow.
An employee fell to the floor while walking, suffering a head injury.
While drilling out a part in a milling machine, an employee's glove got caught in the drill bit resulting in amputation of the left index finger just past the nailbed.
An employee was attempting to move a torch cart when the cart fell, striking the employee on the leg and pinning the employee on the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee was using a 60-foot long pole to knock a piece of steel scrap loose from the heating section of a continuous annealer after a strip break when a refractory brick came loose and fell, striking the employee's hard hat and causing a concussion. A second employee sustained a head contusion when the fragmented refractory brick bounced off the first employee's hard hat and struck him in the head. The first employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a floor filter in a spray booth. While the employee was sliding the floor grate back into place, the employee's finger was pinched between the grate and the floor. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was unloading a truck of metal. The metal began falling off the truck, and a piece caught the employee's left hand against the bed of the truck, injuring the ring and little fingers. The little finger was medically amputated.

An employee was beginning to install solar panels. Anchors and ropes had been installed for the job that day. While mapping out the job, the employee fell off the roof two stories to the ground and landed on his left side. He sustained a broken left arm and a broken pelvis.
An employee reached onto a conveyor system to remove a jammed box when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the diverter belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was pulling a sheet of stainless steel from a rack when he dropped the sheet metal and it severely lacerated the back of his leg.

An employee was operating an overhead bridge crane to move steel beams. The employee placed a beam on the floor to be staged, then unhooked the clamp from the beam. When the hoist was raised, a hook from the clamp caught on the flange of the beam causing the beam to fall onto the employee. He sustained bilateral open femur fractures and a pelvis fracture.
An employee was changing a fan motor on an air conditioning unit. The employee fell from the top of the AC unit to the rooftop about 8 feet below, suffering broken ribs and a broken right collarbone.

On July 29, 2019, an employee was cutting a hydraulic hose with a cutting saw when the employee's left hand contacted the saw blade and was cut. The saw blade was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was standing on a 12-foot step ladder when a powered industrial truck struck the ladder, causing the employee to fall and hit the floor. The employee received multiple facial, hand, and finger injuries.
An employee was stripping cable with a sharp tool when the tool cut his index finger.

On July 29, 2019,at 10:30 a.m., an employee was preparing to add sugar product to a metering chute. He reached up into the metering chute to verify the equipment was off and his right middle finger was struck by a pneumatic slide gate. His finger was fractured and lacerated, resulting in a surgical fingertip amputation.

An employee was lifting a cart onto the access floor with another employee. The second employee dropped his side and the injured employee could not hold the weight by himself. His left ring finer was smashed between the cart and the access floor, resulting in a partial amputation.

A machine operator was loading metal strips into a folding machine when his left thumb was caught between the machine's two clamping arms. He suffered an amputation to the thumb without bone loss. The machine was guarded at the time.

Employees were core drilling into the foundation of a new 
building. When they finished drilling, they tried to pull the 
drill bit out of the machine using two wrenches positioned on 
either side of the drill bit. An employee was attempting to loosen the bit when the 
wrench came loose and struck the employee's right eye, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was disconnecting the back trailer from the converter dolly on the truck. There are hooked safety chains between the trailer and the converter dolly. The trailer dropped and pulled a safety chain tight. The chain caught his finger and caused the amputation of the right index finger to the second joint.
An employee was installing a communication main line drop from an extension ladder and fell 15 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured vertebra that required surgery.
An employee was bending over to pick up a crane outrigger pad when the outrigger retracted, catching the employee's left hand. The employee suffered a dislocation and laceration of the left wrist.

An employee working in climbing gear was installing a new ground wire on a power pole. He made contact with a bracket for a security light, which was energized because the photo controller was improperly wired. After making contact, he donned "secondary" gloves and continued working. About 20-30 minutes later he lost consciousness and stopped breathing. He was hospitalized with cardiac arrest.

Employees were lifting a metal plate with a chain and hoist. The steel plate was to be modified/outfitted with eyehooks. Once the eye hooks were welded onto the plate, the plate was lowered. As the plate was being lowered one of the welds failed causing the plate to fall and land on the employee's foot resulting in an amputation.

An employee working on a tallow hot tank was loosening a clamp on a pipe when he was sprayed with 200 degree product, resulting in burns to his face, neck, chest, wrist, and hands. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift when it drove off the dock. The employee suffered a head injury.
On July 29, an employee slipped while walking down a staircase and suffered a bilateral quad tendon tear, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was washing a car. The door shut on her right ring finger and the tip was amputated.
An employee was working on a portable sub-station with a battery and transformer when the employee suffered an electrical shock, burns, and a fall that required hospitalization.

An employee was lowering a 120-pound helical screw into a centrifuge using a chain fall suspended from an I-beam. When the screw fell quickly into place, the employee's right ring finger was caught between it and the shaft. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was testing an electrical drive panel using an AC meter. A wire touched the employee's hand, burning it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a press die when the die struck his left hand, resulting in amputations of the middle and index fingers.
An employee was setting up a precast concrete form when he began to feel dizzy and nauseous. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

On July 30, 2019, a maintenance technician was standing on an 18-foot step stand, preparing to replace a light ballast. He was shocked while working with the 277-volt circuit and fell onto the stand. He lost consciousness and suffered burns and bruises to the hands, and was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a customer's residence, installing fiber optic service. He began to feel cramping in his stomach and right arm and back area. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
On July 30, 2019, a mold dropped while being put in position, pinching the tip of an employee's little finger against the frame of the machine. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee suffered an electrical shock while plugging a cellphone cord into an outlet.
An employee was feeding an extruder machine. As he tried to clear a jammed piece, the machine caught and lacerated his finger.
A fabric calendar operator's right thumb was caught between fabric and a roller. The tip of the thumb was amputated.
An employee was doing landscaping work in the sun when he began to feel ill due to dehydration.
Employees were troubleshooting a T-nut machine. The machine started while an employee's right index finger was placed where the machine punches, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting out a caulk joint with utility knife when the knife was caught in the joint, causing the blade to slip and cut into the employee's left wrist.
An employee was clearing a carcass stuck in a carcass saw. The saw amputated the employee's right index finger.

An employee was standing on a flatbed trailer, pulling a tarp over a load of cast iron pipe that was covered in plastic. When he went to step down off the cargo, his left foot slipped, breaking through the plastic cover and his left leg slipped in between the cast iron pipes. The employee sustained lacerations to the left calf and knee and was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 50 feet from the roof of a water tower to the ground, suffering a broken arm that required hospitalization.
An employee was standing at ground level, unloading a truck, when he fell into a cellar.
An employee working in the converting department felt cramps and looked pale and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was adjusting the setting points on a car lift which had a car on it. The lift raised up, trapping the employee's left index finger between the setting point of the lift and the undercarriage of the car resulting in the amputation of the left index fingertip.
Two carpenters were hoisting an aluminum bridge between water tanks at a water treatment plant. The elevated load struck one of the employees in the torso, resulting in possible broken ribs.
An employee was putting trash into a compactor when a large chair fell onto his chest, breaking his ribs.

After clearing a jammed board, an employee was making a final adjustment on the molder/planer machine. Material was fed into the machine, causing the employee's hand to get pushed into the machine. The employee's left hand contacted the machine's cutting head and was amputated.
An employee was leaning against a sod harvester machine when his right thumb got caught between the conveyor belt and the pulley causing the amputation of the thumb from the first knuckle.
On July 30, 2019, an employee was moving boxes onto a pallet when he felt a pinch in his lower left pelvic area. He was hospitalized due to a hernia.

An employee was tearing off the existing roof on a residential structure when he fell approximately 8 feet to the ground below, fracturing his pelvis and collarbone. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was in a boat traveling back to a dam when the boat passed through an opened gate. The boat became caught on the gate and tipped over. The employee went underneath the water and suffered an amputation to 1/4 inch of the distal joint of the left ring finger.
An employee was logging when a snag hit his leg. He suffered a broken kneecap and femur and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee slipped on a wet floor while walking through a break room, falling to the floor and breaking her kneecap.

An employee was performing a structural upgrade on a tower. The employee's fall protection detached when a part of the tower was removed. The employee fell about 180 feet, striking an ice cover and an ice bridge, and suffered injuries to both legs, the right arm, and the chest.
Two employees were running a rig to brush a well.  One employee's finger was pulled into a pulley by a cable as he checked cable tension. The tip of his right index finger was severed.

A cook was cleaning out the deep fryers. When she opened the valve to clean it, hot cooking oil shot out. The employee sustained burns on the elbows and hand, and got second degree burns on the right arm.
While pulling a cart, an employee tripped on a piece of hardboard and fell, twisting and landing on her left knee. She suffered a broken left leg.
An employee experienced dizziness and weakness from possible heat stroke after being exposed to high temperatures generated by a melter.

On July 30, 2019, an employee was scraping varnish away from a blade with a chisel. The chisel slipped off the blade and the employee sustained a tissue amputation to the right index finger that required sutures.
An employee was cleaning under the shake clipper when the clipper came down and amputated the left ring and middle fingers.
An employee amputated his right pinky finger while attempting to remove the workpiece from a drill press.

An employee was washing a tank barge that contained a caustic product. The product splashed on his upper left arm, then spread to his waist and lower extremities, causing second- and third-degree burns.

A 6-inch riser for sprinklers was being installed. To attach the riser to the system, an employee pulled off a 6-inch grooved cap. The system discharged air, which blew the coupling and cap into the employee's left thumb. The thumb was amputated and the employee was hospitalized.

While an employee was removing a soffit support jack, the cushion block on the bottom of the soffit fell and smashed the ends of his right middle and ring fingers. He sustained an amputation of the right ring fingertip and was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing to close the site for the day and was securing the fence to the dumpster. The employee was struck by a roller machine and was pinned between the fence and dumpster. The employee sustained injuries to the foot and shoulder and also sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.
An employee's finger was caught and amputated between a loader bucket and attachments.

An employee was assembling parts in a clean room while wearing a new smock with a tightly woven hood. She became faint (possibly due to overheating), lost consciousness, and fell to the floor, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

A mechanical engineer technician was upgrading a load bearing machine from manual to automatic when his glove and right index finger got caught between the sprocket and chain. The right index fingertip was amputated.
While standing up from a chair, an employee tripped over the strap of a bag that was on the floor. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a left shoulder injury.
An employee was working from a scaffold platform. The employee began vomiting due to heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.

An employee on a trailer was standing on a load of pipe while spreading a tarp. He fell about 6 to 8 feet off the trailer to the ground and hit his head on a forklift which was sitting next to the trailer. He sustained a head laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead crane to pick up a discharge head. His right hand was caught between the lifting apparatus and the discharge head; his right thumb was crushed and bone was broken.
An employee was changing a light bulb from a ladder. The ladder slipped and the employee fell 18 feet to the floor, suffering six broken ribs, a broken pelvis, and a broken hip.
An employee was slicing potatoes with a food processor. The cutting blades caused amputations to three of the employee's fingers.

An employee was working on a combine truck trying to get a part loose. The employee was using a blow torch when it exploded. The employee was hospitalized with severe burns, especially on the right leg, and smoke inhalation.

An employee was using a remote-controlled, vehicle-mounted jackhammer to demolish an oven. While the employee was removing debris built up near the hammer, the hammer head crushed his left hand against the floor, injuring his index finger and thumb.

An employee was helping a carpenter place handrail/guardrail material around pier holes, as well as moving lumber from material storage to the work area. He began to sweat excessively, then felt cramps down both legs, his arms, and his abdomen as well as nausea. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
An employee became sick while working outdoors and was hospitalized with heat exhaustion, dehydration, and possible muscle damage.
An employee operating a stand-up lift truck in reverse backed into a parked lift truck and sustained a broken hip.
An employee was cleaning a rotary press machine with a rag when the machine's roller caught and crushed his left middle finger and amputated the ring fingertip.
An employee stepped down from a curb and suffered a hamstring injury.
While walking to a door, an employee slipped and fell, suffering a left ankle fracture that required surgery.

An employee was receiving irrigation pipes while standing on a moving trailer connected to a tractor. The employee fell from the trailer and was run over by the tractor/trailer, suffering fractures to the ribs, a scapula, neck vertebrae, and facial bones.
An employee was positioning product on the shelves in the chip aisle. The employee then turned to walk, tripped over a display, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee delivering building materials fell from the truck to the ground, resulting in a fractured right ankle, a forehead laceration, and an injured wrist requiring hospitalization.

An employee was waiting for a crane to bring him lifting chains so that he could attach them to a compressor being swapped out at an oil well site. He lost his balance and struck a muffler, which his fall protection was tied off to; the muffler fell to the ground and carried him with it. He suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving heavy floor mats out of a building and into his car. He suffered neck and back strains due to the heaving lifting.

An employee was in the center of the street applying marks to the pavement for placement of reflective buttons to mark the lanes. An SUV turned onto the street at a high rate of speed. It dragged the employee before running them over with the front and rear tires. The employee sustained injuries including: an open fracture to the left pelvis; fractured right pelvis; bilateral hip fractures; fractured bones near the eye and cheek bone areas; fractured nose; bruised right lung; bruised liver; and abraded skin and tissue of the face.
An employee was rigging up a mold to an overhead crane. He fell into the mold storage pit, landing 7 feet below, losing consciousness, and suffering a broken rib. He was hospitalized.
While leaving a classroom, an employee tripped over the baseboard or doorjamb. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and possibly a broken right arm.
An employee was walking between two telehandlers. Her leg was caught on the fork support bar of one of them and its blade caught her foot. She fell backwards, breaking her right wrist.
While marking gas lines at the side of a road, an employee was struck by a vehicle. The employee suffered broken bones and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was helping another employee to drop a pallet with a forklift. The pallet was dropped and the injured employee's right index finger was smashed between it and a metal rack beam, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was standing by, waiting for other employees to finish stacking boxes. The lower boxes in the stack collapsed, causing the upper boxes to fall forward onto the employee breaking both legs.
An employee spraying product onto the ceiling of a building fell to the concrete floor from a 39-inch scaffold. The employee was hospitalized with a ruptured spleen and a left shoulder injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a heater treater on a water tank. A flash back from the heater burned the employee's face.
An employee was pulling a trash bag out of a trash bin that is on a wheeled base. The employee fell and fractured a kneecap.

An employee was moving hoses on a frac spread. He had the hoses over his shoulder when residual biocide from one of them flowed onto his shoulders and back. He later lost consciousness and was hospitalized to treat dehydration and skin rashes.
An employee was doing demolition work on a concrete masonry unit wall with a sledgehammer. Part of the wall gave way and fell onto the employee, breaking his right leg.

An employee was working in a customer's attic above the second story. The employee fell two stories through the ceiling and landed on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a shoulder injury.

On 7/31/2019, at approximately 11:07 AM, an employee was walking inside the facility when he was struck by a forklift and sustained multiple fractures to the left foot. The injured employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
While being cut, a 20-inch metal pipe separated and a section struck an employee's lower right leg, causing broken bones.

An employee was monitoring a tree climber. A tree was cut down, rolled into another tree, became airborne, and landed on the employee's right foot, breaking a bone. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
Two employees lifted a large animal. Later, one of them began feeling numbness and tingling in the legs and feet. She was hospitalized, having suffered a back injury.
An employee was helping to lift a C-channel cross member into place when the C-bolt channel clip amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was pulling fish out of a bin in a fish processing room. A fish's fin poked him through his glove. His right little finger was amputated.
An employee was pumping raw milk. As he changed or shut a valve, his right fourth finger was sucked into a vacuum hose. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading a steel cylinder cradle onto a forklift when the cradle slipped off the forks and hit the back of his head and other parts of his body. He suffered a fractured skull.

After cutting a dead tree, an employee was pulling it down with a rope. As the tree came down it struck another tree, which caused a branch from that tree to break and strike the employee in the head. He suffered a concussion and a possible broken bone in his upper back.
An employee was working on an automated rebar bending machine when it severely lacerated his finger.
An employee was struck by a truck's rear wheel while directing traffic. The employee suffered a broken shoulder and severe abrasion to the back and neck.
An employee was working outdoors on powerlines. On returning to the yard, the employee became ill and was hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was putting metal in a pot to melt. The top of the metal started to solidify; the employee was using a rebar to poke a hole in the top to mix the metal when some of the metal splashed onto coils outside the pot. This caused steam to build up and pressurize the metal, which expanded and flew out of the pot. The employee fell while trying to escape the splash, landing on metal that had hit the floor. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the hands, left knee, and stomach.
An employee was pulling plywood from a storage bin when he suffered a hernia.
An employee was disconnecting a hose when it struck him. He was burned by ammonium hydroxide from the hose.

Two employees were replacing roofing panels from the platform of a lift. The lift made a sudden upward movement, causing one employee to hit a steel beam above. The employee suffered head injuries and was hospitalized.
On August 1, 2019, an employee slipped on a freshly painted floor and fell, suffering broken vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder, struck his head, and injured his back.
An employee was helping to hoist a pipe. The pipe swung and the employee's finger was caught between it and a beam. He suffered an amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee was installing pipe with a pipe crew. The employee began to have leg cramps and was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

An employee was grading lumber. A 1x4 board entering the trimmer skewed, causing the board to be cut lengthwise (instead of crosswise) and to be ejected from the saw. It struck the employee on the right side of the abdomen, causing a contusion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a forklift to dump trash into a dumpster. He fell from the forklift or the dumpster to the concrete pavement, suffering a fractured skull.
An employee was coming down a 16-inch lift when he fell, landing on the floor. He suffered back pain and leg weakness.
A jackhammer smashed a finger on an employee's left hand against a structure, causing an avulsion.
An employee was coming out of a stairway when an emergency door slammed on his finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was exiting his truck when he slipped on the ground which was wet from rain and slid down the incline against a retaining wall. He suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was filling cushions with blown polyester fiber. The employee's right hand was amputated in the machine's fiber opening drum.
An employee was trying to flush a liquid bulk tank trailer with hot water. Hot water splashed from a valve in an adjacent bay onto the employee's left leg, burning the calf and the back of the thigh.

An employee was checking on an in-service gas well because the gas had stopped flowing. As hot water ran through the system to melt built-up paraffin, the cap blew off the pipe and the hot water sprayed the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.
Employees were using a forklift to move a 12-inch by 4-inch by 13-foot steel tube radius. The boom came down quickly and an employee's left foot was crushed between the tube and the ground.
An employee was checking a movie theater auditorium when he fell down the stairs, breaking his ankle.

An employee was digging in a customer's yard when he came into contact with pesticides that had been used to treat the yard. He developed a rash the next day and was hospitalized for dermatitis and cellulitis.

An employee clocked out for the day and was walking to her car. The employee stepped off of a curb, heard a pop in her right leg, and fell. She sustained a fractured right ankle, torn tendon, and calf strain. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was punched in the face by another employee and was hospitalized with a head injury.
At about 9:20 a.m. on August 1, 2019, an employee slipped on a spot of water in a hallway and fell, suffering a torn right hamstring. The employee was hospitalized.
A boiler damper was closed, causing an employee to be exposed to carbon monoxide and lose consciousness.
An employee tripped while leaving a register bay. She fell to the floor and cut her head.

An employee was in the street, using a blower to blow cut grass. A passing car struck the employee, causing a traumatic brain injury, a broken jaw and femur, skin abrasions, and an eye injury requiring surgery.
While unloading a conveyor belt, an employee became faint, began to sit, twisted his ankle, and then fell and broke his leg.
A temporary employee was operating a rebar bending machine. His finger got stuck between the rebar and the pin for bending it and was injured.

At about 11:15 p.m. on August 1, 2019, a stage hand was pushing a road case on stage when he fell (less than 6 feet) from the stage to the concrete floor. He hit his head, suffering a concussion, and was hospitalized.
An employee was mowing a lawn on a zero turn mower when the front wheel struck a gate. The employee suffered a contusion on the right leg and a broken left leg.
An employee reached up to pull a bag that had been sucked up by a rotary valve. The rotary valve amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
