An employee was repairing the steering column on a mobile crane. His hammer struck his right index finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
At about 11:30 a.m. on August 1, 2019, an employee was working from a bucket truck, taking measurements of a telephone pole. A power line touched him, causing electrical burns. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning cement off an end dump trailer's tailgate latch. The tailgate closed, pinching the employee's left ring finger between the gate pin and the latch and amputating the fingertip just above the nailbed.
While leaving an exam room, a nurse tripped over the exam step and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left humerus. The nurse was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
At about 12:00 p.m. on August 1, 2019, an employee was leaving a cafeteria when her foot caught on rubber flooring and she fell, breaking both kneecaps. She was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to check the tension on a belt and pulley attached to a pump assembly. The motor started and the employee's fingers were fractured and amputated.
An employee was exiting an elevator when he tripped and fell, hitting his head on a wall. The employee sustained a concussion and a fractured left hip.

Employees were inspecting a joint of pipe on a rack. Another joint of pipe, rolling from the blast line toward the inspection rack, rolled over the stops and struck one of the employees, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was pulling a bologna tree (rack) on a rail system to an oven when the tree snapped and fell on his left leg, breaking it.
An employee was being trained on how to use a punch press. The punch activated while his hand was under the die, amputating the tip of his left thumb and the top of his right index finger.
An employee was hooking the latch from a truck to a dumpster. The truck's lifting lever was engaged, and the employee suffered a partial thumb amputation in the pinch point.
An employee was riding on an amusement park's mountain ride. He lost his balance and came partly out of the cart; his arm hit the track and his arm was broken.

A no-bake foundry operator was cleaning sand from a mixer discharge. The sand mixer blades came into contact with the employee's fingers. About an inch of the left index finger was amputated; the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery to other fingers.
An employee was on a piece of machinery retrieving something. He slipped and fell about 2 feet to the ground, where he hit his head on the pavement.

An overhead crane was being used to stack 4-by-4-by-20-foot steel beams on an existing pile of beams. An employee was walking through the area when a stack of about 20 beams from the pile collapsed and struck the employee's legs, breaking both of them.
An employee was moving a gearbox when it landed on his index finger, amputating the tip. He was hospitalized.
At 3:00 p.m. on August 2, 2019, an employee was trying to relight a pizza oven's pilot light when an explosion occurred and fire burned him. He was hospitalized.
An employee had climbed a ladder to diagnose a jammed conveyor belt. An industrial ceiling fan's rotating blades struck his head, causing contusions and cuts. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a trailer when his foot became lodged between a bar and a moving conveyor belt near the tail of the belt. His right ankle was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working from a ladder on a trailer, covering glass with a tarp. The tarp got caught on something. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground, suffering a broken neck.

A machine operator was moving a 4,200-pound steel plate into position onto an oxy burning table, about 2.5 feet above the floor. The employee was on the table, moving the plate into position using an overhead crane and a bar walker magnet, when the plate got hung up. It then popped up, shifted, and struck the employee in the leg. He fell off the table and suffered a compound fracture to the left leg.
An employee fell to the ground from a 5-foot ladder, suffering head trauma.
An employee was at a substation removing a bird's nest. The employee suffered a 7,200-volt shock and was hospitalized.

An employee's right hand was caught between a hanger and a stationary part of a clothing conveyor system. Three fingers on the employee's right hand were crushed. The tip of the right index finger was amputated up to the first knuckle.
An employee fell and hit her head. She was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a scissor lift between rows of stacked wood to apply end tags. As the lift rose, her left hand was pinched between its handrail and a stack of wood. A fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell about 4 feet from a ladder, hitting his head on the floor and suffering a concussion.
An employee was notching metal material on a notcher machine and amputated the right middle finger at the first joint.
An employee was cleaning a pep machine when a moving chain amputated one of his fingers.

An employee was getting off a tractor to close a gate. The tractor moved backward and the front tire knocked him down. He suffered a dislocated hip, a dislocated shoulder, and a possible hip fracture.
While replacing a ceiling light fixture, an employee was shocked and fell. The employee's head struck the floor, and the employee was hospitalized with head trauma.

An employee was using a crane with a hand-held pendant to turn over a piece of railroad rail (up to 80 feet long, weighing up to 2,000 pounds) on a work table. The rail rolled toward him and broke his left arm.
An employee was retrieving a fallen part from a shot blast machine. The employee's lower left arm was pinched and lacerated between the rotating internal bed and the machinery wall.

An employee was using a half-gallon metal transfer ladle. After she finished the transfer process, the kettle sat on a hot plate. She was clearing a wax chunk from its inside lip when the chunk fell into the kettle and splashed hot wax on her hand. She suffered burns to both hands (mainly the back of the right hand) and possibly on the back of her neck.

An employee was working on a 12- to 15-foot aluminum aircraft floor beam resting on a table. The employee tripped on the table leg and, as she fell to the floor, the beam fell onto her. She suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was operating a standup forklift. A metal rack made contact with the employee's right foot, causing lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was unhooking a cable from a block of metal. The end of the cable was fitted with a quick disconnect device. As the employee removed the cable, the device closed and cut the employee's left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized for infection prevention.
An employee was standing in front of a deli department when a customer's shopping cart struck her. She fell to the floor and suffered pelvic fractures, and was hospitalized.
An employee was in a receiving area when a roll-up receiving door fell off the wall and struck the employee on the arm. The employee suffered a cut and bruising and was hospitalized.

An employee was descending in an aerial lift when his right shoulder made contact with an energized power line (138, 000 volts, about 25 feet from the ground). He suffered burns from the right side of his neck to his pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was closing a 2-inch ball valve on a test separator to make repairs to the down side of a low-pressure sand knockout. The employee was about 2 to 3 feet from the ball valve as he closed it; when he got the valve three-quarters closed, the bell reducer pipe on the back side of the ball valve separated in two, releasing pressure in the test separator. The employee suffered sand blast burns to the left side of his body, a broken arm, a sprained ankle, a fractured back vertebra, and a head laceration.
While an employee was filling a drum/tote on the production floor, an e-cigarette that was in his pocket caught on fire. The employee sustained burns.

Three HVAC mechanics were trying to stop a water drip from a steam line. They isolated the line upstream and downstream from the location of the leak. One of the employees cracked open a pipe union to drain the condensate from the line. Steam began to release from the pipe union unexpectedly, causing second-degree burns to his right hand and arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a body manufacturing shop when his fingers were caught by a conveyor. Two fingertips were amputated.
An employee was cutting 10-inch-wide, 1,600-pound concrete piles from inside a 15-foot-deep excavation. A pile fell on him, breaking his back, pelvis/hip, and upper and lower leg.
On August 3, 2019, an employee was putting feed in a kennel when a dog bit the tip of the employee's ear off. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting touch-up areas while on a suspended work platform. The employee fell 12 feet off the platform, landing on a hard surface and suffering a back/shoulder injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a bean-grading machine in preparation for sanitation. The employee was opening the doors to clean the machine with a power washer when his right ring finger was caught by a roller with a solid bar. The finger was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee was splashed with hot tar after a machinery malfunction.

An employee was working at a nurse station. A member of a patient's family sprayed deodorizer at the door, causing an allergic reaction and severe respiratory distress in the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing batteries from a substation battery house when a flash fire caused first- and second-degree burns to his face.
Two employees were shot by an active shooter in a store.

An employee loaded a piece of rebar onto a rebar bending machine. His finger was in a pinch point between the end of the rebar and a positive stop on the machine when the machine was cycled, resulting in an amputation of the upper portion of his left index finger.

Approximately six hours into his shift, an employee was sweating profusely and came into the air-conditioned quality control lab to cool down. The employee became ill, lost consciousness, and was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
While getting out of a truck, an employee slipped on a step and fell to the ground. The employee's lower leg was broken.

During the unloading of a vessel, an employee was disconnecting twist locks from shipping containers. A twist lock from a container above the employee fell and struck the employee in the face, causing facial fractures.
While cleaning under a conveyor, the employee became entangled in the conveyor and suffered a strangulation injury.
An employee was dismantling the jib on a crane. When the connecting pin was removed, the jib shifted, striking and lacerating three fingers on the employee's left hand.
An employee was doing maintenance on a skinner machine. His finger was caught in a belt and amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee became dehydrated (due to the weather) while overseeing a pipeline project.

An employee was pulling a manual pallet jack when the pallet jack became stuck by pitting on the floor. When the pallet jack became free, the wheel ran over the employee's foot causing lacerations to the second and third toes on the right foot.
An employee's foot got stuck in some shrink wrap that was hanging off a vendor's pallet. He tripped, hitting his head on another pallet and suffering a head laceration and fractured vertebrae.

An employee was washing a drill stabilizer (100 pounds per foot, about 8 feet to 10 feet long) when it fell, striking the employee on the right foot between the big toe and the second toe. The big toe was medically amputated.

On August 4, 2019, a maintenance mechanic was tracking plastic film through a package-sealing machine during a setup process. A film clip caught the mechanic's jacket, pulling the mechanic's right hand toward the chain and gear. The mechanic suffered amputation of the middle and fourth fingertips.
On August 4, 2019, a hose in a pump house water pit disconnected while a valve was being opened. Steam burned an employee on the left side of his body.
An employee fell to the ground while walking. He suffered contusions to the head and left hand and was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a cart loaded with supplies out of a truck. He fell off the lift gate, got his leg caught on the gate, and was left hanging upside down. He suffered broken bones in the lower right leg.
An employee was using a meat saw to cut marrow bones into smaller sections when his right hand slipped and contacted the blade resulting in a deep laceration to his right index finger.
An employee slipped on the second step of a stairway and fell to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and a subdermal hematoma.
An employee helping to unload a telehandler had his hand caught between the telehandler's carriage and the wall board.

A technician was troubleshooting a multi-spindle CNC lathe which is used for metalworking. The technician was manually spinning the spindle which causes the belt and pully to spin. The injured employee s hand became caught in the machine resulting in an amputation to the left index finger.

Employees were using a forklift to move a piece of steel onto a structure when an employee's hand was caught between the steel load and the structure. The employee sustained a crushing injury that resulted in amputation of the right ring fingertip.

An employee had leaned a small ladder against the truck in order to load a larger ladder onto the truck. The ladder he was on slipped and he fell backwards about 2 feet to the asphalt, hitting his head.

An employee was driving a standup forklift to transfer a pallet from the production area to a warehouse. The forklift veered off course and struck a concrete wall. The employee s left foot was caught between the forklift and the wall. He sustained a fractured left foot and ankle.
An employee fell down a set of stairs and was hospitalized with a dislocated shoulder and cracked ribs.

An employee was changing a tire on a tractor. The jack stand that the tractor was on had a piece of wood underneath because the ground was not level. The piece of wood cracked, and the jack stand slipped. The tire came off the lugs and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a ruptured spleen and had surgery.
An employee was cleaning a paint gun at the end of the day when a paint and water mixture was injected into his left middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.
The employee was working on a radiator on a forklift. A fire truck backed up into the employee, impaling the employee's left forearm between the truck and the radiator bolt.
An employee developed heat stress while cleaning a plant site and securing a load to a semi-trailer throughout the day, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell from a ladder while accessing a mezzanine, suffering four cracked ribs and a fracture to the base of the head.
While being moved, a modified handicap vehicle with the pedals reversed, drove forward and an employee was pinned between the van and a workbench. The employee suffered crushing injuries.

An employee had completed approximately seven hours and forty-five minutes of mail carrying duties. He returned to the post office and went to the break area. He was observed to be ill but was responsive. The employee was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.

An employee was using a router with a diamond bit to cut a granite slab. While the tool was running, the diamond outer shell broke and a piece of the broken router bit struck another employee in the eye.

An employee was driving a forklift with a dump bucket attachment full of dirt. The employee stopped the forklift and prepared to dump the bucket. When he pulled the manual latch of the dump bucket, the bucket slid backwards toward the lift. One of his fingers was caught and partially amputated between the forklift and the bucket.

An employee was bending over to remove a license plate from a car. He then stood up, lost his balance, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a contusion to the left side of the forehead, a subdural hematoma, and a laceration above the left eye.

On August 5, 2019, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the forklift struck a horizontal PVC pipe that is suspended by chain and used as an area barrier. The end of the pipe shattered and pieces fell to the floor. The employee sustained lacerations to the left side of the face and bone fractures resulting in surgery.
An employee had entered the auto stacker area to straighten wood when his clothing became entangled in a rotating shaft. The employee was hospitalized with a pelvic injury that required surgery.
At 7:40 a.m. on August 5, 2019, an employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, suffering contusions and left hip and leg pain. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to get a sick steer out of a pen. The steer tried to return to the pen and his horse tried to stop it. The employee's horse then fell to the ground with him still on it, causing the horse to fall on his left leg. With help from another employee, the injured employee was able to get his foot out of the stirrup. His ankle broke in two locations and he suffered a blood clot in his left leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was stripping formwork from poured concrete using a prybar when the prybar slipped and caused him to lose balance. The employee stepped back onto a piece of plywood which caused his foot to twist and fractured his right leg.

An employee was working from an elevated platform. When the employee grabbed a wire rope guardrail, the guardrail collapsed, and the employee fell head first approximately 6 feet into a lift basket. The employee sustained bruising to the spinal cord, fractured vertebrae, and a broken nose.
An employee was struck by a forklift and sustained a laceration to the right leg and amputation of the right foot.

Two employees were removing a motor from an overhead bracket and turned to lower it to the floor. As they were lowering it, one of the employees had his left middle finger caught and crushed between the motor and a 12-inch chute. The employee sustained amputation of the distal phalanx.

On 8/05/2019, an employee was standing on a wood shelf while dismantling an upper shelf. The shelf that the employee was on broke and he fell about 5 feet to the floor. He sustained a dislocated knee.
An employee fell from the roof of a single-story residence while bringing product up to the roof. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was working on a 7.6 kV electrical switch gear panel to add a new cable. The employee was electrocuted and sustained burns to both feet and the right hand.
An employee was tied off in a scissor lift approximately 15 feet high when a beam broke loose and overturned the scissor lift. The employee sustained a shattered wrist and fractured hip.
An employee was installing raptor control on a powerline when the employee contacted the 7,200-volt line jumper. The employee was hospitalized with a burn to the right index finger.
While entering a 3-foot trench, an employee fell onto the handle of a shovel. The employee was impaled by the handle, and sustained injuries which included a perforated intestine and a broken rib.

An employee was running cables in an office ceiling. While ascending a 6-foot A-frame ladder, he fell to the floor and sustained a broken right clavicle, skull fracture, and a brain aneurysm consistent with a concussion.

An employee was climbing a ladder to trim a palm tree. Before reaching the top, to tie the ladder to the palm tree, the employee fell backwards off the ladder. He landed on the brick patio 10 feet below and sustained fractured vertebrae in the neck and back and fractured ribs.
An employee was stacking pallets when a forklift ran into him and pinned him against pallets. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the abdomen and a collapsed lung.

An employee was uncoupling semi trucks via the temporary fifth wheel connection. The trucks had been setup in the piggy back configuration for transport. The employee was pinned between two semi trucks and sustained a fractured jaw and a head laceration.
An employee was walking behind the planter machine that was planting sugar cane. While on break the employee collapsed. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke with complications.

An employee was standing in the cab of his truck, in a bent position, adjusting the shifter boot. He stepped backwards, lost balance and fell from the cab. He sustained injuries to the hip, back, and head, as well as a brain bleed.

In preparation to cut rebar, a Bechtel Construction Services employee was picking up a battery-powered band saw from the ground with his right hand. He simultaneously reached underneath the housing of the band saw and grasped the blade with his gloved left hand. The band saw activated and caused a laceration to his left index finger.
An employee was walking down a two-step stairway, and either missed a step or his foot gave out. The employee landed on the floor and fractured a hip.
An employee was checking fuses at a 480-volt control panel when a flash fire occurred burning the employees face, left hand, and right forearm.
An employee was hospitalized due to stress-related angina.

An employee was responding to a quality issue with a piece of equipment that had a fixture out of place. The clamp was under pressure with air and continued to move once the fixture was back in place. The clamp then pinched the employee's left middle finger and tore off the nail and fingertip.
While in pursuit of a suspect in the desert, an employee ran through a mesquite bush that caused a puncture injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was riding an ATV to the next prairie dog town. The ATV went into a drainage ditch that was hidden by vegetation. As the employee fell into the ditch their head struck an adjacent embankment. The employee initially lost feeling below the neck, and later recovered some sense of touch. The ditch was approximately 5 feet deep by 4 feet wide.
An employee was delivering mail to a house when a dog came out of the door and bit her left hand, left wrist, and right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing the hydraulic assembly on a trailer when the third fingertip on the employee's left hand was amputated in a pinch point.

An employee was unloading a dump trailer when the dump trailer tipped over and caused the truck to tip over on the passenger side. The employee sustained a head contusion, kidney laceration, four broken ribs, and a punctured lung.
An employee was using a table saw to make a drawer box for a cabinet. The drawer side kicked back and the table saw amputated the employee's left middle finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was throwing laundry down a linen chute when the chute door closed on the employee's left ring finger.

An employee was opening a vessel's pump valve when hot pressurized water inside the vessel splashed out and sprayed the employee. The employee received second degree burns to the legs, chest, and arms.

An employee was cleaning and sweeping around a conveyor when his left arm got caught in the conveyor belt, pulling him onto the conveyor. The employee was hospitalized with torn skin and muscle around the left arm at the shoulder.
An employee's left index fingertip was amputated by a power press.
An employee had two fingers amputated by the powder die in a mechanical power press.
An employee was bitten on the leg by a spider while cleaning cobwebs and developed an infection.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the ground and sustained broken bones.

While removing a 60 x 48-inch glass window in a school gym, an employee fell 12 feet from the bleachers. The employee struck his head on the concrete floor resulting in a fractured skull, brain bleeding, and swelling of the brain.

On August 6, 2019, an employee was picking his shipment on a standup forklift. As he was backing up with the load, his left foot was caught between the forklift and an I-beam. He sustained broken toes and a partial amputation of the big toe.
An employee tripped and fell while walking into the office. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder.
An employee fell from atop a tractor trailer, landing on the ground and suffering a dislocated left elbow and two torn ligaments.
An employee had completed his shift as a delivery driver. Later, while at home, he felt ill and was hospitalized for kidney problems possibly associated with heat and dehydration.

An employee was preparing to transfer hydrofluoric acid. A transfer pump motor/gear needed repair in order to transfer the hydrofluoric acid. The employee removed the pump, made the repair, and returned to reassemble the pump. The employee was splashed by hydrofluoric acid and sustained chemical burns to the torso.

An employee was manually lighting burner boxes on hot oil trucks. When using a cigarette lighter to ignite a pilot burner a liquid propane gas flashback (woof) occurred and the employee suffered flash fire burns to the face and lungs.
An employee was torch-cutting a coupler off a railcar. The coupler fell onto the employee's left foot, breaking it.
At 9:30 a.m., on August 6, 2019, an employee was using a ladder to reach the edge of a ceiling. He fell 12 feet from the ladder, suffering a broken left femur and tibia. He was hospitalized.
While stepping onto the track of a bulldozer, an employee sustained a bilateral quadriceps tendon rupture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut roofing decking. The saw became stuck, then came loose and cut the employee's right and left forearms.
An employee entered a room to check trash bins. She tripped on a table leg, fell and broke her hip.
An employee driving an electric pallet jack collided with another employee driving a forklift. The pallet jack driver sustained injury to the left heel.

On August 6, 2019, an employee was supervising the renovation of an elementary school. He was reconnecting a light fixture to the power source when he was electrically shocked and fell about 8 feet from an A-frame ladder to the floor. He sustained burns to his hands and dislocated his left knee cap. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was using an electric jackhammer to break up rock under a pipeline. Flammable gas reacted with the electric motor of the jackhammer, causing a flash fire. The employee was burned on the forearms and face.
While setting up an I-beam for installation, an employee's right big toe was amputated by a pile driver.
An employee was pressure washing a rig when the employee began to see spots and experienced dizziness due to dehydration.
An employee had stepped off a forklift to scan product when pallets behind him fell and struck him, causing a right hip dislocation.
On August 7, 2019, an employee experienced cramps and was hospitalized due to heat stress.

An employee had climbed onto a plasma cutter table to retrieve cut-outs. While the employee was stepping off of the plasma table, part of the grate bent, causing him to fall and hit his head on the plasma track. He suffered a large laceration on top of his head.
An employee was pressure testing a container when the lid blew off and injured his left elbow.

An employee was manually repositioning a full 55-gallon drum when the employee's left index fingertip was caught between the rim of the drum and a second 55-gallon drum, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was attempting to remove a jammed product from a griddle discharge conveyor. The employee went under the conveyor to remove the jam and scraped their left hand on the ground. The scrape became infected.
An employee was standing on top of forklift forks when the forks were lowered and the employee's finger was caught in the hydraulic pinch point. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was installing plywood on a roof. The plywood was staged on forklift forks that were raised approximately 12 feet. The employee climbed from the roof onto the forks of the forklift to retrieve the plywood. The employee was kneeling on the stack of plywood when it fell to the ground. The employee fell with the plywood approximately 12 feet onto concrete, requiring hospitalization for a fractured left ankle.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor while entering the break room, suffering a hip fracture.
An employee was using a pipe wrench to tighten a fitting when the wrench amputated his little finger.

An employee was operating a trim saw to trim boards to length. He fed the board material into the discharge side of the saw at which time his glove was caught on the chain conveyor, pulling his hand into the blade. The index finger and ring finger on his right hand were severed.
An employee experienced cramping in his hands and arms due to heat stress.
An employee fell off a stack of pallets to the ground, dislocating his foot.

After returning an item to the produce section, an employee was walking back toward the cash register area when his left shoe caught on the floor causing him to lose balance and fall onto his right side. He was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.

An employee was using a hose to spray an overhead conveyor while on a six-foot extension ladder. The employee lost balance and their hand became caught in the running conveyor belt. The employee sustained three broken fingers and a partial degloving of the left hand.
An employee was working outside at a saw mill, sorting boards on a green chain line. He began to suffer from heat-related illness and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing stucco work using a scaffold when the scaffold collapsed and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left shin, shattered ball area of a foot, and two fractures to a finger on the right hand.
An employee was stepping down from the back of a shuttle/vehicle and landed awkwardly resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was feeding sassafras leaves into a hammer mill when the bottom of the cyclone dust collector connected to the milling machine became clogged. While clearing the clog, her hand was caught in the rotating impeller of the cyclone dust collector. All fingers on the right hand, except the thumb, were amputated near the first knuckle.
An employee went to remove a gladhand lock from a trailer when a yard jockey backed up and struck the employee, resulting in broken/bruised ribs and a collapsed lung.
While operating a fiberglass mat cutter, an employee's finger was caught in a pneumatic clamping mechanism. The employee sustained an amputation to the left index fingertip.

An employee had used a prybar to remove an un-flattened end of a new coil, and was standing on the coil in an attempt to feed the end into the shear. The coil was moved, and the employee's left foot was caught and fractured between the coil and a hold-down roller.
An employee became overheated and suffered heat exhaustion while working in a manhole.

An employee was on a ladder attempting to put a belt on an exhaust fan when the fan began spinning.  The pulley popped out and hit him on the head, knocking him off the ladder. He suffered a cervical spinal cord injury.

An employee was stepping off a stand-up forklift in the battery charging area in order to charge the lift. The lift moved as the employee stepped off, and it pinched his right ankle between the lift and a metal cart. The employee was hospitalized for a broken right ankle that required surgery.
An employee was using a mud mixer (hand-held) when his hand entered the bucket with a rag. The running mixer amputated his pinky finger.
An employee was walking around the property when he became dizzy and had to sit down. He was hospitalized due to heat stress.

Two employees were moving a 55-gallon drum containing windshield wiper fluid. One of the employees had to re-position the barrel from the vertical to the horizontal position using a rocking stand and strap. As the employee was positioning the barrel, it slipped. The employee's right pinky finger was caught between the drum and stand, resulting in a finger amputation.
After delivering packages to customers, an employee began to suffer heat-related illness, arm pain, and vomiting. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 7, 2019, employees were diagnosing a malfunctioning grease pump that is used to grease truck joints and moving parts. When the injured employee lifted the pump, the cylinder located inside the pump fell and lacerated the employee's left ring finger which later resulted in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was loading bundles of shingles onto a two-story home when he lost his footing and fell to the lower surface. He suffered back and knee injuries.
An employee working in a residential bathroom fell while climbing or while on top of a 5-foot tall single-stage scaffold. The employee sustained a head injury.
Two employees servicing an ATS terminal for a load bank test with a generator were exposed to an arc flash when opening the terminal cover. The employees suffered dermal burns.
An employee was unloading a trailer when the employee slipped on liquid soap and fell to the floor, suffering a broken tibia and fibula.
An arborist was working in a tree, approximately 30 feet above grade, when a felled branch contacted a single-phase electrical line. This caused the employee to sustain an electrical shock and burns.
An employee's finger was mashed between a trench box spreader and the shackle of an excavator, resulting in a fracture and laceration to the left ring finger.
An employee was installing plumbing when sharp metal scratched and cut the lower part of his leg.

An employee was using an excavator along with a chain to pull a dump truck that was stuck. The chain broke and hit the employee in the chest causing a laceration, a bruise, a cracked sternum, and also caused his heart to beat out of rhythm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting with services related to cementing (closing) an oil well when a valve detached from the wellhead under pressure. Part of the valve hit the employee's legs, fracturing the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was power washing equipment with a gas-fired, truck-mounted unit. The employee felt ill and was hospitalized with muscle pain and chest pain due to dehydration.

An employee was operating a sit-down forklift to stack pallets when they fell over. The employee got off the forklift to straighten them and was struck by additional falling pallets. The employee was hospitalized with sternum and rib fractures.
An employee was delivering a refrigerator when it slipped off the dolly, falling on his ankle and breaking it.
An employee was operating a hydraulic compactor during product packaging. The compactor amputated the employee's left hand.
An employee was lifting an empty pallet when he felt a pop in his lower back. He was hospitalized with bulging discs in his lower back.
An employee fell while climbing a portable ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a broken left arm and lacerations.
An employee was working on a gas line when a gas leak caused a small explosion/fire, burning the employee's hands.

An employee was repairing a refrigeration unit and determined that there was a defective electrical switch. Other contractors were at the facility bleeding a gas line at the time. The employee went to the circuit breaker to shut off power by manually flipping the breaker when an explosion occurred. The employee suffered second degree burns to the upper body, including the face, arms, and hands.
An employee tripped on a curb while walking into a bank. The employee fell, breaking his wrist and ankle.
An employee received an amputation.
While walking across a yard, a mail carrier stepped into a divot concealed by grass. The employee suffered leg fractures and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee installing a roof membrane was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was assisting a supervisor to clear jammed material from a machine. A 40-pound knife blade moved and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was climbing a fiberglass ladder when the ladder snapped and the employee fell 10 feet to the ground resulting in fractures.
An employee was walking out of the facility when he tripped/slipped on an object on the floor, falling forward and hitting his head and left shoulder on the floor.

An employee was bending down into a receiving bin retrieving boxes when an empty box slid down the chute and hit the employee in the back of the head. The employee was hospitalized with swelling of an arterial vessel.
An employee fell off a ladder to the ground, suffering a fractured shoulder and hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a ladder to remove a drop (phone line) when the employee fell off the ladder to the ground, fracturing a wrist and ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing an aluminum extension ladder. The employee fell up to 26 feet to the ground, suffering injuries to both heels, both ankles, the left elbow, the left fibula, and the head.
An employee was on a ladder cleaning a grill hood. She fell from the ladder, breaking her right kneecap.
An employee was cutting plywood on a table saw when a piece of plywood kicked back and struck the employee's abdomen, puncturing it.

An employee was setting up to cut a cable and needed to release a come-a-long that was attached to the temporary suspender at the cable. At this point, the temporary suspender spun and pinched the employee between the existing suspender and temporary suspender assembly. The employee suffered a broken left tibia and fibula, dislocated right knee, and cut head.

Employees were working on a muller wheel. One employee was standing in front of a forklift that another employee was operating. The muller wheel came off the forklift and landed on him, striking his lower right leg and both feet and causing multiple fractures.
An employee slipped on wet grass while using a shovel to remove it, falling backwards and striking his head on asphalt paving. He fractured his skull/head.
An employee was moving a battery when his right ring finger was pinched and amputated between two large batteries weighing 2700 pounds.

An employee was walking backwards pulling a hand cart containing batteries. One of the employee's feet came in contact with a concrete curb causing the employee to fall backwards and hit their head on the ground. The employee sustained a contusion to the head and a blood spot on the brain.

An employee climbed a ladder to the roof, opened a hatch door to the roof, and then opened a gate at the top of the roof hatch. When she opened the gate, her finger was caught and crushed in the gate hinge, causing a severe laceration and fracture of the right index finger.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a piece of copper pipe when the employee's left finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was walking up a ramp from the street to the building when he fell on the ramp. His leg hit the ramp floor, injuring his left knee/thigh and causing a hematoma.
An employee was using a meat grinder to tenderize round steaks when her gloved left hand became caught in the blades. The employee sustained lacerations and torn tendons.
An employee was driving his vehicle (golf cart style) to an aircraft when he passed by two large baggage carts and was T-boned by another vehicle. He was hospitalized with a broken left leg.

The injured employee was assisting other employees move a steel beam to a staging location using drywall carts. Once in place, the beam was lifted using rigging and an electric pallet jack. The carts were removed, cribbing was placed, and the beam was lowered onto the cribbing. As the pallet jack backed up, the beam rolled onto the injured employee's right leg causing a lower leg fracture.
An employee was operating tongs when the tongs lacerated the employee's right thumb.
While using a ladder to clean rain gutters, the ladder contacted an electrical line. The employee was hospitalized for electric shock and burns to both hands.
An employee tripped on carpet in an office area and fell sustaining a fractured hip that required surgery.
An employee was operating a stock picker and got caught between the stock picker and a pallet rack resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An auto technician was under a 30-foot RV in a parking lot, installing a spare tire. The jack the RV was on slipped, pinning him under the RV. He suffered 15 broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a lacerated liver and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a clam-shaped curing press to vulcanize tires. The employee had to hold a tire in the press as a bladder inflated. The employee's right hand got stuck between the tire and the bladder; the curing press cycled while the employee's hand was stuck, causing open fractures to the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was removing a tractor tire when the employee's right index finger was pinched between the hub and the rim, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip flesh.
An employee was performing maintenance on a drill rig when a chain coupler dislodged and struck the employee's lower back. The employee suffered fractured discs and bruising to the lower back.
An employee was working a grinder when the employee lost control of the equipment. The grinding wheel then struck and lacerated the employee's bicep.

An employee was pushing stackable carts. One cart was off center and the top cart came down and locked into the bottom cart, pinching the employee's finger between the cart pins. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in an aisleway when the employee tripped over a pallet laying on the floor. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was mounting and dismounting a tire on a vehicle when his left thumb was pinched between the vehicle frame and the lift jack, causing a thumb laceration.

An employee was cutting band iron on an ironworker machine. When he engaged the ironworker, the employee's fingers were smashed between the iron band and the base plate as the band was being cut by the ironworker. He suffered amputations of the right-hand middle, ring, and pinky fingertips below the nail.

An employee was helping a forklift driver move a sole press machine when the machine tipped over and fell onto the employee. The employee was pinned between the machine and the floor, suffering broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a cut to the left ear.
An employee fell 5 feet while climbing down from an excavator he had been working on. He suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was closing a valve when welding sparks ignited ethanol. The employee suffered second-degree burns to both arms.
An employee was moving a sub into a sub box when the sub structure crushed his right thumb.
An employee was unclogging a filler machine. Its blades amputated his left index and middle fingers at the knuckles.

An employee was getting ready to shut down an overwrap machine when it had a problem with one of the packages. The employee attempted to grab the package and the device that cuts off the wrap severed the tip of the employee's right middle finger.

An employee was working on a roof, replacing metal sheets for exterior roofing. The employee fell through a roof opening into the first floor, suffering a broken leg, broken elbow, and broken jaw. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a wooden board with a saw to make skids when the board kicked back and the sawblade hit his left thumb, resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was using compressed air to blow a sponge through a concrete pipeline to clean the pipe. The employee was disengaging the fitting of the air hose reducer, which was still under pressure, when the reducer struck the employee just below the hard hat line. The employee suffered a concussion, brain bleed, and forehead laceration.
An employee was underneath a transport trailer greasing a brake when the trailer pulled forward and rolled over his legs. He suffered a broken leg and broken pelvis.

An employee was pressure washing when the pressure washer nozzle came off and bounced back, striking the employee's forearm. The employee suffered a laceration to the right forearm and a possible impact injury to an artery.
An employee fell while closing a rolling entrance gate. Her left ring finger was caught between the pulley and the gate and the tip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down from a formwork wall when he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and broke his right leg.
On August 9, 2019, an employee was working at his forming station. The employee started to feel ill, went home and was then hospitalized with heat stroke and kidney failure.

An employee had been preparing and moving pallets using a powered industrial truck. As the employee stepped off the truck, it crushed the employee's ankle and foot against a pallet, breaking the ankle and foot.

Ventilation fans inside the restrooms of the employee cafeteria experienced a mechanical issue, causing smoke to occupy the restroom. An employee working in the cafeteria at the time of the mechanical issue experienced trouble breathing and had an asthma attack due to smoke inhalation, requiring hospitalization.

An employee went to a medication room to retrieve medication for a patient when his right arm at the elbow was caught in the door while someone was pushing it. The employee suffered a hematoma of the right arm that became infected, requiring hospitalization.
On August 9, 2019, an employee was tying ladders to the top of a work trailer when he fell off the side of the trailer and landed on the ground, breaking his heel bone. He was hospitalized.
An employee was shopping during her lunch break when she slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her hip.
An employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation while cleaning a plastics grinder machine.

An employee was working on a production line when the employee stepped back and tripped over the edge of a pallet that was sitting on the floor. The employee fell to the concrete floor and fractured the right hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working near a concrete pump truck that had a hose and hose clamp connected to the exterior output connection of the truck. The truck was pumping concrete when the hose clamp broke off and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered facial lacerations.
A scissor lift, moving through a doorway, pinched an employee's left index finger against the doorjamb. The finger was amputated up to the knuckle.

An employee turned into a walkway between portion sizers at a poultry processing facility, carrying four or five tote liners. The employee slid on a small piece of chicken and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was placing boxes on a pallet. The employee's gloves were caught in a tape machine's sprocket, causing hand fractures.
An employee was using a web sling to load a steel coil onto a hoist when the web sling failed, allowing the coil to fall to the ground and land on the employee's left foot, breaking it.
An employee was run over by a dump truck while rolling up a hose, suffering severe skin abrasions to the legs.
An employee was stacking containers adjacent to a self-closing door. The door closed on the employee's pinky finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.

Employees were tasked with fixing an indoor rail car that is utilized for brick making activities. The injured employee went into an open storage area to retrieve corrugated aluminum to utilize for repair activities. The employee stepped on a piece of foam board and fell through the foam board approximately 10 feet into the room below.
An employee was filling a tanker with hot asphalt when the asphalt blew back and struck his face under his face shield. He suffered burns to his face and upper body.
An employee was offloading a truck with process fluid. The employee came into contact with the fluid and suffered second-degree burns to the face, neck, and shoulder.
An employee was making a delivery when he tripped and fell.
An employee was driving a trailer to deliver liquefied petroleum gas to customers when the gas leaked and the employee was exposed to gas inhalation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was coming down from a derrick digger truck boom's seat when he fell to the ground, suffering a head abrasion and fractures to both heels, his tailbone, his right ankle, and a toe on his right foot. He was hospitalized.
While cleaning a pump motor an employee's middle fingertip was amputated. The motor was running at the time.

An employee was checking whether the safety pin on a piece of equipment was locked. The locking mechanism was engaged, and the employee's right little finger was pinched in the mechanism. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was refilling a container of chemicals when the employee became dizzy and could not breathe due to exposure to chlorine gas.

An employee was standing about two-thirds of the way up on a 12-foot portable ladder. He was using the claw of a hammer to partially loosen a screw that was embedded on a wooden board attached to the wall. When the screw came free, the employee lost his balance and fell off the ladder landing on his feet on the concrete floor. He sustained a left heel fracture and a right tibia/fibula fracture.
An employee went to the break room to make herself a cup of tea when she tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.

An employee was offloading fish from a fishing tender vessel using a 12-inch suction hose. The hose had an air pocket that caused it to whip, striking the employee's hand against the coaming on a hatch. The employee sustained right-hand lacerations and a fracture.

A tractor-trailer driver had opened the rear trailer doors and returned to the tractor cab to back the trailer to the dock door. An employee entered the space between the back of the trailer and the edge of the dock. The trailer backed up, trapping the employee between the back of the trailer and the loading dock. The employee suffered a fractured left wrist, fractured pelvic/hip bone, and fractured sacrum.
An employee bent down to gather tools and suffered a hernia. The employee had surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting something on a rack when the rack above bent/failed, causing a large roll to fall onto and crush the employee's arm.
An employee was clearing starch from a drain when their right hand struck the rotating screw conveyor resulting in amputation of three fingertips.
An employee was loosening a hose from a rail car when the hose splashed sulfuric acid on the employee, causing chemical burns to the shoulder.
An employee was processing cotton modules when a module injured his right foot.

An employee was walking with a powered pallet jack in an aisle when he recognized that another employee on a pallet jack needed to go around him. He was moving his pallet jack toward the rack when his right foot was pinned between his pallet jack and the rack. The injured employee's right foot sustained damaged ligaments, a fractured bone and dislocated toes. The injured foot required surgery.
An employee was dumping a trip hopper. The employee's left little finger was pinched between the forks of the forklift and the trip hopper, causing an amputation at the first joint.

An employee was loading sand from a commercial vehicle into a locomotive. When the door of the sand tank was opened, the pressure caused it to strike the employee in the face, causing lacerations and a fracture to the left side of the face.
On August 11, 2019, an employee slipped and fell into a puddle of hot syrup while walking across a production floor. The employee suffered burns to the hands and back.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. While making a turn, the forklift struck a product being pulled by another forklift. The employee's leg was caught and broken between his forklift and the product.
While leaving a ticket kiosk, an employee tripped over the leg of a crowd control barrier. The employee fell onto the asphalt and suffered a fracture to the head of the left femur.

An employee was putting a box of produce on the shelf in the produce cooler. She was standing on the steel shelving wedge placed on the vertical base of the steel shelves to prevent damage when she slipped and her ring became caught on the steel shelving, resulting in a left ring finger degloving.

On August 12, 2019, at 2:00 PM, an employee was carrying an electrical panel (86 inches long, 44 inches wide, 9 inches deep, and 72 pounds) with a co-worker. The electrical panel slipped out of his hands, causing a laceration to his right arm near the elbow. He was hospitalized.

On August 12, 2019, an employee was setting up a printing press, pulling out the paper roll. The machine jogged while the employee's left index finger was inside it, amputating it at the first or second knuckle.

An employee was removing fencing panels from the back of a truck. After pushing a panel off the top of the pile, the employee moved to get down off the truck, slipped, and fell between the fencing panels and the stands that held the fencing up. The employee suffered injuries to the back, left shoulder, and right arm.

On August 12, 2019, an employee was taking measurements utilizing a tape measurer and cutting PVC pipe for about 15 minutes using a PVC ratchet cutter. The employee later felt unwell and was hospitalized for heat-related illness and acute kidney failure.
An employee was using a floor cleaning machine. When he stepped off, the equipment moved and hit his left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was pouring molten brass into a pig mold. Brass splashed into his boot, causing second-degree burns to the side of his right foot and third-degree burns to the top of the foot.

As an employee was exiting a restroom (pushing forward on a hinged door that opens outward), another employee was pulling a pallet of products past the restroom door. The door hit the pallet and then bounced back and hit the employee in the head. The employee suffered a head injury.
An employee was walking when his leg gave out, causing him to fall to the ground and injure his leg.
An employee climbed up on a storage crate and then fell to the ground, breaking an ankle.
An employee was cutting metal brackets while wearing wet gloves and was shocked. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was tightening bolts on a resin tank. The employee was using a slugging hammer, which hit and crushed the employee's finger.
An employee was walking in front of a reach forklift to get product when the forklift fork struck and cut the employee's right heel.
An employee was loading industrial washers in the plant. The employee appeared unwell and was hospitalized for possible heat stress and/or heat stroke.

An employee was unloading an 18-wheeler trailer when a truck frame that was on the truck fell and caught his right pinky finger between the wall of the trailer and the truck frame. His right pinky finger was amputated to the first joint.
An employee tripped and fell sideways on a cylindrical tube sticking up from the same level. The employee was hospitalized with a puncture wound and two broken ribs.
An employee was assembling a valve when the parts slid together, crushing his left index finger and resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was using a post hole digger to dig holes in order to build a fence. The employee inserted the post hole digger into the ground and hit a powerline, which created a flame that shot up and burned portions of the employee's left and right arms. The employee may have suffered a mild electric shock as well.
While performing tasks inside and outside, an employee suffered heat-related illness.

While working in the baggage area under a terminal, an employee was helping to guide a tractor in next to the baggage belt. As the tractor and first cart passed her and turned away from the baggage belt, the second container hit the back of the employee's right hand, which was on a bollard between the carts and the employee. The employee suffered a broken right hand.

An employee was on a forklift platform, using the forklift to move vehicle hoods into a dumpster for recycling. A vehicle hood knocked him off the platform, causing him to fall about 5-6 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken collarbone and a laceration to the back of his head requiring stitches.

An employee was driving a standup forklift down the main aisle to the break room for lunch. When the employee approached the area where the empty forklifts are staged, he turned the corner and hit a parked forklift. His foot was pinned between the two lifts. He sustained a fractured ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a shag truck outside of a warehouse when he drove into a concrete post  in the dock area. He was thrown forward, striking his right leg on the truck's dash. He was hospitalized with a fractured right lower leg.

An employee was carrying a pneumatic ventilation blower and slipped when stepping off one barge to another barge. The employee fell to the deck of the barge and the blower fell on his right thumb, crushing it and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading scaffold sections from a flatbed truck when he fell from the truck to the ground and hit his head, suffering internal bleeding and head trauma.
An employee was using a 14-foot aluminum extension ladder to go from the second to the first floor when the employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered skull fractures.
An employee was doing the wood framing around a window when he suffered a nail gun puncture wound to the chest cavity. He was hospitalized.

On August 12, 2019, at approximately 9:15 AM, an employee was troubleshooting the press stacker when the employee's right hand entered the stacker and activated the lift plate. The plate came down on the employee's right-hand fingers, resulting in a partial amputation to his middle and ring fingers.
An employee was helping a resident when she slipped and fell on a recently mopped floor, injuring her right knee and left thumb.
An employee was pressure washing a roll-off box when the employee contacted the pressurized water, suffering a left foot injury.
An employee was laying pipe in a trench under hot conditions. The employee began to look ill and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

An employee was attempting to remove a drive gear from beneath equipment. The employee was operating a pneumatic drill with his left hand while bracing himself with his right hand on the drive gear. The torque of the drill caused the gear to shift and catch the distal phalange of his right pinky finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
A large spool of electrical wire fell on an employee, injuring his hand.

An employee was blocking a ham that was being cut with a band saw when the ham turned sideways. His hand then came into contact with the sawblade, resulting in an amputation of the pad of his right thumb.
An employee was removing paint in a stairwell where the floor had been removed and fell through a hole in the floor, suffering broken bones.
An employee was walking by a rack when she tripped on a handrail that was in the rack and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was loading a boom attachment onto the tines of a forklift. Noticing that the chain was wrapped around the clamp, the employee attempted to unwrap it. When the chain released, the employees right index finger was caught in the slack of the chain; a bone was broken and the tip was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell while working in an overhead storage area, suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was unloading 50 percent sodium hydroxide from a tanker truck when he became hot and sat down to cool off and drink water. He was hospitalized for possible heat exhaustion.

An employee was performing garbage collection duties (riding on the outside of a trash collection vehicle, collecting garbage from the curb, and putting it into the collection vehicle) when he began to feel flushed and nauseated and stopped sweating. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee drove to a site to shoot wells with a non-radioactive source when the employee became dehydrated and experienced a heat injury.

An employee was removing a tundish with a remote overhead crane when the tundish fell off the crane and struck another employee against a second tundish on the floor. The injured employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was operating a table saw when the employee's left thumb contacted the saw blade, resulting in a left thumb tip amputation.
An employee slipped while climbing onto a baker's scaffold and fell to the ground, fracturing ribs and the clavicle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a student from oncoming traffic when she broke her left ankle on a cement curb.

An employee had just finished strapping a tractor into a truck bed. As the employee came down from the truck, he fell onto the ground, landing on his back. He suffered a broken back and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a parking lot when she fell, landing on the ground on her right knee. Her kneecap was broken and she was hospitalized.
An employee was doing extermination work at a private residence when a bee stung his hand. He went into anaphylaxis and was hospitalized.

At 1:00 PM on August 13, 2019, an employee was working on a storm drainage pipe-laying project when the employee experienced cramps and nausea, requiring hospitalization for heat illness-related dehydration.
An employee fell from a truck and sustained back pain.

A Hirsh Industries employee was unloading drawer wraps from a roll form. While removing one drawer wrap, a second drawer wrap was released by the roll form and collided with the one being removed by the employee. This caused the employee's finger to be pinched between the first drawer wrap and a closed gate. The employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated between the fingernail and first knuckle.

An employee was pre-mixing 18 pounds of xanthan gum with 15 gallons of isopropanol alcohol. Sparks from a drill ignited isopropanol fumes in the kettle and created a flash fire, which burned the employee's hand and nose.
On August 12, 2019, an employee was installing HVAC ductwork in a residential attic. The employee felt ill and was hospitalized, suffering from a kidney infection and dehydration.
An employee was repairing a farm tractor while underneath it. The tractor started and ran over the employee causing a fractured pelvis.
An employee lost consciousness while using a wood chipper on tree limbs. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was assisting with water well drilling operations when he began to feel ill and had cramping due to dehydration/heat stress.
An employee was unjamming a grinder when his left index fingertip was caught and amputated between the blades and the housing. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee stood up at their desk to plug a phone into their computer. When the employee went to sit back down, they missed the chair and fell, hitting their head. The employee required hospitalization for a post-concussive head injury.

A driver backed a truck up to a loading dock door and then went into the building to unload the truck. When he mistakenly opened the doors to a truck in an adjacent bay, that truck started to pull away. The driver then jumped from the dock and landed on the ground below. He sustained a fracture to the left leg below the knee that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was climbing down a 6-foot A-frame ladder. He slipped on the second step from the bottom, fell, and suffered a back injury.
A hose, pressurized at 9,000 psi, ruptured while being tested. An employee's left tibia was injured.

An employee was on a ladder while repairing a shutter on the second story of an apartment building. The ladder gave way and the employee fell straight down to the ground, landing on his feet and suffering a broken back and a fractured foot/ankle.
An employee was operating a roll-off truck when he began to feel a tingling in his arm and became short of breath. He was hospitalized for heat stress/exhaustion.
An employee was clearing a material bridge. A cutter head pinched the employee's foot and partially amputated the little toe.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion and lost consciousness while making deliveries.

An employee working on the de-bone line was cleaning out her work area when her right hand got caught in a small space between the guard and the shaft of the conveyor belt. She sustained a right thumb abrasion and fractured right index finger.
An employee was doing a security patrol when a vehicle struck him, injuring his lower body.

An employee was riding on the rear driver side step of a rear load trash truck. The truck was reversing onto a no-outlet street when it backed into a roll-off container on the side of the street. The employee was crushed between the truck and the container.
While doing housekeeping in the early morning, an employee tripped on an HDPE pipe and fell, breaking his ankle.
An employee was removing an 800-pound inner wheel and tire from a tractor. The wheel slid down the tapered axle shaft and fell on top of the employee resulting in a broken pelvis.

An employee was opening a pneumatic hatch on top of a truck trailer. The employee fell from the trailer to the ground about 13 feet below and suffered a fractured rib, shoulder, and little finger, as well as a punctured lung and a dislocated collarbone.
On August 13, 2019, a yard truck operator was hospitalized for possible dehydration.
An employee was framing an outdoor kitchen. He was on the third step of an A-frame ladder when he and the ladder fell. His head hit the concrete floor, causing skull fractures. He was hospitalized.
At around 9:30 a.m., an employee lost consciousness at a work site due to dehydration.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder, changing out a bubble wrap roll. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle/leg.
An employee was on a roof trimming tree branches when he backed up and stepped through a skylight. He fell 20 feet to the garage floor and sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was lifting an ATV that was stuck when she suffered a bulged disc in her lower back.
An employee was attaching a chain between a payloader and a truck. The payloader tightened the chain and the employee's left index fingertip was caught in the chain and amputated.

An employee in a bucket truck was removing the cover off of a center phase 35.5-kV top circuit and was hit by an arc flash. The employee sustained third degree burns to the neck and the left side of a hand. The employee also sustained first and second degree burns to the face, right shoulder and arm, and around the back from rib to rib.

An employee was going to turn the power off of an air conditioning unit located in the receiving area of the warehouse. The employee got into a bucket that was on top of a wooden pallet on the high-lift. The high-lift was extended about 25 feet into the air. As the employee reached towards the air conditioning unit, he stepped to the left side (front) of the bucket and the bucket slid off the high-lift. The employee fell to the concrete floor, landed on his left side (back), and hit his head on the floor. He suffered a laceration to the back of his head and severe back pain.
An employee fell on a public sidewalk on campus and broke an arm.

An employee was climbing down from the bottom rung of a portable ladder that was leaned against a segment of a caster on a transport car. While dismounting the ladder, the employee lost balance and fell approximately 3' 2" to the floor below. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured vertebrae in the back and required surgery.
While working in the field, installing pipes, an employee began cramping and suffered a heat-related injury.

The injured employee was training another employee on a robot that is used to weld steel battery boxes. While removing a box from the tray fixture, the tray got stuck, bounced, and the upper fixture fell down, amputating the injured employee's right pinky fingertip.
An employee experienced a heat related illness after handling filing cabinets on an overhead conveyor of the paint line. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack behind a floor scrubber when the scrubber stopped and the employee collided with the scrubber's back bumper bar. The employee sustained a fibular fracture to the lower left leg and was hospitalized.
On August 13, 2019, an employee was doing roofing work when he began cramping and vomiting. Later that night, he was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was on top of a plastic injection molding machine when their hand became caught in the running machine. The employee sustained the amputation of three fingers on the left hand.

An employee was riding on the driver's side rear riding step of the trash collection truck. The employee dismounted the step before the truck had fully stopped and fell to the pavement, resulting in a fractured right hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hooking up a tractor trailer when he slipped off the side of it and fell to the ground, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was turning a unit and brushing welded flanges. The employee's left foot was caught between the lifting table and the surface of the unit, resulting in an amputation to the big toe and the second toe.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down a hillside. The tree gaff he was carrying punctured his lower back.

An employee was tearing down a trench box (which was on the ground, not in use). When the last pin holding two panels together was pulled out, one of the panels struck the employee and injured his leg/hip.
While installing a catch pan at the base of a bandsaw, an employee was shocked by a power cord.
An employee was clearing a clog in a brine pump. The pump blade amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was hooking up a trailer to a vehicle. The hitch slipped and the employee's right index finger was caught between the hitch and the trailer. The tip was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee had ascended approximately 21 feet up a grain elevator to close a hatch located at the eave of the bin. While descending, the employee fell to the ground and sustained multiple fractures and a concussion.

On August 14, 2019, a temporary employee was cleaning out a grain bin with a vacuum system. The employee was engulfed in the grain (which was about 5 feet deep) up to about chest height. He was hospitalized, suffering from breathing issues.
An employee began to feel cramping during a work break, then felt ill and was hospitalized, suffering from acute kidney failure and heat-related muscle injury.
At 2:00 p.m. on August 14, 2019, after driving a pickup truck in the morning, an employee began to suffer cramping and lightheadedness. He was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat stress.
An employee was bent over in a parking lot, checking fuel delivery spill buckets. The employee was struck by a customer's SUV, suffering leg, hip, and wrist injuries.
An employee was in the locker room preparing to leave for their shift. The employee felt stomach pain, began vomiting, and was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee fell from a truss that was being installed, landing on the ground 13 feet below and suffering broken bones and head trauma.

At 3:10 p.m. on August 14, 2019, an employee was clamping parts into a fixture to prepare them for spot-welding. The spot-welding machine activated while his hand was in the point of operation and the electrode amputated his right index fingertip.
Three employees were repairing forks on a forklift. While they lifted the forks together, one employee suffered a back injury.

An employee was working near the slat conveyor. When he attempted to retrieve his drink bottle,  his right pinky finger was pinched in the conveyor. As a result, his right pinky fingertip was amputated. The slat conveyor was guarded at the time of the incident.

Two employees were rigging up a conveyor to slide it out and lift it up with a forklift; one employee was on the far side of the conveyor and the other was operating the forklift. The tines on the forklift hit the first employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was wiping down a pastry press with a paper towel. The press pinched the employee's finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was preparing to leave a roof when he slipped and fell to the porch below, striking his head; he then fell over the porch to the ground, where he struck his head again.
An employee fell on the bathroom floor and suffered a hip injury.
An employee was stocking shelves when the shelving amputated her left ring finger.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw. The saw cut his left middle finger. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to amputate the fingertip.
An employee was forming pieces of material at a press brake. Two fingers on his right hand were crushed between the material and the punch of the brake.
An employee was working on a roof, removing damaged panels. An electrical shock burned the employee's right hand and right foot.
A mechanic was troubleshooting equipment when his finger was caught in a machine roller, resulting in a partial amputation.

A temporary employee was on a 10-foot ladder, installing insulation and doing mastic duct work. The employee came into contact with an exposed temporary wire, was shocked, and fell off the third or fourth rung of the ladder. Along with the electric shock, he suffered a broken left heel.

An employee was climbing down a ladder after putting material away on shelves. She fell to the ground, hitting her hand and head and twisting her ankle and leg. She was hospitalized with a broken femur.
An employee was changing a condensate filter. A fire erupted, burning the employee's arms, legs, neck, and face.

On August 14, 2019, an employee was walking into a trailer to add dunnage onto the freight when a forklift struck him while backing up. He suffered a bruised left ankle and broken right hip and was hospitalized.
While driving, an employee began to feel dizzy and unwell. The employee suffered from heat stroke.
An employee was hydroblasting the tubes in a spare condenser with a lance. As he moved the lance from one tube to the next, the lance engaged, jumped back, and lacerated the employee's right hand.
An employee was operating a table saw to cut lumber for doors being manufactured. The saw amputated his right index and ring fingertips.
An employee fell while stepping over a roof parapet wall, falling to the ground and suffering compressed vertebrae.
An employee was running a drilling unit in a field. The drill hit an underground power line. He lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
After working the day shift cleaning and repairing a compressor at an oilfield site, an employee began to exhibit signs of illness. The employee was hospitalized with a possible heat-related illness.

At about 9:15 a.m. on August 15, 2019, three employees were removing a spindle used to feed steel coils into manufacturing equipment. The spindle was being lowered to the floor using straps and a bridge crane. When the spindle came to rest on the floor, the load shifted and the tension bar struck one of the employees on the lower legs, knocking him to the concrete floor. He suffered a broken right hip and a broken left ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee climbed up an electric wind tower nacelle to perform maintenance activities when he became ill, experiencing dizziness and fatigue. He was hospitalized with possible heat exhaustion.
While working on a wind turbine, an employee suffered heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
At 1:45 p.m. on August 15, 2019, an employee was working in a paint booth, preparing a jacked-up car for painting. The car rolled backwards and hit the employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee sandblasting a pipeline. The sandblasting medium was not blowing well, so he approached the compressor; when the hose was disconnected, the machine sandblasted his left hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was turning a ball valve on the bypass relief for a filter. The employee was cycling out dirty oil and adding fresh oil. The sanitary fitting on the top of the valve came loose, allowing oil to exit the pipe and burn both of the employee's legs.
An employee fell through a skylight on a roof, suffering internal injuries.

An employee was cleaning an aspirator. He was caught by the rotating 12-inch screw auger at the bottom of the equipment, which severely lacerated his left leg. The leg was medically amputated just below the knee.
As a pipe-laying job site was being closed up, an employee was struck by lightning. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee (of Savvy Staffing) was standing in front of a valve when it was opened. Scalding water was discharged onto the employee, causing severe burns to 40 percent of the employee's body including the lower abdomen, pelvis, thighs, arms, and hands. The employee was hospitalized.
On Thursday, August 15, an employee was walking from the cafeteria to her office when she tripped, slipped, or fell to the floor.  She broke her right humerus and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was shoveling dirt. The shovel hit an aerosol can and a piece of metal struck the employee's left forearm, cutting the main artery.
On August 15, 2019, an employee was lowering a dump trailer onto the ball hitch on a truck. His left middle finger was pinched between the ball and the trailer hitch, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was replacing a drive belt on a locked-out conveyor. The pulley was turned from the other side, and his thumb was caught between the pulley and the belt. He suffered a soft-tissue amputation (losing the skin and the nail) from his left thumb just below the thumbnail.

An employee was working from a bucket truck, moving 7.2-kilovolt lines 40 feet up on a power pole. A live wire touched the employee's right hand or head; the employee was hospitalized and the hand was amputated.
An employee was using a powered round knife when it cut off the tip of his finger.
An employee was installing sheet metal panels. The employee's hand got caught between a panel and the metal structural frame, which pinched the tip of his right middle finger off.
An employee was blowing down acetylene bottles. The acetylene ignited and the employee's arms and legs were burned.
An employee was walking across a parking lot when she tripped on some sidewalk repair material, fell, and struck her knee on the curb. She suffered a broken bone in her right leg.
