An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder when it slipped and the employee fell. The employee suffered a broken back.

An employee was on a wet metal roof, preparing to install wall panels. The employee fell, landing on the ground 18 feet below and suffering multiple contusions and fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained possible heat stroke while working on an injection molding line.
An employee tripped while exiting a room and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right lower forearm.
As a light was being installed, a neutral wire that was being backfed touched an employee, who suffered minor electrical burns to his index finger and thumb.
An employee was struck by a pallet jack while picking orders. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing an air bubble in the plastic film on a winding machine. His right hand fingers were pinched between two rotating rollers, resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was standing on the rear tire of a multi-axle trailer, preparing it for transport. He fell onto the tire and then to the ground, suffering broken right-side ribs and a broken right foot.
An employee was moving/lifting a running push mower when the mower was set down on the top of his left foot. The mower blade lacerated his left foot, resulting in the partial amputation of two toes.
An employee was helping offload a guardrail from a trailer. A damaged piece of guardrail struck the employee in the abdomen.
An employee tripped over a wardrobe Z-rack and fell to the floor, breaking her right hip.
A crew was setting up to fix storm damage when an employee was shocked, suffering small burns on his index finger and right thumb.
An employee was removing electrical wiring. A short circuit caused second- and third-degree burns to his arm and side.

An employee was standing in the bucket of construction equipment to work on an electrical reel that was mounted above when the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured collarbone and multiple skull fractures.
An employee was changing a battery in an electric pallet jack. His finger was caught between the pallet jack's frame and the battery, causing a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was working from a ladder when he fell off, landing on the ground 7 or 8 feet below. He suffered a head injury requiring sutures and a concussion and was hospitalized.
While trimming a tree limb using a chainsaw, an employee's lower right leg was cut by the chainsaw. He was hospitalized.
An employee was beginning to descend a three-step stairway when he lost balance and suffered a partially torn quadriceps tendon.
An employee fell from the second floor while removing metal framing. He broke his ankle and another bone in his leg.
An employee was working near a parking deck when a roll of cables fell from the deck, striking him and injuring his head.

An employee was working on a conveyor line, waiting for part of a bus frame to reach his area. When the conveyor line started, it caught his glove and pulled his left middle finger into the sprocket, which amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a broom truck on the shoulder of a highway that was being repaired. A dump truck struck the employee's broom truck. The employee suffered a broken arm, a dislocated elbow, a broken leg, a fractured pelvis, multiple broken ribs, a punctured lung, fractured vertebrae, and decompression.
An employee fell on the stairs while delivering furniture.
An employee was on a 10-foot A-frame ladder, cutting steel brackets that held a wooden dock to a cement pier. One of the brackets hit the ladder and the employee fell, suffering a broken wrist.
An employee was trying to catch product coming off a conveyor when his fingers were caught between the conveyor and a metal bar under it. His left index finger was amputated.
An employee was cutting sheets of cotton batting with a lightweight round knife. The knife cut his left middle finger, causing the amputation of flesh from the fingertip.
After work (installing wellheads and valves in the field), an employee suffered severe heat exhaustion and cramping and was hospitalized.

On August 16, 2019, a maintenance field technician was on top of an elevator at the third floor level. The elevator began to move up and he had to jump through the doors to the third floor. He suffered a broken shoulder and broken ribs.

An employee was leaving a truck at the end of his shift. As he climbed down the stairs built into the tailgate, he slipped, hit his forehead on the truck (suffering a forehead laceration that required stitches), and then fell backwards to the ground, breaking his left wrist.
An employee fell from a ladder and suffered facial injuries.

A packing associate was cleaning under a packing bin and as he stood back up he grabbed the discharge chute. The discharge chute came down, pinching his finger at the hinge point, causing a partial amputation of his right thumb tip.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while walking into the building, injuring her left elbow.
An employee's fingers entered a running machine and came in contact with the cutting blade inside, resulting in amputations of parts of the fingers.

At 6:15 p.m. on August 16, 2019, an employee was performing a change-over from one product to the next in a mill area. While the employee was installing one of the conveyors, an open metal cover closed, hitting his left hand and breaking his index and middle fingers.

An employee was transferring a stabilizer from a forklift to a catwalk. One end of the stabilizer slid off the catwalk and fell onto the employee's lower left leg. The employee's tibia and fibula were broken.

At about 6:45 a.m. on August 16, 2019, a temporary employee was using an electric powered industrial vehicle to pick cases in a warehouse. The employee's left foot was pinned and crushed between the vehicle and a racking support. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck. His hand was crushed between the truck and a rack, and he was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on the floor, fell, and broke her right patella.

Two employees were working on an exterior light fixture from a scissor lift 8 feet above the ground, right outside of the door to an airplane hangar. The hangar door was opened, knocking the scissor lift over. The two employees fell to the ground, suffering injuries including a broken jaw and arm fractures. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee was unloading steel beams from a flatbed truck. A beam fell off the truck and broke the employee's leg.
An employee was about to begin grooming a dog when it bit her left thumb. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting ice with a bandsaw. The saw amputated two of the employee's fingertips.

At about 9:40 a.m. on August 16, 2019, a temporary employee was loading a spool of shrink-wrap on a shrink-wrap machine using an electric powered hoist. The hoist dropped the load onto the employee's finger while adjusting a roller tab that had to be in the vertical position for the roll to set in place. The employee suffered the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
On August 16, 2019, an employee was climbing a scaffold ladder carrying a wire spool. He fell to the ground about 15 feet below, injuring a vertebra in his lower back.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor while carrying drywall material, suffering abrasions to the nose and possible neck fractures.

After erecting and connecting a base to a mid tower section, employees were preparing to lower tools. An employee fell through a hatch (open so that tools could be lowered) to the concrete 60 feet below and suffered fractured ribs, a fracture to the T-12 vertebrae, a knee injury, and laceration to the back of the head.
An employee was sitting on a truck, lowering a camera into a manhole. A front end loader struck him, causing amputations to his right big and second toes.
An employee was on the rack of a bucket truck, preparing to enter the bucket, when he fell to the ground and suffered a head injury.

On August 16, 2019, an employee was cutting a telephone pole with a chainsaw. The saw kicked back and struck his right leg, causing a severe laceration, a chipped bone, and cut tendons. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee raised the door to a breading machine and the machine caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was struck by a tractor, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was removing the catwalk on a tank battery. The catwalk tilted down and the employee's fall protection came off; the employee fell about 20 feet, suffering knee injuries and a head injury requiring a stitch.
An employee was forming a part on a press brake. His left middle finger was pinched between the part being formed and the face/ram of the press brake, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.

A driver for LeSaint was on a dock. He and another employee fought and the other employee cut his abdomen with a box cutter, causing a laceration and a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a conveyor system for concrete work. The conveyor system dislodged and pinned the employee to the ground, causing a thoracic compression fracture of the spine.
An employee was shot by a customer after an altercation began at the drive-thru menu board. The employee was hospitalized for the gunshot wound which resulted in a fractured left femur.
An employee was using heat from a blow torch to help loosen a bolt from a vessel's engine when an explosion occurred. The employee suffered first and second degree burns to both arms and both knees.

An employee had been realigning a conveyor chain at an unscrambler. The employee went back to grab a board off the conveyor the machine started. The employee's arm was pinched between the chain and the unscrambler wall; the employee suffered fractures to the left ulna, radius, and hand, as well as a laceration between the left thumb and forefinger.
On August 17, 2019, a mail carrier was at the last stop of his route when he became nauseated and began vomiting. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was inflating the brake airbags on a lowboy trailer. The airbags blew and knocked the trailer off the jack or jack stands. The employee suffered broken ribs.

A telehandler operator was lifting a finishing machine to the third floor to be used to finish the concrete floor. The operator was trying to get the finisher over the safety cables and went to push the safety cable down. As the operator was pushing the safety cable down, one of the uprights holding up the safety cable detached from the angle iron causing the operator to fall approximately 30 feet. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and liver damage.
An employee's hand was caught between two pipes while he was aligning them. He suffered a partial amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was checking the tension on a motor's belt. The belt pulled him in and his finger went across the spindle. His middle fingertip was amputated above the first knuckle and his index fingernail was removed.
An employee's little and ring fingers came into contact with fan blades, which caused an amputation to the little finger and a fracture to the ring finger.
An employee was driving a customer vehicle. The vehicle's hood popped up and smashed the windshield, sending glass into the employee's eye. The employee's eye was scratched.
An employee was cleaning the laminator machine. Their left hand was caught in the conveyor belt and fractured.
An employee was driving a three-wheel maintenance buggy. The buggy rolled over in a turn, and the employee's left lower leg was smashed between it and the ground.

An employee of Aries Wells Service was visually and physically inspecting a tubing line. He glove got stuck on the line and his right index finger was pulled into the drum, which pinched it, removing skin. He was hospitalized and the finger was medically amputated.
An employee was adjusting a screen print machine. A rotating cam in the machine caught and amputated the tip of his right ring finger.
An employee was exiting a forklift. The employee's foot was caught between the forks and they tripped, breaking their ankle.

An employee was cleaning out a tortilla machine. The pneumatic attachment to the masa pump had been removed to prepare for cleaning, and the rotor inside the pump amputated her right middle finger at the first knuckle.

A meter technician was replacing a CT meter loop that had been damaged during a storm; he had been working outdoors most of the day. He became ill, with blurred vision and disorientation. He was hospitalized for dehydration and/or heart-related issues.
An employee was working on the kitchen in front of a steam table. While lifting a tray, his hand slipped into the steam table water, burning his right hand. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was moving a transformer on a dolly. The transformer slipped off the dolly and crushed the employee's left middle finger.
An employee fell while getting up from her chair. She landed on the floor and broke her leg.
An employee was conducting a screen change on equipment when the employee's left middle finger was punctured through the work gloves by the equipment.

At 7:30 a.m. on 8/18/19, a maintenance employee was removing bolts from the bearing housing of a mixer using a break-over bar with a socket. He was standing inside the mixer panel on a flat surface with the break-over bar at chest height lifting upwards when he felt a sharp pain in his back and his knees became weak. He then laid down on his back. He suffered a compression fracture on his L7 vertebra.

On August 18, 2019, an employee was standing on an exterior top plate setting trusses when the employee fell approximately 16.5 feet off the top plate and onto a saw horse and the ground. The employee suffered a fractured leg and jaw. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was attempting to turn on a light switch in resident's bathroom when she received an electrical shock to her right hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was at an oil rig. The line he was tied off to was cut, and its weight pulled him down to the rig floor about 12 feet below. He suffered a spleen injury.

An employee was cleaning a restroom. He discovered water spots on the floor in one of the stalls and placed a caution sign on the floor. As he was about to get a mop, he tripped over the sign and fell to the floor, suffering facial contusions and neck strain. He was hospitalized, undergoing spine surgery.
An employee was walking, delivering mail, when he suffered a hip injury and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery for a broken hip.

An employee was at a register checking out customers. The employee scanned toilet paper and proceeded to grab the hand-held scanner. The employee was walking around the bag carousel to the customer's cart when the employee's foot was caught on the corner of the fixed carousel. The employee tripped, lost balance, and fell to the ground, suffering a lower body fracture and muscle tears.
On August 19, 2019, an employee was walking a horse when it reared and kicked the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and a lacerated liver and was hospitalized.

An employee was painting while standing on the second rung of a ladder. He leaned over to move a pole that was holding up a plastic barrier and lost his balance, falling to the floor and fracturing his right hip.
An employee was cutting sheet metal when the metal separated and hit the employee in the eye. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was opening a hangar door when it slammed shut onto his left middle finger, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
On August 19, 2019, an aircraft mechanic was working on the wing of an aircraft, slipped and fell 5 to 6 feet onto the concrete. He suffered a fractured left hip.
An employee was operating a numeric bender to bend tubing when the employee's left hand entered the point of operation, resulting in the dislocation/fracture of the left index finger.
An employee was working an overtime postal route when a second employee found the employee with symptoms of heat stress. The first employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting an aircraft component with an overhead hoist. The component being hoisted created a shear point between itself and the test stand. The employee's thumb tip was amputated in the shear point.

An employee was setting a pier column and needed to cut a piece of rebar with a gas-powered saw. When the employee started the saw to cut the rebar, it exploded and his pant leg caught on fire, burning the back of his left leg.

An employee was operating a press and proceeded to clean the press. When he removed the bar from the press, the machine activated and pulled his hand into the tooling, cutting his left index finger and resulting in an amputation.
An employee was helping a customer with a propane tank when he inhaled propane, suffering respiratory irritation.
An employee was using a band saw to cut gating off of a part when the employee contacted the saw blade, resulting in an amputation to the right middle fingertip.
An employee was helping a client when the client slipped and fell onto the employee. As a result, the employee suffered a broken hip and leg.
An employee was delivering mail in a postal vehicle when the employee was struck by another vehicle at an intersection, suffering a leg fracture and open wounds to the leg.

An employee was operating a telehandler forklift while wearing his personal fall protection harness. When he went to back up, a lanyard that was hanging down and not attached to the harness caught under the front wheel and jerked him violently in his seat. He was wearing his seat belt at the time. He struck the metal guards on the side seat of the forklift and fractured vertebrae in his back.
An employee was hanging up concrete chutes when the employee's left index fingertip was amputated by the chutes.
An employee was feeding sheets of steel into a masking machine when the employee's left hand was caught and lacerated between two moving rollers.
After delivering mail, an employee stopped sweating and became dizzy. He was hospitalized with a heat illness.

An employee was attempting to use a portable concrete mixer along with two other employees when the lid of the cement mixer came off and hit the top of the employee's forehead, causing a laceration just behind the hairline.

An employee was using his foot to push down material that was stuck in the automatic baler's loading hopper. His foot went through the cardboard into a void area causing the him to lose his balance and fall into the loading hopper then into the compactor ram area. The ram cycled and his feet were caught between the ram and a side of the compactor area. The employee suffered a broken tibia and the right foot was crushed. The employee's right leg was later amputated below the knee.

On August 19, 2019, an employee was opening the pellet warming machine to prepare serving plates for the residents' dinner.  When the employee grabbed the handle on the lid, the employee received an electric shock and collapsed to the floor.
An employee was working on a case packer when a piston was activated, creating a pinch point that amputated the employee's right pinky finger.

An employee was climbing up a ladder when, at approximately 6 feet, the ladder slid sideways. The employee fell to the side, landed on his feet, and then fell backwards onto his back, fracturing vertebrae.
An employee lost balance while on a ladder connecting steel and fell approximately 14 feet to the floor, suffering a compound fracture to the right leg.

An employee installed a new incline belt and was doing a test run when the incline belt would not start up. The employee was attempting to help the belt move when the belt amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

On August 19, 2019, an employee was slicing chicken on a meat slicer in automatic mode. He was trying to move the fence carriage closer to the meat to better hold it in place when the machine pushed his left thumb tip into the blade. As a result, he sustained an amputation to his left thumb tip.
An employee was reaching out for a crane remote control when it slipped off his hand and activated the crane. The crane moved and his fingers were crushed between two pieces of metal.
An employee was operating a slab saw when her hand was caught in the blade, causing severe hand damage.

On August 19, 2019, an employee was working on a baker's scaffold while mudding drywall inside a commercial building. At approximately 11:20 a.m., the employee was standing on the scaffold and using his arms to move the scaffold across the floor when he lost balance and fell over the guardrails, landing on the concrete floor below. He fractured seven ribs and his skull.
An employee was lancing an underflow pump when he pulled on the whip and it came out of the pump. The high-pressure water jet then injured the employee's right forearm.

An employee was guiding a student who was backing a trailer into a parking spot when the employee was pinned between the trailer and a parked trailer. He was hospitalized with kidney/liver contusions.

An employee was cleaning debris around a core machine. The employee kneeled down and placed their left hand on a support bar. The machine cycled and the employee's left middle finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was driving a forklift by a column when his foot was caught between the forklift and the building column, causing a foot injury that resulted in the amputation of three toes.
An employee was pushing cartons along a conveyor when his hand was caught between the roller and belt. He pulled his hand and suffered severe abrasions.

Three employees were a replacing an extruder header. The first employee went to acquire rigging equipment and prepare a hoist. The second employee detached the extruder supply/return lines and began loosening the side clamps. The third employee was preparing the header for removal by removing the eight mounting bolts. Upon removal of the eighth bolt, the header fell approximately 6 feet from its cradle and hit the third employee in the left arm and leg. The third employee fell to the ground and the drive side of the header was resting on the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a broken left tibia, fibula, and humerus as well as a sprained right ankle.
An employee was inside a hull stepping up onto staging from the keel when he lost his balance, fell 3 feet down, and landed on his left leg, breaking his femur.
An employee was bundling pipes. When he pulled one down, it rolled over and smashed his fingers, amputating the tips of his left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was soft washing the roof of a one-story house when he slipped and fell 12 feet off the roof onto the pavers below. He was hospitalized with three fractures on his mid vertebrae, a bruised left knee, a laceration to the back of his head, and a concussion.

An employee was riding on the rear step of a garbage truck when the driver moved the vehicle onto the shoulder to avoid an oncoming vehicle. The employee was caught between the truck and a tree, suffering a rib fracture and chest contusion.
An employee was transporting drums of finished polyester resin to a reactor for rework. When he removed the bung on one of the drums, the polyester resin splashed his face, causing a chemical burn.

On August 19, 2019, an employee was preparing to trim a tree. The employee climbed a ladder and buckled into a tree limb when the limb snapped, causing the employee to fall approximately 15 feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a fractured spine.

An employee was loading packages onto a van line when the employee was caught between a package and the line's fixed static rollers (not powered), resulting in a partial left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was rebuilding a diesel engine at a customer's power generation plant when he attempted to move a four-wheel trailer out of the building that was in his way. The trailer was on a slight incline and, due to the size and weight, got away from him and headed toward some valves and piping along the fence line. He attempted to get in front of it to redirect and steer it when he twisted his lower back and pelvis area, causing factures to the lower vertebra and pelvis. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw when the wood flipped and the employee's hand slipped, resulting in a left thumb tip amputation.
An employee lost her balance and fell backwards while putting back a hand-held basket. She injured her right hip.
An employee was stung by several bees while weed whacking, suffering a reaction that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating an overhead crane to lift a stabilizer from a test fixture. The stabilizer shifted and one end swung upward towards the injured employee, contacting his left forearm and trapping his thumb between the stabilizer and the crane remote sitting on top of the test fixture. He was able to use his other hand to raise up the stabilizer and release his hand. His left thumb tip was amputated.
An employee cut his left wrist using unguarded grinder with a saw blade.

An employee was welding a large casting when he passed out from heat-related illness and fell into the hot casting. His helmet also cut his lip. He suffered a facial abrasion and burns to the stomach and arm.

An employee was re-positioning a gasket between two steel pipes when a pipe shifted and the employee's left middle finger was caught between the pipes. His left middle finger was amputated at the end.
An employee was preparing a food cart when the employee suffered an abdominal strain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to lift a manhole cover when the cover caught the employee's right middle fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when her foot was caught between the pallet jack and a trailer, breaking her foot.
An employee was helping a customer load items in her car when she tripped over a bag behind her and impacted the ground, breaking her knee.

Two employees were repairing a steam leak on a pre-dryer on a 20-foot elevated surface. While welding, both employees fell approximately 20 feet when they both lost their footing on the platform. One employee fell on a peg that punctured his right thigh and was subsequently hospitalized. The second employee received a head laceration that required 9 stitches. The second employee was treated and released the same day.

An employee was assisting a customer to position a shaker basket on a shaker skid utilizing a forklift operated by the customer. Three of the employee's fingers on the left hand were caught and injured between the shaker basket and the cross support of the shaker skid.
An employee fell off an extension ladder to the cement ground while hanging a banner and suffered a broken jaw.
On August 19, 2019, an employee was riding on an ATV to check leaks in pipe lines when the ATV flipped over in a washout.  He was hospitalized with eight fractured ribs.
A temporary employee suffered a foot amputation while operating a cardboard compactor.

An employee was hooking a load up to a crane when the employee walked into a conveyor line. A steel pipe was coming down the conveyor line and struck the employee, causing side and stomach contusions.

An employee was cutting 1/2 inch round metal rod into 4-inch pieces using a horizontal band saw. As the employee removed a piece the glove on his left hand was caught pulling his hand into the blade. Part of his left hand and two fingers were amputated by the saw blade.

An employee was holding the guide wire rope of a rig that was being relocated. The employee walked into the loop of the guide wire over the base beam as a cable moved forward and was caught between the base beam and the loop of the wire, breaking the left lower leg.

An employee was selecting cases of napkins from a pallet. The product on the bottom of the double stacked pallets became compromised and caused the above pallets to lean forward. After the employee selected a few cases of napkins, the pallets fell forward. The employee had her back to the pallets at that point and was struck by several cases of napkins as she went to the ground. She was hospitalized.
An employee was in the process of shrink wrapping a pallet when it shifted and struck him, fracturing his shoulder.
After fixing a roof that was making excessive noise, an employee became ill and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee lost balance and fell from an 8-foot ladder onto a desk, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was using a rag to wipe off oil on a part that was being cut by a horizontal band saw. The saw blade caught the rag and pulled the employee's hand into the saw, resulting in a partial amputation of his right fifth fingertip.
An employee climbing a pole during training activities became ill and was later hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee was driving a pickup truck towards the hangar. When he turned towards the hanger door the truck impacted the stationary clamp used to secure the hangar doors. He struck his head inside of the vehicle and sustained a concussion, forehead laceration, and a herniated disc in the neck.
An employee was working around a ditch when his hands and torso started to cramp up. He was hospitalized due to heat stress.
An employee was moving a steel plate with a chain. The chain caught the employee's right middle finger, severely injuring it. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee walking on a wet floor slipped and fell, hit the back of his head on the floor, and was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was caught/struck by a backhoe bucket while attempting to open a storage container. The employee sustained injuries to both lower legs and was hospitalized.

At the end of an employee's work day, he took his personal vehicle down to the location and parked his vehicle to tell a loader some information. His body was then pinned between a loader tire and his personal vehicle. He suffered abrasions, bumps, bruising, swelling, back pain, and lower body pain.

A maintenance employee was preparing to rotate a degas vessel. He was looking up at the hoisted platform above the degas vessel when his foot was caught between the vessel and the platform, resulting in a fractured and de-gloved left great toe.
An employee was pulling a pallet of product in a walk-in freezer when he slipped on a substance and fell on the floor, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was painting when the employee slipped and fell.

An employee was helping to assemble scaffolding near a fluidized catalytic cracker at a refinery. He began having heat-exposure-related symptoms. He was hospitalized and treated for low electrolytes and dehydration.
An employee was shutting the doors on a scrap trailer when he slipped and fell onto a sharp object that caused a 4-inch wide and 1-inch deep laceration to his left knee (2 inches below).

An employee was loading packages averaging 15 to 20 pounds onto the back of a van that could not be flushed into the van line (dock) because the van's bumper size. While the employee was tossing a package into the van from the van line (dock), he lost his balance and fell about 28 inches to the ground. He broke his right leg and was hospitalized.

On August 20, 2019, an employee was adjusting the forks on a powered industrial truck when a second employee drove down an adjacent row and struck/pushed returnable metal frame packaging toward the first employee. The first employee was pinned between the packaging and the mast of his powered industrial truck, suffering fractured ribs, a lacerated kidney, and a lung contusion.

An employee had just replaced a rubber O-ring on a manifold and was trying to put the bull plug back on the missile when it slipped off and took the employee's hand down, striking it against the flat metal plate below. As a result, the employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

Two employees were capping off an old gas well when the pressure of the well reached a high level and the well head blew off. One employee sustained fractured facial bones, contusions and burns to the chest, and shrapnel in the skin of the lower and upper torso.
An employee was providing home health services to a patient when she missed a step and fell to a lower level. She sprained her right ankle and fractured her left patella.
An employee was walking into work when she slipped and fell on a rug. She fractured her proximal humeral head and required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee parked his electric pallet jack next to a delivery van and stepped off. He then decided to move the electric pallet jack away from the van, pulling it towards himself. His lower left leg was crushed and broken between the bumper of the van and the electric pallet jack.
An employee was carrying display boxes at a store when he tripped and fell to the floor, fracturing his hip and requiring surgery.
An employee fell from the same level while moving chairs and floor mats, suffering a broken hip.
An employee stepped onto an unsupported cantilevered platform. The platform gave way and the employee fell approximately 7 to 8 feet into a water retention pit below, suffering a head laceration.
An employee was standing on a pallet and lifting a box when the employee lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with left leg and hip injuries.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal with a saw when the saw blade broke and lacerated his leg, requiring stitches.

An employee was moving oxygen-compressed air cylinders when one started to tip and fell onto another bottle where his finger was. His finger was caught between the two bottles, fracturing his left pinky finger and knuckle.
An employee suffered an electrical burn to his left hand when he took a part out of a machine.
An employee was loading a truck when he was stung by a bee.

An employee was painting three links on a railcar's hand brake chain when his right-hand fingers were caught in the chain and pulled into the brake housing. He suffered partial amputations to the index and middle fingers.

An employee was removing flash from a forged product using a long rod.  The forge operator did not see the wand while it was within the press, cycled the hammer, and struck the wand.  The wand then flew upwards, striking the employee in the right side of his face and resulting in a fractured jaw and cheek bone. The employee fell backwards and struck his head, resulting in a skull fracture.

An employee was hand digging a shallow trench for an electrical conduit installation. While digging the trench, the employee encountered tree roots.  To remove the tree roots, he cut partially through the roots with his personal utility knife. After cutting the majority of the exposed roots, he placed the utility knife outside the trench. He then attempted to pull the remaining roots and the sudden release of the roots caused his arm to rotate backwards, allowing his left wrist to contact the utility knife blade and suffer a laceration.

An employee was removing the rigging rope from a telehandler after loading a stack (3) of trusses onto an exterior wall when the telehandler shifted forward and caused the telehandler jib to strike the employee. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was adjusting a product in a packing machine when the machine caused an injury that resulted in the amputation of the left first distal phalanx.
An employee was pulling a lift gate down with his right hand when it closed on his left hand, crushing his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was loading a part into a press when it actuated, resulting in the amputation of the two left middle fingers.
An employee was leaving a chicken house through a door when the door slammed on and crushed his finger, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting an aluminum bracket with a miter saw when the bracket pinned his finger up against the backstop, resulting in fingertip amputation.
An employee was laying hot rubberized asphalt material when it splashed and burned the employee's left wrist.

Employees were at site to plug a well and were pulling casing from the well and laying them on a skid. An employee who was standing on a metal bench/stool lost his footing. The case fell off the rack and struck him in the right leg, breaking his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
While delivering mail, an employee began to suffer heat-/dehydration-related illness.
An employee was on a step ladder running wire along a ledge above the door when he fell off the step ladder sideways and hit a plastic slop sink with his left side. He fractured four ribs.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw when the blade cut his right pointer finger, resulting in an amputation and fracture above the first knuckle.

Two employees were setting up to test a piece of equipment with a hydraulic clamp. The first employee started to operate the hydraulic clamp grip while the second employee's hand was in the grip and the clamp closed on his hand, crushing his right index fingertip. His fingertip had to be amputated to the nailbed.
An employee was moving a portable rolling section when two other employees pushed the section at the same time, crushing his left index finger.
An employee was practicing football when his foot became stuck in the ground, resulting in a dislocated/fractured right ankle.
An employee fell to the ground while climbing a powerline utility pole, fracturing three ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a block of meat using a bandsaw. The saw blade cut his right little finger; the tip was medically amputated.

An employee was using a chain hooked around scrap lodged in a shear's press box and attached to an excavator's grapple. When the employee put tension on the chain it broke, causing the grapple to swing and strike the employee's leg. The employee's left leg was fractured, requiring surgery.
An employee was run over by a semi-truck while directing traffic in the recycle yard, suffering full-body, right-side injuries.
An employee was replacing a fire hydrant when he became dehydrated and cramped up, requiring hospitalization for heat stress.
An employee was using a band saw to trim a plastic part. As he moved the part, the band saw caught his left ring finger, amputating the fingertip down to the first knuckle.
An employee was sliding a 30-pound rotor into a rotor block when his finger was caught in a nip point, resulting in an amputation of the right fourth digit (1/2 to 3/4 of an inch).
An employee was loading a coil into a machine when the coil became jammed. When the employee unjammed the coil, the machine's spindle caused an amputation of his right ring finger.
An employee was offloading petroleum gas from a tanker when the oil-based petroleum gas liquid sprayed him as he removed the hose. He sustained chemical burns to both arms.
An employee slipped and fell on the restroom floor, breaking the left ankle.
An employee was standing on a chair in a restroom while opening a paper towel dispenser when he fell to the floor and fractured his hip.

An employee was assembling a pre-hung residential door and needed to add some wooden door jamb extension strips to achieve the proper dimensions for the opening size. He was ripping a board to the needed size on a table saw when the board kicked back. He pushed it back down and his finger came in contact with the blade, lacerating his left index fingertip. As a result, his skin had to be surgically trimmed.

On 8/21/2019, an employee was cleaning inside the back of a box truck while the equipment was running. Toward the end of the shift, the employee began feeling lightheaded and nauseated due to possible heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was securing a vessel to a dock. The employee's right foot got stuck between planks and the big toe was crushed.
An employee was cutting a driveway to pour concrete when a motorcycle came around the flaggers and signs and hit the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg.

An employee was unloading a large metal container that holds mail trays. She removed the netting from the front of the container to retrieve the trays and placed the netting on the ground. After retrieving the trays, she tripped on the netting and fell to the ground, landing on the trays she was carrying. She broke her hip.

The injured employee was directing another employee (fork truck operator) on the placement of a 12' x 8' container onto a flatbed trailer. The employee was pointing to the place on the trailer where the container needed to be in order to secure it for transport. When the injured employee moved his hand, he felt a tug on his right index finger. He observed that the tip of his right index finger had been amputated.
An employee was climbing onto a trailer when he fell to the ground, breaking his wrist and injuring his hip.
A conveyor caught an employee's left hand during maintenance, fracturing the arm.

An employee was walking over a transfer surface for hot steel bars when the employee fell towards the hot bar. The employee's right leg came in contact with the hot bar, receiving second and third degree burns from the knee down and above the ankle. The employee also received a burn on the left wrist.
Two employees were operating a machine next to storage totes stacked on each other when a tote fell approximately 16 feet and struck the employees. They suffered head and back injuries.

On August 21, 2019, a temporary employee was applying grated cheese to a pizza crust moving on a conveyor line to a plastic wrapping system. He was attempting to grab grated cheese that drops into a catch bin under the conveyor when his finger was caught in the chain and sprocket system, resulting in a finger amputation on his right hand.
An employee's right hand was crushed by an industrial press, resulting in an amputation.

On August 21, 2019, an employee was on break in the cafeteria and walking to a table when the employee slipped and fell to the same level. The employee suffered a broken hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was stung on the neck by an insect while collecting garbage, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell 24 feet from a third floor while installing plywood on the exterior of a building. The employee was hospitalized for bruises and contusions.
A driver was on his trailer handling a tarp when he slipped and fell to the ground sustaining a head injury.
An employee was running sheet metal panels though a panel machine when the employee's hand went under the sheers, resulting in an amputation to the left hand (only the pinky finger remains).

An employee was passing through the atrium area of the facility to another area where she tripped over a floor mat and fell to the floor.  She experienced a concussion, wrist fracture, and vertebral compression.

An employee was pulling wire mesh into place on a roof deck when the employee fell 14 feet, 7 inches, through a cover-over hole to the concrete floor below. The employee suffered contusions and fractures to the right ankle, right thigh, and L4 vertebra.

An employee was holding a piece of metal attached to a cable when the cable pulled and the employee's hand was caught between a metal part and pipe, causing an amputation of the left middle finger above the second joint.
An employee had been connecting generator cables for hours when he felt nauseous and lightheaded. He was hospitalized with potential heat stress.
An employee suffered a reaction while cleaning a kitchen sink with bleach, requiring hospitalization.
On August 21, 2019, an employee was walking outside when he slipped and fell. He hit his head and required hospitalization.
An employee was setting up a stage for a television event when he fell 5 feet off the stage and struck his chest on the edge of the stage, sustaining fractured ribs.
An employee was moving a heating coil when it fell on the tip of his right index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
While working in a power plant, an engineer became dehydrated due to the heat. He was hospitalized.

An employee was handling and assembling extruding equipment when his fingertip entered the side port of a head body while inserting the flow divider. This resulted in a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was canvassing addresses for verification purposes. She parked her car on an incline, stepped out, and slipped and fell. She injured her right thumb, broke her left leg, and suffered a swollen eye.

An employee was performing maintenance on a paper machine inside the facility when he started to feel fatigue and sat down. Shortly thereafter, the employee became unresponsive and stopped breathing. He regained consciousness and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was tightening a thread inside a relief valve when both of the employee's hands were crushed and fractured by the compression collar.
An employee was throwing trash into a burn pile. Something in the trash exploded and burned the employee's face and left arm.
An employee fell off a ladder after being startled by an electrical short and suffered head injuries and a broken collarbone.
An employee was hydrostatically testing a pipe when the hydro plug was ejected, striking and breaking her leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while adjusting a fall mat, falling to the floor and suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was driving a fork truck, headed to a put-away location with a pallet of product, when the employee collided with another forklift. The employee suffered an open fracture of the left lower leg just above the ankle.
An employee was pressure-washing algae on a tank. As he was leaving work for the day, he started experiencing body cramps due to dehydration.
An employee was walking up metal stairs when he slipped, fell, and hit his head on the stairs. He was knocked unconscious and suffered a head laceration and concussion.
A security guard was shot in the stomach while standing by a guard booth.
An employee was power-washing concrete at 4,500 psi. The water ran across his right foot, causing a wound to the big toe that required surgery.
A maintenance employee was servicing a casting machine when the automatic ladle spilled molten aluminum on the employee's back. The employee was hospitalized with severe burns to the back.
An employee was setting up a flange machine during training. The machine shifted, pinching his right hand against the flange. The hand was broken and lacerated, and he was hospitalized.

An employee had been trying to clear a clogged drain with drain cleaner. As the employee was using compressed air to clear the drain, the drain cleaner sprayed out and caused second-degree burns to his cheek, nose and forehead.

An employee was in a forklift that was stuck in mud. A truck was pulling the forklift with a chain to get it out of the mud when the chain broke and snapped, hitting the employee who was in the forklift. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a fractured shoulder blade.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when he was stung by a wasp or bee. The employee had a severe allergic reaction and went into anaphylactic shock which caused a heart attack.
An employee was sorting chicken necks on a conveyor belt when her finger was caught between the belt and guide, resulting in an amputation.
On 8/22/2019, an employee was clearing merchandise off a conveyor when the employee's hands were caught in the conveyor, causing flesh wounds that required hospitalization.

A metal vibe plate was being lifted off a truss plate by an overhead crane. As an employee was removing two bolts on the end of the plate, the employee's left little finger was crushed between the plates. The tip was amputated.

An employee was outside helping gather carts from the parking lot. While inside a cart corral, the employee noticed a flat cart was headed towards a vehicle. The employee jumped over the cart corral, landed awkwardly, and sustained a broken leg.

An employee was helping secure a container of poultry sanitizing chemical to a forklift when he slipped in a puddle of spilled chemical and fell. He suffered first- and second-degree chemical burns to the left side of his body.
An employee was helping others to pull a pole from a stack and load it onto a digger derrick when the pole fell and struck the employee, fracturing his pelvis and puncturing his bladder.

An employee tripped and fell while walking boars, hitting the boot of another employee in front of her. Later, she collapsed again. In the course of both falls, she suffered bleeding on the brain and scrapes to the right elbow, the right shoulder, and the right side of her face.
An employee was on a compactor platform throwing cardboard into the trash compactor when she fell 1 foot off the ledge of the platform to the ground, breaking her tibia.
An employee was walking toward the building entrance when she tripped on pavement and fell to the ground, injuring her right shoulder, collarbone, ribs, and left toe.
An employee was operating a debarker. When he went to remove a log, a chain grabbed his left foot, tearing off the skin and breaking bones.
An employee was attempting to clear a piece of wood stuck under the guard of a cabinet defect saw. The saw activated and amputated the right middle and ring fingers at the first knuckle.

An employee was in a bucket trimming limbs with a hydraulic stick saw. A cut limb fell onto a primary power line, pushing the primary line down into the neutral line. The resulting arc flash burned the employee's right hand.
An employee was strapping freight to a truck trailer. A forklift moved and struck the employee, causing a broken foot/ankle.

An employee was cutting material with a band saw. He turned off the band saw to straighten the material in the vice. When he pushed the button to close the vice, his left middle finger was still in the vice as it closed, resulting in an amputation of his finger to the first knuckle.

On August 22, 2019, having spent the previous two days installing solar panels at a residence and feeling nauseous at the end of the second workday, an employee felt unwell and lost consciousness at work. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion, dehydration, and related kidney function issues.
An employee was mixing rubber on a mill when the employee experienced shortness of breath due to heat stress, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder installing internet at a residence when the ladder tipped over and the employee fell to the ground.
An employee was walking and carrying pants inside the store when she tripped over another employee's foot. She fractured her left hip and elbow on the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was preparing to hook up a hoist to an engine when it fell off the table it was on and pinned his feet, fracturing them.
An employee was performing pest control services at a customer's home when the employee was bitten on the hand by a snake or spider. The employee was hospitalized.

After cutting insulated panels outdoors, an employee was climbing a stair to a work trailer when he fell to the ground due to heat exhaustion and dehydration, injuring his shoulder. He was hospitalized.

An overhead lineman was elevated in a bucket while removing the rubber cover from a primary power line. An arc flash caused first- and second-degree burns to the employee's stomach and the area under the right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stopping a fan belt when his finger was caught between the fan belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was clearing a tile jam on the line when the employee's fingertip was injured, resulting in the amputation of 3 mm of the left little fingertip.
An employee was removing tie-down straps from a trailer load of plastic pipe. When the tie-downs were removed, the pipe rolled off the trailer and struck the employee's left ankle, fracturing it.

An employee had been moving materials and was found laying on their stomach on the floor with a fractured skull and laceration requiring 2 staples. It is believed that the employee had a seizure and fell striking their head on a lag bolt that holds a guardrail in place on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was learning to operate a table saw and was cutting a wooden 2x4 when the employee's left hand contacted the saw blade, resulting in a left index finger amputation.
An employee climbed a ladder to the roof. He slipped on the roof's surface after dismounting the ladder and fell to the ground. He suffered fractured L1 and L2 vertebrae.
An employee's finger was caught in a set of double industrial automatic doors, causing an amputation of the right ring distal fingertip.

An employee was loading an oil drum onto a hand truck. Upon placing the oil drum onto the hand truck, the employee's fingers were caught between the two objects. The employee sustained amputations of the right middle and index fingertips.

An employee was changing air hoses on a milling machine and had loaded wood to run through the machine. While pushing the wood through the milling machine, the employee's right hand fingers were struck by the rotating sharper head and the employee suffered amputation of 1/3 of the third digit and amputation of the second digit underneath the first knuckle.
An employee was changing out an empty tote of wash for a full tote in a foundry. The mixer/frame fell and struck the employee's left arm, causing a compound fracture.
An employee was standing on the ground as a come-along was being lowered from a roof when the come-along came loose and fell, hitting the employee. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was working in the warehouse when he tripped and fell, breaking four ribs and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while climbing a 10-foot scaffold to access a swing stage scaffold directly above it. The employee suffered a broken tibia in the left knee with damaged ligaments.
An employee was helping another employee string a wire at a press when his finger was caught by the press, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was arranging a rebar wall for a vault that was being constructed when three parts of the rebar became detached and struck the employee in the head and chest. The employee was hospitalized.

While operating a motorized walk-behind pallet jack, an employee's hand was caught between the handle of the machine and a shelf. This resulted in a fracture to the right-hand pinky finger and dislocated right thumb, requiring subsequent surgery.

An employee was working on commercial roof to pick up a debris and materials. He picked up a piece of plywood put there by another contractor. He did not know it was covering a 4' x 4' hole, stepped in it, and fell 20 feet to the concrete below, breaking his right foot and requiring stitches on his left leg.
An employee was crossing a street on campus when the employee tripped over the base of a pedestrian crossing sign and broke a leg on the ground.

An employee was operating a stand-up mini skid loader when one of the track's slid on some rocks, causing the machine to tip over. The employee's left leg was caught between the machine and a building. The employee was hospitalized with bruising to the upper left leg.

An employee fell while operating a powered pallet jack and her right foot became lodged underneath. She pulled her foot out from under the equipment and suffered a fracture to her right heel. She was hospitalized.

An employee tripped over a rake that was propped up and fell, landing on the floor and a tape measurer that was on the employee's tool belt. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur.
An employee became dehydrated while delivering building materials due to the heat.

An employee was working in the front stock room. She was standing on an 8-foot ladder near the top, putting 8-pound boxes onto shelves. She lost her balance and jumped from the ladder. She landed on both feet and suffered heel and ankle fractures.

An employee was unloading a truck at the loading dock when the employee fell backwards off the dock to a lower level, striking his head on concrete. He sustained a head laceration requiring stitches, and blood on the brain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was tripping pipe when the pipe stand shifted on soft ground and the pipe hit his leg. He was hospitalized with a fractured leg and had surgery.

An employee was struck and run over by a forklift that was driving in the forward position with wood pallets stacked approximately 5 feet off the ground. The employee sustained a severe laceration to her left leg, a fractured left ankle, and contusions to her right leg and arms.

An employee was using a jib crane with a magnetic attachment to lift a steel plate. While stabilizing the load with his left hand, the weight shifted and his left middle finger was pinched between the magnet and the hook partially amputating skin from the finger.

An employee was using a "blast car" to transfer a vehicle from the blast room to the staging area. The employee was found beneath the blast car carriage, and required an amputation to the left leg below the knee.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down stairs, hitting the ground and suffering a head injury.

While dismantling a catwalk, an employee fell about 20 feet off the catwalk to the ground, breaking the right arm, left leg, and multiple ribs. The employee was not tied off at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing a cylinder underneath a trailer when a bolt on the conveyor came off and the trailer's back end came down and struck the employee. The employee suffered a fractured skull and broken ribs.

An employee was attempting to repair a crane boom dolly. The employee released the air supply to the crane boom dolly, allowing the brakes to release. The dolly rolled over its wheel chocks back toward the crane, pinching the employee between the crane and dolly. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.
On August 23, 2019, an employee was positioning a scissor lift underneath a vehicle and reached up under the lift with his left hand when the lift collapsed on his left arm, breaking it.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when the pallet jack was placed in reverse and pinned his left ankle between the pallet jack and a pallet. His left tibia/ankle were fractured.

An employee was running electrical cord while standing on a ladder extended against a tree. The ladder became unstable. The employee then dismounted the ladder and his foot landed on a root, resulting in a broken left ankle.

An employee was prepping to start cutting on a copper pipe with a cordless grinder. When the employee started to cut on the pipe, the cordless grinder slipped and cut him on the top of his left hand, causing a deep laceration.

An employee was at a roaster machine moving a manual cart with a part on it. The employee's finger was pinched between the cart and a frame of the machine, resulting in an amputation to the left ring finger with no bone involvement.

Employees were moving a pipeline inspection tool barrel. The injured employee was pulling on the rigging in order to allow a forklift to move the barrel through an open door. As the barrel was coming through the door, the rigging slipped off the fork and the barrel landed on the employee's foot. The employee's two left toes adjacent to his big toe were amputated.
An employee was cutting sheet metal when the sheet metal shear contacted his right middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee had just concluded pumping fish from the fish hold on a vessel. He climbed out of the fish hold from a fixed ladder and then slipped from the main deck of the vessel, falling approximately 9 feet backwards into the fish hold and landing on his back. He was hospitalized with a stable fracture to the back.
An employee was positioning a riding lawn mower when he lost grip and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his right femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder installing a nut and bolt overhead when he fell 5 feet off the ladder to the concrete floor, hitting his head and fracturing his skull.

An employee was opening a valve when the hot caustic (main component: sodium hydroxide) from an adjacent valve that was open sprayed him. The piping was shut down for maintenance and the injured employee was restoring it to service prior to the incident. The employee sustained a second degree burn on 2% of the right leg surface. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were using a scissor lift to spray-paint and back-roll an exterior wall. The scissor lift was extended to approximately 18 feet when it tipped over. Both employees on the lift fell to the ground with the lift. The lift was operating on asphalt at the time of the incident. The first employee suffered a broken left leg, broken right arm, and three fractured vertebrae. The second employee suffered a broken pelvis and a neck injury. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was helping clean a patient up. The employee then leaned over the  bed to press the "weight" button. The employee lost her balance and her right foot became caught on a cord under the bed. The employee fell to the floor and broke her left hip.

An employee was cleaning/restocking a bar area and carrying a case of drinks when she stepped backwards and tripped over a flatbed rolling cart. She fell to the ground, hitting and fracturing her right elbow.

On 8/24/2019, an employee was unloading wooden building materials from a truck using a forklift. At the jobsite, a vehicle was in his way, so he lifted the load above the vehicle. The forklift then tipped forward. While the forklift was tipped, he attempted to exit the forklift and fell against the roll cage structure, fracturing his shoulder.

An employee had been collecting grocery carts in a store parking lot after the power, which had gone out, was restored to the store. The employee started to feel unwell and was later found laying down. He was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion and acute kidney failure.
An employee was operating a forklift when his foot became pinned between the forklift and a rack, resulting in a broken foot/leg.
An employee was loading a cart with flowers when the employee stepped back, twisted a heel, and fell backwards to the ground. The employee suffered a hip fracture.

On August 24, 2019, an employee was unplugging the rotary valve under a cyclone when the employee's left index finger contacted the moving rotary valve, resulting in a partial amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee slipped while descending an A-frame ladder and attempted to grab a rail, which pinched his left pinky, resulting in a partial pinky fingertip amputation.

On Saturday, August 24, 2019, at approximately 2:45 AM, an employee was carrying a lithium ion battery in his pocket when the battery failed and exploded, causing a burn injury to the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning and doing routine maintenance on a screen conveyor belt when he lost his footing and fell backwards onto the belt, suffering fractures to the lower back.
An employee tripped on a floor mat while walking and fell to the floor, fracturing the right hip.
An employee was placing supplies under her cash register when her shoelace became caught. She lost her balance and fell onto her left side on the floor, fracturing her left hip.

An employee was transporting a 5-gallon ink bucket on a 3-wheel scooter when the rear right tire struck a conveyor, causing him to be ejected onto the concrete floor. He suffered a dislocated vertebra disc.
An employee was repairing a turntable when the turntable unexpectedly activated and punctured the employee's leg. The turntable was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack with double-stacked pallets when the top pallet (900 pounds) fell on the injured employee and fractured both legs.

An employee was replacing lighting fixtures at a customer's location. The circuit to the section where the employee was working was de-energized, but one fixture was incorrectly tied to a separate circuit, resulting in an electrical shock to the employee.

An employee was running an electrical wire and ethernet cable across a large dip tank when the tank cover collapsed and the employee fell into the tank, which was full of alkaline cleaner. The employee received chemical burns across the entire body.
An employee was helping to disassemble a scaffold when the employee fell 13 feet through a board that gave way, suffering rib and back injuries.

An employee was trying to set a spring-operated dock plate in place when a malfunction occurred and the employee's fingers were pinched in the dock plate. The employee suffered right index and middle fingertip amputations.
An employee was on a horse working with cattle when the horse lost its footing in mud and fell with the employee to the ground. The employee broke a finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the restaurant when she tripped over a phone cord and hit the floor, breaking her hip.

An employee was climbing a steel two-section, truck-mounted ladder when one section shifted and caught the employee's finger between rungs. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was de-energizing the main distribution switch board. The breaker had been opened and locked. He tested it and deemed there was no voltage present at the lugs on the supply side of the breaker. A leg of a ground cluster was attached to the neutral bus. Another leg of the ground cluster came in contact with the energized "A" phase on the supply side of the breaker, resulting in an arc flash (480v/277v). The employee sustained first degree burns on the right side of his face and neck and second degree burns on his lips, under his chin, and behind his right ear.

An employee was unloading a truck of ice using an electric pallet jack when the employee slipped on ice that had built up on the floor of the truck and fell, breaking a leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left pinky finger was smashed and fractured between two joints of 12-inch steel pipe while he was laying out pipe.
An employee was climbing onto an over-the-road tractor when the employee slipped off the running board, resulting in a ruptured knee tendon.

An employee was transferring a PVB table from the PVB stretch machine when the middle fingertip on his left hand was compressed between the PVB table and the base of the table holding the PVB table. As a result, he sustained a left middle fingertip tissue amputation (no bone loss or removal of fingernail).

An employee was lifting an auger out of a metal cylindrical screen to clean meat residue off the auger when it slipped from his hand. The fourth finger on his left hand was then pinched between the auger he was lifting and the screen that was resting on the floor, resulting in a distal fingertip amputation.

An employee was being trained on an electric pallet jack when the employee lost control and jumped off the pallet jack, which then ran over the employee's ankle/foot. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture between the left shin and ankle.

Two employees were using a scissor lift to access and repair a damaged valve. The employees were approximately 12 feet above the floor. Employee 1 was using a pipe wrench to open the valve when the gasket failed. Hot, production fluid sprayed both employees in the lift, blocking access to the scissor lift controls. Employee 2 climbed over the rail and down the scissors to the ground. Employee 2 sustained first and second degree burns to the face and scalp, was treated and released. Employee 1 fell out of the lift and sustained multiple orbital fractures, a fractured sternum, a broken knee cap, and a laceration to the forehead. Employee 1 was hospitalized.

An employee was using a bench grinder to clean up 2-inch sub assemblies when his right index fingertip was caught between the grinder and the workpiece, resulting in a fingertip amputation at the knuckle.
An employee was changing misters on a condenser unit. The employee fell 10 feet to the ground below, suffering injuries to three lower-back vertebrae, broken toes, and a lacerated little finger.

An employee was repairing an aerial lift when a hydraulic hose leaked, causing high-pressure hydraulic fluid to come out and puncture the skin on the employee's left middle finger. The wound became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee fell off an electric scooter and hit his head on a concrete apron, suffering a severe head injury, cut to the left eye, and loss of consciousness.

An employee was on a ladder inspecting the coil section of an air handling unit when a PVC cap with a steel bushing burst free and struck the employee in the lower right jaw, knocking him off the ladder. He fell backward onto concrete, causing a 1-inch laceration to the back of his head. The impact to his face caused his jaw to break.
An employee was cutting 1-by-6-by-6s with a chop saw. The saw amputated the last joint of his left index finger.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, cutting exhaust hood ductwork apart for removal. A portion of the ductwork fell and struck the ladder, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall to the floor. The employee suffered a head injury and a broken collarbone.
A temporary employee was unclearing a jam of product on an extrusion machine when the employee's hand was caught and injured between moving parts on the machine.
An employee experienced heat-related illness while delivering mail on his route and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was dismantling sections of scaffolding. A section of the scaffolding took his personal fall protection with it as it fell, causing the employee to fall about 15 feet to the ground. He suffered a fractured left shin and a laceration to his forehead.
After constructing a concrete sidewalk, an employee was found slumped over during a break. He was hospitalized due to heat-related illness.

An employee was operating a pallet jack to unload pallets from a semi trailer.  The stack of pallets would not clear the door of the trailer, and the top pallet became stuck on the trailer door, pulling it closed on the employee's arm.  The employee suffered a broken left forearm and required surgery.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a part in a punch press machine area when the punch press cycled, crushing and puncturing the employee's left hand.

An employee was driving a forklift with a pallet full of products into a storage container when he put his left foot against the inside wall of the storage container. The forklift then moved, causing his left foot to be caught between the container's wall and forklift. He suffered multiple fractures to his left foot and ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a blockage on hammer mill equipment. A blade in the spout of the airlock struck his left middle and ring fingers, amputating the tips.
An employee had been baking donuts and was walking when the employee slipped on water and fell to the floor, injuring the left knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loading feed on a trailer when the feed spilled. The employee attempted to clean the feed and fell off the trailer, suffering a loss of consciousness, an open wound and contusion to the head, a fractured left rib and scapula, and two fractured vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's foot was caught on a phone/computer cable and she fell to the floor on her left side. She broke her hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was unloading a furniture box at a customer's location when the box fell and hit the employee's right ankle, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning and servicing rental cars. One of the cars pinned him against the wall, causing lacerations and a fracture to his lower extremities. He was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting landscaping activities and went to clear a blockage within the blade area of a riding lawnmower when the blade amputated a right-hand fingertip.
An employee was emptying a garbage compactor when a metal bar fell on and injured the employee's foot.
An employee slipped on beans and wrenched his knee while working.
An employee was lining up a part on a mini punch press machine when the employee's left middle finger was caught between the press and the metal piece, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck in the throat by a patient that came into the emergency room, suffering a contusion to the larynx.
An employee was disassembling a paint booth while standing on top of the booth when he fell 7 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fracture to his left ankle.
An employee was coming down the roof using an extension ladder when he slipped and fell about 8 feet.  A stick from a recently timed tree went through his bicep.

An employee was using a fire hose to flush water from a newly installed water line when the hose whipped. The employee tripped or was knocked off balance to the ground by the whipping hose, dislocating the left elbow.
After working, an employee felt sick and was hospitalized due to dehydration.
On August 26, 2019, at approximately 5:40 a.m., an employee was walking down the hall when she lost her balance, tripped, and fell into the wall. She fractured her left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell while walking on a work platform, suffering a back injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking to her car when she tripped on the corner of a speed bump. She fell and fractured her right wrist, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was adjusting the spray tip of a pneumatic powered paint sprayer when the spray trigger was activated, causing the spray stream of paint to contact the employee's hand. Paint was injected into the employee's hand, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were exploring an area within the forest and conducting a field botanical survey. The area included steep, rocky ground and talus slopes. An employee was sandblasting rebar so he could lay new concrete when he tripped on a piece of rebar and sandblasted his right foot.
An employee was exiting a box truck when the employee slipped off the step and fell to the ground, breaking the left hip and femur.
An employee was walking toward a trailer to unload it. The employee slipped into the trailer tire, suffering an injury that resulted in knee and calf swelling.

An employee was in the process of unclogging a drain valve on a paper machine stock refiner when the pulp material inside the valve sprayed out. The temperature of the pulp material was approximately 140 to 200 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee sustained second degree burns to his left hand.

An employee was loading equipment into the rear storage area of a company truck when the employee's right elbow struck an inside latch mechanism on the rear storage door. The employee then fainted and fell backward. The employee's head struck the ground, causing a concussion.
An employee was repairing an auger when the hook holding the tension on the coil became unhooked and caught the employee's middle fingertip, causing an amputation.
On August 26, 2019, an employee was struck by a vehicle while flagging traffic, suffering a broken pelvis and broken ribs.
An employee was grinding spent marijuana using a shredder/mulcher. As the employee tried to clear a jam, the grinder blade amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was climbing up the side ladder of a cement pavement machine. When he was more than halfway up, 5-6 feet from the ground, he fell to the concrete below and broke his left ankle.
An employee was grabbing an overhead cable to pull himself up when the metal cable lacerated his fingers.
An employee was riding an ATV at a team building event when the ATV flipped. The employee suffered a fractured leg.

An employee was attempting to retrieve a label that was sucked up into a dust collection tube when his right-hand fingers contacted the rotating blades, resulting in amputations of his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee slipped and fell. Her leg entered a tank of 180 degree water. She was hospitalized for second degree burns on her left leg at the back side of the knee and ankle.
After performing her duties, an employee was parking the tractor at the dock. The tractor went off the dock and the employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and a subdural hematoma.
While restocking a vending machine at a customer site, an employee began to fell unwell and suffered cramping. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was moving 40-pound crates from one spot to another when his gallbladder ruptured.

An employee was sitting at a computer workstation when she stood up to walk and her foot became tangled in the hoses and cords to the chairside handpieces. When she went to step to her right, her foot was snagged on the hoses and she fell forward, breaking her arm.
An employee's fingers were pinched in tongs, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was providing medical surveillance to responding wildland firefighters when the employee was stung by a bee and suffered a severe allergic reaction. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was arguing with another employee when he was punched in the face, later requiring hospitalization for a concussion.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 wood stake with a circular saw when the saw kicked back and severely lacerated the top of the employee's left thumb.

An employee was attempting to free a pallet stuck on its roller system. The pallet would not move so the employee braced himself against the mezzanine guardrail system and pushed.  The weld on the steel upright broke and the employee fell to the floor, breaking both legs and suffering one compound fracture. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee and his crew were removing a broken power pole. The top portion of the pole was hung in a tree and still attached to the power lines. The crew was digging the bottom broken section out of the ground when they heard the top portion crack. The broken pole fell on the employee and injured his lower back.

An employee had been pulling customer orders while operating a forklift when a second employee heard him call for help. He was found sitting in a pool of blood with a large cut on the head, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a pry bar to separate metal coils and create a gap so a chain could be inserted to lift and load the metal coils onto a flatbed trailer for shipment. During the process, the pry bar slipped and the employee fell backwards to the ground, fracturing his left foot.
