An employee was struck in the leg by a pipe and sustained a fracture.

An employee was operating material handling equipment (MHE) when he hit a column in the warehouse. Just before impact, he stuck his foot outside of the MHE. His foot was caught between a column protector and the bottom of the MHE, resulting in a fractured ankle.
An employee was a passenger on an ATV when the ATV rolled over. The employee suffered a fractured left elbow and a lower back contusion.
On 08/27/2019, an employee was stepping over a 14-inch I-beam on the ground when he tripped over the beam and impacted the ground, suffering a broken rib and bruised arm.

An employee had just removed a food item from a steamer and was walking toward the plate warmer to put the food on top of it. The employee slipped on a small amount of water on the floor, grabbed onto the side of the plate warmer, and suffered an electrical shock.
An employee was having shortness of breath and difficulty breathing while delivering beverages to various locations. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking into the building, stumbled, and fell to the ground. She was hospitalized for a broken right shoulder.

An employee was working at a policyholder's residence responding to their insurance claim. He was on their outside deck and began to climb up a ladder. He was on the 2nd rung from the ground when the ladder lifted back towards him, hitting his forehead area. He continued to fall backwards, hitting the back of his head on the deck and knocking him unconscious.
An employee was walking down the permanent stairs on a residential construction site when he tripped and fell down seven steps, breaking his left leg.

An employee was attaching a jib to a crane. The jib fell and caught his left index and middle fingers between the jib and the top rail of the aerial lift. Part of the left middle finger was medically amputated.
An employee was operating a fabric cutting machine when the equipment created sparks and his shirt caught on fire. The employee was burned.

An employee was placing a sheet of corrugated metal onto a lid frame from an intermodal container. As he tossed the sheet onto the frame assembly, the sheet struck his left arm, cut through his welding sleeves and shirt, and caused a deep laceration to his left bicep.
While working inside an air handling unit, an employee's right hand was caught in the fan belt resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a stand-up mower when the side cover on the deck hit a rock and the blades turned off. The employee's hand entered the deck when the still-moving blades severed a right-hand fingertip to the bone and caused a deep tissue cut.

An employee was replacing a starter generator bracket on a gas-powered golf cart. This required removal of the starter. He removed the seat to gain access to engine compartment and knelt on the floorboard of the car to get into position to perform the task. He loosened the starter generator adjustment bolt so that the starter generator belt could be removed. After loosening the adjustment bolt, he began to pull the belt off the front pully on the starter generator. At the same time, his knee pressed the accelerator pedal on the car. This caused the starter generator to be energized and it began to turn catching his left middle finger between the pully and the belt resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working at the break chain area using a circular saw to make cuts in a carcass when the saw amputated the employee's left ring finger above the middle knuckle.
An employee was delivering well parts at a worksite. A flash fire burned the employee's upper body, back, arms, and head.
A temporary was grinding on the tooth of a plow shank to bevel it when the grinder wheel broke and lacerated the employee's left elbow.
An employee was walking along a gravel road when she stepped into a puddle of mud and fell to the ground, fracturing her right ankle.
Two employees were performing fabrication work on an existing pipe when the valve was inadvertently hit, spraying hot water on and burning the employees.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in the parking lot.

An employee was using an overhead crane with a hoist to lift steel band material when the lifting device experienced tension from the overhead crane and slipped from the steel band. The steel band then struck and fractured his chin.
An employee was loading a door into the door machine when the boring bit lacerated the back of his right hand.
An employee was attempting to clean debris out of a rotary vane under a dust collector when the rotary airlock vane grabbed his gloved left hand and amputated his third and fourth fingertips.

An employee was cutting down a tree when the tree trunk fell and became stuck in another tree. The employee was moving to the other side of the tree, using the tree and stump as leverage to get over the tree. On his way over, the tree rolled, pinning his left index finger between the tree and the stump. His left index fingertip was crushed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee stood up to check in and assist a patient. When she went to sit back down, she missed the chair and fell to the floor, injuring her right hip.

An employee was team lifting a large package onto a tugger cart when he lost his grip on the package and his left hand slipped down. His left middle finger was then caught between the package and the steel frame on the cart.

An employee was preparing to clean up grain from the outside of a grain bin using a grain vacuum. When the vacuum was started, it sucked on to the grain door. It then released suddenly as the employee pulled it off; the employee fell backwards and hit his head and back on a drag conveyor. He suffered a contusion to the back of the head.

Two employees were removing a flange blank from a pipeline when they were sprayed by a 50% sodium hydroxide caustic solution. They were hospitalized with third degree chemical burns to the eyes and face.

An employee was trying to remove a chain that was bound up in a door stacker machine. When the employee removed the chain, it became free and rolled over. The employee's fingers were then caught between the chain and gear, resulting in possible middle and ring fingertip amputations on the right hand.

An employee removed his shoes upon entering a customer's home so as not to soil the customer's floor. As he was taking the stairs leading to the patio, he slipped and fell, hitting his head on the floor and requiring hospitalization for a brain bleed.
An employee sustained an amputation of soft tissue on his index finger.
An employee was cleaning the soil return belt. She lost her footing and her finger was caught in the rotating parts resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was installing insulation from a ladder. He fell from the ladder onto a handrail 4 feet below, suffering a broken rib.
An employee was walking by a pond area with his lunch box when he fell onto his knees and the grass face first. He was hospitalized for renal failure possibly due to dehydration and heat illness.
An employee was coming down from a roof, about 9 feet high. The employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken ankle.

On August 28, 2019, around 3:30 PM, an employee was pulling a 500-pound cart by hand when he backed into a low guardrail that was approximately 1.5 feet tall. The cart then impacted his leg at the calf and shin. The next day, his calf became swollen and blackish, requiring hospitalization and surgery for a muscle injury.
An employee was using a rope to pull down a 50-foot tree when the tree fell on him. He suffered a fracture to his C7 vertebra and a broken hip, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was removing entrails from a slaughtered cow when a piece of hair from the cow lodged in his middle fingernail bed on his right hand. The employee developed an infection in his hand requiring hospitalization.

While leaving after shift ended, an employee ran off the road while exiting the facility's parking lot and was found unresponsive and/or incoherent. The employee was hospitalized due to heat-related illness.

An employee was cleaning bag pieces out of a packaging machine when another employee cycled the machine. His right thumb came in contact with an internal blade and the tip was amputated (only flesh, no bone, partial nail).
An employee was fabricating metal on a roll former and the roller de-gloved his left index finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was washing a ready mix truck when the employee's water hose became caught on the mixer's drum fin and the employee's arm was pulled into the mixer. The employee suffered a right arm laceration.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when he struck another party and suffered broken bones in his right foot.
An employee was setting a 90-degree elbow while another employee operated the crown. The block dropped and crushed the employee's right hand.
A conveyor jammed and was at a complete stop. An employee cleared the jam and the conveyor activated. It caught his right glove and pulled his hand in, lacerating it.
An employee was closing a roof hatch when it closed on his right hand, resulting in a right hand pointer fingertip amputation and fracture.
An employee was loading bags onto a luggage cart. A bag fell off a luggage slide and struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was handling an 8 foot, 2x6 board while descending a ladder when the ladder shifted and he fell 5 feet to ground, landing on his feet. The fall resulted in a broken ankle and a compressed spinal disk.
An associate was walking down the aisle to assist a customer, tripped over a pallet, and fell. The employee suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was filing paperwork when she fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip and wrist and a forehead laceration.

An employee walked over to help support a bin of clothing that was on the rear lift of a box truck. The operator started to lower the bin to ground level when it fell off and struck the employee. The employee was knocked backwards and fell, striking her head on the concrete and suffering a possible brain hemorrhage.
An employee was cleaning out drill mud sediment from a frac tank. He began to experience body cramps and was hospitalized for dehydration and a heat-related muscle injury.

At about 10:20 a.m. on August 28, 2019, a St. Louis Service Base employee was using an industrial shear to cut 6-inch by 6-inch strips of 3/8-inch-thick steel for an ongoing fabrication project. While placing the metal sheet into the shear, the employee closed the clamping apparatus. The apparatus closed on the employee's right ring finger, pinching it under the metal sheet and amputating the last quarter-inch, with exposed nerve endings and bone damage. The fingertip was medically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was threading wire into a wire drawing machine when his finger slipped as the machine was pulling the wire, resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was evaluating and repairing an AC unit when his left middle and ring fingers were caught in a pulley belt resulting in a laceration and crushing injury to both fingers.
An employee was framing a utility power pole when it rolled onto his right leg, fracturing his tibia and fibula.

An employee was cutting concrete with a masonry saw and using a garden hose to spray water directly on the blade to control dust. The saw became stuck and jumped out of its cut channel, striking the employee in the right upper thigh. The employee suffered a thigh laceration requiring surgery, as well as damaged thigh muscle and tissue.

Changing the brushes of an engine. A cable got caught by the rotating engine. The employee attempted to retrieve it and his right hand was pulled to the engine. He suffered a severe laceration on the upper part of the hand.

The injured employee was welding on an assembly line with other workers. After completing a repair, the conveyor started up. The injured employee stepped back to check the weld and was caught by the conveyor resulting in a leg injury.

An employee was using a powered pallet jack to load cardboard into a trailer. He tripped over an empty pallet in the trailer and his right foot and ankle were pinned between the powered pallet jack and the empty pallet, resulting in fractures to the right foot.
An employee was loading a trailer when he tripped over a pallet, breaking his right leg.
An employee was cleaning out the bed of his pickup truck when wet mud/concrete slid out and landed on his right foot. Two of the employee's toes were amputated.

An employee was laying rebar and preparing to pour cement for a pre-cast wall. The employee lost consciousness while walking to the breakroom and was hospitalized for dehydration and heat related illness.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a printing press. The rag got caught and pulled the employee's hand into the roller resulting in a fracture and partial loss of a nail.
An employee was walking out a door when the door closed on the employee's right hand, amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was injured during a football game. The employee was running and was tackled from behind, suffering a broken right foot.
An employee was transporting hot dripping fluid to a used cooking oil container when the fluid contacted the employee, causing first and second degree burns.

An employee was moving material around in a warehouse. Sheets of particle board became unbalanced and fell on the employee, pushing him into a stack of drywall. He suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a cut above the right eye.
An employee was on a ladder to remove an electrical box. When he opened the box, he was shocked and jumped off the ladder to the ground. He suffered two broken heels.
An employee was returning to his forklift when corrugated boxes that were nearby fell on him. He was hospitalized with a broken left leg and dislocated left ankle.
On August 29, 2019, an employee was driving a sit-down forklift when it struck a barrier. The employee was found unconscious on the ground, having suffered a neck injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee's thumb on his left hand was amputated while using a circular saw.
A bee stung an employee in the head as he put on his hard hat. He had an allergic reaction and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading items from the back of a truck. He fell out of the back of the truck and landed on the ground on his knees, breaking both legs below the kneecap. He was hospitalized.
An employee was at a water well working with other employees when the employee suffered from dehydration, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was tearing material from a flat roof, roughly 100 feet from the edge, when the employee stepped on a splice and fell through the roof to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with head and shoulder injuries.

On August 29, 2019, an employee was engaging the brake on a zip line when wind caused the brake to hit and engage the emergency arrest device (EAD). This caused the employee to stop abruptly and be jolted in the air. The employee's foot then hit the zip line and sustained a compound fracture.

An employee was using a step ladder to cut branches off trees. One of the branches fell and hit the ladder, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall to the ground. He suffered a broken right wrist.
An employee was descending from a transmission tower when he fell 25 feet to the ground, suffering a separated shoulder and L2 and L3 vertebrae injuries. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
At 3:48 a.m., an employee was descending from a roof to a lower roof. The employee fell down a stairway, landing 10 feet below and breaking his left leg and foot.

An employee was using an industrial size dust collector (vacuum) to clear out a packaging machine. The employee's hand became caught in a turning valve roll in the packaging machine, resulting in the amputation of the right index and middle fingertips. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was emptying out a soup warmer well when she lost her grip and the hot soup spilled on her chest and stomach. She was hospitalized with burns to the chest and stomach.
An employee slipped and fell on an office floor that had just been mopped, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was working on a utility installation (pipe) crew when the employee exhibited signs of dehydration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was inflating a tire he had just mounted. It ruptured, causing severe injuries to both his arms.

A truck driver was wrapping and tightening a load at a logging site. He lost his balance while pulling on the wrapper, slipped and fell, suffering broken bones above the left ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing the chuck in a lathe when the chuck clamped and crushed the employee's fingers, resulting in amputations of the left third and fourth fingertips.

An employee was changing a work piece on the lathe using a pin piece. While screwing in the punch pin, the employee was caught in the machine resulting in a fractured arm and shoulder, fractured ribs, and a collapsed artery requiring hospitalization.
An employee operating a forklift struck a rack and sustained a foot injury.

An employee was operating a table saw. The employee hit the stop button and reached toward the machine to clear out some saw dust and debris. The blade had not stopped moving at the time and partially amputated the employee's right thumb.
An employee contacted a chain on the automatic nailing machine and it pulled his left middle finger into the sprocket amputating the fingertip.
An employee was at a bridge construction project, cleaning up with a shovel. As he was working behind an aerial lift, it backed up and ran over his foot, then his right leg. His leg was crushed.
An employee was inspecting beef on the kill floor when a cattle carcass rolled off an open switch and struck the employee from behind, fracturing the left tibia.

An employee was trying to hook up a dolly to a trailer and slipped while the dolly was moving. The employee's hand was then caught between the dolly and trailer, crushing the left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was riding in the cargo bed area of an ATV while completing an exercise when she fell off the ATV and hit her head on the pavement. She was hospitalized with a fracture at the temporal lobe and hemorrhage of the frontal lobe.

A forklift operator was loading chicken products onto a crane going to a vessel's freezer area when he struck an employee who was on the dry dock. The forklift's fork punctured the injured employee's right calf and pinned the employee between the forklift and a wood pier piling on the dock.
An employee was exiting the building and walking to the parking lot when someone off the premises shot the employee. The employee sustained a bullet wound to the face/neck and was hospitalized.

An employee was rigging up equipment before moving it. When he started to raise the load, the chain tightened around his left hand, resulting in a crushing injury and partial amputation of the left little finger.
On August 29, 2019, an employee was hitching a trailer when the employee's finger was pinched and amputated in the trailer dolly.

An employee was trying to free a screw that was clogged with rice hulls. The employee shut off the power to the screw and went to pull on the belt that was connected to the pulley that ran the screw. While the employee was pulling on the belt, the screw became free. The stored energy from the bound screw caused the belt and pulley to rotate while the employee was holding the belt. The employee's left index finger entered the pinch point of the belt and pulley, amputating the left fingertip above the nail cuticle.

An employee conducted a claims adjustment inspection on the roof of a 10-foot shed and was attempting to descend a ladder from the roof when the employee slipped off the ladder and fell 10 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken shoulder, three broken ribs, punctured lungs, a pulmonary embolism, and cracked thoracic vertebrae.
An employee was working outside to prepare for a hurricane. He felt ill and began vomiting and was hospitalized. He sustained a head contusion and possible heat-related illness.
An employee on a ladder twisted and aggravated a hernia.
An employee was changing an auger on a digger truck when two of his fingers were amputated.
An employee was using a portable band saw to cut threaded rod when the saw slipped and cut his left index finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
On August 29, 2019, an automotive lift fell on an employee, breaking his pelvis and ankle.
An employee was mixing mortar in a plastic bucket using a mixing drill. The mixer caught the employee's left glove, amputating the employee's left little finger to the nail.

An employee was installing an 11- by 2-foot steel plate onto the inside of a barge when the plate slipped and crushed two fingers on the employee's right hand, resulting in the amputation of the third and fourth fingers.
Two employees were assembling the mold plates and flipped them over. An employee then picked up a plate and it fell smashing the employee's right index finger.
An employee was on an extension ladder working on a television cable line when the cable broke, causing him to lose his balance and fall approximately 14 feet to the ground. His wrist was fractured.
An employee fell off a 4-foot ladder to the ground and broke his leg.
An employee tripped on another employee's feet. She fell and hit her head, suffering a detached retina. She was hospitalized.
After delivering mail, an employee felt unwell and was hospitalized for possible heat stress.
On 8/30/2019, at approximately 11:20 AM, an employee was changing lightbulbs from a ladder when he fell 8 feet to the ground. He suffered a head laceration and concussion, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking across a concrete parking lot. The employee tripped on a parking space curb, fell, and struck his face on the concrete, suffering a contusion and a broken nose. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to load pallets onto a semi truck. While the pallet load was off the semi, the employee got off the forklift to label it. The forklift moved forward, pinning the employee against the load and breaking his pelvis.

An employee was investigating an issue with a clean in place (CIP) system that cleans pipes. He removed the strainer and disconnected the pump. The pump had pressure behind it and hot water/caustic cleaning chemical burned him on his upper and lower back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was preparing to load a delivery truck at a client's site. The employee was attempting to position a dock plate at a loading dock when the flap at the end of the dock plate became stuck. When the employee tried to free the flap, it sprung and came down on his finger, resulting in a right index finger amputation.

A Pepsi employee was standing in the doorway of a restaurant. The door was partially opened and caught the employee's right index fingertip against the doorjamb. Part of the fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was attempting to roll a trailer door when his foot slipped off the rear trailer bumper  while he was still holding onto the door strap. The door then came down and crushed his left hand, resulting in an amputation of his left pinky fingertip.
An employee was working on a conveyor belt. His right hand was pinched between a transfer plate and a flight; the tip of his ring finger was amputated.
On 8/30/19, an employee tripped over a box and landed on her kneecap. She was hospitalized and had surgery for a broken kneecap.

An employee was trying to relieve the tension on a bailer wire channel.  His hand was on the wire/channel when he turned the machine on. The wire then penetrated his left palm and came out the side of his wrist/forearm.
An employee was hooking up a dolly to a lead trailer when his index finger was caught between the pintle hook and the dolly.  This resulted an index fingertip amputation before the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw when the saw cut the side and back portion of his left thumb. He received lacerations and an avulsion to his left thumb.
An employee was changing out a forklift's propane tank. The forklift moved and struck the employee, breaking the employee's fibula.

Employees went to a site for a water leak and had to remove the floor access hatch. While doing so, the door came off its hinge. They were attempting to reposition the hatch when the injured employee placed his fingers under the hatch to move it. The hatch then shifted on the broken hinge and dropped on his finger, resulting in the partial amputation of his left middle fingertip (no bone loss).

On August 30, 2019, four employees were working from the top of a commercial building, removing the old roof and installing a new roof. One of them fell through a flush-mounted fiberglass skylight, landing on the concrete floor about 12 feet below. He suffered major head trauma and was hospitalized. Fall protection was being worn, but the safety lanyard was not tied off, at the time of the incident.

An employee was driving a forklift while carrying a pallet. A second forklift driver was directly behind the first forklift traveling in the same direction. The pallet blocked the safety sensor on the first forklift, causing it to suddenly stop. The second forklift then hit the first one and the employee on the first forklift suffered two broken legs. One of the leg fractures was a compound fracture.
At 10:40 a.m. on August 30, 2019, a cook foreman was peeling potatoes with an electrical vegetable chopper. The chopper partially amputated the employee's right thumb.

An employee was tapping the crucible of a bath when the crucible became full. The employee removed the looking glass and molten bath flowed out, contacting the employee. The employee received second degree burns to the arm and abdomen, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading skids on a trailer with a forklift. The trailer truck moved away from the dock door and the forklift fell 4 feet to the ground. The employee suffered back and neck injuries and a concussion.
At 11:00 a.m. on August 30, 2019, an employee was clearing a lit burn pit. An explosion caused second-degree burns to both his arms and first-degree burns to his face and side. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the transfer system located at the back of a building. His hand was on a pipe when the sliding gate to the transfer system closed back to its original position, resulting in the amputation of all five left-hand fingers (knuckles and up). The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee fell down a hill while walking with clients, hitting the ground and suffering impact injuries.

An employee was descending a ladder when his hand was caught in a shackle. He received a laceration to the right palm, near amputation to the right ring finger, and a fracture/dislocation of the right middle finger.
An employee was using a handheld circular saw to trim a fiberglass bathtub. The saw kicked back and fell onto the employee's right foot, resulting in a partial amputation of his right big toe.

An employee climbed a stack of precast concrete products to place support pads onto the top edge of the top product. After placing the pads, he lost his grip and fell approximately 6' 8" from the stack onto the ground below, breaking his left femur.
On 8/31/19, an employee had tied a chain to a tree limb and attempted to pull it with a truck.  The limb as caught in the crotch of the tree and landed on the employee's leg, fracturing it.

At about 3:30 p.m. on August 31, 2019, an employee fell while walking and was found with a laceration above the left eyebrow, a mild facial fracture, a maxillary sinus fracture, and a subarachnoid fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 31, 2019, an employee was guiding a roll of film into a pizza sauce machine that was being lowered with an overhead hoist when the employee's hand was caught between the film roll shaft and the cradle of the pizza sauce machine. The employee pulled her hand back and received an amputation of the right index fingertip. The unbalanced film roll struck her on the right side of her face between the nose and cheek, causing blunt trauma to the face. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a semi-truck engine when his right arm caught on fire, sustaining second or third degree burns.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it crashed into a pole, crushing his foot.

An employee was standing behind a saw picking up wood as it was being cut when a piece of wood kicked back and struck him. The piece of wood impaled his back and came out of his lower body. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell from a small ladder while performing a cleaning operation. The employee did not lose consciousness and was hospitalized.

On 8/31/2019, an Ovations employee was walking out of a storage trailer/warehouse when he stepped off of the edge of the trailer and fell, hitting his lower back on metal flooring. He experienced pain and could not move the lower part of his body.
An employee was attempting to de-escalate a psych/combative patient when the employee tripped over a rover and fell to the ground, striking the left hip and fracturing the left foot.
An employee was cutting a steam pipe. The pipe rolled off the stand and hit the employee. The employee suffered injuries to the right femur and left-side ribs.

An employee was removing excess foam by the second guide in a conveyor when the employee's left ring fingertip was caught between a machinery/door panel and the conveyor line, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was inspecting under the hood of a fire truck's engine compartment when the hood shut on the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation.

Two employees were working in the store behind the counter when a car crashed through the front of the store and hit both employees. The employees were both hospitalized. One employee sustained fractured cervical vertebrae and facial lacerations requiring stitches. The second employee sustained a broken clavicle and a broken nose.

An employee was driving an electric cargo tractor back to his station. The tractor was pulling an empty luggage cart. While taking a sharp right turn, the employee was ejected from the tractor and sustained a fracture to the lower left leg.
An employee was walking back to her work station from a break. She slipped on a puddle of oily water and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.
An employee lost consciousness due to exposure to dry ice vapors while moving plasma to a dry ice freezer. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a plasma cutter wand cable and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury.
An employee was in a scissor lift when his little finger was caught and injured. The finger was medically amputated.
An employee was putting fries into a deep fat fryer when the fryer boiled over. Hot grease splashed the employee's face and hands, burning them.

An employee was attempting to repair or diagnose an issue with the raise valve on a combine header at a customer's farm. A hydraulic line broke loose, injecting hydraulic fluid into the employee's left index finger and fracturing the finger, requiring hospitalization.
While an employee was emptying a mixer, it activated and fractured his arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping another employee lower a platform on the side of a pump. A pivotal latch caused the amputation of the first joint of his left little finger.

A piece of quartz countertop material was stored on an A-frame metal storage stand that was 9 3/4 inches off the floor, with wheels on one end and permanent legs on the opposite end. The material slipped off the edge of the stand onto an employee's right foot, breaking two toes. The employee was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was working to pull out drip lines by hand from the ground. While re-winding the line into the tape roller (an auxiliary tractor attachment), the injured employee asked the tractor driver to stop. Then due to a lack of slack, he asked the driver to pull forward. When the tractor pulled forward, the employee was pulled into the roller and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was tasked with palletizing debris from a store project. He was using a saw when the saw cut into a finger on his left hand.
During a joint operation, a marine interdiction agent and a border patrol agent suffered smoke inhalation due to a boat fire.
An employee was operating a golf cart. While making a turn, the golf cart rolled over onto the employee's leg. He sustained lacerations and a broken lower left leg.
An employee came in contact with process fluid at a petroleum refinery. The employee suffered burns to the right arm and torso and was hospitalized.
While walking to the time clock, an employee slipped and fell to the ground and sustained injury to the lower extremities.
Five employees were exposed to ammonia released while refrigeration pipes were being welded. One employee (working for National Beef) was hospitalized.
An employee was in training, operating a stand-up pallet lift, when his left foot was caught in the designated pathway railings. The employee sustained torn muscles and ligaments.

An employee was assisting other workers in moving a patient from a bariatric bed to an exam table using a lifting device. Two employees were pushing the patient and two were pulling. While pushing the patient, the injured employee felt pain in her lower back, radiating up to her shoulder blades. The employee was hospitalized with a pelvic injury.
An employee was baling hops. The employee shook the bin and a drive chain amputated the employee's left little fingertip.
An employee was lifting a log onto a wood chipper when it fell from the wood chipper, struck, and amputated his right middle fingertip.

An employee was welding and grinding on a 14-inch, 40-foot pipe resting on two sawhorses. As employees adjusted the pipe, it fell off the sawhorses and struck the employee doing the welding, who suffered a broken right thigh bone, a broken left ankle, and an amputated fingertip on the right hand.
On September 3, 2019, an employee tripped and fell backwards onto a 2-by-4 wooden stake that projected 20 inches from the ground. The employee suffered two broken ribs and a bruised spleen.
An employee was running a trim press on a forging line. His body started cramping and his supervisor took him to the break room to cool off. He later went to the hospital for dehydration.
An employee was water blasting onboard an aircraft carrier when the water lacerated her right calf.
An employee was struck by a rolling 600-pound cylinder, suffering a broken hand and ankle.

A driver was turning an articulating haul truck at the top of a hill at a reservoir under construction. The left tire came off the roadway, and the haul truck rolled over. The driver was taken to the hospital with a bruised back and bruised left ribs, a cervical strain, chest contusions, and a head hematoma.
An employee was conducting a training scenario with pepper spray and a baton. The employee went to get up from his knees, but fell back and rolled on his ankle breaking it in two places.
After operating a lawn mower for approximately 6-7 hours intermittently, an employee fainted while resting outside between the work truck and a trailer. He was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
An employee was placing a steel to block up a conveyor. The conveyor was being raised with a chain fall. It shifted and pinched the employee's left index fingertip, causing an amputation.

An employee was on a ladder preparing to do interior framing work in the garage of a single-family home under construction. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor and was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was handing material to another employee when his finger was caught between the material and a hole cover. His right little finger was amputated.
An employee was moving pre-finished door products into position for assembly when his right middle fingertip was caught and amputated between finished products.
An employee suffered a heat related illness on September 3, 2019, while setting up tents in a stadium.

An employee pulled a van forward, then got out of the van to check the air pressure. As he was getting the tire gauge, the van started rolling backwards and he was pinned between the van and a pickup truck. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.
An employee was moving a pipe dolly to a staged piping area. An extended boom forklift's right front tire struck the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis and a broken left femur.
An employee fell from a ladder while working on the tailgate of a dump truck. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was rolling a 600-pound spool of rubber into position when the spool shifted and the employee's left pinky finger was caught between the spool and an I-beam causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a small stepladder, getting a nut and bolt needed to fasten a steel tool storage cabinet's roof to its frame. A weight shift caused his right arm twist, and his shoulder was dislocated.
An employee was clearing a plugged roller mill. The employee's hand was caught in the mill; two of the employee's fingers were severely injured and two were amputated.
An employee was utilizing a ride-on pallet jack. While making a turn, the pallet jack overturned, throwing the employee to the floor and resulting in a fractured left femur.
While walking through the injection molding department, an employee stepped over a skid, got a foot tangled in some banding, and fell on the concrete floor resulting in a broken left hip.

An employee was working with an engineer to complete layout for a project on a state roadway. While on the shoulder of the road the employee was struck by a motor vehicle and sustained a compound fracture of the tibia/fibula.

An employee was standing outside his truck at a loading dock. Another truck's trailer struck the employee as it backed up to the dock, causing fractures and open wounds to both the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a hoist to change a mold. The hoist pivoted and the employee's finger was caught in a pinch point in the hoist. The left middle fingertip was crushed.

An employee was picking up a 10-inch, 230-pound piece of C-channel, using a 7.5-ton overhead bridge crane. The C-channel slipped off the clamping device and fell approximately 7 feet onto the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the right leg.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift, delivering a gaylord container of scrap metal to a recycling dumpster. The employee's left foot and leg were crushed between the forklift and a bollard that protects a concrete wall. This resulted in amputation of the leg below the knee.

While a crew was completing a casing connection, which involves pieces of pipe being torqued together, an employee's fingers were caught in the top drive wheel. The employee's right middle finger was amputated, and the index and ring fingers were lacerated.
An employee was dumping a 4-yard dumpster with a truck. The dumpster released and jumped back at the employee, breaking his rib and causing him to suffer a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.

A driver was setting up hoses for fuel delivery. He had connected the vapor line and was walking to set up the next line when he tripped over the lines and fell toward the curb. He landed on his arm, breaking it in three places. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A driver was unstrapping a load when a 541-pound truss fell on him. He suffered a neck injury and a broken back.
An employee slipped and fell in the parking lot while preparing to make a delivery. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was cut while using a box cutter and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading concrete slabs into a dumpster which was attached to a telehandler. The telehandler went into reverse and ran over the employee. The injured employee sustained a fractured pelvis, fractured right fibula, and two broken bones on the left foot.

Employees were conducting roofing work on a flat roof. Debris was being placed into a dumpster via a chute. An employee entered the dumpster to even out the pile of debris. The employee fell out of the dumpster and landed on the concrete pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a broken vertebra and abrasions to the head, hands and back.
An employee was operating a saw when it deeply lacerated his left ring finger.
As a field technician was using his hands to check for air leaks, a machine caused amputations to three fingertips on the employee's left hand.
An employee was bleeding liquid from a vapor line. The employee was exposed to anhydrous ammonia from the waist up, suffering chemical burns and an inhalation injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move a pallet of boxes and was struck by a reversing forklift. The employee sustained a crushed right foot that resulted in amputation of three toes, a right ankle fracture, and a torn meniscus in the right knee.
A welder was working from scaffolding approximately 12 feet high when a scaffolding plank broke. The employee fell and sustained fractures to the hip and tailbone resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a gasoline-powered push mower when the blade amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.

A truck driver was delivering 30-inch PVC pipe. While the pipe was being unloaded from the rear of the truck and the driver was standing nearby, a pipe came out of the cradle in the front of the truck and fell off the truck. It hit the driver's left leg resulting in surgical amputation. The driver was hospitalized.
While walking out of an office an employee tripped over a chair leg, fell to the floor, and broke their right hip.
An employee was heating butter in a pan on a stove. When the butter burned, the employee placed the pan in the sink and poured water on it. The oil spattered and burned her face and arms.
An employee was taking the trash out before the end of her shift. While putting the trash in the container the employee slipped and fell on the floor fracturing a hip.
An employee was climbing down a ladder he had been working from. He fell to the ground about 7 or 8 feet below, suffering a compression fracture to the spine.
An employee was spraying an adhesive for insulation. The atmosphere ignited and the employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to the face, neck, arms, and hands.
An employee was picking up trash at a job site and had been working since 12:00 PM. The employee passed out and was hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee had been at work for approximately 2 hours. He was operating a weld plate press machine when he experienced heat stress symptoms and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on the floor near a cart when a forklift hit the cart and the cart hit the employee. The employee was hospitalized with pelvic fractures.
An employee's hand was inside a derrick girder when his hand was struck and fractured by the rig's top drive.
An employee suffered a cut finger while cleaning painting equipment.
An employee was power washing a building while on a 12-foot section of ladder taken from a fiberglass extension ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained broken ribs.

An employee was helping a forklift operator from the ground when the forks became stuck under material. They then recoiled and struck the employee in the throat, bruising it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell in the parking lot while walking to her vehicle and sustained a fractured right ankle.

An employee was using a pallet jack to unload a pallet of water from a trailer. His left ankle was pinned between the pallet jack and the pallet; he suffered a broken left ankle and a head laceration.
While moving a long fork out of the equipment parking area, an employee's right lower leg was caught and fractured between the long fork and a parked forklift.
An employee was using a stepladder to retrieve items from a top shelf. The employee fell off the ladder, suffering a broken tibia.
While operating a pump, an employee's left thumb tip was amputated.

In the raw meat department, an employee stepped up onto a machine's lift platform that was less than 3 feet high. The employee slipped off the platform and fell onto his back. The employee sustained broken rib(s) and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the yard when he tripped and fell to the ground, landing on and bruising his knee.

An employee was using an oxygen acetylene torch when its flame went out. He turned off the oxygen supply to the torch. The flame then returned and the torch's hose separated, causing a large flame that caused second-degree burns to his arms and abdomen. He was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was working on a take-up roller when he fell to the floor and sustained a compound fracture to the left fibula and two broken fingers on the left hand.
An employee was operating a press brake when it caught his left middle finger, amputating it.
An employee's hand was caught in a door jamb. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
A lineman performing repairs on an overhead electrical line came into contact with the electrical line. The lineman was hospitalized for flash burn injuries.
An employee was gathering carts in the storage area, tripped over pallet, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip and a fractured wrist.
An employee was removing jammed cardboard from a box-making machine. The machine lacerated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was operating a press brake when his hand slipped into the jaw resulting in fractures to four fingers.
An employee was loading a coil roll of steel into a press. The coil roll fell and pinned the employee against the press. The employee suffered broken ribs and internal bleeding and was hospitalized.
A piece of heavy equipment backed up over an employee, who suffered a broken pelvic bone, broken ribs (in the back), and a ruptured bladder.
A rattlesnake bit an employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a milking parlor when he slipped and fell on a floor that was damp with water. After a couple of hours, he began to suffer a headache and head injury symptoms. He was hospitalized.

An employee had just filled a water tank in a plant. After he removed the hose, the employee used his left middle finger to check the seal on the tank. As he was removing his finger from the tank and simultaneously stepping down from the work platform, he ring was caught in the tank and the left middle fingertip was amputated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a CNC machine when it crushed the tip of the employee's left index finger.
While conducting landscaping, an employee was bitten by an insect. The employee sustained an infection.
While an employee was preparing a coupler for installation on a pipeline, residual natural gas flared and caught fire. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the face and arms.

A flat bar was being cut on an automatic horizontal bandsaw. A piece of steel tubing was being used to guide the parts being cut into a bin. The tubing moved and the rotating sawblade caught an employee's glove. His left index finger was partially amputated.
An employee fell while exiting her vehicle and broke her hip.
An employee sustained blisters on the bottom of his feet after working on strip casting equipment that was hot.

An employee moved a forging from the layout table to the centering machine using an overhead crane. The employee removed the crane s hook from the forging and then moved the crane away from the area. As the crane was moving away, the hook got caught on the centering machine. The hook came under tension and then let loose, striking the employee on the right side of his head. The employee sustained a fractured orbital bone and eye damage.
An employee was cutting a pipe with a grinder. The pipe started to slip and the employee tried to catch the pipe. The grinder cut a tendon and artery in the employee's arm.

An employee had been at a customer's home doing warranty work on a shed. After returning to the shop, the employee almost passed out and felt numbness/tingling in one arm. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was operating a hand grinder. When the employee stood up to respond to another employee, the cord/plug of the hand grinder struck him in the neck. The employee was hospitalized and received stitches in the neck area.

An employee was on an elevated walkway. When the employee opened a manway cover, wort boiled over from a brewery kettle, hitting the employee on the chest and abdomen. The employee suffered first-degree burns on the chest and abdomen, second-degree burns on the left arm, and third-degree burns on the abdomen.
An employee stopped at a restaurant after completing his mail route. He started cramping and passed out. The employee was hospitalized for a heat-related injury.

An employee had a spool of wire on a spooling machine. The spool was wrapped with plastic wrap and the employee was taping it as it was spinning. While holding the tape with his left hand, he went to cut the tape but it didn't break off. The machine then pulled the employee, flipped him over the machine, and wrapped his arm around the machine. The employee sustained multiple fractures to their arm.
An employee working in the yard started feeling weak and was cramping. He was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee was using a shovel while working on an irrigation system. The employee suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee was installing foundation repair equipment when a pipe slipped and struck the employee on the head and left hand. The employee suffered a broken left hand.

An employee was standing at the end of a wrapper line monitoring operating conditions. The employee's left index finger came in contact with a wrapper cutting knife, resulting in amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was maneuvering a hospital bed into an elevator when it ran over and injured his left foot.
An employee was lifting the upper part of a galvanizing basket guard when the employee's finger was pinched between the guard and hard surface, crushing/amputating the fingertip.
While using a chemical to clean equipment, an employee suffered a chemical burn to the elbow.
An employee had been working at an asphalt plant. The employee left work around 4:00 PM, and started feeling ill. Later that night, the employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was operating controls to steer and level a trailer. A tire on the trailer made contact with the curb and exploded with a loud pop. The employee sustained ringing in the ear and reduced hearing.

An employee was cleaning paint residue off a protective cover of a machine. The employee was scraping with his right hand when his left hand was caught in a moving chain. The left index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
On September 05, 2019, an employee was clearing out a creamer filling machine when the chain activated, catching and causing an amputation injury to their right index finger.

An employee was descending down the side of a building in a boatswain chair. A kink in the rope got caught in the descending device, causing him to lose balance. He began swinging around and hit his ankle on a protruding concrete balcony. He sustained a compound fracture above the left ankle requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was threading pipe on a machine with two separate clamps, one outside and one inside. The inner clamp closed on the employee's right little finger, partially amputating it.
While transferring a patient from a stretcher to a bed, an employee sustained a herniated disc in her back.
An employee was riding a lawn mower when he ran over tree roots and fell off the mower. The mower blade then lacerated his left arm.

An employee was adjusting a tarp on the trailer of his tractor/trailer combination. He was standing on a catwalk, preparing to exit the fixed ladder, when his foot slipped and he fell approximately 8 feet to the gravel lot surface. He sustained a fractured wrist, fractured ribs, and a cracked pelvis.
An employee was training on swabbing a bottle in a bottle forming machine when two of their fingertips were amputated by the machine.
While clearing trees for an install project, an employee was struck on the head by a falling tree branch and sustained a head injury.

An employee was removing a stay rod nut using a hydraulic pump. He was holding the torque tool with his right hand while removing the nut with his left hand. The hydraulic pump kicked on without the operation control being pressed and pinched his right middle finger between the stay rod and the grease pan. The employee s right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee got off a forklift. It rolled forward and its wheel struck the employee's right foot, causing fractures.
An employee was hospitalized after he fainted in a sugar cane field due to heat stress.
An employee tripped and fell, breaking his left ankle.
An employee had been cutting wood on a saw machine. While removing debris, the saw blade caused a severe laceration to the employee's wrist.
An employee's safety vest became entangled with a trenching machine's blade, and the blade lacerated the employee's back.
Two laboratory employees were re-stocking chemicals on shelves. While moving a 4-liter glass bottle of acetonitrile the bottle dropped and broke, splashing them with acetonitrile.
An employee was operating a propane-powered forklift, started feeling dizzy, and was hospitalized for exposure to carbon monoxide.
Employees were pulling slips while running drill pipe in a well bore. An employee suffered a hernia.

An employee had just finished a job assignment and went to assist a co-worker. In order to assist the co-worker with the job task, the employee's machine needed a different setup. While changing the setup of the mechanical machine press, the employee's hand was caught in the machine, resulting in a finger amputation.
While observing work outside, an employee suffered from heat exhaustion.
An employee tripped on a lower shelf in a supply room and fell, suffering a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was outside of the store, at the loading dock, receiving a shipment of shopping carts. The carts were packaged on a pallet, handle side down. When the carts were separated, they shifted and pushed the employee off the loading dock. He landed on his left side, striking his shoulder, head, and hip.

An employee driving a pallet jack entered the rail dock through the overhead door from the expansion dock. He began traveling east on the rail dock and the pallet jack ran into a barrier pole that protects a door on the rail dock. His foot was caught between the pallet jack and the barrier pole. He sustained a crushing injury to the left foot resulting in amputations to the tips of two toes. He was wearing safety toe boots at the time.
An employee was cutting blocks of fish on a bandsaw when the employee's left index finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee pulled into a driveway to deliver parcels that would not fit into a mailbox. The employee got out of their vehicle to retrieve parcels out of the back. As her back was turned, a dog came from behind and bit her right forearm and hand, removing a section of skin from the forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained an amputation to the left index finger while using a band saw.
An employee was on a bridge carrying wood when he stepped on unsecured metal decking and fell approximately 30 feet to the ground below, striking his head.

An employee was setting the anchor for an ice-boom onboard a derrick boat. The employee cut a line that was holding the anchor chain and was then struck by a rigging chain. The employee sustained fractures to both bones in the lower right leg and a shoulder injury from falling overboard.
An employee was hospitalized with dehydration after experiencing heat cramps.

An employee was standing next to a roller bed waiting for the next joist to come down. He reached to stop the joist and pull it over to him so he could tack the two ends. When he grabbed the end bar, it fell between two pieces of angle. The employee's left pinky finger was pinched between the two angles resulting in a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was traveling down an aisle while operating a stand-up forklift when his lower left leg was caught between the forklift and racking. He sustained a laceration.
While using a tire machine, an employee's left middle finger was amputated by the coupler and hydraulic mounting post.
An employee was putting bottles on a pallet. A bottle broke, lacerating his left wrist.
An employee was installing a metal panel when his finger was pinched between the housing unit and a 2x4 wooden board, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing food and filling hoppers with food. He opened an outdoor food hopper to add feed and was bitten on the left hand by a rattlesnake that was in the hopper, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was stepping off a bundle of trusses onto the bed of a flatbed trailer. He fell off the flatbed trailer and struck the ground with his shoulder and head. The employee passed out from head trauma and was hospitalized.

After lining up a cable roller stand with floor anchor holes, an employee was cleaning dirt out of a floor anchor hole. While doing this, another employee moved the cable roller stand to line up a different bolt hole and the injured employee's finger was pinched in a hole. The injured employee sustained a partial amputation and avulsion of the right index fingertip.
An employee installing insulation on the top of a treater shack fell approximately 8 feet from the top of the treater shack to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and neck vertebrae.

An employee was operating a cherry picker to place an appliance on a shelf. The employee fell from the cherry picker to the concrete floor of the warehouse and sustained a head injury, fractured collar bone, and a fractured shoulder.
A crew was using a pump to circulate fluids to a tank when there was a release from a well and a flash fire occurred. Two employees suffered burns to the face and body, requiring hospitalization.

On September 6, 2019, an employee had finished installing gutters on a two-story residential home, when he began to feel ill. After arriving back at the warehouse, the employee began cramping up and was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

An employee was pushing an engine block from one conveyor belt to another. The employee's left middle finger got caught in the rubber grate of the pallet the engine block was on; the tip was amputated.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while performing an X-ray of a weld inside a new tank construction at a rural site.
An employee was capping bins while working from a ladder. The employee fell backwards off the ladder and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
An employee was operating a grinding machine (for tire manufacturing). The employee's hand was caught between rims on the machine, suffering finger amputation injuries.

During unloading of a commercial water heater from a delivery truck, an employee's left index finger was pinched between a fork on the unloading vehicle and the top edge of the water heater. The left index finger was lacerated approximately 1 inch from the tip. A portion of the left index finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was using a band saw to cut neck bones when the blade caused an amputation to their right middle fingertip.
While working on the warehouse floor, an employee was struck by a forklift and sustained a fractured right leg.

At 7:27 AM, two maintenance workers were working in an aerial lift that was 27 feet off of ground. They were servicing an overhead crane. Another overhead crane ran into the aerial lift, tipping it over. The two maintenance workers were hospitalized with fractures to their backs and other injuries.

An employee was travelling down a public road in a telehandler. When the employee pulled to the side of the paved road to allow vehicles to pass, the tires on one side went off the pavement and the telehandler rolled over. The employee sustained an amputated foot, broken legs, a broken pelvis, and a punctured lung.

An employee was testing the effectiveness of repairs to an extendable conveyor and was caught between the extendable conveyor and the front of a trailer when the extendable conveyor was activated. The employee sustained a swollen arm with internal bleeding.
An employee tripped over bins that parts were being sorted into and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was scanning placards on the city dock. A tug that was pulling three containers of mail came around to unload and the end of a container struck the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a cart full of garments through a doorway. The employee then transitioned to the front of the cart to continue pulling it. As the walkway began to slope downwards, the cart caught the employee s leg against a pallet of quick-dry cement. The employee was hospitalized with a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was pulling material with a pallet jack when she slipped and fell backwards, sustaining a broken right wrist and hip.

On 9/06/2019, the injured employee was helping put a patient to bed with the help of two additional employees. The injured employee was knocked down by a patient, fell to the floor, and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was using a digging bar to break rock that was preventing a trench box from fitting into an excavation. The tool caused a compound fracture to the employee's ring finger.

While an employee was installing pipe casing, a shackle moved down and forwards, which caught the employee's middle finger on his gloved left hand. The employee sustained an amputation to the fingertip above the first knuckle.
An employee was welding a tension rod on the rear axle of a truck when the seal came loose and the tension cap struck the employee on the chest causing a laceration.
An employee was servicing trash containers in a residential neighborhood and experienced weakness in his legs. He was hospitalized with a heat illness.
An employee had been helping with plumbing work at a jobsite. The employee experienced cramping and was hospitalized with dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An employee was attempting to remove a vehicle seat from a conveyor transport pallet. The employee's right hand and glove were caught under the seat latching lever and they suffered an amputation to their right index finger.
An employee was clearing a jam when a cylinder activated and fractured their left ring finger.
An employee was washing the oven room. When she turned on a heated water hose, her left leg was sprayed with 180-degree water causing second and third degree burns.
An employee had been working and later experienced severe cramping. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was fixing the layer wind of a covered cable on a wooden reel. The employee used his left hand to guide the cable onto the reel. The machine was activated while the employee's finger was under the cable that was under tension. The employee sustained a left middle finger amputation.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while getting down from a work vehicle. The employee sustained two broken ribs and a ruptured spleen.

On September 6, 2019, an employee was working as a keeper helper on the cast floor at the blast furnaces. This involved observing the filling of torpedo ladles, maintaining the iron run, and taking temperature and iron samples. After experiencing cramping, the employee was hospitalized with heat related illness.

An employee was guiding a chiller head as it was being hoisted by a chain hoist. A strap that was used to hang the chain hoist snapped, causing the chain hoist and the chiller head to fall. As it was falling the chiller head hit a section of steam piping and veered off towards the employee, landing on the bridge of his right foot. Four metatarsals were each fractured in two places, requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor in the bathroom, suffering bruising to the left hip.

An employee was opening the trailer doors. The employee opened the right-side door. Then the employee opened the left side door, and product fell out, causing a gash on their head. The employee then fell and fractured a leg.

An employee was taking product from a drum and placing it on a chute that leads to the rework area. The employee's right hand made contact with a conveyor adjacent to the chute and became caught between the conveyor belt and the conveyor frame. The employee sustained the amputation of the right pinky fingertip.
An employee was on his route delivering mail when he lost consciousness due to the heat and fell, striking his head on a mailbox. He was hospitalized.
An employee was dressing chickens and got their arm caught in the machine resulting in a open fracture to the arm requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell on flat ground and his left leg was run over by a telescoping forklift. He was hospitalized.

A third-party truck driver was getting ready to back up a semi-trailer as an employee came into the loading dock area. The employee was pinned between the semi-trailer and the dock plate. The employee sustained internal injuries and was hospitalized.

On September 7, 2019, an employee was walking out of the lobby when he slipped on a rubber mat and fell to the floor. He hit his head, causing a deep laceration, and fractured his hip, requiring surgery.

An employee was grinding the end of a 30-inch diameter, 40-foot long spiral steel pipe. The pipe was spinning and was set on fixed rotating wheels. The employee was in line with the V-roller line which brings pipe to the rotation station. The V-roller line engaged, sending a pipe in a south to north track. The employee was caught between the moving pipe and the pipe that was on the rotating wheels. The employee was hospitalized for an abrasion.

Four employee were pouring a 320" copper stock.  A hose failed which caused the ram of the casting unit to drop during the pouring process. The falling of this ram, which was controlled by the caster, allowed molten copper to come in contact with steam inside the pit that is filled with water. This caused a violent reaction/explosion. All four employees received burns to their arms, body, and face when they were sprayed with molten copper.
On September 7, 2019, an employee was troubleshooting a conveyor belt when the conveyor belt started up, catching and injuring the employee's right hand between the drive and the belt.
An employee was positioning himself as a safety guide or wing walker to guide a departing aircraft and was struck by a van near the vehicle service road. The employee was hospitalized.

A technician was in training, performing a check on the wheel abrator. He opened the door on the enclosed equipment to visually inspect and noticed debris at the bottom of the machine. He went to clean out the debris and his left middle and ring fingers made contact with the rotary blades resulting in amputation of the fingers and hospitalization.
While performing maintenance on the tire shine machine, an employee sustained amputation of their left ring fingertip.
An employee was hooking up a water hose. When he lifted his head, his head struck the window sill and he was hospitalized with a concussion.

An employee had been conducting work on a scaffold. While descending on the outside of the scaffold, the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee sustained cuts to the face and a knee injury.

An employee was putting tires onto storage racks. The employee slipped and grabbed a rack, trying to prevent a fall. His left pinky finger was caught by the rack and amputated to the first knuckle when he fell approximately six feet.
An employee pulled the pin of a steel dumpster door. The door then swung open and struck the employee in the head causing a head injury.

While observing two other maintenance employees troubleshoot a skinning machine, the injured employee's hand was caught between the tooth rollers of the skinning machine. The injured employee sustained the amputation of four digits.
An employee was checking the belts on a pumping unit. The unit came on, catching his thumb. The employee sustained the partial amputation of his left thumb.
While coming out of a room, an employee slipped and fell sustaining torn knee muscles.

An employee loading boxes into a case packer machine lost their footing. Upon slipping, the employee's thumb contacted a part of the machine causing a partial de-gloving of the right thumb that required hospitalization.
An employee was working as a floor hand in support of an oilfield operation. He became ill from heat stress and was hospitalized.

Two employees were rigging up centrifugal equipment. One employee was on the solids control equipment stand when it gave way, causing him to fall and sustain three fractured ribs and a punctured left lung. The other employee was on the ground near the stand when it collapsed, resulting in a fracture to his lower left leg.
An employee working around the grain bunker was bitten by a snake.
A pedestrian door closed on an employee's finger resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip.

An employee was walking across the venue when she tripped on a crack/uneven area of pavement and fell to the concrete surface. She hit her head on the ground and sustained injuries including a contusion/laceration to the forehead above the right eye, shoulder and upper arm pain on the right side, and numbness of the left arm. She was hospitalized and required neck surgery.

The injured employee was guiding the operator of a forklift which was lifting a 750-lbs. steel roll. As the forklift was backing out with the load, the steel roll slipped out of the slings and landed on the injured employee's foot. The composite toe cap in the boot clamped down crushing the employee's foot and resulting in toe amputations.
An employee was preparing to put out lane closure signs and equipment. He fell from a temporary platform and the arrow board trailer rolled over his left leg. He sustained a fractured left ankle.
An employee was sorting cattle. A cow's horn got stuck in the pen gate; when she shook her head to free it, the horn punctured the employee's eye.

An employee was lifting a 5-gallon bucket of a fermentation enzyme named SZM XT-20+. The bucket tipped and the employee was splashed in the face and upper body by the chemical. The employee was hospitalized with decreased lung capacity due to an allergic reaction.

An employee was attempting to dislodge a blockage from the transfer line. The steam was shut off, but pressure remained in the line. When the blockage was dislodged, hot resin (200 degrees Celsius) sprayed down into the drum and onto the employee's face and neck. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the face and neck.

An employee was walking from the pack floor to the stuff floor to run a hose through a location so that he could perform a cleaning duty. While he was walking over the clean-in-place (CIP) tank, the grating broke and he fell in. His left leg was burned. The CIP process was being run at the time, so it contained hot water and chemicals.

An employee was raking slag while standing on a platform. A plug in the boiler came loose causing water and slag to eject at high pressure and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the back, a compression fracture to vertebrae, and a brain hematoma.
An employee was slicing onions with a vegetable slicer when the slicer cut his left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While loading a piece of metal into a shear, an employee's finger contacted the shear blade. The employee sustained a laceration to his index finger.

A maintenance employee had just tightened a bolt. A second employee then put a wrench on it to check it. As the second employee was applying pressure to the wrench, a valve which controls the flow from the degreaser to the washer opened slightly. The injured employee was sprayed by 200-degree stock. He sustained third degree burns to both hands and second degree burns to his back.
An employee was directing traffic in a work zone when he was struck by a car. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was installing a pump to a mixer on a production line when he sustained an electrical shock.

An employee was changing a filter at a hood above a prep cook surface. The filter dropped behind the equipment and damaged a gas line. Gas leaked and ignited. The employee sustained burns to the face, neck, and arm.
An employee was performing maintenance on a clean-in-place (CIP) machine when the tip of the employee's thumb was caught in a pinch point and amputated.
An employee in the quality lab was pushing a chair back to her desk. Her feet got tangled in the chair and she fell to the floor, breaking both wrists and the left knee.
An employee was struck by the bucket of an excavator when the machine rotated. The employee sustained a broken right lower leg.
An employee was re-stacking boxes that had fallen. A double-stack of pallets that was behind the employee fell and landed on the employee resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat when their index finger contacted the blade and was lacerated.

An employee was removing an aluminum casting from a basket after the heat treating process. The employee's left hand was caught between the lifting hook and the parts hook resulting in a partial amputation of the left pointer finger.
An employee was cutting onions with a knife when it slipped and cut her left middle finger.

A temporary employee was removing a tablet that did not properly eject from a press. The press cycled as the employee's left hand was in the point of operation causing the amputation of the left middle finger.

An employee was cutting a steel plate using a grinder equipped with a cut-off wheel. The cut-off wheel jammed in the material causing the grinder to kick back. The employee dropped the grinder. The employee was hit by the spinning cut-off wheel and sustained a laceration to the right shin area.
At about 6:30 a.m., an employee slipped and fell down stairs, suffering multiple injuries including cracked ribs.
An employee's left middle finger was caught and amputated by a finishing line conveyor.
An employee became ill while working at her cubicle and was hospitalized due to mold exposure.
An employee was unloading a mail truck when the cable for the rear cargo door broke causing the door to fall on the employee's head. The employee sustained a cut and a concussion.
While pulling electrical line using a tugger and tensioner, an employee came in contact with a live electric current and sustained burns to the left hand.
A nurse was assisting in lifting a patient from a stretcher to a wheel chair and suffered lower back pain. The employee was hospitalized.
While climbing down a 32-foot fiberglass ladder, an employee fell approximately two stories to the ground and sustained fractures to the ribs, pelvis, and collar bone.
An employee was using a laser cutter to cut polyurethane when she felt sick and had difficulty breathing. She was hospitalized with carbon monoxide poisoning.

On September 09, 2019, an employee was installing window wrap from a 40-foot extension ladder when he fell about 15 feet to the ground. He suffered fractures to his right shoulder blade, ring finger, and lower back and a laceration to the right side of his face. He was hospitalized. The ladder's feet were not properly positioned at the time of the incident.

An employee was using a wrench to loosen a nut to adjust the vibrating conveyor system of the alloy system hopper. The wrench came off the bolt and the employee fell 6-feet 10-inches. The employee struck their head and sustained lacerations requiring fifteen staples and hospitalization.
While troubleshooting a light fixture, an employee sustained an electric shock and fell from a ladder.
An employee was finishing the inspection of a crane. As he was getting off the crane, the employee slipped and fell to the ground and sustained a fractured pelvis.
On September 10, 2019, an employee was walking into the hospital building when she fell. While catching herself, she fractured her right arm in two places. She was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading products from inside a truck trailer when he passed out in part due to the heat and hit his head on the ground. He was hospitalized.
An employee was shrink wrapping a skid when his left index fingertip was amputated by the cutter on the shrink wrap machine.
While operating a machine, an employee's hand went into a pinch point and the thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was building the frame of a trailer. The trailer frame was lowered via hydraulics while the employee's finger was in a pinch point. The distal portion of his left fifth digit was amputated.

While racking store fixtures, an employee was struck by a clothing rack that had become stuck in an overhead conveyor. The employee fell to the ground and was hospitalized with a fractured lower left leg.
An employee operating a motorized pallet jack was picking goods from the racking systems when they were struck by another pallet jack and sustained a broken leg.
Security officers were pursuing a suspect. An officer running on the concrete sidewalk fell and injured both knees.
An employee was retrieving tools from his tool bag when his finger was caught by the claw of a small hammer resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was placing clothing/hangers onto a moving screw conveyor. A hanger got caught in the screw conveyor, and as the employee was removing it, their left index finger got caught in the conveyor and the end of the finger was amputated.
An employee pushed a bar through rollers. The employee's gloved hand was then pulled into the rollers resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was using a pallet jack to unload pallets from a truck. The dock plate rose up about 1 ft. when the employee entered the truck. While backing out, the employee's right foot was crushed between the dock plate and the pallet jack.
An employee was climbing off of a roof where he had been installing a roof vent. While trying to step down onto the ladder, the employee fell to the ground and sustained broken ribs.
