An employee was power washing a farrowing crate when, as he stepped out of the crate, he slipped and lost control of the power washing gun. High-pressure water then hit and lacerated his right elbow and forearm.

An employee turned off a conveyor belt to pull out a skid that had gotten stuck. While his hand was inside the machine, the machine was turned on again. The employee was hospitalized for injuries to his left hand which require surgery.

A maintenance employee was working on an exhaust fan on the roof of the dining hall. The employee's finger got caught between a belt and pulley and he sustained the amputation of the right index fingertip. The exhaust fan was turned off at the time.

An employee had been putting trim onto a cart. The employee felt something in his safety boot and took the boot off to check for a foreign body. A trim cart then ran over his foot. He sustained an amputation, without bone loss, of the tip of a toe on the left foot.

While building a truss, an employee's left hand was holding onto a wooden truss when a pneumatic clamp, designed to hold the sides of the truss in place during manufacturing, engaged and caused the partial amputation of the employee's left thumb tip.
An employee was using a chop saw to cut an aluminum gutter into smaller scrap pieces. The chop saw blade contacted his hand causing a cut that required surgery.
A temporary employee was carrying formwork jacks when his right thumb was caught and crushed between the jacks and a stack of crates.

An employee was walking between tie-off points and fell through a roof opening to the concrete floor 23 feet below. The employee suffered broken ribs, a collapsed lung, a displaced left hip, a shattered left wrist, and a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was walking into the maintenance shop. He tripped while entering the shop and reached out to break his fall, striking his right hand on an axe which was stored near the door. His right ring finger and palm were cut on the axe blade.
An employee was climbing down a ladder. He was on the second rung when he felt his quadricep pull. He requiring hospitalization and surgery for a detached right quadricep muscle.

An employee was pulling on a tree limb located on the ground using a 6-foot long hanger puller. When the hanger puller became dislodged from the limb, the employee tripped over an anchored guy wire directly behind him. The employee's momentum carried him approximately 6 feet further where he struck his left shoulder on a decorative concrete wall and then fell. The employee sustained fractures to the right fibula, ankle, and left shoulder.

An employee was testing a 16-inch pipe with a test ball when the test ball flew out of the pipe causing the employee to fly back, landing on his right arm. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm.

An employee was cleaning out the parking garage fan room. The employee's hand was in the doorway when the exhaust fan turned on and pulled the door shut on the employee's left pinky finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was walking backwards while installing flashing on a roof. The employee fell approximately 15 feet from the roof and sustained a fractured left elbow and wrist. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee sustained an electric shock on his right ring finger while troubleshooting a wind tower. He was hospitalized.

A forklift was transporting two bales of aluminum, one on top of the other. The bottom bale gave way causing the top bale to roll onto an employee who was working on a piece of equipment. The injured employee sustained severe contusions to the pelvis.

Two temporary employees cut a new window opening into metal siding on the second floor of a building. The employees then went to the first floor to install door and window frames. The injured employee went back up to the second floor to get a cordless drill and then heard the other employee call for something. When the injured employee went to the window opening to look down, the metal siding gave way. The injured employee fell 12 feet from the second floor, landing on the concrete pavement and broken roof tiles that were outside of the building fracturing his right elbow and hip.

An employee was in the basement area looking at completed welding locations at the ceiling line. The employee fell approximately 20 feet from a concrete stair landing and sustained a broken leg, and possible spinal fractures.

The injured employee was holding a valve that was being closed by another employee when his thumb entered the valve. As the other employee closed the valve, the ball of the valve sliced off the injured employee's thumb tip.

An employee turned off the power to a chipper in order to change the blade. The employee then went to get tools. When he returned to the chipper, he checked to see if the blade had stopped spinning and his left ring finger became caught between the belt drive and sheave. He sustained a fingertip and fingernail amputation.

On September 10, 2019, an employee was being trained on how to load and unload batteries from a motorized pallet jack's charger when the pallet jack hit and fractured his lower right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee walked into a storage closet and fell into an uncovered crawl space. The light was off at the time.
An employee was participating in a live fire training exercise and began to feel lightheaded and dizzy. The employee was hospitalized due to low potassium.
An employee was working at a gut table when the employee experienced muscle cramps and heavy sweating due to possible heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized with a muscle injury.

On 9/10/2019, an employee dismounted a forklift to move an object by hand. The forklift moved and pinched the employee between an object and the forklift. The forklift punctured the employee's leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a mower and his finger contacted the mower blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee sitting in an office chair went to stand up, twisted her ankle, and fell to the floor fracturing the right pelvis.
An employee was driving a forklift on an unpaved road. The forklift left the road and tipped over in a ditch. The employee's legs were pinned under the forklift and sustained bruising.
An employee was torqueing bolts under a catwalk when a steel frame released, hitting the employee in the head and eye regions and fracturing bones.

An employee was descending an A-frame ladder when he slipped on the second or third rung and fell 2 to 3 feet to the concrete floor. The ladder fell on him and onto the floor. He sustained a compound fracture to his left ankle.
An employee was cleaning at an machine operator workstation when an unassociated hot water pipe failed and sprayed the employee. The employee suffered burns to the arm and torso.

An employee had finished grinding a shaft on a lathe and turned the machine off. As he went to remove the shaft, a switch was contacted and turned the lathe on. The shaft on the lathe grabbed his glove wrapping it around the shaft and causing an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was inserting a die into CNC machining equipment when the die fell out onto the employee's finger, amputating it.

An employee arrived at work about one hour before his shift started. While walking in the break room to get a cup of coffee, he tripped on a cart and fell. He sustained a broken hip and was hospitalized.
On September 10, an employee was being trained on how to operate a motorized pallet jack and lost control of the vehicle. The pallet jack then hit and fractured his lower leg near the ankle.

An employee was standing on a dunnage rack to reach pizza items on the top shelf in the freezer area. When the employee reached for the items, a bag of cheese opened and cheese scattered onto the floor. The employee stepped backward off the rack and then slipped on the cheese that was on the floor. He fell against the racks that were behind him and sustained a punctured lung, broken shoulder, and two broken ribs. He was hospitalized.

While walking into an office, an employee entered the path of a forklift that was carrying metal siding. The forklift shifted, causing the siding to fall off the forklift and land on the employee's foot. He suffered toe lacerations. Steel-toed boots were worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was working outdoors performing waste collection activities on a residential route and suffered heat exhaustion.

A truck driver along with another employee had just finished draining a tanker. They were unhooking the hose from the tanker when hot liquid asphalt struck the driver's arm causing severe burns. The driver was hospitalized.

An employee was using a crane to unload a windmill. As the employee was hooking a safety latch to the corner casting of a windmill, the vessel where the employee was working moved a little, creating tension on the hook. The employee's left ring finger was caught in the safety latch, fractured, and the fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee of Dreisilker was working as a field service technician, performing infrared testing for a customer. The employee was walking away while a third-party contractor employee was closing the door of a fuse box. An arc flash came from the fuse box and burned both employees, and they were both hospitalized. The Dreisilker employee sustained burns to the right hand, and on the left side of the neck, forearm and face.

An employee was lifting a case of eight 1-gallon water jugs when the case fell on his right foot. Suffering from swelling (as well as what appeared to be an insect bite) on the foot, he was hospitalized.
An employee was walking up a sloped gravel hill when he tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was using a grommet machine to place a grommet in the holder. The machine activated and came down on the top of the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was moving a dresser out of a hotel room in order to refinish it. A metal rim on the bottom of the dresser cut the employee's hand and severed a tendon. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee got off a pallet jack and was walking down an aisle to a pick location. The employee tripped over a box and fell, sustaining a fractured left femur.

An employee was circulating bad oil into tanks. He then went to remove a leaking dump valve from a compressor to conduct repair. While the dump valve was being removed, fluids sprayed out and were ignited by the hot manifold of a compressor. The employee sustained second degree burns to the palms and top surface of both hands and was hospitalized.
An employee was electric shocked while plugging a warmer machine into an outlet.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured fibula after their leg was caught between a dock and a delivery truck.

A temporary employee was teaching an employee how to clean rollers in the pouring and debridge area of the facility. When they were done cleaning the roller, the employee placed it back into the lathe and used a chuck key to tighten it into place. The temporary employee instructed the other employee to turn on the lathe. As the lathe was being turned on, the temporary employee saw the key was still in the chuck and went to remove it. The employee's finger got caught between the key and the guard resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was using a pocket knife to cut a plastic zip tie when the knife slipped and lacerated his wrist, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a forklift onto a trailer when the forklift turned over sideways and he hit his head on the inside wall of the forklift's cabin. He suffered a skull fracture and a hematoma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading supplies in the back of a delivery box truck when his foot was caught on a pallet and he fell, breaking his pelvis.
While standing on the sixth step of a 10-foot step ladder, an employee was adjusting a conveyor belt using a pry bar. He fell to the floor and broke both wrists.
An employee was holding a door open when the door automatically closed, catching his hand and causing a partial amputation to the right middle finger.

While throwing roofing material from the roof into a dumpster on ground level, an employee fell approximately 18 feet from the roof to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra and a punctured lung.
While checking the meter voltage on a rail, an employee experienced an electric shock to the right hand.
An employee fell to the ground after interacting with a fellow employee, fracturing the left ulna and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was holding the vertical support of a racking system while it was being anchored into the floor when the support fell, striking the employee in the head, back, and left leg.
While driving a powered pallet jack, an employee's left foot was caught between the pallet jack and a metal guard. The employee sustained an amputation to the left leg just above the ankle.
An employee was climbing a ladder, fell to the ground, and was hospitalized with a back injury.
A shear machine amputated an employee's right middle fingertip (with no bone loss).

An employee was shaping pieces of material on the table shaper. He then turned the machine off to clean it. The employee's hand contacted the tool while it was still in motion. The employee sustained amputations to the index and middle fingers without bone loss.
An employee was filling a water pump with gas when the gas vapors ignited. The flames contacted the employee, causing first and second degree burns to the employee's hand, arm, face, and stomach.
An employee's right middle finger was trapped in a closing office door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was performing a routine walkthrough of a boiler room. As the employee passed a contractor removing a steam-line pump, a neoprene seal ruptured, causing a chemical release onto the employee. The employee suffered chemical burns and eye irritation.

An employee was delivering supplies at a construction job site. As a customer was taking rebar from the back of the employee's trailer, the rebar began falling off of the trailer. It struck the employee's right leg and landed on his ankle and foot, breaking two bones in the foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting repairs in an MRI room when he made contact with a live electrical wire and suffered a severe electrical shock.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when he was attacked by a swarm of bees. He fell to the concrete below, suffering a fractured elbow and leg, a broken nose, and the loss of some teeth.

On September 11, 2019, at approximately 2:30 PM, an employee lost his balance and fell off an A-frame ladder while cleaning a wall inside an empty grain bin. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both heels.

Three employees were disassembling a lattice boom crane. One of the employees took a pin out of the crane by hitting it with a sledgehammer. A section of the boom then struck the employee on his right side, fracturing his clavicle, ribs, and femur.
An employee became ill and was hospitalized due to heat stress while working on a molten aluminum production of sows.
An employee was fusing a pipe into a fusion machine when his finger was caught in the clamping mechanism of the machine, resulting in a right middle finger amputation.
An employee was using a ratchet to tighten banding on a cart. The ratchet slipped and struck the employee's left cheek and eye area, causing facial fractures and lacerations above and below the eye.

An employee was installing purlins while tied off to a truss on a new construction commercial building. The truss rolled over and the employee fell approximately 16 feet to the ground, suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was using a nibble saw to cut a pallet when his glove became caught in the nibbler saw, resulting an amputation of his right thumb tip and nail.
An employee suffered severe leg and abdominal muscle cramps and was hospitalized due to heat stress.
An employee was descending from a crane boom due to incoming rain when lightning struck the crane boom. The employee sustained burns to the feet.
An employee was installing attic insulation when he sustained heat stroke. The employee was hospitalized and treated for dehydration.
An employee was performing maintenance on a cucumber header when the machine activated and damaged a muscle in the employee's leg.
An employee was closing a gate when a gust of wind knocked the gate off the track. The gate struck and fractured the employee's hip.

An employee was loading a skidder onto a trailer. The D-ring used to attach the strap that retained the trailer snapped forward and crushed the employee's left index fingertip. The fingertip required surgical amputation.

An employee was inspecting a thigh machine in a deboning department. The employee fell forward while walking between two machines, and part of one of the machines amputated the tip of the employee's finger.
While leaving a building, an employee fell down a stairway and suffered injuries to the left and right ankles.
An employee fell while walking on the concrete floor in a parking lot. The employee was hospitalized with a leg injury.
An employee was scanning freight from a forklift. His hand was through the forklift mast when the mast was lowered, amputating his left index finger and requiring surgery.
An employee was operating the controls of a combo dumper. When the dumper was raised, it pinched his right little finger against the rail, causing the amputation of the finger.

After emptying shredded paper from the box of a truck, an employee was preparing to make an adjustment to the tensioning and position of the conveyor belt in the box. The conveyor then injured his forearm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped and fell over boxes while stocking in a dry produce area, breaking the left hip.
An employee slipped on a rung while descending a ladder, falling approximately 10 feet and breaking his left femur.
An employee had completed his route of delivering beverages when he became ill, requiring hospitalization for heat exhaustion.
An employee was doing maintenance on a wall-mounted exhaust fan. The metal fan blade struck the employee, lacerating the employee's right elbow.
An employee was called to restrain a patient. After physical contact with the patient, the employee experienced a sore arm and lightheadedness.
An employee was using the entry door into the facility when the door closed on his pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing water from a cleaning bay with a portable electric pump. An explosion occurred when the pump ignited flammable vapors, causing burns to the employee's chest.
An employee was struck by a moving vehicle while setting up road patterns. The employee suffered a crushed right ankle, broken right collarbone and a concussion.
An employee ran into a cabbage tree while driving a UTV, injuring his right knee and lower leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a chop saw when it amputated his middle fingertip.
An employee fell from a baker's scaffold.
A lineman was trying to change out a recloser when hot hydraulic fluid splashed on his arm and back, causing second-degree burns.

Employees were rigging up a work-over rig. One of the rig wires caught on a 1-inch ball valve and the pressure from the rig rising caused the valve to be sent up as a projectile. It struck an employee on the right side of the face and forehead, fracturing his skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a portable saw to cut a pipe when the saw amputated two of his fingers.
An employee became dizzy while planting sugar cane and was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee was removing a 6-foot section of duct when the duct rolled off the support bracket and onto his right leg, fracturing it.

On September 11, 2019, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was dumping a rolling tub of scrap bags when the employee noticed several individual scrap bags remained in the bottom of the scrap tub. The employee reached into the tub to remove the remaining bags. As the employee pushed on the corner of the tub to provide leverage to raise up the scrap tub, the scrap tub tipped sideways, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a right hip fracture.

An employee was standing on the floor of a drilling rig while hooking up a Kelly hose to a pipe. The hose struck him below the left shoulder blade, and he rolled off the rig and fell to the ground. He suffered kidney trauma, broken ribs, and a liver laceration.
An employee was operating a bagging machine on the production line. When she changed the bags,  her finger was caught in the jaw assembly and her left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was entering a cafeteria. A nursing care resident was in the doorway and the employee tripped on one of the resident's wheels, falling to the ground and suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was under training for clamp truck operation. The employee turned and tried to stop the vehicle. He moved his leg out and was caught between the clamp truck and a yellow fence. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was servicing a compression unit. When he began to shut the unit down, a flash fire occurred. He suffered primarily first- and second-degree burns. He was hospitalized.

An employee was tied to the bucket of a boom truck and cutting the branch of a pine tree when the branch started to fall. The employee attempted to grab the branch and contacted the saw, cutting his right hand/wrist above the thumb area. He was hospitalized. The chain saw was still running at the time of the incident.

An employee was installing rafters on a new farm building when he lost his footing and slipped, falling onto the rafter he was working on. The impact against the rafter ruptured his large intestine. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a manual guillotine cutter to cut plastic tags and cut their left thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was trying to uncouple an attachment from an excavator when his left middle finger was pinched in the coupler.

An employee was trying to connect a beam to a column when the employee fell 14.5 feet onto concrete, suffering a fractured orbital socket and contusions on the face and nose. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working an overtime shift on top of a battery area when the employee became ill due to heat and dehydration. The employee was hospitalized for acute kidney failure and dehydration.

Employees were performing maintenance on a boom lift. While they were disassembling the boom, a piece of the boom fell down and pinned an employee's hand between the boom and a machine, resulting in the amputation of the employee's finger.
An employee was bitten by an unknown bug while moving fixtures and products for merchandise setting, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking across a board during a team building activity at the company retreat when the board slipped or turned, causing the employee to fall to the ground. She suffered a fracture below the right kneecap (tibia plateau), requiring hospitalization.
An employee was replacing/fixing wiring on a light pole while in a bucket truck when the employee received electrical burns to the face and body.

An employee bent down to grab a dock plate. The employee's right foot became tangled in a door strap and the employee fell backwards to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left wrist. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was setting up jack stands for a section of pipe to rest on when a contractor on site turned on a concrete pump hose that moved the jack stand out of position. The employee attempted to set up the jack stand again while a section of pipe was being positioned on it. His right middle finger was caught between the jack stand and the section of pipe, resulting in a finger amputation from the first knuckle behind the nail.

An employee was measuring a ductile iron pipe with another employee. The pipe was on the ground on top of 2x4's and was previously cut at one end, which was sharp. When they tried to move the pipe, it rolled, pinning the employee against the tire of a loader and lacerating his right knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a hallway when a scrubber machine struck her, causing her to fall over a pallet and break both ankles.
An employee was loading steel beams when the load shifted and the steel landed on his legs and ankle. He suffered broken legs.
An employee was installing ground anchors for a fence when the employee struck an unmarked electrical line, suffering an electric shock.
An employee was cutting pieces of metal on a shear. The employee's hand was under the hold-down when it actuated, crushing the employee's left thumb and resulting in a partial left thumb amputation.

An employee was hooking up cargo to a crane hook for discharge from a vessel. The ship moved, causing the cargo (rubber in a metal basket) to strike the employee, who suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a shear machine. While he was picking up a piece of metal, it slipped through his fingers and amputated the third and fourth fingers on his left hand.
An employee fell from the second rung of a fixed ladder on a feed bin. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a back injury.
An employee fell to the floor while climbing a fixed ladder, suffering a cranial hemorrhage, broken ribs, and a broken back.

A maintenance employee was operating a powered piece of equipment to clear a drain in a concrete floor when the glove on the employee's left hand became caught in the equipment's cable. The employee's left hand was then pulled into the apparatus in the drain, resulting in a partial left ring finger amputation.

An employee was lifting and dumping a tilt cart (with a helper) into a roll-off dumpster at a loading dock. The cart tipped downward suddenly from the shift in contents and the employee's pinky finger was caught in a pinch point between the tipped cart and the jagged edge of the roll-off dumpster. As a result, the employee's right pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was attempting to hook a dolly to a tug by hand when the dolly rolled over the employee's foot.
An employee was raising a trailer gate. The employee's left little fingertip was caught between the gate and the trailer's side wall; the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was stocking drywall and using a cart to move the drywall. The ground was uneven, and the drywall cart became stuck (15 sheets of 4x12) and fell over. The employee tried to get out of the way, but the cart pinned him against a beam and hit him on the upper thigh, breaking his left leg.
An employee was removing a beam from a blaster and manually turning it to remove a steel shot when the beam rolled onto his hand, resulting in a left ring finger amputation.
An employee was running to a customer service window when he fell to the floor, breaking his femur.
An employee was on a scissor lift at 30 feet when the lift hydraulics failed and the lift suddenly went straight down. As a result, the employee broke both ankles.
While adjusting material on a delivery truck's flatbed trailer, an employee fell from the trailer to the ground. The employee suffered a broken hip, broken ribs, and cranial bleeding.

An employee was scuffing the bottom of a dump truck bed while standing on the truck's frame when the employee slipped and fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee was hospitalized with four broken ribs on the right side.
An employee was working on a poly-bag cutting machine when the machine amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee was using a deboning saw to debone a poultry thigh when the employee's left index finger contacted the rotating saw blade, resulting in an amputation to the extreme end of the left index finger. Protective gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

Two employees were changing an expansion valve on an outdoor chiller unit. One employee was using a canister torch to sweat the piping and valve while the other was pulling on the pipe with a pair of pliers. When the connection came loose, excess fluid inside of the valve was ignited by the torch and splashed onto the employee with the torch. The employee suffered second-degree burns from the right side of the face down to the right side of the waist.
While an employee was making an adjustment on the rivet squeezers, the machine actuated and caused an amputation of the right thumb proximal to the nail bed.

An employee was collecting trash while a co-worker was using a winch to remove trash from the truck. The employee's hand became stuck in a pinch point between the winch and the truck, injuring his right index finger and resulting in a partial finger amputation.

Inside a building being renovated, an employee was working from a 12-foot A-frame stepladder while using a grinder to remove an air duct when the air duct swung down and struck the ladder. This caused the employee to fall to the concrete floor below, suffering a broken left pelvis/hip, left arm bone chip, and a cut above left eye.

An employee was on a 7-foot scaffold pumping concrete when the hose became plugged and started whipping around. The hose hit the employee and he fell 7 feet from the scaffold. He was hospitalized with fractures to his pelvis.
An employee was dismantling a personnel and material hoist when the top portion of the motor pack fell over and onto the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs.

On 9/12/2019, at approximately 11:30 AM, an employee was carrying a piece of drywall from a stock pile to hand to an installer on a scissor lift. As the installer was lowering the lift, the employee's right ring finger was pinched and crushed between the lift and the piece of drywall, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was leaving a delivery truck when his wedding ring caught on the back of the truck.  His left ring finger was amputated.
An employee fell from a trailer and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was reaching into a packaging machine when the sensors activated and the machine cycled, amputating his index fingertip.
An employee was operating a forklift and slid into a barrier. The employee sustained a left knee fracture.
An employee was standing at the rear of his delivery truck when he was struck by an automobile. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the body and was hospitalized.
While an employee was working on machinery, a sprocket caused the amputation of the employee's right little fingertip at the nail.
An employee was performing maintenance on a TCU that was overheating when the TCU blew up. The employee received burns to the face, arm, hands, back of the neck, and hip.
An employee was working on a roof approximately 20 feet high when the employee walked backwards and fell off the edge to the ground, suffering a skull fracture and contusion that required stitches.
An employee was conducting a quality check on a pile being driven into the ground and was struck by a rolling pipe weighing 7,000 lbs. The employee sustained leg fractures.

An employee was operating a standup forklift in reverse after placing a skid of material on the storage rack. The forklift struck a boom attachment that was stored in the area and the boom struck the employee's left leg causing a compound fracture to the lower leg.
An employee fell off a roof during roofing work, suffering a broken right hip, broken right elbow, and broken right ribs.
On September 13, 2019, an employee was pruning branches when the tie-in point for the rope broke. The employee fell 18 feet to the ground, fracturing a vertebra in his back.
An employee was delivering materials to a job site when a block of foam forms fell and struck the employee, causing a neck injury.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood stakes when the saw amputated the tip of their left thumb.
On September 13, 2019, an employee was cutting a zip tie when the knife lacerated his wrist.
An employee was assisting in a test of a new pan line that was being installed when he was struck by a pan on the line and sustained a broken right hand.

An employee was preparing meat logs to be placed in the meat slicer. The employee's hand slipped down while the meat slicer was in operation and the blade caused an amputation to the left middle finger.
When an employee was mounting a tire onto a wheel, the wheel came out of the tire and struck the employee in the shoulder. The employee was hospitalized with a broken clavicle and required surgery.

An employee was cleaning out a hose leading to a tank. When a steam line was connected to the hose, the hose whipped around and released steam, which burned the employee's left arm and chest. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while cleaning, suffering an arm sprain and head laceration.
An employee twisted his ankle while going down stairs. When he sat down to rest, he lost consciousness, fell off the chair, and hit his head on the ground, suffering a head injury.
An employee was using a push mower to mow grass. As he was lowering the blades, the mower amputated part of his left middle finger and lacerated his left ring finger.
An employee was walking to open the park when she lost her balance, stepped backwards, and tripped on a curb, falling to the ground and injuring her back. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell from concrete formwork to the ground and was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

An employee was moving a water box (weighing 160 pounds) and trying to adjust it on a pallet to get it ready for shipping. The injured employee was on the other side of the box trying to move it when her left index finger was caught in between the edge of the water box and the plank on the pallet, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On September 13, 2019, at approximately 8:36 AM, an employee was repairing a door hinge on a bus that was in for service. The employee bent over and a foreign body struck their left eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to separate two wheel wells with a chisel and a mallet. The wheel wells came back and struck the employee's finger, causing a split finger and an amputation.

Two employees were operating the slitter machine and hydraulic table on Line 1. Employee 1 was operating the controls while Employee 2 was using a wooden stick to pick up the ends of sheet metal coming from the slitter head to set them on the hydraulic table. As the hydraulic table moved towards the slitter head, Employee 2 was caught in between the slitter machine and the hydraulic table. Employee 2 was hospitalized for a contusion and crushed chest wall, liver lacerations and bruised kidneys.
An employee was trying to clear a meat grinder. The grinder amputated 1/8-inch of the employee's right index fingertip.
While walking across a warehouse, an employee tripped over a staged pallet and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a leg injury.
Am employee tripped on the edge of the concrete floor (where the gravel drive meets the building floor) and fell to the floor level, suffering a contusion and traumatic hematoma to the right knee.

On September 13, 2019, at 9:50 A.M., an employee was disconnecting a hose from an asphaltic cement tanker when hot asphaltic cement material contacted and burned his hands, arms, and knees. The tanker valve was not closed at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a degloving of the little finger, which resulted in the amputation of the finger.

An employee fainted while installing a door at a construction site and fell to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration and a fractured first metatarsal on the right ring finger.

On September 13, 2019, at approximately 10:10 p.m., the injured employee offered to help a second employee load three pieces of 20-foot angle onto a trailer using an overhead crane. During the lift, two of the angles became stuck together. The injured employee asked the second employee to further raise the south hoist. As the second employee lifted the angle, the injured employee attempted to release the raised angle from the adjacent angle. When the angles released, the angle being raised released from the chain on the south end. The south end of the raised angle fell to the ground and struck the adjacent angle, which in turn struck the injured employee on his right calf. He was hospitalized with a contusion/compartment syndrome to his right calf.

An employee was trimming a tree while attached to a crane when the employee's fall protection harness broke. The employee fell approximately 50 feet to the ground, sustaining injuries to the back, ankle, ribs, and sternum.
An employee was stung by a bee while throwing trash into a dumpster and had an allergic reaction.
An employee walked through an open loading bay door and fell 5 feet from the loading dock to the ground, breaking his femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working with an edger when a board became stuck. While the saw was still running, the board that was jammed spun out of the edger chamber and struck the employee in the right arm resulting in a fractured radius and ulna.
A security officer was punched by a hospital patient and fell to the ground resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was walking backwards while pulling a piece of steel when the employee slipped on plywood and fell backwards. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the T-12 vertebra.
An employee was using a bandsaw when the blade severely lacerated his right index finger, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was feeding debris into a trimming machine. The trimmer caught his right hand, lacerating the hand/fingers.
An employee was electrocuted while using a chipping hammer.

A maintenance employee changed the knives on the hog barrel while the machine was locked out. After installing the new knives, the employee had to spin the barrel to ensure the knives did not hit the machine. As the barrel was spinning, his left hand was struck by a knife. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery on his left thumb.
An employee was guiding a crane as it lifted gravel onto a roof in its clamshell bucket. The employee's hand was caught and crushed in the bucket.
An employee was filling a wheelbarrow with sand at a blast furnace when the employee became lightheaded. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking in a parking lot resulting in a possible shoulder injury. It was raining at the time of the incident.
An employee had been performing their regular duties as a sales representative which include talking with customers outside and showing RVs. She suffered heat stroke.

An employee was directing a rear-discharge ready-mix concrete truck that was reversing so its discharge chute could reach the receiving hopper located at the rear of a stationary pump truck. As the employee was adjusting the chute on the concrete ready-mix truck, the ready-mix truck rolled forward, then backed up, pinning the employee between a pipe connected to the pump truck hopper and the ready-mix truck's DOT bumper. The employee sustained a leg hematoma that required surgery.
An employee struck a mezzanine while operating a lift truck, suffering a fractured femur.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw when the employee's left hand contacted the sawblade, sustaining a cut, broken bone, and severed tendon.

An employee was descending a 24-foot extension ladder after attaching an aerial service wire to a home. His left foot slipped on the second rung from the bottom, causing him to fall and land awkwardly. He broke his left foot.

The sole of an employee's shoe stuck to the floor. She lost her balance and fell; her left knee, right arm, and shoulder struck the floor and she suffered fractures to the left patella and right humerus. She was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading pipes from a truck trailer when he tripped over a screw that was sticking up on the trailer and fell approximately 3.5 feet from the trailer to the ground. He sustained a right hip injury.

An employee was in a warehouse that had three 6-foot high tiers of tires stacked on top of each other. The employee had climbed on top of a picker, stepped on the second tier tires, and was reaching for the third tier when the tire he was standing on slipped. The employee and tire then fell to the concrete floor, breaking his foot and toe.
An employee was cleaning up bolts at a jobsite when the employee's legs began cramping. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack and ran into a forklift being driven by another employee. The employee suffered a fractured left ankle.
An employee was driving a forklift truck. The truck slid toward a guardrail, and the employee's left foot was caught and injured between the forklift and the rail.

An employee was on a ladder attempting to remove tree limbs from the top of a truck when a tree limb fell and hit the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs.
An employee was bitten by a spider while driving a vehicle, requiring hospitalization for an infection.
An employee was using slip-joint pliers to clear a jam in a cutter machine's hoppers when the cutter partially amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was walking away from a table in the restaurant when she stumbled and fell, hitting her hip on the floor. She suffered a fractured hip and shoulder injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was delivering plywood panels at a site when he slipped on a piece of cardboard and fell, breaking his left ankle.

An employee working as a coating press operator noticed that the starch silo had jammed and was attempting to clear the jam. When the jammed starch cleared, the auger actuated and contacted the employee's hand. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right index finger, just below the first knuckle.

An employee heard a noise in a machine he was working on. He made a repair and had another employee turn the machine back on. His hand was inside the machine and his right index finger was caught and severely damaged in a mechanism in the panel. He was hospitalized and had surgery. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cleaning around a machine when he noticed a loose cover. As he was tightening the screw on the panel, it arced and caused burns to both his hands.

On September 16, 2019, an employee fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor while attempting to access an extension ladder from a barrel vault standing seam roof. The employee's shoulder and pelvis were fractured.
An employee was taking an LP tank to the refill station when a propane flash fire suddenly occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's hands and face.
An employee was driving a golf cart on a tarmac when she made a sharp turn and fell out of the cart, breaking both ankles.

An employee was in a truck picking up trash at a residential site. When he exited the truck to pick up the trash, the truck rolled back and pinned him against another vehicle. He was hospitalized with a broken right leg. The truck was not in neutral at the time of the incident.

An employee was adjusting the height of a hydraulic press table to insert the positioning pin when the hydraulic press came down and crushed the employee's hand between the pin and press table. The employee suffered a fractured left hand requiring surgery and hospitalization.
A public safety officer was de-escalating a fight between family members in a NICU waiting room when the employee was punched in the face. The officer was hospitalized with a broken nose.
An employee was unloading metal racks containing chicks using a hook and winch system. His left hand was caught between a rack and a hook, and his middle and index fingers were lacerated.
An employee was shocked while changing out a motor on an offline washer. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a photo tool. Afterward, he added refrigerant to the tool, which began to leak. He attempted to stop the leak and contacted the refrigerant, burning both of his hands.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance and was removing built-up grease from a moving chain when his right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking beside a cart when it caught her feet. She tripped and her left arm was broken.
On September 16, 2019, an employee was operating a telehandler when it went off the road onto its side. The employee suffered several face and head injuries.

An employee was working on a single point vinyl welder when he turned to talk to another employee. His hand was placed on the top plate of the press welder at the time. When the welder finished its cycle, it came up and trapped his right pointer finger between the top plate and top of the welder. He pulled his gloved finger out and suffered a fingertip amputation.
While an employee was adjusting a chain on a machine, the chain caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was dismantling a temporary tower when a swivel hook appeared to shear, dropping a section of the steel tower 10 feet. The section hit the employee, who sustained a fractured sternum.

The injured employee was holding a long, metal, hollow pole out of the way inside a truck container while a second employee was operating a forklift to load the container. The forklift mast struck the injured employee's hand pushing his hand into the end of the pole and amputating the thumb.

An employee was refueling a water pump when the gasoline began to overflow out of the fuel tanks. It spilled on both the exhaust and the employee, then ignited, burning the backs of the employee's legs above the knees.
An employee was holding a stake to be driven into the ground by another employee when the employee was struck on the hand with a sledgehammer, suffering a fingertip laceration.
An employee fell from a belt loader as he was securing cargo bin netting. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured elbow and hip.

An employee was making adjustments at the back of a machine. When the machine operator started the machine, the employee's thumb was under a chain on the machine and was smashed, resulting in the amputation of the left thumb tip.
An employee was bitten on the leg by a rattlesnake while walking in the pasture.

An employee was putting a wood crate together with a pneumatic stapler. The staple gun came into contact with his thigh and went off, embedding a 2-inch staple in his leg between the knee and the thigh.
An employee was on a ladder when a wasp attacked him. He fell backward from the ladder and suffered broken ribs and an abdominal injury.

An employee was attempting to remove a panel cover on a cable tray while working from an 8-foot stepladder when he felt the ladder shift and lost his balance. He jumped off the ladder and hit the floor, suffering two broken ribs, two cracked vertebrae, a fractured wrist, and a concussion. He also required stitches above his right eye.
While clearing a parts jam on a buckle base machine, an employee's finger was caught and lacerated in the probe.

An employee was hooking the trailer to a pickup truck. Some of the weight of the trailer came down on the employee's left index finger, crushing it against the hitch ball. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was coming down a wireline truck ladder. As he stepped down, his ankle rolled and he fell to the ground. He landed on and broke his right femur, and was hospitalized.

An employee was showing fire department first responders the entrance to a building when the building exploded. The propane explosion injured the employee's head and leg, also causing second- and third-degree burns on 85% of the employee's body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a sidewalk/curb to the ground. She suffered wrist, knee, and ankle injuries and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee had been carrying mail on a city route that included driving and walking. After work, the employee had a cardiac event associated with exposure to heat, and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a power jack. As he was walking backwards he was caught between his power jack and another stationary power jack. The power jack he was operating rolled over his right foot causing a laceration and multiple fractures.

An employee was helping another employee pull a lawnmower out of a ditch using a tractor. The tractor went into gear and knocked the employee off the tractor. The tractor then ran over the employee's leg and face causing injuries.
An employee removed or loosened the coil spring of an overhead garage door and was struck by the assembly, suffering a fractured arm.
An employee was unloading a large cylindrical metal filter housing from a pallet onto the floor to be cleaned when he dropped the assembly on his foot, causing a hairline fracture to his right toe.

On 9/16/2019, at approximately 0945 hours, a border patrol agent was on a horse working traffic when the agent spotted a group running. The agent was riding to the area when the horse started bucking. The agent was attempting to gain control of the horse as it headed straight for a fence and into a metal H-brace. The agent's right leg struck the H-brace, suffering a broken femur.

An employee was helping to move a piece of equipment when it slid off a cross beam. His finger was then caught between the floor and the equipment, stripping the meat from the bone. As a result, his left middle finger had to be surgically amputated at the first joint.

An employee was strapping walls to a flatbed trailer when the employee stepped off the end of the trailer and fell approximately 3.5 feet to the ground, suffering a fractured skull, broken ribs, and bleeding on the brain.
An employee was attempting to retrieve material from a plate saw when the employee's fingers touched a moving blade. Two of the employee's fingers were lacerated.

An employee was picking trash and throwing it out over a balcony railing when the railing gave out. The employee and the railing fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. He fractured his right wrist, forearm, and leg.

An employee was standing on top of a container while a spreader bar was being lowered. The bar swung forward, causing the employee to step back and fall approximately 9 feet off of the container and onto the dock. He broke his wrist and suffered a damaged vertebra.
An employee was attempting to unjam a saw when his left hand touched the rotating blade, lacerating his hand and little finger. As a result, his little finger had to be medically amputated.
An employee was pulling tubing at a well site when an object fell off the derrick and punctured the employee's leg.
An employee was stripping the floor with chemicals when the stripper chemicals spilled on his foot, causing chemical burns that required hospitalization.
An employee's right hand contacted a moving band saw blade, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee had climbed down from a roof and was still wearing his fall protection harness and lanyard. He proceeded to operate a forklift and ran over his lanyard, pulling him out of the forklift.  He was hospitalized with three broken ribs and other possible injuries.
As a forklift was being lifted into a truck, an employee's foot was caught in a dock plate. The employee suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was sweeping when his hand hit against a metal frame. His hand experienced swelling that required surgery.

An employee was washing down an area using an 8-foot portable ladder. The employee was descending the ladder and on the way down, felt dizzy, missed the last step, and fell and hit his head on the concrete floor. The employee suffered a cut on the scalp that required stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a clutch brake on a tractor. The clutch brake cylinder amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee was on an extension ladder removing bolts to detach a 15x6 tank from a tank cart arm when he fell 12 feet from the ladder to the concrete below. He landed on his right side, breaking his right wrist and right femur.
An employee was on a trailer moving some equipment (mix tanks) when he fell off the trailer and hit the ground, breaking his right leg.
An employee was standing on a three-step, 3-foot ladder working on a wall. As she stepped down, she fell 18 to 24 inches to the floor. She suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to retrieve a socket wrench attached to a truck when another employee started the truck. The flywheel then caught the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was loading a 705-pound steel coil on a de-coiling wheel. The coil slipped off the forks of a forklift and fell to the ground, striking the employee. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was attempting to lower a dock plate. He lifted the dock plate up, then placed his fingers between the dock plates in order to fold the plates out so he could lay them flat. In doing so, his right hand fingers were pinched between the dock plates. His fourth finger needed stitches and his third finger was cut to the bone. One of his fingers required partial surgical amputation.
On September 17, 2019, an employee was filling an oxygen bottle when it caught on fire. The employee was burned and hospitalized.
An employee fell while dismounting an excavator. His elbow struck the concrete and was broken.

A temporary employee was dragging boxed furniture off a truck trailer. The truck was not backed up all the way to the building and the employee's leg slipped between the truck and building. The employee was hospitalized for leg and hip injuries.

An employee was operating a machine when the ram brushed his gloved right hand. He was startled and extended his fingers.  The fourth fingertip on his right hand was then run over by the roller wheel on the ram head, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a high-pressure washer to clean an aircraft when his left foot was sprayed with the water, causing a puncture wound.
An employee was in a scissor lift attaching a roof drain pipe to the wall when the employee fell 8 to 10 feet onto the concrete floor, fracturing the left ankle.

An employee was working in the field, servicing customer fire trucks at their location. The employee began to feel dizzy and disoriented. He left the work site and drove himself home. He was hospitalized later that evening for heat stress.
An employee was walking through a food pickup area. She slipped on a piece of ice and fell, suffering an open distal fracture of the left knee.
An employee was grinding/cutting off an old steel column for an overhead canopy using a 4.5" angle grinder with a cut-off disc when the grinder slipped and severely lacerated the employee's left arm.

An employee was helping process cattle into a chute. While the employee was waiting for the next cow to come into the chute, the back gate was opened and the employee's finger was pinched between it and the bracket. The employee suffered a partial amputation.
An employee fell and required hospitalization.
An employee was helping re-spool the winch line on a tubing tester truck when the line caught his right hand. Four fingers were amputated.
An employee delivering mail was walking when he fell on loose gravel and broke his hip.
An employee was injured while working on a trailer. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell, suffering an injury to the left hip.
An employee fell 17 feet to the floor below while releasing a load of steel decking that had been hoisted by a crane. The employee suffered broken bones and internal injuries.

An employee was on a ladder checking the framing on a church's roof when the employee slipped from the ladder and fell approximately 6 feet. The employee was hospitalized with three cracked vertebrae and three broken ribs.
On September 17, 2019, an employee collapsed while loading gallon jugs into a pickup truck. The employee's head hit the ground and the employee was hospitalized with a head fracture.

A temporary employee was operating a power folder when the equipment was activated via the foot pedal. Two of the employee's fingers were then caught under the clamp, crushing the fingertips and resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on sauce that had been spilled on the floor and fell flat on his back. He suffered a collapsed right lung.
An employee was loading chemicals into a pickup when he slipped and fell to the ground. He suffered a dislocated shoulder and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee lost his balance while moving a tire and fell, striking his right forearm on a steel plate.
An employee was working in the freezer/cooler area when he incurred frostbite to his right ring finger and middle finger.

An employee was walking down a driveway. Her left foot hit raised pavement and she fell. Both her knees, both her hands, and her face struck the ground; she suffered a broken left patella, a sprained left wrist, and bruising under her lips.
An employee was hospitalized after a fight in a parking lot.
An employee was using a spot welder to weld two 10-inch rings. His right index finger was pinched in the welder and the tip was amputated.
An employee was making an adjustment on a piece of machinery when his left index finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was attempting to clear a blocked grease line by injecting steam into the line. Pressure overcame the seal on the lid and ejected hot grease onto the employee's shoulder and arm. The employee sustained second degree burns to the top of the shoulders and the right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
On September 17, 2019, an employee was working when she experienced an allergic reaction to an unknown substance, requiring hospitalization.
An employee walking on the sidewalk was struck by a car as it was coming out of a garage. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
An employee was loading a truck when the employee's left ring finger was caught in the truck's lift gate, resulting in a finger amputation.

While performing a break-out and disassembling equipment on-site, an employee removed the meter cover. Then, while removing the bypass blades with pliers and a screwdriver, the screwdriver contacted the meter box, causing an arc flash. The employee sustained second degree burns on his face, chest, and left hand, and sustained a second/third degree burn on his right hand.

A border patrol agent was working at an access control check point when a driver in a stolen vehicle ran the checkpoint, blew out his tires, and attempted to escape down the road. The agent was chasing the driver on foot across the roadway median when the agent was struck by an 18-wheeler. The employee suffered a broken lower right leg and required a right leg amputation below the knee.
An employee's left hand was pinched between the forks of a forklift and a trash hopper, resulting in an amputation of the left pinky finger above the first joint.
An employee was walking in the parking garage and fell. Her right knee cap was fractured and required surgery.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder changing a light bulb. When he started to dismount, he shifted his weight and the ladder slid out from under him. He impacted the tile floor and suffered a broken right arm, three fractured ribs, a broken collarbone, a broken cheek bone, and a broken eye socket.
An employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder to the ground about 10 feet below. Both his heels were broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was trying to dislodge the lift gate on the rear of a delivery truck. The gate abruptly dropped on the employee's left hand and injured it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee's finger was caught in a molding machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On September 18, 2019, an employee was about to remove a 1.5 gate bilge valve inside a vessel's engine room (offshore towing vessel) when he collapsed and then regained consciousness. He was hospitalized due to dehydration (heat stress).
An employee was using an electric food slicer when it caught his left ring finger and amputated the tip.
While engaged in horseplay, an employee fell from trusses to the second floor. The employee suffered a torn liver and a broken jaw, and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on an uneven sidewalk and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left wrist, a broken neck vertebra, and a laceration to the left temple.
An employee's right hand was caught between a guard and a band mill. The employee's middle finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was struck in the leg by pieces of a tire that ruptured while being filled with air. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a ladder painting the inside of an apartment room. The employee opened the lid of a paint remover and inhaled the vapors, causing a burning sensation to the employee's throat.

An employee was carrying a 24-inch gasket on cardboard wrapped with plastic on the tips of his fingers. The wrapped gasket slipped out of his hand, and he struck a work bench and then fell to the floor. He suffered a fractured ball joint in his right hip.

An employee was climbing out a window and onto a roof ledge when he slipped. While trying to hold on and break his fall, his right forearm contacted glass from a possible broken window and was lacerated.

On September 19, 2019, an employee was about to remove a 1.5 gate bilge valve inside a ship vessel's engine room (offshore towing vessel) when he collapsed and then regained consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.
While following an excavator, guiding in new material, an employee became disoriented and collapsed due to heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing out a 2.5-pound CO2 canister for a kombucha kegerator when the replacement canister involuntarily went off due to a gas release and flew into the employee. The canister struck the employee's right foot and split it open, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
While unloading packages from the rear door of a truck onto a dolly, an employee became ill and experienced cramping, nausea, and pain. He was hospitalized for dehydration and acute kidney failure.
An employee became ill from heat exposure while working at a substation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a tortilla mixer when the machine turned on. His right arm was then caught in the machine, resulting in a broken bone above the right wrist.
An employee fell about 7 feet from a roof to the ground, suffering head, rib, and hand injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to install a main landing gear when his finger was caught between the gear lube and trunnion lube, resulting in left middle and ring fingertip amputations.

An employee completed repairs on a potato cleaning machine and was climbing to the top of the machine to remove a rock. The employee then fell into the machine, and the employee's arm was drawn in between the metal and rubber rollers. The employee's arm was crushed up to the bicep.

An employee was changing the saw blade on a piece of machinery. A tool fell onto the machine, causing it to activate, and the blade amputated the employee's middle and ring fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee was attempting to move a 3,000-pound forklift battery when his right index finger was caught between the battery and the battery housing, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was refueling his equipment (track-hoe) when he noticed a few sparks occur once he touched the fuel nozzle to the neck of the fuel tank opening. He went to pull the nozzle out and a burst of flames shot out, causing burns on his right arm and the right side of his face.
An employee fell backwards and struck the back of his head. He was later hospitalized for internal head bleeding.

On September 18, 2019, at approximately 20:30 hours, an employee was replacing three fluorescent light units with LED light units in the HR office. The lights were turned off using two toggle switches, but were still energized. While installing the second LED light unit, the employee sustained an electric shock, second degree burns to his right hand, and a labral tear and crushing injury to the right shoulder.
An employee was putting carboard boxes into a compactor when he became dizzy and fell, striking his head on the ground.
After repairing a ceiling from a ladder, an employee was found on the floor with one leg in the ladder rung. The employee was hospitalized with a forehead laceration and left leg and back injuries.
An employee was installing siding at an apartment complex when he became dizzy and fell off the roof, hitting his head and injuring his neck. He was hospitalized.

On September 18, 2019, a maintenance employee was installing panels for new warehouse racking from a scissor lift when a panel fell, flipping the employee out of the scissor lift. The employee hit the concrete floor and suffered head and back injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting wood for a residential deck using a chop saw. The saw amputated his left thumb.

On September 18, 2019, an employee was removing rust from a round stock with emery paper while the part was turning on a lathe when the employee's glove was caught on the round stock, resulting in hand injuries.
An employee was working on a ladder painting the exterior of a building when the ladder slid out and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg.
An employee fell off a horse, suffering three broken ribs and a collapsed lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading parts from a window staking press when the machine amputated the tip of her right ring finger.
Two employees were removing a cutter bar from a soybean header. The bar slid into one employee's right hand, amputating the little finger.

An employee was pushing an engine block onto a conveyor when their right thumb was pinched between the engine block and a clamp inside a machine. The employee sustained a laceration and an open fracture to the thumb.

An employee was measuring the 4x4 posts of a staircase. The employee was squatting down on the sixth or seventh step from the bottom, with his back facing down the stairs, looking at the condition of the soil under the stairs. While he was doing so, the ball of his foot slipped off the leading edge of the step, causing him to lose his balance and fall backwards to the bottom of the staircase and onto the pavement. He landed on his left side, sustaining contusions to the left hip and left shoulder as well as a sprain to the lower back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to tow a baggage cart. The cart disengaged from the forklift, and he left the forklift to stop the cart from rolling down a ramp. The forklift struck him from behind, breaking his left ankle.

During their work shift, three employees were involved in horseplay that progressed into an altercation. One employee threw a pair of scissors at another employee, puncturing his arm and causing vascular and muscular damage. The injured employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a sheet metal folding machine. The machine activated and crushed the employee's hands, causing the amputation of three fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from plaster scaffolding to repair a 9-foot ceiling. The employee fell about 3.75 feet from the scaffolding to the cement floor, suffering several broken ribs, a punctured right lung, and a broken pelvis.
On September 18, 2019, an employee was directing a fork truck operator and was struck by the forks, suffering a broken right lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee walking towards a patient's home stepped onto a curb, tripped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm, and pain in the left shoulder, elbow and knee.

A maintenance employee was trying to clear a mail jam from a machine when the conveyor pulled his right arm into the machine. He suffered a broken humerus bone to his right arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was installing a turret wheel on a tablet machine. When the employee was moving the machine into position, it activated and a punch came down on his right ring finger. The fingernail was partially removed, with no loss of bone.

An employee was showing another employee how to conduct a test on a machine when the employee's right hand entered the machine. The employee's fingers were caught between a roller and belt, crushing the right middle and ring fingers and resulting in a ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was trying to free a pipe on a horizontal directional drill when the pipe shifted, catching the employee's finger between the drill pipe and the frame of the unit and resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a conveyor belt assembly. The employee's finger was caught by a belt and hit a pulley, causing an avulsion to the left index finger.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken nose and a swollen, bruised right eye.
An employee was cleaning a spill bucket at a fuel station. A truck struck her and threw her 8-10 feet. She suffered a head laceration, a broken collarbone, and a dislocated hip.
An employee was helping move cows into a milking parlor. A cow spooked and turned quickly, pinching the employee's hand against the gate. The tip of his left ring finger was amputated.

Employees were installing a 36-inch auger bore under a railroad. A 40-foot 
length of casing and auger had just been lowered so it could be connected to the previously installed length. The casing moved unexpectedly and pinched an employee's left thumb between a block of wood and the boring machine. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the thumb.

An employee was placing steel abutments onto a sled (a setup and transportation tool) using a hoist. Two abutments were being lifted in the hoist. As the employee placed one of them, the second one swung back toward it, pinching the employee's left ring finger between the two. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing exploratory surgery.
An employee was operating a shear on the continuous rolling mill. While a steel bar was being cut on the shear, it pivoted and struck the employee, fracturing their left arm.
An employee was operating a hydraulic jig and positioning a plate for tack welding when the hydraulic ram actuated the swing clamp. The swing clamp amputated the employee's right pinky fingertip.
An employee's foot was caught in a door and a bone in the foot was broken. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee climbed onto a collector conveyor belt to pry a large rock out from under a feeder grate. The plant was started and the employee was pulled down onto the conveyor under another feeder conveyor. He fell clear after about four seconds of the belt moving under him, having suffered several broken ribs and an internal injury.
An employee was performing an oil change when he slipped and fell to the floor, hitting the back of his head. He suffered a concussion.
An employee was exposed to latex balloons in a conference room and had an anaphylactic reaction.

The injured employee was building scaffolding in a stairwell when another employee approached from behind, struck him in the back of the head and then pushed him down the stairs, approximately 6 feet. The injured employee was hospitalized with a subdural hematoma, lacerations to the back of the head, lacerations to the face/lips, and contusions to the back.
An employee was replacing a separator cap on a back engine on a sweeping truck when the blades on the radiator fan amputated two of the employee's fingertips.
An employee was transferring xylene (a solvent) from tanks into a mixer. The xylene splashed on the employee, injuring the employee's face and eyes.
While repairing a stuck/clogged valve, an employee fell 8 to 9 feet from a ladder and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left leg.
While loading angle into a machine for cutting, an employee's finger was pinched between the angle being loaded and the machine's clamp resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.

An employee had been washing the covered area of the parking lot. The employee was coming down an extension ladder and fell about 6 feet to the ground. The employee sustained two fractured vertebrae in their back.

On September 19, 2019, an employee was guiding a piece of product being lifted by an overhead crane. The employee's hand was crushed between two pieces of product; the employee suffered a broken finger and needed stitches.
An employee operating a horizontal band saw contacted the blade and sustained a finger amputation.
An employee tripped over fixed equipment, falling to the floor and striking the equipment. His face and shoulder were injured, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was using a cutter to cut ducting. The cutter amputated the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell on asphalt sustaining a fractured hip and bruises to the hand and elbow.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder when it slid on the floor. The employee fell to the floor, suffering an open fracture of the right tibia and a dislocated right ankle.
An employee was hospitalized after a welding wire poked through his welding glove causing an infection of the finger.

An employee was moving 20-hp electric motor weighing approximately 280 lbs. The employee was sliding the motor on the floor in the storage area using their foot and guiding it with their hands. The employee's finger was pinched between the shaft of the motor they were moving and a stationary motor resulting in an amputation of the left pinky finger.

An employee was injured when a forklift drove over their left foot, causing the employee to buckle, and then the forklift drove over their lower right leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right tibia.
An employee was unstrapping a pipe rack when it fell over on the employee, who suffered fractured vertebrae.

An employee was driving a forklift, moving coiled steel. The employee dismounted the forklift and went to roll the coil to reset it. The 1,520-pound coil rolled toward him, over his ankle, causing a compound fracture and lacerations.
An employee was working on an overhead power line from the bucket of an aerial lift. The line touched his hands, burning them. They were amputated at the hospital.
An employee was running a tufting machine when it crushed the employee's left index finger.

An employee was pouring molten steel into a mold. Some of the steel passed through a trench cover's lifting holes and came into contact with water. This created superheated steam, which caused the molten steel to spray back through the holes onto the employee. The employee suffered second-degree burns on 18 percent of the body: arms, upper front torso, face, and mouth.
An employee fell from a roof to a lower-level roof 12 to 15 feet below when a lifeline broke. The employee suffered a fractured collarbone and wrist and bruised ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was sealing the roof vent on a grain bin (about 24 feet above the ground) for fumigation. The weld holding the employee's fall protection anchor point failed; the employee fell from the roof of the bin, suffering broken bones in the ankle, heel, and pelvis on the left side.
An employee was working near a conveyor belt system when their left ring finger and middle fingertip were amputated by the conveyor.
An employee was cutting off floor decking with a circular saw. The saw kicked back and cut into the joint of his left index finger.

An employee and a co-worker were installing conveyor equipment at the worksite. The injured employee's right hand became caught in the belt of a conveyor while it was moving. Multiple fingers and a thumb were amputated.

On September 19, 2019, an employee was conducting nursing activities inside the facility. Chemicals being used on the roof of the facility were pulled into the ventilation system and the employee suffered an allergic reaction.
An employee was cutting a large piece of metal with a torch. The lines that supplied gas to the torch burst into flames, causing first- and second-degree burns to the employee's thighs and abdomen.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground, suffering a broken ankle and broken vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.

On September 20, 2019, an employee was operating a runoff machine. The fiberglass material started to bind up. As the employee was correcting the issue, his left hand entangled in the fiberglass strands. The strands pulled his hand in, resulting a partial amputation of the thumb.
While loading/offloading a truck, an employee's hand was caught between a skid tote and a pipe. The employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was clearing the conveyor belt that fed an auto shredder. A piece of rebar stuck in the conveyor struck the employee's lower left leg, breaking it.
An employee was moving mail from a flat sorter area to a trolley. As he left the flat sorter area, he tripped over an all-purpose-container and fell to the ground, breaking his left hip.
An employee was changing a tire. The employee's right leg was pinned and lacerated between the tire-changing machine and the automobile.
An 18-inch pipe rolled off the forks of a loader when the clamps were lowered. Two employees' legs were pinned between the pipes.
An employee was stringing material on a line. She was pulled into a roller and suffered finger fractures and third-degree burns. She was hospitalized.

An employee was using a crane to move a 6,000-pound piece of equipment into another piece of equipment. The first piece did not fully go inside the second, causing the nylon lifting straps to loosen and making adjustments necessary. As the employee made adjustments, the 6,000-pound piece suddenly dropped into the other piece; the nylon straps tightened on the lifting bail ring and crushed the employee's fingers.
An employee was changing a fan belt on an HVAC unit when his left hand got caught up in the belt. The tip of his index finger was amputated.
An employee was run over by a skid steer, suffering a fracture to his right lower leg.
An employee was picking up an object off the ground. A forklift backed into the employee, lacerating the employee's right leg.
An employee was caught between a beam and an aerial lift, suffering a fractured top rib and a bruised shoulder.
