An employee was scanning boxes as they came off a truck. Her foot slipped between the loading dock and the trailer, and her leg was broken in multiple places.

A driver climbed on top of a garbage truck to close the doghouse door on the compactor. He slipped and fell, suffering a broken right wrist, a compound fracture above his right elbow, and a dislocation to the elbow. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A stack of about 20 pieces of plywood fell on an employee's left leg, scraping the entire and landing on the left ankle. Both bones in the employee's lower leg were broken.

An  employee was using a chop saw to cut boards. A board jammed. As he was clearing the jam, his right hand came in contact with the blade, resulting in the amputation of his middle and index fingers at the first joint. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was moving a block of expanded polystyrene foam from a tilt table with a cart. The block started moving toward him, causing him to fall to the ground. He suffered a broken right femur and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee stepped off a ladder onto a roof and fell about 10 feet. He suffered forehead lacerations, a broken right forearm, a broken left shoulder, a broken rib, and a broken nose. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the forearm.

An employee was pulling a 700- to 800-pound rigging hoist, which was on a four-wheel cart, out of a test fixture. The cart caught the side of the fixture and the hoist slid off it onto the employee's steel-toed boot. The employee suffered a fracture and laceration to the foot, as well as a knee contusion. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee inhaled chlorine from chlorine tablets he was retrieving. The next day, on reporting to work, he experienced burning in his throat and lungs when taking deep breaths. He was hospitalized.

An employee was dragging cut brush and forming a pile. The employee was using a chainsaw to cut up the brush. The chainsaw kicked back and cut the employee's right thigh and right arm. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was loading well pipe into a trough when it bounced and dropped on his right index finger. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
At about 9:30 a.m. on September 20, 2019, an employee was about to cut a board on a table saw when the sawblade amputated the first and fifth digits of the employee's right hand.

At about 9:30 p.m. on September 20, 2019, an employee was entering a hospital's behavioral health unit in response to an alarm. A patient struck him in the face, causing severe facial injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a forklift truck. A nylon cord that was wrapped around the employee's left hand became caught under the forklift's tire, causing the partial amputation of the hand.

An excavator was being used to remove a handrail attached to the bridge sidewalk. The handrail struck an employee in the head, causing a skull fracture and a broken rib. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out dough at a conveyor belt. The belt caught the employee's left arm, causing it to strike a roller assembly. The arm was broken.

An employee was standing in a community center when someone at her side tripped on the wheel of a rolling walker and fell against her left knee area. She suffered a broken shinbone and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance work on a diesel generator's turbo chamber when the employee's hand entered the chamber to see if the turbo was functioning properly. The generator then amputated the employee's left pinky fingertip.

An employee was unloading a truck with a stand-up forklift. The forks went beneath the rack footings and the forklift continued forward into the rack. The employee was crushed between the forklift and the racking, suffering three broken ribs, two fractured vertebrae, and internal bleeding.

An employee was bending down, reaching through a tower frame for a work platform to bind straps and frames together in preparation for shipping. The frame flipped over and landed on his left ankle, dislocating and fracturing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a chute for cattle movement. A steer reversed course and hit a cattle gate. The gate hit the employee, who then struck a secondary gate.
An employee was repairing the drive unit on a lint beater. The machine was reactivated and its belt caught the employee's right ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut out foam for packaging. The sawblade came into contact with the employee's left index finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was helping install an aboveground storage unit. While the employee was helping lift two 26,000-pound panels, his left thumb was caught and amputated between the panels.
An employee slipped and fell, suffering a contusion and an open wound.
An employee operating an electric pallet jack crashed into a rack, resulting in a foot injury.
An employee was lifting a flood gate when it dropped onto his right toes. One of the toes was amputated.
An employee fell from a bicycle to the ground while conducting trail maintenance operations, fracturing the right arm.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in reverse while carrying a load. The employee was caught between the forklift and the racking system, suffering a broken rib.
An employee was cutting bands on a pallet when he tripped and fell, breaking his right hip.

An employee was dismantling equipment for scrap removal. As he was about to remove a motor from a height adjustment rack, the motor slid down the track and struck his left ring finger. He suffered a partial amputation and was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a landscaping crew. The employee suffered a separated shoulder with a possible chest contusion while pulling a seedling.
An employee was changing dies on a press. The upper die slipped out and crushed the employee's right ring finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was providing roadside assistance in a highway breakdown lane. A passing vehicle struck the employee's vehicle, and he suffered a spinal injury, a punctured lung, and internal bleeding. He was hospitalized.

An employee was aligning the wheels of an automobile on an alignment lift. The car rolled off the lift and into the garage door frame. The employee's left hand was caught between the automobile and the door frame; the ring finger and the tip of the little finger were amputated.
An employee was clearing broken sheet glass from a rack. A piece of the glass punctured the top of his right hand, lacerating a tendon.
An employee was picking cases in a dairy refrigerator. As the employee walked towards a pallet, boxes of product fell and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized for a crushed pelvis.

An employee stepped back into the aisle behind a cash register. Her heel caught part of a motorized cart, causing her to lose her balance and brace her right arm. Her right shoulder was dislocated. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the back of a restaurant when a man came in and stabbed the employee eight times.

An employee was scanning dog food with a hand scanner when the employee turned and the employee's foot became caught underneath a kick plate. The employee fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured femur.

A maintenance technician was replacing a hydraulic hose on an extruder. An adjacent hot water hose burst at the connector, spraying him with 200-degree water. He suffered second-degree burns to his right arm, stomach, and right thigh and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out a fan belt in an overhead kitchen fan. The belt caught the employee's right middle finger, causing a laceration and partial amputation.

An employee was walking across the carwash bay just as a vehicle was exiting it and was struck. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and friction burns to the left shoulder, elbow, and ankle.
An employee was placing a shelf on a rack system when he lost balance and fell 4-5 feet from the rack to the warehouse floor, striking his head and sustaining a head contusion.
An employee was opening the lid of a trash bin when she fell about a foot to the asphalt. Both her wrists were broken.
An employee was walking on a lawn to make a delivery and fell into a 13-ft. sink hole. The employee sustained bruises.
An employee was working from a ladder when he fell to the ground, hitting his head and suffering temporary paralysis.
An employee was taking a law enforcement handgun training class. As she pulled the gun out of the holster it discharged, shooting the employee in the right calf.
An employee was coming upstairs from a basement when his foot was caught in a hole in a step. He fell backward and tore his quadriceps. He was hospitalized for surgery.

Three employees were detaching an elevated walkway from a tank battery. After being cut, the walkway gave way while two of the employees were on it, and they fell about 15 feet to the ground. One of them suffered a compound fracture to the right femur and a concussion. The other suffered a crushed left heel.
An employee tripped on a pallet while walking. He fell to the concrete, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was cutting small pieces of wood on a bandsaw. The saw amputated the tip of his left little finger.

An employee was operating a scissor lift from the ground using handheld controls. The lift turned and its right wheel struck the employee, breaking the tibia and another leg bone. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a ladder on the rear of a bobtail fuel truck. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
While trying to dislodge a stuck sling, a rigger was caught between two 24-inch pipes and suffered a pelvic fracture. The rigger was hospitalized.
Am employee was cleaning an open-top tank by filling it with water to flush it. The employee lost consciousness and her forehead struck the top of a gate valve, which caused a vertical laceration.

An employee was on a fiberglass extension ladder strapping electrical conduit to a hanger wall when the ladder slipped on the polished floor. The employee fell to the concrete floor and fractured a femur.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on equipment when a bolt dropped onto a moving chain and sprocket belt. He attempted to retrieve the bolt and his finger was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a partial amputation of his left pinky finger.
On September 23, 2019, a blow mold assembler suffered a crushing injury to her left middle finger in the nail area, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

At about 4:00 p.m. on September 23, 2019, an employee was moving a shoulder widener paving machine along a highway under construction. The machine rolled over the edge of the highway embankment, ejecting him. He suffered severe head and facial trauma and was hospitalized.
A machine operator was cleaning a glue pod when his right thumb became stuck. The motor caused the amputation of the thumb tip.
At about 4:11 p.m. on September 23, 2019, an employee was putting a rubber O-ring on a tire using a pry bar. The pry slipped and the wheel lock ring amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was getting into his truck when he fell and struck his head on the asphalt. He suffered a fractured skull and brain bleeding.

An employee was driving a trailer truck when it lost a tire. The employee left the vehicle and was trying to stop the tire from rolling into oncoming traffic when his right foot got caught in its rim. He fell on his left knee, suffering a fracture to the left leg.

An employee was removing a ring that had jammed inside the a bore grinding machine during setup. After the ring was retrieved, the machine loaded the next ring from above, pinching the employee's right index finger between the ring and the cylinder. Part of the inside tip of the finger was pinched off.
An employee was climbing down a ladder from the top of a trailer. He fell, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was walking through the shipping section of a warehouse. A forklift ran over the employee, who suffered a broken right leg, a broken left shoulder, and four broken ribs on the left side of her body. She was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a load for a truck. The employee's foot was caught between the pallet and the pallet jack. The foot was crushed and broken.
A door closed on an employee, bruising the employee's lower back and buttocks.

An employee was operating a forklift loaded with rebar. The front left wheel of the forklift hit a lower/uneven surface, causing the forklift to tip over. As the employee was getting away from the forklift, the fork or the rebar struck him and knocked him to the ground. He suffered a broken right femur, severe bruising of the right arm, and cuts and scratches on the face.
At about 8:00 a.m. on September 23, 2019, a doctor was bitten by a cat on the right wrist and hand while treating it. The wound became infected, and the employee was hospitalized later that evening.

An employee was removing an excavator bucket pin with a crowbar. The crowbar slipped and struck the employee, who fell and suffered a cut on the right side of his face, a broken nose, a possible broken right upper cheek, sore neck muscles, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a motor vehicle while flagging traffic. The employee suffered a broken leg.
While repairing a tin roof, an employee fell through a skylight to the concrete floor about 15 feet below.
An employee was unloading job material from the bed of a company vehicle when his left thumb was pinched between steel and the bed of the truck, resulting in a partial amputation.

On September 23, 2019, an employee was cleaning machinery after production had stopped. The employee was struck by the bone cannon hopper as it was being emptied, causing possible ruptured spinal disks.
An employee was inside a machine attempting to fix the glue mechanism when the machine activated. The machine's tray cut his lower left leg, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing near a low-pressure separator. A flash fire in the separator caused a hose to become detached. The hose struck the employee in the head. Fire was coming out of the hose when it became detached and the employee was burned on the head as well. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury and burns.
An employee fell, suffering an open wound to the lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was laying out hardware and preparing to lay out doors. Several doors came down and fell on his lower left calf area, breaking his tibia. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee fell from a bailer while operating it, landing on the ground or on equipment and suffering a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was flagging traffic when a truck ran over his left foot and ankle. The ankle was broken.
An employee was installing snow retention on a roof from a 16-foot ladder. The employee fell from the ladder, breaking one to three vertebrae.
An employee was climbing on a roof and slipped in wet coating, falling about 15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered arm and leg fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing out of a tractor trailer. The employee fell to the concrete dock floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell in a stairwell, landing on a hard surface and suffering a knee injury.

An employee was moving stone slabs from a forklift to a stacked pile of stone in a yard. The slabs began sliding off the forklift supports, and the employee's fingers were pinched between two of them. The fingertips were torn off, and the fingers were crushed and torn open from the fingernail about halfway down the fingers; no bone was involved.
Limestone panels were being set. A 1,200-pound panel fell over and knocked over a ladder, which in turn struck an employee and pinned him to the ground. He suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was securing a load on a flatbed truck that had a crane attached along with portable forks. A fork fell on the employee's leg, causing an injury to the heel that required surgery.

A nurse was helping a patient (who was sitting on a 3-foot-high-stretcher) sit up and get off the stretcher. She was pulling up on the patient when she felt a pop in her lower back. She was hospitalized, with back pain radiating to her right leg.

An employee was climbing a portable ladder. The ladder slipped and the employee fell onto a shovel 4 or 5 feet below, suffering bruised ribs and a partially collapsed right lung. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee exited a truck, which then rolled over him. The employee sustained injuries to the skull and legs.

An employee was inspecting a fan assembly. The fan belt had been pulled, and the employee was checking fan blade rotation, when the employee's right hand was caught in the belt and pulley system. The right ring finger and the tip of the little finger were amputated.
An employee was working in a grease manufacturing area. The employee became nauseated, suffering lightheadedness and leg cramping. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was moving a pump motor when it fell on his foot, breaking it.
An employee was walking into work through the employer's parking garage and tripped over a low-profile cargo cart. The employee sustained a left ankle fracture.
While doing scaffold work, an employee became overheated and started cramping. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in a grocery store, falling to the floor. The suffered a broken tailbone, a broken rib, and a head contusion.
On September 24, 2019, an employee was climbing out of the cab of a truck when he fell to the asphalt/concrete ground, striking his head.
An employee fell from the back of a propane delivery truck to the ground, suffering head and neck injuries.
An employee was moving trays onto a production line. The cart shifted and trays landed on his left ankle, causing a fracture/dislocation. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping another employee troubleshoot a ceiling-mounted VAV box on a 6-foot step ladder. He was shocked and fell about 3 feet to the floor, suffering back injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was sorting potatoes on a conveyor. The chain from the conveyor's chain drive struck and avulsed the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was grinding a piece of metal on a bench grinder. His right hand was caught in the grinder and the thumb was amputated near the first joint.

An employee was installing cable along the exterior of a residential building from a 24-foot extension ladder. The ladder twisted and the employee fell about 10 feet to the ground, suffering a facial laceration and foot, back, and upper torso/rib injuries.
An employee was trying to lay metal flat on a cooling table from a safety basket. The arm of a tail stretcher machine caught the employee's right leg and broke the thigh.
Employee was loading sheet metal into a press die. The die activated, caught the employee's hand, and crushed it. The employee was hospitalized.
While repairing a roof, an employee fell from the roof and suffered a shattered heel, a broken ankle, and a hairline fracture to the knee. The employee was hospitalized.
At 8:00 a.m. on September 24, 2019, an employee was pushing a garbage cart. The employee tripped on the cart's lid and fell forward into the cart, suffering breaks to the nose and orbital bone.
An employee fell while walking in the chiller room. He broke his ankle and fibula.

An employee was driving a scissor lift into a warehouse. The lift jolted and the employee fell out, suffering a cut above the right eyebrow and a dislocated left elbow with two broken pieces of bone. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A door closed on an employee's left middle finger, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was pulling a slide arm from a cold run rig cart. An adjacent cart pinched the slide arm the employee was pulling, causing the amputation of the employee's fingertip.
An employee was welding near another employee who was using a hand grinder. The grinder wheel struck the employee, breaking the employee's femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was chopping cilantro with a chef's knife. The knife amputated about 1/4 inch of his right index fingertip.

A public safety officer was responding to a motor vehicle accident. An electric crosswalk signal had been severed at the base and suspended over the road by a single cable. While trying to move it so it would not fall onto the road, the officer was shocked, suffering pain and numbness in his left ring and little fingers.

An employee was bringing a high chair to a table when she stumbled and fell to the floor, hitting her face and arm. She was hospitalized with a broken nose, broken ribs, and a shattered elbow, requiring surgery.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet from a roof onto stored material on the ground, suffering a broken arm, rib, and foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it struck another forklift. The employee was ejected and crashed into the floor, suffering a deep gash to the left thigh and lacerations under his chin and on his ear.

An employee was grinding down a casting when the grinding wheel exploded, striking and cutting his left leg. He fell backward and broke his tibia in two places. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was trying to remove a chip tray from the bottom of a drilling machine. The machine injured the top of the employee's right hand and the tips of four fingers.

On September 25, 2019, an employee was on a roof of a commercial metal building, straightening out the roofing insulation. He fell though the roof to the concrete floor 16 feet below and hit his head on a steel girder, suffering head trauma. He was hospitalized.

An employee took a drink from a water bottle and his mouth and throat started burning. The water bottle contained a chemical instead of water and the employee suffered chemical burns to the mouth, throat and esophagus.
An employee was operating a flexible-shaft grinder. Fan blades inside the machine's motor caused the partial amputation and non-displaced fracture of his left middle finger.

Three employees were removing and cleaning equipment and fixtures and tidying up a restaurant that had been closed recently. A gasoline-powered pressure washer was in use near the back door of the restaurant. Carbon monoxide from the machine entered the building, causing all three workers to become lightheaded. One of them lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting and draining a pipe that connected to a mixing tank when an unknown corrosive liquid caused a chemical burn to the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was retrieving something from the top shelf of a shelving unit. The employee fell, and the top shelf caught her ring and pulled her finger off.

On September 25, 2019, an employee was pushing a rail cart (holding steel) through a single exit door. The cart became jammed in the doorframe. The employee's finger was caught between the doorframe and the cart, and the employee's right little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was blowing out a clogged grease line. The line burst and the grease caused second-degree burns to the back of the employee's neck and both ears.
An employee had been doing lawn care work when he felt pain in his abdomen that radiated to his hip and right leg. He developed a rash and was hospitalized, suffering from cellulitis.

On September 25, 2019, an employee was working at a metal detector in an icings, fillings, and mixes room. As the employee was removing product, a valve closed on the top of the employee's left middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was inspecting fan belts and bearings. The employee's right middle finger was pinched between the belt and the sheave, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was riding a company owned shuttle bus from the hospital building to a personal vehicle located in the company parking lot. The employee slipped on the steps while exiting the shuttle bus and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a right hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was clearing a film jam on a bagger. The bagger's jaws closed on the employee's left index finger, causing an amputation. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down stairs while exiting a freezer. The employee fell. The employee's head struck the walking/working surface, causing brain bleeding.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a 1,000-plus-pound roll (in a cardboard box, with a piece of wood blocking the center of the roll). As the roll was being lifted, it shifted and started to fall. The end of the roll struck the employee's left middle finger, causing a soft tissue amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was moving a patient when he felt a pop and burning in his abdomen, followed by stomach pain. He was hospitalized with an umbilical hernia.
An employee was cutting a pressurized 16-inch PVC water line with a chop saw. The line exploded and the employee suffered a fractured pelvis and other injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a skid steer fork attachment that was on a trailer. The attachment rocked back and pinched the employee's left middle finger between the forks and the trailer. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was standing next to a pile of mortar bags. An excavator struck the employee, breaking the employee's right leg.
An employee was cutting pork on a slicer. The blade caught the employee's glove/finger, causing a partial amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was installing fall protection anchor points on a roof. The employee fell to the ground about 20 feet below, breaking both legs.
An employee was using a T-post driver to set posts around a proposed excavation site. The employee's right thumb was crushed between the driver and a post. He was hospitalized.
An employee was hit by a fleeing shoplifter's vehicle and sustained an injury to her head.
An employee was trying to remove a rattlesnake from a worksite when it bit him.
An employee tripped over a doorstop while walking into a door walkway. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a hip injury.

An employee was checking the source of dripping water on dust collector equipment after cleaning, before production start up. While the employee's right hand was below a vacuum air rotary valve on the bottom end of the dust collector's filter unit (about 3 feet above the floor), air flow moved the employee's right middle finger upward into an internal rotating component. The employee's fingertip was lacerated.

On September 25, 2019, a warehouse worker was picking up products on the floor when a forklift struck his right ankle while turning into a rack slot. The employee's right ankle was broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell from the forks of a powered industrial truck to the concrete ground. The employee suffered wrist and head injuries.
An employee was walking through a warehouse when a forklift ran over her right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was scraping the underside of a conveyor when his right arm was pulled into the roller. Both bones in the forearm were broken.

An employee was refueling a small boat. The employee was checking the battery connections to the fuel pump when gasoline vapors flashed, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's arm and head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee 's left thumb was caught in a safe door as it closed. He suffered an avulsion to the thumb tip.
An employee was back-stocking merchandise and fell off a ladder. The employee suffered a broken leg and displaced knee.
On September 25, 2019, an employee picked up a container of product and suffered a disc herniation and arm numbness.
An employee was loading food into a dumbwaiter. The dumbwaiter's doors smashed the employee's right thumb while closing.
An employee was operating a side puller that removes animal hides when his hand was caught in the gripper, resulting in amputations of the fourth and fifth fingertips.
An employee was hit by a pallet jack while operating a forklift. The employee suffered a broken collarbone and was hospitalized.
A truck driver was using a supermarket restroom when someone stabbed him in the right shoulder and right side. He was hospitalized.
An employee was entangled in the cable for a crane when the grapple shifted. Both of his legs were amputated.

An employee was repairing siding on a residential home. As the employee was climbing down the ladder, it slid out from under him and the employee fell onto the wooden deck. The employee suffered a hip injury.

An employee was moving a stand-up forklift off a dock leveler when the forklift drove off the dock. The employee jumped from the forklift and landed on the concrete ground approximately 4 feet below the dock. The employee suffered a broken right leg just above the ankle.

An employee was closing a window blind in a nursing resident's room. The blind pulled out of the snaps and separated from the holder, falling and hitting the employee in the head. The employee suffered a concussion and a laceration to the right eye, requiring stitches.
An employee had an asthma attack at work after breathing in a chemical in the floor wax.
A wire used for towing wrapped around an employee's lower leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was sorting on a conveyor line. PVC mini blinds were coming down the belt when one became caught in the belt and then struck the employee in the center of his chest, causing contusions.

An employee was standing on top of a 7-foot-tall machine, cleaning it. He fell off the edge and landed on the ground, suffering two fractured vertebrae in his neck, a fractured left radius and left wrist, and head lacerations.
An employee fell out of the bucket of a mini-loader and was run over, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was operating a machine when the tip of his glove became caught in the rollers, resulting in the amputation of his left small fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell while walking, striking their right elbow on a pipe. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking to see if feed was coming out of a machine when the fins on the feeder amputated her third and fourth fingers at the first knuckle on the left hand.

Four employees were working on cable pairs, doing aerial work. One of them was 20 feet up on a ladder that was leaning on a strand. The strand gave way and the employee fell with the ladder, suffering a closed fracture of a lower-back vertebra.
Doors fell over an employee while being unstrapped. The employee suffered lacerations to an ear.
An employee fell forward as he stepped up from the dirt to a concrete pad. He hit a steel wall and suffered a dislocated right shoulder and a severe laceration on the right elbow.

An employee was troubleshooting the waste conveyor of a flatbed die cutter, trying to find a squeaking roller. His right hand was caught between a roller and the belt. He suffered a fracture to the neck of the fifth metacarpal bone, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on an overhead walkway when the employee fell approximately 20 feet through grating to the concrete floor of an empty water tank. The employee broke both ankles.

An employee was attempting to realign the overwrap on a muffin overwrap machine when the employee's right middle fingertip was amputated by the machine's jaws. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a drill with a brush attachment. The power cord wrapped around the tool, causing amputations to the employee's right-hand fingers at the first joints.

An employee was replacing a bearing on a pulley. While the employee was lifting the centering roller, the conveyor belt pinched the employee's left middle finger. The finger was surgically amputated at the first digit.

An employee was evaluating metal floor grates in a stairway platform. The employee attempted to reset a metal floor panel in the stairway platform when the grate broke free. The employee's thumbs were crushed between the dislodged grate and a cement step. Both thumbs were amputated.

An employee was standing next to scaffolding, waiting for a concrete pour. A wheelbarrow, being used to move bricks from one side of the scaffolds to the next, became unbalanced. It leaned sideways and the top layer of brick fell out of the wheelbarrow and off the scaffold, striking the employee about 45 feet below. The employee suffered a broken left humerus.

An employee was helping a millwright install the bottom block of the wire-pulling device on a wire-drawing machine. The employee was holding onto the 400-600 pound block, trying to straighten it so it would continue traveling down its shaft. The block unjammed and traveled 4-5 inches, injuring the employee's left middle finger in the nail area. The injury resulted in an amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee was moving a 40-foot-tall scaffold with rollers. The scaffold rolled over the employee's foot, causing lacerations and possible fractures.
A burst of chemical mixture splattered out of a foamer system. The foaming solution hit an employee in the face, causing throat and eye irritation.
An employee was moving mail across the work floor when a reversing forklift struck the employee. The employee suffered lacerations to the face and a broken ankle.

An employee was slitting a roll to a smaller size using a slitter. The employee's arm was pulled into the slitter, causing fractures to the right ulna and radius. The employee was hospitalized, requiring a surgical plate for one shattered bone.
An employee was attempting to hold a load-out hose when its valve opened, releasing pressure. The hose struck and broke the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was cutting into a shock absorber under pressure when a projectile struck and fractured the employee's arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was caught between two electric pallet jacks when one of them began moving. The employee suffered a broken right foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to put a numbered pinny on a person walking a horse as they were entering a paddock area before a race. The horse startled and kicked the employee in the face, breaking the employee's jaw. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck driver was mixing oil (heated at about 375-380 degrees) in his truck for road work. The oil sprayed the driver, burning his neck, forehead, and lower arms.
An employee was lowering supplies onto a truck and buggy drill. The employee slipped and fell onto the truck bed/rail, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was operating a paper folding machine when it pinched her finger. The tip needed to be amputated.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder to the ground, losing consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking from the parking lot to her building to report to work. She lost her footing on a 6-inch step and fell to the concrete surface, suffering a broken left hip, a broken rib, and two fractures in her lower back.
An employee was using a rebar bending machine. The machine activated, catching the employee's left hand in a pinch point. He suffered an amputation to the left ring finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wooden strapping for ceilings when a board kicked and the employee's hand struck the blade, resulting in severe hand/finger lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a circular saw. The saw kicked back out of the cut, causing the blade to cut through the employee's glove, cut the back of the employee's left hand/thumb, and broke the thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift, unloading a bobtail truck. The truck's back door had been unlatched and was being raised when the door handle caught the employee's finger. The employee suffered an amputation to the left index finger/left hand.

An employee was cleaning a line while waiting for maintenance to repair the machine. When she tried to remove scrap product from a roller, the cutter belt crushed her left arm, causing multiple fractures to her fingers.
An employee was operating a skid steer loader. The loader fell into a pit and the employee suffered broken ribs, a broken left hand, and a collapsed lung.

At about 10:15 a.m. on September 26, 2019, an employee was helping to set a manhole section on a site. The hook keeper on the chain sling broke, causing the manhole section to drop. The employee's left index finger and thumb were pinned between two manhole sections, suffering severe trauma.
An employee was riding in a golf cart when she fell off the cart and hit the ground, injuring her head and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a wood skid when the saw blade caught the employee's finger, resulting in a left pinky amputation.
An employee was mounting tires on a machine. The machine caught and tore the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a machine that applies coating to metal sheets used in the manufacture of steel pails. The employee attempted to clean the rear of a catch tray with a wiping rag. The rag entered a gap between the tray and the composite roller and became caught in an in-running nip point between two rollers. The employee's right hand was pulled into the rollers, resulting in a crushing injury. The machine was in motion at the time of the incident.

An employee was backing a mini-excavator out of a bay. The machine rotated and pinned his head between the cab and the bay door frame. He was bleeding from the ears. The employee was hospitalized and needed surgery to relieve pressure on his brain.
During his shift preparing cars for drivers outside in the sun, a temporary employee began to feel unwell. He was hospitalized, suffering from low blood pressure and heat exhaustion.
An employee was using an industrial paper cutter to trim labels and amputated his left index fingertip.

An employee was using a crowbar to lift the bottom mold to reach under it and screw on the eye bolt. The crowbar kicked out and the mold fell on the employee's left index finger causing a partial amputation.

An employee was climbing down a vertical ladder inside a tunnel pit. He fell about 10 feet to the bottom of the pit, landing on a steel plate and suffering fractures to the left and right foot and ankle.

An employee was operating a tube cut-off machine when there was a mis-cut resulting in a longer piece of tubing exiting the machine. The operator saw the mis-cut and reached to remove the tubing. The next tube to be cut struck the end of the tube the operator was trying to remove, causing the employee's fingers to be pinned between the end of the tube and the exit chute. The employee sustained amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was moving a piece of equipment using a forklift and sling. The equipment spun and struck the employee on the left hip, breaking the employee's pelvis.

An employee was standing between a forklift and an elevated bucket while trash was being dumped. The forklift operator drove the forklift into the employee and struck the employee's cell phone. The cell phone exploded, and the employee was pinned between the forklift and the wall. The employee sustained cuts and burns to the left gluteus.
An employee was driving a golf cart. The cart ran into a trailer, which knocked another trailer over. The employee was injured and was hospitalized.

Two employees were backing out a landing joint from a hanger using two chain tongues on each side. One of the employees suffered a back injury while pulling the equipment. He was hospitalized for a ruptured disk.

An employee was stenciling a roll of toilet paper on a tissue machine and went to remove the roll when his right middle finger was pinched between the pusher and paper, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing solar panels on a two-story residential house when the employee fell off the roof, suffering a broken pelvis, a broken wrist, broken ribs, and internal bleeding. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was loading an excavator onto a lowboy trailer. The employee's hand slipped while securing the thumb/bucket and the bucket fell on the employee's hand, crushing the fingers.
An employee was trying to free a chain from the end gate of a truck. The gate slammed shut on his left middle finger, amputating it.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift went off the road. The employee jumped from the forklift and was crushed by the forklift from the waist down.

On September 27, 2019, an employee's stand-up tugger was hit by another stand-up tugger. The employee fell to the ground when the tugger was hit. The employee was hospitalized with abdominal and left foot pain.

An employee was removing wood from behind a conveyor. The employee's hand struck the steel conveyor framing and the employee's lower left arm was broken. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was operating a bar bending machine when his finger was caught between the rebar and mandrel bender wheel, resulting in a right index finger amputation just above the first digit behind the fingernail.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down steps, fracturing the left ankle.

An employee was striking a suspended basket filled with bolts with a stick when a 48-inch anchor bolt flew out of the basket and struck the employee in the forehead, causing severe injury to the frontal lobe.
An employee tripped over a water hose and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was bending a 2-inch by 8-inch piece of metal with a press brake. The brake activated, causing partial amputations to all four fingers on the employee's right hand.

After installing scenic cabling into a concrete wall, an employee was descending a ladder when he lost his balance and fell. His right foot went between the first and second rungs of the ladder as he was falling, resulting in a broken right ankle.

An employee picked up a beverage bottle that had previously fallen from a janitor's cart and drank from it. The bottle contained a blue liquid that was a disinfectant cleaning solution. The employee suffered chemical burns to the throat and esophagus and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to move or operate an electric pallet jack parked near a doorway when she was struck/crushed by the pallet jack. She sustained multiple fractures in her right leg, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was painting from an extension ladder. The ladder fell and the employee fell with it, landing on the ground and suffering a broken nose, right wrist, and knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using an overhead crane with slings to separate granite slabs and inserting spacer blocks between the slabs. As the employee was inserting the spacer, the sling slipped, causing the slab to close against the separator block. The employee's left index finger was crushed between the slab and spacer block, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing a rubber band/gasket, on a battery-operated portable band saw, for the cutting blade to travel on, when his right index finger was caught by the rubber band/gasket, resulting in a fingertip amputation (no bone).
An employee tripped over a pallet, fell, and fractured their right wrist on the concrete floor.
An employee was exiting a semi deck when he fell from behind the semi cab and fractured his wrist and vertebra.
An employee was moving shoring jacks on a construction site when the employee's right middle finger was caught in a pinch point on the shoring machine, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was working on a hook lift roll-off truck. The employee tapped a steel plate with a hammer on the truck to get it to move and the plate dislodged, pinning his right hand and causing multiple fractures.
While performing cleanup operations at a job site, an employee became ill due to direct sun exposure, requiring hospitalization for heat stress.
An employee was loading a trailer. A cart crashed into a pallet jack and the employee's finger was crushed between the two, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was installing flashing and fell from a second-story roof to the ground and landed on their back and head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was getting a case of cooking oil off a storage rack to fill an order. As he pulled the case of cooking oil and twisted to place it on the cart, he felt and heard a pop in his hip. He sustained a broken right hip.
An employee was running the flex line in the re-hang department. While removing a chicken wing, the employee's hand was caught and the left middle finger was amputated by the wing saw.
An employee was loading boxes onto a mobile cart. After lifting a box, the employee suffered pain in the left side of their neck.
An employee was cutting the straps off of a bundle of wood in the lumber drive-thru when the knife went through a strap and caused a laceration and puncture to his left wrist.
While cutting a cardboard box with a safety knife on the receiving dock, an employee cut his left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for a severed artery.
An employee was helping a crane operator reposition a manhole cover when the hook of the crane broke. The employee suffered a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee had delivered mail to a residence and was walking back to his vehicle when a dog pushed through a security screen and attacked him. He suffered a severe dog bite on his left hand, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting wood with a jig saw when the blade hit a nail. The saw jumped and the blade contacted an artery in the employee's wrist requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was pulling tills out of a safe when she backed up and her foot was caught on the carpet. She fell backwards to the floor, fracturing her hip and requiring surgery.
On September 28, 2019, an employee was centering a print screen on a machine when the employee's right pinky finger was amputated above the first joint at the point of operation.
An employee was using a stand grinder to bevel a small piece of pipe in preparation for a welding test. The grinding wheel contacted his left middle finger resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was turning on a portable burner when a flash fire sparked due to a punctured butane can. The employee received severe burns to his face, chest, and arms.
An employee was repairing a mud flap on his truck while it was raining. Lightning struck in the area and the employee sustained tingling of the right side.

After using a hose to transfer asphalt from a distributor to a holding tank, an employee was removing the hose when the asphalt splashed him, burning his face, neck, arms, chest, and stomach. He was hospitalized.

While on a ladder, an employee was going to do a line break on a 2-inch PVC line of bleach (16% sodium hypochlorite) in order to repair a leak. The line was 8 feet above the ground. When the 2-inch PVC  line was cut, the employee came in contact with the bleach, sustaining chemical burns on the upper body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a walk-behind powered industrial truck (PIT) to move pallets onto a rack. The PIT ran over his foot fracturing his left big toe.

An employee was standing on the side of a skid plate while waiting for a welding box to be delivered. A second employee was driving a golf cart to bring the first employee the welding box. The welding box fell onto the accelerator pedal while the driver was approaching the first employee. The golf cart then struck the first employee on the back of his right leg and pushed him onto the skid plate. He sustained a fractured leg.

An employee was walking through an area with her supervisor when her leg made contact with a guarding sensor used to protect automobiles from contacting equipment. She fell to the floor and broke her left femur.
An employee was carrying out trash when she lost balance and fell onto the dumpster. She then fell backward striking her head on the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was hospitalized after receiving a bite from a cat undergoing veterinary care.
An employee was releasing a chain clamp on a two-way spreader used to lower a sheet pile when his finger was pinched between the chains and the sheet, resulting in a right index finger amputation.

An employee was draining waste vegetable oil from a fryer. The employee opened the spigot and allowed the used oil to drain. He shut off the spigot after the bucket was about 3/4 full and emptied the bucket into the 50-gallon wheeled collection bin. A fire started in the fryer and hot oil was expelled over the employee's feet, burning them.

An employee was walking to put something away when the employee tripped on a bench and fell the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right hip and possible head contusion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by a door's hinge as the door opened.
An employee was reaching for a pan on a shelf when a few other pans began to fall. She turned around in a hurry to catch them and tripped and fell, fracturing her right ankle.
An employee was walking toward the office when he tripped over a tote of merchandise and fell to the floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee was walking at a customer's garage when she lost her balance and fell to the floor, breaking her hip and femur.
An employee was removing a tire from a rim using a tire machine when the employee's left middle finger was pinched in the tire machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unlocking a saddle so it could latch around the pin that was holding it in place. When it was unlocked, it released down and caught and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee fell 14 feet to the ground while working on metal decking, suffering head injuries and fractured bones.
An employee was using a nylon strap to dislodge an internal clamp from a pipe when the nylon strap broke, allowing a metal rod being used to pull the clamp to swing and strike the employee's head.

An employee was troubleshooting the robotic welder. The employee was attempting to access the alignment of the welding tips when the pneumatic solenoid activated and his right index finger was caught between the welding tips resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was making a delivery to a restaurant when an unknown insect bit or stung the employee. The employee developed an infection and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a compact utility loader onto a trailer. The employee slipped off a ramp and the loader fell on the employee's leg, pinning it against the ramp. The employee was hospitalized with severe lacerations to the lower leg.
An employee was getting tools from a job box on a forklift when the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the ground below, suffering head injuries.
An employee was working on a concrete truck when the employee's hand was caught in a rotating mixer drum.
A logging employee was setting chokers when a log got hung up and the choker snapped back. The employee was hit by the choker and sustained seven broken ribs.
An employee became ill due to heat stress and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a jack hammer on the concrete floor on the upper level of the parking garage. The floor gave way and the employee fell. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and fractures.
An employee standing in the bucket of a tractor was trimming trees and fell approximately 3 to 4 feet from the bucket. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was machining a round bar when a nest of shavings started to build up. He reached over to turn the machine off when the shavings cut his left wrist, requiring hospitalization.
On 9/30/2019, an employee was walking when their foot caught on a floor tile that was slightly raised. The employee tripped and fell, hit their head, and was hospitalized.
An employee's left middle finger was amputated after becoming caught in a door.
On 9/30/2019, an employee was performing preventive maintenance on the conveyor belt to a shirt press. The moving conveyor amputated the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a skid steer when his right foot became stuck and was crushed between the bucket and a machine.

An employee stepped up onto the right side of a trailer's tire bar, which is 24.5 inches high, to set a deck pin. When the employee stepped back down, his left ankle twisted on the asphalt, causing him to fall on his back and strike the back of his head on the asphalt. He suffered a concussion, a laceration to the back of his head, and a sprained left ankle.
An employee slipped and fell on the ground, fracturing his right hip.
On September 30, 2019, an employee fell from a moving escalator during cleaning operations. The employee fractured his C-2 vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder removing product from a shelf when the shelf collapsed and threw the employee from the ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken right elbow.
An employee was putting napkins into an ironer machine when her left hand was caught on the rotating shaft and injured.
An employee was operating a standup powered industrial truck when he struck against the beam of a rack system, suffering broken ribs.

An employee was on a 28-foot ladder, installing cable on a pole on the street. The employee lost his grip on his meter, his left foot slipped, and he fell from about halfway down the ladder. The employee was injured and hospitalized.
An employee was assisting co-workers with installing a 5x10-foot glass whiteboard. The employee's fingertip was amputated by a sharp piece of metal backing that was on the whiteboard.
An employee was tying illumination electrical branches to an emergency system when the employee made contact with an energized source, suffering a 277-volt electric shock.

An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift tipped over. The employee's left leg and left hand were pinned under the forklift. The employee sustained a broken finger, torn ligaments, and a hyper-extended knee.

An employee was preparing to perform maintenance on a reach truck. While standing on the forks of the truck, the carriage lowered and struck the employee in the abdomen. The employee sustained injury to the intestines.
An employee was pressure washing and lost control of the belly pan and the hold-down loop which smashed their finger. The first digit of the right pinky finger was amputated.
On September 30, 2019, an employee was moving a microscope when he dropped it on his foot. He was hospitalized and required surgery for a foot injury.
An employee was cutting multiple wood 2x4's using a circular saw and amputated the left index finger above the first knuckle.

On 9/30/19, an employee went up the ladder of a separator tank. He was on top of the ladder when a pop-off valve released. He was exposed to gas and lost consciousness, falling 20 to 30 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured left fibula, fractured right hip, and ruptured kidney.

An employee was using a forklift to lift a splice box from a pit when the forklift tipped over into the pit. The employee was pinned against the splice box, suffering a fractured left forearm and elbow.

An employee was changing over a jig cart. The lock pin to hold the jig in place would not advance through the plate on the jig. When the lock pin became unstuck it crushed the employee's right middle fingertip resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working as a catcher, approximately 30 feet from the lumber molder machine. While the machine was idling, the employee was cleaning up behind the machine using an air hose and nozzle. At some point, the bottom head of the lumber molder machine activated and amputated the employee's right thumb and index finger from the middle knuckle up.

An employee was cutting small-diameter trees and shrubs with a chainsaw when he slipped on rocks. The saw contacted the bottom of his chaps, pulling them away from the back of his leg. The saw then contacted the back of his leg and cut his calf, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was building an 18-inch channel block in press brake. As he was making the second bend, his left hand went into a pinch point. The machine cycled and caused the amputation of three fingers on the left hand.
A temporary employee was operating a lawn mower when they slipped on wet grass and their right foot contacted the mower. The employee sustained a laceration to three toes and was hospitalized.
An employee was descending in a boom lift when the lift jolted and the employee hit his head on steel, sustaining a laceration by his ear and a vertebra injury.
An employee was operating a welding machine when their right middle finger was amputated by the machine.

While operating a walkie rider pallet jack and coming out of an aisle, a temporary employee collided with a reach forklift. The temporary employee was thrown from the walkie rider to the floor, suffering a back injury and broken leg. The temporary employee was hospitalized.
An employee was riding one of the horses at the stables and the horse bucked her off. The employee landed on the ground and was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and tailbone.

An employee was maneuvering a full 55-gallon drum of antifreeze. The employee went to let the drum back down to the floor and their right pinky finger was smashed between two 55-gallon steel drums. The right pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a hand tool to remove a fitting from a hot water heater when the employee's right hand slipped and contacted a razor knife, lacerating the right hand in the wrist area.
An employee tripped while heading into a hallway and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was performing maintenance on a steam valve when he was sprayed by the steam, receiving first and second degree burns on the arms and chest.
An employee was hospitalized after feeling dizzy and short of breath.
An employee fell off a flat roof or ladder while reaching for a paint sprayer, suffering a sprained left knee, dislocated left hip, and broken right ring finger.
A trench collapsed, trapping an employee inside. The employee suffered liver damage and three fractured vertebrae.
An employee was adjusting an air cylinder clamp on a table router. The clamp moved and struck the employee in the head, lacerating it.
An employee was providing maintenance on a primer paint booth when a drum up-ender came down on his hand, breaking his ring finger.

At about 3:30 p.m. on October 1, 2019, a processing blender was changing a soft-drink-making system over from clean-in-place to production. After he broke the line, the system discharged cool water (due to condensation), then steam. He suffered first- and second-degree burns to the chest and back and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was putting an 80-pound section of steel into place. The steel dropped onto him, breaking his wrist and ankle.
An employee was using a lifting magnet to lift a plate when the metal plate fell and crushed the employee's left index finger and thumb, resulting in fingertip and thumb tip amputations.

An employee was in his vehicle, making a package delivery, when someone robbed him and shot him with a shotgun. He suffered a gunshot wound, with a spray of pellets and debris affecting multiple parts of his body and body systems.
An employee used a bar stool to get on a bar top and dust light fixtures. After she finished cleaning, she jumped down from the bar and landed on the floor, breaking her right tibia/fibula.
An employee was dismantling a machine in order to clean it. He was pulling out a star blade when the edge of the blade cut his right middle fingertip, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking toward a home when the employee tripped, fell, and broke the left arm.
An employee was driving a stand-up reach forklift and struck an interior drywall, lost consciousness and had a seizure.

An employee was operating a magnetic drill to drill holes into flanges. After drilling and creating metal shavings, the employee utilized his left hand to wipe away the shavings. The employee's glove made contact with the drill, pulling his left hand into the drill and resulting in an amputation to the left ring fingertip.
An employee's finger was caught between a belt and pulley while he was installing a new belt on a machine, resulting in an avulsion to his left ring finger.
While walking out of an office, an employee tripped on a bag and fell to the floor. The employee's hip was broken.
An employee was cleaning a pour hole in a foam mold when the pour hole lid trapped the employee's hand, resulting in avulsions and lacerations to the right-hand fingers.
An employee was loading a trailer when the employee's right leg went through a hole on the trailer floor. The employee's right leg and ankle were injured.
An employee was placing the wire from a capstan onto the empty take-off spool of a mill machine when the employee's left index fingertip was caught in the wire and amputated.

An employee slipped on the grating of a containment sump and fell. The liquid in the sump splashed on him, causing second-degree chemical (dimethyladamantylamine) burns to his buttocks, hamstrings, and left leg.
A stagehand was unloading a truck to set up for a show. The lift gate got stuck, then fell on the employee's left big toe, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was pre-drilling holes into steel siding with a handheld cordless drill. The employee's left glove got caught on the drill bit and wrapped around the bit with the employee's thumb still inside. The outer cutting edge of the drill bit amputated the thumb.
An employee fell from a ladder while climbing down it. The employee suffered a hand injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to stop cases from falling and was forced to jump about 8 feet to the floor, suffering a broken right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a 480-volt shock while investigating a power outage in a production area.
An employee was setting up his outdoor vending cart when he brushed against a frayed electric cable and was shocked. He was hospitalized for bradycardia.

An employee was operating an aerial lift to perform maintenance on a plant lime silo when he made contact with the silo support brace. During this contact, his right index finger was pinched between the top rail of the lift and the support brace, resulting in a laceration and break of the first knuckle.

A bundle of aluminum planks was being placed on a structural steel ramp. The tagline from the tower crane got stuck underneath the bundle. The bundle was lifted. When it was set down, it caught an employee's finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee fell from a ladder while installing a gutter at a private residence, suffering a left knee injury.
An employee was training on how to operate a forklift. The employee's finger was caught and crushed against a fixed metal rack. It was later surgically amputated.
An employee tripped over a floor bolt and fell, suffering a fractured neck. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to troubleshoot an issue with a shaker table that continued to break belts connected to the oscillator. The pulley turned and pulled the employee's thumb in between the sheave and the belt, resulting in an amputation to the right thumb above the knuckle.

An employee was walking down a catwalk. At the same time, an automated system was cleaning and removing aggregate from the drag conveyor of asphalt equipment by spraying diesel fuel onto the conveyor. As the cleaning was taking place, the vapors from the diesel fuel ignited, creating a flash fire. The employee was burned on his face, neck, and arms, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating the cutting machine. As he was manually sliding the lift of paper into the cutting position he suffered a hernia.
While cutting shrubs in a swamp, an employee lost consciousness due to heat-related dehydration.
An employee was driving a forklift when his foot was caught against a rail barrier and injured. The foot was surgically amputated.
An employee was climbing a scaffold ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground 4 or 5 feet below. He suffered a broken femur.

A temporary employee working for Stellar Staffing, LLC, was cleaning up around a depalletizer. He was recovering empty bottles that had accumulated in the depalletizer when it caught and crushed his right arm, breaking it.
An employee's hand was in the door frame near the hinges when the door closed on her hand and amputated her fingertip.
An employee was working to erect a wind tower when he was struck on the hard hat by a bolt that was dropped from above. He suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was doing a roofing work on a new single-family home when he slipped and fell about 9 feet, fracturing his hip. His harness was not connected to a life line at the time of the incident.
On October 2, 2019, an employee was adjusting the torque on a bottle-capping machine. His right index finger was caught in the running belt and pulley and the tip was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was observing the loading of a hopper truck with pet food while standing on the mid-rail. He hopped backwards from the mid-rail coming in contact with the end of a probe.
An employee was moving an air compressor. It shifted and pinned the employee's left leg against the concrete, lacerating it.
An employee was exiting the tractor of a semi truck when he fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was slicing ham on a machine. When she went to get the ham, the machine was still running and the slicer cut off part of her thumb.
An employee was hospitalized for heat stress after remodeling a store.
An employee was pulling a trash bag out of a container when an object protruding out from the bag punctured his right eye.

An employee was reaching for a piece of chicken on the underside of a hopper conveyor belt when the employee's left hand was caught between the hopper conveyor belt and frame, resulting in an amputated index fingertip and avulsion of the nailbed and flesh.
An employee was working on a valve in an extrusion area. The valve amputated the employee's little finger.
An employee suffered heat exhaustion while hand digging a hole to install a meter on a house. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was participating in a pre-operational startup of a fryer in the processing plant when the employee suffered an amputation of the left index fingertip and avulsion of the left middle finger. The fryer was not locked/tagged out at the time.
An employee twisted his knee while pushing a pallet jack, suffering a contusion.

An employee descending the top segment of an extension ladder fell approximately 8 feet to the lower level when the ladder slipped out from underneath him. He was hospitalized with contusions to the right and left sides of his body.

An employee climbed a dumpster to move a cabinet inside the dumpster to the other side when the employee fell from the dumpster to the ground, breaking the left patella. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading equipment with a crane, hoist, and strap when the strap broke, gashing the employee's head and breaking the employee's right leg.
An employee was operating a boring machine. The drill amputated his left index finger.

An employee was using tongs to run tubing. As the employee went to set the tongs on a post, the employee's right thumb was caught between the tongs and the post. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated and fractured right thumb.
An employee was walking down the hallway when she fell to the floor, fracturing her femur and radial neck.

Employees were placing a temporary concrete barrier in a highway work zone. An 18-wheeler truck came into the work zone, hitting the truck carrying the barrier device and a barrier. This caused a barrier to fall on an employee's left foot. The foot was amputated.

An employee was in a verbal altercation with a coworker. The site foreman intervened and the employee began walking away. As the employee was walking away, the coworker assaulted him from behind with a punch to the head. He lost consciousness and fell into hot asphalt that had been freshly poured nearby. He was hospitalized with burns to the left side of the face, the left shoulder, and left forearm.
An employee sustained a mandible injury upon striking a turn stile gate and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood when the saw blade partially amputated his left index finger.
An employee was trying to unjam a tool. The employee's hand was caught between a conveyor and a belt, causing an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was pulling hose to fill a truck tanker trailer when he slipped and fell, striking the ground's asphalt surface. He injured his right hip, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cutting frozen pork rib belly with a meat cutting band saw when the blade amputated his pinky finger at the knuckle.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in an aggregate conveyor when the employee's left arm was caught in the conveyor, resulting in a left arm amputation.
An employee was loading a truck with a 10-ton overhead crane when his left ring finger was pinched between the bundle of steel and the truck, resulting in amputation of the left ring finger.

An employee was working in a trench, using a spud bar to find the opening in a manhole to line up the next piece of pipe to connect. A steel plate next to the trench box fell on the employee's lower right leg, breaking it.
An employee suffered a broken left leg (above the ankle) while descending a ladder.
An employee was working on a 6-foot folding ladder when he fell 5 feet to the ground below. He was hospitalized with a broken left ankle.

On October 2, 2019, at 12:42 p.m., an employee was walking into the casino for a menu tasting when he tripped on a metal brace for slot signage that was being installed and fell to the floor. Later, at approximately 3:00 p.m., he was found in the men's restroom experiencing shortness of breath and dizziness. He was hospitalized with an abdominal aortic aneurysm, collapsed lung, and an aneurysm of the right iliac artery.

An employee was exiting a garbage truck to retrieve a garbage container when he was sideswiped by a motor vehicle, receiving fractures to the right foot, right elbow, and right ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the door of a truck cab to the ground and was knocked unconscious, suffering a head injury.
An employee was inspecting and fixing a tire on a tractor when the tire blew out and impacted the employee. The employee experienced internal bleeding.
An employee was equipping himself to enter a trench. A water pipe and lid exploded after one bolt was loosened; the pipe struck the employee, breaking his leg.

An employee was trying to remove a wood chip that was jamming a saw. After clearing the jam, the employee became caught in moving parts inside the saw and suffered amputation of his right index finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was moving a bundle of angle iron with a hoist when the iron fell and crushed his foot, resulting in the medical amputation of the tips of two toes.

An employee's right hand was injured by rotors inside a control panel. The employee suffered an amputation to the end of the middle finger as well as deep lacerations to the end of the index finger, the right thumb, and the right palm from the pinky finger to the thumb.
An employee was cleaning an underground electrical vault. The employee was shocked, fell from the stepladder, and was injured. The employee's left hand was amputated due to the electric shock.

An employee was replacing the belt of an air handling unit when his hand slipped and his left ring finger was caught in the in-running nip point of the pulley, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was using a rope to pull himself onto a trailer to sweep. The rope came untied while the employee was pulling himself up, causing him to fall 3 feet to the ground and strike his head. He was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

An employee was shutting a truck trailer gate while standing on the edge of the trailer. When the door was halfway down, the employee jumped down to the ground while still pulling the trailer gate with his right hand. His left hand rested on the trailer floor directly under the trailer gate, which came down on his hand, amputating the tip of his left ring finger.
An employee was moving plywood to install scaffolding when the employee fell through a hole under the plywood, fracturing the collarbone, nose, and ribs and suffering bleeding on the brain.

An employee was cleaning the belt to a metal detector. While she was cleaning underneath the machine, the roller to the belt grabbed the towel she was using and pulled her right hand and forearm into the roller, causing an open right upper extremity fracture. The conveyor was not turned off at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a belt sander to grind down a thin disk. His right index finger was pulled into the sander, which ripped off the nail, skin, and some bone.

An employee was retrieving a boat dolly to use in the lamination area when he mis-stepped and his left foot caught the underside of the dolly. The employee's left ankle twisted and his foot rolled, which caused a severe break, three fractures, and an ankle dislocation.
An employee's hand was crushed in a vehicle door, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation.

Employees were replacing stripping rubber. As they were pulling the line up with a lifting hook, the line became caught on a kick-out beam. When the line released from being snagged, it snapped up and the lifting hook struck the injured employee in the mouth. The employee lost three teeth, suffered a broken palate and maxilla, and had one tooth embedded into the roof of his mouth. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam on an oil fill machine. He removed the washer and the slide released its stored energy. The slide piece then pinned his fingertip against the front metal slide, resulting in an amputation to the palm side of his right index finger just below the nail
bed.

On 10/03/2019, an employee was lifting a roll with an overhead crane and adjusting the nylon rigging where it attached to the crane's hook when the employee's middle finger was caught in between the strap and the hook, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped while walking, suffering fractures to the left arm and right leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a film cutting machine. While adjusting the roller, his right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was changing a plastic wrap roll on a robo pack wheel and frame machine. The employee's left hand was pinched against a metal bracket, causing the amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was cutting pipes at the heat exchanger and using a portable hand grinder to replace damaged and clogged pipes. The grinder slipped and lacerated the employee's left bicep region.
An employee was driving a tug with a luggage cart attached. The employee lost consciousness and the tug drove into an airplane. The employee suffered broken ribs and internal contusions.

A forklift operator was setting down a load of corrugated sheet steel when the load shifted. The injured employee attempted to manually stop the load from shifting. The employee's hand was caught under the shifting load, smashing the right middle fingertip and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading cases onto a conveyor. While she was retrieving a pneumatic wand, the line started and her left hand was caught between the conveyor roller and chain. She suffered a broken index finger and an amputation to the middle fingertip.
An employee was transitioning from a ladder to a scaffold when the ladder displaced, causing the employee to fall to the concrete floor and suffer fractured vertebrae.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wooden stakes when the blade partially amputated the employee's left thumb pad.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift and carrying a load as part of his stocking duties. He was going down the same aisle as another employee that was also driving the same kind of forklift. The employee in front suddenly stopped and reversed with the forks in the high position, striking the employee that was behind him. The employee was hospitalized with puncture injuries to the right calf and main arteries.
An employee was tapping a hot water pipe to install a valve. An ice plug failed and the employee's upper body was burned by 180-degree water/glycol.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking in the warehouse, breaking the right leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a potato harvester with a pry bar. The conveyor moved and the bar struck the employee, causing multiple broken ribs, a bruised lung, cuts, and lacerations.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet into an abandoned plating pit, suffering a leg injury.

An employee walked into a fill room while a hot sanitation process was completing. When the hot water was sent to the drain, some of it sprayed out and hit the employees feet. The employee sustained a second degree burn to the upper left foot and the right heel, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a bobbin to clear a blockage on an extruder. While she was clearing the block, the equipment cycled, causing a second degree burn on her right hand and pinning her between the extruder and the cage guard. She broke four ribs.
An employee was walking into a plant when he slipped on spilled liquid near a trash can. He fell to the floor and broke his right femur.
An employee was sampling product as it came out of a piston filler machine when the machine struck her fingers, resulting in the amputation of the ring and middle fingers.
An employee stood on a wheeled office chair to dust and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a machine that removes the heads of fish when the blade cut the employee's right pinky finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was rigging up his equipment in a pulling unit. The blowout preventer was opened, blew the slips, and hit the rig floor. The rig floor broke; the employee slid down the broken part of the floor and hit the slips on the ground. He suffered a lower back injury.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation.
