An employee was walking on a stone surface at a job site. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
A Postal Service employee was delivering mail when he became ill due to possible heat-related illness.

A conveyor was stopped, but then became unstuck and started moving. An employee's right hand was pinched between the conveyor and a support bracket on the side. A quarter-inch of the employee's index finger was amputated.
Two employees were clearing a jam on a baler. Once the jam was cleared, both employees fell to the ground below. One of them landed on a concrete surface and suffered a back injury.

An employee was standing on a pipe railing that was approximately 2 feet high while he was cleaning out a fertilizer blender. He slipped off of the rail and fell, resulting in three broken ribs and a possible punctured lung.

An employee was running a wire re-spooling line into a 500-foot roll. His right ring finger got stuck between the guide and the plastic spool, and the fingertip was lacerated. It was surgically removed to the first knuckle.
An employee slipped on a wet floor, suffering a broken right arm and dislocated right shoulder. The injuries required surgery.

On October 3, 2019, at approximately 10:25 a.m., an employee was cleaning leaves from a residential street using a leaf blower when a passing vehicle struck the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the right leg and ankle.
An employee was using a shear when his left middle finger was caught between the metal and the table being used to hold the metal, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was pushing a die cart into position at a press machine. As the cart rolled into position, her left ring and middle fingers were crushed and broken between the cart and frame of the press machine.
An employee was working on a lawnmower lifted by a jack. The lawnmower's front wheels fell off the jack onto the employee, who suffered a broken left forearm.
An employee was operating a table saw to cut plywood when the saw blade cut and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was selecting groceries in the warehouse when she lost her balance and activated her pallet jack, causing her to fall and fracture her left ankle.

On October 4, 2019, an employee was pulling mufflers from a trailer parked against the loading dock and then stepped onto a 55-gallon drum filled with concrete to hand a muffler to a customer. The employee tripped and fell approximately 42 inches to the concrete driveway. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured eye socket, sprained wrist, twisted knee, and brain bleed.
An employee was operating a table saw when it lacerated his left hand.
An employee was lifting wood panels and twisted his back, suffering a severe back strain.

An employee was walking across a roller conveyor. As he was climbing down off the platform, he fell, hitting the adjustment bar on a packing machine and then the floor. He suffered broken facial bones around his left eye socket, bruised ribs on the left side, and bruises on his belt line.

An employee was opening the bay doors in the morning. After hitting the button to open a bay door, her right ring and pinky fingers became wrapped in a loose cable of the bay door. As the door went up, she tried to free her fingers with her other hand, but her right pinky and ring fingers were severed at the second joint.
An employee was removing the blades from a forklift. They fell off, causing an amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was cleaning a kitchen area when a knife fell. The employee attempted to catch the knife, which amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee's foot became caught on the lip of a trailer and he broke his right leg.
A warehouse employee was stepping onto a walking rider forklift truck. The forklift struck the employee on the left ankle, causing a laceration and fracture of the ankle.
An employee was deboning breast meat. The knife fell. As the employee retrieved it, it stabbed him in the pelvic region. He was hospitalized.

When an employee went to ignite a cutting torch, he heard a quick popping sound within the torch, which resulted in a burst of the oxygen line approximately 6 inches from the fitting. The employee suffered burns to the lower abdominal/naval area.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood with a power saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated his right leg above the knee, causing an 8-inch-long and 3-inch-deep cut.
An employee was using a de-spooler machine to un-spool wire. The employee's left thumb was smashed between two rollers in the machine.
An employee was attempting to break a concrete privacy fence panel with a sledgehammer when he swung back and hit himself on the right cheek with the sledgehammer, suffering a facial contusion.

Three employees were removing pins from gang forms in order to lower a form. When the upper pin was removed, the form fell forward, striking and landing on top of the employees. One employee received serious back injuries, while another employee suffered contusions to his upper body and a broken left ankle. They were both hospitalized.
An employee was blowing debris off a roof with a backpack leaf blower when the employee fell off the roof to the ground, sustaining fractures to the hips and arm.

An employee was attempting to clean the drain underneath a garbage disposal. The employee had treated the drain with bleach earlier in the shift to eliminate smells and kill fruit flies. When the smell persisted, the employee attempted to treat the drain with a different chemical. This caused a chemical reaction that produced gas. The employee became ill and dizzy, requiring hospitalization for inhalation/exposure to chlorine gas.

An employee was using a portable step ladder to access/egress from a roof when the employee missed a step and fell approximately 10 feet to a lower level. The employee suffered fractures to the left fibula and tibia.
An employee fell off a dump truck to the floor, breaking his ankle.

An employee was standing next to a trailer when a 50-foot pipe weighing approximately 1,850 lbs. rolled off the trailer and struck the employee. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the femur and multiple broken bones in the lower leg, later resulting in an amputation of the leg above the knee. The employee also suffered broken ribs and a shoulder injury.

An employee was walking down a hallway. The employee slipped on the recently mopped floor and fell backwards, striking the back of his head. He lost consciousness, suffering a concussion and bleeding from his brain.
An employee was cleaning a kettle when the employee slipped and fell under the kettle. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones in the right leg.
An employee was being trained on how to operate a motorcycle through an obstacle course. The employee fell off the motorcycle when it came to a stop, fracturing the right tibia.

An employee fell in between a truck trailer and a loading dock while unloading the truck trailer, suffering a fractured pelvis, bruised right thigh, and two broken teeth. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after performing physical exercises.
An employee was repairing a wire inside a machine that sweeps logs onto a conveyor belt when the machine struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken right shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was stepping over a string line when he tripped and fell to the ground. He fractured his hip and was hospitalized.
While unloading a truck, an employee sustained a heart attack.
An employee was troubleshooting a ground fault on a pump when a transformer exploded. The employee sustained burns.
An employee was conducting a security patrol of an area where buses and trailers park when the employee was struck by a vehicle, suffering blunt force trauma.

A line cook had poured boiling sauce into a blender. When the blender was turned on, its lid came off and the sauce splashed on the cook's face, neck, and shoulder, causing second-degree burns to the face and neck.

An employee helped install a new blade on the bun slicer section of a production line. Upon restarting the production line, a bun was misaligned and the employee attempted to straighten it. The slicer blade contacted the employee's right hand, resulting in amputation of the index finger and lacerations to the other fingers.
An employee was retrieving pouches of cereal for a conveyor belt. Her right thumb was caught between the belt's moving parts, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was walking in a parking garage when he tripped over a structure expansion joint and fell to the ground, injuring his right femur bone.
An employee was accessing a work area from elevated heights (tank) to survey for radiation when the employee slipped and fell 10 feet onto a catwalk beam, suffering fractured vertebrae.
A deli slicer cut the tip of an employee's ring finger as he was cleaning it. The fingertip was removed.
An employee was standing at a table folding clothes on the sales floor when she tripped and fell to the floor, injuring her hip.

An employee was picking parts for an order when he fell about 8 feet off the end of a mezzanine onto an empty wooden pallet on the floor below. He was hospitalized for a severe concussion, a fractured rib and multiple lacerations.
An employee fell while walking down a three-step stairway, suffering a broken right ankle and a laceration on the right arm. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was using a prybar to unjam a pallet that was stuck on a conveyor when the wood in the pallet gave way and caused the employee to lose his balance and fall backwards. He rolled his left ankle and broke it, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was hospitalized with a neck fracture after falling through shelving in a garden center.
An employee was removing bolts from an actuator when the actuator fell and struck the employee's right wrist, breaking it.
An employee fell to the floor while turning. The right side of her head and her knee hit the floor. She was hospitalized, suffering brain bleeding and swelling.
An employee was on an ATV, rinsing sand off an adjacent truck using a hose. He fell 3 feet to the floor below, suffering a dislocated right knee.
An employee approached a suspected shoplifter in the parking lot to verbally deter him and was punched and kicked in the body by the shoplifter.
An employee was walking in the yard when he tripped over a piece of wood and injured his back.
An employee's fingers were smashed in a door. The employee suffered a degloving of the tip of the middle finger at the nail and the removal of the ring fingertip above the nail.
An employee was entering the front of the facility when she slipped and fell, striking the linoleum floor. She injured her knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was replacing seal rings on a valve strainer. After isolating the valve and bleeding off steam, the employee was removing a plate holding the seal ring when water released within the strainer and valve. The water contacted hot metal, which caused it to steam. The steam contacted and burned the employee's stomach and upper legs.
Two forklifts collided in a warehouse. The head and shoulder of one of the drivers struck the floor, and the driver was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a line for 14-inch PVC pipe production. As the PVC pipe came out of the extruder, it started to sag. The employee lifted the pipe with the left hand to align it and was controlling the remote with the right hand. When the tank came in, the employee's left thumb was caught between the alignment pin and the tank, resulting in a thumb tip amputation between the nail and first knuckle.
An employee was working from an A-frame ladder while looking for a steam valve when the employee fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee was loading sanitation debris into a sanitation truck when the truck backed up and ran over the employee's foot, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a small piece of wood on a miter saw when the blade partially amputated his right index fingertip.

On October 7, 2019, around 1:30 p.m., an employee was nailing a bridging on a truss from a manlift at approximately 12 feet from the ground. The truss slipped and struck the manlift, causing him to fall to the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a dislocated hip and a facial contusion.
An employee was cutting cardboard with a table saw. The saw cut his left index finger.
On October 7, 2019, a security guard was punched in the face and knocked down by a hospital patient. The guard suffered a laceration to the lip and left elbow, as well as abrasions.

A rebar cage  broke free from its rigging while suspended from a crane. The rebar cage fell to the ground and then onto a nearby employee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for bone fractures in the neck and left foot.

At about 2:30 p.m. on October 7, 2019, an employee was trying to retrieve a crushed cup from a rotary filler. The machine automatically cycled, and the employee's right middle finger was caught in the head heater area, causing an amputation between the first and second joints. The heater head was unguarded at the time of the incident.
A pallet fell from a picker lift, striking an employee in the leg. The employee suffered a broken kneecap.
An employee was pulling weeds from a potted plant when a snake bit her on the hand. The employee was hospitalized because of the venomous bite.
An employee was unhooking a 24-inch, 7-foot sewer pipe inside a trench. The pipe struck the employee, breaking four ribs and collapsing a lung.

An employee was feeding mule tape through a 1 1/2-inch conduit using a power blower. The tape got stuck at about 20-25 feet. As the employee tried to dislodge the line dart, the pressure hose was separated or removed and the dart was pushed back due to the backpressure built up in the line. The dart impaled the employee in the right chest area, causing a severe puncture injury with partial lung collapse.

On 10/07/2019, at approximately 17:45, an employee was filling a propane tank inside a scrubber when a static ignition source was created and ignited the propane vapors in the area, causing a flash fire. The employee received burns to the left arm and both legs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was securing vehicles on a car hauler trailer when the employee fell to the concrete ground, suffering a fractured right ankle and left knee.
An employee was taking a coolant sample from a CNC milling machine. The employee's finger contacted spinning machinery and was lacerated, requiring surgery.

An employee was cutting a catalytic converter with alligator shears. While the employee was trying to prevent the converter from falling, the clamp actuated. The employee's right index finger was crushed between the converter and the clamp and amputated at the first digit.
An employee was conducting work under a machine when his right middle finger above the first knuckle was struck by a moving chain under the machine, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was helping to operate a hoist used to raise stone to an elevated work area.  The employee grabbed the cable on the hoist to help guide a lift when his finger went into the pulley.  The employee sustained an injury to his left pinky finger that required an amputation at the first joint below the nail.

Three employees were installing a cage back into the crusher. They were transporting the cage back to the crusher utilizing a trolley system with three-ton chain falls attached to the trolley. The cage, that weighed 8000 lbs., tilted catching the injured employee's left hand between the chain and the striker plates resulting in amputation of the middle finger just above the second knuckle. The index finger was crushed.
Two employees were attempting to move a pallet when the pallet fell on top of them. One employee sustained a broken ankle and the second employee sustained severe knee injuries.
An employee was on a scaffold, framing a roof. The employee fell 17 feet to the ground, suffering a back injury and a head contusion.
An employee climbed a ladder and got onto a form to nail a 2x4 beam when he lost his balance and fell 10 feet. He was hospitalized with a cervical fracture and fracture of the right distal femur.

An employee was working near a router head when a piece of wood was vacuumed into the router head. As the employee was trying to remove the wood, the employee's hand was pulled into the bit. The employee suffered lacerations and a fracture to the left ring finger, along the top.
On October 7, 2019, an employee was emptying trash out of a rolling dumpster on the loading dock when he tripped over a pallet and fractured his right hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was exiting an shuttle in front of the hospital when the employee fell down three steps leading out of the shuttle into the parking lot. The employee suffered bleeding in the hip area.
An employee was installing shingles and fell from a roof to the ground, suffering fractures.
An employee fell off a roof about 16 feet in the air. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down the back of his truck when the employee slipped on the wet tailgate and fell. The employee struck the tailgate and suffered a pelvic injury.
An employee was moving a pipe stand when the stand's leg folded and his right index finger was caught in the shear point, resulting in an amputation to the first digit of his right index finger.
An employee was inserting a rug into a roller shaft opening when the machine started and pulled her left hand into the roller shaft opening, resulting in amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was inspecting bad cable at a take-up reel. The employee's left hand was caught between the cable and the reel, causing the amputation of the tip of the little finger.

An employee was standing near his tractor and waiting for a service truck. When the service truck arrived, the driver's foot slipped off the brake. The employee was then pinned and crushed between his tractor and the service truck. He was hospitalized for excessive blood loss in a lower extremity and his right leg had to be amputated above the knee.
An employee was on a truck, using a bar to move a pallet jammed against another. The pallet broke and the employee fell off the back of the truck to the ground 39 inches below.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground as she was walking to her office. She was hospitalized for a broken left foot and fractured left wrist.
An employee leaned over to select a case from a slot and hit his head on the rack, suffering a head injury.
An employee was installing ceiling lights from an 8-foot A-frame step ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered a head injury.
An employee fell while walking on a sidewalk. The employee's right shoulder hit a welding machine, causing a fracture to the right upper arm.
An employee fell about 18 feet to the ground while exiting an aerial lift onto a roof. He suffered fractures.
An employee fell from a powered industrial truck to the floor after colliding with a stack of material. The employee suffered a back injury and broken hip.

The injured employee was operating an electric pallet jack to shuttle empty totes and was driving around a pallet of freight. At the same time, a forklift operator was driving around the pallet of freight while carrying an empty pallet. The empty pallet contacted the injured employee s lower leg area, causing the employee to be thrown from the pallet jack and strike their head on the floor. The injured employee broke a leg.
An employee was disassembling a scaffold. When the employee moved his side of the staging, the load became heavy and he fell backwards onto a railroad track. He suffered a broken rib.

Two employees were working from mobile scaffolding when it collapsed. Together, the employees suffered multiple fractures and were hospitalized. One employee also suffered a concussion. The second employee is paralyzed from the neck down.

After cleaning and sanitizing a table, an employee was pushing a chair back under the table when his foot became caught under the chair, causing him to fall forward onto the back of the chair. He suffered fractured ribs.
An employee was stowing away the catwalk on a pavement marking vehicle when his left ring finger was caught in the catwalk, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was performing maintenance on an automatic stacker with two co-workers. He was under the stacker when it suddenly dropped from an undetermined height and caught his shoulder and knee, crushing them and causing compound fractures.

A temporary employee went to disengage the drum for the woodchipper. When he stepped up to activate the lever, a piece of wood hit his hard hat. He fell to the ground, hitting his face. He was hospitalized with bleeding on the brain and had surgery.
An employee was making a truck delivery. A second truck rolled and pinned the employee between the two trucks. The employee suffered chest trauma.

An employee was coming down from an A-frame platform ladder when he inadvertently missed a step, causing him to fall approximately 7 feet. He hit the ground and broke his right shoulder, requiring surgery.
An employee fell while descending a step ladder and landed on a metal floor cart. He was hospitalized with four broken ribs and a punctured lung.
After delivering mail to a residential house, an employee was walking down from the wooden steps when she fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee was cleaning up the job site with his co-workers towards the end of the day when he passed out. He was hospitalized for dehydration and heat stress.
On October 8, 2019, an employee slipped and fell in an MRI reception area, breaking her hip.
An employee was fixing a toaster and may have received an electric shock.

An employee was driving a utility vehicle around a building pad that was under construction. The vehicle tipped over while going up a slope and the employee sustained a broken left ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was gauging a tank at an established well site. He lost consciousness and was found on top of the tank, with his head down in the manhole and with rib injuries. He was hospitalized.

A technician was removing a discharge valve from a cylinder at a machine shop. The valve and chair came out, causing the discharge valve to drop slightly. His left middle finger was pinched in the opening and the fingertip was severely damaged. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a grinder when the wheel shattered and struck the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a vehicle being moved by another employee, suffering injuries to the chest/ribs, back, and head.
An employee was installing a floodlight from a ladder. The ladder's feet slipped out and the employee fell, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was splashed/sprayed by hot water while removing a clamp to a hot water pipe on a press, causing second degree burns to the back and neck.

An employee was using a T-handled tool to attempt to pull a food-filled drain basket out of the floor. She fell to her left side, landing in the hot water that was flooding the floor. She was burned on the left side, back, and forearm, and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while getting on a bus and broke her ankle.

An employee was rigging a load of rebar for a lift via a tower crane. The load lifted and swung out, carrying the employee with it. The employee fell after being raised about 20 feet, suffering fractures.

An employee was exiting a dining area and crossing through a doorway toward the outside. She tripped on a doormat and fell forward to the concrete floor outside the dining room, suffering a broken left lower leg.
An employee was taking concrete out from a cast mold when his middle finger became caught while trying to keep the "key-way" open, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting meat on a process floor. His knife struck him in the chest above his mesh apron, causing a laceration.
An employee was preparing a flat roof to be silver-coated. While removing excess water with a squeegee, the employee fell to the ground below and suffered a head laceration and a broken vertebra.
An employee was cleaning the top of a vessel with a water hose. The employee lost consciousness.

An employee was unloading plant material from a tractor trailer. The employee was using a plant hook to grab the plastic container and pull the container to the rear of the trailer. As he neared the back of the trailer, the container broke and the associate fell from the trailer, suffering a broken femur.

On October 8, 2019, at approximately 9:54 a.m., an employee was removing a broken section of concrete sidewalk from around a wrought iron fence.  As the employee manually lifted and moved a section of concrete away from the fence, the employee was struck in the face by the bucket of an excavator. The employee's head was temporally pinned between the bucket of the excavator and the fence. The employee was hospitalized for treatment of a broken arm, broken jaw, separation of the right ear, and injuries to the head and neck.

An employee was tapping out a hole at the back of a boat being built, using an angle drill, a socket, and a tap. The employee's gloved left hand was pulled into the rotating tap, resulting in the partial amputation of the thumb.
On October 8, 2019, an employee was using a radial arm drill press to balance a propeller when the drill press amputated the employee's left thumb at the first knuckle.
An employee was on a ladder changing a ballast in a light fixture when he was shocked and fell from the ladder, hitting his head on the concrete ground and losing consciousness.
An employee experienced a fingertip amputation while operating a compactor.
An employee was operating a meat slicer when the employee's right middle finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was running a pallet-nailing machine. One of the hydraulic nailers in the machine jammed; as he was trying to clear the jam, another nailer descended and amputated his left little finger.
An employee was clearing a jam when the machine cycled and amputated two fingers in the point of operation.
An employee was accessing a lower staircase from a catwalk. The employee fell to a lower level, suffering a broken back.
An employee was lowering a dump truck's tailgate when his left hand was caught between the tailgate and safety chain, resulting in an amputation to the ring finger.

An employee was using a drum lift to pour acrylic acid. The drum slipped and splashed acid on the right side of the employee's body. The employee suffered chemical burns to the right arm, leg, neck, chest, and face.
An employee lost his balance while stepping off a wooden box, landing on and fracturing his heels.
An employee was operating a can filler/seamer machine when the machine became jammed. The employee was attempting to remove the jam when the machine amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was stocking in a stockroom. The employee tripped over a hand truck and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee reached into the bench area of a draw bench to retrieve a piece of wood for cribbing for steel bundles. The operator of the draw bench dropped a steel bar which fell onto the employee's right hand, causing dislocated finger bones (requiring resetting), cuts (requiring stitches), and bruises.

On October 9, 2019, an employee was riding a ride-on spreader to treat a turf area with herbicide when the employee went over a hole that caused him to be jolted and land on his ankle. He suffered a dislocated and fractured ankle.

An employee was grinding a piece of copper on a disc sander when his glove was caught between the sander belt, pulling his right thumb into the sander operation area and resulting in the amputation of his right thumb tip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was watching a rotary screen while washing down the floor and equipment. In the area was a chemical dosing pump that delivers peroxide to a mixing system to clean and sanitize carcasses. The suction side of this pump has a chemical O-ring that compresses the suction hose feeding the chemical into the pump. The O-ring was compromised, allowing chemical to drip out of the hose and onto the floor. The employee breathed in the chemical vapors, exposing his respiratory system to them.

On October 9, 2019, an employee was walking up an incline to enter the main building and tripped on either the mat covering the incline or the incline itself. The employee fell backwards and struck the back of his head on the ground, suffering a head injury and bleeding out of an ear.

An employee was conducting grinding operations on a flange weighing 265 pounds. The flange was supported by two metal saw horses. After the employee finished grinding on the top side of the flange, the flange had to be flipped over to grind the bottom side. A crane was used to lift and flip the flange. As the flange was being flipped over, it started to fall off one of the saw horses. The employee attempted to grab the flange. The employee's middle finger on his left hand was caught in between the flange and the saw horse. The employee was hospitalized  for a compound fracture of the left middle finger that required surgery.
An employee was installing tape on top of an aircraft engine when he fell about 13 feet to the ground, suffering fractures.

An employee was reaching into a wooden crate to retrieve some parts. A wasp stung him, and the sting site became red and painful. The next morning, his hand was swollen and difficult to move. He was hospitalized.
An employee was entering a trench when the employee was trapped by falling dirt, suffering crushing injuries that required hospitalization.
Three employees were moving an upright piano into a residence using moving straps. A piano leg landed on the right foot of one of the employees, breaking it. She was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning dough from a straightening-out device in a bakery. Her right arm was pulled into the rollers, causing a fractured arm, a laceration to the hand, and ligament and tendon injuries to the hand.
An employee's right thumb was caught in a belt plate on a conveyor belt. The thumb was amputated.
An employee was washing down a press with a high-pressure water machine when he dropped the wand and high-pressure water injected into his left arm just above the elbow. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to unstick a conveyor belt. He gripped the conveyor belt with his right hand and pulled on it to get it to move again. His right thumb was still underneath the belt as it began to move. The moving belt pulled the skin off his thumb to the bone, causing a partial right thumb amputation.
An employee was putting on a work boot when a fiberglass splinter punctured the bottom of the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.

An employee was setting up a large press machine when a nearby forklift lifted the press. The press fell into a tub and then rolled onto the employee, who suffered a laceration/fracture of the right arm and a laceration of the left leg.
An employee was putting his tools in a container when a spray paint can rapidly decompressed and bounced off a wall, hitting him in the face. He suffered a laceration and fracture to the nose.

An employee operating a tiara machine began to jog (actuate) the machine. The foil band did not feed through the cutter into the mandrel. The employee was attempting to straighten the band when the employee's right third finger was caught by the cutter, resulting in a fracture and laceration to the fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck driver arrived at work before the start of his shift at 7:00 AM. He was bitten on the right thumb by a venomous snake and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a tugger, proceeding down a travel lane in front of a receiving dock. He passed a forklift, which struck the tugger in the rear. He fell out of the tugger to the concrete floor, suffering a lower back injury.
On October 9, 2019, an employee heard a "pop" in his back while he was lifting a heavy bag of concrete. He was hospitalized for a pinched nerve/pulled muscle.
An employee was cleaning a floor with water from a hose. He became tangled in the hose and fell, breaking a rib.

An employee was carrying a ballistic pad and walking by her sewing machine when she slipped and fell on a piece of fabric that was on the floor. She impacted the concrete floor, fracturing her left arm.

An employee was checking the belt on a conveyor. The machine cut on and pulled the employee's right hand into the pulley. The tip of the index finger, knuckle of the middle finger, and tip of the ring finger were amputated.
An employee suffered an amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee was cutting a concrete header using a handheld concrete saw with a 14-inch blade. The saw blade hit the rebar, kicked back, and cut the employee under the left arm.

While performing part inspection and packaging, an employee noticed a sprue was lodged in a stripping fixture. He climbed a step stool and was trying to dislodge the sprue when a robot approached and struck his right forearm and hand as it came down. As it continued to cycle, it tore the skin and removed flesh in a downward and upward motion.

An employee was using a jack knife to cut a zip tie that was keeping two items of luggage together. As he was cutting the zip tie with his right hand, his hand moved towards the left hand, cutting his left wrist to the vein.
An employee was cleaning a meat processing machine. The employee's left hand was caught on a moving plunger and the ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing a "Christmas tree" fitting from a pressurized wax tank. The pressure in the wax tank caused the wax to burst from the fitting and onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized for burns to the body.
On October 9, 2019, an employee was crossing the street in a crosswalk. A motor vehicle struck the employee, causing a broken wrist, shoulder, hip, and sacrum. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat with a knife when the blade sliced and amputated her right little fingertip.
An employee fell while walking down a wet walkway ramp, hitting the ground and breaking her ankle.

Employees were dumping powder from a super sack into a tank on a tanker trailer when a spark occurred, causing an explosion. One employee suffered burns to the face and eyes. A second employee suffered burns to the arms and face.

An employee was assembling an amusement ride while standing on the deck. He stepped off the deck just as he was walking off a curb and fell approximately 5 to 6 feet to the ground, suffering a concussion and left forearm fracture.

A temporary employee was moving a pallet containing four steel molds using a sit-down forklift. When the employee lifted the forks on the forklift, the pallet broke apart causing two molds to fall on the floor. The employee retrieved a new pallet to replace the broken pallet. He then attempted to pull and slide over one of the remaining molds on the broken pallet onto the new pallet, which he had placed alongside the forks. The steel mold was approximately 500 lbs., and when he slid it to the pallet edge, the pallet once again broke apart. This caused the mold to come crashing down onto the employee's left hand, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was hydroblasting when the sprinkler head malfunctioned. Water shot out of the hose at 18,000 psi, blowing off a piece of pipe and tubing. The piece impaled an employee's left leg, breaking the tibia.

An employee was helping a contractor close a tarp atop a trailer. The tarp was pulled and the employee fell 8 feet to the ground, suffering a broken left elbow, a broken left wrist, and a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing crown molding with a nail gun. One of the nails bounced back and pierced his right eyebrow, going all the way in.

An employee was removing bolts from a flanged cooling water pipe connection. When the last bolt was removed, a surge of blast furnace gas came out of the pipe, exposing the employee to carbon monoxide.

An employee was part of a team that was rebuilding a cement hopper used to bag cement. While being lifted, the metal hopper twisted and struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was exiting a vehicle on a mail route when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing the right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing the housing from a drill rod and putting on the reamer. A pipe wrench slipped off of the pipe and spun around, striking and breaking the employee's left leg.
An employee pushed a button on the milling machine when the track came around and ran over his foot, breaking it.

An employee was installing a horizontal rack beam from a scissor lift. When he moved the scissor lift, he was pinned against the rail of the lift and the rack beam. He then fell from the lift. He suffered fractured vertebrae and a severed lymph node system.
An employee was hoisting a propane tank when the chain rigging caught the employee's hand, resulting in an index finger amputation.
A sawblade came off a concrete saw and struck an employee who was working nearby, breaking and lacerating the employee's leg.
An employee suffered fractured ribs and a punctured lung after he slipped and fell off of a bucket truck.
An employee was moving pieces of steel when a piece shifted and smashed the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation and bone damage.
An employee was loading chicken feathers into a bin. Rendering fluid splashed on him, causing third-degree burns over 40 percent of his body.
An employee was lifting a dolly to place on the pintle hook of a trailer. The employee's left hand got caught between the dolly and the trailer. The hand was broken.
While adjusting a guard, an employee came into contact with an exit chain drive. He suffered a partial amputation to the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was changing out a bucket on a bucket loader. The loader was actuated and the employee's left hand was smashed. The employee underwent surgery to amputate fingers.
On October 11, 2019, a door closed on an employee's left hand, injuring the middle finger. The employee was hospitalized and the fingertip was later medically amputated.
An employee was pushing cattle through a gate. The wind was moving the gate, and the employee's left thumb was caught between the gate and the fence. The employee suffered an amputation to the thumb.

An employee was helping to unload near-empty wire-duct spools (2 feet tall, 200-300 pounds) off a trailer bed that was about 2 feet off the ground. The last spool rolled over from the trailer and one side fell on the employee, who suffered a fractured vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder while reattaching electrical service to a house. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken wrist and a back injury.
An employee was trying to realign a tray when he fell, landing on his back on the concrete floor.
An employee was returning a truck unloading platform's transition plates to their resting position. The plates struck his right thumb, causing a fracture and an avulsion of the nailbed.

An employee was framing a wall for a new construction. The employee fell backward against a guardrail, which broke; the employee then fell from the second floor to the ground, suffering a concussion and broken ribs.

A forklift operator was moving kegs. The top keg on the forks tipped and fell back toward the operator. The keg crushed the operator's right hand against the top of the rollover protection system, causing fractures to multiple fingers.
Two employees were opening a sliding gate. One employee's right-hand fingers got caught in the gate roller guide, causing severe fractures to the ring and little fingers.
An employee was cutting pants at a cutting table. The textile cutting machine's blade lacerated her left middle finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was walking down stairs. His foot slipped on a step, causing his right leg to strike the edge of the lower step. The leg was broken.
An employee was lifting a piece of wood when a forklift contacted the wood, causing the wood to come down on his right index finger, resulting in an amputation to his fingertip.
An employee was using a press laundry washing machine. The press came down on the employee's hand, amputating at least one finger.
An employee was working at a gate. As she opened the door for an inbound truck, she fell to the floor and broke her hip.
A driver slipped and fell while exiting the cab of his truck. He landed on his right side and suffered fractures to the right elbow, wrist, and knee.

An employee was driving a lift truck to pick up and empty a trash dumpster when a pallet fell off the dumpster and struck the employee, crushing the right index finger and resulting in a partial surgical amputation.

An employee was hooking up two sets of trailers when he slipped on the ground and lost his footing. His hand was pinched in between the dolly and the trailer, resulting in a laceration to the left thumb that required hospitalization.

An employee was setting up an in-line machine. The employee noticed a wrinkle in the material inside the machine and was about to clean it when his hand was drawn into the roller. His ring fingertip was amputated and his little finger was broken.
Employees were preparing to move a precast wall with a forklift. The wall fell on an employee's leg, crushing it.

An employee was oiling the chain on a running small stacker machine. He had a rag in his right hand and an oil can in his left hand when the rag was caught in the chain and sprocket. His right middle fingertip was then amputated by the chain.
An employee's right index fingertip was amputated by a chain and sprocket.
An employee was climbing a tree. At 15 feet up, he fell from the tree to the ground, breaking the sacrum bone near his tailbone.
While working in a steam vault, an employee suffered second-degree burns from a release of steam.

An employee was driving a tow motor down an aisle. Her tow motor crashed into another one, which was stopped at an intersection, and her left leg was crushed between the two tow motors. Her lower leg was injured and she was hospitalized.
A driver was stepping out of the truck he had just parked. He fell and hit his head on the ground. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery for brain bleeding.
An employee's hand was caught between the rollers and a metal beam on a saw production line. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was rebuilding a chopper assembly for a packaging machine in the maintenance shop. He was hooking up compressed air to test the unit while his left hand was resting against the chopper blade when the blade cut off the fingerprint pad on his left finger.

An employee was picking parts from a rack. A forklift on the other side of the rack was taking a pallet down from the top of the rack. It pushed a container off the top rack that fell on the employee, who suffered head and neck injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

At about 11:05 p.m. on October 10, 2019, an employee was cutting vinyl window parts using a pneumatic saw. The saw caused a partial amputation of the employee's left ring and middle fingers and a laceration to the tip of the left index finger.
An employee was clearing out concrete from the inside of a 5-inch pipeline. A metal object that was being used to remove the concrete lacerated the employee's cheek.
An employee was fitting insulation into a hole and fell through a roof opening, landing on the floor 17.5 feet below. The employee suffered blunt trauma injuries.

An employee was using a wire-end brush attachment in a pneumatic die grinder to clean debris out of a casting mold. The employee stepped down from a 6-inch raised platform, then felt severe pain in his left knee as soon as it was bearing weight. A 1-inch-long, 0.0104-inch-thick steel wire from the brush had penetrated the knee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was rolling angles along non-mechanical conveyor rollers to bring material closer to a cutting saw. The employee's left little finger was crushed between a roller and the material, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
On October 11, 2019, an employee was bitten by a dog while providing home healthcare services at a patient's home. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee started a troweling machine while it was hanging in mid air. The troweling machine's pan came off and struck the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee's finger was pinched in a closet door. The tip was amputated.

An employee was bringing dogs inside when a dog  got loose and bit another dog's nose. As she attempted to pull the dog off the other dog, he bit her. She sustained three puncture wounds to her left arm/wrist and an amputated right pinky fingertip.
An employee was operating a press brake when his right hand was caught between a metal fixture (the product) and the brake press. The hand was broken and lacerated.
A belt fell off a pulley. As an employee moved to reconnect the pulley, another pulley caught his glove and right ring finger, amputating the tip.
An employee tripped on a pallet while pulling a mattress. The employee suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized.
An employee's right thumb came in contact with an electric slicer while slicing ham, causing the amputation of the thumb nail and thumb tip.

On October 11, 2019, an employee was unloading metal ductwork from a box truck. A large sheet metal duct fell and trapped the employee's wrist between its sharp edge and the edge of the truck floor. The employee suffered a lacerated wrist and cut tendons.

An employee was cleaning vents from a scissor lift. The employee fell through an opening to the ground about 8 feet below. The employee suffered a head injury causing brain bleeding and was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding a crane during a container lift. The employee's hand was crushed between containers.

On October 11, 2019, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was installing an egg belt conveyor system at an animal confinement building. A temporary cable and pulley system was being used as part of the installation process to transport materials. The cable became dislodged and the employee's left index and middle fingers were caught by the cable and pulled into a pulley. The employee's left index finger was amputated at the middle knuckle, and the left middle finger was fractured.
An employee was bitten by a copperhead snake at a garden center. He was hospitalized.
An employee was checking a leak in equipment when an auger blade caught his middle finger under the equipment. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking over a transfer hose when he lost his balance and fell, breaking his left arm.
An employee suffered a headache after inhaling spilled nitroglycerin in a manufacturing area.
The morning after a shift spent repeatedly bending and lifting up to 20 pounds, a temporary employee suffered pain in her lower back and legs and could not move properly. She was hospitalized.
Two employees were moving a treadmill. One of them had a foot caught in a pallet; when they began a team lift of the treadmill, he fell over and broke his femur.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. The jack ran over his left foot, crushing it.

An employee was standing next to a crate of windshields that were packed vertically. The windshields fell forward and the crate broke. The falling materials struck the employee, causing multiple pelvic fractures on both sides, a tailbone fracture, bulging discs, and lacerations to the arm.

An employee was working on the brakes of a baggage cart. The employee's left little finger was smashed between the side of the trailer and a tongue that locked the tires. The finger required surgery, having suffered minor damage to the bone.
An employee was clearing meat from a bone collector when a piston on the machine amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was helping another employee clear a jam from a bag machine. The bags dislodged, causing the employee's left little fingertip to strike a sharp plate. The plate amputated the fingertip.

An employee was standing on a ladder to restock prizes. As the employee was coming down, the ladder came out from beneath him, and he fell 4 feet to the floor. The employee hit his head on the floor or the bottom of a display shelf and then had a seizure.

An employee was walking down a store aisle when her rubber-soled footwear became stuck on the floor and her shoe came off. She then tripped and fell, fracturing her pelvis and requiring hospitalization.
A certified nursing assistant was leaving a patient room. She slipped on liquid in the hallway and fell to the floor, injuring a knee. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was operating an electrical gangway when the gangway hydraulics failed, causing the gangway and employee to fall 10 feet to the lower level. The employee contacted the gangway's metal frame. His knees were bruised and he lost consciousness.
An employee slipped while carrying a stick of galvanized pipe. He fell to the floor and suffered a left-arm muscle injury that required surgery.

An employee was clearing a jam on a stem cartridge filling machine when his left index finger was caught between a pneumatic plunger and the frame of the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The air source was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking across a floor that had just been mopped when he slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing his right hip and requiring hospitalization. "Wet floor" signs were posted at the time of the incident.
An employee was removing shavings from a magnetic drill. His hand was caught by the drill bit. His ring finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was a spotter for a forklift operator. He was walking backwards when he stumbled and fell to the ground. The forklift driver stopped and the load (pit liner material roll) rolled off the forks, striking the employee and breaking his legs.

An employee was moving a cappuccino machine from a cart to a pallet. The legs of the machine dropped through the top of the slats on the pallet, causing the employee's finger to be pinched between the body of the machine and the pallet. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was bending lance pipes when he slipped and struck the edge of a pallet carrier. He suffered facial injuries.
An employee was removing bolts from a steam line when an adjacent steam line burped, releasing steam that burned his lower rear section.
An employee was climbing a ladder while doing maintenance work when he missed a rung and fell to the floor. The fall resulted in a broken wrist, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking into a locker room when he slipped and fell onto the floor. He hit his head, right elbow, and right hip. He was hospitalized the next day, having broken the hip.
An employee's left arm was caught and broken between a roll-up spindle and plastic wrap.
An employee was trying to get away from a wasp, stepped backwards off a curb, and fell on the concrete ground, fracturing his left hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling a crane. His finger was cut and bruised while he was aligning a pennant on a boom.
An employee was using a powered lathe to polish a steel shaft with an emery cloth when his hand was caught between the cloth and the shaft. He suffered fractures to three fingers and his wrist.

An employee fell approximately 6 feet while attempting to hammer a pin in the swing away attachment on the boom of a crane. The boom was activated while the employee was inside the swing away attachment, causing the attachment to disengage from the boom and fall to the ground with the employee inside it. The employee suffered multiple back fractures and bruises.

After installing rooftop HVAC systems, an employee started to descend the extension ladder from the roof when it retracted, causing the employee to fall approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee suffered four cracked ribs, a fractured pelvis, and a fractured vertebra.

While cleaning equipment prior to rig down, an employee was working with a rig contractor to rig down a centrifuge slide with a forklift. The employee was sitting on a beam under the centrifuge and behind the slide when the slide slipped off the forklift, swinging and pinning the employee against the beam of the centrifuge. He sustained a fractured tibia and fibula just below the left knee.
An employee was crouching down while sand-blasting a void tank on a barge when abrasive material from blast nozzle struck his right calf, causing a skin abrasion.
An employee walking up a ramp fell over the rails and injured his back and ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was setting floor joists when one of the joists became dislodged, fell, and struck a step ladder. The step ladder then struck the employee's right shoulder, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake on the left index finger while engaged in search and tracking operations in the field. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee stepped up on the rear tire of a pickup truck to access a toolbox in the truck bed. As he was getting down, he lost his balance and fell onto the ground, fracturing his left leg and ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 25 feet to the ground while descending an electrical tower, suffering broken bones and contusions.

On October 14, 2019, an employee was placing a wire rope choker around a pedestal that was going to be moved by an all-terrain forklift when his hand was pinched between a piece of rigging (wire rope choker) and the load that was to be moved. He was hospitalized with fractures to three of his fingers and a laceration to the palm of his left hand.
An employee filling propane cylinders for forklifts was burned on the arms and back following a release of propane that ignited.

An employee was moving a metal food cart so that she could wash the floor under it. A wheel came off the cart, causing her to fall. The cart struck her left hand and broke her left middle finger. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
While working in a oil mill, an employee stepped on a screw conveyor belt cover. The cover shifted, causing the employee to fall into the conveyor belt and resulting in a left ankle amputation.
An employee driving a lift truck hit a barrier and was ejected from the lift truck, suffering a broken left leg.

An employee was operating a powered industrial vehicle to transport wheeled material baskets when the transported baskets struck a stationary basket. The struck basket fell and was going to hit a computer station. The employee left the vehicle and was struck while attempting to prevent the basket from striking the computer station. The employee suffered a right knee laceration.
An employee was setting up his work area. While he was lifting his saw, he pulled a muscle in his lower body, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was clearing clogged material on an auger when his finger was caught between the auger and the auger housing, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was repairing a potable water cabinet on a jet bridge from an A-frame ladder when the jet bridge moved and knocked the employee approximately 8 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left heel.

An employee was operating a golf cart while performing maintenance repairs when his foot slipped off the pedal and became caught on a parking lot barrier. He was hospitalized with an overextended foot.
An employee overextended and injured his back while reaching to tighten a bolt during a wheel alignment. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking from her vehicle in the employee parking lot to the main building when she tripped on the seam of a cement slab and fell to the cement ground. She broke her hip and required hospitalization.

An employee was showing another employee how to shut off a stud machine when the cable on the stud machine arced. The employee reacted by jumping out of the back of the trailer (height of approximately 4.5 feet). His foot became caught on the ladder, causing him to land awkwardly on his arms. He suffered a fractured radial head on his left arm, as well as a broken radial head and dislocated elbow in his right arm.
An employee was pushing a drywall cart when a wheel broke off the cart and the drywall fell on the employee's leg, causing muscle damage and bruising.
An employee was operating a forklift in reverse and struck another employee that was walking in the area. The injured employee suffered a laceration and broken bone to the left foot.

An employee was attempting to remove the drag link, also known as a steering arm, on a ready-mix concrete truck. He removed the front nut and was attempting to remove the rear nut but it would not come free. He then used a sledge hammer and struck the nut, which came off, causing the steering to swing and strike the employee on the left cheek and eye. The employee sustained a left orbital fracture, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On October 14, 2019, an employee was checking a machine's chain for bent pins when his right hand came in contact with the chain and sprocket. This resulted in the amputation of his right ring fingertip.
A propane smoker exploded while an employee was trying to light it. The employee suffered injuries to the right forearm, right hand, and right side of the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after falling in a staircase, requiring surgery.
An employee was sitting in chair at a push position location. She got out of the chair and stumbled. She reached for something and her left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was cutting something with a knife. The knife cut off the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was putting cardboard into a compactor. His right ankle got stuck and was then caught by the compactor, causing a double fracture above the ankle. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was working on a customer's electric forklift, which had a dead battery. After power was connected to the battery, the forklift moved in reverse and crushed the employee's lower leg against another piece of machinery. The leg was broken.

An employee was operating a CNC router machine and was drilling holes into a metal part that was loaded into the router. The tool bit in the router machine broke and particles punctured his abdominal area. The particles entered his body and had to be removed surgically.

An employee was placing recycled cardboard into a bailing conveyor machine while maintenance cleanup was being conducted nearby on an open floor panel of the machine. He fell through the open floor panel into the hole and struck the outer surfaces, sustaining bodily lacerations and contusions near his chest and back.

On October 14, 2019, an employee was operating an upcut saw. As the employee was loading approximately two inch by three quarter inch wood material into the saw, the employee's left hand was clamped into the saw's point of operation. The saw blade cycled and amputated four fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a walkie pallet jack, picking orders. The employee's pallet jack bumped into another one, stopped in front of him, and his little finger was crushed. The finger underwent an amputation.

An employee was repairing the pour spout on a furnace. He had stepped over and was straddling the spout when his foot became caught on the edge of the furnace lid. He lost his balance and fell backwards into the furnace slag pit, suffering multiple fractures to his back and ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a side shift cylinder on a forklift. The lever on the unit that actuates the side shift cylinder was then moved. The employee's hand slipped and fell inside of the cylinder hole, amputating the left index fingertip.
While stepping down into a catch basin, an employee fell feet first into the bottom of the basin. The employee suffered injuries to both heels and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a loading dock when a stand-up forklift ran over the employee's toes causing lacerations. An antibiotic used to treat the employee caused a reaction and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning plastic film that had dripped from the hanger die of a bubble machine. The employee's left hand was caught between the machine's roller and nip roller, causing fractured fingers and a degloving injury to the ring and index fingers.

An employee was on a 10-foot ladder hanging and removing signs from the front of a building. While coming down the ladder, he slipped and lost his footing, falling from about the halfway point on the ladder to the ground. He landed on his left back side, injuring his back, neck, left knee, and left elbow.
An employee's leg was crushed and broken when a semi-tractor trailer he was working on rolled over his leg.

An employee was taking a lift truck outside to perform preventive maintenance on it. While he was moving the lift truck, he heard a squeaking noise coming from the engine compartment. He opened the bonnet/hood and was trying to figure out where the noise was actually coming from. The engine was running at the time. While he was trying to get a better look at the water pump area, his right index finger was caught between the fan belt and pulley, resulting in a finger amputation.
On October 15, 2019, an employee was operating a portable circular saw when the saw blade amputated the employee's left thumb and left little finger.
An employee was operating a crane in a pot room when a fire occurred. While exiting the crane, the employee suffered burns to the hands and face.
An employee was on a pallet jack pulling an order. When the employee dismounted the pallet jack, it rolled over the back of the employee's left foot, causing a laceration to the left Achilles tendon.

An employee was operating a machine that load tiles into a box. The employee attempted to correct mis-loading of tiles into the box when their gloved index finger was caught in the pulleys that drive the roller and conveyor feeding tiles into the box resulting in amputation.
An employee was bent down beside a pallet when a forklift backed into him, causing the amputation of his right leg below the knee.
An employee had two fingers amputated during installation of a soil/cave protection system.

An employee was moving reels in a machine. The employee unloaded a full reel from the machine and was rotating an empty reel to be loaded.  The employee's left hand was caught between the full reel and the empty one, causing the amputation of the index, middle, and ring fingertips.
An employee was operating a winding machine when the employee's left arm was caught and fractured in the machine.
An employee was bending a part on a press brake. His left index finger was caught between the top of the part and the front of the upper die. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee installing drywall fell from the third step of a step ladder and broke his leg.

An employee was driving a forklift into a trailer. While turning to avoid a pail, he struck a metal bar used to raise or lower the extendable, suffering a puncture wound to the left leg and a fractured lower leg bone.

An employee was using a handheld circular saw to cut wooden planks when the saw blade came in contact with his lower leg area, causing a severe laceration to his right calf muscle that required hospitalization and surgery. He was installing a roof at a residential construction site at the time of the accident.
An employee was operating a lift gate control to lower a dock plate when the dock plate lacerated his left hand along the outer edge of his palm below the pinky.
An employee was attempting to enter a tractor when a bolt on the first step broke off, causing the employee's leg to impact the ground and resulting in pain to his lower back.
An employee went to remove an actuator from a valve. The actuator was still energized and sprung up, hitting the employee in the ribs. The employee was hospitalized with five broken ribs.
An employee fell 8 feet from the platform of an order picker to the floor, suffering back injuries.

A maintenance employee was setting the calibration on the metal detection section of the packing line, which was not running at the time. The employee's calibration card fell into the belting on the conveyor. The conveyor belt was lifted to retrieve the card. During this time, the belt was activated. The employee's hands were caught between the bottom of the conveyor belt and a conveyor roller. He sustained the amputation of the left middle fingertip and lacerations to fingers on his right hand.
An employee was delivering mail when he began to experience nausea and heat cramps, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was changing the sandpaper on a disk sander with a 3-inch putty knife. The sander kicked back, causing the putty knife to slip and amputate the employee's left index finger at the middle joint.

A Kinder Morgan employee accessed the top of a truck during a loading operation. When he opened the dome lid, alkylate pressure released and propelled him onto the truck rack roof, then to the ground below. He suffered multiple fractures and a torn artery in the skull, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning material from a screen located above a rotary valve when the employee's right index fingertip was caught in the rotary valve, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On October 15, 2019, a driver had finished servicing a school when he went to get a drink from the back of the refrigerated box truck. He climbed up the truck's door to reach for the drink when he slipped and fell about 4 feet to the ground. He suffered a fracture to the ball joint going into his hip socket and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a table saw to cut plywood for a crate. The saw blade amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb.

An employee was investigating a thermostat that was mounted about 10 feet above grade. She was using a step ladder to access the thermostat. She was standing approximately 4 to 5 feet up the ladder when it tipped over. The resulting injuries required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a conveyor belt when his right arm was caught in between a roller and the conveyor belt, resulting in his right arm at the wrist and forearm being severely lacerated.
An employee was erecting a barn when a wind gust hit the wall of the barn, causing it to become unstable and strike the employee. The employee suffered a broken back and broken ribs.

An employee was testing the RPM of a chain drive on an airlock valve assembly when the employee's right middle fingertip was caught in the chain drive, resulting in a fingertip amputation to the middle of the fingernail.
An employee became caught under a dolly while moving a trailer, suffering a broken hip and broken ribs.
On October 15, 2019, an employee was painting lines on pavement when the paint can fell and exploded. The employee's face was struck and lacerated by the can.

An employee was operating a hoist to move steel I-beams and set up an area. As he was moving an I-beam, it bumped into another I-beam and caused it to fall over. The falling I-beam landed on the employee's left leg, breaking it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On October 15, 2019, an employee was attempting to clear a jam on an extruder machine when the employee's right hand made contact with the extruder's rotating screw, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee fell off a step ladder while hanging an extension cord, suffering a broken tibia.

A joint of pipe that had an end hook was conveyed into the CNC machine. In order to process the hooked material, an employee decided to shim the pipe. He was holding a shim next to the pipe with his right hand while his left hand was resting on the chuck ring. He activated the foot pedal that engages the self-centering arms to align the pipe and clamp the jaws. Once the pipe was aligned, the jaws clamped on the pipe and the centering arms retracted, causing the employee's left middle finger to be caught in the chuck ring. He suffered a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing a displacement ramp onto a light-capacity rough-terrain forklift chassis. The employee's left middle finger was caught between two pieces of equipment, causing the amputation of the tip.
An employee was striking a nail with a hammer when it ricocheted and struck him in the corner of an eye under his glasses, severely rupturing the globe. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
On October 15, 2019, an employee was attempting to secure a barge when his right hand was crushed and lacerated by the winch wheel.
An employee was on a step stool scanning price tags when the employee fell to the floor, suffering a hairline fracture to the pelvis.
An employee was working on a basket that was attached to a forklift when he fell with the basket to the ground, breaking an arm and ribs.

Two employees were working in a man-made basket that was tied to the clamps and mast of a powered industrial truck. The basket was raised 7 feet when a safety attachment broke and both employees fell to the ground. One employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow, fractured right ribs, and a punctured right lung.
An employee was walking toward the customer service desk when she slipped on something and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.
An employee was walking through a door when it closed on his little finger, amputating it.

An employee was installing a pumping unit at a well site. The employee was measuring a rod with a tape measurer when the rod slipped through the safety clamps. The employee's fingers were crushed between the rod clamp and load cell, resulting in amputations of the right index and left ring fingers.

An employee was performing a parts replacement on equipment when a stainless steel mesh part struck his hand, causing a laceration through his leather work glove. He was hospitalized, requiring stitches and surgery.

An employee was attempting to put a chain on a sprocket, turned on the power for the sprocket to rotate, and his right middle and ring fingers were caught between the sprocket and chain, resulting in finger amputations.

An employee was unloading a shipment of mattresses from a truck at the loading dock. The employee slipped and fell about 18" from the loading dock to the ground floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the humerus in the right elbow.

An employee was removing a valve that had been heated to liquify the solder binding the valve to a pipe. Oil had collected in the piping at the valve; when the valve was removed, the oil ignited and caused first-degree burns to the employee's face and second-degree burns to his wrist.
An employee had placed a truck on a lift to perform vehicle maintenance when the truck fell off the lift and struck the employee. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a molder machine. As the employee went to remove a piece of wood, his left pinky finger was caught and amputated by the moving gear.
An employee was standing on a roof cleaning gutters. He slipped and fell to the ground, suffering back and wrist injuries.

A maintenance technician was grinding on a piece of metal using a 7-inch electric hand grinder when part of the grinding disc broke off and hit the employee in the pelvic region. The employee was hospitalized.

At 2:40 a.m. on October 16, 2019, an employee was working on the cold foil web unit on a press. While the employee was webbing the ancillary piece of equipment with the foil, the press was jogged and the employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee tripped over an anti-fatigue mat and fell to the floor, suffering a head contusion and a broken left hip.

An employee was milling an active pharmaceutical compound and was exposed to buprenorphine hydrochloride. The employee began vomiting, was lethargic, and suffered a decreased pulse rate. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in the plate department when a roller caused a crushing and debridement injury to his lower right leg.
An employee was trying to unclog a jam on a conveyor. The employee fell and got caught in a conveyor sprocket, suffering lacerations to the right thigh. The employee was hospitalized.

When a driver opened the tractor trailer door, the safety strap came off the trailer and product struck the driver on the head, causing him to fall to the ground. The driver sustained a fracture to the lower back.
On October 16, 2019, an employee experienced strong pressure in his abdomen after lifting a 20-pound case of sodas while stocking the cooler. He was later hospitalized due to a hernia.
An employee fell 15 feet during a ready-mix batch cleaning operation. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken sternum and a broken vertebra.
An employee was removing rigging from a deck panel. When a crane raised the panel, it struck and lacerated the employee's right inner thigh as it moved.

An employee was sliding a single mold pouring pan with a cast tree on it. The employee moved the pouring pan by hand onto the forks of a powered industrial truck (PIT). When the pan was moved the cast tree fell over. The employee attempted to grab the tree to stop it from falling. Molten stainless steel poured onto their right forearm/hand causing second degree burns requiring hospitalization.
An employee was counting money in a small safe. The safe's door closed on the employee's right middle finger, which was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was walking between cash registers when she tripped on a floor mat and fell, striking her left knee on the floor.

An employee was training a new hire on the milk selection process, which involves the use of a portable (wrist mounted) RF scanner and a powered pallet jack. He was walking backwards behind his jack when the lower part of his left leg was caught between the pallet jack and a stationary jack. The impact fractured his lower left leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While tearing down a roof, an employee fell through a weak spot, suffering broken ribs and a lung collapse.
An employee mis-stepped while getting off a tour bus. The impact onto the ground surface caused a compound fracture to their leg requiring hospitalization.
An employee was preparing the next drill location when a rock fell onto his right foot. He sustained fractured toes and lacerations to the foot.
An electrician was working on a circuit breaker at a private residence. When the employee's wrench touched a live wire, he was shocked and sustained electrical burns requiring hospitalization.
An employee suffered an amputation from a saw.

Three employees were trying to unjam a buckled service door using a forklift. They were using the forks to put pressure on the front of the door. One employee's fingertip got caught between the forks and the steel service door. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left middle finger.
An employee was caught between two rolls of paper as they proceeded off the paper machine. He sustained a pulled muscle in the pelvic region and back pain.
An employee was operating a wood notching machine when the machine made contact with his fingers, resulting in partial amputations to three left-hand fingers.
As an employee turned to walk from his computer station to another area, his feet became entangled in the hoses of an air/wet polisher. He fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was working at a cash register. A metal shoplifting alarm pin lodged in her wrist. She was hospitalized and the pin was surgically removed.

An employee was installing springs on a pickup truck. He was using a wrench and another part to compress the spring on the rear of the truck. The part slipped, causing the spring to snap back and  pinch his hand between the spring and the frame of the truck. He was hospitalized with a fractured right hand.
An employee fell off a step while leaving a cash register area, landing on the floor and suffering a broken hip.
An employee slipped on food on a classroom floor while cleaning after children's lunch, dislocated the right hip.

An employee was on top of a tanker truck using a tape measure to check the depth of the waste blood being pumped into the tanker. He was later found unresponsive laying near the open hatch of the truck with his right arm and head in the access hole on top of the tanker truck. He also had a cut on his forehead and suffered possible exposure to hydrogen sulfide.

An employee was helping an excavator operator with ground operations. The excavator bucket was swinging to pick up a scoop of dirt when dirt that was stuck to the outside of the bucket broke loose and hit the employee on the back. The employee suffered a back fracture.
An employee was performing hydroblasting activities when the hydroblasting device's wand came back and struck the employee's right leg, lacerating it.
An employee was standing on a delivery truck, trying to move a 700-pound pipe. The employee fell off the truck, landing 8 feet below; the pipe then fell on him and broke his pelvis.

Employees were performing normal daily tasks within the rendering department when a natural gas explosion occurred in the furnace of the blood dried system. Two employees were hospitalized with burns and other injuries.
An employee was opening a box and walking when he tripped over a pallet and struck the floor. He fractured his hip and required surgery.
An employee was using a three-step stool to count inventory. She fell from the last step as she climbed down, landing on the floor and breaking her right wrist.

An employee was servicing a lavatory on an airplane using a cart that connects a hose to the waste port to evacuate waste off of the airplane. The employee stood up beneath the aircraft engine and hit their head on the engine's oil drain mast. The employee suffered a concussion and bruising on the head.

On October 17, 2019, an employee fell approximately 5 feet from an extension ladder while cleaning a solar panel at a gauge station. He landed on his back on top of the ladder, breaking a back bone and requiring hospitalization.
While working on a roof, an employee fell through foam board insulation to the ground. The employee suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling control cable from a control house to a manhole. A pull rope was pulling the cable through the manhole; the employee's right ring finger was pinched under the rope on the spool, and the tip of his finger was amputated at the first joint behind the nail.
