An employee's big toe on their right foot was partially amputated when an outrigger on the laser screen machine was dropped on it.
An employee slipped and fell backwards into a box while entering a sit-down fork truck, suffering a fractured vertebra.
An employee was cleaning gutters from a ladder. He fell from the ladder, landing on his head 15 to 20 feet below. He suffered skull and facial fractures.
A car struck an employee in a parking lot, causing head and leg injuries.
An employee handling frozen turkeys felt severe pain in his abdomen and was hospitalized with a hernia.

An employee was helping load equipment into a truck. A stack of equipment was pushed into the equipment bin the employee was working on, and the bin in turn crushed the employee's right middle finger against the truck wall. The fingertip was amputated.

Employees were installing a 54-inch pipe. Both the manhole and pipe were inside a trench box. While operators were repositioning, the excavator slid down in the mud, causing the pipe to move further into the manhole. An employee was pinned between the interior wall of the manhole and the pipe. The employee was hospitalized with leg and abdomen bruising.

On October 16, 2019, an employee was operating a shape pad machine. The pads were sticking to the bottom roller and under the felt lubrication bar. The employee adjusted the bottom vacuum unit while knocking pads off the bottom roller. The top rollers caught the employee's right index finger, crushing it. The employee underwent surgery that included removing a piece of bone.
An employee was crimping six wires together using a crimping press. The dies closed on the employee's right index finger amputating the tip. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee tripped and fell while walking down the steps outside the shop. She had her lunch bag with her, and that bag had a paring knife inside. When she fell, the knife punctured her left lower abdomen, requiring hospitalization.
On October 22, 2019, an employee suffered a right index finger amputation while working with a precision surface grinder machine.
An employee was coming back from break when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his ankle.

An employee was rigging a steel beam with an overhead crane when the overhead crane was impacted by a second overhead crane on the same rail. The steel beam shifted and impacted the employee, who suffered a broken left leg and ankle.
An employee was cutting a ply board with a skill saw when the employee's glove and left hand were pulled into the saw, resulting in a partial left index finger amputation.

On October 17, 2019, an employee was using a shrink wrap machine to wrap cardboard boxes of plastic bottles on a pallet when his right thumb was caught in the wrapping process, causing a soft tissue amputation.
An employee was using a cheese conditioner machine. While the machine was rotating, his left middle finger and left index finger were amputated.
An employee was straightening the foot pad of a filler machine when the machine shifted and crushed the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a power drill with a connected ground wire. The employee was drilling some holes when the wire became wrapped on the drill head. The employee's finger was then caught between the wire and drill, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was polishing a part in a rotating lathe, using a sandpaper strip. The sandpaper and the employee's right hand were pulled into the lathe. The employee suffered a cut finger and a broken right arm above the wrist.
An employee was attempting to reposition a ladder while standing on the third rung when the employee lost footing and fell to the floor, suffering a concussion and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was feeding a sheet of metal into a shear machine when his finger came in contact with a spring in the machine, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.
A roofer was climbing to a penthouse roof from the main roof, using a fixed ladder on the building. He slipped and fell, injuring his lower legs.
A employee slipped on wet pavement while walking to her car, fracturing her patella.
An employee was using a jackhammer to clear a conduit obstruction. The jackhammer struck the top of the employee's left foot just before the big toe.
An employee fell off a lift gate while product was being unloaded, suffering a broken left leg and a collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting wood using a table saw when the saw amputated approximately half an inch from the middle and ring fingers of the left hand.
An employee was loading ham into a machine. His left index fingertip was amputated by the machine's product metal detector.

A landscaper was mowing the grass at a high school, using a stand-up riding mower. A hole, tree stump, or root caused the mower to bounce and his right foot was caught between the mower's deck and its discharge platform. He suffered a broken toe and was hospitalized.
On October 17, 2019, an employee fell out of the back of a trailer to the ground, suffering a broken collarbone and a head injury that required staples.

An employee was outside the back of the store, carrying a plastic tote of parts for delivery, when he tripped and fell down a flight of eight stairs, striking his head on the pavement. He was found unconscious at the base of the stairs. He suffered a head laceration and cranial fracture.
An employee was walking down a hall. She turned, tripped, and fell to the floor, suffering fractures to both upper arms and her right shinbone. She was hospitalized.
An employee was unwinding a winch when his left middle finger was pulled into the winch, resulting in an amputation to the second knuckle.

An employee was riding a mule up a trail. The mule lost its footing, and it and the employee tumbled down the mountain. The employee suffered a broken sternum, six broken ribs, and lacerations to the head and arm.

An employee was approximately 3 feet up on a free standing ladder looking at and cleaning site glass on a water knock when the ladder twisted, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slid, causing the employee to fall 2 to 3 feet to the ground from a flatbed truck. He received a compound fracture to his lower right leg.

An employee was aligning a mold with his finger using a hydraulic jack trolley when the valve power brake was pressed which lowered the valve onto the employee's middle finger and amputated the fingertip below the nail.

An employee was driving a forklift and he reached down to pick up a loose piece of banding. As the forklift drove forward, the banding was wrapped under the forklift. His finger was caught between the forklift and banding, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was carrying a tray to the kitchen and something was blocking the kitchen door. The employee tried to push the door open. The door came back and hit the tray, which struck the employee in the throat area. The employee suffered blunt neck trauma and respiratory failure.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift, traveling across the end of an aisle. A ride-along pallet jack struck him as it exited the aisle. His leg was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

In the thermal forming department, a machine was shut down because the sheet was wrapped around the rolls. The sheet was cleared, and the leader sheet was in place to start the line. During the start-up process, the sheet broke away from the leader sheet.  An employee was on the east side of the chrome-roll stand between the scanner and draw rolls. The employee was trying to save the sheet and manually hand feeding the sheet into the draw rolls when his hand was caught between the rolls and his arm was pulled in. He suffered injuries to his fingers, hand, and arm up to the bicep and internal bleeding.

An employee was adjusting a chain on a sprocket. His right index finger was pinched between the chain and the sprocket. The fingertip was partially amputated, with a partial loss of the nail. The machine was unguarded at the time.
While removing a truck bumper, an employee stood up, lost consciousness, and fell hitting their head on the floor. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee was operating a tube mill machine. The mill fractured the employee's right little finger.
While valet parking, an employee put a car in park but the car kept moving. He fell down and his right hand went under the bumper. His right-hand pinky finger was crushed, requiring stitches.
An employee was caught between a hoist hook and a mold, resulting in the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was installing guardrails on a one-tier scaffold. The employee fell onto a mound of dirt on the ground, suffering a broken ankle and a dislocated knee.
An employee was operating metal shears. The shears' hydraulic stop crushed the last joint on the employee's left little finger, leading to an amputation.
An employee was cleaning out an injector line in a milling area. The employee's right index finger was caught in a butterfly valve when the machine cycled, causing the amputation of the finger.
An employee was attempting to move a roller bed from a cooler entrance when his left thumb was pinched, resulting in a left thumb tip amputation.

A frac pump was running at a well location. An employee heard a rattling sound and walked over to investigate. A maintenance packing bar was laying on top of the pump. When the employee got even with pump, the packing bar slipped into the pump, which kicked the packing bar back out. The packing bar struck the employee in the right eye, causing right eye orbital socket fractures.
An employee was pulling a cart when it rolled up onto the employee's ankle, cutting the Achilles tendon.
An employee was cutting an exhaust pipe when the metal blade shattered and a piece of it lodged in the employee's neck. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was cleaning a moving drive chain on a conveyor belt when the employee's hand was caught in a pinch point in the machinery, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking along the top of a block wall to pull a tarp over a trailer in the loading pit. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor about 4.5 feet below, suffering several broken ribs.
Cookies were getting hung up on a cutter on an oven. An employee was clearing the jam when the cutter activated, amputating the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee fell 13 feet from a roof and was hospitalized.

On October 18, 2019, an employee was using an access ladder to access another level of a water tower to remove tools. He stepped off of the ladder onto a ceiling that he thought was a platform. He fell through the acoustic ceiling approximately 15' to the ground, fracturing his lower spine.

An employee was installing a backyard utility pole. The employee was climbing the pole with foot spikes when the employee fell approximately 12 feet onto bushes and grass. The employee suffered a back injury with possible compressed vertebrae.

While an employee was attempting to change a leaking O-ring on an excavator's hydraulic line, a sudden release of hydraulic oil startled the employee. The employee fell back off the catwalk and down about 11 feet to the barge below. The employee hit a concrete ballast block, suffering several broken ribs, a broken pelvis (in three places), a concussion, a laceration of the ear, a fractured wrist, and a broken cheek bone.
An employee fell off a beam while installing an HVAC unit, suffering a broken rib.

An employee tripped on a rug while walking up to a store's front registers. The employee fell to the floor, suffering bruises to the head and left shoulder and a right knee injury that required surgery.
An employee fell from the roof of a building.
An employee fell through the roof of a job site building, suffering a fractured wrist and hip as well as head trauma. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee's hand was caught between a roll of paper and a machine mechanism while the paper was being loaded into the machine. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the right ring finger, losing the pad of the first knuckle and part of the bone.
While stocking shelves, an employee stood up, became dizzy, and fell to the ground, suffering a shoulder injury.
Two employees fought, and one suffered neck, back, and head injuries, including an eye injury that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
At 12:53 a.m. on 10/19/2019, an employee was running to her car in the parking lot when she slipped and fell. She injured her head, suffering a concussion and possible brain swelling/bleeding.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw and amputated three fingers.
An employee was performing work on an electrical switch gear and suffered arc flash burns.
An employee tripped and fell on cardboard while walking, breaking a rib.
An employee was opening a box with a safety cutter when the cutter severely lacerated his left arm and wrist.
An employee was cleaning a depositor spool valve when his right middle finger contacted the valve's rotating parts, resulting in a fingertip amputation at the first joint.

An employee was cutting a plywood form with a circular saw. The sawblade caught the metal lifting strap for the inlet structure and jerked the saw in a new direction. It cut into the employee's left hand and wrist.
An employee was cutting open a salmon packet when his knife amputated the tip of his left index finger.
An employee was in a patient's residence when she bent down to pick something up and hit her head on a table. She was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was rolling a trash can out a door when he slipped and fell, breaking his leg.

An employee was performing flagging duties in a work zone when a motorist drove into the work zone lane closure and struck the employee. The employee suffered a head laceration and fractures to the shoulder, pelvis, and leg.

On October 19, 2019, an employee was assembling a rock hopper. The bottom part fell and the employee's finger was caught between the base of the hopper and the concrete floor. The employee suffered an amputation to the right middle finger.

An employee was working on a sand conveyor, using the jog switch with a key interlock to run the belt up and down identifying bad bearings, as well as installing a cover. Power to the conveyor was turned on and it amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was walking out of a building when a forklift struck her. She suffered a broken left foot and hit her head.
An employee was stocking freight and saw a spider. She killed the spider and then experienced heart attack symptoms and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking into the building for a project management meeting when an AC unit fell from the roof, striking the employee and knocking him to the ground. He suffered injuries to the ribs, lung, and collarbone.

An employee opened the release latch on the bottom of a mixer to allow materials to exit the hopper. His hand then entered the latch opening and the mixer severed his left index finger. The mixer was turned on at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping a trucker load material. A power pole shifted on the trailer, causing it to roll. The employee jumped off the trailer bed to the ground to avoid the pole and broke his left ankle and tibia.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder with a spray rig gun in his right hand. The trigger to the spray gun was hit accidentally while the gun's extension was resting on his palm below his left index finger. The spray rig discharged, and the pressure cut through the skin and injected paint into the palm of his hand.

An employee was retrieving a sample solution from a drain valve located near the bottom of the kettle when a hot chemical (caustic) solution spilled over the top of the kettle and burned the employee's back, left side, and leg/foot.
An employee using a step ladder to replace a cosmetic event sign fell approximately 4 feet from the step ladder to the floor level, suffering a couple of broken ribs.

An employee was working on a compressor and attempting to dump a scrubber on the compressor. At the time, the scrubber would not dump because it had frozen up. The employee opened a valve and gas began to exit the valve, causing a flash fire. He sustained second and third degree burns on the face and hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting fish on a band saw when the saw amputated the employee's right index finger.

An employee was doing maintenance at a sawmill. While getting ready to start the chip heads, he leaned in to observe a chain. The chain moved into position and caught the employee's right leg. He suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized requiring surgery.

On October 20, 2019, an employee was acting as a rock climbing guide and walking across a gulley when the employee fell about 30 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with head trauma, eye injuries, and fractures to the pelvis.
An employee was climbing a ladder to enter a trailer when a gust of wind blew the trailer door open, causing the employee to fall off the ladder and sustain a concussion.
An employee was stabbing a piece of casing with a backhoe when a joint of pipe struck him in the leg, causing bruising and soreness of the lower leg/shin area.
An employee was extinguishing a grass fire and was overcome by smoke inhalation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a retirement community resident when she tripped on an electrical cord and fell to the floor, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a box of plastic bags and struck her head, requiring hospitalization.
At approximately 1400 hours on 21 October, an employee was cutting wood using a table saw when the wood kicked back and struck the employee's lower body.
On October 21, 2019, an employee was observing a log being removed from a damaged tree when the log swung and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and collarbone.
An employee was climbing into his truck to get asphalt when his leg became tangled in a chain and he fell 3 feet to the ground, fracturing his left leg.

An employee was moving scraps on an assembly line. She was sitting down beside the conveyor belt with her hand resting on the conveyor belt. The conveyor belt is automatic and turned on. Her cotton glove was caught in the belt, resulting in the left index finger getting caught between the chain and the frame. She was hospitalized with a lacerated/broken left index finger.
An employee was cutting lumber and pushing wood through a table saw when the saw amputated the employee's left ring finger.
An employee was walking behind meat slicers in a deli department. The employee slipped on a piece of lunch meat on the floor and fell backwards, striking her head on the floor.

On October 21, 2019, an employee was guiding a rope to prevent it from catching/rubbing on a piece of equipment while millwrights (contractors) were installing/pulling the belt up into a leg housing. The rope then broke, causing the employee to fall backwards on the gravel parking lot (same level) and land on their shoulder. The employee then stood up for about 30 to 60 seconds and fainted, falling to the ground (same level) and striking their head. The employee suffered a separated right shoulder and collarbone and a laceration to the skull.

An employee was operating a press brake. His hand was inside the die area when the press brake was activated via the foot pedal. His hand was caught in the die, resulting in the amputation of three right-hand fingers.

An employee was trying to attach a bridle to a horsehead on a pumping unit. The horsehead became detached and fell from the walking beam on the pumping unit, striking the employee in both legs. The employee suffered a broken right kneecap.

On or about October 21, 2019, an employee had just removed an empty pallet off a stack and slid it onto the floor when the employee felt a sharp pain in the lower back hip area. The employee had a back spasm and was hospitalized for a back sprain.
Two employees were making repairs to HVAC equipment. A fan blade struck one of the employee's finger, resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.
While attaching a lifting sling to a truck, an employee was struck by a backhoe bucket. The employee suffered a right hip injury.

An employee was trying to install a transmission in a clutch assembly. The transmission would not go into the clutch due to a plate that had moved. When the clutch was unbolted, its weight caused it to fall and crush his right middle finger against the flywheel housing.
An employee was closing an overhead door when his right little finger was caught between the door and the doorjamb (on the latch of the door).
On October 21, 2019, an employee was using a rolling cart to move a center console toward a boat. The cart tipped over, striking and injuring the employee's lower back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a nail out of a board with a claw hammer when it flew into his right eye, impaling it and requiring surgery.
A temporary employee was working with a rivet machine when it triggered, causing an amputation to the employee's right thumb.

An employee was using an air-powered nail gun to attach a piece of wood to a crate when the tip of the nail gun turned sideways and a 2-inch nail went into his left hand which was holding the piece of wood. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a downspout. The employee's right middle finger was crushed in the downspout hole and amputated.
An employee was standing in front of stacked bales when a 1,200-pound paper bale fell and struck him. He was hospitalized with internal injuries and a right leg injury.
An employee was using a rolling ladder to install window signs. He fell from the ladder and hit his head on the concrete sidewalk, suffering a head laceration.

On October 21, 2019, at approximately 10:15 p.m., an employee was emptying a hopper into a hog. He used his hand to release the bottom lever when it snapped back and caught his left middle finger, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a portable table saw to cut wood for a crate when the saw blade made contact with the employee's left hand, amputating part of his left ring finger at the middle joint and partially amputating the middle finger on the same hand.
An employee was walking to another building when she tripped over an uneven sidewalk. She sustained a fracture to her left knee and right wrist, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was working near a grader that was cutting the road. The employee went to push a roll of plastic and it caused him to stumble backwards. The grader then ran over and fractured his left ankle, causing him to fall backwards and sustain a second fracture on his left arm.
An employee fell down a set of stairs, suffering a broken clavicle and brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hand loading 8-inch x 18-inch cement cinder blocks from a store's lumber yard onto a customer's vehicle. The employee wrenched his back and was hospitalized for a possible pinched nerve, slipped disc, or spinal injury.

On October 21, 2019, an employee was installing the rails for solar panels on the low pitched roof of a residence. When he walked backwards to check the alignment of the rails, he fell 10 feet to the ground. He landed on his feet and suffered two broken heels, requiring hospitalization. Fall protection equipment was not worn at the time of the incident.

On October 22, 2019, an employee operating a forklift struck a vertical metal aspirator stand. The employee's finger was crushed between the aspirator stand and the forklift side rail, resulting in a surgical amputation to the first knuckle.
On October 22, 2019, an employee was cutting a vinyl floor plank on a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's right little finger at the middle.

An employee was repairing a skid steer loader, draining the hydraulic lines. The bucket, which had been raised in the air, came down, hitting the overhead cover of the engine compartment and striking and trapping the employee. The employee suffered a broken jaw and facial bones.
An employee had just adjusted the meat in a meat cutter machine when his left index finger was pinched between the machine's moving parts. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell 12 to 14 feet down into an open hatch on a vessel and hit the floor, fracturing an arm and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove a chunk of concrete from a hopper when his hand was caught in the concrete pumping mechanism, amputating four fingers on his right hand.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder in order to perform maintenance services on a cooling tower. During the ascension of the fixed ladder, he fell about 14 feet to the ground onto his left side. He was hospitalized with broken ribs, damaged vertebrae/collarbone, and a bruised lung.
An employee was using a tarp to cover an overbleed stack. He slipped on the tarp and fell, landing on a solid metal surface and breaking his pelvis.

An employee was packing boxes using an electric tape dispenser when the machine became jammed. The employee was attempting to clear the jam when the machine started. The tape dispenser blade then amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee was loading personal items into his truck in preparation for a delivery. He was holding onto the outer handle of the truck cab when it broke. He then fell to ground, fracturing three ribs and his pelvis.
An employee's right index finger was caught between the double doors of a paint booth. The finger was amputated.
Two fingers in an employee's left hand became stuck/crushed in a pizza dough rolling machine.
An employee was filling a can with alcohol. The alcohol ignited and splashed onto the employee's hand and arm, igniting her clothing. She suffered second-degree burns to the hand and arm.
An employee was getting a flu shot when the employee experienced nausea, dizziness, chest pressure, palpitations, and shortness of breath.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while bending over to pick up paper off the floor, breaking an ankle.

An employee was climbing down a 28-foot fiberglass extension ladder when the base of the ladder became unstable and slid down a small incline and out onto the street. The ladder was struck by a moving vehicle, resulting in the employee falling 20 feet. The employee suffered a fractured right hip, cracked rib, and broken nose.
An employee was removing condensation from a vacuum when the blades in the vacuum amputated a fingertip.

An employee was operating a motorized push cart when the employee's right index finger was caught between the lever on the push cart and frame of a home being built, resulting in a fracture and partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift when he ran into a steel column. Upon impact, he struck his head against the overhead lift cage. He was hospitalized for a laceration, requiring stiches and surgery.
An employee was walking to her car in the dark when she slipped on wet leaves in the parking lot and broke her ankle, requiring surgery.
An employee was struck by another employee who fell from a ladder, suffering a neck injury that required hospitalization.

Two employees were transferring pre-cast concrete using a 7-ton overhead crane. The wire rope broke and the hoist block fell onto the employees. Employee 1 had two toes amputated from the left foot. Employee 2 suffered crushing injuries to both legs resulting in amputation of both legs.
An employee was replacing a chain when their finger got caught in a chain hole. The chain then moved and crushed the employee's finger resulting in amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was cutting a metal stud with a band saw when the saw got in a bind and pulled his hand into the blade.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a mixer shaft. The shaft rotated and struck him in the head, smashing his face against a forklift mast. He suffered facial fractures.
On October 22, 2019, an employee was pushing a dolly containing boxes of cleaning supplies down the ramp when he slipped and fell. He was hospitalized with a muscle injury to a leg.

An employee was working as a crew member at a substation when the employee placed a test lead from a tube stick on an energized conductor.  An arc flash occurred, causing thermal burns to the employee's face and chest.
An employee was on a ladder to clean gutters on a residential home. The ladder became displaced from the base and the employee fell to the ground, spraining his ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was performing a procedure on a patient when she cauterized her right index finger near her palm. The next day, she noticed that the injury was getting worse and was hospitalized.
On October 22, 2019, an employee began having muscle cramps after a day servicing customers' lawns. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

On October 22, 2019, an employee was using a hydraulic bolt tensioner when a seal failed, shooting pressurized hydraulic fluid in the employee's face. The employee suffered a laceration from the lip to the ear on the side of the face.
An employee was heating a mold. A propane tank exploded and the employee was knocked to the floor, suffering a broken wrist and burns to the body.

An employee was delivering furniture to a home location. He struck his head on a low hanging wall while walking down stairs and fell, striking a concrete landing. He was hospitalized with a head injury and concussion.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake on the left middle finger while installing a moisture barrier at a customer's residence, suffering swelling and soreness. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to rotate the drum of a commercial washing machine when his fingers were caught between the drum and the housing of the machine, cutting three fingers and amputating the tip of his second left finger.
An employee was hanging a steel beam as part of a new construction project. The employee fell about 14 feet from the beam, suffering a broken hand and a head injury.

An employee was opening the parts plate after a cycle on a compression molding machine. As the upper plate opened, the employee noticed a part stuck in the upper plate. The employee reached in between the upper plate and the tool to reach the stuck part. As the employee reached in, the hook from the hoist chain released and the upper plate fell down onto the employee's hand, causing a burn injury.

An employee was on horseback herding cattle in the penning arena. When a calf/steer ran into his horse, the horse reared up and threw the rider against a fence and onto the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury and a broken arm requiring surgery.

An employee was putting grams into a machine. The employee opened the screen and was using the left hand to move the gram when the employee's left middle finger was caught by the moving auger inside the machine, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was splicing piles when the upper pile, which was suspended by a crane, broke free, swung, and struck the employee in the back, resulting in broken vertebrae tips and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was trimming a plant with his pocket knife when his hand slipped and the knife cut his left forearm, causing an arterial laceration.
An employee was performing a tire change on a forklift and in the middle of inflating the tire, the tire blew up in his face. He was hospitalized for injuries to his face and jaw.

An employee was handling a rope (tagline) while removing a lid from a barge. A gust of wind moved the barge lid, causing the rope to jerk around the employee's thumb and resulting in an amputation of the right thumb.

After trimming a tree, an employee was taking off climbing gear while on the ground. The employee was removing the right climbing gaff and slipped, causing the gaff to impale the employee's left calf.
An employee was cleaning a machine when the employee's thumb became stuck in the machine, amputating skin from the thumb.

An employee was trying to transfer molten wax from a bulk container. During troubleshooting, a cap was removed from the line and the wax sprayed on the employee's right hand and forearm resulting in burns.

An employee was holding a tagline during a lifting operation at a wind farm when a crop duster aircraft flew between the wind tower and tagline that the employee was holding. The aircraft struck the tagline, which caused the employee to be lifted into the air and subsequently land on his back on the ground. He suffered a fractured L1 vertebra.

An employee was working on electrical power lines at a substation. An arc flash caused the employee to jump out of the bucket to the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg, a broken pelvis, and two broken ribs.

An employee was unloading empty pallet carts. Tension was applied to a flat metal winch hook, and his middle fingertip was pinched between the hook and a pallet cart. He suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was working in a scissor lift, replacing the ground wire in an electrical box. The employee came into contact with the live wire and an arc flash shocked the employee with 480 volts, causing first- and second-degree burns to the employee's face and arms.

While performing duties as a valet, an employee was walking to the designated valet service parking lot to retrieve a customer's vehicle and was struck from behind by a pickup truck.  The employee was knocked down and his left leg was run over. The employee sustained a broken left tibia, three broken toes on the left foot and torn tendons in the left leg.

An employee was waiting to pull product from a pallet inverter machine to load the product into a wrap machine for storage. A second employee was operating a forklift to pull the product from the machine. The second employee lowered the forklift bucket, and the first employee stepped in front of the pallet of product and was struck by the forklift's right fork. He fell to the ground, sustaining a laceration to his left foot and a broken heel.

Two employees were working inside a truck trailer to repair it. One employee was installing a scuff plate while the other sprayed an adhesive to help install the next scuff plate. The first employee's cordless drill ignited fumes from the spray adhesive, creating a flash fire that caused first- through third-degree burns to the employee's face, hands, neck, and leg.
An employee had been setting forms for concrete and became ill. The employee was shaking and unresponsive, due to possible heat stroke.
An employee was using a handheld cup-shaped grinder on a manhole cover. The cup flew off, striking the employee on the right knee and hand. He was hospitalized.
On 10/23/2019, an employee was rewinding material and pressing material down when their fingers were pulled into the rewind roller. The employee sustained a broken left forearm.
An employee was changing tools on a machine when the employee's left pinky finger was caught between the pusher tool and another tool. The employee suffered a broken left pinky and torn ligament.
An employee was walking into a freezer when the employee tripped over a box that was propping the freezer door open and fractured a femur.

An employee was helping assemble a crane by connecting an outrigger pad (shoe) to it. A pin popped out of the shoe and struck him in the face and right wrist, causing fractures to the face, wrist, and nose.
An employee was cutting a veal shank using a bandsaw when the shank bone slipped. The employee's thumb was then cut by the bandsaw, resulting in a partial right thumb amputation.

An employee was working behind the counter when a man entered the store with a container of gasoline, chased her back to the kitchen, doused her with gasoline, and set her on fire. She was hospitalized with 32% burn coverage to the face, neck, chest, and extremities.

An employee was cutting and removing a fallen tree and was pinning down the power line and communication cables. As the tree was being cut and removed, the communication cable sprang up and struck the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with facial injuries.

While loading a rail car with monomethylamine (MEA), a transfer operator wiped away sweat with glove covered hands. The gloves had become contaminated with monomethylamine. The employee began experiencing eye irritation and was hospitalized with chemical burns to the eyes.

An employee was working on a roll-down shop door while standing inside a loader bucket for elevation when the door rolled closed and struck the employee in the loader bucket. The employee was thrown to the ground, suffering a fractured hip, right wrist, and left ring finger, as well as lacerations.
An employee was backing up a loaded forklift when it struck a parked pallet jack. The employee's left foot was run over, suffering fractures to the main bone and four toes.
An employee was operating a two-roll mill machine and lifting material when the employee suffered a hernia.
A contract mechanic was doing maintenance on a baghouse machine. The machine's moving parts amputated the tip of the mechanic's left thumb.
An employee was conducting physical training when he felt pain in his upper left shoulder and chest. The employee was hospitalized for pericarditis.

An employee was operating a straightener machine when the employee's hand was caught by a piece of steel that was being straightened, resulting in the partial amputation of the left middle finger and degloving injuries to the left ring and pinky fingers.
On October 23, 2019, an employee was struck by a skid steer as it backed up. The employee suffered a lower extremity injury.
Two employees were removing a steel plug from a pump. Hot asphalt sprayed their faces, causing burns.
An employee was changing a burner tube on a furnace when molten salt poured out of the tube and onto their leg. The employee was hospitalized with third degree burns to the right leg.
An employee was climbing down after adjusting a steel pipe loaded on an open railcar when a trackhoe struck him with the bucket's loading attachment device. He suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was raking asphalt behind a road paver when the employee was struck by a vehicle, suffering a head injury, fractured rib, and fractured left leg.
An employee tripped and fell while walking on a tile floor, suffering a broken nose, fractured left eye socket, concussion, and subdermal bleeding. She was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a rotatory hammer drill to dill into concrete when his gloved left hand became caught, resulting in amputation of the pinky finger.
At 11:30 a.m. on October 23, 2019, a roofer fell from a fixed ladder while accessing a roof. The roofer landed on the concrete surface below, suffering head trauma and broken ribs.

An employee was filling propane cylinders at a commercial landscape business. A propane line disconnected from a cylinder and sprayed liquefied petroleum gas on the employee's right leg, causing severe cold burns to the leg.

An employee was topping a 100-foot-tall tree. The employee was attached to the tree using a climbing line and a safety line, about 60 feet high, when the tree split below the cutting point. The employee was knocked off the tree and struck by the split section of the tree, suffering a broken right leg, abdominal contusions, and a chipped lower-back vertebra.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a stairway, landing on the concrete floor below and suffering contusions and a head injury.

An employee was cutting the banding off a piece of steel with a torch. The steel popped off its resting place and landed on another employee's left leg. The second employee suffered fractures to the left tibia and fibula.

On October 24, 2019, an employee was replacing pulley belts on a dust collector system. The employee's left little finger was caught between the belt and the pulley sheave, causing a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was inspecting an attic when he fell approximately 9 to 10 feet through the ceiling and struck his head on the concrete garage floor. He suffered a head laceration and multiple fractures.
An employee was using a brake press to bend sheet metal. During the second bend, the press caught her right middle finger causing an amputation.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while walking down an aisle, fracturing the right hip.
An employee suffered a left thumb tip amputation.
An employee was unloading packages from a trailer when the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the trailer and an extendable conveyor, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving from a roof to a ladder. The employee tripped and fell to the ground below, suffering fractures, abrasions, and a traumatic brain injury.
An employee was shaking vines out of a harvester when he was bitten by a snake on the hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to install a grounding rod. A piece of debris struck him in the eye. The debris was embedded and the injury required surgery.
An employee was riding on a tractor when he fell off. The tractor's rear tire ran over him and broke his hip.

An AECOM maintenance employee was troubleshooting a malfunctioning encoder device. To access the device, the employee had to stand on top of a tank holding a caustic cleaning solution, about 3 feet off the ground. The employee's left leg slipped through one of the access covers and was immersed in the caustic solution up to the knee. The employee suffered third-degree burns to the lower leg.

An employee was on an extension ladder inspecting gutters on the leading edge of a roof. The ladder slipped and the employee fell with the ladder. The employee suffered a right foot fracture and abrasions, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was getting down from a ladder and missed the last rung, impacting the ground and suffering a fractured hip.
An employee was taking cash out of a vault for a customer when his right thumb was caught in the vault door, severing part of his thumb tip.
An employee experienced dehydration symptoms while conducting lead refining tasks, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was assembling a belt conveyor on a roller conveyor when the belt conveyor tipped over and struck the employee in the head, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee suffered a head injury and knee fracture.
An employee was cleaning around a tank. The tank overflowed, splashing the employee with boiling water and causing second-degree burns to his arm and lower legs.
An employee was entering a facility when she tripped on the entrance steps. She fell, suffering a broken hip.

On October 24, 2019, a forklift operator picked up two pieces of granite slabs using a lifter that was attached to a forklift truck. The two slabs weighed approximately 3,421 pounds. The injured employee had his hand on the two granite slabs while the forklift operator was moving them into position to place them on a truck. The injured employee was on the left side of the forklift when the two slabs shifted. The employee moved under the mast of the forklift and the front left tire ran over the employee's leg.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when she tripped over the curb and fell, fracturing her ankle.
An employee was removing a person from a property when the person attacked the employee with a brick, causing severe facial lacerations.

A temporary employee was loading garbage into a hopper of a residential garbage truck. As the packer panel mechanism was activated, the employee's right hand was caught in a pinch point, causing a severe laceration to the thumb from the sweep blade. The employee required surgery.
An employee was adjusting a dock plate when the dock plate fell, hitting the employee's head and chest. The employee suffered a chest contusion and laceration to the hairline.
An employee's finger was caught between a re-bar bender and a table, resulting in a right pinky finger amputation to the knuckle.

An employee was providing therapy to a resident when a fire started in a room across the hall. The employee suffered from smoke inhalation symptoms in her respiratory tract, including throat irritation, dizziness, and weakness. She was hospitalized.
An employee was running a drill press. The press caught the sleeve of the employee's welding jacket and pulled in the employee's arm. The employee's arm was fractured.
An employee was cutting 3/4-inch EMT conduit with a bandsaw. The saw blade partially amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was loading dump trucks with an excavator when the gate on a dump truck would not latch. The employee got off the excavator and tried to manually latch the gate shut. At the same time, the dump truck driver was trying to latch the gate with the hydraulic system. The hydraulic system caused the gate to latch and crush the employee's fingertip.
An employee was installing recessed lights. A spring struck and punctured his eye.
On October 24, 2019, an employee was trimming floor boards with a table saw when his finger came in contact with the blade, resulting in a partial index finger amputation.

An employee was transporting two sections of 3-inch schedule 50 piping. While the employee was offloading the trailer and moving the pipes from a pallet to cribbing, a pipe slipped and fell onto the employee's right foot; the employee then fell while turning, hitting the ground and suffering a broken fibula and tibia.
An employee was lowering a lift gate on a vehicle. The gate struck the employee's left hand, causing the amputation of the ring and little fingertips.
An employee was helping to unload a generator from a truck when the truck's lift gate actuated, pinching his left leg and fracturing his tibia/fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading a press machine prior to pressing a two-handed device. The two-handed device malfunctioned and the press cycled while the employee's finger was in the point of operation. The employee sustained the amputation of the first digit of the left ring finger.
A temporary employee was struck by a forklift. He suffered five toe fractures, foot fractures, and ligament damage to the left foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was nailing siding with a pneumatic coil nail gun. The gun shot a nail into her foot. She was hospitalized.

An employee was working as the lead operator of an extrusion line and was monitoring the operation of the plastics extruder. The employee was standing next to the vent of an extruder machine when hot plastic overflowed from the extrusion line s vacuum vent. The employee sustained severe burns to his arms and forehead.
While leaving a parking garage, an employee was shocked and burned by electrical wiring that was being tested.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction to aerosol air freshener being utilized in the bathroom.
An employee was operating a tug when he heard a bang and saw smoke. He jumped from the tug while it was in motion and sustained a broken right femur.
An employee tripped over a cart and fell to the floor, fracturing the left hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was closing a van's sliding door when her right pinky finger was caught between the door and door jam, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning a belt. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the pulley and the belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was climbing down from a roof on a ladder. The employee fell to the ground, suffering fractured vertebrae.
An employee fell off a ladder while picking apples, suffering a broken leg.

On October 24, 2019, an employee experienced an anaphylactic reaction likely associated with the cooking of shellfish-containing food(s) in the kitchen/cafeteria area of the outpatient clinic.  Due to the nature/severity of the allergic reaction, the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading drywall at a job site when the load of drywall fell on the employee, fracturing the right femur.
While getting up from a chair an employee's boot became caught in the cord of a security scanner. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was walking by a cooler and tripped on another employee's foot. The employee fell forward into a wall and suffered a broken left femur.
An employee was working with the rigging of a piece of metal. The rigging failed and the piece of metal struck the employee's lower body. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was clearing debris from a conveyor belt using a 2 X 4. The 2 X 4 was sucked into the machine along with the employee's body, injuring his left arm and shoulder, his head, and causing part of his left ring finger to be amputated.
An employee was at the bundle squeezer when a bundle went past and the bundle squeezer closed on their finger. The employee sustained crushing injuries to their left index finger.

An employee was cutting a notch on a piece of plastic using a notching machine. The machine caught the employee's finger and caused a partial amputation (skin of the nail and nailbed) to the fingertip.
An employee was operating a separation table when his right index and middle fingers were amputated in the rotary airlock valve.

An employee was lighting a pilot light on an asphalt heater when a flame came out through the pilot light access point, causing second degree burns over his face, left arm, and right hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling on a stackable metal bookshelf while a second employee was pushing it. The first employee slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing the T12 vertebra and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped over a curb and fell to the ground while carrying flowers. She suffered a broken upper left arm.
An employee was working on a railroad car coupling. A piece of metal fell out of the coupling and smashed the employee's finger, causing a fracture and a contusion. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, catching debris in a 5-gallon bucket from a contractor coring through the concrete floor above, when the employee fell from the ladder and sustained a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was disassembling a piece of equipment in the strip mill. The employee was removing a shaft. The shaft came out at the bottom once the bolts were removed. The shaft then struck the employee's legs, causing fractures to both legs.
An employee was unjamming a cartoner machine. A chain inside the machine pinched the employee's right index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee testing a piece of rebar on a bending machine when his hand was caught between the roller and the piece of rebar, causing an amputation of his right ring finger and pinky.
An employee's left index finger was caught between a conveyor and the guard. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on an industrial magnet, removing nuts, bolts, and washers. The magnet got close to another magnet and they snapped together. The employee's right index finger was amputated.
An employee was closing an overhead transformer fuse with an insulated stick. The transformer lid separated; oil sprayed out and burned the employee's back, back of the head, and forehead.

An employee was dumping a container of scrap wood that was attached to forklift forks into a dumpster when his finger was pinched between the container and the dumpster, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a ladder to remove insulation when the employee fell off the ladder to the floor, suffering a concussion.
An employee was cleaning equipment from a 15-foot-high platform. The employee fell and suffered a broken back.

While pushing a vehicle into a parking spot, an employee was steering the vehicle with the driver's door open and walking along side of it. When he reached the halfway point of putting the vehicle into a 
parking spot, his right thigh was caught between the door and the vehicle parked next to him, pinching his upper thigh muscle.

An employee had just finished her shift and clocked out. As she was leaving the hospital, a women approached her with a baby that was not breathing. The employee began CPR and then carried the baby to the ER department. After the incident, the employee reported being short of breath and was later hospitalized, suffering from an aggravation of a neuromuscular disease.
An employee was cutting chicken on a bandsaw when his left thumb contacted the blade, cutting his left thumb tip.

An employee had a three-wheeled sweeper tractor on the hitch of a company-owned pickup truck. The employee exited the truck and tried to disconnect the sweeper from it. When the latch would not budge, the employee grabbed a piece of rebar from the bed of the truck. As the employee pushed the latch up with the rebar, the sweeper popped off the hitch and began to roll away from the truck. The employee chased the tractor as it was traveling down a small hill toward a busy road and was reaching for the brake when the sweeper ran over the employee. The employee suffered two broken ribs, a punctured lung, and bleeding on the brain. The employee also sustained a lump and cuts on the forehead and cuts on the right arm from the bristles of the broom tractor. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 25, 2019, an employee was inside a man lift (18 feet high) installing lighting when the lift tipped over. The employee jumped out of the lift at the last minute as the lift was falling to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated right elbow and right heel.
An employee was mixing icing when his index finger entered a pump and was amputated.

An employee was talking to a co-worker while walking to lunch and tripped over a pallet that was against the wall. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a laceration to the left arm and a fractured elbow.
An employee was putting on a bolt when a machine was activated and smashed the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and suffered amputation of the right ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was opening a blasting pot when pressure in the blasting pot caused the top to blow off and throw the employee off the blasting pot. The employee sustained injuries to the head and arm.
An employee was draining water from a water booth vessel when steam/hot water released from a loose fitting onto the employee's midsection, causing first and second degree burns.

A temporary employee was operating a pallet jack when he stepped off the pallet jack. It continued moving and crushed his ankle between the pallet jack frame and a bollard. He was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.
An employee was putting plastic scrap into a pallet box. The scrap lacerated his left index and middle fingers. The fingertips were medically amputated.

On October 26, 2019, a crew was performing roofing work in a commercial building. At approximately 4:30 PM, wind was blowing away the TPO (thermoplastic polyolefin) that an employee was installing. The employee tried to grab the TPO and the wind caused the employee to back up towards an old skylight. The skylight broke and the employee fell approximately 50 ft. to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a brain injury and a broken arm and leg.
While bending over to pick up newspapers, an employee lost their balance and fell on the sidewalk, sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee fell while walking down an aisle. The employee sustained a fractured femur and dislocated left knee.

A maintenance employee made contact with an energized conductor when he was in the process of removing a bolt inside an electrical box (240 volts) with a wrench. This action induced an arc flash. The employee sustained first degree burns to both hands and second degree burns to his left forearm.
An employee was placing cases of product on the floor when he tripped over a wood pallet and fell on his left knee, fracturing it.
An employee was checking the hydraulic lines of a skid steer for leaks when two of their fingers became caught in the hydraulics and were smashed. One finger had to be amputated to the nail.
An employee was hooking up a panel on a flatbed trailer. The employee mis-stepped and fell off the trailer, suffering a broken arm and a small brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving to a service call when individuals in Halloween masks stopped the vehicle and assaulted the employee. The employee suffered a broken jaw and facial laceration.
On October 27, 2019, a temporary employee was taking apart a cheese shredder and contacted the rotating shredder head, suffering amputation of multiple fingers.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while exiting a room in the deli department. The employee sustained a broken left hip.
An employee fell 34 feet to the ground through an opening in metal roof decking and sustained a fractured leg and arm.
An employee attempted to crush a box under foot and fell to the floor, breaking the right leg. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was cranking on a jack with their foot to raise up a trailer when the jack failed, allowing the trailer to fall on and crush the employee's second, third, and fourth toes on the left foot and resulting in possible toe amputations.

An employee was unloading a box that was positioned on a pallet. The forklift driver came over to move the pallet. The forks did not go all the way in. When the pallet was moved, it shifted and pinned the employee's left leg between the pallet and a flatbed trailer. The employee suffered hyperextension of the left leg.
An employee walked over the top of a rope extension/partition. Her foot became entangled in the partition rope, causing her to fall and break her hip.
An employee was taking roils out of an oven when she lost her balance and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.

An employee was painting a 4" pipe when he tried to clean the residual paint off the paint mixer drill bit attachment. He was using a nylon sack to wipe the excess paint off when the drill was inadvertently activated. His left pinky finger became wrapped in the nylon sack material, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was riding the leading-end platform of a railcar as it was entering a road crossing when a semi-truck and trailer operated by a third-party trucking company entered the crossing just in front of the train. The train was unable to stop in time to avoid a collision and the employee was struck by the truck, which fractured both of his legs above the ankle.
An employee was using a powered industrial truck to load a pallet into a trailer when the employee's leg was caught and fractured between the truck and a pillar. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a boot dryer on the floor. She struck a credenza, suffering knee and tibia injuries.
An employee was stepping off a porch when the employee fell to the ground, tearing the quadriceps in both knees. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was installing a roof on a steel building when he lost his balance and fell approximately 30 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with an injury to his arm and leg. Fall protection was unhooked at the time of the incident.
An employee was installing guttering from an aerial lift when the employee contacted a power transmission line, suffering electrical burns to the face, hands, and body.
An employee fell off a mobile nightstand, suffering a broken hip.
An employee tripped over a bucket and fell onto a concrete patio, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was moving a lettuce slicer when her left thumb was caught between the slicer's blade and guard. She bumped the handle and the blade cut her left thumb, resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was operating a scissor lift when material fell and pushed the lift, causing it to top over and fall with the employee inside. The employee suffered a fractured right wrist and lacerations.

An employee was on the roof of a residential home. He was in the process of removing shingles from a pallet on an elevated forklift when the pallet broke, causing the employee to fall approximately 9 feet to the ground. He broke his right foot and ankle.

An employee was in a scissor lift repairing an oven. A pusher struck the scissor lift. The employee sustained extensive facial and orbital fractures, a left scapula fracture, a T-12 compression fracture, a C-1 fracture, multiple fractured ribs on the left side, a chest wall laceration, upper lip laceration, and a laceration to the nasal tip.
An employee was moving a bagging machine when it slid off the edge of a mobile cart and crushed the employee's left thumb.
An employee was picking up a tool bag when a venomous snake that was under the tool bag bit the employee's left index finger.
An employee was cleaning the fuzzy seed location when the dust caused an asthma attack.

Two maintenance employees were trying to clear a clogged pipe using a small piece of metal. One of the employees was holding down the manual button on a solenoid so the gate would stay open. The employee holding the button let go of the button and the gate closed on the other employee's finger. He suffered a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was in a receiving aisle doing merchandising work. At the same time, a forklift two aisles over was moving something when the forklift struck an item. The item fell onto a safe that was double stacked on a pallet. The safe then fell onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured vertebrae.

An employee was going to sand blast when the high-pressure sanding unit began to roll. He was trying to stop it when his right index finger was caught between the lid and the lip of the unit, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck by an ATV while crossing the road, suffering a hairline fracture to the skull and a fractured tibia.
An employee was operating a band saw when the employee's hand slipped and contacted the blade, resulting in a possible right index finger amputation.
An employee was building a load for a trailer. One of the I-beams being prepared was caught in the beam hooks and rolled onto the employee's right leg. His leg was broken right above the ankle.

An employee was changing a roll of paper on a rack with a 10- to 12-foot bar. The bar's pin was removed on one end. When the employee pulled up on the end of the bar, it came loose, causing the opposite end of the bar to fall. This then caused the entire bar to fall, and the employee's left fourth finger was caught between the bar and the rack, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was rolling cut pipe from a conveyor when the employee's hand was caught between two pipes, resulting in a pinky fingernail amputation.

An employee was clearing a bone from the jaw separating machine when their fingertip was pinched in the machine. The employee sustained an avulsion to the left index finger that required amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was assembling a pallet with an air gun. When he fired a nail into the pallet, debris entered his eye, requiring hospitalization and surgery. Safety glasses were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was winterizing a gas compressor when a flash fire occurred. He received burns to his face, neck, and hands.
On October 28, 2019, an employee was in an auto salvage yard when a cottonmouth snake fell from a car's bumper area. It bit the employee's right hand, and he was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the hard surface in a room, suffering a brain bleed/skull fracture.
An employee was loading a feed truck compartment when the wind blew the lid closed on his left index finger.
An employee was bitten by an unknown insect and hospitalized.
At about 10:00 a.m. on October 28, 2019, an employee was lowering the landing gear of a log trailer when the "swing" landing gear beam crushed his right middle and ring fingers.
Two employees were arguing. The injured employee attacked the second employee with a shovel. The second employee used a garden rake to defend himself and broke the injured employee's arm.

An employee was working from a one-person pod lift, installing network cable in a loading dock area. An overhead door struck the lift while being opened, causing the lift to tip over and the employee to fall to the floor. The employee suffered trauma to the back, shoulder, arm, and hand.

An employee was cleaning debris from glue rollers when the employee's right thumb and index finger were caught between two rotating glue application rollers. As a result, the employee suffered a partial amputation to the right thumb and fracture to the right index finger.
An employee was operating a powered lift truck when his left foot was crushed between a bollard and the lift truck, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cutting tortilla strips when the knife slipped and amputated a fingertip.

An employee was trying to remove a bad book from a conveyor when the employee tripped and fell forward, contacting the floor. The employee suffered abrasions and bruising on the knees, a cut on the lower lip, and a concussion.
An employee suffered an eye injury while pouring a zinc oxide product into a bucket.

An employee was on an orchard ladder pruning trees using a pole pruner. The spring component of the pruner caught on a limb. When the employee attempted to move the pole to make another cut, the pole pulled him off balance. The employee fell 10 feet from the ladder to the ground, landing on his right foot. He sustained a fracture to the right heel.
An employee was climbing a step ladder when she lost her balance and fell to the floor, suffering a compression fracture of the L1 vertebra.
An employee was scanning a cotton bale when a forklift hit his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to open the door to a semi trailer. The strap broke and the employee fell backward off the trailer to the ground, suffering a broken left elbow.

An employee was inspecting a piece of equipment that was making noise when the employee's glove was caught between the equipment's chain and sprocket. His finger was pulled into the spinning chain and sprocket, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was bitten by a venomous snake while installing dewatering materials.

An employee was working in a two-person crew to address a steam leak from a flange. A wooden plug was placed into the flange to reduce and mitigate the leak in preparation for the job. The plug dislodged, and the resulting burst of steam burned the employee's right hand, leg, and face. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to get into a vehicle that was on a slow moving conveyor in order to move the vehicle to another conveyor for inspection. A second employee was already in the vehicle. When the second employee started driving the vehicle, the first employee lost his balance and fell to the floor, fracturing his hip.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering head trauma, broken ribs, and a broken leg.
An employee was handling two industrial magnets. The magnets attracted each other while in the worker's hands, came together, and amputated his left thumb tip.
An employee tripped over the base of a fence post and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a possible dislocated elbow.
On 10/29, an employee was stocking books on shelves when she slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her elbows and nose. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was spooling wire coming off a wire draw machine when the end of a piece of fence wire struck the employee's eye. The employee suffered an eye injury requiring stitches. Safety glasses were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was inspecting a trailer. While its door was being closed, the employee's left thumb was caught between the trailer and the door. The tip was amputated.
An employee was attempting to remove a wedge that was under tension in the weld of a bucket when the wedge flew out and struck the employee in the face. He suffered a fractured orbital bone.
An employee suffered a leg injury when a rifle accidentally discharged while adjusting the scope mount and bore sight.
An employee was attempting to light the pilot light on a heater treater when a faulty valve allowed gas to escape and ignite, causing second degree burns to the employee's face.

An employee was standing on the fifth floor supervising workers. The employee took a step back and fell through a hole approximately 14 feet to the fourth floor. The employee sustained a laceration to the back of the head, and fractures to the spine, ribs, and jaw.

An employee was operating a press brake. To get the angle correct on a piece of sheet metal, a second piece had been added. When the machine was activated, the employee's right index finger was caught between the two pieces amputating the fingertip.
On 10/29/2019, an employee was walking across the parking lot when he slipped and fell to the ground, hitting his head.
An employee was walking to his vehicle when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking his left tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to catch a bottle that was falling off of a cart when she lost her balance and fell. She was hospitalized with a right hip fracture.

An employee was unloading a shipping container. A portable loading ramp was being moved into place when it fell off the forklift and landed on the employee's foot. The steel cap of his steel-toed boots was crushed against his toes, resulting in medical amputation of four toes.

An employee was climbing a 28-foot extension ladder to attach an aerial service wire to a communications pole when the pole snapped due to wood rot. The employee fell 15 feet to the ground and broke his left arm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee attempted to remove a board that was jammed in the entrance of the gang saw. On the third attempt to remove the board, the employee's arm contacted the planer head of the gang saw resulting in amputation of the right arm below the elbow.
An employee slipped on ice/snow and fell in the parking lot while accessing a work truck, suffering a back/rib injury.
An employee was getting a saw out of a toolbox when his right middle finger was pinched, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing a mold to be blasted. While maneuvering the molding into place, the employee's right ring finger was pinched by the mold, causing an amputation to his fingertip without bone loss.

A temporary employee had his right foot on the brake of a hand truck and was in the process of leaning the hand truck back toward himself when one of the boxes on the hand truck shifted. The result of this action altered the distribution of the load and exerted pressure onto the employee's right leg. He sustained fractures to his right tibia and fibula.
An employee was entering a hot rinse water tank when he slipped and fell into the hot water up to his waist, suffering burns.
An employee was cutting pipe with a construction saw when the saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's throat.

An employee was standing in the back of a truck, setting out traffic cones on the edge of a road. The truck moved forward and the employee fell from the truck, landing on his back. An arrow-board in tow ran over his right leg, breaking it.

An employee was attempting to unclog a jammed vacuum unit when his right hand entered the energized unit. His right index finger was then caught between the vacuum's airlock and flange, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was assisting a patient in a parking lot and contacted a foreign substance, possibly Fentanyl, that was on the patient. The employee started having cardiac issues and was hospitalized.
An electrician was climbing down a ladder when she fell, landing on the ground below and breaking her right ankle.
An employee was removing trim from a 6-foot step ladder when he lost his balance and fell off the ladder, fracturing his leg and ankle.
An employee was on a scissor lift 20 feet high, removing a damaged aisle upright. The scissor lift fell over with the employee inside, and the employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee climbed to the 6-foot level of a ladder on a deck to remove screws and trim boards when the ladder slipped on the deck. He fell to the side and then jumped to the floor off the deck, landing on his feet before collapsing. He fractured his right tibia and injured his left heel, requiring surgery.
An employee was pouring a hot load of molten steel into a mold when a hot piece of metal splashed and went inside his boot, burning his foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee stepped off a stair step, twisted his leg, fell to the ground, and broke his leg.
An employee was manually moving a rack weighing 500-800 pounds when it tipped over on top of the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the upper left leg and ankle.

On October 30, 2019, at approximately 1:40 a.m., an employee was placing steel pallet forms used to create foam insulation panels into a press. The pallets are guided into the press by rollers located underneath the pallets. As the employee was moving a pallet form into the press, the pallet form became stuck on the guide rollers. The employee was attempting to reach up to free the pallet when the roller drive mechanism engaged, causing the employee's right hand to be caught between the pallet and a vertical steel press support column. The employee suffered a fracture of the 5th metacarpal in the right hand (pinky finger between knuckle and wrist joint), requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was disassembling a shelf when it fell and cut off part of the employee's little finger.
While inspecting lumber, an employee was struck by a stack of lumber that was being conveyed. He sustained a laceration to his leg resulting in hospitalization.
Employees were attempting to attach forks to a backhoe. The injured employee was holding the forks when he fell off the casing trailer. The forks landed on his chest and he sustained broken ribs.

An employee was going to use a water hose to remove chicken debris from the floor inside the further processing oven room. As the water valve was turned to the on position, the pressure from the hose caused it to slip out of the employee's hands and the end of the hose made contact with the left eye of another employee standing nearby. The eye injury required surgery.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet to the ground while installing a single-wide mobile home roof and suffered fractured vertebrae.

An employee was removing a coaster car from the tracks using a forklift, when their right hand was caught between the wheels and the axel. The employee sustained amputation of the right pinky fingertip.

A maintenance employee was fixing a folding rail that was stuck. When the scissor railing lowered, the employee's finger was caught in a pinch point of the folding section. The employee's left pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was assembling a trench box and sliding a side panel into a corner post when the steel panel amputated the employee's right ring fingertip to the first knuckle.
A maintenance employee was conducting a leak test when their right hand was caught on the die resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was using a battery-powered handheld circular saw to cut wood. He was adjusting his grip on a piece of wood when his hand came in contact with the moving blade, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation.

An employee was working in an excavation, connecting horizontal boring drill attachments. The boring machine kicks out soil while it is operating underground. This soil was being scooped up by an excavator when the excavator's bucket bumped the wall of the excavation, causing a wall of soil to fall onto the employee. The employee sustained a fractured ankle and pelvis.

Two employees were pulling a manure hose through a culvert using a tractor in order to field-spread manure. The injured employee's leg became entangled in the manure hose, and the tractor dragged him. The injured employee sustained a partial leg amputation (above the knee).
An employee was walking to her car when she slipped on black ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, breaking her left ankle.

An employee was trimming branches from a tree when they slipped from a branch. The fall protection system engaged, causing the employee to swing and hit the trunk of the tree. The employee was hospitalized with a lower back injury.

An employee was securing material for a delivery when the employee fell approximately 4 feet from a flatbed truck to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured skull, broken ribs, and a bruised lung.

Two employees were putting pallets and wood in a roll-off dumpster. After completion, some pieces were sticking out above the fill line. The employees climbed the dumpster to rearrange the wood to fit within the fill line. The injured employee fell from the dumpster to the ground below, sustaining a broken hip that required surgery.

An employee was observing line machinery operations when he attempted to check an air cylinder actuator with his left hand. The actuator suddenly actuated, and his left ring finger became lodged, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was walking when a forklift reversed and ran over the employee's left foot. The employee's foot was crushed and had to be amputated.
An employee was using a drill press to drill a hole in a piece of metal when the piece began to spin and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was attempting to jump a cable from a temporary meter when an arc flash occurred. The employee received electrical burns to the arm and face.

An employee was operating a walkie/rider electric jack when he turned the electric jack to the left and his left foot hit a concrete pole. His foot became caught between the pole and the electric jack, resulting in a swollen left foot area with two fractures and a cut. His foot was off the forklift platform at the time of the incident.

An employee was working as an assistant on the extrusion line, pulling plastic out from the machine. The roller was dropped on the injured employee's right hand, crushing two fingers between the machine's rollers. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the ring and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a press machine when the employee's left middle and ring fingers were caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was walking in the locker room when hardware in his prosthetic leg failed, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with possible broken ribs.

On October 30, 2019, an employee was preparing an area to throw bundles of mail underneath the automated parcel bundle sorter. He got on a powered operated pallet jack to move it.
