While he was moving the pallet jack, the control handle unexpectedly came up, causing the pallet jack to come to a quick stop. He fell off of the pallet jack and landed on his back on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured back.

An employee was dislodging a piece of lumber from a conveyor when another piece of lumber hit the piece he was attempting to remove, causing his left pinky finger to be caught between the lumber and a piece of steel. As a result, his left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a piece of lab equipment and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was attempting to remove a rock that had jammed a mechanical gate on a batch plant hopper and conveyor. When the rock became free, the gate snapped shut, pinching the employee's hand and fingers between the gate and the stop point of the gate. Four fingers were amputated at the second joint of the knuckles.
An employee was cutting material on a block using a chop saw when the saw kicked back and amputated his left index fingertip.
While unloading a flatbed truck, an employee slipped off the truck and fell approximately 4.5 feet to the ground, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was retrieving his fallen hard hat from under the mold line when the line indexed, impacting the employee's head. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture.
An employee was at the range when a disc in his neck broke into three pieces and one of the pieces went through a ligament.
An employee was standing on the incline of a grinder. The employee fell 3 feet off the grinder onto the floor breaking two ribs and puncturing a lung.

An employee was going to lift steel products using a chain sling and an overhead bridge crane. The employee's left thumb was pinched between two chain pieces when the crane started lifting the product. He sustained a laceration and fracture of the left thumb.
An employee was operating a standup forklift to load produce at dock door #4. En route to the dock office, the forklift backed into the concrete dock office wall and the driver's ankle was fractured.
An employee was felling a tree when a tree or branch struck the employee, causing fractures to the neck and cheekbone.
An employee was throwing trash in a truck when his finger became caught in a pinch point between the cable and the truck, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a four-wheeler to take soil samples when it hit a rock. The four-wheeler rolled over onto the employee's left leg fracturing the fibula and tibia.
An employee was lifting material with a crane when a skid of metal fell and landed on him. He suffered a leg laceration and contusions to the abdomen and pelvis.
An employee broke his leg when a wall partition fell on his leg.

An employee was sliding a box across the floor when the box struck a raised floor-mounted electrical outlet, causing the employee to lose her balance and fall head-first into merchandise shelving. She sustained a head injury.

An employee was cradling a 20-pound spool of synthetic yarn that had become unraveled. The employee was attempting to find the end of the ball of yarn and had been making loops with their left hand. The employee dropped the spool and it fell to the ground. As a result one of the loops of yarn clinched tight on the end of the employee's left little finger pad and sliced/tore the skin away.

An employee was walking on a paved road to a training class at a training facility. When he reached the crosswalk, he slipped and fell to the ground. He suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee offloading boxes from a truck suffered chest pains and was hospitalized.

An employee fell approximately 9 feet from a ladder to the ground while attempting to reach an alarm that was going off on top of a machine. The employee suffered a broken left arm and fractured ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee seated in a chair fell out of the chair and injured their back.

An employee was sliding a fork extension onto forklift forks when the fork extension slipped from his grip and his left hand was caught between the fork extension and the forklift forks, resulting in an amputation to the left middle digit.
An employee on a ladder was nailing siding using a nail gun. While securing the nail gun it missed his pouch causing a nail to shoot and penetrate his thigh.
An employee was punched in the face by a patient. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured jaw.

An employee was cleaning and emptying trash cans when the employee tripped over a guest's foot and fell onto a display case. The employee's head/lip area struck the case, and the employee suffered head, face, and chest injuries.
An employee was taking apart a countertop. The countertop fell and caused an amputation to the employee's finger.
An employee's right hand was caught and de-gloved between two rollers on a rubber mill.

An employee was cleaning mud off his boots with a 3,500 psi pressure washer when he lost control of the pressure washer and was struck on the right calf with pressurized washer spray. He suffered a puncture wound to the right calf and was hospitalized.

An employee was working inside a barricaded area on a road replacing a broken electrical pole. A car broke through the barricade and contacted a fiber optic cable that was on the ground. The cable then struck the employee, throwing him into the road and dragging him approximately 27 feet. The employee sustained injury to the head and face.
An employee was placing cribbing underneath a part when the part slipped, catching his finger between the material and a machine. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing a drive shaft when it fell and struck his right forearm.
An employee was climbing a portable ladder and fell to the floor below resulting in two fractured vertebrae.

An employee was rehanging a line on a pole approximately 18 feet high. During high winds, a nearby tree broke and fell onto the feeder cable causing the top of the pole to snap below the transformer. The employee did not fall from the pole, but was struck by the pole or the transformer. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from home constructing an A-frame easel to be used at the store. He was operating a table saw, turned the saw off and reached for the cut piece of wood. The still moving blade severely lacerated his left index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was injured by an arc flash while working on a live electrical panel. The employee received burns to the face and hands.
An employee was repairing a stacking machine when the machine belt suddenly started and amputated the tip of his thumb.

An employee was walking on top of a fuel tanker preparing to fill the truck. He stepped over an opening, lost his footing, and fell to the ground sustaining a bruised left leg and lacerations to the nose and forehead.

Two employees were unboxing stadium chairs. Employee 1 picked up a paddle-lock and hit the injured employee in the head with it. The injured employee was knocked out, began having seizures, and was hospitalized with severe head trauma.

An employee was getting ready to change out a tool die on the press. The lifting device shifted and dropped; the top shut on the employee's hand. The employee sustained a fractured right index finger and the right ring finger was amputated.

On 10/31/2019, at approximately 10:00 AM, an employee was on his hands and knees balanced on trusses while sheeting a roof. He lost balance and fell approximately 14 feet to the concrete below, sustaining a neck injury.

An employee was collecting solid waste material at residences. The employee was riding on the back of the truck. It was raining and the vehicle was wet. The employee fell from the back of the truck and was hospitalized with head injuries.

An employee fell 43 inches from a crane platform while removing a pin from the boom. The pin weighs about 50 lbs. and the employee lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, hitting his head. He suffered two fractured vertebrae in the back and one fractured vertebra in the neck.
An employee was cutting a section of a sidewalk using a saw when the saw kick backed and lacerated the top of his left foot.
An employee was hanging ceiling grids while wearing adjustable stilts. A screw came out of the stilts and the stilts collapsed, causing the employee to fall and break a leg.

An employee was working on an automatic drill apparatus. A tool was left on top of the machine, and the vibration from the machine started to move the tool. The employee was attempting to grab the tool when the machine cycled again. The employee's left arm was caught in the machine, resulting in a left arm fracture and severe lacerations.
An employee was operating a brake press when her finger got caught between the two dies resulting in amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was spraying an area with a water hose when she slipped and fell, injuring her knee.
An employee was tapping a chain when his index and middle fingers were caught in the chain and sprocket. He suffered an amputation to the index and middle finger on the left hand.
An employee was using a multi-meter to troubleshoot an electrical issue on a 26-kv primary switch. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained electrical burns to the hands and face.

An employee was attempting to tack weld and repair a tubular steel livestock gate. The gate was in a bind due to a broken component and was positioned in such a way that a gap was present between the broken component and anchoring rail. As the employee placed the left hand on the anchoring rail, it dropped, pinching the soft tissue of the employee's left index finger between the component and anchor. As the employee pulled the hand back, the employee's left index finger was amputated (without bone loss).
An employee was assembling a 6" bend for a manhole vent when his finger was caught in between the bolts and the hood, fracturing his middle finger.
An employee was on a truck's platform, unhooking air lines from the trailer. The employee fell off the platform to the asphalt ground and suffered a broken right femur.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack, taking it to be charged. When the employee dismounted the pallet jack, his right foot became caught under the pallet jack, fracturing his right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was injured while shoveling soil inside a trench when the side collapsed and struck his right leg. The employee suffered a lower leg fracture.
An employee jumped down into an excavation that was 9 feet deep and then the walls of the excavation caved-in on him. The employee sustained broken ribs and a crushed collarbone and jaw.
An employee was operating a sweeper truck and hit a guardrail, suffering a deep laceration above his right ankle.

An employee was working with a ground man to remove a storm-damaged red oak tree that had fallen on a primary power line and secondary communication lines. The tree was being supported by two branches near ground level. When one branch was cut, the weight shifted onto the other branch, which failed. This caused the tree to roll and strike the employee in the right leg, fracturing his femur.

On November 1, 2019, an employee was unjamming material from the caking roller using a wrench. The wrench was pulled into the caking roller and the employee's fingers were crushed by the wrench and the ingoing rollers. The employee sustained the amputation of their left pinky fingertip and a fractured middle finger.
An employee was taking a picture from the back of an empty trailer when she was struck from behind by a forward moving tractor. The employee sustained a contusion to the abdomen.
An employee slipped on ice while leaving a vehicle in the company parking lot. The employee fell to the pavement, suffering an injured back and neck, and was hospitalized.
An employee was patrolling a parking lot when she was shot once in the abdomen and once in the hip.

An employee had delivered housekeeping equipment to another building. Upon returning from the other part of the facility, the employee slipped on ice that was on the ground in front of the entrance door. The employee sustained a broken leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a press machine. The employee was attempting to pull a pin out of the master bushing while the chain was moving forward when the employee's left hand was caught between the left/front pusher head and the pin being pushed out. As a result, the employee sustained an amputation to the left pinky finger.

Employees were working on a ride-on core aerator in a garage. The core aerator was raised up on a forklift so the employees could examine the belt. As the injured employee was examining the belt, the aerator was turned back on and the injured employee sustained amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee slipped/tripped on ice on the frozen ground, breaking the left femur.

An employee had picked up an odd-shaped piece of decking material that weighed approximately 44 lbs. and was moving it to a place on the deck when he slipped, lost his balance, and fell onto the deck. As he fell, he let go of the decking material and it struck his calf, breaking his left tibia and fibula.
An employee's legs were pinned between a concrete piling and the tire of his truck while he was trying to remove a piece of wood from the cement piling. He suffered a torn left ACL.

An employee was helping a machine operator load a personnel bucket onto a trailer when the employee was struck by the boom of a rear-easement backyard digger-derrick machine. The employee suffered fractures to the ribs, hips, and right femur.
An employee operating a double pallet jack in the freezer was struck by a forklift and was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
A maintenance employee was cleaning a forklift engine with a pressure washer when the nozzle tip came off and steam released. He suffered a laceration and burns to his hand.
An employee tripped and fell down while descending a staircase inside the facility. The employee suffered a fractured left wrist, contusion on the forehead, and potential concussion.

An employee had been inspecting a roof line from a ladder. As the employee climbed down the ladder, the ladder's base gave out and the employee fell onto a porch roof and deck. The employee suffered a compression fracture to a back vertebra.

An employee was unloading crates of apples that weighed approximately 20 to 30 pounds when he fell and hit his head against the base of a shopping cart. He suffered a head laceration and two fractured vertebrae.

An employee was walking around a truck that had a form extending beyond the truck's body when she lost her footing and fell onto the asphalt surface. She broke her right femur and required hospitalization for surgery.

On October 27, 2019, at about 7:45 a.m., an employee was trying to get a power washer to turn over. The employee was testing the battery and solenoid when the motor moved and caught the employee's left ring finger in the belt, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

On November 1, 2019, an employee was hanging birthday decorations from a sales countertop. She went to step onto an A-frame ladder and slipped, falling to the floor on her knees and elbow. She was hospitalized with sprained knees and a dislocated elbow.

A temporary employee was hooking up a cargo load in the hull of a boat when the straps holding the pipes broke, allowing the pipes to fall on top of him and strike his legs. He suffered a broken left leg and right leg laceration.
An employee was lifting a pot of water to empty at the steam table when she felt something pop in her back. She fell onto the steam table and possibly down to the floor as well.

An employee was attempting to apprehend a shoplifter when the shoplifter pushed the employee. The employee fell and struck their head on the ground, suffering swelling of the brain and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working the cash register at the front of the store. A masked person entered the store and demanded money. As the employee turned to open the cash register, the person shot the employee twice in the stomach.
When a flight attendant sat in the forward cabin jump-seat, his left ring finger was caught in the seat's folding mechanism. The flight attendant sustained a fingertip amputation and a broken finger.
An employee was straightening boards on a chain conveyor when his glove was caught by the conveyor's chain. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was closing a dock door when he lost his footing as he was bringing the door down, causing it to land on and break his left arm.

An employee was kneeling down to look under an welder machine to see if he could find a bracket that had broken off. The employee lost his balance and his left hand slipped off the frame of the machine. His left index finger was caught between a table transfer cylinder and a metal stop and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working a pipeline tie-in operation, aligning a pipeline section with an existing pipeline. The nylon sling attached to the track hoe that was holding the pipeline section had too much slack, and the pipeline fell about 2 feet (while still in the sling) and struck the employee. The employee suffered a hairline hip fracture.

An employee was operating a yard horse and was exiting the cab onto the platform of the yard horse when their safety boot got stuck on the platform grating causing the employee to fall approximately 42 inches from the platform onto the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow and vertigo.

An employee was mounting a tire on a tire changing machine. He was attempting to clean off debris from the automated duck head when his right index fingertip was pinched between the duck head and the wheel of the tire, resulting in a partial finger amputation. The duck head was in motion at the time of the incident.

An employee was preparing to work on the brakes of an overhead crane when the brake shoes were removed on the static brake and the crane moved. The employee was caught between the crane trolley and the beam, suffering a spleen injury that required surgery.

The injured employee was steadying an 8-inch pipe that was positioned on a pipe stand so that another employee could grind a tack weld on the pipe. The pipe slipped off the stand and crushed the injured employee's left arm against the stand. The injured employee sustained a broken ulna and radius and required surgery.

On November 01, 2019, an employee was cleaning a mandrel (metal cylinder which holds the can) of a can printing decorating machine when the printer jogged, causing his right hand to be caught between machine's mandrel and blanket wheel (transfers the image onto the can). The employee suffered a laceration and fracture to his right hand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working on the top floor of the mill attempting to unplug a cyclone, when he lost balance and fell into the open hatch of the auger. The auger rotated and amputated the employee's lower left leg. At the hospital, the employee's leg above the knee was surgically amputated.

An employee was setting dunnage for crane pads when the employee's finger became stuck between the dunnage and the crane pad. The employee's left index finger was de-gloved and had to be medically amputated.
An employee was acting as a spotter for a moving aerial work platform when one of the platform's wheels struck and fractured the employee's left leg.
An employee was inspecting fire extinguishers on a fourth floor roof when he fell from the roof.

An employee was sealing a trailer before it departed. The trailer pulled away from the loading dock and the employee fell approximately 4 feet from the loading dock. The employee sustained a head contusion, fractured ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee had just hooked up to a bulk chemical trailer and was performing a pre-trip inspection. Caustic soda ash blew from a rail car inside the plant and the employee sustained chemical burns to the eyes, face, throat, and lungs.
An employee was unclogging a pneumatic paint gun when bronze paint was discharged into a finger on the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the elevated forks of a forklift to reach racking in a warehouse. As he was being lowered down from the racking, the forklift shifted, causing him to lose his balance and fall approximately 5 feet to the ground. He suffered closed head trauma.
An employee was working on or around 13,800-volt electrical equipment at a substation. An arc flash occurred and the employee sustained second and third degree burns to the face and neck.

The injured employee was helping a co-worker near the boiler when he noticed a pressure valve was providing a false reading. He tapped on the fluttering boiler gauge; the gauge dislodged and sprayed hot water (180-190 degrees F) onto his left forearm resulting in a second degree burn.
An employee was pulling a line of baggage carts when he pulled a muscle in his back.
An employee was opening a sliding metal gate when the gate came off its track and struck the employee on the left shoulder and thigh. The employee sustained a ligament tear in the thigh.
An employee was operating a flow wrapper, pushing film through it, when his hand contacted the flow wrapper blade and amputated his right index finger.

An employee was trying to put a muzzle brake in a howitzer. His finger entered a slot of the muzzle gun, which weighed 144 pounds, to align it.  When he turned the gun, his left index finger was caught in the slot, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing next to a trackhoe looking at pipe when the bucket coupler released. The trackhoe's bucket struck the employee in the back and the bucket's teeth pierced the employee's side. The employee sustained injuries to the spine, ribs, spleen, and kidney.

An employee was removing rigging to a piece of equipment that arrived by flatbed truck when the truck rolled backwards, struck the employee's left leg, and pinned it against a crane that was waiting to lift equipment. The employee suffered a broken femur, fractured tibia, and fractured patella.

An employee was manually tying a cable on an automatic cut line that was malfunctioning. When the machine unjammed, it began operating while the employee's hand was in a pinch point area. The employee suffered a laceration from the middle of the middle and ring fingers down to the wrist on his left arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading batteries onto a pallet when he tripped on a battery on the ground and landed on his left hip, breaking it.

An employee was finished performing duties on the warehouse floor. While reaching down to grab his laptop bag, he had positioned his hand on a fusion table. A nearby forklift carrying a PVC pipe was rocked; the pipe went to the back of the forks and the edge of the table. The employee was caught and sustained a revision amputation of the left pinky finger.
An employee was in the office shutting down for the day. The employee impacted the back of their head on an unknown object and was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was exiting a truck when he lost his footing while descending the cab stairs. He fell to the ground and injured his left elbow, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning needles used to inject an animal antibiotic into cattle when the needle punctured his left thumb.
An employee was walking into the break room when the employee slipped on the wet floor and sprained a knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was conducting drywall operations approximately 14 feet high on a scaffold when the employee fell to the ground, suffering a head injury.

An employee was using a forklift to relocate a concrete pre-cast form when the hook chain sling became dislodged, causing the form to fall on the employee's right foot. He suffered fractures to his third and fourth toes.

An employee was stepping off a ladder onto a roof. The ladder fell, causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the wrist, vertebrae, and heel.

An employee was cleaning cotton from around the area of a cotton gin and had accessed the box area. While cleaning, he was struck by the box as it rotated, suffering a broken left arm (radius) and dislocated left elbow. He was hospitalized.
An employee was loading, pushing, and pulling a cart with wooden doors that weighed approximately 20 pounds when he suffered an abdominal hernia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee approached a folding machine that was folding metal plates. As he was putting on his personal protective equipment, one of his gloves fell into a gap between the work table and the edge of the machine. He was reaching into the gap for his gloves when the machine started. The positioning bar then moved, catching and lacerating his right forearm.
An employee was carrying a box when she tripped over an object and fell to the floor, landing on and breaking her arm.

An employee was removing a 55-gallon barrel from one pallet to another when the pallet broke. The employee lost balance and dropped the barrel, which struck the employee. The employee suffered bruising and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a guardrail to cut the top off a form when he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground, breaking a vertebra in his neck.
On November 4, 2019, an employee was working near the lime silo when the employee's eyes were exposed to powdered lime. The employee was hospitalized.

While helping a customer, an employee heard the CO2 alarm go off and then called the fire department. The fire department came and did not find any problem, then turned off and reset the alarm. After the fire department left, the employee felt dizzy and was hospitalized for CO2 poisoning.
An employee was checking the operating software on sizer machines. While walking between two machines, the employee fell and fractured the upper left arm.

An employee was replacing a wire rope on an elevator. A pair of wire rope cutters were on the counterweight. When he started the elevator, the wire rope cutters fell on his foot, causing a fracture and laceration that required surgery.
An employee fell approximately 18 to 20 feet down to the ground while descending from a 32-foot fiberglass extension ladder, fracturing the right ankle.
An employee was moving bovine into a pen when an animal pushed her to the ground, causing her to fracture her right femur.
An employee was installing siding from a 10-foot scaffold when he fell from the scaffold to the ground below. He suffered wrist and neck fractures, as well as an ear laceration.
An employee was attempting to remove excess onion skins from an onion slicing machine when the slicer blade amputated the employee's fingertip (no bone; only nail and flesh).

An employee was using a dolly to move boxes of bottle caps to the production area when he slipped on a pool of standing water. He fell to the concrete floor and was buried under the dolly and the boxes of bottle caps. He was hospitalized with a broken right pelvis and torn ligament in his right wrist.

On 11/4/19, an employee was standing on the bottom row of parts racking approximately 1 foot above the floor to retrieve parts from the top row, which was approximately 5 feet above the floor. At approximately 12:17 p.m., the employee fell backwards from the bottom rack. Her head hit the floor, and the parts bin slid out of the rack and also struck her head. She was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was using a two-shelf ladder cart to restock spices onto floor shelves. She was positioned on the second rung and reaching over to unload spices when the ladder began to roll. She lost balance, fell to the ground, and broke two bones in her right ankle.
An employee was cleaning the entry pinch roll on the cut-to-length line when their right hand was caught in the entry pinch roll. The employee's right thumb and index finger were partially amputated.

Two employees were installing a heavy metal cabinet through an opening in the raised floor of a fire truck rear compartment. The injured employee had one hand through another opening in the rear compartment. While both employees were attempting to align the cabinet to a bolt hole, the cabinet pinched the injured employee's fingers, causing a partial amputation of the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was struck in the abdomen by a piece of metal while performing a die change. The employee suffered an abdominal laceration, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
On November 5, 2019, an employee was adjusting the return flap on a conveyor system when the employee received an electric shock.
An employee was checking out a trailer after he noticed the latch had been tampered with. When he opened the doors, he inhaled chemical fumes and became ill/nauseous.

An employee was climbing down a 10-foot ladder. It slipped out from under him and he fell, landing on a 3-inch-diameter PVC pipe that was lying on the ground. He suffered six broken ribs and a punctured lung.

On November 5, 2019, at 2:07 PM, an employee was walking between a tote container filled with empty hangers on the floor and a Z-rack. As she turned the corner, she tripped over the base of the Z-rack and her face struck the base of the Z-rack bar. She sustained a compound fracture to her left arm and a right wrist fracture, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving an order picker forward between two racks when a rack guide rail broke, causing the vehicle to stop suddenly. The employee hit the end of the next piece of the guide rail and was thrown forward. His head hit the windscreen and he fell backwards. The employee sustained a concussion and a cut on the bridge of his nose.
While operating a band saw to cut meat, an employee was struck by the blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.

While working under or around a scaffold, an employee was struck in the chest by a 3-foot long, 65-pound S-spool that fell while it was being buffered with a wire wheel by an employee up on the 10-foot scaffold deck. The employee was hospitalized with chest bruising.
An employee was standing on a ladder cleaning air vents when the employee fell from the ladder to the concrete ground, suffering a fractured skull.

An employee was attempting to free a piece of carpet that was jammed on a cut table when the table blade contacted the employee's hand, resulting in the partial amputation of the employee's right index and middle fingers. The cut table was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was helping to tear down an A-frame hoist when the employee's thumb was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was on a walkway installing mechanical equipment when he fell 3 feet to the ground on his left side, fracturing his collarbone, six ribs, and his pelvis.
An employee was walking across the front end of the store when she slipped and fell to the floor, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was walking in the middle of the store when she tripped over raised granite that was part of the floor structure and injured her hip.

An employee was cleaning the guard of a press machine with a rag when the rollers of the machine caught the corner of the rag and dragged the employee's right middle finger, resulting in a degloving injury from the distal interphalangeal joint to the tip of the finger. The employee's fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was turning to grab a saw horse when he slipped and fell on the floor, landing on and fracturing his left hip.

Two employees were moving a five-drawer cabinet on a four-wheel dolly. One of the wheels got caught on a damaged part of the floor. The cabinet tipped over and injured an employee's lower back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from the top platform of a portable stair tower. While reaching in the direction of the stairs, the employee fell approximately 5 feet to the ground below and sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was moving a drum roller in the yard when a mechanical vehicle hit the employee and broke his left leg.
An employee was rigging a 2.5-inch anchor safety shackler weighing 75 pounds when he suffered a herniated disc in his back.

An employee was delivering steel beams to a residential job site. He pulled parallel to the curb and unstrapped his load. When he pulled a beam toward himself, the far end of the beam shifted and the beam tipped towards him and the beam pinned his left middle finger against the truck bed. He pulled his hand out from underneath the beam, and the beam fell to the ground. His left middle finger was amputated at the middle of the nail bed.

An employee was changing the transfer paper roll on the back of a blanket press when her right arm became trapped under a large, heavy pin and pressed down and twisted on the conveyor belt. While waiting in the first aid area, the employee passed out, fell backward, and hit her head on the concrete floor. She was hospitalized with a right arm injury from the elbow down, right knuckle abrasions, and a head injury.

An employee was responding to an issue with a shape machine; a wheel was stuck in the upper punch retainer tooling. The wheel was under stored nitrogen energy and released from the tooling. The employee's right hand and index finger were caught between the wheel and the machine resulting in partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was cutting sheet metal on a shearing machine when the employee's left hand was caught in the point of operation, amputating two fingers.

An employee was operating a machine that punches holes into canvas material when her right hand went under the guard and the machine operated. Her right middle fingertip and ring fingernail were amputated.

An employee has helping to demobilize a crane. While the employee was putting the feet of the outriggers into storage, the crane began to pull the outriggers in. The employee's arm was caught between the crane and the outrigger. The employee sustained a broken upper right arm and muscle damage.
An employee fell to the ground while walking into work for the day. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated knee.

An employee was loading a pipeline cleaning pig into a launcher when the third finger on their left hand was pinched between the pig and the launcher. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the finger near the distal joint.

An employee was installing bottom bracing on framing to support a concrete pour. The employee used a battery operated circular saw to make a shallow cut into a wooden board. The employee sustained a cut to the left hand at the inside of the middle finger and down through the palm, which required hospitalization for tendon repair surgery.

On November 05, 2019, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was found unconscious on a reach truck after becoming caught between the reach truck and a pallet while trying to exit the vehicle. He suffered an abdominal injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was riding a horse, corralling livestock, when the horse lost its footing and fell on the employee. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee was fixing lawn equipment. He tripped on the equipment and broke his right femur.
Employee was rounding a tree stump when he slipped on the roots and the soft ground. He suffered a broken leg bone.

An employee was sitting on a forklift with his seatbelt on. The forklift he was operating was stuck in the yard, so another forklift had hooked a chain to his forklift and was attempting to pull it loose. The forklift then turned over on its side and the employee's foot was caught underneath it, fracturing the foot.

An employee was cleaning out a choke with an air hose when the hose was caught by and pulled into a moving gear. The employee's hand was also pulled into the gear, suffering a cut and an avulsion injury.
An employee was standing outside the dressing room when the employee lost footing and fell to the floor, fracturing the right hip and wrist.
On November 5, 2019, a temporary employee was placing parts in a machine when it caught his right thumb. He suffered crushing injuries and an amputation of the thumb.

An employee was reaching for a broom and dust pan that was under a work station with her leg/foot when her foot became caught in some computer wires. As she pulled her leg out from under the table, it became wound up on cables and she fell to the ground, breaking her hip.

Two agents were conducting patrols using ATVs. The injured agent struck the other agent's ATV from behind and was ejected. The injured agent sustained six broken ribs, a fractured sternum and a torn lung.
An employee was operating a drill machine when his glove was caught in the drill bit, resulting in a right pinky finger amputation.
At about 1:00 p.m. on November 6, 2019, an employee was operating a cement mixer when it amputated the employee's fingertips.
An employee was moving a scrap cart away from the machine where he was stationed when the fifth digit on his left hand was caught between the cart and the machine and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down stairs, landing on concrete and suffering a broken pelvis.
An employee was setting a cast iron tub. The tub fell on the floor, landing on the employee's right index finger. The tip of the finger was ripped off.
An employee was exiting a work vehicle on the passenger side while taking a break. His foot got caught under the dashboard causing him to fall out of the truck and break his right arm.

An employee was in the bottom of a trench directing the excavator operator by giving him hand signals when the employee's arm was pinned between the excavator bucket and the trench box. The employee suffered possible soft tissue/nerve damage.

An employee was cleaning near a roller system using a rag when the rag was caught in the rollers and pulled the employee into the roller system. The employee sustained a dislocated right shoulder, a broken right clavicle, a broken right arm, and broken ribs.

An employee was removing rust from the interior of a 60-70 gallon diesel fuel tank using a portable electric tool. The flammable vapors ignited and a flash fire occurred inside the tank. The employee suffered burns to the left hand, arm and neck.
An employee was attempting to clean a concrete pump when the pump mechanism caught his left middle and ring fingers, resulting in the partial amputation of both fingers.
An employee was repairing a damaged railing and fell 25 feet through the railing to the concrete floor below. The employee suffered multiple injuries including broken bones.
An employee missed a step while climbing down a ladder and fell approximately 3 feet onto a mat-covered dirt floor sustaining a broken right hip.

An employee was driving a forklift down an access ramp when the forklift fell off the ramp and pinned the employee against the pavement and the overhead guard of the roll cage. The employee suffered leg, hip, rib, and back injuries.

An employee was trying to light the pilot on a buster at a tank battery when a  flash-back occurred which blew him back 15-20 feet. The employee sustained second degree burns on part of his face and hands and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an edge banding machine. While cleaning out the build up of glue, wood dust, and cutting debris, his left hand contacted the rotating blades resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingers at the second knuckle and the index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was just getting ready to start work for the day. To get to the roof, the employee needed to climb up several flights of stairs and a ladder. After climbing the stairs and ladder, the employee felt dizzy. He sat down and then became unconscious. He was hospitalized with a heart attack.
An employee left a meeting at the job trailer and slipped and fell on ice while walking back to the job site. The employee hit his head and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a window from a dolly when he lost his footing and the window fell on his foot, fracturing it.
An employee was unloading a truck when the employee's left finger was caught between the tailgate and the chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell, suffering a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee and his co-worker were feeding ground wire underneath a transformer cabinet. His co-worker was pushing down on the ground cable with a metal framing system when the tension on the cable released, causing the metal framing system to drop down onto the employee's right hand. As a result, the employee sustained an amputation of the right index finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a machine when it amputated several fingers on his right hand.
An employee was using a band saw to cut pork chops when their right index finger contacted the  blade resulting in a laceration/fracture.
An employee was holding a 2-foot section of tubing on a bender machine when the die closed on the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation to the right ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a forklift and crushed his right hand between the forklift and a fiberglass mold. Four fingers on his right hand were amputated.

An employee was helping to offload a 267-pound cement load-bearing handhold from the flatbed of a truck when his left hand was caught under the handhold, injuring two fingers. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was observing a concrete precast form being moved and cleaned when the form headwall shifted and impacted his left foot, crushing it.

An employee was in the process of moving over ceiling lights in the electrical grid. The employee was daisy chaining lights to a main panel's junction box in an electrical closet when he received 277-volt electrical burns on both hands.
An employee fell from a height and was hospitalized for a broken nose, a fractured right elbow and lacerations to the forehead and knee.
An employee was pushing a stream liner cart full of files when her supervisor noticed she was having problems breathing. She was hospitalized.
An employee was transporting a patient in a vehicle. The employee struck their head, slipped, and fell on the vehicle's access ramp, suffering a broken wrist.

An employee was moving metals from a powered rotating table when his finger got pinched between the metals (approximately 25 pounds) and the edge of the wood table top. His right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was standing next to a material handler preparing to cut material being removed from the pile. A steel lattice beam fell from the pile and struck the employee fracturing the employee's left foot and right lower leg and ankle.

An employee was descending an 8-foot fixed ladder when she lost her grip on the ladder and fell approximately 3 to 5 feet to the ground, suffering a laceration and hematoma to the forehead and abrasions to the left cheek.
On November 6, 2019, at 11:50 AM, an employee was using a gas-powered chain saw to cut shrubs when the saw contacted his left foot, causing a fracture and cutting two tendons.
At 11:50 a.m. on November 6, 2019, an employee was using a gas-powered chain saw to cut shrubs. The saw cut his left foot, cutting two tendons and causing a fracture.

On November 6, 2019, an employee fell 21 feet from the roof of a utility building to the ground below when the framing supporting their body weight broke. The employee sustained a shoulder fracture, rib fractures and a punctured lung.
An employee was watching a crane lower an overhead load when the load struck and broke his right ankle.
An employee was moving suspended metal plates when they fell onto the employee's hand, causing an amputation.
An employee was using a come-a-long when the chain snapped and the come-a-long fell onto the employee's foot breaking a toe. The toe was medically amputated.
An employee sustained a fractured leg while trying to move a blast pot used in abrasive blasting.
An employee was walking to his vehicle in the parking lot when he slipped and fell on ice, fracturing his ribs.
An employee was dismantling a manual overhead bay door. His hoodie was caught in the spring when it was released and hit left arm was broken.
A transformer fell from the forks of a fork truck, striking an employee. The employee suffered respiratory complications.

On November 7, 2019, at 2:30 p.m., an employee performing aircraft servicing prior to departure slipped and fell due to glycol on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the right ankle.
An employee sustained a partial amputation of the left pinky when a door closed on his finger.

An employee was transferring bulk material from a tanker truck to a storage tank. The employee's leg was struck by the transfer hose when the hose coupling broke. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower leg and required surgery.
An employee was on a ladder stand, removing bolts. He fell to the ground and suffered broken ribs.
An employee was walking to work from her car when she slipped and fell due to icy conditions. She suffered a broken leg.
An employee was walking from their car to the facility in the morning when they slipped on ice and sustained a fractured right ankle.
An employee was stepping down from a forklift when he slipped off the running board and fell to the ground, sustaining a broken right wrist.

While operating a coin sorter an employee noticed the conveyor belt was not operating properly. While adjusting the tensioner, his left index finger was caught between the belt and gear and was amputated.
An employee was helping to check bearings on an air handler. The employee's right little finger got caught in the pulley, causing the fingertip to be amputated.
An employee hanging dry wall fell from a 6-foot ladder to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a spleen injury and rib fracture.
An employee assisting customers at the self check-in kiosks tripped over a customer's bag. The employee fell to the floor and was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

An employee was feeding 2x4s into the horizontal band saw. Saw dust was being ejected toward him so he went to clear the dust port. His right index finger contacted the blade and required surgical amputation.

A temporary employee was using his left hand to push a piece of stock into a rolling machine when his left pinky and ring fingers slid into the rollers and were crushed.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a bender/tumbler while mixing pellets and was struck by the blades resulting in lacerations to three fingers.
An employee slipped on wet stairs as she was walking down them. She fell, suffering a strained neck and lower back.

An employee was climbing down an A-frame ladder. At the third step from the bottom, he slipped and the right side of his upper body struck the corner of a metal tote stand. He suffered four broken ribs.

An employee at a customer site was attempting to free a stuck pallet. When the jack came free, the employee fell backwards sustaining a fracture to their left wrist requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On November 7, 2019, an employee was signaling a 75-ton crane from the ground. It began to rain, and a galvanized tube (12 feet long, 4 feet in diameter, weighing 500 pounds) slipped from the crane's rigging and fell. It bounced from a second-story beam and hit the employee, breaking a bone in the employee's foot and cracking three ribs.
An employee was unloading a new trackhoe from a tractor trailer. The trackhoe's tracks moved and crushed the employee's hand. The employee's left index finger was amputated.

A deck hand was attaching a shackle to a deck line and a hole in a dolphin (circular bridge protection dome) on the water when the shackle released and landed on his fingers. He sustained amputation of his left pinky fingertip and a laceration to his left ring finger.

On November 7, 2019, an employee was performing setup and changing the coil on an automatic crimper machine. As the employee was feeding the coil into a new point of terminals, the machine actuated and the anvil came down on his finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was loading a trailer when the portable ramp slipped off the back of the trailer and fell onto his left hand and amputated the middle finger.
An employee was guiding a beam to the area where prefabrication was to take place. An all-terrain forklift rolled over his left foot and ankle causing multiple fractures to the ankle.
An employee was sorting and packing polishing wheels. The employee tripped on a wheel on the floor and fell, suffering a broken left hip.

At about 1:30 p.m. on November 8, 2018, a truck driver was climbing down the ladder of his trailer after getting a sample of the corn germ that a customer had just loaded into the trailer. He slipped off the ladder and fell 10 to 12 feet onto concrete, suffering a concussion and fractures to the nose, wrist, hand, and leg.
An employee was placing a trailer axle on a jack stand when the employee's index finger was pinched between the axle and jack stand, resulting in an amputation.

Two employees were reinstalling bolts on a steel ring that held a rubber membrane in place on the bottom of a laundry press. The metal basket had been raised using the system's hydraulics so the ring could be accessed. The basket dropped onto one employee's fingers, causing fractures and lacerations.
An employee was pulling into a customer's driveway. The employee fell out of the truck to the concrete, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was conducting a survey in a parking lot. A vehicle struck the employee, who suffered a hip fracture.

An employee was folding logs of dough in half on a cart behind a ravioli former. The employee tried to remove a small piece of hanging dough, and the employee's left ring fingertip was pinched between the side of the anvil roller and the die roller. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was disposing of old coffee. When the employee poured it into a cleaning bucket, it melted through the bucket and spilled onto the employee's legs, burning the employee's thighs.

Two employees were carrying a large pot of hot fish stock, each holding one handle of the pot with both hands. One of them tripped on the leg of a shelf and fell and the stock spilled from the pot, splashing him. He suffered burns to the right arm and the right side of the lower back.

An employee was providing ground support and acting as a spotter when a steel wire that was being lifted drifted toward a boom cylinder. The employee was trying to stop it from striking a digger derrick when the employee's pinky and ring fingers were pinched between the wire wheel and the boom cylinder, resulting in partial amputations of both fingers.
An employee was cleaning a cocoa press. The machine caught the employee's left index finger and amputated it between the first and second knuckles.
An employee was cleaning equipment when his left index finger was caught in the equipment, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While lifting a metal kitchen exhaust, an employee slipped on snow/ice. The kitchen exhaust fell on the employee's arm, causing contusions.

An employee was checking the material level in the melter on a striping truck, which was parallel to a 
supply truck from which a hose was running into the melter. The hose ruptured and the employee was sprayed with molten thermoplastic. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to the face and the back of the neck, and some plastic adhered to his skin.
An employee was operating a rag tearing line. The material jammed in the line; as the employee was unjamming it, the exit rollers grabbed the employee's left hand and broke it.

An employee was clearing a jam in a rinse tank in a galvanizing-after-weaving department. The employee slipped and fell into a hot galvanizing tank next to the rinse tank. The employee suffered burns to the sole of a foot and the lower leg.
An employee fell from the second level to the first level in a mushroom house, suffering head and back injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee left a vehicle to check clearance for a turn. The vehicle moved forward and pinned the employee against a guardrail. The employee suffered multiple fractures in both legs.
An employee was transferring an air pallet from a stationary rack to a dolly. The pallet tilted, catching the employee's foot and amputating the big toe and the second toe.

Two employees were putting a down joint of pipe on the back of a fracturing pump unit for mobilization. The down joint was to be placed between the ladder and the step handle. One employee's right index finger was caught between the joint of pipe and trailer deck of the unit. The finger was injured and was surgically amputated.
An employee was cutting chicken wings in a deboning area. A saw blade amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee fell from a ladder and broke her leg. She was hospitalized.

Employees were setting 5-foot by 5-foot concrete mechanically stabilized earth (MSE) wall panels. While they were adjusting a panel, the tooth of an excavator caught the metal strap of an adjacent retaining wall, causing it to fall over and break an employee's pelvis.

An employee was manually offloading an 1,130-pound manlift from a trailer at a jobsite. The manlift rolled over the employee and then toppled over him. He suffered three broken right-side ribs, a broken left clavicle, head lacerations on the left side, a lacerated left ear, and a broken lower-back vertebra.
An employee was driving a flat, bag cart. While making a left turn, the cart struck and amputated his left index finger from the top joint to the tip.
An employee was helping a welder when he fell through a floor hole from the second floor to the first floor. He suffered a broken elbow and hip.
An employee was emptying a garbage can while standing on a ladder/stand. He fell to the ground, hit his head, and lost consciousness.
An employee was cutting meat with a saw. The saw hit the employee's left thumb, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was driving sheet piling when a sheet piling hammer fell on the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the left leg and facial fractures; the employee's left arm was medically amputated.

An employee was on a catwalk, unjamming a sheet of material at the cross-cut saw on an extrusion line. The employee's right leg was caught between a fixed roller conveyor and a saw carriage that moved back and forth on the conveyor. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the leg.
An employee was leaving a patient's home. She fell as she stepped down; her right knee struck the concrete and her femur was broken near the knee.
An employee was walking down metal stairs. The employee's ice cleats got caught on the stairs and the employee fell back against the stairs, suffering two broken vertebrae.

An employee was reaching down to pull a stuck board from an unscrambler machine. The machine gate came down and smashed the employee's upper body. He suffered a cut above the eye, as well as cuts and scrapes to the head that required stitches.
An employee was mopping a train car. The employee fell out of the train to the concrete ground, suffering five broken ribs.
Two employees got into a fight at a work station. The both went to the floor; one suffered a shoulder injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning glue rollers on a press machine. The rollers caught the employee's right hand and amputated three fingers. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was working on a stacking machine. The cart moved and struck the employee, who fell onto a stop plate and suffered a broken lower-back vertebra.
An employee was walking inside an airport terminal when his radio fell down. As he went to pick it up, he lost his balance and fell onto his right knee, fracturing it. He was hospitalized.

At about 9:30 p.m. on November 9, 2019, an employee was trying to retrieve a cheese block from the top shelf inside a walk-in cooler. She fell from a metal keg, which struck and lacerated her right shin under the knee.
An employee was stacking pallets with a forklift. After getting out of the forklift, the employee was struck by a falling pallet and suffered a pulled neck muscle.
An employee was on her way to do an inventory count at a store when she tripped over uneven concrete in the parking lot and fell, fracturing her ankle. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was cleaning box labels off a conveyor. The employee was removing a label from under the roller when the conveyor caught the employee's right arm, pulling it in. The arm was broken and the employee was hospitalized.

At 1:30 p.m. on November 10, 2019, an employee was working near a confectionery-making machine's reject conveyor. The conveyor caught and lacerated the employee's little finger, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was inside an aerial lift while placing sheeting on the underside of a bridge when the employee fell 16 to 18 feet from the lift basket, fracturing the pelvis and both wrists.

An employee was moving a ladle hoist into position to pour material into a form. The metal framework for the hoist came loose and fell 8-10 feet onto the employee, striking his hand, arms, and shoulder.
An employee was trying to release solids in a centrifuge that had packed off. His left ring finger was caught between a belt and a pulley and the fingertip was amputated.

On November 10, 2019, an employee was on a step ladder, trying to clear a piece of plastic from the head pulley on the product belt of a crusher. The employee fell from the ladder into the conveyor, suffering an amputation to the left little finger.
An employee was knocked to the ground while breaking up an altercation between two customers outside a market. His head hit the floor and he suffered head injuries.
An employee was putting trays on a conveyor. The chain came off the sprocket. While trying to get it back on, the employee suffered an amputation to the tip of the left ring finger.
An employee was operating a sash welder. The employee's chest/shoulder was caught and crushed between two heads when the welder cycled. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a trailer when he was robbed and hit on the head with a pistol. He suffered a head injury.

An employee was dumping sand from his truck. The truck tumbled over and the employee hit his head on the inside of the truck door. He suffered a laceration to the top of the head that required stitches.
An employee was erecting a scaffold when a plank board he was standing on broke. He fell 6 feet, suffering injuries to the left knee and right ankle.
An employee's left hand was caught between the deck of a trailer and a piece of equipment as the trailer bed was lowering. The little finger was amputated.
An employee was working with an irrigation machine when his finger slipped and was caught by the machine's chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a scissor lift, working on the chain drive for a roll cooler line. The employee's right hand was caught in the chain and his index finger was amputated.
A pop-up saw amputated an employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was adjusting sheet metal on a machine. The machine came down on the employee's left index finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was tightening the valve on a 120-liter HDPE tank. The nipple to the valve broke off, releasing the sulfuric acid in the tank. The acid sprayed the employee's upper chest, arms, thighs, and face. He suffered second-degree burns on the body and third-degree burns on the legs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving calves from one trailer (cattle trailer) to another (semi-trailer) when the trailer door closed on his finger, partially amputating his left index finger.
An employee was using a leaf blower to blow leaves. The employee stepped off a curb and was struck by a lawnmower. The employee suffered a broken left leg and knee injury.

An employee was helping someone roll a steel tie bar onto a cart when the tie bar fell and the employee attempted to catch it. The tie bar rolled on top of the employee's left ring and middle fingers, crushing them and resulting in a partial traumatic amputation of the left middle finger through the phalanx.

An employee was climbing down the ladder of a front end loader. He fell at the last step, landing on his right foot about 3 feet below and suffering a twisted ankle. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using a stand grinder to grind a riser and contacts off a casting. His left little finger made contact between the casting and the grinding stone, and the grinding stone caused a partial amputation to the finger.

A forklift operator was using the forklift to take pallets from receiving docks to a reserve storage location. The forklift reversed and his left little finger was pinched between the forklift and a rack, causing an amputation of the fingertip with bone loss.

Two employees were cleaning up debris in a yard. A piece of wood fell over as one of them was swinging an axe to split it; the other employee's left hand was caught between the wood and the axe, and the ring finger was amputated.
An employee fell approximately four feet to the ground while exiting a wind turbine, breaking an arm.
An employee was trying to pull out a stuck cage inside a baghouse. The cage's lid crushed the employee's left index fingertip, causing an amputation.
An employee fell off a ladder and fractured his hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing wood on a conveyor system when his glove was pinched. He jerked his hand back and his left index finger was amputated.
An employee was running a coiler. His left hand was caught between the fixed arm and the moveable arm when the machine operated; the thumb was amputated at the tip.
An employee received steam burns to the left hand/arm after reaching over a bowl that was boiling on a kettle while making pastries in a resort kitchen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a garbage truck. Part of the vehicle caught him and fractured his wrist.

An employee was replacing the rubber gasket on a dredge boat's discharge pipe. The dredge boat was moving with the waves, which pushed the dredge pipe into the pontoon of the boat. The employee was holding the end of the dredge pipe when it struck the pontoon of the boat. The employee's right index finger was caught between the end of the pipe and the pontoon, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A manufactured walkway (8 feet long, 3 feet wide, and 3 feet tall) fell over while being lifted. It caught an employee's left ring finger and amputated the tip at the nail bed.
An employee was inspecting a fiberglass saw, adjusting the height of the clamp. His left thumb was pinched between the clamp and the saw and amputated.

A correctional officer was attempting to secure an inmate who had a suspicious item. He was holding onto the inmate with his feet planted on the ground as the inmate tried to break away from him. This caused the officer to fall to the ground. He was hospitalized with dislocated kneecaps.
An employee was lowering the wheels on a tractor-trailer when the crank started to spin and struck him in the head. He suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving an 800-pound core box with a hoist. As the box was lowered, it slid off the hoist hook and struck the employee's ankle, breaking it.
An employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder. The ladder wobbled, then fell; the employee fell with it to the floor and suffered a back injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking up a ramp to a patient's home. The ramp was wet and cold, and the employee slipped and fell, suffering a broken left leg. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell in a parking lot and his head struck the ground. He suffered brain bleeding.

An employee was "charging" a furnace with more metal stock. There was a reaction when the metal stock was placed into the molten metal in the furnace, and molten metal blasted off onto the employee. He suffered burns to his hands, torso, and legs.
An employee was pinned between a forklift and the wall of a trailer, suffering a bruised chest.
An employee was troubleshooting a fan belt on a conveyor system. The belt amputated the employee's left ring, middle, and index fingers, and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a piece of cardboard behind the draw rolls on a bag machine. The rolls caught and crushed the employee's right index finger. He was hospitalized and the finger was medically amputated.
An employee was sealing bags with a heat sealer. The employee's right little finger got caught in the sealer, and the tip was amputated.
An employee was given diluted industrial degreaser and told it was a sports drink. The employee drank the liquid and was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing wiring and other components for power line installation. A de-energized line became hot and the current burned the employee's hands and legs, most severely injuring the employee's left hand.

An employee was cleaning a clogged box tipper screen that weighed 45 pounds. As the employee removed the broom handle that held the screen up, the raised screen fell and crushed the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was punched in the face by a client, suffering a sprained jaw. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading an air conditioner unit from a pickup truck when the employee dropped the unit and fell backwards on the curb. The employee experienced swelling of the spinal area and was hospitalized with a lower back contusion.
An employee was preparing to load a tanker truck. The employee slipped and fell from the top of the truck to the concrete floor and suffered a concussion, fractures and cuts/lacerations.
An employee suffered a hernia while changing bedsheets. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered an avulsion of the right thumb tip while cleaning a machine. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was standing at the rear of a big rig attaching a cable. The wind blew the door shut and caught the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to push a roof truss into a larger roller press with his right foot when his shoe laces or pant leg became caught on the truss. The truss then pulled his foot/leg into the roller press, resulting in the amputation of his right foot.

An employee was installing sprinklers for landscaping while a dump truck from another company was dumping sand close to a highline wire. The dump truck hit the energized wire, causing it to split and fall on top of the employee. He received an electrical shock and experienced trouble breathing, a sore chest, and burns from the neck down.
An employee was setting up a rail press machine. The press amputated the employee's right middle finger.
An employee broke both his arms in an endless sander.

An employee was walking and stepped on the edge of a sidewalk (next to grass) when her foot became caught on the edge. She fell forward and rolled to her right to try and catch herself but landed on her right shoulder. She suffered a right shoulder strain and contusion.

An employee was removing a stuck 100-pound fiberglass fan blade from a mold. A wedge between the blade and the mold came out, and the blade dropped down and lacerated his right ring fingertip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a lift truck when it struck a guardrail. His left foot was caught and he suffered an amputation to the heel.

An employee was walking in the yard when he was clipped/hit by a truck's mirror while the truck and trailer were backing up. The employee fell to the ground and the truck tire ran over his left leg, fracturing bones above the ankle and below the knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

A cashier was using three buckets stacked upside down as a step stool to install a flat cardboard box over the cashier's register hut's roof to keep the sun out. The buckets tipped over, causing her to fall about 2 feet to the ground. She suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
A forklift struck a Hwashin American employee as it backed up. It knocked down the employee and ran over both of the employee's legs, breaking them.

An employee was dumping a 55-gallon drum into a galvanizing trough with the assistance of a cab-operated crane. As the drum was dumping, the employee's thumb was pinched between the drum and the galvanizing trough. The employee suffered a broken left thumb that required surgery.
An employee was helping another employee box antenna equipment. The other employee left to get something and when he came back, he found the injured employee on the concrete floor with a head injury.

On November 12, 2019, an employee working at Tri-City Heat Treat was walking to retrieve tools from a parked vehicle when the employee slipped and fell onto an ice-covered walkway, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was descending a ladder when he fell from the third rung from ground level to the ground, breaking his leg.
An employee was walking from his car into the building when he slipped on the icy sidewalk and fell. His head hit the concrete, causing brain swelling that required hospitalization.

At 5:30 a.m. on November 12, 2019, an employee was unhooking and moving a dolly converter from a trailer. The employee's right index finger got caught in between the dolly converter's safety chain and the dolly itself, and the tip was amputated.

On November 12, 2019, a temporary employee was attempting to remove a stuck label from inside a label machine when her left hand became caught and fractured between the machine's paddles. The machine was operating at the time of the incident.

An employee was on the air ring of an extruder drum, trying to pull up a foam sheet that was being fed from a lower platform but had jammed against a slitter blade. The employee's left index finger contacted the stationary slitter blade, and the pad was cut off.

An employee was sitting on a maintenance sweeper scrubber, training another employee on a reach truck, when the employee was struck by a pallet that was released from the pallet return. The injured employee suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was being trained on how to operate a high-reach forklift when he hit his head on a cross brace and broke his jaw.
An employee was unwrapping a skid when her shoe became caught in the plastic wrapping. She fell to the ground, landing on and contusing her left hip.

An employee was being trained on crane operation when a bundle of steel bars pushed the employee's right hand into a cabinet, resulting in the amputation of 3/4-inch of the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was blocking product on the shelves when he had an asthma attack and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a truck loaded with trusses, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was cutting a 1-inch steel tube with a bandsaw. The blade caught the tubing, and the employee's left thumb was pulled in toward it. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was operating an overhead crane and loading I-beams into the camber machine. The camber machine bends the steel I-beam by securing the ends of the beam and applying hydraulic pressure to the center.  The employee was approximately 6 to 8 feet to the side of the machine waiting to load another beam when one of the blocks that secure the ends of the I-beam failed.  The block ejected from the camber machine and struck the employee, fracturing the lower left arm in two places.
While stepping off a deck that was 2 inches above the floor, an employee suffered a twisted right ankle and fractures to the tibia and fibula.
An employee was working on a sling for a three-part form when the safety latch unhooked and fell on the employee's head. The employee suffered a head laceration and broken jaw.

Four employees were inside a warehouse, installing a 15-foot-long steel beam for the top of a roll-up exterior door yet to be installed. The beam twisted as it was being installed into a notch and struck one of the employees in the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a bundle of tubing that slid off the forks of a forklift, suffering a fractured left hand and right leg.

A water tank driver was offloading at a job site when the employee's elbow struck a valve. The cap from the valve came off and struck the employee in the stomach, cutting the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot while conducting a pre-trip inspection. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

The injured employee and a coworker were moving a walk-behind powered pallet stacker down a slight decline from an elevated platform to a lower level to prep for moving additional equipment on the lower level. The stacker moved quicker than expected and the brake did not activate sufficiently enough to stop the stacker completely on the decline. The stacker continued to move down the ramp, causing the employee to let go of the machine handle. Once the stacker reached the flat surface it spun to the right, striking the injured employee on the right side of his right foot causing a broken right foot and a laceration.

An employee was using a knife to remove a solid gasket that was attached to the manway of an oil/gas/water separator. A vacuum on the separator was being used to draw the remaining contents out of the bottom of the tank to a vacuum truck. The vacuum pulled the employee forward, causing a traumatic head injury, an injury to a neck vertebra, several damaged/broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was connecting a trailer to a work truck. His right middle finger was caught in the ball hitch's connection point. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was dismantling a scaffold when the employee fell 40 feet from the scaffold to the ground, suffering multiple injuries.

An employee was using an arc gouger with compressed air when his fire resistant shirt caught a hot spot. The hot spot was put out but rekindled, resulting in a burn on the employee's left tricep. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a 12-foot ladder to change a light bulb. He was working from the fourth rung when he fell to the ground, suffering leg and heel fractures. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using an overhead crane to lift a metal basket used to move tubulars. As it swung off a stand, the basket hit him on the right upper thigh and knocked him to the ground. He suffered a deep cut (to the bone) and a bone bruise; he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was involved in lifting a pipe out of a double service well rig and taking apart the slip bowl assembly. The operator had attached the lift sub to bring the pipe up when the threads failed, causing the pipe to come back down and amputate four of the fingers on the employee's left hand.

An employee was observing the operation of a lint cleaner when he attempted to move the cotton and his right hand was caught between the rollers. His hand was crushed and sustained a possible fracture.

An employee was reattaching a thumb grapple to an excavator when he lost control of the hydraulic and his hand was pinned between the hydraulic and the thumb grapple. He suffered a severed tendon and broken finger, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell while walking down the stairs, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee fell while getting off a school bus, landing face up on the concrete sidewalk. The employee suffered a laceration and swelling on the back of the head, as well as brain bleeding, and was hospitalized.
An employee was talking to a forklift operator when the forklift struck the employee's right foot, causing tissue damage.
An employee was picking up material from the floor under a crane. A crane attachment fell onto him, breaking his right leg and foot.
An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot when he stepped off a curb, lost his balance, and fell to the ground, landing on and breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering supplies to the store and putting them away when the employee tripped over a tote of materials, falling to the floor and fracturing the right shoulder.

An employee was operating a palletizing machine when the employee's arm was pinned between the palletizer apron, the mesh belt of the section behind it, and a lower bracket. The employee was hospitalized with a pinched and bruised arm.
An employee was walking to do a sales call at a business when the employee slipped and fell on gravel, breaking the left femur.

An employee was using a trackhoe to move a water line in a trench using the bucket and a strap. The strap slipped and the pipe struck the employee, knocking the employee into the trench. The employee suffered two broken legs and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking near a dolly tug while it was making a U-turn when the employee was caught between the dolly tug and an air can (cargo container). The employee was hospitalized with a muscle injury to the left ankle.

An employee was attaching forks to a delivery truck. The employee was clearing snow and ice from a pin hole when the fork was pushed to slide it into place. The employee's right index finger was amputated beyond the third knuckle.

An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder wiring an LED light fixture when the employee received an electric shock and fell approximately 6 feet to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a head contusion, a hematoma to the posterior head with a small abrasion, a thoracic spine compression fracture, blistering to the right index finger, and an avulsion to the left index finger.
At about 3:00 p.m. on November 13, 2019, a roofer was climbing down a ladder when he slipped on debris and fell to the ground, suffering a compound fracture of the left ankle.
A temporary employee was bolting down steel poles. A spiral section struck him as it was being lowered, breaking three bones in his thumb.

An employee was attempting to remove the pony rod from a pump when his finger was caught in between the pony rod and the pump metal base. He received fractures to his left-hand index finger and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while descending a scaffold. He suffered a broken tibia.
Two employees were moving metal baking carts. One of them suffered an amputation to the right middle fingertip, below the nail, when it was caught between two of the carts.

An employee was conducting a demonstration of a large commercial blower used to remove leaves from sports fields and parking lots. He was using the blower on an incline and lost control of the machinery, which then struck his leg and fractured his tibia.
A maintenance employee was cleaning a piece of fiber from a roller shaft bearing when the roller turned and the protruding teeth struck the employee, causing an amputation to the right index finger.
