An employee was on a ladder repairing an overhead vacuum hose when the employee fell from the ladder and fractured the left ankle.

Employees were pouring concrete in drill shafts. An overhead power line arced, struck the concrete pump truck, and struck an employee. The employee was shocked and lost consciousness, and was hospitalized to treat right hand/fingertip burns.
A temporary employee was making a delivery when he fell off a loading dock to the ground and broke his leg, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were checking the baskets in a dual filter basket system for debris. The hot water flow had been diverted to one basket while they checked the other one; as they were about to replace that basket's lid, there was a pop and hot water rushed into it, scalding the two employees and causing second- and third-degree burns on their arms and chests. One of them was hospitalized.

While running a plastic extrusion line, an employee saw a piece of plastic that was stuck, shut off the machine, and attempted to remove the plastic. The employee was contacted by moving parts, resulting in a thumb amputation.
Two employees were phasing out a new run of cable when an arc flash occurred, causing burns to their faces that required hospitalization.

On November 13, 2019, an employee was working on a paint line and noticed a defect on an aluminum coil. He was trying to brush off the defect when the strip grabbed his right hand and pulled him into the rollers of the accumulator tower. He suffered a dislocated right elbow that required surgery and bruised ribs.

An employee was sanding the pulleys on a ski lift when the employee's hand was pinched between a pulley and the drive belt, amputating the right hand. The employee's head also struck the upper pulley, causing head lacerations and the loss of teeth.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw when the top of the employee's right hand contacted the saw blade, causing a laceration and cut tendon.
An employee was cleaning drum rollers. The rollers spun and the employee's hand was pulled in and crushed.
An Emera Maine employee was using a hammer drill to drill a hole in concrete. His mitten slid off the hammer drill and got caught in the drill bit, causing the employee's left thumb to be amputated.
An employee slipped on black ice in the parking lot and hit the pavement.
An employee was welding on an overhead unit when weld slag dropped onto his clothing, resulting in second and third degree burns to the back.

An employee was disconnecting a 2-inch coupler on a steam line to remove a clog. The coupler had been loosened an hour earlier to release pressure. The employee loosened the coupler further to perform the maintenance and was hit with steam on the right arm and back. He suffered second-degree burns.
An employee slipped/tripped and fell on a paved surface, suffering a broken right lower leg that required surgery.
An employee was using a shaper to cut a cabinet door when the board kicked back and his hand slid into the shaper blade, cutting his right index and middle fingers.
An employee was operating a band saw when his right hand contacted the saw blade, resulting in amputation of his right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack. While the jack turned by the end of an aisle, the employee's left foot got caught between the jack and the racking. He suffered a mild bone displacement.
An employee was checking a wire for scratches on a block machine wheel when the employee's right hand was caught in the wheel behind the block, resulting in a middle finger amputation.

An employee was driving to the next destination on a lab route when she lost control of the vehicle on the icy roadway and crossed the center line, colliding with an oncoming vehicle in the opposite lane. She suffered multiple broken bones in her legs, arms, feet, and pelvis.
An employee was on a ladder. A peracetic acid solution splashed on the employee's hip, causing a burn that required skin grafting.

An employee was connecting a pipe fitting when the pressure of the pump dropped and his pinky finger was caught between the fitting and pump stand, resulting in a severe fracture that required surgery.
An employee was moving waste lumber. The lumber slipped and the employee fell to the floor as he tried to move out of the way. His left wrist was broken.

An employee was about 13 feet high on a scissor lift taking a measurement. The employee fell off the back of the lift to the concrete below. The employee was hospitalized for head trauma and a broken collarbone.

A maintenance employee was performing maintenance of a dock plate by using an electric pallet jack to extend the dock plate. 

During the process, the pallet jack wheel fell in between the dock and plate. 

The pallet jack then fell over, trapping the employee between the body of the pallet jack and a rail. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was removing a piece of rubber from a transfer belt when the employee's right arm was caught in the conveyor, fracturing the right forearm.

An employee was operating a sample pack machine. The employee was helping spread out material in the sample pack bowl when the paddles advanced, trapping her right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a 10-foot ladder, installing conduit for a rough-in. The employee fell 8-10 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering a concussion, bruises, and lacerations to the top of his head on the right side; internal bleeding in his head; a broken right collarbone; and three broken ribs.

An employee was in the trailer inspection lane at a facility to have his trailer inspected for suitability to load. There was a small amount of debris inside the trailer. He climbed into the trailer, collected the debris, and put it at the rear of the trailer for disposal. He then climbed down from the trailer and stepped onto the ground. The pavement was wet and sloped toward a drain, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the ground. He attempted to catch himself with his left hand and arm, and his left wrist was fractured as a result of the fall. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was sitting on a stool when the employee fell off the stool to the floor, suffering broken bones.
On November 14, 2019, an employee tripped and fell while walking through a packaging area. He landed on the concrete floor, breaking his right hip.
An employee was operating a picker when it malfunctioned and struck a support column. The employee suffered an elbow injury that required surgery.

An employee had completed a welding job inside an industrial boiler and was removing a bladder from a water pipe, as the last step, and was outside the confined space when hot water spewed out, causing second and third degree burns to his right hand.
An employee was helping to prevent an engine block from falling when the engine block blade caught and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was kicking out a piece of pipe. As the pipe kicked out, the two jack cylinders from the turn rolls were not fully retracted, causing the pipe to knock the turn rolls over. As the employee placed his hand on the frame and was attempting to re-center the turn rolls, the frame of the turn rolls slid off the jack cylinders and pinched his left middle finger against the frame assembly and the floor plate. As a result, his left middle finger was partially amputated.

On November 14, 2019, an employee was using a nail gun to conduct roofing activities when he put the nail gun down and went to get more shingles. When he picked up the nail gun, he accidentally hit the trigger and a nail shot into his leg. He was hospitalized with a puncture wound to his leg.

An employee was monitoring the transfer of raw material via a temporary feed pipe. The pipe slipped; the employee's left little finger struck against the feed auger and was lacerated. The finger was medically amputated above the second knuckle.

An associate was cleaning and sanitizing a cutter, which housed motor-driven blades used to cut the product created by an extruder. The employee's left thumb  contacted the cutter blades, resulting in an inch-long laceration to the back inner side of the left thumb that in turn caused a partial amputation of the thumb.

An employee was greasing a tree shear attachment on an excavator with an automatic greaser when the tree shear head rotated while the employee was out of the cab and the equipment was idling. The shear head caught the employee's work vest and pulled the employee's right arm into the shear head. The employee suffered a deep laceration to the underside of the right arm up to the armpit, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was helping a customer with a package in a parking lot. The employee tripped over a bicycle and fell to the concrete, breaking her hip.

A temporary employee was adjusting trays that were not stacking properly on a candy production line. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the line's chain and sprocket and was amputated at the first joint.

An employee was carrying cases of water from ground level up a flight of stairs. When he squatted down to pick up the last three cases of water, he suffered a severe back strain with two torn discs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to her station while carrying a box when she met a work assist vehicle operator between pack stations and a rack. As the employee waited for the operator to reverse and clear her path, the operator accidentally moved toward her and hit her leg against the upright rack. She sustained a fractured shin bone.

An employee was adjusting a sensor on an air cylinder. The machine was cycling to check the correct position when it faulted, so the employee went to re-position the sensor. Before he was finished, another employee at the controls reset the machine, causing the air cylinder to fire and pinch his finger between the air cylinder and top block of the assembly. His left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell through a loose board on the deck of a flat, metal roof, landing on the concrete floor 14 feet below. The fall resulted in a fracture.
An employee was passing wood over a jointer when the tips of his fingers on his right hand became caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of three middle fingertips.
While walking down the steps of an RV, an employee slipped on the wet surface and fell, injuring his left ankle.
An employee fell in a parking lot, landing on the ground and suffered torn tendons above both knees.

An employee was trying to remove a damaged hydraulic hose on a roll-off truck. The employee was using a wrench and heat to loosen a tight connection.  When the connection loosened, residual hot hydraulic fluid in the line leaked on the employee's forehead, burning it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of tube steel attached to a steel truss. A steel piece fell onto the employee's hand, smashing the hand and fingers.
An employee was standing on the deck of a truck when a tower crane-suspended load of concrete formwork panels struck the employee. The employee sustained a lower back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was pushing a 5-inch by 8-inch piece of wood through a table saw blade. The saw blade amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee sustained a partial amputation of the left index finger while cutting a mud flap with a saw.

An employee was on a catwalk, about 10 feet high. When the employee opened a hopper door, ash flew out of the hopper and created a plume. While climbing down a permanent 10-foot ladder, the employee fell and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was taking waste out of a warehouse when her left index finger was pinched in a door. The fingertip was severed.

An employee fell 10 feet through a hole in the roof after attempting to flip a piece of wood covering the hole. The employee suffered broken ribs, a broken thumb, and facial fractures and lacerations.

An employee was standing on a ladder installing an overhead plastic water pipe when he lost his balance and fell backward to the concrete floor. He suffered seven broken ribs and one cracked neck vertebrae.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. Another forklift struck him, its forks breaking his left ankle.

An employee was using compressed air to blow down the conveyor system when the air wand was caught by the magnetic roller, pulling the employee's hand in between the magnetic roller and the conveyor belt. The employee's middle and ring fingers were fractured.
An employee was using a ratchet to apply pressure to and calibrate a torque wrench when the ratchet struck his eyeglasses and pushed them into his left eye, causing an eye injury.
An employee was reversing a standup forklift when his right foot became caught between a steel rack and the forklift, fracturing his right ankle.
On November 15, 2019, an employee was attempting to fix the water hose on a vertical band saw machine when two fingertips contacted the running saw blade and were amputated.
An employee was removing the metal cover off a radiator and cut his thumb on a sharp edge of the cover. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was performing an in-home wireless installation when the homeowner's dog bit his finger. The bite became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell on machine skates on the floor. His elbow struck the concrete floor and was broken; he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On November 15, 2019, an employee fell while swiping a security badge to open a pair of double doors. The employee's head struck a door, causing two lacerations on the back of the head and fractures to two neck vertebrae.
On November 15, 2019, an employee fell while straightening two pallets that were stacked on top of each other. The suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized.

At about 3:00 or 4:00 p.m. on November 15, 2019, an employee was doing a repair on a building while on an A-frame ladder, about 2.5 feet from the ground. He fell to the concrete floor, suffering a skull fracture, broken ribs, and a dislocated right shoulder, and was hospitalized.
A delivery driver was in a dock receiving area, making a delivery. He was adjusting a dock plate when it fell on his left foot, causing a contusion that resulted in the amputation of the big toe.
At 3:15 p.m. on November 15, 2019, an employee was pulling lumber at a green chain. The employee's left index finger was caught in a chain and sprocket. The finger was amputated.
An employee was setting up a machine for a weekend run. The metal door closed on the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was unloading a UPS truck. The employee stepped on a package on the floor and suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee was walking through an automatic door when it began to close and struck her. She then fell to the ground, hitting and fracturing her hip.
An employee fell onto a conveyor belt and was carried along until he fell over 20 feet onto a cage. He suffered crushed legs, a broken spine, punctured lungs, and spinal injuries.
An employee was unfolding the lift gate on a truck when the employee's fingertip was caught in a pinch point on the lift gate, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee had just finished dropping off a trailer at a plant. While leaving the cab, the employee fell to a curb below, landing on his back (on the left side, near the middle). He suffered two broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a bruised lung.
An elevator door closed on an employee's foot and the employee fell backward onto the floor, suffering a broken D12 vertebra.
On 11/15/2019, an employee was prepping two molds on a prep table when the employee's right index fingertip was caught between the two molds, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was reaching into a car trunk. As he was pulling an item out of the trunk, he pivoted and fell to the pavement. He broke both arms while cushioning the fall.

At 8:00 a.m. on November 15, 2019, an employee was putting a vinyl sash into a fusion welder. The employee's right little finger was caught and pinched between the vinyl sash and the clamping plate and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a mini jerk machine when his hand was smashed between the lever and the machine.
An employee fell about 18 feet into an excavation, possibly from a ladder. The employee suffered injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder about 10 to 12 feet up when his foot slipped through the rungs and he fell backwards to the ground. The ladder then fell on him. His head either struck the ground or was hit by the ladder, causing a bruise on the brain that required hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to install a new steel coil onto an uncoiler machine when the steel coil fell onto his left lower leg, causing a severe compound fracture.
An employee was working on a piece of plywood panel when it fell onto the employee, who suffered a broken right femur and a broken left foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering a scissor lift. The employee's finger was caught in the lift and the tip was amputated.

An employee was working with a metal pot that tipped over. Molten metal spilled out of the pot, contacting the employee's lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns and had surgery.

At 10:30 on November 15, 2019, an employee was standing on a 6-foot stepladder, de-racking a 50-pound radar transmitter box. As the box was releasing from the housing rack, the rack's spring force moved the box with enough momentum to knock the employee off the stepladder to the floor. He suffered a laceration and a broken arm.
An employee was pressure-washing a concrete walkway using a 10,000-psi water spin jet system. His hose got caught on the railing and the gun shot water onto his right foot, lacerating it.
An employee had just opened an autoclave when a bottle of 5% hydrochloric acid and water pressurized and splashed hot acid on her face and neck, causing second-degree burns. She was hospitalized.

An employee was getting ready to clear brush in the area and exited a tractor. As he was walking, a large tree limb hit him on the head. 
He suffered a fractured neck and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping the operator of a press brake machine. The employee's right-hand fingers were smashed in the machine and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working near a press machine when he turned and fell to the floor on his right side, fracturing his right hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped/tripped while standing up from a desk. The employee's nose struck the desk and began to bleed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding a truck when it ran over his right foot, causing an injury that required surgery.
An employee was trying to deliver mail when a dog ran out of the house and chased her. She tripped in a hole in the ground, suffering a broken right knee.
An employee was removing paper waste from a rewinder machine. A sharp object poked his hand, causing blood poisoning.
A strand of cable from prestressed concrete impaled an employee's right leg.
A nurse clinician was taking care of a patient in a room. When the patient started to argue with her, she started to have chest pain.
An employee was helping to walk a shoplifter back into a store. Once inside the store, the shoplifter pushed the employee to the floor. The employee suffered a skull fracture and brain bleeding.
An employee tripped on an anti-fatigue mat while working a checkout line. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a hip dislocation.

An employee was pulling a hose across a spiral freezer conveyor. The employee's sleeve got caught between the belt and the point where the scraper contacted the belt, causing injuries to the employee's left-hand fingers.

While taking equipment off a trailer, an employee noticed a hydraulic leak. He was under a directional boring drill, trying to stop the leak, when hydraulic fluid spilled out and the drill lowered onto his chest. He suffered a chest contusion and a lack of oxygen.

An employee was operating a press machine. Aluminum plugged the die; the press continued, pushing the aluminum. The pressure caused the metal to shoot out of the press, smashing the employee's left hand between the aluminum and a run-out table. The employee suffered an amputation to the index finger.

A temporary employee from QPS Employment Group was working with another employee to set up a hydraulic press. The press would not cycle. While the second employee was away and the first employee was cleaning up the area around the press, the press activated and amputated the employee's finger.
An employee was working in a deli. As the employee stepped around a table, an electric cord caught the employee's foot and the employee tripped, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was bent down to pick up a hard hat when a vehicle entered the work zone and hit him, breaking bones.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the concrete, suffering a broken femur/hip. The employee was hospitalized.
While working in a tunnel, two employees suffered flash burns from underground equipment.
An employee was cutting pork loin with a meat saw. The blade cut the employee's right index and middle fingers.
An employee was opening the door to a closet. As she tried to prop the door open, it shut on her right hand. Her little finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
While clocking in to work, the injured employee was attacked by another employee using a knife. The injured employee sustained multiple stab wounds.
An employee was riding as a passenger in a baggage tug at an airport. A second tug struck the employee's tug, breaking the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was in a staging area, moving a pallet using a stand-up forklift. The forklift began to tilt forward and the employee fell off it; the pallet then fell off of the forklift and the forklift came back down, landing on the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to remove a blood clot.

An employee was training another employee on a projection welder. He was adjusting a piece in the equipment when the equipment cycled, its top piece catching the employee's left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
As they were leaving a control room, two employees fell 30 feet through a floor opening immediately outside the door to the concrete below and were hospitalized.

An employee was locking up the building to leave work for the day. As he was exiting the building, he tripped on floor mats at the door that had become bunched up. He fell towards the loading dock and dock stairs. He reached out to grab the stair hand rail but broke his wrist and fell off the dock to the concrete driveway, landing on and fracturing his hip.

An employee was walking a rolling rack of apparel merchandise to the freight elevator. The rolling rack fell over and the employee fell with it. During the fall, she sustained a laceration to the lip, a cracked front tooth and a broken humerus that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was sawing a notch into a cedar board with a chainsaw. The saw bound up and, when pulled free, struck the right side of the employee's chin. He suffered a laceration all the way to the cheekbone.
An employee was getting ready to mop the floor. While carrying a bucket of hot water, the employee slipped and fell. The water burned the employee's right hand and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reattaching a chain guard on a packaging machine when the machine amputated the employee's index fingertip.

A home inspector was inspecting a roof. As he came down a ladder, it slipped from under him and he fell onto the patio 9 feet below. He suffered broken teeth, a broken left wrist, and a broken pelvis and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was applying winter poly to the outside of a greenhouse. The employee fell 12 feet to the ground level below, suffering head, neck, chest, and back injuries.
An employee was accessing a pedestrian bridge. While approaching a ladder at the end of the bridge, the employee fell 5-8 feet onto the sloped paving, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee was loading a dishwasher when they slipped on water and fractured their right ankle.
An employee was installing ridge racking within a facility. The employee fell about 4 feet from the racking and broke three ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
On November 18, 2019, a temporary employee was walking to clock-in when he stumbled over wire covers. He sustained a fractured femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was attaching a hoisting chain to an excavator bucket. The employee's finger was pinched between the chain and the load, causing an amputation.
An employee was clearing excess shrubbery using a chainsaw. He slipped on an uphill slope and the chainsaw cut his knee.
While scanning merchandise in the back room, an employee tripped over rolling bin track rails in the floor and fell, sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was driving a forklift up a ramp. One of the wheels came off the ramp causing the forklift to tip over and fall onto the employee, injuring his right foot.
An employee was walking on the road toward a car. The employee tripped over a sidewalk curb, falling to the ground and suffering a broken right forearm.
An employee was pulling a grocery dolly when she tripped and fell to the concrete floor, breaking her hip.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to his car, falling and injuring his head.

An employee was trying to remove aluminum that was stuck to an iron pin from previous work by dipping the pin in molten aluminum that was already in the mold. The pin dropped into the molten aluminum; while the employee was retrieving it using a shovel, the aluminum burned the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder, grouting a light fixture. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete and suffered a broken wrist, bleeding in the brain, and a laceration.

An employee was working on a scissor lift. The employee left the lift and stepped onto a steel beam to work on a piece of rebar. The rebar broke, causing the employee to fall with it to ground level. The employee suffered fractures to the tibia, clavicle, and the disks of the neck.

While directing the operator of a backhoe, an employee was lining up the last four tubular braces with the inner short tube of the trench box wall. His gloved left hand was caught between the two tubes and his index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was trying to release a dock lock from a semi trailer. The employee's right hand was caught between the loading dock and the trailer. The hand was crushed and the index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was removing built-up debris from the chute of a walk-behind mower. The impeller smashed/crushed the top part of his left middle finger and index finger.
An employee walking to the break room was struck by the side mast of a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

An employee was operating a load press machine, working on a metal casing, when the part did not eject. The machine was under pressure and expelled the part just as the employee was reaching to get the casing. The ejected part struck the employee's ring finger causing a contusion and laceration to the ring finger.
An employee was threading the core on a paper winder. A nip point in the winder pinched the tip of his left middle finger, removing the skin at the tip. The bone tip was medically amputated.
An employee was opening a ball valve when a mechanical failure occurred and the employee was sprayed with a chemical solution resulting in chemical burns to the hands and face.
Hot oil from a fryer that was being unclogged splashed onto an employee's hand and arm, causing second-degree burns.
Two employees were putting two pieces of tooling together. As the two pieces were hammered together, an employee's left index finger was caught between the two pieces. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell, striking his head on the side of a building and then on a concrete step landing area. He suffered serious face/head injuries.
An employee was working on a crane drum and observed an oil leak coming from the crane causing distraction. The employee's hand was caught between the stub and the drum, causing torn tendons.
At about 10:15 a.m. on November 18, 2019, an employee was cutting 2-by-4 wood material with a circular saw. The saw kicked back and the blade contacted the employee's thumb, partially amputating it.
An employee was climbing a mulberry tree. The employee fell to the ground 4-5 feet below, subsequently suffering lower back pain.
An employee fell from a dock plate when a truck pulled away, landing on the ground 4 feet below and suffering a broken ankle.
At about 11:30 a.m. on November, 18, 2019, an employee was doing guardrail work when he got entangled in a magnetic drill. Three of his fingers were amputated and he was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a flight of stairs. Two steps from the bottom, the employee fell and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a forklift and crushed his left leg between the forklift and a metal post as he approached the office. His lower leg was fractured.
While walking into the emergency department observation unit, an employee became dizzy, passed out, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a cut to the head.

An employee was holding a tag line for a rotary head that was being lifted 300 feet into the air for installation. The tag line got hung up in the shackle. When the employee disentangled it, his right hand got caught in the tag line and pulled into the shackle. His index finger was amputated above the fingernail.
An employee was working on a ridge cap near the peak of the roof when he slid off the roof landing on the ground below. He sustained fractures to the right heel, left wrist, and vertebrae.

An employee was unloading six commercial doors from a box truck inside a loading dock. The doors had shifted, and when they were unstrapped they fell on him and pinned him to the inside of the truck. He suffered facial fractures and lacerations and nose injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking the gift shop supplies when she stepped back and tripped over a rubber threshold. She fell to the floor and sustained a broken left wrist and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was working on the re-saw machine in the pallet assembly and cutting area. While adjusting the height of the blade with his right hand, his left hand was pinched between the moving infeed conveyor belt and the feed wheel. This pushed his hand into the moving saw blade. He sustained severe lacerations to his left ring and pinky fingers resulting in surgical amputation of both fingers.
An employee was working on the engine compartment of a vehicle. The employee fell 6.5 feet into the mechanics pit, suffering three broken lower-back vertebrae.

An employee was standing on top of a feed truck attempting to loosen something with a pipe wrench. The pipe wrench slipped out of the employee's hand and he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to an arm, hip, femur, and heel.
An employee was installing a cupola at the peak of a pole barn. The employee slipped on the metal roof, slid, and landed in the basket of a scissor lift, sustaining a fractured right hip.

An employee was leaving the site at the end of his shift when he noticed a piece of stationary equipment (hydraulic plant) was still running. He stepped out of his truck to shut off the equipment. He was struck by a steel shim that weighs 1.38 lbs. and that fell from a height of approximately 35 feet. He sustained a head laceration and skull fracture.

An employee was cutting flooring on a table saw. The employee's hand contacted the saw blade, resulting in a severe laceration to the pinky, ring finger, and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
Employees were exposed to dishwasher sanitizer, a corrosive chemical. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee's finger was caught between a nut and a reaction arm while using an electric torque tool resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a coin rolling machine when his fingertip was amputated in the conveyor.
An employee was working with racks of clothes. She turned and fell on her left side sustaining fractures to the left side ribs and cuts on the left arm.
An employee was operating a forklift and hit a pallet of boxes. The forklift went out of control,  changed direction, and struck another employee causing a fractured ankle.
An employee was walking along the main corridor when she tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left shoulder.

An employee was walking by the service desk and tripped on the anti-fatigue mat and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a displaced left knee and a fractured patella requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped and fell into a service pit, suffering fracture injuries.
An employee was walking into work from her car when she slipped and fell in the parking lot. She sustained a fractured tibia and fibula. The ground was slippery due to condensation.
An employee descending a 4-step set of stairs rolled and fractured his ankle.

An employee was cutting a 6-foot by 6-foot piece of horizontal structural steel frame using a powered grinding tool. Once the cut was through, the cutting wheel/disk became lodged in the steel, causing the grinding tool to kick back and lacerate the employee's left forearm above the wrist.
An employee was delivering milk to a store in the airport and collapsed. The employee was hospitalized with a heart attack.

An employee was directing a 6-inch pipe spool during a bull rigging operation. He went to move a piece of chain out of the way when the pipe spool came down onto his right forearm. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured bones in the right forearm.

Employees were moving a 35-foot utility pole using a pole truck equipped with a tension hook. When the utility pole was raised, it broke and struck the injured employee causing three broken bones in the neck and a broken left tibia.
An employee was moving a copper fixture weighing 117 pounds and sustained a hernia.

An employee was picking up pipe. He set one end on a jack. As he was about to put the other end on another jack, the pipe fell off the first jack and his left middle and ring fingers were smashed between the second jack and the pipe. He suffered amputations to both fingers.

The injured employee was spotting/escorting another employee who was driving a forklift loaded with a pallet of plywood. The plywood shifted and the injured employee moved out of the way, but tripped and fell to the ground sustaining a fractured arm.
An employee was manually clearing a jam at the duct bagging station when the pusher caused a partial amputation of their left index finger and fractured their left middle finger.
An employee was cleaning a lamination roller with a rag. The employee's right hand and the rag were caught between the two rollers, and the hand was crushed.
An employee was compacting backfill around a manhole in a trench when he was struck by a truck that rolled into the trench. He sustained a broken collarbone and broken ribs.
An employee descending a fixed ladder fell backwards and landed on the concrete ground. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the back and neck and required three staples in the head.
An employee was struck by a forklift and was hospitalized for a leg injury.

An employee was pulling on a lifting strap while offloading a toolbox from a truck's lift. The strap broke causing the employee to fall backwards 2-3 feet. The employee impacted a vehicle lift during the fall and sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was working on a structure's exterior walls. While climbing from a beam onto a scaffold, the employee fell to the concrete surface below and suffered a fracture.

Employees were setting up for a stress test using a 6"x6" wooden piece of dunnage that was 8 feet long. They were using a forklift to assist in moving the dunnage and counterweights. When the forklift lowered its forks, the weight of the dunnage shifted and it went off balance. The injured employee's right middle finger was pinched between the ground and the end of the dunnage. The employee was hospitalized and his fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was installing a vent chimney for a gas fireplace and fell from the roof to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with bilateral foot fractures.
An employee was bent over while standing on the ground installing fence components. The employee collapsed and was hospitalized for a heart attack.

Two employees were using a hoist to move a cylinder from a paint truck. Employee 1 removed the hoist cylinder pin and was lowering the cylinder to the top of the transfer case. The injured employee's right hand was then caught and crushed between the hoist cylinder and the transfer case. The injured employee sustained an amputation to the right ring finger and required stitches on the middle and pinky fingers.
An employee sustained an electrical shock from an overhead line as he was leaving a lease road.
A temporary was leaving work, walking down steps. The employee fell and suffered broken ribs.
An employee was on a roof, pulling up plywood to install on the roof. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a hip injury.
An employee was drilling holes in a metal tube. The drill bit snagged his left hand, causing a partial amputation of the index fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a machine when his foot slipped. His chin and cheekbone struck the machine and were lacerated. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a 3-foot-deep trench when the soil became loose and hit him on the right knee.
An employee was moving a garage door pan when it fell on his wrist. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to an artery in their right wrist.
An employee was on a forklift's riding platform when it struck a guard rail. The employee suffered a broken tibia and a muscle injury to the leg.

An employee was driving a golf cart. The cart and a moving tractor trailer collided and the employee suffered fractures to the sternum, the right arm, and a lower back vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a backhoe down a highway in a construction zone. An 18-wheeler semi truck struck the backhoe from behind; the employee suffered a broken nose (requiring emergency surgery) and a large laceration to the back of the head (requiring stitches).

At 6:12 a.m. on November 20, 2019, an employee was unloading merchandise, pulling cardboard boxes of recliners to the edge of a trailer. He fell out of the trailer and his back struck the metal railing of a scissor lift. He suffered four broken ribs and a lacerated spleen.
An employee was carrying empty trash bags when the bags fell out of her hand and she tripped on the bags and fell to the ground, striking her left elbow and fracturing it.

An employee was going to conduct an inspection and evaluation of an air handler unit that did not sound right. His right hand was caught by moving v-belts and pulled into a large fan pulley, resulting in partial amputations to the ring and middle fingers on the right hand.
An employee was clearing leaves and water from a roof using a leaf blower. The employee fell from the roof to the ground and sustained a back injury.

The injured employee was moving out of the way of another employee who was moving machinery. The injured employee lost their footing on shifting boards and fell from the second level to the first, sustaining injury to the back and head.
An employee's fingers were caught/crushed between a roller guide and a manual fence gate leading into the shipping/receiving area. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was riding the tractor (ride on mower) near a lake embankment when the tractor tipped over on a slope and injured his left ankle/foot area.
An employee was unchoking a cotton gin machine. The machine's saw blade caught and amputated his right hand.

An employee was preparing to load a part into the back of a van when the van rolled backwards and pinned the employee against axle assemblies. The employee sustained a broken left femur and knee ligament damage.
The tip of an employee's finger was amputated.

While entering the office, an employee tripped over a wooden block that was beneath the mail tub located in the doorway of the room. He placed his hand out to break the fall and sustained injury to the left wrist and knee.
An employee was operating an order picker. As he was lowering it, his right ring finger was caught between its head rest and the shelf rack, causing a partial amputation at the tip.
An employee was stacking columns of boxes. The boxes became unstable and began to fall. The employee attempted to get out of the way and tripped and fell to the floor, breaking their right hip.
An employee was venting steam from a manhole. The employee got tangled up with a pipe and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee stepped off a curb, lost their balance, and fell sustaining a broken hip.

An employee was trying to sit on the top level of a two-step ladder when the ladder folded up. Her finger was caught in between the steps of the ladder and she sustained an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was watching a cubing machine. The employee stuck his hand into the cubing machine and the machine amputated the tip of the employee's middle finger.

An employee was refilling a blast pot for sand blasting operations. When the lid of the blast pot was loosened, pressure was released and the blasting media was discharged into his face. The force also knocked him back, causing him to fall and strike his head on another blasting pot. The employee was hospitalized with abrasions to the face and eyes and injuries to his head.
An employee fell from a ladder.
An employee was working on the roof and fell approximately 10 feet from the roof to the ground. The employee sustained broken bones and a head injury.
An employee fell 4 feet while washing a truck. The employee suffered a shoulder injury, a cracked rib, and a concussion and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a ground rod to set poles in an area for powerline distribution. He was raising the ground rod when his right hand was caught between the rod and the handle, resulting in an amputation of his right index finger.
An employee was reaching for a hoist cable over a guardrail. The employee and the guardrail fell to the ground about 25 feet below and the employee suffered broken bones.

An employee had emptied a roll-off box. As the employee went to close the door of the roll-off box, he stopped to pick up a securement strap and the door blew open, trapping the employee between the door and the roll-off box. The employee sustained facial fractures, brain bleeding, ear lacerations, and contusions.

Employees were working to remove and change the air swivel on the down the hole hammer (DTH) machine. They were using a 60" pipe wrench weighing 60lbs. to loosen the drill steel by over-torqueing the pipe wrench and wedging it against the mast while rotating the drill steel in a counter direction. After some attempts, the DTH operator approached to help Employee 2. The drill then rotated and the pipe wrench contacted the right side of Employee 2's face, knocking him to the ground. The wrench then struck the DTH operator on the hard hat. Both employees were taken to the hospital. The DTH operator was released from the hospital after an evaluation. Employee 2 was hospitalized with multiple fractures to his jaw and cheek bone on the right side of the face.

An employee was guiding a steel structure onto anchor bolts for securement. The steel structure began to rotate and the employee grabbed the base of the structure to prevent movement. The employee's finger was pinched between the steel structure and the anchor bolts resulting in an amputation to the left middle fingertip.

On November 21, 2019, in the paint kitchen, an employee was clearing oil inside a pneumatic spray pump and their fingertip became caught between the pneumatically driven pump cup and the pump body. The employee sustained a fingertip and partial nail amputation to the second finger on the right hand.
An employee was in a drop ceiling changing air filters. He fell 8 feet to the ground and suffered a head laceration.
While walking on a sidewalk delivering mail, an employee was attacked by a dog.  The employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the right forearm.
An employee was exiting the building through a door when the door's shade caught her pant leg, causing her to fall to the ground and bust her knee.

A temporary employee was assisting another employee with moving a metal grate onto a wooden pallet in order to clean underneath the grate. While positioning the grate onto the pallet, the temporary employee's left middle finger was caught between the grate and the pallet resulting in amputation of the distal end of the left middle finger.

Maintenance employees had finished a repair on a board edger machine. When the machine was re-started an employee's arm and wrist were caught between a heavy metal guard that measures board thickness and a conveyor belt. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm and required surgery to reduce swelling.

An employee was doing preventative maintenance on a pelletizing mill. The equipment grabbed his left glove and broke his index, ring, and little fingers. The tip of his little finger was also severely damaged.
An employee stepped off a curb and sustained fractures to both feet, requiring hospitalization.

On 11/21/2019, employees were securing the crawler crane's boom and the headache ball to the barge so they could transfer the crane to another work location. When the crane operator lowered the boom, the line that held the headache ball 30 feet up in the air released and the headache ball fell. It bounced on the deck of the barge and struck the injured employee who was assisting in securing the lines to the barge. The employee's right toe was crushed and later amputated.

On November 21, 2019, an employee was mounting a center-ride double pallet jack. The pallet jack moved in reverse and the employee's leg was crushed between the pallet jack and a safety post. The employee's leg sustained internal damage that required surgery.

An employee was removing boards from a scaffold. While the employee was pulling a nail from a board with a hammer, the nail flew off and struck the employee between his nose and right eye, becoming embedded in his skin. He was hospitalized.
While turning, a bus swung and its side pinned an employee against a wall. The employee's ribs and neck were injured.

On November 21, 2019, at 7:30 AM, employees were installing underground wire and conduit. An employee who had just been fired returned to the job site and assaulted the injured employee, stabbing him in the neck with a knife. The injured employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was walking along side a pallet jack in a frozen food aisle when he was caught between the pallet jack and a metal racking system. The employee sustained a hip fracture requiring hospitalization and surgery.
A temporary employee was processing lobster bodies when their finger was caught in a conveyor. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a cement truck. The trailer rolled backwards and the employee was caught and injured between the axle and the ground.
An employee was assisting in cutting plastic off of round cotton bales when the employee was caught between a powered industrial truck and a loading skid. The employee's pelvis was crushed.
An employee was using a saw. The saw cut off the top of his right thumb.
An employee was replacing the front plate of a mechanical barrier when the barrier dropped down onto his arm. The employee's middle finger was amputated and the ring finger was partially amputated.

An employee was performing rigging operations when a headache ball (overhaul hook ball) became caught on an I-beam. When the employee freed the headache ball, it made contact with the employee's left foot. The steel toe on the employee's boot pressed down on the big toe, requiring stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was heating oil with a hot oiler on frac tanks when a fire started. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns on the face, hands, and back.

A Fastklean employee was cleaning up spilled milk at a distribution center and was struck by an electric pallet jack operated by a distribution center employee. The Fastklean employee suffered fractured hips and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was making an adjustment to the welding arm of a stationary spot welding machine when her right index finger was smashed on the up-stroke, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized with a suspected spider bite on his right lower extremity.
An employee was taking inventory in the warehouse when she lifted a bucket of bolts and sustained a back injury.

An employee was reworking a part on a lathe. The tool grabbed the part and ejected it through the closed main operating door. The door pushed the employee to the floor as it flew off, and the employee suffered injuries to the hip, back, neck, and head.

An employee was using a shear to cut thin pieces of metal. The shear activated while his right hand was at the cutting area and the tip of his right middle finger was amputated. The shear was unguarded at the time.

The injured employee was spotting for a dump truck while it backed up to dump crushed stone near an approximately 76-inch deep excavation. While signaling the dump truck, the injured employee lost his footing and fell into the open hole, landing upright, and sustaining a fractured right ankle.
An employee was slicing meat and suffered a partial amputation to the right middle finger.
An employee was struck in the head by a piece of falling scrap metal.

An employee was using a knife to remove banding around oriented strand board product that he had delivered to a construction site. The knife slipped and caused a laceration to a patellar tendon that required hospitalization and surgery.
At about 1:00 a.m. on November 22, 2019, a cheese cuber operator was trying to clear cheese particles from a photo eye. The machine cycled and amputated the operator's right middle fingertip.
On November 22, 2019, an employee fell while walking down a flight of stairs, suffering a bruised knee and neck and back injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was riding in the passenger side of a buggy. The buggy turned and the employee was ejected, landing on the airport tarmac and suffering head trauma. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was reading a meter on a residential property. A dog chased him, and he broke his leg while jumping over a ditch.
An employee was walking from a parking lot to a walkway. The employee slipped on the icy curb/walkway and fell to the ground, suffering a broken fibula and left elbow.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder set up on a slope to install a surveillance camera when the bottom of the ladder slid out and the employee fell to the ground approximately 10 feet below. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a shredder truck. The machine jammed, and as the employee tried to unjam it the employee's foot was caught in the shredder. Four of the employee's toes were later amputated.

An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift to move items in the shop. While holding a fork up and trying to slide it, the fork slipped out of his hand and his hand was caught between the fork and the carriage. The employee's hand was smashed.

Two employees were operating a metal shearing machine. It jammed and, while one of the employees was helping free the material, the shear blade came down on the tip of her left thumb. The thumb tip was amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.

An employee was in the break room when she fell, striking her head on a metal rack as she fell to the floor. She was hospitalized with a laceration over the left eye and a fractured cervical vertebra.
While working on the slitter machine, an employee was moving a piece of plastic and his left index and middle fingers contacted the slitter blades resulting in two fingertip amputations.

An employee was walking into work when she tripped on stones in the parking lot. She fell to the ground and sustained abrasions to the face and right knee as well as a fractured right shoulder which required surgery.

An employee was putting a piece of heavy equipment into a storage rack. The employee's left little finger was pinched between the equipment and the cradle, and a depositor valve severed the fingertip.
An employee was working around a labeler machine, performing housekeeping tasks when he observed a jam. When the employee attempted to clear the jam, their left middle fingertip was amputated.

The injured employee was helping a co-worker unpack a front load washer in the main drive aisle between appliances and plumbing. The injured employee went to step backwards and tripped. He fell backwards and landed flat on his back and his head struck the floor. He sustained a suspected brain bleed and concussion.

An aluminum extrusion run had just finished, and two employees were using a die separator machine to separate the molds and tools from the die. As one of the employees started the machine, a hydraulic line on it blew apart at a fitting. The line, with the fitting on the end, struck one of the employees on the right shin. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on his leg.

An employee was telling two temporary employees that they had been fired. One of the temporary employees punched him in the face, causing him to fall back onto the floor. He suffered soreness in his chest, as well as a gash in the back of his head that required staples to close. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using sand paper to manually finish a part on a lathe. The employee's glove got caught on the spinning lathe and pulled his arm into the lathe. The employee was hospitalized for an injury to his right hand and lower forearm.
An employee was lifting a bag off a belt in the bag room. The employee fell to the ground due to the weight of the bag and sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was cutting tripe on a vertical bandsaw. The sawblade caught his little finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was training a customer on the use of a skid steer with an attachment. The side window of the skid steer was frozen shut and the employee was positioned between the skid steer and the front attachment. While the customer was operating the skid steer, it lurched, and the employee fell onto the blades of the attachment sustaining broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was driving a stand-up reach truck when it struck shelving and he was caught between the reach truck and a fixed shelving unit. The employee sustained a pelvic injury and a hernia.

On November 22, 2019, an employee was walking to their next jobsite with a maintenance cart. A forklift struck the maintenance cart which then struck the employee. The employee fell to the concrete floor and sustained a broken right hip.
An employee was holding an apparatus designed to help pull a piece of equipment when his thumb was caught and crushed. The employee sustained an amputation to the nailbed of the left thumb.

An employee was filling a missing cell into a carrier, which involved opening a door while a conveyor was running. The sleeve of the employee's smock was caught in the sprocket that moved the conveyor; the employee's arm was pulled into and through the sprocket, and the employee was trapped in the machine. She was hospitalized.

An employee had unloaded the table of the surface grinder. The grinder was in the stop position as the employee used a hose and a rag to wipe the table for cleaning purposes. The employee's left hand went under the grinder's wheel. The employee sustained amputations to her left middle fingertip, and index finger.

An employee was exiting a yard truck when their foot became wedged between the frame and the catwalk of the equipment and he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a leg injury and was hospitalized.

Employees were removing a tarp from blades using a powered industrial truck. While the powered industrial truck was working on the opposite side of the blades, the forks contacted the injured employee's left middle finger, resulting in an amputation of the first digit.

On November 22, 2019, an employee was placing lids on wooden boxes filled with cheese then affixing straps to the boxes for shipping. A wooden box being fed into the conveyor struck a door that had swung open. The wooden box then kicked back towards the tipping mechanism and the employee's right thumb was caught and partially amputated between the wooden box and the rail of the tipping mechanism.
An employee was using a hammer to strike equipment numbers onto buckets. The hammer head separated from the hammer and struck the employee's left ring finger. The finger was amputated.

An employee was carrying a roll of shrink wrap. The employee tripped over a pallet and fell, the roll crushing the employee's left little finger against the floor. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was troubleshooting a bailer leg cutout separator. The employee lost balance and the employee's left hand slipped into the separator resulting in a laceration to the thumb. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was assisting in loading cargo onto a flatbed truck. The employee held a piece of 4x4 wood while a forklift driver pushed the wood in order to center some cargo. The employee's right middle finger was caught and fractured between the wood and the cargo.

An employee was rolling out a trash can to the side of the road when he fell while holding onto the handle of the trash can. His right middle finger was pinched between the handle and asphalt surface, resulting in a partial middle finger amputation.

Onboard an aircraft carrier, a rigger helper was steadying a pipe in a compartment while pipefitters adjusted the pipe in another compartment. While adjusting the pipe, the light end of the pipe shifted upwards and the rigger helper s left little and ring fingers were caught between the pipe flange and the overhead. The tip of the pinky finger was crushed and the fingernail was removed, and the ring finger sustained a 2-3  laceration. The employee was hospitalized and the pinky finger was amputated to the base of the fingernail.
An employee riding in the passenger side of a sanitation truck jumped out of the truck and their right foot was run over by the truck.
While replacing a light pole in a parking lot, an employee received an electric shock.
An employee was cutting meat on a vertical band saw when the employee slipped and the bandsaw blade cut the right index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a metal press to form metal parts. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee observing the bridge conveyor on the corrugator machine was struck by a powered industrial clamp truck. The employee sustained a broken right ankle and foot and a laceration on the right leg.
An employee was mounting a tire when his finger was caught, causing an amputation.

While working on a saltwater disposal system, an employee was checking the rotation of a pump and noticed the oil tank was bulging at the bottom. The employee ran to get away from it when a flash fire erupted. The employee sustained second degree burns to the face, lower back, and both hands.
An employee was clearing a material jam at the slitter machine and amputated a finger on the right hand.
An employee was transferring sodium hydroxide solution from a bulk liquid tank. An external valve failed and the solution sprayed onto the employee, causing a chemical burn.
An employee was trimming trees when a branch that he cut rotated back into the ladder causing him to fall off the ladder. He sustained a broken arm, a dislocated shoulder, and a fractured wrist.
An employee was on top of a stock cart removing items from shelves when she lost her balance and fell to the floor on her right side resulting in a fractured femur that required surgery.

An employee was walking with a steel pipe. The employee tripped over a portable bandsaw and fell; the sharp end of the pipe struck the employee's hand, amputating about 3/4 inch of the right little finger.
An employee sustained a right thumb amputation while operating a mechanical power press.

An employee was pushing carts into an indoor cart corral. The employee tripped on a piece of metal and fell, suffering a nose bleed, broken right shoulder, and broken right upper arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was slicing salami and suffered a partial finger amputation.
An employee was putting money and stamps in a safe when the safe door closed on their thumb and amputated the tip.

A maintenance employee was filling a container on wheels with scalding hot water for cleaning behind kitchen equipment and was struck by the scalding hot water. The employee sustained third degree burns on both feet and ankles.
An employee tripped on non-slip mats and fell, breaking her hip.

Employees had replaced old poles with new ones and then went back to the yard to take the old poles off the truck using tongs. The tongs shredded a pole and part of the pole bounced up striking an employee in the stomach. The employee was hospitalized with internal bleeding due to a lacerated liver.

A range safety officer was observing a customer at a shooting range who was shooting a handgun when a hot shell casing flew down the customer's shirt, startling her. She stepped back from the firing line, turned towards the range safety officer, squeezed the trigger, and unintentionally shot the range safety officer in the leg. The right leg of the range safety officer was amputated.

An employee was attaching a tow bar to an aircraft when he noticed it was not lined up properly. He stopped the tug and exited the tug to tend to the tow bar. The tug then lurched forward pinning the employee between the tow bar and the hatch to the front landing gear. The employee sustained a fractured left forearm and a fractured sternum.

An employee was assisting the sawyers with putting the de-bark machine back into service by placing a pin back into the center ring. The center ring of the de-bark machine caused a partial amputation of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was pulling an online grocery cart when they felt pain in the abdomen. The employee sustained a muscle strain.
An employee tripped over a rock and fell to the ground with another employee, who landed on top of him. He suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a dock plate at a loading dock. His finger was caught and lacerated between the plate and the dock. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attaching a steel cable for rigging a steel beam when the steel cable slid, pinching and amputating the thumb at the first joint.
An employee was walking through the office and fell sustaining a broken ankle.

An employee was 4 to 6 feet up a ladder, placing a lock on a closed valve during a lockout/tagout process. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering fractures to the right wrist, right pelvis, and nose, and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when the paddle of a second forklift struck his left leg, breaking it.

An employee was doing maintenance work on an air cylinder that operates a jaw bagger when their finger was pinched by the air cylinder. The employee sustained an amputation to the left distal fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was unloading a trailer when her shoelaces were caught in a conveyor wheel, causing her to trip and fall on her right knee. The knee was fractured and required surgery.
An employee troubleshooting an LED light fixture lost their balance while plugging in the light fixture and fell from a height to the floor below.
While climbing down from the roof on a 24-foot extension ladder, an employee's foot was caught, and the employee fell off the ladder. The employee sustained a broken right tibia.

An employee was connecting a nitrogen hose to a main line. The gasket inside the hose fell out. While the employee was trying to close the valve on the process side, PTBP crude sprayed the employee, causing second-degree burns to the neck and the hand.

An employee had finished his break. He then mounted a horse and was leaving the horse barn area. The horse began to buck and threw the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a separated shoulder, a left-side subdural hematoma, and a temporal fracture.

An employee was helping a mechanic diagnose a problem with an airlock. The mechanic had the airlock open to access the fan that was inside. The employee attempted to clear cocoa powder that was stuck in the port with his finger. The running airlock fan propeller then amputated his right index fingertip.

The injured employee was shrink wrapping a pallet of product when their foot was run over by an electric pallet jack operated by another employee. The injured employee sustained a crushing injury to the left foot.
An employee was painting storage tanks using an 8-foot ladder. He fell from the ladder to the concrete floor and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was working at a table saw. When he fed a board through the saw, the blade amputated multiple fingers.
An employee was pushing a truss on rollers. A chain on the motor caught the employee's glove and amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was cleaning paddles on a concrete mixer. His foot slipped into the mixer, coming into contact with the blades; three toes were amputated.
An employee was standing next to the forks of his industrial truck. Another industrial truck pushed the forks into the employee's lower leg, causing a broken ankle that required surgery.
An employee was removing an 8" cap from the air tested 8" main when the cap blew off and struck him. The employee sustained a bruised shoulder and fractures to the jaw/teeth.
An employee was moving scaffold planks during a dismantling process. The employee stepped on an unsupported plank and fell about 20 feet to the floor below, suffering a torso laceration.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move a 5,500-lbs. part. The magnet slipped, causing the part to drop onto the machine and amputate the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingertips.

An employee was cutting up a piece of equipment for removal. The employee cut a chain and then threw it over a de-energized sprocket. The counter weight yanked the chain and his fingers into the sprocket assembly, pinching the tips of his fingers. The pinky and ring fingertips on the right hand were amputated and further surgery was required on the middle finger.

An employee was bending over, adjacent to a garbage truck, to pick up a piece of cardboard. The employee was struck by the truck. He then fell onto his back and the front right tire of the truck ran over his right hand, wrist, and forearm resulting in lacerations, contusions and a degloving injury.

An employee was on a scaffold finishing drywall on an interior soffit when the employee fell off the scaffold onto a concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, a broken wrist, and a punctured lung.
An employee experienced respiratory issues due to carbon monoxide exposure while operating a grinding machine.
An employee was standing at her work station, folding towels, and passed out. The employee fell to the floor, hitting her head. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the head.

An employee in the battery room changed a battery on a walk-behind powered pallet jack. As the employee was exiting the battery room his thumb was caught and smashed between the pallet jack and a concrete bollard. The employee sustained a partial thumb amputation.
An employee was using a knife to cut onions and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was using a plasma torch to cut metal off an excavator bucket. The heat created a fire that ignited his clothes. The employee sustained second degree burns to the left side of the torso.
An employee was on a wooden step stool taking banners and streamers down from the locker room ceiling. The employee fell backwards off the step stool and was injured.
An employee was preparing a piece of material to slice on a slicer machine when the blade of the slicer amputated the index and middle fingers on the right hand.

An employee was helping the knuckle boom operator to unjam a log on the conveyor. The employee attempted to rig a chain around to the log and back to the knuckle boom, but the chain did not reach the knuckle boom. When the knuckle boom operator made a minor adjustment to the boom, the grappler attachment swayed on its swivel joint and pinned the employee's right ring finger against the conveyor's side wall. The fingertip was crushed and surgically amputated to the second knuckle.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack. The employee's left leg was pinned between the jack and a rack during a turn, and the rack cut the employee's upper thigh. The employee was hospitalized.

An operator was lowering a poly pipe into the bell hole for a poly fuse tie-in. The injured employee was in the hole receiving the pipe when the pipe shifted and crushed his hand against the poly machine. The employee's right thumb and right index finger were crushed. The thumb nail and part of the thumb were removed. The index finger was degloved and later amputated at the hospital.
On 11/25/19, an employee was walking to her car when she tripped over a parking block and fell in the company parking lot, fracturing her right kneecap and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a knife to cut the plastic banding on a pile of lumber when the knife slipped and lacerated his leg just above the knee. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

The injured employee was working on a split sizing line, placing pieces of chicken breast onto the conveyor belt. At the same time, other employees were next to her restacking a pellet of 70-pound totes. Three totes then fell off the pallet and struck the injured employee's back. The impact caused her to fall down. She suffered lower back and neck injuries.

An employee was branding a tire. A piece of rubber came away from the tire and remained on the branding iron. When the employee flung the burning piece of rubber onto the floor, it caught rags on the floor on fire and the employee suffered burns to the left lower leg.
An employee was working at her computer workstation. She tripped on a 6-inch step, hitting her knees on a grated platform. She suffered a broken right knee and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder to install electrical connections at a new residential building. The ladder slipped and the employee fell about 10 feet onto a stack of bricks. The employee suffered cracked ribs and a fractured skull.
While cleaning a centrifuge, an employee dropped a tool into the machine. The machine then grabbed the employee's glove and amputated their right index finger.

An employee went to the roof to repair a belt on a fan. The fan was turned off but was not completely done rotating at the time. The employee was trying to manually slow the fan when the moving belt pulled his hand inside the belt and rotated it through the pulley system, where it pinched off his left index fingertip.

At around 1:20 p.m. on November 26, 2019, an employee was pulling an empty cardboard box out from a combo dumper by the plastic tie binding. The binding broke, causing him to fall forward onto the concrete floor and suffer a broken right femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a ladder cart full of dairy overstock back to the walk-in cooler when their finger was caught between the cart and a door handle resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was carrying a box down the stairs on a boat. He slipped and fell down the stairs, breaking his leg.

On November 26, 2019, an employee was maneuvering a platform lift truck through a doorway. His head became caught between the truck and the door frame. He suffered damage to the mouth and jaw that required oral surgery.

An employee was working on a building's third floor, installing floor trusses. As he stepped out onto a balcony framing member, the board broke and he fell about 30 feet to the ground below. He suffered a dislocated shoulder and bruised ribs.
An employee had been using a ladder to repair a light fixture. While coming down the ladder, he fell at the last step and broke his left leg.

An employee was using a crane to lift chains when the crane's hook got tangled. The crane's cable snapped and hit the employee in the lower back, causing a bruised liver, three fractured ribs, and a lumbar fracture.

An employee was reaching to operate a lever on a hopper that had been raised by a forklift. The hopper shifted and pinched the employee's left ring finger against the forklift fork. The end of the finger was amputated.

At 3:24 p.m. on November 26, 2019, an employee was helping customers in the front end of a store when she lost her balance and fell to the floor, breaking her hip, She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was closing a terminal box's access hatch. The hatch caught, then closed suddenly, pinching his left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was adjusting a conveyor belt using a wrench. The wrench slipped and the employee's right thumb was caught and lacerated between the belt and the pulley.
An employee was tying down tarps on a truck. While moving from the truck bed to a catwalk, he slipped and fell to the ground, injuring his leg.
An employee was working in a manlift to push something when the employee slipped and fell over a railing, falling 14 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken arm and cracked ribs.
An employee sustained a right ring fingertip amputation while testing a flow mixed fan assembly.
An employee was cleaning a slide plate on a concrete funnel. The slide plate moved, striking the employee and breaking the employee's ribs.
While sitting in his truck taking a break, an employee felt chest pains. He was hospitalized with a collapsed lung believed to be the result of cranking the landing gear on the trailer.

An employee's hand slipped while cutting 2x4s with a table saw. The sleeve of the employee's jacket was caught by the blade and their hand was pulled into the blade resulting in amputation of two fingers.
An employee was walking in a parking lot. The employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
A sloth bit an employee at an amusement park. The wound became infected and she was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through the plant. He stopped and turned to talk to a co-worker when his left knee gave out and he fell to the floor. The employee's left femur was fractured.

The injured employee used a step ladder to climb on top of a mold. Another employee was on the step ladder assisting him and handing him tools as needed. The injured employee was startled and fell approximately 7 feet from the mold to the concrete floor, sustaining head and back injuries.
An employee was using steel wool to clean a high-speed patcher. It grabbed his right hand and crushed it; he was hospitalized and a finger was medically amputated.
An outrigger on a boom truck broke. The truck tilted and the boom hit an employee, who lost consciousness and suffered a head injury, back injury, and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a supply room carrying a load. The employee tripped over a pallet and fell to the floor, suffering a broken femur.
While setting up decorations, an employee fell from a chair, landing on the ground and incurring a compression fracture to the back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was drilling a hole in a wall. When the drill came through the wall, it struck his index finger and amputated the tip.
An employee was cutting aluminum sheet metal on a notcher machine. The blade amputated the tip of his left little finger.

An employee was on a platform with a removable railing (designed to allow forklifts to bring down pallets with boxes of product). As the employee put the last box on the pallet closest to the edge, he fell off the platform, landing on the concrete floor 11.5 feet below and fracturing a heel.
An employee was using a saw to cut a pipe when the saw slipped and cut his right knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a circular trim saw to cut material down to size. The saw amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was troubleshooting an air-actuated spray booth damper when he sustained an amputation to his right thumb at the first knuckle.
An employee was preparing to cut a 2-by-4 with a power saw. The saw caught the employee's glove and amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell about 6 feet from an extension ladder, landing on the ground and suffering broken ribs and a broken hip.

An employee was transferring 6x6 timber from a roll case in a planar mill when the timber slipped and pinched the employee's right ring finger between it and the roll case guard. The employee suffered a right ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was preparing food in a kitchen. Her left foot was caught under a food cart and she fell, the cart landing on her. She suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, required surgery.
An employee was running a ripsaw and doing minor maintenance. The shaving bin caught fire. When it was opened, the shavings dropped out and burned the employee's forearms. He was hospitalized.
An employee working at her desk fell and sustained a possible broken hip.
An employee slipped and fell off the dock while closing a garage door. The employee sustained a  skull fracture.

A driver pulled a truck away from the loading dock and then climbed up on the bumper to pull down the roll-up door. The driver slipped from the bumper and fell approximately 4 feet, striking his head resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was pulling two containers into a tractor trailer. The two containers rolled into one another and smashed his right thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working along a slope. The employee fell 8 to 10 feet down the sloped ledge, suffering a broken leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a snow plow blade from a pallet. The blade slipped and smashed the employee's left middle finger against the pallet. The end of the finger was amputated.

An employee was standing on a 20' extension ladder that was positioned against the roof at the rear of a single-story residential construction site.
