The employee was using the ladder to apply caulking to the fascia boards in preparation for painting. The ladder slipped and the employee held onto the edge of the roof and then fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured back.
While exiting a loader that was missing a step, an employee lost balance and got his right leg tangled in the netting resulting in a fracture of the right leg.

An employee was installing a pop-off valve on a vessel. A pipe wrench jaw broke, causing the employee to lose balance and fall. The employee's right leg was caught in the piping, and the tibia and the fibula were broken.

An employee was changing a filter roll in a filter system using a broomstick. The employee's right arm was caught between the conveyor belt and the platen. The employee sustained an 8" laceration and two broken bones to the right arm, resulting in medical amputation above the elbow.

An employee was standing/working under the front end of a motor vehicle while attempting to raise the front end of the vehicle further using a pneumatic jack, in order to perform a front end alignment. The vehicle rolled backwards and slipped off of the jack, causing the jack to rotate and strike the employee in the neck.
After delivering mail, an employee was walking back to their vehicle and was struck by a cement truck. The employee's right forearm was crushed.
An employee was changing paper rolls on a paper machine when the employee's right ring and middle fingers were caught and crushed in between two embossing rolls on the machine.

An employee was sweeping near a conveyor belt when her sweatshirt hood got snagged in a set-screw on the end of a shaft. The hood and sweatshirt wound up tightly in the shaft and caused a laceration to the employee's ear and shoulder area.
An employee suffered back pain while loading/unloading package cars. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing rubber product from a calender roll's rollers. The rollers caught the employee's arm, burning the forearm and elbow with their heat.

An employee was driving a forklift to unload a stack of 15 pallets at a dock door when he struck a pole/column. The abrupt stop caused him to strike his head on the roll-over protective structure of the forklift, resulting in head and spinal injuries that required hospitalization. A seatbelt was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was delivering a package to a residential address when a masked man approached the employee and shot him in the ankle with a gun.

At about 8:10 p.m., an employee was using a hydraulic press brake to form a steel part. As the steel part was re-struck, the material bent up into the front of the dies while the employee was holding it. The employee's left thumb was pinched between the die and steel part at the middle of the thumbnail, causing the amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was stocking merchandise on a store shelf from a ladder. He fell (no more than about 4 feet), striking his head on the floor. He suffered head trauma and was hospitalized, undergoing treatment to release pressure to his brain.
On November 27, 2019, an employee slipped and struck their left arm on a concrete retaining wall. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on a broken arm.

An employee was hoisting a bundle of pipes, and the employee's right hand was positioned on the bundle for stability. The hoist's up button was pushed, causing the employee's right middle and ring fingers to become crushed between the pipes and resulting in the amputation of both fingertips.
An employee was picking up trash in an aisle when a pallet jack and forklift collided. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.

An employee was operating the core cutter. When the employee lowered the core cutter, the blade (18") caught the core (7" long). The employee's right thumb was then pulled into the blade, partially amputating the right thumb including the nail bed.
An employee was riding on an electric pallet jack. The jack struck a golf cart, causing an injury to the employee's leg.

An employee was conducting airport ramp service operations, assisting on an offload from a cargo pit. One of the back locks on the dolly was not fully secured; the employee was securing it when the cargo pallet conveyor severed his right index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was using a hoist to lift a bundle while standing on an elevated platform. The employee fell about 8-10 feet to the ground, breaking three ribs and a bone in the back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up a molder machine. The employee ran a small piece of the wood through the machine and the wood splintered. While the employee was clearing the splintered wood, the bottom planer head crushed his left ring finger. The finger was later amputated.

An employee was on a flat, single-story roof inspecting temporary waterproofing. As the employee inspected a corner, a full sheet of plywood (spanning a section where two jack rafters had not yet been installed) shifted diagonally. The employee fell about 13 feet to the dirt below. He suffered fractured back vertebrae and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was cutting down trim kit pieces with a mitre saw. The employee was holding the board in place when the blade came down. The board kicked back and pulled his left hand into the table, amputating his index finger (at the second knuckle) and the tips of his middle and ring fingers.

On 11/28/2019, at 1:30 a.m., a temporary employee was inspecting a roller on the conveyor belt of a pattern-maker machine when his hand became wrapped in the roller. He suffered a compartment syndrome injury to the right wrist, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was walking a property, "chasing wires" to find a controller that was not working properly with the irrigation system (sprinklers). The employee was walking down stairs when he slipped on the last step, turning on his left foot. He lost balance and stumbled, but did not fall to the ground. The employee sustained a pinched nerve in the lower spine.

An employee was performing a roving fire watch duty when she went to transition through a door. While transitioning through the door, her glove became caught between the door and the door frame. The door then closed on her finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was climbing a 32-foot extension ladder. When he was approximately 6 to 8 feet up, a 30 MPH gust of wind knocked him and the ladder down to the ground. He suffered a broken heel on the right foot and a fractured L1 lumbar spine.
An employee was using a power washer to perform sanitation duties when the power washer wand sprayed and lacerated three toes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was going to search for a patient's dentures inside a dumpster. She felt dizzy while bending over to start searching. She went to stand up and hit her head on the dumpster. She suffered a concussion and required hospitalization.

An employee was working with portioning equipment to produce ground lamb when the employee's hand contacted the equipment's pneumatic guillotine blade, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
While cleaning up a room, an employee slipped and landed on her back. She sustained injury to the spinal cord and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a vehicle. The vehicle hit a bump and the employee felt tingling in their legs. The employee was hospitalized and had back surgery.

An employee was at the time clock, clocking out to go home, when she stepped back and tripped over three carrying trays and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with three broken bones in the right foot.
An employee was assisting in moving a patient in their bed when she lost balance and landed on her knee. The employee sustained a fractured right knee that required surgery.

An employee was changing the forks of a pallet jack from a double to a single. When he pressed the controller to move forward, the pallet jack moved in reverse. A metal cross-beam struck the employee's chest resulting in fractured ribs and a partially collapsed lung.

While headed towards their car, an employee fell off a dock that was approximately 2 feet high and landed on the concrete surface below. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was performing machine startup. The employee went to check the torque on the rotary valve and his fingers were caught in moving parts. The employee sustained lacerations to the left index and middle fingers, and the left ring finger was amputated to the knuckle.
An employee slipped and fell while closing a sliding gate to the facility. The employee's knee was injured and required surgery.
An employee arrived at a well location to perform chemical treatment. The employee felt a pop in the back while walking on gravel and required hospitalization for back pain.
An employee was operating a stitcher machine when her right index finger was caught in the blades. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was moving a transferring container out from an air loader to a dolly to roll the container into a warehouse. She started to lift the lock on the dolly and was trying to secure the container to the dolly when her right hand was crushed between the dolly and the container. Her ring and middle fingers were crushed, requiring surgery.
While connecting a can to the flange, an employee's finger was pinched between the can and the flange and the first digit of the left hand was amputated.
A employee had just removed a granite countertop when the countertop fell on the employee's right toes, resulting in the amputation of the two middle toes.
An employee was adjusting a patient in an electrically operated chair when his finger was caught in between the metal parts of the chair, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.

On November 29, 2019 at 1:15 p.m., an employee was working in the stairway between the 3rd and 2nd floors to de-gloss a handrail. While he was repositioning himself, he lost his balance and fell down the stairs, suffering a 1-inch laceration to the top of his head.

An employee had operated a meat grinder with a foot pedal. Afterwards, the pedal was not put away in the assigned spot at the machine. The employee then started cleaning tasks and tripped over the foot pedal, falling to the floor and fracturing his left knee. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking behind a gun counter with a long gun box when he tripped and fell, fracturing his leg.

An employee was climbing up a de-icing unit truck and fell approximately 28 feet. The employee struck the top of the de-icing unit truck, then the open driver's door, and then the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a ruptured spleen and liver and multiple fractures.

During a project to make way for a fire sprinkler system, employees were doing demolition work. While approximately 15 feet above the concrete floor, the employees worked from a 2x12x20 plank in the rafters. The injured employee was using a leaf rake to remove insulation when the employee fell approximately 15 feet to the concrete floor below, suffering a head injury.
While feeding paper into a roller, an employee's finger was caught on a bolt hole in the winder/slitter assembly band. The right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was attempting to clear material that was on fire inside a lint cleaning machine. The employee turned off the power and reached in to remove the burning material. The blade cleaning drum was still rotating and contacted the employee's hand. As a result, the employee sustained a thumb amputation and fingertip amputations to the middle and ring fingers.
While an employee was troubleshooting an overheating hydraulic unit, smoke came out of an oil residue tank. The employee was hospitalized with a respiratory illness.

An employee pulled a cart with a Christmas tree on it to a customer's vehicle. She put the Christmas tree down to be loaded and was turning to leave when her foot was caught in the tree stand. This caused her to trip and fall onto her right side on the concrete walkway. She broke her right hip.
An employee was checking receipts when a customer punched him repeatedly in the face until he fell to the ground. He suffered broken facial bones.
An employee was walking across a parking lot. The employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was attempting to restart a boiler. When the employee opened the observation window, a flash occurred, causing first and second degree burns to the employee.

An employee was pushing cotton that falls apart from the bale down on the module feeder to the gin when his left foot was caught and mashed between two rollers, causing skin to be pulled from the bottom of his foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance duties on a check valve when the valve failed, causing chemical to shoot out at the employee. The employee received second degree chemical burns to the face and neck.
An employee was operating a TUG that ran out of gas and was subsequently being pushed by another TUG/belt loader. The stairs on the TUG/belt loader struck and broke the employee's foot.
An employee was placing product on a pallet when a forklift ran over his left foot, resulting in amputations to the second and third toes.
An employee was transporting vehicles from one area to another when the employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right fibula, requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning a mirror in a nursing care resident's bathroom. A self-closing door closed on her little finger, cutting off the tip.

An employee was troubleshooting a saw and asked a coworker to shut it down. He opened a panel to check on the blade and his left hand came in contact with a moving belt and pulley. He sustained a partial amputation of the middle and index fingers (to the first joint).

An employee was removing shelving from a storage rack. The employee was positioned on the shelving when the rack became unstable as screws were removed, which caused the employee to fall approximately 6 feet to the floor below. The employee suffered a fractured left wrist.
An employee was painting on a roof landing and fell 13 feet. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.
An employee slipped and fell on ice after exiting a vehicle, requiring hospitalization for a left hip injury.
On December 2, 2019, an employee was moving tables around in the dining room when she tripped over a chair and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip and hospitalization.
An employee and a coworker were handling a cutter blade when the blade cut his thumb, resulting in a possible amputation.
An employee was conducting a fuel test under the hood of a vehicle when the vehicle caught on fire, causing burns to his nose, face, and right ear.
An employee was moving a stack of empty pallets with an electric pallet jack in a congested area when he tripped and fell. The pallet jack then rolled over his right foot, fracturing it.

An employee was observing the injection machine filling up bottles. The injection machine was moving fast, so the employee tried to make an adjustment to slow it down. The employee's finger was then caught in the pinch point area, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was delivering mail on his route when he slipped and fell on ice, tearing his quadriceps tendon.
An employee was sweeping out the grain trailer. While climbing down a ladder on the trailer, the employee lost footing and fell to the ground, fracturing both heels.

On December 2, 2019, an employee was turning the crank on the light tower to lower it to the down position when the hoist cable fell, causing the light tower to collapse onto his head and right hand. He received a laceration to the head and three broken fingers on his right hand, requiring hospitalization.
An employee received an amputation while installing a grate on the floor.
An employee was walking up to the building using the sidewalk when the employee slipped on ice. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle and leg.
An employee was welding a structural steel beam when his hoodie caught on fire, burning his left ribcage and back.
An employee was attempting to leash a dog when it bit the employee's hands, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On 12/02/2019, at approximately 7:20 p.m., an employee was delivering mail when the employee stepped off the curb and was struck by an SUV. The employee sustained injuries to the head and ribs and was hospitalized.
On 12/2, an employee slipped and fell in the parking lot following a snow storm. The employee was hospitalized the next day for broken ribs and a lung problem.

An employee was acting as a spotter for a forklift operator that was moving pallets with bags of concrete. The operator hit the brakes as the exposed employee was in front of the load. Bags of concrete fell from the pallets and struck the employee, who suffered a hip fracture.
An employee was raking top soil when another employee drove over the injured employee's foot with an excavator truck. The injured employee suffered a broken left foot and ankle.
An employee was walking on a company sidewalk when she slipped on black ice and fell, breaking her leg in two places.

An employee was working at the liver harvester position when the employee's glove was caught by the conveyor line and pulled into a fixed blade, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger at the first joint.
On December 2, 2019, an employee was unloading and pulling parts when the employee felt a pain in the stomach. The employee was hospitalized the next day with a hernia, requiring surgery.
An employee was setting up a punch press and changing a die when the press was activated via the foot pedal. The ram then came down and amputated his thumb.

An employee was processing a board through the jointer to square off the board. The employee's hand slipped off of the board and went into the blade of the jointer, amputating the fingertip of the right middle finger.
On December 2, 2019, an employee fell from a ladder while working on an overhead door. He broke his hip bone and was hospitalized.
An employee was sweeping the floor when the employee's left hand entered a running cotton lint cleaner, receiving multiple lacerations and a middle finger amputation.
An employee was delivering mail on his route when he felt chest pain. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee went to a truck to get a drill to fix a door. After retrieving the drill from the truck, the employee turned to close the truck door. His index fingertip was then caught and amputated between the truck door and the truck door frame.
An employee was shoveling snow and ice from a walkway near the warehouse and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was training another employee to operate the scrap metal recycling equipment when their finger was caught in the equipment and amputated.
An employee was lancing a line (high-pressure water cleaning) when the lance whipped out under pressure and cut the employee. The employee received a water laceration to the ribcage area.
An employee was using a commercial T-post driver to drive a post when the T-post driver hit and smashed his left ring fingertip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was inspecting product when her hand was caught in a moving conveyor belt, resulting in a partial amputation of her finger/hand.
An employee was using a band saw when his right pointer finger entered the cutting area and was amputated by the blade.

An employee was trimming flashing around a drip edge with an electric nipper while on an extendable ladder when he lost balance and fell 11 to 12 feet onto a prepped gutter on the ground. He was hospitalized with broken bones to the top of the left foot, requiring surgery.

An employee was releasing a pin from a crane's rigging when the cable tightened and caught the employee's fingers between the cable and sheave. As a result, the employee sustained an amputation to the left middle finger just below the knuckle.

An employee was retrieving empty boxes from a pallet. The employee unknowingly stepped into a loose section of banding on a bundle of boxes on the bottom of the pallet. When she went to walk away, she tripped and fell to the ground, breaking her hip.
An employee was working in the engine room of a boat. When he stood up, he struck his head.

Two employees were installing a blank line inside of a coke oven when the emissions line water seal broke, exposing the employees to the coke oven emissions. The employees experienced elevated carboxyhemoglobin from carbon monoxide overexposure and were hospitalized.
An employee was closing the safe door in a store's cash room when the door closed on the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was squatting down behind a belly dump trailer, adjusting the brakes. The inside dual tire blew up, and debris broke the employee's right arm and lacerated the employee's face.
An employee was welding overhead when molten metal slag dropped onto the employee's shirt, causing it to catch fire. The employee was hospitalized with burns to the upper right torso and arm.
An employee was preparing to use a ride-on blower. He pushed the flap inward and three of his fingers were caught in the fan, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation and two broken fingers.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation while lifting a pallet on the sales floor.
An employee was on a step stool. It moved and the employee fell 3 feet to the ground, suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was shoveling snow to get his work vehicle unstuck and collapsed from a heart attack.
An employee was replacing hydraulic oil on a lift conveyor when the lift fell on his right elbow. He was hospitalized with a broken elbow.
An employee was unloading a refrigerator with a hand truck. As he was walking out of the truck, the refrigerator fell on his leg.

An employee returned from a trip and parked his bus at the shop. He was walking down the steps of the coach when he fell, hit his head on the door of the coach, and landed on his back on the floor. He was hospitalized with a concussion and a back injury.
An employee slipped on a snow-covered walkway and struck the curb, suffering a fractured hip and requiring surgery.

On December 3, 2019, an employee was programming an overhead door remote control while on an aerial lift. The employee was reaching overhead when the employee's left index finger became caught in the drive chain of the overhead door, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
While walking between buildings, an employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell. The back of the employee's head struck the ground, suffering a concussion.

During a changeover, an employee was trying to move a stand, but the actuator would not move. He then tried to use a racket wrench on the top nut to get it to engage but was unsuccessful. The wrench was left on the nut. The employee found a missing key and turned the switch that allowed the system to engage. When the system engaged, the wrench hit his right arm, fracturing his right distal humerus.
An employee was cutting a piece of meat with a handheld knife when the knife severely lacerated his left middle finger.
An employee became ill and was hospitalized after being exposed to carbon monoxide while assembling parts.

On 12/03/2019, at 8:30 a.m., an employee was setting floor on a second floor when he fell through to the first floor, which was concrete. The employee suffered a head injury and back injury and was hospitalized.

On December 3, 2019, at 8:45 a.m., an employee was operating a drill press to drill holes in a block of material when his sweatshirt strings became wound in the spindle of the drill press, strangling him. He was found unconscious and hospitalized with short-term memory loss.
An employee was working in a field/harvesting when he was bitten/stung on his leg by an insect or spider. He was subsequently hospitalized with an infection.

An employee was trimming a 4" wide by 5' long board with a table saw in the back production area when he moved to the back side of the saw to advance the board through the saw and received an amputation of his left thumb tip.

On December 03, 2019, a maintenance employee was working in a commercial fishing boat's engine room to install a new deck. While he was using a slide grinder to grind a piece of metal, the grinder became stuck and then kicked back, lacerating his right hand. He was hospitalized.
While rigging up a trolley line, an employee fell through a missing grate on a platform and hit the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a gutter on a home and fell from an extension ladder. Upon striking the ground, the employee suffered a chin laceration and possible fracture to the left ankle.

An employee was trying to clear ice from a snowblower with a stick when the snowblower broke the employee's right middle and ring fingers and amputated the right middle fingertip. The snowblower was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to remove a box that was stuck on a 
conveyor when his finger entered a hole in the belt, pinching it against the belt guide. As a result, he suffered a partial fingertip amputation of the fourth digit on his right hand.

An employee was clerking and counting bundled steel pipes that had already been unloaded from a barge for a forklift to pick up and bring to a staging area. A 4x8 piece of wood used to stack the bundles broke between one of the tiers, causing the bundled pipes to roll off and pinch the employee between pipes. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and hip, along with some internal bleeding.
An employee was sanitizing a neck skinner machine when the machine amputated the employee's right index finger. The machine was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
While clearing wildlife out of an attic, an employee was leaning on a 32' ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his left heel and hip.
An employee pulled up to a wellsite and exited his truck. He was walking over to a control unit to restart the well when he slipped on ice, suffering a hip fracture.

An employee was pulling cardboard to the back opening of a truck. There was slush that made the back of the truck slippery. The employee slipped and fell backward 4 feet from the truck to the ground, sustaining three broken ribs, a collapsed lung, and a severe head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was servicing a small water well rig and was on the deck, which is about 4 feet from the ground. He put the rig in gear and then fell. His pants became caught in the drive line, which burned his right-side upper torso. He was hospitalized with burns and lacerations.

An employee parked a forklift, exited it, and was attempting to open a dock door when the spring broke on the door, causing it to come down. The employee lost balance and fell onto the parked forklift, suffering lacerations to the head, a wrist sprain, and a back injury. The employee was hospitalized and required staples.
After moving his car so a plow truck could plow the area, an employee stepped out of his car and slipped on ice. He fell on his elbow, sustaining an injury that required surgery.

An employee was using a lift to hold a platform for him to stand on while installing blocking on a metal building. He fell to the ground and the platform fell on top of him. He suffered multiple broken ribs, a broken back, a cracked sternum, and a head laceration.

On December 4, 2019, an employee was trying to position an I-beam that was being supported by a forklift when the employee's right thumb was pinched between the forklift fork and the I-beam, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was working on the roof of a residential building when he fell to the ground, fracturing his left leg and left elbow.
An employee was working on a commercial dryer. A pulley on the dryer started to rotate as the employee was holding it, causing a puncture on the employee's left hand.
An employee slipped and fell on acorns in a landscaped area of the parking lot. She suffered displaced tibia and fibula fractures to the right leg/ankle.

An employee and a coworker were spooling up a steel cable on a winch line when the employee's hand was caught between the sheave and the cable, resulting in the surgical amputation of the right index finger and surgical repair of the third digit.
An employee was dismounting from an excavator when his right foot slipped off the track. He fell to the ground, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was driving a scissor lift that was elevated 8 to 10 feet on uneven ground when the scissor lift tipped over and crushed the left side of the employee. The employee suffered a broken left arm and leg.
An employee was working on a machine's wet end when the employee's right hand and arm were pinched between a steel bar and the machine's bull wheel.

An employee was putting a wheel loader cylinder in place on a piece of construction equipment when the cylinder started to roll and crushed his right index and middle fingers resulting in fingertip amputations.

During construction of a log cabin kit, an employee was getting ready to put in a snap line on the second floor. He slipped and fell onto the ground, suffering a broken right hip. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was unchoking a gin when the employee's hand was caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.

Two employees were troubleshooting the starter on a forklift in the maintenance area. While both employees were on opposite ends of the forklift, the second employee pulled the connection tube on the forklift tank. A flash fire occurred. The first employee suffered second degree burns to the face. The second employee suffered second degree burns to the hand/finger and a first degree burn to the forearm. Both were hospitalized.
On December 4, 2019, an employee slipped and fell on an icy aluminum staircase while exiting a job trailer. The employee's left quadriceps was torn.
An employee was cutting papers with a manual paper cutter when the cutter blade cut off the tip of her left thumb.
At about 6:00 p.m., an employee was leaving his truck when he slipped and fell, his left side and back striking the truck's bumper. He suffered muscle and tendon injuries and lower back pain.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a flight of stairs, breaking his hip.
An employee was walking down steps after delivering a package at a residence when she tripped and fell to the ground, fracturing her left foot.
An employee was walking to a van in a parking lot. The employee slipped on black ice and fell to the asphalt, suffering a broken right pelvis, arm, and shoulder.
An employee was struck by a UTV while walking along a road on site, dislocating the employee's left ankle and fracturing the left fibula.

An employee was pulling a wheeled cart into a temporary storage area when the cart rolled into a building support. His gloved hand was caught between the support and cart, resulting in a right pinky finger amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was monitoring a 2-inch hose that was being thawed out using steam and was about to uncouple it to drain the line. When he unlatched the cam locks, built-up steam in the line released and burned the employee's face.
An employee slipped and fell on a wooden ramp while exiting the external freezer. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the right ankle or right leg, requiring surgery.

An employee had taken a 32-foot extension ladder apart and was using it to put up a safety platform when the employee fell with the ladder 14 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg and facial contusion.
An employee was conducting surveillance to make an arrest when his firearm discharged into his thigh.

An employee was doing light demolition work on junction boxes and conduit using a power saw. The saw came into contact with the concrete ceiling, causing him to fall/jump from the ladder to the ground. His left tibia was broken.

An employee was replacing a spindle using a hoist when the spindle slipped approximately 3 to 4 inches, pinching the employee's fingertip between the spindle and a fixed object (separator base). As a result, the employee's fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking while walking to a vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a head contusion and possible concussion.
An employee operating a pallet jack was struck by a forklift backing out of a trailer. The employee's right leg was broken.
An employee slipped while getting off a ladder and fell on the concrete, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee was attempting to clean rotating rollers with a rag when the employee's right hand and three fingers (index, middle, and ring) were crushed between the two turning rollers, resulting in the amputation of the index and middle fingers.

An employee was helping to unload rolls of rubber (500 pounds each). The rolls are placed on racks and are secured with straps during delivery until it is time to unload. During the unloading, the pole attachment of a forklift could not reach high enough to get the roll. The employee was moving the rolls on the rack so they could be reached with the pole attachment when a roll fell on top of the employee's left leg, causing a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was walking to a dining area when she slipped on a freshly mopped floor, injuring her left leg.
When a conveyor was activated, an employee's right hand was caught between the indexing mechanism and the conveyor. Three of the employee's fingers were amputated.
An employee was putting up Christmas decorations in an office. The employee was on a table when it tipped and the employee fell, striking a vent as she hit the ground. She suffered six broken ribs.
An employee was checking cargo for marks on the warehouse floor when a forklift struck the employee on the right leg and thigh. The employee sustained a thigh contusion.

At 10:45 a.m. on December 4, 2019, an employee was hanging a piece of material. While the employee was trying to secure the material with wire to prevent it from swinging, the material shifted, pinching the tip of the employee's left middle finger between two pieces of steel. The employee suffered a laceration and amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was attacked by a police dog while trying to tag it. The dog attacked her face and left arm, causing the loss of a third of the muscle mass in her arm, the loss of her lower right eyelid, and cuts all the way through her bottom lip.
A forklift ran over an employee's left foot, breaking it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a rollout table. A piece of tube got hung up on the table, then sprung free and struck the employee's face. The employee suffered a fractured jaw, a laceration, and broken teeth.
An employee was using a metal tape measurer when it contacted live electrical wires, resulting in electrical burns to the employee's hands and both sides of the body.

An employee was at the back of a forklift changing out a propane tank when another forklift driver backed into the employee. The employee was pinned between the two forklifts and suffered a fractured pelvis.
An employee was trimming a piece of wood on a table saw. The piece kicked back and struck the employee in the chest, causing a laceration that required stitches. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing down a ladder to access a work area when he tripped and fell, landing on a hot boiler casing. He suffered a burn to the left palm (requiring a graft) and minor burns to the right hand.
While dusting walls and ceilings, an employee fell down a flight of stairs. The employee suffered broken vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a line with a take-up reel leaning against mule tape. The mule tape had a small tracer wire in it. The employee came in close proximity to the electrical line and an arc occurred, shocking the employee's left hand.
An employee was welding when a spark landed on his shirt under his uniform and ignited both layers of clothing. He received first, second, and third degree burns to the upper torso, neck, and face.

An employee was valeting and checked in a customer's vehicle that had been modified to accommodate the customer's physical disability. The employee went to move the vehicle from drive when it accelerated unexpectedly. Due to the modifications on the vehicle, the employee was unable to locate the brake pedal. In an attempt to avoid two vehicles and an ambulance parked on the drive, the employee swerved  but was unable to avoid the vehicles. The employee struck several vehicles before hitting a wooden/aluminum shelter and a concrete wall and finally coming to a stop. The employee sustained a knee injury and was hospitalized for surgery.

On 12/05/2019, at 2:13 p.m., an employee was lighting a propane burner when the propane splashed back onto him. He suffered second degree flash burns on the right side of his arm down to his fingertips, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing metal decking on an existing building when the employee tripped over another employee's lanyard and fell off the roof. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right leg, left wrist and ankle, and pelvis. The employee's harness was not tied off at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered a hand injury and lost consciousness, falling to the floor and injuring their jaw and tongue.
An employee was walking on the sidewalk outside when the employee tripped on a branch sticking out of the ground and fell, suffering a left knee injury.
An employee was walking in a store's meat department when she tripped on a loose tile and fell into a pole. She suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.
On December 5, 2019, an employee was observing as another employee unloaded a pallet of juice from a truck with a pallet jack. The pallet fell on his left leg, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down cement steps when the employee tripped and fell, hitting the stairs. The employee suffered a broken tibia and rib.
An employee was trilling a plexiglass test fixer when the drill press caught his glove. The press amputated his ring and little fingers.
An employee was struck by a light pole that was being transported by a mini excavator traveling backwards and a back hoe pushing it from the front. The employee was hospitalized with leg injuries.
An employee was removing a blind in a depressurized line at a refinery when a flash came out of the flange and burned his ear and wrists between his gloves and FRC sleeves.

An employee was trying to release the lock on an auto lift to lower a vehicle. The auto lift's locking mechanism caught two fingers on the employee's left hand. The middle finger was medically amputated above the knuckle. The ring finger was crushed but surgically repaired.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while crossing a road. The employee suffered head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing and cleaning a conveyor belt when the roller caught his arm.
An employee was working on a frac tree. The tree fell, catching the employee on the leg and breaking it.

On 12/5/2019, at 6:10 AM, an employee was working on a palletizing line and was attempting to untangle the drive bands on the rolling conveyor. His right middle fingertip was caught in the bands and subsequently amputated.

An employee was making a jig to accommodate tube bending. The employee was holding stock near the chuck of the tube bending CNC machine while waiting for another employee to find an extension to hold the stock in the chuck, prior to actuating the clamp via a control panel. The clamp actuated, catching the employee's finger and degloving the fingertip which resulted in a medical amputation.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder when the latch slipped, causing the ladder and the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both legs.

An employee was trying to fit up a pin with a channel on a component that was being assembled. Another employee slid the component back and caught the employee's finger between the hole and component, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking down a hall to the break area when he tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was entering a building when he fell to the floor and broke his left leg.

At about 9:00 a.m. on December 5, 2019, an employee was climbing an oak tree. The employee was moving to a new position on the tree when he fell, landing on the ground about 20-25 feet below and suffering a broken lower leg. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was taping a finished roll of rubber when her left hand was caught between the roll of rubber and the wind-up roller wheel. She received a crushing injury to her left hand, requiring surgery to relieve the pressure.

An employee was disconnecting his cart from an order picker (PIT) when another PIT struck the employee's cart from behind. He was caught between the cart and his PIT, resulting in the amputation of his right foot.
An employee was trying to clear a jam inside a machine when his right middle finger became caught, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working from a ladder, installing gas lines at a home under construction. A gust of wind blew a door open, knocking him off the ladder. He suffered a laceration above his right eye and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a 6-foot A-frame ladder using a screw gun to install lights in the ceiling grid when the employee fell backwards to the floor, suffering fractured vertebrae and a head injury.

An employee was picking up twigs from the ground while another employee was in a tree cutting it down. A section of the tree dropped onto the head of the employee on the ground, who suffered a broken skull.

An employee was running an extrusion line in the manufacturing of a hydraulic hose. In the process of finishing a run, the employee attempted to separate the hose from a reel that was attached with string. The employee's left index finger was inadvertently tangled in the string, which tightened around the employee's fingertip. As a result, the skin and nail was removed from the fingertip.
An employee was inspecting a property and walking across its parking lot when she slipped on a layer of snow and ice and fell to the ground, breaking her right tibia and fibula.
An employee was troubleshooting and testing the air blast in a folding machine when the employee's left hand was caught by the rollers, causing a contusion and laceration to the hand.

An employee was loading materials into a skid steer bucket when he went to grab falling materials and his finger was pinched by the skid steer's grapple, resulting in a right pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping to clear a jam on a punch press when the die caused amputations on two of the employee's fingers.
An employee's hand/arm was entangled in a conveyor belt. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a new garage door opener. He was working from an extension ladder, which was leaning against the garage door; the door unexpectedly opened and he fell about 14 feet to the ground and landed on his buttocks. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when he struck a column, crushing and lacerating his foot.
An employee was chasing individuals on foot when the employee fell 10 feet onto gravel ground, suffering a broken jaw and nose.

Two employees were unclogging a drain at a building's wastewater system. One employee was using a hose plugged into a pressure washer; the hose burst and high-pressure water lacerated the other employee's index finger.
An employee was moving packages from a conveyor to a baker's rack. The items fell and the employee slipped on the packages, breaking a femur. She was hospitalized.

An employee was working in a trim picking aisle at a steel plant. She was performing a cycle count for a stand-up bin of ridge caps. As she counted the pieces she was leaning the ridge caps against her shoulder. Eventually, the weight of the stack of ridge caps pushed her back and she fell to the floor with the stack on top of her. She suffered an abdominal injury and was hospitalized.

An employee had been cutting lumber when he bent down and used the saw table as a brace. His hand then came into contact with the saw blade, which was still de-energizing, resulting in the amputation of half of his ring finger.

An employee was operating a horizontal lathe when he attempted to change the tooling on the tail stock. The moving chuck caught his tooling, causing the tooling to rotate and strike his left hand. He broke his left hand and received several lacerations on his two middle fingers that required stitches.
A nurse had just completed a home visit and was walking through a parking lot to her car. She slipped on a patch of ice and fell onto her right side, suffering a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was lifting a heavy box from inside a trailer when it caused her left shoulder to pop out of place. She was hospitalized.

After performing a mill changeover, an employee was adjusting the rollers. The employee's left hand was caught between the rollers and the pipe running through the mill, and the left little fingertip was amputated. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was wrapping yarn around a beam on a rebeamer machine when her hand was pulled forward, causing her to jump back reflexively. In the process, her right ring finger was partially amputated.
A Tradesmen International employee was helping paint an electrical tower. An arc flash injured the employee, who was hospitalized.
An employee was identifying wires using a jumper wire when an arc flash occurred between the jumper wire and hot wire. The employee was hospitalized with burns on the right forearm and left hand.

An employee was attempting to repair a vibration pad. While working on the pad, the employee was sitting on the battery box. When the employee connected two wires, the vibration pad raised up and pinched the employee's ankle, breaking it.

An employee went to the wastewater area to get additional sulfuric acid for the anodizing process. While walking back to the anodizing area with a bucket of sulfuric acid, she tripped and fell. The sulfuric acid splashed on her, causing chemical burns to the wrist, neck, and legs.

An employee was using a vacuum lift to move an air conditioning unit onto a pallet. The unit's metal edge cut the employee's right little finger, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip to the end of the nail.

At about 2:55 p.m. on December 6, 2019, an employee was moving a steel trim staging table. The employee's left thumb tip was pinched between the table and another, stationary table. It was lacerated and subsequently amputated.
An employee was driving a company service truck on a rail terminal when he crashed into a parked intermodal chassis with a container attached to it. The employee's legs were crushed.
An employee was standing on a rolling 10-foot aluminum ladder, removing a sign. He fell from the fourth rung to the concrete floor and broke his hip.

On December 6, 2019, a truck had been backed into a parking space close to a cinderblock wall, next to a loading dock. One of its loading doors was open. An employee was standing next to the truck, waiting for the driver to pull out to give the door enough clearance from the cinderblock wall to be closed. The door began to swing back toward the cinderblock wall as the driver began to pull out. As the employee tried to keep the door from striking the wall, the employee's upper right forearm got caught between the door and the wall. The employee suffered a laceration of the right upper arm.
An employee was sprayed with hydrofluoric acid and suffered chemical burns.
An employee was drying a conveyor and loading plastic into a feed wrap. The feed roller caused a laceration on her right arm that required stitches.
On December 6, 2019, an employee was reaching for a tool between a stack of guardrails when the stack of guardrails fell on the employee's finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was helping to lift tin panels off a flatbed truck. A spreader bar fell off the tines of a forklift and struck the employee, who fell backward onto the trailer. He suffered a broken left ankle, a contusion to the back/neck, and a laceration to the head.
A police officer responded to an active shooter situation. He entered the building with three other base policemen and was shot in the leg by the suspect. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on the deck of a flatbed truck trailer. He fell to the ground, suffering a dislocated elbow, a broken arm, and broken ribs.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access an overhead crane to perform work. The crane was still energized. When the employee touched the crane, it shocked him, causing him to fall to the ground below. He suffered a fractured back and collapsed lung.
An employee was pulling down the roll door on the back of a trailer after making a delivery when he suffered an abdominal hernia.
An employee was standing on her desk attempting to adjust an air vent when she lost her balance and fell to the ground, fracturing her left hip and left wrist.

An employee was pushing a gangway to a railcar. The gangway was extended. The extension piece fell down and struck the employee's hand, injuring it. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

At 10:00 p.m. on December 6, 2019, an employee was operating a powered industrial truck when his foot was caught between the truck and a metal rack. He suffered a contusion, followed by muscle injury. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

On December 6, 2019, a crane was landing a bundle of steel decking on the ground when it struck a 52" steel beam that was on cribbing. The beam fell onto an employee's foot, causing a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was banding down material on a pallet when a forklift, parked behind him, rolled into his heel. He suffered severed tendons and a broken foot.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while delivering propane to a customer's home. The employee suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

An employee was torqueing a bolt with an impact gun. The employee's finger was caught between the bolt and socket when the impact gun trigger was engaged, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was cleaning up logs that were laying on the lawn after a storm. The employee used a crowbar to lever a log as a second employee used a chainsaw to cut the log into smaller pieces. The crowbar lever was dropped, and the log rolled onto the first employee's ankle and fractured it.
An employee was repairing a light fixture from the third step of a 6-foot ladder. He fell and suffered a back injury.
A Sunshine Staffing temporary employee lifted products at a job site from 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. He became sore, stopped working, and was then hospitalized, due to a muscle injury.
An employee was working on a pig launching platform. A flash fire caused second-degree burns to the employee's hands.

An employee was attempting to manually wipe excess lubricant off of elevator cables when the car moved, putting the injured employee's arm in the pinch point between the ropes and the sheaves. The employee was hospitalized with a severe fracture and laceration to the left arm.

An employee was moving feed in the feed building. It was cold and rainy, so the employee went over to a propane heater mounted on a 30 lb. tank inside the feed building to warm up. The employee was standing near the heater when his jacket caught on fire, causing third degree burns on his back that required hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder, helping remove a window from a wall. The window started falling; he moved out the way, but was caught between the window and a forklift. He suffered broken ribs and lacerations.
An employee was approaching the entrance end of a car wash when she slipped and fell on the wet surface (diamond plate), fracturing her left ankle and tibia. She was hospitalized.
An employee was in a warehouse. The employee walked between two tall pallets holding product, turned and tripped on a pallet, fell, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee had a cardiac event which resulted in them falling over and striking their head on the floor.
An employee was taking out trash. A vehicle struck him while he was in a crosswalk, and he suffered a concussion and bruises.
An employee was walking on an aircraft flight line when a vehicle on the flight line made an abrupt U-turn and impacted the employee. He was hospitalized with injuries to his hip and pelvis.
An employee was draining natural gas condensate from a level transmitter. When a valve was opened, the escaping gas ignited. The employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the face and neck.

An employee was pulling a spud pin out of a barge's rear spud. Before he could get the spud all the way out, the spud was lowered, causing the pin to jump up and strike him on the left side of the face. He was hospitalized with a fractured orbital bone and mandible, requiring surgery.
An employee was exiting a vehicle when the employee slipped on the running board and fell onto the car parked next to the driver's side. The employee was hospitalized with head and neck injuries.
An employee was unfolding a glue conveyor into its flat position. The conveyor flipped on its own, pinching the employee's right ring finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was removing electrical cables from an A-frame when an arc blast occurred, injuring one employee.

An employee was helping another machine operator at a finishing press. The employee was checking the die with her hand in the press when the press engaged. The die then caused partial amputations of the employee's right index and middle fingers.
An employee fell from a makeshift 18-inch-high stairway leading up to a 36-inch foundation. The employee landed on the ground and broke his right tibia.
An employee tripped on a 4-by-4 pallet support board and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a possible leg fracture.
An employee was attaching a trailer tongue to a truck hitch when his left index finger was caught between the trailer tongue and truck hitch, amputating it at the nailbed.
An employee was operating an all terrain vehicle to intercept a drug smuggler when the employee struck barbed wire, suffering a throat laceration.

An employee was attempting to engage dolly locks when her right leg entered the pathway of the moving dollies. Her right leg was then pulled in between a dolly and a commander platform as the dollies were moving forward. She was hospitalized with bruising to the right leg.
While working at a cash register, and employee became lightheaded and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a possible vertebral fracture.

An employee was attempting to place a bale in a cotton bale press when his right hand was caught in the press, resulting in amputations of the right middle, ring, and pinky fingers. The press was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was power washing the shop when he was struck by a reversing forklift that ran over and broke his right leg.
An employee was making a routine adjustment on the slicing line of a repack machine when the machine's cross-cutting knife amputated the employee's middle and ring fingers near the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to locate the cause of a noise in the cooling fan of a piece of lab equipment. The employee was tapping the fan blade when his right index finger was caught in the blade, causing a fingertip amputation. The fan's cover was removed at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating and turning a motorized scooter when the scooter slipped out from under him and landed on his leg. He sustained a broken leg and ankle.
An employee was sitting in a wheeled chair. The employee bent down out of the chair to pick up a piece of paper, became dizzy, and fell. The employee's head struck the floor.

An employee was removing the yoke from the transmission on a commercial truck. A bolt broke and shot back into the employee's face. The employee suffered a left-side facial fracture and tearing of the orbital socket, requiring hospitalization for surgery.

An employee was operating a 1,600-ton dry press machine. He was standing on the pressing platform while waiting for the press cycle to complete. He fell off the platform and his head struck the reinforced concrete floor about 2 feet below. He lost consciousness and began bleeding from the back of his head and the side of his nose. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a step stool organizing supplies when the employee fell off the stool and fractured the right hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking to her car at the end of her shift. Precipitation had frozen to the ground. The employee slipped and fell, breaking their femur and requiring surgery.

An employee was cutting insulation off of a cable that he thought was de-energized. However, the cable was energized, and he received third degree electrical burns to his knees and elbows and a first degree burn to his face.
An employee was cleaning a bread slicer when the blade lacerated the employee's right thumb, index finger, and middle finger. The slicer was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to close the jammed back door to a postal delivery truck. His left middle finger was caught between the two panels of the door and was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was taking wrapping off palletized boxed produce. A box of the produce fell off the top of the pallet and struck him in the chest. He fell backwards to the floor, and the box landed on him. He suffered chest and lower back injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a sand mixer machine. He loosened a metal plate on the machine, which then fell onto his left hand, crushing his left index finger and resulting in a medical finger amputation.

An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) when the PIT struck a sprinkler head, creating a flood of water from overhead. The employee disembarked the PIT and slipped and fell on the wet concrete floor while attempting to exit the flooded area, suffering a serious spinal injury.
An employee was exiting a package delivery vehicle. She fell, suffering a broken right wrist and a head laceration.

An employee was driving a forklift across an iron pour area. A ladle containing molten iron struck the forklift; as the employee left the forklift, the employee's feet came into contact with molten iron and were burned.
An electrical technician was using a multimeter test for voltage across a live circuit and sustained burns from an arc flash requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working at the self checkout lanes when a customer came up behind her and began punching her in the face. She suffered a broken nose, fractured left eye socket and cheek, and injured right ear.

An employee was looking under the hood of a truck. The employee's hand was on the engine alternator belt when the engine was started. The employee's fingertip was then caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was walking across the parking lot when he slipped on the icy pavement and landed on his foot, breaking his ankle.
An employee suffered the amputation of three left-hand fingers while operating a shear.

An employee was using a full-size metal shear to cut metal. As the employee was holding the metal in place, the shear actuated and cut off the tip of the employee's right middle finger to the top of the nail bed.
An employee was operating a mini-grinder. The equipment jammed; while the employee was trying to unjam it, the running paddles caught and amputated the employee's left index finger.

On December 9, 2019, at 8:55 a.m., an employee was working on a PIV. The employee was tightening the hose clamp with a socket wrench when the tool slipped and the employee's left hand made contact with the PIV engine's drive belt, causing an amputation to the left pinky finger. The engine was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was troubleshooting a drying problem on a pellet dryer. The employee removed the airlock hose on the bottom of the dryer and used his right pinky finger to sweep away a piece of debris. The airlock rotated and caught his leather glove. When he pulled his hand out, his right pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was placing trash into a trash compactor. The employee tried to remove an item from the trash compactor and amputated their left middle, ring, and pinky fingers.

An employee was hooking up a trailer to a pickup while a second employee was using a skid steer to remove snow around the trailer. The skid steer bucket struck the first employee, causing a compound fracture of the lower left leg below the knee and a fracture to the right wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to clear jammed wire from machinery when the employee's hand entered the point of operation. The machine then cycled, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a press brake. As he was removing stuck material, the machine caught and partially amputated his right thumb.
An employee was manually jogging a machine by pulling on the drive belt when the employee's hand was caught in the pulley, resulting in a finger amputation.
Two employees were mixing mildew cleaner when sodium hypochlorite and phosphoric acid were mixed, creating chlorine gas. Both employees were hospitalized with inhalation injuries.
An employee was using an electric saw to cut drywall. The blade hit an object, causing the saw to jump back and cut two of the employee's fingers. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell to the ground while helping another employee tarp a trailer. The employee suffered a broken wrist, broken elbow, and fractured hip.
An employee was walking through a parking lot on a slight grade. The employee slipped on wet grass, fell to the ground, and suffered broken teeth. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a broken chain on a machine on a repair line when the machine was activated while his hand was on the chain, resulting in a left little finger amputation and broken left ring and middle fingers.
An employee suffered a partial distal tip amputation while operating a production conveyor.

An employee drove a log skidder to a site to drag a log out of the woods. When he got out of the log skidder, a dead tree fell and hit him, knocking him to the ground and against part of the skidder. He suffered a broken/fractured elbow, fracture to several vertebrae, and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was using a chain hoist to lift a 150-pound heat pump when an overhead anchor broke free from the cement ceiling, causing the pump to fall and strike the employee. He suffered a cervical injury.
A 1-ton tow truck backed over an employee, breaking the employee's left ankle.

An employee was operating a manual surface grinder and tried to move the diamond dressing tool with his right hand while the grinder wheel was running. His right index finger was caught in between the grinding wheel and the diamond dressing tool, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam on a line that had caused a belt to come off a roller. The employee slipped and fell 7 feet to the cement floor below, suffering a broken vertebra.
An employee was carrying equipment into a store. He fell to the floor as he entered a room, breaking his right wrist.
An employee received an electric shock while installing exterior lighting outside a central plant.

Casing was being run at a drilling site. The employee was reaching for a safety chain on an elevator door when the casing was pushed into the employee's right arm, smashing it against the pipe and tool that was in the hole. The employee's arm was broken.

The injured employee was working in the waste processing area of plant discussing tasks and duties with employee 2. The injured employee was assaulted by employee 2. The injured employee was punched while inside the plant. Then the altercation moved outside to the parking lot, where the injured employee was shot and pistol-whipped by employee 2. The injured employee sustained a gunshot wound and broken ribs.

An employee was walking behind a forklift when the forklift started to back up. The forklift operator did not see the employee and struck him. He suffered a fractured left tibia and broken left ankle.
An employee was working on a small air press. While she was getting a part from the machine, it cut her right index finger. She suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was trying to remove a rag from a milling machine. The employee's right hand was pulled into the machine's rotating parts, causing the amputation of the little finger, the ring finger, and half of the middle finger.

A 6-foot piece of steel weighing approximately 1,300 pounds was being hoisted, when it slipped from the rigging and fell from approximately 8 feet, striking a machine and then striking an employee in the leg. The employee's leg was fractured.

An employee was working at the edger when he started to fall. He reached his hand out and it contacted the edger chain and/or was caught between two boards, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation. The chain and sprocket was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was cutting metal on a shear. As he pushed material into the shear, the machine started. His finger was crushed and the tip was amputated.
An employee was clearing a jam on a machine. The rollers caught him and amputated his left thumb.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift when his hand was caught between the forks and the carriage, resulting in the surgical amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was pulling rods from a well and placing them in a basket on a truck. A rod fell from the basket and struck him on the shoulder. He suffered a collapsed lung and broken bones in the shoulder, and was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting a butter pump and loading it with a block of butter. The employee's left-hand fingers were pinched between the top guard and the side of the pump, resulting in a partial amputation of the tips of the ring and middle fingers.

An employee was on top of a shot blaster pushing down metal shots from a sight glass into the auger when the auger caught the employee's hand and pulled his arm into the shot blaster. He sustained vascular damage in his arm and was hospitalized.
Two employees got into an argument. They went outside and the argument escalated into a fight outside the restaurant. One employee was stabbed five times and hospitalized.
An employee was working on a front end loader. The locking attachment pin struck the employee's left middle finger, which was later medically amputated.

An employee was getting ready to pull parts from an oven with an electric cart dolly. He was reversing the electric cart dolly in high gear toward the oven when the handle bar of the cart dolly pinned his hand against the oven door. He suffered a hand injury, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was ripping wood flooring on a sliding table saw. A piece of flooring got stuck. While the employee was clearing it, the blade cut his right index middle fingers. The index finger, which had been cut at the knuckle, underwent a medical amputation; the middle finger required stitches. The blade was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell to the ground and broke his head while unloading freight from the lift gate of a trailer.
Two employees were staging material for an upcoming job when an active vent line above them had a release of steam. They both received second degree burns and were hospitalized.
On December 10, 2019, an employee was struck by a backhoe blade while milling and paving a roadway. The employee was hospitalized and suffered an amputation.
An employee was delivering product to a customer when the employee slipped and fell on ice, breaking the right hip.

An employee was in a man lift changing a light bulb in a gym when a spotter lowered one of the stabilizers, causing the employee to fall 25 to 30 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with facial, head, and internal organ injuries.

An employee was preparing to service a car and placed it on a lift. The car fell off the lift and pinned the employee to the ground, causing contusions and possible fractures to the right side of the body. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was dropping boxes into an elevator shaft when the employee fell down the shaft and hit the shaft floor, suffering a back injury.
An employee fell from a 4- to 5-foot scaffold to the concrete landing below. The employee suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was measuring a forklift fork. Another fork, lying next to the one the employee was measuring, was knocked over and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip and left index fingertip.

An employee was helping another employee investigate the operation of a lift gate on a box truck. The second employee lowered the lift gate, but the mechanism was stuck. The second employee freed the mechanism and used the controls to lower the lift gate. The lift gate ramp then needed to be flipped over. Both employees grabbed the ramp plate to flip it over and as they were bringing the ramp plate over, it fell on the first employee's right foot. The first employee was hospitalized with four toe fractures.
An employee was cutting down a tree when it fell on him, breaking his nose, back, and shoulder.
An employee was walking out of the building when she slipped and fell on a slippery floor, fracturing her left hip.
An employee was poling a light when a small amount of molten bath splashed on his jacket, causing it to ignite. He received burns to his left-side flank under his arm.

An employee was throwing trash into a dumpster from a receiving dock when the employee slipped and fell off the dock, which was wet. The employee landed on the dumpster and received lacerations to the spleen, kidney, and left elbow; a fractured rib, and a right knee injury.

At 12:55 a.m. in a highway construction work zone, a van struck the employer's pickup truck, which in turn struck two employees. One of the employees was hospitalized, having suffered two broken ribs, two broken vertebrae, and a bruised lung.
An employee was feeding rebar into a cutting machine. It actuated and his hand got stuck in the machine. He suffered broken bones and underwent a surgical amputation.

An employee was walking down a flight of stairs carrying packages from the mailroom when the employee missed the last step and fell to the hard stairwell surface. The employee was hospitalized with a ruptured quadriceps tendon.

An employee was using a cut-off saw to cut a pipe when the saw became caught or kicked back and struck the employee's face, causing severe facial lacerations that required hospitalization and stitches.
Employees were using a skid steer to load flat rails onto a trailer. One employee's fingers were caught and crushed between a rail and the trailer.
An employee was cleaning a roller conveyor when the employee's finger contacted the chain, resulting in the amputation of the left small fingertip.

A maintenance employee was installing a harmonic balancer on a crank shaft on a frac pump. He was pulling himself up using a strap when the strap sheared a bolt holding some of the components together.  This caused the metal lifting eye to fall and strike the employee's hand, resulting in an amputation of the right pinky finger.
An employee was cutting 2X4 lumber with a miter saw when his hand slipped and contacted the blade, lacerating his left index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was coming into work from the parking lot when she lost her balance and fell to the ground, hitting her head. She was hospitalized with a brain bleed.
An employee was working on a 5-foot ladder to remove cardboard from a shelf when the employee fell off the ladder, suffering left rib and left leg injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning up mulch spillage around a screener (electric and hydraulic) when a piece of tarp was blown into the screener.  The screener operator stopped the screener and the employee attempted to remove the tarp piece. His left hand became wrapped up in the idler roller, resulting in fractures to the hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was on the upper level of a drop-deck flatbed trailer, rigging electrical bushings so a crane could remove them from the back of the trailer. He fell from the upper level to the lower level, 3 feet below, and broke his left tibia and fibula.

An employee was working with another employee to unjam a fiber picker machine when the employee's left arm was pulled into the hazardous area. The employee was hospitalized with left hand and arm injuries.
An employee was operating a flange-refacing machine. His arm contacted a rotating part and was injured. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down from a rough terrain crane when he lost his footing and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a  fracture above his left ankle.
On December 11, 2019, a live-in caregiver was taking trash to a can outside a house. She tripped on the edge of a small ramp and broke her ankle. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was in an aerial lift helping to erect precast tilt-up concrete panels. Approximately 5 minutes after the panel's installation, workers adjusting the panel began to notice it shifting away from its structure. Immediately after noticing the shift, workers started clearing the area. Within seconds, the panel became displaced and completely fell. During the panel's descent, it struck the left side of the employee's aerial lift guardrail. The panel's strike caused the aerial lift to rebound sporadically. The rebounding motions caused the injured employee to strike the left side of his abdomen against the aerial lift's guardrails and platform. This caused him to break his fifth and sixth left-side ribs, and suffer a partially collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up trash when he slipped on ice in front of the store and broke his ankle.

An employee had been standing in the bed of a pickup truck, shoveling salt out to de-ice walkways. After jumping down off the truck he lost consciousness and fell to the ground, striking his head on the concrete. He suffered a head injury and minor brain bleeding, and was hospitalized.
An employee was rigging and lifting a load with an overhead jib crane when the load fell on the employee's hand, smashing the fifth distal phalanx and resulting in a fourth finger amputation.
A fabric cutter's blade amputated the tip of an employee's left middle finger.
An employee was working on the loading dock when a forklift driver reversed over the employee's foot, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.
At 7:30 p.m. on December 11, 2019, an employee was folding up the legs of a foldable table. When the hinge of a leg was released, the leg dropped forward, slicing open the employee's right eye.
An employee was attempting to unjam a heat sealing machine when the machine burned the employee's right hand and forearm.
A patient bit the tip of an employee's finger, causing the amputation of the tip without loss of bone.

An employee was walking to a moving storage box in a parking lot when she slipped on black ice and fell to the parking lot surface. She broke her lower right leg in two places and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was riding on the rear steps of a residential collection truck when a piece of debris flew in his face, causing him to either jump or fall off the rear step onto the ground. He suffered a fractured ankle, neck, and back as well as shoulder soreness.

An employee was cleaning the stairs with water and bleach. The employee slipped on the wet floor, tripped and fell down the stairs from the first floor to the basement. The employee sustained a fracture requiring surgery.
An employee tripped over a chair in the ICU breakroom and impacted the ground, fracturing the left hip.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by a closing steel door.

An employee was standing in front of a standard-transmission vehicle, looking into the engine. The vehicle was started while it was in gear and its bumper pinned the employee against a concrete barrier. The employee's leg was broken.

An employee arrived at work for a monthly meeting. The employee entered an auditorium where latex balloons had been left from a previous event. Upon entering the room, the employee began experiencing a severe allergic reaction to the latex and respiratory distress, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was loading a cart with plywood when the plywood slid off the cart, striking the employee in the sternum. He flew 10 feet and fell to the floor, hitting his head. He was hospitalized with a head injury requiring stitches, sternum injuries, and a possible concussion.

An employee was trying to flush contaminants from a chemical line. The flow came out at a higher rate than expected. Toluene di-isocyanate splashed out of the containment bucket and onto two employees. One of them, splashed in the head, face, and chest area, suffered skin irritation and the effects of chemical inhalation.
On December 11, 2019, an employee was cutting wood stock with a chop saw to fabricate a window when the spinning saw blade amputated the employee's right thumb.

Employees were moving a large steel vessel head piece with a forklift when the head piece was pushed off of the cribbing onto the injured employee's foot, crushing it and resulting in a small toe amputation.
An employee was walking on a snow-covered surface when he fell to the ground and fractured his ankle.
An employee fell off a ladder he was climbing, landing on the concrete floor about 8 feet below. He suffered a cut to the back of the head, a cut to the chin, a broken shoulder, and a broken heel.
An employee either fell to the floor while standing on a chair or tripped and fell to the floor while walking. The employee sustained a broken leg in two places, requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped on the corner of a pallet and fell to the floor, breaking both arms.
An employee was preparing to lift a bundle of rebar with a crane when the employee's thumb became caught in the clamp of the crane's jib, resulting in a thumb amputation.
An employee reached into a tray former to grab a box tab. The plunger that grabbed the boxes came down and struck his right index finger, breaking it; the finger was later amputated.
An employee was climbing down a pier when he slipped and his eye contacted uncapped rebar, causing an eye contusion.
