Employees were working in the sterilization department. A motor which controlled the ventilation of ethylene oxide failed. Six employees were hospitalized for exposure to ethylene oxide.

An employee was sitting in the cab of a forklift while fueling the lift. The fuel started to overflow so the employee exited the cab and slipped and fell 3 feet to the cement. She landed on and fractured her ankle.
An employee was offloading a tractor trailer. The employee's left index finger was pinched by the load and partially amputated.
An employee was returning from lunch and collapsed, requiring hospitalization.

On December 11, 2019, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was attempting to clear a piece of wood that was lodged in a lumber finish planer when a rotating cutter head contacted the employee's right pinky finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was changing out a liquor gun for a recovery boiler when black liquor (caustic-type material) contacted the employee's face. He was hospitalized with second degree burns to the face and upper chest.

An employee on a second floor was installing floor trusses into hangers. A truss pushed out of the hanger, causing the employee to fall 18 feet from the second story to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion.

An employee of Andino's Landscape was working on bar countertop trim using a 7.5-inch circular saw. He was cutting a piece of trim on a balcony. The sawblade made contact with the guardrail, causing the saw to kick back and contact the employee's left index finger. The finger was amputated.

An employee was installing safety railings on a new parking deck construction when he tripped and fell through an elevator shaft to the ground below (approximately 50 feet). He suffered fractures to both legs, two fractured ribs, and a major spinal compression, requiring hospitalization. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.

Two employees were loading a backyard machine onto a trailer for transport. When the machine was backed up, its right track slipped off the right ramp and it tipped over. It struck the employee who was acting as a spotter, causing a broken vertebra, broken ribs, and bruised lungs.

On December 12, 2019, around 3:00 PM, an employee was operating a forklift inside a freezer when he pressed the gas instead of the brakes. His hand was outside of the forklift cage at the time and became caught between the forklift and a rack. He suffered a thumb fracture and ligament damage and was hospitalized where the thumb was surgically amputated.
While doing a bait monitor check, an employee fell at a customer's house and struck his head on concrete. The employee sustained severe head injuries and seizures.
The employee was bracing a pallet with his foot so he could nail it with a nail gun. The employee slipped and the nail gun shot a nail into his foot.
An employee was moving a parallel bar. The bar fell on the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee tripped and fell while moving an empty shopping cart. The employee suffered broken ribs.
On December 12, 2019, at approximately 5:00 PM, an employee was leaving for the day when the employee slipped in the hallway and fell. The employee refractured the right hip.

An employee was placing a 425-pound turbine disk into a crate for shipment. While attempting to position the turbine disk, the employee's right middle finger was caught in between a 2x4 inside the crate and the turbine disk. When the employee attempted to pull out the right middle finger, the right distal phalangeal tip was amputated.
An employee fell while walking out of work, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was performing remedial concrete work on a wall from an extension ladder. The ladder slid out from beneath him and he fell approximately 8 feet to the ground below. He broke his left wrist and suffered contusions to his left ribs, requiring hospitalization.
On 12/12/2019, an employee was manually moving forms when he felt a "pop" in his stomach area. He was hospitalized with an umbilical hernia that required surgery.
An employee was repairing a leaky extrusion press when the employee slipped on oil from the press on the floor and fractured the right leg.
An employee was using a stump grinder to remove a tree stump from a golf course. The grinder's teeth lacerated the employee's right big toe.
On December 12, 2019, an employee lost her balance and fell onto the floor, fracturing her left hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on top of a tank when it exploded. He was thrown from the tank and required hospitalization for multiple fractures.
An employee was operating a PIT vehicle when it struck a guardrail. As a result, the employee suffered five broken ribs.
An employee was walking in a parking lot when another employee's vehicle hit him, causing a bone fracture.
An employee was guiding a fence panel that was suspended by a crane. The employee's finger was crushed between the suspended load and an object on the ground. The finger was amputated.
An employee using a table saw to rip lumber sustained a partial amputation to his left thumb.

On December 12, 2019, an employee was helping with a crane load being lifted when a steel sheet slid out from the load and pinned the employee between the sheet and a manlift tire. The employee suffered a fractured right leg.
An employee climbed a ladder to a roof. As soon as he stepped off of the ladder and onto the roof, he fell approximately 12 feet to the ground, suffering broken bones and a left ankle injury.
An employee was loading wood onto a bandsaw for cutting. A part snagged, stopping the wood; the sawblade lacerated the employee's right middle and index fingers.
An employee fell from the fifth floor to the fourth floor while cutting a wood joist and suffered bone fractures.
An employee was on a ladder fastening a structure on a tank when the employee fell off the ladder, suffering a fractured back.
An employee was laying sticks on the back of a stacker when his finger was caught between a wooden board and metal pipe on the stacker, resulting in the amputation of his left ring finger.
An employee was walking in a transfer yard when he tripped over a metal pipe, fell to the ground, and broke his leg.
An employee was walking from a scrap pile to the office. A customer's pickup truck backed into the employee, causing a dislocated left shoulder and a broken right hip and leg.
An employee fell onto a joist while tearing off decking, suffering fractured ribs.
An employee was standing on a chair while filing when the chair rolled out from under her and she fell to the floor, hitting her head and tailbone.
An employee was cutting a tree when another tree fell and hit him on the head. He was hospitalized with a fractured neck and had surgery.
An employee slipped on a water hose while walking in the wash bay, falling to the floor and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a battery-powered hand drill to get paint out of tapped holes in a framework and mount casters/level feet when the employee's right thumb was caught in between the framework foot pad and concrete floor, resulting in a partial distal phalange amputation of the left thumb.
An employee was walking toward the exit door of a lobby. She tripped, hit her face against the door, and broke her fall to the floor with her hands. She suffered injuries to the nose and arms.

An employee was exiting the facility at shift change. While en route to the gate, the employee ducked and walked under a transport trailer. When he raised up, he struck his head against the metal structure of the trailer, injuring his neck.
An employee was getting material from the back of a pot. His right ring finger was jammed, cut, and fractured.
An employee's right ring finger was caught between a steel plate. The finger was lacerated and fractured.

A CHEP employee was standing off to the side of a service area when a pallet jack operator lost control of the pallet jack and struck the employee's left leg against upright racking. He suffered broken bones in his left leg.

An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot to move it when he stumbled on the curb, lost his balance, and fell. He hit his forehead, suffering a brain hemorrhage and loss of consciousness. He was hospitalized.
While scraping off a car in a parking lot, an employee fell on ice and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was loading plastic film into a bacon packaging machine. The machine's cutting blade amputated the employee's finger.

An employee was walking with a relief crew, inspecting rig-down operations. The employee fell through an open hinge floor plate, landing 3 1/2 feet below and suffering a dislocated left shoulder and broken left humerus.
An employee was clearing a jammed tray from a trim press when the perimeter die closed on the employee's right middle finger and amputated it at the first knuckle.
An employee's hand entered an automatic slicer, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
A temporary employee was cutting pre-cooked chicken with a kitchen knife. The knife amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

An employee was installing a 1,200-pound switch on a man lift. He finished securing the switch and was removing the round sling from the hook when he noticed that the headache ball was still coming down. He tried to move his hand out of the way by moving the hook. His left hand was then caught between the beam and the headache ball, resulting in an amputation of the left index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, suffering a broken right leg.

At about 8:45 a.m. on December 13, 2019,  an employee fell through a skylight during a re-roofing project. The employee landed on the concrete floor 18 feet 7 inches below, suffering a broken elbow, a shattered pelvis, and a compression fracture to his back.

An employee was delivering mail. She stepped out of her vehicle to deliver a package to a house and a dog bit both her legs; she fell and suffered a wrist injury. The bites became infected and she was hospitalized.

On 12/13/2019 at 9:55 a.m., an employee was packing items for customers at her workstation when she tripped over a box on the ground and fell onto the concrete floor. She suffered a right ankle fracture and distal fractures to the tibia and fibula, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee had finished using an overhead crane with a c-hook attachment to unload steel coils off a flatbed trailer. Employees were trying to use a forklift to pick up the attachment for use at a different crane when the attachment fell over onto the crane operator, causing a broken left leg.
An employee suffered a partial finger amputation and a fracture of the distal middle finger when putting a chickpea cart back on the rail.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to remove a piece of plywood from a wall when he slipped and fell off the ladder, fracturing his left wrist. It was raining at the time of the incident.
An employee was clearing a clog in an industrial vacuum when the automatic flapper shut on his left arm, crushing it and causing a laceration and bruising.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when he turned the wheel and accelerated.  At that time, the employee's leg was outside the vehicle and was pinned between the pallet jack and a rack. The employee's right leg was fractured.

An employee was working on a strut and spring, and placed the equipment in a spring compressor. The strut and spring released from the compressor, hitting him in the face. He suffered a fractured nose, fractured cheek bone, and shoulder injury.
An employee's socks became wet while pressing on sand bags, which caused extreme blistering and skin around the area to turn black, resulting in a right toe amputation.
On December 13, 2019, an employee tripped and fell in a corridor. The employee suffered a broken right forearm and underwent surgery.

On December 14, 2019, at approximately 1:00 PM, an employee was walking through the parking lot returning to the store after break when she was struck by a motor vehicle, fracturing her right tibia and big toe.

An employee was moving cows from one area to another area. When she attempted to close a fence gate, a bull struck her. She was hospitalized with a broken shoulder or collarbone and a possible collapsed lung.
An employee was flying a helicopter, which had a mechanical failure. The employee's ribs were broken.
An employee was measuring the remaining plastic in a roll on a rotating shaft when the employee's hair was caught by the rotating roll. Her hair and skin were pulled off of her head

An employee was using a stepladder to pour seasoning mix into a mixer. The scoop fell into the machine; as the employee was retrieving it, the machine amputated his right ring finger to the second knuckle and lacerated his right little finger with tendon damage. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was handling a steel manhole lid. The lid fell onto his right foot, breaking a bone.
An employee slipped and fell in the store, suffering a hip injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting fruit with a knife and amputated the tip of their left thumb.
An employee was cleaning an aircraft window when she fell approximately 21 inches off a ladder to the ground, fracturing her L1 vertebra.

An employee was cleaning up the restaurant for the evening. The employee grabbed a hot pot of water with his apron. The pot was so hot that he spilled the hot water on his left arm and hand, receiving second degree burns.
An employee slipped and fell 16 feet to the floor below while laying floor decking, suffering a broken wrist that required hospitalization.

An employee driving a forklift was backing up and fell off the loading dock. The employee attempted to jump off, but the forklift landed on and injured his pelvic area. A seatbelt was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking in the kitchen when the employee slipped on water on the floor and fell, impacting the floor. The employee suffered a concussion/head injury.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking to her car, fracturing her hip and requiring hospitalization.
An employee's left toe was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor when he attempted to remove stuck material. The conveyor then amputated his right pinky finger.

An employee was on site installing new furniture. He went out to the second-story balcony to throw out a box. The permanent metal railing failed and the employee fell from the balcony. He required stitches on his head.

An employee was adjusting a bottle conveyor screw when his wrench slipped and fell into the clutch box assembly underneath the conveyer belt. He removed the face plate of the clutch box assembly and retrieved the wrench. Upon restarting the line, he received a clutch jam notification that stopped the machine. He went back to the clutch box assembly and attempted to determine what was causing the clutch jam. He asked a partner to intermittently operate the human machine interface that starts and stops the machine as he observed and adjusted the clutch mechanism and sensor. As he was troubleshooting back and forth between the clutch mechanism and the sensor, his finger became caught in the clutch gear and belt, resulting in a medical amputation to the left index finger s first digit.

An employee had hooked two concrete pilings to a travel lift crane. He was standing at the end of the pilings, holding a 2-inch by 4-inch by 3-foot board to use as a cushion between them. The board fell to the ground. While the employee was retrieving it, the pilings were lifted and pinched the employee's right arm.
An employee tripped on a box while walking to a stock room. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was driving a utility vehicle when it hit a small tree in a median. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a hip injury.
An employee was descending a ladder when he fell to the concrete below and fractured his hip and leg.
An employee was threading a machine when the machine's 50-inch blade amputated four fingers on his left hand.
An employee fell from a ladder while picking orders to stock. She suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was fitting an engine frame onto its roll-over fixture. As the employee was guiding the pins on the engine frame into the holes on the roll-over fixture, the frame moved downward and pinched the employee's left hand between the frame and the roll-over fixture. He was hospitalized for hand surgery.
An employee was descending a ladder while stocking groceries when she missed the last step and fell to the ground, landing on and fracturing her knee.
An employee was slicing tomatoes when the slicer blade cut her right index finger, resulting in an amputation of the finger.
An employee was helping install a metal staircase. It shifted and pinched the employee's left middle finger, amputating it at the first knuckle.
An employee was closing a safe door when the door closed on the employee's finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a trailer unloading carts when he tripped and fell, injuring his right ankle.
An employee slipped on wet grass while delivering mail. The employee suffered a twisted right knee that required surgery.
An employee fell through an attic ceiling, suffering a broken wrist and cheekbone.

An employee was in the process of unloading a rail car. While he was disconnecting a product line hose containing sulfuric acid, residual pressure on the unloading line caused the sulfuric acid to expel and contact the right side of his face, right arm, and waist, causing second degree burns.
An employee pulled her back while watering a plant with a watering can. She began to have difficulty breathing and was hospitalized.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder installing a data cable when he fell from the ladder and landed on the concrete floor, hitting his head and suffering head trauma.
An employee was adjusting the fork width on a telescopic handler. The fork smashed his right index fingertip, causing the amputation of the tip with no bone loss.

An employee was operating a plasma saw. When he attempted to clear metal shavings from the table, the saw blade caught his glove, pulling his left ring finger into the blade and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was standing on two pallets, getting boxes down. The employee fell and suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was showing a maintenance electrician a problem he was having moving a part of a mixing machine. When the injured employee adjusted the ball valves on the equipment the employee received an electric shock and sustained a fractured right scapula, and a fractured and dislocated left shoulder.

An employee was digging around the saddle of a sewer tap at a residential job site. The side wall of the ditch collapsed and a chunk of asphalt and dirt pinned the employee against the side of the ditch. He suffered broken ribs and a broken pelvis.
An employee was installing gutters on a two-story residential roof. He fell while moving from the roof to a ladder, landing on a cement floor and suffering a broken arm.

An employee was using a power drill to drill a hole through a conduit when the drill bit pulled his leather glove and wrapped it around the bit. His left index fingertip was lacerated and his left middle finger was amputated from the nail up.
An employee fell backwards to the ground while entering a personal vehicle, suffering a fractured pelvis.

An employee was standing on a ladder installing a video surveillance camera. When the employee was climbing down the ladder, his foot slipped and he fell backwards, landing on his left arm. He sustained injuries to the left wrist and arm.
An employee tripped while carrying a tub of silverware and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee tripped on forklift tines and suffered broken ribs.
An employee was preparing to mop a floor and was wringing out the mop when she fell, breaking her left femur.

An employee was installing a 480 VAC circuit breaker when the employee's pliers contacted the energized bus bar and caused an arc flash. The employee was hospitalized with first and second degree electrical burns to the face and arms.
An employee was on top of a coil, trying to align its head end with its tail end for stationary welding. The coil clamp was lowered onto the employee's left foot, amputating the big toe.
An employee was using an electric pallet jack to position a load near a conveyor when the employee ran into the conveyor, suffering a left leg laceration that required surgery.
A block from a crane pinned an employee's leg and fractured it, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was descending a 3-rung ships ladder, missed a rung, and fell 36 inches to the floor sustaining a broken ankle.
An employee was sorting packages in the back of a mail truck on a rainy day. As the employee exited the rear door of the truck, the employee slipped and fell out, injuring the right knee.

An employee was rolling an 80" tall x 9" round, 1,500-pound tool to storage when the tool began to tip over. He tried to stop the tool from falling and it landed on the lower part of his body, causing a possible fractured hip.
An employee was on a ramp, delivering food using a hard cart. The employee slipped and fell, suffering finger cuts and an amputation to the left little finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was clearing a clogged pipe when their hand was caught inside a pump motor. The employee suffered a fractured hand and lacerated fingers.
An employee was lifting cam blocks out of a die when the employee felt stomach pains, requiring hospitalization for a hernia.

An employee was bringing belongings into a patient's room when another patient followed him into the room and struck his right temple with his fist. The employee fell, hitting his head on the patient's bed and floor. The employee also struck his tailbone against the floor as he fell. He was hospitalized with head and tailbone injuries.
An employee fell while exiting a trailer on a load stand. He landed on his right knee and suffered a broken kneecap.
An employee was using an overhead crane when an attachment fell, striking her and injuring her leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through a hallway when the employee slipped and fell on the wet floor, suffering a Colles fracture.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a wooden post when the saw blade cut the employee's index finger, resulting in a possible amputation.
Two employees were changing out a plastic mold cavity. The machine engaged while one employee's hand was in it, and the employee's right little fingertip was amputated.
An employee's foot was caught in the chain and sprocket of an unscrambler, causing severe injuries on the lower left leg.
An employee fell while stepping off a two-step stool. The employee suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to grab a bottle that was jammed in the trip chute of a blow molding machine when the trimmer block cycled and amputated approximately one-half of his left index finger.
While operating a tube bender machine, an employee's right pinky finger was caught in a pinch point on the machine, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.
An employee stepped onto a 2-inch diamond plate floor scale ramp to weigh a chemo waste container when he slipped and fell on the scale. He was hospitalized with a broken right leg.
An employee slipped on ice and snow while walking across a parking lot. The employee fell, suffering broken ribs and a broken clavicle.
An employee was probing ground. The bucket of a mini excavator struck and lacerated the employee's lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
After parking his vehicle, an employee was walking to a security office when he slipped on black ice in the walkway. He fell, suffering broken ribs and a possible collapsed lung.

An employee was driving a forklift when his right forearm/wrist/hand was pinched between a wall and a junction box. He suffered a cut to the forearm that required two stitches and a muscle injury to the hand that required hospitalization and surgery.

On December 16, 2019, an employee was moving raw material to a band saw area when his right middle finger was caught in the saw's vice clamp, crushing two fingertips on his right hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was exiting the rear of a delivery vehicle from the passenger side using three points of contact when his foot slipped off of the vehicle's step. He was unable to grip the handrail before falling on the ground. His left hip hit the rear bumper, causing a fracture to his hip, and he also fractured his wrist upon impact with the ground. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were opening the top hatch on sulfur rail cars to vent them when the employees were overcome by hydrogen sulfide gas. They were both hospitalized. The first employee suffered pulmonary edema (chemical) and the second employee suffered hemorrhaging in the eyes due to breathing stress.
An employee fell 13 feet from a metal roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken legs, arms, and ribs.
An employee was working from a 10-foot ladder, pulling old telephone wires in a ceiling. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered a concussion, a small brain bleed, and a dislocated left hand.
An employee was pulling a tube and injured his back, requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were troubleshooting a conveyor in a feed mill. The conveyor caught one employee's coat and pulled his left arm in. The arm was lacerated and his index finger was partially amputated. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a left index fingertip amputation while operating a grinding machine and clearing material that was stuck on the screw.
An employee was working on a water blast machine when the employee's right index finger was caught between the hydraulic clamps, resulting in hospitalization and subsequent partial amputation.

An employee was operating a packaging machine when a piece of cardboard jammed. He was clearing the machine when a gluer tube exploded, spraying the machine and the employee with 350-degree melted glue.

An employee's hand was resting on a hydraulic dump trailer when the down button was pressed instead of the up button. His right pinky finger was then pinned by the dump trailer, smashing his fingertip.
An employee participating in a team building event lost her footing while trying to hit a balloon. She fell backwards to the ground and landed on her hands, fracturing her left wrist.

An employee was asked to load large granite slabs onto a truck with the assistance of another person. The slabs were on a dolly. When he moved the slabs, a domino effect occurred and the slabs fell on him. He was caught underneath, crushing and breaking bones in both legs.
An employee was taking materials and supplies from a pallet inside the warehouse when a brown recluse spider bit him in his left elbow area. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a kitchen cabinet using a dolly when he ran over a metal piece and his left foot was caught between the dolly and metal piece, fracturing his three middle toes.
On 12/17/2019, an employee was moving a steel beam in the yard when it dropped, crushing the tip of his index finger. Surgery was required, resulting in bone loss to the fingertip.
While moving boxes to another floor, an employee entered an elevator and stepped on a few empty boxes. The employee then fell in the elevator and fractured a leg.
An employee was sweeping a floor. The employee fell, landing on the floor and suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung on the right side.
An extension ladder slipped out from underneath an employee. She fell about 7 to 10 feet; her right arm was broken in multiple places as she fell, and she landed on the ladder.

An employee was stacking boxes of vegetables on a wooden pallet when his foot was caught between the wooden slats of the pallet. He lost his balance and fell to the ground and onto his right hip, resulting in a fracture that required surgery.
An employee was unloading new mattresses off the bed of a pickup truck when he fell and hit his head on the ground, sustaining head trauma.

While walking, an employee's feet became caught on the concrete floor, causing the employee to trip and fall into the wall/floor. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and right shoulder and required lip stitches.

An employee was in an uninsulated attic installing a thermostat wire. While he was walking on a truss chord, the lumber broke and he fell through the ceiling to the concrete floor below. He suffered a broken leg and blunt force trauma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was setting a retaining wall. The employee's left hand was caught between a shackle and rigging, and the index finger was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee was pulling a mixing bowl from a bowl lift when the bowl slipped, hit another bowl, and injured the tip of his left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a distribution line after a storm, repairing a fused cutout switch that was 7,200 volts, when he contacted the live switch and received a flash burn on his right arm.

An employee was working at a head rig saw when a conveyor carrying wood slabs jammed. The employee went to clear the jam, and the employee's left index finger was pinched and cut between the jammed slab and another slab.
An employee was using a battery-operated impact drill to screw a lag bolt into a wooden pallet. The bolt caught the employee's gloved left hand, and his middle finger was amputated.
An employee was struck by a vehicle in a parking lot while walking to a building. The employee suffered a broken left lower leg.

An employee was operating a continually running radial saw. He attempted to clear debris from the saw when his left hand touched the blade, resulting in amputations of parts of the middle and index fingers.
An employee was climbing up a ladder when she fell, suffering a pelvic fracture.
While walking into the building, an employee slipped and fell on ice and snow, suffering a brain bleed.
An employee was attempting to move a luggage cart when she lost her balance and fell to the ground, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee slipped on ice and sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was stationed on the winder end of a winding machine and tasked with observing the product (roll of paper poly/film) being rolled. The employee had his left hand crushed between the floating shaft (holds roll on machine) and ejector roll bar, resulting in the ripping/amputation of the tips of the middle finger and ring finger by the machine.
While walking toward the store, an employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee fell from a plane while loading the cargo bin with luggage. The employee landed on the ground, suffering head injuries.

An employee was conducting maintenance operations when he attempted to clean flour out of a pipe so he could look inside. His right index finger was caught in the pipe, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping to load paper onto trucks and was cutting a nylon cord with a paper knife when the knife severely lacerated his right hand. Gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was repairing a leak on a gas line in the vicinity of a melting furnace. After fixing the gas line, the employee noticed the leak was still present. The employee was doing additional repairs when a flash fire occurred, causing burns to the front of the employee.

On December 17, 2019, at 11:00 AM, two employees were in a scissor lift in an elevated position repairing a natural gas furnace. One of the employees was not contained by the safety gear of the scissor lift and fell approximately 8 feet onto the floor of the warehouse. The employee sustained a fractured skull, fractured vertebrae, and bleeding on the brain as a result of the fall.

An employee was helping break down a transformer and rig copper winding onto a rough-terrain forklift. The forklift struck the employee against the transformer's base, breaking two of the employee's ribs on the left side.
An employee was burned with water while checking a piping system. The employee suffered first- and second-degree burns.
An employee was pulling electrical wires from a pulling machine when a piece of the equipment became loose and struck the employee's forehead. The employee was hospitalized with a forehead cut.

An employee was adjusting a piece of wood on a multi-saw stacker conveyor fork when the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the fork and the wood, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
Employees were moving an electric motor with a crane. When the motor came free, a piece of its mount struck an employee, breaking their left forearm.
An employee was standing in the doorway of a room with his hand resting between the door and frame when the self-closing door closed on his left hand, resulting in a ring fingertip amputation.
An employee and a co-worker were turning over a piece of structural steel for painting operations when the steel rolled onto the injured employee's right foot, resulting in fractured bones.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder while installing a gutter system when the employee lost footing and fell 5 feet to the ground, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was using a skid steer to move a metal pole stand, used to support a wooden electrical pole. The wooden pole slid on the forks of the skid steer and pinched the employee's right little finger against the pole stand. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a transport dolly to maneuver a metal frame from one area of the plant to another when the base of the metal frame started to slip off the dolly. The employee's left hand was in the pinch point zone, and the metal frame contacted the employee's hand. The employee's left ring finger was lacerated, resulting in the surgical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was investigating a smell behind the office. She entered the 6-foot high wooden fenced-in area when the self-locking gate proceeded to lock behind her. After several attempted calls for help, she proceeded to climb the fence and jumped down on the parking lot side. She landed awkwardly, fracturing the tibia and fibula in her left leg
An employee's right pinky finger was caught in a pinch point between overlapping cables, resulting in an amputation to the finger.

An employee was in her office, getting out of her desk chair. When she pushed the chair away from the desk, the wheels of the chair caught on a portion of the carpet. The chair tipped backwards, causing the employee to hit her head on the desk behind her and sustain a cut to the head.
An employee was installing a 10-foot fiberglass column when the employee lost control of the column. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated between the fiberglass and the ground.
An employee was hospitalized after suffering a traumatic injury with a sprained lower right arm and wrist.
An employee slipped and fell while trying to access a 5-ton truck in a maintenance shop. The employee's throat struck a handrail and suffered a contusion.
An employee tripped and fell to a concrete warehouse floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was stocking an item when a forklift ran over his foot, breaking it.

An employee was removing three guards to access the adjustment knuckles on a conveyor belt. While the employee was observing the belt, he fell forward toward the conveyor. His left arm landed on top of one of the conveyor rollers and was pulled under it, sustaining a compound fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to move an aluminum baking rack that was stuck to another rack. A second employee was attempting to help the injured employee un-stick the rack when the racks shifted and crushed the employee's left middle finger between two of the racks. As a result, the employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was getting out of a truck at his hotel when he fell to the ground, suffering a ruptured patellar tendon.

An employee in the cooling tower yard was making adjustments to a chiller plant when he tripped over a piece of maintenance equipment and fell to the concrete surface on the same level. He was hospitalized with a fractured hip, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to pull a dry skid off a trailer and onto a rail gate (a moving platform that freight is loaded onto) with a pump jack. The rail gate was slippery from the previous day's snow. He got onto the platform of the rail gate and turned the handle of the pump jack to stop its movement, but the pump jack kept sliding toward him. As he tried to get out of the way, he fell approximately 4 to 5 feet to the ground. He suffered a cut over the left eye, bruised ribs, and a crushed left elbow.
An employee was walking toward a bucket trailer truck, 6 feet off the road. A car fishtailed out of control and struck the truck and the employee, breaking the employee's left femur.

The injured employee was assisting another employee, who was operating a punch press. The press was actuated as the injured employee was pulling out a part, partially amputating their right index finger.
An employee was operating a walkie/rider electric jack to perform warehouse stocking activities when the employee was crushed between the jack and a rail, resulting in a fractured right ankle.
An employee was using a grommet to punch in material when the grommet caused an amputation to the employee's left index finger up to the nail.
An employee was closing a dump truck tail gate when the tail gate closed on his right thumb, resulting in a partial thumb amputation.

An employee was helping another person move a pallet with a transformer on it when he dropped his side of the pallet. He was unable to move his hands in time and the transformer landed on his fingers, resulting in amputations of the left middle and ring fingertips, as well as the right middle fingertip.

On December 18, 2019, at 11:00 a.m., an employee was uncrating a large machine when one side of the wooden crate fell and he was pinned underneath it, resulting in a fractured pelvis and hospitalization.

An employee was moving the tubing tongs on a workover rig over the head when the tongs caught the head and the level became stuck while the motor was in high gear, causing his gloved hand to become wrapped in the coil. His left distal phalange was degloved, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was walking through a neonatal intensive care unit to put a pacifier in an infant's mouth. The employee tripped on the cord to a machine and fell, landing on the floor on her stomach. She suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was working in the bakery back room when she tripped, striking her arm on the leg of a metal table. She was hospitalized with a broken arm.
An employee was lifting boxes in the casting department when the employee slipped and fell, suffering burns to the hands and thigh.
An employee slipped on black ice while closing the back door of a truck trailer, impacting the ground and breaking the right leg.
An employee was standing in the hallway of a pediatric unit when a coworker sprayed aerosolized air freshener and the employee began having wheezing and having difficulty breathing.
An employee was clearing a parking lot when the employee slipped and fell on ice, suffering a broken ankle that required surgery.

An employee was removing a cast iron heater from the overhead in a mill. Ropes that were temporarily holding the unit broke and the unit knocked the employee from his ladder to the floor. He suffered 11 broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a head laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was dismounting from a crane onto the work deck next to the cab. He attempted to jump from the platform approximately 3 feet across to a road work area. When he landed, his foot slipped and he fell backwards to the ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured vertebra.
An employee was struck by a train while driving a tractor. He was bounced around inside the cab, suffering contusions.
An employee was moving a cart of poles and metals when the cart tipped over and hit his head and fractured his right leg.
An employee was climbing down an aluminum extension ladder when he missed the last step of the ladder with his foot and fell on the concrete floor, injuring his upper torso and head.
An employee was guiding a bucket truck that was being backed up when he tripped and fell, hitting his head on a concrete sidewalk and breaking his neck.
An employee fell down stairs to a concrete floor, suffering a concussion.
An employee was setting a ladder on the side of a house when the employee lost balance and fell backwards to the ground, breaking both wrists.
An employee was entering a building when she tripped on the edge of a rug (in place to collect snow/water/ice/salt in the entryway) and fell to the concrete. She suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was working on the setup of an aluminum caster machine. The machine, which is supposed to cycle once at a time, must be cycled in order to gauge the machine. The machine cycled once and the employee was attempting to gauge it when the machine cycled again, closing down on his fingers. All fingers besides the thumbs were crushed on both hands.
An employee was working from a ladder cleaning a bead blast conveyor when he fell from the ladder and fractured his L1 vertebra.

On December 19, 2019, an employee was conducting maintenance on a forming machine. He was checking the machine's ventilation system when the mold came down on his right thumb, causing an amputation without bone loss.

Two employees were observing a crew who was in the process of reconfiguring a well head. Trapped pressure was released within the well and blew shrapnel (nuts, bolt, plastic parts of the inside of the valves that are part of the well head tree) at the two employees. One employee received an amputation injury to his right thumb. The other employee received shrapnel injuries to his body requiring him to be hospitalized and undergo surgery to remove the shrapnel.
An employee was working on a tractor trailer's brakes. His brake wrench hit him in the left eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the chain and pulley of an overhead door when the chain hooked to the employee's glove and pulled his hand onto the sprocket. He sustained a couple of broken left-hand fingers and damage to the nerve and veins.
An employee working on a machine sustained a partial amputation of the right index finger.
A maintenance employee was descending a ladder to the pit floor to check the governor tension sheave switch when he either missed or slipped on one of the bottom rungs and fell, breaking his leg.
An employee was walking to his truck when he slipped and fell on ice in the trailer lot, landing on and injuring his right knee.
An employee was getting down from a truck when the employee's ring finger was caught on a hook, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee fell off a 7- to 8-foot ladder, suffered broken ribs, and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder, retrieving merchandise for a customer order. He fell from the ladder, about 3 feet, and his right little fingertip was caught on a shelf and amputated at the knuckle.
An ironworker was unhooking a steel beam. When he cabled up on the crane, the rigging hook hung on the beam and pulled the beam over onto his right leg, breaking it.

On 12/19/2019, at 9:05 AM, an employee was walking around a parked concrete truck when the employee slipped and fell on the icy pavement, fracturing the left tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was cutting banding from a bundle of steel tubing. When the last section of the banding was cut, the tubing rolled and caught his left pinky finger between the tubing and an upright stop on the table. His left pinky finger received an avulsion that resulted in a medical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a drill press when the employee's glove was caught in the running drill bit, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was inspecting a cotton gin that was sparking. The lower service door was removed, and the employee looked into the machine and used his left hand to steady himself on the doffer scroll. The machine was electronically locked out but had not come to a complete stop at the time. The doffer pulled the employee's left hand and arm 18 inches down into the radius scroll, severely injuring his left arm.
An employee was painting on a scaffold when he slipped and fell approximately 5 feet from the scaffold to the floor. He was hospitalized with a fracture to the L2 vertebra.
An employee fell to the ground in a parking lot and broke an elbow.

On December 19, 2019, an employee was working inside an electrical vault. As the employee tried to climb an extension ladder, the ladder failed and the employee fell about 15 feet, suffering a broken pelvis and two broken wrists.
While removing a crushed can from a seamer, an employee cut their thumb on a torn can edge.
An employee was pulling stacked recyclable cardboard when he fell backwards, landing on the ground and suffering an elbow injury.
An employee slipped and fell on black ice in the parking lot, suffering a blood clot in the back of the head close to the neck.
An employee was holding an asphalt wand to spray liquid asphalt when the wand's hose burst, spraying hot asphalt onto the employee. The employee suffered burns to the face, ear, and hand.
An employee was attempting to lift a 40-pound box of banding clips onto a table that was 36 inches tall. The box became caught on edge of table and he lost his balance and fell, fracturing his hip.
An employee was clearing a jam in a production line when an air piston actuated and caught the employee's right index finger. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was standing on a forklift trying to empty a dustbin barrel. The barrel slipped and the employee fell into a hopper. The employee's right leg was pinned under the barrel and broken.
An employee was cleaning a planer wheel with a paper towel when he was pulled into the machine, ripping the skin from his arms and requiring stitches.

An employee was installing a piece of equipment in the facility that involved moving the equipment into place and plugging it into a receptacle. The employee realized the plug and the receptacle did not match. When the employee removed the receptacle from the wall to inspect the wiring an arc flash occurred and burned the employee's hands.
A temporary employee was loading mattresses in a trailer. A mattress fell and knocked him out of the trailer to the ground. He suffered head and neck injuries, including a large cut on the head.
An employee was placing sheet metal onto a hydraulic shear when his left hand was caught between the down and shear, resulting in a left middle finger amputation.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking into the building, fracturing the right ankle.

An employee was cleaning dirt from the tip of a sprayer nozzle and wand when the gun actuated while his palm was directly under the nozzle. The paint penetrated far into his hand, causing tissue damage and the entry of foreign material.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of their middle finger while using a drop saw.
An employee was trying to calm a residential client and direct him back to his room. The employee's left thumb was caught in a door and the tip was amputated.

At 6:00 a.m. on December 20, 2019, an employee was positioning a hoist to move a rack of tooling to a wash bay. As the employee operated the hoist to remove the slack from the chain, the eyehole of the hook pinched and smashed the employee's left index finger due to the weight of the rack being lifted. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a horizontal fiber baling unit when the steel door to the baler closed on his left hand, amputating his left thumb tip.
An employee's right ring fingertip was caught and injured between a large roll pin and a roller.
An employee was getting leaf rakes from a truck when a vehicle struck the back of the truck, also hitting the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was stepping off of a 24" tall platform when he fell and landed on a 1" steel pipe, suffering fractured ribs and a perforated lung.
An employee was at a press, aligning a die, when the stripped plate dropped and amputated the employee's left little finger.
After driving around the bank to check the ATM and make sure the building wasn't broken into, an employee exited her car and slipped on ice. She fell and broke her leg.
An employee was crouched down, doing maintenance work on a brush cutter, when a truck backed over her leg. Her right femur was broken.
An employee was moving the scrap skeleton of a steel plate when his thumb was caught between the scrap bin and the steel plate as it slid into place. His right thumb was fractured.
An employee was retrieving a customer's walker and lost balance, falling to the ground and breaking the left hip.
An employee was loading a new bore roll in a machine when his left index finger was smashed between the roller and cone, causing a laceration that later resulted in a fingertip amputation.

A temporary employee was unloading a crated kitchen range from a tractor trailer at the warehouse's dock when he mis-stepped, slipped, and lost control of the load. He then fell and was struck on the head by the falling appliance, suffering a mastoid effusion, L1 burst fracture, severed central canal, compression of conus or proximal calida equina leukocytosis, and hyperglycemia.

On December 20, 2019, an employee fell approximately 8 feet while climbing wall supports during the construction of the exterior walls of a pole barn. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ribs and vertebrae.
An employee was trying to free a stuck mold from a blow mold machine. The mold closed on his right hand, crushing it. His index finger had to be amputated during surgery.
An employee was pulling a customer order on an electric pallet jack. When he stepped off the jack, it ran over his right ankle, crushing it.
An employee was driving an ATV to check Christmas light displays when the ATV tipped over onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
While removing scaffold components, an employee tripped over a pallet. The employee's right hand got caught between bearings and the ring finger was broken. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking toward equipment when the employee tripped on a 2-inch pipe on the ground. The employee hit their nose and upper lip and suffered a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was unloading and strapping material on the bed of a flatbed truck at a customer's location when he tripped on an A-frame and fell to the deck of the truck before rolling off to ground. He dislocated his shoulder and sustained a neck injury.
On December 20, 2019, an employee was installing insulation for an HVAC unit when he possibly stepped on a nail. The next day, his middle toe became infected, requiring hospitalization.
On December 20, 2019, an employee received a left thumb tip amputation while using a chop saw.
An employee was placing sheet metal onto the table of a hydraulic shear. The machine caught his left middle finger and amputated the tip.

An employee was standing between two trucks, helping transfer cargo from one truck to the other. One of the trucks moved and the employee's leg was caught and broken between the two trucks.
An employee fell while descending a ladder, landing on the ground 3-4 feet below and suffering a rotational fracture to the tibia and fibula.
An employee was servicing an elevated heating unit. The platform the employee was standing on came loose and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken right arm and a head injury.

An employee was using his hands to push and slide a paper roll onto the forks of a forklift when the operator inadvertently hit a button in the cab and the forks started to raise, causing the roll to move towards the employee. The employee began to run/jump out of the way when the roll struck the employee and pinched his leg against a second roll that was sitting on the floor behind him. He suffered a left fibula fracture.
An employee was removing a temporary water line when hot water spewed out, causing second degree burns to the employee that required hospitalization.

An employee was conducting an inspection on a finger car where the kiln is located. He slipped while descending from the rack shelf frame and fell 10 feet to the floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured left wrist and lumbar.
An employee was performing maintenance on tongs when the tongs engaged, amputating the employee's right index fingertip.
Two employees were installing a service panel cover when the cover contacted live circuits, causing electrical burns to both employees' hands (one hand each).
An employee was repairing an assembly machine. The turntable activated and his arm was trapped in the machine and broken.

A maintenance employee was moving boxes and items out of the way at a client's location to gain access to an air conditioning unit when a paper cutting machine with a swing blade attachment fell and cut the employee's right index finger. He was hospitalized and had skin graft surgery.
A mechanic was using a truck jack to place a wheel ramp under a tire. The tire blew out and the jack broke loose, striking his side and back. He suffered a fractured rib and a punctured lung.
An employee had finished checking on an alarm in the master bedroom. He then walked down stairs, missed the bottom step and fell to the ground, suffering a head contusion.

An employee was adjusting racking when the employee's right index finger was crushed between an upright and a horizontal beam, resulting in a partial traumatic amputation of the right index finger through the phalanx.
An employee was cleaning excess dough from a dough machine's rollers. The employee's hand was caught between the feed roller and the roller die, causing a fingertip amputation.
On January 3, 2020, a press room operator developed blisters and a rash after washing their hands with a cleaner over an extended period. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to deliver a package when two dogs charged at the employee after the homeowner opened the door. One of the dogs bit the employee's left ankle, injuring the Achilles tendon. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was working at a residential home. While ascending a ladder outside, the employee fell around 9 feet to the ground, requiring hospitalization for a possible rib injury and a collapsed lung.
An employee was closing a kitchen drawer. The drawer caught her left index finger.
An employee was unloading a small aircraft when the employee lost balance and fell 4 feet, requiring hospitalization for possible hand, wrist, and spinal fractures.

A window washer was on the roof of a building, preparing to start washing windows. When he attempted to plug a rig into an outlet, he received an electrical shock, afterward suffering numbness to an arm and a headache.

An employee had finished cutting a round metal ingot with a saw. The employee went to move the scrap piece and it fell/sank down into a bed of mechanical rollers. The mechanical rollers are normally used to remove the scrap piece out of the way so the piece can be lifted by a crane. The employee then attempted to manually move the scrap piece by pulling it off of the mechanical rolls. The piece was too heavy and rolled backwards towards the ingot. The employee's left middle finger became trapped/pinched between the ingot and scrap piece, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was preparing to cut fabric with an electric cutter. The cutter amputated the pad of his left middle finger.
On January 3, 2020, an employee was attempting to unjam a de-palletizer machine when the machine amputated the employee's left middle finger at the first knuckle.

An employee performed a roof security check and then started descending a ladder from the roof. The employee was attempting to step down while approximately 4 feet off the ground when the employee lost balance. The employee then jumped down and landed on their feet, fracturing both tibias and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was guiding a bundle of box channels/tube columns toward the ground. His left hand was on the bundle when it shifted, causing his left hand to become pinched between two pieces of steel. His left hand was lacerated.
An employee was working underneath a vehicle on a lift to remove a suspension bolt when he lost his footing and fell to the floor, fracturing his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.

On January 3, 2020, employees were hanging connections when the injured employee's right middle finger was smashed between two iron bar joists after the load came down. The employee's right middle fingertip was medically amputated.

On January 3, 2020, a press operator was using the press machine on the draft gear line and a welder was observing the press operator insert pins into a draft gear. The pins were not correctly inserted into the draft gear and the welder attempted to insert the pins properly. The press machine cycled, pressing down on the draft gear, and the welder's hands were pinched between the pins and conveyor guide rail, resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip and a laceration to the right pinky finger.

An employee was reattaching a customer's tire to the rim using a tire mounting machine. His right little finger was caught between the rim and the machine, and the fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was unloading a grocery truck. He fell from a platform lift to the concrete floor about 4 feet below, suffering a broken right arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using stilts to hang drywall when he fell to the ground, fracturing his right knee and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a planer when it became jammed. He was attempting to unjam the equipment when his right hand made contact with the top of the planer head, amputating his fingers and mangling his hand. The planer was running at the time of the incident.

A maintenance employee was attempting to tighten a friction belt with an Allen wrench on a wrapper machine when the employee's hand was caught in the friction belt, resulting in lacerations to the right index and ring fingers.

On Friday, January 3, 2020, at approximately 10:50 AM, an employee was troubleshooting an injection molding machine. With the machine locked out, the employee reached into the molding area of the machine and manually pressed against the mold-closing mechanism. The mechanism closed and caught his right pinky finger, resulting in a first digit amputation.
An employee fell from a 6-foot ladder, suffering three broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee working in the dishwashing area of the kitchen tripped or slipped and fell striking her left knee on the concrete floor. The kneecap was fractured and the employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was hospitalized for an injured thumb.
An employee was stocking freight on shelves from a ladder when the employee slipped and fell off the ladder, suffering a broken hip and cuts to the arm.
An employee was on a ladder installing cable when he fell off the ladder and fractured his skull.
An employee was attempting to remove trash bags from the top of a truck. The employee fell from the top of the truck to the ground, suffering a broken right foot.

On January 3, 2020, an employee was working on the singlefacer to troubleshoot a quality issue with the machine. A singlefacer is an enclosed machine that forms a corrugated shape in a sheet of kraft paper and bonds it to a sheet of flat linerboard using a starch-based adhesive. While removing bolts from the steam chest, the chest unexpectedly dropped and released hot water onto the employee's chest, arms, and legs. The employee was hospitalized for burns.
Two employees were burned while they were cleaning out a tank when a spontaneous combustion occurred.
An employee was greasing a fillet machine when the employee's right index finger was caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was training another employee, watching the second employee conduct a pump swap. The expansion joint fitting failed during the swap and caustic lime solution sprayed about 10-15 feet, hitting the injured employee. The employee suffered chemical burns to the leg, torso, and left eye and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a shred cooker lid. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between a spud wrench and a railing; the fingertip was amputated with no fracture or bone loss.

An employee climbed up stairs to a tank gauging platform, accessed the tank to be gauged, cracked the gauging hatch to let it vapor off while standing upwind, and gauged the tank twice. During the third gauging effort, the employee was exposed to hydrogen sulfide (H2S). He was hospitalized for upper respiratory tract irritation, dizziness and disorientation.
An employee slipped while descending stairs on a drill rig, falling and breaking his ankle.
An employee was on a ladder getting boxes down from shelves when the employee fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering an ankle injury.

While stocking products in an aisle, an employee was descending a rolling ladder carrying a box when she missed the second step from the bottom and fell forward, catching her right foot on the bottom step and then impacting the floor. She was hospitalized and required surgery for a right lower leg/ankle fracture.
An employee was adjusting a film roller in a vacuum forming machine. The employee was pulled into the machine, and all four fingers and part of the thumb on the employee's left hand were amputated.
An employee was walking behind another employee who was pulling a pallet jack when he tripped on the pallet jack and fell on the concrete floor, fracturing his hip.

An employee was helping to move a piece of equipment out of the plant with a team of people. While moving the object that was controlled by other employees, the employee was positioned between the edge of the dock and the machine. He dismounted from the dock to reposition himself. When his feet struck the ground, he broke both heel bones.
An employee was reorganizing a shed when a grill slipped and fell on his right foot, breaking the first and second toes.

On, January 6, 2020, an employee was unloading a steel delivery of 15' 9'' long "I" beams. After the steel was taken off the truck by a forklift, it was set down on two A-frames and rolled to a storage location by two employees. There was one employee on each A-frame. The steel on the A-frames was on uneven ground near a curb and sewer drain while the employees waited for help to remove it from the A-frames and place it on the ground. While waiting, one employee walked in between the A-frame and sewer grate, which is slightly pitched for drainage, placing one foot on the curb and the other on the grating with his back to the steel beam. The A-frame slowly started moving down toward the grating. Once the front wheel of the A-frame hit the grating, it tipped over, causing the steel beam to roll toward the ground and land on the employee's leg, knocking him to the ground. He suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while walking to punch out, suffering a fractured hip.

An employee was concrete form stakes with a circular saw. The sawblade hit a piece of the sawhorse table, causing the saw to jump back and cut the employee's left middle finger (including tendons and bone). The finger was amputated to the first knuckle; the employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee fell to a laboratory floor while trying to sit down on a wheeled chair. The employee suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was performing a preventive maintenance check on a machine when the employee's right index finger was caught in a running chain, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was walking to his work station when he tripped on a pipe assembly and fell to the ground, suffering a spinal compression injury.
An employee was attacked by a dog during a home health visit, suffering lacerations to the face, arm, and leg.

An employee was adjusting the orientation of a 300-pound cast metal part while it was on the floor in a sling. The part shifted and pinched the employee's left middle and ring fingers against the sling, causing the amputation of the middle fingertip and an avulsion on the ring finger.
An employee was driving a car when he was involved in a car accident, resulting in a leg amputation.
While walking to his car, an employee tripped going down stairs and fell to the ground, breaking his neck.

On January 6, 2020, an employee was adjusting the weights on a mechanical press when the employee's left thumb was pinched between the wheel for the weights and the table on the press.  The employee suffered a traumatic amputation of the left thumb and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing meat from a meat tenderizer. His gloved left hand was caught by the machine and carried through its teeth, where it was crushed and lacerated. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting an engine attached to a pallet out of a flatbed truck using a hydraulic hoist when the chains connected to the pallet and engine slipped, allowing the engine and pallet to roll toward the employee. The pallet with the engine struck him, tearing open his left arm and pushing his left knee sideways, causing tendon damage. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was walking from the rear of his truck to the cab when he slipped and fell to the ground on his knees, dislocating his quad muscle.
An employee was using a hand tool to work on a Velcro strip for his truck when the tool punctured his right index finger and he fainted. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was dumping an 8-yard rear-load container. A piece of furniture was caught between the scraper blade and the hopper seal. When the blade came down, it kicked the container off the truck and into the employee, who suffered bruising to the kidney, spleen, and liver, as well as possible fractures to ribs and/or vertebrae.
An employee was loosening a cargo strap when the tightening mechanism struck his right index finger. The finger was crushed and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was changing a power cable for an electromagnetic crane when he was struck by the crane's H-link, fracturing his right arm.
An employee was dismantling a scaffold. The employee fell through a floor opening to the concrete 14 feet below, suffering injuries to the brain and ribs.
An employee was backing up an electric pallet jack. The employee's left elbow was caught between the pallet jack's handle and a rolling stairs stand, causing trauma to the forearm.
An employee was performing chicken leg deboning when his knife slipped out of his hand and stabbed his abdomen, lacerating it.

An employee was aligning a board as it traveled along a roll case conveyor when the board pushed his right hand against the side of the conveyor angle iron, resulting in lacerations and a fracture to the right index finger knuckle.
An employee was cutting banding around a steel pipe when the pipe rolled off the rack and struck the employee's right leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula.
An employee tripped on a hallway rug, falling to the floor and suffering a broken left leg.
An employee was laying decking when he lost his footing and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below, breaking his left wrist.
An employee was repairing a transport platform and removing an exit gate from the platform when a spring struck and fractured the employee's right thumb.

An employee was installing a steel beam and using a dolly to support and move the beam. The dolly was approximately 5 feet off the ground when the beam fell off the dolly and landed on the employee's right foot, breaking three toes.
An employee tripped and fell requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading rolls of paper into a machine and crushed their right thumb, index finger, and middle finger in the machine.

An employee was working on a utility line installing new equipment. The employee was attempting to change the battery on an impact gun when the employee's left hand contacted the tail of the conductor, causing electrical burns to the hand. Gloves were not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was clearing jammed boards on a conveyor. The conveyor chain caught the employee's hands, causing the amputation of four fingers on the left hand and two on the right hand.
An employee was using a compound miter saw to cut a piece of pine when the saw blade contacted his left hand, resulting in an amputation to the thumb and index finger.

An employee was performing maintenance checks on the tail rotor of a helicopter. While on the ladder doing visual inspections, the employee fell 6 to 8 feet, landing on the ground. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a fractured pelvis, and a fractured left arm.
An employee was adjusting a pallet on a forklift's forks. The employee's right index finger was crushed between the forks and the pallet, causing its amputation.
While spotting a crane, an employee tripped on laminate timber mats and fell to the ground, suffering face, head, neck, and back injuries.
An employee was struck on the lower leg by an ingot that fell from a crane. The employee's right lower leg was fractured.

An employee used a sit-down forklift truck to load a 4 ft. x 4 ft. x 4 ft. tote filled with scrap onto a flatbed truck. The flatbed truck was backed up to the dock and was slightly lower than the dock. As the forklift was being driven down the dock plate, the flatbed truck rolled forward about 7 or 8 feet. The forklift fell and hit the ground in the upright position. The employee jumped out the left side of the forklift, landed on his left side, and rolled onto his back side, suffering multiple injuries, including a fractured left hip, shoulder injuries, a left elbow injury, and a head injury.

At 3:54 a.m. on January 7, 2020, an employee was preparing to clean an auger that fed the mixers on a production line. His left hand came into contact with an adjacent, moving auger, which amputated about 1/2 inch of his left thumb. He was hospitalized.

An employee was descending a short ladder underneath a conveyor when he lost his balance and his right hand entered the in-running nip point of the conveyor, resulting in amputations to part of the first and second fingers.
An employee was stacking bread on a conveyor when the employee's left hand made contact with an unguarded chain on the conveyor, resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring and middle fingers.
Employee was walking from her car to the building when she slipped on ice in the parking lot and impacted the ground, breaking her hip.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, striking her head.

An employee was descending a 4-foot ladder when he fell to the ground and his legs became twisted in the bottom two rungs. He suffered a fracture to the right ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was on a 10-foot step ladder drilling into concrete with a hammer drill when the employee fell from the eighth rung to the ground below, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was reaching for a broken piece of lumber that was hung up on a board edger's infeed chains. His right hand was caught between two cants (or a cant and part of the machinery); the hand was lacerated and the index, middle, ring, and little fingers were broken.
After pulling a 36-pound skid into place and then repeatedly moving 14-pound boxes, an employee suffered a muscle tear in the lower right abdomen. She was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a brake part on a refurbished rail car. The employee fell from a 4-foot ladder to the cement floor, suffering head injuries and losing consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a cart with 140-pound equipment down a wet ramp when she slipped and fell. The cart then struck her ankle and dislocated it.

Two employees were performing a pre-trip inspection on a dump truck. While one employee was checking the fan belt, the second employee started the engine. The first employee's hand made contact with the moving pulley and fan belt, amputating the left index and middle fingers.

An employee was part of a crew clearing land and moving a downed tree when a branch on a felled tree broke and snapped back, striking the employee. The employee suffered severe back and knee injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a new rail and bracing himself on a railcar when the suspended rail struck his left middle finger, resulting in an amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee in a kitchen prep line suffered a laceration to the forehead when another employee stabbed him with a kitchen knife.
An employee was clearing a piece of wood from the infeed of a dryer. A sprocket caught his jacket, and the chain and sprocket abraded and burned the bottom and underside of his right upper arm.
An employee fell through a roof while installing decking and was hospitalized for a fractured skull and pelvis, a brain bleed and a laceration to the right elbow.

An employee was unloading rolls of insulation from the back of a flatbed trailer when a roll struck the employee, causing him to fall off the truck to the ground. He suffered broken ribs, a broken back, and a potential brain bleed.
While holding a door open and trying to push a cart through, an employee suffered a hernia.
An employee was pumping concrete when the employee's hand entered the concrete pump and sustained an injury.

An employee was on a fixed ladder in an elevator pit performing elevator testing and maintenance when the employee slipped on the third rung and fell 3 feet. The employee was hospitalized with a knee injury and fractured tibia.

An employee was painting on a ladder in a stairwell. The employee reached to paint a pipe and the ladder gave way. The employee fell approximately 5 feet and struck the stair railing on the way down, sustaining a fractured wrist and cuts to the front and back of the head.

An employee was removing the safety strut on a dock leveler when the clamp on the crane slipped, allowing the dock leveler to fall on the employee and drive him to the ground. He cut his ear and broke his leg.

An employee was assembling a wood crate using a pneumatic staple gun when the staple gun's safety mechanism pressed against the employee's thumb while he simultaneously depressed the trigger. The staple released into his thumb and he required hospitalization.

An employee was resetting film on a laminator after a breakout. The employee's gloves were caught in the bottom roller; the roller pulled in his hands, causing contusions to both hands and his right arm.
An employee suffered a head injury while skiing.
An employee was lifting a part with an overhead crane when the part dislodged from the rigging system and moved toward the employee and fractured the employee's hip. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 07, 2020, an employee was removing the metal sheeting of a 1:12 pitched roof while using his personal fall protection. He was anchored to the peak of the roof when he stepped back while pulling a metal sheet and fell head first through a skylight about 16 feet to the concrete floor below. He suffered head trauma and was hospitalized.
An employee came off a ladder and then fell down the steps, breaking a shoulder and wrist.
An employee was installing an adapter plate into a mill stand when the employee's left middle finger was caught between the base of the stand and the 400-pound adapter plate, breaking his finger.
An employee was pulling product and placing it on a pallet, which rested on an electric pallet jack. The employee's leg was pinned between two pallet jacks, and the employee's tibia was broken.

An employee was low-voltage wiring HVAC equipment located under a raised floor. While attempting to de-energize the equipment, the employee's hand touched a live hot leg, receiving an electrical shock and burns to the left-hand fingertips. The employee was hospitalized.

At about 2:15 a.m. on January 8, 2020, an employee was wiping down a coil of titanium with a rag before it went into a machine. The rag got caught and the employee's finger was pulled into the machine and partially amputated.

An employee was cleaning a stove and then went to the sink to rinse the cloth in a resident's home. The employee turned to return to the stove and her foot became caught on something on the floor. The employee fell on her right side to the level floor and sustained a broken lateral rib on her right side.

A part jammed in the track of the thread roller on a piece of machining equipment. An employee removed the access cap to get the jammed part. Once the part was removed, the load shuttle moved horizontally and contacted the employee's right middle and index fingers. The middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was changing into her work uniform in a locker room when she had a suspected allergic reaction to peanuts.
An employee tripped while stepping off a 12-inch-high workstation and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.

On January 8, 2020, at approximately 3:15 a.m., an employee was setting up a print press when the employee attempted to clean the print rollers. The employee's glove was pulled into the machine's rollers, crushing the employee's right hand. The employee sustained four broken fingers and the amputation of the pointer, middle, and index fingertips. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee suffered breathing problems and a burn to the lungs while extinguishing a fire. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 08, 2019, an employee was operating a beading machine that seals metal tubes for HVAC ducting parts when his glove was pulled into the beading section of the machine (wheels that bead the metal), resulting in the amputation of his left middle and ring fingers from the first knuckle.
An employee fell while exiting a truck, landing on the ground about 1 to 1 1/2 feet below and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was removing a straw from a wrapper machine. The machine partially amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was exiting her vehicle when she slipped on ice and injured her tibia and fibula.
While removing objects from their car at a client's home, a home health care employee was stabbed in the stomach with a knife.
