An employee was climbing a ladder that was approximately 27 feet high to the second roof of a commercial building when the employee slipped at the top of the ladder and fell from the second roof to the top of the first roof. The employee broke both ankles, the left tibia, and a heel.
An employee was clearing a sponge that had become stuck in a pneumatic bench-mounted launcher. The employee's hand got entangled in the machine's piston, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell while walking on a wet pool deck to enter a locker room.
An employee was walking through a swing gate when it hit her from behind, causing her to fall forward and break her right hip.

After repairing a roof HVAC unit, an employee was descending a ladder when it became displaced. The employee then fell 15 feet to the blacktop driveway below, suffering a broken left wrist, fractured left elbow, two fractured left ribs, a compound fracture of the back, a lacerated kidney, and a fractured pelvis.
An employee suffered from dizziness, head pressure, fatigue, soreness, and chest pains while conducting abrasive blasting operations.
An employee was walking to a curb when she fell at a hole in the concrete sidewalk. She landed on the sidewalk and suffered a broken right arm. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was shot in the leg while delivering pizza to a residence.
An employee was working on a lathe, which caught and broke the employee's thumb.

An employee was trying to remove debris from a gang saw. He bent over and the wood became dislodged, hitting his face. He suffered a facial laceration requiring stitches, a concussion, and a nasal bone fracture.
An employee was conducting a pipe laydown operation. An elevator struck a mast, kicking the pipe out so that it struck the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck in the head by a boom from a buggy during trenching operations for pipeline construction.
An employee was working on a flatbed truck while tying merchandise when he fell approximately 4 feet from the truck to the ground, suffering head trauma.
An employee was de-burring a part in the lathe while it was rotating using a sand paper strip. The employee was pulled into the lathe, suffering a fractured right arm and lacerated right thumb.
An employee was driving a truck when it caught fire. After pulling it over and using a fire extinguisher, she suffered from smoke inhalation and was hospitalized.

An employee was helping to connect a container dumpster to a roll-off truck when another employee engaged the hook lift system of the truck. The employee's left foot was then caught between the metal hoist rails of the truck, causing deep lacerations to the left foot and the first and second toes.

Two employees were repositioning an extrusion press's tail stretcher. The head stretcher was moved closer to the tail stretcher while one employee's right hand was on the material flow table. His little finger was pinched between the metal and the table, suffering an amputation.
An employee was descending a ladder, slipped and fell approximately 10 feet off the ladder. The employee suffered a broken wrist.
An employee was removing a jammed box from a conveyor. His finger was caught and crushed between a roller and the box.
An employee was performing housekeeping duties when she was exposed to the smell of perfume, causing her to experience shortness of breath and an asthma attack. She was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a laser machine onto a cart when wind blew fibers off the machine/cart. The employee pressed the brake on the cart, retrieved the fibers, and took them inside the building. When the employee returned for the cart, it was rolling toward cars in the parking lot. The employee chased the cart and ran into a concrete barrier and fell, suffering a fractured right hip and right elbow injury.
An employee fell while walking across loose dirt. He suffered a broken right elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee came into contact with live electrical cable, suffering burns to both hands.
On January 9, 2020, an employee was putting a product in a bandsaw when the bandsaw's clamp pinched the employee's left middle finger against the product. The fingertip was amputated.

On January 9, 2020, an industrial mechanic was replacing suction cups on an end-of-arm tool for a robotic depalletizing machine in a distribution plant. The employee was on an elevated depalletizing table between the depalletizing machine and a conveyor. A mechanical bar (used to push palletized merchandise from the depalletizing table onto the adjacent conveyor) struck the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized, requiring stitches and then surgery. The area was guarded with light curtains at the time of the incident.
An employee was disposing of psyllium dietary fiber by mixing it with cat litter. The employee began to have difficulty breathing after inhaling the psyllium dust.
An employee stepped into an aisleway and was struck by the tine of a forklift. The employee suffered a laceration and fracture to the left foot.
An employee was caught between a truck and a trailer, suffering a pelvis injury. The employee was hospitalized.

A pipe lining crew was using a hot water system to inflate a liner inside a pipe. Hot water and 6.5 pounds of pressure were added to invert the tubes inside the pipes. An employee was standing next to the tube when it burst at the seam, spraying hot water on the employee and causing second- and third-degree burns to the right side of his body. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a tire changing machine. The employee aired up the tire and the bead did not seat properly. The pressurized tire and rim then flew from the machine and struck his face, causing facial trauma.
An employee was holding a blast hose in his left hand and reaching to turn off the compressor with his right when he became tangled in the hose and blasted his right arm.
An employee was conducting a security check, slipped on ice, and fell to the ground injuring the right ankle.

A temporary employee lifted a load of totes with a forklift. As the forklift was turning, the load became unstable, fell, and knocked them employee down onto the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee reached into the running engine of a bus and severed the tip of his finger.
An employee fell while walking and struck her head on the wall.
An employee delivered a package and was returning to the delivery vehicle when the employee slipped on ice in the customer's driveway and fell breaking a knee.
An employee fell while skiing, suffering a broken left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
As an employee shut the tool cabinet door, his left ring finger was caught between the door and the frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was working in a warehouse and was using a motorized double jack. A nearby powered industrial truck (PIT) was lifting a pallet of boxes that contained frozen meat and weighed 60 pounds each. The PIT struck a cross-member of a storage rack. The load then shifted and the PIT overturned. The boxes fell off the pallet and struck the injured employee breaking his right tibia.

An employee was laying steel columns out for future placement with another employee and a crane. When the crane lifted the column, the material started rotating. The injured employee placed his hand on the column to stabilize it and his right ring finger was pinched between the shackle and the column, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was exiting a room and caught their left pinky finger between the door and the door jamb resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was unloading a semi-trailer, slipped from the edge and fell to the ground breaking their humerus.
An employee was operating forklift. It hit a ramp, causing his left leg to fall out and hit a trailer. He suffered a laceration and a broken bone in his left foot.

An employee was working at the laydown yard moving windmill components. As the employee was stepping from atop one windmill machine head to another adjacent windmill machine head, she slipped and fell 15 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a compression fracture of the L1 vertebra, a broken pelvis and a broken right ankle.
An employee was stacking cut pieces of wood coming off a conveyor. As the employee was aligning a piece, another one became airborne and struck the employee on the right side of the head.

An employee was replacing a fan while on a 4-foot step ladder that was placed on an elevated platform. The employee fell approximately 8 feet and landed on a slanted plastic surface. The employee sustained two broken ribs in the upper back.
An employee was guiding a hoisted bundle of decking. The decking swung and pinned the employee's left hand against a structural steel frame. His index finger was amputated.
A driver was making a delivery. While walking to the customer's door, he tripped and fell hitting his head on a parked van. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae in his neck.
An employee slipped in an icy, snow-covered parking lot. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken left femur.
An employee was cutting tortillas using a kitchen knife and amputated a fingertip and nail.

The injured employee parked the vacuum truck on the SW end of the pulling unit. Another employee used the winch line on the pulling unit to grab a pipe. He wrapped the winch line around the vacuum truck's bumper tow pin and back up around the pipe to just below half-way up the pipe. The pipe began to bow in the middle. The pipe gave way and hit the injured employee on the left side, stomach, and back knocking the employee to the ground.

An employee opened the grinder for inspection and cleaning. He stepped up on some angles on the front of the grinder, held onto the machinery with one hand, and rotated the grinder blade with the other hand. As he was manually rotating the blades in reverse, his left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting sweet potatoes with a knife. The knife partially amputated the tip of his thumb.

An employee was straightening up after reaching under his desk to get something out of his backpack. When the employee came back up he hit the top of his head on a security control panel. He suffered a cut on the head and was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming the flash off a part when another part touched his shirt and set it on fire. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns on the back and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a router when his left hand was caught in the machine, amputating his two middle fingers.
An employee fell and struck a boiler.
A refuse driver was returning a garbage tote, slipped on a curb and fell fracturing the left hip.

An employee was applying plastic stretch film to a roll of carpet using a trolley-mounted stretch film head. The film tore and retracted back into the head of the film machine, wrapping around some small middle tension rollers. The employee was removing the film from the rollers with scissors when the machine activated and fed more film. His gloved left hand was caught between the small rollers and the lid of the stretch wrap machine, causing friction burns to the back of the hand, the little finger, and the middle finger.
An employee fell while moving from a roof to a ladder, landing on the ground about 20 feet below. The employee suffered a broken right leg and foot and a separation of the right shoulder.

An employee was attempting to break loose rail wheels from icy conditions so they could be unloaded. When the rail wheel broke free, it rolled forward and crushed the employee's right leg against a piece of machinery, causing bruising.

An employee was picking up a piece of scrap iron to place it in the recycle hopper when he lost his balance and fell onto the hopper. When he landed, his finger was caught between the hopper and the scrap iron resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was watching foam blocks travel down a conveyor. A piece of plastic that was on one of the blocks got wrapped around one of the conveyer's rollers. The conveyor stopped and the employee tried to remove the piece of plastic; the conveyor started again and the employee's hand was entangled in the plastic and pulled into the roller. The employee suffered a dislocated left shoulder and elbow.
An employee was stung by an insect while working aboard a ship in the shipyard constructing platforms, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was trying to extract a pipe liner out of a pipe, holding and positioning a bar inside the pipe (through an opening on the pipe) while another employee used a press to press the liner out. The first employee's wrist was crushed between the liner and the pipe.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when his right middle finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a soft tissue amputation to the finger.
An employee was clearing sugar buildup within the sugar hopper when his left hand contacted the rotary valve resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.

An employee was preparing the dock plate for a forklift to unload a shipment of rolls inside a shipping container. The rolls of fabric inside the container shifted and rolled onto the employee breaking a leg(s).
An employee tripped on a 2-by-4 on a lowboy trailer and fell about 2 feet to the ground, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was lowering a pickup truck's tail gate when his right ring finger was caught between a cable and the tailgate's upper rail. The fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was cleaning out the powder feed area of a starve feeder. He was clearing some clogged powder near an auger when the auger caught and severely lacerated his right index and middle fingers.

An employee had just climbed off a transfer truck (yard mule) and was walking towards the facility when a forklift struck the employee from behind. The employee suffered a fractured left ankle and lacerations to both knees.
An employee fell through an attic ceiling, suffering broken ribs.

An employee was standing on the ground, operating the control panel to a grain bin's slide gate. The gate came out of the slide and fell 60 feet, striking the employee in the head. He was hospitalized.

At about 10:20 a.m. on January 10, 2020, an employee was using a traveling crane to lift concrete product. The crane's lifting bar cable broke and struck the employee, breaking his collarbone. He was hospitalized.
On January 10, 2020, an employee was struck by a falling skid of stringers after a forklift had struck the skid and caused it to fall. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured lower left leg.

An employee was helping the operator remove an auger bit from a drilling rig. During the removal, his left hand was crushed between the head of the auger bit and outer kelly resulting in amputation of the pinky finger.

An employee was pulling blank sheets of metal off a burn table using a crane. The employee was shaking the metal to loosen the blanks from it when a sheet fell onto the employee's left little finger, pinching it against a slat. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was standing next to a dump truck, dumping a load. A bale of trash from a previous load rolled off a pile and pinned him against the truck. He suffered a punctured lung, two broken ribs on the left side, and a broken collarbone.
A roofer fell off a roof to the ground, suffering fractures to both arms and the right femur.

On January 20, 2020, an employee was working with a 3-4-foot pipe wrench when the employee slipped and fell to the floor striking his head on the pipe wrench. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture and a laceration.
An employee was working on equipment when it fell and struck his foot causing a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on 480 volt equipment when an arc flash occurred, burning the employee.

An employee was picking up a steel beam with two gantry cranes. As the employee was moving the beam towards himself, he tripped over the wheel of the crane and fractured his foot, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was accidentally shot by a customer's concealed hand gun. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring a safe with a hand truck. While tilting the hand truck backwards, the safe door opened and fell backwards causing her left middle finger to be caught between the door and side of the safe. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was removing dough from the extruder cutter head section of a dough-cutting machine. The cutter amputated the tip of his right ring finger.
An employee felt ill after a fatality occurred in the workplace, requiring hospitalization for a possible heart problem.
An employee was walking from an excavator to a pickup truck when he slipped on ice and suffered broken leg.
At about 5:50 a.m. on January 12, 2020, an employee was loading a delivery van when he fell off the loading dock to the ground 3 feet below. He suffered head injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a battery charging machine. His arm was pinched by a lever and suffered muscle and tendon damage. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a bag cart down a ramp. Her left leg was caught between the bag cart and a wall. The leg was broken and she was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was attempting to reposition a ride-along pallet jack between steel racking units in a freezer when the pallet jack hit an upright. The employee's hand was outside the steering guard at the time and was caught between the steel upright and the frame of the pallet jack. As a result, the employee's left pinky finger was amputated.

An employee was exiting the cab of a tractor to hook up airlines from the trailer. As he put his right foot on the bottom step, his foot slipped and he fell backwards to the ground onto his left hip.  The fall resulted in a fracture to his left hip that required hospitalization.

An employee was erecting a hanging scaffold onboard a ship. While traversing across a lattice girder, the employee fell 25 feet to the concrete surface below, suffering a broken wrist, shattered left ankle, and fractured right ankle.

An employee was doing preventive maintenance on a gallon caser, cycling the cylinders to identify leaking cylinders or sticking solenoids. He noticed some buildup on the fingers of the machine and was trying to determine how much buildup was present when the fingers crushed his right index finger, removing about half his fingernail and some tissue above the bone.
An employee fell and broke his hip while helping a customer push his vehicle in a gas station area.
An employee was attempting to exit a tractor trailer by climbing over a pallet when he fell approximately 4 to 5 feet out of the trailer and onto the ground, breaking his left hip.

An employee was in the back of a flatbed truck moving portable signs when the wind caught one of the signs and caused it to strike the employee, knocking him off the truck. He then struck his head on the roadway.
An automated saw's drive shaft caught an employee's glove and pulled him into the machine. His left arm was broken.

An employee fell while turning, striking the back of his head (behind the right ear) on the stone wall as he fell to the floor. He suffered fractures to the right ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A maintenance employee climbed a ladder to access an intake on top of a grinder machine and install new equipment. He was attempting to remove a bolt with a wrench when the wrench slipped off the bolt. The momentum of his body caused him to lose his balance and fall 6 feet to the concrete surface below, fracturing his left wrist and left leg.

An employee was attempting to unclog a drain. He added a household drain cleaner to water and a chemical reaction occurred. The chemical mixture splashed onto him, causing second degree burns to his right arm and minor burns to his left arm, neck, and lip.

An employee was sweeping the floor in a smoking area when a customer ripped a door off a cabinet and threw it at her. It struck her head. While she was on the floor, the customer punched her three times in the face. She suffered a 3-inch facial cut.

An employee was operating a gantry crane. The crane raised two steel plates instead of one, and the lower plate slipped from a clamp and landed on the employee's left index finger. The finger was partially amputated at the first joint.

An employee was operating an electric forklift when the forklift slid off of the dock while making a left turn and hit the ground. The employee fractured his right arm, right-side ribs, and collarbone; suffered a bruised liver; and required staples on the right side of his head.

An employee was up on a work platform removing the cover from an oil filter housing to change out the filters on a furnace when the oil pump continued to push out the oil, which contacted the employee and landed on the hot furnace. The oil then flashed and the employee received second and third degree burns on the left arm, left side of the back, buttocks, and flank area.
An employee fell while picking up a passenger at their home.
An employee was inspecting the inside of a new tank car. He attempted to maneuver around another employee inside the tank car when he slipped and fell, suffering a femoral neck fracture.
An employee was operating an auger when the employee was pulled into the auger, suffering broken ribs and a broken right arm and wrist.
An employee lost balance while loading dishes into a dishwasher and fell to the floor, breaking a femur.
An employee slipped on snow or ice on the sidewalk, impacting the concrete and suffering five fractured ribs, three fractured vertebrae, and a punctured lung.
A forklift backed into an employee, running over his right foot and leg. The employee suffered a leg fracture.
An employee was climbing out of his truck in the rain when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his right hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was driving a forklift into a warehouse when the forklift struck the door frame. The employee's left leg was broken between the door frame and the forklift.

On January 13, 2020, the injured employee made a 3/4 cut into a 7-inch abandoned water pipe. An excavator operator extended the excavator bucket to push down onto the pipe and finish breaking it off. After the pipe broke loose, the excavator operator hooked the cut end of the pipe with one of the bucket's teeth and started to slide the pipe away from underneath the trench box. The pipe popped off the bucket's tooth and struck the injured employee in the leg.
An employee was power-washing engine parts with a high-pressure water hose. The water from the pressure wand cut through the employee's steel-toed right shoe, lacerating the foot.
An employee was trying to lift heavy metal stairs when he heard a pop on his back. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrae.

An employee was working with others on top of a derrick to drill a pipe into the ground. He placed his hands on the pipe to steady it and his fingertips were caught between the collar and elevator, resulting in middle and ring fingertip amputations.

On January 10, 2020, an employee finished drinking a bottle of sports drink and set it down empty in a maintenance shop before leaving for the weekend. The bottle was then used to hold brake cleaner. On January 3, the employee refilled the bottle with water, began drinking, and became nauseated and vomited after the first few gulps. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was receiving a data cable that was being moved through a conduit. He suffered an electrical shock causing a cardiac event and was hospitalized.

On January 13, 2020, an employee was operating a clip jig machine. The employee operated the lever to lower a hold-down fixture, placed clips on the part, and then operated the lever again to lower another fixture that pressed the clips into the part. The employee's right index finger was caught in the point of operation and the tip was amputated.
An employee was exiting a truck when its steering wheels ran over the employee's left foot, causing crushing injuries.
An employee was testing a tool by running it down into a pipe with a gun when the employee's right middle finger was caught between the pipe and the testing tool. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working from a telescoping ladder in an elevator shaft. The ladder collapsed and the employee fell into the elevator pit, breaking both heels.
An employee was stocking empty watch boxes onto shelves while on a rolling stool when the stool rolled out from underneath the employee. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from a wet ladder while climbing down off a roof. He was hospitalized for a possible lower back fracture.

An employee was atop a ladder when it slipped, causing him to fall 14 feet to the ground below. He suffered a left eye socket fracture and a laceration from below the left eye to the mouth area and was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a clog in a dust collector using a chop saw. The sawblade lacerated the employee's right index and middle fingers. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee fell about 10-14 feet from a trailer and suffered a dislocated left wrist, a fractured right wrist, a hairline fracture to vertebrae and the neck, and a 1-1.5 inch laceration to the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a roller machine that stamps out Kaiser rolls when his hand entered the machine's roller. His finger was caught by the chain that places the indentation in the roll, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was changing a belt on an air handling unit. Their right pinky finger was caught between the belt and a sheave, resulting in amputation below the first knuckle.

On January 14, 2020, at approximately 2:35 p.m., an employee was reversing a stand-up lift truck while moving pallets from the rail dock to racks. A clamp truck operator at the rail dock stopped to yield the right-of-way to the employee, who attempted to stop and change directions. The lift truck then slid on condensation on the dock floor and impacted the clamp truck, resulting in the clamp striking the employee's left foot. He was hospitalized with a punctured left foot.

An employee was operating a wood chipper machine when it became jammed with material. The employee's fingertip was amputated while trying to unjam it and the employee was hospitalized. The machine was not running at the time of the incident.
An employee was driving a tractor on an earthen ramp when the ramp's surface area broke away, causing the tractor to flip over. The employee suffered a back injury.

An employee was sorting boxes on the pre-sort line and attempted to make an adjustment to a box on the box line. The line was in motion and caught the employee's thumb between the box and a guardrail upright at the end of the platform. The employee sustained an amputation of the distal phalanx on the left thumb.
An employee was attempting to repair a conveyor belt when his right pinky finger was caught between the belt and the drive pulley, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was throwing garbage when he slipped or stepped on a loose brick and fell to the floor. He suffered head, shoulder, and right ankle injuries.

An employee drank liquid from a water bottle. The employee sustained chemical burns to the lips, mouth, throat, and legs and was hospitalized. A coworker had intentionally substituted the injured employee's water bottle with a water bottle containing sulfuric acid.

An employee was using a snowmobile to access a remote site when a change in the terrain caused the snowmobile to roll over onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a compound leg fracture.
An employee was walking and hit his head on a fire extinguisher wheel. He fell to the ground, struck his head on the floor, and was knocked unconscious. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down a stairway and sustained a fractured left tibia and fibula.

An employee got off a forklift to adjust the forks. An electric tugger with four dollies attached turned the corner and one of the dollies pinned the employee against the forklift. The employee was hospitalized with bruising to the buttocks.
An employee was working on the construction of a wall when the employee tripped on a clamp and fell. The impact of the fall resulted in a broken leg that required surgery.
While working from a scissor lift, and employee contacted live electrical components and was shocked, receiving electrical burns.
An employee was riding a lift gate when his right foot was caught between the lift gate and trailer, resulting in the amputation of his middle and fourth right toes.

An employee was using a jack to lift a vehicle fuel tank. The air-powered jack pinched the employee's fingers when activated, fracturing the left index and middle fingers and injuring the left index extensor tendon.
An employee was struck by a falling pallet of cat food that a forklift operator pushed off an overhead rack. The employee suffered a fractured C7 vertebra in the spine.

An employee was trying to gain access to the attic from the second floor when the employee fell approximately 10 to 12 feet to the concrete below. The employee suffered forehead trauma (bleeding on frontal lobe), facial lacerations and fractures, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was loading a 5-foot auger drill bit onto a flatbed truck. His right pinky finger was caught between the auger he was rolling and another that was already on the truck. He sustained amputation of the pinky finger below the lower knuckle.

A roof truss had stopped moving at the location where the finished trusses come out of the building and go into the finish press. An employee went into the approximately 2-foot wide gap between the wall and the finish press to push the truss into the press. The press engaged, and the truss hit the employee. The employee sustained a hair-line fracture of the pelvis, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was helping to clean up an iron spill. A 3-foot skimming rod was laid on top of the machine ladle of a casting machine. The rod had been previously dipped in the blacking liquid. The wet rod fell into the ladle, causing a reaction that ejected molten iron from the ladle. The molten iron contacted and burned the employee's left foot.
An employee was inspecting the MDO rolls for wrapper film when his hand was caught between the rotating MDO rolls.

An employee was filling a mop bucket with hot water for cleaning. 200-degree water spilled out of the bucket onto the employee, causing first- and second-degree burns to the front of the employee's body and the employee's left leg.

On January 14, 2020, an employee was clearing a blockage in the gate valve of the deaerator tank located in the boiler room. As the employee was getting the gate valve fully nested, the blockage cleared and the employee was sprayed with hot water (225 F). The employee was hospitalized with burns to the face, neck and shoulders.

An employee was vacuuming the framework around a belt conveyor when the vacuum attachment and employee's arm were pulled into the conveyor. The employee suffered fractures to the right radius and ulna.
An employee's hand entered a CCS machine, resulting in a left hand amputation.

Two employees were working to unchoke a dust collector. The injured employee suffered amputation of two fingertips when he contacted the rotating rotary valve. The valve was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was lifting a mold using an overhead wire sling when the employee's left ring finger was caught and crushed between the mold and the wire sling, resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.

An employee was moving a pumping unit into the top-dead-bottom position. He stood behind the pump jack motor and began pushing on the belt to help roll the pump unit. The unit moved and suddenly shifted. The employee then slipped and lost his balance. His left hand contacted the bottom belt and was pulled into and around the motor sheave, amputating his left pinky fingertip and lacerating and fracturing his left ring and middle fingers.

An employee was inside a mid-level ballast tank onboard an amphibious transport dock (naval vessel). He was walking across the deck and stepped onto a board that was covering an open hole. The board split and the employee fell about 15 feet to the bottom of the tank. He sustained internal bleeding, a brain hematoma, and fractured the C6 and L1 vertebrae.

An employee was on a scaffold tearing down a pool cage and knocking down a beam with a hammer when the entire sidewall gave way and knocked the employee from the scaffold onto the paved deck below. The employee subsequently fell into an empty pool, suffering a broken rib and broken jaw.

An employee was cleaning parts in a solvent tank when solvent spilled on the employee's clothing. The employee walked by a furnace and the solvent on their clothing caught on fire resulting in burns to the entire lower half of his body.

An employee was sanding a piece of metal with a disk sander when the clamps holding the piece of metal did not fully engage due to a build-up of debris. The disk sander then amputated the employee's right thumb tip with bone loss.

An employee was prepping an 8-inch by 20-foot long piece of steel to cut. The steel was being moved by a crane with a webbed piece of strap when the steel fell over and crushed the employee's finger against a table. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left index fingertip.
A truck driver was performing a delivery. While walking towards the customer's lift gate, the driver slipped and fell sustaining a fractured shoulder.
An employee was pressure washing a vent hood on the roof of a building. He was standing on the parapet wall when he fell off the roof to the ground. He was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out of his smock and tripped, falling to the floor and fracturing a hip.

While participating in a unit-level training exercise, an employee was acting as a gate guard. During the exercise, a role player approached the entry control point driving a black vehicle. The employee was attempting to take the role player into custody when a small struggle occurred and the employee fell to the ground. The employee's lower body contacted the role player's knee, causing blunt force trauma and a blood clot to the lower body that required hospitalization.

While standing on a step ladder an employee was washing out a cattle trailer using a water hose. The employee slipped and fell off the ladder, landing on concrete. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a fractured right shoulder.
An employee was run over by a machine while cutting a lawn, suffering a broken clavicle and tibia.

The injured employee was cutting down a tree while another employee was operating heavy machinery to help pull the tree down. The tree fell and struck the injured employee in the head causing a laceration to the head and injury to the neck and chest.

An employee had been using a pry bar to remove a sign (weighing 150 lbs.) from an endcap. The employee was holding the structure when the sign came loose and fell, striking and amputating their right thumb.
An employee was getting laundry out of a dryer at a client's home. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip ball socket.
An employee was operating an overhead crane to lift a forklift battery for cleaning when his left middle finger was caught in the crane clamp, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee climbed up a ladder to pull product from a back room when she lost her balance and fell from the ladder to the floor, suffering a compound fracture to her left lower leg.

An employee was working at a machine when hydraulic oil started spraying out from a cracked fitting. The spray contacted the hot end of a part, which ignited the oil. The employee suffered a second-degree burn on his forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee was in the back of a truck taking load bars down when he slipped and fell onto the truck trailer floor, fracturing his left hip.
At about 3:30 a.m. on January 15, 2020, an employee was scanning a barcode on a truck. When the scissor lift was lowered, the employee's left foot was caught under it. The big toe was amputated.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press when their finger went between the dies, resulting in an amputation to the left index fingertip.
An employee was lifting a die plate with a hoist. The employee's finger was caught between the hoist hook and the die plate eyebolt, and the fingertip was amputated.

On January 15, 2020, an employee was working at a welding machine and holding the tarp as it came out of the machine. As the machine began to cut the tarp, the employee attempted to cut the corner of the tarp with scissors. The machine's blade then contacted his finger, resulting in a partial amputation of the left fifth digit.

An employee was clearing a jam on a vacuum packaging line. While threading film through the machine, her left hand was pulled into the machine. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingertips were amputated.

On January 15, 2020, an employee was using a pendent-controlled crane to lower a part onto a prep table when the employee's left ring finger was pinched between the part and the prep table, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was entering a locker room when she was hit by the door as another employee was exiting the locker room. She suffered a contusion to her face near the right eye.
An employee was checking the tension on a canter trash chain when the employee came into contact with the moving chain, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was repairing a sensor on a conveyor line when the employee's finger was caught between a moving chain and sprocket drive, resulting in a middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a hammer and chisel to remove some floor tiling when a piece of tile went under the employee's safety glasses and into the eye, lacerating it and requiring surgery.

An employee was pulling a parts basket that weighed between 500 and 3,000 pounds when the employee's left pinky finger was caught between the basket and a rack, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on ice while walking outside and suffered a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was cleaning lights while standing on a stainless steel surgery table/bed. The wheels on the bed moved, and the employee fell to the floor sustaining a broken left leg.
An employee was helping to fold up a long table attached to a wall when the table fell onto her pelvis, fracturing it.

An employee was making a wooden crate with a pneumatic nail gun when the employee slipped with the nail gun in hand. The trigger release was hit and the nail gun went off, shooting a nail into the employee's left foot.

While an employee was repairing a water condensate motor and pump, the grating covering an adjacent u-drain dislodged. This caused the employee's right leg to drop into hot water condensate resulting in a thermal burn to the lower right leg.
An employee was installing a skillet blind when the employee's left index finger was caught between a wrench and a bolt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On January 15, 2020, an employee was walking toward a wire carrier that was about to finish uncoiling when the wire carrier became jammed and fell onto the employee's ankle, breaking it.
An employee was working in the chipper location when their leg was caught in part of the chipper. The employee sustained a leg amputation.
An employee was on a roof setting up a personal fall arrest system when the roof gave way and the employee fell 25 feet to a platform below, suffering a broken wrist.

On January 15, 2020, an employee was sitting on a rub rail at a dock. At the same time, a truck driver was backing a truck trailer into the dock. The employee was struck and caught between the truck and trailer, requiring hospitalization for fractured ribs and a lacerated kidney.
While working on a small scaffold, an employee fell between the scaffold planks. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractured ribs.
An employee hit a concrete wall while operating a standup forklift. The employee's left foot was crushed, resulting in a foot amputation.
An employee suffered a ruptured gluteal artery while providing physical therapy at a patient's home.
An employee slipped and fell on wet concrete paving, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was opening the top steam vent on the main fractionator. The trapped hot condensate from the vent leaked out and landed on the employee's back and shoulders. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns.

An employee was hooking up a dolly as a coupling between two trailers. The dolly went over a lip in the asphalt, and the employee's left hand was pinched between its frame and the lead trailer. The ring finger was lacerated and broken.

An employee was setting up a lane closure. A Truck Mounted Attenuator (TMA) was stationed in the roadway with the crash cushion in the downward position. The arrow board was mounted on the TMA in the upward position with the arrow activated instructing the traffic to move over. The pilot vehicle with a trailer attached was approximately 102 feet in front of the TMA. The employee was between the pilot vehicle and the TMA, standing on the berm of the road with one foot on the berm and one foot on the fog line. A motorist went around the TMA and then took evasive action, came back across the lane, and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, a broken leg, and a head injury.
While an employee was weighing product, her hand was caught on the shaft of a moving transfer conveyor. The employee's hand was injured.

An employee was operating a lathe in a tool and die shop when a lanyard around his neck was caught by the lathe. He was pulled in and was struck by the handle. The employee sustained torso, lower back, and posterior head trauma resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was mixing a batch of starch. As the employee added steam to the mixer, the starch overflowed. The employee slipped on the hot starch, which burned the employee's left hand and lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee became pinned by two I-beams while performing rigging operations, injuring the left leg above the left ankle.

An employee was performing preservation work on a new construction hatch door when the 400-pound hatch door closed on the employee's left hand. The impact crushed the employee's left ring and middle fingertips and resulted in an amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee's left middle fingertip was crushed by an excavator bucket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A rural mail carrier was shot by an assailant while delivering mail and sustained head trauma.

An employee was installing water-proofing on a balcony with a 2x4 wooden railing when the railing cracked and became off place. The employee fell three stories to the ground, breaking his hands and suffering head trauma.
An employee delivering packages experienced a cardiac event.
An employee was walking when an I-beam fell on his right foot, causing lacerations that required hospitalization.

An employee was stacking and organizing materials at a tower construction site when he fell through a 3-foot-by-6-foot hole that had been covered by plywood. He landed on a lower-level floor and suffered fractures to the left femur, left foot, left arm, and pelvis.

An employee was working on a running lathe. He was attempting to advance the ring on the well to make it flush with another component. When he attempted to mark the steel with a marker, the long finger of his left hand was caught between the gap in the ring, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While attempting to realign a crate, an employee slipped and fell to the same level. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.

An employee entered the conveyor area to insert multiple extensions into profiles. The employee stepped on the framework while exiting the conveyor area and fell forward, resulting in the employee being pinned between the framework.  The employee suffered a broken ankle, a broken fibula, and a dislocated knee, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was guiding a top mold plate down to connect to a bottom mold plate when the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between the two plates.

On January 16, 2020, at 6:20 p.m., an employee stepped out of the cab of a trailer truck and onto an asphalt road when he slipped on black ice, fell on the road. He suffered a head injury and laceration, requiring hospitalization.
An employee stepped off an electric pallet jack and it cut her foot.

On January 16, 2020, at approximately 7:15 a.m., an employee was loading surfaced hardwood onto a cart when a wood splinter punctured the glove on the employee's left hand and pierced the skin between the index and middle finger. The employee was hospitalized the next day.
A driver was delivering a garbage container to a customer residence. An SUV struck the driver from behind, causing injuries that necessitated the amputation of the employee's leg.
While moving merchandise, an employee slipped on spilled liquid on a sales floor, fell, and suffered a broken kneecap.

An employee was operating an electrical pallet jack with extended forks and was making a turn at the end of the aisle when his foot was caught between the pallet jack and a bollard, smashing four of his toes.
An employee was operating a screw conveyor when his left hand entered the conveyor's auger, resulting in an amputation of approximately 3/4 of the middle finger.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when he lost control of the jack and it ran over his right foot, injuring it.

An employee was measuring a steel coil as it traveled down a roller conveyor when the employee's left index finger was pinched between the steel coil and the roller on the conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was retrieving a 17-pound stator from an overhead bin when the stator fell on his head, striking and lacerating his face.
An employee was helping to offload a container when the container contents leaked and he was sprayed with caprolactam. He was hospitalized with thermal burns from the hot chemical (over 100 degrees).
An employee tripped and fell into a conveyor, which caught and broke his right forearm.
A branch fell from a tree that was being trimmed. It struck an employee on the head; the employee suffered a skull fracture and was hospitalized.

At about 10:40 a.m. on January 16, 2020, an employee was with a crew removing boiler panels after a demolition. He was at ground level receiving the metal panels. He was holding on to a panel, trying to position it as it was being lowered. It stopped, then came down suddenly, striking and pinning down his left foot. He suffered a deep laceration on the side of the foot, as well as broken toes. He was hospitalized.
An employee was supervising the movement of two houses by line roll. He was on the ground level when he tripped on a hanging wire and impacted the concrete floor, fracturing his right femur.

An employee was trying to clear debris from a grinder machine. His left hand was holding the vacuum hose as the plastic bag was about to be sucked into the machine. As he was trying to move it, his fingers slipped through the bars and the grinder paddles amputated three fingertips.

An employee was climbing a scaffold near the captain's deck of a ship to paint the hull when the scaffold began to fall. The employee jumped 7 to 8 feet as the scaffold was falling, landing on his feet. He broke his left ankle, suffered a compound fracture to his right foot, and ruptured a lower disk.
An employee was lowering a stop sign when the employee's finger was caught in between the stop sign and the brace, resulting in an avulsion to the right pinky fingertip.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a saw when the blade amputated his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was conducting a roof inspection when he tripped on an air hose and injured his right knee extensor, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee climbed an extension ladder with a 5-gallon bucket and was traversing from the ladder onto the roof when the employee's hand slipped while reaching for an upper rung. The employee lost hold and fell 18 feet to a lower roof, suffering fractures and a punctured lung.

Two employees were delivering refrigerator up a ramp using a furniture dolly when the dolly and refrigerator tipped over, striking one employee. The employee suffered three broken vertebrae in the neck area and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing an grab bar at the home of a customer. He drilled in the wall and made contact with an electrical wire, receiving an electrical shock that required hospitalization.
An employee was on a 6-foot ladder, drilling into a metal stud to install conduit. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground about 4 feet below, suffering a broken left wrist.
An employee was cutting a pallet with a power saw. The sawblade cut the employee's leg.

An employee was installing a bait station in the attic of a residential home when the employee fell approximately 8 feet through the sheetrock to the floor below. The employee suffered a broken left ankle and required surgery.

At 2:15 p.m. on January 17, 2020, an employee was climbing down a scaffold ladder. As he moved from the ladder to the work platform, he slipped and fell about 5 feet to the lower level. He suffered a broken bone in the left leg.
An employee tripped on a pallet jack and fell to the floor, breaking an arm.

An employee was driving new vehicles from the plant to the rail station. While getting out of a van, she lost her footing and stumbled to the ground, breaking her right wrist. She was hospitalized and later had surgery on her wrist.

An employee was placing a chuck and strand into a stressing jack arm. The chuck and strand fell into the ram. The employee grabbed the chuck and tried to reposition it.  At the same time, another employee was moving the ram down and the injured employee's right little pinky and ring fingers were pinched between the chuck and stressing ram. As a result, the employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated and right ring finger was cut.
The employee was trying to repair a snow blower in an enclosed garage. He was overcome by carbon monoxide fumes from the blower, collapsed, and was hospitalized.
Three employees were attempting to fix a leaking valve on a tanker truck that contained butane when a flash fire ignited, causing burns to 90 percent of the employees' bodies.
An employee was aligning metal beams on a table by hand before pushing them into a cutting machine when his hand was wedged between two beams, resulting in a left ring finger amputation.
An employee approached a customer about a product he was leaving the store with and the customer shot the employee in the left leg. The employee experienced bleeding and a broken femur.
An employee was exiting a truck when the employee's foot slipped off the truck step. The employee fell and struck the ground, suffering fractured ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 17, 2020, at approximately 6:10 p.m., an employee who was operating a forklift came to a stop and exited his vehicle. An RF scanner on the vehicle fell onto the throttle, causing the forklift to accelerate in the employee's direction. He fell to the floor and his left leg was pinned underneath the forklift, resulting in a compound fracture to the left leg.
An employee was servicing a first stage rescuer when his hand was caught and lacerated in the channel faws.
An employee was setting up parts on a 2-ton press. The press came down and amputated the employee's left pinky and left ring finger.
An employee was walking past a lint cleaner when he slipped. His hand was caught in the lint cleaner, and four of his fingers were amputated.
An employee slipped on an icy sidewalk while walking into a building. The employee fell to the concrete, suffered a broken left ankle, and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was holding a stack of doors while another employee pulled a door out from the stack. The injured employee fell to the ground, striking his head (which sustained a 1-inch cut) and back and suffering a broken hip.

An employee was in a pipe rack area. A pipe rolled and struck him in the back of the head. It pushed his head into another pipe, which crushed his face. He suffered fractures to the jaw bone, left eye socket, and facial bones, as well as a slight skull injury.
An employee fell through the door of a gas station kiosk, landing on the concrete ground and suffering fractures to the right rib and shoulder. He was hospitalized.

On 1/17/2020, an employee was re-roofing a second-story tile roof when he fell onto the first-story roof and then rolled off onto the ground. He was hospitalized with crushed vertebrae in the lower back, requiring surgery.

A truck driver was in the back of a trailer, clearing it out after a delivery. The driver began to climb out of the trailer using a ladder leaning against it; the ladder kicked out and the employee fell to the pavement, suffering a broken hip and bruised ribs.
An employee was walking toward a stack of wood to remove a tag for material tracking. He slipped on ice and fell, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was connecting a dolly to a yard hostler truck and severed the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was standing on a step stool in the cooler to reach a product when he fell off the step stool and struck his head on a rack in the cooler. He suffered a concussion and strains and sprains to the neck and back, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was replacing chains on a forklift, whose mast was hooked and supported by an overhead 5-ton crane. When the support nuts at the bottom of the fork chains were removed, the forklift forks and backstop fell on the employee, knocking him down and pinning him to the floor. He suffered injuries to the left hand, neck, back, and collarbone and a broken left femur. During surgery, his left ring finger was amputated to the first joint.
An employee was unloading items from a top stock cart on the sales floor when she lost her balance and fell around 4 feet to the ground, fracturing the right tibia plateau.
While working in the feed yard, an employee slipped on ice and fell resulting in back pain.
An employee was operating a forklift when the employee's foot was pinned and injured between two forklifts.

An employee was stepping onto an angled piece of metal to reach/wash off the gravity table when he slipped, reached to catch himself, and his left hand contacted the drive head roll belt, resulting in lacerations to the top of his left hand and a boxer's fracture. He required surgery to repair tendon damage.

On January 17, 2020, an employee was working on a double bender. While the first bend was being made on a piece of metal, the bending pin broke and struck the employee on the right side of his face, lacerating it.
An employee was helping to move cargo when his left-hand fingers were caught in a pinch point on the load, resulting in a laceration and dislocation.
An employee was walking a patient in the ICU when the patient fainted and fell on the employee. The employee's leg was twisted, requiring surgery.

On 1/17/2020, an employee was lifting a piece of steel (shaft) with another employee when suddenly the metal fell and crushed the employee's left middle fingertip. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches.
An employee experienced a fingertip amputation while attempting too unjam a bag packer auger.
An employee was helping to roll a pipe into position when his finger was caught between pipes, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was troubleshooting a varnish pump. He removed and replaced the pump. The pump was turned on and the pump impeller amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was bending while using a hose to clean underneath a product cooker when the employee sprained/strained the lower back.

An employee was assembling warehouse storage racks/shelving when a PIT struck and knocked over three 4-foot-wide by 30-foot-long upright racks that were laying parallel to the floor in the staging area. The uprights struck the employee, who suffered a fractured hip and three fractures in his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck in the head by a pipe while servicing a compressor, requiring hospitalization for a head injury. A hard hat was not worn at the time of the incident.

An employee was moving a steel bundle with an overhead crane when the wrong button was depressed on the overhead crane controls, causing the steel load to crush him. He suffered a fractured hip or pelvis.

An employee was crossing into the kitchen area when she slipped on the floor, which had recently been mopped. She fell to the floor, hitting the back of her head and spraining her lower back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was placing frozen items into a bin containing hot water to defrost them when the hot water splashed on the employee, causing burns that required hospitalization.
An employee tripped and fell while zoning and cleaning up an area, suffering a hip fracture that required surgery.

An employee was working on the sort line when it became jammed. He had to go onto the line to remove a wire that was twisted in the conveyor. When the wire was removed, he entered an area above the chute. Once the belt was restarted, he missed a step and fell down the chute, landing on the pile of refuse below. He suffered multiple lacerations.
An employee tripped on a curb and fell to the ground while walking into work, breaking the left wrist.
An employee was walking on an icy driveway to make a propane delivery when the employee slipped on ice and fell the ground, breaking an ankle.
An employee was operating a forklift when the employee's left foot was crushed and fractured between two forklifts.
An employee was lowering a vehicle on an automotive lift when his finger was caught in the nip point of the lift's moving gear, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a standalone ice making unit in the maintenance area when he bent over the machine to move it into a better access point and heard a pop in his back. He was hospitalized with a compression fracture of the lower vertebrae.

An employee was working with a crew on a roof to remove the existing concrete tile and underlayment. He walked down to the eave of the roof with his rope to install the new underlayment. While installing the underlayment, he slipped off of the roof onto the concrete porch below, fracturing his arm and leg.
An employee was in a basket on a forklift, wrapping a new home. The basket fell off the forklift to the ground, and the employee suffered a broken femur, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was attempting to clean metal scrap out of a machine when the ram came down and smashed his right hand.
An employee was putting tools back on a tool rack in the tank farm area when the employee tripped on a drain hose and hit the ground, fracturing the left hip.
An employee was replacing a sawblade. While he was bringing the saw cylinder back to home position, the cylinder framework lacerated his head near the left eye. The machine was guarded at the time.

Employees were moving material with a crane when the plate clamps that were attached to the crane caught the flag of a steel beam. The clamps flipped off the rollers and landed on the employee's foot, causing a laceration.

Employees were working to remove a blow-out preventer (BOP) by dragging it with a tandem bed truck on the BOP skid from between two rig subs during rig-down operations. An employee was spotting the BOP skid as it was being pulled out by a tandem bed truck so it did not contact the rig sub's cylinders. He was standing on each side of the BOP skid directly beside the gas well cellar that the BOP had been removed from in order to watch the skid pass the cylinders and communicate with the bed truck operator as he pulled the skid away from the spotters. At the time, the well cellar guards had been removed from around the BOP, as is required to disconnect the BOP and lay it over on the skid. The employee stepped back into the cellar opening and fell 4 feet down onto a metal work platform and toe board, resulting in a broken collar bone, broken ribs, and a punctured lung.
An employee slipped while shoveling snow. The employee's hand broke a window and was lacerated by the glass.
An employee was helping a client unclog a dryer discharge chute when hot process water and salts spilled onto the employee, causing second degree burns to 25 percent of his body.

An employee was operating an excavator to sort scrap metals when a pipe flew off from being sheared by another excavator and pierced through his operator cab's glass. The metal pipe them struck him, causing a head concussion.
An employee suffered burns and lacerations to both hands while cutting a ground wire.
An employee was plumbing a wall when he fell from a 6-foot-4-inch scaffold, landing on the ground and suffering broken ribs and cuts on his head.

An employee was pulling a pallet jack backwards in the stock room when the employee tripped on the handle. The employee's head struck the concrete floor, causing severe head trauma that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw and amputated his right index finger.
An employee developed metal fume fever due to grinding or welding operations on a metal base, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down an unmarked, open elevator shaft, hitting the ground and sustaining a back injury that required surgery.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) to unload a trailer when a second PIT turned and the pallet being carried struck the employee, lacerating his side.

An employee was helping a customer near the fitting room. While getting a dress for the customer, the employee slipped and fell to the floor. She sustained neck injuries and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was helping an operator set up a rebar-bending machine. The employee's little finger was caught, broken, and lacerated between the rebar and a pin.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while entering a patient's home, breaking the right ankle.

On January 20, 2020, at approximately 3:45 PM, an employee was driving a golf cart around a curve when the cart started to tip. The employee put her leg out to steady the cart when it tipped to the side and her leg was caught between the cart and the ground. She suffered a right ankle fracture.

On January 20, 2020, an employee was working under a semi-truck that was on a jack. The employee was changing tires and doing an oil change when the truck slipped from the jack and crushed the employee's chest.

An employee was using a horizontal bandsaw to cut materials. As the saw was rising to the top position after completing a cut, the employee attempted to remove the drop scrap piece. The blade was still moving at the time and caught the drop scrap, which then struck and amputated the employee's left index and middle fingertips.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice while walking into work, impacting the ground and suffering a compression fracture to the spine.

While going to get salt to treat ice on a city road that runs between the building and the yard, an employee slipped and fell on ice on the street, breaking the left hip and requiring hospitalization for surgery.

On Monday, January 20, 2020, at approximately 6:45AM, an employee was exiting the cab of his truck when he stepped on an ice patch and fell, fracturing his left ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
Three employees were manually flipping a roll of coiled tubing when the tubing struck the injured employee's right thumb, resulting in a fracture and soft tissue amputation of the thumb.
An employee was stocking groceries using a 2-step stool. As she stepped down, she fell to the floor and fractured her hip.
An employee was walking in a designated aisle when the employee turned a corner and tripped on a pallet, fracturing the left patella.
While walking, an employee slipped on icy ground and fell resulting in fractures to the right fibula and tibia.
An employee tried to clean a roller with a metal tong when the employee's right hand was caught between the roller and the tong, causing an amputation to the index finger.
An employee slipped and fell on a patch of ice, resulting in a fracture to his right radius and nerve damage.

An employee was moving metal in a forming machine when an adjacent employee hit a button, causing the machine and metal to cycle in the wrong direction. The metal struck the employee's leg, causing severe leg lacerations that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press brake when his right index finger went between the metal and the bending blade. The hydraulic press brake then cycled and severed his right index finger.
An employee was closing a safe when the safe door closed on the employee's left middle finger, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was on the roof of the facility, and was accessing the penthouse roof, when he slipped on ice and fell, fracturing his right leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cutting shams on a table saw when the employee's left hand made contact with the saw blade, lacerating four fingers.

An employee was working on a wind-out and putting a calendar on the roll. While he was guiding the roll holding the bar, the roll slipped and pinched the tip of his left index finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
A temporary employee slipped and fell after coming inside out of the snow, suffering a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was replacing a converter box in a wind tower. He contacted an electrical line and suffered burns to the left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee stepped down from his truck and slipped on ice, suffering torn ligaments in his left knee.

On January 20, 2020, an employee was at a residence removing a fan unit from the sidewall while on a scissor lift. He lost his balance and fell 8 feet from the lift to the floor, hitting his head. He suffered several facial and head lacerations and a skull fracture.
An employee was running electrical wire through a panel box when an arc flash caused second degree burns to his face and wrist.
An employee was climbing out of a truck when he slipped on ice and broke his ankle.
An employee was walking when her prosthetic shifted and she fell to the ground, dislocating her hip.
An employee was cutting concrete with a saw when the saw kicked back and lacerated his right forearm.

An employee's fingers were in the eye of a hook being connected to a bucket. When the bucket was lifted, the employee suffered lacerations and ligament damage to the fingers. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On January 20, 2020, at approximately 11:45 p.m., an employee was walking on a sidewalk to reset a circuit breaker when the employee slipped and fell on ice, breaking an ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting bags in cart for a customer. She then walked backwards to her register and tripped on a rock salt display, causing her to fall. She landed on and fractured her right hip.

An employee was drilling a 2-inch hole into a piece of aluminum when the employee's shirt sleeve became caught in the drill filing and pulled the employee's arm into the drill press bench. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right forearm.

An employee was having a conversation with an excavator operator when the push blade of the excavator fell onto the employee's left foot, pinning it to the ground. He was hospitalized with injuries to his left toes.
An employee was assisting a patient when she tripped on the patient's wheelchair and fell to the ground, landing on her right side and breaking her right hip.

A maintenance crew was working on a belt attached to a chip feeder with the guarding on. After the belt was fixed, the guarding was removed, signaling that the machine was again operational. The injured employee's hand was near the machine at the time, and when it came back on, the employee's hand was injured.  A quarter of the bone in the left thumb was lost due to the injury.
An employee was operating a stand-on mower when suddenly his left index finger was crushed between the handle of the mower and a tree, cutting his fingertip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee mistakenly drank methanol that was in a soft drink bottle and sustained poisoning.

A driver was backing a trailer into a jobsite when the trailer became caught on a road sign. After the road sign was released, it sprung back and struck the injured employee in the midsection. The employee suffered three fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, and internal bleeding.
An employee was walking down the stairs when she stumbled and fell down the stairs, injuring her head and requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while exiting a postal vehicle, suffering a broken kneecap and torn muscle.

A crew was exposing a new water line looking for a leak. A trench was excavated near the pipe with a compact excavator, and an employee was exposing the pipe with a shovel.  A piece of dirt from the top of the trench fell on the back of his legs and he suffered a pelvic fracture. The trench was approximately 4.5 feet deep.
An employee missed a step while stepping down from a step stool, causing the employee to fall and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was using a 16-pound sledgehammer to set formwork for concrete along the side of the street when the hammer struck his right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking in the stockroom and tripped on a furniture skate. The employee fell to the ground and broke a leg.

An employee was putting ingredients inside a grinding machine when a bag fell inside the machine. The employee tried to grab the bag and contacted the auger inside the machine, resulting in a left hand amputation.

An employee tripped over an aircraft grounding cord while exiting a scissor lift and fell onto an apparatus near the aircraft and the floor surface. The employee was hospitalized for leg and hip injuries.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck while standing near a semi-trailer. The employee suffered a broken ankle and back pain.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while operating a stand-on mower on a median island, suffering broken bones in the leg and shoulder.

On January 21, 2020, an employee was assessing an air handler unit that needed new insulation when the employee's left hand came in contact with the belt and pulley on the unit, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The belt and pulley were not completely guarded, and the unit was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee had exited a truck to deliver produce when the truck rolled forward, pinning him between it and another truck. He suffered a broken leg. The brake was not applied at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down stairs when the employee tripped on the last step and fell to the ground, tearing tendons in the right and left knees.

Employees were processing a pipe on site. A forklift driver lowered the pipe and, believing the forks had cleared the pipe, began to turn the forks to move the pipe. When the pipe started to move, it struck a nearby employee in the left leg. The injured employee suffered leg fractures, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was using a feeding hose to remove material from a tank when a flash fire occurred within the tank and contacted the employee's face, causing second degree burns.

An employee was rinsing out chemical barrels when sanitizing chemicals mixed with phosphoric acid and produced chlorine gas. The employee inhaled the chlorine gas, suffering a chemical burn in the lungs.
On November 21, 2019, an employee suffered a back strain while climbing a ladder.

An employee was attempting to pull a part out of a press. He went to the end of the press where the belt motor is located and was squeezing the belt when his glove was caught in the pulley. As a result, his right index fingertip was amputated at the nail.

An employee was pulling down the hood of a sprayer and had one foot on the step and one foot on the sprayer frame. The employee was hooking up the strap to the crane on the service truck when the employee's foot slipped.  The employee fell from the sprayer and struck the ground, breaking the hip socket and requiring surgery.
An employee was stepping off the curb when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing two fingers. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was attempting to loosen a strap that was on a trailer loaded with PVC pipe.  As he began to loosen the fourth strap, a bundle of PVC pipes fell and struck him on the head, rendering him unconscious. He sustained multiple fractures to the cervical spine.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking to a client's house, suffering a fractured ankle.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and injured both knees, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting a fire hydrant using a chop saw. The saw's guard struck the employee in the face, lacerating it.
An employee was de-burring metal with an abrasive pad on a CNC lathe. The lathe caught the employee's glove, pulled in his arm, and broke it.
An employee was doing maintenance work at an oven. As he cleaned one of the chains, his hand got caught and his left middle finger was amputated. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
While sorting mail, an employee tripped on a large mail bin and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left femur.
Steam burst out of an autoclave when an employee opened it, causing second-degree burns to the employee's face, chest, and right arm.
An employee was leaving his station for lunch after completing construction of a scaffold. While stepping over a pipe, he tripped and fell, twisting his leg and breaking his left tibia and fibula.

An employee was standing outside a trench when the side wall gave way. He fell into the trench and ended up on his knees with dirt up to his waist. He suffered hip and rib injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a surgical scope into an operating room. She tripped over a part of the surgical table and fell, breaking her right ankle.
An employee was walking around his truck when he slipped on snow-covered ice and fell, striking his head on the ground.
An employee was on a ladder performing a cleaning operation when he lost his footing and fell onto a hard surface, injuring his back and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating an overhead crane. While he was hoisting the crane, the block contacted the upper limit switch. The switch was set off but did not stop the crane's movement, causing the crane's cable to snap. When the cable snapped, the crane block (weighing 91 lbs.) and chain (weighing 43 lbs.) fell 18 feet and hit the employee. He was hospitalized with a broken right foot.
An employee fell out of a chair and landed on his knees. He was hospitalized.
An employee's finger was caught under the belt of a plate former carriage, resulting in a partial amputation to the fifth digit of the left hand.

An employee was in a storage closet, applying fire caulk from a 12-foot A-frame self-supporting ladder. The employee fell from the ladder; the employee's head struck the concrete floor and was injured.

An employee was removing a part from the permanent mold machine.  When the machine opened, the employee's glove and fingertip became caught between the ejector plate and airline, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation. Two other employees helped him release his finger.

An employee was operating a table saw to cut wood. When he attempted to clear debris from the saw, his left hand contacted the blade causing lacerations to his left hand that resulted in an amputation. The blade was unguarded and in motion at the time of the incident.

An employee had finished loading a grain truck and was coming down a fixed ladder when the employee fell approximately 10 feet onto the metal grates of a dump pit. The employee suffered a broken right wrist, lower back, and pelvis.
On January 22, 2020, am employee's truck was impacted by another truck while parked in the safety zone. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
While dropping fuel, an employee slipped on a small patch of ice and fell to the ground, breaking the left femur.

An employee was performing a final sugar addition to a heated solution of caustic, silver nitrate water when a portion of the mixture ejected from the lid of the 100-gallon reaction vessel and contacted the employee's body. The employee suffered second and third degree chemical burns to the face, arm, back, and leg.

On January 21, 2020, at around 3:00 PM, an employee was fixing a printing press when his right hand fingers were caught between the belt and pulley resulting in lacerations to the index and middle fingers. The middle fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was being lifted on an alignment rack when the employee fell from the lift to the ground below, suffering fractures to the ankle, hip, elbow, and finger.

An employee was operating the tail end of a material stretcher and actuating the stretcher foot to remove the aluminum profile material. The material remained fastened to the stretcher foot. The employee's left index finger was on the material when the material broke free of the foot and the employee's finger was crushed between the material and the machine. The fingertip was amputated with bone loss.
An employee was holding a cell phone flashlight to illuminate a breaker panel while another employee worked on the panel. An arc flash burned the employee's face and neck.
An employee was on a ladder, attaching a metal track to concrete. The employee fell from the ladder, suffering three broken ribs; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a flexible cable tray on a production machine. The tray was raised using a bottle jack. The bottle jack kicked out while the employee's finger was in an alignment hole on the flexible cable tray, resulting in a left index fingertip amputation.

A shuttle bus driver was placing safety cones around a bus in a parking lot. He slipped on ice, fell backwards to the ground, and hit his head, suffering an abrasion and a hemorrhage. He was hospitalized.
While helping a client out of a paratransit vehicle, an employee was knocked to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was loading a roll of paper (500 to 800 lbs.) from a railcar onto a powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when the roll fell on top of the employee's PIV protective cage.
