The employee raised his hand to protect himself and his fingers went outside of the cage and were crushed between the bar of the cage and the roll of paper. As a result, he sustained a partial amputation of his left index finger and debridement of his left middle finger.
An employee was doing maintenance on a fence weaver machine. The machine activated, and a rotating shaft caught his hand. His right arm was wrapped around the shaft and suffered multiple fractures.
An employee performing preventive maintenance on an excavator slipped and fell to the ground while stepping off the equipment's battery box, fracturing his left ankle.
An employee was lifting dishes out of a dishwasher when his body twisted and he injured his back.
On January 22, 2020, a store cashier was helping customers when two masked men came into the store. One of them shot her in the upper right shoulder. She was hospitalized.
An employee was locking a fan motor after making an adjustment when his hand slipped and his finger hit the fan motor blades, resulting in a right index finger amputation.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice while walking from one building to another outside and fell to the ground, fracturing the left fibula and tibia.
An employee was cutting meat on a band saw when the saw blade cut the employee's right index and middle fingers, resulting in index and middle finger amputations.
An employee was operating a handheld grinder when the grinding wheel disintegrated, and the grinder hit the employee's face, lacerating the lower lip.
An employee was operating a cash safe door. While the door was closing, it caught the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking backwards while uncoiling a hose when he stepped into a hole and was burned by steam and hot water.
An employee was operating a rivet machine when the machine crushed the employee's right thumb, resulting in the surgical amputation of the thumb's first digit.

An employee was in the elevated platform of a scissor lift pulling a telecommunications cable. He reached out and handed the cable to an employee in an adjacent scissor lift and heard a pop. The employee suffered an abdominal hernia that needed surgery.

An employee was working from a ladder while attempting to install a clamp and hoist onto a metal boot (industrial plow) when the boot shifted, knocking the ladder away and causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered 7 broken ribs, a lacerated kidney, and internal bleeding.
An employee was using a jaw puller in a harvest line. The jaw puller activated and the employee's thumb was bent backwards and broken.
An employee was helping install a fence post. The employee's hand was on top of the fence post when a fellow employee struck it with a sledge hammer. The employee suffered a broken hand.
An employee was deburring a part on a CNC lathe when his glove became caught and his hand was pulled into the lathe, resulting in a right index finger amputation at the second knuckle.

Employees were at a dewatering line filling a tank on a subcontractor's truck when the tank pressurized and forced water from a hatch. The pressurized water made contact with two employees. One of the employees was hospitalized with head, back, face, and eye injuries.
An employee was attempting to climb down from a burner table when he slipped and fell 2 to 4 feet to the ground, breaking his right arm and requiring surgery.

An employee was helping another employee position a forklift attachment into place when the employee's left middle finger was caught in the positioning hole used to place a pin in the attachment and amputated.
An employee was in training for defensive tactics. As she attempted to perform a hip toss move, she felt a tearing sensation in her lower back. She was hospitalized with a lower back injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when the employee's right thumb was caught in the belt and pulley at the in-running nip point, resulting in a thumb amputation and palm laceration.

An employee was splicing an electric cable in a trench that was 4 to 5 feet deep, 14 feet long, and 4 to 5 feet wide when the side wall caved in and contacted his right leg, breaking his tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

On 1/22/20, an employee was walking up the icy sidewalk of a residential house when the homeowner's dog barked. The employee was startled and turned to see where the dog was, causing him to slip and fall on the sidewalk. He fractured his right ankle.

An employee was spotting for a skid steer that was loading a bucket into a pickup truck when the employee slipped and fell near the skid steer tracks. The skid steer moved forward and ran over the employee's leg, fracturing the tibia.

An employee was walking through a maintenance shop after completing a DVIR (Driver's Vehicle Inspection Report) when she slipped (possibly on a piece of insulation) and fell to the concrete floor, hitting her head. She suffered a brain injury.
An employee was removing cotton from a lint cleaner. A part in the machine struck the employee's fingers, causing fractures and lacerations.
An employee was stapling a piece of wood. The staple gun shot a staple into the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was installing new drywall in a bathroom and slipped off the first step of a ladder resulting in a dislocated knee and hospitalization. The leg was amputated above the knee a week later due to poor circulation.
An employee was stepping down from a 12-inch-high scale when the employee fell and fractured the right arm.
An employee fell while walking down an exterior stairway and tore a quadriceps muscle from the bone.

An employee was exiting the office building and descending the entry staircase when she missed the bottom step and fell onto the sidewalk, breaking her left distal femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a saw when his hand was caught in the moving blade, resulting in a hand amputation.

On January 23, 2020, an employee used an extension ladder to access the roof of a new one-story house in order to install the dry-in. After stepping onto the roof, he slipped off the roof before he had the chance to connect his lanyard onto the anchor point. He fell about 12 feet to the ground and was hospitalized with a right heel injury.
An employee was walking when a reversing forklift struck the employee. The employee suffered internal bruising and a hematoma in the abdomen.

An employee was cleaning the bottom of a grain bin when he stepped on the door of the auger and it became displaced. He then fell into the auger, resulting in a severe laceration and amputation of the lower left leg.

An employee working as a finishing operator was using sand paper to clean a spindle roll on a slitter machine. The employee's arm was caught in the spinning rollers. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right arm requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While exiting a vehicle at a residential home, an employee slipped on ice/snow and fell to the ground, requiring hospitalization for a fractured wrist.

An employee was operating a metal sheet bender machine. He was adjusting a metal sheet. When he pressed the button that engages to hold the metal sheet, his left hand was caught between the two holder components. He suffered an injury to his left hand that required hospitalization and the amputation of his left ring finger.

An employee was working at a tail stretcher operation when he crossed over some equipment and was struck in the leg by a machine's transfer arm. He was hospitalized the next day for a broken leg, requiring surgery.
At about 3:50 p.m., an employee was driving a forklift when it struck another, stopped forklift. She suffered an injury to her left ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a truck that required a steering arm replacement. The employee released the tie rod and a clip or tab flew out and hit him in the eye, puncturing his cornea. He was hospitalized.
An employee walked past a doctor who was using essential oils and had a respiratory reaction.
While walking to a car, an employee slipped and fell on ice. The employee sustained an ankle injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was transporting sulfuric acid in a plastic bucket when the bucket handle failed and the bucket tipped. The corrosive acid contacted the employee's legs, causing third degree chemical burns to the legs and feet.
An employee was using a planer when the employee's left hand contacted the blade, resulting in amputation of the left pinky and ring fingers.
A Tradesmen International employee was moving a delivery chute for a cement delivery vehicle. The chute joint caught his right index finger, causing a soft tissue amputation.

An electrician was on a ladder, working on a lighting circuit. The electrician came into contact with a 277-volt energized circuit, suffered burns to the thumbs and fingers, fell from the ladder, and suffered chest abrasions. The electrician was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a water main. A pipe cap struck the employee's left leg, causing artery damage. The employee was hospitalized.
A truck struck an employee while he was jogging as part of physical training. He suffered multiple serious injuries.
An employee was leaving the store when she slipped and fell on ice, breaking her ankle.
An employee was at a coffee station when he tripped on a dustpan and impacted the floor, breaking his right ankle and leg and sustaining a meniscus tear.
A security guard was assisting with an unruly patient when the guard lost balance and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was using a table saw to cut wood. While the employee was removing an object that was stuck in the saw, the saw caught the employee's glove and pulled the employee's hand into the saw blade. The employee suffered a finger amputation and crushing injuries.
An employee was walking to his car after parking a bus in the parking lot when the employee slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was clearing product from a pump. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were amputated by the pump rotors.
An employee was standing around talking inside the office on ground level when he stepped back, turned, and lost his balance. He fell, struck the floor, and was hospitalized with a broken femur.

An employee was standing near stacked steel beams, using a handheld remote to raise the top beam with a crane. When the beam was lifted up, the bottom beam became unstable and shifted off the dunnage onto the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a compound fracture of the lower leg.
An employee was cleaning a grader drum with compressed air. His arm was caught and injured between the drum and the equipment's frame. He was hospitalized to treat a muscle injury.
An employee was holding a door open for someone when it shut on her right hand, amputating the tip of her ring finger.

An employee was driving a stand-up reach forklift with a load elevated in the air. The load caught a ceiling-mounted heater, causing the forklift to tip backwards. The employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and the ground, causing several fractures to the foot and ankle.
An employee was installing roof decking on a warehouse. He fell from the roof decking to the ground about 40 feet below, suffering fractures to the legs, pelvis, and arms.
An employee was moving scrap aluminum beams into a stack in a warehouse. His right middle finger got stuck between the beams and sustained an amputation.
An employee was walking from a kitchen to a bathroom after cleaning a fryer with degreaser. He became lightheaded and fell to the floor, breaking his right leg.
An employee was operating a pneumatic shear machine when his left thumb tip was caught in the shear, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

An employee was using a stand-up rebar pipe bending machine. He was grabbing rebar when he was caught in the bending pen. His pinky finger was amputated and the middle and ring fingers were fractured.
An employee was cutting strips of metal with a metal shear. The shear crushed the employee's right ring finger; the finger was partially amputated.
An employee fell from a second-story balcony when the railing broke.
An employee was attempting to jump over a pipe that was being lowered into a bell hole when the employee hit the pipe. The pipe then fell and struck the employee's lower abdomen and hip.
An employee checking a belt on a pulley when the employee's finger was caught in the rotating pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was delivering propane to a customer's residence. He parked his propane truck on the driveway and connected his transfer hose to the customer's storage tank.  As he proceeded to return to his truck, he slipped on ice that was present on the property. He fell to the icy ground and hit his head.  He slowly got back up and walked back to the propane truck to stop the transfer pump.  At this time, the customer returned home to see the employee leaning next to his truck dazed. He was hospitalized for a concussion and some brain bleeding.
A police trainee suffered an exertion-related muscle injury during training.
An employee was operating a machine and caught their left thumb in the point of operation resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.

Employees had been laying down fire cloth in the engine room to prepare for pipe fitting and welding repairs. An employee fell approximately 18-20 feet into the hull of a floating maritime academy training vessel and was found lying unconscious. The employee was hospitalized with injuries including gashes to the head and thigh requiring stitches and severe hematomas.

An employee was spraying food processing equipment with a hose when the machine started running and caught the hose. The employee attempted to pull back on the hose and the employee's left hand was pulled into the machine, causing a laceration and penetrating injuries to the left hand.

An employee was standing inside a building between two loading docks at the steps leading to a lower level.  A package fell off a belt and hit the employee. The employee lost his balance and fell down the steps. He suffered a head laceration and limited movement in his arms and legs due to pressure on his spine.
An employee was installing 10-foot, 500 lb. posts when the employee's finger was caught between the floor and a post, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was attaching a shackle to a steel plate that was being lifted by a loader when the employee's left thumb was caught between the shackle and the steel plate, resulting in a left thumb amputation just past the fingernail. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was moving a bundle of stainless steel bars. The bars cut the bundle's strap and dropped onto the employee's left foot, causing broken bones.
An employee was moving silo panels when his left thumb was caught in a pinch point between a jib and a strap, resulting in a left thumb amputation.

An employee was attempting to help another employee remove a 70 lb. stop/guide pin from leads. The injured employee's left ring finger was between the leads and the pin when the other employee struck the pin with a sledgehammer to free it. As a result, his left ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a crane to pick up metal strapping bound into a coil. The coil fell to the ground and came undone, smashing the employee's right big toe. The employee suffered a partial amputation.
An employee was clearing a jam in a lamination glue filter. The pneumatic ball valve actuated, catching the employee's left middle finger and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was cutting plywood using a table saw. The plywood bounced and the employee's index finger struck the blade causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was shot by a temporary employee while walking across the parking lot.

On January 24, 2020, an employee was removing a plastic ball from the feed throat of an injection molding machine. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the screw and the barrel, and the tip was amputated.
A maintenance employee was attempting to repair/replace an inoperative breaker to a hot oil furnace when an electrical arc flash occurred, causing first degree burns to the employee's hands.
An employee was receiving training on how to operate a pallet jack when the employee was struck by the pallet jack, suffering a broken left ankle that required hospitalization.

An employee was trying to remove a jam from a VH machine when another employee jogged the machine. The employee's left ring finger was then caught in a pinch point between two rollers, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing to receive roof trusses. He was moving from an extension ladder and going onto the tie beams when he fell and struck his head on the concrete below. He was hospitalized with head injuries.

On January 23, 2020, an employee working for AK Steel was starting to pour an electric arc furnace when an explosion inside of the furnace caused molten metal to be ejected from the furnace, striking the employee. The employee was hospitalized with serious burns to her upper body.

An employee was troubleshooting a pump that was not working. The employee was on top of the  piping system checking the flow switch. While troubleshooting the flow switch, the cap was removed and the employee noticed the flow switch was leaking. The employee made contact with electrical parts within the flow switch and a fire started. The employee then jumped off the piping system. The employee suffered a broken left leg and third degree burns to both hands.

An employee was driving an aerial lift into a building along a concrete ramp. When the lift entered the building, its front wheels came off the ramp and fell 10 inches, causing the basket to shoot upward and throw the employee out. He hit the ground and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was carrying drinks to serve to customers when the bartender added more alcohol to the drinks and they flared up. The employee received second degree burns to the throat and face.
An employee was sitting on a chair when he leaned back and the chair broke. He fell backwards and hit his head on the concrete floor, suffering a concussion.
An employee was painting the dump door of a dump truck. The door fell shut, amputating the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee was removing a pipe stand roller from a pallet jack when a portion of the employee's middle finger near the area of the fingernail was caught between the base of the pipe stand roller and the concrete floor, resulting in a partial amputation to the middle fingertip.

An employee backed his truck up to a bay door to load stock. While exiting the vehicle, he stepped on a 2-pallet stack, lost his footing, and fell to the ground. He put out his left arm to stop himself. His arm hit the ground and broke. He was hospitalized with a broken left arm and bloody nose.
A paramedic was walking up to the scene of a medical incident when she slipped on ice and fell, suffering a broken right hip.

A longshoreman was unloading I-beams off a cargo ship. The beams were secured with a lashing system composed of wooden 4-by-4s and cables. While the cables were being loosened, a 4-by-4 sprung loose and struck the employee on the hardhat, causing a head injury.
An employee tripped on a toy on the floor in a toy department. She fell to the floor, suffered a broken right elbow, and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was pushing a job cart out of a building. The double door slammed shut, catching and amputating the tip of the employee's little finger.

An employee was performing a pre-trip inspection on a vehicle when the employee's gloved right hand was caught and pulled into the engine's rotating belt. As a result, the employee's right thumb was amputated.
An employee was applying aerosol lubricant to a crane boom hoist. The employee's left index finger was caught between the boom hoist rope and the fleeting sheave and was partially amputated.
An employee tripped and fell while unloading a pallet. The employee suffered a head laceration and a torn quadriceps.
An employee was operating a reach truck when it collided with a support beam. The employee's left leg was pinned between the truck and the beam and was broken below the knee.
An employee suffered a back strain while moving pallets.
An employee was cutting a door jam with a table saw when the employee's right hand slipped into the moving blade, cutting the hand.
An employee was working from an order picker, pulling a freezer off a shelf. He fell several feet to the ground below, suffering leg and hip injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee was meeting a prospective client with her sales manager at the prospective client's residence. Upon entering the home, the employee missed a step on the stairs leading to the foyer and fell, fracturing her right hip and requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a hanging furnace while standing on a ladder when the employee fell approximately 4 feet to the floor, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw when the employee's sleeve became caught, pulling the employee's arm into the saw blade and causing an amputation.
While exiting an elevator, an employee tripped and fell to the same level, broke a hip, and was hospitalized.

Two employees were on a lift torch-cutting an old connection plate off of a concrete beam and preparing to weld a new connection plate on when a concrete beam weighing approximately 68,500 pounds hit the lift and collapsed the basket.  The employees fell approximately 21 feet with the basket to the ground, sustaining a spinal injury, broken ribs, and a facial injury.
An employee was putting notches in 2x4 wooden boards with a woodcutting notching machine when the machine amputated two middle fingers and part of the pinky finger on the employee's right hand.
An employee lost sight of the edge of a platform, fell, and landed on his right elbow. His elbow broke and required surgery.
An employee lost consciousness due to dehydration.
An employee was walking on a stage when he fell approximately 42 inches off the stage to the floor below. He was hospitalized and had to have his spleen removed.
An employee fell to the ground while moving cars for de-icing, suffering a large contusion to the left hip.
An employee was walking to her register when she tripped on another employee's walker. She fell and suffered a broken femur.
An employee picked up a hopper with a front end loader. It became unstable and smashed his middle finger, causing an amputation at the end.

An employee was molding a rubber weight on a rubber press. He was attempting to move the rubber weight mold inside the press when the start button was pressed. The machine then crushed his left pinky, ring, and middle fingers.
An employee was operating machinery when their left ring finger was caught, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was ejected from a ski lift chair while on the platform, resulting in multiple rib fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning an offline grinding machine when its blade amputated his left middle finger.

An employee was rinsing equipment with a high-pressure hose when he raised one of his legs approximately 3 feet off the ground and his foot entered an opening in the side of the equipment. His foot became entangled with the equipment, resulting in an amputation at the left knee.

An employee was working as a self checkout host. The employee went to help a customer with an override and turned around and tripped over a case of water at the store. The employee impacted the ground, suffering a broken hip that required surgery.
An employee was re-securing a load on the back of a trailer. He fell off the trailer to the concrete 5 feet below, suffering a concussion and abrasions.
An employee was shutting the lid of a cargo bin when the lid fell onto his right index finger, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift and got off of it to move a double pallet jack. He leaned forward and grabbed the pallet jack's throttle. The pallet jack then went to the side into racking. The pallet jack and racking struck the employee's right ankle, causing a fracture.

An employee was hooking a chain hook onto a crankshaft buggy that lifts the crane shaft. The buggy moved and smashed his left index fingertip between the hook and the buggy, causing an amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was working inside an enclosure on the overhead roll-up garage door. The power to the door was turned on and the employee was crushed between the door and a wall, suffering four broken pelvic bones. The door had been turned off but not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
While taking out the trash, an employee slipped on ice and fell. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a head laceration.
An employee was climbing out the back of a truck trailer when he slipped on the icy floor and hit his head on the truck's bumper. His head received a cut that required stitches.
An employee was sweeping the floor by the shipping dock when he attempted to move a molded piece of steel with his hands. The steel then fell on his leg, causing fractures to his leg and toes.
An employee suffered a hernia while picking up a steel ramp for a forklift.
An employee was standing on the curb waiting for a bus when her foot became caught in a gap and she fell to the concrete, fracturing her hip.

The injured employee and a co-worker were receiving and inspecting scrap metal. A large scrap electrical cabinet needed to be moved to a different area for processing. Prior to moving it, they wanted to inspect the inside of the large electrical cabinet to ensure there were no unacceptable materials in the box. There was a large electrical control panel on top of the electrical box and it was sitting at an angle. As the injured employee lifted the door, the control panel shifted and fell, striking his left hand. He sustained a laceration of his left hand and a broken middle finger, which required surgery to repair.
An employee was using a step stool while performing automotive work when he slipped and fell, injuring his knee and requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting fajitas with a knife and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was cutting metal with a shear machine when the blade amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was conducting quality checking when his right index finger got caught in between a die and a can resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was securing the forks to a forklift when the employee's fingers became pinched between the mast and the boom on the forklift, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was vacuuming the trunk of a vehicle when another vehicle rolled toward the employee and pinned the employee between the two vehicles. He employee was hospitalized with a fractured right femur.
An employee was walking from a carpeted area to a tile floor when the employee slipped and fell onto the tile floor, suffering shoulder, knee, nose, and mouth injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was erecting a masonry scaffold when his left index finger was pinched between the cross brace and the frame of the scaffold, resulting in the amputation of the distal phalanx of the left index finger.
An employee was roping a horse off when his hand was caught between the rope and a saddle horn, mangling his right thumb.
An employee was drilling an electrical cover when the employee contacted live electrical wires and an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burn injuries to the face and right hand/arm.
An employee was mixing corrosive chemicals when the chemicals splashed on the employee's face, eyes, neck, chest, and upper extremities, causing chemical burns.

An employee was attempting to put a clevis on a section of fiberglass walls stored on a cart. The sections are used to make cooling towers. The employee moved a piece to clear the clevis and approximately 10-12 4'x30' sections fell over and struck the employee on his left femur. The employee was knocked to the ground and the pieces landed on his leg. He sustained a broken left femur that required surgical repair.
An employee was using a core-making machine when the machine severely crushed the employee's left index fingertip, resulting in a surgical amputation.
An employee was removing a stuck bottle from a conveyor. The conveyor caught his right index finger and amputated the tip.

A temporary employee was performing maintenance on a depositing machine when a second employee cycled the machine as the temporary employee's finger was in the point of operation. As a result, the temporary employee received an amputation.
An employee was cleaning the outfeed rolls on a press with kerosene and a towel when the employee's right hand was pulled into the roll opening, resulting in a right ring finger amputation.

An employee was working near a metal beam for a concrete form when the rigging slipped and the 42-foot, 500-lb. beam fell on the employee's right foot, causing multiple fractures and requiring surgery.
A traffic control flagger was struck by a truck while standing on the curb, suffering bruised ribs.

An employee placed his right hand on top of a mortar mixer grate to pull the drum back into the upright position when the paddles came down and made contact with three of the employee's fingers, causing a partial amputation of the ring finger.

An employee was sitting in a concrete truck that was stuck in the mud. The back of a second concrete truck was attached to the front of the concrete truck that was stuck in the mud by a ratcheting strap. The connecting strap snapped, flinging the metal ratchet device crashing through the driver side window of the concrete truck. The device struck the employee in the head, causing a forehead laceration that required sutures and hospitalization.

An employee was scooping debris with a shovel and pitchfork from a pit for a railcar and putting it into the grapple of an excavator when the employee's leg was pinned between the excavator bucket and a section of train track. The employee received a compound fracture of the left ankle.
An employee was in a basket attached to a forklift. He was approximately 5 feet up when the basket fell, sending the employee to the ground. He broke his arm.
An employee was installing a vent boot on a roof when the employee fell 25 feet to the ground, fracturing the left arm and right heel.
An employee was using a saw to cut a bow blank when the saw lacerated his right index finger, resulting in a surgical amputation down to the middle knuckle.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, helping install a new lighting truss below a false ceiling. The employee fell (along with the ceiling) to the concrete floor about 24 feet below, suffering multiple arm fractures.

An employee was standing on the second landing of a recently poured concrete staircase, cleaning mortar droppings from handrails, when the employee lost balance and slipped/fell down six concrete steps.
An employee was on a ladder installing a tankless hot water heater. While descending the ladder, the employee missed a step and fell, suffering a laceration to the head and a brain bleed.
An employee tripped and fell on a carpeted area, suffering broken bones in the leg.
An employee was using a hammer to set a piece of metal channel into place. His finger was under the channel when it fell into place, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a eviscerator in the evisceration department of the processing plant and caught her arm in the machine. The injury required stitches.
An employee was using a table saw when his finger contacted the blade, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee was attempting to get on a moving aggregate spreader when the employee slipped and the tire ran over the employee's right foot. The employee's right foot was injured and required surgery.

On January 27, 2020, an employee was setting up an assembler in the assembly department when the employee's fingers became pinched between the die and the roller assembly, resulting in partial amputations of the index, middle, and ring fingers on the left hand.
An employee lost balance while reaching for a swing gate at the top of stairs and fell to the floor, suffering a traumatic left hip fracture.
An employee was transferring chemicals from a 55-gallon container when a flash fire occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee.

An employee, walking down a flight of stairs, fell and struck a stationary pipe object at the bottom landing. The employee incurred serious injuries, including a lacerated spleen, a liver laceration, and a possible fractured rib.

An employee was helping a yardman unload a metal material lift from a flatbed truck to the ground using a forklift when the metal material lift fell forward and hit the employee's forehead.  The employee fell to the ground and hurt his neck and back.

An employee was replacing the door tracks on a roll-up door for a storage unit when the tension came off the spring, releasing the door frame. The door frame struck the employee in the face, resulting in potential facial fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was climbing a ladder with a nail gun hanging off a tool belt when the nail gun trigger hit the ladder, resulting in a nail penetrating the employee's knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was sliding a dock section on a table and caught their left middle finger between the section and the table resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a cartoner and feeding a box of product into the machine when paper fell out and became jammed. The employee cycled the machine to clear the jam and the employee's finger became caught in a chain, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading empty carts into a semi-trailer using the lift gate mounted on the rear of the trailer. While he was riding the lift gate up and demonstrating this process to a trainee, he tried to reposition his feet, shifting from one foot to the other. In doing so, he stepped over the lip at the side of the lift gate. His foot then hooked onto one of the bars that allows the lift gate to travel up and down and his leg became caught, causing a scrape and swelling to the calf. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unjamming the a machine when the maintenance operator began to assist in the process.  The maintenance operator activated the machine and it cycled while the employee's hand was inside, resulting in the partial amputation of the left thumb and full amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was trimming tree limbs when the employee's cutter hit an electrical line. The employee received an electrical burn to the left hand and right foot.

An employee was assisting a patient, tripped over an electric wheel chair foot rest, and fell to the floor striking a door jamb/frame during the fall. The employee was hospitalized for a subarachnoid hemorrhage.
An employee was finishing his daily duties and exiting his delivery truck when the truck rolled into him. He was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance/greasing a chain on a conveyor system when his right index finger was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was jumping a short distance to push a box farther onto a shelf when the employee's ring became caught on the shelf and lacerated the employee's finger, resulting in a surgical amputation.

An employee was troubleshooting a door machine issue when his right hand entered the point of operation, striking a rotating drill bit and amputating the right ring finger at the base of the hand and the first knuckle.

An employee was using an in-house manufactured utility cart to move 50 metal plates. The plates were stacked on the cantilevered end when the cart tipped and the metal plates slid off, striking the employee. The employee suffered a fractured left foot, tibia, fibula, and ankle.

An employee was attempting to cut a small plate of stainless steel into smaller pieces to weld them. The plate was not inserted far enough, so he pushed the edge of the plate with his right index finger to reposition it. In doing so, his middle finger extended into/between the shear's point of operation as he stepped on the foot pedal actuator. The shear blade dropped down, cutting and causing a partial amputation of his right middle finger.
An employee heard a noise and dismounted from a pallet jack to investigate. The pallet jack continued to roll when she got off and pinned her between the jack and rack, fracturing her left foot.

A maintenance employee had locked a machine out and was preparing for maintenance. The employee was tightening a spanner nut when he bumped the hydraulic oil line. The oil sprayed out of the line and cut the employee's finger, which required 2 stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was moving metal around a manual metal bending machine when his arms were caught in the machine, lacerating both arms.

An employee was operating a power stocker lift. The lift was coming down when the employee stepped backwards and fell approximately 2 to 3 feet to the ground, striking his head and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder dumping trash onto trucks. He lost his balance and fell off the ladder, twisting his body and falling to the pavement on his right arm, which was dislocated.
An employee was unloading product from a trailer when the trailer door slammed shut on his finger, crushing it. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was stepping out of his delivery truck onto the street when he slipped on an ice buildup, injuring his hip.
An employee was walking out onto a new car sales lot when the employee slipped on ice, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was setting wall forms while tied to a beam. The beam gave way, causing the employee to slide down to the ground level via his lanyard. He landed on his feet and then fell backwards, injuring his back.
An employee was standing on a ladder while changing a light bulb and fell to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs and required hospitalization.

After installing light fixtures in a room of a new 3-story house, an employee opened the door to an elevator shaft thinking it was another room and fell down approximately 36 feet to the ground floor. He suffered fractures to both legs, a vertebra, and an arm and was hospitalized.

The injured employee was working on a ramp behind a manlift. As the manlift was going up the ramp it began to roll back. The employee operating the manlift applied the brakes, but nothing happed. The injured employee was pinned between the manlift and the wall and fractured the right leg.

An employee was painting from a scissor lift with a sprayer gun when he fell between 15 and 16 feet from the lift. Fall protection was not worn and the lift's end door was not closed at the time of the incident.
An employee was inspecting an aircraft and tripped on a 3-step stand, fell to the same level, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.

On January 28, 2020, an employee was installing a soffit board on a two-story beach house from a walk board when he lost his balance and fell 10 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off stilts that were 9 feet high and hit the floor during a rehearsal, impacting and injuring his lower back, shoulder, and head.

An employee was working from a scissor lift and wiring a light fixture near a roll-up door when the door was activated and the employee became rolled up in the door. Nearby employees activated the door to release the employee, who fell approximately 10 feet to the concrete floor and suffered broken ribs.
An employee was removing nitrogen from a system when a tool malfunctioned and a Schrader pin hit the employee's hand and nitrogen gas got under the skin on the employee's left arm and hand.
An employee was reassembling a valve actuator in the machine shop when a piston rod plate dropped on the employee's right pinky finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was untwisting nail wire in a nail maker machine and suffered a right thumb amputation.
An employee was working on a compressor when his wrench slipped, causing him to fall and hit his head on the concrete. He suffered fractures to the head and back.
An employee was on scaffolding framing up a fur down (dry wall ceiling) and hanging sheetrock. The employee fell and was hospitalized for broken ribs and a leg contusion.
An employee was up in a gumbo limbo tree cutting it when the tree base snapped and he fell, hitting and fracturing his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking in the rain and observed an aluminum container on the ground. The employee picked it up and attempted to see if there was anything in the container. The top came off and exposed the pellets inside to the rain.  The pellets inside the container were highly reactive to water and exploded when the rain entered the container. The employee suffered burns to the eyes.

An employee was preparing to install solar panels at a residence using a 17-foot ladder. The employee was holding onto the gutter when it broke, causing the employee to fall from the ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was sweeping debris from the sidewalk when she hit an uneven piece of the sidewalk and fell, fracturing her right knee.

Two employees were removing a meter inside a customer's establishment to perform a meter transfer. The injured employee was lowering the meter when he lost his grip and it slipped from his hands, striking his left thigh. He suffered a ruptured quadricep in his left thigh.

An employee was parked at the end of an aisle with his pallet jack. He asked a forklift driver to reverse in order to make room for him to drive his pallet jack. The forklift driver accidentally drove the forklift forward and struck the employee's left foot, causing a laceration and broken bones.
An employee was trimming material on a fabric cutting machine when the machine amputated her finger.

An employee was using a ladder to install cable TV/internet services when the ladder shifted, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee suffered a broken left heel, broken left leg, and dislocated left shoulder.
An employee was walking on a car carrier when he fell about 4 feet to the ground, striking his head and back. He suffered hyperextension of the neck, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking through the parking lot when she was struck and run over by a waste removal truck, requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee was trying to hold a door open for another employee when the automatic door closed on the injured employee's left ring finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated halfway down the fingernail.
On January 29, 2020, an employee operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse struck a parked forklift, resulting in a left foot injury and the amputation of two toes.

An employee was working to fit two 1-1/2-inch stainless steel spool pieces at a flanged connection to bolt up. 

To align the two spool pieces, the top section of pipe (10 feet in length) was rigged using a nylon strap choker, attached to a 1/2-ton chain. 

As the employee attempted to move the pipe, the load shifted in the nylon strap, causing the top section of the pipe to drop approximately 1-2 inches, which pinched the injured employee's left index finger in the flanged connection and resulted in an amputation of the finger's distal tip.
An employee was on a stand assisting a setup when he slipped from the stand and struck his head on the edge of the platform, lacerating the left side of his head.
An employee was moving a cart with tomatoes when two carts bumped each other, resulting in amputation of the employee's thumb tip.

An employee got onto a roof and was in the process of installing his anchor to the roof when he slipped down the side of the roof (two stories) and fell to the ground, fracturing his left orbital bones.
An employee was cutting bacon with a 10-inch chef's knife when the blade lacerated the employee's left thumb, resulting in a suspected amputation of the thumb tip.
While descending from a ladder, an employee missed a rung and fell to the concrete ground, suffering cracked ribs and a broken clavicle.

An employee was using a 10-foot extension ladder to hang a sign in the warehouse.  The ladder slipped out from under the employee, who fell to the ground and suffered from a partial fracture to the spine. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a water calibration meter on top of the concrete plant and fell 12 feet from a concrete conveyor to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right shoulder and a fractured back.
The injured employee was removing soil to lay a concrete form when a loader that was backing up ran over the employee's leg and fractured it.

An employee had stepped out of a scissor lift that was approximately 8 feet high onto a steel beam to retrieve a fan. The employee fell off of the beam and landed on the concrete floor, breaking his right knee and left ankle.
An employee was cutting wood with a hydraulic wood splitter when his hand went in front of the cutting section of the hydraulic wood splitter, causing an amputation to the left pointer finger.

An employee was pulling on a green vinyl strap that was part of the sheet skid packaging in an attempt to move the sheet skid to the back of the trailer for the next delivery. The vinyl strap broke, causing him to lose his balance and fall off the back of the trailer, landing on the ground. He sustained a laceration to the back of his head and broke four ribs.
An employee was cutting siding with a circular saw when he hit a wood stud and the saw caught the end of his left pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving a pallet of material using a reach truck/powered industrial vehicle when the pallet began falling from the forks. The employee reached out to stop the materials from falling and then dismounted the truck to stop it. The truck continued to move, and his left leg was pinned and crushed between the truck and a nearby railing.

On January 29, 2020, at approximately 10:50 a.m., an employee was setting up equipment in preparation for cable pulling when his finger made inadvertent contact with the duct dog (cable pulling equipment), resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a dry packaging machine when the machine jammed. As the employee attempted to unjam the hopper, the auger caught and degloved the employee's left index finger, resulting in the loss of the nail.
An employee tripped and fell while unloading a pallet, striking the left leg on a tote. The employee suffered fractured left patella.

An employee came up behind a second employee, who was getting parts off a shelf, to put snow down his shirt. The second employee stood up and turned around, which knocked the first employee over. He fell against a tire and broke his right hip.

An employee was putting merchandise on a mobile cart. As he was taking laundry baskets out of a box to put them on the cart, the cart moved and he tripped over one of the boxes and fell to the ground, breaking his left hip. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was adjusting the sheeter rollers on a bun divider machine with his right hand. As he was making the adjustment (changing the dough pans), he slipped and his left hand slid into the rotating roller, which was unguarded at the time. His left pinky and middle fingers received lacerations and his left ring fingertip was crushed, resulting in a surgical amputation.

An employee walked to the edge of a retaining wall to throw a chain rigging onto a flatbed truck. He stepped on the edge of the concrete block retaining wall, slipped, and lost his balance, falling approximately 5 feet and landing between the flatbed truck and the retaining wall. He fractured his right tibia.
An employee was operating a hand-held circular saw to cut wood when the saw slipped and his left thumb contacted the blade, resulting in a left thumb tip amputation.

An employee was cutting tomatoes with a knife when he hit a hard spot on the sundried tomato, causing the knife to jump and smash down on his right thumb. As a result, his right thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was moving a box of parts (less than 20 lbs.). She took a step and bumped her right foot into the leg of the staging table, which caused her to lose her balance and fall to the floor. While falling, her left leg became caught on a platform behind a CNC machine. She fractured her left hip.
An employee was closing a door and caught their left middle finger in the door resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A USPS employee was pulling a pallet jack when the pallet jack ran over the employee's foot, resulting in multiple broken foot bones and requiring hospitalization.

On January 30, 2020, an employee was quoting repairs on a cooling tower basin. He was standing on the concrete area that the boilers are on, discussing the repairs with the customer and a subcontractor. He attempted to step off of the platform but was closer to the edge than he realized, causing him to lose balance and fall about 20 inches to the ground below. He suffered a broken hip and broken right wrist.
An employee was stocking a shelf when a case fell from the shelf, striking the dead man's switch on his machine. His machine then pinned him to the wall, breaking his left pelvis.
On 1/30/2020, an employee was participating in a race when he fell, hurting both knees and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was carrying materials and suffered a lower right leg fracture.

An employee was standing on an A-frame ladder installing plastic material over an I-beam before starting to paint. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained two broken wrists and injuries to his back.
An employee was stepping off a truck inside a warehouse, missed a step and fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a wrist sprain and head trauma.

Two employees were rigging down a cellar pump line while another contractor was rigging down a standpipe line. While both operations were close to each other, the crews were working separately. The injured employee had attempted to stabilize the standpipe with a come-along and forklift prior to rigging the line down, but when one of the hammer unions broke loose, the entire line shifted out of the support stand and fell on his right leg just above his ankle. He was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

An employee was cleaning the flights of the rotary valve. He manually moved one flight to reach another flight to clean it.  His hand slipped and slid past a sharp edge that cut through his cut-resistant glove and amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was mixing paint using a mixing drill. A rag became caught in the mixer and his left pinky finger was caught in the mixer drill and ripped off.

An employee was measuring the length of an I-beam prior to cross cutting it on a band saw when his right hand was caught between the remote-controlled pneumatic clamp and the back fence of the saw where the I-beams are secured prior to cutting. Three fingers on the right hand were broken and the employee's ring finger was amputated below the first joint.

An employee was getting ready to unload a truck. He extended the dock plate and was walking onto the truck when the truck driver pulled away to square the truck up, causing the dock plate to fall. The employee fell to the ground, hitting his head and landing on his back. He sustained contusions to his back and the back of his head.
An employee was loading ductwork onto a flatbed trailer when the sliding gate pinched the employee's right middle finger, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was checking pigeon traps and fell off the roof. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and three fractured vertebrae.

An employee was conducting a visual inspection of a marine vessel inside dry dock. The employee fell approximately 9 feet from a fixed ladder to the bottom of the dry dock and sustained multiple fractures to the left arm.

An employee was mixing masa in the tumbler in preparation for making dough for tortillas and contacted one of the spiral assembly parts with his right hand. The employee sustained lacerations to his thumb, palm and part of right hand.
An employee was changing a grinding wheel when it fell onto his left hand, causing a partial amputation of the left pinky finger.
An employee tripped and fell on stairs while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized for a right hip fracture.

An employee was working on a forklift when the forklift carriage fell from the guide and hit (fell on) the employee. He was hospitalized with a laceration, fractured left femur, and vertebrae fractures.

An employee was walking toward a customer to take an order at the deli when the employee slipped on grease from rotisserie chickens that was on the floor and impacted the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right femur.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor resulting in hospitalization for a left hip fracture.
An employee was carrying a large box of material into the inventory storage area, tripped over a part on the floor, and fell breaking the right femur.
An employee was stepping off the bottom rung of a step ladder, lost balance and fell. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and a broken left wrist.
While walking, an employee tripped and fell face first onto the floor, suffering facial and mouth injuries.

An electrician was retrieving an aerial lift from the dock. While driving the equipment back to the facility, the lift turned sharply, forcing the front right tire off the road and onto a levee. The lift tipped and ejected the employee from the basket. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the right leg including the shin and ankle.

A security officer was attending to an aggressive dog(s) by the patient entrance to the hospital. During the intervention with the dog(s), the officer was bitten. At that point, the officer discharged a firearm at the dog and the discharged round struck the officer in the left little finger area.

At approximately 3:00 a.m. on January 31, 2020, an employee was operating a delivery truck's lift gate when the employee fell forward off the lift gate after miss-stepping over the edge. The employee fell chest-down on the ground and was hospitalized with four fractured ribs.
An employee was skiing and practicing G-turns when a guest skier traversing a slope struck the employee. The employee sustained a fractured femur.

An employee was stocking shelves with new, unopened chemicals. The employee fell over and struck their head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury and possible chemical exposure.

An employee was operating a manual lathe, machining an auger journal end. The employee pressed the stop control, and the lathe started slowing down. The employee attempted to visually inspect the part and placed his left hand on the steady rest to get a better view. His hand then slipped and struck the spinning auger, resulting in medical amputation of the left pinky finger.

An employee was stepping out of a crane carrier onto a walking working surface when he slipped and fell off of the crane carrier and landed on a log. He suffered three broken ribs and a bruised lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was a welder tasked with moving an idle roller with a forklift used to stabilize ships for welding operations. As he was positioning dunnage under the idle rollers for the forklift, the idle roller slipped, crushing his left foot. He was hospitalized and required surgical amputation of his left big toe tip.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by a hedge clipper.

An employee was loading his machine (scraper) on a clay slope at approximately 5:10 AM. The scraper hit an uneven surface and jostled the employee in the seat. The employee immediately felt a sharp pain in their back and was hospitalized for a T12 fracture.
An employee was opening a gate and caught their left ring finger in the gate resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing a 6-foot pipe from a machine when his hand went between the machine turret and the pipe, smashing his right ring finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing 65-foot concrete wall braces using a powered industrial truck and a choker sling. He was holding a tag line at the end of the brace. When the brace was removed the balance was uneven. The brace cantilevered and seesawed the employee 20 feet into the air. He struck the ground, fracturing his pelvis.
On January 31, 2020, an employee was tearing down a die and emptying molten metal from a mold when the molten metal contacted the employee, burning his right leg and ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee had an unknown allergic reaction to something, requiring hospitalization.

On January 31, 2020, at approximately 7:35 AM, the injured employee was inspecting carcasses for contamination on the pre-final rail while another employee was operating a handheld skinner on the opposite side of the carcass. The employee using the handheld skinner started to remove hair on the right side of the carcass at the same time that the injured employee reached to turn the carcass with the left hand. As the carcass was turned, the injured employee's left hand hit against the skinner, resulting in an amputation of the left 5th fingertip down to the first knuckle and a laceration to the left 4th fingertip.
On 1/31/2020, an employee was helping two other employees move a safe down stairs.  The safe slid down the stairs and struck the employee, crushing the employee's abdomen.
An employee was repairing a vertical injection press when the bolt broke and the injector unit fell and crushed the employee's right hand.
An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack and got wedged between the pallet jack and shelving. The employee was hospitalized for a rib injury.
An employee was using a mag drill when his glove was caught in the drill and his left thumb was amputated.

An employee was performing maintenance on a machine conveyor. He was physically checking the rotation of the sprocket and chain when his finger became caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a table saw to cut plywood when the saw blade amputated the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was riding a pallet jack and stopped to pick up his jacket that had fallen off the machine. As the employee stepped off the machine and reached down to retrieve his jacket, the operation controls were triggered and the pallet ran over his left foot. The employee sustained lacerations to the left leg and crushed toes.
An employee was unjamming a packing machine and amputated their left index fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on a cement floor resulting in hospitalization for a hip fracture.
An employee was reaching into a tuber machine to clean a tape cutting blade when the machine cycled and the employee sustained a left index fingertip amputation.

An employee was in the process of cleaning and setting a 20' steel siderail for a mold while standing on top of the 2.5' high mold. The employee stuck a piece of rebar into a hole of the mold to adjust the siderail's position in the mold. The employee pulled on the rebar and it came out of the hole, causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture the right femur.

An employee was cleaning a loading belt in a lettuce processing area. A piece of lettuce fell between the belt rollers, and as he was catching it the rollers caught the glove on his left hand. He suffered fractures to the fingers, as well as his left arm.

On February 1, 2020, a maintenance employee was cleaning the roller of a bacon transfer conveyor also known as the precook bacon machine. The employee was scraping a rotating roller with a 2x4 (approximately) scraper while working inside the Ready to Eat (RTE) room. While cleaning, the scraper slipped and the employee's left index fingertip was caught and amputated between the moving roller and a metal bar. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee was folding a 45' W by 100' L rubber sheet when she fell backwards, striking her head on the concrete ground and suffering a brain bleed.
An employee's hand was caught in a molding machine, resulting in several broken bones and requiring surgery.
An employee received burns to his neck, face, head, and both forearms after an aerosol paint can exploded, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving pallets of products on the warehouse floor. While repositioning an electric pallet jack, her foot was pinned between the pallet jack and an empty pallet. She was hospitalized with lacerations and fractures to the first, fourth, and fifth toes, requiring surgery.

Employees were using an extending boom forklift to move a dumpster. The injured employee was securing the dumpster to the forklift forks with chains. The employee's foot was leveraged against the side of a railing when the dumpster and forklift shifted slightly and pinched the employee's toes between the dumpster and the railing. As a result, two of the employee's right toes were amputated.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam in a rotary molder when it partially amputated two fingertips on the employee's right hand. The rotary molder was on at the time of the incident.

On February 1, 2020, a maintenance employee was using a de-greaser containing de-natured alcohol to re-ignite a charcoal grill when the de-greaser caught on fire and flashed/exploded. The employee suffered burns to his arm and face.

An employee was changing out air handler bearings, using a beltway to rotate a motor shaft. The drive belt rolled his gloved right index finger into the pulley sheave, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee fell from a rooftop, suffering two fractured ankles and a chin laceration.
An employee was removing blades from a cane knife when the blades amputated the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was unloading concert equipment using an automatic loader. The garage door on a ramp would not open; while the employee was trying to open it automatically, the automatic loader slipped, catching his right foot between the ramp and the I-beam underneath the garage door. His right second toe was medically amputated.
An employee was carrying cold cuts to a shelf when he tripped over a customer and fell to the floor, suffering a broken humerus.
While working with a client on a couch, an employee's leg became numb. When she stood up from the couch, she lost balance and fell, breaking her hip and pelvis.
An employee was snowboarding down a ski slope. The employee collided with a guest who had come to a sudden stop, and a two-way radio punctured the employee's abdomen and caused trauma to the spleen.
An employee was walking into work from her car on 02/03/2020 when she slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, fracturing her leg.
An employee was overcome by carbon monoxide while working behind a counter.
While walking into work, an employee slipped on ice that was on a sidewalk. The employee fell, suffering a broken ankle, and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was cleaning up the hardwood shaker area and attempted to pull a piece of metal out of a conveyor. The piece of metal then severely lacerated the employee's left thumb, resulting in a surgical thumb tip amputation. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut meat when the band saw lacerated and fractured her right middle and index fingertips. She was hospitalized.
On February 3, 2020, an employee was checking whether a recirculation pump was clean when the pump started. The pump's blade then partially amputated his left ring finger (entire nail area).
An employee was changing a tire on a school bus. While the spare was being lowered from under the bus, the ratchet strap came loose and pinched off the tip of the employee's index finger.
An employee was directing trucks at the company site yard. A truck ran over his feet, breaking the left one.
An employee fell off a 4-foot scaffold to the floor, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was struck by a 50-pound bag of onions while trying to free a stuck pallet on rolling racks. He suffered a spinal cord injury that caused paralysis.
An employee's middle finger was amputated by the hoist on a truck.
An employee was clearing metal debris from a press. The ram came down onto her forearm and broke it in two places.
An employee was walking down stairs. She fell at the last step, breaking her lower left hip.

A maintenance employee was in the shop cleaning up for the day when he took a juice container from a tool bucket and ingested it. He realized that it was not his drink and had a strange taste. He became ill and required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a rotating chain and sprocket using a cloth when his right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was preparing to weld the bottom flange on a steel channel when the steel channel fell on and smashed his middle finger, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was taking a piece of cut material off a hydraulic vise machine and asked a second employee to help. The second employee accidentally pushed the wrong button and activated the machine. The injured employee's hand was crushed between points of contact on the hydraulic vise, resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring finger and a crushed middle finger.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a head contusion and concussion.
An employee tripped over a bollard on ground level while walking and suffered a facial injury to the right cheek.
An employee was climbing a stepladder on a trailer. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground about 3 feet below, suffering a fracture near the right eye, a broken pelvis, and broken ribs.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering bruising.
An employee hooked up a hose and then tripped over it, fracturing the right hip on the ground.
While getting out of her car, an employee slipped and fell to the parking lot ground. She suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized.

At about 8:00 a.m. on February 3, 2020, an employee was cutting a 2-by-4 with a circular saw. The saw hit a knot, jumped, and struck the employee. It partially amputated his left thumb (below the nail) and lacerated his left index and middle fingers.
An employee walking through a parking lot to go to work slipped on ice and fractured his left leg.

On February 3, 2020, an employee was dumping a scrap hopper of metal into a larger hopper. The scrap hopper started to slide down the forks, and the employee's fingers were caught between the forks and the scrap hopper. Two of the employee's fingertips were amputated.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in a room and fell, breaking his left hip.
An employee was on a ladder retrieving parts in a back storage building when he fell off the ladder and landed on the floor. He was hospitalized for leg fractures.

Two employees had lifted a 200-pound hatch and attached a gas shock to the hatch assembly (to be prototyped as a hold-open device). A third employee reached up to pull on the hatch and determine the force needed for the hatch to close with the gas shock in place. The tack welds that held one end of the gas shock broke, causing the hatch to close on the employee's right hand. The employee's hand and fingers were broken and a tendon and an artery in the hand were torn.

An employee was building an electrical rack (support rack) with an 8' by 20' steel plate (2,200 lbs.). The employee was helping to hold the plate vertically while a forklift driver was trying to turn it over when the forklift bumped the steel plate, causing it to fall on top of the employee's legs. The employee suffered a broken right tibia, fibula, and femur.
While exiting the doghouse of a nitrogen unit, an employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a back injury.

At about 10:45 p.m. on February 3, 2020, an employee fell while pulling a pallet positioning cart into place to load cardboard into a packaging machine. The employee's head struck the concrete floor, causing a concussion and a laceration that required three stitches to close. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 3, 2020, an employee slipped and fell while stepping over some snow. He suffered a broken lower right leg.

An employee was repairing/troubleshooting a portable pressure washer whose belts were seizing up. His right hand was pulled into a nip point between the belt and pulley causing a partial amputation of his right middle finger. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was performing a rescue bag safety check and simulating a fall/recovery that resulted in an actual fall of approximately 15 feet. The employee suffered fractured heels. Fall protection was not attached at the time of the incident.

An employee was leaving a client's home after delivering food. While stepping down in the icy conditions, the employee fell from the porch to the ground and suffered compound fractures to her left leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was using a leaf blower when the rotor cut her left index finger. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell in the parking lot at a satellite location and fractured a hip.
An employee tripped while measuring the length of a beam. He fell to the ground and broke his right arm.
An employee was walking through the parking ramp from her car and was struck by a vehicle going 5-10 mph. She suffered an open fracture on the right leg.
On February 3, 2020, an employee was loading a snow pusher attachment onto a trailer for transport when the employee's hand was crushed by the snow pusher, resulting in amputated fingers.
A security guard was assaulted by a homeless person with a pipe while walking around the building, suffering a head injury.

An employee was unloading new equipment from a pallet skid. The employee was removing the strapping from a panel when it became dislodged from the transportation skid and began to tip. The employee attempted to balance the paneling but succumbed to the size. The panel continued to tip and caught the employee's finger between the panel and the parked forklift's mast, resulting in a partial amputation to the right ring finger from the nail bed to the tip.

An employee was returning to work from lunch. While talking to another employee on the other side of a closing access gate, the employee leaned against the gate before it completely stopped. His left hand was caught in the top roll bar of the gate, crushing the left fourth digit and requiring an amputation of the tip.
An employee was closing a gate when the employee's left hand was pinched between the gate's roller, resulting in a broken left hand and a laceration.
An employee was walking down the stairs when she missed the last step and fell to the ground, breaking her right femur and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a ladder stocking items when the employee fell off the ladder to the floor, suffering a head injury.
An employee was using a bailer when it crushed his left hand. The ring and middle fingers were medically amputated.

An employee was operating a bending machine. He was putting pieces of trim in the machine. His fingers were on the top of a metal piece when the machine was activated via the foot pedal. The machine amputated his left index finger and crushed his right index and middle fingers.
An employee was stepping off a ladder at a client's home. The ladder slipped out from the employee, who fell to the ground, suffering injuries to the back and buttocks. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was taking out a small trash cart. The employee picked up the cart to dump the trash, and the cart slipped out of the employee's hand. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the cart and a dumpster, sustaining a partial amputation.

An employee was performing nursing rounds and caregiving activities for patients at the psychiatric unit of the hospital. A patient pulled the fire alarm in an attempt to escape, and threw water on the floor behind him as he was running. The employee ran after the patient, caught him, and brought him back to the unit. The patient became combative and bit the employee's finger and both of them slipped on the water and fell to the floor. Once the patient was secured back in their room, the employee went to the emergency room for a laceration he sustained when the patient bit his finger. The employee was then hospitalized for a heart attack.
An employee was operating and reversing a standup forklift. The forklift collided with a stationary pallet jack, resulting in a left ankle and heel contusion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a belt guide under a cutting machine. His right hand was pulled between two rollers and the index and middle fingers were injured.
An employee was going down the stairs of a school bus when she slipped and fell, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was doing maintenance on ventilation fans. A fan belt pulled his left hand toward a pulley, where the tip of his middle finger was amputated.
An employee was installing flashing materials on a second-floor roof, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ankles.

On February 4, 2020, an employee was coming down off the rooftop of a building after checking on a humidifier issue on an air handler. The employee climbed down from the roof via a fixed ladder. In order to close the roof hatch, the lock must slide out. When the employee slid the lock, the hatch was caught by the wind and came down. The employee's finger was caught between the hatch and the frame, resulting in an open fracture of the left index finger/partial amputation.

A forklift was carrying a double-stacked load approximately 12 feet high. The load fell while the forklift operator was attempting to stage the pallets, striking an employee working in the area. The employee sustained a broken ankle and elbow and a head laceration that required 24 staples.
An employee turned to reach for container lids, fell to the floor, and landed on her right elbow. She was hospitalized with a fractured elbow.
An employee was holding a part to deburr it on a drill machine when the employee's gloved hand became caught in the drill, resulting in amputations to two fingers.
A employee was operating a standup forklift when it malfunctioned and threw her into a storage rack. She suffered an 8-inch cut on the arm that required surgery.

On February 4, 2020, an employee was bent over to re-stock a lower bin/shelf when he stood up and struck his head/face on a plastic shelving bin. He suffered a subdural hematoma and acute subdural bleed over a chronic bleed in the frontal lobe of the brain, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was on a ladder repairing a light fixture. The employee fell to the ground while coming down the ladder, detaching the muscle in both knees.

An employee was on a step ladder changing belts out on an exhaust fan for preventative maintenance when he reached to steady himself and his left pinky finger was caught between the fan's belt and pulley. As a result, his pinky fingertip was amputated. The fan was turned off but still turning at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to blow out the core box mold to make sure it was clear from residual sand when the machine cycled unexpectedly, pinching his left index finger between the pin and the cup. His finger was amputated at the first knuckle (mid-nail). The machine was in automatic mode at the time of the incident.
An employee was doing maintenance on a feed auger. The auger activated and amputated the employee's right index finger at the middle joint.
An employee tripped over a plastic tote while pulling a customer's order. The employee fell and fractured the left hip.
An employee was unjamming a log on a reject log deck. The employee slipped and the chain conveyor caught his right foot, lacerating the foot and ankle.

An employee was running the breading machine. He looked into the product entry opening and saw breading had clotted up inside. He was attempting to remove the clot when his right hand contacted a conveyor belt flap inside the machine, resulting in a right middle fingertip amputation.
An employee was starting up a horizontal injection machine when the employee's right arm was caught by the park takeout area chute, resulting in an arm fracture.

An employee had completed measuring the second floor of a new residential construction project for insulation and was stepping onto the top tread of a temporary staircase to go down to the first floor. When he stepped down and placed body weight onto the top tread, the staircase gave way, causing him to fall approximately 16 feet into the basement. He struck the back of his head on the basement floor or plywood on the first floor, rendering him unconscious. He received four broken ribs, a broken scapula, a broken clavicle, and broken vertebrae.

An employee was attempting to clean a conveyor machine part when his left index finger became caught on the conveyor, resulting in  the amputation of his fingertip. The conveyor was running at the time of the incident.

An employee was attempting to remove a mirror off a wall from a 6-foot ladder when the mirror fell and struck the ladder, causing the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground. He suffered a right femur fracture.

At about 1:00 p.m. on February 5, 2020, an employee was disassembling a 40-gallon water expansion tank to scrap it. Pressurized air from a bladder in the tank discharged when a flange bolt was removed, causing the flange to strike and injure the employee's face.

An employee was stringing film in a packaging machine during a product change-over when his right hand entered the area of the machine that cuts film, resulting in an amputation to the right ring fingertip.
An employee was descending a tree using a rope tied at the top. The knot came undone and the rope and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right leg and wrist.

An employee was working on an overhead garage door opener, reprogramming the controller. He was approximately 5 to 6 feet up on a 10-foot A-frame ladder when the door was opened. He reached for the door and lost his balance on the ladder, falling to the concrete floor. He suffered a broken right tibia and fibula and a right shoulder rotator injury.

On February 5, 2020, at approximately 11:45 a.m., an employee was operating a stand-up forklift when his foot made contact with a storage rack as he drove past it. He was hospitalized with four fractured toes of the left foot.
