On February 5, 2020, at approximately 11:46 a.m., an employee was slicing ham on a manual slicer in the employee dining room when his thumb contacted the blade, resulting in a severe laceration and possible amputation.
An employee was pulling a cart loaded with aluminum bars inside. A caster hung up on the floor and the cart tipped over onto his right leg. He suffered a broken right femur.

An employee was pulling a 150-200 lbs. wheeled fire extinguisher unit up a 6" lip when he lost his balance, slipped, and fell backwards down a nearby grading of stairs. The wheeled fire extinguisher unit fell with the employee and landed on his right hand. His right hand sustained multiple injuries including a broken index and middle finger.

On February 5, 2020, an employee was training a new employee on a notcher machine, which creates half moon-shaped notches on pallets. The employee changed the setting on the machine to create notches on 50-inch long lumber. The machine then jammed and he immediately pushed the E-stop button. He attempted to remove the jammed piece of wood with his left hand when the machine's blade caused an amputation of his left thumb tip and index fingertip with bone loss.

While loading and positioning a new empty scrap box onto a line, a fork truck accidentally struck the corner of the box.  This caused the empty box to shift, striking the employee who was at the controls of the lift for the box. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was stocking shelves using a top stock ladder cart when the employee fell from the third step (approximately 29 inches) to the ground, suffering neck and back injuries that required hospitalization.

On February 5, 2020, at approximately 4:30 PM, an employee was holding a rigging chain that was part of a drill bar set. The load was released, causing the rigging chain to swivel. The chain hook caught and crushed the employee's left middle fingertip, resulting in a medical amputation.

On February 5, 2020, at approximately 5:00 p.m., two employees were using acetylene torches to dismantle an industrial tank. A small piece of steel fell to the floor, creating a small spark that resulted in a flash fire. The first employee sustained first and second degree burns. The second employee sustained first and second degree burns and a possible lung injury. Both were hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a machine's feed rollers when his left hand became stuck and injured in the rollers.
An employee was using an overhead crane to put a piece of metal scrap in a dumpster. A stack of beams turned over and pinned the employee, injuring the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee poured a diesel fuel additive into his truck to prevent the fuel from gelling up in extremely cold weather. Afterwards, he placed the half-emptied bottle in the cab of the truck. While driving the truck he became ill due to exposure to the diesel fuel additive.

An employee was entering the building carrying a briefcase and his lunch when he lost his balance while opening the door. He fell down six outside steps, resulting in a fractured arm and contusions to the head and knee.

An employee was filling the cup and lid dispensing mechanism of a packing machine when the lids became jammed. She was able to remove all lids that were stacked in the dispensing mechanism, but one lid was jammed between the stacking mechanism and the lidding stomper. As she attempted to remove this lid, her right index fingertip was pinched between the lid stomper and the rotating table (nest plates), resulting in the amputation of the fingertip right above the nail bed.

An employee was grinding a rubber roller on a manual lathe. The employee's right hand came into contact with the grinding wheel and the employee's right middle and index fingers were partially amputated.
An employee was loading 55 bags of mulch in a trailer when he slipped off the trailer to the ground and broke a bone in his right shoulder.
An employee suffered a foot injury while driving a forklift.

On February 5, 2020, at approximately 8:45 a.m., an employee was operating a forklift. While backing-up the forklift and making a left turn, the employee's left foot was caught between a guardrail and the outside frame of the forklift, resulting in fractures to the 4th and 5th distal bones of the left foot. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
On February 5, 2020, an employee was running a rewind slitting machine when his left arm was caught in between the rollers, crushing his left arm up to the elbow.
An employee was using a power washer when it slipped from his hands and cut his right forearm.
An employee was stocking shelves from a "high low" powered industrial vehicle and fell onto the warehouse floor. The employee suffered a broken hip, elbow and ankle and a head injury.
On February 5, 2020, an employee was rolling up a hose to load it into a fire truck when the hose jerked forward and jolted him. He suffered a hernia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was working near a rebar cage when it came loose and struck the employee. The employee suffered brain bleeding, fractured vertebrae, and broken ribs.
Employees were using steam to soften and unclog an asphalt blow line. The asphalt released under pressure and burned two employees' arms and hands. They were hospitalized.

An employee was walking toward the back of the store when the employee slipped and fell on the wet floor, which a third-party was stripping. The employee was hospitalized with a head contusion that required staples and three injured ribs.
An employee fell while retrieving a part from an aisle and struck his head on the floor, losing consciousness.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder, changing a light ballast. The ballast broke free and hit his right eye, cutting it; he fell off the ladder and suffered a broken right leg.

Two electricians were troubleshooting an HVAC (condenser) unit in a control room. Both employees went to the control room and applied group lockout to a single disconnect rated at 250 VDC power. After locking out the power to the control room and condenser unit, the employees began troubleshooting several deficiencies they observed while looking through the control panel. After repairing those items, the two employees removed the locks and validated that the repairs were working. The employees observed everything working as required except the HVAC compressor. The injured employee went up to the condenser area on an elevated walking surface that was covered in blaze which is a byproduct of the coke produced at the plant. The accumulation of blaze created an uneven surface. The employee had to remove an exterior covering or guard to validate that 250 VDC was coming from the thermostat to the junction box on the compressor motor. The employee squatted down and lost his balance before checking for 250 VDC. The employee reached to catch himself and in doing so grabbed the belts that drive the compressor motor. When contact was made, the motor began running and the employee's left hand was pulled through the pulleys amputating his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was moving a mobile conveyor for her workstation (a 300-ton press). The employee's left ring and little fingers got caught on the conveyor and the fingertips were amputated.

An employee was working on an assembly line when he attempted to free a pallet that was stuck in the pallet elevator. When he released the pallet, a proximity switch was activated, causing the machine to cycle. His left arm was then caught between the pallet and the elevator, resulting in a lower left arm fracture.
An employee was making a delivery using a liftgate trailer when he lost his footing on the liftgate step and fell to the concrete ground, requiring hospitalization.
Alloy from a crane hook piece flipped onto an employee's left hand and pinched off the tip of the ring finger.
An employee was hanging a cable TV drop on a customer's home. The employee fell onto the driveway and suffered broken ribs.
An employee had been driving a truck. He stopped and climbed up a dumpster. He then slipped and fell approximately 5.5 feet from the dumpster, suffering a head laceration and left knee injury.
On February 06, 2020, an employee was cutting rebar using a rebar machine when the machine was inadvertently activated via the foot pedal, resulting in the amputation of his left middle finger.
An employee was pushing a cart with manufacturing materials in boxes. The cart went over a cleanup hose and tipped over; the employee fell onto it, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee slipped on a truck's lift gate and fell, suffering broken ribs and a ruptured spleen. The employee was hospitalized.
On February 6, 2020, an employee fell from a ladder to the ground about 20 feet below. The employee suffered broken bones and was hospitalized.
An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move inventory. His foot was pinned between the pallet jack and a pallet.
An employee was taking care of a client in her home. The house caught fire. The employee suffered smoke inhalation while trying to get the client out of the house. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying linen through a door when the door closed on his right hand. His little fingertip was amputated.
On February 6, 2020, an employee was clearing a jam in an envelope folding machine when his right index finger was amputated in the machine's cylinder.
An employee was crimping wire ends. The handle on the crimper machine kept getting stuck; as the employee tried to get it to release, it smashed and lacerated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee dismounted from a pallet truck, which then moved. Its handle pinned the employee against a rack, causing a ruptured spleen.
On February 6, 2020, an employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, breaking an ankle and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was cutting slat boards with a cut-off saw. The saw/guard control was activated while her right hand was under the pneumatic guard. The guard came down and the saw blade started and came up, amputating her right index, middle, and ring fingers and the tip of the little finger.
An employee was on a delivery truck, helping a forklift operator unload it. He slipped and fell from the trailer, suffering fractures to the right tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking down stairs when she fell and broke her leg.
An employee was snowboarding downhill to report to his lift station. He suffered a concussion and a broken jaw.
An employee was operating a printing machine. The machine's moving parts amputated the employee's right middle finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was snowboarding down a mountain after his shift. He collided with an ascending snowmobile, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was removing wood cladding from the ceiling when a piece fell and struck him on the hardhat, knocking him down. He sustained a concussion.
An employee was testing a fan when its blade cut off the tip of the employee's middle finger.
At about 10:30 a.m. on February 6, 2020, an employee was delivering bulk oil to a customer's property. The employee suffered a hernia while pulling open a large, heavy shed door and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail at a residence. The employee slipped on ice while walking down a ramp and fell to the ground, suffering a broken foot.
An employee jumped down from a garbage truck and was pushed into a garbage pile by a bulldozer. The employee suffered a broken femur and lacerations from the dozer's bucket.
An employee knelt on a pebble while stocking bottom shelves. His left knee became infected.
While leaving a production line, an employee tripped on a pallet and fell, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was attempting to remove debris from inside a kiln. His right wrist and forearm were pulled into a chain and sprocket, sustaining lacerations.

An employee was working from a walk board that was elevated by two A-frame step ladders to place metal sheeting on the roof of a newly constructed protective structure for an outside air compressor. The employee fell about four feet from the walk board and was injured.

An employee was driving an ATV when it ran over a fallen tree branch. The branch popped up and went through the ATV's floor, striking the employee. The employee suffered a broken arm, a bleeding spleen and liver, and a head laceration.

An employee was at the back of a building, unloading a truck of goods using a forklift. A truck entered the back driveway (followed by a police car) and struck the employee on the forklift. The employee suffered internal bleeding.
An employee was trying to reinstall a cover on a machine she was operating. A machine belt caught her glove and pulled in her left hand, causing a partial amputation of the index finger.
An employee was on a 5-foot mobile platform removing window tint. He fell from the platform, suffering a broken fibula and a head injury that required seven stitches.
An employee stepped out of a forklift, which then pinned the employee's leg.
While carrying towels, an employee slipped on liquid air freshener on the ground and fell, suffering a broken leg.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken ankle.

On February 7, 2020, an employee was running an overhead conduit pipe from a 6-foot A-frame ladder when the ladder's spreader bar came off, causing him to fall about 4 to 5 feet to the ground. He fractured his right elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the inclined portion of a covered parking garage surface. The employee slipped and fell on ice, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee was grabbing some insulation. Its weight shifted, causing the work knife in his hand to lacerate his stomach.

An employee was moving a pallet with a piece of equipment on it. The pallet started to shift and the equipment struck the employee's left hand and arm, causing a fractured wrist and a large cut on the arm.

An employee was picking up a patient from the hospital. As the employee was transferring a wheelchair to the van, the patient slipped. The employee strained herself while trying to lift the patient. The employee sat down and experienced chest pain.
An employee tripped and fell in the parking lot while walking to a car, fracturing the right leg.
Two employees were removing fence chain links at an event area. The fence chain links came down and amputated one employee's fingertip.

An employee was connecting a trailer to a truck. He lowered the trailer's landing gear so the trailer could be connected. The landing gear handle sprung back when released, striking his right arm below the elbow and breaking it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating and standing on a dock plate when he slipped. While trying to catch himself, his right middle and ring fingers were pinched in between the plate's joint and lip, causing an avulsion to the soft tissue on the fingers.
An employee was opening a store. While marking her way toward the alarm to disarm it, she slipped and fell on the tile, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee was trying to clear a jam from a welding machine. When the jam was cleared, the machine smashed the employee's right middle finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking through entrance sliding doors when the employee tripped on a mat that was in the doorway and fell onto the floor, fracturing the right knee.
On February 7, 2020, an employee was operating an up-cut saw to cut 2 x 12's when he made contact with the spinning circular blade, resulting in a partial amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was driving an off-road dump truck at a construction site. The truck went into a hole in a snow-covered area; the employee suffered cracked ribs and a punctured lung and spleen.

An employee and the company owner were working in aerial lift buckets, converting a single-phase line to a three-phase line. The employee came into contact with an energized line and suffered burns to both arms, both elbows, and the right hand.

An employee was sweeping a bedroom on the second floor of a new-built residence. She backed into a hallway and fell from a balcony in a place where the guardrail had not been completed. She landed about 12 feet below, on stairs at the bottom of a stairway; she then rolled down to the floor. She suffered three broken ribs on the left side, as well as a fractured lower-back vertebra.

An employee was working in a plant's coating area where pipes came down a rack. A 24-inch pipe rolled down the rack and did not stop at the bumper, rolling over the employee's entire body but stopping before reaching the head. The employee suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
On February 7, 2020, an employee collapsed while running during training due to dehydration, resulting in acute kidney damage and hospitalization.

An employee was placing a 4-inch by 8-inch piece of sheet metal in a punch press. When the press was activated, the metal shifted and pinched his glove and the tip of his right index finger against the fiberglass guard on the machine. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
A an employee was cycling a brake press when it caught the tip of her right thumb, causing an amputation to the thumbtip.
An employee fell while walking near a trailer. Her head struck the trailer and was injured.
A bakery machine roller crushed an employee's arm. She was hospitalized.
Two employees were repositioning a patient in bed when one of them suffered a back injury.

An employee was standing on a sidewalk in front of the building when he was hit by a stray bullet during a police chase of a suspect who was running down the street. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a scaffold 6 feet high, filling wall cavities with a pump truck hose, when the hose hit him in the face and knocked him to the ground. He was hospitalized with head trauma.

An employee was troubleshooting a die cast machine. The top part of the die plunged at high velocity and hot metal was expelled, causing second- and third-degree burns to the employee's right arm, chest, and face.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press to straighten out a rolling cart when their right pinky finger was pinched in the press and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was conducting a security patrol when they slipped and fell on ice on a walkway, sustaining a fractured ankle.

At 5:15 AM, the crew had started drilling horizontal holes in an island slab. At 5:45 AM, an employee noticed a hole had been drilled 1/2 inch off from the correct location. To correct the issue, an employee grabbed a drill, thinking that it had stopped running, but the drill was still on. The employee's glove was caught in the drill bit resulting in an amputation of the top of the employee's middle finger.
An employee was pushing a cart that was full of water. The cart got hung up on some carpet and the employee flipped over the top of the cart and landed on her back, sustaining a back injury.
An employee was working the tray line and turned to reach for an item when she tripped and fell sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was sitting in a chair at the parts counter. When he pushed back away from the counter, the chair tipped over causing the employee to fall onto the floor and fracture a hip.

Employees were operating a baggage tractor on a service road. The tractor made contact with an aircraft's left wing and the seat of the tractor was ripped off. The employees were thrown to the ground. Two employees were hospitalized with injuries including a chipped tooth, bruises and abrasions, a dislocated hip, a fractured humerus bone, and a laceration to the left knee.
An employee was cutting a fallen tree when his feet became entangled in the branches. The employee fell backwards and broke his left femur.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on an overhead ground beef take-up conveyor and its motor/gearbox assembly. The employee's left arm was caught in the moving conveyor and skin was burned/removed.

An employee was helping a discharged patient walk out of the emergency room. The patient started to fall and the employee went to brace the patient using her foot and felt a pop in her back. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was standing near a cannon-type heater trying to warm himself. The employee's shirt ignited due to contact with the heater. The employee sustained second degree burns to the left front, side, and back torso, and the left thumb, fingers, and palm.
A football player was blocking during an offensive play when an opposing player fell onto him and dislocated his left knee.
An employee was struck by a forklift during offloading operations and sustained a broken lower leg and ankle and five broken ribs.
On February 9, 2020, an employee was brushing snow from her vehicle in a parking lot when she slipped and fell, breaking her left ankle.

On Feb 9, 2020, at approximately 7:15 PM, an employee was moving between two large fixtures in the storage room to get through to another aisle. The employee struggled to get through and fell onto the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip.
An employee was walking away from the blancher after turning it off. The blancher then shot out hot water which burned the employee's back, neck, and shoulder.

An employee was unloading lumber from a railcar. Railcars have ladders welded to each side for employees to enter/exit. The employee was climbing down one of the railcar ladders and slipped and fell between 6 and 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured back, dislocated shoulder, and laceration to the top of the head.
An employee's right thumb tip was pinched in a hoist hook resulting in amputation of the thumb tip without loss of bone.
An employee was bitten by a venomous spider while landscaping and had a severe reaction to the venom that required hospitalization.
An employee was feeding a hopper when her right middle finger was caught in the auger, resulting in a middle finger amputation.

An employee was walking around a school bus conducting a pre-trip inspection. The employee slipped and fell on ice that was covered by fresh snow and sustained a broken ankle requiring hospitalization.
An employee lost her balance and fell to the floor, injuring her hip and back. She was hospitalized and required hip surgery.

An employee was adjusting a sensor inside of a de-stacker machine. The machine was then activated and the injured employee was struck by the suction cup carriage as it came down resulting in fractured ribs and a fractured shoulder that required hospitalization. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was getting her lunch bag from the lunch room. Her right hand was on the hinge side of the door when the door closed and amputated her middle fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the tailbone and lower back.

An employee was closing up the personal water craft (PWC) rentals. While operating one of the PWC's, he took a sharp turn and hit a wave. The employee then contacted the dash and handles. He sustained a hernia which required surgery.

On February 10, 2020, an employee was gathering runners from a conveyor belt when the employee's finger was caught between the guard and the belt, pulling the employee's left hand into the belt. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left wrist.
An employee was hand stacking cases when he tripped and fell forward, hitting his head on a lab station desk. He was hospitalized with a forehead contusion.
An employee walking in the work area slipped on a puddle of water and fell sustaining head and arm injuries.
An employee was walking from her vehicle to the workplace when she slipped and fell on ice that was covered by fresh snow. She sustained a broken left leg that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on the kitchen floor and sustained a fractured right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to her car when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, breaking her lower right leg.
An employee was manually rotating a belt pulley during oil servicing. The employee's left hand was pulled into the pulley system, resulting in amputation of the middle and ring fingertips.
At about 8:30 AM, an employee was opening a scrubber pot. Flammable gasses escaped from the pot and ignited. The employee sustained burns to the hands and face and was hospitalized.

An employee was ascending a portable ladder attached to a telephone pole in order to replace a coaxial cable known as a "cable drop." The ladder was resting against the telephone pole and was connected to the base with a ladder strap. While climbing, the employee fell approximately 16 feet from the ladder to the ground and sustained multiple fractures to the lower limbs.
An employee suffered burns to the neck and back from hot water and steam while cleaning a processing kettle.

An employee was working on an extruder when he went into the winder to re-thread the sheet. He asked his helper to position the turret forward to gain access to the sheet roll. When the helper rotated the turret, the employee was caught between the idle roller and the pull roll guard. The injured employee sustained fractured ribs.

An employee was on the loading dock while another employee was using a forklift to load a trailer. As the employee turned to get a pallet jack, the employee's foot became pinched between the rear of the forklift and the dock plate. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle and tendon damage.
An employee was polishing a roll on a grinding lathe and contacted the headstock of the lathe, resulting in lacerations and a fractured left shoulder.

An employee was attempting to load a rough terrain forklift onto a flatbed trailer. The forklift slipped off the trailer onto its side and the employee suffered a fractured pelvis and three fractured ribs.

An employee was on a 5-foot ladder repairing a hydraulic valve and changing the internal packing. He used pressurized air to push the piston up. He then bled the fluid out of the valve. Once he removed the last bolt, pressure released, and the valve housing struck the employee in the rib area knocking him off the ladder. The employee sustained bruised ribs and back pain.

Employees were working on a press machine that had a mold that was leaking rubber. The employees proceeded towards the control panel to manually lower the mold. The injured employee entered the machine between the front knock-out slides, with a flashlight and approached the mold. Upon starting the inspection of the donut, the employee heard a suction sound. The employee was startled as the top plate came down and he quickly turned his head down and away from the front side of the machine. The employee struck his forehead on the left side rails and then fell backwards and struck the backside of his head on the opposite rail. The employee received staples to the back of the head and stitches to an eye and was hospitalized for a concussion.

An employee was working as a net mender, tasked with positioning the nets for fishing operations. While the employee was wrapping a rope around the cathead to position the net, his left hand was caught in the cathead and he was wrapped around the cathead several times. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated left forearm.

An employee was on a ladder prepping a house to install insulation when the ladder slipped out from under him. He fell 12 to 15 feet to the ground, landing on his lower back and breaking his tailbone.
An employee was trying to remove a cat from a warehouse. The cat bit the employee's knuckle.
An employee was walking down an aisle way and tripped over a box of flowers. The employee fell on the floor and sustained a fractured right shoulder.

An employee was working from a floating platform to remove a concrete form when a wave in the water caused the platform to rise up above the protective bumpers. His left little finger was then caught between the formwork bolt and the platform, causing a partial amputation of the left little finger.
An employee was descending from the third floor deck in an aerial lift and made contact with a 69-Kv power line. The employee sustained flash burns to the face.

A delivery truck with a flatbed semi-trailer was parked in the yard. The back end of the trailer has a hydraulic dovetail to facilitate drive-on/drive off loading and unloading. It was in the down position. The injured employee drove a scissor lift and parked it over the tail end lip of the lowered dovetail. With the unit placed against the dovetail, the injured employee initiated testing of the pothole protection system and began lifting the basket. The delivery truck driver, unaware of the scissor lift's presence, used a remote to lift the dovetail to its travel position so he could depart. The dovetail lifted the scissor lift and caused it to tip over with the injured employee in it. The employee fell 10-12 feet to the ground and sustained a fractured pelvis.
While setting up a dining table an employee fell to the ground and injured their hip.
An employee was setting a garbage tote back on the ground after emptying it into the back of a garbage truck when the arm of the garbage truck sprung open and struck his right leg, fracturing it.
An employee was leaving a breakroom. While she was holding the door open for another employee, the door slammed on her right little finger. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was patching drywall from a stepladder and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken ankle.

An employee was water jetting a clogged section of pipe when the employee lost their grip and the water jet line forced itself back out of the pipe due to the pressure. The water jet pierced the employee's left glove and punctured the left hand as it came out of the pipe.

An aerial crew was lashing a span of fiber telecommunications line when the fiber rose under tension and contacted the overhead primary electrical line. An employee working out of the bucket sustained burns to both hands and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a router to duplicate chair parts in plywood. She was feeding the corner of the material into the spinning bit when the bit grabbed the material and spun it out of her control. She suffered a deep laceration to the left index finger.
An employee was attempting to de-escalate an agitated student when the student head-butted the employee. The employee sustained a concussion.

On February 11, 2020, an employee was using a handheld circular saw to cut a plastic barrel when the saw slipped and struck the employee's left leg above the knee, causing a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder preparing a wall for an electric conduit when he became unbalanced and fell 8 to 10 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a head laceration and a broken arm. He was hospitalized.

An employee was in the back of his trailer offloading a 1500 lb. crate for a customer. There were two straps on the crate holding it to the wall. He released a strap so the customer could unload the crate completely. When he released the strap, the crate tipped over onto him. He sustained a broken shoulder, broken ribs, and an ear contusion.
An employee fell to the ground while picking up a cracker box, suffering a fractured pelvis.

An employee was picking up parts from a plastic bin on the floor. When the employee turned around, she caught the edge of the pan with her foot, causing her to fall onto the cement floor.  She landed on her left side and sustained injuries to the left tibial plateau, right ankle medial/lateral malleolus, and right metatarsal.
An employee slipped onto a cement mixer while it was being cleaned. His right forearm was caught in the mixer and he sustained lacerations to the right arm.

On February 11, 2020, an employee was carrying roof decking material into the active area of the roof deck replacement. The employee stumbled and fell through an open hole in the roof deck and landed on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the spinal cord and wrist.

An employee had just finished painting a metal carriage for battery handling. The employee was pulling the carriage out of a paint booth to put it in a blast oven when it slipped out of the employee's hand and the momentum from pulling it caused the employee to fall to the ground. The employee broke the left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a forklift operator when the forklift's wheel ran over his left foot. He suffered detached ligaments and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a truck with pieces of granite. A piece of granite rolled onto the employee's hand and amputated the end joint of his finger.
An employee was using a clamp when the clamp closed on his finger resulting in a partial amputation of the left index fingertip.

An employee was trying to attach a ground power unit (GPU) to the rear hitch of a tug. As the employee was pulling the tongue of the GPU, his left hand was caught between it and the hitch of the tug. The employee suffered an amputation of a fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was attempting to unjam a stick recovery machine when he was caught between the metal kicker and the metal frame. He was hospitalized with internal injuries in the abdominal area and kidney damage.

An employee was performing maintenance on a golf cart that was on a jack lift when the cart moved while the employee was working underneath it and fell on the employee. The employee suffered four broken ribs and an air pocket in the lung. The cart was not in park at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking down concrete steps toward his vehicle when he fell onto his right knee on the concrete. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was painting a tank car when his left hand came in contact with the spray from the paint sprayer, puncturing his left index finger. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was using a two-handed drill to make holes in the wall studs for piping, and was standing on a ladder. When the drill bit came through the wall stud, it caught the employee's sleeve and lacerated his left forearm.

Employees were moving 10x10-foot panels to screw onto a structure. The crane that was being used made the structure move, hitting an employee who was on a ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and sustained a fractured pelvis.
While delivering building products to a residential jobsite, an employee slipped and fell from a rooftop to the ground below. The employee sustained fractured vertebra and ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while walking out of a refrigeration room, breaking her right hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee entered a silo (tank) to clean the remainder of the grain from it and handle the sweeper machine. While the other sweepers were operating, he stepped back and his foot went inside the sweeper. The sweeper machine caught his boot first and then his foot, causing an open wound and broken bone.

An employee was removing material from a roof and loading it into a wheel barrel when he lost his balance and fell through an intact skylight to the concrete floor below. He suffered a broken collarbone, three fractured ribs, and a crushed vertebra, and he required staples in his head.
An employee was driving a golf cart when it was struck by a guest's car. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
While descending a ladder from a roof, an employee fell 8 feet from the second story, rolled down the roof and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist and a concussion.

An employee was working as an event specialist, tasked with performing product demonstrations. While she was in the backroom looking for a water sprayer, she tripped and fell, injuring her hip. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
Employees were moving a large electrical cabinet when it tipped over, striking an employee. The injured employee sustained a fracture and ligament damage requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking on metal mesh to retrieve a tool. The mesh panel gave way and the employee fell 27 feet to the floor, suffering broken hips and legs.

An employee was helping building maintenance install a new dock plate. While the employee was installing the dock plate by hand, the dock plate shifted and caught the employee's gloved hand, pinching it between the new dock plate and the concrete dock. As a result, the employee's right thumb tip was amputated.

On February 11, 2020, an employee was using a hose to spray off equipment. The employee attempted to move a conveyor belt, but its casters were locked; the employee's left hand slipped into the running conveyor belt, which amputated the middle fingertip.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine's conveyor when his fingers were caught in a nip-point between the belt and roller, amputating the fingertips of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was cutting baseboards with a circular saw. The saw amputated the employee's left ring finger and cut the employee's left little finger.
While disconnecting a quick-connect hose fitting, an employee's finger was pinched between the quick-connect fitting and a steel pallet resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee working at the salad bar was filling a food processor when her fingers contacted the blade. The employee sustained amputations to two fingertips before the nails.

An employee was walking up to the front door of a residence to deliver a parcel when he missed the first step leading up to the door, causing him to lose his balance and fall onto his left side on the concrete pavement ground. He was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.

An employee was operating a crane with a clamshell bucket attachment. The anti-two-block device came free from the main line and fell into the operator's cab after bouncing down the boom. The employee suffered a broken right arm and a major contusion of the right thigh. He was hospitalized.

Employees at an oil rig were breaking down its blowout preventers. After removing the preventers from the wellhead, they put a wooden board on the ground to set the preventer on and keep it from getting muddy. When one employee unhooked his tagline from a preventer, the preventer shifted and the locking stem on its top struck the top of the employee's left boot. He suffered a laceration to the foot and two broken toes.

An employee was cleaning around an edger saw using an air wand. The employee was removing a piece of wood lodged in the edger when its rollers caught his coat sleeve and broke his right hand in three places.

An employee was standing behind a winch truck. The truck rolled back and ran over the employee's left leg. The employee suffered a thigh injury, a head laceration, and bruising to the right-side ribs.

A maintenance employee was performing repairs on a CNC machine.  The automatic tool changer (ATC) door next to the tool arm was misaligned, and the employee was removing it. The employee manually turned the tool arm which caused the door to actuate and shut suddenly pinching the employee's left hand and causing a partial amputation of the distal phalanx of the middle finger.

An employee was helping in loading operations involving a chain sling and crane. Sheets of steel shifted in the load, and a finger on the employee's left hand was caught and crushed between the sling and the material. The finger was amputated.
An employee was repairing a food processor when a blade in it cut his finger. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

After a concrete bucket was filled from a chute, the chute was raised up and crushed the left little finger of the employee who had been filling the bucket. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was standing on an upper deck unclogging a cyclone. A steam release caused an explosion panel in the hopper to blow out toward the employee, who suffered a third-degree steam burn to the face.
An employee was setting filters in molds in a molding machine. The employee's leg was pinched and broken between the foundry mold carriage and a roller bracket.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. The employee's foot was pinned between the pallet jack's platform and a stack of pallets, sustaining a contusion.

On February 12, 2020, at approximately 7:10 AM, an employee was preparing to load liquid feed into a truck. As the employee applied additional force to release a transfer hose cap that was stuck, the hose cap popped up and struck him on the right side of his face. The employee sustained a fractured orbital bone and fractured nasal bones as well as a laceration to the nose and an abrasion to the right side of the face. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
On February 12, 2020, an employee was checking the water level at a riverbank. The employee slipped on a rock and fell 4 feet to the water's edge, suffering a broken left leg.

A forklift was lifting a block cart so an employee could hit the caster wheel with a "dead sledge" in an attempt to straighten the wheel. Due to the striking of the caster wheel, the block cart shifted and slipped on the forks, which caused the base plate to slide off the block cart. The employee lost his balance and fell to the ground. The base plate slid and struck the employee's left leg causing a broken left femur.

An employee was welding an impeller section when the impeller shifted and he tried to grab it. The impeller spun and struck his left leg, causing a fracture to the left tibial plateau that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was walking to her truck to retrieve a set of gloves while preparing for feedlot bedding operations. A front loader emptied a load onto the bedding wagon. The loader then backed up and the employee was knocked to the ground by the loader's bucket, and then run over. The employee sustained fractures to five lower vertebrae.

An employee was walking into the bag room in a golf cart barn when he tripped over a golf bag on the barn floor. He fell onto his hands and knees, and a nearby chair struck this throat and chest; he suffered broken vertebrae, three cracked ribs, and a torn esophagus.

An employee was installing insulation. As she was drilling a hole into the metal insulation, her cut resistant gloves got caught in the drill bit and her left index finger was smashed between the drill bit and the metal insulation. Her left index fingertip was amputated.

At 8:15 a.m. on February 12, 2020, a Roll-Rite employee was installing a tarp system for a trailer when his left little finger was caught between a cable and a pulley. The fingertip was pinched off. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on wet, sloping ground near the base of a tree. He fell and was knocked unconscious, also suffering a bruised shoulder.
An employee was using a forklift to empty a dump bin when their left index finger was caught and smashed in a pinch point between the forks and the dump bin resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was replacing a new liquid propane tank for a forklift. The propane leaked through a valve from the tank and onto the employee's right index and middle fingers, burning them.

An employee had just finished working on a fan motor. When the fan was turned on to verify the direction of its rotation, the vacuum of the fan pulled the tip of the employee's right index finger into the spinning blade, causing it to be severely lacerated from the middle of the nail to the end of the finger.

A temporary employee was running a printing machine when it became jammed. The employee's left hand then became caught in the printing machine and two fingers were crushed. A portion of the left middle finger needed to be medically amputated.
An employee was changing a tank on a forklift. The valve was faulty and sprayed the employee with propane. The employee sustained frozen/burned skin and required a skin graft.

An employee was inspecting the roof of a building for possible repairs to be made, when he slipped and fell approximately 19 feet from the roof to the ground below. He sustained a dislocated shoulder and left hip, and a fractured left ankle.

The injured employee was training another employee on a molding machine and observed that the mold needed adjustment. While the injured employee was reaching into the machine, the trainee unknowingly pushed the start button, cycling the machine. The injured employee sustained crushing injuries to the right thumb resulting in amputation.

Two employees were descending in an aerial lift after doing bridge work. The boom and basket became stuck against the bridge girder. When the boom came loose, the wheels of the boom lift came off the ground and threw the employees out of the basket. Both suffered broken legs, and one was hospitalized.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet from a scaffold while installing a window. The employee s leg was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a new tank hatch lid. The lid struck the employee's left hand, amputating the tip of the thumb (with no bone loss).
An employee was walking up the back steps to a warehouse. He fell forward and his face struck a guardrail at the top of the stair platform. He suffered a facial laceration and possible fracture.
An employee was securing equipment on a pickup truck with a bungee cord. The bungee cord snapped loose and struck the employee on the left eye causing an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a machine press. The press activated and his right middle finger was caught under it. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was outside, about to perform a yard check of tractor/trailers. Another employee's car backed into the employee, injuring the employee's left hip and leg.
An employee was working in a freezer unit, slipped and fell, suffering a bruised back and ribs and a blood clot. He was hospitalized.

An electrician was relocating a live, 480-volt wire in an electrical panel. Carpenters from another company were drilling a hole on the floor with a track underneath the panel. An arc flash occurred in the electrical panel and hit the electrician and two carpenters. The electrician sustained burns to his face and stomach. One carpenter sustained burns to his back. The other carpenter had buzzing in his ear due to the loud sound.
An employee was loading a jackhammer attachment onto a trailer. The equipment slid from its wooden pallet onto his left middle finger. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee's finger was caught in a door, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a shear to cut through a piece of iron. When the shear cut through, the piece of metal flew back and struck the employee in the back. He sustained a concussion, skull fracture, and a fractured rib.
An employee fell off a trailer while unloading freight from it. The employee landed on a forklift and was injured. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was servicing an airlock machine when it amputated his left index, middle, and ring fingertips.
An employee fell through an opening in a catwalk, landing on the ground 60 feet below and suffering multiple fractures and head trauma.
An employee slipped on uneven ground in a parking lot and fell. He hit the ground and suffered injuries to the left elbow, left hand, left hip, and lower back.
An employee was oiling the chain on a machine. As he was wiping off excess oil, the chain caught his hand and amputated his right middle fingertip, removing two-thirds of the nail.
An employee was descending a rolling staircase. The employee fell from the staircase to the floor below, suffering a broken right knee. The employee was hospitalized for treatment and surgery.
Two employees had a domestic incident at work. The injured employee was struck in the head by the other employee and was rendered unconscious.
An employee was changing a roll of seal film on a sealer. The film slicing clamp came down on her right ring finger. The tip was medically amputated.

An employee was watching hotdogs on a packing machine to be sure they were straight. The employee was straightening them out when a block came down and struck the employee's right little finger, causing three fractures. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken right hip.

An employee was operating a riding pallet jack, staging a load of pallets. As he was backing the pallets into the staging area, the top pallet came in contact with a concrete pillar. It shifted forward and struck the employee's right hand as it rested on the throttle control of the pallet jack. The employee suffered a compound fracture and laceration to the little finger, resulting in a medical amputation to the finger.
An employee was cutting marine board at the glass cutting area on a table saw. The blade caught the board; then the saw kicked back, resulting in the amputation of his left middle fingertip.
An employee was bent over, picking up stacks of boxes from the floor to put into a carriage. He picked up multiple boxes and turned and felt a pop in his back. He was hospitalized with a back strain.
While leaving a customer's docking area, an employee slipped on the snowy floor and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for bleeding in the brain.
An employee fell off a truck ramp while raising it. The employee landed on concrete and suffered laceration requiring stitches.
An employee was clearing snow from the load on a curtain trailer. He slipped off the load and landed on the floor below, suffering a broken pelvis and a dislocated hip.

At about 8:30 a.m. on February 13, 2020, two employees were doing carpentry work at an office building. A section of HVAC duct broke free from ceiling mounts and struck one employee's head, injuring it.
An employee was helping lean windows back to get another window. The windows fell on him, breaking a vertebra in his lower back and causing a laceration above the left eye.
An employee slipped on snow-coated steps outside of the facility and fell to the ground, breaking her leg and requiring hospitalization.
An employee tripped on a curb in a parking lot and fell to the asphalt, suffering a dislocation and fracture of two toes on the left foot.

An employee was on a scaffold, using a gas-powered saw to cut out a lintel. The saw caught on something and kicked back, striking the employee in the right cheek. The employee suffered lacerations from the cheek to the top of the nose.

An employee had been checking airlines on railcars. The pickup truck that the employee had been driving rolled backwards and pinned him between the driver's side door and a rail car. He sustained bruised ribs.
An employee tripped on a cone that was covering a hazard on a cafeteria floor. He lost his balance, fell to the floor, got up, slipped, and fell again, breaking his left hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unjam a resin clog in a spin dryer. The rotating blades inside the exit port amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was shutting end gates in the back of a semi trailer. The trailer pulled away and the employee fell out, suffering a broken right leg.
An employee fell while trying to jump onto a runaway forklift, landing on the concrete floor and suffering contusions and bumps.

While holding a sheet metal part and bending it in a press brake, an employee's right ring fingertip was caught between the sheet metal part and the work rest. The right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a forklift with a mule attachment. The metal frame of the mule came off the metal bracket on the forklift. As the employee attempted to adjust it, his pinky finger was pinched between the metal bracket on the forklift and the metal mule frame. The top one-third of the employee's pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was welding on a 55-gallon drum when it exploded, injuring the employee.
An employee was putting up products in the beauty department and slipped, landing on the countertop. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
On February 13, 2020, an employee was slicing cucumbers with a meat slicer. The machine amputated the tip of his right thumb.
An employee was operating a food processor when its blade amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was on a scaffold applying insulation. The scaffold and the employee fell. The employee's right foot landed on the protruding shower drain pipe and was fractured.
An employee was tightening a gas line fitting. The employee's wrench slipped off the fitting, and the employee fell backwards onto a tree stump, suffering a broken right rib and a punctured lung.
An employee sustained a dog bite to their left forearm and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell from a scissor lift, landing about 10 feet below and suffering two broken ribs, a sprained ankle, and a sprained wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was switching out the battery on an electric pallet jack using an electric overhead hoist. The employee's finger was caught between the hoist hook and the pallet jack battery resulting in amputation.
An employee was cleaning a spiral inlet belt on a line. A sprocket on the belt caught his left hand, and his left arm was broken.
An employee was installing a toilet. The toilet fell and broke, and its sharp edge lacerated the employee's left arm to the bone.
An employee was on a roof when he tripped on a skylight and fell backwards to the roof surface, breaking his ankle.

An employee was working inside of the air handling unit and was working on the fan blade belt and pulley system. The employee rotated the fan blade pulley belt and amputated a finger between the fan blade and belt system. The air handling unit was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

Three employees were moving steel plates using an overhead crane. One employee's left little finger was caught between the ring of the lifting clamp and the hook of the crane chain, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell on ice while walking toward a self-storage unit, suffering a broken femur.
A personal care assistant was walking up to a house when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot, slipped and fell on ice and fractured ribs.

An employee was connecting two dollies. He had pulled the pin from the eyelet of one dolly and was pulling the other dolly to make a connection when his right middle finger was caught between the tongue of one dolly and the eyelet of the other dolly. The finger was lacerated between the nail and the first knuckle, and the fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was using a skid-steer to clean up debris and dump it into an over-the-road dump truck. The dump truck's bed was partially raised. The employee exited the skid-steer and stood behind the truck. Hot asphalt flowed from the truck bed onto the employee resulting in second and third degree burns to the hands and face.  The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was loosening a loading spout and fell approximately 12 feet. The employee sustained a fractured right elbow and left tibia and a torn left ACL. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was in the stock room hallway when a construction worker asked the employee to move a piece of sheet rock by hand. The sheet rock fell and struck the injured employee's leg, breaking it.
The injured employee slipped and fell on the slick roadway during a heavy snow storm. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured right femur.
An employee was walking on the deli department sales floor, tripped and fell on her right shoulder. The shoulder was fractured.
Two employees were moving a 3-inch shaft. The shaft slipped and trapped one employee's left index finger against the rollers of the trough below. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee's hand was caught in the rollers of an outdoor electric gate.
After moving a box from one pallet to another, an employee turned to walk away; her foot caught in wrapping on a pallet and she fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was preparing for breakfast in a kitchen restaurant. The employee was shot twice in the head and once in the shoulder.
An employee slipped on an icy patch on a rubber membrane roof, fell to the roof surface, and suffered two broken back vertebrae.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a tool-changer on a horizontal mill. The tool changer cycled while the employee was inside the machine, striking the employee in the chest. The employee suffered a fractured sternum, two fractured ribs, and small fractures to two bones on the spine. The employee was hospitalized.
Explosive powder material was being poured into a plastic container. An explosion occurred and five employees were transported to the hospital. One employee sustained burns to the face and left hand.

On February 14, 2020, an employee was turning on the glue and the air in a carpet winder machine. The machine was turned on and the employee's left arm was broken. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was adjusting the tooling on a brake press. The upper die descended onto the employee's right arm and left hand, severely injuring both.

After repairing a power press machine, an employee began to operate it. The clutch pin was not positioned properly and eventually slipped off, causing the press to come down twice in rapid succession and amputate the employee's left thumb and index finger.
An employee had tarped the load on his truck. He was on top of the load to fix a twisted strap when he fell off the back of the truck and injured his neck.
An employee was inspecting the inside of a dryer. An object moved inside the dryer, crushing the employee's skull against the side of the dryer. The employee suffered multiple skull fractures.

An employee was using a shear press to cut metal and cardboard. The press activated while the employee's fingers were in the point of operation and amputated the top of the employee's left middle finger.

At about 12:00 p.m. on February 14, 2020, an employee was taking product through a warehouse using a stand-up clamp truck. He fell off the lift, struck his head on the concrete ground, and lost consciousness, beginning to shake. He was hospitalized, in a coma and suffering from a skull laceration.

An employee was conducting a walk-around, inspecting a house to see where to install a satellite dish, when a neighbor from 120 yards away saw him, thought he was trying to break in, and started shooting at him. He was shot in the left bicep, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was assisting in cutting downed logs into small sections. An end section of log came loose from the tractor and struck the employee in the right leg fracturing the femur.
An employee suffered a punctured lung while carrying a sauce bucket. The employee dropped the bucket and the bucket bounced off a door and struck the employee.
An employee conducting re-roofing work was hospitalized for back and leg injuries after falling 28 feet from a flat roof into a metal dumpster below.
An employee was making a propane delivery at a residential customer location. As he walked to the customer's door, he slipped on ice and fell resulting in a right leg and ankle fracture.
An employee was walking, tripped over an elevated floor plank, and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a hip fracture.

A ski instructor was carving a turn during a morning training session. The instructor's skis caught on the snow and the instructor fell to the ground, suffering a spiral fracture of the left tibia and fibula.
An employee was laying pipe when two of his fingers were pinched between two trench boxes. He suffered an amputation.

An employee was directing a crane operator with hand signals to pick up a piece of scrap steel off the floor when his hand was caught between the sheet of scrap metal and the lifting device (grab). The employee sustained a finger amputation and a laceration.
An employee was bringing a patient something to drink when she tripped on a toy and fell, striking her head and fracturing a vertebra.
An employee was holding the stand in order to set a die onto to it. The die was placed on the employee's pinky finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was struck by crane as the company was performing a rig move. The employee suffered a fractured left heel.

An employee fell approximately 20 feet through an unsecured grate that was being refurbished. The employee was hospitalized for a broken left leg and five broken ribs, a concussion and lung contusions.
An employee's foot got caught on the computer cord when she stood up from her workstation. The employee fell and was hospitalized for a right ankle injury.
Two employees were installing a metal panel. The panel slipped out of the hands of the employee holding it and it struck and fractured the other employee's lower right leg.

An employee was using a tube squaring machine to cut tubes. The employee had turned off the machine in order to tighten the clamping shell. The machine had not come to a full stop as the employee moved his right hand into position to turn the tensioning screw. While turning the tensioning screw, the employee s right hand slipped and his right ring finger contacted the square tube blade resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

An employee was backing up a dock stocker when it collided with a storage rack. The employee's foot was caught and crushed between the dock stocker and the rack. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the foot.

An employee was placing snaps and positioning webbing material into the snapping machine. The machine was activated via the foot pedal while the employee's index finger was in the point of operation. As a result, he suffered a fracture to his finger.
An employee was operating a ham skinner. His right ring fingertip was caught and lacerated in the skinner.
An employee was peeling carrots when a carrot got stuck in the peeler machine. She was trying to dislodge the carrot when the machine amputated the tip of her left middle finger.
An employee slipped and fell, suffering a broken hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating a walk-behind gasoline-powered tamper, trying to repair a low section of asphalt. While the employee was tampering the temporary asphalt, the fuel line connection broke from the fuel tank at the rubber grommet, discharging gasoline on his pants, which then ignited. He suffered second degree burns to both legs.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot of the facility and fell resulting in a bruised lung and fractured ribs.
An employee was driving a tractor up a trailer ramp when the tractor started going backwards and rolled over. The employee was struck by the tractor and suffered a pelvic fracture.
As a crane truck was rigging down, an employee's hand was caught between the outrigger and the crane. Three fingers on the employee's right hand were crushed and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was exiting an RV using an affixed three-step assembly when he lost balance while stepping down from the last step, which was approximately 4 inches from the ground. The momentum of his body when his foot contacted the ground resulted in a left ankle fracture.

An employee was removing trash from a rail car. As the employee exited the railcar and stepped onto the dock plate to re-enter the dock, the employee mis-stepped and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured clavicle and fractured ribs.
An employee slipped on ice while on a path into work and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left fibula.
An employee was cleaning a pit when a shackle fell from overhead and struck the employee. The employee sustained a back fracture.
While an employee was putting cheese into a cutter machine, his left arm got caught and crushed in the machine.
An employee slipped and fell while walking on a sidewalk, striking his head on the ground. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was performing maintenance work and replacing strips on a conveyor. The employee tripped and fell onto the conveyor hitting their arm. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured arm.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, fracturing the right ankle and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was removing a tire from a car. The tire became unbalanced and struck the employee's hand, pinning it against a tire and causing lacerations and a fracture.

An employee was standing on the tail end of a trailer, taking boxes off a scissor lift that was against the trailer. The scissor lift moved and the employee fell about 5 feet to the ground between the end of the trailer and the lift. The employee suffered a head contusion, a lacerated right leg, and a broken right arm.
An employee was making a delivery, slipped on snow covered ice, and broke an ankle.

An employee was lowering a boom from a crane onto the ground for disassembly. Two load blocks were placed next to each other and one of the blocks knocked into the adjacent block, causing it to fall over onto the employee's left foot. The employee's foot was crushed.
An employee was talking to a skid-steer operator. The skid-steer turned to move, and the tracks ran over the employee's feet resulting in fractures and other injuries to his feet.
An employee was lifting a manhole cover when it slipped and pinched his left middle finger, causing an avulsion.

An employee was troubleshooting a corner post part stacker to determine if there were any faulty sensors. The machine cycled and pushed a slide mechanism into the employee's hand, amputating the tip of the ring finger at the first joint.
An employee was operating a forklift and got their foot caught between the forklift and a guard pole.
An employee was examining a cat when the cat lunged at her and bit her right middle finger. She was hospitalized as a result of the animal bite.
An employee was operating a chain breaker when the chain breaker slipped and struck his face, causing impact injuries, a laceration, and a fracture.
An employee twisted his back, suffering a herniated disk, while stepping down from his work trailer. He was hospitalized.
A trainer was entering a stall and was kicked in the chest by a horse. The employee suffered a lacerated liver.
An employee was cleaning a truck when he fell from its running board. He suffered cuts to his right shin.

On February 17, 2020, an employee was replacing a shingle roof on a three-story apartment building when his left foot slipped out from under him and he fell off the roof onto the ground. He was hospitalized for a fractured neck.

An employee was being lifted in a man basket and tried to hook up a cable to a construction truck bucket. He asked the forklift operator to raise him higher and his finger was pinched between the man basket and a bolt, causing a deep tissue injury that required surgery.
An employee was operating a drill press when it grabbed his left glove. He suffered an amputation to the left little finger and a broken ring finger.
While attempting to restrain a combative patient, an employee passed out due to physical exertion.
An employee was taking garbage out to a trash bin on the sidewalk. The employee tripped on a water display case and fell, suffering a closed fracture of the left hip that required surgery.
An employee was stocking product was using a three-step ladder. As he was descending, he missed the last step and fell. The employee sustained a fracture to his left femur and hip.
An employee was putting papers away in a cubicle cabinet when she fell on the floor and broke her hip.
An employee tripped over a cord while maneuvering around a resident's bed, striking the ground and requiring hospitalization for a broken pelvis.

An employee was operating a leather machine to trim excess leather off a shoe when the machine became jammed. While the employee was trying to remove the leather, the machine gears struck the employee's hand, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was trying to cut a tangled thread from a twisting machine. The machine caused the amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip.

An employee was asked by a table saw's control panel operator to push back stacked material to be cut through the hold-down bar area. The injured employee hit the E-stop button to push back the material as requested. While his hand was still on the material, the control panel operator hit the cut buttons, causing the hold-down bar to come down on the injured employee's right hand. The employee pulled his right hand out from under the hold-down bar, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger up to the knuckle with bone loss.
A welder was restocking a steel plate when it slipped from his hands and landed on his foot, breaking it. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
On February 18, 2020, an employee was using a biscuit joiner cutter for cabinet frames. The cutter lacerated his left index finger and thumb.
An employee was operating an edger saw when the employee's arm was pulled into the shaft of the lumber deck, causing a compound fracture to the upper arm and a fracture to the lower arm.
An employee was using a pipe on the end of an air pressure gun. When the air was activated, the pipe became airborne and hit the employee in the face.
An employee slipped on ice while getting out of her car in a parking lot. She suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing metal decking when he went through a hole and fell 12 feet to the next lower level, suffering broken wrists.
A team of employees was carrying a 10-foot section of iron tubing. One of them slipped and the tubing struck the back of his head. He suffered dizziness and blurred vision.
An employee was operating a header machine when his foot slipped from the brake and his right hand thumb was caught in the machine, amputating the tip of his thumb.

An employee was moving metal walls on a movie set, setting them against the side of a truck. One of the walls fell forward and struck the employee on the head, tearing ligaments in the employee's neck.
The mobile gantry crane was being assembled when a collapse occurred and a piece of the crane struck an employee and fractured their right leg.

On 02/18/2020, at 9:15 a.m., an employee was working on a packaging line that was feeding film when product started jamming. As he attempted to get a better visual of the heat cramp sealer, his right hand was pulled into the heat cramp sealer area, resulting in a right thumb tip amputation. The heat cramp sealer was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was framing a soffit at the top of a scaffold. He pushed himself using bars attached to a desk as leverage. The scaffold started to roll too fast, and when he tried to stop it, he fell approximately 5 feet from the top of the scaffold onto the concrete floor. He suffered a cut on the head, a right knee and lower leg fracture, and a left knee fracture.
An employee was using the bagel slicing machine when a bagel got stuck. The employee was removing the bagel when their right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped on a damp walkway and overcompensated to keep from falling down, resulting in a fractured left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a cement mixer when the mixer paddle struck the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was verbally harassed by a client and experienced extreme heart palpitations and a spike in blood pressure, requiring hospitalization.
Two employees were  pushing a cart when one of them suffered a hernia.

An employee was standing on a forklift/picker platform, retrieving product from a third-tier shelf. He fell about 15 feet, suffering a broken wrist, broken ribs and a head wound that required stitches. The employee's lanyard was not connected at the time of the fall.

An employee was walking from her personal vehicle back into the school by going down an embankment that was 18 feet long and had a slope of approximately 70 degrees. While walking down the embankment, she fell and broke her left leg (fibula and tibia).
An employee was caught in the track of a moving excavator. The employee's ankle was broken.
An employee was loading rail cars. The employee fell from a car, suffering broken ribs and further injuries, and was hospitalized.

A welder/fabricator was moving an 8-inch-diameter, 8-foot-long pipe across a table to where other pipes were. The pipe rolled over his left hand, fracturing and lacerating his ring and middle fingers.

An employee was trying to remove jammed material from a bagger machine when the employee's right middle finger was caught in the machine, resulting in a finger tip amputation. The machine guard door was open at the time of the incident.

An employee was observing a forklift unload his 44-foot trailer when he was struck by a steel round bar (1 ft. 11/16 in. diameter; 24 ft. long and weighs 186 lbs.) as it was forklifted from his trailer. He sustained a fractured right arm and lacerations to the back of his head.

On February 19, 2020, an employee fell from a 10-foot step ladder while climbing it to power-wash walls. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken rib, a facial contusion, and a leg injury.

An employee was pin spotting or installing rivets on panels. The panels were coated with an adhesive, and the tool used to rivet the panels caused a spark that ignited the adhesive. The resulting flames caused second degree burns to the employee's face, burned the employee's head and hair, and caused a possible respiratory tract injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a bushing on a fixture stand in a repair area, using a portable drill tool with a deburring attachment. The tool started to jump around, and the employee's left gloved hand made contact with the deburring attachment. The employee suffered a laceration to the top of the hand and an amputation of the tip of the little finger.

An employee was using a mobile trash tote to take garbage to the dumpster. The employee was propping the mobile tote between the dock and the dumpster when the mobile tote began to slip and caught the employee's left middle finger between the tote and the dumpster. As a result, the employee's left middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was installing wiring for new screens inside a canopy. An access door gave way and she fell through it, landing 17 feet below and suffering facial and arm trauma that required surgery.

An employee's hand slipped while changing a belt on an air handling unit. The employee's left pinky, ring, and middle fingers were lacerated and fractured as they were caught between the belt and the pulley. The unit was powered off at the time of the incident and a lock out/tag out procedure was followed prior to starting work on the unit.

On February 19, 2020, an employee was adding chemical to an alcohol wash holding tank when alcohol wash splashed onto the employee's clothes. The employee put the shirt on the ground and tried to burn off the alcohol with a torch. The shirt caught fire and set the employee's pants on fire as well. The employee suffered burns to the hands, arms, chest, and legs.
An employee was cleaning a dough roller with a towel. The machine caught the employee's right hand, breaking it.

An employee was cleaning a hog farrowing floor with a high-pressure washer. The water jet cut through his boot into the top of his foot, causing laceration, trauma, and infiltration of hog manure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was shifting paint containers around on a 5- or 6-foot-high scaffold when she lost her balance and fell off of the scaffold to the ground. She suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was tracking the transfer belt on a machine when his hand was pulled by the belt, resulting in a fracture to his arm.

On February 19, 2020, an employee was cleaning a roll on a printer press when the employee's hand was pulled into a running nip point on the press. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the right thumb and right middle finger as well as damage to the right pinky finger.

An employee was on-site (outside) working on a forklift battery. He was burning a negative cable on the battery. When he finished, he pushed the battery back into the forklift. He noticed that the battery was on an incline and it was slowly moving. He grabbed the battery and his right index finger was pinched by the battery causing injury to the finger.
An employee was standing on a customer's dock when a reversing forklift struck the employee, resulting in a broken left arm and hand.
An employee was performing well servicing operations when a swivel amputated a thumb tip.
An employee tripped and fell while walking through a lobby. The employee suffered a left wrist contusion, a laceration at the upper left lip, and a possible concussion.
An employee was attempting to unjam an auto shear machine when his hand entered an area where a temporary guard was loose and the machine amputated his left pinky finger.
An employee was pulling a door slab from a shelf when he lost balance and fell backwards onto the concrete floor. He suffered an injury to a spinal disc and was hospitalized.

An employee was using his right hand to remove jammed paper from a paper machine when his right arm and hand were caught between two rope sheaves, causing severe lacerations, a severed main artery in the forearm, and a fractured hand bone. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was using an angle grinder to grind out imperfections in a concrete curb. The grinding wheel exploded. Flying pieces of it hit his left knee pad (causing the knee to swell) and lacerated his left index finger, damaging the bone.
An employee stepped up on the second step of a step ladder. Some screws/the connector had broken off the ladder, causing it to collapse. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a back injury.
An employee was getting out of a forklift truck when he slipped on ice and fell, breaking his leg.
An employee was handling pallets when fiberglass particles became airborne and caused the employee to experience lung irritation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up to replace elevator cables when the employee's finger was caught in a cable shackle, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from a 71-inch stair platform, suffering a broken right arm and right hip. The platform did not have a handrail at the time of the incident.

On 2/19/2020, an employee was removing food items from a wooden pallet when she tripped and fell on the corner of the pallet, injuring her left knee and elbow. She was hospitalized and required knee surgery.
A truck knocked over an employee, who suffered broken bones.
