An employee was installing a carpet runner under a roller table. The employee's left ring fingertip was caught and injured between a roller and a metal plate. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee's hand entered a rethermalizer machine and sustained a second degree burn.

Two employees were assembling doors onto storage cabinets while the cabinets were laying on their backs. After attaching the doors, they stood the cabinet up onto a wooden dolly. The doors came open and the excess weight away from the center of gravity caused the cabinet to fall forward on top of one employee. The employee was hospitalized with abrasions to the left arm and pelvis.

An employee climbed to the top of a ladder and was stepping onto a roof when he lost his balance and fell toward the ground. A coworker caught him under his arms from behind, preventing his head from hitting the ground, but not before his heels hit the sidewalk hard. He suffered a compression fracture and heelbone fractures, requiring hospitalization.
On February 19, 2020, an employee was working to clean a salt spreader on a landscaping truck when the employee's right arm was caught in an auger, crushing and breaking bones in the arm.
On February 19, 2020, an employee was operating a pallet jack when it crushed his foot between steel shelving uprights. He suffered a broken ankle.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground at a customer's site. The employee sustained broken ribs.
An employee was on a catwalk performing a fire watch for a welder when the catwalk collapsed during the weld. The employee fell 12 feet from the catwalk, sustaining a hairline fracture to his neck.
An employee suffered a back strain while preparing a hotel room for pest treatment.
While working on a cup polisher machine, an employee suffered an amputation to the left middle finger at the first joint.

An employee was standing on a hatch cover, removing twist locks on the forward end of a container. A container attached to a crane spreader struck and pushed the employee, breaking the employee's right arm.

An employee was removing a chain binder holding a 54-inch concrete stormwater pipe. As he snapped the binder free, the chain released and caught his left index finger and thumb in the chain links. As a result, his left thumb tip was amputated and his left index finger was fractured.

An employee and a coworker were completing a roll change at the caster runout. They had already removed the old roll and were putting the new roll into final position. The roll was supported by an overhead crane. The coworker on the west end of the roll was providing hand signals to the crane operator in the cab. The injured employee was on the east end of the roll trying to guide the bolts into the bolt holes. The injured employee's finger was caught between the flange of the bearing housing and a piece of key stock welded to the structure, resulting in a right index finger amputation at the first knuckle.

An employee was reaching over an asphalt machine. The employee's jacket sleeve was caught between the trunnion and a tire, causing a partial amputation of the left ring finger and the laceration of the left little and middle fingers.

An employee was checking an asphalt machine on an asphalt plant truck when his jacket sleeve was caught between the trunnion and the tire. As a result, his left ring ringer was partially amputated and his left pinky and middle fingers were lacerated.

An employee was using a hole saw to cut a hole in a plywood sheathing to install a toilet flange when the saw became caught and kicked back, striking the employee's leg above the knee. The employee sustained a severe laceration to the lower right thigh.
An employee was unloading a trailer when a crate fell on his head, causing a concussion.
An employee was moving a man lift when the lift wobbled and landed on his left arm, causing tendon damage that required surgery.

An employee was working on an end dump truck. While he was flushing the hydraulic pump's pipes out with air, the tank blew off and struck his right leg, dislocating his right knee and partially cutting the interior artery.
An employee was working on drywall trim from a platform about 3 feet above the ground. The platform collapsed and the employee fell, suffering a broken right tibia and fibula.

An employee was performing housekeeping and cleaning up wood used to build forms. She was dragging a heavy wooden saw horse while walking backwards when she tripped over a stack of rebar and impacted the ground, fracturing her right femoral head.
An employee was exiting the bus when she fell head-first onto the bus stairs, suffering broken ribs, a head injury, and loss of consciousness.
An employee tripped over an extension cord and injured her shoulder and hip on the ground.
An employee slipped from the steps of a deicer truck and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when the jack pinned his leg against a rack. He suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working from a pallet to remove a bale from a compactor when he fell backwards, striking his head on the ground and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was standing next to a mini excavator being used to push PVC pipe under a golf cart path when the PVC pipe shattered. He was struck in the left eye by a piece of the shattered PVC pipe.
An employee was taking boxes of food down a ramp on a dolly. The employee fell, suffering a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hammering a nail to install siding onto a building when the nail ricocheted and flew back, striking his right eye.
An employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell to the ground, hitting her head and suffering a brain bleed. She was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing a part in a press brake when the part shifted, catching his right thumb and resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was moving a bundle of pipe when his left hand was caught in the bundle, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was stepping out of a truck at a worksite when he slipped on ice and fell to the ground, hitting his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was loading material into a cure press using a mobile ladder. While descending the ladder at a height of 3 feet, the employee tripped and fell into a nearby forklift, suffering broken bones.

An employee was working aloft in a locust tree with his tie-in point high in the middle of the tree. He had worked his way out on a branch to make the needed cuts and was walking back in toward the main trunk when he slipped and swung back into the trunk. He struck his foot, causing a break in both bones of his lower leg.

An employee was working on the vertical slide of a sub-arc. The motor bolts were loosened and as the employee pushed on the motor to adjust the tension on the belt, the slide dropped down and pinched the employee's thumb, amputating it to the first knuckle.
An employee was on a table storing materials on an upper shelf when he fell from the table to the ground, breaking ribs on his left side and suffering a concussion. He was hospitalized.

A corrections officer was escorting an inmate to his cell. The officer was opening a shower door when the inmate attacked him. The officer was hospitalized with scratches to the face and neck and contusions to the eyes.
A crew was clearing away signage and cones after a survey. A vehicle struck an employee who was putting cones into the back of a truck, causing the amputation of both the employee's legs.
An employee was moving a reel with a crane. The crane topped over and the employee fell out, suffering a shoulder injury. He was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was conducting maintenance on the left side of a gang saw while other employees were changing a saw blade on the right side of the equipment. Once the saw blade was attached, the equipment began operating and the maintenance employee was caught in a pinch point, suffering injuries to the left hip and pelvis.
An employee was coming down a straight ladder when it slid and he fell to the ground. His left leg was broken in two places between the knee and the ankle. He was hospitalized.
On 2/20/2020, at 11:00 a.m., an employee was bagging a mattress using a bag sealer when the bag sealer amputated a finger on the employee's left hand.

An employee was removing runners from a notching machine when their right hand was struck by the rotating notcher head. The employee's right index and ring fingers were amputated at the first knuckle. The middle and pinky fingers were also injured.

An employee was constructing a pergola in the backyard of a residential property when a beam being hoisted by a winch fell from the top of the pergola and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was walking to his truck to get tools when he slipped in mud while walking down an incline. His right foot became stuck in the mud, resulting in a broken fibula and tibia.
An employee was erecting a concrete form from a scaffold when his anchor system collapsed and he fell about 20 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee was rolling a 550-pound truck tire rim across a shop floor. The rim tipped over and struck his hip and leg, breaking the leg and damaging the hip.
An employee was bending a metal sheet on a flip forming and bending machine when his gloved hand was pulled in between the rollers, crushing his middle and index fingertips.
An employee was helping an extruder operator with the machine when he attempted to prevent a wrap-up and his left arm was pulled in between two rolls, causing lacerations.
Two employees were lifting a solar panel when one of them suffered a hernia. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was reaching to attach a sign cable between two I-beams while standing on a 4-foot ladder when the employee fell about 4 feet to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee had been pushing a car and later collapsed to the floor with chest pains and was coughing up blood. The employee was hospitalized with a tear where the esophagus and stomach meet.
An employee was in a construction zone inspecting the road when a car drove through the work zone and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an overhead crane to move a coil to a staging rack. After setting the coil down next to another coil, the employee did not move the chain, which was caught between the two coils. When the employee went to move the crane with the lodged chain, the coil became unstable and began to fall. The employee stepped out onto the staging rack to stabilize the coil with his hands. The coil was too heavy and fell onto the rack and the employee's right and left legs. As a result, the employee suffered amputation of the left leg and a fracture to the right leg.
An employee was tying rebar when a post-tension cable snapped and struck the employee's hands. Both thumbs were lacerated.

An employee was operating a band saw and using a push stick. He placed material on the table and secured it with clamps. The material became jammed, so he moved to the other side and activated the saw blade. The saw blade caught the push stick and amputated his right index finger.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold while working on an elevated platform that was lifted on the forks of a telehandler forklift and was equipped with a steel guardrail system. The employee was working from one side of the platform and slid a 24-foot aluminum scaffold platform from the wall bracket onto the top of the guardrail. The scaffold platform pivoted on the guardrail and fell 12 feet to the ground below. The employee was holding onto the platform as it fell and was ejected from the platform onto the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and fractures to the hip, wrist and ankle.

An employee was operating an order picker to place pallets on shelving when he lost his handle on the controls and overcorrected. The order picker then struck a rack, and his arm was caught and broken between the rack and the order picker.

An employee was acting as a spotter for the loading of a rig pump. The employee tried to remove a pin that was in the way of the resting point of the pump and his right thumb was caught in a pinch point, resulting in an amputation of the thumb at the first knuckle.
An employee was bending down to pick up a hose to connect to a pump to pressurize it when he felt pain. He was hospitalized and required surgery for a hernia.
A reach truck struck an order picker. The employee operating the reach truck suffered a cut left Achilles tendon.

An employee was manually rotating the rubber ironing roll of a separator to back-thread the tail through the machine in order to make a splice. After making a couple of rotations, the employee's right index finger was caught between the rubber roll and the material on the arbor roll, pinching and causing a partial amputation of the left side of the employee's right index fingertip.

An employee was walking on a shanking conveyor when he slipped while stepping over a piece of conduit. His hand went into a chain and sprocket on the roller conveyor, resulting in an amputation to his right ring fingertip. The chain and sprocket were unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee fell on ice while delivering auto parts to a customer. The employee suffered a broken hip.
An employee was clearing a jam when his right hand came in contact with a knife head, resulting in the amputation of his right thumb and finger.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while walking though a doorway, suffering a fractured hip.
An employee was helping a driver reverse a vehicle using hand signals when the employee was pinned between two vehicles, resulting in muscle damage to the left thigh.

An employee was working on the top section of a 4,160-volt switch gear. The employee's hat fell into the bottom section of the switch gear, and an arc flash burned the employee's face and left hand as he was retrieving it.
An employee was working as a trim inspector while standing on a bulk scale when a powered industrial truck operator struck her. She was hospitalized with fractures to both ankles.

An employee was reaching with a push stick to adjust an empty plastic bottle that was stuck about 14 feet overhead. A forklift backed out of an 18-wheeler trailer and struck the employee's right leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized and the employee's right foot was medically amputated.
A crew was in the process of adjusting the rigging on a flat rack when a pipe shifted and contacted the injured employee's right leg.
An employee was calibrating the dye on a hydraulic press when the employee's right thumb was caught and amputated in a pinch point on the hydraulic press shaft.

An employee was picking up debris and placing it in refuse bins when a nearby forklift operator reversed without looking and hit two pallets. The pallets hit the employee, who suffered a right leg injury.

Two employees were diagnosing a bundling machine and were in the process of removing blocks.  When the employees actuated the bundling machine, the machine lifted but the machine frame did not. One employee had his fingers between the frame and machine at the time, resulting in the amputation of the employee's right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a lathe when the lathe amputated the employee's finger.
An employee was stepping onto a roof from a ladder. He slipped and fell, landing on the ground 12 feet below and suffering an injury to a lower-back disk.
An employee was driving a lowboy to move equipment off a construction site. While exiting the vehicle, he fell approximately 4 feet onto the gravel surface, fracturing his left fibula and tibia.

An employee was walking through a doorway and pushed on the swinging door. The employee expected more resistance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a right hip injury and a fractured femoral neck bone.
An employee was operating a digger derrick to dig for utility line access. While he was troubleshooting the faulty boom of the truck, his hand was placed on the boom, crushing his left ring finger.
An employee installing solar panels on a residential roof fell to the ground and broke an arm, requiring hospitalization.
Two employees were working in a lift. The lift was raised and a beam struck one employee's hard hat, cutting the employee's ear.
An employee was loading a semi-trailer when a load bar impacted a pallet. The pallet and load then struck the employee, who suffered a broken right leg.
An employee's left index fingertip was caught in a folding cement chute, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was pinned between two pickup trucks inside the building, sustaining external and internal bruising in the abdomen.
An employee was removing a die set when his left middle finger was caught between the cradle and the safety guard. The tip of the finger was amputated.
An employee was pushing down a loading dock plate when it came down on the employee's hand, amputating the tips of the employee's right middle and index fingers.
After running overhead beverage lines in a restaurant, an employee jumped off a ladder, landed wrong, and suffered a broken foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a table saw when it kicked back while the employee was cutting wood. The employee suffered an amputation of the right pinky fingertip.
An employee was removing a pallet from a bucket truck in a production area. He slipped and fell on his left hip fracturing it.

An employee was attempting to clear a pellet clog in a conveyor using a wrench when the hand wrench contacted the moving conveyor chain, causing the wrench to move forward and resulting in the employee's right index finger being pinched between the wrench and the conveyor housing. The employee sustained an amputation of the distal right index fingertip.
An employee was dumping a tote of rice using a forklift. The employee dropped his work knife. As he went to retrieve the knife, his right hand was caught in a lump breaker resulting in nerve damage.
An employee attempted to untangle ends on machine when their right hand got caught in the yarn and severed the tip of employee's pinky finger.
An employee was observing a welder when a piece of angle iron fell on the employee's left foot, breaking a toe.
An employee fainted after attending to a patient and broke their right ankle.
An employee was pouring molten iron back into a furnace using a ladle. The metal splashed onto his lower body, burning his waist and legs.

An employee was feeding paper through a winder. The paper did not transfer from the back of the drum to the roll; the employee was trying to transfer it when the front drum came into contact with her left arm and pulled it into the nip point between the roll and the drum. The arm was bruised.
After assisting a customer, an employee became dizzy and stumbled to the floor, hitting their head on a shopping cart. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting rollers when one of them fell on his right big toe, lacerating it.
An employee fell from an 8-foot A-frame ladder while carrying a sheet metal part. The employee sustained a laceration to the left side of his face and a broken shoulder.
An employee was standing next to a pallet, cutting stretch wrap. A forklift backed into him, pinning his left foot against the pallet and breaking it.
An employee was carrying mail on a postal route when she tripped while stepping over a brick. The employee fell to the ground, breaking her left arm. She was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a motorcycle from the service area to the pre-owned area. The employee lost control of the motorcycle, jumped off, and the motorcycle fell on top of him. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and a punctured lung.
A temporary employee was positioning a pipe in a sledger when it crimped on the pipe, catching the employee's left hand and partially amputating the thumb and forefinger.

An employee was in a scissor lift using a sheetrock knife to cut sheetrock. He was putting the knife on the tray when his arm hit the cable tray causing the knife to ricocheted out of his hand and strike his left eye causing damage to the retina.

Two employees were cooking in the kitchen when they became dizzy and faint and had headaches. The employees were transported to the hospital for treatment of carbon monoxide poisoning due to a malfunctioning exhaust hood.
A host in the restaurant tripped over a chair leg and fell breaking the right femur.
An employee was getting bales of hay for a customer from a trailer using a bay hook. The bales of hay fell onto the employee causing a fractured knee cap and a torn meniscus and ACL.
An employee was operating a storm water lift pump and hot water condensation blew out of the atmospheric muffler vent onto the operator's back causing first and second degree burns.

A cashier was pushing shopping carts in a crosswalk on the main lane in front of the store when a vehicle impacted the shopping carts and subsequently struck the employee. The employee suffered a concussion.
While operating a ride-on electric pallet jack, an employee got caught between the pallet jack and the wall. The employee's ankle was fractured and he was hospitalized.

An employee was using a spray bottle to clean a coating machine. The employee dropped the spray bottle, and when he reached for it, his hand was caught in the machine. His hand was crushed and lacerated. The machine was running at the time.

Two employees were performing a changeover of steel rolls/tooling. While one employee was pushing a metal roll stand back onto a shaft, the injured employee's left middle finger was caught between the metal spacer and the key-way of the metal stand. The fingertip was amputated.
While climbing a fixed ladder to access the roof, an employee slipped and fell 6 to 7 feet and landed on the floor, sustaining a lower back injury.
Two employees went to service a car and the car ran over them. One employee was hospitalized for a broken leg. The second employee was hospitalized for a broken hip.
An employee was breaking down equipment and was found laying on the ground with head trauma and lacerations. Pieces of support truss were nearby.

On February 23, 2020, at approximately 12:30 a.m. an employee was working in a commercial bakery on a bread line machine where the dough is rolled into a loaf. The employee needed to clean the machine top belt, which is done by manually opening the top of the belt in a door-like fashion. The employee finished cleaning the belt and when he closed the belt manually, the employee's left pinky finger was closed in the belt and amputated.

An employee was on a 7-step rolling staircase to clear a jam on the overhead conveyor. While clearing the jam, the staircase shifted and the employee lost balance and fell over the railing onto the ground causing a partial collapse of the right lung.
An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack when his thigh was caught between the pallet jack and a material rack. He sustained a bruised left thigh and possible hematoma.

An employee was servicing an air conditioner unit at a customer's house. Upon completion, the employee attempted to disconnect a Freon gauge from the air conditioner unit. One of the valves got stuck and Freon gas started to flow out. The employee reapplied the gauge as the Freon was coming out and sustained freon burns to both hands.

An employee was unloading palletized scrap metal from the bed of a bobtail truck using a pallet jack. The pallet of scrap metal started to fall over the edge at the end of the truck causing the pallet jack to raise up and crush the employee's right index finger between it and the scrap metal. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking on a crushed-stone path from the work area towards his vehicle when he slipped on ice that was obscured by standing water and fell to the ground. He sustained fractures to the left ankle and left leg.
While an employee was removing a guard, the guard slipped and pinched his left index finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was using a reciprocating saw to trim excess conduit and sustained lacerations on the elbows and knees.
An employee was off loading a drill stem using a caliper. The drill stem fell out of the caliper and fractured the employee's left leg.

An employee was executing the removal of the unloading arm coupling blind and was struck by the coupling blind. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the arm/wrist, fractured ribs, and amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was loading a folding ladder onto a golf cart. The ladder tipped forward and pressed the accelerator, causing the cart to drive forward and run over the employee's foot. The employee's foot was broken.

An employee was installing a valve on a compressor cylinder. The valve flipped and as the employee tried to stop it, his hands were caught in a pinch point causing amputation of the middle, ring, and pinky fingertips on the right hand. The employee was hospitalized and the fingertips were reattached.

An employee working as a chemical operator was attempting to light one of the mills. Solvent vapor was ignited by a spark and the employee was burned on the face and hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was applying double-sided tape to the slitting machine core when the positioner came across and caught the employee between the slitting machine and the positioner. The employee was hospitalized with a head laceration, fractured sternum, and two fractured ribs.
While pumping fluid out of a pit into a vacuum truck, an employee slipped from the operator's platform and hit his knee on the ground. The employee suffered a knee injury that required surgery.

An employee was repairing a clogged drain on an automatic beverage machine at a restaurant. The employee heard a popping noise while lifting the machine over drain pipes. The employee sustained a hernia.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle after tripping over a gas pump hose and falling at the gas station.
An employee was securing a load on a flatbed trailer and fell off the trailer onto the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs, swelling around the spine, and an abrasion above an eye.
An employee was making coffee. The coffee pot overflowed and the employee's hand was burned.

An employee was walking up a ramp placed on the bed of a straight truck. The ramp fell off the truck and the employee fell on top of the ramp resulting in broken ribs and vertebrae.

See 1547058 for information on a second injured employee due to this incident.

An employee was walking up a ramp from the ground into the back of a truck when the ramp fell from the truck. The employee fell onto the edge of the ramp and sustained fractures to the ribs and vertebrae.

See 1547045 for information on a second injured employee due to this incident.

An employee was replacing a bearing on the shaker table. The injured employee and three co-workers were trying to place the shaker table back on the central pin, when the injured employee lost their grip and the shaker table came down on their right hand. The right index finger was broken in two places and the middle finger was broken and lacerated. The injuries required surgery.

A carpenter was cutting 5-inch shims for a door jam project. While cutting on two saw horses, his saw kicked back and cut his left hand which was holding the wood board. He was hospitalized for a cut to his first and fifth digits and a severed tendon on the first digit that requires surgery.
An employee's right index fingertip was amputated when he manually pushed an endplate down the shaft into the motor housing unit.
An employee was removing a high mast light pole at a highway interchange. The crane rigging broke and struck the employee resulting in a broken arm.

An employee was cleaning the production floor in the packaging room. The employee reached for a water hose in front of the bagger and fell. The employee sustained chemical burns to the right buttock from the cleaning product.

An employee was using a drill to mix concrete inside a 5-gallon bucket. When the employee checked the drill's chuck to see if it was loose, the left index fingertip portion of his glove got caught in the teeth of the spinning chuck and the employee's finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was using a squeegee to apply roofing paper on a commercial roof. The employee fell 7 feet onto a lower roof adjacent to the building and suffered bruised vertebrae.

An employee was conducting demolition and repair work on a concrete parking garage stairwell. The employee began to remove concrete slabs from the top of the second-floor platform when the metal sub-sheet underneath him collapsed and he fell approximately 10 feet through the opening. He landed on the concrete ground and sustained fractures to his hands and pelvis.

An employee was standing on top of stacked wooden utility poles that were positioned on a flatbed trailer while connecting lifting chains to one of the poles to be unloaded. While connecting the lifting chains, the employee lost his balance and fell approximately 10 feet to the earthen ground, sustaining a fractured right tibia.

On February 24, 2020, an employee was feeding bonobo monkeys when she lost her balance and  her right index finger went though the mesh. The monkey bit her finger resulting in amputation of the finger from the nail up.

An employee was working as a chill cell helper to move the trays of meat on the rail system to and from different coolers. The employee was moving a 1500 lb. rack of meat along the overhead rail system. When the employee came to a switch (interchange), the rack fell from the overhead rail system and struck the employee who fell to the concrete ground. The employee sustained fractures to the back, pelvis and sternum.

An employee was power washing a previous concrete pour to prep for the next pour when he stumbled over the steel mesh that was in place. He then lost control of the power washer wand and the top of his left boot was punctured by the hot water. He sustained second and third degree burns to the foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 with a circular saw. The board twisted and the saw kicked back causing a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was found incoherent with injuries to the face and arm and was hospitalized. The employee may have fallen from a ladder.

An employee was draining condensate from an air compressor when a catastrophic failure occurred on a check valve on a natural gas line. The natural gas began blowing toward the running compressor and the gas ignited causing an explosion. The employee was hospitalized for second and third degree burns to the face, hands, left leg, and left midsection.
An employee was grinding a spring and suffered a partial amputation to the left ring finger.
An employee was operating the former machine and crushed three fingers on their right hand. Two fingertips were amputated.

An employee had parked their vehicle in an offsite parking garage on the third level and proceeded to the south stairwell to go down to the shuttle bus on the ground floor. The employee missed a stair and fell, sustaining fractures to the second, third, and fourth metatarsals of the left foot.
An employee slipped and fell onto the floor while picking up an item. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.
An associate was walking through the lawn and garden center and tripped over a grate in the ground and fell resulting in a broken left elbow that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder taping a camper to prepare for painting. When he descended the ladder, he missed the last rung and fell backwards hitting his head on the concrete ground. The employee suffered a laceration and bruises to the head.
An employee was trying to unrig sheet pile and crushed the tip of their index finger causing an avulsion injury.

An employee was welding a piece of 36" cutter pipe on a welding table. When the table was moved, the pipe fell onto the employee's knee, fracturing his tibia. He then fell from his stool and suffered a laceration to the side of his head.
While washing the inside of the walk-in cooler, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the floor. He was hospitalized with a back injury and a cut on an eyebrow.

An employee was removing a CB antenna on the platform on the side of a tractor-trailer. As the employee descended the platform, he missed a step and fell to the ground onto his back. The employee sustained a back fracture requiring hospitalization.
While walking down an aisle in the restaurant, an employee slipped, hit her head on a table, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a forehead laceration.
On February 25, 2020, an employee slipped and fell on the icy sidewalk while walking to work from the parking lot.
The injured employee was standing beside a forklift going through paperwork. The forklift operator moved the forklift and it struck the injured employee resulting in a broken left fibula.

An employee had been fastening a wooden splash guard to the backside of a cleaning table in the Caustic Room using a power drill. He began to have trouble breathing and felt ill. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee opened the rear door of an open top refuse container and was struck by a roll of plastic sheeting that weighed approximately 300 pounds. As the roll struck him, the employee fell backwards and struck the back of his head on a concrete pad. Another roll of plastic sheeting dislodged from the container and landed on top of his legs. The employee sustained fractures to his right ankle and pelvis, as well as a laceration to back of his head.

An employee was changing the blades on a miter saw. A wood block was placed under the miter saw blades to hold the blades against the wood block. When the employee loosened the saw blade nut, the wood block slipped, and the saw blade came down and amputated their right middle fingertip.

An employee was closing the cage door after walking the dog and the dog jumped up on door. As the employee went to close the door to prevent the dog from escaping, the dog bit her hand through the cage bars. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated and required surgery.
An employee was walking around a desk and wiping it off when the employee tripped over wires around the desk and fell onto a metal chair resulting in facial cuts and a broken orbital bone.

As an employee was repositioning a steel box fan, a can of glue fell into the fan. When the employee attempted to retrieve the can, her right hand contacted the fan blade and her index, middle, and ring fingers were broken and lacerated.
An employee was operating a wing saw in the debone area and sustained an amputation to a fingertip.
On February 25, 2020, a driver was in the back of his delivery truck at a dock when he lost consciousness and fell to the floor. He struck his head, suffering head trauma, and was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a window and fell through a floor opening resulting in fractured vertebrae.

An employee had been picking up a load from a customer. The truck rolled over a curb into a gas line. The gas line ruptured and caught on fire. The employee exited the truck and jumped through the flames, sustaining second degree burns to the left hand and first degree burns to the right hand and face.
While adjusting the forks of a forklift that were resting on a flatbed trailer, something shifted and the employee's left arm was crushed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attending a meeting near a production line. He activated a tilt table in order to move it out of the way. The table came down on his left foot, fracturing the big toe.

An employee was standing in the excavation area around a gas main at night signaling the excavator operator when the excavator bucket struck the employee's right foot causing four dislocated toes and tendon and ligament damage that required surgery.

The injured employee was working on a coal car while the air valves were also being worked on. When air was connected, the doors closed on the injured employee's legs resulting in fractures to both legs.
An employee was approaching a skid-steer from the side when the skid-steer ran over his left foot and fractured a toe.
An employee was walking back to the work area, slipped, and fell to the ground fracturing the right tibia and fibula.

An employee was unloading shingles at a new construction job site. While trying to release a crane hook on the delivery vehicle, his left hand was caught in a pinch point between a spring loaded shackle and the track it rests on. The employee sustained partial amputations of the left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was clearing a jam on a conveyor belt, slipped, and fell 1.5 feet to the floor sustaining a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to free a stuck truck when an ATV ramp dislodged and struck the employee's shin and fractured it.

An employee was loading parts onto the chuck of a surface grinder when his left hand was pulled in causing a partial amputation to the left index and middle fingers. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a concrete saw to cut up a demolished deck when the saw cut his chest.
An employee was using a chainsaw to clear brush. While cutting a tree, the tree kicked out and struck the employee causing a lower leg fracture.
An employee was getting off the bed of a truck, slipped, and fell to the ground fracturing their left foot.
An employee was performing a voltage check on 1440V and received first and second degree electrical flash burns to the face. The employee was hospitalized.

At approximately 2:00 p.m., an employee working in the warehouse bent over to pick a piece of paper off the floor. At that time, a forklift was backing off from a trailer. As the forklift turned to the right, it made contact with the employee. The employee sustained foot fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing an exhaust fan belt when their fingers were caught between the belt and the pulley. The ring and middle fingers on the right hand were broken and the right pinky finger was amputated above the fingernail.

An employee reached for a valve stem pulling tool that was near the swing arm of the tire changing machine. At this point, the swing arm was moved and crushed the employee's fingertip against the adjustment knob of the tire changing machine's frame. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index fingertip.
An employee was riding on the side of a front-end loader. It passed a pile of hardened dirt, which caught the employee's leg. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken right tibia.

An employee was blowing excess sand off a pneumatic trash compactor skid that had recently been sandblasted prior to painting. While repositioning himself onto the platform, the weight shifted to one side, forcing the equipment to tip and pin him to the ground. The employee's right fibula and tibia were broken.
An employee was working from a scissor lift. The employee fell from the lift to the ground 10 feet below, suffering fractures to the left wrist, hip, and vertebrae.
An employee was working on a product's display foot to level the display out. The display tipped over, causing the employee to fall backwards and hit his head on the floor.
An employee was transporting 50,000 lbs. of materials on a cart. The injured employee was standing nearby and the cart ran over their left foot resulting in five broken toes and abrasions.

An employee was working on a printer machine, cleaning the front printer roller. Their rag was pulled into a pinch point and the right ring finger was pulled in and crushed resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was unloading a trailer with a pallet jack when she tripped over an empty pallet and fell. Her left foot was struck by the pallet jack wheel resulting in fractures.
An employee jumped off a retaining wall and broke her left tibia and fibula.
An employee was operating a surface grinder and suffered an amputation.

An employee was lifting a metal plate with an overhead crane and a magnet. The plate or the magnet shifted and struck the employee's chin. The employee sustained a fracture and laceration to the chin and a concussion.

While removing jammed bottles from a detabber machine, the operator's glove was caught in the ejection belt conveyor pulling his hand toward the belt. The employee's left ringer fingertip was amputated.

An employee arrived at work and started shoveling snow. Within minutes, the employee felt upper chest pain and went back inside to alert others. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack and underwent surgery.

An employee was walking back to his work station from the tool room when he tripped on a stand that holds the fans for the harvesters and fell onto the concrete floor. He landed on and fractured his right hip.
An employee was adjusting and tightening the chain links to a conveyor. The conveyor activated and the employee's right foot was caught between the chain and sprocket amputating toes.
An employee was stocking shelves, tripped over a pallet, and fell onto a case of wine bottles. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a punctured left lung.

A maintenance employee entered the cheese molding cell after de-activating it to troubleshoot the equipment. When the equipment was re-activated, the cheese lid armature moved and struck the maintenance employee on the face causing a laceration from the forehead to the lower cheek that required surgery.

Two employees were in a scissor lift removing a plumbing piece from the side of a building. The lift moved unexpectedly in reverse instead of down and the injured employee struck his head on a structural beam on the side of the building. He bounced back and struck his head on the rail of the scissor lift. The injured employee was hospitalized for head and face injuries.
An employee was working in a yard when a panel shifted and pinned his arm, breaking it in two places.
An employee was adjusting a metal plow on a forklift and amputated their right pinky fingertip.

An employee was moving cereal boxes on shelves while on a step stool. The employee mis-stepped while descending the step stool and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip and injury to the left wrist and left leg.
An employee was feeding plastic into a plastic bag manufacturing machine. The machine pulled in her right hand, partially degloving the front and back of it. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a handsaw in the debone area and amputated their left thumb.

A temporary employee was working at a brake press. The employee was sitting on a stool and lost balance. The employee extended their hand to the middle of the press to catch their balance and at the same time the machine cycled and amputated three fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing a jammed part in a tapper machine. The employee's right index fingertip got caught in the jaws of the tapper machine as they closed. When the employee pulled their finger back, their fingertip remained in the jaws and was avulsed, and the bone of the fingertip was fractured. At the time of the incident, the machine was in manual mode.
An employee was returning to her mail truck after delivering mail when she slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.

An employee was in the back of a truck, loading it with product. The truck started and began to pull away from the dock. The employee fell out of the back of the truck and landed on the concrete ground. The employee suffered a broken ankle, a broken left tibia and fibula, and two broken ribs, and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a restroom with a cleaning wipe and became ill from the fumes.
An employee was working on a CNC machine. As he went to remove a part, the drill bit caught his glove and left index finger. The finger was fractured.

Employees were on-site delivering a bundle of pipes. An employee was unloading the pipes by tying the pipes with a chain that was hooked to the back of a pickup truck. When the pipes came off the flat bed, one of the pipes struck the injured employee, who was standing on the ground near the flat bed, on the head resulting in a laceration.
An employee was operating a disc sander when his glove was caught in the sanding disc. The employee's right thumb was amputated at the first knuckle.

Two employees were removing an overhang bracket. One employee was holding the bracket while another employee was using an air impact wrench. The socket slipped off the nut causing the wrench to drop down and strike the employee's first finger on the right hand causing an avulsion between the second and third knuckle.
At 1:00 p.m. on February 27, 2020, a temporary employee tripped over a pallet, fell, and hit her head on the concrete floor. She was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a fingertip amputation while operating a die cutting machine.

Employees were using a rope puller to load a broken chipper onto a flatbed trailer. When the rope puller was tensioned, the hook broke; the rope and broken hook rebounded, striking an employee. The employee suffered a broken right arm and internal bleeding.
An employee was standing on roof joists, installing plywood. He fell off the joist and landed on the floor about 7 feet below. He was hospitalized for a fracture injury.
An employee was bending gutter straps using a motorized folding machine. The machine clamed on his right middle and ring fingers, crushing them and amputating the fingertips.
An employee was standing on the steps of a single drum compactor, cleaning its windows. His left foot slipped from the wet front frame and he fell to the ground, breaking his leg.

An employee was using a mortar mixer to mix fireproofing material. He was cleaning off the sides of the mixer drum when the mixing blade caught his fingers. His right index finger had skin removed, and his right middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a machine that draws welding wire when the wire pinched his fingertip between the cylinder head and the wire resulting in loss of the finger nail. The employee later sustained a partial left index fingertip amputation after treatment to close the wound.
An employee was removing a piece of meat left on a machine when the machine activated and amputated their right index fingertip.

On February 27, 2020, at approximately 6:40AM, an employee was unhooking a load of galvanized steel from a crane when his right pinky finger was caught between the hook and the galvanized steel crushing the fingertip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to remove the crushed fingertip.

An employee was working in the pit under a vehicle. While using a two-handed tool to loosen a bolt on the vehicle, the tool hit the front passenger-side tire. The tool then pinched the employee's finger against the vehicle's skid plate resulting in a partial amputation to the middle finger on the left hand. The vehicle was not moving, but the tires were rotating at the time.
An employee was standing on the floor and bending over to stock shelves at ground level. The employee fell and sustained a broken right ankle.
An employee was standing next to a forklift with steel totes on its forks. A tote fell off the forks, striking the employee's left arm and breaking it in two places.

An employee was installing gutters on a newly constructed residential dwelling. The employee was climbing a portable extension ladder to install a downspout over the garage and fell approximately 10 feet head-first onto the concrete driveway. The employee sustained a skull fracture, swelling of the brain, eight broken ribs and a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.

A machine operator and his co-worker were removing the gear boxes (weighing between 300 and 400 pounds) from the roll mill machine. His co-worker was using the forklift with a lifting strap attachment to lift a gear box off of the roll mill machine to be serviced when another, unbolted gear box got caught on one of the forks of the forklift causing it to break free and moved towards the machine operator. The machine operator moved away from the flying gear box, fell to the ground, and hit his head on a machine guard that was on the floor, causing a laceration to his ear and the top of his head and two cracked neck vertebrae.
An employee was checking a pumping unit to see if the belt was loose. The pumping unit activated and the belt amputated this right pinky fingertip.

An employee was changing gaskets on a valve that contained condensate. When the employee opened the pipe/valve, he was sprayed with hot water and sustained first and second degree burns to the back and legs.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in a parking lot and sustained a broken ankle requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was going to visit a client. While going up the steps at a neighbor's house, the employee slipped on an icy stairway and fell down the stairs. The employee sustained a broken right ankle.

At about 10:00 a.m. on February 27, 2020, a vehicle struck an employee as he was helping pedestrians at a crosswalk in a valet parking area. He suffered fractures to the shoulder, shoulderblade, vertebrae, and ribs, as well as a collapsed lung.
An employee was riding on a tug and suffered injuries to his neck and lower back when the tug went under a belt.

A maintenance employee was visually inspecting a stacker package maker to troubleshoot a reported issue. He placed his right leg inside the roll case area of the machine to obtain a better visual. As he was looking upwards in an attempt to identify the issue, the stacker activated and a package of wood came down the roll case area and struck the employee's right leg. The employee sustained fractures to the right tibia and fibula.

An employee was releasing the emergency release on a garage door. The door swung up, catching the employee's collar and pulling the employee off a telehandler basket. The employee fell 10-15 feet to the ground, suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was putting tires on a rack. He fell from the rack to the floor, suffering a head injury that caused brain bleeding.
On February 27, 2020, an employee fell to the ground outside near welding gas cylinders, suffering a head injury. The employee was found unconscious and was hospitalized.

An employee was manually pulling electrical wiring through the rear side of a 300-pound, partially assembled HVAC unit, when the unit tipped over and landed on the employee. The employee sustained a fractured lumbar vertebra.
An employee was shocked while moving components in an electrical outlet box.
An employee was moving furniture on a loading dock. The employee felt dizzy and fell backwards three feet off the loading dock to the ground. The employee sustained bleeding on the brain.

An employee was pulling a pin from a stud in preparation for mooring operations. The pin struck the employee, causing contusions and a laceration on the right side of the face and a hematoma on the back of the head.
An employee was moving a granite slab. The slab fell on the employee's foot, breaking it; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a sensor on a tank. The scale on the tank read zero so he thought the tank was empty. When he removed the sensor, hot asphalt sprayed out and the employee sustained second degree burns to the face and arm.

An employee was tasked with operating the rotary blast machine. While walking to his work station, he tripped on a piece of banding and fell to the floor, injuring his right hip. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was assisting others carry a 3/4" pipe. When he stepped on the edge of a 4" concrete pad, the employee's ankle rolled and fractured.

An employee was cleaning up after replacing a motor on a conveyor. While trying to pick up the old motor it slipped and fell. The employee tried to catch it and the motor fell on his right hand causing broken bones.

An employee was part of a crew installing guardrails on the side of the highway. The employee was knocked down by a concrete truck and the truck ran over his toes. The employee suffered toe fractures that required surgery.

An employee was loading two empty containers onto a forklift. They became tangled, and the employee left the forklift to straighten the load. One of the containers fell and struck the employee's right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
A bundle of angle iron was being lowered and the injured employee's left thumb was caught under the bundle resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was cleaning the lobby area when he tripped over a broom and fell breaking his right hip.
An employee was operating a brake press and fractured two fingers and dislocated one finger.
An employee was stationed on the ground hoisting materials via a crane. While following the materials on the crane, the employee tripped on a staged joist and fell injuring his left knee.

During swabbing operations, an employee was changing a drain hose from one bucket to another when hydrogen sulfide gas released from the hose. The employee fainted and was hospitalized for hydrogen sulfide exposure.
An employee was removing snow from their shoes after walking into work. The employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was shocked by an industrial vacuum cleaner while using it to vacuum blasting grit. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving pallets in a tractor trailer. A pallet fell onto the employee's face, causing a broken nose and fractures to the upper jaw and chest.
An employee was pulling a board with a bar from the rerun deck. The board struck the employee's lower right leg and fractured it.

An employee was roll-forming sheet metal into an 8-inch tube. The radius had been made too small. The employee tried to pull the metal piece out and their right hand was pulled into the roller. The pinky and ring fingers on their right hand were smashed resulting in medical amputation of the pinky finger. The machine was in auto-run at the time.
An employee fell from a telehandler basket onto the ground and suffered a broken wrist and arm injuries.

An employee retrieving a case of product which had fallen in an automatic storage and retrieval system (ASRS) was caught between the rack and the shuttle. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones in both legs and feet.

An employee was monitoring machines on the production floor when he noticed plastic sticking to the head of the machine. As the employee tried to remove the plastic, the machine clamp closed on and crushed his left hand.

An employee was using a hand truck to move a large compression testing machine. The shipping weight of the item was 975 lbs. The load was top heavy and when the employee tipped it back it fell and struck his lower left leg causing a fracture near the ankle.

An employee was moving a 550-pound titanium slab to another location on the plant floor using a  vacuum attached to a crane. She then went to mark the slab when the vacuum failed and the slab fell, pinning her right hand between the slab and the floor. This resulted in a fracture to the right middle finger and amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was repairing wood on the roof and fell approximately 18 feet from the roof onto the ground. The employee suffered fractures.

A crew of ironworkers was disassembling am 1,100-pound steel jacking frame using chain hoists. The upper section of the frame freed from the upper bracket and the load became unstable, swung free, and knocked an employee to the ground. The employee suffered a concussion and lacerations to the kidney and pancreas.
An employee was pulling landscaping ivy from the grounds and felt chest pain. The employee was hospitalized with unstable angina.
An employee was removing a battery from a powered industrial truck (PIT) with a hoist. The battery fell from the hoist onto the employee's foot and caused a partial amputation of the second toe.
An employee was struck by a concrete form and sustained a ruptured disk, and other related shoulder, back, and neck injuries.
An employee was testing the operation of a fan when a finger on their right hand was caught in the fan belt and pulley resulting in lacerations and a fingertip amputation.

An employee was pushing cattle in the pens when a steer jumped the 10-foot gate and struck the employee causing multiple facial fractures and a laceration across the nose. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a large dolly and fell to the floor, hitting several items on the way down. She suffered a broken bone in her left thigh and a strained right wrist.

An employee was securing the lock on a container when a coworker pushed the adjacent container while his hand was still on the lock. His right index finger was caught between the container and the floor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was shutting the back room exit door when wind caused the door to slam shut. The employee's finger was smashed between the door and its frame resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a forklift behind the store when the forklift fell off the dock and rolled onto its side. The employee was hospitalized with a possible broken pelvis, arm, and rib.
An employee was showing a camper to customers. When the employee tried to fold down a counter extension, their index finger was caught in the folding arm resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was emptying a tub of ham shank bones situated near a band saw and contacted the saw blade resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.

On February 29, 2020, a sales employee entered a tire service bay and tripped over a pneumatic air hose, striking his head on a wall.  He suffered a head laceration and two fractured vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a standup forklift and moving a pallet of product. The employee jumped off the forklift as it veered toward a pallet racking system. The employee's foot was crushed between the forklift and the rack guard protection.

An employee was walking on top of mold tools, staged between molding machines, in order to stage a hoisted mold tool in the same area. The employee slipped off the top of a mold tool and fell approximately four feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for contusions to the head and torso.

On February 29, 2020, an employee was on an elevated platform to perform routine cleaning activities and fell through an open access hatch in the floor of the platform. The employee fell onto a metal grate and sustained fractures to both arms and a rib requiring hospitalization.
An employee was carrying hot water in a pitcher in the kitchen. The pitcher overflowed onto her right hand causing second degree burns.

While hooking up a pump trailer to the hitch on a truck, an employee's finger was caught between the hitch ball on the truck and the coupler on the trailer. The employee sustained a crushing injury/fracture to the left middle finger that required surgical amputation.

An employee was replacing a baggage conveyor system clutch and checking the drive belt when the employee's glove was caught and their left hand was pulled into the machine's pulley resulting in a partial amputation of the index finger.

An employee was working on plastic display racks in the garden center. The employee was standing on a table attempting to pull a leg out of one of the racks when the table became unstable and the employee fell to the concrete floor. The employee fractured a hip.

On March 1, 2020, at approximately 5:40 a.m., the injured employee was catering a flight with employees 2 and 3. While the catering box on the lift truck was elevated, employees 2 and 3 were closing the aircraft's door and heard a noise. They observed the injured employee on the ground below. It is believed that the injured employee was inside the catering box while it was raised to service the aircraft and fell out after the box's door was opened. The injured employee sustained a skull fracture.

An employee lost balance while operating an electric pallet jack. The employee fell from the pallet jack and their left foot was caught between the pallet jack and a pallet. The employee was hospitalized with an open fracture of the left big toe.
An employee was mopping a floor. When he went to get a caution sign, he slipped and fell to the floor, breaking and dislocating his elbow.
An employee was producing a run of product on a machine when it jammed. While clearing the jam, the employee's middle finger and either the ring or index finger on his left hand were amputated.

Two driver employees were riding a lift gate from the ground to the trailer's edge. As they were traveling up, one employee reached down to lift up the trailer's roll up door. While reaching for the trailer's door, the employee's left foot got caught between the lift gate and the back of the trailer. Three toes on the employee's left foot were broken and the employee was hospitalized.
The injured employee was going through a doorway on the roof to re-enter the building when he missed the step into the facility and fell down the step. He was hospitalized with a broken right hip.

An employee was using a torch to cut back-to-backs from 12-inch channel iron. His hose got caught; as he tried to free it, the torch slid down his hand into his glove. It caused second- and third-degree burns to the palm and hand.
An employee had just stepped off the back of a truck when the truck backed up. Its tire ran over the employee's foot, breaking it.
An employee was feeding raw product into an extruding machine when their hand was caught in a roller. The employee sustained a partial de-gloving injury.
An employee was in a truck lane after sealing a truck. A truck backed up and pinned the employee against the building, crushing the employee's legs.

An employee was applying sealer on roofing paper. The employee stepped backward and fell through a skylight opening, landing about 18 feet below and suffering a cerebral hemorrhage, broken bones, and a lacerated liver and spleen.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to the ring fingertip while working on a butterfly valve actuator.
An employee working on a barge slipped and fell, sustaining a pulled hamstring.

The injured employee was on an aerial lift, conducting an orientation of a steam valve. Upon completion of the job, the injured employee came down from the lift. He went to remove his lock from the lockbox, and struggled with getting the lock off. Another employee noticed the injured employee's hands were shaking, his breathing was labored, and he seemed confused. The injured employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

An employee was trying to direct milking heifers into milking stalls. The employee was pushing one of the heifers into the stall when she jerked her head up and caught the employee's finger against an overhead guardrail. The finger was amputated.

An employee was pushing a stand of drill pipe to its stowed position. While pushing the drill pipe, he slipped and fell forward. He placed his right hand on the deck to catch his fall. The stand of drill pipe swung back towards the injured employee as the driller was lowering the top drive to catch the stand, before it swung across the mast. The stand of drill pipe was then set down on the injured employee's right hand, amputating his ring finger.
An employee was setting up an oven's outfeed plates. The rake initiated and struck the employee, causing second-degree burns to the employee's back.
An employee was operating the groove side end matcher machine when the rotating saw blade contacted the employee's fingers resulting in partial amputation of the left thumb and index finger.
An employee slipped in liquid and fell down the stairs. He sustained injuries to the left side of his body, including internal injury.
An employee was on a pathway, walking toward a building, when she slipped on ice and fell to the ground. She suffered a broken right leg.

On March 2, 2020, an employee was helping winch a treetop to a wood chipper when the winch rope lacerated the employee's right hand. The employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers were medically amputated.

Two employees were trying to pull a cow out of a ditch. After they got the cow out, one employee's horse got scared and started bucking. The employee fell from the horse and the rope became tangled around his neck, causing face and neck injuries.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and sustained a head injury.

Employees were preparing a pig receiver and pig launcher. The block valves had been closed, and the receiver and launcher had been blown down; liquids were draining from the opening of the launcher. A forklift was being used to open the receiver hatch. The hatch struck the forklift's forks, and liquids at the receiver and launcher ignited. An employee suffered second-degree burns to the face and right hand, as well as first-degree burns to the left and right lower legs, and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping align a press, to be used in welding beams. His right hand was amputated between the ram and the shoe of the die.

An employee was moving a UPS cabinet off a pallet using a pallet jack. The pallet buckled and tipped toward the employee, bending his right hand back. He suffered two broken bones in the hand and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was on a forklift when its rear wheel amputated half of his left foot.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck by remote. The truck activated and ran over his leg, breaking it.

An employee was greasing a trailer at a loading dock. A forklift entered the trailer causing the trailer to bounce and the height locking mechanism to disengage. The trailer frame then came down on the axel and the employee's left middle finger was caught and crushed between the axel and frame. The injury led to an amputation.

An employee was placing wood skids, setting a cradle for 36-inch steel pipe while the operator turned it to set it in place. A skid fell and smashed the employee's right hand against a piece of pipe. The employee's thumb was partially amputated.
While moving a table, an employee's finger was caught between the framework of the table and an adjacent table. The finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
On March 2, 2020 at 10:43 PM, an employee was preparing to close the lobby service area of the restaurant when a robber shot the employee in the back, causing injury to the back, torso, and lung.

A truck driver had stopped to adjust the loose tarpaulin over the load of dirt in the dump truck. While climbing down after adjusting the tarpaulin, he fell to the ground breaking two ribs on the left side.

While working in the backroom, an employee's foot/feet got tangled in plastic wrap that was on a pallet. This caused her to fall and strike both the floor and a wooden pallet. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture below the knee.

An employee was waiting for a mechanic to gather tools needed to reeve a hoist cable through a single-sheave rope block. The block fell over, pushing the employee forward and causing him to fall. The block then landed on his left ankle/leg, breaking the ankle and the tibia.

An employee was cutting a small narrow piece of wood with a table saw and using a push stick. After finishing the necessary cut, the employee reached to shut the machine off. While reaching for the stop button, the employee's hand entered the vicinity of the blade before it had come to a complete stop. Three fingertips came in contact with the blade, resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was cutting metal on a shear. His hand slipped and the shear amputated four of his fingers.

An employee was on break in the break room. The employee put her foot up onto a chair, to tie her shoe, while she was standing. When the employee lifted her head back up, from tying her shoe, she passed-out, fell backward, and hit her head. The employee sustained a hematoma on the back of her head and was hospitalized.

At 1:30 p.m. on March 3, 2020, an employee was lining up separate pieces of lumber to be spliced together on a splicer machine. The machine tripped, and the employee's left hand was caught between the piece of lumber and the machine's metal rollers. The thumb, index finger, and middle finger were broken.
An employee was using a radial arm saw to cut wood 2 x 4s. The saw kicked back and the employee's finger contacted the blade, resulting in an amputation of the left index finger to the third knuckle.
An employee was receiving a pig from the pipeline, when the pig exploded through the cover. The employee sustained a fractured hand and a concussion.

A mechanic was investigating a possible hydraulic leak on the lift gate of a semi-trailer. A hydraulic line on the lift gate released pressurized hydraulic fluid which lacerated the mechanic's right middle finger and fluid was injected into the finger.

Two employees were fixing and troubleshooting a machine. One of them was on a ladder on top of a belt that needed to be replaced, 3.5 feet high. The machine was activated and the belt moved the ladder, causing the employee to fall to the ground and injure his lower right leg.
An employee had finished securing a load on a flatbed trailer when the employee lost balance and fell to the ground below. The employee's left arm was dislocated at the elbow.

An employee was tying in a newly installed, de-energized domestic water line by brazing a 3-inch copper coupling in a shallow excavated area with a gas brazing rod. A natural gas explosion burned the employee.
An employee was operating a cable-cutting machine. As she was realigning a cable, the machine actuated and amputated the tip of her right thumb.
An employee was leaving a client's facility when she tripped over a curb and fell to the ground, breaking her knee. She was hospitalized.

An employee was priming the seal water pumps for a paper machine. The employee removed a cap and was struck by discharging hot water, suffering first- and second-degree burns to the arms and back. The employee was hospitalized.

While walking to her car at the end of the day an employee's left foot slipped off the sidewalk and landed in the parking lot, causing her to lose balance and fall face first onto the sidewalk. The employee sustained a broken nose, facial fracture, concussion, and contusions.
An employee suffered a back injury while restacking pallets in a freezer.
An employee was judging a polo match and was struck by a horse. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg and a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was cleaning a truck in the rain. As the employee began to step down on the passenger side of the truck, she fell. Her back struck the ground. She suffered a closed head injury, a lumbar strain, a thoracic strain, and pain in both ankles.
An employee was cutting plywood with a table saw and amputated his left thumb. His left index finger suffered a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a border wire (clinching) gun when his finger was caught between the wire and the gun. The tip of his finger was amputated.

An employee was removing container deck shoes while containers were being discharged. He walked to the side of the hatch lid to get out of the swing radius of the crane. The employee then turned and stepped off the hatch lid. He fell and sustained a closed skull fracture.

Employees were laying down an 8" drill collar from the catwalk using the main rig hoist. During this, the injured employee was placing a 3x6 wooden board under the collar. When the collar came in contact with the board, it caused the end of the board to rise up, partially degloving the employee's left shin that required a skin graft.

An employee was using a hoist to move a wall into place so it could be screwed down. While moving the wall into place, it bumped into an existing wall and was displaced from the hoist, falling onto the employee. The employee sustained a neck fracture.
An employee was speaking on the phone at the nurses station when a patient attacked the employee by striking her in the face and neck. The employee was hospitalized with cervical and neck injuries.
An employee was servicing a car. A cover, placed under the car, slid when the employee stepped on it. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a dislocated right shoulder.

The operator of the up-cut saw pressed the lever to lock down the guard and start the saw cycle. As the guard was lowered an employee, who was responsible for take-off, reached to adjust the wood that was being cut. The blade contacted his right thumb, amputating the tip.

An employee was operating a re-saw. While the employee was repositioning the "stop" on the saw, his foot contacted the saw blade. He sustained a laceration to a toe and tendon requiring surgery. The machine was running at the time.
A security guard was walking through a kiln when he stepped into a hole filled with hot water. He suffered second-degree burns to the right leg, from the foot to just under the knee.

An employee was placing a B-arm on a pole and was using an impact wrench. The impact wrench loosened the bolt and the arm fell, pinching the employee's index finger between the arm and the pole resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was entering the cab of a forklift. While shutting the door the employee's left middle finger was pinched between the door and the door jam resulting in a partial amputation.

At about 9:30 a.m. on March 3, 2020, an employee was using a winch on a disposal truck to move a dumpster. The employee's arm was caught in the winch cable between the dumpster and the truck, and was severed just above the wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained back pain due to riding in a truck bed.

Employees were placing front tongue load-bearing metal poles into metal stand boots. A metal pole weight slipped, and an employee's right thumb was caught between the pole base and the boot rim. It was amputated at the first joint. The employee was hospitalized and the thumb was surgically reattached.

An employee was retrieving a pallet of baked goods. The pallet in front of that one fell, striking the employee in the head and leg as he was exiting the fork truck. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for the injured leg.

Air was being reintroduced to a dry pipe fire suppression system as part of an inspection. The air supply pipe burst. The pipe struck an employee standing outside the room, about 3 feet from the door. It cut his head, causing an injury that required hospitalized and stitches.
An employee was standing next to a dumpster. A hopper was being moved, and the employee's little finger was caught between the hopper and the dumpster. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing metal from a wall while standing on the log deck. He lost his footing and fell through a gap between the log deck and the transfer deck and landed on the basement floor. He sustained a closed head injury and a lumbar disc herniation.
While closing the door of the recovery boiler personnel elevator, an employee's right hand was caught in the closing door and three metacarpal bones were fractured.
An employee was changing a water filter for heated processed water. When the employee opened the filter, water splashed onto the inside portion of their upper right arm, causing a second degree burn.

The injured employee was supervising another employee who was cutting grooves into a piece of pipe. When the injured employee reached to grab a pipe, his right hand was caught in the roll groover machine and two fingers were amputated.
An employee suffered second-degree burns while conducting an arc flash study. The employee was hospitalized.

An excavator was being used to turn a wrench to remove nuts on a crusher. The wrench came loose and hit an employee in the head. The employee suffered a welt and knot on his forehead and a swollen right eye.

An employee was loading a single, push-around manlift onto the lift-gate of a stake-body truck. The lift became unstable. While the employee attempted to stabilize it, he slipped and fell sustaining a severe laceration on his left shin.

On March 4, 2020, a lineman was transferring #6 copper wire from an old pole to a new pole while on an aerial lift (30 feet above the ground). He was using a MAC (used as a temporary jumper wire) when a live #6 copper wire at the other end of the MAC touched his left thigh and right elbow, which completed the circuit, causing contact burns to his left thigh and right elbow. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking into the building an employee tripped and fell on the floor, fracturing their hip.
An employee was operating a bagging machine. The employee stopped the bagger and was inspecting the side sealer when the sealer cycled. The knife came down and amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was disassembling an MRI medical table when it fell onto his hand, breaking it.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum in the band saw when his left hand slipped and his left middle finger was partially amputated by the saw blade.
A cashier was getting a pizza for a customer. She tripped on a rubber mat and fell, breaking her hip. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee had been inspecting an HVAC unit on the roof of a building. He then climbed down the first section of a fixed ladder from the roof and was standing on a metal platform before climbing down the second section of the ladder. He fell through the opening in the platform where the second section of the ladder starts, and landed on the ladder's base, which is a raised metal platform. He sustained fractures to the left arm and right ankle.

A sanitation employee was cleaning a dough cruncher/roller machine when two fingers on his right hand were amputated between the nail and knuckle. At the time of the incident, the blade was not in the machine, but the machine was running.
An employee was dumping a dump hopper. The hopper came back down and struck the employee's left little finger, resulting in an amputation.

A mail carrier was delivering mail to a residence. While running from a barking dog, the mail carrier fell and struck their head against the wheel of a customer's car. The mail carrier sustained fractures to an eye socket, the right shoulder, and left elbow.
An employee was dismantling shoring when a beam fell on him and broke his right leg.
A battery on a pallet fell onto an employee's leg, breaking the tibia and causing a chemical burn.
An employee had an allergic reaction to an antibiotic and was hospitalized.
An employee's right middle finger was pinched between two grates in a piece of equipment. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped and fell about 10 feet off of a residential roof, landing on frozen ground. The employee's right heel was fractured.
