An employee was working on an individual folder machine. The employee slipped and their hand contacted a gear resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.

The injured employee was talking to another employee while kneeling on the mud pan. The injured employee's right foot/leg were caught between the mud pan and the catwalk resulting in a fracture to the right leg. The machine was in operation at the time.
An employee had an allergic reaction to shrimp that someone was eating nearby and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell over a curb while participating in a fire drill. The employee struck the ground and suffered a broken right knee and right-side contusions.
An employee was working on an excavator bucket, he tripped over a pry bar and fell to the floor, breaking and dislocating his left wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee passed out while sitting in a meeting. He was hospitalized with altitude sickness and dehydration.

An employee was backing up a motorized pallet jack. The employee started to step off the pallet jack while it was still moving backwards and her right leg was pinned between the pallet jack and a floor scale. The employee sustained two broken bones in the lower right leg.
An employee was observing a changeover of a rolling mill. The carriage moved and pinched the employee's right hand, amputating the middle finger above the tip.
An employee was closing the gate to the pipe storage area (bullpen) and caught a finger between the gate stop and the gate resulting in a partial amputation.
A temporary employee was cutting wood on a table saw. The wood kicked up and the blade amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee removed the tarp from a load on her truck, suffered a heart attack, and was hospitalized.

After recharging the furnace, there was an explosion inside the furnace. An employee was hit by a hot piece of scrap metal that flew out of the furnace while he was using the lance. The scrap metal struck the employee in the left shoulder near the arm pit.

On March 4, 2020, an employee was using a table saw when he noticed that the dust collecting vacuum appeared to be clogged. He was reaching to tap the hose/vacuum when his hand hit the moving blade, severely lacerating two fingers.

To repair a pump, an employee removed a grate from a 2-foot deep pit containing hot water which drains from a corrugated machine. The employee lost his balance and his left leg entered the water up to the calf. The employee was hospitalized with a second degree burn.
An employee was removing a mold from press. The employee's finger was pinched between the accordion mold and the stop block. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was operating a kick shear and amputated their left index and middle fingers.

As an employee was walking to his work station, he saw two boards misaligned on the green trimmer conveyor belt. When he reached to align the boards his left pinky finger was jammed between the conveyor belt wall and the boards. His left pinky fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee fell from a dumpster and sustained severe head injuries.
While walking around the exterior of the building, an employee stepped in mud and sustained a broken ankle.

Employee 1 was using a front-end loader inside a concrete storage bin to scoop up a boulder of burnt soybeans that had clumped together. Employee 1 could not scoop the boulder into the front-end loader's bucket. The confined space attendant and a supervisor went into the storage bin to assist the front-end loader in scooping the boulder into its bucket. Another soybean boulder, weighing approximately 100 pounds, fell down and hit the attendant and the supervisor and they both sustained fractures to the pelvis. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of their vehicle on their mail route, slipped in slush, and fell to the ground breaking the left ankle.
An employee fell down the stairs from an office trailer, landing on the ground and breaking his leg in two places. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it was struck by another stand-up forklift at an intersection inside the facility. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was cutting steaks with a bandsaw, The sawblade amputated his right index fingertip.

Employees were trying to move a roadside traffic arrow sign onto a lowboy trailer. One employee's finger was pinched between the sign's hitch and the trailer frame. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the left middle fingertip.

The injured employee was assisting another employee with removing a pin from a mini-excavator. When the pin came out, it struck the injured employee's left hand causing a fractured wrist and a tendon/ligament injury. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee slipped and fell in a staff bathroom. Her left shoulder struck the wall between the table and the toilet and was broken.

An employee had been connecting cables between a load bank and a transformer (neither were connected to an energy source). After that he began to roll out and position cables to connect the transformer to an electrical switchboard. While positioning cables at the rear of the switchboard in preparation for making the final connections, he contacted an energized buss bar. The employee sustained first degree burns on both arms, with second degree burns on his forearms and hands. He also sustained first and second degree burns on the left side of his chest. Additionally, he sustained two exit wounds on his left leg, one on the knee and the other just above the knee.

An employee was loading up a stall with a crane on an exterior crane to a building. The employee's left pinky finger was caught between pieces of steel; the pinky finger was broken and tendons were lacerated on the pinky and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

A cowboy was walking his horse out of the horse barn to start the day. When he climbed on his horse it started to buck and he fell to the ground. He sustained fractured ribs and vertebrae, and a punctured lung.

An employee was walking down a stairwell en route to her office. The employee miss-stepped and fell down the flight of stairs to the stair landing. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.
An employee was filling cylinders with pressurized nitrogen. A piece of metal came loose, lacerating and breaking the employee's arm.
An employee was exiting the back of the delivery truck after he finished a delivery. He missed a step and fell 38 inches to the ground resulting in a fractured right patella.
On March 5, 2020, an employee was using a handheld grinder to grind on metal. The grinding wheel severely lacerated the employee's leg.

A forklift pushed a metal vat against a bollard while an employee had their hand on the vat. The employee's left middle finger was smashed between the vat and the bollard and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped on a bubble of linoleum in the floor and fell, injuring his back.
An employee was cutting product from a carcass. The knife lacerated the employee's inner right thigh; the employee was hospitalized.
While using an order picker machine, an employee fell 12-15 feet to the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a broken back, ruptured spleen, and multiple rib fractures.

On 3/5/2020, a custodian was cleaning a toilet. The employee placed bleach in the toilet and then added a germicidal bowl cleanser chemical to the toilet. A chemical reaction occurred and the employee had an asthma attack. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 5, 2020, an employee was using a pressure washer to clean a scrubber. When the washer was activated, the wand jumped away from the hose and lacerated his left hand with water (pressurized at 3,500 psi). He was hospitalized.

An employee was in a bucket truck's bucket. The upper boom caught between branches; while the booms were being moved, a branch broke, causing the upper boom to spring side to side. The employee fell out of the bucket and was caught by his full-body harness after falling 2 feet. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was performing an operations check on a recently assembled rifle. A component of the rifle was missing, allowing the rifle's bolt to be ejected, lacerating the employee's face and imbedding into their shoulder.
An employee was threading a production line with plastic. The employee's head was caught and injured between two rollers.
An employee was walking around a unit of corrugate, tripped on dunnage, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured femur.
An employee was cutting metal with a torch. Metal splattered onto his right leg, burning the inside calf area.

An employee of Collins Aerospace and an employee with another company were working on the back rest of an aircraft seat. The Collins Aerospace employee suffered an amputation of a right-hand fingertip between the first knuckle and the nailbed.
An employee was pulling a strip of rubber out of a rubber warming mill. The rubber broke, causing her to fall backwards to the floor and suffer multiple broken bones in her left arm and wrist.

An employee was operating a standup forklift and was making a right hand turn into an aisle. The employee's leg hit a guardrail and the employee sustained a sore foot. The employee later had surgery to amputate the big toe and the tip of the second toe.

An employee was putting a brass bushing in a ring bearing for a beam. A forklift was lowering the beam while the employee was manually adjusting the position of the bushing. The injured employee's left ring finger was crushed by the beam resulting in surgical amputation.
An employee was pouring gasoline into a vehicle carburetor. The gasoline ignited and burned the employee's right arm and hand, right-side chest and neck, and left arm.
An employee was using a sledgehammer to straighten out a piece of metal on a vehicle when a piece of metal broke off and hit him in the eye.

A service technician was installing rental equipment attachments. As he was inserting a retaining ring, the equipment attachment fell and his left index finger was caught and lacerated between the ground and the attachment. He was hospitalized and had surgery on his left index finger.

An employee was visually inspecting the calciner (furnace) tube. When the employee removed the manifold for the calciner tube, tungsten (product) and nitrogen and/or hydrogen caused an explosion inside the calciner tube. Flames shot out of the end of the tube and burned the employee's face and right forearm.
An employee was working on a garbage truck. The employee disconnected the hydraulics and the arms of the truck came down and trapped the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.

A temporary employee was using a sandblaster to prepare steel product for painting. The employee lost control of the sandblaster and sandblasting material struck the employee's face and eyes. The employee sustained abrasions to the left side of the face (cheek and forehead).
An employee was loading a trailer using a forklift. The truck moved forward and the forklift fell to the ground. The employee suffered a cut or pinch to the right thumb/palm.

While returning to his parked vehicle after delivering a package to a residential address, an employee was attacked by three dogs. The employee sustained multiple bites and scratches to the hands, arms, and legs and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading ductwork from a truck to a skip pan. The employee slipped and fell through a 2- to 3-foot gap between the truck and the pan, landing on the ground 3 feet 8 inches below. The employee hit the side of the truck while falling, suffering five broken right-side ribs (one of which punctured the lung).
An employee tripped on a rack's leg and fell, suffering a glass cut to the right hand.

An employee was greasing equipment while standing on a conveyor belt. When the equipment was powered on, the employee fell from the conveyor and struck his head and right hand. The employee sustained injuries to his right hand.
An employee was pressing bus parts using a 90-ton press. The machine actuated and amputated the tips of eight of the employee's fingers.

On March 6, 2020, an electrician in a mechanical room was disconnecting wires that feed to the fire alarm pump, to replace it. The power company arrived to perform the power shutdown and told the electrician that he could flip the breaker. Afterwards, he disconnected the wiring and the breaker arc flashed, causing second and third degree burns to his face and hands. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an extruder. His right hand was caught in a running nip point in the machine while removing waste material from the die and the little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was transferring sulfuric acid from a railcar to a cargo tank trailer. When the railcar was empty, the employee removed the product transfer hose. While removing the valve fitting, sulfuric acid (in the form of a mist) sprayed out and contacted the employee's face and upper torso. The employee was hospitalized for chemical burns.
While running conduit, an employee fell partially through a ceiling. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung, and was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting a measurement setup on a parabolic eye forming apparatus. During the setup process, the forming assembly cycled and the employee's left index finger was crushed between the forming assembly and the die block. The employee sustained a laceration and fracture to the left index finger that resulted in medical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell while walking down stairs, landing on the floor and suffering a broken right tibia and head pain.
An employee was in a trailer moving around freight. He was unstrapping and moving a skid when a skid fell and struck his back. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.

An employee was traversing south in a walkway, entering a T-intersection in the mechanical components department. A forklift that was hauling a hopper full of scrap metal came from the right and turned left into the intersection. The hopper struck the employee on the left side knocking the employee to the ground. The employee sustained a right forearm contusion, two or three fractured ribs on the left side, a fracture of the left upper femoral head, a fractured vertebra, and a concussion.
An employee was walking and tripped over a cable that was attached to a chair. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

On 3/6/2020, an employee was unloading a tractor trailer at a convenience store. While walking up the tractor trailer ramp, he struck his head on the tractor trailer door and fell off the loading ramp. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and was hospitalized.

A front loader operator was salvaging parts of a car. As he was loosening the bolt on a spring assembly, his hand struck against the interior of the car's wheel well, injuring his left ring finger. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
While working a wedding event, an employee was walking down the stairs, misstepped on the first stair, and fell down the stairs. The employee sustained a broken elbow.
Automated carts/wagons moved and struck an employee's left leg, lacerating the upper thigh.

An employee was transporting a pallet containing two paper rolls (weighing about 900-1,000 pounds each) using a standup rider pallet jack. The pallet jack collided with another pallet, causing the rolls to shift. One struck his leg, breaking it.

An employee was operating a CNC lathe when an article of their clothing made contact with a bolt on the chuck. The employee was pulled into the moving chuck and sustained a broken wrist, a broken jaw, and a cut on the neck.

An employee was spraying the ceiling of a parking lot while on a rolling scaffold. The employee turned to spray and fell 6 feet from the scaffold to the concrete below. The employee was hospitalized with a subdural hematoma and facial fractures.

A temporary employee utilized an overhead crane to move a concrete panel from one area to another. The panel started moving towards a post. The employee put his hand on the concrete panel to stop it before hitting the post, but his left hand was caught between the panel and the post.  The employee sustained a crushing injury to the left hand and was hospitalized for surgery.
A terrain park employee broke his tibia and fibula after landing wrong while skiing.
An employee was walking at the job site when he tripped over some material and sustained a broken leg.

An employee was pushing a steel mud bucket inside a tunnel work area. The bucket was loaded with pieces of lumber and C-shaped steel beam rings. A piece of the steel caught the edge of the tunnel wall, moved back, and caught the employee's right index finger against the upper edge of the bucket. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

On March 7, 2020, an employee went to talk to a co-worker in a back office which is near a stock room/merchandise processing area. In that area, cardboard boxes are broken down and flattened so they can be removed from the area. Afterwards, she walked to the merchandise processing area, slipped on a cardboard box, and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized with a sprained knee and fractures to her left femur and hip.

An employee was cutting up scrap metal. There was a hole at the connection in the hose of the hand torch which caused the employee's shirt to become saturated with oxygen. When the employee lit the torch, his shirt caught on fire. The employee was hospitalized with burns on his stomach, right arm, and back.

An employee was breaking down storage racks when their right pinky finger was struck by a long-handled sledgehammer. The finger was smashed between the rack and the hammer and required a partial amputation at the hospital.

An employee was assisting with patients in the emergency department. The employee became faint, weak, and lethargic in part due to exhaustion, then began having seizures. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was stringing a machine when his finger was caught. The fingertip was broken resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking toward a break room. The employee suffered fractures and was hospitalized.
A boom lift ran over an employee's right foot, causing a fracture of the first metatarsal and a laceration of the foot.

Three employees were tying up a cruise vessel when the vessel tightened one of the ropes, causing it to pop and strike the three employees. Two of the employees were hospitalized. Employee 1 was hospitalized with a fractured left index finger and left forearm. Employee 2 was hospitalized with multiple fractures on the left arm. Employee 3 sustained bruises to the right side of the body.

An employee had just finished unloading a pallet of product. The employee picked up the empty wood pallet to place it on top of the stack of empties and got a splinter in their right hand. The next day, the employee was hospitalized due to an infection in the hand.
An employee was working on skis, removing a fence. The employee fell down onto the trail and suffered a broken hip/pelvis.
The injured employee had been taking the orders of drive-through customers. The injured employee was then involved in an altercation with fellow employees and sustained a broken eye socket.
An employee was placing cartons on packaging equipment. The employee tripped on a pallet leveler corner base and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee had climbed on a desk to change a clock on the wall. The employee became light-headed and fell to the floor, hitting his head and sustaining a contusion.

The cast deck crew were performing a ladle exchange, which involves the ladle turret being rotated from north to south to exchange the empty ladle with a full ladle. The crew were changing the ladle shroud during the ladle exchange. The crew removed the spent shroud from the empty ladle and turret rotation was then initiated to exchange the empty ladle. The crew was placing a new shroud onto the shrouding device, when an employee s foot was caught between the shrouding device and the access stairway on the north tundish car. The injured employee was hospitalized with a crushing injury to the left foot.

An employee was walking through the deli backroom area when her sneaker caught on the trim around a floor drain causing her to fall forward and strike a wall several feet away. The employee sustained a fracture to her left humerus, a laceration to her left knee requiring 6 stitches, and a contusion to the left wrist. The employee required surgery.

Two employees were working on a feed line. They had shut the power off to the feed auger and were clearing a rock from it. Once the rock was pried free, the auger swung back to its normal position and amputated one employee's right index fingertip, also lacerating the employee's right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a cash register when a cord caught her foot and she fell. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery for her broken leg.
An employee reached into an ingoing nip point and suffered a fractured finger.
An employee was operating a yard hostler or yard dog. While making a turn on the dock, the hostler rolled over and the glass in the cab shattered. The employee sustained lacerations to the arm.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder trimming a tree with loppers. The employee lost his balance and fell onto his left hand fracturing the wrist.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a large planter and rolled onto its side. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.

On March 9, 2020, an employee was trying to remove a tool die from a thermoforming machine when his left index fingertip was caught between the machine's handle and its shaft. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to remove built-up margarine that was clogging a machine. The machine caught her glove and amputated the tip of her finger.

An employee was waiting for glass to come down the conveyor/roller system when their fingers were caught in the system. The left ring finger was de-gloved and the left middle finger was amputated at the second knuckle.
An employee fell while beginning to climb down a 24-foot ladder, landing on a concrete pad and suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was using a pocket knife to remove a headlight switch from a truck. The knife cut his left thumb.

On March 9, 2020, an employee was walking in the parking lot at the hospital, going into work. The employee was struck on the side by a vehicle which caused her to fall and hit the ground forcibly, resulting in a fracture to the L3 vertebra.

An employee was using a pry bar to help align a front end loader and its pin so he could guide the pin back into place. The pry bar slipped, causing an amputation (not affecting bone) to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was about 18 feet up on a ladder at a job site when the ladder slid and the employee fell hitting his head. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was operating an extruder machine. While aligning a plastic string inside the cutter, the employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was function testing the wench line for leaks, slipped on the oil rig floor, and fell onto a sheave, amputating two fingers on his left hand. The sheave was partially guarded at the time.
During a commercial dive, an employee suffered an injury that resulted in an amputation to a left-hand finger.
An employee was operating a machine. The employee's arm was caught and fractured in a nip point between a roller and the product.

Inside a dumpster, bleach and washer fluid had mixed, resulting in chloroform gas being generated and entering the building. An employee scheduling patients for medical services was overcome by the gas. The employee was hospitalized with lung and gastrointestinal illnesses.

An employee was cleaning the yard and burning trash. An empty barrel that had held flammable material exploded on the trash pile. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the hands and face, and another employee from a different company also received hand and facial burns. Both employees were hospitalized.
An employee fell off a scaffold while sanding drywall. The employee suffered a broken, leg, arm, and finger.

An employee was walking with a pallet jack to pick up a set of pallets. The handle of the pallet jack jerked to the right and the pallet jack pinned the employee's right foot against a barrier. The employee sustained fractures to the right foot.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in a warehouse when his foot/ankle were caught and crushed between the forklift and a guardrail. The employee was hospitalized with presumed fractures of the foot and/or ankle.
An employee was working on a cord crimper and amputated the right forefinger.
An employee was setting up a horizontal band saw. The saw's hydraulic vises caught the employee's fingers, causing amputations to three fingers on his left hand.
An employee was using a deli slicer when its blade partially amputated her left index finger.
An employee was tightening bolts inside an electrical cabinet. An arc flash caused first-degree burns to the employee's face.
An employee was hanging sheet rock in an elevator shaft and fell. The employee had back pain.

An employee was spotting for a powered industrial vehicle operator who was loading a large toolbox onto a truck. The toolbox slipped and the employee tried to catch it, resulting in a broken leg and arm gash.

A well service floor hand was connecting pipe to a power swivel. The employee's left thumb was caught and crushed between the tubing elevators and a lifting cable. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing a surgical amputation to the thumb.

The injured employee was assisting another associate in working on a bumper winch. The injured employee's hand was on the bumper when someone under the truck called the employee's name. The injured employee looked under the truck and the eyelet on the bumper winch caught their thumb. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right thumb.
An employee took off his hard hat, struck another employee in the face with it (breaking his nose in two places), and beat the second employee

An employee was removing a tire, rim, and wheel assembly from a tractor. The wheel hit the ground, causing the chain to come undone and the tire to fall on him. He suffered broken vertebrae and a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

After crushing boxes inside a dumpster, an employee was climbing out of the dumpster when something caught his trousers and caused him to fall. He landed against the metal edge of a nearby compactor table and suffered three broken ribs.

An employee was cleaning the deli slicing room conveyor belt (the belt after the slicer) when the belt caught his glove and pulled his hand into the roller of the drive shaft. His left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was using a meat saw. The saw cut the employee's finger to the bone and the employee was hospitalized, undergoing a surgical amputation to the finger.
An employee was using a table saw to cut plastic when the blade amputated the left middle and ring fingers.
On March 10, 2020, an employee was forming retainer parts on a 90-ton brake press. The press dropped onto the first three fingers of his right hand, crushing them. He was hospitalized.

An employee was riding in the back of a trailer with signs and barricades. The barricades fell over. As the employee tried to stop them from falling, he fell from the moving trailer onto the highway. The employee sustained bruises and contusions.
An employee was carrying lab supplies through a lab. The employee tripped over a table leg and fell, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was feeding bar stock into a bar straightener. The employee's apron became wrapped on the spinning bar; as the employee tried to free the apron, his left hand was caught between the bar and the machine guard. The tip of his little finger was amputated and the middle and ring fingers were broken.
While walking down stairs an employee fell and injured her ankle. The employee may have also hit her head.

The injured employee was cutting tree branches with other employees, when a tree branch fell and struck the injured employee in the head. The employee sustained a bruised head and a possible concussion.
An employee was doing cornice work from a 20-foot scaffold. He fell from the scaffold to the ground, landing on his face and shoulder and suffering broken bones. He was hospitalized.
An employee was rewinding a roll on a spool at the rewind station. The employee's hand was caught in the roll to the rewind machine and the employee sustained multiple arm fractures.

The injured employee was collecting produced water from a well site when he observed a person collapse. The injured employee attempted to render aid to the person, when he succumbed to hydrogen sulfide (H2S). The injured employee was hospitalized for H2S exposure.
An employee was loading parts on a nut welding machine when an electrode came down on the welding machine and smashed the employee's thumb. The left thumb was amputated.

While clearing wood from a under a chipper machine, an employee's right hand was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in amputation of the thumb and index fingers and lacerations to the right hand, forearm, shoulder, chest, and the back of the head.
An employee was exposed to hydrogen sulfide and was hospitalized for an inhalation injury.
An employee sustained a severe laceration to the forearm when a channel iron came forward from a machine and struck the employee.
An employee was dismounting a pallet jack when his ankle got caught between the jack and a yellow barrier pole. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was using an overhead crane to move a rack upright. The 200-pound rack fell from the crane and crushed the employee's left foot.
A plumber was installing a concrete anchor using a drill. His glove got caught in the drill and part of his finger was removed. The finger was amputated at the hospital.

An employee was operating a roll threader machine to manufacture a metal bolt. The employee picked up a piece of material and positioned it into the threader dies to thread. He closed the dies with the foot pedal and used his left hand to help balance the material. When the material began to spin, his glove was caught and his left arm was twisted and broken.

An employee was behind a truck, preparing to dump one of two pallets of lumber from the truck's dump body (which had been raised so the lumber could be unloaded). The other pallet slid off the truck and struck the employee's lower leg, breaking it.
An employee was retrieving something from a postal car when she slipped and fell to the ground, breaking her left ankle.
An employee sustained burns to the abdomen while cleaning a crock pot.

An employee was operating the crosscut machine, which uses table extensions for cutting larger rugs. To unfold a table, the employee pushed in the left bracket and then went to push in the right bracket. When he pushed in the bracket that is underneath the table, the extension came down, catching his fingertip between the middle and right table extensions. This resulted in a partial amputation and a fracture to the fingertip.
An employee was reinserting a die in a punch press when his middle finger was caught in a keyway. The 28-pound die amputated his fingertip.

An employee was blasting a steel structure using black beauty/coal slag as the blast media. The employee lost control of the hose and blasting device and was struck in the upper right arm by the blast media sustaining a laceration and penetration of the skin.
A mechanic was working on a pump truck's belt drive radiator fan system. His left little finger was caught between the timing belt and a pulley, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was clearing product from a conveyor belt and contacted a band saw blade resulting in a deep laceration to the left middle finger.
On March 10, 2020, an employee was working on an alligator shear when it activated and lacerated the employee's left middle and ring fingers.
While cleaning a dining room, an employee tripped on a customer's foot, fell to the floor, and suffered a bruised wrist and dizziness.

An employee had placed a skid between the blades of a skid steer and a concrete drain box to prevent damage. As the skid steer applied pressure to move the concrete box, the employee's finger was crushed between the skid and the concrete box, resulting in a partial amputation to the index finger.

An employee was monitoring a welding heat prep operation for a large drum shell that was braced for support. The drum expanded during heating, and the brace failed and struck the employee, who fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a head injury requiring stitches and hospitalization.

The injured employee was using a drum lifter to move 55-gallon drums. A drum became dislodged and another employee was helping to lift it manually. The 55-gallon drum then fell off the drum lifter and amputated the injured employee's left thumb tip.

The employee was punching small parts on the hydraulic punch press when a part got stuck. As she tried to pull the small part out of the punch press, the punch activated, smashing the end of her finger. The fingertip was amputated to just behind the fingernail.

An employee was pulling a battery cart carrying 40 cells. The cart struck a parked cart and the employee's right ring finger was pinched between the two, causing the amputation of the fingertip at the first joint.

An employee was removing something from the rollers of the glue machine when their right hand was caught in the rotating rollers and the right thumb was crushed. The thumb was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was operating a resistance welder. The employee placed a ring band on the lower electrode. She then placed a closure handle on the top of the band. Once the welding process was initiated, the employee reached for the next band to process with her left hand, and reached for the ring she was currently welding with her right hand. The machine had not completed the clamping process and her right index finger was caught between the upper electrode and the ring. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee had been removing formwork to set up for a different job and was struck by the concrete formwork and sustained a broken pelvis requiring hospitalization.

An employee working as a tower operator was performing a task that requires the blending of compounds used to fabricate plastic. While operating the regrind machine, the employee's left middle finger was partially amputated.
An employee was backing away from a cash register when she tripped on another employee's foot and fell, breaking her femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a garage door opener while standing on an adjustable A-frame ladder. A cable snapped and the employee fell to ground. The employee suffered a fractured wrist and leg.
While picking up traffic cones, an employee was struck by a vehicle mirror. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an upcut saw and contacted the blade with their left hand resulting in amputation of the left thumb and a hand injury.
An employee tripped and fell backwards into a concrete catch basin, landing about 7 feet below and suffering broken ribs and a concussion.
An employee rolled her ankle while walking, felling and sustained fractures to the lower tibia and fibula near the ankle joint.

An employee was trying to clear a jam in a line so that flour would feed from a hopper. The employee's right middle finger was caught between a chain and a hook; the first digit of the right middle finger was amputated.

An employee was on a metal, fixed ladder. He was opening the roof hatch to go onto the roof when he fell about 12-14 feet to the floor, hitting a sink faucet and the ladder on the way down. The employee was hospitalized with multiple rib fractures on the left side, a fractured scapula, and a bruised lung.

An employee was pushing a bird cart guiding it into a walkway. While entering the walkway, the employee's finger was caught between the cart and a stationary metal rail. The employee sustained amputation of the pinky fingertip.
An employee fell from a ladder and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was entering a building when the door closed on his left hand, crushing the fingers.

Earlier in the day the injured employee was visiting a client and had tripped on the curb, injuring his shoulder. A few hours later while at the office, he began to feel ill. The employee passed out and landed on the floor in an awkward position resulting in a fractured left foot and a dislocated left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a valve assembly back together when their right pinky finger was pinched and amputated in the valve assembly.

An employee was removing and repairing a hydraulic lift cylinder on a piece of equipment. The employee loosened a connection and pressurized hydraulic fluid burst out, hitting the employee's hand. Hydraulic fluid penetrated into the skin tissue and muscle of the thumb on the palm side of the hand.
An employee was loading a plastic applicator machine. A roller caught the employee's clothing and pulled the employee's left wrist into the applicator, where it was crushed and broken.

An employee was accessing the vane feeder to clean it out. The employee removed the cover and proceeded to clean out the vane feeder with his right hand. The employee's right index finger was caught in the machine resulting in an amputation down to the first knuckle. The machine was in operation at the time.

An employee was visually inspecting a faulty part for the cuber carrier. The employee had stepped out of the basket into the frame when the cuber carrier moved, causing him to lose balance and fall 12 to 13 feet onto a slat conveyor. The employee sustained fractures to the left wrist and left hip. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a blower to blow leaves off a planter. He fell off the planter to the ground 3 feet below, suffering a laceration to the back of the head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam in the cutter blades of a jelly machine. The blades amputated the employee's ring and middle fingertips.
A brick mason was using a drill to mix mortar when the drill's cord wrapped around their left ring finger causing a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was snowboarding from one lift area to the next to relieve another ski lift operator. The employee struck a tree, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was changing a valve while working from a ladder. The ladder slipped and the employee fell with the ladder to the concrete floor, sustaining a head injury.

At about 11:30 p.m. on March 11, 2020, an employee was setting up a drawbench machine to pull aluminum wire. The employee's right ring finger was caught between the wire and the capstan wheel, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was tipping plastic recyclable materials from a rolling cart into a dumpster when their right middle finger was caught between the cart and the dumpster. The distal end of the finger was amputated.

An employee assisting in hydro-excavation operations sustained injuries to the left foot from a pressure washer being operated by another employee. The injured employee sustained lacerations on the left foot a few inches above the ankle and between the little toe and the fourth toe.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to her car and fell, suffering a knee injury. She was hospitalized.

At about 12:20 a.m. on March 11, 2020, an employee was trying to adjust a stack of sheet metal when the stack fell. The employee's left ring finger was pinched between the sheet metal and a pallet, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unjamming the bottom plate of a cardboard baler. The bottom plate popped up and pinched the employee's right index finger against the baler frame. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee's left hand was caught in a sprocket as the employee checked a chain. The employee suffered possible finger amputations.

After finishing orientation and safety training, an employee went out in the yard to learn how to clean and assemble molds. While building a mold, the mold header dropped onto the employee's right ring finger resulting in amputation of the last 3/4-inch of the finger.
A forklift operator's foot contacted a steel upright shelf. The operator suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was hooking up a trailer to the back of a tractor. The employee's ring finger was pinched between the hitch and the trailer, suffering a soft tissue amputation to the fingertip. The fingertip was sutured.
An employee tripped and fell, and was hospitalized.
While operating a bandsaw, an employee suffered an avulsion to the tip of his right thumb.
An employee was struck by a motor vehicle in a construction zone, suffering a broken clavicle, ribs, and pelvis.
An employee was using a staple gun to secure cardboard to a shipping crate. The gun shot a 3/4-inch staple into his knee.
An employee tripped and fell in a store, suffering a knee injury. She was hospitalized.

An employee had been tearing down 2000-pound corrugated blocks of sugar. A chunk of sugar sloughed off the block and struck the employee in the back of the left leg. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia and fibula.
An employee was stepping from a sidewalk to a parking lot when she turned her left ankle and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee got out of his forklift and it moved forward, running over his foot and causing a compound fracture. He was hospitalized.
On March 12, 2020, an employee was getting on a parked forklift and was struck by another forklift resulting in a broken left ankle and foot.
An employee was strapping down a load on a tractor trailer when he fell off the trailer, landing on the pavement and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a hammer to remove parts when it smashed his finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was loading pails of adhesive into the bucket of a utility loader when their left middle finger was pinched between a 15-gallon pail and the bucket and amputated.

The injured employee was standing at the end of the dock waiting for a pallet to be set on the ground and then be loaded into a delivery truck. The pallet was set on the ground and as the forklift driver was removing the forks, the pallet tipped over and struck the injured employee. The injured employee sustained a fractured right hip and a rib fracture.

An employee was operating a crane that was lifting a mold with a turnover system. Another employee was operating the turnover system. The first employee was holding the hook to align the mold while the hydraulic lock on the hook was cycled. When the lock was cycled, the employee's left middle finger was pinched and partially amputated.

An employee was attaching oriented strand board (OSB) sheathing to exterior wall paneling using a staple bridge machine and was caught in the in-feed chain resulting in partial amputation of the distal part of the right middle finger.
The injured employee was assisting another employee with fueling a push boat when fumes/vapors in the area were ignited by a spark from the battery post. The injured employee sustained flash burns.
An employee was walking in the hallway in the lab. The employee tripped on a co-worker's foot and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured left hip.
An employee's left pinky finger was caught and amputated while using a tire machine to remove a tire from a rim.

An employee was standing on stored materials to take a measurement of materials on a storage rack. The employee slipped and fell backwards approximately 2 feet. The employee was hospitalized with a broken back and bruised legs and ankles.
An employee became dizzy while oiling a fifth wheel, fell, and injured his back. He was hospitalized.

While entering his tractor trailer on the driver's side, an employee felt a pop in his lower back. He did not slip or fall. After driving for one hour, the driver's seat came out of locked position and he sustained pain in the lower back.

An employee was assembling a meat grinder. While pushing a screw into the housing, the employee's right index finder got caught between the housing and the screw. The employee was hospitalized with a hand injury.
On March 12, 2020, an employee was trying to remove part of a broken power transmission line from the distribution line it had fallen on. An electrical flash burned the employee's stomach and wrist.

An employee was retrieving a window from a trash box attached to an aerial lift. When setting the window, the trash box tipped over and the employee fell 17 feet. The employee sustained a compression fracture to the spine.
An employee was cutting a ductile-iron pipe using a gas-powered handheld chop saw. The saw bound up, kicked back, and cut the employee on the right side of the chest.

The injured employee was overseeing that the rod connections were going well. A work crew was coming out of the well with 1.5-inch, fiberglass rods and double stands. They had just made the connection. An approximately 60-foot fiberglass rod unscrewed from the holding, slipped out of the transfer, fell out of the barrack, and hit the rig floor. It then bounced off the rig floor onto the ground and struck the injured employee on the left side of the head, knocking him unconscious.
An employee was removing overhead wood framing from a soffit. His foot slipped and he fell, breaking his right femur against a concrete flower planter.
Am employee was installing metal decking on the roof of a steel building. While going backwards, the employee fell approximately 19 feet off the roof and fractured an arm.
An employee was climbing a ladder to leave an excavation. A strap broke from the ladder and the employee fell to the ground at the bottom of the excavation, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was on a step ladder, troubleshooting an issue with a conveyor, when he lost his balance and made contact with the conveyor belt and pulley. The employee's left little finger was amputated.

An employee was cleaning on the third-floor mezzanine when they fell through an access hatch and landed on the second-floor mezzanine. The employee sustained a broken collar bone, a broken rib, a possibly broken vertebra, and a brain hematoma.

An employee was performing an inspection of the inside of a pipe near a solenoid valve. The valve actuated while his left hand was inside the pipe resulting in a partial amputation of the index and middle fingers.
An employee suffered a partial amputation of his left middle finger while cleaning a dicer machine.

An employee was helping install a gearbox on a machine. The gearbox slipped off the lift and caught the employee's right hand against the machine. The hand was lacerated, the middle finger was broken, and the little finger was dislocated.

An employee was troubleshooting and performing service and/or maintenance on equipment when an actuator valve engaged and caught the employee's finger. The left index finger was amputated. The equipment was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was feeding tubes into a draw machine. The employee's left ring and middle fingers were pinched between two tubes, and a fingertip was crushed and amputated.

An employee was checking for a seam under a suspended pipe. The sling holding the pipe shifted and the pipe lowered onto his right index finger, crushing the tip. The fingertip was amputated past the nail.

An employee was locking all the doors and securing the building after their shift. The employee tripped over a dock plate and fell to the ground, landing on their left elbow. The employee sustained a compound fracture of the left arm.
On March 13, 2020, an employee was overcome by gasoline motor fumes while spray-painting inside a home being built. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing the die on a mechanical punch press. The die came down on employee's hands and fingers, amputating the left middle finger, index finger, and half of the thumb and crushing the right index and middle fingers.
While taking garbage to a dumpster, an employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell on their leg fracturing it.

An employee was troubleshooting an R-22 refrigeration system. When the employee went to disconnect a connector from a valve, the connector did not fully disengage from the valve, causing the valve to be halfway open. R-22 refrigerant escaped. The employee was hospitalized with second degree chemical burns and frostbite to the top of both hands.
An employee was cutting turkey on a meat slicer. The blade partially amputated the employee's left middle finger.
At 4:30 p.m. on March 11, 2020, an employee was moving plastic-wrapped pallets. The employee tripped over plastic wrap and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was cleaning an idle roller of a card press. The employee was removing some material when the press tore a tendon in the employee's left index finger.
A passing school bus tire grabbed an employee's leg which was then torn open and degloved.

A truck driver was on the ground, directing a loader as it unloaded his truck. His right hand was caught between the trailer and the loader, amputating the ring and little fingers. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was moving a bundle of rebar off a pallet. His right little fingertip was pinched and sustained an amputation.
An employee was helping move a bundle of metal tubes. A couple of the tubes came loose and fell onto the employee, pinning him against another bundle and breaking his right shin.
An employee was using a wheel balancing machine. While reaching for a tool, his finger was struck by the wheel balancing machine. His right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee was pouring a corrosive cleaning chemical when it splashed in his eyes and onto his neck and shoulder. The bucket containing the chemical then fell, splashing his right leg as well. He suffered chemical burns to the eyes, neck, shoulder, and leg.

An employee was positioning an oilfield drill bit when it fell from the connection fixture it was connected onto. The bit fell onto the employee's left ring fingertip and crushed it against the work surface. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee slipped on a roof and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip and wrists.
An employee was backing a forklift through an aisle when it struck another forklift. The employee suffered a loss of consciousness, then pain and weakness in the upper extremities.
An employee was tying off a fish pump with a rope. The employee's thumb was caught in the rope and partially amputated.
An employee was checking a customer's car when the engine belt amputated the employee's middle finger.
An employee was waxing metal slides so that lumber would slide over them better. The employee's left hand was crushed between two pieces of metal as they came together.
An employee was standing on a 5-gallon bucket when it slipped out from under her. She fell to the concrete floor, suffering wrist fractures.

An employee was using a manual pipe dolly to move a pipe fabrication into a building for installation. He was guiding the pipe along the path when his right thumb was pinched between the pipe fabrication and an existing support, resulting in a partial transphalangeal amputation of the right thumb.

An employee climbed a 6-foot ladder to cut a tree branch. While cutting the tree branch with an electric saw, the employee lost balance and fell off the ladder sideways, landing on the left side of his back. The employee sustained fractures to the left wrist, ribs, and pelvis.
An employee slipped in water in a vestibule, suffering a dislocation of the left knee and a broken leg.
An employee was loading hose into a hose machine. The employee's left middle and ring fingertips were caught in the machine. The fingertips were medically amputated.
An employee was performing maintenance on a saw when the blade amputated his right middle finger.

An employee was cleaning wood dust from a molder after running the machine. The blades snagged the tips of his gloves, pulling his right hand under the guard and into the splitting head. The employee suffered amputations to the ring and little fingers above the knuckle.
While actuating a control valve, an employee was struck by a jet stream of hot water from a nearby hose. The employee sustained first and second degree burns.
An employee tripped over a pallet strap and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was backing up a pallet jack when his right foot was caught between the jack and the wall. The foot sustained a dislocation and fracture.
An employee was bitten by a client's cat on the finger. The wound became infected, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had an asthma attack while operating a two-saw edger.

An 8-ton tugger (a pneumatic winch with cables and pulleys) and snatch block were being used to move a coil pack into position. An employee was monitoring the cable and pulleys. The employee's right hand was caught between the cable and the channel of the block, causing amputations to the right index, middle, ring, and little fingers and a non-displaced fracture to the right little finger.
An employee was helping to unload a truck when three boxes fell and struck him in the head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a meat slicer. She lowered the slicing basket and went to scrub the upside face of the blade using a sanitized cloth. She extended her hand further out and her right ring finger ran across the blade resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking into work from their car to begin their shift. The employee slipped on ice and fell on the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip.
An employee was lifting bay doors when they came loose. He fell backwards and hit his head on the concrete ground, suffering a concussion.
An employee was repairing a fuel pole stanchion when his finger was caught between the clamp and the steel pole. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a reach forklift in an aisle that had been blocked off with a safety barrier. A customer went under the safety barrier and walked in front of the forklift to grab a case of mayonnaise. The employee tried to step off the forklift, but his shirt got stuck on the drive handle. The forklift then accelerated into steel pallet racking and the employee was pinned between the rack and the forklift. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An associate was stabbed while trying to save customers from a person with a knife. He was stabbed in the leg and suffered hand injuries that required surgery.

An employee was traveling upward on an aerial lift inside a tank. The lift stalled at a height of about 57 feet, then fell. The employee fell with the basket to the floor of the tank, breaking both feet and both ankles and suffering lacerations and five broken vertebrae.

An employee was holding a hose during the filling of a storage tank. A valve blew apart and the hose backlashed, striking the employee on the left side of the face. The employee sustained a broken jaw and facial lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working inside a gondola rail car, rigging bundles of steel rebar for hoisting out of the car. During a partial breakout lift (hoisting about 2 feet to gain access for slinging), a nylon strap parted under the 1,100-2,200-pound load, which fell back into the car and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken femur and collarbone.
An employee fell while climbing a rack, landing on a pallet about 4 feet below and suffering a broken and dislocated left hip.
An employee was sandblasting a cap aluminum dye assembly. He stood the part up to turn it onto the other side. The part then tipped over and amputated his left middle fingertip.
On March 14, 2020, an employee was injured while apprehending a potential shoplifter. The employee was hospitalized for a broken leg.
While walking to a laundry cart, an employee stubbed their toe on the floor, tripped and fell, suffering a broken right femur and left shoulder.
An employee had been pulling brick from a conveyor. The employee's finger was caught in the conveyor plates and was amputated.

While an employee was cutting plywood using a table saw, the plywood bound up on the saw. When the wood suddenly became free, the employee's left hand contacted the saw blade. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was ascending a fiberglass extension ladder to check a customer's electrical connections. He was approximately 6 feet off the ground when the ladder slipped off of the house, causing the employee to fall and hit his elbow on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right elbow.
An employee was using a table saw when his right thumb tip was amputated at the first knuckle. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery. The table saw was unguarded at the time.

An employee was attempting to take the vitals of an inmate. The inmate jumped out of a wheelchair and assaulted the employee. The employee sustained multiple contusions to the right-side ribs, a fractured nose, two black eyes, a puncture wound to the right side of the back of the head, pain in the right arm and neck, pain/bruising to the lower left leg, and a blood blister on the lower lip.

An employee was entering the cab of a semi-truck when he slipped from the handle and step of the truck. The employee fell backwards and struck his head on the ground. He was unconscious for a few seconds and was bleeding from the nose and ears.
An employee sat a package down and his knee buckled. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was lowering an object into a pulverizer when his fingers were caught in a come-a-long chain. His left index finger was amputated at the hospital and the left middle finger was pinned and sutured.

An employee was moving bison heifers into a pen. The group of bison turned around and ran towards the employee, knocking him down and stepping on him. The employee sustained an abrasion on his armpit.
While operating a powered industrial truck (PIT), an employee's arm got caught between the cage and a door. The employee sustained a broken arm.

An employee was working on a flatbed semi-trailer that could extend its length. The air cylinder to release the pinning device was not working properly, and he manually released it. When the truck pulled forward, the employee was caught between two pieces of steel. He suffered broken ribs and punctured lungs.
An employee was adjusting a flexographic press. The press amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee was working the third shift, either mopping or running the cash register, when the employee was shot in the leg by an active shooter.
An employee tripped and fell into a mobile material handling cart, breaking his left arm.

An employee was putting fiberglass into the wrapper stacker machine. The employee was correcting fiberglass that was going in crooked, when his hand was pulled into the rollers of the machine. The right ring finger had to be amputated.
An employee fell from the top of a tandem trailer while unloading trash at a landfill. The employee sustained lacerations to the head, a dislocated shoulder, and a concussion.

An employee was installing metal decking on the second floor of a building when he fell through an opening and landed on the ground floor. The employee sustained multiple fractures of the upper extremities.
While moving a dust vacuum an employee tripped over the vacuum's cord and fell 3.5 feet. The employee sustained pain in their back and shoulder.

An employee was operating a loom when the mechanical chain drive seized. The employee tried loosening bolts to the mechanism to free the chain drive, but that did not work. The employee then tried to manually manipulate the chain drive mechanism resulting in amputation of the right thumb tip.

An employee was under a sawmill, investigating an issue with the dust chain. The drag chain caught his left foot and entangled him against a chain hold-down arm. He suffered a broken bone, a broken big toe, and a small laceration to the right foot.
An employee was operating a press when her fingers were caught in the rollers. Her left index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee fell in a parking lot after stepping on a small animal. He sustained a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a 4-foot mobile staircase to retrieve a part from an inventory rack. The employee missed the bottom step while descending the staircase and fell to the ground, fracturing a hip.

An employee was transferring finished product (cured concrete) from a staging area. As he moved a piece of wood cribbing, his left hand was pinched between the concrete and the cribbing. He was hospitalized for a hand injury.
An employee was walking through a shipping area. A forklift backed into the employee, severely lacerating the employee's right leg.
An employee was riding in the back of a cow trailer. The back door of the trailer opened and the employee fell out, hitting his head on the concrete drive. He suffered brain bleeding.
An employee was closing a door from the batch plant office. A gust of wind blew the door shut, catching his left thumb in the doorframe and resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was dragging an empty pallet when she slipped and fell. The pallet landed on her. Her left leg was broken below the hip.
An employee working as a deckhand was securing ropes on a barge when he was struck under the knee by the rope. He was hospitalized with a fractured right leg.

An employee was operating an aerial lift and was elevated 9.5 feet. While traveling backwards, he was pinned between the cage of the aerial lift and overhead structure bracing. The employee's chest/neck area was pinned, cutting off oxygen and resulting in strangulation.
An employee walking on an 8-foot high walkway of creel rack fell through the gate on the walkway and landed on the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was checking a metal disk used for metal detection in food. The metal disk fell. When the employee reached up beneath the conveyor for the disk, their glove got stuck in the conveyor which caused a laceration to the middle of the employee's right hand. The employee required surgery.
An employee was carrying a conveyor part to a pallet and fell on the floor. The conveyor part landed on the employee's leg and broke it.
While moving 55-gallon drums from one pallet to a storage pallet, a barrel slipped and an employee's hand was caught between two barrels, amputating part of the right middle finger.
An employee was operating a tomato slicer when she contacted the blade with her cut glove, resulting in a left thumb tip amputation.
An employee was operating a die set machine when their left hand was caught between the machine and the die set resulting in a partial amputation to the pinky finger.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the metal and a machine, and the top of the finger was amputated.
An employee pushing a copier machine slipped and fell. The employee sustained a spine injury.

An employee was pouring caustic into a kettle with hot water to sanitize the kettle. A chemical reaction occurred, causing caustic to splash back onto him. The employee sustained chemical burns to parts of the face, the eye, and also to the wrists, neck, thigh, and buttocks.
An employee was working on replacing an 8-inch compact light and suffered an electric shock. The employee was hospitalized.
A forklift's mast struck the top of a doorway and two of the wall panels it was carrying fell onto an employee. It struck the top left side of his head, causing a laceration and neck pain.
An employee was operating a pipe bender when their fingers were caught and crushed. The fingers were later medically amputated.
While preparing to mop the area an employee stepped over a case of water bottles, tripped, and fell to the ground resulting in fractures to the left wrist and hip.
An employee was using a table saw. The employee's hand slipped and contacted the running blade; the employee suffered an amputation to a finger.
An employee was using a man-up forklift to pick an order from the warehouse racking and fell 17-18 feet to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with spine and skull fractures.

An employee was unloading a rebar delivery at a new home construction site using a forklift. The forklift tipped forward and the employee was thrown off the forklift. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra and lacerations to the head.

An employee was preparing to raise a steel frame using an overhead crane and chain sling. The tip of the crane hook was being used to raise the frame. After the frame was raised 6-12 inches from the floor, the employee went to position the chain and the frame fell onto his left hand. He sustained amputations to the middle, ring, and pinky fingers and was hospitalized.
While framing the inside of a structure, an employee fell approximately 12 feet through a floor opening and suffered head trauma.
An employee was cleaning wood chips off a machine when the plates of the machine amputated her left index fingertip.

An employee was driving a forklift with a hopper attached to the forks. The hopper was full of metal chips. The employee then parked the forklift, released the hopper's dump mechanism, and dumped the hopper's contents into a large receptacle. As the employee moved the hopper back into the upright position, his left hand was caught at the point where the hopper latches into the upright position and the hopper crushed his left middle finger. The finger was amputated from the first knuckle.
A temporary employee fell through a manhole at a demolition site, landing 14 feet below and suffering a severe head injury and broken ribs.

An employee was guiding a suspended conveyor belt by hand as its tension was adjusted. The employee's right-hand fingertips were caught between a plate and the adjustment nuts on the conveyor. The ring and little fingers were partially amputated.

An employee uploaded water into a tank at a man camp. After uploading the water, he was reversing the pump to clear out the line. As he pulled the pin from the plunger bar his finger was caught between the plunger nut and the valve. The fifth digit on his left hand was amputated.
While descending a ladder, an employee fell from the third or fourth rung to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee was aligning/installing the bottom punch in a forging press. An airline was hooked up to extend cylinders for the die pod. The airline became disconnected and the die pod fell, pinching the employee's left index finger between the die and the punch. The finger was amputated to the second knuckle.
An employee was on an extension ladder, clearing a bottle jam in an overhead conveyor. The employee fell off the ladder to the floor about 12 feet below, suffering a head injury.
An employee was carrying a tray with parts soaking in it when the employee slipped and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip that required surgery.
An employee was working on the paper machine winder. While moving a large roll of paper on the cradle, the employee's right index finger was caught and amputated between two rolls of paper.
An employee tripped and fell face first in the shop. She was hospitalized with a possible back injury.

An employee was inspecting and writing down the serial number of a casing adapter tool in the yard. The employee rolled the tool over and the tool proceeded to roll over again, striking and amputating the employee's right index finger.

An employee was transferring material contained in a forklift's hopper attachment to the trash. When the hopper was released, it rotated forward and pinched the employee's left hand between a forklift tine and the attachment tube resulting in amputation of the pinky finger.

An employee was breaking loose a bundle of sheet metal parts. The bundle had been placed on a wood pallet on a table. The whole bundle of sheet metal parts slipped off the table, falling to the ground and landing on the employee's right foot. The employee sustained fractures to four toes.
An employee was trying to load a bar straightener machine. The employee's arm was pulled into the machine, where it was broken and lacerated.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor. Her right femur was broken at the hip and she was hospitalized.
An employee was spooling new cable into an air winch. His right middle finger was caught between the cable and the spool body and was partially amputated.
An employee was performing auto repair work when his finger was pinched and fractured in a hydraulic jack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee placed an 8-foot piece of louver material onto a non-automatic saw bed and was attempting to cut the louver when her left thumb and forefinger contacted the blade, receiving amputations.
An employee was operating a press brake. The press brake came down on the employee's left hand, crushing three fingers.

An employee was repositioning an elevated steel beam on a lifting device that was about 6 inches off the ground. The employee was hitting the steel beam with a hammer when the beam slipped off the lifting device and crushed the toes on the employee's right foot.

An employee was pulling a dolly (holding a fireproof cabinet weighing about 500-600 pounds) while two other employees pushed it. The employee slipped on the wet ground and fell; his leg landed between the ground and the dolly and was broken.
An employee was closing the rear door of a truck. His left ring finger was pinched in the door handle, and the tip was amputated.
An employee was unjamming a conveyor when her left index finger was caught in a "dog flap" on the conveyor. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was driving an order picker, moving a pallet of wire to be put away. While he was backing the order picker into position to offload the pallet, his left index finger was pinched between an overhead pipe and the overhead guard. His fingertip was lacerated and part of it was amputated.
An employee was working from an elevated pallet on a forklift when he fell 6 feet to the ground, striking his head. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was doing abrasive blasting from an 8-foot step ladder. He fell from the ladder and blasting medium was injected into his armpit. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a hallway. She fell to the floor and broke her right arm.
An employee got cut in the stomach while operating a blade machine.

An employee was repairing a broken yard end. While he was untying yarn ends to remove a yarn wrap from a 4-inch feed roller, the roller cycled, pinching the tip of his right thumb between a 2-inch tension roller and the 4-inch feed roller. He suffered an amputation to the thumb.

Two employees were picking up palletized product that had fallen and was leaning against the wall. When one employee pulled a pallet loose, the pallet and product fell onto the second employee. The injured employee had fractures to the right collarbone and knee, as well as bruising to the right knee. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped due to icy conditions in the parking lot and suffered a left hip injury.
A cleaning technician was cleaning a tank trailer that contained residual sodium bisulfide. As he was cleaning the tank trailer with hot steam, he began to experience shortness of breath.
An employee was performing taping work, tripped over plumbing that was coming out of the floor and fell. The employee sustained a broken right leg.

An employee had been unloading cheese from a blender. The employee was holding two buttons used to control the cheese blender paddles/manually jog the equipment. The employee let go of the buttons and went to grab a piece of cheese that was stuck in the blender. There was a 4-second delay after letting go of the buttons before the paddles completely stopped moving. The employee's hand contacted the still moving paddles. The employee sustained an amputation to the corner of the left pinky fingertip and a laceration on the pad of the left pinky finger.
An employee was exiting the receiving area and tripped and fell to the floor while stepping over product that was on a partially empty pallet. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was being trained to operate a saw machine. The employee was guiding pieces of wood from the chain deck conveyor into the saw. The employee's fingertip got caught between the wood being pushed and the chain conveyor's guard. When the employee felt his fingertip get pinched he pulled his hand out. His left pinky fingertip was fractured and a portion of the fingertip was pulled off.
An equipment operator was reaching to move a paver into a conveyor system when a robotic arm struck him. His left thumb was broken and lacerated and he was hospitalized.
An employee jumped to the ground from the third rung of a ladder and broke their lower right leg.
An employee was operating a brake press machine and amputated their right middle, ring, and pinky fingertips.
An employee was leaving a room when the door shut on her right middle finger and latched. She suffered a fracture and an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee sustained a partial finger amputation while operating a punch press.

An employee was feeding sheet metal into a rolling machine when his glove got struck on a burr on the sheet metal and his left hand was drawn into the roller. The employee sustained the amputation of his left ring finger.
A Davey employee was in a coned work zone. A vehicle ran through the cones and struck the employee, causing fractures to the right lower leg and eye socket, bleeding in the skull, and a neck injury.
While painting the hull of a ship, a painter fell to the ground from a scaffold. He was hospitalized with lacerations to his arm, a skull fracture, lumbar fracture, and a pulmonary contusion.

An employee was installing the third chute to dispense cement from the cement truck. The employee lost balance and grabbed the chute. The second chute then came down and pinched his fingers between the two chutes resulting in amputation of the left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was conducting maintenance on equipment when the cover started to slide and caught the employee's right index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was removing a load bar from the back of a trailer. The truck pulled forward and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken left femur and right wrist.

An employee was cleaning out a hose that was used during concrete pouring. He was pulling out the slack and pulled the trigger on the pressure washer. Water shot out of the pressure washer and punctured his left ring finger.
An employee was loading sawblades onto a cart for cleaning. A 24-inch blade fell and struck the employee's left foot, lacerating it.

An employee was coupling railcars near the melt shop. The employee's right foot was crushed between railcar couplers and toes were amputated by the steel toe of their boot. The employee was hospitalized and their leg was medically amputated from the knee down.

An employee was working from a 15-foot-high scissor lift, replacing lightbulbs along a ceiling. An overhead crane struck the scissor lift, causing it to tip over. Its basket fell onto a table on the floor, then ejected the employee; the employee suffered a broken elbow, a possibly broken arm, a broken collarbone, and a head injury.
An employee was troubleshooting a candy machine when their left middle fingertip was amputated by the rotary valve blades.
An employee was cutting plastic when his right thumb came into contact with the blade of a floor-mounted vertical bandsaw. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was walking to the sink to wash his hands when he slipped and fell on the floor. He was hospitalized with injuries to his lower back and hip.
An employee was ripping 3/4-inch strips of wood using a table saw when his hand contacted the blade, resulting in an amputation his left middle and pointer fingertips.

Two maintenance employees were disconnecting utility lines to remove a large oven. The injured employee was lying on his right side applying a valve lock device beneath the oven when his coworker cut the compressed air line, releasing the residual air pressure and allowing the door to glide down and pin the employee to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with rib compression fractures.

An employee was scrubbing the framework of a conveyor belt. The belt had been removed. The sprockets on the running shaft snagged the employee's jacket and pulled his arm between the framework and the shaft. The employee suffered lacerations and other injuries to the lower left arm and was hospitalized.

While an employee was scrubbing the framework of a conveyor, their rain jacket was snagged by the sprockets on a running shaft. The employee's left arm was pulled between the framework and the shaft. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations and other injures to the lower left arm.
An employee was on a roof removing leaves. He fell off the roof to the surface below, suffering a back injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished with vegetative watering and was on the hydro-seeder. The employee stood up as the hydro-seeder went under a low hanging line and he was knocked off the hydro-seeder. He fell to the ground and sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was operating a lift to move a heat wagon when the lift turned over and he fell off. His leg was pinned under the lift, causing a foot/ankle injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting an overhead crane. A part in the electrical cabinet caused an arc flash that burned his right hand. He was hospitalized.

After completing maintenance repairs above a finished product freezer, an employee was climbing down a self-supporting ladder to clean up the work area. The ladder shifted forward and caused the employee to lose balance and lean back against a wall. The shift in weight then caused the ladder to shift even further forward, away from the employee, and the employee fell an estimated 6 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee braced for the fall by reaching out his left arm and landed on his elbow. The elbow was fractured.
An employee was hospitalized with a concussion after falling from a stationary ladder.
