An employee was using a hose to clean a mixer. The hose got pulled into the mixer and as the employee was pulling out the hose, their hand was pulled into the mixer blades. The employee sustained lacerations requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's left hand was amputated while using a cutoff saw.
An employee was changing a chain and sprocket when the employee's fingertip was caught in the sprocket and amputated.

An employee was removing burrs from a rotating shaft with a hand grinder. The shaft caught the employee's glove and pulled the employee's left hand into the roller, causing two broken fingers and nerve damage for which surgery was needed.
An employee was cleaning a dust screw auger. The auger caught the employee's hand, causing the amputation of two fingers.

An employee was operating a bagger machine line when it became backed up and needed to be cleared. The employee switched the machine to manual and began clearing fasteners with his left hand. The bagger clamps closed on the employee's left ring finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was helping to move a slab of granite by hand when it shifted and struck him in the head.
An employee was attempting to load a steel plate onto a work table for a water jet to cut when the piece shifted, and a finger on the employee's left hand was caught in a pinch point and amputated.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting a large bag of dog food, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was strapping product to a skid. The employee's gloved left middle finger was caught between the strap and the product, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was delivering mail when she slipped on wet pavement and impacted the ground, breaking her ankle.
At breaktime, an employee was parking an electric pallet jack and was struck by another electric pallet jack. The injured employee sustained a broken lower left leg.
A CNC part fell from an overhead crane sling. An employee jumped out of its way and struck a tool cabinet, suffering a broken rib.
An employee was cleaning spilled glue from a belt and pulley. The belt and pulley grabbed the employee's right index finger and amputated it.

An employee was spooling out cable with a power winch. There was slack in the cable. The winch was put into forward, then reverse; the cable tensed and caught the employee's finger against the metal housing. The employee's fingertip was amputated (without bone loss).
An employee was handling a large locker door when it slipped and hit his forearm.
An employee was leaving the department to take a break. The employee fell and fractured an ankle.
At the hospital, a nurse was injured trying to subdue a patient. The nurse was hospitalized.
On March 20, 2020, an employee was reaching to flip a tube when their arm was caught by the chuck and lacerated. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee had climbed onto the roof to perform a task. When the employee was coming down the ladder, the ladder came out from underneath him and he fell to the ground. The employee sustained an ankle fracture and five broken ribs. He also sustained bumps and bruises.
An employee was walking on a work platform when he stumbled and lost balance, then fell and hit his head on a metal bar. He was hospitalized with a scalp laceration and subarachnoid hemorrhage.
An employee was moving a shopping cart out of the office and tripped, resulting in a fracture to her right foot.
An employee was unloading appliances. A washing machine fell from a stack onto the employee.
An employee was climbing down a 4-foot ladder and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was climbing into her truck when she slipped on ice and suffered a back strain.
An employee slipped while transporting hot adhesive. The adhesive went into their glove causing second degree burns to the left hand.
While picking up equipment outside, an employee slipped on a wet, wooden deck and fell. The employee sustained a broken leg.
An employee tripped over a hand truck while making a delivery. He fell and was injured.
While unloading a dump truck at a refinery, an employee's hand was crushed by the dump truck's gate.
A flashlight was charging in a small truck cab. It ignited, causing an employee to suffer smoke inhalation.

On March 20, 2020, at about 11:00 AM, an employee was cutting a four-foot piece of wood on a radial saw when the wood kicked back and injured the employee s left index finger. At the hospital, the finger was amputated to the second knuckle.
On March 20, 2020, an employee was hooking a coil of metal to put in a dip tank when his finger was pinched between the coil and the hook, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was getting ready to access a manlift when he slipped and fell into the opening of the manlift. The metal steps of the manlift hit his chest and pinned him against the concrete opening. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee tripped over a flat cart in the warehouse. The employee fell to the concrete floor and their kneecap was shattered.

An employee was working from a manlift in close proximity to the underside of a barge. While maneuvering the manlift closer to the barge, the manlift jerked in an upward fashion causing the employee s head to be caught between the bottom of the barge and the top rail of the manlift. The employee sustained a fractured mandible and a subarachnoid hemorrhage.
An employee was installing insulated blankets into a knife switch for future work. As the employee was attaching a blanket with a clip, an arc flash burned his hand, shoulder, and ankle.
An employee tripped and fell to the cement while unloading materials. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

A vacuum truck driver was loading his truck with salt water from a tank battery. The truck rolled backward and pinned him to a firewall, severely injuring his right leg and abdomen. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell approximately 8 feet to the floor from the third level of a rack system. The employee sustained fractures to both legs.

An employee was replacing a bumper on a semi-trailer. While aligning the bolt holes, the bumper slipped and the employee's finger was pinched inside a bolt hole. The employee sustained a left index finger amputation.
An employee had been driving in a pasture to check on a pregnant cow. The truck door closed on the employee's hand causing an amputation to the right middle fingertip that was closed with stitches.

Two employees were checking secondary voltage in a pad-mounted transformer. One of the employees was holding a voltmeter while the other held its test probes. A test probe was pulled out of the second employee's hand and made contact with an energized device. This energized the voltmeter the first employee was holding, burning his left hand, left shoulder, and both feet.
An employee was struck in the head by a falling tree while walking across a job site. He was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting a pallet when it fell on his leg, breaking it.
While attempting to free a potato that was stuck in a conveyor, an employee's fingertips were nipped by moving parts of the conveyor. The middle fingertip on the employee's left hand was amputated.

On March 21, 2020, an employee was cleaning the rollers on a pasta machine when his smock was caught and his arm was pulled into the machine. The rotating blade inside the machine amputated the employee's arm below the elbow.
An employee was clearing debris from a feed shoot. The employee's left hand was caught in a rotary sorter, which amputated the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee had been dispatching APCs using a ride-on pallet jack and struck an I-beam. The employee was thrown from the pallet jack onto the floor and fractured their right ankle.
The injured employee had been supervising a group and working on a plastic molding machine. The employee's right index finger was partially amputated by the air cleanout device.

An employee was troubleshooting a clogged batter pump when the valve turned back on and the auger caught the back side of her finger. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was carrying plywood on the jobsite and fell through a hole in the parking structure. The employee fell 9 feet to the level below, sustaining injuries to the leg, head, and back.

An employee was conducting a service call for replacement and assembly of a windmill gear box. The employee picked up the pillow block and while setting it into place, his left middle finger was pinched between a plate hole and the stud of the nacelle bed plate main frame. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

While servicing a conveyor belt, a box fell from an overhead conveyor belt and struck an employee in the head. The employee then fell and hit his jaw on a floor-level conveyor. The employee sustained a facial laceration and jaw injury.
An employee fell from a roof while looking for a circuit breaker. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a traumatic brain injury.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs at a client's private residence. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a closed head injury.
While handling a patient's wallet, an employee came into contact with a white powder resulting in a possible exposure to fentanyl.
A security guard was conducting a patrol of the hardwood mill. He stepped over a floor opening and onto a lower lumber deck. He then slipped on a floor grate and broke his left leg and ankle.
A tree fell onto an employee's head after being cut down. The employee sustained fractures to vertebrae T2 and T4.
An employee's right glove was caught between the roller, belt, and conveyor under a powered belt conveyor. The employee's arm was broken.

An iron worker was walking towards a forklift that was moving a steel beam (about 200 pounds) to the other side of the site. His feet were run over by the left front tire of the forklift. He was hospitalized with a fractured leg and ankle.
An employee tripped over a tool bag and fell to the ground, suffering an injury to the right elbow.
On March 23, 2020, an employee's left index finger was smashed and broken in a rail car's sliding steel door. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a roll of film into place. The roll of film dropped, and his right index finger was caught between the roll positioning rod and the framework of the machine he was placing it on. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee slipped and fell on a concrete floor. The employee suffered fractures to the left shoulder and upper back, as well as a right knee injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the concrete ground while walking into a hospital. The employee suffered a broken right fibula and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a clamp from the cable on the swivel. The decking had been removed and the employee was standing on the beam. The employee slipped and fell, landing on the surface casing valve. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
While loading material onto a flatbed trailer, an employee lost his balance and fell to the ground. He sustained a fractured arm.
An employee was climbing a 40-foot wooden pole. The employee was about 8-10 feet up the pole when his gaffs cut out and he fell to the ground; he suffered a fractured disc and a bruised leg.
An employee slipped on wet pavement and fell to the street, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was getting a cup of coffee when she fell on the floor and injured her right elbow.

An employee was securing the dock locks on a trailer when the trailer moved, causing the employee to slip and get caught between the trailer and the dock. The trailer then rolled back and caused a crushing injury to the employee's head.
An employee was transferring product from one truck to another using a transfer plate. The employee slipped and the transfer plate broke the employee's left leg.
An employee was using a sealer for plastic bags. A rotating shaft in the sealer caught his sleeve and broke his left arm.
An employee was climbing a ladder. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right wrist, chipped teeth, and a broken jaw.

An employee was measuring the thickness of a brass strip as it was being fed into a press. A micrometer the employee was using was pulled into a 4-inch gap at the press opening, taking the employee's right hand with it. The employee's little finger was partially amputated.
An employee was on a catwalk, cutting into a tank so it could be scrapped. A spark got into a nearby tank, causing an explosion. The employee suffered a broken jaw and lacerations to the face.
While walking into the bakery, an employee tripped and fell on the floor, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was working guard duty when an inmate beat him in the head with a sock that contained a lock. The employee suffered head and facial injuries and swelling, and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.

During rig down, an employee was attempting to move a hose supported on a spreader bar. The hose came free from the spreader bar and swung into a machine, and the employee's left little finger was caught between the hose and the machine. The distal phalanx of the left pinky finger had to be medically amputated.

An employee was folding up the hydro platform truck. He got the platform stowed, then extended the outriggers/tracks. Afterwards, he flipped the outrigger locks and walked back behind the truck. The hydro platform truck rolled back and pinned him against the tool truck. He was hospitalized with six broken ribs, a punctured lung, a broken left tibia, and a broken right femur.

An employee was operating a nut tapping machine, that cuts screw threads inside the nut, when the nut became jammed. As he tried to clear the jam, his gloved left hand became caught in the rotating nut tap. He suffered at least one fractured finger requiring surgery, with other fingers receiving lacerations. He was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a belt tracking on rollers. As he moved to tap a roller with a hammer, his right hand was caught between the roller and the belt, resulting in a partial amputation of the index finger across the nailbed.
An employee's finger was amputated.
During barge lid operations, an excavator boom struck an employee standing in the swing zone, breaking the employee's feet. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to install metal wall panels at a residential building. The employee fell off the ladder and landed on the ground. He sustained a broken right femur and a laceration to the head.
An employee was wiping the outside of a parcel conveyor system with a rag and cleaner. The system activated and pulled his left hand into the roller and belt. His arm and finger were broken.
An employee fell through a drop ceiling while installing insulation, landing on the floor and suffering a severe ankle/foot injury.
An employee was stocking a shelf from a 2-foot stepladder. The employee fell from the stepladder to the floor, suffering a broken left femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking down stairs. The employee landed on a metal landing and broke both kneecaps.
An employee had just loaded a car onto a car hauler. He left the car and the car moved, catching his right thumb against the car hauler. The thumb was injured and was later amputated.
An employee was at a customer's home to repair a cable/internet line. While carrying his ladder to set up against a utility pole, he tripped and broke his ankle.

Two employees were unwrapping a crate containing a new pump. The crate slipped and an employee's left hand struck against the pump. The employee suffered a laceration to the index finger and an amputation to the middle fingertip.

An employee was inspecting the brake drum and the left wheel on a forklift. While the employee was reinstalling the brake, his left little finger was caught between the drum and the brake drum. The finger was lacerated and the tip was amputated.
An employee was doing maintenance work on an electrical breaker when an arc flash burned the employee's right hand, abdomen, and forearm.

An employee was using a spudbar/tamping bar to remove asphalt insulation roofing material. As he lifted the bar, his right little finger was caught between it and the metal handlebar of a piece of nearby roofing equipment. The finger was lacerated and broken.
An employee had locked out a plastic bottle grinder and was clearing jammed material when a finger on his left hand was caught between two blades. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee jumped from a loading dock to the pavement about 3 feet below. He suffered a broken tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood stock on a table saw. The saw amputated three fingers on the employee's right hand.
An employee who had been exercising, experienced a heart attack and was hospitalized.
An employee was in a sawmill's re-cutting machine, clearing out a jam. The machine activated. The employee suffered three broken toes, one of which had its tip amputated.

An employee was grinding concrete floor edges using a handheld grinder. When he put the grinder down, his left glove got caught on the wheel as the machine was winding down. He suffered a closed, nondisplaced fracture at the middle of the left little finger.
An employee fell (from the roof or a ladder) while working on a residence. The employee landed on the ground and suffered broken vertebrae and brain bleeding.

An employee was unloading a truck at a customer's site. The employee fell from the back of the truck to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 28-foot extension ladder that was leaning against (and strapped to) a telephone pole. He was connecting a line from the pole to a house when he fell about 18 feet to the ground, suffering a broken leg.
A forklift backed into an employee, breaking his left foot/ankle.
A driver was raising a trailer's freight door when an item fell on him, breaking his elbow and giving him a concussion.
An employee was using a high-pressure water gun to wash parts of a line. The water stream lacerated the top of the employee's left hand.

An employee had grabbed jammed boards at the outfeed of a splitter box when the machine's feed rolls were reversed. The employee's left-hand fingers made contact with the press rolls, resulting in cuts and an amputation of the first joint of the index finger.
The tip of an employee's right little finger was amputated.

An employee was using skid steer with an attachment to pull fence poles out of the ground. The skid steer was backing up, carrying a pole, when its bucket tilted and came down. The pole struck and broke the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was cutting logs with a billet saw. The saw blade broke, causing amputations to the employee's left little, ring, and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left elbow.
An employee was moving lumber from a saw to a conveyor. The employee's right hand was pulled into the conveyor belt. The hand and finger(s) were lacerated and broken.
An employee was mounting a core box on a machine. The machine snapped shut, amputating his right thumb tip.
An employee fell while walking from one side of a patient's bed to the other. The employee suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was using a bin drill to clear material hung up inside an ingredient bin. The employee's arm was caught in the drill and broken.
An employee was clearing a blockage in a sausage machine. A blade in the machine amputated the top of the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell from the rear of a trailer while loading it, landing on the ground and suffering a broken femur.
An employee was burning excess cardboard boxes when a gust of wind blew the flames toward him. His shirt caught fire and he suffered second degree burns.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine when her left ring finger was caught in its belt and pulley. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the sidewalk, suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee had been traveling on a riding pallet jack. While the employee was off the pallet jack, it struck the employee, tearing ligaments in the employee's left leg and right wrist.
On March 25, 2020, an employee was sanitizing equipment when he lost his balance. The moving parts of a poultry machine (a tail quill puller) caught his right hand, amputating four ringers.

An employee was doing pipeline maintenance work. While the employee was inserting a pig into a barrel, the employee's left middle finger got stuck between the pig and the barrel. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to unjam a pallet on a conveyor. His right thumb was pinched under the pallet, causing a soft tissue amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal with a saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's upper stomach.
A forklift struck a cart, which in turn struck and fractured an employee's lower left leg.
An employee was repinning a cable sheave onto a side boom. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the cable sheave and the pinning arm, and was partially amputated.
An employee suffered heat-related illness while riding on the back of a trash collection truck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking across a fabric rug, landing on the floor and suffering a broken left hip and wrist.
At about 7:05 a.m. on March 25, 2020,  a McDonald's employee shot five times by another employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing 2-by-4s from bridge forms. A form fell and broke the employee's collarbone and ribs.

An employee was standing three or four rungs up on an extension ladder that was leaning against the gutter in front of a garage, taking pictures of the roof. He slipped off the ladder and his right leg was caught between its rungs, causing fractures to right tibia and fibula.

An employee was closing the door of an empty trailer. The door's cable was broken and it closed quickly, striking and fracturing the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was walking in a tunnel between two buildings. The employee slipped on a wet floor and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right wrist.
An employee was sandblasting a pipe when the sandblasting machine discharged blasting medium at the employee, lacerating and burning the employee's face.
An employee was riding in the basket of a scissor lift. The employee was caught between the basket and a concrete structure, suffering a broken sternum.

An employee was installing conduit on a wall. He had to loosen the metal straps to get the pipe in the correct position. As he was adjusting the pipe, it slipped and fell. Its circular end struck his left middle and ring fingers, severing the fingertips.
While dismantling a scaffold, an employee fell from the scaffold to the ground. The employee suffered a broken hip and femur.

An employee was delivering glass to a client. He was attempting to secure tarps that were covering the glass on a flatbed trailer when he pulled on a rope and the rope broke. When the rope broke, he fell off the trailer and onto the concrete ground, fracturing his right scapula and three right ribs. He also suffered a concussion and neck injury.
The employee was torqueing bolts on the sprocket of a bulldozer, using a handheld torque gun. The employee's fingertip was caught and crushed between a bolt and the torque gun's reaction arm.
An employee fell into an electrical vault, landing on a concrete floor about 10 feet below and suffering bruises and sprains.
An employee was heating a tub girder when he fell to the ground, suffering a cut to the head that required stitches.
An employee tripped over a forklift's forks and fell against the mast, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An HVAC technician was returning from lunch to a maintenance job at a home. He was showing a 9-millimeter firearm to another employee when it discharged, shooting him in the left leg. He was hospitalized with a wound to the knee and thigh.
An employee was erecting a steel beam. The employee fell to the ground 13 feet below, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was spray painting a building from a ladder when the employee fell 8 feet to the ground, suffering multiple fractures to the back, knee, and ankle.
An employee was on a roof when it collapsed. He fell 16 feet, landing on a floor inside the building and suffering back and ankle injuries.
An employee was working on an air manifold when a fan partially amputated his right ring finger.

An employee was using a pallet jack to move a container from inside a box truck to a lift gate. The employee set the container on the lift gate. When the lift gate was lowered, the pallet jack and the container shifted, and the container knocked the employee to the ground. His right leg was caught between the lift gate and its support and was broken in three places between the knee and the ankle; his right arm struck the ground and was broken between the elbow and the wrist.

An employee was unrolling waterproof conduit on a roof. He tripped over a fall protection anchor installed in the roof and fell backwards onto a 3-inch plumbing vent pipe that extended 14 inches above the roof. He suffered several cracked ribs.
While walking, an employee tripped over a 1.75-inch elevated metal edge protecting a floor scale. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee fell while helping offload a trailer. She suffered a cut to the head and a possible leg injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting yarn. The waste yarn cut the employee's left ring finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was using a stand-up mower. His right foot was caught on the lawn mower stand, and he suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was struck by a terminal tractor while picking up a load, requiring hospitalization for a head injury.
An employee was using a bandsaw. The product slipped out of the employee's hand and the bandsaw amputated the employee's right thumb, also breaking the index finger and lacerating the middle finger.
While walking from a parking lot to the workplace, an employee slipped on a rock and fell, suffering a broken arm.

An employee was bringing a piece of equipment into a warehouse on a pallet jack. As he entered the warehouse, the pallet jack hit a hump in the floor and tipped over, breaking vertebrae in the employee's back.
An employee was removing bolts from a piece of machinery. A bolt got stuck; when it came loose, the employee's left index finger was pinched in a tongue and partially amputated.
An employee was using a nail gun to nail a slab on top of a pallet. A nail went through the wood of the pallet and into the employee's leg, right below the calf.

An employee was helping a forklift driver prepare 720-pound 
nose-blocks (slightly curved, cast cement blocks) for shipment when the forklift driver lowered the forks of the forklift, smashing the employee's thumb between the nose-block and 
the wood block and resulting in an amputation.
An employee suffered a back injury while lifting a 45-pound box.
An employee was caring for a patient. The employee's foot was caught by cords that were connected with a plastic tie. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

On March 26, 2020, an employee was installing an airbag underneath a vehicle. The pressure released and the airbag struck the employee in the head, causing a shattered jaw and a broken skull. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding metal into a machine when the metal material kicked back and struck his mid-section, rupturing his colon.
An employee was replacing shingles on a roof. The employee tripped over the hose for a nail gun and fell to the stone ground 8 feet below, suffering three broken ribs and a cut to the head.
An employee was in a 3-foot ditch, unhooking a cement curb inlet. The inlet was raised before it was completely unhooked and struck the employee, causing a back injury.
An employee had been pumping gas and was hospitalized for an allergic reaction to a wasp sting.
An employee was rolling a pole on a trailer to unload it when the pole fell from the trailer and struck the employee's left leg, resulting in a broken tibia/fibula.
An employee was on a loading dock checking a delivery truck that had backed up to the dock. The employee fell off the dock and landed between it and the truck, suffering a broken left humerus.
A skid steer struck and broke an employee's right leg while the employee was walking.
An employee slipped on a board while walking. He fell to the floor and twisted his left leg.

An employee was exiting the stairwell on the second level of the parking garage when she tripped and fell over the curb. She suffered a closed fracture of the left olecranon process (bony tip of the elbow, left arm).

An employee was washing the back of a dump truck. The latches for the back gate were stuck closed, and the employee lifted them up to allow the gate to close. The gate closed and pinched his right middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was using a torque multiplier ratchet wrench to loosen a bolt. The wrench broke and struck him in the arm, breaking the forearm. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was working on an R-valve that was clogged with rice. He was using a metal rod to break up the clog. When the clog of rice broke loose, the blades in the R-valve started to rotate and amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee had just adjusted the speed of a shaker table, and was turning to walk away, when the table's belt caught his left glove and pulled his index finger into the pulley. He suffered a fracture and an amputation to the finger.

At approximately 6:45 a.m., an employee was hand-operating a gang switch when one of the three legs detached from the switch. The live part contacted the employee's left hand and thigh, causing burns that required hospitalization.

An employee attempted to walk a pallet jack backwards when the steering handle turned, causing him to be pinned between the pallet jack and a rack. He suffered a contusion to the chest and collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was welding in a tight area when he accidentally hit the whip line button. The line popped out and ignited his shirt. He had to take his gloves off to unsnap his right sleeve cuff and remove his shirt, resulting in a second degree burn to his right wrist.
An employee fell out of his truck while arriving at work. His left hip was injured on the parking lot surface and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

While performing composite clean up, a temporary employee slipped and fell into some metal panels. The panels then caused an industrial exhaust fan to fall on top of the employee, fracturing his pelvis.

An employee was standing on a conveyor system, trying to remove foam material hanging from a roller overhead. The employee slipped and the foam pulled his left hand and arm into the roller. He suffered a broken forearm and was hospitalized.
An employee was on an elevated platform removing temporary power after completing a job when the mast the employee was working on broke. The employee fell to the ground below.
An employee was helping a delivery driver stabilize a large switchgear on a lift gate. The switchgear shifted and fell off the gate, breaking the employee's ankle.
An employee was moving a cheese mold on a conveyor using a tool. As the employee was pulling the mold, the employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering an ankle and possible leg fracture.

An employee was helping replace plastic straps on a unit of corrugated boxes. He tripped on a plastic strap that had been removed during this process and fell to the floor, breaking the ball joint in his left hip.

An employee was driving a forklift in a warehouse. As he was backing up with a skid (wood pallet) load, the load caught on a beam post; his head hit the handle of the forklift and his abdomen hit the steering wheel. He suffered a vertical cut between his eyebrows, about 2-2.5 inches long, as well as an abdominal injury with possible internal bleeding.

An employee was trying to retrieve a tray pack of product that was wedged inside a tunnel. The conveyor belt the pack was sitting on pulled the employee's right hand into the sprocket. His little fingertip was amputated and his middle and ring fingers were broken.
An employee was working on a tree about 25 feet up from ground level. He fell, suffering fractures to his left shoulder, wrist, collarbone, and spine.

An employee was unloading a box trailer using a forklift. As the employee drove over the dock plate (which had initially not lined up with the trailer, but had been adjusted), the forklift fell. Two of the employee's fingers were crushed between the forklift's frame and the wall, and were amputated.
An employee was setting up a machine when a piece of steel caught his hand and pushed his pinky finger into a saw blade, resulting in an amputation of the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was repairing a valve when air pressure was lost and the valve closed on the employee's pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was backing a forklift out of a trailer. The employee's left foot struck the trailer wall, causing fractures to the fibula and tibia.

An employee was walking down a ship's ladder carrying an 8-foot-long scaffold pole. Her foot slipped on the wet steps of the ship's ladder and she fell 6-7 feet, striking several metal surfaces. The employee suffered a scalp laceration, four broken ribs, and fractures to three vertebrae in her lower back.
An employee was delivering a package to a residence. A chained-up dog bit the employee, lacerating the employee's right forearm and causing possible nerve damage.

An employee was struck by a forklift while standing in an aisle. The employee landed on storage racks. The forklift operator fell out of the forklift and was struck by the forklift and also landed on storage racks. Between them, the two employees suffered multiple facial and skull fractures, a concussion, and internal bleeding.

An employee was troubleshooting the cause of a glass jam in a forming machine. As the employee was removing a knuckle pin from a glass forming machine so it could be replaced, the adjacent section's hanger opened. The employee's left thumb was pinched between the two sections, causing a partial amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was changing the die on a roll former. The machine activated, causing amputations to the employee's fingers.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift. Her thumb was caught in the pivot point of the forks, suffering a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on the floor where a drink had been spilled. He suffered an injury to his left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing breaker wires. An arc flash burned the employee's forehead.
An employee tripped while turning and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee had just moved the bed of a tow truck using a winch attached to an overhead crane. As he set the bed down on a cart, the winch detached, came back up toward the employee, and struck his left hand, pinching it against the crane hook. He suffered a partial amputation of the middle finger.

An employee was carrying a box of fortune cookies from the front of the store to the back of the store when the box became caught on the wall. The box struck the employee in the stomach and she was hospitalized with a liver laceration.
An employee was operating a UTV to haul chickens when the UTV hit a pole. The employee sustained a fractured C2 vertebra.
A driver was unjamming a load of freight. He fell from the freight and broke his lower leg.
An employee was working on a corrugator machine. As the employee was adjusting a glue machine, the glue machine's chain and sprocket caused an amputation to the employee's left index finger.
While testing an electrical system, an employee suffered an electrical burn to the hand.
A forklift ran over an employee's right foot with its back tire. The foot was crushed.

An employee was using a tool to tighten lug nuts on a truck. The tool's reaction bar rotated counterclockwise, pinching the employee's left index finger against the truck wheel. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was grabbing an apparel cart when her foot got caught on the rack, causing her to trip. Her knee struck the floor and was injured; she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
At 8:10 a.m. on March 30, 2020, an employee was moving a forklift's forks when his fingers were caught between a fork and the mast. Five-eighths of a finger on his right hand were amputated.

An employee was on a container ship's catwalk, lashing containers to secure them. The employee fell to a deck about 15 feet below and suffered spine fractures, lacerations to the liver, and a head injury that required stitching. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting a steel plate when the steel plate landed on the employee, causing a broken hip and lacerations that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning batter from the interior housing of a mixer. Moving parts in the housing caught the employee's right hand, causing the partial amputation of the index fingertip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was removing a stuck board from a wooden container manufacturing machine. The machine lacerated the employee's head above the eye, causing an injury that required nine stitches.
An employee was operating a machine. Moving parts inside the machine caused amputations to two of the employee's fingers.
A veterinarian was preparing to give an IV injection to a cat. The cat bit the veterinarian's left thumb; the bite became infected, and the employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were adjusting a roller table and bracing. The metal roll casing fell onto one employee's right index finger while being lifted, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was moving a part from the metal pallet. The metal pallet moved as well, catching the employee's right middle finger against a table. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was in an aerial lift, preparing to remove a section of a bus. A 500-kilovolt power line caused second-degree burns to the employee's chest and arms.
An employee fell off the stool they were sitting on and landed on the floor, breaking their right lower leg.
An employee fell from the second-floor level to ground level while installing a staircase. The employee suffered two fractured ribs and a punctured lung and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A postal carrier was leaving his postal vehicle to walk his delivery route. An SUV rear-ended the postal vehicle and catapulted the carrier 17 feet into the street. The carrier injured his head on the road surface and was hospitalized.

On March 31, 2020, an employee was standing on the ground, using an extended chainsaw to cut a tree limb that was near an energized wire. The wind blew the tree limb into the wire. The employee suffered entry and exit burn wounds on his right hand and left foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a chair from the bed of a pickup truck to a loading dock. He stepped into a gap between the tailgate and the loading dock and fell into the truck bed. His right leg was trapped in the gap and broken. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was loosening the bolts in a 1,500-2,000 pound sign. The sign fell and struck the employee in the back, breaking a vertebra. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up a machine. The employee's left middle finger came into contact with rotating gears, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was moving a movable rack containing meats to the smoker when another employee also using a movable rack rammed into him, causing his right middle finger to be caught between the two racks. The employee suffered an amputation without bone loss to his right middle finger.
On March 31, 2020, an employee was cutting sheets of plastic on a table saw. The saw blade amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.
An employee was cleaning a slitter machine when the employee's hand was caught in the rollers, removing skin from the hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a pallet jack to pull a pallet of goods off a truck. He fell off the back of the truck and broke both his feet.
An employee was attempting to reconnect a hose when the thumb hole punch unit amputated the employee's right ring and pinky fingertips. The unit was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was driving a forklift when it struck another, parked forklift. His left foot was caught and lacerated between the two forklifts. He was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving food from a walk-in storage cooler. The door closed on the employee's hand, amputating the tip of his left middle finger.

An employee was standing on a rolling safety ladder/platform, testing a machine that had been assembled. He fell to the floor, hitting his head, breaking his jaw on the left side, and suffering broken fingers on his left hand.
An employee was servicing a conveyor belt when the chain caught his fingers, amputating his right index and middle fingers.
On March 31, 2020, at approximately 7:48 PM, an employee was unloading a (demountable) pod when he smashed two fingers, amputating one of the fingertips.

An employee was changing out a broken cable. The cable was raised and had a punch installed to hold the weight of the door while the employee was performing the maintenance. When the cable was replaced, the weight of the door dropped, resulting in an amputation of the employee's left middle finger to the joint and a damaged ring finger.

An employee climbed a walking deck to gain access to the hull side of a barge to move a portable welding machine so she could continue welding tank side stiffeners. While climbing down, she attempted to step onto a side stiffener but missed. Her right leg then contacted the tank side angle, causing a fracture to her right tibia.
An employee was splitting bricks with a hammer. The hammer smashed the employee's thumb, and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a 2-step step stool to remove a decal/sticker from the exterior of a building when she lost her balance and fell to the ground, hitting her head. She sustained a head injury with brain bleeding.

Two electricians/journeyman mechanics were doing preventative maintenance on a high-density storage system, an aisle with two cranes. They were preparing to lubricate the chains on one of the cranes. One of them was on the lift station, seated above the crane on a cross-support bar to perform lubrication and test the vertical limit switch. He tripped the vertical limit switch to begin the work. The crane and the lift station began to move up, and his right leg was pinned and broken between the frame of the crane and the crossbar of the lift station.

An employee was replacing a wheel on a kiln cart. He was aligning the wheel with the wheel bracket when the wheel dropped down and pinched his left middle finger, amputating 1/3-inch from the fingertip.
An employee was trying to tighten slack in a conveyor line. The conveyor line started and amputated the employee's right ring and little fingertips.
While replacing electric insulators, a lineman came into contact with an energized line. The current entered the lineman's hand and exited through his back.
A forklift driver was loading a truck at a dock door. The trailer moved away and the forklift fell to the ground; the driver suffered a severe lower back strain/sprain and was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing an HVAC unit on the roof of a school. He slipped on the rooftop ladder and fell. The ladder caught his left little finger as he fell, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was notching a tree when his chainsaw kicked and cut his right shin.

Two employees were digging and dewatering an excavation when one of them came into contact with a live underground power line. One employee suffered an electric shock and left hand burns; the other was also shocked. Both employees were hospitalized.
On April 1, 2020, an employee was performing a screen and magnet check on a B filler when the employee was burned by hot water. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a board into a wood moulder. The feed roller engaged and pinched his right index finger against the board. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger (without bone loss) and the nailbed.

An employee was pulling a barrel of bell peppers when the employee was struck by the right rear tire of a forklift, suffering bruising, lacerations, and possible fractures to the right foot, ankle, and lower leg.
On April 1, 2020, an employee was operating a 35-ton punch press when it came down on the employee's right hand, amputating the index fingertip.
An employee slipped while cleaning the cement floor and broke his hip.
An employee was cutting an onion with a knife when the blade amputated two fingertips.
An employee was operating a press brake when it cycled, causing an amputation to his right index finger.
An employee was attempting to align a brick in a strapping machine when the employee's fingers were caught in the machine, resulting in the removal of skin from two fingers.
An employee was attempting to move a light cart when his hand contacted the tongue of the light cart, smashing his finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from a ladder onto a concrete slab 15 feet below, suffering broken ribs and a broken nose.

An employee was attempting to load a reel in a machine. While he was lining up the reel with the pintle and operating the controls with his left hand, the reel shifted and smashed his right-hand fingers between the reel and the pintle. His right index fingertip was amputated as a result.
An employee was working on a control panel and connecting wires when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns to the face and hands.

An employee was operating a rototiller when the blades of the rototiller became stuck in the ground.  The employee moved to the front of the rototiller and attempted to dislodge it.  The rototiller moved forward and the blades struck the employee's lower left leg, causing multiple fractures.

On April 1, 2020, an employee was using a water hose to wash down a work area when he was either struck in the face by the water hose or fell to the ground and impacted his face. He was hospitalized with lacerations to his face and mouth.
An employee was pushing a piece of fabric into a 1-inch crimper. The machine activated and amputated his left index fingertip.

Employees were trying to remove a guardrail so they could replace a concrete sidewalk. One of the guardrail's bolts was 
stripped and would not come out. A skid steer did not succeed in removing the bolt, so they released the pressure from the guardrail. The bolt then came loose, causing the guardrail to pop up and hit one of the employees on the chin. He suffered a neck injury and was knocked unconscious, then had trouble breathing after waking up. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a trough full of dough into a secondary mixer when his right hand slipped and his right index finger was caught between the locking mechanism and the trough, resulting in an amputation of his right index fingertip.
An employee was mowing grass on a riding mower. The mower caught a boulder and threw the employee backward to the ground. The employee suffered a lower back injury and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was ascending scaffolding when he reached the top rung, slipped, and fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete floor. He fractured both ankles.

At about 10:50 a.m. on April 1, 2020, four employees were trying to unjam a sheet of drywall that was stuck in a kiln dryer. One of the employees was pulling on the sheet when it moved, causing the drive belt and assembly to rotate and pin his left hand. The pad of his middle finger was cut off to the first knuckle.

A seven-employee crew was removing a 100-foot poplar tree. The crown was cut off and the employee on the tip line (which controls the direction of the tree limbs, keeping them away from power lines) was signaled to begin pulling. The tree limb that the tip line was attached to broke free and struck the employee's torso.

On April 1, 2020, an employee was operating a car haul to move a railcar to the next position on a repair truck. As the railcar approached the car haul the employee shut off the air to the car haul's chugger motor. He then stepped in front of the car haul to remove the car haul's hook from the railcars. As he moved to the front of the car haul, he stepped into a cable loop that had formed on the ground. At this point, the railcar was moving past the employee and car haul position, causing the cable loop on the ground to begin tightening as slack was now being picked up. The cable caught the employee around his hip, pulling and pinching him against the car haul frame. He was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis and perforated bladder.
An employee was climbing a ladder to a roof. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a broken pelvis, a shattered left heel, fractured lower vertebrae, and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was feeding product into a sizing machine. The employee's right hand was injured at the infeed point, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a casket when she stepped into a hole and fell, breaking her leg.
An employee was operating a manual furnace loader to unload a heat treating furnace when his right foot was caught and crushed between the manual furnace loader and a parked loader.
An employee fell from an unknown area and remains unconscious.
An employee was removing a utility pole from the ground when the pole struck the back of his left leg. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the calf muscle.

On April 2, 2020, an employee was sending pieces of wood stock through a chop saw's infeed table. The wood jammed, and the sawblade cut the top of the employee's left hand while he tried to clear the machine.

An employee was emptying the remaining aluminum from a kettle into a mold. The hot metal hit the cold mold and exploded, splattering onto the employee and burning his chest, arms, and legs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving an elevator with a cart which was carrying metal sheets. A sheet fell off the cart and struck the employee's left leg, breaking the femur.
An employee was cleaning a bathroom when she slipped on the floor and fell onto the toilet. She suffered broken ribs and a deflated lung.

An employee was using a manual pallet jack to move a freight down a steep driveway when the employee tripped over the pallet jack tires and fell on their left side to the concrete driveway. The employee suffered a non-displaced left hip fracture.

On April 2, 2020, at approximately 2:45 PM, an employee was climbing up a portable ladder to inspect a flood gauge on a tank when he slipped and fell to the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a compression fracture on his back.

An employee was climbing a 4-foot sawhorse ladder to gain access to a narrow scaffold. The scaffold shifted and he fell to the ground, his right leg becoming entangled in the rungs. The leg was broken.
An employee was operating a forklift when she hit a safety barrier and injured her lower left leg.
While leaving a supply room, an employee stepped over a rope gate, which entangled the employee's left foot. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was sitting on a stool working on the computer when the stool broke and impaled the employee in the buttocks.

An employee was using a tagline to guide a crane that was lifting a sign to a post when the employee went near a powerline and it arced over to the crane. The employee was hit with an arc flash, suffering second and third degree burns to the stomach and back.
An employee was changing a pressure transducer on an extruder barrel when hot polyester polymer released due to a pressure buildup, causing severe burns to the employee's right arm and neck.

An employee depressed the foot pedal on an air bending machine to bend parts. He rested his left hand on the area where the arm meets the bending roller, which controls the bending arm. When he released the foot pedal, the bending arm automatically returned to home position and his left thumb was pinched between the arm and the bending roller. His left thumb tip was amputated as a result.

Employees were using a front-end loader to load equipment onto a trailer when the equipment shifted, striking an employee's hand and trapping it between the equipment and the trailer. The employee sustained a broken right pinky finger that required surgery and received stitches on the right ring finger.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) when he lost control of the PIT and his leg was crushed between the PIT and a concrete barrier.
An employee was cutting wood with a chop saw. The sawblade caught his left glove and amputated his little finger.
An employee was filling a gas truck with liquid propane fuel. The fuel caught fire and the employee suffered burns to both hands, a wrist, and the forehead. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on a pallet that a forklift operator had lifted approximately 10 feet in the air to remove an exhaust pipe. The employee fell from the pallet while attempting to remove the exhaust pipe 
and struck his left wrist on a water pipe as he fell to the floor. He suffered a severe fracture of his left wrist resulting in hospitalization.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the asphalt ground, suffering a broken left leg.

An employee was performing maintenance on a vertical two-phase separator. The employee was reconfiguring the sight glass and using various wrenches to loosen the existing fittings and tighten the new fittings. The fitting that connected the vessel to the sight glass piping broke behind the closed valve. The swage (fitting that broke) caused the pressurized hydrocarbons to release into the air, which found an ignition source and started a fire. The employee received second and third degree burns to the hands, legs, and arms and was hospitalized.

An employee went onto a rollcase to try and release a board that was trapped inside the outfeed rollcase of an edger machine. He lost his balance and fell 10 feet onto a steel waste chute, then slid an additional 10 feet to the bottom of the chute. He suffered a fractured pelvis and broken ribs, as well as a laceration above the eye.

An employee opened the trailer door of a truck that had just arrived. A double-stacked pallet inside the truck had become unstable, and its weight pushed the door open very quickly. The employee was knocked to the floor between the truck and the dock plate; the pallet then fell from the trailer onto the employee's right knee. The employee suffered a broken right tibia.

An employee was pressure washing a piece of drilling equipment when he slightly slipped, lost his balance, and ran the tip of the pressure washer wand across his foot, causing an injection wound. He was hospitalized with a foot laceration from the high-pressure water.

The injured employee was inventorying tires when another employee, who was helping, pushed a ladder forward to the next section of shelves and bumped a tire, knocking it off the shelf. The falling tire struck the injured employee, causing a neck injury.

An employee was operating package filling equipment when he attempted to loosen clumped sugar in the equipment piping and injured his right hand. He was hospitalized with fractures to four fingers on his right hand.
While walking out of a building, an employee slipped on a patch of ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was operating a self-piercing rivet machine when it struck her left middle finger, lacerating and crushing the fingertip resulting in amputation.

An employee was removing jammed plastic between an extrusion head and the top of molds when the mold clamp closed, crushing the employee's left-hand pinky, ring, and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was performing safety maintenance pruning procedures on a large oak tree using a chainsaw, pole saw, and hand saw. He was using a tree edge saddle/fall protection gear with a climbing line that was secured in the upper canopy of the tree. He had just finished pruning some dead limbs from the tips of a large scaffold branch and started walking back down the limb toward the trunk. He noticed a branch he had cut was stuck between two limbs, so he lowered himself down in between the limbs. He grabbed his handsaw (blade up) and reached out to pull the limb toward him. During that time, the limb freed up. The force of his pull caused his hand and handsaw to jerk toward his climbing line. The handsaw contacted his climbing line, which then snapped in half at the point of contact, causing him to fall 35 to 40 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken wrist and three broken bones in his ankle.
An employee was attempting to hook a dolly up to a trailer when the employee's left ring finger was caught between the trailer and dolly, resulting in a fingertip amputation (no bone).

An employee was connecting a towable arrow-board to a truck hitch. A car entered the construction zone and struck the arrow-board, knocking it into the employee. The employee suffered leg and facial injuries.
An employee was using a machete to free a cut tree limb from vines. The machete cut the employee's left hand.

A temporary employee was adjusting dunnage under a lifted load of corrugated metal decking when he signaled the forklift operator to let the boom out. During this process, a piece of decking slid off and hit his lower leg. He was hospitalized with a right ankle fracture and a fractured right tibia and fibula.

On April 3, 2020, an employee was placing caution tape around a crane lifting area when the crane extended the outriggers, one of which landed on the employee's right foot. As a result, he sustained three toe amputations.
An employee was unjamming a de-clipper machine. After the air lines were shut down, the clipper head partially amputated the employee's thumb.
An employee was unloading a control panel with a pallet jack when the panel tipped over and fell on the employee. The employee suffered a left leg injury.
An employee was pinned between two concrete molds while checking on a kiln issue, resulting in severe leg injuries.

An employee was about 10 feet off the ground in a bucket truck's bucket, trimming a pecan tree. The bucket was snagged by a branch and the tension pushed it. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a sprained back and shoulder. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An exit swing conveyor (which directed piping to a quenching machine) was undergoing maintenance. The swing conveyor abruptly cycled and swung to the left, pinning an employee's leg against a building column. The employee suffered a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was stabbed while fighting with a customer. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee jumped over rails and landed on a surface that gave way, falling to the next level below.
An employee was found laying unconscious next to a utility vehicle with a broken jaw and cuts to his lip and head.
An employee was loading a piece of equipment onto his flatbed delivery truck when he slipped and fell to the ground, dislocating his right arm from his shoulder.

At about 1:00 p.m. on April 4, 2020, an employee was removing a patient to a seclusion room. The patient kicked a door, which slammed on the employee's fingers. The employee's right middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An employee was spotting for a backhoe when its track struck the employee. The employee's left leg was amputated from the knee down.
An employee was operating a metal shear when the shear amputated his left index finger to the first knuckle.
An employee had been moving 4 x 8 pieces of wood. The employee fell through a ceiling, landed on the ground, and sustained a laceration to the head.
An employee was mowing grass. The employee slipped and his left foot went under the mower deck, where the mower blade amputated his big toe and second toe.

An employee had just started a coating line and lowered the rollers over the rod. The employee reached over the rod to tap it, in order to remove some air bubbles in the coating liquid. The sleeve of employee's cleanroom suit, along with his right arm, were pulled in between the idler and the film. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.

An employee carried an extension ladder to the work location and was raising it to a strand. He realized that the strand hooks were not extended, so he slowly lowered the ladder to extend the strand hooks. He then stepped into a hole in the customer's yard and twisted his ankle. He was hospitalized with a fractured ankle and had surgery.
An employee was slicing potatoes. The slicing machine caught the employee's left hand, partially amputating the middle finger.

An employee was in a buffer room, putting pallets away using a forklift. His hand was caught between his forklift and another forklift, and he suffered fractures to the left ring and little fingers and a lacerated palm.
An employee walking down a passageway was struck by a loaded fork truck. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones.

On April 5, 2020, at approximately 2:30 AM, an employee was checking the chain tension on a discharge conveyor. His right index finger became pinched in the conveyor's chain and sprocket and was amputated.
An employee was troubleshooting the dehydration unit at the compressor station when he sustained burns to the hand and face from a fire. He was hospitalized.

The injured employee was in the back room with a cart and was speaking with another associate. The injured employee then stepped backwards out the back door and fell from the dock to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a broken femur.
An employee was cleaning waste material from a ready-mix plant. A piece of the material broke free and rolled into the employee's right lower leg, breaking it.

The injured employee was replacing linens underneath a patient and moving the patient from an operating room table to a patient bed with the assistance of co-workers. During this work, the injured employee tweaked his lower back. The injured employee was hospitalized with a lumbar sprain.
An employee was investigating a power outage. As the employee was using a multimeter to see if a panel had power, an arc flash burned the employee's arms and hands.
An employee was explaining a framing change and stepped backwards off the second-floor deck. The employee fell 11 feet to the ground below and sustained fractures to a leg, an arm, and the pelvis.
While walking around the property, an employee stepped in a hole and fell. The employee sustained a broken leg and a hip injury.
An employee fell approximately 18 feet from a bridge. He was hospitalized with a broken C7 vertebra and two broken arms that required surgery. The employee wasn't wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee was removing metal shavings from a lathe when the lathe rotated, causing an amputation to the tip of the employee's right thumb.
An employee had been collecting molten copper samples for testing and started feeling sick. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was operating an all-terrain forklift on a construction road. The forklift drove off the gravel road and rolled over onto its side. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a fractured C6 vertebra, and a vertebral wedge fracture.
An employee was walking to a cash register when he tripped on a trash can and fell on the floor. He sustained a broken femur that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning his knife at the end of a shift. The knife stabbed his left hand, puncturing his cut-resistant glove and cutting an artery. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a grinder with a cutoff wheel to cut pipe. The wheel broke apart and struck the employee in the left forearm, pieces of it became embedding in the forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking an employee tripped over a shopping cart and fell, sustaining a broken hip that required surgery.

An employee was hooking a tractor up to a trailer when the entire unit began to roll. The employee tried to stop the unit with a hammer, but was injured by the tractor trailer. The employee sustained abrasions and cuts to the chest, abdomen, right hand, foot, and ankle.
While engaged in sanitation collection, the employee was struck by a motor vehicle. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for compound fractures to the lower right leg/foot.

On April 6, 2020, an employee climbed a 25-foot pine tree to complete routine maintenance trimming on a two-phase powerline. The employee completed the work on the southwest side of the tree, passed through the center, and began to reposition to the northeast side of the tree. While the employee was repositioning, the limb that he had his work positioning lanyard attached to failed and the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground, landing on his back near the base of the tree. The employee was hospitalized with a ruptured diaphragm, collapsed lung, multiple lumbar and thoracic fractures, laceration of the spleen, epidural hematoma, right renal contusion, and multiple rib fractures.

An employee moved a fixture into the load area using a cart caddy/fixture mover, then went to the other end of the facility in the unload area to retrieve another fixture to move. As the employee was walking backwards across the facility and operating the cart caddy/fixture mover, he was caught between the cart caddy/fixture mover and the fixture he had deposited earlier. He sustained an abdominal compression injury.

An employee had been cutting or measuring the coating on a 20-foot section of pipe. The employee was pulled into a rotating lathe and sustained lacerations to the face and upper body. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing out of his tractor and missed the bottom step. He fell to the ground, landing on his left knee. The employee's patellar tendon was torn, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was putting a chain back on the drive sprocket of the live hang. The line came on, catching his hand between the sprocket and the chain, resulting in a cut and fracture to the left hand.

At 9:30 a.m. on April 6, 2020, an employee was drilling a hole in concrete for bollard installation. The drill bit got stuck in the concrete and started to wobble. The foot then broke free and turned, hitting the employee's foot and knocking him to the ground. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a jammed stick from a band saw when the saw blade amputated the end of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was carrying work materials towards a lumber bundle. While walking, the employee was struck by a forklift that was traveling towards the lumber bundle. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left femur.

A bundle of paper rolls fell off a rack as it was being lifted by a forklift. It rolled into an employee who was adjusting a slitting machine, pinning him against the machine and breaking his right femur.

An employee had been packing up some belongings. The employee started picking up papers from the floor while sitting in an office chair. The employee lost their balance and fell to the floor. After being helped back up, the employee proceeded to their car, but fell in the parking lot. The employee sustained a hematoma on the back of the head and may have a broken bone in their neck.
An employee was transferring a patient from a bed to a wheelchair. The brakes on the wheelchair failed and the employee fell, suffering injuries to her right upper leg, hip, and elbow.
An employee fell off an 8-foot step ladder and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the back, elbow, and ribs.

An employee was part of a roofing crew that was demolishing a roof. The employee was walking toward the roof ladder when he fell through a section of the roof that had been cut out. He landed on the ground about 18-20 feet below, broke the left leg, and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to remove a bolt when the cut-off wheel came loose and struck the employee's neck, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was bending 3-foot long rebar on a rebar bending machine. He was bending to 90-degree angles, using the foot pedal for control. His finger was caught in a pinch point and was partially amputated.

At 1:40 p.m. on April 7, 2020, two employees were replacing a 150-pound drive unit on a forklift. The drive unit shifted and fell onto one employee's left index finger, pinning it against a nearby floor jack. The finger was amputated above the nailbed.

An employee was using a machine to bend metal ridge cap shingles. The machine's dies closed on his right hand and crushed the fingers. The ring finger was surgically amputated, as were the middle and little fingertips.

An employee was on the back of a digger derrick, prepping the unit for an endurance test. The employee was using a torque wrench to remove bolts for analysis. As the employee was applying force, the socket slipped from the bolt resulting in a loss of balance. The employee fell 4' 7" from the back of the truck onto the ground. The employee landed on both feet and sustained a broken left ankle that required surgery.

An employee had been trimming a tree at a peak working height of approximately 40 feet. While descending the tree, the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and sustained a fractured sternum.

An employee was using a pressure washer to wash grease off of equipment. The employee was moving the power washer wand from side to side, when the wand went across his right foot. The pressurized spray cut through his boot and caused abrasions and lacerations to his right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaving work. A car struck her in the parking lot, breaking a bone.
An employee was loading a tube into the collet of a bending machine when the grip closed on the employee's little finger, amputating the first joint.

On April 7, 2020, at approximately 7:20 AM, a maintenance employee was adjusting the height of a mower, which requires adding or removing shims from travel tires. While removing shims, the hydraulics bled down, causing the mower to slide down and catch the employee s right hand in a pinch point. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the fourth finger and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning tandems with a hot water hose. While cleaning his left boot with the hot water, he sustained second and third degree burns on the left ankle.
While trying to strike a nail with a hammer to flatten it. The hammer struck the employee's finger, cutting it.
An employee was using a water hose to add water to cement in a cement mixer. The mixer pulled in the hose and the employee's hand, and the paddles amputated his index and middle fingers.
An employee had been unloading material from a truck. The employee had a heart attack and was hospitalized.

A carpenter was operating the concrete mixer. He used an all-thread rod to loosen hardening concrete. The all-thread rod and the employee's shirt sleeve got caught in the concrete mixer's shaft injuring the employee's hand. He sustained lacerations to his fingers. In addition, one finger was amputated and another finger was partially amputated.

An employee was using a scouring pad to remove excess zinc from a steel tube on a mill. As the employee was moving up and down the tube, the employee's gloved hand was pulled into the mill's rollers, resulting in partial amputations to the right middle and ring fingers.

An employee was fixing a crossup at the sorter incline chain. The employee was attempting to get on the grating under the incline chain when his foot slipped and he fell in-between the guardrail and the grating. He fell 14 feet to the floor, hitting an airline on the way down. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured skull and possible fractured vertebrae.

An employee was closing an overhead door with an attached tagline for closing the door. The bolt the tagline was attached to came loose and struck the employee in the head; the employee fell backwards, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was working from a ladder to fix a hole in a spout. The ladder slipped and the employee slid down the ladder, catching his thumb on the ladder. The employee sustained a partial amputation to his left thumb.

An employee jacked up a trailer for repair and then got under the axle to perform work. The trailer was equipped with an auto-leveling system. The system activated and pinned the employee between the axle and the ground.
An employee had been installing door and inside trim at a location. The employee was cutting lumber with a chop saw and amputated his left middle and index fingers.
An employee was driving down an aisle in a powered industrial truck. The truck hit some racking and a pallet on the rack struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

Two employees were performing monitoring well services for environmental compliance. One of the employees was kneeling to remove a well cap when a car that had just been fueled drove away from a pump and ran over the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a broken tibia and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
While making boxes in the back room of the store, an employee tripped over the corner of a pallet that was on the ground and fell to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken right hip.
An employee was sitting on a large engine, masking an electrical system off for painting. The employee moved to step onto a lift and fell to the ground, suffering a broken elbow.

An employee was manually shrink wrapping a pallet while walking around it. The employee tripped and fell to the floor of the loading dock. The employee sustained a broken left hip and was hospitalized.

On April 8, 2020, an employee was on an A-frame ladder, cutting pipes of a heat steam tube to remove the heat exchanger. The employee cut above two valves on the heat exchanger and the heat exchanger rolled forward. The cut tube lacerated the inside of his elbow.
An employee was unloading cargo. When he cut a banding strap, the cargo shifted and crushed his pinky finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee had been performing roofing activity. While descending from a ladder, the employee lost his footing and fell 5 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a twisted ankle.
An employee was throwing a strap over a load in the yard. The strap got stuck so he got onto the truck to adjust the strap. He slipped off the truck, injuring four ribs on the way down.
An employee was climbing down off a loader when he fell to the ground 3 feet below. He suffered a broken hip.
An employee was climbing down from a flatbed truck. He slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his femur. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a luggage cart in the drive lane. Another cart approached from the opposite direction; the employee swerved and made contact with a parked luggage cart. The parked cart's spring-loaded hitch detached and struck the employee, breaking the employee's ribs.
An employee was setting up anchor points on a roof when he slipped and fell 14 feet off the roof. He was hospitalized.
A delivery driver was unstrapping a load of aluminum for delivery. Part of the load fell on him, fracturing his back.
While moving furniture, two employee's fell from the second-floor balcony to the ground level when the railing gave way. The employee's were hospitalized with trauma to the back, head and face.
An employee was using a roller to flake corn. While removing some rocks from the rolls, the employee suffered a partial amputation.
An employee was working on a weed-wacker and cut their right index finger. When the employee saw blood, the employee passed out and fell to the ground, breaking a jaw bone.

An employee was cleaning a cheese hopper. Her sleeve became entangled in the mixing rod and was pulled in, entangling her arm. The employee was pulled into the side of a hot tank, which caused burns to her face, shoulder, and chest. The employee also sustained injuries to the right arm.

An employee was working out of a lineman truck bucket about 18 feet over a coned-off lane, installing traffic light mounts on an under-bridge deck. A semi tractor trailer swung wide and hit the bottom corner of the lineman truck bucket. The impact pinched the employee's arm between the bucket and bridge, breaking the arm.
While walking out of an elevator, an employee tripped and fell on her right arm, fracturing it in two places.

On April 8, 2020, an employee was assembling and feeding copper and cables into a crimper machine. The machine closed on her left index finger, breaking the finger and partially amputating the fingertip.

At 1:00 p.m. on April 9, 2020, an employee was turning to walk away from his truck when he tripped on a flatbed cart and fell to the ground. He landed on his knees and sustained injury to the knees and quadriceps tendon.

An employee was grabbing pieces of OSB board from a stack and placing them on top of shingle pallets. Four or five pieces fell, one at a time, and a corner of a piece struck the employee on the toe resulting in a fractured toe.
An employee was cleaning up debris in a second-floor room. The employee fell into a 3-foot by 3-foot hole, landing on the floor about 12 feet below.

An employee was on a scissor lift installing sheet metal for a mini-storage unit. The employee was approximately 19 feet high when a strong wind blew the scissor lift over. The employee sustained back injuries and a broken arm.

An employee was operating a motorized pallet jack. It collided with another, parked pallet jack; the employee's left foot was caught between the two pallet jacks and the big toe was broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee was packing up his truck at the end of the work day. There was a group arguing in the distance and a shooting occurred. The employee was struck in the thigh by a stray bullet.
An employee was on a 32-foot extension ladder while inspecting the roofline of a two-story residential home. The employee fell from the ladder and broke both ankles.
An employee was on a bridge, fixing containment for sandblasting. He fell from the edge to the ground 4-5 feet below and suffered a broken pelvis.
A taping machine caused an amputation to an employee's left index finger.
