An employee was stepping into a truck when he slipped in the rain and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right leg.
On April 9, 2020, an employee was operating a pesticide sprayer on a slope at a golf course. The sprayer rolled over and broke his right thigh.
An employee was exiting a parked scissor lift. While descending the ladder, the employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken hip.
An employee was placing a beam using a boom lift. The employee was pushing away the beam when his right thumb was pinched between the top of the lift and the beam. The tip of the thumb was amputated.
An employee suffered facial injuries while setting up a small press.
An employee sustained a crushing injury from an electric pallet jack. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was working on a conveyor line. A machine activated and struck the employee's leg resulting in a laceration and fracture to the leg.
An employee fell 11 feet to a lower level through a floor opening. The employee suffered a fracture injury.
An employee was on top of a dumpster to cut a strap. The frame that holds the basket hit him in the forehead and knocked him into the dumpster. He suffered head and back injuries.
An employee was walking down an aisle. The employee turned, lost his footing, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a broken nose, a broken shoulder, and a laceration on the forehead.
While threading pipe, an employee's hand was pinched between a wrench and pipe threading, resulting in the partial amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was cutting bone on a bandsaw. The saw cut off one of his fingertips.
An employee was cleaning a fryer when a bucket spilled excess hot oil onto his body, burning him. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an overhead crane to lower material onto a table. His left-hand fingers got caught between the material and the table. Four fingers were broken.

An employee was stepping from the ground to the second step when their body twisted and their knee gave out. The employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with meniscus tears in both knees and a fracture above the right knee.
An employee was shocked while working on equipment.

The injured employee was moving a cart with three other employees. The cart was holding a fiberglass console. The cart hit the edge of concrete causing the load to shift and fall onto the injured employee's hand. The injured employee was hospitalized with lacerations to the pinky and ring fingers on the left hand.
An employee was performing a CT scan when she slipped on an IV cap on the floor. Her ankle rolled and she fell, landing on and breaking her right arm.

On April 10, 2020, an employee was performing stocking duties. The employee was coming down a track ladder in the back storeroom, missed the last step, and fell to the concrete floor. The employee landed on and fractured her right hip.

During power restoration work after a storm related outage, a crew was assigned to clear a broken pole and low wires from a roadway. An employee was removing the remaining primary take off conductor. The pole dropped straight down, but then bounced back up and towards him. The telephone cable struck him in the neck region, knocking him unconscious, and pinning him in the bucket. The employee was hospitalized with a contusion to the right side of the neck and possible injuries to his thyroid and carotid.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor in the evisceration area when their arm was caught by the roller. The employee sustained multiple lacerations to the left arm.
A valve on a tanker truck actuated while an employee was putting in a part. It amputated about 1/8 inch of the employee's fingertip.

An employee was driving a pallet jack to the back of the dry storage area to put away the dry mop. The employee exited the pallet jack as it was coming to a stop. The pallet jack rolled over the employee's right foot causing a crushing injury.

At 4:10 a.m. on April 10, 2020, an employee was setting up a new roll of plastic on a winder machine. The machine pulled in the employee's left hand, breaking several bones in the forearm area. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hitching two cargo dollies together. A tug struck one of the dollies creating a nip point with the trailer hitch and tongue that amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift, carrying a load of batteries. His left ankle was caught between the vehicle and a fixed racking system. He suffered fractures to the ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a gas pump, working inside a coned off area, while wearing a reflectorized vest. A vehicle entered the coned off area and ran over the employee's feet. The employee sustained a fractured right ankle.
An employee tripped on the edge of a pallet and fell to the floor, suffering an injury to the left hip.
While stepping over trays of bread, an employee tripped over a roller of empty trays and fell to the floor, breaking his right hip.
An employee stepped off a waste management truck, which then ran over his right foot, crushing his foot/leg.
While working on a panel, an electrical arc flash occurred and burned an employee's torso and arms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a drain plug in the floor and fell, their head striking a table. The employee suffered a pinched nerve and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using bolt cutters to open a transfer trailer door. The door sprung open and struck the employee in the face causing lacerations.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was sanding the edges of some parts. The sander pulled in the employee's right index finger, partially amputating it.

Employees were troubleshooting a PSV that was lifting prematurely. A release of hydrocarbon/hydrogen caused an explosion and fire. One employee suffered burns to the face. A second employee struck a rail during egress as a result of the pressure wave and suffered a fractured kneecap. Both employees were hospitalized.

The injured employee was helping another employee unload a skid steer and a few attachments off a delivery truck. The injured employee was helping to guide the driver of the skid steer when his left foot was caught under the skid steer's tracks as it moved closer to the attachments to connect them for unloading. He suffered a right distal tibia fracture and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was unjamming a piece of frozen meat from a locked-out auger. When the employee inserted a T-handled bar into the winding down auger, the bar moved, and pinched the employee's hand against the machine's fixed guard. The employee sustained an amputation.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to the right thumb while closing a magnetic safe.
An employee was climbing into his truck cab when he fell backward, hitting his head on the concrete slab and breaking his skull.
An employee's finger was caught in a doorjamb. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working in a wet air oxidation unit. As she was clearing a hose into a tank, she was sprayed with spent caustic released from the tank's top hatch. She suffered chemical burns and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a golf cart, striking his head on the ground and suffering a fracture.
An employee went to close the door of a diverter. When he pushed the diverter closed, it came back and smashed the end of his right thumb resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was drilling holes in a part using a radial drill press. His left hand was entangled with the drill and injured, with partial amputations to multiple fingers.
An employee was thrown from a powered industrial truck to the floor. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was lifting a transformer from on top of a pallet when his left index finger was caught between the pallet and the floor, resulting in a partial amputation of his left index finger.
An employee was lifting a transformer from on top of a pallet. The employee's left index finger was caught between the pallet and the floor and was partially amputated.
While walking from the fifth floor to the fourth floor, an employee tripped and fell down two steps to the ground. He sustained a broken right ankle.

An employee was about to remove the stair tower so that he and other crew members could replace it with a new tower. He was at the stair landing between the bottom floor and the second floor. He stepped up the first stair tread. The angle clip that held the tread in place was rotted. The employee fell through the stairs to the ground, breaking his right leg.
Employee was climbing down from a pole after assisting CMP with storm restoration and fell to the ground. He was hospitalized with a heart attack and pneumonia.

An employee was in an excavation about 15 feet deep, probing with a probe bar to find an existing sewer pipe. Part of a step fell and hit him on the knee, causing him to fall. He suffered injuries to his knee and two left-side ribs.

An employee was operating an aluminum stretcher machine. The employee was struck by a piece of steel tooling that failed while in the machine. The employee sustained a laceration and a fractured lower leg.
A dog bit an employee on the right forearm while the employee was delivering mail.
An employee was coming down a ladder while holding his brick holder and shovel when he missed a step and fell to the concrete floor. He fractured his leg.

On April 13, 2020, a UPS employee was returning to her package car after making a delivery to a customer's porch. When the customer opened their door to retrieve their package, a dog ran out of the house and bit the employee's right calf. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a pallet jack and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was walking out of a shower he had just cleaned. The closing door caught his prosthetic left leg, causing him to trip and fall to the tile floor. His hip was broken.

The injured employee walked across the customer's parking lot to help another driver who was working in a trailer. The injured employee was entering the back of the trailer by climbing up the side of the lift gate, while it was in the raised position. The injured employee slipped and fell approximately 3 feet to the ground, landing on their hip. The injured employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip and required surgery.

An employee was stabilizing a load on a pallet when the contents collapsed on him. He then fell out of an open dock door and landed on the receiving dock ramp. The employee sustained a head injury, two fractured ribs, and a fractured clavicle.

An employee was operating a bending machine, making bends into thin gauge stainless steel bands. As the employee loaded the end of a steel band into the machine's tooling, her finger slipped up the side of the band and was caught in the point of operation. The fingertip was amputated.

A temporary employee was trying to turn a riding pallet jack when he lost his balance and fell from the pallet jack, landing on his tail bone/back and hitting his head. He was hospitalized with bruising to his back and head.
While delivering mail, an employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right femur.

An employee was using an overhead crane to return a spent parent roll to a stand. The roll bounced and smashed his left middle and index fingers against the crane hook. Both fingers were crushed and cut, and the middle finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting hind shank with a bandsaw. The bandsaw cut his right middle and ring fingers, amputating both.
An employee sustained a right knee contusion while operating a pallet jack.
An employee was treating a patient in the back of an ambulance. The ambulance stopped quickly and the employee suffered a fractured C7 vertebra and bruises.

An employee was collecting sawdust from under the edger and saw a piece of wood lodged in the bottom side of the edger. When he reached to remove the wood, the saw caught the scrap wood and pulled the employee's hand into the blade resulting in an amputation.

An employee was hooking up piping connections. He removed a pipe from a tank that was filled with hot water. When he raised the pipe up, it filled his boot with hot water. The water burned his lower leg and foot.

A machine operator was completing a setup to run another sheet metal part on an automatic straight side press. The machine cycled and the employee's hand was caught by the die. He sustained amputations of the left index and middle fingers.
An employee was walking away from a log conveyor when he tripped. His hand was caught on the conveyor belt, and he suffered two broken fingertips and a flesh amputation.
An employee was adjusting a pipe when the employee's hand was caught between a pipe shoe and angle iron, crushing the employee's finger.

An employee was working on a floor truss on a floor truss manufacturing machine's table. After the employee turned the truss, the table closed on his left thumb and amputated it about halfway down the nail.

After planing the edge of a piece of wood with a jointer, an employee was inspecting the wood when the jointer's cutting head caught his left glove at the little finger. The finger was amputated at the first joint, below the fingernail.

An Eversource employee was recovering downed power lines in a street. A vehicle entered the work zone and struck the employee, running over and breaking the employee's ankle as well as striking the employee with its side view mirror.
An employee was working with a hydraulic strand jack machine when a stream of hydraulic fluid entered their right middle finger. The employee was hospitalized with a possible infection.
An employee fell off a ladder and sustained a back strain.
An employee was climbing the steps of the compactor roller and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right ankle, fibula, and tibia.

An employee was climbing up a fixed ladder to verify a process valve lineup. He fell off the ladder, landing 10 feet below on a rail and gravel. He suffered lacerations to his left elbow; collapsed lungs; and fractures to the ribs, elbow, and pelvis.

An employee was preparing to assist the trackhoe operator with plate placement. The employee was struck by the swing arm of the trackhoe and was then pinned between the trackhoe's bucket and a rock box. The employee sustained a broken left hip.
An employee was loading an aluminum bar into a machine from behind when his right hand was punctured by the bar.
At about 9:30 a.m. on April 14, 2020, an employee was operating a table saw when it cut his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a piece of glass from a truck. The glass broke and lacerated the employee's arm.
An employee was preparing to hook up electrical service on a pedestal when the employee was exposed to an arc flash resulting in burns to the face and neck.

An employee was clearing an opening to run bailer wire around a cardboard bail when the up-right bailer machine cycled. The one-foot long iron bar tool he was holding shifted and caught his left pinky finger against the bailer machine resulting in an amputation.
An employee was removing a piece of wood from a pallet on a roller conveyor when their right middle fingertip was pinched between the pallet and the backstop of the roller conveyor and  amputated.

On April 14, 2020, an employee was retrieving produce from a walk-in cooler. The employee tripped on a pallet and fell forward onto the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured nose and contusions to the cheek and forehead.

Two employees were assembling a roll-up door. Tension had been applied to help roll the curtain into the door barrel; one of the employees was using a metal bar and a pin to secure the pre-tension wheel as this tension was slowly released. The pin dislodged and the wheel spun, pinching the employee's left hand between the end bell metal plate and the bar. The employee's index and middle fingers were crushed and the tip of the left index finger was amputated.

An employee was working on a metal cover on a second-level carousel. The employee fell about 14 feet to the floor below, suffering a contusion to the left side of the body, a contusion with abrasion/swelling to the back of the head, a contusion/abrasion to the front of the left hand, a contusion (and pain) to the left shoulder, and a contusion/swelling to the left hand/wrist.
An employee was walking across a repair bay doorway when a vehicle struck him, causing a closed fracture of the right tibia.

An employee was operating a soil compactor in a building. The compactor backed into the structural framing of the building and the employee was caught between a steel I-beam and the compactor's steering wheel. The employee suffered possible internal injuries.
An employee was found under a pile of racks, pallets, and salt after a rack in the warehouse broke and fell on the employee. He suffered ACL and tibia injuries.
An employee was helping to disconnect a trailer from a truck. The trailer hitch slipped and the trailer fell on the employee's leg, resulting in an amputation from the knee down.

An employee was working on a car that would not start. When he jumpstarted the starter, the car jumped into gear and pinned him between two cars. He sustained a fractured pelvis and two cracked vertebrae.
An employee was running meat through a saw. His metal mesh glove came into contact with the sawblade, which pulled his left middle finger into the saw and caused a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was driving a concrete mixer truck down a hill. While turning, the truck tipped onto its side. The employee suffered a concussion and a scratched eye from broken glass.
An employee was found on the concrete floor on his back unresponsive on 4-15-2020 at 4:00 PM. He had a bump on the back of his head and was hospitalized for a brain bleed.
An employee fell in a stairway and was hospitalized.

On April 15, 2020, an employee was using an ethanol filter to make sanitizer. As the employee was using a pump to filter ethanol from one 5-gallon bucket (through tubing and a charcoal filter) to another, the ethanol started to spray out and immediately caught fire. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the face, hands, and arms.
An employee was dislodging a paper core that had fallen into a slitter rewinder machine. The employee's right index finger was caught by a belt driven pulley and sustained an amputation.
An employee was discharging a can of belt dressing onto a conveyor belt. The belt's roller caught the employee's left arm, causing a partial amputation to the arm.

On April 15, 2020, an aircraft electrician was retrieving a tool that fell through the grated cover of a two-foot utility trench. While lifting the grated trench cover, he lost his grip. The trench cover fell and his middle finger was caught between the cover and the floor. He sustained an amputation without bone loss to his right middle fingertip.

A temporary employee was attaching ropes to piping coming off an assembly line. As he was positioning a rope on a 42-inch pipe, the pipe rolled and crushed his left hand. His left little and middle fingers were medically amputated.

An employee was putting tension on a conveyor and aligning it at the bacon microwave for the morning startup. While he was steadying himself, his left thumb was caught in an ingoing nip point, resulting in a thumb tip amputation and left thumb fracture.

An employee was using a metal grabber and overhead crane to assemble a chute out of various pieces of steel. The employee had positioned a sheet of steel in a vertical manner and then climbed onto an 8-foot step ladder to remove the metal grabber from the top of the sheet of steel. The metal grabber moved away from the employee, and the employee lost balance and fell to the floor, landing on the right side. The employee sustained a contusion to the right elbow.
An employee was forming the end of copper tubing using a swaging/flaring tool when his right ring fingertip was amputated by the tool.

An employee was pulling a tarp off while standing on a 6-foot step ladder when he slipped off the ladder onto the concrete floor, fracturing his left femur. The employee's shoes were wet at the time of the incident.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a 2x4 when the saw blade came into contact with his right thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was reaching under a nail table where nail guns are kept when he struck the handle of a nail gun with his head and it discharged a nail into the back of his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was performing electrical work on a 6-foot step ladder at ceiling height when he fell and impacted the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken wrist, cracked ribs, and head contusion.
An employee was changing the film roller on a winder machine when the employee's left hand was pulled back into the winder, amputating her left middle finger.

An employee was replacing an old fuse cutout in order to install a trip saver. A lightning arrester failed, causing an electrical arc. The employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the arms and face. He was hospitalized.
An employee was fixing a chain on a piler when the piler was turned on. The employee's left index finger become caught and pinched between the chain and wheel sprocket, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was removing an interior wall when he came in contact with copper wire. The back of his hands were burned.

An employee was climbing up a ladder. The ladder slipped from the side of the building and the employee fell to the ground about 10 feet below. He landed on his feet, then tripped over the ladder lying on the ground and fell. He was hospitalized, having suffered a broken left ankle.
An employee had lifted a 15- to 20-pound box of rotisserie chicken and was frying the chicken when he suffered a slipped disk in his back. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was on a 6-foot step ladder, using a wire cutter/stripper to prepare a wire for reconnection to a light fixture in a drop ceiling. A short-circuit caused a flash of light and the employee fell from the ladder to the concrete floor. The employee suffered two broken ribs on the left side, a bruised left lung, and a contusion, and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a fingertip avulsion while operating equipment.

A truck driver's tractor had begun to roll away from its trailer. The driver was trying to reach it to stop it when his body struck one of the tires. He fell, rolled, and suffered a laceration above the left eye, another laceration on his nose, and hip and pelvis fractures. He was hospitalized, requiring sutures to the forehead and glue for the nose laceration.
An employee was installing a single roof panel when the employee slid off the roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a left femur fracture.
An employee was closing an elevator walk-on plate. The plate caught the employee's right ring finger resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was setting up for hot work on a scaffolding platform. He opened the swing gate at the platform entry and lost his grip on the ladder while transferring from the platform, falling approximately 5 feet onto the main deck of the ship. He was hospitalized with a compression fracture to the T2 vertebra.

On April 15, 2020, a nurse was leaving a patient's home when a member of the patient's family attacked and stabbed her multiple times. She suffered damage to the larynx and the phrenic nerve, as well as a shoulder injury and the near amputation of one of her fingers.

An employee was moving a 65-foot-long beam with cranes when one end of the beam swung around and pinned the employee between it and another beam. The employee sustained a pelvic fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was installing a pipeline in a trench. The employee coiled tubing on a spool and was attempting to tie in two pipe ends when the pipe slipped and flexed, striking and fracturing the employee's fibula.
On April 16, 2020, an employee was walking when she tripped over broken down cardboard boxes and fell to the ground, injuring her shoulder. She was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting in the break room when another employee walked over and threw hot soup into the employee's face. The employee suffered burns to the left and right eyes, left cheek, and right nostril.

Two employees were working on a 16-inch plastic water pipe, drilling for a saddle tap when the pipe exploded. One employee suffered an amputation of the right arm, a laceration to the right leg, and the loss of vision in the right eye. The second employee suffered lacerations to the legs and sand in the eyes.

An employee lost his balance while securing lawn mowers on a flatbed trailer. He grabbed one of the lawn mower hoods to prevent himself from falling. The hood flipped up and the employee fell 3 to 6 feet onto his back. He suffered bruising to his back and knees and was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up cases of product that had fallen off a pallet. He tripped over one of the cases and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a forklift while closing a door when the employee's foot slipped off the forklift brake. The forklift continued to travel and the employee's right hand was caught in the door, resulting in a partial hand amputation.

An employee was a passenger in a golf cart when he fell out of the golf cart as it turned to enter the facility. He tried to gain his footing but fell backwards onto the concrete, hitting his head on the pavement. He suffered a skull fracture and subdermal hematoma.

An employee had climbed up a fixed ladder on a roof parapet wall to install conduit when he fell 9 feet through the fixed ladder opening to the roof below. He was hospitalized with fractured vertebrate and lacerations to the head .
An employee was checking for a hydraulic leak on a piece of machinery when the machinery lacerated one half-inch of his finger.
An employee slipped on recently mopped wet tile in an elevator landing at work, falling to the wet floor and breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a cord (angle iron) onto a rigging table when the cord suddenly moved approximately 10 inches and caused amputations to his left ring and middle fingertips. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a rack from a hanger. The rack dropped onto his right foot, causing an open fracture, as well as a puncture wound and contusions.
An employee was baling cardboard when he fainted and hit his head on the floor. He was hospitalized with a severe head injury.

An employee was acting as a spotter for employees who were moving a boom lift into position when the lift's basket hit a piece of steel, causing it to tip over and strike the employee on the left leg. The employee suffered a lower leg compound fracture.

On April 16, 2020, an employee was on the roof of the first level of a 2-story split-level house caulking the dormers to be painted when he slipped and fell 12 feet to the ground, resulting in a broken right hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when she missed the last step and impacted the floor, severely injuring her tibia and kneecap.

An employee was operating a standup forklift when he stopped his lift on a shipping dock in front of a door. A sit-down forklift was backing out of the door and hit the employee's leg, pinning it between the two lifts. His left leg had a fractured femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was organizing an area full of part buggies and pushing them to their proper locations. As the employee was pushing a cart, the front side struck another buggy. When this happened, it caused wood stiles inside the buggy to shift, crushing her right middle finger between the stiles and the handle of the buggy and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was repositioning the print tape that prints labeling on a cable. The tape stuck to his finger when he tried to position it on the cable, causing his finger to get caught between the print wheel and the cable resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was performing a quality control check when his finger struck against a sharp object in a bean bowl mixer, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

An employee was unclogging the steam line for a lawn mixer. The steam line was not locked out and the steam line valve was not turned off at the time. When the line was unclogged, steam was released, and the employee sustained second degree burns on both arms and hands.

An employee was standing beside a concrete column form, guiding it as a crane picked it up. The rigging came loose and the form fell to the ground, striking the employee on the way down. The employee suffered a left clavicle fracture, a left acetabulum fracture, transverse vertebrae fractures, compression vertebrae fractures, and multiple contusions and abrasions.

An employee was on a ladder installing an electric metallic tube. While attaching the tubing, the employee was startled by a shock and slipped off the ladder, falling to the ground and breaking his wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on top of a 4-foot concrete road barrier when he fell and his leg was caught in between another barrier, resulting in a broken femur.

An employee took the plug out of a hydraulic cylinder when the metal arm on the cylinder came down under its own weight and pinched his pinky finger between the two pieces of metal. As a result, his right pinky finger was partially amputated at the first knuckle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was framing the scope of work on the roof at the entry of a house. While cutting sub fascia from the entry, he fell 14 feet to the ground, suffering bruised ribs.
An employee was moving lumber when his leg was pinned between two bundles of lumber. He was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was feeding a board through a shaper machine when the machine jumped and caught his left middle finger, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was un-jamming a slitter machine when the cutting blade cut off his pinky fingertip.
An employee was removing a panel to access a fan belt when the employee's left index finger was pinched and fractured between the fan belt and pulley. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a chain on a wire wheel when his hand became stuck on the chain, resulting in a left pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was manually positioning  a 13-foot long, 460-pound steel I-beam with his hands onto cribbing with the assistance of a forklift when other I-beams stationed on the forks of the lift shifted. This action resulted in the employee having his right-hand middle finger caught between I-beams, which resulted in a partial amputation to his finger.

An employee had removed the conveyor on the backside of a machine to clean. When the employee went to put the machine back in place, the employee's left ring finger was caught in a pinch point created by the lug conveyor chain and the traying machine. As a result, the employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading card stock into a corner-cutting machine. The blade in the machine amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was walking to a car to deliver food. She tripped over an uneven spot in the concrete and fell to the ground, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was hiking over rough terrain en route to respond to a fire. He lost his footing and fell, breaking his ankle.
An employee slipped on ice while walking and sustained a fracture.

An employee was cleaning mud out of a concrete footing with a hydroexcavator when the insert from the excavator's rubber vacuum hose sheared off, severing the connection with the dig tubes and causing the dig tubes to fall and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a compression fracture to the back.
An employee was unlatching a pin on a tractor when his right hand was caught between the equipment. He sustained a laceration to his right hand requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling a box from a shelf when the box ripped. He then fell backwards, hitting an ice machine and then the ground with his right hip. He suffered a right hip fracture.
An employee exited his vehicle and was entering the worksite. He slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell sustaining a head injury. The employee was hospitalized for a brain bleed.
An employee was going into a warehouse when he fell, striking and injuring his head.
An employee tripped over a tool box and fell through the back door of a van, suffering a dislocated jaw.

An employee was attempting to position a power cylinder head into storage with an overhead crane. While placing the power cylinder in the bottom part of the rack, the rack shook and knocked off another power cylinder that struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

The injured employee climbed up a ladder to access the top of a concrete ledge, which was part of the support structure for a furnace, and was standing on the north side of a cylinder as another employee was operating a lift to align the pin on top of the cylinder. A third employee was working a come-a-long to help align the cylinder top. The injured employee was flagging from the platform when he fell approximately 8 feet, landing on the concrete surface below. He was hospitalized with a fractured tibia and fibula in the left leg.
An employee was welding a steel plate onto an I-beam when the plate slipped off and struck his left leg (femur), causing a fracture and requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was in the process of switching railcars in the scrap yard when he slipped and fell from the engine landing beneath the railcar wheel as the railcar was moving. His right leg and left foot were crushed, resulting in a right leg amputation.
An employee was descending a structural fixed ladder when the employee lost grip and fell approximately 10 feet to the lower level. The employee suffered fractures to the right and left ankles.
An employee was welding from a bucket truck when sparks dropped into the bucket and caused a fire. The employee sustained burns to the legs and back.
An employee fell and fractured her hip, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was loading boxes onto a trailer. The conveyor belt caught the employee's left middle finger, partially amputating it. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were drilling a water well. As they were removing a cut-out portion of the well casing from the drill floor, the casing was bumped and shifted, causing it to fall enough to take slack out of the cable. The injured employee had placed his hand on the cable to remove it from the hook and his finger was caught between the hook and the cable. As a result, the distal phalange of his left index finger was amputated.

An employee was unloading a vehicle from a flatbed tow truck. The vehicle slid sideways and its frame pinned his arm against the frame of the tow truck bed. His arm was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a sandblasting hose. It activated and sprayed sand in his eyes.
An employee was unloading doors from a truck when wood molding and building materials fell off the truck and struck his face, causing cuts and lacerations to the face and head. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell during horseplay with other nurses and broke a hip.
An employee was cleaning a rice miller's cooling chamber discharge. The feed screw inside the machine caught his right index finger, amputating it below the nailbed.
An employee was using a band saw to cut meat when the blade amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was up a ladder and on steel beams while lifting box freight when he fell to the floor and landed on his right side. He fractured his humerus in his right arm.
An employee was securing a dead front panel on a panel board when an arc flash occurred, causing second and third degree burns to the employee's hands, arms, and face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to the front of a trailer when she tripped over the rollers in the trailer and fell to the ground, breaking her right ankle.
An employee was unjamming a box from a conveyor. The employee's right glove was caught between the conveyor belt and a roller, and the back of the employee's right hand was abraded.

An employee was on a ladder tightening a steam pipe when the steam pipe burst. A piece of the pipe hit the employee on the head, knocking him off the ladder. He hit a piece of equipment on the way to the ground and landed on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized.

A mechanic was notified of a cooling issue on a refrigerator trailer in the fleet. He had just brought the trailer in from the yard and parked in the work bay of the trailer shop to begin the troubleshooting process. While performing the tension checks, the thermostat on the trailer triggered the engine to start. A belt pulled the mechanic's hand into a pulley and his fingers were caught at a pinch point. He sustained an amputation to the left middle finger at the first joint, and an amputation to the left index finger at the base of the fingernail.
An employee was loading metals into a loader with a scrap crane when his right middle finger was caught between a crane magnet and the scrap metal and  amputated.
Employees were organizing iron beams with an overhead crane and sweeping the work area when the steel beam tipped over and pinned the injured employee's legs, causing fractures to both.
An employee was showing another employee his gun. The gun fell to the floor and discharged, hitting the second employee in the left thigh. The second employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading in the top of an open container when he lost his balance and fell approximately 3 feet to the concrete ground, landing on his tailbone and injuring his lower back.
An employee was climbing down from a front-end loader when his foot slipped on a lower step. He fell about 4 feet to the ground below, suffering a broken fibula.

An employee was operating the extruder for polystyrene rolls when a roll snapped. He was feeding the sheet through the rubber rollers that control the tension on the roll when the rolls grabbed his fingers, injuring his right middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was working under a conveyor casing. The casing fell on the employee, breaking the employee's ribs and collarbone.

An employee was using a flat-bladed screwdriver to remove a screw out of a concrete wall in preparation to paint the wall. As he applied force to remove the screw, the screwdriver slipped and lacerated his left arm/wrist area, causing a vascular bleed that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was assisting as a crane moved a load. As the crane lifted the load, his finger was caught between the sling and the load, resulting in a fracture and amputation.

An employee was operating a ribbon cutting machine. The machine became jammed with elastic; while the employee was clearing the jam, the machine cycled and amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.

An employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, cutting sheetrock to attach an electrical terminal box. His elbow hit the terminal box and he was thrown off balance, falling to the floor from about four rungs up. He suffered a dislocated right wrist and a cut from a metal bracelet he was wearing.
An employee had been stacking boxes and started having chest pains. The employee was hospitalized and had cardiac related surgery.

A maintenance employee was helping move a die that was sitting on a pallet. The die tilted and pinched the employee's right little finger against another die causing a cut that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a table saw when the saw's power was cut. His right ring finger made contact with the saw as it was slowing down, and the fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was moving turf with a walk-behind mower. The mower partially ran over the employee's left foot, lacerating it; the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing at the edge of an approximately 48-inch diameter hole that was approximately 18 feet deep. The employee was using a winch cable off the back of a drilling rig with a hook on it, attempting to retrieve a shovel that had fallen into the hole, when he lost his footing and fell approximately 18 feet to the bottom of the hole. He broke his right leg in two places with possible additional injuries to the left leg.
An employee was walking from a trailer to an office with paperwork when the employee's knee gave out. The employee fell onto the concrete ground and broke the kneecap.
An employee was cutting scrap material with a torch when the material shifted and struck the employee's right foot. The employee sustained a right foot laceration and fracture.
After unloading materials from a flatbed truck, an employee was climbing down from the flatbed truck when the employee fell and suffered a head concussion.

Employees were measuring a vault that was under construction at a new bank location when the vault fell on top of an employee, trapping and crushing her. She suffered multiple bone fractures to her lower extremities.
An employee was attempting to clear an equipment jam when his right index finger was caught between the equipment's roller and drum, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was attempting to clear what he believed to be a clogged blower chute from the spin trimmer. As he was shaking the chute to clear it, the chute disconnected from the blower unit. He pulled a rolling ladder to the unit and then attempted to reconnect the chute to the blower. His left hand slipped and entered the motor where the impeller blades struck and amputated the fingertips of his index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was using a sand mixer when the employee's hands entered the mixer. The mixer blade then cut off two of the employee's fingers. The mixer chute was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was cleaning up a job site and throwing a board into a dumpster when he was struck by a sheet of siding that was dropped from a boom lift 20 feet above. He suffered multiple head contusions; abrasions to the head, neck, back, and chest; and fractured ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was struck on the head and neck by a falling ladder.
An employee was repairing a conveyor belt when it activated. The chain and sprocket caught his fingers, amputating the left index and ring fingers.
An employee was retrieving a tire that had fallen from a truck. While retrieving the tire, the employee was bitten by a water moccasin snake. The employee was then hospitalized.

A temporary employee cleaned a tripper and radioed the operator to restart the machine. The employee was then caught in a rotating shaft, suffering a left shoulder dislocation and left arm fracture that required hospitalization. The guard was removed at the time of the incident.

An employee was climbing down the steps of a bucket truck when he placed his hand on the open tool box and a co-worker closed the tool box lid on his hand. As a result, his right index finger was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee was installing a gutter from a ladder when he fell 20 feet, striking his head and requiring hospitalization for head trauma.

An employee was shifting a larger timber off of a smaller timber as it was going down the line when his finger was caught between the larger timber and the metal side rail of the line, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A truck driver was preparing to load his truck, using a lift bar to manually place the dock leveler. As he was guiding the dock leveler plate onto the back of the truck, the tip of his left index finger was amputated in the hinge.
Two employees were sitting at a table outside their work building, next to the parking lot. A patient's vehicle struck the employees, who suffered fractures to the lower extremities and head trauma.
An employee was moving material when his finger was pinched between the handle of a cart and a metal stud, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning up material near a flight of steps at a jobsite when the employee fell down 10 steps to the ground, suffering a head laceration/injury.

To help move cardboard boxes, an employee used a lift machine to move the pallets storing the boxes. He exited the lift while it was still in motion and his hand was caught between the back of the lift and a yellow bin. He was hospitalized with a broken/bruised right thumb/palm.
An employee was riding on horse back, checking the health of feedlot cattle when the horse lost its footing and rolled over on the employee's leg, breaking the tibia on the right side.

An employee had just disconnected a tractor/trailer and exited the truck to put in a support bracket that sits under the nose of the trailer. His tractor rolled backwards and pinned him between the trailer and the back of the tractor. He sustained lacerations.

An employee was attempting to remove an actuator pipe/valve combo that had fallen into a hopper with an auger when his arm triggered a sensor, causing a pneumatic valve to close on his right ring finger and amputate the fingertip. The auger was moving at the time of the incident.
An employee was intervening in an argument between two elder care clients when she was accidentally pushed down a flight of stairs. She landed on the sidewalk and was injured.

On April 21, 2020, an employee had just completed preventive maintenance on a conveyor's belt and bearings, and was checking how the belt was tracking, when a powered roller in the middle of the belt caught his right thumb. He suffered a degloving that resulted in a partial amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was coming down an extension ladder from the roof of a building when the ladder and employee fell. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and left hip. The ladder was not attached to the building and was missing feet at the time of the incident.

An employee was helping a crew run a cleaning pig through a pipe running from an oil well into the manifold. During the pig retrieval process, the pig became dislodged by unanticipated vapor buildup and exited the pipe. The vapor burst exited the pipe and the employee was overcome by the H2S vapors.
Two employees were lifting a valve when one of them suffered a back injury. He was hospitalized.

Two employees were unloading a truck at a dock; one was driving a standup forklift and the other was driving a high reach forklift. While the standup forklift was backing up, its operator's leg was pierced by the high reach forklift's forks.
An employee was feeding wood into the chipper when a board kicked out and struck him in the left hip, which was fractured. He was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to remove a superstructure from an engine using a crane when the down button on the crane was pressed instead of the up button. The superstructure then amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was using a motorized drain auger to unclog a machine. A spinning spiral mechanism (which turned the auger) caught his thick leather glove and cut off the tip of his right ring finger.

An employee was cleaning a roll former's tooling with a rag and manually jogged the machine with a remote control. The employee's glove and cleaning rag came in contact with the roll former, pulling his finger between the rolls. His left index finger was pinched and rolled over, resulting in surgical amputation of the finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting trees with a chainsaw when the chainsaw lacerated his arm and cut a nerve. He had surgery and was hospitalized.

An employee was taking down or placing chairs in storage while standing on the top platform of a rolling stair ladder when he fainted and fell to the concrete floor. He was hospitalized with a fractured skull, fractured spine, and a broken rib.
An employee was helping a co-worker move some drywall when the drywall fell over and struck him in the leg, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was attempting to climb into a railcar when he slipped and fell, hitting his face on a roll of paper and injuring his neck.
An employee was adjusting the chain on an arm pole when the employee's right ring finger was caught between the pole and its stand and fractured.
An employee was transitioning over a precast bed form when he fell approximately 3 feet to the floor below and broke his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was contacted by moving parts while cleaning a machine, sustaining severe lacerations to the left hand and fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a wedge from a mill stand guide when the guide shifted and amputated the tip of the employee's left pinky finger.

An employee was troubleshooting a de-energized screw conveyor. While he was manually moving the belt drive, the jammed object came free and the conveyor belt moved and pulled his hand in between the belt and pulley. He suffered a left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was emptying a tip dumpster into a larger roll-away dumpster with a forklift. When the employee released the lever allowing the tip dumpster's contents to transfer to the larger dumpster, the weight shifted and the employee's left ring fingertip was caught between the tip dumpster and the forklift fork, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
The injured employee was cleaning rollers with a partner when one of the rollers was moved. The injured employee's finger was then pinched between the rollers, breaking a bone in his index finger.
An employee was on a ladder when it slipped out from under him. He fell and landed on the concrete floor, hitting his face and chin and suffering a cracked rib.

An employee was helping with the installation of a brace on a prefab concrete panel when the nylon sling slipped out of the lifting hook, slid down the panel, and the brace struck the employee. The employee sustained head, neck, and back injuries.
An employee suffered a herniated disc in his back while lifting a package during a delivery.
The injured employee was moving a stone up one level to another employee on a scaffold, when he lost his balance and fell on the stone he was standing on, injuring his back and hand.
An employee was visiting various construction sites. After parking their vehicle, the employee walked across the road to a construction site and was struck by a car, suffering a broken left femur.
On April 22, 2020, a temporary employee was walking from across an aisle way. A forklift backed into her and ran over her right leg, crushing it. She was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a ladder on top of a truck. While descending the ladder, the employee missed the last rung and fell onto the truck before falling onto the concrete below. The employee suffered a fractured skull and broken finger on the right hand.

On April 22, 2020, an employee was attempting to climb into a jockey truck when the employee reached for the grab bar and missed, causing a loss of balance. The employee fell backwards, striking the elbow on the jockey's steel platform and resulting in a left elbow laceration, torn bicep, and torn tricep, which required stitches, surgical muscle repair, and hospitalization.

An employee was washing out a concrete truck after unloading it. While the employee was spraying down the fins, the hopper of the truck came down onto the employee's left hand, fracturing it. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting pieces as they came out of a machine. He went to pull apart the pieces. The punch came down and injured his fingers, resulting in amputations to his pinky finger as well as his middle and ring fingertips.
An employee slipped on tile and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
On April 23, 2020, at 2:40 PM, an employee was performing maintenance under an air handler unit. When the employee stood up, an iron bracket cut the back of the employee's neck.

An employee was climbing a ladder. The employee's foot got caught between two rungs; she lost balance and fell about 3 feet to the ground, suffering a broken right foot. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was stocking shelves using a ladder. While stepping down backwards, the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip or femur.
An employee was using a grinder on a metal railcar running board. The wheel on the grinder came off and lacerated his left thigh.

An employee was on a ladder, installing new security cameras on a university building. He fell from the ladder to the ground 15 feet below, striking his head. He was hospitalized, suffering from brain bleeding and lung bleeding.
An employee slipped and fell down a staircase, breaking one finger.

An employee was pushing a two-wheeled cart carrying a 55-gallon drum. The cart slipped and pressed the employee's left little finger between the cart and the wall, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee fell from the top of a ladder while checking a new property. The employee struck the ground and suffered a dislocation to the foot.
An employee slipped while walking down stairs, falling and breaking his leg. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was helping a crane operator retrieve a roll from a storage rack. The employee was working on the west side of the rack and the crane operator was working on the east side of the rack. The employee's hand was resting on the end of the roll. When the operator lifted the top roll, the other roll moved, pinching the employee's left hand and resulting in amputations to the left pinky and ring fingers.
An employee was moving a cart when the employee slipped on a mat and fell, breaking the right femur.

On April 23, 2020, at approximately 8:25 p.m., an employee was adjusting the position of a conveyor belt. He grabbed the belt with both hands in order to pull the belt over. As he was pulling the belt over, the fingers on his left hand were pinched between the belt and roller, amputating his left ring fingertip and fracturing his left middle finger.
An employee was cutting trees when a branch fell on him. He suffered broken ribs.
An employee was standing on the fork of a forklift 2 feet off the ground pulling on shrink wrap when he slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing his hip.

An employee had unloaded a tracked drill rig off of a trailer and started to drill when the employee's pant leg became caught in the drill auger. As a result, the employee suffered a fracture to the left fibula with contusions and a hematoma, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attaching an elevator to a column pipe when the elevator slid up to the lifting lug, smashing the employee's right pinky finger. The employee's finger was partially amputated.

Two employees were troubleshooting a variable-frequency drive. As one of the employees was removing the wires from the bottom of the control disconnect, a wire touched the frame of the drive, causing an arc flash that burned the employee's right hand and face.
An employee was retrieving an item from a machine. A sharp object in the machine cut the employee's hand near the thumb, causing an injury that needed stitches.

Two employees were taking cross-braces off a shoring tower and handing them to a third employee at the base of the frame. They were working from the top down, and had removed the braces from the top two sections; as they began to remove the braces from the bottom section, the tower tipped over and landed on the employee on the ground. The employee suffered three broken vertebrae and three dislocated vertebrae in the back.

A millwright was doing preventive maintenance on a cooling wheel that was locked out. The failsafe brake malfunctioned, causing the wheel to turn and strike him. He suffered a broken left arm, a broken left leg, and broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee lost his footing and fell to the ground while climbing down an 8-foot ladder, fracturing his arm.
An employee was trying to unclog a flux system when his hand entered a valve that was activated, resulting in amputations to three fingertips on the right hand just below the fingernail.

An employee was using a drill and paddle bit to drill holes in a plywood form, which was lying on the ground. While drilling, he hit a can of spray adhesive, causing a fire that burned his hands, arms, chest, and head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was repositioning a patient using a draw sheet with another technician when she experienced pain due to a severe back sprain, requiring hospitalization.
An employee had just serviced a generator. The employee was removing a rag when the generator's fan blade cut off the tip of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was hauling granite on a flatbed truck and stopped at a truck stop for a routine check of the load. The employee noticed one of the chains was becoming loose and used a snap binder to secure the load. The employee went up on the flatbed to tighten the chain when the snap binder snapped back up and hit the employee in the face, causing a fractured skull and brain bleed. The employee was found unconscious on the ground.

An employee was applying coating to a weld at a pipe joint when an adjacent pipe shifted, pinning the employee against a second pipe. The employee sustained fractures to his rib cage and tailbone along with bruising to the right leg.

An employee was operating a trench machine when he took the cap off a radiator and was sprayed by hot anti-freeze. He received burns to the left thigh and left arm and fractured his ankle when he jumped off the machine.
An employee was pulling a part out of a reamer machine when his thumb was pulled into the machine, resulting in a partial thumb amputation.
After pulling a pallet jack with a pallet 2 feet away from his workstation, an employee walked backwards and tripped over the pallet, breaking his left leg in two places.

An employee was attempting to remove a splintered piece of wood debris that was stuck at the feed inside a molder machine when a spinning profile cutter removed a deep chunk from his right index finger.
On April 23, 2020, an employee was operating a demolition saw at a construction worksite. On April 24, 2020, the employee was hospitalized for a ruptured aorta and required surgery.

An employee was setting up to sanitize a production line when her rain jacket hood was caught by a moving shackle, pulling her down to a drip pan where she struck a support post and then fell 4 or 5 feet to the ground. She suffered an internal laceration to her liver.

An employee was troubleshooting a new conveyor. While he was sitting on it, two of its wires were reconnected and the conveyor activated. He traveled on the conveyor for about 6 feet; a cross brace struck his back, injuring it.
An employee was chipping at some concrete stuck in an I-beam when the I-beam swung out and smashed his right index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering an aluminum mullion from a rack. It slipped and his left ring, middle, and index fingers were crushed against the ground. He suffered fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee working on cabling was shocked by a 277-volt exposed wire in the ceiling, burning the third and fourth fingers.
An employee fell off the deck of his rollback truck while climbing up to get his winch cable, striking his head on the ground.
An employee was working near a dock operating a forklift. He was reaching for paperwork when he lost control of his forklift and it struck the dock, injuring his foot.
An employee was walking to an assigned work location when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was changing a blade on a sawmill module. His glove got caught and pulled off, and the blade amputated his left ring fingertip.

On April 25, 2020, at approximately 2:00 a.m., an employee was being trained to use an electric  pallet jack (PIT). While going in reverse, he lost control of the electric pallet jack and let go of the arm. As he let go of the arm, he stepped off the jack and his left leg was pinned against a rack. He suffered a lower left leg fracture.
An employee sustained second degree steam burns to his upper right arm and right torso while operating a steam hose on a railcar.
An employee was removing a piece of plastic from a conveyor line when her right hand was caught between the conveyor roller and a nip point, resulting in a right ring fingertip amputation.

On April 25, 2020, at approximately 6:15 a.m., an employee was inflating a dismounted tractor-trailer tire on the interstate when the single piece wheel rim was ejected from the tire and struck the employee in the head. The employee sustained face and head injuries.

An employee was working in a COVID-19 unit, and accordingly was wearing full PPE during her shifts on April 25 and April 26, 2020, including an N95 mask. She felt itching on her forehead and around the mask on April 25, then developed swollen eyelids and hives to the face, trunk, and legs on April 26. She became short of breath at home on April 28 and was hospitalized, suffering from diffuse urticaria and dyspnea, possibly from the mask.
An employee was driving a forklift in reverse when the forklift struck a support beam from the left side. The employee's left foot sustained injury which required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a landscaping vehicle when it flipped over. The employee's arm/hand was caught between the vehicle and a tree.
An employee was cleaning the chain on a foil machine. The chain caught the employee's right glove and amputated the employee's ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was moving a tote when she tripped on a dolly and fell, breaking her left leg and requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning apple packing equipment when the employee's right thumb and fingers were caught in the machinery, resulting in an amputation of the right thumb tip and fractured fingers.

An employee was trying to remove a T-post fencing stake using a stake remover tool. While using his body weight to push down on the lever, his leg twisted and broke. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was stepping over a caution tape barrier when she tripped over the barrier and fell, fracturing her left shoulder and upper arm. She was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was cleaning the coater pan of a press oven when the employee's gloved hand became caught between two moving rollers on the machine. The employee's left pinky and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee was cleaning the work area when his arm was injured in a piece of equipment, sustaining lacerations.
An employee was installing a satellite dish. The employee fell off a ladder to the ground about 5-6 feet below, suffering a contusion.
A nurse was attacked by a patient in a care unit. She suffered a cut to the forehead, a bruised elbow, eye injuries, and injuries to the head area and was hospitalized.

An employee was working in a steel trench box (about approximately 10-12 feet deep), spreading rock at the bottom of the trench and waterline pipe. A pipe struck the employee as the employee was working in the trench and fractured the employee's pelvis.
An employee scraped a hand on a bent safety steel slat while stocking, receiving a laceration that required surgery.

An employee was carrying a 6-foot-long and 5-inch-diameter pipe filled with dirt when he tripped into a 2-foot-deep ditch. He fell on top of the pipe with his hand between the pipe and ground. He sustained a fracture to his right hand that required surgery.
An employee was lifting a mold block using an overhead crane. The block broke the employee's left arm and crushed the employee's right arm and hand.
An employee was on a deck delivering a package. He jumped onto a bench to get away from a dog, then lost his balance and fell from the deck to the ground, suffering broken ribs.

An employee was cutting up a felled tree with a chainsaw. The chainsaw got stuck and the employee turned it off. Another employee stepped between the tree and another tree, pushing down the tree with the chainsaw stuck in it. The tree freed itself from the stump and hit the employee's left knee, fracturing and dislocating it.
An employee was stocking merchandise from a step ladder or a rolling staircase when he missed a step and fell to the floor, injuring his left hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a hallway, when she scuffed her foot, lost balance, and fell on her left knee, fracturing her patella.
An employee was found laying on the ground with a broken rib, concussion, and laceration above his eye, potentially as a result of a fall from a ladder. He was hospitalized.
At about 6:50 p.m. on April 27, 2020, an employee fell off the end of a product picking location and landed in netting. The employee suffered a lacerated right shin that required surgery.
An excavator's boom swung and struck two employees. Between them, they suffered a broken collar bone, 15 broken ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee was moving a surgical laser machine to a different location when the fingers of his right hand were caught and crushed between the machine and a door frame, resulting in the surgical amputation of his right small fingertip.
An employee was guiding a telehandler forklift with a sheet of steel attached. The employee slipped and fell and the forklift's tire amputated the employee's left foot.

An employee was using an industrial sewing machine to make slings. The presser foot rose while the employee's finger was in the path of the metal channel, and the employee's left middle finger was amputated.

Three employees were trying to set up a concrete silo mixing plant and had the silo lifted on a forklift. The back legs on the silo needed to be adjusted to level out the silo. The legs were stuck, so the forklift was tilted forward to try and force the legs free by lowering it onto the ground. The silo slid forward and struck the employees, one of whom suffered a fractured leg and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking in a warehouse when her leg was caught in plastic wrap. She fell and fractured her tibia.

An employee was storing a golf cart that was not working. He attempted to accelerate the cart to get it going again. The cart was in reverse instead of neutral at the time and went backward. The cart's belt then pulled his finger toward the engine pulley, cutting and amputating his index fingertip.

An employee was unloading materials onto a roof when the employee slipped and fell off the roof. During the fall to the ground, the employee's head hit a trailer, resulting in a fractured skull and injuries to the nose, mouth, teeth, jaw, ear, and left shoulder. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized. Fall protection was not worn at the time of the incident.
An employee was oiling a product chain during routine preventive maintenance when his hand was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in ligament and nerve damage.

An employee was working near a cart with a concrete stair tread on it. The cart tipped over and the stair tread fell, slid down the employee's leg, and landed on his left foot. His little toe was crushed.
An employee was unjamming and realigning steel bars on a bar straightener. Her left hand was caught between a steel bar and a roller, and the middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was helping a driver load pipes onto a transport trailer when a pipe rolled and wedged his left thumb, resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was repairing a leak on a barge. After repairing the leak, the employee was working overhead when fire/slag from a welding torch's oxygen line fell on his glove, igniting and burning his left hand and forearm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a farm tractor when the wind blew the door closed on his finger, smashing and amputating his fingertip.
On April 27, 2020, an employee was walking in a canyon adjacent to the road while performing orientation training and was bitten by a rattlesnake. The employee was hospitalized.
On 04/27/2020, at 10:52 a.m., an employee was cutting a palm tree with a chainsaw when the chainsaw kicked back and cut his left wrist. He had surgery and was hospitalized.
An employee was dismounting a powered industrial truck. The vehicle went into reverse and injured the employee's foot and ankle.

An employee was working on a marine engine with a rag in his hand. A belt pulled the rag, which then pulled his right index finger through the pulley. This caused the amputation of approximately half of the finger.
A temporary employee was picking up trash in a ditch. He tripped on a rock and fell to the ground, suffering lacerations to the elbows and hands, as well as a strain and pain in the knee.
An employee who had been operating an excavator reported experiencing a headache, increased heart rate, and chest pains. The employee was hospitalized.

On April 27, 2020, at 12:30 p.m., an employee began rolling the rubber sheet coming out of a press machine onto the electric roller when his left hand and arm were pulled into the rubber roller on the press. He was hospitalized with left arm fractures.
An employee was sanitizing shopping carts in front of a building. She fell from a cement curb, suffering injuries to her left leg. She was hospitalized.
An air-powered muntin bar knocker (used to cut, shape, and notch glass) amputated an employee's finger.

At about 1:00 p.m. on April 28, 2020, an employee was checking a sulfuric acid railcar to ensure that it was empty before it was sent offsite for cleaning and decommissioning. The employee loosened the railcar's dip tube cap with a pipe wrench, then removed it. Residual pressure in the railcar sprayed about 4 pounds of acid into the employee's face, causing chemical burns to the employee's forehead, cheeks and nose.
An employee was cutting meat with a saw. The blade amputated the tip of his left pinky finger.

The injured employee was loading books into a gondola from a protected hydraulic tipper and transporting the gondola to a staging area with the assistance of another employee. While putting the gondola bin in the staging area, the injured employee removed his hand from the handles and placed them on the top rail. His right pinky finger was then caught and pinched between the bin on his gondola and a second gondola's bin. As a result, the employee's right pinky finger was amputated at the top joint.
A volunteer collapsed at work and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to clear a clog in an auger-driven material transfer line when the employee's fingers were contacted by energized/moving parts. The middle and ring fingertips on the right hand were amputated.

An employee was bolting a support leg onto the bottom of a trailer. The front of the trailer was lifted slightly in order to insert the leg mounting bracket into position under the trailer mounting bracket. Once in position and after being lowered, the two brackets can be bolted together. The employee's left hand was on the back side of the support leg and his thumb tip was amputated in a pinch point between the two brackets while the trailer was being lowered.
An employee was carrying a stack of cardboard when he tripped over a pallet and fell to the concrete floor. He suffered a broken elbow and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a lift to paint a ceiling beam when he was caught between the lift and the beam, suffering crushing injuries.
An employee was on a ladder using an air hose to blow off a break tank when the employee fell from the ladder, suffering a hip injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on a tie jig (equipment that grabs railroad ties) which was connected to the bucket of an excavator. After performing some repairs underneath the tie jig, the employee crawled underneath the other side of the tie jig to make a final repair and was crushed by the tie jig. The employee was hospitalized with a broken sternum and broken ribs.

An employee was cleaning a vent within the building and as he was descending a ladder, he fell from the ladder to the floor below.  He sustained a broken clavicle and broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing inside a man basket assisting with a line washing task at a well head tree when he was struck on his right leg (shin area) with pressurized water, sand, and shale from the well head tree flow line. He was hospitalized with a broken right leg, requiring surgery.
An employee was freeing a stuck pulley belt on an auger. The belt took off and pulled the employee's hand into the pulley, amputating a fingertip up to the first knuckle.
An employee had just removed the bands on a pallet of siding when the stack of siding tipped over and landed on his leg. He suffered a fracture above the ankle.
An employee was installing wire lath on the side of a house when he fell off a ladder onto the edge of a dumpster, injuring his back. He required back surgery and was hospitalized.

An employee was starting up a reel on a wire packaging machine when a loop in the wire wrapped around his pinky finger. As the reel was turning to wrap around the drum, the loop tightened around his pinky finger and lacerated it, resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.

On April 28, 2020, a temporary employee was operating the brownie mix sifter in the layer packaging department. The sifter became clogged with the brownie mix product at the sifter beat screw housing. The employee's left hand fingers were caught in the rotating auger while unclogging the sifter severing the fingertips.
An employee fell from a two-story roof to the ground while conducting an insurance inspection, suffering injuries to the head, neck, back, and left leg and a brain bleed.

An employee was guiding/lowering a Kelly hose off to the side of the work floor with a winch line when a counterweight slid down the winch line and struck the employee's left hand, causing an open fracture that required hospitalization.

At 7:15 AM, an employee was operating a refiner and was on the operation control end with his hand on the quick-release lever. The lever was in the up position when the quick release became disengaged and the lever came down on the employee's hand with force. The lever amputated his left thumb just above the second knuckle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a continuous vulcanizing line, which extrudes rubber jacketing around a conductor cable and uses an indent printing process to label the cable. The indent printer housing had a steel cap on the side; the employee had just tightened this cap into place and was making adjustments on a panel when steam pressure ejected the cap into his abdomen. The cap knocked the wind out of him and he suffered first- and second-degree burns from the steam. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a paint scaffold to reach boxes on an industrial shelf about 6-feet 4-inches high. A metal frame caught his foot, causing him to trip and fall onto a pipe. He suffered a broken pelvis, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was standing next to concrete forms when a crane operator began lifting the forms. The pile of forms shifted and the employee's finger was pinched between two forms, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was loading a curtain trailer when the employee slipped on insulation and fell backward off the trailer. The employee fell 4 to 5 feet, suffering a fractured right arm that required surgery.
An employee was climbing down a 6-foot step ladder. At the last step, he fell to the concrete floor and sustained a hip fracture and a concussion.
An employee tripped over a speed bump in a parking lot and fell, suffering a broken right elbow.
An employee climbed 5 feet up a 10-foot ladder to tighten a coupler bolt when the employee fell to the ground, suffering a back injury with fractured vertebrae.
An employee was lifting a hollow structural steel rib for a dome when a hollow steel section broke off and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was working from a scaffold, installing a beam clamp. The employee fell 5 feet to the ground, suffering three broken ribs as well as head and ear lacerations from his hard hat.

An employee was heading out of the office and down the stairs to begin her shift at the gate. It was stormy with heavy winds at the time. She stepped out onto the landing and shut the door when a gust of wind caused her to lose her balance and fall down the stairs. She was hospitalized with a possible concussion and a fractured coccyx.
An employee was unboxing a crate of glass. When the side of the box was opened, the product fell out and caught the employee, crushing his hip.

An employee was on a loading dock lowering the door of a refrigerated trailer when the trailer door rapidly closed on the employee's left index finger. The employee's finger was pinched in the door, resulting in a partial left index fingertip amputation.
An employee lost consciousness while splitting lumber on a resaw. His right elbow got caught in the blade and was cut.
An employee was labeling clothing using heat transfer labels. She smelled a chemical smell, then felt dizzy and weak, and experienced numbness on her left side.
An employee was installing a drainage pipe in a trench when the dirt trench walls collapsed on the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis and hip.
The injured employee was helping another employee move dunnage with a forklift when the dunnage slipped off the forklift and struck the injured employee's right jaw, breaking it.
An employee suffered a right-hand finger amputation while operating a drill press.
An employee was laying pipe in a trench when a chunk of dirt/mud rolled into the trench box and onto the employee, who suffered a broken leg.

An employee was using a press to bend a piece to a 90-degree angle. When the die came down, the piece did not bend 90 percent as it was supposed to, so the employee lifted the die, held the piece with both hands, and activated the press with the foot pedal. The press die then amputated the employee's thumbs from the middle of the nail to the tip.

An employee was parking a powered industrial truck (PIT) when he noticed that the left tine was not aligned properly. He turned off the truck with the tines elevated in order to reposition the tine so that it could be securely lowered to the ground for the evening. The truck was parked over an unused metal PIT attachment. He grabbed the horizontal section of the tine with his right hand and as he began to place pressure on the tine to move it toward the center, the tine dislodged from the carriage and fell onto the metal attachment below, crushing the middle and ring fingers on his right hand. As a result, he suffered amputations of the fingertips of the third and fourth distal phalanges on the right hand (above the nail bed).
