An employee was holding a knife in his right hand to debone a poultry thigh when the knife suddenly slipped from his right hand. As he attempted to catch the knife, the tip of the blade made a small cut on the right side of his lower abdomen.

An employee was going to dispose of a piece of plate/liner material. She placed the plate/liner on the floor and later stepped on it, causing her to slip and fall to the floor. She fractured her hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was off his forklift when another forklift ran over his foot. He suffered a severe crushing injury to his left foot and a cut to his left shin.
An employee was attempting to clear a jam on an extruder machine when the employee's hand came into contact with a rotating valve, resulting in the amputation of four fingers.

An employee was working around a can line conveyor when his left leg lower extremity made contact with a metal bracket mounted to the can line conveyor, resulting in a laceration to his left Achilles tendon. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was standing 8 to 10 feet up on a ladder inside a water tank applying tank coating when the employee fell to the metal bottom of the tank. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae, broken ribs, and a punctured neck.
An employee lifted the tongue of a generator to move it when his finger was caught/pinched between the jack and tongue. This resulted in a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.

An employee was taking down the canopy over a walkway. When he stepped on a brace on the canopy, it gave way and he fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below. He suffered a fractured skull with intracranial bleeding and a T12 vertebra burst fracture.
An employee was in a lift removing a window about 30 feet above ground. The lift got close to an FPL wire and a power surge shocked the employee, causing injuries including a leg amputation.
An employee was leaning over a propane grill to light it through the cooking grates when the flames jumped and burned the employee's face and arms.
An employee was conducting welding operations on a spot welder when the machine cycled and partially amputated the employee's right index finger.

An employee was moving a parts table with two pallets stacked on top of each other when a pallet shifted, causing the employee's fingers to be caught between the two pallets. As a result, the employee sustained a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing a wooden pallet from the second level of a metal angle rack when the next pallet came forward. The employee's thumb was caught between the metal rack and the wooden pallet, resulting in a right thumb amputation.
An employee was pressing meat into the glide toward the blade on a meat band saw when his left hand slipped and went into the saw blade. The employee suffered an amputation of the left pinky finger.

On April 29, 2020, at 12:45 PM, an employee was walking to the back store room to check the level of the anti-freeze drum. Less then a minute later, an explosion occurred in the building. Two employees ran to the back room and found the employee with face and neck burns and singed hair. He was hospitalized.

On April 29, 2020, a pilot driver for an oversized load that had been transported from Texas was struck in the legs by the decking of the trailer that had been used to transport the oversized load. When a crane attempted to lift the decking at its destination in Florida, the load shifted and struck the pilot driver in the legs causing a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a customer's address to troubleshoot an in-channel frequency response issue. The employee was preparing to check radio frequency levels at the tap located on the strand next to a wood utility pole at the end of the customer's concrete pad driveway. He set up his 28-foot extension ladder onto the wood utility pole and began his ascent. He ascended the ladder to about the 13th or 14th rung and was reaching for his fall restraint lanyard to secure himself and the ladder to the pole when the pole began to break at its base. He fell from the extension ladder from a height of approximately 13 or 14 feet and contacted the concrete pad driveway below, landing on the side of his body and suffering fractured ribs.

An employee was cutting metal with a small handheld grinder when his hands flinched, which caused the tool to come toward his face. The rotating disk severed the left side of his lip and his face below the eye. He was hospitalized.

On 4/30/2020, at approximately 2:00 PM, an employee was delivering mail to residents when he stepped backwards onto a stone or brick that came loose and twisted his left ankle. The employee then fell to the ground, suffering two fractures and a dislocation of the left ankle. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

At 2:15 PM on April 30, 2020, an employee was unloading a bushing from a flatbed trailer. He was lifting one side of the bushing to place a lifting strap under it. As he lowered the bushing, it pinched his finger against the bushing that was beneath it, resulting in the amputation of his right index fingertip to the first knuckle.

An employee was using a jib crane to position a beam onto a workhorse when the beam struck a second beam, causing the second beam to fall to the floor. The beam, which weighed 644 lbs., fell on and crushed the employee's left foot.

An employee was helping a loader operator transfer catalyst from a bin into a roll-off box when the bin came off the loader's forks and fell on the ground. The employee was standing next to the bin when it fell and attempted to get out of the way, falling down in the process. The employee sustained left and right knee injuries.
An employee was operating a handheld grinder while grinding a patch on a silo to finish repairs when the disc shattered and fragmented pieces embedded into his left forearm, causing two lacerations.
An employee tripped on a cash register cord and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right arm.

An employee was approximately 36 inches up on a ladder removing conduit from beneath a catwalk when the base of the ladder kicked out. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a displaced fracture to the right humerus, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to empty a dumpster into a roll-off container when slack in the lift chain caused the forklift's mast to fall. His left thumb was caught between the mast and the dumpster, resulting in a partial left thumb amputation.

An employee was on a ladder at a customer's house, dropping a new cable line. The cable moved and knocked the employee off the ladder to the ground. He suffered a broken right arm near the wrist, as well as a concussion.
An employee was lifting a case of bottled water when she felt a sharp pain in her abdomen. She was hospitalized and required surgery for a hernia.
An employee was operating an oil pump machine when his right index finger was caught between the machine's chain drive and gear, resulting in amputation.

An employee was clearing a clog of sawdust on the discharge side of a sawdust collection unit when his hand was contacted by the impeller, resulting in an amputation to the left middle finger and hand lacerations.

At about 9:30 p.m. on April 30, 2020, an employee was cleaning a conveyor belt on a tomato slicing machine. His left glove got caught in the conveyor gear on the left side of the belt, resulting in the amputation of his left middle fingertip. The belt was running at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell from a standard mower. His left foot was caught under the mower, against the concrete, and his tibia was broken at the ankle.

On April 30, 2020, an employee was removing torque rods from a truck tractor using a 25-pound sledge hammer when the sledge hammer struck his left third finger, lacerating it and requiring surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to manually open an overhead garage door when the cables on which the door ran, snapped, causing the door to come down on his hand. He suffered a broken hand, requiring surgery.

An employee was getting ready to conduct framing operations on the third floor when he removed the floor cover and fell approximately 26 feet through to the ground level. Both of the employee's ankles were fractured.

An employee was operating an industrial vacuum machine when his right arm was pulled into the end of the hose while he was reaching down to pick it up. He experienced arm swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee was directing an excavator operator who was backfilling on the downhill side of a retaining wall when the operator disengaged the hydraulic control. The employee was then struck by the excavator bucket or mud, suffering a fractured leg.

An employee was unchoking a friction washer system. He climbed on the floater table, which is 50 inches from the ground, and placed the lid back on the friction washer. As he was climbing back down, he slipped and his left leg fell into the auger, resulting in the amputation of the left leg above the knee.

An employee was inspecting rooms in a house under construction when he opened an elevator access door thinking it was a closet. He fell four stories down the elevator shaft to the cement floor, suffering leg and spinal fractures. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a tanker truck and passed out, requiring hospitalization.
While working in a space to unclog a sewer line, an employee became hot, dizzy and nauseated, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on top of a 4-foot scaffold installing plastic trim when he lost his balance and fell on ceramic. He was hospitalized for internal bleeding.
An employee was struck by a forklift.

An employee was in a trench box (near the ladder, about 5 feet inside the box) when a large boulder of dirt fell immediately outside the box. Some of the dirt rolled into the end opening of the box, striking the employee on his heel as he tried to get away and knocking him down to the ground. As he fell, his head struck a T-valve, resulting in contusions to his head and face area. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an edge bander. The moving saw blade partially amputated the employee's little finger.

An employee was operating a double-length walkie rider pallet jack. While turning into a lane, the pallet jack struck a support beam; the employee was thrown off and fell 3 feet to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An oil/gas well employee was pushing down on a liner washer tube with a pin. The pin slipped, and the employee's right thumb was caught and smashed between the piston and the liner. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the thumb.
An employee lost his balance and fell from a 3-foot A-frame ladder, breaking his leg.
An employee was setting a piece of equipment down on a stand. The employee's right middle finger was partially amputated by the stand and the equipment.
A door caught an employee's left hand, causing the amputation of the tip of the index finger.
An employee was leaving a room when the door closed on his left index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was adjusting a forklift's fork extender chain. The chain lacerated three fingers on the employee's right hand. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was cleaning out a cement mixer when it caught and broke his left hand.

An employee was using a measuring tape to measure an aluminum log on a conveyor. The conveyor started while the employee's hand was between two of the logs, crushing his fingers and resulting in the surgical amputation of his left middle fingertip.
An employee was pulling a set of skate rollers when she tripped over a pallet jack and fell to the floor, breaking her hip.
An employee was trying to raise a trailer's lift gate. The gate was lowered and crushed the employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was medically amputated at the first knuckle on May 2, 2020.

An employee was torqueing bolts with a hydraulic torque wrench inside a wind turbine. The employee was reaching to clear plastic debris from between the bolt and the wrench when the wrench actuated, crushing his right little finger and ring finger. He suffered an amputation to the little finger (6 millimeters from the nail); the injury to the ring finger required stitches.

An employee was trying to de-burr a piece of metal with a grinder. The tip of the employee's left middle finger was caught between the part, the table, and/or the sanding disc, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was welding a 2,200-pound steel I-beam from a sitting position. The I-beam rolled off the sawhorses supporting it and fell on the employee's legs, breaking them both below the knee.
Two electrical workers suffered a 480-volt shock. They were hospitalized.
During an altercation, an employee picked up another employee and slammed that employee to the ground, breaking the employee's leg.

An employee was attempting to retrieve a small stack of pallets using a front rider pallet jack. As the employee was reversing to exit the rack storing the pallets, the pallet jack s front lift control box caught on a rack beam. The employee s left index finger was caught between the lift box and the rack beam, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working on a blow mold machine. While he was cleaning out a mixing/blender cylinder, the mixer lacerated his arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was washing out a paint filling machine. The filler head's automated valve closed on his left middle fingertip. About an inch of the finger was amputated.

An employee was on an extension ladder, using a caulk gun to service a customer's leaking window. He fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a broken wrist, six broken ribs, a broken knee, a broken septum, and various other cuts and contusions.
On May 1, 2020, an employee was stepping down from a 4-foot ladder when he lost his balance, jumped from the ladder and landed awkwardly on the ground, breaking his right leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was doing electrical work at a remote worksite. The employee came into contact with a downed primary electrical wire and was shocked. The employee suffered hand injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was re-taping a large irregular package. The employee's right hand was caught between the package and the package cart, causing two broken fingers. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was holding a rope that was wrapped around the base of a tree trunk to lower a limb.  The rope was slick due to inclement weather conditions and slipped out of the employee's hands.  The limb started to fall, pulling the rope and causing it to unwind around the trunk. The rope struck the employee in the left eye, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was picking up a stack of pallets with an electric jack. His hand was caught between the jack and the warehouse racking, causing a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
On May 2, 2020, an employee fell from the back of a golf cart as the cart went around a curve. His head struck the pavement; he suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.

A metal chip used to test the metal detector had fallen off the conveyor. As an employee reached to retrieve the metal chip, her cotton glove was caught by a sprocket. Her arm and hand were pulled around the bar attached to the sprocket. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery on her wrist.

At 4:00 p.m. on May 2, 2020, an employee was hooking a chain that connected an H-pile to a crane block. The crane started lifting the pile, and the employee's right index fingertip was pinched in the chain. The fingertip was amputated.
At 5:16 a.m., a convenience store manager was forced into the store at gunpoint, then shot, suffering a leg injury.
A driver got into an altercation with a citizen while on the road and was injured, suffering from concussion-like symptoms. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder to the floor below while restocking shelves, injuring the left wrist.
An employee was standing behind a concrete pump truck when the piping system failed and swung into the employee's legs. The employee suffered a broken femur.
On May 2, 2020, a delivery driver slipped in mud while walking around the back of a semi trailer. The employee fell, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee was diagnosing a problem with a car. When the customer sat inside the car, the shock absorber in the car's wheel well pinched the employee's ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was trying to get the jaws to retract inside a machine's drum. The jaws retracted on the employee's left little finger, causing an amputation to the tip.
An employee was cleaning a van after a trip. The van began to roll and ran over the employee, causing fractures to the employee's pelvis, ribs, and shoulder.
An employee was pulling a cart. The employee's left little finger was caught and amputated between the cart and another cart.
An employee was driving a reach forklift when it struck a bollard. The employee's leg was caught between the forklift and the bollard and was broken.
An employee was loading traffic control barrels into the bed of a truck. The truck moved and the employee lost his balance and fell to the highway asphalt, breaking his wrist.
An employee was removing the lockout bar from a dumper. The dumper fell on the employee, breaking the employee's lower leg, ankle, and shoulder.

An employee removed a piece of pipe to clear a blockage. After removing the pipe, the employee backed away and removed his PPE. The blockage broke loose and he was splashed/sprayed with condensate/steam heated to about 180-200 degrees Fahrenheit. He was hospitalized with burns to his elbow and shoulder blades.

An employee was installing/winding a rope on a four-drum, motorized rope puller. The employee's right little finger was caught between the rope and the drum, and 1/2 inch was amputated from the tip of the finger.
An employee fell while climbing down an extension ladder. The employee landed about 7 feet below, suffering fractures to the right arm, right shoulder, and right-side ribs.

An employee was removing bolts on a shaft adapter with a ratcheting allen head socket wrench. While the employee was loosening a bolt, the blocking bar for the shaft slipped, allowing the shaft to drop 6 inches and pinch the employee's left little fingertip between the ratchet and the top of the gearbox. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee was holding a piece of trim to be bent in a trim folding machine. The machine actuated and the employee's left hand was caught under the clamping beam. The employee's fourth and fifth fingertips were amputated.
After bagging fertilizer, an employee shut off the bagger and began clearing out the hopper at its top. The auger began to turn and amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was polishing a metal drive shaft attached to a manual lathe. His rubber glove got caught and the lathe twisted his arm, breaking it.
An employee was loading a package car. The employee's leg became sore and the employee was hospitalized, having suffered a broken hip.
An employee was using a horizontal saw to cut tubes. The saw cut about 1/8 inch off the tip off his left middle finger.
An employee was lubricating a chain and sprocket during preventive maintenance when the employee's hand was caught in the chain and sprocket, resulting in a fractured right finger.
An employee was moving a dock leveler plate when the plate dropped, causing a fingertip amputation.

While installing under-cabinet lighting, an employee fell off a 4-foot step ladder and landed on the floor, resulting in a loss of consciousness, two broken front teeth, and a broken nose. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on plastic while stepping off a pallet. The employee fell, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was securing a front-end loader that was loaded on a trailer. He fell from the loader onto the concrete below, suffering injuries to the shoulder blade, ribs, a collarbone, as well as blood in the lungs.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a compound fracture to the right elbow.

The injured employee was in a cherry picker. A stand-up forklift struck the cherry picker's wheel and the injured employee fell, landing 20 feet below and suffering a head contusion, a broken collarbone, and broken ribs. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was stepping down while walking into an area. His foot rolled and he fell onto a concrete floor, breaking his left lower tibia and fibula.
An employee was stepping out of a scissor lift when his left ring finger got caught in the metal wire/pins of the scissor lift gate. The fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was waiting to help guide a concrete barrier as it was moved. The barrier struck his left foot, injuring it.
An employee was loading tools onto a truck. While closing a cover, the employee fell from the back of the service truck, landing on the ground 4-5 feet below and suffering a broken arm.
A mail carrier tripped and fell on stairs at a residence. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was walking a scissor lift up a ramp. The lift rolled back and caught the employee's right arm against a wooden platform. The arm was broken at the forearm and elbow.

An employee's truck broke down while he was on a dirt pit site. A mechanic on site put the truck on a low boy to transport it back to the company's physical location. While the truck was on the low boy, the employee entered the truck to retrieve paperwork, slipped, and fell off the low boy onto the ground and landed on his left arm and wrist. His left wrist was fractured.

An employee was manufacturing 4-foot-long pieces of strip metal into cable hangers. The employee's right middle fingertip was caught in the stamping press. The fingertip was amputated just below the fingernail.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a paper machine's hood exhaust fan. The employee was trying to remove a belt when their right middle and ring fingers were pinched and lacerated between the exhaust fan belt and sheave. The employee sustained an amputation to the fourth finger on the right hand.

An employee was standing on level ground, stocking cases of tissues. He became lightheaded, lost his balance and fell. He tried to catch himself on a forklift and his right forearm got stuck between a pallet and the forklift backrest. The employee suffered a fractured right forearm and was hospitalized.
While carrying wood blocks, an employee turned, tripped, and fell. The employee's head hit a metal tool box, requiring hospitalization.
A temporary employee backed into a parked cement truck while operating a concrete buggy, resulting in contusions and lacerations to the right leg.
A service technician was standing on the frame rail of a truck and torqueing engine cylinder head-bolts using a torque wrench. He fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip and wrist.

An employee was lowering a transfer hose between two liquid cargo barges. The winch started to free-spool and the hand crank came out of its seat. The employee was putting the hand crank back in to stop the winch from free-spooling, when the gears on the winch caused a partial amputation of a finger on the right hand and a fracture.

An employee was picking up metal scraps around a jobsite when he tripped and fell 20 feet from a balcony to the ground. He suffered seven broken ribs, a concussion, a collapsed lung, and a possible right arm fracture, requiring hospitalization.

A truck driver had just dumped dirt from his truck on a shoulder. A skid steer loader began moving the dirt from the shoulder to grade out the slope. The skid steer was backing up to the slope to get its second load of dirt when the truck driver's right arm was caught between the back of the skid steer and the back of the truck. The driver's radial artery and radial nerve were severed and the driver was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was in a newly dug grave, measuring it, when its walls gave way and the employee was trapped. The employee suffered lower back and chest pain and was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a lumber yard when a forklift backed into him, breaking his left leg.
An employee was setting a ring on a manhole when the ring came down on and crushed his left middle fingertip, amputating the underside and half of his fingernail.
While installing plumbing in a clean room, an employee contacted a white powdery substance that burst into flames. The employee suffered thermal burns to the hands.
A nurse practitioner slipped on a wet floor while evaluating a patient. She fell backwards and her head struck the floor.

A temporary employee fell from a board to the ground about 5 feet below. The board was on top of a retracted scissor lift. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a broken hip that required surgery.
An employee was delivering mail when slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was trimming a sheet of plywood on a table saw. The blade caught his fingers, amputating the tip of his right index finger.
An employee was preparing to pull mirrors from a rack to get at a particular mirror. The stack of glass hit the left side of the employee's face, causing a severe cut. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped in loose gravel while walking across a parking lot. The employee fell, suffering a broken hip and a twisted ankle.

An employee was operating a forklift when his left leg was caught between the forklift and a stationary metal rail guard. He suffered an open fracture of the tibia and fibula, as well as an injury to the left peroneal artery.

On May 5, 2020, an employee was measuring a trailer to install a winch when he tripped and hit his head on the truck's bumper. He suffered a bruise on his left side and was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee tripped on a banding strap and fell to the ground while walking, fracturing a kneecap.

An employee was disconnecting the electrical supply from a piece of equipment for removal and transport. When he returned to the machine after testing the source to be sure it did not have power and verifying that the disconnect was in an off position, the cut wires burst open from an arc flash that burned his face, left hand, and arm.

An employee was installing exterior handrails on the fourth floor of a multi-family residential building under construction when the employee fell approximately 40 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with leg and back injuries.

An employee was using a forklift to offload drywall. While sitting in the forklift, the forklift became unbalanced causing him to hit his head on the top rail, suffering a contusion to the top of his head.

An employee was attempting to unclog a flour build-up in the spout transition section of a flour distribution station when a rotary valve activated and amputated the distal joint of his right index finger.

An employee was washing off the machine wash rack area using a spray wand. He then started washing down the wash rack floor, stepping backwards while continuing to wash in a side to side motion. The pressure washer wand went across his left knee area; the water punctured his jeans and his skin just above the left knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking down a stairway, landing on the concrete floor at the bottom and suffering a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was going down a set of stairs when he stumbled on the bottom few steps and lost his balance. After taking a couple of steps to regain his balance on level ground, he bumped into another employee and fell to the ground on his left hip. He was hospitalized with a fracture to the left femur at the hip joint.
A temporary employee was changing the filter in a dust collector. A fan in the hose caught his finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was on a step ladder, placing an auto part on a shelf. He fell off the ladder and struck his head on the floor, suffering a head laceration. He was hospitalized.
An employee stepped off a single step, fell, and suffered a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was using his gloved fingers to clean out a gunite machine's feed wheel area when his glove was caught in a pinch point. The feed wheel then caught his left index and ring fingers, resulting in the medical amputation of his index finger and requiring surgery for his ring finger.

On 5/5/20, an employee was walking to his work station when he was struck by the tail of a forklift as it was making a three-point turn. He sustained a broken right leg and was hospitalized. The designated pedestrian walkway was not used at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to clear a jam on a tablet press when the machine became disengaged and the release pin came down and pinched his right middle finger, causing an avulsion.
An employee tripped over a cone used to indicate social distancing requirements and fell, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was operating an electric hand truck. The controls struck an upright on a storage rack; the employee's hand was caught and injured between the controls and the storage unit.

An employee was attempting to clear debris that was causing noise in a machine's dust collection system. His hand was inside the discharge chute when the dust collection blades partially amputated his right pinky, ring, and middle fingers at the first joint past the nail.

An employee was unloading a truck of medical supplies. As the employee lifted the truck's lift gate and the automatic dock plate, the employee's hand was caught between the lift gate and the dock. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the right hand second through fifth fingers, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was driving a pallet jack when it hit a shrink wrap machine. The employee suffered a broken right big toe and was hospitalized.
An employee opened a process lid to address a jam in a piece of equipment. The lid bounced back and closed, catching his right thumb and amputating the tip.

Three employees were cleaning a heater treater when a gas build-up caused an explosion in the building. Two of the employees received minor injuries; the third was hospitalized, having suffered a severe laceration across the forehead, burns to the face and neck, and a fractured spine.

An employee fell from a 10-foot A-frame ladder to the ground while descending. The employee's elbow hit a push cart and their head hit a metal cover on the floor resulting in a fractured elbow and stitches above the eyebrow.

An employee was installing a telephone pole. He backed up from the sidewalk and was stepping off the curb when he lost his balance. He tried to turn his body to catch himself when he landed face first on his side on the street. He suffered two fractured ribs and a bruised spleen.

An employee was attempting to cover a loaded dump truck with a tarp along with another employee on top of the dump bed when the wind caught the tarp and blew him off the top of the bed to the ground. He was hospitalized with a concussion and a laceration to the back of the head.
A product fell on an employee who was working on an order picker. The employee suffered neck and head injuries and was hospitalized on May 7, 2020.
An employee was cutting a piece of frozen meat with a band saw when his hand slipped and the blade cut his right little finger, causing a displaced fracture of the distal phalanx.

An employee was operating a loader when it backed over a hill. The employee was thrown from the loader and was hospitalized for a dislocated shoulder, three broken ribs, a cracked pelvis and a bleeding spleen.

An employee was leveling out trash and roofing debris inside a roll-off dumpster. Another employee picked up a piece of newly removed roofing debris and proceeded to dispose of it into same roll-off dumpster, hitting the injured employee on his right hand. He suffered injuries to his right wrist/forearm and the right side of his body.

An employee was operating a skid steer while another employee acted as a spotter. The two employees were talking, with the skid steer stopped; the machine jerked and its track struck the spotter, breaking her left tibia. She was hospitalized.

On May 6, 2020, at approximately 7:45 p.m., an employee stopped a lathe and pulled a nylon strap through the center of a 13-inch long, 8-inch diameter part. The nylon strap was attached to a jib crane, and the employee needed to jog the lathe to lock the chuck. The lathe did not jog and instead began running at operational speed. The employee's gloved right hand was caught between the nylon strap and rotating metal part, resulting in a broken thumb, severed nerves and tendons, and severe tissue damage to the hand.

On May 6, 2020, an employee was operating a metal shear to cut 2-inch strips of aluminum. He was attempting to catch the strips behind the shear so they would not fall on the floor. While his hand was behind the machine, the shear was actuated via the foot petal, causing the shear to come down on his left middle finger. His fingertip was amputated to approximately the end of the nail bed.
An employee walked into the back room and tripped over quick service restaurant equipment, fell, and injured her knee. She was hospitalized and had knee surgery.

An employee was mopping a restroom floor when her hand slipped from the mop handle and she lost balance and fell to the floor. She broke her left leg and was unable to stand, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was standing on a stack of cardboard, labeling and reviewing items to be moved when a stock order picker (equipment) came around the corner. When the employee saw the equipment approaching, she attempted to step down and ensure she was not in a hazardous situation with the equipment. She stepped on the side of a wheeled cart, causing the cart to move, and she lost her balance. She fell and hit her head on the concrete floor, suffering a subdural hematoma that required hospitalization.

At about 8:10 a.m. on May 6, 2020, an employee was running a low-pressure test line to a pressurized tank. The employee's foot got caught in the exhaust hoses and he fell, landing on his right hip and breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on shrink wrap and fell, her head striking an automatic dishwasher. She suffered a head injury, with a possible concussion.

An employee was in a bucket replacing an existing electrical pole. The employee became entangled in his lanyard. As he was untangling his lanyard, the bucket shifted. A powerline under tension and pulled around a jib frame, rolled up and off the jib frame as the bucket shifted. The power line acted like a rubber band and struck the employee. The employee was ejected from the bucket and fell about 32 feet to the ground. The employee suffered broken bones in both feet and a broken arm.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut a pipe for a slab conduit when the knife slipped off the pipe and lacerated the employee's right forearm.
An employee was driving a forklift in the warehouse freezer. When he came to a stop, he slid into the forks of another forklift and hit his left foot on the forks, causing a soft tissue injury.
An employee was cutting pork with a meat saw. The saw amputated his right index finger.

An employee stepped on a storm inlet grate that was not seated fully on the top flange after getting off equipment. The lid flipped in and the worker fell approximately 15 feet to the bottom of the inlet.  He was hospitalized with a dislocated shoulder and possible cracked vertebrae.
An employee was on a roof, caulking a chimney. He fell from the roof to the ground, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was at the loading dock ready to unload a truck. The employee manually picked up the lift dock plate with the assistance of the delivery driver. The delivery driver released too soon, which caused the plate to land on the employee's right pinky and ring fingers. Part of the pinky finger was amputated during the incident.

An employee was backing up from a trailer on his forklift when the pallets fell off the forks. He got off to place the pallets back on the forks. The forklift rolled forward and pinned him between the pallets on the forks and the I-beam under the trailer. He suffered a broken leg and ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was backing up a construction/utility vehicle. The corner of the vehicle's bucket caught a stack of three bales and tipped over the top bale. The bale struck the injured employee who was separating cardboard in the area, causing a broken leg and bruised ribs.
An employee was using a pipe to fill a 5-gallon bucket from a barrel containing chemical. The pipe broke, allowing chemical to splash and burn the employee's lower body.

An employee was removing a small piece of drywall that also had a ceramic tile attached. After it was removed from its metal stud framing, the material fell toward the floor, and the ceramic tile cut through his work boot and lacerated the top of his left foot.
An employee fell as he was descending a wet grassy slope, resulting in bilateral knee injuries requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a planer. The planer's blade touched his right thumb as he tried to pull out a piece of lumber, partially amputating the thumb.

An employee was rinsing down a tub wash machine in the off position with a water hose when he noticed a piece of plastic in the machine and turned it on. He was attempting to retrieve the plastic when the moving conveyor belt caught his glove and proceeded to cut his finger, resulting in an amputation to the left ring finger.
An employee was attempting to empty and depressurize kegs. As he removed the stem from a keg, the stem discharged into his face, fracturing his facial bones.
A delivery driver became dizzy and vomited, suffering from heat-related dehydration.

An employee was conducting wildlife surveys from a UTV. After attempting to dig out the UTV, she was climbing back into the vehicle and had her hand on the roll bar when her foot slipped off the step-up plate, causing a sudden sharp pain to her abdomen area. She was in severe pain and required hospitalization for a muscle injury.
While ringing out customers, an employee suffered an allergic reaction to latex from the gloves worn by customers.

An employee was working from an extension ladder at the edge of a high-ceilinged room. The ladder's feet slipped on the floor and it fell; the employee fell with it and landed on the concrete floor, also striking the ladder itself on the way down. The employee suffered a broken right femur, a broken right elbow, and lacerations to both legs, and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing an electrical system neutral when the wire came into contact with the energized side of an insulator, creating an arc flash. The employee received electrical burns to the hands and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing roofing work when he fell 12 to 15 feet through the roof and suffered a compound fracture in his arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a film cutting machine when his hand entered the machine's chute, resulting in an amputation to his right index finger.
An employee was pulling product when he stepped backward and tripped on a pallet on the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left wrist.

An employee was operating a scraper when the cushion hitch closed, restricting the shock-absorbing capabilities of the scraper loaded with soil. The employee hit an obscure bump on the haul road and as a result experienced a back injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was stepping into a vehicle at a customer site, holding a package she had just picked up. She fell to the ground, suffering a broken right femur.

On May 7, 2020, an employee was helping to set up a scaffold tower on ground level when the jacking system fell over and struck his right foot, resulting in the amputation of one toe. He was hospitalized.

An employee was gathering up work tools at the end of a work day when a piece of angle iron fell off dunnage and hit his ankle area. He was hospitalized and required surgery for broken bones in his ankle/leg area.
An employee was removing tooling from a hydraulic press brake when the brake came down on the employee's right hand, resulting in a partial amputation to the right ring finger.
An employee was attempting to lift a dock plate when his hand slipped from the handle. He fell backwards, lost his balance, and hit his head on the ground.

At approximately 6:30 p.m. on May 7, 2020, an employee was using a set of  5-foot high job-made wooden scaffolds, standing on a 2x10 plank, while nailing a floor joist overhead. He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, hitting his head. He experienced dizziness and was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was operating a foil cap insert machine when his hand entered the point of operation and the foil shear amputated his right ring fingertip.

An employee was changing out a paper roll set on a winder. The core chucks were being retracted, and he was clearing a piece of paper from them when the tip of his left index finger was caught in the wedge hole. As the chuck retracted into the outer cylinder, about a centimeter of the fingertip was sheared off.

An employee was prepping a piggyback air emergency spring brake chamber to later be placed on a truck in need on a service call.  To cage the spring and remove hazardous energy from the internals of the part, he supplied air pressure to compress the spring and then placed the caging bolt in the hole on the end to retain the spring.  When his finger was in the pinch point placing the nut on the caging bolt, the chamber lost air and actuated the spring with the bolt in it. His finger was then caught between the nut and the base of the chamber, causing skin removal and partial nail removal to his right index fingertip.

An employee had just delivered a 30-foot cantilever gate. He began re-strapping his remaining load while others unloaded the gate. The gate slipped out of the forks of a skid steer, tipped over, and struck the employee's legs from behind. Both his ankles were broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell forward. Her left shoulder struck a stacked pallet of gas meters, and her left humerus was broken.

An employee was rigging steel beams for unloading from a trailer when he tripped and fell from the trailer to the ground, landing on his left side. He suffered a fractured left elbow, laceration, and contusions to the head.

On May 07, 2020, at 8:30 a.m., an employee was operating a powered pallet jack when a co-worker operating another powered pallet jack struck his pallet jack, causing him to lose control of his pallet jack. He crashed into a rack, pinning his ankle between his pallet jack and the rack.
An employee was taking down a palm tree when he was struck by a tree limb, suffering three broken ribs.

On May 7, at approximately 10:24 AM, a temporary employee was standing on a platform while insulation was being rolled on a laminating machine's mandrel when his hand was pulled into the rotating mandrel. He suffered a cervical fracture in his neck and two fractured bones in his right arm, requiring hospitalization and neck surgery.

Employees were lowering the bottom half of a distribution box into an excavation when the shackles became caught on the notch outs. The load was re-rigged with wire to allow the box to be completely set into place. One of the shackles was stuck and the injured employee was trying to get it to break free. The wire broke before the shackle could be released, allowing the load to drop on the employee's foot and partially amputate the employee's left big toe.

A temporary employee was attempting to close a sliding warehouse door from the outside when a metal horizontal beam fell from the door framing and struck his left hand. His left ring finger was almost completely severed during the incident, which also broke his left pinky finger and caused a puncture wound.

On May 8, 2020, an employee was operating a lathe and polishing a tube using an emery cloth when the employee's right-hand glove came in contact with the rotating part and pulled the employee's hand into the lathe. As a result, the index and middle fingers on the right hand were amputated.
At approximately 1:45 p.m. on 5/8/2020, an employee was struck by a vehicle that entered a work zone on I-95.

An employee was adjusting a shim on an excavator arm to install a new pin. The employee asked the operator to lift the arm slightly. His fingers were then caught in a pinch point, resulting in the amputation of his index and middle fingertips.

On May 8, 2020, an employee was moving a finished core from an unwinder machine with a crane and attempting to set the core onto the slabbing table. The table flipped and the core struck the employee in the right shin, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was standing on a trailer looking at the motor of a construction loader when he fell backwards off the trailer onto the asphalt ground. He suffered two damaged neck vertebrae and a laceration to the back of the head.

An employee was welding in a manlift approximately 14 feet above the ground when the manlift pinned the employee against the bottom of an I-beam. He was hospitalized with a fractured jaw and neck injuries.
An employee was found on the floor after delivering his last package.
An employee was trying to remove the fifth wheel from the back of a truck when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
On May 8, 2020, an employee's foot became caught on the leg of a table. She tripped and fell, breaking her hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was reaching for rebar gathered in a trough on a rebar stretching machine when the employee's right ring fingertip was pinched as the trough actuated. The employee sustained a distal amputation on the right ring finger.
On May 8, 2020, an employee was using a maul hammer when part of the tool struck the employee's left pinky, causing crushing injuries and a pinky fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a scaffold 8 feet high and scooting from one area to another when one side of the scaffold fell into a drainage hole. The scaffold then began to tip over, and the employee jumped out of the scaffold. Upon landing on the ground, the employee fractured his left ankle, right tibia, and right fibula.

On 5/08/2020, at 09:30 AM, an employee was delivering concrete to a construction site and installing the metal chutes on his ready mix truck when his right two middle fingers were pinched between chutes. As a result, he sustained a partial traumatic transphalangeal amputation of his right middle finger.
An employee was inspecting his powered industrial vehicle (PIV) when another PIV struck him and he was caught between the two vehicles. He was hospitalized with a fractured hip.

An employee was checking the belts on a commercial truck when the operator started the truck while the employee's hand was in the belts. When the truck started, the employee's right hand became caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in the amputation of his right index finger and middle finger.

An employee was walking outside the premises of the main building. The soil foundation was loose and he stepped over vapor lines under the ground, resulting in his left leg getting burned from the calf down. He was hospitalized.

On May 8, 2020, at 10:30 AM, an employee was spraying a wasp nest with wasp spray. The nest then fell to the ground and she went to step on the nest. As she did this, she rolled her ankle and fell into the side of the building. She felt pain in her ankle and was hospitalized for three broken bones and a torn ligament in her foot.
An employee was setting a power pole when his right thumb tip was caught in the boom tip on a digger truck, partially amputating the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was trying to lift a dock plate into place with another employee when the employee lost balance and fell backward onto the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right hip requiring surgery.

An employee was drilling a hole on a pole during an inspection. When the employee pulled the drill out of the hole, the bit came off the drill and struck the employee on the face, resulting in a fractured jaw.
An employee was using a paper cutter. The cutter came down on the employee's left thumb, amputating the tip.
An employee was handling the lift gate of a company truck when his pinky finger was caught by the gate, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered a right index finger amputation while operating a chop saw, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working to remove a section of catwalk that was approximately 30 feet high when he stepped from the catwalk section being removed onto the assumed catwalk to be left in place. The planking of the catwalk bent, causing him to lose his balance and fall to the ground. He suffered a broken right arm.
While drilling a hole for installation of a dirt infiltration system, the machine became unbalanced and tipped over. The employee suffered a fractured foot.

An employee was adjusting a trailer dolly between two trailers. As the employee began to move the dolly from under the rear trailer, the weight of the trailer shot the dolly forward. The dolly hit and pushed the employee, who became pinned between the two trailers and injured his pelvis.
While walking through a doorway, an employee tripped over the threshold and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.

An employee initiated a machine to start a production cycle. His hand was in the path of the machine's closing guard, which closed on and caused the amputation of his left index finger's distal phalanx.

An employee was loading/securing equipment on a trailer when a bucket attachment moved and pinched his right hand between the bucket and an excavator boom, resulting in a partial amputation of his right ring finger.

On May 9, 2020, an employee was using an Allen wrench to tighten a manual lathe when the wrench slipped, resulting in his left ring finger hitting the lathe's blade. His fingertip was amputated. The lathe was not in operation at the time of the incident.
An employee was repairing a truck when an adjacent truck pulled away and ran over his right foot, breaking it. He was hospitalized.

An employee went to clean the belt of a trimmer on a machine that is used to make plastic bottles. The belt caught the rag, pulling his right index finger and pinching it in the equipment. As a result, he sustained a partial amputation of the right index fingertip (no bone loss).

An employee was cleaning around an airlock on a blower system when the employee's fingers were struck by the moving paddles, resulting in the amputation of the right middle and ring fingers to the first knuckle.
An employee was on a ladder trimming a tree when he slipped and fell from the ladder, landing on his back. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was troubleshooting an electrical circuit in an electrical cabinet at the base of a wind turbine when an arc flash occurred, causing second degree burns to the employee's right hand.
An employee was working on a roof when wind blew the employee 30 feet across the roof and 18 feet off of it. The employee suffered a broken wrist, fractured leg, and torn knee.
An employee was driving a forklift when it struck pallets loaded on another forklift. The pallets hit the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was kneeling down prepping towable vacuum equipment to connect to grooving equipment. When he stood up, he lost his balance, fell forward, and struck the right side of his face on the hitch of the grooving equipment. He was hospitalized with a face injury.
An employee was operating a pick cart when the employee turned and fell onto the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a severe hip injury.
An employee was cutting cilantro with a knife. The knife partially amputated his left thumb.

An employee was using a foot-actuated stamping press when she lost her balance and leaned forward. Her hand then entered the point of operation while the actuating pedal was being pressed. The press crushed her left pinky finger, resulting in an amputation at or just above the distal joint.
On May 11, 2020, an employee was feeding panels into a double end tenoner when the blade cut her left hand/fingers.
An employee was unloading a general merchandise truck when he experienced chest pains. He was hospitalized with a heart attack.

An employee was clearing grass along a ditch using a side-by-side mower. One of the mower's tires went into the ditch line, causing the mower to flip. It struck the employee in the back, injuring two lumbar vertebrae. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a side plate's coupon feeder when the side plate retracted back to the home position, catching his right middle finger between the slide plate and a roller. As a result, the employee's right middle finger was amputated.
An employee experienced breathing difficulty while smoke jumping and was hospitalized.
An employee experienced an amputation of his right arm while operating a cable stripper on 05/11/20 at 5:15 p.m.
While operating a straddle machine, an employee attempted to make a right turn when the straddle tipped over. The employee sustained a left arm fracture.

An employee was helping to restrain a combative patient in an emergency room. The patient attacked and fell backwards onto the employee's left leg, causing a fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking along the dock, scanning bar codes, when a forklift backed up and struck him. He suffered a fractured pelvis.
While preparing work on a tubular welded scaffold, an employee fell approximately 15 feet from the scaffold to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
On May 11, 2020, an employee was operating a drill press while wearing a glove. The employee's glove became caught on the rotating chuck, resulting in a thumb amputation.

An employee was preparing to fill a truck up with water at a water station. The truck had a 3-inch cam lock and when the employee attempted to make a connection, the hose popped off, striking the employee in the face with approximately 700 PSI. The employee sustained a concussion, broken nose, and facial lacerations, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was climbing a fixed ladder while carrying plastic to place the plastic over a hole on the roof that was leaking due to a storm. He slipped and fell approximately 12 feet off the ladder to a lower level, fracturing his right wrist and right hip.
An employee was repairing an industrial powered truck when the hydraulics failed, causing the lift carriage to fall onto his back.

An employee was replacing forks on a warehouse forklift truck. The employee was standing in front of the forklift, facing the forklift carriage. He lifted the pin on top of the carriage fork holder and was installing the fork. His co-worker, who was sitting in the forklift, operated the control lever and pinched the employee's left thumb between the carriage and the fork, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

An employee was in the process of turning a coil on the mill when he attempted to push the coil behind a safety gate. The coil then uncoiled, catching his left thumb between the safety gate and the coil. As a result, his left thumb was partially amputated.

An employee was in the in the rear of a bucket truck making up material when another employee aloft in the bucket began to lower the basket to its cradled position. The employee in the back of the truck was struck on the right shoulder by the bottom of the basket, which caused forward momentum and positioned him between the basket rest and the basket as it came to its resting position. He suffered five broken ribs on the right side of his abdomen and a hemopneumothorax.
An employee was cutting a piece of Styrofoam on a table saw when his left hand came in contact with the table saw blade, cutting three fingers.
An employee was driving a forklift when a bale of dry waste fell onto his leg, causing a compound fracture.
An employee was walking up stairs that went over a conveyor. The employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken right upper arm, a head injury, and an injury to the left little finger.

An employee was doing a pre-check of the warehouse when he heard something metal coming down the screen. He opened the airlock and was investigating with his hand when the airlock fan blade amputated three of his fingers.

An employee was a team member inspecting an aircraft hangar. While opening the hangar doors, the employee's hand was caught between one of the hangar door panels and a support beam, resulting in a laceration and broken fingers.
While walking, an employee's legs gave out and the employee fell to the floor, suffering severe facial contusions and a broken nose.
An employee was unloading a railcar. Product collapsed and fell on the employee, who suffered multiple fractures.

After repairing an AC unit on top of a lab area, an employee was descending a ladder when the ladder brace came loose. He fell off the ladder to the ground, hitting his head on the cement floor and suffering head trauma.
Two employees were working in a manhole within a roadwork zone. A vehicle crossed into the work zone and struck the employees. One of them suffered multiple fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking through a set of double doors. As she was closing the door, her right pinky finger was caught between the door and the frame, causing a laceration that resulted in a partial finger amputation.
A temporary employee was trying to dislodge a keyboard that had fallen onto a machine. The machine amputated the employee's fingertip.

A commercial driver was opening the doors of a trailer when a bundle of insulation fell out from the trailer, knocking the driver to the ground. The driver suffered injuries to multiple body parts (including rib and ankle fractures) and was hospitalized.

Two employees were replacing a cover on a compact trench system. While they were dropping the cover in, one employee's left middle and ring fingers were pinched. Both fingers were broken, and the middle fingertip was amputated. The employee underwent surgery.
An employee was operating a concrete saw. The saw kicked back and landed on his foot, causing a laceration to the top of the foot that required surgery.
An employee was unloading grain from a transport trailer when the employee slipped and fell off the top of the trailer to the dirt ground. The employee was hospitalized with a shattered hip.

An employee was placing material into a metal folding press to be fabricated when the operating pedal was engaged before her hand was out of the way of the moving parts. Her hand was caught in the machine, resulting in one broken bone in her right middle finger and one broken bone in her right ring finger. She was hospitalized.

An employee was feeding a panel saw and holding the boards to be cut. The employee's left thumb was pinched between the pressure beam of the saw and the stack of wood, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was testing an electrical line. The termination point of the line shocked the employee.
An employee entered a forklift. When he engaged it, his right leg got caught in a strap (used to secure cargo to the floor of the forklift truck) and was broken.

An employee was climbing a 6-foot step ladder to access the back of a flatbed crash truck. He realized he needed to move the ladder and climbed down. As he stepped down to the first step, he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, twisting and landing on his hip. He suffered a fracture at the top of a femur.

The injured employee was setting a truss about 10 feet high on a residential building. He was working with two other employees. The truss was not going into the right position and when one of the employees pushed it, the injured employee, who was grabbing the truss, lost his balance and fell to the floor, fracturing his hip. The employee required surgery.

An employee was shutting down a piece of equipment. He removed a bin and was brushing debris off the equipment when his left hand was drawn into the roto-lock. His index and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was working on a painter's scaffold, 4.5 feet off the floor, demolishing a wall made of steel and plaster. A wall part shifted and knocked him off the scaffold to the floor. He suffered fractures to a tibia and a small bone in the ankle.
A rail car technician was compressing springs. When he released the spring from the press cage, the bolt released from the lower seat of the spring and hit his throat, injuring it.
An employee put a piece of metal into a shearing machine. The machine caught his left hand, crushing the index and middle fingers.
An employee was picking up a load. While walking from his truck to the security check-in area, he tripped and fell, suffering two broken ribs and a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was taking out old parts of a 690-volt electrical panel. When the employee removed one of the panel's doors and placed it next to the live side of the panel, an arc flash burned both of the employee's hands. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was approaching the exit end of an automated and fully enclosed shot machine. A spring that was discharging jammed between the discharge pusher and the discharge transfer plate. The spring unjammed suddenly. Due to the excess force created between the discharge pusher and the discharge transfer plate, the spring shot out of the machine to the stop plate, a distance of approximately 8 feet. At that exact moment, the employee's hand was near the discharge table and the spring struck the employee's right arm, catching it between the spring and the stop plate. The employee suffered broken bones to the lower right arm (wrist area) as well as severed tendons and nerves.
An employee was moving a mule from one pasture to another when the animal spooked and ran her over, breaking her left femur.

An employee was attempting to mount the step to the cab of a moving backhoe when he lost his balance. He then fell between the tractor and the wheel, and the wheel ran over both of his legs. Both legs were severely injured and possibly broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee was servicing a lift truck for a customer at the costumer's site when the employee collided with a stationary object and suffered a broken foot.
An employee suffered a hand amputation while operating a saw.

An employee was transferring the material he was running from one spindle on a winder to another spindle when the cutting function on the machined failed to cut through the material. He crawled underneath the spindle within the winder and attempted to cut through the film with a knife. His hand slipped and then his left wrist was wedged between the film and the roller, resulting in bilateral wrist and finger injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was on a roof looking for leaks when the employee fell through a roof skylight to the concrete floor, suffering a broken arm and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee turned off a lathe machine, opened it, and used a push bar to push material into the lathe. The push bar was still in the machine when the lathe was reactivated. The push bar was then thrown into the employee's head, fracturing the skull. The lathe was unguarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was holding/monitoring the purging "pigging" of a concrete pumping hose after testing. The hose began flailing and struck the employee in the face, causing face, jaw, cheek, and nose injuries/lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack that had glass on one side and was empty on the other side. When the pallet jack came to a stop, the glass shifted, came off the rack, and struck the employee, pinning him against another rack of glass. The employee suffered a head injury.

An employee was installing solar panel mounting supports on the roof of a commercial building when the anchor he was tied off to ripped out of its seam, causing him to fall 20 to 25 feet to the asphalt below. He suffered brain swelling, a collapsed lung, and paralysis.
An employee was assembling a table. While making adjustments on top of the table, he fell from the table and struck a rebar, which impaled him.

An employee was laying brick while working on a scaffold. The employee tripped and fell 20 feet from the scaffold to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken femur and tissue damage to the leg, as well as an injury to the rotator cuff, and cuts and scrapes.

An employee was attempting to start an extruder. The extruder would not start, so the employee grabbed the belt to pull and rotate the motor with his right hand. Four of his right fingertips were then pulled by the belt into the pulleys, resulting in the amputation of the four fingers.

On May 13, 2020, an employee was operating a metal lathe. The employee inserted a metal pry bar into the chuck of the lathe to spin the tool while cleaning its end with an emery pad. The spinning tool caught and partially amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee in the parking lot suffered an amputation of the end of the pinky finger up to the first joint below the fingernail when a coworker closed a car door on the injured employee's finger.

An employee was helping move a portable scaffold on wheels. The scaffold struck a parked forklift, and the scaffold railing amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingertips. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to have the fingertips reattached.
An employee was operating a skid loader. While his feet were resting outside the front of the cab, he lowered the bucket, which then pinched and broke both of his feet.
An employee was performing maintenance and starting a gas plant by turning the valves when a flash fire and explosion occurred. He suffered burn injuries to his hands and face.
An employee fell from the top of a stack of paper rolls, landing 11 feet below and breaking his right hip in three places.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder and landed about 20 feet below, hitting a skylight on the way down. He suffered a broken left tibia and fibula.

An employee was flagging traffic as part of an equipment road crossing effort. The employee had successfully stopped the first vehicle when a second vehicle approached the traffic control scene behind the first. The second vehicle suddenly swerved to the right, contacted the first vehicle, and then struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with broken legs and a broken back.
An employee was using a knife to cut open a box when the knife severely lacerated the employee's abdomen.
An employee was struck in the back by a falling bale of boxes.

An employee was using a grease gun to grease a wood chipper turret. The chipper was spun, and the employee's right index finger was pinched in a grease outlet hole on the chipper. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a roll-up door in the maintenance shop when he noticed that the chain was loose on top, so he placed a ladder next to the door to climb up and fix it. The ladder was placed on the bottom lip of the garage door. The employee asked another employee to push the button to have the door roll up so he could monitor the movement of the door/chain. As the door rolled up, it pushed on the ladder, causing the employee to fall. He struck the ladder, a nearby object, and the concrete floor, injuring his back, side, leg, and arm.
An employee was loading a mold into a vise to saw off an eye bolt when the vise closed on the employee's finger, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.

An employee was struck by a car while crossing the street to retrieve a trash tote. The employee was hospitalized with a head/brain injury; a broken back, leg, ankle, knee, and forearm; and broken ribs.
An employee was servicing an ice maker. His knee gave out and he fell to the floor, breaking his right hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift and got off the lift to pick some product when another employee got on the forklift and backed up over his foot. He suffered broken toes and required stitches.
An employee was retrieving a tape measure from a roof. The roof was wet and the employee slipped and fell to the ground 10-12 feet below. The employee suffered a broken kneecap.

On May 13, 2020, an employee's left little finger was caught between a metal bale (a device used for lifting, carrying, and rolling boxes) and a pattern box with a sand core inside it. The fingertip was crushed, resulting in its amputation.
An employee fell from a flatbed trailer, suffering right facial fractures, a cervical spine fracture, a right cheek abrasion, a forehead laceration, and paralysis.

An employee was tightening a nut on a polished rod's 2-bolt clamp on a horse head while standing on a well head cap 2 feet off ground when the employee slipped and fell back, hitting a concrete block. The employee suffered a head contusion.
An employee was operating a blender in a kitchen production area. The employee was removing a stuck piece of chicken when a paddle inside the machine pinched off the tip of the employee's left thumb.
An employee was setting 20 lb. charcoal bags at a Publix supermarket when the employee felt dizzy and fell to the floor, suffering a cracked rib and minor cuts to the face and hands.

An employee was operating an auto-tarp before dumping a 40-yard open top container. A tarp arm struck him in the face, causing facial fractures, head contusions, cervical fractures, and swelling in his spinal column. He was hospitalized.
An employee was slicing a ham on a table saw when the ham flipped in his hand and his hand came in contact with the blade, amputating his right index fingertip.
An employee was setting up a fence line machine. A moving part of the machine pinned the employee's knees together at the exit table, breaking the employee's right leg and causing nerve damage.
An employee was driving an ATV when the ATV tipped over while making a sharp turn. As a result, the employee suffered broken bones to the left leg.

An employee was repairing an elevated conveyor belt that had separated and stopped turning on the rollers. He repaired the belt and re-energized the system. The belt still did not move properly, and he moved to view the mechanism from a different angle. The belt caught his left hand and pulled it into the roller mechanism. The employee's left hand was crushed and degloved.
An employee was leaving the kitchen after putting water away when the kitchen door slammed on the employee's left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was repairing equipment with the aid of a hoist. Another employee accidentally made contact with the hoist controller, causing the hoist to rise and amputated the first employee's finger.

An employee was cutting trim on a miter saw when her finger contacted the blade. She sustained a deep laceration with an open fracture to the right second finger. The finger was surgically amputated at the hospital.
An employee was doing roof work. The employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken collarbone, a broken sternum, a fractured spine, and slight amnesia.

An employee was lowering a component onto a welding table using a crane when the employee's left small finger was caught between the load and the table, resulting in a fracture and partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting concrete with a chop saw when the saw kicked back, caught his shirt, and pulled him into the saw. The blade severely lacerated his neck, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was operating a forklift when material wrapped around the employee's leg and forklift, resulting in a broken ankle/leg.

On May 14, 2020, at approximately 1:00 p.m., an employee was operating a dispensing machine fed by a moving conveyor belt. As the employee attempted to retrieve material from the conveyor, the employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated by the moving belt and pulley.

An employee was placing angle iron pieces on a dolly the long way. He placed his hand on the load and his other hand on the handle of the dolly. As he was moving the load, the load shifted and smashed his right index finger between the load and the handle, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was training on how to clean off the wire of an auto-tie baler. His right hand was between two pieces of the frame on the machine when the baler cycled and caught his gloved right hand, causing a laceration and open hand fracture. He was hospitalized and had hand surgery.

An employee was standing on the step outside a truck, leaning into the cab to wire a harness, when he fell to the ground. He sustained damage to a previously implanted hip replacement, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was on a silage pile to roll down side walls and weigh them down with tires. A tire rolled downward, striking him in the face. He suffered a damaged ligament in the neck.
An employee was spotting for a forklift driver. His left hand was caught and crushed between the forklift's mast and a crate. Four of the fingers were injured and required surgery.

An employee was driving a forklift when it struck a structural steel column, which separated the mast from the forklift. The right side of the employee's skull struck a front support post in the forklift cabin, and the employee suffered a neck fracture and a concussion.

An employee was doing maintenance on a circular head saw blade splitter. The employee was straightening the splitter with an adjustable wrench and cheater pipe extension. The wrench slipped off the splitter, causing the employee to fall backwards onto a platform and suffer a dislocated/fractured right ankle.
An employee was pulling electrical wiring for a new sub-station under construction when a flash occurred. The employee sustained flash burns and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered an amputation of the right index finger and partial amputation of the right thumb while attempting to unjam a bagger machine. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was driving a double pallet jack. The pallet jack struck a steel racking system as it went around a corner, and the employee suffered a fractured pelvis and vertebrae.
An employee was operating air-powered manufacturing equipment when the employee's left middle finger was caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a cable-cutting machine to cut wires. The wires got caught inside the machine, and the employee was trying to get them unstuck when the machine cycled and amputated the employee's middle and index fingertips. The machine was unguarded at the time.
While moving breakfast trays, an employee tripped on a doorframe and fell to the floor, fracturing the right hip.

A temporary employee was driving a golf cart when it struck a steel beam. The beam broke through the golf cart's windshield, hitting him in the chest and then landing on his legs. He was hospitalized and required stitches (no broken bones).
An employee was replacing a hot water tank. Sharp metal on the tank cut the employee's right ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was manually putting cardboard into a baler when he stepped backwards into the pathway of a forklift and was struck by the forklift's load. He sustained a broken left hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a roof access hatch ladder. About halfway down, he fell, landing on the ground about 8 feet below. He suffered a broken left femur and was hospitalized.
An employee hit something while mowing a lawn, causing his leg to break.

An employee was operating a stand-on mower. His right foot went under the mowing deck while the blades were rotating. His second toe was degloved and he suffered cuts on his third and fourth toes that required stitches. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a chainsaw on the ground to create a notch in the tree. He had completed the face cut and begun to make the undercut when his foot slipped and the chainsaw's chain lacerated his right thumb. He was hospitalized.

An employee was hydraulic hand-sawing on a concrete wall when the diamond-tipped blade made contact with a wood beam. The saw handle kicked back and knocked the employee off a 4-foot baker's scaffold. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee lost balance while putting on and standing up on a pair of drywall stilts. The employee fell from the stilts and broke an arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell to the ground while ascending a ladder, fracturing the left tibia.
While carrying boxes filled with plumbing stock, an employee tripped and fell. His left elbow struck the floor and was shattered.
An employee was cutting a willow tree branch (12-14" diameter) when the branch snapped and came down on the employee. He suffered lacerations to the head and right kidney.

On May 15, 2020, an employee was moving equipment between a truck and the shop. While stepping off the truck bumper to the shop floor, the employee landed awkwardly and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip and pelvis.

An employee was using an overhead hoist to lift an assembly (tire and rim) that was still attached to a mounting machine. When the employee lifted the assembly, it caused the machine to lift as well, so the employee unlocked the assembly. At that time, the mounting machine fell on the employee's left foot, crushing it.
An employee was removing flanges with a piece of equipment. A crane moved the equipment, causing it to wedge the employee's little finger against the concrete floor. The fingertip was amputated.
While driving a forklift, an employee hit a pothole and lost control. The forklift overturned and the employee sustained a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down from the third rung of an 8-foot ladder while installing electrical wiring, sustaining a bump and laceration that required stitches to the head.

An employee was adjusting a bundle of material that he had loaded on a trailer. He was using a crane to raise one end of the bundle (to slide a block under it) when the bundle slipped off the crane's chain and pinched his hand. His left index finger was amputated.
An employee was working at a paper machine winder, cutting plastic and using a razor. The winder caught his right index finger, causing an amputation above the knuckle.
An employee was walking in an office when she fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was operating a forklift truck when he turned to check his blind spot. As he did, he placed his right hand on the chassis of the forklift. While he was traveling in reverse, his pinky finger was pinched between the chassis and a truck, resulting in a surgical amputation of the finger.
