An employee was installing a square duct while standing on an 8-foot A-frame stepladder when he lost his balance and fell to the ground. He required stitches on his left eyebrow area and broke his left wrist and T12 vertebra.

An employee was walking in the hallway to give out medication to patients when she slipped on wet cereal residue that was spilled on the floor and fell on her knee. She fractured her right patella and was hospitalized.

An employee was on an extension ladder affixed to a telecommunications strand. The strand failed and the employee fell to the ground 15-18 feet below. The employee suffered broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung.

A maintenance employee was fixing a refrigerator diffuser in a produce cooler that was leaking water. The produce cooler has dock doors for truck deliveries. The employee was squeegeeing the water out of the produce cooler when he slipped on the water and fell off the dock onto the concrete below. He suffered a broken hip.

A fire sprinkler pipe burst or became detached from an anchor, causing large pieces of piping to fall. A falling piece of the pipe stuck the employee in the shoulder and head. The employee suffered broken ribs, a broken sternum, a heart injury, two punctured lungs, and a crushed back vertebra that caused paralysis from the chest down.

An employee was on the ground, trying to get a pallet jack unstuck from under a pallet. Another employee was trying to pry it loose using a forklift. One of the forks on the forklift popped up, hitting the bottom of the first employee's right foot and breaking his heel. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was sitting on a four-legged chair in the break room. When she stood up from the chair, her foot became caught under one of the chair's legs and she tripped, falling to the ground on her right side. She was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a table saw when the wood kicked back and pulled his hand toward the blade, resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
An agent was arresting a fugitive that was in a car. When the fugitive was told to get out of the car, he shot the agent in the right hip.

On May 15, 2020, an employee was carrying empty carboard boxes to place them in a metal crate used to transport the cardboard. After placing the cardboard on the metal crate, she turned to walk away and her pant leg became caught on a piece of metal wire sticking out about 1 inch from the crate's corner. She then fell on the floor and fractured her left hip, requiring hospitalization.
An employee's left hand contacted the moving parts of a braiding machine, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation (no bone loss).

An employee was assigned with cleaning around the facilities near the fuel islands at a truck stop. While closing the door to an out building, the employee's right fifth digit (pinky) was caught in the door jamb, which ripped his nail and most of the finger off.

An employee was installing insulation while standing on a scaffold when the employee lost balance and fell 6 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured nose and fractures to both wrists, requiring surgery.

An employee was cutting meat on a meat saw. He slipped on a piece of fat on the ground and fell; his right middle finger came into contact with the blade and he suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

At about 5:40 a.m. on May 16, 2020, an employee fell while walking into work. The employee's face struck the concrete, causing a head contusion and a laceration above the right eye.  The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the belt on a capper machine. The drive belt caught and lacerated the employee's right ring finger.

An employee was tasked with removing sweet potato plants from a trailer to be planted in the field. While the employee was climbing on the side of the parked trailer, the top side bracing bar of the trailer came off and the employee fell approximately 1 foot to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured back.
An employee was lowering the upper die on a brake press to bend a steel cart leg (6-8" long) when the upper die came down on the employee's left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On May 15, 2020, employees were installing drywall sheets, and one employee had his weight on a stack of about 12 sheets piled up against wall studs, when one of the sheets broke. The rest came down on his right knee and broke his right tibia. He was hospitalized.

An employee was giving hand signals to a forklift operator who was lowering a wacker packer into an elevator pit. The forklift operator had boomed out toward the elevator pit when the back wheels of the forklift lifted off the ground. The injured employee was standing on ground level on the other side of the pit. The forklift bucket then hit him at about shoulder level and traveled down his side, pushing him to the ground and coming to a rest on his leg. He suffered a broken ankle, torn ligaments and other damage to his knee, three broken ribs, and a fractured sternum.
An employee was using a chop saw when the blade amputated the second and third fingers of the employee's left hand.
An employee was cleaning a slicer when she leaned forward and her apron became caught on the start knob. The slicer then amputated her right pointer and middle fingertips.
An employee was cutting boneless meat on a boneless meat band saw when the blade amputated the employee's right index finger to the end of the nail.

An employee was walking while conducting housekeeping activities when her shoes became caught on the floor. She tripped and fell, striking and fracturing her right hip and the neck of her right femur.

An employee was removing a steel plate to deliver materials. A pin fell out of the steel plate and the plate fell onto the employee's lower body. The employee sustained a broken leg, pelvis, ribs, and arm.

An employee was climbing down a ladder on a tanker truck. The pneumatic guardrail system on the top of the truck retracted and struck the employee. The employee fell to the ground, suffering broken bones.

An employee was cutting pork loins on a bandsaw in the deli. While positioning the meat, the employee's hand slipped and contacted the blade. The employee suffered a lacerated right index finger and fingernail avulsion.
An employee was working to clear a clogged machine. When he opened the fitting to clear the clog, 190-degree water entered his glove, causing burns to his left forearm.

An employee was setting highway cones on pavement from the back of a cone/attenuator truck. As the employee finished setting the cones, he placed his hand on the support bracket of the truck-mounted attenuator. At the same time, the driver of the cone truck began to retract the attenuator. The employee's right middle fingertip was then caught and smashed between the attenuator and the support bracket, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning material off a concrete block push-off machine. The pusher cycled and crushed his right arm against the guide, removing skin.
An employee was adjusting a bellypan conveyor belt when his right arm was caught by and pulled into the moving conveyor belt, trapping his arm and causing severe damage to the right arm muscle.

A maintenance employee was installing a lift cylinder on an iron. While he was aligning the lift cylinder bolt hole and a roller, the roller moved and his right thumb was caught between the roller and lift cylinder bolt hole. As a result, he sustained a fractured right thumb.
An employee was running to stop a shopping cart that that was rolling toward parked vehicles. She fell to the concrete/asphalt ground, suffering a broken jaw and shoulder.
After driving and delivering product, an employee returned from a customer site and experienced cramps that did not go away. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee was bringing shopping carts into the warehouse and began to separate two carts that were together. When the carts separated, a cart tailgate fell and pinched his right ring finger, resulting in a medical fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a tug when the door to the tug blew shut on the employee's finger. The employee's left ring finger was caught between the tug and the door, resulting in an amputation to the finger.
An employee was operating a repacking machine. The machine amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was cutting flashing on a machine when the flashing stabbed his hand between the index finger and thumb, cutting a tendon. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was in the process of tightening a winch line when his right index fingertip was severed between the winch line and a bracket.
An employee was sorting packages on a caster dock when he fell from the dock to the floor below. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

An employee was on two ladders that were tied together to power wash the side of a house. As he was trying to reach the roof, the ladders collapsed and he fell four feet to the ground. The fallen ladders landed on top of him. The employee suffered multiple fractures.

An employee was operating a machine in automatic mode. Copper and scrap material built up in the machine and the employee used his left hand to clear the copper and scrap. When the copper and scrap was removed, the machine cycled and the employee's left index finger was caught between a copper tube and the machine. As a result, the employee's left index finger was fractured. The machine was running at the time of the incident.

On May 18, 2020, a nurse was leaving a home after caring for a patient. She fell to the floor of the home's porch, suffering a hairline fracture to her jaw and an injury to her left leg resulting in damage to an artery. She was hospitalized.

An employee was directing a tug operator to connect the tug to a dolly with mail. The tug operator mistakenly reversed instead of pulling forward, causing the employee's left leg to be pinned between the tug and the dolly. He suffered a puncture wound to his lower left leg.
While cleaning material with a power washer, an employee slipped on a wet surface and struck the edge of a press machine, suffering fractured ribs and contusions.
An employee was helping to lift a steel road plate when the plate pinched his finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On May 18, 2020, at approximately 10:15 a.m., an employee was helping another employee cut sheet aluminum and when his left thumb entered the shear at the same time that the other employee stepped onto the lever. The shear then amputated the employee's left thumb tip.

Two employees were using a propane-powered saw indoors to cut concrete. They began to feel sick, stopped work, and went to the doorway for some fresh air. One of them lost consciousness and was hospitalized, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning.

An employee was performing controls maintenance on an HVAC unit. While stepping down from working on top of an air handler and onto an A-frame ladder, he fell off the fourth ladder step and injured his left wrist while attempting to break his fall.
An employee was cutting block outs for concrete forms with a worm drive saw when the saw kicked back and cut the employee's left hand, resulting in a left pinky finger amputation.
An employee was pressure-washing an AC unit on a guard shack roof. The employee fell to the ground 12 to 15 feet below, suffered a broken leg, a broken arm, and a broken finger.

An employee was adjusting the plates on an in-ground vehicle lift. As he was sliding the plates, his thumb entered one of the holes in the plate and was pinched, resulting in an amputation to his right thumb tip.

An employee was inside a cage elevated by a forklift cleaning out gutters. The forklift began to roll down the hill and then tipped over. The employee struck the ground and suffered fractures to the back, abdomen and neck.

An employee climbed on top of a roll-off trash container to remove some debris. As he went to get down from the container, he lost his balance and fell 5 feet to the asphalt ground. He was hospitalized with fractures to his right hip and pelvic bone.
An employee was working on a hospital bed when the bed frame collapsed on the employee's left hand, causing lacerations and a possible fracture.
An employee was working with a crew of three people to repair a metal roof. He fell through a flat, corrugated translucent fiberglass panel, suffering injuries.

On May 19, 2020, at 1:30 p.m., an employee was guiding a commercial sign into position when the sign dropped from the rigging used by a boom truck crane to raise and position the sign. The sign struck his left foot, breaking multiple bones and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was trying to open the sealer bar on a piece of bagging equipment, which had closed in the down position due to low air pressure. The sealer bar closed on the employee's right index finger, causing a partial fingertip amputation (halfway down the nail, with no bone loss).

Two employees were installing vent pipe and supports on top of a bulk storage tank. There was an explosion in the tank causing the employee working on the tank roof to fall from the tank to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured shoulder. The second employee was in an aerial lift at the roof line when the tank exploded. The second employee did not fall, but sustained flash burns to the face and arms.
An employee was loading a commercial water tank onto a truck using a stair climber dolly. The tank slipped and the employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was looking through a warehouse for missing parts. The employee tripped over some spools of electrical wire and suffered a broken right ankle.

An employee was clearing straws from a wrapping hopper. A transfer belt (which fed straws from the extruder machine to the wrapping hopper) made contact with the employee's right middle finger, amputating the tip just above the first knuckle

An employee was removing surface rust on a lathe machine's shaft when the employee's cut-resistant glove became caught in the lathe machine and pulled the employee's arm into the machine. The employee sustained a broken hand and arm.

An employee was replacing cooling fan motors in a switch gear. When he leaned in to install the fan, his right arm came into contact with an energized coil. He received electrical burns to the right arm.
An employee was climbing down a ladder from a trailer. He fell to the ground, his head striking a girder as he fell. He suffered a broken right hip socket.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake while cleaning up construction debris.
An employee was moving a truck dolly when it pinned the employee's left hand, causing a laceration that required surgery.

An employee was driving a commercial truck on public roadways while hauling poles and equipment for installation of electric utilities.  The truck's brakes did not hold the load while descending very steep terrain in a mountainous area. The truck crashed into the back of other vehicles and the employee was seriously injured, requiring hospitalization for head and other bodily trauma.
An employee was cutting lumber with a skill saw. The sawblade lacerated his left hand.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood when the blade contacted his left hand between the thumb and forefinger causing a laceration.
An employee was adjusting an operator seat in a ramp tug. The wind blew a door shut on the employee's finger. The fingertip was amputated.

A temporary employee was servicing a waste container while at the operator position on the back of a garbage truck. As he tried to grab the container with his hand, he leaned onto a hydraulic lever that activated the trash sweeper blade, which crushed his hand. This condition resulted in the surgical amputation of his right hand.
An employee parked a reach truck at the battery recharging station, fell and struck his head on a battery charger. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration, concussion, and a fractured nose.
An employee suffered a hernia while lifting a package weighing over 70 pounds. He was hospitalized.

An employee picked up a hose and walked backward into a trench where the metal grate covers had been removed for water extraction. He fell into the trench, injuring his lower left leg and requiring surgery.

Two employees were using a golf cart to transit from one production building to the other when the golf cart veered off the road and turned over into a ditch. The cart landed on one employee's right leg, breaking it in several places.
On May 20, 2020, an employee was mopping a restaurant floor. As he was wringing the mop in the bucket, he slipped, fell, and broke his left hip. He hospitalized.

An employee was operating a processing line. He was moving to insert a drain plug into a hopper, below an auger, when his left middle finger slipped into the drain hole. The auger amputated his fingertip.
A sales person was walking down a city street while coming from or going to a customer's business/home when a man robbed and shot the employee in the stomach. The employee required surgery.
An employee fell from a flatbed trailer to the ground. The employee suffered a broken skull, with brain bleeding, and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a dock with another employee when his hand was caught between the dock board and a pipe, incurring severe lacerations that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell off a moving pallet of potatoes. The employee's right side struck the ground, and the employee's right hip was broken.

An employee was standing on a ladder in the spa section of an empty pool, installing a screen enclosure. The ladder shifted and he fell into the deep section of the pool, hitting the concrete floor and suffering a broken femur and two broken wrists.
An employee who was cleaning slipped on soap that was on the floor from soap draining from the walls and pipes. The employee fell on top of a motor and fractured four ribs.
An employee was maneuvering a piece of melamine material through a table saw. The employee's hand came into contact with the spinning sawblade, which cut his hand and finger.
An employee was operating a filler machine when her left index finger was punctured by a screw/pin on the machine's moving piston.
An employee was testing a gauge when a stream of hydraulic fluid came out the side of a connection and penetrated his finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was counting wire harnesses when the employee tripped over a wire harness that was hanging over the edge of a barrel. The employee fell to the concrete ground on their right side and suffered a collapsed lung, requiring hospitalization.

At about 2:50 p.m. on May 20, 2020, an employee was loading broth from a holding tank into a tanker trailer in an animal feed department. As the trailer became full, the employee began to remove the load hose from the trailer connection and was sprayed by the broth, suffering burns to the right arm, the torso, and the right side of the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's left thumb tip was caught and amputated in the door of a CNC machine.
An employee was securing wooden trusses on a newly constructed pole barn when a truss fell, causing the employee to fall from heights. The employee was hospitalized with back injuries.

An employee was power-washing a concrete drive. Water from the high-pressure power washer tore through his clothes and cut deeply into the skin, muscle, and ligaments of his leg and knee. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the dressing wheel on a grinder. The rag he was using fell between the wheels and pulled his left hand into the wheel. The finger was cut down to the first joint.
An employee was operating a meat saw. The saw blade flipped the piece of meat and sliced off the tip of the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was replacing an 80-pound grating over a hole when he dropped the grating on his right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving a piece of board through a jointer. The employee's left middle finger made contact with the blade; the employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

On May 20, 2020, at approximately 7:15 PM, an employee was removing an aggressive client to a seclusion room when the client kicked the seclusion room door. The door slammed on the employee's finger, resulting in a partial amputation of her right middle fingertip.

An employee was going to infill an opening on an existing wall built in 1995. As he prepared to begin, a masonry block fell and landed on his head. He suffered head trauma. He was wearing a hard hat at the time.
An employee slipped on the floor and fractured her femur.

An employee was monitoring chicken as it went into an oven. The chicken was getting stuck between two conveyors; when the employee grabbed one of the conveyors to move it, his finger got stuck, and the fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was receiving a package from a mail handler. A case the mail handler was leaning on tipped over and struck the employee, breaking a bone in the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was working on a vacuum pipe when a metal plate inside the pipe moved and crushed his right thumb. The thumb was partially amputated at the bottom of the nailbed.

An employee was on a scissor lift, installing flashing over an accordion-style hangar door. The door opened and pushed the scissor lift over. The employee fell to the ground and suffered broken limbs and internal bleeding.

A Prock Marine Company employee was helping a crew set up steel I-beams on a barge to move them to the dock with a crane. In the process, one of the I-beams fell, hitting the employee's leg and knocking the employee into the water. The employee suffered a broken lower left leg.
An employee was inspecting heavy weights in the yard when he experienced stomach aches and cramps, requiring hospitalization due to potential heat exhaustion.
An employee was hanging a piece of rubber matting on the right rear corner of a milling machine. The track on the machine ran over her right foot, fracturing it and smashing the toes.

After processing meat, an employee put his left hand into a sterilizer. His inner rubber glove had come off when he removed his outer cotton glove, and the sterilizer's hot water burned his hand and fingers.
An employee fell off a sawhorse while loading a horizontal boring mill part onto a crane. The part severely lacerated the employee's right wrist, and the employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was adjusting a malfunctioning lift gate. The gate moved downward, crushing the employee's left little finger. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was removing the rear axel on a forklift for maintenance purposes. While the forklift was blocked underneath, the employee utilized a chain-link hoist to lift the rear of the forklift. In the process of doing this, the employee's finger was caught between the chain-link hoist and the forklift counterweight, resulting in a left ring finger amputation down to the first knuckle.
An employee was repairing a hoist from a rolling ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and landed about 8 feet below. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while walking down an aisle, falling to the floor on her left side and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was on a rolling chair, watering plants. The chair slid out from the employee, who fell to the floor and suffered an L1 back fracture.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. The employee fell off the forklift as it turned, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

On 5/20/2020, around 12:20 p.m., an employee was walking down the stairs and tripped on the first set. The employee struck his head and received a fracture to the left wrist and a skull fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee performing groundskeeping activities was swarmed by bees, causing the employee to fall and break an ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was going from the bag room to the main building when an overhead door started closing on her. She rushed to get through and slipped on the sandy floor, breaking her ankle.
On May 21, 2020, at 1:00 a.m., an employee was checking the belt tension on a conveyor's serpentine belt when the conveyor activated and partially amputated the employee's finger.

An employee was knocking risers off of castings using a sledge hammer. As he was swinging the sledge hammer, his left index finger was smashed between the sledge hammer handle and a part of the casting. The injury resulted in a soft tissue defect with an amputation at the distal aspect of the left index finger (no bone loss).

An employee was shoveling hot asphalt when he started to feel unwell. Around the afternoon, after sitting in the shade and drinking some water, he became ill and required hospitalization for heat illness.
An employee was holding a flashlight for his partner who was cutting a bumper off a truck when the bumper fell on the employee. He suffered a broken jaw and a damaged nerve around the eye.

Two employees were troubleshooting air actuation issues at a plastic injection molding press. One employee activated the press while the second employee was inside the press. The pin inside the press then struck the second employee's right arm, crushing the right elbow. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was labeling palletized 20-pound boxes suspended on the forks of a forklift. The boxes fell on her, knocking her to the floor and breaking her femur.

An employee was climbing down from a truck and was 2 to 3 feet from the ground when his left foot missed a step, he lost his grip, and his right foot became hung up in a step. As a result, he sustained a right ankle fracture.

An employee on a ladder was replacing cables on the side of a building at a height of 8 feet when the employee's foot slipped and was caught between two rungs. The ladder fell to the side, causing the employee to fall and hit the ground. The employee suffered a left leg fracture.
An employee was helping to remove pipe from a structure when the pipe fell and struck the employee's right leg, fracturing the tibia and fibula.
An employee was working with a flammable membrane cleaner. The cleaner caught fire when the employee went to light his cigarette and both of his hands were burned.

An employee was carrying a 10- to 12-foot long metal channel up a metal ladder when he contacted an overhead power line and received an electrical shock. He then fell from the ladder. He sustained electrical burns and fractures.

An employee was balancing a blower assembly that had a mechanical indicator with a magnet. While the blower wheel was moving to check for vibrations, his hand entered the assembly and it caught his thumb, resulting in a right thumb amputation. He was hospitalized.
An employee was herding cattle onto a truck when a calf broke away and ran over the employee. The employee suffered a fractured skull.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to his left middle finger when his hand entered the discharge chute of a hammer mill while it was operating.
An employee was loading a truck for the day with rolls of fencing when he lost his balance and fell from the bed of the truck to the ground, striking and fracturing his skull.
An employee fell about 5 feet off an 8-foot step ladder to the ground while putting up fiberglass panels, fracturing an ankle and wrist.
An employee was fixing leaks in and around reverse osmosis equipment when he was exposed to the exhaust of a high pressure washer. He became ill and collapsed due to carbon monoxide poisoning.
On May 21, 2020, an employee was entering a pavilion through a doorway when she slipped and fell to the ground, fracturing her left tibia and requiring surgery.

An employee was operating an up-cut saw to trim scrap material. The employee's left hand was in the point of operation when the saw was actuated via the foot pedal. The saw then amputated the employee's left middle finger to the second knuckle, the ring finger to the first knuckle, and the pinky fingertip.

An employee was running a tagline of an elevated load (conveyor bed) during an installation. As the load was lifted, the tagline became twisted around the employee's thumb. As the load moved, the rope caused an open wound to the right thumb that resulted in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was speaking with another employee when a forklift came through a roll-up door and struck him. He was hospitalized with a head injury and possible fracture.
An employee was removing a pump for a hot water heater when hot water burned his torso.

An employee climbed a ladder to hang a banner for Memorial Day and fell off the ladder, resulting in a dislocated shoulder and a splinter in the hand. The splinter had to be surgically removed. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a ladder to repair a piece of fascia when the piece of facia contacted a powerline. He received an electric shock and suffered second and third degree burns on 40 percent of his body (mostly his back and hands). He was hospitalized.
An employee was transporting handheld power tools to another location when he slipped, engaged the handheld grinder, and lacerated the top of his left hand.
An employee was working on a commercial roof when a chain fell on his hand, resulting in two possible fingertip amputations.

An employee was felling a tree with a chainsaw. As he attempted to maneuver around the tree base, he slipped and lost his footing. As a result, he contacted the chainsaw with his left arm, resulting in a cut to his forearm and a fractured ulna.

An employee was trimming an overhead limb off a felled tree when the tree branch fell and struck the employee. The employee suffered three fractured ribs, a collapsed lung, and a T-12 vertebrae fracture.

An employee was cleaning up trash around a pumpjack unit. The unit turned on, caught the employee's shirt, and pinned the employee against the unit's fence enclosure. The employee lost some skin on the left leg, as well as torn ligaments in the left knee.

An employee was jackhammering a concrete deck on the top level of a parking garage when the deck collapsed and he fell to the level below. He impacted concrete rubble on the floor and a piece of concrete slab that sheared from the deck, suffering a fractured femur, broken tibia, and cracked ribs.
An employee was reinstalling a square pack blade back into an automated refuse truck. He went to reposition the come-a-long when the pack blade slipped and fell on his left leg, fracturing it.
An employee was attempting to remove a TPU sheet from a TPU machine when her thumb was caught between two rollers, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was working on a fan assembly line when their thumb became caught in a fan and was amputated.
An employee was cutting a soil nail to remove a whaler from an excavation protective system when the whaler tipped over onto him. The employee suffered a spinal injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting concrete form stakes out of 2"x6" lumber laying on a couple of sawhorses. There was a nail embedded in a 2"x6" that caused the saw to bounce when he cut into it. The saw bounced down onto his right leg, cutting his right inner thigh and requiring surgery.
An employee was hoisting a steel plate. The employee's fingers were caught between the plate and another surface, causing amputation of the right little finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was moving into a new office space and that had junk left in the office areas from previous tenants. He was taking a large piece of commercial glass to the dumpster using a dolly. As he was picking up the glass over his head to throw it in the dumpster, the glass broke and half went into the dumpster and the other half fell on his right lower leg, severely cutting it. He was hospitalized with a severed tendon.
After performing general maintenance around a plant, an employee started experiencing muscle spasms and was hospitalized for a possible heat stress injury.
An employee was drilling a water well. A single pipe rod holder malfunctioned and came down on the employee's little finger, crushing it.

After disconnecting a clevis from an excavation bucket, an employee bent down to pick up a stack when the excavator operator turned the excavator. The bucket then hit the employee in the head, causing a neck fracture.
An employee was tarping a load of lumber on a flatbed trailer when the employee tripped and fell off the trailer to the ground, suffering a laceration above the left eye and a broken left ankle.
An employee was working in her designated area pulling parts when she slipped and fell to the floor, striking her left knee and forehead. She was hospitalized for her injuries.
An employee was working on shop doors while standing on a step ladder when he fell to the ground and struck his head. He suffered broken ribs and a concussion, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to move materials with a push dolly when he fell to the ground and fractured his right femur, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was carrying a hot pot when it tipped over, hitting the employee's left hand and causing a burn.

An employee was pulling an auger while standing on top of a scale house when the auger gave, causing the employee to lose footing and fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left arm, multiple broken ribs on the left side, and a broken pelvis.

On Friday, May 22, 2020, an employee was unloading materials off a sky track lift on a third floor balcony when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a hairline fracture on the jaw and a broken arm.
An employee was climbing up a hill when he slipped and fell to the ground, breaking his leg.

An employee was fixing the coin hopper in a coin recycler that would not dispense change. After emptying out the pennies and coin holders, she was closing the coin hopper when her hand was caught in the closing door. As a result, she suffered a left index fingernail amputation.

An employee was testing an HVAC system when the face of the pressure regulator blew off and hit the employee in the face. The employee suffered multiple fractures and lacerations to the face and a ruptured eardrum.
An employee was working on a hydraulic shear machine. He was attempting to turn a cylinder that was being processed when his fingers were caught in the shear. Two fingers were amputated.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while walking, breaking her femur.

An employee was tasked with welding a pipe. As he was getting a cutting torch from a toolbox on a buggy, he became caught between the side boom of a pipelayer and the buggy. He suffered internal bleeding and damage to his small intestine, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was helping operate a hydraulic mold press. The press engaged, crushing the employee's left index fingertip. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was performing maintenance on a wheel loader (front-end loader) and removed an access plate to the bottom of the engine compartment. After the fasteners were removed, the access plate fell to the floor and crushed the employee's forearm between the plate and the floor. The employee suffered damage to the muscle and connective tissue (no broken bones).
On May 22, 2020, an employee was walking across a wet mopped floor when the employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a compression fracture to the lower back. The employee was hospitalized.
On May 22, 2020, an employee fell into a drainage ditch while walking to his car. He was hospitalized with broken ribs, a punctured lung, and bruises.

An employee was helping a forklift operator load material inside a truck when the employee was pinned between the material he was loading and the existing material in the truck. He suffered injuries in the abdominal area and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to a concrete floor and hit her head, suffering a contusion and a small brain bleed.

An employee was walking near a steel platform performing maintenance when the wire ropes holding the platform snapped, causing the platform to strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and a slight fracture to the spine.
An employee was working on a former. The employee stood up into a rail, fell, and suffered a concussion.

An employee was using a rag to clean a conveyor belt on a bag flattener. The employee's arms were pulled into the nip point between the belt and an idler pulley, causing arm contusions, abrasions, and potential soft tissue damage.
An employee lost consciousness while applying spray for fire ant control at a commercial location. The employee was hospitalized to treat heat-related dehydration.
An employee was closing a garage door when the employee's fingers were pinched between the closing door panels, resulting in the amputation of the left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was rigging the motor on a tower when his right hand was caught in a pinch point, resulting in an open fracture with an amputation of the right middle distal fingertip.
An employee was on top of a trailer rigging steal beams so that they could be lifted when he fell off the trailer to the ground, injuring his right shoulder and lower back.
An employee tripped on a mouse cord while standing up from a desk. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken humerus.

On May 22, 2020, at approximately 12:00 p.m., an employee was working in a lab drive-through shed when she sprayed a wasp with wasp spray. The wasp started to chase her, so she ran. While running, she tripped and fell in the parking lot, fracturing both wrists.
An employee was struck by a patient and knocked to the floor, requiring hospitalization and surgery on her neck and back.
On 5/22/2020, an employee was breaking up a cast iron boiler with a sledgehammer when a metal fragment struck the employee in the eye, causing eye trauma that required hospitalization.

An employee was leveling product on a store shelf 
when an errant vehicle crashed through the front of the store. The vehicle struck the employee on the right side of his body. He suffered broken bones in the right cheek, the loss of several teeth, and a right arm laceration that required stitches.

On May 23, 2020, a UPS employee was walking out of the rear of a package car and onto the dock when he stepped on a package that had fallen out of his hand. He rolled and broke his ankle, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was having his tractor filled with dry fertilizer. He was on the front section of the tractor's hopper box, about to perform a density check on the fertilizer, when he slipped. A sharp object on the tractor caused a degloving injury to the inside of his right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was checking the voltage of an on-ground 150 kVA transformer when the transformer shorted out and shocked the employee. The employee was hospitalized.
While conducting a taste test, an employee mistakenly grabbed a sample cup that contained sodium hydroxide, incurring chemical burns to the mouth and lip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was opening an inspection door to clean inside a coal chute when his left middle finger was pinched between the door and the piping next to it, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was material handling freight with a jack. When she advanced the jack, she was pinned between an upright beam and the jack. She suffered deep bruising in the liver area.
An employee was assisting a customer. The customer pulled out a machete and attacked the employee, injuring her face, head, neck, and shoulders. She was hospitalized.

An employee was on a stand inspecting aluminum rolls from a roller mill by taking sheets out to inspect for quality issues when he fell to the same-level concrete surface and hit his head, requiring staples.
An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a glass washer when the employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught and crushed in the nip point of the washer's belt.

Two employees were standing in a loading area and operating an overhead crane with a remote when a set of PBR aluminum steel sheets fell from the crane and landed on the employees. The first employee suffered a forehead laceration. The second employee suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was rolling a fully loaded cart down a truck ramp to deliver products to a retail store when the cart struck the edge of the truck ramp, causing the load to shift forward and the employee to lose control of the cart. The employee then fell off the ramp to the ground below, breaking the left tibia.
An employee was working in the kitchen at a nursing home. The employee was on a two-step ladder to reach a pan on a top shelf when the employee lost balance and fell, fracturing the left femur.

An employee was loading a gun safe into a customer's vehicle with three other employees. The employee was in the bed of the vehicle when the gun safe slid onto his left middle finger, causing it to be caught between the gun safe and the vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left middle finger.
An employee was working at a paper machine. As he was checking a label on a roll of paper, his foot was pulled into the conveyor. He suffered a broken toe and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing cleaning services at a food processing facility when he tripped over a water hose and fell. As he attempted to catch himself, his finger was caught in a conveyor belt, resulting in a pinky finger amputation.

At 8:47 a.m. on May 24, 2020, an employee was trying to pull a winch line from the back of a dozer when his left hand was pinched between the shackle and spool. His index and middle fingers were partially amputated.
An employee felt a sharp pain in the lower body while pushing a patient in a wheelchair. The employee was hospitalized for a bilateral hernia.
An employee suffered a cut thumb while cutting chicken with a knife. While washing the cut, the employee fell, striking their head on the sink and the floor. The employee suffered a fractured skull.

An employee was cleaning a welding table when he bumped the table with his body. A 150-pound part from a coal pulverizer then shifted and fell, pinching the employee's left pinky fingertip between the part and the grating on the table. As a result, his left pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on the roof of a fertilizer storage building, shoveling fertilizer that had spilled out through the hole in the roof. He slipped and fell down 20 feet of roof, then dropped 12 feet straight onto a trolley rail, then fell from the rail to the ground 18 inches below. The employee suffered three brain bleeds, a broken fractured left wrist, stomach injury, a kidney injury, a fractured eye socket, a pelvis fracture, a gash in the forehead (requiring stitches), and a cut that left skin hanging from his forehead.
An employee was stocking groceries in the walk-in refrigerator when she slipped on the floor and fell, fracturing her tibia/fibula.
An employee was getting back onto his tractor when he fell and struck a memorial, fracturing six ribs.

On May 24, 2020,at approximately 11:30 a.m., an employee was operating a side-by-side UTV downhill when he realized the slope was too steep to negotiate. He attempted to reverse the UTV, and it flipped and rolled to the bottom of the slope. The employee suffered a fractured ankle.
On May 25, 2020, an employee was moving a pallet by hand when she slipped and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, fracturing her right knee. She was hospitalized.

An employee was walking in the warehouse, picking parts for an order. The employee turned a corner and collided with another worker, head-to-head. One of the workers fell to the floor fracturing her left shoulder. The other worker was not injured.
While changing blades on a machine, a blade fell and partially amputated an employee's right ring finger.

An employee was about to spray lubricant onto the chain and sprockets of a conveyor belt. He fell forward and his right index finger was caught in the moving chain and sprockets. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
While helping to install a sanitary sewer, an employee became dehydrated and had signs of heat exhaustion.
An employee fell to the ground while erecting scaffolding, suffering ankle and wrist fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was getting ready to use an oxy propane torch to cut some aluminum on or near empty 55-gallon drums that last contained tertiary-butyl alcohol. During lighting of the torch, vapors in a drum immediately adjacent to the torch exploded. The employee suffered second and third degree burns to the hands, face, chest, and stomach.
An employee was moving equipment from the grass to the pavement when the employee slipped and fell onto a jack. The employee suffered an internal abdominal injury.
An employee was positioning a utility pole on a trailer when the pole made contact with the employee's foot, causing a foot injury.

An employee was assembling parts of the all-wheel steering on a piece of agricultural equipment. A suspended strap failed and a heavy metal wheel dropped down on the employee's left index finger, causing an amputation.

An employee was transporting goods on a two-wheel hand cart down a ramp from the back of a delivery truck when he slipped on the ramp, sustaining injuries to his back and neck and several broken bones.

An employee was moving a pallet with an electric pallet jack when he took a turn and his leg went outside of the pallet jack and was struck by the pallet jack. As a result, he suffered a right ankle fracture.

An employee was positioning the end of a coil into the butt welder machine. As the employee pressed the foot pedal to close the pneumatic clamp his right index finger was caught in the clamp and amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was walking out of a patient room when her shoe caught the floor, causing her to lose her balance and strike a chair's wooden arm. She suffered three broken ribs.

A piece of metal grating slipped after an employee replaced it in a storage rack. The employee was trying to push it back in place when the grate fell between two crossbeams, catching the employee's right middle finger against the storage rack beam and causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was stepping out of an excavator onto its right side track. He fell from the track to the ground, suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
The left front wheel of a piece of material handling equipment rolled over an employee's left foot, breaking three toes.
An employee was pulling a cart between buildings. The cart got stuck, then fell over onto the employee's right leg and broke it.

An employee was adding a dry powder cleaning agent to a trolly wash tank when the mix reacted aggressively with the water and flashed onto the employee, causing third degree burns to the face and body.
An employee was crushed between an electric pallet jack and a forklift while moving boxes, suffering broken legs and a shattered pelvis.

An employee was on a barge, pulling rigging on top of a stack of steel pipe pilings. He fell off the end of the stack, landed on crane mats used as dunnage, then fell 7 feet to the deck of the barge. His right leg struck a 6-by-6 piece of dunnage lying on the deck, and he suffered a broken femur.
While walking in an office hallway, an employee slipped on a mat from a 6-inch step, suffering a dislocated knee.

An employee was working with a pipe grooving machine when an article of his clothing was caught in the machine. As he was attempting to remove the article of clothing, his right index and middle fingers were amputated by the machine.
An employee was disassembling a cubicle with a screwdriver when the screwdriver slipped and impaled the employee right below the right eye.

On May 26, 2020, an employee was cutting concrete using a concrete saw when he slipped as he cut between a drain and a sidewalk. The saw cut his right knee, causing a 2-inch laceration. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over an air hose, fell to the ground, and suffered a neck injury.

An employee was adjusting a tractor trailer to put it on dolly legs when the trailer shifted, causing the trailer crank to spin and come down on the employee's head. The employee suffered a concussion and broken facial bones.
A tractor trailer pinned an employee against a loading dock as it backed up. The employee suffered fractures to the ribs, hip, and back, as well as a liver laceration.
Employee tripped while stepping onto a curb and fell into a stone wall. The employee's purse snagged on the wall as she fell. She suffered a broken nose and left shoulder.
An employee lost his balance while climbing down a ladder between the 22nd and 21st floor of a new construction and fell approximately 6 feet, breaking his right leg above the ankle.
While using a leaf blower, a temporary employee removed a tube to the motor assembly. His left hand slipped into the blades and his left pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was climbing up an extension ladder to secure it at the top. The bottom kicked out and the employee fell 17 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised spleen and fractures to the leg, wrist, and ribs.
An employee was stepping onto a pallet jack when it turned into him. He suffered a cut to the top of his foot and a ruptured Achilles tendon.

An employee was making his rounds to verify the mill was shut down when he noticed a wood block lodged in the trim/block conveyor underneath the trimmer. When employee moved the wood block, the conveyor belt started and his finger was caught between the block and the belt causing an amputation to the end of the right ring finger.

On May 27, 2020, an employee was operating an automated trim saw. When the employee tried to remove a piece of wood, the saw blade caused an amputation to the employee's right thumb, index finger, and middle finger.
An employee was using a metal shear to manufacture live banding material. The shear amputated the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was clearing loose product from the end of a bandsaw when the blade cut the employee's third finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.

On 5/27/2020, an employee was delivering mail to a residence. The employee approached the porch between a car and the yard, then stepped off the paved walkway and slipped on the mud on the irrigated yard. The employee fell, landing on the ground and sidewalk, and sustained a broken right elbow and abrasions to the knee.
An employee was unloading sheet metal from a shear press. His sleeve got caught on the edge of the sheet metal and his elbow sustained a severe cut.
An employee was descending a set of stairs inside a facility. She fell, suffering a broken left ankle.

An employee was inside a fuel tank preparing to clean it out using a high-pressure water hose. The water was turned on and the hose whipped around and hit the employee in the arm causing a laceration. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery on his arm.

A team of three employees were removing wood panels from the wall. Two workers were at the top of the panel and one was at the bottom. The panel weighed approximately 90 lbs. It slipped out of the hands of the workers at the top and landed on the hand of the employee at the bottom severing the employee's left ring finger.
While working on top of a rail car, an employee's leg got caught on the top of the rail car. The employee fell to the rail car surface and sustained a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was helping to move a piece of angle iron when it fell on his left index finger, resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee was trying to sharpen the blade of a guillotine at the end of a plastic extruder line. The blade cycled down and cut off the tips of his left middle and ring fingers.

An employee fell to the ground while climbing a 20-foot portable ladder at a customer's residence. The employee suffered multiple fractured ribs, a shoulder fracture, and a back fracture with loss of feeling in the legs.

An employee was painting a water tower with a pneumatic paint sprayer. While on top of the water tower, the employee slipped and fell over the edge striking the catwalk and then the ground about 100 feet below. He was hospitalized for multiple fractures. The employee was wearing a harness with a lanyard attachment, but the lanyard was not attached to an anchor point.

An employee was standing on the floor inspecting parts for paint quality. When he was finished looking at a part, he starting walking backwards and tripped on a wooden pallet that was laying on the floor behind him. He fell to the concrete floor and fractured a hip.
While doing touchup work on the second story, an employee fell 12 feet and was hospitalized for a fractured rib and a fractured left foot.

After cutting paper from a roll on a rewinder, an employee tried to pull the paper out from underneath the spool. The spool came loose and pinned the employee's leg against a cart behind him, breaking the leg.
While walking across a break area, an employee slipped on water in front of an ice machine. She fell to the floor, dislocating her knee.
An employee was closing the door to a storage box when his left thumb was caught between the storage box and the closing door. He sustained a partial amputation of the tip of the left thumb.

While removing debris from a manure handling belt, an employee slipped and their hand was caught in the chain and sprocket drive system of the belt. The employee sustained amputations of the pinky and ring fingers at the proximal joints.

Three pieces of metal, weighing approximately 250 pounds each, were being lifted using slings attached to an overhead crane. An employee was guiding the metal as it was lifted out of a rack. The metal pinched the employee s finger against the rack resulting in the amputation of his right ring fingertip.

An employee was rotating tires on a customer's vehicle. While carrying the tires from the rear to the front of the vehicle, the employee tripped over an air hose and fell. The employee's head struck a four-post lift, and the employee suffered a spine injury.

An employee was delivering a package at a resident's home when a dog escaped out the door and attacked her. She received bites on the left leg (thigh near knee) and right leg (back of thigh), and her left thumb tip was bitten off.
An employee tripped and fell while leaving his work area. He was hospitalized, suffering internal bleeding.
An employee was using a cart to deliver groceries to a customer when the cart's weight pushed the employee onto the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was chopping slices of bacon when the knife partially amputated her left thumb tip.

After delivering a load of stone to the jobsite, the driver of the dump truck was checking to see why the tailgate of the dump truck was not closing properly. When he pushed the tailgate, it returned, trapping the fingers on his left hand between the bed and the gate. The ring and middle fingers were amputated to the first joint.

An employee was stepping off the lower step of an aerial lift platform when the employee's left knee struck an unknown object. The employee then fell backwards and landed on the sidewalk. The employee suffered a fractured kneecap.
An employee had been mopping and hand scrubbing spilled paint off the floor. The employee lost consciousness due to a possible heart attack. He fell and struck his head on a pallet jack.

An employee was riding on the rear step of a rear-loading trash truck. The truck hit a bump and the employee fell off the step, suffering multiple lacerations, contusions, road rash, and a broken arm and nose.
An employee was walking away from a patient when he chased her down and flipped her onto the ground. She landed on her head, suffering a hematoma and skull fracture. She was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading and restocking a delivery truck when she fell from the lift gate to the ground 4 feet below. She suffered a broken knee.
An employee was on the top of a bulk trailer. The employee slipped between the guardrail system and the trailer, falling to the ground and suffering broken ribs, a punctured lung, and lacerations.
An employee was cutting an 18-inch concrete pipe using a concrete saw. He was almost finished cutting it when the concrete saw locked in the cut, causing it to swing back and lacerate his jaw.
An employee injured their back while lifting equipment. The employee was hospitalized.
While trying to move the drive-thru canopy back into place, an employee fell off a ladder. The employee landed on the concrete driveway and sustained a head injury.
An employee was on a ladder, installing a window and removing trim. The employee fell about 11 feet to the concrete driveway below, suffering a back injury.

An employee was moving a rolling ladder back into its designated storage location. The employee tripped over the stabilizer and fell to the floor, landing on her right side and suffering a hip fracture. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was installing a planter box at a private residence while standing on a ladder when the ladder slipped from the bottom and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken wrists.
A driver was loading new vehicles onto his auto hauler. After driving a vehicle onto the trailer he exited the vehicle and slipped. He fell about 4 feet to the ground injuring his heels.

An employee was grinding the flat surface of his welding table to remove old welds from a previous set-up. He was using a 5-inch angle grinder equipped with a cut-off disk. The disk disintegrated and fragments hit the employee causing lacerations to the stomach area. The employee also sustained internal bleeding as a result of contusion to arteries.
An employee fell from a 2-foot-high platform to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was going up a ladder when he slipped and fell 4 feet onto the ground. He sustained a fractured vertebrae disk and was hospitalized.

At about 11:30 a.m. on May 28, 2020, an employee was clearing a clog from the classification system for a plastic media recovery system. When the clog cleared, the open adjustable rotor started to spin, causing amputations to the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers (with bone loss to the furthest knuckle on the middle finger).

An employee was checking a top seal machine to determine why the bags were not heat sealing properly when he contacted an energized 240 volt, 20 amp electrical wire and received electrical burns to his right hand.

An employee was driving a checker vehicle when it collided with a truck that was backing up. The employee suffered a right superior articulating facet fracture of the C6 vertebra, a fracture of the left posterior tubercle at the C5 vertebra, a grade IV blunt cerebrovascular injury with distal reconstitution, abrasions to the left ear and left elbow, and decreased sensation in the right thumb and index finger.

At about 11:55 p.m. on May 28, 2020, an employee was replacing a light ballast from an extension ladder. The ladder slipped out from under him and he fell about 8 feet to the floor, suffering a fracture to the back, a left heel injury, and lacerations to the head and fingers.
An employee was standing on a concrete slab, examining a broken weld. He slipped on some wood chips and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee stood up from a chair, then lost consciousness and fell to the floor, fracturing her right arm.
An employee was adjusting a conveyor. The employee's right foot fell through a top plate and was injured by the conveyor.
An employee was moving soda bibs from around a soda machine when she suffered a pinched nerve in the lower back. She was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a backpack with a pair of lopping shears attached to the side when the shears opened and amputated his right index finger.
An employee tripped and fell down the stairs. He was hospitalized with broken ribs and other injuries.
An employee was walking out of an office when the employee's right index finger was caught in the door jam as the door closed, resulting in a partial amputation to the top of the finger.

An employee was moving a food cart down a cement ramp on a loading dock. She tripped and fell to the ground at the bottom of the ramp, and the cart landed (upright) on her ankle. She suffered a fractured vertebra in her back.
An employee was using a pair of vice grips to hold a piece of metal that the employee was grinding on a bench grinder when the vice grips came loose and hit the employee in the head.

An employee was on a mower, trying to engage its emergency brake as it rolled downhill. The mower crashed into a pontoon boat (on dry land); the employee suffered three broken left-side ribs, a large laceration on the left leg, and a knee injury.
An employee suffered a back injury while lifting a box of apples. She was hospitalized.
An employee experienced heat stress while delivering mail, requiring hospitalization.
On May 29, 2020, an employee was placing decking on a nail machine. His left hand was crushed under the nail chuck.

An employee tripped and fell on the concrete floor while carrying a flat piece of cardboard to be recycled. There was a score in the concrete at the site of the fall but nothing was sticking up. She sustained a fractured left hip requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a riding pallet jack when his left foot became jammed between the pallet jack and a shrink wrap machine, causing a severe left foot injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning a bathroom when a stall door closed on her right hand. Her right ring finger was caught in the door hinge, resulting in a fingertip amputation and open fracture to her finger.

An employee was working at a paper winder. He taped the paper to the core and it began to tear. While he was trying to grab the tail of the paper, the winder grabbed his right-hand fingers and pulled his hand in. He suffered fractures to his middle and ring fingers.
An employee was cleaning a CNC lathe with a rag. The rag was caught between the pulley and the belt, and the belt amputated the employee's finger.

Two employees were moving a cart, one pushing it and the other pulling it. They reached a point where they needed to turn, and as they did the second employee's right little finger was caught between the cart and a metal pole. The finger was amputated.
While moving plywood on a roof, an employee stepped into a hole and fell 25 feet onto concrete. The employee suffered a broken femur, broken arm, broken ribs, and brain swelling.

An employee was moving aluminum castings to be grinded when the end of a compressor tank blew off. Shrapnel from the explosion struck the employee, who was hospitalized with a head laceration and brain bleed.
Two employees fell off of scaffolding while installing drywall. They were hospitalized with broken legs.
An employee was repairing a breaker when energized wires burned the employee's right hand. The burns resulted in a finger amputation.
An employee was operating a saw when his hand slipped and his right pinky finger contacted the moving saw blade. He suffered an open fracture and partial amputation to his finger.

An employee was carrying a propane cylinder bottle in the storage area. He was walking and removing the cylinder from the storage cage when he lost his balance upon turning and fell. The cylinder fell on his left hand, causing fractures.
Two employees were repairing a bearing on an ice resurfacer. One of the employees reached in to adjust the bearing and suffered an amputation to the right middle finger from the nailbed forward.

An employee was working from a 12-foot A-frame ladder. A board he was working on broke away and he lost his balance and fell, landing on the concrete floor 7-8 feet below. He broke ankles, his hip, and a femur.
An employee was working on a piece of equipment when his knife slipped and went into his chest.

An employee was using a gas trimmer to cut brush when he was stung by a wasp on the left arm. The employee swatted with his right hand across his body and made contact with the blades of the trimmer, amputating the tip of his right ring finger.

An employee was loading meat product onto a conveyor belt when a piece of meat got stuck. As the employee was dislodging the meat, his finger was caught between the catch plate and the moving conveyor belt. He sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was standing near a plywood manufacturing line. A piece of MDF board came down the conveyor path and was automatically ejected, striking the employee's right leg just above the ankle and breaking his tibia and fibula.

An employee was cleaning a paving machine's hopper with a shovel. The employee noticed that the "auto" button was activated and tried to shut it off. The machine's front apron came down and caught the employee's right foot against the front bumper. He suffered a broken right foot, a broken left collarbone, and a burned right hand.

An employee was loading parts into a foam press using a roll-in/out table. The table was moved by a chain and sprocket system. While the employee was pulling out the parts, the chain and sprocket caught the employee's gloves and amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was walking toward a door entry when he lost his footing on the edge of the sidewalk and fell to the ground, suffering multiple fractures to his hip joint.
At 4:20 p.m. on May 30, 2020, an employee was retrieving an object from an alligator pen when an alligator bit him on the right elbow. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a fork truck. As his truck and another one approached each other, the employee's left foot was caught between the two. The foot was severely injured and the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
While troubleshooting on a natural gas train platform, an employee went down the stairs and fell to the ground, suffering a hip fracture.

On May 30, 2020, an employee was bending parts on a press brake. The employee's left index finger was caught between a part and the bottom of the die. The finger was pinched, leading to the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was operating a forklift when it got stuck on low overhead ducts. As the employee tried to back up, his right hand was caught between the forklift's overhead cage and a duct. His little finger was amputated.
An employee was making iced tea when she noticed a clog in the brewing basket. She was pulling the brew bucket out to unclog it when hot water scalded her left arm.
An employee was struck by a steel board moving on a conveyor. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was changing the roll on a winder machine when the employee's hand entered the machine to cut plastic, resulting in amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was loading a last-minute bag into the cargo bin of an aircraft. The belt loader that was normally used was pulled away, so the employee jumped from the ground to the cargo bin. The employee fell from the cargo bin and struck the back of his head on the concrete, suffering a traumatic brain injury, temporal skull fracture, and subarachnoid and subdural bleeding.

An employee was helping a customer load a tool box into the back of the customer's pick-up truck. After loading the truck, he fell from the truck and landed on the ground, fracturing his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was beneath a vehicle, welding, when a container of gas/tar caught fire. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to the arms and face and was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling the foot from a fence lag when he lost his balance and fell over the side of an 8-foot wall. He broke his left arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was moving landscape timber. One of the timber cores fell off the loading table, crushing the employee's left little finger against the metal frame of the machine. The finger was later amputated.

An employee had been using a dolly to move a barrel. The employee hit his head on an overhead walkway while wearing a hardhat. He got back up and continued working until he later passed out and had a seizure. The employee broke his nose during the seizure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing pipes for highway construction. Two of the employee's fingers were crushed between a girder and a PVC pipe. The employee underwent surgery.
An employee was setting up a medical cart when she tripped on a computer cord, fell, and landed on the floor on her back. She was hospitalized.
An employee pulling weeds at a private residence was bitten on the finger by a copperhead snake.

An employee was removing brackets from an exterior wall. The ladder he was using slipped out from under him and he fell to the tile floor about 6 feet below. He suffered a broken arm and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell while exiting a tractor, suffering a left ankle injury.

An employee was throwing appliance boxes over a third floor railing when the railing gave out and the employee fell approximately 24 feet to the ground. He experienced back pain and was not able to move his legs.
An employee was running copper wire into a large wooden take-up reel when his right foot and body were caught in the rotating reel. He suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was walking towards his car in the parking lot after his work shift was over. A car backed out of a parking spot, then drove forward striking the employee. The injured employee sustained a laceration to his left foot.
Employees were decommissioning a tower. The tower collapsed while two employees were on it. One employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis and legs.
An employee was using a table saw to cut thin foam material when his glove was pulled into the blade and his right index finger was amputated.
An employee was tucking cables into an electrical cabinet up the tower on a wind turbine when he was electrically shocked, suffering burns to the left forearm that required hospitalization.

An employee was driving a stand-on pallet jack to pick up a pallet when his hand was pinched between an I-beam and the handle bar of the pallet jack. Multiple fingers were injured and he sustained an amputation to the index finger just above the last knuckle.

On 6/01/2020, at about 6:30 AM, an employee was cutting grass with a lawnmower when his foot slid under the lawnmower and contacted the blade. The big toe of the left foot was amputated, and other toes may have been fractured.
While delivering mail, an employee tripped on the sidewalk and sustained a broken right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was applying manifolds to a coil. The coil got stuck on the stopper. As the employee pushed the stopper, the employee's glove was caught between it and the coil. The employee's left middle finger was fractured and partially amputated.
While coming into work in the morning, an employee tripped going up the steps, fell, and broke their right arm. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking from one cocoa processing machine to another when she slipped on a grated platform. The pulley belt on a husker machine amputated three fingers on her right hand.
An employee broke a leg in two places while crossing over a rollover draw machine.
An employee was adjusting a fan when the rotating fan blade struck the employee's finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was hanging chickens on shackles in the evisceration department. While removing a chicken from a hook, the employee's finger was lacerated by a double leg shackle resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was descending a step ladder when he slipped off the bottom step, stuck his hands out to catch himself, and struck the floor, breaking his right wrist.
A machinist was filing a burr using a CNC lathe. The file ejected from the machine, hitting him in the abdomen and perforating his small intestine. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee torch-cut an expansion joint around a piece of ductwork at a cage mill. After removal of the last piece of expansion joint, the top pipe chute came down and caught the employee's right arm between the top pipe chute and the bottom pipe chute. The employee sustained a crushing injury to the right arm, requiring hospitalization for surgery.

An ironworker was checking a bolt hole on a steel column to see why a bolt would not go into the hole. A steel beam (still attached to a crane) was being connected to the column. The beam shifted and pinched the employee's finger, amputating the left middle fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized after being exposed to iodoacetonitrile.
An employee was operating a wheelchair outside when the wheelchair rolled over a curb and toppled, throwing her to the pavement in the parking lot. She suffered a broken hip and femur.

An employee was installing a roof on a building. He was carrying a roof sheet up to the peak when a purlin broke underfoot. The employee fell to the ground about 20 feet below, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was helping an associate lift a side stack off a garden cart when he tripped on the lip of the cart and hit his face on the floor or a beam. He suffered a broken nose and was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting under a patio having lunch when the entire structure of the patio collapsed. The employee sustained a fracture between the knee and ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was wrecking on the first floor of a parking garage under construction. He placed a hand on a fence and felt an electrical shock through his arm. He was hospitalized with an increased heart rate and elevated blood pressure.
An employee was bleeding down a pressurized line that was being pressure tested when the head of the line burst off the line and struck his right arm. He was hospitalized with a fractured right arm.
An employee was attempting to detain a patient and was pushed to the ground. He fell backwards and hit his head on the ground, requiring hospitalization.
An employee sustained lacerations to his face from the release of pressurized urea solids.
An employee was moving a scaffold when his thumb was caught between the I-beams. He broke his thumb and required surgery.

Two employees were assembling part of a tree spade. A pin in the stabilizer leg was not aligning in its hole properly. One employee was trying to find the groove between two bushings in the pinhole when the pin was pulled out, amputating the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was using a hand-held circular saw to cut a piece of wood lath. The blade contacted the employee's left index finger, resulting in an amputation down to the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a press when the press operator started the machine. The press then crushed the employee's right hand, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was brooming concrete on the third level of a parking garage under construction. The handle of the broom came into contact with overhead power lines. The employee suffered electrical burns to both hands and was hospitalized.

An employee was exiting the building when she tripped on the floor mat at the employee exit and impacted the floor, resulting in abrasions on the face, an injury to the right wrist, and a hospitalization for a fractured L5 vertebra.
An employee was installing shingles on a roof and fell 30 feet from the roof to the ground. The employee suffered two fractured wrists and injuries to the mouth.
An employee was organizing/cleaning around a wire bound machine when the employee's hair was caught on a rotating shaft, scalping the employee.
An employee was driving home after work and became lightheaded. He pulled over, got out of the car, became disoriented, and stumbled into a ditch due to heat stress.
On June 2, 2020, an employee was going to the parking lot to park cars. Thieves were stealing trucks from the storage lot and struck the employee with a vehicle. The employee sustained fractures.

A driver was using a dolly cart to unload product from the back of a truck. His shoe got caught in the bumper as he was stepping down to the ground, causing him to fall. The employee was hospitalized with a broken lower right leg and had surgery.
An employee was struck on his left leg by a high-powered pressure washer and sustained a deep laceration.
An employee was using a rod to clean coal ash out of a bin. The employee felt pain in his upper back, neck, and both arms and was later taken to the hospital.

An employee was entering the company truck which was parked in the service bay between the automotive lift posts. The employee slipped and fell on same level inside of the automobile service area. The employee landed on his shoulder/back on an automotive lift arm, which was at ground level, and sustained a punctured lung.

An employee was on the roof of a shop, retrieving a tree trimmer, when he fell through a skylight to the concrete floor 17 feet below. He suffered a broken wrist, elbow, and femur; kidney and liver injuries; and facial fractures.

An employee was trying to dislodge a mattress that was stuck on a wooden pallet. The forklift that had loaded the mattress moved to the side, freeing it and causing it to pinch the employee's ring finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell down the front steps and sustained fractures to the left arm and elbows.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder when it became unattached from the building, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was working on the roof, removing plastic coverings (formerly skylights) and replacing them with plywood. The employee fell 19 feet through an open space to the floor below. He sustained cuts, including cuts near his eye, a possible broken wrist, a possible dislocated finger, and a possible concussion.
An employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger while changing a bit on a router machine.
An employee was clearing debris from a machine. Power was turned back on, and his right arm was pulled under a roller and broken.
An employee was performing maintenance work from a ladder when he slipped and fell off the ladder and hit his head on a concrete pillar. He suffered a traumatic head injury.
While troubleshooting a jam in a laminator machine, the machine cycled and an employee's hand was caught and crushed in the machine, resulting in surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was working in an attic installing tubing. When the employee finished and was heading back to the stairwell, he stepped on an old access hole and fell through to the concrete below. He suffered heel and vertebrae fractures.
