An employee was helping to reinsert a 10,000-lb. die set on a cupper. While pushing the die set in, the employee s left hand was on the bottom of the die set, with the tips of his fingers in a recessed hole underneath the die set. As the die set slid into place, the employee's fingertips were contacted by the straight edge of the lower base of the cavity, resulting in the amputation of the index, middle, and ring fingertips.
An employee was trimming trees at a residential property. A limb fell and lacerated the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a battery-powered pallet jack. Its handle struck the employee in the abdomen, causing three broken ribs and a bruised liver.
An employee was installing insulating boots on a de-energized 5-kilovolt termination and suffered an electrical shock.
An employee suffered a hernia while bending over to pick up a pallet.
Two employees were in a scissor lift surveying storm damage on a roof panel. One of the employees fell from the lift cage to the concrete below and fractured their back.
An employee was spackling from a baker's scaffold about 18-20 feet above a concrete floor. He fell, struck the ground feet first, and rolled, suffering muscle strains throughout his body.
A foundry employee was using a hoist to move cast iron parts. He was overcome by the heat and was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.

An employee was cleaning his work area when the strap holding a container rotator in a vertical position failed. The container rotator, and the container roll-in/out platform it was attached to, swung and struck the employee on the right upper torso and hip area. He suffered broken and dislocated ribs, a pelvic fracture, and fractures to lower-back vertebrae.

An employee was sitting at her desk performing management tasks. A guest went to the front lobby brandishing a 9mm gun. The guest approached the employee, hit her in the head with the gun and then, as security approached the area, shot the employee five times hitting her on the arm three times. The employee sustained a head injury and gunshot wounds to the left arm.

An employee was pushing the ripped wall of an intermodal trailer back into place from the outside. A piece of protruding metal lacerated the employee's right forearm near the wrist. The employee was hospitalized on June 3, 2020.
An employee was offloading product from a multiple-head drill press. His right hand hit the turning bit, causing laceration to the back of the hand. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was cutting plastic with a table saw. His left hand slipped, broke the guard, and was drawn into the blade. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the left little finger.
An employee was cutting deli meat. The deli slicer cut the employee's left index finger and the employee was hospitalized, requiring stitches.
An employee was cutting a tree limb when he fell from an excavator's claw to the ground 15 feet below. He suffered broken ribs and a broken left femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by the tracks of a mini-excavator and sustained a fractured ankle.

An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder on a TV broadcast tower. The employee fell 25-30 feet to the ground. He suffered broken ankles, broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a spinal cord injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was backing an ATV toward a loading dock when it rolled off the dock. The employee suffered a broken ankle and possibly cracked vertebrae.
An employee was inspecting the paint job on a roof when he fell through a plastic sunroof sheet to the ground about 12 feet below. He suffered neck and head injuries.

An employee was cleaning glue off the rollers on a laminator machine. The machine was turned on in reverse, catching the rag and pulling it into the rollers along with the employee's hand. The blades behind the rollers amputated two of her fingertips.
An employee was starting a fire in a boiler. The fire flashed back, causing first-degree burns to the employee's hands and second-degree burns to the arms.
An employee was helping to load food boxes onto a school bus when he became overheated. He was hospitalized.
On June 3, 2020, an employee was walking in an office when she felt a pain in her leg and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized, having suffered a broken femur.

At about 8:55 p.m., an employee trying to dump waste into a large container using a forklift with a self-dumping attachment. As the forks were raised, the load shifted and pinched his left ring finger, partially amputating it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was power-washing a vessel when the water stream struck his foot, causing a wound that became infected. He underwent surgery to clean the wound.
An employee fell from an excavator, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was stepping over a 2-foot retaining wall while holding a 25-foot aluminum pole. The pole touched an overhead transformer fuse, and the employee was shocked. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to the leg, buttocks, and arm.
An employee was unloading freight at a store. He fell while bent over a pallet of product and landed on his back, suffering a lower-back fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee had removed an extension rod from a load and was about to put a shorter extension in its place. The load tipped over and fell on his right arm, pinching it between the metal staging rack and the retort of the load. The employee suffered a broken bone above the elbow.
An employee was traveling through a warehouse on a pallet jack. She slipped off the jack and it ran over her right leg, causing a laceration from the ankle to the knee.
An employee was spraying sanitizer when she tripped on a crack in the concrete and fell. She suffered multiple fractures to her left arm and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while bringing in shopping carts. His leg was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting up felled trees. The tree supporting the tree he was cutting snapped back and struck the employee in the knee. The employee suffered a fractured knee and torn ligaments.
An employee was filling a fruit display and tripped over a shopping cart resulting in a fall. The employee sustained a broken hip.
An employee was cleaning a cheese blender when it partially amputated three of the employee's fingers.
While placing a fiber line at a residential property, an employee became ill from overheating.
On June 4, 2020, an employee was working from a ladder, pulling cable. The employee fell to the floor, landing on their feet and breaking both heels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was monitoring tubing as it exited the run-off table into a bin. A piece of pipe struck him as it was falling into the bin causing a laceration to the right upper arm.
An employee was stocking merchandise in an aisle. When she knelt down, glass on the floor punctured her right leg beneath the kneecap. She was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee tripped and fell, suffering a dislocated left elbow and a broken left wrist that needed surgery.
An employee was draining glue from melted adhesive. The glue severely burned his fingertip and he was hospitalized.
Two employees were installing braces on trusses. One of them was using a nail gun when it struck the other employee's head and discharged, firing a 3 1/2-inch framing nail into his head.
An employee was moving a wire feeder when its safety latch failed and its lid slammed shut, amputating the employee's left index fingertip at the first knuckle.
An employee was untangling wiring in a suspended electrical pole. The pole slipped in its rigging, pinning the employee's right middle finger against the base. The fingertip was lacerated.
An employee was reinstalling an auger housing. The housing came down and injured the employee's right index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was installing a 550-pound blower on a generator engine. While the employee was raising the blower into position with a half-ton chain, the blower was caught between the generator and its A-frame. While being pulled loose, it swung and caught the employee's right little finger against the generator's A-frame. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
After a shift using a backhoe to move dirt on a median, an employee developed heat-related illness and was hospitalized.

An employee opened a paint oven door to unload a cart of parts from the oven. As he was reaching into the oven, the door hit the left side of his forehead above the eye. He fell to the ground and the door of the oven broke loose from the chain, then fell onto him. He suffered a broken hip, a broken thumb, and a cracked heel bone and was hospitalized.
An employee was dumping a manual trash hopper. The hopper pinched four of her fingers, causing injuries that required surgery.
An employee was cutting a chain when it broke and struck the employee's hand, breaking his finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move merchandise in a warehouse. The jack pinned the employee's leg against a bollard, breaking it.
While walking through a wooded area, an employee tripped on a tree root and fell to the ground. She suffered a broken pelvis and a dislocation femur.
An employee was dislodging a rock from a concrete mixer when the mixer amputated one of the employee's fingers.
On June 4, 2020, after working from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., an insulation installer began having dehydration-related cramps. He was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a bag of marinara sauce in hot water. The water overflowed and burned the top of the employee's left foot.
An employee fell and the knife he was holding cut his left leg. He was hospitalized, having suffered nerve damage that required surgery.

On June 4, 2020, an employee was trying to get a cow to move from a scale. The cow stood up and pushed the employee against a fence, causing fractures to the left hip, pelvis, and sacrum. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were using an overhead crane to lift a steel column that was interlocked with a second steel column. The columns were side-by-side standing on the floor. Employee 1 attached the lifting device to the second column. When Employee 2 lifted the second column it swung and caused the first column to fall over and land on top of Employee 2. Employee 2 suffered a broken left femur and lacerations to the right leg.
An employee was cleaning a dough auger when it caught the employee's right hand, amputating three fingers.
An employee was carrying a box, stepping from a loading dock into his truck. He fell between the truck and the dock, and the truck's bumper severely lacerated his lower right leg.
An employee was cutting PVC pipe on a chop saw. The employee's left hand slipped and the sawblade amputated the tip of the employee's thumb.
An employee was on a 10-foot A-frame ladder (at about the fourth rung) when he fell to the concrete ground. He suffered head injuries requiring four staples, as well as a compound wrist fracture.
An employee was limbing a tree when the tree rolled, crushing his left lower leg and causing a compound fracture.
An employee was picking up trash in the highway median. A vehicle hit the employee, causing broken ribs, a fractured neck, and a broken leg.
An employee was trying to remove a piece of paper stuck in a machine. The machine crushed three fingers on the employee's right hand.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee tripped over a vacuum cord and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a scraper to clean the inside of a pretzel auger machine. Her hand was caught and injured by the auger's spinning coil.
An employee was changing the chain tension on a machine. The chain caught his hand and amputated his right index finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee was backing up a tractor when it rolled onto its side. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a back injury.
An employee was operating a forklift when it ran into storage racks. Her left foot was caught between the forklift and a rack. The foot was broken and toes were amputated.

An employee was riding on the back of a truck cab, training a new hire. As the tractor backed up, the fifth wheel of the tractor did not engage the trailer pin and the tractor continued back into the front of the trailer. The employee was crushed between the two and suffered a broken leg and a broken pelvis.
An employee was folding linens and moving items at a warehouse where the temperature was 86.5 degrees F. Suffering from heat stress, the employee became dizzy and was hospitalized.
An employee was retrieving formwork materials off a pickup truck. He fell to the ground and suffered a skull fracture.

An employee was making a seal by combining the top and bottom plastic at the infeed of a fold and roll machine. While adjusting the plastic, the front heat seal bar began sequencing and came down onto the employee's arm, pinning it in the machine. The employee was hospitalized with burns and bruising to the right forearm.
An employee experienced breathing difficulty after opening a bucket of pool chemicals, requiring hospitalization for a collapsed right lung.

On June 5, 2020, an employee was working at his machine. The floor in his work area was being cleaned with a cleaning solution. The employee was overcome by the vapors from the cleaning solution and had difficulty breathing.

An employee used a hook to pry up a cast iron manhole cover to check if water was flowing through the drain system. The cover slipped from the hook and fell on his right middle fingertip, causing an amputation that included bone.
While welding with a wire fed welder, an employee stood up, lost his balance, and his hand caught the hot wire tip on the welder. The employee was hospitalized with a swollen and burned index finger.

An employee was powder coating racks in a paint booth. The employee lost consciousness in the paint booth and was hospitalized for acute respiratory failure, heat stroke/malignant hyperthermia, acute renal failure and septic shock.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor. The employee's rubber glove and rag got caught between the turnover of the belt and the ending piece of metal, causing the amputation of the left little finger, a fracture to the left ring finger, and a laceration across the left palm.
An employee was driving a powered industrial truck. As it turned, the employee's right foot was raked between the machine and a rack, causing a cut to the foot/heel.

An employee was at a weld press printing station, performing a product change using an overhead crane. His left ring finger got caught between the lock collar and the gear sleeve, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
On June 5, 2020, at 3:30 PM, an employee was helping a customer load lumber onto a lumber cart. The cart tipped onto the employee's arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left forearm.
An employee was struck by a telehandler while inspecting it before use. The employee was hospitalized for a tear to the small intestine.
An employee was walking into a wind tower to check on a restart failure inside the cabinet at the base of the wind turbine. An arc flash caused burns to the employee's chest, neck, and face.
An employee was getting out of a parked semi cab. He slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a tear to his spleen.
An employee was unjamming a ring from a compounder machine when the machine finished a cycle and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, doing maintenance on an overhead gantry crane. The crane moved and pushed the scissor lift over. He fell and was impaled on a piece of equipment on a table below, suffering internal injuries. He was hospitalized.
On June 5, 2020, a utility cart and a golf cart collided. The golf cart's driver fell out of the cart and suffered a hip injury. The employee was hospitalized.

On June 5, 2020, an employee was straightening a sheet of veneer from the out-feed of a dryer machine. The employee's left hand and glove were caught in a chain and sprocket in the machine, causing amputations to his left little, ring, and middle fingers at the first joint and his right index fingertip above the first joint.

An employee had placed a piece of sheet metal into a folding machine and was operating the machine when the metal slipped further into the machine. The top plate came down on the employee's left middle fingertip, causing an amputation.
An employee had been loading a mail truck when she was found unconscious on the ground. She was suffering from brain bleeding, having struck her head.
An employee fell through a skylight on a roof, landing on the floor below and suffering a broken leg.
An employee fell about 6 feet from a communications repeater affixed to a building. He suffered fractures to both heels.
An employee was using a saw to cut metal roofing materials when he slipped and his left hand contacted the saw blade, resulting in full index, middle, and ring finger amputations.
An employee was cutting meat with a meat saw. The saw amputated part of his finger.
An employee was guiding a wall into place. The wall came down on the employee's left index finger, amputating part of it.
An employee who had been irrigating mushrooms fell through open floorboards to the level below. The employee was hospitalized with a head laceration.
An employee fell through a floor hole in an elevated platform, landing about 6 feet below and suffering a head laceration.
An employee was trying to unjam a pulley on a forming machine when the wire rope on the pulley let go and pulled her thumb under it, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was holding a small plastic cap in his teeth while preparing to take a carbon dioxide sample. The cap went back into his throat and became lodged in his trachea. The cap eventually became logged in his lung.
An employee was aligning a pump on its base when it slid and smashed his fingers, causing amputations to his fingertips.
On June 5, 2020, an employee was using a table saw to cut wood trim when the blade caused lacerations to the middle finger, index finger, and thumb of the left hand requiring hospitalization.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack. As he was turning in a warehouse aisle, his left ankle was pinned between the pallet jack and a product.

While delivering mail, an employee was startled by a dog causing him to back up and fall over a rail, landing on the ground 12 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with two skull fractures and a broken wrist.

An employee was standing on the intermediate platform on the 22nd floor, holding the end of a concrete chute. He was casting the lower section of a set of stairs which spanned between the 22nd and 23rd floors. The concrete chute hung from a concrete hopper that was set up on the 27th floor, and consisted of a series of chutes fastened to one another by interlocking chains on either side. The employee felt a violent jerk and the chute, which was filled with concrete, slammed into his right knee and leg. He lunged forward and fell down to the framed lower stairs. The rest of the chutes continued to fall from above. The employee sustained a fractured femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a plastic drum when the saw skipped/slipped and caused a cut to the bones in his left forearm just above the wrist.

An employee tripped over a metal grate while walking into a building at a construction site. The employee fell forward and extended his left arm toward the wall adjacent to the doorway to prevent himself from falling. His arm struck the wall and the humerus was broken. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pouring corrosive cleaning chemicals into equipment when some of the chemical splashed onto the employee's wrist, causing chemical burns.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift through an aisleway. The forklift ran into a support column, pinning the employee's left leg against the column. The employee suffered a leg injury that required surgery.
An employee became faint while directing a queue outside. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.

An employee was trying to get animals from their enclosure inside for the night. He opened the door for the smaller, siamang animals, but one of the animals would not go inside. As he went to retrieve his keys from the open door, an orangutan in a separate enclosure grabbed his hand and bit him. The employee suffered a puncture wound on his right forearm and a broken finger on his right hand. He was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was spotting a forklift as it pulled forward into a storage building. The employee's foot was caught under the forklift's wheel, and the employee suffered a broken foot/lower leg.
An employee was walking from the water cooler back to the table when her leg gave out. She landed on the floor and sustained a fractured hip requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An LSC Communications security guard was performing security checks throughout the facility while operating a three-wheeled electric cart. The cart struck a vertical steel I-beam, causing the employee to continue forward and contact the edge of the I-beam and then fall to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with lacerations on the forehead and nose, and fractures to the forehead and right cheek bone.
On 6/6/2020, an employee received an electrical shock to his left hand and right forearm while performing a harness connection to a solar module. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a slab from a paper roll (to address two breaks that had happened near each other on the paper machine rewinder). The employee was tucking the paper back into the infeed between the bed roll and the finished roll when the nip point pulled the employee's arm in, about to the elbow. The employee suffered soft tissue damage.
An employee was walking down steps when he fell to the cement ground, suffering ligament damage to his knee.

An employee was standing in a basket getting ready to repair a downed powerline. While attempting to attach a ground wire to the top of a neutral wire on a pole, the employee received an electrical shock.
An employee was using a napkin to wipe away dirt on a macerator machine. The employee's left hand was pulled into the machine, and its knives amputated two of the employee's fingers.
Two employees were working on a pad mount transformer. One employee tripped on a rock and fell into the open equipment. An arc flash burned the employee's left hand and arm.
An employee was cleaning floors in a deli. The employee slipped over a deli slicer stand leg and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee had climbed a 10-foot ladder to unhook a chain from a crane when he fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering multiple vertebrae injuries and a fractured clavicle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in the break room when her right foot caught the leg of a chair causing her to fall on her right side and fracture a hip.

An employee was climbing down a ladder into an 18-wheeler trailer to change out the load level indicator. The leg of the ladder shifted and the employee fell approximately three feet into the trailer breaking their lower right leg.
A part being machined with a CNC machine hit a door on the machine where an employee was working. The door in turn hit the employee, bruising the employee's torso.
An employee was repairing a pipe joint and was inserting another pipe. His finger was at the edge of the pipe and when he inserted the pipe section his fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on top of a concrete finishing machine to reach a generator that was mounted to the unit. As he was moving the generator, the plywood it was sitting on gave way. The employee fell from a concrete finishing machine to the ground; the generator fell on his leg, breaking his left shin and foot.
An employee was dismantling a car. While the employee was cutting out a seat belt with a box cutter, the cutter severely lacerated the employee's left index finger.
A temporary employee had been closing a door. A forklift backed into the employee causing a broken leg that required surgery.

An employee was directing the driver of a truck. The truck's right front tire drove over the employee's lower left leg (below the knee) and onto the right leg near the calf. The truck was then backed off the employee. The employee was hospitalized with swelling, a contusion, and a blood clot.
An employee was approaching a resident to collect enumerating data and was bitten on the right calf by a dog causing a laceration.
An employee was starting a roll of metal building insulation. His right hand was caught in the roller and pulled in. The employee sustained a broken right hand.
An employee was unclogging a dust collector on a binder machine. The machine amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
While jack hammering concrete, an employee slipped and fell 5 feet.
An employee was removing concrete with a jackhammer when he made contact with a buried electrical line and received an electrical shock.
An employee was sitting in a buggy entering measurement data for drilling, when he started feeling ill. He was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was working on the demolition of electrical wiring in a school. The employee fell from a ladder to the floor, sustaining a cut on the head and broken ribs.
An employee was driving a truck on a construction site when it overturned. The employee sustained a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was handing out water when he stepped into a walk-behind trowel machine that was running. The employee was injured by the blade of the walk-behind trowel resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was waiting to disconnect a box blade attachment from a tractor. The attachment rolled onto the employee's right foot, crushing the tip of the big toe.
An employee slipped on oil in a dry storeroom and fell to the floor, suffering a dislocated right elbow and a broken right arm.

An employee drove a forklift into the aerosol room with a pallet of product on the forks. She drove down the back driveway to the aisle of racking she needed to turn into. The forklift drove through salt brine that was on the floor and slid into a concrete bollard at the end of that aisle. The employee's left foot got caught between the bollard and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized with four broken toes and a laceration to the left foot.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet kitchen floor, suffering an injury to the right hip. The employee was hospitalized.

A technician was removing a drive shaft from a truck. He disconnected the drive shaft from the transmission and then unbolted the swing bearing. When the shaft came free, it fell off the transmission jack that was supporting it and landed on his right hand. The hand was crushed and the pinky finger was amputated.
An employee fell in a parking lot. His head struck the pavement and he suffered a brain bleed.
An employee was preparing to install a piece of steel angle iron when it fell from the top flange of a beam, striking the employee and causing a shoulder injury that required surgery.
While walking, an employee tripped on a pallet and fell breaking his lower left leg.
On June 8, 2020, an employee was walking to their car after their shift and was struck by a customer's vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to multiple body parts.

The injured employee was building a tubular scaffold to do a stucco repair on a condo. While the injured employee was receiving a scaffold frame, the employee that was handing the frame lost their grip on it, and the injured employee fell 15 ft. with the frame in hand. The injured employee sustained a compound fracture to the right leg and a laceration to the forehead.

An employee was preparing a dock plate for a truck that had just arrived at a loading deck. The employee fell from the dock plate and the truck, suffering multiple fractures to the left leg and cracked ribs on the left side. He was hospitalized.
A gas powered concrete buggy began to roll down a concrete driveway. An employee attempted to stop it and was struck by the buggy, sustaining a broken leg.
An employee was hospitalized after falling off a ladder while inspecting a battery on a crawler crane.

An employee was pulling a cart of waste onto a freight lift. He fell approximately 4.5 feet off the lift and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured clavicle, fractured pelvis, and three broken ribs.

An employee was taking apart a flange to a 2-inch pipe. Alkaline product inside the pipe sprayed onto his forehead, upper chest, and abdomen. He suffered chemical burns in those areas, including third-degree burns to the chest and abdomen.

An employee was laying down string line on the ground for an asphalt paving crew when an asphalt delivery truck backed into the employee, knocking him to the ground, and then running over his foot. He required stitches to the underside of his foot where the toes connect.

An employee was catching metal plates. The material was binding and sliding down after it was cut. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the stop and the material, sustaining a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a thread-rolling machine. Her hair got caught in the machine and her scalp was removed.

An employee was attempting to release the pressure on a breaker (excavator attachment) to remove it from the machine. The equipment's thumb released and came down, pinching the toes of his left foot between the breaker and thumb. The third toe was partially amputated.

An employee was unloading a 48-inch steel roller form a 40-ton trailer. The roller lost traction, causing it to turn 90 degrees and flip over. The right side and part of the roller landed on the employee's right foot, severing the toe next to the big toe.
An employee fell while coming down a ladder, missing the last two steps and landing on the ground. The employee's femur was broken near the hip.
An employee was cleaning a pie maker when she hit the release button, which caused the roller to close on her left hand. This resulted in an amputation of the left pinky and ring fingertips.
An employee fell off a ladder after receiving an electrical shock from a live conductor. He landed on an office partition and sustained broken ribs.
After working at an outdoor job site, an employee became overheated, sat on the steps of a truck to rest, and then lost consciousness. After awaking, he was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting up tree logs and branches, while on the ground, when the chainsaw he was using kicked out and caught his left leg. He sustained severe cuts to the calf and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee ascended stairs to make a delivery, then missed a step coming down and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured left arm, right femur, and kneecap, as well as a fracture to the nose or sinuses.
A steel coil fell off a forklift and landed on an employee's leg resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was directing a forklift. The forklift picked up a load, backed up, and ran over the employee's left foot and leg, causing fractures and severe lacerations.

An employee was standing on the tail of a truck and a dock plate to close the door. The bobtail pulled out of the dock door and the employee fell, landing on the cement about 4 feet below and suffering a dislocated knee.
An employee's left thumb was amputated while using a powered circular saw.
An employee woke in the middle of the night feeling ill and was hospitalized with a heat-related muscular injury.

After cutting a board on a table saw, an employee was walking away from the saw when he tripped. His left hand came into contact with the saw's spinning blade; the index fingertip was amputated and the thumb was broken.

An employee was hooking two trailers. As the employee was positioning a converter dolly at the first trailer, the dolly started to roll toward him. His left thumb was caught between the dolly and the lead trailer and sustained an amputation.

Two employees were pulling wires on the scissor lift. While maneuvering between a door, the scissor lift caught the face of one of the employees against the door of the electric building. The employee sustained neck and back injuries.

A brace surrounding the photo eye on the stretch wrapper machine was loose, causing the photo eye to be misaligned. This caused the chain to stop on the conveyor. An employee knelt down to adjust the brace. His hand was on the chain guard on both sides of the brace when the photo eye became aligned and the chain started up again. The chain caught his right middle finger causing a partial amputation to the distal phalanx.
A Sysco delivery driver was delivering to his last stop. He felt cramps all over his body and was hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee was on top of a press machine when his foot slipped into the press, becoming trapped. The press came down on his foot, breaking toes and amputating three toes.
A carpenter apprentice was assisting in building a form for a turbine pit when he fell approximately 5 feet to the concrete below. He landed on his left arm and sustained a broken humerus and elbow.
An employee was on a ladder. When he tried to adjust it, he and the ladder fell. The employee sustained a broken tailbone.
An employee was using a circular saw to remove a silt fence so a truck could back down the path to the work area and lacerated (soft tissue and muscle) his left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were in a fabrication shop, working on opposite ends of a 30x150 steel beam. One of them reached out to push/stop the beam as he was trying to move out of its path, but the bottom flange caught his left foot, causing a laceration and broken bones. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a duct line. As the employee was adjusting the feed, the duct line amputated his right little finger. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee jumped over a counter and fell, sustaining a fractured left ankle.
An employee was adjusting a 6-inch gutter coil machine. The machine was actuated and caught his finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was surveying a sewer system. His camera equipment touched an overhead line, causing an electrical arc that burned the employee's feet (most severely affecting the left foot).

Two employees were trying to fix a bar on a spreader truck. One of them was holding the bar when it snapped into place and pinched his gloved left hand, injuring the left little finger. The finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was hydrostatically testing a vessel when it ruptured. The employee suffered facial lacerations.
While an employee was disconnecting a sling, an I-beam slid downward pinching the employee's finger. He sustained an amputation to the left ring fingertip.
An employee was doing lawn care work when, suffering from heat stress, he began vomiting and suffered cramping in his feet.
An employee was getting out of a truck when he fell about 30 inches to the ground, suffering a possible broken hip. He was hospitalized.
On June 9, 2020, an employee was operating a full-revolution mechanical power press. The employee's right index finger got caught in the die, sustaining a partial amputation.

An employee was inserting an oxygen lance into a furnace to melt metal that had solidified over the argon injection ports. Molten metal splashed out onto the employee's face and neck, melted the employee's face shield and safety glasses, and caused first- and second-degree burns over five percent of the employee's face and neck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting boards with a compound miter saw when the blade cut his fingers, resulting in amputations to his left ring, middle, and index fingertips.
An employee fell off a 6-foot ladder while pruning a tree. The employee struck a hard surface and suffered several broken ribs and vertebrae.
An employee was making a mail delivery. While running from a dog, the employee fell to the ground and fractured her left tibia.
An employee was using a dolly to take packages up a stairway. The employee fell down the stairs, suffering a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.

A support for erecting a solar array was being driven into the ground, but had stopped due to an underground obstruction. An employee was re-connecting a chain to the ground support when the puller ram machine activated, causing the chain to rise up and tighten around the support and catch the employee's finger. The employee sustained an open fracture, laceration, and hematoma to the index finger.

An employee was climbing down a wall. The wooden cross-bracing failed when the employee stepped on it, and the employee fell 10-12 feet. The employee suffered a broken left kneecap and a broken nose, and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a forklift, raising and lowering equipment for an AC repairman to work on a unit. As he lowered the equipment on the forklift, a freon canister started to roll off the pallet, and the employee jumped off the forklift. The forklift was moving slowly and struck the employee's lower right leg, causing multiple fractures and torn ligaments.

A service clerk was helping a customer in the propane tank area. As he was exchanging a propane tank, a propane tank that was on a shelf fell and fractured the second toe on his right foot. He was hospitalized and had surgery on his right foot.

An employee was helping to guide a home elevator piston onto a jack stand. While the chain-fall was being lowered, his thumb was pinched between the bottom of the piston and the top of the piston jack. A bone in the left thumb was crushed.

After climbing an attached ladder to retrieve packages from a conveyor, an employee began climbing down the ladder when he fell off and hit his arm on the top of a control box. He punctured his right inner arm and was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to cut a small piece of tape that was taped around multiple wires with a splicing knife when he was shocked/electrocuted. His entire right arm tensed up all the way up to his shoulder, causing him to drop his splicing knife.
While tasked with checking inventory in the warehouse, an employee was stung on the left thigh by an insect. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a forklift to move pallets at a warehouse. As he was backing up the forklift, his hand went outside the forklift and was crushed between the forklift and an adjacent trailer. He was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to unclog a heat shrink machine when the machine's blade amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee suffered a twisted leg while delivering mail.

An employee was removing dough and attempting to clear a photo eye on a dough-dividing machine that was malfunctioning when the employee's right hand was caught in a shear point, resulting in the amputation of three fingers.

An employee was trying to restart a conveyor belt that would not run. The employee was checking the tension on the motor belt when the auger motor started running, causing an amputation of his left thumb above the first joint.

An employee was pushing a container to the end of a flatbed truck's bed. A forklift pushed a container while it was lifting another container from the truck's bed. The employee's right ankle got caught between two containers on the flatbed and was fractured.

An employee was on the roof checking an air handling unit when the pulley grabbed the employee's glove and pulled in the left hand, cutting the left ring finger just below the nailbed and resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working to free a trailer's roll-up door that was stuck. He grabbed a panel on the door and applied force in the opposite direction. The panel came free from the track and the momentum caused the employee to fall down onto his right side resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was checking a dust collection system when his hand was caught in a rotary blade. Four fingers were amputated.
An employee was taking measurements when an access door shut on their finger amputating the right middle fingertip.

An employee was assigned to clean all the work areas. While climbing down a fixed ladder, the employee's right index finger got caught on the grill steel surface. She lost her balance and fell approximately 10-12 feet to the ground, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.
While removing the roof of a mobile home, an employee fell approximately 10 feet from the roof to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a strained lower back.
After operating a paver screed, an employee became ill and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift blade became caught on a piece of metal over the expansion joint on a dock surface, causing the forklift to abruptly stop. The employee was buckled but his head impacted the forklift's front guard. He was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was carrying a bucket of water. The bucket fell to the floor; then the employee fell, suffering second- and third-degree burns to the arm and stomach from the water.

An employee was closing a cardboard baler with his left hand. He pulled down the door and continued to hang onto the handle of the cardboard baler with his left hand as it closed. He reached with his right hand to start the baler. As he did this, his left pinky and ring fingers were caught in the baler, which started to pull his fingers in. His fingers were then caught on the safety mechanism.
An employee drove a car into the shop that had been treated with an anti-odor, anti-mold chemical. The employee was hospitalized for chest pain and symptoms of an allergic reaction to the chemical.
An employee was sanding a pole sander from the top of a 6-foot stepladder when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. The employee suffered broken bones.
An employee was cutting a laminated board with a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's right thumb and ring finger and lacerated the index and middle fingers.
An employee was walking when he tripped and fell to the floor fracturing his right tibia.
An employee was cleaning a fryer when the employee's hand slipped and hot oil splashed the employee's chest, face, left shoulder, and left hand/arm.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was backing out of a trailer on a warehouse dock, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee had been operating a gasoline powered water pump. When the water pump ran out of gasoline, the employee went to add gasoline and the gasoline fumes ignited. The employee was burned on the left hand, left arm, and left leg.

An employee had been performing maintenance on an air compressor. The employee was testing the voltage on the motor control panel when an arc flash occurred. The employee was treated for second and third degree burns to the arm and both hands.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood when the saw partially severed his right-hand index, middle, and ring fingers.

While sandblasting, an employee lost his grip on the sand blasting nozzle. The nozzle recoiled back at the employee's leg and blast grit embedded into the skin on his leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was hand wrapping a skid to repair a section that was torn. The employee was walking counter-clockwise around the skid when the wrapping broke and he lost balance. The employee fell and sustained a fractured right femur.
At about 11:15 a.m. on June 10, 2020, an employee was in a tree, performing utility line clearing. His chainsaw struck the top of his left hand, lacerating it. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell into a hole while walking and broke his leg.
After performing work in a vault, a mechanic was climbing up a ladder when his hand slipped and he fell 8 feet to the bottom of the vault. He sustained a leg injury that required surgery.

An employee was surveying for plants in a canyon. While hiking through the canyon, a rock dislodged and stuck the employee on the left ankle and foot. The employee sustained fractures to the ankle and foot.
An employee opened a box that contained cashews and almonds and experienced an allergic reaction to the nuts.

An employee was operating a stand-up lift in the warehouse when it started to slide on water that was on the floor and struck a column (rack). The employee sustained fractures to a toe on his left foot.
An employee was turning into the company parking lot when his tractor trailer tipped over. The employee sustained lacerations and a broken shoulder.

On June 11, 2020, at 1:30 PM an employee was operating the radius bending machine. He was bending two pieces of rebar, when his glove got stuck between the two pieces and pulled his left hand into the machine's gears. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation and a fractured finger.
An employee walked into her cube, tripped over her chair, and hit her eye on her chair leg. She was hospitalized with a broken left leg and a right eye injury that required surgery.

An employee was assisting a forklift operator move an oxy/acetylene cutting rig. The employee's hand got caught between a fork and the lifting eye on the cutting rig, causing a fracture to the index metacarpal bone in the hand.

An electric pallet jack operator was traveling down an aisle attempting to pass another stopped pallet jack, when his pallet/load got caught on another pallet in a pick location. The operator lost his balance when the equipment stopped suddenly, and his hand engaged the throttle, causing the pallet jack to move forward. His right foot had slipped off the platform and became pinned between the platform and racking. The operator was hospitalized with a fractured right foot.

An employee was standing at the box making machine's manual conveyor. The employee's foot got caught on the fixed leg of the conveyor. The employee's knee then buckled and she fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right patella and a fractured left humerus.

An employee was helping a patient get up out of bed. The patient pulled down on her to stand up, and the employee felt a sharp pain in her mid-right back. The next day, the employee experienced shortness of breath and was hospitalized for a back strain and collapsed lung.
An employee was connecting an airline from a tractor trailer when he slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.

An employee was stepping out of the back of his parts truck, using the grab bar. He stepped down onto the bumper of another truck that was parked right next to his truck. His boot got stuck and he slipped and twisted his leg. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia.
A driver exited the truck in front of a fuel island. The truck proceeded to roll and pinned the driver against the fuel island. The driver sustained a fractured foot and pelvis.

An employee was adjusting the guardrail of an elevated lift platform. The employee was pushing the guardrail up while another employee, who was standing on the lift, was pushing down on the guardrail. The injured employee got his right middle finger caught in a pinch point on the guardrail and sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee working in a meat cooler opened the cooler door to exit when his finger was caught between the door handle and the wall on the cooler. The employee's middle finger on his left hand was amputated.

On June 11, 2020, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was diagnosing why a breaker kept tripping on a dust extraction system at a grain dryer facility. As the employee was cleaning out the dust near the airlocks, the system started. The fan blades then amputated all four of his fingers on his right hand.

An employee was unloading a super sack that was hoisted by a forklift into a hopper when the loops that hold the super sack up broke, causing the sack to fall onto the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg requiring surgery.

An employee was descending a light pole and stepped onto an A-frame ladder in the closed position. The ladder gave way and the employee fell approximately 8 feet to the ground level, suffering right hip and right rib injuries.

An employee was walking from the maintenance shop to the warehouse area. He was struck in the back by a sit-down forklift that was carrying two stacks of oriented strand board (OSB) that had been recently heat-treated. Each stack weighed approximately 3,500 pounds and had a temperature of approximately 250 degrees Fahrenheit. The employee sustained burn injuries to his lower back and buttocks, a puncture wound to his right forearm, and contusions to his ribs.
An employee was operating a forklift to unload a truck when the truck moved, causing the employee to fall to the ground and suffer a spinal injury.

An employee was working from the ceiling joists while installing ductwork on a single-family residential house under new construction when one of the joists broke apart, causing him to fall approximately 23 feet to the concrete floor below. He fractured both wrists and his left elbow.

An employee was removing a lug on a cylinder mount. He fell from the railing, outside the shredder, approximately 12 feet onto concrete and scrap metal. The employee was unconscious and sustained internal bleeding and head injuries.
An employee collapsed while moving merchandize and experienced shortness of breath, facial tingling, and numbness in his face and hand. He was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee was preparing to close the roll-up door on the back of a package delivery truck. He stepped backwards to place his foot on the lift gate and fell approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated and fractured elbow that required surgery.

An employee was conducting an emissions test of a nitrogen vaporizer unit inside an instrument test trailer when a pipe explosion occurred outside. Pieces of the steel pipe scattered in all directions, including toward the trailer. As a result, the employee suffered a fractured right radius bone, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was installing a new elevator, working from a false elevator car in the shaft. A railing on the false car fell apart and the employee fell through it, landing 23 feet below in the pit of the elevator shaft. The employee suffered a broken foot, dislocated shoulder, and broken pelvis.
An employee was going onto a roof to retrieve a tool when the employee fell from the roof to scaffolding and then to a catwalk. The employee suffered broken ribs.

An employee was attempting to remove the lid from a plastic container by applying heat with a torch to loosen the top. The liquid inside the container heated up and the container burst open under pressure, spraying the employee who suffered first and second degree burns to the front of his body.
An employee was applying edge protectors on top of a load of drywall on a flatbed truck. He fell to the ground, suffering broken vertebrae and bleeding under the skin.
An employee was operating a scissor lift using the remote control box. The employee was struck by the lift and his foot was broken. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out scrap from a 100-ton press. The machine started and amputated four fingers of his left hand at the first knuckle.

An employee was using an industrial lifting magnet to pick up a steel plate when the magnet dropped the steel plate. The employee had his left ring finger on the table when the plate dropped, smashing the fingertip, which had to be amputated.

An employee was cleaning a room with a mop. The employee stepped backward and their foot became entangled in the mop. The employee tripped and fell backward to the floor, resulting in a back injury and a hip contusion.
An employee was working while a running forklift was parked nearby. The forklift began to roll and struck the employee, resulting in hospitalization for a broken leg.

An employee was working inside a manhole, trying to connect an air gun to the an compressor. Air pressure built up; the air gun popped off and hit him between his elbow and wrist on his left arm. He developed cellulitis and was hospitalized.

A carpenter was stripping column forms when his right middle fingertip was pinched between the brackets on the hinge side. The fingernail and skin on the fingertip were removed and the bone was fractured.
An employee was attempting to remove a plastic label from a plastic blow molding machine when the machine amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
While exiting from a truck, an employee stepped into a pot hole and fell, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was on a ladder using a chainsaw to trim trees above a residential home. The employee lost his footing on the ladder, causing the chainsaw to slip and lacerate his right forearm.

A temporary employee was operating a shear to cut rebar. The employee was removing two pieces of rebar from the gauge table when his finger was pinched between a piece of rebar, the prybar he was using, and the gauge table. This resulted in surgical amputation of the right middle fingertip, just below the fingernail.
An employee was supervising the clearing of a floor drain when he slipped on wet cheese powder. He fell on the floor and broke his left hip.
An employee was stocking chemicals on shelves and fell off a step ladder, hitting his head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was helping to move a hay trailer on a dolly. The hay trailer fell off the dolly and struck the employee between the knee and upper part of the leg resulting in hospitalization with a possible fracture.
While placing a piece of nonwoven geotextile along the shoreline bank, a bucket excavator struck an employee resulting in a broken pelvis and fractured ribs requiring hospitalization.
An employee flagging traffic was hit by a vehicle's passenger side fender and side mirror. The employee sustained contusions.
An employee was disconnecting an attachment on a skid steer when the arms dropped a little and caught him on the hip against the machine. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee was offloading sliding glass doors. After removing a strap, the employee was walking away and the doors fell on him. The employee was hospitalized with a cervical fracture.
Two employees were working inside of a water tower to erect scaffolding when they fell approximately 40 feet to the ground.
An employee was standing near a shaft while it was being moved with an overhead crane. The shaft bumped into another shaft which hit the employee's foot. His right foot was fractured.
An employee tripped and fell while walking and sustained a fractured elbow.

An employee was picking up construction debris behind a skid steer when the skid steer backed into him and ran over his foot, breaking two bones in his right ankle. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

A maintenance employee was attempting to clear a jam on a conveyor. The employee's hand was between the conveyor bars when the equipment moved and cut the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting a press. The employee had used a ladder to reach a portion of the press when the press activated and caused a partial amputation to his left middle fingertip.
An employee standing on a scaffold was helping to guide a load onto the roof. The back of his left hand was cut when it contacted the edge of the building's tin roof.

Two employees were operating high reach stand-up forklifts. Employee 1 was traveling north along an aisle in a room while employee 2 was putting away a pallet in the same aisle. Employee 1 jumped out of his forklift and was crushed between his forklift and employee 2's forklift. Employee 1 was hospitalized with a pelvic fracture.

An employee was injured when another employee driving a pickup truck backed into him, pinning him between the truck and heavy equipment. He was hospitalized with a puncture laceration to the right buttocks.
While lifting a case of drinks, an employee suffered damage to a pre-existing hernia. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was handling a ladder on a sales floor when his left little finger got caught in the rungs. As the ladder tipped over, the finger was amputated at the knuckle.
An employee entered a patient's room, tripped over the patient's shoes, and fell on her right knee. The knee was fractured.

On June 13, 2020, an employee was conducting touch-up paint work on traffic arrows on the asphalt parking lot. The employee had set up cones around the work area. The employee was struck by a customer's vehicle resulting in crushing injuries to the lower left leg.

A driver was pulling a pallet of dry product onto the liftgate of a delivery truck using a manual pallet jack. The weight of the pallet pushed him back against the chain on the liftgate causing him to lose balance and fall backward. His right leg was pinned between the pallet, the manual jack, and the chain. The driver was holding onto the chain while hanging from the gate and was able to pull his leg free. The driver was hospitalized with a broken right lower leg.

An employee was torch cutting springs on a boiler. When the spring being worked on would not come off, the employee went to remove it by hand, and the spring struck his hand. The employee sustained a palm laceration and a fractured right middle finger.
An employee was driving a forklift down an enclosed corridor when the forklift struck a steel rack.  The employee's left foot was crushed between the forklift and the steel rack.
An employee was traveling through an aisle on a forklift when it skidded on a powder substance that was on the floor and struck a storage rack. The employee's left ankle was broken in five places.
An employee was riding a motorcycle on a trail when the front tire hit a rock and the employee was thrown from the motorcycle. The employee sustained a broken leg and a broken wrist.
An employee fell from a metal roof that was being removed and replaced. The employee landed on a concrete floor about 22 feet below, suffering skull and neck fractures.
An employee was performing an audit of the cash in the safe when their right thumb was caught and amputated by the safe door as it was closing.
An employee was trying to reach for a document when he fell to the ground and broke his leg.
An employee was on a rig floor walkway removing a wireline top tree flange when the walkway collapsed to the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg and a head laceration.
An employee was cleaning a discharge auger at the bag house when his right middle and ring fingers were caught and amputated in the rotating auger.

An employee was cutting metal when his left ring finger was caught under a metal clamp. Once he pressed the pedal to actuate the cutter, his finger was crushed from the nail to the fingertip causing it to be amputated.
An employee operating a reach truck struck a bollard pole and sustained a left lower leg fracture.
A cashier was checking out and assisting a customer when she tripped over a flat cart and fell to the floor. She sustained a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving plastic tote containers when he fell to the surface. He was hospitalized, suffering from neck, back, leg, and arm pain.

On June 13, 2020, an employee fell down the stairs at his house and fractured his foot. The next day, he went to work and was pulling a parts cart up a ramp when he felt his foot pop. He was hospitalized, and his foot had to be amputated.

On June 15, 2020, an employee was operating a punch press when his left hand entered the die area of the press. The foot pedal was then pressed, causing the machine to cycle and crush the employee's left palm and four fingers. As a result, the employee's left index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was assisting a resident when she got caught and tripped on the patient s bedding and fell to the floor, breaking her tibia and fibula. The employee required surgery.

An employee was cleaning glue from the roller of a glue machine when the employee's hand was caught in the roller, resulting in torn ligaments. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was operating a roller machine to seal coat on asphalt when the employee swerved to avoid a dog and the roller machine rolled down a hillside. As a result, the employee sustained four fractured ribs and a burned right leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling wire through a cabinet using a chugger when the cabinet tipped over onto the employee, who suffered two fractured ribs and three fractured vertebrae.
An employee was using his right arm to release a package jam. He suffered an overextension-related injury to the right shoulder.
An employee had just checked a vehicle's exhaust from a lift. As the employee moved from the lift to a stool, he fell about 4 feet to the floor and suffered a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.

At about 2:30 p.m. on June 15, 2020, a temporary employee was drilling holes in the outside wall of a house (to install shutters) when he became lightheaded due to heat exhaustion and dehydration. He was hospitalized.

An employee was tightening straps on a 3,000-pound wire ram. Straps on the opposite side became loose and the ram began to dig into the ground, then fell and pinned the employee to the ground. The employee suffered a lower lumbar compression.
An employee was doing caulking work from a scaffold when he fell. He landed on the ground about 8 feet below, suffering a dislocated shoulder and broken femur.
An employee was climbing a ladder out of a chip pit. When he reached the top, he fell straight down about 10 feet to the concrete floor, breaking both his heel bones.
An employee developed heat-related dizziness and a headache while finishing a collection route.
On 6/15/20, an employee began cramping and became ill due to possible heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized.
An off-center fan belt was turned and pulled an employee's left hand between the pulley and the belt. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was painting the exterior of a home from a 12-foot ladder. The employee fell from the ladder and landed on a patio, suffering multiple broken ribs and a large gash on the head. He was hospitalized.
A truck driver was moving the seal of a leaking pump. His right index finger got stuck in a valve, which amputated the fingertip.

An employee arrived at the shop to pick up parts. He used a lift jack to move crates, uncrated a crate, took the parts out and set them on the side. There was a heavy metal pole that is used for the lift jacks that fell off the shelf and hit his hand. He sustained the amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was holding down the hose pump to transfer chemicals from the dip tank to a tote. The employee was exposed via inhalation to phosphoric acid resulting in chemical burns to the lung.

An employee was working the hand brake to stop a railcar. The hand brake jammed causing the railcar to bump into a shop truck that was on the same line. The employee's right hand got caught between the railcar and the shop truck, causing the amputation of the index finger, middle finger, and thumb.

An employee was machining a component on a horizontal boring mill when the employee's glove was caught in the rotating boring instrument, resulting in the amputation of the employee's right hand thumb.

An employee was using a portable ladder to access the second level of the roof from the first level. The bottom of the ladder slid out, causing the employee to fall to the first level. He suffered fractured vertebrae.

Two employees were pushing a cart that was fully loaded with drywall sheets (weighting about 600 pounds) when the cart's wheel fell into a hole in the ground. The cart tilted and the drywall sheets fell onto one employee, pushing him backward. He landed on top of another drywall stack and sustained a back injury.
An employee was performing maintenance on a fuse box when the fuse box caught on fire. The employee sustained burns to his arms and was hospitalized.

On June 15, 2020, at approximately 8:00 AM, an employee (temporary employee contracted to site) was reaching over a turkey gizzard processing machine when her gloved hand became trapped in the machine. The employee sustained a fractured thumb and was hospitalized.

A crew blew a tire on the highway. They decided to change the tire. After changing the tire, they were placing the damaged tire back on the trailer when the tire slipped and pinched the injured employee's right pinky finger, amputating the top inch.
An employee was turning off a valve with a wrench when he developed a hernia. He was hospitalized.

While an employee was performing routine maintenance on the conveyor system, the conveyors turned on and pulled the employee's right hand through the sprocket. Four fingers on the right hand were amputated.
An employee was operating a front deck lawnmower when he drove into some stairs. His finger was pinned and fractured.

An employee was using his right hand to clean residual dough out of a trough. The door to the trough was locked in the up position while the employee was cleaning out the excess dough. The employee bumped the trough and the door suddenly released and slid down, striking the employee's right hand and resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.

An employee was working in the mechanical room doing an inspection on the air handler (checking belts, bearings, pulleys, etc. for vibration). He put his left hand on the inboard bearing and was rolling the belts to rotate the shaft while feeling the bearing for abnormal vibration or noises. The belt grabbed his glove and pulled his right hand into the groove of the pulley and belt. He sustained lacerations at two fingertips on the right hand without bone loss.

An employee had a mandrel in the vertical position in a vise. As the employee was opening the vise to release the mandrel, the mandrel tipped to the right, causing the employee's right hand to move to the right. During this process, the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the jaw casting and body casting of the vise, causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.

Two employees were removing a door from a control room to take out a refrigerator while another employee was lying on the ground removing screws to disassemble a countertop. The door was let go and it fell over, striking the employee that was lying on the ground. The injured employee was hospitalized with a broken lower left leg and a dislocated ankle.
An employee was mowing a terrace lawn on a zero-turn mower when the mower got close to a hill and flipped sideways. The employee suffered a broken hip/pelvis.

An employee was unloading a mail cart when the cart rolled away on the parking lot surface incline. The employee chased after the cart and fell to the parking lot surface, fracturing his right forearm. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
A mini-loader was carrying flowers to a planting area. An employee was planting flowers when the bucket of the mini-loader pinned his leg to a cement structure, resulting in a left ankle fracture.

An employee was changing blades in a bag machine. While reaching to orient the new blade assembly with both hands, his left-hand glove was pulled under the drive belt guard and into the drive belt resulting in amputation of the left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was fixing a hydraulic hose on an industrial trash compactor. While his right hand was holding the hose that goes to the ram of the compactor, the compactor actuated. Up to 6500 PSI of hydraulic fluid shot out of a small hole in the hose and pierced a hole in the pad of the employee s right index finger.

An employee was driving a company vehicle (bucket truck). As they passed by a convenience store, they were struck in the neck by a stray bullet that may have been shot as part of a shootout that occurred at the convenience store.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground while walking in the breakroom, suffering a left femoral fracture.
An employee was rigging a precast panel. A metal pole brace came loose from the precast column and struck the employee on the left shoulder, causing broken left-side ribs and a possible concussion.

An employee was operating a standup counter-balanced forklift and was traveling toward a unit of plank siding with the forks trailing. He tried to stop the lift using the dead man pedal. His right foot was crushed between the lift and the plank siding.

An employee was backing a forklift out of a trailer when the truck's roll-up door rolled down about 6 inches. He pushed it up using his hand and pressed the accelerator. His hand was then caught between the forklift cage and the truck's roll-up door, suffering fractures. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the top rung of an 8-foot ladder that was placed on a hill. While the employee was stretching to screw a strap to the wall, the ladder tipped over, causing the employee to fall and sustain a broken left leg below the knee.
An employee was operating an asphalt fiber feeder. His glove was caught in the drive chain, which amputated three of his fingers. The drive chain was not guarded at the time.

An employee was training to pack boxes on the extruding line. While reaching for a lid, the employee's left pinky finger was caught in the slat conveyor. The left pinky fingertip was amputated to the first knuckle at the hospital.
An employee was using a chain saw to cut into a birch tree branch at ground level when the chain saw kicked back and severely lacerated the employee's bicep. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when her foot went between grass and the sidewalk. She rolled her ankle and fell on her right shoulder and elbow, fracturing both.

An employee was sitting down at the break table. When she went to get up from the table, her feet became twisted and she fell to the side. She was hospitalized with a bruised elbow, sprained ankle, and possible hip fractures.

An employee was operating a miller machine to pour a concrete mow strip in the center median of the highway. He dismounted the machine complaining of a headache due to the heat/exhaust of the machine. He started having trouble breathing and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was working on a trim side winder line and was attempting to secure two tether brackets using a secure gun. The employee was using the secure gun while holding the bracket when the bracket spun and struck the breakaway gloves, causing them to break but still catch the employee's finger and cause a compound fracture to the finger.

On June 16, 2020, at approximately 5:00 PM, an employee reached to use controls to lower a hydraulic part of a trailer. The truck was on a hill and the unmovable part of the trailer moved and pinched his forearm against a concrete beam. He was hospitalized with injury to the right forearm.

An employee was elevated in the bucket of a back hoe and was using a bottle jack to straighten the body of a dump truck under repair. The bottle jack became dislodged and struck the employee in the face. The employee was propelled backwards and hit the back of their head against the bucket of the back hoe, sustaining a head injury.
An employee was operating a continuous draw machine when his right hand entered the point of operation, resulting in the amputation of the two middle fingers.

An employee was operating a forklift to move pallets out of a slot when his left calf was pinned and fractured between the forklift and a rack. His foot was outside the forklift at the time of the incident. He was hospitalized.

A welder was drilling 2-inch thick steel plate with a magnetic drill. He was brushing filings away from the drill bit when his glove was caught by the drill and his hand was pulled in. The drill bit amputated his left pinky finger above the knuckle.
An employee was thrown off a horse and sustained a broken clavicle, three broken ribs, and a possible punctured lung.
At 9:35 AM on June 16, 2020, an employee was cutting potatoes to make French fries when the potato cutter amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was standing in the basement at the project site when a mini-skid steer struck the employee from behind in the back of the leg. The employee sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was lifting a box that weighed no more than 25 pounds and experienced pain in the abdomen. The employee sustained a hernia requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting a countertop with a cordless circular saw when the saw cut his finger, resulting in a 3/4-inch amputation.

An employee was performing a tire exchange service. During the air up process on the rim clamp tire equipment, the tire sidewall failed/exploded, causing the rim and tire assembly to strike the employee in the left arm/wrist area. The employee was hospitalized with left arm injuries.
An employee was cutting lettuce with a vegetable grip arm when the employee's left index finger contacted the slicer blade, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a cut-to-length slitter machine. A piece of 0.036 metal sheeting became stuck and he was attempting to dislodge it when three fingers became entangled. The fingers were broken and required surgery.
An employee was rolling a roll-off box to the ground when his right middle finger was caught between the box and it's rail resulting in an amputation.

An employee was taking inventory of lighting fixtures in the hallway and then proceeded to come down the stairs. The employee slipped and fell down the stairs, which were wet because wax was being stripped. The employee's head struck the stairs and he sustained three broken bones in his left arm. He was hospitalized and required surgery on his arm.

An employee was preparing to put a camper in a frame. He raised the jig while his hand was resting on the block. When he lowered the jig, his left thumb was caught between the I-beam and the block, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a flipover. While bolts were being removed, the inner frame of the flipover fell and landed on the employee's foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using an overhead hoist to move a partial tub filled with components when his finger was caught in the hoist. The employee sustained a partial amputation to one finger.
An employee was walking across the dock when he fell and tripped over a handheld pallet wrapper, breaking his right ankle.
An employee was refueling a company vehicle at a fueling station when the pump spilled gas on the ground. The employee slipped on the gas and fell to the ground, sustaining a torn tendon.

An employee was using a drill press to drill out a plug in a turbo housing. He wanted to change the drill bit and thought the drill press was in neutral. As he reached under the turbo housing, his right middle finger came in contact with the still-spinning drill bit, causing  a severe laceration that resulted in an amputation to the first digit.
While sweeping and cleaning up garbage an employee fell 10 feet through a stair hole. The employee landed on the floor and sustained a head injury.
An employee was working in the shop in the tire machine when the machine crushed the employee's left hand.
An employee was checking the rotation of a fill machine. A sharp edge cut the employee's left middle finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee sat down on his tool box. His left middle finger was then pinched between the lid and the box, resulting in a finger amputation with bone loss.
An employee was operating a stand-on commercial mower when the employee fell off the mower, suffering a laceration and broken heel.
An employee was standing on the deck of a flatbed truck getting ready to un-tarp a load. When he pulled the tarp, he lost balance and fell to the ground sustaining abrasions and a sore hip.

An employee was using a cutting torch to remove rusted bolts off a spreader buggy when his hand slipped and the torch flame made contact with his left hand. He sustained burn injures to his left thumb and index finger.

A employee was grinding a metal bar on a floor grinder. The bar became caught between the work rest and grinding wheel. The employee's right middle fingertip was amputated when the bar was pulled by the grinding wheel.
An employee had just finished operating a crane. While exiting the cab, the employee rolled his ankle and fell to the ground. He sustained a fractured ankle and possible tendon damage.
An employee was delivering mail when a dog approached him. As he reached for his dog spray and retreated, he tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken wrist.

An employee was changing the trash bag on a shim vacuum when he attempted to check the vacuum impeller for a clog. The moving impeller blades then amputated his right ring fingertip and 1 inch from his right index fingertip. The vacuum was energized at the time of the incident.
An employee was performing an operational test on a muffin depositor when his right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a bottle blow molding machine when he dropped his cell phone through the front opening of the machine. He activated the machine to move forward and attempted to retrieve his cell phone. While bending over, he touched the stop button, which caused the machine to reverse into the home position. The employee then became pinned when the panel moved into the home position, injuring his left arm and upper torso on the left side.

An employee was walking on a ramp to deliver a laundry cart when she took a step backwards and her foot was caught in a cart track. She fell to the ground and fractured her ankle, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working at their workstation. The employee changed direction and tripped over a pallet falling to the floor and fracturing the left knee.

An employee was in the process of cutting a coil of steel when the coil sprung open, catching his left leg and pinning it to the ground. He sustained a severe injury to his left ankle and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was connecting a bucket attachment to a front loader when the employee's right index finger was caught between the locking pin and the circular hole attachment point, amputating the fingertip.
On June 17, 2020, an employee was cleaning a grain chute and was caught in the chute when their neck was pinched by a grain chute lever and injured.

An employee was starting the hammer mill line from the control station. Once the start button is activated a short delay occurs before the machine starts moving. The employee then ran down two flights of stairs, lifted the rubber cover on the chute for the elevator bucket, and was caught by the equipment as it started to move. The employee sustained fractures to the ulna and radius in his right forearm and the right index finger was amputated to the second knuckle.
