An employee was using a grinder to clean a part when the grinding wheel contacted the employee's hand. The employee sustained an open fracture to his left pinky finger.
An employee operating a forklift attempted to stop at a stop sign and slid into a flatbed cart, suffering a fractured leg.

An employee was about to start winding the core of a hose on a reel, which requires attaching the end of the core to an air inlet on the side of the reel. The reel becomes automated once the hose core is attached and begins to spin. When she went to attach the core to the air inlet, the reel began to automatically spin. Her hand was caught between the spinning reel and a clamp that holds the pin in, resulting in a fracture to the second metacarpal bone of the left hand.

A coil repair technician was using a drill press when the drill press caught the glove on his left hand and pulled his hand into the press. He sustained injury to the left hand that required surgery and a partial amputation of the thumb.

An employee was operating a forklift truck. His left hand was outside the cage area of forklift as he was moving parallel to a storage rack. He positioned his left hand on one of the rack beams and then slightly turned the truck with his right hand. The truck maneuvered at an angle, and the rear cage frame struck his left hand.
An employee was walking to her car to put some supplies in it when she tripped over a concrete parking block and fell forward, fracturing her pelvis in two places.
An employee was involved in an accident while riding an ATV, suffering an arm injury.
An employee was taking a break from laying sod. When he went to get up, he fell backward and needed assistance to get up. He suffered from dehydration.

An employee and other employees were transporting a 400-pound gastric bypass patient on a machine-powered bed. The bed accelerated, pinning the employee's leg between the bed and the wall. The employee was hospitalized with a broken lower right leg.

An employee was operating a machine used to manufacture wire mesh when a spool on the turn table shifted. As he was attempting to adjust it, the table created a shear point and amputated his right index fingertip down to the knuckle.
While installing roof decking, an employee fell approximately 12 feet from a ladder. He landed on his back and was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was chopping lettuce with a chef's knife when the blade amputated the employee's left thumb tip.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet off a ladder to the floor, suffering broken ribs and a broken hip.

An employee mounted a chiller section hoisted about 4 feet above the ground by a crane.  When getting back off the section, the employee fell and hit their head on the ground. The employee suffered a concussion that required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a stacker machine when one of the boards became jammed. He hit the board with his hand, causing the jam to clear. The cleared board then struck his hand, smashing his right pinky finger against a metal frame just below the fingernail and resulting in a partial finger amputation.
While stocking merchandise on top shelves, an employee fell from a stock cart to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the head, arm and wrist, and required surgery for her wrist.

A maintenance employee was tightening a loose screw on a machine to stop it from wobbling in the drum area when the rotating drum partially amputated one of his left-hand fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was offloading a pipe when his hand was caught between the pipe and the bollard protecting an exterior roll-up door, resulting in a right middle finger amputation.
An employee was walking on a roof when he stepped into a floor hole and fell. He was hospitalized with fractures to the left leg, both wrists, and the right elbow.
An employee was making deliveries on their route. During the seventh or eighth hour of their shift , the employee was hospitalized with heat stress.
An employee crushed his right ankle while jumping off a pump truck cabin to the ground.
After working on a water tower at a height of approximately 120 feet, an employee returned to the ground and felt ill. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was troubleshooting an air conditioner in a customer's attic. As the employee was exiting the attic area using the customer's ladder, it slipped and the employee fell approximately 10 to 15 feet to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a concussion, blood clots in the head, and swelling of the brain.
An employee became lightheaded while en route to make a delivery. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was moving forks on a zoom boom telehandler to fit into a manhole when the forks became stuck. As he was trying to push them over, the forks swung back and caught his right middle finger, crushing and severing the tip.
While moving a box on conveyor belts an employee's right hand was caught between the box and the conveyor belts. The employee sustained a muscular injury to his hand.
An employee was repairing a CNC router machine when the machine cycled and his head was pinched. The employee sustained a fractured skull.
An employee fell off a motorized pallet jack and hit her head on the ground, suffering a concussion and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was dismounting a pallet jack when the pallet jack was pulled toward him, pinning his leg against a guard post. He suffered a leg injury and fractured ankle.
A delivery driver fell to the ground while stepping down from his truck. He sustained a dislocated right ankle and a torn left patella tendon and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a ladder when a free standing leg support was bumped and fell over causing a laceration to the employee's right leg.
An employee was trimming a tree at heights when a tree branch contacted power lines. The employee was indirectly shocked and sustained burns to the right hand and both forearms.
An employee was utilizing a ram on a jack stand to close a structural gap when the stand kicked out and the ram struck his face. He suffered a fractured jaw and other facial fractures.
An employee assisting with the placement of a deck panel had his finger pinched outside the deck panel. He sustained an amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was removing a screw while standing on a walk board when the walk board shifted, causing the employee to lose balance and fall 6 to 8 feet to the ground. The employee suffered lacerations to the head/face and fractures to the ribs and hand.
An employee was helping cut shoulders when the knife cut his hand. He sustained a laceration to the top of the right hand that involved a tendon.

An employee was helping to clean up around a conveyor belt area. Another employee turned the conveyor on so it could move and clear some material. The employee attempted to remove a large piece of bark under the conveyor. His left arm was caught in the moving parts under the conveyor. He was hospitalized with a broken left arm and required surgery.
An employee was stripping wood from a concrete roof with a hammer when a piece of metal went under his glasses and into his eye.
An employee was assembling a new trailer. While cutting a Z-member channel, the material got caught forcing the band saw to work backwards. The employee sustained a right index fingertip amputation.
An employee experienced dizziness and cramps due to dehydration while building cranes outside.
An employee was riding a lawn tractor when the tractor drove into a ditch. The employee fell from the lawn tractor and three fingers on the left hand were severely lacerated.

An employee was performing a pre-shift inspection of the straddle carrier truck (PIT). While climbing up the fixed ladder to the cab of the PIT, the employee fell approximately six to seven feet to the floor below. The employee sustained a fractured left heel and a possible compressed disc. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was assisting in the loading of raw milk onto a truck when the pressure within the tank equalized and the pressure relief valve shut. The employee's right index finger was caught in the valve and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee stopped at a metal store on his way to work. He was moving expanded metal sheets when they slipped and lacerated his arm.

An employee exited his truck to assess the job site and work to be done. When he reached the edge of the area excavated for the work, the ground gave way causing him to fall into the excavation. The employee was impaled by a piece of rebar. It entered his left armpit and went through his chest muscles and up to his collar bone area.
On June 19, 2020, an employee was operating a cutting tool machine when the employee's right thumb was caught and partially amputated in the machine.

An employee was using an extension ladder to look above the ceiling in an airport terminal. As he was climbing the ladder, it slipped out from under him and he fell to the ground. He scraped his elbow and bumped his hip and leg. He was hospitalized and required surgery for a fractured hip.

An employee was attempting to remove a jammed round from an ammunition reloading mechanism he brought from home when the round discharged. Part of the ammunition casing struck his upper arm. The injury required surgical removal of the casing shrapnel from his upper arm.
An employee was attempting to repair a newspaper machine when he lost his balance while standing on a roll of newspapers. He fell and fractured his ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a trailer using a freight stacking system when the system was released and dropped a beam. The beam landed on the employee's head, causing a fractured C2 vertebra.
An employee suffered a finger amputation.

An employee was working off an A-frame ladder when he lost his balance and fell approximately 5 feet onto a customer's trailer hitch that was directly under him. He struck his abdomen and right arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee working on a scaffold on the opposite side of the guard rails fell 18 to 20 feet to the ground, breaking a leg and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking across wet slippery totes that were on top of a flatbed truck when he slipped and fell approximately 20 feet to a floating concrete dock below. He suffered a broken pelvis, a broken elbow, and broken bones in his face.

An employee was loading a mandrel rod onto a machine when the pusher connector rod slipped off the pusher. The operator of the control panel stopped the pushing device and put it in reverse. The employee's finger was then caught and amputated in the machine.
An employee was riding in a UTV when the steering mechanism malfunctioned as a left turn was being made. The UTV flipped and fractured the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was skinning and pushing meat with their hands when the meat skinner amputated the employee's left pinky finger. A hook was not used at the time of the incident.
An employee was operating a CNC bender when the machine closed the tooling clamp on his left index finger. The employee sustained an amputation to the left index finger.

On 06/19/2020, an employee tripped over a clothing rack and 
fell, cutting the back of her right leg when she hit the ground. The employee required a skin graft for her laceration.

An employee was operating a packaging machine when a jam occurred. As the employee was clearing plastic debris, the machine cycled causing its jaws to close on the employee's left hand. The employee s left thumb was amputated at the base of the fingernail.

An employee was clearing a blockage on the exhaust system at start-up while standing on the cooling bath rotor. The fins on the cooling bath roller cut through the employee's steel-toed safety shoe and amputated the right pinky toe. The machine was not guarded at the time.

An employee was unloading a produce truck when she was sideswiped by a pallet. She fell on the floor and landed on her left wrist. She suffered a wrist injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
While closing the sliding door of the delivery truck, an employee's hand was caught in the door. The employee sustained a partial amputation and had surgery.

An employee was climbing a ladder attached to a rail car, with the intention of inspecting a valve. The employee was on the fourth rung, slipped, and fell to the cement ground below. The employee was hospitalized with broken leg bones.
An employee was transitioning from a roof onto a ladder when he lost his footing and fell to the ground. He broke his hip and injured his neck and leg.

An employee was prepping an overhead crane for painting. The crane slipped off the 2-foot tall stands it was sitting on and landed on the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture below the clavicle.

An employee was attempting to fix a transmission issue in a box truck. He was underneath the vehicle when the transmission slipped out of gear and the vehicle rolled backwards onto him. As a result, he suffered broken ribs, scrapes to the side and buttocks, a collapsed lung, and bruises.
An employee was operating a pallet jack to stock inside a freezer when his finger became stuck between a steel plate and the power jack, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating an ATV at the edge of a pond that was 1 foot deep, spreading weed killer on pond weeds, when the ATV turned over and landed on his back. He suffered a C7 vertebra fracture and a bruised lung.

An employee was servicing a traffic arresting barrier gate that was equipped with a retractable bollard. The bollard is moved into the up position by use of a pump and hydraulic pressure. The bollard moves into the down position by gravity as a solenoid is triggered to open a valve to relieve hydraulic pressure. When the gate is closed, the bollard is in the up position. When the gate is triggered to be opened, the bollard retracts below the road surface and then the gate slides open.  There was a removable access panel that allows access below the surface of the road to a pit where adjustments to limit switches, sensors, etc. may be made. After diagnosing the problems with the gate, the employee discovered an issue with the proximity sensor within the pit below the access panel. While adhering magnets to the surface of the bollard in line with the proximity sensor, the bollard unexpectedly descended into the frame sleeve below the road surface without the hydraulic pump activating. The employee's hands were in the pit at the time and his fingers were inside the frame sleeve. The employee's left middle and ring fingertips were amputated. The right middle fingertip was also amputated.
An employee was helping to steady a light pole that was being removed when the light fixture fell from the pole and struck his head, causing a severe laceration.

An employee was working to ignite a scrap wood burn pile using gasoline. When the gasoline caught fire there was a large burst of flame and the employee sustained burns to both arms, a portion of the back, their lips, and hair.
An employee was removing concrete, reached down to pick up concrete, and was shocked by a cut, exposed, live electric lead. The employee suffered disorientation, arrhythmia, and headache.

An employee was installing a new damper actuator on an air handler unit. He was using a cordless impact driver while working from a step ladder. While driving a self-tapping screw into a bracket, the screw bound up in the bracket causing the bracket to spin. The bracket knocked off the employee s prescription safety glasses and struck his right eye.

An employee was conducting welding and cleanup onboard a naval ship. The employee was on a straight vertical ladder, went to grab the hatch cover above, and fell approximately 4-5 feet to the deck. The employee sustained two broken bones in the right foot.
While an employee was moving a trash can of product, the can fell onto the employee resulting in a broken left ankle.
An employee was delivering mail when a dog bit the employee's right hand. The bite became infected and required hospitalization.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when a dog came through the unsecured front door and bit the employee's legs and hand.
An employee was placing block dividers in-between material on a forklift's forks. The material slipped and smashed the employee's fingers against the forks, resulting in amputation.
An employee was removing a jam from the vertical raceway bucket scale system. The employee s right hand slipped into the machine and the pinky finger was amputated.
An employee tripped and fell over a step stool while getting product off a shelf, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee tripped over a chair and fell to the ground while carrying a tray and bruised a knee.
An employee had chest pain and difficulty breathing after pushing a wheelchair to drop off a passenger at an airport gate. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was parking his tractor trailer truck. He was found on the ground with broken ribs, a broken forearm, lacerations on the back, and a bloodshot eye. He appears to have been assaulted.
An employee was moving boxes in a bakery freezer and stepped on a stack of two pallets. The employee lost balance and fell back, hitting their head and shoulder on a steel shelving unit.
While walking through the facility, an employee tripped over a pallet and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a knee laceration.
An employee was climbing a steel ladder. The employee felt dizzy, took a step backwards off the ladder, and sustained a fractured ankle requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped over a mat and fell on the ground. She broke her femur and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and/or fell to the floor and suffered a head injury, requiring hospitalization.
The injured employee was showing a maintenance employee where a problem was on a piece of machinery when their right hand was crushed between the machine's frame and the transfer carriage.
An employee was cleaning up scraps of paper and tossing them over a wall when a slab of paper struck and fractured his left forearm.
An employee was loading chicks on a truck when he crushed and amputated his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee tripped on a water hose causing him to fall to the ground and break his hip.

An employee was climbing up a two-foot step ladder to unjam the head of a turret machine. The employee missed one of the steps, fell off the ladder, and landed on the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken collar bone and a subdermal hematoma.

An employee was changing an AC filter from a 13 -foot A-frame ladder when a monorail crane system knocked the employee off the ladder. The employee fell to the concrete floor and sustained left arm and left knee fractures requiring hospitalization.
A maintenance mechanic was replacing a wheel on a machine and sustained the amputation of the right index finger.

An employee was operating a gypsum pump when he lost his footing and grabbed an area to prevent him from falling. The area he grabbed contained mixing blades that were rotating. As a result, he lost the end of his left middle and ring fingers just above the fingernail.

An employee was leaning against a mule train going over a rough patch in a corn field. He was trying to adjust the wing to stabilize it when the wing moved and came down, crushing his finger. As a result, his left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was having a heated discussion with a customer when the customer pushed the employee to the floor. He landed on and fractured his left knee.

On 06/22/2020 at about 4:30 PM, an employee was off-loading equipment after doing eight hours of landscaping duties and riding for one hour in the air conditioned truck. He started feeling ill and was hospitalized for a heart attack and dehydration.
An employee was clearing a jam on a conveyor when his fingers were caught by the conveyor belt. He sustained a fracture to the left thumb and a contusion to the left index finger.
While closing a refuse compactor's door, a piece of cardboard started to fall out. The employee grabbed the cardboard and the compactor's door closed on his left hand, crushing two fingers.

An employee was in the process of adding sulfuric acid to an acid bath when the hose he was using to pour the acid into the tank became loose and spilled the acid onto his upper legs, resulting in severe burns.  He was rushed to a quick drench shower and then hospitalized.

An employee was trying to seal a punctured bag of material that was at the bottom of a stack.  The top bag of material (2,000 lb.) fell on top of the employee, who suffered three broken ribs and a possible fractured eye socket.
A forklift struck an employee's foot, injuring it.
An employee was using a hot stamp machine. The machine actuated and partially amputated the employee's left ring finger.

On June 22, 2020, at 7:20 PM, an employee was loading packages into a trailer using a loader assist machine. As he was finishing loading the trailer, the loader assist machine pushed forward into the trailer, hitting the employee in the back and pressing him into the wall. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was carrying a bundle of electrical cable when his legs felt weak and he fell to the ground. He suffered a herniated disc in his back that caused a pinched nerve.

An employee was gathering stacked building materials at the perimeter of the job site. When the employee picked up a piece of lumber, a raccoon jumped out from underneath the pile and bit the employee's right hand. The bite pierced the employee's glove. The employee was hospitalized due to rabies.

An employee was climbing a ladder between platforms on a ready-mix plant while holding a hose in one hand. The employee then slipped and fell approximately 10 feet from the ladder to the platform below, fracturing the right knee and elbow.

An employee was on the back of a truck trailer, unloading pipe from the trailer. The employee fell to the ground due to environmental conditions and muddy boots. The employee sustained four fractured ribs and an L12 vertebra fracture.

An employee was cleaning out a tool box on the back of a buggy. The lid to the tool box was open when the side boom was signaled to move forward. The boom struck the lid, trapping the employee between the lid and tool box. The employee suffered back and leg injuries.

In the vehicle maintenance shop, an employee was attempting to access the loft (10 feet high) with a ladder. The employee fell off the ladder and fractured his skull, ribs, and thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was conducting a pre-startup walkthrough, looking into inspection doors and checking for irregularities. His hand was in the process directly below a rotary feeder when the rotary feeder caught his gloved hand, resulting in a partial amputation of his left middle fingertip.

An employee was threading a steel cable through a stress head when it became obstructed. The employee looked in the equipment to see what the obstruction was when the tension released and the wire struck him in the eye.

An employee was backing up an electric pallet jack and hit a truck cart. He dismounted the pallet jack with his hand still on the steering arm, and caused the pallet jack to run into his leg. The employee sustained a left leg fracture.
An employee was retrieving shelving from the third row of warehouse racking. The employee lost their footing and fell, sustaining a fractured ankle.
A temporary employee was lifting a steel crane arm off the floor. The crane arm fell onto the employee's fingers. Two fingers on the left hand were partially amputated.

On June 22, 2020, at 10:50 AM, an employee was installing a fuel sender in a 31-foot boat's fuel tank. As he connected the fuel sender wires, a spark was created and ignited the fuel vapors. The vapors exploded and then caught on fire, burning the employee. He jumped down from the boat and other employees ran over to put out the fire. He was hospitalized with third degree burns on his hands and a concussion.

An employee was packaging finished parts when she turned to step off a mat and her inner left foot caught the edge of the mat. Her left ankle rolled and she fell on her right side, fracturing her right fibula and multiple bones in her lower right leg.
An employee was struck by a forklift, suffering a broken left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on site when a powered industrial truck driver ran over and fractured the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained an amputation of the right ring finger when a 500-pound steel plate fell from a jib crane and landed on the employee's finger.

An employee was inspecting a conveyor system, looking for the source of a noise, when their left arm was caught in the conveyor. The employee was hospitalized with wrist and elbow lacerations, requiring surgery.

An employee was on a forklift's forks, which had been raised so he could unwrap a tarpaulin. As he unwrapped the tarp, he was dragged off the forks and fell to the ground, injuring his head on the concrete driveway.
An employee was throwing metal into the hopper when his finger was caught between metal and the hopper, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was moving stacked doors when the doors shifted and fell on top of him, fracturing his back.
While exiting a refrigerator, an employee's hand was caught and degloved by the closing door.
An employee was stocking shelves and turned to grab another box when his leg gave out and he fell to the ground resulting in a fractured hip.
A skid steer backed into an employee, pinning him against a barrier. He suffered a pinched artery and was hospitalized.

Two employees were accessing a water tower. They climbed a ladder to access a walkway. One of the employees fell from the walkway to the ground, a distance of 23 feet. The employee suffered multiple fractures including a fractured pelvis, upper arm and two ribs.

A tire technician was changing the tires on a forklift when their left hand was caught between the turning table and the tires. The technician's left hand sustained four broken fingers and two torn tendons.
A temporary employee was observing two employees using a hydraulic torque wrench. When the machine was in cycle the temporary employee's hand became caught and a fingertip was amputated.
An employee had been operating a utility vehicle. He was found unresponsive in a field and was hospitalized with a head contusion and possible brain bleed.
An employee was edging and trimming when he began to feel ill and had cramps in his arms. Later that day he was hospitalized for renal failure due to dehydration.

An employee was using a forklift to move a metal frame divider/welding blind. The employee had partially lifted the divider (blind) and then exited the forklift to push over the divider onto its side. The blind slid on the forks and tipped upwards causing one of the support legs on the blind stand to contact the employee's left ribs. He sustained fractured ribs and a hemothorax.

An employee set a ladder on top of the pedestal of a memorial to hang poly over a window. When he accessed the ladder, the platform moved and caused him to fall. His right pinky finger was caught in the framing of the window and amputated.
An employee who had been engaged in driver training with a supervisor was hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee received an electrical shock while changing fuses on a portable trailer.
An employee was hospitalized due to a heat-related injury.

An employee was wiping crumbs off the belt and the edge of a conveyor when their fingers were caught between the chain and sprocket at the bagel slicer. The employee sustained the amputation of four fingertips on the left hand.

An employee was using a sleever bar to separate a steel bar joist from a bundle that contained five steel bar joists. The nearest steel bar joist fell on the employee and rolled on the front of the employee's abdomen. The steel bar joist weighs approximately 1,500 pounds. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee experienced shortness of breath and dehydration while restocking shelves in a warehouse, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was operating an ATV while inspecting vegetation in a utility right of way. The ATV was traversing a hill when the left front tire dropped off into a washout area. The ATV rolled over and landed on top of the employee. The ATV remained running as the employee worked to free himself. The hot muffler was just above the employee's back while he was under the ATV and caused third degree burns on the right side of his back.
An employee was cutting concrete decking with a demo saw when the demo saw kicked back and cut his neck.

An employee was attempting to move a 96" X 4" X 7" C channel by hand on his fixture table. As he began to pull the C channel across his fixture table, his right thumb was pinched between a square hole in the fixture table and the C channel, resulting in a partial soft tissue amputation without bone loss of the fingerprint side of his right thumb.
An employee was operating a radial edge miter saw when his hand was caught in the blade and a finger was amputated.

An employee was on the production floor cleaning a machine with a metal rod. The metal rod got caught and was pulled by the gear of the machine causing the handle of the rod to press the employee's fingers against the edge of the area being cleaned. The employee's index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated.
An employee was working on a breaker isolation switch of unknown voltage. The employee received an electrical shock from the switch and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was cleaning excess oil from around the air operator machine (punches a hole in material). When the employee inadvertently contacted a button located below the table, the air cylinder moved down and caught the employee's left middle fingertip between the vertical guides, resulting in fracture and partial amputation. The machine was not guarded.
An employee fell from a ladder to the concrete floor while performing maintenance work, suffering a head injury.
An employee was ripping a 2x4 for a keyway using a portable circular saw when the saw amputated his right pinky finger.
A Presbyterian Night Shelter employee was hit by the trash truck he was working on. He suffered a left foot fracture that required surgery.

An employee was spotting for a forklift operator moving rebar to reinforce steel. The load became stuck on the ground, causing it to fall off the forks of the forklift and onto the employee's right leg. The employee suffered a fractured ankle, requiring surgery and hospitalization.
An employee fell while walking into her office. She landed on the ground and suffered a broken hip.
A Waste Management driver was backing a waste truck in a cul-de-sac when the truck struck another helper employee. The injured employee sustained a fractured left foot.

An employee installing a metal roof deck fell through an opening in the roof approximately 26 feet to the concrete ground. The employee sustained fractures to the left leg, left arm, pelvis, and cheek bone.
An employee was transferring flammable liquid in the lab from a 5-gallon container to a 1-gallon container when the liquid ignited, resulting in burns to the employee's hands, knee, and left forearm.
An employee fell from a 5-rung step ladder while removing Christmas decorations, suffering a broken femur.

An employee was operating a narrow-aisle standup powered industrial truck (PIT) in the manufacturing warehouse. When he attempted to slow down, the lift started to slide due to the damp floor from the rain. His left foot became pinched between the PIT and a steel bollard. He sustained an open displaced fracture with a laceration of the left big toe.

A maintenance employee was using a ladder to perform utility activities in a ceiling. Upon descending the ladder, the employee slipped on the last rung and landed horizontally on his left hip, sustaining a fractured pelvis.

A driver had just gotten a skid off the truck while delivering cargo to a customer when he came into contact with a mower blade that was sticking out of the cardboard container that it was in. The driver sustained a cut to the Achilles tendon on his right ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet off a roof hatch to the floor, suffering brain injuries.

An employee was standing to the left of a chair with his right foot on the chair leg when he lost his balance and fell to the floor. As a result of striking the floor, the employee broke his left foot.
Two employees were assaulted by a customer in a cell phone store, suffering bruises.
An employee was moving a stone slab from an A frame when the stone slab fell on the employee. The employee sustained a broken leg.

Employees were moving a large window through a door of an apartment. The window had to be tilted so it could pass through the door, and its rail plastic safety block fell off. The windowpane slid and caught the right middle finger of one employee (working for Juarez Glass) against the frame. The last joint of the finger was amputated.

An employee was removing an open-head drum from a skid. When he removed it, he rolled it on the floor. His finger got caught between the drum he was moving and another drum that was stationary. The employee's right ring finger was amputated between the two drums.

An employee was walking down the service road to clock-in for their shift. When the employee went to step onto the grass, they lost their footing and stepped back into a pothole and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left fibula and an open fracture of the left ankle.

While walking through the parking lot, an employee tripped and fell and stumbled into a brick wall. The employee was hospitalized with a hematoma to the right eye, a contusion to the right shoulder, and a fractured right femur.
An employee had been outside pushing dirt using a broom. He was hospitalized with dehydration.

An employee was forming a part on a roller when his right glove became caught and his hand was pulled into the roller. His right index and middle fingers were crushed, resulting in a fracture and amputation of the distal fingertip.

A temporary employee was removing a part that she had just fabricated from the rolling machine. She stepped on the foot pedal while her hand was near the roller, which snagged her glove and pulled two fingertips into the roller. Her right middle and index fingertips were crushed.

An employee was weighing cans and placing gallon-sized cans on a small cart. While pulling the cart, the cart caught the employee's foot, causing the employee to trip and fall on the floor. The cart and three cans fell on her. She was hospitalized with a fractured wrist and hip.

An employee was using a rag to clean ink blots from the rollers of a flexo press. The rag became caught in the rollers and pulled the employee's left hand into the machine's rollers. The employee sustained amputation of the left index and middle fingertips.

An employee was assisting in attaching a bucket, with a large pin, to an excavator. The pin was dropped and it crushed the injured employee's hand against the bucket. The employee sustained the amputation of the ring finger and was hospitalized with open fractures to multiple fingers of the left hand.
After her shift, a driver was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee attending a company going away party had an allergic reaction to latex balloons.

An employee was walking down a grassy slope. She became unsteady or slipped. At that point her right knee locked in place, her leg bent the wrong way, and she fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right tibia.
An employee working on air conditioning vents fell through an opening to a lower level. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing an extractor fan from the top of a manhole when he stepped forward and fell into the manhole. He sustained multiple broken bones.
An employee was changing the die on a molding machine when the tip of her thumb was amputated.
An employee fell down stairs and bruised her left knee.
While unloading a truck, an employee fell to the ground from the back of the truck. The employee was hospitalized with multiple contusions.

An employee was performing drywall finishing work while on a scaffold. The scaffold's caster wheel fell into a floor opening causing the scaffold to tip over. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.

An employee was standing on the lower platform of a utility truck that was being driven slowly. He had picked up a construction-related temporary sign and was putting it in the back of the truck when he fell, landing on hard pavement and suffering several skull fractures and soft tissue damage to his face.
A contractor employee supervised by Tennessee Valley Authority was greasing a trackhoe when the bucket of the trackhoe moved, fracturing the employee's pelvis.
While closing a gate, an employee's finger was pinched in the gate's roller resulting in amputation of the left pinky fingertip.
An employee was pushing garbage into the waste truck when the blade of the hopper amputated his left ring fingertip.

A driver had been making a delivery and was walking back to the trailer. The driver tripped over a speed bump in the parking lot and fell to the ground sustaining a fractured right humerus requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While moving a frame rail from left to right, an employee's finger was pinched between the frame rail bracket and a J-hook. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing cut sections of sheet metal from the laser conveyor. One of the sheets moved forward, pinning his finger against the opposite side. The employee sustained a right middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was unbolting two adjoining pieces of a steel walkway/platform frame on wood blocks at the bottom of the clarifier. He reached over and around the steel member, grabbing it with his left hand. The member fell approximately 1- to 3-inches, pinning his left index finger against a wood block and fracturing it.
An employee was working as a flagger on a highway project. While directing northbound traffic, he was struck by a motorist heading northbound. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was placing a steel beam that was being lowered by a hoist onto the ground. After he released the straps, the steel beam rolled and struck his calf lacerating an artery.
While an employee was lowering a trailer, the landing gear on the trailer spun and struck the employee's right hand.
An employee suffered a finger amputation.

An employee was about to move a cart that was blocking an automated guided vehicle from its designated stop. The cart started to move and the employee's finger against a pole, amputating the underside of the finger.

An employee was driving a spotting truck with a shipping container into a loading dock. The truck came into contact with a trailer in the adjoining dock; his left arm was pinched between the truck and the trailer.
An employee was changing the trim blade on a machine when the blade dropped on the employee's right wrist causing a laceration to the wrist that severed an artery and grazed a nerve.
An employee was being tied to a buck hoist. While the elevator was descending, the counterweight amputated his left hand.
Two employees were torqueing bolts on a valve. The torque machine was actuated and crushed one of the employees' fingers against the valve, causing fractures.
An employee developed a headache and lightheadedness at about 2:00 p.m., then began vomiting. He went home and was hospitalized at 5:00 p.m., suffering from heat-related dehydration.

An employee was helping to troubleshoot a resin conveying butterfly valve for proper operation. To perform the operation check, the employee had to support the weight of the valve to minimize the strain on the valve's wiring harness. His right thumb inadvertently entered the butterfly valve's area of actuation, and the butterfly valve smashed his right thumb diagonally across the nail, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was handling poultry and laying them down on a conveyor when the employee's right second finger was caught in a moving shaft, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was using air to pressure test a tank. The tank burst and a piece of the tank struck the employee in the left shin and fractured the lower leg.
An employee was operating a pallet jack. The tine of a forklift struck the employee, breaking the employee's left foot

An employee was cutting a gated part on a saw when a piece of the metal part broke off and caused the abrasive saw blade to grab/pull in the part. The employee's thumb tip was also pulled into the blade, amputating the tip upon impact.

An employee was in the back of his trailer, making a delivery. As he loaded his hand dolly, he slipped on some condensation and fell to the ground. He suffered contusions to the left rib and hip, as well as a ruptured spleen.
At 8:07 a.m. on June 25, 2020, an employee was struck on the side of his hard hat by a piece of flying material. He suffered a skull fracture and underwent surgery.
An employee was working on a grain dryer door when the door moved and pinched his right thumb, resulting in a thumb fracture and requiring hospitalization.
An employee was chipping on an electrical duct. An arc flash burned the employee's upper torso.
An employee was doing demolition work on a brick wall. The wall fell over and crushed the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee was standing on her vehicle's bumper to unload parcels when she fell to the ground resulting in a broken tibia and fibula that required surgery.
A mechanic was working under a vehicle that had been raised on jacks. The jacks were released and the vehicle came down; its tires rolled toward the employee's back and he suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was filling a 125-gallon propane cylinder when the connection tube ruptured. The employee sustained a concussion.

On June 25, 2020, an employee was acting as a groundman to assist the locomotive driver in staging cars in the blast building. As the railcar was moving past a beam that is part of the building, the employee became pinned between the beam and the railcar and sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was turning a valve with a wrench when he suffered a twisted back muscle.

An employee was going across a working platform when he fell to the ground 30 feet below. He suffered multiple fractures to his head, sternum, and pelvis; a broken left arm; and a broken back with three disc fractures.

An employee was installing a panel and using a power planer. The employee's right hand was on the planer and their left hand was in front of the discharge when the planer blade cut the employee's left ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was putting cardboard into a coil on the slitter when his glove got caught by the edge of the steel and pulled his arm into the slitter. The employee's left arm was amputated above the elbow.
A truck's lift gate was raised while the driver's hand was on it. The gate pinched the driver's left thumb,

A Tyson Poultry commercial motor vehicle driver was struck from behind by an empty cage being carried on a three-wheel forklift. The driver suffered lacerations to the right elbow and the top of the left hand, a compound fracture to the right tibia and fibula, fractures to three lower-back vertebrae, and body abrasions.
An employee was assisting a press operator. When the power press engaged, it caught the employee's fingers in the machine resulting in amputations.

On June 25, 2020, an employee was using a high-pressure water lance. The rigid lance broke at a connection near the employee, and a high-pressure water stream severely lacerated the employee's arm and shoulder.

An employee was working to remove an aircraft landing gear assembly. The landing gear moved and struck either the employee or the ladder that the employee was standing on, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee was knocked unconscious, suffering a concussion and leg bruising. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on an ATV when it flipped on its side. The employee fell to the ground. His left forearm was broken in three places, and the shoulder and elbow were dislocated.

Two employees were preparing to install a new die in a press. One employee was pulling the spring block off the top of the die to accommodate the shut height of the brake press. When the employee got the bolts out of the block, the die hung up on the guide pins; as the employee worked the block loose, the die freed and came down on the stop block. The other employee's right middle finger was between the stop block and the top of the die, and the fingertip was amputated.

While operating a band saw machine, an employee attempted to retrieve the cut piece of metal from inside the machine. The blade had not yet come to a complete stop and lacerated his left index finger.

An employee was struck on the head with a winch bar while securing a ratchet on a pipe hauling trailer, suffering a concussion and a forehead laceration that required sutures. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just cleared a machine, jammed by a mis-cut, in poultry cut-up area. The employee was reaching to remove a second mis-cut when the circular saw started up and amputated the tips of the employee's right thumb and index finger (with no bone loss).

On June 26, 2020, a steel chain on a roll-off truck trailer broke and struck an employee on the arm, causing fractured ribs, a fractured sternum, a small contusion to the right lung, a heart contusion, a broken right hand (at the metacarpal joint), and a wrist laceration.
An employee was closing a trailer when the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the trailer flap, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was setting timing on the inline section of a printing machine, which had been removed from service and was in a maintenance shop. The employee's right little finger was caught in the timing gear and amputated.
A follow block fell from a jib crane and struck an employee's left hand, causing fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding a piece of ductwork as it was pushed into another piece. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the two pieces, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was waiting in the cab of his truck to deliver materials to a worksite when he was overcome by what was believed to be carbon monoxide exposure.

As an employee was working in a shallow trench, the ground beneath an excavator collapsed, causing the excavator to fall into the trench and strike the employee. The employee was temporarily pinned between the excavator and a communication box installed in the trench, suffering broken ribs and back vertebrae.
An employee was about to polish a work piece using a grinding tool, with a Velcro-attached polishing pad. When the tool was started, the pad separated and hit the employee's left eye.
A postal employee developed heat exhaustion while delivering mail. He was hospitalized.

At about 4:00 a.m. on June 26, 2020, an employee was setting up a newly installed ultrasonic welder. While he was adjusting the head of the equipment on the mount relative to the welding plate, a gap was created between the head of the equipment and the welding fixture. When the computer recognized that the machine was too far out of adjustment, the welding fixture recoiled back up, closing the gap on the employee's left index finger. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee was riding a zero turn mower. The wheel began to slide down an embankment. The mower turned around, did not flip, and slid down the embankment. The mower's blade cut the employee's left foot, causing fractures to the first, second, and third toes as well as severe cuts.

An employee was waiting to remove the connecting pin to the rotator on a harbor crane when the remote control that was being used malfunctioned, causing the rotator to fall to one side. The rotator struck and crushed the employee's right hand.

A garbage truck driver had picked up a trash bag and was walking back to his truck when a vehicle struck him, knocking him unconscious. He suffered a dislocated left shoulder and a broken bone above his right ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was straightening material on an oven feed line. He was reaching around and under the machine to adjust the material when his fingers were caught in the nip rollers of the feeder line. He suffered three fractured right fingers, and his ring finger was degloved and partially amputated.
An employee suffered from heat exhaustion while supervising a lifeguard team at a water park.
An employee slipped on spilled hair lotion while stocking products on shelves. The employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken right knee.
An employee was on an order picker, pulling a tempered part from a top rack. The employee fell from the order picker at 6:45 a.m., landing about 15 feet below.

On June 26, 2020, at 7:00 PM, an employee was guiding a light pole being lifted by a forklift down onto a platform. The pole then swung into the employee's hand, pinning it between the pole and the forklift. His left hand was crushed and he suffered finger amputations.
A machine operator was cleaning glue from a glue spreader's rollers. Two rollers pulled in the employee's left hand, degloving the thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees (one driving, one a passenger) were transporting a load of steel reinforcement on a rough-terrain flatbed truck. The truck rolled down a hill and overturned. The driver suffered a broken heel and the other employee's foot was broken.
An employee was repairing a feed-bagging machine. A roller caught the employee's left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was dismantling a scaffold. A forklift rolled into the scaffold and the employee fell, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a head injury.

An employee was operating a roller on an incline. As the roller backed down the incline, it began to roll quickly downhill, struck a parked work truck, and rolled over. The employee suffered head, arms, and upper extremity injuries.
An employee lacerated his left pinky finger on a toolbox. The laceration became infected, and his pinky fingertip had to be surgically amputated on June 26, 2020.
An employee was removing an air breather off of a boat motor when the engine's turbo pulled the employee's finger into the engine rotor blade, resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
A pest control employee was stung by bees while trying to exterminate a beehive at a customer's house. He suffered multiple stings to the head and stomach.
While climbing down an 8-foot fixed ladder, an employee slipped and fell off the ladder to the concrete floor, suffering a fractured pelvis.

An employee was using a wire wheel brush on a pedestal grinder to deburr a piece of strut. The wheel caught the employee's glove and pulled in his right hand, causing a degloving injury to the middle, ring, and little fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using an articulating front end loader to move bales of hay. The loader tipped over on its side and broke the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading steel rods from a forklift onto a storage rack. His right hand was between the forks of the forklift while he was pulling on a rod. The large steel rod then moved and struck his right pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A driver was exposed to carbon monoxide while waiting in his truck. He became ill and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a wall from a one-tier-high baker scaffold. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a sprained left leg.

Two employees were in the bed of a customer's pickup truck, moving a grill to the back of the bed. The customer removed his ratchet straps from the truck's cab and threw them on the ground. When one of the two employees stepped down from the truck bed, his left foot landed on top of the ratchet. The employee went to the ground and the foot was broken.
An employee was scanning small packages at a sorter. A nearby tugger struck a rolling bin, which in turn hit the employee's left hip and caused a contusion.
An employee was removing a ladder from the first tier of a roof when he fell 10 feet from the roof, suffering back, neck, and hand injuries. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
Two employees were standing next to a wall when a strong breeze caused the wall to crack. It fell onto one of the workers, covering his body in blocks. He suffered broken teeth and bones.
An employee was working on a flour rounder machine. When she tried to get a piece of dough out of the machine she suffered a right index finger amputation.

On June 27, 2020, an employee was tying a new breaker into a busway. As he was about to hook up the ground wires, the ground wire touched one of the energized bus bars; an arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's neck, face, right hand, and arm.

On June 27, 2020, an employee was entering a fertilizer bin through the top access when the employee fell off the bin's internally mounted ladder and struck internal structural members and the bottom of the bin. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right arm, fractured left shoulder, fractured ribs, and cracked vertebrae.

An employee was riding a bike trail after placing signage at a trail junction. The bike's rear tire washed out and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken left forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up an assembly line conveyor belt on a fill machine when her right pinky finger was caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a finger amputation.

An employee was working on a scaffold raised to a height of approximately four feet to install can light trim and sheet rock the ceiling. As the employee exited the end of the scaffold, he mis-stepped on the rung of the ladder integrated to the scaffold. He fell backward and struck his head on the wall. His hard hat fell off and then his head struck the floor. He was hospitalized for a fractured skull and bleeding in the brain.

On June 27, 2020, an employee was working from a ladder at a customer's home. The ladder slid down the cable strand and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg, a chipped heel, and a broken shoulder.

A utility terrain vehicle had driven off a maintenance road and had been attached to a winch. The backlashed winch line tightened when the payout control was engaged, pinching an employee's left index finger against the vehicle's bumper. The finger was lacerated and suffered nerve damage that necessitated a partial medical amputation.
An employee was changing a print die on a die-cutter printer. The employee's right middle and index fingers were pulled into the stationary rollers and broken.

On a rig at a well site, a hydraulic line ruptured and sprayed diesel fuel onto a turbo, which caused a fire. Two rig employees hit the kill switch and jumped off of a 15-foot platform. One employee suffered a fractured ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat. A bone jerked and the meat saw lacerated the employee's right index finger, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee lost her balance and fell backward while walking in the deli. She landed on her hands, breaking both.
An employee had clocked out and left work feeling ill. After the employee arrived home and was still feeling ill, the employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee fell from the third or fourth rung of a ladder to concrete below, suffering a head laceration.

At 1:45 p.m. on June 29, 2020, an employee was installing plumbing at the bottom of an excavation, about 5-7 feet deep, when the side of the excavation collapsed and fell on him. He suffered fractures to the ribs, collarbone, and pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was building a box to hold an order for shipping. The employee stapled the first half of the box and spun the box around to staple the other half, but the flap of the box got caught on the platform of the stapler. The employee was freeing the flap when the stapler activated and amputated his left middle fingertip.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a raised automotive lift. The lift's automated locking mechanism failed and it dropped, trapping his hands beneath it. Both hands were severely lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was assisting in the backfilling of a trench after sewer line and water line repair. A co-worker was directing a waiting vehicle while the injured employee was directing the operator of an excavator that was moving out of the road. The excavator made contact with an overhead electrical line and the injured employee touched the handle on the excavator resulting in a 7400-volt electric shock. The employee was hospitalized for burns to the hand, back and feet.

On 6/29/2020, at approximately 3:38 p.m., an employee was using his lanyard to lift a piece of grating when he fell through the floor opening in the mezzanine, contacting the mezzanine, grating, and/or floor while falling. He suffered lacerations to the head and neck.
An employee fell from a roof while cleaning gutters and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to paint a wall. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a fracture.
An employee suffered respiratory problems caused by mixed bleach and an alcohol.
An employee had been folding boxes and walking back to the line when she fainted and hit her head on the concrete floor, suffering an internal head injury.

An employee was operating a scissor lift to load a truck trailer when the dock plate gave way and the scissor lift tipped over. His foot fell between the plate and the back of the trailer and he suffered a laceration to his lower right shin area and a fractured shoulder requiring hospitalization.

While delivering a new container to a customer, an employee attempted to repair the existing container that was already at the residence. The employee was holding the container up with a knuckle crane on the employee's truck and a jack from the customer when the crane slipped, dropping the container on top of the employee. The employee experienced a broken clavicle and two broken ribs, requiring hospitalization.
An employee walked into a resident's room, slipped on the wet surface, and fell onto his back, hitting his head on the concrete floor.
An employee tripped on coil wrapping and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.

Two employees were attempting to dislodge two steel carts that had become entangled when a cart shifted on its base, coming into contact with the injured employee's right pinky finger. As a result, the employee's right pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was loading a pallet full of beverages when a forklift struck him and pinned him between two pallets. He suffered a broken ankle and hip.

An employee was attempting to replace a spring in the tooling system. The employee's left hand got caught in the tooling system as it cycled resulting in injuries to the left ring and pinky fingers. The pinky finger was amputated.

An employee was preparing to transfer material from a tote to a packaging line when the employee was exposed to insecticide, sustaining second degree chemical burns to the lower right leg, ankle, shin, and calf.
An employee was cutting a concrete pile when a cut off section of the pile broke loose and crushed the employee's right hand, resulting in a thumb amputation.
An employee was moving steel in a bin. A piece shifted and severely cut his left forearm. He was hospitalized.

A forklift was being used to take material off a roof. Its forks and the load became stuck in the roofing material; the forks dislodged and struck the employee in the face, causing a broken nose and a facial laceration.
While trying to redirect a person's behavior, a group home employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken femur.

Employees were working from a non-stop scaffold. The scaffold's planks had moved; an employee was walking across the planks to correct them when he fell to the ground about 16-18 feet below. He suffered an upper back fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a brake press to bend a part when the employee's right thumb was pinched, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was moving a piece of angle iron in an outside assembly roller area when the angle iron tipped over and pinched his index fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was laying down trusses. The employee fell from the trusses to a concrete slab, suffering a broken skull, three broken ribs, and fractures to a cheekbone and an eye socket.
On June 28, 2020, an employee was adjusting the chain tension and linkage on a packaging machine. The employee's right hand was crushed in the point of operation of the die.

An employee was loading a telehandler onto a flatbed trailer. The employee stepped down 1 foot, trying to avoid mud, and stepped onto a grassy patch, then rolled his left ankle which was fractured and dislocated.
An employee who had been operating a front-end loader was found trapped and crushed underneath the loader, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was backing a mower into a tractor trailer when the mower's gas tank struck the trailer and exploded. The employee received burns to the face (around eyes and forehead), arms, and knees.

An employee was sitting on a tower platform running a new cable to the top for a new antenna installation. A gust of wind blew the other end of the cable, causing it to swing and then strike proximal transmission lines. An arc occurred, and the current went into the employee's left arm and out his lower left side. He descended a fixed ladder with assistance and was hospitalized with electrical burns to the left arm, buttock, and thigh.
An employee was sanding a part after welding it. His right thumb was caught between the metal and the sanding belt and was amputated below the fingernail.
After doing landscaping work all day, an employee became ill and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was on a 6-foot mobile scaffold, applying stucco to a corner beam. The employee fell to the ground about 4 1/2 feet below, suffering a fractured left wrist that required hospitalization.

On June 30, 2020, at approximately 3:45 PM, a temporary employee picking orders in the warehouse was struck in the back of the neck by a stack of boxes that fell from stacked pallets. The employee sustained fractures to the back, ribs, and pelvis, requiring hospitalization.

On June 30, 2020, an employee was installing sheathing on a low slope roof of a residential structure. The employee fell about 4 feet onto a self-supported scaffold system below the work area; a vertical scaffold post struck the employee's right armpit, causing a laceration/avulsion and severe bleeding to the armpit.
An employee suffered heat-related illness while carrying letters and other mail, requiring hospitalization.
After carrying mail at about 100 degrees Fahrenheit, an employee suffered heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a heat-related illness while repairing a gas meter outside.

An employee was moving a 10-gallon water container on a four-wheeled dolly. The dolly hit a bump and the container moved. The employee suffered a muscle strain in the lower back while trying to prevent the container from falling.

An employee was removing a valve cap on a compressor at a compressor station. Trapped pressure caused the cap to fly off and strike the employee on the right side of his face. Glass from his safety glasses was embedded in his right eye, necessitating surgery to remove the eye.

An employee was clearing shredded plastic out of a grinder. While the equipment was locked out, the employee pushed the blade to clear out more plastic and his finger became caught between the blade and edge of the grinder, resulting in a partial amputation of his left pinky finger.
An employee was operating a forklift to carry bricks when the metal strap that held the bricks together became caught in the forklift tire. The metal strap amputated his third right fingertip.

An employee was working on a tractor's drive shaft. The tractor was positioned on an incline at the time. After working on the drive shaft, the employee moved some blocks that were used to hold the wheels in place. The brakes were not set at the time, so the tractor rolled slowly back and crushed his body between the tractor and a flatbed that was waiting outside the bay. He was hospitalized for a fractured hip.
An employee was setting a steel beam in a form. The employee was adjusting the beam when his left index finger was caught between the steel pipe and the chamfer. The fingertip was amputated.
A temporary employee was loading a piece of furniture into the hopper of a garbage truck. A glass part on the furniture broke and severely lacerated the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was using a pry bar on a hot mold in a tire change press. His left pinky finger contacted the hot mold, resulting in a burn. He was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee was using a square pipe to dislodge material that was jammed in the outlet gate of a machine's oil filter. The square pipe pinched his left thumb, resulting in a thumb tip amputation.
An employee was clearing an apparent jam from a dust collector machine. A rotary valve on the bottom of the dust collector amputated the first joint of the employee's right thumb.

An employee was using a log processor to cut a log. He tried to support a cut piece of log with his hand when the weight of the log pushed his hand into the log splitter's blade, resulting in the amputation of his left hand at the wrist.

An employee was rigging a piece of angle iron on a dock to an excavator bucket on a barge. The excavator was swaying due to being on the barge, causing the bucket to go up and down on the dock. The bucket came down and struck the employee on top of his foot, resulting in a partial amputation of his big toe.

An employee was emptying trash containers in the back of a compactor truck when his hand was contacted by the compactor blade, resulting in a partial amputation to the distal phalanx of his left middle finger.
An employee was standing on the back of a golf cart while the cart was in motion. The employee fell off the golf cart and struck his head on the pavement, suffering a head injury.

An employee was standing on a 12-foot ladder, cutting a 3-inch water pipe. When he cut it, the pipe swung down and knocked the ladder out from under him. He fell to the ground about 9 feet below, landing on the ladder and suffering rib, lung, and hip damage.
A maintenance employee was painting the trim inside a resident's bathroom when he lost his balance and fell, fracturing some ribs.

An employee was sweeping around a 3-foot by 4-foot roof opening. The employee fell through the opening to the floor about 30 feet below. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the upper body and head and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a meat packaging machine. The employee's right hand was caught between the sealing head and the sealing bucket. The employee suffered lacerations to the middle and index fingers, as well as an amputation to the ring finger.

An employee was using a paint brush to touch the side of a spool that another employee was loading onto a trailer using an overhead crane when the spool (12 feet long with a 12-inch diameter) caught another spool on the trailer. This caused the other spool, to fall off the trailer and strike the employee's left foot, fracturing it.

An employee was trying to clear rock from the manual tailgate of a dump truck when the tailgate fell and caught his fingers between it and the bed of the truck, resulting in the amputation of his right middle and ring fingertips.
A maintenance employee was injected with hydraulic fluid in the right index finger while using their hand to try to feel for a hydraulic hose leak.

An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a circular saw when it bound up in the wood.  The employee pulled the saw up and it released, cutting the fingers on his left hand and resulting in an amputation of his left ring finger.

On June 30, 2020, an employee was fastening straps on an empty trailer. As the employee was tightening the winch, the strap came undone and he lost his balance. He fell into the trailer, struck his head on the edge, and then fell to the ground. He suffered a head injury that required stitches, as well as a torn esophagus.

An employee was removing lime from an outdoor pit by manipulating a 6" diameter hose from a vacuum truck. The pit was estimated to be approximately 8' to 10' x 4' x 7' deep. The employee was wearing a protective garment, goggles, and a cartridge respirator. The employee sustained second degree chemical burns from the lime to the neck, abdomen, both upper both arms, both thighs, and both ankles, as well as third degree burns on one ankle.
An employee stood up to reach for material at a workstation and lost balance, falling to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a left hip fracture.

Employees were pulling cable strands with a rating of 5000 pounds. While they were tightening the cable on the right side of the street, there was some slack in the cable on the left side of the street. A tractor trailer pulled out of an industrial park and snapped the cable. The cable swung towards the bucket truck causing employee 1, who was wearing a harness, to jump out of the bucket truck to avoid being hit by the cable. Employee 1 sustained a fractured rib and a back injury. The cable then swung through some trees and hit employee 2, who was on the ground. Employee 2 sustained a leg injury.
At about 12:30 p.m. on June 30, 2020, an employee was adjusting the position of books on a cutting machine. The clamp cycled and came down on the employee's hand, causing a partial finger amputation.

An employee was actuating a valve handle at an open end pipe extension of a well tree to release gas from a natural gas storage well. The well tree rotated and the pipe extension struck the employee's head causing a skull fracture behind the right ear.

An employee was using a ladder to enter a pit to remove rails and install machines. The employee stepped off the ladder approximately 1 foot from the pit floor and tripped over a pit rail, falling to the ground (the rail was not unbolted from the ground at this time and is a fixed part of the pit). The employee was hospitalized with a broken right femur.

A drilling pipe was being unloaded from a flatbed trailer and being strapped to a backhoe. The flatbed trailer collapsed. The pipe rolled to the right and struck an employee in the chest, causing chest and neck injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was resetting a punch press.  As the employee finished resetting the press, he tripped and his right middle finger was caught in a gear mechanism and crushed.
An employee was moving a patient's walker out of a hospital aisle. The employee tripped over the walker, fell, and was injured.

An employee was at a construction site, standing beside a vehicle track being carried by a forklift. The forklift lowered the track. As it hit the ground, the employee lost his balance and fell. A portion of the track slid off the forks and struck him as he tried to stand up. He suffered a broken back vertebra, a broken left eye socket, and a laceration to the back of the head.
An employee was consolidating aerosol cans. A can fell to the ground and shot back up striking the employee in the eye. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery to remove the eye.

An employee working at the magnetic particle inspection clamp in the track machine line activated a hydraulic clamp and pinched their right ring finger between the side edge of the product being clamped and the clamp wall. The pinching action trapped the employee's finger and removed the soft tissue portion of the ring finger pad under the fingernail, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was using a nail gun to frame the chimney area of a house when the gun shot a nail into his right lower leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery to remove the nail.
An employee was on a 4-foot stepladder, replacing a vent pipe on an oil tank outside a garage. The employee fell from the ladder. His left hip struck a steel/concrete bollard and was injured.
An employee was changing out punches in a plate duplicator machine. The machine began to operate, causing fractures to the employee's tibia and fibula as well as a severe laceration.

An employee was driving his personal vehicle on the property when he lost control of the vehicle, spun out 20 feet, and hit a tree. He sustained fractures to the ankle, hip, and vertebrae and lost consciousness.
An employee experienced a back strain while repositioning a patient's bed, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was picking up trash during a roof removal process when the employee fell through the roof and landed on the concrete approximately 20 feet below, suffering fractures.

An employee was clearing jammed film on a packaging machine when the employee's right hand was caught between the die hand and die plate, fracturing the right middle and index fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee as cleaning up debris using a concrete buggy when he inadvertently reversed the buggy into a parked vehicle and broke his leg.

At 7:05 a.m. on July 1, 2020, a Waste Pro employee was gathering a pile of refuse about 40 feet from a road. A vehicle swerved to avoid the employee's garbage truck, went off the road, and struck the employee. The employee suffered multiple injuries including a broken arm and a dislocated shoulder and was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering a metal sign into place when the sign crushed two of the employee's fingers.
On July 1, 2020, an employee was unjamming a packaging machine and sustained a partial amputation to the right index finger when the gloved finger contacted the blades inside of the machine.
An employee's knee went out and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was checking the air pressure of a truck tire when the tire blew out, fracturing the employee's leg.
An employee tripped on a path between an office area and a garage. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a herniated disk in the lower back.
An employee suffered a fingertip avulsion while trying to unclog a spray valve.
At 7:47 a.m. on July 2, 2020, an employee was clearing leakage from a meat processing machine. The machine's moving mold plate amputated the tip of his right middle finger.

An employee was cutting a weld out of a roof panel when the cutting wheel became pinched between two sections of metal. The grinder spun and kicked back toward the employee, its disk striking her in the face. She suffered a laceration across the nose and on both cheeks.
An employee was cutting granite with a grinder when the grinder cut the employee's right hand above the middle finger knuckle.
An employee was installing a 10-foot long pipe to a new separator. The pipe came loose and struck the employee's thumb against a support bracket. The thumb tip was medically amputated.

On July 1, 2020, an employee was sweeping soy beans and cleaning up the flat storage facility when the employee slipped on spilled beans and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a hip fracture, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was lubricating a chain on an elliptical machine when his gloved finger became caught between the chain and sprocket, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was on a ladder painting the exterior of a house. The ladder was set on decorative rock that shifted and caused the ladder to slip. The employee fell five feet from the ladder onto the ground and rocks, sustaining a left elbow injury that required surgery.
An employee fell while descending from a step stool. The employee landed on the floor, suffering a broken hip.
At about 7:40 a.m. on July 1, 2020, an employee was sweeping beans into a rotating auger. The auger amputated the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized.
On July 1, 2020, a temporary employee was slicing meat on a deli slicer when the blade caught his finger, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was loading boxes on a conveyor when the employee's hand entered the moving parts, causing lacerations and crushing injuries.
An employee was cleaning a light fixture on a loading dock. Her foot was entangled in the dock door's pull rope and she fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
On July 2, 2020, an employee tripped and fell while sweeping a sales floor, suffering a hip fracture.
An employee was delivering mail on their normal route. The employee felt ill and became disoriented. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.

An employee was trying to repair a leaking valve on a pipeline that delivered milk product to a milk carton filling machine. A spray of steam came out of the filling machine, contacting his right hand, face, and neck. He suffered second-degree burns to the right hand and his right side.

An employee finished cleaning the feeder from the extruder line and was descending a step ladder. The ladder moved unexpectedly, causing the employee to lose balance and fall. The employee's left ring finger contacted a slowly rotating agitator resulting in a broken bone and lacerated tendon.

On July 2, 2020, at 2:00 p.m., an employee was unloading freight at a store when a rollatini measuring 2' x 4' fell on his leg. The rolltainer was on a lift gate and became unlevel, tipping over and striking the employee's ankle. The employee was hospitalized with a closed, non-displaced fracture of the medial malleolus of the right tibia that required surgery.

An employee was working on a garage door from an A-frame ladder when a motion detector sensor was engaged, causing the door to start to come down. The door struck the employee's head, causing him to fall off the ladder and hit his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with injury to his head.

An employee was assisting with hoisting piping by a crane. The piping struck the employee and caused the employee to fall 5 feet off a trailer to the ground. The employee suffered a partial dislocation of their left shoulder with a possible fracture, as well as L2, L3, and L4 transitional lumbar fractures.
An employee was working on a wind tower when he began to experience cramping. He was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was working on an air conditioning unit in a single-family home. He was injured by an electrical shock, suffering injuries including severe burns to the face and losing consciousness.
An employee was checking whether a car's fan was working when the fan partially amputated his left ring and index fingers.
