An employee was checking repairs to a truck-mounted compressor. While he was securing the cover to the compressor fan, the fan lacerated his right thumb. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

On July 2, 2020, an employee was performing maintenance work on a pneumatic cylinder to remove a spacer. The cylinder amputated four of the employee's fingers. Two fingers on each hand were amputated.

An employee was standing on the third rung from the bottom of an eight-foot ladder while assisting with a hanging metal door. The employee lost his balance and fell, bringing the ladder down on top of him. The employee sustained a fractured and dislocated left ankle.
An employee s hand contacted a conveyor belt shaft and was drawn into the ingoing nip point. The employee sustained an amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee tripped over an electrical cord powering a pedestal fan. The employee fell to the floor and sustained a broken hip.
An employee was lowering the metal chute of a concrete truck when it crushed the tips of his left middle and ring fingers. The fingertips were medically amputated.
An employee tripped on his cane and hit his head on a cabinet.
An employee was utilizing crutches and fell while on the way to the presort meeting area. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
While climbing down a ladder at a water treatment plant, an employee fell into a 10-foot-deep pit, landing on the cement floor and suffering a head injury.
An employee was making a delivery at a dealership when he slipped and fell, breaking his hip.
A recycle tech was recycling foam material. While attempting to clear an obstruction from the conveyor, his right arm was caught in the conveyor belt resulting in a fractured forearm.

An employee was installing a hydraulic cylinder onto a forklift using an overhead crane. While manually maneuvering the cylinder into place, the employee s left thumb was pinched between the cylinder and the forklift carriage resulting an amputation up to the first knuckle.
An employee was cutting lumber with a saw. The saw bucked, pulled in the lumber, and amputated the employee's hand.
An employee was on a scissor lift, pulling data cable. The lift struck and injured his stomach.
An employee amputated their right middle finger while handling sheet metal plate.
An employee was wiping down a hood filter area with a towel. The employee slipped and fell into hot water, suffering burns.

As a moving cart was being lowered by a truck's lift gate, one of the four table tops it was carrying slid off. The table top struck an employee's lower left leg, breaking the fibula. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was assisting a crane operator in positioning a conservator when his left ring finger was crushed by the conservator, resulting in hospitalization.
On July 2, 2020, an employee using a hydraulic bottle jack on a mobile home trailer frame suffered a crushed hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting strip steaks with a meat saw. The saw amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was hospitalized for renal failure and dehydration after offloading tankers.
An employee was working on a mule at an airport. A hydraulic line burst as he was pressurizing the hydraulic system, causing him to fall backwards and hit his head on the pavement.

An employee approached an I-beam in order to start welding on it. The I-beam had been set on the ground with an overhead crane and unhooked from the rigging before the crane traveled away. The beam then rolled and landed on the employee's right foot. The employee sustained broken bones and deep lacerations to their right foot. The employee was hospitalized for surgery and wound cleaning.
An employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.
An employee was cleaning oil fryers. A hose broke off and sprayed hot oil onto the employee, who suffered multiple burns.

An employee was handling a wheel at the inspection station. While turning the wheel over onto the table, the flange of the wheel landed on the employee's left index finger causing an avulsion to the distal phalanx that resulted in a surgical amputation.
An employee was sitting on a stool after working a shift. He lost consciousness and fell off the stool due to dehydration.
An employee fell while cleaning the inside of a tank that had contained ethyl alcohol. The employee injured his face and knocked out two teeth, possibly aspirating one tooth.
A motorized pallet jack struck an employee's foot, breaking it.
On 7/3/2020, at 7:00 PM, an employee was climbing down a scaffold and was sprayed by water. This startled him and he jumped off the scaffold. He landed on his heels and fractured them.
An employee was found laying on the ground by a coworker. It is believed he was struck by a package. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee was operating a mower on a sloped hill of a golf course. The employee sustained a head injury and broken ribs after the mower tipped over and pinned the employee to the ground.
An employee was removing a roller on the mast of a gantry head when it shifted and broke the employee's left forearm.

A temporary employee was collecting garbage and picked up a large piece of glass. The employee attempted to turn over the glass and it shattered, lacerating his right arm. The arm was surgically amputated below the elbow.
An employee fell through an opening in scaffold planking, landing on the concrete surface below and suffering a severe head laceration.
An employee was unjamming a wood cutting/wood splitter machine when it amputated the employee's hand.
An employee suffered hot water burns while making tea.
An employee stepped out of a pickup truck, which began to move. The employee fell and the truck ran over the employee's right leg, causing tibia and fibula fractures that required surgery.
An employee was working on a six-foot ladder fishing line through a wall when he fell to the ground and sustained a concussion, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was using a lift truck to put product away in an aisle. After putting product away in a slot, he backed out into a stack of pallets. The top pallet went into the operator compartment, pinning his leg and breaking his tibia and fibula. When he drove forward to free his leg, he fell out of the lift onto the floor. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation when their hand was caught in a machine.
An employee was driving an ATV while inspecting the property. He lost control of the vehicle and ran off an embankment. The employee was hospitalized with multiple injuries, including fractured ribs.
On July 3, 2020, a cabin service agent fainted. She was hospitalized on July 4, 2020, for dehydration.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when his finger was caught between the belt and a sprocket. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet from the second elevated platform to the first elevated platform of an elevated sort tower and landed on the guard rail resulting in a fracture injury.
An employee was walking from the morning meeting to a turnstile. The employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken left knee.
An employee's right ring finger was pinched between a cart and a form tool. The employee suffered a soft tissue amputation to the fingertip.

A nursing assistant's foot caught on the edge of a patient's bed as she was leaving the room. The employee fell to the floor and tried to break her fall with her hands. She sustained two broken wrists.

An employee slipped and fell while walking behind a caf  serving line. She caught a wall-mounted fire extinguisher as she fell; it fell onto her hand when she landed on the floor, amputating her left index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was working at the opening of a silo. A metal panel, propped up next to the silo, slipped and fell to the ground, striking the employee's left foot and causing two fractures and a puncture wound.
An employee feeding paper into a single slice doughboy machine made contact with the heated knife that cuts the paper. The employee sustained amputation of the left ring fingertip.

An employee was on the second step of a step stool replacing grill hood filters when the employee fell. The employee's arm landed in a fryer containing hot cooking oil, resulting in burns on their right hand, arm, stomach, and back.
An employee was attempting to throw away cardboard after stocking shelves when she suffered an amputation injury to her left index finger when it was caught between two stock shelving carts.
An employee became dizzy while descending a water park tower, falling down three stairs and hitting her middle back and the back of her head.
An excavator bucket struck an employee in the head, causing the employee to fall off a jetty and land on a rock. The employee suffered a broken leg.
An employee was moving a 1-inch-diameter metal pipe onto the forks of a forklift. The employee's left hand was pinched between the pipe and the forks; the ring fingertip was crushed and amputated.
On the evening of July 6, 2020, an employee was helping install a power line when his finger was caught in a chain that was being used to lift equipment. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee dismounted a forklift and the forklift continued to move. As he reached for the parking brake, his leg got caught in the right rear tire and was lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.
A 9-foot concrete form fell on an employee's left index and middle fingers, causing avulsions to the ring and middle fingers.
An employee was closing the overhead door of a box truck. The tip of his left ring finger was caught in the joint between the panels and was amputated (without bone loss).

An employee was performing door-to-door sales. While walking between sales visits, the employee tripped on an uneven sidewalk/driveway slab of concrete and fell to the ground, striking his left knee area and suffering bone fractures.
An employee was climbing down a ladder when it shifted. The employee fell and suffered a broken leg. He was hospitalized.

A Goodyear employee was replacing a steer tire on a semi truck on an interstate highway. A vehicle struck the back of the Goodyear truck, which in turn struck the employee. The employee suffered multiple injuries and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was reversing the lock out/tag out while on a pumpjack, removing the chain and binder from 
the unit. The employee slipped and fell onto an angle iron on the outer side of the concrete base. The employee sustained injuries to his right side, including his right hip and elbow, as well as transverse process fractures in two locations.
An employee suffered back pain while lifting a box and collapsed.
An employee suffered a back strain while helping to organize a warehouse.
An employee suffered a lacerated and bruised finger.
An employee tripped on a bale of wood shavings in a chicken house, suffering a broken femur.

An employee fell approximately 12 feet from a garage roof after loading shingles. The fall occurred as the employee was transitioning from the roof to a conveyor used to descend the roof. The employee sustained a broken right hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning out pieces of dough from a machine and amputated her fingertip.

An employee was on a 5-foot rolling scaffold that was being moved as work progressed. The scaffold's wheel got caught causing it and the employee to fall to the concrete floor. The employee sustained head and face injuries.
An employee was preparing to paint a bulk propane storage tank while on a 16' ladder. The employee fell from the ladder onto the ground and sustained a broken pelvis, hip joint, and two ribs.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while entering the restaurant, suffering a broken hip and fractured femur.

An employee was preparing to remove a trailer from a dump truck. The employee had unhooked the electricity and had just removed the pin to the trailer hitch when an excavator was offloaded from the trailer. The tongue of the trailer jumped off the hitch and pinched the employee's right index finger, causing a fracture, a torn ligament, the loss of the nail, and the amputation of about 3/8 inch of the tip.
Employees were clearing underbrush and trees to clear a path for a road to be built. An excavator, used to move a downed tree, struck an employee in the left leg, causing an open fracture.

A construction worker was working with two other workers to remove a metal plate from a semiconductor tool base. The employee was attempting to remove inertial dampeners from the bottom of the plate while it was being suspended by a gantry. The bolt holding the plate sheared and the plate fell, fracturing the employee's arm.
An employee was preparing to use a hoist to move a large, metal plate. The metal plate fell on the operator's right arm, resulting in a fracture.

On July 6, 2020, a mobile equipment operator was operating an overhead crane inside a building and felt light-headed. The employee then took a 15-minute break and drank a bottle of water. After the break the employee was standing and fell to the ground breaking his left ankle. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was removing a clamp from a pipe connection. The pipe sprayed 200-degree water onto the employee, who suffered second-degree burns to the face and from the chest to the knees.

An employee was collecting trash in a residential neighborhood. The employee was placing a 3 x 3 foot mirror into the front-loading garbage truck when the mirror broke. The employee sustained a laceration to their left bicep.
An employee tripped while stepping down from an 8-inch elevated work surface. She fell and suffered a broken hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a trim die machine and the machine amputated 75% of the employee's left pinky finger.

An employee had been using a trimming machine with a 1-inch-diameter radial blade to trim off excess leather shoe material. While he was moving a case of finished trimmed work, the blade nipped his left middle and ring fingers, causing partial amputations.

An employee was installing a solar panel on a second-story residential roof. The employee fell 20 feet from the roof and struck an AC unit. The employee suffered a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee had entered the cab of a delivery truck and was closing the slide door. The door caught the employee's left ring finger as it closed and amputated the top of the finger.

A temporary employee had been loading and unloading tires into a truck trailer when he experienced cramps. He was hospitalized for severe dehydration, heat exhaustion, a kidney injury, and hypochloremia.
An employee was cleaning debris from an auger. The employee suffered an amputation to the left ring finger caused by pliers.

Two employees were moving a 4-foot-diameter hub into position on a 1,300-pound stainless steel shaft. The rigging on the crane carrying the hub failed; the hub fell onto an employee's foot, causing two broken toes and a laceration.
At the end of a 30-minute lunch break, an employee stood up from a chair, lost consciousness (due to heat exhaustion and dehydration), and fell to the floor.
An city mail carrier was attacked by a dog while delivering mail. The dog bit the carrier's left shin severely; the carrier was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was changing the motor and motor sheath of an HVAC unit. As the motor was rotated, his right ring finger was caught between its belt and pulley. The finger was amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee was pulling material from a coil to be cut to proper size. While he was holding the material down, the shearing knife actuated and amputated the tips of his left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was driving a forklift toward a freezer. The forklift slid on the moist floor and collided with a stock picker in a battery charging room. The employee's left foot was caught between the two trucks and broken.
An employee was going up a staircase when his right foot slipped on the first step. His right shin hit the second step and suffered a hematoma.
An employee was filling a chemical day tank when 5 gallons of acid overflowed onto the floor. As he was cleaning it up, the acid flowed over his shoes and burned his feet and toes.
An employee was cleaning out a grinder. As the wheel was being spun, the machine's blade caught his left hand, cutting the fingers and amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was carrying a box down stairs. She fell at the last step, landing on the floor and suffering a broken ankle. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee developed dehydration while removing bracing from a shoring tower.
An employee was on an extension ladder when it broke. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a leg injury.
An employee was exiting a trailer when his left knee buckled. He was hospitalized.
An employee was watching as equipment was loaded onto a flatbed truck. The employee was caught between the machine carrier's two moving poles while unhooking a chain, suffering four broken ribs.

On July 7, 2020, an employee was using an aerial lift to change sprinkler heads in a warehouse facility. The employee was raising the lift and was about 7-8 feet up when his back struck a ceiling beam. The beam pinned the employee against the lift control panel.  The employee suffered abdominal crushing injuries (bruise, contusion, abrasion) and was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling a pallet of milk out of a walk-in cooler with a powered pallet jack. As he turned, his right little finger was caught between the pallet and the steel door frame. The fingertip was amputated.
On July 7, 2020, an employee was adjusting a metal dock plate. The plate fell on the employee's right hand, causing amputations to the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was stacking product off a conveyor belt onto pallets. A carton fell, and the employee's hand was caught between it and the conveyor belt. His middle finger was broken and the tip of his little finger was amputated.
An employee was installing a new power pole when he came into contact with live wires. He suffered electrical burns to his hands.
An employee was trimming the outer edge of a plastic part with a knife. The knife slipped and punctured the employee's forearm.
An employee was doing maintenance work on a commercial trailer's airbag system. An airbag exploded and sent metal fragments into the employee's abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding the tail end of a steel strip through the guide rolls on a press. The employee's right index finger was caught between the strip and the edge guide roll, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was mixing coloring into a distillery tank. A flash fire burned the employee's right middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee was using a saw when it kicked back and struck him in the chest. He suffered a severe cut.
An employee was operating a press brake when it cycled and amputated four fingers on their left hand.
An employee was loading a box truck. The employee fell off the lift gate, landing about 4 feet below and suffering a broken left arm.

An employee was performing remodeling work at a school. The employee turned off the breaker. He was standing on an 8-foot ladder and started stripping a wire, when he was electrocuted. He sustained burns on the right index finger and left middle finger. He also fell off the ladder and sustained a fracture to the head and twisted his back.
An employee was riding a belted man lift when his fall protection became caught in the man lift. The employee fell approximately 8 feet and broke his lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had installed a fan in production. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee was using a cant hook to remove a stuck cant from a cant catcher. The cant kicked back and struck the employee in the lower left leg, breaking the leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was placing parts onto a sawhorse with a crane. The parts started rocking; his finger was caught between them and the sawhorse, and the fingertip was amputated. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was standing on the ground when the wind knocked a 10-foot stepladder from the fourth-floor level. The ladder struck the employee on his hard hat, causing a fracture.
An employee was delivering mail when he became ill, suffering from dizziness and vision problems. He was hospitalized.
An employee was on a ladder hanging a soffit and fascia. The employee fell from the ladder and struck an object on the ground, suffering a burst fracture to a lower-back vertebra.
A piece of logging equipment ran up onto the legs of an employee who was near its left rear track. The employee suffered fractures to both legs that required surgery.

An employee approached a brush pile to gather cut brush. A second employee was cutting limbs in the brush pile using a chainsaw. When that employee turned, the tip of the chainsaw lacerated the first employee's right arm.
While applying a sealant to a home foundation, two employees were overcome by the fumes from the sealant product. One of them was hospitalized.
On July 8, 2020, an employee developed heat exhaustion while performing a post inspection on a garbage truck. The employee was hospitalized.
On July 8, 2020, an employee began cramping and vomiting at the end of a shift doing concrete work. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee was cleaning a container/tank. When the steam hose/line was removed from the container/tank, steam condensate struck the employee in the chest, neck, and face causing second degree burns.

An employee was running a 50-pound bag of sugar through a bag sealer while attempting to correct a problem with the machine. His left index finger was caught in the machine's drive pulleys, and the fingertip was medically amputated. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was backing up a stand-up forklift when his left leg was pinned between the forklift's outer cage and a structural pole. He suffered a large laceration and contusion, with broken bones in the lower leg.
After pulling cable in a ceiling and shoveling dirt onto the back of a truck, an employee developed a hernia. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was in a warehouse, standing on a dock plate between the dock and a truck trailer. The truck pulled forward and the employee was pinched between the trailer and the dock wall. The employee suffered fractures to both legs and some internal bleeding.
An employee was putting a gas-powered generator into an enclosed trailer. As he was moving a metal gas can, a flash fire began and caused burns over 40 percent of his body.
An employee was loading chicken in the thigh deboning machine at the shackle. As he pushed the thighs into the moving shackle his right thumb was caught in a space behind the shackle and amputated.
On July 8, 2020, an employee became ill while delivering packages. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee had been working on the line applying molding. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration and renal failure.
An employee fell 15 feet to the floor from the top of a steel rack and sustained injury to both feet and ankles.
An employee fell approximately 15 feet to the floor from metal racking and landed on their feet. The employee was hospitalized for feet and ankle injuries.

A temporary employee was traveling to a job site. The employee's car broke down at 6:00 p.m. The employee arrived at the site at 8:00 p.m., developed symptoms of heat exhaustion at 8:15, and was hospitalized.
An employee's hand was crushed in a propane cage while exchanging propane cylinders, requiring hospitalization and a finger amputation.

An employee was moving a rack of 25 20-foot steel channel stacks, weighing 625 pounds, on a cart. The cart got stuck on a crack on the ground and tipped over; the channels fell onto the employee's left leg and broke it.
An employee was repairing fog nozzles from a 6-foot ladder. The employee fell to the ground, breaking a wrist and the left ankle.

A forklift was about to lower 800-pound steel decking, being carried on the forklift's forks. Instead the load titled forward and slid off the forks; it fell about 12 inches and hit an employee in the head and the ankle. The employee suffered fractures to the ankle, the tibia, and a back vertebra.
An employee was helping a driver back up a truck. The employee was pinned between the loading dock and the truck's bumper, suffering a crushing injury.
An employee was helping load a semi-trailer truck. As steel material was being placed on the truck, it amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a forklift at a freight terminal dock. As the forklift backed up, it pinned the employee's right middle finger against a safety pole next to a dock door. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a ladder, hanging a TV on a wall. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at the front desk in an extended-stay hotel. A guest who had just received an eviction notice stabbed the employee, causing multiple injuries including a black eye and a possibly punctured lung.
On July 8, 2020, an employee suffered a hiatal hernia while loading an 800-pound safe onto a truck, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was moving a pallet of product with a power jack. After the pallet jack was removed from the pallet, the pallet of product became unstable and cases of product fell onto the employee, injuring one of the employee's ears.
An employee was doing form work when concrete/cement got into his boots. He sustained chemical burns.

Three employees were bracing porcelain tile panels that weighed 2000 pounds. The panels fell and landed on one of the employees, trapping his legs. He suffered minor internal bleeding, a broken pelvis, and five fractures to the femur. He was hospitalized.

Employees were erecting scaffolding inside a vessel. An employee climbed up from near the bottom to the top of the vessel (at ground level). As he was walking up a sloped duct, he lost his balance and fell, sliding about 15 feet down. He suffered a head contusion and an injury to the side.

An employee was driving a stand-up pallet jack in a warehouse. While turning, the jack slipped on oil that was on the floor. The employee's right foot was caught between the jack and the wall, and his large and middle toes were amputated.
An employee was moving livestock. A bull hit a corral gate, which in turn struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken kneecap, a possible throat injury, and a concussion.

An employee was staging sheet metal for manufacturing. The employee bent down to pick up a sheet of paper from the floor. When he stood up, his head struck a piece of sheet metal in a storage rack, and the metal lacerated his scalp.

Two employees were doing monthly preventive maintenance/inspection on a natural gas boiler system. A fire ignited in the system; one employee was burned on the back and side of the head, and the other suffered second-degree burns on his face, arms, and hand.

On July 9, 2020, an employee was in a training class, practicing how to rig and flip I-beams using a chain. His right thumb was slammed between the chain and the beam, causing an avulsion; the thumb tip was medically amputated on July 10, 2020.

An employee was driving a tug with a load into a warehouse. While the employee was trying to disconnect the dolly from the tow tractor hitch, the dolly brake tongue swung and struck his left knee. He suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An inmate punched an employee in the face multiple times, causing facial swelling and a concussion.

An employee was cutting wooden sticks of lumber for a crating operation. When the radial arm saw retracted, it hung up on a small pile of debris. As he reached for a new piece of lumber to cut, the saw blade lacerated his forearm.
An employee suffered nose and eye socket fractures while using an ATV.

An employee was training a new operator when a machine jammed. The employee had used an adjustable wrench to remove bolts and was clearing the machine when its moving parts amputated three fingertips on her left hand.
An employee fell from a conveyor, landing about 10 feet below and breaking his kneecap.
An employee had been cooking. After throwing water on a pan fire, he fell to the floor. The pan and hot grease fell on top of him resulting in second degree burns to the face, arm, and neck.

An employee was standing on a ladder, using a circular saw to cut siding for a residential construction project. The saw kicked back and struck the employee in the left shoulder, cutting it. The employee was hospitalized.
A pallet jack ran over an employee's left heel, causing a fracture and a laceration.
An employee was cleaning the top of a 19-foot tank. The top gave way and he fell to the bottom, suffering fractures to a lower-back vertebra and four toes on the right foot.

An employee was rigging a heat exchanger to a crane. As the crane was applying tension to the load, the rigging slipped. The employee was trying to move the rigging back into place when his hand was caught in the pinch point. Three of his fingers were broken.
An employee had been taking packaged olives off a conveyor. The employee sustained abrasions to her left arm when it was caught between the conveyor and a rolling belt.

An employee was standing at two sawhorses, assembling pieces of wood to be part of a larger concrete form work. She was holding a 2-by-4 with her left hand and a gas-powered nail gun in her right hand. When she fired a 16-penny nail into the wood, it hit a knot, turned out, and punctured her left index finger.

While sanding an axle on a lathe, an employee suffered amputations to the right index, ring, and little fingers (to the first knuckle), as well as the tip of the middle finger when their glove was caught in the lathe.

Two employees were trying to tip a dumpster over onto its front and then onto its top so that they could straighten out the back of the dumpster. One of the doors of the dumpster closed on an employee's left index finger, causing an amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was showing another contractor an upcoming scaffolding job on the outside of an electrical substation. He was standing outside the barrier for a 15-kilovolt rectifier when his pants zipper came in contact with the barrier. Electricity arced from the rectifier to his right arm and then grounded to his zipper, causing electrical burns to his right upper body and pelvic region.
An employee was assisting in positioning a small set of stairs. While on a platform 9 feet from the ground, the employee had a seizure and fell onto the AC unit. He sustained facial fractures.
An employee was walking to his car in the parking lot when he was shot in the abdomen by a former coworker who had been terminated a few days earlier.
A welder suffered heat-related muscle spasms while carrying out general maintenance welding duties. The employee was hospitalized.
A zoo employee was checking on a newborn pygmy zebu calf. The calf's mother attacked the employee, who suffered head and chest injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a saw when the blade amputated their right index finger and thumb.

Employees of Sundown Operating, Inc., and Axis Energy Services, LLC were working at an old oil/gas well plugging the well and getting ready to rig down. The Axis Energy Services employee was working from the platform operating the snubbing equipment. The casing from the well bore connected to the primary BOP broke causing the secondary BOP and the platform where the employee was working to fall to the ground approximately 28 feet below. The Axis Energy Services employee was hospitalized for a fractured leg. The Sundown Operating employee was assisting with the snubbing operation and was struck on the leg by the falling lug nut to the hydraulic BOP. The Sundown Operating employee was hospitalized for a fractured hip.

An employee was working from a ladder, finishing up wiring on a lighting circuit. When a wire was cut, the employee was shocked and fell about 6 feet onto equipment below. He suffered a severe laceration to the left triceps and was hospitalized.
On 7/10/2020, an employee was using a cable hoist to load a utility terrain vehicle (UTV) onto a trailer. The cable caught the employee's right middle finger, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was re-filling the gas tank of a mobile pump and sustained second degree burns on the front of both legs between the top of the ankle and the mid-thigh area.

An employee was changing a surface casing of a drill rig, pulling it up with the drill pipe. His right thumb was caught in a pinch point between the mast and the casing. The thumb tuft was amputated, along with the soft tissue of the thumb tip.
An employee was loading a pallet of merchandise and suffered possible heat stress.

An employee was working to free a stuck overhead door. While trying to get a roller back into the track, a bottom plate which was under tension, came loose, and sprung up striking the employee in the forehead. The employee sustained a forehead laceration and possible skull fracture in the frontal lobe area.

An employee was finishing a shift and preparing the miscellaneous pail line for the next (first) shift.  The employee was trouble-shooting the clutch mechanism or making a last-minute adjustment on the curler machine when it cycled and amputated the employee's right index and middle fingers.

An employee had been doing plumbing work at a warehouse. At the end of his shift, he was stepping into his truck when he lost consciousness, fell backwards, and struck his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering a tool from a height of about 17 feet. The rope wrapped around his right little finger and removed his flesh to the bone on half his finger on the palm side.
An employee slipped on a wet floor, fell to the floor, and suffered spine disc damage.
An employee was riding a horse, rounding up sick cattle at a feedlot. The horse bucked. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was moving a pallet jack when his left ankle was caught between its platform and the wall. He suffered a broken ankle and tibia.
An employee was setting hollow-core plank at a new construction site. The employee fell from the third floor to the second floor, suffering a broken rib and a broken bone in the back.
An employee was using rigging to replace a manhole. The lifting jib fell into the hole, striking the employee in the abdomen.
Substrate beneath a track hoe gave way and the machine lunged forward. The bucket struck an employee who was standing in the trench box. The employee was hospitalized for a contusion on their back.
An employee was repositioning a ventilation fan. It shifted and fell over, severely pinching the employee's left index finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder. The employee fell to the ground, suffered a broken leg, and was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished spray painting the floor of a generator enclosure. The spray paint can was knocked over and ruptured, and the escaping paint vapors ignited. The employee suffered serious burns to the face, neck, hand, and arm.
An employee was overcome by fumes while brazing on an expansion valve and copper line set.

An employee was riding a horse to check on cattle when the horse caught a soft spot on the ground causing the horse to bend down and the employee was knocked into a fence. The employee suffered a possible concussion, head laceration, neck pain, and mouth laceration and pain.
An employee was pulling tools up onto the roof. He laid on his stomach and slid off the upper roof onto the lower roof. When he landed, he suffered a dislocated ankle.
An employee was unjamming a towel when he was pulled between two conveyor belts. He suffered injuries to his neck and legs.
An employee was loading cattle into a pen when two cows charged the employee causing internal injuries and a partially collapsed lung.

An employee was using a crane to set concrete blocks for a concrete footing. The crane came into close proximity with overhead power lines and two employees were electrically shocked and hospitalized.

An employee was operating a meat press when a mold jammed. As the employee was fixing the mold, the machine activated and his right hand was caught in the machine. The employee suffered lacerations and fractures to the right hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was rotating a carousel stacked with cut lumber when he suffered a hernia. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was in the process of exiting a scaffold when he lost his balance and fell approximately 3 to 3.5 feet to the ground below. During the fall, he struck a scaffold bracket. The employee suffered bruised ribs and possible internal bleeding.

An employee was cutting metal on a shear machine. The machine cycled and the ram came down to hold the piece of metal. It crushed the tip of the employee's right little finger, which was medically amputated to the first knuckle.
On July 10, 2020, a hospital employee fell, injuring his head and leg. He was hospitalized.
Three employees were assembling a wooden truss. A nail from a pneumatic nail gun ricocheted off the truss and punctured the left side of the employee's chest.
While delivering products an employee fell about 5 feet off the back of a truck bed and sustained a broken humerus.
An employee was driving a pallet jack down an aisle. The jack spun out on a spill; the employee was pinned between it and a middle rack for a moment. He suffered a lacerated ankle.
An employee's chain glove was caught by a wing module on a moving line. Her left ring finger was pinched between the module and a stainless steel guide, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
A forklift operator was driving in reverse when he hit the side of a wooden pallet. His right little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on the 7th rung of a step ladder performing sheet metal work. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered two broken feet, two fractured vertebrae, and a fractured pelvis (two places).
While delivering food to a drive-through line, an employee tripped on the cord from a floor fan. The employee fell, suffering a broken femur.

An employee was pushing a flight out of the gate. While disconnecting the tow bar, the bar dropped onto the employee's left foot. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the second toe and a fractured big toe on the left foot.
An employee was removing trap lines from a vessel in order to launch the vessel when the wheel of the forklift carrying the vessel struck and fractured the employee's left foot.

Two employees were installing pre-cast concrete floor panels. The concrete floor panels collapsed onto the lower floor when the brackets and/or screws that secured the brackets into the wall failed. Both employees were hospitalized with blunt force trauma injuries.
The injured employee was holding a door for a co-worker when their finger was pinched between the door and the frame resulting in an amputation.
An employee tried to stop a load bar from falling off the back of a trailer. The falling bar struck and injured the employee's pinky finger.
An employee fell down a ladder, landing on both feet and breaking both heels.
An employee was delivering a package and was bitten by a dog. The employee sustained serious lacerations and other injuries that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a car wash tunnel with a cleaning chemical when the chemical spilled onto his shoe. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to his foot/toes.
An employee was servicing an exhaust fan motor. The fan suddenly began to turn, and the employee's thumb was pulled into the pulley and amputated.

Two employees were working on a 2-ton furnace lid that was suspended by a crane. The eye bolt broke, causing the lid to fall and land on the employees. One employee suffered a crushed abdomen and pelvis; the other suffered broken ribs.
An employee was troubleshooting an air conditioner. The discharge line exploded, and a piece of the copper line went into the employee's leg.
An employee was sorting and moving product in the receiving area and began to have an asthma exacerbation. The employee was working with a face covering on.

During demolition of a gel coat booth, an employee stepped on a sheet of plywood and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fracture injury requiring hospitalization. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee was delivering mail and felt dizzy. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was relocating a steel I-beam when their finger was pinched between the beam and a fixed surface. The left index finger was partially amputated.
An employee was on a forklift when the employee's left foot struck a metal beam. The employee suffered toe amputations.
An employee was clearing a piece of meat from the drain plug of a meat grinder and suffered amputation of the left middle and ring fingers.
While coming into work an employee walked up the sidewalk, tripped into a ditch along the sidewalk, and fell into a nearby wall. She was hospitalized with a fractured right arm.
An employee was operating a meat saw to cut dry-aged beef and amputated her left pinky fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was mopping a floor with bleach. The bleach came into contact with the bottoms of the employee's feet, burning them.
An employee was moving a container of boiling water off the stove when the water spilled on her leg. She then slipped in the water and fell. The employee was hospitalized with burns.

An employee was using an electric riding pallet jack to unload a trailer when the jack stopped running and the employee fell off. The jack then kept going, striking and pinning the employee to the trailer floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was on the loading dock throwing trash into a dumpster. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the leg and head.
An employee was making a delivery at a customer's shop. He fell from a flatbed truck to the pavement and sustained a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.
On July 13, 2020, an employee was working on the roof and fell approximately 12 to 15 feet to the ground. He sustained a broken patella and was hospitalized.

An employee was setting up work stations and maneuvering a pallet jack down an aisle-way.  Upon setting the load down, he pressed his left thumb against the racks. The handle of the pallet jack then came down and smashed his left thumb. He sustained a crushed left thumb, resulting in an open fracture and partial amputation of the left thumb tip.
An employee was cleaning parts in the parts washing area in the brass department and began to feel unwell. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
While collecting trash on a residential route an employee became dehydrated and suffered heat exhaustion.

An employee was adjusting product placement in the finished part container, which sits on the end of the quench tank. Water splashed out of the tank and landed on the employee causing second degree burns to the left arm and hand and the left side of the torso.
While stepping out of an elevator an employee slipped and fell into a table. The employee sustained a laceration to the forehead.

An employee was using a mechanical hammer to clean debris from the furnace. As the impact of the hammer knocked debris loose a large section of debris fell and struck the employee resulting in hospitalization for a crushing/blunt force trauma injury.

On July 13, 2020, an employee rolled a flat cart to the outside of the receiving bay door in order to drain standing water off the cart. The cart was next to a delivery truck and when the delivery truck left the dock, the employee fell 3.5 feet off the dock. He was hospitalized with a broken left leg.
An employee was cleaning a packaging machine. While lowering a spiral metal chute, the equipment slammed onto his finger. The employee's right pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was wiring lights when he fell from the fourth step of an 8-foot step ladder. The employee sustained fractures to the clavicle and sternum, and was bleeding from his head.
A truck driver experienced heat exhaustion on the way to the company's terminal.

An employee was emptying a small garbage dumpster on a forklift into a larger dumpster. The employee pulled a lever, then grabbed onto the dumpster, which moved and pinched the employee's fingertip between the two dumpsters. The fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee walked onto a floor that was being stripped with floor stripper. The employee slipped and fell on the floor, hitting their hip, back, and head.

A mechanic was servicing an elevator. As he was reaching around to secure a bolt, he was shocked by the electrical wiring. The employee pulled his arm back suddenly which resulted in a dislocation of his shoulder and a fracture in his arm.

At the feed mill, an employee was wrapping red duct tape around a metal trough. His left index fingertip went inside the trough housing through an unseen hole in the metal. The conveyor screw inside the trough caused a partial amputation of the left index fingertip.

While maintenance employees were evaluating an actuator on top of his work box, the injured employee supplied air to see which direction controlled the valve. When the air released, the injured employee's left index fingertip was amputated by the actuator valve.
An employee was using a grinding disc to grind concrete. The disc broke and the employee sustained a severe cut.
An employee was walking the zoo grounds and tripped on a crack in the sidewalk. The employee sustained a broken left hip, requiring surgery.
An employee was loading a trash cart onto a trailer. He lost his footing and fell approximately 15 feet, sustaining a fractured right hip.
An employee was feeding a piece of stainless steel into a shear press when their fingertip was pinched between the metal part and the base of the press. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was lifting the trailer hitch of an air compressor and sustained torn muscles in his legs, hips, and buttocks.
An employee was climbing down a scaffold, lost his grip while transitioning to a ladder, and fell 12 feet to a pallet on the ground below. He sustained a twisted ankle and broken bones.

An employee was feeding a branch into a chipper when the branch kicked back and caught the employee's hand between it and the top of the chipper. The employee's fingertip was smashed, resulting in an amputation of the left fifth digit tip.
An employee was operating a shear and suffered a partial amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee had been working on a roof and felt ill. He was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

On July 13, 2020, at approximately 11:45 AM, an employee was in a bucket truck using a chainsaw to cut a tree. While cutting, the chainsaw got stuck, causing the tree to twist. A rope, which is used to lower the tree, swung and caught the employee around the neck. The employee was pulled from the bucket but was suspended by his fall harness. The employee was hospitalized with neck injuries.
An employee was loading a trailer when the tip of their right middle finger got caught in an extendable conveyor belt and was amputated.

An employee had been tasked with roofing work. Upon descending the roof for lunch, a portion of the roof collapsed and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained two broken ribs and a head laceration requiring stitches.

A welder was tasked with a repair project on a de-barker machine. He was carrying a 44-pound roll of welding wire to the location. Accessing the de-barker drum requires walking down a rubber conveyor. While stepping onto the conveyor, the employee slipped. This caused him to drop the roll of wire onto his right hand. He sustained crushing injuries to the fingers on his right hand and required surgery for his right middle finger.

On July 13, 2020, at approximately 4:30 p.m., an employee was removing a bale (12" x 10" x 8") of scrap aluminum from the discharge area on a baling machine. His right little finger was caught in the baling press area and was amputated to the first knuckle.

An employee shut off the leveler and climbed on the tarp to straighten it. As he was stepping off the tarp, the leveler started back up. The employee slipped. His foot landed on the leveling paddle and his leg got caught between the rotating paddle wheel and the frame. The employee s lower leg was fractured.

An employee was doing a final inspection to verify that all contracted work had been completed. While retrieving a paint tray that was left on the roof, he fell approximately 8 to 10 feet from the roof to a bed of rocks and a concrete sidewalk. He was hospitalized with a fractured vertebra, a fractured toe, a broken wrist, a cut on his forehead that required stitches, and a bump on the forehead.

An electric gate at a third party facility would not operate. The pin pad had been disabled and the chain had been unhooked from the operator for the gate. An employee was manually opening the gate (pushing it open) when the chain got caught on a bolt or other object. While the employee was trying to release the chain, the gate moved, causing the employee's hand to go through a roller. He sustained contusions and lacerations to four fingers and a partial amputation of his left middle fingertip.

An employee had been rigging long-span steel joists for hoisting when several joists that were leaning against a wall fell, striking the employee's foot. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the ankle.
An employee was working above ceiling tiles installing a junction box. The employee fell from a ladder and sustained a skull fracture.
On July 14, 2020, an employee was felling a tree from the ground using a chainsaw when a tree trunk hit his pelvis area. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
A lighting fixture slipped out of an employee's hand. As he tried to catch it, the sharp edge of the fixture cut his wrist in two places, severing the tendon.

An employee was inspecting the installation of a peel and stick membrane on a residential roof. The employee tried to peel off a section of the membrane, lost his balance, and fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete ground. The employee suffered a fractured back and dislocated wrist.
An employee was removing a jammed bundle from a conveyor when their finger was pulled by a sheet metal guide. The employee sustained an amputation of the right ring fingertip.
After carrying out tire servicing, waiting on maintenance shop customers, and answering phone calls, an employee became ill. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.

An employee was pulling a rear sway bar off of a vehicle when a piece of metal came loose and hit him in the eye. He sustained a tear to the iris and cornea of the right eye, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was changing a tire on a forklift when the forklift slipped and smashed his right hand. The employee was hospitalized with possible broken bones.
While using a band saw to cut meat, an employee's thumb was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was operating a slitting machine when his left hand was contacted by either the coil or the mandrel. His left index fingertip was amputated.
An EMT was responding to a grass fire and went into a home to evacuate it. The employee suffered smoke inhalation and was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding an overhead crane C-hook into coils of sheet metal. His hand was on the back side of the C-hook when it struck another master coil. His finger was caught between the C-hook and the coil, resulting in a partial amputation of his right distal pinky finger.

An employee was driving a loader with pipes attached to the bucket. The loader's rear wheels left the ground while it was driving down a hill. The employee then lowered the bucket and the loader began bucking. The employee was thrown around inside the cab. He was hospitalized with a compressed disc in his neck and pinched nerves.
An employee was driving on his designated route, delivering mail, when he felt cramps in both hands and both legs. The employee suffered dehydration.

Two employees were performing work on an automated welder. One employee was operating the main control panel and the injured employee was working at the rear of the machine. When the machine was restarted, it pinched the injured employee's pinky finger causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was carrying an 8-inch cast iron casting from the yard when he tripped on a pallet of ready-mix concrete bags and fell. His right thumb was pinched and severely lacerated.
An employee exited the passenger side of a refuse truck to collect garbage. The truck's passenger side front tire rolled over his right foot causing a crushing injury to the foot.
An employee was using a knife to cut sheets into rags when the knife cut their right thumb. The laceration resulted in amputation of the thumb tip.

On 7/14/2020, an employee on a loading dock was scanning a barcode that was attached to the rear door of a trailer. The employee lost her balance and fell 45 inches from the dock to the cement ground. The employee sustained a broken left arm, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On July 14, 2020, an employee was operating a machine that wraps plastic film over seafood trays when the plastic film became jammed. As he attempted to pull out the plastic from the back side of the machine with his right hand, the machine's blade amputated his right middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a pallet jack in reverse when it struck a rack. The employee was pinned between the pallet jack and the rack and sustained broken bones and internal bleeding.

An employee was making trial parts in a press when the press unexpectedly stopped. The employee reached into the die and the press finished its cycle causing fractures and lacerations to the employee's wrist.

An employee was picking up trash on a route and operating the levers that put the sweep blade into motion to sweep recycling materials into the body of the rear-load truck. The sweep blade knocked some of the material out of the hopper. The employee was pushing material back into the hopper when his left hand was caught by the sweep blade. The thumb on his left hand was pinched and broken.
An employee was on the raised platform of an order selector. While trying to reach something, he fell to the ground resulting in fractures to both legs.
An employee was turning a plastic part in a puller machine when his left hand was caught in the machine, resulting in multiple lacerations and stitches. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving furniture. When the piece being carried bumped into a stationary object, the carried piece's glass shattered. The glass lacerated the employee's arm resulting in a cut artery and nerve.

An employee was operating a roll former when either his glove and/or a rag was caught in the machine. He was hospitalized with partial amputations to the right middle, ring, and pinky fingers. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was assisting with cutting a tree. A branch that was being cut spun on the rope and struck the employee. He was hospitalized with fractures to the ribs and pelvis.

On July 14, 2020, an overhead linesman was standing in his bucket waiting for the rope which pulls the wiring lead conductor. The roller broke and a piece of it projected towards him striking his left arm. He was hospitalized with a broken left arm.

An employee was inspecting the inside of an industrial heat treating furnace. A defective relay allowed natural gas to flow into an area of the furnace and the gas was ignited by the radiant tube heating system. The employee was directly in front of a fireball that came from the oven, and sustained second degree burns to the head, face, and neck.
A delivery driver had clocked out and gone home after his shift. The employee later called management and informed them he felt ill. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress and dehydration.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to access a roof when the ladder kicked out at the bottom. He was 8 to 9 feet above ground level and tried to hold on to the roof line to stop falling.  However, the ladder continued to kick out and he fell, sustaining a sprained left ankle and knee, two fractured disks, and a broken tailbone. He was hospitalized.
Three employees were moving a patient. The patient fell and one of the employees sustained a back injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was working as a rigger for a crane that was putting a separator on a trailer. The rigging slipped as the load touched down and the chain struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture of the left arm.

An employee was cutting a large tree (135') in order to provide an anchor point for the yarder. When the tree came down, it landed on several root wads that were on the ground from a previous felling operation for road clearing the year before. The rood wads moved another tree (50') that was covered with brush. The arms of the tree that was on the ground came up and struck the employee in the face. The employee sustained a concussion, a broken and lacerated nose, severe bruising and a fractured eye socket, and a punctured lung.

An employee was gathering carts in the parking lot and putting them on the cart mule. The employee was walking back to the mule and was hit by a customer's vehicle. The employee was thrown approximately 25 feet from the point of impact and sustained a broken leg, a broken wrist, and other injuries.
An employee was throwing away scrap. In the scrap bin, the employee moved a mandrel hanger to an empty spot and his right little finger got caught against another mandrel resulting in amputation.
An employee slipped and fell while entering a warehouse. The employee was hospitalized with a lower back injury.

An employee was on a dock attempting to dislodge a tarp winder that was caught on a truck trailer. When the tarp winder became dislodged, the employee fell 4.5 to 5 feet to the concrete floor between the dock and the trailer, cracking his pelvis and seven ribs.

An employee descended from a forklift to fill a container with a chemical from a tote that was mounted on the forks of a forklift. The chemical tote hit the employee, resulting in injury and hospitalization.
An employee was using a ratchet wrench to loosen a bolt. The adapter that holds the socket on the wrench broke. This caused the employee to fall to the ground and sustain a broken right femur.

An employee had been making a bale with the baler. While ejecting the bale, she noticed the metal wire was stuck on the chain in the machine. The employee cut the wire free. The bale then fell, knocking her over and resulting in two broken wrists. She was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was putting a grease container on a fuel service truck at the fueling station. He tripped and fell on the ground, sustaining a dislocated knee that required surgery.
An employee fell on the floor and fractured their wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was on a truck picking up road cones when he fell off the back of the truck, suffering a broken ankle and head laceration.

An employee was using a hand truck to move a refrigerator from the shipping container to the receiving area. While moving the appliance onto the dock plate, the weight of the refrigerator caused her to fall onto her back and the refrigerator landed on top of her. The employee was hospitalized.

While standing next to a forklift, an employee was struck by another forklift that was backing up. He was pinned against the forklift that he was standing next to. The employee's leg was further injured when the vehicle turned to pull away.
While walking, an employee was struck from behind by a forklift that was backing up. Both of the employee's legs were amputated.
An employee was operating a machine. While clearing a jam, the blade amputated their left ring fingertip.
An employee was performing maintenance on a depanner conveyor when their finger was caught between a chain and sprocket. The right index finger was amputated.
An employee was assisting with the hoisting of a concrete barrier. The hoist chain caught the employee's thumb against the concrete barrier and the thumb tip was amputated.

A temporary employee was working with a garbage collection truck. The employee's finger was cut by the edge of a television while picking it up. He sustained an amputation of the left ring finger, was hospitalized, and had surgery.
Two employees were performing maintenance on a shear. One of the employee's hands slipped during a lift and the guard fell on their right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was pulling wire on the ceiling of a structure under construction. The employee fell through an opening in the ceiling, landing on the concrete floor about 9 feet below and suffering a broken lower-back vertebra.
An employee was on the back of a work truck platform. As he was stepping off the platform, he slipped and fell, struck his head, and sustained a skull fracture.

An employee was monitoring the flow of lumber at the even end rollers of the planer mill's stacker unscrambler. A board skewed off the even end rollers striking the employee and causing him to fall and hit his head on the floor. He sustained a laceration to the back of the head.

An employee walked to the back of the assembly line to sign off on the completion of the fail-safe process. When they were returning to the front side of the assembly line, the employee stepped inside the frame of a finished goods cart and tripped, striking their head and right shoulder against the cart and the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a head laceration and a dislocated right shoulder.

A fire occurred while an employee was transferring fuel from a larger tank to a smaller tank on a pickup truck. The employee was burned on the right arm and the right side from their armpit to their waistline. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee on a horse was pushing yearlings (cattle) out of the willows to the meadow. The employee was riding his horse over to rope a yearling when the yearling turned quickly, along with the horse. The horse slipped on wet grass and fell on top of the employee. His leg was caught between the horse and the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.

An employee was spotting for the operator of a road paver as it was backing up. The employee was struck by the paver and caught against a road roller machine. He sustained injury, including a crushed artery, to the left thigh requiring surgery.
An employee was connecting electrical pipes. A pipe slipped and struck the employee's finger.

On 7/15/2020, an employee was working near the barb wire manufacturing machines. He was making sure wire was in the machine and was adding and removing spools of wire. The employee experienced cramps and was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was walking to her car when she tripped and fell in the parking lot, fracturing her shoulder and breaking her wrist.
An employee was descending stairs and missed the bottom step. The employee fell on his right elbow.
An employee was delivering mail when she stepped on a board which broke, causing her to twist and fracture her ankle.

The injured employee stumbled while walking and bumped into another employee that was using scissors to cut poultry. The injured employee was struck by the scissors and was hospitalized with a puncture to the right side of the chest.
An employee was performing roofing work, suffered heat exhaustion/heat stroke, and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing the plastic film roll on a conveyor belt when the employee's finger was caught between the conveyor chain and the chain cover, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was moving a generator at a storage yard. While re-adjusting the generator on a trailer, the rope snapped and the employee was ejected from the bucket truck. The employee fell to the ground, hitting the trailer on the way down. The employee sustained fractures to the ribs, hip, and left leg.
An employee was working in the cooler when their foot got caught in the floor chain that moves product throughout the cooler. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the right foot.

An employee had been operating fans with wind-power equipment. The employee fell backwards, off a ladder, approximately five feet to the lower surface. The employee sustained a lower back and tailbone injury.
An employee descending from an 8-foot step ladder lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, breaking his wrist and hip.

An employee was helping to install steel piping for a water well. A well digging machine was holding the pipe vertically and moving it into position when the pipe came out of the holder and fell on the employee's left foot. Several toes were crushed and had to be amputated.
An employee was moving a load of steel with a forklift. The load shifted, so the employee got off the forklift to straighten up the load. The load fell on him and injured his back.
An employee fell on a slippery belt loader that was wet due to rain and broke the right ankle.

A YRC driver was standing in front of a freight dock waiting for paper work. The driver was struck from behind by a trailer that was backing into the dock. The driver felt the impact in their hip/back area and immediately turned to the left and fell to the ground. The injured driver was hospitalized with a possible fractured pelvis.
An employee was leak testing gas riser parts when the leak tester's sliding clamp returned to its home position and caught his left index fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking in the parking lot and was struck by a tractor trailer that was in the process of parking. The employee sustained fractures to a rib and elbow and head lacerations.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press and attempting to remove a cut piece of metal when the machine was actuated and amputated his left index and middle fingertips.
An employee was preforming daily maintenance on an asphalt crusher when he lost his balance and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground, hitting his head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing tooling components from a 2,000-ton trim press. He was using a ratchet to loosen the bottom bolts to secure the tooling. The weight of the upper portion of the tooling was secured by a 2 x 2 block of wood. This block failed, allowing the top portion to contact the employee's hand and crush his left middle finger. He was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was moving a flat bar/plate from a storage rack using an overhead crane equipped with a lifting magnet. The magnet detached from the plate and the plate struck the employee's left forearm as it fell to the ground. The employee sustained a severe laceration.

An employee was swabbing a valve at an oil well site when the swab tool spun around and struck him in the torso. He sustained a broken right arm, broken sternum, and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working with an air handling unit when his head struck the unit, causing numbness in his arm, head, and neck.

An employee was holding a box down on a box printer machine when the employee's left hand became pinched between the feeder opening and the guide that pushes the box into the machine, resulting in an amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a roll forming machine when it activated, causing the partial amputation of a finger.
A high-pressure hose separated, swung, and struck an employee's arm, breaking it.
An employee was airing up a single tire on an implement rim when the tire blew off the rim, resulting in facial fractures requiring hospitalization.

An employee was making cuts on a 20-inch long piece of material using a radial arm saw. One of the pieces cut crooked. The employee went to even the cut and the blade caused a severe laceration to his left thumb.

An employee was using a table saw to cut through 2 inches of ISO insulation when his thumb was amputated. It was later reattached during surgery. The palm of the hand was also injured. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee received an electric shock while connecting a new construction residential home to an outside pedestal.
An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw when it kicked back and lacerated the inside of his right leg below the knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trimming a tree limb with a chainsaw. When the limb started to come down, the employee reached to grab it and the chainsaw cut his right wrist/hand, including an artery. The injury required surgery.

An employee was reversing a forklift into a parking spot when the employee became dizzy and lost control of the forklift. The employee collided with a rack and sustained a lower left leg fracture and laceration.

A delivery driver was lifting bundles of wire mesh off a flatbed trailer using a truck-mounted lift. As he was lowering the mesh, the lift tipped over and ejected him forwards. He landed on the ground and was injured.

At approximately 1:33 PM on July 17, 2020, an employee was walking toward a water dispenser to refill her water bottle when she tripped over a safety mat and fell to the floor, breaking her humerus. She was hospitalized.

An employee was supervising a shift starting at 5:30 PM and was also assisting in running the glass machines. Around 2:30 AM, the employee began to cramp up and went home. He was later hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

On 7/17/2020, at 3:00 PM, an employee entered a screen machine to clear debris from the spindles and discs. The employee exited the screen machine via the downstream conveyor. The employee walked alongside the conveyor to exit the area and fell through a material chute at the end of the conveyor to the ground 17 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and fractures to the left leg, pelvis, ribs and face.
An employee fell approximately 10 to 12 feet from the top of a concrete masonry unit wall to the ground.

An employee was walking by a pit at the bus maintenance garage when he slipped and fell at least 6 feet down into the pit. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs, a punctured lung, a head contusion and possible bleeding on the brain.
An employee was seated behind a desk. The employee stood up, turned, lost balance, tripped and fell, sustaining a broken left hip.
An employee was climbing a ladder while carrying a piece of aluminum fascia when the fascia contacted an overhead power line. The employee received an electric shock.
While an employee was adjusting a stop on a machine the machine engaged and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was guiding a small piece of metal into a shear cutter when the blade partially amputated his left middle finger (no bone).

An employee was attempting to bend back a loose pulley onto the mast of a powered industrial truck when the employee made contact with the lever. The mast then tilted back, causing the employee to become caught between the truck's mast and overhead guard. The employee sustained abdominal injuries and intestinal bleeding.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder while closing a ceiling hatch, shattering both heels and sustaining a laceration to the back of his head.
An employee tripped on the arm of a machine and fell into hot asphalt. He sustained burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was team lifting a frame from the ground and trying to hang it on the non-powered spur of an overhead conveyance system when the frame slipped and struck the employee's right forearm, causing a laceration.
An employee was using a grinder to cut mortar joints in a concrete masonry unit when the grinder kicked back and cut into the right side of his face/mouth.

An employee was unloading windows out of a box truck at a customer's place of business when the windows fell over and knocked him out of the truck and onto the ground. He sustained a fractured rib and punctured lung.

An employee was operating a forklift to stack insulation and attempted to reverse the forklift. The forklift contacted another roll of insulation, which fell on top of the forklift. The employee stepped out of the forklift to remove the insulation. The insulation then hit the ground and bounced, striking and breaking the employee's left fibula.
An employee was stabbed multiple times by a shoplifter in the store and suffered a head injury.

On July 17, 2020, an employee was using a circular saw to cut a piece of a window sill when a small piece of wood became stuck, causing the blade guard to not fully retract. The blade then kicked back and lacerated his leg.
An employee was making precast connections at the construction of a new air tower. The anchor gave way and the employee fell 3 to 4 feet to the next level resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was standing on top of a sand truck. The truck moved and the employee fell approximately 8 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained injury to his ribs and a laceration to his head.
An employee fell while walking and was hospitalized.
While operating a forklift an employee became ill and fell to the ground. He fractured his neck and was hospitalized.

On July 17, 2020, two employees were using a 6-wheeled utility vehicle to assist them in traveling between rows of apple trees to pick up pruned branches from the ground. At approximately 10:00 a.m., the injured employee was picking-up branches and was struck by the utility vehicle. The injured employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures of the sternum, pelvis, and ribs.
An employee was providing security services when a customer came in the facility and started stabbing people with a knife. The employee suffered multiple stab wounds.
An employee was bitten/stung by a small animal (insect or similarly sized) while cleaning a student dorm.
An employee was trying to clear a slab that was jammed in a saw when his right arm contacted the saw, resulting in an amputation below the elbow. The saw was operational at the time of the incident.
An employee was gathering brush on the ground when a 4-inch by 2-foot piece of wood fell and struck the employee's hard hat. The employee sustained a bruised spinal cord.
An employee was moving concrete barrier blocks when their pinky finger got caught between two blocks. The finger was fractured and required surgery.
An employee fell from a ladder that was more than 15 feet high to the unpaved dirt ground, suffering a broken clavicle as well as broken ribs and vertebrae.
While cutting and trimming grating with a torch, an employee cut the grating he was laying on and fell 7 feet to the concrete ground, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was flagging traffic when a vehicle veered into the work zone and struck the employee. The injured employee sustained a torn aorta and fractures to the hip, arm, and hand.

An employee was laying sheathing onto a flat roof. A sheet of OSB slipped out and he fell through the roof trusses to the ground 17 feet below. He suffered a broken right ankle, two damaged vertebrae, and soft tissue injures and was hospitalized.

A temporary employee was using a cordless drill to attach a hose clamp to machinery. The drill arced, which caused a fuel bucket to ignite. The employee's left arm and right hand were burned by the fire.
An employee climbed on a conveyor to unjam a box. While dismounting the conveyor, he was flipped and then fell on his arm. He sustained broken bones in his right forearm.
An employee was walking down a stairway when his knee buckled.
On 7/18/2020, at 1:30 PM, an employee fell from a ropes course while doing some maintenance work. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated elbow and fractured pelvis.
A paramedic and was providing patient care in full personal protective equipment (PPE) and became dehydrated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a chain length with an angle grinder when the grinder kicked back and cut the employee's left forearm, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on the ground using a chain saw to cut a tree that was storm-damaged when he slipped and dropped the chain saw. He then fell on the saw blade, cutting his arm and requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was at the door of a pulpit. His left hand was on the door jamb when the door closed on and pinched his left ring finger, resulting in a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was maneuvering a pallet of produce when it began to tip over. Produce fell off the pallet onto his right ankle causing a contusion.

After cutting wood on a table saw, an employee turned the saw off and attempted to grab the cut pieces of wood. The still-rotating blade then partially amputated his right ring finger and amputated his right middle finger and right index fingertip.
An employee was using chemical cleaning products to unclog a sink drain when the employee inhaled the chemical mixture and suffered respiratory irritation.

On July 18, 2020, a temporary employee, who is supervised by Imeson Distribution Center, was dissembling racks. The employee was using a platform on a forklift to  reach the first rack's crossbars. The employee fell 5 to 6 feet from the forklift to the ground. He was hospitalized with a broken left elbow.
An employee was removing an electric pallet jack from the equipment room when the pallet jack crushed his foot against the wall. The employee's left foot was amputated at the hospital.
An employee was troubleshooting a cutting machine. He lifted the pusher and the machine activated. The machine then struck and injured his right elbow.

An employee was working on an HVAC system replacing a belt on an exhaust fan. The cover to the exhaust fan was on his left on the roof surface. The employee took a picture of his completed work,   and stepped to the left when his pants caught on the edge of the exhaust fan cover. He then fell backwards onto a rooftop access hatch. The employee sustained three broken vertebrae and four broken ribs.
An ABS employee fell and was hospitalized.
An employee was detasseling corn and felt ill. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to saw down a small pine tree near a larger rotting pine tree when the small tree fell against the larger tree and jolted it. An upper section of the larger pine became dislodged and fell several minutes later. The employee was struck and pinned to the ground by a protruding branch of the trunk section that fell. He suffered crushed vertebrae, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee fell to the ground while climbing down a ladder and sustained a broken leg/ankle.
