An employee was operating a pallet jack in the warehouse when his foot was caught between the standing platform of the pallet jack and a support column. The employee was hospitalized with a crushed right foot, requiring surgery.

Employees were setting large sandbags along the edge of a retaining wall using an excavator to lift the bags into place. An employee was attaching the hook when his right index finger was caught between the hook and the nylon strap. When the load was lifted, the finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was checking on an error. He went to level off the tabber equipment when the machine turned on, amputating his right middle fingertip.

An employee was operating a forklift. While traveling on the dock, the forklift hit a guardrail and stanchion pole. The employee's leg was pinched between the stanchion and the forklift resulting in a fractured left foot.

An employee was working as a cashier inside the fuel kiosk while the roof was being replaced. The employee became nauseous, got a headache, and experienced chest pains from the fumes inside the kiosk.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a safety bollard. His left thumb was caught between the forklift and the bollard and amputated.

An employee was breaking up hardened residual ash to remove it from the inside of the second chamber of a dryer during a scheduled outage of the equipment. A piece of the ash fell and pinned the employee's legs. Interior layers of the residual ash were still hot, causing third degree burns on the right leg, second degree burns on the left leg, and second degree burns to portions of both arms. The employee was hospitalized.
A test plug blew off and struck an employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a portable fan when their fingers were contacted by the blades resulting in amputation of the ring fingertip.

An employee was working behind a register. There were wires connected to a counterfeit bill checker that were under the counter. As she passed by, her foot became tangled in the wires causing her to fall and strike her hip and head on the floor. She sustained a broken left hip and injury to the head.

An employee was standing between two concrete forms. One of the forms was lifted and during the lift it shifted and struck the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized with injury to the ankle and knee.
An employee was mixing cement using a cement mixer when he felt ill. The employee started sweating and became lethargic due to possible heat stress.
An employee was cleaning up and sweeping the floor inside the facility when he fainted. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on top of a ceiling joist in attic space to install an HVAC vent system. The ceiling joist cracked, split, and broke in half causing the employee to fall approximately 10 feet. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and head, back and neck trauma.
While operating the edger and long chain conveyors, an employee's glove got caught between the roller and guard. Three fingers were crushed.
An employee had been repairing a roof and later that evening was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was driving a utility vehicle (UTV) on sloped terrain on the side of the road, off the public way. The vehicle rolled several times, hitting the driver. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail and suffered heat stroke.
An employee was on a wooden ladder climbing to the second floor of an apartment complex. The ladder gave way, causing the employee to fall to the ground. He sustained fractured ribs.

A forklift operator had just placed a 3-high stack of bundled lumber on the ground. He then backed the forks out from underneath the bundles and exited the forklift. He used a pair of snips to cut the nylon banding off the top bundle. The top bundle moved and the bottom board fell to the ground. As the employee moved away from the stacked bundles, he tripped over the forks and fell to the concrete ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the right ilium and femur.
An employee fell approximately 10-12 feet off a ladder and was hospitalized.
The injured employee slipped and fell while practicing tactical body carrying. The trainee being carried landed on the injured employee's ankle and broke it.

An employee was under a truck using a stethoscope to diagnose a problem. The rear of the truck was on a lift, raised about 1 foot; the front of the truck was on the ground. The employee was pinned under a spinning tire and sustained chest compression.
While working in the facility, the injured employee's throat was cut by another employee.
An employee tripped over a curb and injured their wrist requiring surgery.

An employee was using a chain hoist to lift a cant from a conveyor. The cant swung and crushed the employee's fingers against the conveyor frame resulting in amputation of the left ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was using a boom lift to access and install a light bracket on the side of a bridge. The bracket came loose and struck the employee causing injury to the forearm that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning an empty hospital room using a cleaner with bleach. He developed breathing problems after inhaling the bleach fumes and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a forklift when his left foot struck a pallet of freight and was fractured.
While cleaning an automatic screw machine, an employee's left thumb was crushed and partially amputated in the machine. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was loading and unloading boxes of chickens onto a freight elevator. The elevator's doors struck the employee, breaking both arms.
An employee turned on belt washers to help the sanitation crew. A hose then whipped and the fitting on the end of the hose struck the employee's left leg resulting in a compound fracture.
An employee was lowering a bundle of PVC pipe links with a truck's tailgate when his hand was caught between the lift gate chain and the lift gate. His right index finger was fractured.

An employee was walking in the facility when they stepped in front of a traveling powered industrial truck (PIT). The PIT stopped abruptly and stretch-wrapped barrels of product rolled forward off the forks and contacted the employee. The injured employee was knocked to the floor and sustained a fracture to the pelvis and left wrist.
An employee sustained amputation, crushing, and laceration injuries to his right hand while setting up a roll form machine.
An employee was operating a screw machine when the gears caused an amputation to three fingers on their left hand.

At 12:10 p.m. on July 20, 2020, a city mail carrier was delivering a parcel at a front door when a dog charged through the screen door and began to chase him. As he ran from the dog, he fell and his head struck the curb. He suffered a concussion and lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
A mini-excavator was being loaded onto a flatbed trailer when it rolled over the side of the trailer and struck an employee. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised kidney.

An employee of West Texas Boring was 2.5 feet from the edge of a pit trying to measure the distance of the water line. The ground gave way under his feet and he slid down into the pit. The employee was buried up to his waist in approximately 4 cubic yards of heavy rock and dirt. He sustained fractures to the ribs and a leg.
An employee was walking backwards with a powered pallet jack when their leg was caught between the pallet jack and a pole. The employee was hospitalized with a broken tibia/fibula.
An employee's left little finger was caught and lacerated in a cutting machine.
While walking down the hall an employee tripped and hit their head on a wall, resulting in a concussion.

An employee was using a table saw equipped with a dado blade to cut a notch in a board. When the employee turned on the saw, the dado blade caught the board and kicked it back, causing the employee's left hand to contact the dado blade. Three fingertips were amputated.

The employee was working from a bucket truck transferring live wires from an old power pole to a new pole. The employee's lanyard got close enough to a live wire that an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained second degree burns where the metal parts of the harness contacted his body.
An employee was changing an air filter in an attic. The employee fell through the ceiling to the floor 13 feet 9 inches  below, suffering a broken wrist and a concussion.

A driver was delivering groceries from a truck to a store. He slipped on the ramp at the back of the truck and fell to the ground along with the dolly he was using. He suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving product through a warehouse using a powered industrial truck (PIT). The PIT reversed and struck a post. The employee sustained a broken left tibia and fibula.

An employee was stocking shelves of vitamins using a 3-tiered step stool. The employee missed the last step while descending the step stool and fell backwards to the floor. The employee sustained a broken left hip.

The injured employee was painting while another subcontractor on the same floor was using a generator to conduct welding. Carbon monoxide from the generator accumulated and overcame the injured employee.
An employee was removing pipe from the lifting hook when the pipe slipped out of the hook and partially amputated the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was standing nearby while a dump truck dumped a load of gravel. The employee tried to manually remove a rock that was stuck in the tailgate and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.

An employee was repairing an automobile when the vehicle's control arm dropped on the employee's left hand. The employee sustained an amputation to the nailbed and first knuckle of the left middle finger.
An employee was doing a walk-around inspection of a tractor trailer when he tripped and fell over a tire that was hidden in the grass. His knee was dislocated.
An employee was sorting packages on the conveyor belt. The employee felt cramps throughout their entire body and was hospitalized due to heat stress/dehydration.

An employee was removing excess butter from a machine when the filler caught the employee's disposable glove, forcing their finger into the mold. The employee sustained lacerations and fractures to two areas of their left middle finger.

On July 21, 2020, after working the morning in his office, an employee filled in for a delivery driver in the afternoon. He fell ill after the end of the workday and was hospitalized with symptoms of dehydration.

An employee slipped and fell approximately 5 feet to the floor from a shelving unit. The employee sustained contusions to the face and a compound fracture to the right ankle requiring hospitalization.
An electrician was performing repair work on an electric panel and tightening the lugs on some wires in the panel. An arc blast occurred resulting in burns to his face, arms, chest, and neck.
On 7/21/2020, an employee was standing on the tines of a forklift to repair a trailer door and fell to the ground. The employee was found unresponsive next to the trailer with head and neck trauma.
An employee was bending rebar on a rebar bending machine when their finger was caught. The fingertip was crushed and was amputated at the hospital.

An employee had been conducting framing work. The employee was laying plywood to a window opening and was leaning against the guardrail. The guardrail gave way and he fell from the third floor. He struck a beam on the second floor and landed between two concrete platforms in the grass. The employee sustained multiple injuries including a compressed fracture with retropulsion at the L2 vertebra, a pelvic fracture, and a non-displaced sacral alar fracture.
An employee was pushing electrical wire through an underground conduit. The electrical wire arc-flashed with a switch gear and the employee sustained burns to the hands and face.
An employee was stepping off a truck crane and fell from the ladder to the ground fracturing an ankle.

An employee was helping to set the pick on the anchors. The approximately 15-foot rail fell and hit the employee. The employee sustained an injury to the legs or spine, and a fractured foot. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell through an opening in a deck. He landed about 7 feet below and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum with a bandsaw when he sustained the amputation of approximately 1/2 inch of the right index fingertip.

An employee was returning a client to bed from the shower. The employee slipped and the client rolled out of the bed, landing on the employee's leg and fracturing the patella and fibula. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing debris from a conveyor when a pedal on the machine caught his right index finger resulting in an amputation to the first knuckle.

The injured employee was in the nose of a 53-foot trailer inspecting a piece of freight. Another employee pulled onto the dock plate at the rear of the trailer and the freight fell on the injured employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur.
While loading a dumpster, an employee turned, fell to the ground, and sustained a fractured hip.

Two employees were working in close proximity to a paving machine that was attached to a dump truck. When the dump bed was elevated, it contacted overhead electrical wires. The two employees were hospitalized for electrical burns.
An employee was cutting plywood on a table saw and amputated a fingertip.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs when her heel got caught on one of the stair treads. The employee sustained a fractured tibia.
An employee was checking a dewatering pump when he fell from a step stool, landing on his chest and fracturing two ribs.
While cleaning a mill roll, an employee's finger was caught by metal on the moving roll. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was sanding drywall while standing on a 6-foot step ladder. She fell and sustained a fractured left ankle.
On July 22, 2020, an employee was loading material onto a machine when his back struck the static metal bar on the machine. The employee's back was injured and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hooking up a tandem trailer. While attaching the dolly section, the employee was pinned between the dolly and the trailer and suffered a broken left leg.
An employee exited the cab of a crane and walked down the middle of the bed to the ladder. He lost his footing and fell from the bed to the ground.

On July 22, 2020, at approximately 2:00 AM, an employee was preparing to wash down equipment. When he opened the door of the equipment, his left thumb was pinched against the power panel attached to the opposite wall, causing an injury that required surgical amputation of the distal portion of the thumb.
An employee was off-loading a windmill blade when his right index finger was caught in the rigging. He sustained an amputation to the right index finger near the nail.
An employee was hiking down steep rocky terrain when he twisted his right knee.
An employee was operating a mill creating taps and dyes and suffered a laceration to the left middle finger requiring surgery.
An employee collapsed while loading tools at the end of a shift. The employee was hospitalized for a heat injury.
An employer was in back of the concrete mixer truck washing down the fins. A loader backed up and bumped into him, knocking him down. He sustained injury to both legs.
A gas pump attendant had an altercation with a customer and the customer hit the employee with their vehicle.  The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was changing a forklift's tire. The employee removed the lug nuts and had grabbed the sides of the tire to remove it. As the employee was rocking the tire, the forklift fell off the jack and pinned the employee's arm between it's fender and the tire. The employees arm was fractured and required surgery and hospitalization.

Two temporary employees were installing a fence post. The post was driven down with a post driver; one employee's hand was on the post, and that employee suffered a severe laceration that resulted in the amputation of the right little finger.
When an employee reached for a falling ham both of the employee's forearms came in contact with the skinner machine and were lacerated.
An employee's right index finger got pinched in a file cabinet while moving it resulting in a partial amputation.

A truck driver backed up to a door at a front dock. He alighted from the truck and proceeded to the dock area. He then engaged the dock plate lever, but the transition plate did not flip up. The driver then went into his truck, secured a strap, attached it to the lip of the dock plate and pulled back. He lost balance, slipped and fell back, using his right hand to break his fall. He sustained a fractured right wrist.

An employee was cleaning out debris from a wood pellet mill. The employee's hand was pulled between the mill's die and roller; the employee suffered compression injuries to the left hand, with partial amputations to the left index and middle fingers.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to install plumbing test plugs on a second level. Once the employee had ascended to the top of the ladder, it collapsed and the employee fell to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with spinal injuries and broken bones in his feet.
While performing solar panel installation on a residential home, an employee fell from an extension ladder and sustained a broken foot.
An employee fell off the edge of a deck, landing on the ground below and suffering left knee and chin lacerations, as well as a broken right wrist.
An employee was working in the office when they stepped back, tripped over a bag that was on the floor, and fell. The employee sustained a dislocated hip requiring hospitalization.

A road project was utilizing two excavator mounted drilling attachments, which have telescoping Kelly bars to make the drill bit go down into the ground. Two mechanics came out to inspect the Kelly bars. The injured mechanic was facing the excavator operator and signaled the operator to raise the boom, but the Kelly bar raised/collapsed instead. The injured mechanic s right hand slipped into the inner and outer Kelly bars of the drill and the first, middle, and ring fingers were injured. The top of one of the fingers was surgically amputated.
An employee was connecting a 90 psi, half-inch air hose to a bottle. The hose released from the tank and struck the employee in the neck, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee and the owner were changing a tire on a yarder. The tire next to it exploded, breaking both of their ribs. The employee and the owner were hospitalized.

On July 22, 2020, at approximately 12:15 PM, the injured employee had been removing a jammed bag from a packaging machine. A supervisor found the injured employee on the floor, unresponsive. The employee had been injured by the bag carriage device on the packer machine. He was hospitalized with head trauma, lacerations on the left eyebrow and back of the head, two broken ribs on the right side, and multiple fractures to the right side of the jaw requiring surgery.

Within 15 minutes of being on the job, an employee became ill. He continued to work throughout the day, taking frequent rest breaks. The employee was having cramps on his left side throughout the day. After finishing the day, the employee went home and was later hospitalized with dehydration, suspected heat exhaustion, and acute kidney failure.
While working on a rooftop unit, an employee's lanyard failed, resulting in the employee falling from the roof of a store and landing on the ground. He sustained broken vertebrae.
An employee who had been delivering mail was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was removing a fabricated roll cage from a tractor using a 4 1/2-inch grinder with a metal cutoff wheel. The employee started cutting the weld. When the employee got to the end of the cut, the wheel hit the center between the tubing and kicked back, jerking the grinder from the employee's hands. The grinder lacerated the employee's hand.

An employee was removing plastic debris from a saw when the blade contacted their left hand. At the time of the incident, the saw had been powered down, but the blade was still spinning. The employee's left ring, middle, and pinky fingers were crushed. The middle finger was amputated at the hospital.

On July 23, 2020, a mechanic was conducting maintenance on piping in a boiler room. The employee s leg started cramping in mid-morning. In the afternoon, after returning to work, the employee started cramping in the hands and foot. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee was detailing a yacht at a marina. The employee fell from the yacht to the marina's deck 5 feet below, breaking both his feet.

An employee was preparing a house for gutter installation. The employee got off a ladder and stepped onto the porch roof to remove shingle strips. He then fell 9 to 10 feet off the roof, landing on the lawn and breaking his right femur.
An employee was patching holes on a large refractory product. The product slipped off the working surface and fell on his leg, breaking it.
An employee sustained heat stress and dehydration while working on the rig.

An employee was climbing a ladder to install internet. The ladder was set against a light pole which severed at the base and collapsed. The employee fell to the ground, sustaining a dislocated shoulder and a broken humerus. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was watching a lint cleaner machine. He was cleaning cotton from the machine when it cut the top of his hand.

An employee was on a work platform about 6 inches above the floor. The employee stepped back, lost footing, and fell backwards from the platform to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the left wrist.
An employee was closing a sanitation closet. The door cut the tip of the employee's middle finger.

An employee was performing framing work on the first floor of a building and fell into an open stair hole, landing on the basement floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken collarbone and a skull fracture.

An employee was assisting with moving crane mats. When the excavator moved onto a crane mat, the mat shifted and the employee fell from the mat to the ground. He landed on his side on the flange of a steel beam that was laying on the ground. The employee sustained a laceration on his eyebrow and broken ribs.

An employee was repairing pallets using a hammer, a pallet disassembly pry bar, and a pneumatic coil nailer. While he was placing a new board on a broken pallet, the coil nailer nailed his left middle finger to the board. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
While installing steel pan decking, an employee fell 10 to 12 feet off a bridge onto a paved parking lot. The employee suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was operating a forming press machine and amputated the tip of his right index finger.

An employee operating a rebar bending machine had his finger pinched between a piece of rebar and a fixed point on the rebar bending machine. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was filling a cylinder with a mixture of CO2 and argon gas. The cylinder ruptured and the bottom of the cylinder fractured the employee's left leg.

An employee was bending a part in a hydraulic press brake. The employee's right middle finger was pinched between the part and the machine (not at the point of operation), causing a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor resulting in a broken jaw and a concussion.
An employee was using a mixer during a production run when his right middle finger contacted a rotating screw. The employee sustained a fracture and partial amputation of the right middle finger.
A temporary employee received chemical burns during mixing operations.

An employee was using a forklift to unload a trailer attached to the cab of a truck. The truck pulled away from the dock and the forklift fell toward the ground. The employee was injured in escaping from the forklift, and was hospitalized.

An employee was being trained to operate a dual pallet jack when the forward control actuated and the pallet jack crushed his right ankle against wall curbing. The employee sustained a fracture and lacerations to the right ankle.
An employee had been surveying when they started feeling dehydrated. The employee left the job site, became ill, and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was cleaning a racking system when a rack fell towards him and hit his leg. The employee sustained a broken right femur.
On July 24, 2020, employees were taking a patient upstairs using a stair chair. One of the employees suffered a back muscle pull and a bulging disk. She was hospitalized.
After picking up trash around the work zone an employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was installing wiring at a home. As he was coming down an 8-foot ladder, he fell. He landed on the ground and broke his right ankle.
An employee was closing a gang box door. The door closed on the tip of the employee's right ring finger, amputating the tip (with no bone loss).

On July 24, 2020, an employee was walking from the maintenance shop to the cardboard container recycling mill. When he arrived at the cardboard container recycling mill he slipped and fell on the concrete floor fracturing his left femur.

On July 24, 2020, a maintenance technician was demolishing a 10-foot-high structure inside a manufacturing facility. He had removed the structure's plywood roof and was about to climb down a ladder when the fascia board collapsed and knocked him down. He fell about 10 feet, striking a table and the floor. He suffered a broken jaw and bruising to his face, shoulders, and thighs.

An employee was using steel tongs to attach a 15-foot metal rod to the existing drill rod string. The drill rod began rotating and the employee was stuck by the pipe tongs causing a left forearm fracture.

An employee was removing personal equipment from the cab of a temporary tractor. He fell while stepping down from the tractor, landing on the ground and suffering two broken ribs and bleeding in a lung.

An employee had been doing custom wiring installation. The employee had felt ill for three days. After finishing work on the third day, the employee was hospitalized for dehydration and kidney failure possibly due to heat exposure.
While an employee was loading a board onto a chain, a saw blade lacerated his index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee fell and hit his head while walking to his vehicle. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking across a drain grate, an employee's foot went through the drain grate into hot waste water and was burned.
An employee was climbing to fix a transformer that was placed on a trailer when he slipped. His foot got wedged and his left leg was fractured above the knee and required surgery.
An employee tripped on a floor mat and fell fracturing her hip.
An employee was using a hand-held leaf blower to remove debris from a flat roof. The employee fell approximately 15 feet from the roof and sustained fractures to the wrist and leg.
An employee was walking past a machine-operated press when it ejected material, which struck the employee and broke the employee's pelvis.

An employee was on a portable ladder changing out a compressor for an air handler. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground about 5 feet below, suffering a spinal fracture in the lower back.
On July 24, 2020, an employee sustained lacerations to the fingers on their left hand.
An employee was working outside installing pipeline and doing directional drilling. The employee became dehydrated and was hospitalized.

An employee was servicing a piece of rental equipment. While the employee was looking for a hydraulic leak, the employee's finger contacted the high-pressure leak and was lacerated by the hydraulic fluid. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was placing rubber mats on the ground to protect the concrete from the metal tracks on the curb machine. His right leg was caught and run over by the curb machine. The employee sustained an abrasion to the foot, dislocated toes, and swelling. He also required leg surgery.
An employee was handling a wire mail basket. Her finger was caught in the container while she was placing it on the counter resulting in an amputation to the left middle fingertip.

An employee was working on a boom lift when the equipment started to slowly come down and the basket tilted sideways. As the employee tried to push the basket away from the wall his left hand got caught between the top rail of the basket and the wall resulting in fractures to the thumb, index, and middle fingers.
An employee was installing solar panels when they slipped and fell from the roof to the ground. The employee sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was delivering mail. When she stepped off the delivery vehicle she misstepped and fell, resulting in a fractured right femur.

An employee was performing maintenance on an 8,600-ton shear press. The employee was standing on a metal plate approximately 3.5 feet long by 1.5 feet wide. The metal plate had a weld fail which caused the plate to break and fall into a pit. The employee fell partially into the pit and sustained a fracture to the right femur.
An employee was watching another employee use an AR-15 during a team-building exercise. A metal object (possibly a piece from the target) struck the employee, causing an arterial laceration.
An employee was assembling cabinet frames. While using a table saw, the third and fourth fingers on his left hand were partially amputated.

An employee was loading a coil on a press using a forklift with a boom, hook, and chain. The employee was struck on the right side by a forklift and fell to the ground. His right foot was pinned under the forklift resulting in amputation of the right leg just below the knee.
The injured employee had just completed a postal route and upon returning to the post office began displaying symptoms of heat-related illness. The employee was hospitalized.

On July 25, 2020, a roofer was installing a 5:12-pitched roof on a new three-story apartment when he slipped and fell about 32 feet to the ground and landed on his back. He was hospitalized with spinal injuries and a punctured lung.

An employee was mopping the floor. While carrying the mop, bucket, and a bottle down the stairs, she slipped on the fifth or sixth steps from the bottom. She fell backwards and hit the back of her head. She was hospitalized for a possible head injury.
An employee was placing items into a jewelry safe. When the employee closed the safe door, her left thumb was crushed and partially amputated.
An employee was putting cash in a safe. The safe door crushed the employee's fingers.

An employee was performing cleaning procedures prior to roofing installation on a three-story building. The employee removed a piece of plywood and then fell through a hatch, about 15 to 16 feet to the ground. He sustained a head laceration and left tibia fracture.

An employee was filling a store order. While lifting a 40-pound bag of onions from a pallet, he tripped over shrink wrap that was attached to the pallet. The employee fell to the floor sustaining a swollen disk and lower back pain requiring hospitalization.

An employee was troubleshooting limit switches using an electrical meter. One of the switches tripped and activated a magnet to retract, which caught his finger between the magnet and a switch bracket. His left pinky finger was partially amputated, below the first knuckle.

On July 26, 2020, an employee received a call from a tenant that the elevator was not working at their rental house. The employee drove to the three-story rental house to fix the issue. While trying to reset the elevator, the employee lost her balance and fell about 30 feet through the sheet rock to the first floor of the elevator shaft. The employee was hospitalized with a back injury.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut plywood for a scaffold. A board kicked back and the saw contacted the employee's hand, amputating the pinky finger.
An employee was conducting a safety inspection of a semi-truck when he missed a step and fell off the truck, hitting his head on the floor.
While surveying the plant, an employee tripped on a berm and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration.
An employee was placing dough in a tortilla machine line. The chain and sprocket conveyor inside the tortilla machine caught her left hand, causing an amputation to the left index finger.
On July 26, 2020, an employee was checking can codes on a canning line. While retrieving a can, the employee's left middle finger was caught between the conveyor and a transfer plate and amputated.

A postal employee was delivering mail in a post office letter carrier vehicle. The vehicle was equipped with a comfort fan but no air conditioning. At approximately 5:55 p.m. on July 27, 2020, the employee was found unresponsive inside his vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a high temperature and a possible seizure. Heat stress/exhaustion is suspected.

An employee was ascending a portable extension ladder to access a piece of equipment. The employee lost their footing and fell approximately 8 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained fractures to the collar bone and ribs.

An employee was repairing two dust collector systems under a shed in the back of the shop. The dust collector began to tip over and contacted the employee, causing a contusion and cuts to his face, as well as a possible broken bone in his face.
An employee fell 6 to 7 feet from an A-frame ladder to the ground and sustained possible rib fractures.
An employee fell between a loading dock and a trailer, suffering a broken leg.

A Vivid Mechanical employee was removing couplings from a chilled water pipe (connected to a chiller). The pipe struck the employee in the face and knocked the employee over. The employee suffered a fracture and lacerations to the face and lacerations to the torso.

Two employees were troubleshooting a lift table that was not functioning. When air flow to the table was turned on, the table tilted down quickly and an empty mold plan slammed into the guide rail. An employee's right index finger was smashed between the guide rail and the mold; the fingertip was amputated during treatment.
An employee was walking across the yard to assist a forklift operator by spotting for him. He missstepped and fell sideways to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left hip.
On July 27, 2020, an employee was operating an end rider pallet jack and struck an elevated platform. The employee sustained a laceration to the left calf.
An employee was performing repairs on a 15-foot high roof when he fell off, hitting his head on a traffic arm box while falling to the ground. He sustained a head injury.
An employee was lifting a patient when she suffered an abdominal injury that caused stomach pain and vomiting.

An employee was walking on a concrete block wall near a trash compactor. The employee fell from the wall to the ground, suffering a broken rib, broken left wrist, and bleeding around the kidneys. The employee was hospitalized.

After chocking the wheels of a rail car an employee stood up and felt dizzy. The employee then fell onto a concrete curb along the rail track. He sustained lacerations to the head and hand, a bruised sternum, and fractured ribs.

An employee was working to clear a soda ash blockage that jammed the rotary feeder blades of a silo. Once the employee cleared the blockage, the rotary feeder blades rotated and amputated the second and third fingertips on the employee's left hand.

An employee was lifting a hydraulic cylinder onto a bench vise for repairs. The vice rotated and the employee's left thumb was caught in a fitting hole. Then the cylinder rotated and caught the employee's thumb against the vise amputating the fingertip.

An employee was dropping a trailer and opening the doors. Upon opening the last door to the trailer, the employee passed out and fell from the back of the trailer to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and syncope.

An employee moved a small step stool under a stationary fan so he could reach the fan. The employee was repositioning the fan when his left hand slipped past the guard and contacted the metal fan blades. The first and third fingertips on his left hand were lacerated and the second fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking down a flight of stairs. His left leg buckled and he fell, suffering a broken left femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee's right index finger was amputated in a screw conveyor.

During paving operations, an employee was releasing a hose at the hot plant to clear out the line, when hot oil sprayed out onto the employee. The employee sustained burns to the arms requiring hospitalization.
While walking toward the time clock, an employee tripped over a parts pan that was on the floor, injuring his knee.
An employee was placing a 55-gallon drum on a pallet. The employee's finger was smashed between two of the drums, causing an amputation.
An employee was cutting pork loins with a bandsaw. The sawblade amputated the employee's left little finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was on the ledge of a piece of fryer equipment, changing the vent filters above the hood. Her right foot slipped into the hot oil, and she suffered third-degree burns to the calf, ankle, and foot.
An employee fell while walking up stairs, suffering broken bones.
An employee fell from a roof, injuring his ankle and elbow.

An employee was investigating a noise in an HVAC duct-system. He located a suspect auxiliary blower unit, deenergized it, and then went to retrieve tools. He returned to the blower after approximately 10 minutes. The fan/belt/pulley were slowly rotating even though power had been isolated. The employee removed a cover so he could press a tool against the belt to bring the blower to a stop. While reaching for the tool, his hand slipped into the pulley/belt resulting in an amputation to the right index finger from the base of the nail to the end of the finger. Also, the top third of the right middle finger was degloved.
An employee was operating a bench disk sander. The sander amputated the tip of the employee's ring finger.

An employee was carrying a 36-inch by 60-inch sheet of paper and stepped on the paper which caused him to trip and fall. The employee braced his fall with his elbow and sustained a fracture to the left humerus.
While servicing an auger head an employee sustained an amputation.
An employee was filling up a small engine with gas. A fire started and burned the employee's legs and hand.

An employee was overseeing the process of emptying a condensation pit into a relief pit. While observing a pump, hot steam from a condensation tank leaked out onto the employee resulting in first and second degree burns to their back, the backside of both arms, and the backside of both legs.

Two employees were fixing a commercial washing machine. As the drum was being manually spun to bring a broken airline into view, the injured employee's left middle finger became caught in the pulley system resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

On July 28, 2020, a technician was investigating a lack of cooling in the HVAC system of a building. He determined there was a refrigerant leak. While showing his supervisor what had been found, the technician opened a 3-phase, 208-volt junction box and sustained electric shock and burns to his hands, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was using a forklift to move a triple-stacked pallet of drums containing chemicals. An expandable concrete joint hit the pallet, causing the material to shift. One drum was punctured and sprayed chemical onto the employee's entire body.

An employee was making a delivery on his regular route. After retrieving a package from the package car, the employee was closing the bulkhead door of the delivery truck when his right pinky finger got caught in the door. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading porcelain panels (5' x 10') from an A-frame storage unit. When he cut the tension straps, the panels collapsed on him resulting in fractures to both legs.
An employee was walking a 100-pound-plus dog. The dog lunged forward and the employee fell, suffering a broken right femur and a broken right wrist.
On July 28, 2020, an employee was moving a piece of steel on his workbench. The steel shifted and struck him in the face, lacerating his cheek.

On July 28, 2020, an employee was doing housekeeping at the end of his shift. As he walked across the work area after emptying a trash can, he slipped in oil and fell, suffering a left ankle injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking down the stairs near the loading dock when they fell and broke a bone in their left foot.

An employee had left the store to get supplies for the shop from a business next door. On his way back to the bay area of the store in a heavy rain, the employee lost his footing on the wet and slippery ground and fell. The right side of the employee's head hit the ground and he was unconscious for about a minute. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a hydraulic access panel while doing maintenance on an excavator. The panel swung back and crushed the employee's hand against the excavator's track. The employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee was on top of a fuel truck filling it up when the fueling arm swung around and knocked him to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the ribs and pelvis.
An employee was driving a forklift, loading and unloading tires from a trailer. The forklift slipped on water on the floor, and the employee's left leg was crushed.
While unloading steel an employee sustained a crushing injury to their foot.

An employee was cooking a batch of lubricating grease. Flames and grease slurry came out of the grease cooking kettle and splashed onto the employee; this also started a fire outside the kettle. The grease/oil slurry was approximately 185-200 degrees and caused second degree burns to the employee's face, neck, arms and hands.
Two employees were moving the hood of a car. One of the employees sustained a back strain and fell to the ground.

Two employees were removing interior metal liner wall panels two at a time, leaning them against the wall, and then lowering them to the ground to be stacked. Each panel is 3' wide x 18' 6" long, and weighs approximately 30 to 35 pounds. Two panels were leaning against the wall. The employees  lowered the first panel to the floor and were about to stack it, when the second panel fell and hit the injured employee s hard hat and cut his nose and cheek. The injured employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using a polishing cloth to clean aluminum tubes after they were cut by the automatic circular saw. As the employee was moving aluminum tubing down the finishing table air that was blowing from a fan flipped a corner of the polishing cloth that was in his hand under the saw guard. The saw then pulled in the cloth and the employee's right index finger was amputated.

An employee was placing personal protective equipment into a storage cabinet. She slipped and fell backwards, hitting her head on a cabinet as she fell. She suffered a laceration to the back of the head.

An employee was working on a flaker assembly line. As he was moving a unit, it fell from his hands and its stainless steel edges lacerated his chin and his arm. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A crew was working on a single-phase re-conductor project. The digger truck, which was pulling the four-drum puller trailer, had been driven into position to start pulling ropes on a section of line. The puller was at a 90-degree angle to the digger truck to align the drums with the existing poles. The puller then needed to be repositioned. An employee used two safety chains to connect the puller to the winch line from the digger. He then winched up so he could disconnect the puller from the back of the digger truck. At this point the puller disconnected from the hitch and rolled forward on sloped ground, pinning the employee between the digger truck and the puller. He sustained injury to the pelvis and back.

An employee was moving a sick steer. The steer hit the employee with its head, knocking the employee into a steel fence. The employee suffered bruises, fractures to the left shoulder blade and ribs on both sides, and upper torso swelling.
A temporary employee was operating a leak tester machine when the clamping cylinder caught her left middle finger in the point of operation. The fingertip was amputated.
On July 28, 2020, while helping the driver of a truck to back in an employee was pinned between the reversing truck and a stationary trailer. He sustained an abdominal hematoma.

An employee was unloading a heater and a tool belt from the company truck. The employee felt ill, so he started walking back to his vehicle but passed out in the elevator of the parking garage, hitting a handrail as he fell. He was hospitalized with a laceration on the head, a bruised rib, and heat exhaustion.
An employee was using a knife to prepare food in the kitchen when the knife slipped and partially amputated his thumb tip.
An employee was lifting a heavy box to throw it into a dumpster. His hand was crushed between the box and dumpster, causing a severe laceration.
An employee was climbing down a ladder on a flatbed truck and jumped from the second rung. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was cutting wood on a table saw. The employee reached for a piece of wood to cut; the sawblade caught the wood and the employee's hand was pulled into the blade. The employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers were amputated, along with the tip of the thumb.

An employee was lubricating the lift cylinder of a powered industrial truck. When grease lubricant was injected, it came out of a crack in the truck's grease hose and perforated the skin of the employee's right palm. The employee was hospitalized.
Employees were putting an electrical panel back together after repairing it. An arc flash occurred that burned an employee's left arm, hands, and eyes.
An employee was climbing a scaffold ladder on a metal wall. When the ladder slid off, the employee fell and was impacted by the ladder, sustaining a broken left arm requiring surgery.
An employee was delivering mail. While stepping out of their vehicle, the employee's ankle twisted and fractured.

On July 29, 2020, an employee was working on a pump on a water ride. As he was descending a ladder down a rock formation to go into a concrete channel to work on the pump, he tripped and fell approximately 16 feet into the channel, which had been drained of water. The employee's injuries included fractures and dislocations.
While cleaning a deli slicer an employee sustained a possible fingertip amputation.

A fuel truck had just been freed after being stuck in sand. The driver left the truck and unhooked it. While he was between the two trucks, the fuel truck rolled forward, pinning him between the two trucks. He suffered a broken pelvis and a possible vertebral injury.
An employee had been working outside and carrying a silt fence and experienced symptoms of heat stress. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing cheese curd from a plugged line when the rotating star valve amputated approximately 3/4-inch of his right index fingertip.
An employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken left hip.
While connecting a purlin an employee fell from the boom lift.
An employee working from a step ladder fell backwards and fractured a hip.
An employee fell while walking security rounds, suffering a knee injury and left-side numbness.
After working on a computer server, an employee was replacing a steel beam guard. The beam dropped on his right ring finger causing a partial amputation to the fingertip without bone loss.
An employee was climbing from a ladder onto a residential roof to inspect it when he slipped off the roof and fell to the ground below. The employee's spine was broken.

An employee's foot caught a photo eye on a conveyor. He fell, his face striking an electrical box mounted on a hydraulic unit. He suffered a broken bone in the face, a lost tooth, and a facial laceration.

Two employees were pushing a multi-tiered material handling cart that weighed approximately 363 pounds. The cart rolled over the foot and ankle of one of the employees. The injured employee sustained lacerations to the ankle and chipped bone.
An employee was cleaning before closing the department for the night. The employee fell on the floor and sustained a fractured right elbow.

An employee drank from an unlabeled water bottle sitting next to another employee's water bottle. The bottle the employee drank from contained solvent. The employee began vomiting, then felt better, but began coughing up blood the next morning and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while entering a truck trailer, striking the parking lot surface and a curb and suffering a head injury and a broken leg.
An employee was pulling product through a machine. The employee's hand was crushed when the puller cycled. The machine was not guarded or locked out/tagged out at the time.

An employee was walking into the building through the vestibule entrance. A driver reversed out of a space in the parking lot and struck the employee, sending her through the frame/glass between the entrance and exit doors. The employee sustained broken ribs, a broken elbow, a broken thigh bone, multiple lacerations, and internal bleeding.
An employee was working as an apprentice operator on a shop bottle forming machine and was hospitalized due to heat stress/dehydration.

An employee was pushing the head unit on an automated cable-wrapping machine along its roller bar tracks. The employee's right hand was caught between the head unit and a support mount on the roller bar tracks, causing a partial amputation to the little finger.
An employee's fingers were caught in a meat grinder; three fingers were amputated.
An employee was running a controls and equipment test on a chiller. One of the pumps started up, causing a spark. The employee was burned.

A maintenance employee was removing a level control valve when he was sprayed with Hexamethylenediamine (HMD). The contents of the pipe were under pressure and the liquid was hot, but less than 100 degrees Celsius. The employee sustained chemical burns and possibly thermal burns to his face and back.
An employee was placing a case of vegetables onto the bottom shelf of a cart. As she stood up, her head hit the cart's top shelf, resulting in a scalp contusion.
While lifting a 55-pound mold in a molding oven room, an employee briefly lost consciousness.
An employee was watching the flow of product in a meal load sampler. The automatic sampler in the machine struck the employee's left arm, causing a break that required hospitalization and surgery.
On July 30, 2020, an employee became overheated and was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

Employees were replacing a double circuit pole. When one phase of a 3-phase, 200V-power line was energized, it went straight to ground, causing an arc flash. An employee sustained second degree burns to the face and upper left arm.
An employee was found unconscious on the dock floor with possible heat stroke.
An employee was adjusting a dock plate in order to unload a truck. The employee's finger was pinched between the dock plate and the truck resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking out of a facility when he slipped on a piece of plastic and fell to the ground, breaking his left leg below the knee. He was hospitalized.
While taking her lunch break, an employee was exposed to another person's vaping, triggering a severe asthma attack that resulted in hospitalization.
An employee was running an excavator with a grapple magnet. The magnet swung back and hit the cab and power box, and the employee was shocked.
An employee was using a dolly to transport seven cases of product through a doorway. He fell; the cart also fell, striking his right hand and amputating the tips of his middle and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a hydraulic press brake when his right index fingertip was amputated by the machine.
At 4:30 p.m., after delivering mail from a van, an employee developed heat stress and was hospitalized.
The injured employee was watching another employee operate a machine when the saw table returned home and crushed his finger resulting in a severe laceration and partial amputation.

Two employees were using a gantry crane to flip a dock (approximately 45 feet long by 4 feet wide) from pontoons side up to pontoons side down. While the dock was at an approximately 45-degree angle, with the pontoons facing down, the injured employee began lowering the dock to the floor using the gantry crane s pendant. He then saw an issue and began to lift the dock back up, to roll the dock backwards and position it vertically. At this point, the rigging slipped out of the gantry crane s hook. When the injured employee began to lower the dock again, the dock fell on top of him, crushing his left ankle and fracturing his right femur.
An employee's right hand was burned in a pan containing hot fry oil.

An employee had been caulking while on an 8-foot ladder. The employee lost balance/footing while descending the ladder and jumped from the ladder. The employee impacted the floor and sustained a lower leg fracture requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating an excavator to excavate coal combustion residual (CCR) from below ground to create a sump. The sump was being excavated to a lower elevation to allow water to be collected at the bottom and pumped into a ditch. The surface material the excavator was placed on set down vertically approximately 6 to 8 feet. The employee then jumped off the excavator and landed on the ground resulting in a fractured left tibia.

An employee was transferring food into a cooler from a rack that was on a pallet jack. The employee was moving the pallet jack so the rack would be closer to the cooler. While getting off the pallet jack, the employee became caught between the pallet jack and the cooler. His right ankle was fractured.

An employee was walking between a transformer and wall-mounted, lead-jacketed secondary cable. His right shoulder brushed against the cable and his left elbow touched the transformer bracket, causing an arc flash. He suffered first- and second-degree burns to the left arm and the left chest area.
An employee was using a demo saw to cut pipe. The saw kicked back, striking him in the face and breaking his nose and cheekbone.
An employee was helping install a loader storage bin. While hoisting the bin up, it slipped off, causing a laceration to the employee's left thumb that required surgery.
An employee had been tack-welding boundary bars for insulation on the deck. The employee experienced severe cramps and was hospitalized for dehydration and an acute kidney injury.
An employee was fixing a conveyor belt. The middle roller on the adjacent belt caught his right hand and burned the hand, wrist, and back of the hand.
An employee was operating a skid steer. The skid steer shifted and the employee's fingers were caught in its hinged door. The employee suffered a finger avulsion.

An employee had been standing and giving a presentation. When finished, he went to sit down in a chair but the chair rolled out from under him. The employee fell to the floor, sustained a left hip injury, and was hospitalized.
An employee was descending a ladder that was against an electrical pole when the pole broke at the base. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee was pulling out a winch line when his fingers were pinched between the winch cable and the housing of the winch. The middle and index fingertips were surgically amputated.

On July 30, 2020, at approximately 10:30 AM, a temporary employee was operating a rotary molder and adding dough in the rollers. The employee came in contact with the knife on the rollers resulting in a partial amputation to the right thumb.
A pallet jack crashed into an angle iron, pinning an employee. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was collecting shopping carts in a parking lot. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was unloading a piece of equipment from the lift gate of a truck. The equipment fell on the employee, causing broken ribs, a lacerated liver, and a torn aorta.
An employee had a severe allergic reaction to some citrus fruit that another employee had brought to the lunchroom. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a hydrovac when a hose burst in it, cutting the employee's right bicep.
An employee was using a dynamic cone penetrometer (DCP) tester when his left ring fingertip got caught between the weight and the top of the tool. The fingertip was crushed.
An employee was taking a sample of molten metal when a piece of slag contacted the tongue of his boot. The employee was hospitalized with burns to his leg.
An employee's finger got caught in the door of the company truck. The left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a brake press. The press activated and severed four fingers on the employee's right hand.
After finishing a double shift, an employee became ill while waiting in a parking lot. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
During hurricane clean up, an employee fell through a trash chute on the third floor. The employee landed on the ground and sustained a fracture to the second lumbar vertebra.
An employee was changing a bit on a hammering gun when the gun actuated, causing an amputation to the employee's little finger.
An employee had chest pain after chasing a patient who was attempting to leave the unit.

An employee was operating a brake press to flatten a part. The employee reached down to straighten the part, when the pedal was pushed and the machine actuated, resulting in amputation of the right middle, ring, and little fingers at the distal joint.
An employee was operating a pallet rider when his foot slipped off the vehicle and it lacerated his foot near the ankle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a radial arm saw and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was on top of a condo, moving an 800-pound sandblasting machine on its two wheels. The pot tilted over and landed on his leg. He suffered a broken tibia and fibula and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a wire stripping machine. The machine caught his glove and pulled in his hand. He suffered lacerations to his index and middle fingers and his thumb (which was split down the middle), as well as a broken bone.
An employee was using a forklift to empty trash into a dumpster. He fell to the ground, suffering a head laceration, cracked ribs, and a punctured lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving material from a loading dock to the seventh-floor level via hoist. He became dizzy, began to sweat heavily, and could not stand. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration and an elevated heart rate possibly due to heat exposure.
An employee working on a milling machine placed a round bushing into the fixture-activated pneumatic hold-down. The clamp came down and partially amputated her left index finger.
An employee was frying chicken when hot grease spilled from the pan. The employee slipped and fell into the hot grease, burning both legs and both forearms.
On July 31, 2020, a groundsman was using a hammer to drive a steel pile into the groove of a driving machine when the hammer hit his left index finger causing a fracture. He was hospitalized.
On July 31, 2020, an employee's hand was crushed in a swing load rigged to a crane, after the load tightened during a lift. The employee suffered crushed fingertips, resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell 4 feet off a bakers scaffold and was hospitalized for fractured ribs.
On August 1, 2020, an employee was delivering mail when he developed heat exhaustion, suffering from muscle cramps and difficulty walking. He was hospitalized.
On August 1, 2020, an employee missed the last step while descending from an A-frame ladder and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right heel.

An employee had just placed some timbers on a pipe stack. As he was moving away, a 16-inch by 10-foot pipe that was being stacked rolled onto the timbers past the intended placement. This caused the timbers to catapult over the pipe. One of the two timbers struck the employee on the right side as it was coming down, knocking him to the ground. He suffered fractures to the right wrist, nose, face, and skull on the right side. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell while walking, suffering a fracture in their left arm.

An employee was assisting an ATV and a forklift in pulling wire. The ATV slid into a 3-foot trench where the employee was standing, trapping them between the ATV and the ground. The employee sustained a dislocated right shoulder and a damaged L1 vertebrae.
An employee was cleaning filters when he lost consciousness and fell to the ground, striking his head. He was hospitalized.
A census employee was leaving the home of a census respondent when the employee fell down the stairs, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee fell while walking down a flight of stairs, landing on the concrete floor below. The employee suffered a broken arm.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when the conveyor belt was turned on and crushed her left hand and wrist. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist that required surgery.

An employee was working as a go-kart track attendant. Several of the carts collided and stopped; the employee was resolving the situation when another cart drove into his right foot. He suffered two broken toes and a laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was spooling new wire into a road mesh machine when his hand got caught in part of the machine and the reverse button on the machine was pressed. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

An employee was under a disabled vehicle that had been raised on a flatbed truck. The vehicle rolled off the bed of the truck and its tire landed on the employee's right forearm, causing multiple fractures.
A security guard was escorting a patient to the restroom when the patient attacked him, causing facial bone fractures.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and struck the back of their head on the floor, resulting in hospitalization.

A Census Bureau employee was delivering census packets. He lost consciousness while approaching a home, fell, and struck his face on the ground. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and facial abrasions.
An employee was pulling out a pipe from a furnace when the mechanism that he was using malfunctioned and caused a part to break and hit the employee. The employee suffered a forehead laceration.
A pump coupling failed and caused objects to fly in the air and strike an employee. The employee received two lacerations to the inner left thigh.
A border patrol agent became dehydrated while tracking in the brush.
An employee was training sea lions when one of them bit the employee's upper right thigh. The employee was hospitalized.
On August 3, 2020, at approximately 9:27 a.m., an employee suffered a partial amputation of the left arm while cleaning a meat grinder.

On August 3, 2020, an employee was descending a metal staircase and fell three steps from the bottom. The employee fell against the step or hand rail and injured their abdomen. The employee suffered a lacerated spleen.
A one-ton pallet of material fell, striking and pinning an employee. The employee suffered fractures and cuts/abrasions.

An employee was drilling a support column when a metal shaving caught his glove and pulled his fingers around the drill bit. The drill bit amputated the tip of his left middle finger, damaged the tendon on his ring finger, and bruised his thumb, index finger, and pinky finger.
An employee was cutting the edge off a 2-by-4 using a handheld circular saw. The guard caught and the saw cut the employee's left thumb, breaking a metacarpal and causing arterial bleeding.

An employee was guiding in a 150-pound section of bar grading that was being hoisted by a crane. The grading pinned his arm against a steel I-beam, breaking the forearm. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was cutting lumber on a table saw. The sawblade amputated part of the employee's left index finger.
A forklift collision broke an employee's heel and ankle.

While closing the door to his terminal tractor with his right hand, a maintenance employee's left index finger slipped in-between the door and the door frame, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
A recycling driver had emptied a recycling bin and was taking it back to a residence. A vehicle struck the employee, resulting in a broken leg and arm.
An employee was taking out trash when he fell to the pavement, suffering a compound fracture to the left arm. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
A rock climbing guide fell while rappelling down a wall, landing on the ground about 20-30 feet below and breaking both wrists.
The injured employee was assisting an extruder line operator when the synthetic fibers wound tightly around his left thumb and amputated it.

A temporary employee was operating a horizontal band saw when his hand got caught in the vice that held the piece to be cut. The employee was hospitalized for a muscular injury and swelling in their hand.
An employee was walking out of her office when she fell to floor, fracturing her left kneecap.

An employee was transferring products from a pallet to a non-motorized conveyor belt. While walking around the pallet, she tripped on one of its corners and fell to the ground, breaking her lower left leg.
An employee attempted to unclog the rotary valve of a dryer when he suffered a partial amputation of his left index finger.
An employee slipped and fell in an office hallway, landing on the tile floor, and suffering a broken kneecap.

An employee was using a crow bar to attach a metal drag bar (10 feet long, weighing 400 pounds) to the bucket of a front end loader. The employee's hand was caught between the bottom of the drag bar and the ground, causing a partial amputation to the right index finger.
An employee set down his personal bag containing a gun and it accidentally discharged, striking another employee in the lower leg.
An employee was crushing boxes in a bailer. The door came down and crushed the employee's right index finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a center-rider pallet truck when his right foot came into contact with a piece of wood from a broken pallet. He suffered an avulsion to the middle of the foot and was hospitalized.
An employee working on an extension ladder fell off the ladder after the ladder slipped. The employee suffered a broken left wrist, broken tail bone, and damage to their back.
Trusses fell from a cart, breaking a temporary employee's pelvis.
An employee tripped over a shopping cart and fractured their back.

On August 1, 2020, a foundry employee was cleaning a sand muller prior to changing out the liners. The employee stepped on the wheel when in the muller, slipped, and fell causing the wheel to turn. His leg was caught in the 1 1/2-inch gap between the wheel and the wall of the muller. He was hospitalized, suffering from a muscle injury.

Employee 1 and Employee 2 were working on a pulverizer breaker when Employee 1 made contact with the energized parts. Employee 1 suffered burns to their upper body and face, while Employee 2 suffered additional burns.

An employee was loading chicken crates. One of the crates hung up, and while the employee was getting it loose he fell from a platform to the ground 6 feet below. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing housekeeping duties when they backed into a ball valve causing steam to release. The employee sustained second degree burns to their back.
A painter was picking up an airless spray gun and suffered an injection wound to the left index finger.
A driver was connecting a dolly to their truck when the tip of their left little finger was amputated.
An employee suffered two pulled chest muscles while moving heavy pieces of wood onto the forks of a forklift. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a portable extension ladder to get onto a scaffold platform. The ladder fell away, and he fell to the floor about 11 feet below and suffered broken vertebrae.
An employee was installing a cylinder on the applicator boom of an agricultural sprayer when the cylinder slipped and struck the employee in the head and shoulder, leading to a contusion.

An employee was loading a coil that weighed 1,368 lbs. into the feeder for the press using a forklift. The coil was turned the wrong way, so the employee lowered the coil onto the ground so that it was standing up. The employee attempted to turn the coil manually so he could pick it back up with the forklift and in the process of turning it fell on the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized for a compound fracture of the left leg.
An employee fell while changing a flat truck tire and their fingers got caught between the truck's fender and the tire. The employee suffered a partial amputation.

An employee was picking cases in a four-deep pallet location with two pallets left in it. As the employee was taking two cases off one of the pallets, their weight pulled the employee off the second level of the modular line. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a broken right wrist.

On August 4, 2020, a machine operator was bending thin aluminum tread plate parts on a press brake when the tip of his right index finger got caught between the part and the bottom die. The employee suffered the amputation of half of his fingernail to his fingertip.

An employee was pulling a plate clamp out from under a 1,600-pound stainless steel plate above a plasma table. The plate slipped out and pinched his finger against one of the slats on the plasma table. His fingertip was medically amputated at the first knuckle.
On August 4, 2020, an employee was installing a French drain when his muscles started to cramp. He was hospitalized due low electrolytes.
An employee was hospitalized for a heart attack, possibly related to heat stress.

A driver was climbing from the top of a trailer when his heel caught on the trailer, causing him to fall backward to the ground onto gravel. He sustained fractured ribs, a head contusion, and a sore back with bruises and scrapes.
An employee was opening a package of seafood with a box knife. The knife cut the employee's left thumb, resulting in the amputation of the tip.
An employee became dizzy and nauseated and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized, suffering from kidney failure due heat-related illness.

On August 4, 2020, at approximately 4:20 PM, an employee was walking outside between work stations in extreme heat. The employee had his duty gear on and was carrying a backpack with first responder gear when he collapsed. The employee had a heart attack and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a sidehook machine. The machine's arm came down and pressed the employee's hand into a recessed area for a mandrel. The hand was crushed and the employee underwent bone reduction surgery to the little finger.

An employee was attempting to move a conveyor when her left middle finger slipped into a channel behind a pneumatic slide on the side of the conveyor. The device activated and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was setting up a small tube-sheet. A 3-foot plastic block slipped from underneath the tube-sheet, causing the tube-sheet to fall on the employee's right little finger. The employee suffered a soft-tissue amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was walking to a customer's vehicle to deliver a curbside order. She tripped on a crack in the sidewalk and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was conducting maintenance on a natural gas glycol dehydration unit when the housing unit ruptured and hot glycol fluid made contact with the employee, leading to hospitalization for third degree burns on top of the head, neck, and back.
A temporary employee was operating an electric pallet jack when his foot was caught between the pallet jack and the wall resulting in injury to the left ankle.
A Johnson Controls employee was working on a rooftop HVAC unit. A gust of wind blew the unit's door closed on his right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
A vehicle struck an employee while she was walking across a parking lot, breaking her right shoulder and her tibia.
An employee was moving glass jars when a jar broke. A piece of broken glass cut the employee's right wrist, resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting the concrete surface in a parking garage. He fell through the resulting opening to the lower level, suffering minor bruises and contusions on the concrete floor.
An employee tripped and fell in the office parking lot while attempting to remove a case of sodas from her car. The case of sodas fell on her right leg and foot, fracturing both.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking towards the entrance to the worksite. She sustained a broken hip.
An employee was moving a sheet of plywood. The plywood fell onto a drive plate, which then struck the top of his foot and broke it.
An employee was working in a dishwashing area when she slipped and fell. Her right ankle was caught under a pole and was broken and dislocated. She was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down a hallway when he tripped and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was lifting a large roll. The roll released and dropped on his right little finger, resulting in an amputation.
Five employees were unloading sign structures using a crane. The crane tilted over and the structure fell onto an employee, smashing his right foot.
On August 4, 2020, a roofer fell about 12 feet from a ladder to the ground while preparing to climb onto a roof and suffered a broken femur.

While at a construction site, an employee fell from a scaffold's side bracket platform that was approximately 7'4" off the concrete flooring, sustaining fractures to their skull, arms, and wrist, as well as a laceration to the skull.
An employee was lifting a cable off the floor when he felt pain in his abdomen. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 4, 2020, an employee was installing a satellite dish at a customer's home. He fell off his ladder to the ground 20 feet below, suffering three broken vertebrae and a head injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while descending an aerial lift platform that was approximately 17 inches from the ground. The employee hit the ground, fracturing his hip and requiring hospitalization.

An employee fell approximately 18-20 feet from a second story door while removing and discarding old HVAC duct work. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right arm and foot, and also received staples to close a laceration on his head.
An employee fell while delivering mail on a city carrier route. The employee suffered a knee injury.
An employee was opening a hatch to check liquid sulfur draining into a pit. The liquid sulfur splashed onto the employee's hand and face, causing chemical burns.
An employee was servicing a crane. The employee's right index finger was stuck in a pinch point, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was taking pressure readings on a hull when his right foot fell into the hull opening where grating had been removed. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and torn tissue in his knee.
An employee was replacing forks on a forklift when the forks crushed his ring finger, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was stepping from a secured pipe on a trailer deck when he fell to the ground, leading to right-side distal tibia and fibular fractures.
An employee collapsed and fell, striking his head on the concrete floor.
As a hopper was being moved over a concrete form, it caught an employee's right middle and ring fingers against the form. The two fingertips were amputated.
An employee was walking down stairs when she slipped. Her ankle struck the edge of a concrete step, causing a burst Achilles tendon. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
Employees were cutting and torching metal scraps. A metal object fell onto an employee causing multiple fractures to the ribs and spine.
An employee was trimming shrubbery and fell approximately 4-5 feet from a ladder/wall before landing on concrete. He was hospitalized with a broken arm.

An employee was standing on a dock when a dock plate shifted. The employee's right foot was caught between the curb stop and the rear end of a forklift. The employee suffered a degloving to the right ankle.
On August 5, 2020, a service provider completing a delivery began to feel light headed and nauseous. He was hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee was cutting wood on a straight line rip saw when a piece of the scrap wood was ejected from the cutting area and impaled the employee's upper left leg.
An employee was struck by a boulder while working to extinguish a fire, causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet down a hill. The employee suffered a skull fracture and lacerations.
An employee came into contact with a battery backup wire while replacing a light fixture. He fell off his ladder to the floor, suffering a head injury.
On August 5, 2020, an employee slipped and fell while walking down a spiral staircase, suffering a ruptured right patella tendon. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a piece of I-beam to pound out a piece of scrap metal from a mandrel when his hand got caught between the I-beam and the scrap metal, leading to a cut and a smashed hand.
A landscaping employee suffered cramps and dehydration due to a heat-related illness.
An employee was providing care to a patient when the patient kicked the employee in the chest, knocking her to the floor and breaking a hip.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. During a turn in an aisle, her torso struck against racking and she suffered fractures. She was hospitalized.
An employee was turning on a standing forklift when his left leg struck a shelving unit. He suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was clearing debris from the pin hole while setting up an auger into a shaft. The shaft and auger then fell into place and pinched his right middle finger. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation, just above the nailbed.
