An employee was standing on the roof performing masonry wall repairs when he fell 10 feet from the edge to the ground and suffered a broken jaw and arm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell onto pavement while loading parts into a van for delivery.
A can punch was activated and caught the tips of two fingers on an employee's left hand, leading to the amputation of the smallest phalanges on each finger.

An employee was operating a manlift onto a levee dock ramp when the manlift began to slide down the levee for about 15 feet. The tires caught on the levee and the manlift flipped over sideways, causing the employee to land outside of the manlift basket. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
An employee was standing on an antistatic mat when they tripped and fell onto the concrete floor, leading to hospitalization for a dislocated hip.
An employee was replacing a water line in a 7-foot deep trench. The trench caved-in and the employee was caught in the dislodged soil. The employee sustained bruises.

An employee was operating an excavator. While extending the tracks, the excavator tipped over and landed on top of an employee's left foot. The impact ripped the leather of his steel toed boots just above the steel and resulted in broken toes.

An operator was attempting to retrieve a part from a furnace loader when his shoe got caught in a cable, causing him to fall onto his side from a height of about 1 foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An employee amputated the tips of two fingers using a circular saw.
An employee was standing on a 3-foot 6-inch platform. The platform collapsed and the employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken tibia. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
A go kart ride attendant was walking in the pit area. A kart struck the employee and caused a laceration to their foot.

An employee fell from the top step of a rubber-tired front-end loader. His back hit the fender, causing him to flip and land on the ground on his head. He suffered a head contusion and a broken left wrist.
An employee was using a router to complete the assembly of a picnic table for staff use when his finger got caught in the blade, resulting in amputation of a left-hand fingertip.
An employee was walking on conveyors when another employee removed a roller from the conveyor. The employee stepped where there was no roller and fell, cutting his arm on the centering device.

An employee was moving an air compressor trailer by hand when it impacted the back of a vehicle. The employee's left hand was pinched between the air compressor trailer and the vehicle's hitch, resulting in a fracture above his wrist.

An employee was grinding meat when the machine jammed. The employee cleared the machine and retracted her hand when the sleeve of her smock got caught and triggered the clicker, causing the blade to come down. The employee suffered an amputation of their left ring, middle, and index fingers.
Two employees were lowering a large roll using a hoist. One employee's hand was caught between the roll's steel core and a storage rack, causing a thumb injury with exposed tissue.

An employee was handling a pressurized water hose to clean a large culvert pipe when the hose slipped from his hands and began to flail around, striking the employee approximately four times. The employee was hospitalized with an abdominal injury.
An employee was checking the voltage on the power source to a chipper motor. The meter blew up, causing an arc flash that burned the employee's neck, face, and hands.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a running bottle conveyor when the rag she was holding got pulled into the conveyor, injuring her left hand and causing a partial amputation of the left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting ribeye steaks on a band saw when he suffered a laceration on his right index finger, leading to hospitalization.
An employee was wiping grease off a machine with a paper towel. The towel got caught in the machine, pulling his hand in and partially amputating his right ring finger.

On August 5, 2020, an employee was cutting metal pieces on an automatic saw. The machine stopped running; after he got it running again, his left middle finger was caught by its belt. The fingertip was amputated.

On August 5, 2020, a cemetery landscaper was mowing a slope when the mower got out of control and the employee let go. The mower slid down the hill, struck a headstone, and bounced toward the employee, landing on his leg and causing two factures in his tibia.

An employee was climbing out of a trench when the bucket of a trackhoe struck the employee's hand, crushing it between the edge of the bucket and the surface of a road. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was driving a utility vehicle when it tipped over, leading to hospitalization and fractures in his wrist and ankle.

An employee slipped while descending a ladder and fell, landing on the ladder and then on the floor about 5 feet below. The employee suffered a compound fracture of the left ankle, a left shoulder dislocation, and a broken nose.
An employee was clearing a clog in a dust collector. The rotary drive paddles caused a partial amputation of the employee's left index and middle fingers.
An employee was preparing a concrete pump to fill a concrete truck hopper when the employee was struck by the concrete truck, resulting in a crushed pelvis.
An employee fell off of a moving garbage truck, hitting the ground and sustaining a head injury.

An employee was placing brush into a disc chipper while trimming trees. The employee tripped and fell backward into the brush and was pulled into the disc chipper. The employee was hospitalized for severe lacerations and cuts to the left shoulder.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt when his left hand/glove was caught by the conveyor and his arm was pulled into the conveyor/sprocket. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the left forearm.
An employee fell while descending concrete stairs, resulting in a contusion and fractures to the back and center of his head.
An employee broke their teeth on the railing of a boom lift while attempting to navigate the lift onto a curb.
An employee lost consciousness while dismounting a forklift, fell, and struck his head on the concrete floor. He was hospitalized and required stitches to the forehead.
An employee was driving a forklift through a door. The mast on the forklift struck the door header. The employee was ejected from the forklift, struck the floor, and suffered a broken left elbow.
An employee was climbing a step ladder when the ladder was kicked out from underneath him, causing him to fall and hit the right side of his head on the ground below.

While inspecting completed railroad wheels, a railroad wheel fell on an employee's legs and knocked him over. The employee suffered a compound fracture in his left ankle, broken metatarsals in his right foot, and an injury to his right ankle.

An employee was trying to mount the rear riding step on a residential trash truck. The employee missed the step and the truck tire rolled over the employee's foot, causing a laceration and possible broken bones.
While conducting molding of plastic tubing, an employee's index finger got caught in a hydraulic cold press, resulting in a cut fingernail and a laceration to the fingertip.

An employee entered a hopper with an auger in the floor to tighten screws on the inside of the hopper. While in the hopper, the auger turned on and caught the employee's feet. The employee was hospitalized for right foot fractures.
An employee became faint and dizzy while painting in an apartment. He was hospitalized.

An employee was scanning his badge at the card reader to open a gate when he fell from his vehicle and was run over by a truck, leading to internal injuries to his spleen and kidney. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for his injuries.

An employee was mowing the grass when the mower slid into a drainage ditch and landed on top of them. The employee suffered amputated fingers on the right hand (3rd, 4th, 5th fingers) and a portion of the palm, leading to hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was closing a vehicle's tailgate. The employee's right little finger was caught in the latch mechanism and was partially amputated.

Two spotters and an operator were offloading excavators from a vessel using a crane when an excavator that was suspended in the air struck and pinned one of the spotters against the vessel. The spotter suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was pulling out pipe from over his head when his left bicep tore.
A mail carrier was bitten by two dogs, suffering a hand injury.

An employee was at a repair station, filling lumber on the bottom shelf of a lumber rack. Another employee placed a nail gun on the bottom shelf of a nearby table, and the gun fired a nail into the first employee's upper back on the left side.

An employee was using a forklift to move materials on pallets. He got off the forklift when its forks became stuck in the crates. As he was trying to move the forks, a tine fell onto his finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee set up a 24-foot extension ladder to 12 feet. When he climbed the ladder, it twisted and collapsed causing the employee to fall and fracture his ankle.
An employee fell while exiting a piece of cargo handling equipment, landing on the ground about 15 feet below. The employee suffered a broken knee, femur, tailbone, and pelvis.

An employee was using a drill to replace the screws on the dead front panel of a 600-volt disconnect box. A screw penetrated the insulation of an energized wire, causing an arc flash that burned the employee's arms and hands.

An employee was taping carpet on the metal roll of a roll forming machine when both of the employee's hands were pulled between the rolls. The employee was hospitalized for broken bones and multiple finger amputations on both hands.
An employee was cleaning a rip saw when his right pinky finger got caught on the blade, resulting in amputation.
Two employees were securing a tarp to a dump trailer. The tailgate smashed one employee's left little finger, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
While unloading boxes that contained hunting stands from a shipping container, an employee collapsed and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee had a heart attack while testing a transformer and removing the lines.

An employee was preparing to remove copper lines from an old compressor using an oxygen and acetylene welding torch. Flames came out as soon as the torch was turned on and the employee was burned on their face and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was painting parking lot lines and became dehydrated. The employee was later hospitalized with a heat-related illness.
An employee tripped and fell over an empty box that was next to a trash can. Her right elbow was shattered and required surgery.
An employee had been driving a skid steer loader on the job site. Both of his feet were fractured by the loader's bucket. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was operating a press. The press cycled and his left index finger was caught in the die. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee disengaged a shaft cylinder and in the process severely pinched her right index finger between the shaft and the shaft collar.

An employee was sitting on the seat of a forklift when he stuck his arm through the mast of his forklift to scan freight. The cord from his scan gun caught the lever to move the mast up and down, causing the mast to retract and come down on his right arm. As a result, he suffered a right arm amputation.

On August 7, 2020, at approximately 2:38 AM, two security guards were conducting an exterior patrol of a bus station. The guards directed a person to leave the property for failing to provide a valid ticket. The person then stood up and hit one of the guards on the left side of the face/neck with a metal pole. An altercation ensued; the assailant then pulled out a knife and began striking the injured guard in the left forearm and right hand. The injured guard sustained lacerations to the arm, hand, and neck.
An employee was walking and tripped on the floor's transition strip. The employee fell to the ground and hit their head/face, suffering a concussion.

An employee was performing maintenance on a lock/latch mechanism when their pinky finger got caught between the piston and the rail of the machine, resulting in amputation of the pinky finger from the knuckle up.

On August 7, 2020, an employee was pulling on a pie tin that was caught under a kick-off arm. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between the kick-off arm and the pie plate, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was stepping through a metal rack when the rack lacerated the employee's leg, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a 6-foot Baker scaffold when the walk board collapsed. He fell to the concrete floor about 4 feet below, suffering a broken ankle that required surgery.
An employee delivering mail on a route was attacked by a dog from the property.
An employee was parking a reach truck when the employee's foot was caught between the reach truck they were operating and a second reach truck. The employee suffered a left foot fracture.

An assembler was using a cordless drill with a 3/8" bit to drill through a fiberglass reinforced panel on a truck when the drill bit went through the steel wall of the truck cab and grabbed onto his glove. The right index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was in the bucket of a truck making repairs to an electrical power system. He was shocked while using a drill to make a "hot tap," receiving an electrical burn on his left index finger.
An employee fell seven to eight feet off a scaffold onto the ground and suffered a concussion and contusions and abrasions to his arms.
On August 7, 2020, a paramedic/EMT was bitten on the right hand by an insect in the course of several ambulance calls. She was hospitalized the next day for infection.

An employee was spraying down drip-pan equipment with foam chlorine when she fell off the third rung of a 6-foot A-frame ladder and landed on her left knee. The employee suffered fractures to her left leg, femur, tibia, and knee.
An employee was struck in the face with a golf club while walking behind a golfer, leading to hospitalization.
An employee fell while stepping off a bus, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working as a helper on a resaw line when a cant became skewed on the live roller deck, causing the cant to stop moving. The employee stepped onto the deck and corrected the alignment of the cant. He turned and was stepping down when he slipped, causing him to fall onto his right hip/leg. He fractured his right femur, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
While driving a forklift to be parked, an employee got caught between the forklift and an automated forklift, leading to two broken legs.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a beef shank when the shank became displaced after contacting the saw blade. The blade then amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee fell off a ladder while servicing an alarm system and hit the ground, resulting in an injured arm and femur.

A work crew was moving concrete barriers along a traffic lane using an excavator with a barrier lifter. The excavator's boom contacted a 19.9-kilovolt overhead power line, and an employee was shocked. The employee suffered burns to the right hand and right foot.
An employee fell off a moving golf cart to the ground, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.

An employee fell while descending steps outside a residence, suffering contusions to the forehead, right wrist, and both knees. The contusion to the forehead resulted in internal bleeding on the brain.

An employee was operating a yard hostler and moving a container to be loaded onto a ship. He became disoriented and drove the yard hostler into a parked forklift and then into a privately owned vehicle that was also parked. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee fell off a ladder and suffered a leg injury.
An employee was walking to re-rack a product when he fell and had a seizure that may have been heat-related.
An employee was preparing a choke sling for piping when the excavator rotated and struck the employee. The employee suffered rib fractures and internal bleeding.

An employee was adjusting a misaligned pallet on a conveyor system. The pallet return lift station rose up and pinched the employee's forearms against the frame of the machine. She suffered bruises and contusions on both forearms.

Four employees were transporting cleaning chemicals when there was a spill and/or chemical reaction when the chemicals mixed. One of the employees was hospitalized, suffering from difficulty breathing, shortness of breath, and lightheadedness.
An employee was boiling water to cook oatmeal. Boiling water spilled down the employee's front, causing burns to the abdominal area and the left foot and toes.
An employee was about 8 feet up an extension ladder when he fell, striking the handrail and then the landing of a stairwell. He suffered broken ribs on the right side, as well as internal bleeding.

An employee swung a sledge hammer to hit a hammer union. The sledge hammer missed and caused the employee to lose balance and fall approximately 3 feet, hitting his back on a mud pump module and suction pipe. The employee sustained fractures to the L2, L3, and L4 vertebrae.

An employee was in a kitchen, helping prepare dinner for group home residents. An aggressive patient entered the kitchen with a rock and struck the employee with the rock and his fists, then took the employee's frying pan and struck her in the head with it. She fell to the ground and the resident continued to strike her. She was hospitalized, suffering from bruising to the face and body and general soreness.
An employee was driving a forklift when he collided with another forklift at an intersection. His left foot was smashed between the two forklifts, resulting in an amputation injury to his left foot.
An employee was stepping down from a three-step top stock cart and missed the last step, falling to the floor. She was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee was grinding a concrete panel with a 4-inch grinder. The top of the panel broke and fell to the ground, landing on his left foot and breaking all five toes.
An employee was attempting to clean a running conveyor belt when his hand was pulled into the roller, resulting in a broken wrist.
An employee was assaulted by two customers while operating a ride and suffered a broken jaw.
An employee was opening a valve on an acid prep tank. The pipe fitting was loose and acid sprayed the employee, burning the employee's upper body.

An employee was using a machine to change a tire when his thumb got caught in the machine as it mechanically lowered to break the tire bead from the rim. The employee suffered an amputation of the tip of his left them.
An employee was cleaning a crimper machine when the machine amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was walking to his work station when he slipped on air conditioner condensate on the floor. He fell and fractured his right leg.
An employee was trying to pull a winch hook out on a tilt trailer. The winch was activated, partially amputating one of the employee's fingers.
An employee was trying to dislodge scrap from the exit end of a scrap chute. The scrap chopper in the chute amputated the tip of his left ring finger above the first knuckle.

On August 10, 2020, at approximately 1:30 a.m., an employee fell to the floor while loading a mail container. The employee's foot became caught in the strip of the container and the employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee began experiencing leg cramps while working in a trench. The cramps worsened and the employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress/dehydration.

An employee was operating a reach truck when the safety flags fell between the operator's compartment and mast. The employee attempted to grab the flags and hit the controller while doing so. The mast lowered, trapping his right arm in the machine. He was hospitalized with a degloved arm.

An employee was spray-painting the ceiling and upper walls of a dock area. He was working from a heavy-duty plastic utility storage bin/box placed on the forks of a forklift. The box shifted, tossing him to the concrete floor about 9 feet below. He suffered broken ribs.

An employee was running a labeler on a bottling line when there was a glue build up on the labeler. The employee began cleaning it with a rag, when the rag got pulled into the machine and the employee suffered a partial amputation of their right index finger.
An employee was loading his truck when he fainted and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was in a bucket truck in the raised position to perform power line repairs. While removing some foliage from the power lines, the employee was shocked by the power lines, and sustained burns to both hands.

An employee was opening a swing door on a tractor trailer. The wind pushed the door back, and it struck the employee's head and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a head injury requiring stitches as well as a broken right arm.

On August 10, 2020, a plumber was cutting copper pipe with an angle grinder while working from a ladder when the angle grinder wheel became stuck in the pipe. He tried to dislodge the grinder by pulling on it and fell from ladder, sustaining a cut on his right forearm and leading to hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was traveling through an airport to return home when he fell down some stairs and landed on concrete. He lost consciousness and was hospitalized due to a concussion and brain bleed.
An employee was punched in the head while stopped at a traffic light. The employee lost consciousness.
Two employees were performing maintenance on a hydrolyzer when steam released. Both employees were hospitalized with burns.

On August 10, 2020, an employee was removing tools from a press. He was using his right hand to operate the hoist chain while his left hand was on the eye bolt. When he pulled the hoist chain, it created tension on the eye bolt as it picked up the load. His left index finger was then crushed between the eye bolt and the spinner, resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee tripped over a computer cord and struck her head against a countertop. She suffered head lacerations.

Two employees were felling a de-limbed, live tree. They attached a rope to the tree to help control the direction of fall and ensure nothing fell toward the road. As the tree was falling, it went off course and the two employees went separate ways. One of the employees went into the path of the falling tree, which hit the left side of his back and hip area. He broke his left femur, lumbar spine, left hip, and left leg.
An employee hit his left hand while closing a trailer roll-up door, fracturing his ring finger and requiring stitches on his left middle finger.

At about 9:00 a.m. on August 10, 2020, an employee was using a table saw to rip a piece of hardwood flooring when the wood kicked back and the employee's left hand was pulled into the blade. The employee suffered partial amputations to three fingers on the left hand.

On August 10, 2020, an employee was changing out pins and dies on a pill press machine when the machine was actuated and a pin came down onto his finger. The employee was hospitalized with a partial amputation of his right pinky finger. The feed tray was not installed in the machine at the time of the incident.

An employee was backing up a stand-up forklift. The forklift's mast struck a 900-pound bundle of aluminum channel overhead, causing it to fall from a rack onto the employee's right hand. He suffered a laceration and a fracture to his right index finger.
An employee opened a T-handle valve on a tanker truck. The running pump caused the valve to slam shut on the employee's left ring finger, amputating the tip.
A temporary employee's glove was caught by a roller. The employee sustained injury to their right ring and pinky fingers resulting in amputation and hospitalization.
An employee was kneeling on a platform. He stood up, then fell off the platform to the ground 7 feet 10 inches below, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was cutting a piece of plywood on a table saw. His left hand came into contact with the sawblade, which partially amputated the first and second fingers.
A saw blade lacerated the top of an employee's right hand.
An employee was changing the film on a machine when the employee's left middle and index fingers were pinched between the heating plate and die box, resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was lining up a piece of product to cut using an upcut saw when the foot pedal was engaged while the employee's thumb was still on the product, leading to an amputation of the left thumb.
While installing sheetrock in a closet, an employee received a electric shock to the right shoulder and left hand from a 110-volt temporary light. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder when a gust of wind caused the ladder to break free of its tie. The employee fell with the ladder and suffered a broken finger and elbow.
An employee was cleaning up the job site and suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee was working on the driveline of a semi-truck when the driveline shaft fell onto their fingers. Two fingers were amputated.

An employee working as a scaffold helper was tasked with handing material to the scaffold workers. At the end of his shift, the employee felt ill and became unresponsive. The employee was hospitalized with swelling in his brain and elevated body temperature.
An employee lost her footing while pulling on a door knob, fell, and hit her head on the ground. She was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

Employees were utilizing boom trucks to transfer live power lines to a new pole. One of the employees reached out to another to grab a tool while simultaneously holding the power line and experienced an electric shock. The injured employee was hospitalized.
An employee was shocked on the finger/hand while plugging a machine into a wall outlet.

While performing an inspection on hydraulic lines, an employee lost footing on an uneven surface and fell to the ground, hitting their ribs on a solid metal object. The employee's ribs were fractured.
An employee was walking up steps when a handrail gave way, causing the employee to fall forward onto the steps. He suffered an injury to the left elbow and a broken left forearm and right wrist.
A census taker was attacked by a dog at a private residence. The census taker fell to the ground and suffered two broken thumbs.
An employee was walking with an armful of bottled product. The employee tripped over an ankle-high fan cord and fell to the concrete floor, suffering head injuries.

An employee had climbed a 6-foot A-frame ladder that was leaned up against a baler machine and was going to use pressurized air to clear debris off the electronic eye. The baler activated and the blade swept, amputating a portion of the employee s left index finger.

An employee was removing a defective piece of pipe from a bundle of 40 to 60 pipes about 20 feet long and was mounted on a metal cart. When the defective pipe came loose, it pushed back, pinching the employee's right ring finger against the cart. The employee sustained a laceration that resulted in surgical amputation of the fingertip.

On August 11, 2020, an employee was working in a textile mill operating a fabric line in the pre-shear department. The fabric was beginning to curl under prior to entering the shear. The employee attempted to uncurl the fabric and contacted the spinning shear blade resulting in amputation of their left index and middle fingers above the first joint. The shear blade was not guarded at the time.
An employee tripped over a cart while walking into the meat cooler and fell to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to the nose and jaw, and broken teeth.
An employee fell through a ceiling at a demolition site, suffering hand lacerations.
An employee was conducting interviews and handing out booklets to residents. As she was walking down a driveway, she stepped into a two-foot hole and suffered a broken left ankle.
A truck was pulled over while an employee had one foot in the truck and the other foot on a dock. The employee fell.
An employee was driving a counterbalance forklift. His left foot struck an object outside the forklift platform, and he suffered three broken toes.
An employee was repairing a primary jumper. The employee was shocked, suffering a burn on the hand as well as a fractured back vertebra.

An employee was installing floor sheathing on the second floor of a residential structure and fell through an opening in the floor to the basement level. The employee sustained multiple fractures and a collapsed lung.

An employee was delivering propane to a customer when the tank released propane gas into his face. As well as propane inhalation, he suffered minor facial burns and contusions where the tank cap struck his face.
An employee was riding a lawn mower while cutting the grass when the lawn mower slid down a bank and flipped into a lake, leading to hospitalization.
An employee was conducting log out operations on the plate ridge trail when the employee was struck by a falling log resulting in left arm bruising.
An employee was repairing the bed of a dump truck when the eyelet that was holding the gate broke. The gate released and crushed the employee's right arm.

An employee was assisting with moving cargo that was blocking the path at a customer's location. The customer was driving a forklift to move a pallet. While positioning cargo with a strap, the pallet shifted and the employee's fingers were caught between the strap and the pallet. Two fingertips were amputated.
An employee fell from a ladder while removing stock from a shelf. The employee suffered a broken left leg.

On August 12, 2020, a mechanic was lubricating the boom cable of a crawler crane and caught his right hand between the cable and the sheave resulting in the amputation of his right middle, index and pinky fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a paving machine. He was on the machine's conveyor belt when it actuated. He fell onto the conveyor belt and fractured the L1 vertebra.

An employee was changing the plunger on a press and adding bolts to the side of the plunger. When the employee lowered the lazy Susan, the plunger fell and one of the bolts punctured the employee's right hand, causing an open fracture. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was on an extension ladder, using a hammer drill to drill into a concrete block. The employee fell to the floor, breaking both feet and suffering a head laceration.

An employee was descending the ladder of an elevated cargo loader when he slipped and fell, landing on the ground about 10 feet below. He suffered head and back injuries including fractured vertebrae, an acute subdural hematoma, and an intraparenchymal hematoma of the brain.

While walking down a set of stairs that had four steps, an employee missed a step and slid down the stairs, catching his leg between the upper and lower hand rail. The employee's knee twisted, tearing a thigh muscle.
An employee developed heat stress symptoms after delivering packages. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee was using a ladder to access to the attic of a residential home. The employee fell off the ladder onto the ground and fractured his left femur.

An employee had been dismantling a scaffold when he experienced stomach cramps. He was monitored for approximately 45 minutes while in an air conditioned environment and his stomach cramps improved. After work, he was hospitalized with dehydration/heat stress.
An employee fell from a ladder and injured both feet and his back.
On August 12, 2020, an employee was walking at a construction site when his foot fell into a hole and he tripped. He landed on a piece of metal, suffering a broken femur.
An employee lifting a loaded trailer of sulfuric acid sustained chemical burns on his back after coming into contact with sulfuric acid that had leaked from the trailer.
An employee fell to the floor while trying to break up a fight between patients. The employee suffered a fracture to the lower back.
An employee was working in the fields chopping bushes and developed muscle cramps. The employee was hospitalized for a muscle injury and heat exhaustion.
An employee sustained a fractured hip while attending to a fallen tree.
An employee was investigating a jam when his left index fingertip was amputated inside a silo.
On August 12, 2020, a roofer was installing dry-in materials on the roof when he slipped and fell off of the roof onto the ground. He suffered cracked vertebrae and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 10-foot A-frame portable step ladder positioned in front of a forklift. The forklift mast moved forward and knocked the employee off the ladder. He fell to the floor about 7 to 8 feet below, suffering a broken ankle (which required surgery) and an elbow injury.
On August 12, 2020, an employee was walking out of an office, turned, tripped over a resident's feet, and fell. The employee was for a fractured right shoulder and knee that required surgery.
An employee was moving and stacking commercial truck tire rims. His finger got pinched between two rims causing an amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was delivering a bag of groceries to a customer and slipped and fell in the parking lot. The employee sustained a lower leg fracture.

On 8/12/2020, an employee was meeting with a juvenile around 2030 hours. The juvenile became aggressive and the employee attempted to restrain them. The juvenile assaulted the employee, resulting in the employee's head hitting a chair. The employee was knocked unconscious and the juvenile continued to assault him. The employee was hospitalized with a skull fracture.
An employee was loosening bolts with a wrench. The wrench slipped and cut the employee's fingertip.
An employee was attaching an extension chute to the back of a concrete mixer truck. The employee's left index finger was partially amputated in a pinch point between the chute and the truck.
A forklift operator's hand was crushed when a box of metal valves fell onto it.
An employee was handling a rare-earth magnet. The magnet was attracted to a metal plate, and the employee's fingertip was amputated between the two.
A power crew was picking up wood poles. A sling released and a pole fell, hit the ground, and bounced back. It struck an employee in the left leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking in a hallway when she slipped on some residual salad dressing. She fell to the floor, landing on her right knee and suffering a broken right kneecap that required surgery.

On August 12, 2020, an employee was troubleshooting tracking issues with the belt on a belt wrapper. The belt and a roller pulled in the employee's left hand and forearm; the employee suffered a wrist/forearm fracture.
An employee was burned by hot liquid polymer, released as he took a nozzle out of a drain. He suffered second- and third-degree burns.

At about 11:30 p.m. on August 12, 2020, an employee was working on a truck with his penlight in his mouth. The penlight was jammed backwards into his throat, puncturing the back of his throat. He was hospitalized later that night, suffering from internal bleeding in the throat.
An employee was lifting a 5-pound tray of pasta off a cart when she developed a hernia. She was hospitalized.
An employee was checking a butterfly valve after cleaning it. The valve pinched his finger, amputating the tip with no bone or nail loss.
An employee was unloading glass. The employee's hand was caught in a pinch point on a pallet jack, causing the amputation of a fingertip.
A temporary employee passed out while flagging traffic at a road construction project. He sustained a heat related illness.

A temporary employee was attempting to place an empty bin under a shredder. The bin was not in alignment so two co-workers pushed the bin forward while the injured employee guided it through. The injured employee's right thumb was pinched between the bin and the shredder frame. The employee was hospitalized for an open fracture of the right thumb.

An employee was placing a work piece on a female die section. The press was activated and the male die section came down on the employee's right middle and ring fingertips, crushing them. Each fingertip was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was testing equipment and suffered heat exhaustion.
An employee was on scaffolding installing trim on the edge of a roof. The employee fell off the scaffolding onto the ground and suffered a fractured skull and a fractured back.
An employee developed heat exhaustion while placing bricks and mesh so a concrete slab could be poured.

The injured employee was riding on the back of a hostler truck (yard mule). The injured employee fell off the truck and was struck by the back wheels. The employee was hospitalized for a broken ankle and a blood clot in the hip area.

At around 4:45 p.m. on August 13, 2020, an employee had just parked a rubber tire gantry and was climbing down from it. He slipped and fell from the fourth rung to the ground, suffering a broken leg and a possible broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was inspecting a conveyor belt to make sure it was clean. It caught his arm, breaking and lacerating it.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a molding tool when it kicked out, causing a partial amputation to the employee's finger.
An employee fell from a scooter and suffered a right tibial plateau fracture with damage to the knee joint. The employee also suffered abrasions on the left elbow and left ankle pain.

An employee was sorting pallets at a pallet sorting machine. The machine's cushion arm returned to the "up" position, and the employee's left middle finger was caught between the cushion arm and a roller. The finger was partially amputated.

A service technician was tasked with moving equipment. As he was moving a carrier basket from a pallet, the equipment fell and crushed his right index finger. The employee was taken to the hospital where the tip of his right index finger was amputated.

An employee was spotting a forklift as it moved a 11,642-pound steel shaft. The shaft moved, and when the forklift tines were raised it was knocked off its wooden end supports. It rolled over onto the employee's foot, crushing the top and middle parts of the foot. The foot was amputated just below the ankle.

On August 13, 2020, an employee was removing a filter screen from a washer machine. While the employee's right ring finger was between the screen and the filter housing, the edge of the filter screen struck it and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was picking up a dropped part near a drill press when the press caught and lacerated the employee's right ring finger.

On August 13, 2020, an employee was demonstrating an issue involving a loose chain on the socket of the label machine. The chain grabbed the employee's right gloved hand and pulled it into the socket resulting in a finger amputation.
An employee was testing the drive belt on an oilfield pump. The pump was started, and the belt partially amputated the employee's right thumb.

An employee was standing on stairs that were being held by welds and chain falls. The welds broke and the employee fell approximately 15 feet onto the concrete floor. The stairs fell on top of him. He was hospitalized with multiple fractures.
An employee was taking a piece of product off the skinner and stumbled forward. The employee's fourth finger on the right hand contacted the skinner's blade and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee working as a rigger began work at approximately 7:00 AM and was assisting another worker at ground level to rig pieces of precast concrete. He began feeling ill at the start of the day and was later hospitalized with dehydration.

At 1:30 p.m. on August 14, 2020, an employee was shoveling dirt along the edge of a concrete curb into the path of a road grader. The road grader's wheel struck the employee from behind, causing a crushed foot, ankle, and lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 13, 2020, the employee was repairing a leak on an aluminum tanker truck that previously hauled gasoline and diesel fuel. The employee was welding the cracked area when an explosion occurred within the confined space of the tanker. The force from the explosion caused the front head of the tank to blow out toward the victim. The victim was crushed in the rear of the tank and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for traumatic brain injuries, broken ribs and a broken collarbone.

An employee was grinding/welding inside a tanker truck tank. An explosion blew out the aluminum head and it struck the employee, knocking the employee unconscious and causing a broken collarbone, broken ribs, and brain swelling.

An employee was working atop a horizontal whaler (steel I-beam) within a coffer cell approximately 12 feet from ground level. The employee was tied off to a cable lifeline above. When the crane hoisted the rigging out of the cell, one of the rigging hooks caught the whaler and broke the welds. This caused the whaler and the employee to fall. The employee struck the top of a concrete pile during the fall and sustained a fracture to his right acetabular bone (hip).

An employee was operating an angle grinder, cleaning a metal surface on a cart. The wire wheel caught a large burr, kicked back, and caught the employee's shirt. It wrapped up in the loose material and lacerated the employee's left wrist/forearm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying an electric motor that weighed 35lbs. and had to use four sets of stairs to reach the area where the motor was to be installed. After coming down the third set of steps, he was on a flat surface when he tripped over an air wand hose that was on the ground. The motor he was carrying came down on his right ring finger, causing an amputation of the soft tissue of the right ring fingertip.

An employee was mounting a tire. The tire machine robot arm's head was pressing against the edge of the lip of the wheel; it then slipped off the wheel and down onto the tire, pinching the employee's right little finger against the tire rim. The finger was amputated.
While pushing a test weight onto the belt loader, an employee's finger got caught between the hand extension and the loader's pillar resulting in a right index fingertip amputation.
While loading a roller, an employee fell from a lowboy trailer to the ground and broke his wrist.
An employee was laying metal decking on a metal building about 15 feet high. The employee fell off the leading edge to the ground.
An employee was observing a power press when her hand was caught in a conveyor belt and was fractured.
An employee was doing an inventory check. He stepped onto an L-cart to check the second shelf, then fell to the concrete floor and struck his head. He suffered a brain bleed and lost consciousness.
While relocating his fall protection anchor, an employee slipped and fell off a residential roof onto the ground. The employee was hospitalized for back and neck fractures.

At about 8:00 a.m. on August 14, 2020, an employee was adjusting a binding machine when its feed hopper lowered and crushed the employee's left index finger. The fingertip was medically amputated. The machine's safety interlock was not operational at the time of the incident.
Two employees were carrying a 100-pound foam void. One of them fell backwards to the ground, hitting his head and losing consciousness.
An employee was moving a cart of recycled material. A manual jack struck the cart. The employee fell backwards to the ground, suffering a rib injury.
An employee was walking to a nurse's station when she slipped on a cotton bandage and fell. She suffered a thoracic spine injury.
While erecting stair tower scaffolding, an employee fell about 6 feet and landed on a concrete slab. The employee suffered a back injury.

On August 14, 2020, a temporary employee was throwing an empty cardboard box into a construction dumpster when nearby employees heard him call out. They found him on his knees with his hands on the dumpster. He experienced neck pain and numb legs, requiring hospitalization.
After working on an HVAC system on top of a warehouse office, an employee was descending a ladder when it started to slip. He then jumped down a couple of feet and dislocated his ankle.

An employee was installing a roof on top of a newly constructed water tank. The employee fell 16 feet through the roof to the steel surface below, suffering a head injury, a broken pelvis, and a broken vertebra.

On August 14, 2020, a temporary employee was hanging spline shaft parts on vertical racking on a line to be washed. The employee hung a part on the top row of the racking and was hanging a part on the bottom row when the part fell from the top row. It landed on the employee's left hand, breaking and wounding the little finger.
An employee was performing aircraft maintenance and fell approximately 8 feet from the work platform to the concrete floor resulting in a fractured elbow.

A mechanic was performing an alignment on a vehicle. A second mechanic was inside the vehicle checking on an air conditioning part. The vehicle was inadvertently placed in drive and the brake brace was knocked out of the way. The vehicle fell off the ramp and struck the first mechanic in the head. The mechanic was hospitalized for a fractured skull and ear laceration.
An employee was walking into her work area when she slipped on the wet floor and fell. She sustained a fractured femur and was hospitalized.
On August 15, 2020, an employee working at a cash register experienced a back spasm that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a bandsaw in a meat processing area. The blade caught her glove and amputated her left middle fingertip.
An employee was securing a tarp on a trailer and fell 12 feet from the trailer to the ground. The employee suffered a broken wrist and arm.

An employee was operating a standup forklift when his left foot was pinned between the back of the forklift and the baseplate of a safety bollard near the path of travel. He was hospitalized with left foot fractures and lacerations.
An employee was tying back airlines and cables near a moving belt. His gloves touched the belt, which drew his hand into the end pulley. He suffered a broken wrist.
An employee was approaching a cat (a veterinary patient) when it bit her left middle finger.

An employee was unjamming a press when the press was activated and the press crushed/severed the employee's right ring finger. The press was unguarded and was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
An employee fainted inside a trailer during a delivery due to dehydration and heat stress.

On August 15, 2020, an employee was unjamming the rotating diverter wheel on a production machine. The tension released, pushing the employee's hand into a compressed air jet. The air punctured her hand and she was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a ladder positioned on a scaffold and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with head and back injuries.
An employee was rolling a trim roll of paper when it hit the side of a packaging machine and tipped over. The roll landed on the employee's foot and amputated two toes.

An employee had attached crane rigging to a transformer coil and was adjusting an outrigger block. The crane activated and the employee's left thumb was caught between the crane block and the rigging. The thumb tip was amputated.

A mechanic was preparing to replace a filter assembly for a recirculation fan on a passenger aircraft. He reached to remove a screw near the fan, which sucked in his right hand and amputated his index fingertip.

An employee was attempting to close the extended lip of a malfunctioning dock plate. He used a T-bar to prop the dock plate up while trying to disengage the dock lock with another T-bar. The T-bar propping up the dock plate fell, causing the dock plate to fall down on his left arm and break it.
An employee was washing the southeast side of a poultry barn with a pressure washer. Water from the pressure wand lacerated her left forearm.

An employee was working near a shelf containing sheet metal parts when a forklift truck on the other side pushed a sheet metal part off the shelf. The part fell on the employee, causing a facial laceration and fractured right femur.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood. The wood got jammed inside the saw's guard, and the saw cut the employee's ankle, causing a laceration that required surgery.
An employee was repairing broken blades on a sod cutter. As he was checking his work, a blade amputated his right thumb.
An employee was transporting a patient to a psychiatric unit. The patient struck the employee in the nose with a stethoscope, breaking the employee's nose. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was standing in a hole with a pipe in it during road construction. The employee was unloading bags of concrete from an excavator bucket in preparation for pouring the concrete around the pipe in the hole. The excavator bucket was lowered onto the employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized for a crushing injury to the left foot that required surgery.
An employee was installing a pipe liner in a sewer manhole and suffered second-degree burns.
An employee was bending metal to make air ducts and the machine caught the employee's hair.
An employee was cutting a lintel with a chop saw. The saw kicked back and cut him.
A roofer was climbing a ladder to go onto the roof when he fell off the ladder onto the ground and broke his right ankle.
An employee tripped over a cart and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was lowering the trailer's support arm to the hitch on a truck and amputated the left ring and middle fingers.
An employee fell from a stand-up reach truck to the concrete floor, suffering a 2-inch head laceration.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs and sustained a broken hip.

Two employees were changing out a dock leveler's dock plate. While the injured employee was on his hands and knees under the leveler, installing the keeper-pins, a forklift that had been holding up the dock leveler's lip hinge moved back and released the dock plate. The plate fell on the injured employee, breaking most of his ribs, causing internal bleeding, and causing a T-Fracture in his lower back as well as fracture to the upper back.
An employee was operating a caustic flush and adding potassium hydroxide to water when the solution splashed him, causing chemical burns to his arm, face, and head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to bend copper pipe with a hand-held pipe bender. The employee's left thumb was caught and fractured between the pipe bender's cylinder and the pipe.

On August 17, 2020, an employee was using a pry bar to remove nails from metal on the edge of a roof. He fell off the roof to the concrete ground below, suffering two broken wrists, broken ribs, a neck injury, and a collapsed lung.

An employee was guiding a steel stair suspended from a crane hook into place to be connected with bolts. He used his sleever bar to guide and make sure the stair riser cleared the opening in the steel, but the top stair riser got hung up on the support beam. He pushed the stair riser with his foot. A clip angle on the stair got caught on the employee's pant leg and the stair swung back and caught the employee's right leg between the stair and the steel support beam. The leg was fractured above the ankle and required surgery.
An employee was grabbing a knife tub containing approximately 40 knives when the employee's left hand entered a hole on the bottom of the tub and contacted a knife blade, causing a laceration.
While attempting to repel from a tree, a smoke jumper fell approximately 25 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured L4 vertebra and a shoulder injury requiring surgery.
On August 17, 2020, an employee was cutting a demolished section of a ceiling into pieces. The employee's saw jerked at the end of a cut and lacerated the employee's left shoulder and chest.
On August 19, 2020, a piece of cracked window glass fell out while being moved, cutting an employee's right calf muscle.
An employee was climbing down an access ladder from a roof. He fell from the fourth rung, landing on his side and suffering a broken right hip.
A forklift struck the employee spotting it as it backed up, injuring the employee's ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

The injured employee was talking to an employee that was on a skid steer when the injured employee's foot got caught under the skid steer. The injured employee sustained the amputation of the right big toe and possibly the second toe.
An employee climbed a wooden pole to remove a downed conductor. The employee's right arm contacted the bottom of the energized switch and received third degree burns.
An employee suffered a broken bone while working on deliveries via a box truck.

An employee was in a boom truck, cutting limbs off a tree. He made a notch on a limb that forced the boom down and he was ejected, landing on the ground 15-20 feet below. He suffered a fractured skull and fractured vertebrae. Fall protection was not tied in at the time.

An employee was standing by a press, waiting for a fork truck to drop off a metal coil. The coil was set on the floor and the fork truck backed out. The coil started to roll, then fell over while the employee was trying to balance it. It struck the employee's right leg, causing a fracture that required surgery.
An employee hit his head on the inside of his car. He was hospitalized, suffering from brain bleeding.

Employees were inside the basket of the feed truck repairing the drive shaft on the main floor chain that is beneath the grain pile and perpendicular to the feeder/delivery chain. As the employees were removing feed from the main floor basket to access the drive shaft, an employee was swept by the feeder chain and pulled up and entangled into the beater bar. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated chest, punctured lung and broken left tibia.
An employee was cutting lamb with a meat bandsaw. The saw amputated his right thumb tip, just past the fingernail.
An employee was coming down a 4-foot step ladder and missed the last rung. The employee fell to the floor and suffered multiple fractures to the lower left leg.
An employee was moving grain from a truck into a mill. A nearby auger caught the employee's pants leg and pulled the clothing off; the employee suffered an abdominal injury that required surgery.

An employee was standing on a baker's scaffold, pumping concrete into a concrete block wall. A 4-inch drop in the concrete slab caused the scaffold to lean against the wall. The impact broke the employee's leg.
An employee was unclogging a riding lawn mower. The mower's impeller cut the employee's left middle finger at the knuckle, causing a fracture and ligament damage that required surgery.
An employee fell from a 4-foot ladder while restocking 5 lb. bags, impacting the ground and fracturing his lower left leg.
An employee was installing an 18-inch pipeline flange that weighed about 150 pounds. The flange made contact with the employee's right thumb, lacerating and breaking it.

An employee was loading countertop slabs onto an A-frame on the back of a flatbed truck. The slabs began to fall, causing the employee to fall onto the ground with his head and torso below the truck. The slabs then fell onto his legs. His left leg was amputated.
An employee was on a ladder, lost balance, and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken collarbone, scapula and broken ribs.
An employee was on a scissor lift using a pressure washer and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a broken femur and elbow.
After performing grinding outdoors, an employee suffered heat stress.

On August 18, 2020, an employee was adjusting the timing on a tray forming machine. The employee's left hand was caught between a counterweight and a stationary support for the machine; two bones in the hand were broken and the employee was hospitalized.
On August 18, 2020, a car drove through the front of an office. An employee working in the office suffered broken bones and internal injuries. She was hospitalized.

An employee was in the bucket of a bucket truck, repairing a storm-damaged electrical distribution line at the top of a pole. The employee was shocked, suffering first- and second-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing the gas cap from a gasoline engine that was in a semi-trailer. The vapor from the fuel ignited, severely burning the employee.

An employee was inspecting the welds on a 10-inch pipe. A 24-inch pipe next to the 10-inch pipe rolled off a piece of dunnage while the employee was passing over it, causing the employee to strike the 10-inch pipe with his right side. He suffered a kidney injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a trailer when the tongue of the trailer struck him, fracturing his right leg.
An employee was opening a bundle of bar joists. One of the joists fell and caused another joist to hit the employee's left leg, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a car while walking in a parking lot, suffering a broken tibia.
An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack. His foot was caught and broken between the pallet jack and a conveyor.

An employee was helping reconnect a drag chain. The chain began jumping; as he tried to hold it down, his foot was caught between the chain and a sprocket. Three of his toes were smashed, and there was an amputation.

An employee fell from the top of a tanker trailer, landing on the ground about 8-10 feet below. The employee suffered a bruised right shoulder and a cut above the right eyebrow that required stitches.
An employee was operating an electric pallet rider when he hit a parked pallet rider. His left foot was caught between the two riders.

An employee was next to the "little blue cars" at a shipyard. When the cars were pushed under a strongback (a wooden block) that was supporting a unit, the block was pushed off and fell onto the employee's left hand. He suffered a partial amputation of the middle fingertip, as well as open fractures of the middle and ring fingers.
An employee turned on a combustor at an oil and gas production site. A flash fire caused second-degree burns to the employee's hands and first-degree burns to his nose and ears.
An employee was checking a belt. The returning fan and pulley caught the employee's right hand, amputating the tip of the employee's thumb.

An employee was riding on a trailer inside a closed traffic lane, picking up traffic cones. His foot slipped off, hit the pavement directly in front of the trailer tire, and was run over. He suffered a broken ankle.

An employee fell through a 48-inch opening in the roof where two panels had been removed and struck a shelving unit and then landed on the floor approximately 30 feet below. The employee suffered fractured ribs, a punctured lung, and a bruised liver. The employee was not tied off at the time.
An employee was clearing a jam on a conveyor when the machine started up and amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was helping a forklift operator move a pallet and a 4X4 piece of wood when the employee's right pinky was crushed between the pallet and the 4x4, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unloading a piece of quartz from a truck. The quartz dropped onto his foot, breaking his toes.
A temporary employee was cleaning out a nut mixer when the blade started and pinned his right arm to the side of the mixer, crushing it. He was hospitalized.
An employee's fingers were pinched in the cart tipper on the back of a garbage truck, causing injuries that required surgery.
An employee fell while walking down a flight of stairs, suffering a broken right hip.
A machine struck an employee in the leg, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized.

A maintenance technician was inside the bucket of a bucket truck, which was on the side of the highway. The bucket was 20 feet in the air when the bucket truck was struck by a passing vehicle. The employee was thrown from the bucket to the ground and sustained a broken pelvis, fractured ribs, and a dislocated shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
At 11:35 a.m. on August 18, 2020, an employee was poisoned after drinking from a drink bottle containing a chemical.
An employee was working on a sewer line in a trench, replacing water line saddles when soil materials broke loose from the trench wall and fell on the employee's leg, fracturing it.
An employee slipped on a wet lobby floor and fell, suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee was removing an earth mover's drive shaft when it fell and crushed his left middle finger, causing an avulsion.
A census worker was on a house porch, asking the homeowner questions. A dog ran out of the house and knocked her off the porch to the ground. She suffered broken ribs and a twisted knee.

An employee was loading marble slabs onto a delivery truck using a forklift. A slab fell off the truck and struck the employee in the back of the neck/shoulders. The employee then fell forward and struck their head on a slab that was stored adjacent to the truck. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration.

An employee was performing repairs to the fan deck in a cooling tower. Upon entry into the cooling tower, the platform failed and the employee fell approximately 50 feet to the concrete basin at the bottom of the tower. The employee was hospitalized for three fractured vertebrae in the back, fractured tibia bones in both legs, a left elbow fracture, injuries to both knees, internal bleeding, bruised lungs, a concussion, lacerations to the head, and nerve impingement (back).
An employee fell out of a vehicle after it was lifted 4 feet with him inside it. He landed on the concrete floor, suffering lacerations and broken bones.

At 1:45 p.m. on August 19, 2020, two employees were putting a highway sign on a flatbed truck. The wind blew the sign, knocking one of the employees off the truck. The back of his head struck the curb. He suffered lacerations to the back of the head, a laceration near his left cheek, a broken forearm, and a concussion. He was hospitalized.
An employee returned from making deliveries and began to experience chest pain. The employee was hospitalized with an inflamed muscle.
On August 19, 2020, an employee was shocked by a live wire while working on a moored yacht. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning bottles in the trimmer section of a blow mold machine when the employee's finger was caught in the machinery, resulting in a transphalangeal amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee pinched their right thumb between a wrench and a nut, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was sawing tubing on a horizontal band saw. He was brushing chips away from the saw blade when it amputated his left middle fingertip just behind the nail, also lacerating his ring finger.

The injured employee was rolling up product with a co-worker when a roller pulled his gloved left hand forward. The weight of the roller smashed his fingers resulting in a partial amputation of the index finger and a fracture to the middle finger.
An employee was standing on the ladder/steps of a semi-truck. While swatting at a bug, the employee fell to the ground and fractured the left tibia.
An employee had been retrieving a one-gallon pail of paint from a shelf. While descending a three-step step ladder, the employee fell from the second step to the floor and sustained a broken hip.
An employee was trying to move a box jammed in racking. The box was dislodged and the employee slipped, fell, and hit the ground, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee experienced cramping at the end of his shift. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

On 8/19/2020, at 6:20 a.m., an employee was performing routine cleaning on a reclaim pelletizer. While performing this task, the employee attempted to activate the dump valve that stores hot water. Due to an internal defect on the pipe valve, the hot water did not drain out completely. As the employee released the locking collar, the stored water released through the gap, spraying hot water onto the employee. The employee sustained first and second degree thermal burns to the chest and left arm.
An employee fell from the second floor of a creel rack, suffering a broken left femur.
A staple gun fired a staple into an employee's right thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was tasked with maintenance work on top of a cooling tower. While leaving the tower, the employee lost his footing and fell to the ground, resulting in a head laceration, bruised lung, and spinal fractures.
An employee was repairing a leak on a metal roof. While walking on the roof the employee fell 15 feet through an opening to the concrete surface below. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was investigating a car accident in the parking lot outside the lobby and was struck by another car. The employee suffered a head injury.

On August 19, 2020, an employee was turning to pick up cleaning rags from a countertop, tripped over the legs of a stool, and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a leg fracture in two places.
An employee tripped on a curb and fell to the ground on their side. The employee suffered five broken ribs.
An employee was driving a mobile cart. His left foot was caught and broken between the cart and a stationary post.

An employee was on an extension ladder approximately 4 feet off the ground opening a junction box on the exterior of a house to trace the wires for a security camera installation. Upon removal of the cover plate of the junction box, a swarm of wasps started to rapidly fly out of the junction box toward the employee. The employee was startled, lost balance on the ladder, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist and a fractured L1 vertebra, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a portable hydraulic press to push a pin out of a pipe. The pin sheared off and flew toward the employee's head, lacerating it.
An employee was attempting to unclog a breading machine. When he tried to jog the belt his hand was caught between the belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped on a stand while placing goods on a pallet. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken femur. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell down a two-step stairway, hitting a paved surface and suffering a broken pelvis/hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting 3/4-inch plywood with a table saw. The saw lacerated the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to repair the injury.
A census worker was approaching a residence when a dog bit her ankle. One of its teeth was embedded in the ankle and she was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was attempting to open a door to enter the office area when she slipped and fell to the floor. She was hospitalized with a hairline fracture to her hip.

On August 19, 2020, at approximately 12:15 PM, an employee was restocking the supplies in a customer service area. She placed her stock onto the counter and walked around, entering the retail lobby through the lobby entrance. As she pushed open the lobby door, she fell onto her right side. She was hospitalized with a broken hip.

The injured employee delivered cement to the customer and was cleaning the chute on the concrete truck in the staging area established at the site for cleaning tools. A track hoe arrived at the staging area for cleaning. The injured employee was standing between the concrete truck and track hoe and was struck in the abdomen by the track hoe bucket. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on spilled juice while walking across a dining area. She fell to the ground and suffered a broken left kneecap.
While grinding a piece of metal an employee's left thumb got caught between the piece of metal and the grinding wheel resulting in partial amputation of the left thumb.
An employee developed heat-related illness about 45 minutes before the end of his shift offloading cars. He was hospitalized the next morning, suffering from dehydration.
An employee was moving a tote of chicken when their right thumb and index finger were pinched by the belt drive on the shaker table resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a feed auger mounted on a 2-ton truck. The auger caught the employee's arm and amputated his hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was getting ready to switch out a motor on a piece of foundry equipment. The motor shifted, crushing the employee's left ring finger against its metal frame and causing a partial amputation to the finger.
An outrigger on a concrete truck shifted, causing the truck boom to strike an employee. The employee suffered a bruised spine and was hospitalized.
An employee of Bobs Concrete was struck by the boom of a concrete pumping truck after the truck's outrigger shifted. The employee suffered a broken collarbone and a hand laceration.
An employee fell to the concrete ground while stepping out of the cab of his tractor-trailer. The employee sustained a fractured left hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cleaning a lawn mower that was on a jack. When the employee was lowering the jack, the jack fell on his hand and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was troubleshooting a system when his left middle finger was caught between the mount and guiderail of a stencil machine. The tip of the finger was amputated with no bone loss.
On August 20, 2020, a grocery clerk reached for the cash drawer to pull himself up from a kneeling position and tore his left triceps muscle. The employee was admitted to the hospital.
An employee tripped and fell from a single step to the ground, resulting in fractured right leg.

An employee was pulling a wheeled cart containing parts to another area of the assembly line. During transport, the cart hit a floor mounted rail track in the aisle, causing the cart to tip over. The cart struck the employee's lower right leg and fractured the tibia and fibula.

A crane operator was moving a high-tension power pole. The top/spreader bar on a foundry hook made contact with the pole, causing slack in the crane cable. It disconnected, fell about 3 feet, and struck the employee's shoulder.
An employee was straightening rollers on a load when the roller's wheels collapsed and fell on his right foot, breaking two bones.

An employee was washing down a conveyor belt. He slipped on a platform and his glove went into a 3/4-inch gap in the back of the chain guard. The chain drive pulled in his hand. He suffered amputations to the left ring and index fingers.
An employee was struck by a piece of wood that fell off a swing stage scaffold and suffered a broken leg.
An employee arrived at work, turned the corner leading into the cafeteria, tripped over a box, and fell. The employee sustained a broken right kneecap.

While walking through the parking lot an employee tripped on the corner of a curb around a flag pole and fell onto the concrete flag pole setting. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a punctured/collapsed lung.
An employee felt upper-leg pain while walking into a building. The employee's femur was broken.
An employee was post-tensioning an arch culvert. The post-tensioning machine caught and injured the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was clearing soil away from an underground power line with a shovel. The shovel cut through the wire's insulation, resulting in an arc flash that caused first-degree burns to the employee's arms and neck.
An employee was attempting to free a plastic bag that had become jammed in the bagging machine and suffered a partial amputation of the right index finger.

Two mechanics were working on a semi. The semi was started from the ground and lurched forward, pinning one of the employees against the back of a box truck. The employee suffered a crushing injury to the left leg and torso.
An employee was riding on the paver box when their fingers were caught between the guardrail and the mechanical lift on the paver. The employee's left middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

An employee was loading large cylindrical arbors vertically into a cart with wheels when an arbor fell. This caused a shift in weight and the basket became top-heavy and tilted. The employee's hand was still on the lifting device connected to the hoist and arbor when the basket and arbors shifted. His left ring finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was inserting the pin of the hydraulic cylinder into the trench box hole when her right middle finger got caught in between the pin of the hydraulic cylinder and the trench box hole and was amputated.
An employee was removing paper from a paper bag machine. The gears in the bundler amputated the employee's right index finger at the knuckle.

An employee was inspecting bearings on equipment while walking around the equipment. He stepped through an open hatchway and fell eight feet to the level below landing on grating. The employee sustained a fractured spine and a concussion.
An employee was disassembling a mobile crane. Part of the crane came in contact with a service line for a cell tower. The employee sustained electrical burns to the left arm and right foot.
An employee and fell while walking to retrieve a seat cushion, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was driving a golf cart when it crashed into a stationary bollard. The employee suffered contusions to the chest and abdomen.

A driver was at a customer's location unloading fiberglass insulation on pallets. As the driver was removing a pallet, the top bags got caught on the door and shifted. The driver tried to shift them back and fell from the liftgate at the back of the truck. The driver sustained a cut on the leg and possible bone damage.
An employee was operating a machine when his foot was caught in its chain and sprocket. He suffered severe lacerations and fractures and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was sweeping sunflower seeds into the floor auger portals in a flat-bottom grain storage bin. He slipped down a pile of seeds (about 5-6 feet tall) and his leg was caught by an auger. His leg was amputated.

An employee climbed onto the wing of a B-52 aircraft from an aerial lift to begin preparations for priming. The employee slid off the wing to the floor approximately 7 feet below. The employee landed on his knees then hit his head on the rear landing gear tire that resulted in an injury requiring stitches. The employee also sustained a possible fractured hip. The employee was wearing fall protection at the time.

An employee was working on slab lifter tongs with another employee. The employee was placing a stone slab wedge to separate bundles so that the clamps could pick up a stone slab. The 400-pound stone slab overturned, pinning the employee between the stone slab and the unloading dock. The employee sustained a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

On August 21, 2020, a census worker was on a residential porch. The resident opened the screen door and the resident's dog lunged at the employee, causing the employee to fall off the porch and suffer a broken ankle, a broken leg, and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground and sustained a laceration and possible concussion.
An employee was operating a press to bend metal flashing. His finger slipped into the press at the same time the machine cycled and his hands were crushed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a middle finger amputation during the operation of a meat tenderizer.
An employee was standing next to a forklift when it turned and caught the employee's leg, resulting in hospitalization with broken bones.

After tearing up flooring (including carpet, laminate, and plywood) in a living room that an AC unit had flooded with water, two employees developed burns and rashes. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to punch a hole into the cooling tower support beam using the hydraulic punch set. The employee's foot slipped out on uneven ground and the employee fell to the ground dropping the tool onto his leg and fracturing it.
An employee was lifting a dock plate to make a delivery when the dock plate smashed and crushed the employee's pinky finger.
An employee was removing meat from a grinder and the blade amputated finger(s) on the left hand.

An employee had been conducting flagging operations at an intersection where other employees were applying hot tar to the road. The employee went to get onto the hot tar buggy to ride to the next intersection but fell off the buggy and landed in hot tar that had puddled on the road. The employee sustained burns to his left arm and right hand. He also sustained a bruised left leg.
An employee had been wearing a surgical mask for extended periods of time which caused a cut into the back of the left ear that resulted in a bacterial infection. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered an amputated right index finger while tying a rope around a cleat on a dock to secure a boat.
An employee was sand blasting a tank and was struck in the right arm by the air and sand (125 psi) which penetrated and lacerated their arm.

An employee was using a chain to close a parking lot gate. The gate was connected to an electric fence; one of the electric guide wires touched the chain and the employee was shocked. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a 120-pound piece of scrap steel plate into a scrap bin. The piece fell onto the employee's right foot, causing ligament damage.

An employee was on the platform of a 4-foot high platform step ladder to install reshoring for pour-in-place concrete construction. The employee fell approximately 4 feet from the platform to the floor and sustained a back injury.
An employee was driving a four-wheeler when it hit a ditch and rolled over. The employee's lower right leg was broken.
An employee was wiping the top of a machine with a cloth when her finger slipped through an opening on the guard and the mold clamp closed on her fingertip and amputated it.
An employee was forming parts on a 100-ton press brake and caught his left hand between the lower and upper die resulting in four broken fingers and a lacerated thumb.
