A pharmacy courier was pushing a med-cart into the facility when the employee lost control, causing the cart and the employee to fall off the edge of a loading dock. The employee was hospitalized for multiple fractures to his right arm.
An employee was operating a skid steer when his foot was caught between the bucket and base of the skid steer. The employee sustained two closed fractures to the right ankle.
An employee was moving wood in a roll-off box when a piece of wood slipped and lacerated the employee's right leg.

An employee was working on top of an elevator car removing counterweights. The elevator car was being lowered when the coffing hoist holding it up snapped and the elevator car and the employee fell from the 10th floor to the basement. The employee sustained broken bones.

An employee was preparing steel flats to be loaded using an overhead crane and a hook. He lifted the material about 4 inches up and attempted to put a block under the material with his right hand. The material slipped off the hook and came down on his right hand, crushing and amputating the index finger below the second knuckle.

While reaching for the button to raise the overhead door of a truck an employee's arm was caught in a loop of the wire cable that raises and lowers the door. The employee was lifted and sustained two arm fractures.
An employee fell from the top of a truck cab to the ground, suffering injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was tightening bolts on the handrail system of a boat dock under construction. The employee fell from the dock's roof, landed on the construction platform, and then fell to the ground. The employee suffered contusions and lacerations to the head, neck, left arm, and left leg, as well as a wrist fracture that required surgery. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was placing a vinyl/canvas cover over the bucket of a bucket truck. The employee slipped on the non-skid surface of the platform beneath the boom cradle and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left tibia and fibula.
An employee was descending the stairs from the fourth floor down to the third floor when she slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.
An employee was clearing product out of the cutting machine and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.

At about 8:15 a.m. on August 22, 2020, an employee was in a truck yard opening the swing-style doors on the back of a semi trailer. When the employee opened the right-side door, a generator weighing over 200 pounds fell and struck the employee, knocking her to the ground. She suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was working on a box conveyor machine. He was cleaning the chain when the chain and sprocket caught his fingers. His right ring and little fingers were amputated.

An employee was ascending a tree using climbing equipment. A large hollow space in the tree collapsed causing the employee to fall 30 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a  broken right shoulder and broken ribs.
A small book cart slipped off the forks of a forklift and fell on an employee, crushing the employee's arm and shoulder.

On August 22, 2020, the injured employee and a coworker were removing a trash gondola out of a compactor. Both were positioned outside of the compactor. As they were attempting to slide it down to the base of the gondola tipper, the gondola moved and caught the injured employee's fifth digit on his right hand and amputated it at the nail bed.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun. A nail bounced back and struck the employee in the eye, cutting the eyelid. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on concrete steps while walking toward a house to conduct work, suffering a fractured leg.

An employee was helping a customer inside the store when a motorist outside lost control of her vehicle, crashed through the store wall, and struck the employee. He was hospitalized with a lacerated liver.
An employee had been helping to switching cars. The employee began to feel ill and was hospitalized with dehydration.

An employee was on the working platform of a scaffold at a height of approximately 9 feet doing welding operations. During an alarm, the employee fell from the scaffold's ladder to the ground, resulting in a compound fracture to the lower left leg requiring hospitalization and surgery.

On August 23, 2020, an employee was walking from a fitting room to a sales floor. The employee's foot got caught under a chair and the employee fell, suffering a twisted and strained left knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in a restroom when the automatic lights shut off. He was trying to find the exit when his head struck the wall. He lost consciousness and suffered head, neck, and back injuries.

On August 23, 2020, an employee was checking the pressure on compressed oxygen cylinders used for boiler chemistry control. When the employee opened a cylinder manifold valve, the stainless steel braided hose connecting the cylinder cradle to the pressure gauge failed and whipped around, striking the employee on the back and the left elbow. The employee suffered a 6-inch laceration to the elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee was retrieving two cargo airbags for loading a truck. While driving a powered industrial truck (PIT) down the dock, the PIT collided with a bollard by a door. The employee sustained a left thumb amputation.
A cashier was walking from her register to a desk. She tripped over her portable oxygen hose and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was trying to get a dock plate up to put in the back of a trailer. The plate was stuck. Another employee picked it back up; the first employee slipped and fell, and his hand was pinched by the lip of the dock plate. He suffered a partial amputation to the left thumb (with no bone loss).
While working on a metal slitter machine an employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger and a laceration to the right middle finger.

An employee was changing out the capacitor on the blower motor of a heat pump. After the swap out, he turned the power back on, but the blower motor was not working. He reached under the unit and disconnected the 277-volt power. The employee was then electrocuted and dropped to the floor.
An employee slipped and fell down stairs while delivering mail. She hit the ground and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was placing steel angles on skids. Multiple steel angles fell off a skid, dislocating and fracturing the employee's heels. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a cutoff saw when it kicked back and lacerated the employee's upper left arm. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was fixing a clamp on a metal saw. The clamp was moved and caught the employee's hand/wrist against the side wall of the machine, breaking them.

On 8-24-2020 at 2:40 a.m., an Ivory Solutions employee was on a stepladder removing a ceiling when the ceiling fell, causing the employee to fall off the stepladder. As he fell, he hit his ribs on the ladder, injuring them and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was filling a wall using a grout pump that was mounted on the elevated forks of a telehandler. The lift tipped forward and the pump struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the head, ribs, eye, and hand.
An employee tripped on a fuel hose while fueling a vehicle at a gas station. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken and dislocated elbow.
An employee was drilling holes in crane mats. A grate guarding the auger underneath the floor was dislodged and the employee's foot slipped through the hole and was lacerated by the auger.
An employee was cleaning up steel banding. The banding whipped and cut the employee, causing an inch-deep laceration about an inch above the right elbow.

On August 24, 2020, two employees were installing the lower shelf inside a carousel used to dispense prescription medicine. The carousel cycled and its door came down on one employee's chest, causing cracked ribs, a collapsed lung, and hematomas.

An employee was removing a tarp covering a mechanical fabrication area. The employee was standing on the fourth rung of an 8-foot ladder when he lost his footing and fell to the ground sustaining a broken tibia/fibula.
An employee lost balance while on an extension ladder and fell. The employee sustained broken bones in the shoulder and ankle requiring surgery.
An employee fell, injuring his ankle and breaking his index finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking a piece of angle steel down to be loaded onto a truck for delivery. While removing the chain from around the piece of steel, the chain slipped and caught the employee's fingertip against the angle steel, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was waiting for rebar to be unloaded from a trailer. Straps broke and rebar struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee injured her hand in a machine. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was crossing over a conveyor when she stepped on the moving conveyor. The conveyor caught her leg and fractured it in three places.
An employee was receiving a piece of rebar that was being lowered to him. The rebar was dropped. Its point hit the employee's hard hat and was deflected into the back of his left shoulder.
An employee tripped over debris and fell, striking his right hip on the ground. The employee sustained a broken hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee suffered a dislocated kneecap while squatting to inspect a pallet.
An employee was operating an incinerator. While opening the door of the incinerator, a metal part of the incinerator lacerated the employee's left forearm.
An employee was operating a portable circular saw. The saw amputated two fingers from his left hand.
An employee was using a circular saw when it cut his finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was rolling a dumpster to the loading dock for collection when his right hand was caught and fractured between the roll-off dumpster and a concrete wall.

Two employees were repairing a grain auger that was hitched to a tractor. The tractor was turned on to make the auger rotate so the employees could ensure that the repair was complete. When the auger began to rotate it caught the left foot of one of the employees. The injured employee sustained a partial amputation of the left foot (from the arch to the toes).
An employee was replacing a damaged air break switch at a distribution circuit. A surge arrestor connected to the air break switch failed and an arc flash caused burns to the employee's face.
An employee was applying brush-on paint stripper to a concrete wall. Paint stripper ran into his glove and contacted his forearm. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to the forearm.
At about 11:40 a.m. on August 24, 2020, an employee was aligning the lower flight into a grain cart with a hoist. As the flight dropped into place, it amputated the tip of his right index finger.

An employee was preparing to realign a product back onto the core of a shaft. The employee's arm was caught by the rotating shaft and became bound up in the product. The employee's left shoulder was dislocated and their left forearm was broken.

An employee was climbing a 16-foot ladder that had been placed on a wall. He slipped and fell from halfway up the ladder, landing on the floor in a standing position and suffering a broken right ankle. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

Two barges were lodged together. An employee was on the walking surface of one of the barges when the two barges abruptly dislodged. The employee was ejected from the barge, landing in the water and sustaining lacerations to the head and left arm.
An employee was backing a forklift down a warehouse dock. The forklift collided with another forklift; the employee's left foot was caught and broken between the two.
An employee fell while climbing down a ladder. The employee struck a guardrail and then landed on the ground, suffering injuries to the lower back and abdomen.
An employee was operating a skid steer in a closed lane of a public roadway. A city bus struck the skid steer, which tipped on its side. The employee suffered possible broken ribs and a concussion.
A hopper lid fell on an employee who was removing a bag, injuring the back of his neck and his upper back.

A crew of five employees used two forklifts along with a telehandler to load and carry pipe that had been cut into 125-foot sections from the fuel pier to the parking lot for painting. The injured employee was guiding the pipe while it was being moved by the forklift. The pipe struck a bush and began swaying and the injured employee's hand was caught between the pipe and the building next to it. The employee's right ring and pinky fingers were amputated.
On August 24, 2020, an employee was servicing a diesel engine when he was struck by a forklift being operated in reverse, suffering a fractured pelvis.
An employee operating a riding lawn mower at a commercial jobsite fell off the lawn mower. The mower blade then caused an amputation to his foot.
An employee was leading a horse into a show ring when the horse spooked, pulled itself to the end of the lead, and kicked the employee in the stomach. The employee suffered an intestinal injury.
An employee was handling rope attached to a machine. The machine was energized, drawing the rope across the employee's hand and amputating the tips of the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee stepped into the nose of a drop-frame trailer to cross to the other side. The open rollers caused him to lose his footing and fall. He suffered abdominal injury.

A load lugger work crew was unloading a roll-off bin. An employee was removing a cable from the bin when the truck rocked backwards slightly. The employee's left leg was pinched between the tilted rails where the cables were attached, resulting in a fracture to his fibula and a laceration to his calf area. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was clearing a deck of unlocking poles. The employee fell from a platform to a surface 8 feet below, suffering broken bones.
An employee experienced heat stress while demolishing a brick fa ade, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was dismantling a roofing truss on the ground when the truss became displaced and struck his lower left leg, fracturing it. He was hospitalized.

Employees were installing a 25-foot steel column that had a hitch to a steel base plate. As they tried to put the base plate on the foundation with a telehandler, it slipped out of the nylon sling. The hitch struck an employee on the left lower leg between the knee and ankle, causing a compound fracture.
An employee was cleaning the bottom lock area of a raised dump truck bed when a chunk of asphalt fell down the bed and hit him, fracturing his ankle.
An employee was working in a robot area. His muscles began cramping in the morning and he was hospitalized that afternoon, suffering from heat stress.

An employee was offloading pipe using a 5-ton overhead crane. He was lowering a bundle that had been lifted off center and was using his left hand to level and balance the load when the chain sling slipped and his left hand was trapped between the chain and the pipe. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pouring a pre-cast member while standing on a concrete form. The employee fell to the ground 4.5 feet below and was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was climbing down from a roof on a fixed metal ladder. The ladder broke from the wall and he fell 5-6 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a head injury.
An employee was drilling holes with a core drill. The employee's right thumb was pinched between the drill handle and the adjacent equipment. The thumb was amputated.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder. The ladder slid and the employee fell to the ground 4-5 feet below, suffering broken ribs and a closed fracture of the spine. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee missed the last 2 steps while descending from an A-frame ladder. She fell to the concrete floor and suffered a possible brain hemorrhage.
An employee was loading a pallet onto a semi-trailer using a fork truck when his left arm was caught between the fork truck and the trailer, resulting in a fractured arm.
An employee was doing preventive maintenance on a conveyor. The employee's shirt was entangled in the conveyor belt and roller, and the employee suffered four fractures to the left arm.
An employee that had been driving a forklift suffered a heart attack.
An employee was replacing a belt on a motor. The motor started and the employee's right middle fingertip was pinched between the belt and a pulley. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking toward a counter in a store. A member of the public stabbed the employee in the back multiple times with a knife.
An employee was walking away from a counter when she tripped on a wire. She fell, suffering a hip/pelvis fracture as well as elbow and head injuries. She was hospitalized.
A Rogers and Sons Concrete employee sustained a leg fracture at a construction site.

An employee was servicing a material handling kicker plate when it activated. The cylinder retracted and crushed his right thumb between the kicker framework and a conveyor belt. He suffered an open fracture to the thumb tip.

An employee was removing a small strap coil band from an arbor by sliding off the uncoiler drum. The drum was still collapsing to allow the coil to be removed, and as it closed it crushed and broke the employee's right ring and little fingers.
An employee was changing out the die on a pellet mill. When he spun the die, it caught his left-hand thumb, resulting in the amputation of 1/2 an inch of his thumb.
A spray can exploded on a conveyor line after getting jammed near a heat plate. Three employees suffered burns and one was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was installing a light while standing on an 8 foot extension ladder. The bottom of the ladder kicked out due to a wet floor and the employee fell. He was hospitalized for a broken ankle.
An employee was cutting a piece of foam on a table saw. The material kicked back and the saw cut three fingers on the employee's left hand. The little finger needed partial surgical amputation.
An employee tripped and fell while walking away from a residence, hitting rocks and the ground itself. The employee suffered a broken humerus and a laceration over the eyebrow.

On August 25, 2020, an employee was operating a vertical band saw to cut meat when the employee's right hand made contact with the energized saw blade, resulting in an amputation to the right thumb tip.
An employee was driving an ATV when it flipped over on him, causing broken ribs and a broken knee.
An employee was using an ATV when it ran into some overgrown brush, then flipped back and landed on the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken knee.
While taking out drywall and insulation, an employee began to feel ill and developed stomach issues. He was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat stress.
An employee fell while installing metal roof sheeting, landing on the ground 41 feet below and suffering broken ribs, legs, and hips.

A coater operator was working at a board machine, adjusting the coater wipe at the coater rolls. The rolls caught the employee's right forearm, crushing it. He was hospitalized and his right hand was surgically amputated.
An employee was lowering a dock plate onto the rear of a trailer. Another employee stepped on the plate, causing it to pinch the first employee's hand. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
On August 26, 2020, an employee was placing a sticker on a trailer in a yard when a tractor ran her over. She suffered a leg injury and was hospitalized.

An employee was using an overhead bridge crane to pick up a bundle of steel rebar. As the bundle was clearing the bin pocket, it swung into the employee's right arm and hit it against a fixed piece of machinery. His arm was broken and he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat-related dehydration.
An employee was stepping off a ladder cart when she fell from the last step, landing on the tile/concrete floor and suffering a broken leg and possible broken hip.

On August 26, 2020, an employee was cleaning an industrial mixer when a flash fire erupted within the mixer and burned the employee's face, neck, and hands. The cleaning process involves manually scraping a mixture of aluminum paste with petroleum distillate carrier. Isopropyl alcohol is then used to wash the mixer.
An employee was on an extension ladder when it fell. The employee fell with it, and both landed on the ground two stories below. He suffered lacerations to the eyebrow and mouth and a broken nose.

An employee was driving a forklift forward when she tried to move a dolly's break bar by pushing it with her arm. Her ring and middle fingers were then caught between the overhead guard frame of the forklift and the dolly's break bar, resulting in a ring fingertip amputation and middle finger laceration.
An employee was unloading a treadmill from a truck using a dolly. The treadmill and the dolly fell on him, breaking a vertebra at the base of his neck. He was hospitalized.

A 2,200-pound bulk bag of peanuts had fallen to a warehouse floor and come open. Employees were cleaning up when another bulk bag fell onto one of them, covering his entire body except for his head and feet. He suffered a broken femur and humerus, as well as head lacerations. He was hospitalized.
An employee became dizzy and lost his balance while operating a press brake. While he was getting his balance, the press brake closed on his right hand, crushing the middle and index fingers.
On August 26, 2020, an employee lost control of a stand-up forklift. The employee's leg became caught between the machine and a guardrail, causing the employee to sustain a broken left leg.

On August 26, 2020, a temporary employee was operating a fork truck when it tipped onto its side, causing the overhead guard to land on the employee's left foot and break it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee had completed his shift and was preparing to punch out when he became disoriented. He later had a seizure and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
On August 26, 2020, a delivery driver became dizzy after making a drop-off. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee's left hand and arm were pulled into a net puller machine. The employee suffered an open fracture of the arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling a 1,500-pound metal coil. The coil tipped over onto the employee's left ankle, breaking it.
An employee became dehydrated and had to be hospitalized.
An employee was operating a dock plate when it partially amputated the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was cutting a ductile water line pipe to be replaced using a gas powered cut off saw. Something caused the saw to kick upwards and the body of the saw struck the employee's face causing fractures and a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a tree in order to cut it. His rope failed and he fell 45 feet to the ground, suffering a broken back.

At 9:30 a.m. on August 26, 2020, an employee was cutting off fiberglass material that had wrapped around a roller on a production line. A chain and gear caught the employee's gloved-hand, causing a 3-millimeter fingertip amputation.
An employee was leaving a pallet area when a stand-up forklift ran over his left foot. He suffered a broken and dislocated big toe.
An employee was scraping a grill after applying a chemical cleaner to it. The chemical splashed back and struck the employee's right hand, causing second- and third-degree burns.
A UPS delivery driver returned to the UPS facility after a day delivering packages. She became ill, suffering from heat-related dehydration.

A veterinarian was drawing blood from a patient for a test when the dog pulled her arm and jerked it back. The needle went into the veterinarian's thumb about an inch. Her hand started swelling in the evening. She later went to the hospital for an infection.

An employee was sitting on the liquid petroleum tank of a forward-tipping forklift, unloading a safe into a dumpster. The forklift tipped forward. When it tipped back to a neutral position, the employee suffered a lower back injury.
An employee was using a meat slicing machine when his hand was caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of three fingers.
An employee was cutting a flagpole with a demolition saw. The saw lacerated the employee's chest.
An employee sat down to take a break and had a seizure that was possibly heat-related and suffered a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was working outdoors in the lumber yard and building material orders. The employee became light-headed and had chest pain. The employee was hospitalized due to heat exhaustion.

An employee was helping a crane operator move a valve off a pallet. The employee hooked up the valve by the shaft. When it was raised, the valve shifted and caught the employee's right index finger against the crane block. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell while walking down steps. The employee's right ankle was broken in three places.

An employee was in a manhole, tending a ladder while a pipe plug was being deflated. The pressure inside the pipe caused the plug to pop out of the pipe and strike the access ladder inside the manhole. The ladder in turn struck the employee in the throat, causing a neck contusion.

An employee was cutting 3/4" x 2.25" floorboards with a saw-stop table saw. While he was attempting to cut a plank, the board kicked back and struck his lower right abdomen. He suffered a perforated intestine.
After performing maintenance-related tasks on a skid steer using a sledge for an hour and a half, an employee developed heat-related illness.
An employee developed muscle cramps after working on a rooftop. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack to pick orders when the jack struck a guardrail, tearing a ligament in the employee's right leg.
An employee received an amputation while removing paint buildup from inside a powder coating machine.
An employee's left hand was caught in a rolling mill. Two-thirds of the employee's middle and ring fingers were amputated.

An employee was servicing an overhead light fixture when he received an electric shock that made him fall from an 8-foot ladder to the ground. He hit shelving as he fell, cutting his head. He also suffered a broken wrist and broken ribs.
An employee was using a tube cutting machine. The machine operated while his hand was inside a chute and amputated the tip of his finger.

An employee was standing on a desk when it collapsed. As she fell, her mouth hit a metal bracket from the broken desk. She suffered lacerations to the inside and outside bottom lip, broken teeth, and a broken left foot.

An employee was cleaning up a solvent leak from a membrane skid in a manufacturing facility. A nearby heat gun caused fumes from the leak to ignite. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the hand and arm.
An employee fell from a chain used to rope off the dock and landed on the floor 4 feet below, suffering injuries to the ribs, collarbone, and face.
Two employees were throwing away a toilet in a dumpster. One employee's left middle finger was lodged between the toilet and the dumpster rim, resulting in an amputation of the fingertip.
A cat bit a veterinary technician's left hand. The wound became infected and she was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to unjam batteries on an assembly line. The employee's left index finger was pinched between the conveyor framework and the stopper. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was setting up a machine and feeding marking thread through the die to prepare for startup. The employee's right middle fingertip was crushed, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was performing his routine job duties when he passed out, possibly due to high heat exposure. He was hospitalized.
An employee amputated two fingers while operating a slicer machine.
An employee was trying to remove a small piece of burning cotton from a cotton gin machine. The machine's saw amputated his finger.

An employee was trying to reposition a resident in bed. The resident was pulling on the employee and hurting her, and she leaned back to get away from him. When he released her, she fell and lacerated the left side of her forehead on the leg of the patient's lift machine. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell while carrying a medication tray. She landed on the ground and suffered a broken left patella.

An employee was working at a treatment facility construction site. A flatbed had transported a single platform about 1 mile to the site. The platform was strapped onto the flatbed and had wood blocks to keep it from moving. During the transport, one of the pieces of wood vibrated out of position. When the employee released the ratcheted straps, the tubular steel frame platform toppled over and off the flatbed. The platform struck and broke his left leg. He was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two employees were driving a utility terrain vehicle when it slid on muddy soil and rolled over on an incline. An employee's leg was caught underneath the vehicle against the soil/mud. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was loading livestock into a cattle hauler when he began experiencing symptoms such as dizziness and lightheadedness. The employee took a break to hydrate and returned to work when he felt better. Later that night the employee went to the hospital with heat stroke.
An employee was trying to replace the gasket on a pump before replacing the hose. When the employee tried to fully seat the gasket, the pump impellers amputated the tip of his finger.

An employee was changing the drum brakes on a yard truck. As he used a pry bar to help install the upper brake shoe of the right rear drum, his left little finger was caught between the S-Cam roller and the brake shoe. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a hand vacuum to clean up tea powder around a machine. Her cleaning rag fell off the side of the machine into a coned-shape opening where bags of material were being cut. She tried grabbing her rag with her left hand, but the rag was caught and pulled by the machine. As she tried pulling the rag out, her left index fingertip was cut by the machine blades.
An employee's knee gave out and she fell, hitting her head on a door frame. She suffered a head laceration and a broken right hip.

An employee was stepping over a guardrail when it caught his shoe, causing him to fall to the cement floor. He suffered a contusion to the left kidney, a muscle strain in his shoulder/left upper arm, and a lower back strain.

An employee fell while trying to climb off a residential roof onto a fixed ladder attached to the service truck. The employee landed on the ground about 8 feet below and suffered a concussion and cracked vertebrae. Fall protection was not in use at the time.
An employee was lifting a steel I-beam to be placed on a table when the I-beam slipped. The employee attempted to grab the I-beam and it fell on his index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was trying to start a pulley by hand when the pulley grabbed and pulled the employee's right ring finger between the pulley and belt, resulting in an amputation of the finger.

On August 28, 2020, around 4:13 a.m., an employee was preparing to help unload a trailer at a loading dock. As the employee was traversing from the loading dock to the trailer, he missed the trailer and fell to the ground. He put his right arm out, which took the force of the fall and resulted in a fractured right wrist.
On August 28, 2020, at 4:15 p.m., a United States Postal Service employee was on his route when he started to feel dizzy and lightheaded. He was hospitalized for heat-related illness.
An employee had been driving a truck all day performing delivery activities in the heat. Near the end of his shift, he was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
After shoveling coke in heated conditions, an employee experienced dehydration and had to be hospitalized.
An employee was using a sheet metal bender. The machine amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb.
On August 28, 2020, a forklift struck an employee's left foot, resulting in amputations to the big and second toes.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut pine wood blocking stock. The wood stock was pulled into the sawblade, which amputated four fingers on the employee's left hand, also lacerating the thumb.

An employee was stacking lumber coming out of a moulder. A bundle of MDF slipped off the front of a forklift, hitting the cart holding the lumber. The employee was pinned between the lumber and the moulder, suffering a broken lower left leg.

An employee was sanding the rough edge of a stainless steel sheet after a plasma cut using a 4.5 inch electric hand held grinder with a sanding disk when the employee's hair was caught in the tool's rotating assembly. The sanding disk cut the employee's left temple and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a cart loaded with packages. His thumb was smashed between a metal I-beam and the cart structure, causing an injury that required surgery.

At approximately 9:45 a.m. (CST), an employee was using a crane to move a piece of sheet metal. The piece of sheet metal became stuck on another sheet. The employee tried to free the piece of sheet metal with his right hand. When the piece of metal dislodged, it struck the employee's right ring finger and caused an amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee was stepping out of a manlift while attempting to connect to a steel pipe when the employee fell 15 feet, suffering a fractured pelvis and lower back fracture.

On August 28, 2020, an employee was affixing the D-ring of a pallet lifting device to the sling hook of an overhead crane when the crane's hook was raised. The employee's left thumb was caught between the crane hook and the D-ring, and the thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a block of wood when the wood became jammed. As he attempted to unjam the wood, the saw blade amputated a quarter inch of his left thumb tip (no bone loss).

Two employees were attaching a tie-in wire to hold a wire to a new insulator that had been put on a pole. The tie ware came into contact with the pole grounding wire, causing an arc flash that burned the employees' faces, arms, and necks.

A temporary employee was helping with a bundle of steel when a vertical row of 7 pieces of 2" tubing began to fall over. He reached out with his right arm to catch them, and when he pulled his arm back, his upper arm brushed against the end of one of the tubes, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was shot by his former spouse (non-employee), suffering gunshot wounds to the chest and torso area, buttock, and leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to repair an auger in a volumetric cement mixer when the employee fell 7 to 13 feet out of a raised bucket truck to the ground below. The employee suffered fractures to the elbow, resulting in surgery and hospitalization.
A forklift ran over and broke an employee's left foot as it backed up.
On August 28, 2020, an employee was inserting vegetables into a food processing machine. Blades inside the machine's chute amputated two of the employee's fingertips.
An employee tripped and fell while cleaning shopping carts. Her head struck the floor.

An employee was climbing a 20-foot extension ladder. He fell from 16 feet up; his head struck a beam before he landed on the platform below, and he briefly lost consciousness. He was hospitalized, having suffered four cracked ribs, a cracked pelvic bone, a concussion, and a broken hand.
A census employee was shot in the leg, through a car door, while parked near a sample unit.
An employee was operating a punch press. The press cycled and caught the employee's left ring finger, causing a partial amputation above the first knuckle.
An employee had been setting long span girders, welding, and adding X-bracing in the gym area. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stress.
An employee became ill after loading diesel onto a tanker trailer. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs, suffering bruised right and left knees and a sprained ankle.
A security officer was at a check-out gate, moving product inside a pickup bed, when a spider bit his arm. He developed a staphylococcus infection and was hospitalized.

An employee was changing out dies on a hydraulic press brake. As the employee was trying to move the plastic die in the point of operation, the brake closed on the employee's left-hand fingers. The two middle fingers were later amputated to the knuckle.

An employee was working from a ladder as part of a crew who were tearing off an old roof on a residential property. The employee missed a rung as he was climbing down the ladder and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing concrete grouting when a nearby box truck hit a barrel, causing the barrel ring to fly out and hit the employee's left leg. His left shin broke, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Two employees were replacing a bearing on an acceleration belt roll. A 20-pound roll bearing fell to the ground, wedging one employee's right hand against the ground. The middle finger was amputated at the second knuckle, the index finger was lacerated, and the ring finger was crushed.

An employee was preparing to reinstall a box chain that had broken. When he tried to rotate the drive belt manually (in order to straighten the chain and thus find its end), the chain shifted and the drive belt rotated in the opposite direction. His right ring finger was pulled in and trapped between the sheave and the V-belt. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell in a produce cooler, hit his head, and sustained a broken nose. He was hospitalized.

An employee was installing an impact table on the south side of a conveyor. The impact table was resting on the conveyor rail. When the employee attempted to move the table, it fell off the side of the conveyor frame and dropped down, crushing his left index finger between the conveyor frame and the top of the impact table plate.
While switching a slurry strainer, an employee was struck by hot mash, receiving second/third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using an abrasive wheel to sharpen a tool when the wheel shattered and lacerated his hand.

An employee was pulling film out of the can that has a vacuum on top that pulls the waste film off of the line. The fan blades lacerated two fingers on the employee's left hand. A fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was on a utility pole, making repairs. An electric power line shocked the employee.
A temporary employee had an allergic reaction after being stung by a bee and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on the last step while walking down stairs, landing on the ground and suffering an injured right knee and a broken pelvis.
A hospital bed collapsed during a motor change, causing a severe laceration to an employee's left hand. The injury required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was setting up a drill press. The employee's shirt and hair were caught in the drill bit, causing injuries including a right ear injury, a broken left pinky finger and scalping.
An employee fell while walking down a hallway, breaking her left hip.
An employee fell while walking down a hall, breaking her left hip.
An excavator load struck an employee. The employee was knocked over onto a steel diaphragm, which caught the employee's leg and pinned it as the employee continued to fall. The leg was broken.
An employee was backing a stand-up reach truck into an aisle. His left thumb was pinched between a load beam and the truck.
An employee fell from a ladder to the floor about 9 feet below, suffering a broken wrist and a lacerated kidney.
An employee was securing a load on a tractor trailer. He fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was installing plywood/decking in a residential barn's attic. The employee fell to the ground about 14 feet below, suffering injuries to the back and arm, and was hospitalized.

A Tree Wizard, Inc., employee was helping remove a tree that had struck a power line. When he made the final cut on the tree, the line rolled under the log and struck him in the face. He suffered a fractured eye socket, a fractured skull, and multiple facial lacerations.

An employee was manually unloading sections of counterweight pipe. Each pipe had swiveling D-rings mounted on the ends to be used for lifting the pipes with slings. The employee's finger got caught between a D-ring and a pipe resulting in a partial finger amputation.
An employee had just stepped off a step ladder onto the floor when he caught his foot in a grated section of the floor and fell. He suffered an ankle injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a meat grinder when the auger caused partial amputations to three fingers on the employee's right hand.
An employee was driving a motorized pallet jack. The jack struck a stopped maintenance cart, and the employee's left ankle was crushed.

On August 31, 2020, an employee fell while walking up the three steps on a pop wrap machine. His head and shoulder struck the floor and he suffered a scalp laceration, a head contusion, and a fractured shoulder. He was hospitalized.
A forklift rolled backward over an employee's leg, causing fractures to the femur and the lower leg.

As a forklift backed out of a trailer, a strap on the trailer's wall caught the steering wheel of the forklift, causing a collision. The forklift's seat slid forward, and the drive suffered a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was walking across the manufacturing floor when a forklift ran over the employee's foot, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was lifting a portable generator out of the back of a truck with the help of another employee. The generator fell and the employee's left thumb was pinched between the frame and lifting handle. When the employee pulled his hand back, the tip of his left thumb was amputated.
An employee's hand was caught and lacerated by the blade inside a hopper box. The wound became infected.
An employee was feeding meat into a meat cuber when the employee's gloved fingers were pulled into the meat cuber, resulting in an amputation of the left index finger.
An employee cut the strap on a bundle of lumber and it collapsed on him, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee's right thumb was caught between a turnaround conveyor and a product guiderail. Half an inch of the thumb was amputated.

On August 31, 2020, an iron worker was installing a steel wall curtain while attached to the steel wall curtain approximately 12 feet from the ground. The steel wall curtain was on an overhead crane and employees were making ties at certain points. When the steel wall curtain was released by the crane it overturned and the iron worker was either struck by the steel wall curtain and/or struck an air compressor that was on the ground where he fell. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ribs.

An employee was on an ATV, monitoring plants and endangered species on a remote road. The ATV hit a rock and the employee fell off; the ATV then tumbled over the employee, who suffered a sore right leg, a sore lower back, and a spleen laceration.

An employee was operating a machine that worked with extruded plastic. The grinder attached to the machine became clogged and the employee stopped the machine to unclog the grinder. As he was clearing the jam, the grinder motor was still winding down and the still rotating blades inside the equipment amputated multiple fingers.

An employee was using a handheld grinder to cut an angle iron when the cutting blade became trapped between two pieces of metal and jumped back, cutting his right index finger to the bone. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cleaning a meat slicer in the kitchen area that was powered off when his left middle finger struck the blade, resulting in a partial finger amputation (skin only).

On 8/31/2020, a Noble Casing, Inc., employee was on location performing rathole operations. A nearby skid steer operator was unloading a joint of pipe from a trailer and had the pipe elevated while backing to clear the bunks. The pipe then slid off the skid steer forks and trapped the employee between the pipe and trailer. The employee suffered a dislocated left elbow, broken left femur, single vertebra fracture, and bleeding in the brain, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An excavator's track caught an employee's left leg as the excavator backed up.
An employee's left middle finger was pinched in the dust collector of a mixer. The finger was partially amputated.
A customer punched an employee, who hit his head on the ground (causing contusions) and lost consciousness.
An employee was cutting a two-by-four with a powered circular saw. The wood pinched the blade, causing the saw to kick back and amputate the employee's right little fingertip.
An employee fell while climbing down a 5-foot A-frame ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a broken right lower leg.
An employee tripped over uneven sidewalk pavement and fell onto steps, suffering a broken left arm.

An employee was doing masonry work from a scaffold. A board dislodged when the employee stepped on it; the employee fell through the scaffolding to the ground about 12 to 15 feet below, suffering a head injury requiring staples, a left leg injury that required stitches, and a broken/sprained foot . The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while climbing down an A-frame ladder, landing on the ground about 3-5 feet below and suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee's right middle finger was amputated above the knuckle by the blade inside an edge band trimmer.
Material was being loaded in a metal building laminating machine. The machine's saw blade came off, cutting an employee's foot.
An employee was turning a motorized pallet jack. The employee's left hand came into contact with steel shelving, which severed the employee's left little finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing onto a frack pump. He fell to the ground about 5 feet below, suffering a broken arm.
An employee was operating a pneumatic press when it crushed his right middle and ring fingers.
An employee started exhibiting signs of heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was helping another employee replace a fire hydrant. After lunch the employee became ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was repairing a bucket loader in a maintenance shop. A jack kicked out, striking him in the head and knocking him to the floor. He suffered a skull fracture.
An employee was handling pieces of flat steel bar when they fell on his foot, crushing the foot and causing a laceration.
An employee was rolling pipe by hand on jack stands when a section of pipe rolled off the jack stands. The pipe pinned the employee's right hand and amputated the ring, middle, and index fingers.
An employee was operating a punch press when the press came down on both of the employee's hands. The employee sustained the amputation of three fingers on each hand.
An employee tripped over a box of tiles while walking down an aisle. She suffered injuries to the right wrist and left knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was moving sows. As he moved through a doorway, the wind caught the door and slammed it shut on his right middle finger. He suffered a partial amputation of the last joint.
An employee was working on the wind farm and received an electric shock from a cattle gate. He was hospitalized, suffering from dizziness and a low heart rate.

An employee  was moving drums in the bed of a pickup. He fell from the tailgate, landing on his back and striking his head on the concrete ground. He suffered a contusion to the back of the head and bleeding in the brain.

At approximately 4:00 p.m. on September 1, 2020, an employee was closing a delivery truck door after unloading it. The truck pulled away and the employee jumped down to the ground between the truck and the dock. She was hospitalized.
An employee was going down stairs at the end of her shift when she fell and broke her ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
A mechanic was performing maintenance on an exhaust blower when his finger got caught in a belt/pulley. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee had climbed on a tire to change a windshield wiper blade when the employee slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a head injury that required hospitalization.

At around 4:40 AM, two employees were hooking up an air compressor to the back of a pickup truck. Due to wet weather, the injured employee's hand slipped, causing the end of the compressor to fall, pinching his left middle finger between the arm of the compressor hitch and the top of his boot. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the middle fingertip.

The injured employee was helping another employee change the propane tank on the dock sweeper. The tank was leaking and when the injured employee tried to start the sweeper, a large flame burned both of his arms and legs.

An employee was charging an aluminum furnace by adding a solid aluminum ingot into the molten aluminum bath. When the ingot was added, an explosion occurred and the employee sustained burns to multiple parts of the body.
An employee was observing the patient monitors and experienced an allergic reaction, possibly caused by the cleaner that is used on the monitors.

An employee working as a cashier near the drive-thru window experienced heat exhaustion and collapsed while walking to the walk-in cooler. The employee struck their head during the fall which resulted in a concussion and seizure.
An employee was returning collected garbage to the lay-down site at the end of his shift when he  started cramping up. The employee was taken to the hospital where he was treated for dehydration.

An employee was lining a hydraulic cylinder up with the eye (opening). The hydraulic cylinder was attached to a 300-pound crush plate and was supported by a pry bar. The pry bar slipped out and the cylinder dropped, pinching his right middle finger and causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing to remove a film roll from a chuck. The roll was pulled and the first employee's right index finger was caught between the roll and a cradle. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
Two employees were moving a VFD on rollers when it tilted on them. One employee suffered a leg fracture. The other employee suffered a hip fracture. Both were hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning around a blower machine and noticed labels stuck inside. She was attempting to remove the labels when her left index finger was caught in the belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was placing a post to support a stair landing when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, injuring his side and right arm.

On September 1, 2020, at approximately 8:00 p.m., an employee was working on conduit for a new installation from the platform of a scissor lift that was not yet elevated when it came in contact with (and was dragged by) a rotary dryer. The employee was crushed between the scissor lift and the rotary blower, suffering fractures on his mandible, clavicle, and right orbital bone. He was hospitalized.

An employee was greasing the chain on a machine when the lubricating hose of the grease device became caught on the chain and sprocket, pulling the employee's right hand into the chain and sprocket. As a result, the employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
After making a delivery to a customer's address, an employee began to feel pain in their lower back due to dehydration.
An employee was mopping the floor when she slipped on the wet floor and fell. The employee sustained a broken femur.

An employee was walking into a filler room and started to step up on the threshold of the door but he slipped and fell, landing on his knee. He was hospitalized and required surgery for a broken left kneecap.
An employee was on an H-pile in the center span of a bridge, walking towards the pier cap to retrieve his water bottle. The employee went to step up and stumbled onto rebar which impaled him.

On September 1, 2020, at around 10:00 AM, an employee was pulling wire. He had a hoist on the conductor. As he was pulling slack, his hand slipped off the handle and the handle hit him in the face. The employee sustained swelling to the eyes and nose.
While standing on a step stool to clean a mirror, an employee fell backward onto a hard surface and suffered a back injury.

On September 1, 2020, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was getting ready to clean hot water and resin from a strainer when a bolt became loose as he was standing over the system. He was then sprayed with hot material through the cap on top of system. He received first and second degree burns on his right and left thighs, lower body, right and left arms, abdomen, chest, and left ear and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing lime from the interior wall of a holding tank while working from a baker-style scaffold. A section of lime fell and struck the side of the scaffold causing it to tip over. The employee fell to the ground approximately 5 feet below and sustained fractures to both wrists.
A temporary employee was wiping/cleaning a conveyor belt in the blending room when her right arm got caught between the rollers and the belt. The employee sustained a fracture to the right forearm.

An employee had dropped a roll of change by the pizza cabinet and bent down to pick it up. While standing back up he struck the back of his head on the bottom edge of an open drawer and sustained a laceration/contusion.

An employee was driving a pallet mover around a corner in the warehouse when she fell off the mover and was dragged by the mover and then crushed against nearby racking. She sustained abdominal injuries.
An employee was using a grinder to modify a 10" pipe when the grinder kicked back and lacerated the employee's upper thigh.
An employee was on a work platform located on the second level of a printing press when they slipped and fell backward onto the working surface. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was cutting a board on a table saw. The board kicked back and the employee's right ring finger was partially amputated by the blade.

An employee was putting a bend channel in a sheet of metal using a press brake. The brake actuated and the sheet metal rose up against the brake die, smashing the employee's fingers between the brake die and the sheet metal. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left middle finger at the last joint.
After working with 2-by-4s in direct sunlight, an employee became overheated and started cramping. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and dehydration.
While working from an aerial lift, an employee came into contact with an overhead energized line. The employee was shocked and suffered a burn to the hand.
An employee was using a stressing jack when hydraulic fluid blew through a pin hole in the hydraulic hose of the jack and entered his left-hand palm.
An employee was replacing a bearing. The employee was using an air chisel to help remove the bearing from the brace when a piece of metal broke off and struck the employee's right eye.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on a medium volt switchgear. The employee began to wipe the area with a rag and sustained an electric shock (13,800 volts) to the left arm. The employee was hospitalized and has second degree burns on six percent of their body.
An employee was changing a heat print ribbon when the print wheel was lowered onto the wire. The rolling wheel crushed the employee's left index finger, causing an open tuft fracture.
A mechanic was servicing a vehicle. As he moved the grating to the underside of the car, his finger got caught in the grating. The fingertip was medically amputated.

On September 2, 2020, an employee was sliding up an interactive whiteboard when it detached from the wall. It fell about 3 feet and knocked the employee to the ground. She suffered a broken hip and/or femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a meat tenderizer machine, feeding small pieces of beef into the machine from the top opening. The machine became jammed with product and the employee suffered a partial amputation of the right ring finger while trying to clear the jam.

An employee was leaning over the laser sensors using his finger to check that a part was not rotating in the pipe bending machine when he slipped and fell into the clamp on the machine. The employee's right index fingertip was amputated.
While walking across the parking lot, an employee tripped on a section of raised asphalt and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured upper right arm.
An employee was lifting boxes weighing 27.8 lbs. to stack on a pallet and suffered a back strain.
An employee was clearing a jammed piece of cardboard packaging from a machine when the cutter engaged and amputated her fingertip.

A temporary employee was guiding the mult coil (over 2000 lbs.) that was being placed onto the uncoiler machine with a crane. The employee was standing behind the mult coil while the crane operator maneuvered to position the load onto the uncoiler machine. The crane operator was not able to position the mult coil onto the uncoiler machine so it was placed back on the ground. It was unbalanced and fell. The employee was struck by the mult coil and fell to the ground. In the process the employee's right hand was caught between the mult coil and uncoiler machine and crushed. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

When an employee turned the control on the robotic extruder machine to auto the sensor on the gate malfunctioned and allowed the robot to operate. The robot swung and hit the employee on the right side causing broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was unloading a trailer. The employee was pulling a pallet jack out of the trailer when it went onto their left foot resulting in the amputation of a toe.
A UPS driver became ill after completing his work day and was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
A utility van door closed on an employee's right thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding paper into the plate machine when his left index finger was caught in a pinch point and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working in the fabrication shop when he tripped and his left arm struck a piece of sheet metal. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery for a severed artery and tendon in his left arm.

An employee was working in trench when one side of the trench caved in, pinning the employee under the soil. The employee sustained a broken wrist, dislocated jaw, fractured collarbone, and broken ribs.

The owner and an employee were standing on the ground as wooden roof trusses were being prepared to be reset in the correct position. The trusses fell in a domino effect on top of both. The owner was hospitalized for a fractured leg and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized for fractured legs.
An employee was working on the first floor of a residential home when sheet rock from the second floor fell on the employee's foot, crushing it.
An employee was carrying a large stock pot of hot water from the stove to the sink when he lost his balance, slipped, and fell. The hot water spilled on and burned his body.
An employee was restraining a dog when it bit the employee's left arm.

On 9/02/2020, at 12:10 PM, an employee was picking a case in an aisle behind a high-lift forklift. The forklift backed up and caught the employee against the rack. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee was overcome by heat while working on an aluminum sow production line.
An employee was cleaning a noodle jam on a conveyor. Her left ring fingertip was caught between the conveyor belt and the transfer plate and amputated.

An employee was operating a reach truck. As the employee steered into an aisle, the reach truck was headed for a rack and the employee jumped off the truck. His left leg was pinned between the truck and the rack, resulting in hospitalization for a broken left leg that required surgery.
An employee tripped over a grocery cart's wheel and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was stepping off a forklift. The employee's left foot was crushed between the forklift and a railing, and the little toe was amputated.

An employee was assembling a mobile container that was to be used as an office. Employees were lifting the second half of the container when it fell on the injured employee. The injured employee's leg was pinned to the ground resulting in a right leg fracture.

An employee was performing work on a bridge from a platform that was elevated by a crawler crane. The platform got entangled and the employee was caught between the bridge and the platform. He sustained a crushing injury requiring amputation.

An employee returned to the scale house after dumping at the landfill. He parked his vehicle on the ramp. As he stepped out of the truck, he missed the ramp and fell onto the concrete sidewalk. His left hip fractured.
An employee began having stomach pains while tossing packages on a conveyor. The employee was later hospitalized with a hernia.
Employees were turning a well back on. An employee was standing next to a tester when a flex line failed under pressure and blew, striking and fracturing the employee's left collarbone and jaw.
An employee was moving office furniture. The employee's right middle finger was caught between a cabinet and a pallet, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cutting PVC pipes with a chop saw. The saw cut off the tip of his right middle finger (with no bone loss) as he was readjusting the pipes. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was hitching a trailer to a truck. The trailer rolled and the hitch fell onto the employee's foot and amputated a toe.
While delivering groceries, an employee begin to feel light headed and dizzy. The employee was hospitalized for heat related illness.
A scaffold frame was being moved from one location to another when it fell onto an employee's foot and fractured it.
An employee suffered a broken finger when a steel drum fell on his right ring finger.
An employee was testing a three-way actuated valve assembly. When the ball cycled, it closed on the employee's left hand, amputating the tips of his middle and ring fingers.
An employee fell while cleaning animal cages, suffering a cut to the back of the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a 4x4 section of lumber with a radial arm saw. The lumber kicked up and pushed her hand towards the saw blade. The employee sustained a laceration on the left pinky and middle fingers and injury to the left ring finger requiring amputation.

An employee was brushing the inside of a cooker. The lid of another, nearby cooker came open; hot peanut oil and steam sprayed out and caused second-degree burns to the employee's arms, neck, and face.
An employee was loading bagels from a table when his finger got stuck in the gap between work tables. When he pulled away he sustained a partial amputation of the left middle finger.

An employee was on a flatbed truck and was using a center-mounted conveyor belt. As the employee was loading a cube of foam insulation onto the conveyor belt, the cube rolled back onto the truck. The employee stepped to the side to avoid the cube and fell 52 inches off the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a broken right leg and a bruised right shoulder.
An employee was using a bandsaw to trim ribs. The saw cut his left hand, amputating four fingers.
An employee was placing traffic cones at a construction site and was stung by an insect. The employee suffered an allergic reaction.

An employee was performing maintenance work to change/inspect a belt on a blower motor. The employee was removing/inspecting the v-belt from a motor/fan drive sheave and as he was rolling the belt off the sheave his left ring finger got caught between the belt and the sheave resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was running a re-winder machine when the speed of the machine increased. The employee then slowed down the speed and also tried to stop the re-winding process. The employee's arm was pulled into the printing press resulting in a fracture to the forearm.
An employee fell onto pavement from an unknown height and hit her head. The employee was hospitalized with head injuries including bleeding from the brain.

An employee was accessing the chipper conveyor via the sliding door. The employee grabbed the left sliding door with both hands. As he slid the left door open, he pinched his left middle finger between the left door and the right door. The employee suffered an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking in the hallway, slipped and fell. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was using a pneumatic nail gun to build wood pallets when their left thigh was impaled by a nail.

An employee was cutting wood with a foot-operated knot saw when his hand caught on a splinter and was pulled toward the saw. The employee suffered a laceration to his left-hand middle finger and amputation of the tip of his left-hand index finger.
An employee fell from a pull-down ladder at a house, landing on the ground and suffering a head injury.
An employee was working a bag machine (filling station) when his left index finger was caught in a chain and sprocket. The fingertip was partially amputated.

The injured employee was assisting another worker at ground level to rig pieces of precast concrete. The injured employee experienced chills, dizziness, and thirst and was hospitalized with heat exhaustion/dehydration.
An employee tripped while stepping down from his truck. He fell to the cement ground and hit his head, suffering a concussion.
An employee was making repairs on a jacket line using a forklift. The employee's left thumb was caught between the forklift's forks and a clamp. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was moving a steel coil when he was struck by the moving coil and became momentarily pinned against a stationary coil. The employee was hospitalized with a crushing injury.

On September 3, 2020, an employee was working on the roof's edge attempting to insert a rivet while installing gutters. A high power electrical line was located about 2 feet from the edge of the roof where the employee was working. A power surge caused the power to jump off the line entering the employee's head and exiting through his right arm.

An employee was being trained on transferring acid from one tanker truck to another. He was connecting hoses and fittings between the trucks when nitric acid from the open end of one of the lines splashed onto his right arm. The employee was hospitalized for third degree chemical burns to 2.5% of the employee's right arm.
An employee was framing using a nail gun. The nail gun fractured bones in his right hand.

An employee exited the cab of a cab-over style front-loading waste truck before the truck had come to a complete stop. When his foot came in contact with the ground, the employee lost balance and fell. The passenger side front tire ran over his left heel and right foot. The employee sustained a fracture and degloving injury to his right foot and a laceration to the heel of his left foot.
An employee was attempting to cover the feed trailer with a tarp. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete slab and fractured their pelvis.
An employee left his area of the aircraft carrier after lunch and was noticed stumbling and moving side to side as he walked. The employee sustained heat stroke and an acute kidney injury.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor near a fry station, suffering a broken left hand, left arm, left hip, and femur.
An employee was pushing a hand truck through a freezer entrance. He slipped on ice and the cart crushed the fingers on his right hand, severing fingertips.

An employee had been operating a forklift. While releasing a dumper trash hopper into a dumpster, the employee's finger became trapped in the base of the trash hopper. The left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee had been preparing a grave site. He collapsed due to heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.

On September 4, 2020, an employee was performing sanitation duties on a horizontal auger when their left arm became caught in the auger. The employee sustained an amputation to the left arm above the elbow.
An employee went to change the laundry in a client's home and slipped in 3 inches of water that had leaked from the client's washer. The employee sustained a broken ankle and foot.
An employee missed the first step of a two-step ladder and fell 9 inches to the floor, sustaining two broken ribs and a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

After making repairs to an air conditioning system, an employee was testing the system and sustained a 460-volt shock. The employee was hospitalized with burns on the left pinky finger and internal burns in the shoulders.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, fracturing his hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a band saw to cut oxtails when their right index finger contacted the blade resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cleaning a brick machine when their glove was caught in a chain/sprocket assembly. A finger was partially amputated.

An employee was removing electrical conduits and a junction box from the exterior of a building. While on a 12-foot A-frame ladder, the employee removed the cover from the junction box and was loosening the anchor bolts within the empty junction box when the entire box and six conduit pipes broke free from the wall and struck the ladder. The ladder tipped over and the employee fell approximately 9 to 10 feet onto the asphalt ground, breaking his ankle. The conduit pipes then fell on him. The broken ankle required surgery.
An employee stepped onto a box that was on a pallet in order to scan items on a top shelf. The employee lost balance and fell to the floor, sustaining a right leg injury.
An employee was caught between a moving tractor and a towed planter. He suffered broken ribs and contusions to his feet.
An employee was straightening a stack of glass sheets when a piece of glass lacerated his left wrist.

An employee was standing next to a golf cart when it was struck by a high lift fork truck. The golf cart then struck the employee in the upper thigh, causing internal bleeding and possibly deep bruising.

An employee was using a towel to dry tire rims on a vehicle that had just exited the car wash. After stopping at the bump stop, the vehicle began to slowly roll backwards. When this occurred the employee's right ring finger became stuck in the tire rim and  amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee was changing a forklift battery. When the battery was dropped, the employee's left ring finger was caught between the battery and the battery box and amputated.
An employee was feeding wood stock into a table saw and sustained an amputation injury (bone chip) to their left thumb.

On September 4, 2020, a welder operator was training a new employee on how to operate a robotic welder. The machine actuated while his left hand was in it, resulting in a partial amputation of the little finger.
An employee was clearing some plastic caught in a conveyor and auto wrapping station. A roller cut off the tip of his right index finger.
An employee was positioning storm drain grates on the back of a truck. A grate dropped on the employee's left hand, amputating the little finger below the first knuckle.
An employee was driving a forklift when the forklift impacted with a stationary forklift, leading to a crushed forearm.
An employee was tacking metal deck and fell 18 feet through the metal deck roof. The employee sustained injuries to his pelvis and right arm and facial lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.

At around 2:00 AM, an employee was troubleshooting low suction on a housekeeping vacuum system. The employee was clearing a blockage when a rotary valve in the chute under the dust silo hopper closed and amputated his right index fingertip.
A delivery driver was investigating a jammed loading dock door at a store when the door came down onto his finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee fell from a 10-foot ladder to the ground, landing on his right side and suffering a broken right elbow, wrist, and forearm.

An employee was manually adjusting a block of frozen product on a conveyor, when his right middle finger was caught between the block and the frame causing a fracture and laceration to his right middle finger that required surgery.
While carrying trash to a dumpster, an employee slipped on mud and fell to the concrete. The employee suffered a broken humerus.

An employee was operating a loaded pallet jack. While exiting a trailer onto an elevated dock lift, momentum from the load caused the front wheels to go off the dock lift. The employee then jumped, or fell off, and sustained a bruised knee.
An employee was loading a van for delivery when his arm was caught by the back of a box truck operating by the side. The employee suffered an arm fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the height of the landing gear leg on a trailer. The employee's left index finger was inside the pin hole when the leg slipped, amputating the fingertip.

While wrapping a bundle of board games on a pallet an employee jumped up to tap a box into position. The employee landed on their feet, but fell to the concrete floor and sustained a broken right femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was using an electric grinder when it cut the employee's left forearm.

An employee was walking on a scaffold plank when the plank shifted or collapsed, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured shoulder and compressed back disks.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake while pulling grass out of a rock border.
An employee was cooking beans and suffered burns to the stomach area.

On 9/5/2020, at approximately 10:40 a.m., a Lowe's employee was making a delivery at a customer's home. The employee had positioned a washer on the lift gate of the delivery truck and was attempting to step around the washer when he fell off the lift gate, which was raised several feet off the ground. As the employee fell, he grabbed the washer and pulled it down on top of him. The washer landed on his abdomen. He was hospitalized with fractured ribs, a fractured C7 vertebra, and a head injury.

On the morning of 9/05/2020, an employee was using a water jet machine to clear a plugged sewer line. Around 11:48 AM, the jetter nozzle struck an obstacle in the line that caused it to change direction back toward the sewer line opening. Once the nozzle reached the opening of the manhole, the backjets sent the nozzle up the manhole. The nozzle struck the employee in the torso, knocked him over, and got caught in the clothes around his torso while still under pressure. The employee sustained puncture wounds from the pressurized water and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a panel drill when their free hand became trapped by the drill when it lowered. The employee required surgery to repair broken fingers and a nicked artery.

On 9/06/2020, a spud barge with an excavator was tied to a deck barge by two steel cables around timber heads, one forward and one aft. As the excavator was removing rock from the deck barge, the deck barge began to sway, creating more tension on the aft cable. At 1:00 PM, the cable slipped over a timber head on the spud barge, released, and struck an employee on the spud barge and propelled them overboard. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the left hand.

An employee had just finished repurposing chickens on a white tray that was sitting on the right side of a scale. He was moving the tray and stepping from the right to the left side of the scale when he twisted his left foot, heard a pop, and fell to the floor. He was hospitalized with a broken bone under his kneecap.

An employee was cleaning the exterior of a tank. While moving around the tank, the employee slipped into an uncovered trench drain 15 inches deep. The drain was clogged and full of margarine and hot water. The employee fell in a seated position with her feet in the drain. The employee was hospitalized for burns.

An employee had placed a package on a pallet and was returning to their position on the line when they tripped on the pallet and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left humerus, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

Employees were installing a new belt and buckets in a grain elevator. Two employees were struck by the belt and bucket assembly as it was being installed by crane when the rigging gave way. The first employee was hospitalized for a broken leg. The second employee sustained nerve damage to an arm and was hospitalized.
While making a client's bed, an employee tripped over the foot rest of a wheelchair and fell resulting in a broken hip. The employee's shoulder and knee were also injured.
An employee was using a meat slicing machine. The blade amputated the palmar surface of his right fingertip.

Company employees were onsite, cutting and dismantling components of the ammonia system in preparation for demolition. An employee was exposed to ammonia when he cut a line that still had ammonia left in the pipe. The employee was hospitalized due to respiratory system problems.
An employee slipped and fell. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was draining gas from a scrubber when a fire erupted and burned the employee's face and hands.

Two maintenance employees were inspecting the Omega coupling on the high melter pump. During inspection, the employees realized the shaft on the pump was broken rather than the coupling. The maintenance supervisor was going to locate a rebuilt seal assembly for the pump. The employees started removing the seal assembly from the pump. As one of the employees removed the base plate bolts from the pump, the head pressure from the high melter tank pushed the seal assembly out of the pump casing and hot sugar juice sprayed onto the employees causing first and second degree burns to the upper and lower arm, hand and chest areas.
Employees were loading a truck with ammonium hydroxide. A transfer line ruptured, spraying an employee. The employee suffered chemical burns to the face, neck, and chest area.
