At about 5:45 a.m. on September 7, 2020, an employee tripped and fell in a hallway, striking her head on the floor. She suffered a head injury, a bruise to the right elbow, and a skin tear on the finger. She was hospitalized.

An employee was working on the band side of a tire machine. The employee removed the empty A-frame and was pushing in the next A-frame when the top roll came back and pinched their hand between the adjustment nut of the top roll and the frame of the equipment. Half of the employee's left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was working with an unsteady patient who began to fall. As the employee attempted to catch the patient, the employee strained their back.

A maintenance technician was troubleshooting a heat transfer fluid (HTF) motor failure on the production line. While the motor was being removed, the technician was sprayed with hot HTF, resulting in burns to the hands, arms, and torso.

A graduate student was performing an experiment under a fume hood. Fumes from the acetone and the ether the student was using ignited and the employee suffered second-degree burns to the torso and hands.
On 9/07/2020, an employee was sitting at her desk. When she stood up to leave the desk, her left knee became entangled in computer wires. The employee fell and was hospitalized with a swollen knee.
An employee was having lunch and walking around a table when she tripped over the table and fell, sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was troubleshooting a leak from a hydraulic line when high pressure hydraulic fluid penetrated the skin on the employee's finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was pumping a hydraulic actuator when a concrete panel fell on the employee causing scrapes on the right side of the employee's back and the right ankle.
An employee was working with a crane when a bolt broke and the cheek plate fell off and struck his left leg. His leg was fractured in two places and required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was putting bottles in boxes on a production line. A carton became lodged in the taping portion of the carton erector. He was trying to unjam the carton when it ripped, causing his right hand to pass over the cutting mechanism and the protective cover on the cutting blade to pull back. The blade cut off the tip of his middle finger.
A crane was moving a load of sheeting. The load dropped, hit an elevated sand bank, and then struck an employee on the pelvis and pinned him. He suffered two broken vertebrae.

An employee was in a parked golf cart. He placed his feet on the ground beside the golf cart and grabbed the side of the cart to prepare his body to stand. As he stood up, he felt a pop in his right leg and fell over onto the ground. He was hospitalized with a broken femur in his right leg. His leg had a weakened bone due to a prosthetic from a previous amputation he had suffered.
An employee was working on a flat roof and began to feel unwell. He was hospitalized for dehydration.

A log was being loaded onto a truck with a grapple. Because of the log's size, the grapple operator could not see the back of the truck and needed assistance placing the log in the truck. An employee climbed onto the back of the truck in order to assist. The log started rotating as it was being placed onto the truck. When the employee jumped out of the way, their hand was pinched between the log and a part on the back of the truck. The employee's left pinky finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was hitching a trailer to a truck when their finger was amputated.

An employee was clipping bands to cables which involves partially hoisting the cables with a crane. During the hoist, the employee's left hand was pinched between the cables and a steel pin resulting in a partial amputation to the left thumb.
While walking through the plant, an employee was struck by a forklift and sustained a head injury.
An employee was pulling dough through the dough cutter blade when their right pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was removing a fracturing pump suction/discharge manifold. The discharge manifold shifted, and his right index finger was pinched between it and the suction manifold. The top part of the finger was amputated.
An employee fell from a ladder and sustained a compound leg fracture.
An employee tripped while walking and fell to the floor, hitting his head and injuring his hip.

An employee was trying to attach a hose to a fire hydrant to fill up a brush truck water tank. The force of the water through the hose knocked the employee off balance. He fell off the brush truck, landing about 6-7 feet below and suffering a broken left elbow.
Three firefighters were hospitalized for burns while fighting a forest fire.

An employee was retrieving boxes from the roof of an interior lab/office. The employee fell through the roof approximately 10 feet to the floor below. The employee suffered a fractured left femur and patella as well as head lacerations.

An employee was pulling jammed cartons off a track. The employee's middle finger got caught in a pinch point of a machine where the cartons out-feed, resulting in a partial amputation of the right middle finger.

An employee was in a trench that was approximately five feet deep, installing grout and bricks around a pipe that lead into a concrete drainage structure. The employee was between the concrete structure and a steel cave-in protection shield. An excavator was operating close to the trench and caused the steel shield to move, which pinned the employee's hip against the concrete structure. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.

An employee was cleaning a jam in a laminating machine when the tips of her glove were caught between the feed and snap rollers, pulling in her right hand and crushing her little, index, and ring fingers.
An employee removed the floor anchor bolts on an arbor press. While moving the press manually, it tipped over and struck the employee on the shin and ankle.
An employee tripped while walking up a hill, landing on their face and suffering a head injury.
An employee was tying a bungee cord when it came loose and struck his left eye resulting in the loss of the eye at the hospital.

An employee was milling beveled washers on a manual milling machine. As the employee was adjusting the washer, his left glove was caught by the shaft. His left pinky finger was lacerated and dislocated requiring surgery and hospitalization.
While trying to reestablish a powerline connection, an employee came into contact with an energized line and suffered second- and third-degree burns to both arms and hands.
An employee was repairing an air bag used in barge construction. A steel beam hit the employee's hardhat, forcing his mouth/jaw into another beam. He suffered an injury to the mouth/jaw.
An employee was working rods up and down. His left hand was between the bottom clamp and the rod rotator when the rod rotator fell down, smashing and fracturing his left thumb and index finger.
An employee's limb was pinned between a 12,000-pound transformer and a bucket truck. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when a second forklift ran into him. His left foot was caught between both forklifts and injured.
An employee's finger was caught between the door and door-frame of an entryway while entering the building. The distal end of the left middle finger was amputated.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw when his hands slipped and contacted the saw blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading a truck when he tripped over a pallet and fell from the raised gate to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken wrist and pelvis.
An employee was drilling a hole in a can containing aerosol spray glue. The can exploded, causing second-degree burns to the employee's arms, face, and neck.
An employee was cleaning out grease traps when hot grease got into her gloves. The employee was hospitalized with third degree burns and required surgery.

An employee was loading corrugated sheets into a box former from a 24" platform beside the equipment. As he was descending from the platform, he swung under the top rail to the floor and momentarily lost his balance. His right hand then entered the maintenance access opening on the backside of the box former, resulting in a partial digit amputation at the middle phalanx of the right index finger.
An employee was outdoors carrying equipment to locate pipelines when he started cramping. He was hospitalized for possible dehydration.

Employees were using a forklift to lift a mower deck off a truck. The mower deck slid off the forks, pinning the employee's arm against the truck and breaking it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee entered the subfloor to survey the area before submitting a plan for repair. There is a submersible pump and an electrical outlet for the pump to plug into under the subfloor. The employee touched an electrical source and sustained an electrical shock. The employee sustained a burn injury, internal damage, and was rendered unconscious. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing an underground 7,200-volt utility cable. The cable shocked the employee, causing electrical burns on the torso and stomach area and an exit wound on the left foot.
An employee was loading a trolley full of plants onto a truck. The trolley rolled off the truck and the employee was pulled over with it, falling to the ground and suffering a broken left tibia.
An employee was lifting a steel coil roll onto the 220-ton press when the strap broke and the coil dropped onto his left shin. The employee's leg was amputated.
An employee was performing fire watch duty when she walked backward and tripped over a fire extinguisher that was staged on the ground. She fractured two bones right above her ankle.
An employee was unloading a flatbed truck. He fell off the truck onto the ground, injuring his ankle, and was hospitalized.
An employee was chipping concrete with a rivet buster when an object struck his eye, tearing his cornea. He was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was helping to put guardrails around a barge when he fell onto the steel floor, breaking his jaw bone and busting his lip.

On September 9, 2020, an employee was attempting to start a vibrating tamper in order to continue compacting backfill material in a completed excavation. The employee pulled the starter cord multiple times. After the pull which started the engine, the pull cord of the vibrating tamper did not recoil correctly. The employee gathered the excess cord in his left hand in order to prevent an additional slip, trip, or fall hazard. When he engaged the throttle of the machine with his right hand, the pull cord retracted, wrapped around the employee s left thumb, and caused a partial amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was setting up a canning line to package sliced beets. While checking to see if any food was stuck from sanitation, the employee's index finger contacted the rotating metal vanes of the rotary valve resulting in amputation.
An employee was attempting to grab a can of corn from a palletizer when the magnetic palletizer arm came down and partially amputated the top of the employee's left index finger.
While climbing a ladder to go to the roof, an employee was stung by a bee. The employee had an allergic reaction and was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking, landing on the floor and suffering a broken left elbow.
An employee was using a magnet to flip a gear when the magnet disengaged from the part and fell on the employee's hand causing three broken fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been dealing with a trespasser and had the police onsite. She also had a verbal altercation with a vendor. The employee then suffered cardiac distress.
An employee was working from a scaffold when he lost his balance and fell 10 feet through the guard rail to the ground. He fractured his skull.

An employee was attempting to move the cooling drum away from the blancher when their foot slipped causing their right thumb to get caught between the blancher drum and pasta chute while the drum was rotating counter clockwise. The employee sustained the amputation of the right thumb above the first knuckle and was hospitalized.
An employee was attacked by a dog while delivering a package. The employee suffered multiple bites and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting wood with a bandsaw. The saw blade lacerated the employee's right middle and ring fingers and fractured a middle joint and ligament.
An employee was on a ladder performing house wrapping. The employee fell from the ladder and landed on the ground. The employee's right knee was injured and possibly broken.

An employee was cleaning the paw picker while holding the lid of the machine open. The lid fell onto the employee's hand resulting in a cut on the right index finger that became infected and required surgery.
An employee was troubleshooting an inoperative 277-volt light relay. The employee made contact with an energized component and received an electric shock and burns.
While using a band saw to cut meat, an employee sustained a cut tendon, a fractured bone, and a possible amputation.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slipped out from under him. He fell 5-7 feet to the floor below, suffering a head laceration, a broken wrist, and a possible spleen injury.
An employee fell to the floor while walking, suffering a broken left humerus and right tibia.

The injured employee was stepping aside to allow another employee to pass by. The injured employee's shoelaces got caught in the metal lace hooks of their planted boot. The employee lost balance, fell to the concrete floor, and sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was feeding a cage sheet into a roller and became entangled in the cage sheet pulling his right arm into the roller. The employee suffered a broken right ring finger and wrist.

A mechanic was replacing a flat tire on an over-the-road container chassis. While pushing the tire into position on the rear chassis axle, the new tire's rim shot off and struck the mechanic's left leg breaking the tibia.

An employee climbed up a stepladder to paint when the stepladder moved/shifted and the employee fell 4 to 6 feet onto a steel surface. The employee was hospitalized with a broken shoulder, broken pelvis, and bruised spleen.
On September 10, 2020, an employee fell from a ladder to the ground, resulting in hospitalization for back injuries.
An employee slipped on a wet, concrete floor and fell to the ground fracturing their right kneecap.

On September 10, 2020, an employee was leaving work when she slipped on the surface of a handicap ramp that was wet from rain. She hit the ground and fractured her knee, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was directing crane operations. Other employees were welding an H-beam together for the ring beam. The apparatus used to twist the 30-foot H-beam failed and the beam fell off the fixture onto the employee's right leg. The leg was crushed below the knee resulting in a surgical amputation.
An employee was operating a standup forklift and struck a steel beam. The employee's leg was crushed between the beam and the forklift resulting in amputation of the foot above the ankle.
An employee was digging and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was using a band to pull pallets of cans off a truck when the band snapped, causing the employee to fall backwards onto the floor. The employee suffered a fractured left arm and hand.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. The forklift crushed his left foot against a cement wall.

An employee was trying to change a tooth on a saw blade. A pin on the tool the employee was using broke, and the employee's right middle finger came into contact with another tooth. The employee suffered an amputation affecting the side of the finger and the nail, with bone loss.

An employee was attempting to connect a trailer to a ball hitch. He slid his fingers into the trailer receiver around the ball hitch when the receiver slid down, amputating his left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was attempting to disentangle the wire in a rewind machine when the wire caused a partial amputation to the employee's left thumb tip.

An employee was loading a paper roll onto a machine using a pneumatic powered dolly. The employee's hand was caught between a stationary roll of paper on the floor and the roll of paper they were moving. The employee suffered an avulsion to the hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the hallway, slipped on the wet tile floor, and hit her head, right side and right knee.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to offload a delivery truck at a loading dock. The pallet jack's front wheels retracted and the employee's left ring finger was caught in the pinch point. The employee suffered a fracture and amputation to the last joint of the finger.
An employee was lifting a piece of sheet metal from a shear. The metal fell and lacerated his left forearm.
An employee was unloading tiles on a rooftop when he slipped and fell 9 feet off the roof to the ground floor, breaking his heel. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting an 18-inch detention system manifold supported on a metal sawhorse. When the employee rolled the part from vertical to horizontal, the pipe side of the manifold slipped off his hand. His left ring finger was pinched between the pipe and the sawhorse and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was flushing the line of a machine. Her earplug fell into the bowl and when she went to retrieve it, the blades amputated her right index fingertip.
An employee was slicing deli meat and amputated the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was adjusting a hydraulic press machine to push out a seal. The employee was moving the piece to be pressed when a second employee initiated the press to start the process to remove the seal. The ram came down and amputated the tip of the left little finger.
While working in a crane truck, an employee lost balance and fell out of the bed of the truck, suffering injuries to the wrist and arms that required surgery.
An employee was lifting a box that weighed about 50 lbs. out of the back of his truck and dropped it on his foot. He experienced a loss of feeling in his foot and was hospitalized.

On September 10, 2020, an employee was working from an 8-foot portable step ladder when the ladder became unstable and the employee fell to the ground. The employee suffered a dislocated clavicle and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a battery operated cut-off saw to cut a hole in the steel deck when the saw ran out of battery. Another employee was going to retrieve a new battery, stepped onto the cut section, and fell through to the concrete deck approximately 21 feet below. The injured employee was hospitalized for a broken leg, pelvis, arm and ribs, a punctured lung and internal bleeding.

An employee was returning to her work area within the office using crutches. Her crutch slipped on a tiled portion of the floor. The employee caught herself from falling with the leg that had the pre-existing injury. She was hospitalized for muscle trauma to the upper right leg.
An employee was moving a single manlift. As the employee tilted the lift backward, it fell on him and fractured his left ankle and injured his right knee.

On September 10, 2020, at approximately 11:00 a.m., an employee was installing a fire alarm system from a ladder when he fell 20 feet to the pavement below. He was hospitalized with head and clavicle injuries.
An employee was using an angle grinder when it kicked back and lacerated the employee's forearm, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was dismounting from a crane, missed the hand rail, and fell to the hanger floor. The employee sustained a broken right arm.
An employee developed an inguinal hernia while lifting a set of hoses.
An employee was pushing a tile cart that was on an automated track into a dryer. The employee got caught between two carts and was struck by a cart. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee was climbing up a ladder to look at a roof and give an estimate when the employee fell off the ladder.
An employee tripped on the base of a wall and fell. She sustained a fractured right arm and a dislocated right wrist.
An employee was walking into the facility after a break, tripped on curbing, fell, and fractured their right arm.
An employee was replacing manhole covers in the road and was struck by a passing car. The employee suffered a concussion and a broken back and was hospitalized.

An employee was doing electrical work inside a house under construction. An excavator broke a gas pipe behind the house, possibly exposing the employee to natural gas. The employee suffered shortness of breath and dizziness and was hospitalized.
An employee of Corbon's, Inc., was using a bandsaw to cut meat when his hand slipped and made contact with the saw blade, resulting in the amputation of his left index finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was climbing an outside mounted ladder to access the roof on a commercial property. The ladder detached from the building and the employee fell to the ground, suffering leg and foot injuries. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was flagging drivers in a work zone on a public highway. He was struck by a spray truck that was moving in reverse while applying tar during a tar and chip paving operation. The employee suffered trauma to the left side, broken vertebrae, a punctured lung, and trauma to internal organs.
An employee was preparing a pre-trip on his forklift. Another forklift was moving pallets and backed into the employee causing a broken pelvis and internal bleeding.

The injured employee was aligning a crane girder at the gas compressor building using a 10-ton hydraulic ram and three steel wedges. The employee was removing the last wedge using an 8-pound sledgehammer as another employee stood on the concrete off to the left side holding a tool tether attached to the wedge with python tape. As the injured employee was backing out the last wedge from the right side via a sledgehammer, the wedge unexpectedly came out from in between the column and the shim, striking the injured employee on the lower left leg and fracturing it.
An employee was struck by a forklift and suffered a head injury.

An employee was injured on September 11, 2020, while pushing down on the support arm of an unloading device while a second employee was cranking it up. The injured employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.
On September 11, 2020, an employee tripped over an outlet in the floor while walking backwards. The employee suffered a fractured right hip and sprained shoulder, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was pulling wrap from the machine when a finger was caught by the crimper resulting in amputation of the distal phalanx and distal aspect of the middle phalanx.

An employee was retrieving a tool that had fallen into a foam conveyor line. The employee fell into the conveyor line and was stuck between the heated blowout manifold and the conveyor, suffering burns and broken ribs.
An employee tripped and fell while stepping up onto a stoop, injuring her right arm and left leg.
A trailer was being loaded with crane mats and precast concrete barriers. An employee was caught between the crane mats and an excavator and suffered bruising to the hips and buttocks.

An employee was building a deck. When he approached the edge while installing screws, he fell about 10 feet to the ground. He suffered a left arm/elbow fracture and a right wrist fracture and a possible hip injury.
An employee was cleaning a food processor when its blade amputated the tip of a finger on his right hand.
While collecting garbage, an employee stepped off the garbage truck and was crossing the street when a pickup truck struck the employee. The employee suffered head and hip injuries.
An employee fell from the roof of a steel building to the concrete floor and was hospitalized with a bruised eye, busted lip, and facial scratches.
An employee fell 40 feet from a tree that he had been pruning. He suffered a broken back, broken neck, and a separated shoulder.

On September 11, 2020, an employee was hospitalized after their right ring finger was caught in a jammed garage door near the compactor as it was being forced closed with the forks of a forklift. The finger was lacerated.
A rolling cart struck an employee who was making a delivery. The employee suffered a leg injury.

At 9:58 a.m. on September 11, 2020, an employee was installing HVAC duct in a ceiling at a new-construction single-story house. The employee fell from an attic area to the floor 9 feet below, suffering a fractured skull and losing consciousness. The employee was hospitalized.

Two temporary employees were cleaning up trash in the work area. As they were transporting the trash to the trashcan using a utility vehicle (UTV), the UTV rolled over. The driver sustained a concussion and head laceration and was hospitalized. The passenger was not injured.

An employee was troubleshooting a tree sprayer with a full tank while on the boat dock at a pond. The sprayer released a chemical for the control of cyanobacteria and algae onto the employee and another employee. Both employees were hospitalized for injuries sustained including corneal abrasion, bilateral conjunctivitis, and chemical burns.
An employee suffered an asthma attack in an area that was being mopped.
A security guard was punched in the face, suffering a broken jaw.
A teacher lost their footing while walking in a classroom and fell. The teacher suffered a broken ankle that required surgery.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a conveyor using a rag. The rag got caught on a live chain drive and pulled the employee's right index finger into the chain drive resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was trying to muzzle a dog. The dog bit the employee's right hand and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was building pallets using a nail gun. He tripped on a board on the floor, and the gun shot a nail through his hand.

An employee was preparing a steel sheet for loading by placing it onto the floor. After being tilted to the side, the sheet fell onto the employee's legs and broke the employee's left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
On September 12, 2020, an employee was attempting to remove jammed material from a click press when the machine amputated their left index, middle and ring fingers at the phalanx.
An employee was closing a gate. His middle and ring fingertips were caught between the gate and its guide wheel and amputated.
An employee was adjusting a cutter when the machine cycled and his right index finger was pulled into the guide. The fingertip and nail were amputated.
An employee was feeding metal into a shear. The shear activated and closed on the employee's left thumb, amputating it.
An employee was laying down new insulation board on a roof and fell approximately 14 feet off the roof to the ground below. He suffered a broken tibia and injured his back and ankle.
A metal grate slipped off an item that was being used to hold it up. It fell onto an employee's left hand, amputating the tip of the middle finger.

Two employees were loading a roll of paper into a printing press. The decking moved forward as part of the process, and an employee slipped and fell into the resulting opening. The employee suffered a broken tibia.

An employee was performing preventive maintenance (oiling and lubrication) on a packaging conveyor when the employee saw something on the chain and attempted to wipe it off. The chain caught the tip of the employee's glove and pulled their hand into the drive chain and sprocket, resulting in an amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was preparing to run wire, fell on the roof, and broke a hip.

An employee was running a liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) standard with laboratory equipment when the equipment was knocked off the counter, causing the quick connect to fail. LPG then released and was ignited by the equipment's heating element. The employee received first and second degree burns on the right and left hands.

An employee was pushing a housekeeping cart down a ramp to the trash can. The ramp was approximately 6 inches from the sidewalk to the ground level. The cart went off the ramp and the employee tripped over the cart and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.

An employee was standing next to a spool, guiding a cable as it was spooled on. The employee was caught between the cable and the box, suffering a broken right big toe and amputations of three other toes.
An employee was working in the kitchen area and fell into hot oil resulting in burns to his back, backside, and leg. A second employee helped the injured employee out of the oil and burned his hand.
An employee fell from a ladder and suffered a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to relieve pressure at the valve of a workover rig. The valve broke under the pressure and the employee's face was lacerated.

An employee was using a lift to access a work platform to conduct work on an exhaust fan. As the employee stepped from the lift basket onto the work platform, the platform collapsed and the employee fell 16 feet to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured left hip, two left rib fractures, a fractured left arm, and a fractured left orbital bone.
An employee was bitten by a rattlesnake while pulling weeds.
An employee was using a saw to cut the end of a wooden survey stake and suffered a partial amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was operating a reach truck and pinned his left foot between the reach truck and the supporting beam resulting in a compound fracture.
An employee was unloading a truck using a cart. The cart tipped over onto the employee's leg and fractured the left tibia.
A employee was hospitalized for heat illness.
On September 14, 2020, an employee was guiding powder flow into the capsules on a pellet press. The employee's right middle finger was pinched in the press, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was delivering mail when a low hanging branch struck his left eye. The eye injury required surgery.
An employee was on a residential service call. While descending a ladder he fell and broke his leg. He also sustained a fractured vertebra.

An employee was abrasive blasting structural steel when their air supply hood caught on something causing the employee to lose their balance. As the employee reached to regain their balance, the abrasive nozzle crossed their arm causing a laceration/abrasion injury to their wrist.
An employee was working on a roof and started to feel dizzy. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was helping to stabilize a hydraulic brake that was being lowered to the ground via a powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee was holding onto the pallet when it was lowered onto the ground and crushed his right index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was on a line crew replacing burned power line poles. The employee touched the backhoe boom and suffered an electric shock.

At about 6:30 a.m. on September 14, 2020, an employee was preparing to load reels of copper cable onto a flatbed truck. The employee's left ring finger was pinched between two of the reels, causing a displaced fracture and an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was unloading the truck onto the docking station. The employee was on a ladder attached to the truck when he slipped and fell backwards. His foot got caught in the ladder and the employee's ankle was broken.
An employee jumped onto some cardboard on a pallet and fell, breaking his right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam on the blown fiber machine and smashed his left ring finger and amputated his index finger on the roller.

On 9/14/2020, at approximately 7:10 a.m., a maintenance technician was troubleshooting a date coder conveyor on a packaging line when his arm became entangled in a roller on the underside of the conveyor belt resulting in hospitalization for a fractured ulna and radius.

An employee was struck by a vehicle while gathering census information. The employee suffered a concussion, a broken shoulder, a dislocated and broken left ankle, facial abrasions, and a dislocated right middle finger.

An employee was replacing filters on top of a vacuum truck. The truck's 400-pound hatch closed on the employee, causing a laceration to the right hand, bruising above the left knee, and a dislocation at the right ankle.
An employee was stung by an insect while putting on gear to start welding and was hospitalized.
An employee was welding and crushed their left index finger between a weld point and the metal plate in the weld fixture resulting in amputation.
On September 14, 2020, an employee fell approximately 13-14 feet from the edge of a roof onto the ground. The employee sustained a fractured sternum and vertebrae.

An employee was operating a projection welder when the electrodes closing action was activated while his finger was between the electrodes. His left index finger was caught in the welder, resulting in an amputation.
An employee slipped and fell off the back of a flat bed truck. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was stapling insulation onto the side of a building under construction. The employee began convulsing and fell, lacerating their head and requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell down stairs and suffered a head injury.
An employee was loading product onto a box truck using a pallet jack. His right foot got caught between the pallet jack and the interior wall of the box truck and was fractured.

The injured employee was part of a crew unloading a semi-trailer of a 6-foot stack of insulated pipe. After cutting one of the four steel bands, the employee stepped onto a nearby 4x4x4 crate in front of the trailer. The employee lost balance, fell and landed in between the tractor and the trailer. The employee injured their collar bone and scapula and sustained a cut on the head and a puncture wound on the back.
An employee was cleaning up shot from under a steel plate that was being held up by a forklift. The plate fell onto the employee, breaking the employee's leg.

An employee was moving a steel-plated skate/equipment pallet across the floor. The employee's right middle finger was caught between the skate and the floor. The fingertip was amputated with no bone loss.

On Monday, September 14, 2020, at approximately 10:40 AM, employees were setting precast concrete wall panels (45' x 12'). A lift was used to pickup braces. The frame of the lift contacted a wall brace causing a concrete panel to fall. As the panel fell, it struck a manlift that was being used to install braces. As the manlift fell, it struck the lift causing an employee in the manlift to be ejected. He was wearing a personal fall arrest harness at the time. The employee sustained a fractured right femur and fractured ribs and was hospitalized.

On September 14, an employee was on a ladder performing telecommunications work when the ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones and required surgery.
An employee caught his foot on the corner of a desk and fell breaking his right hip.
An employee's right ring finger was amputated between the first and second knuckle by the hydraulic ram of an asphalt paving machine.
An employee was operating the rebar bending machine and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was picking up product using a pallet jack when his knee was caught between the pallet jack and a rack and fractured.

An employee was on a ladder about 10 feet off the ground, trying to unclog a water mister. The mister began to spray water onto him; as he tried to close it off and avoid the water, his right hand was struck by a large box fan blade. He suffered an amputation to the little finger.
An employee was replacing a 25hp electric agricultural water pump in an irrigation pumphouse and received an electric shock of 480 volts. The employee sustained burns to the hands.
An employee was sharpening a belt on a lathe. The employee sustained a broken wrist when their hand was caught in the machine.
An employee was cutting wooden 2x4s using an angle grinder blade. The wood kicked back and the employee sustained a 5-inch laceration on the left forearm that required surgery.

Two employees were removing 50-pound hammers from a steel box on a roader in a sugar mill. While removing the hammers, the steel box fell. One employee was pinned between the steel box and the roader. The other employee was struck by hammers. One employee was hospitalized for a fractured sternum.
An employee was operating a labeling machine and suffered an amputation injury to a finger and a thumb laceration.
An employee was taking down warehouse racking when a piece of the racking fell down and amputated the tip of the employee's index finger.
An employee fell from a second story residential roof to the ground, fracturing several bones.
A solar installer fell off a ladder onto the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for fractures to both legs.

A truck driver was working from a stepladder, loading pre-cast concrete sound barriers onto the flatbed of a truck. He stepped off the ladder, slipped, and fell about 5 feet to the ground. He suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.
A census taker was at a house when a dog chased her. She fell, hitting her head on the ground. She was hospitalized.

A warehouse worker was attempting to move a food assembly machine off a broken pallet. The machine began to fall over and it fell onto his right hand as he tried to catch it. The employee sustained three fractures and two lacerations to the right hand.
An employee tripped and fell on a buckled section of floor, suffering a broken right hip and femur.
An employee was stung by a bee or wasp and was hospitalized for heart arrhythmia.
An employee was pushing a wire cart in the trash enclosure and brushed up against a trash bag. An unknown protruding object lacerated the employee's lower right leg.

An employee was scrubbing the framework of a stand that held a tabletop scale. As the employee moved the scale, it fell to the floor and onto his left middle finger and amputated 1/4 inch of the finger.
An employee was using a lift gate to load tubs into the truck. When the lift gated was activated, the employee's right middle finger was caught and partially amputated.
At 8:00 a.m. on September 15, 2020, an employee was using a bandsaw when it fell onto his right little finger and lacerated. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee stepped from the wire bridge to the winch wall and lost his footing on the wall. His left leg and knee struck the wall as he fell resulting in a fractured lower leg and damage to his knee cap.
An employee was organizing clothes racks on the sales floor prior to store opening. The employee fell and fractured a femur. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was transferring raw material into a product hopper via a vacuum transfer system. During the bag change process, a flash fire occurred and burned the employee's forearms and face.
A circular saw amputated an employee's left index fingertip at the first knuckle.
On September 15, 2020, an employee was using a pry bar to unjam pallets on a roller conveyor and suffered a partial amputation to the left pinky finger.

A temporary employee was installing a structural steel brace for a cooling tower being erected. An unsupported brace slid off a column and the employee's right index and middle finger were pinched between the two. The employee suffered amputations to both fingers below the knuckles.

An employee was moving two steel pipes from one run to another run using a rail car pipe truck. While transferring pipe, the east (right side) pipe struck a steel I-beam causing the pipe to jump the pipe truck retainer lip and the spigot end of the pipe struck the employee's foot. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the foot.
An employee was climbing up a ladder and fell 6 to 8 feet. Both arms were fractured.
An employee was bending parts on a press brake when his hand got caught in the machine resulting in amputation of his right index finger.

An employee was straightening out a section of a core wall in a core cell. The employee completed his work and was stepping down off the wall when he lost his footing, slipped, and fell 3 to 4 feet to the floor, landing on his right foot. His right ankle was broken.
An employee was doing roofing work on a dome. The employee slid about 60 feet down the roof and struck a wall, suffering a dislocated left knee and broken left tibia.
An employee tripped and fell 4 feet out of a box truck resulting in a torn patella tendon in the right knee.
An employee fell off a double-stacked pallet, landing on the ground about 8.5 feet below. He suffered rib or chest injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a push aid to unjam shredder output when he felt a pain in his lower back and leg. He was hospitalized for a lower back strain.

An employee was using a drill on the cage of a mobile welding machine. As he tightened a bit on a truck tool, the tool was activated and lacerated his right index finger and the space between the finger and the thumb. He was hospitalized.

An employee was troubleshooting and adjusting the position of a lift table assembly  inside a bagging machine when the entire lift table assembly rotated, pinching the employee's left index finger between the pivot arm and the servo coupling. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the left index fingertip.
An employee was riding a bicycle when the chain dislodged from the sprocket. The employee fell to the concrete, suffering a broken right forearm.
An employee missed a step while descending a staircase and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.

An employee was walking through a door carrying product when the product became caught on the door. The employee tried to free the product by pushing on the door. One of the employee's right-hand fingers was then caught in a pinch point as the door began to close, removing a sliver of flesh and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was moving equipment using a lift when he felt a sharp pain in his stomach due to a hernia.
An employee inadvertently placed their right hand on a belt sheave, which then amputated the middle finger.

On September 16, 2020, an employee was clearing the bottom tape that had become wrapped around the crusher belt on the bag line. The machine was activated and the employee's left middle finger was caught in the crusher belt resulting in surgical amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was helping install steel bar joists on steel beams as the joists were lifted into place. A joist hung up, then swung as the employee pried it loose. His right hand was caught between the joist and other steel members and the tip of his little finger was amputated.
An employee was walking up the ramp for the shuttle bus when she slipped and fell on her upper extremities. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was operating a cable pully machine (a winch) when the nylon rope that was attached to a cable he was pulling through an underground electrical installation broke and struck him in the head and face. The employee sustained a head laceration and bruises to their face.

An employee was getting ready to remove product from the loading dock when he slipped and fell on a wet ramp. The ramp activated and his right middle finger was caught in a gap in the ramp and amputated.
An employee was walking down the dock and was struck by a forklift. The employee received multiple fractures to the right leg.
On September 16, 2020, an employee tripped over a rail in a warehouse aisle. She fell, striking her knee on the concrete floor. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery for the knee injury.

An employee was on a ladder 6 to 7 feet high performing maintenance work on a light fixture. The employee received and electrical shock and fell from the ladder to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with two fractured vertebrae, a fractured left humerus, and an electrical burn on his hand.
At about 8:30 a.m. on September 16, 2020, an employee fell through a roof opening and suffered a broken wrist and a neck injury.

An employee was approximately 4 feet above the ground on a 6-foot A-frame ladder using a drill to remove screws from an air handling unit vent when the drill kicked back. The employee lost balance and fell backward onto a concrete ledge, suffering a fractured skull, forehead cut, fractured heel, and hematoma.
An employee was adjusting a stitcher machine when their gloves were caught in a gear and chain. The employee's fingertip was amputated.

An employee was walking on an elevated walkway approximately 20 feet high to reach a camera that needed repair. As he walked past another employee who was also walking on the walkway, he fell through an opening in the hand rail. The employee sustained a broken right arm, a fractured L-4 vertebra and a laceration to the face that require stitches. The employee required surgery to repair a fracture.
An employee was walking with an armful of materials. He tripped and fell to the floor, suffering an injury to the right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a serious injury.
An employee opened a trailer. A propane leak within the trailer caused an explosion and the employee suffered severe hand burns.
An employee was securing a load on a flatbed trailer and slipped off the trailer to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured wrist, dislocated shoulder and a head laceration.

An employee was working from a perry style scaffold that was 3 feet off the ground when he stepped backward off the scaffold and fell to the ground. He broke his right tibia, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was taping a new core to the winder stand of the calendar machine when their left arm was caught in the rotating winder and fractured.
An employee was struck in the face by a falling concrete block while lining up the scaffold to repair a door lintel. The employee sustained a fractured nose.
During tree felling, a tree fell to the ground, bounced, and struck an employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized for a leg fracture.

An employee was standing on a truss, sheathing the side of another truss. The employee then attempted to set up a truss to the layout tie but lost his balance and fell 12 feet onto a concrete patio. The employee was hospitalized with breathing complications and chest pain. The employee's lifeline was untied at the time.
An employee was winding synthetic rope onto the hoist of a chipper machine when his thumb was pinched by the rope. The employee's left thumb was amputated at the first digit.
An employee was monitoring the operation of a machine and suffered amputation of the right middle fingertip in an auger.

A construction forklift leaving the construction area with the forks elevated approximately six feet above the ground, turned toward traffic, and struck a postal vehicle and the driver with the forks. The postal carrier sustained a broken arm and elbow.

An employee was using a forklift to fill orders in a warehouse and attempting to retrieve a pallet between two stacks of other pallets. As he was driving between the two stacks, his foot was caught on a pallet on the left side of the forklift, pinning his leg between the pallet and the forklift. His left leg broke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell through the sheetrock ceiling in a home's attic, landing on the concrete floor below and suffering head injuries.

On September 17, 2020, at 1:00 AM, two employees were working in a lift painting a bridge on an interstate overpass when the lift malfunctioned. They were attempting to exit the lift when a semi-truck struck them. They were both hospitalized with broken bones.
An employee was operating a forklift at a well site and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was using a break machine to form metal . His right index finger was caught between the machine's clamp and the metal material, causing an amputation to the tip of the finger.
An employee was cutting scrap with a vertical bandsaw when the back of the employee's hand contacted the blade and was lacerated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a forklift basket and fractured both forearms. The employee also sustained a left knee fracture and facial fractures. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was cutting steel with a cutting wheel on a rotary grinder when the cutting blade broke apart and a piece of the blade struck his inner right arm. He suffered an arm laceration that required surgery.
An employee was using a walk-behind floor foamer/scrubber when the employee slipped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left femur.

An employee was hot air welding PVC roof seams and transitioning to a new location on a roof when his extension cord bumped a gallon container of acetone. The container began to tip and he tried to catch it with his right hand. Some contents spilled and were subsequently ignited by a flameless hot air welder that was approximately 2 feet away. His pants and shirt caught fire, and he received second degree burns to his right hand, arm, and bicep. He was hospitalized.

An employee was tying down a load on a flatbed trailer with binding straps. As he threw a strap across the load, he released the strap and lost balance. He fell to the ground, striking and fracturing his left hip.

An employee was operating a bar spinner machine when he noticed that it was not moving back and forth smoothly. The employee went under the machine while troubleshooting to look at how it was traveling along the rails. As the employee went to stand up, his hand came in contact with the machine while the spindle was still in motion, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger above the first knuckle.

An employee was working on an 8-foot ladder and fell backwards from the ladder onto the concrete and striking his head on the threshold of a doorway. The employee sustained a head contusion and laceration.

Two employees (mechanic and operator) were changing the wheels on a landfill compactor. The operator was operating a wheel loader and lifted a large metal compactor wheel off the ground to be installed on the compactor. The mechanic was signaling directions to the operator to align and set the wheel in place. While signaling and moving the wheel onto the machine, the wheel shifted on the loader forks and pinned the mechanic between the forks and the wheel. The mechanic suffered a fractured rib, hip and vertebrae.
An employee was placing a lantern on the dock stairs when she was bitten several times on the right wrist by a baby copperhead snake. She was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing to change an oil plug when a fire occurred and the employee was burned.

An employee was operating a rubber jamming machine when a piece of rubber became stuck in the cutting side of the machine. As he was attempting to unjam it, the machine's knife cut his fingers, resulting in the amputation of his right ring and pinky fingers.

An employee was cleaning a conveyor line used to package finished cheesecakes. The conveyor belt was removed for cleaning and the employee was cleaning around the head/drive pulley. The conveyor started and the employee's hands were pinned under the conveyor's sprockets and shaft located on the head/drive pulley. The employee sustained a fractured left forearm and lacerations on the left hand.
An employee suffered the possible amputation of three fingers while using a chop saw.

An employee was walking alongside a skid steer that was carrying a hoisted cage used to pour foundations. He was holding onto the cage to keep it steady when he tripped over a nearby portable generator. The skid steer then ran over his foot, fracturing his right ankle.
An employee was walking on a roof and fell 14 feet through the roof to the cement floor below. The employee sustained a fractured tail bone.

A truck driver was sitting in a stopped pickup truck with the driver-side door open in the left shoulder median of I-95 southbound, checking truck access areas for an I-95 northbound paving work area. The employee's pickup truck was then struck by a tractor trailer, and both vehicles spun and ended up in the trees on the right side of I-95 southbound. The employee was thrown from his vehicle and impacted the ground, suffering a head injury, fractured ribs, and a fractured femur. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking up to a forklift to speak to the forklift operator when the forklift operator reversed the forklift and ran over his foot, fracturing it.

Two employees were hand-loading fiberglass panels onto a hand cart when four panels slipped off the cart to the ground. They tried to pick up all four panels at once, but realized that the stack was too heavy and started to put them back down. At that time, one of the employees lost his grip and the panels landed on his left middle finger, resulting in the medical amputation of his fingertip.

An employee was changing a blade on a utility knife/scrapper. As he was tightening the screw that holds the blade in place, the screwdriver slipped, causing his wrist to slide across the blade. He suffered a laceration and puncture wound on his wrist.
An employee fell from a trailer while it was in motion. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a possible dislocated shoulder, an ankle injury, and required stitches on the forehead.
An employee was on a five-foot baker's scaffold installing an acoustic ceiling. The employee fell to the ground below and suffered a nose bleed and confusion.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fractured her hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while exiting a water truck via the ladder. The employee was hospitalized for a foot/ankle injury.
An employee was setting a press die. As he fed material into the press, the die amputated a fingertip.
A piece of 6-inch by 6-inch metal T-beam dislodged from an A-frame cart while being lifted. It fell 8-10 inches and struck an employee's right big toe, fracturing it.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to enter the attic. The bottom of the ladder slid out and the employee fell 6-8 feet hitting his left ribs on a metal sink. The employee sustained eight broken ribs.
An employee was flagging traffic when an SUV struck the employee. The employee suffered nerve damage in the lower back and down the leg as well as a hyperextended medial collateral ligament.
An employee was walking along a temporary path to a bathroom when the employee slid/fell approximately 8 feet down an embankment to the ground, suffering fractured ribs.
An employee was loosening Allen bolts on a generator system when a seal failed on a line connected to the generator, exposing the employee to leaking chlorine dioxide.
An employee was operating a steel bender when their right ring finger was caught in a pinch point on the bender, de-gloving the finger from the knuckle to the tip.
An employee was operating a mobile boom lift on a barge to lift a piling out of the water when the boom broke and struck the employee on the leg, leading to a fractured leg.

An employee was collecting road cones from the back of truck that had a hydraulic lift gate when his fingers got in the pinch point between the gate and truck bed, leading to an amputation of his middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was loading packages into the right side of a mail truck when a garbage truck struck the left rear-end of the mail truck. The impact pushed the mail truck onto the sidewalk and into a building, and the employee was thrown from the truck to the ground. The employee suffered collarbone and head fractures.

An employee was helping to install an M256 tube with a bearing assembly into a recoil mount in preparation for testing. While guiding the tube (which was being held by a crane) into the recoil mount, his gloved hand became caught, resulting in the amputation of two left-hand fingertips.
A pressure washer injured an employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized.
While returning to their patrol vehicle after dark, an officer slipped and fell down an embankment in the woods fracturing three ribs.
On September 18, 2020, an employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a hip fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing shrink wrap from a pallet and tripped over an extended outrigger on a forklift. The employee fell and fractured their right femur.

An employee was walking to a hand wash area at the end of his shift. At the same time, a contract team member was entering the facility to clean it with a water hose. Part of the hose was dragging on the floor. The employee tripped on the water hose and fell, fracturing his left hip.
An employee was working on a lacquer cylinder on a printing press when the cylinder moved and caught his left hand. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised left hand.

An employee returned from his lunch break and was performing labor which included removing dirt clods from a small trench. The employee was sweating and pale, and stated that his chest was hurting. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack.
An employee was checking sensors on sump pumps and fell approximately 5 feet into the opening of the sump vault. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

On September 18, 2020, an employee was servicing a printing press. While manually working on the drive shaft, the machine re-energized and the employee's right hand was caught between the tensioning device and drive belt resulting in an amputation.

Two maintenance employees were replacing an oil pressure pump coupling on a moving table bridge mill. The cutter dropped from the spindle and amputated the injured employee's right thumb below the fingernail.
An employee was inspecting equipment to find the source of a hydraulic fluid leak when his right arm was caught between the wheel and the wheel frame resulting in fractures to the right wrist.
A temporary employee was operating a lathe and caught his right middle finger in the machine. Half of the finger was amputated at the hospital.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder attached to a building, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to a wrist and hip that required surgery.

The injured employee was working under the truck when a second employee tried to start it causing the truck to jump forward and run over the injured employee's left foot causing a closed fracture of a metatarsal bone.

A separator operator in training was loading chick buggies onto the chain conveyor of a separator machine. The employee noticed a crooked tray on a buggy entering the separator and placed his right foot on the chain conveyor to reach into the machine and straighten the tray. The next buggy moved forward and caught the employee's leg against the conveyor fracturing his tibia and fibula near the ankle.
A lineman fell approximately 28 feet from an elevated bucket truck to the ground. The employee lost consciousness and suffered fractures to a heel, both forearms and the L-1 vertebra.
An employee was bending bars when their fingers were caught in rollers and amputated.
An employee was cleaning a resaw machine and amputated their index fingertip. The index finger was also fractured.

On September 18, 2020, at 6:21 AM an employee working on the rear passenger side of the garbage truck was struck by a vehicle while picking up curbside garbage. The employee suffered a broken orbital bone, broken cervical discs and facial lacerations.
An employee was servicing shredder equipment that was jammed and began to have leg cramps. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was wrapping a component for shipping when the component tipped over onto the employee's leg.

Two employees were operating a 300-ton press. The injured employee was stacking manufactured parts from the mechanical press. As the injured employee was removing a cut part from the press, the press activated and his arm was crushed in the press. The employee's arm was amputated at mid forearm.
An employee was loading a refrigerator, slipped, and fell hitting her head on the floor. The employee sustained a head injury and bleeding on the brain.
A truck backed up and pinned an employee between the dock and the trailer. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis.

An employee driving a forklift made a left turn to go into a rack aisle, then stopped to let another employee lower their forklift. The employee then lost control of the forklift while passing the other lift. The employee reached out to brace himself prior to impact with a cross beam and his left pinky finger was pinched between the forklift and the cross beam. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning an encapsulation machine when her left index finger got caught between two segments of the machine and was amputated.

An employee was working on a granulator machine to align the hopper when his right middle finger got caught between the hopper and the base of the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On 9/18/2020, at 9 PM, a temporary employee was crossing a dock to guide a trailer into a door when a crossing/passing forklift ran over his foot. He was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.
An employee was working at a swaging station. The swaging machine amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was vacuuming sand from a residential crawl space when the vacuum caught the employee's left arm causing a hematoma.
An employee was operating a pneumatic-powered shear and suffered a partial amputation of the left ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was troubleshooting a knockout punch and suffered a partial distal phalanx amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was emptying a trash can, lost his balance, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was operating a bandsaw and amputated their right thumb tip.

On September 18, 2020, at 10:43 AM, an employee was felling a tree. When the tree fell and contacted the ground, the butt end of the tree jumped off the stump and struck the employee.
