The fractured ulna required surgery.
One employee stabbed another with a pocket knife, causing abdominal wounds that required hospitalization and surgery.
While moving drums in the back of a delivery truck, an employee fell from the truck to the ground, suffering a concussion and head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a box when he started having back pain. The employee was hospitalized for a soft tissue injury that was causing internal bleeding.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor while walking, fracturing a knee.
An employee bent over to pick up an agave plant for a customer and the tip of the plant struck her right eye.

An employee was attempting to pull a switch in the back of a forklift to release the brake. His hand contacted the radiator fan blade and half of his right pinky finger was amputated. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing hot sulfur slugs and sulfur splashed onto his face. The employee sustained a second degree thermal burn on his cheek.
An employee was lifting a conveyance gate and caught their finger in a conveyance roller resulting in a severe abrasion that required surgery.
An employee fell through a hole in the decking on the ninth floor to the eighth floor below and suffered a compression fracture of two vertebrae and a fractured wrist.
An employee was removing a stuck part from a mechanical power press and amputated two fingers on the right hand.

At 1:14 p.m. on September 18, 2020, an employee slipped in the asphalt cement at the edge of a roof as he stepped onto the roof from a ladder. He fell to the ground 8 feet below and suffered a broken heel.
An employee was using a magnetic drill and caught their left thumb in the rotating drill bit resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell breaking their right hip.
An employee was operating a capstan hoist when two fingers on his right hand were caught between the rope and the drum of the hoist resulting in amputation of the distal phalanges.
On September 19, 2020, an employee fell while descending a ladder from a roof and landed on a concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured knee.
An employee was cutting meat using a band saw and amputated the right index and middle fingertips.

An employee parked her truck but it started rolling. She tried to get back in the truck and then tried to get out again before the truck rolled into a river. She got caught between a tree and the truck door. The employee sustained multiple rib fractures and an abrasion to her shin that required a skin graft.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack when his left foot struck a pallet of produce. He suffered a broken left tibia and fibula.

An employee was conducting morning inspections in a caustic unit. A section of CPVC pipe 15 feet above broke off as a valve was being released, fell, and hit the employee in the head. He suffered a skull fracture and lost consciousness. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the boiler house when he noticed a spider bite on his left elbow.
An employee's fingers were amputated when their hand was caught in the meat tenderizer machine.

An employee was stepping from the top of a cargo tank trailer onto the top rung of a ladder when they fell approximately 12 feet to the ground. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the right arm that required surgery.
A door slammed on an employee's left little finger, cutting the fingertip severely.

An employee was performing maintenance on a baggage belt and was using a towel to clean the belt. The belt pulled the towel and the employee's left hand into the belt. His left middle finger was caught in the chain and sprocket and amputated.
An employee was repairing a valve on an air line. As he tested the valve, it closed on his left index fingertip, causing an amputation.
An employee leaned on the glass door of the fragrance cabinet and the glass shattered. The employee was hospitalized for an eye injury .

Employees were performing maintenance on a crimp press. The employees were using an impact (pneumatic) wrench to remove bolts from a vertically positioned cylinder in the crimp press. The injured employee was supporting the weight of the impact wrench to keep it steady. His fingers were underneath the vertically positioned impact wrench, away from the nut being removed. When the final nut was loosened, the cylinder slid down and crushed his pinky finger between the back/bottom of the impact wrench and the metal below it.

An employee was monitoring machine operation and noticed an ice cream bar stick was not released. The employee's right ring finger was then caught in the point of operation and amputated by the drop bar on the machine.
An employee was lifting a bundle of metal onto a stack with a crane. The bundle clipped the top bundle on the stack which then fell off and onto the employee's left leg fracturing it.

At 3:00 a.m. on September 21, 2020, an employee was unloading a trailer. The employee's right foot was caught and lacerated between a pallet jack and the wall of the trailer. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was power washing a deck and fell to the ground below, breaking a leg.
While cleaning a conveyor belt an employee was removing a piece of product and his finger was caught between the moving conveyor belt and scraper. The pad of the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was exiting her carrier vehicle from the driver's side (right side) and stepped on a gravel area. She slipped on a rock and fell, landing on her wrist and fracturing it.

An employee was cleaning in the pack off area of the facility using a high pressure hot water hose. The employee was walking with the hose when the hose got caught on the conveyor frame in the area and the employee lost their grip on the hose. The hose fell to the ground and the employee was sprayed with hot water. Hot water got inside their boot and the employee sustained first and second degree burns to their left foot.

On September 21, 2020, an employee was performing boiler maintenance and was using a 6" hand held angle grinder with a wafer cutting wheel to cut block welds in order to remove the cyclone tubes for replacement. While cutting, the cutting wheel became pinched and the grinder kicked back. The employee lost control of the grinder and sustained a laceration on his right leg above the knee that required sutures and hospitalization.
An employee slipped and fell while opening an office door. The employee suffered a broken hip or leg bone.

An employee was aligning a machine press using his hands to guide the machine at the bottom. The machine fell into place and crushed his right index finger resulting in amputation above the first joint.
An employee was cutting poultry using a band saw and amputated the tip of his right thumb.

A live haul trailer backed into an employee as he walked through a trailer bay toward his workstation. He suffered injuries to his left knee and lower left leg (including an arterial injury) and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking beside a 12-ton bulldozer, holding a dirt grading rod. The bulldozer, moving in reverse, struck and fractured his left femur and right foot.
A nurse was bitten by a patient on her right thumb and left chest area. The injuries required surgery.

An employee had been installing blocking on a roof. The employee slipped and fell approximately 12 feet off the roof and sustained a fractured left ankle, a fractured left elbow, and a fractured and dislocated right elbow.

On September 21, 2020, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was driving a golf cart on the golf course when he lost control of the vehicle, jumped from the golf cart, and impacted the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right arm.

An employee stepped onto a rolling ladder while cleaning a mixing bowl on an elevated bread line. The employee fell 4 feet, suffering a severe injury to the right knee that required hospitalization for surgery.
An employee was performing demolition work and was pulling on an overhead three-inch vertical PVC pipe. The pipe broke off and struck the employee in the head.

An employee was dumping lime in a field when a hydraulic line broke in his tractor trailer causing the truck to tip over. The employee was hospitalized with three cracked vertebrae and a bruised lung.
An employee was operating a mill machine when the rollers of the mill machine grabbed his left hand fingers. The employee sustained partial fingertip amputations of the left ring and middle fingers.
An employee's foot got caught in the belt of a pulley system. The employee's lower right leg was fractured.

An employee was inspecting the insulation of a drag conveyor when a piece of angle iron fell into an opening in the housing. The drag conveyor then contacted the angle iron causing it to strike an employee's left thumb. The employee's thumb sustained a deep laceration.
An employee was walking through a store backroom when she slipped and fell on her knee. She was hospitalized for a fractured knee cap that required surgery.

Two employees were operating a side-by-side UTV on a forest road and were involved in a head on collision with a pickup truck. Employee 1 suffered a compound fracture to their left femur, a laceration on their left calf, and a laceration just below the right kneecap. Employee 1 was hospitalized and required surgery. Employee 2 sustained shoulder and neck injuries and was treated and released.
An employee was replacing a membrane in the reverse osmosis system and partially amputated two fingers.

On September 21, 2020, an employee was walking into an apartment building to conduct interviews with individuals at their private residences when she tripped on an incline and fell resulting in a fracture in her third lumbar vertebra.
An employee who had been driving for a long period of time got out of the driver's seat of a parked bus and felt a sharp pain down their lower right leg due to a lumbar sprain.

An employee was riding in the bed of a company pickup truck stabilizing the motor that was being brought over to the dumpster for disposal. When the truck came to a stop, the employee lost his footing and fell out of the truck bed on the driver's side and struck the back of his head on the driveway pavement. The employee suffered a laceration to the back of the head and a skull fracture.

A work crew was unloading a used 35-foot power pole to a residential site. The pole rolled off the digger derrick truck, fell approximately 30 feet, and landed on the injured employee. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion, a fractured shoulder and ribs, and internal injuries.
An employee was descending 3 to 4 stairs when he fell to the floor and hit his head. He was hospitalized with a skull fracture and subdural hematoma.

On September 22, 2020, an employee was moving a new log splitter when it struck a pallet on the floor, causing the arm to come down on the employee's hand. The employee suffered an amputation of their middle finger. Their ring finger was able to be reattached.
An employee was on a one-step ladder stocking shelves. Her foot slipped as she stepped backwards off the step ladder and she fell onto her right knee. Her tibia was fractured.
While pushing an aircraft out of a hanger using a tow truck, an employee was struck by the aircraft causing fractures to both legs.

An employee was arranging pipe on the trailer. When he went to get down from the trailer the employee slipped on an oily surface and lost his footing. He fell off the trailer and landed on his right side fracturing his hip.
An employee was operating a plastic trimming machine when the trimming blade amputated their right ring fingertip.

A truck driver was attempting to drain waste milk from a tanker into a designated disposal area. The liquid in the tanker would not drain and the driver contacted the injured employee for assistance. The injured employee drove to the disposal site to investigate. The disposal site (owned & operated by a separate employer) provided a PVC pipe with a scoop at the end of it for the injured employee to take a sample of the liquid in the tanker to determine why the liquid would not drain. The injured employee climbed to the top of the tanker. During the maneuvering of the PVC pipe into the liquid, the handle of the pipe contacted an overhead electrical line and the injured employee received an electric shock. The employee then fell approximately 15 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a broken back resulting in paralysis and hospitalization.

An employee was operating a mini skid steer. As he exited the skid steer, his foot was wedged between the arm and the cab of the skid steer causing him to fall forward and snap his foot. Three toes were degloved and one bone in the foot was dislocated.
While performing maintenance on a forklift, an employee cut their right arm on a firewall (sheet metal material).
An employee slipped off the wet step of a truck and tore a tendon in his knee.

On September 22, 2020, an employee was troubleshooting a problem with the tub conveyor on the tub press packing line. The employee entered the automated machine and stepped up onto the magazine between the tub feeder and the conveyor. The employee's foot slipped into the void between the tub feeder and conveyor and the tub feeder activated, pinching the employee's leg. The employee was admitted to the hospital for a broken left leg and muscular damage.
An employee fell down stairs to a landing, suffering head injuries.
An employee was walking down interior stairs and fell to the first landing, sustaining head injuries.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when the jack struck a metal storage rack and the employee's left calf was lacerated. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was driving a rider jack when his load was struck by a forklift's load. He fell off the rider jack and hit his head on the concrete floor. The employee sustained an injury that required stitches.
An employee made a cut with a saw, turned the saw off, and struck the still spinning blade as he reached for the cut piece. His fingers were lacerated.
An employee was unlocking twist locks on a catwalk on a container ship. He fell through an open access hatch and sustained six broken ribs and a bruised lung.
A wall panel was being removed when it fell on two employees. Both employees were hospitalized for fractures.
An employee was scooping cleansing chemicals into a vat filled with hot water. The hot water erupted and spilled onto the employee. The employee suffered thermal and chemical burns to their eyes.

An employee was attempting to reconnect a pin that holds a transition deck to a commander unit when his right index finger was caught between the two pieces of equipment resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was using a sledgehammer to loosen dirt from the inside of an excavator bucket. A piece of the bucket tooth broke off, struck the employee's right leg, and lacerated it.

An employee was walking through closed fire doors and hit her left elbow on a door. She sat down on the floor to avoid falling. The employee sustained a laceration to the left elbow requiring hospitalization.
An employee was loading boxes onto a trailer when a 40-pound box fell and landed on his right foot, resulting in amputation of his right toe.
On September 22, 2020, as an employee was removing a concrete form, the bottom piece of the form fell onto the employee's left foot, resulting in a crushing injury to the foot/toes.
An employee was changing oil on a forklift when an oil wrench was dropped on his face. He sustained a concussion, a fractured nose, and an abrasion.
An employee was performing roofing work from inside a man-made box attached to a forklift and fell 20 feet to the lower level.
A 4' x 4' bundle of polyfoam insulation board fell from the crane rigging and struck an employee on the upper back. The employee was hospitalized for fractured vertebrae in the neck.

On September 22, 2020, at 9:15 AM, an employee was assisting with drawing blood from a sick cat. The cat bit her left index finger. Later, her finger became swollen and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery on her hand.
An employee was hanging live birds onto a shackle line when he fell from the conveyor onto the ground and broke his left leg.
An employee was on an auto picker machine approximately 10 feet in the air selecting orders. The employee lost balance and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured hip, femur and ribs.
An employee fell off a ladder at a second story height while working on a residential home. The employee was hospitalized with five broken ribs, a concussion and a back injury.

On September 22, 2020, an employee was lifting a die with an overhead gantry crane and a four-legged lifting device. His right index finger was partially amputated when it was pinched between a lifting leg and the die.
An employee was breaking down boxes. The employee tripped over a box and fell to the ground, suffering wrist and hip injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a piece of material weighing approximately 40 lbs. on the radial arm saw when the material fell and crushed her left index finger. The finger was fractured and partially amputated.
An employee tripped over the threshold of a door and fell striking their forehead on the floor. The employee sustained a concussion.
An employee was removing a wheel and tire assembly from the safety inflation cage. The wheel and tire assembly failed and the employee sustained a concussion, a fractured jaw, and broken teeth.
An employee was struck by a forklift moving in reverse. His leg was caught between the forklift and a stack of doors on a pallet resulting in fractures to the left tibia and ankle.
An employee was repairing the belt on a thatching machine when his thumb was caught between the belt and pulley and amputated below the nail bed.
An employee was injured while trying to restrain a patient. The patient fell on top of the employee's leg causing multiple fractures.

On September 22, 2020, an employee was assisting an excavator operator. As the employee approached the excavator to unstrap a pull barn pole, the employee was struck by the pole and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was under a truck taking the transmission out. The truck, which was supported by blocks, fell and the gas tank pinned the employee to the floor. He sustained injury to the hips, leg, and lower back.

An employee was using a pallet jack to unload boxes of furniture from a trailer. A box of furniture was sitting on a pallet that was partially shattered. An employee was picking up hurricane debris and was bitten by a copperhead snake on two fingers on his right hand. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.
On September 22, 2020, an employee slipped off the step while exiting the cab of a commercial truck and fell to the parking lot pavement. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee tripped on an electrical cord in the walkway and fell to the ground on his shoulder.
An employee was filling the pressure washer with gas. The tank slipped from his hand and fuel splashed onto his legs. The gas was ignited by the hot engine and one of the employee's legs was burned.
An employee performing roofing activities on a roof fell approximately 12 feet to the gravel surface below. The employee was hospitalized for a fracture injury.

An employee was loading a forklift onto a trailer during night operation. The employee stepped down off the forklift and into a small hole in the trailer floor resulting in a fractured lower right leg and hospitalization.
An employee's finger was struck by the extractor bar on a frozen food machine as it cycled. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right index finger.

On September 23, 2020, an employee had been decommissioning a bundle puller on a flatbed trailer. The employee went to descend from the trailer, swung his leg over the side of the trailer and lost balance, falling into the forks of a forklift that was parked parallel to the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs and a possible spleen injury.

An employee was picking up a portable band saw and a long piece of all-thread. As his left hand lifted the blade portion of the saw and the all-thread, the trigger was squeezed and his left index finger was pulled into the saw resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was directing traffic and was struck by a forward-moving forklift that was carrying three bundles of lumber. The employee's left lower leg was amputated.

The injured employee was holding an adjacent pen gate open when a forklift struck an overhead pipe and the pipe struck the employee in the back of the head. The employee sustained a head laceration/hematoma.
An employee was clearing a clog in fiber processing equipment when his hand came in contact with a moving part, injuring his fingers and resulting in an amputation.
An employee fell from a portable A-frame ladder while pulling boxes of records from a storage rack. The employee suffered contusions to the back of the head.

On September 23, 2020, at 4:00 PM, an employee was guiding a precast cement structure that was being lifted by an excavator. The load shifted and the lifting cable caught his fingers against the cement structure. The tip of his thumb was amputated.
An employee was using a grinder to cut a barrel. The grinder caused a spark that ruptured the barrel.  The employee sustained a burn to the abdomen requiring hospitalization.
On September 23, 2020, an employee was reversing a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) and struck a warehouse rack pole. The employee was hospitalized with a crushed left foot.

An employee was unloading a truck with an electric pallet jack. When he crossed an entryway that connects two areas in the warehouse, the pallet jack collided with a forklift. The employee suffered an injury to his left foot.

A vehicle traveling through a work zone struck a traffic control worker. The employee's right leg was fractured in three places. The employee also sustained a fractured pelvis and a possible left leg fracture.
An employee was walking down a wooden staircase and lost his footing. He fell approximately 4-5 feet and suffered a major tear(s) to his quadricep muscles.
An employee was walking through the outdoor courtyard when she fell to the floor and fractured her tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was injured while guiding a buggy cart that was coming down a ramp. The buggy cart got away and struck his leg. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured leg.

An employee was in a lift bucket 10-12 feet off the ground, cutting a tree branch that was 8-10 inches thick. The branch split up the middle 3-4 feet above the employee's head, snapped back, and struck the employee in the torso. The employee suffered injuries to the liver and kidney, as well as a broken arm.

Employee 1 was replacing a bucket (480-volt breaker) while Employee 2 was observing from outside the arc flash boundary (36"). Employee 1 completed the work and was closing the door when an arc flash occurred. Employee 2 sustained first degree burns on the forehead and cheek and first and second degree burns to the hand. Employee 2 was hospitalized. Employee 1 was not injured.

On September 23, 2020, at 8:40 AM an employee was connecting a male connector to a female connector. The male connector was attached to an air-operated ram. The ram retracted and amputated the employee's index finger.
An employee was sitting in a chair when she fell out of the chair and struck her head on the edge of the counter. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been cutting concrete. After he finished, he was moving the concrete saw to a different spot when it lacerated his left shin.

The injured employee was assisting a drill operator. As the employee was removing debris from the machine, his left hand was caught in the machine resulting in a finger amputation at the first joint, lacerations and a broken wrist.
An employee was using industrial shears to cut bands from stacked lumber. The loose lumber then struck the employee's left leg and fractured his ankle.
A belly dump truck was hauling dirt on a construction site when it tipped over onto its side. The driver was hospitalized with fractured ribs.
An employee propped a 6-foot step ladder up against the wall and as he was climbing up it, he fell off the ladder and was hospitalized for a hairline back fracture.
An employee squatted down to observe a non-working conveyor roller. His gloved left index finger was caught in a rotating chain underneath resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unloading his truck when he fell off the back of the trailer. He landed on the ground and sustained broken ribs.

An employee was repairing a tube bender machine when a component of the machine shifted and caught the employee's left ring finger in a shear point. The finger was amputated from the nail to the fingertip.
An employee was troubleshooting the injection molding machine and amputated their left ring finger.
An employee was adjusting the height on 4-foot exit conveyor when it became unstable and tipped over onto the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a fractured left leg that required surgery.

Two employees were raking concrete in front of the concrete screed in a work zone. A semi-trailer entered the work zone and struck the concrete screed. The concrete screed then struck both employees and knocked them to the ground. Employee 1 suffered a fractured left leg and a laceration to the back of the head and was hospitalized. Employee 2 suffered contusions to both knees and the chest and whiplash. Employee 2 was treated and released.

An employee was operating a standup clamp truck, transporting a large box (washing machine) across a facility. As the truck passed a structural support beam, the corner of a clamp at the back struck the beam. The resulting jolt caused the employee to fall out of the truck, which continued to roll forward and struck the employee's foot. The employee suffered a partially amputated big toe.

An employee was operating a vertical lathe and using sandpaper to deburr the sharp edges of material on the machine. The sandpaper or the employee's glove got caught on the edge of the spinning part and the employee's right hand was lacerated.
On September 24, 2020, an employee was injured when the tugger he was operating was struck by a second tugger. The employee was hospitalized for rib fractures.
An employee fell down an exterior staircase and injured his right leg.
An employee was walking across the warehouse and was struck by and run over by a forklift that was operating in reverse. The employee sustained a fractured right shoulder and left leg.

Two employees were inside a man basket suspended by a tower crane. They were erecting a suspended scaffold for a CAT 3, which processes hydrocarbons. The suspended man basket descended about 14 feet in 1-2 seconds before stopping. The basket did not strike the ground, but one of the employees fell out of the basket and was hanging off the side. The employees were wearing fall protection at the time. Both employees were hospitalized. Employee 1 sustained four fractured ribs and contusions to the skull and thoracic area. Employee 2 sustained a facial skull fracture, epidural bleeding, and a left tibial fracture.
An employee was checking the blower on the truck when his left hand was pulled into it resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring finger.

A cable operator was staging a reel into the payoff. As she was attempting to manually position the shaft into the hole, her right thumb was caught between the metal reel and the drive arm plate resulting in a below the nail bed thumb amputation without bone loss.
An employee was returning census equipment when she tripped on a curb and fell onto the sidewalk, fracturing her hip which required hospitalization and surgery.
A delivery driver was on a ride-along with a fellow employee. The driver fell down some steps as they were leaving an address resulting in a left leg injury and an broken ankle that required surgery.
On September 24, 2020, an employee fell while riding on the bottom step of a reach stacker and was run over by the rear wheel, sustaining a crushed pelvis and left leg amputation.
An employee was clearing a package jam on the conveyor line. Her foot got caught underneath and she sustained a broken ankle.

Two employees were working as flaggers for a construction site and were assisting a truck driver back out of the site. As the truck was backing out onto the service road, a motorist struck one of the flaggers who was in the street. The employee received head and bodily injuries. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was operating the rolling machine and crushed their left index finger and thumb. The index finger was amputated.
An employee was putting steel bands on a cardboard bale at the baler. She stepped back, tripped, and fell backwards resulting in a broken forearm.

On September 24, 2020, at about 7:20 AM, an ATV unit agent was assisting in the apprehension of three suspects. While working the group via the ATV, one suspect ran out of a cornfield in front of the ATV. The agent applied the brakes to avoid striking the suspect, flipping the ATV in the process. The ATV then rolled over the agent. The agent was hospitalized for a fractured scapula.

An employee was making a metal platform. As the employee was moving the metal platform with a half-ton jib hoist to weld the platform, the strap broke and the metal platform struck the employee knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.

An employee was pushing a metal mold onto a shelf. When the employee pushed on the top bar, it glided and the employee's right middle finger was pinched between it and the surface of the mold. The fingertip was amputated from the bottom of the nail to the top.
An employee's finger was caught by a material feeder's screw conveyor, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was preparing to take out cardboard recycling with an electric ride-on pallet jack when his foot became caught between his pallet jack and a stationary pallet jack. His left foot was crushed and sustained a muscular injury requiring hospitalization.

An employee was walking out of a box truck when he lost balance and fell. He put his arms out and his left hand caught on the truck loading ramp. The middle and ring fingers were crushed to the nailbed.
During a crane lift, a piece of temporary support steel fell from the load that was being lifted and struck the crane's signalman. The signalman sustained fractures to the leg and ankle.
An employee was taking the cap off a pressurized fire hydrant. The cap blew off and struck the employee in the right leg fracturing the tibia and fibula. The employee required surgery.
An employee was pouring the shower pan and fell from the second floor deck to the ground floor. The employee was hospitalized for fractured ribs and facial fractures.

An employee was using a chainsaw to trim a tree on the shoulder of the highway. The employee either lost his footing or was hit by a branch and fell from the tree, landing on one side. The chainsaw landed on his other side. He sustained a compound fracture to one leg.

On September 24, 2020, at approximately 11:00 a.m. an employee was walking from an area to the next well. A guide bar for the rear drilling area was lodged on a matting board. As the employee attempted to dislodge the guide bar, he was struck by the bar resulting in a fractured lower right leg.

An employee was trying to remove a sheet pan from a dish machine, where it was causing the dish racks to jam. The momentum of the racks re-latching onto the dish conveyor dislodged a sheet pan in the next rack, which fell onto the employee's left hand and severely lacerated the ring finger.
A letter carrier was bitten by a dog, leading to a wound on their right calf.
A trail guide was bucked off while attempting to get on his horse. He landed on his right side and fractured his hip and wrist.

After finishing work on a fence, an employee started picking up tools to put them in a golf-cart. The employee was in front of the golf-cart when it struck her. She sustained several fractures including a broken leg and ankle that required surgical repair.
An employee fell 15-18 feet through a vent opening while cleaning a construction site and suffered multiple fractures.

An employee was loading liquid fertilizer from the safety rack onto a tank that was on the trailer of a truck. The truck moved and pinched the employee's leg between the safety rack and the trailer. The employee was hospitalized with two broken bones in the right leg, located 14 inches above the ankle.

The driver of a full-sized bus was replacing a set of drive belts that had broken/frayed while he was on route with a busload of passengers. While doing so, his hand was caught between the crank shaft pulley and a belt resulting in severe lacerations to fingers and a fingertip amputation.
An employee's right middle fingertip was amputated while working on a crimping machine.
An employee was about to inject a vaccine into a chicken when the chicken struggled and the employee injected the vaccine into her own wrist.
An employee was getting tools from a tool box. The box's lid struck the employee's head, causing a scalp laceration.

An employee fell while moving from a roof to a ladder. The employee landed on the ground and a metal grate, about 10 feet below, and suffered a broken left wrist; a broken nose; and lacerations to the right foot, right knee, and right-side forehead.
A crew member developed chills, nausea and vomiting. He was hospitalized for pneumonia.
An employee was stepping up to a platform approximately 24 inches off the ground when he lost balance and fell backward, fracturing his elbow.

On September 25, 2020, at approximately 3:00 a.m. a maintenance employee was investigating liquid on the shackles on Line 2 in the evisceration department when, while dabbing the liquid with his gloved hand, his glove became caught in the chain line above a shackle resulting in the partial amputation of his right middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jam on the straw machine and amputated their right middle finger.

A crew was using a hydraulic tunneling jack to push a carrier pipe into a tunnel. An employee was adjusting the rigging on the tunnel jack machine when the push plate became dislodged from the end of the pipe and fell. The plate struck the employee and came to rest on the backside of the tunnel pit. The employee sustained a compound fracture of the left humerus, a fractured right ulna, and lacerations to the head and knees.
An employee was collapsing a portable paint booth when the booth tipped forward and landed on them. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was using a push-pull slam wrench to land a base section of a wind tower. The tool struck the employee's abdomen, causing a mid-section hematoma.

An employee was making a 13-inch bushing on a vertical turning lathe. The lathe moved down and in, causing the chuck to break free and strike the employee's left ankle. It broke the ankle and lacerated the employee's left foot.
An employee was climbing down a ladder. He fell, landing on the ground less than 4 feet below. He was hospitalized.

An employee was setting a coil of steel on an arbor of a steel slitting machine. As he was picking up something on the floor, an opening of the arbor caught his right ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

While putting up some tube steel, an employee was climbing up an extension ladder. The ladder's feet slid out and the employee fell about 10 feet to the ground, landing on both feet. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture in the top of his right foot.

An employee was completing a quality check at the coating section of the paper machine. As the employee was clearing a coating buildup from the applicator roll, the employee's left hand was caught in a nip point between the applicator roll and coater roll and crushed.

An employee was removing a sensor from the wellhead when a pressure release caused the sensor to blow into the employee's chest. The employee was knocked backward eight feet and landed on piping. The employee sustained a broken collar bone, humerus, and femur and a right leg laceration.
Three employees were struck by a private vehicle while setting up flagging stations. Two employees were hospitalized for broken legs and ribs.
An employee was assaulted in a parking lot after closing a store. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a tablet press that presses powdered material to form pills. The powder was not flowing evenly into the machine. The employee was moving excess product back into the feed frames and dies when her left index fingertip and fingernail were amputated.
An employee had finished his delivery route and returned to his work facility. He then began to experience heat stress and dehydration symptoms such as cramping, vomiting, and tongue swelling.

An employee was measuring a second-story window from the inside. The employee fell out of the window to the ground, suffering an injury to a major artery and fractured ribs, both injuries requiring surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's right ring finger was caught between the valve body and valve disc during a function test of the actuator/valve assembly. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was running wood through a moulder and crushed both middle fingers. One finger required surgical amputation.

An employee was preparing to put the nip on the railing system. The nip did not roll in straight. While rolling the nip back out, the bolts broke and the nip fell onto the employee's left foot fracturing it.

An employee removed a semi-refrigeration unit from the semi-trailer to repair it. After repair, the employee was putting it back on the semi-trailer, but the bolts did not line up. As the employee tried to adjust the bolts, his left index finger was caught between the refrigeration unit and the semi-trailer resulting in amputation of his nail and a quarter inch of his finger.
An employee was tilting a floor grinder back when the handle released, causing the employee to fall to the floor and break his hip.
An employee was clearing a piece of cheese from a packaging machine when the rotating equipment cut palm the employee's right hand and amputated their right index finger.

An employee was making improvements to a railing on an upper floor of a steel structure. The employee fell 14 feet through a roof opening to a lower level and sustained seven broken ribs, and fractures to the wrist, elbow, and pelvis.
An employee was working on a wind turbine when an arc flash burned their hands and back.
An employee was deboning the head of a carcass. His knife slipped and stabbed his left hand.

An employee was checking to see if the outrigger wire was tight enough. He grabbed onto the outrigger wire and it slipped, causing him to fall approximately 20-25 feet from the platform and into shallow water and a riverbed road below the bridge. The employee suffered multiple arm and leg fractures.
An employee was installing insulation at a customer's house. As he was climbing down an A-frame ladder, it shifted and he fell. His arm was pinned under the ladder and broken.

An employee was removing the trailer hitch from a customer's vehicle at the carwash. A second carwash customer pulled up behind the employee and pinned him between the two vehicles. The employee sustained a fractured spine and lacerated liver.

An employee was measuring a pallet. A forklift drove into him, and its own load of pallets pinned him against the pallet he was measuring. He suffered severe bruising around the ankles and a broken heel bone.
An employee was treating rooms with bleach for mildew. He suffered a serious asthma attack and was hospitalized.

An employee was on the roof over a garage to install a gutter above the garage. He slipped and fell approximately 10 feet onto the concrete driveway. He sustained a fractured skull and a broken wrist. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
While removing a tire from the wheel of a semi-truck, an employee's left ring finger was caught between a tool and the wheel. The finger was partially amputated.

The associate was going up to the roof to check the air conditioning unit. The associate jumped off the ladder on his way down and landed awkwardly on the concrete resulting in a left leg sprain and tear.

An employee was cutting the heads off a solar panel harness when he touched the torque tube (metal frame on solar panel) and was shocked. He suffered a loss of consciousness and had an irregular heartbeat.

A temporary employee was handing barrels to another employee off the back of a truck. A barrel fell on top of another barrel and the temporary employee lost balance and fell off the truck. The employee sustained a broken pelvis.

At about 5:20 p.m. on September 26, 2020, an employee was on a table about 2 1/2 feet high, checking for a blockage in a metal chute that deposited sirloin onto an overhead conveyor. The employee fell, and their right little finger became lodged between the chute and a metal shield used to prevent product from falling off the conveyor. The fingertip was amputated at the last joint.
An employee was closing a tanker of milk and pushing the valve in to lock it in place when his right index finger was caught in the valve mechanism and amputated.
While an employee was removing the wooden shipping frame from a bundle of metal purlins the purlins shifted and pinched his left middle finger between the purlins resulting in an amputation.
An employee was installing cement board siding from a stepladder. The employee fell 8-9 feet from the ladder, suffering several broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was servicing bait stations on the exterior of a facility. The employee was stepping over an air conditioning supply line which was 8-10 inches above the ground, when his left foot was caught on the line. His leg twisted, causing him to fall and fracture his left femur.

At approximately 9:30 p.m. on September 26, 2020, a Nesco Resource employee retrieving a diaper that had fallen between the rollers on a running conveyor when her hand was caught in the belt/pulley system resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was on a 24-foot extension ladder doing touch up work on cornerbead at a window. The ladder slipped on paper that was protecting the floor and the employee fell. The employee sustained a broken femur and arm.
The injured employee was spreading rubber pellets across a track and was struck by a forklift that was moving a super sack of rubberized pellets. The injured employee suffered fractures to both legs.

On September 26, 2020, the cable line of a workover rig failed, causing the block to fall and strike a platform where an employee stood. This caused the employee to fall from the platform. The employee landed about 34 feet below and suffered broken bones and a laceration.
An employee was operating a forklift when it backed into the forks of another forklift. The forks lacerated the employee's chest.
An employee was caring for patients. A patient struck the employee, who fell to the ground and suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was attempting to reset a sensor on the crane when their hand was pinched between the crane and an intermodal box resulting in finger amputations.

A temporary employee was bagging the forming head on a packaging machine so the machine could be pre-rinsed. The forming head activated, coming into contact with the employee's left hand and partially amputating the middle finger.
An employee performing a yearly routine maintenance task received second degree burns to the arms, shoulder, and neck and was hospitalized.
On September 27, 2020, an employee's hand was caught in the rollers of a corn husker resulting in crushing injuries including fractures to the middle two fingers and hospitalization.
An EMT was restocking the vehicle, when her co-worker leaned on the fire extinguisher expelling foam. The EMT developed shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The forklift was about to hit a pallet and she jumped off; the forklift then rolled over her left foot, resulting in broken toes and a cut.

An employee was on a ladder masking an area to paint. The beam the ladder was leaning on dislodged, causing the ladder to tip over and the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a moving conveyor belt. Her right hand was caught between the belt and an interior sprocket, causing lacerations and potentially broken bones. She was hospitalized.
A census taker was hit by a vehicle while crossing the street, and suffered multiple broken bones.

An employee was operating a forklift while holding the spotters line. The slack from the line wrapped around the back wheel of the forklift and when the wheel moved it tightened and crushed the employee's left hand.
An employee was cutting shims using a circular saw. The saw kicked back and amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a material handler. The pin broke and the forks and shaft came down on the employee, breaking his left leg.

An employee was unloading vehicles from a car carrier. As he was releasing one of the chains that held a car down, the car rolled backward and the chain caught his glove. His left hand was pinned between the chain and the aluminum deck, and the index finger was injured. He was hospitalized and the finger was medically amputated above the knuckle.

Two employees were performing maintenance and repair on a press. Each one of them was standing on a ladder. One of them slipped on the third rung from the bottom of their ladder and fell about 3 feet, striking a protruding part of the press. The employee suffered broken ribs and a lacerated arm, and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a head from a fitting assembly when her finger was pinched in the fixture. She suffered an amputation.
A temporary employee was in the fields picking cucumbers when he became disoriented and lightheaded and developed cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration/heat exhaustion.
An employee was closing the garage doors on a new construction project. Two of his fingers were caught in the door/rails, and the fingertips were amputated.
On September 28, 2020, an employee was closing a truck trailer door when his finger was caught in the joint of the door, resulting in an avulsion and the loss of a fingernail.

On September 28, 2020, while walking in the facility, an employee stepped on a tacky mat and one shoe stayed stuck, causing her to lose her balance and fall forward. She landed on her left hip fracturing it and lacerated her left index finger as she tried to catch herself by grabbing onto the lockers. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was inspecting a truck and its load and making necessary adjustments. He fell from the driver's-side truck stairs and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken right leg and right ankle.
An employee's hair was entangled in a conveyor. While trying to free her hair, her thumb was caught in the conveyor roller causing a fracture and laceration.

An employee was standing on the forks of a ride-on electric pallet jack which were raised approximately 9-12 inches from the floor to retrieve a box that was approximately six feet from ground level. The employee's knee gave out and the employee fell to the ground hitting the forks of the pallet jack in the process. The employee sustained a possible pelvic fracture.
An employee was turning a forklift into an aisle. The forklift struck a pole, which caught the employee's left ankle and broke it.
An employee slipped on grass near a break patio. He fell to the ground, broke his right fibula, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
Employees were unbinding a gondola cart door using a front-end loader. The gondola cart door sprung open and struck the employee in the upper back and neck area.

An employee was driving a forklift up a ramp. His right hand hit the ramp wall. The first four of his fingers were crushed, and the cutouts on a propane tank he was holding lacerated his hand. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was shaping a piece of sheet metal when the tip of his right thumb was pinched by the material.

An employee was using a press brake to form 2-by-2 metal sheets into a box. As he was retrieving a metal piece, his right hand was caught in the point of operation as the press brake activated. It closed on his finger tips, causing partial fingertip amputations to the right index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was caulking a window from a ladder. The employee fell to the brick patio about 10-12 feet below, suffering a head injury.

An employee was using a rope to move a sick cow out of a pen. The cow suddenly moved and the employee's fingers were caught between the rope and a saddle horn. His right index, middle, ring, and little fingers were amputated.

An employee was operating a backhoe carrying a bucket full of dirt. He approached a wall and prepared to dump the dirt against it; as he was raising the bucket, the backhoe's front tire fell into a soft spot and the backhoe tipped over. The employee suffered a broken left femur.
A coral snake bit an employee. He was hospitalized.
An employee was stung by a bee, lost consciousness, and fell, hitting their head.
An employee fell from a ladder while getting supplies from a storage room. The employee suffered two broken ribs.
An employee was feeding sheet metal into the transverse duct connector machine when his hand was pinched between the first set of rollers resulting in medical amputation of his left index fingertip.

A lineman contacted an energized 7,200 single-phase line while pulling copper ground wire. The employee received an electric shock resulting in burns to the right shoulder, neck, chest, shin and thigh.
On September 28, 2020, an employee was cutting straps with a round knife machine. The blade partially amputated his left middle finger, cutting through the bone.
An employee's left leg was caught under the rear tires of a moving forklift resulting in a compound fracture and hospitalization.
An employee opened a hatch on a pasteurizer. Hot water sprayed out and burned her hands and legs.
An employee fell from a fence to the ground, landing on their feet. The employee suffered a neck injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was dismantling a boom when his left ring finger was caught between two pieces of angle iron resulting in amputation of the first digit.
An employee was loading a rack, tripped on a step that was three feet high and fell hitting her head on the floor.

An employee was attempting to load a heifer into a trailer and placed a rope around the saddle horn to pull the heifer into the trailer. The rope slipped off the saddle horn and the loop in the rope quickly tightened around the employee's right middle and ring fingers due to the calf pulling back on the rope. The fingernail and skin was removed from the tip of his right middle finger and the right ring finger was fractured.
An employee was sanding underneath a second story roof eve and fell off the roof to the ground. The employee sustained broken bones and lacerations.

On September 29, 2020, at approximately 1:45 a.m., an employee was visually inspecting a chain on top of the east scald cabinet of the kill floor when he slipped. To avoid a fall, he put his right hand down in the sprocket and chain. He was able to pull his hand free, but sustained two fractures to his middle finger, a fracture to his index finger and a laceration on the back of his hand that required surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was working with a crane operator to load an auxiliary cab onto a platform. The employee used a pipe to ensure proper spacing between the cab and the other equipment previously installed on the platform. When the cab was lowered, the employee's right middle finger was pinched between the cab and the platform. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was bent over, cutting a roof membrane with a razor knife. The employee fell through a gypsum panel to a concrete floor slab about 18 feet below, suffering spleen and liver injuries, head trauma, and broken facial bones.

An employee was replacing a chain on the palletizer machine when his hand was caught between the chain and sprocket. His left middle fingertip was crushed and surgically amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee entered a cardboard baler behind a heavy, 4 1/2-foot by 6-foot metal door. A forklift moving a load struck the door, which in turn struck and injured the employee.
On September 29, 2020, an employee's fingers on both hands were crushed in a press brake machine while bending steel pieces. Eight fingers were amputated. Six fingers were reattached.
A contractor employee sustained a possible amputation of the left leg below the knee during explosive blasting.

An employee was climbing a stepladder to check the coolant level on a roof. When the employee tried to open the cooling tower door, the handle broke off and he slipped and fell. He landed on his back about 3 feet below. He was hospitalized.

An employee was starting to climb a utility pole after attaching the lower removable rung assembly. When the employee stepped on one of the rungs, it gave way and locked in place. The employee fell backward to the ground 4 feet below. The employee sustained back pain between the shoulders.
An employee's fingertip was amputated after being caught in a pinch point.

An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck as he walked to a pipe rack. His right leg was pinched under the wheel and he suffered ligament and tendon damage. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was preparing to lift the averaging arm on a milling machine and place it in the locked position so the milling machine could back up and get into position to start a new cut on asphalt. The milling machine started backing up. Another employee grabbed the averaging arm by the end to help the first employee; it raised unbalanced, the opposite end teetered, stuck into the asphalt surface, and the end the second employee was holding lifted. The employee's right index and middle fingers were caught, lacerated, and fractured between the averaging arm and the milling machine. The index finger was medically amputated below the joint and the middle finger was amputated at the tip.
An employee was sitting on a handrail for a scene and fell backwards. She fell down approximately 6-8 stairs and landed on the floor. She suffered a right rib fracture.
On September 29, 2020, an employee was showing a press to a coworker. When the employee grabbed the frame of the press, the press pivoted and fell over, breaking the employee's legs.
An employee was closing a large security gate. A gust of wind pushed the gate, causing the employee to fall to the concrete ground and suffer a broken hip.
A contract employee was driving a forklift in a warehouse. As he went around a corner in an aisle, his hand was caught, crushed, and lacerated between the forklift and a rack.

An employee was straightening a counter in a hardware department. A bottle of liquid drain opener fell, and its cap and seal broke. The liquid spilled onto the employee, causing chemical burns to her right leg, face, and arms. She was hospitalized.
An employee was ascending a 12-foot ladder and fell when he was approximately half way up the ladder. The employee suffered a broken clavicle and collapsed lung.

The injured employee was helping another employee unload pipe from a delivery truck. As an employee lifted pipes with a forklift, a shorter pipe slipped off the forks and hit a wedge, which hit a 4" x 4"x 8' board. The board spun up and struck the injured employee in the abdomen, causing blunt force trauma to the abdomen that resulted in removal of part of the small and large intestines.
An employee was troubleshooting a bean huller when their right thumb was amputated above the first knuckle by the motor of the bean huller cyclone.

On September 29, 2020, an employee was working on a warehouse roof. As he looked for an anchorage point, he fell through a skylight to the floor 12 feet below. He suffered a skull fracture and a spleen injury; he was hospitalized and his spleen had to be removed. Fall protection was being worn, but was not anchored at the time of the incident.
An employee was walking to the walk-in freezer at the back of a restaurant. He slipped on some French fries that were on the floor near a potato sink, fell, and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was disassembling metal racking. A piece of racking fell and struck the employee, causing head trauma. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking in a warehouse, injuring his left hip.

An employee was stepping in and out of a cardboard gaylord container through a cutout, retrieving small merchandise items from the container. While stepping out of the container, the employee tripped on the bottom of the cutout and fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing next to a bundle of purlins, guiding the telehandler operator to establish fork placement. As the forks were entering the top section of purlins, the top bundle slid down off the lower bundle, landing on the employee's right foot and trapping the employee. The purlins continued to fall, landing on the upper part of the right leg. The employee sustained a crushing injury, puncture to the right lower extremity, and a muscular injury.

An employee was performing routine maintenance on a conveyor attached to rock crusher/screen equipment. While installing a new conveyor belt, the conveyor support assembly fell and struck the employee's legs. The employee suffered leg and possible knee injuries.

An employee was standing on top of a fuel truck refueling another vehicle. He slipped and a 3/4-inch metal rod (connected to the truck's railing behind the cab) impaled his left thigh, entering from the rear of the thigh but not passing completely through.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while walking to deliver mail. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while walking, hitting the floor and suffering a broken nose.
On 9/29/2020, an employee was planting sugarcane when he began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized due to heat stroke.

An employee was leaving from the rear of a box truck. As he exited the box, the roll-up door dropped and pinched his left ring and middle fingertips against the truck's deck. The fingertips were amputated.
An employee was cleaning the box chute for a crusher when his left hand slipped between the rollers while they were still turning, causing trauma to the hand and forearm and an amputation.
An employee was cleaning a deli slicer. The slicer activated and amputated part of the employee's right thumb.
An employee suffered five broken toes while delivering a package. He was hospitalized.

An employee was carrying a piece of glass (4' x 4') to a truck. When the glass was set down it shattered and lacerated the employee's right arm from his wrist to his forearm. The laceration required surgery.
An employee was unjamming a hopper and suffered a partial amputation of their left index and middle fingers.
An employee was raising a scissor lift when his right hand was caught between the top rail of the lift and a pipe. The employee's middle, ring, and little fingers were broken.

Employees were using an overhead crane to submerge metal I-beams and girders in a galvanizing dip tank. Other I-beams and girders were stacked on the shop floor waiting to be processed. The stack was bumped, causing three I-beams/girders (weighing about 4,000 pounds in total) to fall off and strike an employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized with multiple leg fractures.
An employee was lowering a boat from a trailer when a battery compartment on the tongue of the trailer exploded. The employee was hospitalized for multiple facial fractures.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a tanker trailer and became disoriented and unresponsive due to gases inside the tanker.
An employee was loading filter media into a pleating machine when her right hand became caught between pleaters, causing contusions and lacerations.

On September 30, 2020, an employee had just replaced a motor and belts for an aspirator fan blower motor. After tensioning the belt, the employee was rotating the assembly sheave to confirm the belt was properly seated. The employee's right index finger was caught between the belt and the sheave and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing an interior ladder to a rooftop. He slipped and fell to the concrete 10-12 feet below. He suffered a broken right hand and right foot and was hospitalized.

An employee opened an overhead garage door on a dock. As the employee was looking for IT cables on the outside of the building, he fell off the dock and hit his head on the concrete about 4 feet below. He suffered a skull fracture and brain bleeding.

The employee was working on a bearing assembly that was in a bench vise. As he was putting pressure on the part with a wrench to tighten it up, the part came out of the vise and started falling to the floor. The employee tried to catch it and pinched the tip of his finger between the falling part and the edge of the work bench resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was assembling truss components with a pneumatic stapler. He was moving the stapler across the truss pieces when he crossed his foot and activated the stapler. The staple went through his leather work boot into the joint of his big toe.
An employee was flipping a grate on a manual grinding line. As he was placing the grate on the table to lay it down, the grate came off the hook, fell, and crushed the employee's right hand.
An employee was walking beside a scissor lift, operating it via remote control. The lift's wheel struck and broke the employee's left ankle. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was attempting to set pressure on a pressure release valve and lost control of the end of a fire hose. The hose struck the left side of his face causing a laceration and a fracture that required surgery.
An employee slipped and fell off a dumpster while throwing trash. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a head and neck injury.
An employee was holding a part in place at the opening to a tube bending machine. The machine crushed three fingers on the employee's left hand. All three were medically amputated.
An employee was applying pipe identification to a pipe moving along a v-roller line. A support frame failed and the pipe fell over, injuring the employee's hips/pelvis and leg.

On September 9, 2020, around 10:15 p.m. the injured employee was assisting a Dupont ENI mechanic repair a breaker by holding a flashlight for the mechanic when an arc flash occurred causing burns to the injured employee's face and hands.
An employee was spotting for a construction vehicle as it backed up. The vehicle struck the employee.
After replacing a spring on an upset punch press, an employee was troubleshooting on the die side of the punch. The die moved and injured his right hand.

An employee was working from an 8-foot stepladder, preparing a piece of plastic conduit to be glued. The spreader brace bowed, causing a rivet to fall. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken left tibia.
An employee was carrying a pallet, tripped on a rock, and fell on the parking lot. The employee suffered a fractured upper right leg.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack and caught his right hand between the pallet jack handle and a conveyor resulting in a soft tissue amputation on the distal third finger.
On September 30, 2020, an employee tripped and fell in a parking lot, suffering a broken left hip.
A postal employee fell down a flight of 5 stairs, suffered a ruptured spleen, and was hospitalized.
A trainer was training a new employee on how to use a crimping machine. While the trainer was reaching to grab a device, the machine was activated and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
The grinding blade on a deactivated meat grinding machine amputated an employee's right middle fingertip.

An employee fell while climbing a poplar tree, landing on the ground about 30 feet below and suffering a broken femur, ankle, wrist, and pelvis, as well as minor compression fractures in his spine. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the femur.
An employee was climbing from one catwalk to another. The employee slipped and fell to the concrete floor below, suffering broken ribs and a head injury.

An employee was changing 4' fluorescent light bulbs using a 6' A-frame ladder. As the employee descended the ladder, he slipped from the third rung and fell to the tile floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis.
An employee was checking a safety valve in a wind turbine hub. The valve separated from the mechanism and struck the employee's hand, causing a 2 1/2-inch laceration.
An employee was pushing a cart loaded with crated eggs onto a lift to load them into a truck. The cart rolled over and fell onto his lower right leg fracturing it.

A temporary employee was tasked with releasing water from the pasteurizer. As she opened the main double doors, boiling water was released and the employee suffered burns to her hands and legs while closing the doors.
An employee was operating a forklift when his lower left leg struck the forks of another forklift resulting in a laceration and fractures.
An employee was at customer's job site to deliver rebar. The employee was hospitalized after his right leg was fractured by rebar.
An employee's right foot was caught between a powered industrial truck and a curb at the receiving dock. The foot was injured, requiring surgery.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the wood kicked back and the employee's hand slipped, making contact with the saw blade. The left thumb was amputated at the knuckle.
An employee was on top of an elevator installing some components when his foot got caught between the elevator and a ladder crushing his big toe.
An employee slipped and fell on the wet floor in the kitchen, breaking his hip. He was hospitalized and required surgery.
On October 1, 2020, at 4:00 p.m., an employee fell while exiting the rear of his delivery vehicle with a package for delivery, resulting in hospitalization for a pelvic injury.
An employee fell to the ground as he exited the rear of a postal truck and sustained injuries to his pelvis.
An employee was in a man basket trimming a tree and caught their right thumb between the tree and the man basket control lever resulting in a partial amputation.
A forklift operator was dumping a dumpster when his left middle finger was caught between the forks of the forklift and the dumpster resulting in amputation of the finger up to the first knuckle.
An employee tripped while walking up stairs and fell resulting in a tibia fracture.

An employee climbed up an extension ladder and began using bungee cords to secure a tarp to a railcar. He hooked one end of a cord and then pulled the cord so it would reach the anchor point for the other end. The cord broke causing him to fall backward off the ladder approximately 10 to 12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right knee and left ankle, and his left heel was shattered.

An employee was sorting wood as it came out of a sizing machine. While removing a stuck piece of wood, the employee's hand was pulled into the running machine. The middle and ring fingers were partially amputated and the left pinky finger was fractured.

An employee was starting a press. While feeding material into the die, a steel slug was ejected from the point of operation, struck the employee, and imbedded in their chest. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 1, 2020, around 6:30 PM, the injured employee was operating an order picker to fill orders. Another employee struck a pallet, which was then pushed into the injured employee's order picker, causing the injured employee to lose balance and fall approximately 15 feet to the ground. The injured employee sustained a brain bleed and fractures to the skull, ribs, arm, and shoulder. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee had been installing new blades on a wire chopper granulator. A metal shard got in the employee's left eye and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a piece of tape that was caught around a conveyor roller when his glove got caught by the tape and his arm was pulled in and around the roller. The employee's left forearm was fractured.
An employee was using an overhead crane to remove coils from machinery. The coil of metal fell and struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs.

A bucket truck was being used to remove limbs from a dead tree. A primary limb was cut, struck the limb of another tree below, and fell to the ground. As this occurred, a smaller limb broke off from the primary limb and struck the face and hard hat of an employee who was acting as a safety spotter. The employee sustained a fracture above the right eye.

On October 1, 2020, an employee was assisting a subcontractor with a valve packing repair. During the repair, the valve packing dislodged creating a chlorine gas leak. The employee was evacuating the area when the hose of her supplied air system pulled her mask off, exposing her to the chlorine gas. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding wood into a resaw when her glove was caught in the wood and her hand was pulled into the saw. The saw blades lacerated the knuckles of her left hand.
An employee was cleaning out the warehouse and burning cardboard boxes in a burn pile. A box had a paint can inside which exploded onto the employee causing burns to the face and hands.
An employee was working in a grain bin when the employee made contacted with the auger, resulting in a right leg amputation below the knee.
An employee was on a derrick connecting drilling rods. His fingers were caught between a drilling rod and a winch line and a finger was amputated.

An employee was getting a pair of shoes off a stockroom shelf for a customer. While descending the ladder, the employee lost her balance and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a crushed L1 vertebra and a concussion.

An employee was working on a streetlight fixture to be installed on a pole. The employee was caught between the lower boom of a bucket truck and a tool box, mounted on the bed of the truck. The employee suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee amputated their right ring finger at the first digit while processing turkey hocks on a machine.

While unloading restaurant equipment from a dolly, the dolly moved and an employee's finger was caught between the dolly and a stainless steel counter. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right middle finger.

On October 1, 2020, an employee was using a radial arm saw to cut 2x4's. An employee was removing a piece of cut wood when the teeth of the saw grabbed his gloves and pulled his hand into the saw. The left middle fingertip was amputated immediately and the ring finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was operating a bar support machine. The employee's left hand was caught and crushed in the bending area of the machine. Four fingers were amputated.
An employee was dismounting a TV from a wall mount at a customer's residence when his left hand was lacerated by the TV and/or the bracket on the wall. The employee required surgery.

The injured employee was handing a tool to another employee when he lost his footing and fell into a pit, landing on the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to the left arm and femur requiring hospitalization.

An employee climbed a fixed ladder on the glass crusher to perform a product purge. The employee pulled the handle on the diverter box and the handle snapped and broke. The employee lost his balance and grabbed the side of the metal diverter box with his right hand. The diverter plate fell on his right hand and crushed it against the side of the metal box. The employee sustained a laceration to the index finger which developed an infection and required medical amputation of the intermediate and distal phalanges.
An employee suffered burns to their finger and arms from an arc flash and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a walkie-rider. The walkie-rider would not stop and the employee's foot was crushed between the walkie-rider and a guard on a conveyor.
An employee was conducting an inspection in the parking garage and fell through a hole on the third floor. The employee sustained a clavicle fracture and lacerations.
An employee was troubleshooting a dicer and got caught between the belt and pulley resulting in amputation of the right thumb tip and tissue damage to an index finger.

The injured employee was assisting in the off-loading and stacking of plastic pipe using a backhoe and sling. A piece of pipe was lowered to the ground. While the injured employee attempted to remove the strap from the backhoe bucket lifting hook, the backhoe operator rolled the bucket to release tension on the strap and his right hand was crushed between the backhoe piston and bucket causing injury to three fingers. The employee suffered a severed tendon and a fracture to the ring finger.
While mopping the floor with hot water, an employee slipped and fell in the water. The employee sustained burns on the arms, torso, and buttocks.
An employee slipped in water that was on the ground next to the sink, fell, and struck the back of her head. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was moving a conveyor when it fell over and smashed his left middle finger resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was walking out from under a mezzanine when a stack of totes fell from the mezzanine and struck her. She sustained a fractured right tibia.
An employee was operating a table saw when his finger was caught in the saw's blade and amputated at the knuckle.

An employee was adjusting the photo eye on a conveyor line when his left hand was caught in the path of the diverter gate. When the diverter activated to switch lanes, the tip of the employee's ring finger was amputated.
On October 2, 2020, an employee was hospitalized with chest pains after using a draw sheet to move a patient from a cot to a bed.

An employee went to manually move a pallet on a non-motorized conveyor because it was not moving. Another pallet began to roll forward and struck the employee's left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
On October 2, 2020, an employee was struck by a motor grader while shoveling windrow. The employee sustained fractures to the right arm, right foot, and ribs.

An employee was using an ATV to haul a trailer. While maneuvering between a building and a concrete bench, one of the trailer's tires got stuck on the bench, causing the employee to hit his head on the dashboard of the ATV. The employee sustained a cut on the top of his head.
An employee was snipping a piece of wire off of a horizontal, temporary, piece of rebar. The rebar fell and struck the employee's thumb resulting in an amputation.
While framing a residential structure, an employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground and sustained fractured ribs.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it slid out. The employee fell nine feet, making contact with the ladder and sustaining a bruised spleen and pancreas.

Employees were transporting a mobile elevated work platform (MEWP) through a doorway to another location in the facility. A support bar slipped out of position causing the MEWP to free-fall to ground level. An employee's leg was caught between the mast of the MEWP and the loading dock floor. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture of the lower right leg.

On October 2, 2020, at approximately 8:45 AM, in preparation for cleaning activities, an employee crouched down beneath a conveyor belt. The employee lost balance and his left hand landed on the belt tension roller. He was pulled in between the roller and the belt, resulting in crushing injuries to the left hand and forearm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell from an extension ladder while working to correct a leak from a hydraulic hose fitting. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a trimming knife to trim a plastic container. The knife slipped, went through his protective apron, and punctured the right side of his abdomen.
While directing a crane from the second floor on a new construction, an employee fell 18 feet to the ground and sustained a broken left elbow.
An employee was opening bags and mixing sand in a paint mixer. His left hand was struck by the agitator and fractured.

An employee was clearing a jam in front of the wood sorter gate before the chipper in-feed conveyor. The jammed wood had pushed the sorter gate up to nearly the full-open position. The employee attached a chain-fall to one of the jammed logs. As the log was raised, the rest of the jam was relieved and fell on the conveyor below. The sorter gate then closed on the employee's right leg crushing it between the gate, a piece of wood and the surrounding frame. The employee's lower right leg was fractured.

An employee suffered a collapsed lung while lifting a jet ski hull that was raised on a hoist, pushing it sideways four feet to the press, and lowering it into place on the bonding machine. The employee was hospitalized.
While opening a steam-line valve on a pasteurization tank, an employee was sprayed by hot water and sustained burns to the left side of the body.
An employee fell 10-18 feet from a fixed ladder in a warehouse injuring his ribs and pelvis.

On October 2, 2020, a forklift operator was adjusting the shackle on the back end of the forklift connected to a train of kiln carts when a front-end loader pushed the kiln carts from the opposite end. The forklift operator was pinched between the forklift and the kiln carts and both legs were surgically amputated below the knee.
An employee had responded to a downed light pole outside of the building and possibly sustained an electric shock.

An employee was cleaning the rollers of a plastic extruder machine when he slipped or tripped and fell, becoming entangled in the rollers. The employee sustained cuts, broken ribs, and shoulder injuries.

An employee was exiting a scissor lift. He was climbing down the three steps and missed the last step, fell backward and hit his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with bleeding in the brain.
An electrical contractor was shutting the door to a company vehicle and caught their right thumb in the door latch resulting in amputation of flesh from the thumb tip.
