An employee was cleaning near high voltage cables and received an electric shock.

An employee was attempting to clear yarn that was being spun and starting to cluster at two large spinning cyclones. The employee's right thumb became caught between the spool of yarn and the yarn being spun resulting in amputation of the left thumb at the base of the nailbed.

An employee had been filling water tanks on top of a flatbed trailer. The employee jumped three feet to the ground from a ladder on the truck. When he landed, his right ankle twisted and he fell, resulting in fractures to his right leg and ankle.
An employee had been digging a 3-foot hole to perform plumbing activities. The employee sustained a leg cramp and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a buffer inside the electrical room to buff paint thinner onto the floor. The resulting vapor found an ignition source and an explosion occurred. The employee sustained burns to 43% of his body.

After finishing setup, an employee was making adjustments to the tooling on a trimmer machine. The machine was activated and the employee's hand slipped. His left ring finger was caught between a cogged belt and a wheel. The finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was performing maintenance on the box machine when his left hand was caught between two gears in the machine resulting in amputation of the third and fourth digits.

An employee was inventorying drums of chemicals and assisting a forklift driver when the forks became stuck in an elevated position. While dislodging the mast chain, the employee's right hand became wrapped around the chain and was pulled into the pulley system as the chain realigned. The employee sustained lacerations, three broken fingers, and a partial amputation of the index finger.
A stack of drywall sections on a construction site fell over. Five or six sheets fell onto an employee's right leg causing injury.

An employee was standing on a ladder scaffold with a wood plank platform, about 4-5 feet above the ground, placing siding on a house. The plank snapped in half and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken ankle.

An employee was trying to unclog a grinder's airlock. Metal paddles inside the airlock caught the employee's right index finger and thumb, amputating the finger right under the top knuckle and the thumb right above the top knuckle.
During a training exercise, an employee was learning how to secure a chain and fell to his knees. The employee was hospitalized and required knee surgery.

An employee was operating a triple pallet rider. While turning to the right to dispose of a pallet board, the pallet rider struck a support column and the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with fractured toes and a laceration across the top of the left foot.
While walking in the front door, an employee tripped on a mat and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a contusion to the head and a fractured arm and leg.
An employee had been watching contractors unload equipment. The employee slipped on gravel and struck their head on a truck's bumper. The employee was hospitalized and received stitches.
An employee was clearing a rice milling machine and caught his left hand in the auger resulting in fractured bones in the hand and wrist and amputation of the left index finger.
A sanitation truck driver's arm was caught between his truck and a dumpster. The driver sustained lacerations on his arm.

Two employees were moving a pallet of tower trays and beams using a hydraulic pallet jack when a board from the pallet became caught under one of the wheels of the pallet jack. An employee was removing the board when the hydraulics were released, lowering the pallet onto the employee's hand and resulting in partial amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was checking bags at an entry gate, tripped and fell to the concrete ground. The employee fractured their right arm.

On 9/28/2020, an employee fell from a ladder while reaching to perform ceiling work and injured his hip. The injury did not require medical treatment. On 10/04/2020, the same employee reinjured his hip while moving a couch and was hospitalized for treatment.
On October 4, 2020, a WSL agent had been working traffic earlier in the day and experienced abdominal cramping. The employee was hospitalized with a heat-related illness and dehydration.

A maintenance employee was rotating a belt on the canter machine by hand to check the alignment on the belt after a new canter head and arbor shaft were installed. His left thumb was caught between the belt and the sheave resulting in an avulsion and partial amputation to the left thumb.

An employee was performing scheduled maintenance on the side seal heater section of a filler. He was manually moving the heater bars back and forth when the cylinder engaged and retracted back from a closed position, pinching his finger between the heat bar and the frame of the sealer. He sustained an amputation to a finger.

On October 4, 2020, an employee was working at the dryer section of a machine. While feeding felt paper into the reel of the machine, the employee's left hand became caught between the mandrel and the seal, resulting in fractures to the index and middle fingers.
An employee was lifting a pan of food and felt pain in his back.
An employee was using a drill to ream out carbon rollers when his right hand got caught on the end of the reamer and was amputated.

A bakery clerk was walking back to her work area from the freezer when another employee inadvertently stepped backward into the clerk's path. The clerk tripped over the other employee's leg and fell to the floor striking her head and left arm. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left arm and head injuries.
An employee was operating a forklift and struck a bump. His left hand was crushed against the wall. The employee had surgery with an amputation to a finger.
An employee's right pinky finger was crushed by a concrete slab that was being transported on a moving belt. The employee sustained an amputation.
An employee was hospitalized due to respiratory distress after inhaling odor eliminator spray.
An employee was clearing a cup/foil jam on a filler when they were injured by the yogurt cup conveyor. The employee sustained lacerations to the left arm and left side and fractures to the left arm.
An employee had been walking a surveillance round. The employee was found unresponsive, and had sustained a head injury.
While removing sections of steel piping, an employee grabbed the cable of a winch. His left hand was pulled into the snatch block between the cable and pulley, crushing four fingers.

On October 4, 2020, at approximately 11:45 AM, an employee was in the break area on her official break. She had an altercation with another employee and was hit in the face by a closed-fist, causing her head to hit the wall. The employee sustained a fractured jaw and two broken teeth. Her injuries required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was screening bags at a security gate and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was moving the brake table attached to the drilling rig when his left ring finger was pinched resulting in amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was feeding scrap foam (strings) into a pelletizer machine. The feed rollers caught his glove, causing an amputation of his left middle finger.
Two employees were driving company vehicles on a farm road when they collided at the top of a hill. One employee sustained a left broken leg.
A mechanic was moving a pump into a trailer when the pump slipped and fell onto the employee's right middle finger causing a fracture and a fingertip amputation.
On 10/05/2020, an employee performing gutter installation/repair fell approximately 15 to 18 feet from a roof and sustained a broken ankle/leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a window blind when the saw jammed. As the employee tried to unjam the saw, the blade lacerated her right index finger and amputated her thumb.
An employee was delivering construction material. He suffered a back strain while reaching to lift a piece of material.
An employee was using a 4-foot shear to trim strips of cardboard when his left pinky finger was caught under the hold bar of the machine and crushed. The employee suffered an amputation injury.
Employees were repairing a distribution cable. One employee was trying to locate the faulty cable when it failed resulting in an arc flash that burned the employee's right wrist and forearm.

An employee sustained head and neck injuries while removing a form panel that was used to form a pilaster as part of a concrete wall system. There were 12 clamping bolts originally holding the wall in place while the concrete was poured. Six clamping bolts had been removed prior to the employee ascending the wall. The employee's task was to remove four of the remaining clamping bolts while ascending the wall and then connect the rigging from the crane to the panel so it could be hoisted out of the area. When the employee was close to the top of the panel, the panel came free and tipped over. The employee was tied off to the panel utilizing a personal fall arrest system. The employee fell backward with the panel and landed on the ground. The employee was not struck by the form as it fell.
An employee was working on a pill cutting machine and amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was operating a forklift. The forklift left the roadway and overturned and the employee suffered a fractured left arm and leg.

While on a route delivering mail an employee stepped out of their LLV onto soft/loose gravel, lost footing, twisted an ankle, and fell to the ground. The employee attempted to brace their fall with their arm which resulted in a broken shoulder blade.

On October 5, 2020,  a mower operator was trying to make contact with the injured employee. The injured employee was walking toward the mower operator and stepped on the plastic chute on the zero turn mower deck. The mower turned and the injured employee's foot struck the moving blades causing the amputation of a toe.

An employee had been leveling out a rock base in the storage yard. He tripped and fell on broken concrete, sustaining a knee laceration, torn tendon, and a punctured knee cap. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking out of an office, tripped over a box on the floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a hip fracture requiring surgery.
An employee was pulling some film from a double tray sealer when the cutter blade/heater came down and amputated part of her finger.

Employees were disconnecting a motor tool with a pipe wrench. The pipe fell approximately 6 inches, pinning an employee's finger between the motor tool and the hand rails. The right pinky fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a loading dock while a box truck was backing up into the loading bay. The employee was pinched between the trailer and the rubber seating around the bay door. The employee suffered fractured ribs and a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the hallway when a forklift pinned them against a wall, resulting in a chest injury.

An employee was climbing down a ladder to enter a submarine when they fell 6 to 9 feet onto a metal deck. The employee sustained broken legs and internal bleeding in the lower legs resulting in surgical amputation.
While climbing down a ladder, an employee slipped off the ladder and fractured an ankle.

On October 5, 2020, at approximately 8:13 a.m., an employee was preparing to string a cast extrusion line. When the employee ducked under the winder to grab the rope used to string, the carriage moved forward and struck the employee in the face. The employee fell to the floor and struck their head on the floor resulting in a severe head injury.
While using a battery powered reciprocating saw, an employee fell from a ladder to the floor. He fractured both wrists and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a tree that had just been cut and sustained trauma to the L4 and L5 vertebrae.
An employee was physically assaulted by a patient and was hospitalized due to multiple facial fractures.
While cleaning a tube filling machine, an employee suffered a partial amputation on a left-hand finger when the machine was jogged.
An employee was checking material inventories in the warehouse when he fell onto a pallet striking the back of his head and losing consciousness.
While moving a box from a cage and grabbing for the box an employee suffered a collapsed lung.

An employee was moving super sacks onto racks. The employee was standing on the second level of a rack, approximately 12 feet high, to guide the straps of the super sack onto the forklift blades. The employee stepped onto a board to move closer to the super sack and the board broke. As the employee fell his head hit the racking before landing on a super sack below the racking. The employee was hospitalized for fractured neck vertebrae.
An employee fell off the back of a work vehicle's bumper resulting in a head injury.
An employee's finger was amputated from their left hand while removing stuck lumber from a wood chipper. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee's right arm was caught in the mast of a forklift when the forks were lowered resulting in a forearm injury.

The injured employee was operating a compact tractor with a seeder attachment on an incline to spread lime. The tractor overturned and the employee sustained a fractured clavicle, fractured ribs and vertebrae, and a fractured lower right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
On October 5, 2020, an employee was pinned between a stand-up powered industrial truck and a storage shelf. The employee was hospitalized for possible broken ribs and facial lacerations.

While erecting a scaffold, an employee was descending a clamp-on ladder when he fell approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a dislocated shoulder and fractures to the toes, a  hip, and ribs.
On October 5, 2020, an employee was welding on a diverter gate that is positioned with bearings. When rotating the gate, the actuator cylinder shifted and crushed the employee's right ring finger.
An employee was unloading hogs from a transport trailer and suffered a right ring fingertip amputation (no bone loss) and a crushing injury to the right middle finger.
An employee was pinned between the crane stairs and the left front bumper of a van. The employee sustained a bone fracture.

An employee was preparing the molding machine for the shift by removing the sprue plug from the injector. When the sprue was removed, hot resin struck the employee's left hand and arm resulting in first and second degree burns.

An employee's right hand was caught in a pinch point between a cable and steel rods while he was shaking out steel rods at a new school construction site. His right thumb was amputated above the first joint.
While performing maintenance on a machine, an employee sustained a partial amputation to his thumb when his hand became entangled in the chain drive and sprocket.
While closing a safe door, an employee's finger was partially amputated.
An employee was driving a lift truck and caught his left foot between the lift truck and a bollard. The employee's left lower leg and foot were injured.

Two employees were preparing a vessel for cleaning. The injured employee was on the deck of the vessel handing pieces of plywood (temporary compartment covers) out of the side dive door to the other employee who was standing on the ground. The injured employee slipped and fell from the boat to the ground and suffered a rib injury.
An employee was removing a hose from a power washer and sustained burns to the right hand from the hot water that was in the hose.
An employee was using a concrete mixer that was attached to a skid steer and amputated the tip of his right index finger.

An employee was transitioning from the B deck of a rail car to the rail car side ladder. The employee lost his grip on the ladder and fell approximately six feet striking his backside on the hood of a parked shuttle pickup truck.
On October 6, 2020, an employee was operating a bagger machine. As the employee was getting a bag, the moving cutter knife amputated the tuft of the employee's right index finger.
An employee was unjamming a grinder's airlock. The grinder fingers in the airlock severely lacerated the employee's left hand; the middle finger was medically amputated.

An employee was changing out the skid steer bucket when the latch holding the bucket in place became stuck and wouldn't release. The employee used a hammer to release the bucket. The bucket fell approximately 18 inches and landed on the employee's left foot causing multiple fractures.
An employee tripped over a fan cord in the laundry room and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.
An employee was rigging structural steel components for hoisting. When hoisted, one of the sling hooks gave way and the components fell onto the employee and fractured a femur.

An employee was working on pipe welds. He was walking between two steel pipes when the pipes began to roll. His foot was caught between the two pipes resulting in a dislocated toe and a broken toe. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee became ill from Legionella bacteria suspected to have come from a chiller tower in the workplace.
An employee was closing a switchgear in an underground residential distribution primary when an arc flash occurred and caused third degree burns to the employee's hands.

An employee was tightening bolts on a flange attached to a pipe. The employee was repositioning the pipe by moving the trunnion back and forth to allow access to the bolts on the flange. The trunnion moved towards the employee and he tried to grab the base plate to try and hold it up. The base plate struck the ground and caught the top of his left hand between the plate and the ground causing fingertip amputations to his left middle and ring fingers.

An employee was performing maintenance on a cylinder assembly machine when their right hand was pinned between the equipment gate and the hold down on the machine resulting in multiple hand fractures.

An employee was performing maintenance work underneath a recreational vehicle (RV). Pressure released from a hydraulic bottle jack that was elevating the RV off the ground. The RV struck the employee's chest resulting in a fractured collarbone.
While descending from a crane's deck platform at approximately 68 inches in height, the employee lost balance and fell to the ground. The employee sustained two fractured ribs and a shoulder sprain.

An employee was applying ice and water shield to roof decking when he stepped on a piece of plastic and fell off the roof approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee sustained broken bones and internal injuries. Fall protection was not worn at the time.

An employee was turning a cart used for stacking lumber. The cart turned on and the wheel pinched the end of his right ring finger, resulting in amputation of the fingertip. The fingertip was reattached.

An employee had been repairing a cable line from a ladder. The employee was climbing down the ladder when it shifted, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip and lacerations to the wrist and head.
An employee stepped out of his truck at a public landfill, heard his knee pop, and fell. The employee sustained a separated left kneecap, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using a slag spoon to skim off impurities on molten gray iron. The employee dipped the spoon into the zircon wash and gray iron popped onto the employee. The employee sustained first and second degree burns to the left side of the palm, the forearm, and the abdomen.

An employee was moving 10 sheets (74 lbs. each) of gypsum board on a cart across the east parking area. A  caster wheel on the cart struck a storm drain with a slotted grate, causing a gust of wind to knock the sheets of gypsum onto the employee. The employee was trapped underneath and pinned to the ground. The employee suffered six fractures to his pelvis and was hospitalized for surgery.

The injured employee was working on the roof of a private residence installing membrane around a chimney. He was untangling his safety line from a co-worker's safety line when he fell approximately 9 feet to the ground below. The injured employee sustained a punctured lung and a brain bleed.

An employee was watching cable being pulled into a bored passage. He lost his balance, and his right ring finger was caught by a cable being drawn through a machine wheel. The cable pulling block partially amputated the finger.

An employee was trimming a tree that was adjacent to the tree he was tied off to. After completing the trimming, he swung back to the tree he was tied off to and the limb broke causing the employee to fall approximately 20 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.
An employee had been disposing of scrap bar and fell into the well of a receiving dock. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a fractured clavicle, and a punctured lung.

An employee fell approximately 16 feet through a plastic skylight panel on the roof and landed on the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured right hip and injuries in the right cheek and wrist.

An employee was removing metal roofing panels and fell approximately 10-12 feet through a skylight onto a pallet. The employee sustained a concussion, neck fracture, internal bleeding and a pelvic injury.
An employee was cleaning windows and fell from the lower roof level approximately 10 feet resulting in a fractured leg.
A maintenance technician was checking a newly installed label machine when the machine turned on and the collar and cylinder pinched and amputated his right ring fingertip.

On October 6, 2020, at approximately 10:45 AM, an employee was cleaning the tailgate on a semi-trailer. While shutting the door, the employee's finger got caught in the barn door hinge. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was walking on the deck of a rollback delivery truck. The employee walked around an excavator bucket and fell off the edge of the truck bed, impacting the ground. The employee sustained multiple displaced fractures of the pelvis.

An employee was cleaning/servicing a powder-actuated tool. While the tool was disassembled and the piston was against the palm of his left hand, the trigger was actuated. The tool was loaded with boosters and projected the piston into the employee's left hand/wrist. The employee sustained a punctured left hand.
An employee was doing maintenance on a machine. A fingertip on the employee's right hand was caught and amputated.
An operations manager was helping another worker unjam a dock plate when his middle fingertip was caught and amputated between the dock plate and a trailer.
An employee was lying on the grass on his break and was run over by a pickup truck driven by another employee. The employee sustained scrapes and bruises.

An employee was transferring liquid soap from one storage tote to another storage tote. The hose had pressure built in the line and when the nozzle was turned on to allow for liquid release, the liquid forcefully exited the hose and struck the employee's eyes resulting in chemical burns to both eyes.
An employee's right thumb was amputated by a sanding disc while sanding metal.

An employee was tightening battery cable using a wrench. His wrench touched a compressor, causing an arc flash which created a hole in the compressor. Freon was then discharged from the hole in the compressor, resulting in second and third degree burns to the employee's arm, face, and chest.

While passing lumber forms that weighed 100 lbs., an employee tripped and fell approximately 8 feet off the leading edge of a retaining wall onto the concrete pavement. The employee sustained fractures to the T6 and T12 vertebrae with a tension band injury to the T11 vertebra.
An employee fell while descending a ladder inside of a scaffold and sustained a head laceration.

On October 7, 2020, an employee was descending an extension ladder from the second floor and fell to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, two fractured wrists and a left orbital cheek fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was emptying the septic tank on the back of the bus. When the employee went to close the service door, his right hand was caught in the engine's fan belt resulting in amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when it struck a pallet stop. The employee's left foot was lacerated.
At about 6 p.m. on October 7, 2020, an employee was dismounting a forklift when their elbow struck the forklift's frame. The elbow was injured and began to swell; the employee was hospitalized.
An employee servicing a residential garbage route was hospitalized for heat exhaustion, dehydration, severe muscle cramps, and acute kidney issues.

On October 7, 2020, an employee was working at the gin stand, monitoring the gin process. The employee was trying to dislodge a wad of cotton when the gin amputated the employee's left ring and middle fingers, as well as an injury to the index finger that necessitated a medical amputation.

A contracted employee was brought on site to cap off an HDPE methane gas supply line due to leachate coming through the pipe. Hot leachate (150 degrees F) released from the pipe and struck an employee who was standing 30 feet away. The employee sustained first and second degree burns to the neck, chest, abdomen and arms that required hospitalization.

An employee was opening the gate/door to empty a load with the wheel handle beneath a powder blender when he felt pain in his right forearm. The employee was hospitalized for a muscle tear that required surgery.
An employee was cutting conduit with a portable electric saw. The tool bounced and the blade reached the employee's left hand, amputating part of the last joint on the index finger.
An employee inhaled chemicals from a spray duster. The employee lost consciousness and hit her head, resulting in a skull contusion.

An employee was unloading a spring-loaded fork on a powered industrial truck (PIT). A dislodged spring partially amputated his right ring fingertip. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was sorting through his load to locate cases and organize subsequent stops. He was stacking cases on the ladder platform of the freezer's side door. He placed his hand on a case and stepped to the side ladder. His foot slipped off the top step and he fell to the ground landing on his right hand and breaking his wrist.
An employee was removing dough from a machine when the machine blade amputated the upper section of the employee's left middle and ring fingers.
An employee fractured a leg while walking into the building.
While repairing a feeder in the hotel pool, chlorine splashed into the employee's right eye.

An employee was operating a punch press to produce ceramic parts when their left ring finger was caught between the two dies resulting in a fingertip amputation. The press was not guarded at the time.
An employee was climbing a tree when the limb system broke. The employee fell to the ground and sustained three broken ribs.
An employee was struck by a subcontractor employee that fell six feet or more from the roof and was knocked to the floor. The employee suffered a dislocated jaw.

On October 7, 2020, a temporary employee was unloading grain from the back of a semi trailer. His fingers were caught in the door while closing the trailer. The middle and ring fingers on the right hand were partially amputated and the employee underwent tendon surgery.
A hospital employee was standing by a door when a patient shut it. The door caught the employee's right index finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee working on the patent line was routing wire through the guide wheels and onto the pulling block when he brushed up against a hot wire that was in the vicinity. His fingers were then caught between the wire and the guide wheel resulting in amputation of the right middle and ring fingertips.

An employee was removing bolts from the diving door of a submarine using an air-driven impact wrench. When he removed the final bolt, the door swung down, pushing the impact wrench down on his hand. His thumb was pinched between the impact wrench and a support beam under the submarine. The employee sustained an amputation to the left thumb that included bone loss.
A piece of steel fell and broke an employee's leg.
An employee accessed the top of a fuel tank and slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left arm as well as scratches, cuts, and abrasions to the face and head.
An employee was brushing wood off a table saw. The saw amputated the employee's right index, middle, and ring fingers to the first knuckle.
An employee was hospitalized after receiving an electrical shock while operating a machine.
An employee was operating a Christmas tree baler when their hand was caught in the machine. The employee sustained an amputation of their right ring finger to the first knuckle.

On October 8, 2020, an employee was climbing an inside fixed ladder to reach and close a roof hatch. His foot slipped off a rung and he fell to the floor, suffering fractures to the lower and middle back.
An employee was walking down the steps, slipped, and fell onto his left hip.
An employee was loading trash into the back of his truck when he slipped on a trash bag on the ground and fell onto his left hip. The employee sustained a fractured hip requiring surgery.

An employee's hand came into contact with a pinch point on a stepper (a machine that moved wafers during semiconductor manufacturing), and the machine degloved one of the employee's fingers to the knuckle. The finger was later partially amputated.

An employee was using a table saw to rip a door jamb to size. The saw amputated the employee's right middle finger between the first and second knuckles, as well as causing injuries to the thumb and index finger that required stitches.
An employee climbed onto the back of the cones truck in order to secure a ice cooler and fell to the ground, suffering a forehead laceration and a broken finger.
An employee was loading a part into a machine when the clamping mechanism closed on their hand, resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was standing on top of a truck filling a tank-wagon with diesel fuel. The tank exploded, causing the employee to suffer burns and a broken leg.

After unloading processed meats from several walk-in ovens, an employee entered a walk-in cooler. The employee passed out and fell face-first to the floor of the cooler. The employee sustained a dislocated jaw and several teeth were knocked out.
An employee had a reaction to the fumes from cleaning chemicals, fainted, and was hospitalized for asthmatic exacerbation.

An employee was carrying a pot with hot oil and tripped on a grill that was lying on the kitchen floor. Hot oil splashed on the employee resulting in burns to the face, eyes, right leg, and both hands.

An employee was dumping pans of breader. While removing product, the employee's glove was pulled into the chain and sprocket. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the fingertip of the third digit on the left hand.

An employee was unloading a pallet from the back of a truck's trailer. When the employee got to the end of the lift gate his foot got caught between the safety bar/pallet stop and the manual pallet jack. He fell off the lift gate approximately 4 feet to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a right knee injury and a shattered fibula.
An employee's fingertip was amputated by a hay packaging machine.

An employee was moving equipment and roofing material on a roof. The employee fell from the roof to the ground 29 feet below, suffering three breaks to the left femur, a dislocated right little finger, and broken left wrist.
An employee was cutting boxes open with a box cutter. The box cutter sliced off the tip of one of the employee's fingers.

An employee was washing a barn using a pressure washer. Pressurized water struck a divider board, which then fell and struck the employee's arm causing the hand holding the pressure washer hose to angle down. The pressurized water then lacerated the employee's right foot behind the steel toe of his boot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a section of a roller conveyor into a truck for unloading. The equipment was pushed and pinched the employee's right middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip (with no bone loss).

An employee was checking the hydrolyzer inspection door for obstructions. When the employee opened the door, hot water splashed on his left forearm and upper right chest area. The employee was hospitalized with first and second degree burns.
An employee was assisting in crane operations. Rebar was being loaded when the choker slipped, causing the load to shift and amputated the employee's left thumb.
As a PIT was backing up, it hit an employee, knocked him to the ground, and ran over his foot. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture of the foot.

An employee was installing low-voltage electrical wiring and conduit from a scissor lift about 25 feet high. The overhead door was opened from outside and hit the lift, causing the employee to fall 20-25 feet and suffer possible broken bones.

On October 8, 2020, an employee was bringing down a sink from an upper-level shelf using a ladder. He fell from the ladder to the ground about 9 feet below, suffering broken ribs that punctured his lung.
An employee tripped on a curb and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was installing piping for an electrical cabinet that was set on blocks. As the employee tried to remove the door of the cabinet, the cabinet fell on him, breaking his pelvis as well as causing a lip injury that required stitches.

An employee was stocking shelves with chocolate products. The employee lifted a box weighing 20 to 30 pounds, and while twisting to put it on a shelf, he sustained an injury to organs in his lower right abdomen.
An employee's right thumb was caught and amputated by a rotating shaft in a component saw.

An employee was standing in front of a slab of quartz that was being moved by a forklift. The slab of quartz fell from the forklift and the employee attempted to stop the slab from falling. The slab struck his hand and amputated four fingers.
An employee was visiting a customer's location. While walking up stairs he fell on the stairway and sustained a fractured right ankle/leg. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was providing pest service at a client's home. While the employee was in a shrub, an insect bit him on the upper left leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking when his shoe got caught in the carpet and he fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the head and arm.

An employee was on the third rung from the top of a 6-foot-high ladder, putting a wooden pallet into an open dumpster. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground, suffering a broken right shoulder and a bruised right hip.

The injured employee was operating a sit-down forklift (PIT) with an empty pallet on its forks when the PIT got stuck in the grass and mud while ascending a slight incline in a grassy area in back of the building. A second PIT was used to push the stuck PIT out of a rut to no avail. A third PIT was then connected to the other two PITs with a sling tether and a heavy chain. The two PITs attempted to tow the injured employee s PIT out of the rut and the jarring motion caused a small rock or piece of mud to strike the injured employee in the back of the head, causing her head to strike the PIT frame. The employee suffered a loss of consciousness, a skull fracture, a subdural hematoma and a head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading motors when a pallet shifted and a motor fell and amputated the employee's finger.
An employee was operating a forklift when it tipped over. The employee was pinned under the forklift and sustained a broken pelvis and a leg injury.
On October 9, 2020, a furnace operator was unjamming a furnace and was overcome by carbon monoxide. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell through a skylight while performing roofing overlay, landing on the ground and suffering a concussion.

An employee was troubleshooting a dry ice block-making machine that was not forming ice blocks correctly. The machine engaged and the employee's left hand was pulled inside resulting in amputations to the pinky, ring, and middle fingers on his left hand.

An employee was checking a recompression evaporator when a moving fan blade inside the machine lacerated his left ring and little fingers. The employee underwent surgery, and the little finger was medically amputated.

An employee was operating a tube bender and noticed that one of the pressure dies was misaligned. The employee initiated a manual pause on the bender and then started adjusting the pressure die. A separate pressure die actuated, catching the employee's finger between the pressure die and a tube die causing injury to the distal phalanx of the right middle finger which required medical amputation.

An employee was operating a press machine. He was removing a piece of product stuck to the underside of the press when the fingers on his right hand were pinched between two press plates. The middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
An operator was examining the stacking section on the folder glue machine and the stop feed mechanism amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was levelling a formwork post when a wood beam (4" x 4" x 6') fell and hit her head and shoulder. The employee's shoulder was injured.
An employee parked the utility truck. The brakes were not set and the vehicle rolled back and pinned the employee between the truck and a metal pipe resulting in a hematoma.

An employee was operating a foam profile machine. As the employee attempted to remove a piece of foam from within the profile machine their finger contacted the blade resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was using a chain hoist to lift an angle hook that had been tack-welded to a metal plate. The weld failed, causing the plate to drop and strike the employee's left hand. Fingers on the left hand were injured and the index finger was partially amputated.
An employee contacted overhead power lines while in a truck basket and suffered electrical burns to the right arm, right side of torso, and right hip.

Employees were finishing one ground termination in a three-phase, 480 volt panel. The ground touched the feeder lug and the panel, which caused a short and an arc flash. One employee was hospitalized with burns to the face, hands, and forearms.

An employee was attempting to line up machined holes in a repaired gear box assembly's base plate to bolt it into the gear box cabinet. The gear box assembly was being raised into position and the employee was correcting the alignment when the gear box assembly shifted and caught his right hand between the upper interior cabinet and the gear box assembly resulting in amputation of the ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was cutting a 30 degree bevel on a 2x4 with a circular saw. During his cut, the saw bucked and the employee's hand contacted the saw, resulting in a partial amputation to the right thumb.

An employee was working near the edge of a pier and fell off the pier approximately 20 feet into the water. During the fall, the employee struck a barrier in the water. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis, a fractured right middle finger, fractured ribs, and a punctured lung.

An employee was using a rake to grade hot asphalt in a parking lot. The employee tripped over a car stop and fell onto the hot asphalt, suffering second- and third-degree burns to the lower back and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
While operating a tree cutter, an employee was struck by a 3-inch-thick, 3-foot long tree limb, suffering a laceration to the right side of the neck.

While working in the Rigger Shop, an employee was using channel lock pliers to disconnect two pieces of pipe that were bolted together. The pipe was raised by a crane. When the top bolt was removed, a portion of the pipe was pulled upward, and the other portion fell to floor. The employee's finger was pinched between lower handle of pliers and the portion of pipe supported by the crane. The employee suffered an amputation to his left ring finger.
An employee was standing on gate while corralling cattle. A cow struck the gate and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a fractured tailbone and collarbone.
An employee was arranging garbage in a dump truck and fell from the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist and elbow.
An employee was operating a shirt press when her hand was caught in the machine. The employee was hospitalized for burns to three fingers on her left hand.
An employee was clearing debris in a wood grinding machine and amputated her right little finger.

An employee was operating a paver when the mirror of a passing dump truck caught the seat of the paver as it drove by. The seat twisted and pinned the employee against the control panel, resulting in fractures to the ribs and sternum and a dislocated clavicle.
An employee was moving tires on a storage rack and fell to the concrete ground. The employee sustained broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was walking along a rack being towed. The employee tripped over a tow chain and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a fracture to the right arm that required surgery.

An employee was walking toward a deli station in a supermarket. She bumped into another employee and fell to the floor, landing on her side. She suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, requiring hip surgery.
An employee was conducting Census duties on the road and suffered an asthma attack due to smoke in the environment. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was sandblasting at a bridge when the nozzle and blast tip of the line unthreaded. The employee fell backward injuring his back and metallic grit (sandblasting material) caused an abrasion to his arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a 1,000 lbs. 10' x 15' rubber mat using an all-terrain powered industrial truck (PIT). While unrolling and setting the mat into place, the employee's right hand was caught between the mat and the end of the PIT's fork resulting in amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee was pushing a cart loaded with countertops when it tipped over on top of the employee resulting in three fractured ribs.
An employee was hooking up a trailer and was crushed between a jockey truck and trailer. The employee was hospitalized for crushed ribs.
An employee was climbing down a six-foot fiberglass stepladder and missed the bottom step. The employee fell to the floor and fractured his right hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was checking trash cans when he was struck by a forklift that was exiting a tractor trailer. The employee sustained a fractured right leg.

An employee was in the dish area when the dish washing machine stopped working. He opened the  machine to investigate and the track caught his right middle finger at the mid-point of the nailbed and partially amputated it.
A forklift ran over an employee's foot and crushed the employee's toes.

An employee was working on a roof overhang. The employee stepped down from the roof onto a step ladder, which tipped over, causing the employee to fall approximately 10-12 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured back.

An employee had been pulling samples from drums, placing them in jars, and placing them in the lab for testing. He headed to lunch, then returned and began to work in the lab under the lab hood. When he opened a jar, there was a flash fire and chemicals splashed onto him. He suffered burns to the neck, chest, left hand, and wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee received an electrical shock after inserting a wire into a molding machine.

On October 11, 2020, an employee was commuting to work on his bike. The employee rode over a speed bump on the company property and fell off his bike, sustaining a rib fracture, a scapula fracture, and a spinal compression fracture.
An employee was operating equipment that deposits brownie mix into sheet pans and amputated their right thumb tip.

An employee was hooking up a flatbed trailer to a pickup truck. While letting the hitch down onto the receiver ball, the hitch became bound. The employee jostled the hitch pin while continuing to let the jack stand down. The hitch slipped while the employee's fingertip was in the safety pin hole, causing a fingertip amputation.

On October 11, 2020, the injured employee was directing a passenger vehicle into the service bay. The vehicle pinned the injured employee against a tire machine. The injured employee sustained a fractured lower left leg requiring hospitalization.
An employee was transporting a patient on a gurney when she felt a sharp pain in the right side of her back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee experienced back pain after moving boxes.
While loading tubing product, an employee fell from a tractor-trailer and broke his pelvis.
An employee fell approximately 20 feet from a mobile scaffold resulting in left leg and lower back injuries.

A crew was digging with a rubber-tired backhoe to raise a valve can. The excavation was approximately 3.5 feet deep. Dirt from one side of the excavation collapsed into the hole and pinned the injured employee's leg against the existing utility in the excavation. The employee was hospitalized for a broken leg.
While climbing an external ladder on a rail car, an employee fell to the ground and sustained a broken right femur.

An employee was operating a powered pallet jack as part of PIT training when the pallet jack struck a warehouse storage rack. His foot was caught between the pallet jack and the rack. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to two toes.
An employee was cutting copper on a shear machine and amputated their left thumb.
An employee slipped while descending a scaffold and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken rib.

While working on the top level of scaffolding an employee tripped and fell through the side guard rails to the concrete ground approximately 18 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left femur and a cut above the left eye.
A delivery driver was organizing his truck for daily deliveries and fell from the liftgate to the ground. The employee suffered a dislocated/fractured elbow.
A fluid shipping employee was manually closing an equipment access door and amputated his right ring fingertip.

An employee was moving a box of office supplies from the back seat of his car onto a dolly. While making a twisting motion, he felt something pop in his back and felt a sharp pain and his feet went numb. He was hospitalized.

An employee loaded a part onto the forming machine and activated the machine using the two hand activation buttons. The machine pushed the pipe and the pipe touched the proximity switch which signals the machine to lower the pipe holding parts, but the holding parts did not come down. The employee was adjusting the pipe when the holding parts came down and amputated the index and middle fingers on their left hand.
While closing a gate an employee's finger was caught in a roller and amputated.
An employee fell while walking to the back utility room and suffered an ankle injury.
An employee was riding his bike down a trail and crashed. The employee sustained an arm laceration that required hospitalization.
A prep cook was operating a cooking vessel. The vessel boiled over and hot gravy splashed onto the employee. He suffered second-degree burns on his head, face, arms, hands, and torso.

While delivering vending machine products to a worksite, an employee's foot got caught in a dolly-cart that was leaning up against the inside of the box-truck. While attempting to get his foot unstuck the employee lost balance and fell, striking his ribs and spleen on the back opening-lip of the box-truck. He sustained three fractured ribs and a bruised spleen.
An employee was removing tape from the bench welder when his hand was caught in the bench welder. The employee received finger fractures and lacerations, as well as a possible fingertip amputation.

An employee on the deck of a marine vessel was attempting to free a jammed mooring line by manually pulling on it. The line popped free, causing the employee to fall backward onto the deck. The employee sustained a broken left femur.
A team member was unhooking the asphalt oil supply line from a tanker truck when hot asphalt oil sprayed onto his hands and arms causing burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) when her vehicle was struck by another PIT. The small toe on the employee's left foot was amputated.
While descending a 10-foot step ladder an employee slipped and fell, sustaining two broken bones in the lower leg.

An employee was setting up lane closures. A car driver crossed over four lanes and hit the arrow board (already set up) and the company pickup truck. The truck in turn hit the employee, who suffered a broken left femur, chipped bones in the shoulders, a broken right ankle, and three broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring water from the frac tank/settling tank to another tank. The transfer continued until sludge built up in the pipe. The employee then had to clear the sludge from the pipe. The employee blew the line out using nitrogen, at 40 to 50-pounds, then heard a leak coming from a cam-lock connection. The employee was securing the broken cam-lock mechanism when a plug shot out of the pipe and broke the employee's finger. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was running a line moling machine to clean the inside of pipe. When the employee went to pressure up the system using a 20-k water line, water from the hose injected into the pinky finger on his left hand.
A service technician was performing maintenance on a forklift when his fingers got caught in the carriage chains resulting in partial amputations to digits 4 and 5 on the right hand.
An employee was cleaning a plate on the press and amputated fingertips.

An employee was setting up slitter knives to be sharpened on a knife grinder when their right middle finger was crushed between a level used to align the grinding wheel and the grinding wheel guard. The employee sustained amputation of their right middle finger between the first and second knuckle.
At 11:30 a.m. on October 12, 2020, an employee suffered a broken femur while stepping off a pile of mattresses. He was hospitalized.
An employee went outside of an office building while other employees where fuming a honeycomb. The employee was stung in the head by a bee, went into cardiac arrest, and was hospitalized.
An employee was on a buggy in a driveway, moving trailers to storage and was struck by a semi-truck. The employee sustained contusions to the right side of the body requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a rag to wipe pieces of paper from the press rollers. The rag got pulled into the rollers and pulled the employee's arm into the nip point. Their right arm was degloved from the elbow down.
A temporary employee was working on equipment with a conveyor belt when he got caught in the equipment. The employee sustained injuries to the right calf, foot, and ankle.
An employee tripped and fell while going down stairs. The employee was injured and required surgery.

While walking through a warehouse facility that was being renovated, an employee fell through a floor hole where a grate had recently been removed. The employee sustained broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was placing a steel plate back into a rack using a 10-ton overhead crane and a plate clamp. The plate fell, hitting the employee's left foot and amputating the big toe as well as part of the second toe.

An employee was using a 4-inch angle router to remove residual weld from a tooling-removal area on an aluminum ring. The angle router kicked and its blade came into contact with a finger on the employee's left hand, causing an open fracture.

An employee was leaning into an office to speak to another employee when the office door shut and pinched his left middle finger between the door and the door frame resulting in an amputation with bone loss.
An employee was struck by a forklift resulting in broken bones in their right foot.
An employee slipped on water in a parking lot and fell, suffering a knee injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attempting to replace a wear pad on a crusher. A come-along, being used to hold an access gate open, came loose and dropped the gate onto the employee. The employee suffered a chipped and/or broken vertebra.

On October 13, 2020, an employee was riding on the tailgate of a pickup truck. The truck went over a bump and the employee fell striking his head on the concrete parking lot. The employee suffered a skull fracture and bleeding in the brain.

An employee had been media blasting for about an hour. Due to a clog, the employee lost control of the blasting nozzle. The employee's left hand slid in front of the blasting nozzle and the garnet sand used for media blasting went into the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized and their left thumb required a skin graft.
An employee's left ring finger was caught in the snake machine and fractured while unclogging a pipe.
An employee was walking up stairs. The employee's heel caught on a step and they fell backwards down the stairs, suffering lacerations to the left hand and right knee that required sutures.
An employee was landscaping around the entrance of the park when he was struck by a vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left leg and bleeding in the brain.

While working in a block house where concrete blocks were being manufactured, employees became lightheaded due to potential carbon monoxide exposure. One of them was hospitalized for high carboxyhemoglobin level resulting in headache and mild delirium.
An employee was operating a machine press to fabricate a piece of metal and amputated their right index fingertip.

An employee was cleaning a hydraulic conveyor roller while a large steel pipe was on the conveyor. The employee's right hand was caught between the conveyor roller and the pipe resulting in amputation of the employee's thumb and lacerations to the index finger and palm. The employee was hospitalized.
While performing maintenance on equipment, an employee's right pinky finger was caught between a belt and pulley resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was preparing to conduct welding on a row of U-shaped piping. He was walking on a plank board placed in the saddle of the "U" when the board flipped. He fell about 10 feet to the ground below, suffering fractures to the back and neck.

An employee carried a 50-60 lbs. roll of broadcasting cable around a truck to the point of deployment. He placed the cable on the ground and prepared to deploy it. When he stood up, he experienced pain in his abdomen. The employee sustained a laceration to his spleen.
An employee was steaming the inside of a production tank when a flash fire occurred inside the tank. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the face and third-degree burns to the hands.
An employee was picking marijuana buds and placing them on a tray when he suffered a severe asthma attack. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had just clocked out and was walking to his car in the parking lot when he was shot by an individual who had been waiting for him in the parking lot. The employee was hospitalized.
After looking into a box of mail, an employee lost her balance and fell, landing mainly on her right wrist.

An employee was on a roof to attach the roof ladder to the peak of the roof. The ladder slipped while he was trying to attach it to the roof. The employee lost balance and fell approximately 15 feet to the ground below suffering injury to his right side and shoulder area and damage to his mouth and teeth.
An employee was feeding scrap into a shredder and caught his left arm in the conveyor. The employee was hospitalized for injuries to his left bicep and forearm.
An employee was in an attic service space to perform maintenance when they bumped their head on an I-beam and fell back. The employee sustained a back sprain and a laceration to the forehead.

On 10/13/2020, at approximately 12:25 AM, an employee was walking past a moving conveyor belt when his left middle finger was caught by the conveyor. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee was cleaning the area and amputated their right index fingertip while moving a circular saw.

An employee was clearing brush, tripped on TV cable that was lying on the ground, and fell onto the concrete ground. The employee suffered an injury to his knee cap that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee fell from a 20' high flat roof, sustaining injuries to the left leg.

An employee was standing in front of a set of towed aircraft stairs, guiding a tow car back. The tow car backed into the employee, and his left leg was caught against the tow stairs hitch. He suffered broken bones and a damaged artery in the leg.

An employee was working near other contractors on site who were using ladders and tools. He was maneuvering around a ladder and a box of tools when his ankle got caught on the box and he tripped and fell onto his elbow. The elbow was fractured.
An employee was approaching an excavator and was caught between the swinging tail of the excavator and a tree. The employee's arm was crushed and had to be amputated.
A day care employee tripped over a crawling baby while holding another baby. The employee suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was changing the tip on a pressure washer when water was injected into their right hand.
An employee was clearing a clog in a paper shredding vacuum. The shredding blade moved and cut the employee's right middle finger, causing a partial amputation.

An employee was standing in front of a forklift carrying several 2,000-pound "logs" of aluminum. The logs were banded together; when the employee cut the banding so they could be unloaded, one of them rolled onto the employee's foot. The employee's steel safety toe collapsed, and the employee's toes and metatarsals were crushed. Part of the foot was medically amputated.

An employee was operating the snubbing unit snubbing a pipe out of the hole and laying down pipe using a single latch elevator on the driller side rig winch. The elevator got hung up on the tubing board above and the latch on the elevator opened allowing the pipe joint to come free, fall, and strike the employee in the forehead. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting and cleaning a probe on a newly installed power distribution transformer, after ensuring that the fuses were disconnected. The employee's left index finger touched powered equipment and the employee was shocked.

An employee was drilling holes in a piece of tube steel. As he was repositioning the material, it shifted, trapping his finger against the drill bit. The drill bit caused a laceration requiring hospitalization and tendon surgery.
An employee was struck by a reversing skid steer. The employee sustained a fractured left foot that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was robbed while delivering pizza. He tripped and fell while running away, and his face was injured where it struck the ground.

On September 14, 2020, an employee was climbing a fixed ladder to repair a roof. When he was four or five rungs up, he lost his grip and fell to the concrete floor below. He suffered a broken right leg.
While removing a temporary cover from an electrical panel an employee was burned on their right arm and face by an arc flash.
An employee was stocking product on shelves from a two-step stepladder. The employee fell, suffering a broken left arm.

An employee was moving a piece of copper alloy pipe he had just cut and cleaned. When the employee placed the pipe section on a stationary conveyor it bounced up and pinched his left ring finger against the frame, amputating the finger.
An employee was removing a light fixture from a conduit. He was using a fixture clamp vise and ratchet set. The fixture shifted and amputated a quarter-inch of his left index fingertip.

An officer was conducting border watch operations in a train yard area. While walking down a creek, he fell and hit his head on a tree trunk. He sustained a cut to the head and a potential concussion.
An employee was connecting a load to a crane when his left ring finger was crushed by the load chain resulting in medical amputation.
An employee was sliding a potential transformer on a trailer. The tip of his little finger was pinched between the transformer and another one next to it. The fingertip was amputated.

On October 14, 2020, an employee was installing ductwork from the third rung of an A-frame ladder. He fell to the floor 4 feet 9 inches below, landing on his back and suffering a cracked vertebra in his back. He was hospitalized.
While standing up from his desk, an employee fell to the tile floor and injured a hip.
An employee was coupling rail cars when an unknown object struck his left foot penetrating his leather boot and causing a laceration/puncture injury to his left foot.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, programming transmitters for the drive motor of an overhead door. The remote transmitter in his sweatshirt pocket activated the motor. His left index finger was caught in the exposed chains and sprockets, and was amputated at the distal joint.

Two employees were moving material that was loaded on a material cart that weighed 3,500-4,000 lbs. The material cart was on an electric pallet jack. The injured employee tried to help stop the pallet jack and was caught between the material cart and a support beam, sustaining a ruptured spleen.
An employee was exposed to a propane gas leak and was hospitalized for elevated carbon monoxide levels.

An employee was operating a chip spreader machine down a hill. The spreader began to skid when he applied the brake. The wheels locked and the spreader continued to slide down the hill. The spreader impacted a ditch and spun 180 degrees. The operator was thrown off the machine and landed on the bank of the ditch causing injury to his lower back.

An employee was on a flatbed trailer, choking a rigging sling to a concrete cylinder when he fell backward off the trailer approximately 53 inches onto compacted soil and sustained a broken right hip.
An employee was on top of a block wall, cleaning off debris. He fell off the wall to the ground (concrete and hard-packed earth) below, breaking both feet and his right fibula.

An employee was coming out of a room and turned off the light switch. An explosion occurred due to a propane line running through the ceiling in the office which provided gas to a heater. Three employees were injured; two of them were hospitalized with burns.
An employee fell while working in a trench, striking his head on a pipe. He suffered head injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was adding bags of minerals to a mixer. His fingers were caught in the rotating mixer blades while sweeping residual material into the opening resulting in amputation of the right index and middle fingertips. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee experienced an allergic reaction to latex gloves sold in the store, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee changed the battery of a forklift and dropped the battery on her foot. The employee was hospitalized for injury to the left foot/toes.
An employee had been stretching out a cargo net. He tripped on a pallet tie-down and fell resulting in a head injury.

A toolmaker was setting a pin in a die set using a hand-operated press with an overhead pull-down bar when the die set slipped. This released the resistance against the downward force causing the toolmaker to fall backward against a storage rack and then to the floor. The toolmaker suffered a head injury.

An employee was attempting to realign a floor plate in the metal transfer run when a coil of brass product fell off the buggy, pinning the employee's lower leg. The employee sustained a fractured  lower leg and wrist and a laceration on the back of the lower leg.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood frame boxes, concrete forms, and 2x4 boards. The saw slipped while cutting the 2x4 and amputated the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingertips.

The injured employee was working on a slip repair. He was standing on a sloped surface to spot for the articulating dump truck. A dozer was pushing dirt above and away from where the employee was spotting. A large dirt clod rolled from the dozer and struck the injured employee who slid down the sloped area approximately 15 feet and then fell over a benching of the hill that dropped approximately 5 feet onto the ground below. The employee suffered a fractured collarbone, hip, and pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting the tower to the spike when his finger was caught between the two. The employee's right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.

Crew members where unbolting a 40-foot riser pipe in order to separate the pipe in two pieces. When the bolts where removed, the pipes fell apart. The cable used to secure the bottom pipe caught an employee's left hand and pinched it between the pipe and the cable. causing a laceration to the middle finger and injury to the index finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was repairing a nitrogen line. Pressure in the line caused a fitting to come off the line and strike the employee, causing abdominal injuries and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was performing maintenance on a walkway above a tank that contained hot water (212 degrees). Rising steam caused second degree burns to the employee's leg.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam in the stacker/sorter. The machine activated, causing the stack of pallets to rise and amputate the employee's right thumb. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was removing a jack stand from a fertilizer spreader that is pulled by a tractor. The jack stand fell onto his left thumb crushing it between the jack stand and the fertilizer spreader. The thumb was fractured.

On October 15, 2020, at approximately 7:30 a.m., a field service technician had just loaded a drive unit into a van using a forklift. The employee exited the forklift to straighten the unit in the van. The forklift rolled forward and pinned the employee between the bumper of the van and the carriage of the forklift. The employee was hospitalized for broken bones in the right leg.

An employee was caught under partitions when they let go of the tie that was holding the partitions together. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, cracks to his spine, a punctured lung, and a minor neck injury.
An employee was cutting a 2x4 on a table saw and amputated the tip of their right thumb.
An employee was cleaning out trash from a conveyor line. The conveyor's chain caught the employee's left hand and amputated the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was adjusting a log on a conveyor when their leg was caught in the conveyor chain and amputated.
An employee was clearing a jam in the half pint machine and amputated their left middle fingertip when it contacted the conveyor chain.

A service technician was on a ladder repairing an aerial telephone cable at a customer's home. While descending the ladder, the technician fell approximately 5 feet to the ground and broke his left wrist.
An employee was working on a manufacturing line when his right arm was caught in the stacker machine and broken.
While walking to the lobby, an employee slipped and fell on a wet tile floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured kneecap.

The injured employee and a co-worker had just finished removing a cover from a roll of carpet when the injured employee's right foot and ankle were run over by a forklift. The employee's foot was fractured.
An employee fell from the cage of a forklift while cutting branches. The employee landed on the ground and fractured his right ankle.
An employee was working on a highway project when a track-hoe backed into a barrier causing the barrier to strike the employee's foot. The employee sustained fractured toes.

Employees were placing stumps in the back of a truck. The injured employee was in the back of the truck guiding the loader when the loader closed its clamps to exit the back of the truck and pinched the employee's left foot in the clamps. The employee sustained injury to a toe on the left foot.
An employee tripped on a raised curb near a building entrance. The employee fell across the sidewalk, striking their head on the base of a concrete pillar.
An employee was wiping a moving roller with a rag when the employee's left hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in amputation of their middle and index fingers.
An employee was working on the webbing machine when their thumb was caught by the polyester webbing and was amputated.
An employee was monitoring an electrode insulation process. The employee inhaled vapors from the coating tank and developed respiratory irritation and blurred vision. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a 1x4 piece of wood using a miter saw when the saw lacerated his left middle finger and amputated his left ring fingertip.
An employee was using a press machine to press the metal bars. While he was putting a new bar in the press was activated and the machine caught his right index finger and caused an amputation.
An employee cut into an electrical conduit wire while he was removing asbestos insulation from a demolition site. The employee was hospitalized for electrical burns.
An employee opened the gate to a cattle pen. The employee was knocked to the ground and stomped on several times by a cow. The employee was hospitalized with internal injuries.
An excavator bucket was being put on an excavator. When the excavator's arm moved, the bucket fell off and struck an employee. The employee's leg was broken in two places.
An employee was entering a restroom. The employee's foot got stuck and they fell to the floor, suffering two broken arms.

An employee had been finishing concrete while wearing gloves and a long sleeve shirt. The employee left work at 2:00 PM on 10/16/2020. The employee went to the hospital at 5:00 PM, having sustained contact dermatitis on the hands, arms, and back of the neck due to exposure to concrete.

An employee was hauling cotton seed and arrived on-site for a load. When one of the bins would not drop cotton seed, the employee opened the back gate to the trailer and stood on the cotton seed to poke the seed. The cotton seed fell, engulfing the employee. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a plow blade from a plow frame when the blade fell forward and struck the employee's left shin. The blade slid down the employee's left leg as the employee fell backward. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.
An employee was dragging a bucket filled with hot oil. The oil splashed onto the employee's boots, burning the employee's feet and ankles.
An employee was standing in a trench at a depth of 3 feet when the side of the trench collapsed. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

While walking into work, an employee stepped into a mulched area that was lower than the lip of the concrete sidewalk. The employee tripped on the lip of the sidewalk and fell, sustaining a broken pelvis.
On October 16, 2020, an employee was operating a joiner machine to flatten and straighten a board when his hand contacted the blade resulting in amputation of two fingers.
A temporary employee was replacing a printer plate on a jumbo press machine when the machine crushed his left hand. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking on top of a piece of cargo when the employee stepped through a section of plastic sheeting covering the cargo. The employee fell approximately 14 feet to the steel deck of the ship's hold and fractured their left shoulder, left ankle, and left wrist.
An employee was putting money into a safe. While closing the door, the locking mechanism amputated her thumb tip.
After talking to a customer, an employee turned to walk away, tripped and fell to the ground, sustaining a fractured left hip.

An employee had dropped off concrete at a residence and was cleaning out the barrel of the truck using a water hose. The hose got caught on the rotating barrel and the nozzle caught the employee's hand causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was unfolding a fold-up staircase attached to a mobile toilet facility. The stairway hinge caught a finger on his left hand, amputating it above the knuckle.
An employee received multiple yellow jacket stings after leaving the crawl space of a customer's home and suffered an allergic reaction.

On October 16, 2020, an employee was walking towards the kitchen at a customer's house when she fell and struck her head. The employee suffered a concussion and lost teeth. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hooking up two 28-foot freight trailers. His left hand was caught between a trailer and the converter gear, and he suffered lacerations and a broken middle finger.

An employee was operating a forklift and was attempting to push the button to open a garage door. The employee's ring finger was caught between the forklift and a pole resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was performing maintenance on a drum at an asphalt plant. The drum was activated while the employee was turning by hand, causing the employee's fingers to be caught in a V-belt pulley. Two of the employee's fingers were amputated.
An employee was trying to fix a feeding issue on a wrapper machine. The feeding mechanism pinched the employee's right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was on the ground removing a caster from a material handling cart. The 60-pound caster fell from the employee's hands. As the employee attempted to catch it, the caster struck their left hand causing multiple fractures.
An employee was working on an extension ladder, installing or repairing wiring, and fell to the ground sustaining a broken right leg.
An employee was working on overhead lines when he felt numbness in both forearms while making a connection.

A skid steer was grading rock along a curb for a parking lot. An employee was shoveling the rock along the curb to uncover the curb. The employee lost his balance while shoveling the rock and stepped behind the skid steer while it was backing up. The skid steer ran over the employee's right leg causing a compound fracture to the shin.
An employee fell off a ladder while spraying ceilings with paint. The employee suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was getting supplies from a closet. He fell over a cart, landing on the floor and suffering a shoulder injury that required surgery.
An employee was performing maintenance on a yarn twister machine. When the employee started up the machine, it caught and amputated the employee's left little finger.
An employee was escorting a customer to their car in the parking lot and was struck by a car as it was backing out of a space.
While pushing a cart of meat trays, an employee slipped on the floor and fell on his left hand resulting in a left wrist sprain and dislocation of two fingers on the left hand.
An employee was making an adjustment to the bagger machine. His right thumb got caught between the chain and the sprocket and was partially amputated. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was walking at the jobsite, tripped, and fell onto plywood and metal framing resulting in a laceration to the left forearm.
An employee was operating a piece of asphalt milling equipment on a highway. The mill struck a vehicle in a live lane of traffic and the employee suffered whiplash and contusions.

Employee was assisting the platform manager to move a drum of oil with a dolly. While setting the dolly down, he smashed the tip of his finger between the handle of the dolly and a beam on the platform. This resulted in the amputation of his right middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing a choked machine when he contacted rotating parts in the machine. The employee sustained a partial amputation of two fingers on the right hand.
An employee was checking the gap between the feed rollers when his right hand was caught in the rollers. Multiple fingers on the right hand were amputated.
An employee was cleaning the tracks on a machine when a chunk of concrete rolled off a hill and struck him. The employee sustained broken ribs and a broken hip.
An employee reached down to brush debris from the outrigger of a bucket truck. The outrigger retracted and amputated the employee's fingers.
An employee was walking and tripped over a clothing bin causing her knee to pop.
On October 19, 2020, a carpenter was ripping a piece of 2 x 4 lumber with a circular saw when the saw kicked back and amputated the employee's left pinky and ring fingers.

A road was being prepared for new asphalt. Another contractor was milling down existing asphalt and then running a sweeper machine to push the loose asphalt to the middle of the road so it could be picked up. An employee was inspecting the work by measuring the depth of the milling operation when the street sweeper backed up and struck him. The employee sustained injuries to the pelvic area.

An employee was using a battery-powered circular saw to cut a piece of high-density plastic to make a ceiling tile. The saw would not start after the battery was replaced. The employee tried two different batteries. While adjusting the trigger, the saw started and the blade contacted the employee's left middle finger, amputating it from the cuticle to the tip.
An employee was working on an industrial lathe when the tail stock on a 17,000-pound reel spool broke and the spool dropped onto his leg, crushing it. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 19, 2020, an employee was cleaning kitchen pots. While emptying a vat, the handle dislodged and boiling water spilled onto the employee and the floor. The employee then tripped over a drain lip and fell onto his back in the hot water that had spilled on the floor. The employee was hospitalized for second degree burns to his legs and hands.

An employee was using a pedestal grinder to put an edge on the wedge of a pry bar. The part was pulled into the grinder and the employee's left pinky finger contacted the grinder wheel resulting in a partial amputation.
