An employee was moving a stuck pallet off a powered rider jack when he was caught between the rider jack and the pallet. The employee sustained broken bones in the right leg.

An employee was working on the empty tote conveyor. As he was putting a chain onto a sprocket, a box passed through a photo eye, triggering the conveyor.  The employee was caught by the sprocket and chain, sustaining the amputation of 1/8" of the left ring fingertip.
An employee was operating a lathe when the mandrel struck the employee's arm and broke it.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) and struck the racking. His left foot was crushed between the PIT and the racking.

On October 19, 2020, around 4:00 p.m. two line crew members were removing a fallen static transmission line when the line broke from the top of the tower and contacted the energized line on the opposite side of the tower causing an arc flash. The employees suffered burns to their hand and arms.
An employee was cleaning an apartment that was under construction and stepped on a 1/2 inch nail. The employee's right foot was amputated.

While operating an industrial vacuum, an employee's arm was sucked into the vacuum's hose. The employee sustained a circulatory injury to his right arm. He was hospitalized with arm swelling and underwent surgery.
An employee was operating a brake machine and fractured four fingers on the right hand and their left thumb.
An employee was walking in the area filling drink orders and tripped over a loose floor tile. The employee fell and broke their right leg.

An employee was helping unload boxes from a box truck. The employee climbed onto the lift gate to grab a box then slipped and fell 3 to 4 feet to the pavement, hitting their head. It was raining at the time. The employee sustained lacerations and a fracture to the back of the skull, swelling of the brain, and a possible concussion.

An employee was walking down a set of steps on the grading line. A leg from a pallet rack was blocking their path and when the employee tried to step over the obstacle, he missed the next step and fell forward onto the floor. The employee sustained a broken left leg.
An employee was replacing a clean privacy curtain in an isolation room and fell approximately seven feet off an A-frame ladder onto the floor. The employee suffered head trauma.
An employee was operating a saw to cut a 2x4 and amputated half of his thumb. The saw was not guarded at the time.

An employee was cleaning a grain barge. While climbing the ladder from the barge to the dock, the employee lost their footing and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured lower right leg near the ankle.
An employee was inside a chute, cleaning dust, when he slipped and cut his right elbow on an object inside chute.

Two employees were inspecting the hoist cable on an overhead crane. One employee was operating the crane while the injured employee inspected the hoist cable. The injured employee was feeling the cable while it was moving through his gloved right hand checking for burrs or distortion in the cable when his fingers were caught between the crane cable and the pully of the block. Two fingertips were amputated.

An employee was operating a concrete transport vehicle in the company yard. While making a turn, the wet cement shifted causing the vehicle to overturn. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left ankle.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder marking locations for brackets to hold plumbing pipes in the ceiling and wall. The employee was about 8 feet high on the 12-foot ladder when he lost his balance while reaching to mark a location for a bracket and fell from the ladder onto the floor. The employee injured his face, eyes, shoulders and sustained a broken right femur.
An employee was reaching for a sliding nail gun and fell 30 feet off a roof onto the ground. The employee suffered broken bones.

An employee was attempting to unclog a pipe in the taco department line between the holding tank and the mixer when their right index finger contacted the ball valve and the pneumatic actuator cycled causing amputation of the finger between the first and second joint.

A conveyor belt on the green bean line was slipping due to some icing on the drive motor. An employee went over to start it manually. While tugging on the belt, the employee's hand got pulled into the underside of the conveyor. The employee sustained third degree burns on his left arm and hand requiring skin grafts.
An employee was cleaning a pot sticker machine when the blade amputated a fingertip.

An employee was trying to bolt up approximately 15 feet of pipe to a spool piece coming out of the pump intake. As he was trying to insert a gasket, the spool piece dropped on his hand and amputated part of his pinky finger.
An employee was lifting boxes weighing approximately 36 pounds and felt pain in his stomach. He was hospitalized with a hernia.
An employee's left hand and forearm got caught in the roller section of the concrete mixer truck causing severe damage that required hospitalization.
An employee fell and injured her knee while delivering an order to a customer's car in the mall parking lot.
An employee was pushing a cart across the parking lot when the cart became entangled in weeds. The employee tripped and fell, striking his head. He temporarily lost consciousness.
An employee was using a forklift to pull a customer's order. The employee fell from the forklift onto the concrete floor.
An employee had been stripping foundation form work. The employee was in the break area when he got up to get a drink of water and collapsed due to a heart attack.
An employee was assaulted by a customer during an argument. The employee sustained a broken finger, a cut, and bruises.
An employee fell while descending a ladder and broke his leg.
An employee was replacing the drive belt on a 40-inch exhaust fan. A finger was caught between the belt and pulley resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee placed a new bundle of metal tubing on a work bench. While the employee was removing the last steel strap, the bundle shifted and his finger was crushed between the tubes and the bench. The employee's left ring finger was amputated.
An employee was guiding a hoist to pick up a connex box. The twist lock came off the shipping container and struck the employee in the head causing a broken nose. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam on the conveyor belt leading to the chipper when a stump kicked back and jammed his right ring finger resulting in a compound fracture and secondary partial amputation.

Employees had shut down and locked out a cotton gin lint cleaner to clean it. An employee entered the lint cleaner and his glove was caught by the teeth of the cleaner. His glove was pulled off and the employee sustained a de-gloving injury to the top of the right hand.

On October 20, 2020, at approximately 11:45 PM, an employee was kicked in the chest while trying to restrain a combative patient. The employee developed dizziness, chest pain, and shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
A bridge beam had been rigged to a forklift. The rigging slipped from the forklift and the beam struck an employee's foot, amputating four toes.

An employee had dumped a 2-yard dumpster. He then used the control box to wind the winch cable. The winch cable was wrapped around the employee's left hand and also became caught on something on the side of the truck. The employee pulled his gloved hand out of the winch cable and sustained a laceration to his left middle fingertip. The injury required surgery and involved loss of bone.

An employee was readjusting the straps on an eight foot high electrical switchboard that was resting on the liftgate of a delivery van when it fell onto the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs, and a broken left hip and right arm.

An employee was operating a welding machine when it was jammed by a piece of material. The employee cleared the jam and started the machine. The material jammed the machine again. The employee walked behind the machine and proceeded to clear the jam. Soon after, the machine continued to cycle. A set of material clamps came down and a material pusher came forward. The employee was then caught in the machinery and both of his hands were amputated.
An employee was unjamming a seamer machine and lacerated her right index finger.
An employee was assisting with de-escalating a student. When it was time to restrain the student, the employee fell, struck her head, and suffered a seizure.

On October 20, 2020, at approximately 1:15 PM, an employee was moving a 24-foot long beam with a co-worker. The employee fell backward through an open roof hatch approximately 17 feet to the floor below. The employee was hospitalized for a skull fracture.
An employee sustained an amputation to the index fingertip on their left hand while cleaning a rubber kneading machine. The machine was running at the time.
A kitchen manager was slicing vegetables with a knife and lacerated the tip of his left middle finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip near the nail area without bone loss.

On October 20, 2020, a maintenance employee was cleaning a machine pit. The employee was lifting a wooden box and it slipped out of his hands. When he tried to grab the wooden box, he pinched his left middle finger between the wooden box and a metal corner on the machine resulting in amputation of his left middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing a blockage on a piece of equipment when the slide gate closed on his hand and amputated the left index fingertip.

An employee was using a ladder to climb down from the roof. The employee slipped from the rungs of the ladder and fell onto cinder blocks and the ground. The employee fractured bones in their ankle, foot and heel.
An employee was on a forklift platform stocking material on a rack and fell approximately six feet and struck his head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a fryer when a bucket was tipped over, spilling a foaming alkaline caustic cleaner that burned the employee.
On 10/20/2020 at approximately 7:30 AM, an employee was clearing scrap from a saw when their left ring finger contacted the blade. The finger was amputated below the first knuckle.

On October 20, 2020, at approximately 7:35PM, an employee was placing boxes of bleach onto a conveyor system. The bottom of a box broke causing bottles of bleach to fall out. One bottle struck the conveyor and broke open splashing bleach into the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized for treatment.
An employee was operating the downspout gutter machine and amputated a fingertip.

An employee was trying to roll a crossed iron pipe back into the fixed metal pipe saddle. He lost his balance and as he tried to catch himself, his index finger was caught between the pipe and the pipe saddle crushing it. The fingertip was surgically amputated at the first knuckle. His middle and ring fingers sustained contusions.
An employee was operating a milling machine when his hand was caught in the machine, resulting in the amputation of the employee's right hand.
An employee was using a scraper or a hand-grinder to clean weld splatter on a stanchion from a towable gate. A steel part fell and broke the employee's lower left leg.

An employee was using a cart to move welding pipe weighing about 900 pounds. The cart tipped over and the pipe struck him in the left leg. He suffered a contusion to the upper thigh and was hospitalized due to concern about blood clots.
An employee was waxing the floors, slipped, and fell onto their back. The employee was hospitalized for a collapsed lung.
An employee was dismantling a battery pack after destructive testing. A tool contacted the battery core and it shorted causing burns to the employee's thigh, calf, and ankle.
An employee was walking across the road and was struck by a forklift resulting in a compound fracture to the left leg.
Two employees were moving a spool of cable down a flight of stairs. The spool rolled down the stairs and struck two employees causing broken bones.
An employee was involved in bushing removal using an impact tool when a metal shard flew off of the impact tool and punctured the employee's abdomen.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder when it came loose from the wall causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture a foot.
An employee was feeding paper into a paper core machine when their finger got caught on a belt. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was on a 15-foot ladder to remove a rain gutter pipe. He missed a rung as he descended the ladder and fell backward. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured neck.

A pack of re-run railroad ties were placed on a vertical re-saw roll case to be re-sawn. An employee was cutting the banding when the pack fell apart. The railroad ties pinned the employee's right leg against a guardrail and the leg was broken.
An employee was on a ramp pulling on a cargo strap when the strap broke and the employee fell backward striking his head on the ground and causing a loss of consciousness.

An employee was opening a train gate for a rail company. Before the employee could open the gate, the train struck the gate which knocked the employee down and rendered him unconscious.  The employee sustained fractures to the skull and right eye socket.
An employee was feeding the wire stripper and suffered finger lacerations and a fingertip amputation on the left hand.

An employee was using a table saw to cut a 5-inch wide board into two 2-inch long pieces. As he was using a push stick, the cut piece moved under the push stick and kicked back and the 2-inch piece struck him in the right hand and fractured a knuckle.

An employee finished unloading the truck and was getting ready to close the rear roll up door on the truck. As he was holding the roll up door to close it, he stepped off the back of the truck and the door closed on his right hand. His index and ring fingers were broken and the middle finger was amputated and reattached.

An employee had begun to shut down a roll coat/top coat machine when material spilled on the carrier rollers. The employee used a tool to reach the roll and remove the material. The machine grabbed the tool and the employee's left arm was pulled into the machine. The employee was hospitalized and a surgical procedure was performed.
An employee was mowing a yard entrance with a brush hog. A pipe fell onto his right foot, breaking the little toe.
An employee was troubleshooting a sandblasting auger and suffered amputation of his right leg.
On October 21, 2020, an employee was walking to the break room when she tripped over a rug and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck and was struck by another powered industrial truck. The employee's foot and ankle were amputated.

An employee was spotting for a lift while it was moving a modular unit. The modular unit swayed and struck the employee, crushing him against a stationary modular unit. The employee was hospitalized with blood vessel damage requiring surgery.

A driver stopped at a convenient store. As he entered the store he thought he saw the truck moving. He ran to the truck, tripped on the curb in the front the store, and fell on his right knee shattering it.
An employee was using the groover machine to groove a piece of pipe and amputated his right index finger.
While delivering mail, an employee fell and broke his arm.
An employee was helping direct a skid steer operator when he stepped backward, tripped, and fell on concrete. The employee sustained injury to their head and knee resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was securing a handbrake on a railcar. The railcar knocked him to the ground resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee was moving z-sheeting with a loader. The loader pushed the pile of z-sheeting forward over the steel tip portion of the employee's boot and into his foot. The employee's foot was crushed and the employee hospitalized for surgery to repair the injury.
While walking outside, an employee's shoe got caught on concrete. The employee fell and was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee was on an 8-foot ladder stalling insulated foam board. The ladder shifted and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured lower leg.
An employee was standing at the bottom of a hill. A 20-foot long log rolled down the hill and the employee attempted to stop it. The log rolled onto their leg and fractured it in three places.

An employee was loading a chest freezer to be thrown away. As he was lifting the freezer, the lid opened and one of his fingers was crushed between the lid and the side of the freezer. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee went to check the pump behind the paint line and fell into a man-sized hole at the grating around the pump, landing 6 feet below on piping and the circulation pump. The employee sustained bruising, a laceration to a hand, a scrape on a leg, broken ribs, and internal bleeding.
An employee was greasing a bearing on a top sheeter machine when his left index fingertip was amputated. The machine was running at the time.

An employee dismounted a garbage truck from the passenger side. The truck then pulled forward and the front passenger-side tire struck the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right tibia and multiple metatarsal fractures.

While putting stabilizers in and getting ready to leave the location, an employee's finger was caught between the body of a boom truck and the outrigger/stabilizer resulting in amputation of the right pinky fingertip.

On October 21, 2020, an employee was looking for supplies in the crawlspace above the cooler when she fell through a ceiling tile, clipped a shelf containing dishes, and landed on the floor in the prep area approximately 12 feet below. She was admitted to the hospital for a fractured shoulder, two fractured ribs, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was unloading shingles from the pallet on the boom onto the roof and fell from the roof. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist and ankle.
An employee amputated his left index and middle fingers while using a metal rolling machine. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was cutting boxes with a table saw when the blade amputated his left thumb.
An employee was washing down his truck when his right middle finger was caught in a pinch point between the drum and the hopper of the truck resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On October 22, 2020, a rehabilitation nurse technician was working in a patient's room when she slipped on water that was on the floor and fell. She fractured her left knee.

Two employees were inside a scissor lift traveling to another location. While passing through a doorway one employee's hard hat hit the door frame, pulling the employee's face up against the door jam. The injured employee sustained fractures to the jaw and facial lacerations.
An employee was driving an off road vehicle on a farm road and collided with a pickup truck. The employee sustained head and spine injuries.
An employee was working on a line using a pneumatic torque wrench when his left glove got caught in the tool while the wrench engaged. The employee suffered the amputation of his left ring fingertip.

An employee was exiting the rear of a box truck. As he turned around to place his foot on the steps, he slipped and fell. As he began to fall, he grabbed the strap hanging from the rear door but missed the three-point exit handle. His left elbow struck the rear deck of the truck, and the rear door descended and hit his arm. His left elbow was broken.
A carpenter was adjusting turnbuckles on concrete forms when his finger got caught between the pipe and the turnbuckle causing his right pinky fingertip to be amputated.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
While actively suppressing a spot fire, a forest service employee was moving downhill when they lost their footing and fell contacting a large rock which resulted in a fractured femur.

The employee was bending down in the stock room in order to pick up a piece of a metal clothing rack. She twisted and her leg gave out causing her to fall to the ground and break her tibia at the knee. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was performing tree removal at a condominium when he was struck by a rope, fell backward, and broke his leg.

On October 22, 2020, at 5:30 a.m., a driver was walking to his tractor to begin his route when he was struck by a vehicle. The employee incurred a laceration to his head and two fractured vertebrae requiring hospitalization.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was operating a ride-on sweeper in the yard cleaning the concrete pad. He took a turn toward the radial stack conveyor and the sweeper struck a C-channel support beam on the side of the conveyor. The employee sustained lacerations to the face/neck, a compression fracture of the T-7 vertebra, and a punctured lung.
An employee was picking up a 15-pound parts bin. She lost balance or her hip gave out and she fell backward to the floor, landing on and fracturing her right hip.
An employee was putting wall ties into pier form work. He was stepping into and out of the form, slipped on rebar, and fell 2 to 3 feet. A rebar impaled the employee's right buttock.

An employee was putting cement chunks in the loader bucket when his fingers were pinched against the bucket. The employee's index and middle fingers on the left hand were injured, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a torch to dismantle a refrigerator. As the torch cut a copper tube the torch burst into flames and the employee sustained burns to the head, face, and neck.

An employee was standing near where the iron beams are stored. A forklift operator was positioning the beams in the designated spot when the top beam fell onto the injured employee's right foot and fractured his toes.

An employee was using a tool to reach for a "kicked out" chicken that fell into the drip pan. The end of the tool caught on a shackle and was pulled down the shackle line. The tool's handle pinched the employee's left ring finger against the other shackle(s) resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was coming back into the terminal when they slipped on ice and fell to the concrete, striking their head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was spraying water into a concrete truck when they fell from the catwalk of the truck, landing on the ground. The employee sustained injuries to the lumbar region, pelvis, hip, and wrist.

An employee was unstrapping a load of steel wire. The load shifted and fell onto him, causing swelling on the forehead, bruising on the right arm and chest, lacerations to the left arm, and scraped skin on the left ankle.
While walking, an employee tripped on the floor where a drain cover had been removed and fell. The employee's right knee was fractured, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a box of mail into a cage and suffered a shoulder injury requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working on a flat roof and fell 14 feet through an opening in the roof created during the work. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and back.

An employee had loaded several 6-foot by 6-inch guardrail posts onto the lift gate of a truck with a covered bed on the back. The employee was riding on the lift gate as the truck was driven at about 5-mph to an installation site 100 yards away. When the truck turned onto a median to change directions, one of the posts slid towards the ground and became caught between the ground and the bracketing. The employee's left leg was pinned between the post and the truck bed, causing crushing injuries and lacerations to the lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On October 22, 2020, an employee was walking on a snow-covered driveway to deliver a package to a customer's residence when they stepped on a hockey shooting pad, which was beneath the snow, and slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip.
An electrician was working in a junction box. He turned to walk out and his shoulder hit the bar inside of the electrical panel box. He was electrocuted and hospitalized.

An employee was using a line up bar, which is a metal bar with tapered ends. The tapered ends are inserted in the holes of a frame in order to align the frame. While inserting the bar in the holes, one of the ends broke off and struck the employee in the left eye.
An employee was unjamming a coin sorting machine and amputated his left ring finger.
An employee was clearing a jam in a feed molder when the saw blade amputated their left thumb.
An employee was stepping out of a vehicle when she hit her knee on a metal device in the vehicle. She lost consciousness and fell to the floor, suffering a head injury.

An employee climbed onto a 6-foot step ladder to place a box onto a metal shelf. As the box was being placed, the shelf slipped out of its post slots striking the employee and causing her to fall approximately 2 to 3 feet from the ladder onto the floor. The employee sustained a concussion and a possible cheek bone fracture.

An employee was operating a standup forklift to put a rack of windshields onto a rack. After placing the rack of windshields into a rack the forklift backed up and the employee's left foot was crushed between the forklift and the metal rack resulting in fractures to four toes.
An employee was operating a drill press. The press caught the employee's gloved left hand and pulled it into the point of operation resulting in amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was operating a sanding disc when their thumb was caught in the disc and amputated.
An employee slipped on built-up oil mist on the floor near a machine. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip and a broken left ring finger.
An employee was part of a site clearing operation when a tree fell from an excavator and struck his leg breaking the tibia in three places. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was painting a container using an airless sprayer. The employee cleaned the sprayer with a paint thinner and thinner spilled onto their clothing. The employee then used a propane torch and their clothing caught on fire. The employee sustained third degree burns.
An employee was transitioning from a roof to a ladder when he slipped and fell eight feet, six inches to the ground and sustained a right arm fracture. He was hospitalized for surgery.

A box truck drove into a work zone and struck a truck-mounted attenuator, which in turn struck an employee. The employee suffered multiple abrasions to the face, a laceration to the right eyelid, eye contusions, a laceration to the upper lip, upper and lower incisor avulsions, abdominal pain, road rash on the left elbow and left thigh, rib fractures, and a pelvic crest fracture.
An employee was laying a stake and amputated their pinky finger with a sledgehammer.
An employee was spotting as a large tree limb was dragged. A branch broke from the limb and struck the employee, causing possible internal injuries.
An employee was lifting a package that weighed over 70lbs. to load it onto a truck when her hip gave out. The employee's artificial hip was fractured.
The injured employee was standing between two vehicles and was working on one of them. The other vehicle started and lurched forward pinning the injured employee between the two vehicles.

An employee was climbing onto a tractor when she fell, landing about 4 feet below. She suffered a broken right wrist; a possible fracture of the right foot; and severe bruising to the ribs, back, shoulder, and right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking into a building on the sidewalk, an employee struck a bollard and fell backward. The employee fractured a hip.
An employee was working from an extension ladder. The ladder's feet slipped and the employee fell to the floor 8-10 feet below, suffering a broken knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee walked out of a trailer and was struck by a forklift that backed out of an adjacent trailer. The employee sustained injury to her left foot.
An employee was operating a standup forklift and got his left foot caught between a protective guardrail and the forklift resulting in a crushing injury.
An employee was traveling in an elevator at a residential home. The elevator broke and free fell to the lower level. The employee sustained fractures to the left forearm and foot.
On October 23, 2020, an employee was operating a mini excavator and doing demolition work when the excavator tipped over on its side. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured right hip.
An employee was removing a broken glass panel when a piece fell and lacerated the employee's lower right leg.
An employee was strapping down a shredder for transfer. As he moved the shredder with the hitch his left pinky finger was amputated.
An employee was riding on a flatbed trailer when his left foot was caught between the trailer and a trackhoe. He sustained a laceration to his left foot that required stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was grinding bar stock on a bench mounted grinder and amputated their left thumb.
An employee was performing a leak test and lacerated a thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee stepped off an aircraft onto a step stool and fell to the concrete floor. The employee lost consciousness.
An employee was trying to enlarge the diameter of wooden rings on a transformer with a router when the router bit caught the employee's glove and partially amputated their right thumb.
An employee was bitten by a spider while sitting at a computer. The employee developed an infection.
An employee was cleaning the rear window of a tractor while standing on the hitch bars and fell. The employee fractured three ribs and sustained a hemothorax on the right side.

An employee was using a knife to cut the tail off a finish roll of plastic at the winder machine. The knife didn't cut through the plastic and the employee's arm was pulled into the machine and fractured.
On October 23, 2020, an employee fell from an 8-foot fiberglass step ladder. The employee fell less than 6 feet and landed on the ladder, suffering five broken ribs.
An employee was cutting a piece of scrap copper when a previously cut piece fell and struck the employee's right ankle, breaking it.

An employee was using an electric grinder on a weld joint, opening up the joint on the bottom flange of a steel beam. The grinding disk caught an edge of the beam, kicked back, and lacerated the employee's neck. He was hospitalized.

At 9:30 a.m. on October 23, 2020, an employee was trying to free a pipe valve on a barge. The valve came loose and the employee slipped and fell, striking the floor of the barge. He suffered a head laceration that required staples, as well as a broken collarbone.
An employee was cleaning and setting up an auger for product change and suffered a partial amputation of their right index finger.
On October 24, 2020, an employee was attempting to prevent a jam on the press machine when their right index finger was caught in the discharge folder, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood on a table saw and amputated a finger and lacerated other digits.

An associate was putting lids on pans on a conveyor belt when the belt jammed. The associate was trying to fix the jam when his gloved left hand got caught in the conveyor. The employee's left ring finger was amputated.

An employee was on a moving conveyor in order to replace screws in the overheard carrier system. In the process of walking backward, he tripped on a carrier motor box and his right foot got caught in the nip point of the conveyor system. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was working on the rig floor. Equipment fell to the rig floor and the employee jumped off the rig onto the ground suffering a compound fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was walking in an aisleway, slipped on oil on the floor, and fell. The employee sustained a skull fracture and a right elbow fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving an empty pallet with his foot. A loaded container that was being moved by a forklift struck the empty pallet and the employee's foot was caught between the pallet and a steel frame. The foot sustained fractures that requires surgery and hospitalization.

An employee was making an adjustment on the soybean extruder. A wrench slipped into the mouth of the conveyor, while the employee's finger was caught in the loop of the wrench. The employee sustained a left ring fingertip amputation.
An employee was working on a new power line installation in an existing transformer and sustained third degree burns to the head, left palm and right elbow.

An employee was installing steel plates for crane setup. The employee's left leg was caught under a steel plate while attempting to move the plate into place. The employee was hospitalized for a lower leg fracture.
A mail carrier fell while delivering a parcel to a house and broke her right leg.
An employee was helping set a cooker drive shaft and suffered an amputation to the end of the right index finger.
An employee was shot by a robber during an attempted robbery in the restaurant. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing a stand-up fork truck out of trailer into the warehouse and struck the bumper of the loading dock at the outside edge of the dock plate. He fell off the fork truck onto the concrete floor in the dock area. The employee was hospitalized for a leg injury that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning mirrors when they slipped and fell to the concrete floor and fractured a hip.
Cases of beer fell from a double stacked pallet onto an employee causing a compound fracture to the lower right leg near the ankle.

An employee was on a golf cart at the property and was struck by a truck. The employee was ejected from the golf cart and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for knee, wrist and rib pain.
An employee was operating the welder machine when his left thumb was caught between two metal clamps and amputated.
An employee was operating a standing forklift inside a freezer warehouse. The forklift slid on a patch of ice, and the employee's left foot was crushed between the forklift and a wall.

An employee was standing on the right side of the chipper chipping debris. A climbing rope was on the ground and had become entangled with the tree limbs. The rope went through the chipper, broke and snapped loose, and struck the employee on the face. The employee had severe bruising and a partially torn left ear. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was building tires. The employee's left index finger was pinched and lacerated between ingoing rollers, and was later medically amputated.
An employee was walking into a warehouse when he tripped over the forks of a parked forklift. He fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip.

A temporary employee was trying to remove a stuck pallet from a stand-up pallet jack. The movement of the pallet jack against steel racking threw the employee off the jack, and he was pinned between it and the steel rack. He suffered a pelvic fracture.
An employee's right ring finger was caught by the block and piston on a nailing machine when the drive fired. The fingertip was crushed and amputated.
An employee was adjusting a chain on a press dryer. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught in the chain and sprocket, and the fingertips were amputated.
An employee was assaulted by a homeless person and sustained lacerations from a knife.
While walking into work, an employee slipped on ice and struck his head on the ground. The employee sustained a concussion and brain bleed.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift. A fork tine fell off and struck the employee's left foot, breaking a bone.
On October 26, 2020, an employee was stacking plywood sheets on top of saw horses when one of the saw horse gave way. The plywood fell on the employee's left shin, crushing their shin and toes.
An employee was climbing up the side access ladder of a mobile crane. He fell from the third step and his lower back struck the ground. He suffered two fractured lumbar vertebrae.

On October 26, 2020, an employee was using a ladder to clear fishmeal from the cyclone funnel meal feeder on an elevated conveyor. While walking on the conveyor, the employee stepped onto a breaker box that was mounted on a pole alongside the conveyor. The breaker box broke free from it's metal mounting bracket, and the employee fell approximately 5'6" to the floor. The employee's right arm was lacerated by a mounting bracket as he fell. The employee was hospitalized for surgery to close the wound.
An employee tripped and fell in a parking lot, suffering a broken hip.
A temporary employee was cleaning with a disinfectant when she began having breathing issues.
An employee was band cutting and sustained an amputation injury to her left index finger.
An employee was bending over to perform a task when a dolly of bread trays struck him in the back. The hospital was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a 6-foot wooden ladder into an elevator shaft. Bricks from the wall began to fall onto him, causing him to jump and land on the ground. He suffered a broken left heel.

An employee was felling trees. A tree that was being felled split and struck another tree causing a limb from that tree to fall and strike the employee in the head. The employee suffered a broken neck, brain swelling and facial trauma.
An employee was replacing the filters on the hood system and stepped into the hot oil in a fryer causing burns to the employee's foot.
While inspecting a roof for possible replacement, an employee fell through the roof.
An employee suffered amputation of the right middle fingertip while moving a loaded dolly down stairs.

An employee was squatting to remove a roll from the labeling machine and fell backward. The employee attempted to break her fall by grabbing the base of the machine and contacted the spindle of the machine resulting in amputation of her left index fingertip. The machine was unguarded at the time.
An employee was installing a gutter and fell approximately 11 feet from the roof. The employee sustained a right foot fracture.
An employee was traveling between work areas using a utility terrain vehicle (UTV). The UTV struck a log and rolled over. The employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee was cutting tie downs with a pocket knife when the employee cut their stomach, resulting in internal bleeding.
An employee caught his finger between a chair and the wall in the break room resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was working on a vertical lathe machine that had an oil leak. The employee used his finger to wipe the oil and his finger got caught between the hydraulic positioning switch and pin resulting in amputation of the fingertip and nail.

An employee was cutting a one-inch PVC type 1 material on a table saw. As the material was being cut, it bound, kicked, and pulled his left index finger into the blade resulting in a partial amputation. The table saw was guarded at the time.
An employee slipped and fell backward on a concrete floor that was wet from the rain and broke his right arm.

An Enterprise employee was performing maintenance activities on the P-113 small volume prover. While attempting to remove the chain on the prover, the employee's left thumb was caught between the sprocket and chain and fractured. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was on the shoulder of a highway when a truck entered the closed work area and struck him. He suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was tracking a conveyor belt when skin was peeled from the top of the right hand.

The employee was using a pressure washer to clean a water valve. The tip was leaking and the employee was adjusting the tip when the wand was triggered and a stream of water punctured the palm of his right hand.
An employee was repairing a non-powered roller conveyor when the tip of their left index finger was caught between two metal conveyor parts and amputated without bone loss.

A forklift was undergoing an icing test inside a 15-foot by 15-foot cold chamber, into which liquid nitrogen had been injected. The nitrogen had become a gas, and when one of the employees entered the space to check on the test's progress, he breathed in the gas and lost consciousness. His head struck the floor. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading rail cars and came in contact with the indexer. The employee's right foot was caught between the indexer and a rail car causing a laceration to the top of his foot and two fractured toes.
An employee was inspecting the engine of a dump truck. The engine was started and an alternator belt amputated one of the employee's fingertips.
An employee stepped off a six-inch platform and fell to the ground injuring her head and fracturing a hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was standing and talking to another employee when the employee suddenly passed out due to dehydration.

An employee was unloading lime from a pneumatic trailer. The lower portion of the trailer exploded, striking the employee in the head and face and sending him into a steel beam. He suffered multiple fractures to the head and face area.
Four maintenance technicians were unclogging a vacuum line. When they re-energized the vacuum system, an actuator valve inside the vacuum tube crushed one employee's right hand.
An employee was using a grinding lathe with a sanding belt. The employee's right hand came into contact with the belt, causing the amputation of the nail and skin from the tip of the index finger.
An employee had his hand close to a stump that was being cut by another employee with a chainsaw. His left ring and pinky fingers were injured.
An employee was performing maintenance on an injection molder when the machine struck his right arm, resulting in a cut, burn, and fracture to the right arm.

An employee was performing steel construction on a commercial building. He climbed out onto the long cantilever and attached his fall protection to the cantilever. The bolts which attached the cantilever to the main structure failed and the employee fell approximately 15 feet onto a hard surface. The employee sustained broken ribs, a broken elbow, and a head laceration.
On 10/27/2020, at approximately 9:10 a.m., an employee suffered a partial amputation of the left thumb while closing the doors of a package delivery truck.
An employee was removing a small acetylene tank from the closet when the tank exploded. The employee was hospitalized for second degree burns to the face.

An employee was tracing an electrical line on the roof of a 9-foot-tall walk-in cooler. The employee fell through an uninstalled section of the roof and suffered head and neck trauma, as well as broken ribs.
On October 27, 2020, an employee was mixing chemical products when a chemical reaction occurred and the employee suffered chemical burns to the face.

An employee was moving a pallet that contained boxes of washer fluid using a pallet jack. The load became unstable and fell over onto the employee pinning his leg to the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was using a cellular shade cutter and amputated her right middle fingertip and lacerated her index finger.
An employee was pouring footers when the concrete pump truck shifted causing the boom and the chute to shift. The chute struck the employee causing a head injury on the right side and a broken arm.
An employee was unjamming a piece of equipment and suffered a partial amputation to the right thumb.
An employee was moving machinery within a shop. A pipe from the upper level on a machine fell and struck the employee in the face, causing facial injuries.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and suffered a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was connecting a trailer and pinched a finger between the ball and socket resulting in an amputation injury.

An employee was walking between machines when he tripped on a bolt that was protruding up from the base of a piece of equipment and fell to the concrete floor. He sustained a compound fracture to his right femur that required surgery and a laceration to the upper lip area.

The injured employee approached another employee who was on the first step of the ladder on a truck. This startled the employee on the truck who then fell onto the injured employee and both employees fell to the ground. The injured employee sustained a fractured tibia and fibula.
An employee developed lower back pain while pushing a pallet jack loaded with about 200 pounds of motor oil. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a motorized pallet jack to load a truck. His right foot was pinned against a concrete pole, causing an open fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee was checking out a customer whose purchases were on a flatbed shopping cart. The employee tripped over the end of the cart and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a spleen injury.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor outside a bathroom. She suffered a soft-tissue injury to her lower back.
While walking to his vehicle, an employee slipped on a slab of cement and fell, breaking his right kneecap. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a magnet in a pneumatic dust handling system and pinched and lacerated a finger. The finger was amputated.
An employee was caught between the met hood and a column in the ladle refining furnace area. The employee was hospitalized for broken ribs and vertebrae and a punctured colon.

An employee was attempting to remove a ballast weight from under a ladder. The ballast weight slipped from his hands and fell on his right middle finger resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was removing a staple from a wire conductor reel when the staple dislodged from the wood and struck the employee in the eye causing an eye injury.
An employee fell from a roof to the gravel ground, suffering a broken rib, a broken vertebra, and torn ligaments/tendons in vertebrae.

A employee was attempting to move a broken electric pallet jack with a forklift. The injured employee attempted to assist the employee in turning the pallet jack upright. He grabbed the wheel well with his left hand and his hand became lodged in the wheel well and was fractured.

The injured employee was assisting with removal of a rotary valve from the flanges of a silo. It was then placed on the floor of the silo for inspection. While Employee 2 was inspecting the rotary valve to ensure it was in good working condition, he noticed there was plastic material inside the rotary valve near the impeller (vane). The injured employee removed the pieces of plastic as Employee 2 turned the outside wheel with his foot. After all the plastic material was removed, Employee 2 moved the outside wheel a final time to ensure free movement of the part. At this time, the impeller (vane) came in contact with the injured employee's middle finger. The injured employee abruptly jerked his hand away resulting in a laceration to his fingertip and fingernail.

An employee was in the basket of an aerial lift, which was being moved across a lane of traffic with help from a spotter truck. A vehicle entered the lane and struck the aerial lift, leaving the employee hanging outside it. The employee suffered minor rib fractures and an abdominal injury.
An employee was working from a scissor lift to service a trailer. The employee fell to the concrete ground and suffered head trauma.
An employee was working near a skid steer loader when the bucket of the loader came down and struck his left foot. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the foot.
An employee was putting plates on a machine for a job change and pinched his right middle finger between the table plate and the apron. The finger was amputated.

An employee was pouring molten aluminum with a hand ladle. The employee stepped into the sand pan to pour the aluminum from the ladle into the mold. The employee caught his left leg on the edge of the sand pan and fell toward the mold with the ladle in his hand. While the ladle broke his fall, the employee was splashed with molten aluminum on various areas of his body. The employee was hospitalized with second and third degree burns.
An employee's left ring finger got caught in a door resulting in a fingertip amputation without bone loss.

Two molds were jammed on the line. An employee was attempting to unjam the molds. When the jam released, the molds came together and broke the employee's right tibia and fibula. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was exiting the rear of the package car. When he stepped down to the concrete dock  with his right foot he slipped and fell resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was walking an order out to a customer and slipped and fell on the sidewalk. The employee sustained a hip injury that required surgery.
An employee was climbing an extension ladder and fell to the concrete floor resulting in a back injury.

A forklift was moving from one aisle to another aisle and struck a stationary reach truck. The employee's left leg was caught between the two vehicles during the collision resulting in a compound fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had just finished working on the roof of a building and was climbing down a fixed, caged, steel ladder. He lost his grip and footing and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained multiple fractures to the left arm.
Employees were removing a motor for replacement when the steel mount/bracket fell more than 20 feet and struck the injured employee on the head causing a head injury and a concussion.

On October 29, 2020, an employee was installing two helical piers when his right index finger got caught in the connecting point of the two piers resulting in an amputation injury up to the first knuckle.
An employee was loading parts into the welder when the welder cycled and the employee's hand was caught in the point of operation. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving kegs onto a pallet. His right ring finger was caught between the pallet and a keg, causing a laceration and the removal of skin and the fingertip.
Aluminum posts were being transported by a forklift when they fell off the forklift and struck an employee. The employee sustained a fracture to the lower leg.
A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a thermoforming oven and amputated their left thumb.
An employee fell while stepping from a raised planter onto a concrete guard booth foundation. He landed on his right knee and suffered a ruptured knee tendon.
While operating a pavement sweeper, an employee was hit by an incoming vehicle.
An employee was climbing shelves when she lost her footing and fell from the second to the bottom shelf onto the floor fracturing her left femur.

An employee was feeding a plastic sheet into a grinder machine. The sheet stalled going into the machine; while the employee was trying to get the feed process to resume, their left foot landed on the sheet just as it began to move. The employee was propelled, causing their right leg to buckle. The employee suffered a broken right leg below the tibia and a dislocated right knee.

An employee was starting a new take-up reel on a cable line. The second wrap of cable overlapped the first (starting) wrap. The employee used a rubber mallet to move the first wrap toward the flange. When the first wrap moved, the second wrap came down and pinned his left thumb against the reel drum. He suffered an amputation to the thumb.

An employee was making 12-inch by 32-inch concrete paver blocks. The employee was checking the blocks for cracks when the fingers cart cycled to collect a pallet of blocks from the stacker. The employee was caught between the fingers cart and the stacker and suffered fractures to the left wrist/arm, left side of the pelvis, and lower back.
An employee was operating an extrusion take-up machine and caught his gloved hand between the wire and die resulting in amputation of the left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee bent down to install fuel tank straps on the left side of a truck and hit their forehead on the chassis frame. The employee sustained a head laceration.

An employee was working on a concrete manufacturing machine. As he was attempting to change out the forms, a forklift pulled up with a new form. He stepped sideways over a pit area where the form would sit, fell approximately eight feet, and struck his head. He was hospitalized for a fractured skull.
An employee was getting on a forklift and stepped on the accelerator. The forklift went in reverse and his foot was caught between the lift and a concrete wall. The employee's toes were fractured.
On October 29, 2020, a Performance Food Service employee was unloading food products at a customer location when he suffered an exacerbation of an umbilical hernia.

An employee was securing a 5-gallon bucket to the bed of a pickup truck. The employee slipped while exiting the wet truck bed and fell onto the closed tailgate. He struck the underside of his arm on the tailgate and sustained a punctured lung.
An employee's rain jacket was caught by a running conveyor belt sprocket. The employee suffered a shoulder-to-bicep brachii rupture.
An employee was starting a forklift with one foot on the ground and one foot on the forklift. The employee sustained a broken left leg.

An employee was operating an order picker. As the order picker was raised the employee's left hand fingers were caught between the order picker cage and a ceiling I-beam resulting in two broken fingers.

A temporary employee was operating a scissor lift at the airplane hangar. The lift toppled over onto its side and the employee suffered a broken right arm and a head laceration that required stitches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a hoist. The hoist rolled over and amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was strapping down a piece of freight inside a trailer. The employee had one strap secured and was securing a second one when the first strap failed. The freight fell onto the employee, breaking the employee's back.

An employee was hooking up a converter between two trolleys. It shifted and caught his left hand between the eye hook and the back of the trailer. He suffered a partial amputation to the little finger (at the second knuckle), as well as bruising to the ring finger.
The tree limb that an employee was tied into failed causing the employee to fall and sustain a fractured left ankle.

An employee was standing on a flatbed trailer tying down a tank. The employee stepped backward off the trailer and fell approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured pelvis, fractured ribs, and fractured L2-L5 vertebrae.
An employee was moving a die with a cheater bar. The bar slipped and the die landed on the employee's left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
On October 29, 2020, an employee was operating a plastic CNC machine while standing next to it. The CNC arm rotated, striking the employee in the lower leg and causing a laceration and bruising.

An employee was drilling through a wall when his glove and pinky finger got caught around the drill shaft. The employee sustained a fracture, lacerations, and a partial amputation of the pinky fingertip.

An employee cut a piece of exterior siding and climbed a stepladder onto the scaffold platform to install the siding. The employee fell 8 feet from the scaffold onto the ground and sustained fractured ribs, two cervical fractures, and a brain bleed.
An employee working on a threading breaker amputated their right middle fingertip when the machine was activated.
An employee was repairing a forklift when they were struck by the forklift's mast resulting in a fracture.

An employee was dry cleaning a weigher while standing on top of a three-step step ladder. The employee reached over the weigher and the ladder moved underneath her. She fell and struck her head on the ground.
An employee was standing/walking behind a truck and trailer when they were run over by a reversing trackhoe trailer. The employee sustained broken ribs.

An employee was holding a pole with an explosive charge on the end of it, which was being used to de-slag a boiler. The explosive charge ignited and caused lacerations to the employee's left hand which resulted in amputation of the hand.

A machine operator was cleaning the conveyor belt when the cleaning pad was caught between the belt and pulley. The employee's gloved hand was then pulled into the moving belt and pulley resulting in amputation of an index finger.
An employee was removing leftover rubber from a machine when air buildup blew out of the ram and a 10-12 inch sphere of rubber struck the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized for contusions.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck while standing in an open area of the facility causing a laceration to the lower right leg.

An employee was removing a large pin from between two concrete jersey barriers. As one barrier was being lifted, the employee's left index finger was pinched between the metal pin and a U-bolt that was imbedded in the jersey barrier. The employee sustained an amputation.
While constructing a metal shed, an employee fell 12 to 15 feet from metal rafters and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was standing by the coil saddle preparing to package the metal coil. As the coil was lowered onto the saddle by a gantry crane, it rolled off the saddle and struck the employee. The employee sustained a fractured left femur and kneecap and a contusion to the right knee.
An employee was checking the amperage on a generator's power transfer switch when an arc flash caused second degree burns to his hands and first degree burns to his face.
An employee fell while walking down steps, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip.

An employee was moving a manlift. The manlift's mast got caught under a conveyor, causing the lift to tip and the employee's head to be pinned between the conveyor belt and the lift cage. The employee suffered a head injury and a broken jaw.

An employee was walking when she stubbed her toe on the V-shaped legs of a piece of exercise equipment and fell to the floor hitting her face, left shoulder, left wrist, back, and left knee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the patella, wrist, and tibia. The broken patella required surgery.
An employee was performing maintenance on a garage door when he felt ill. He was hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee was unloading bales of insulation when a bale fell on the employee and caused back and teeth injuries.
An employee was performing maintenance on a vehicle, tripped over an extension cord and fell breaking a hip.
An employee was descending a vertical ladder and fell 8-10 feet. The employee sustained a shoulder sprain/fracture and an abdominal injury.

An employee was bending rebar on a rod bender machine. The machine malfunctioned causing the bender to jerk back and forth. The employee grabbed the rebar and his right thumb was crushed between the rebar and the bender stop.
An employee was washing windows from a roof and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a  broken neck.

An employee was in the trailer pulling a piece of rolled product off the trailer when he lost his footing and fell onto the concrete ground. It was raining and the back of the trailer was wet at the time. The employee sustained fractures to the left femur and left wrist requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee slipped on the door threshold and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hip injury.
Two employees were pouring an acid mixture into a vat that contained bleach. A chemical reaction occurred and the mixture erupted onto the employees. Both employees were burned and hospitalized.
An employee fell while climbing down a ladder. The employee landed on the ground and suffered broken vertebrae and a torn muscle in the upper back.

The winch cable on a tow truck snapped while a car was being hooked up to it. The tow truck driver jumped out of the truck and ran to stop the car being towed from rolling into another car. The truck hit the car and pinned the driver between two cars.
An employee fell down stairs and fractured their left ankle.

On October 31, 2020, the injured employee was walking backwards while supporting part of a wall with two other employees. The injured employee slipped on frost, losing his balance and control of the wall. The injured employee fell and the wall fell on top of him. The employee suffered chest pain and cuts on his forehead.
An employee was cleaning dough from a donut plunger between batches. The machine cycled and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was struck by a passing order picker causing a laceration and possible fracture of his right pinky toe.
An employee was securing a metal roof when a metal roofing platform gave way, causing the employee to slip and fall to the ground 15 feet below. The employee suffered a broken collarbone and femur.

An employee was oiling and visually inspecting conveyor chains and sprockets. The employee's right index finger was pulled into the chain as he attempted to wipe oil from underneath it. The finger was caught between the chain and sprocket, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell and fractured their hip while running away during an active shooter situation in the parking lot of the store.
An employee was walking to get a pallet and stepped into the boiler blow down crock and suffered second degree burns to the bottom of their left foot.
A lineman acting as a spotter was struck by another vehicle. The lineman sustained head and rib injuries.

An employee was operating the floor scrubber and pinched his right index finger between the steering wheel on the floor scrubber and a crossbeam by the storage racks resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was found on the floor at the bumper cars. He had been moving a bumper car and sustained an electrical shock. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning toilets at a rest stop and had trouble breathing due to the fumes produced from the mixture of bleach and toilet bowl cleaner.

An employee was on a scaffold painting columns. A gust of wind knocked the scaffold down and the employee fell from a height of more than 10 feet. The employee sustained a compound fracture with a dislocated ankle.

A skid steer was pulling a steel truss. The truss got stuck and when an employee tried to free it, his left pinky finger was caught between the truss and the rollers of the winch on the skid steer resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a lifting hoist to move a fuel dispenser onto an island for mounting. A hoisting swivel failed, causing the dispenser to fall and land on the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized with several broken bones in the right foot.
An employee tripped over a telephone cord and fell.

An employee was grinding a 24" diameter pipe on a jack stand. The pipe fell off of the roller jack stands, catching the employee's ring and little fingers between the pipe and the stand. The employee was hospitalized and sustained a possible surgical amputation to the pinky finger.
An employee was on a catwalk unclogging an auger and fell to the concrete ground below. The employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was operating a can line when a jam occurred on the auto-feeder. While clearing the jam, the employee's glove was pinched by the running conveyor and the employee's right ring and pinky fingers were pulled into the machine, causing a partial amputation to both fingertips.

An employee was waiting for his coworker to bring a boom lift to his location. The employee became dizzy and fell approximately 13 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury above the left eye.
An employee was moving extension tables in the manufacturing area when the employee tripped over a table and fell. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the lower right leg.
An employee was walking to their car after their shift had ended when they tripped and fell in the parking lot, sustaining a fractured right hip.

An employee was offloading a slot machine from a delivery truck using an industrial tilt back dolly. The slot machine fell off the dolly onto the employee's leg. The employee sustained a fractured knee.
An employee removed a high voltage cabinet and went to push a cable through when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained burns on the right hand, left arm, and the back.

An employee was placing carbon steel parts into a fixture so a robot could weld them. The clamp on the fixture actuated and caught the tip of the employee's left little finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was attempting to open the top of the tanker trailer and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured skull and fractured ribs and their spleen was removed.

An employee was kneeling on the floor to remove a castor off of the bottom of the 2.5 gallon capping machine. The machine was sitting on a pallet about to be picked up by a forklift. As the forklift lifted the machine, the machine tilted over and fell onto the employee. The employee sustained a broken ankle, a broken foot, and a fractured vertebra.
An employee was loading parts onto the read side of a piercing and bending machine when the machine was engaged. The employee sustained a crushing injury to her thumb.
An employee was manually igniting a burner at the plant and suffered burns to the left side of the face and on both hands.

An employee was manually moving a 55-gallon steel drum away from other drums on a pallet in order to pick up the drum using a drum grabbing machine. The drum shifted and pinched his left pinky above the knuckle. The employee sustained an amputation of the left pinky fingertip.

An employee was moving a steel containment grate. The plant had a water main break and the maintenance employee had to move the containment grate to get a pump into the pit. The steel grating slipped out of his hands and landed on the right index fingertip, pinching it between the concrete floor and bottom of the grating. The employee sustained a fractured finger and an amputation of soft tissue from the finger.

A crew had finished paving a 1200+ ft. stretch of interstate. While the paver was being backed up to its starting point, the paver suffered an unknown mechanical failure that caused the engine to stall. The paver lunged forward and an employee on the paver lost his balance and fell forward onto the floor of the paver seating area. The employee struck his head on the metal handrail, causing a laceration to the head.
An employee was using a table saw to cut wood. The employee's left middle finger made contact with the sawblade, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was struck by a forklift and sustained a broken leg.

On November 3, 2020, an employee was performing a mammogram on a patient. The patient went limp and passed out while clamped in the mammogram machine. When compression of the machine was released, the employee helped guide the patient's fall to the ground. The employee landed on the floor with the patient on top of them and suffered a fractured left ankle and tibia.
An employee was doing maintenance on a blowout preventer. His left thumb got caught between the torque wrench he was using and the nut, and the first joint of his left thumb was amputated.
At about 1:40 p.m. on November 3, 2020, an employee slipped on a wet floor in a hospital hallway, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken left kneecap.

An employee was attempting to clear a jam that occurred inside of a vacuum pipe leading to a tank that holds debris from freshly hatched chickens. The employee removed an access cover to remove the blockage when the knife cage closed on his hand causing a deep laceration that required hospitalization.
At 2:00 p.m. on November 3, 2020, an employee slipped in a puddle of water and fell, suffering a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping unload a skid steer off a truck skip. While positioned with his left foot on the  skid steer's step and his right foot on the tire, he was helping unhook the chains from the truck skip and slipped and fell backward, landing on the rear rail of the truck skip. He suffered six broken ribs and a flail chest injury.
An employee had been helping to load boxes. When the employee went to close the main door, the door closed at a high rate of speed and his right middle finger was caught in the door and amputated.
An employee was operating a power shear to cut sheet metal and amputated a finger.

An employee was on the third floor of a structure, crossing an area to get to a staircase. The employee fell through an opening in the floor, hitting the concrete floor one level down and then falling to the concrete floor on the first level. The employee suffered injuries to the right foot and a vertebra in the back.

An employee was mixing acoustic material with a hand drill. The drill caught a rag he was holding, and his left hand was pulled into the turning chuck. His little finger was severely lacerated and fractured, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was dislodging a rock from the conveyor belt of the rock crusher using a piece of rebar/pipe when the employee's right hand slid into a pinch point between the frame of the equipment and the rebar resulting in a partial amputation of the right index fingertip.

A 20-foot tapered I-beam was positioned on a fixed conveyor that is approximately 12 inches off the ground. The beam was placed on the conveyor behind the spray paint booth after it was painted before moving it to the yard. The beam shifted and pinned the injured employee's right leg between the beam and the conveyor. The leg was fractured.
Two employees were putting together a 300-pound steel form for concrete. While the form was being repositioned, it pinched an employee's left thumb, amputating the nail and the tip of the thumb.
An employee was moving items with a forklift when it struck a stack of pallets. The pallets fell onto the employee, who suffered a broken arm, dislocated vertebrae, and a concussion.
On November 3, 2020, an employee was welding a hatch coaming to the deck of a vessel. The metal hatch cover closed on his left hand and crushed it. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was performing daily preventive maintenance on a boiler and suffered burns to the neck, back, right arm and shoulder when hot water backed up the drain and overflowed onto the employee.
An employee had been riding on the back of a garbage truck. Four of his fingers were caught and crushed between the truck and its winch cable.

An employee was working on the second level of the building. While he was walking to go on break he stepped on the corner of a floor covering that was covering an opening in the floor. The covering had shifted and the screws that were holding the covering to the concrete broke free. The floor covering flipped up and the employee fell through the opening onto the ground below. The employee fractured his nose and both elbows.
An employee was on a ladder in order to check the attic area for a rodent infestation. The employee fell off the ladder to the ground, sustaining broken ribs and a possible head injury.
An employee was hooking up an ammonia tank to a pickup truck when the pickup truck backed up and struck the employee, resulting in broken ribs, broken vertebrae, and a punctured lung.
An employee was riding on the back of a garbage truck. The employee fell off the riding step as the vehicle began to move, landing on the ground. The employee sustained fractured ribs.

An employee was holding a mandrel while operating a hydraulic press brake. When he engaged the foot pedal, his fingers were caught between the mandrel and the top of the forming die. His right index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee suffered a severe asthma attack after exposure to cigarette smoke.
An employee was on a ladder, tightening a fitting on a boiler. The employee fell from the ladder's second step to the floor and suffered a hip injury.
An employee slipped and fell while walking resulting in broken ribs.

An employee was operating a smooth drum roller. The machine tipped over and pinned the employee's left hand, causing soft tissue and muscle damage to the top lower part of the hand toward the palm area and the middle, ring, and little fingers.

An employee unhitched a tank of anhydrous ammonia. The tank rolled into the employee, crushing the employee's left leg against a pickup truck. The employee's calf was impaled and the employee suffered a fracture in the lower leg.
An employee stepped on a steel cable. A frayed wire on the cable punctured the jacket of a 440-volt electrical cable. The employee suffered a shock and was hospitalized.

An employee was throwing trash into a dumpster with a half yard hopper. The hopper tipped into the dumpster and its metal bottom edge caught his middle finger against the top edge of the dumpster. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was inspecting sound wall panel installation. While installing a panel, the adjacent panel that was already installed was bumped and the panel fell onto the injured employee. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and other internal injuries.
An employee fell while walking down steps into a basement. The employee's leg struck a door jamb, causing muscle damage to the leg that required surgery.

An employee was observing the warper machine when his right arm got caught on the roller bar and was pulled into the machine. The employee sustained broken ribs as well as a broken right arm and elbow.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut pork chops. The employee's left hand slipped and made contact with the sawblade, which partially amputated the employee's left thumb.
A mechanic was moving steel with a fork truck when the tip of his right middle finger was caught between the steel and the carriage of the fork truck. This resulted in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell 20 feet into an empty irrigation basin resulting in a broken pelvis, arm, shoulder and ribs. Fall protection was not worn at the time.
An employee's left middle finger was caught between two carts and crushed. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking backward on a sloped, 50-foot-long table, pulling supply hoses. He fell off the table, landing on his left side on the concrete about 4 feet below and suffering a broken hip.
An employee slipped while picking up a hose and fell backward onto a dirt floor. A protrusion on the floor chipped one of the employee's vertebra.

An employee was bending steel using a rebar bending machine. As the employee was pushing rebar into the steel rollers, the rollers caught the employee's left glove and crushed the employee's left little finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was moving a piece of wood that was preventing a tarp from lying flat. When the tarp came down, his left middle finger was pinched between the trailer frame and the tarp frame. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was bending metal on a CNC brake press. The brake came down on his fingers and amputated one finger at the first knuckle and degloved the other fingers.

An employee was walking on a ceiling grid and fell approximately 60 feet through a draft opening striking another employee on a lower level. The employee on the lower level was hospitalized for fractures and other injuries. The employee that fell suffered injuries that resulted in a fatality.

On November 4, 2020, an employee was operating a forklift and struck the side of a trailer. The employee fell off the forklift and their legs were pinned underneath the forklift. The employee was hospitalized for leg fractures.

An employee was on a platform lancing a ladle holding liquid steel. He fell forward and his left hand went into the tundish containing liquid metal. He suffered third-degree burns to the hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a three-way valve when her right hand got stuck inside. She suffered a cut to the wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating the lamination machine when her arm was caught in the point of operation and degloved from the elbow to the hand.
An employee was performing a sanitation inspection on a machine and amputated their middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jam in an incline conveyor and sustained left arm and shoulder fractures and a degloving injury to the shoulder.
An employee was standing on a step ladder repairing a faulty garage door when he lost balance and fell to the garage floor. The employee sustained fractures and lacerations to the right elbow.
A truck driver opened the door at the back of the trailer and the door fell onto the driver's right foot. Two toes were amputated.
An employee was placing material onto the rack. He tripped and fell into the chain and sprocket resulting in a finger amputation. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw and suffered a deep laceration on his left hand.

On November 4, 2020, a customer service technician was at a client's facility when the technician stumbled and fell while walking on an uneven slope along the side of the road. The employee sustained a broken leg and ankle.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was backing up and sustained a fractured tibia.

An employee was using a bone-in saw to cut steaks. While he was securing the meat against the plate, the meat slipped and his left thumb came into contact with the sawblade. The blade amputated part of the thumb.

An employee was unhooking the steel stack from the moving lifter in order to have the plates picked up by the suction lifter when the top plate shifted and fell. The sheet slid down and struck the employee's left foot, fracturing the metatarsal bones. He was hospitalized for treatment and surgery.

On November 4, 2020, at approximately 11:45 AM, two Ranger Construction employees were unloading a skid steer loader from a tandem-axle heavy equipment trailer that was attached to a pickup truck. One employee was driving the loader down the trailer's loading ramp when the latch on the truck receiver was released. The weight of the loader on the back of the trailer caused the ring of the trailer receiver to pop up, contacting the latch and pinching the injured employee's left index finger between the latch and the hitch receiver. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking to the elevator, tripped over cables on the ground, and fell fracturing their femur.
