An employee was sitting on a mechanic's step stool on wheels installing a pump. The employee extended his feet and the step stool tipped over causing him to fall off. As he was falling, he tried to brace himself and suffered a right wrist fracture that required surgery.
An employee was using a torch to cut a wire. A nearby air line pipe ruptured and blew back into his face, burning his face and head.
An employee began to feel ill while dumping powdered caffeine into a vat. He was hospitalized, suffering from heart palpitations caused by the caffeine.

At about 2:00 p.m. on November 5, 2020, an employee was helping to move an engine mounted on a piece of metal with wheels. As the employee pulled the engine cart, one of its wheels ran over his left foot.

An employee was standing near lumber chains in a sorter area. When the machine was turned on, the front part of his foot was pulled into the chain and sprocket and two toes were amputated. Steel-toed boots were in use at the time.
An employee was draining a sulfuric tank. When the employee disconnected the line that was draining the sulfuric acid, acid in the line sprayed the employee's body.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut juniper branches. The chainsaw came into contact with a downed branch and kicked back, striking the right side of the employee's face and causing an eye injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bolting a transmission into place on a vehicle that was on a lift when the transmission fell striking the employee on the head. The employee sustained bruising to the head.
A forklift driver collided with an order picker. The employee operating the order picker was pinned between the two pieces of equipment, suffering a lower back injury and fractures to the pelvis.
An employee was cutting a stair trimmer with a hand-held grinder. The grinder kicked back and lacerated the back of his hand.
An employee was operating a scrap chopper and amputated multiple fingers.

An employee was removing two 6-inch diameter elm trees to create space to fell a larger ash tree. The employee felled the first tree and it fell into the second elm tree. When he cut down the second elm tree, it broke off the stump due to the pressure from the first tree and struck the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured fibula.
An employee was unhitching a farm implement from a tractor and sustained a deep laceration to the right hand and thumb.
An employee was finishing a commercial roofing job. The employee fell from the roof to the ground, suffering a head injury.

An employee was opening a gate when the horse he was riding slipped or bucked, then fell and landed on the employee. The employee suffered a crushed pelvis, with fractures to the pelvis and a lower-back vertebra.
An employee was driving a powered pallet jack. The pallet jack stopped suddenly and the employee fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered contusions to the back, arm, and head.
An employee was changing a belt on the motor of a blower machine. The employee's left ring finger was pinched between the belt and a pulley; the employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee had just helped attach a wagon to a pickup truck, then spoken to the truck driver at the driver's door. The employee began to walk away and the truck drove forward. The back wheels of the wagon struck the employee, causing abdominal and leg injuries.

An employee was performing landscaping work when the edger struck a nylon strap that was buried in the mulch. The strap hit the employee in the face and broke his safety glasses resulting in an eye injury.

On November 5, 2020, an employee was removing lumber pieces off the round table. A forklift was picking up a pack of lumber near the round table. The forklift bumped the lumber pack and pinned the employee between the lumber and the round table. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee fell while building a scaffold, striking his head.
An employee was on a lift measuring a door and fell 61 inches to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
A temporary employee was adjusting a conveyor belt. An adjacent motor degloved the employee's left hand, leading to the amputation of the little fingertip.
An employee was pinned at the chest between a tractor and a trailer and sustained an acute respiratory issue.
An employee was at the top of a ladder, inspecting above a ceiling. The ladder gave way under him and he fell, suffering a fracture to humerus at the shoulder.

A chemist was handling energetic material in a laboratory when it exploded. The employee suffered a broken right arm and wrist, an injury to the right eye, and metal shrapnel embedded throughout the body. The employee's right hand was medically amputated.
An employee was positioning himself on a tree branch to make a cut. The branch broke and the employee fell, suffering a broken leg.
On November 6, 2020, an employee was changing out a flat tire on a truck. The jack gave way while he was under the truck and the vehicle fell on him, breaking his ribs.
An employee slipped and fell in a corridor, suffering an avulsion to a tendon in her right kneecap.

On November 6, 2020, an employee was holding a fence post that was being placed into position. A tractor's front bucket became dislodged and fell on him, breaking his right ankle, left hand, and ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a loose candy wafer sheet and caught his left index finger between a moving baking plate and a stationary scraper resulting in amputation at the first joint.
An employee was setting up a mill when his right arm was crushed between the mill rollers. The arm was medically amputated at the elbow.

An employee was trying to reset a roll of misaligned bulk paper in a machine. His right little finger was caught between the roll lifting cradle and the lifting piston, and the fingertip was amputated.
On November 6, 2020, a mail carrier was walking down a wooden stairway after a mail delivery. She fell, landing on the concrete in front of the stairway and suffering a broken hip.

An employee was repairing the bell mouth when he attempted to use his foot to move a rolling mechanic's chair out of his way. The employee's foot got caught in the vertical uprights of the chair causing him to lose his balance and fall to the ground. The employee sustained a left leg fracture.

An employee was operating the fill machine when the machine became clogged with fill. As the employee was removing the clog, the machine blades lacerated his right index and middle fingers resulting in amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was in a bucket truck servicing the breakers and contacted an electrical line (7200V).  The employee sustained burns and tissue damage to his left shoulder, arm and wrist.
An employee was walking while carrying a plastic rake. The employee tripped over the rake and fell resulting in a broken shoulder and a laceration on the face.
An employee suffered an allergic reaction after walking into a room where medical procedure masks were stored.
After lifting boxes, an employee collapsed, having suffered a collapsed lung.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck (PIT) when it struck a concrete pillar in the warehouse. The employee's foot was crushed between the PIT and the pillar resulting in toe amputations.
An employee was climbing down an 8-foot A-frame ladder. The employee fell near the bottom of the ladder, hitting a shelf and the floor and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was on a roof. His foot slipped on metal roofing that was slippery from dew. He fell, landing on the ground two floors below and suffering a broken ankle and toes.
An employee was standing on a three-step platform ladder, loosening a nut on a bolt. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was servicing a rear-load trash container. His left index finger was pinched between the container and the back of the truck, and was broken and lacerated.
An employee fell 16-17 feet from an aerial lift to the ground and suffered a fractured left femur and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were vacuuming the top of a seal pot for a boiler, using a 6-inch steel flex hose. An eruption of molten ash blew back onto the employees and burned the employees on the face and neck. Both employee were hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while walking and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was helping to move a pipe that was on a forklift and weighed 3,000 lbs. The pipe started to roll and the employee tried to stop it with his foot. The pipe struck his left leg causing a leg and ankle fracture.

After cleaning a heater treater and flushing it with water, employees were preparing to conduct pinhole welding when a flash fire occurred. An employee suffered burns to both arms, from the elbows to the hands.
An employee was working near a backhoe. The boom came down and struck the employee's right foot, breaking it.
An employee was operating a walkie-rider and pinned his left foot between the rider and a pallet resulting in an injury to the left foot that required surgery.
An employee was closing down the go-kart ride when a go-kart struck the gate. The gate then rolled into the employee, resulting in abdominal injuries.
An employee was painting a grain elevator garage door from a forklift man basket. The employee fell to the ground 8-10 feet below, suffering a broken right collarbone.
An employee fell 14 feet from a roof and suffered a back injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was in the back of a store using a roller dolly. Her shoelace got caught in the dolly's wheel and she fell to the floor, breaking her left hip.
An employee was cutting a tree with a chainsaw. The trunk split and the tree kicked back, landing on the employee. The employee suffered a knee injury and a broken femur.
An employee was cutting ribs on a bandsaw. The employee's right thumb came into contact with the moving sawblade, which amputated the tip of the thumb.
A pocket of natural gas ignited and an employee was burned.
An employee was transferring a patient from a stretcher to a bed and suffered a bilateral inguinal hernia.
An employee was walking around a shopping cart when she tripped and fell. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was cleaning a pipe line with a water hose. A valve in the reject line actuated and amputated the employee's right index finger at the first knuckle.

A hoist was being used to move a 700 lbs. object. While holding a chain to help direct the object, an employee tripped and was struck by the object. The employee suffered a head/scalp injury, an injury to the left hand, and a left pinky finger injury. The employee required surgery for all injuries.

An employee was standing next to a jockey truck. A pickup truck crossed a marked RTG lane and struck the employee, who suffered a fractured skull, broken vertebrae in the back, and a dislocated left shoulder.
An employee was mopping up water in a flooded room. The employee slipped, hit the wall, and then hit the floor, suffering injuries to the left arm, neck, back, and chest.
An agent was bitten by a snake and had a bad reaction to the antivenom.
While closing an overhead door, an employee slipped and fell fracturing an ankle.

An employee was monitoring the extrusion line that manufactures plastic board when it was stopped due to a process upset. When the line stops, material in the line must be cleared out before it may be restarted. The employee was clearing the line when his left middle finger was pinched between a board and the gravity roller causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was slicing deli meat. The deli slicer amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb.

An employee was filling anhydrous ammonia tanks. He set the fill hose down on a riser, climbed down the steps of the riser dock to ground level, and picked up the fill hose. The valve opened and released liquid anhydrous ammonia, which sprayed down onto his feet. He suffered burns to both feet and was hospitalized.

An employee was loading medium-sized window frames onto a utility trailer. As he pulled on the rope to tie a frame to the trailer, the knot came undone from the trailer causing the employee to fall backward about 2.5 feet to the ground. His leg was caught in the trailer after the fall. The employee sustained a fractured right leg and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was working from a step ladder on a baker scaffold. The scaffold moved, causing the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground about 10-12 feet below. The employee suffered two broken wrists and was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling a steel tube beam on a cart. The cart struck a rock on the concrete slab causing the tube to fall onto the employee's foot and fracture toes.
An employee fell while unloading materials onto a scissor lift, landing on a concrete slab about 10 feet below and suffering a head contusion.
On November 9, 2020, an employee suffered an allergic reaction to latex in the strap of goggles they were cleaning. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning a proximity switch when the cylinder for the cotton press engaged and the block on the latch pivoted and came down on the employee's left hand crushing it between the frame of the press and the block. The employee suffered three broken fingers and tendon damage.
An employee was greasing hydraulic quick-connect pins on a loader. The pins were activated and crushed the employee's right index and middle fingers. The fingers were amputated.

An employee was preparing a roof area for work on the next day, including covering a skylight. The employee fell though the skylight onto a concrete surface 20 feet below, suffering severe contusions, fractures, and a concussion.
Four employees were dislodging a canister cart ring from a canister. The ring shifted clockwise and amputated the tip of one employee's right index finger.

An employee was standing in the bed of a pickup truck dumping leaves from a barrel into the dumpster when the employee slipped and fell from the truck to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury and concussion.
An employee was trying to fix a flap near the cutter on a sealer machine. The machine caught her fingers and amputated her right ring fingertip.
An employee lacerated his left forearm with a utility knife while cutting a conveyor belt.

An employee was on the gondola using a stick to unblock rubber pellets inside the mixer. The track that ran the gondola was turned on and moved forward knocking the employee off the hopper. The employee fell between the gondola and the track below and suffered abrasions. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was loading an aerial work platform onto the back of a box truck. The platform tipped over and fell, landing on the employee's upper right leg. He was hospitalized for a fractured femur.
Employees were shoveling asphalt. One employee's shovel came down on the injured employee's left ring finger and amputated the tip.
Three employees were moving a steel door that was on a pallet. The door slid back and cracked the wood cribbing of the pallet and fell onto the employee's right middle finger crushing the fingertip.

An employee was loading a 60-foot power pole onto a pole trailer using a pole crane and choker chain. The chain bound up; the employee grabbed the chain and tried to unbind it. The chain released and caught the tip of the employee's left middle finger, amputating it above the first knuckle.
An employee was pushed by a patient causing the employee to fall on the floor. She landed on her right arm and fractured the humerus.
On November 9, 2020, an employee suffered a partial amputation of his left thumb and a laceration on his left index finger while operating a table saw.

Two employees were unloading two pallets from a box truck. As they placed the second pallet onto an electric hand truck, the rear wheels rolled over the dock bridge plate, which caused the front of the plate to tilt up and the hand truck to become stuck. The injured employee attempted to push down and hold the bridge plate by the handle on the left side to free the hand truck and as the hand truck operated it caused the bridge plate to twist and pinch their left fingers between the bridge plate and the back of the truck. The employee's left index finger was injured.
A 500-pound pulley slipped and struck an employee. The employee's left little finger was amputated.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder, installing the header of a window frame. The employee fell to the ground about 5 feet below and suffered broken ribs and a broken wrist.
While cutting foam board on a table saw, an employee suffered severe lacerations to four fingers on the left hand that required surgery. The saw was not guarded at the time.
A temporary employee moved a wedge that was holding wooden poles. The poles rolled over their hand and caused an open fracture on a fingertip.

At 11:00 p.m. on November 9, 2020, an employee was cleaning a VTA machine. A blade on the machine contacted the employee's left index fingertip, causing an amputation between the fingernail and the first joint.

An employee was unhooking a 6-inch rotary pump from a company vehicle. When the pump came off of the hitch, the jack rolled back and the pump fell to the ground, crushing and amputating the employee's left big toe.

An employee was performing overhead maintenance work from an A-frame ladder. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, striking his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized for a head injury and fractures to both arms.

On 11/09/2020, at 11:45AM, an employee began to climb an extension ladder. Upon reaching the fourth rung he began to descend the ladder. His left foot slipped between the second and third rungs, causing the ladder to destabilize and fall. The ladder slid down the wall and the employee rode it to the ground, with his foot trapped in the ladder. He sustained a fractured left ankle.

On November 9, 2020, at around 12:00PM, an employee was helping to rescue ducklings from a sewer when the sewer grate came down on their hand. Two fingers were fractured and a fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a utility knife to trim conduit. The knife slipped and amputated the top of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee fell while stepping off a truck. The employee's right knee struck the pavement, suffering a deep bone bruise. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was grinding beans in a meat grinder and amputated their right middle fingertip.

Three employees were riding on a utility terrain vehicle, which was going 12-15 miles per hour. The vehicle lost traction on newly applied gravel and rolled over onto its side. One employee's right leg was pinned and broken by the vehicle's lower frame. He was hospitalized.
An employee was bitten by a cat on her right index finger when she reached into a kennel to remove a leash off the cat. The wound became infected.
An employee was installing OSB sheathing on the outside of a prefab home. The employee's staple gun fired a staple into the employee's ankle, penetrating the bone.

An employee was the bucket of a bucket truck, installing a new light bulb at one end of an overhead street light arm. The opposite end of the street light arm fell and made contact with an energized overhead power line. The resulting arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's back.

An employee was helping clean out a pool of sodium hydroxide. While the employee was in the pool, the chemical entered the employee's boots (having broken the seal at the top of each boot) and burned the tops of the employee's feet. The employee was hospitalized.
On November 10, 2020, an employee was wiring a power door when his right hand touched a 460-volt live wire. He was shocked, suffering a burn to the right hand, and was hospitalized.

Two employees were trying to retrieve a piece of glass that was buried at the back of a rolling A-frame cart. One of them was holding up pieces of glass (each about 60 by 80 inches) that were leaning out from the stack. Their weight, pushing against the base of the cart, caused the wheels to move. The glass then fell onto the employee, pinning him against the horizontal bar of a piece of equipment about 5 feet away. He suffered internal injuries.
An employee was placing a sheet of plastic on top of a pallet for shipping and fell from a rolling step stool, striking his head. The employee sustained a head laceration.
An employee took a step and broke their right ankle.
An employee was leaving a cooler area on a pallet jack after dropping off a pallet of material. The employee's lower right leg was pinned and broken between a rack beam and the pallet jack housing.
An employee was approaching a potential shoplifter at the front of a store. The shoplifter pulled out a corn knife and severely lacerated the employee's arm several times.

An employee was cleaning up at the end of the shift and putting small hand tools and extension cords away in a large, steel tool box. The employee was holding the tool box lid open with one hand and putting tools away with the other hand when the lid slammed shut causing the amputation of the employee's left ring fingertip.
An employee was tagging a lower bundle when a bundle of cardboard weighing approximately 1,200 pounds fell from above and onto the employee who sustained multiple fractures and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on an icy metal grate while walking toward a building. The employee fell to the metal grate and the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was on the lift gate of an electric truck. The gate tilted down while it was still 4 feet off the ground; the employee fell to the ground and a cart that had been on the gate landed on the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working at a gauge. A 12-pound part failed the gauge and the employee picked it up to take it to the rework stand. As she turned, she felt a sharp pain in her lower middle back.

An employee dismounted a sit-down forklift to adjust freight boxes on its forks. The forklift began to roll forward and one of the forks pinned the employee's left foot against the wall of a tractor-trailer. The employee suffered a broken first toe and contusions to the foot.
Employees were cleaning the lint cleaner machine when one employee's finger was caught in the saw. The injured employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was operating a lathe and suffered a finger amputation.
A moving steel plate caught two of an employee's fingers. Both fingertips were amputated between the first and second knuckles.
An employee's finger was caught in a door jam as the door closed causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped over a clothing rack and broke an arm.

An employee was rebuilding a water hydrant. The employee removed the head from the hydrant and then went to the truck to get a rebuild kit. The employee was returning to the hydrant when he was struck by hydrant parts. The employee sustained a 6 to 8-inch laceration to the forehead.
An employee fell from the back of a delivery truck and broke his arm.

On November 10, 2020, an employee was on the roof of a two-story, new-build home to install anchor points for fall protection devices. The employee slipped on the wet underlayment and fell 20-24 feet to the ground below, suffering a fractured neck, ribs, and arms.
A fleet mechanic was gathering mileage information from his truck. As he exited the truck, he missed the last step and fell about 14 inches to the ground below. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trimming a tree when its root structure gave out. The tree fell and pulled the employee to the ground; the employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a sander on a piece of metal. The sander slipped and amputated the first joint of the employee's left thumb.

An employee was operating a 50-ton press on a compression mold. When the employee went to flip the mold, the press crushed the employee's right index finger resulting in amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee fell through a skylight onto the concrete floor and suffered a broken back, dislocated right shoulder and a broken right ankle.

An operator was attempting to start a fuel truck, but the truck (air brake type) did not start. It rolled forward and pinned a service crew technician against a large sump pump. Both of the technician's lower legs were broken.
An employee was in a lift basket, removing a plastic tarp from a bridge. The lift moved and crushed him between the handrail and a beam. He suffered crushed ribs and vertebrae and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice while walking out of a cabin at a filming location. His right ankle twisted under him and he fell, suffering a broken ankle.
Two employees were pulling and connecting electrical wires. They came into contact with a live, parallel wire and both suffered electrical burns. They were hospitalized.

Two employees were responding to a power outage. They were pulling in a secondary conductor while up on a distribution pole. One or both employees went to attach the conductor and contacted an energized high-voltage power line. Both employees were hospitalized with burns.
An employee was stripping a ceiling when he lost his balance and fell from a baker scaffold. He suffered a foot injury.
An employee fell from an extension ladder to the concrete slab below, suffering a broken leg and an ankle injury. The employee was hospitalized.
While an employee was clearing a jam on a polyester filling machine, a pneumatically controlled door closed on his right ring fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
A truck driver was sitting in a truck in the drop yard/lot when a gust of wind caused the truck door to slam shut onto the employee's middle finger, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was clearing powder from a clogged dust collector on a grinder and suffered a partial amputation of the right index fingertip from the moving rotary valve feeder/air lock at the bottom of the hopper. The machine was not locked out at the time.
On November 11, 2020, an employee was working from an extension ladder when it slipped. The employee fell about 6 feet onto a pallet of bricks below, suffering bruises to the back.

An employee was cleaning out a cotton ginning plant when the machine caught his work glove and pulled his left hand into the machine. Four fingers on the employee's left hand were amputated at the second joint.
An employee was using a drill press to bore a piece of wood. The drill bit caught the glove on his left hand, resulting in the amputation of his left thumb.
During a dispute with a customer, an employee sustained a laceration on their back from a pocket knife.
An employee was unjamming a blade machine and suffered a finger amputation when it was caught between the pulley and chute.

On November 11, 2020, three employees were stacking two crates on top of each other for transport to a mulching station. One employee was on one end and the other two were on the other; when the top crate was pushed toward the single employee, the employee's left index finger was caught, fractured, and partially amputated between the two crates.

An employee was using lubricant on the bearings of a conveyor roller, which were not turning. They began to turn and a cube of bricks advanced on the conveyor, pinching his left ring finger against a roller. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee walked into a closet. A hand tool was dropped from above and lacerated the employee's head.
An employee was cleaning a batter mixing machine when their left index fingertip was amputated in a port on the machine. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was using a surface grinder to vent a kickout pin. The grinding wheel ran over the employee's right thumb, causing a partial amputation to the thumb.
Two employees were carrying a 2-by-12 up a ladder. One employee slipped and fell off the ladder, breaking his ankle.
An employee fell while walking down a hallway and broke her right humerus.
During an attempted robbery, an employee in the parking lot was shot twice. The employee sustained bullet wounds to the shoulder and leg.
An employee was riding on a pallet on a forklift. The employee's left ring, middle, and little fingers were caught between the forklift and a chain, and were broken and lacerated.

An employee was closing a rolling gate after herding cattle through it. The mechanism at the top caught the employee's left hand and pulled it in, crushing and breaking the index and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee's right foot was caught and pulled into a chain and sprocket. The foot was broken and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it hit a piece of angle iron and jolted. The employee fell off the forklift and suffered lacerations to the head and arm.

An employee was inspecting a powerhouse transformer. The employee slipped and fell in a containment area (containing less than an inch of standing water), landing on the ground and suffering head and lower leg injuries.

An employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, installing new flex-duct on an HVAC system. The ladder became unstable; it and the employee fell in different directions, and the employee landed on the tile floor. The employee suffered injuries to the left hip and both knees.
An employee was working on a track press machine. The employee's left hand slipped and was caught between two tracks, and the tip of the little finger was amputated.
A spray paint can exploded when an employee picked it up. The employee suffered a hand injury.
On November 11, 2020, an employee was climbing down from a crane when he slipped and fell about 3-4 feet to the ground. He suffered a back injury and was hospitalized.
An employee had been working on a hot water heater located above an office. The employee fell through the roof in the shipping area, landed on the floor, and sustained a broken pelvis.
An employee's left hand was caught between a container and a flatbed. The employee suffered an amputation to the little finger.

Inside the maintenance shop, two employees were using a mechanical press to remove a shaft from a gear belonging to an overhead crane. While the gear was being adjusted, it slipped and fell, striking one of the employees on the hand. The employee sustained a broken hand.

An employee was using a powered pallet jack to move trays into a mixing room. The employee's right foot was caught and crushed between the pallet jack and a concrete bollard; the employee was hospitalized.
While exiting a ready-mix truck cab, an employee fell onto the truck platform 2.5 to 3 feet below. He suffered broken ribs on the left side.

An employee was on a scissor lift, 15 feet above the ground, testing a large vinyl water bladder.  The bladder exploded, causing him to fall from the scissor lift to the ground. He suffered a broken sternum and an abdominal injury.
An employee was lifting a transmission. The transmission fell on his finger, breaking it.
An employee was giving medication to a patient. The patient pushed the employee and she fell to the floor, sustaining a head laceration that required staples. The employee was hospitalized.

On November 11, 2020, an employee was on a product transfer cart between two conveyors. The cart moved and crushed his foot against a conveyor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the foot.

An employee was inside a hydro-scaffold to ensure that the scaffold was clear to be lowered. As the scaffold was being lowered, an outrigger arm was caught on a baring plate, causing it to become unseated. The scaffold then fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken pelvis and a lacerated scalp.
An employee was on a chair to reach items in a cabinet and fell, striking their head on the floor.
An employee was cleaning out a pump. His right hand was caught in the hopper and the tips of his index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee fell from a step stool to the floor about 27 inches below. The employee's right leg was broken.

Two employees were using a hand operated lift and were installing a power box onto the shelf of a rack. The lift moved and caught the left hand of one of the employees against the box which resulted in amputation of the left pinky finger.
An employee was performing maintenance on a piece of machinery and suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was helping move a lift onto a flatbed truck. The lift moved and struck the employee on the leg, lacerating it.
On November 12, 2020, an employee was routing a floor of an emergency vehicle for an installation. The router jumped out of his hand, causing an avulsion to his left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting roofing material with a demolition saw. As he moved from one cutting location to another, the saw cut his left forearm.
An employee was trying to remove a plastic cover from a completed drill pipe. The coating cage basket fell on the employee's right forearm, breaking it.

An employee was changing the bit on a router. The machine was cycled and the bit struck the employee, causing a fracture and a puncture wound to the right foot. The router was not locked out at the time.
An employee's right little toe caught a wooden pallet and was punctured by a splinter from it. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped on a bollard at the edge of a walkway. The employee fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was cleaning and doing preventive maintenance on a pasting line. A piece of equipment moved and pinned his left index finger, dislocating it. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was packaging steel coils when a support arm opened, pinching the employee and the steel. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture.
On November 12, 2020, an employee tripped on a box and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left knee. She was hospitalized.
An employee was moving two hand carts when he slipped and fell to the floor. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee fell through a work platform opening on a scaffold, landing on the floor about 20 feet below. The employee's right ring finger was broken.
An employee fell at the last rung of a ladder as she climbed down, landed on the floor, and broke her right knee. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was aligning material on a shear machine. The hold-down foot caught his left little finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning a grease trap with a pressure washer. The washer hose ruptured and water, dirt, and other foreign objects were injected into the employee's right hand.
An employee was unclogging a pump. Fins inside the pump housing amputated the employee's right thumb.
An employee was unloading materials from the back of a truck. The employee fell from the truck to the ground and suffered ankle and knee fractures.

A ship's crew was moving a ship along a dock. One of the ship's lines broke and struck an employee who was walking on the dock. The employee suffered an arm amputation below the elbow, a broken pelvis, and abdominal injuries.
An employee fell while buffing a floor. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a neck and back injury.
An employee was removing a ship rope from the steel hook on a buoy. The hook crushed his left big toe and second toes. The big toe was medically amputated at the base of the nail.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof. The employee fell from a height of 12 feet.
An employee suffered finger amputations inside a picker (a large drum with fingers that pull fiber apart).

An employee was cutting through a section of piping when it broke loose and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered fractures in the jaw and mouth, a broken nose, and chipped teeth and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a bicep tendon separation while grinding fittings. He was hospitalized.
An employee was guiding a gantry crane as it moved a piece of metal. The crane struck him and pinned him beneath it, breaking his left leg, pelvis, and ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a paper towel to dry the bottom of a hopper. The hopper activated and the employee's right hand was caught in the machine's paddle system. The employee suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was working from a 16-foot ladder to replace a cable line at a customer's home. The employee fell from the ladder to the asphalt driveway, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee slipped and fell in the parking lot. She suffered a broken left femur and was hospitalized.

Two employees were unloading insulation bundles from the forks on a boom. When the load was detached from the forks, it fell over and landed on one of them, causing broken ribs, a spine and shoulder blade injury, and a collapsed lung.
An employee was walking toward a store and fell as she stepped onto the curb. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was inspecting the belt of a building exhaust fan on a roof. His left middle finger was pinched between the belt and the pulley and amputated down to the first joint.
An employee was pushing a piece of sheeting on a table saw. The sheeting began to lift; while the employee was pushing it down, the blade amputated the tips of his left ring and middle fingers.
An employee was loading recyclable cardboard onto a compactor loading area. As he pulled a piece of wood out of the loading area, a nail punctured his right little finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over the corner of a pallet, fell to the floor, and fractured their left hip.

An employee was troubleshooting an air conditioning unit from a ladder. As he reached up to retrieve his phone, his finger entered the belt and pulley of the unit. He suffered an avulsion that resulted in an amputation of his left middle fingertip at the knuckle, just behind the nail.

An employee tripped on a fatigue mat while walking from a register to a self check-out, falling to the cement floor. The employee suffering a fractured left eye socket and their nose was broken in three places.
An employee was running a machine that straightened corrugated boxes. While he was straightening a box by hand, the machine engaged and trapped his left leg, breaking the lower leg in two places.

An employee was cleaning under a rewinder machine. The employee backed out in a crouched position, began to stand up, and turned to get traction. The employee's left foot got caught under the outfeed discharge conveyor; they fell with their foot under the conveyor, landing on their face and suffering a laceration over the eye that required 7 stitches, as well as a left ankle dislocation and tibia-fibula fracture.

An employee was placing parts in storage bins, which were then stacked on top of one another. A forklift came to move a filled bin, and its forks caught on a bin below the one being lifted. The bin struck the employee's right leg, causing a compound fracture of the lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's ex-partner showed up at work. After a few words were exchanged, the employee was shot in the abdomen by their ex-partner.
An employee fell to the ground in a parking lot, hitting her knee and head and scraping her arm. She was hospitalized due to the head trauma.

An employee was removing the last chain from a substitute vehicle for a driver that had broken down. The driver went into the cab of the semi-truck and began driving forward. The truck ran over the employee's feet, and the employee was pulled against the tires. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and crushing injuries to both feet and ankles.
An employee tripped while stepping off a platform. He fell about 6 inches, landing on his hip (and on a radio in his pocket). His hip was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee was painting from stilts. He tripped on a cable and fell to the ground, suffering broken wrists. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell from an elevator to a floor 20-25 feet below. He suffered liver trauma, a lateral lung contusion, and right rib fractures. He was hospitalized.

Employee was working with a 3.5-inch air nail gun to assemble wooden trusses on the production line at a modular home manufacturing plant. As he tried to free a stuck air line running to the gun, the hose cam loose. The gun swung into his leg and fired a nail into the leg above the knee.
An employee jumped up to remove a load lock on a freight truck, landed on the ground, and suffered a torn right ACL and broken tibia.

An employee was testing a two-stage hydraulic ram. The internal components of the ram blew out, puncturing his left forearm at the bottom and exiting at the top. The projectiles did not hit or break any bones.

An employee was standing outside his truck, watching as rigging beams were loaded onto the tractor trailer. A crane was lifting a beam when it swung around, pinning and crushing the employee against another beam. The employee suffered three pelvic fractures and abdominal injuries.
An employee was adjusting a load of roofing material on a flatbed conveyor truck. The employee slipped on snow and fell to the asphalt, suffering three broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was building a brick wall on a roof when he stepped on a blue tarp that was covering an HVAC opening and fell through the opening, resulting in a broken leg.

Employees were trying to start a reactor arm. One of them was trying to adjust a three-groove V-belt that was turning in the pulley but was not in the proper grooves. The employee's left glove was caught and pulled into the pulley grooves, and two of his fingers were amputated.
An employee fell to the ground in a parking lot, suffering a broken right arm.
An employee was riding a railcar to a track area. The employee fell from the railcar, suffering a broken tibia.
An employee was doing performing maintenance on a conveyor belt when it caught and lacerated the employee's right little and ring fingers. The fingers were medically amputated.
An employee was breaking down beams on a production line. A steel beam crushed one of the employee's fingers, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was operating a forklift in a warehouse. While making a turn into a crossing lane, the forklift struck another forklift that was parked on the side of the lane. The employee's leg struck the carriage of the forklift and was fractured.

An employee was performing a safety test on a ladder to ensure that it was stable. When the employee shook the ladder, it collapsed and the employee fell on his back. He suffered two broken vertebrae.
An employee was cutting a tank with a torch when the tank dropped onto his right foot and fractured it.
An employee was using a concrete saw when it kicked back, lacerating the employee's upper left arm.

An employee was removing a plywood cover over a 6-foot-deep excavation for a post hole sign base. The soil at the edge of the excavation failed and the employee fell into the hole, and his right humerus was fractured with a dislocation at the shoulder joint.

At 2:00 p.m. on November 14, 2020, an employee reached into an energized airlock underneath the hopper of a baghouse. The guard had rotated out of place and the airlock blades/arms partially amputated the employee's right ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was feeding product through a crimper. The employee's left thumb entered the gap in the packaging lateral seal and the tip was partially amputated.

At about 3:00 a.m. on November 14, 2020, an employee was checking a molding machine containing seized-up material. As he opened the machine's door and looked down, the molding material gassed off and blew into his face. He suffered facial burns, as well as splatters on the neck and hands, and was hospitalized,
An employee was moving an electric pallet jack when it pinned her right leg against a storage rack. She suffered a torn ACL in the leg and was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee was adjusting the alignment of a shaft-driven conveyor belt. The rotating shaft bolt and collar caught the employee's sleeve and pulled the employee's right arm into the shaft. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the arm.
An employee tripped over a stationary deli/meat case bumper and fell to the floor, suffering a knee injury that required surgery.
Employees were installing a blowout preventer. One employee's hand was caught between the actuator assembly cage and the top drive. His right index finger was crushed and later amputated.
An employee was stacking axles. As he tried to insert a spacer/peg and move a hoisted axle, the axle crushed the tip of his left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.

On November 14, 2020, an employee was mixing burrito ingredients in a mixer. The auger ejected the food mix from the machine. As the employee was trying to get out more of the mix, the auger amputated the end of the employee's right index finger.

An employee was at a construction site to review project work and to direct future project work. After concluding her meeting, the employee was in the driveway returning to her vehicle to leave the construction site when a tree from the abutting property fell and struck the employee, portions of the building under construction, and a vehicle. The employee lost consciousness and suffered skull and brain injuries that required surgery. The employee also sustained neck trauma and bone fractures along with lacerations, bruising, and swelling.
An employee was repairing an air line on a trailer. The line burst and struck him in the eye, fracturing his eye socket. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a roller machine when it amputated one of the employee's fingertips.
An employee fell from a step ladder to the floor, suffering a broken left arm.
An employee was burned on the face and arms by a gas fire when he attempted to move the fryer. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was backing an empty electric tugger into a lane when his left thumb was caught between the tugger's steering head and a metal beam. The thumb was lacerated.

An employee was in a grain bin. While stepping over the grain bin sweep, the employee was caught by the sweep and pulled in. The employee suffered leg and arm injuries that necessitated two skin grafts, including missing skin and muscle in the leg.
An employee was hospitalized after falling over a seizure mat.
An employee was working in a warehouse. A forklift pushed materials off pallets and they struck the employee, who suffered fractures to the jaw, a broken nose, and knocked-out teeth.
An employee was driving a forklift when his foot was caught between the forklift and a guard. He suffered multiple fractures to the foot.
An employee fell while moving plastic totes, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip and femur.
In the course of an altercation, one employee shot another.
Two employees were working to restore flow through a pipe. Hot water released from the pipe and hit the employees, who suffered first- and second-degree burns.
An employee was sitting in a folding chair while working. When he stood up, his foot caught on the chair leg and he fell onto the floor landing on and fracturing his right hip.
An employee was using a rag to clean the polish rod on the pumping unit when he right index and middle fingers were amputated.
An employee was trying to stop a metal storage cabinet, which was being blown by a gust of wind, from striking a fuel truck. The cabinet struck the employee and broke his arm.
On November 15, 2020, an employee attempted to lift a patient that had fallen to the floor. The employee experienced abdominal pain and was hospitalized for a hernia that required surgery.
An employee fell from the ladder of a wheel loader.

Employees were rigging a piece of pipe. When the pipe was being lifted, the load shifted, and the pipe crushed an employee's left ring finger against a piece of wood. The fingertip was amputated above the nail.
An employee was on a ladder in a residential property performing a rodent exclusion. The employee fell from the ladder and struck their head on the floor.

An employee was installing and caulking a rubber boot seal on a vent pipe on a metal mobile home roof. She slid off the roof, falling to the ground about 10 feet below and suffering a broken right tibia.
An employee was removing pins from a crane attachment. The attachment struck the employee's left foot, breaking it.
A roofer tripped and fell off the edge of a roof, suffering a laceration to the right arm from a glass table.
An employee was exiting a forklift when his right foot was caught between the forklift and a palletizer. The foot was broken.
An employee sustained amputation of their right index finger.
An employee was standing on a slide guard on a roof. One of the anchor brackets ripped out and the employee fell 25 feet, suffering fractures to the skull, a shoulder, and a hand.
An employee fell while carrying a piece of lumber and suffered a broken right thumb.

An employee was removing a damaged boiler door using a chain hoist. The door slipped off the hinge and pinned the employee's left thumb, crushing and partially amputating the tip. The employee was hospitalized and another part of the thumb was surgically amputated.
An employee was using a water hose to spray a parking lot. The employee tripped over the hose and fell to the concrete ground, suffering a broken left hip.

After filling a demolition saw with fuel, an employee started the saw up to cut rebar. Gas spilled out of the saw onto the employee's right pants leg, and a spark from the cutting ignited it. The employee's right leg was burned above the knee.
An employee was holding a wire from a wire-drawing machine with a rag. The rag got caught on the draw block and pulled the employee's hand into the machine, causing the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was using a 10-foot rolling stair ladder to access the top of a salt hopper. The employee fell to the ground 10 feet below, breaking both heels and his left ankle.
An employee was moving a safe on a pallet using a pallet jack. The pallet jack got hung up on the floor; the safe tipped and struck the employee in the left leg, breaking the ankle.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to move an empty chemical tote out of a chemical injection room. The jack's handle struck a full chemical tote, and his left little finger was caught between the handle and the tote. The finger was fractured, with tendon damage that required surgery.
An employee was operating a screed and amputated a finger.

An employee was pressing a rag against rollers inside a folding machine. When the machine was jogged, the rag and the tip of the employee's right index finger were pulled into the rollers. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee was carrying clean dishes from the dishwasher to the plate caddy when he fell. The plates broke when they struck the floor and the employee landed on top of the broken plates causing lacerations to his hands and forearms. The laceration on his right forearm required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was working on a rotary airlock when it broke and lacerated his left hand.
An employee slipped and fell while getting off a lift gate, landing on the ground about 2 feet below and breaking his right femur.
An employee was preparing to perform maintenance on a crane. While climbing down the crane's platform, the employee fell five feet resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was standing next to his forklift and was struck by another forklift that was backing out of a container. The employee's leg was pinned between the two forklifts.
An employee was sitting in a chair when a 66-pound box fell out of a modular stacking system onto the employee's head. The employee suffered a head injury.

On November 17, 2020, an employee was flipping the gating tree and pour cup on the line when the pour cup fell backward and crushed her left index finger on the shaker table resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was zoning merchandise in a store. As she stood up from a squatting position, she slipped and fell, suffering an injury to the left hip.

A mechanic was working under the hood of a vehicle that would not start, checking while another employee turned on the ignition. The vehicle started and the radiator fan amputated the tip of his left index finger.

An employee was working at a stand up desk testing the fat on the meat. The employee stepped back and his foot got caught on a concrete bollard behind him causing the employee to fall to the ground and break his left hip.

On November 17, 2020, employees were replacing a steel core. The injured employee was releasing air from the airshaft by depressing the air valve while a forklift operator was removing the airshaft from the steel core. The injured employee's right index finger was pinched between the steel core and the airshaft causing a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee tripped over a cord behind a cash register and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee had been delivering mail and was walking back to her vehicle from an apartment complex when she fell on the ground and sustained two fractures to the left ankle.
An employee fell off a residential roof, landing on a floor and suffering back injuries.

An employee was cleaning a dough sheeting machine. The machine pulled in the employee's right hand, crushing the middle finger and causing a closed fracture of the ring fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
On November 17, 2020, at 7:30 p.m. an employee was using a drill press when his glove became entangled in the drill bit resulting in amputation of a finger at the first knuckle.
An employee's hands were caught in a centrifuge causing injury to the left index and middle fingers and the right ring finger.

An employee was loading wood from the back of pick up truck onto a smaller dump truck to move the wood to various locations around the property. After loading the dump truck he stepped onto the back of the dump truck's tailgate and fell, breaking his wrist and sustaining other injuries.

An employee was transferring wood slabs from the belt to the feed chain when his left hand went under the slab and was pinched by the roller and chain. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, drilling a pilot hole for a screw. He fell from the fifth rung of the ladder to the concrete floor 3-5 feet below, suffering head and sternum trauma and broken/bruised ribs.

The injured employee was assisting another employee to transport a patient on a hospital bed from one unit to another using the outside sidewalk. The wheel of the bed went into the grass. The injured employee grabbed the wheel of the bed at the same time the second employee pulled on the bed. The injured employee's right pinky finger was pulled into the bed rail joint and the fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were preparing to pour concrete to manufacture burial vaults. The belt on the concrete auger broke. One of the employees had replaced the belt and was fixing a twist in it, with his left middle finger under it, when the machine was turned on. The fingertip was amputated about 1/4 inch below the nail.

An employee fell while stepping out of a yard switcher. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken left wrist and left hand, contusions to the right hand, and scratches on both knees. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a backsplash using a cut saw and amputated multiple fingers.

A carpenter was on a ladder to get measurements. As the employee started extending the tape measure, the ladder moved and the employee lost balance. Both the employee and the ladder fell to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee fell off a flat roof onto the gravel ground. The employee sustained a fractured leg and wrist.

An employee was working from a set of portable metal stairs, cleaning ammunition rounds with a drill brush. The wheel from a cart struck the stairs as the cart was pulled forward, causing the employee's leg to slip off the stairs and be caught between the stairs and a bollard. The employee suffered a broken tibia and fibula and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a jam from a small paper shredder machine. His gloved hand was caught and pinched under a flap. He was hospitalized.

An employee was in a trench encased in concrete that was 4 feet in depth and 5 feet wide cutting an old pipe. When he cut the pipe, a part in the trench collapsed and struck the employee's ankle causing the employee to lose his balance. The saw then contacted the top of his boot and lacerated the top of his foot.
An employee was repairing a bin sorter machine. The machine was turned on and the employee's hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket, causing amputations to three fingers.
An employee was operating the rubber mill when their right hand was pulled into the rollers. The right pinky finger was partially amputated.

An employee was installing valves on a vessel. He squatted down and grabbed a mid-rail wire rope guardrail. The guardrail loosened and the employee lost balance. The employee then slipped between guardrails and fell approximately 9 feet to a lower deck. The employee sustained a left hip fracture that required surgery.

An employee was operating a forklift to load a trailer at the dock. The trailer moved and the forklift fell between the trailer and the dock. The employee sustained head, neck, shoulder, back, tailbone, and wrist injuries.
An employee was on the outside of a trailer loading conveyor device, trying to break a jam. He fell and hit the back of his head on the concrete, suffering a concussion.
A mechanic was jacking up a gooseneck trailer and resting it on jack stands. The mechanic's hand was caught on the top/end of a jack handle, causing a crushing injury to the top of the hand.
While delivering a package, a letter carrier fell in a leaf-filled ditch and suffered a broken right upper arm.
An employee tripped over the cord attached to the patient alarm pad on a wheel chair and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was operating a magnetic drill. The drill bit caught his glove, amputating his right thumb.
An employee fell from a fixed ladder while climbing down from a roof. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken leg or legs.
An employee was washing out a drum truck when his left hand was caught between the drum flange and the drum guide. He suffered a laceration and a compression fracture to the hand.
An employee sustained an amputation injury to the left index fingertip pad.
An employee tripped and fell while walking. The employee struck a rock on the ground and sustained a possible fractured femur.
An employee was clearing a jam on the packaging machine and sustained amputation of the left index finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was cleaning fryer filters when he slipped and his left foot went into the fryer oil. He suffered burns to the foot.
An employee was operating a stand-up fork truck when his foot struck a guardrail and was broken.
An employee was unloading material from a telehandler when their fingers were caught in a pinch point between the hook and chain resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell while climbing down a 6-foot A-frame ladder, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken left leg.
An employee fell to the concrete ground, hitting his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing next to a parked forklift, wrapping a pallet. Another forklift backed into him and pinned him against the parked one. He suffered muscle injury and severe swelling to both legs.

At about 7:44 p.m., a group of employees were looking for the cause of a smoke-like smell. They traced the scent to the top of a seed house, where they found black areas in the cotton and on the wall around a bale motor. When the motor was turned off, the fire flashed. Two of the employees suffered severe hand, face, ear, and neck burns.
A carpenter was cutting a 2-by-4 with a miter saw. The employee's left hand came into contact with the sawblade, which amputated his thumb below the nail.

An employee was on a ladder when his neck made contact with a roll of wire energized at about 480 volts. The employee fell off the ladder, striking his head on a transformer box and landing on the ground. He suffered a broken left femur and an open head wound and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a hydraulic shear to cut sheet metal. The machine activated, and the blade amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger between the nail bed and the joint.
An employee stepped off a curb/sidewalk and struck her right knee on a postal vehicle.
An employee was lifting and moving floor drain grates. The employee's right middle finger was caught between two of the grates and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell from a flatbed (attached to an ATV) to the concrete floor, suffering a broken wrist and a head injury that caused bleeding in the brain.

An employee slipped on ice that had accumulated on the floor and fell while stocking shelves in a walk-in freezer. The employee's head struck a storage rack. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury and concussion.
An employee was helping another employee unload concrete manhole rings from a flatbed trailer. The employee's middle finger was pinched between the rings, and the fingertip was partially amputated.
On November 18, 2020, an employee was lifting a 50-pound case of celery when he fell forward and hit his head. He suffered a hernia tear.
A temporary employee was trying to unfold a piece of cardboard between a forklift and its attached grabber. The grabber pinched two of the employee's fingers, causing their amputation.
Two employees were removing a fitting from a hose which was attached to a hydraulic line for a pump, pressurized at 20,000 PSI. The hose came off and hit an employee, amputating his finger.
An employee was jogging a paper stack into place when the holding clamp was lowered. It amputated the employee's left middle finger.
An employee developed abdominal pain while lifting a 70 lbs. package.
An employee was lacing a bag under the sealing bar of a sealing machine. The bar pinched and lacerated her left index finger, causing partial amputation of the tip.
An employee was leaving an office when their purse got caught on the door handle. The employee lost balance and fell onto the floor, suffering a broken left hip that required surgery.
An employee tripped over some physical therapy equipment in a hallway and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a broken wrist, an avulsion fracture to a neck vertebra, and a head laceration.

An employee was removing a transfer bolt from a 14-inch casting table using his left hand. As he unscrewed the bolt, the platen under the table was lowered. It pulled the screw down through the table top port, smashing the employee's left index and middle fingers between the bolt washer and the table. The index fingertip was amputated and the middle finger was crushed.
An employee was cutting a frozen turkey with a saw machine. The saw amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

Two maintenance technicians were working on a scissor lift, cutting a hole in a metal panel on a wall using a circular saw. The saw kicked back and partially amputated one employee's left middle finger.
An employee fell from the bottom rung of a ladder while climbing down, landing on the floor and breaking his right hip.
A 1,700-pound steel plate was being moved with a crane when it came loose, fell, and struck an employee's left foot. The foot was crushed and broken, and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee had lowered the bed of a double-headed planer machine and was about to clean it. He was trying to remove a piece of wood from the machine bed when the blade of the planer kicked the wood out. It struck the employee on the right index finger, causing lacerations to the fingernail and finger, as well as a fracture and partial amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was helping to place an aluminum coil onto an anodizing line. The rollers caught the employee's right glove and pulled in the employee's hand, degloving the thumb and index, middle, and ring fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to retrieve a metal bar from a bundle of metal when the bundle shifted and fell on his left hand. It crushed and amputated the tip of his ring finger.
An employee walked into a roof support beam in a shipping dock and suffered a broken nose.

An employee was working from a 6-foot A-frame ladder to mount a mold crossbrace. The employee fell from the top of the ladder to the floor, suffering broken ribs and vertebrae as well as internal bleeding around the hip.

UGI employees were doing excavation work on a the shoulder of a two-lane residential street. One of them was standing in front of a barrier vehicle, in place to protect the work area. A pickup truck struck the barrier vehicle. The employee's right hand was broken and lacerated, either by debris from the barrier vehicle or from the pickup truck's passenger-side mirror.
An employee was rotating the rotor of a wind turbine tower. The employee's right index finger was caught by the turbine rotor disc and amputated.
An employee was using a miter saw to cut a 2-by-4. As the employee lowered the saw, the 2-by-4 jumped, causing the blade to amputate the employee's left thumb above the first knuckle.

On November 19, 2020, a maintenance employee was assisting other employees to move equipment from one company location to another. The employees loaded several pieces of fencing/guardrails and a welding machine onto the forks of a forklift. The employees then backed the welder into the trailer and drove several blocks away. Upon reaching the facility, the employees parked the trailer at a dock that had an approximate 15 degree incline. The injured employee went into the trailer to retrieve the equipment and found the fencing had shifted between the welder and the forklift. As the employee attempted to remove the fencing, the forklift began rolling forward striking and pinning the employee between the welder frame and the forklift. The employee sustained fractures and a concussion from the impact of the forklift and was hospitalized.
On November 19, 2020, an employee was spotting for a forklift while it was moving a granite slab. The employee's foot was run over by the forklift and fractured.

An employee was walking down a hallway at a jobsite when he encountered a set of staircases and realized it was a dead-end. He went to turn around but lost his footing and fell down the staircase resulting in injured ribs and a punctured lung. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was jacking up the trailer of an 18-wheeler with an air jack under the rear bumper. The rear bumper broke when the welds failed, and the 800-pound jack fell onto the employee. He suffered a forehead laceration, broken ribs, and a spleen injury.
An employee was using a tire balancing machine. A spinning tire on the machine broke the employee's right leg.

On November 20, 2020, an employee was preparing to use a metal shear. As he handled the sheet metal to be trimmed, his right hand slipped toward the shear's blade, which amputated his ring and middle fingers at the first knuckle.
An employee fell 30 feet through a hole in the roof. He sustained fractures to the head, ribs and spine and was hospitalized.

A truck driver was using a ladder to access a large load on a flatbed truck. The ladder slipped on the ground and he fell, striking the heavy steel edge of the trailer and suffering a broken right lower leg and foot.

An employee was trying to pull a part out of the outfeed end of a thermoformer. The scrap wrapped around the chain, which pulled the scrap backwards and in turn pulled her hand into the scrap shear. The shear actuated and amputated her middle, ring, and little fingers above the knuckle.
An employee was walking between a trailer and a truck. He tripped and fell, and a diesel gas can he had been holding cut three fingers on his right hand.

An employee was changing out the propane bottle on a forklift. As he was connecting the line to the bottle, it started to spray propane onto his left hand. He suffered freezer burns to the thumb, index finger, and middle finger and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking to his car when a vehicle struck him. He suffered a fractured pelvis, fractures to three lower-back vertebrae, a broken nose, a head contusion, a laceration to the leg, and a hematoma in the pelvis.
An employee was operating power equipment. The employee's left foot slipped off the equipment and was crushed between it and a storage rack.
An employee was exiting a track loader that had just been loaded onto a flatbed trailer. He slipped and fell 5 feet to the ground, suffering a broken leg.

At about 8:00 p.m. on November 20, 2020, an employee was using a crane to remove product from a racking system. A cable broke and the crane tipped forward, ejecting the employee. The employee flew about 10-12 feet into the air, then fell to the concrete floor. The employee suffered two broken ribs, a broken collarbone, a broken tailbone, a punctured lung, and lacerations that required suturing.
Two employees were replacing the tubs on a heat exchanger when they came into contact with anhydrous ammonia. Both employees suffered burns to the torso.
On November 20, 2020, an employee was carrying loose plastic to a dumpster. A forklift backed into the employee, who fell to the ground and suffered a loss of consciousness and a skull fracture.
An employee was standing on a desk when it broke. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a shattered kneecap.
A cow pinned an employee against a fence in a livestock yard alleyway. The cow's horn punctured the right side of the employee's stomach.

At 9:40 a.m. on November 20, 2020, an employee tripped and fell near a piece of equipment while helping the equipment remove excess asphalt. The employee suffered a broken right foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was spotting as a mini-excavator installed a telephone pole. The excavator's boom struck the employee on the left side of his face and his left shoulder, knocking him backwards over a utility pole behind him. He suffered a small laceration to the side of the face and an injury to the shoulder, as well as a lower back injury from the fall. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while climbing down a ladder, landing on the ground and suffering a head laceration.

An employee was replacing a trailer suspension air spring. Tension was lost between the frame and the spacer, and the tip of the employee's left middle finger was caught between the two. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, breaking his right ankle.
A mechanic was working under a truck that was jacked up. The jack slipped a couple of notches and hit his shoulder, bruising it.

An employee was troubleshooting a hanging light fixture. While climbing an 8-foot A-frame ladder, he lost consciousness and fell from the second step to the concrete floor. He suffered a spine fracture and a head injury, as well as broken ribs and a punctured lung.

The safety cones closing off a lane of traffic were being cleaned up at the end of a shift. An employee was in the basket of the traffic control truck, picking up the cones, when a passing SUV crashed into a guide rail and then into the truck. The employee suffered a head laceration, internal injuries and bleeding, and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was preparing to mop a floor. A mixture of cleaning chemicals produced fumes, causing the employee to develop blurred vision and difficulty breathing after she inhaled them. She was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a vehicle when it struck a stationary reach truck. The employee's left leg was caught between the two vehicles and was fractured.
An employee slipped on a wet floor, fell, and suffered a sprained leg.
An employee lost his balance and fell.

An employee entered a manhole to assess repairs to a steam distribution line. As he went to inspect a valve on the condensate discharge line on the opposite side of the space, he stepped into a sump pit (14" in diameter by 18" deep) that contained hot water. The employee was hospitalized for third degree burns to his foot and ankle and second degree burns to his lower leg.
An employee tripped on a plastic strap sticking out from the bottom of a pallet. He fell and hit his head on the floor.

An employee had just finished welding a rear frame assembly and was moving to another work station frame with a hoist. The frame separated from the hoist, striking the employee and causing a leg fracture and a head injury.
A forklift driver got off a forklift to adjust a pallet. The top pallet of products fell, breaking the driver's leg. The driver was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee fell to the floor from a rolling staircase ladder while reaching for a product on a shelf. The employee suffered a head injury resulting in a brain bleed and was hospitalized.
An employee fell to the floor while running through a building. The employee suffered a broken left femur.
A child walked into a cashier's work area. The cashier tripped on the child, fell to the concrete floor, and struck her head, suffering a head injury.
Employees were loading bales of donations onto the back of a box truck. The truck's lift gate crushed an employee's left thumb, amputating the tip just past the nail.
An employee was cleaning automatic rollers when they caught his left-hand fingers, amputating the middle fingertip.

An employee was using a track excavator to remove the top part of a retaining wall. The excavator skidded on the concrete paving and slid off the top of the retaining wall, landing on the ground below. The employee suffered two broken ribs.

An employee was cutting the hinges off a damaged door using a cutting disk. The door slipped and pinned the cutting disk against the doorframe; the tool then fell onto the top of the employee's left hand, causing a severe laceration that required sutures and overnight hospitalization.
An employee was moving empty pallets with a forklift. When the forklift stopped, the employee fell off to the ground and suffered broken neck vertebrae.

A maintenance employee was attempting to straighten a bent forklift extension so it would not slide off the fork. The fork extension broke, struck the employee, and caused the employee to fall. The employee was hospitalized for lower leg fractures.
An employee was pulling plastic between the wheels on a sealer machine. The machine clamped down on her hand, causing third-degree burns. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a clogged regrind machine. The machine amputated fingers on the employee's right hand. The machine was energized at the time.
An employee was on a step ladder, storing product on a shelf. The employee fell off the second step of the ladder to the floor, suffering a broken right fibula.

An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack. The pallet jack slid on a wet floor while turning, and the employee's right foot was crushed between it and a storage rack. The employee suffered multiple fractures and crushing injuries to the foot.
An employee was trying to pull a hay bale off a truck. The bale fell on the employee and pinned her to the ground. She suffered broken thoracic vertebrae and lack of feeling and movement in her legs.
An employee tripped on a rock and fell while delivering mail, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip.

An employee was checking under a truck for leaking oil. The truck was started and drove forward, pinning the employee against tool boxes. The employee suffered five broken ribs and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding sheet metal into a ductwork roller machine. The metal caught his glove and his fingers were drawn into the machine. He suffered cuts to three fingertips.
An employee was using a pressure washer when the high-pressure water contacted his gloved hand, resulting in a severe laceration that required surgery.

On November 23, 20202, an electrician was replacing a conveyor belt on a multi-stage boom conveyor and ancillary equipment. The employee reached under the running machine to check the tension on the conveyor and his right arm was caught in the machine resulting in a fracture and severe lacerations that required surgery.
An employee was working from a walk board over an empty pool. He fell into the pool and broke both heels. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was working with a crew to lift a gang form with a forklift/tractor over an existing portion of gang form. The employee was on the inside corner of the wall portion of the forms where they were connected on the ground. The tag line caught on the top corner as the form was coming over the existing wall, causing the gang form to rock; the scaffold plank came loose and struck the employee. He fell to the ground, suffering head lacerations, broken ribs, and a possible back injury.

An employee had finished welding on a panel. A forklift lifted the product and steel tubing broke from the assembly, bounced off the concrete, and struck the employee, knocking him to the ground. The employee sustained contusions/bruising to the left arm and leg muscle.
An employee was operating a garbage truck's loading control panel. A dumpster fell off the forks and struck him, causing a concussion and a broken hip.

At 5:30 a.m. on November 23, 2020, an employee was trying to unjam a piece of meat from an overhead rib transfer belt when the employee's arm was caught in the belt. The employee's arm and wrist were broken and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was rolling garment trolleys along an overhead rail to feed into a chain conveyor. His left glove was caught between a trolley and the conveyor guard, and the tip of his little finger was amputated.
At 6:45 a.m. on November 23, 2020, an employee's right index finger was partially amputated by a skinner blade.
An employee was loading a roll of rubber mat into a pickup truck. The mat fell and caught the employee's finger against the bed rail. The employee suffered an amputation.
An employee was filling a 250-gallon container with water while standing on a 30-inch-high trailer. He fell to the ground, breaking four ribs and puncturing his lung.
An employee was using a pipe groover. His index finger was amputated in the pipe at the first knuckle.
An employee was putting a 17-inch tire on a 17-inch rim when it exploded. The employee suffered internal injuries and needed surgery.
An employee was using a slicer to cut cucumbers. The slicer amputated the tip of his left middle finger.
An employee was reaching for a drill when it turned on. The drill's cord wrapped around the employee's left index finger, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee had just un-banded laminated glass in a crate. A sheet of the glass fell from the crate and struck the employee in the helmet and then the right leg, breaking his tibia and fibula.
