An employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering broken bones in the left forearm.

An employee was standing on a platform washing the outside of the rear of his ready-mix truck. A fin in the slowly turning mixer drum caught the sleeve of his coat and twisted his right arm. He suffered a broken wrist and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell off a portable ladder while working on a truck in the body shop. He landed on the cement floor, hitting his head and suffering a head injury.
An employee had jumped up to reach a nylon rope to close a pull-down door. When he came down, the door jammed and the rope caught his right thumb. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning glue off the blade of an undercutter. The undercutter amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was setting up and running steel coils through an 18-inch slitter. His left little finger was caught in the slitter and amputated.
An employee was on a skid steer bucket when his leg was caught between the bucket and the track of the skid steer. His leg was amputated from the knee down.
An employee was operating a material handling device when it overturned. One of the employee's toes was amputated.

On November 23, 2020, an employee was reaching from a step ladder to trim a tree branch. The branch came off the tree, struck the ladder, and knocked the employee off the ladder. He fell to the ground and suffered broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell 2 feet from the top of a cabinet. His wedding ring got caught on the cabinet's frame while falling, causing the amputation of his left ring finger.
On November 24, 2020, an employee was hooking up two pieces of mobile equipment when a baggage tractor was engaged and struck the employee. The employee suffered crushing injuries.
On November 24, 2020, an employee was coming down an 8-foot fiberglass stepladder when he slipped, falling to the ground about 5 feet below. He suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of trim when it kicked back. The miter saw pulled in the employee's left hand and cut the index and middle fingers.
An over-arm bar for a slitting machine amputated the tip of an employee's right ring finger.
An employee was climbing down a 6-foot A-frame ladder. The employee fell at the second step from the bottom, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was leaning against a door when it opened and her finger was caught in the door hinge. The right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was in a truck, picking up traffic cones that were closing off a lane. The employee's truck crossed a live lane of traffic and was struck by another vehicle. The employee suffered fractures to both legs and the pelvis.
An employee was using a jackhammer to break up the concrete on a sidewalk. The jackhammer struck a toe on the employee's right foot, breaking it.

An employee slipped from a ladder and fell about 3 feet, striking an aeration pipe clamp and flange joint. The employee suffered two parallel 4-inch abrasions, three broken ribs, and a lacerated spleen.
An employee jumped from a tire storage rack. His finger was caught in a hole in the racking, resulting in a fracture to the finger.
An employee was setting up a liner press. His right index finger was caught by a belt and pulley near the adjustment wheel, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a bandsaw when it caught their glove and amputated their ring finger.

An employee was adjusting the dovetail end of a max ramp for installation onto the I-beam of a trailer. As the tail end was lowered onto the trailer, the employee's fingertip was caught and amputated between the tail and the I-beam of the trailer.
An employee was struck by a fork drive beam while restacking boards. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee slipped and fell on black ice in a parking lot, fracturing his left tibia and fibula.

An employee was stepping out of a portable toilet when a thrown rock, aimed at the side of the toilet, struck the employee in the hardhat and head. The employee suffered a laceration and broken bones in the right side of the head/forehead.

On November 25, 2020, an employee was driving a used passenger vehicle onto a roll-on/roll-off cargo ship. The vehicle's accelerator got stuck and it crashed into a pole within the ship. The employee suffered a leg injury that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped on a rug in a supermarket produce department and fell to the floor, suffering hip and arm injuries.
An employee was helping a concrete operator. The employee's right thumb was caught in a grooving machine and cut by the blade.
An employee was tarping a load of lumber on his truck. He fell off the top of the truck to the ground and broke both wrists.
An employee walk walking toward a time clock when she tripped and fell, breaking her right arm.

An employee was walking through a job site, along a crane mat running along muddy ground, picking up sections of 4-by-6 dunnage. He slipped as he stepped off the mat, and the two 4-by-6 lumber sections he was carrying crushed the tip of his right little finger as they fell to the ground. The fingertip was amputated just below the nail bed.

An employee was using an extension ladder to descend from a roof. The ladder slipped on the wet asphalt, and the employee fell about 10 feet to the ground on top of the ladder. The employee suffered a broken nose; fractures to an eye orbit, the sternum, and a knee; a head contusion; and brain bleeding.
An employee caught her foot on the floor and fell, suffering a broken hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a computer monitor down a stairwell. The employee fell down the stairwell, suffering a broken left lower leg and a dislocated left ankle.
An employee was using a pry bar to open a customer's tote. The tote gave way causing the employee to fall on the ground and land on his side. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left femur.

An employee was leaving for his break. While walking through the parking lot to get to his vehicle, a vehicle entered the parking lot, forcing the employee to stop abruptly, which caused him to slip on a patch of ice and fall. The employee's ankle was broken.
An employee was working on a 480-volt AC electrical connection motor control center room, changing out motors for baghouse fans. An arc flash burned his left hand and he was hospitalized.
While walking back to her desk an employee tripped over a power cord and fell fracturing her right hip.

An employee was cleaning up after working with BB cartridges (an ignition charge assembly) in a rotary machine. Residual HMX under the funnel ignited due to friction, burning the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was reaching into a cupboard over a fryer. A small CO2 container (used for whipped cream) was knocked into the fryer and exploded, splashing hot grease onto the employee and causing burns to the employee's face, neck, and forearms.

On November 25, 2020, an employee was trying to reach an upper conveyor belt to fix a jam. The employee's foot contacted the moving lower conveyor belt and his leg was pulled between a metal support bar for the conveyor and the chain of the conveyor belt resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was climbing down a 10-foot A-frame ladder when he fell at the last rung, hitting a sharp sheet metal edge on the wall of the enclosure he was in. He suffered a severe laceration to the right bicep.
An employee was unloading supplies for a residential roofing job. He fell off the flatbed approximately 54 inches to the ground and broke his arm.
An employee was moving a pump when his left index finger touched a moving impeller. He suffered a partial amputation at the fingertip.

An employee's finger was caught in a leaf spring clip installation machine, between the two forming clamps, when the machine's pneumatic actuators engaged. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
While on break, an employee climbed over a stair rail and fell 40 feet to the concrete below, resulting in broken legs and a spine injury.
On November 25, 2020, an armed robber attacked a convenience store cashier with a knife. She was hospitalized, suffering from abdominal stab wounds.
An employee was carrying a box of product in the back of a box truck. The employee slipped, suffering a dislocated ankle and fracture.
An employee went to sit on a glass countertop and fell through four panes of glass. The employee sustained severe lacerations to the back.
A forklift was carrying a 45-inch wheel assembly as its load. The flange fell from the load and smashed an employee's right little finger.

While discarding cardboard into a baler, an employee was holding the security door with their right hand and disengaged it from the locked position. While pushing cardboard into the baler with his left hand, his right hand slipped off the security door. The door slammed down and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was walking down a hill after making a notch in a poplar tree. The tree fell onto the employee, injuring his head.
An employee was descending a ladder when he missed the last rung and fell to the concrete floor. He suffered a broken tibia.

An employee was using a compressor grease gun to apply grease to the rotating ring of the mixer drum on the back of a ready-mix truck. Grease built up between the roller and the mixer drum; the employee was trying to remove it when his right index finger was caught between the rollers. The last joint of the finger was amputated.
An employee was doing elevator maintenance. The cable grab system caught his finger, amputating it at the first joint.
An employee was walking along a concrete pathway, tripped on loose pavers, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.

On November 25, 2020, after inspecting a roof for wind damage, an employee stepped onto a ladder to leave the roof. The ladder moved out from under him and he fell to the ground below, suffering broken vertebrae.

An employee was on the shoulder of a road, removing traffic control signs and barrels. An 18-wheeler struck part of the crew tailgate, causing it to become detached and in turn strike the employee. The employee suffered a facial laceration and a concussion.

On November 25, 2020, an employee was frying chicken in a deep fryer. When he unlatched the lid to pull out the chickens, oil came out of the fryer, causing first- and second-degree burns to his hand and torso.
An employee was on the third rung of a ladder when it kicked out. The employee fell; the employee's face struck the ground and was injured.
An employee tripped on a steel step at a hot press and fell backwards to the floor, breaking her right wrist.

At about 3:40 a.m. on November 26, 2020, an employee was working on a paper machine, sliding the extractor open to load a roll. The extractor fell onto the employee's left index finger from a height of about a foot, breaking the finger at the tip just behind the nail bed. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to put a surgical pin in place.
An employee was replacing a gasket on a steam manifold. When the employee loosened bolts on the manifold, steam escaped. The employee suffered first- and second-degree burns.

On November 26, 2020, an employee was loading a missed pallet of bananas onto a truck using a forklift. At that moment, the loaded truck began pulling away. The forklift was caught between the departing truck and the loading dock, then fell an estimated 3 feet to the ground. The forklift remained in the upright position and the employee remained seated. The employee was hospitalized with back pain.

An employee was holding tension on a winch cable while reeling it in when their left hand got pulled into the guidance pin and bridle loop. The middle, ring, and pinky fingers were crushed and the pinky was medically amputated.
A border patrol agent was bitten by a service dog on the right thigh.
An employee was using braided strap equipment when it amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell on a slippery floor, suffering a broken right knee.

An employee was cleaning a dock-locking mechanism on a solid waste container on the back of a truck. The latching mechanism was engaged, catching the employee's right glove and partially amputating the little finger at the second knuckle.
An employee was skiing on a trail, doing a pre-season terrain check. While in a turn, the employee fell uphill and landed on his left shoulder. The employee sustained a fractured humerus.

An employee was walking through the store room when her left foot caught on a dolly. She lost balance and fell forward onto the floor with both arms outstretched in front of her. The employee sustained a facial fracture by the left eye socket and a fractured left arm.

Two employees were installing a new plastic roll on a winder machine. One of them was pulling the film with her left hand from the output side of the machine; the film and the rotating member of the winder caught her left hand, breaking both bones in her left forearm.
An employee tripped while going down stairs. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken ankle.

Two employees were on a roof, repairing a ladder. One of them slipped on ice and fell off the roof, landing on the ground about 23 feet below and suffering a broken left foot and shattered right heel.

At about 10:30 a.m. on November 27, 2020, an employee was performing maintenance on an exhaust fan in a mechanical room. As the employee tried to grease bearings in the fan, residual energy caused its pulley to rotate. The employee's left middle finger was caught between the pulley and the belt, and the fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was cutting a zip-tie off a Christmas tree when the knife cut his left eye.

An employee was picking up a milking plug off the floor of a rotary parlor. She came into contact with the structure of the rotary parlor as it turned, and it trapped her between the mobile area and the stationary area. She suffered broken bones.
An employee was unclogging a scrap cyclone. The employee's finger was caught between a ladder and a dead blow hammer, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was working with a pipe cylinder. The cylinder slipped and trapped the employee's right middle finger against a metal work bench. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a saw and cut their finger.

The injured employee and his coworkers were riding the bus to the jobsite. There was a dirt bump in the road and the driver lost control of the bus. The employee sustained a possible head injury and injuries to his right hip and right hand.

An employee was cleaning and spraying disinfectant on the railing in the community home. As she was walking towards a client's bedroom, she slipped on disinfectant that was on the floor and fell, sustaining a fracture to the lower left leg.
An employee fell from a tug while driving it. The employee's left leg was caught under the tire, causing an ankle fracture.
An employee was installing ventilation grating. The employee slipped and fell 15 feet to the ground below resulting in hospitalization for a fractured ankle.
On November 29, 2020, an employee was sitting on a roll of paper as a crane was setting down another roll of paper nearby. The second roll struck his left ankle, breaking it.
An employee was moving a refrigerator with a two-wheel dolly when he tripped and went backward. The appliance fell on his leg and broke his thigh bone. He was hospitalized for surgery.
While crossing the street in the front of the store, an employee moved to avoid being hit by a car and fell to the ground sustaining a broken right hip.
An employee was working on a conveyors with a load planner when he was struck by a forklift that  ran over his left foot. The big toe on the left foot was amputated.
A mail carrier was walking to the door of a house to deliver a parcel when she slipped on black ice on the sidewalk. She fell and sustained a broken right femur.

An employee was helping change a roll on a piece of plastic folding equipment. The employee's glove got caught on the roll, and the machine pulled in the employee's left arm. The employee suffered two compound fractures to the lower arm.

An employee was using a crane to unload two bundles of 8" square tubing that was 20 ft. long from a flatbed semi-trailer onto the floor. As the employee lowered the square tubing bundles onto two round pipe bundles, the top bundle of round pipe became unstable and fell over, striking him in the knee area of the right leg and knocking him over and under the trailer. The employee sustained a fracture of the right tibial plateau.

A crew was loading an excavator onto a drop deck trailer for hauling. As one employee was placing a steel plate on the deck, the excavator's boom was engaged and caught the employee's right hand. The employee's right middle finger was crushed, and had to be medically amputated.
An employee was using a forklift to unload a semi trailer. The trailer pulled away from the dock and the forklift fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was walking across a loading dock area when a forklift backed out of a truck into her. She suffered a broken hip and two amputated toes, and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder to tie it to a beam. The ladder slid along the wall and the employee fell to the ground about 12 feet below, suffering head and spine injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working at a roof build table. The roof build table is located near the end wall/truss area where a router is used. The employee stepped down off a step ladder, slipped on sawdust from the router, and fell 20 inches to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured left tibia requiring surgery.

An employee was walking down stairs when the heel of his foot caught the carpet. He lost balance and fell down 9 stairs. The employee sustained a cut to the top/back of his head and scratches on his forehead.
An employee was cleaning a loading dock. The employee stepped up on the dock step to plug in a blower when he lost his balance and fell, breaking his right hip.
An employee was placing fiber optic cable. A winch rope gained tension and one of the bull snaps failed, lacerating the employee's left palm and fracturing the employee's left little finger.
A dunnage board for setting concrete moved, and an employee's left hand was caught between the board and a concrete panel. The employee's middle and ring fingertips were amputated.
A temporary employee was cleaning around a scrap conveyor. He was pulling out scrap from between two belts when his hand was pulled up into the pulley system. Two bones in the hand were broken.
An employee was in training. While a coil was being lifted, the crane swung back, pinching his hand between a skid and a metal plate. The employee was hospitalized and required stitches to the hand.
An employee was checking the contents of a hydro-vac truck. The truck's door was closed while the employee's right arm was inside it, causing lacerations to the upper arm.
An employee was climbing a ladder. She fell from 5 feet up the ladder, landing on her head and back and suffering a broken ankle and two broken ribs.
An employee was collecting carts when he fell to the floor, breaking his ankle.
An employee was throwing roofing material into a dump truck from a one-story residential roof. The employee fell into the dumpster and suffered a fractured skull and bleeding inside the head.

An employee was clearing a bind between a coil of steel and a coil guide. The guide dropped down and its handle struck the employee in the eye. The employee was hospitalized and lost vision in the left eye.
A nurse was walking down a hallway when a patient tackled her to the floor. She suffered a broken left hip and a dislocated femur.

An employee was checking a double feed roller hydraulic assembly to see if any obstructions were keeping it from opening all the way. As the employee removed a piece of steel, the employee was crushed in the hydraulic assembly resulting in fractured ribs and vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was guiding a steel cover back into position on top of a rail car. The top shifted and the employee's finger was pinched between the brake wheel and the hoisted steel cover. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee slipped and fell while carrying a rack of glasses. The employee suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and internal bleeding.
An employee was on a roof, about to make roof repairs. The employee fell through the roof, landing on a concrete floor about 28 feet below. The employee suffered brain and organ damage.
An employee was walking to their vehicle in the parking lot when they fell to the ground and sustained a broken femur.
An employee was moving a steel beam that was inside a dumpster. The employee's left ring finger became caught between the dumpster and the steel beam, sustaining a laceration/avulsion.
An employee was collecting a fuel sample from a vehicle. The vapors ignited when he had a cup of fuel in his hand, and he suffered second-degree burns to the arm and face.
An employee was watching during concrete screeding. The employee was pinned between the concrete paver and the trailer of a semi truck, suffering a strained shoulder.
An employee was unloading freight from a trailer with a pallet jack. He fell out of the trailer, landed on the ground, and injured his right ankle.
An employee's hand was caught between two roof panels. The employee was hospitalized the next day, suffering from hand swelling.
An employee was working under a patio covering when a brace gave way and the covering collapsed. The employee suffered fractures to the right leg, right arm, and left wrist.

An employee was moving a part from a metal stamping press. The pull-backs she was wearing pulled her hands back, but her right middle finger came into contact with the sharp edge of the metal part she was handling and she suffered a severe laceration to the fingertip. The fingertip was partially amputated under the fingernail.

An employee was performing roof and/or eve repairs on a residential building. The hammer the employee was using struck his head and he fell from a ladder to the ground. He sustained a skull  fracture and bruising to the ribs.

A traffic control crew was picking up signs to move to a different location. An employee was putting the temporary roll-up signs in the traffic control trailer. He sat on the sign while moving to the next sign. Wind caught the sign he was sitting on causing him to fall off the trailer while it was in motion. He was hospitalized with a broken left leg and contusions to his arms and face.

An employee was pushing a barricade into place to block a roadway while others were holding traffic. A passenger vehicle entered the area and struck the employee, breaking the employee's ribs. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee had been making deliveries in a residential area. The employee slid out of the jump seat of the delivery vehicle and struck his head on the steps, eventually striking his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee inhaled smoke caused by dust that had settled on an HVAC system. She developed shortness of breath and chest pain and was hospitalized, suffering from lung irritation.
On December 1, 2020, an employee was assisting a co-worker with unloading a treadmill package when he felt discomfort in his abdomen. He was later hospitalized with an umbilical hernia.
An employee was repairing a hammer mill. The mill's hatch door fell on the employee, breaking the employee's pelvis.
An employee was trying to free a lumber slab that had hung up at a saw infeed. The chipper head and saw amputated one of his fingers at the knuckle.
An employee was struck by a shipping tote measuring 5x5x5 feet that fell off a forklift, resulting in a fractured hip and fractured left tibia.
A truck driver was loosening the chain binder on a load of steel beams. The chain binder struck his chin, causing a laceration and fracture.

An employee was using a shovel to excavate roots. The blade was positioned under a root and the employee was using the curve of the blade as a leverage point when the handle snapped. The fractured end of the shovel handle struck the employee's face, causing lacerations to the forehead and eye lid, and a 1mm puncture to the eye.
An employee was using an air hose to clean under a thermal former. The machine grabbed the hose and pulled the employee's hand into the gear, causing the amputation of one of her fingers.

Four employees were repairing/installing guardrails when they were struck by car. All four employees were hospitalized. One employee suffered a leg amputation. A second employee sustained fractures and internal injuries.
An employee was connecting an HVAC duct inside the facility, tripped over the duct, and fell fracturing his left femur.
An employee was moving metal stock. Two pieces of the metal crushed the employee's fingers, and one of the fingers was medically amputated.
An employee slipped on a pair of scissors while walking down an aisle. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken kneecap.

An employee was carrying a small, empty pan from a kitchen prep area to a dishwashing station. The employee slipped on a small plastic storage container lid and fell to the floor, suffering a broken right kneecap.
On December 1, 2020, an employee slipped on a patch of ice while walking inside a building. The employee fell to the concrete floor, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.

An employee tripped on a crease in the rug that was behind the register desk, causing her to fall forward on her knee and into the register counter with her hands. The employee sustained a knee injury.
An employee was lifting pipe above his head. The pipe slipped out of the thread protector and its end struck the employee's nose, causing an open fracture.
An employee was inserting a piece of wood into the hot press machine when their right hand was caught in the press by the platens. The employee's right hand was crushed and amputated.

A crew of employees had completed pulling a 1,000 foot run of 4/0 insulated ground cable into a cable tray. The employees at the bottom of the tray were tailing the cable in and began to tie into another cable tray. The injured employee was securing the cable that had just been installed and was located about halfway down the conveyor of the 1,000 foot run. The cable that had been pulled into the tray, began to fall out of the tray and struck his left hand, smashing it against the cable tray, resulting in a broken thumb and a laceration between the left thumb and forefinger.
A FedEx employee was shot in the back while delivering packages.
An employee was using a utility knife to cut fire hose to length when the knife amputated the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was hauling corn in a semi-truck from one farm to another. He climbed a ladder that was mounted to the trailer. While the corn level was rising, the employee went to climb down the ladder to shut the grain off and fell off the ladder approximately 5 feet. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and injured shoulder, both on the right side of the body.

An employee was using a magnetic lift to lift product to the mixing bowl. Their thumb was caught between the mixing bowl and the guard, after it was bumped by the magnetic lift. The employee's left thumb was amputated one-half inch below the tip.

An employee was retrieving tubing from a pallet. He fell backwards off a nearby edge, landing on the ground about 5.25 feet below and suffering a fractured skull, head lacerations, a broken collarbone, fractured ribs, and a back injury.

While assisting a coworker, an employee was cracking a suction line to determine if hot asphalt was unloading from a truck when they were sprayed with the 460 degree hot asphalt. The employee sustained second degree burns to the left side of their nose, cheek, ear lobe, chin, and part of their neck.
An employee was descending the stairs, missed the last step, and fell to the floor landing on her hip. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was working at the caustic tank car load rack, assisting with the general preparation of a rail car for loading. The employee was found lying on his back next to the rail car and appeared to have suffered a fall. The employee had pain in the head, neck, hand, and leg.
An employee was performing cable installation tasks from a ladder at a height of approximately 20 feet. The employee fell to the ground and sustained fractured vertebrae.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering broken ribs.

An employee had been placing pre-warning burning flags in a sugar cane field. When completed, he walked into a grassy area and was bitten on the left leg by a rattlesnake. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to repair a stuck roll-up door. The door shifted down, causing the chain and sprocket to move and pinch the employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell while standing on a stair landing, suffering a twisted knee that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee had just replaced a broken sprocket and put in a new chain on a high-volume oil conveyor. The chain seized up. As he tried to free it, it took off and his left index finger was caught between the chain and the sprocket. The fingertip was amputated halfway up the nail.
An employee was walking down the stairs during a fire drill when he tripped and fell onto the next floor's landing, resulting in a dislocated left shoulder.
Two employees were clearing a jam in a machine. One of them came contacted the roller teeth of a picker in the machine, suffering amputations to two right-hand fingers at the last joint.

Two employees were opening lids on railcars to prepare the cars for loading on a track. Both employees were in full body harnesses and were connected by a self-retracting lifeline (SRL) to a rail fall safety system. The train started moving north and the employees realized that the cars were going to move beyond the fall protection coverage and decided to unhook from the rail fall protection. Employee 1 assisted the injured employee and unhooked from the system. As the injured employee attempted to unhook, the SRL ran out of cable, roughly 25 feet from the rail shed. The injured employee was pulled onto his back and remained stationary on his back, held by the SRL cable, as the rail cars moved under him. The employee sustained a laceration and contusion to the top of the head; bruising and scrapes to the lower back, legs and arms; a cut on the right hand; and a bruised thumb.
An employee was erecting scaffolding at a height of less than 5 feet. He lost his balance and jumped off the scaffolding, landing on the concrete floor. He suffered a broken left leg and left knee.
An employee was installing siding from a work platform about 4-5 feet above the ground. The employee fell off the platform to the ground and suffered facial and wrist fractures.
An employee's right hand became entangled in the cable on a block-and-tackle charge hoist and was pulled into the block. The right ring and pinky fingertips were amputated.
An employee was walking toward the cash register when she slipped on a wet floor and fell. The employee sustained a fractured sacrum bone and contusions of her hand and wrist.
An employee was retrieving a pipe from a rack when he stepped on an unsecured hot water pit cover and his leg went into the pit. He suffered burns to his legs.

The employee was monitoring a plastic injection molding machine during it's start up/warm up phase. The employee observed excess product sitting in the bottom of the machine. As the employee was removing the product, a sprocket/gear on the machine grabbed the employee's left arm and pinched it just above the wrist. The employee sustained a cut on the left arm and wrist, which affected bones and tissue.
An employee was helping to unload countertops when the countertops shifted, pinning the employee against the wall and the floor. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and a punctured lung.

At 12:20 p.m. on December 2, 2020, an employee was on a ladder putting boxes on a shelf. The ladder slipped and the employee fell about 8 feet, landing on top of the ladder. The employee suffered chest, lower back, and leg pain.

While an employee was deburring a plate, the plate got caught between the spinning disc and the machine table, cutting the employee's thumb and pushing it toward the spinning disc. The employee's thumb was then pinched between the plate and disc, leading to an amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was putting frozen chicken on a conveyer belt. The belt was bouncing a lot, and a 40-pound chicken fell; as the employee tried to catch it, it caused the amputation of the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee came into contact with an energized 480-volt electrical line while moving a transformer. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the right hand and neck and was hospitalized.

On December 3, 2020, an employee was operating a forklift and stopped to talk to another employee. While pulling away after the conversation, the employee's left hand was caught between the vertical roof support beam on his forklift and the open cab door of the coworker's vehicle. The employee sustained lacerations and crushing injuries to the left hand, and the left index finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was on a step ladder hanging Christmas decorations. The employee fell from the ladder to the floor, their head striking a freezer as they fell. The employee suffered a skull fracture, broken vertebrae, and a possible brain bleed.
An employee fell approximately three feet off a lift gate while trying to stabilize forklift propane fuel cylinders, resulting in a broken jaw.
An employee inhaled smoke while putting out a waste basket fire.

An employee was doing grounds maintenance with a tractor, and was out of the tractor when it rolled, pinning the employee against a steel fence post. The employee was hospitalized with five broken ribs and right arm injuries.

At about 3:00 p.m. on December 3, 2020, an employee was switching out a one-ton chlorine cylinder in an ethylene glycol unit when a chlorine leak developed. The employee inhaled chlorine gas and was hospitalized.

An employee was pressing a bushing into an aircraft part using a rod bushing setting tool and a 5-ton arbor press mounted to a table. While the employee was pulling down the lever on the arbor press to seat the bushing into the aircraft part, the rod tool snapped, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall on his left knee. He suffered a broken left femur.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, leading to a lower back injury.
An employee was walking at a jobsite, stepped on a hose, and slipped in friction reducer compound. The employee fell on the ground and broke a kneecap.
An employee fell in the parking lot while walking to work and sustained a fracture in their lower left leg.

An employee was trimming parts in a 50-ton trim press. While he was retrieving a part, the press cycled and came down on the fingers of his left hand, partially amputating the index and middle fingers. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to her car. Her head struck the trunk of the car and she suffered a concussion.
An employee was cutting wood with a circular saw when the saw jammed and amputated the employee's left middle finger at the second joint.
An employee suffered a right eye injury while pulling a golf club shaft out from the golf club's head.
An employee working at a site slipped and fell on an icy ramp. The employee sustained a fractured left hip.

A Steeltech employee was using a hoist to lift an 8-10 foot, 150-200 pound handrail for installation on a staircase. The shackle snagged as the rail was lifted, and the welding point on the staircase snapped. The top two steps of the staircase collapsed and struck the employee's lower back, breaking his tailbone and lacerating his right leg. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
On 12/3/2020, an employee fell from a bar joist. He was later admitted to the hospital for breathing issues, fractured ribs, and a fractured tailbone.

An employee was using a pin press machine to put pins in the back of a heat exchanger louver blade. His right hand was caught between the blade and a hydraulic component, causing a partial amputation to the index fingertip.
An employee was operating a swaging machine and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder verifying welds. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken ankle and elbow. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working from a step ladder, leveling grain in a semi-hopper trailer to allow the tarp to close. The step ladder tipped over and the employee fell to the ground fracturing his right ankle.

An employee was operating a cherry picker when it struck a concrete column. The employee was ejected from the cherry picker and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

An employee hit their knee on the drawer under their desk, causing them to fall, hitting the front of their head on the desk and the back of their head on the floor. The employee sustained a concussion and lost consciousness.

An employee was in a harness within a bucket truck when a cable on the boom snapped, causing the boom to fully retract. The employee then slammed into the bucket, resulting in six broken ribs and a herniated disk.
An employee was on a roof performing work using a wedge-shaped cushion. The cushion slid and the employee fell from the roof to the ground below, sustaining fractured vertebrae.

An employee was assisting a coworker in attaching two hooks of a four-legged sling to a mower when the employee's finger was pinched between the hoist hook and the mower attachment point. The employee sustained an avulsion on his left-hand pinky finger.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both wrists.
An employee was using a chainsaw to cut fronds from a tree. The chainsaw caused two, approximately 3-inch lacerations, to the employee's left forearm.

An employee was taking the temperature in a milk tanker. He slipped and fell 10.5 feet from the top of the trailer and landed on the ground between the safety railing and the tanker. He suffered a fractured left shoulder and a tear to the right shoulder.
An employee was cleaning off the cutter head of a molder machine when his glove was caught and pulled into the cutter, resulting in an amputation of the right index finger to the second knuckle.
An employee was helping clean up used pallets and material in a grocery receiving area. A forklift backed onto the employee's foot, breaking the employee's ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been walking and checking a skid count of items received. The employee was struck by a forklift and sustained an amputation injury to a foot.
An employee was clearing noodle debris from the wrapping machine when the gear and sprocket amputated their right middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a rough-terrain forklift when it turned over on the boom side. The employee suffered a partially collapsed lung, a broken scapula, and broken ribs.

On December 4, 2020, at 4:30 a.m., an employee was trying to remove the leading edge mouse on the glue box during a routine cleaning task on a paper machine. The employee used both hands to pull the mouse when it jerked backwards, catching the employee's gloves between the mouse hook and the glue box and causing an amputation of the pinky finger up to the first knuckle.
An employee was using a hopper to throw trash in an outside dumpster. The employee moved a lever on the trash hopper and the hopper fell back onto his left hand and amputated his index finger.

U.S. Marshals were serving an arrest warrant on a fugitive at a residence. When the Marshals entered the residence, the suspect began firing at them with a handgun. Marshal 1 sustained a gunshot to his right leg/thigh. Marshal 2 sustained gunshot wounds to his right hand, left hip, and left elbow.

An employee was trying to hook a pallet that had stopped on the conveyor belt when the long hook tripped the sensor for the automatic shuttle car. The employee was pinched between the shuttle car and the racking system, resulting in surgery for lacerations on both legs.
An employee was stacking product into the cradle of an automated saw when the employee's fingertip came into contact with the saw, resulting in an amputation.
An employee's left middle finger was caught between a slide and a roller bar. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was installing an adapter on a lathe. While attempting to loosen a retaining collar from the existing shaft setup, his left ring finger was momentarily pinched between the retaining collar and the machine frame, resulting in a partial amputation on his left ring finger.
An employee was transporting a 150-pound part on a cart. The part and the cart shifted and fractured the employee's lower back.

An employee was working aloft pruning a live oak tree when his pole saw began to fall. The employee reached for the pole saw handle but the pole slipped through his hand and the blade cut his left hand.

An employee was attempting to bleed off a hydraulic cylinder on a diecast mold. Their hand was placed on the side where the hydraulic cylinder was hooked to when it lowered and amputated three fingers.
An employee was installing a beam from an aerial lift. The lift swung and his head struck another beam. He suffered a head injury and a gash under his eye.
On 12/4/2020, an employee was oiling a repack machine. She sustained a laceration to the right index fingertip.

An employee was installing conduit underneath electrical switch gear when an arc flash occurred, resulting in first degree burns to his face and second degree burns to his hands and wrists. The switch box's shielding was removed at the time.
An employee was testing and electric fan after changing the motor when the propeller made contact with the employee's left hand, resulting in a partial amputation of three fingers.

An employee was in an aerial bucket clearing branches. A 70-pound branch hung up in the tree after being cut, then fell and struck the employee in the back and neck. The employee suffered a broken scapula and three broken vertebrae.

An employee was working on a generator. His right hand came into contact with a rotary blade, which caused multiple lacerations and two broken bones in the back of the hand. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was getting ready to charge a environmental control unit with refrigerant. Refrigerant spilled on his hand and caused burns.
An employee was cleaning the deep fryer when she slipped and spilled hot grease on her body. She sustained first and second degree burns on her foot, leg, and arm.

On December 5, 2020, an employee was on the wash pad, securing a piece of equipment to prevent it from rolling. The employee's left hand was caught between the rolling equipment and the securing device cable. The employee sustained a fractured ring finger and an avulsion to the middle finger requiring hospitalization and surgery.
On 12/5/2020, an employee was cleaning a patio when her feet got caught in a water hose, causing her to fall and suffer an L2 vertebral compression fracture in her back.

While working in the maintenance shop, an employee's jacket caught the spout of a bottle of chemical floor stripper, spilling the chemical on his pants. Later that evening the employee was hospitalized with chemical burns to the leg.
An employee was cleaning an impression plate. His thumb got caught in a roller, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped while cleaning fryer equipment and her hand went into the hot oil. A hose came unattached and sprayed hot oil onto her back. She suffered burns to the hand and her back.
An employee was repairing a garage door in a warehouse. The cable released and amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell off a hydraulic lift while unloading trash containers. He suffered a broken hip.
An employee working in the kitchen turned the corner, tripped over metal floor grating, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was driving a double pallet jack when he struck his head on a racking system, resulting in a broken nose and jaw. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting frozen meat when the meat slipped out of their hand and the tips of their middle and index fingers were amputated by the band saw.
An employee's right hand was caught when an A-frame folded down into a horizontal position. The hand was broken and lacerated.
An employee was using a 2,500-psi pressure washer. Water from the washer severely lacerated the employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a ladder approximately six feet above the floor to install window trim. The employee fell from the ladder, resulting in hospitalization for a concussion.

While two employees were preparing a 40-inch pipe support for replacement, one of the clamps holding the pipe rotated, crushing an employee's fingers between the clamp and the pipe. The employee suffered a crushed right hand, and his right middle fingertip had to be surgically amputated.
An employee was clearing onions from the "brooming section" of a machine when their arm was caught in a roller and/or chain and sprocket and amputated.
An employee was installing a firewall section. Two framed walls fell and struck the employee, causing back trauma.

On 12/7/2020, an employee was pushing a die out of a hydraulic press when their fingers were smashed between the die they were pushing and a stationary plate on the press frame, resulting in a partial amputation of two fingertips. The machine was locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a gutter downspout when the ladder slipped out from underneath him, causing him to fall approximately six feet and resulting in an injured left wrist.

An employee was trying to release the mechanical hold down for a dock plate while a forklift lifted the plate up so that the employee could access the area. When the hold down was released, the forklift moved from under the dock plate, allowing it to fall onto employee. The employee suffered two broken ribs, a laceration to his liver, and injury to his diaphragm.
An employee tripped over a box in an office and fell to the floor, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was reaching into a machine to adjust rollers. The machine cycled on and pulled the employee's right hand into the rollers, causing the amputation of three fingers.

A corrections officer was unlocking cell doors in a housing unit when an inmate attacked him with a 14-inch homemade metal weapon. The officer was struck in the neck and face area, suffering wounds on the left side of the neck and the left cheek.

An employee was cleaning a large pot used for mixing compounds for coating shell work when his left pinky finger was struck by a moving part that rotates inside the pot, resulting in a partial amputation of the pinky fingertip.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a press machine. The machine was homed so that the employee could clear a piece of copper from the machine's die; the die closed and amputated the employee's left ring finger, as well as damaging his middle and index fingers and his thumb.

An employee was pulling a showing frame off the top of a stack of showing frames. The frames were stacked 10 to 12 high and weighed 50 to 60 lbs. each. As he pulled and turned with the top showing frame, the stack fell over and struck his left hip. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was pushing on a tree while it was being cut with a chainsaw. The chainsaw went through the tree and struck the employee in the left arm and chin, lacerating both. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the placement of a pallet of freight. The employee's left little finger was crushed between two pallets, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
A tractor trailer was backing up to a dock hook when it struck an employee and pinned him against the dock plate on the dock door. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and back.
An employee stepped out of a security guard shack and fell down stairs, landing on their left side. The employee suffered pain in the left leg and hip.

On 12/7/20, an employee was in the office opening mail and moving boxes. When moving a box of copy paper, the employee pulled muscles in her back.

An employee was communicating with the driver of a construction vehicle when the vehicle struck the employee, pulling him beneath the vehicle's tracks and resulting in broken ribs, a broken pelvis, and multiple fractures to both legs.
An employee fell through a skylight and landed on the floor 20 feet below. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee fell down the stairs, resulting in surgery for a torn knee ligament.

An employee was going through training on loading the truck. While strapping down the load, the strap didn't go all the way over the load. The employee stepped up on a tire to reach the strap and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fracture to the upper right arm that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was tightening a part on a foil slitting machine. The machine caught the employee's right middle finger and amputated the fingertip.
While using a press machine to cut an object, a temporary employee's thumb got stuck between the object and the blade, resulting in an amputation of the tip of their left thumb.

An employee was extending a dock plate when it failed to extend properly. The employee was investigating the locking mechanism under the plate when the plate extended suddenly, amputating his left middle fingertip.

An employee was stepping from a barge to a pier when a tendon tore in his right knee.
An employee was performing initial setup of a circular saw when the blade amputated his right middle finger. The saw was not guarded at the time.

An employee was repairing a portable air compressor when the compressor started and the fan blade amputated the employee's left pinky finger.

An employee was helping a mechanic troubleshoot a dust collector. While attempting to clear a blockage, the employee's right hand came into contact with rotating machinery within the dust collector, resulting in an amputation of the fingertips on their middle and index fingers.

A lineman was ascending a pole when his gaff penetrated the conduit and then reached the lead sheathing of the live conductor. This resulted in an electrical arc flash. The lineman was hospitalized with electrical burns to both knees.

An employee was unjamming a conveyor line when his hand was caught between a chain and a roller. He suffered a broken finger and soft tissue damage.

An employee fell from the top of a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken left leg.

An employee was loading boxes on a conveyor belt for a robotic palletizer when several boxes fell off of the conveyor, causing the employee to trip and fall. The employee suffered a fractured left hip.

An employee was removing chicken from a mixing machine and amputated his index and middle fingers.

An employee was making a delivery when they slipped and fell off a lift gate, resulting in a head injury.

On December 9, 2020, an employee was getting a battery out of a straight truck. The employee slipped and fell off the truck to the ground, suffering a broken left arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a napkin folding machine that included a bandsaw blade. An employee tripped on a step stool and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was driving a pallet jack when it struck another, parked pallet jack. The employee suffered two fractures to the left tibia.

While putting mail in a mailbox, an employee tripped on an uneven surface and fell to the sidewalk, suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was placing signs on a roof. The roof collapsed and the employee fell through it to the ground, suffering a back injury.
An employee was replacing a motor on a juice line. Beet juice burned the employee's right side, specifically the arm, hand, ear, neck, and shoulder.
An employee had been moving an anchor from one point to the next. The employee fell from the roof to the ground and sustained a fractured pelvis.
An employee was replacing caps on rebar around a concrete pour. The employee slipped on a 2x4 and fell onto a piece of uncapped rebar, suffering an abdominal injury.
An employee was unloading a truck at a docking area. The employee's foot was caught under a pallet jack wheel, causing the employee to fall to the ground and suffer an injury to the left hip.
An employee was lighting a propane burner when a flash fire burned the employee's hands and face.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when it struck a guard rail. The employee's leg was crushed between the pallet jack and the guard rail resulting in lacerations and a fractured leg.

An employee had just finished dumping a rear load container into the back of a rear load garbage truck. An employee was trying to clear a jam on a crossover chain. The chain moved and caught his right little finger against a gearbox. The finger was amputated.
An employee was hooking up an air line on a piece of equipment. A crane load struck the employee, who suffered multiple leg fractures.
An employee fell off a forklift, landing on concrete and suffering a broken arm.

An employee's finger was smashed by the end of a dock plate. She suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee walked up to the top of the stairs and then stepped on crumbled pieces of landscaping rock on the landing between the stairs and the entrance. The employee lost his footing and fell to the pavement sustaining a broken hip.

An employee was standing within proximity of the drilling pipes as the pipes were being tightened with a wrench and the bucket of a mini excavator. The employee sustained a concussion and a cut/laceration.

An employee was walking on a roof to get to their work location. A thin layer of ice or dew was on the roof at the time. The employee slid and fell through a skylight, landing 25 feet below on the concrete floor. The employee sustained fractures to the right leg and elbow.

An employee was operating a punch press, loading a piece of sheet metal and placing a metal bracket near clamps (to protect the rubber seal of a door panel when a clamp comes down). The clamp came down and the bracket amputated the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was on the roof of a one-story home, pushing solar cables through a junction box to another employee who was in the attic. An employee was removing a piece of chicken from the halver machine and sustained an amputation to the left index fingertip under the nail.
An employee was clearing scrap on the guard of a radial arm saw. The saw blade caught his left hand and amputated his left little finger above the first knuckle.
An employee was on a line cutting chicken. His knife amputated the tip of his left index finger.

An employee amputated their right index fingertip while cleaning a cutting machine.
An employee fell while descending a ladder. He landed on the shop floor, suffering five broken ribs and a punctured lung.

On December 11, 2020, an employee was emptying a kettle drain from a chocolate enrober machine when the machine caused an amputation to the employee's left index finger. The machine was running at the time.

An employee was using a band saw to cut bones when the blade amputated his left index finger under the knuckle.
An employee was unloading product from a truck. The employee's right index finger was caught between a can of green beans and a metal rail. The fingertip was amputated.
On December 10, 2020, an employee fell while stepping from a hatch cover to a walkway on the forward end of a bay on a ship. He suffered left leg pain and was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was moving a railcar caddy into a building. The employee was pinned between the caddy and an elevated platform, suffering a broken collarbone and ribs.

After kneeling down to clean in a deli department, an employee struck his head on the corner of a table while standing up. He was hospitalized, undergoing multiple brain surgeries.
An employee was walking to get a cart when he tripped over a cart guide rail and fell fracturing his right femur.

Two employees were offloading product for a residential delivery. They were using a manual pallet jack to move a load onto the lift gate of a truck when the jack and the load fell to the ground and landed on one employee's hand. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the thumb.

A security guard was directing an ambulance that was backing up from the facility. He stepped out to the main street and was struck by an incoming car. The security guard's legs and shoulders were fractured.
Three employees were moving a metal container full of metal parts. One employee had two fingers pinched by the corner of the container. The right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ship's ladder when he slipped and fell 15 feet to the lower level, fracturing both of his legs and resulting in hospitalization.

An employee fell while entering a break room, landing on the floor and suffering fractures to the right femur and kneecap and the right little finger, as well as contusions to the right hand, shoulder, and cheek.

An employee was installing metal sheeting on the roof of a new building. He fell through a skylight, landing on wooden pallets, transformers, and/or the concrete floor 18-22 feet below. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and broken ribs.
An employee was working at the saturation machine. While he was manipulating webbing material, the nip rollers caught his left hand, breaking three fingers and lacerating his skin.

An employee was walking on the apron of the sidewalk when their sandal got caught causing the employee to trip. The employee sustained a broken foot.

An employee was walking in front of his electric pallet jack when it struck a loaded pallet. His feet were pinched between the jack and the pallet.

On December 13, 2020, a press operator was making adjustments to the direction of a fan to cool the frames on the thermoforming press. The employee's left middle finger contacted the moving fan blades resulting in  amputation to the first digit.
