An employee was bending a part in a press brake when their thumb got caught between the part and the machine. The tip of the right thumb was amputated.
An employee was in a company vehicle (SUV) that was driving into the cargo yard when her vehicle was struck by another employee-driven SUV resulting in a fractured right femur.

On December 14, 2020, an employee was building wire cages in a warehouse when a board or beam struck him and knocked him to the ground. The next day he felt pain and was hospitalized for a lacerated spleen.
An employee was standing at the edge of a roof when they fell five stories into a dumpster below, resulting in a broken wrist and broken ribs.
An employee had been working on an HVAC system located on a roof. The employee tripped and fell 8 feet from the roof. He sustained fractures to the right shoulder, pelvis, and right femur.

An employee slipped on an icy sidewalk on the way into a building. She fell, landing on the right side of her body and suffering contusions to the head and face causing right-side head pain, headache, right cheek pain with swelling, right jaw pain, a nosebleed, an abrasion to the nose, and right eye redness; she also suffered right knee pain with swelling.
An employee fell while descending from the deck of a crane, landing on the ground and suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was on a manlift welding a flange on a gas supply line. There was residual gas in the pipe and the pipe exploded. The employee sustained burns to approximately six percent of his body.
An employee was performing opening duties when her foot got caught on a ledge and she fell on her hip, fracturing it.

An employee was manually turning a section of a trailer on a rotating device. As the employee reached to slow the section, their left ring finger was caught in the pinch point of the rotator and trailer section. The finger was amputated between the fingernail and first joint.
An employee was picking up a 32-pound metal plate when it slipped and pinched the employee's finger against a shelf. The employee suffered a partial fingertip amputation and a fingertip fracture.
An employee was stacking money in her cash bus when its metal lid slammed down on her fingers. She suffered fractures to her right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor. While removing dough his glove was caught in the conveyor resulting in amputation of his right index finger.
An employee was painting when he tripped and fell 11 inches, hitting his head on a skid steer. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

Shortly after 7:35 p.m. on December 14, 2020, an employee was trying to fix an outgoing conveyor belt on a line. His jacket was caught in an adjacent conveyor, which pulled in his right arm and crushed it. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery for a broken forearm.
An employee was walking to his vehicle when he slipped on a discharge hose and fell, suffering a spiral fracture to his right tibia.

On December 14, 2020, an employee was manually rotating a die board cylinder. The prybar he was using to rotate the cylinder came down and pinched his left hand against the anvil blanket around another, lower cylinder. His left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped while taking a die out of a sign blank machine. The die came down and severed his right little fingertip.

An employee was attempting to retrieve a marker pole near an excavation when a road plate that had been standing vertically fell over onto the employee, pinning the employee to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs and a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting a pulp hoist. The hoist was activated and the employee's right index finger was crushed between the lower stop of the hoist and the hoist case itself. The fingertip was partially amputated.

An employee was trying to remove a piece of wood that was creating a jam at the end of a chain conveyor. His fingers were caught in a pinch point, causing amputations to his right ring and little fingers at the nailbed.
An employee tripped on an anti-fatigue mat that was in front of his machine. He fell to the floor and injured his hip.

An employee had parked his electric forklift next to a parked semi-trailer and dismounted the forklift to count stock. He returned to the forklift and as he was climbing up the forklift the accelerator was depressed and his legs were caught between the side of the trailer and the forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the right calf and torn ligaments and a laceration to the left knee.

An employee was taking packages out of a cart under a chute. As the employee turned to remove a package from the cart, another one came down the chute and struck the employee in the corner of the right eye, causing lacerations to the corner of the eye and just under the eye.
An employee was cutting material on a small table saw. The sawblade amputated his left middle finger at the knuckle. The machine was unguarded at the time.

An employee was standing on the ground about 20 feet from where plywood was being pulled up to be installed for a trash chute. The plywood became loose from the chute above, began to fall, and was blown by the wind into a fence on the ground about 8-10 feet from the employee. This caused the plywood to flip over and roll toward the employee, lacerating and fracturing his face.
An employee was inspecting concrete forms at a construction site when he slipped and fell onto one of the forms, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee slipped on Vaseline on a store floor and fell. The employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting insulation paper. The shear activated and amputated the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was cutting metal electrical conduit with a pocket knife. The knife fell, severing the employee's right index finger at the first joint, above the nail.
An employee fell while stepping off a ladder, suffering broken heels. She was hospitalized.

An employee was installing fiber optic cable from a scissor lift. A forklift backed into the scissor lift, causing the employee to fall to the floor about 20 feet below and land head/face first. The employee suffered severe head trauma and broken bones.
On December 15, 2020, at 5:00 PM, an employee was delivering packages when they twisted their ankle, lost their balance, and fell on the pavement, resulting in a broken knee.

While walking across a warehouse roof to access a cable attachment, an employee fell through a skylight and landed on the concrete surface below. The employee sustained injuries to the head, chest, and hip. The injuries also included multiple broken bones.

An employee was using a dolly to unload goods from a truck. He slipped while coming down the ramp in the back of the truck. His right ankle and foot were broken in three places and his lower leg was broken.
An employee was moving a 6,000-pound roll of copper with a crane. The roll fell out of the lifting device and lacerated the employee's right foot.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell, breaking two vertebrae in the lower back.

On December 15, 2020, an employee was pulling a 40-inch handheld pallet jack into position for a forklift to pick it up. The forklift struck the employee as it backed up, breaking his right ankle. He was hospitalized.
Two employees were engaged in horseplay with an air hose when one of them suffered a compressed air injection injury.

An employee was troubleshooting a hydraulic leak on an aluminum die casting machine when the machine was turned on. The employee was caught in the machine and suffered fractures to the shoulder and ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee had just stepped backward after pulling a pallet from a stack. A passing pallet jack caught his foot between its forks, and his body struck the machine. He suffered fractures to the left knee, left foot, and right ankle.
An employee was feeding a piece of material into a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee was traveling down a warehouse aisle on a motorized pallet jack. The pallet jack collided with another pallet jack traveling in the opposite direction. The employee jumped off just before the collision, and their foot made contact with the other pallet jack. The foot was broken in two places and the heel was crushed.
An employee was working from the back of a truck when he slipped and fell from a height no greater than 4 feet. He suffered a back compression fracture.
An employee was trying to dislodge a workpiece that had fallen off a conveyor. The employee's right middle finger was caught in a chain and sprocket, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was holding a clamp while cutting a piece of wood with a horizontal table router. The employee's right hand slid off the clamp and struck the router bit, which caused a partial amputation to the middle fingertip.

On December 15, 2020, an employee was inspecting a palletizer machine and pallet feed when he slipped and his hands contacted the back side of the pallet lift (a stationary forklift) to break his fall. His left index finger was caught between the pallet's gear and the fork, resulting in a fracture and an amputation without bone loss. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell on oil in a back room. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating an uncoiler machine. He was inspecting the insert of the uncoiler when it caught his glove, pulling in his left hand. It sliced the thumb, causing an injury that required ten stitches and the insertion of a pin between the first and last joint.
An employee was pulling a kraft paper roll when a spindle crushed and amputated his right middle finger.
An employee was moving empty boxes to a garbage compactor. The employee was struck by a forklift and suffered bruises.
An employee developed a hernia while moving a patient.
An employee was working on a scaffold 16 feet above the ground. They fell from the scaffold to the ground, suffering a broken hip and an injured ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing brush with a skid steer. A large tree branch broke, crashed through the windshield, and entered the cab, striking the employee in the abdomen. The employee suffered broken ribs and internal injuries that required surgery.

Three employees were installing new pins on the right and left lift arms of a skid steer. The left pin was removed while work was being done on the right pin. When the pin was removed, the lift arm assembly slid forward and its cross-member pinned an employee's legs. The employee suffered a leg fracture.

An employee was accompanying a quality inspector who was conducting an annual quality audit on the beverage can filler production area. The quality inspector asked to see a strainer located on the piping housing. The employee proceeded to remove the strainer from the piping line. While attempting to remove the strainer, the strainer ejected from the piping and struck the employee above the left eye. The employee sustained a concussion and a laceration above the left eye.
An employee was driving an electric tug when it struck a baggage cart. The employee suffered a broken rib and a possible punctured lung.
An employee was moving an aluminum coil from a coil tilter. The coil fell, striking the employee's left leg. The employee suffered swelling to the leg.

An employee was changing a wheel/tire assembly. He was straightening a valve that had been pushed out of position when the tire slipped out of the clamp and pushed his hands into the studs. He suffered a laceration and fracture.
An employee was drying in a tile roof when he slipped on paper and fell to the ground, suffering back injuries.
An employee was unloading a supersack of concrete ready-mix. A forklift amputated the employee's right thumb.

An employee was climbing a ladder with guard rails to access the rig floor. The ladder twisted to one side causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained displaced vertebrae in the neck and bruising and soreness.
An employee was loading steel tubes onto a rack. A tube shifted and struck the employee's right hand, lacerating and breaking the little finger.

An employee was putting up merchandise in a store's clothing department. A customer bumped into her and knocked her to the floor. She suffered injuries to her head, left wrist, and left leg and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery for a fractured pelvis and left femur.

An employee was driving a forklift with an attached personnel cage. The blades contacted a permanent railroad track sunk into the pavement; the forklift stopped abruptly and the employee struck the windshield and steering wheel.
An employee was walking down an outdoor staircase when he fell at the last step. He landed on hard pavement and hit his head. He was hospitalized.

A driver was sitting in a garbage truck cab while the truck was checked for an air brake leak. The truck rolled over the chock at its rear wheel and began to roll down a slight incline in the parking lot. The driver jumped out of the cab, and the truck ran over his left foot and ankle (first the front steering tire, then the dual rear tires on the driver's side). The employee suffered a foot/ankle injury resulting in partial amputation and hospitalization.

Employees were using a chain to lower a new electrical pole into a hole. When the pole stopped moving, an employee moved to remove the chain from around the pole. The pole slipped down further and trapped the employee's index finger against the chain. The finger was amputated.
At about 4:15 p.m. on December 16, 2020, an employee suffered an electrical shock while working with a soaker sink in a meat department.
An employee was in front of a cart, helping to steer it as it was pushed from behind. Her right heel was caught under the lip of the cart and she fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee had been installing low-voltage wiring. The employee fell through the roof and landed on the ground 20 feet below, sustaining multiple bone fractures.

An employee was working on a trailer door and its spring. The spring broke loose and hit him in the right front side of the head. He then fell out of the trailer, landing on his head. He suffered a skull fracture and head swelling, and his right eye swelled shut.
An employee was setting up a bending machine to bend copper tubing. The employee's right thumb was caught in a clamp, causing a partial amputation to the top of the thumb.
An employee was installing pylons on a beach. A pylon was taken by the wind and struck the employee.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a boom forklift. The fork attachment fell and fractured his right arm and hand.
An employee was operating a punch machine when the die amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee fell from a ladder to the floor inside a store that was being demolished. He suffered a head laceration, concussion, and a brain bleed.
An employee slipped and fell on ice, suffering a head injury.
An employee was maneuvering a drywall cart. Drywall fell on the employee's leg, breaking it.
An employee fell while climbing down from the back of a box truck, landing on the ground and suffering five broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a patch of ice while stepping out of a delivery vehicle. She suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
A letter carrier was exiting their vehicle to begin deliveries when they slipped on black ice and fell in the parking lot. The employee sustained a broken ankle.
An employee was assisting with offloading metal materials from a truck, when the load slid off the truck bed and fractured his foot.

An employee  was carrying a metal part in his hands when he slipped and fell on a damp floor. His left little finger was crushed between the part and a metal tool basket nearby, resulting in a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was repairing a gas tube heater from a 15-foot ladder leaning against the raised forks of a forklift. The ladder slipped out from under him and he fell about 10 feet, suffering a spine injury and a head wound that required stitches.
An employee was repairing a chain conveyor. The conveyor was turned on, and the chain and sprocket lacerated the tip of the employee's right index finger.
An employee was operating a forklift when it caught on fire, burning the employee's arm.
An employee was taking a window frame out of a shipping container. The frame fell onto his right leg, breaking it.
An employee was in an attic repairing a plumbing leak. The employee fell through the ceiling and suffered fractures to the right tibia and fibula, as well as an injury to the left ankle.
An employee was cutting the straps on a brick pallet with a knife. The knife cut his left forearm and he was hospitalized.
On December 17, 2020, an employee tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee was removing a chicken part off a picking line. The line caught the employee's glove and pulled in his right arm, lacerating and breaking the lower arm.
An employee was working inside a wind turbine when they slipped and fell approximately 57 feet off the ladder, striking a ladder support and resulting in two broken legs.

An employee was transporting steel casting flasks from one area on a finishing floor to another area using a forklift. One of the turnbuckle posts ripped from the flask causing the load to shift on the forks of the forklift. Both flasks then rolled off the forks and pinned the employee underneath them. This also caused the flask coverings to separate from the flasks and the employee was covered in approximately 700 degree sand from the chest down. The employee suffered burns to his legs and fractures to his pelvis.
An employee was punched by another employee. He was hospitalized, suffering from a concussion and loss of teeth.
An employee was driving a vacuum truck when it tipped over past the edge of a driveway. The employee suffered two broken legs and a fingertip amputation.
An employee was polishing material on a manual lathe. The lathe caught the employee's left wrist/hand, amputating the wrist/hand.
An employee was installing a crate divider when her finger got caught between the guide and the divider. She suffered an amputation to the left middle fingertip.

An employee was about to unload a trailer. The employee opened the dock door and discovered that the last pallet on the end of the trailer was leaning and in jeopardy of falling over. He climbed over the pallet and lowered himself to the floor between it and the second row of pallets. As he came down, his right ankle twisted and struck the edge of the pallet. The ankle was lacerated and broken.
An employee was hit by a car, fell, and suffered a fracture to the right wrist. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On December 17, 2020, an employee was standing on the fork of a forklift as it lowered a powered pallet jack. The jack tipped and the employee jumped to avoid being struck by it. He suffered a broken kneecap and an injury to the mid-leg.
An employee was cleaning a former machine with a spatula. The machine came down and caught the employee's right arm and hand, causing fractures to both.
An employee was cutting meat using a buster saw. The employee's fingers were caught between the blade and the guide, and the blade amputated three fingers.

An employee was working under an assembly. The assembly line kept moving and the employee was struck by a product and pinned against the machine. The employee suffered broken ribs, a lacerated liver, and a punctured lung.
While walking across the parking lot, an employee slipped on snow/ice and fell on the ground, fracturing their right hip.
On December 17, 2020, a concrete finisher was helping dismantle a bollard when a skid steer's bucket detached from its mount and broke his lower right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell to a shop floor, suffering a broken hip.

A mower machine caught a piece of wood, about 2 feet long and 3 inches wide, and threw it 90 feet backward. It struck an employee in the lower back, causing broken ribs, a vertebral fracture, and lacerations to the kidney and spleen.

An employee was cleaning a kettle. A chain holding the kettle fell into the kettle, along with a nut that had held the chain in place. The employee was trying to retrieve the nut when his finger was caught in a pump hole. The pump amputated his fingertip.
An employee was working on a conveyor when he slipped and fell. His finger got stuck in the chain and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a leaf blower to dry frost and ice. He slipped and fell to the next roof below, landing on his back and suffering a collapsed lung, a cracked rib, and a head laceration.
An employee was using a hammer drill to lay down a track. The hammer drill caught his left glove, pulled in his hand, and amputated the tip of his left ring finger.
An employee was pulling an empty rack when he tripped and fell backwards, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken pelvis and right arm.
An employee slipped and fell in a parking lot. She suffered a spiral fracture to the tibial plateau.
An employee slipped on ice while delivering mail and suffered a broken right knee.
An employee slipped on ice during a delivery and fell, suffering a broken rib and a collapsed lung.

Two employees were changing a battery. As one of them moved a pallet jack to the battery, the other lifted the locking arm on the battery. The battery shifted, pinching the second employee's left thumb against the locking arm. The thumb was amputated.
An employee was operating a fabric splitter. The employee's hand was caught and pulled into the uptake roll, causing the amputation of the arm at the shoulder.
An employee was cleaning the inside of a van. The van's door closed on the employee's right index finger, amputating part of it.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, falling to the asphalt surface and suffering three broken ribs and a punctured lung.
On December 18, 2020, an employee was struck by a forklift as it backed up. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the left leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was dropping off an empty trailer. He was releasing the pin from the trailer when his lower back popped, causing worsening pain, then shortness of breath. He was hospitalized, suffering from bulging discs in his lower back.
After getting out of her car, an employee slipped on black ice on a sidewalk, fell, and suffered a broken right kneecap. She was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder while climbing down it. The employee struck the ground and suffered a concussion and a broken left arm.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck  when it struck a pillar. The employee was ejected and his head came into contact with the structure of the truck. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was on a dock plate when the truck pulled away from the loading dock. The plate dropped down and the employee fell, landing 4 feet below and suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was on a platform, removing a material jam from a conveyor belt. A turntable, moving back toward him, caught his lower left leg against the platform. The leg was pinched and fractured.
An employee was on a metal roof, removing siding in preparation for installing foam insulation. The employee slid off the roof and fell to the ground 13 feet below, suffering a spine fracture.
An employee was helping to connect pipes. His right middle finger was caught and amputated between two pipes as they came together.

On December 18, 2020, an employee was walking through a plant next to a conveyor. The employee's safety vest got caught in a rotating chain and sprocket that powered the conveyor. As he tried to free himself, his gloved left hand was pulled into the sprocket and his fingers were lacerated. He suffered amputations to the fingers.

An employee was pulling a four-wheeled cart out of a truck. The cart's wheels got caught on a ramp running from the loading dock to the truck; the cart flipped over and the employee fell backward, landing on the floor and suffering hip socket fractures.

Employees were lifting a variable frequency drive (VFD) container using a sit down forklift. The VFD container shifted, fell, and struck an employee's right leg/foot. The employee suffered a broken bone and a laceration.
An employee slipped and fell in a parking lot, landing on the ground and suffering a broken leg.
An employee was struck by a stolen car outside a gas station. The employee suffered a kidney laceration, broken ribs, and a brain bleed.

An employee was descending a catwalk. He lost his balance and his foot was wedged between the base of the catwalk and a machine. He suffered fractures to the right fibula and tibia and was hospitalized.

An employee clocked out and was walking to his car. He stepped down from the parking lot to the grass area to get to the side wall. He fell and hit his head on the concrete ground sustaining a concussion and a laceration on the forehead.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken arm.
On December 19, 2020, an employee was scanning a parcel when she stepped back onto a pallet jack and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was using a foot-operated saw. The employee's gloved right hand was pulled into the saw area, and the employee suffered an amputation to the thumb tip.
An employee fell off a dock while closing a trailer's rear door. His fibula was broken at the ankle.
On December 19, 2020, an employee slipped on black ice in a driveway and fell, breaking her leg.
An employee slipped on ice while making a grocery delivery to a residence, falling and suffering a broken foot.
An employee was bleeding a chemical transfer line. Cresol sprayed out from the line, burning the employee.
An employee slipped while providing hand signals for an excavator. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a broken leg.

An employee was inspecting the doghouse panels for the backsides of breakers in a doghouse. An arc flash burned both the employee's hands, causing a large cauterized laceration to the right hand. Both hands were amputated.
An employee was helping detect propane leaks. The employee developed carbon monoxide poisoning and was hospitalized.

At 10:37 p.m. on December 19, 2020, an employee was greasing a drive train for the conveyor. The employee used a rag to remove excess grease and the rag got caught in the sprocket, pulling the employee's ring and middle fingers into the sprocket and causing an amputation injury.

Two employees were processing a bale of mixed plastic bottles and other material for recycling. When the strand of wire was cut, the cut end whipped around and struck the outer edge of an employee's eye. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
On December 19, 2020, an employee's fingers were caught in a press. The employee suffered an amputation.
While walking in the lot, an employee slipped on ice and fell, hitting her head and sustaining a concussion.
An employee was moving the shot position of a die cast machine with a crane. The chain broke and struck his arm, injuring it.
While trying to give a customer their receipt, an employee slipped on ice or snow in the parking lot and fell. The employee sustained a broken bone in the face and bleeding in the brain.
An employee was moving a rounder machine. The machine fell on one of the employee's left-hand fingers, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a jack to lift a convertor dolly. The dolly fell off the jack and struck the employee's left hip, dislocating it.
An employee was shot by their spouse while working in a kitchen, suffering two gunshot wounds to the lower leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On 12/20/2020, at approximately 6:30 AM, employees where using a wooden box to hoist tools up to the third floor of the facility. The injured employee reached out a window on the third floor to unload the box and it tipped, pulling him out the window. The employee fell to the ground and was hospitalized with various broken bones including a fractured hip and back injuries.
An employee was cleaning a hopper when he fell in and suffered a broken left foot.
An employee was servicing equipment, moving a stuck chunk of hot asphalt. The asphalt came out and burned his left hand.

An employee was traveling on a reach truck in a distribution center. The truck lost traction on a wet floor and collided with a rack. The employee's left foot was crushed between the truck and the rack, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a leak from a refrigerator. A 12-ounce refrigerant tank ruptured in the employee's right hand, breaking the index finger in front of the knuckle.
An employee was vacuuming above a metal lab. The employee tripped and fell through a guardrail opening, landing 8-10 feet below and suffering possible fractures to the face, wrists, knees, and arms.
An employee was adjusting a crane line on a spool. The employee's left index fingertip was caught between the line and the spool and was amputated.
On December 21, 2020, an employee was operating a headband cutter and amputated the tips of her left index finger and thumb.

An employee was measuring natural gas levels in the vicinity of suspected damage to a natural gas line. An adjacent apartment building exploded and caught fire, and the employee suffered burns to the side of his face and his left hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving a stack of metal corners. The stack fell and trapped the employee's right little finger against the floor, amputating the fingertip.

An employee was moving packages across a roller conveyor system when his finger was pinched between the rollers and the package he was handling. This resulted in partial amputation of his right middle finger.

An employee was standing on a platform about 7 feet from ground level, putting plastics into a machine. The employee slipped and fell from the platform, landing on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with head and shoulder injuries.
An employee developed a hernia while moving a 97-pound cylinder along a conveyor. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A employee was operating a jackhammer to break up concrete so a utility pole could be installed into the sidewalk. The jackhammer made contact with the employee's left foot, striking it near the two smallest toes just past the steel toe of the boot. The employee sustained fractures to the left foot/toes.
An employee was trying to get out of an office chair. The employee's leg got caught under the leg of another chair in the area, causing the employee to fall and suffer a broken hip.
An employee was using a hoist to lift tooling into a tooling box. The tooling fell onto the employee's left leg, breaking the lower leg.

Two employees were replacing an autoclave seal. The seal was being lifted with a hoist when the connecting i-bolt came loose and the seal fell onto one employee's right hand. The employee suffered a severe crushing injury to the hand and fingers, with severe damage to the little finger.
An employee had been cleaning a machine. The employee's right hand got caught in a hydraulic gate resulting in fractures and lacerations to the wrist. A guard was not in place at the time.
An employee slipped on spilled spaghetti and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting trim material on a table saw when a piece of wood trim became bound up in the saw, causing his hand to slip and contact the saw blade. The employee suffered an amputation to the tip of his right pinky finger.
At 11:00 a.m. on December 21, 2020, an employee was working inside a bakery freezer when her foot was caught in a cart. She fell and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was walking through a locker room when their sleeve got caught on a door handle, resulting in a cut on their right forearm. The next day, the employee's arm was feeling numb.
An employee was using a screwdriver to attach a string to a vehicle. Her finger was caught in the string and the left middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped while coming out of a cooler, fell backwards, and hit the back of her head on the floor.

An employee was moving a test plug on the bed of a truck. The employee's right ring and middle fingers were caught between the plug and the truck bed; the right fingertip was smashed and the middle fingertip was amputated. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

On 12/22/2020, an employee was coaching an advanced-level group of skiers. While demonstrating how to jump off a natural feature, the employee fell forward to the ground and sustained a fractured tibia that required surgery.

A temporary employee operating a rebar bending machine inserted material into the machine and was moving his hand away from it when his glove got caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of his pinky finger.

An employee had landed a load of glass in an "A"-style crate. The crane rigging caught on the bottom of the crate, causing it to tip over and land on the employee's left side and ankle. The employee's ankle was broken.

A crew had just finished backfilling an excavation on a construction site and were putting lime on the soil. An employee slipped and tripped in mud and could not get out of the way of an excavator as it backed up. He suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking down the stairs at a patient's home and fell down the stairs breaking their right ankle.
An employee was driving a forklift through a doorway. The employee's left arm was caught between the forklift and a temporary plywood entrance resulting in a fractured arm.
An employee was delivering a package to a residential home when a dog came from the rear of the property and attacked the employee. The employee was hospitalized with bites to both arms and legs.
An employee fell while reaching for a package on the floor. He suffered a broken left hip.

During assembly operations, a temporary employee was installing a chain on a sprocket when his hand got caught between the chain and a railing, resulting in an amputation of the left middle fingertip that was able to be reattached.
An employee suffered a fingertip amputation while removing a jammed board. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a fracture to the tibia at the kneecap. The employee was hospitalized.
A mill operator tried to unstick rubber from the apron on a mill. His gloved hand was pulled into the mill machine. The employee was hospitalized with a compound fracture to the upper left arm.
An employee was machining a steel roller on a manual lathe. The employee's hands came into contact with the roller, causing an amputation to the right index finger and a fracture to the left hand.
An employee fell from an 8-foot A-frame ladder, landing on the floor and suffering fractures to the right leg and spine.
An employee was rotating a C-hook lifting device when their fingertip was caught in the device and crushed, resulting in an amputation.
An employee started up a shredder machine. A large wrench attached to the machine hit him in the right temple and shoulder, causing abrasions to both. He was hospitalized.

A forklift operator dropped off a load of lumber onto a chain leading to a lumber stacker. The employee got off the forklift and pushed a control button next to the chain to push the lumber towards the stacker. As he was walking back to his forklift past the end of the chain, which is approximately 5 feet off the ground, 8 to 10 boards that were frozen together fell backward off the stack and landed on his right leg. The employee sustained broken bones in the lower right leg.
An employee fell while stepping out of a truck, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was repairing a forklift when his finger got caught in the pin housing of the forklift. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was touching up the paint on a stairway and preparing to put no-slip strips on the steps. While descending the stairs, the employee missed a step and fell down two steps, breaking her right wrist and hitting the back of her head on the floor, which resulted in a concussion.

Employees were drilling using an auger. They hit rock around 1.5 feet and the injured employee turned around to let his helper know to drop a spoon. The injured employee's jacket sleeve got caught in the auger, pulling him into the auger and causing lacerations to the left shoulder and chest.
An employee was cutting a steel bar with a bandsaw. The sawblade caught the employee's glove, causing a soft-tissue amputation to the left middle finger.

An employee was working on an edger chain. While the edger was shut off, the employee reached to straighten out a board on it; the edger was turned on and the employee's glove was pulled into the chain. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the left middle fingertip.
An employee was removing tangled grass from farm equipment rollers when their arm was caught in a moving roller resulting in a broken arm and lacerations.
At about 11:00 a.m. on December 22, 2020, an employee tripped over a parking block and fell in a parking lot. The employee suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading a flatbed truck with fabricated steel pipe. A pipe rolled onto the employee's finger, causing an amputation.

An employee was operating a bulldozer on a worksite when the bulldozer struck a rock which jolted the employee causing spinal pain. The pain increased until the employee lost all feeling in his legs. The employee was hospitalized with a herniated disc at L2-L3.
An employee was removing scrap from a press. The employee's left index finger was caught in the die, which amputated the fingertip.
An employee fell through a roof to a concrete floor, suffering broken vertebrae.
An employee was bending rebar on a radius machine when their hand was caught in the machine, resulting in four pinched and broken fingers.

The pulling unit crew was running rods in the hole from the derrick. The rig operator raised the rod string and began to lower the rods into the well. With the rod transfer still in place on the rod triple, the blocks were lowered, causing the chain holding the rod transfer to break. The rod transfer then fell and struck an employee, who was standing on the work floor, on the top frontal area of his hard hat resulting in the loss of an eye.
An employee was leaving a building. The employee's finger got caught in the door and was injured. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating an excavator when the roadway underneath the excavator collapsed, pinning the employee.
An employee tripped on an air curtain striping while walking into the backroom to let a vendor into the store, resulting in hospitalization for a foot injury.
An employee was walking into a facility. A strong gust of wind caused her to slip on ice on the ground and she fell, suffering a broken hip and arm.
An employee was cutting a heat exchanger with high-pressure water. The hose broke and the water cut a tendon in the employee's knee.
An employee was walking to their car at the end of their shift. The employee slipped and fell on black ice in the parking lot and sustained a broken left hip.

On 12/23/2020, employees of Zone Safety LLC were setting up a temporary traffic control zone. As the injured employee was controlling traffic with hand signals and a hand-held paddle, the employee was struck by a moving motor vehicle resulting in multiple severe injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee on a pallet jack and an employee on a forklift collided at the entrance to a freezer. When the collision occurred, the pallet jack handle broke, causing the employee on the pallet jack to fall forward, where their pinky finger was caught between the forklift grate and the pallet jack handle. The employee suffered a laceration to their pinky finger.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. Another forklift stopped in front of his and its raised forks lacerated the bottom of his right foot.

On December 23, 2020, an employee was cleaning overhead piping using an extended brush on an 8-foot A-frame ladder. The ladder began to tip and the employee fell to the floor, suffering two broken bones in the ankle that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning and reinstalling the X-axis way cover on a machine when the employee slipped and fell onto the machine, suffering an abrasion to their face under the eye.
An employee tripped and fell on a restroom floor slip carpet, hitting a door frame and suffering a broken lower-back vertebra.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in a parking lot, suffering a broken leg. She was hospitalized.

A forklift was lowering a 7,500-pound motor onto timber cribbing. The timbers shifted and the motor moved, then slid off the forklift blades. It pinned an employee against a hydraulic skid, breaking the employee's left femur and right leg before the knee.
An employee slipped on ice in a lot and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was replacing a lower window sash when the upper window sash fell on his gloved left hand, amputating a fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs.
An employee was trying to slow down a forklift to prevent a collision with another forklift. The employee's left foot was smashed between the two forklifts.

An employee was emptying a forklift hopper of steel chips into a larger bin. The employee's left index finger was pinched between the fork of the forklift and the hopper, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was shocked by live electrical wiring.
An employee was working in the cab of a truck. The employee developed chest pain, difficulty breathing, and dizziness caused by exhaust fumes from a leaking hose. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bitten by two dogs while delivering mail at a residential home.
A bank teller was punched in the face by a customer, suffering a broken cheekbone and a fractured eye socket.
An employee was loading a cinder block into a golf cart. The block rolled and disengaged the parking brake. The cart pinned the employee's leg against the pallet of cinder blocks and broke it.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a closed fracture of the left hip.
An employee was cleaning a running roller conveyor. The employee's right ring finger was caught in a gap between the roller and the conveyor frame, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while unloading packages from a mail truck. She suffered a compound fracture of the right elbow.
An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack when it struck a concrete pillar. He fell off and hit his head on the concrete floor, suffering a head injury.
An employee lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, striking his head on the floor and suffering a severe concussion and brain bleeding.
An employee was driving a forklift when his foot was caught and crushed between it and a metal pole.
An employee lost balance and hit a counter, suffering injured ribs.
An employee fell from an extension ladder, landed on asphalt, and broke his left wrist.
An employee slipped on ice on a concrete parking deck. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.

A garbage truck driver had noticed that the hydraulic oil level for the truck's packer blade was low. He was adding oil to the reservoir when the blade retracted and crushed his right hand against the truck body. He suffered two broken wrist bones.

An employee was pushing a mail cart. A forklift was carrying a box in the area; the box struck the mail cart and pushed it into the employee, who fell and hit her head. She suffered a concussion and arm pain.
A shoplifter closed a door on an employee's right foot during an altercation, causing a foot injury that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped on the floor and severely injured her right knee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was struck in the leg by a steel wire-braided discharge hose that jumped when pressure was applied. The employee suffered a broken leg.
A veterinarian was bitten by a cat during a medical treatment.

On December 26, 2020, an employee reached under a chain conveyor to get a piece of wood that had splintered from a pallet. The conveyor had been stopped, but it advanced and the employee's left hand was pulled between it and a tension roller. The employee suffered crushing injuries to the hand and amputations to the left middle finger and thumb.
An employee was cutting meat on a bandsaw when the sawblade cut the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning flakes around a hopper/box. The employee's right hand came in contact with machinery under the hopper, causing injuries to the middle and index fingers. One joint of each finger was amputated.

An employee was attempting to remove a safety block from a machine with a pry bar when the pry bar struck the employee in the face, resulting in lacerations to his face and right eye and requiring surgery to his right eye.
An employee was moving a set of rollers. The crossbar fell off the rollers and struck the employee's toe, causing its amputation.
An employee tripped on a blood pressure cuff while walking around a hospital bed. She fell to the floor and suffered a dislocated left shoulder and a broken left arm.

An employee had been loading a safe with a forklift. The employee was adjusting the forks of the forklift when their finger got caught between the forks. The employee sustained an amputation to the left ring finger.
Two forklifts were traveling down a warehouse aisle. The one in the rear struck the one in front, and its operator suffered an injury to the left heel. He was hospitalized.
An employee was turning a pallet jack when his left foot slipped and was pinned between the jack and angle iron. He suffered fractures to the left ankle and left tibia.

On December 27, 2020, an employee was chipping ice under the ramp toe plate using a hand chipper. The employee walked backward to move from the area and struck the back of their head on a shackle attached to the frame of the ramp. The employee was hospitalized for a bruise/contusion and abrasion.
An employee was moving pallets when a forklift ran over his leg. He suffered fractures to his left femur and right tibia and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
While extinguishing a grass fire, an employee came into contact with an energized wire hanging from a utility pole. The employee suffered electrical burns to the back, left arm, and thighs.

On 12/28/2020, while an employee was attempting to fix a pallet that was stuck to a palletizer, a photoelectric sensor on the palletizer tripped, causing a metal plate (apron) to retract. When the plate retracted, 11 cases of product dropped onto the employee's head, shoulder, and wrist, resulting in a small subarachnoid bleed and a sprain in their right wrist.
While lowering an infant care station crib to the floor to be serviced, an employee fell to the floor with pain in his right hip. The employee sustained a hip injury.

An employee was working from the third rung of a ladder, installing a fitting on a new transport line. He fell and his left middle finger was caught by the edge of the pipes and fittings, which amputated the fingertip.
An employee was walking backward with a yarn buggy in tow when her right hand was caught in between the yarn buggy and a support I-beam, resulting in amputation of her right pinky fingertip.

An employee was removing a hose from a truck. Pressure in the hose caused asphalt to blow back on the employee, who suffered second-degree burns to the left hand and chemical burns to the face and neck.

An employee had been hauling and disposing of lime kiln filters while wearing dust goggles, hearing protection, steel-toed shoes, and a blue medical mask. About one to two hours after the process was completed the employee noticed irritation in his mouth and throat. The employee was hospitalized with irritation of the upper respiratory tract due to lime dust.

An employee was cooking on a grill in a cafeteria. The grill's burner ignited gas leaking from the grill's hose, and the resulting fire set off the sprinkler system. The employee slipped on water from the sprinkler while evacuating, fell, and struck his head on a metal sink. He suffered a laceration to the right temple, as well as a burned left forearm.

Two employees were in a scissor lift while a 3,500-pound column was lifted into place to be welded. The column released from its chainfall and struck the scissor lift, tipping it over. One of the employees remained inside the lift while the second employee landed about 2 feet outside the lift. Both employees were hospitalized for fractures and sprains/strains. Both employees were wearing fall protection.
An employee was helping unload a truck using an accordion-style rolling table. The table fell onto the employee's left hand, causing an amputation to the little fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice while walking through the parking lot and fell, resulting in hospitalization for a fractured leg.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. His left foot was caught between the forklift and a concrete bollard, suffering multiple fractures and ligament damage.
While walking outside, an employee slipped on ice and fell on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee was 6 feet up an 8-foot step ladder securing overhead wires. He fell off the ladder, suffering a head injury.
On 12/28/2020 at 7:45 AM, an employee was freeing a bag that was caught in the product bagging machine and amputated his left index finger.
An employee was operating a hoist when equipment fell from the hoist, landing on their foot and causing a fracture.

An employee was running cardboard through a machine to stamp a company's logo on it. As the employee added ink to the roller, the employee's right hand, wrist, and forearm were caught between the transfer roller and the print roller. The employee sustained a fractured finger and severe lacerations. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell to the ground, suffering injuries to the back, knee, and ankle.

An employee was helping the gang saw operator by unloading the wood from the saw. A piece of wood was jammed in the saw. The saw was turned off. As the employee removed the jammed wood, his hand contacted the still spinning blades and sizer teeth. The employee received lacerations and contusions requiring hand surgery.

An employee was guiding a manhole lid to be set on the manhole when their right ring and middle fingers were caught between the lid and manhole. The employee suffered amputation of their right ring and middle fingertips.
An employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder to remove a window contaminated with lead when they fell approximately 3-5 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured T7 vertebra.
An employee slipped and fell while walking through a bakery. The employee's head and right eye struck a metal prep table, causing right-side head trauma and an injury to the eye.
An employee was walking inside an air can from an air unload grating/platform. The employee fell through the gap between the air trailer and the platform, suffering an abdominal area laceration.
An employee was using a meat saw to slice meat. The sawblade amputated the tips of her left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was exiting the building following her shift when she slipped on ice and fell, resulting in hospitalization due to a broken and dislocated left ankle.
On 12/29/2020, an employee stepped off the back of a truck and fell to the ground, resulting in hospitalization for two broken ribs.

An employee was working on a steel I-beam that was being driven into the ground with a hammer from a crane when the employee's right pinky finger was crushed between the I-beam and the hammer, resulting in amputation.

An employee was in an aerial lift installing a concrete form. As the employee was installing the turnbuckles on the concrete form, the aerial lift was positioned between the building and a 7.6Kv powerline. The aerial lift contacted the power line and the employee was electrocuted.
While performing housekeeping tasks, an employee slipped and fell forward onto his knees, resulting in a distal fracture on his right femur.
An employee tripped over a floor mat and fell to the floor, resulting in broken ribs.
An employee's right little finger was caught in a closing door. The fingertip was amputated.

On 12/29/2020, an employee was changing out a machine's wire bobbin when the high-speed spinning wire got loose and cut the employee's right hand, resulting in a laceration and a 1-inch to 2-inch wire embedded in his palm.

An employee was cleaning a steel catwalk and removing and collecting a come along pulley and chain device to place back into a storage location. While moving backward, the employee stepped into an open floor hatch in the catwalk floor and fell 22 feet. The employee was hospitalized for a broken ankle and a sprained back.
A door-to-door salesman was robbed at gunpoint and shot in the face, requiring surgery.
An employee was removing tags from pallets when they tripped over an extension cord and fell to the floor sustaining a broken femur.
An employee tripped on a floor mat in an office and fell to the floor, suffering a right hip injury.

An employee slipped while putting a manhole ladder into the hole of a structure. The employee fell into the hole and landed about 14 feet below, hitting his head, chest, and leg on the ground. He suffered two cracked ribs, a foot injury, and head trauma and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a cap from a standpipe. The cap came loose and was launched about 18 feet into the air, along with the tools being used to remove it. The employee suffered a fractured left cheekbone and a 1-inch laceration to the left cheek.
While inserting laminated insulation pieces into aluminum wall panels, an employee collapsed and struck his head on an insulation panel. The employee sustained three lacerations to the head.

An employee had just finished changing and adjusting the belt on a foundry standing grinder when the employee's left index finger made contact with the rotating wheel, resulting in a partial amputation.
On December 29, 2020, an employee was pushing a robotic cart and suffered a lower back injury.
During setup of a hydraulic hose cutoff machine, an employee was removing a piece of scrap hose when the machine activated and amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was monitoring parts of an elevator being moved off a transport truck when a piece of the elevator fell and struck the employee, resulting in a fractured right ankle and fractured ribs.
An employee slipped and fell getting out of a truck. The employee suffered contusions to the head and a left-side rib.
An employee turned to walk away when they tripped on a garden hose on the ground and fell, resulting in a fractured femur.
An employee was removing lumber from a steel beam with a claw hammer. A metal sliver flew into the employee's right eye, causing an injury that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was walking beside a forklift to help guide a piece of scrap granite that was being held by a crane attachment on the forklift. While walking, the employee fell into a hole in the asphalt and was run over by the forklift tires, resulting in a broken leg and foot.
An employee was cleaning a manure belt. The tool the employee was using got caught in the belt, pulling his hand along with it into the machine. The employee's hand was crushed.

An employee was operating a paper rewinder machine when he slipped and his fingers went into a nip roll. The employee sustained an amputation to the pinky fingertip, and two other fingers were injured.
An employee was operating a gluer machine. The employee's left hand was caught in the feed section of the machine, resulting in the amputation of the hand.

An employee was cutting down a birch tree. While he was making a cut to remove a section of the tree above his tie-in location, the tree broke below his feet. He fell to the ground about 20 feet below and suffered broken ribs and internal bleeding.
An employee was on a truck, trying to put insulating blankets in a blanket tube. He fell off the truck to the ground and suffered a broken right arm.
An employee was climbing a ladder up the side of a truck. The ladder broke free, causing the employee to fall to the ground and suffer a broken pelvis.
On December 30, 2020, an employee was manually lifting a roll of film. The employee tripped and fell; the roll landed on their left hand. The end of the employee's fourth finger was amputated.
An employee was walking to help a customer pump gas when her ankle twisted and she fell to the concrete floor, breaking her right ankle.

An employee was changing the battery on a forklift when her left middle and ring fingers were caught between the battery and the structure. The middle fingertip was amputated and the ring finger sustained a laceration.
An employee went into the parking lot to change a sign, slipped on ice, and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was walking up a paved walkway to deliver a package to a condo building when she slipped on ice and fell on the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to her right hip.
An employee had setup a table saw to cut a small piece of wood. While cutting the wood, the blade of the saw caught the employee's left index finger and partially amputated it at the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing a ladder to an airplane. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete ground, breaking both ankles.
An employee in the deli department was cutting tomatoes with a mandoline when the mandoline amputated their little fingertip.

The injured employee was on the ground holding the bottom part of a sprayer while a coworker sprayed releasing agent onto concrete forms. The coworker noticed that the form was leaning toward the injured employee and shouted to warn him. The injured employee tried to run, but the form fell forward on his lower torso. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was on a baker scaffold set at approximately 4 feet high, preparing the existing siding on a house to receive new siding at the eve of the porch roof addition. A temporary post that was supporting the roof's ridge beam was removed causing the roof structure to collapse, striking the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the left hip and left shoulder requiring surgery.

An employee was walking out to a customer's vehicle to help the customer load plants. The employee went to walk under a sod shed, tripped over the shed, and impacted the concrete ground. The employee sustained a fractured right elbow.

An employee was using a rag to wipe lubricant off the feed table of a flexo machine. The rag was pulled into the feed rollers, pulling the employee's hand with it. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was unloading produce from the back of a truck trailer when he slipped and fell to the ground breaking his left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down stairs when they tripped and fell down three steps, resulting in a fractured elbow.
An employee was bagging groceries. The employee suffered a strained shoulder while lifting products off the register.
An employee was conducting a pre-trip inspection on his truck when he slipped on ice and tore his left quadriceps muscle.
An employee was backing up an electric triple pallet jack when it struck a concrete bollard. His right foot was caught between the bollard and the jack, sustaining broken toes.

An employee was packing hind feet in boxes when their artificial finger nail was caught in a segmented transfer conveyor. The employee sustained an avulsion and required surgical amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee slipped on detergent that had spilled and fell on the floor. The employee landed on their left arm fracturing the radius.
While walking at grade under an asphalt rail car loading rack, an employee tripped on concrete that was protruding from the walkway. The employee fell and sustained five broken ribs.
An employee was driving a vehicle when another vehicle struck it. The employee suffered a compression fracture to a back vertebra, as well as a contusion to the right lung.

An employee on the bed of a hay delivery truck was removing twine from a bale of hay when he slipped and fell approximately 4 feet from the truck to the ground. The employee landed on their right foot, then rolled the right foot/ankle and caught himself with his right hand. The employee was hospitalized with a broken tibia and fibula which required surgery, and also sustained a dislocated right pinky finger.
An employee fell to the ground while dismounting the back of a truck. The employee landed on his side and sustained fractured ribs.

An employee was loading inventories when a van flipped and hit the employee, throwing the employee into a concrete wall. The employee sustained a ruptured spleen, fractured skull, laceration to the brain, brain swelling, broken ribs, and collapsed lungs.

An employee working in the sausage stuffing process area went to the storage area to retrieve casing for the sausage. The employee retrieved about 25 lbs. of casing using a stainless steel rolling cart. While pulling the cart back to her work area she lost footing and fell with the cart. The employee held onto the cart's handle and her fingers got caught between the cart and the concrete floor, amputating the left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee fell while descending a ladder, suffering a broken elbow and a bruised hip.
An employee was adjusting a guard on a machine when his glove caught on the sharp edge of the guard. The metal guard partially amputated the employee's left middle finger.
While walking to a gate an employee tripped on uneven concrete and fell to the floor, sustaining a broken left hip.

An employee was using a scraper to clean a dryer chute. As the employee was cleaning the inside of the chute, the air lock blades amputated the employee's right middle, ring, and index fingers. The machine was running at the time.
A letter carrier slipped on black ice while exiting a mail delivery vehicle. She fell and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was cleaning trash when he stepped on broken glass, leading to a laceration that became infected.
A ski instructor was struck by a snow boarder. The employee was hospitalized with a rib fracture and pneumothorax.
While retrieving a bag of ice an employee lost their footing and fell to the ground, sustaining a face contusion.

An employee was holding a door open for a customer. His left middle finger got caught in the backside of the door frame as the door was closed. He sustained an injury that resulted in a fingertip amputation.

A delivery driver was tasked with delivering a washer and dryer to a customer's home. The employee was retrieving a cord on the delivery truck when he lost balance and fell off the back of the truck onto the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm.

An employee had placed a machine in slow-speed mode and was wiping the inbound feed roller. The employee's left hand was caught between the roller and steel material. Their left index finger was injured and was subsequently medically amputated.

An employee was preparing to clean the bottom of a grain bin of soy beans when his safety rope became entangled in the auger below the floor. He wrapped the rope around his wrist to try and free it and was pulled down to the floor, resulting in a broken left wrist.
A mail carrier was bitten by two dogs while delivering mail on a porch. The employee sustained injuries to their hand.
An employee was driving a forklift when it crashed into another, stationary forklift. His left foot was crushed.

A maintenance mechanic was working with another employee to fix the recycle waste conveyor chain. They needed to knock out a bushing on the conveyor chain using a steel rod and bull pin. The employee working with the mechanic struck the metal rod while the mechanic's finger was between the rod and the bull pin. The mechanic's right middle finger was partially amputated.

The injured employee was going to enter a room at the same moment another employee was exiting the room. The door swung open and struck the injured employee. The injured employee fell to the concrete floor and broke her hip. The employee was hospitalized.
A lineman was cutting a tree from a power line when the tree split and fell on him. The employee sustained fractures to both legs.

The injured employee was helping a forklift operator weigh and load scrap aluminum into a shipping container. The employee was caught between the forklift's hopper and a shelf mounted to a cinderblock wall and hospitalized for a broken pelvis and a lacerated spleen, colon and liver.
A maintenance employee working in a hot box area slipped on a buildup of ice on the floor. The employee fell backward and sustained a skull fracture resulting in hospitalization.
A temporary employee was removing meat from a cooking pot when boiling water spilled into his boot. The employee was hospitalized with a burn to his foot.

An employee was moving food product from a taller pallet onto another pallet in the back storage room when he caught his foot on a piece of plastic from a pallet and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken right ankle.

Two employees were installing exhaust piping on a fryer. The injured employee was stabilizing and rotating the middle section while Employee 2 was bringing the stacks together. Employee 2 had material slip out of his hands, which then fell onto the injured employee's finger causing the amputation of the left index fingertip.

On 1/3/2021, an employee was operating a press with a rotating table to fabricate a part. When the employee pressed the palm button on the machine, his left hand fingers slipped forward and entered the swing radius of the block extension on the rotating table. The block extension amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger to the knuckle.
An employee had been getting produce from the backroom. The employee tripped and fell to the floor, sustaining a hip injury.
An employee was unloading bore gel from a trailer when they fell in a hole in the trailer decking, resulting in broken bones in their foot that required surgery.

An employee was getting snow off of stored boats and their covers when he slipped on a patch of ice under the snow and fell on the tongue of a trailer, landing on his back. The employee suffered two broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung.

An employee was rodding out scale and lime material from a chute that led into a screw. A chemical reaction took place between the lime scale and the materials used in the process, and the employee suffered first- and second-degree burns to the face and arms from hot vapor.

An employee went to release a kink in a flexible hose of a dewatering system/pump when his fingers got caught between the hose, resulting in injuries to three fingers and a dislocated wrist on right hand.
An employee was walking into the building from outside when they slipped on a concrete floor and fell, resulting in hospitalization due to a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a tuber machine and was caught in a shaft on the machine. She suffered a broken leg, a thumb amputation, a scalp avulsion, and the loss of part of her face.

An employee was operating a standup lift and lost control while entering the charging area. As the employee jumped from the lift, his left foot was caught between a floor barrier and the lift, resulting in a fracture to his left heel.

On January 4, 2021, an employee was operating a pneumatic press with an operating pressure of 400-700 psi. The employee as cycling the press when they reached down to retrieve a cutting die that fell off the staging block. The employee's left index finger was caught in the point of operation, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was power washing a wall while on top of scaffolding when they slipped and fell to the concrete below, resulting in a head injury.
On January 4, 2021, an employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on black ice and hit their head, resulting in a concussion that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking back to his truck after delivering a package when the homeowner's dog became untethered and attacked the employee, resulting in an amputation to the tip of his right thumb.
On January 4, 2021, an employee fell down a flight of stairs, landing on the floor suffering knee and lower back injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

On January 4, 2021, an employee was holding two runs of duct work that were inserted into a tabletop corner insertion machine when the machine activated by proxy switches that sense the presence of the metal and begin the sequence. An angle fixture popped out of the table and traveled from a horizontal to a vertical position to hold the duct work while a corner clip was being applied. The employee's gloved left ring finger was pinched by this angle fixture, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was attempting to hook a converter dolly to a trailer when his left hand was caught between the dolly and the trailer resulting in a crushing injury that required hospitalization.

On January 4, 2021, an employee was standing on a platform while pulling an object when they fell backward through railings 8.5 feet to the concrete floor below, resulting in hospitalization due to a concussion and lacerations to the head and leg.
An employee was removing product debris from a conveyor when his right index and middle fingers were caught between the pulley and the belt, resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was cutting a tree when the chainsaw kicked back resulting in a deep laceration to the knee. The injury required surgery.
An employee was filling a refrigerator with bottled water when the employee slipped and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right hip that required surgery.
An employee was operating a scissor lift when his finger got caught between an electrical panel and the lift's railing, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On 1/4/2021 at 12:15 pm, an employee was placing meat into a meat grinder and when the foot pedal was pressed and the machine turned on. The grinder caught his hand, which resulted in a soft tissue injury to his right hand that required hospitalization.
An employee was opening a valve to prepare it to be drained of sulfuric acid when a pump failed and sulfuric acid sprayed onto the employee causing chemical burns.

An employee was installing metal roofing for a residential home. The metal z-bar he was using contacted a powerline. The employee was shocked and fell about 10 feet from the home's rooftop. He sustained severe electrical burns to his hands, arms, and legs.

An employee was assisting another employee with adjusting the wire ropes in the main boom tube on a boom lift. While checking the tension on the wire ropes inside the boom tube, the boom retracted, resulting in amputation of two fingers on the employee's left hand.

The injured employee was assisting another employee with loading grates onto a bucket loader. The injured employee's left index finger was caught between the grate and the loader bucket, resulting in amputation at the first digit.

An employee was inspecting components and contacts of a transformer load tap changer in a substation. When the equipment rotated, it caught the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation at the nail bed.

An employee was on a ladder removing Christmas lights from the trees on the property and fell approximately six feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured neck, chipped teeth, and a forehead laceration.
An employee returning  to his work station walked by a forklift in operation when the forklift's tire struck his left ankle, resulting in swelling in his ankle and calf.
An employee fell to the floor while descending a 3-foot step ladder, resulting in a fractured left leg.
