On January 21, 2021, tripped on a monitoring cord while walking across an operating room. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur and a dislocated right shoulder.
An employee was climbing a ladder in order to install a solar panel. Rungs from the ladder broke, causing the employee to fall to the ground and sustain arm and shoulder injuries.

An employee was using an air hose at the company's fueling station to fill a co-worker's bicycle tires. The employee was bent over in front of a pickup truck while filling the tires. The pickup moved forward, striking the employee and causing a compound fracture to his left leg.
An employee was resurfacing a tool on a milling machine. The machine bit caught his right-hand glove and pulled in his ring finger. The finger was amputated at the second knuckle.

An employee was installing a sheet metal roof. The employee stepped on a section of the sheet metal roof and it gave way, causing the employee to fall 15 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a brain hemorrhage, severe facial fractures, a rib fracture, and a punctured lung.

The injured employee was assisting the blasting machine operator at the exit end of the machine. After a piece of steel exited the machine, the employee was brushing some blasting media back into the machine when his hand was crushed between the roller and the piece of steel, resulting in the amputation of a fingertip.
An employee was operating a ride-along pallet jack on a workroom floor. During a turn, the employee's right foot was caught between the pallet jack and a wall railing. Two of her toes were broken.

On January 21, 2021, an apprentice pipe fitter was making sure that the facing machine's blades were set properly when a clamp on the machine loosened, pinching the employee's right thumb and resulting in an amputation to the tip of his thumb without bone loss.

An employee was operating a double pallet jack in a warehouse. When he stopped the pallet jack, a swing reach forklift struck it. He was thrown from the pallet jack, landing on the concrete floor on his right side. He suffered a head injury and a broken right femur.
An employee was loading cardboard into the baler. The baler door closed on the employee's finger, causing an amputation of the left middle fingertip.

On January 21, 2021, a machine that is used to apply an adhesive to the back of solar panels became jammed. An employee attempted to pull the product from the jammed machine when hot adhesive sprayed out of the machine onto the employee's neck and hand, burning the employee.
An employee was moving cattle from pen to pen in a barn. A steer became agitated and head-butted the employee's upper right thigh. The employee suffered a contusion and swelling to the thigh.
An employee was loading garage doors on a flatbed truck. A stack of garage door sections (about 7 feet high) fell onto the employee, causing three fractures in the leg and ankle.
An employee was stacking lumber from a conveyor. The employee's glove came into contact with the conveyor's chain and sprocket, causing the amputation of the employee's right ring fingertip.

An employee was cutting film on a machine in order to release air bubbles when the employee's right hand was caught in the machine's rollers. The employee sustained a lacerated right hand that required surgery.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack down an aisle. The pallet jack collided with a moving stand-up forklift and the employee suffered fractures to fingers on their right hand.
An employee was walking in an office, lost balance, and fell resulting in a hip injury.
Two employees were trying to replace a pressure relief valve in a hot water system. Hot water was released and caused first- and second-degree burns to one employee's torso.
An employee was climbing a 20-foot extension ladder and fell to the ground about 10 feet below, suffering a dislocated shoulder and a fracture.
An employee was working inside the hub of a wind turbine, tightening bolts for the fan blades, when he suffered a crushing injury from an accumulator. His hip was broken and he was hospitalized.
An employee collided with another skier and sustained four broken ribs.

An employee was using a table saw to cut wood pieces. The saw caught his left hand, amputating his left index and middle fingers and almost removing the ring finger. All three fingers were ultimately amputated.

At about 8:15 p.m., a customer who had been told to leave a mall attacked a security guard. A second guard came over to help and the customer punched her and then kicked her in the head, arm, and back. The second guard was hospitalized, having suffered a concussion and a fractured humerus.

An employee was troubleshooting the slide gate valve at the top of a materials silo. As the employee was reviewing the operation of the valve, the valve actuated and pinched his left thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was operating a trimming machine. The employee placed his foot on the machine in order to activate the photo eye and his pant leg got caught in the machine, causing a laceration to his right heel.
An employee was spraying lubricant on a machine. The machine pulled the employee's finger in and caused an amputation to the finger.
An employee was working on a pump when their finger got caught between a mechanism and its housing, resulting in a fingernail loss and a fingertip amputation.

An employee was climbing up stacked totes. When she grabbed the tote above her (which was empty), it shifted and she fell. The empty tote fell with her and hit her in the left leg. She suffered a broken right heel and a broken left femur.
An employee was descending a scissor lift when his finger got caught on the latch of the scissor lift. The employee sustained an amputation to the left ring fingertip.
An employee was lubricating a window punch machine. The machine activated and amputated the tip of his index finger.
An employee suffered a contusion to the back of the head. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading angle iron from a flatbed trailer located inside the facility. While traversing the trailer, the employee's foot was caught on a piece of angle iron on the trailer floor, causing the employee to fall approximately 4 feet from the trailer to the concrete floor. The employee's head contacted the floor, resulting in a head injury.

An employee was watching a front-end loader scrape frozen aggregate from a sidewalk. After the front-end loader had made a pass, the employee moved towards the sidewalk to begin melting frozen aggregate with a torch. The front-end loader began to make another pass of the sidewalk, causing the loader bucket to swing and strike the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and a strained neck.

An employee was moving merchandise in the receiving area of the store. Another employee was moving a cart and it collapsed on the injured employee, resulting in fractures to thoracic and lumbar vertebrae.
An employee was blending bulk vitamins when the employee's middle finger contacted the platform alignment hinge, resulting in a severed middle fingertip.
An employee was unjamming a mail sorting machine when it started up. The employee's left hand was caught between a conveyor belt and a roller, and bones in the hand were broken.
An employee was adjusting a packaging machine and contacted a pressure belt resulting in a pinky fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered an abdominal injury while shoveling soap stock into a drain. He was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting and stacking fifty 44-pound lab reagent boxes. The employee experienced a subarachnoid bleed.

A mechanic was troubleshooting an electrical issue with a machine that was causing trouble with startup and stopping. At the same time, another employee was cleaning the machine rolls. The roller plates started up and caught the mechanic's left middle and index fingers between the rollers, resulting in amputation injuries to the fingers.

Two employees were removing a sheave cover on a 310-ton crane in order to reeve the hook block. The hook block was located on stands 7-8 feet above the ground. One employee was removing a sheave cover from above while the other was removing bolts from below. The employee below was struck by the sheave cover and sustained fractured vertebrae, a fractured right ankle, an injury to the ACL and patella on the left knee, as well as a dislocated hip.
An employee was breaking a piece of a brick wall with an electric hammer. The wall collapsed and fell on the employee, who suffered a dislocated hip and a broken rib.

A rigging hook had just been unhooked from a pipe that a crane had lowered. While the crane's cables were being raised, the hook caught onto the racking that was bracing the pipes. The tip of the hook broke off and struck an employee in the jaw, lacerating and possibly breaking it.
An employee was loading carts when he fell to the concrete ground, suffering fractures to the hip, knee, and tibia.

On 1/23/2021, at approximately 12:30 PM, an employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT). While turning right into an aisle, the PIT struck a 4-foot high metal bollard. The employee's left foot was caught under the main cabin of the PIT and his left ankle was against the bollard. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left heel.
The sampling door on a smokehouse was closed on an employee's right middle finger, causing a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking from a hospital to a parking garage when they slipped and fell on a sidewalk, resulting in a fractured tibia. Freezing rain was present during the incident.
Two employees were preparing to change out a saw blade on a saw. The still moving belt pulled in one employee's right hand, crushing the knuckle of their index finger.
An employee was feeding fabric into a fabric insert machine. The machine caught her finger and amputated it.
An employee was shocked while replacing a can light fixture. The employee suffered a burn to the hand and a shoulder sprain.

An employee was walking on a catwalk above a stage and seating area. A section of catwalk grating became dislodged, causing the employee and the grating section to fall. The employee struck the floor about 20 feet below and suffered fractures to the right arm, right leg, right ankle, and hips/pelvis.
An employee was walking around the building when he fell to the ground and broke his femur.

A maintenance employee was supporting a machine component by hand while another associate loosened mounting fasteners. The cooling fan blades partially amputated the injured employee's left middle finger (third distal phalanx with acute fracture).

At 2:20 p.m. on January 25, 2021, an employee of Legends Construction Company was moving some steel from a parking lot to a garage using a telehandler. The telehandler went off the road and tipped over, and the employee suffered broken ribs and lacerations.
An employee was setting up a CNC machine. The machine crushed the employee's right ring and middle fingers.

An employee was trying to place a chute into a hopper under a conveyor through a side opening in the hopper. A rope, used to secure the chute in place under the upper conveyor, got caught in a conveyor drum at the bottom of the hopper. The employee was holding the rope in his hands at the time, and the conveyor pulled the rope and the employee's right hand down into the rotating drum. The hand was torn open and the top part of the index finger was medically amputated.
An employee was delivering packages when the truck door closed on their right middle finger. The employee sustained a fracture to the finger.
An employee was cutting a board on a table saw. The saw kicked back and the blade amputated the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers. The blade was unguarded at the time.
An employee was operating a utility loader and backed up into a horizontal beam. The employee sustained a broken rib.
An employee was moving from one room to another when the automatic sliding door engaged, causing the amputation of the employee's left middle fingertip.
An employee was walking away from her car after parking it. She slipped on black ice and fell fracturing her left tibia.

An employee was investigating an issue with one of the bag houses. While moving powder away from the flip flop valve (air lock), the air lock opened and the flip flop valve closed and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was operating a lashing machine when the bottom of her t-shirt was caught and pulled into the machine. The employee suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was running hot oil down tubing when his truck caught on fire. The employee sustained third degree burns to both hands.
An employee tripped over a wooden pallet while delivering milk, falling and suffering a broken left wrist.
An employee exited their work vehicle, slipped on the icy parking lot, and fell. The employee sustained two broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was welding a tube to a flange when a clamp device closed on her right thumb. The thumb tip was medically amputated above the first knuckle.

An employee had been securing a load on a trailer with straps. The employee tried to step up onto palleted material when his left knee gave out, causing him to fall 4.5 feet to the pavement, resulting in injury to both knees.
An employee was assisting with a rack repair in a warehouse. A weld broke on an upper crossbar, causing it to fall down and lacerate the employee's head and face.
An employee arrived at work in the company parking lot and was getting out of her car. The employee slipped on ice in the parking lot and fell, resulting in a broken leg and hospitalization.
An employee fell off a ladder while working on a garage door. The employee landed on the ground and suffered broken ribs, a pelvis injury, and a shoulder contusion.
An employee was installing the roof of a carport. The employee slipped on snow and fell off the roof to the ground 14 feet below. The employee broke several bones and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a restacker machine. The employee accessed the outfeed area, immediately to the right of the yellow guardrail, and the hoist came down hitting the employee and pinning him to the floor. The employee was found unconscious having suffered head and neck injuries.
While descending an 8-foot ladder an employee slipped off of a rung and fell backward, hitting his head on a 4-foot metal safety pole during the fall. The employee sustained a head injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on a motor line and fell through a hole, approximately 8 feet, to the surface below striking their head and losing consciousness. The employee suffered a contusion to the back of the head and was hospitalized.

While conducting a field assignment, an employee was carrying equipment down a flight of stairs on his way to collect milk samples. The employee slipped and fell down the stairs striking the floor face first and sustained seven fractured facial bones and brain hemorrhaging.
An employee was working near a mini excavator and was struck by the excavator's bucket. The employee sustained a brain bleed.
An employee sustained a fingertip amputation when their finger was caught by the roller of a conveyor.
An employee was handling the winch cable on the back of a garbage truck. The end of the cable amputated his left ring finger.

An employee was connecting two concrete traffic barriers. As he was placing the securing pin between the two barrier pieces, one barrier shifted, pinching his hand between the two barriers. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle fingertip.
An employee was walking to his car, slipped on snow and ice, and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.
An employee was cleaning a work truck. While he was clearing an obstruction in the salt hopper, his glove was caught and the auger partially amputated his hand.

An employee had just finished unloading a trailer. The truck began to leave as the employee was removing the dock plate from the trailer. The employee fell between the trailer and the dock, suffering a leg injury.
An employee was operating a 30-ton press shear when a chip of metal struck the employee in the throat causing a puncture injury.
An employee was using a drill press and removing boards from the press when the drill bit caught his glove and pulled his finger into the bit. The employee's left ring finger was amputated.

An employee was walking along docks from the rear of the building toward the front. The employee was struck by a forklift traveling in reverse and sustained multiple lacerations and fractures to the lower left leg.

An employee was backing up an electric pallet jack to move out of the way of another associate. The employee's right foot was then caught between his pallet jack and a pallet that was on a stopped pallet jack in front of him. The employee sustained a crushing injury to the right lower leg.
An employee was walking down the stairs when he tripped and fell onto the floor sustaining a fractured knee.
An employee was part of a sanitation team and was cleaning the milk filler line when her wrist was pinned under a bottle cap turret. The employee's right wrist was fractured and crushed.

An employee was driving an ATV on a gas well access road. As the employee drove down a hill, the ATV's rear end slipped on leaves. The ATV slid into a rut in the road and flipped over, throwing off the employee. The employee struck the ground and suffered a broken collarbone and three broken ribs.

An employee was installing a new power line when a rotten telephone pole snapped, sending the power line onto the telecommunication line. The employee was struck by a live primary electrical line, resulting in electrical burns.

An employee was removing steel plates from a parts rack. The lower of two steel plates shifted as it was removed from the rack; the employee's right middle finger was caught in openings in the two plates and the fingertip was amputated.
On January 26, 2021, an employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof. The ladder moved and the employee fell to the ground about 8 feet below. His left elbow, wrist, and leg were broken.

An employee removed the protective covering of the elevator brake (brake cap). The brake coil sleeve got caught on the brake plunger and the employee lost his balance. The brake cap, which is a heavy piece of cast metal, fell onto the employee's right hand, breaking his thumb. The injury required hospitalization and surgery.

At the end of her shift, an employee went to park and charge her forklift. She exited the forklift before it had completely stopped and the forklift pinned her leg against a concrete wall. She sustained broken bones in her foot and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a rubber blow machine. The employee was clearing excess rubber at the top of the machine when it started. Its hydraulic piston struck the employee's right hand, causing three fractures.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot. She fell and her head struck the ground.
An employee entered a bus and tried to activate the service door lever, but fell down the three stairs inside the bus and onto the asphalt outside. The employee suffered a broken hip.

An employee was working as a packer on the thermal folding floor. A plastic blister fell down into a stacker. The employee went to get the fallen plastic blister when their left middle finger was pinched between two pieces of the stacker resulting in amputation of the fingertip to the nail.
An employee was helping push a container in an aircraft. The employee's foot was caught under the wheel of the container, and the employee suffered a broken toe.
An employee had been doing office work when the doorbell rang. The employee answered the door and an assailant gained entry, stole cash, and shot the employee in his right shoulder.
An employee slipped on ice and fell in the parking garage resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was driving a concrete cart. As the cart turned from a street into a parking lot, it hit the concrete lip at the drive entrance. The handlebars jarred, hitting the employee in the side and causing him to fall off the cart. He landed on the concrete and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee's back went out while they were taking parts off a shelf that was 4 to 6 inches high.
An employee's tractor trailer was hit by another truck as it backed into a shipping/receiving area. The employee's head hit the driver's side window and was injured on the left side.

On January 26, 2021, an employee was operating a bending machine to fabricate various sizes of metal hangers. The employee's left hand was caught in the rollers while running the flat stock through the machine and four fingers were crushed and fractured.
An employee was walking when they were struck in the head with a magnetic door lock that had loosened, resulting in a head contusion.

On January 26, 2021, two employees were trimming trees from an articulating boom lift, about 20 feet high. The lift drove over a septic hole, tilted, and fell; both employees jumped out. One of them suffered a broken right leg.

On January 26, 2021, an employee was adjusting the bed height of a hydraulic press. The table/bed adjustment handle slipped and the table dropped on the employee's right hand. The employee's thumb was crushed between the bed and one of the pins the employee had been adjusting, and the thumb tip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was using a pressure washer to clean equipment. He slipped and the water stream lacerated his left hand. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the hand.

An employee was unbinding cages from a live-haul trailer in preparation for unloading. The employee completed the trailer and proceeded to the other side of the loading area to start on the next trailer. The employee was struck by a reversing forklift and was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle.

An employee was leaning over the side of a dumpster with his upper body inside the dumpster and his legs hanging outside. When he swung himself up from the position to his feet, he lost consciousness and fell to the ground, striking his head on the concrete. The employee suffered a subarachnoid hemorrhage.

An employee was performing demolition activities in an area where a hole was cut in the concrete floor and a plywood cover was placed over the hole. The employee stepped on the cover and it shifted, causing the employee to fall to the floor below and resulting in a broken hip and arm.

A vehicle battery frame was being held by a scissor lift on one end while two other employees at the other end pushed the battery (weighing about 650 pounds) into position to be attached to the frame. One employee's left ring finger was caught and crushed between the frame and the battery. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was doing diagnostic work on a half-gallon juice filler. The machine's chain and sprocket caught the employee's right index finger and amputated the fingertip.

The employee was working from a scissor lift to fix an overhead garage door. A trailer backed into the scissor lift and knocked it over. The employee struck the concrete garage floor and suffered three or four fractured vertebrae.
An employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground while getting out of a truck, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was at a customer site delivering product. He was trying to lower his lift gate when the dock leveler was engaged. He fell between the dock and the lift gate and injured his legs.
An employee fell and struck his head on pavement after parking a vehicle in a yard. He lost consciousness.
An employee slipped on a walkway after leaving an office and suffered a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was refilling the hydraulic fluid for a bin dumper. The bin dumper activated and the employee was caught between the platform and the machine cradle. The employee suffered five broken ribs.

An employee was using a manlift when the top pulley became detached from the anchor point in the manlift's head house and the employee fell within the manlift, resulting in two fractured arms and a fractured vertebra.
An employee was attempting to subdue a client when they fell to the floor and suffered a knee injury.

At about 3:15 p.m. on January 27, 2021, an employee was standing on a ladder to stack mattresses. A mattress struck a support post when the employee pushed it toward the wall causing the employee to fall off the ladder to the floor. The employee suffered fractured ribs and vertebrae and a displaced disc. He was hospitalized.
An employee was moving material on a dolly. The dolly tipped over and the employee suffered a broken leg.
A belt and pulley caught an employee's glove and lacerated the employee's index finger above the knuckle. The top half of the finger was medically amputated.
An employee was exiting a mailroom when she tripped over a rug in the hallway and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

An employee was removing lag bolts from a man cover, waiting for the slurry tank to drain. When all but two bolts were removed, the access door opened up spilling liquid lime onto the employee. The employee sustained burns to both feet.

At about 6:00 a.m. on January 27, 2021, an employee was using a powered industrial truck (PIT) to load a trailer with product. The trailer pulled away causing the PIT and the employee to fall out of the trailer onto the tarmac. The employee suffered a lower back strain.
An employee tripped over a unistrut and fell to the concrete floor, breaking her left elbow.
An employee fell on ice in a parking lot, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip.
While an employee was adjusting the airline of a press, their foot slipped on a pedal and engaged the trimmer. The employee's right middle finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a pallet jack inside of a trailer when his right foot became pinned between the jack and the trailer wall, resulting in a crush injury.

An employee was operating a rubber mill when their right hand was caught between the roller of the mill and a piece of rubber. The employee's middle and ring fingers were degloved to the first knuckle. Later, the ring finger was medically amputated to the first knuckle.

On January 27, 2021, a pipe fitter was changing out the transfer pump when he lost footing on the pump's foundation, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left wrist.
An employee was rolling up cord reels. One of the reels got tangled and amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was moving a group of metal bars. As he placed them on a table, they caught his fingers and amputated his left middle and ring fingertips.
An employee was hauling a load of rock to a site. He got out of his truck, slipped on a patch of ice, and fell, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee fell while walking down a hallway, resulting in hospitalization for a knee fracture.
An employee was driving a motorized pallet jack out of the freezer when he lost control. His right foot slipped, striking a pole and fracturing toes.

An employee had been climbing a utility pole to install a dolly on the pole and fell approximately 50 feet to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with a lacerated spleen and internal bleeding.
An employee was working on a flare machine when a clamp closed on his little finger. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was walking down a set of interior stairs. The employee slipped and fell a few steps from the bottom, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was riding a tricycle when they stopped to let a pedestrian cross the aisleway, causing them to fall from the tricycle and resulting in a broken lower right leg.
An employee fell to the ground while helping another employee move stock/product. The injured employee sustained a broken hip.

An employee was disconnecting the rigging from a rudder shaft that was secured on a flatbed trailer when he tripped on dunnage (wooden planks supporting the shaft), and fell on his hip on the flatbed trailer. The employee sustained a broken right femur.
An employee fell from a tractor trailer while disconnecting the brake and electrical lines, resulting in hospitalization for a broken femur in their left leg.
An employee was conducting snow removal and injured a toe resulting in amputation.
An employee was walking to their desk when they tripped over a box and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken humerus.

An employee was hooking up a chain to move a mobile home to its next manufacturing station. The employee's right middle fingertip was crushed between two chains, causing an open laceration. He underwent surgery and the fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was loading a helicopter into a 40 ft. ocean shipping container. The employee kneeled on a razor blade lodged in a piece of foam, resulting in a laceration of the right knee.

An employee was inspecting the upper level of a conveyor system. The upper section was not properly assembled and fell onto the employee from a 4-foot height, resulting in a fracture to their right ankle.
An employee was stepping down from the last step of a 4-foot ladder when he fell to the concrete floor, suffering a dislocated hip.

An employee was cutting air ducts in the ceiling of a gymnasium from a manlift when the duct work broke loose and knocked over the manlift. The manlift and the employee fell to the floor, resulting in broken bones.

An employee stumbled while stepping down off a 4-foot ladder. He tripped and his head hit the wall; he then fell to the floor and lost consciousness, having suffered a concussion with brain bleeding. He was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting a forklift operator with unloading 10-inch and 4-inch pipes when the employee's ring and middle fingers were caught underneath a 4-inch pipe, resulting in a partial amputation of the tips of their ring and middle fingers.

An operator was putting product into a hopper. There were issues with processing the product through the grater/strainer. While the operator was pushing the product, a finger on their right hand contacted the auger resulting in partial amputation.
An employee fell to the concrete floor and suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was spreading out a tarp on the roof of a residential structure when they fell from the edge of the roof approximately 8 feet, 11 inches to the ground below, resulting in a broken arm and wrists and a back injury.

While walking between an operator station and the edge of a lathe in operation, an employee's shirt was caught by a 2-inch diameter piece of bar stock on the lathe. The employee fell to the ground and hit his head. He sustained a traumatic brain injury and an injury to the left arm.

Two employees were conducting maintenance on electrical switches. While the employees were applying jumpers, contact was made on the 115 kV transition line causing an arc flash. The employees were hospitalized with electrical burns.
An employee reset a breaker after a power outage. He was shocked by the breaker panel and knocked to the ground.
An employee was standing at the end of the trench box laying waterline when dirt engulfed the employee up to his hip. The employee was hospitalized with stomach pain.
An employee had been climbing a fixed ladder while carrying a mop. The employee slid down the ladder and landed on the ground, sustaining bilateral foot fractures.

After being loaded, a truck began to drive away from the loading area and ran over the driver of a second truck, who was waiting for their own truck to be loaded. The driver of the second truck suffered two broken legs.

At 7:30 p.m. on January 28, 2021, an employee was sitting in his vehicle in a company parking lot when he was shot in the face with a shotgun through the driver's side window. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

An employee was operating a ring rolling machine when he noticed a cut off slug had fallen into the overlap press. He pressed the quit button on the controller to stop the machine. He then reached into the overlap press to clear the debris and the press crushed the two middle fingers on his right hand, resulting in a partial amputation of the two fingers just below the fingernail.

An employee was using a non-powered manual pallet jack to reposition a loaded pallet. The employee stepped back from the pallet and fell on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the right hip and leg.

On January 28, 2021, a crane block and hook had been lowered to the ground for removal from the crane. As the crane load hook came in contact with the ground, an employee tried to rotate the load hook so the block/sheaves would come to rest in a vertical position on the ground. The hook became unstuck and his right foot was wedged between it and the load block. His little toe was broken.
An equalizer bushing pusher activated and caught an employee's right hand, amputating the tip of the employee's right thumb.
An employee was loading material into a line when they got caught in the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle finger on their right hand.

A forklift backed into an employee as she was walking on a pedestrian walkway in a dock area. She fell to the ground and one of the forklift's rear wheels ran over her left leg and foot. She suffered broken bones in the foot, big toe, and ankle.
A mail carrier was walking to the next delivery when a dog came up from behind and jumped on him, knocking him to the ground. The employee suffered a broken right hip and broken left elbow.

An employee was trying to remove a block of meat jammed in a grinder. Another block of meat came down and crushed his hand against the machine, breaking three bones. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was driving a pallet jack backward to line up with a pallet when his left foot got caught between the pallet jack and a storage rack, resulting in injuries to his left ankle.
An employee was cutting a piece of metal with a saw. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's right thumb.
An employee had been cleaning a car and was found on the ground bleeding from a cut on the head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting T-bone steaks with a bandsaw. The bandsaw amputated two fingers on the employee's left hand.

The injured employee was assisting with mixing concrete by adding water to the mix while another employee was using a mixing drill. The injured employee's sweater got caught in the mixing drill chuck, resulting in a broken right arm.
An employee was cleaning a concrete form using a hand grinder with a wire wheel. His right thumb was caught in the tool's handle and lacerated.

On January 29, 2021, a truck driver had finished unstrapping his load and was standing near his truck while the forklift operator was setting down cross-members. A cross-member rolled onto the employee's left leg, causing fractures to both the tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.

Employees were loading material that had been dismantled from a hoist onto a truck at the loading dock using a pallet jack. While the material was being transported by the pallet jack, the load shifted and one of the employee's left middle fingertip was caught between two hoist poles and amputated.
An employee was bent over looking at paperwork when the employee was struck from behind by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
An employee was loading a pallet onto the trailer using a forklift when his left foot was pinned between the forklift and the pallet resulting in a broken foot.

On January 29, 2021, at approximately 3:00 PM, an employee was spray painting a conduit pipe while on an A-frame ladder. He fell from the fifth rung of the ladder to the concrete floor and sustained a fractured right ankle.
An employee was acting as a spotter for a forklift driver when the forklift backed over the employee's foot, resulting in a broken foot.
An employee was moving a surgical equipment cart down the hall, tripped on the cart, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a strained knee.

An employee was transferring a 55-gallon drum to a secondary containment pallet. The employee slipped and fell, causing the drum to also fall. The drum fell on the employee's hand, resulting in the amputation of the right index fingertip and the right middle finger at the first knuckle.

An employee was going to unload a tractor trailer at the loading dock. The employee straddled the trailer lip and the dock to release the door latch. The tractor trailer pulled away from the dock and the employee fell to the ground between the dock and the trailer. As the tractor trailer backed up to the dock again, the employee was pinned between the trailer and the dock.
An employee was signaling a tractor trailer as it was backing up. The employee was pinned between the trailer and the loading dock and sustained fractures to the ribs and pelvis.

An employee was installing a metal air handler hood. It would not fit properly, so he wedged a 2-inch by 4-inch piece of wood in. As he was about to press it with a scissor lift, the wedge slipped out and the hood caught his left middle finger amputating it at the knuckle.

An employee was setting up a lamination line when they attempted to clear a flag that was on the impression roll. The employee's finger contacted the impression roll, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was working on a roof while installing a membrane roofing system over an existing metal roof. The employee was pulling a generator cord out of the way when he fell off the roof edge approximately 20 feet into muddy ground, resulting in a fractured pelvis and right lung contusion.
An employee was walking from the parking lot into the distribution center when they slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a broken pelvis.
An employee was driving a golf cart around a stationary aircraft. A baggage tug struck the employee and his cart; the employee suffered broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a lung injury.

An employee was prepping a 40-foot solid wood pole to be set with other team members. While the pole was being set into the ground with a track bucket, the employee started to push the pole into place. The operator boomed up to straighten the pole. The rigging slid off the pole and landed on the outrigger of the track bucket. The pole bounced and struck the employee causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a contusion to the head and a chipped tooth.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor in a pharmacy. The employee suffered a broken left hip.
An employee slipped on an ice-covered parking lot while leaving his vehicle. He suffered multiple fractures and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was exiting their vehicle when they slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a lower back injury.
An employee was at the start of his shift, walking through the shipping yard to his tractor trailer, when the employee slipped on ice, resulting in a fractured right leg and a torn ligament.
An employee was standing near a cook when the cook dropped a spoon into hot oil and the oil splashed onto the employee, resulting in a burn.
An employee was walking to their car in the parking lot when they slipped on ice, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee bumped into a box and a milk crate on top of it fell and hit her knee.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was walking in the yard on patrol when they slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a fractured pelvis.

A maintenance worker was clearing a jam in a pelletizer. The employee was using a putty knife near the rotating blade when the putty knife was caught and spun, cutting the employee's hand and breaking his finger.

Two employees were conducting preventative maintenance on multiple air handling units. One employee was greasing the motor and fan bearings inside the end of a unit when his left pinky finger was caught and pinched between the belt and pulley resulting in a partial amputation of the distal phalanx.

An employee was working on top of a grading platform, replacing a faulty spring on a shaker. As the employee knocked on a bolt to get to the spring, the shaker dislodged and fell. It amputated the tip of the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was getting ready to install tar paper on a one-story residential roof when the employee slid off of the roof. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured ankle.
An employee was walking around outside a customer's home in order to quote an exterior project when the employee slipped on ice and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee tripped and fell, sustaining an ankle fracture.

An employee was checking control voltage in an electrical panel when an electrical short occurred, causing an arc flash which resulted in third-degree burns on the hands and second-degree burns on the face of the employee.
An employee fell from a roof to the ground at a residential construction site. The employee suffered injuries to the neck and head.

An employee was walking across the floor to begin the end-of-day cleanup when the employee slipped on fireproofing spray on the concrete floor and fell. The employee was hospitalized with three broken ribs and a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was receiving debris on the ground when they were struck on the head with a 2-pound piece of stucco, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a tufting machine when their left arm was caught between the yard feed rollers and fractured.
An employee was getting up from a chair. The employee's foot got stuck and they fell to the floor, suffering elbow and hip fractures.
An employee slipped and fell on outdoor stairs, resulting in a fractured left ankle.

Two employees were manually tapping holes after destructive removal of studs. They were using a pneumatic ratchet, placed on the socket over the tap, with a stop bar in one of the existing studs. When the injured employee activated the pneumatic wrench, it pulled the employee toward a neighboring stud. The employee's left ring finger was pinched between the tool body and the stud, causing an amputation at the fingertip.
An employee was walking in the parking lot to start his shift when he slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a head injury.
An employee was walking around his work truck on muddy terrain when he slipped and fell in the mud. His left hip struck a 6-inch tree stump and was broken.
An employee was inspecting trailers when they slipped on ice and fell fracturing a hip.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured hip or pelvis after slipping and falling on ice.

An employee was cleaning out a wood burner. A falling clump of wood ash struck his right hand in the airlock, causing the amputation of the ring fingertip against the airlock fin and the chute's frame.

An employee was removing aluminum stuck in a cable stripping machine that had just been turned off. A still spinning blade in the machine pulled in the aluminum and the employee's right index finger. The fingertip was amputated, with the loss of the nail bed.

Two employees were in an aerial lift, approximately 25 feet from ground level. The employees were spraying water with a fire hose into ductwork on a machine in order to remove a blockage. When the blockage was removed, steam from the ductwork enveloped the employees in the lift. The employees were hospitalized due to steam burns.
An employee was performing prep work when they slipped and fell, resulting in a broken hip and a laceration that required stitches.

An employee was on a 3-4 ft. platform ladder adjusting a vacuum hose in a resin super sack. The platform ladder fell over and the employee fell to the concrete floor, sustaining injuries to the back and leg.

An employee was about to unload the garbage from a garbage compactor. When he released the lever on the door, it swung open and struck him in the face. He suffered a broken nose and a facial laceration.
An employee was walking across the floor of a warehouse when they fell and struck their head on a piece of equipment, resulting in a concussion and loss of consciousness.
On February 22, 2021, an employee was using an emery board to polish or de-burr bar stock when their right pinky finger was caught in the lathe and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working on a furnace line in a wire mill department, running material line on a spool. A piece of material caught his left index finger as he tried to cut it, amputating the fingertip.

The employee was on the first floor of a building that was under renovation. She fell into a floor hole and was trapped between joists. She suffered broken ribs and back vertebrae, as well as a punctured lung.
Two employees were using a dolly to transport a safe. When the dolly moved over the door's transition strip, the dolly and safe bounced, crushing and causing a fracture on the employee's right hand.
An employee had turned to grab a pen from his work desk when he tripped over a trashcan and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured left arm.

An employee was walking alongside a rail car. The railcar rolled out of control, striking and rolling over the employee. The employee suffered an amputation to the right leg between the hip socket and the knee, a partial amputation of the left foot, a broken pelvis, and abdominal injuries.
An employee was walking to his truck when he slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a fractured leg and ankle.
An employee slipped on a wet floor in a building while walking toward the exit. The employee fell, suffering a broken kneecap.
An employee was moving cattle from the holding pen to the kill pen. A cow turned back, charged, and headbutted the employee's left leg, resulting in a tibia fracture.
An employee tripped on plastic shrink wrap and fell to the floor inside a cooler. The employee suffered an injury to the left hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when the employee slipped and fell on ice. The employee's head impacted the ground, causing the employee to lose consciousness.
An employee was walking into work when she slipped on a patch of ice in the main plaza and fell. She suffered a broken right tibia and cartilage damage.

An employee was building a shipment using a pneumatic nail gun when the nail hit a knot in the wood and ricocheted, going into his left knee area and resulting in an injury that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a metal angle with a band saw. The angle snagged on the blade and smashed the employee's right ring fingertip against the saw's backstop. The fingertip was amputated.

On February 22, 2021, at approximately at 7:50 p.m., a temporary employee was using a custom-made portable grinder to grind cannoli when his right hand was caught in the grinder s point of operation. His right index finger was severely injured resulting in surgical amputation. His right middle finger was crushed from the second joint to the tip and his right thumb nailbed was separated.
An employee slipped on ice and fell while leaving a store. The employee's back and head struck the ground, causing a back injury and a possible concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee stepped down from the second step of a ladder to the floor, landed forcefully, and suffered fractures to the left tibia and left radius.
A forklift backed into an employee, pinning him against a steel beam. He suffered massive internal injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing diagnostic testing on an automobile elevated on a car hoist. The employee was working from a portable staircase and fell 6 to 8 feet to the ground, resulting in a loss of consciousness, a broken finger, a head injury that required stitches, and a concussion.

An employee was stepping from a metal grating onto a sloped metal ramp, 2 inches high by 6 inches wide. He slipped on residual graphite dust and fell backwards. The back of his head struck the metal grating and he suffered lacerations and a brain bleed. He was hospitalized.
An employee was repositioning a ball valve when the valve closed on the employee's finger, resulting in an amputation to the tip of the employee's right ring finger.
On February 22, 2021, an employee was walking in her work station when she bumped into some boxes. She fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was using a come-along when it came off its anchor point, causing the employee to slip and fall onto his left side and break his pelvis.

An employee was moving a mini-compactor to another work area. The employee was caught between a skid steer and the mini-compactor, resulting in a compound fracture of the lower right leg that required hospitalization.
An employee got out of a vehicle and was run over by its rear driver's side wheels. The employee suffered a spinal injury, bruised lungs, and a shoulder fracture.
An employee slipped on a snow-covered ice patch in a back lot between steel storage racks. He fell and injured his left ankle.
A temporary employee was retrieving an item from a machine. His left index finger was caught by a chain and sprocket and was amputated between the first and second knuckles.

An employee was assisting with moving steel columns and other materials around the jobsite. A steel column being moved by a forklift swung and struck the employee in his right lower leg, resulting in a broken fibula and tibia.

An employee was operating a dock stocker. As the dock stocker made a left turn, it struck a stack of empty pallets and a corrugated gaylord. The employee's left foot was caught under the gaylord and was degloved. The employee was hospitalized, and two of her toes were medically amputated.
An employee slipped in snow and fell to the ground while walking to a vehicle. The employee suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.

An employee was walking by a railcar commodity offloading area. A 2-inch rubber hose funneling phenol into a 55-gallon drum became dislodged from the drum and sprayed liquid phenol onto the employee. He was hospitalized, having suffered second-degree chemical burns to the back of his neck and first-degree chemical burns to his face and arms.

A temporary employee was walking toward the exit of a production floor at the end of their shift. As the employee approached the exit, a co-worker walking in front of them stepped to the right, knocking the employee to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured right pelvis.

A forklift operator had just finished loading a trailer and was trying to return a dock leveler machine to its neutral position. The flap remained extended; as he tried to close it with his right hand, the dock plate lowered and pinched his right middle finger in the flap pinch point. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was ascending a ladder on a wooden pole. The pole snapped from the base, causing the employee to fall 3 ft., resulting in a fractured hip and wrist.
An employee was operating a yard tractor in a parking lot when the yard tractor collided with another yard tractor. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee fell down stairs, resulting in a fractured left ankle.

An employee was calibrating equipment in a hotel parking lot. The equipment had radiation and laser equipment that deployed from the back of a truck and rotated down. The employee was crushed between the hood and the bumper of the truck, suffering chest injuries. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was walking while inspecting recently casted concrete segments when they came into contact with abrasive water during a high-pressure washing operation, resulting in lacerations on their right palm.
An employee was operating a forklift when the forklift struck a dock wall, resulting in a fractured forearm.
An employee exited their truck to clear ice off the windshield. The employee slipped and fell on ice, resulting in hospitalization for a fractured right femur.
An employee suffered a lower back strain while moving a hospital patient in bed.
An employee was emptying a salt spreader attached to a truck. The employee became entangled in the auger and suffered an amputation to the right arm.

Two employees were changing the cups in a pump. The pump was started up to put the machine in reverse, which would get the cylinder cup out to the end of the material cylinder so the cup could be removed. The swing tube switched, and an employee's right thumb and index finger were caught in it. The employee suffered amputations to the thumb and finger.
An employee was cutting pieces of trim with a 12-inch miter saw. The sawblade lacerated his left index and middle fingers.
An employee was closing a rolling trailer door. The employee's right hand slipped under the door, which closed on the hand, causing fractures.

An employee was removing bolts from a crane to disconnect the crane from a wind tower. When the crane was being lifted up, the employee's left hand caught on a bolt and was pulled into the bolt, resulting in an amputated thumb and ring finger.
An employee was stepping off a ladder after removing a branch from a light when they missed a step and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken back and right leg.
On February 23, 2021, an employee was making a key in a plant's operations department. The key machine lacerated his right thumb. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a chimney from scaffolding. The employee fell from the scaffolding, striking a steel support beam and the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
On February 23, 2021, an employee who was making deliveries got out of his vehicle, tripped, and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right arm that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a band saw on a product when they suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell through a grating on a mezzanine. The employee landed on the concrete surface below and suffered a broken right femur.

An employee was stepping onto an 18-inch-high step on the back of a mixing truck. He lost his balance and began to fall. He extended his arms to catch himself and suffered a fracture to the upper left wrist that required surgery.

An employee had been pruning a tree using an arborist rope saddle and climbing equipment. While descending to the ground, the knot securing his rope to the harness became untied. The employee fell 15 feet onto a landscaped area of the property. The employee was hospitalized with possible broken ribs and shoulder and lower back injuries.
An employee was skiing down from a station at the top of a ski run. He lost his balance and fell onto his right hip, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was stocking shelves when they fell from a stock cart to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
An employee was applying salt to an icy sidewalk when they slipped and fell, resulting in a fractured right leg and ankle.
An employee was removing a piece of scrap from a punch press's shuttle system. The shuttle moved and amputated the pad of the employee's thumb.
An employee slipped and fell on black ice in a parking lot. The employee suffered a fracture to the left ankle (as well as minor scrapes to the left hand) and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to their vehicle in the parking lot after their shift. While scraping ice from their windshield, the employee slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee was running 1/2-inch square bar solder into a chucker machine. As the employee was clearing a jam in the machine, it activated and caught the employee's left middle finger. The employee suffered an amputation at the tip/nail.
An employee was installing ductwork in an attic. The catwalk came unsecured and the employee fell through the rafters, catching himself before hitting the ground but suffering a ruptured spleen.
An employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a broken ankle that required hospitalization.
A test pilot was testing a jet ski in the water when he came into contact with a wave, resulting in a closed fracture on his leg.
On February 23, 2021, an employee was attempting to clean/remove cardboard from a block saw when the saw's rotating blade lacerated his forehead. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was coming off a snow covered rooftop onto a ship stair/ladder to go into a building when they slipped and fell approximately 18 feet from the ship stair/ladder to the ground. The fall resulted in a broken leg requiring surgery.
An employee was hauling air bags with a forklift when the forklift collided with a support column, resulting in injuries to the employee's hands and feet.

On February 23, 2021, an employee was removing 4-inch by 4-inch posts from the tops of stacks of veneer before they were loaded into an industrial veneer dryer. While the employee was between stacks of pine veneer on the dryer's infeed chains, the employee was caught between two of the racks and suffered pelvis fractures. She was hospitalized.

On February 23, 2021, a People Ready temporary employee was operating a machine. His coat was caught in the machine and wrapped up in the shaft of the machine conveyor. He suffered serious internal injuries and broken bones and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a piece of meat on a band saw and amputated the tip of his right thumb.

On February 23, 2021, an employee was placing an asphalt keg into a kettle. The keg slipped and hot asphalt splashed out of the kettle and onto the employee's face. The employee suffered facial burns and was hospitalized, requiring surgery to remove the asphalt.
An employee was opening a bag of guacamole using a knife. The knife slipped and amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was using a 5-foot ladder to access a work area. A piece of a component the employee was holding came loose, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall backwards to the ground 55 inches below. The employee suffered broken ribs and a laceration to the lower left leg, about 6 inches above the ankle.

An employee was setting up a palletizer when their right hand became caught in moving parts of the machinery. The employee suffered a laceration that required surgery, which resulted in a partial amputation.

An employee was observing the metal fabrication process. The employee was struck in the head by a small metal projectile created from the fabrication process, resulting in a laceration to the forehead and a possible concussion.
An employee was removing formwork from a ceiling. An aluminum beam he was pulling down struck his hard hat, causing a neck injury that required surgery.

An employee was pulling cable while standing in front of a directional drilling machine when the machine struck an electrical pole riser. The electrical pole riser clamp had a power cord that contacted the drilling machine. The employee was shocked and sustained burns to the right hand.
An employee was tightening a 1/2-inch belt on a pulley. The employees finger got caught between the belt and pulley, causing a fingertip amputation.

An employee had been standing on a level platform mounted on the forks of a lift truck. The employee was moving off the platform through the truck's operator cage when the mast activated. The employee's right knee was pinched and crushed. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

On February 23, 2020, an employee was moving a 570-pound tire onto a pickup truck's lift gate when the tire fell off the lift gate and knocked the employee to the ground. The employee suffered an injury to his right lower muscle and was hospitalized.
An employee was closing the cover to an oil vat and was sprayed with hot oil, resulting in second degree burns to the face and left arm.
A mail carrier was delivering mail when they fell on the sidewalk due to uneven pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.

Pre-conditioned air had just been hooked up from a jetway to an airplane. The air coupling broke away from the flange and struck an employee four times. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and fibula.

An employee was guiding a tree with both hands while it was strapped to the boom of a front end loader. The employee slipped and lost his balance, and one of the loader's front tires ran over his right leg and ankle.
An employee was on a ladder at a construction site when the ladder "walked" into a hole, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained a skull fracture.

An employee was changing a motor on a sorting line and correcting tension on the conveyor belt. The belt slipped and, as he was adjusting it, his right thumb was caught by the belt and pulley. The belt wrapped around his thumb, causing the amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was placing a mobile home on a trailer when the mobile home slipped off the jack and struck the employee. The employee suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was clearing a paper jam. The employee's thumb was pulled into the machine rollers and crushed, undergoing a partial amputation.

A forklift operator was instructing another employee where to secure a load of pipe. A pipe in the load shifted, pinching the operator's thumb between the pipe and cab mounting bracket on the forklift. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the right thumb above the top knuckle.
An employee was replacing an electrical breaker for a garage door at a residential site. The employee suffered a 120-volt shock to the right hand.
While connecting a chain to a rubber pit mat, an employee was struck by a UTV as it was backing up. The employee sustained a laceration to their ankle.

An associate was troubleshooting a faulty electrical component on a golf cart equipped with a flatbed when the cart energized and started to move backward. The associate grabbed the front of the cart; the cart's directional switch was then flipped, causing the cart to move forward and push him against a stationary forklift. The associate was hospitalized with a fractured right hip.
A group home resident suddenly jumped back, causing himself and an employee to fall down stairs. He landed on top of the employee and broke her femur.

On February 24, 2021, an employee had just unhooked a tow strap. The employee was laying on the ground, attempting to re-insert a pin into the front of a haul truck. The truck was at an intersection that had a flagger signaling the public traffic. The flagger motioned to the public traffic and the haul truck moved forward and struck the employee that was working under the truck. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis, a detached femur, and internal injuries.

An employee was transferring hot oil from a tanker truck to a tank storage unit when back pressure in the hose caused oil to spill over onto the employee's forearms. The employee sustained second degree burns to both forearms.

The injured employee was rigging boring machine tracks. A chain was used to lift and reposition the tracks. While the tracks were suspended, the boring machine operator went to boom up and the injured employee's left thumb was caught between the tracks and the rigging chain, resulting in a partial left thumb amputation.

An employee was stepping off a gangway and tripped on a piece of rope that is attached to the safety net. This caused him to fall to the dock and then he rolled underneath the passenger side of a pickup truck that was parked about 3 to 4 feet from the gangway. When the pickup truck pulled away, it ran over the employee's left leg and fractured it.

An employee was moving a pack of pressurized air cylinders with a forklift. The employee noticed the forks were too close together and dismounted the forklift. As the employee was walking around to the front of the pack, he tripped on a curb and pulled the pack of air cylinders onto his foot.
On February 24, 2021, an employee was hospitalized with a right ankle fracture after slipping and falling on ice in a parking lot while walking into work.

A crew was removing steel beams from the work area using a fork lift. There were 10-foot and 30-foot sections of steel beams stacked on dunnage next to each other. After allowing employees to clear approximately 25 feet away from the lift, the forklift operator began to lift a 10-foot section of steel beam. The bottom left flange of the 10-foot beam being lifted caught the top flange of the adjacent 30-foot beam, causing it to fall off the dunnage and onto an employee's foot. The employee's left foot and toes were crushed by the steel beam, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee had been bagging food and was assaulted by a co-workers' father. The employee was hospitalized with multiple jaw fractures.
An employee slipped and fell on black ice in a parking lot. Her ankle was broken in three places and she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was walking from their car into the building when the employee slipped and fell on black ice in the parking lot, resulting in a contusion on the back of the head and back pain.
An employee was using a wheel grinder when the grinder became unplugged. The employee plugged it back in and when he returned to pick it up, the grinder lacerated his wrist and forearm.

An employee was removing material from a container when the material shifted, causing his right pinky fingertip to be caught between the material and the wall of the container. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right pinky fingertip.

An employee was on a 32 ft. scaffold. He stepped on a walk board and the walk board slipped, causing him to fall approximately 28 feet to the ground. He was hospitalized with a hairline fracture to vertebrae.

An employee was on the second rung of an A-frame stepladder when the ladder collapsed. The employee fell to the ground, landing chest-first on the top of the ladder and suffering broken ribs and a possible collapsed lung.

An employee was inside a building on a 6-foot stepladder, using a chain come-along to draw the building together at the top so a bolt could be installed to hold it together. The chain released, swung back, and struck the employee's head, knocking him off the ladder. He suffered a skull fracture.

An employee was working in the finished crating area, using a nail gun to build a wooden crate in order to ship finished product. The nail gun activated, discharging a nail into his calf that had to be removed surgically.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot, fell, and suffered a dislocated right hip.

An employee was lifting and moving a 22-ton mold using a 50-ton overhead crane. The crane moved and the employee was caught between the suspended mold and another, stationary mold behind him. He suffered lacerations to the liver and spleen, a broken rib on the right side, and a collapsed right lung.
An employee was cutting a billet with a horizontal bandsaw. As the employee closed the vise, his finger was pinched between the vise and the billet. He suffered a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating a welding machine when an air-powered clamp block pinched the employee's fingers between the stationary and the moving clamp pieces, resulting in amputation of two fingertips on the left hand.
An employee was walking from his truck to the customer's house when they slipped and fell on gravel, striking and fracturing his left hip on the concrete apron.

An employee was standing in front of a heater, watching a casing being floated into a hole to seal it. A ball valve failed and burst apart, fracturing the employee's cheekbone and lacerating his cheek.
At 10:00 a.m. on February 24, 2021, an employee fell while stepping off a 14-inch-high platform, landing on the concrete floor and suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell through an unstable fiberglass skylight and suffered a back injury.
An employee was setting up a new press brake when his finger was caught between the press brake and a part. The tip of the employee's finger was amputated.

On February 24, 2021, at approximately 10:30 a.m., an employee was climbing down a fixed ladder attached to a 40-foot long bulk tanker trailer while carrying a steel five-gallon bucket approximately half full of asphalt material. Due to the bucket's weight, the employee dropped the bucket onto the ground while stepping down onto the fourth ladder rung. While releasing the bucket, the employee lost his balance and fell approximately 4.5 feet to the crushed rock grade, resulting in a shattered left femur and hip socket. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was driving an aerial lift onto a trailer while at an auction yard when the trailer moved, catapulting him from the aerial lift and onto the trailer. The employee suffered a broken right femur, a broken hip, and head trauma.
An employee fell from the leading edge of a 15-foot-high roof to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs.

On February 24, 2021, an employee was helping install a 250-pound metal pallet on a precast concrete form. The pallet became bound on the inner core of the form while an overhead crane was lowering it into place. The employee began moving dunnage below while the crane held the pallet about 12 inches above the ground. The pallet fell onto the employee's right ring and middle fingers, catching them against the dunnage and causing partial amputations to both fingers.

An employee had been grounding copper wire to the ground grid and was helping move cable jack reel stands out of the way. As the employee was tipping a reel stand onto its side, the adjustable roller head slid down and pinched the employee's right middle finger against the top of the stand. The fingertip was medically amputated about 1/4 inch from the end.
An employee was spreading de-icing agent on a driveway when they slipped and fell on ice. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the right knee.
An employee was exiting a restroom when the door caught her left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was pulling a scrap cart out of a machine. The employee fell backwards to the floor, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was moving residents from beds to wheel chairs and changing bedding. The employee had a heart attack.

An employee was loosening a bolt with a wrench. The wrench slipped off the bolt and a piece of metal lacerated the employee's wrist. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery to repair an artery.
An employee was removing a truck-mounted hoist from a service vehicle in order to install it on another vehicle. The hoist fell and landed on his thumb, amputating the tip.

On February 25, 2021, an employee was using a shear to cut metal coils when the tape which holds the metal coils in place came off. This caused a coil to spring up, hitting the employee in the right eye. The employee was hospitalized with a cut to his right iris' tissue.

On February 25, 2021, an employee was working on a 5 ft. scaffold applying a drywall finishing compound to the wall. The employee lost his balance and fell off the scaffold, resulting in a laceration and tissue damage to the right upper arm.
An employee was performing maintenance on a mixer machine when they suffered the amputation of their left middle fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was operating a forklift when the chain that operated the forks' raising mechanism snapped off the pulley. As the employee adjusted the chain his right hand fingers were caught in the chain resulting in amputation of two fingertips.
An employee was walking out of a surgical site after cleaning it up. The employee tripped on a broken bar on the laundry cart and fell to the floor, suffering a hip injury.

The injured employee and a co-worker were carrying a window through the yard to store it in the garage. The injured employee slipped on snow/ice and landed on the right side of his body. He was later hospitalized with a broken rib and a collapsed lung.
An employee was sawing wood block strips with a table saw and sustained a severe laceration across the top of the left arm.
An employee was using a table saw to cut molding pieces and amputated their right index finger. The guard was raised at the time.

An employee was tightening the on/off tool onto the sucker rod at a well site when their fingers were crushed between the rod table hole and the rod. The employee sustained a right ring fingertip amputation and a deep laceration to the right middle finger.

An employee was inside a mechanical room undergoing renovation. He went to open the exterior loading doors to provide light.
