A temporary employee was on a pallet jack turning around when the pallet jack hit a large tote, causing the employee to fall off onto the ground and fracture their right ankle.
A moving powered industrial truck struck an employee, breaking the employee's left foot.
An employee was filling a container with sodium hydroxide when the sodium hydroxide splashed out of the container onto the employee, resulting in chemical burns.
An employee was on a ladder, replacing rollers on a conveyor belt. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground 8-10 feet below and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was cutting wood with a table saw and suffered a partial thumb amputation.
An employee was assisting with bringing drywall up to the second floor when they fell off a ladder to the concrete floor, resulting in a neck injury.
An employee was picking up a paper towel from the floor near a two-phase electrical heater. Loose wiring on the heater and stand shocked the employee's left ring and index fingers.
An employee was placing hinges on a fixture. A blade activated and came down while her right hand was on a hinge, amputating three of her fingers.
An employee was performing maintenance on a pneumatic lathe when he sustained an amputation to the ends of three fingers.

An employee was moving a steel coil that was 4.5" in width and weighed 1,340 lbs. from where it was being stored to the machine using an overhead crane. As the employee was attempting to roll the steel coil out from where it was stored to attach it to the crane, it started to become off balance and tipped over, landing on the employee's legs. The employee was trapped under the steel coil and sustained a broken tibia and fibula that required surgery.
An employee went to crush a bug with her foot when she fell to the ground, sustaining a fracture to the right ankle.
An employee was repairing/unjamming a pneumatic nail gun. The gun activated and drove a nail into the employee's left index finger; she was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a rebar-bending machine when his left index finger was caught between a bending pin and a piece of rebar. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was pulling a strap to unload a delivery when the strap suddenly gave way and the employee fell to the same level, sustaining a fractured left femur.
An employee was descending stairs, slipped, and fell approximately four feet, sustaining a compound fracture of the left arm.
On February 25, 2021, an employee was unloading product from a delivery truck when he fell about 4.5 feet to the ground below, fracturing his hip.

An employee was installing a railroad bumping post. As he loosened a nut on a bolt so the bolt could be re-seated, the bumping post collapsed and his right leg was pinned between two pieces of it. He suffered fractures to the tibia and fibula.

An employee was emptying cardboard from a baler. As he was opening the baler door, he noticed it was stuck on the top gate. He lifted on the top gate to free the bottom door and the door swung open, smashing his right-hand fingers against the door latch. His right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was standing on the back of a truck crane loading material into a dumper using a hand handled remote control. The employee fell from the flatbed of the truck crane onto the ground resulting in multiple fractures to their ribs, vertebrae and head.
An employee was plastering an apartment from a baker scaffold. The employee fell about 5.5 feet from the scaffold.
An employee was refilling a kettle used to lay asphalt when hot asphalt spilled on his right arm and forearm, resulting in burns that required hospitalization.
On February 25, 2021, an employee was struck by a reversing forklift. The employee sustained crushing injuries to the left foot and toes and a fracture to the lower left leg.
An employee was cutting down a tree near a river's edge when the tree snapped back and struck the employee. The employee sustained a broken left leg and a lower back injury.
An employee was on a ladder changing an air filter when they lost balance and fell to the floor, breaking two ribs.
An employee was testing a cable assembly that had just been molded. Live cables shocked his left hand, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was on a pallet jack, unloading pallets on a semi trailer. The employee's hand was trapped between the pallet jack's steering handle and the trailer door, causing finger fractures.

A team member was pushing an empty pallet by hand, sliding it across the floor in order to stack it at the end of the shelving. The pallet struck a joint in the floor, causing the team member to fall and break their left femur.
An employee was cutting a catalytic converter with a torch. A spark from the torch set the employee's clothing on fire. The employee suffered a second-degree burn to the right side of the body.

On February 26, 2021, a co-worker was handing over a costume for repair as an employee was sitting down. The employee missed the chair and struck her elbow on the ground, resulting in a fractured arm that required hospitalization.

On February 26, 2021, an employee was walking from the mill to the maintenance shop when a dislodged log fell from the re-edge deck onto the employee's foot. The employee sustained a crush injury to their left foot, resulting in two fractures.

An employee was retrieving a hose from the opposite end of a moving conveyor when the sleeve of her jacket was caught by the conveyor, pulling the employee's arm in and resulting in an amputation of the right arm below the shoulder.
An employee was operating a batch mixer when it caught his left index finger. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
On February 26, 2021, an employee was hospitalized with pelvis and arm fractures after being struck by a vehicle in the company's parking lot.
An employee was offloading cargo at the airport and was struck by a forklift, resulting in a broken tibia/fibula and lacerations to the thigh and foot/ankle.
An employee was vaccinating poultry at a farm. A bird suddenly jumped, causing the employee to be injected with a poultry vaccine.
An employee fell while stepping up on a conveyor crossover, landing with his hands on the conveyor crossover. The employee sustained a broken femur.
An employee slipped and fell on ice in the parking lot, resulting in a fractured lower extremity on his right side.
On February 26, 2021, an employee was trimming branches using a chainsaw. The chainsaw kicked back and its blade lacerated his left little finger. He was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering groceries at the loading dock when he tripped over a dock plate and fell onto the concrete loading dock floor. The employee suffered a dislocated shoulder and fractured facial bones.
An employee was unjamming a conveyor belt when his finger was caught in the conveyor's chain drive, resulting in an amputation of the left ring fingertip.
An employee was walking into the workplace and slipped and fell on ice, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was trying to remove jammed packing plastic from a machine. The machine's cutting knives activated and amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee was moving tiles out of a crate. The tiles shifted and crushed his fingers, causing an amputation to the top of the ring finger and a laceration on the right middle finger.
An employee was exiting a vehicle to determine why a tool had gotten stuck in a pipeline. The pipeline ruptured. Flying debris struck the employee's left leg, breaking the femur.
An employee was closing the rear door of a trailer when he slipped and the door came down onto his arm, resulting in a broken wrist/forearm.
An employee was pushing meat products down into an extrusion tunnel. The blades in the tunnel crushed and lacerated his index and middle fingers.
An employee had been moving a scrap bin. The employee was struck by a forklift, which ran over the employee's lower leg and broke it.

An employee was operating a stand-up skid steer pulling a grounded tree with an attached rope and pulley. Another employee was assisting by pulling on the attached rope when his right ring and pinky finger slid into the pulley sheave area between the rope and the pulley, resulting in a degloving injury.

An employee was cooking food in a deep fryer. As the employee took the basket out of the fryer, he bumped a pan of hot grease that was sitting on the side of another fryer. Hot grease spilled onto the employee, resulting in second-degree burns on the right forearm and hand.
An employee was struck by a stack of corrugated boxes while operating a transfer car. The employee suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, injuring his right hip. A hematoma developed on the hip and he was hospitalized.
On February 26, 2021, a spider hoist weighing 500-700 pounds fell from its mount and landed on an employee's head, resulting in a concussion and traumatic brain injury.

On February 27, 2021, an employee was cleaning the conveyor belt system for a tortilla dough-making machine when their hand was caught between the moving belt and the steel roller resulting in fractures to the employee's left arm and hand.
An employee was assisting a customer and tripped over a box and fell onto a stock cart, hitting her head on the corner of the cart. The employee sustained a laceration to the top of the head.

On February 27, 2021, an employee was using a three-step stool to reach a medication in the pharmacy. When coming down, she missed a step and fell backward, resulting in a back L2 compression fracture that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning up spilled material on the floor using hot water from a hose. The hot water went into the employee's boot, resulting in 3rd-degree burns to the top of the employee's left foot.
Employees were preparing a unit for turn-around and chemical cleaning. There was a release of un-hydrotreated naphtha that resulted in a fire. Six employees sustained burns and were hospitalized.
An employee tripped while stepping over a stanchion, fell forward, and suffered a broken left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell while walking to a building, landing on the ground and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was caught between a loading dock and the back of a trailer when the trailer backed into him resulting in crushing injuries to his chest.

An employee was utilizing a crane to stack steel when the chain hit a piece of wood on the stack next to it. The steel being transported fell off the crane striking the employee and causing crushing injuries to their lower right leg.

An employee was moving steel plates with a forklift. The straps holding the plates came loose, causing the forklift to fall over. The employee suffered a broken hip and a head laceration and was hospitalized.
On February 27, 2021, an employee was walking toward a truck when she tripped and her right arm struck an exterior wall of a building. Her arm was broken and she was hospitalized.
An employee was at a dairy holding pen next to a push gate. The push gate stopped, then started up again as she was investigating why it had stopped. Her fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working from a 5-foot platform when a support pin came out, causing the platform to collapse. The employee fell to the ground and the platform fell onto him. He suffered a broken pelvis.
An employee was delivering mail when they slipped and fell on snow. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was exiting a room when she fell and landed on her knee, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization and subsequent surgery.

An employee reached into equipment to remove a piece of chicken debris as part of the sanitation process. When the employee reached into the equipment, the water pressure activated and caused the employee to strike their hand against the machine, resulting in a laceration to their middle and ring fingers that required stitches. The equipment was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
Two employees were moving an extension ladder to another part of a house. The ladder contacted an overhead power line and the employees sustained electrical shock.
An employee was signaling a crane operator to hoist a form. As the crane lifted the load, the spreader bar chain pinched the employee's left middle finger. The finger was amputated.

On February 27, 2021, an employee was using a plasma cutter to cut open a transformer tank that had been previously drained and vented, resulting in an explosion. The employee suffered bruising and a laceration on their right palm.
An employee fell to the ground while moving a pallet. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to their left wrist and hip.
An employee was adjusting a blade in a printing unit. Two or three fingers on his right hand were crushed between the printing cylinder and the impression cylinder.
An employee was oiling a chain and used a towel to remove excess oil when the towel was caught by the machine, resulting in a partial amputation of the right index finger.
An employee slipped on a floor and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was operating a snow mobile on a groomed trail when they struck a tree, resulting in a fractured nose and femur.

An employee was performing an inspection of a mechanical power press when he bent down to pick up a dropped tool. While standing up, the employee's hand came into contact with the machine's core rod, which moved and crushed his left index finger. The employee sustained an injury that required surgery and a subsequent partial amputation.
An employee missed a step while climbing down from a tanker truck and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right elbow.
An employee was unloading a truck when he slipped inside the trailer and fell, resulting in head and spine injuries.
An employee was performing cleaning operations in a pyrotechnic loading machine. A flash burned her right hand and the inside of her forearm.
An employee was standing on the tailgate of a truck when he fell backward and hit his head on concrete, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was unloading a truck. The employee slipped while inside the trailer and suffered a broken wrist.
An employee was standing in a 47-inch-deep ditch when dirt fell, pinning the employee's lower leg against a pipe. The employee's lower left leg was broken.

An employee was hooking up a second bar joist to some rigging when the top bar-joist came loose and struck the employee, resulting in a lower right leg fracture, a cranial laceration, fractured ribs, and a C-2 fracture.
An employee was pushing empty totes to a storage area. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was waiting for a boom operator to finish setting a cube of 90 concrete blocks measuring 8x8x16 inches onto another cube. The cube bumped into another cube that was already on the ground, causing some of the blocks to fall off the cube and strike the employee's right hand, resulting in broken index and middle fingers.

On March 1, 2021, an employee slipped and fell on a patch of ice in the parking lot while on their way to the maintenance shop. The employee suffered two fractures in their left leg: below the knee and above the ankle.
A postal carrier was delivering mail when she tripped and fell on the sidewalk, landing on her hand. The employee suffered shattered bones in her hand, which required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was retrieving die cuts from between two pallets when their foot became caught on one of the pallets, causing the employee to lose their balance and fall to a concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured right hip.

An employee was working from a step ladder, trying to place a piece of scrap into a basket on a rack system. There was not sufficient clearance to put the pipe in, so the employee pulled the basket out. The basket fell against the ladder and tipped it; the employee fell about 6 feet to the floor below, and the basket landed on his foot. He suffered a broken foot, leg, and hip.
An employee was using a compressed air blower to clean up accumulated dust and was exposed to airborne contaminants at the facility. The employee experienced shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
On March 1, 2021, an employee was feeding parts into a milling machine when his right hand and fingers were pulled into the machine, resulting in injuries that required surgery.
An employee slipped and fell onto a roof deck and suffered a possible hernia.
An employee was adjusting one of the beams in a forklift when their left thumb became caught between the two support beams, resulting in bone fractures and a skin laceration.
On March 1, 2021, a roofer was climbing up an extension ladder to access a roof. He fell, landing on the ground 10 feet below. He suffered a head laceration and was hospitalized.

On March 1, 2021, an employee was retrieving a plastic spacer used to separate rows of boxes on a pallet. A floor jack bumped into a nearby stack of pallets, and a pallet struck the employee. The employee suffered fractures to the lower leg and ankle and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was removing the bucket from a tractor when a pin became loose and the bucket rolled onto the employee's ankle, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was operating a lip weld robot. When the robot began to cycle, a shim fell off the lug. As he was retrieving the shim, the robot cycled and pinched his left index finger between the lip plate and the lug. He suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was providing care to a resident who was having a seizure while sitting in a wheel chair. The employee tripped over the wheel chair or the resident's legs and fell, striking the wall with her shoulder and face, and then landing on the floor. The employee was bleeding from the nose and was hospitalized with a fractured right humerus.
An employee was operating a chop saw and amputated his left index and middle fingers to the first knuckles.
An employee tripped and fell while walking on the sidewalk, striking the left side of his face on the sidewalk. The employee suffered a laceration above his left eye that resulted in hospitalization.
An employee was working in a shallow trench preparing to install fiberoptic cable. When he stood up, he hit his head on the bucket of a trackhoe and had a seizure.

An employee was changing grinder blades. The employee had to turn the blades on a belt to remove them. The belt got caught, and a blade cut the employee's left hand between the little finger and ring finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee and a coworker were manually transferring a die set (593 pounds) from a maintenance table to an industrial cart. The cart consists of a stationary platform and a lift platform controlled by a chain and hydraulic cylinder operable by foot pump. After the two employees pulled the die set onto the raised lift platform from the table, the chain over the hydraulic cylinder came free from the threaded rod and nut that serve as an anchor point on the stationary platform, causing the lift platform with die set to fall from table height to the ground. The die set struck the injured employee's leg as it fell, resulting in lacerations and fractures to the shin and ankle.

An employee was climbing a 6-foot ladder from a 3-foot crawlspace up into the living room level. The ladder moved as he stepped off, causing him to fall to the floor. The employee suffered a dislocated and torn hip socket.

An employee was on a clam boat trying to tie a rope to a disabled oyster boat. A wave hit the clam boat and the employee lost his balance and fell. His right hand and thumb were caught and lacerated between the two boats.
On 3/01/2021, an employee was cutting a piece of wood using a table saw when a kickback occurred, resulting in a partial amputation of the left thumb.

An employee was trying to get wheel parts to feed down into a bucket below a storage rack. The bin needed to be reoriented so the parts door would open; a powered industrial truck was brought over to pull out the container and turn it 45 degrees. When the container moved, a finger on the employee's right hand was caught between the bin and the steel rack. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was operating an assembly machine when they tripped over a floor fan and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right hip.

A driver was helping unload product at a customer location. As the customer used a forklift to unload the product, an iron pipe started slipping. The employee was using a tightening rod to push the bar when his left thumb was caught between the pipe and the rod. The thumb was crushed and broken.
An employee fell while walking down stairs, hitting a landing and suffering a broken left hip.

While performing a clean-in-place procedure, an employee removed the nozzle of a hose to place the hose on piping when a valve opened and sprayed her with 185-degree hot, caustic water. The employee suffered burns to both arms, both legs, and her abdomen.

Employees were installing some caps and a torque tube (a long cylindrical metal frame 6 inches in diameter). The tube fell, catching an employee's left little fingertip against a post. The fingertip was amputated.

On March 2, 2021, an employee was washing down around a filter press operation near a horizontal conveyor belt. He slipped on sludge around the filter press. As he tried to catch himself from falling, his right hand landed in an opening on the moving conveyor belt. He suffered a contusion, abrasions, and cuts to his right arm and was hospitalized.

Two employees were hanging an elevator shaft while standing on plywood boards. One board shifted, causing the two employees to fall 31 feet from the third floor to the ground floor. One employee was hospitalized for a lower back fracture and the second employee was hospitalized for a brain bleed.
An employee was attempting to calm a patient when the patient pushed the employee. The employee fell and struck their head on a door jamb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was taking product out of the freezer when she lost her balance and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken femur.
An employee was cutting steaks on the bandsaw when the blade partially amputated a finger.

An employee was using a flip dolly to rotate a rack of glass. The employee used their right hand to operate the flip dolly's wire control box when the dolly rotated downward and pinched their right thumb, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was walking between work stations when they tripped over a spring actuated pallet carousel (pallet riser) and fell to the floor, resulting in hospitalization due to a broken and dislocated left shoulder and a possible clavicle fracture.
An employee was on a step ladder adjusting a security camera and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a head injury.
An employee was using a table saw when they contacted the saw blade, resulting in a severe laceration.
An employee was assisting in the rotation of a boat hull mold when his left ring finger was caught between the mold and the frame used to hold the mold, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was adjusting the forks on a forklift when the carriage assembly slid off and landed on top of his left foot, resulting in an injury.

An employee and a coworker were lifting a stone so that it could be hooked to and lifted by a forklift. The coworker used hand-operated suction cups to lift the stone while the employee used their hands. A suction cup came loose and the stone dropped and smashed the employee's left hand, resulting in the amputation of his left index fingertip.
An employee fell from an A-frame ladder to the ground, suffering leg and hip fractures.
An employee was unjamming the inline grinder when his shirt sleeve got caught in the machine.  The chain rubbed against his arm, causing a deep laceration to the right forearm.
An employee was attempting to connect carts to a tugger when their right ring finger became caught between the handle of one cart and the rack of another cart, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was using a rag to apply grease to a gear sprocket and chain on a barrel tumbler. The rag and his glove were pulled into the sprocket and chain, resulting in two finger amputations. The machine was running at the time of the incident.
An employee was working on a forklift fuel system when the fuel ignited. The employee suffered second degree burns to the ear, cheek, and lips.
An employee was bending metal in a 50-ton press brake. His finger was caught in a pinch point resulting in amputation of two fingertips and the loss of two fingernails.
An employee was cleaning a squeeze roller when their finger got caught between the rollers. The employee suffered a degloving injury that resulting in an amputation.
An employee was attaching a 90-degree elbow to the back of a vacuum truck when they were caught between the 90-degree elbow and a roll-off box, resulting in abdominal injuries.

An employee had attached a crane sling to an 8-inch pipe, and the crane was holding the pipe with minimal tension while bolts were removed from its lower flange. The pipe came loose and knocked the employee off the trailer to the ground 6 feet below. The back of the employee's head struck the trailer after the fall, causing a head injury.
An employee was walking along a platform when a drill bit, being used nearby, broke and sent a steel shard into the employee's left eye. The employee suffered a cut retina.

A technician was prying a reach assembly on a reach truck with a pry bar, trying to extend the reach assembly. The pry bar slipped and the reach assembly closed back on the employee's right hand breaking it.

An employee was working from a 6 ft. stepladder removing wiring from a suspended ceiling. The employee fell from the third rung of the ladder, approximately 3 feet, to the tile floor, resulting in 3 broken ribs and a hip fracture.
An employee was utilizing a railroad jack handle when the jack handle swung up and hit his face, resulting in a skull fracture and a broken nose.
On March 3, 2021, an employee was pulling a wooden flatbed cart. The cart caught the employee's right foot and lacerated the Achilles tendon.
Two employees were shoveling gravel in a trench when a shovel slipped from the gravel and contacted an employee's left pinky finger, resulting in amputation.

An employee was making repairs to a 480-volt generator. A cable came in contact with a lug on the load side of the transfer switch, causing an arc flash that burned the employee's hands, left arm, and neck.

An employee was doing roofing work on the edge of a one-story residence. The employee fell 9 feet, hit a tree branch, and then landed on the grass. The employee was hospitalized for neck and face fractures.
An employee was walking to her car after her shift and was knocked down by a gust of wind. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured leg.
A partly filled bucked of hot asphalt was dropped on an employee's arm. The employee suffered burns to the left arm and left ear.

An employee was feeding veneer into the dryer when the veneer became jammed. The employee's right arm was caught in the chain and sprocket while unjamming the veneer, resulting in amputation of the employee's right arm up to the elbow.
An employee was performing routine maintenance on a cold roll steel line when their right ring finger was caught by the machine's guard mechanism resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.

On March 3, 2021, an employee was feeding linen inside an ironer equipped with eight heating rollers, including belts. The employee was feeding the machine when a piece of linen got spooled around the machine, catching the employee's arm within the feed belts. The employee's arm curled around the belt, putting pressure onto the arm as the employee attempted to tug his arm out. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was collecting mail in the plant using a tow tractor when they lost control and fell from the vehicle. The employee's left ankle and foot were caught between the tractor and a guardrail in the facility resulting in a fractured ankle.

An employee was lifting a hydraulic cylinder off the shelf, tripped on nylon webbing, and fell to the ground while holding the hydraulic cylinder. The cylinder smashed his left hand and partially amputated his left thumb.

On March 3, 2021, an employee was feeding rubber into an extruding machine when their right hand was pulled into the machine, resulting in a crushing injury to the right index finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was attending to a client in a facility. A tenant at the facility struck the employee on the head, face, and body, causing contusions and bruising to the head and the body.
An employee was walking around the site when they stepped into a divot in the ground and broke their leg.

An employee was helping push a landing joint onto a catwalk trough at the v-door on a rig floor. The employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught between the locking ring and landing joint. The employee suffered a fracture to the middle fingertip and an amputation to the ring fingertip at the nail.
An employee was splashed by hot asphalt while unloading a truck. The employee suffered burns to the back and both arms.
While flagging traffic, an employee was struck by a falling utility pole. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was cleaning a compression machine when their left index finger was caught in a pinch point, resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was working on an extension ladder when the ladder slid out from under him, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet to the floor. The employee sustained fractures to the right leg.
An employee fell off a garbage truck to the ground, breaking his left wrist. He was hospitalized.

An employee was straightening a hand line (rope used to move material) with an attached pulley that was stretched between the bucket truck and the skid steer. The rope snapped under pressure, striking the employee and causing a fracture to the left hand and lacerations on the right hand.

An employee was working inside a paint line washer. The employee was walking on a walkway when he slipped and his left leg fell into a wash tank containing 160-degree water. He suffered a third-degree burn from the knee down and was hospitalized, requiring skin graft surgery.

On March 3, 2021, an employee was re-spooling a wire on a spooler. While the reel was on its side, the wire got tangled. His right thumb was caught and lacerated in the tangled wire. He was hospitalized.

An employee had been setting up braces for piers on a three-foot foundation. His foot slipped off the edge of the pier, causing him to lose balance. He fell backward to the ground, landing on his back and his head struck a hard clump of dirt. The employee was hospitalized with seizures.
On March 3, 2021, an employee tripped over dialysis cords and fell to the floor, resulting in head, face, and left knee injuries.

An employee was using denatured alcohol to remove glue from a vehicle. The employee lit a small amount of the alcohol on fire, which ignited the vapor from the alcohol bottle and caused the bottle to explode. The employee sustained second and third degree burns on his upper left torso.

An employee was removing a track bolt on a crane using a pry bar and a wrench. As he loosened the wrench, the pry bar slipped, causing the chain to fall and pinch the employee's left thumb between the chain and the bolt. The employee sustained an amputation to the left thumb tip.
On March 4, 2021, employees were carrying a roof truss when one of them tripped over lumber and fell to the ground. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was emptying a rail car. The car's door closed on his left hand, amputating the ring finger at the second knuckle.
Employees were standing two walls and were connecting them when one of the walls came loose and landed on an employee, resulting in a bruised leg and hip.
An employee slipped on a wet, recently mopped floor and fell, suffering a broken femur and wrist.

An employee was on an A-frame ladder fixing an electrical wire on an HVAC unit in a ceiling. The employee was holding onto the unit with their left hand when the employee was shocked with 480V of electricity. The employee let go of the unit and fell 6 feet from the ladder. In the midst of falling, the employee hit their head on a metal work station. The employee was hospitalized for two skull fractures, burns to three fingers on their left hand and one finger on their right hand, and unspecified right arm pain.
A truck driver fell from his truck and sustained fractured ribs, thumb, back, and face, along with a brain bleed.

An employee was repairing a clamp whose pin had become compromised and attempting to clean a sensor. The clamp closed into the material, pinching the employee's right index finger and causing an amputation to the fingertip.
A recycling-sorting employee was removing debris from a conveyor belt and fell at least 4 feet from the conveyor belt to the ground, resulting in a leg injury.
An employee was moving steel beams with an overhead crane. The beams shifted and pinned the employee's legs, breaking both of them.
An employee was putting a chain on the roll-down curtain door when the door's socket caught the employee's fingers, resulting in an amputation of the right index and middle fingers.
An employee was using a dolly converter while unhooking a set of double trailers when he was struck in the chest by the dolly converter. The employee sustained fractures to the sternum and ribs.

An employee was training a new employee on a thermoforming machine. As the employee was disposing of a roll of plastic scrap, the tail end of the roll struck the employee in the left eye, resulting in a ruptured globe and a traumatic cataract to the left eye.
An employee was trying to push a trailer hitch onto a trailer ball when his left middle finger was crushed between the hitch and the ball.

Two employees were working on a threaded rod. The first employee was checking one end while the second was turning the other end with a rachet when the bolt broke, causing the pulley to move and crush the first employee's left index finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a lathe when his glove was caught and pulled into the machine. The employee sustained a fractured arm.
An employee was wiping the tension roller on a 6-inch slitter with a rag. The rag and the employee's right hand were pulled into the roller; the employee's fingers were crushed and degloved.
An employee was unclogging an auger and sustained the amputation of his left index fingertip.
A table saw lacerated four fingertips on an employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell off an off-road vehicle and was hospitalized.

An employee was on an 8-foot ladder, removing fuel tank panels using an air impact screw buster. He lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a fracture to the ribcage, a forearm laceration, and a back injury.
An employee was counting received product when they suffered an allergic reaction that required hospitalization.
An employee fell over the bolt that held down a barrier. The employee suffered a broken wrist.
An employee rested his hand on the inside of a garbage truck hopper as he operated the packer panel. His hand was caught between the packer panel and the truck, resulting in a fractured left hand.
An employee had been on the ground trimming tree branches with a pole chainsaw. The employee was found lying on the ground unconscious and was hospitalized for a concussion.

Two employees were lowering a car on an automotive lift by manually engaging an unguarded latch. The latch snapped back and pinched one of the employee's left hand against the lift post resulting in a partial amputation of the index and middle fingertips.
An employee was using a nonpowered pallet jack and pinned his right leg between the pallet and the racking, resulting in a fracture to the right tibia.

An employee was moving a small container to a staging area with a forklift. The employee lowered the container to the ground, but one of the forklift's forks jammed in the wheels of the container. The employee exited the lift and got the container to release. The pressure on the forks released and the left blade fell, landing onto the employee's big toe less than 2 feet below and cutting it. The employee was hospitalized. The toenail was removed.

An employee was taking lab waste to a special waste dumpster. The employee fell through grating adjacent to the special waste dumpster approximately 4 feet to the concrete floor and sustained broken bones in both feet.
An employee broke his leg while attempting to jump onto a truck.

At about 4:30 p.m. on March 5, 2021, a U.S. Postal Service employee was stepping out of her postal vehicle in a residential driveway. She lost her footing and fell to the driveway, with her feet moving in opposite directions away from her center of gravity, and broke her right ankle and tibia. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was climbing up a ladder and fell from the fourth step to the ground, resulting in hospitalization for a sore back.
An employee was moving logistic bars in a trailer. A forklift moved and struck his leg, breaking it.

An employee was doing maintenance work on a pump. The employee was sprayed in the face with pressurized hydraulic fluid, which lacerated the employee's right eye. The employee was hospitalized and underwent debridement of the eye.

On March 5, 2021, an employee was engaged in the task of adding backstops to the highest shelf of a storage racking system in the pre-blend department. The employee used an extension ladder to access the highest shelf. The employee attempted to step from the ladder onto the shelf when the bottom of the ladder slid out due to a slippery floor. The employee fell  approximately 20 feet to the concrete floor and suffered fractured vertebrae. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was bailing cardboard and started feeling ill. The employee was hospitalized for a heart attack.
While loading a box truck, an employee stepped backward and fell 3-4 feet from the truck to the ground. The employee sustained broken ribs.

A longshoring employee was removing strapping from a bundle of lumber at pierside. The employee's leg was entangled in the rigging sling a forklift had used to move the bundle of lumber. The employee suffered leg and ankle injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was taking a step up onto a lettuce bagging machine platform when their right foot slipped, causing the left foot to contact the floor. The employee suffered a foot/ankle fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a forklift while walking on an airport ramp. Both of the employee's legs were amputated.
An employee was opening a door on a roll-off container using the chain. The chain broke and the employee slipped and fell to the ground below, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was working on top of a powered scaffold, adjusting the rigging for a transformer coil assembly. He fell between the unit and the scaffold platform to the floor 11 feet, 10 inches below. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the palletizer platform stairs, slipped on the last stair, and fell. The employee sustained a broken left arm.

An employee was tightening a bolt holding a pulley. The bolt snapped, releasing the pulley and the cable. The cable snapped and caught the employee's fingers against a guard, causing the amputation of the left index finger at the last joint and a laceration and fracture of the left middle finger.
An employee was walking through the shop and was pinned between a car and a van on the lift. The employee sustained a broken ankle and fractures on both sides of the pelvis.
An employee was servicing and cleaning a section of a conveyor belt. As he was closing the conveyor section, it landed on his left hand and amputating the tip of the little finger.
An employee was MIG welding a repair on a bracket. Her shirt caught fire, causing second-degree burns to her stomach, chest, and neck.

An employee was using a posthole digger to clear dirt away from a propane vaporizer when the line disconnected, sending liquid propane into the air. The employee sustained propane burns to the nasal cavity, face, and head.
An employee was arranging chicken product in a walk-in meat cooler. He slipped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting welds loose on a steel assembly. The assembly broke loose and struck the employee, resulting in a fractured sternum, fractured collarbone, two fractured ribs, a bruised lung, and a fractured toe.

An employee was on a catwalk, cleaning the shower on a paper machine. As he was using a wrench to rotate the shower shaft with his right hand, the indicator came around and caught the tip of his left index finger, causing a partial amputation to the finger pad.
An employee reached to grab rubber in a conveyor belt and their arm was caught in the belt, resulting in a fractured forearm and a right index finger injury.
An employee was standing next to staged formwork, about 3-4 feet high. The formwork shifted and fell on the employee's lower left leg, fracturing the ankle.

An employee was hanging up a mop in a kitchen. The kitchen door opened as another employee walked through, and the employee's left little finger was caught between the door and the door jamb. The finger was broken and the fingertip was amputated.
At about 12:45 p.m. on March 6, 2021, a U.S. Postal Service mail carrier was delivering mail when a dog jumped a fence and bit his left hand.

An employee was operating a motorized walk-behind wire wheel brush inside a road work barricade. A car from live traffic entered the area and hit the employee, breaking the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was vacuuming the floor and tripped over the hose and fell to the floor, possibly breaking her hip.

SPN Well Services employees were inspecting gas production unit chokes for sand washing. They had inspected three units and were bleeding off pressure on a fourth when a flash fire engulfed it in flames. One of the employees suffered first-, second-, and third-degree burns.
An employee was cleaning a grill with a towel. The towel caught fire and burned his hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of his truck when the truck door closed on his finger, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was cutting meat with a knife when the knife slipped, resulting in a stab wound to the employee's abdomen that included a severed artery. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was riding on the end platform of a tank railcar. As the railcar came to a stop, the employee fell off the platform to the ground. The railcar wheels ran over his forearm as he fell. The forearm was medically amputated.

An employee was screwing in drywall while standing on approximately the middle rung of a 6-foot A-frame ladder. The employee leaned out to the left to reach his work when the ladder tipped over sideways. He grabbed a metal stud with his left hand in an attempt to stop his fall and his foot got caught in the ladder during the fall. He sustained lacerations from the metal stud and a fractured hip caused by contact with the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing metal curb on a roof and fell through a roof opening, resulting in multiple broken bones.
An employee was conducting work on second story balcony when they leaned on a guard rail and it fell off. The employee fell approximately 12 feet to the concrete below and sustained broken ribs.
An employee was performing vigorous activities at work. He became dizzy and began vomiting. He was hospitalized, suffering from low electrolyte levels.

An employee was operating a valve seater machine on an aerosol production line when the machine malfunctioned. While unjamming the machine, the employee's hand was caught on a belt which pulled her fingers into the machine and amputated her index finger below the first knuckle.

On March 8, 2021, an employee was reinstalling a belt in a machine. The machine was activated, and the employee's right hand was caught in a pulley. The machine struck and injured four of the employee's fingers.
A mail carrier tripped over a curb and fell on pavement, resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee was walking in a warehouse under a low beam. The employee's head grazed the beam, causing the employee to lose balance and fall to the floor. The employee sustained an injury to their right knee.
An employee was operating a shipping shuttle system. The shuttle malfunctioned, and she tried to unjam it; when it broke free, her ankle was pinched and broken between the shuttle and a rack support.
An employee tripped on merchandise on the floor and fell, injuring her right shoulder.
An employee had arrived at a client's home to provide home health aid. The employee fell after leaving their car and suffered an injury that required stitches.

An employee was taking a transfer unit off a telephone pole when the pole's base snapped, causing the employee to slide down the pole and fall to the ground. The employee suffered a broken femur that required surgery.

An employee was operating an order picker in the receiving area. She stopped and dismounted in order to retrieve an appliance when the order picker moved backward, pinning her against a beam connecting two aisles of racking. The employee sustained a rib injury.
An employee was near the edge of a road. Two vehicles collided and one of the vehicles hit the employee, causing a laceration to the left elbow and a fracture to the right fibula.
An employee was on the fifth step of an A-frame ladder, installing J-hooks. He fell and suffered a head injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee was connecting two steel beams when his right ring finger was caught between the beams, resulting in surgical amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was cleaning an animal enclosure when the Komodo dragon bit the employee on the leg.
A carpenter was ripping 1-by-4 material to the required size with a table saw. The sawblade severed his right index finger just below the second knuckle. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee was stressing post-tension cables using a hydraulic ram. As the ram was retracting, the employee's hand slipped and the ram pinched the tip of their left ring finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was working in a clean-in-place room. A circuit was removed that was running a three-step wash on a ketchup deck bulk line, causing hot water and caustic chemicals to escape out of the line and spray the employee. The employee was burned.

Two employees were unloading and loading propane cylinders. A leaking propane tank was placed in front of a makeshift structure. Propane gas accumulated within the structure and an explosion occurred. Both employees suffered second and third degree burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was helping a patient get out of bed when the patient fell on top of him. The employee sustained a back injury.
An employee was using a chop saw in the flooring department and amputated their left index and middle fingers.
An employee was cleaning a blend tank when the pump to the machinery caught his right index finger, amputating the tip.

An employee was operating a bulldozer on a road when it slid on ice, then rolled a full 360  down an embankment and came to rest with its tracks wedged in rocks. The employee was found outside of the vehicle with a gash on his head and was hospitalized.
A butcher slipped and fell in the meat cutting room, resulting in a skull fracture.

An employee was coming around the corner of an aisle carrying multiple packages. The scanner on his finger struck the end of the aisle, and while he was catching the packages he lost his balance and fell. He landed on his left side and suffered a broken hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a heat sealer machine. The machine's sealing mechanism caught his left index finger and partially amputated the upper portion.
An employee fell while walking through a parking lot, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was clearing a cotton jam in a card machine. The machine started and caught the employee's hand, causing severe damage up to his wrist. The hand was amputated.

An employee reached into the passenger window of a customer's car in order to collect money for gasoline. The customer drove off, dragging the employee approximately 20 ft. before the employee was able to free themself from the vehicle.
An employee was installing drainage culverts in a trench bank. The trench bank caved in on the employee, who suffered injuries to the lungs, spleen, and liver. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a machine, removing a material wrap from the nip roller when the employee's left hand was caught in the nip roller, resulting in fractured fingers.

On March 8, 2021, an employee was adjusting the alignment of a hot dog line machine. When he moved a loader so the hot dogs could drop into a square cup, the loader pinched his right ring finger. He suffered an amputation to the finger without bone loss.
An employee was rigging a precast concrete panel to a crane when their left index finger became caught between the wire rope sling and the crane hook, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was performing maintenance on a pump when his finger was caught in the rotating pump, resulting in amputation of the distal phalanx of his right index finger.
On March 8, 2021, an employee was standing on the right rear step of a waste disposal truck when the truck's sweeping blade activated and hit his left leg, breaking it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was clearing a jam from a rotary airlock when the airlock caught the employee's fingers. The employee suffered amputations (above the second knuckle) to the right middle and ring fingers.
Two employees were moving a pallet when an unassembled entertainment center fell from the pallet and crushed one employee's right thumb. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
The hose for a grease gun ruptured, causing an artery obstruction in an employee's hand. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was emptying a wheeled cart with trash into a dumpster. The cart began to fall into the dumpster, pinching the employee's finger between edge of the cart and the dumpster and resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.
A patient care technician's feet were tangled in a stool. The technician fell to the floor, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized.

At 1:27 p.m. on March 9, 2021, two employees were troubleshooting a welder that would not start. An explosion occurred on the welder that blew out the side of the gas tank. One of the employees suffered burns to the body and was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting and delivering packages. The employee felt chest pain and was hospitalized with a collapsed lung.
An employee was riding on a motorized pallet jack. The pallet jack hit him, causing a fracture and a skin tear in his leg. He was hospitalized.
A blade cover was being removed when it fell down onto an employee's left ring finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was clearing a package jam when the tip of his little finger was caught between a belt and a transition plate. The finger was lacerated and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was strapping a load on a flatbed truck in a parking lot. Another truck ran over his right foot as it left the parking lot. He suffered a crushing injury, a contusion, a broken second toe, and a dislocation of the first toe.
An employee was using a drill when the drill chuck released from the drill, hitting the employee in the face and resulting in a broken jaw.

An employee was connecting an auger to a drill. The employee's right ring finger was caught in the pinch point between the auger and the hook on the service winch for the drill, causing a laceration to the finger and a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder repairing a light fixture. The fixture shorted, and he suffered an electrical shock and burns to both hands.

A crew was removing an 8-inch rubber hose from inside a 2-foot diameter metal pipe. The hose was being pulled by a loader. The hose became stuck and began to stretch. An employee was performing brick-laying work from a scaffold. As the employee walked on the scaffold, the wood board overturned, causing the employee to fall 20 feet to the ground and sustain contusions to their head, arms and legs.
An employee twisted his left ankle while walking.
An employee slipped and fell in a wet, muddy yard, suffering a broken ankle.
A Customs and Border Patrol agent was riding an ATV on a dirt road. He lost control at a corner and jumped from the ATV, hitting a boulder and suffering a shattered lower-back vertebra.
On March 9, 2021, a CNC machine operator suffered a laceration and fracture to the left hand/arm. The employee's little finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was using a plasma cutter on a steel plate that weighed approximately 1140 lbs. A bolt that was holding the steel plate in position broke, causing the steel plate to fall on top of the employee. The employee sustained fractured L5 and S1 vertebrae and a fractured pelvic bone.

An employee was operating a forklift when the front tire hit a drain. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured back.
An employee was running into the building and fell onto the vinyl floor, sustaining a fractured right femur. It was raining at the time.

An employee was unspooling aluminum from a coil when the coil kicked back, causing a partial amputation of the left middle finger.

Two employees were inspecting a house from an onsite scaffold when a scaffold board broke, causing the employees to fall approximately 7 feet to the ground. One employee suffered a sprained ankle while the second employee fractured their right ankle, requiring surgery and hospitalization.

Two employees were working on a scaffold during an exterior siding inspection. A board broke and the employees fell. One suffered a broken ankle, and the other suffered a sprained ankle and cut to the left hand.
An employee was walking in the shop when he slipped on a plastic corner protector and fell to the floor, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing a tree when he fell 30 feet to the ground. He suffered a broken arm, leg, and pelvis.
An employee was attempting to unclog a machine when the machine cycled and a rotating metal wheel inside the machine cut her right index finger that resulted in an amputation.

On March 10, 2021, an employee was using a 12-foot A-frame ladder to pull insulation panels off a shelf when he lost his balance and fell 6 to 7 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a fracture to his left ankle that required hospitalization.

An employee was working on a roller that belongs to a conveyor when his hand got caught between the conveyor belt and a roller, resulting in a fracture in his lower left arm. The machine was running at the time.

A customer got into a physical altercation with a store manager, hitting them with a hand basket and stabbing them in both arms using a knife. A customer who tried to help the store manager was also stabbed.
An employee was pushing boxes through a tape machine when he suffered a back injury and fell, unable to feel his legs.

A maintenance employee was troubleshooting a conveyor belt system when his glove was caught in the machine pulling his left arm into the moving belt and resulting in a fractured arm and lacerations. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning an industrial mixer when the mixer activated.  The employee's right hand was crushed by the mixing paddle, resulting in surgical amputation of the right hand.
Two employees were operating company vehicles in the yard and collided with each other.
An employee was closing a door when his knee gave out and he fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was operating a forklift and struck a pallet jack resulting in a fractured left leg and hospitalization.

An employee was moving materials on a dumbwaiter. The dumbwaiter shifted downward and the employee was caught between the dumbwaiter and the floor resulting in broken ribs and soft tissue injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was lifting boxes and strained their back.
An employee was putting a conveyor belt back on a sprocket. The conveyor was activated and amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger (without bone loss).
Employees were welding an elevator leg at a mill when the cover of the leg came off, struck an employee, and broke their arm.

An employee was spot welding an area under a boat. The welding equipment ignited vapors in a compartment that surrounded the gasoline fuel tanks and a vapor explosion occurred. The employee suffered a fractured skull, chest wall, ribs, and shoulder.  The employee required hospitalization.

An employee was operating a forklift in a trailer to move product when the forklift wheel caught on the dock plate and became stuck. When the forklift cleared the edge of the plate the employee's leg was pinned between the forklift and the trailer wall, resulting in a broken leg above the ankle.
An employee's arm was caught in the rollers of an adhesive laminator. The employee suffered head and chest contusions.

An employee was running a jointer with gloves on when their right middle finger contacted the  interior portion of the jointer, causing a laceration on the finger that included tissue and bone. The employee was hospitalized and suffered a subsequent amputation between the top and middle joints of their finger.

An employee was preparing to move a steer into the auction pen when a second steer knocked the employee to the ground. The employee sustained fractured neck vertebrae, lacerations to the head, and shoulder contusions.
A temporary employee was preparing to change a filter in a filter housing. When a filter housing was opened, 190-degree water burned his right arm and the right side of his torso.
An employee was operating a wood stacking machine when his glove was caught in the chain and sprocket underneath the guard, resulting in a partial amputation of the right thumb.
An employee was working on a carousel when his left pinky finger became caught in a chain and sprocket, resulting in amputation.
An employee was adjusting an overhead door spring. He struck part of the door spring or bracket and suffered a wrist laceration that required hospitalization for surgery.

An employee had been observing the trolley line. His hand came in contact with a pinch point on the trolley where the carcass changes direction to proceed into the deep chill cooler. The employee sustained a partial amputation of his left ring finger.

An employee was operating an assembly machine and had to adjust a part in the machine. While adjusting the part with his left hand, the machine cycled resulting in a partial amputation to the middle fingertip, without bone loss.
An employee's hand was caught in a machine. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was walking along the side of a ditch in order to take measurements of piping elevation when he tripped and fell into the ditch on his left side, resulting in a fractured left radius.
At about 12:00 p.m. on March 10, 2021, an employee tripped while stepping off the curb outside her office. She fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the guiderails inside a case packer when his left ring finger got caught between the groove and the railing, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was using a manlift to pull products from a shelf. He fell from the manlift to the cement floor about 9 feet below, suffering fractures to the pelvis and shoulder.

An employee was removing an excavator's grapple arm pin with a hammer and a steel bar. The bar struck the employee's jaw, knocking the employee unconscious and causing an injury that required surgery.

An employee was standing next to a closed roll up door. When the door opened, the manual pull-down rope caught the employee's feet, and the employee fell to the ground sustaining broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was picking trash and metal off a conveyor belt when their right arm became trapped in the conveyor belt roller drum, resulting in amputation below the shoulder.
An employee was walking through rooms after connecting lights to make sure the lights were working when he fell on broken tiles that were on the floor, resulting in a broken left hand.
An employee was removing a battery from a lift truck. While pushing the battery out of the truck, the top of the battery injured three fingers on her right hand.
An employee was bending over to pick up a dropped item when a broom handle punctured his right eye.

An employee was replacing a non-functioning fuel sender on a boat. After installing the new part, he was using a small torch to seal the heat shrink connectors when fumes ignited, causing an explosion. The employee suffered burns on the left side of his face, as well as shoulder and rib pain.

A school bus driver fell while stepping out of his bus in a parking lot. He landed on the ground, suffering lacerations to his left thumb and right middle finger; a left leg injury that left the leg unable to support weight; and abrasions to the forehead, right eye, and nose.

An employee was installing wire from a utility pole to a house. He became nauseated and began climbing down, but as he was descending he got dizzy and fell, landing on the ground 14 feet below and suffering a broken heel.
An employee was cleaning a tenderizing machine. The employee's hand was caught in the rotating chain and sprocket, causing an amputation to the middle finger past the second knuckle.

An employee had just exchanged the propane tank on his forklift. After he began driving the forklift, he noticed a propane fuel smell. He stopped the forklift, stepped off, and proceeded to tighten the coupler with his hands, resulting in second degree burns that required hospitalization.

An employee was removing pizza from a conveyor line when their gloved finger became caught between the conveyor belt and a belt roller resulting in a fractured finger, a fingertip amputation, and a nail avulsion.

An employee was in a ski lift loading area. She was holding two bags. One of the bag handles broke, and as she reached down to grab the bag, her left knee twisted and the lift chair hit her buttock. She suffered a fracture to the upper part of the left tibia, at the knee.
An employee's head struck a machine. The employee suffered a head contusion and fracture.

An employee was removing stock off pallets in the stockroom and putting it on carts. After completing the process, the employee was standing upright when he collapsed backward, striking his head on the floor. The employee suffered a ruptured aorta.

An employee was climbing up a fixed ladder to a roof access to look at AC units that would need to be labeled when he lost his grip and fell 15 feet down the ladder, resulting in fractures that required hospitalization.

An employee was using a water hose to fill the water tank in the back of his truck. When he finished filling his truck, he handed the hose to another employee and started walking toward the back door of the office. He tripped over the hose and fell to the ground, breaking his left leg in three places.
An employee was descending from stairs when they slipped and fell, resulting in a head lesion.
An employee was tracing lines in an area to prepare for upcoming work. He tripped over a curb and fell, suffering a broken arm.
An employee was scanning parts on a pull cart near a forklift when they were struck by the forklift as it was backing up, resulting in broken bones in their foot and ankle.

An employee was using a ladder to get inside a manhole to measure a pipe that was being replaced. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground and suffered a compression fracture in their back. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were tightening down bolts on a press punch block. As the last bolt was being tightened down, the wrench slipped and part of the press block fell on the hand of the employee holding up the press block. The employee's left ring finger was pinched between the ratchet tool and a punch that was hanging down, causing an amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was stepping off a curb while walking to their vehicle and fell. Their femur broke and caused their tibia to be pushed out through their ankle.
A furnace technician was severely burned when a steam boiler exploded at a customer's home.
An employee experienced trouble breathing while on their mail delivery route, resulting in hospitalization.

On March 11, 2021, a temporary employee was on a route picking up garbage. While he was cycling the hopper, a metal pole sprung out and struck him in the face, resulting in facial fractures that required hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting a collar on a shaft. The shaft moved, and his right ring finger was pinched. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip, above the first small knuckle.
An employee was performing setup on a straight cut machine when her left middle finger was pinched in a clamp mechanism, causing an amputation to the finger.

At 12:30 p.m. on March 11, 2021, an employee fell off a burning table while removing scrap from it. He landed on his arm on the concrete floor, suffering a fracture to the elbow/arm that required hospitalization and surgery.

On March 11, 2021, an employee poured cake mix into a baking pan and then stepped onto a ladder when he slipped and fell to the ground, resulting in a bruised head and tailbone that required hospitalization.
An employee twisted his ankle while stepping down a level. He suffered a broken left knee and was hospitalized.
An employee was greasing the fifth wheel of a truck between the drive tires on the passenger side when the truck went into gear and rolled over the employee's left leg.
An automated railroad car door closed on an employee's thumb, smashing it against the door locking mechanism and resulting in a fractured thumb.

At about 3:30 p.m. on March 12, 2021, employees were loading hot water condensate from a utilities unit into a vacuum truck. When the truck was nearly full, the water supply was shut off. As an employee was disconnecting the hoses for the water, he was sprayed with residual pressurized water from a 6-inch coupling he was disconnecting at the truck. He suffered second-degree burns to both forearms and the left side of the face and neck.
An employee was riding on the bumper of a work van. He fell off and his head struck the pavement, causing a head/brain injury. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was repairing a belt on a conveyor. He turned and struck his head on an overhead beam and then fell back into the conveyor he was working on, sustaining a back injury.
An employee was attempting to release a bag that had become stuck between two conveyors when the tip of their finger became caught in the belt, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was coming down a step ladder. The employee missed the last step and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was switching valves on a pump in the recovery boiler area. While en route to the equipment, the employee entered an area where excavation work was being performed and that was flooded with 6 inches of cloudy water. The employee stepped into an inspection port that was waist high and sustained burns to the lower body from a hot water mixture.
On March 12, 2020, an employee was driving a pickup truck along a closed highway lane. The truck hit the side of a skid steer's track, and the employee suffered neck whiplash. He was hospitalized.

An employee hooked up a high vac to perform routine housekeeping tasks. The employee was walking to turn the high vac on when they fell to the ground and contacted the furnace deck, resulting in a fractured left femur that required hospitalization.

An employee was working in a basement, keeping the area secure while other employees drilled down from the floor above. The concrete core drilled out from the floor above fell down, struck the rim of the core-catching bucket, then fell about 15 feet further, striking the employee's hardhat and then the back of his head and neck. He suffered a laceration to the back of the head and a ruptured cervical disk.
Two employees were installing pipe supports when the top support slid and struck them both. One of the employees was hospitalized for lacerations and injuries to the ribs, face, and back of the head.
An employee was removing a rock that had stuck on a dump truck gate. The gate shut on his fingers, causing amputations to three fingers on his right hand.
An employee was moving the air pole on the side of a drill press when their gloves got caught in the drill press, resulting in an amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee tripped over a chair in a break room, falling and breaking her hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was leaving the facility for the day. As the employee was about to exit the building, he stopped at a table that stores hand sanitizer and face masks. At the same time, the work platform adjacent to the table was struck by a transfer car that was being repositioned. When the transfer car struck the tower, it dislodged a service part (2" steel blind flange) from one of the platform levels, which then fell and struck the employee on the head. The employee sustained a laceration, contusion, and fracture to the head.

Two employees collided while one of them was climbing down a ladder carrying a nail gun. The gun discharged, firing a wire nail fastener into the other employee's head. That employee was hospitalized.

An employee was transferring a bag of fertilizer that was held up by a forklift into a front-end loader. As the employee was standing in-between the forklift and the front-end loader, one of the machines rolled forward and the employee was pinned between the forklift mast and the bucket of the front-end loader. The employee was admitted to the hospital with six broken ribs.
An employee fell to the floor in a deep freezer. The employee suffered a compression fracture to a lower-back vertebra.

An employee was attempting to move a steel form panel with a crane when the spreader beam became tangled with a rebar cage. As the load began lifting, the tension from the chains making contact with the rebar cage allowed the load to swing toward the employee, trapping him between the steel form and a solid staircasing and resulting in an injury to his left leg.

An employee was troubleshooting a large industrial grinder because it was stuck. The grinder's blades became free, striking the employee's right hand and lacerating four fingers. The ring finger was amputated.
An employee was disconnecting a trailer from a truck by pulling on the fifth wheel handle. His hand slipped off the handle and he fell backward to the ground, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was cleaning the floor with a bucket of water that contained oven cleaner instead of floor cleaner. Some of the water spilled onto the employee's feet, resulting in chemical burns.
An employee was climbing into a skid steer when he slipped and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee fell to the asphalt in a parking lot while trying to stop two thieves from stealing her vehicle. She suffered a back injury.
An employee developed severe right thigh pain after stepping off a stand-on snow removal machine. He was hospitalized, having suffered a possible tendon injury on the thigh.
An employee fell from a roof access ladder to the ground, suffering facial trauma and a broken foot.
An employee was acting as the front spotter for a forklift on the salesfloor when the wheel of the forklift ran over his left foot, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was moving product between pallets. The employee's leg got caught in shrink wrap, and the employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was stepping off a scissor lift onto a steel structure while tied off to a plumb line when they slipped and fell, resulting in a fractured left hip and elbow.
At about 12:55 p.m. on March 13, 2021, an employee suffered a broken hip while stepping off a stand-up lift.
An employee was turning an electric pallet jack when his foot was caught between the pallet jack and a pole resulting in an ankle fracture and laceration.

On March 14, 2021, an employee was pouring hot water from a container into a salad bar ice reservoir to melt the ice and prepare the salad bar station for cleaning. The water spilled down the employee's front, causing third-degree burns to his abdomen and the front of his legs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was lifting a metal coil with an overhead crane. He noticed the chain sling was twisted and was trying to straighten it when his left index finger was pinched between the chain sling and the coil. The finger was broken.

An employee was dumping a mini dumpster, mounted on a forklift, into a large trash container. When the mini dumpster tipped, the employee's finger was caught between it and the forklift's forks. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell while jumping over a snow bank in a parking lot. The employee suffered a dislocated knee and a broken tibia.
An employee was walking to a dumpster. A forklift struck the employee as it backed up in an intersection. The employee suffered a head laceration, a left leg wound, and a crushed left little toe.

On March 15, 2021, an employee was using a manual pallet jack to unload a trailer. As he was maneuvering the load toward the end of the trailer, it began to fall. The employee fell to the asphalt ground, suffering a broken left elbow and hip.

On March 15, 2021, an employee was helping demolish a concrete floor when a 650-pound, 3-foot by 3-foot concrete slab slipped off a forklift and landed on his right foot. The foot was broken and he was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A temporary employee was controlling a come-a-long on one side of a flat plate while another worker was using a 20-pound steel hammer to strike the plate and move it into position inside the engine room of a vessel which was on shore/dry dock. The temporary employee was manually shaking the plate to see if it would slide down under its own weight when his left hand was struck by the hammer. The injured employee was wearing protective leather gloves at the time. His middle finger was broken and lacerated, the ring finger was also lacerated.
An employee had just shut off a meat grinder and was reaching to clear its blade. The grinder blade amputated 1/4 to 3/8 inch from the employee's left middle finger.

An employee was using a hydraulic torque wrench to loosen the nuts that held a pump's fluid end to the stay rod bolts. His right little finger was caught between the wrench and a nut that the wrench was braced against. His finger was crushed, and he was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a tractor when it went out of control. The employee jumped from the tractor, landed on a rock, and suffered rib fractures.

A press brake operator was bending small sheet metal parts when his left ring finger and middle finger were caught between the part being bent and the face of the upper bending die. The tips of each finger were crushed and the employee was hospitalized for surgical amputation of both fingertips.
An employee tripped and fell while working behind a jewelry counter, suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was adjusting a machine when it cycled and its parts caused the amputation of the employee's middle fingertip.
An employee was walking toward a clean room exit when she tripped on the edge of a floor tile and fell to her knees, suffering a broken hip.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, sustaining injury to the right hip and elbow.

An employee was connecting beams to columns during steel construction. While walking from one point to another, he lost his balance and fell to the ground about 13 feet below. He suffered a broken left elbow.

An employee was unloading a concrete mop sink from the back of a truck with a dolly. The slope of the ramp caused the sink to slide down the dolly and crush the employee's right thumb. The employee suffered a fracture and dislocation to the thumb.

At about 8:00 a.m. on March 15, 2021, an employee was pushing back a curtain for a Conestoga trailer when a forklift dropped a pallet on the employee. The employee suffered cuts, bruises, and a fractured back vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was preparing a cup line packer for sanitizing. The machine started, and a moving rail amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
On March 15, 2020, an employee was moving steel slip coils when a coil came off a crane. The employee's legs were pinned under the coil and one of his legs was broken. He was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a hose out of an exterior door on the second floor of a facility. The hose lifted up the hand rail and the employee fell over it, landing on the ground 12 feet below. The employee suffered a broken right ankle.

An employee was standing near the edge of a loading dock, handing HEPA filters to another employee who was inside a dumpster. A 300-pound cart moved toward the employee. As he attempted to evade the cart, he lost balance and fell over the edge and into the dumpster, landing on the bottom about 4 or 5 feet below and suffering a broken sacrum.

At about 10:00 a.m. on March 15, 2021, an employee was loading a trailer with a forklift. As the forklift moved around the trailer, it became stuck in a hole. The employee was trying to free it when it broke loose and slid into trailer. The employee's left hand was smashed between trailer and the forklift's roll cage; the hand and fingers were broken.

An employee was unloading a small bundle of lumber from a truck using a forklift. As he backed away from the truck, the forklift's rear wheel rolled into a curb. The resulting jolt caused the top of the employee's head to strike the forklift's roll-over protective cage. He suffered a laceration to the top of the head.
An employee was using a ladder to access a racking system. He fell, suffering injuries to the head and face.
An employee was preparing to install an alarm system sensor. The employee was burned by a gas fume flash fire, suffering burns to the right side of the face and hand.

An employee was backing up a tow tractor. The tips of the employee's right middle, ring, and little fingers were caught between the tow tractor and a roof support pole, causing partial amputations to those fingers.
