An employee was standing on a stepladder, replacing an exhaust fan hood vent gutter. He stepped onto a fryer cover, which moved, bringing him into contact with the fryer oil. He suffered second- and third-degree burns to the right leg, ankle, and foot.

An employee was working at a roll former, feeding a coil of steel through the rollers to form a ring. The steel became misaligned at the second of three forming rollers. The employee was aligning the piece when the roller caught his right glove and drew in his index, middle, and ring fingers. He suffered a fracture to the index finger and crushing injuries to the middle and ring fingertips, with amputations at the fingertips. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was cutting a sirloin steak with a band saw when the sawblade amputated the tip of a finger on his right hand.
An employee was kicked in the stomach by a dog while holding down the dog for a normal procedure. The employee sustained injuries to the abdomen and required surgery.
An employee was on a ladder, changing a bearing on a conveyor system. The employee slipped off the ladder and fell to the floor, suffering a neck fracture and a laceration on the face.

An employee was cutting pig tails on a bandsaw. The saw lacerated the employee's right hand between the index finger and thumb, cutting into the palm. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was installing pipe insulation from a ladder. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a head laceration, a dislocated right middle finger, and the loss of a fingernail on the right hand.
An employee was lighting wood debris on fire. The thinner he was using exploded, burning his face and arm.

An employee was operating a logging-type truck with a grapple attached. An outrigger had been set for the truck, and the employee was setting the second outrigger when the first one slipped, causing the truck to pitch sideways. The employee was ejected, struck the ground, and suffered a broken left leg and an injury to the right shoulder.

An employee fell from an extension ladder onto an asphalt pavement about 15 feet below, suffering a skull fracture, internal bleeding in the head, a broken collarbone, broken vertebrae, five to eight broken ribs, and a liver laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a forklift to stack cotton bales for transport. Two of the bales fell and struck the employee, causing head, rib, and pelvis injuries.
An employee was inspecting a roof leak from an extension ladder. He fell off the ladder, landing about 20 feet below and breaking his femur.

An employee was changing a core box containing a mold and foundry sand. When the employee was putting away the core box, it moved unexpectedly and crushed the tip of the employee's right little finger. The fingertip was then amputated.

The employee was disconnecting old equipment and installing new equipment when he was exposed to hydrogen fluoride. He suffered chemical burns to the left arm and light burns to his left cheek and eye.
On March 16, 2021, an employee slipped on black ice (concealed by recent snow) while stepping out of a building. The employee fell, suffering a broken left wrist.
An employee was threading a machine when it pulled in the employee's left hand, lacerating the palm.
An employee was trying to clear jammed wood from a trim saw when one of the blades cut his hand.
Two employees were fighting in a parking lot. One employee's head struck a concrete barrier; he lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting an oil separator and suffered amputation of their right ring finger below the first joint. The machine was not shut down or locked out at the time.

At about 10:40 a.m. on March 16, 2021, an employee was pushing a 24-inch-long, 6-inch-diameter steel pipe with a forklift. The pipe slid off the fork, smashing employee's right index finger against the fork. The employee suffered a laceration to the finger.

An employee was monitoring as a tree was felled. The tree hung up; an excavator pushed on it to clear it, and its top half snapped and sprung backwards toward the crew. Part of this upper section, about 4 inches in diameter, struck the employee in the back of the right leg as he was trying to get away. He suffered an open fracture of the tibia and fibula.
An employee slipped and fell in an icy parking lot. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a fractured L1 vertebra.
While pulling a kitchen cart, an employee slipped on a wet floor in front of an ice machine. The employee fell to the floor, suffering a head injury.

An employee was walking along the edge of an excavation while the bucket was being changed on the excavator. The quick coupler slipped while releasing the bucket and the bucket slid down the spoil pile, knocking the employee into the ditch. The employee sustained a fractured bone in their back.

An employee was removing brackets from an overhead door while standing two rungs from the top of a 10 ft. ladder. When the employee removed the last bracket the overhead door shifted and the employee fell off the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the heels of both feet.

An employee was troubleshooting a vacuum pump connected to a drum containing cream filling. The employee shut off the vacuum pump, disassembled the pump, turned the pump back on, and was trying to remove thick cream around the edge when the pump suction cycled. The employee's left thumb was caught between the base ring and the inside of the pump ferrule housing, and was amputated at the first knuckle from the tip.

An employee was starting up a thermoforming machine. As the employee threaded a plastic sheet through an oven, his fingers were pinched in a nip point created by the oven chain as it indexed. He suffered a partial amputation to the right ring finger and a laceration to the right middle finger.

An employee was trying to hang netting in the back of a chicken house. As the employee was securing the net to the corner of a ventilation fan guard, the guard broke loose, fell, and struck the employee's right hand. The employee suffered lacerations across and between the ring and little fingers.

An employee was cleaning a serrated cutting edge in a taping machine through a 3-inch by 3-inch opening. The cutting edge activated and caused an avulsion injury resulting in surgical amputation of their left thumb tip.

Two employees were inspecting separate sides of a void tank in a ship. When one of them stood up from a squat, his glasses slid down his face and his eye and right brow struck a protruding piece of a metal bracket. He suffered a cut to the brow and an eye injury from the bracket piece.
An employee was standing on a trailer lift gate, trying to lock it. The hook broke and the employee fell onto a metal welding bin. The employee suffered three broken ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee was strapping down merchandise in the back of a box truck. The strap did not lock down. When the employee pulled on it to make sure the merchandise was secured, its looseness caused him to fall backwards out of the truck to the ground and suffer a broken arm.
An employee was checking to add more dough to a machine when an auger in the machine amputated his right middle finger.

An employee was standing between a forklift and a tilt hoist, trying to reinstall the hoist arm. The fork and boom extension fell and pinned him to the tilt hoist. He suffered a possible skull fracture and a dislodged right ear canal and was hospitalized.
An employee lost his balance and fell while exiting a bucket truck's bucket. He landed on the ground below and suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee tripped on a bucket in the back of a delivery truck and fell. The employee's head struck the dock, causing a head laceration and a broken nose.
An employee was aligning a rotor shaft to go into a line board. The employee's finger was pinched between the shaft and the board, leading to a fingertip amputation.
An employee was working in a junction box. An arc flash caused second- and third-degree burns to the employee's face, arm, and lower back.
An employee tripped over a box of hangers while stepping out of a register bay. She fell, injuring her right leg.

Employees were rigging up a work over rig and using a crane to move a blowout preventer off a trailer. The blowout preventer moved and swung once it was lifted from the ground, hitting an employee in the chest. He suffered minor internal bleeding and was hospitalized.
An employee was remotely operating a crane. The employee lost their footing and fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was stocking shelves when a bungee cord on a freight cart came loose and struck the employee in the head, causing a head injury.

An employee was oiling a boom hoist cable on a crane. His left hand was caught between the top of the sheave and under the keeper that was guiding the boom hoist cable. Four fingers on the hand were amputated.
An employee was cleaning a backing roll. The employee's hand was caught in a nip point between rolls, causing a crushing injury to the hand and arm.
An employee was rolling bins in a receiving area. She tripped over a metal tracker on the floor, landed on her right hip and shoulder, and suffered injuries to both including a broken hip.
On March 17, 2021, an employee fell 17 feet from the bucket of a loader while covering a haystack with a tarp, landing on the ground and suffering injuries to their ankles, feet, and ribs.
An employee slipped and fell while getting down out of a crane. The employee landed on decking below and suffered a broken hip.
An employee fell while moving from a ladder to a roof. The employee landed on the asphalt ground below and broke both heels.
An employee was using a torque gun to loosen a bonnet bolt on a blowout preventer door. The torque gun swung around and struck his left middle finger, causing the amputation of half of the finger.

An employee was unloading tires from a truck at the transfer station. The employee opened a box on the truck to dump the tires and when he opened the door, a tire came loose from an elevated position and struck his left leg. The employee sustained a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was moving trash with a forklift. As the employee emptied the forklift's trash hopper, his left ring finger was caught in a pinch point and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was feeding product into a heart and liver machine. The machine amputated her right ring fingertip below the nailbed.
An employee was operating a core drill. The machine caught the employee's clothing, then entangled his right thumb. The thumb was amputated.
An employee tripped on a rug in a break room, falling to the floor and suffering a broken right hip.
An employee lost his footing while stepping out of his truck. He fell to the ground, suffering a broken femur.

An employee had just repaired a portable pallet wrapper and was remounting its metal table top. As he made fine adjustments to align the mounting holes, the table shifted and his left middle finger was caught between the table and a support roller. The finger was degloved and later amputated at the first knuckle.

On March 17, 2021, an employee was working in the bucket of a bucket truck when a box truck drove under the bucket and struck its bottom. The bucket turned 90 degrees and ejected the employee, who landed on top of the box truck and then rolled off it to the ground below. The employee suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was accessing the top of a river barge with a portable ladder. The employee fell from the ladder, suffering a broken bone in the shoulder area.
An employee was removing a panel/guard from a pasting machine so it could be cleaned. The roller inside the machine smashed his left little finger, which was amputated up to the first knuckle.
An employee tried to jump onto a slow-moving truck, but fell under it. The wheel drove over him and broke his pelvis.
On March 18, 2021, an employee was hospitalized after their foot was crushed between a forklift and a steel beam.
An employee was counseling an inmate when the inmate charged him, throwing him to the concrete floor and breaking his hip.
An employee was stepping off a forklift when his left foot was pinched and lacerated by another, moving forklift.
An employee was working on a CNC machine when his glove was caught and pulled. His right ring and little fingers were amputated.

An employee was helping to lift a pallet of glass bottles that were stacked on top of each other in approximately 11 layers. The employee assisted with splitting the layers in half when the pressure on the pallets caused one of the bottles to break. The employee suffered a laceration on his right ring finger that resulted in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was stepping onto a lumber landing when his foot slipped on the landing's edge. His right hand was caught in a conveyor roller as he tried to stop his fall, and he suffered several broken fingers and lacerations.

An employee was riding on a push cart, with both feet off the ground, when the cart tipped. The employee fell and was struck on the right leg by the cart's handlebar. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was pressure-washing ductwork. As he was adjusting the pressure washer, it came back and hit his face and eye. He suffered cuts to the right eye and was hospitalized.
An employee was lowering a spool on a take-up machine. The spool went up instead of down and pinched his left index finger against a knob. He suffered an amputation at the first joint.
An employee was struck by a vehicle while picking up a trash container. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was performing a post-remediation inspection. As he looked up at metal beams, cross-members and columns with a flashlight, he fell through a floor opening onto a bunch of boxes (filled with filters) on the floor below. He was hospitalized.

An employee was helping replace a die on a pellet mill. A blow from a sledgehammer caused a small piece of metal to fly off and strike the employee in the abdomen. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a ruptured spleen.
An employee tripped while opening a shop door from the outside. He fell, breaking his left elbow and injuring his shoulder.

An employee was coaching another employee on using a stamp machine. The machine was activated while the employee's right hand was in its feeder area. It pressed down on the employee's hand, causing a complete amputation just below the thumb.
An employee fell off a ladder while climbing it. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a leg injury.
An employee fell from the roof of a garage inside a warehouse after descending a 5-foot ladder. The employee landed on the ground 11 feet below and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was operating a forklift when its forks became caught in the sandy ground. It tipped forward, and momentum caused the employee's head and body to strike the forklift's structure.
An employee was unloading steel coils from a barge. A crane cable snapped, causing a coil to roll over the employee's left leg and crush it.
An employee was working under the dashboard of a vehicle with a sharp pick tool. The tool slipped from his hand and lacerated his right eye.
An employee slipped on ice/snow in a parking lot and fell, hitting his head.

Employees were replacing a 6-inch metal pipe fitting. As they were aligning the pipe, it swung into a concrete wall. An employee's hand was caught between the pipe and the wall. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was unloading a bin off a pallet. The employee's foot went between the slats of the pallet, causing the employee to fall to the floor and suffer fractures to the hip/pelvis and wrist.

On March 18, 2021, at approximately at 3:30 PM, five employees were lifting a car transmission on a pallet off of a truck on a rainy day. While lifting the pallet, the transmission slid and the five employees quickly set the pallet on the truck again and the injured employee's finger was trapped between the truck and the pallet resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was positioning a container roof. The roof sliced off the top of the employee's middle finger at about the top knuckle, amputating about an inch of finger.
An employee was releasing a handle on a mast climber. The handle amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
An employee was helping an operator move plastic drive mats. The mats slid to the side across the ground; the employee could not move out of the way and fell to the ground, breaking his hip.
An employee was adjusting the film of a packing machine when a button was pressed and the arm came down on the employee's left thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A maintenance technician was inspecting the front suspension on a garbage truck. When the steering wheel was turned, the employee's head was pinned between the tire and the cab of the truck. The employee suffered a face fracture.
An employee was walking toward a parking lot when she tripped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was in a trash chute removing jammed plastic. The chute had been lifted with a chain fall and was being held in place with a nylon chocker strap. When the plastic was removed, the chute dropped about 3 inches and a sharp object cut the strap, causing the chute fall another 3 feet. The employee's right leg was broken above the ankle.
On March 19, 2021, an employee missed a step at the bottom of some stairs and fell, suffering an ankle/foot injury. The employee was hospitalized.

Three employees were working on a bridge while in a mobile working platform. The platform fell, and the employees fell with it to the ground about 16 feet below. One of them suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was transferring gear from one truck to another when he fell off a truck step. He landed on the ground and suffered a broken right hip.

An employee was riding an electric pallet jack to a charging area. His foot was caught between the jack and the charging area. He suffered a laceration to the lower leg and fractures to the left fibula and tibia.

An employee was cleaning mud off the lights on a truck after a cargo container had been unloaded from it. As the truck's lift gate was being put away, the winch cable engaged and pulled in the employee's hand, lacerating it and causing four fractures to the palm.
An employee opened the doors on a trailer. Bundled cardboard boxes fell out of the trailer and knocked the employee to the ground. The employee suffered a broken femur.
The wheel of a grinder disk broke off and struck an employee (standing 6-7 feet away) in the eye. The employee suffered an eye injury.
An employee was exiting a car in a parking lot. The employee stepped onto broken pavement and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was rolling a dumpster out of a containment box when they suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was clearing out sawdust from a rotary feeder. The employee's right middle finger was caught by a paddle wheel inside the feeder, causing the amputation of the fingertip. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee collapsed, suffering from dehydration. The employee suffered an injury to the back of the head where it struck the floor.
An employee was placing a connector to a hot mold. Some moisture got into the mold, causing it to pop. The employee suffered burns to his leg, his heel, and the back of his head.

An employee was operating an electrical chain hoist. As he was engaging the hoist to lift, using the pendant with his right hand and holding the hook with his left, his left index fingertip was caught between two contact points. As the chain went in, the tension amputated the fingertip.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a structural pole in a building. The employee's head struck a side view mirror on the forklift, causing an eye contusion.
An employee fell to the floor and suffered a dislocated/broken right ankle. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was standing behind a horse when it kicked him in the face. He suffered six broken teeth.
An employee received acupuncture as part of a training when they suffered a collapsed lung that resulted in hospitalization.
An employee was unloading a pallet jack. The employee slipped and the jack ran over the employee's foot, breaking bones in the foot.
An employee was struck by a car while crossing the road. The employee suffered a back injury.
A temporary employee was taking a measurement from a ladder leaned against a truck trailer. The ladder moved and the employee fell to the ground, suffering fractures. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were replacing the threads on a 4-inch riser tube on an underground storage tank. The tank flashed over and blew the manway off. One of the employees suffered third-degree burns on 50 percent of their skin surface.
An employee was using a shear machine to separate brass when his left arm contacted the shear blade as it was coming down. The employee's arm was surgically amputated.
An employee was cutting pork chops with a bandsaw. The sawblade amputated the employee's right index finger.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder on the back of an antenna inside a radome. He fell from the ladder to the radome deck about 12 feet below. He suffered a broken heel and a broken rib.
An employee was moving a pallet from an elevated shelf. A small piece of wood fell from the pallet, striking the employee in the eye.
An employee was leading a patient back to their room. The patient pushed the employee, who fell to the floor and suffered a broken right shoulder.

At about 3:30 p.m. on March 20, 2021, employees were changing the lap on a signature on a printing press. An employee was checking to see that the lap was flush when his right index finger was caught under a plate. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered an amputation to the left little finger while servicing a cryo-vac machine.

An employee was positioning a steel beam to be welded. As the beam was being lifted to turn over, it got caught on rollers. It came loose while the employee was trying to dislodge it, and his left hand was caught between the beam and a roller. He suffered amputations to the first and middle fingers just below the nails.
While the band on some elevated tubing was being cut, the tubing fell off its rack and hit an employee's leg and foot. His leg was broken and he suffered multiple fractures to the foot.
Employees were lifting a 3-foot by 3-foot, 250-pound cover. A knot failed and the cover fell to the bottom of a hole, striking an employee's left foot. The employee suffered three broken bones.
An employee became dizzy and fainted in the street while returning to a patient's home from a store. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken left arm.
An employee was working in a rail yard coupling rail cars when his left leg was pinned between rail cars at the knuckle joint. The leg was broken.
An employee separated two pallets of product, wrapped them, and then began to back his pallet jack under them. The jack pinned his foot against the rack, breaking his femur.

An employee was helping a patient to the restroom. The patient lost consciousness in the restroom and fell back toward her, causing them both to fall. The toilet struck the employee's right knee, causing a fracture to the tibia at the knee.

An employee was diagnosing issues with a palletizer. As he was working to realign the row-former and removing bolts on a guard to access the counterweight mechanism, the counterweight actuated. He was caught between the row-former and a steel support beam and suffered broken ribs.
At the end of a shift on March 21, 2021, an employee developed back pain while lifting a container of lettuce. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered strains.
On March 21, 2021, an employee was walking in a powerhouse's boiler area when a large non-return valve ruptured. The employee suffered steam burns to the hands and face and was hospitalized.
An employee was on an auger when it was turned on. The employee suffered a toe amputation.
An employee was using a horizontal bandsaw when his left hand and fingers were caught between the saw clamp and the part on the saw. He suffered a finger amputation.
An maintenance employee was assisting with rebuilding a machine when the machine's bottom plate dropped down and caught the employee's right ring finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading tires onto a flat trailer. He tripped and fell, striking his head on the ground and suffering hairline skull fractures. He was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling on a tree limb when another tree limb rolled and struck the back of their head, causing injury.

On March 22, 2021, at approximately 1:15 AM, an employee was picking a case of oranges in the produce department while a fork truck was moving a pallet nearby. It's forks swung to the left and struck the employee's lower right leg. The employee sustained fractures to the tibia, fibula, ankle, and foot.

An employee was recovering loose straws between the roller and the drive bar on a packer/case sealer. The employee's left little finger was caught between the roller and the drive bar, leading to an amputation of 1 centimeter of the fingertip.
An employee was cutting strips of beef with a bandsaw. The saw amputated the employee's left thumb.

Two employees were lowering a dock plate to the floor. One employee's left hand was caught between the plate and the floor as the plate dropped. The employee's index fingertip was crushed and was later amputated.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift to pick up a metal bin. The mast of the forklift hit an overhead door, causing the forklift to tip over backwards. Inside the cab, the employee suffered seven broken ribs and a broken collarbone.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder when he fell to the ground about 4 feet below. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee fell while changing a compressor air filter, suffering an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee got up from his desk to go see a patient when he fell and broke his hip.
An employee was adjusting an element of a hydraulic system to correct a leak. The bucket of the bucket truck fell on him, causing a head laceration and a possible fractured rib.
An employee was unlocking a trailer from a dock. The employee jumped from the dock to the ground and sustained ligament and tendon damage to both knees.
An employee was struck and injured by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee parked a forklift on a ramp. When the employee got off the forklift to close an overhead door, the forklift started rolling. The employee got on to stop it; it hit a tier rack and the rack fell on the employee, catching his left foot and ankle. The employee developed a muscle injury that required surgery.
An employee was putting the dock plate into a trailer. His foot slipped and he fell, suffering a broken bone in his foot.
An employee fell off a truck while working on concrete pump pipes, landing on the ground and suffering a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was conducting general cleanup around the gin and fell from the catwalk. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a head laceration, a broken collarbone, and broken ribs.

An employee was descending a concrete stairway with wire rope guardrails. He began to fall and grabbed the guardrail, which gave way. He fell to the concrete floor about 15 feet below, suffering a left-side impact that caused an eye socket fracture and other fractures. He was hospitalized, requiring treatment including a rod in his back.

An employee was removing scrap from a conveyor belt when their hand became caught on the conveyor belt and drawn into the pinch point between the belt and the tensioner roller, resulting in a broken arm.
An employee sprayed glue on the porch of a trailer. He then grabbed a drill to remove two screws and a spark from his drill ignited the fumes from the glue, burning his face, arms, and legs.
An employee lost consciousness while casing mail. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee suffered an amputation while assembling food packages using a grommet machine.

Two employees were setting a metal pipe in place for installation on a metal rack. When one employee pushed on the pipe, the other employee's left index fingertip was pinched between the pipe flange and a conduit. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

At about 10:15 a.m. on March 22, 2021, an employee was working with a part on a bench disk grinder. The disk caught the employee's left glove and pulled in the employee's middle finger, amputating the fingertip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell off a baker scaffold to the wooden deck 39 inches below, suffering head, neck, and back injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
A postal carrier slipped on ice and fell while walking to their vehicle. The employee suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee set up a ladder and was climbing up to tie it off when the ladder shifted. The employee fell onto the concrete approach. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs, a back injury, and a cut on the head.
An employee was climbing up a fixed ladder attached to a tank when she fell from the ladder and suffered a broken ankle, resulting in hospitalization.
A veterinarian was helping another employee put a dog in a kennel. The dog bit the veterinarian on the left arm, causing a puncture and a laceration.

An employee was repairing a breader. The employee was unjamming a clog from it when its incline chain paddles struck the employee's left hand. The employee suffered an amputation to part of the middle finger.
An employee was operating a stand-alone pallet tugger. The tugger ran into a pallet of toiler paper, and a piece of cardboard in the way cut her right thumb severely.
An employee fell from the back of a golf cart as it turned. The employee landed on the pavement and suffered a broken left collarbone and two broken ribs. He was hospitalized.

An employee was spinning the belts on a machine after the machine had jammed. The employee's ring finger was caught between the belt and the sheave of the machine, causing a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was working on a press brake machine. As he aligned sheet metal against the backstop, the machine actuated and injured both his hands.
An employee was looking at a customer's truck and RV hitch setup. A tension bar hit the employee in the head, knocking him unconscious.
An employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood. The wood jumped, causing the sawblade to amputate the employee's middle finger.

An employee was working from an extension ladder that was supported by a wooden bump pole. The pole broke at the bottom as the employee was approximately 28 feet in the air and the employee fell to the ground sustaining a compound fracture to a leg.
An employee was sanding a shaft that went through a motor and gearbox. The shaft caught his glove, causing him to suffer an amputation of the left index finger and a broken left middle finger.

An employee was putting a dislodged plastic belt section back into position on a conveyor. The conveyor shaft rotated, causing the conveyor to lacerate and fracture the employee's right thumb. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery to the thumb. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was running production on a chopper machine when material got stuck behind the blade. While clearing the material, the machine cycled and amputated his right index fingertip.

An employee was leading a ski school class and was demonstrating a technique when she skied over a soft mound of snow that caught the edge of her ski. Her ski binding released and she fell to the ground and sustained a spiral fracture of the left tibia and fibula.

On March 23, 2021, an employee was using a circular saw to cut rotted wood on the roof of a one-story house when his foot slipped from under him, causing his steering/controlling hand to contact the blade of the circular saw. He sustained the amputation of the left index fingertip without bone loss.
An employee had been putting money in a vault. As she was shutting the vault door, her hand got caught in the door and her right index finger was amputated at the knuckle.

The injured employee was lifting a manhole cover with another crew member when it slipped off the lifting hook. The injured employee's left index finger was caught under the manhole cover and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was working to clear a pump for maintenance and was sprayed with hot oil. He sustained first degree burns to the right wrist and lower portion of his face; and sustained first and second degree burns to his left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing water proof sheathing and fell 30 feet from the lift truck to the ground. The employee was hospitalized for multiple fractures.

An employee was working on a vertical chain drive on a dumper. When the employee tried to take slack out of the back side of the chain, the carriage of the dumper shifted down a few inches. The chain on the drive sprocket tightened and the employee's right middle finger was caught between the chain and the sprocket. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was standing on a sidewalk rigging a steel column when a masonry wall was struck by the tines of an all-terrain forklift. The wall toppled onto the employee causing a leg injury.

An employee was jumping up to activate the tilt lever on a telehandler. The dump box tripped forward and came back down on the telehandler's forks, pinching the employee's left index finger. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee lost his balance on a straight ladder and fell. He sustained fractures to a leg and foot.
An employee fell from a roof and was injured.

An employee was trying to reconnect an airline between a tractor and a trailer while on the side of the road. The truck began to move. The employee fell under the truck and was run over as the truck pulled away. The employee suffered multiple fractures.

On March 23, 2021, at approximately 9:15 AM, an employee was positioning a steel frame for shipping and pinched the tip of his left ring finger between two metal pieces when he set it down. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated at the nail bed.
An employee was operating a sizing press. The employee's left thumb was caught in the point of operation, causing an amputation to the thumb tip.

An employee was separating an injection molding tool. The employee hooked up one of the mold's two sides to overhead hoists and began to separate the mold. The other side (weighing 500 pounds) fell over and crushed the employee's left ring finger against a work bench.
An employee was working on an electrical panel. An arc flash burned the employee's left arm.
An employee was descending from a column form. He slipped and fell to the concrete about 3 1/2 feet below, suffering a broken wrist and broken vertebrae.
An employee had been stocking the cooler/freezer area. While moving a box, the employee felt a sharp pain. The employee was hospitalized with a bulging disk.
An employee tripped and fell while walking down stairs. She landed on the floor, suffering broken ribs and a broken arm.
While moving a tote, an employee tripped and fell to the floor resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was using an overhead crane to load a bundle of hexagonal bars onto the conveyor belt of a die bench machine. When the employee unstrapped the bundle, a hexagonal bar moved  and crushed the tip of his left thumb against another bar resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was patching a concrete wall when he fell off a ladder, suffering a broken leg.
An employee fell on wet pavement while trying to get into a car. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the left leg.
On March 23, 2021, a temporary employee was working from a beam when he fell to the floor 4 or 5 feet below, suffering a fracture to his tailbone and hip. He was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to move a pallet with a roll cage on top of it. The roll cage moved slightly and pinched the tip of his thumb against the roll cage. The thumb tip was amputated.
An employee was walking through the barn when he slipped on manure in the back alley and fell on a crate. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the ribs and torso.
An employee suffered a hand laceration while hopping over something. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee got off a forklift, which then moved forward. Its fork pinched the employee's foot against a pallet shrink wrapper, breaking the foot.

An employee was moving a metal manifold with a jib hoist. The employee lowered the manifold onto the cart and was using both hands to position the manifold. The pendant struck the metal manifold and hoist lifting hook and broke the back cover off which exposed the live electrical terminals. The terminals then contacted the metal and shocked the employee resulting in a burn to the back of their left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

On March 24, 2021, an employee was running a 10-inch laminating rotary dye press machine when their right hand was caught in a raw material called "webbing" which pulled their hand between two rollers and caused a partial amputation to three fingers.

An employee was working on an electrical switchgear with two other employees. The switchgear was energized and an arc flash caused third degree burns to the employee's hand. The hand was surgically amputated.
An employee's glove was caught in a machine's rotating blades. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.

Three Kaplan Corporation employees were helping a delivery driver, who was using a pallet jack to unload a pallet of glass from a delivery truck. One of the jack's wheels hung up on uneven pavement around a manhole cover. One of the employees was trying to free the wheel when the jack's hydraulics were released and it dropped its load to the ground. The employee's right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was stepping off a sidewalk when they lost balance and fell into a glass door, resulting in fractured arm.
While training to operate a pallet jack, an employee was pinned between the jack and a rack. The employee suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was on an order picker, loading a pressure washer in the bay, when he lost balance and fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete. The employee sustained a head injury, a fractured hip, a fractured rib, and a punctured lung.

An employee was performing maintenance on the frame of a forming machine. When the employee closed the slatted frame, his right ring finger was pinched between it and the outside shoe bellows clamp. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.
An employee suffered an open fracture to the right middle fingertip. The fingertip was partially amputated.

A backhoe struck a vent pipe while digging next to it, causing the weld at the bottom of the pipe to fail. The pipe fell and struck an employee on the hardhat. The employee suffered a forehead laceration.

An employee was changing out porcelain bells to polymer bells on a single phase conductor and received an electrical shock, resulting in first degree burns under his right arm and second degree burns in his left armpit.
A crew was lifting a wooden framed wall when the wall slipped and fell on an employee resulting in fractures to his thoracic spine.
An employee was inside a gantry press, trying to reposition a jack. The machine was started while the employee's left hand was outside the boom. The employee's hand was crushed.

A letter carrier went up on a porch to deliver mail to a home when a dog came out of an open window in the screen door and attacked her, biting the left side of her face. A second dog also attacked, biting her on the right calf. The employee was hospitalized and required reconstructive surgery on her facial wounds.

On March 24, 2021, at approximately 8:05 AM, an employee was sweeping the floor. She bent down to pick up the broom and the top of the broom poked her right eye. The employee was hospitalized and had eye surgery.

An employee had been conducting ramp operations using a roller bed to load air freight. While folding the roller bed for storage, his left hand was caught between sections and his left index finger was crushed. The employee was hospitalized and the left index finger was surgically amputated.

An employee was rolling a machine down a ramp, from inside a warehouse to the outside, so he could load it on a delivery truck. At the bottom of the ramp, he tripped over the forks of a fork truck, and his right leg was caught between the fork truck and the machine he was moving. He suffered a broken right leg.

On March 24, 2021, an employee was using a push cart to move packages inside the building. As he was turning left, his thumb was caught between the cart and one of the building's metal support beams. He sustained a compound fracture to his left thumb and was hospitalized.

An employee was on an extension ladder working on cable lines. While descending the ladder to retrieve the replacement section of coaxial cable, the existing/defective cable broke, causing the extension ladder to move and the employee fell approximately 16 feet from the ladder to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized for blunt force trauma to his ribs and the back of his head.

A temporary employee was on a step ladder adjusting an open-web bar joist in the overhead of a hanger bay. The joist slipped and as the employee grabbed the joist, it lacerated the palm of the employee's left hand. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a back sprain while moving a lid from a septic tank.
An employee was cleaning their work area. The employee stepped backward and tripped over a pneumatic air-line. The employee then fell and broke their left wrist.

An employee was using a jointer to cut an acrylic piece. As he was reaching to adjust the wheel with his right hand, the machine was activated and its blades made contact with the fingers on his left hand. They amputated the top half of the index finger to the first distal knuckle, as well as severely lacerating the middle fingertip.

On 3/24/2021, at 11:30 AM, an employee was cutting a small piece of lumber on a table saw. The employee was removing the scrap piece when his left index finger contacted the moving blade and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee's shoe cover was caught on the wheel of a baby crib. She tripped and fell, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was mixing two-cycle fuel for a concrete saw when sparks from concrete sawing ignited the gasoline vapors, causing a fire and burning the employee. The employee sustained severe burns to the hands, neck, and face.

Two employees were removing a broken drive chain that weighted approximately 70 lbs. from a sprocket on a bottom plate motor. The injured employee's hand slipped from the oil on the chain and their right thumb was pinched between the chain and sprocket causing a partial thumb amputation.
An employee welded an I-beam into place. The employee then turned to the left and struck his left eye against the I-beam, sustaining an eye injury.

An employee was clamping an aluminum part into the chuck of a vertical turning lathe when the foot pedal was engaged causing the hydraulic clamp to close on the employee's left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was testing a new snowboard jump and landed on his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a concussion and an abdominal injury.

An employee was grinding rough edges off a piece of metal plate. The employee's right thumb was caught between a vertical rotating grinding disk and the tool table/rest. The employee suffered tissue damage and an amputation of the thumbnail/fingertip.
An employee was using a pressure washer to wash the walkways of a property. When he pulled the hose, the wand slipped and water flow hit his right forearm, resulting in a severe laceration.

An employee was on a ladder working a customer's service line on a utility pole by the road. The utility pole broke causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the L2, L3, and L4 vertebrae, as well as whiplash.

An employee had been cleaning up debris on a roof. The employee fell through the roof substrate and hit his leg on a steel beam inside the building. The employee sustained a laceration to the right leg and a broken fibula.
An employee was moving a test fixture for armored vehicle glass when one of the wheels failed, causing the fixture to tip onto the employee and fracture their right foot and injure their left knee.
An employee was unloading oil and fell from the truck to the ground, resulting in a loss of consciousness and lacerations to the head.

An employee was helping to change out a cylinder on a press. He was putting the cylinder arms down to put the cylinder in place. As he stepped over the driveshaft to pull the pin and roll the cylinders, he lost balance and started to fall forward. He dropped the cylinder arm to regain his balance and the arm came down on his right index finger and amputated the fingertip.

On March 25, 2021, a security officer was working at the return desk and went outside the return doors to investigate a commotion. A customer shot the security officer in the head with a gun. The security officer was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was riding on an electric maintenance cart that contained metal rolls. The employee was holding onto the rolls when the cart hit an object. The rolls moved and smashed a finger on the employee's left hand, causing the amputation of half of the first joint.

A fire occurred at the initiator tanks area within the facility when a small amount of organic peroxide slowly leaked by a gate valve into the main header flush line over a two-day period. The peroxide sat in the flush line and slowly decomposed as it warmed up. A production operator had been walking by the initiator tanks area when the fire broke out. He suffered burns to his back and lower body and was hospitalized.

An employee was aboard a vessel and had been loading the cargo hold. As the vessel was closing the front and back hatch, the employee was retrieving twist locks to place on the hatch once closed. When he leaned over to pick up some more twist locks his left hand was caught by the wheel from the hatch cover. Four fingers on the left hand were amputated.
An employee prepared medicines at a med cart. The employee went to turn and her foot got stuck in the cart. The employee fell backward onto the floor, fracturing her right hip.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift and collided with a parked stand-up forklift, resulting in a broken foot.

On 3/25/2021, an employee was driving from the warehouse to a designated lot space. While turning, the trailer became unstable and began to tilt and the cargo container detached from the chassis. This motion forced the tractor to rise off the ground. As the container slid off the chassis, the tractor came down with force and bounced four times before coming to rest. The employee struck their face on the steering wheel and was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the face and head, a laceration above the left eye, and bilateral eye bruising/swelling.

An employee was riding on the passenger outside side cab of a moving garbage truck. He lost his footing and the truck drove over his right leg and foot, breaking all the toes in the foot. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving a cart with a grey board on it. Due to shifting of the cart or a wheel catching on an obstruction, the cart tipped over and struck two employees. One employee sustained a laceration on his arm requiring hospitalization.

An employee was installing structural steel. The beam the employee was sitting on dislodged and fell off the support it was on causing the employee to fall 10 feet. The employee was hospitalized with a leg laceration.

An employee was preparing to pull plastic netting through an orienter (a machine that heats and stretches plastic film over a series of rollers). The employee tied a string to the netting, wrapped the string around his left hand, and began to pull the string through the machine to the end roller. The roller started, and the string tightened around his left hand. His ring and little fingertips were amputated.
An employee tripped on a rug in a lobby and fell, suffering contusions and a fracture to the right side of the pelvis.
An employee was moving an empty water tank. A finger on his left hand was caught and fractured between the water tank and a stationary surface. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the finger.
An employee was using a lift/hoist to lift a part for inspection. The employee's finger was caught between the part and the strap, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

The injured employee and a co-worker were taking off the service cap of a king valve when refrigerant discharged into the injured employee's glove at high pressure causing burns to the left hand that required hospitalization.
An employee was lifting a bucket full of leaves when he began to suffer lower back pain. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a fitted sheet and fell to the floor fracturing their hip.

An employee was smoothing a metal plate using a bench grinder when the end of their thumb was caught between the material and the grinding wheel. The employee sustained a partial amputation (approximately 25 percent) of their left thumb.

An employee was closing the dock door at approximately 11:50 PM on 3/25/2021. As he pulled the cable to close the door, the cable wrapped around the yellow safety pole and was pulled taut against the pole. The employee's left middle finger got pinched between the cable and the pole and the fingertip was severely lacerated. The employee required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was working with a child patient when the patient crawled behind her. The employee tripped over the patient, fell, and lost consciousness.

An employee was repairing a water pump in a car wash. The pump was energized and actuated when a car entered the car wash tunnel. The worker's right hand was caught in the belt/pulley system, resulting in three partial finger amputations on the right hand.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold when a pin was knocked out of the scaffold and vibrations caused a plank to fall. The employee stepped down on the plank and then fell to the ground, resulting in a hip injury.

On March 26, 2021, an employee was walking across the lab and her left boot laces caught on the speed lace eyelets of her right boot causing her to fall on the floor and fracture her right ankle. She was hospitalized.

An employee had been placing a die in a press. The employee lost balance on a platform and fell 17.5 inches to the concrete surface below. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration on the back of the head.
An employee was sitting at a desk using a computer when they suffered an asthma attack after being exposed to carpet cleaner.
An employee was cutting a piece of drapery fabric in half when her left index finger contacted the blade resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip at the nail area.

While hooking up a crane, the crane rigger signaled the crane operator to slack off. The operator slacked off and one chain was removed. When the rigger went to remove the second chain, the counter balance fell to the ground. The counter balance hit the rigger's left foot and severed their boot, resulting in injuries to the big toe and the toes next to it.
An employee was cleaning and changing out a winterized auger that seemed to be clogged. The screw in the pipe caught three of the employee's fingers, causing them to be amputated.

An employee was performing chimney repairs inside of a chimney. One of the securing lines was severed by the oscillation of the outer concrete covering due to high winds. The employee fell a short distance before being secured by secondary safety lines. This action caused the employee to slam into either the wall or part of the safety cage. The employee sustained a broken rib and a possibly broken shoulder blade.
On March 26, 2021, a temporary employee was cleaning a mixer when her arm got caught in the rotating paddles resulting in the amputation of her right arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee came into the shop to repair a zero-turn mower. Boards were placed underneath the mower to prop it up. As the employee was underneath the mower, it fell on top of him. The employee sustained broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.

An employee had been removing wooden blocking from a hull in preparation for the hull's departure from the dock. While using a wooden wedge to remove sand from under the blocking, the blocking shifted and the employee's right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was climbing down a ladder, slipped, and fell two feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was reaching to pull a cardboard box stuck in a conveyor belt transition plate. The employee's right index and middle finger were caught in the transition plate, causing the amputation of the index fingertip.

An employee was loading t-shirts on a screen printing machine. The printing machine rotated, struck the employee's abdomen, and pinned them between a printing pallet and the screen. The employee sustained bruised ribs and a fractured back.
An employee was struck by falling pallets in a warehouse. The employee suffered a compression fracture and a head injury.

An employee was helping load trucks. A load of strapped millwork material was brought into the loading area on a forklift. It was unstrapped, then rotated 180 degrees to be lowered onto 18-inch steel trestles. The employee was placing a trestle when some wooden window trim kits shifted from the load and fell onto the employee's head, causing a 3-inch laceration and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was putting a bicycle together when their left index finger struck the disc brake, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was using a ball press when a pin that joins parts of the tool together broke. A part of the broken pin struck the employee in the left eye, resulting in a laceration.
An employee was unloading cargo at a terminal. The employee was struck by a chain and hook, suffering facial lacerations and a concussion.
An employee had been felling hazardous trees in a campground. The top of a tree detached, fell, and struck the employee. The employee sustained injury to the head, shoulder, and arm.

An employee was delivering materials to a customer location. While removing materials from the truck, the employee fell off the lift gate and landed on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with three fractured ribs, multiple left transverse process fractures, and a left scapula fracture. The employee required surgery.
An employee was using a torch to cut a shock off a truck. The vehicle caught fire and the employee was burned.

An employee was performing maintenance on a mechanical vapor recompression evaporator when hot water unexpectedly released through the sight glass. The employee sustained second degree burns to his chest, left arm, and right arm.
An employee was hospitalized with a foot injury after their right foot was crushed between two powered industrial trucks (PIT).

An employee was repairing a gutter at a customer's home. As the employee was climbing a 15-foot ladder, the ladder tipped over and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right elbow and hip.
An employee stepped 1 to 2 feet down from a step stool and broke her leg on the floor. She was hospitalized.
An employee was unpacking coils of steel when a coil fell on their left foot resulting in a crushing injury.
An employee was maneuvering a cheese cart when one of the cheese tubes on the cart came loose and struck his thumb, resulting in a partial amputation of the left thumb tip.

An employee was filling up a boom lift with a 5-gallon diesel can. He fell from the top of the boom lift's wheel to the ground and his face hit the fuel can. He suffered a cut above his left eyebrow and nose from the fuel can, as well as a broken neck vertebra and a contusion to the right hand from the fall.
An employee was returning a wheelchair to a hospital when they tripped over some construction material outside the front door, resulting in a bruised hip and kidney.

An employee was prepping an outboard boat motor for a customer and testing all features. The motor got stuck in the tilted position. The employee was trying to free the tilt lock when the lock freed itself and the motor struck the employee's fingers while they were in the hinge area resulting in amputation of the employee's right pinky fingertip.

An employee was pulling a frame cart for a new job when they tripped and fell, wedging their right pinky finger between the handles of two frame carts. The pinky finger was amputated just above the first knuckle.
An employee reached under a conveyor for an envelope and their left arm was caught in the conveyor, resulting in a fracture to the forearm.
An employee was troubleshooting a machine that wraps coating over cable when they sustained an amputation to a fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.

While performing maintenance on a front end loader/backhoe, an employee removed a pin, which caused the machine arm to come down on the employee's finger. The employee's finger was caught between the machine arm and a stationary object, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While de-boning cow ribs, an employee dropped his knife. As the employee went to catch the knife it stabbed him above his mesh apron.
An employee was turning an electric pallet jack down an aisle when it struck her ankle, resulting in a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting an operator when they noticed an unusual amount of steam/leaking water coming from another area. The employee went to investigate and sustained burns from the steam, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee had been climbing a tug boat mast. The employee was working to untangle crane block rigging when high winds blew the rigging over. The employee was entangled in rigging wires and suffered internal injuries.
An employee was removing steel pipe from a pump on a water truck when a pipe fell on his right ring finger. The employee sustained a lacerated and twisted finger.

On March 27, 2021, an employee was walking over an island in a parking lot when she slipped on leaves on the ground and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle that required surgery.

An employee was operating an enclosed pallet jack and stopped to scan a pallet. As the employee reached out to scan the pallet, the cord of the scanner hit the throttle of the pallet jack. The pallet jack lunged forward and pinched the employee's right leg against a doorway protection pole resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee had been stocking products in an aisle and fell from a ladder cart. The employee's left knee was fractured and dislocated.

An employee of Specialized Equipment Contractors was operating a boom lift while performing work at a plant. While the employee was turning the boom lift around to bring it to a different location, he boomed up to miss some interferences on the ground level and was struck in the face by a ceiling fan. The employee sustained facial fractures, a broken jaw, and a dislocated tooth.
An employee was standing on top of a cooler to view the upper shelves and fell through the top to the cooler floor. The employee sustained a concussion, a broken wrist, and contusions.
An employee was walking through a parking lot retrieving shopping carts. She tripped and fell while stepping down from a curb resulting in a fractured right hip.

An employee running a check stand/cash register tripped over a box of grocery bags that was on the floor. The employee's left arm hit the floor causing a dislocated left shoulder requiring hospitalization.

The injured employee was one of three workers on-site repairing a downed overhead conductor that had been damaged by a fallen tree. The injured employee began to measure the length of the jumper before the circuit was de-energized and grounded. He grabbed a de-energized conductor with one hand and touched an energized conductor with his other hand. The employee sustained electrical burns to both hands.

An employee was attempting to install a cap (a two-part assembly) onto a casing head. The cap was stuck, and as the employee tried to manually thread it onto the casing head, its upper part came down and caught the employee's left thumb. The employee suffered an amputation to the thumb and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was ripping off excess plastic from a pallet on a conveyor when their left hand was crushed between a pallet and a metal stop on a roller conveyor. The employee sustained a middle finger amputation to the first knuckle.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift toward a warehouse. The forklift struck a cardboard pallet while turning, and his left leg was caught between the forklift and the pallet. He suffered a broken left tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee had been running a cutting die machine. While clearing a jam, the employee's left hand was caught by the machine resulting in amputation of two fingers.

An employee was stacking merchandise on a pallet when a pallet jack drove past the employee and struck a pallet. As the employee attempted to move out of the way, the employee walked into a pallet, resulting in a right leg injury above the ankle.
An employee was painting from a scaffold when they fell approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
At 2:17 p.m. on March 29, 2021, an employee fell while stepping out of a tractor. He landed on the ground and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was changing a trailer hitch. The trailer shifted while the hitch was being removed and fell on the employee's right arm, breaking it. The employee was hospitalized.
A forklift operator and two concrete workers were placing concrete forms when the forklift contacted an electrical line. One of the concrete workers was hospitalized with electrical burns.
An employee was repairing a trimmer machine. The machine cut the knuckle on the employee's right index finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting a roller in a press. Her right hand was pulled in and crushed between a rubber tent sleeve roller and another, stainless steel roller. She suffered cuts, contusions, and fractures to the middle, ring, and little fingers and was hospitalized.
An employee was using a box cutter to strip wire. The box cutter slipped and lacerated the employee's left index finger, resulting in an infection.

An employee was charging a gas spring to pressure when the gas spring blew apart, injuring his right hand, left hand, and abdomen. The employee suffered the amputation of three fingers on his right hand and was hospitalized.

On March 29, 2021, an employee was retrieving supplies from a shelf in the storeroom. The employee tripped over boxes on the floor and caught herself by grabbing the shelf, resulting in a fractured left shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing floor trusses. The employee fell from a first-floor top plate to the basement floor 19 feet below, suffering a broken jaw and head injures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee sustained a partial left index finger amputation when high winds caused the compressor building door to slam on the employee's finger.
An employee was conducting storm clean up. While cutting a limb from a downed tree, the limb snapped and struck the employee resulting in a fractured foot and four broken ribs.
An employee was demolishing a floor on a construction site. The employee fell through the floor and sustained broken bones in their left hand.
An employee was separating product from an animal carcass using a saw and amputated their left thumb tip just below the nail.

Employees were moving sows. An employee stepped out of a storage area, saw some sows coming down the hallway, and stepped back into the storage area. Before the employee could get the door latched, the sows hit the door, which knocked the employee down to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken left hip.
On March 29, 2021, an employee sustained burns to the hand after retrieving a utensil that was dropped into boiling water.
An employee was walking up a set of four or five stairs. The employee fell, suffering arm, shoulder, and head injuries from the impact.

An employee was conducting maintenance on machines in an open warehouse location. The employee developed difficulty breathing, caused by chemical vapors from an intermediate bulk container that was being drained about 30-50 feet away.
An employee was stepping into an access hatch at the same time that the hatch was opened from below. The employee fell 3 feet and suffered a broken tibia.
On March 29, 2021, a temporary employee sustained an amputation to the tip of his thumb while attempting to dislodge a stuck blade in a running machine.

An employee was installing hardware during the construction of a bridge. While walking to get a board along the bent end (where the bridge and ground meet) the employee stepped onto uneven or loose ground, lost his balance, and rolled his ankle. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle.

An employee was standing on a plant stand, hanging a frost cover over the plants in a store's garden section. She fell backward from the stand, landing on her back and suffering a potential lower-back fracture.
An employee was shearing metal on a shear machine when the plate came down on his left hand, resulting in an amputation to the pinky finger pad.
An employee was pushing a shopping cart on a driveway. The employee tripped while trying to grab a tray that was falling off the cart and fell to the pavement, suffering a broken pelvis.

Employees were using an overhead crane to put a 500-pound water pump onto three V-shaped stands. The pump shifted, and an employee's right middle fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle by a hook from a strap on the pump and the stand.
An employee was standing outside his forklift, cleaning it, when another forklift backed into him. He suffered internal injuries.

An employee was lifting an electric pallet jack onto a manual pallet jack. When the employee put the electric pallet jack down, his left index finger got caught between the pallet jack and the wheels and amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was filling a towel dispenser in a warehouse restroom. The restroom door closed on the employee's left hand, causing an amputation of the little finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a trailer and missed a step causing them to fall to the ground and sustain injuries requiring hospitalization.
An employee was using a table saw to cut plastic for conveyor belt transition plates when the saw came into contact with their left pinky finger, resulting in a broken bone and laceration.
An employee was on top of a truck when a high wind caused him to fall to the ground about 10-12 feet below, resulting in a right leg injury.

A hardware installer was working on the fourth level of an apartment construction site. The employee was reaching for hardware that was on a forklift that had been raised to the fourth level and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken orbital bone, and lacerations to the face, torso, and right arm near the armpit.
An employee was assembling a packaging conveyor system when their right index finger was pulled into a sprocket of the running conveyor, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On March 30, 2021, an employee was operating a rubber mill and was removing rubber pieces from the exit side of the cutting machine when the blade amputated the employee's right index finger.

An employee was operating a pallet jack when his load hit a bin, causing the pallet jack to swerve into racking. The handlebars of the jack got caught in the racking and pinned the employee. The employee sustained fractures to the right ankle, the pelvis, and the sacrum.
An employee was looking under a conveyor when it caught his right hand, causing multiple lacerations to the hand.
A security guard was responding to a combative patient when the patient punched the guard in the forehead. The security guard became diaphoretic and fainted. The security guard was hospitalized.
Two employees were working with a fabrication machine. The machine crushed two fingers on one of the employees' right hand.
An employee was moving a pallet with a pallet jack. His leg struck a conveyor that had been extended to a truck trailer. The employee suffered a lower left calf laceration and was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading a truck. The truck pulled away and the employee fell off the back of it, suffering a broken left leg.

An employee was pulling a metal cart with a plastic roll on it toward a flatbed truck. His left little finger was caught between the cart handle and a piece of metal pipe on the truck. The finger was lacerated and the employee was hospitalized.

On March 30, 2021, an employee was standing on a metal step, clearing built-up slag to allow water to flow through a trough. When he stepped down, his foot entered the hot water and he suffered second-degree burns to the right shin.
An employee was starting up a tractor. When it started, it ran over the employee, breaking his left leg and hip.
An employee was hospitalized for carbon monoxide poisoning after painting outside.
An employee was spotting a dump truck. The truck raised its bed into a high-voltage overhead powerline while the employee was touching a hopper connected to the truck. The employee was shocked.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor, suffering a head injury and a broken wrist.
An employee was walking through a production area when she tripped and fell over a small lip between the two floor surfaces, fracturing her hip.
On March 30, 2021, an employee walked across an insulated concrete blanket at a work site. He slipped and fell on the blanket, suffering a femur fracture above the right knee, and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell while walking back from a dumpster. She landed on the concrete and suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was diagnosing an issue with a military vehicle when their left thumb struck against the vehicle's engine fan, amputating the thumb tip.
An employee was walking to a trash compactor. He stepped up onto a wood platform and fell to the ground about 2 feet below, suffering a broken left wrist. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell down stairs, suffering a broken left humerus. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing down a pallet of material. She slipped and fell to the ground, breaking her elbow and twisting her ankle.
An employee slipped on a pickle while cleaning. He fell to the floor and suffered a broken femur.
An employee tripped over a pipe on a barge and fell. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee sustained a puncture injury to the pelvic area after tripping and falling on 4-inch concrete anchor bolts.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking, resulting in a broken bone in the upper left leg and hospitalization.
On March 31, 2021, an employee was emptying a trash hopper when his finger was crushed in the hopper resulting in medical amputation of the finger above the knuckle.

An employee was using needle-nose pliers to remove shrink wrap from conveyor sprockets when the machine cycled and pinched his finger in the chain and sprocket. The employee's middle fingertip was amputated.
While loading cattle, an employee attempted to evade a yearling cow and fell onto an irrigation pipe, causing a deep laceration to the left knee.
An employee was descending a set of temporary stairs when they slipped and fell, resulting in fractures in their left foot.
An employee was stocking shelves when they suffered an allergic reaction to nuts and cleaning products, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was attempting to remove a jammed piece of paper from the copier when they lost balance and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a dislocated right shoulder and a broken right hip.
An employee was driving a wooden stake into a concrete form with a hammer. The hammer struck the employee's left index fingertip, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

A temporary employee had just transferred trash and recyclables into a metal trash bin and tried to push the bin into the arms of a trash compactor. The employee pushed the start button and held it down to raise the bin and empty the trash into the compactor, but when the compactor was at its furthest point, he noticed that trash was dangling down. He had reached into the bin to pull out the trash when the bin slid the rest of the way down the compactor arms and caught his fingers against the compactor. The last joints of his middle and index fingers were amputated.
An employee was placing material to be cut in a saw when the saw activated, resulting in the amputation of four fingers on the left hand.

An employee was moving products from the truck into the backroom of a retail store. She tripped over a box of product near a walkway aisle and fell on her left hip and leg. The employee sustained a broken left hip.

An employee was clearing wood from the molder when the feed wheel picked up the next wood board pushing the board forward. The employee's right index finger was struck by the board and pinched between another board, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell forward, sustaining a laceration to the forehead that required hospitalization.

At about 9:00 a.m. on March 31, 2021, an employee was using an overhead crane to pick up steel tubing to put it into a tube cutter machine. As the employee reached to remove a tag affixed to the tubing, his left middle fingertip was amputated by the guide gate of the tube cutter.

Two employees were rolling a wooden cable spool that weighed approximately 500 lbs. down a flight of stairs. The employees were in the process of spinning the spool around a stair railing when it suddenly rolled down the stairs and pushed an employee to the second deck. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a partial ear avulsion.
On March 31, 2021, an employee was driving a pallet jack out of a freezer when her hand was caught between the jack's handle and a rack. She suffering an amputation to a fingertip.
An employee was operating a rolling machine on top of compost when the rolling machine ran over the top of the employee's hand, resulting in amputation of a finger.

At about 9:30 a.m. on March 31, 2021, an employee was backing an order picker through a narrow aisle, carrying empty pallets. The top few pallets struck a box, then struck the uprights of the high rack, and then struck the employee's left leg and pinned it against the order picker. The employee suffered severe contusions.
An employee was walking to inspect an electrical supply issue and slipped and fell on the wet sidewalk, resulting in fractured vertebrae.
The employee was performing pipefitting duties when they tripped and fell over a bracket on the floor of the inverted hull section, injuring their ankle and back.
On March 31, 2021, an employee was open the doors on the back of a semi trailer. A gust of wind came and moved the door, knocking him to the ground. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was aiding in production when another employee moved the table that the injured employee was resting his left hand on, which pinched his hand between the table and a stanchion and caused a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
A chef was slicing limes with a knife and amputated their left ring fingertip.
A heavy work piece fell out of a machine lathe while it was being lifted out with a crane. It fell and crushed a finger on the lathe operator's hand. The finger was later amputated.
An employee was cutting lumber on a table saw when their left hand contacted the saw, resulting in lacerations to three fingers that required surgery.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift. As the forklift went around a corner, the employee's left foot was caught between the forklift and a rack. The employee suffered a crushed left foot and ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning process lines with steam. After opening the hatch of a 3-foot pit, the employee lost his balance and his leg fell into the pit. The open steam line caused second degree burns to the employee's knee and thigh area that required hospitalization.
An employee was closing the tailgate of a pickup truck and caught their left ring finger in the hinge of the gate, resulting in an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was running to catch a bus and fell to the ground, fracturing their right leg.

An employee was using a tugboat to winch the barge. While the employee was winching the barge, the winch handle spun backward and struck the employee's right wrist, resulting in a compound fracture of the wrist.
An employee was assembling a bike and fixing the brakes when their right thumb tip was amputated (without bone loss).
An employee was walking on the boom of a crane when they tripped on their harness and fell, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was removing a bolt from an engine block when the block sank due to rain and crushed the employee's foot, resulting in broken bones.
An employee was descending an extension ladder when they fell, resulting in a fractured L1 vertebrae.
An employee was moving a refrigerator by hand on an unguarded loft and fell 9 feet onto concrete, resulting in fractures to the ankle, tibia, and heel.

An employee was using a broom handle to break up grain debris at his feet. The debris broke free, causing him to fall feet forward onto a grain belt conveyor, 5 feet below the opening. He suffered a scalp injury and possibly other injuries.

An employee was performing a leak repair on the roof of a building. The employee's leg became caught on an object, causing the employee to trip and fall through a skylight approximately 15 feet to the concrete below. The employee sustained broken bones and contusions.
An employee was installing a track pod assembly onto an SSL chassis on the main assembly line when their right index finger was trapped between the track pod and chassis, resulting in  amputation.

An employee was unhooking a planter from a tractor when the planter shifted and fell toward the employee, pinning him against the tractor. The employee was hospitalized with injuries to the jaw and torso.
