Employees were guiding a steel lid for a concrete ground box. The lid was suspended by a backhoe. The knuckle of the backhoe curled, causing the lid to swing and pinch an employee's left hand against the ground box resulting in amputation of two fingers.

On April 1, 2021, a temporary employee stepped out of the truck to pick up a residential recycling bin while the truck was moving and he slipped and fell. His left leg was run over by the truck's tire, resulting in hospitalization and the amputation of his left leg.
A forklift operator had dismounted his forklift when he was struck by a farm tractor. The employee was pinned between the forklift and the tractor, resulting in a leg amputation above the knee.
An employee was repairing a damaged bundle of lumber and was struck by another bundle coming out of the machine. The employee sustained a broken left tibia that required surgery.

An employee was working on the limits of a conveying ash booster pump discharge valve. When the employee turned, his head struck a straight valve handle, resulting in a laceration to the lower right eyelid.
An employee was delivering an order to a customer's car when he fell and hit his head on the concrete.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk and stepped off the edge into mulch and fell, resulting in a fractured hip.

An employee was moving a barge upriver, using a winch and cable to give slack in the mooring lines so they could be removed. As the cable reeled in on the winch, it caught the employee's life vest and pulled him into the winch pulley bolted to a stanchion. He suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a walkie rider and pinned their ankle between the walkie rider and a rack base guard plate while turning. The employee sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was getting the barge ready for a load of soy beans. The employee opened the top door of the grain barge and lost his balance, falling 10 to 14 ft. to the bottom of the barge and resulting in blunt force trauma and multiple broken bones.
An employee was unloading a trailer when a pallet of freight shifted, causing the freight to fall and strike the employee. The employee sustained injuries to the head, shoulder, and hand.
An employee was walking into the facility entrance and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left hip.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut pork ribs when his finger contacted the saw blade, resulting in a laceration to the left index finger.

An employee was removing a squirrel's nest in order to install a router. The employee stepped down from the ladder to the ground and injured their right leg. The employee had surgery for fractured bones.
An employee was on a 5 ft. tall scaffold when the scaffold board gave way, causing the employee to fall through to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken right ankle.

An employee was opening the gates to the dumpster area in order to dump materials. The wind blew one of the halves of the metal gate, striking the employee in the face. The employee was hospitalized with face and neck injuries.
An employee was repairing a roof. The employee fell through the roofing surface to the ground 12-14 below, suffering broken vertebrae.

An employee was setting a metal strip coil in a mill utilizing one of the racks. As the employee was pulling out the crane, the hook caught the last coil and pulled it out of the rack. When the coil tipped backward off the rack, it fell, pinning his right leg to the ground and crushing it.
An employee was walking across a parking lot when they slipped on black ice and fell to the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the ankle/foot.
An employee was cleaning an operating room when they tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in injuries to the lower back, shoulder, and knee.
An employee was swabbing a drain and caustic splashed into the employee's right eye, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
On April 2, 2021, an employee was changing the pads on a grinding machine when the top of the machine fell down on the employee's hand, resulting in amputation of the left middle fingertip.
An employee was clearing excess material from an interfolder machine when a knife inside the machine caught and amputated the tip of the employee's right middle finger.
An employee was using a saw that was binding. He was holding a board with his right hand and reaching with his left hand when the saw amputated his left thumb from the knuckle up.
An employee was handling a piece of steel and lacerated his finger, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was at his locker, gathering his equipment when he began feeling ill. The employee went into the cooling room to sit for approximately 20 minutes. The employee left the cooling room to report to his supervisor that he was feeling unwell. While his supervisor was talking to him, the employee collapsed in the supervisor's office and was unresponsive. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee was cleaning a machine when their left hand fingers were pulled into the machine, resulting in a degloving of three fingertips and broken knuckles that required surgery.
An employee was unjamming a parts elevator when his arm became stuck in the parts elevator. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm.
An employee was walking in the RV lot when they tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was hanging and setting anchors on a barge when he was struck in the face by an anchor line, resulting in a facial injury and several lacerations.
On April 2, 2021, an employee was walking in the parking lot when they slipped on ice and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery for fractures.
An employee fell from a 13" step stool to the floor, resulting in a skull fracture.
An employee was under a jammed notching machine, removing a board, when the machine amputated the tip of their left middle finger.
An employee was walking to the tube station when she tripped and fell to the floor, sustaining a fractured right wrist and left shoulder.
An employee fell from a chair. The employee's right arm struck a safe mounted to the floor, and the employee suffered injuries to the right arm, lower back, and right hip.
An employee was retrieving tools from his work van when the van door closed on his left middle finger resulting in an avulsion injury that required surgery.

An employee was on a ladder retrieving a box of soap from the top shelf of a storage room. The employee lost balance and fell from the ladder to the floor resulting in contusions to the head and back and numbness in the right arm and hand.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a radial arm saw when they suffered the amputation of their thumb.

An employee was walking while carrying a book of rug samples when one sample fell from the book. The employee tripped over the sample and fell, resulting in a broken right hip and a sprained left wrist.
A car struck an employee in a parking lot. She fell backwards onto the ground and suffered a broken femur. She was hospitalized.

On 4/3/2021, an employee was stacking dry ice on a production line when the saw that cuts the dry ice jammed. The employee attempted to clear the jam when the saw contacted his fingers, resulting in hospitalization and subsequent amputation of his left ring and pinky fingers.
An employee was inspecting a tire/wheel assembly after he mounted it on a vehicle when the tire blew off, fracturing his left wrist.
An employee was riding a ski lift to the top of the slope. The employee fell while exiting the lift and sustained broken ribs and loss of oxygen.
An employee was working with another employee on the wire spooling machine. The employee's leg was caught on the wire being spooled, causing the employee to fall and break his leg.
On April 3, 2021, a resident punched an employee on the left side of her face. She was hospitalized with a fracture to her left eye socket.
An employee was serving food and had an allergic reaction to the fish that was being served. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a grill using water. The lid of the grill fell, causing hot water to splash onto the employee. The employee sustained burns to the face and eye.
An employee fell while walking down a flight of stairs. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised left leg and foot, as well as lower back pain.
An employee was patrolling a hospital campus when they were struck by a vehicle. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg, a broken arm, and a bruised internal organ.
On April 4, 2021, an employee was cleaning dust off a planer machine when their glove was caught in the machine, pulling in their hand and amputating the left middle finger.
An employee was cutting plywood using a table saw. The employee's left hand slipped and contacted the saw blade, resulting in a laceration to the index and middle fingers.
An employee was doing carpentry work when he fell approximately 6 feet from scaffolding. He landed on the floor and sustained a concussion.
An employee was on a ladder performing a roof inspection when the ladder shifted and the employee fell approximately 10 ft. to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured shoulder and pelvis.
An employee sustained a contusion/laceration to their right hand when their hand was caught in the tension stand of a metal slitting machine.
An employee was standing at the shop when the employee was hit by a customer's car, sustaining broken ribs and punctured lungs.

An employee was working from a ladder to install an awning on the second floor of a residential building. The ladder tilted and the employee fell, striking another ladder before landing on their own ladder in a mulch bed. The employee suffered broken ribs, a partially collapsed lung, a broken and dislocated finger, a hairline leg fracture, a head wound, and overall contusions.

An employee was lowering a hydraulic trailer to the ground when a weld broke on the trailer frame causing the frame to fall to the ground. The tire on the driver's side pivoted, causing the frame to strike the employee's right forearm and fracture both bones of the forearm.
An employee was installing a beam with a chain fall when it fell and hit the employee on the top of his eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a water filter pit and fell 10 feet into the unguarded pit, resulting in broken ribs. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time.
An employee was riding a lawnmower near a creek when the lawnmower flipped into the creek, resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was building wooden cabinets using a staple gun and sustained injuries to their left hand.
The employee was walking near the fueling area in order to change trash cans when they tripped on a fuel hose and fell. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was in an attic when they tripped over a beam and fell to the floor, sustaining lacerations to the rib area and blunt force trauma to the abdomen.

An employee was driving a tugger in the warehouse and drove underneath racking, pinning himself between the backrest of the tugger and the racking unit. The employee sustained contusions to the chest.

An employee was installing an insulation roll on a roof when a gust of wind blew insulation into the employee and knocked the employee off the roof. The employee fell approximately 25 feet to ground and sustained a fractured pelvis and wrist.
An employee tripped and fell on stairs, injuring their knee.

Two employees were attempting to move a tender truck that was stuck in gravel. Employee 1 was operating a skid-steer loader with a chain that was attached to the mast and to the front of the tender truck to pull on the truck. Employee 2 was operating another skid-steer loader to push on the truck's rear bumper. Employee 1 pulled on the truck and then exited the loader to retighten the chain attached to the loader's mast. Employee 2 pushed on the truck's rear bumper and the truck traveled forward, pinning Employee 1 between the truck's front bumper and loader's mast area. Employee 1 was hospitalized for a fractured pelvic bone, two fractured hips, three fractured bones in the left leg, and internal bleeding.
An employee was assisting in closing an aircraft door when the tips of their right index and middle fingers were caught on the edge of the door, resulting in fingertip amputations.
Two employees were working and got into an altercation. One employee struck the other with a 2x4 causing head and back injuries.
An employee was using a bandsaw. The employee's glove got caught in the saw, resulting in the amputation of three fingers.

An employee was leaving a scaffold to get onto a ladder. The tank sheet buckled, causing both the ladder and the anchor of the employee's lanyard to slide off. The employee fell approximately 16 feet and sustained a fractured pelvis.

An employee was operating an overhead crane from a scissor lift. He was holding the object being lifted when the lifting hook caught his glove, causing the employee to fall 10 feet from the scissor lift and suffer fractures to his shoulder, hips, and knee.
An employee was on a ladder installing cable and fell off the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a concussion, broken ribs, and lacerations and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a pump skid when the employee was struck on the left leg by the pump skid.
An employee was operating a shearing machine when their left middle finger was caught in the clamp's pinch point, resulting in a partial amputation to the nail area.

An employee was in a trailer checking the temperature of perishable goods when they tripped over a pallet and fell backward onto the concrete dock. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and two fractured fingers.

An employee was operating a standing electric forklift putting a pallet on the floor underneath a rack. The forklift reversed quickly and the employee's arm was crushed between the forklift and the racking. The employee sustained two arm fractures.

An employee was putting down temporary reflectorized striping tape during milling operations. A vehicle ran through the work zone, striking a motorized boom and then striking the employee who was following behind the motorized boom. The employee sustained a broken leg.

On April 6, 2021, an employee was operating a forklift and activated the dead man lever in order to avoid a collision. The forklift stopped abruptly and jerked forward, causing the employee's left arm to get caught between the lift and the racking. The employee sustained a laceration to the left forearm.
An employee scratched his left eye on a stationary exterior metal panel of an ice machine.

On April 6, 2021, an employee was prying off formwork from an elevated beam and had one hand placed on a shoring frame head. When the 4x4 board came loose, one end of the board hit the employee's pinky finger resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was removing bolts from a joist assembly when a joist fell and struck the employee, breaking their ankle.
An employee was preparing demo samples when the employee tripped over an open lower cabinet door and fell to the floor, resulting in injuries to the shoulder and hip.

An employee was painting from a 10-foot ladder that was leaning against a wall. The ladder slipped out from the employee and he fell from the third rung, striking his head on the ground and suffering a head injury.
An employee was working from a 40-foot wall when they fell 28 feet to the ground.

An employee was trying to open the door of a truck that was locked with the keys inside. He fell backward from the top exterior step of the truck. The back of his head struck the ground and he lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured skull and bleeding in the brain.
An employee was taking auto parts out of a storage room when he fell down to the first floor, injuring his right elbow.
An employee was using a cut-off saw when the saw blade amputated their left hand.

An employee was attempting to rig an 18' in diameter HDPE pipe. The employee was placing a nylon sling around the pipe when the pipe shifted unexpectedly. The employee's left pinky and ring fingers were pinched, resulting in an amputation of the ring finger to the second knuckle.

An employee was descending an A-frame ladder after filling gas in the back of a truck on a spray rig unit. The employee had one foot on the ground when his left foot got caught and he twisted and fell, resulting in a broken left femur.

An employee was loading trash bags into the back of a garbage truck. The truck backed over him. He suffered eight cracked ribs, a collapsed lung, a lacerated liver, a broken knee, a broken ankle, a gash in the lower right leg, and spine injuries.

A maintenance employee was servicing a piston cylinder when the rod and rod head came loose from the framework holding it. He and another maintenance employee were lifting the cylinder with a hoist and the cylinder head fell approximately 20-24" and struck the employee's left ring finger, causing a fracture and a partial degloving. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

While on a 6-foot rolling platform ladder, an employee was using a bandsaw to cut a section of piping. As the employee finished making a cut, the ladder tilted forward, then moved backward, before toppling over. The employee fell over the handrail of the platform and struck his ribs on the handrail of a nearby emergency exit staircase. The employee was hospitalized with four broken ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee was positioning a sheet of steel decking when they fell approximately 15 feet through a hole to the lower level. The employee sustained fractures to the head and spine.

An employee was descending from a catwalk when they missed the step onto the ladder and fell approximately 21 feet to the ground, sustaining a fractured pelvis, a chipped spine, a concussion, and a laceration to the face.

A lineman was in a bucket trying to pull the powerline when it got caught in a tree limb. The powerline then came in contact with an energized line, causing an employee on the ground that was in contact with the tail end of the line to receive an electrical shock/burn.
An employee was dumping scraps of sheet metal into a waste bin. He was retrieving some pieces of metal from the hopper when they lacerated his left index and middle fingers.

An employee was troubleshooting a prototype poultry ventilation fan, trying to point out a loose bolt or vibration. His left pinky finger contacted the moving fan blade resulting in a revision amputation.
While climbing up a ladder to clean an awning with a power washer, an employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained head trauma.
An employee was cleaning out a drain in the parking lot when they were struck by a car.
While walking in the offstage area, an employee tripped over a coat rack and fractured her hip.

Employees were unloading a tractor in order to dig up a drain line. One employee was using a pry bar to loosen the chains. The pry bar slipped and flew out of his hand, striking another employee on the hand. The employee sustained the amputation of his right middle fingertip.

A temporary employee was moving a 2' x 20' steel beam weighting between 2500 & 3000 lbs. using an overhead crane. The employee sat the steel beam on stands with chains and lifted one end of the beam with the crane when a chain caught and pulled the beam off the stands. One end of the beam landed on the employee's left foot and ankle causing crushing injuries including  broken bones that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was removing a ladder from the roof of a vehicle when the vehicle door closed on their hand. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.
An employee was moving a metal grate when his finger was pinched between the grate and an I-beam, amputating his left middle fingertip.

An employee was helping secure bridge beams that were being set when a beam broke. Concrete pieces of the beam fell and one piece struck the employee, knocking him off the column he was standing on. The employee was wearing a harness and his lanyard deployed, curtailing the fall. The employee swung back into the column, resulting in a fractured rib and lacerated spleen.
A baler door closed on an employee's finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was assisting a patient when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.

An employee was helping to recover an RV that had gone over a highway embankment. A chain broke on the rotator wrecker and swung around behind the RV, wrapping around the employee's leg. This resulted in broken bones below the employee's right knee.

An employee swept loose aluminum powder dust from an air filter into a dustpan and poured the dust into a 55-gallon water-filled sludge drum. Additional water was poured on top of the aluminum powder floating on the surface when the resulting hydrogen gas ignited, causing second-degree burns on the employee's right forearm and hand.
An employee was working in a trench making a pipe connection when the trench collapsed on the employee. The employee's leg was crushed.
An employee was riveting two pipes together using a rivet machine when the rivet hammer activated and crushed the employee's left index finger. The injury resulted in an amputation.

An employee accessed the top of a piece of equipment from a platform and had been removing a damaged motor from the equipment. The employee fell down the side of the 8-foot high piece of equipment and struck a rail and the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with three broken ribs and a contusion on the side of the head.

An employee was removing a chain binder that was used to secure cargo to a vessel. While working to free the handle of the tension binder from the deck plate using the handle of another binder, the binder suddenly released and struck the employee on the left side of his face and on the right thumb. The employee sustained a fractured right thumb and a laceration on the left cheek.
An employee was loading product when their right arm became caught in the conveyor and was amputated at the shoulder.
An employee's arm was caught by a forklift when its parking mode deactivated and the employee was dragged by the arm. The employee suffered a fractured left arm and a fractured hip.
After returning from a scheduled break, an employee was in the break room changing into their work uniform and fell onto the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip and arm.
The employee was printing labels at the printing machine when the product shifted. The employee was adjusting the product and sustained an amputation to the fingertip.

While pulling door decals off the door of a cooler, an employee fell backward off a 2-step ladder. The employee landed on the concrete floor and sustained fractures to the lower right leg and right wrist.

An employee installed new control wiring for the emergency release button on a formic acid process. When the employee tested the new wiring, formic acid sprayed out of a secondary pipe and struck the employee causing chemical burns to the face, chest, right shoulder, and arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing scrap pieces of board from a conveyor and sustained an amputation to the right pinky fingertip.
While running wood through a jointer, an employee's right ring fingertip was partially amputated by the jointer's blade.
An employee was using hot water to clean a vapor recovery line on a cargo tank trailer. As he removed the line, hot water sprayed his left foot, burning the top of the foot.
The injured employee was on a ladder retrieving a part when another employee bumped the ladder and the injured employee fell to the floor and broke broken a hip.
An employee was operating a pressure washer. A fitting failed and high-pressure water was injected into the employee's leg.

An employee was welding the bottom of a chute on the underside of a bin. Hot material came through a small gap between a gate inside the bin and the chute, contacting the employee below. The employee received second and third burns to the neck.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder when he lost his footing and fell feet first to the ground. The employee's ankles were injured.
A temporary employee was driving a pallet jack to a charging station when her leg was crushed between the pallet jack and the charging station platform.

Two employees were moving gate valves from one pallet to another. A gate valve slipped and one of the employees reached out to catch it from falling and pinched his right middle finger between the falling valve and another valve, severing the fingertip.
An employee was using an impact torque wrench on a fluid end cap when the wrench spun and crushed the tip of his right middle finger.
A delivery driver was getting ready to deliver food. While attaching a trailer to the truck, the employee's foot got caught on the hitch trailer. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.
An employee was chopping basil with a knife and severed the tip of his left thumb.

An employee was clearing sawdust from a framework. The employee kicked a pile of sawdust next to a conveyor roller and the employee's pant leg was caught in the roller. The employee sustained two right leg fractures that required surgery.
An employee was moving sandbags when they became dizzy.

An employee was loading OTRs into a trailer at the loading dock. As he was pushing an OTR into a truck, it veered off the left side of the ramp and tipped over onto the driver sign-in desk. The employee was holding the OTR on the side as it rolled off the dock plate and his ring finger was crushed between the OTR and a metal table resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was setting up to cut pipe with a saw. A clamp actuated and pinched the employee's left index finger between the clamp and a pipe. The distal third of his left index finger was amputated.
An employee was removing an electrical panel when an arc flash occurred. The employee sustained electrical burns to the face, neck, and arms.

An employee was drilling holes in C-channel beams that were 16 feet long and weighed approximately 400 pounds. The employee placed three beams on saw horses. After drilling holes, he manually flipped them over. When the employee flipped the third beam it landed at an angle and fell off the saw horses and struck and fractured the employee's right leg and left ankle. The employee was hospitalized for surgery on his left ankle.
An employee tripped while turning to walk away from a sink. She fell, suffering a broken femur.
An employee was on a ladder nailing patter on top of a two-story house. The ladder slipped, causing the employee to fall and fracture their right hip and left foot.
An employee was driving an armored vehicle when it broke down. The employee inhaled smoke and was hospitalized.
On April 8, 2021, an employee was operating a crane when its load shifted and struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.

A steel member was being transported by a material handling magnet. The magnet lost contact with the steel member surface while it was being transported to the staging area. The steel member fell and struck the injured employee's leg resulting in a lower leg fracture.
A wall fell while being taken down. It struck an employee in the back of the leg, causing a laceration.
On April 8, 2021, an employee was setting and securing the dock plate when she fell onto the concrete floor landing on her right side.

An employee arrived at a location to shut some production wells. While walking through the location, the employee tripped on a 1-inch piece of pipe and fell to the ground on their right side. The employee sustained a fractured hip requiring hospitalization.
An employee was walking up the K-loader when they slipped and fell over the side of the K-loader to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured right arm.

An employee was trying to rotate a section of aluminum screen enclosure from a balcony next to overhead power lines. The aluminum frame made contact with a power line, and the employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to the hands and chest.
While waiting next to a truck to load it with trash, an employee was stung by a bee. The employee's hand got infected and swelled, requiring hospitalization.
An employee walked around the back of a brake press when they knocked over trays and then tripped over the trays, falling to the floor and resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was walking through the production floor when she lost her balance and stepped between a transfer car and the transfer car pit wall, resulting in a horizontal scrape to the outside of her left calf.

An employee was riding on the back of a trash truck when the truck hit a bump in the road, causing the employee to fall from the truck and hit his head on the pavement. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury/concussion.
An employee was escorting a forklift driver in the outside lawn and garden area. The employee fell to the ground while walking and was hospitalized with fractures to the right wrist and hip.

An employee backed a trailer into an empty space, then got out of the truck. The truck rolled back and its door pinned the employee against the adjacent trailer. The employee suffered three broken ribs.

An employee was loading milk into the milk tanker from the silos. The employee noticed a leak on the valve stem and went to stop the leak by tapping it. The valve closed on his left ring fingertip and amputated it.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack and turned toward a stationary object. The employee jumped from the pallet jack in order to avoid a collision and their right foot was caught between the pallet jack and a parking block.
An employee was backing up a standup forklift when their left foot was crushed between the forklift and a rack, resulting in a fracture and lacerations.
An employee was taking an empty two-wheeler back to a truck. The employee slipped on wet pavement and fell, suffering an abdominal pull that required surgery.
An employee was on a stepladder by a press, clearing a jam from a conveyor. A robotic arm knocked him from the stepladder to the ground. He struck his head and suffered a broken wrist.

An employee was pushing a welder on a dolly when the dolly hit a bump in the concrete and flipped up. The welder shifted, and the employee's right pinky finger was caught between the dolly and the welder. The finger was amputated. The employee was hospitalized and the finger was reattached.

An employee was aligning a conveyor with a press used for laminating plywood. When the employee kicked the conveyor, his right foot was pulled into a chain and sprocket. The employee attempted to free his foot with his right hand which was also pulled into the chain and sprocket. The employee sustained the amputation of two toes on their right foot. The chain and sprocket were not guarded at the time of the incident.

While prepping a push-boat to move to another location, employees filled both motors with 2-stroke oil and put the cowlings back on the motors. An employee went to start the motors. The port motor started but the starboard motor hesitated. The employee tried again; the starboard motor started up but fire shot out and fuel that leaked caught fire. One employee was hit by the flames, and sustained burns on the neck, left hand, and both legs.

An employee was pulling parts to fulfill a customer order in the parts department. While utilizing a Work-Assist Vehicle (WAV) to pull two 89-lbs. axles, the remaining axles in inventory shifted. One axle rolled forward and struck the employee in the face. The employee sustained a fractured cheek bone.

Employees were putting in the helical foundation to install a PTC tower when they hit rock and stopped work. An employee took the boom truck remote control and climbed onto the boom truck bed and proceeded to disconnect the foundation adapter plate from the helical foundation. The employee then lifted the boom to remove the helical foundation from compression and pushed the foundation over toward the ground at the back of the boom truck. At that time, the injured employee came around the back of the boom truck and was struck by the falling foundation, resulting in a fracture to the right foot and a tendon injury to the right knee.

An employee was felling a large tree. As the tree fell, it contacted another large tree, causing that tree to become uprooted and fall. That tree then contacted a dead tree, causing a large section of the dead tree to break off. Pieces of the dead tree section struck the employee in the back, resulting in three fractured ribs.
An employee was servicing industrial manufacturing equipment. His left hand became caught in one of the mixer's paddles and his entire left arm was amputated.
A bale of cardboard fell onto an employee, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was removing a wall brace when a telehandler tire caught the employee's jeans and pulled him down to the concrete floor. The tire then ran over the employee's left foot and crushed it.
An employee was backing a stand-up electric pallet jack out of a trailer freezer. The employee's right leg was caught between the pallet jack and a pallet, causing a hairline fracture to the leg.

An employee was performing maintenance on a loader. While checking the tension of the alternator belt their fingers were caught in the belt. The employee sustained an amputation of the index and middle fingertips.

An employee was about to move a vehicle that was exiting the car wash for drying and detailing. When the vehicle was started, it raced forward, crossing the property and then six lanes of traffic, and crashed into a structure across the street. The employee suffered a head injury and concussion when the air bags deployed.
An employee was repairing a cylinder on a tractor with a backhoe. After pulling a lever, the employee was caught between the backhoe arm and a raise outrigger, resulting in a broken jaw.
On April 8, 2021, an employee was walking on a warehouse floor when a forklift backed into him. He suffered foot and leg injuries and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting material with a circular saw when his middle and ring fingers contacted the saw resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was cutting a strap on a breakdown unit. The employee fell backwards and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee fell while skiing, suffering a broken right leg.

An employee was following other employees out of a 53-foot trailer. He stepped on rollers and fell into the belly of the trailer, which was about 3 feet deep. He suffered three broken ribs, a collarbone fracture, and a brain bleed.

An employee was climbing an extension ladder with his tools in a bucket. As he reached the top of the ladder and raised the bucket to the third floor, he fell from the ladder onto the decking of the second floor 15 feet below. He suffered a broken vertebra.
An employee fell off of a 6-foot ladder while working on the front elevation of a home. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was operating a stand-on mower next to a chain link fence and struck a fence post. The employee was thrown onto the mower's right control handle, resulting in an abdominal injury.

An employee was moving pallets out of a dairy cooler. As the employee pulled a motorized pallet jack out from under a pallet, his leg was caught between the jack and the wall. He suffered a broken fibula.
An employee was stepping down from a machine when his knee gave out and he fell 22 inches to the floor below.
An employee was bitten by a patient while treating the patient. The employee suffered an amputation to a finger.

An employee was operating a zero-turn commercial lawn mower when they were thrown from the  mower and their left leg became caught in the rotating blade. The employee's left leg was amputated mid-calf.
On April 9, 2021, an employee was assisting in a dumpster collection. His left index finger was crushed when the mechanical sweeper engaged.  He was hospitalized and had surgery on his finger.
An employee was cleaning a meat saw and amputated their right index fingertip.

An employee was standing at the top of a belt loader, getting ready to load an airplane with luggage. The loader was energized, and the employee fell to the concrete about 6 feet 7 inches below. He suffered a laceration to the back of the head, as well as a C6-C7 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) surgery.
An employee was pointing at the source of a squeaking sound on a hook-and-loop fastener dot application machine. Moving parts caught his left middle finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
At 9:00 a.m. on April 9, 2021, an employee fell to the floor while walking down a hallway. He suffered a broken right humerus.
An employee was tightening a flange on a hot water pipe. The hot water burst out of the pipe and sprayed him, burning his torso, abdomen, and thigh.

On April 9, 2021, a 16-inch tire spontaneously released air after being mounted on a 16-inch rim, then taken off the mounting equipment. An employee was struck by the tire and the rim, suffering fractures to the left hand.
An employee was driving a forklift inside a box truck. While adjusting the load, the employee's leg was pinned by the forklift, resulting in a leg fracture.

An employee walked into a location in a tank containment dike where part of a grate had been removed, causing his right leg to sink in hot wash water up to his knee. The water filled his rubber boot and he suffered second- and third-degree burns below the knee.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a fixed ladder on a rail car. The employee suffered a broken left wrist and left leg.

An employee was moving a 30-gallon poly drum containing a halon fire extinguisher. He opened the container to verify its contents. Once he unlatched the drum ring, the lid flew off of the drum and struck the left side of his face. He suffered a fracture to the left eyebrow and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was climbing down an extension ladder. The employee fell to the grass about 8 to 10 feet below, suffering a broken left elbow.

An employee was unloading a trailer using a forklift. He left the forklift and removed a strap securing freight to the wall on a deck over other freight. One or more of the four beams running from one side of the trailer to the other failed, and the freight fell forward onto him. He suffered a broken fibula and tibia.
An employee was pulling in a line of shopping carts when his knee gave out and he fell on his left side. He reinjured a left femur fracture and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was working inside a building on a fixed platform, feeding pipe upward through a hole to a roof. Ammonia leaked from a pipe about 15 feet away. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from a respiratory illness.
A powered industrial truck backed into an employee, who suffered a broken pelvis with internal bleeding. The employee was hospitalized.
At about 5:45 p.m. on April 10, 2021, a customer's child bumped into an employee in a store, causing the employee to bump into a box. Her ring fingernail was removed at the hospital.
At about 6:45 a.m. on April 10, 2021, an employee was scraping down the inside of a mixing bowl when the mixer dough hook caught his index finger. He suffered a broken finger and a cut.
An employee was cleaning a roller on a manure belt. The employee's left arm was pinched between the belt and the roller and was broken.
An employee was delivering an order to a customer. When he left his car to make the delivery, he was carjacked and then run over by his car. He suffered skin abrasions and a spinal injury.

On April 10, 2021, an employee was observing a lawn mower that had an issue. The mower was engaged and ran over the employee's foot, lacerating it and severing a tendon. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a ham shank with a 6-inch curved knife. The knife slipped and struck his left arm, puncturing the bicep and causing a muscle injury.
An employee was leaving a patient care room when she fell forward, landing on her arms. She suffered a fracture to the right arm between the shoulder and the elbow.
An employee fell from a swivel chair to the floor, suffering injuries to the left hip, left outer thigh, and head.
An employee was on horseback trying to catch a younger horse. His horse bucked him off and he fell to the ground, landing on his head. He suffered a neck fracture between two vertebrae.

An employee was trying to fix a jam on a die press. The machine closed on his left hand, crushing, fracturing, and lacerating it. The employee's pinky finger was amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.

An employee was climbing up out of an area after inspecting a piece of equipment. When a looper table actuated, his left foot was caught and crushed between the table's mechanical stop and a mechanical block. Multiple toes were medically amputated.
On April 10, 2021, an employee was using a leaf blower. He was assisting the operator of a riding lawn mower when the mower ran over his foot, its blade amputating multiple toes.

Employees were pushing a cart loaded with 23-foot-long tubes off a trailer. The load came to a sudden stop due to an uneven dock leveling plate; some of the tubes fell onto an employee's right leg, causing multiple fractures.
An employee was struck by a forklift. He fell to the ground and the forklift's tire caught his right hand/arm. He suffered an amputation to the arm, between the wrist and the elbow.
An employee was installing grading on a 3-foot platform. He slipped off the platform and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right ankle.
An employee had just finished cleaning a ribbon mixer and was lifting himself up when a rotating mixer blade amputated his right index finger below the second knuckle.

At 12:06 a.m. on April 10, 2021, an employee was preparing tortilla dough for a machine that routinely dropped dough onto a cast pan. While the employee was pulling out the cast pan, the machine's arm struck his hand. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery to alleviate pressure.

An employee was adding metal to bins in a chrome plating hot water bath. The employee fell into a 148-degree solution of 6 percent sulfuric acid up to the waist; the employee suffered second-degree burns to the legs and was hospitalized.
At 3:15 p.m. on April 11, 2021, a dock worker was driving an electric pallet jack through a roll-up door when the door came down and broke the employee's left thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. The jack went out of control during a turn and ran over the employee's right leg, breaking the ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

A temporary employee tried to cycle a piece of machinery, but it did not complete a cycle. The employee was troubleshooting the issue when the machinery abruptly started to move and crushed his index finger. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee was attempting to remove a jam in a machine. Once the jam was removed, the machine's sock fitting cylinder continued its motion and crushed the employee's right index finger. The finger was medically amputated.

An employee was moving a triple pallet truck near a concrete curb in a warehouse. When the truck reversed, it pinned the employee's right leg against the curb. The employee suffered fractures to the lower leg and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was traveling on a dock lift when it struck an empty pallet. The employee was thrown from the lift, which kept rolling and pinned his left foot. He suffered a partial amputation to a toe.
An employee tripped over a case of water that was sitting on the floor between two store check-out lanes. She fell to the floor and suffered a broken left hip.

An employee was sorting non-machinable mail into dispatch cages when she tripped on a bundle of magazines that had fallen to the floor. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a left hip bone fracture.
While navigating a hand cart, an employee's right leg was caught under the cart. The employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left leg/knee.
An employee was walking a till to a register when she slipped on a greeting card and fell, suffering a broken pelvis. She was hospitalized.

An employee was walking through a landscape bed (bushes and mulch) to enter a building. The employee tripped on a curb/lip at the edge of a sidewalk and fell. The employee sustained face/forehead and knee injuries.
The employee was walking down the steps while delivering mail when they lost their footing and fell down the steps onto a cement walkway, resulting in a torn calf muscle on the left leg.

An employee was backing up a forklift. The employee's left thumb was caught between the forklift's overhead guard and a partially fabricated tank made of thin-gauge steel. The thumb tip was amputated.

An employee was setting up a well rig when the counterweights spun free and caught his fingers. He suffered an amputation to the right ring finger at the top knuckle and an amputation to the right little finger at the tip.
An employee was cleaning a water vessel that contained waste including hydrogen cyanide. The employee was exposed to the hydrogen cyanide and became disoriented.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when it backed into the raised forks of another, parked forklift. The employee suffered lacerations to the back of his left thigh.

An employee was clearing a steel plate trapped under a palletized coil on a conveyor. The coil was reversed while the employee's hand was on the steel plate. The employee's fingers were caught in the resulting pinch point, causing amputations to the index and middle fingertips.
An employee was adjusting steel strips in a bandsaw. He activated the hydraulic clamp to hold the material in place, and the clamp amputated the tip of his right thumb.

At 4:10 p.m. on April 12, 2021, an employee was preparing cars at the beginning of a car wash line. One of the cars accelerated and pinned the employee against another car. The employee suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was assembling a pallet using a screw gun. The gun double-bounced and shot a fastener through the base of the employee's left hand and into the wrist.

An employee was cleaning inside the CNC machine when it started and the CNC arm struck the employee. The employee suffered a broken collar bone and a deep scalp laceration. The machine's interlock device was not working at the time.
An employee was painting on top of mobile scaffold when they fell six feet, resulting in broken heels.

At 4:45 p.m. on April 12, 2021, an employee was preparing to pressure-wash an ash hopper. After he was set up, the wand slipped out of his hand and the trigger deployed when it hit the ground. Pressurized water struck his left little finger. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped while standing up from a chair, fell, and suffered a broken left hip.
An employee was driving a reach truck when it hit a guardrail. The employee suffered leg fractures.
An employee slipped and fell on a wet floor while walking into a men's room to clean it. The employee suffered a broken right leg.
An employee slipped on a puddle of water on a cafeteria floor, fell to the floor, and broke her kneecap. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
The doors on an oven blew open and struck an employee in the head. The employee developed a blood clot in the head.
A bus driver fell into a railing while walking up the steps into a bus. The driver suffered eight broken ribs.
An employee was standing outside a machine, inspecting a basket malfunction, when the counterbalance weight fell from the machine onto the employee's right foot. The foot was broken.

An employee was unloading a 32-inch-wide scissor lift from a trailer. A spotter told the employee to stop the lift because it was not completely lined up with the ramp. The employee stopped the lift, but it tipped and fell to the ground with the employee inside it. The employee suffered a broken left femur.
An employee jumped about 6 feet into a gravel area and broke his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee had an asthma attack after entering a patient room.
A technician was inspecting the belts on a machine when it started unexpectedly, catching his left index finger in the belts and resulting in an amputation at the first joint.
An employee was working with a metal shearing machine. The machine partially amputated the employee's left ring finger.
An employee's arm was sucked into the hose of a sand vacuum. The employee suffered bruising and abrasions and was hospitalized, requiring shots and IV treatment.
An employee was loading a part into a gang mill. When the clamping mechanism was activated, it caught his right index finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
On April 12, 2021, an employee was operating a jointer machine. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the left index finger while removing the wood panels from the machine.

An employee was operating a road grader. The grader stopped and the employee dismounted to check it. The grader then began moving. The employee chased it down and jumped up to stop it, but fell under it. The employee suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was working in an elevator that was being built. While stepping from the floor of the elevator (which was raised 4 feet off the floor on sawhorses) to an 8-foot fiberglass ladder, he missed his rung and fell backwards, landing on his shoulder on the floor. He suffered a shoulder injury.
An employee lost consciousness due to heat exposure after moving refrigerant to the roof of a building.

An employee was stripping concrete forms from a 10-foot step ladder. He lost his balance and fell 5 to 6 feet to the concrete floor below, landing on his feet and then his knees. He suffered injuries to both knees and was hospitalized.

An employee was sorting steers in an alley. The employee's right ring and little fingers were crushed between the gate and the steer, and the employee's right thumb was lacerated. The ring and little fingers were medically amputated at the first knuckle below the nail.
An employee suffered a lower back strain while standing up from a work stool.

An employee removed a cap from a gravity-fed water line to use water to clean the line. Hot water from the line struck the employee's left forearm, causing second-degree burns. The employee was hospitalized.
On April 12, 2020, an employee tripped on a rock and fell to the floor, breaking her wrist. She was hospitalized.

An employee was pulling stainless expanded metal from a rack. The metal lacerated the employee's right hand, cutting through an artery and a tendon. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was moving product from a skid. The employee tripped over banding on the concrete and floor and fell, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was using a plasma cutter to cut the top of a barrel that had been filled with flammable liquid. The barrel, with residual antifreeze under pressure, exploded. The employee suffered a jaw fracture and a brain bleed.
On April 12, 2021, an employee was on a ladder, attempting to throw a pallet into a dumpster. He fell to the ground 7 feet below and suffered a compound fracture to the left leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on the RF generator portion of a beam press. The employee contacted a live electrical conductor and electricity entered the employee's flashlight and exited the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized for electric shock.
An employee was participating in training exercises and was hospitalized for a muscle injury.

A metal tote was being carried on a forklift. The tote shifted forward during a turn, slid off the forks, and struck an employee standing below. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and a fractured knee.
An employee was changing safety filters when a filter that was under pressure sprayed hot juice onto the employee, resulting in burns to the neck and back.
An employee was working underneath a vehicle on a car lift when the car lift lowered onto the employee and fractured their pelvis.
An employee was helping the operator of an assembly stand. The machine was engaged and the stand amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was power-tapping a hole in a pump stuffing/packing box using a vertical knee mill. The employee was wiping away metal debris with his gloved hand when the glove became entangled on the rotating tap and pulled the employee's fingers around, cutting through the glove. The employee's left pinky finger was amputated.

An employee was using a forklift to load empty pallets onto a trailer. His forklift struck another lift, parked nearby. He suffered a laceration to the right lower leg that required hospitalization and stitches.
An employee was preparing to move a crate when their left leg became caught between a truck bed and a dock, resulting in an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was checking for an irrigation leak near a retaining wall when the employee slipped and fell from the retaining wall to the concrete below, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was using a mixing machine. The employee was caught in the mixer and suffered broken bones and lacerations.
An employee was walking across a roof when he fell through a section of weak decking and landed on the concrete floor about 30 feet below. He suffered injuries to the wrist, hip, and pelvis.
An employee was operating a chop saw. The sawblade cut off the tip of the employee's right thumb.

An employee was roping a steer from horseback. The steer ran in front of the employee's horse, which tripped and fell. The employee's right leg was pinned between the horse and the hard-packed ground. The employee suffered a broken fibula and broken metacarpals.
An employee was cutting a piece of baseboard with a table saw and lacerated their fingers. The saw was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was fixing a jam in a machine when the machine caught her glove and pulled in her hand, resulting in amputation of the left middle finger.

An employee was preparing merchandise for delivery when the employee stepped backward and fell 4 feet from the back of the truck to the ground. The employee hyperextended both knees tearing and straining muscles and ligaments.
On April 13, 2021, an employee was operating a walkie rider when their leg was pinned between the walkie rider and a pallet, resulting in a fractured right tibia.

An employee was performing forestry-related burning operations. He had one burn torch in his hand and another attached to his fire line pack. The second torch failed; fuel got free of the drip torch and was ignited by the open flames. The employee suffered second- and third-degree burns to the backs of his legs.

An employee entered an enclosed, automated, heated cleaning line to look for missing parts. He stepped on a grate, which slipped, causing his left leg to slip into a tank. He suffered burns and was hospitalized.
A cashier was shot during an attempted robbery.

An employee exited an HVAC mechanical room in an attic, closed the door to access an extension ladder, and fell through a suspended ceiling tile. He landed on the floor below and suffered fractures to facial bones and ribs.
The injured employee was setting up a hydraulic brake press for production and was running a test piece when the foot pedal was pressed and the employee's left hand was cut and crushed.
An employee was stepping off a fixed ladder. She fell at the fourth step and broke her left ankle.

An employee was taping boxes with a manual taper. The employee reached into the taping mechanism to pull a piece of tape off the machine. The taping mechanism cycled, causing the tape blade to lacerate and partially amputate the tip of the employee's right index finger and fingernail.
A fork truck reversed and backed onto an employee's foot. The employee suffered foot and leg injuries including a fracture, swelling, and tissue damage and was hospitalized.

An employee was spraying foam on the ceiling of a room above a garage. The employee fell through a floor opening, through the garage, and down to a basement floor about 20 feet below. The employee suffered pelvis injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing v-belts on a set of rolls on a rolling table that was isolated at the time. The employee was using a pipe wrench to manually turn the rolls so that the v-belt could be installed when his left finger became caught in the nip point of the belt and pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A wildland firefighter was physically training for the job when he started feeling aches in the shoulder area. Later that evening he felt extreme fatigue, and body aches in the shoulder area and legs. The following morning, the employee was hospitalized with a muscular injury.

An employee and a co-worker were troubleshooting a printing press when a part inside the machine came down on the employee's right index fingertip, resulting in an amputation at the cuticle that required surgery to reattach.

On April 14, 2021, an employee was using a manual pallet jack when she saw a stand-up pallet jack turning into her aisle. She stepped back, tripped over her jack, and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken right wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped and fell while walking down stairs. She suffered a head laceration and a broken shoulder/arm.
On April 14, 2021, an employee was inspecting a sowing machine that was making a loud noise and amputated their index fingertip.

On April 14, 2021, at 7:30 AM, an employee was throwing a 78-pound casting into a wire basket when the flashing on the casting caught their leather glove and pinched their right middle finger between the two castings, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was removing a hose after unloading sodium hydroxide. The hose had residual pressure in it and sprayed the employee in the face, resulting in chemical burns to the eyes.
An employee was operating a brake press when his right hand was caught in the point of operation. The employee sustained a compound fracture to the right hand.

An employee was riding on the side of a forklift while another employee operated it. The employee stepped off the forklift and their right foot was run over by the forklift's tire, resulting in a broken foot.
A siding worker was climbing up a ladder and fell approximately 6-10 feet onto a concrete slab. The employee sustained a fractured wrist, the loss of a front tooth, a swollen eye, and a broken lip.
An employee was walking down an aisle when they were struck by a metal stool that a co-worker was moving. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a fractured femur.

An employee was inserting a metal wedge between a tundish cart and a stopper to prevent movement of the cart. The wedge twisted and the employee's fingers got caught between the cart and the stopper, resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was standing on a step stool placing labels on shelves. She fell from the stool to the ground, landing on her left side and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was removing a part off a conveyor when their finger was caught between the conveyor belt and a metal part resulting in a fracture and amputation of the left ring fingertip.

An employee was walking with a pipe in his hand when he tripped and fell. The employee's finger was smashed between the pipe and the floor, resulting in the detachment of their fingernail that required surgery and hospitalization to be reattached.

An employee was part of a crew installing new electrical wiring. The employee's right hand came into contact with an energized part while his left hand was touching grounded hardware. He suffered electrical burns to three fingers on the right hand, as well as his left thumb and index finger.

An employee was placing a metal shelf (39 x 95 inches) on a storage rack. He attempted to straighten the shelf and center it on its support. The shelf slipped off the support and pinched his wrists against a cross brace. The employee sustained artery damage at the left wrist, requiring surgery.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck when the vehicle made a sudden right turn and crashed through a dock door and landed in the parking lot. The employee sustained a dislocated right shoulder, a broken ankle, and head lacerations.
An employee was struck by a piece of material ejected from a machine, resulting in a laceration to the arm as well as a laceration and bruising to the liver.

An employee was setting up a line and noticed that a polytube above a dust hopper feeder had pulled into the transition piece. He removed the lid from the feeder and was reaching in to pull the polytube out when the valve closed on the ends of his index and middle fingers, amputating the pads of his fingers.
An employee was performing surveying work on site and was bitten by a rattlesnake.
An employee was inspecting a commercial roof when they fell approximately 10 feet to the ground and fractured their humerus.

An employee had been engaged in stocking activities. While descending a rolling platform ladder, the employee fell backward to the ground. The employee was hospitalized, having sustained a fractured right clavicle/scapula, a hemorrhage, a vertebra compression fracture, and a seizure.

An employee installed a nitrogen supply line containing a particulate filter, pressure gauge, and pressure relief valve for a dual gas inlet gas booster system. When the employee pressurized the supply line, the particulate filter failed, causing the quick-disconnect metal bowl guard to become airborne and strike the employee's left pinky and ring fingers, resulting in broken bones.
An employee was moving debris with a bulldozer. A metal bar flew up and came through the bulldozer's right-side window, lacerating the employee's head.
An employee fell off a ladder while repairing a drop line. The employee landed on blacktop and suffered hip and skull fractures, a sprained left arm, and a gash over an eye.

An employee was exiting the top of a manufactured home to a catwalk when they fell from the top of the home onto the rail of the catwalk. The employee suffered a broken right humerus and dislocated his right shoulder.
An employee was hanging clothes on a rack. She turned and her left leg gave out, causing her to fall to the floor and break her left hip. She was hospitalized.

On April 15, 2021, an employee was removing rust from the spindle of a lathe using an emery cloth when their glove become entangled in the back chuck, resulting in a partial degloving of the right middle finger and complete amputation of the right ring and pinky fingers.
An employee tripped while walking out of a building and fell forward into a door. The employee suffered facial injuries, a dislocated shoulder, and a broken foot.
While treating a backyard, an employee was bitten on the left index finger by a coral snake.
An employee stepped out of a post office vehicle to deliver a parcel to a residence and twisted their ankle, resulting in a fall and an ankle fracture that required hospitalization.

On April 15, 2021, an employee conducted a test run of a new bagging machine when one of the bags got hung up in the bagging compartment. The employee attempted to unjam the machine when his left index finger became caught between the cutter and a flat piece of metal at the base. The employee suffered the amputation of his left index finger tip without bone loss.
An employee was traveling to a client's house when they were robbed and shot in the back of the leg and in the right hand. The employee was hospitalized.
At about 9:00 a.m., an employee stepped out of a waste management truck to service recycling totes. The truck's right front tire ran over his right foot, breaking his ankle.
An employee felt pain in their lower back and leg after handling a patient.
While performing a medical examination on a patient, an employee stood up and struck their head on a hanging cabinet, resulting in paresthesia related to a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was securing a water blaster in its stow position when the equipment shifted, catching the employee's finger between the locking bar and the equipment. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation on the left hand and was hospitalized.

Employees were using gas-powered tools in the basement to cut a cement floor. One employee was found unconscious. A second employee suffered dizziness, difficulty breathing, and headaches. Both employees were hospitalized due to exposure to carbon monoxide.
An employee slipped and hit a vat of hot oil/grease, which burned his arm, chest, and torso.
An employee was installing facia from a boom lift when they fell out of the lift approximately 20 feet to the ground below, resulting in fractures to their ribs and pelvis.

A temporary employee was operating a lift to move pallets to a staging area for shipment when her hand became trapped between the racking system and the lift handle, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking to lunch. The employee used the elevator to transit from their office down to the break area. The employee tripped and fell to the floor. The fall resulted in injury to their hip.

An employee and a co-worker were loosening nuts and bolts on a 24-inch, 300-pound flange with hydraulic torque equipment and a reaction arm. The hydraulic torque equipment was not functioning due to pump issues. The co-worker went to inspect it when the pump kicked on and engaged the torquing equipment. The torquing equipment moved the reaction arm, which struck the employee's right-hand index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was remote-operating a crane at about midnight. A steel beam fell and hit him in the head, knocking him into something hot. He suffered a concussion, a wound on the back of the head that required staples, and burns.
An employee was closing the door of the box truck when the pull handle broke, causing him to fall to the ground and break a bone in his lower leg that required hospitalization.
An employee was servicing a machine when it started and the base plate struck the employee, resulting in a 3-centimeter laceration to the right side of their neck.
An employee was working as a field service representative for a grocery store. The employee slipped on a wet floor in the grocery store and fell, fracturing her tailbone.

An employee was training a horse. While riding, the horse stopped and hunched its back up while the employee was coming down onto the back of the saddle. The force resulted in a fractured pelvis and internal bleeding.

An employee was wrapping ductwork with insulation in an area where wires were hanging out of an existing conduit. The employee bumped the wires and the wire nut fell off which caused the employee to sustain an electric shock and second degree burns to the right arm.

An employee was operating a two-color large image pad printer. The working table caught her left little finger as it slid back and forth, pinching it against the open rail. The fingertip was amputated.

On April 16, 2021, at approximately 1:20 a.m., an employee was installing a new emergency/parking brake on a compact wheel loader equipped with a pallet fork attachment. While the employee was under the arms and pallet fork attachment of the wheel loader, the hydraulic cable was released causing hydraulic oil and pressure to escape. The arms and pallet fork attachment lowered and pinned the employee's left arm and leg between the pallet fork attachment and the ground. The employee's lower left arm and wrist were crushed. The employee also sustained broken bones in lower left leg and multiple broken vertebrae in lower back.
An employee was using a bone saw to cut meat when the saw amputated the employee's right thumb.
On April 16, 2021, an employee slipped on an oily floor while getting up from her desk. She landed on the floor, suffered a fracture to a thoracic vertebra, and was hospitalized.

An employee was performing maintenance on a skid steer while standing in front of it. The seat fell forward and hit a control lever moving the skid steer forward. The skid steer caught the employee's leg and pants, knocked him down, and rolled over him causing pulmonary contusions and a fractured pelvis.
An employee was trying to unclog a weight scale bender when a machine door closed on his left middle finger, causing a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was setting up adsorbents near an excavator. The excavator's hoist cylinder casing struck the employee, who suffered broken ribs, a broken collarbone, and a head laceration.
An employee was trying to move a barrel of liquid. He slipped and fell back onto the ground, breaking his left hip.
An employee was doing repair/maintenance work under a utility vehicle. A chair fell onto the vehicle's controls, and the vehicle ran over the left side of the employee's body, crushing it.
An employee was sweeping around his area and putting trash into the trash can. The employee was picking up the trash by hand when a piece of plastic struck his left eye.
An employee was installing gutters from an aerial lift. The employee fell 14 feet to the ground and was hospitalized with a fractured right wrist and a contusion to the ribs.

An employee from Tractor and Equipment Company was standing on the side of a sewer pipe trench at a customer worksite. The ground caved in. The employee fell head-first into the trench and was buried up to his feet. The employee was suffocated by the soil and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion and fractures.

An employee was re-threading a paper converting machine at the embossing roller area. Their left hand became caught between the steel embossing roller and a rubber roller. The employee's left index finger was amputated.
An employee was about pack corn when his left ring finger was caught between the corn machine and the part of the machine that held boxes in place. His fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to unjam waste paper in a paper slitter. The slicer blade amputated the employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was unloading freight from a truck. The pallet holding the freight slid and the lift gate came down on the employee's left foot, breaking the foot and the ankle.

Material was being transferred from one bag to another using a forklift. One of the forklifts moved as an employee reached to open a bag further, and the employee's right ring finger was caught between the mast of one forklift and the tine of the other. The finger was amputated at the top knuckle.

The injured employee went over to assist another employee with a load of steel pieces that were being lifting by a crane. The load was approximately 3 feet off the ground when a piece of steel fell, striking and fracturing the injured employee's left foot.

An employee was working on the replacement of a metal roof when he tripped over a gutter on the flat roof and fell through the plastic cover of a skylight landing 14.5 feet below on the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to a hip, the nose, and both wrists.

An employee was helping to get bottle spray trigger caps moving through the orienter machine when his right ring fingertip got caught between two spinning belts. The employee sustained an amputation to his finger.
An employee was crossing from one side of a vessel to the other. He tripped and fell from the roof of a catwalk, landing on a shipping container 15 feet below and suffering a broken left femur.
An employee got off his reach truck. A moving cherry picker ran over his foot causing three broken toes. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat using a bandsaw. The saw partially amputated the employee's index and middle fingers.
An employee was walking around a desk. The desk caught her right foot and she fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur.

An employee was moving materials on a mezzanine when he lost balance and leaned on the railing, which failed, and then fell approximately 8.5 feet to the ground floor. The employee sustained two broken wrists, a broken rib, and a head laceration.

An employee was in front of a table bender rebar machine, bending rebar. The employee's left middle fingertip was caught in a hole in the rotating top. The fingertip was nicked, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was on top of a flatbed truck. The employee slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken wrist, eye socket, and ribs.
While cutting into cow hide with a knife, an employee's knife got stuck and then slipped, causing a laceration to their upper left arm.
While leaving a client's home, an employee slipped on snow-covered stairs and fell sustaining a broken leg. The employee was hospitalized.
While returning from her lunch break, an employee tripped and fell onto a metal track system that protrudes 10 inches from the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right humerus.

An employee was lancing a ladle when the lance pipe became stuck to the ladle opening. The employee then pulled on the pipe. The pipe detached from the lance and liquid steel poured out of the pipe and struck the employee's gloved right hand causing second degree burns to the palm and wrist.

On April 17, 2021, a maintenance employee completed greasing the shaker screen chip belt. The employee then stepped down onto the belt with their left foot, slipped on rainwater, and landed on their right leg fracturing it.
An employee was loading watermelon onto a bus. He fainted due to heat stress and fell to the ground.
On April 17, 2021, an employee was walking when they tripped and fell on the ground, sustaining a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was pushing a bread rack on wheels. The rack began to roll more quickly than the employee was moving, and the employee fell to the concrete floor. He suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee developed heat stress and a muscle injury resulting in hospitalization.
A nurse trainee was sitting on a couch, working with a patient. A child pushed her off the couch and she fell to the floor, breaking her hip.
An employee was moving steel beams to the ground when his hand got caught between two beams resulting in broken fingers.
An employee was troubleshooting and oiling a box strapper machine. The employee's left thumb was caught between the machine's chain and sprocket and was amputated.
On April 17, 2021, an employee tripped on an apron string and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip. She was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder up to the roof of a single-story house. The ladder slid out from the employee, who fell to the concrete driveway about 8 feet below. He suffered a broken leg.

An employee was preparing to unload the contents of a tanker. He climbed the tanker ladder to cut off the seal and loosen wing nuts to allow the tanker to pump off. His hand slipped and he fell 8 to 10 feet to the ground and sustained a fractured left arm and three broken left ribs. Has was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was cutting croutons and amputated his left index fingertip.
An employee was receiving shopping carts in a parking lot. A customer's car struck the employee, who suffered a broken ankle and was hospitalized.

On April 18, 2021, a maintenance employee was pushing a rail track switch lever to move the track so that an amusement park train could continue on its way. The switch was blocked, and when he gave it a harder push, his hands slipped off it. The lever hit his lower abdomen and ruptured part of his small intestine. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a wide loader when it was struck by a baggage tractor. The employee lost consciousness.
An employee was in a freezer when a forklift came through the door and struck her, lacerating her right leg. She was hospitalized.
An employee was standing on a box to reach an item on a shelf. The box tipped and the employee fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm.

An employee was cleaning a 12-foot steel bar on a rack. He was trying to keep the bar from rolling off the rack when his thumb was caught between the bar and the rack. The tip of his thumb and part of the thumbnail were crushed and amputated.

An employee was working on a water main. A vehicle entered the work zone to avoid being hit by another vehicle and struck the employee, who suffered broken legs and a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance technician was setting up a box binding machine for the next day. He came in contact with a timing belt and his right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unloading merchandise. A pallet jack took a sharp turn next to him, and a load of frozen food tipped off the jack onto him. He suffered bruises to the back and legs, as well as a closed head injury.
An employee climbed onto the back of a truck to start a generator, slipped, and fell to the ground, about 4 1/2 feet below. The employee suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee tripped over a case of water and fell, resulting in hospitalization for a hematoma to the leg.

An employee was bitten by insects on the right forearm, neck, and back during a late-night ambulance shift on April 19, 2021. The forearm bites resulted in cellulitis, and the employee was hospitalized.

An employee was sitting in the cab of a truck that was backing up. When the truck stopped, the employee stepped out of the truck and the truck pulled forward, running over his foot. The employee required surgery for an injury to the foot.

An employee was getting down from the back of a scrap tire trailer. The employee grabbed the mast of a forklift just as the mast was engaged; the employee's finger was caught between the mast's telescoping sections. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee slipped in front of a fryer station and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was working on a balcony. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground 10-11 feet below, suffering hip and wrist fractures.
An employee was operating a reach lift. The employee's lower left leg was crushed between the reach lift and metal shelving.

An employee was unloading pre-cast concrete from his tractor trailer. He fell from the truck bed to the ground, landing on his back and hitting his head. He suffered a contusion to the back, as well as a concussion.
An employee was working on a window regulator when the mechanism amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was moving a pallet. When he swung the pallet to the floor, a protruding nail on the pallet cut his left forearm and hand. He suffered a broken left wrist.
An employee was on a step ladder changing a light fixture. While descending the step ladder, he slipped and fell to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken hip.
