An employee was fueling a mobile drill rig. When lifted, the drill boom contacted an overhead powerline. The employee was shocked, suffering a small pinhole burn.
An employee fell while cutting grass and the lawn mower ran over his left foot, amputating the big toe and part of the second toe.
An employee was unloading an old pallet jack. The tip of a finger on the employee's right hand was trapped and pinched in the jack's mechanism, then amputated.

An employee was operating a circular saw to cut wooden stakes when the saw hit a knot in the wood and kicked back in the direction of the employee. The employee sustained an amputation to his left pinky finger and lacerations to his palm and pointer finger.

An employee was troubleshooting a sheet alignment issue on a trim press. The employee's glove was caught on a spline shaft, and the employee's left thumb was injured. The employee was hospitalized and the thumb was amputated.

An employee was exiting a scaffold system into the general construction area when a co-worker who was operating a rough terrain forklift in reverse ran over the employee's foot, resulting in a broken toe, a dislocated toe, and cuts and bruises. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was placing elbow spacers between 4-inch by 4-inch, 40-foot-long billets. The tips of the employee's left pinky and ring fingers were crushed between an elbow and a billet, causing fingertip amputations.
An employee was struck by a forklift in a warehouse. Both of the employee's feet were broken.
An employee fell out of the cargo area of his delivery truck, landing on the ground and suffering fractures to the scapula and lower back, as well as a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was removing a coupon from a machine. The machine's jaws closed on his right middle finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was operating a shear. The employee's right index finger was caught in the shear as the employee adjusted metal, causing the amputation of 1 1/2 inches of the fingertip.

An employee was driving an off-road utility vehicle on a blacktop road. The employee moved to the gravel along the side of the road, then attempted to get back onto the blacktop road, and the vehicle turned over. The employee sustained a broken left ankle, injuries to his left leg, and road rash on his back.
An employee slipped and fell from a fixed ladder, landing about 6 below and fracturing a bone in his lower leg.

An employee was using an overhead gantry crane to change the battery in a forklift. The load tipped and the hook gave way, causing the battery to fall and strike the employee's left foot. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the big toe.
An employee was troubleshooting a tractor engine. The employee's hand slipped into the turbo intake, and the tip of his left little finger was amputated at the first joint.
While hanging supplies on a wall display, an employee stepped back and her flip-flop hit the corner of a box and she fell onto the floor. The employee broke her left humerus.
An employee was using a grinder to clean a metal casting. The casting fell off the table and struck the employee's foot, fracturing it.
An employee was traveling on a three-wheeled electric cart. While turning a corner, the employee grazed his leg on a steel guardrail, resulting in a deep laceration to his calf.
An employee was preparing to lift an HVAC unit with a duct lift. The duct lift malfunctioned and its handle struck the employee in the head, possibly fracturing the employee's skull.

An employee was installing neoprene vibration dampeners under an air handling unit. The unit had been lifted about 1/2 inch off a concrete slab. It slipped off the lifting mechanism and crushed the employee's fingertip.
An employee was installing a water main pipe when he became pinched between the excavator bucket and the trench box, resulting in fractured ribs that required hospitalization.
At 3:55 p.m. on April 20, 2021, an employee fell down an elevator shaft from the second-floor level in a residence under construction. The employee suffered lower leg injuries and was hospitalized.
On April 20, 2021, an employee was exposed to a chemical, possibly carbon monoxide, in a paint booth. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder to reach the cab of a container loader. He slipped and fell to the ground, suffering a broken ankle and heel.

An employee was hooking up a chain sling to lift concrete catch basin risers. He was holding the chain when the sling tightened, and the tip of his left little finger was caught between the chain and a concrete riser. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking into a building when she slipped on snow melt and fell to the ground. She suffered a broken hip.
A ranch employee's gun accidentally discharged, shooting the employee in the foot and knee.

Two employees were attempting to remove a metal box from the outside of a building. On employee cut the top two bolts holding the box to the building, so that the bottom two box could act as a fulcrum as the box fell. The other employee was walking the box down, hand over hand, when it fell. Its top left corner struck him in the head, neck, and right shoulder, and he was briefly pinned under the box. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a ladder to remove a display outside a store. He fell about 12 feet to the concrete sidewalk and suffered hip injuries. He was hospitalized.

An employee operating a transfer press was manually moving a press ram when their left hand slipped off the flywheel onto the top of a gear. The employee's third and fourth fingers became caught in the gear, resulting in an amputation to their fourth finger.
An employee was adjusting the backstop on a brake press. His left hand was caught between the press's bottom and top dies, and he suffered broken bones.
An employee fell from a ladder to the ground. He suffered brain bleeding; ear bleeding; and fractures to facial bones, his skull, his arm, his wrist, and a rib.
An employee tripped over a curb while exiting a car. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was working at a machine. His left index finger was lacerated by a part leaving the machine and entering a straightening die.
An employee was climbing down a fixed ladder from a roof into a building. He fell about 10-12 feet and suffered back and head injuries.
An employee was shutting a lift gate on a delivery truck. The employee's fingertip was caught in the gate and was amputated (without bone loss).
An employee was driving a company vehicle within the facility when the vehicle veered off the road and struck a light pole. The employee sustained injury to a wrist, and a dislocated hip.
An employee was driving a work vehicle to clock out for the end of the day when they struck a bridge plate hanger on the driver's side, resulting in multiple fractures in their left leg.
An employee fell through a skylight on a roof, landing on the ground below and suffering a back injury.

An employee was collecting a sample at a closed loop station. Recently installed tubing came loose, spraying the employee with spent acid. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the right forearm and left wrist.
An employee was inspecting a pipeline after hydroblasting. The employee was blasted with a sudden burst of high-pressure steam, suffering burns to the shoulders, hands, and knees.
On April 21, 2021, an employee was using a paint gun. As he tried to tighten or clear the nozzle, the gun sprayed his right hand, lacerating it. He was hospitalized.

An employee was standing next to a work site entrance. A truck ran over a 10-pound rock, which was pinched between the pavement and the truck's tire, then launched toward the employee. The rock struck his left shin, breaking the tibia.

On April 21, 2021, an employee was using a 4 1/2-inch handheld grinder on a 10-inch stainless steel fitted pipe. The grinder kicked back, knocked his safety glasses off, and struck his face, lacerating it near his left eye. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving a truck and hit a set of railroad tracks. The truck bounced and the employee hurt his back.
A water main line failed while being pressure-tested. It sent a bolt flying that struck an employee, causing internal injuries.
An employee was operating a table saw. The sawblade caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was loosening a twist-lock on a container on a vessel. A piece of metal from the ship's crane fell onto his head, piercing his hard hat and lacerating his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee missed a step up into a building and fell, landing on her left arm and breaking it.
An employee was working at a shaker. His fingers were pinched between a concrete mold and the shaker, and his right middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

An employee was using a mobile ladder, gathering boxes from a storage rack. A forklift struck the ladder and the employee fell to the concrete warehouse floor. The employee suffered bleeding from the head, a broken collarbone, and broken ribs. The employee was hospitalized.
n employee tripped on a comfort mat and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was hauling a load of salt water to an oil well to be pumped into the well. The truck hose was connected to the well. When a valve was opened on the truck, the pressure blew the aluminum hatch off the truck and it struck the employee. The employee was hospitalized for head and shoulder injuries as well as a punctured lung.

An employee was loading a box truck. The truck began to pull away and the employee fell to the concrete below, hitting the back of his head. He suffered a contusion and laceration to the back of the head, as well as a broken ankle.
On April 21, 2021, an employee was removing a pan from a conveyor when the employee's right index finger was caught between a belt and a pulley. The finger was degloved.
An employee fell from an elevated platform to the floor, suffering a broken skull, other fractures, and contusions. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting a board using a circular saw. The saw amputated the employee's right index finger and lacerated two other fingers.
An employee was wrapping a tub for shipment. He tripped over a roll of shrink wrap and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee tripped on the leg of a rack while walking by it. He fell to the concrete floor, landing on his right knee and suffering a knee injury that required hospitalization for surgery.

An employee was standing on a pallet of tires on an order picker. The pallet fell and the employee fell with it, striking the tires and the ground below. The employee suffered three broken back vertebrae and broken ribs.

An employee was trimming trees from a raised bucket. A branch fell into the employee, knocking them out of the basket. The employee suffered a broken left arm, a broken left shoulder, and back injuries.
An employee was loading a new piece of metal on a machine after stopping it. The machine engaged and the shear blade amputated three of the employee's fingers.
An employee tripped while walking away from his vehicle and fell to the asphalt ground in a parking lot. He struck his head and suffered a scalp laceration.
An employee got tangled in a hose while stepping out of his truck. He fell backwards to the pavement, suffering a broken rib and a punctured lung.
A dumpster fell into a truck hopper, pinning an employee's left hand against the truck. The employee suffered amputations to the index, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was putting a temporary patch on an auger chute when the auger amputated three of the employee's fingers. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was driving a lift truck through a warehouse. The truck struck a vertical I-beam, and the employee's head was lacerated on the truck's overhead guard. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a window sill to the concrete 5 feet below. The employee suffered internal injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was adjusting the lower pin alignment on a robotic cell stationary welder. The welder actuated, pinching and lacerating the tip of the employee's right index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was riding a bicycle between two buildings on a campus. The bicycle chain disengaged and the employee fell, suffering a broken collarbone, a head laceration, and a scraped knee.

Two employees were working on a boom truck that had outriggers and a leaking hydraulic cylinder. The injured employee had removed the hydraulic cylinder, rebuilt it, and reinstalled it. While verifying that the repair was correct, a bolt fell into the frame rail. As the injured employee reached to retrieve the bolt, the hydraulic cylinder went into motion resulting in amputation of the first knuckle from the right index finger.
An employee was using a utility knife to demolish vinyl flooring. The knife slipped through the material and lacerated the employee's wrist.
An employee was cleaning debris from under a semi truck. The truck was driven forward and ran over the employee's leg, breaking the fibula.
During the startup process of the pot and hot marble machine, a piece of glass punctured an employee's glove and left hand.

An employee was working on a vehicle. The employee's index finger was caught between one of its rims and a caliper (part of its brake system). The employee was hospitalized, suffering from a broken and cut finger that was then medically amputated above the second knuckle.

An employee was installing a boom pin on an overhead tree trimmer. While the employee was holding a bushing in place, the crane holding the boom in place shifted and amputated part of the employee's left thumb.
An employee was freeing a hose stuck in an in-line extruder. The extruder's saw blade amputated three fingertips on the employee's left hand.

An employee was tying down a crane boom onto a flatbed trailer. As he was on the flatbed, securing the boom with tiedowns, he lost his grip and fell about 5 feet. He hit a box trailer and then the gravel ground, suffering damaged vertebrae in the lower back.
An employee was working on a piece of machinery. The employee was knocked off the equipment and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized for brain swelling and surgery.
An employee was trying to unclog a kitchen drain. A mixture of bleach and a drain cleaning solution produced toxic vapors, which the employee inhaled.

An employee was replacing belts on an air compressor. The motor pulley rotated, grabbing the employee's fingers and pinching them between the tightened belt and the pulley. The employee suffered a severed right index finger, a lacerated right middle finger, and a broken right ring finger.
A telescopic conveyor belt at a truck loading dock deeply lacerated an employee's leg.

An employee was cutting dunnage on the back of a trailer using a chainsaw. When he stepped back after finishing, his foot caught a steel beam and he fell off the trailer to the ground. He suffered a broken right scapula and broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling wire back to the truck and had to cross a creek. While crossing, the employee became stuck in the creek causing him to sustain a fractured right femur.

At 4:06 a.m. on April 22, 2021, an employee was stepping off energized conveyor rollers onto an adjacent conveyor frame after clearing a jam on the line. He lost his footing and fell backward off the frame, landing on the concrete floor about 15 feet below. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized for surgery.

Two employees were inspecting a dust collection unit. Material fell out of the unit and ignited from the heat in the unit. The employees suffered first- and second-degree burns to the backs of their arms and hands.

An employee was operating a forklift in a trailer. The trailer pulled away from the dock; when the employee backed out, the forklift fell to the ground below, and the employee suffered an injury to the left foot that required surgery.
An employee slipped on ice between cars in a parking lot, fell to the ground, and suffered a broken femur.
An employee was removing the cover for an exterior fuel window drawer. She fell and struck her head on the brick pillar behind her and sustained a head laceration.

During a tooling change on a piece of equipment, a maintenance mechanic had just removed a heat plate when another employee walked in his direction. He flipped the hot plate toward his chest to keep it from touching the other employee and suffered a pulled or torn muscle in the upper left arm and shoulder.
An employee was cleaning adhesive off a roller. The roller caught the rag he was using and pulled in his right hand. He suffered a laceration to the hand and a broken right finger.
An employee was cleaning a pool with a leaf net. He tripped on pool furniture and fell, suffering a head contusion and a concussion.

An employee was hooking up an air compressor to a pickup. The air compressor started rolling on its tires, pushing the employee toward the pickup. The employee's hand was smashed, causing broken bones.
An employee was servicing a hydraulic line and punctured their right middle finger, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk when a car moved forward from its parking place and pinned the employee against a building. Both of the employee's legs were broken.

At about 10:15 a.m. on April 22, 2021, an employees' right foot got caught on the base of a printer stand as she turned to walk toward her work station. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken right tibia and a dislocated right ankle.

An employee was holding a stake for concrete molding while a co-worker was driving the stake with a 10-pound hammer. The employee thought the co-worker was finished and grabbed the top of the stake to assist himself up from a kneeling/bending position when the hammer struck the end of the employee's right-hand pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was adjusting stabilizers at the top of a ladder, preparing to install solar panels. He fell from the ladder to the pavement 8 feet below, sustaining a broken left ankle.
An employee was driving an electric pallet jack when he fell to the ground, suffering a contusion to the back of the head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was putting hides on hooks and pulling hides off hooks. The employee suffered a hernia.

An employee was placing concrete mesh in preparation for a concrete pour. A guardrail failed and the employee fell about 12 feet to a lower level, suffering two broken fingers on the right hand, two broken right-side ribs, and a broken right hip.

An employee was moving three tooling plates to a cleaning area with a magnetic hoist. The plates bumped into the cleaning station and one of them was jarred loose. It fell and struck the employee's left leg, lacerating it.

A forklift driver and a truck driver were loading a freight box onto a truck. While headed to the truck, the truck driver was struck on the left ankle by the forklift's forks. The truck driver was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was pulling and pushing two carts at a customer's garden center. The employee tripped and fell and broke her knee.
An employee was removing a bearing from a joint using a hydraulic press. The knuckle slipped from the press and struck the employee in the arm, breaking it.
An employee was using a knife to cut a piece of rubber when the knife slipped and cut the employee's left forearm, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was taking an online order out to a customer in a cart. The cart and items tipped over. While trying to keep them from falling to the ground, the employee suffered a crushed lower-back vertebra.

Two employees were changing air filters on top of a roof. They had accessed the roof by way of a scissor lift. As they started to descend down, the scissor lifts' wheel rolled into the dirt and the lift fell over. The employees fell about 20 feet to the ground. One employee was hospitalized with an injury to the pelvic region.
An employee was installing insulation around a tank at 52 inches above the floor when they fell to the floor, resulting in an injured left ankle.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck (PIT) and backed under a storage rack. The employee's head and face struck the rack and the employee sustained contusions and lacerations.
While walking towards the office inside the warehouse, an employee slipped on a piece of debris (green strap) that was on the floor and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee fell from the last step of a stool, landing on the floor and suffering a knee injury.
A truck driver opened the left door of a trailer, and an automotive rack fell out and hit him in the head. He suffered a concussion and was hospitalized.
An employee was throwing pecans onto a moving conveyor belt when their finger became caught between the belt and a pulley, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

After an employee turned on a finger joint machine and a clamp cylinder, the employee's right hand was caught by the lumber clamp in the machine's operating area. He suffered broken bones in the palm of the hand.
An employee was struck by a motor vehicle while walking in a facility. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was investigating the chain of a pallet jack that had hung up. The chain pulled tight and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
An employee was cutting cardboard tubing with a miter saw and suffered an amputation to the left thumb.

An employee was trying to remove waste material from a guide roller at the exit of an accumulator on a carpet coating line. The employee's right arm was caught in the waste material and rolled around the bar, which broke the employee's humerus.

An employee was checking the hood motor on the roof for proper function. While climbing the outside roof access ladder, the employee fell and sustained a broken pelvis, bleeding in her spleen, and a head laceration.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in an extruder. The extruder crushed the employee's right hand and broke the employee's right thumb.
An employee was inflating a wheelbarrow tire when it exploded. The employee suffered facial fractures and lacerations and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a switchgear metal cover panel. A tool fell into the switchgear compartment and contacted a 480-volt bus, resulting in an arc flash that caused second degree burns to the employee's face and arms.

An employee was working on a scissor lift near a hook conveyor belt system when a cord from the conveyor belt got stuck on a bolt of the scissor lift causing the lift to fall over. The employee fell from a height of 12 feet to the concrete floor below and sustained a fractured pelvis, broken ribs, an abrasion on a lung, and chipped vertebrae.

An employee was using an overhead crane to move a metal coil of steel from a machine and place it on a skid. The coil shifted while being set down and pinched the employee's left ring finger amputating the fingertip just below the nail bed.

A truck driver was closing the doors on his trailer when another truck struck the trailer causing the truck to bounce and shake erratically. The driver suffered a broken pelvis and a laceration across his back.
An employee was attaching a trailer hitch to the ball on a vehicle. The employee's left index finger was crushed between the ball and the hitch, causing an amputation to the finger.
A forklift ran over an employee's foot as it backed up. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was leading a horse and the horse turned and kicked him in the abdomen, resulting in bruises.
An employee was on a crank-up scaffold, working to dismantle it and lower it to the ground. He fell to the ground 15 feet below, hitting a board lying there and suffering a broken neck.

An employee was standing on a ladder, preparing the outside of a house for painting. The ladder slipped and the employee fell to the ground about 15 feet below. He suffered broken ribs, a broken leg, and a cracked skull and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to push out a catch pan to clean an area. The employee's right index finger came into contact with the machine's drive chain and sprocket, causing an amputation to the fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time.

The security officer was working at a bus station when a bus driver stopped and asked for assistance. The officer asked a passenger to leave the bus and the passenger assaulted the officer, resulting in a fractured nose, concussion, and a laceration above left eyebrow.

An employee was working from an elevated scaffold system. While applying force with a burke bar to strip the wood, he fell 8 feet to the dirt. The employee was hospitalized with a dislocated and fractured right foot.

At 8:30 a.m. on April 24, 2021, an employee was on the fifth rung of an 8-foot ladder. The ladder was knocked over and he fell to the concrete floor, suffering broken bones in his left leg and tendons in his left shoulder.

At approximately 0900, an employee was trying to move a pulp roll back into position on a pulp feed rack. The pulp roll slid off the rack onto the floor and caught the employee's right arm against the rack. The employee was hospitalized with a broken arm that required surgery.
A casino cash box was dropped on an employee's left foot. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from foot swelling and the exacerbation of a pre-existing condition.
An employee was caught by a pinch point resulting in a partial amputation of the left ring finger.
An employee was walking through a store to get change for her register when she tripped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured arm that required hospitalization.
An employee was walking in a back kitchen/storage area. The employee stepped into a drain containing hot water and suffered second-degree burns. She was hospitalized.
An employee was reaching for filling inside a mixer. The auger caught his hand and pulled his arm in. He suffered lacerations and a broken arm.
An employee was inside a scissor lift when a piece of equipment knocked over the scissor lift. The employee fell out of the lift onto the concrete floor.
An employee was inspecting a machine that organized short jerky sticks. As he was pointing out a segment of jerky, the collator belt pulled in his left index finger and amputated it.
An employee suffered a severe asthma attack in reaction to the wax being used to clear floors. She was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a roof system on an all-terrain vehicle. The employee fell from a step stool and suffered a broken right hip.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a pole. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee became dizzy while doing morning work in a bakery. He fell backwards to the floor and suffered a broken hip.
While opening a valve an employee was splashed with chemicals and sustained chemical burns to the right leg, right arm, and face.

On April 25, 2021, at 8:56 AM, natural gas pressure increased at the fuel skids which activated one of the pressure safety valves. An employee was dispatched to shut off the gas supply remotely. Natural gas discharged from the PSV and accumulated in four adjacent enclosures that house operating equipment. The gas vapors ignited and an explosion occurred. The employee was burned on both arms and hands, their face, and lower torso. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to dislodge a pallet that was stuck on a rail system. He cleared the pallet, but his left middle finger was caught between it and some equipment. The finger was broken and he was hospitalized.

Two employees were installing 2-by-4 wood framing for column furring around a structural column. One of the employees, working from an 8-foot step ladder, reached back to align or fasten a 2-by-4 to the top plate on a corner of the column. The 2-by-4 he grabbed gave way; he lost his balance and fell to the dirt pad below, suffering fractures to the hip and upper leg.

An employee was working inside a fan housing. The employee's right index finger brushed against a metal burr, and he got a metal sliver in the finger. The wound became infected and the employee was hospitalized.
While climbing a ladder, the employee fell and broke their left arm and right knee.

An employee was removing boxes off the main conveyor when she tripped on boxes that were on the floor. The employee fell forward onto the ground and landed between the steps that lead to the raised pallet. The employee's right hip was fractured.
An employee attempted to cut a hole in a rubber mudflap with a pocket knife. The pocket knife closed and cut the tip of the employee's left index finger.

An employee was standing at the edge of the furnace pit and was going to push out the lining on the furnace. The employee fell approximately 20 feet into the furnace tank and sustained broken vertebrae, two broken ribs, and a brain bleed. The employee was not wearing fall protection at the time of the fall.

On 4/26/2021 at 4:00 PM, an employee and his co-workers were loading 30 sheets of 1/2" plywood and 50 pieces of 2x4x10" lumber in the back of a customer's trailer. As the forklift lowered the load onto the pallets in the trailer, some of the 2x4s gave way, causing the entire load to collapse and pin the employee's left foot inside the trailer. The employee suffered a fracture in his foot.
An employee was sweeping a warehouse floor. A powered industrial truck ran over the employee's right foot, breaking bones.

An employee shrink wrapped a pallet of selected cases of product and began to transport the pallet toward the shipping dock area using a pallet jack when they collided with the forks of a stationary forklift, resulting in a lower right leg fracture.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on the control panel for a piece of equipment. The employee was using a spring loaded manual hand tool to cut a wire when the blade of the tool partially amputated his left thumb tip.
While painting was being done by a contractor, an employee working in the assembly area had an allergic reaction to the latex floor paint. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working with a foam take-up machine in the manufacturing area when their lab coat got caught in machine. Their arm was then pulled into the machine resulting in a fractured ulna and radius.

An employee was driving a motorized buggy down an aisleway in the assembly area of a plant along with a co-worker. The employee braked to turn a corner when his foot slipped off the brake and on to the accelerator pedal. The motorized buggy turned the corner and went right into a mist collector. The employee was thrown forward in the buggy and suffered multiple fractures to his left foot that required surgery.
An employee was moving a rolled coil when it fell, hitting and breaking his leg around the knee.
An employee was installing a wooden office door. A splinter from the door impaled the employee's left hand, causing an infection. The employee was hospitalized.
On April 26, 2021, at approximately 9:00 a.m., an employee was setting up a trimmer on the side of an edge bander when their right thumb contacted the trimmer, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While insulating refrigerant pipes, an employee came into contact with a battery bank and was shocked. The employee suffered hand lacerations and two dislocated shoulders.
An employee was pushing a conveyor belt out of a truck after unloading the truck. A finger on his left hand was caught in the folding parts of the belt. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was cutting grass with a zero-turn lawn mower and collided with a parked vehicle in the parking lot, resulting in a broken leg and lacerations.
An employee was working on a heavy-duty truck when the cab of the truck fell on the employee's left hand, resulting in a laceration to their left wrist and palm.

An employee was working on a pizza production line, checking the weight of pizzas after they passed through a "waterfall" section that put cheese on them. She was removing some cheese that had built up on a roller when she was pulled into the rollers on the bottom side of the conveyor. She suffered fractures to the right arm and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was backing up a forklift when his left leg was caught between it and a shelving unit. His foot was broken.

An employee was driving a tractor to position a bag cart closer to the bag chute of an airplane when he collided with a metal pole on the driver's side of the tractor, resulting in a fractured lower left fibula.

An employee was installing granite pavers along the platform edge. When the employee stood up from a kneeling position, he lost his balance, and fell about 4 feet 10 inches from the platform to a track bed. He suffered contusions to his right-side ribs, shoulder, and chest, with a possible fracture.

An employee was using a jointer machine to smooth the edges of plastic poly material. He had angled the material instead of laying it flat on the machine to smooth out its triangular edges. It kicked back and he slipped, suffering a partial amputation to the left middle finger.

An employee was manually pulling a safety guard from a stack of safety guards and felt a pop in his right wrist. The employee was later hospitalized, suffering from wrist pain, swelling, and cellulitis with a possible ruptured tendon.

As an employee was exiting a trench on a ladder, an excavator bucket became detached from its boom, slid down the slope of the trench, and struck the employee. The employee suffered a lacerated liver and damage to the diaphragm.
An employee was stepping down from a platform to the floor when they slipped and rolled their right ankle, resulting in a fracture.

A UPS employee was unloading packages from the left side of a truck. A vehicle hit the driver's side of the truck, pushing it into the employee and pinning him between the truck and a telephone pole. He suffered three broken ribs, a punctured lung, a shattered collarbone, thoracic vertebra swelling, and several cuts to the left side of his face and head.

An employee was cleaning a striping machine for pavement markings on the ground. The hose jammed as it was wound up. As he tried to unjam it, the trigger was hit and the hose struck his left index finger.
An employee inhaled sodium hydroxide fumes and was hospitalized.
An employee was washing down the production area floor in a meat department. He tripped and fell over a drain, suffering a dislocated shoulder and an injury to his vertebrae. He was hospitalized.
While delivering mail, an employee tripped on a crack in a sidewalk and fell. She suffered multiple fractures to the left ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading liquid caustic potash into a tank. When the hose was uncoupled, the employee was sprayed with the chemical. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered chemical burns to the neck and face.
An employee was loading a metal plate onto a trailer. The plate fell out of the trailer, landing on the employee's foot. The employee suffered a broken metatarsal and four dislocated toes.

An employee was operating a log loader. The loader struck a tree stump embedded in the ground and rocked, its open door swinging shut. The employee's left middle, ring, and little fingers were caught between the door and the cab. The middle ring and ring fingers were medically amputated at the second knuckle, and the little finger was reattached.
An employee was on top of a platform (a truss for concrete). A piece of 2-by-4 wood caught his right hand, causing a partial amputation to the middle finger.

On April 27, 2021, an employee was belt-grinding an aluminum casting when the casting's weight and momentum crushed the employee's left ring finger against a metal cart. The finger was severely lacerated and broken.

An employee was standing by a forklift that a co-worker was operating in a stationary position using the brake. The co-worker moved and their foot slipped off the brake, causing the forklift to move forward and run over the employee's right ankle and foot with the back right tire. The employee suffered two bone fractures.
An employee was doing metal roofing work. The employee contacted an overhead power line with metal and suffered electrical burns.
A forklift carrying a stack of pallets made a sharp turn next to an employee. The pallets fell onto the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis, a neck fracture, and a leg fracture.
An employee slipped and fell off a ladder while changing light bulbs. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was loading skids with product and began to experience chest pains.
An employee was walking toward customers when he came into contact with a skid loader that was backing up, resulting in a broken lower left leg.
An employee fell off a roof, landing on the rocky, landscaped ground 14 feet below. He suffered four broken ribs on the left side and a fractured L2 vertebra.
An employee was clearing backed-up ties on a trimming line. When the machine was turned back on, the chain raised quickly and crushed his left hand between the timber and the chain.
On April 27, 2021, an employee was climbing to a second-story roof using a ladder. He fell, landing on the ground and suffering a broken left elbow and hand.
An employee was injured when the extension ladder he was working on slipped out from underneath him.  The employee suffered broken ribs.

On April 27, 2021, at approximately 11:30 am, an employee was working on a machine with an exposed shaft. He was retrieving a dropped item when his hair was caught by the rotating shaft, resulting in a scalping injury and hospitalization.
An employee was directing the loading of pallets of pavers onto a trailer. An object struck the employee, who suffered fractures to his arm.
An employee was stepping onto a platform when he lost his footing and fell from the top step to the concrete 20 inches below. He suffered a broken right leg and was hospitalized.
A mini-excavator backed into an employee, its track breaking his right leg.

On April 27, 2021, an employee was trimming plastic from a running machine. The employee's finger was caught between a rubber roller and the machine guard. The fingertip was medically amputated the next day.
An employee was loading and unloading potted trees when a potted tree fell onto the employee's left leg, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was replacing a drive motor on a telestacker. When he removed the motor, the telestacker started to roll downhill. One of its wheels pinned the employee, who suffered broken legs.

On April 27, 2021, an employee was stepping off a manlift onto a ladder when the lift started and moved upward. The employee hit his back on a metal tube running diagonally above him and was then pinched between the tube and the railing of the manlift. He suffered bleeding and fluid around the lungs and was hospitalized.

On 04/27/2021 at 12:45 pm, an employee was pushing a buggy and pulling parts. The employee spun the buggy around and smashed his right pinky finger between the buggy and the door rack. The employee suffered a fractured right pinky finger and a subsequent partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was delimbing a cut-down tree. One of the limbs kicked back and struck the employee between the ankle and the knee, breaking the employee's tibia.
An employee was installing a stud for a dead end cap in a sectionalizer cabinet. An arc blast caused second-degree burns to the employee's face, neck, right elbow, and thigh.
An employee was separating lighting on electrical relays. The employee was shocked by wires and fell from a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was unloading steel members with a delivery crew. While the employee was trying to control a hoisted load, his hand was pinched between the load and material stacked on the delivery truck. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.

An employee was walking toward the back of a truck to grab a pair of gloves. Scrap iron was being unloaded from a trailer attached to the truck. A piece of angle iron fell from the trailer and struck the employee on the forehead, causing internal bleeding.
An employee was walking on the rig floor when he slipped on an open drill hole 10 inches in diameter, falling to the floor and fracturing both elbows.

An employee was swapping out sides of a choke manifold during drill out operations when the threaded end of a 10K needle valve parted from the end cap and struck the employee causing a laceration to the right leg.
An employee was filling a tire truck when the tire blew, resulting in bruised lungs and a laceration to the back of the head that required staples.

An employee was cleaning the tank on the back of a tractor. The employee stepped from the tank onto the tractor's tire, slipped, and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on water and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur.
An employee was removing weights from the base of a sensor wind tower. The tower tilted and struck the employee, causing a head injury that required staples.

On April 28, 2021, an employee was inspecting steel fixers in the second floor deck of a new hospital. When he stepped on the steel pan section (U-channel), his foot slipped and landed in a 20-inch-deep space between the pans. He suffered a broken left leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning the second level of a processing unit with a leaf blower. The employee fell through a 4-foot gap in the railing, landing on the floor and suffering bruises, lacerations, and a knee injury requiring surgery. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a grain dryer when it lacerated his left thumb.
An employee was pulling a hamper to the loading dock when his right hand was caught between the metal railing and the hamper, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was getting stock out of a cooler. The employee fell over the filler box for a fryer that was being taken back to the sink to be cleaned, landing on the floor and suffering a back injury.

An employee was manually operating a wire-drawing machine to remove the remaining wire coil. The wire came free of the guide roller and struck the safety cage, which lifted quickly and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered a contusion and a laceration.
An employee was sharpening a 6-inch meat cutting knife with a handheld knife sharpener. The blade slipped and punctured the employee's abdomen.
On April 28, 2021, two employees were lifting a patient and one of the employees suffered an arm strain.

An employee was using a grinder to cut an aluminum conduit. The blade of the grinder broke off in the conduit, causing the grinder to jump up and cut the employee's left wrist and forearm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping get a truck unstuck from a ditch. The truck ran over the employee who was hospitalized.
An employee was changing a valve on a mixing kettle when a cleaning chemical leaked from the valve onto the employee's left hip, resulting in a chemical burn.

An employee was repositioning an 800-pound component on a transfer cart using an overhead crane when the component shifted and caught the employee's left thumb and index finger between the component and the transfer cart. The employee's left thumb and index finger were crushed.
An employee was cleaning a pinch roller assembly when their right index finger got caught in the roller assembly, resulting in a partial de-gloving and amputation.
An employee was repairing roof insulation when his ladder become unstable. As he fell, his left hand caught a loose piece of thin, hanging metal strapping, which lacerated his ring finger.

An employee was operating a hydraulic brake press to shape a piece of sheet metal. The employee was manually positioning the workpiece as he operated the machine and his left hand became caught between the die and the top punch of the brake press, resulting in amputation of the distal phalanx of the left index finger.
A cook was dicing meat. The cook's knife amputated part of the employee's left middle fingertip, with no bone loss.

An employee was helping a crew repair a gate that had fallen off its hinges. A snake was run over by heavy equipment near the gate where the crew was working. The employee tried to remove the snake from the work area and was bit on their right index finger.

An employee was assisting a co-worker in opening a precast concrete form so that the outer shell could be removed from the form when his left hand became caught between the form and the shell. The employee suffered a crushed fingertip, causing a fracture of the distal phalange, and partial amputation of the middle fingertip.
An employee was rolling a piece of steel on a steel roller. The employee's right index finger was pinched between a roller and the material. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.

An employee was working at a machine when she slipped and attempted to grab a table, catching her lower arm on piece of aluminum. The employee suffered a deep laceration to her arm, including possible vein and nerve damage.

An employee was assisting a shipper with preparing a workstation crane and its components for shipment. The crane measured 390 inches long and 12 inches high. The employee was helping the shipper manually turn a bridge on skids from a vertical position to a horizontal position when the bridge struck the tip of their left middle finger, pinching it between the skid and the bridge. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee had been walking toward a conveyor. The employee fell and sustained a broken leg.

Two employees were putting back a planer chain using a come-along. The come-along slipped and the chain fell, landing on an employee's right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated (without bone loss).

An employee was sitting in her office chair when a ceiling tile above the employee that was saturated with water fell and hit them on the head and shoulder, resulting in a concussion and a shoulder injury.

An employee was operating a backhoe to move tooling when it overturned onto its left side, catching the employee between the rollover protection and the ground. The employee suffered a fractured pelvis and leg.

An employee was installing wood blocking on a south elevation parapet wall. While completing the task, the employee climbed through a guardrail system to access the security fencing area on a roof at an inmate recreation yard. The employee fell through the fencing, and the employee's fall protection rope snapped/tore. The employee landed on the concrete floor about 14 feet below, suffering a broken rib and a fractured hip.

An employee was spraying mold release spray on an injection mold machine when the machine's tie bar closed and pinched the employee's hand on the spray can. The employee suffered crush injuries to their right middle and ring fingers, as well as an amputation of their right ring fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was carrying one or two broken-down cardboard boxes when her caught got caught at the corner of a wooden pallet. She fell, breaking a bone just below the kneecap.

An employee was covering an area of frac sand with a tarp to prevent rain damage. A gust of wind pulled the tarp while he adjusting it, and he slipped and fell off a ladder to the ground. He landed on his left hand and elbow, suffering a broken ulna.

An employee changed out a press mold and heated a nozzle with a torch to purge the press out. After the employee was finished heating the nozzle, he went to close the front door when degraded plastic came out of the barrel and onto his right arm. The employee suffered burns to his arm that required hospitalization.

An employee was helping restrain a 14-year-old mental health patient. The patient freed a leg and kicked the employee multiple times in the back of the head, causing a brain bleed. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was maneuvering a stand-up reach lift to a charging station when his left foot was pinned between the lift and a concrete column, resulting in amputation of the lower left leg.

An employee was in a parking lot, carrying two tubs of mail to her vehicle. Her foot caught a crevice between the sidewalk and a curb and she fell, spraining her left ankle and breaking both right ankle bones. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was setting up at his work station when he was assaulted by another employee with an air hose nozzle, resulting in an abdominal injury that required hospitalization.

An employee had just loaded a 24-foot spreader bar onto a trailer. The employee was moving the bar when it fell from the trailer, knocking the employee off the trailer. The employee suffered several contusions and a broken jaw.
An employee was walking down steps and fell at the last step. The employee suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was pouring a concrete floor deck. The decking collapsed and the employee fell about 20 feet to the ground, suffering broken ribs, a broken skull, and a back fracture.

An employee was working on an out-of-service electrical pole. While he was up the pole on a ladder, and then on hooks, his hand touched with a primary voltage jumper that had burnt off at the transformer. He suffered an entry wound through the little finger and out the back of his arm behind the elbow.
An employee was installing an HVAC unit when his finger was caught in a belt and pulley system and amputated.

On April 29, 2021, at 8:47 a.m., an employee was operating a winding machine when their right-hand middle, ring, and pinky fingers were crushed at the point of operation, resulting in hospitalization and fingertip amputations.
An employee was cleaning a machine when their hand became caught in a rotating metal plate, resulting in partial amputations of two fingers.
Employees were demolishing metal ductwork. While they were removing hanging straps, a duct slipped and cut an employee's left forearm.
An employee was removing a part inside a wax injection mold machine. The machine cycled and crushed the employee's hand.

An employee was standing at a loading dock next to his forklift. Another forklift, parked nearby, experienced a brake failure and rolled down a slope toward the employee. The employee was caught between the two forklifts and suffered a pelvic fracture and internal bleeding.
An employee was cutting boneless pork sirloin chops using a meat band saw when the saw came into contact with his right hand, resulting in an amputation of the index finger.
An employee was preparing dough in a dough machine. The machine was closed and turned on with her left index finger inside, amputating her fingertip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was installing low data wiring on the second floor inside a new home under construction when they fell from the second floor to the concrete first floor below, resulting in broken heels on both feet.

On April 29, 2021, an employee was in the gym, trying to keep a child from running out of the area. She fell to the floor and broke a bone in her lower left leg. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a pneumatic staple gun while fabricating a wall panel. The gun fired a staple into the employee's left foot.

An employee working in a home under construction was prepping trim on a ladder that was on top of scaffold. The scaffold tipped over while he was on the ladder and the employee fell to the floor, resulting in a broken right elbow, broken left wrist, cut nose, and contusion above the right eye.
An employee was working on a stepladder. He came in to contact with an energized ceiling fan, was shocked, and fell off the ladder. He suffered broken ribs and a punctured lung.
On April 30, 2021, at 1:00 p.m., an employee was cutting a plywood square with a circular saw when his hand slipped and the saw lacerated four fingers on his left hand.

On April 30, 2021, an employee was folding back a dock leveler after making a delivery. The lip plate did not automatically fold down when the push button was used, so the employee used their hand to push it down. The lip plate snapped downward all at once, and the three middle fingers on the employee's right hand were crushed.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when the pallet jack jumped backward, smashing her thumb between the pallet jack and a cardboard bailer. The employee suffered a crushing injury to her left thumb and a possible amputation.
An employee had an allergic reaction to a bleach-based cleaning compound. The employee was hospitalized for respiratory distress.

On April 30, 2021, an employee was placing a tag onto an empty pan and was struck by a side loader. The employee was dragged several feet down the filling station and was caught between the side loader and the filling station. The employee sustained bruises, contusions, and a left knee fracture and torn meniscus. The employee was hospitalized.

Carpenter crews were setting a bulkhead panel. The panel was being lowered into position when it got hung up on a horizontal water stop cut out on a 2x6 guide bar. The injured employee pushed on the panel to clear the guide. Upon doing so, the slack from the cable was taken up and the panel shifted. An employee was changing a circuit breaker fuse when an arc flash occurred. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns.

An employee had climbed onto a hydraulic platform floor lift to move jammed material. While the floor lift was moving up, the employee stepped off the lift and his foot was caught between the floor of the lift and the metal plate on the floor above. The employee was hospitalized with a crushing injury to his foot and toes.
An employee was operating a ride-on pallet jack. He ran into racking and his foot was cut open.
An employee slipped and fell from the truck while climbing into a delivery truck. The employee struck their head, sustaining injury.
An employee was repairing a truck-mounted steam cleaner. Steam coils overheated and exploded, causing burns to the employee's face and scalp.

An employee was clearing a paper wrap in the upper embosser roller and lower pressure roll on the rewinder section of a line. The machine was jogged and the employee's left hand was caught in the point of operation. The employee suffered amputations to the ring and middle fingertips, losing skin, the middle fingernail, and the fingertip pads. There was no bone loss.

An employee was working to free a truss on the exterior of a building that was hung under one of the rollers of the finish conveyor. The finish roller conveyor was put into reverse and the truss moved backward causing the employee's leg to get caught between the truss and rollers. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg.
A temporary employee was manually rolling an 8-inch pipe to the end of the pipe rack when the pipe rolled over his thumb, breaking it. The left thumb was medically amputated at the middle joint.
An employee was exiting out the back of a tractor trailer. The employee slipped and fell to the parking lot, suffering a possible broken hip.
An employee was moving a sawhorse when it tipped over and smashed the employee's left ring finger. The employee suffered an amputation.

A Glacier Construction crew was setting a 36-inch steel pipe in a trench and working to line/plumb the pipe. The bracing on the pipe gave way and an employee was trapped between the pipe and the trench wall. The employee sustained a chest contusion and a liver hematoma and was hospitalized.
An employee was unhooking a trailer from a truck cab. The cab ran over the employee, who suffered foot and face fractures.
An employee stepped out of a delivery truck via the driver's side door and suffered a broken ankle as he stepped onto the pavement. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

Employees were transferring chlorine containing material from a storage tank into a tanker truck. Chlorine containing air escaped and two employees were hospitalized for lung damage due to chlorine exposure.
An employee was walking out of the breakroom when they stumbled and fell into the door jamb resulting in a concussion.
An employee was using a 3,500 PSI power washer. The hose developed three pinholes, and high-pressure water punctured the employee's hand.
An employee was walking in the hallway when he slipped on water that was on the floor and injured his right ankle.
An employee was setting up a display when they caught their foot on the fixture and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken wrist.

An employee was changing a valve on a propane cylinder. The old valve that was being removed sheered off and the employee's finger became caught in the de-valver. The employee sustained an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was testing vehicles under high voltage and sustained an electrical shock.
An employee was stacking lumber and the lumber pinched their finger against a back stop. The employee sustained an amputation to a fingertip.
An employee picked up a case of water bottles and felt pain in his back.

The injured employee was standing on the right side of his powered industrial truck (PIT), filling out a dock door checklist and using the PIT seat as a writing surface. His PIT was parked at an angle in front of a dock door. Another PIT was driving forward with two pallets loaded on its forks. The moving PIT struck the injured employee's stationary PIT which caused the injured employee to fall on the floor. The injured employee sustained a laceration above the left heel and a fractured left ankle.
An employee was operating a continuous gutter forming extruder machine when he noticed a jam. While working to free the jam, the employee sustained a degloving injury to their left index finger.
An employee was hospitalized with a fractured knee after they slipped and fell in the parking lot.

An employee was working from a Baker scaffold to put in studs. The scaffold was bumped and one of its wheels fell into a hole. It then fell over, and the employee fell to the ground 6 feet below, suffering a possible fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee had been operating a string trimmer. The employee tripped and fell on the ground and sustained a broken lower leg.
An employee was moving a patient on a medical table when they tripped over the table's wheel and fractured their femur.

An employee was using a chain hoist to lift a mattress from a lower floor. The employee fell through a hole in the floor he was working on and impacted a concrete floor that was 18 feet below. The employee sustained a broken wrist.
An employee was driving a pallet jack when the back of his pallet jack was struck by the forks of another pallet jack. The employee sustained a broken left foot.
An employee was operating a punch press and amputated four fingers on their left hand.

An employee was working on an HVAC unit on top of a ceiling. The employee fell through the metal trusses, then fell 7-8 feet through a drop ceiling, landing on the floor. The employee suffered back contusions.

A maintenance employee was repairing a packing machine. The employee was under the machine when it cycled. The employee's right hand and forearm were caught and crushed by the counterweight of the cullet chute and the motor housing.

An employee was operating a skid steer loaded with a jackhammer attachment. He had lifted the attachment up over the seat when it broke off from the loader and fell on his leg. His right leg was broken below the knee, and the skin was punctured.

An employee was driving a powered industrial truck in a warehouse freezer. The truck struck a corner guard, and the employee's right leg was caught between the truck's steel platform and the fixed steel baseboard of a racking system. The employee suffered an open fracture near the end of his right tibia.
An employee was stepping down from a 4-foot stepladder. He fell and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was working on a bus. The bus slid off the jack it had been raised on and landed on the employee's inner thigh, injuring it.

An employee was standing above a trench as a storm water line was being installed. A trench box that was chained to an excavator tipped over while being moved. The trench box struck the employee and pinned them against the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis.

An employee was spotting a dump truck carrying fill material. The truck's bed was extended to its full height to dump the load. The truck then began to move forward, toward overhead electrical lines. The truck contacted the lines while the spotter was touching it. He was shocked and suffered burns to the arm and back.
An employee was closing a small vault door. The door caught the employee's thumb, causing an amputation.

The injured employee had been working on the roof of a  building. The employee was getting off the roof and onto a 10-foot ladder to get down, while another employee held the ladder. While going down the ladder, the injured employee lost their footing and fell about 10 feet onto the dirt, landing on their left side and sustaining a broken left humerus.
An employee was on lunch break sitting on the grass near the driveway at a job site when a truck ran over both of the employee's legs and fractured them.
An employee was rolling an 800-pound reel of aluminum into the storage area when his left index finger was caught and amputated between two reels.
An employee was performing maintenance on a floater machine and was struck in the face by a spring-loaded latch. The employee suffered a broken nose and facial fractures.
An employee lost balance and fell from an unknown height on a three-leg ladder. The employee sustained a fractured ankle that required surgery.
An employee was picking up construction debris and loading it onto a hand truck. The employee suffered a pinched nerve in the back, as well as a slipped disk.
An employee was performing maintenance on an unloading machine when it started up and the pusher bar activated and fractured both of the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a box that had fallen off a conveyor when his leg was caught in the conveyor chain. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the lower left leg.
An employee was finishing the prep work on a mold in a low-pressure tilt machine. The machine started up and cycled, causing amputation and crushing injuries to the employee's fingers and hand.
An employee was chipping concrete with a pneumatic chipping gun and pinched their middle finger between the chipping bit and the concrete substrate.
An employees hand was caught in the door jamb as the door closed and the top part of the employee's finger was amputated.

On May 11, 2021, an employee was using a hammer to adjust a slipping agitator belt on the filler head of a machine. The employee's right middle finger was pulled between the belt and pulley resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee injured their lower left back while pushing a patient in a wheelchair. The employee was hospitalized.

On May 11, 2021, an employee was working on a yacht, doing maintenance work on an air conditioning unit. A refrigerant tank fell over and began to leak. The employee covered the leak, and the refrigerant caused second-degree burns to both of his hands.

An employee was riding a bicycle. While still on the property at a crossroad, she was struck by a car. The employee sustained fractured ribs, a fractured clavicle, a fractured nose, and bleeding in the brain.
An employee was walking through a post office when they tripped and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones in the right knee.

An employee was on top of a trencher to put a cover on its exhaust manifold when he slipped off the trencher and fell 5.5 feet to the ground, resulting in five broken ribs, a lacerated spleen, and a lacerated liver. It was raining at the time.

An employee was using a floor shaper to put a radius on plastic parts. When placing a part into the shaper bit area, the part kicked and dragged the employee's left hand into the shaper. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the left middle finger and lacerations and avulsions to the left ring finger.
An employee was using welding equipment. Residual solvent fumes ignited and the employee was hospitalized for burns.

An employee was walking up a set of stairs and was inspecting welds on a handrail where a platform was going to be installed. At the transition where the stairway lead to the next flight of stairs, the employee fell and landed on the floor below, sustaining injury to the back and arm.

An employee was cutting tree limbs when one of the branches fell, ricocheted off something, and struck the employee in the head. The employee was hospitalized with a large gash on their head and a possible back injury.

On May 11, 2021, an employee was operating a pedal-operated brake press, and was feeding sheet metal into the press. Both of their hands were caught in the press, resulting in amputation of the right index finger and possibly crushed knuckles on both hands.
While walking down stairs in a client's home, an employee tripped on a pair of shoes and fell 2 to 3 steps, landing on the base of a child's car seat. The employee sustained a broken right femur.
An employee was connecting a tractor to a trailer. The employee got out of the truck to check the connection and his right arm was caught between the fifth wheel and the trailer and fractured.

An employee was helping to pick up trash from the side of the street. Their right index finger was fractured by the lifting mechanism on the trash truck. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was removing some equipment on a job site. While climbing a ladder, the employee fell 10 to 12 feet and landed on the left side of their back. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unjamming a machine. The machine jolted and struck the employee resulting in lacerations to their left hand and bottom lip and a dislocated shoulder.

An employee was bending down to pick up some studs near a ladder. Some sheetrock another employee (working 12 feet up the ladder) was holding slipped down and hit the employee as he bent over, striking and bruising his back. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking to get a drink. The employee slipped on water that was on the floor near the ice machine and sustained a broken femur.

An employee was testing a winch. When the employee went to wipe the winch with a rag, the rag was pulled in, pulling their hand in as well. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the left middle finger.
An employee ran into a fixed desk and fell to the floor. The employee's hip was injured by the fall and required surgery.
An employee was working in a filing room, tripped over a box of copy paper and fell into a filing cabinet injuring her left upper arm.

An employee was in an attic looking for a leak. He fell off a walkway through the attic ceiling, falling about 12-15 feet and suffering cracked ribs, a partially collapsed lung, a concussion, and cuts and bruises.
An employee was wiping off an area below a conveyor when their hand became caught in the conveyor belt.

On May 11, 2021, an employee was gathering bad straws from a drop chute to throw away. The machine restarted and his finger was caught between a groove on the transfer belt and a metal piece on the machine. The employee sustained the amputation of his left ring finger.

On 5/11/21, four filler operators were performing a changeover on the filler. The injured operator entered the filler to change chucks using portable steps with a handrail. Another operator was walking up and down the steps handing parts for the changeover. When the injured operator exited the filler using the seal of the door and stepped forward onto the portable steps, the steps slid causing the injured operator to fall back next to the filler. The injured operator hit their head on the filler door and then on the floor three feet below. The operator was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was on a ladder wiring an overhead fan and fell 5 feet off the ladder onto the ground. The employee suffered pain in the back, neck, and right arm.
An employee was leaning against a handrail when it broke and the employee fell to the walking surface. The employee suffered bumps and bruises.

An employee was operating a drill machine to drill pairs of holes into wooden boards. The employee noticed that the board was not correctly positioned and tried to move it with their left hand while at the same time lowering the lever used to lower the hold-downs/drill bit pairs with their right hand. The board would not move and their left hand slid along the board to one of the drill bit pairs. A drill bit caught the employee's glove and pulled a finger into the drill bit resulting in a fractured finger and partial amputation.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack and pinned their left leg between the pallet jack and a floor scrubber. The employee's leg was fractured.

An employee was working on a circular saw, cutting cold steel bars. A bar got caught and the employee reached to help release it. The circular saw cut the tip of the employee's right middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was loading a tandem dump truck with road base material. Some of the load had been dumped so the truck would not be overloaded, and material had collected under the tailgate, preventing it from closing. As the employee tried to clear away the material, the employee's right middle finger was caught between the tailgate and the tailgate latch. The fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.

An employee was packaging boxes on the gallon production line and moving them to a skid. While relocating a box of product to the skid, he felt a pull in his arm. He was hospitalized for a swollen right wrist.

An employee was putting a package into a plastic bag to put over the fence for delivery when a dog came out from behind the garbage carts and bit her right thumb. Her right thumb was amputated to the first knuckle.
An employee tripped over a bag of potting soil in the garden center.

An employee was carrying a 5 gallon bucket of 50% hydrogen peroxide solution when the handle broke or he dropped the bucket and the solution splashed onto him. He experienced chemical burns on his left arm, chest, left shoulder, and just above the left eye. He was hospitalized for burns as well as inhalation of vapors and ingestion of liquid solution.

After participating in a physical training exercise, an employee began to lose feeling in his lower extremities. He was hospitalized, having suffered bulging disks, an annular tear, and a muscle injury.

On May 12, 2021, at around 8:45 a.m., an employee was installing a cutting head into a molder machine when the cutting head slipped from his hands and the blades cut his hands. The employee was hospitalized.

On 05/12/2021, at approximately 8:52 AM, an employee of Petrin Corp. was on an elevated, grated platform at a chemical plant replacing a removable barricade with a hard barricade when he tripped, lost balance, and fell approximately 20 feet. The employee sustained fractures to a hip, the right arm, and the right wrist.
An employee was working on scaffolding when they fell 4 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured right leg.
An employee was moving a roll of paper (approx. 72 inches in diameter and weighing 400 lbs.) it rolled onto the employee's left leg and fractured it.
An employee was hooking up a washing machine to be tested. The employee touched two live wires and suffered a shock to the entire body, as well as burns to both hands.
On May 12, 2021, an employee was attending quarterly firearms training when her 9mm discharged into her right thigh and exited out of her lower right leg.

An employee was cleaning dust off the photo eye of the dump hopper when it activated and caught  his left arm between the dump hopper and the frame of the machine. The employee sustained a left ulnar fracture, an elbow wound and traumatic muscle injury.

An employee was laying hot asphalt during road construction and was standing on the rear catwalk of a laydown asphalt paver operating the controls. A subcontractor dump truck backed into the paver and pinned the employee between the paver controls and the dump truck. The employee suffered bruises and internal bleeding to both upper legs.

A warehouse coordinator was receiving skids of product (tiles) while a forklift operator was putting the skids back into the staging lanes. While placing the skids of tile, the skids fell on top of the warehouse coordinator who suffered a broken pelvis and five broken ribs.

An employee was carrying trash outside to the burning pit using a forklift. The forklift got stuck in the mud outside and the operator asked another forklift operator to pull the stuck forklift out of the mud. The second forklift was backing up to the stuck forklift to attach a chain. The injured employee was holding the chain and while the second forklift backed up and the employee's left arm was crushed between the two forklifts resulting in amputation of the arm.

A turret on a piece of trimmer equipment was being manually rotated into position while offline. An employee was helping move the turret when a pinch point on it caught his right hand. He suffered an amputation to the ring fingertip.

Two employees were operating forklifts in a freezer. One forklift stopped to let the other go by. One of the forklifts slid on the icy floor and its forks struck the left calf of the other forklift's operator, fracturing their shin.

A five-man crew had been subcontracted by Laredo Petroleum to replace the fire tubes on a heater treater and clean the inside of the tank. Three employees with Dorado Construction Group were contracted as a roustabout crew to clean the tank and replace the fire tubes, one employee of Mulholland Energy Services was contracted to operate the vacuum truck and remove the sludge from the tank, and one employee of Permian Service Co., LLC  was hired to operate a hot oil truck to provide water to the roustabout crew for cleaning. At approximately 1:00 p.m. the employees had completed pulling out the old fire tube and had begun the process of cleaning the inside of the tank from the open hatch when an explosion occurred. Three employees were hospitalized for second and third degree burns to their arms and face.
An employee was loading a heat press machine. The employee's left hand was caught in the machine, which caused third-degree burns to the lower arm and the back of the hand.
Two employees fought. One punched the other, breaking the employee's jaw. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the rollers on a roll coating machine. His hand was caught in the rollers, causing the amputation of a finger.
An employee was picking up cardboard and plastic from the floor when he stepped on the plastic he was carrying and fell. The employee suffered a fractured ankle.
An employee fell on a wet floor, suffering back and neck injuries.
An employee was trying to remove a floor truss from a table when the table closed. His left middle finger was caught in the table, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was standing on a metal roof installing insulation. He stepped backward onto a skylight and fell through it 35 ft. to the concrete ground, resulting in bruises and a fracture.

An employee was using a 6-foot fiberglass ladder to hang a banner above an entry door. After he completed work on the banner, he descended the ladder and was approximately four feet high when he lost his balance and fell onto the entryway. The employee sustained a fractured L1 vertebra.

An employee was on a manlift, waiting for a piece of metal that a crane was lifting to be put into place. The crane ball hung up and the load dropped quickly, striking the employee in the face. The employee suffered facial fractures.

Employees were cleaning out a heater treater using hot water to remove debris. When an employee opened the door to the heater treater, remaining hot water hit him in the face, chest, and hands, causing first- and second-degree burns.
An employee's right hand was caught and crushed in the pulley of an asphalt conveyor.

An employee was helping perform an inflatable line stop. During the line stop installation, the launch tube slid into the open valve, pinching the employee's left thumb between the locking clamp and the set point stopping block. The thumb was broken and lacerated.
On May 13, 2021, an employee slipped and fell while waking down the 1st floor aisle near the Oak Room. The employee bumped their head against the wall as they fell and was hospitalized.

A nursing assistant was helping to recline a resident's wheelchair. When she pulled back on the wheelchair, she lost her balance and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur that required surgery.
An employee was trying to dislodge a material truck cart in an automated storage and retrieval machine. The employee dislodged the cart and was struck by the pusher arm, suffering a broken leg.
An employee's left hand was caught in a meat grinder. The hand was amputated.

Employees were removing dies from a press. The injured employee was guiding a suspended die set by hand to ensure proper placement on the skid when the employee's gloved fingertips were pinched between the upper and lower dies of the blanket die set as it was lowered by a hoist onto a skid. The  employee's left middle and ring fingertips were amputated.

On May 13, 2021, at approximately 8:00 PM, an employee was operating a stand-up forklift and was backing away and turning from a pallet. The forklift struck a steel structural pole and the employee sustained compound fractures to the left tibia and fibula.

An employee was driving a cement mixer. It flipped while turning a corner, and the cabin was flattened. The employee was pinned in the cabin and suffered a broken right hand, three broken ribs, and head lacerations.
Two employees were lifting a capstan hoist out of the bed of a truck when it fell, landing on one employee's left middle finger and causing a partial amputation.
An employee was trimming trees from a stepladder. The employee fell to the ground, suffering broken ribs and other internal injuries that necessitated emergency surgery.
An employee was pressure washing interior concrete walls to remove existing liner and lacerated the top of his left foot.
An employee suffered a strained back while pulling a 44-gallon drum that was half filled with water.

An employee was trimming excess leather from a boot on the inseam trimming machine when the workpiece slipped and his right index finger contacted the blade resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
A forklift struck an employee.
An employee was using a piece of emery cloth to polish a metal part that was rotating on a lathe. The part caught the employee's glove, and the lathe broke the employee's right forearm.
