On 5/13/2021, an employee was operating the silk screen machine. The machine was running while she adjusted the wheel nut with a wrench. The slide activated to the right and amputated her right middle fingertip.
An employee was driving a golf cart when it hit a speed bump. It flipped over and the employee suffered broken ribs, a punctured lung, and broken lower back disks.
An employee's gloves were caught in the chain and sprocket on a conveyor resulting in amputation of the right middle fingertip.

An employee was investigating a noise coming from a guarded gearbox on the backside of his machine. He was moving a loose grease line when his finger slipped into the chain and sprocket located in the box resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.
An employee was working on top of a roof near a belt pulley. The pulley drifted out of place and fell on his right hand crushing the fingers and causing a partial amputation of his pinky finger.
An employee fell from a height.

An employee was operating the shop blaster. The employee was working at the rear of the machine. As he moved toward the front of the machine, he tripped over a pallet and fell on the pallet. The employee sustained a broken right femur, broken ribs, a punctured lung and a fractured shoulder.
An employee tripped while exiting a waste collection vehicle. The employee suffered a compound ankle fracture.

An employee was holding a sheet of metal to cut for the controller box. The sheet metal slipped from his hand while using a 4" hand grinder and sliced a finger on his left hand. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

The injured employee was training another employee and they were heating and pouring zinc into wire rope sockets (spelter sockets). The injured worker stepped backward, lost his footing, and fell  into the hot kettle, knocking it over. The employee sustained a third degree burn on his back that required hospitalization and surgery.

On May 13, 2021, an employee was operating an overhead crane to move a 2,980 lbs. chip hopper. The hopper was approximately one inch off the ground while moving it. The hopper rotated and caught the employee's foot against the hopper frame and concert ramp resulting in a fracture and laceration to the foot.
An employee was carrying plastic boxes and tripped over a purse that was on the floor. She sustained an injury to femur and hip that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was clearing a re-grind blockage when the rotary valve amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder. The employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken heel that required surgery.
An employee was working at a printing press. The employee was checking T-shirts and ink between two pallets when the machine was shifted, crushing and breaking the employee's right arm.
Employees were installing a culvert. Dirt picked up in an excavator bucket loosened and fell onto an employee's back, causing a fracture.

An employee was unloading a truck. As the employee came down the ramp with a box spring, he fell from the ramp to the floor. He suffered a laceration to his left lower arm and a broken left wrist. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the wrist.
An employee was unloading a truck and crushed their left ring finger between the line and cement bollard resulting in amputation.
An employee fell in an elevator, landing on the floor and suffering a compound fracture of the right arm.
An employee was winching a vehicle onto a rollback tow truck when their finger became caught between the winch cable and the truck bed, resulting in an injury to a tendon in their left middle finger.

On May 14, 2021, at approximately 8:30 a.m., an employee was performing sandblasting operations on the inside rear of a trailer. The trailer was secured to a fixture that allows the trailer to be rotated in order to access different parts of the trailer frame. The counterweight had not been added to the frame or fixture and when the employee began to rotate the trailer, the trailer swung down and collided with their left ankle. The employee was hospitalized for an acute displaced fracture of the left tibia and fibula.

An employee was moving material with a walk-behind forklift when his left leg was pinned between the forklift he was operating and another forklift parked behind him. The forks of the parked forklift penetrated his shoe and the employee sustained a fractured metatarsal and laceration on the left foot.
An employee was hammering rebar using a sledgehammer in order to construct a sidewalk and struck his right index finger causing a fracture and contusion that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was working on a roof, stepped on a plywood sheet, and fell through the roof to the ground resulting in a broken arm required surgery and two fractured discs.
On 5/14/2021, an employee was guiding rubber in the mixing area when their left forearm was caught in the roller of a mixer. The employee suffered a fractured arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting 2x6 lumber with a circular saw and amputated their right thumb.

Two employees were moving an axle tube. Employee 1 set down his end of the tube; the injured employee dropped his end. The injured employee's index finger was caught between the falling tube and another tube, and he suffered an amputation to the finger.

Two employees were in a hopper, performing maintenance on a rock crushing machine. The belt began to operate, carrying them into the chute and through the machine. They suffered fractures and lacerations.

An employee was fixing a battery-powered electric gate. After he reinstalled the battery, the gate actuated and his right index finger was caught in the chain and sprocket. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was cleaning an area between silos/platforms. The employee stepped onto an area between silos and fell 10 feet onto enclosed conveyors below. The employee was hospitalized with fractured ribs and a fractured/dislocated shoulder.
An employee was changing a font print blanket on a printer when their left middle finger was caught between the blanket drum and the plate drum support resulting in amputation.
An employee was closing the door to a boiler ash discharge. The employee's finger was caught between the door and its hinges, causing an amputation to the finger.
An employee was clearing the silo so product would flow freely and suffered the amputation of two fingers.

An employee was on an extension ladder installing a panel and caulking units. The employee fell from the ladder onto the concrete pavement below. The ladder appeared to have struck the employee as it also fell. The employee lost consciousness and was hospitalized for a head laceration requiring sutures, a concussion, and broken ribs.
An employee was picking up a keg of beer in a walk-in cooler. The keg fell over and struck her left leg, breaking the tibia. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee slipped while climbing down a ladder and fell about 12 ft. to the ground, suffering a broken left elbow, a broken lower right leg, and a bruised heel.
A transmission fell on an automotive mechanic's right hand, amputating the ring fingertip.

Two employees were in a confined space and noticed changes in the temperature and smell. They were exiting the confined space when they were overcome by carbon dioxide (CO2). They lost consciousness and were hospitalized.
An employee was helping remove a tree stump. Another employee was using a chainsaw, which bounced back and severely lacerated the first employee's right lower leg.

An employee and a co-worker were conducting work on the pipeline right-of-way. The co-worker went across the bridge to help guide the employee as he drove a side-by-side utility task vehicle (UTV) across the bridge. As he crossed the bridge, the boards along the right side began to give way. The employee hit the accelerator, trying to make it across the bridge. He made it across and the UTV veered to the right, ultimately striking a tree. The UTV rode up the side of the tree, coming to a stop while leaning against the tree, and the employee fell out of the vehicle. The employee suffered a broken rib on his left side, a broken sternum, and fractured vertebrae.
An employee was using a bun slicing machine and amputated a fingertip.

An employee was standing next to a skid of turf on the ground. A forklift picked up the skid and lowered it onto the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized for an injury to their toe that required surgery.
An employee had removed a deckle nozzle to change it. It dropped, and as he tried to catch it his glove was caught in the cylinder. He suffered a degloving to the right thumb.
An employee was loading pallets into a trailer using a pallet jack and pinned his left foot between the pallet jack and the trailer wall. The employee sustained a fractured left ankle.
An employee was spraying down equipment and removing some chicken fat on a shackle when their left index finger was caught in the equipment and amputated.

An employee was selecting items and placing them onto a pallet in the freezer section of the warehouse. He stepped backward to move out of the way of another pallet jack operator and his foot got caught in a pallet causing him to stumble. He then grabbed the pallet jack handle to catch himself, twisted the handle which unlocked it, and the jack rolled and caught his foot between the electric pallet jack and the other pallet. The employee sustained a fractured left leg or foot.

At about 8:45 p.m. on May 16, 2021, an employee opened the lid of a clarifier containing water. Hot water (about 195 degrees F) spilled onto the employee, causing second-degree burns to the employee's chest and stomach.
An employee was adjusting wire on a wet lap machine when their left arm was crushed in an in-going nip point.

A mail carrier was walking back to his truck after delivering a parcel. A dog came out of a house through a dog door, attacked him, and knocked him to the ground. He suffered bites to both forearms and was hospitalized, requiring 40 stitches.
An employee was climbing a ladder. The ladder twisted and the employee fell about 12-15 feet, suffering a rib injury, a spine injury, and a bruised lung.

An employee was washing a tank trailer. When he opened the rear discharge valve on the trailer, ethylenediamine sprayed onto his right torso and upper thigh causing second and third degree chemical burns.

An employee was on a 12-foot ladder working on a aluminum roof when he rotated and fell off the ladder, hitting a metal sign with his chest as he fell to the asphalt drive and concrete sidewalk/curb. He sustained fractured ribs and a bruised sternum.

An employee cut into a 55-gallon drum with a plasma cutter. Gasoline fumes in the drum ignited and then flamed out. The employee suffered burns to both shins, as well as a laceration to the right temple from a piece of the drum.
An employee was performing catering service to an aircraft and fell between the aircraft and the high-lift truck positioned at the aircraft door. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
An employee was walking toward the time clock, tripped and fell resulting in a right patella fracture.
An employee was pushing a part into a machine. The machine caught the employee's left right finger, causing a crushing injury.
An employee was cleaning the blower for a saw and amputated their right index finger.
An employee was adjusting a machine when a rail slid into place. His right middle finger was caught between a piece of angle iron and a strap, and the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was performing quality control on an 8-foot stack of pallets while standing on a 4-foot ladder. The employee was using an air hose to blow dust off of the pallets. The air hose was wrapped around the ladder. When the employee tugged on the air hose, they fell off the ladder onto the ground and fractured their forearm.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wooden planks into stakes. The saw caught his shirt and was pulled toward his abdomen, lacerating it. He was hospitalized with a 10-inch cut from the right side of his torso to the left side of his navel.

On May 17, 2021, a service technician was using a 6-ft. A-frame ladder to install cable service at a residence when he fell off the ladder and onto the wood floor. He suffered a broken right ankle and was hospitalized.
An employee was fixing a vacuum roll on a machine. The employee's left index finger was crushed between the vacuum roll and the table. The finger was amputated.
An employee sustained a transient ischemic attack (TIA) while he was in a meeting.
An employee had finished delivering roofing materials and was removing a fall protection anchor point when he lost balance and fell to the ground injuring his right side.

On 5/17/2021, an employee was removing a broken harp wire from a giant block of cheese when the employee's arm was caught between the push plate and the frame holding the harp, resulting in an arm fracture.

An employee opened a valve to see if a drum was free of hot residual oil. The oil was plugged behind the open valve, but the plug dissolved. Hot oil (300-400 degrees F) splashed out of the drum's receiving receptacle and onto the employee's right thigh and right arm, as well as the right sides of the employee's abdomen and face.

An employee was servicing a conveyor belt. After greasing the ports and gears, the employee restored energy to the machine. The employee's left hand was then caught between the bottom belt and the pressure roller. The employee suffered a fracture and a tendon injury to the left little finger and a forearm burn.

An employee was troubleshooting a stamper machine. The part-sensing proximity switch was malfunctioning. The employee reached through the part access opening in the guard to adjust the proximity switch bracket. The machine cycled, causing the employee's left middle finger to be pulled between the arbor and the embossing stamper. The finger was amputated between the first and second knuckles.
An employee attempted to scrape ground meat from the throat of a meat grinder and contacted the grinder blades resulting in a left middle fingertip amputation.

An employee was working from a ladder, installing a copper welding wire spool. The spool fell and knocked the employee from the ladder. The employee suffered broken left-side ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to clear a jam while walking on a conveyor. His foot got stuck and he fell off the side of the conveyor and broke his leg.

On May 17, 2021, at approximately 12:30 p.m. a letter carrier was delivering mail to a residence when a dog broke free from his chain and attacked her. She sustained a bite on her right thigh and a cut on her head from falling to the ground. She was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing a roof panel. The employee fell through a hole to the ground and some boxes 20 feet below, suffering a broken cheekbone and lacerations.
An employee was replacing plates between conveyors when their left thumb was caught in the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee tripped over elevated caulking between slabs of concrete and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right femur.
An employee was removing a tree limb. When the limb came free, a tag line that was wrapped around the employee's right arm caused serious rope burns and possible tissue damage to his forearm.
An employee was removing a misplaced grommet from the grommet press when their left middle finger was caught in the press and the press activated causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was opening a freezer door when she lost her grip on the handle and fell to the floor. She suffered a back injury and was hospitalized, possibly requiring surgery.
A meat grinding machine amputated three of an employee's fingertips.
An employee was operating the hydraulic shear and amputated a fingertip.
An employee was checking the roller alignment on a corrugated tubing machine when her left middle finger was caught between a roller and the tubing resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell while walking down stairs from a second floor. The employee struck the ground and suffered a left ankle injury.
An employee was leaving work and walking to her car when she slipped down steps and fell onto the concrete below, resulting in a fractured right wrist and left knee.
An employee was welding when there was a dust flash fire and explosion. The employee was burned on the hand and the upper torso.

A temporary employee was on a ladder adjusting the volumetric filler on top of a horizontal form, fill, and seal machine. As she was making adjustments to the brush mechanism, it amputated her left middle and index fingers. The machine was energized at the time of the incident.
An employee slipped and fell on the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading trailer. As he stepped out of the trailer and onto the docking plate it came down and struck the employee's left leg and caused a deep laceration.

On May 18, 2021, an employee was servicing a chiller cooling unit. The employee had removed a side cover from the unit to add water when the fan on top of the unit turned on and pulled in his right hand. He suffered an index finger amputation, a possible amputation of the thumb, and a laceration to the middle finger.
An employee was walking in the parking lot and fell resulting in facial injuries.
An employee was operating a skidder at a logging site in thick brush when the employee's left foot was crushed by the skidder blade.
An employee was struck by a customer's car in a store parking lot. She suffered a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to park an electric pallet jack in its charging station. It jolted and pinned his left leg against a wall, breaking the lower leg.

An employee was rolling 12" pipe from the exit of the large line paint booth to a transfer car. He rolled two pipes by hand onto the transfer car and then rolled the third pipe toward the transfer car. He turned and reached for the fourth pipe when the third pipe began to roll away from the transfer car and pinched his right middle and ring fingers between the two pipes resulting in a partial amputation of the ring finger.

An employee was connecting a wire rope choker to a section of 36-inch concrete sewer pipe. After connecting the choker, a backhoe lifted the section of pipe. As the pipe section was being lifted it began to spin and struck the employee pinning his right leg against a section of stationary pipe. The employee sustained a fractured right femur and lacerations.
An employee fell while moving to descend from the third rung of an 8-foot ladder. He landed on the ground and suffered a broken hip.

An employee was cutting bolts from a bridge during a bridge demolition. When the bolts were cut, the employee was pinned between a beam and the aerial lift. When the lift was moved to unpin the employee, they fell to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken leg and pelvis.

An employee was unjamming caps of deodorant sticks from an unscrambler machine when their right ring finger became pinched between the orienting disc and the timing belt of the machine, resulting in an amputation of the tip of the right ring finger.
An employee had just finished wiring a junction box for a cooler in a food storage unit. The box was powered on and the employee suffered a 120-volt shock.

An employee was standing on the second step of a step-ladder unhooking a 4-inch hose. After unhooking the hose, the end of the hose caught his glove pulling the employee off the ladder to the deck two feet below the ladder. The hose continued to pull the employee to the ground approximately 2.5 feet below the stepladder. The employee suffered neck trauma and spinal cord swelling.
An employee was carrying a large piece of glass during a demolition job. The glass slipped out of his hand and cut his right arm above the elbow. He lost consciousness after receiving the laceration.

An employee was pulling down a garage-style overhead door. The employee's right hand became tangled in the rope tied to the door handle. The metal door track then lacerated the employee's middle finger, causing a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was aligning supply wood to cut with a handheld saw when the saw jerked, caught the employee's glove, and pulled the employee's left index finger into the blade resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was cleaning lines when water pressure caused a hose to burst. He was struck on the face, suffering a cheek fracture and cuts from his broken safety glasses, as well as a retinal detachment and bruises to a cornea.
An employee was standing in the door of his truck when another truck backed into his truck and pinned him between the two trucks. The employee sustained crushing injuries.

An employee was sweeping the floor and was struck by a forklift. This caused the employee to lose his balance and fall to the floor. The employee sustained internal injuries that resulted in the removal of the spleen and a portion of the small intestine.
An employee was on a break smoking a cigarette and suffered burns.

An employee was assisting a patient having a seizure. The patient began to fall and the employee tried to catch the patient. This resulted in both the patient and employee falling to the ground. The employee fell on and broke both of their elbows.
An employee was preparing food using a food processor and amputated their left index and middle fingers.
An employee was unloading a dumpster into a bin when the dumpster lid closed on his right hand and amputated multiple fingertips.
An employee tripped going over a containment curb and fell. A Unistrut clip caused a laceration and degloving injury to his abdomen.
On May 19, 2021, an employee was standing next to the frame machine as it was being pulled into the stall. The dolly wheel ran over his right foot causing a fracture. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cleaning conveyors. His right hand was caught in the ingoing nip point of the tail end rollers. The conveyor pulled in his arm up to the shoulder, injuring the hand, arm, and shoulder.

While out on assignment the employee's vehicle stopped working and needed to be towed for repair. The employee stepped out onto the foot hold on his vehicle at the same time the tow truck driver was trying to hook up the boom from the tow truck. The boom device struck the vehicle and the employee slipped from the foot hold and fell onto the street. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.
An employee was assembling a trench shield. Two of the employee's fingertips were caught and amputated between the spreader and the collar.

An employee was beginning to place a load into a furnace for heat treating. The furnace flared suddenly, shooting out flames caused first- and second-degree burns to the employee's head, lips, and ears.
An employee was clearing a jammed board in the planer mill and contacted the cutter head resulting in amputation of their left index finger at the first joint.

An employee was participating in field training which consisted of various physical activities including running, lifting, and carrying objects. Just prior to the lunch break the employee felt dizzy, was checked out on-site by medics, and was given the OK to proceed. Later in the day, the employee began to feel chest pains and was hospitalized due to dehydration and a muscular injury.
An employee was operating a table saw and amputated a finger on their left hand.
An employee was using a power washer to clean a cement mixer. He fell, hitting his head on the way to the ground and suffering a head laceration and a concussion.
An employee was working on a machine when his right hand was caught in a nip/pinch point. Fingers on the hand were injured, and the index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was driving a stand-up powered industrial truck (PIT) to the charging station and struck a cement reinforcement barrier. The employee was pinned between the PIT and the cement reinforcement barrier, resulting in the amputation of their lower left leg.
An employee was removing a sheet of glass from a window sash when the glass slipped and the employee suffered a deep cut to his right leg. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was operating a brake machine and amputated their left thumb.
An employee was operating a laminated fabric machine when their left arm was pulled into the winder causing a crushing injury.
On May 19, 2021, an employee was responding to a road call and had just arrived at the scene. He fell as he stepped out of the tractor cab and he landed on the ground, suffering a hip fracture.
A Swissport employee bumped into another employee while standing up after picking up aircraft wheel chocks and fell to the ground. The injured employee sustained a broken left arm.

An employee was repairing a sand blaster machine. After the sand blaster was reassembled, the employee then turned on the generator to check the pressure. The employee went back to check the drum and air was escaping. The employee noticed that the hose was slipping off. The employee grabbed the hose and it slipped off and struck the employee on the left side of the head resulting in a laceration and a swollen left eye.

On May 19, 2021, an employee was throwing away a display into the top of the dumpster when he slipped and fell off of the dock ledge to the ground about 3.5 to 4 feet below. He suffered a fractured femur and was hospitalized.
A team member was stepping down from a stand and missed the last step. Her ankle rolled and fractured. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

A welding technician was installing hydraulic packing cylinders for an Automate Side Loader (ASL). The cylinder was on a stand. When the employee attempted to move the cylinder it slipped and fell on the employee's finger pinning the employee's hand against the front part of the truck body. When the employee tried to remove their hand from under the cylinder, their right ring fingertip was amputated.
A molder machine jammed and was turned off. Its still rotating knives caught an employee's hand, causing the amputation of the index finger.

An employee was making a delivery to a customer location. The employee's foot was caught between the truck's liftgate and the rear bumper as the liftgate was raised causing a crushing injury to his right big toe.
An employee was grabbing a package from a shelf in a freezer. A forklift backed over her foot. One of her toes was amputated.
An employee was winching a truck onto a flatbed hauler. The winch cable snapped and the employee suffered a left knee injury that required surgery.
An employee was ripping 2x4 boards on a table saw. A board kicked back and the employee's left hand contacted the blade. The employee sustained a fingertip amputation.

An employee was attempting to clear the air lock by scooping the feed down with a grain shovel. While standing on the pile of feed, he lost his balance. As he went to catch himself, his hand was caught in the air lock resulting in a broken thumb/hand.
A temporary employee was cleaning an airlock from on top of a pile of feed. He began to fall, and his hand was caught in the airlock as he tried to catch himself. He suffered a broken thumb.

An employee was doing remediation work following a water loss in a mobile home. The employee fell through a water-weakened spot in the OSB subfloor to the ground under the trailer, about 10 feet below. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were involved in horseplay while walking when one employee fell and struck their head on the concrete floor resulting in a concussion.
An employee slipped and fell, breaking his left hip and leg.
An employee was walking behind a forklift when it ran over the employee's foot. The employee suffered four broken toes, a dislocated right ankle, and a laceration.

Employees were lifting up a generator from a pallet using a forklift. The straps securing it slipped off the forks. The generator flipped and pinned an employee against a fence. He suffered back and rib injures and a stomach contusion.
An employee was trying to retrieve a piece of meat lodged in a conveyor. The conveyor belt caught the employee's left hand. The hand was amputated.

An employee was trying to clear asphalt from a tailgate latch. He had used a shovel to pry the gate open; the shovel slipped while his hand was between the tailgate and the truck bed, causing a fingertip amputation.
A nurse responded to a small fire caused by a patient and then suffered a heart attack.
An employee was unloading materials from a truck. Their leg buckled while lifting the materials and the employee's lower leg was fractured.

An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the wood kicked back and knocked the employee's hand into the saw blade. The employee suffered a severe laceration to the left hand and an amputation to the left index finger.
An employee was in the pig pen when the animals started fighting. One pig was on top of another when it rolled off and onto the employee's right ankle fracturing it.
An employee's left little finger was caught in a door jamb as the door closed. Her fingertip was amputated.
An employee was closing room partitions and caught his finger between the partitions resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was moving freight inside a trailer for delivery. The employee fell off the truck's lift gate to the ground, suffering fractured vertebrae.

An employee was cleaning up a yard. Some debris fell into his boot. He sat down on some stacked steel plates to remove it; a plate rocked, and as he tried to brace himself his left ring fingertip was amputated between two of the plates.
A meat grinder blade amputated an employee's index fingertip.
One employee struck another employee in the face with a closed fist causing him to fall to the ground. The injured employee sustained a broken nose and a brain contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee inhaled low-foam acid fumes while cleaning a tank. He developed respiratory symptoms and was hospitalized.
An employee bumped into another employee coming out of a dish room. She fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur.

An employee was retrieving carpet rolls from a shelf located about nine feet above the ground while standing on a platform that was raised on the forks of a forklift in order to reach the shelf. Two of the platform brackets broke off causing the platform to tilt to one side. The employee lost balance and fell onto the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured left leg and a concussion. The employee was hospitalized.
A skid steer struck an employee as it backed up.

An employee was operating a double pallet jack. During a sharp right turn, the employee's left foot was caught between the platform of the pallet jack and a wooden pallet on the ground. The employee's lower ankle was lacerated.

Three employees were polishing the concrete floor in the back break room and were overcome with carbon monoxide (CO) from the compressor that was used in that room. One employee was hospitalized for CO poisoning.

Electricians had just finished connecting two portable AC units to a subpanel outside a main panel. They put the fuses back on, and one of them was about to close the electrical panel when an arc flash burned his left hand and forearm.
An employee was struck by a car in a supermarket parking lot and suffered a fractured left ankle and foot.

An employee was cranking the handle of a material winch to raise a 6.5-foot lead cable from a manhole. At the apex, he released the crank handle and tried to retrieve the cable and pull it away from the opening. As the cable started to drop down into the manhole, the crank handle started freely spinning and struck his left forearm, breaking it.
An employee was working the hat channel jig and suffered the amputation of their left middle finger.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell, injuring her left knee.
An employee suffered chemical burns while changing sulfuric acid and was hospitalized.
An employee was attempting to free a jammed board in a sorter bin. The bin arm cycled and pinched the employee's left thumb causing a partial amputation.

An employee was loading a casting into a core knockout machine. When the machine was activated, the casting slipped out of the clamps. The employee was trying to catch it when the clamps caught the tip of his left index finger. He suffered an amputation (without bone loss) to the fingertip.

On May 21, 2021, an employee was using an overhead crane to lift a cured precast concrete piece. The employee had connected the crane's lifting hook to the lifting hook on the concrete piece. As the piece was lifted, the chain tightened and pinched the employee's right index fingertip. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was trying to re-enter a store after being locked out. He fell while climbing over the front counter, landing on the floor and suffering a broken leg and shoulder.
An employee slipped and fell on a slippery production floor. The employee landed on their right knee, suffering a broken kneecap that required surgery.

An employee was operating a CNC lathe. After machining a part, the employee went to open the lathe doors and his right middle finger was caught between the first and second accordion doors causing a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was injured in a material-handling incident. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a cap in a valve and amputated their left index fingertip.

An employee was operating a backhoe to level ground and seal an above-grade aluminum deposit at a landfill. The aluminum reacted with moisture in the ground when the operator leveled the ground, causing a reaction that produced ammonia. The operator suffered lung scarring due to ammonia inhalation and was hospitalized.

An employee was on top of a ladder pulling network cable through an open ceiling to wire for a security camera. The bottom of the ladder slipped out and the employee fell close to the wall. A large piece of crown molding was sticking out from the wall and the employee hit his head on it as he fell. The employee was rendered unconscious and was hospitalized for a head injury and a laceration above the right eye.
An employee was working on a lighting junction box above the ceiling and cut an energized 277-volt circuit wire. The employee was shocked and received an electrical burn on their right hand.
A temporary employee was using the wood jointer and amputated the tip of his right pinky finger.
An employee was bringing a brake down on a piece of metal. The clamping mechanism caught his right thumb, causing the amputation of the thumb tip.

An employee was working in the bed of a truck strapping material down. The employee stepped backward and fell out of the truck to the ground below. The employee suffered a broken rib and collapsed lung.
An employee was cutting a tree on the ground using a chainsaw. The tree rolled into the employee's left leg, breaking it.

An employee was welding inside a barge. While trying to move a scaffold, a scaffold board fell and his right thumb was pinned between an angle bar and the board. The tip of the employee's right thumb was amputated.
An employee was separating two large mail containers. When the containers became loose, she lost her balance and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken hip.

At about 10:25 a.m. on May 21, 2021, an employee was moving stored pedestal fans from an overhead balcony onto an adjacent elevated forklift platform. As the employee stepped off the balcony and onto the forklift platform, the platform became unstable and tipped off the forks. The employee fell to the concrete floor about 10 feet below, suffering a back/spine injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized after a material handling incident.

An employee was mowing a lawn with a riding mower. The mower became stuck on a tree stump. The employee slipped while trying to dislodge it and the employee's feet went under the mower deck. The employee suffered an amputation at the left shin, as well as the amputation of the right big toe.
An employee was standing next to a directional drilling machine when a plastic bracket from the drill struck the employee in the face causing three broken teeth and mouth lacerations.
An employee was installing metal roofing onto a house when he fell off the roof edge onto the ground and suffered a broken right leg.
An employee was trying to readjust a pin for a chassis in a container box. The 53-foot  container dropped on his left pinky finger, crushing it and causing a partial amputation at the second knuckle.

An employee was preparing to repaint the indoor pool. The pool had been drained and a scaffold was erected inside of the pool. The employee leaned over the railing to drop a broom down to another employee working below when the midrail on the scaffold failed causing the employee to fall 12 feet before striking cross bracing and then fall another three feet to the bottom of the pool. The employee was hospitalized for a broken wrist and internal abdominal injuries.

A half-ton jib crane was being used to move a bundle of 1 3/8 inch hex bars into a storage rack. The material rolled, and an employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught between the bars. Both fingertips were amputated.
An employee was rappelling from a helicopter when he fell to the ground, resulting in a broken leg.

Two employees were working to clear a jammed screw conveyor and replace a drive belt. The injured employee's left index finger was crushed in a nip point between the belt and pulley. Approximately one-third of the employee's finger was medically amputated.
An employee was getting off an elevator that was not flush with the floor and tripped on the uneven surface and fell, sustaining a hip injury.
An employee was about to sit down in a chair and fell. The back of the employee's head struck the floor.
An employee was checking for a leak in a hydraulic hose on the trim press machine and lacerated his right middle finger.

An employee was unloading a box truck. The employee was operating a manual pallet jack while walking backwards onto the lift gate. The jack struck the employee's right leg, fracturing the fibula and the tibia.

An employee was descending a ladder that was positioned against a gutter. The ladder slid on the gutter and the employee fell onto concrete pavers about 10 feet below, landing on and breaking their arm.
An employee was dumping garbage and was struck by a car. The employee suffered two open wounds on the head and the right leg.

An employee was changing the creamers at the coffee station when a customer came up beside her. As she turned toward the customer, she fell backward hitting the right side of the bottom of her head on the of the corner of the yogurt bar. This resulted in a laceration on her head and bruising on her right hand, knee, and hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking across a production floor. He slipped on a metal drain cover that was covered in animal blood, fell, and landed on his left arm, breaking it.

A crew had put their tools down after pressure-washing the outsides of two oil tanks. As they walked away, one of the tanks exploded. One of the employees suffered second- and third-degree burns on the back, from the waist up.

An employee was bringing pallets down from the top of the steel shelving using a walkie stacker forklift. His hand got caught between the shelving and the forklift. As the employee tried to free his hand, he suffered a deep laceration that required surgery and hospitalization to repair.
A person fell on an employee who was sitting on a bean bag. The employee suffered injuries and was hospitalized.

An employee was operating power tongs and running casing into a hole. The CRT tool fell 40 feet from the top drive striking the casing stump and the employee. The employee suffered four amputated toes on their right foot and a puncture wound on their back and was hospitalized.

An employee was on a 10-foot ladder, doing maintenance on a vent hood outside a hotel restaurant kitchen. As he was climbing to the top of the ladder, the ladder slipped. He fell to the ground and suffered a broken right thumb.

An employee was placing tire tread onto trays on a tread cart. When employee stepped down between the cart and the guardrail to straighten the tread, the tugger moved and pinned the employee's left leg between the guardrail and the cart and fractured it.
After changing an air filter in an attic area, a mechanic was getting down from a raised area (2-3 feet) when she suffered a left femur fracture resulting in hospitalization and surgery.
An employee's right foot slipped on debris as the employee walked into a trailer. The employee was caught in an awkward position and suffered a fracture above the left knee.
An employee was working out in an onsite gym as part of his approved work activities. He strained his back while performing back extensions and was hospitalized.
An employee was loading steel beams onto a truck. The employee fell from the truck to the ground, suffering a broken pelvis.

An employee was venting a 275-gallon intermediate bulk container to facilitate gravity feeding. He stepped up onto the platform of the secondary containment to gain access to the center cap. While doing so, he lost his footing and fell from the platform (25.5 inches above grade) to the concrete floor and suffered a fractured left tibia and fibula.
On May 24, 2021, an employee was removing rigging from a 2,000- to 3,000-pound beam sitting on a hilltop. The beam jostled loose and rolled over him, breaking his pelvis.
An employee was dislodging debris from a conveyor when the employee's left index finger was caught in the pulley, causing an amputation to the last joint.
An employee's right index finger was caught in the shop door resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was operating a rip saw. A piece of wood kicked back and the employee sustained a puncture wound to the leg and was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing a 28-foot ladder on the side of a customer's home. The ladder shifted causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with rib fractures and lacerations to his head and hands.
An employee tripped and fell over a floor scrubber in a janitorial closet. The employee suffered a hip contusion.
An employee was leaving a room when she tripped on a stanchion divider. She fell onto her left knee.
On March 24, 2021, the injured employee was walking down the stairs to leave work. The employee missed a step and fell down the stairs. The employee was hospitalized for a head injury.

An employee was standing near his truck while hot liquid were being loaded into it. The liquid clogged, and while a pump was being used to blow and pull it, there was an explosion. The hot liquid burned the employee's face, hands, and feet.
On May 25, 2021, an employee was bitten on the left hand by a rattlesnake at the loading dock. He was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail and started feeling ill and became dehydrated from the heat.

A smokejumper parachuted out of a plane to fight a wildfire. He had a hard landing on rocky terrain and suffered a skull fracture, a traumatic brain injury, facial fractures, a fractured neck vertebra, left-side pneumothorax, a broken left humerus, a broken left scapula, three broken ribs on the left side, a broken right tibia, and a shattered knee. He was hospitalized.

An employee was walking into the building from the parking deck when her shoe got caught on the textured surface and she fell forward. The employee was hospitalized for a subdural hematoma and bruises to the right orbit, chin, and left hand.

An employee was standing on the platform at the galvanizer machine holding onto the metal hand rail and observing the moving shovel/ladle for cleaning the galvanizer. The shovel/ladle struck the middle divider of the holding tank causing the shovel/ladle to move up and down roughly. As a result the employee's hand was struck-by the handle of the shovel/ladle and their fingertip was caught between the metal hand rail and the metal handle and amputated.

An employee was moving several boxes of floor tile that were in front of a 2x2 piece of granite countertop. When he moved the last box, the countertop tipped over and struck him on top of the head and caused a laceration.
An employee was walking through a garage. He tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a facial fracture and a cut hand.
An employee was delivering vinyl fencing to a customer's home when a timber rattlesnake bit his right hand. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating the notching machine and amputated their right middle fingertip.
An employee lost his footing as he exited a trailer. The trailer's rear door strap was pulled onto his right shin.
An employee was taking groundwater samples from a monitoring well and became ill. The employee was diagnosed with chemical pneumonitis due to exposure to volatile organic chemicals (VOCs).

An employee was operating a cracker mill designed to grind soy beans. The employee was clearing a jam in the machine when their right hand was caught between two cracker rolls (8" blades) resulting in amputation of their pinky, ring, and middle fingers and a partial amputation of their right palm.
An employee was using a chain and hoist and suffered the amputation of their left thumb.

An employee was cleaning a clog out of a spray nozzle head for a spray gun. The spray gun activated while the employee's hand was over the nozzle head, causing chemical/material to penetrate the employee's right hand. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to remove the chemical/material.

An employee was preparing an inoperable AH-64 Apache Helicopter for tractor-trailer removal from the training area. During the process, the helicopter rolled on its side and caught the employee's left leg underneath it resulting in a fractured tibia, fibula, and ankle.
An employee was moving a glass piece of furniture. The piece fell and lacerated the employee's right forearm.

An employee was standing on a counter to mark the location of a new wall mount for a flat screen television when his right foot slipped off the edge of the counter and the employee fell three feet to the floor below. The employee sustained rib fractures, a hemothorax, and a pulmonary contusion.

A piece of duct fell from a duct jack approximately five feet. The injured employee attempted to catch the falling piece of duct and crushed his fingertip between the duct and a nearby support steel frame resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

An employee was removing the tire from a forklift for transport to the shop for repair. The front tire was foam-filled and was heavier than expected. When the employee pulled the tire from the hub, he lost his balance and the tire fell onto his leg breaking it.
On May 24, 2021, an employee had just moved some empty racks when a fork truck backed into one of the racks. The employee was crushed between the racks and suffered fractures to both legs.

An employee was installing purlins on the roof of a new building. The employee fell on the roof surface and the back of his right arm was caught on a purlin clip as he was falling. He suffered a laceration to the arm and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was servicing/inspecting the belt and pulley on an air exchange unit and amputated their right thumb.
An employee was helping a child get out of a chair when they tripped over an adjacent chair and fell. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.
An employee was changing a hose on equipment. The hose crushed the tip of his right index finger, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was using a crane to move material to the saw. After transferring the load, one of the sling hooks caught the frame of the saw, snapped back and struck him in the face.

An employee had just placed wood cribbing on the ground in front of a forklift's forks and was trying to work a 5,000-pound cylinder off the forks and onto the cribbing. The cylinder rolled off the forks and caught the cuff on his glove. He was pulled down and pinned between the cylinder and the ground, suffering a dislocated right shoulder and a broken right arm.
A framer was installing walls to a steel-framed building when he fell 30 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a shattered pelvis, torn ligaments, fractured vertebrae, and a spleen injury.

An employee was installing an exterior window from a swing stage. As the employee was climbing down through the scaffolding to a lower level, his hand slipped and he fell to the ground, resulting in four broken ribs, a punctured lung, liver damage, and a head laceration.
An employee was walking on top of steel that had been loaded on a trailer. The employee fell from the steel, suffering broken ribs and a punctured lung.
On May 25, 2021, an employee was walking toward his work area when a rubber-track mini excavator backed into him. The track ran over his right foot, causing an open fracture. He was hospitalized.
An employee sustained chest contusions after being struck by a silage wagon that he had disconnected from a truck.

An employee was on a lift, welding a clip on the outer side of a building at about the fourth-floor level. The elevator came down and contacted his right hand, cutting the wrist. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the wrist.

An employee was lowering a pallet from the second shelf of the warehouse storage rack using a forklift. The pallet struck the wire frame shelf that it was on and knocked the horizontal bar on the rack down. The employee was putting the bar back on the rack when it fell and amputated their finger against the wire frame shelf.
An employee was using a hand crank to crank a tarp and fell 10-15 feet to the ground. The employee sustained an pelvis fracture, multiple fractured ribs, severe head trauma, and a severe lung injury.

At about 6:45 a.m. on Tuesday, May 25, 2021, two employees were removing a shaft from a plastic sheet roll core. One of them was releasing air from the shaft air bladders when her right index finger was caught between the shaft and the core. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using grain vacuum to clean up bad grain at the bottom of a corn grinder. The vacuum became clogged and as the employee tried to unclog it, the auger blades amputated the top of their right index and middle fingers.

An employee was checking a load in a truck before docking. The load had shifted in transit and began to fall when the employee opened the door. The employee jumped from the truck to the concrete floor, landing on his side and suffering a broken hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was mowing a grass area along a lake when the lawn mover flipped over and the employee was trapped underwater for 4-5 minutes. The employee was hospitalized for a near-drowning and chemical burns to his lungs from inhaling water/fuel.
An employee fell about 20 feet from an aerial lift while pulling cables.

An employee was in a truck loading material on a pallet jack. He fell from the back of the truck, landing three feet below and suffering a head injury and pain in his hands, wrists, left shoulder, left-side ribs, and knee. He lost consciousness and was hospitalized.
An employee was struck by a mini loader while trying to retrieve equipment that had been run over. The employee sustained injuries to his face and hand.

An employee was pulling a dock leveler into a paint booth. The employee's left pinky finger was caught between the riser and a conveyor roller, causing the amputation of the fingertip just past the nail.

An employee was dismantling a scaffold and was removing a 24-foot deck from the power unit using a forklift. The deck got hung up and then released and swung around pinching the employee's right leg between the deck and the power unit and fracturing it.

An employee was turning a pallet jack into an aisle. The employee's right foot slipped off the platform of the jack and was pinched against a building column at the end of the aisle. The foot was broken.
An employee was operating a manual milling machine when his right hand was caught in a mill bit. His ring and pinky fingers were amputated.
A mechanic was observing equipment from a two-step work platform (approximately 20 inches high) and fell to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained five broken ribs and a broken clavicle.
An employee fell from a steel beam 10-15 feet above the ground while taking measurements at a baseball stadium. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis and fractured vertebrae.

An employee as investigating a leak at roof level beside a parts rack at the final assembly area. As the employee was taking a picture of the leak, he stepped back into the drive path of a dolly train. The employee made contact with the third dolly in the train causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture a leg.

Employees were testing a series of five high-pressure hoses. There was a disconnect between the first and second hose and pressure in the second, third, and fifth hoses that needed to be released. As this pressure was released, a hose whipped and struck an employee's right foot and left ankle. The ankle and the foot were both broken.

An employee was sanding a foundation fixture weighing approximately 400 pounds. The employee was working to rotate the fixture 90 degrees toward the ground in order to access the underlying edges. As he was maneuvering the foundation downward, it tipped over and a protruding appendage of the foundation pinned his pinky finger to the floor. The employee's finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was stepping up to a concrete ledge with a nail gun. The gun shot a nail into his right knee when he stepped up.
On May 26, 2021, an employee was operating the bread packaging machine near the conveyor and sustained the amputation of their left middle fingertip.

While conducting a hole in tubing test, a pressurized release of natural gas and debris knocked an employee off balance causing the employee to fall into the debris and gas. The employee sustained a right pinky finger dislocation and abrasions on their back.

On 5/26/2021, two employees were working from a scaffold platform that was supported by side arm brackets applying brick veneer at a construction site. The employees fell approximately 20 feet when a bracket became dislodged from the frame. The injured employee suffered a back injury. The second employee was able to grab hold of the scaffold to keep from falling.

An employee was checking a strapping machine that was not working. The employee raised the platform on the strapping machine from the deck and was caught between one of the rollers and the metal platform. The employee suffered an amputation to the right pinky finger and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet floor and fell injuring her neck and head.
While cleaning inside a machine, an employee contacted a rotating blade and sustained a hand laceration.

An employee was trimming a pecan tree with a hand saw. He had climbed the tree and was pulling a limb back to cut it when the limb contacted power lines. The employee was shocked and suffered burns to both hands and both knees.

An employee was using a hook tool on the finishing press machine in the finishing area. The tool got caught in the machinery and the employee's finger was pinched between the tool and the machine. The employee's left index finger was medically amputated.

On May 26, 2021, an employee was driving a standup forklift taking products from the backroom to the produce area when the forklift hit a pole and then a pallet of wine causing her foot to be caught between the forklift and the pallet of wine. The employee suffered a broken left foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was crimping heaters, which were not staying in place. As she tried to fix them, a crimper crushed the tip of her finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped and fell on the floor and fractured their left hip.
On May 26, 2021, an employee slipped while cleaning the back of a dump truck. His right forearm was lacerated on a sharp edge of the dump truck's box. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a punch press. A piece of fabricated metal broke off and struck the employee in the neck, lacerating it. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery to remove the metal shard.
An employee was using a meat grinder and amputated a finger.
An employee was walking beside a forklift when his foot was run over by one of the forklift's front wheels. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture and lacerations.

An employee was climbing down a stepladder. One of the ladder's legs dropped into a core hole that had been filled with foam and covered with a skim coat the same color as the floor. The ladder tipped and the employee fell, landing 4 feet below and suffering a broken ankle.
A mill was being set up. It jogged while an employee's hand was in it, amputating one of the employee's fingertips.

An employee was disconnecting a plant process hose carrying 32% liquid sodium hydroxide. The employee was exposed to the chemical under his face shield. The lower part of his face was exposed and he suffered a rash/burn.

An employee was operating a dryer kiln when an alarm went off indicating that one of the two limit switches of the centering device control was not functioning properly. In order to reach the centering device control limit switch, the employee used a rod and kneeled down stretching his body/hand forward between the dryer exit and a column of an unloader machine. The employee's body was caught between the exiting tile cart and the column of the unloader machine resulting in fractured ribs.
An employee was cutting bar stock with an automated saw. The pneumatic clamp crushed her left ring finger at the nailbed. The fingertip was medically amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was helping co-workers to set a 3/8" tempered glass material in the shower with suction cups. During installation, the glass shattered and cut the employee's right forearm.

Two employees carried a piece of glass that had been on a conference room table to the dumpster. The glass was roughly 8 feet by 3 feet. As the employees got ready to put the glass into the dumpster, the glass shattered, causing a severe laceration to the right forearm of one of the employees. The laceration required surgery.

An employee was moving across a first floor ceiling. The employee stepped on a ceiling joist, which gave way; the employee fell to the concrete floor about 10 feet below and suffered a broken right hand and broken right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was grinding steel on a tank barge for hull repair. Sparks flew into the employee's shirt, which caught fire and burned the employee's stomach and hands.
An employee suffered a partial amputation to the left middle fingertip while cutting millwork with a miter saw.

An employee was in a bucket constructing a new electrical distribution line. The employee was connecting a primary phase to a pole. While holding the primary phase in his right hand, his left hand was on the controls of the bucket. A metal part of the bucket contacted a live, energized line and the employee was shocked. The employee also sustained burns to both hands.
An employee jumped off a pallet jack, which accelerated forward over her right foot. The foot was broken.
An employee was in an attic when they fell through the ceiling and landed at ground level, suffering fractures to the right leg and heel.
An employee was on a step ladder moving products. While descending the ladder, the employee missed a step and fell striking the shelf and then the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was cleaning grease from the drum roller bearing of a mixer truck when the side of the rotating roller contacted his left middle finger causing a partial amputation of the fingertip.

A driver was inspecting an empty container for damage. While the driver was inside the container, a stacker operator started lifting the container, which was still attached to the chassis with four twist locks. The driver, upon feeling movement, jumped approximately 6 feet out of the container onto the concrete ground and broke his heel in two places.

An employee was performing masonry work on a residential home while working on a scaffold near an overhead powerline. The employee was electrocuted by the powerline and suffered injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was removing a piece of wood from an electric saw when the saw contacted his right hand, resulting in the amputation of two fingers.
An employee was on a mobile ladder installing speaker wire. The ladder shifted and the employee fell about 10 feet, suffering a head laceration, a broken leg, and a broken arm.

An employee was on a 28-foot ladder holding onto a cable that was being replaced. A truck struck the cable and the employee fell to the ground. The employee sustained a broken neck, shoulder, arm, wrist, and fingers.
An employee fell off a fixed ladder while performing work.

At about 1:30 p.m. on May 27, 2021, an employee was carrying a 4-by-6 plywood panel down stairs from a second floor to a mezzanine. The employee fell at the last or second-to-last step and landed on the floor. Both of the employee's knees were injured, with quadriceps tendons torn from the kneecaps. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was unloading a cart of unsellable merchandise into a trash compactor. He lifted a broken picture frame and was impaled by a protruding shard of glass. The employee was hospitalized with a cut artery and a suspected tear to the liver.
An employee was operating a forklift when it struck a support beam. The employee suffered a head laceration.
On May 27, 2021, an employee was trimming hedges with the hedge trimmer and amputated their left index fingertip.
A vehicle struck a school crossing guard in the street. The guard suffered fractures to the right kneecap, sacrum, and right-side pelvis.

An employee was manually refeeding tissue into the napkin press and folder machine. When the machine was jogged, a finger on her left hand was pulled between two rollers. The employee suffered a partial amputation of the left finger and was hospitalized.
An employee was servicing a rooftop AC unit. While descending the roof's fixed ladder, he slipped and the employee fell onto his right side. The employee suffered a displaced elbow fracture.
An employee was sanding an elevator door and fell striking their head on the elevator doorway.
Employees were installing HVAC systems at a three-story apartment building. An employee fell 35 feet through an unguarded elevator shaft and suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was transferring milk into a delivery truck when the plunger valve on the milk truck partially amputated their left index finger.
An employee was moving an electric pallet jack. The jack ran over the employee's left foot, breaking toes.
An employee was turning on the injection pump at a work site when a pressurized release of water struck the employee causing a laceration to their abdomen and chest and an injury to the left arm.

While leaving work and heading to a vehicle, an employee fell forward in the parking lot hitting her face and head on the concrete. The employee was hospitalized with a laceration to the left brow, a broken nose, and a spinal fracture.

An employee was preparing a spool to take up cable from an extrusion process. Tubing got caught on the collet and spindle of the winder. The employee was going to use scissors to cut the tubing off the winding reel. Before being able to cut, the tubing tightened on the rotating spindle shaft, amputating the employee's left index and middle fingers at the first joint.
On May 26, 2021, an employee was using an 8-foot A-frame ladder to clean the building's awning when he slipped and fell off the ladder. He broke his right ankle and was hospitalized.

A mechanic had ascended a work platform that was 44" tall and had been positioned around the aircraft to perform his task. While addressing his work he stepped over the toeboard at the end of the platform onto the ground. He was hospitalized for five broken ribs and a bruised lung.
An employee was climbing a wood power line pole. The pole failed below ground level and fell on him, breaking his pelvis.

On May 27, 2021, employees were conducting power restoration at a site. An employee came in contact with an energized power line and sustained burns to both hands. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

Two employees were lowering a 6-foot, 8-inch section of pipe to the ground with a come-along. The pipe slipped out of the rigging and struck a 6-foot stepladder one of the employees was standing on. The employee fell to the ground, suffered a skull fracture, and was hospitalized.

Two technicians were changing out a compressor on an HVAC chiller. While preparing the chiller for a pump down, the compressor was over pressurized and the copper drain lines burst. As one technician approached the chiller, a piece of the copper drain line hit the technician on the left wrist. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a crane at a steel fabrication shop. The employee had just laid a section of steel, carried in the crane's hooks, on the ground. The employee unhooked the hooks and began to raise them. One of them hooked the section of steel and overturned it onto the employee's right foot. The employee suffered fractures to the foot and toes.
An employee was using a table saw to cut cabinet filler boards. The saw amputated their left thumb between the fingernail and knuckle.

An employee was in a bucket truck attempting to lift a light pole using a rope and a winch. The rope broke causing the employee to fall from the bucket onto the truck. The employee sustained a fractured C-5 vertebra and a fractured shoulder blade.
An employee was on a ladder sawing off a dead tree branch. The employee fell off the ladder onto the ground and suffered multiple broken ribs and a spinal column injury.

An employee was trying to find a test sample that had been placed into a pipe. As her finger entered the expulsion port, the pneumatic valve closed, amputating the bottom pad of her right middle finger near the tip.
An employee was sawing a downed tree when the tree rolled and his left calf was cut by the chainsaw. The cut required surgery.
While carrying two lamps, an employee tripped on the corner of a nightstand and fell, fracturing his hip.
An employee was changing plastic film in a machine. Moving parts in the machine caused the amputation of the first joint of the employee's right index finger.

An employee was cleaning the floor behind the cutter machine at the end of their shift and were struck in the head by the cutter. The employee then fell and hit their head on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured jaw.
An employee finished an oil change and was cleaning the car's engine when his pinky fingertip was amputated by the fan belt.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor machine. His upper body was caught in the machine's rotating shaft, and he suffered broken bones and facial lacerations.
An employee was operating a welding machine. A falling piece of metal landed on the employee's left hand, partially amputating the index finger.
While mounting a pallet jack, an employee grabbed the throttle instead of the safety bar. The jack moved and the employee's foot was broken between it and a pole.

An employee was scanning freight on a forklift through the mast of the lift and bumped the mast lever. The employee's right arm was caught by the mast resulting in a forearm fracture that required surgery.
An employee was cleaning a drum former machine. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the machine and the fingertip was amputated.
On May 28, 2021, an employee was cutting onions with a standard chef's knife and partially amputated their left thumb.

A crew of three Bassler Energy Services employees were about to clean out a heater treater vessel bottom. The vessel had been depressurized and its contents had been evacuated below the manway. When the crew opened the vessel to begin pressure-washing the manway face, fumes ignited and the resulting flash fire burned two of them. One suffered burns to the face, cheeks, and neck; the other suffered burns to the hands. One employee was hospitalized.

An employee was backing down a dock with a large skid on the forks of his forklift. The forklift struck an upright I-beam. The employee's right hand was caught between the I-beam and the right rear upright post of the forklift's protective cage, causing the amputation of his pinky, middle, and ring fingers.
An employee was operating a palletizer and suffered a hand fracture that required surgery.
An employee was assisting in cleaning out the baghouse in the spray dryer room when the blades of the rotary valve amputated four fingers on their right hand.

A mobile scaffold had fallen over and come to rest against a catwalk. A team of 10 to 12 employees were trying to right it when it moved off the catwalk, then fell to the ground. One of its crossbars struck an employee, who was trapped between the scaffold and the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with back injuries.
An employee went to remove a garment that had jammed on a conveyor line. The tip of her right ring finger got caught in the conveyor belt and was amputated.

An employee was sitting in a rolling chair in the security office and bent over to pick up a piece of dropped paper. As she bent over, the chair rolled out from underneath her, causing her to fall and hit her head on her desk. She was hospitalized for a concussion.

A stand-up powered industrial truck struck another powered industrial truck while turning. Its operator was ejected and was caught between the two pieces of equipment. The operator suffered a bone contusion and a small pelvic fracture at the left side of the hip.
An employee had been using a coil cleaning product when the wind blew the chemical into his face resulting in eye irritation.

At 11:00 a.m. on May 28, 2021, an employee was bracing the lid of a shaft plate by standing against it. The water stream from a high-power pressure washer struck him in the back, causing a laceration and a collapsed lung. He was hospitalized.

An employee was sliding two empty totes stacked on top of each other across the floor into a storage area. While doing so, the bottom tote started sliding out from the top tote. The employee used one hand to hold the top tote then placed her other hand on the bottom tote to support herself from falling. She then fell and fractured her femur.
An employee was sweeping out the bus while walking backwards. The employee fell off the edge of the bus onto the ground and sustained a concussion.
An employee was removing a blister from a machine on a manufacturing line. She suffered a partial amputation to her right middle fingertip.

An employee was placing wheel chocks on a trailer. The trailer moved when another employee entered it, causing the wheels to crush the first employee's fingers. The employee suffered a partial amputation to a thumb.

An employee was at an oil rig, cleaning a window while standing on the second rung of a ladder. The ladder shifted and he fell. He landed on the rig floor and suffered fractures to the left lower tibia and fibula.
An employee closed the door of a safe on their finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee was on a ladder installing a gutter and fell from the ladder onto the ground. The employee sustained a fractured foot.
An employee was repairing the bottom of a customer's boat and drank acid resulting in burns to their throat and stomach that required hospitalization.

A shipping yard laborer had just helped a straddle carrier operator connect lifting gear to a flat rack's arms. The straddle carrier was lifting the arm when the flat rack slid toward the yard laborer and pinned him against the bumper of the straddle. The laborer suffered a broken sternum.
On May 29, 2021, an employee sustained an electric shock to the left hand while cleaning a deli slicer. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking past a dock as a forklift was backing out of the trailer at the dock. The rear tire of the forklift struck the employee resulting in a left foot/ankle laceration and fracture.
An employee was monitoring a cookie machine when his right ring finger was caught in the machine and amputated.
An employee was in a stock picker when it moved downward and crushed his fingers against a rack resulting in partial amputation of the distal phalanx on their middle finger.
An employee was cleaning food equipment when the employee's right hand got stuck in the rollers of the conveyor portion of the equipment resulting in a severe laceration.
An employee began to feel lethargic and to cramp at the jobsite. The employee was hospitalized for a possible heat illness.
An employee's foot got caught on a power cord while standing up from their desk and the employee fell fracturing their left hip.

An employee was changing a pricing sign while on top of a soda machine located outside the grocery entrance. The employee fell backward off the machine and sustained injuries to the shoulder, back, and head; as well as an undetermined fracture that required surgery.

Four employees were pushing a roll of paper on the paper machine winder deck to clear a conveyor for two defective rolls. They lost control of the roll and it struck one employee resulting in a fractured pelvis that required surgery.

An employee was maneuvering a product cart with his hands on the sides of the cart. As he was doing so, the employee's left pinky finger got caught between the cart and the edge of a metal guard on a conveyor belt resulting in a fingertip amputation.
While walking down stairs, an employee tripped and fell to the stair landing. The employee sustained a fractured left femur.

A mechanic was performing preventative maintenance on an automated plunger type valve. The air pressure on the valve released and the valve closed due to spring pressure on it. The employee's left ring fingertip was caught between the valve and its seat resulting in amputation.
An employee was clearing scrap from the press outfeed roller conveyor and contacted the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was replacing a gearbox on a palletizer when the tip of his right ring finger was caught in the chain/sprocket assembly causing a partial amputation.
An employee was priming a sump pump when hot water and steam were released burning his left arm and neck.

An employee was walking through the chemical room when he noticed a 2.5 gallon jug of detergent that was unstable on the storage rack. When he went to grab the jug, his hand slipped off of the product which caused the chemical to splash onto his stomach and upper leg. The employee was hospitalized for chemical burns.
An employee was pouring concrete and fell onto exposed rebar resulting in an arm laceration and hospitalization.
While cleaning the operating room, an employee tripped over a cord and fell fracturing her ankle.

On May 31, 2021, at approximately 5:30 p.m., a material equipment operator (MEO) was driving a forklift in reverse to place a bundle in a staging area. The forklift ran over the foot of another employee who was walking in the area. The injured employee's foot was surgically amputated.

An employee was in between two parked vehicles. Another vehicle left an on-ramp and went onto the grass shoulder. It then struck one of the parked vehicles, causing the employee to be caught between the two parked vehicles. The employee sustained fractures to both lower legs.
An employee was clearing a jam in the filler machine and amputated their right thumb.
An employee had been decking the roof of a one-story house. He fell to the ground and was hospitalized with a broken femur.
An employee was cleaning the manure belt in the barn using a broom. The broom became caught in the manure belt. The employee attempted to free the broom and amputated their left index finger.

An employee was unpacking a crate of pre-purchased glass sheets. While unpacking the crate, the weight of the glass shifted and the glass fell forward out of the crate and onto the employee's left leg resulting in a fractured fibula and tibia that required surgery.

While reaching for product in the warehouse, an employee lost balance and fell off a pallet jack landing on the floor approximately 4 to 5 feet below. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left knee.

An employee was attempting to restore power by removing tree limbs from the power lines and fell out of a tree. The employee suffered a concussion, fractured T6-T8 vertebrae, and an injured sternum, a right ankle tendon injury, and a lumbar injury.
An employee fell from a ladder and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a lumber pile 8 to 9 feet off the ground in order to cover it with a tarp and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured skull.

While measuring with a tape measure, an employee bumped their hard hat on something overhead and then stepped backward into a 3-foot deep conveyor tunnel, falling and sustaining a fractured right tibia.
An employee was descending a fixed ladder when he lost his grip, causing him to fall approximately 8 feet to the floor. The employee sustained a broken right leg.

An employee was using a doffing cart to move a roll of paper over to a conveyor. The roll hit the edge of the roll plate, causing it to tip over; the employee suffered a back sprain while stopping it from falling.

An employee was removing the bands from a package of 12-foot logs, which had been raised on a forklift and supported at each end with more logs. When the employee cut the last band, the logs fell on his ankles and broke both of them.
An employee was picking up a piece of glass with a co-worker when the glass slid and cut the employee's left wrist.

An employee descended a ladder inside a barge tank to take depth measurements of the lining. About 2-3 rungs from the bottom of the ladder, he turned and jumped to leap over a puddle of liquid around an inside pump. The employee landed in the liquid, which splashed on his face and  eyes. The liquid was caustic and the employee suffered loss of vision in his right eye and third degree burns on his legs.

An employee was removing a utility vehicle with other team members when they decided they needed additional rigging. The employee was securing the additional chain for the rigging when the vehicle shifted and caught the employee's leg between the vehicle and a collection box. The employee suffered a compound fracture to his lower right leg.

An employee was observing a robot stacking lumber onto pallets for shipment. The robot's arm picked up a piece of lumber to place on a pallet, then swung and struck the employee's face. The employee was hospitalized with a jaw fracture, loss of teeth, and an open wound to the right side of the mouth.
