While trying to avoid being hit by a patient, a nurse tripped on tubing/wiring and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured left knee.

After repairing a casing on a power line, an employee was making a connection to energize a distribution line. The employee was shocked, suffering second- and third-degree burns to the face and left elbow.
An employee was entering the back door of his work location when he tripped over a concrete slab and fell, resulting in a fracture to his left hip below the ball joint.
An employee was testing a circuit breaker panel with a multimeter when the panel flashed and the employee was burned on their hands and arms.
An employee was moving hockey bleachers to a prep area when they fell off the bleachers and fractured their wrist.
An employee was about 4 feet up an 8-foot step ladder, installing window blinds. He lost balance while descending the ladder and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left foot.

An employee was working near an elevator shaft opening on the third floor when he fell down the elevator shaft and onto the roof of the elevator, resulting in a laceration on his forehead, brain hemorrhaging, and back pain.
An employee was repairing a plastic flighted conveyor when a plastic piece broke and flew into their eye, resulting in an injury.

An employee was assembling a slide rail system and had an interior panel installed into the soil when the panel dropped 2 feet, causing him to lose balance and fall into the excavation. The employee suffered contusions.

An employee was observing the installation of a boom mower which was being moved by a forklift. When the load was relieved from the forklift on the left side, the assembly shifted toward the forklift and out of alignment with the tractor. The forklift operator attempted to reposition the load balance; however, the load shifted forward and the right side of the assembly dropped off the forks to the ground, striking the employee's right foot. The right foot was crushed and the tibia, fibula, and heel bone were broken.
An employee was using a table saw and amputated his left pinky finger.

On June 1, 2021, at approximately 5:15 p.m. an employee was cleaning residual material from a tank wagon. When the tank wagon operator opened the meter/pump valves residual rinse water (approximately 200 degrees F) was released from an open hose and splashed onto the employee's legs. The employee was hospitalized for second degree burns on his lower legs.

An employee had been operating the envelope production line. As the employee was troubleshooting the line, the employee was caught in and struck by a rotating drive shaft resulting in a severe leg laceration requiring surgical repair.

An employee emptied the contents of a truck into a tank and then closed the valve on the truck. While taking the asphalt transfer hose off the truck, residual liquid asphalt splashed on his face and chest resulting in second degree burns.
On June 1, 2021, an employee was reinserting a repaired roll into a machine. Another roll in the machine tilted, came off the track, and fell onto him. He suffered broken ribs.
An employee tripped on a brick on the sidewalk in a parking lot. He fell to the ground, breaking his right hip. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a reach truck in the reverse position and lowering the forks. The truck struck a wood pallet, a piece of which broke off. The employee's right leg was pinned between the piece of wood and the truck's cab. The leg was broken, and the employee was hospitalized.

An error came up on a pallet receiver table's machine panel and an employee went to the pallet ejector to troubleshoot. The employee was resetting a limit switch when his thumb got caught by a moving chain. The employee suffered a laceration that resulted in a revision amputation.

An employee was preparing to pump bail water to a vessel when a metal end-cap was blown off the end of the 3-inch bail hose. The end-cap struck the vessel, ricocheted, and then struck the employee's jaw. The employee sustained a fracture to the face and jaw.
An employee was loosening a clamp on a steam line for a carton filling machine. Steam burst out of the pipe where the clamp was and burned the employee's chest and arms.

An employee was repairing a battery-powered lawnmower . As the employee lifted the mower to look underneath, the mower energized. The blades struck the employee's left hand resulting in the amputation of the middle, ring, and pinky fingers.
A crew drilled a hole in the ground for a power pole. While the auger was being lifted, the sling snapped and struck an employee on the right arm, resulting in a fractured elbow.
An employee was removing mold plates from a pallet when the bottom plate fell forward off the pallet and struck her lower left leg, resulting in a fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was offloading a stand-on lawnmower from a trailer. His foot was caught between the lawnmower and a concrete parking block. He suffered broken bones in the left leg.
An employee was cleaning meat out of the auger machine. A door in the auger machine went down on his right hand resulting in amputation of the ring finger.
At approximately 9:45 PM, an employee was found unconscious on the floor, laying next to a ladder. The employee sustained a laceration on the back of the head and was hospitalized.
An employee was fixing the load on a trailer. He pulled on cardboard, lost his balance, and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken left wrist.
A temporary employee was bending down to pick up a lateral support block when his nail gun fired a nail into his right knee.
An employee was troubleshooting the preheater of a repaver and sustained burns to the left hand and arms.
An employee stepped on a temporary air hose while walking through the shop, lost balance, and fell to the ground breaking a leg.
An employee was taking pictures of the fire sprinkler system inside of the dumbwaiter when she fell 10 feet. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was mowing a lawn when a branch got caught on the front of the mower. As he was trying to free the branch, the rotating mower blade lacerated his foot.

On June 1, 2021, an employee was trying to clear a milk case jam on the dolly loader track. His right was hand was under the milk crate and his index finger got caught in the chain of the track, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
A postal employee began to feel hot, dizzy, and clammy. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.
On June 1, 2021, an employee was removing a mold from the side of a press. The mold slipped off the steel transfer plate and fell onto the employee's left foot, breaking three toes.
An employee was stocking product in his work area when a family member entered the store and stabbed the employee in the neck with a knife. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
Two employees were fixing the clamping mechanism on a trim press. The press activated and came down on top of an employee's left thumb and lacerated it.
An employee was bitten by an insect while processing material.
An employee was pulling parts in a warehouse when they began to feel heat-related illness symptoms and were hospitalized.

An employee was driving home when he began to suffer nausea and cramps in the fingers, arms, and chest. After stopping his truck and leaving it, he lost consciousness. He was hospitalized, suffering from a possible heat illness/injury.

An employee was replacing an air compressor. The employee was heating the tubing with a torch when the oil residue from the tube flashed and contacted the employee's face area. The employee's face cover caught fire, and the employee suffered first-degree burns to the face and chest. The employee was hospitalized.
The injured employee was driving a forklift when they were struck by the forks of a pallet jack. The employee suffered a broken right femur.
An employee was operating a standing forklift with loaded pallets. The forklift hit a bump and the employee's leg was pinned between the load and a concrete bollard, resulting in a broken leg.

An employee was standing in the area where his truck trailer was being unloaded when a forklift operator moving a crate bumped into the trailer wall, causing the crate to shift and fall onto the employee. The employee suffered a fractured hip and pelvis.

An employee was assisting a co-worker with reassembling an operating room bed when her finger became pinched between the top and bottom pieces of the bed, resulting in an amputation of the left pinky fingertip.

An employee was riding as a passenger in a side-by-side golf cart as it came down a mountain. The cart started to tilt, then fell as the employee was trying to keep it straight with his right leg. The driver fell on him. He suffered three broken ribs and a broken right femur.

An employee was using a CNC lathe to finish-grind a small urethane roll. His right hand contacted the rotating grinding wheel and was pulled in. He suffered amputations to the ring fingertip (at the first knuckle) and the middle finger (at the second knuckle).
An employee was walking above a hatch when he fell into the hatch approximately 25 feet to the ground below, resulting in back injuries.
An employee suffered a puncture wound to the left index finger while using spray paint equipment. He was hospitalized.
An employee was working at the tail end of an edger conveyor. The employee was caught in the rotating tail end of the conveyor and suffered an arm amputation.

An employee was standing on the deck of a barge after helping set a 60-foot wooden post in a pile driver mounted on an excavator. The post snapped in two and one section swung back and struck the employee in the back, knocking him to the deck of the barge. The employee suffered skin abrasions and fractured bones in his back and ribs.
An employee was operating a pneumatic press when it cycled and struck the employee's right little finger. The fingertip was amputated. The press was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was moving product with a forklift when the forklift struck a bollard. The employee's left foot was crushed, resulting in an amputation.

On June 2, 2021, at 8:20 a.m., an employee was driving a forklift uphill that was holding bundles of beams that became unstable. With the forks on the ground, the employee attempted to move a board that was part of the load supporting the stack of bundles, causing one bundle to fall and pin the employee's leg between it and a bundle that had previously fallen. The employee was hospitalized due to a contusion to the left knee and leg.

An employee and a co-worker were getting ready to splice underground wires when a screwdriver that had put on a wall made contact with the old wire, causing a flash. The employee suffered burns to their arm, hand, leg, and face that required hospitalization.

An employee had just finished helping a co-worker secure a 9-foot section of wire trough, that was secured to a cross member that was elevated approximately 11.5 feet above the concrete floor. The employee was descending a fiberglass step ladder when the ladder shifted from beneath him in one quick movement, causing him to lose his balance and fall approximately 5 feet. The employee suffered an L-1 lumbar fracture and was admitted to the hospital.

An employee was using a screwdriver to clean out a hole saw attached to a drill. The drill was activated and the blunt end of the screwdriver struck the employee in the right eye. The employee suffered bleeding to the eye and permanent vision loss.

On June 2, 2021, at 9:30 a.m., an employee was moving stock material from a pallet by hand when other stock materials fell from the pallet and struck the employee's ankle, resulting in a torn Achilles tendon.

On June 2, 2021, at approximately 10:45 AM, a mechanic was standing next to a hydraulic baler press when it cycled. The platen came down on the mechanic's foot resulting in amputation of several toes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was entering the building and held the door open for a co-worker exiting the building. The edge of the door edge contacted a bollard and pinched his left middle finger. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was removing a refrigerator unit with a hoist when it shifted, causing the employee's finger to get caught in a lifting hook and resulting in amputation of their left index fingertip.
Equipment was being moved into a charging area. It pinned an employee against a guardrail, breaking the employee's ankle.
An employee was preparing to load equipment into their truck. The employee fell, striking their head and suffering a concussion, a brain bleed, and possible fractures. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was fixing a grinder. The space was limited and he could not open the grinder electrical door all the way. After checking voltage and replacing a fuse, he stood up to shut the main disconnect off and the cabinet door shut slowly, pushing his hand inside and shocking him. He was then held to the grinder. He was shocked, resulting in the amputation of his left pinky and ring fingers, as well as a thumb injury that required a skin graft.

An employee was operating a milling machine and pressure-testing finished parts. As the employee tested a part, an upper piece of the test fixture separated and struck the employee's head causing a laceration.
An employee was trying to clear a jam on a keg line. The employee's left foot was caught by the infeed. The foot was amputated.
An employee was attempting to attach chains to a 1,060-lbs. steel frame when the frame fell onto the employee, resulting in eight broken ribs and lacerations above the eye and to the fingers.
A piece of material or equipment fell from a 20-story building, injuring an employee.

An employee was descending a ladder when he fell from the second rung of the ladder and hit his head on a parked lift truck. The employee suffered blurred vision, a headache, a bump on the back of his head, and a brain bleed that required hospitalization.
A road flagger slipped on loose gravel and fell, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was operating a large manufacturing press when their left ring finger became caught in the press, resulting in a partial amputation just above the first knuckle.
An employee was operating a table saw when it amputated his left thumb.
An employee tripped on a power cord for an electric rocking chair, fell to the floor, and broke her hip.

While riding an ATV during a training class, an employee was going down a hill on a trail with some hairpin turns when a wheel got caught on a rock and the ATV rolled over. The employee suffered a lacerated left calf and scrapes and abrasions on the left arm.

Employees were disassembling a flange test adapter on equipment after it had undergone  hydrostatic pressure testing. The injured employee was loosening the bolts holding the test flange to the equipment when pressurized water (22,000 psi) escaped and struck his upper legs, causing severe lacerations to both thighs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to close a trailer door when they fell off the back of the trailer to the ground below, resulting in a head injury.

An employee and a co-worker were cleaning out a tank. The employee had drill mud all over their boot and the co-worker was helping spray mud off the boot with a pressure washer gun when the pressurized water cut the employee's foot.

An employee was removing a 30-pound tray of salmon from a rolling tray rack when the tray became jammed in the rack. When it came unjammed, it impacted the employee's left middle finger, just after the nail bed, up to the first knuckle. The employee suffered a crush injury with the loss of skin.
An employee was cleaning out a hopper when his hand slipped and contacted the rotor, resulting in a right middle finger amputation at the base of the nail and damage to the index finger.

An employee was moving cattle on horseback. While he was cutting a bull from the herd, his horse spooked and began to buck. He was thrown from the horse to the ground, suffering a broken left fibula and ankle.

An employee was standing on a stool/ladder to reach a nip point on an unused portion of a printing press, about 10 feet off the floor. The employee was caught between a press nip roll and an idler roller, suffering contusions and damage to skin on both arms.
An employee was cutting boneless strip steaks with a boneless saw. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's right thumb.

An employee was dumping mail from an all-purpose container onto a culling belt. The employee was reaching with their right hand to remove a package stuck in the container while their left hand was on the bar that holds the container in place when it's turned upright to dump the contents. The container shifted and crushed the employee's left middle finger between the bar and metal frame of the container, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was inspecting a part in an air-powered machine. The machine crushed her left index fingertip, amputating about 1/4 inch of it.

An employee was moving grating onto a hole in a mezzanine floor when he fell feet-first through the hole to the concrete floor 10 feet below, resulting in three fractured vertebrae, a broken rib, and a concussion.
An employee cut his left index finger while taking a panel of sheet metal off a machine during preventive maintenance.
On June 3, 2021, an employee was standing in a receiving area when a forklift struck him. He suffered two broken legs.
An employee was removing a bolt from a window covering when the window came down, crushing their left pinky finger and resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was loading and unloading grain when the swivel spout broke loose from the bracket and fell on the employee, resulting in hospitalization for broken ribs and a head abrasion.
An employee was taking a tire off a rim. When the arm of the tire machine moved, it caught the employee's left index finger and amputated the fingertip above the first knuckle.

An employee was unloading a truck with a forklift. The employee's right hand was caught between the forklift's roll cage and a computer keyboard's metal swing arm. The little finger was crushed at the knuckle and the ring finger was lacerated.
An employee was pushing material forward on a conveyor belt. The employee's left index finger was caught between the rollers and the belt resulting in amputation of the pad of the finger.
An employee was loading material on the back of a box truck when he lost his balance and fell to the ground, resulting in fractures to the left tibia, fibula, and ankle.

An employee was on a ladder, working on an aircraft antenna. The employee fell 3 feet from the third rung of the ladder, struck the wing, and then landed on the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken pelvis.
At about 3:30 a.m. on June 4, 2021, an employee fell from the back of a delivery truck while unloading it. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken hip.
An employee slipped while stepping onto a curb and fell to the ground, suffering a broken left hip.

An employee was walking across the rig floor carrying a large bolt, called a connecting pin, when he tripped on an object and fell to the floor. The bolt impacted the end of his left ring finger and amputated the fingertip.

An employee was changing out floor paper under a chain conveyor inside a topcoat cure oven. His left middle finger was pulled into a pinch point between the conveyor's chain and a gear. The skin of the fingertip was degloved, and the fingertip was medically amputated at the first joint.

An employee was climbing down industrial stairs after rinsing a conveyor. The employee slipped on a hose and fell down the stairs, catching their right pinky finger between food fencing and a conveyor channel. The finger was amputated below the second knuckle.
An employee was clearing a jam on a board edger when their right index finger was struck by a saw blade, resulting in amputation at the second knuckle.
An employee was operating a metal shear machine when the blade dropped and amputated his right hand.
An employee was descending from a ladder when he fell, landing on the floor and suffering a hairline fracture to the left wrist, a ruptured spleen, and internal bleeding.
On June 4, 2021, an employee was installing shades inside a greenhouse from a scissor lift about 16 feet in the air. He fell from the lift, suffering back injuries. He was hospitalized.
An employee was re-reeving blocks using a crane. When the cables were loosened, the blocks shifted and fell on the employee's left leg, fracturing it.
An employee at a boarding facility opened a cat enclosure to feed a cat and clean the enclosure when the cat bit her left hand.
An employee was moving about 12 sheets of drywall, stacked against a wall in a hallway. The drywall became and unstable and fell on the employee's left leg, breaking the femur.
An employee had been moving wood pallets. An inverter struck the employee's left arm resulting in a fractured ulna and tissue damage to the arm.

An employee was carrying ceiling panels and placing them on a scissor lift for installation. The employee fell through a floor hole and landed on a concrete floor below, suffering a punctured lung, a broken kneecap, and a laceration to the left side of the forehead.
An employee was working with leather using a manually held rotary knife and amputated their left index fingertip.

Employees were loading a flatbed trailer with deck slab forms using a 15-ton crane. After the last form was loaded onto the flatbed, two employees climbed on top of the form to unhook the rigging between the form and spreader bar. The spreader bar was hoisted up and the crane began to move toward the east end of the building. The crane boom struck the employee, who was knocked to the ground (about 13 feet below) and suffered a head injury. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was chipping up concrete around an air conditioning slab using a hammer. A sharp piece of concrete dislodged and struck his chest causing internal bleeding.
While walking down an aisle in the warehouse, an employee was struck by a forklift and subsequently fell. The employee sustained fractures to the right hip and left ankle.
An employee was working on a breaker box when it arced. The employee suffered a burn to the right arm.
An employee was tending to a grinder machine that was smoking. The machine caught fire and exploded. The employee sustained first, second, and third degree burns to their back and both arms.
While cleaning the bars to the tack spray, some tack spray material landed on the employee's shirt and burned his chest.

On June 4, 2021. a temporary employee (working for Express Management) was near a storage rack when a 3-foot bin weighing about 45 pounds fell on her. She suffered a head laceration/contusion and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out a cylinder on a 40-foot towable man lift. The cylinder slipped back and amputated the employee's middle fingertip on his left hand.

An employee was loading a patient on stretcher into the back of a helicopter when the stretcher collapsed and the employee's left pinky finger was crushed between the stretcher and the ground, resulting in amputation.
An employee was attacked by two dogs while delivering packages to a house. The employee suffered arm and hand amputations.

An employee was trying to resolve an issue with a mill at a take-out door. The machine was actuated and the door shut on the employee's left hand, causing amputations to the tips of the middle and ring fingers.

An employee was using a torquing tool to torque down bolts on the blades in a wind turbine. As he began to tighten a nut, his finger became caught between the torquing tool and the wall of the hub.  The employee sustained an avulsion fracture to a finger.
An employee was repairing the four belt blower motor of an air handling unit. The belts rotated and the employee's left index finger was caught in the unit resulting in an amputation to the finger.
An employee was unclogging a pump with chicken product. His right hand got caught in the pump, and the index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee sat on a bucket, which had potassium hydroxide on the lid. The employee suffered a chemical burn and was hospitalized, requiring a skin graft.

At about 4:30 p.m. on June 5, 2021, an employee was trying to break up a fight between a coworker and a customer when the customer stabbed the employee with a knife. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered a punctured lung.
An employee's pant leg was caught by a forklift tire and pulled. The employee's left ankle was broken.

On June 5, 2021,  an employee was attempting to fix the check-weigher on a line and the chain pulled their left glove into the chain and sprocket resulting in a partial amputation of the left index fingertip.

An employee was using an electrical pallet jack to move pallets. While turning, his left foot and leg were struck by the pallet jack. The employee sustained multiple contusions and lacerations to the left leg, ankle, and feet.
On June 5, 2021, an employee was stocking merchandise when she tripped over a hand truck she had been using. She fell to the floor, breaking her elbow. She was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a box, fell to the floor, and suffered a pelvic fracture.
An employee was moving a parking barrier with a forklift. When he went to reposition the barrier, his finger was smashed between the barrier and the forklift, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was driving a stand-up forklift when it struck a piece of wood on the floor. The forklift then diverted into a storage rack and the employee's foot was pinched between the forklift and the rack resulting in multiple fractures to the foot and ankle.

Employees were attaching bungee cords to keep hides separated between carcasses. Two S-hooks on a bungee cord became entangled and began stretching. As an employee drew her knife to cut the bungee cords apart, the knife lacerated another employee s left arm above the elbow.

An employee was spray-painting a ceiling from an elevated mezzanine area. He got entangled in the spray hose and fell to the floor about 8 feet below. He suffered a compression fracture to a back vertebra, as well as four broken ribs.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a hand saw. The saw cut his right thumb.

An employee was filling air pockets in seam welding for structural support on an aluminum platform. As the employee was grinding the platform with a grinding disk, a piece of metal from a wire brush (which had been embedded in the aluminum) came free and injured his left eye.
An employee was exiting a production floor into a hallway when he slipped and fell. He suffered an aggravation to a previous back injury and was hospitalized overnight.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while working with a lead stripping machine.
While inspecting a boat, an employee fell through an open hatch leading to the engine room. The employee suffered a broken femur, caused by the ladder and the floor the employee landed on.
An employee was using an upright panel saw. While holding a piece against the fence, the saw amputated the employee's thumb at the second knuckle.

An employee was installing a 16-inch pipe, which was hanging off the ground. He tripped and caught himself on the pipe; the pipe then swung, and his left hand was caught and fractured between it and an I-beam.
An employee was cutting the shrink wrap off pallets when a load of material fell from a pallet onto the employee's head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was running an asphalt rake to set the edge of pavement. The employee developed heat stress symptoms and was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.

An employee was backing away from a desk when she tripped on a pallet and fell, hitting the metal shelving under a nearby work table with her right elbow and the right side of her rib cage. She suffered three broken ribs, scrapes and bruises to the elbow, and a possible partially collapsed lung.
An employee was moving a stuck 80-pound cart filled with milk. He suffered a muscle strain and went to the hospital, where he was diagnosed with a collapsed lung.
An employee was cleaning out mud from a gas-powered masonry mixer. Once the mud was dislodged, the mixer's paddles began to move and caught his right arm. He suffered an injury to the forearm.
At 4:45 p.m. on June 7, 2021, an employee was unloading a truck when a box fell and struck her. She fell on her left hip, injuring it.
An employee was operating a forklift when her foot was pinned and injured. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was coming out of a dock to unload a pallet using a stand-up forklift. It was raining at the time. The forklift slipped and her leg was caught between it and a rail. She suffered a broken ankle.
An employee accidentally ate a bar of industrial soap and was hospitalized.
A snowplow was being assembled. While the plow's A-frame was hoisted to a height of 2-3 feet, the hoist hook slipped and the A-frame fell, striking and breaking an employee's foot.

An employee was using a table saw to a rip a beveled edge in a 2-by-8. His right hand contacted a blade on the saw, which caused the amputation of several of his fingers. The blade was unguarded at the time.

On June 7, 2021, an employee was standing on a 6-foot fiberglass step ladder, addressing an issue with a heat pump. The heat pump was turned on to build pressure. While checking the refrigerant in the heat pump, the employee contacted a wire, was shocked, and fell from the ladder. The employee was hospitalized, having suffered electrical burns to the left thumb, index finger, and middle finger, as well as a bruise to the left arm from the fall and neck/back strain.

An employee was using a plywood press on a gluing line. A piece of plywood got stuck. While he was trying to release it, the press actuated and crushed several of his fingers. He suffered crushing injuries and amputations to the fingers.

An employee was helping to remove excess tools and equipment from a bucket barge unloader. A roller slipped as the employee was lifting it and pinched his right index finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee's left ring finger was crushed and partially amputated above the first knuckle, under the nail.
An employee fell after stepping onto a pallet. The employee's foot went between two of its boards during the fall, and the employee's ankle was broken.
An employee was climbing up on a lift gate trailer. He slipped and his right ankle was caught on the steps. He suffered a broken right ankle and a laceration to the top of his right foot.
Four employees were moving a supported scaffold. The scaffold collapsed and struck one of them on the head causing a contusion.
An employee suffered a hand injury while unjamming a machine.
An employee was using a popup saw to cut 2-by-4s. When it popped up to cut the board, the saw amputated the pinky, ring, and middle fingers from one of the employee's hands.

An employee was undergoing wilderness training near a mountain. He was walking down a path, acting as a carrier during a four-point stretcher lift of another employee, when his foot caught on a rock and twisted. He suffered spiral fractures to the right tibia and fibula.
An employee was working at the main register when she fell to the floor and lost consciousness. There was an issue with the air conditioner at the time.

An employee had been packing food orders in the warehouse and placing them onto a cart. The employee stepped back and fell onto the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right hip and a strained left shoulder.

Employee was carrying paint up a ladder. When he reached the top, the ladder slipped out from under him and he fell to the ground. He suffered a left ankle injury, and his jaw struck a bollard on the way down.

An employee was assembling a trailer at ground level. He tripped and fell backwards, hitting another trailer behind him. He suffered a displaced fracture of the ribs on his right side and was hospitalized.

On June 7, 2021, an employee stepped back onto roofing material that covered an opening in the roof and fell 15 to 20 feet through the opening onto the concrete floor below. The employee suffered a broken wrist and contusions to the pelvis and spine.

Employees were unloading a pallet of large forklift forks from a flatbed trailer using another forklift. The pallet cracked as it was picked up, and one of the forks fell to the ground and crushed an employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking by a desk, an employee tripped and fell striking an office chair. The employee sustained a fractured right humerus and a dislocated right shoulder.

An employee was pressing electronic boards to size from a long electronic board sheet. The employee's hand was caught in the power press's point of operation, which amputated the index and middle fingers and partially amputated the ring and little fingers.
An employee was cleaning rollers on a roller oven. He was pulled into the box of the oven, suffering injuries to the right leg.
An employee was using a vertical band saw to cut metal tubing. As the employee was wiping down the metal tube with a rag, his hand contacted the saw blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was walking over to a forklift in order to talk with the forklift operator when the forklift backed out into the aisleway, striking the employee's right ankle. The employee sustained fractures to the right foot and toes as well as dislocations and was hospitalized.

An employee was unpacking two suspensions that were bolted together with a razor-sharp angle bracket. While the employee was using a box end wrench to unscrew the bolt, the suspensions shifted and caught the employee's right index finger. The fingertip was amputated behind the nail.
An employee was cleaning a positive displacement pump. As he was checking for oil on the hose, his finger contacted the shear of the pump and he suffered an amputation.
An employee was cleaning up a work area after conducting pipeline construction and excavation operations. The employee developed severe leg cramps and was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.

An employee was feeding logs into a wood chipper when a log stopped the blade. While unjamming the chipper, the employee's right hand was caught between the log and chipper chute and his middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was stepping down off a ladder when he slipped and fell, breaking his left ankle.

An employee was placing fiber optic cable on a utility pole line. He climbed the pole and was swapping a lasher machine from one side of the pole to the other when there was an arc flash between the energized, 14,400-volt line and his work belt. He suffered burns to the upper body and was hospitalized.

On June 8, 2021, after operating a remote-control overhead crane in a steel-making plant, an employee became ill, suffering from leg cramps. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat stress.
On June 8, 2021, an employee was running a mill in the mixing department when he began cramping and did not feel well. The employee subsequently became ill and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
At about 7:00 a.m. on June 8, 2021, a Border Patrol agent slipped while chasing a group of people and fell to the ground, breaking his left leg.
On June 8, 2021, an employee was walking toward a gate when she slipped and fell down a slope. She suffered a dislocated hip and a broken leg and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over a stair, fell, and struck her head on the floor, losing consciousness.

An employee was carrying a push broom down a ladder. The employee slipped and fell backwards, landing on the concrete floor and the push broom. The employee suffered bruised ribs, a broken right arm, and lacerations to the lower lip.
An employee was connecting a service drop to a pole from a 28-foot ladder. A strand came loose and the employee fell to the concrete, suffering fractures to a hip and ribs.

An employee was unloading a grocery truck on a dock. As he was setting a dock plate between the truck and the dock floor, his right foot was caught under the dock plate. He suffered a fracture to the second metatarsal.
An employee fell down a flight of stairs, sliding down them on his back. His head struck the first step and his back hit the next step. The employee was hospitalized for head and back contusions.
An employee slipped on a puddle of water near an outpatient drop-off area. She suffered a broken right kneecap.
An employee was hooking up a fitting to a fire hydrant. Pressurized water from the hydrant knocked the employee to the ground. He suffered a dislocated right arm and a broken right leg.
An employee became ill after completing outside welding work at 2:30 p.m. He was hospitalized at 9:30 p.m., suffering from dehydration.

An employee was working on a deck immediately behind a hatch. A sailor came up through the hatch, which slipped from the sailor's grasp and fell backwards onto the employee. The employee developed a left-flank hematoma.
An employee was using a nail gun to attach metal plates to trusses. A nail from the gun deflected off a metal plate and impaled the employee's left index finger.
An employee was preparing to pour concrete footers when a piece of metal post fell and struck the employee on the calf. The metal lacerated an artery, and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was supervising a go-kart track when he was struck by an oncoming go-kart, resulting in a head injury and bruises on his legs.
On June 8, 2021, an employee was filling a mobile nurse tank with ammonium hydroxide. A hydrostatic valve failed and the chemical burned the employee's buttocks.
An employee fell while unloading and loading a dishwasher, landing on the floor and suffering multiple fractures.
An employee was shocked while replacing an electrical pole resulting in cardiac arrest and burns to both feet.

An employee was setting up a bead roller. The tip of his left index finger was within the point of operation when the machine cycled, crushing part of his left index fingertip. He suffered an amputation to the finger.

On June 9, 2021, an employee tripped and fell over the edge of a concrete parking lot block stopper. The employee suffered injuries to the head, right elbow, and right wrist and was hospitalized for wrist surgery.
An employee's right hand was caught in a rotating cement mixer. Two of the employee's fingers were amputated.
On June 9, 2021, an employee was closing double doors that a customer had left open when her ring finger got caught between the two doors, resulting in the amputation of her ring finger.
On June 9, 2021, an employee developed a hernia while stretching to install plastic sheets. He was hospitalized.
On June 9, 2021, an employee tripped while fixing an HVAC system and fell onto the system. Three fingers on his right hand were amputated.

An employee had just closed the back of his company truck and was walking to a work area when the truck began to roll backward. While he was trying to enter the truck, the driver's-side door struck him and he fell to the ground. He suffered three cracked ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a ladder while stocking shelves. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was working to pull out an enclosed cab tractor that was stuck. A chain was hooked to the front of the tractor and the tail end of a flatbed truck. The tractor began to inch forward when the chain parted. The chain went through the windshield of the tractor and struck the employee in the chest resulting in a chest wounds, a broken left collarbone, and a collapsed lung.
An employee suffered heat stress while conducting on-the-job training.

An employee was getting into an electric cart using a strap for assistance. The strap broke and the employee fell to the ground, hitting a concrete curb.. The employee suffered trauma to the side of the head and face, the left leg and knee, and both arms.
An employee was transferring hot oil from one tank to another. The bottom of the first tank ruptured and hot oil burned the employee's body.

An employee was standing at a manufacturing turnstile that held coils. The turnstile was turned on and moved to its "home" position. The employee's boot was caught under the turnstile plate, which fractured and dislocated his toes.
An employee placed a part on a CNC bend machine. The employee's right middle finger went into the bend machine along with the part, resulting in an amputation.

Employees were moving an oil rig's horse head out of the way so they could install a blowout preventer. As the operator picked up the winch lines, the two floor hands began moving the horse head to the side. The horse head flipped over, and an employee's finger was caught in the winch line and the horse head's bridle cable. The finger was lacerated and the fingertip was amputated above the nailbed.
An employee was trying to get inside and stop a moving tow buggy when the tow buggy struck a fence. The employee sustained a fractured left pelvis.

An employee was preparing to lay cable. While the employee was straddling a trailer, holding the cable roll, the trailer became unstable and flipped, striking and throwing the employee into a 3-foot deep trench. The employee sustained a broken right femur.

An employee was training on an electric pallet jack. During a turn, the employee's right leg was pinned between the platform of the pallet jack and a metal bollard. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the lower right leg.
On June 9, 2021, an employee suffered dehydration while driving a package car, delivering parcels.

An employee was using a pallet jack to load a trailer. The jack ran over a piece of broken pallet and the handle of the pallet jack struck the employee in the leg. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from internal bleeding.

An employee was unjamming a beef hide from a flesher machine when the flesher wheel closed on the employee's arm, fracturing the upper arm and wrist. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident, but was not locked out.
An employee was working on a wall from a 6-foot-high scaffold. The scaffold fell over and the employee fell, suffering broken wrists and ribs.

An employee was during utility work during the second shift, 7:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. At about 9:45 p.m., he began to feel hot and switched to light duty. At about 6:40 a.m., he felt ill and developed heat cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from a heat-related illness.
While doing general labor, an employee developed signs of heat stress. After going home, later, he was hospitalized for dehydration and heat-related symptoms.
An employee was cutting metal on a horizontal bandsaw. The saw amputated the employee's middle, ring, and little fingers.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left femur. She was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

A rotomill was being used to cut up a highway. An employee was on the ground, checking the depth of the cut, when the machine's hydraulic side plate was lowered. Three of the employee's fingers were caught by the cutter blade and injured including amputation of a finger.
An employee was taking a break after helping to unload materials when they passed out, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was operating a pallet jack when his left index finger hit a pole. The finger was crushed.
An employee lost consciousness while installing underground conduit. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was crossing a street when a vehicle struck him, causing multiple fractures to his left leg/ankle. He was hospitalized.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack down an aisle when it struck a double-stacked pallet on the forks of another, stationary electric pallet jack. The employee suffered a broken right ulna and radius.
An employee was working in an aerial bucket lift when his left shoulder contacted an energized overhead wire. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the shoulder.
An employee fell while working at a counter. She suffered a broken left hip and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was using a foot-pedal-controlled sheet roller to roll ladder cages. The roller crushed his right index finger and he was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
On June 9, 2021, an employee fell through a hole in floor grating. The employee's arms broke the fall, causing a dislocation to the right shoulder.
An employee fell while climbing out of a service counter window. The employee landed on the floor and suffered an injured left knee, with a hematoma.
An employee fell while getting off a two-step ladder, landing on the floor and suffering a broken hip. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee was operating an R-panel roll former. He began to clean metal shavings on the top roller (non-power driven roller) with an abrasive pad. The employee's left hand was pulled between the top and bottom roller (power driven roller) and became trapped. The employee tried to free his left hand with his right hand and both hands were caught between the rollers. Both hands sustained lacerations and his left hand was medically amputated.

An employee was training to use a forklift. While the forklift was turning, the employee's left arm was caught between it and a rack. The employee suffered a broken wrist and was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was repositioning a rubber blanket over energized equipment. A phrase-to-ground contact caused burns to the employee's neck and face area.

An employee was trying to stop a forklift that was rolling back. The forklift ran off the edge of a ramp and flipped onto its side, crushing the employee. He suffered a broken femur and a crushed ankle.
An employee was delivering supplies to a roof when they began showing signs of heat exhaustion, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee had been pouring and mixing concrete on June 8, 2021. The employee came into work the next morning, felt ill, and was sent home. The employee was hospitalized with dehydration.

An employee was cleaning a spray paint hopper bucket with a pressure washer. The employee reached down to adjust the position of the bucket with his left hand when his left index finger contacted the water from the pressure washer, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was being trained on using a spotter truck to connect a loaded trailer. The spotter truck backed into the trainer, breaking their left leg.
An employee developed heat-related dehydration and became dizzy while making deliveries. He was hospitalized.
An employee tripped and fell while delivering mail, suffering a broken hip.

An employee was constructing a new electrical distribution line. While connecting a neutral line near an energized primary phase, the employee's face contacted the energized phase resulting in burns to his face and arm. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving steel pieces on a cart. The cart got stuck on a rail track and collapsed. The employee's finger was pinched between two pieces of steel, and the employee suffered an amputation.
An employee was installing plant material when they began to feel cramps in their legs and abdomen. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration and signs of heat exposure.
An employee was helping move lumber to a dumpster. The employee struck a 2-by-4, which broke the employee's skull at the right temple.

An employee shut off a planer machine and lifted the door to free a jammed board. The centrifugal force of the cutter head was still moving and when he pulled the board back, the cutter head caught his right hand, resulting in four finger amputations and a laceration to the thumb.

An employee was in a manlift, troubleshooting the pilot for the main burner on a furnace. The furnace door was opened and contacted the manlift basket. The employee fell about 8 feet and suffered contusions to his left thigh, knee, and shin area.

Employees were moving bird carts from the bird truck into the layer house. An employee's left middle finger was caught between the cart he was moving and the metal housing for the load bar. The employee's left middle fingertip was partially amputated.
An employee was working on a scaffold when they were exposed to soda ash from work being performed 50 feet away, resulting in hospitalization due to lung irritation and an allergic reaction.
An employee was performing maintenance on a machine when they suffered a partial amputation of the right ring finger.

An employee was exiting the rear of a rail car by the fixed ladder on the rail car when they fell approximately 18 feet, resulting in a fractured wrist and laceration to the face that required hospitalization and surgery.

Employees were disassembling a lattice boom crane. The crane had been lowered to a working height slightly above ground level and was also being supported by an assist crane. The injured employee was removing one of the connector pins when a section of the boom shifted downward and contacted his right foot resulting in a crushing injury to the foot and toes.
An employee was moving a load from the mold area to the melting area. The employee was lowering the mold when his pinky finger was crushed by the mold, resulting in a broken finger.
An employee was using a circular saw when the saw jumped and his left index finger went into the blade, resulting in amputation.
Two employees were moving a piece of heavy equipment when a wheel caught in a floor drain. The machine tipped over and struck an employee's leg fracturing their femur.
An employee was operating a band saw with a shuttle vice and a machine vice. The machine vice closed on the employee's pinky finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee and two co-workers were using a crane to move a work reel weighing approximately 6.7 tons onto a frame for production. The employee was acting as a spotter when their hand was crushed between the frame and the base of the reel being lowered by the crane. The employee suffered a left middle fingertip amputation.
An employee and his crew were at a remote worksite excavating holes to inspect and treat utility poles when the employee began to feel ill due to the heat.

Two employees were in an excavation with benching, installing conduit along its entire length. The trench collapsed and the bench wall struck one of the employees. The employee suffered a broken right wrist and rib fractures on both sides, as well as internal injuries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a backpack blower while on a stand-on mower when they hit a curb and tripped. The mower landed on the employee, resulting in a leg fracture.
An employee was placing plastic over duct work when they tripped and landed on the duct work. The metal duct work lacerated the employee's forearm.

An employee was guiding a piece through a rolling machine when the foot pedal was actuated and his right hand was drawn into the rollers at the point of operation, resulting in a partial amputation of the right ring finger.
An employee drank from an electrolyte solution bottle in the refrigerator that had been filled with degreaser. The employee became sick and was hospitalized.

On June 10, 2021, an employee was stacking a pallet full of textbooks onto a rack about 12 feet high using a reach truck. The employee got out of the reach truck to check on the pallet of books when the books fell toward him. As he ran to get away, he fell on the floor and a book hit his right leg, resulting in a fracture to his right ankle that required hospitalization.
An employee was carrying pots and pans to a drying rack when they slipped and fell, resulting in a broken leg that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was exiting her semi-tractor when she fell off a step on the tractor, resulting in an L2 vertebra fracture.
An employee was painting a wall from a ladder. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a separated wrist and three broken fingers in his left hand.
An employee was performing a clean-in-place process and took pipes apart. The pipes contained pressurized hot water that burned the employee's head, neck, and back.
An employee tripped and fell to the floor, suffering a broken leg.

An employee was putting blanks from aluminum downspouts in a rollforming machine when a blade contacted their left thumb, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was pushing a row of carts towards the cart manager when he lost his balance or grip on the carts and fell. The employee sustained injury to the left hip and upper leg.

A USPS mail carrier was walking to a resident's door with a heavy parcel. As the carrier moved from the side of a carport to reach the front porch, the parcel hit the top of the carport. The carrier fell backward and suffered a broken right fibula, tibia, and ankle.

At 3:36 p.m. on June 11, 2021, an employee was using a cutting torch to cut the end off a 55-gallon drum that had been filled with hand sanitizer. The drum flashed and the employee suffered a thermal burn to the left side. He was hospitalized.
Employees were troubleshooting a machine when the machine amputated an employee's right index fingertip.
An employee was unloading freight when the storage system failed and freight slid down from the storage racks. The employee was struck by the freight and suffered a broken leg.
While walking up steps in the dishwashing area, an employee tripped over a step and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured hip.
Around 6:45 PM on June 11, 2021, an employee was troubleshooting a milk filler machine that he was operating. The machine moved, causing a laceration to his right hand that required hospitalization.

An employee was inspecting a valve on a product line when the valve became dislodged, causing the employee to fall to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the jaw and left wrist, and a laceration above the right eye.
An employee was walking down a hallway in the office when they slipped and fell sustaining a fractured right knee and right elbow.
An employee removed a cap while prepping a tote in a wastewater treatment area and was exposed to sulfuric acid, resulting in chemical burns.
On June 11, 2021, an employee was hooking a dolly up to a tug hitch. The employee's left middle finger was pinched between the dolly tongue handle and tub hitch. The finger was amputated.
On June 11, 2021, an employee developed Legionnaires' disease and was hospitalized.

An employee was installing flashing above an overhead door while on a scaffold when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete driveway below, resulting in a compound wrist fracture, a fractured heel, and a head laceration.
An employee fell while entering a building, landing on the floor and suffering a broken hip.
An employee was cutting a piece of wood with a saw and amputated his left index finger.

Employees were lifting a dumpster out of a compactor when the load shifted. An employee's finger was caught between the fork and the dumpster resulting in amputation of his left pinky finger at the first knuckle.
On June 11, 2021, an employee was reaching for a part when a machine cycled, causing an amputation to the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee had been troubleshooting an extruder machine. The employee was struck by steam that came through a bolt hole and sustained second degree burns to the neck. The employee was hospitalized.
While taking a level reading from a silo, an employee stepped out and slipped on a mixture of condensation and mud. The employee fell to the ground and sustained three broken ankle bones.
On June 11, 2021, an employee bumped into an air-actuated cylinder while turning to walk. The employee suffered a contusion and hematoma to the right leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was getting in their vehicle when someone shot them through the door of their vehicle, resulting in a right hand injury.
An employee was running an edger. While pushing a log through the edger, the log kicked back, striking the employee in the stomach. The employee sustained a cut to his stomach.

An employee was adjusting a valve for an air cylinder to synchronize the lifters to lock a carriage on a conveyor line. He actuated it to cycle to check the adjustment. When it cycled, his right hand was pinched between the lifter and the rail and he suffered broken fingers.
A maintenance employee was trying to remove a chicken tender from a machine when the machine amputated the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was seated on a rebar mat that was at the bottom of an approximately 8 foot deep excavation. The employee was removing dirt by hand, next to the west wall of the excavation. A portion of the soil wall collapsed onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with displaced vertebrae.
An employee was helping to relocate a cart when their arm became caught between the cart and a concrete column, resulting in a broken bone in the right forearm.

On June 12, 2021, an employee had finished conducting maintenance on a machine and was closing the door of the machine when their left middle finger was pinched in the hinge, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was descending stairs. The employee fell at the last step, landing on the concrete and suffering a knee contusion.
An employee was working on an automatic guided vehicle (AGV) that had stalled when they were struck in the right leg by a second AGV, resulting in a fractured right tibia.
An employee was standing up from her work station when her foot got caught on the desk. The employee fell to the floor and broke her left hip.

An employee was walking from the check-in lobby to the ticket counter. Condensation from a customer's drinking cup had made the floor wet. The employee slipped on the condensation and fell to the floor sustaining a sprained right knee.

An employee was carrying a storage bin of clothing down a flight of stairs when he tripped over a shoe that had fallen onto the stairs. The employee fell down the stairs and suffered a ruptured patella tendon in the left knee and a right wrist sprain.
An employee was descending a 3 ft. aluminum ladder after retrieving merchandise and missed the bottom step, falling to the floor. The employee sustained a broken right hip and required surgery.
An employee was operating a meat slicer and sustained an amputation to the tip of her finger.
While performing a loss prevention stop, an employee was attacked by an assailant. The employee fell and hit their head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was operating a forklift when their left foot was caught between the reach truck and racking. The employee sustained a broken and dislocated foot.
An employee was walking and moved to avoid a customer who was also walking. The employee tripped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a pelvis fracture that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a wire drawing machine when their glove was caught and drawn into the machine. The employee sustained partial amputations to their left ring and middle fingers.
An employee was operating an extrusion machine when they passed out due to the heat. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration and kidney failure.
An employee was setting up a spiral cutter in an extrusion bay when they began to feel hot and lightheaded and experienced muscle cramps. The employee was hospitalized due to dehydration.

An employee was trying to connect two bar racks by inserting a cotter pin into each hole. While the employee's finger was in a hole, the top rack shifted, pinching his left index finger and amputating the fingertip.
An employee was clearing a jam on a battery machine when their finger got caught between the machine and a battery case. The employee sustained a finger amputation.
On 6/13/2021, an employee was hospitalized after making contact with secondary voltage in a pad mounted transformer and receiving an electric shock.

On 6/13/2021, at approximately 8:22 PM, a security officer was at their post observing personnel at a mall. Two individuals approached the security officer, attacked, and then shot him twice with a gun.
An employee was cutting PVC boards using a chop saw and amputated his left thumb and index finger.

An employee was using an 8-foot, A-frame ladder to clean the hopper of an extruder. He finished cleaning and fell less than 7 feet, from the ladder to the ground. The employee sustained a broken leg requiring surgery.

An employee was using an air wand to remove sand when hot sand was blown back into the employee's face and under his jacket. The employee was hospitalized with second degree burns on the forehead and right forearm.

The injured employee was unloading a trailer with a forklift. He had just stopped the lift and stepped from the operator compartment onto the warehouse floor. Another forklift pulled forward pinning the injured employee between the two forklifts. The injured employee sustained multiple back and leg fractures.
An employee fell from a 10-foot A-frame ladder to the floor, suffering a broken pelvis and broken right leg.
An employee was operating a mechanical punch press when their left hand was crushed by the press, resulting in a finger amputation.
While running the bulk line machine, an employee reached to clean the machine and their right index finger was partially amputated in a pinch point.

A driver was doing maintenance on the gladhand connections on the front of a tank trailer. While climbing up to the catwalk area with a tire thumper and a razorblade knife (to rough up the rubber grommet to create a better seal), he fell. He landed on both feet on the fuel tank steps behind the cab. The tire thumper drove the pocketknife into his left little finger, causing a laceration near the first knuckle.

An employee and a co-worker were preparing to change the position of a pump control device for a water filtering system on a tug boat. The employee was loosening a screw when they received an electrical shock to their hand from a 480-volt current and burns.

An employee was carrying materials across a roof. The employee slipped and fell through the roof to a catwalk 10 feet below, striking a valve wheel and the catwalk grating. The employee suffered fractures to the ribs and back, as well as a cut and bruises on the face.
A crimping gun fell out of an employee's tool bag and recoiled after hitting the ground. It struck the employee's chin, fracturing the jaw.
An employee was picking up tools at the end of the work day on an outdoor job site. The employee became ill, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was cutting the top of a clothes hanger with a box cutter and cut their finger. The employee was hospitalized for an infection.
An employee fell from a scaffold to the ground, landing on his back. He suffered a broken neck and pelvis, as well as torn muscles. He was hospitalized.
An employee was shackling livestock when his finger contacted the chain and tension bar, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was checking why a fire exit door was not closing properly. When he moved a protruding piece of metal hardware, the door closed on his right thumb and amputated the tip at the nail.
An employee was restocking a soda vending machine when her finger was pinched in the door resulting in a 1/4 inch amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was exiting the cab of a ready mix truck. He tripped over a concrete pillar that was behind him and fell to the ground, breaking his left arm.
An employee tripped over a security cord and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured hip.
On June 14, 2021, at 5:30 p.m., an employee collided with a cart being pushed by a co-worker, resulting in a broken left femur that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was preparing to move a glass sheet with a rack when the glass shifted and slipped out of the rack, sending the load backward and hitting the employee on the hip. The employee suffered a fractured hip and pelvis.
An employee was moving packages from a conveyor to a cart. The employee suffered a hernia and was hospitalized.

A fork truck had been used to place metal concrete forms in place. An employee went to manually adjust the "L" sections of the forms by lifting one end with his right hand. The employee was setting down the end of the metal form when it slipped out of his hand pinching the middle fingertip on their left hand. The employee's fingertip was amputated without bone loss.

An employee was troubleshooting a slug cutter machine. The employee was wiping grease off of gears to inspect them when their fingertip got pulled through two gears. The fingertip was amputated at the nailbed.
An employee was pulling wire through a junction box when an arc flash occurred and burned the employee's hands. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was attaching a trailer to a semi truck. While the employee was raising the dollies using the landing gear crank, it became difficult to crank. The employee bent down to see if the dolly legs were coming up when the tension in the crank caused it to come back and hit the employee in the face. The employee suffered a broken jaw.
An employee was on a forklift, preparing to get a pallet of tile down from storage racks. He fell to the ground and suffered a broken shoulder that required surgery, as well as head trauma.
An employee was climbing a ladder to access a roof when they fell off the ladder, resulting in injuries to their right ankle and left ring finger.
An employee was attacked at work, suffering a broken jaw and lacerations.

On June 14, 2021, at approximately 11:00 AM, an employee was on a mezzanine handing a tool to a co-worker beneath him. The top rail of the mezzanine's guardrail broke and the employee fell 9 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to the left hip and left elbow.

An employee was standing about 15 feet away from a concrete truck. As the truck moved up a ramp to dump its load of concrete, one of its tires threw a rock that struck and fractured the employee's left leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee removed a piece of plywood to lay down some pipe, then moved to lean the plywood against a wall. The employee fell through a 3-foot by 4-foot hole that had been concealed under the plywood, landing 8 feet below in a crawlspace. The employee suffered a hip injury and was hospitalized.
A railing gave way causing an employee to fall 4 feet in a warehouse. The employee was hospitalized for a back injury.

An employee was about to kosherize a product line, having just switched a hose from another line after draining the water out of it. When he opened a valve to start the process, 200-degree Fahrenheit water hit him in the left leg and foot, burning him from the thigh down.

On June 14, 2021, an employee was operating a CNC brake press. The employee was holding a part while making a second bend when their thumb was pinched between the side of the machine and the part being bent. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the thumb.
An employee slipped and fell on a piece of equipment, suffering two broken ribs and a collapsed lung.

Employees were trying to unload a grain bin. The unload holes were plugged up, so they cut a hole in the side to drain the bin. One of the employees stepped on a nearby U-trough auger and his left foot went through a part of the auger. The auger caught and lacerated his foot.

An employee was delivering a load of caustic liquid to a facility when he stepped in a puddle of unknown chemical composition, resulting in chemical burns to his right foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was trying to keep a wild steer in a holding pen by holding the gate latch down. The steer popped the lock and pushed the gate open, striking the employee in the head and knocking him to the ground. The steer stepped on him. He suffered a broken rib and a broken left leg.

Employees were removing an exterior wall panel from a building. As the panel was being lowered down by a winch and a tagline, it hit a swing stage scaffold and broke into several pieces. The panel fell about 15 feet to the scaffold below and struck an AKT employee. The employee suffered two broken ribs, an internal laceration, and a puncture wound on the side of the chest.

An employee was using an industrial drill, drilling holes for footings. The kelly cable drive was not retracting properly on the machine's drum, so the employee tried to disconnect the cable to re-spool the drum. He backed out the threaded pin from the kelly drive clevis that was holding the cable drive end. As he tried to push the pin through, his right middle finger was pinched in the clevis and cable. The finger was amputated at the first joint.
An employee was operating a wrapping machine when her right thumb and index finger were caught in the teeth of the machine's spinning blade. Both were amputated.
An employee developed leg cramps while climbing an electric pole. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

An employee was standing on the fourth or fifth rung from the top of a 10-foot A-frame ladder, using an impact drill to remove cottonwood debris from louver screens. He fell to the concrete floor below and suffered injuries to the right side of his body: a wrist fracture, broken ribs, a pelvic fracture, and a partially collapsed lung.
An employee was installing equipment on a rail car. The employee developed heat-related illness and was hospitalized.
An employee was working on a mold on an injection machine and stated that he felt ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was in a scissor lift conducting fireproofing activities when the lift tipped over, causing the employee to fall and suffer a fractured leg.

An employee was taking boxes off a pallet and putting them on a top stock cart. She backed up while holding a box and tripped over another box and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured right hip, requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was trying to take a blood sample from a monkey when it scratched her left arm. She had an adverse reaction to the antiviral medication she received and was hospitalized the next day.
An employee was walking through an open area when high winds caused a crane boom to collapse. Debris struck the employee and broke the employee's right tibia and left foot.
After carrying mail during a summer heat wave, an employee developed heat stress and was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing for a concrete pour from the platform of a scaffolding system. The employee stepped on the platform and fell approximately 17.5 feet to the ground along with a scaffold plank. The employee sustained a fractured left wrist, a sprained right wrist, and facial lacerations and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing on the side of a trailer, helping load a pile hammer onto the trailer. A cable from the crane disconnected and the pile hammer landed on the employee. The employee suffered a broken right tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a bandsaw to cut piping. The blade caught the employee's gloves and pulled in the employee's hands, causing a finger amputation.

An employee was loading freight on a trailer. The trailer pulled away from the dock while the employee was entering/exiting it, and the employee's forklift dropped between the dock and the trailer. The employee's right index finger was smashed.
An employee was sweeping a floor. As she bent to clean under a machine, the broom handle jabbed her eye and injured it.

On June 14, 2021, an employee was setting up a lasering system at a newly constructed commercial building. While anchoring or aligning a frame over a 20-foot by 22-foot floor opening, the employee fell through, landing 10-12 feet below. The employee suffered a cracked vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering packages when they began to feel ill due to heat stress, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a meat cutter. The cutter activated and its blade amputated the employee's finger.

An employee had just finished installing the traveling cable on an elevator and was standing on the work deck when the hanger failed. As the traveling cable fell, it wrapped around the employee's legs and broke both of his ankles.
An employee was repositioning an equipment case on a transport cart and amputated their right middle finger.

An employee was standing between two flatbed trailers. He ducked under one of them to avoid falling machinery, and his left hand was caught between the machinery and the trailer. He suffered amputations to the left index, middle, and ring fingertips.
An employee was stepping from a screen deck onto a catwalk. The employee fell over the guardrail and landed on the ground 5.5 feet below. He suffered a broken wrist and a broken left-side pelvis.
On June 15, 2021, an employee was supervising a work crew on a roof job. The employee fell off the roof, landing about 8 feet below and suffering broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was driving a forklift down an aisle. The forklift struck a piece of wood, went out of control, and hit a rack. The employee's right thumb was crushed between the rack and forklift resulting in a partial amputation of the thumb.

An employee was on an 8-foot A-frame ladder, using a resin rod to unjam a blowback chute above. The ladder tipped over and the employee fell, landing on the ladder and suffering four broken left-side ribs.
An employee was walking from one facility to the next when they tripped and fell, resulting in an injured pelvis and hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was cutting a 4-foot by 8-foot piece of plywood on a table saw. The saw amputated the tip of the employee's left thumb.
An employee fell through a floor cutout and landed on the ground approximately 42 inches below. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from a wastewater clarifier, landing 10 feet below and suffering broken ribs and a broken pelvis.

On June 15, 2021, an employee was walking from the pipe fabrication area to a gate outside when he was struck by a company vehicle trying to turn around. The employee suffered a broken rib, a collapsed lung, and a lacerated liver that required hospitalization.
An employee was getting out of her chair when she tripped over the base of her chair and fell to the floor. She suffered a broken femur and was hospitalized.
An employee attempted to sit down in a chair, missed the chair and fell backward hitting their head on a vice that was mounted on the workbench.
An employee was using a saw to cut trim that was stuck to the saw's base. When the trim came free, the employee's finger contacted the blade resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was filling forklift cylinders with propane gas when the nozzle connected to the cylinder released and the employee was burned by the propane gas.

An employee was walking though the washroom when a barrel that was being filled with caustic liquid overflowed. The employee slipped on the caustic liquid, resulting in chemical burns to their left wrist and right leg.
An employee was on an 8-foot step ladder applying grout around a beam. The employee fell to the floor 68 inches below, suffering a dislocated hip, a femur fracture, and a head laceration.
An employee had just unjammed a warehouse dock leveler. The end of the dock leveler came down on the employee's left middle and ring fingers, crushing them against a container and causing avulsions.
An employee was operating a chop saw when it amputated his left thumb. He was hospitalized.
An employee suffered heat stress while handling concrete forms.
An employee was working with a titanium target on a copper plate. As he moved it from his left hand to his right hand, it lacerated his right middle finger.
A road grader struck an employee that was performing surveying work. The employee suffered a broken hip, a broken right foot/ankle, and possibly broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking the metal decking of a roof when he fell through the decking approximately 13-14 feet to lower level, resulting in a broken wrist, pelvis, femur, and leg.
An employee was working on a workover rig when a suspended rod and clamp struck their little finger and crushed it on an elevator sitting below, resulting in multiple finger fractures.
An employee was making a shaft on a lathe when his shirt was caught inside the machine. The employee sustained a broken shoulder.

Two employees were lifting a refrigeration unit's aluminum frame off a work table. The frame slid and pinched one employee's right middle fingertip against a bench. The last joint of the finger was amputated.
An employee was chipping wood. The chipper's lid struck the employee, causing broken ribs and a broken arm.

An employee was working on a press and went to remove aluminum scrap. The machine single-stroked one time, catching his right thumb between the punch and the bottom former. The thumb tip was amputated.
A border agent developed heat exhaustion while tracking in brush.
An employee was working their shift when a customer entered the establishment and pulled a gun on the employee. A shooting occurred. The employee sustained a bullet wound to the right arm.
An employee fell while climbing down the ladder of a top stock cart. The employee landed on the floor and suffered a broken femur that required surgery.
An employee was delivering packages by car when they began experiencing symptoms of heat exhaustion, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was unloading chickens into a chicken house when they became dehydrated and were hospitalized.
An employee was operating a slitting machine when the core spun and amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was setting up a machine when it moved and pinched the employee's left index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was operating a hydraulic punch press. The press amputated the employee's finger.
An employee was moving a tool chest when it tipped onto his right leg, bruising it.

An employee was standing in an aisle. A forklift in an adjoining aisle bumped into stock on the shelf between it and the employee, causing 15-20 pounds of plastic totes to fall from the shelving onto the employee's head. She suffered a concussion.

A 19-inch aluminum billet was being loaded onto a homogenizing oven pad with a forklift. Two employees were trying to reposition it using a pry bar when it rolled off the stack, causing a stacking rail or pad backstop to strike one of the employees in the back. The employee suffered four broken vertebrae in the lower back, as well as liver, spleen, and kidney lacerations.
An employee was placing a wire reel/spool on jack stands. The employee's right index finger was pinched between the bar going through the reel and the top of a stand. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was in a lift, pruning a large Ficus tree. The employee fell to the ground 12 feet below and sustained a fractured skull.
An employee was on a lift gate unloading product. He fell to the ground.
