An employee was cleaning cars when a door shut on his index finger, resulting in the loss of skin near his finger that required hospitalization.
On June 16, 2021, an employee was attempting to adjust a jammed chain on a machine when their left hand became stuck between the chain and a sprocket, resulting in amputation of the index fingertip.
The screen door of a large grinder head came open and struck an employee's steel-toed boot. The boot's toe guard amputated the employee's left big toe and second toe.
An employee was climbing down an access ladder on a tanker trailer. He fell approximately 6 feet to the ground.

An employee was operating a saw to cut cedar wood. The saw jammed on a piece of wood. The employee was clearing the jam when the saw cycled back down, resulting in amputation of the employee's left hand.
An employee tripped over a power jack, fell to the floor, and suffered a head laceration that required staples.

An employee performing maintenance on a forklift was removing the hydraulic cylinder from the mast, which was elevated on spacer blocks. When the cylinder was removed, it struck the spacer block, causing the inside rail to lower. The employee's left hand was pinned between the inside and outside rails of the forklift, resulting in a crush injury and a laceration between the knuckles and wrist.
An employee jumped off a flatbed trailer to the ground 5 feet below, breaking his left leg.

An employee was descending a fixed ladder on a conveyor system. He fell backward off the ladder onto the concrete floor, suffering a right midfoot fracture dislocation and a left intra-articular distal tibia and fibula fracture. He was hospitalized.

An employee was unloading a tanker full of chemicals into a storage tank. During this process, a pipe at the base of the tank broke and the chemical began running into the containment chamber. One of the employee's attempted to plug the leak with a piece of wood when the air pressure caused the material to discharge in a vaporized form. A second employee entered the area to offer their assistance. Both employees suffered irritation to their respiratory systems and eyes. One employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering 200 cases of product to a store when they began to experience nausea and symptoms of heat exhaustion, resulting in hospitalization.

Two employees were moving a pallet of sheet metal from ground level to the ninth floor using a buck hoist. As they arrived on the ninth floor, the sheet metal bowed in the middle and fell over, pinning the employee's legs and resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee was working on a pipe at a steel producing facility. Flammable material inside the pipe ignited, causing burns to the employee's face and torso.
An employee was walking into a room when they fell to the floor, resulting in a broken patella.
An employee was cutting wood on a jointer and their hand slipped under the guard, resulting in amputation of the left ring fingertip.

An employee was kneeling down and drilling holes into a form so he could tie the form to rebar. As he stood up, he lost his balance and fell off the ramp to the ground about 15 feet below. He suffered bruising to the left hand and abdomen, as well as facial fractures.

An employee was standing on a ladder, arranging packing material on a top metal shelf. He fell to the ground 6 feet below and suffered a broken hand, rib pain, and an injury to the face resulting in bleeding.
On June 17, 2021, an employee was participating in an emergency preparedness drill when she slipped on a wet spot on the floor and fell, resulting in a fractured knee.
An employee was working on a machine with a ball valve that was leaking. The employee was trying to identify the issue when the valve actuated and amputated his left middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a printing press when he felt ill and was transported to the hospital, where he had a heart attack.

An employee was in the back of a truck, pulling a tarp over debris. He slipped on a wet floor and fell on his back, landing on the trailer about 4 feet below. He suffered fractured ribs and laceration to the spleen.
An employee was taking pictures of a tree limb that had been obstructing a billboard when they fell to the ground, resulting in a back injury.

An employee was removing a small section of existing vertical steel attached to an overhead doorway. After almost cutting the steel all the way through with a power tool, the employee began to manually move it with his hand. When the steel came loose, it fell and caught his left index finger between the falling piece of steel and another piece of steel below, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was trying to open a window when he bumped it with his hand. His right hand went through the glass, which cut his forearm.
Employees were hoisting a garbage chute with a crane. The chute broke free, striking two employees. One employee was hospitalized for numerous injuries.
An employee was standing on a folding chair, hanging a banner. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a shoulder injury.
An employee was walking around a box with a shrink-wrap stretching tool when he tripped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a hematoma.

On June 17, 2021, a maintenance employee was on an A-frame ladder replacing a sign. The bottom legs of the ladder crumbled and the employee fell to the floor. He suffered a concussion and a muscle strain to his buttocks and lower back. He was hospitalized.

An employee and a co-worker were preparing to remove a load of mesh from a flatbed. After releasing the ratchet strap that was being used to secure the mesh, the tension on the strap caused the mesh to shift and fall toward the employee. The employee was pushed into a panel behind him, resulting in a fractured left index finger, C5 and C7 spinal fractures, and possible nerve damage.

An employee had just finished cleaning a gear box leak. As he turned the machine back on, the chain grabbed a napkin in his right hand and pulled his index finger into the chain and sprocket. He suffered an amputation to the fingertip.

An employee was standing near a cross rolling machine when they lost their footing and fell toward the machine. As the employee tried to regain their balance, their right hand contacted the roller on the machine, resulting in an index finger amputation and a laceration to the middle finger.
An employee was standing under a screw conveyor. Part of the conveyor caught her hair, pulling on it and causing scalp lacerations.
An employee was weighing ammonium persulfate (APS) for a batch when the chemical sprayed onto the employee, resulting in burns to their face, arms, and chest.
An employee was repairing a telephone line using a bucket truck. The line shocked the employee, burning the employee's arm. The employee was hospitalized.
A delivery driver developed heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning under a gumbox. His right ring finger was caught under a gummer paddle, which amputated the fingertip.

An employee was in the attic of a residence that was being renovated. Most of the attic floor had been removed. A 3.5' x 3.5' area was covered with a piece of sheetrock. The employee stepped on the sheetrock and fell through it 9 feet to the floor below and sustained contusions.
An employee was cutting chicken with a meat saw. The saw cut the employee's left thumb, causing an amputation.

An employee was backing up a yard tractor that was hooked up to a chassis with a loaded container. The chassis with the container flipped over and pulled down the tractor with it. The employee fell off the vehicle and suffered fractured ribs and vertebrae and a fractured wrist.

An employee was performing preventative maintenance on the battery pack of a standup forklift. When he went to re-install the battery pack the electrical connector fell into the work area. As he reached in to retrieve the connector, his other hand was caught by the roller and his ring finger was amputated.
An employee was beginning to weld an angle iron on a new bridge when they fell approximately 51 feet from the bridge to the ground below, resulting in fractures to their face and ribs.

An employee was standing next to a pallet conveyor when she lost her balance and fell onto the conveyor, which pulled in her leg. The employee suffered an open wound to her left leg that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee became disoriented the morning after work and was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat stress.

An employee was operating a chop saw when the saw blade bounded with the material being cut, causing the material to flip and contact the employee's left middle finger. The employee suffered an open fracture and the amputation of a finger on their left hand.

An employee was connecting a ground power unit to a tow tug. While the unit was being pulled toward the tow hitch, its tow tongue contacted the tow hitch and slipped. The employee's right middle finger was pinched/crushed between the tongue handle and the hitch, resulting in a partial amputation of the finger.

On 6/18/2021, an employee was unjamming a metal frame below a pallet of plywood on the wood line. The metal frame came off the tracks and the employee's finger was caught between the metal frame and the conveyor resulting in amputation of the right index finger.
An employee was using a stand-up pallet jack to separate pallets on a dock. The employee struck a guardrail and suffered an amputation to the right little fingertip.

An employee was on top of a 6-foot retainer wall to disengage a tree limb that got entangled in the wall. When the limb was freed, the employee lost their balance and fell 20 to 30 feet on the other side of the retaining wall, landing on bushes. The employee suffered contusions, bruises, and a back injury.

An employee and two co-workers were removing a feed hopper due to a piece of hard resin that had accumulated between the hopper and the mixer. When the hopper was dislodged from the mixer, it pivoted into a new position and contacted the employee's right pinky finger, crushing it between the hopper and the mezzanine floor and resulting in crush injuries and lacerations that required hospitalization.

On June 18, 2021, an employee was operating a truck to move a dumpster out of the company's parking lot and struck another vehicle. The employee sustained hip and pelvis injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was backing up a pallet truck when they collided with a guardrail and their left foot was crushed between the vehicle and the lower guardrail, resulting in a fractured foot.
An employee was performing a leak test of a gas line when a flash fire occurred, resulting in second and third degree burns to their face and arm.
An employee was exiting his truck to check in with a security/scale house when he was struck by another truck approaching the scales, resulting in a broken left leg.

On June 18, 2021, an employee was mowing the grass with a push mower when they fell and their foot went under the mower. The employee suffered the amputation of their right big toe and trauma to their right foot that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was walking to take a break when their knee gave out and the employee fell, resulting in a splintered femur.

On June 18, 2021, an employee was carrying sample bottles from the fume hood to the work station when they slipped on water on the floor and fell, resulting in a dislocated left knee and shattered left knee cap that required hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning a screw conveyor with a shovel. He slipped into the auger, and the conveyor lacerated the arch of his right foot and broke some bones. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was carrying natural gas pipe fittings out of a trailer. One of the fittings fell and struck the employee's right thumb as the employee tried to catch it. The thumb was amputated.
An employee was assisting a customer with securing their vehicle that was on a trailer when the vehicle rolled forward. His right index finger was caught in a pinch point and amputated.

On June 18, 2021, a roofer was tearing a roof off. As he was walking in an area of the roof containing the original shingles, his foot went through the rotted wood under the shingles. He suffered a twisted ankle and was hospitalized.

An employee was connecting a 4-inch metal flex hose to a connection point. The hose slipped off the connection point and pinched the employee's right leg against a wellhead isolation valve, causing an open fracture to the femur.

An employee was sitting in his personal vehicle parked on the side of the road in a road construction zone. A motor vehicle traveling the wrong way on the highway drove into the construction zone and struck the employee's vehicle. The employee sustained two broken ribs and a broken leg.
While dismounting a skid steer loader, an employee contacted the loader and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured femur.
An employee was stepping down from a stock cart when they missed a step and fell to the floor, resulting in injuries to their head and back.
On June 19, 2021, an employee was removing ductwork when a 10- to 12-inch piece of the ductwork fell onto his left ring finger. Its sharp edge amputated the fingertip.
An employee was grinding metal with a grinder when the grinder wheel broke and cut his arm.
While opening a door and stepping backwards, an employee tripped. She fell to the floor, breaking her femur, and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was removing asphalt from a buggy auger. The employee's right index finger was amputated in a shear point between the spinning auger and the machine's frame. The auger was not locked out at the time.
On June 19, 2021, an employee was working on a pneumatic hopper. The employee was cleaning food out of the machine when it crushed his right middle finger, leading to an amputation.
Two employees were putting an unframed glass mirror into a trash gaylord. The mirror broke and lacerated an employee's inner right elbow.
An employee was emptying trash into a dumpster. The employee fell through a 6-inch wooden riser in front of the dumpster and suffered a broken leg.
On 6/20/2021, an employee slipped on water and fell to the floor, resulting in a broken leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was cleaning out metal cup casings around a chain, sprocket, and rotating shaft during maintenance. The machine was turned on while the employee's hand was in a pinch point. The employee's fingers were caught in the machine's chain and sprocket, and the employee suffered a broken right arm and possible finger amputations.
An employee was ascending a ladder when they slipped and fell 10 feet, resulting in broken ribs and a fractured pelvis.

An employee was pushing an empty pallet with a pallet jack when the empty pallet got stuck on the pallet jack. The employee tried to get the pallet off the pallet jack while near a post. The pallet jack struck the post and the employee fell off the pallet jack, resulting in a head laceration and possible concussion.
An employee was moving to sit in a chair when it slipped out from under her. Her back and neck struck the chair and the floor, and she suffered a brain bleed.

Three employees had just retrieved a wooden beam from under a section of ductwork. One of them was bending over to pick it up when the duct section shifted and a piece of angle iron slid off it onto that employee's left thumb. The thumb was broken and the employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was cleaning off a manure belt when the belt grabbed onto his hand, resulting in an amputation of the right arm above the elbow.
An employee was unhooking a hose on a chemical reel car. The employee was sprayed with sodium hydroxide and suffered chemical burns to the mouth.
An employee was manually moving a pallet along a conveyor when the employee became caught between the pallet and conveyor roller, resulting in a partial amputation of a finger without bone loss.

On June 21, 2021, an employee was operating a chair leg bending machine. The employee's fingers were caught between the die set and the leg of the chair to be bent; three of the employee's fingers were amputated. The machine was guarded at the time.
An employee was operating a dump pedal during water blasting activities when a 3/16-inch flex lance connection failed, resulting in a puncture wound to the employee's right thigh.
On June 21, 2021, an employee was installing ductwork when they fell approximately 16 feet through an opening in the ceiling, resulting in fractures to their hip and wrist that required surgery.
An employee tripped and fell while walking into an office. She suffered a broken right wrist.
An employee was working partway up a 7-foot ladder. He slipped off the ladder and landed on the ground on his feet, suffering a hip injury. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working on a project to install a phone line when they were struck by the back side of a cable trenching plow, resulting in crush injuries to their legs and the amputation of their right leg.
An employee became dizzy and developed a headache while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

An employee was driving an all terrain vehicle (ATV) along a fence. When they crested a sand hill, the employee was ejected from the ATV, resulting in four to nine cracked ribs and a bruised lung and spleen.
An employee was using a chainsaw and severely lacerated their leg.

On 6/21/2021, an employee was climbing a ladder to inspect a piece of equipment when they fell from the ladder, resulting in fractures to the humerus, skull, and vertebrae that required hospitalization.
An employee was laying irrigation pipe when a passing mower threw debris that lacerated and broke the employee's left ankle.

Three employees were demolishing a wall inside a clean room. One of them was holding a base plate while a wall panel was removed. The panel dislodged and fell on the employee's right thumb, injuring it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was spraying weeds from an ATV. While the ATV was driving uphill, its back left tire went into a ditch and it rolled over backward. The employee jumped off and the ATV rolled over onto him, crushing his pelvis and fracturing his sacrum.
An employee was walking down the stairs onto a sidewalk after delivering a package when they were struck by a bicycle, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.

An employee was standing while providing care to a patient in the back of a moving ambulance. The ambulance made a turn and the employee fell onto wooden cabinets mounted on the wall of the ambulance. The employee suffered back trauma that resulted in hemothorax, that required medical treatment.
An employee was attacked by wasps while working from the first step of a ladder. The employee stumbled backwards and struck their head against a field tank. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was installing handrails on a scaffold. While changing position, she fell, landing on the ground 14 feet below and suffering several broken ribs, a punctured lung, and a non-displaced vertebra fracture.
An employee was pushing extra material through a bonder machine when their right hand contacted the bonder, resulting in the amputation of four fingers at the palm level.
An employee was checking the belt tension on an air handler when their left index finger became caught in the machine; the fingertip was amputated down to the end of the nail.
An employee lost consciousness and fell while stocking produce. The employee's head struck a cooler in the fall, causing a cut to the head. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee fell from the right riding step of a garbage truck, landing on the ground and suffering a contusion on the back of the head.
An employee was guiding a tram cart that was holding telephone poles when a pole rolled off the tram onto the employee's left foot and crushed it.
Two employees entered a cage to troubleshoot a foam line. While they were inside, the door was closed and a sensor activated a cross-cut saw. One employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

An employee was looking for defects in a carpet while standing on the floor between a catwalk and the exit roller of a tufting machine. He stepped backward and tripped on the edge of the catwalk, grabbing onto the exit roller of the machine with his left hand in order to catch himself. While doing so, his left index finger went into the keyway hole on the rotating exit roller, which caused his left index finger to be lacerated.
An employee opened the top of a blending tank and a hot water hose came out. The employee was burned by hot water.

An employee was euthanizing a cow with a pneumatic knocking tool when the cow swung its head and pushed the tool toward the employee. The tool triggered and its pin struck the employee in the left elbow, resulting in a broken humerus bone.

A temporary employee was trying to help pull a jammed pad through a pad cutter. The cut button was pressed while the employee's thumb was in the path of the blade, which partially amputated the thumb.
An employee was delivering mail on a walking route when they began to feel ill and were hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was installing a 277-volt light fixture while on a 6-foot, A-frame ladder when the employee contacted a phase of the conductor and was shocked, causing him to fall backward off the ladder to the ground below. The employee suffered trauma to their head, neck, and chest.
Two employees collided and one fell, suffering two broken arms.

At 12:04 p.m. on June 21, 2021, an employee was dumping 50-pound bags of ground caraway into a hopper through a screen. The product bridged in the hopper, so the employee slid the screen out of the way and began pushing the product down. The screw feed auger at the bottom of the hopper nipped his right index finger, causing an amputation.
An employee was standing in a hallway when an automobile that was in the parking lot crashed into the building and struck the employee.

An employee working on a bridge was going to check paint levels in a paving striper when he fell through a 24-inch gap between two bridges, resulting in a dislocated shoulder, three to four dislocated ribs, a fractured pelvis, and head contusions and lacerations.
An employee was operating a front-riding piece of power equipment when he struck a pallet and fell from the lift to the floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was measuring a bar stock to be cut. A chop saw blade amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was closing the ramp of a truck. As it closed, the ramp amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was cleaning a coffee grinder when it activated and amputated her left thumb.
An employee was climbing a ladder. He fell at the second or third rung, hitting his head on the ground below and suffering possible head trauma.
An employee was using a cutting machine. As he put a wood stick on the machine, his right ring finger was caught in the cutter, which amputated the fingertip.

An employee was adjusting planks for a press when the stack of planks tilted and started falling. The employee tried to catch the planks and they fell on his right hand, resulting in amputation of the right little finger.
An employee became lightheaded while walking, tripped on a bench leg, and fell onto the bench, suffering five broken ribs on the right side.

An employee was operating a filler machine when she noticed a jam and went to unclog it. The employee's right hand contacted the machine between the labeler guards/track and the machine dial, resulting in the amputation of skin on her middle fingertip.

An employee was working from the second rung of a 4-foot A-frame step ladder. He lost his balance and his foot went into an open cabinet drawer. He then fell to the ground, twisting and breaking his right leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was disassembling a pool umbrella when its base fell and broke the employee's left leg.
An employee fell while stepping off a stool, landing on the ground and suffering a broken T12 vertebra.
On June 22, 2021, an employee was working from a raised scissor lift, stepped backward, and fell from the lift onto the ground. The employee suffered a concussion and spinal fractures.

An employee was trying to free a utility pole section for disposal. The pole came loose, struck the employee, and knocked him off the trailer he was working from. He fell and struck his head on the ground, suffering head trauma, lacerations, and possible fractures.
An employee tripped and fell, suffering an elbow injury.

An employee was in a traffic attenuator truck protecting the crew who were putting sign covers on the advance warning signs when a vehicle ran into the back of the truck, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.
A forklift struck an employee as she walked across an aisle. She suffered a broken left leg.

An employee fell while exiting a pickup truck, landing on the asphalt parking lot surface about 22 inches below. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the left femur (including at the neck of the hip socket) and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was moving a chain and trolley while preparing to hoist a wooden set wall into position. The chain broke and the trolley hoist struck the employee, resulting in a contusion on their back left shoulder blade, as well as a laceration to the medial aspect of the left orbit.

An employee was pulling a stack of sheet rock that was leaning against a wall to look at a low-voltage telecommunication box. The stack of drywall fell and broke the employee's upper right leg and lower left leg. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee tripped on a river rock and fell into a shallow excavation, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was helping change trays for a shaker table. As the employee was closing a latch for a tray, it caught his index fingertip. About a quarter of the fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a flange-making machine to make a head for tanks/vessels. The employee stopped the machine to take a measurement of the head with a tape measure. Their glove became caught and their right hand was crushed between the side roll and the head, resulting in five broken bones in the hand and three broken fingers.

An employee was power washing a sidewalk inside a carwash when the washer hose wrapped around the employee, pulling him and causing him to spin down the carwash tunnel. The employee struck his feet against the track of the carwash, resulting in two foot fractures.
An employee was chaining a container on a trailer. His left middle finger was caught between the trailer and the chain. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was driving a forklift in reverse when it struck a steel pillar, resulting in the amputation of four fingers on their right hand.

On June 22, 2021, an employee was attempting to open an elevator dump pit. When the employee stepped on a brake that was holding up a metal bar, the bar came down forcefully and struck the employee on the left side of the chest. The employee suffered internal bleeding and a possible tear to the aorta. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was poisoned by carbon monoxide from a dishwasher.
On June 21, 2021, an employee developed heat-related dehydration after a full day helping a crew install water services. He was hospitalized.
An employee tore his Achilles tendon while lifting a heavy package. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

An employee was assisting a forklift operator in moving boxed materials weighing 259 pounds. One of two boxes fell from the elevated forks and landed on the employee's left leg, resulting in a lower leg fracture.
An employee was thrown from a material delivery tug to the ground, suffering a broken ankle.
On 6/23/2021, an employee stood to walk away from a conveyor belt area when she fell to the floor, landing on her right side and resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee was discharging concrete into an excavator bucket. The bucket moved and struck the employee's right ear, crushing and lacerating it.

An employee was waiting at a welding line. The head of the weld wheel began to move, and the employee's right little finger was caught between a stationary lifting lug and an outcropping on the carriage passing by. The finger was broken.
An employee suffered heat stress and lost consciousness after working a 10.5-hour shift at a hot forge plant.
An employee was delivering auto parts at a salvage yard. A dog startled him and he fell to the ground, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was walking in a parking lot. She stepped in a rut, fell, and broke her leg.
An employee was grabbing products from a conveyor when his finger was caught in the ingoing nip point between the conveyor and the backstop resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was disassembling a scaffold. After opening a gate to load a mud bin onto a forklift, the employee fell from the scaffold to the ground. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee's foot was partially run over by a moving mini excavator track, resulting in a fracture.

An employee was mopping hot tar when he tripped backwards over the mop cart. His right arm landed inside the cart, which was half full of asphalt. He suffered second-degree burns to the forearm and hand.
An employee was parking a double pallet jack forklift and collided with a parked reach truck, resulting in a laceration to her left foot.
An employee was pouring oil into a refill port when the oil shot back out onto the employee, resulting in burns to the chin that required hospitalization.
An employee was driving a shuttle bus when it collided with another vehicle in a parking lot. The employee developed severe back pain and was hospitalized.
An employee was changing out an overhead coffee filter on an industrial coffee maker when hot water poured down on the employee, resulting in burns to their shoulder, chest, and arm.

An employee operating an end rider pallet jack was entering the cooling section of a facility after returning from the trash disposal area when they collided with the rear of a stationary end rider pallet jack. The employee suffered a gash on their leg.
An employee was troubleshooting a power outage when an arc flash occurred. The employee suffered electrical burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was putting weights back on a rack after lifting them. The employee's left little finger was caught between two weight plates and amputated.
An employee was opening a gate when they tripped on a curb and fell to the concrete ground, resulting in an open head wound and a broken rib.

Two employees were dismantling tube and coupler scaffolding when it collapsed and the employees fell approximately 26 feet to the ground. One employee sustained a fractured left fibula and a fractured right wrist. The second employee fractured both feet. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was separating a concrete form from a vault. The form came off the hoist hook, and the employee's fingertips were crushed between it and the vault. The employee's right ring and middle fingertips were medically amputated.

An employee was operating a dock plate while making a delivery when their little finger got caught in the dock plate at the delivery site loading dock. The employee suffered a crush injury that resulted in surgery and a fingertip amputation.

An employee on a ladder was straightening the door hinge on a piece of equipment using a pry bar when the employee fell approximately 5 feet to the concrete floor below, resulting in lacerations to the back of the head and internal bleeding.
A forklift struck an employee from behind as it backed up. The employee suffered a broken left leg.

An employee was using a plasma cutter to cut parts on a line's cutoff. Sparks from the cutter came into contact with a flammable liquid that was used to mark parts, and the employee suffered burns to the face, neck, chest, and arms in the resulting fire. He also suffered a head laceration.
An employee was cleaning an air valve. A plunger inside the valve actuated and amputated the tip of the employee's right index finger.
A Border Patrol Agent trainee became ill during formation run and then began to have seizures. He was hospitalized with heat stroke.
An employee was cleaning a baking machine with a water hose when their left index finger got caught within a chain and sprocket that was driving the machine's conveyor, resulting in amputation.

An employee was searching for a fox den. As the employee climbed up a slope a boulder dislodged, causing the employee fall 10-15 feet. The boulder then pinned the employee to the ground. The employee suffered multiple fractures to the right side of the torso, the collarbone, and the right arm, as well as a laceration to the back of the head.

An employee was cleaning around a chop saw when the blade lacerated their left middle and ring fingers.

A 3/16" nylon rope was being pulled through the employee's left hand as it was being applied to a rotating mandrel. A knot in the rope caught the employee's left pinky finger and amputated the distal and middle portion.

An employee was unloading lumber from a flatbed truck and fell backward off the back of the truck to the ground 4 feet below. The employee was hospitalized for brain swelling, a fractured collarbone, a fractured hip and memory loss.
An employee stepped off the back of his truck. He then took a few steps and his knee gave out and hyper-extended, resulting in a torn tendon in his right leg.

An employee was working at a computer workstation. An idling ambulance was parked outside the building next to the air intake vent that comes directly into the office area on the second floor. The employee experienced headache, dizziness, and nausea and was hospitalized due to carbon monoxide exposure.

An employee was using an overhead grid crane when their right middle finger was pinched between the engine head assembly and the transport rack resulting in amputation of the fingertip just below the nail bed.
An employee was repairing a semi-truck that was on a jack. The jack shot out from under the truck and struck the employee in the leg, fracturing it.

A truck driver was standing near the truck with his hand on the edge of the flatbed while a drilling mast was being loaded onto the truck bed. The mast shifted and pinched the truck driver's finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A 2500 lbs. tote bag had fallen over. An employee was holding open a loop on top of the bag to accommodate the forks of a forklift. His finger was caught between the forks and the loop and the pad of the right middle finger was amputated.
An employee had been operating a pallet jack. The pallet jack moved while recharging and fractured the employee's ankle.
An employee was working on a crane's power. He went to turn on the disconnect and it backfired. He sustained an electric shock and burns to his abdominal area and left elbow.
An employee was moving a section of warehouse rack beams when one section slipped from his hand and struck his foot. The employee sustained a broken right foot requiring surgery.
An employee was on a platform on a concrete truck cleaning dried ready-mix from the chute. The employee fell from the platform to the ground resulting in hospitalization for a fractured hip.
An employee had been unloading parcels. The employee was hospitalized with severe dehydration.

A load of cargo from a vessel was being landed on the dock. The injured employee walked towards the load in order to unhook the rigging, when one of the 4-ton round steel bars rolled and came to rest on his left foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left ankle.

An employee was setting up film on a small pack machine. The first bag became stuck on the tape and when the employee grabbed the bag, the machine started. The employee's left index finger contacted the machine's knife bar, resulting in an amputation of about 1/2 inch of the finger.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it struck a wall. His left foot was caught between the pallet jack and the wall resulting in a fractured left ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing down the fixed ladder of an asphalt shuttle buggy when he slipped from the top step and fell approximately 10 feet to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the pelvis and right hand.
An employee had been installing internet in a residence and was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

The injured employee and a co-worker were cleaning the jammed auger system of the rotary airlock feeder. The injured employee was using a piece of rebar when his hand and arm were pulled into the auger. His hand was injured and three fingers were amputated by the rotating auger.

An employee was repairing a wrap line machine. While checking the tension of a chain in the machine, the employee's glove was caught by the chain and his finger was pinched between the chain and a sprocket. His left index finger was medically amputated to the first knuckle. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.

An employee was walking between a pallet and a wall rack when their foot got caught. The employee tripped and fell, hitting his head/face on the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a bruised orbital area and a cut to the forehead.

An employee drove a pallet jack to the fueling station and dismounted the pallet jack before it came to a complete stop. His right leg was caught and fractured between his pallet jack and a parked pallet jack.
On July 1, 2021, an employee was sitting at his desk when he began to smell a sulfur odor, resulting in dizziness, nausea, the inability to focus, and eye sight issues that required hospitalization.
An employee was washing the shoulder skin machine and was removing a piece of meat stuck in the roller. Her left little finger was caught in the rotating roller and amputated.
On July 1, 2021, an employee was bending metal parts on a brake press when their right middle finger was caught in the point of operation and partially amputated.
An employee was walking from the information desk to the back office when she fell and sustained a broken leg.

An employee was assisting the crew in laying the last piece of material. He stepped on the material so it could be welded by a co-worker. The material slid and the employee fell through the hole approximately 30 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a dislocated hip and injures to the face and forehead.
An employee was operating a lathe when coolant got onto his face. He was hospitalized, suffering from a bacterial infection.

An employee was operating the 5-pound flour packaging machine. While cleaning something on the machine, the employee's hand was caught in the machine resulting in a deep laceration to the right little finger which required hospitalization and surgery.

A powered industrial truck (PIT) operator was speaking to another employee and looked over their right shoulder in order to back up. While backing up, the PIT struck the other employee resulting in fractures, a torn rotator cuff, a crushed right foot, a leg laceration that required stitches, and the loss of the nail on their big toe.
An employee was reaching for an item on an upper shelf when she fell to the ground, resulting in a leg fracture and head laceration.
An employee lost her footing and fell while closing a trailer door. The trailer door then struck her on the back.
An employee had been repairing a vehicle and felt dizzy and had a rapid heartbeat. The employee was hospitalized for a heat illness.

Two employees were working on ladder jack scaffolds that were greater than 20 feet above the lower level. The injured employee was on the wooden plank that bridged two ladder jack scaffolds when they fell to ground below. The employee was hospitalized.
A driver was opening the back door of a trailer when product fell and broke their left ankle.

On July 1, 2021, two employees were filling up a grain truck. One employee was standing in the load out area, which is a platform approximately 15 feet high used to observe the level of grain inside the trucks. Employees access this platform via a ladder that is located above the booth pit. The second employee was conducting groundwork and operating the controls that supply the grain to the trucks located behind the booth pit. During this process, the second employee went to use the stairs to climb up to the loading platform. At this time, the booth pit hole was open and uncovered. While the employee was climbing the ladder, the employee fell approximately 24.5 feet into the booth pit and suffered multiple broken bones and lacerations.
On July 1, 2021, an employee was walking in the warehouse when they tripped and fell to the floor resulting in hospitalization for a fractured left hip.
While installing a placard on a truck, an employee fell backward and hit his head on the concrete. He was hospitalized for possible bleeding on the brain.
An employee was getting a grave ready for a funeral service. The employee fell into the grave and suffered a broken femur.

An employee was cutting meat on a bandsaw when a piece of frozen meat became caught on the teeth of the blade and jerked the safety plate, which forced the employee's hand into the blade. The employee sustained an amputation to the right ring finger.
An employee was using a string trimmer to cut grass along a fence and was stung by ground bees on the face, arms, and back.
An employee was picking up trash and driving a utility terrain vehicle (UTV). The UTV rolled over while coming down a hill and the employee sustained a broken ankle.

An employee was preparing strips of moulding for delivery. The moulding was stacked on a wooden pallet, which the employee grabbed to move the material closer to his workstation. A slat of the pallet broke and struck the employee in the abdominal area resulting in a lacerated bladder.
On July 2, 2021, an employee had just finished loading his truck and was removing a dock plate when its hinge section partially amputated his left ring finger at the first knuckle.
An employee was working on a pallet machine to fix the chain when the chain released and partially amputated the employee's right middle fingertip.
An employee climbed up the side of a garbage truck to clear away loose debris on the truck. The employee fell, landing on the ground about 8 feet below and suffering a head laceration.

An employee was unloading product from a truck using a forklift. While stacking the product, one of the pallets fell. The employee got out of the forklift and started picking up the fallen product. When the first pallet fell it struck another stack of pallets, causing them to be unstable. The stack fell onto the employee causing multiple femur fractures.
An employee was driving a forklift in the warehouse. While driving out of the cooler, the employee's foot got caught between the forklift and a pole, resulting in a broken foot.

Two employees were working to clean the exterior of a customer's one-story residence. The employees were anchored to each other. Employee 1 climbed the ladder to clean the gutters and Employee 2 followed up the ladder. Employee 2 lost his footing on the ladder and fell, which also pulled Employee 1 down. Employee 1 sustained a fractured left hip. Employee 2 sustained a head injury and an abrasion to his back. Both employees were hospitalized.

An employee was getting a tarp crank handle out of the way by pushing the handle behind the ledge of a roll-off box. He then turned to pick up a chain that was on the ground to hook to the box. Tension on the handle caused it to release and hit the employee in the head/face. He was hospitalized with a forehead contusion and a laceration to the bridge of the nose.

An employee was riding a Segway reading meters. As the employee was riding between two poles a wire that was hanging between the poles knocked him off the Segway. The employee struck his head and lost consciousness. The employee was hospitalized with a neck laceration.

An employee was assembling a vertical dough lift machine which required four bolts to assemble. The employee installed the top two bolts. While attempting to align the holes and install the bottom two bolts, the machine shifted and the employee's left little finger was caught in a pinch point resulting in amputation after the second knuckle.
An employee was loading an aircraft with a unit loading vehicle (ULV). He was pulling the ULV when his left foot got caught between the ULV and a lock. The employee sustained a fractured left foot.
An employee was dropping cubes from the flatbed truck to feed cattle. As the employee was clearing out a cake, the hopper door came down and amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee was moving a shopping cart filled with cardboard down a ramp to the recycling dumpster. The employee pushed downward on the shopping cart's handle and the cart tipped over causing her to fall to the ground. The employee sustained bruises to her left knee and right ankle.
An employee was struck by a motor vehicle while walking to their own vehicle. The employee suffered a broken wrist.

An employee was performing a leak test/pressure test on a line set and looking at a pressure gauge. A piece of steel blew off the end of the copper line and hit the employee in the head. The employee fell and suffered a laceration to the back of his head.
An employee was moving equipment on a pallet jack when the equipment fell off the pallet jack and broke his ankle.
An employee was putting a shaft into a cable machine and amputated fingertips on both hands.
An employee was struck by a customer's forklift while delivering freight, resulting in broken bones in both feet.
An employee was stripping a concrete form when it fell on him. He suffered a cracked sternum and was hospitalized.

An employee was collecting hand baskets in a parking lot. A customer in a truck asked for one of the baskets. As the employee was handing one to him, the truck struck the employee and caused him to fall. He suffered a broken ankle.

On July 3, 2021, at approximately 2:00 p.m., an employee parked a forklift next to another forklift. While exiting the forklift, the controls engaged causing the forklift to move and crush the employee's left leg between the two forklifts resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was loading a trailer with pallets of product at a warehouse dock. After stowing the dock plate, the employee entered the trailer to put some airbags in the trailer to help support the pallet loads. While exiting the trailer, the employee's leg fell into the gap between the trailer floor and the dock floor resulting in a lower leg laceration.
An employee was hospitalized for a broken clavicle.
An employee was changing a tire on a customer's car when she fell forward, hit her head on the vehicle, and suffered a concussion.
An employee lost his balance on carpeting and fell, hitting a handrail and the wall. He suffered a laceration and a contusion on his forehead and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning the inside of the mixing machine when the door of the mixing machine struck the employee's right wrist resulting in a laceration and contusion to the right wrist.

An employee was operating a CNC bandsaw with an automatic material loading shuttle and clamping mechanism. The wood that the machine was shuttling into the clamping area was tipping, and the employee reached over to stabilize it for the clamp. The clamp closed on the employee's right index finger and amputated the fingertip.
An employee slipped and fell in a restroom, suffering neck and back fractures.

An employee was using a manlift to observe a leak at a white liquor line. The gasket at the leaking flange area failed and sprayed hot white liquor on the employee, who suffered burns to his side, buttocks, and eyes.
An employee was working with a sausage stamper and amputated part of her left middle finger.

An employee was walking from a culinary trailer to his truck when he tripped over a cable tray cover. The employee's right knee twisted and he fell to the ground landing on his right knee and resulting in torn ligaments that required hospitalization.

An employee was attempting to put a muzzle on a cat in order to trim its nails when the cat bit the worker, resulting in a puncture wound to the right index finger that became infected and required hospitalization.
A Border Patrol agent was apprehending a group of subjects on a ranch and suffered heat stroke.
An employee was cutting a squash when the paring knife he was using amputated the tip of his left ring finger.
Two employees were breaking up a dog fight and sustained dog bites. One employee was hospitalized for surgery. The second employee received stitches and was released.
An employee was clearing a plug in a drain line. The line broke. Hot water (between 180 and 200 degrees Fahrenheit) gushed out, causing first-and second-degree burns to the employee's lower left leg.
An employee was putting away overstock in a meat/deli cooler. The employee tripped over the leg of a cart and fell to the floor, suffering a broken left hip.
An employee slipped and fell while walking to his truck, twisting an ankle and suffering a foot injury.

An employee was on a loading dock, unloading a full cart of eggs from a truck. The wheels of the cart got stuck on a dock plate and the cart tipped over onto the employee. The employee suffered a concussion, back fractures, and possibly a foot/toe fracture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was feeding film into a separator machine when their hand got caught in the rollers, resulting in the removal of skin from their fingers and hand.
An employee was directing a customer to a parking spot. The customer's vehicle struck the employee, pinning them against the wall and causing injuries to both knees.

An employee was painting outside a building from an articulating boom lift about 25 feet off the ground. The lift ran out of gas and stopped working. While trying to reach the ground, the employee fell about 9 feet onto gravel and suffered a compound fracture to the right tibia and fibula.
On July 5, 2021, an employee tripped and fell in a break room, hitting a table and then landing on their right side on the floor. The employee suffered a broken right hip/pelvis and was hospitalized.
A hydraulic lift was being used to move an I-beam. It failed, and an I-beam hit an employee in the chest. He then fell and his face struck the ground.
An employee fell about 5 feet from a ladder to the ground, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was feeding steel into a furnace when a steel rod struck his head.
An employee's index and little fingers were caught and fractured between a swinging gate and a stationary gate.
An employee was using a table saw to cut extruded polystyrene. The saw cut the employee's fingers, causing partial amputations to the index and middle fingers.
An employee slipped on a grated metal step while entering a truck cab. The employee fell to the parking lot surface and suffered a compound fracture to the left ankle.
An employee was laying out plywood on the roof of a building and fell about 15 feet. The employee sustained sprains.
An employee was walking down steps in the hotel when she fell forward, stopping about 10 steps below. She suffered a spinal injury and was hospitalized.
An employee tripped over the power cord for a piece of cleaning equipment as she walked away from it. She fell to the ground, suffered a broken hip, and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On July 6, 2021, at 1:20 p.m., an employee was climbing a fixed vertical ladder to a commercial roof in order to install metal coping around the perimeter of the roof. The employee fell about 6 feet off the ladder to the concrete floor below, resulting in a head laceration with swelling and a left ankle injury.

An employee was using an extension wand and sprayer to apply oil to the chains on a moving walkway. While sitting on the threshold of the moving walk's pit, the employee's left foot contacted a pallet (step) and became lodged between a pallet and the turnaround crossbar. The employee suffered fractured bones in his foot.
An employee was operating a punch press when his right hand was caught in the point of operation resulting in a crushed right index finger.

An employee was installing a grounding rod next to an electrical panel using an impact tool. He was standing at the edge of a trench which was approximately 2 feet deep. It had rained the previous day so the ground was damp and loose. The tool was placed on top of the grounding rod and it covered approximately 6 inches of the top of the rod. The employee would lift up the tool without exposing the top of the rod and then using a downward force, drive the rod into the ground. One of the times, after lifting up the tool, the ground underneath the employee shifted causing him to lift the tool off the rod as he pulled up on the tool. When the employee began the downward force with the tool, the ground under him gave way causing him to fall forward onto the grounding rod, striking part of his face and his eye.

An employee was standing next to a truck and trailer while poles were being loaded onto the trailer. The equipment struck an overhead powerline and electricity traveled through the equipment and through the employee, resulting in burns to his right thigh and both feet.

An employee was operating a roll-up side mechanism on a greenhouse and suffered a right thumb amputation when their shirt was snagged by the mechanism and twisted tightly around his upper arm and hand.
An employee fell 12 feet through a skylight and suffered back fractures.
A maintenance employee was unjamming a golf straightener. When the machine was jogged, the employee's finger was caught between the carrier block and the frame and crushed, resulting in amputation.

On July 6, 2021, an employee was crossing a road, holding a 1/4-inch telecommunications strand cable with his left arm. A truck sped through the traffic stop, and the cable became tangled in its rear tires. The cable amputated the employee's left arm.
An employee lost consciousness while leaning over to pick up an object. The employee's head struck the warehouse floor in the resulting fall.

An employee was operating a three-wheeled personal electric transport vehicle. While traveling up a concrete grade of approximately 30 degrees, the equipment failed. The employee then attempted to turn left, back down the incline, and the front wheel may have caught on a concrete barrier. The employee fell out of the vehicle, landed on the concrete ground and sustained a broken left femur.
At about 5:15 p.m. on July 6, 2021, after driving a delivery route and delivering packages on a 90-degree day, an employee developed muscle cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee was unjamming a piece of metal from a body maker machine when the machine engaged and caused the amputation of fingers.
An employee tripped over a resident's shoes and fell to the floor. The employee suffered a possible bone fracture.

An employee was releasing a concrete form from the mold jacket. The mold weighed 800 lbs. and the employee's left index and middle fingertips were pinched when the mold shifted resulting in fingertip amputations.
An employee was working alongside the paver in the heat and direct sun. Around 4:00 p.m., the employee began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was cleaning the shower. She bent down to wipe the floors and her hand was caught in the towel rack. Skin was removed from her finger and she was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee completed a clean-in-place (CIP) process. At the end of the process, the employee was disconnecting the hoses and was sprayed with 'rinse water' that may contain CIP chemicals. The employee was hospitalized for ingestion of the chemicals.

An employee was pushing a medical cart in an operating room when they tripped over the wheels of a surgical table and struck the table before falling to the floor. The employee lost consciousness and suffered injuries to their arms, head, and neck, including a hyper-extended neck and tingling and weakness in both upper extremities.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut a 4x4 post when the saw blade contacted his left middle finger, resulting in an amputation of approximately 40% of the finger.

On July 6, 2021, at approximately 8:30 AM a semi-truck was delivering rebar to the site. As an employee went to the rear of the truck to help guide it, a loader grabbed one side of the rebar and caused the other side to bounce and strike the employee on his left leg. The employee suffered fractures to his tibia and fibula.
An employee tripped and fell to the ground, breaking her hip.

An employee and a co-worker were replacing an air filter in a dust collector using a scissor lift. The co-worker pushed the filter with his foot so that the employee on the ground could grab the filter when the employee's finger was smashed between the filter and the scissor lift, resulting in an avulsion and an amputation of the right ring fingertip.
An employee was skinning fish using a skinning machine when her glove was caught and skin was removed from her right index finger.
An employee was pouring a 5-gallon pail of waste chemicals into a 55-gallon container. The chemical splashed the employee, who began to suffer breathing problems. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating material handling equipment and caught her left hand between the equipment and an electrical outlet on a beam. The employee's left index and middle fingers were lacerated, resulting in partial amputations to both fingers.
At about 10:00 a.m. on July 6, 2021, an employee was doing electrical powerline work when he developed heat stress symptoms. He was hospitalized.

An temporary employee was collecting a small bundle of yard waste from the curb and loading it into the rear hopper area of a sanitation truck. The packer panel was activated and the employee's left hand was caught by the panel and crushed.
An employee was cleaning the filter on a floor cleaning machine on a dock and fell off the edge of the dock to the ground below. The employee's ankle was broken in three places and required surgery.

On July 7, 2021, an employee was using a wooden platform that was about 10 to 12 feet high to install the overhead can lights on a new two-story home. The wooden platform gave way causing the employee to fall on his feet. He was hospitalized for a broken right ankle.

The injured employee was in a 7- to 8-foot deep trench installing a large, 66" diameter reinforced concrete pipe. An excavator bucket came loose and fell into the trench, striking the employee on the left side of their body. The employee sustained a large contusion on the upper left leg, a broken left arm, and their left hand was surgically amputated.

An employee was operating a stand-up loader and was parallel parking the loader between a parked truck and a chipper tongue. As he was positioning the loader, his left leg was caught between the loader and the parked truck and was fractured.
An employee was unjamming a machine and partially amputated their right index finger.
An employee was shifting a drawer with a cart when the cart hit a bump and his left ring finger was crushed, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on water and fell to the ground, suffering a back injury.
An employee was working on the trim folder machine. The employee's left hand slipped and was caught in the machine resulting in fractures to the index and middle fingers.

Two employees were unclogging the chipper after a rainstorm. One employee opened an access panel to the drum of the chipper to unclog it while the second employee went to the other side of the chipper. The first employee then shut the access panel. The motor was off, but the drum was still spinning. A piece of clogged brush kicked the panel open and struck the second employee in the forehead, resulting in multiple skull fractures.
An employee was performing patient care activities in the patient's home when the employee tripped and fell while entering a "sunken" living room, fracturing their hip.
An employee was cleaning a machine and partially amputated their right middle finger.
An employee was shutting the rear door of a store when her left middle finger was caught in the door, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee was preparing to clean a ribbon blender. The blender's lid came down on the employee's left ring finger, amputating the fingertip.
An employee was adjusting a loader when 15 boards dropped onto his head. He suffered facial fractures.
An employee was sitting on a desk. When she stood up, she fell to the floor and broke her right ankle.
While walking down a jet bridge, an employee slipped on the wet surface, fell, and sustained a broken right arm.
A temporary employee was attempting to remove a piece of metal from a jammed machine when the rotor lacerated his left middle finger resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.

On July 7, 2021, an employee was removing a repair trailer from a utility vehicle's hitch using their right hand. As the hitch released, it pinched their right index finger between the tailgate of the utility vehicle and the trailer hitch latch resulting in a laceration and fracture to the right index finger that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee collapsed at the end of the work day due to dehydration and heat-related illness.
An employee experienced heat-related illness at the end of their shift due to dehydration and was hospitalized.

An employee was driving around and making deliveries on July 7, 2021. It was a humid, 92-degree day and the delivery truck's air conditioning failed. On returning to the facility at 5:00 p.m., the employee was hot and sweaty, with incoherent speech. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and kidney failure.

On July 7, 2021, an employee was operating a standup forklift. When they lifted their left foot to apply the brake, their foot extended outside the operator compartment and was caught between the forklift and a concrete curb, resulting in a fractured left ankle and lacerated shin.

On July 7, 2021, a painter was attempting to remove residual material while using a portable pneumatic powered abrasive wheel. The organic rubber wheel broke apart and debris struck the employee's eye. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was participating in the running portion of a physical examination when they collapsed due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was walking from their personal vehicle to the work location. While going down a grassy hill, the employee slipped on pine needles and sustained a fractured ankle.

On July 7, 2021, an employee was lifting their left leg up to climb onto the upper scaffold deck for scaffold modification. After stepping up approximately 2 feet to the upper scaffold deck, the employee felt a pain in their abdomen. The employee suffered an inguinal hernia that required hospitalization.
An employee was working at her desk and fell resulting in a fractured arm, wrist, and hip.
Two employees were changing a guy wire, trying to remove the pin using a hammer and bull pin. When the pin came free, it crushed one employee's hand in the guy wire eyelet.
An employee who had been delivering packages began experiencing cramping in their arms and legs and was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was carrying a large tray in a kitchen. The employee tripped over a plastic drink carton that was sticking out into the walkway, fell, and landed on the concrete floor, suffering a broken right hip.
An employee was filling a repaired tire with air. The tire exploded and the employee sustained a fractured skull, a broken pelvis, a broken rib, a punctured lung, and a forehead laceration.
An employee was acting as the team mascot and was hospitalized for a heat-related illness.
An employee was performing maintenance work on a piece of equipment when their left hand contacted an auger, resulting in an index finger amputation.
An employee was backing up a dump trailer when it tipped over. The employee suffered broken ribs.
An employee was using a pressure washer when the fitting came off, causing the water to be injected under his skin.

An employee was performing maintenance and mechanical work at the concrete plant. A generator stopped working because it was overheated. The employee cooled the generator engine using a hose. The employee then lifted the radiator cap lever to release steam. After the steam was released, he opened the cap and pressurized hot water was released causing third degree burns to their wrist and second degree burns to their arm and chest.

An employee was in a manlift mounted on a forklift. When the manlift was raised, the employee's right hand was pinched between the lift bucket and a ceiling joist. The employee suffered a broken knuckle.
An employee was conducting a home visit and suffered an insect bite on her leg. She was hospitalized.
The injured employee was observing another employee raking out an electrical breakroom when an arc flash occurred that caused second degree burns on both arms and minor burns on the employee's face.
An employee was on the furnace gantry arm replacing a 1/2" water line. The employee sustained blisters and swelling in his throat due to lime dust exposure.

An employee was sharpening a long bolt with a grinding machine. The bolt slipped and the employee sustained lacerations to their ring and pinky finger as well as an open fracture and a nail bed injury.

On July 8, 2021, at approximately 3:20 AM, as an employee was stepping out of a control room located on the phosphate mine, he slipped on a surface that was wet due to rain, fell and fractured his left femur.

At approximately 3:38 PM, an employee got off his forklift and used a package knife to cut an air bag that was between loads. The load then shifted and a pallet of cable (800 lbs.) fell, pinning him against the side of the trailer and forcing him to the floor. The employee sustained a fracture to his back.

On July 8, 2021, an employee was on an extension ladder under the silo attempting to tighten a pin located on the inside of the silo. The employee was accessing the pin through a pocket door. The employee was startled and jumped off the ladder landing on a stabilizer bar below. The employee sustained broken ribs.

The injured employee had spilled some gas on his pant leg while handing a chop saw to a co-worker. The co-worker began to cut a piece of steel and a spark from the chop saw ignited the employee's pant leg. The employee was hospitalized for burns to the leg.
An employee was cleaning dough from the sheeter when their right hand was caught between the rollers. Their hand and fingers were crushed.
An employee was delivering parts in a customer's store when he tripped over a chair and fell to the floor sustaining a fractured hip.
An employee had been moving furniture and passed out in the company parking lot from dehydration and heat-related illness.
An employee on a fixed ladder platform tried to remove the top tote from a stack when they fell from the ladder to the ground, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee experienced a back strain while lifting a 25-pound box and placing it down.
While performing maintenance on a conveyor belt, an employee's hand was caught in a pinch point when the machine cycled. The employee suffered an amputation injury.

The injured employee was directing the excavator operator in the lifting of the boring rig from the boring pit. During the lift, the chains needed to be adjusted. As the employee adjusted the chains the boring rig slipped off its tracks and pinned him against the shoring box. The employee suffered a pelvic fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a ladder and fell two feet onto a metal walkway below. The employee sustained a fractured right femur and a fractured right arm.

A mechanic was using a prybar to remove a pin from the arm of an excavator that was being offloaded. The prybar slipped, striking the employee in the face. The employee sustained a severe laceration to the face and was hospitalized for surgery. The employee also lost the use of his right eye.
An employee was attaching a dolly to the back of a trailer. His left hand was caught and crushed between the dolly and the trailer. He was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading resin from a railcar. As the employee was pushing the lever to open the outside storage container at the bottom of the rail car, his left pinky finger was amputated.

On July 7, 2021, at approximately 5:30 p.m., an employee was parking a front-end loader after moving hot coils from production to shipping in a steel mill. While exiting the front-end loader, the rear wheel on the left side of the loader exploded, throwing the employee approximately 20 feet from the boarding platform. The employee was hospitalized with broken bones in both ankles.
An employee became dehydrated while finishing concrete. The employee felt weak and dizzy and became ill. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up the short path wiped film distillation machine and suffered a hand injury that resulted in an amputation to their left index finger.
An employee was standing on an 8-foot ladder drilling through block inside a house in order to run duct work. The employee fell to the ground and fractured their wrist.
An employee was pumping gas into a customer's car. The customer started to drive away and the employee was dragged a few feet resulting in a hip fracture.
An employee was installing pipes and ducts in an attic space. His elbow struck a metal frame and was injured.
An employee was descending a 6-foot ladder and missed the last step, causing the employee to fall to the ground and fracture his hip.
An employee was walking down from a platform. He missed a step and fell, breaking his left foot. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking though the warehouse and was struck by a forklift resulting in an open fracture of the right ankle. She was hospitalized.
An employee was performing work on a machine when the machine's cover fell onto his leg, resulting in a broken leg.
An employee was unloading a truck when a wood beam fell off the truck onto the employee's left leg and fractured it.

An employee was working on a stand-alone rig. The employee had just broken off the tubing swivel with the tongs and was preparing to make the last connection. He placed his left hand near the opening of the tongs to push the tongs off the connection, but the Kelly hose was caught on the back of the tongs. The employee used his right hand to push the Kelly hose out of the way. The hose caught the operating handle and engaged the tongs causing the amputation of his left index and middle fingers and an oblique fracture of his left thumb.
An employee was standing on top of a 9-foot concrete structure and fell to the ground below. The employee sustained a fractured leg.
An employee's right-hand glove was pinned by the vise clamp of a saw. The employee suffered an amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was using a machine to cut grating to size when the clamp on the machine amputated their thumb.
An employee was using a paper cutter and amputated the tip of their left thumb.
An employee was loading a flatbed trailer with material. The employee slipped and fell from the flatbed to the ground, suffering broken ribs and a forehead laceration.

An employee was operating the pulverizing machine in the Plastic Department. The employee used a computer to set up and adjust the temperature of the machine and was monitoring the machine for jams. As the employee was removing a jam, his left index and middle fingertips were amputated.

The employee was rigging a towing strap to a front-end loader to tow a truck out of the mud and onto matting. The front-end loader moved while the employee's thumb was between the vertical drop pin and the tow bar of the front-end loader, resulting in a partial thumb tip amputation.
An employee was setting up a machine when their foot got caught in a cord which caused the employee to fall to the ground and fracture their left hip.

On 7/9/2021, at approximately 2:15 p.m., an employee was attempting to leave their desk and got caught on the corner of the desk, causing a trip and fall. The employee fractured their left hip and was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee fell off a roof.

An employee was standing on steel floor plates. The floor plates shifted under the weight of a forklift as it backed over them. The employee lost balance; his left foot slid down and became trapped between floor plates with the weight of the forklift pushing on the plates. The employee sustained the amputation of two toes.
An employee was operating a front-end loader. The employee fell off the loader and fractured their tibia and fibula.
An employee was delivering mail and felt dizzy from inhaling the exhaust fumes from the delivery truck.
An employee was cleaning equipment when the star valve on the equipment amputated four fingers on the employee's left hand. The equipment was running at the time.

An employee was on a ladder that was leaning against a flag pole. As the employee was changing the rope on the flag pole, the pole shifted and the employee fell to the concrete below, resulting in a broken ankle, a fractured wrist, a knee injury, and a lower back injury.
An employee was flipping an I-beam when it landed on his left little finger and ring finger. The little fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating a plate machine. There was tape inside the machine and the employee tried to pull it out. The employee's finger was caught in the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On July 9, 2021, employees were operating a mobile conveyor belt to load sand into a silo. The conveyor was experiencing belt issues and was being replaced with a new conveyor. The injured employee was operating the conveyor to fold it up so that it could be transported when the conveyor struck an overhead electrical line. The resulting arc flash burned the employee's left hand fingers.

The injured employee was descending a fixed ladder in the base cone of a spheroidal design water tower. Another employee above him was lowering a plastic, 5-gallon bucket full of tools with a rope. The handle on the bucket broke and the bucket and its contents fell on the injured employee causing him to let go of the ladder and fall approximately 10-12 feet to the lower level. The injured employee sustained fractured vertebrae, a concussion, and lacerations to the face and head.
An employee was changing an airbag on a truck. He slipped and fell, suffering a dislocated elbow and a wound on his arm. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a pin from a portable track press. The pin struck the employee on the head causing a laceration.
An employee was grinding on a steel vertical stiffener when the grinder kicked back and contacted the employee's left index finger, resulting in a laceration that required surgery.

An employee was checking a flour return valve that was reported as out of position. The employee connected and disconnected the pneumatic air hose to the piston. The piston's reciprocating movement restarted and it struck the tip of the employee's right index finger, causing an amputation.

The employee was using a walk-behind saw to cut concrete. The saw produced a slurry and the employee slipped in the slurry and fell into a pit. The employee sustained head lacerations and bruised ribs.
An employee was installing insulation when they fell to the basement floor below, resulting in broken ribs.
An employee was in a scissor lift painting a ceiling. A wheel on the lift went into a depression on the concrete floor causing it to fall over. The employee suffered head and back injuries.
An employee tripped over a trash bag tied to her product-stocking cart. She fell and suffered a broken hip. She was hospitalized.

An employee was removing the bag from a lawn mower. When the employee attempted to clear some grass from the opening, the lawn mower blades made contact with three of the employee's fingers, resulting in amputations.
An employee was setting utility poles. A pole slipped and struck the employee's hard hat causing head and chest trauma.

An employee was driving a rear-property machine across a bridge over a river when the bridge collapsed and the machine and the employee fell 16 feet into the river below. The employee suffered a broken ankle and broken ribs.
An employee's thumb was pinched and lacerated while making adjustments to the shutter on a press machine.
An employee was delivering uniforms to a business when she slipped on a set of stairs and fell to the ground. She suffered a hematoma to the buttocks.
An employee was walking out of a patient's home and rolled her ankle, resulting in a fractured foot.
On July 9, 2021, a bar joist fell off the truck trailer and struck an employee working on the ground. The employee sustained a broken collarbone and two broken ribs.
An employee was closing a trailer door and fell off the back of the trailer onto the ground. The employee sustained a head laceration.

A smokejumper jumped out of a plane to fight the fire and got caught in a tree. The parachute let go and he fell to the ground. The employee sustained a pelvic injury, a broken tibia and a concussion.
An employee was loading a band saw when their left pinky finger was caught in the pneumatic clamp resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was emptying trash into a garbage truck. The sweeper blade grabbed his work glove and lacerated his ring finger.

An employee was delivering mail to a home. A dog attacked the employee causing the employee to fall and the dog latched onto the employee's hand. The employee sustained a hand injury and was hospitalized.
Two employees fought in a parking lot. One of them suffered eye injuries and broken bones.

On July 9, 2021, at approximately 11:15 a.m., an employee was aligning a belt on the press conveyor and attempted to remove a piece of rubber underneath the conveyor when their right middle finger was caught between the cylinder and the conveyor, resulting in amputation at the proximal phalanx. The conveyor was running at the time.

The injured employee was felling a tree. After the tree was down on the ground, the trunk shifted onto the employee's lower left leg knocking him down. The resulting impact caused fractures of the lower bones and ankle.
An employee was working outside assembling equipment in heat and humidity. The employee sustained heat-Illness/dehydration.
On July 9, 2021, an employee was staging a train of empty rolling carts when he lost his balance and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in a fractured right elbow.
An employee had been packing product and sustained heat stroke and dehydration.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. The forklift battery began to slide out of the battery compartment. As another forklift tried to lift the battery using a hoist attachment, the battery fell out onto the employee's left foot. Toes on the foot were amputated.
