An employee raised a pallet with his forklift in order to record information written on the pallet. While he was recording the information, the pallet slipped off the forklift's tines and crushed his finger. The finger was amputated.

An employee was working on an electrical power panel. Wires slipped out of the employee's hands and the device he was using to hold the wires, resulting in an arc flash. He suffered electrical burns to the hands, forearms, and neck and was hospitalized.
An employee was walking out of an elevator and twisted her ankle. The employee fell and broke her right ankle.
An employee was climbing a fixed ladder to access a raised mezzanine, slipped, and fell 8-12 feet to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a fractured leg.

An employee was spotting for a forklift that was transporting compressor cylinders. The cylinders slid off the forklift's forks, struck the employee, and pinned him against another cylinder on the floor. He suffered lacerations to the abdomen and face and was hospitalized.
An employee was observing forklift operations in the warehouse and was struck by a forklift, resulting in broken bones in their right foot.
An employee was cleaning a glue machine and amputated their left index finger.
An employee was clearing a jam using a push broom and fell approximately 11 ft. from an open door in the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a broken rib and a broken facial bone.

At about 8:00 a.m. on July 10, 2021, an employee was putting product into a brake press. The machine was engaged while his right hand was in the point of operation resulting in finger fractures. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee slipped and fell and hit their head on the floor.
An employee was operating a 9-head cutting machine and suffered a severe laceration to the right hand.

An employee was directing the track loader as it backed up. A half-inch double-braided polyester rope that being used to remove tree trunks broke and struck the employee resulting in a traumatic head injury and the loss of their left eye.
An employee was attempting to free a hydraulic line. When the coil tubing was freed it struck the employee in the head causing a skull fracture and a laceration that required stitches.
A forklift struck an employee, causing a broken left leg that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in a pellet mill. A portion of the mill was still cycling and the rollers caught the employee's right hand. The index finger was medically amputated.

An employee was driving an all terrain vehicle (ATV) to the driving range when he hit a patch of gravel that caused the ATV to overturn on top of him. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left ankle as well as lacerations and abrasions to his leg and forearm.
An employee tripped and fell while walking toward a building exit. The employee's knees and head struck the floor, causing a cracked left kneecap and a head contusion.
An employee was walking in an operating room when they slipped on liquid and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured right patella.
An employee was using a forklift to load a pallet and was backing away from the pallet when the forklift collided with another forklift. The employee suffered a leg injury.
An employee was using a handheld circular saw to cut a wooden stake when the blade contacted his left hand, resulting in the amputation a finger.

Two employees were loading concrete barriers into the bed of a dump truck using an excavator. The injured employee was in the bed of the dump truck when one of the barriers shifted and fell onto his left foot. His left foot was then caught between two barriers and sustained tendon damage.

An employee was unloading concrete from a ready-mix truck. The employee was leaning on the truck's fender and had a remote control for the truck in his hand. The pumper that he was feeding into made contact with an overhead power line; the employee suffered a whole-body shock.
An employee was cutting a panel on the sliding saw and cut their right middle and ring fingers.
An employee was touring the store, missed a step, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a hematoma.
An employee was removing a popsicle stick from a frozen treat machine when their glove was caught in the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation on the right hand.
An employee fell to the floor while walking and suffered an open fracture to the right wrist.

An employee was unloading packages from a container. Their foot was caught between the container and the bay door floor and the employee fell more than 4 feet. The employee sustained a fractured leg and ankle.
An employee was shrink wrapping a pallet for transport at the loading dock. When the employee stood up from a kneeling position, they felt a "pop" and experienced pain in their hip.
On 7/12/2021, at approximately 8:00 AM, an employee was walking in the plant, tripped on a corner of a pallet, and fell. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured left hip that required surgery.
An employee was loading a machine with product. The employee's right middle finger was caught in a nip area on a pulley, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

An employee was preparing to mix floor stripping product. The undiluted product spilled, then seeped into the employee's shoes. The employee suffered second- and third-degree chemical burns to the feet.

At about 9:35 a.m. on July 12, 2021, an employee was using a rebar bender. The machine actuated while the employee was holding a bar with two hands; its pin rotated, and the employee's fingers were caught between the pin and the rebar. The employee suffered fractures of fingers on the left hand and was hospitalized.

An employee was using a tool to clear a jam in the rotary cutter machine when the door on the machine closed on his left thumb resulting in a loss of flesh on the front of the thumb without bone loss.

An employee was welding a mild steel deflector onto a rail car dumper. The employee unhooked their lanyard to reach a welding rod and received an electrical shock. The employee fell 20 feet to the steel floor and was hospitalized for a fractured wrist and pelvis.
An employee was cleaning meat off a conveyor belt when his glove was caught under the belt, causing his finger to be pulled into the sprocket and resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was taking measurements on a rooftop and fell 9 feet to the ground. The employee sustained multiple broken bones.

An employee was carrying dirty laundry to a laundry room when the lid to the clothes basket came off and fell to the tiled floor. The employee slipped on the lid, fell forward, and suffered a broken lower tibia and contusions to the head and knees.
An employee sustained injuries from a fire that occurred at a wellhead.
An employee was changing a fan pulley when the fan blade injured their right index finger resulting in an amputation to the finger.
A crane inspector was inside the cab of a crane when the floor of the cab gave way and the employee fell 25 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained multiple broken bones.
An employee was guiding a customer's car to the conveyor system that guides the vehicle through the car wash. The car missed the conveyor and struck the employee who sustained a fractured hip.
An employee was operating a crank lift. The wheel of the dolly rolled over the employee's toe. The toe became infected and the employee was hospitalized for treatment.

An employee was assisting another truck driver with hooking his set of twin trailers. The employee was between trailers and was struck by the converter dolly. The employee sustained a fractured left foot/ankle requiring surgery.
An employee was riding a forklift and fell off. The forklift ran over both of their legs, resulting in crushing injuries.

An employee was changing the battery on a forklift using a mobile battery dolly. The employee positioned the dolly adjacent to the storage rack. The dolly began to roll backward when the employee was transferring the battery and the battery fell off the rack and onto the employee's left foot. Three toes were severely crushed resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was working with steel frames. He was cutting wires when the frames fell on him resulting in a fractured right femur and a fractured left leg. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was walking outside when their ankle turned, causing them to fall to the ground and sustain a broken left hip.

An employee was helping a customer at the self check out register and as she was walking away she tripped over the corner of the register and fell onto her right side. The employee sustained a fractured right hip and a right elbow laceration.
An employee slipped or tripped and fell on the floor, resulting in a fractured left hip.

An employee was standing on a 14-inch, 60-foot-long, 73-pound-per-foot H-pile lying on dunnage. A rough-terrain forklift was being used to move a 6-inch, 12-foot-long channel on its forks. The end of the channel clipped the end of the H-pile, causing it to roll off the dunnage and strike the employee's lower leg. The employee suffered fractures to the lower leg and ankle, with no open wounds.

On 7/13/2021, at approximately 4:55 PM, an employee was lifting a drain grate to remove a glove from the drain when the grate slipped and fell on his left hand causing the amputation of the left middle finger at the first joint behind the fingernail.
An employee was greasing a bearing with a grease gun when grease punctured the skin on his left middle finger, requiring surgery.
An employee was shoveling coal inside the conveyor room, got dizzy, and collapsed. The employee was hospitalized for heat stress.
Two employees were moving 60 lbs. boxes of beef in the freezer. One box fell on the injured employee's hand and amputated his thumb.
An employee was performing maintenance on a stretcher lever machine and received an electric shock (480 volts).

An employee was preparing to load a pallet on the dock and was checking the label on the pallet. The employee stepped on the edge of the skid and got caught on a piece of plastic wrap or tape and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained injuries to the right hip and leg.
An employee was conducting maintenance on a rotary microtome when the tip of their right little finger contacted the microtome blade, resulting in an amputation.
On July 13, 2021, an employee was on a ladder in the foyer changing a light bulb. The employee fell from the ladder and was hospitalized.

A tractor trailer driver climbed into the driver's seat of their truck, set down their lunch box and hat, and started to get back out of the truck to get some gloves. The employee fell to the ground and suffered a compound fracture to the wrist that required surgery.
An employee was walking in the kitchen, slipped on the wet floor, fell, and fractured their hip.
During the process of nipping down the well head, a flash fire occurred and an employee was burned on the face and neck.

An employee was on scaffolding and was using a broom to push an air duct out of the way for a clear view of a pallet on pallet racking. While pushing the air duct, the broom gave way and bent in half, causing the employee to lose balance and fall forward. The employee fell from the scaffold, roughly 5 feet, to the floor and sustained 8 broken ribs, a broken scapula, and a laceration that required staples. The employee was hospitalized.
On 7/13/2021, around 9:00 a.m., an employee was servicing a hydraulic motor when the table that it was welded to fell 2-3 feet from a crane and struck the employee's right leg, fracturing it.

An employee was moving a machine apparatus that weighed approximately 3,000 lbs. with a forklift. As the apparatus was lifted, it shifted and amputated the employee's left middle finger to the first knuckle.
An employee was climbing down a step ladder when she fell to the floor below, resulting in an injured knee.

An employee attempted to get a part out of a machine when their arm got caught in the machine, resulting in a crushing injury including a partially severed muscle and an injured tendon that required hospitalization.

On 7/13/2021, an employee was carrying a conveyor roller while walking backward on a catwalk. The employee missed a step while going down the stairs, causing the employee to fall backward. The roller came down onto the employee's fifth digit on the right hand crushing it against the catwalk decking and fracturing it.
An employee was taking a U-joint out of a dry shaft using an air hammer when fractured metal hit his left wrist, resulting in an injury.
An employee was erecting a scaffold and fell 24 feet through an opening in the scaffold. The employee sustained broken bones on the left arm and wrist and a hip injury.
On July 13, 2021, a concrete delivery driver was attaching the second chute to the mixer truck when the tip of his right index finger was pinched and amputated between the chute and the truck.
The injured employee was putting on skylight covers and fell 24 feet to the ground. The employee sustained a broken arm, leg, and pelvis. Fall protection was not connected at the time.

On July 13, 2021, an employee was drilling a hole for piping in a concrete wall using a core drill. The employee's gloves caught the shaft of the core drill causing a partial amputation to the left index finger and lacerations to the left middle and ring fingers.
An employee went to sit on a folding chair when his left ring finger got caught on the folding portion of the chair, resulting in a distal amputation.
On July 13, 2021, an employee was moving two 90 lbs. parts and pinched his left middle finger between the two parts resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was stepping over a 30" concrete parapet wall and lost balance. The employee fell back and to the side, striking their arm against a metal wall track that was mounted on the top section of the wall. The employee's left forearm was lacerated.

An employee was attempting to raise an oscillating motor when their left index, ring and little fingers became caught in the belt that rotated around the drive, resulting in an amputation of their left ring finger, including soft tissue loss.
An employee was repairing a broken torsion rod on a liftgate when the rod released and struck the employee's face. The employee sustained facial fractures and a broken nose and was hospitalized.

An employee was changing a bearing on a fly cutter and his left hand was caught in the point of operation when the machine cycled. The employee suffered a laceration from the dorsal side of his left forearm proximal to distal terminating at his metacarpal.
An employee was cutting laminated flooring with a portable table saw and amputated the tip of his left thumb.
An employee was using a cut-off saw to cut rebar when sparks from the saw caught the employee's clothes on fire. The employee sustained burns to the left side of his body.

An employee was troubleshooting a machine when the machine activated and pulled in their left hand. The employee sustained broken bones in their hand as well as a severe laceration that required stitches.

An employee was attempting to cut a groove in an 8-inch diameter HVAC pipe using a roll grooving tool when his hand slipped and the tip of his right index finger was crushed in the point of operation.

After moving machinery from a tractor trailer using a crane, employees were disassembling and stowing the crane. A steel spreader bar, used as rigging, was placed on the ground while the employees were stowing the crane. The spreader bar tipped over on uneven ground and struck an employee in the heel and fractured it.
An employee was testing an electrical transformer and sustained an electric shock and burns.
On July 14, 2021, at 3:15 p.m., an employee was loading a forklift onto a flatbed trailer. As he stepped off the forklift and onto the flatbed, he fell onto the asphalt and broke his femur.

An employee was assisting with installation of a pipe cutting machine. During the installation, the machine slipped off the pipe. The employee attempted to grab it and their right little finger was pinched between the machine and the ground, resulting in a partial amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was walking down stairs when they tripped and fell, resulting in a broken ankle.
An employee was operating a machine when his right hand contacted the belt/pulley assembly, resulting in the amputation of the distal 1/4 inch of his right ring finger.
On 7/14/2021, an employee dismounted a sit-down forklift and his right foot was then run over by the forklift, resulting in a right foot amputation.

An employee was preparing to straighten a photo proximity eye in a machine when their left index finger was pinched between a moving belt and a fixed component of the machine, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was conducting casting operations near the furnace and became ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was hanging overhead water lines while inside a forklift box attachment approximately 14 feet off the ground. The box attachment fell to the ground and the employee suffered broken ribs.

An employee was getting ready to enter the facility's external chlorine shed to clean up a broken light bulb when they began to experience shortness of breath due to chlorine exposure. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was setting up their work station for the day, slipped and hit their head on a nearby conveyor. The employee was hospitalized for an eye contusion and later lost their right eye.
An employee was hospitalized after being assaulted by another employee.

The injured employee was operating a forklift while another employee was backing a forklift out of a trailer. The backing forklift struck the injured employee's forklift. The injured employee's left foot was caught between the two forklifts and injured.

An employee was standing on a 10-inch step stool performing maintenance on a pickup truck engine when they fell off the step stool and landed on a wheeled tool chair. The employee suffered six fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was hopping down off a concrete platform outside the building and fell 2 feet to the ground, resulting in broken bones. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting wood on a table saw and amputated part of their thumb.

An employee was exiting a letter carrier vehicle when he tripped on the seat belt, causing him to fall and hit his head on the pavement. The employee suffered head swelling that required hospitalization.

An employee working at a loading dock entered the back of a truck. The truck pulled away causing the employee to fall out of the truck. The employee sustained a concussion, left forehead hematoma, broken left shoulder, and broken left heal.
An employee was on a portable ladder, installing a metal awning over a doorway. The employee fell from the ladder to the concrete ground, suffering a broken wrist.

Employees were pouring a culvert using a trackhoe. The injured employee was dumping a concrete bucket when the hydraulic line on the trackhoe failed causing the stick portion of the boom to release. The bucket struck the injured employee and he fell into a rocky bank and struck his head.
An employee was taking down a partition wall. The wall fell on the employee, injuring the employee's left knee.
An employee was feeding a chipper machine when a board slab shifted, hitting him and knocking him to the floor. He suffered contusions to the right shoulder and hip.

Employees were creating a joint in casing. When the employees reversed out the tongs, the tension in the casing pushed the tongs toward the injured employee. The injured employee's finger was pinched between the casing safety door and the tongs and their fingertip was amputated.
An employee was performing maintenance activities on a drive train when they were caught between a tensioner and a beam, resulting in fractured ribs and a fractured sternum.
An employee was riding on the tailgate of an off-road utility vehicle. The employee fell to the pavement and sustained a fractured skull.
An employee went to sit on a stool when the stool rolled out from under her, causing her to fall to the floor and resulting in a broken neck vertebra.
An employee was pumping a load of chocolate off a tanker. The dairy valve sucked in, injuring his right index and middle fingers and causing an amputation to a fingertip.
An employee was cutting a 15-inch concrete pipe with a 20-inch radial hand saw. The saw kicked back and deeply lacerated the employee's chest. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a circular pattern in cloth using an electric rotary cutter. The cloth got caught in the cutting tool's blade and the employee's hand was pulled into the tool. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee developed heat exhaustion while working in a blast container.

An employee was off loading ammonia solution at the plant when the connection at the pump truck came off and approximately 500 gallons of ammonia were spilled. The employee suffered chemical burns to the legs and feet due to the ammonia exposure.
An employee was delivering products to a store when they fell from the side of the trailer attached to the delivery truck, resulting in head injuries.
An employee was installing a splitter on a TV cable while on an A-frame ladder when he fell, resulting in a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee had been excavating and setting shoring for the excavation. He lost consciousness and was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee stepped on a nail in a parking lot. The wound became infected, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was manually lifting corrugated sheets off the production floor when she was struck by a moving T-car unit, resulting in a cut to the lower left leg above the ankle bone.
An employee was performing cleanup tasks on a casting machine when the machine started up, resulting in an amputation of his left pinky finger and part of his ring fingertip.

An employee was removing his tools from the basket of his bucket truck. When he turned to step down, he fell to the pavement and landed on his hip, resulting in a broken hip that required hospitalization.
An employee was starting a pit scraper machine. The employee's right middle finger was caught in the machine's belt and pulley system. The fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was sandblasting the external hull of a battleship. The blasting hose lost pressure because the blasting hose was under the tire of an aerial lift. The employee lowered the lift and tried to free the hose when it ruptured, causing a laceration to the employee's right arm.
An employee was in the basket of an aerial lift when blast grit from a co-worker's hose struck the employee's right upper arm, resulting in a severe laceration.

On 7/15/2021 at 9:00 a.m., an employee was traveling down a warehouse aisle on an electric pallet jack when a forklift struck the pallet jack at an aisle intersection. The employee was pinned to the pallet jack by the palletized materials on the forklift, resulting in leg fractures that required surgery.
An employee was leaning against a steel beam when the steel beam and the employee both fell approximately 5 feet to the ground. The employee suffered a fractured wrist.
An employee was driving a motorized pallet jack. The employee leapt from the pallet jack and his ankle was crushed and fractured between it and a shelf.

An employee attempted to remove a waste pan from a rack in the blanching area when the pan tipped and caught her finger between the pan and the rack. The employee's left middle fingertip was amputated.

The injured employee was changing a coil on a coil threader. As the employee walked toward the machine, his right leg contacted a compressed air line that was mounted to the side of the machine, causing him to fall toward drive rollers on the flex line coil threader. As he fell, his right hand entered the machine's point of operation. The employee suffered injuries that required the surgical amputation of the right index finger and ring finger, and a partial amputation of the right middle finger.
An employee was preparing to clean a chemical tanker when a pressure release occurred, spraying the employee with acrylic acid and resulting in chemical burns to their legs and abdomen.
An employee was on a ladder pulling cable through ceiling tile. The employee was descending the ladder, missed a rung, and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a back injury.
An employee was installing a beam when he fell about 15 feet along with the beam he was hooked up to, resulting in multiple broken bones and lacerations.
On July 15, 2021, an employee was operating a press when fingers on their left hand were amputated.

An employee was monitoring an automated onion bagging machine. The employee noticed a piece of scrap wood stuck in the staple machine. After he removed it, the machine cycled and a staple went through his left middle fingertip. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee slipped on water on the floor and hit her back, resulting in a back injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was unloading freight using an electric pallet jack. While backing up the pallet jack collided with a rack. The employee's arm and wrist were caught between the pallet jack handle and the metal rack, resulting in injuries.

On July 15, 2021, at 12:55 p.m., an employee stepped off a raised selection area onto a pallet in order to reach product when the pallet shifted, causing the employee to fall approximately 6.5 feet onto a pallet of product. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right arm.
An employee was opening semi-trailer doors when a bale fell against the door of the trailer and the door hit the employee, causing him to fall to the ground and sustain a fractured vertebra.
An employee was climbing down from a crane after loading it onto a lowboy trailer. He fell to the ground about 4 feet below and suffered a spiral fracture to the lower right leg.
On July 16, 2021, at approximately 1:50 p.m., a subcontractor employee was picking up trash when he was run over by a skid-steer loader, resulting in a broken right leg.
An employee tripped over a bag that was on the floor and fell, sustaining injuries to the leg and shoulder which required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was climbing down a ladder when it shifted, pinching the employee's little finger against the overhead water pipes and steel support braces. The finger was severely lacerated, resulting in an amputation below the knuckle.
An employee was lifting a patient when he began to feel abdominal pain and was hospitalized. The employee suffered a hernia.

An employee was putting wood under a 500-pound steel cutout that had been raised by a magnet crane. The cutout fell from the crane and hit the wood, which flew up and struck the employee in the face. The employee suffered a broken front jaw and several broken teeth.

An employee had replaced a hydraulic hose on a forklift and was removing the blocks when a block kicked out. The mast and forks came down and struck him in the right forearm, cutting and fracturing the forearm.
An employee was working in a farm field behind a piece equipment that puts plastic in the ground. The employee began to experience heat-related symptoms at the end of their shift.

An employee was inspecting a malfunction in the wire tie of a baler. The tension release bar engaged and caught the employee's right index fingertip resulting in an open fracture and partial amputation.
An employee was operating a compound utility loader. A truck struck him as it backed up, breaking his leg. He was hospitalized.
An employee was opening a trailer door when the trailer moved and the employee fell 51 inches to the ground below, resulting in a broken femur.
An employee was operating a press brake when it amputated the tip of his left ring finger.
An employee was in an aerial lift on a public road. A truck hit the lift basket and its ladder/ladder rack injured the employee's leg. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.

On July 16, 2021, an employee was moving a 3/4-inch metal plate with a crane onto a work skid when his left ring finger got caught between the load and the skid, resulting in a pinched fingertip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

A temporary employee was parking a stand-up forklift. He got off the forklift while it was still moving and the forklift pinned his left foot against a parked forklift. The employee sustained a broken foot requiring hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was trying to determine what was preventing an auger bit from setting in a Kelly bar when his finger was caught in a pinch point in the Kelly bar. He suffered a fingertip amputation.
On July 16, 2021, an employee tripped on a floor mat while entering the store. She fell and suffered a broken right thumb. She was hospitalized.
An employee was reaching up to turn on a fan in the outdoor register hut. She fell off a bucket and landed on the floor, resulting in a back injury that required hospitalization.

An employee was rolling a cart carrying used fryer oil. The handle broke and the cart fell to the ground. Hot oil got onto the employee, who suffered second-degree burns to the right ankle, left leg, and left arm.

An employee was operating a hydraulic press metal stamping machine when his left-hand fingers contacted the stamping die at the point of operation, resulting in a partial amputation of the left index finger.

An employee was operating a rigid cell brace punch machine when their left index finger was caught in the point of operation, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.
On July 16, 2021, an employee was operating a lift when his left hand was caught between the lift and a sort rail. He suffered a laceration and nerve damage to the hand and was hospitalized.
An employee was shredding plastic material when their middle finger was pulled into the shredder, resulting in amputation.

An employee was assisting co-workers with re-lining a steel ladle cover for a ladle that was approximately 12 feet by 14 feet. The ladle was attached to an overhead double girder bridge crane and was suspended off the floor. The ladle lid moved off the crane and landed on the employee's foot, resulting in broken bones.

An employee was drying off a small area of a roof that was being installed using a 1-pound butane torch when the fumes from the bonding adhesive ignited and the roof caught fire. The employee sustained second degree burns on 25 percent of his body.

Employees were on the roof to install a generator. The injured employee went into the attic and fell through the attic landing on a table and then falling to the floor. The employee sustained back injuries.

An employee was in the pit under a molding machine. The machine cycled, and the rotating loading plate struck the employee in the head. He was then caught between the loading plate and the loading grate when the machine moved to cycle again. The employee suffered internal crushing injuries to the upper body and head.
An employee was working from a ladder when it slid out from under him. He fell to the ground and suffered broken teeth and a fractures to the jaw, forearm, and thumb.

On July 16, 2021, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was standing on a truck's trailer adjusting a load of steel parts that were to be hauled to a scrap yard. The load shifted and the employee jumped off the trailer to the concrete approximately 4 to 5 feet below to avoid being injured by the shifting load. The employee suffered a fractured right heel and fractured left knee that required hospitalization.
An employee was waiting on a customer, turned and fell, resulting in a left hip fracture.
An employee was trying to clear a blockage in a drain pipe when the pipe's pneumatic valve cycled, resulting in a partial amputation of their right index fingertip.
An employee got up from their desk, tripped on the chair, and fell suffering a broken patella.
An employee tripped over equipment and fell to the floor, suffering facial and leg fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was detaching a 200-pound bale at or near an oil well site. He tripped on a rock and fell backward and the bale fell on his abdomen, causing internal bleeding.

An employee was removing slag from the walls of a receiver with a chipping hammer. The employee was caught between a hot metal carrier ladle and chisel bits and suffered a crushing injury to the torso that resulted in a lacerated liver. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was trying to pick up a roll of wire that had tipped over. The roll began to slip and caught the employee's left middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.

On 7/17/2021, at approximately 6:30 p.m., a temporary employee was operating a battery powered pallet jack. While walking backward, he tripped over the forks of a parked forklift. The pallet jack continued moving, rolling up onto his right leg and fracturing the ankle and foot. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a front-load garbage truck. The employee lowered the front forks on the truck and climbed them to clear debris. The employee then fell 8-9 feet and suffered fractured ribs and possible spinal injuries.

An employee was on a ladder clearing a conveyor belt. A large piece of material fell from the conveyor belt and struck the ladder causing the ladder and the employee to fall to the ground. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.
An employee was working with high pressure oil and sustained a high pressure wound under his left index finger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
An employee was performing maintenance outside when he began feeling lightheaded and disoriented. The employee later collapsed and was hospitalized for heat stress.
An employee slipped/tripped and fell to the floor, breaking her right arm.

An employee was on a ladder replacing a fan on an inverter and was shocked. The employee fell off the ladder approximately 2-3 feet to the ground. The employee sustained an electrical burn to the right hand and a fractured spine.

An employee was unclogging a blower machine that breaks down poly-cotton blend fibers. A cylinder inside the machine was still spinning and pulled the employee's right hand in. The right arm was amputated up to the elbow and the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was disconnecting a hot water hose from a trailer. Hot water burned the employee's right thigh and leg.

An employee was using a manlift to reach a platform and remove material from the infeed conveyor. As he stepped out of the manlift onto the platform he fell about 8 feet and landed on a pile of shredded metals. The employee suffered a C-5 vertebra fracture and was hospitalized.
An employee serviced a machine and upon restarting the machine, the cutting knife partially amputated the employee's fingertip.

An employee was working in a trench excavation. A section of the excavation began to collapse, and the employee's leg was struck and broken by the falling soil as he tried to get out. He was hospitalized.
An employee had placed a metal part on a parts table. The part then slid off the table and struck the employee's lower right leg causing a laceration that required hospitalization.

An employee was placing a large bulk bag that weighed approximately 1000 lbs. onto a pre-positioned pallet utilizing four eye rings attached to the bulk bag when his right thumb was caught between the forklift tine and the bulk bag ring resulting in a fingertip amputation.

There was a natural gas leak in the sewer line of a facility. An employee lit a cigarette, which ignited the natural gas and resulted in an explosion inside the store. The employee suffered burns and was hospitalized.

An employee was delivering a newspaper. The employee's car started rolling and the employee was run over by the car as he tried to stop it. The employee sustained a broken clavicle and a fractured left ankle.
An employee was positioning dough when a chain and sprocket under the reciprocator amputated his left ring fingertip.

An employee was poking material inside a storage bin to get it to flow. The employee fell about 4 feet and struck their ribs on the lid of a conveyor. The employee suffered three broken ribs and was hospitalized, required surgery.

An employee used a 20-pound dry chemical fire extinguisher to extinguish a fire under the furnace on a melt deck. The employee began to have trouble breathing and was hospitalized, suffering from smoke inhalation.
An employee was reconnecting an 80-foot pipe. The pipe pinched the employee's right ring finger, causing the amputation of the finger.

An employee slipped a separator over the end of the beam and was using a 10-ton overhead crane to lift the beam. As the employee was placing a wood block in place, the separator slipped off the end of the beam, and the beam fell onto the employee's left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a slicer to cut vegetables and amputated the tip of his right thumb.

An employee was preparing a boulder for demolition. The employee drilled the boulder in two places using a jackhammer and loaded the first hole with a charge. The charge was a dud so the employee flushed out the hole with pressurized water. The employee put gel into the second hole to expand and hold the charge. The second charge was also a dud. The employee flushed the second hole with pressurized water, releasing both charges. The employee drilled another hole and an unknown charge released, causing debris to go into the employee's face and arms. The employee was hospitalized.
While walking in the back hallway behind the bakery, an employee slipped on a grape and fell, suffering a broken right leg and a knee injury. The employee was hospitalized, requiring knee surgery.

An employee was on a section of an extension ladder, installing caulking in a wall approximately 8 to 10 feet from the floor level. The ladder slipped away from the wall and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken right arm requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was trying to dislodge a part jammed on a conveyor. The conveyor caught the employee's glove and pulled in the employee's left hand, causing fractures to the index and ring fingers and amputating the middle finger.
An employee was preparing to vaccinate sows using a needle-free injection gun. The gun engaged and injected the employee's left palm. The employee experienced an allergic reaction.
An employee was cleaning floors, tripped, and fell backward resulting in a head injury.
An employee slipped and fell while descending a ladder. The employee landed on the ground about 3 feet below, suffering a dislocated ankle and a broken lower leg.

An employee had a long screw auger set on pipe stands approximately 4 feet from the ground. One of the pipe stands tipped as he was adjusting the auger, causing the auger to fall onto his foot and fracture it.
An employee was bitten on the right hand by a dog while checking in the dog for an exam. The employee required surgery and hospitalization.

A piece of material had become stuck in a machine. Two employees were working to deactivate the machine and remove the struck piece; as one employee removed the piece, the machine activated and broke the other employee's leg.
An employee was working with precast forms. A form was lowered and struck the employee's left hand, dislocating and lacerating his knuckle. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a pressure washer to clean the floor of a food truck. Pressurized water struck the employee's leg, causing a 1-inch laceration.
On 7/19/2021, an employee had been sampling vegetation when they began to experience symptoms of heat stress and dehydration afterwards, resulting in hospitalization.

An employee was driving an industrial yard truck to move semi-trailers in the yard. He was hooking the airlines of a trailer with his foot on a step when he lost his footing and fell off the side of the truck, about 36 inches, onto the asphalt/concrete ground. The employee stuck his head on the asphalt/concrete and suffered a brain bleed as well as cuts and scratches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking, slipped on wet slurry, fell, and broke his femur.
An employee was loading boxes onto a truck when they fell from the ramp and struck the edge of the semi-trailer. The employee sustained fractured ribs.
On July 19, 2021, an employee was working on the clean-in-place (CIP) system and was burned on the chest, stomach, arm, and leg by pressurized hot liquid.

An employee was loading lumber and gusset plates into a splicer machine which presses the plates into the lumber to connect them. The employee's forearm was caught in the point of operation when the machine started, resulting in a fractured and lacerated right forearm.
An employee was holding wood down on a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's left thumb.

An employee was trying to manually untangle wire from a rack when the coil of wire became unsteady and fell toward employee. The employee fell to the concrete floor and the coil fell on their lower body. The employee sustained a fractured hip.

An employee was moving a motor vehicle in the company parking lot. The employee exited the vehicle, slipped on the ground that was wet from the rain, and fell between the open vehicle door and the door frame. The vehicle began to roll backward, dragging the injured employee. The employee sustained injuries to the knee, elbow and side.

At about 11:30 a.m. on July 19, 2021, an employee was on a ladder when the ladder slipped out at the bottom. The employee fell to the concrete 5 or 6 feet below, landing on their right side and suffering fractures to the right foot and shoulder. The employee was hospitalized.

A employee had pulled a rope out of a chipper. He laid the rope on the ground and then picked up a pile to place in the chipper. The rope also went into the chipper, while wrapped around the employee's leg. As the rope was pulled into the chipper, the employee sustained rope burns and bruising.
An employee was moving a section of PVC pipe to a pipe rack when their left hand was caught and crushed between the section of pipe and the rack.
At about 12:00 a.m. on July 19, 2021, an employee had just cut through an aluminum part on a bandsaw when the blade lacerated the employee's right little fingertip.

An employee was bent over checking spill buckets at the fuel station and was struck by a pickup truck. The employee sustained lacerations on the ear and head, a broken finger, and an abdominal injury.
An employee tripped over a portable wall partition and fell to the ground, suffering a head injury and a broken arm that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was setting the 5th wheel onto a truck body. A hoist moved and its hook caught on the 5th wheel. The employee's left index finger was caught in a bolt hole and the fingertip was amputated just below the nailbed.

An employee was performing maintenance on a load cell. Their right hand was on an RPM sensor of rotating weights when the pump jack cycled on, resulting in amputation of three fingertips on the employee's right hand.
An employee was moving a part on a rolling rack. The employee grabbed a piece that was hanging. The jig then fell and lacerated the employee's arm.

On July 20, 2021, an employee was using a jig to grind metal rods. As the employee was removing a part from the jig, the jig pinched the employee's gloved, right index fingertip. The employee suffered an amputation to the fingertip.

A winch on a waste collection vehicle was reeling in cable. An employee's left hand was caught between the cable and the vehicle; the employee suffered three broken bones and a laceration to the hand.
Employees were standing outside when a drive-by shooting occurred. Three employees sustained gunshot wounds.

A crew, working for Red Diamond Energy Services, was laying down 2 7/8-inch tubing. The employee on the floor would unlatch the elevators slightly above the floor. The joint would bounce and the employee on the ground would grab and slide the tubing down the rack. While the 29th joint was being laid down, the employee's right ring finger was crushed between the tubing and the floor as the joint bounced resulting in amputation.
A temporary employee was using a blasting pressure hose with chemicals in the pulp area when the hose hit their left side on the upper back and left armpit area causing a laceration.
On July 20, 2021, an employee was operating a grommet machine when it cycled and caused an amputation to the employee's thumb.
An employee was assisting with installation of fiber optic conduit pipe when he tripped and fell into a trench.

An employee used a safety cage with a gangway stair that is attached to an overhead catwalk and lowered onto the tanker truck to disconnect a hose on top of the tanker and close the tanker. The truck started moving back while the employee was on top of the truck and her legs were caught between the tanker trailer and the lowered gangway stair. The employee suffered two broken bones in the right leg, a fractured left leg, and a fractured spine.

An employee was assisting a new employee when her right hand was caught in the powered conveyor rollers resulting in a friction burn and internal damage that required surgery to her right ring finger.
An employee was using a water hose to cool down a forklift's radiator. The radiator discharged steam and hot radiator fluid onto the employee, who was burned.
An employee was driving a forklift in the parking lot and went over a metal grate that caused him to fall out of the forklift. His left foot was run over by the forklift and injured.
An employee was operating an air lock while repairing a BMO system when their right index finger contacted the air lock, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating an unloaded forklift on a paved surface outside of the building to return the forklift to the parking lot. When the forklift turned, it tipped over and the employee, who was wearing a seatbelt, remained in the seat with one leg turned up under him and the other behind him as he faced the ground. His left foot and right leg were fractured.
An employee developed heat stress/dehydration and collapsed while moving household furniture.

On July 20, 2021, an employee was rolling and cutting galvanized sheet metal using a crimp and beading machine. As the sheet metal was feeding into the machine, the sharp edge of the sheet metal cut her left middle finger resulting in medical amputation.

An employee was lowering machinery into a vat of caustic chemical using an electric hoist and crane. An I-bolt (screwed into the heavy machinery and also being held by the hoist) broke, and the machinery dropped into the vat. Caustic splashed the employee's clothing, who suffered burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was pulling a box off a pallet and fell to the ground. The employee sustained fractures to the right femur and tailbone.

An employee was loading a roll onto a lathe. The employee's right hand was caught between a piece of equipment and the chuck jaw of the lathe. The employee suffered an amputation to the little finger.

An employee was loading his catering truck when he fell off the back of the truck and hit his head on the sidewalk, resulting in a concussion and a laceration on the back of the head that required hospitalization.

On July 20, 2021, at approximately 8:00 a.m., an employee was on a 6-foot high rolling platform ladder hanging 10-foot metal hooks on a chain. The employee was hanging a hook when one of the hook ends got caught in the handrail of the rolling platform ladder and tipped it over. The employee fell to the concrete floor and sustained a contusion to their side.
An employee was helping close a vault door. The door caught her left hand and severely lacerated her middle and index fingers.
An employee was moving upper booms when their right hand was caught in a pinch point between the hoist hook and the lifting attachment, resulting in a partial amputation of their thumb.
An employee was using a powered pallet jack to unload a trailer. As the pallet jack reversed, it pinched his foot against another, parked pallet jack. He suffered a broken blood vessel.

An employee was trying to put the strap on the quick-connect on a bucket excavator so it could pull a pipe out of the ground. As he was trying to connect with a pin, the pin slipped out and his finger slipped into the pinhole. He suffered amputations to the right ring finger down to the knuckle, as well as the tip of the middle finger.
A cook was working in the kitchen, slipped on some food debris on the floor, and fell breaking a hip.

An employee was transferring potassium hydroxide (50-70%) from an IBC tote into a blending tank using a pneumatic double diaphragm pump in the transfer area at the facility. The hose disconnected during the transfer and potassium hydroxide (caustic potash) caused chemical burns on the employee's face, neck, and upper torso. The employee was hospitalized.

Employees were screwing a running tool into a wellhead assembly. The injured employee's finger was in the wellhead assembly checking alignment when the assembly was manually rotated and the running tool amputated the employee's left index fingertip.

An employee was trotting down the shoulder of a roadway along side the garbage collection truck. As the truck approached a home that had trash out for collection, the employee moved toward the moving truck to retrieve his work gloves. As he reached for the work gloves, his right foot was positioned behind the rear outer dual tire which struck his ankle and fractured it.
An employee was performing maintenance on an air compressor when their finger was caught in the belt and pulley resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On July 20, 2021, during a scheduled break time, a technical assembly employee went to kneel on the bench of an outside picnic table, missed the bench, and struck her knee against the concrete ground surface, resulting in a broken left hip. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee was dumping a rear load container into a residential garbage truck when their hand was crushed by the cable on the rear load truck.

An employee was calibrating elevated refrigeration probes while inside a cage about 15 to 20 feet off the ground, chained and padlocked to the forks of a forklift. The forklift backed into a safety bollard. The cage broke free as the chains and padlock snapped. It fell to the ground and the employee suffered a broken back with spinal cord damage.

A temporary employee was in the warehouse standing next to his electric pallet jack and stacking cases of soda onto his pallet when he was struck by another pallet jack, resulting in a fractured left fibula.

An employee was working in an isolated, de-energized section of a switch gear. The metal wall on one side of the section made contact with an energized terminal. In the resulting arc flash, the employee suffered burns to the upper back and neck.
An employee's hand was between the plates of a stopped 60-ton press. The machine engaged and severely injured two fingers on the employee's left hand, crushing one and amputating the other.

On July 20, 2021, an employee was operating a 60-ton mechanical power press when their right hand was caught in the point of operation resulting in amputation injuries to two fingers and a crushing injury to another finger.

Employees were adjusting the length of a spreader bar on rigging. The spreader collapsed and the injured employee's left middle finger was pulled into the spreader, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was performing preventive maintenance on a blower motor. The belt on the pulley amputated the pad of the employee's right middle finger without bone loss.

A temporary employee was training on a stand-up forklift. The forklift spun and pinned the employee's left leg against some racking, and he struck his head against the racking. The forklift then ran over his left foot, crushing the ankle and resulting in an amputated foot.
On July 20, 2021, an employee was climbing an 8-foot step ladder when he missed a rung and fell to the floor. He was admitted to the hospital for fractured ribs and a back injury.
An employee was moving a ladle of molten metal by monorail tractor when molten metal spilled onto his leg, causing third degree burns to his foot.

An employee made lumber adjustments and got onto a forklift when they noticed more adjustments were needed. The employee leaned forward while on the forklift when a lever caused the lumber to move, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee suffered a hernia while picking up a package for delivery.
An employee was in a non-climate-controlled building, applying packaging material to furniture in preparation for shipment. The employee developed a possible heat-related illness.
An employee was installing a ground rod. The employee slipped and the ground rod struck his throat.

An employee was working on a motor condenser when he received an electrical shock, knocking him backward and resulting in a dislocated shoulder. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time of the incident.

An employee was assisting with staging a conveyor to install a new conveyor belt. As the new conveyor belt roll was being lowered to a stand, the employee was removing the roll straps. The straps amputated the employee's left index and middle fingers to the first digit.
An employee experienced first and possibly second degree burns to his back and shoulders when a machine that cooks beans overflowed and splashed him with hot water. The employee was hospitalized.

A mechanic was on top of the HHP in Bay 1 drilling out broken bolts. Another operator was running the overhead crane using a handheld remote, moving it from the south side of the HHP to the north side to pick up a fluid end. As the crane moved over the top of the HHP, it struck the mechanic, knocking him off the HHP onto the cement floor of the shop 13 feet below. The injured employee was hospitalized for broken ribs, a sprained wrist and stitches to the face.
An employee was on a ladder changing letters on the outdoor sign. The ladder shifted and the employee fell to the ground resulting in a fractured ankle that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee tripped on the corner of her desk while getting up. She fell to the floor, suffering a displaced fracture to the right hip.
A driver exited their van to make a delivery. The van began to roll away and as the employee attempted to stop it, a wheel ran over his foot and fractured toes.

A maintenance employee was replacing a roller adjuster on a piece of equipment and was attempting to remove a bearing from the left side of a solid steel shaft. The right end of the shaft slipped out of its bearing and dropped suddenly. The left end of the shaft then moved in an upward direction and pinched his left thumb between the bearing and the machine frame, resulting in amputation of the fingertip and nail.
An employee was working on a roll bagger machine and suffered a partial amputation of their thumb.
An employee was filling bait boxes and tracking moles at customer sites. The employee began suffering dizziness and tunnel vision and was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration/heat stress.
An employee was troubleshooting a voltage switch on an elevator. His thumb was caught in a belt, resulting in an amputation.
An employee stepped onto a mason scaffold that collapsed. The employee fell with the scaffold, sustaining a head laceration, and fractures to the ribs, clavicle, and thumb.
An employee was pointing to a part of a machine. His right index finger was caught by tubing that was into the machine to be processed. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was taking out trash when he slipped and fell to the floor causing a right hip fracture.
An employee was in a warehouse, positioning dunnage in a container for incoming 1,400-pound plywood bundles. A bundle pinned his left leg, breaking the femur.

On July 21, 2021, an employee was feeding reclaimed lumber into a wood jointer when his left ring finger contacted the machine's rotating cutter head, resulting in an amputation above the top knuckle.
An employee was troubleshooting a vertical stamp press when their right hand was caught in the press, resulting in severe injury to three fingers.
On July 21, 2021, an employee fell about 7 feet from a sifter in a mill. She suffered three broken ribs and a collapsed lung and was hospitalized.
An employee's hand was caught in the blades of a wall-mounted fan that pulled air out of a building. The employee suffered amputations to two fingers.
An employee was performing maintenance and repair work on a boat. When the boat was started up, it caught fire and exploded. The employee suffered second-degree burns to the face, hands, and legs.

The injured employee was installing pallet stops on the floor using an impact wrench. A scissor lift moved and the tire caught the employee's pant leg and pinned his leg under the tire, resulting in a compound fracture of the left leg.
An employee was cutting a 2 x 4 on edge using a table saw. The push stick he was using broke and his left thumb slipped into the saw blade. Three-quarters of the thumb was amputated.
An employee was delivering a certified letter and was attacked by a dog. The employee sustained bites to the leg and arm that requires stitches and hospitalization.
An employee was in a restaurant attic running printer cable. He fell through the ceiling onto the restaurant floor. He suffered a concussion and a broken arm and was hospitalized.
An employee was working at a demolition site. A steel beam struck the employee's lower right leg, breaking it.
An employee was walking the grounds toward the guard shack and was bitten by an unknown insect (possibly a spider) and suffered severe stinging, discoloration, and swelling in his left ring finger.
An employee's face was burned by asphalt mixture. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was laying sheet metal decking at a roof elevation. He fell from the roof to a slab of concrete, suffering broken ribs and a broken pelvis.
An employee was in a guardhouse when an insect stung/bit him. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a banding machine when it injured his left little finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.

On July 22, 2021, an employee was doing underground electrical work. After beginning work at 8:00 a.m. and taking a lunch break at 11:30, he became ill at about 2:00 p.m. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.

An employee was walking on the main wooden beam inside the attic of a newly built one-story house. When he stepped onto the cross member beam, it gave way. He lost his balance, hit an extension ladder, and fell 10 feet to the concrete floor in the garage. He suffered a broken tailbone and was hospitalized.

An employee fell from a Baker scaffold while it was being moved, landing on the concrete floor about 6 feet below (and on a tool belt, tape measure, and tool belt hook). The employee suffered a broken left leg.
An employee was herding cattle with a utility terrain vehicle. The vehicle rolled over and the employee suffered a fracture and puncture wound to the leg.

At about 3:45 p.m. on July 22, 2021, an employee became ill during a scheduled break from working at a resort attraction's outdoor guest services kiosk. At about 5:10 p.m., the employee was found lying semiconscious next to a vehicle in the parking lot. He was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat-related illness.

An employee was descending a pole after performing trimming activities when he kicked his 20-inch pole saw and the saw began to fall. The employee attempted to catch the pole while it was falling and the blade lacerated the webbing of his right hand between the index finger and thumb.
An employee was installing fascia with a drill while standing 4 feet above the ground on a fiberglass ladder when they fell onto the concrete below and suffered a broken right wrist.

An employee was installing a new belt on the grinder machine. As he was manually rotating the pulley wheels to align the new belt, his right index finger was caught between the belt and one of the wheels resulting in a fingertip amputation.

A Spectrum employee was installing a coaxial cable line through a suspended ceiling. He was using a 6-foot A-frame ladder to access the ceiling near a wall to run glow rods through to the next room. The glow rods became stuck in the ceiling; as he tried to free them, he lost his balance and fell to the floor about 5 feet below. He suffered injuries to the right arm and ribs.
An employee was walking in the warehouse and lacerated his leg on a piece of metal banding.
An employee tripped on the metal webbing of a set of bleachers. The employee fell, suffering a broken left ankle, and was hospitalized.

Employees were fighting wildfires when the wind changed and blew the fire back onto the firefighters. The employees sustained multiple burn injuries and one firefighter was run over by a UTV while trying to escape the flames.
An employee was shot while on break.
An employee was struck by a forklift that was backing up out of a trailer, resulting in a broken ankle and injured knee that required hospitalization.
An employee was climbing down a ladder from a roof. The ladder slipped out and the employee fell to the ground, suffering a broken L4 vertebra.
An employee was breaking down a malformed bottle with a box cutter. The box cutter slipped and amputated the side of the employee's left thumb.
An employee was making repairs on a dryer when a come-a-long chain holding a 250-pound diagonal brace broke. The brace fell and struck the employee's foot, fracturing it.

An employee was clearing jammed material from a pelletizer with a rotating cutter. As he was removing uncut strands of acrylic from the guide tray, his left index finger was pinched between the two feed rolls of the pelletizer. The rotor blade then cut his finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.
An employee was using a saw to cut a wind turbine blade for recycling. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's upper right chest.

An employee was using a metal rod to dislodge a grain blockage from the outside of a grain bin withdraw chute. When the blockage cleared, the rod twisted down and contacted the drag conveyor below. The rod was then pushed against the chute and pinched the employee's hand resulting in amputation of the ring finger and a contusion on the middle finger.
An employee was walking from the third floor to the fifth floor to put materials into a bin. He slipped and fell on steps, suffering two jaw fractures and a shattered chin.
A dog attacked a mail carrier, who fell backward to the ground while defending herself. She suffered a hairline fracture to the back.

A temporary employee was cutting IBC bags of barite into a metal hopper to unload product. The employee's left hand was on the edge of the hopper as a forklift approached with a bag. The employee's pinky finger was caught between the hopper and the bag resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee fell from a portable ladder to the ground, suffering multiple fractures.
An employee was moving a pallet jack when his foot got caught up in the wooden pallet, causing him to fall to the floor.
An employee was shoveling dust and water around a baghouse. As the employee tried to clear a clog in a drain hole, an auger grabbed his right glove, amputating the middle finger at the first joint.
An employee was standing on a plastic pipe, checking a secondary pipe print line. The pipe rolled back on top of the employee, who was pinned to the pipe stack and suffered a broken right femur.
A roll stock packaging machine was started as an employee was unjamming it. A cross-cut blade on the machine amputated the employee's left index finger.
An employee was using a transmission jack to lift a transmission. The jack lacerated a finger on the employee's left hand.
An employee fell down in a parking lot, suffering face and elbow contusions.

An employee was carrying out a diamond wire cutting process on a tank. When the employee pulled on the diamond wire cable, his right ring finger was pinched between it and the pulley. The finger was amputated to the last knuckle.
An employee was using a forklift to stack tires for loading. The employee set a tire in place and got off the forklift; the tire then fell on him, breaking his leg.
An employee was welding on an empty hydraulic tank. A flash occurred and the employee sustained second and third degree burns to the neck and arms.

A temporary employee was standing on a conveyor when an alarm went off, signaling that a shredder was about to start up. The employee, startled, rolled off the conveyor and fell to the ground about 8-10 feet below. He suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee removed a flag pin to replace a hydraulic cylinder during servicing of a loader. An employee was driving a ride-on forklift. The employee had to swerve to avoid another powered industrial vehicle and her right foot was caught between the two vehicles and broken.

An employee was wrapping finished rolls of paper when their right leg became caught in a gap between the platform and the wrap machine's roller, resulting in fractures to their lower right leg and ankle.
An employee was operating a core machine, removing the core from the core box. The top part of the core box (cope) struck the employee in the left leg, breaking the employee's tibia.

An employee was driving a front-end loader from one yard to another when the engine shut off, leaving him with no power to control it. He jumped clear of the loader and broke his left leg when he hit the ground.

At about 6:00 p.m. on July 23, 2021, an employee was using a forklift to empty a pellet hopper into a roll-off box. An employee was moving a concrete block off a sorting line and into a bunker. The concrete block was positioned on top of a 5-gallon bucket. An employee felt ill after his shift and was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
An employee slipped on some plastic banding and fell, suffering a head injury.
An employee was tending residents as they ate breakfast. One of the residents grabbed the employee's hand and bit off the top part of her thumb. The employee was hospitalized.

A docking block partially released as it was being hoisted. It struck an employee and knocked him off an A-frame ladder to the ground. He suffered right leg, arm, and abdomen injuries from the block and the fall.
An employee was standing on a trailer adjusting its load. A piece of equipment shifted, causing the employee to fall to the ground and strike his head. He suffered head trauma.
An employee was changing a belt on a ventilation fan when he lost balance and contacted the blades of an adjacent fan. He sustained lacerations to the left hand and wrist.

Two employees were trying to get a cardboard sheet from behind 24 pieces of cold-rolled steel sheets that were leaning against a wall. An employee was holding plywood form work while another employee was using a wrecking bar. The plywood form struck the employee's right middle finger, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift. As it turned, his left middle finger was caught between the upright to its overhead guard and a pallet on a rack. The finger was amputated.
An employee was moving metal coils on a cart. The cart tipped and the coils fell off, breaking the employee's leg.
Two employees were retrieving plastic grocery bags. One employee slipped on some bags that had fallen to the floor, fell, and suffered a broken hip.
An employee was monitoring a machine during a plastic manufacturing process. The machine released formaldehyde into the work area and the employee suffered an irritated mouth, nose, and throat.
A substation employee was removing bolts from a recloser bushing. The employee's hand made contact with an energized wire, causing electrical burns to the employee's hand and leg.

The injured employee was standing on the left side of his pallet jack applying stickers to it. A co-worker was operating a pallet jack in the same area. The co-worker was moving to pick up a pallet and the equipment jerked to the left and struck the injured employee's left foot and ankle, pinning them to the pallet jack. The employee's foot and ankle were fractured.

An employee was delivering a package to a residence when he tripped over a large boulder in the yard, resulting in a fractured left knee.

An employee was on a break after working on a vehicle. When the employee lit a cigarette, brake cleaner on the employee's hands caused the employee's gloves to ignite. The employee's hands were burned.

On July 24, 2021, at 4:15 p.m., an employee and a co-worker were verifying prior work done on a machine. An employee was struck by a forklift and suffered a broken foot.
An employee fell from a multi-level mobile scaffold to the concrete floor. The employee suffered a broken leg/ankle.

An employee was operating a yard truck to pull a trailer when the yard truck blew two tires. The truck lunged forward and the employee was hospitalized with injuries to the rib cage from the seat belt.
At about 8:55 a.m. on July 24, 2021, a border patrol agent suffered multiple bee stings and was hospitalized.
A meat hook trolley fell, catching an employee's hand on a tray. The employee's right little fingertip was amputated.

Two employees were washing a semi-truck on a wash pad in a yard. Near the end of the job, the truck was moved ahead about 30 feet while one of the employees was still on it. An employee tripped on a crack on the concrete pavement of a courtyard. She fell, breaking her left hip and suffering a contusion.
An employee got off a forklift he had been operating. The forklift rolled back onto him, pinning and breaking his leg.

Three employees were walking through trusses on top of a roof when one of the trusses collapsed and the employees fell 20 feet to the ground. One employee suffered a fractured lower right leg and another employee suffered internal bleeding.

An employee was cleaning the contacts of the tie bar inside a 480V switchgear and suffered burns from an arc flash. The employee received third degree burns to his arm and first degree burns to his face.
An employee was cleaning a printing press. The press rollers caught the employee's right hand and degloved it.
An employee was standing at a roller conveyor when it started up. The employee's gloved hand was caught in a roller. The employee suffered a degloving injury and was hospitalized.
At 4:34 p.m. on July 25, 2021, a customer shoved a store employee to the floor, injuring the employee's hip. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was climbing out of a containment basin after closing a valve on a sodium hydroxide tank. The legs of his chemical protective suit slid up, allowing a small amount of sodium hydroxide solution to run down his legs and burn them.

An employee was working on a platform. As he turned to get a tool, he stepped into an open hole, fell partly through an open pass-through gate and struck the platform. He caught himself on the ladder and the platform, but suffered two fractured ribs and a punctured lung.
An employee got off an electric pallet jack as it was coming to a stop. The pallet jack injured the employee's right foot.
An employee was moving a 55-gallon drum. A rotary valve lacerated the employee's left index and middle fingers resulting in a partial amputation.
An employee was carrying a 2.5-gallon bucket up some stairs. He fell, and the chemical in the bucket spilled onto his upper torso and face causing chemical burns.
A forklift struck an employee, who suffered multiple contusions to the entire body.

On 7/26/2021 at 1:08 p.m., an employee entered a customer's residence to investigate a natural gas odor. The house exploded and the employee sustained burns to their hands, arms, chest, and face that required hospitalization.

An employee was using an overhead crane when its hook got caught on the bed of a hydraulic press. When the crane was being lowered, the hook slipped, struck the employee's left arm, and broke it. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was cleaning a board with a hand-held circular saw. The board slipped and the saw amputated part of the employee's left ring finger.

On July 26, 2021, an employee was hydroblasting using a 5,500 psi water blast gun with a 66-inch barrel. The barrel was run across the top of his left boot, lacerating the top of the foot. He was hospitalized, requiring cleaning and stitches for the wound.
An employee was in the back of a truck when they fell to the ground, resulting in multiple injuries.
An employee was reaching for a timing belt that was on the peg board when they fell off a 14-inch-tall cabinet and suffered a broken left hip.
While cooking in a daycare center kitchen, an employee developed exhaustion, sweating, and shortness of breath. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee lost consciousness due to heat, fell to the floor, and suffered a broken elbow.
An employee was spray-painting a square iron beam when it rolled onto the employee's right wrist, causing a severe cut to the wrist.
An employee was reaching out to place merchandise on shelves. His middle and ring fingers got caught on a shelf and both fingertips were amputated.
An employee was cleaning a paint spray gun. The gun activated and injected paint thinner into the employee's left little finger.
An employee lost her balance while riding an escalator and fell to the floor, suffering four broken ribs and a brain bleed.
An employee was working on a two-tier frame scaffold when they fell to the ground, resulting in a laceration to the middle and back of the head.

An employee was operating an automated drill and rivet machine and was getting the machine lined up against the crossmember on the trailer side. As the employee was feeling for the crossmember, the machine cycled and the stability bar engaged, resulting in amputation of their index fingertip. The machine was guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee was trying to clean a roller with a spud hoe. The hoe struck the employee, lacerating his face and breaking two ribs.

On July 26, 2021, an employee was on the riding step of a garbage truck picking up garbage on a dirt road. The truck got close to a tree, knocking the employee off the riding step and resulting in bruising on his left thigh that required hospitalization.
On July 26, 2021, an employee became ill after a hot, humid day spent preparing aluminum fishing boats to be painted. She was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

After carrying a suitcase generator (weighing 45-50 pounds) from a tower to a substation about 125 feet away, an employee felt hot, collapsed, and was hospitalized, suffering from possible heat exhaustion/heat stress.

An employee removed a weld mint (welded part) from an A-frame cart using a hoist and proceeded to maneuver the part onto a pallet for packaging. The employee's finger got pinched between the hoist hook and the part. The employee sustained an amputation.

On July 23, 2021, an employee was descending from a tanker trailer ladder in heavy rain. He slipped and turned his ankle on a curb, suffering fractures to the ankle and the lower leg. He was hospitalized.

At about 7:40 a.m. on July 26, 2021, an employee was settling a bundle of four pieces of square tubing onto a workbench when the tubing shifted and slid onto his left hand and index finger. The finger was pinched and crushed between the tubing and a piece of channel on the workbench, causing an amputation to the fingertip above the nailbed.
An employee was climbing down a ladder. The employee fell, landing on the ground about 12 feet below.

An employee and co-workers were working on taking a cable up a grain leg so they could re-install the belting and buckets for the leg. While turning the drum on the grain leg with his right hand, the employee's left hand was caught between the pulley and the belts on the reducer, resulting in amputation of his little fingertip.
An employee was throwing construction debris into a dumpster. A piece of block debris lacerated his right bicep. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell while getting out of a car in a parking lot. The employee suffered an arm/shoulder fracture.

An employee was walking on a board being used as decking while a bridge deck was replaced. The board broke and the employee fell to the ground about 12 feet below, suffering fractures to two vertebrae and the pelvis. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was moving goods in a trailer with an electric pallet jack. The employee's left hand struck the side of the trailer and the little finger was crushed. The injury required a medical amputation to the finger.

An employee was operating a high-reach powered industrial truck when it collided with a load being carried by another powered industrial truck. The employee's foot was caught between the vehicle and the load, causing an ankle/foot injury.
An employee was cutting beef with a meat saw when his right thumb contacted the saw blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

On July 26, 2021, an employee was working inside a tank as part of a crew erecting a scaffold.
