An employee was waiting for a cassette pallet to advance to his station. The cassette settled on guide pins and fell into position where the employee's hand was. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee noticed a person in front of a store with a handgun, acting erratically. The employee left the store and retrieved a handgun from his personal vehicle. On his way back into the store, he was shot in the back of the head by the person. He suffered paralysis from the neck down.
An employee fell from a scaffold ladder while climbing down. The employee landed on concrete about 13-14 feet below, suffering a broken tailbone, two broken back vertebrae, and a broken left ankle.
An employee was caught between mechanical components of a trim saw while trying to remove debris. The employee suffered an internal injury to the upper leg.
An employee was clearing a jam on a paper plate machine when they contacted the machine's blade, resulting in amputation of four fingers on the left hand.

On July 26, 2021, an employee was using a pipe grooving machine to cut a groove in a sprinkler pipe. He was checking the depth of the groove when his left hand was pulled into the blade of the machine, causing an amputation of the ring fingertip.
An employee was walking when they slipped on plastic material that was on the ground. The employee fell and sustained a fractured left forearm.

An employee was working drilling holes to mount a controller box to a running conveyor belt. The employee was checking for metal edges or burr when his left middle finger got caught between the chain and sprocket resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was restarting a plastic machine. Melted plastic got on his right arm, his armpit, and the right side of his torso. He suffered second-degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was removing fat/meat that was clogging a drain in a separating room. An auger amputated his right index finger.

An employee collapsed while picking up trash on a route suffering from a heat-related muscle injury and dehydration.

An employee was walking on stilts to install a grid when he tripped over an item and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured elbow and lacerated forearm.

An employee opened the door of an enclosure and, while looking at a termination, was struck in the right eye by a disconnect panel shaft. The eye was injured.
An employee was physically assaulted by a patient, resulting in injuries to their head and L2 vertebra.

An employee was doing a hot check in the garage of a high-rise. He came into contact with electrical equipment and was shocked.

An employee began shaking and trembling while installing piping insulation on the third level of a structure. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion and dehydration.

An employee was checking the bond on a plywood panel when they were struck by another plywood panel that came out of the outfeed of a press. The employee suffered a possible neck injury.

An employee was standing on the floor pulling shrink wrap off a pallet of cleaning supplies. The employee lost their footing and fell to the floor, fracturing their right wrist.
While cleaning up a yard, an employee stepped on a nail that was sticking out of a pallet. The nail punctured the employee's right foot.

An employee was climbing a ladder to a roof. The employee fell, their feet becoming tangled in the rungs, and struck their head on a concrete stair landing. The employee suffered a subdural hematoma and a cervical strain and was hospitalized.

Two employees were removing a racking system in the lumber department when dimensional lumber fell from the racks and struck them. One employee suffered injuries to their chest, abdomen, and lower extremities and the other employee suffered a broken right leg.

An employee was using a right angle drill. The drill was activated and amputated the employee's finger.

An employee working at an outside jobsite suffered heat exhaustion, which caused his muscles to fail after returning to a hotel at the end of the day.

An employee was unloading parts from the paint line when their heel caught on a cart near the work area, resulting in a hyperextended knee.

An employee was replenishing shelves from a narrow aisle reach truck. As the truck turned, the employee's left foot was caught between the operator platform and the protective rail for the shelving units. The employee's middle toe was amputated.

An employee tripped over a conveyor belt power cord and fell to the ground, resulting in a fractured right hip.
An employee and co-workers were taking apart bison fence panels when a fence panel fell onto the employee, resulting in a broken pelvis, broken vertebra, and a spinal cord injury.
On July 28, 2021, an employee was painting corbels on the roof of a house when he slipped and fell to the grass below. He suffered three broken ribs and was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting wooden boards into smaller pieces using a miter saw. The saw amputated the employee's right thumb and index finger, as well as deeply cutting the middle, ring, and little fingers.
A hose ruptured during a test of a cooling loop system and released hot water on an employee, resulting in burns on his abdomen and legs that required hospitalization.

An employee was crossing a materials aisle, moving away from her welding cell, when a lift truck struck her as it backed up. She suffered an injury to the right foot.

An employee suffered a finger amputation while using a drill during the installation of a car's exhaust pipe.

Two employees were investigating a 4-inch spent sulfuric acid line to see what was needed for repairs. The line ruptured and sprayed acid on both employees. One suffered burns to his hands and the lower part of his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was moving metal materials by hand. One of the employee's fingers was caught between two pieces of metal, and the fingertip was amputated.
On July 29, 2021, an employee working in a hot process area began to feel nauseous and was later hospitalized for heat stress.

An employee opened double doors leading to a mechanical room on a mezzanine. The safety bar in front of the door broke and the employee fell to the floor about 12 feet below. The employee suffered fractures to the collarbones, ribs, and back.
An employee was near a production machine when it sprayed hot plastic onto the employee, causing burns to the left arm, face, and chest.

An employee was removing the back gate of a flat bed truck fitted with a removeable fence. The employee fell from the loading dock less than 4 feet to the ground. The employee later collapsed in the parking lot when trying to leave for the day and was hospitalized.

A border patrol agent was hiking down a hill in pursuit of someone. The agent stepped into a hole and fell downhill, stopping about 20 feet below. The agent suffered a broken left tibia and fibula and was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
On July 29, 2021, after finishing his shift at about 5:00 p.m., a mail carrier was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

An employee was building parts at a frame square work area when their right little finger got caught in a pinch point of the crossover track conveyor as they released a lever, resulting in a fracture.
An employee was walking down a paved road when they fell and landed on their right arm/elbow.
An employee was exiting his truck when he was struck by a vehicle, resulting in a fractured left leg.

An employee was using a pressure washer to clean the inside of a fertilizer tank containing ammonium polyphosphate solution when the pressurized steam punctured his left big toe, resulting in infection and hospitalization.

An employee was using a press brake to bend parts in four sequences. The brake activated and caught the employee's left hand, amputating half of the last joint of the ring finger and also lacerating/splitting the middle finger.
An employee who had been performing walkthrough inspections and cleaning drain filters began to experience nausea and cramps due to heat and dehydration, resulting in hospitalization.
While leaving work, an employee tripped on a rug and fell resulting in a fractured left femur.
An employee was disconnecting a wash line. While in a squatting position, the employee was using a rubber hammer to tighten a clamp and sustained a back injury.
An employee developed heat-related illness at a prequalification camp.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack. Another jack struck the one the employee was driving and the employee's foot was caught between the two jacks. The employee suffered a broken ankle.
An employee was at a site where a communications tower was being installed. The employee was tying rebar when he became ill and then fainted due to a heat-related illness.
An employee was plugging in a floor scrubber for charging when he tripped over the cord and fell to the ground, resulting in injuries to his left ear and hip.

An employee was walking near a pile driver to grab some chains when a metal pile pocket sitting on top of a template fell after being hit by the pile lead. The pile pocket bounced and hit the employee on his lower body, resulting in multiple fractures on both legs below the knee/shin area.

An employee was loading pallets of merchandise inside a parked trailer using a forklift. An operator attached his mule to the parked trailer and drove about 10 to 15 feet from the bay deck at the same time as the forklift operator was placing a pallet of merchandise inside the trailer. The employee and the forklift fell to the ground and the employee was hospitalized for a back strain.

An employee was on their knees with their upper body in a car while attempting to connect scanning equipment to an engine control module. The car went into drive and lurched forward. The driver's door struck a post and pinned the employee between the door and doorframe, resulting in a broken pelvis.
An employee was walking toward a house to deliver three boxes when she tripped on a bump in the concrete and landed on her right hand, resulting in three broken fingers.
An employee was installing a pipe through a wall. The employee's hand was caught against a metal wall beam, resulting in the amputation of his fingertip.

On 7/29/2021, an employee was putting on her boots while using the door to support herself. The door closed and her right little finger was caught between the door and the doorjamb, resulting in an amputation just below the nailbed.

On July 30, 2021, at approximately 12:35 p.m., an employee was working at a 90-ton hydraulic brake press to bend door parts. The press cycled and the employee's left forearm and right hand were caught in the pinch point between both dies. The employee's left forearm was crushed and his right palm was fractured. He was hospitalized for surgery.
An employee became dizzy while standing on a ladder, working on a communication line. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was moving a 30-pound work piece when its sharp edge caught the tip of the employee's little finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee suffered injuries to the left shoulder, neck, and back while lifting a child. She was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing up on the back of his truck to shut the back door when he slipped and fell to the pavement, resulting in a fractured left arm that required hospitalization.
An employee was installing siding from a 6- to 7-foot ladder. The ladder slid along the siding and the employee fell. He landed on the ground and suffered broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was operating a forklift to take bins to the warehouse for storage when the forklift overturned on his legs, resulting in fractures to both legs.

On July 30, 2021, at 6:00 p.m., an employee was removing a hose and the stainless steel hardline for a positive displacement pump when their left middle finger caught on a blade in the pump, resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee had been flipping a 50-pound bag over. The employee's glove got caught on a chain conveyor, pulling his hand and wrist into the conveyor. The employee sustained soft tissue damage to the hand and wrist/forearm.
An employee was unloading food products for a customer when they began feeling lightheaded and disoriented, resulting in hospitalization for dehydration.

An employee was placing a barricade around a work area with an active hot water discharge that created steam and standing water. The employee stepped into a depression containing hot water, resulting in second degree burns to their foot.

An employee was on a 6-foot ladder while removing debris from a ceiling. A piece of cement fell from the ceiling and the employee lost his balance and fell off the ladder, resulting in broken ribs and an injured wrist.

An employee was working at a wrapper on a recoiler, wrapping a coil with plastic. A pigtail became caught on a pipe; while an employee was pushing it back into a working position, the machine engaged and its rotating bearing hit the employee's left hand. The employee suffered partial amputations to the middle and ring fingers. The machine was unguarded at the time.
Employees were working on a fence machine stacker. When it was activated, an employee was pinned between a lifting mechanism and the machine's lid, suffering a crushing injury across the chest.
An employee was unpacking merchandise and placing it on a shelf when she received a cut on her finger and then fainted, resulting in a contusion and chipped teeth.
An employee was making a connection when a swivel bounced back and caught his right middle finger between the swivel and the stump, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee walked under an aerial lift as a piece of sheet piling was being cut. The piece fell approximately 20 feet and struck his hard hat and neck, resulting in a neck laceration.
An employee was operating a forklift when their right index and middle fingers were caught between the frame of the forklift and a guardrail, resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was repairing an elevator door and fell from the top of the elevator cab to the bottom of the elevator shaft. The employee sustained broken arms, collapsed lungs, a head injury, a chest injury, a stomach injury, an abdominal injury, and blood clots.
On 7/30/2021, an employee was stocking products on a top shelf when they fell off a step stool and landed on the floor, resulting in a right hip fracture that required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was on a straight ladder gathering equipment to be used at a jobsite. When they began descending the ladder, they fell 8 feet from the ladder to the ground below, resulting in fractured wrists, a fractured cheekbone, and a laceration on their hand.

An employee was attaching communications cable to tensioned strand wire using a lashing device from the ground and alternating work tasks to include working from a bucket truck. The employee began to display signs of heat exhaustion and was hospitalized.
An employee was working near an assembly line when a vehicle struck a wheel hub that subsequently struck the employee, resulting in a puncture on their right calf.

On July 30, 2021, at 12:15 p.m., an employee was inflating a farm tire to the required 30 psi while it was in a tire cage. The tire pressure rose to approximately 20 psi when the tire exploded and the force of the explosion shifted the cage. A portion of the tire struck the employee in the legs as the cage moved, resulting in a fractured right tibia and a ruptured tendon in the left leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was using a hammer to attach a cross-arm on a form. The hammer handle hit the tip of his little finger and fractured it.
An employee worked an entire shift and sustained heat stroke.
An employee was working the suppression operation lines while fighting a wildfire on rugged terrain when they experienced possible heat stress and dehydration and lost consciousness.

An employee was lying on a concrete slab immediately next to an unloader. The unloader had been raised on a hydraulic jack so the employee could make a shim adjustment to it. When the employee lowered the unloader after making the adjustment, it fell and struck the employee, who suffered a 10-inch horizontal laceration to the chest; the amputation of three fingers on the left hand; a cut to the left side of the head; cuts on the upper right arm; and bruises to the back, left hip, and right shoulder.
An employee was taking a break after sucking insulation out of an attic using machines. The employee began cramping and was hospitalized for possible heat exhaustion.

An employee's gloved hand came in contact with a rotating extension on a right angle DC torque tool. The glove got caught in the tool's extension, causing the employee's left index finger to get wrapped in the extension. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was cleaning a portable belt conveyor when their right hand contacted the power end of the belt conveyor, which crushed the employee's hand.

An employee climbed up the side of a product rack to retrieve a case of product from the second tier when they fell and landed on their stomach, resulting in a fractured maxillary face bone, a displaced nasal bone, and a fractured left and right arm.

An employee was feeding paper into a folder mechanism on a press and adjusting the tension in preparation for the evening press run. The employee's left little finger got caught in the rollers. As the employee attempted to pull their left hand out, their right hand was caught in the roller resulting in an amputation injury.
On July 31, 2021, an employee was performing a sea lion puppet show when a sea lion bit their thigh, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was on the tarmac on a deck loader when they began to feel faint, dizzy, and incoherent, resulting in hospitalization for a heat-related illness.
An employee was disposing of materials in an outside trash receptacle. The employee fell from the side of the receptacle to the ground about 3 to 4 feet below, landing on his shoulder.
An employee was trying to stop a car that had started rolling. She fell out of the car, which ran over her left calf and ruptured an artery, leading to an internal hemorrhage. She was hospitalized.
An employee was carrying a bundle of insulation when he tripped over the corner of a pallet, fell backward, and hit his head on the fork of a forklift, resulting in a concussion.
An employee was using an extension ladder while on a barge when they fell approximately 12 feet, resulting in a left ankle injury and a right ankle fracture that required surgery.
An employee was swinging a hammer while on a 6-foot step ladder when they fell to the floor, resulting in a broken collar bone.

On July 31, 2021, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was cutting a piece of concrete pipe with a portable cut-off saw when the saw got bound after the pipe pinched it. The employee lost his grip and the saw flipped over and bounced up to the left side of his neck, resulting in a laceration.
An employee accessed an electrical panel to switch a breaker when they received a 480-volt electrical shock that went from their right hand to their left hand, resulting in hospitalization.
A nurse was sitting at a nurse's station. A patient struck the nurse on the head with a fire extinguisher, knocking the nurse unconscious.

An employee was leaving a building through a roll-up door. After she lifted it to go out, the bracket on the wall that held the spring for the door broke. The door came down on her leg and fractured it. She was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was unclogging a line when lithium nickel oxide entered his gloves, causing a burn. He was hospitalized.
An employee was inspecting the middle lane of a lane closure when a car struck him. He fell to the pavement and suffered a head laceration.
An employee tripped on a cart and fell to the floor, landing on her knees and suffered a fracture to the right knee.

A crew was loading material into the bed of a boom truck with a tag line on one end. An employee was steadying a bundle of I-beams as they were being hoisted onto a boom truck. The load shifted and pinched his right middle finger, resulting in an amputation.

An employee was surveying a rural property along the fence line when they were struck by a driver who left the roadway, resulting in a broken right arm, a damaged artery in the right arm, a fractured C1 vertebrae, a broken left ankle, and possible nerve damage to the right arm. The employee required hospitalization.

Three employees were doing highway work when a vehicle went past the barricades and hit them. Two of the three were hospitalized: one (who had been picking up barrels on the grass by the highway) suffered a broken femur and the other (who had been cracking down an arrow board) suffered a head contusion, a shoulder separation, and a shoulder fracture.

At about 2:00 p.m. on August 2, 2021, an employee was making batches of popcorn when the kernel dispensing tube cap came off. The employee was putting a lid/cap on the tube system when the auger (spiral rod) grabbed his lab coat and pulled him in. The auger penetrated the employee's chest and exited his back. He was hospitalized.

An employee was using a powered miter saw to cut down a 10-foot trim piece. The employee's left hand and left index finger came into contact with the saw's rotating blade, which amputated the index fingertip.
An employee's finger was caught between the paddle and the drum of a mortar mixer. The finger was partially amputated.
An employee was removing bricks from a conveyor belt. The employee's middle finger was pinched in the belt and crushed.

An employee was repairing a natural gas line leak on an extreme heat day (which entailed using a hand shovel to dig two 19- to 20-inch holes in packed soil: one hole to expose the gas line to stop the flow of gas and one to make the repair). The employee had a heart attack and was hospitalized.
On 8/02/2021 at 3:00 p.m., an employee jumped to the ground from the bed of a flatbed truck and suffered a broken ankle that required surgery.

An employee was transporting product to a delivery truck using a manual rack and a ramp. The truck moved forward and the employee lost his balance and fell 5 feet to the ground, resulting in injuries to both wrists, including a right wrist injury that required surgery.
An employee was operating a recoiler when his left hand became entangled with the metal strip being wound up on the recoiler. He suffered a hand/wrist injury.
An employee developed heat exhaustion/dehydration while making food deliveries. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was backing a forklift out of a racking storage area. The employee's left arm was caught between the forklift's overhead cage and the racking system. The forearm was broken.
An employee was struck by a forklift as he walked away from a trailer. He suffered a broken leg.
An employee was lowering a vehicle's lift gate. A spring broke and the gate crashed down on the employee's feet, amputating both big toes.
An employee tripped on a curb and injured his back.

An employee was cutting a piece of aluminum trim with a miter saw. The saw grabbed the piece of metal, and the employee's left little finger was caught between the table of the saw and the piece of metal. The finger was partially amputated.

An employee had cleaned a vacuum belt dryer feed tank with steam-heated water, which he then drained out of the tank through the outlet valve at the bottom. When he disconnected the nitrogen supply line on the upper part of the tank, hot water sprayed from the flange for that line and struck the employee. He suffered second-degree burns to his neck, chest, back, legs, and arms, covering about 30 percent of his body. He was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a coil from a winding machine. The employee's little finger was pinched between the cylinder and the machine. The very tip of the finger was fractured. Part of the fingernail was damaged and tissue beside the fingernail was removed.

An employee was cutting heating element wire. The employee was adjusting the cutting blade when the piston arm activated and their finger was pinched in the machine, causing a laceration and a broken finger. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a large ring using a crowbar. The tool slipped and the ring came down on the employee's finger. The fingertip was amputated above the first knuckle.
An employee was performing maintenance while on a ladder when they fell approximately 5 feet to the ground, resulting in a fractured wrist.

An employee was leaning between two stacks of lumber to place a strap on one of the stacks. The strapper pulled the stacks together, and the employee was caught between them. The employee suffered a fractured sternum.

An employee was on a platform hanging a 4-inch piece of cast iron pipe. He fell through a ladder access hole and landed on the floor about 8 feet below, suffering a head injury (with a concussion) and a sore shoulder.
An employee was on their hands and knees going through a pallet of products. A forklift backed into the employee, who suffered a broken foot.
An employee had an allergic reaction to the apron they wore. The employee developed a neck rash and was hospitalized.
An employee was standing near a forklift. Six pieces of shaft wall fell off the forklift and landed on the employee's leg. The employee suffered a broken tibia and ankle.
An employee was carrying a pan of hot water. It fell, causing second-degree burns to his torso.
An employee was helping a child off a bus. The child ran away, pulling on the employee and causing her to fall to the ground. She suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting meat with a bandsaw when the machine got stuck. As he was turning off the machine, the blade amputated his left thumb at the first knuckle.
An employee was driving an electric riding pallet jack. His left foot slipped off the jack and was crushed between it and metal racking. His left tibia was broken.

An employee was cutting a piece of steel with a torch. About 40 feet away, an excavator with a grapple attachment was pulling apart two other pieces of steel that were connected with bolts. When those two pieces were pulled apart, the bolts broke and one of the pieces flew out the side of the grapple. It struck the employee in the hand and right leg, causing hand fractures and lacerations and a broken femur. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cutting lumber with a circular saw when the saw contacted their left index finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was taking a dog out of its harness, helped by the dog's owner. The dog lunged over and bit the employee, causing an injury to the left eye that required surgery.
An employee was measuring a piece of granite with a tape measure. The granite tipped and fell onto him, breaking his leg.

An employee was trying to unjam an injection mold machine. The outer door to the machine was closed, causing the mold to actuate and catch the employee's left arm. The employee was hospitalized and the arm was medically amputated.
An employee was water blasting when the water stream struck the employee in the left ribs, bicep, and wrist, resulting in water under the skin that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in a warehouse. He backed into a parked forklift and suffered an injury to his right leg.
An employee was under a vacuum truck checking a driveshaft installation. The truck rolled over him, crushing his pelvis and breaking ribs.
An employee was string-trimming around a ground cover. Hornets, coming from a nest in the ground cover, stung the employee multiple times. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking through a door and starting to walk through another door when she slipped on a wet floor and fell, resulting in a broken left femur.
An employee fell from a step ladder while installing a grill on a refrigerator. The employee landed on the ground about 18 inches below and suffered a broken hip.

Two employees were attempting to install metal framing studs near a 480-volt electrical panel box when an arc flash occurred, resulting in electrical burns on both employees that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped while leaving the cab of a tractor-trailer, falling backward to the ground and suffering a broken elbow.
An employee was shackling beef when his right little finger got caught between the chain of the shackle and the metal tension bar, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cleaning machinery when it caught her glove, resulting in the amputation of her right forearm.
A stand-up order picker backed into an employee who was picking up cases of liquor. The employee's left ankle was pinned between a pallet on the picker and one on the ground. The ankle was broken.

At about 7:00 p.m. on August 3, 2021, an employee was removing laser-cut parts from a sheet of steel that was positioned on a conveyor belt. A magnetic hoist was being used to lift a part from the sheet when the magnet momentarily lifted the metal conveyor belt from the frame of the conveyor. The employee's hand was resting on the conveyor frame, and when the conveyor belt separated from the magnet it fell onto the employee's hand, partially amputating a finger.
An employee was using a meat bandsaw. The saw cut the employee's fingertip, resulting in an amputation.
An employee was in his vehicle, getting ready to do firearms qualification, when his gun fired into his left leg.
An employee was reading gas meters when a ram attacked him. The ram struck his lower left leg from behind, resulting in a fractured tibia that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was placing stacks of totes on a wood pallet. The totes fell over on the employee, who suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized for surgery.

The injured employee was part of a team that was holding an agitated patient to assist with medication administration. The patient was attempting to bite, kick, scratch and spit throughout the event. It is not known how the employee was injured, but he reported dizziness, headache, nausea, and abdominal pain. He was hospitalized after experiencing multiple seizures.

An employee was doing preventive maintenance on a mold on a work table. One of the pin actuators on the mold was not functioning properly. The employee was using a handheld air hose with a rubber nozzle tip attachment to actuate the pin in and out. The pin would actuate in but not out; while the employee was trying to manually slide the pin, the air hose attachment activated. The pin caught the employee's left middle finger, partially amputating it.
A front end loader's bucket was rotated while an employee's hand was on it. The employee suffered a laceration to the little finger.

An employee was installing or checking ridge vents on a metal rooftop. The employee fell to the ground about 30 feet below and suffered chipped vertebrae, a collarbone injury, an internal abdominal injury that required surgery, and a sprain or fracture to the wrist.

An employee was operating a machining mill. While loading a new piece of material into the machine, the employee brushed off metal shavings from the top of the machine and their left hand was caught between the piece of material and tailstock of the machine. Their left middle and index fingers were crushed and the middle finger required surgical amputation.
An employee was stepping over a residential gate when they tripped, resulting in a broken left hip.
An employee was operating a forklift. The employee's foot was wedged between the forklift and racking, causing an ankle injury.

An employee was performing maintenance on a generator and fell from a 10-foot ladder to the concrete floor, striking his head and suffering a fractured skull, pelvis, ribs, and vertebrae, as well as a possible broken arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a brake press. The press activated and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip at the first joint.
An employee was doing punch-out repair work on a metal roof. The employee fell from the roof to the ground, suffering a back injury.

An employee was cleaning a residential gutter from an A-frame ladder, 6 to 7 feet above the ground. The employee fell to the ground and suffered two fractures in the lower back and a broken right ankle.
An employee was flushing a tank. The handle slipped out of her hand and hit the left side of her face, breaking her cheekbone and lacerating her cheek.
An employee was trying to clear a jam in a machine. The machine's rollers caught his right hand and crushed the tip of his little finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was adjusting a reroller machine. The employee's right forearm was pulled into the dies and fractured. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was clearing metal strips that were stuck in a machine. The tip of his left ring finger was pinched in the machine, causing a partial fingertip amputation without bone loss.
An employee was using a company bicycle to travel to a company property when they were struck by a vehicle that was backing out of a driveway, resulting in a fractured leg.
An employee was filling a propane cylinder at a residence when a propane explosion occurred, resulting in burns to their wrist and head.
An employee was preparing a new lift to receive an engine. His right pinky finger was pinched and he sustained a loss of soft tissue.
An employee was cutting vinyl siding with a circular saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's left little finger.

An employee was operating a dozer in an open field. The dozer's blade got caught at a drainage ditch and the dozer stopped suddenly. The employee was thrown from the seat to the floor of the cab and suffered a spinal injury. He was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet floor, fell, and broke her left kneecap.

An employee was emptying a half-full wheelbarrow of concrete when the wheelbarrow tipped over. The employee tried to stabilize the wheelbarrow and their left knee buckled, resulting in a dislocated left knee.
An employee was stepping down a ladder when he fell approximately 3.5 feet to the shop floor, resulting in a right wrist fracture and left patellar tendon rupture.
An employee was using a forklift when one of its forks punched a chemical tote containing benzene chloride. The employee suffered a chemical burn.

An employee was mowing grass with a push mower. The employee was "bumping" the mower so it wouldn't get clogged when the mower contacted their left foot, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle toe.
An employee was using a hammer to strike a steel wedge. A piece of the hammer broke off and struck the employee's left index finger, causing a laceration that required surgery.
On August 4, 2021, at 7:30 a.m., an employee was clearing excess cheese from a grinder when the grinder blades contacted the employee's right thumb, resulting in amputation of the thumb tip.
An employee was disassembling a bushing on a hydraulic cylinder. The bushing fell on a finger on the employee's left hand; the fingertip was medically amputated.

Two employees were transporting a cold box with a self-propelled modular transporter. As the load passed a power pole with a distribution transformer, the transformer arced onto a chain securing the load. The current traveled through the equipment and shocked both employees.
An employee was passing though an area where a drum washout was occurring. Hot water splashed onto the employee, burning his left heel.

An employee was welding studs on a bridge deck. During the welding process, a flash occurred causing the employee to fall backward onto the bridge deck. The employee was hospitalized with bruises and contusions.

An employee was drilling holes in a piece of pipe with a horizontal drill when a piece of metal that had sheared off caught his glove and pulled his hand into the drill, resulting in a partial amputation of the left thumb.
An employee was replacing a roll of wrapping for a packaging machine. A box entered the machine and tripped the carrier/sealer; the machine caught the employee's finger and amputated the fingertip.

At 9:30 a.m. on August 4, 2021, a two-person crew was trimming branches on a 36-foot locust tree using an elevator lift truck. An employee was in the elevated bucket of the boom truck using a stick saw. While he was lowering the boom to clear some hangers, the walking pin to the hydraulic cylinder failed. The upper boom and bucket fell about 7.9 feet, coming to rest on the top of the cab protection rack. The employee suffered a head laceration and was hospitalized.

An employee was working inside an enclosed generator when they stepped on a two-step A-frame ladder in order to get down. The ladder broke as soon as the employee stepped on it, causing the employee to fall approximately 2.5 feet onto the concrete and resulting in a lower left leg fracture.
An employee was cleaning a slitter machine when their hand got caught in the machine, resulting in lacerations and amputations to their right hand.
An employee was clearing a jammed machine. The machine activated and the employee's left index fingertip was caught in its cutting knives compartment. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was grinding beef with a mixing machine when their left middle finger was caught between the lip and the stand of the mixer. The finger was amputated.
On August 5, 2021, an employee was checking an injection molding machine when they were shocked by a live wire in the machine's electrical cabinet. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unhitching a tool bar when their left little finger became caught between the tow and the trailer hitch, resulting in amputation.
An employee was moving a bundle of solid brass rods with an overhead crane. After being set on the floor, the bundle separated; rods rolled onto the employee's feet, crushing them.
An employee was on a trailer, unstrapping a load of metal sheets for roofing. The employee fell from the trailer to the ground and broke a rib.

The injured employee was working on an open-top coal car replacing a piece that supports the sides of the car. The injured employee and a co-worker each had a side of the support. As the co-worker unbolted his side, he lost his grip, and the support swung down on the side of the injured employee, amputating their right ring fingertip.
An employee was using a ladder to perform an estimation in a cellar when the ladder slipped and the employee fell 10 feet, resulting in a fractured rib, a head contusion, and a lumbar spine injury.

An employee was opening a truck door with his left hand to get inside a truck when a vehicle pulled up alongside the truck and struck the truck's door, which subsequently struck the employee's hand, resulting in lacerations that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was cutting a tube with a band saw when his glove got caught in the blade and his index finger contacted the saw, resulting in a fingertip amputation from the bottom of the nail.

Two employees were working from an aerial lift, preparing the outside of a building for painting. Another lift struck the aerial lift and both employees were ejected falling approximately 30 feet to the ground. Both employees were hospitalized for fractures and contusions. Safety harnesses were worn, but were not attached to the lift by a lanyard/lifeline at the time of the incident.
An employee fell and suffered a fractured right femur.
An employee's clothing was caught in a sprocket for a conveyor and was pulled in. The employee suffered broken knee.
An employee was exiting a room when her right little finger was caught in the door jamb on the hinge side of the door. The door pinched her finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was walking on a loading dock when they slipped and fell to the bottom of the dock, resulting in possible head injuries.
An employee was ripping plywood across a table saw. The saw blade cut the employee, resulting in the amputation of the employee's left middle and ring fingers.
An employee was walking near a conveyor. Her toe was caught on a support pole for the conveyor and she fell to the concrete floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was transporting a coil of steel when the banding let loose and the tail of the coil struck the employee in the head.

On August 5, 2021, an employee was operating a crane by remote control to move bundles of steel bars for packaging. A bar from one of the bundles came loose and the employee's right hand was caught between the bar and the remote control, resulting in a partial amputation of the middle finger.
An employee was working on a slitter machine when the rubbers on its arbor caught his right hand and pulled his arm through the slitter head. The employee's right hand and arm were crushed.

An employee was moving an aerial lift over a gantry crane track using an overhead crane. The employee was standing between a 74-inch steel pipe and the boom of the aerial lift when the final wheel of the lift cleared the gantry track and the boom swung over and pushed the employee into the pipe, resulting in fractured ribs and contusions on the left lung.

An employee was using a horizontal drill when a coolant hose became wrapped around the drill, broke free, and struck the employee multiple times, resulting in multiple fractures and lacerations to the right wrist and right shin.

An employee was performing a run check of a machine when a finger on their right hand got caught between the belt chain and sprocket, resulting in a fingertip amputation. The machine was not locked out at the time of the incident.
An employee was caulking a balcony window and fell approximately 3 feet off a ladder onto the balcony floor. The employee suffered a knee fracture and displacement.

An employee was working on a cheek plate line making bowling pins. The employee tried to grab a falling bowling pin when a moving chain contacted their left hand, resulting in amputation of the ring finger down to the first knuckle.
An employee was fixing a board that had flipped over on a conveyor. A pusher cylinder came forward and caught the tip of a finger on the employee's right hand. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was clearing a jam from a bag cutting machine when the blade amputated the tips of their right thumb, index, and middle fingers.
An employee was readjusting a piece of metal to be sheared. The employee's finger was crushed in the metal shear.

An employee was using a pallet jack to load and unload palletized freight from a delivery truck at an offsite location. The employee fell while inside the delivery truck and tried to grab the strap of the truck's sliding door. The door came down on the employee's hand as he fell, resulting in fractures to the fingers/hand.

An employee was operating a stand-up forklift when its steering tire got stuck in a hole in the concrete dock. Another forklift was being used to push the employee's lift when its fork entered the employee's cab and broke his left foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was working on a roof when they fell to the concrete below, resulting in a fractured heel bone.

An employee was using a pry bar to reshape a metal auto rail. The tool came loose and struck the employee's nose, causing a laceration. The long edge of the pry bar struck and ruptured the employee's left eye.
An employee was inspecting a garbage truck when he slipped and fell to the floor. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
On August 8, 2021, at 1:00 p.m., an employee was struck by the bucket of a backhoe that was digging a pit for a trench box, resulting in a severe hand injury.

An employee was climbing a tree to trim branches from it. A rope that had been secured to a branch broke and the employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered spinal fractures, a lost tooth, and kidney lacerations.

An employee was removing masks from the conveyor. A mask was stuck in the main conveyor and as the employee attempted to remove the mask, her finger was caught in the sprocket pinch point and amputated.

An employee was operating a ride-on fertilizer spreader on a slight slope. The spreader hit a small rabbit hole and seemed like it was about to tip over. The employee's right leg was broken as he stuck his foot out to brace himself.
An employee was disconnecting a rope from a barge. The employee's middle, ring, and little fingers were crushed between two barges. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was lifting a fabricated product with a lifting magnet. The product fell off the magnet onto his left foot and fractured it. He was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a forklift when her left leg was caught between it and another, empty lift. Her leg was lacerated.

An employee was draining down and isolating piping. While he was trying to remove debris from a 1-inch vent valve, liquid started to gurgle up into the valve. He closed the valve with his right hand to prevent a release, and it closed on his left index finger. He suffered a partial amputation to the finger.
An employee was trying to adjust the pressure rod and tension ball of a slitter machine. The slitter blade amputated the employee's left index finger. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

An employee was moving a chain on a laser CNC machine. When he pulled the chain toward the sprocket, his left ring finger was caught in the nip point of the chain/socket assembly. He suffered a partial amputation to the fingertip.
The injured employee had been putting away tools when they were attacked with a hammer by another employee. The injured employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was backing up a motorized pallet jack. The employee's hand was caught and crushed between the jack and a bailer.

An employee was working from a scissor lift, helping cut a wooden display wall into small sections for removal. The employee cut a section free to be lowered. When it was pulled away from the wall, some attached electrical conduit pulled the entire wall toward the scissor lift and knocked it over. The employee fell to the concrete floor next to the lift, striking his head on the floor and suffering a head injury. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.

An employee had just checked the temperature of some product on a trolley and was trying to pull the trolley back into a chiller. The trolley instead followed the overhead rail system to a different chiller, hit the rail stop mechanism there, derailed, and fell to the ground. The employee was pinned under it and suffered a broken left tibia.
The employee was removing a screw housing from a machine when the machine housing pinched his left middle finger, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was operating the trash can injection mold machine and noticed that the hopper was jammed with plastic material. As the employee attempted to unjam the hopper, the blade amputated the fingertips on his left hand.
An employee was delivering mail when a dog ran across the street and bit her arm, resulting in cuts that required hospitalization.
An employee had finished unloading a trailer when they began experiencing tingling in their legs and were hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

The injured employee was working in the platform of an aerial lift approximately 40 feet above the ground. Another employee was extending the boom of a telehandler with an iron girder truss attached to the forks. As the telehandler operator was lifting the iron girder truss, he simultaneously lifted the left-side outrigger. The length and weight of the girder truss caused the telehandler to tip on its side, striking a support beam. The support beam broke from the anchor bolts, causing the support beam along with an attached iron girder truss to fall backward and strike the aerial lift. The aerial lift fell and the employee was ejected from the platform, resulting in lacerations to the face and multiple lost teeth.
An employee was climbing down a ladder and fell to the floor 8 feet below, suffering a broken right tibia and ankle.
An employee tripped on a cable and fell on the floor, landing on their left side and sustaining a broken hip.
An employee was climbing off the back of a delivery truck when he slipped and fell 52 inches onto a block wall that was adjacent to the parked truck, resulting in fractured ribs and a punctured lung.

An employee pulled his truck into a return lot, got out, and was robbed and beaten with a 2-by-4 by one or two assailants. He suffered a skull fracture on the left side, fractures to the eye orbits, and a fractured collarbone, as well as bruising to the mouth.
An employee was delivering parcels along their route when they were attacked by multiple dogs, resulting in hospitalization due to bite injuries.
An employee was pushing scrap metal through a metal saw when the saw struck the employee's left little finger, resulting in amputation at the first knuckle.
An employee was aligning the butt section of a wind turbine when his left middle finger was struck by the reaction arm when it extended, resulting in amputation to the first knuckle.
An employee was restacking and palletizing materials when a forklift ran over his left foot, breaking it.
An employee was standing on the side of a truck while putting trash into the truck when he was struck by a vehicle, resulting in a contusion and road rash.
An employee was helping remove forks from a forklift. A fork dropped and caught his left middle finger against the ground. The employee's hand and finger were cut.
An employee tripped on a curb while crossing a parking lot and fell, landing on their left hand and suffering a broken left wrist.

Two employees were offloading 12-inch pipes from a truck at a construction site. They were operating the offloading mechanism when one employee's left little finger was pinched between one rolling pipe and the next. The finger was degloved and the fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee slipped and fell at a home while delivering a package. He suffered an arm injury.

An employee was clearing a jam in an edge bander machine. A machine part closed on the employee's right middle finger after the jam was cleared. The employee suffered an amputation to the last joint of the finger.

An employee was driving a concrete mixer truck up a hill to a job site. The road's soft shoulder gave way at the rear of the truck, which rolled over. The employee suffered injuries to the head, neck, and right arm.
The injured employee and three co-workers were lifting a dock plate when it slipped and pinched the injured employee's fingertip, resulting in a partial amputation.
A contract employee was cutting a band on a package. The employee slipped and fell from the package to the ground, suffering a broken tibia and fibula.
An employee was collecting conifer cone crops on an orchard ladder. The employee fell off the ladder to the ground about 10 feet below, suffering a broken leg that required surgery.

An employee was leveling and anchoring racking uprights using a plumb bob level (attached magnetically to the upright about 3 feet above the ground). The employee was down on the ground tapping the foot of an upright into place with a small sledgehammer when the plumb bob level detached from the upright and fell/slid down, amputating his left index fingertip just past the last knuckle.

An employee was operating a small jib crane in the shop to lift a small valve. While adjusting the rigging around the valve to position it, the employee's left ring finger was caught between the rigging and the valve, resulting in a partial amputation before the first knuckle and the removal of the fingernail.
An employee was pushing pipe casing with a detached, 24-inch backhoe bucket when the bucket rolled down the hill and struck the employee, resulting in broken ribs.
An employee was training on a lift when they struck a guardrail, resulting in a leg laceration.

An employee was unjamming a forming machine when her fingers contacted the rollers that pull wire through the machine, resulting in a pinched ring finger and injuries to the little finger that required amputation down to the middle phalange. The machine was not guarded at the time of the incident.

An employee was painting a steel fence in a rain garden/courtyard area. A vehicle backed uncontrollably from the street, jumped two curbs, pinned the employee between the car and the fence, and continued, striking a building. The employee suffered fractures to the collarbone, ribs, and a leg.
An employee was cutting a block of wood with a table saw when the block slipped and the table saw lacerated four fingers on their right hand, resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was troubleshooting a back surfacing and granule chute that was clogged when their right middle, index, and little fingers were amputated. The machine was not locked out at the time.

On August 16, 2021, an employee was using a concrete saw cutter to cut an 8-inch diameter PVC sewer pipe when the blade contacted his left calf, resulting in a laceration that required hospitalization.
An employee was ascending a ladder to perform roofing work when they fell off the ladder to the ground below, resulting in a lower back injury.
An employee was manually loading trash into a trash truck when he sustained heat stroke and was hospitalized.

Two employees were lifting a 59-pound piece of steel plate into the engine room of a vessel. One of the employees, standing on the ground, lifted the plate up to the other and released it. As the other employee was lifting it into the vessel, it fell down through a hole. The first employee's left ring and middle fingers were caught between the plate's edge and a steel I-beam. Both fingers suffered multiple compound fractures; the little finger and half the ring finger were medically amputated the next day.
An employee was mowing on a slope around a pond. The mower lost traction, flipped over once,  and landed back upright. The employee was hospitalized with broken ribs.
An employee was gathering shopping carts in the parking lot. She went inside and collapsed due to heat exhaustion.
An employee was dismantling a vehicle. When the employee struck a bolt with a hammer, a piece of metal went into the employee's eye.
A Turn-Key Construction employee was cutting aluminum trim with a saw blade. The trim snagged in the blade, pulling his finger toward it. The blade lacerated his finger to the bone.

An employee was driving a forklift, moving pallets of finished product. He smelled something burning or melting and got out of the forklift. He traced a trail of antifreeze to the back of the vehicle; steam then shot out of the back of the vehicle. The employee sustained second-degree burns.
The injured employee was cutting duct work. A nearby scissor lift struck a steel pipe that was on a jack stand and caused the pipe to swing into the injured employee resulting in lower leg fractures.
An employee was working on a conveyor. A chain drive engaged on the conveyor, pulling the employee's left thumb into a sprocket and chain. He suffered an amputation to the end of the thumb.
An employee was cleaning a part in a machine. The machine came down on the employee's right hand, causing an amputation to the little finger.

On August 17, 2021, an employee was inside a trailer that his truck had just backed up to a loading dock. As he tried to straighten a banded load of cardboard, the band snapped and the load fell, knocking him into the side of the trailer. He suffered head lacerations and a dislocated shoulder.
An employee was operating a cash register and was shot during a robbery attempt.

After unloading metal roofing materials on a roof, an employee fell through a skylight to the ground. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures. Fall protection was not connected at the time of the incident.

An employee and a co-worker were delivering a copier to a client. While using the stairs and a stair climber device for copiers, the machine fell and landed on the employee, who then fell down the stairwell. The employee suffered multilevel spinous process fractures from the T4-T10 levels that required hospitalization.
An employee became dizzy and nauseated while doing underground work. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related illness.

An employee was driving cattle in a pen corral. The employee climbed up a pen rail to keep from being rammed by an aggressive cow. The cow's horns caught his boot and pulled him to the ground inside the pen. He suffered fractures to the left tibia and fibula, as well as an injured left shoulder.
An employee was setting up a vertical mill when it started. It began to turn and threw the employee out. The employee's left leg struck a table, and the employee's tibia was broken.
An employee was bending rebar when his glove got caught in the machine and his left index finger was pinched, resulting in an amputation.
A temporary employee was operating a bar drill. His hand was pinched between a table and a metal bar on the exit side of the drill. He suffered a crushed finger.
An employee was standing on the top of a grinder when it activated. Its feed wheel roller engaged and pinned the employee to a mill box, crushing the employee's abdomen.

An employee was pushing the forks of a forklift to widen their position. He needed to get the forks around the hook it sits in. Once it cleared the hook, the fork slid quickly, catching the employee's right middle finger against the headache rack support. The finger was amputated.
On August 18, 2021, an employee was stamping a metal piece on a press. As he was retrieving the piece, the press came down and crushed his middle finger. The finger was amputated.
At 2:12 p.m. on August 18, 2021, an employee was demolishing electrical switches when the gear fell on him as it was being lowered. The employee's left leg was broken.

An employee was removing material that was blocking a drain for the fresh product auger. The auger contacted the employee's left hand and amputated three fingertips. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee developed heat exhaustion (chest tightness, tiredness, and a headache) while hanging drywall.
An employee fell from a ladder on a vehicle, landing on the ground and suffering a hip injury.

An employee had been digging with a shovel in a farm field and laying plastic in the heat. The employee felt hot, fatigued, and experienced dry mouth and shaky legs. The employee was hospitalized for heat stroke.
An employee was grinding bolts on the base of a street light. The grinder bound up and spun out of his hands, causing a 2-inch cut on his upper left leg.
An employee slipped on dew while getting out of his truck. He fell to the ground, suffering a broken right arm.
An employee was mixing bentonite with a mixing machine. A small engine caught fire, and the employee suffered second- and third-degree burns. He was hospitalized.
An employee was using a high-pressure hose to clean a conveyor system. The employee suffered a severe laceration.

An employee was cleaning a concrete placer. He was on the housing of the auger/hopper area, chipping out some built-up concrete, when his right foot slipped. The auger caught his pant leg and pulled in his right leg. The leg and the ankle were broken.
An employee was cleaning the elbow of a transformer when he suffered electrical contact burns to the left hand and flash burns to the right hand.
An employee was walking to a work station. The employee's right hand struck a counter balance bar and was broken.

An employee was doing maintenance on a gas well pump jack. The brake did not hold when he set it, and a belt and pulley caught his hand. He suffered an amputation to the little finger, about 7/8 of the way from the end.
An employee was moving pallets using a powered pallet jack when their leg was pinched between the jack and a pallet. The employee sustained bruising to the lower leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing an A-frame ladder to take down a chain fall. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground about 5 feet below, suffering injuries to the right shoulder and left-side waist.
An employee was climbing a ladder when it shifted to the right. The employee fell to the ground, suffering fractures to the left leg and foot.
On August 18, 2021, an employee tripped over a hose near a fuel island and hit his head on the pavement. He suffered a bruise above his right eyebrow and was hospitalized.

An employee had just delivered mail to a house and was going down the steps when two dogs came out of the house and attacked her. One of the dogs jumped at her and bit her right arm while she lay on the ground. She suffered severe puncture and bite wounds to the forearm and biceps area.
An employee was using a handheld plasma torch to cut the lid off a 55-gallon barrel. The barrel exploded, and the employee suffered broken ribs.

An employee was demolishing a residential garage roof. The roof collapsed to the ground and the employee fell from the roof to the cement floor of the garage, suffering two broken wrists and a broken collarbone.
An employee was changing a belt on an electric apron feeder. The machine activated and amputated the tip of the employee's left index finger.
At 11:00 p.m. on August 18, 2021, an employee was inspecting and setting up a press when it amputated the employee's left index finger.

A stand-up forklift operator was moving a rack of bumpers. He reversed and then got off the forklift as it rolled to a stop. His foot was caught between the forklift and a rack that was behind the forklift. The employee's ankle was fractured.
An employee was standing on a skid plate or slip plate when it amputated most of his big toe and part of his second toe.

An employee was standing on a portable stair platform, using a flashlight to see if there was a water leak under a conveyor. Her left lower arm was caught between the conveyor belt and a roller. She suffered three fractures to the lower left arm between the wrist and elbow.

An employee had been using a scissor lift to caulk seams around an air conditioner. The employee exited the scissor lift and was kneeling on top of the air conditioner when he lost balance and fell to the floor approximately 13.5 feet below. The employee sustained a hip fracture and a laceration above the left eyebrow. Fall protection was not used at the time of the fall.

On August 19, 2021, an employee was dismantling scaffolding. The employee slipped on a surface that was wet from rain and fell. He landed on the ground about 12 feet below and suffered head, back, rib, and left and right arm injuries.

At about 3:00 p.m. on August 19, 2021, an employee was on a ladder, hanging artwork on a church wall. A volunteer leaned on the opposite side of the ladder, trying to support the employee, and the ladder destabilized. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right shoulder, as well as a contusion to his right elbow.
An employee fell while trying to sit down in a chair, landing on the floor and suffering a broken right arm and hip. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee was operating a hydraulic shearing machine when the cutting blade came down and amputated the end of his left middle fingertip.
An employee was servicing an auto filler packaging machine when a belt and pulley caught his fingertip. His right index and middle fingertips were amputated.

On 8/19/2021, at approximately 0400 hours, the injured employee was assisting another employee to remove a fluid end on a frac pump in the repair bay. A wrench was activated and the employee's ring finger was caught and amputated between the HTW and the fluid end.
An employee was moving metal billets onto a load table with an overhead crane. The employee's fingers were caught between two billets, causing the amputation of the right fourth and fifth fingers.
An employee tripped and fell while walking to her car. Her left arm struck a metal signpost and was broken.

On August 19, 2021, an employee was driving a reach truck in a warehouse area. As he went around a corner, the truck ran into another, parked truck with an empty pallet on its forks. The forks of the moving truck shattered the pallet. When the pallet broke apart, it struck the employee's legs causing a laceration on the left leg and a fracture to the right leg that required hospitalization and surgery.
A security guard was starting his personal vehicle. While exiting the vehicle his feet got caught on the doorsill and he fell out of the car, fracturing his hip on the ground.
A freezer door handle caused an amputation to an employee's fingertip.

A baghouse was being moved using dolly carts. A cart got stuck on a crack in concrete; a forklift was used to lift the baghouse while an employee moved to adjust the cart. The baghouse slipped from the forks and crushed the employee's hand against the cart.
An employee was installing satellite service at a customer's residence. While he was picking up a dropped screw from the grass, a snake bit his left middle finger.
An employee was lifting a turntable out of a chassis of a boom. A crane lifting strap broke and hit his left hand, breaking his ring and little fingers. The ring fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee fell backward from a truck bed to the ground, hitting raised concrete. He suffered injuries to the left shoulder and ribs and was hospitalized.
An employee was rolling a piece of metal in a rotary machine when their glove got caught on the corner of the piece and the machine partially amputated their left index finger.

Employees were sliding a 12-foot steel column when one employee's right hand was caught between the column and a metal plumbing sleeve. The employee's little fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.
On August 19, 2021, an employee was cutting an piece of plastic pipe with a cutoff saw. The saw kicked back and lacerated the employee's chest. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
An employee fell through a roof hole, landed on a concrete floor about 17 feet below, and suffered a broken right wrist and upper right arm.

On August 19, 2021, an employee was working with the deicer machine on an airplane. Finishing the job, he moved to close the 500-pound power module. His right hand was caught between the power module and the deicer machine. Three fingertips were amputated.
An employee was performing maintenance on a conveyor belt roller when their right thumb was pinched and amputated by the roller. The machine was not locked out/tagged out at the time.
An employee was returning to their workstation after a break and fell down stairs. The employee sustained a seizure and was hospitalized.
On August 19, 2021, an employee was struck by a forklift and sustained lacerations to the right leg requiring hospitalization.
An employee's knee hit the frame of a conveyor belt. The employee suffered blood clots and was hospitalized.

Two employees were on a utility pole, shifting position and equipment, when the pole broke. The employees fell 15 feet. Employee 1 suffered a broken jaw, a broken nose, and a broken vertebra and was hospitalized. Employee 2 was treated and released.

On August 19, 2021, an employee was unloading a pipe storage rack from a flatbed trailer. A chain was holding two sections of pipe rack together. When the chain was removed, a section of pipe rack became unstable, causing the rack and the employee to fall approximately 3 feet from the flatbed trailer to the ground. The employee became pinned under the section of pipe rack and was hospitalized with a fractured pelvis. The section of pipe rack was 30 feet long and weighed approximately 1,380 pounds.
An employee was exiting a box truck when he fell forward to the concrete floor 2 feet 10 inches below. He suffered a broken left arm and a head laceration.
An employee was adjusting the direction of a structure-mounted air circulating fan. The fan blade struck and amputated his right index finger.
An employee was delivering mail when he became dizzy and nauseated, suffering from possible heat-related illness.

An employee stood on an extension ladder to guide a metal pipe into a hole/drum. The pipe made contact with a pipe that had been previously placed in the drum and knocked it loose from its friction weld and crimp. The employee then jumped off the ladder rather than be struck by the loose pipe. The employee landed on the floor and sustained a fracture to the left tibia and right heel.
An employee was operating an electric pallet jack when it collided with another pallet jack. The employee suffered a crushed right foot.
An employee was working with sheet metal. A sliver of the metal penetrated the employee's gloves and punctured their hand. The employee required surgery to remove the metal.
An employee was startled by a dog while installing internet service at a residence. He ran, fell to the ground, and suffered a knee injury.
An employee suffered a broken kneecap and a shattered tibia. The employee was hospitalized.
A maintenance employee was attacked by a tenant at an apartment complex. The tenant struck the employee in the head with a hammer, causing a laceration.
An employee tripped on an anti-fatigue mat at a register. She fell to the floor, breaking both shoulders, and was hospitalized.

An employee was checking to see if product was flowing through a blender. When the power to the blender was turned off, the pneumatic fly gate valve closed on the employee's left hand and amputated three fingertips.

An employee was in an aerial lift's metal bucket, installing a banner on the side of a building. The employee finished placing the banner and pulled back to take a picture. The aerial lift came into contact with a power line; the employee was shocked, suffering second-degree burns to the chest and head.
An employee was walking to a parking area. He fell while stepping off a curb, landing on the pavement and breaking his elbow and humerus.

On August 20, 2021, an employee was performing maintenance work on an air conditioner. The employee's steel-toed boot made contact with a 240-volt wire. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a broken right clavicle, a laceration between the right thumb and finger, and bruising to the right side of the face.
An employee fell from the cab of a provisioning truck while dumping trash from the truck. He landed on the ground and suffered broken ribs, collapsed lungs, and spinal fractures.
An employee was attempting to remove a jammed staple in a pneumatic staple gun. The staple gun fired a 2-inch staple into the employee's right thumb and palm.

At 7:24 p.m. on August 20, 2021, an employee tripped and fell over a pallet of product at a warehouse. He cut his ankle, then tripped and fell again while standing up, suffering open fractures to the tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized.

An employee was entering a trailer to unload it. The truck pulled forward and the lift fell and got hung up by the trailer and the dock plate. The employee suffered a fracture to the T12 vertebra and was hospitalized.
An employee suffered a herniated disk while picking up a box containing a 74-pound roll of sheet membrane waterproofing.

An employee was tightening a belt on a golf cart when the seat of the cart fell forward, hitting the ignition. The vehicle turned on and the employee's left hand was pulled in. The belt amputated his index fingertip.
An employee fell off a bulldozer while changing a condenser. The employee landed about 7 feet below, suffering five broken ribs and a collapsed lung.
A forklift was being used to remove a 1,500-lbs. pad of copper tape from a pallet. The pad fell and landed on the injured employee's left foot, breaking it.
An employee was installing a sprinkler system mainline when they fell from a ladder to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fracture to the right side of the pelvis.

An employee was scaling meat prior to filling in pouches on a bag former machine when their right-hand fingers were pinched in the machine, resulting in a laceration and partial amputation of the middle fingertip and a laceration of the ring finger.
An employee was shocked while practicing tack welding.

Employees were inspecting a grinder machine. While one of them was turning the grinding blades, his right hand was caught in a shear point between them. The blades lacerated all four of his fingers. He was hospitalized.
An employee was driving an airport tug when it ran over chocks. The employee was ejected and the tug ran over his left lower leg, breaking it.
An employee was positioning a pole to be raised up. The pole hit an overhead power line and the employee was shocked.
Employees were mountain biking at a team event. An employee fell on their head, sustaining a fractured C6 vertebra, and a misaligned C7 vertebra, and a separated knee ligament.
An employee was exiting a truck. The door closed on his right middle finger and amputated it.
An employee was cutting an air line when the cutting tool amputated the tip of his left index finger.
An employee was entering a building after cleaning a floor drain in a courtyard. He slipped and fell down a flight of 7 stairs, coming to rest on a landing and suffering a broken left ankle.
An employee tripped while walking the plant floor, but caught himself before falling. The employee sustained a bulging disc in his back and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a wire drawing machine when it partially amputated his right index finger.

An employee was trying to break up products that were clogged in the rotary valve of a grain bin dust collector. The collector partially amputated two fingers on the employee's left hand, up to the second knuckle.
An employee was walking across a yard. A piece of metal from a shredder struck the employee in the face, causing a laceration and fractures to the face and jaw.
An employee was cutting a tie wire used to suspend parts for hot-dip galvanizing. A metal grate fell when the wire broke, striking his leg and lacerating the shin/calf area. He was hospitalized.
An employee was removing a package from a conveyor belt when he fell on his knee and injured his hip.

An employee was doing housekeeping work with a 150-horsepower industrial vacuum. The vacuum sucked in a piece of plastic, then sucked in the employee's right arm as the employee tried to remove the plastic. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery to the arm.
An employee was cutting a carcass using a knife. The knife lacerated the employee's bicep.
A temporary employee lost his balance and fell while walking down a hallway. He suffered a broken right hip and was hospitalized.

An employee was preparing a skid for transportation. The handrails had been removed, and the employee was tying them down, when a rope broke. The employee fell backward to the ground about 6 feet below, suffering broken ribs.
An employee tripped on uneven concrete while delivering a package. The employee fell, suffering compound hip fractures.
An employee was making an electrical repair. An arc flash caused second-degree burns to the employee's face.
While checking the source of an electrical failure, an employee suffered a high-voltage shock, with severe burns to the arms, legs, and torso.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in a freezer area. The forklift struck a rack and ejected the employee, who suffered a broken left arm.

An employee was taking a break outside his work vehicle at a convenience store when he was attacked by a customer with a pair of scissors. He called 911. When the operator asked which way his attacker had gone, he stepped away from his vehicle and the attacker hit him with his van. The employee suffered a head injury; multiple broken ribs; abrasions all over his body from being dragged by the van; and injuries to the right shoulder, right knee, right ankle, and lower back.
An employee was adjusting the belt on a machine when their finger became caught between the belt and the pulley. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was cutting beef shanks with a saw. The sawblade amputated his right middle fingertip to the nail.
An employee was working as a casting assistant in a casting area when he began sweating profusely and feeling ill. He was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration and heat exhaustion.

An employee was changing the pad die on a machine. The die and the old pad were lifted with a hoist. The pad started swinging and broke the employee's left middle finger as the employee tried to stop it. The employee was hospitalized, requiring surgery.
On August 23, 2021, a temporary employee fell through a soft spot in a roof. He landed on the ground about 10 feet below and suffered a broken leg.
An employee was walking out of a storage area on a warehouse floor when a clamp truck struck him. He suffered a broken pelvis.

An employee was removing a hickey from the back of a web press. The employee's rag was pulled into the press, which in turn pulled in his left fingers between the plate and water form cylinder. The employee suffered amputation of the left thumb and degloving of the left hand.
An employee was lowering a vehicle lift when it crushed his right index finger, causing a partial amputation.
An employee was sanding the bottom of a boat when he experienced pain in his chest and left arm. The employee was hospitalized for a cardiac event.

An employee was backing up a forklift to line up and put a pallet of product in a storage rack, when he struck a rack beam. The beam dislodged and hit him in the back. He was hospitalized for a contusion.

An employee was unloading material from a semi trailer using a standing pallet jack. While exiting the trailer, the employee struck a recycling dumpster being carried by another pallet jack. The employee suffered lacerations and fractures to the right foot.
An employee was changing a product transfer hose. Sodium hydroxide splashed onto the employee's face, eyes, and torso. The employee sustained chemical burn to the eye(s).
An employee was taking inventory in a warehouse aisleway. A lift truck struck the employee, who suffered a jaw and neck laceration from a metal part of a storage rack.
An employee was shoveling excess dirt from the bed of his truck. While exiting the truck, the employee fell to the ground, resulting in three broken vertebrae.

Two employees were clearing debris from the back of a dump truck after it had dumped its load of soil. They lifted the tailgate up, but it fell and crushed an employee's right ring finger against the trailer bed. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was about to use a captive bolt gun to stun a bull that was down in a cattle pen. The bull got up and knocked the employee to the ground; the stun gun went off and struck the employee in the left thigh. The employee suffered a broken femur.
An employee was maintaining an electrical box. He suffered an electrical burn to the right hand and arm and was hospitalized.
An employee fell off the rear of a golf cart as it turned. The employee's head struck the concrete, causing head trauma.
