An employee tripped over a garment rack in the entrance of a locker room. The employee fell, striking their head on the concrete floor and losing consciousness for several minutes. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was helping rig up a drilling rig. While he was driving a securement pin on an upper spreader beam, another spreader beam (stacked on the first one) slid over and struck his left foot. The foot was broken.
At about 6:00 p.m. on August 23, 2021, an employee became ill while working as a package handler. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.

An employee was inspecting vehicle repairs in the delivery department. The employee felt dizzy, nauseated, and was having cramps in their shoulders and neck. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was doing maintenance work on an air handling unit when he tripped on a condensation line. His left hand contacted a belt, which caused amputations to his ring and middle fingertips.
While walking on the sales floor, an employee tripped and fell sustaining a fractured right hip.

An employee was working on a piece of welded equipment. Having been lifted on one side by a crane, the equipment was being supported by the crane on one side and by a horse and braces on the other. While the employee was under the equipment adjusting the horse, the equipment shifted; the horse struck and injured the employee.
An employee was reconnecting a demo fixture. He was shocked while stripping a wire and fell from an A-frame ladder, landing 3 feet below. He suffered a contusion and hematoma to the lower back.
At 9:15 p.m. on August 23, 2021, a utility worker developed signs of heat exhaustion. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from dehydration.
An employee fell while stepping on a box to crush it. The employee landed on the ground and suffered a broken femur.
An employee tripped while carrying a bucket of hot tar. The bucket dropped and splashed tar on his feet and right arm. He suffered burns to the arm and both ankles.

At 12:02 p.m. on August 26, 2021, an employee lost consciousness while working on a rooftop. The employee slid off the rooftop, fell about 30 feet, and suffered fractures to a shoulder blade, the pelvis, three ribs, and both heels. The employee was hospitalized. Fall protection was not being worn at the time of the incident.
A correctional officer was assaulted by an inmate. The officer sustained a traumatic head injury requiring hospitalization.
A flagger was struck by motorists, suffering fractures to an ankle, a lower leg, and a neck vertebra, as well as head and arm lacerations.
An employee was gathering up rented materials from a wedding. A fire started and the employee suffered burns.
An employee fell from a conveyor belt, landing on the floor 1 1/2 feet below and suffering a broken right knee.

An employee was cutting a block of wood with a saw when the wood block pinched and the saw went across the employee's right hand, resulting in a laceration and a subsequent amputation of the index finger.

Employees were working in a 5-foot-deep trench. While an employee was repositioning pipes, the gravel layer toward the bottom of the trench gushed out of one of the sidewalls of the trench and engulfed his right foot, trapping him. Simultaneously, the force of the rushing soil pushed his lower right leg sideways. He suffered a broken tibia and was hospitalized.
An employee slipped on a wet lawn, fell, and suffered a broken ankle. The employee was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
On August 23, 2021, an employee tripped and fell out of the passenger side of a postal delivery vehicle, landing on the ground and suffering a broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was reversing a forklift out of a pick location and struck a plastic barrier around the steel support beams. The employee's right little finger was crushed between the forklift and the barrier, resulting in a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee's hand was caught in the track of an oven. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was operating a zero-turn lawnmower when it ran over a pipe, lodging the pipe between the deck and the ground. As he was trying to remove the pipe, the lawnmower fell and struck his finger. He suffered an amputation.

An employee was placing sod alongside a roadway. After being hit by a car mirror, the employee jumped back and fell into the path of a skid steer that was backing up. The skid steer ran over his legs, breaking both of them.
An employee developed heat stress after processing donations in a hot, humid warehouse. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was operating a crimping machine and caught his right index finger in the machine resulting in a laceration. The employee was hospitalized.

Two employees were working together to rotate the arbor on a slitter and tape the slitter rubbers. As an employee was taping the rubbers, the rotating arbor grabbed his left hand and pulled his index and middle fingers into a pinch point. Both fingers were amputated.

An employee was working on the production floor in a staging area where she was folding and labeling cartons. The employee stepped out of the aisles of stacked pallets and was struck by a reversing forklift transporting a pallet of cartons. The forklift struck her right foot and she was hospitalized.
On August 24, 2021, an employee slipped off rigging equipment and suffered a broken heel.
An employee was removing a vent hose from a rotary valve. The employee's left index finger was caught in the equipment, which amputated the fingertip at the top knuckle.
An employee was using a riding mower when it got caught in a tree branch. The employee had to lower the roll-over protection. Its hinge caught his left thumb and amputated the tip.
An employee was verifying that the extrusion was feeding correctly when the glove on their left hand was pulled into the extrusion rollers resulting in amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee was leaving the building using a sidewalk ramp when they fell and suffered a broken bone in their left knee and a broken left arm.
An employee was installing a pallet/conveyor belt system when his right hand was caught between two metal pallets. He suffered an amputation to the index fingertip.

An employee was on horseback in a cattle pen, trying to herd a sick cow out of the lot. The horse lost its footing and fell onto the employee, breaking his left tibia and fibula. He was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was using an automatic bander to band a wheel. His gloved finger was pulled in and caught in the banding, which removed the flesh from his left index finger above the second knuckle.

On the morning of August 24, 2021, after working with another employee to move cattle from horseback, an employee rode his horse into a barn. He was later found lying face down with a head injury, having been kicked in the head by the horse.
An employee was loading a cargo plane. The employee's right index finger was caught between a railing and a pallet, and the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was performing a die change on a 150-ton press when he began to feel weak, suffering from possible dehydration and/or heat exhaustion.

The injured employee was training a co-worker in a weld cell and putting parts into the fixture. The injured employee's left middle finger got caught in the head rest clamp resulting in a partial amputation of the finger at the nailbed.
An employee became ill and was hospitalized, possibly suffering from heat-related illness.
An employee was guiding a steel plate into a press brake. The plate slipped from the clamp that was suspending it in the air. It fell on the employee, who suffered a broken wrist.
An employee was operating a ring roller machine. Her left hand was pulled into the machine, which lacerated her fingers and broke her thumb.

An employee was standing between a motorized pallet jack and an empty stack of pallets, filling an order. A forklift struck the stack of pallets, which pinched the employee against the pallet jack. The employee's hip was broken.

On August 24, 2021, an employee was using a pry bar to expand brake shoes and springs. The bar slipped and the brake shoe closed on the tip of the employee's left ring finger, causing the amputation of the fingertip.

A pizza delivery employee was approaching a customer's residence when he was shot from behind by assailants attempting a robbery. He sustained bullet wounds from a handgun in the right knee and right elbow and was hospitalized.
A flagger was struck by a vehicle, resulting in injuries to their shoulder and back.
An employee was loading an ATV onto a flatbed truck. The ATV rolled over onto the employee, who suffered a broken jaw, nose, and eye socket.

An employee was operating a table saw when the guard got stuck. As the employee was freeing the guard, their gloved hand was caught by the sawblade and drawn in. The employee sustained a finger amputation.

On August 24, 2021, an employee was unjamming a pad lock from an energized bar loader machine when their left middle finger was caught in a pinch point. The employee sustained a partial fingertip amputation.
An employee slipped on damp underlayment and fell off a second-story roof, landing on the ground and suffering fractures to the hip and face.
A crane operator came out of a crane cab to move cardboard boxes, fell about 30 feet, and suffered multiple fractures and a kidney laceration.
A duct support structure was being assembled. Its framing fell, pinning an employee under it. The employee suffered a broken arm (with muscle damage) and a laceration to the leg.
An employee was operating a powered pallet jack on a loading dock. The pallet jack collided with a forklift, and the employee suffered a broken femur.

An employee had just finished pouring a mold using a pouring ladle. The ladle would not stop pouring; while it was being moved by crane, it spilled molten metal onto the employee. The employee's right leg and foot were burned.
An employee was rolling a large rock when his right index finger was caught between it and a skid steer bucket. The finger was amputated to the knuckle.
An employee became ill while installing the wall of a storm drain. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat stress.
An employee was using a table saw to cut laminate flooring. The saw kicked back and the employee's fingers were amputated.
The injured employee was assisting a resident and another employee. The injured employee fell backward to the ground and sustained a back injury.
While working in the deli, an employee fell on the floor and broke their hip.
An employee's right hand and fingers were caught between a tablet press and a lid. The employee suffered a laceration and an open fracture to the little finger.

An employee was on top of a 30-yard roll-off box that was loaded with pallets, trying to remove the pallets from the sides so that he could tarp the box. As he tried to dislodge a pallet that was sticking up out of the top of the box, it suddenly came free. He stumbled backward, then fell off the box to the ground, suffering a cut on the left side of the head and a concussion.

An employee was standing on the second or third rung of an A-frame ladder, holding a piece of sheet metal and using pliers to put tension on it. The rubber grip on the pliers came off and the employee fell, suffering lower back fractures.

Employees were trying to fix a hose on a skid loader's concrete breaker attachment. The skid loader attached to the breaker, raised it, and began to rotate it forward to give the mechanic access. The breaker fell off the skid loader and broke the right leg of the mechanic, who was standing to the left front of the skid loader.

Three employees were emptying a full container of trash into an outside dumpster. As they were lifting the container over the edge of the dumpster, it came down and caught one employee's right hand against the dumpster's edge. The employee's middle and ring fingertips were amputated, including the nails.
An employee fell from the top of a stack of forms, landing about 5 feet below and suffering a broken femur and hip.
On August 25, 2021, an employee slipped on liquid on an operating room floor, fell, and suffered a broken right femur. She was hospitalized.

An employee was loading plant material onto a truck. The plant's 50-pound, 20-gallon plastic container broke, causing the employee to lose his balance and fall off the truck. He suffered three herniated disks in his neck.
An employee suffered dehydration and was hospitalized.
On August 25, 2021, an employee fell in a stairwell. She was hospitalized, having suffered a broken femur.
An employee was loading and offloading and was struck by a forklift operated by a vendor resulting in amputation of the employee's leg and hospitalization.

An employee was unjamming a roller from a paper machine. The employee pushed on the roller to remove a roll of splice tape that was preventing it from ejecting and caught his right ring finger between the roller shaft and the machine frame. He suffered a crushed fingertip, which was medically amputated.
A postal employee was delivering mail to a residence when three large dogs broke through a fence and attacked. The employee suffered bites to both arms and the right thigh that required stitches.

At about 9:02 p.m. on August 25, 2021, an employee was trying to clear clogged wastewater pumps. The employee turned off power to the pumps and started the procedure to clear the lines. Upon opening a line, the employee was sprayed by heated liquid and suffered second-degree burns to the torso and upper right arm. The employee was hospitalized.
An potential employee's left leg was pinned and broken between the forklift he was operating and another forklift.
An employee fell about 4 feet backward while trying to connect lights. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.

On August 25, 2021, an employee was standing on a platform next to an extruding line when hot plastic was expelled from the line during startup. It landed on the employee's cheek, ear, and forearm, burning the skin.
After finishing pole top rescue training in the heat, an employee became ill and was hospitalized, having suffered a myocardial infarction.
An employee was ensuring that equipment was running. The employee reported a lack of energy and cramping and was hospitalized with heat stress.
An employee lost balance while walking and his left hand contacted fan blades. He suffered partial amputations to the little and ring fingers.

Two employees were pushing a parts rack through a facility. They stopped to move two vacuum pack hoses that were on the floor blocking the path of travel. While one of the employees was moving the vacuum packs, he stepped on the hoses, lost his balance, fell into a guardrail, and then landed on his right hip. His hip was broken.
An employee was walking when they slipped on a wet floor and fell, resulting in a broken right ankle.
Two employees were arguing in the company parking lot. One employee shot the other employee in the leg. The injured employee was hospitalized.

An employee was using an emery cloth to polish a round stock bar on a conventional lathe. The shaft grabbed the emery cloth and pulled the employee's right hand against the shaft. He was able to get free, but the shaft then pulled his left hand and lower arm around itself. His forearm was broken.
An employee became dehydrated while supervising a roofing project.

On August 26, 2021, at 1:30 p.m., an employee was walking across an aisle to a pedestrian walkway when a forklift swerved toward the employee and the rear wheel of the forklift ran over employee's right foot. The employee suffered broken bones in their right foot that required hospitalization.

An employee was using an 8-foot, A-frame ladder while pulling wiring for a new security camera through the wall to the outdoor loading dock area. While stepping down the ladder, the ladder tipped away from the building and the employee tried to step down again to stabilize it. The ladder continued to fall and the employee fell onto a guardrail and struck the ground, resulting in fractures to the face and various bruises.

At about 2:00 p.m. on August 26, 2021, an employee was replacing a pulley on a conveyor belt. The employee's left hand was pinched between the pillow block bearing and the base plate, and the employee suffered amputations to the tip of the little finger, half of the ring finger, and half of the middle finger.

On August 26, 2021, an employee was working from an aerial lift basket, installing metal wall panels on a new building. He fell out of the basket, landed 10 feet below on a lower canopy roof, then bounced/rolled off and fell 15 feet to the dirt ground. He suffered a broken wrist, broken ribs, a ruptured spleen, and a punctured lung and was hospitalized.

A hoisted metal cover, about 3 feet by 3 feet, fell off the hook of an overhead crane that had been used to lift it. It landed on the left hand of an employee who was cleaning under it, and he suffered fractures and a partial amputation (below the nail) to the left middle finger.

An employee was reinstalling a chain link fence. The employee was holding a bar/pipe that passed along the top of the fence to hold it up. The bar/pipe fell and hit the employee in the shoulder area, causing a neck/shoulder injury.
An employee picked up a handgun and it discharged, causing a gunshot wound to the employee's leg.
An employee became dehydrated while delivering packages.
An employee was repairing a flat tire on a forklift when he began to experience heat-related illnesses and later passed out. He was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was sitting on a stool at a cash register, scanning purchased items. Her foot got stuck between the stool and the bag carousel, causing her to fall to the floor and suffer a broken hip.
An employee was rigging a steel road plate. The tip of the employee's right middle finger was caught between a lifting chain and a lifting ring. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee had placed a casting on a crane hook and was operating the crane by remote control. When the employee grabbed the casting to turn it, it fell off the hook and struck the employee's fingers. The employee suffered a partial amputation to the right ring finger, as well as lacerations to the right ring and middle fingers.

An employee had been directing a concrete truck. The employee's right hand got stuck between the truck's chute and the hopper of the concrete pump. The employee sustained crushed fingers and an injury to the wrist.

An employee had just washed out an emulsifier feed auger, a piece of equipment with two rotating augers. He noticed that liquid was no longer draining from the equipment. As he tried to free any product that might be causing a plug, the lower auger amputated his right index finger up to the nail.

An employee was stepping around caution tape surrounding a newly painted floor when she slipped and fell. While attempting to stop the fall, the employee fell on her right hand, resulting in a broken wrist that required surgery and hospitalization.
An employee was cleaning the air cylinder in a tearing machine and amputated their left middle finger.
An employee slipped and fell to the ground while walking down a mountain. The employee suffered broken bones and was hospitalized.
Employees were stacking pipe. As they added a pipe to the third tier using a skid steer, the pipe slid and fell onto an employee. The employee suffered an injury to the left ankle and leg.
A temporary employee's right arm was crushed between two dies on a die cut press.
An employee was picking up a pipe from a plasma table. The pipe slipped out of her hand, catching it against the plasma table. The employee suffered an amputation to the right middle fingertip.
An employee was mowing the grounds on a rider-mower when he began to feel hip pain and couldn't move.

An employee was unloading liquid asphalt cement from a semi-tanker. He left to retrieve a new gasket for the tanker's hose. The valve was opened while he was gone, and when he returned and removed the hose, 300-degree asphalt cement sprayed out of the connection and struck him. He suffered second-degree burns to his left and right forearm, left thigh, lower stomach, and right shin toward the ankle.

An employee was adding a second trailer with a dolly to the rear of a trailer. The employee's right leg got stuck on the dolly and the employee fell on their left leg, suffering an injury to the left hip.
An employee slipped on yellow paint on the floor and fell, suffering a head injury.

An employee was repairing truck wheels. A socket the employee was using cracked as the employee was using it to torque a hub nut. The employee fell to the ground on his back and suffered a lumbar strain.
An employee was lifting a bucket of bolts weighing approximately 60 to 70 pounds when they suffered an inguinal hernia that required surgery.

After working from an aerial bucket for about 10 minutes, an employee developed cramps in his arms and shoulders. He lowered himself to the ground, where he lost consciousness. He was hospitalized, suffering from heat exhaustion.
An employee was watering plants. The employee tripped over a garden hose and fell to the ground, suffering a broken arm.
On August 26, 2021, an employee was working on the dough production line and suffered the partial amputation of their finger while clearing dough from the opening. The employee was hospitalized.
A dog groomer was bitten by a dog on August 26, 2021. Their hand began to swell and they were hospitalized for treatment.

On August 26, 2021, an employee was turning a stand-up forklift when it struck a pole, then a rack. The employee's foot was caught between the forklift and the rack, causing a partial amputation to the foot.
An employee was repositioning a tool that was on a forklift when their right little finger was pinched between the tool and the forklift, resulting in an amputation just past the fingernail.
A forklift ran over an employee's left foot, breaking it.

An employee was loading a die onto a press. While maneuvering it to see if it was loaded correctly, the employee slipped on some oil on the floor and braced herself by holding onto the die. The die fell off the press and onto her right foot, breaking it.
An employee was performing concrete work when they began experiencing heat-related illness.
An employee was cleaning a tablet press. The press amputated the tip of the employee's left middle finger.
An employee slipped while picking up a food tray and fell to the floor. The employee suffered an injury to the right knee.
An employee was driving a utility cart when his left leg was caught between the cart and a post. The leg was broken.
A work assist vehicle struck an employee and broke her right femur.
A firefighter suffered a foot laceration while fighting a wildfire, resulting in hospitalizationa and surgery.
An employee was webbing paper through the glue unit of a printing press. The employee's hand was pulled between two rollers and crushed.
An employee fell backward onto a concrete floor and became lightheaded.
An employee was cutting a wall stud with a circular saw. The saw blade hit a knot in the wood; the saw kicked back and amputated the employee's left index fingertip at the first knuckle.
An employee attempted to sit on a shoe bench when she contacted the edge of the bench and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured hip.
An employee was moving a forklift onto a trailer. His foot was caught between the lift and a pallet, and he suffered broken toes.
An employee was installing reinforcing cables to an automated racking system and fell 18 feet from the platform, resulting in a broken tailbone.
An employee stumbled and fell. He was shaking and became unresponsive. The employee sustained heat stroke.
An employee was connecting steel while 20 feet above the ground when they fell off the beam, resulting in injuries that required hospitalization.

On August 27, 2021, an employee was using a hammer to tap a sprocket on the tracks of a skid steer. A metal flake hit the employee's face. The employee suffered a temporary loss of sight in the left eye and was hospitalized.

A crew was setting a utility pole when it contacted a primary power line. Two employees were holding the bottom of the pole. One of them suffered first- and second-degree burns to the right toe and heel.

On August 27, 2021, an employee was using a patty machine to make hamburger patties. The employee was straightening a metal mold plate below the knockout cup when the machine amputated the tips of two fingers on the employee's left hand. The machine was not guarded at the time.
An employee was standing on the side of a trench when he fell into it along with loose soil. The employee suffered a broken leg/foot.

An employee was operating a tractor when it flipped and ejected him. Its back tire then rolled over him, and he suffered a collapsed lung, broken ribs on the right side, and lacerations to the left hand and right arm.
At 3:30 p.m. on August 27, 2021, a teacher slipped on hand sanitizer that had fallen to a classroom floor. She fell, suffering a broken hip. She was hospitalized and underwent surgery.
An employee was walking next to a vehicle laying traffic cones when the vehicle ran over his right foot, resulting in broken bones.
An employee fell to the floor while trying to sit down, landing on her left side and suffering injuries to the left hip and knee.

An employee was removing a part from under a rotational mold cover, held by a chain hoist about 6-7 feet above the working surface. The chain slipped about 1 foot, after which the load brake activated; this caused the cover to bounce off of the chain hook, strike the employee, and then come to rest on top of him. He suffered multiple fractures.
An employee was lifting a steel flat bar onto rollers to straighten it. The employee's left ring finger was caught between a roller and the bar, causing an amputation to the fingertip.
An employee was walking around a stack of tubs when her right toe struck a dolly and she fell to the floor. She suffered a broken left hip.
An employee suffered a right thumb amputation while using an upcut chop saw. The saw was guarded at the time.

On August 27, 2021, an employee was operating a pallet jack at a warehouse distribution facility. He was standing in an aisle, trying to reposition the pallet jack to lift another pallet, when the jack's drive wheels spun on the wet floor. The jack then slid toward him, pinning his leg against a pallet of boxes and causing a laceration to the calf. He was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a chop saw to cross-cut out sections of bad wood. While clearing a piece of wood, the saw actuated, contacting the employee's left hand. The employee suffered a laceration to their thumb and index finger, and surgical amputation of the left index fingertip.
An employee stood on the edge of a conveyor to view a jam. When he stepped back down, his left foot slipped and got caught in a roller on the conveyor, resulting in amputation below the knee.
An employee was lifting a casting using a crane when the crane hook slipped off the casting and the casting fell onto the employee's left foot, resulting in multiple fractures.

At 10:30 a.m. on August 26, 2021, an employee was helping unload material from a flatbed trailer. He was standing on product when he tripped and fell, striking his head on the ground and losing consciousness as well as suffering two broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor when it caught the employee's hair. The employee suffered a scalping injury.
An employee had been lining up the field for a tractor. The tractor rolled over the employee's leg resulting in a fracture and sprain.
Two employees were troubleshooting a pontoon boat motor. The motor began to run and the flywheel of its engine contacted an employee's right middle finger. The employee's fingertip was amputated.
An employee was maneuvering and positioning a vehicle hood assembly on a dolly. The assembly fell and a hood struck the employee's right arm, breaking it.
An employee was walking to the back of a store when she tripped and fell to the ground, resulting in a laceration to her forehead and pain in her wrist. She was hospitalized.

An employee was installing a column and a beam from a grated deck that was 15 feet high. The employee fell to the floor through an opening in the grating that was 4x4 feet and had been removed to stand up the column. The employee suffered a broken back that required hospitalization.
An employee fell from a ladder to the floor, suffering a leg injury that required surgery.

An employee was sweeping up broken bottles when she slipped on a plastic bottle and fell, her right leg striking an anchor bolt next to a support plate. She suffered a laceration and fracture to the right knee.
An employee was troubleshooting a bander. As he was trying to move a folded piece of paper in the bander, the strap head caught his left middle finger, causing an amputation. He was hospitalized.

An employee was assisting in landing the top of a cut-off H-pile that was being hoisted by a crane. When the piece touched down on the deck it slid and rolled as the employee was moving to another area. The bottom of the H-pile pinched the employee's foot against the top of another H-pile resulting in a broken metatarsal.
An employee was walking on a rocky surface and fell backward while picking up a water bottle on the ground. The employee suffered an injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a miter saw and amputated two fingers and the thumb on their right hand.
An employee tripped and fell while walking.

An employee was inside an elevator when the elevator suddenly dropped and the employee slammed into the floor, resulting in a lumbar transverse process fracture, as well as back, hip, and shoulder pain.
An employee's left foot caught a pallet that was on the floor. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken right hip. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 29, 2021, an employee was cleaning dough from the roller of a chunker hopper. As he was removing a piece of dough, his left hand was caught by a roller of the chunker machine. He suffered an amputation of the index finger, as well as crushing injuries to the left middle and ring fingers.
An employee fell while climbing down a tree, landing on the ground 10 feet below and suffering a broken lower back vertebra.
An employee was working on an extruder barrel heater when he contacted a 480-volt terminal. He suffered an electrical burn to the right little finger.
An employee was taking tubes out of a crib with a crane. The tubes slipped and his hand was caught between them. He suffered an amputation to the little finger.
An employee was painting the top of a roof when he fell through a skylight into the machine shop below. He landed on the roof of a truck, then fell to the concrete floor. He suffered leg injuries.
On August 29, 2021, a temporary employee was backing up a stand-up forklift when his left big toe was caught between the forklift and a rail. The toe was amputated.
An employee was taking food out of a rethermalizer and putting it into bins when hot water got into her gloves causing second degree burns to her left forearm.

An employee was working to lift and flip a 1,100-pound disc on a table to grind the opposite side. Softeners had been put between the disc and the sling because the disc had sharp edges. During the lift, the softeners slipped out and the nylon sling was sliced by the sharp edges of the disc. The disc then fell onto the employee's foot. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured foot.
An employee fell while climbing over a retaining wall, landing on the ground and suffering a broken wrist.
An employee was trying to raise the mast of a service rig. Something let loose or moved, causing his right hand to be caught. He suffered lacerations to fingers on the hand.
An employee was carrying a steel beam for steel sheeting attachments. The employee fell over 17 feet from a steel support beam to a lower level and sustained broken arms and ribs.

An employee was dismounting returned mounted wheel and tire packages. A tire/wheel assembly was secured on the mounting machine, and the employee was trying to engage the bead roller when it struck his face. He suffered a broken tooth, a closed fracture, and a laceration to the lip.
At about 2:50 p.m. on August 30, 2021, an employee was holding a 2-by-4 in place when a nail from a nail gun struck him in the eye. He was hospitalized.

An employee was constructing a platform for a film set. The employee was standing on the platform, when he lost his footing and fell about 10 feet to the cement floor, landing on his left side. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his left arm and pelvis.
An employee was working on a casting in the welding department. A fork truck backed into his right leg causing a severe laceration that required surgery and hospitalization.

On August 30, 2021, an employee was opening the door to a pallet magazine while operating a forklift. As the employee backed up the forklift, the employee's fingers were pinched between its frame and the magazine door. The employee suffered a fingertip amputation.
An employee was cutting open shrink wrap using a box knife. The knife slipped and amputated his left little finger.
An employee had been performing roofing work and was hospitalized with a heat-related illness.

A driver was preparing to unload a tanker trailer into a customer's silo. When the driver removed a cap from the customer's air supply, pressure caused the cap to hit the driver's right leg. Their right leg was broken and lacerated.

An employee was loading a trailer with a forklift. The product shifted and some items fell off the pallet that was on his forks. After he dismounted to pick up the product, the forklift's parking brake failed and the forklift rolled forward. The forks pinned his right ankle to the pallet, causing multiple fractures to the ankle.
An employee was installing a chain onto a brick conveyor when his finger was caught and amputated between the chain and sprocket.
Employees had been replacing a conveyor roller. When the conveyor was restarted, an employee's gloves were caught in the chain resulting in amputation of the right index fingertip.
An employee was pulling a loaded patient gurney through the woods when their right little fingertip was caught and amputated between the frame of the gurney and a large rock.
An employee was removing a piece of wood from a conveyor. The conveyor caught and fractured the employee's right arm; the employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working with a wrench. The employee fell backward into a valve, suffering an injury that required hospitalization.
An employee slipped on a metal pan and fell to the ground 16-20 feet below, suffering a compression fracture to the pelvis and bruised lungs.

An employee was using a powered pallet jack to move product. The stabilizer/drive wheel lost contact with the floor. When the wheel caught traction, the employee's lower right leg was pinned between the jack and the wall. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the lower leg.
An employee tripped and fell, suffering a broken leg.
An employee was driving a forklift when the back of her heel was crushed between the forklift and a steel roof beam. She suffered an injury to the left ankle and Achilles tendon.
An employee was loading pallets on a pallet truck. The pallets fell and landed on the employee's right hand, amputating the index finger.

An employee was on his second SCUBA dive of the day, stacking tires for removal from the seabed of a failed artificial reef. He developed vertigo and nausea, which worsened when he surfaced. He was hospitalized, suffering from decompression sickness.

On August 30, 2021, an employee was unpacking and redistributing assembly materials. He used a scalpel to cut the banding on a bundle of vertically placed steel L-profiles. The L-profiles then fell over and onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to both legs.

An employee was at a well site, adjusting studs in a tubing head with a blowout preventer and the tubing head in the air. The blowout preventer twisted and the employee's finger was crushed between the nut and the backup. The employee suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was adjusting a circuit breaker from an elevated manlift. The employee fell from the manlift, landing about 20 feet below and suffering a fractured back bone.

An employee was walking to pick up materials when he slipped and fell onto a wooden board. He suffered a puncture wound to the right side of his head, caused by a nail that was sticking out of the board.
On August 30, 2021, an employee was operating a stationary electric bandsaw when the saw blade amputated the employee's fingertip.
An employee was leaving a store when a gust of hurricane-level wind picked her up and tossed her to the ground. She suffered a broken hip.
Two employees were working on a 600-amp breaker. One employee suffered an electrical shock and burns to his face, head, upper torso, and his left hand due to an arc flash.

On August 30, 2021, an employee was using a cut-off machine to cut a PVC pipe when his T-shirt got caught between the guard and the blade, pulling the saw back into his right shoulder. The employee suffered a laceration to his right shoulder and lower arm pit area, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was on a ladder, putting ceiling tiles back in the grid in a loading dock area. The loading dock's garage door then opened, and the employee jumped from the ladder to avoid being struck by the door. He suffered a broken ankle.

An employee was inspecting a Utility Task Vehicle (UTV). The employee topped off the coolant and started the UTV. He then went to the front of the UTV to check for a coolant leak. The UTV lunged forward pinning the employee against a building. The employee sustained fractures and contusions to their femur(s).

An employee was hanging a ladder on a ladder rack in a trench box when the ladder slipped from their grip and pinched their finger between the ladder and ladder rack. Their left middle fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was opening a pocketknife when it stabbed the employee's left thigh.

An employee was operating a stand-up reach forklift in a warehouse. The forklift struck a guardrail and ejected the employee, who landed on the floor and suffered multiple rib fractures, a lung issue, and muscle damage around the hip.

Employees were at a site to remove old glass from a building and install new glass when it began to rain. An employee was stowing a lift when he stumbled over a curb/curb bumper and dislocated his knee.
An employee was climbing down an A-frame ladder when his foot slipped on a rung and he fell to the floor, breaking his ankle.

On August 31, 2021, an employee was running an extruder. As the employee used a metal spatula to scrape built-up extrudate from the chill knife, he lost his balance and his little finger was caught in the rollers. The fingertip was degloved.
An employee was removing pieces of metal from a shearing machine. While clearing some film coating, the shear contacted his right hand, partially amputating the ring and little fingers.

An employee was checking temperatures with his pallet jack parked behind him. A reach truck came around a corner and struck the parked pallet jack, which rolled onto the employee's legs and knocked him to the ground. He suffered an ankle dislocation and a hairline fracture.
An employee was using a pallet jack to move ice cream in the warehouse. When they made a right turn, the pallet jack struck a bollard. The employee sustained a fractured pelvis.

While moving from a fixed ladder to a roof, an employee slipped and fell. The employee landed on the concrete ground about 15 feet below and suffered a dislocated elbow, a broken wrist, a dislocated knee, multiple broken ribs, and cuts to the chin and head.
While handling the hydraulic lines of an excavator, an employee's hand was lacerated and injected with hydraulic fluid. The employee was hospitalized.

On August 31, 2021, an employee was removing a bolt in order to remove a section of some scaffolding. A scaffold fell off a nearby forklift and landed on the employee's left leg, causing multiple fractures. The employee was hospitalized.
Two employees were working on a metal brake. The brake was closed on one employee's right thumb, crushing it and resulting in an amputation injury.
An employee was installing a roll of tape on a strip roller machine. Their right middle finger was caught and amputated in the machine when it cycled.
An employee was installing cable service in an attic. He fell through a sheet rock ceiling, landing about 9 feet below and suffered a broken right kneecap.
An employee fell from a roof to the cement driveway below, suffering a broken wrist and cuts to the chin and elbow.

While working from the bucket of a bucket truck to replace residential telecommunication lines, an employee contacted energized 720V overhead power lines. The employee received electric shock injuries including burns and an amputation to the left arm. The employee was hospitalized.
A temporary employee was sorting/stacking blocks on the conveyor line. A chunk of concrete got stuck between the conveyor and a dead roller. The employee went to remove the chunk of concrete.
An employee was walking near a pallet stacking machine when a stack of pallets fell on him. The employee sustained head trauma and cuts.
While walking across the break room, an employee tripped on a broken floor tile and fell to the floor. The employee sustained head trauma.

An employee was helping an equipment operator move a guide back into position. The employee's right foot was caught under the ram on the equipment when it was lowered, which caused an amputation to the toe about 1/4 inch from the tip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was walking down the stairs in a client's apartment when he slipped and fell down the stairs. The employee sustained three fractured vertebrae and bruised ribs.
An employee operating a forklift turned a corner and the forklift struck a pallet that was loaded on an unattended, parked forklift. The employee was hospitalized with a broken leg.
While walking inside the hospital, an employee slipped on food waste and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured patella.
An employee was helping to move a desk when they tripped an fell. The employee was hospitalized for a broken pelvis.
An employee fell off the fourth rung of a 6-foot ladder while conducting maintenance on an airline.
An employee was accessing the top of a shipping container using an extension ladder when he fell and sustained a fractured wrist.
An employee was working on a 1-inch ball control valve when it caught and lacerated his left index finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee had been setting up before entering a manhole. He became overheated and was later hospitalized with dehydration.
An employee operating a radial arm saw was drawn into the saw and sustained a severe laceration to the arm.
An employee was working on a pumping unit. The employee's left middle and ring fingers got caught in the sheave and belt on the pulley system of the pumping unit resulting in fingertip amputations.

An employee was using a hose to spread a lightweight mixture on the roof of a building when he began to suffer symptoms of heat stress, which included cramps, and was unable to move. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.

An employee was installing a window screen outside a two-story house. The ladder he was on fell, and he fell with it, landing on the ground and suffering bruising to a back vertebra, a broken elbow, and multiple body bruises. He was hospitalized.
An employee was backing up a forklift when it struck a warehouse guardrail. The employee suffered a compound fracture to the lower right leg and was hospitalized.

On September 1, 2021, an employee was selecting an order using a pallet jack. As he went to pass another pallet jack, his upper torso contacted a rack resulting in a broken clavicle and broken ribs. He was hospitalized.
An employee was walking on the concrete sidewalk in front of the lobby door when she tripped and fell onto the sidewalk dislocating her right shoulder.
An employee fell down stairs, from the second floor to a landing between the first and second floors, in a parking garage. The employee suffered a dislocated and fractured right ankle.
An employee was operating a forklift. As he turned a corner, his foot was caught and crushed between the forklift and poles.
An employee fell from the side of a platform, landing on the ground about 4 feet below and suffering a back fracture.

An employee was walking on top of floor joists, proceeding back to finish installing the joist hangers. The employee lost his balance when he stepped on an unsecured floor joist and fell approximately 20 feet to the floor. He sustained a back injury.
An employee was loading a trailer when the tension cable wrapped around their right thumb and amputated it.
An employee was carrying empty milk crates down a set of fixed stairs. The employee slipped and fell down about 10 steps. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.

An employee was using an emery cloth to polish a shot pin in a lathe. The cloth caught on the pin and pulled the employee's hand into the lathe. The employee suffered fractures to the hand and fingers.
An employee was removing a sled attachment from his pallet jack. The sled fell on his right hand resulting in amputation of his middle fingertip.
An employee was splicing internet cable from a ladder. The employee fell from the ladder to the ground 19.5 feet below and suffered broken ribs.
An employee was cleaning the edge of a pool when she fell in and suffered a broken ankle. She was hospitalized.
While instructing a new employee, the injured employee was struck by a triple pallet jack and sustained a fractured ankle.
An employee was cleaning a liver harvest machine. While removing liver/gizzard parts from a plastic auger, the rotating auger amputated his right index fingertip.
An employee working in a warehouse began having cramps throughout his body. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.

An employee was securing a ladder to the upper roof with a bungee cable. The bungee cable snapped, causing the feet of the ladder to move. The employee fell with the ladder and sustained a broken arm.
An employee was cutting a plastic tray on a table saw when their hand was cut by the saw.

An employee was disassembling a manhole cover lifter to be loaded into a work van. As the employee was removing the magnetic attachment and bent over to pick it up, the long handle fell down, hitting the employee on the head. The employee suffered a concussion.
An employee tripped and fell on a raised area of the floor and sustained a fracture to their femur.
An employee tripped over a cart corral while pushing a cart. The employee suffered a spinal cord injury.
Roof trusses fell while they were being installed, striking an employee and breaking the employee's left arm.
An employee was hospitalized for an allergic reaction to flowers delivered to the emergency room.
An employee was struck with a hand tool used by another employee and suffered a knee injury.

An employee was removing cases from the side door of the freezer section of a trailer. He fell approximately 4 feet from the trailer deck to the asphalt parking lot, landed on his back, and suffered three broken ribs and an injured tailbone.

An employee was transporting a trunnion from a kiln on a forklift when the trunnion rolled off. He stopped the forklift and went to stop the rolling trunnion. The trunnion rolled onto his right hand causing crushing injuries.

An employee was shooting brads into the top of a house. The brads came in sleeves, held together by plastic fasteners designed to fall off when the gun was fired. As it came off, one of these plastic fasteners struck and injured his left eye.
An employee was standing on the side of a road after a vehicle incident. Another vehicle swerved and hit the employee.

An employee was hoisting an 18-inch, 6-foot wooden work platform from the ground to a height of 12 feet. The cleat used to secure the rope failed causing the platform to fall 2-3 feet. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.

An employee was taking a break by a baghouse after shoveling hot pellets that were being expelled from a cooler. While the pellets were still being expelled from the cooler hopper, a flame shot out of the discharge pipe, then backdrafted up the pipe into the cooler and then into the bag house. The employee suffered burns to the hands and arms from the resulting explosion.
An employee was troubleshooting a vacuum system when a pneumatic cylinder actuated and struck his right index finger. He was hospitalized and suffered an amputation.

The injured employee was standing by a bag house that that was approximately 27 feet away from where a discharge pipe was discharging wood pellets. A fire came out of the pipe and back flashed through a cooler and back through the piping system to the bag house where an explosion occurred. The employee sustained burns to the arms, neck, and torso.

The injured employee was parked in a tugger. A reach truck driver was relocating a container that was behind a stack of containers. The forks came into contact with the stack of containers, tipping it over onto the injured employee's tugger. The injured employee was hospitalized with lacerations to both hands and the right side of their face.
An automated guided vehicle (AGV) was transporting a pole. The pole struck the injured employee in the chest.
An employee was moving 4-inch pieces of solid round material, cradled in a sling. The employee's right middle finger was pinched between two pieces of the material and partially amputated.
A commercial jet aircraft crashed into the northwest corner of the facility and a fire resulted. An employee inside the facility sustained burns to his head, neck, and back.

An employee was working from a scaffold about 20 feet high, installing snow rails on a standing seam roof. He fell through the guardrail/toe board opening at the scaffold's ladder access, landing on a railroad timber on the ground. He suffered a broken left femur.

An employee was pushing expanded metal material through a leveler when the glove on their left hand became caught on rollers. Three left hand fingers were crushed in the rollers. The employee required medical amputation of the index finger to the proximal joint and amputation of the middle finger to the middle joint. The left ring finger and thumb were lacerated.
An employee was retrieving a broken part from an automation machine when the machine actuated and broke his right index finger. He was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee was spreading gravel on top of a building when a mini loader drove onto his leg and broke it.
An employee was installing a conveyor belt. While he was under it, the conveyor roller pulled in his safety vest and left arm. The arm was broken. The employee was hospitalized, undergoing surgery.
An employee lost his balance while getting into a vehicle, fell backward, and hit his head on the pavement. He suffered a head contusion and was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to push trash off the sill of a hopper. The cart tipper was activated, and as it rose it pinched the employee's left hand against the sill. The employee's little fingertip was amputated.
An employee was mounting a tugger and engaged the throttle. The tugger spun backward in a circle and pinned her left leg against a short beam and desk which resulted in fractures to the leg.
An employee was tripping pipe on a drilling rig. His right hand was caught with the drilling rods in the hole as the rods were being unscrewed, and his little finger was amputated.
An employee was helping another employee with a roll of cured tread that had fallen over in a storage rack. Another roll of tread fell and hit the employee, who suffered a back injury.

An employee was replacing a broken hasp on a gang box. Combustible vapor from a 10-cubic-foot low-pressure acetylene cylinder in the box ignited. The employee suffered multiple burns, a head laceration, and a fractured arm, cheek and nose.

At about 2:15 p.m. on September 3, 2021, employee 1 was assisting in the placement of the jib extension back onto the cradle position for transport. Employee 1 was standing on the work platform near the crane cab. Employee 2 was at the front of the crane where the jib extension was secured to the crane itself. Employee 3 was on the ground at the front of the crane. The crane operator was inside the cab. Employee 2 attempted to free the extension from the crane itself and  knocked out the remaining pin securing the extension. This action caused the extension to fall from the crane. The falling extension may have struck employee 1 before he fell to the ground below the work platform. Employee 2 was knocked off the ladder and also fell to the ground. Employee 1 sustained a shoulder fracture and contusion.

An employee was adjusting straps for a sheetrock truck. While moving to step off the truck, the employee stepped on a board that snapped, causing the employee to fall to the ground. The employee suffered a back injury.

An employee was changing an oil filter on a material handler while standing on the tire of the material handler. The tire rotated, causing the employee to lose balance and jump three feet to the ground below. The employee sustained a broken foot.
An employee was cleaning carpet pieces using a pressure washer. High-pressure water hit the employee's left hand, cutting the top of the hand.
While dispensing icing into a container, an employee went to unclog some of the material from a mixer. A rotating shaft inside the mixer caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.

On September 3, 2021, an employee was troubleshooting an extruder take-away conveyor. As the chain and sprocket was rotated, it pinched the employee's right index finger and the sprocket's teeth lacerated the employee's fingertip. The fingertip was medically amputated.

An employee was stacking racks for transporting insulated glass units. He was placing the fourth rack on top. It failed to settle onto the pins at first, then fell into place when bumped. It crushed the tip of his right little finger, causing a fingertip amputation.
An employee was putting on a cleanroom suit. When he stood up, he slipped and twisted his left ankle resulting in a fall and a fractured ankle.

An employee was troubleshooting an applicator roller on a can printer. The roller activated and pulled in the employee's right hand. The skin was torn off the hand and palm and the little finger was crushed.

An employee had just lowered a bundle of scaffold frame to the ground with a crane. He released the chains from the bundle and was walking away when the scaffold frame fell onto the back of his right arm and his right little finger. The fingertip was amputated.
An employee was assembling an irrigation unit when a metal support bracket fell and pinched their right index finger against a metal bar. The fingertip was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee was using a brake press to bend metal for production. The press caught the employee's right thumb, removing the fingernail and flesh about a quarter inch from the thumb tip.
An employee slipped and fell on wet ground, suffering a laceration to the right side of the face. The employee was hospitalized for stitches and additional surgery.

A cooling tower fan had stopped working. The breaker feeding the fan had been turned off, and an employee was investigating the problem with the fan. The subpanel was connected to a variable-speed motor; a circuit overloaded and an arc flash burned the employee's left arm, forearm, and hand.
An employee was operating a reach truck. During a turn, his left foot was crushed between the vehicle and the yellow upright bumper guard of some racking.

On September 3, 2021, an employee was climbing down a 6-foot A-frame ladder after cleaning an AC drain. He lost his balance, fell, and hit his head on the top of a cubicle wall. He suffered a head injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was installing a bus exhaust system. When the exhaust slid into place, the employee's arm was lacerated by the exhaust shield. The employee was hospitalized.

At about 10:00 p.m. on September 3, 2021, an employee was climbing down an approximately 6-foot A-frame ladder after painting air conditioning vents on a ceiling. One of his feet got caught and the other left the ladder at the third or fourth rung, resulting in a compound fracture to the left ankle.
An employee's knee struck a table as the employee was standing up from a chair. The employee fell to the floor and suffered a broken hip.
Employees were trying to close a stuck sliding door. An employee's left hand was jammed between the two doors, causing a partial amputation to the little finger.
On September 3, 2021, an employee was trying to lift open a metal-framed window. The window slammed down and amputated the employee's right ring fingertip.
An employee was polishing a 3/4" x 13 1/4" steel shaft in a lathe using emery paper. The emery paper got caught around the workpiece and the employee's right ring finger was amputated.
An employee was operating a jib boom with an aluminum hand controller. The controller shocked the employee.

An employee was using a jib crane to move a pallet of brick into a ladle. The pendant controller shocked him. He was unable to release his right hand from the controller and slowly fell to the floor of the concrete platform, suffering a chipped bone in the left shoulder and a sprained right ankle.

Employees were installing grounding tools as part of an addition to a compressor station. An employee was hammer-drilling a ground rod when the edge of a trench failed; the employee slipped, fell, and landed on the rod, which impaled his inner thigh.

An employee fell while walking out of a kitchen. The employee's side struck the floor, and the employee suffered an injury to the shoulder, back, and side. The employee was hospitalized for hip surgery.
An employee was scanning a patient's wrist band when her foot was caught in the loop of a bed lift. She tripped and fell to the floor, shattering her elbow and hitting her head.
An employee was loading cardboard boxes onto a bailer. When the employee closed the bailer's gate, the bailer caught the tip of the employee's finger. The fingertip was amputated.

An employee was unloading animal feed from a trailer through an auger. The feed got plugged, and the employee was clearing the auger when his left hand was caught in it. He suffered an amputation to the middle finger.
On a vessel, an employee stepped into an open manhole and fell to the deck. The employee sustained fractured ribs and a collapsed lung.
An employee was operating a table saw. The wood kicked and a shard of it pierced the employee's abdomen.
While walking in the storeroom an employee tripped on a drying rack and fell on the floor breaking her right hip. The employee required surgery.
The employee was helping load seed into a seed spreader. The employee was injured when they stepped on a tire that moved, which caused them to fall.

An employee was putting a metal cover on a frame belt. An end of the cover got caught on some frames passing underneath, causing the cover to pinch the employee's right little finger and ring finger. The little finger was amputated just below the nail.

An employee was driving an electric bag tug from one airport concourse to another. While turning right to enter a bag room area, the employee's tug collided with another tug. The employee suffered two broken ribs on the left side; a lacerated spleen (with internal bleeding); and contusions and abrasions to the left side of the head, forehead, left knee, and left arm.
An employee who works on the beach renting personal water craft (PWC) and kayaks sustained heat stroke.

An employee was replacing a 3-inch belt that had fallen off a flywheel. When he placed the belt back on the flywheel, the spinning wheel caused his left hand to be pulled into a pinch point. He suffered amputations to the index and middle fingers.

An employee was operating a pallet jack to select product for an order. The employee was maneuvering the pallet jack around a steel bollard in the warehouse when his feet were pinned between the bollard and the pallet jack resulting in a right foot fracture and a laceration on the left foot requiring stitches. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was working in a kitchen area when a pot caught fire. The employee suffered third-degree burns to the right arm while moving it.
An employee was cutting bone-in ribeyes on a meat saw. A piece of meat twisted and pulled his right hand into the saw, which amputated the tip of the thumb and lacerated the index finger.

An employee was in a trailer, using an electric pallet jack to realign a pallet of product that had shifted during shipment. The employee was caught between a pallet and the jack's handle; the employee suffered a laceration and/or puncture to the lower abdomen.
An employee opened a dryer to take clothes out and her finger got caught in the machine, likely the dryer's door. The employee sustained an amputation to the right index finger.

An employee was at the extruder pushing pipe down the line. As the employee was manually positioning a piece of pipe that was being heated, his finger was caught in an unguarded rotator chain resulting in an amputation.

In the early morning of September 6, 2021, an employee was traveling on a powered cart when its front passenger tire contacted a handrail post on the side of the roadway. The cart tipped onto its left side, and the employee suffered a laceration to the lower left leg and multiple fractures to the right ankle. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was trying to remove an automobile floor mat from a rug beater machine. The side service panel had been removed from the machine so she could diagnose a possible issue with the machine. The mat came free, and her right hand slipped into the path of the machine's chain and sprocket. Her right index finger was amputated at or near the first knuckle.
An employee was breaking down a skid on the dock. The employee tripped on the corner of the skid and fell face-first onto the concrete ground. The employee's knee was fractured.
An employee was helping connect tubing on a hydrowalk. His middle finger was pinched between the tubing and the hydrowalk. The finger was amputated.

An employee was trying to slide a work platform back into its housing. His middle finger was caught between the midrail and the side safety gate of the platform. The pad of the finger was severely lacerated, and was medically amputated.

On September 7, 2021, an employee was using a utility knife (in his right hand) to open a floor box containing an electrical enclosure. When he swung the knife upward to cut through the tape, it lacerated his left wrist. He was hospitalized.

The injured employee was working in a two-person team conducting troubleshooting and repair of an onboard boat engine. The engine started and the injured employee's right index fingertip was amputated. The cowling guards had been removed to provide access to the engine components.

An employee was investigating a possible malfunction in a vacuum cleaner system for removing powder paint from paint booths. While his right hand was in the discharge outlet of a rotary airlock valve on a dust collector, the blade inside the valve caught his glove and pulled his hand further in. He suffered partial amputations to two fingers, losing half of each one.

An employee was troubleshooting a dock plate on the loading dock with other maintenance workers. When the lockout pin on the dock plate was removed, the plate fell down and caught the employee's left leg. The employee sustained a compound fracture of the left femur and a head laceration.
An employee was using a spray hose to clean conveyors when her forearm became caught in a conveyor belt. Skin was removed from the forearm.
An employee was moving from a scaffold ladder to the scaffold platform when he fell to the ground 15 feet below. He suffered a broken right wrist and broken ribs.
An employee was loading a press machine when their left forearm was struck and lacerated by the sheet of corrugated metal that was being loaded. The laceration resulted in tendon damage.
An employee was adjusting a car lift arm when the lift arm raised up, pinning the employee's hand between the lift arm and a car. The employee sustained fractures to the hand.
An employee was cleaning debris in a confined space (vault). Electric power surged through wires, and the employee was burned.

An employee was starting her shift at the fuel station. She walked past a person that had a dog carrier attached to their bicycle. The dog was on a leash, but it jumped out of the carrier and bit the employee's left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was replacing a conveyor belt when his right hand was caught between the belt and the sprocket. His hand and fingers were crushed in the sprocket and he was hospitalized.
An employee was standing in a bike lane, using a backpack leaf blower to blow grass off a street onto the sidewalk. A passing car struck the employee, who suffered a broken left arm and left foot.
At 4:00 p.m. on September 7, 2021, an employee stepped on a nail that punctured his right foot. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery to remove the nail.

At about 4:30 p.m. on September 7, 2021, an employee was guiding plastic material into a winding machine for an operator. The machine pulled in the employee's hand and broke it. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was unloading product from a truck when they slipped and fell from the liftgate of the truck onto the concrete parking lot. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left wrist.

An employee was maneuvering around a pallet when her foot hit the corner and she fell to the ground. As she tried to brace herself, her left arm struck against another pallet of rolled plastic and her left humerus was broken.
An employee was lowering the landing gear of a trailer. The crankshaft lacerated the employee's face.

A temporary employee was standing on a rider jack as it left one aisle and entered another. The employee could not slow down the rider jack fast enough and jumped off. The employee's left leg was crushed between the jack and an upright.

An employee was winching cages down to a drop-deck live-haul trailer. The terminal tractor moved in reverse and the employee was pinned between the fifth wheel and the trailer kingpin area. The employee suffered multiple fractures and lacerations.
An employee was trying to remove a stuck pin on a loading dock. The employee fell off the loading dock about 3 feet to the pavement below, suffering a broken right tibia and fibula.
A forklift struck an employee with its forks, injuring the employee's right leg.
A forklift's fork struck an Amazon employee in the right leg, causing a contusion and a cut and possibly necessitating the medical amputation of the right foot.
An employee was using a saw to cut off a casting. The saw blade contacted the employee's left thumb, causing an amputation to the thumb.
An employee had been washing dishes. The employee's right leg gave out and she fell.

An employee was walking between two registers. As she stepped over a chain separating the register areas, her back foot caught the chain and she fell to the ground. She suffered a broken pelvis and was hospitalized.

An employee was starting up machines after a holiday. Noticing a jam on the powder feed system, he tried to remove a valve. The butterfly mechanism in the valve closed and amputated the tip of his right middle finger.

An employee was trying to set a bucket of tools and parts into a modular apartment. His right foot was caught under a caster/wheel that the apartment rolled on. He suffered two broken toes and a wound that required 25 stitches in his right foot; he was hospitalized.
An employee was hospitalized due to an infection of the left foot caused by tight boots.
An employee was walking down a vacant hallway when they fell on the wet floor and fractured their hip. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was backing up a forklift. As it turned, his right upper arm was pinched between it and a material storage rack. He suffered a deep tissue avulsion above the elbow.
An employee was moving a 96-gallon residential cart when chemical fluids spilled out of a bottle onto his left arm. The arm was burned.

On September 7, 2021, an employee had adjusted a chain link fence and was standing next to the fence. A forklift moved towards him and crushed his right hand against a fence pole. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was replacing springs on a pallet labeler when his foot got caught in the pallet rollers on the line. The employee sustained fractures to his foot and toes.
An employee was rigging a cable on a roof. He fell through a skylight, landing on a car about 15 to 20 feet below and suffering a concussion and a broken femur.
An employee tripped and fell in a hallway, striking her head on the floor and suffering a head injury.

An employee had been backfilling a previous excavation. As the employee walked along the duct bank, a portion of a steel support plate shifted and crushed the employee's leg. The employee's left femur was fractured.

An employee was going to clean a patient room. She turned to walk into the room, lost her footing, hit the door jamb, fell on her knees and then onto the floor. The employee sustained a fractured right humerus.

An employee had just installed a temporary PVC bypass pipe to flush a system. The pipe was connected to hot water, and the water melted the glue joints on the pipe. Hot water sprayed onto the employee's chest and burned it.
An employee had been working on a pool and was feeling unwell with heavy breathing and muscle cramps. The employee was hospitalized with a heat illness and dehydration.

An employee was in a tree, cutting off the top. The tree shook and the employee's safety line hopped over where the cut was made. The employee fell to the ground, suffering pelvis and rib fractures and a spine injury.

An employee was walking back to her office, carrying three bottles, when she tripped and fell over a floor tile that was missing a piece. She fell on her right knee, left arm, and left elbow; she was hospitalized, requiring surgery to the arm.

Employees were repairing a guardrail system which had been damaged by back-fill soil material. A skid-steer was removing soil from the guardrail system while the injured employee was pulling a stanchion out and away from the skid-steer bucket. The bucket caught the employee's right index finger against the stanchion; the fingertip was amputated.
An employee was unloading wooden utility poles. A pole was put on ground by a front-end loader. The pole then rolled downhill onto the employee's leg fracturing the tibia and fibula.
An employee was rolling up a water hose next to a steam filler. Hot water came out of the steam filler and burned his shoulder and chest.
An employee was running to climb onto a truck. The employee slipped and the truck ran over their foot.

An employee was mudding the door on an oven. The employee fell approximately 15 feet from the mud cart to the concrete floor on the next lower level. The employee sustained fractured ribs, thoracic spine, and teeth.
An employee was walking in the store parking lot when he tripped or lost balance and fell to the ground, injuring his hip.
An employee was cutting product on a chuck saw when the saw amputated the tip of their right thumb above the fingernail.
An employee was unloading a generator. The generator slipped from his hands and fell on his right ring finger. The fingertip was medically amputated.
An employee was cleaning a conveyor belt. The belt caught the employee's left hand and arm, breaking the arm. The employee was hospitalized.
A nurse was performing a restraint on a combative patient and sustained a tear to his quadriceps that required surgery.
While leaving a room, an employee tripped on folded mats outside the door and fell to the floor, suffering a broken hip.
An employee was changing the belt on a pulley system that turned a blower fan. His right middle finger was caught between the belt and the pulley and amputated below the nail.

An employee was operating a battery-operated pallet jack. As the jack turned a corner, the employee fell. She struck the concrete floor and the racking, suffering a right pelvic fracture, a left sacral fracture, and a fracture to a lower-back vertebra.

An employee was replacing high hats when he was shocked by electricity and fell from the second step of a ladder to the ground. In addition to being shocked, the employee sustained a leg injury and was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning a food preparation machine. A blade in the machine lacerated her right index and middle fingers resulting in partial amputation.

An employee was standing in a laundry area, in front of a washing machine, after emptying a plastic bag of laundry into the washer. The employee dropped the bag, slipped on it, and fell. Her right hip struck the concrete floor and the metal threshold of a doorway. The hip was broken and she was hospitalized.
An employee was watching an oven roller as part of the manufacturing process when their right index finger was caught in a pinch point resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee fell from a ladder and was hospitalized for surgery.

An employee was pushing a newly cut section of beef down a conveyor belt. A hook, used to reach and hold the piece in place, did not release when the employee pushed the piece down the conveyor. The piece of beef then pulled the employee off balance. The employee's right hand slipped into the sawblade, which amputated the index finger.

An employee was deburring a 1-inch carbon steel pipe on a lathe for weld practice. The employee was polishing the outside diameter of the pipe using emery cloth. The employee was straddling the pipe, with one hand on each end of the cloth, when the rotating pipe pulled in the employee's glove and right hand. The employee's right index finger was amputated at the first knuckle.
An employee bent down between two stacks of pallets to inspect a packing slip on a pallet on the floor. When she stood up, her back struck the edge of a wooden pallet and was injured.
While climbing a 5-foot ladder, an employee fell 3 feet to the floor and sustained injury to his shoulder, wrist, and right leg.

An employee was on a ladder, replacing the motor of a fan box in a classroom. He lost his balance, fell from the ladder to the carpeted concrete floor, and suffered a compound fracture to the right ankle.
An employee fell from a 6-foot step ladder while installing a monitor and sustained an injury requiring hospitalization.

On 9/08/2021, a concrete truck driver was repairing a rear light approximately 7-8 feet above the ground. He lost his grip and his hand got caught between the roller and the drum. He lost a fingernail and required amputation to the right ring finger.
An employee was adjusting an encapsulating tabulating machine press. The machine activated and came down on the employee's right hand, amputating the middle fingertip.
An employee was opening boxes with a safety knife. The knife lacerated the inside of the employee's left wrist.
An employee was using a pair of scissors to open a bag containing an ink cartridge for his printer. The employee sustained an amputation to the left middle fingertip without damage to the fingernail.
An employee slipped and fell down stairs, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee suffered an amputation and was hospitalized.

An employee was working with a 50-ton swage machine pressing metal beads onto wire rope. The employee was using an Allen wrench to position the part between the dies when the machine closed on their right index finger resulting in a fingertip amputation to the first knuckle.
While pushing hindquarters through a band saw, an employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee fell into a hole covered by a piece of plywood that broke. The employee landed 10 feet below and suffered a broken right leg.
On September 9, 2021, an employee was taping house wrap onto the outside of a two-story residential home. The employee fell 15 feet from a ladder and sustained injury to their head and back.
An employee was moving boxes and began to feel severe chest pains. The employee was hospitalized for possible heart issues.

An employee was stepping onto an electric pallet jack when it activated, jerked, and pinned his leg against a stack of pallets. He suffered a compound fracture to the lower left leg, at the ankle, and was hospitalized.

An employee went out into the parking lot of the establishment to confront a client that was told to leave. The client got into his vehicle and used it to strike the employee. The employee sustained a concussion and possible brain bleed.
An employee fell off a golf cart and hit his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee was transferring supplies to another store and was struck by a customer's car.
An employee was installing a portable weather station for use against a wildfire. The employee slipped on a moss-covered rock and fell to the ground, suffering a broken right femur at the ball joint.

Employees were securing a 40-foot ladder to the trim of a building. The extension portion of the ladder descended, causing an employee on the ladder to fall to the ground 8 to 10 feet below. The employee suffered a shoulder and back injury.
An employee was unloading a metal cart of parts. A door hinge closed on the employee's left middle finger, amputating the tip.
An employee was standing behind another employee who was tightening the blade on a bandsaw. A piece of metal from the tensioner spring bolt struck the employee in the knee.

An employee was repairing a patch in a grain trough that spans across from the corn bins to the steam closets. The employee reached under the trough to clean out some corn. His right middle finger got caught where the patch was going and he sustained an amputation at the nailbed.
An employee's thumb was caught in a radiator fan and lacerated.

The injured employee was unloading a truck and staging materials while flagging/directing a forklift. As the operator shifted the load, the forks of the forklift bumped a steel beam that was staged on top of wood dunnage. The beam shifted and fell onto the injured employee's left foot. The employee sustained 15 fractures to his foot that required hospitalization and surgery.
An employee was pinned between a forklift and a metal door. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
On 9/9/2021, an employee was inspecting an array for defects when he was bitten on the leg by a snake.
